explanation: 移改变，变动。稳定坚强，毫不动摇。
explanationTraditional: 移改變，變動。穩定堅強，毫不動搖。
explanationEn: Steadfast and unyielding; firm and unwavering.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·唐记·文宗开成五年》推心委任，坚定不移，则天下何忧不理哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·唐記·文宗開成五年》推心委任，堅定不移，則天下何憂不理哉！”
derivationEn: From 'Zizhi Tongjian·Tang Ji·Emperor Wenzong's Kaicheng Reign': 'If you entrust with sincerity and remain steadfast and unyielding, then why worry about the world not being well-governed?'
example: 他们走得很慢，然而是～地向前走。★茹志娟《澄河边上》
exampleTraditional: 他們走得很慢，然而是～地向前走。★茹志娟《澄河邊上》
exampleEn: They walked slowly, but moved forward steadfastly and unyieldingly. (Ru Zhijuan, 'By the Cheng River')

explanation: ①指依照当时当地情形；在不同的时间、地点。②任何时间、地点；时时处处。
explanationTraditional: ①指依照當時當地情形；在不同的時間、地點。②任何時間、地點；時時處處。
explanationEn: At any time and any place; according to the circumstances.
derivation: 清·周中孚《郑堂札记》卷一游山诗有时地之异宜，随时随地，设色布景，否者皆陈言也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·週中孚《鄭堂札記》卷一遊山詩有時地之異宜，隨時隨地，設色佈景，否者皆陳言也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhou Zhongfu's 'Zheng Tang Notes': 'Poems about mountain tours vary with time and place; one must adapt to the situation in setting scenes and colors, otherwise they are all clichés.'
example: 有人向他建议多招募民间乡勇，分散在宁波、镇海、定海附近，～以小队水陆分扰乱人。★郭沫若《中国史稿》第五编第一章第一节
exampleTraditional: 有人向他建議多招募民間鄉勇，分散在寧波、鎮海、定海附近，～以小隊水陸分擾亂人。★郭沫若《中國史稿》第五編第一章第一節
exampleEn: Someone suggested recruiting more local militia and dispersing them near Ningbo, Zhenhai, and Dinghai, to harass the enemy with small units by land and water at any time and place. (Guo Moruo, 'History of China', Vol. 5, Chapter 1, Section 1)

explanation: 赴前往。把全部力量都投入进去。
explanationTraditional: 赴前往。把全部力量都投入進去。
explanationEn: To go all out; to spare no effort.
derivation: 清·越翼《廿二史札记·五·东汉尚名节》盖当时荐徵辟，必采名誉，故凡可以得名者，必全力赴之，好为苟难，遂成风俗。”
derivationTraditional: 清·越翼《廿二史札記·五·東漢尚名節》蓋當時薦徵闢，必採名譽，故凡可以得名者，必全力赴之，好為苟難，遂成風俗。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhao Yi's 'Notes on the Twenty-Two Histories': 'At that time, recommendations and appointments were based on reputation, so anyone who could gain fame would go all out, even doing difficult things, thus forming a custom.'
example: 他们缺乏一种主动的积极的高兴的欢迎的～的精神。（毛泽东《〈中国农村的社会主义高潮〉序言》）
exampleTraditional: 他們缺乏一種主動的積極的高興的歡迎的～的精神。（毛澤東《〈中國農村的社會主義高潮〉序言》）
exampleEn: They lack a proactive, enthusiastic, welcoming, and all-out spirit. (Mao Zedong, 'Preface to 'The Socialist Upsurge in China's Countryside'')

explanation: 内容丰富，花色繁多。
explanationTraditional: 內容豐富，花色繁多。
explanationEn: Rich and varied; colorful and diverse.
derivation: 峻青《秋色赋》一个不久前才由机关、工厂的业余戏剧爱好者所组织进来的吕剧团，演出了丰富多彩的节目，非常令人兴奋。”
derivationTraditional: 峻青《秋色賦》一個不久前才由機關、工廠的業餘戲劇愛好者所組織進來的呂劇團，演出了豐富多彩的節目，非常令人興奮。”
derivationEn: From Jun Qing's 'Autumn Colors': 'A newly formed Lü opera troupe, organized by amateur drama enthusiasts from offices and factories, performed a rich and varied program that was very exciting.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指某一事件虽然结束了，可是留下的影响还在起作用。
explanationTraditional: 指某一事件雖然結束了，可是留下的影響還在起作用。
explanationEn: The aftermath is not yet settled; the repercussions are still ongoing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 颖尖子。锥尖透过布囊显露出来。比喻本领全部显露出来。
explanationTraditional: 穎尖子。錐尖透過布囊顯露出來。比喻本領全部顯露出來。
explanationEn: To stand out; to show one's talent prominently.
derivation: 《史记·平原君虞卿列传》使遂早得处囊中，乃脱颖而出，非特其末见而已。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原君虞卿列傳》使遂早得處囊中，乃脫穎而出，非特其末見而已。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian·Biography of Lord Pingyuan and Yu Qing': 'If I had been placed in the bag earlier, I would have emerged, not just showing the tip.'
example: 经过艰苦努力，他的学习成绩终于在全班～。
exampleTraditional: 經過艱苦努力，他的學習成績終於在全班～。
exampleEn: After hard work, his academic performance finally stood out in the class.

explanation: 指从实际对象出发，探求事物的内部联系及其发展的规律性，认识事物的本质。通常指按照事物的实际情况办事。
explanationTraditional: 指從實際對象出發，探求事物的內部聯繫及其發展的規律性，認識事物的本質。通常指按照事物的實際情況辦事。
explanationEn: To seek truth from facts; to be practical and realistic.
derivation: 《汉书·河间献王刘德传》修学好古，实事求是。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·河間獻王劉德傳》修學好古，實事求是。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han·Biography of Liu De, Prince of Hejian': 'He cultivated learning and loved antiquity, seeking truth from facts.'
example: 总结经验要～，不可弄虚做假。
exampleTraditional: 總結經驗要～，不可弄虛做假。
exampleEn: When summing up experience, one must be practical and realistic, not falsify.

explanation: 一完全；既往从前，已往。指态度没有变化，完全象从前一样。
explanationTraditional: 一完全；既往從前，已往。指態度沒有變化，完全象從前一樣。
explanationEn: Just as in the past; as always.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 可是，中国又穷又弱的现状～，丝毫无所改变。（张扬《第二次握手》六）
exampleTraditional: 可是，中國又窮又弱的現狀～，絲毫無所改變。（張揚《第二次握手》六）
exampleEn: But China's poor and weak condition remained just as in the past, unchanged at all. (Zhang Yang, 'Second Handshake', Chapter 6)

explanation: 大家普遍知道的。
explanationTraditional: 大家普遍知道的。
explanationEn: As everyone knows; it is well known.
derivation: 《玉娇梨》第二十回城中宣杂难住，莫苦就在众所周知石村卜一居，与白公为邻。”
derivationTraditional: 《玉嬌梨》第二十回城中宣雜難住，莫苦就在眾所周知石村卜一居，與白公為鄰。”
derivationEn: From 'Jade Charming' (Yu Jiao Li), Chapter 20: 'The city is too noisy and hard to live in; it's better to settle in the well-known Stone Village near Mr. Bai.'
example: 这种小说的生产，～，主要是为了爆炸”，所以他特别注意的是政治上的应时。★孙犁《文林谈屑（一）·运动文学与揣摩小说》
exampleTraditional: 這種小說的生產，～，主要是為了爆炸”，所以他特別注意的是政治上的應時。★孫犁《文林談屑（一）·運動文學與揣摩小說》
exampleEn: It is well known that this kind of novel production is mainly for 'explosion', so he pays special attention to political timeliness. (Sun Li, 'Literary Ramblings (1): Campaign Literature and Speculative Novels')

explanation: 指每年一次。
explanationTraditional: 指每年一次。
explanationEn: Once a year; annually.
derivation: 宋·王安石《送吴显道》诗之五惟有春风应最惜，一年一度一归来。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王安石《送吳顯道》詩之五惟有春風應最惜，一年一度一歸來。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wang Anshi's poem 'Seeing Wu Xian Off': 'Only the spring breeze cherishes most, returning once a year.'
example: ～秋风劲，不似春光。胜似春光，廖廓江天万里霜。★毛泽东《采桑子·重阳》词
exampleTraditional: ～秋風勁，不似春光。勝似春光，廖廓江天萬里霜。★毛澤東《採桑子·重陽》詞
exampleEn: The autumn wind blows once a year, unlike the spring scenery. Yet surpassing spring scenery, vast frost covers the sky. (Mao Zedong, 'Picking Mulberries·Double Ninth Festival')

explanation: 因依据；制制定；宜适当的措施。根据各地的具体情况，制定适宜的办法。
explanationTraditional: 因依據；制制定；宜適當的措施。根據各地的具體情況，制定適宜的辦法。
explanationEn: To take measures suitable to local conditions.
derivation: 汉·赵晔《吴越春秋·阖闾内传》夫筑城郭，立仓库，因地制宜，岂有天气之数以威邻国者乎？”
derivationTraditional: 漢·趙曄《吳越春秋·闔閭內傳》夫築城郭，立倉庫，因地制宜，豈有天氣之數以威鄰國者乎？”
derivationEn: From Zhao Ye's 'Wu Yue Chun Qiu' in the Han Dynasty: 'Building city walls and granaries, taking measures suitable to local conditions, how could there be a mandate of heaven to intimidate neighboring states?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 想尽或用尽一切办法。
explanationTraditional: 想盡或用盡一切辦法。
explanationEn: To try every possible means; to do everything possible.
derivation: 《朱子语类·论语十七》譬如捉贼相似，须是着起气力精神，千方百计去赶他。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子語類·論語十七》譬如捉賊相似，須是著起氣力精神，千方百計去趕他。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Zi Yu Lei': 'It is like catching a thief; you must exert all your energy and spirit, trying every possible means to catch him.'
example: 这个老匪开初～想收买这支已经武装了的工人队伍，可是工人们坚决拒绝加入匪股。★曲波《林海雪原》十四
exampleTraditional: 這個老匪開初～想收買這支已經武裝了的工人隊伍，可是工人們堅決拒絕加入匪股。★曲波《林海雪原》十四
exampleEn: At first, the old bandit tried every possible means to buy over this already armed workers' team, but the workers firmly refused to join the bandits. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 14

explanation: 息呼吸时进出的气◆吸也相互关联。形容彼此的关系非常密切。
explanationTraditional: 息呼吸時進出的氣◆吸也相互關聯。形容彼此的關係非常密切。
explanationEn: Closely related; intimately connected.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 水是生命的源泉，水与生命的起源息息相关。
exampleTraditional: 水是生命的源泉，水與生命的起源息息相關。
exampleEn: Water is the source of life, and water is closely related to the origin of life.

explanation: 层重复；穷尽。接连不断地出现，没有穷尽。
explanationTraditional: 層重複；窮盡。接連不斷地出現，沒有窮盡。
explanationEn: To emerge in an endless stream; to occur frequently.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《贞曜先生墓志铭》神施鬼设，间见层出。”《唐书·艺文志》历代盛衰，文章与时高下；然其变能百出，不可穷极，何其兴衰。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《貞曜先生墓誌銘》神施鬼設，間見層出。”《唐書·藝文志》歷代盛衰，文章與時高下；然其變能百出，不可窮極，何其興衰。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Mr. Zhen Yao' in the Tang Dynasty: 'Divine and ghostly arrangements, appearing layer upon layer.' Also from 'Tang Shu Yi Wen Zhi': 'The rise and fall of dynasties, literature changes with the times; yet its variations emerge in hundreds of ways, inexhaustible.'
example: 爱国精神之表现于中外文学里已经是～的，数不胜数了。★闻一多《文艺与爱国——纪念三月十八》
exampleTraditional: 愛國精神之表現於中外文學裡已經是～的，數不勝數了。★聞一多《文藝與愛國——紀念三月十八》
exampleEn: The expression of patriotism in Chinese and foreign literature has been emerging in an endless stream, countless in number. — Wen Yiduo, 'Literature and Patriotism — Commemorating March 18'

explanation: 注目注视。吸引人们注意。
explanationTraditional: 注目注視。吸引人們注意。
explanationEn: To attract attention; eye-catching.
derivation: 毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》也有敲打铜锣，高举旗帜，引人注目的。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》也有敲打銅鑼，高舉旗幟，引人注目的。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan': 'There are also those who beat gongs and copper drums, raise high banners, and attract attention.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 当务指应当办理的事。当前任务中最急切要办的事。
explanationTraditional: 當務指應當辦理的事。當前任務中最急切要辦的事。
explanationEn: The most urgent task at hand; top priority.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》知者无不知也，当务之为急；仁者无不爱也，急亲贤之为务。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》知者無不知也，當務之為急；仁者無不愛也，急親賢之為務。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jin Xin I': 'The wise have no knowledge that they do not seek, but they prioritize what is urgent; the benevolent have no one they do not love, but they prioritize亲近 virtuous and talented people.'
example: 今学者～，曰中国古今史，曰泰东西古近史。★清·沈惟贤《万国演义序》
exampleTraditional: 今學者～，曰中國古今史，曰泰東西古近史。★清·沈惟賢《萬國演義序》
exampleEn: The most urgent task for today's scholars is to study Chinese history from ancient to modern times and the history of the East and West. — Qing Dynasty, Shen Weixian, 'Preface to Wan Guo Yan Yi'

explanation: 指过分地或非法地行使自己掌握的权力。
explanationTraditional: 指過分地或非法地行使自己掌握的權力。
explanationEn: To abuse one's power; to misuse authority.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们不能～去谋私利。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能～去謀私利。
exampleEn: We must not abuse our power for personal gain.

explanation: 指理论、学说、政策等为人们深切了解和信服。
explanationTraditional: 指理論、學說、政策等為人們深切瞭解和信服。
explanationEn: To be deeply rooted in people's hearts; to win popular support.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第二十回且君新得诸侯，非有存亡兴灭之德，深入人心，恐诸侯之兵，不为我用。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第二十回且君新得諸侯，非有存亡興滅之德，深入人心，恐諸侯之兵，不為我用。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 20: 'Moreover, you have newly won over the vassals; without the virtue of preserving or reviving states, deeply rooted in people's hearts, I fear the vassals' troops will not be used by you.'
example: 可是总没有这位先生的讲说那样一句句～。★叶圣陶《英文教授》
exampleTraditional: 可是總沒有這位先生的講說那樣一句句～。★葉聖陶《英文教授》
exampleEn: But none of them were as deeply rooted in people's hearts as this gentleman's lecture. — Ye Shengtao, 'The English Professor'

explanation: 看到正义的事，就勇敢地去做。
explanationTraditional: 看到正義的事，就勇敢地去做。
explanationEn: To act bravely for a just cause; to do what is righteous without hesitation.
derivation: 《论语·为政》见义不为，无勇也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·為政》見義不為，無勇也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Wei Zheng': 'To see what is right and not do it is cowardice.'
example: ～真汉子，莫将成败论英雄。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十四回
exampleTraditional: ～真漢子，莫將成敗論英雄。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十四回
exampleEn: A true man acts bravely for a just cause; do not judge heroes by success or failure. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 14

explanation: 依仗势力或抓籽柄进行恐吓，用威胁手段索取财物。
explanationTraditional: 依仗勢力或抓籽柄進行恐嚇，用威脅手段索取財物。
explanationEn: To extort; to blackmail.
derivation: 曲波《林海雪原》三三一名宋福，一名王大路，专门纠察库仑比的淘金工作和山林工人，为非作歹，敲诈勒索，无恶不作。”
derivationTraditional: 曲波《林海雪原》三三一名宋福，一名王大路，專門糾察庫侖比的淘金工作和山林工人，為非作歹，敲詐勒索，無惡不作。”
derivationEn: From Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 33: 'One named Song Fu, another named Wang Dalu, specialized in supervising Kulunbi's gold panning and forest workers, committing all kinds of evil, extorting and blackmailing, and stopping at nothing.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 虚假。传出的名声不是虚假的。指实在很好，不是空有虚名。
explanationTraditional: 虛假。傳出的名聲不是虛假的。指實在很好，不是空有虛名。
explanationEn: Having a reputation that is well-deserved; not just an empty name.
derivation: 《史记·游侠列传》然其私意廉洁退让，有足称者，名不虚言，士不虚附。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·遊俠列傳》然其私意廉潔退讓，有足稱者，名不虛言，士不虛附。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Wandering Knights': 'But their private intentions are honest and humble, worthy of praise; their reputation is not false, and scholars do not attach themselves in vain.'
example: 系船白面问溪翁，～说未通。★宋·华岳《白面渡》诗
exampleTraditional: 系船白麵問溪翁，～說未通。★宋·華嶽《白麵渡》詩
exampleEn: Tying the boat at Baishan, I asked the old man by the stream; the reputation is not false, but the explanation is not yet clear. — Song Dynasty, Hua Yue's poem 'White Face Ferry'

explanation: 来之使之来。得到它不容易。表示财物的取得或事物的成功是不容易的。
explanationTraditional: 來之使之來。得到它不容易。表示財物的取得或事物的成功是不容易的。
explanationEn: Hard-earned; not easily obtained.
derivation: 明·朱柏庐《治家格言》一粥一饭，当思来处不易；半丝半缕，恒念物力维艰。”
derivationTraditional: 明·朱柏廬《治家格言》一粥一飯，當思來處不易；半絲半縷，恆念物力維艱。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Zhu Bailu's 'Maxims for Managing a Household': 'Every bowl of congee and every plate of rice should remind us that they are not easily obtained; every half thread and every half strand should remind us of the difficulty of material resources.'
example: 我们活着的人都不要忘记，我们的红色江山～啊。★何长工《红旗插上井冈山》
exampleTraditional: 我們活著的人都不要忘記，我們的紅色江山～啊。★何長工《紅旗插上井岡山》
exampleEn: We who are alive should never forget that our red regime was hard-earned. — He Changgong, 'Planting the Red Flag on Jinggang Mountain'

explanation: 名声或名义和实际相符。
explanationTraditional: 名聲或名義和實際相符。
explanationEn: Living up to one's reputation; the name matches the reality.
derivation: 汉·曹操《与王修书》君澡身浴德，流声本州，忠能成绩，为世美谈，名实相符，过人甚远。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·曹操《與王修書》君澡身浴德，流聲本州，忠能成績，為世美談，名實相符，過人甚遠。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Cao Cao's 'Letter to Wang Xiu': 'You bathe in virtue, your reputation spreads in this province, your loyalty and ability achieve results, becoming a fine tale of the age; your name matches reality, surpassing others by far.'
example: 而况教育能不能～，还是个不能便下断语的问题。★叶圣陶《桥上》
exampleTraditional: 而況教育能不能～，還是個不能便下斷語的問題。★葉聖陶《橋上》
exampleEn: And whether education can truly live up to its name is a question that cannot be easily answered. — Ye Shengtao, 'On the Bridge'

explanation: 下落着落，去处。指不知道要寻找的人或物在什么地方。
explanationTraditional: 下落著落，去處。指不知道要尋找的人或物在什麼地方。
explanationEn: Whereabouts unknown; missing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 懈松懈。坚持到底，一点不忪懈。
explanationTraditional: 懈鬆懈。堅持到底，一點不忪懈。
explanationEn: Persistent and unremitting; to persevere without slackening.
derivation: 《清史稿·刘体重传》煦激励兵团，坚持不懈，贼穷蹙乞降，遂复濮州。”
derivationTraditional: 《清史稿·劉體重傳》煦激勵兵團，堅持不懈，賊窮蹙乞降，遂復濮州。”
derivationEn: From 'Draft History of Qing: Biography of Liu Tizhong': 'Xu encouraged the troops to be persistent and unremitting; the enemy, exhausted and desperate, surrendered, and thus Puzhou was recovered.'
example: 这些都证明我们对于加强统一战线实行革命政策来进行抗日战争的这种方针，是～的。★毛泽东《和英国记者贝特兰的谈话》
exampleTraditional: 這些都證明我們對於加強統一戰線實行革命政策來進行抗日戰爭的這種方針，是～的。★毛澤東《和英國記者貝特蘭的談話》
exampleEn: These all prove that our policy of strengthening the united front and implementing revolutionary policies to carry out the War of Resistance is persistent and unremitting. — Mao Zedong, 'Interview with British Journalist James Bertram'

explanation: 形容接连不断。
explanationTraditional: 形容接連不斷。
explanationEn: Continuous; in an endless stream.
derivation: 《孟子·万章上》欲常常而见之，故源源而来。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章上》欲常常而見之，故源源而來。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Wan Zhang I': 'Wishing to see him often, so he came continuously.'
example: 夜间，官军打通了由智亭山通往龙驹寨的大道，所以从天亮起就有军粮～地从龙驹寨向西运送。（姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十三章）
exampleTraditional: 夜間，官軍打通了由智亭山通往龍駒寨的大道，所以從天亮起就有軍糧～地從龍駒寨向西運送。（姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十三章）
exampleEn: At night, the government troops opened the road from Zhiyingshan to Longjuzhai, so from dawn, military grain was continuously transported westward from Longjuzhai. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 13

explanation: 形容行人车马来来往往，接连不断。
explanationTraditional: 形容行人車馬來來往往，接連不斷。
explanationEn: In an endless stream; continuous flow of people and vehicles.
derivation: 《后汉书·南匈奴传》窜逃入塞者络绎不绝。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·南匈奴傳》竄逃入塞者絡繹不絕。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of the Southern Xiongnu': 'Those who fled into the frontier passes came in an endless stream.'
example: 我梦里所到的地方，竟是一片康庄大道，马来车往，～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 我夢裡所到的地方，竟是一片康莊大道，馬來車往，～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第六十回
exampleEn: The place I visited in my dream turned out to be a broad avenue, with horses and carriages coming and going in an endless stream. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 60

explanation: 耍花招欺骗人。
explanationTraditional: 耍花招欺騙人。
explanationEn: To practice fraud; to resort to deception.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无论做什么事都应该实事求是，不该弄虚作假。
exampleTraditional: 無論做什麼事都應該實事求是，不該弄虛作假。
exampleEn: No matter what we do, we should be practical and realistic, and should not resort to deception.

explanation: 原有神秘奥妙的意思。现多指无法想象，难以理解。
explanationTraditional: 原有神秘奧妙的意思。現多指無法想象，難以理解。
explanationEn: Inconceivable; unimaginable; beyond comprehension.
derivation: 《维摩诘所说经·不思议品》诸佛菩萨有解脱名不可思议。”
derivationTraditional: 《維摩詰所說經·不思議品》諸佛菩薩有解脫名不可思議。”
derivationEn: From 'Vimalakirti Sutra: Chapter on Inconceivable': 'All Buddhas and Bodhisattvas have a liberation called inconceivable.'
example: 一片澄澈的蔚蓝色的天宇，高深得～。★郭沫若《少年时代·黑猫》
exampleTraditional: 一片澄澈的蔚藍色的天宇，高深得～。★郭沫若《少年時代·黑貓》
exampleEn: A clear azure sky, deep and inconceivable. — Guo Moruo, 'Youth: Black Cat'

explanation: 不正当的社会风气。
explanationTraditional: 不正當的社會風氣。
explanationEn: Unhealthy social trends; improper practices.
derivation: 《抱朴子·辩问》移不正之风，易流遁之俗。”
derivationTraditional: 《抱朴子·辯問》移不正之風，易流遁之俗。”
derivationEn: From 'Baopuzi: Debating Questions': 'To change improper practices and transform vulgar customs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 翼翼严肃谨慎。本是严肃恭敬的意思。现形容谨慎小心，一点不敢疏忽。
explanationTraditional: 翼翼嚴肅謹慎。本是嚴肅恭敬的意思。現形容謹慎小心，一點不敢疏忽。
explanationEn: Describes being extremely cautious and careful, not daring to be negligent.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·大明》维此文王，小心翼翼。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·大明》維此文王，小心翼翼。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs: 'This King Wen, cautious and respectful.'
example: 母亲～地起床做饭，心里欣喜地想，让儿子多睡一会，不要惊醒他。★冯德英《迎春花》第二章
exampleTraditional: 母親～地起床做飯，心裡欣喜地想，讓兒子多睡一會，不要驚醒他。★馮德英《迎春花》第二章
exampleEn: Mother got up cautiously to cook breakfast, thinking happily to let her son sleep a little longer without waking him.

explanation: 治太平；安安定。形容国家长期安定、巩固。
explanationTraditional: 治太平；安安定。形容國家長期安定、鞏固。
explanationEn: Describes a long-term stable and secure country.
derivation: 《汉书·贾谊传》建久安之势，成长治之业。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·賈誼傳》建久安之勢，成長治之業。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Han: 'Establish a long-term stable situation, achieve enduring peace.'
example: 要维持民族和国家的长久地位，还有道德问题，有了很好的道德，国家才能～。★孙中山《民族主义第六讲》
exampleTraditional: 要維持民族和國家的長久地位，還有道德問題，有了很好的道德，國家才能～。★孫中山《民族主義第六講》
exampleEn: To maintain the long-term existence of a nation and race, there is also the issue of morality. With good morality, the country can achieve long-term stability.

explanation: 荼茅草的白花。象火那样红，象荼那样白。原比喻军容之盛。现用来形容大规模的行动气势旺盛，气氛热烈。
explanationTraditional: 荼茅草的白花。象火那樣紅，象荼那樣白。原比喻軍容之盛。現用來形容大規模的行動氣勢旺盛，氣氛熱烈。
explanationEn: Originally described military might; now used to describe large-scale actions with vigorous momentum and热烈的 atmosphere.
derivation: 《国语·吴语》万人以为方阵，皆白裳，白旗，素甲，白羽之缯，望之如荼。……左军亦如之，皆赤裳，赤，丹甲，朱羽之缯，望之如火。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·吳語》萬人以為方陣，皆白裳，白旗，素甲，白羽之繒，望之如荼。……左軍亦如之，皆赤裳，赤，丹甲，朱羽之繒，望之如火。”
derivationEn: From the Discourses of the States: 'Ten thousand men formed a square formation, all in white... looking like white flowers. The left army was all in red... looking like fire.'
example: 过了两年五四运动”发生了。报纸上的～的记载唤醒了他的被忘却了的青春。★巴金《家》六
exampleTraditional: 過了兩年五四運動”發生了。報紙上的～的記載喚醒了他的被忘卻了的青春。★巴金《家》六
exampleEn: Two years later, the May Fourth Movement occurred. The fiery reports in newspapers awakened his forgotten youth.

explanation: 折、扣出售商品时，按定价减去的成数。没有折扣，表示完全、十足的意思。
explanationTraditional: 折、扣出售商品時，按定價減去的成數。沒有折扣，表示完全、十足的意思。
explanationEn: Means complete, total, without any discount or reduction.
derivation: 老舍《女店员》第二幕如今的妇女跟男人不折不扣一样尊贵！”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《女店員》第二幕如今的婦女跟男人不折不扣一樣尊貴！”
derivationEn: From Lao She's play: 'Nowadays women are just as noble as men, without any discount!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 顾回头看。来自后方的忧患。指在前进过程中，担心后方发生问题。
explanationTraditional: 顧回頭看。來自後方的憂患。指在前進過程中，擔心後方發生問題。
explanationEn: Refers to worries about troubles from behind while advancing forward.
derivation: 《魏书·李冲传》朕以仁明忠雅，委以台司之寄，使我出境无后顾之忧。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·李衝傳》朕以仁明忠雅，委以臺司之寄，使我出境無後顧之憂。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Wei: 'You are benevolent and loyal, entrusted with high office, allowing me to go abroad without worries from behind.'
example: 将军为殿，寡人～矣。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第六十二回
exampleTraditional: 將軍為殿，寡人～矣。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第六十二回
exampleEn: The general is the rearguard, so I have no worries from behind.

explanation: 原意是让闪光的金纸把人弄迷糊了。形容叫人沉迷的奢侈繁华环境。
explanationTraditional: 原意是讓閃光的金紙把人弄迷糊了。形容叫人沉迷的奢侈繁華環境。
explanationEn: Describes a luxurious and indulgent environment that intoxicates people.
derivation: 宋·陶穣《清异录·居室》（痈医孟斧）有一小室，窗牖焕明，器皆金饰，纸光莹白，金彩夺目，所亲见之，归语人曰‘此室暂憩，令人金迷纸醉。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陶穣《清異錄·居室》（癰醫孟斧）有一小室，窗牖煥明，器皆金飾，紙光瑩白，金彩奪目，所親見之，歸語人曰‘此室暫憩，令人金迷紙醉。’”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty records: 'A small room with shining windows, gold-decorated utensils, and dazzling paper, making visitors feel drunk with gold and paper.'
example: 我来到日本不久，听的不多，见的不广，但在五光十色、～的纷乱生活中，有些事物给我的刺激特别深。★杨朔《樱花雨》
exampleTraditional: 我來到日本不久，聽的不多，見的不廣，但在五光十色、～的紛亂生活中，有些事物給我的刺激特別深。★楊朔《櫻花雨》
exampleEn: Since I came to Japan, amidst the dazzling and luxurious life, some things have deeply impressed me.

explanation: 力体力，能力；及达到。在自己力量的限度内所能做到的。
explanationTraditional: 力體力，能力；及達到。在自己力量的限度內所能做到的。
explanationEn: Within one's power or ability to do something.
derivation: 晋·羊佑《诫子书》今之职位，谬恩之加耳，非吾力所能致也。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·羊佑《誡子書》今之職位，謬恩之加耳，非吾力所能致也。”
derivationEn: From Jin dynasty: 'My current position is due to undeserved favor, not something I could achieve by my own ability.'
example: 特别是要用实例、用典型示范去告诉他们组织起来的好处，这种好处是超出单干户～的。★郭小川《十字路口》
exampleTraditional: 特別是要用實例、用典型示範去告訴他們組織起來的好處，這種好處是超出單幹戶～的。★郭小川《十字路口》
exampleEn: Especially use examples and demonstrations to show them the benefits of organizing, which are beyond what individual farmers can achieve.

explanation: 供供给，供应；求需求，需要。供应不能满足需求。
explanationTraditional: 供供給，供應；求需求，需要。供應不能滿足需求。
explanationEn: Supply cannot meet demand.
derivation: 巴金《忆觉醒与活动》当时在成都新的书报很受欢迎，常常供不应求。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《憶覺醒與活動》當時在成都新的書報很受歡迎，常常供不應求。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin: 'At that time, new books and newspapers were very popular in Chengdu, often in short supply.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 目看；了然清楚，明白。一眼就看得很清楚。
explanationTraditional: 目看；瞭然清楚，明白。一眼就看得很清楚。
explanationEn: Clear at a single glance; easily understood.
derivation: 明·张岱《皇华考序》可见按图索籍，三溪道路，一目了然。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張岱《皇華考序》可見按圖索籍，三溪道路，一目瞭然。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty: 'One can see the roads clearly at a glance by looking at the map.'
example: 却说这中堂正对着那个围场，四扇大窗洞开，场上的事，～。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第十九回
exampleTraditional: 卻說這中堂正對著那個圍場，四扇大窗洞開，場上的事，～。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第十九回
exampleEn: The central hall faced the field, with four large windows open, so everything on the field was clear at a glance.

explanation: 形容事情或道理很明显，极容易看清楚。
explanationTraditional: 形容事情或道理很明顯，極容易看清楚。
explanationEn: Describes something or a truth that is very obvious and easy to see.
derivation: 清·李渔《闲情偶寄·结构第一》此显而易见之事，从无一人辩之。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《閒情偶寄·結構第一》此顯而易見之事，從無一人辯之。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty: 'This is an obvious matter, yet no one has argued it.'
example: 日本帝国主义和中国讨伐派的失望，已～。★毛泽东《关于蒋介石声明的声明》
exampleTraditional: 日本帝國主義和中國討伐派的失望，已～。★毛澤東《關於蔣介石聲明的聲明》
exampleEn: The disappointment of Japanese imperialism and Chinese punitives is already obvious.

explanation: 持坚持；恒恒心。长久坚持下去。
explanationTraditional: 持堅持；恆恆心。長久堅持下去。
explanationEn: To persevere with constant effort.
derivation: 清·曾国藩《家训喻纪泽》尔之短处，在言语欠钝讷，举止欠端重，看书不能深入，而作文不能峥嵘。若能从此三事上下一番苦功，进之以猛，持之以恒，不过一二年，自尔精进而不觉。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾國藩《家訓喻紀澤》爾之短處，在言語欠鈍訥，舉止欠端重，看書不能深入，而作文不能崢嶸。若能從此三事上下一番苦功，進之以猛，持之以恆，不過一二年，自爾精進而不覺。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Guofan's 'Family Instructions': 'Your shortcomings lie in slow speech, lack of dignity, shallow reading, and mediocre writing. If you work hard on these three things with vigor and perseverance, in a year or two you will improve without noticing.'
example: 学习要锲而不舍，～，就能取得好成绩。
exampleTraditional: 學習要鍥而不捨，～，就能取得好成績。
exampleEn: If you study with perseverance and persistence, you can achieve good results.

explanation: 形容数量很多。
explanationTraditional: 形容數量很多。
explanationEn: Thousands upon thousands; a great number.
derivation: 老舍《神拳》第二幕做假事骗得了几个人，骗不了成千上万的人。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《神拳》第二幕做假事騙得了幾個人，騙不了成千上萬的人。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'The Magic Box' Act 2: 'Deception can fool a few people, but not thousands upon thousands.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 城镇里的街道里弄，概指都市里的各处地方。
explanationTraditional: 城鎮裡的街道里弄，概指都市裡的各處地方。
explanationEn: Streets and alleys; every part of a city or town.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十六回正月十五日，上元佳节，好生晴朗，黄昏月上，六街三市，各处坊隅巷陌，点花放灯，大街小巷，都有社火。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十六回正月十五日，上元佳節，好生晴朗，黃昏月上，六街三市，各處坊隅巷陌，點花放燈，大街小巷，都有社火。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 66: 'On the fifteenth day of the first month, the Lantern Festival, the weather was clear. At moonrise, the six streets and three markets, every corner and alley, were lit with lanterns and fireworks. Streets and alleys were filled with festive activities.'
example: 吃了早饭，摇个串玲上行走去了，～乱走一气。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第十九回
exampleTraditional: 吃了早飯，搖個串玲上行走去了，～亂走一氣。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第十九回
exampleEn: After breakfast, he took a rattle and went out, wandering through streets and alleys. (From Qing Dynasty Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can' Chapter 19)

explanation: 不用说明就能想象得到。
explanationTraditional: 不用說明就能想象得到。
explanationEn: It is easy to imagine; one can well imagine.
derivation: 宋·王楙《野客丛书》而郊以吟诗废务，上官差官以摄其职，分其半禄，酸寒之壮，可想而知。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王楙《野客叢書》而郊以吟詩廢務，上官差官以攝其職，分其半祿，酸寒之壯，可想而知。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wang Mao's 'Notes of a Rustic': 'And because Jiao neglected his duties for poetry, a superior sent an official to take over his post and split his salary. The miserable state can well be imagined.'
example: 你想日本人练陆军把东三省地图当作功课，其用心～。★清·高鹗《老残游记续集》第一回
exampleTraditional: 你想日本人練陸軍把東三省地圖當作功課，其用心～。★清·高鶚《老殘遊記續集》第一回
exampleEn: You think the Japanese army studies the map of Northeast China as a lesson? Their intentions are easy to imagine. (From Qing Dynasty Gao E's 'Sequel to The Travels of Lao Can' Chapter 1)

explanation: 安安定；乐喜爱，愉快；业职业。指安定愉快地生活和劳动。
explanationTraditional: 安安定；樂喜愛，愉快；業職業。指安定愉快地生活和勞動。
explanationEn: To live and work in peace and contentment.
derivation: 《老子》第八十章民各甘其食，美其服，安其俗，乐其业，至老死不相往来。”《汉书·货殖列传》各安其居而乐其业，甘其食而美其服。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第八十章民各甘其食，美其服，安其俗，樂其業，至老死不相往來。”《漢書·貨殖列傳》各安其居而樂其業，甘其食而美其服。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi' Chapter 80: 'The people enjoy their food, admire their clothing, are content with their customs, and happy in their occupations, until they grow old and die without visiting each other.' Also from 'Book of Han: Biographies of Merchants': 'Each dwells in peace and enjoys his occupation, relishes his food and admires his clothing.'
example: 一家正～，不想安禄山兵乱，潼关失守，天子西幸。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷六
exampleTraditional: 一家正～，不想安祿山兵亂，潼關失守，天子西幸。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷六
exampleEn: The family was living in peace and contentment when suddenly An Lushan's rebellion broke out, Tong Pass fell, and the emperor fled west. (From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 6)

explanation: 形容认识一致，共同努力。
explanationTraditional: 形容認識一致，共同努力。
explanationEn: To work together with one heart and one mind.
derivation: 《墨子·尚贤》《汤誓》曰‘聿求元圣，与之戮力同心，以治天下。’”
derivationTraditional: 《墨子·尚賢》《湯誓》曰‘聿求元聖，與之戮力同心，以治天下。’”
derivationEn: From 'Mozi: Exalting Worth': 'The 'Tang Oath' says: 'Seek the great sage and unite with him in heart and strength to govern the world.''
example: 往后咱们～，一块打反动派！★冯德英《迎春花》第十九章
exampleTraditional: 往後咱們～，一塊打反動派！★馮德英《迎春花》第十九章
exampleEn: From now on, let's work together to fight the reactionaries! (From Feng Deying's 'Spring Blossoms' Chapter 19)

explanation: 天天然，自然；厚优厚。具备的条件特别优越，所处环境特别好。
explanationTraditional: 天天然，自然；厚優厚。具備的條件特別優越，所處環境特別好。
explanationEn: To be richly endowed by nature; to have exceptional advantages.
derivation: 清·洪亮吉《江北诗话》卷二得天独厚开盈尺，与月同园到十分。”
derivationTraditional: 清·洪亮吉《江北詩話》卷二得天獨厚開盈尺，與月同園到十分。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Hong Liangji's 'Poetry Talks of Jiangbei' Volume 2: 'Endowed richly by nature, it opens a full foot; sharing the garden with the moon, it reaches perfection.'
example: 曹沾进园，草草看了，便觉这南园”～，就在它有一片好水。★端木蕻良《曹雪芹》十八
exampleTraditional: 曹沾進園，草草看了，便覺這南園”～，就在它有一片好水。★端木蕻良《曹雪芹》十八
exampleEn: Cao Zhan entered the garden and glanced around, feeling that this 'South Garden' was richly endowed by nature because it had a fine stretch of water. (From Duanmu Hongliang's 'Cao Xueqin' Chapter 18)

explanation: 钟集中；钟情爱情专注。旧指男女之间一见面就产生爱情。也指对事物一见就产生了感情。
explanationTraditional: 鍾集中；鍾情愛情專注。舊指男女之間一見面就產生愛情。也指對事物一見就產生了感情。
explanationEn: To fall in love at first sight.
derivation: 清·古吴墨浪子《西湖佳话·西泠韵迹》乃蒙郎君一见钟情，故贱妾有感于心。”
derivationTraditional: 清·古吳墨浪子《西湖佳話·西泠韻跡》乃蒙郎君一見鍾情，故賤妾有感於心。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Guwu Molangzi's 'West Lake Tales: Traces of Xiling': 'Then I was favored by you with love at first sight, so I felt grateful in my heart.'
example: 祁连山俘虏了我的心，青湖我～。（徐迟《三峡记·远游》）
exampleTraditional: 祁連山俘虜了我的心，青湖我～。（徐遲《三峽記·遠遊》）
exampleEn: The Qilian Mountains captured my heart, and Qinghai Lake made me fall in love at first sight. (From Xu Chi's 'Three Gorges Notes: Distant Travel')

explanation: 不怕艰难困苦，坚持英勇斗争。
explanationTraditional: 不怕艱難困苦，堅持英勇鬥爭。
explanationEn: To struggle hard under difficult conditions; to work hard and persevere.
derivation: 陶铸《崇高的理想》我们要过渡到共产主义社会，还要经过长时期的艰苦奋斗。”
derivationTraditional: 陶鑄《崇高的理想》我們要過渡到共產主義社會，還要經過長時期的艱苦奮鬥。”
derivationEn: From Tao Zhu's 'Lofty Ideals': 'To transition to a communist society, we still need a long period of arduous struggle.'
example: 我们要提倡艰苦奋斗，反对铺张浪费。
exampleTraditional: 我們要提倡艱苦奮鬥，反對鋪張浪費。
exampleEn: We must promote hard work and perseverance, and oppose extravagance and waste.

explanation: 投入全部精力，一点没有保留。
explanationTraditional: 投入全部精力，一點沒有保留。
explanationEn: Wholeheartedly; with all one's heart and mind.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 张思德全心全意为人民服务的精神，值得我们学习。
exampleTraditional: 張思德全心全意為人民服務的精神，值得我們學習。
exampleEn: Zhang Side's spirit of serving the people wholeheartedly is worth learning from.

explanation: 没有相同的或没有可以相比的。
explanationTraditional: 沒有相同的或沒有可以相比的。
explanationEn: Unique; having no equal or match.
derivation: 宋·延寿辑《宗镜录》卷三十一独一无二，即真解脱。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·延壽輯《宗鏡錄》卷三十一獨一無二，即真解脫。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Yanshou's 'Zongjing Lu' Volume 31: 'Unique, that is true liberation.'
example: 赢了钱，便大把的赏人；输了钱，无论上千上万，从不兴皱眉头真要算得～的好赌品了。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 贏了錢，便大把的賞人；輸了錢，無論上千上萬，從不興皺眉頭真要算得～的好賭品了。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十一回
exampleEn: When he won money, he generously rewarded others; when he lost money, whether thousands or tens of thousands, he never frowned—truly a unique and unparalleled gambler. (Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Appearance' Chapter 21)

explanation: 约相约。事先没有约定而相互一致。
explanationTraditional: 約相約。事先沒有約定而相互一致。
explanationEn: To act in concert without prior agreement; to happen to coincide.
derivation: 《史记·平津侯主父列传》应对而皆动，不谋而俱起，不约而同会。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平津侯主父列傳》應對而皆動，不謀而俱起，不約而同會。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of the Marquises of Pingjin and Zhufu': 'They respond and move together, rise without planning, and meet without prior agreement.'
example: 中军元帅栾书，～，亦至朝门，正遇胥童引兵到来。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 中軍元帥欒書，～，亦至朝門，正遇胥童引兵到來。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五十九回
exampleEn: The commander of the central army, Luan Shu, arrived at the court gate without prior agreement, just as Xu Tong was leading his troops. (Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 59)

explanation: 锣鼓点敲得很密。比喻公开活动前的紧张气氛和舆论准备。
explanationTraditional: 鑼鼓點敲得很密。比喻公開活動前的緊張氣氛和輿論準備。
explanationEn: Intense preparation or buildup before a public event; a flurry of activity.
derivation: 刘绍棠《狼烟》四绿树葱茏的太子镇里，传出一阵阵紧锣密鼓的喧响。”
derivationTraditional: 劉紹棠《狼煙》四綠樹蔥蘢的太子鎮裡，傳出一陣陣緊鑼密鼓的喧響。”
derivationEn: From Liu Shaotang's 'Wolf Smoke' Chapter 4: 'From the lush green town of Taizi came a burst of intense gong and drum sounds.'
example: 经过一阵～之后，新计划终于得以实施。
exampleTraditional: 經過一陣～之後，新計劃終於得以實施。
exampleEn: After a period of intense preparation, the new plan was finally implemented.

explanation: 原指五行阵和八门阵。这是古代两种战术变化很多的阵势。比喻变化多端或花样繁多。
explanationTraditional: 原指五行陣和八門陣。這是古代兩種戰術變化很多的陣勢。比喻變化多端或花樣繁多。
explanationEn: Varied and numerous; a wide variety of things or styles.
derivation: 《虞初新志·孙嘉淦》伏龙以西，群峰乱峙，四布罗列，如平沙万幕，八门五花。”
derivationTraditional: 《虞初新志·孫嘉淦》伏龍以西，群峰亂峙，四布羅列，如平沙萬幕，八門五花。”
derivationEn: From 'Yu Chu Xin Zhi: Sun Jiagan': 'To the west of Fulong, peaks stand in chaos, scattered like a thousand tents on a plain, with eight gates and five flowers.'
example: 湖北的省政府在当时真正是一种鱼龙漫衍的模范政府”，那个委员会～地是什么人品都有。★郭沫若《革命春秋·北伐途次》
exampleTraditional: 湖北的省政府在當時真正是一種魚龍漫衍的模範政府”，那個委員會～地是什麼人品都有。★郭沫若《革命春秋·北伐途次》
exampleEn: The Hubei provincial government at that time was truly a 'model government' of mixed elements, with all kinds of people in it. (Guo Moruo's 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: The Northern Expedition')

explanation: 一应一切；俱都。一切齐全，应有尽有。
explanationTraditional: 一應一切；俱都。一切齊全，應有盡有。
explanationEn: Everything needed is available; all are present.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 厨房里的各种调味作料，一应俱全。
exampleTraditional: 廚房裡的各種調味作料，一應俱全。
exampleEn: All kinds of seasonings in the kitchen are available.

explanation: 应顺应；运原指天命，泛指时机。旧指应天命而产生。现指适应时机而产生。
explanationTraditional: 應順應；運原指天命，泛指時機。舊指應天命而產生。現指適應時機而產生。
explanationEn: To emerge at the right time; to arise in response to the needs of the time.
derivation: 汉·荀悦《汉纪·后序》实天生德，应运建主。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·荀悅《漢紀·後序》實天生德，應運建主。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Xun Yue's 'Han Ji: Postscript': 'Heaven gave birth to virtue, and he arose in response to the mandate.'
example: 天地生人，除大仁大恶，余者皆无大异；若大仁者则～，大恶者则应劫而生，运生世治，劫生世危。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二回
exampleTraditional: 天地生人，除大仁大惡，餘者皆無大異；若大仁者則～，大惡者則應劫而生，運生世治，劫生世危。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二回
exampleEn: Heaven and earth give birth to people; except for the great benevolent and the great evil, the rest are not much different. The great benevolent arise in response to the times, while the great evil arise in response to calamities. (Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 2)

explanation: 跟大家不一样。
explanationTraditional: 跟大家不一樣。
explanationEn: Different from others; distinctive.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》这是今日令中第一个古人，必须出类拔萃，与众不同，才觉有趣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》這是今日令中第一個古人，必須出類拔萃，與眾不同，才覺有趣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror': 'This is the first ancient person in today's order; he must be outstanding and different from others to be interesting.'
example: 从他～的解题思路中，看出他很聪明。
exampleTraditional: 從他～的解題思路中，看出他很聰明。
exampleEn: From his unique way of solving problems, it can be seen that he is very smart.

explanation: 看见某种严重情况，心里感到震惊。
explanationTraditional: 看見某種嚴重情況，心裡感到震驚。
explanationEn: Shocking to see; alarming; striking.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《昌黎集·贞曜先生墓志铭》及其为诗，刿目怵心。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《昌黎集·貞曜先生墓誌銘》及其為詩，劌目怵心。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Mr. Zhenyao': 'When he wrote poetry, it was eye-cutting and heart-stirring.'
example: 又因他姓赤，惟恐厕内倘有赤痢血痔之类，也好教他～，时常打扫因此把他派了。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 又因他姓赤，惟恐廁內倘有赤痢血痔之類，也好教他～，時常打掃因此把他派了。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十九回
exampleEn: Also, because his surname was Chi, fearing that if there were red dysentery or hemorrhoids in the latrine, it would shock him and make him clean frequently, he was assigned to that task. (Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 99)

explanation: 屡多次；鲜新鲜，新奇。常常见到，并不新奇。
explanationTraditional: 屢多次；鮮新鮮，新奇。常常見到，並不新奇。
explanationEn: Common occurrence; not uncommon; frequently seen.
derivation: 《史记·郦生陆贾列传》一岁中往来过他客，率不过再三过，数见不鲜，天久慁公为也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·酈生陸賈列傳》一歲中往來過他客，率不過再三過，數見不鮮，天久慁公為也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Li Yiji and Lu Jia': 'In a year, he visited guests many times, but not more than three times; seeing it often is not fresh, and it would be troublesome for a long time.'
example: 搜身的纠葛，在香港～。★鲁迅《而已集·略谈香港》
exampleTraditional: 搜身的糾葛，在香港～。★魯迅《而已集·略談香港》
exampleEn: Body searches are not uncommon in Hong Kong. (Lu Xun's 'And That's It: A Brief Talk on Hong Kong')

explanation: 独一个；偶一双。不只一个，竟然还有配对的。表示两事或两人十分相似。
explanationTraditional: 獨一個；偶一雙。不只一個，竟然還有配對的。表示兩事或兩人十分相似。
explanationEn: Not unique but has a counterpart; coincidentally similar.
derivation: 刘半农《奉答王敬轩先生》先生与这位老夫子，可称无独有偶。”
derivationTraditional: 劉半農《奉答王敬軒先生》先生與這位老夫子，可稱無獨有偶。”
derivationEn: From Liu Bannong's 'Reply to Mr. Wang Jingshan': 'You and this old gentleman can be called a pair without parallel.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 之代词，它，指办法、措施等；效成效，效果。实行起来有成效。指某种方法或措施已经实行过，证明很有效用。
explanationTraditional: 之代詞，它，指辦法、措施等；效成效，效果。實行起來有成效。指某種方法或措施已經實行過，證明很有效用。
explanationEn: Effective in practice; proven to be effective through implementation.
derivation: 毛泽东《中中国共产党第八届中央委员会第二次全体会议上的讲话》整风是在我们历史上行之有效的办法。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中中國共產黨第八屆中央委員會第二次全體會議上的講話》整風是在我們歷史上行之有效的辦法。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's speech at the Second Plenary Session of the Eighth Central Committee of the Communist Party of China: 'Rectification is a method that has proven effective in our history.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 知知道；觉觉察。没有意识到，没有觉察到。现多指未加注意。
explanationTraditional: 知知道；覺覺察。沒有意識到，沒有覺察到。現多指未加註意。
explanationEn: Unconsciously; without realizing or noticing.
derivation: 明·赵弼《两教辨》遂使昏愚之徒，听其妖诞，舍正从邪，醉生梦死，不知不觉。尧舜三代以前，未闻有此教。”
derivationTraditional: 明·趙弼《兩教辨》遂使昏愚之徒，聽其妖誕，捨正從邪，醉生夢死，不知不覺。堯舜三代以前，未聞有此教。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Zhao Bi's 'Two Teachings Debate': 'Thus the foolish and ignorant listen to their absurdities, abandon righteousness for evil, live in a drunken dream, and die without knowing. Before the times of Yao, Shun, and the Three Dynasties, such teachings were unheard of.'
example: 他的残忍和狠毒，时而～地在老人面前显露出来。★曹禺《王昭君》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 他的殘忍和狠毒，時而～地在老人面前顯露出來。★曹禺《王昭君》第二幕
exampleEn: His cruelty and viciousness sometimes unconsciously revealed themselves before the old man. — Cao Yu, 'Wang Zhaojun', Act 2

explanation: 大势指整个局势。整个局势发展的趋向。
explanationTraditional: 大勢指整個局勢。整個局勢發展的趨向。
explanationEn: The general trend; an inevitable development of the overall situation.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《上孝宗皇帝第三书》天下大势之所趋，非人力之所能移也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《上孝宗皇帝第三書》天下大勢之所趨，非人力之所能移也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Chen Liang's 'Third Letter to Emperor Xiaozong': 'The general trend of the world is not something that human power can change.'
example: 解放区人民的力量，大后方人民的力量，国际形势，～，使得国民党不得不承认这些东西。★毛泽东《关于重庆谈判》
exampleTraditional: 解放區人民的力量，大後方人民的力量，國際形勢，～，使得國民黨不得不承認這些東西。★毛澤東《關於重慶談判》
exampleEn: The strength of the people in the liberated areas, the strength of the people in the rear areas, and the international situation—the general trend forced the Kuomintang to acknowledge these things. — Mao Zedong, 'On the Chongqing Negotiations'

explanation: 指众多人家。
explanationTraditional: 指眾多人家。
explanationEn: Numerous households; countless families.
derivation: 孙犁《画的梦》千家万户的年画，给了我很多知识。”
derivationTraditional: 孫犁《畫的夢》千家萬戶的年畫，給了我很多知識。”
derivationEn: Sun Li's 'Dream of Paintings': 'The New Year paintings of thousands of households gave me a lot of knowledge.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 悸因害怕而心跳得厉害。危险的事情虽然过去了，回想起来心里还害怕。
explanationTraditional: 悸因害怕而心跳得厲害。危險的事情雖然過去了，回想起來心裡還害怕。
explanationEn: To have lingering fear; one's heart still pounds with fear after a dangerous event has passed.
derivation: 孙犁《奋勇地前进、战斗—在一次座谈会上的发言》如果他第一次在路上遇到的只是井绳，他就不会心有余悸了。”
derivationTraditional: 孫犁《奮勇地前進、戰鬥—在一次座談會上的發言》如果他第一次在路上遇到的只是井繩，他就不會心有餘悸了。”
derivationEn: Sun Li's 'Advance Bravely, Fight—Speech at a Symposium': 'If he had only encountered a well rope on his first trip, he would not have lingering fear.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 得能够。没有办法知道。
explanationTraditional: 得能夠。沒有辦法知道。
explanationEn: Unable to know; there is no way to find out.
derivation: 《后汉书·桓谭传》盖天道性命，圣人所难言也。自子贡以下，不得而闻。”唐·韩愈《争臣论》故虽谏且议，使人不得而知焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·桓譚傳》蓋天道性命，聖人所難言也。自子貢以下，不得而聞。”唐·韓愈《爭臣論》故雖諫且議，使人不得而知焉。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Huan Tan': 'Heavenly Dao and human nature are difficult for even sages to speak of. Since Zigong, they have not been heard.' Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Debate on the Minister of Admonition': 'Therefore, even if he admonishes and discusses, people cannot know about it.'
example: 从未到过广西，所以谁做了广西政府的高等顾问”等等，我～。★邹韬奋《经历·贫民窟里的报馆》
exampleTraditional: 從未到過廣西，所以誰做了廣西政府的高等顧問”等等，我～。★鄒韜奮《經歷·貧民窟裡的報館》
exampleEn: I have never been to Guangxi, so I cannot know who became the 'senior advisor' of the Guangxi government. — Zou Taofen, 'Experience: A Newspaper Office in a Slum'

explanation: 从来没有过的。
explanationTraditional: 從來沒有過的。
explanationEn: Unprecedented; never before seen or experienced.
derivation: 宋·徐度《却扫编》卷下而邓枢密洵武真以少保领院而不兼节钺，前所未有也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·徐度《卻掃編》卷下而鄧樞密洵武真以少保領院而不兼節鉞，前所未有也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Xu Du's 'Sweeping the Desk' Volume 2: 'Deng Qiwu truly led the academy as a junior protector without concurrently holding a military command, which was unprecedented.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 近紧急。急迫得不能等待。形容心情急切。
explanationTraditional: 近緊急。急迫得不能等待。形容心情急切。
explanationEn: Too impatient to wait; extremely urgent.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六回且系酒后游戏，该仙子何以迫不急待。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六回且系酒後遊戲，該仙子何以迫不急待。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 6: 'Moreover, it was a game after drinking; how could the fairy be so impatient?'
example: 他～地推开门，走进屋去。
exampleTraditional: 他～地推開門，走進屋去。
exampleEn: He pushed open the door and walked in impatiently.

explanation: 比喻接连遭受灾难，损害愈加严重。
explanationTraditional: 比喻接連遭受災難，損害愈加嚴重。
explanationEn: To add insult to injury; disasters come one after another, making the situation worse.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷十九饶你道有什么事，犹是头上着头，雪上加霜。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷十九饒你道有什麼事，猶是頭上著頭，雪上加霜。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Shi Daoyuan's 'Records of the Transmission of the Lamp' Volume 19: 'Even if you say there is nothing, it is still putting a head on a head, adding frost to snow.'
example: 正在惊慌，偏又转了迎面大风，真是～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十一回
exampleTraditional: 正在驚慌，偏又轉了迎面大風，真是～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十一回
exampleEn: Just as they were panicking, a headwind turned against them, truly adding insult to injury. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 51

explanation: 形容事情已到眼前，情势十分紧迫。
explanationTraditional: 形容事情已到眼前，情勢十分緊迫。
explanationEn: Urgent; imminent; pressing right before one's eyes.
derivation: 《庄子·庚桑楚》曰向吾见若眉睫之间。”《列子·仲尼》远在八荒之外，近在眉睫之内。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·庚桑楚》曰向吾見若眉睫之間。”《列子·仲尼》遠在八荒之外，近在眉睫之內。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: Gengsang Chu': 'I looked between your eyebrows and eyelashes.' 'Liezi: Zhongni': 'Far away in the eight wildernesses, near within the eyebrows and eyelashes.'
example: 新的内战危机忽然又～了。★方纪《挥手之间》
exampleTraditional: 新的內戰危機忽然又～了。★方紀《揮手之間》
exampleEn: Suddenly, a new civil war crisis was imminent. — Fang Ji, 'Between Waves'

explanation: 这里起来，那里下去。形容接连不断。
explanationTraditional: 這裡起來，那裡下去。形容接連不斷。
explanationEn: Rising here and subsiding there. Describes something happening continuously one after another.
derivation: 华而实《汉衣冠》四此起彼伏，似有万人响应。”
derivationTraditional: 華而實《漢衣冠》四此起彼伏，似有萬人響應。”
derivationEn: From Hua Ershi's 'Han Yiguan' Chapter 4: 'Rising here and subsiding there, as if thousands respond.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 脚踏在坚实的土地上。比喻做事踏实，认真。
explanationTraditional: 腳踏在堅實的土地上。比喻做事踏實，認真。
explanationEn: Feet planted on solid ground. Metaphor for being practical and down-to-earth.
derivation: 宋·邵雍《邵氏闻见前录》卷十八公尝问康节曰‘某何如人？’曰‘君实脚踏实地人也。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·邵雍《邵氏聞見前錄》卷十八公嘗問康節曰‘某何如人？’曰‘君實腳踏實地人也。’”
derivationEn: From Shao Yong's 'Shao's Records of Things Heard' Volume 18: 'Junshi is a man who keeps his feet on the ground.'
example: 他们渐渐丢了那空架子，～向前走去。★朱自清《论书生的酸气》
exampleTraditional: 他們漸漸丟了那空架子，～向前走去。★朱自清《論書生的酸氣》
exampleEn: They gradually abandoned their empty pretensions and moved forward with their feet on the ground. — Zhu Ziqing, 'On the Pedantry of Scholars'

explanation: 料想不到，没有料到。
explanationTraditional: 料想不到，沒有料到。
explanationEn: Unexpected; beyond one's anticipation.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二回今日这般寒冷，满天雪片飘扬，仙姑忽来下顾，真是意想不到。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二回今日這般寒冷，滿天雪片飄揚，仙姑忽來下顧，真是意想不到。”
derivationEn: From Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 2: 'Today it's so cold with snowflakes flying, your visit is truly unexpected.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 错交错，交叉；综合在一起。形容头绪多，情况复杂。
explanationTraditional: 錯交錯，交叉；綜合在一起。形容頭緒多，情況複雜。
explanationEn: Interwoven and complex. Describes intricate and complicated situations.
derivation: 《周易·系辞上》参伍以变，错综其数。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭上》參伍以變，錯綜其數。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Appended Remarks': 'Interweaving and varying, interlocking their numbers.'
example: 不管形式上怎样～，变化诡奇，实际上总有一个基本的道理贯串其间。★秦牧《河汊错综》
exampleTraditional: 不管形式上怎樣～，變化詭奇，實際上總有一個基本的道理貫串其間。★秦牧《河汊錯綜》
exampleEn: No matter how intricate and varied the forms, there is always a basic principle running through them. — Qin Mu, 'The Interwoven Rivers'

explanation: 厚深重；非非议，否定。不能过分责备。指说话做事虽有缺点，但还有可取之处，应予谅解。
explanationTraditional: 厚深重；非非議，否定。不能過分責備。指說話做事雖有缺點，但還有可取之處，應予諒解。
explanationEn: Not to be overly blamed; understandable despite minor flaws.
derivation: 《汉书·王莽传中》莽怒，免英官◇颇觉悟，曰‘英亦未可厚非。’”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·王莽傳中》莽怒，免英官◇頗覺悟，曰‘英亦未可厚非。’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Wang Mang': 'Wang Mang was angry and dismissed Ying, but later realized Ying was not entirely blameworthy.'
example: 作者的动机～，但客观效果则不尽符合作者的动机。★茅盾《一九六０年短篇小说漫评》
exampleTraditional: 作者的動機～，但客觀效果則不盡符合作者的動機。★茅盾《一九六０年短篇小說漫評》
exampleEn: The author's intention is not to be overly blamed, but the objective effect does not fully match the intention. — Mao Dun, 'A Casual Review of Short Stories in 1960'

explanation: 源头很远，水流很长。比喻历史悠久。
explanationTraditional: 源頭很遠，水流很長。比喻歷史悠久。
explanationEn: A distant source and a long stream. Metaphor for a long history.
derivation: 唐·白居易《海州刺史裴君夫人李氏墓志铭》夫源远者流长，根深者枝茂。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《海州刺史裴君夫人李氏墓誌銘》夫源遠者流長，根深者枝茂。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi's 'Epitaph for Lady Li, Wife of Prefect of Haizhou': 'A distant source yields a long stream; deep roots produce luxuriant branches.'
example: 剥削阶级的幸福观，是～，影响仍然是相当深广的。★秦牧《一个黑人战士的豪迈声音》
exampleTraditional: 剝削階級的幸福觀，是～，影響仍然是相當深廣的。★秦牧《一個黑人戰士的豪邁聲音》
exampleEn: The exploiting class's concept of happiness has a long history and still has a profound influence. — Qin Mu, 'The Heroic Voice of a Black Soldier'

explanation: 反类推。比喻从一件事情类推而知道其他许多事情。
explanationTraditional: 反類推。比喻從一件事情類推而知道其他許多事情。
explanationEn: To infer the rest from one instance; to draw analogies.
derivation: 《论语·述而》举一隅不以三隅反，则不复也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》舉一隅不以三隅反，則不復也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Shu Er': 'If I show one corner and he does not return with the other three, I will not repeat.'
example: 我是凭着一卷《诗韵》学说话，倒可以有～”的效验。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第三十四回
exampleTraditional: 我是憑著一卷《詩韻》學說話，倒可以有～”的效驗。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第三十四回
exampleEn: I learned to speak using a book of rhymes, and it had the effect of 'drawing inferences from one instance.' — Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' Chapter 34

explanation: 指学习工作等按照一定的步骤逐渐深入或提高。
explanationTraditional: 指學習工作等按照一定的步驟逐漸深入或提高。
explanationEn: To proceed step by step in order; gradual progress.
derivation: 《论语·宪问》不怨天，不尤人，下学而上达，知我者其天乎？”朱熹注此但自言其反己自修，循序渐进耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·憲問》不怨天，不尤人，下學而上達，知我者其天乎？”朱熹注此但自言其反己自修，循序漸進耳。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's commentary on 'The Analects: Xian Wen': 'This is just speaking of self-reflection and self-cultivation, proceeding step by step.'
example: 她通常是从一个角度写，而不是从几个角度写；还只是～地写，而不是错综交叉地写。★茅盾《怎样评价〈青春之歌〉？》
exampleTraditional: 她通常是從一個角度寫，而不是從幾個角度寫；還只是～地寫，而不是錯綜交叉地寫。★茅盾《怎樣評價〈青春之歌〉？》
exampleEn: She usually writes from one angle rather than several, and progresses step by step rather than in a complex interwoven manner. — Mao Dun, 'How to Evaluate 'The Song of Youth'?'

explanation: 遗留；余力剩下的力量。把全部力量都使出来，一点不保留。
explanationTraditional: 遺留；餘力剩下的力量。把全部力量都使出來，一點不保留。
explanationEn: To spare no effort; to do one's utmost.
derivation: 《战国策·赵策三》秦之攻我也，不遗余力矣，必以倦而归也。”《史记·平原君虞卿列传》秦不遗余力矣，必且欲破赵军。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·趙策三》秦之攻我也，不遺餘力矣，必以倦而歸也。”《史記·平原君虞卿列傳》秦不遺餘力矣，必且欲破趙軍。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Zhao Ce III': 'Qin attacked us with all its might, and will surely retreat exhausted.' Also 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Pingyuan Jun and Yu Qing'.
example: 委员和事，调停惟赖孔方；绅士责言，控诉～。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第四回
exampleTraditional: 委員和事，調停惟賴孔方；紳士責言，控訴～。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第四回
exampleEn: The committee mediated relying on money; the gentry complained sparing no effort. — Li Baojia, 'A Short History of Civilization' Chapter 4

explanation: 喻了解，明白。不用说话就能明白。形容道理很明显。
explanationTraditional: 喻瞭解，明白。不用說話就能明白。形容道理很明顯。
explanationEn: It goes without saying; self-evident.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》仁义礼智根于心，其生色也，然见于面。盎于背，施于四体，四体不言而喻。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》仁義禮智根於心，其生色也，然見於面。盎於背，施於四體，四體不言而喻。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jin Xin I': 'Benevolence, righteousness, propriety, and wisdom are rooted in the heart; they manifest in the face and limbs, and are understood without words.'
example: 你想他们这朋友之乐，尽可～了。★清·刘鹗《老残游记续集》第一回
exampleTraditional: 你想他們這朋友之樂，儘可～了。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記續集》第一回
exampleEn: You can imagine their joy as friends; it goes without saying. — Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can' Sequel Chapter 1

explanation: 讨索取。买卖东西，卖主要价高，买主给价低，双方要反复争议。也比喻在进行谈判时反复争议，或接受任务时讲条件。
explanationTraditional: 討索取。買賣東西，賣主要價高，買主給價低，雙方要反覆爭議。也比喻在進行談判時反覆爭議，或接受任務時講條件。
explanationEn: To bargain or haggle over price; also used metaphorically to describe negotiating terms or conditions.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷一三巧儿问了他讨价还价，便道‘真个亏你些儿。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷一三巧兒問了他討價還價，便道‘真個虧你些兒。’”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories Old and New' of the Ming Dynasty: 'The girl asked him about bargaining and said, 'You really gave me a little discount.''
example: 我们的方针是不拒绝谈判，要求对方完全承认八条，不许～。★毛泽东《在中国共产党第七届中央委员会第二次全体会议上的报告》
exampleTraditional: 我們的方針是不拒絕談判，要求對方完全承認八條，不許～。★毛澤東《在中國共產黨第七屆中央委員會第二次全體會議上的報告》
exampleEn: Our policy is not to reject negotiations, but to demand that the other side fully accept the eight conditions, and not allow bargaining. — Mao Zedong, 'Report to the Second Plenary Session of the Seventh Central Committee of the Communist Party of China'

explanation: 恶厌恶；痛痛恨；绝极。指对某人或某事物极端厌恶痛恨。
explanationTraditional: 惡厭惡；痛痛恨；絕極。指對某人或某事物極端厭惡痛恨。
explanationEn: To detest or loathe someone or something intensely.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心下》斯可谓之乡愿矣” 宋·朱熹集注过门不入而不恨之，以其不见亲就为幸，深恶而痛绝之也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心下》斯可謂之鄉愿矣” 宋·朱熹集註過門不入而不恨之，以其不見親就為幸，深惡而痛絕之也。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's commentary on Mencius: 'He does not hate them for passing by his door without entering, but considers it fortunate not to be close to them, deeply detesting and utterly abhorring them.'
example: 不象他对于墨家那样的真心的～。★闻一多《杂文·善于儒、道、土匪》
exampleTraditional: 不象他對於墨家那樣的真心的～。★聞一多《雜文·善於儒、道、土匪》
exampleEn: Unlike his sincere deep detestation of the Mohist school. — Wen Yiduo, 'Essays: On Confucianism, Taoism, and Bandits'

explanation: 比喻三个人、三件事或三个方面联成的一个整体。
explanationTraditional: 比喻三個人、三件事或三個方面聯成的一個整體。
explanationEn: A trinity; three persons, things, or aspects forming an integrated whole.
derivation: 毛泽东《为争取千百万群众进入抗日民族统一战线而斗争》为什么提出'巩固和平'、'争取民主'、'实现抗战'这样三位一体的口号？张
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《為爭取千百萬群眾進入抗日民族統一戰線而鬥爭》為什麼提出'鞏固和平'、'爭取民主'、'實現抗戰'這樣三位一體的口號？張
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Win the Masses to the Anti-Japanese National United Front': 'Why raise the trinity slogan of 'consolidate peace,' 'strive for democracy,' and 'realize resistance'?'
example: 我俩没儿没女，洁琼常来，可以说是～，宛如一家★扬《第二次握手》
exampleTraditional: 我倆沒兒沒女，潔瓊常來，可以說是～，宛如一家★揚《第二次握手》
exampleEn: We have no children, but Jieqiong often comes, so we can be said to be a trinity, like a family. — Yang Mo, 'Second Handshake'

explanation: 截然很分明地、断然分开的样子。形容两件事物毫无共同之处。
explanationTraditional: 截然很分明地、斷然分開的樣子。形容兩件事物毫無共同之處。
explanationEn: Completely different; having nothing in common.
derivation: 宋·陆九渊《与王顺伯》从其教之所由起者观之，则儒释之辨，公私义利之别，判断截然，有不可民者矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸九淵《與王順伯》從其教之所由起者觀之，則儒釋之辨，公私義利之別，判斷截然，有不可民者矣。”
derivationEn: From Lu Jiuyuan's 'Letter to Wang Shunbo' of the Song Dynasty: 'From the perspective of the origins of their teachings, the distinction between Confucianism and Buddhism, public and private, righteousness and profit, is sharply cut off, with no common ground.'
example: 直到近来，经过许多学者的研究，才知道孩子的世界，与成人～。★鲁迅《坟·我们现在怎样做父亲》
exampleTraditional: 直到近來，經過許多學者的研究，才知道孩子的世界，與成人～。★魯迅《墳·我們現在怎樣做父親》
exampleEn: Until recently, after many scholars' research, it is known that the world of children is completely different from that of adults. — Lu Xun, 'Grave: How We Should Be Fathers Now'

explanation: 犹还。过去的事，至今印象还非常清楚，就象刚才发生的一样。
explanationTraditional: 猶還。過去的事，至今印象還非常清楚，就象剛才發生的一樣。
explanationEn: To remember vividly as if it happened yesterday.
derivation: 宋·刘克庄《后村全集·跋章南举千藁》仆曩官健上，多识其士，友去之数十年，犹记忆如新相知；今屈指故交存者十无一二。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·劉克莊《後村全集·跋章南舉千藁》僕曩官健上，多識其士，友去之數十年，猶記憶如新相知；今屈指故交存者十無一二。”
derivationEn: From Liu Kezhuang's 'Postscript to Zhang Nanju's Thousand Manuscripts' of the Song Dynasty: 'I served in Jian many years ago and knew many scholars there; after decades, I still remember them as if we were newly acquainted.'
example: 恭王因为皇帝的告戒，～，在这些加官进爵的事上，要避把持的嫌疑。★高阳《玉座珠帘》下册
exampleTraditional: 恭王因為皇帝的告戒，～，在這些加官進爵的事上，要避把持的嫌疑。★高陽《玉座珠簾》下冊
exampleEn: Prince Gong, because of the emperor's warning, still remembered it vividly, and in matters of promotion and ennoblement, he avoided the suspicion of monopolizing power. — Gao Yang, 'Jade Pearl Curtain' Volume 2

explanation: 喜欢听，乐意看。指很受欢迎。
explanationTraditional: 喜歡聽，樂意看。指很受歡迎。
explanationEn: To be loved and welcomed by many; very popular.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这是一部很有教育意义、人民群众～的好小说。
exampleTraditional: 這是一部很有教育意義、人民群眾～的好小說。
exampleEn: This is a highly educational novel that the masses love to hear and see.

explanation: 喻明白；晓知道。家家户户都知道。形容人所共知。
explanationTraditional: 喻明白；曉知道。家家戶戶都知道。形容人所共知。
explanationEn: Known to every household; widely known.
derivation: 《汉书·刘辅传》天下不可户晓。”宋·楼钥《缴郑熙等免罪》而遽有免罪之旨，不可以家谕（喻）户晓。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·劉輔傳》天下不可戶曉。”宋·樓鑰《繳鄭熙等免罪》而遽有免罪之旨，不可以家諭（喻）戶曉。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Liu Fu': 'Cannot be known household by household.' Song Dynasty Lou Yao's 'Memorial to Remit Zheng Xi et al.': 'And suddenly there is an order of remission, which cannot be made known to every household.'
example: 与其作不能行远不能普及之秦汉六朝，不如作～之《水浒》《西游》文字也。★胡适《逼上梁山》
exampleTraditional: 與其作不能行遠不能普及之秦漢六朝，不如作～之《水滸》《西遊》文字也。★胡適《逼上梁山》
exampleEn: Rather than writing in the style of Qin-Han or Six Dynasties that cannot be widely spread, it is better to write in the style of 'Water Margin' and 'Journey to the West' that are known to every household. — Hu Shi, 'Forced to Liangshan'

explanation: 新更新；异不同。每天都在更新，每月都有变化。指发展或进步迅速，不断出现新事物、新气象。
explanationTraditional: 新更新；異不同。每天都在更新，每月都有變化。指發展或進步迅速，不斷出現新事物、新氣象。
explanationEn: Changing rapidly; making progress or development every day and every month.
derivation: 《礼记·大学》苟日新，日日新，又日新。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·大學》苟日新，日日新，又日新。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: The Great Learning': 'If you can renew yourself one day, then you can renew yourself every day, and continue to renew yourself.'
example: 教授之术，亦采法列强，教科之书，～。★清·吴趼人《痛史·原叙》
exampleTraditional: 教授之術，亦採法列強，教科之書，～。★清·吳趼人《痛史·原敘》
exampleEn: The art of teaching also adopts methods from foreign powers, and textbooks are changing with each passing day. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren, 'History of Pain: Original Preface'

explanation: 指夺取别人的地位而由自己代替。现也指以某一事物代替另一事物。
explanationTraditional: 指奪取別人的地位而由自己代替。現也指以某一事物代替另一事物。
explanationEn: To replace someone or something; to take someone's place.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》秦始皇游会稽，渡浙江，梁与籍俱观，籍曰‘彼可取而代也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》秦始皇遊會稽，渡浙江，梁與籍俱觀，籍曰‘彼可取而代也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'When the First Emperor of Qin toured Kuaiji and crossed the Zhe River, Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu watched. Xiang Yu said, 'He can be replaced.''
example: 清帝方今玩于彼股掌之上，及其时则～耳。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第八十六回
exampleTraditional: 清帝方今玩於彼股掌之上，及其時則～耳。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第八十六回
exampleEn: The Qing emperor is now playing in their palms, and when the time comes, they will replace him. — Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China' Chapter 86

explanation: 说不出其中的奥妙。指事情很奇怪，说不出道理来。
explanationTraditional: 說不出其中的奧妙。指事情很奇怪，說不出道理來。
explanationEn: Baffling; inexplicable; unable to make head or tail of something.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第十五回我实在是莫名其妙，我从那时得着这么一个门生，连我也不知道。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第十五回我實在是莫名其妙，我從那時得著這麼一個門生，連我也不知道。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' Chapter 15: 'I really couldn't make head or tail of it; I don't know how I got such a student.'
example: 躲懒的人念成潭拓寺”，那更是～了。（朱自清《潭拓寺和戒坛寺》）
exampleTraditional: 躲懶的人念成潭拓寺”，那更是～了。（朱自清《潭拓寺和戒壇寺》）
exampleEn: Lazy people pronounce it 'Tan Tuo Temple,' which is utterly baffling. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Tan Tuo Temple and Jietan Temple'

explanation: 比喻名次列在前面。
explanationTraditional: 比喻名次列在前面。
explanationEn: To rank among the top; to be at the top of the list.
derivation: 《左传·宣公十二年》蔿敖为宰，择楚国之令典，军行，右辕，左追蓐，前茅虑无，中权，后劲。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公十二年》蒍敖為宰，擇楚國之令典，軍行，右轅，左追蓐，前茅慮無，中權，後勁。”
derivationEn: From Zuo Zhuan: 'In the army, the front scouts use white grass as a signal; those at the front are the best.'
example: 去年弟在京师，听说二公子中了秀才，且～，颇为学台赏识，实在可贺可贺。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十七章
exampleTraditional: 去年弟在京師，聽說二公子中了秀才，且～，頗為學臺賞識，實在可賀可賀。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十七章
exampleEn: Last year in the capital, I heard that the second young master passed the imperial exam and ranked among the top, much appreciated by the examiner. Truly congratulations!

explanation: 排除忧愁，解除困难。
explanationTraditional: 排除憂愁，解除困難。
explanationEn: To relieve worries and solve difficulties.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指多种不同的式样、种类或方式。
explanationTraditional: 指多種不同的式樣、種類或方式。
explanationEn: All kinds of; various types or styles.
derivation: 茅盾《子夜》十二毒太阳晒得马路上的柏油发软，汽车轮辗过，就印成了各式各样的花纹。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《子夜》十二毒太陽曬得馬路上的柏油發軟，汽車輪輾過，就印成了各式各樣的花紋。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's Midnight: 'The scorching sun softened the asphalt on the road, and car wheels left all kinds of patterns.'
example: 儿童乐园里的玩具～，真是好玩极了。
exampleTraditional: 兒童樂園裡的玩具～，真是好玩極了。
exampleEn: The toys in the children's playground are of all kinds, really fun.

explanation: 不认真、不负责地对待本职工作。
explanationTraditional: 不認真、不負責地對待本職工作。
explanationEn: To neglect one's duty; to be derelict in one's responsibilities.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 由于他玩忽职守，结果给单位造成巨大的经济损失。
exampleTraditional: 由於他翫忽職守，結果給單位造成巨大的經濟損失。
exampleEn: Due to his neglect of duty, he caused huge economic losses to the unit.

explanation: 任负担；道路途。担子很重，路很远。比喻责任重大，要经历长期的奋斗。
explanationTraditional: 任負擔；道路途。擔子很重，路很遠。比喻責任重大，要經歷長期的奮鬥。
explanationEn: The burden is heavy and the road is long; to shoulder heavy responsibilities and face a long struggle.
derivation: 《论语·泰伯》士不可以不弘毅，任重而道远。仁以为己任，不亦重乎？死而后已，不亦远乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·泰伯》士不可以不弘毅，任重而道遠。仁以為己任，不亦重乎？死而後已，不亦遠乎？”
derivationEn: From The Analects: 'A scholar must be broad-minded and resolute, for his burden is heavy and his road is long.'
example: 人民教师肩负着培养祖国建设接班人的重担，～。
exampleTraditional: 人民教師肩負著培養祖國建設接班人的重擔，～。
exampleEn: Teachers bear the heavy responsibility of cultivating future builders of the motherland; the burden is heavy and the road is long.

explanation: 奋发精神振作。精神振作，有所作为。
explanationTraditional: 奮發精神振作。精神振作，有所作為。
explanationEn: To be energetic and promising; to strive for achievement.
derivation: 汉·王充《论衡·初禀篇》勇气奋发，性自然也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王充《論衡·初稟篇》勇氣奮發，性自然也。”
derivationEn: From Wang Chong's Lunheng: 'Courage bursts forth; nature is as such.'
example: 能够如此～，将来甚么事不好做呢！★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 能夠如此～，將來甚麼事不好做呢！★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十五回
exampleEn: If one can be so energetic and promising, what good deed can't be done!

explanation: 只要脚移动一下，就会影响两边的轻重。指处于重要地位，一举一动都足以影响全局。
explanationTraditional: 只要腳移動一下，就會影響兩邊的輕重。指處於重要地位，一舉一動都足以影響全局。
explanationEn: To hold a pivotal position; one's move affects the whole situation.
derivation: 《后汉书·窦融传》方蜀汉相攻，权在将军，举足左右，便有轻重。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·竇融傳》方蜀漢相攻，權在將軍，舉足左右，便有輕重。”
derivationEn: From Book of Later Han: 'When Shu and Han are at war, the power lies with the general; a slight move affects the balance.'
example: ～，动关大局。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第四回
exampleTraditional: ～，動關大局。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第四回
exampleEn: A pivotal position affects the whole situation.

explanation: 比比一个挨一个。到处都是，形容极其常见。
explanationTraditional: 比比一個挨一個。到處都是，形容極其常見。
explanationEn: Everywhere; extremely common.
derivation: 《战国策·秦策一》犯白刃，蹈煨炭，断死于前者，比是也。”宋·包拯《请救济江淮饥民疏》年亢旱，民食艰阻，流亡者比比皆是。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·秦策一》犯白刃，蹈煨炭，斷死於前者，比是也。”宋·包拯《請救濟江淮饑民疏》年亢旱，民食艱阻，流亡者比比皆是。”
derivationEn: From Strategies of the Warring States: 'Those who face blades and die are everywhere.' Also from Bao Zheng's memorial: 'Famine causes people to flee; they are everywhere.'
example: 上自朝廷，下至草野，～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二回
exampleTraditional: 上自朝廷，下至草野，～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二回
exampleEn: From the court to the countryside, they are everywhere.

explanation: 卓卓越，高超。有突出的成绩和效果。
explanationTraditional: 卓卓越，高超。有突出的成績和效果。
explanationEn: Highly effective; with outstanding results.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们要奋发地工作，卓有成效地完成上级交给我们的任务。
exampleTraditional: 我們要奮發地工作，卓有成效地完成上級交給我們的任務。
exampleEn: We must work energetically and complete the tasks assigned by our superiors with outstanding results.

explanation: 比喻长期安家落户或切切实实、一心一意地做好所从事的工作。
explanationTraditional: 比喻長期安家落戶或切切實實、一心一意地做好所從事的工作。
explanationEn: To settle down permanently; to commit oneself wholeheartedly to one's work.
derivation: 《人民日报》1969.12.18他们纷纷表示，要在农村落地生根，干一辈子革命。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1969.12.18他們紛紛表示，要在農村落地生根，幹一輩子革命。”
derivationEn: From People's Daily: 'They expressed their determination to settle in the countryside and work there for life.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 行做。从事情发展的趋势看，必须采取行动。
explanationTraditional: 行做。從事情發展的趨勢看，必須採取行動。
explanationEn: Imperative; be imperative (under the circumstances); be necessary to take action based on the trend of events.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 历史上从来没有过的事。指前所未有。
explanationTraditional: 歷史上從來沒有過的事。指前所未有。
explanationEn: Unprecedented; having no precedent in history.
derivation: 清·丘逢甲《岭云海日楼诗钞》卷十二牢落文章第一人，天门垂翅竟何因？百年记注无前例，万事枢机有要津。”
derivationTraditional: 清·丘逢甲《嶺雲海日樓詩鈔》卷十二牢落文章第一人，天門垂翅竟何因？百年記注無前例，萬事樞機有要津。”
derivationEn: From Qiu Fengjia's poem in Qing Dynasty: 'A hundred years of records have no precedent, all matters hinge on key positions.'
example: 现在的贫富悬殊是～；现在的享用娱乐也是～的。（朱自清《论且顾眼前》）
exampleTraditional: 現在的貧富懸殊是～；現在的享用娛樂也是～的。（朱自清《論且顧眼前》）
exampleEn: The current disparity between rich and poor is unprecedented; the current enjoyment and entertainment are also unprecedented. (Zhu Ziqing, 'On Only Looking at the Present')

explanation: 当然应当如此。按道理应当这样。
explanationTraditional: 當然應當如此。按道理應當這樣。
explanationEn: Of course; naturally; as a matter of course; it stands to reason.
derivation: 隋·王通《文中子·魏相篇》非辩也，理当然耳。”
derivationTraditional: 隋·王通《文中子·魏相篇》非辯也，理當然耳。”
derivationEn: From Wang Tong's 'Wenzhongzi' in Sui Dynasty: 'It is not debate, but reason naturally so.'
example: 善者福而恶者祸，～。★明·赵弼《续东窗事犯传》
exampleTraditional: 善者福而惡者禍，～。★明·趙弼《續東窗事犯傳》
exampleEn: The virtuous receive blessings and the wicked suffer calamities, it stands to reason. (Ming Dynasty, Zhao Bi, 'Sequel to the Story of the East Window Incident')

explanation: 指听得多了，能够说得很清楚、很详细。
explanationTraditional: 指聽得多了，能夠說得很清楚、很詳細。
explanationEn: Familiar to the ear and can be repeated in detail; having heard something so often that one can describe it in detail.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《泷冈阡表》吾耳熟焉，故能详也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《瀧岡阡表》吾耳熟焉，故能詳也。”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Xiu's 'Longgang Qianbiao' in Song Dynasty: 'My ears are familiar with it, so I can describe it in detail.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 由来从发生到现在。事情从发生到现在已经过了很长时间了。
explanationTraditional: 由來從發生到現在。事情從發生到現在已經過了很長時間了。
explanationEn: Long-standing; having existed for a long time.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·德行》王子敬病笃，道家上章应首过，问子敬由来有何异同得失。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·德行》王子敬病篤，道家上章應首過，問子敬由來有何異同得失。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'Shishuo Xinyu' in Southern Dynasties: 'Wang Zijing was critically ill, and the Taoist priest asked him to confess his sins, inquiring about his past merits and demerits.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 样子完全相同。
explanationTraditional: 樣子完全相同。
explanationEn: Exactly the same; identical in appearance.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第五十四回今日抬头一看，却见他黄着脸、秃着头，就和前日梦里揪他的师姑一模一样，不觉就懊恼起来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第五十四回今日抬頭一看，卻見他黃著臉、禿著頭，就和前日夢裡揪他的師姑一模一樣，不覺就懊惱起來。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars' in Qing Dynasty: 'Today I looked up and saw his yellow face and bald head, exactly the same as the nun who grabbed me in my dream a few days ago, and I couldn't help feeling annoyed.'
example: 这两件衣服从颜色到款式虽然～，但质量却有很大差别。
exampleTraditional: 這兩件衣服從顏色到款式雖然～，但質量卻有很大差別。
exampleEn: Although these two clothes are exactly the same in color and style, their quality is quite different.

explanation: 厉严格。严格地实行节约。
explanationTraditional: 厲嚴格。嚴格地實行節約。
explanationEn: Strictly practice economy; rigorously implement thrift.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 工作中必须厉行节约，反对浪费。
exampleTraditional: 工作中必須厲行節約，反對浪費。
exampleEn: At work, we must strictly practice economy and oppose waste.

explanation: 许多坏事互为因果，循环不已，越来越坏。
explanationTraditional: 許多壞事互為因果，循環不已，越來越壞。
explanationEn: Vicious circle; a cycle of negative events that reinforce each other, leading to worsening conditions.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 铤急走的样子；走险奔赴险处。指在无路可走的时候采取冒险行动。
explanationTraditional: 鋌急走的樣子；走險奔赴險處。指在無路可走的時候採取冒險行動。
explanationEn: Take a risk in desperation; make a reckless move when there is no other way out.
derivation: 《左传·文公十七年》小国之事大国也，德则其人也，不德则其鹿也，铤而走险，急何能择？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·文公十七年》小國之事大國也，德則其人也，不德則其鹿也，鋌而走險，急何能擇？”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan': 'When a small state serves a big state, if treated with virtue, it acts like a man; if not, it acts like a deer, taking risks in desperation.'
example: 碰了荒年，也少不了这班人，不然，闹出那～的，更是不得了了。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 碰了荒年，也少不了這班人，不然，鬧出那～的，更是不得了了。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第十五回
exampleEn: In times of famine, there will inevitably be such people; otherwise, if they resort to desperate acts, it will be even more troublesome. (Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events Witnessed in Twenty Years', Chapter 15)

explanation: 全世界的人都注视着。
explanationTraditional: 全世界的人都注視著。
explanationEn: Attract worldwide attention; be the focus of global attention.
derivation: 《国语·晋语》则恐国人之瞩目于我也。”战国·楚·屈原《渔父》举世皆浊我独清。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·晉語》則恐國人之矚目於我也。”戰國·楚·屈原《漁父》舉世皆濁我獨清。”
derivationEn: From 'Guoyu': 'Then I fear the people of the country will focus their eyes on me.' And from Qu Yuan's 'The Fisherman': 'The whole world is muddy, I alone am clear.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 接接战；厉磨快，引伸为奋勉，努力。指公鸡相斗，每次交锋以前先磨一下嘴。比喻继续努力，再加一把劲。
explanationTraditional: 接接戰；厲磨快，引伸為奮勉，努力。指公雞相鬥，每次交鋒以前先磨一下嘴。比喻繼續努力，再加一把勁。
explanationEn: To continue striving; to make persistent efforts; to redouble one's efforts.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《斗鸡联句》一喷一醒然，再接再厉乃。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《鬥雞聯句》一噴一醒然，再接再厲乃。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Cockfighting Couplet' in the Tang Dynasty: 'After each spray and awakening, again and again sharpen the beak.'
example: 取得好成绩也不能自满，要～，不断进取。
exampleTraditional: 取得好成績也不能自滿，要～，不斷進取。
exampleEn: Even after achieving good results, one should not be complacent but continue to strive and keep improving.

explanation: 脚不跨出家门。
explanationTraditional: 腳不跨出家門。
explanationEn: Not to step out of one's house; to stay indoors.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十五却说苏盼奴自赵司户去后，足不出门，一客不见，只等襄阳来音。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十五卻說蘇盼奴自趙司戶去後，足不出門，一客不見，只等襄陽來音。”
derivationEn: From Ling Mengchu's 'Striking the Table in Amazement, First Collection' in the Ming Dynasty: 'Su Pannu, since Secretary Zhao left, never stepped out of her door, saw no guests, and only waited for news from Xiangyang.'
example: 据我个人的经验，我们那里的土话，和苏州很不同，但一部《海上花列传》，却教我～”懂了白。★鲁迅《花边文学·汉字和拉丁化》
exampleTraditional: 據我個人的經驗，我們那裡的土話，和蘇州很不同，但一部《海上花列傳》，卻教我～”懂了白。★魯迅《花邊文學·漢字和拉丁化》
exampleEn: Based on my personal experience, the local dialect there is very different from Suzhou, but the novel 'Flowers of Shanghai' taught me to understand it without leaving home. (Lu Xun, 'Flower Border Literature: Chinese Characters and Latinization')

explanation: 覆翻过来。形容变化巨大而彻底。也指闹得很凶。
explanationTraditional: 覆翻過來。形容變化巨大而徹底。也指鬧得很兇。
explanationEn: Describing a tremendous and thorough change; also refers to a great uproar or upheaval.
derivation: 唐·刘商《胡茄十八拍》诗天翻地覆谁得知，如今正南看北斗。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉商《胡茄十八拍》詩天翻地覆誰得知，如今正南看北斗。”
derivationEn: From Liu Shang's poem 'Eighteen Beats of the Barbarian Reed Pipe' in the Tang Dynasty: 'Heaven and earth overturned, who knows? Now the south is seen as the north.'
example: 真象～的变动就快要临头了。★沙汀《兽道》
exampleTraditional: 真象～的變動就快要臨頭了。★沙汀《獸道》
exampleEn: It seemed that a truly earth-shattering change was about to come. (Sha Ding, 'The Way of Beasts')

explanation: 寻常平常。形容人和事物很突出，不同于一般。
explanationTraditional: 尋常平常。形容人和事物很突出，不同於一般。
explanationEn: Extraordinary; out of the ordinary; remarkable.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他是一个非同寻常的人物。
exampleTraditional: 他是一個非同尋常的人物。
exampleEn: He is an extraordinary person.

explanation: 每家每户，户户不漏。挨，依次，顺次。
explanationTraditional: 每家每戶，戶戶不漏。挨，依次，順次。
explanationEn: From door to door; house to house; every household without exception.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》七四自从他作了副县长，随着白巡长挨家挨户地收铜铁，他的美誉便降落了许多。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》七四自從他作了副縣長，隨著白巡長挨家挨戶地收銅鐵，他的美譽便降落了許多。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof': 'Since he became deputy county head and went door to door collecting copper and iron with Patrolman Bai, his reputation had greatly declined.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 翼翅膀。没有翅膀却飞走了。比喻物品忽然丢失。也比喻事情传播得很迅速。
explanationTraditional: 翼翅膀。沒有翅膀卻飛走了。比喻物品忽然丟失。也比喻事情傳播得很迅速。
explanationEn: To disappear without trace; to vanish into thin air; also refers to news spreading quickly.
derivation: 《管子·戒》无翼而飞者声也。”《战国策·秦策三》众口所移，毋翼而飞。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·戒》無翼而飛者聲也。”《戰國策·秦策三》眾口所移，毋翼而飛。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Jie' and 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qin III': 'Sound travels without wings.' 'What many mouths move, moves without wings.'
example: 足足的一百六十块钱就那样便～了。★郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年》
exampleTraditional: 足足的一百六十塊錢就那樣便～了。★郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年》
exampleEn: A full one hundred and sixty dollars had vanished into thin air. (Guo Moruo, 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: Ten Years of Creation')

explanation: 参差长短、高低不齐。形容水平不一或很不整齐。
explanationTraditional: 參差長短、高低不齊。形容水平不一或很不整齊。
explanationEn: Uneven; not uniform; varying in level or quality.
derivation: 《诗经·周南·关雎》参差荇菜，左右采之。”汉·扬雄《法言·序目》国君将相，卿士名臣，参差不齐，一概诸圣。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周南·關雎》參差荇菜，左右采之。”漢·揚雄《法言·序目》國君將相，卿士名臣，參差不齊，一概諸聖。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Zhou Nan: Guan Ju' and Yang Xiong's 'Fa Yan: Xu Mu' in the Han Dynasty: 'Uneven water plants, picked left and right.' 'Rulers, generals, ministers, and famous officials are uneven, all judged by the sages.'
example: 礼生见他们～，也只好由着他们敷衍了事。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第一回
exampleTraditional: 禮生見他們～，也只好由著他們敷衍了事。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第一回
exampleEn: Seeing that they were uneven, the master of ceremonies had to let them muddle through perfunctorily. (Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 1)

explanation: 水位升高，船身也随之浮起。比喻事物随着它所凭借的基础的提高而增长提高。
explanationTraditional: 水位升高，船身也隨之浮起。比喻事物隨著它所憑藉的基礎的提高而增長提高。
explanationEn: When the water rises, the boat floats higher. Metaphorically, things improve or increase as the foundation or basis improves.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》水长船高，泥多佛大。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》水長船高，泥多佛大。”
derivationEn: From Shi Daoyuan's 'Transmission of the Lamp' in the Song Dynasty: 'When water rises, the boat rises; when mud is more, the Buddha is bigger.'
example: 几回事情一来，他晓得人家有仰仗他的地方，顿时～，架子亦就慢慢的大了起来。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 幾回事情一來，他曉得人家有仰仗他的地方，頓時～，架子亦就慢慢的大了起來。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十九回
exampleEn: After a few incidents, he realized that others relied on him, and immediately his boat rose with the water, and his airs gradually grew. (Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 59)

explanation: 沸沸水翻滚的样子；扬扬喧闹、翻动的样子。象沸腾的水一样喧闹。形容人声喧闹。
explanationTraditional: 沸沸水翻滾的樣子；揚揚喧鬧、翻動的樣子。象沸騰的水一樣喧鬧。形容人聲喧鬧。
explanationEn: Bubbling and noisy; like boiling water; describing a hubbub or uproar.
derivation: 《山海经·西山经》其中多白玉，是有玉膏，其原沸沸汤汤。”
derivationTraditional: 《山海經·西山經》其中多白玉，是有玉膏，其原沸沸湯湯。”
derivationEn: From 'The Classic of Mountains and Seas: Western Mountains': 'There is much white jade, and its spring bubbles and gushes.'
example: 后来听得～地说黄泥冈上一伙贩枣的客人把蒙汗药麻翻了人，劫了生辰冈去。”★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 後來聽得～地說黃泥岡上一夥販棗的客人把蒙汗藥麻翻了人，劫了生辰岡去。”★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第十八回
exampleEn: Later, it was noisily said that a group of date sellers on Yellow Mud Ridge had drugged and robbed the birthday convoy. (Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 18)

explanation: 发开始行动；制控制，制服。原指丢动手的牌主动地位，可以控制对方◇也泛指争取主动，先动手来制服对方。
explanationTraditional: 發開始行動；制控制，制服。原指丟動手的牌主動地位，可以控制對方◇也泛指爭取主動，先動手來制服對方。
explanationEn: To gain the initiative by striking first; to preemptively control or defeat the opponent.
derivation: 《汉书·项籍传》先发制人，后发制于人。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·項籍傳》先發制人，後發制於人。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'He who strikes first controls others; he who strikes later is controlled by others.'
example: 剑波没等这位警长开口，便理直气壮地来个～。★曲波《林海雪原》三
exampleTraditional: 劍波沒等這位警長開口，便理直氣壯地來個～。★曲波《林海雪原》三
exampleEn: Before the police chief could speak, Jianbo took the initiative and struck first with a righteous tone. (Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 3)

explanation: 轩然波涛高高涌起的样子。高高涌起的波涛。比喻大的纠纷或乱子。
explanationTraditional: 軒然波濤高高湧起的樣子。高高湧起的波濤。比喻大的糾紛或亂子。
explanationEn: A great disturbance or uproar; a major dispute or trouble.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《岳阳楼别窦司直》诗轩然大波起，宇宙隘而妨。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《岳陽樓別竇司直》詩軒然大波起，宇宙隘而妨。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's poem 'Seeing Off Dou Sizhi at Yueyang Tower' in the Tang Dynasty: 'A huge wave rises, the universe narrows and hinders.'
example: 没想到这么点小事竟然引起这样一场～。
exampleTraditional: 沒想到這麼點小事竟然引起這樣一場～。
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, such a small matter caused such a great uproar.

explanation: 出乎人们意料之外。
explanationTraditional: 出乎人們意料之外。
explanationEn: Beyond people's expectations; unexpected.
derivation: 《南史·袁宪传》宪常招引诸生与之谈论新义，出人意表，同辈咸嗟服焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·袁憲傳》憲常招引諸生與之談論新義，出人意表，同輩鹹嗟服焉。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Southern Dynasties: Biography of Yuan Xian': 'Yuan Xian often invited students to discuss new ideas, which were beyond expectations, and his peers all admired him.'
example: 才貌却相当，缘合未堪奇赏，～，在那错联鸾凰。★明·无名氏《赠书记·奉诏团圆》
exampleTraditional: 才貌卻相當，緣合未堪奇賞，～，在那錯聯鸞凰。★明·無名氏《贈書記·奉詔團圓》
exampleEn: Their talents and looks match, but the union is not yet worthy of admiration; unexpectedly, the wrong couple is linked. — Ming Dynasty, anonymous 'Gift of a Book: Receiving the Imperial Decree for Reunion'

explanation: 当地生长的。
explanationTraditional: 當地生長的。
explanationEn: Locally born and raised; native.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他是当地土生土长干部，对这里的情况了如指掌。
exampleTraditional: 他是當地土生土長幹部，對這裡的情況瞭如指掌。
exampleEn: He is a locally born and raised cadre, thoroughly familiar with the situation here.

explanation: 统筹通盘筹划；兼本义为一手执两禾，引伸为同时进行几桩事情或占有几样东西；顾照顾。统一筹划，全面照顾。
explanationTraditional: 統籌通盤籌劃；兼本義為一手執兩禾，引伸為同時進行幾樁事情或佔有幾樣東西；顧照顧。統一籌劃，全面照顧。
explanationEn: Overall planning and all-round consideration; to make overall plans and take all factors into account.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 国家利益、集体利益、个人利益要三者统筹兼顾才行。
exampleTraditional: 國家利益、集體利益、個人利益要三者統籌兼顧才行。
exampleEn: The interests of the state, the collective, and the individual must be taken into account in an overall manner.

explanation: 从明里细心察看，从暗里询问了解。指用各种方法进行调查研究。
explanationTraditional: 從明裡細心察看，從暗裡詢問了解。指用各種方法進行調查研究。
explanationEn: To observe openly and investigate secretly; to conduct thorough investigations using various methods.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《痛史》第十一回我住在此处，徒占一席，于事无济，倒不如仍然到外面去，明察暗访。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《痛史》第十一回我住在此處，徒佔一席，於事無濟，倒不如仍然到外面去，明察暗訪。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'A Painful History', Chapter 11: 'Staying here in vain, I am of no use; it's better to go out again and observe openly and investigate secretly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 刻指短暂的时间；缓延迟。指形势紧迫，一刻也不允许拖延。
explanationTraditional: 刻指短暫的時間；緩延遲。指形勢緊迫，一刻也不允許拖延。
explanationEn: Not a moment to delay; extremely urgent.
derivation: 宋·周密《齐东野语》帝王即位，即是好日，兼官历又吉，何疑？事不容缓。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《齊東野語》帝王即位，即是好日，兼官曆又吉，何疑？事不容緩。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhou Mi's 'Qidong Yeyu': 'When an emperor ascends the throne, it is a good day, and the official calendar is auspicious; what doubt is there? The matter cannot be delayed.'
example: 胎前产后以及难产各症，不独～，并且两命攸关。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十回
exampleTraditional: 胎前產後以及難產各症，不獨～，並且兩命攸關。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十回
exampleEn: Complications during pregnancy and childbirth, including difficult labor, not only brook no delay but also concern two lives. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 40

explanation: 融合为整体。比喻几种事物关系密切，配合自然，如同一个整体。
explanationTraditional: 融合為整體。比喻幾種事物關係密切，配合自然，如同一個整體。
explanationEn: To merge into an integrated whole; to be closely integrated and harmonious.
derivation: 先秦·管仲《管子·七法》有一体之治，故能出号令，明宪法矣。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·管仲《管子·七法》有一體之治，故能出號令，明憲法矣。”
derivationEn: From pre-Qin Guan Zhong's 'Guanzi: Seven Laws': 'There is governance as one body, so orders can be issued and laws clarified.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 焕然鲜明光亮的样子。改变旧面貌，出现崭新的气象。
explanationTraditional: 煥然鮮明光亮的樣子。改變舊面貌，出現嶄新的氣象。
explanationEn: To take on an entirely new look; to be completely renewed.
derivation: 唐·张彦远《历代名画记·论鉴识收藏购求阅玩》其有晋宋名迹，焕然如新，已历数百年，纸素彩色未甚败。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·張彥遠《歷代名畫記·論鑑識收藏購求閱玩》其有晉宋名跡，煥然如新，已歷數百年，紙素彩色未甚敗。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Zhang Yanyuan's 'Famous Paintings of Past Dynasties: On Appreciation and Collection': 'The famous works of Jin and Song dynasties are as fresh as new, having gone through centuries without much damage to paper and colors.'
example: 依中国法度，造作旗帜大纛，～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 依中國法度，造作旗幟大纛，～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十一回
exampleEn: According to Chinese laws, they made banners and flags, which were completely new. — Qing Dynasty Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 11

explanation: 则准则，榜样。以自己的行动做出榜样。
explanationTraditional: 則準則，榜樣。以自己的行動做出榜樣。
explanationEn: To set an example by one's own actions; to act as a role model.
derivation: 巴金《家》二十五这其间不顾一切阻碍以身作则做一个开路先锋的便是许倩如。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《家》二十五這其間不顧一切阻礙以身作則做一個開路先鋒的便是許倩如。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin's 'Family', Chapter 25: 'The one who set an example by disregarding all obstacles and acting as a pioneer was Xu Qianru.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 潜暗中同，不见形迹；默不说话，没有声音。指人的思想或性格不知不觉受到感染、影响而发生了变化。
explanationTraditional: 潛暗中同，不見形跡；默不說話，沒有聲音。指人的思想或性格不知不覺受到感染、影響而發生了變化。
