exampleEn: But they are often sternly rejected by the peasant association, so they always live in fear. — Mao Zedong, 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan'

explanation: 徇曲从；舞舞弄，耍花样。为了私人关系而用欺骗的方法做违法乱纪的事。
explanationTraditional: 徇曲從；舞舞弄，耍花樣。為了私人關係而用欺騙的方法做違法亂紀的事。
explanationEn: To bend the law for personal gain; to engage in fraud for private benefit.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第八十三回谁想这伙官员，贪滥无厌，徇私作弊，克减酒肉。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第八十三回誰想這夥官員，貪濫無厭，徇私作弊，克減酒肉。”
derivationEn: From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', chapter 83: 'Who would have thought these officials were insatiably greedy, bending the law for personal gain, and skimping on wine and meat.'
example: 这种～的事情，他绝不会干。
exampleTraditional: 這種～的事情，他絕不會幹。
exampleEn: He would never do such a thing as bending the law for personal gain.

explanation: 什么也不知道。
explanationTraditional: 什麼也不知道。
explanationEn: To know nothing at all; to be completely ignorant.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十五小学生望后便倒，扶起，良久方醒。问之一无所知。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十五小學生望後便倒，扶起，良久方醒。問之一無所知。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World', volume 15: 'The elementary school student fell backward, and after being helped up, took a long time to wake up. When asked, he knew nothing.'
example: 对于世界历史，他～。
exampleTraditional: 對於世界歷史，他～。
exampleEn: He knows nothing about world history.

explanation: 锲镂刻；舍停止。不断地镂刻。比喻有恒心，有毅力。
explanationTraditional: 鍥鏤刻；舍停止。不斷地鏤刻。比喻有恆心，有毅力。
explanationEn: To carve without stopping; to persevere unremittingly.
derivation: 《荀子·劝学》锲而舍之，朽木不折；锲而不舍，金石可镂。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·勸學》鍥而舍之，朽木不折；鍥而不捨，金石可鏤。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi's 'Encouraging Learning': 'If you carve and give up, even rotten wood will not break; if you carve without stopping, even metal and stone can be engraved.'
example: 夫固谓一人～，则行美于本性矣。★章炳麟《菌说》
exampleTraditional: 夫固謂一人～，則行美於本性矣。★章炳麟《菌說》
exampleEn: Thus it is said that if a person perseveres unremittingly, their actions will surpass their inherent nature. — Zhang Binglin, 'On Bacteria'

explanation: 用心居心，打算。心中另有算计。指言论或行动另有不可告人的企图。
explanationTraditional: 用心居心，打算。心中另有算計。指言論或行動另有不可告人的企圖。
explanationEn: To have ulterior motives; to harbor hidden intentions.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第九十九回王太尊也是说他办事可靠，那里知道他是别有用心的呢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第九十九回王太尊也是說他辦事可靠，那裡知道他是別有用心的呢。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 99: 'Magistrate Wang also said he was reliable in handling affairs, but how could he know that he had ulterior motives?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 打出手戏曲中的一种武打技术，一出剧中的主要人物与多个对手相打，形成种种武打场面。比喻逞凶打人或殴斗。
explanationTraditional: 打出手戲曲中的一種武打技術，一齣劇中的主要人物與多個對手相打，形成種種武打場面。比喻逞兇打人或毆鬥。
explanationEn: To engage in a fierce fight or brawl; to come to blows.
derivation: 郭沫若《南京印象》这儿在三天前正是大打出手的地方，而今天却是太平无事了。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《南京印象》這兒在三天前正是大打出手的地方，而今天卻是太平無事了。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'Impressions of Nanjing': 'This place was exactly where a fierce fight took place three days ago, yet today it is peaceful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 舟船；济渡，过洒。坐一条船，共同渡河。比喻团结互助，同心协力，战胜困难。也比喻利害相同。
explanationTraditional: 舟船；濟渡，過灑。坐一條船，共同渡河。比喻團結互助，同心協力，戰勝困難。也比喻利害相同。
explanationEn: To cross a river in the same boat; to cooperate in overcoming difficulties together.
derivation: 《孙子·九地》夫吴人与越人相恶也，当其同舟而济，遇风，其相救也如左右手。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·九地》夫吳人與越人相惡也，當其同舟而濟，遇風，其相救也如左右手。”
derivationEn: From Sunzi's 'The Art of War': 'Though the people of Wu and Yue are hostile, when they cross a river in the same boat and encounter a storm, they help each other like left and right hands.'
example: 通常在林海里人与人相遇，和在远洋航海中～一样，为什么他竟这样势不两立。★曲波《林海雪原》二十七
exampleTraditional: 通常在林海里人與人相遇，和在遠洋航海中～一樣，為什麼他竟這樣勢不兩立。★曲波《林海雪原》二十七
exampleEn: Usually, when people meet in the forest, it is like crossing the ocean together in the same boat. Why then is he so irreconcilable? — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 27

explanation: 指春天下雨后，竹笋一下子就长出来很多。比喻事物迅速大量地涌现出来。
explanationTraditional: 指春天下雨後，竹筍一下子就長出來很多。比喻事物迅速大量地湧現出來。
explanationEn: Like bamboo shoots after a spring rain; to emerge rapidly and in large numbers.
derivation: 宋·张耒《食笋》诗荒林春雨足，新笋迸龙雏。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張耒《食筍》詩荒林春雨足，新筍迸龍雛。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Lei's poem 'Eating Bamboo Shoots': 'After abundant rain in the desolate forest, new bamboo shoots burst forth like dragon cubs.'
example: 国内废科举，兴学校，好象～，努力学习西方。★毛泽东《论人民民主专政》
exampleTraditional: 國內廢科舉，興學校，好象～，努力學習西方。★毛澤東《論人民民主專政》
exampleEn: Domestically, the abolition of the imperial examination and the establishment of schools sprang up like bamboo shoots after a spring rain, as we eagerly learned from the West. — Mao Zedong, 'On the People's Democratic Dictatorship'

explanation: 兢兢形容小心谨慎；业业畏惧的样子。形容做事谨慎、勤恳。
explanationTraditional: 兢兢形容小心謹慎；業業畏懼的樣子。形容做事謹慎、勤懇。
explanationEn: To be cautious and diligent; to work conscientiously and with care.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·云汉》兢兢业业，如霆如雷。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·雲漢》兢兢業業，如霆如雷。”
derivationEn: From the 'Book of Songs, Greater Odes, Cloudy Han': 'Cautious and diligent, as if facing thunder and lightning.'
example: 于是宁府中人才知凤姐厉害，自此俱～，不敢偷安。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 於是寧府中人才知鳳姐厲害，自此俱～，不敢偷安。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十四回
exampleEn: Thus the people of the Ning Mansion realized how formidable Xifeng was, and from then on, they all worked cautiously and diligently, not daring to slack off. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 14

explanation: 哭得噎住了，出不来声音。形容非常伤心。
explanationTraditional: 哭得噎住了，出不來聲音。形容非常傷心。
explanationEn: To choke with sobs; to be unable to speak through tears.
derivation: 《吴越春秋·越王无余外传》尽夜哭泣，气不属声。”
derivationTraditional: 《吳越春秋·越王無餘外傳》盡夜哭泣，氣不屬聲。”
derivationEn: From 'Spring and Autumn Annals of Wu and Yue': 'Weeping day and night, breath failing to connect with voice.'
example: 弥留之际，日饮白汤升许，欲以洗涤肺腑，及食不下咽，～。★清·黄钧宰《金壶七墨·鸳鸯印传奇始末》
exampleTraditional: 彌留之際，日飲白湯升許，欲以洗滌肺腑，及食不下咽，～。★清·黃鈞宰《金壺七墨·鴛鴦印傳奇始末》
exampleEn: On his deathbed, he drank a liter of plain water daily, hoping to cleanse his internal organs, but eventually could not swallow, and choked with sobs. — Huang Junzai, 'Golden Pot and Seven Inkstones: The Story of the Mandarin Duck Seal'

explanation: 问津询问渡口。比喻没有人来探问、尝试或购买。
explanationTraditional: 問津詢問渡口。比喻沒有人來探問、嘗試或購買。
explanationEn: No one asks about the ferry; no one shows interest or inquires.
derivation: 晋·陶潜《桃花源记》南阳刘子骥，高尚士也，闻之，欣然规往，未果，寻病终◇遂无问津者。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陶潛《桃花源記》南陽劉子驥，高尚士也，聞之，欣然規往，未果，尋病終◇遂無問津者。”
derivationEn: From Tao Qian's 'Peach Blossom Spring': 'Liu Ziji of Nanyang, a noble scholar, heard of it and joyfully set out, but failed to find it and later died of illness. Thereafter, no one inquired about the ferry.'
example: 这部传记小说，虽然摆在书架上，却根本～。
exampleTraditional: 這部傳記小說，雖然擺在書架上，卻根本～。
exampleEn: This biographical novel, though placed on the bookshelf, has attracted no readers at all.

explanation: 该有的全都有。形容很齐全。
explanationTraditional: 該有的全都有。形容很齊全。
explanationEn: To have everything that should be there; to be complete and comprehensive.
derivation: 《宋书·江智渊传》人所应有尽有，人所应无尽无，其江智渊乎！”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·江智淵傳》人所應有盡有，人所應無盡無，其江智淵乎！”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Song: Biography of Jiang Zhizhi': 'What a person should have, he has all; what a person should not have, he has none. Is that not Jiang Zhizhi?'
example: 这家商场里的商品品种丰富，～。
exampleTraditional: 這家商場裡的商品品種豐富，～。
exampleEn: The variety of goods in this department store is rich, and everything one could want is available.

explanation: 引用；戒鉴戒。指把过去犯错误的教训拿来作为警戒，避免重犯。
explanationTraditional: 引用；戒鑑戒。指把過去犯錯誤的教訓拿來作為警戒，避免重犯。
explanationEn: To take as a warning; to learn from past mistakes to avoid repeating them.
derivation: 《国语·楚语下》人之求多闻善败，以鉴戒也。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·楚語下》人之求多聞善敗，以鑑戒也。”
derivationEn: From 'Discourses of the States: Discourses of Chu, Part 2': 'A person seeks to hear much about good and bad deeds in order to take them as warnings.'
example: 所以近七八年来，历任巡抚者～，不敢委他事情。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 所以近七八年來，歷任巡撫者～，不敢委他事情。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十八回
exampleEn: Thus, in the past seven or eight years, successive governors have taken this as a warning and dared not entrust him with any tasks. — Li Baojia, 'Officialdom Unmasked', Chapter 18

explanation: 异军另外一支军队。比喻一支新生力量突然出现。
explanationTraditional: 異軍另外一支軍隊。比喻一支新生力量突然出現。
explanationEn: A new force suddenly emerging; a sudden rise of a new power or group.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》少年欲立婴便为王，异军苍头特起。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》少年欲立嬰便為王，異軍蒼頭特起。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'The youths wanted to make Ying their king, and a different army rose abruptly.'
example: 武昌树帜，余在沪读，值先烈陈英士先生～。★柳亚子《燕子龛遗诗序》
exampleTraditional: 武昌樹幟，餘在滬讀，值先烈陳英士先生～。★柳亞子《燕子龕遺詩序》
exampleEn: When Wuchang raised the banner, I was in Shanghai, and it coincided with the rise of the late martyr Chen Yingshi. ★ Liu Yazi's 'Preface to Swallow Niche's Posthumous Poems'

explanation: 原形容水面辽阔。现比喻声势雄壮或规模巨大。
explanationTraditional: 原形容水面遼闊。現比喻聲勢雄壯或規模巨大。
explanationEn: Originally describing vast waters; now metaphorically refers to a grand scale or powerful momentum.
derivation: 南朝·宋·鲍照《登大雷岸与妹书》旅客贫辛，波路壮阔。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·鮑照《登大雷岸與妹書》旅客貧辛，波路壯闊。”
derivationEn: From Bao Zhao's 'Letter to My Sister on Climbing Thunder Mountain' (Southern Dynasties): 'The traveler is weary, the waves are vast and magnificent.'
example: 七言诗须～，顿挫激昂，大开开阖耳。★清·郎廷槐《师友诗传续录》
exampleTraditional: 七言詩須～，頓挫激昂，大開開闔耳。★清·郎廷槐《師友詩傳續錄》
exampleEn: Seven-character poetry must be magnificent, with abrupt transitions and stirring emotions, opening and closing widely. ★ Qing Dynasty Lang Tinghuai's 'Continuation of Teachers' and Friends' Poetry Talks'

explanation: 奈何如何，怎么办。指感到没有办法，只有这样了。
explanationTraditional: 奈何如何，怎麼辦。指感到沒有辦法，只有這樣了。
explanationEn: Having no alternative; feeling helpless and resigned to the situation.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策三》太子闻之，弛往，伏尸而哭极哀。既已无可奈何，乃遂收盛樊於期之首，函封之。”《史记·周本纪》祸成矣，载可奈何。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策三》太子聞之，弛往，伏屍而哭極哀。既已無可奈何，乃遂收盛樊於期之首，函封之。”《史記·周本紀》禍成矣，載可奈何。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Yan' and 'Records of the Grand Historian: Zhou Annals': 'The crown prince heard of it, rushed there, wept bitterly over the corpse. Since there was nothing to be done, he accepted Fan Yuqi's head and sealed it in a box.'
example: 大哥同杨太守来拿我，实是一毫不知，既被他连累，也～了。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三回
exampleTraditional: 大哥同楊太守來拿我，實是一毫不知，既被他連累，也～了。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三回
exampleEn: When Brother Da and Magistrate Yang came to arrest me, I truly knew nothing. Being implicated by them, I had no choice. ★ Qing Dynasty Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel' Chapter 3

explanation: 归结到根本上。
explanationTraditional: 歸結到根本上。
explanationEn: In the final analysis; when all is said and done.
derivation: 清·张南庄《何典》第二回归根结柢，把一场着水人命一盘摙归去，还亏有钱使得鬼推磨。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張南莊《何典》第二回歸根結柢，把一場著水人命一盤摙歸去，還虧有錢使得鬼推磨。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Nanzhuang's 'He Dian': 'In the end, the whole murder case was settled, and it still took money to make the devil push the mill.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 兼都。思想品德和学业都很优秀。
explanationTraditional: 兼都。思想品德和學業都很優秀。
explanationEn: Excellent in both moral character and academic performance.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第九回一定是一位品学兼优，阅历通达的老长辈。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第九回一定是一位品學兼優，閱歷通達的老長輩。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines' Chapter 9: 'He must be an elder of excellent character and learning, experienced and knowledgeable.'
example: 他是一名～的好学生。
exampleTraditional: 他是一名～的好學生。
exampleEn: He is a good student with excellent character and academic performance.

explanation: 司空古代官名。指某事常见，不足为奇。
explanationTraditional: 司空古代官名。指某事常見，不足為奇。
explanationEn: A common occurrence; something that is frequently seen and no longer surprising.
derivation: 唐·孟棨《本事诗·情感》载刘禹锡诗司空见惯浑闲事，断尽江南刺史肠。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·孟棨《本事詩·情感》載劉禹錫詩司空見慣渾閒事，斷盡江南刺史腸。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Meng Qi's 'Anecdotes of Poetry: Emotions': Liu Yuxi's poem: 'The Minister of Works is used to such trivial matters, but it breaks the heart of the Jiangnan governor.'
example: 帝国主义”这种字样，在现今已是～了，但在当年却几乎是一种讳名。（郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年续篇》）
exampleTraditional: 帝國主義”這種字樣，在現今已是～了，但在當年卻幾乎是一種諱名。（郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年續篇》）
exampleEn: The term 'imperialism' is now commonplace, but in those days it was almost a taboo. ★ Guo Moruo's 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: Continuation of the Decade of Creation'

explanation: 澜大波浪。比喻从旁鼓动、助长事物（多指坏的事物）的声势和发展，扩大影响。
explanationTraditional: 瀾大波浪。比喻從旁鼓動、助長事物（多指壞的事物）的聲勢和發展，擴大影響。
explanationEn: To add fuel to the fire; to encourage or exacerbate a situation (usually negative).
derivation: 隋·王通《文中子·问易篇》真君建德之事，足推波助澜，纵风止燎尔。”
derivationTraditional: 隋·王通《文中子·問易篇》真君建德之事，足推波助瀾，縱風止燎爾。”
derivationEn: From Sui Dynasty Wang Tong's 'Wenzi: Asking Yi': 'The events of Zhenjun and Jiande were enough to push the waves and help the billows, to fan the wind and stop the fire.'
example: 即或漏吞舟之鱼，而已暴鳃断鳍，颓然老矣，尚何能为～之事哉！★严复《论世变之亟》
exampleTraditional: 即或漏吞舟之魚，而已暴鰓斷鰭，頹然老矣，尚何能為～之事哉！★嚴復《論世變之亟》
exampleEn: Even if a fish that swallows a boat escapes, it is already broken and old; how can it still stir up waves? ★ Yan Fu's 'On the Urgency of World Change'

explanation: 形容非常小或非常少。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常小或非常少。
explanationEn: Extremely small or insignificant.
derivation: 《尔雅·释训》式微式微者，微微微者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《爾雅·釋訓》式微式微者，微微微者也。”
derivationEn: From 'Erya: Explanation of Training': 'Shi wei shi wei zhe, wei wei wei zhe ye.' (Interpretation of 'wei' as tiny.)
example: 富庶的河套，是黄河所给的一点点它口里所吐出的，和被它所吞没的比较起来，真是～了。★臧克家《毛主席向着黄河笑》
exampleTraditional: 富庶的河套，是黃河所給的一點點它口裡所吐出的，和被它所吞沒的比較起來，真是～了。★臧克家《毛主席向著黃河笑》
exampleEn: The fertile Hetao region is just a tiny bit that the Yellow River spits out; compared to what it swallows, it is truly negligible. ★ Zang Kejia's 'Chairman Mao Smiles at the Yellow River'

explanation: 相提相对照；并齐。把不同的人或不同的事放在一起谈论或看待。
explanationTraditional: 相提相對照；並齊。把不同的人或不同的事放在一起談論或看待。
explanationEn: To mention or treat different people or things in the same breath; to equate.
derivation: 《史记·魏其武安侯列传》相提并论，是自明扬主上之过。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魏其武安侯列傳》相提並論，是自明揚主上之過。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Wei Qi and Wu'an': 'To equate them is to openly expose the emperor's fault.'
example: 二者～，则陈张两公之捐躯殉难，均有所迫而然也。★清·淮阴百一居士《壶天录》
exampleTraditional: 二者～，則陳張兩公之捐軀殉難，均有所迫而然也。★清·淮陰百一居士《壺天錄》
exampleEn: To equate the two, then the sacrifices of Chen and Zhang were both compelled by circumstances. ★ Qing Dynasty Huaiyin Baiyi Jushi's 'Records from a Gourd'

explanation: 策办法。遇到问题，就象手被捆住一样，一点办法也没有。
explanationTraditional: 策辦法。遇到問題，就象手被捆住一樣，一點辦法也沒有。
explanationEn: To be at a loss; to have no solution or plan when facing a problem.
derivation: 元·无名氏《宋季三朝政要》（秦）桧死而逆亮（金主完颜亮）南牧，孰不束手无策。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《宋季三朝政要》（秦）檜死而逆亮（金主完顏亮）南牧，孰不束手無策。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'Three Dynasties Political Records of Song': 'After Qin Hui died, the Jin ruler Wanyan Liang invaded the south; who was not helpless?'
example: 梅飏仁正在～的时候，听了师爷的话说甚是中听，立刻照办。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 梅颺仁正在～的時候，聽了師爺的話說甚是中聽，立刻照辦。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十五回
exampleEn: When Mei Yangren was at his wit's end, he found the advisor's words agreeable and immediately acted upon them. ★ Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene' Chapter 55

explanation: 相信他是真的。指把假的当作真的。
explanationTraditional: 相信他是真的。指把假的當作真的。
explanationEn: To believe something to be true; to accept falsehood as truth.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言·李沠公穷邸遇侠客》只因他平日冒称是宰相房玄龄之后，在人前夸炫家世，同僚中不知他的来历，信以为真，把他十分敬重。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言·李沠公窮邸遇俠客》只因他平日冒稱是宰相房玄齡之後，在人前誇炫家世，同僚中不知他的來歷，信以為真，把他十分敬重。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World': 'Because he often claimed to be a descendant of Prime Minister Fang Xuanling and boasted about his family background, his colleagues, unaware of his true origins, believed him and respected him greatly.'
example: 宝玉又问他地名庄名，来往远近，坐落何方，刘老老便顺口诌了出来。宝玉～。★清·曹雪琴《红楼梦》第三十九回
exampleTraditional: 寶玉又問他地名莊名，來往遠近，坐落何方，劉老老便順口謅了出來。寶玉～。★清·曹雪琴《紅樓夢》第三十九回
exampleEn: Baoyu asked her the name of the place, the village, the distance, and the location, and Granny Liu made up answers on the spot. Baoyu believed them to be true. — from Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 39

explanation: 冷灰重新烧了起来。原比喻失势的人重新得势。现常比喻已经消失了的恶势力又重新活动起来。
explanationTraditional: 冷灰重新燒了起來。原比喻失勢的人重新得勢。現常比喻已經消失了的惡勢力又重新活動起來。
explanationEn: Dead ashes burning again; originally meant a person who has lost power regaining it, now often refers to evil forces that have disappeared reviving.
derivation: 《史记·韩长儒列传》狱吏田甲辱安国。安国曰‘死灰独不复燃乎？’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·韓長儒列傳》獄吏田甲辱安國。安國曰‘死灰獨不復燃乎？’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'Prison officer Tian Jia insulted An Guo. An Guo said, 'Can dead ashes not burn again?''
example: 儒家的理论，非等到董仲舒不能～的。★闻一多《什么是儒家》
exampleTraditional: 儒家的理論，非等到董仲舒不能～的。★聞一多《什麼是儒家》
exampleEn: Confucian theory could not revive until Dong Zhongshu. — from Wen Yiduo's 'What is Confucianism'

explanation: 堪能。痛苦或困苦到了极点，已经不能用言语来表达。
explanationTraditional: 堪能。痛苦或困苦到了極點，已經不能用言語來表達。
explanationEn: Pain or suffering so extreme that it cannot be expressed in words.
derivation: 宋·李昌龄《乐善录·刘贡父》晚年得恶疾，须眉堕落，鼻梁断坏，苦不可言。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李昌齡《樂善錄·劉貢父》晚年得惡疾，鬚眉墮落，鼻樑斷壞，苦不可言。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Li Changling's 'Records of Joyful Virtue': 'In his later years, he contracted a terrible disease, his beard and eyebrows fell off, his nose bridge collapsed, and his suffering was beyond words.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一分一秒也不放过。形容充分利用时间。
explanationTraditional: 一分一秒也不放過。形容充分利用時間。
explanationEn: To seize every minute and second; to make the best use of time.
derivation: 《晋书·陶侃传》常语人曰‘大禹圣者，乃惜寸阴，至于众人，当惜分阴。’”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·陶侃傳》常語人曰‘大禹聖者，乃惜寸陰，至於眾人，當惜分陰。’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin': 'He often told people, 'The sage Yu cherished every inch of time; ordinary people should cherish every minute.''
example: 我们在学习上要～。
exampleTraditional: 我們在學習上要～。
exampleEn: We must seize every minute in our studies.

explanation: 集集中；思思考，意见；广扩大。指集中群众的智慧，广泛吸收有益的意见。
explanationTraditional: 集集中；思思考，意見；廣擴大。指集中群眾的智慧，廣泛吸收有益的意見。
explanationEn: To pool the wisdom of the masses and absorb useful opinions widely.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《教与军师长史参军掾属》夫参署者，集众思，广忠益也。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《教與軍師長史參軍掾屬》夫參署者，集眾思，廣忠益也。”
derivationEn: From Zhuge Liang's 'Instruction to Officers': 'In participating in official duties, one should gather the thoughts of many and broaden beneficial advice.'
example: 便凡闻有奇奢异能之士，都想请来，也是～的意思。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第三回
exampleTraditional: 便凡聞有奇奢異能之士，都想請來，也是～的意思。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第三回
exampleEn: Whenever he heard of someone with extraordinary talent, he would invite them, which was also a way to pool wisdom and benefit. — from Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 3

explanation: 态度粗暴，不讲道理。
explanationTraditional: 態度粗暴，不講道理。
explanationEn: To be rude and unreasonable; to refuse to listen to reason.
derivation: 毛泽东《关于正确处理人民内部矛盾的问题》在我们社会里，也有少数不顾公共利益，蛮不讲理，行凶犯法的人。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《關於正確處理人民內部矛盾的問題》在我們社會里，也有少數不顧公共利益，蠻不講理，行兇犯法的人。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'On the Correct Handling of Contradictions Among the People': 'In our society, there are also a few people who disregard public interest, are unreasonable, and commit crimes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 更生再次获得生命，比喻振兴起来。指不依赖外力，靠自己的力量重新振作起来，把事情办好。
explanationTraditional: 更生再次獲得生命，比喻振興起來。指不依賴外力，靠自己的力量重新振作起來，把事情辦好。
explanationEn: To rely on one's own efforts to revive or accomplish something; self-reliance.
derivation: 闻一多《组织民众与保卫大西南》我们人民能以自力更生的方式强起来了。”
derivationTraditional: 聞一多《組織民眾與保衛大西南》我們人民能以自力更生的方式強起來了。”
derivationEn: From Wen Yiduo's 'Organizing the People and Defending the Southwest': 'Our people can become strong through self-reliance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 的箭靶子；矢箭。放箭要对准靶子。比喻说话做事有针对性。
explanationTraditional: 的箭靶子；矢箭。放箭要對準靶子。比喻說話做事有針對性。
explanationEn: To shoot the arrow at the target; to speak or act with a specific purpose.
derivation: 毛泽东《整顿党的作风》马克思列宁主义理论和中国革命实际，怎样互相联系呢？拿一句通俗的话来讲，就是有的放矢”。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《整頓黨的作風》馬克思列寧主義理論和中國革命實際，怎樣互相聯繫呢？拿一句通俗的話來講，就是有的放矢”。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Rectify the Party's Style of Work': 'How are Marxist-Leninist theory and Chinese revolutionary practice connected? In popular terms, it is 'shooting the arrow at the target'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指做好充分战斗准备，等待着敌人。
explanationTraditional: 指做好充分戰鬥準備，等待著敵人。
explanationEn: To be fully prepared for battle, waiting for the enemy.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·汉纪·光武帝建武三年》甲辰，帝亲勒六军，严阵以待之。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·漢紀·光武帝建武三年》甲辰，帝親勒六軍，嚴陣以待之。”
derivationEn: From 'Comprehensive Mirror to Aid in Government': 'On the day of Jia Chen, the emperor personally led six armies, standing in strict formation awaiting the enemy.'
example: 鲍叔牙闻鲁侯引兵而来，乃～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 鮑叔牙聞魯侯引兵而來，乃～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十六回
exampleEn: Bao Shuya heard that the Duke of Lu was leading troops, so he stood in strict formation awaiting him. — from Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 16

explanation: 建建立；功功勋；业事业。建立功勋，成就大业。
explanationTraditional: 建建立；功功勳；業事業。建立功勳，成就大業。
explanationEn: To establish merit and achieve great deeds; to make contributions and accomplish a great cause.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《上两制书》古之圣贤建功立业，兴利捍患，至于百工小事之事皆有可观。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《上兩制書》古之聖賢建功立業，興利捍患，至於百工小事之事皆有可觀。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Letter to the Two Ministers': 'The ancient sages and worthies established merit and achieved great deeds, promoting benefits and preventing harm, even in trivial matters.'
example: ……凭着这资格可以～，也可以升官发财。★朱自清《经典常谈〈四书〉第七》
exampleTraditional: ……憑著這資格可以～，也可以升官發財。★朱自清《經典常談〈四書〉第七》
exampleEn: ...With this qualification, one could establish merit and achieve great deeds, or gain promotion and wealth. — from Zhu Ziqing's 'Classic Introductions: The Four Books', Part 7

explanation: 人群如山似海。形容人聚集得非常多。
explanationTraditional: 人群如山似海。形容人聚集得非常多。
explanationEn: A huge crowd of people; a sea of people.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第五十一回每日有那一般打散，或是戏舞，或是吹弹，或是歌唱，赚得那人山人海价看。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第五十一回每日有那一般打散，或是戲舞，或是吹彈，或是歌唱，賺得那人山人海價看。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 51: 'Every day there were performances, either plays, music, or singing, attracting a sea of people to watch.'
example: 节日的公园～，热闹极了。
exampleTraditional: 節日的公園～，熱鬧極了。
exampleEn: The park on holidays is packed with people, extremely lively.

explanation: 溃溃败，散乱。被打得七零八落，不成队伍。形容惨败。
explanationTraditional: 潰潰敗，散亂。被打得七零八落，不成隊伍。形容慘敗。
explanationEn: Utterly defeated; routed; scattered like a defeated army.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第八章等待着敌人的锐气开始衰落时，抓住要害猛力一击，就可以把敌人杀得溃不成军。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第八章等待著敵人的銳氣開始衰落時，抓住要害猛力一擊，就可以把敵人殺得潰不成軍。”
derivationEn: From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng' Volume 1 Chapter 8: 'Waiting for the enemy's momentum to decline, then striking at the vital point, they could rout the enemy completely.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 国家经济和人民生活。
explanationTraditional: 國家經濟和人民生活。
explanationEn: National economy and people's livelihood.
derivation: 《荀子·富国》如是则上下俱富，交无所藏之，是国计之极也。”《左传·宣公十二年》民生在勤，勤则不匮。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·富國》如是則上下俱富，交無所藏之，是國計之極也。”《左傳·宣公十二年》民生在勤，勤則不匱。”
derivationEn: From 'Xunzi·Enriching the State': 'Thus both upper and lower classes are wealthy, and there is no place to store it; this is the ultimate in national planning.' And 'Zuo Zhuan·Duke Xuan Year 12': 'People's livelihood depends on diligence; diligence leads to no scarcity.'
example: 这几年她已深切了解，做官的人，对～，或者不甚措意，但于权贵的荣辱得失，十分敏感。★高阳《玉座珠帘》上册
exampleTraditional: 這幾年她已深切瞭解，做官的人，對～，或者不甚措意，但於權貴的榮辱得失，十分敏感。★高陽《玉座珠簾》上冊
exampleEn: In recent years, she has deeply understood that officials may not pay much attention to national economy and people's livelihood, but are very sensitive to the gains and losses of the powerful. ★ Gao Yang 'Jade Pearl Curtain' Volume 1

explanation: 年事年纪。指一个人的岁数已经很大了。
explanationTraditional: 年事年紀。指一個人的歲數已經很大了。
explanationEn: Advanced in years; old in age.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛称美好山河。
explanationTraditional: 泛稱美好山河。
explanationEn: Beautiful mountains and rivers; picturesque scenery.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》问‘牛头未见四祖时如何？’师曰‘青山绿水。’曰‘见后如何？’师曰‘绿水青山。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》問‘牛頭未見四祖時如何？’師曰‘青山綠水。’曰‘見後如何？’師曰‘綠水青山。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Question: 'How was it before Niutou met the Fourth Patriarch?' Master: 'Green mountains and clear waters.' 'After meeting?' Master: 'Clear waters and green mountains.''
example: 九重天，二十年，龙楼凤阁都曾见，～任自然。★元·马致远《拨不断》
exampleTraditional: 九重天，二十年，龍樓鳳閣都曾見，～任自然。★元·馬致遠《撥不斷》
exampleEn: In the ninefold heaven, twenty years, I have seen dragon towers and phoenix pavilions, and freely enjoyed green waters and green mountains. ★ Yuan Dynasty Ma Zhiyuan 'Bo Bu Duan'

explanation: 半壁半边；江山比喻国家疆土。指在敌人入侵后残存或丧失的部分国土。
explanationTraditional: 半壁半邊；江山比喻國家疆土。指在敵人入侵後殘存或喪失的部分國土。
explanationEn: Half of the country (often referring to the remaining or lost territory after enemy invasion).
derivation: 清·蒋士诠《冬青树·提纲》半壁江山，比五季朝廷尤小。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蔣士詮《冬青樹·提綱》半壁江山，比五季朝廷尤小。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Jiang Shiquan's 'Winter Green Tree·Outline': 'Half of the country is even smaller than the Five Dynasties.'
example: 军声壮，阵法多，～全仗我。★清·吴梅《风洞山·阅兵》
exampleTraditional: 軍聲壯，陣法多，～全仗我。★清·吳梅《風洞山·閱兵》
exampleEn: The army's morale is high, the battle formations are many, and half of the country relies entirely on us. ★ Qing Dynasty Wu Mei 'Wind Cave Mountain·Reviewing Troops'

explanation: 求寻求；存保留；异不同的。找出共同点，保留不同意见。
explanationTraditional: 求尋求；存保留；異不同的。找出共同點，保留不同意見。
explanationEn: Seek common ground while reserving differences.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 在这个问题上，我们还是求同存异吧。
exampleTraditional: 在這個問題上，我們還是求同存異吧。
exampleEn: On this issue, we should seek common ground while reserving differences.

explanation: 从挂下来的蜘蛛丝可以找到蜘蛛的所在，从马蹄的印子可以查出马的去向。比喻事情所留下的隐约可寻的痕纪线索。
explanationTraditional: 從掛下來的蜘蛛絲可以找到蜘蛛的所在，從馬蹄的印子可以查出馬的去向。比喻事情所留下的隱約可尋的痕紀線索。
explanationEn: Clues; traces; subtle signs that lead to the truth.
derivation: 清·王家贲《别雅序》大开通同转假之门，泛滥浩博，几凝天下无字不可通用，而实则蛛丝马迹，原原本本，具在古书。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王家賁《別雅序》大開通同轉假之門，氾濫浩博，幾凝天下無字不可通用，而實則蛛絲馬跡，原原本本，具在古書。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wang Jiagui's 'Preface to Bie Ya': 'Opening the door to extensive phonetic loan characters, vast and abundant, almost making it seem that no word in the world cannot be used interchangeably, but in fact, the clues and traces are all originally found in ancient books.'
example: 机敏的公安人员根据现场的～，很快找到了作案人的线索。
exampleTraditional: 機敏的公安人員根據現場的～，很快找到了作案人的線索。
exampleEn: The sharp police officers quickly found the culprit's clues based on the subtle traces at the scene.

explanation: 比喻坏人和好人混在一起。
explanationTraditional: 比喻壞人和好人混在一起。
explanationEn: A mix of good and bad people; a motley crowd.
derivation: 唐·张志和《和渔夫词》十三风搅长空浪搅风，鱼龙混杂一川中。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·張志和《和漁夫詞》十三風攪長空浪攪風，魚龍混雜一川中。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Zhang Zhihe's 'Song of the Fisherman': 'Thirteen winds stir the sky, waves churn the wind; fish and dragons mix in the river.'
example: 现在人多手乱，鱼龙混杂，倒是这么着，他们也洗洗清。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十四回
exampleTraditional: 現在人多手亂，魚龍混雜，倒是這麼著，他們也洗洗清。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十四回
exampleEn: Now there are many people and chaos, with a mix of good and bad; it's better this way, they can also wash themselves clean. ★ Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 94

explanation: 指难辨兔的雌雄。形容事情错综复杂，难以辨别清楚。
explanationTraditional: 指難辨兔的雌雄。形容事情錯綜複雜，難以辨別清楚。
explanationEn: Confusing; complicated and difficult to discern clearly.
derivation: 《乐府诗集·横吹曲辞五·木兰诗》雄兔脚扑朔，雌兔眼迷离，双兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌。”
derivationTraditional: 《樂府詩集·橫吹曲辭五·木蘭詩》雄兔腳撲朔，雌兔眼迷離，雙兔傍地走，安能辨我是雄雌。”
derivationEn: From 'Yuefu Poetry Collection·Hengchui Songs·Mulan Poem': 'The male rabbit's feet are restless, the female rabbit's eyes are blurred; when they run side by side, how can you tell which is male and which is female?'
example: 敌军却始终～，不知我军主力所在。★杨至城《巧使敌人就范》
exampleTraditional: 敵軍卻始終～，不知我軍主力所在。★楊至城《巧使敵人就範》
exampleEn: The enemy army remained confused and unable to discern our main force's location. ★ Yang Zhicheng 'Skillfully Making the Enemy Fall into a Trap'

explanation: 熙熙和乐的样子；攘攘纷乱的样子。形容人来人往，非常热闹拥挤。
explanationTraditional: 熙熙和樂的樣子；攘攘紛亂的樣子。形容人來人往，非常熱鬧擁擠。
explanationEn: Describes a bustling scene with people coming and going, very lively and crowded.
derivation: 《史记·货殖列传》天下熙熙，皆为利来；天下攘攘，皆为利往。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·貨殖列傳》天下熙熙，皆為利來；天下攘攘，皆為利往。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of the Merchants': 'The world bustles, all for profit; the world hustles, all for gain.'
example: 共青团员都打扮成去远足的样子，每人提了个提包，有的是挂包，～的会集在厂里的球场上。★茹志娟《新当选的团支书》
exampleTraditional: 共青團員都打扮成去遠足的樣子，每人提了個提包，有的是掛包，～的會集在廠裡的球場上。★茹志娟《新當選的團支書》
exampleEn: The Communist Youth League members, all dressed as if going on an outing, each carrying a bag or a satchel, gathered bustlingly on the factory's playground. — Ru Zhijuan, 'The Newly Elected League Branch Secretary'

explanation: 技技能，本领；长擅长、长处。指有某种技能或特长。
explanationTraditional: 技技能，本領；長擅長、長處。指有某種技能或特長。
explanationEn: Refers to having a particular skill or expertise.
derivation: 清·郑燮《郑板桥集·家书·淮安舟中寄舍弟墨》愚兄平生漫骂无礼，然人有一才一技之长，一行一言之美，未尝不啧啧称道。”
derivationTraditional: 清·鄭燮《鄭板橋集·家書·淮安舟中寄舍弟墨》愚兄平生漫罵無禮，然人有一才一技之長，一行一言之美，未嘗不嘖嘖稱道。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zheng Xie's 'Zheng Banqiao Collection: Family Letters': 'I have always been rude and disrespectful, but if someone has a skill or a talent, I never fail to praise them.'
example: 风琴棋书画，医卜星相，如有～者，前来进谒，莫不优礼以待。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十四回
exampleTraditional: 風琴棋書畫，醫卜星相，如有～者，前來進謁，莫不優禮以待。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十四回
exampleEn: Those skilled in chess, calligraphy, painting, music, divination, or astrology, if they have a skill, they come to visit and are treated with utmost courtesy. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 64

explanation: 指靠临长江中下游两岸的广大地区。
explanationTraditional: 指靠臨長江中下游兩岸的廣大地區。
explanationEn: Refers to the vast area along the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River.
derivation: 清·恽敬《上曹俪笙侍郎书》而大江南北，以文名天下者，几于昌（猖）狂无理，排溺一世之人，其势力至今未已。”
derivationTraditional: 清·惲敬《上曹儷笙侍郎書》而大江南北，以文名天下者，幾於昌（猖）狂無理，排溺一世之人，其勢力至今未已。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Yun Jing's 'Letter to Shang Li Sheng': 'In the vast area north and south of the Yangtze, those who are famous for their writing are almost all arrogant and unreasonable, overwhelming the people of their time, and their influence has not ceased to this day.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容数目很少，扳着手指头就能数过来。
explanationTraditional: 形容數目很少，扳著手指頭就能數過來。
explanationEn: Describes a very small number that can be counted on one's fingers.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《忆昨行和张十一》诗自期殒命在春序，屈指数日怜婴孩。”宋·欧阳修《集古录跋尾·唐安公美政颂》今文儒之盛，其屈指可数者，无三四人。非皆不能，盖忽不为尔。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《憶昨行和張十一》詩自期殞命在春序，屈指數日憐嬰孩。”宋·歐陽修《集古錄跋尾·唐安公美政頌》今文儒之盛，其屈指可數者，無三四人。非皆不能，蓋忽不為爾。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's poem 'Recalling Yesterday with Zhang Shiyi': 'I expected to die in spring, counting days on my fingers, pitying the infant.' Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'Collected Records of Ancient Inscriptions': 'The prosperity of literary scholars today can be counted on one's fingers, no more than three or four.'
example: 中国民族工业就只剩下～的几项了！★茅盾《子夜》二
exampleTraditional: 中國民族工業就只剩下～的幾項了！★茅盾《子夜》二
exampleEn: Only a handful of China's national industries remain! — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 2

explanation: 各种光亮、色彩等互相映照。
explanationTraditional: 各種光亮、色彩等互相映照。
explanationEn: Various lights, colors, etc., illuminate each other.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 满城的彩灯与腾空的焰火～。
exampleTraditional: 滿城的彩燈與騰空的焰火～。
exampleEn: The city's colorful lanterns and soaring fireworks illuminate each other.

explanation: 公公开；之代指事物的内容；于向；众大众。把事情真相向大家公布。
explanationTraditional: 公公開；之代指事物的內容；於向；眾大眾。把事情真相向大家公佈。
explanationEn: To make something known to the public; to disclose the truth to everyone.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容说话罗嗦，唠叨。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話羅嗦，嘮叨。
explanationEn: Describes talking in a verbose and nagging manner.
derivation: 明·汤显祖《紫箫记·胜游》自成了人后，夜里和李郎絮叨叨到四五更鼓，番来覆去，那里睡来？”
derivationTraditional: 明·湯顯祖《紫簫記·勝遊》自成了人後，夜裡和李郎絮叨叨到四五更鼓，番來覆去，那裡睡來？”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Tang Xianzu's 'Purple Flute: Victorious Journey': 'Since becoming a man, I have chattered with Li Lang until the fourth or fifth watch, tossing and turning, unable to sleep.'
example: 那呆子～，只管念诵着陪礼，爬起来与沙僧又进。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 那呆子～，只管唸誦著陪禮，爬起來與沙僧又進。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第四十九回
exampleEn: The idiot kept chattering and apologizing as he got up and entered with Sha Seng. — Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 49

explanation: 拍乐曲的段落，也称打拍子。一打拍子就合于乐曲的节奏。比喻困情意相投或有利害关系，一下子就说到一起或结合在一起。
explanationTraditional: 拍樂曲的段落，也稱打拍子。一打拍子就合於樂曲的節奏。比喻困情意相投或有利害關係，一下子就說到一起或結合在一起。
explanationEn: Metaphor for people who share similar interests or have mutual benefits quickly coming to an agreement or joining together.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第十八回古人云‘君子之交，定而后求；小人之交，一拍即合。’”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第十八回古人云‘君子之交，定而後求；小人之交，一拍即合。’”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Lüyuan's 'Lamp at the Crossroads', Chapter 18: 'The ancients said, 'The friendship of gentlemen is made after careful consideration; the friendship of petty people is made at the snap of a finger.'
example: 既然我们～，所见略同，我也不瞒你。★陈登科《赤龙与丹凤》第一部十八
exampleTraditional: 既然我們～，所見略同，我也不瞞你。★陳登科《赤龍與丹鳳》第一部十八
exampleEn: Since we hit it off and share the same views, I won't hide it from you. — Chen Dengke, 'Red Dragon and Phoenix', Part 1, Chapter 18

explanation: 苟苟且，马虎。指做事认真细致，一点儿不马虎。
explanationTraditional: 苟苟且，馬虎。指做事認真細緻，一點兒不馬虎。
explanationEn: Describes being meticulous and not careless in doing things.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四回上司访知，见世叔一丝不苟，升迁就在指日。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四回上司訪知，見世叔一絲不苟，升遷就在指日。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 4: 'The superior officer investigated and found that you, uncle, are meticulous in everything, and your promotion is imminent.'
example: 我们在学习上，应有～的精神。
exampleTraditional: 我們在學習上，應有～的精神。
exampleEn: In our studies, we should have a meticulous spirit.

explanation: 互相依靠着过日子。泛指互相依靠，谁也离不开谁。
explanationTraditional: 互相依靠著過日子。泛指互相依靠，誰也離不開誰。
explanationEn: To depend on each other for survival; to rely on each other, unable to live without one another.
derivation: 晋·李密《陈情表》臣无祖母，无以至今日；祖母无臣，无以终余年。母孙二人，更相依为命。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·李密《陳情表》臣無祖母，無以至今日；祖母無臣，無以終餘年。母孫二人，更相依為命。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Li Mi's 'Chen Qing Biao': 'Without my grandmother, I would not have reached today; without me, my grandmother cannot end her remaining years. Grandmother and grandson depend on each other for life.'
example: 死而复生的只有这些杂乱的败草。永逝不返的却是我们～的慈母。★郭沫若《棠棣之花》
exampleTraditional: 死而復生的只有這些雜亂的敗草。永逝不返的卻是我們～的慈母。★郭沫若《棠棣之花》
exampleEn: Only these scattered weeds have come back to life. But our beloved mother, who depended on us as we depended on her, has departed forever. — Guo Moruo, 'The Cherry Blossom'

explanation: 微细，小；足值得；道谈起。微小得很，不值得一提。指意义、价值等小得不值得一提。
explanationTraditional: 微細，小；足值得；道談起。微小得很，不值得一提。指意義、價值等小得不值得一提。
explanationEn: So small or insignificant that it is not worth mentioning.
derivation: 郭沫若《百花齐放·单色蓳》诗在草花中我们虽然是微不足道。但我们的花色却算是紫色代表。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《百花齊放·單色蓳》詩在草花中我們雖然是微不足道。但我們的花色卻算是紫色代表。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's poem 'Hundred Flowers Bloom: Single Color Violet': 'Among the grass flowers, we are insignificant, but our color is considered the representative of purple.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 作为做出成绩。能够极大地发挥作用，作一番贡献。
explanationTraditional: 作為做出成績。能夠極大地發揮作用，作一番貢獻。
explanationEn: To be able to play a significant role and make great contributions.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑下》故将大有为之君，必有所不召之臣，欲有谋焉则就之。”朱熹集注大有为之君，大有作为，非常之君也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑下》故將大有為之君，必有所不召之臣，欲有謀焉則就之。”朱熹集註大有為之君，大有作為，非常之君也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gongsun Chou II': 'Therefore, a ruler who is to achieve great things must have ministers he does not summon, and if he wants to consult them, he goes to them.' Zhu Xi's commentary: 'A ruler who achieves great things is a ruler of great accomplishments, an extraordinary ruler.'
example: 民国元年革命后，先生的所志已达，该可以～了，然而还是不得志。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文末编·关于于太炎先生二三事》
exampleTraditional: 民國元年革命後，先生的所志已達，該可以～了，然而還是不得志。★魯迅《且介亭雜文末編·關於於太炎先生二三事》
exampleEn: After the revolution in the first year of the Republic, Mr. Zhang's aspirations were fulfilled, and he should have been able to achieve great things, but he still did not realize his ambitions. — Lu Xun, 'Essays from the End of Qiejieting: A Few Matters about Mr. Yu Taiyan'

explanation: 莠狗尾草，很象谷子，常混在禾苗中∶人坏人都有，混杂在一起。
explanationTraditional: 莠狗尾草，很象穀子，常混在禾苗中∶人壞人都有，混雜在一起。
explanationEn: A mixture of good and bad people, with the good and bad intermingled.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十六回且说彼时捐例大开，各省侯补人员十分拥挤，其中鱼龙混杂，良莠不齐。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十六回且說彼時捐例大開，各省侯補人員十分擁擠，其中魚龍混雜，良莠不齊。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure' Chapter 56: 'At that time, the donation system was wide open, and the number of candidates waiting for appointments in various provinces was extremely crowded, with a mix of fish and dragons, good and bad.'
example: 兼之人品～，诚恐因逸生事。★太平天国·洪秀全《整顿属员诏》
exampleTraditional: 兼之人品～，誠恐因逸生事。★太平天國·洪秀全《整頓屬員詔》
exampleEn: Moreover, the quality of people is mixed, and I fear that idleness may lead to trouble. — Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, Hong Xiuquan's 'Edict on Rectifying Subordinates'

explanation: 瞩注视。使人注视。
explanationTraditional: 矚注視。使人注視。
explanationEn: To attract people's attention; to be noticeable.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这项工程之大令人瞩目。
exampleTraditional: 這項工程之大令人矚目。
exampleEn: The scale of this project is remarkable.

explanation: 原意是说，劈竹子时，头上几节一破开，下面的顺着刀口自己就裂开了。比喻处理事情、解决问题很顺利。
explanationTraditional: 原意是說，劈竹子時，頭上幾節一破開，下面的順著刀口自己就裂開了。比喻處理事情、解決問題很順利。
explanationEn: Originally meaning that when splitting bamboo, once the first few joints are broken, the rest splits open easily along the blade. Metaphorically, it means to handle problems or resolve issues smoothly.
derivation: 《晋书·杜预传》今兵威已振，譬如破竹，数节之后，皆迎刃而解。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·杜預傳》今兵威已振，譬如破竹，數節之後，皆迎刃而解。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Du Yu': 'Now our military might is already strong, like splitting bamboo: after a few joints, the rest splits open as soon as it meets the blade.'
example: 只要这位教士到场，任你事情如何棘手，亦无不～的。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十四回
exampleTraditional: 只要這位教士到場，任你事情如何棘手，亦無不～的。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十四回
exampleEn: As long as this priest arrives, no matter how difficult the matter, it will be resolved smoothly. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure' Chapter 54

explanation: 降下落。比喻出于意外，突然出现。
explanationTraditional: 降下落。比喻出於意外，突然出現。
explanationEn: To fall from the sky; to appear unexpectedly or suddenly.
derivation: 《汉书·周亚夫传》直入武库，击鸣鼓。诸侯闻之，以为将军从天而下也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·周亞夫傳》直入武庫，擊鳴鼓。諸侯聞之，以為將軍從天而下也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Zhou Yafu': 'He directly entered the armory and beat the war drums. The feudal lords heard this and thought the general had descended from heaven.'
example: 哥哥，你真是～也！万乞救我一救。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 哥哥，你真是～也！萬乞救我一救。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三十一回
exampleEn: Brother, you have truly descended from heaven! I beg you to save me. — Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West' Chapter 31

explanation: 时宜当时的需要和潮流。不适合时代形势的需要。也指不合世俗习尚。
explanationTraditional: 時宜當時的需要和潮流。不適合時代形勢的需要。也指不合世俗習尚。
explanationEn: Not in keeping with the needs or trends of the times; out of step with current customs or conventions.
derivation: 《汉书·袁帝纪》皆违经背古，不合时宜。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·袁帝紀》皆違經背古，不合時宜。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Annals of Emperor Ai': 'All these violate the classics and ancient principles, and are not in keeping with the times.'
example: 闻得他因～，权势不容，竟投到这里来。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: 聞得他因～，權勢不容，竟投到這裡來。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十三回
exampleEn: I heard that because he was out of step with the times and could not gain favor with the powerful, he ended up here. — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 63

explanation: 佛教用语。指佛力广大，能现出种种人相，向人说法。现指以亲身经历和体验为例来说明某种道理。
explanationTraditional: 佛教用語。指佛力廣大，能現出種種人相，向人說法。現指以親身經歷和體驗為例來說明某種道理。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist term meaning that the Buddha can manifest in various forms to preach to people. Now it means to use one's own personal experience as an example to illustrate a point.
derivation: 《愣严经》卷六我与彼前，皆现其身，而为说法，令其成就。”宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷一亦于十方界中现身说法。”
derivationTraditional: 《愣嚴經》卷六我與彼前，皆現其身，而為說法，令其成就。”宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷一亦於十方界中現身說法。”
derivationEn: From 'Shurangama Sutra' Volume 6: 'Before them, I manifest in various forms and preach the Dharma to them, enabling them to achieve enlightenment.' Song Dynasty Shi Daoyuan's 'Transmission of the Lamp' Volume 1: 'Also, in the ten directions, he manifests in various forms and preaches the Dharma.'
example: 袁伯珍这一席话，可谓～。（清·无名氏《官场维新记》第十六回）
exampleTraditional: 袁伯珍這一席話，可謂～。（清·無名氏《官場維新記》第十六回）
exampleEn: Yuan Bozhen's speech can be described as using his own experience to illustrate the point. — Qing Dynasty Anonymous, 'The Reform of Officialdom' Chapter 16

explanation: 陈陈旧的；代替换；谢凋谢，衰亡。指生物体不断用新物质代替旧物质的过程。也指新事物不断产生发展，代替旧的事物。
explanationTraditional: 陳陳舊的；代替換；謝凋謝，衰亡。指生物體不斷用新物質代替舊物質的過程。也指新事物不斷產生髮展，代替舊的事物。
explanationEn: Originally refers to the biological process of replacing old substances with new ones. Also refers to the continuous emergence and development of new things replacing old ones.
derivation: 毛泽东《矛盾论》世界上总是这样以新的代替旧的，总是这样新陈代谢、除旧布新或推陈出新的。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《矛盾論》世界上總是這樣以新的代替舊的，總是這樣新陳代謝、除舊佈新或推陳出新的。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'On Contradiction': 'In the world, new things always replace old ones, always undergoing metabolism, replacing the old with the new, or pushing out the old to make way for the new.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 声势声威和气势；浩广大。声威和气势非常壮大。
explanationTraditional: 聲勢聲威和氣勢；浩廣大。聲威和氣勢非常壯大。
explanationEn: Great in reputation and momentum; imposing and powerful.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第十六回其实他们空着没有一点事，也不见得怎么为患地方，不过声势浩大罢了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第十六回其實他們空著沒有一點事，也不見得怎麼為患地方，不過聲勢浩大罷了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' Chapter 16: 'In fact, they were idle and did nothing, nor did they cause much trouble to the local people, but their reputation and momentum were great.'
example: ～的游行队伍，迈着整齐的步伐向主席台走来。
exampleTraditional: ～的遊行隊伍，邁著整齊的步伐向主席臺走來。
exampleEn: The imposing parade marched towards the rostrum with neat steps.

explanation: 原指地位高，现在形容领导者脱离实际，脱离群众。
explanationTraditional: 原指地位高，現在形容領導者脫離實際，脫離群眾。
explanationEn: Originally meant high status, now describes leaders who are out of touch with reality and the masses.
derivation: 《诗经·周颂·敬之》无曰高高在上，陟降厥士，日监在兹。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周頌·敬之》無曰高高在上，陟降厥士，日監在茲。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs, Zhou Song, Jing Zhi: 'Do not say you are high above, descending and ascending, daily watching here.'
example: 有着理智的青年朋友们眼看部长～，三青团”爪牙虎视眈眈，也只有沉默装傻而已。★邹韬奋《患难余生记》第二章
exampleTraditional: 有著理智的青年朋友們眼看部長～，三青團”爪牙虎視眈眈，也只有沉默裝傻而已。★鄒韜奮《患難餘生記》第二章
exampleEn: Young intellectuals with reason, seeing the minister high above and the 'Three Youth League' claws glaring, could only remain silent and play dumb. ★ Zou Taofen, Chapter 2 of 'Memories of Hardship'

explanation: 符合情理。
explanationTraditional: 符合情理。
explanationEn: Conforms to reason and emotion.
derivation: 陈残云《山谷风烟》第11章黄为民心情显得轻松，觉得周祺这个人很可爱，既有原则，又能合情合理地帮助他解除思想包袱。”
derivationTraditional: 陳殘雲《山谷風煙》第11章黃為民心情顯得輕鬆，覺得周祺這個人很可愛，既有原則，又能合情合理地幫助他解除思想包袱。”
derivationEn: From Chen Canyun's 'Wind and Smoke in the Valley', Chapter 11: 'Huang Weimin felt relaxed, finding Zhou Qi very likable, both principled and able to help him resolve his mental burden reasonably.'
example: 学校认为这个方案～，就定为制度。★柯岩《特邀代表》
exampleTraditional: 學校認為這個方案～，就定為制度。★柯巖《特邀代表》
exampleEn: The school found this plan reasonable and established it as a rule. ★ Ke Yan, 'Special Representative'

explanation: 量估量；行行事。按照自己力量的大小去做，不要勉强。
explanationTraditional: 量估量；行行事。按照自己力量的大小去做，不要勉強。
explanationEn: Act according to one's ability; do not overexert.
derivation: 《左传·昭公十五年》力能则进，否则退，量力而行。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公十五年》力能則進，否則退，量力而行。”
derivationEn: From Zuo Zhuan, Duke Zhao's 15th Year: 'Advance if strength allows, retreat if not; act according to one's ability.'
example: 各位同学呢，大家～，能捐多少就捐多少。★叶圣陶《英文教授》
exampleTraditional: 各位同學呢，大家～，能捐多少就捐多少。★葉聖陶《英文教授》
exampleEn: Dear students, please act according to your ability, donate as much as you can. ★ Ye Shengtao, 'English Professor'

explanation: 指不符合实际。
explanationTraditional: 指不符合實際。
explanationEn: Not conforming to reality; unrealistic.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 在确定销售计划之前，应先进行市场调查，以免做出～的预测。
exampleTraditional: 在確定銷售計劃之前，應先進行市場調查，以免做出～的預測。
exampleEn: Before setting a sales plan, market research should be conducted to avoid making unrealistic predictions.

explanation: 针锋针尖。针尖对针尖。比喻双方在策略、论点及行动方式等方面尖锐对立。
explanationTraditional: 針鋒針尖。針尖對針尖。比喻雙方在策略、論點及行動方式等方面尖銳對立。
explanationEn: Tip to tip; metaphor for sharp opposition in strategies, arguments, or actions.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷二夫一切回答，如针锋相投，无纤毫参差。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷二夫一切回答，如針鋒相投，無纖毫參差。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Daoyuan's 'Jingde Chuandeng Lu', Volume 2: 'All answers are like needle tips meeting, without the slightest discrepancy.'
example: 彩云听着唐卿的话来得厉害，句句和自己的话～，思忖只有答应了再说。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十六回
exampleTraditional: 彩雲聽著唐卿的話來得厲害，句句和自己的話～，思忖只有答應了再說。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十六回
exampleEn: Caiyun heard Tangqing's words coming fiercely, each sentence opposing hers tip to tip, and thought only to agree and then talk later. ★ Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower of Sin', Chapter 26

explanation: 贷推卸。自己应尽的责任，不能推卸给旁人。
explanationTraditional: 貸推卸。自己應盡的責任，不能推卸給旁人。
explanationEn: One's own responsibility that cannot be shifted to others.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 农民向国家交售征购粮是责无旁贷的任务。
exampleTraditional: 農民向國家交售徵購糧是責無旁貸的任務。
exampleEn: It is the farmers' unshirkable duty to deliver grain to the state.

explanation: 瞻视，望；瞩注视。站得高，看得远。比喻眼光远大。
explanationTraditional: 瞻視，望；矚注視。站得高，看得遠。比喻眼光遠大。
explanationEn: Stand high and see far; metaphor for far-sightedness.
derivation: 汉·王充《论衡·别通篇》夫闭户塞意，不高瞻览者，死人之徒也哉。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王充《論衡·別通篇》夫閉戶塞意，不高瞻覽者，死人之徒也哉。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Wang Chong's 'Lunheng': 'Those who shut doors and block thoughts, not looking high, are like dead men.'
example: 他们的切身的问题，也使他们无暇去～的去关心与分析世界问题。★老舍《四世同堂》七十三
exampleTraditional: 他們的切身的問題，也使他們無暇去～的去關心與分析世界問題。★老舍《四世同堂》七十三
exampleEn: Their personal issues left them no time to look high and far to analyze world problems. ★ Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof', Chapter 73

explanation: 形容为数极多。
explanationTraditional: 形容為數極多。
explanationEn: Countless; an extremely large number.
derivation: 唐·杜牧《晚晴赋》千千万万之状容兮，不可得而状也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜牧《晚晴賦》千千萬萬之狀容兮，不可得而狀也。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Mu's 'Ode to Evening Rain': 'Countless forms and shapes, impossible to describe.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 明目睁亮眼睛；张胆放开胆量。原指有胆识，敢做敢为◇形容公开放肆地干坏事。
explanationTraditional: 明目睜亮眼睛；張膽放開膽量。原指有膽識，敢做敢為◇形容公開放肆地幹壞事。
explanationEn: Originally meant bold and daring; now describes openly and brazenly doing evil.
derivation: 《晋书·王敦传》今日之事，明目张胆，为六军之首，宁忠臣而死，不无赖而生矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王敦傳》今日之事，明目張膽，為六軍之首，寧忠臣而死，不無賴而生矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin', Biography of Wang Dun: 'Today's matter, with clear eyes and bold courage, as the head of the six armies, would rather die as a loyal minister than live as a scoundrel.'
example: 近日京师奔竞之风，是～，冠冕堂皇做的。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第三一百三回
exampleTraditional: 近日京師奔競之風，是～，冠冕堂皇做的。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第三一百三回
exampleEn: Recently, the trend of seeking office in the capital is done openly and brazenly, with great fanfare. ★ Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 103

explanation: 连锁像锁链似的一环扣一环。比喻相关的事物发生相应的变化。
explanationTraditional: 連鎖像鎖鏈似的一環扣一環。比喻相關的事物發生相應的變化。
explanationEn: Chain reaction; metaphor for related events causing corresponding changes.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们要注意此事的连锁反应。
exampleTraditional: 我們要注意此事的連鎖反應。
exampleEn: We must pay attention to the chain reaction of this matter.

explanation: 适正，恰好。恰恰得到与预期相反的结果。
explanationTraditional: 適正，恰好。恰恰得到與預期相反的結果。
explanationEn: To get exactly the opposite result from what was expected.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 学习知识，应踏踏实实，循序渐进，想一口吃个胖子，结果将会～。
exampleTraditional: 學習知識，應踏踏實實，循序漸進，想一口吃個胖子，結果將會～。
exampleEn: When learning knowledge, one should be down-to-earth and step by step. If you want to get fat in one bite, the result will be just the opposite.

explanation: 旧时神怪小说中描写有神通的人能用法术一晃身子就改变自己本来的模样。现用来形容人不讲道义原则，一下子来个大改变。
explanationTraditional: 舊時神怪小說中描寫有神通的人能用法術一晃身子就改變自己本來的模樣。現用來形容人不講道義原則，一下子來個大改變。
explanationEn: To change one's appearance or identity suddenly, often implying a change in principles or character.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第二回悟空捻着诀，念动咒语，摇身一变，就变做一稞（棵）松树。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二回悟空捻著訣，念動咒語，搖身一變，就變做一稞（棵）松樹。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 2: 'Sun Wukong, pinching his fingers and reciting a spell, shook himself and turned into a pine tree.'
example: 就这样铁路总公司的第七次的股东大会～变成了川汉铁路的保路同志会”。★郭沫若《反正前后》
exampleTraditional: 就這樣鐵路總公司的第七次的股東大會～變成了川漢鐵路的保路同志會”。★郭沫若《反正前後》
exampleEn: Thus, the seventh shareholders' meeting of the Railway General Company suddenly transformed into the 'Railway Protection League' of the Sichuan-Hankou Railway.

explanation: 跃跃急于要行动的样子；欲要。形容急切地想试试。
explanationTraditional: 躍躍急於要行動的樣子；欲要。形容急切地想試試。
explanationEn: Eager and impatient to try something out.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十五回一席话说得唐二乱子心痒难抓，跃跃欲试。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十五回一席話說得唐二亂子心癢難抓，躍躍欲試。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 35: 'These words made Tang Er Luanzi's heart itch and he was eager to try.'
example: 运动会即将举行，同学们个个磨拳擦掌，～。
exampleTraditional: 運動會即將舉行，同學們個個磨拳擦掌，～。
exampleEn: The sports meet is about to be held, and the students are all rubbing their hands and eager to try.

explanation: 会集中。原指君臣协力，集思广益◇形容精神高度集中。
explanationTraditional: 會集中。原指君臣協力，集思廣益◇形容精神高度集中。
explanationEn: To concentrate one's attention and energy completely.
derivation: 汉·王褒《圣主得贤臣颂》聚精会神，相得益（章）彰。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王褒《聖主得賢臣頌》聚精會神，相得益（章）彰。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Wang Bao's 'Praise of the Wise Monarch and Virtuous Minister': 'Concentrate spirit and focus mind, complement each other to shine.'
example: 看校样时的～，就和在写作的时候一样，因为我的目的要使它没有一个错字。★邹韬奋《经历·一个小小的过街楼》
exampleTraditional: 看校樣時的～，就和在寫作的時候一樣，因為我的目的要使它沒有一個錯字。★鄒韜奮《經歷·一個小小的過街樓》
exampleEn: The concentration when proofreading is the same as when writing, because my goal is to have not a single typo.

explanation: 用一杯水去救一车着了火的柴草。比喻力量太小，解决不了问题。
explanationTraditional: 用一杯水去救一車著了火的柴草。比喻力量太小，解決不了問題。
explanationEn: A cup of water to put out a cartload of burning firewood; a totally inadequate measure.
derivation: 《孟子·告子上》今之为人者，犹以一杯水救一车薪之火也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·告子上》今之為人者，猶以一杯水救一車薪之火也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gaozi I': 'Now those who cultivate virtue are like using a cup of water to save a cartload of burning firewood.'
example: 有新债未动毫分的，除了承许夏鼎三十两外，大有～之状。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第七十四回
exampleTraditional: 有新債未動毫分的，除了承許夏鼎三十兩外，大有～之狀。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第七十四回
exampleEn: Those who had not yet spent their new debts, except for promising Xia Ding thirty taels, were largely in a state of 'a cup of water for a cartload of firewood'.

explanation: 承承接；启开创。承接前面的，开创后来的。指继承前人事业，为后人开辟道路。
explanationTraditional: 承承接；啟開創。承接前面的，開創後來的。指繼承前人事業，為後人開闢道路。
explanationEn: To inherit the past and usher in the future; to carry forward the cause of predecessors and open up a path for successors.
derivation: 明·朱国祯《涌幢小品·曾有萩赠文》公承前草创，启后规模，此之功德，垂之永久。”
derivationTraditional: 明·朱國禎《湧幢小品·曾有萩贈文》公承前草創，啟後規模，此之功德，垂之永久。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Zhu Guozhen's 'Yongchuang Xiaopin': 'The Duke inherited the pioneering work of the past and initiated the scale for the future; this merit will last forever.'
example: 至于青年之急待攻击，实较老年为尤甚，因为他们是～的桥梁，国家的绝续，全在他们肩上的。★鲁迅《两地书》一一
exampleTraditional: 至於青年之急待攻擊，實較老年為尤甚，因為他們是～的橋樑，國家的絕續，全在他們肩上的。★魯迅《兩地書》一一
exampleEn: As for the urgent need to attack the youth, it is even greater than for the elderly, because they are the bridge between the past and the future, and the continuity of the nation rests on their shoulders.

explanation: 比喻一个不漏地全部抓住或彻底肃清。
explanationTraditional: 比喻一個不漏地全部抓住或徹底肅清。
explanationEn: To catch all in one net; to round up the entire lot at once.
derivation: 宋·魏泰《东轩笔录》卷四聊为相公一网打尽。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏泰《東軒筆錄》卷四聊為相公一網打盡。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wei Tai's 'Dongxuan Records', Volume 4: 'Let me catch them all in one net for you, Prime Minister.'
example: 人民也会想到使汉奸合法化的，自己就是汉奸，人民的决心是要～的。（闻一多《谨防汉奸合法化》）
exampleTraditional: 人民也會想到使漢奸合法化的，自己就是漢奸，人民的決心是要～的。（聞一多《謹防漢奸合法化》）
exampleEn: The people will also think that those who legalize traitors are themselves traitors, and the people are determined to catch them all in one net.

explanation: 原指经播种耕耘后有了收获。现比喻工作有进展，并取得了成果。
explanationTraditional: 原指經播種耕耘後有了收獲。現比喻工作有進展，並取得了成果。
explanationEn: To blossom and bear fruit; to yield positive results after effort.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷五十开花结果自馨香。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷五十開花結果自馨香。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting', Volume 50: 'Blossoming and bearing fruit, naturally fragrant.'
example: 如今方下种，还没有发芽哩，再隔五六年，～，才到你口。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷一
exampleTraditional: 如今方下種，還沒有發芽哩，再隔五六年，～，才到你口。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷一
exampleEn: Now we have just sown the seeds, and they haven't sprouted yet. In another five or six years, when they blossom and bear fruit, they will reach your mouth.

explanation: 慷慨豪爽，大方；解囊解开钱袋拿出钱来。形容极其大方地在经济上帮助别人。
explanationTraditional: 慷慨豪爽，大方；解囊解開錢袋拿出錢來。形容極其大方地在經濟上幫助別人。
explanationEn: To generously open one's purse to help others financially.
derivation: 姚雪垠雪《李自成》第二卷第十八章因此只得不揣冒昧，向大公子求将伯之助，不知公子肯慷慨解囊否？”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠雪《李自成》第二卷第十八章因此只得不揣冒昧，向大公子求將伯之助，不知公子肯慷慨解囊否？”
derivationEn: From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 18: 'Therefore, I take the liberty to ask for your help, not knowing if you would generously open your purse.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 素平素，向来。向来不认识。
explanationTraditional: 素平素，向來。向來不認識。
explanationEn: To have never known each other before; to be complete strangers.
derivation: 元·尚仲贤《柳毅传书》第四折我与你素不相识，一旦为你寄书，因而戏言，岂意遂为眷属。”
derivationTraditional: 元·尚仲賢《柳毅傳書》第四折我與你素不相識，一旦為你寄書，因而戲言，豈意遂為眷屬。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Shang Zhongxian's 'The Story of Liu Yi', Act 4: 'You and I have never known each other, yet I delivered a letter for you, and it turned into a marriage.'
example: 船儿只管乘风破浪的一直的走，走向那～的他乡。★冰心《寄小读者·通讯十八》
exampleTraditional: 船兒只管乘風破浪的一直的走，走向那～的他鄉。★冰心《寄小讀者·通訊十八》
exampleEn: The boat kept sailing forward bravely, heading towards a foreign land where we knew no one.

explanation: 长期这样下去。
explanationTraditional: 長期這樣下去。
explanationEn: If things continue this way for a long time.
derivation: 高阳《清宫外史》上册长此以往，必定搞成明朝末年那个样子，大政受言路的影响，亿不定，政府一件事不能办。”
derivationTraditional: 高陽《清宮外史》上冊長此以往，必定搞成明朝末年那個樣子，大政受言路的影響，億不定，政府一件事不能辦。”
derivationEn: From Gao Yang's 'Unofficial History of the Qing Palace', Volume 1: 'If things continue this way for a long time, it will surely end up like the late Ming Dynasty, where major policies are influenced by public opinion, and the government cannot accomplish anything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有什么可争辨的。表示确实无疑。
explanationTraditional: 沒有什麼可爭辨的。表示確實無疑。
explanationEn: Indisputable; beyond argument.
derivation: 清·陈澧《东塾读书记》卷十六太社不立于京都，当安所立。尤无可置辩矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·陳澧《東塾讀書記》卷十六太社不立於京都，當安所立。尤無可置辯矣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Chen Li's 'Dongshu Reading Notes', Volume 16: 'If the Grand Temple is not established in the capital, where should it be established? There is no room for dispute.'
example: 我们应该用～的道理说服人，而不是装腔作势，借以吓人。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該用～的道理說服人，而不是裝腔作勢，藉以嚇人。
exampleEn: We should convince people with indisputable reasoning, not by putting on airs to intimidate them.

explanation: 格格阻碍，隔阂。形容彼此不协调，不相容。
explanationTraditional: 格格阻礙，隔閡。形容彼此不協調，不相容。
explanationEn: Incompatible; out of tune with one another.
derivation: 《礼记·学记》发然后禁，则抜格而不胜。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·學記》發然後禁，則抜格而不勝。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Record on the Subject of Education': 'If prohibitions are imposed after the evil has developed, they will be resisted and will not prevail.'
example: 我本不知运动”的人，所以凡所讲演，多与该同盟～。★《鲁迅书信集·致章廷谦》
exampleTraditional: 我本不知運動”的人，所以凡所講演，多與該同盟～。★《魯迅書信集·致章廷謙》
exampleEn: I originally consider myself a 'non-athlete', so all my speeches are mostly incompatible with that alliance. — From Lu Xun's 'Letters: To Zhang Tingqian'

explanation: 蔚然草木茂盛的样子。指一件事情逐渐发展盛行，形成一种良好风气。
explanationTraditional: 蔚然草木茂盛的樣子。指一件事情逐漸發展盛行，形成一種良好風氣。
explanationEn: To become common practice; to grow into a general trend.
derivation: 范文澜《中国通史》第三编第七章第八节日本国内，自望族以至一般文士，摹仿唐诗蔚然成风。”
derivationTraditional: 范文瀾《中國通史》第三編第七章第八節日本國內，自望族以至一般文士，摹仿唐詩蔚然成風。”
derivationEn: From Fan Wenlan's 'General History of China', Volume 3, Chapter 7, Section 8: 'In Japan, from the nobility to ordinary literati, imitating Tang poetry became a common practice.'
example: ”五讲四美在我们周围～。
exampleTraditional: ”五講四美在我們周圍～。
exampleEn: The 'Five Stresses and Four Beauties' campaign has become common practice around us.

explanation: 形容自然界充满生命力，或社会生活活跃。
explanationTraditional: 形容自然界充滿生命力，或社會生活活躍。
explanationEn: Full of vitality; lively and vigorous.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 改革开放以来，我国的第三产业生机勃勃，发展非常迅速。
exampleTraditional: 改革開放以來，我國的第三產業生機勃勃，發展非常迅速。
exampleEn: Since the reform and opening up, China's tertiary industry has been full of vitality and developing very rapidly.

explanation: 耐禁受得住。能过困苦的生活，也经得起劳累。
explanationTraditional: 耐禁受得住。能過困苦的生活，也經得起勞累。
explanationEn: To endure hardships and work hard.
derivation: 周恩来《目前形势和新四军的任务》而我们新四军能吃苦耐劳，不怕困难。”
derivationTraditional: 周恩來《目前形勢和新四軍的任務》而我們新四軍能吃苦耐勞，不怕困難。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Enlai's 'Current Situation and the Tasks of the New Fourth Army': 'And our New Fourth Army can endure hardships and work hard, not afraid of difficulties.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 神志昏沉，不省人事。
explanationTraditional: 神志昏沉，不省人事。
explanationEn: Unconscious; in a coma.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第一回谁知早有人将信暗暗透于冷宫，秦凤一闻此言，胆裂魂飞，忙忙奏知李娘娘。李娘娘闻听，登时昏迷不醒。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第一回誰知早有人將信暗暗透於冷宮，秦鳳一聞此言，膽裂魂飛，忙忙奏知李娘娘。李娘娘聞聽，登時昏迷不醒。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Shi Yukun's 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants', Chapter 1: 'Who would have thought that someone had secretly informed the Cold Palace? Qin Feng, upon hearing this, was terrified and hurriedly reported to Empress Li. Empress Li, upon hearing it, immediately fell unconscious.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时店铺为显示资金雄厚而用金箔贴字的招牌。现比喻高人一等可以炫耀的名义或称号。也比喻名誉好。
explanationTraditional: 舊時店鋪為顯示資金雄厚而用金箔貼字的招牌。現比喻高人一等可以炫耀的名義或稱號。也比喻名譽好。
explanationEn: A gold-lettered signboard; a prestigious title or reputation.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十五回珏斋郻只出使了一次朝鲜，办结了甲申金玉均一案，又曾同威毅伯和日本伊滕博文定了出兵朝鲜彼此知会的条约，总算一帆风顺，文武全才的金字招牌，还高高挂着。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十五回珏齋郻只出使了一次朝鮮，辦結了甲申金玉均一案，又曾同威毅伯和日本伊滕博文定了出兵朝鮮彼此知會的條約，總算一帆風順，文武全才的金字招牌，還高高掛著。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flowers in a Sinful Sea', Chapter 25: 'Juezhai had only been on a diplomatic mission to Korea once, settled the Gapsin Coup case, and signed a treaty with Japan's Ito Hirobumi regarding mutual notification before sending troops to Korea. It was smooth sailing, and his gold-lettered signboard of being a man of both civil and military talents was still hanging high.'
example: 只要敬爱他的人，多发挥这一点，不要七手八脚，专门把他拖进自己所好的油或泥里去做～就好了。★鲁迅《花边文学·趋时与复古》
exampleTraditional: 只要敬愛他的人，多發揮這一點，不要七手八腳，專門把他拖進自己所好的油或泥裡去做～就好了。★魯迅《花邊文學·趨時與復古》
exampleEn: As long as those who admire him can make good use of this point, and not drag him into their own oil or mud to make him a gold-lettered signboard. — From Lu Xun's 'Huagai Collection: Following the Trend and Returning to the Ancients'

explanation: 径小路；庭院子；径庭悬殊，偏激。比喻相差很远，大不相同。
explanationTraditional: 徑小路；庭院子；徑庭懸殊，偏激。比喻相差很遠，大不相同。
explanationEn: Widely different; poles apart.
derivation: 《庄子·逍遥游》吾惊怖其言，犹河汉而无极也。大有径庭，不近人情焉？”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·逍遙遊》吾驚怖其言，猶河漢而無極也。大有徑庭，不近人情焉？”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi's 'Free and Easy Wandering': 'I am astonished at his words, which are like the Milky Way—endless and boundless. They are greatly different from common sense and far from human feelings.'
example: 虽然结果一样，其因”却～。（鲁迅《集外集拾遗·田园思想》）
exampleTraditional: 雖然結果一樣，其因”卻～。（魯迅《集外集拾遺·田園思想》）
exampleEn: Although the results are the same, the 'causes' are vastly different. — From Lu Xun's 'Collection of Extracurricular Writings: Pastoral Thoughts'

explanation: 堂皇官署的大堂，引申为气势盛大的样子。形容端正庄严或雄伟有气派。也指表面上庄严正大，堂堂正正，实际却不然。
explanationTraditional: 堂皇官署的大堂，引申為氣勢盛大的樣子。形容端正莊嚴或雄偉有氣派。也指表面上莊嚴正大，堂堂正正，實際卻不然。
explanationEn: Openly and proudly; in a dignified manner; often with a sense of pretentiousness.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 坐在一排一排的矮椅上，和跪下的样子也差不多，大家便实行马虎主义，还是～地坐着。（邹韬奋《经历·踏进了约翰》）
exampleTraditional: 坐在一排一排的矮椅上，和跪下的樣子也差不多，大家便實行馬虎主義，還是～地坐著。（鄒韜奮《經歷·踏進了約翰》）
exampleEn: Sitting in rows of low chairs, almost like kneeling, everyone adopted a perfunctory attitude and still sat there openly and proudly. — From Zou Taofen's 'Experience: Entering St. John's'

explanation: 好象数自己家藏的珍宝那样清楚。比喻对所讲的事情十分熟悉。
explanationTraditional: 好象數自己家藏的珍寶那樣清楚。比喻對所講的事情十分熟悉。
explanationEn: As if counting one's family treasures; to be very familiar with something.
derivation: 柳亚子《二十世纪大舞台发刊词》某也贤，某也不肖，一一如数家珍。”
derivationTraditional: 柳亞子《二十世紀大舞臺發刊詞》某也賢，某也不肖，一一如數家珍。”
derivationEn: Liu Yazi's 'Inaugural Speech of the 20th Century Grand Stage': 'So-and-so is virtuous, so-and-so is not, one by one as if counting family treasures.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 抢着向前，唯恐落后。
explanationTraditional: 搶著向前，唯恐落後。
explanationEn: To strive to be the first and fear to lag behind.
derivation: 清·张春帆《宦海》第十四回一个个争先恐后的直抢上来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張春帆《宦海》第十四回一個個爭先恐後的直搶上來。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Zhang Chunfan's 'The Sea of Officialdom' Chapter 14: 'Each one scrambled to be first, fearing to fall behind.'
example: 在学校举行的运动会上，各班同学～，奋力争先。
exampleTraditional: 在學校舉行的運動會上，各班同學～，奮力爭先。
exampleEn: At the school sports meet, students from each class scrambled to be first, striving to lead.

explanation: 用浓重的墨汁和颜色来描绘。形容着力描写。
explanationTraditional: 用濃重的墨汁和顏色來描繪。形容著力描寫。
explanationEn: To depict with thick ink and heavy colors; to describe with great emphasis.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指使用阔大的刀斧砍杀敌人◇比喻办事果断而有魄力。
explanationTraditional: 原指使用闊大的刀斧砍殺敵人◇比喻辦事果斷而有魄力。
explanationEn: Originally refers to using a broadsword and a big axe to kill enemies; metaphorically means to act decisively and boldly.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第一百十八回当下催军劫寨，大刀阔斧，杀将进去。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第一百十八回當下催軍劫寨，大刀闊斧，殺將進去。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 118: 'Immediately urged the army to raid the camp, wielding broadswords and big axes, charging in.'
example: 世界上原有两种人一种是～的人，一种是细针密线的人。★朱自清《山野掇拾》
exampleTraditional: 世界上原有兩種人一種是～的人，一種是細針密線的人。★朱自清《山野掇拾》
exampleEn: There are two kinds of people in the world: those who act decisively and boldly, and those who are meticulous and fine. — Zhu Ziqing's 'Gleaning in the Mountains'

explanation: 失措失去常态。由于惊慌，一下子不知怎么办才好。
explanationTraditional: 失措失去常態。由於驚慌，一下子不知怎麼辦才好。
explanationEn: To be panic-stricken and at a loss; to lose one's composure due to fright.
derivation: 《北齐书·元晖业传》（元）孝友临刑，惊慌失措，晖业神色自若。”
derivationTraditional: 《北齊書·元暉業傳》（元）孝友臨刑，驚慌失措，暉業神色自若。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Northern Qi: Biography of Yuan Huiye': 'Yuan Xiaoyou was panic-stricken at execution, while Huiye remained calm.'
example: 遇到危险情况，应该沉着冷静，不要～。
exampleTraditional: 遇到危險情況，應該沉著冷靜，不要～。
exampleEn: In dangerous situations, one should remain calm and not panic.

explanation: 剩余留下来的。剩下的没有多少了。
explanationTraditional: 剩餘留下來的。剩下的沒有多少了。
explanationEn: Very little remains; not much left.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十回好在所剩无几，待我念完，诸位才女再去慢慢参详，或者得其梗概，也未可知。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十回好在所剩無幾，待我念完，諸位才女再去慢慢參詳，或者得其梗概，也未可知。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 90: 'Fortunately, there is not much left; let me finish, and then you ladies can slowly ponder.'
example: 除垫还他经手若干外，～，一齐打三折归还人家的本钱，以作了事。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十三回
exampleTraditional: 除墊還他經手若干外，～，一齊打三折歸還人家的本錢，以作了事。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十三回
exampleEn: After deducting what he handled, there was not much left; all were returned at a 30% discount to settle the matter. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene' Chapter 53

explanation: 禄俸禄。泛指职位高，待遇优。
explanationTraditional: 祿俸祿。泛指職位高，待遇優。
explanationEn: High official positions and generous salaries; high rank and good pay.
derivation: 《荀子·议兵》是高爵丰禄之所加也，荣孰大焉。”汉·司马迁《报任少卿书》下之不能积日累劳，取尊官厚禄，以为宗族交游光宠。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·議兵》是高爵豐祿之所加也，榮孰大焉。”漢·司馬遷《報任少卿書》下之不能積日累勞，取尊官厚祿，以為宗族交遊光寵。”
derivationEn: 'Xunzi: On Military Affairs': 'High rank and rich rewards are the greatest honors.' Sima Qian's 'Letter to Ren An': 'I cannot accumulate daily merits to obtain high rank and generous salary to bring glory to my clan and friends.'
example: 假如有一等做官的，误国欺君，侵剥百姓，虽然～，难道不是大盗。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷八
exampleTraditional: 假如有一等做官的，誤國欺君，侵剝百姓，雖然～，難道不是大盜。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷八
exampleEn: If there are officials who mislead the country, bully the emperor, and exploit the people, even with high rank and generous salary, are they not great thieves? — Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement' Volume 8

explanation: 只有一个心眼儿，没有别的考虑。
explanationTraditional: 只有一個心眼兒，沒有別的考慮。
explanationEn: To have only one heart and one mind; to be single-minded and devoted.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·杜恕传》免为庶人，徙章武郡，是岁嘉平元年。”裴松之注引《杜氏新书》故推一心，任一意，直而行之耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·杜恕傳》免為庶人，徙章武郡，是歲嘉平元年。”裴松之注引《杜氏新書》故推一心，任一意，直而行之耳。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Du Shu' annotated by Pei Songzhi: 'Therefore, with one heart and one mind, I acted straightforwardly.'
example: 所以彭官保便～的料理防守事宜，庄制军便～料理军需器械。★清·张春帆《宦海》第四回
exampleTraditional: 所以彭官保便～的料理防守事宜，莊制軍便～料理軍需器械。★清·張春帆《宦海》第四回
exampleEn: So Governor Peng single-mindedly handled defense matters, and Governor Zhuang single-mindedly handled military supplies. — Qing Dynasty Zhang Chunfan's 'The Sea of Officialdom' Chapter 4

explanation: 井然整齐不乱的样子。序次序。整整齐齐，次序分明，条理清楚。
explanationTraditional: 井然整齊不亂的樣子。序次序。整整齊齊，次序分明，條理清楚。
explanationEn: In good order and well-organized; neat and orderly.
derivation: 清·王夫之《夕堂永日绪论外编》第二十六卷如尤公瑛《寡人之于国也》章文，以制产、重农、救荒分三事……井然有序。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王夫之《夕堂永日緒論外編》第二十六卷如尤公瑛《寡人之於國也》章文，以制產、重農、救荒分三事……井然有序。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Wang Fuzhi's 'Evening Sun: Eternal Day: Outer Compilation' Volume 26: 'Like You Gongying's essay on 'The King's Benevolence'... divided into three matters: production, agriculture, and famine relief, in good order.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指写字的笔法曲折多变。现比喻文章的结构起伏曲折。也比喻事情进行中意外的变化很多。
explanationTraditional: 原指寫字的筆法曲折多變。現比喻文章的結構起伏曲折。也比喻事情進行中意外的變化很多。
explanationEn: Originally refers to the twists and turns in calligraphy strokes; now metaphorically means a story with many twists and turns, or unexpected changes in events.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《题卫夫人笔阵图》每作一波，常三过折笔。”《宣和书谱·太上内景神经》卷五然其一波三折笔之势，亦自不苟。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《題衛夫人筆陣圖》每作一波，常三過折筆。”《宣和書譜·太上內景神經》卷五然其一波三折筆之勢，亦自不苟。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty Wang Xizhi's 'Inscription on Lady Wei's Brush Formation': 'Every wave stroke often has three bends.' 'Xuanhe Calligraphy Manual: Inner Scenery Classic' Volume 5: 'Yet the wave stroke with three bends is also not careless.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 举动和神色值得怀疑。
explanationTraditional: 舉動和神色值得懷疑。
explanationEn: Suspicious in behavior and expression; deserving of suspicion.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·房文淑》邓以形迹可疑，故亦不敢告人，托之归宁而已。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·房文淑》鄧以形跡可疑，故亦不敢告人，託之歸寧而已。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio': 'Deng found his behavior suspicious, so he dared not tell others, pretending to return home.'
example: 贴在教务处骂他的纸条，确有点过火，但也是他～所致。★鲁迅《两地书》一一
exampleTraditional: 貼在教務處罵他的紙條，確有點過火，但也是他～所致。★魯迅《兩地書》一一
exampleEn: The note posted in the dean's office cursing him was indeed a bit excessive, but it was also caused by his suspicious behavior. ★ Lu Xun, 'Two Places', letter 11

explanation: 手摸上去感到热得烫人。比喻权势大，气焰盛，使人不敢接近。
explanationTraditional: 手摸上去感到熱得燙人。比喻權勢大，氣焰盛，使人不敢接近。
explanationEn: So hot that it burns the hand. Metaphor for great power and arrogance, making people dare not approach.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《丽人行》炙手可热势绝伦，慎莫近前丞相嗔。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《麗人行》炙手可熱勢絕倫，慎莫近前丞相嗔。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Fu's poem 'The Beautiful Lady': 'So hot it burns the hand, unmatched in power; beware, do not approach, the prime minister frowns.'
example: ～握大权，待郎充犬吠篱边。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第一回
exampleTraditional: ～握大權，待郎充犬吠籬邊。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第一回
exampleEn: Holding great power, burning hot, he waits as a lackey barking by the fence. ★ Qing Dynasty Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 1

explanation: 临到；境境界，地方。亲自到了那个境地。
explanationTraditional: 臨到；境境界，地方。親自到了那個境地。
explanationEn: To personally experience the situation; to be on the scene.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这篇散文把桂林山水描写得形象逼真，读完使人有身临其境的感觉。
exampleTraditional: 這篇散文把桂林山水描寫得形象逼真，讀完使人有身臨其境的感覺。
exampleEn: This essay describes Guilin's landscape so vividly that readers feel as if they are personally there.

explanation: 不说任何别的话。指立即行动。
explanationTraditional: 不說任何別的話。指立即行動。
explanationEn: Without saying another word; to act immediately.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》九八‘日本鬼子完蛋了，投降了，’方六低声回答。丁约翰象在教堂里说‘阿门’那样，把眼睛闭了一闭。二话不说，回头就跑。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》九八‘日本鬼子完蛋了，投降了，’方六低聲回答。丁約翰象在教堂裡說‘阿門’那樣，把眼睛閉了一閉。二話不說，回頭就跑。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof': 'The Japanese devils are finished, surrendered,' Fang Liu whispered. Ding John closed his eyes like saying 'Amen' in church. Without another word, he turned and ran.'
example: 来到岸边，～，驾起船，直奔河心。★《为了六十一个阶级弟兄》
exampleTraditional: 來到岸邊，～，駕起船，直奔河心。★《為了六十一個階級弟兄》
exampleEn: Upon arriving at the shore, without another word, he set sail straight to the river's center. ★ 'For the 61 Class Brothers'

explanation: 流连留恋不止。玩乐时留恋不愿离开。留恋得忘记了回去。
explanationTraditional: 流連留戀不止。玩樂時留戀不願離開。留戀得忘記了回去。
explanationEn: To linger and forget to return; to be so captivated that one forgets to go back.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王下》从流下而忘反谓之流，从流上而忘反谓之连。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王下》從流下而忘反謂之流，從流上而忘反謂之連。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius, King Hui of Liang II': 'Going downstream and forgetting to return is called lingering; going upstream and forgetting to return is called lingering.'
example: 四时随意出游，弦管相逐，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十一回
exampleTraditional: 四時隨意出遊，弦管相逐，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十一回
exampleEn: They traveled at will in all seasons, with music and song, lingering and forgetting to return. ★ Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 81

explanation: 盈充满；眶眼眶。因感情激动而使眼泪充满了眼眶，形容感动至极或非常悲伤。
explanationTraditional: 盈充滿；眶眼眶。因感情激動而使眼淚充滿了眼眶，形容感動至極或非常悲傷。
explanationEn: Eyes brimming with tears of emotion; deeply moved or very sad.
derivation: 邹韬奋《我的母亲》往往讲到孤女患难，或义妇含冤的凄惨的情形，她两人便都热泪盈眶，泪珠尽往颊上涌流着。”
derivationTraditional: 鄒韜奮《我的母親》往往講到孤女患難，或義婦含冤的悽慘的情形，她兩人便都熱淚盈眶，淚珠盡往頰上湧流著。”
derivationEn: From Zou Taofen's 'My Mother': 'When telling the tragic stories of orphaned girls or wronged virtuous women, both would have tears brimming in their eyes, streaming down their cheeks.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 销通消”，消失；匿隐藏；迹踪迹。指隐藏起来，不公开露面。
explanationTraditional: 銷通消”，消失；匿隱藏；跡蹤跡。指隱藏起來，不公開露面。
explanationEn: To hide oneself and not appear in public; to disappear from the scene.
derivation: 宋·孙光宪《北梦琐言》卷十一家生避地，亦到锦江，然畏颖川知之，遂旅游资中郡，销声敛迹，惟恐人知。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·孫光憲《北夢瑣言》卷十一家生避地，亦到錦江，然畏穎川知之，遂旅遊資中郡，銷聲斂跡，惟恐人知。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Sun Guangxian's 'Records of Northern Dreams': 'The family fled to avoid trouble, also reaching Jinjiang, but fearing that Yingchuan would know, they traveled to Zizhong County, hiding their traces and concealing their whereabouts, afraid of being discovered.'
example: 他生平最是趋炎附势的，如何肯～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 他生平最是趨炎附勢的，如何肯～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十八回
exampleEn: He was always one to fawn on the powerful; how could he be willing to hide himself? ★ Qing Dynasty Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats', Chapter 28

explanation: 打击攻击。用敌对的态度回击对方。
explanationTraditional: 打擊攻擊。用敵對的態度回擊對方。
explanationEn: To retaliate or take revenge against someone, often in a hostile manner.
derivation: 《人民日报》1988.12.31披露了我们向上级反映我店截留利润六十五万元的问题后，遭受打击报复的一些真相。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1988.12.31披露了我們向上級反映我店截留利潤六十五萬元的問題後，遭受打擊報復的一些真相。”
derivationEn: From 'People's Daily', December 31, 1988: 'It revealed some truths about the retaliation we suffered after reporting to superiors the embezzlement of 650,000 yuan by our store.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指费尽心力。
explanationTraditional: 指費盡心力。
explanationEn: To exert one's utmost effort; to do one's best.
derivation: 《晋书·王坦之传》且受遇先帝，绸缪缱绻，并志竭忠贞，尽心尽力，归诚陛下，以报先帝。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王坦之傳》且受遇先帝，綢繆繾綣，並志竭忠貞，盡心盡力，歸誠陛下，以報先帝。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin, Biography of Wang Tanzhi': 'Having been favored by the late emperor, with deep affection and devotion, we have exhausted our loyalty and done our utmost to serve Your Majesty, repaying the late emperor.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 贯贯穿。用一个根本性的事理贯通事情的始末或全部的道理。
explanationTraditional: 貫貫穿。用一個根本性的事理貫通事情的始末或全部的道理。
explanationEn: To consistently follow a single principle throughout; to run through with one consistent thread.
derivation: 《论语·里仁》子曰‘参乎！吾道一以贯之’曾子曰‘唯。’子出，门人问曰‘何谓也？’曾子曰‘夫子之道，忠恕而已矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·里仁》子曰‘參乎！吾道一以貫之’曾子曰‘唯。’子出，門人問曰‘何謂也？’曾子曰‘夫子之道，忠恕而已矣。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects, Li Ren': 'The Master said, 'Shen! My doctrine is that of an all-pervading unity.' Zengzi said, 'Yes.' When the Master left, the disciples asked, 'What did he mean?' Zengzi said, 'The Master's doctrine is nothing but loyalty and reciprocity.'
example: 据谷超豪等人回忆，凡遇应当参加的讨论会，苏先生向来是风雨无阻，几十年间～。★刘征泰《苏步青》
exampleTraditional: 據谷超豪等人回憶，凡遇應當參加的討論會，蘇先生向來是風雨無阻，幾十年間～。★劉徵泰《蘇步青》
exampleEn: According to Gu Chaohao and others, whenever there was a discussion he should attend, Mr. Su would attend regardless of weather, consistently for decades. ★ Liu Zhengtai, 'Su Buqing'

explanation: 恍然猛然清醒的样子；悟心里明白。形容一下子明白过来。
explanationTraditional: 恍然猛然清醒的樣子；悟心裡明白。形容一下子明白過來。
explanationEn: Suddenly realize or understand something clearly.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷五简蒙指教，豁然大悟。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷五簡蒙指教，豁然大悟。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan's 'Jingde Chuandeng Lu' Volume 5: 'Jian Meng zhi jiao, huo ran da wu.' (Suddenly enlightened after receiving instruction.)
example: 袁太守和庄太守听了，方才～，彼此相视而笑。★清·张春帆《宦海》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 袁太守和莊太守聽了，方才～，彼此相視而笑。★清·張春帆《宦海》第十七回
exampleEn: Governor Yuan and Governor Zhuang heard this and suddenly understood, smiling at each other. — Qing Dynasty, Zhang Chunfan's 'The Sea of Officialdom' Chapter 17

explanation: 之代词，它；理理睬。放在一边，不理不睬。
explanationTraditional: 之代詞，它；理理睬。放在一邊，不理不睬。
explanationEn: Ignore or pay no attention to something or someone.
derivation: 清·黄小配《廿载繁华梦》第十六回各人听了，反不以为是，就有说他是嫌钱多的，又有说他是愿贫不愿富的，邓仪卿种种置之不理而已。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃小配《廿載繁華夢》第十六回各人聽了，反不以為是，就有說他是嫌錢多的，又有說他是願貧不願富的，鄧儀卿種種置之不理而已。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Huang Xiaopei's 'Twenty Years of Splendor' Chapter 16: 'Deng Yiqing simply ignored them.'
example: 老师批评他，他～。
exampleTraditional: 老師批評他，他～。
exampleEn: The teacher criticized him, but he ignored it.

explanation: 形容事情容易做，不费力气。
explanationTraditional: 形容事情容易做，不費力氣。
explanationEn: Very easy to do, requiring little effort.
derivation: 《诗·大雅·焌民》人亦有言，德輶如毛，民鲜克举之。”朱熹注言人皆言德甚轻而易举，然人莫能举也。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·大雅·焌民》人亦有言，德輶如毛，民鮮克舉之。”朱熹注言人皆言德甚輕而易舉，然人莫能舉也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Daya, Jiongmin': 'People say virtue is light as hair, but few can lift it.' Zhu Xi's commentary: 'People say virtue is extremely easy, yet no one can lift it.'
example: 事情并不象宋福想的那样～。★杨朔《渔笛》
exampleTraditional: 事情並不象宋福想的那樣～。★楊朔《漁笛》
exampleEn: Things were not as easy as Song Fu thought. — Yang Shuo's 'Fisherman's Flute'

explanation: 人来来往往连续不断。也形容忙于应酬。
explanationTraditional: 人來來往往連續不斷。也形容忙於應酬。
explanationEn: People coming and going continuously; also describes being busy with social engagements.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百十回这两三天人来人往，我瞧着那些人都照应不到，想必你没有吩咐，还得你替我们操点心儿才好。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百十回這兩三天人來人往，我瞧著那些人都照應不到，想必你沒有吩咐，還得你替我們操點心兒才好。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 110: 'These two days, people have been coming and going, and I haven't been able to attend to everyone.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛称美好山河。
explanationTraditional: 泛稱美好山河。
explanationEn: Beautiful mountains and rivers; picturesque scenery.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》问‘牛头未见四祖时如何？’师曰‘青山绿水。’曰‘见后如何？’师曰‘绿水青山。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》問‘牛頭未見四祖時如何？’師曰‘青山綠水。’曰‘見後如何？’師曰‘綠水青山。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Question: 'How was it before Niutou saw the Fourth Patriarch?' Master: 'Green mountains and green waters.' 'After seeing?' Master: 'Green waters and green mountains.'
example: 历遍了～，看不尽野草闲花。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十三回
exampleTraditional: 歷遍了～，看不盡野草閒花。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十三回
exampleEn: Traveling through green mountains and green waters, seeing endless wild grass and flowers. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West' Chapter 23

explanation: 多方面同时前进。多形容几件事情或几项工作同时进行。
explanationTraditional: 多方面同時前進。多形容幾件事情或幾項工作同時進行。
explanationEn: Advance simultaneously on multiple fronts; do several things at once.
derivation: 周恩来《在上海科学技术工作会议上的讲话》实现科学技术现代化的主要要求是实事求是，循序前进，齐头并进，迎头赶上。”
derivationTraditional: 周恩來《在上海科學技術工作會議上的講話》實現科學技術現代化的主要要求是實事求是，循序前進，齊頭並進，迎頭趕上。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Enlai's 'Speech at the Shanghai Science and Technology Work Conference': 'The main requirements for modernizing science and technology are to seek truth from facts, proceed step by step, advance simultaneously, and catch up.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 筹筹划、计谋；展施展。一点计策也施展不出，一点办法也想不出来。
explanationTraditional: 籌籌劃、計謀；展施展。一點計策也施展不出，一點辦法也想不出來。
explanationEn: Unable to come up with any plan or solution; at one's wit's end.
derivation: 《宋史·蔡幼学传》其极至于九重深拱而群臣尽废，多士盈庭而一筹不吐。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·蔡幼學傳》其極至於九重深拱而群臣盡廢，多士盈庭而一籌不吐。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song, Biography of Cai Youxue': 'In the end, the emperor is isolated and ministers are useless, many scholars fill the court but cannot produce a single plan.'
example: 平时学习不认真，不求甚解，到用时就会感到知识贫乏，～。
exampleTraditional: 平時學習不認真，不求甚解，到用時就會感到知識貧乏，～。
exampleEn: If you don't study seriously and only seek superficial understanding, you'll find yourself lacking knowledge and at a loss when needed.

explanation: 形容百花盛开，丰富多彩。比喻各种不同形式和风格的艺术自由发展。也形容艺术界的繁荣景象。
explanationTraditional: 形容百花盛開，豐富多彩。比喻各種不同形式和風格的藝術自由發展。也形容藝術界的繁榮景象。
explanationEn: A hundred flowers bloom; describes a rich variety of art forms developing freely, or a flourishing artistic scene.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三回百花仙子只顾在此著棋，那知下界帝王忽有御旨命他百花齐放。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三回百花仙子只顧在此著棋，那知下界帝王忽有御旨命他百花齊放。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 3: 'The Hundred Flowers Fairy was playing chess, unaware that the earthly emperor had decreed all flowers to bloom.'
example: 美术展览会上展出了许多新作品，～，各具风格。
exampleTraditional: 美術展覽會上展出了許多新作品，～，各具風格。
exampleEn: The art exhibition displayed many new works, with a hundred flowers blooming, each with its own style.

explanation: 执坚持。各人坚持各人的说法。形容意见不一致。
explanationTraditional: 執堅持。各人堅持各人的說法。形容意見不一致。
explanationEn: Each insists on their own version; disagreement in opinions.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二十九两下各执一词，难以定招。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二十九兩下各執一詞，難以定招。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 29: 'Both sides insisted on their own words, making it hard to reach a verdict.'
