example: 辩论会上，双方～，争执不下。
exampleTraditional: 辯論會上，雙方～，爭執不下。
exampleEn: In the debate, both sides insisted on their own arguments, unable to agree.

explanation: 道途径。志趣相同，意见一致。
explanationTraditional: 道途徑。志趣相同，意見一致。
explanationEn: Having the same aspirations and goals; like-minded.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·陈思王植传》昔伊尹之为媵臣，至贱也，吕尚之处屠钓，至陋也，乃其见举于汤武、周文，诚道合志同，玄漠神通，岂复假近习之荐，因左右之介哉。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·陳思王植傳》昔伊尹之為媵臣，至賤也，呂尚之處屠釣，至陋也，乃其見舉於湯武、周文，誠道合志同，玄漠神通，豈復假近習之薦，因左右之介哉。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Wei Shu, Biography of Chen Si Wang Zhi': 'In ancient times, Yi Yin and Lü Shang were lowly, but when they met Tang and Wen, they shared the same path and spirit.'
example: 两人起先虽觉得～，后来子美的热狂冷了。★闻一多《杜甫》
exampleTraditional: 兩人起先雖覺得～，後來子美的熱狂冷了。★聞一多《杜甫》
exampleEn: At first, the two felt like-minded, but later Zimei's enthusiasm cooled. — Wen Yiduo's 'Du Fu'

explanation: 费尽脑筋。
explanationTraditional: 費盡腦筋。
explanationEn: To rack one's brains; to think hard.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 碰到这个难题，他绞尽脑汁也想不出解决的办法来。
exampleTraditional: 碰到這個難題，他絞盡腦汁也想不出解決的辦法來。
exampleEn: Faced with this difficult problem, he racked his brains but couldn't find a solution.

explanation: 首首先。扳指头计算，首先弯下大拇指，表示第一。指居第一位。引申为最好的。
explanationTraditional: 首首先。扳指頭計算，首先彎下大拇指，表示第一。指居第一位。引申為最好的。
explanationEn: To come first on the list; to be second to none; the best.
derivation: 闻一多《家书——给父母亲》此校确系美国之首屈一指，我毕业于此后，纵欲继续研究，在此邦亦无处可去也。”
derivationTraditional: 聞一多《家書——給父母親》此校確係美國之首屈一指，我畢業於此後，縱慾繼續研究，在此邦亦無處可去也。”
derivationEn: Wen Yiduo's 'Letter to Parents': 'This school is indeed the best in the United States. After I graduate, even if I want to continue studying, there is nowhere else to go in this country.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 渠水道。水流到的地方自然形成一条水道。比喻条件成熟，事情自然会成功。
explanationTraditional: 渠水道。水流到的地方自然形成一條水道。比喻條件成熟，事情自然會成功。
explanationEn: When water flows, a channel is formed; when conditions are ripe, success will come naturally.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《答秦太虚书》至时别作经画，水到渠成，不须预虑。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《答秦太虛書》至時別作經畫，水到渠成，不須預慮。”
derivationEn: Su Shi's 'Letter to Qin Taixu': 'When the time comes, we will plan accordingly. When water flows, a channel is formed; there is no need to worry in advance.'
example: 须要自然而然，～，非由车戽，最忌无因而至，突如其来。★清·李渔《闲情偶寄·大收煞》
exampleTraditional: 須要自然而然，～，非由車戽，最忌無因而至，突如其來。★清·李漁《閒情偶寄·大收煞》
exampleEn: It must happen naturally, like water forming a channel, not by artificial means. The worst is to have no cause and come suddenly. — Li Yu, 'Xianqing Ouji'

explanation: 廉便宜。东西价钱便宜，质量又好。
explanationTraditional: 廉便宜。東西價錢便宜，質量又好。
explanationEn: Good quality and low price; cheap and fine.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《近十年之怪现状》第十回苏州有个朋友写信来，要印一部书。久仰贵局的价廉物美，所以特来求教。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《近十年之怪現狀》第十回蘇州有個朋友寫信來，要印一部書。久仰貴局的價廉物美，所以特來求教。”
derivationEn: Wu Jianren's 'Strange Things of the Last Ten Years', Chapter 10: 'A friend from Suzhou wrote to me, wanting to print a book. I have long admired your shop's good quality and low price, so I came to ask for your help.'
example: 提倡～，老少无欺，反对粗制滥造，偷工减料。（朱德《要把手工业生产合作社搞好》）
exampleTraditional: 提倡～，老少無欺，反對粗製濫造，偷工減料。（朱德《要把手工業生產合作社搞好》）
exampleEn: Promote good quality and low price, fair to all ages, oppose shoddy work and inferior materials. — Zhu De, 'On Doing a Good Job in Handicraft Cooperatives'

explanation: 纷纭多而姑乱。人多嘴杂，议论纷纷。
explanationTraditional: 紛紜多而姑亂。人多嘴雜，議論紛紛。
explanationEn: Opinions vary; a wide divergence of views.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·阿纤》君无二心，妾岂不知？但众口纷纭，恐不免秋扇之捐。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·阿纖》君無二心，妾豈不知？但眾口紛紜，恐不免秋扇之捐。”
derivationEn: Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: A Xian': 'I know you have no second thoughts, but with so many opinions, I fear I may be abandoned like an autumn fan.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为政管理政事，泛指行事。各自按自己的主张办事，不互相配合。比喻不考虑全局，各搞一套。
explanationTraditional: 為政管理政事，泛指行事。各自按自己的主張辦事，不互相配合。比喻不考慮全局，各搞一套。
explanationEn: Each acts on his own; each does things in his own way without coordination.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·节南山》不自为政，卒劳百姓。”《左传·宣公二年》畴昔之羊，子为政，今日之事，我为政。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·節南山》不自為政，卒勞百姓。”《左傳·宣公二年》疇昔之羊，子為政，今日之事，我為政。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Jienanshan': 'You do not govern yourself, and in the end you trouble the people.' 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xuan's Second Year': 'In the past, the sheep was your affair; today, the battle is my affair.'
example: 诸将专威于外，～，莫或同心。★《三国志·吴志·胡综传》
exampleTraditional: 諸將專威於外，～，莫或同心。★《三國志·吳志·胡綜傳》
exampleEn: The generals wielded power outside the court, each acting on his own, with no unity of purpose. — 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Hu Zong's Biography'

explanation: 话深刻有力，情意深长。
explanationTraditional: 話深刻有力，情意深長。
explanationEn: Sincere words and earnest wishes; speaking with deep meaning and heartfelt emotion.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他这些语重心长的话，深深地打劫了我的心。
exampleTraditional: 他這些語重心長的話，深深地打劫了我的心。
exampleEn: His sincere and earnest words deeply touched my heart.

explanation: 德品德；才才能；备具备。既有好的思想品质，又有工作的才干和能力。
explanationTraditional: 德品德；才才能；備具備。既有好的思想品質，又有工作的才幹和能力。
explanationEn: Having both moral integrity and professional ability; combining ability with character.
derivation: 宋·许月卿《先天集·人邑道中三首》天涵地育王公旦，德备才全范仲淹。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·許月卿《先天集·人邑道中三首》天涵地育王公旦，德備才全范仲淹。”
derivationEn: Xu Yueqing's 'Xiantian Ji: Entering the County Road, Three Poems': 'Heaven and earth nurture the king's virtue, complete virtue and full talent like Fan Zhongyan.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 此这。因酷爱干某事而不感觉厌烦。形容对某事特别爱好而沉浸其中。
explanationTraditional: 此這。因酷愛幹某事而不感覺厭煩。形容對某事特別愛好而沉浸其中。
explanationEn: To take delight in something and never tire of it; to be completely engrossed in an activity.
derivation: 《后汉书·光武帝纪》我自乐此，不为疲也。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·光武帝紀》我自樂此，不為疲也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Emperor Guangwu': 'I take delight in this and do not feel tired.'
example: 更兼这位老先生，天生又是无论什么疑难，每问必知，据知而答，无答不即详且尽，并且～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十八回
exampleTraditional: 更兼這位老先生，天生又是無論什麼疑難，每問必知，據知而答，無答不即詳且盡，並且～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十八回
exampleEn: Moreover, this old gentleman was naturally such that no matter what difficult question, he always knew the answer, and answered in detail and without end, and he never tired of it. — Wen Kang, 'The Story of a Heroic Couple', Chapter 38

explanation: 方正在；兴兴起；艾停止。事物正在发展，尚未达到止境。
explanationTraditional: 方正在；興興起；艾停止。事物正在發展，尚未達到止境。
explanationEn: To be in the ascendant; to be growing and not yet reaching its peak.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《戊申再上孝宗皇帝书》天下非有豪猾不可制之奸，虏人非有方兴未艾之势，而何必用此哉！”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《戊申再上孝宗皇帝書》天下非有豪猾不可制之奸，虜人非有方興未艾之勢，而何必用此哉！”
derivationEn: Chen Liang's 'Memorial to Emperor Xiaozong, Again': 'The world is not yet plagued by unruly villains, and the enemy does not have a growing and unstoppable momentum, so why use this?'
example: 正当辽沈战役～之时，毛泽东同志在华东人民解放军取得了济南战役胜利以后，又组织了淮海战役。★叶剑英《伟大的战略决战》
exampleTraditional: 正當遼瀋戰役～之時，毛澤東同志在華東人民解放軍取得了濟南戰役勝利以後，又組織了淮海戰役。★葉劍英《偉大的戰略決戰》
exampleEn: Just when the Liaoshen Campaign was in full swing, Comrade Mao Zedong, after the victory of the Jinan Campaign by the East China People's Liberation Army, organized the Huaihai Campaign. — Ye Jianying, 'The Great Strategic Decisive Battle'

explanation: 形容色彩复杂或花样繁多。引伸为各色各样。
explanationTraditional: 形容色彩複雜或花樣繁多。引伸為各色各樣。
explanationEn: Describes a variety of colors or a wide range of things.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十四回惟各人所登之云，五颜六色，其形不一。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十四回惟各人所登之雲，五顏六色，其形不一。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 14: 'The clouds each person rode were of five colors and six hues, each different in shape.'
example: 这在四川的拉夫史上是一桩奇迹，于是那些乡下人，哦了一声，立刻发出～的推测来了。★沙汀《凶手》
exampleTraditional: 這在四川的拉夫史上是一樁奇蹟，於是那些鄉下人，哦了一聲，立刻發出～的推測來了。★沙汀《兇手》
exampleEn: This was a miracle in the history of Sichuan's press-ganging, so those villagers let out an 'oh' and immediately began making all sorts of speculations. — Sha Ting, 'The Murderer'

explanation: 衷内心。心里一点儿也没有触动。指对应该关心、注意的事情毫不关心，置之不理。
explanationTraditional: 衷內心。心裡一點兒也沒有觸動。指對應該關心、注意的事情毫不關心，置之不理。
explanationEn: Completely unmoved; indifferent to matters that should concern one.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十三回以至顶到如今，偏偏碰着这位制军是不轻容易见客的，他见也好，不见也好，便也漠然无动于中了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十三回以至頂到如今，偏偏碰著這位制軍是不輕容易見客的，他見也好，不見也好，便也漠然無動於中了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 33: 'Up to now, they happened to meet this governor who was not easy to see; whether he saw them or not, they remained indifferent and unmoved.'
example: 面对集体财产遭到大火的威胁，我们怎么能～呢？
exampleTraditional: 面對集體財產遭到大火的威脅，我們怎麼能～呢？
exampleEn: Facing the threat of a fire destroying collective property, how can we remain indifferent?

explanation: 锦有彩色花纹的丝织品。在锦上再绣花。比喻好上加好，美上添美。
explanationTraditional: 錦有彩色花紋的絲織品。在錦上再繡花。比喻好上加好，美上添美。
explanationEn: To add flowers to brocade; to make something good even better.
derivation: 宋·王安石《即事》诗嘉招欲覆杯中渌，丙方唱仍添锦上花。”宋·黄庭坚《了了庵颂》又要涪翁作颂，且图锦上添花。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王安石《即事》詩嘉招欲覆杯中淥，丙方唱仍添錦上花。”宋·黃庭堅《了了庵頌》又要涪翁作頌，且圖錦上添花。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wang Anshi's poem 'Impromptu': 'A good invitation wants to cover the cup's green, but the singer still adds flowers on brocade.' Also from Huang Tingjian's 'Eulogy for Liaole Temple': 'Again ask Fulong to write a eulogy, just to add flowers on brocade.'
example: 命穷时镇日价河头卖水，运来时一朝的～。★明·康海《中山狼》第一的
exampleTraditional: 命窮時鎮日價河頭賣水，運來時一朝的～。★明·康海《中山狼》第一的
exampleEn: In poverty, I sold water by the river all day; in fortune, I suddenly had flowers added to brocade. — Ming Dynasty Kang Hai, 'Zhongshan Wolf', Act 1

explanation: 荒荒唐；淫淫乱；度限度。形容征逐酒色，生活糜烂。
explanationTraditional: 荒荒唐；淫淫亂；度限度。形容徵逐酒色，生活糜爛。
explanationEn: Excessive indulgence in wine and women; debauched and dissolute.
derivation: 汉·杨恽《报孙会宗书》人生行乐耳，须富贵何时。是日也，拂衣而喜，奋袖低昂，顿足起舞，诚淫荒无度，不知其不可也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·楊惲《報孫會宗書》人生行樂耳，須富貴何時。是日也，拂衣而喜，奮袖低昂，頓足起舞，誠淫荒無度，不知其不可也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Yang Yun's 'Letter to Sun Huizong': 'Life is for pleasure; why wait for wealth and rank? That day, I joyfully flicked my sleeves, raised and lowered them, stamped and danced, truly indulging in debauchery without limit, not knowing it was wrong.'
example: 由于～，乡长的身体越来越加坏了，随常都在闹病，于是他的太太硬把她的愤怒转注在所有的流娼身上。★沙汀《一个秋天的晚上》
exampleTraditional: 由於～，鄉長的身體越來越加壞了，隨常都在鬧病，於是他的太太硬把她的憤怒轉註在所有的流娼身上。★沙汀《一個秋天的晚上》
exampleEn: Due to his excessive debauchery, the township head's health worsened, and he was often ill, so his wife vented her anger on all the prostitutes. — Sha Ting, 'An Autumn Night'

explanation: 指对旧的文化进行批判地继承，剔除其糟粕，吸取其精华，创造出新的文化。
explanationTraditional: 指對舊的文化進行批判地繼承，剔除其糟粕，吸取其精華，創造出新的文化。
explanationEn: To critically inherit the old, discard the dross, absorb the essence, and create something new.
derivation: 清·戴延年《秋灯丛话·忠勇祠联》不特推陈出新，饶有别致。”
derivationTraditional: 清·戴延年《秋燈叢話·忠勇祠聯》不特推陳出新，饒有別致。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Dai Yannian's 'Autumn Lamp Tales: Loyalty and Courage Shrine Couplet': 'Not only does it push out the old and bring forth the new, but it also has a unique charm.'
example: 研究棋艺，～。★陈毅《题〈围棋名谱精选〉》诗
exampleTraditional: 研究棋藝，～。★陳毅《題〈圍棋名譜精選〉》詩
exampleEn: Study the art of chess, push out the old and bring forth the new. — Chen Yi, poem 'Inscription on Selected Masterpieces of Go'

explanation: 毫无阻碍地通行或通过。
explanationTraditional: 毫無阻礙地通行或通過。
explanationEn: To pass or travel without any obstacles.
derivation: 毛泽东《整顿党的作风》铲除这两方面的祸根，才能使党在团结全党同志和团结全国人民的伟大事业中畅行无阻。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《整頓黨的作風》剷除這兩方面的禍根，才能使黨在團結全黨同志和團結全國人民的偉大事業中暢行無阻。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Rectify the Party's Style of Work': 'Only by eradicating these two evils can the Party advance unimpeded in the great cause of uniting all Party comrades and the people of the whole country.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 树立；帜旗帜。单独树起一面旗帜。比喻独特新奇，自成一家。
explanationTraditional: 樹立；幟旗幟。單獨樹起一面旗幟。比喻獨特新奇，自成一家。
explanationEn: To set up a separate banner; to develop one's own unique style or school.
derivation: 清·袁枚《随园诗话》卷三元、白在唐朝所以能独树一帜者，正为其不袭盛唐窠臼也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·袁枚《隨園詩話》卷三元、白在唐朝所以能獨樹一幟者，正為其不襲盛唐窠臼也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Yuan Mei's 'Poetry Talks from the Sui Garden', Volume 3: 'The reason Yuan Zhen and Bai Juyi could set up a separate banner in the Tang Dynasty was precisely because they did not follow the worn-out patterns of the High Tang.'
example: 苏轼也擅长书法，他取法颜真卿，但能～，与蔡襄、黄庭坚、米芾并称宋代四大家。
exampleTraditional: 蘇軾也擅長書法，他取法顏真卿，但能～，與蔡襄、黃庭堅、米芾並稱宋代四大家。
exampleEn: Su Shi was also skilled in calligraphy; he modeled after Yan Zhenqing but developed his own style, and together with Cai Xiang, Huang Tingjian, and Mi Fu, he was known as the Four Great Masters of the Song Dynasty.

explanation: 形容生活简朴，吃用节俭。
explanationTraditional: 形容生活簡樸，吃用節儉。
explanationEn: To live frugally and economize on food and expenses.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十七回虞华轩在家，省吃俭用，积起几两银子。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十七回虞華軒在家，省吃儉用，積起幾兩銀子。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 47: 'Yu Huaxuan stayed at home, saving on food and clothing, and accumulated a few taels of silver.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 济补益，帮助。对事情没有什么帮助或益处。比喻不解决问题。
explanationTraditional: 濟補益，幫助。對事情沒有什麼幫助或益處。比喻不解決問題。
explanationEn: Of no help or benefit to the matter; does not solve the problem.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十二回如今远水救不得近火，就是我们再帮点忙，至多再凑了几百银子，也无济于事。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十二回如今遠水救不得近火，就是我們再幫點忙，至多再湊了幾百銀子，也無濟於事。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 52: 'Now distant water cannot quench near fire; even if we help a bit more, at most we can add a few hundred silver taels, which will be of no avail.'
example: 遇事需当机立断，任何犹豫和怯懦都是～的。
exampleTraditional: 遇事需當機立斷，任何猶豫和怯懦都是～的。
exampleEn: When encountering problems, one must make prompt decisions; any hesitation or timidity is of no help.

explanation: 禁抑制。感情激动得不能控制。强调完全被某种感情所支配。
explanationTraditional: 禁抑制。感情激動得不能控制。強調完全被某種感情所支配。
explanationEn: Unable to control one's emotions; completely dominated by feelings.
derivation: 南朝梁·刘遵《七夕穿针》诗步月如有意，情来不自禁。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝梁·劉遵《七夕穿針》詩步月如有意，情來不自禁。”
derivationEn: From Southern Liang Dynasty Liu Zun's poem 'Weaving on the Seventh Night': 'Walking in the moonlight as if with intent, feelings come uncontrollably.'
example: 她又～地放声哭了。★沙汀《一个秋天晚上》
exampleTraditional: 她又～地放聲哭了。★沙汀《一個秋天晚上》
exampleEn: She couldn't help but cry out loud again. — Sha Ting, 'An Autumn Night'

explanation: 足值得。不值得奇怪。指某种事物或现象很平常，没有什么奇怪的。
explanationTraditional: 足值得。不值得奇怪。指某種事物或現象很平常，沒有什麼奇怪的。
explanationEn: Not worth wondering about; not surprising; common or ordinary.
derivation: 宋·毕仲游《祭范德孺文》人乐其大而忘其私，不然则公不足为奇。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·畢仲遊《祭範德孺文》人樂其大而忘其私，不然則公不足為奇。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Bi Zhongyou's 'Sacrificial Essay to Fan Deru': 'People enjoy the great and forget their private interests, otherwise the public is not worth wondering about.'
example: 这些都是小事情，～，不过偶然想到，举例而已。★《鲁迅书信集·致李霁野》
exampleTraditional: 這些都是小事情，～，不過偶然想到，舉例而已。★《魯迅書信集·致李霽野》
exampleEn: These are all trivial matters, not surprising, just occasional thoughts, for example. ★ Lu Xun's 'Letters to Li Jiye'

explanation: 再也忍受不下去了。
explanationTraditional: 再也忍受不下去了。
explanationEn: Cannot bear it any longer; reach the limit of endurance.
derivation: 清·无名氏《官场维新记》第十四回果然那些学生忍无可忍，闹出全班散学的事来了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·無名氏《官場維新記》第十四回果然那些學生忍無可忍，鬧出全班散學的事來了。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, anonymous 'The New Officialdom': 'Sure enough, those students could not bear it any longer and caused the whole class to drop out.'
example: 他在～的情况下，终于出手还击。
exampleTraditional: 他在～的情況下，終於出手還擊。
exampleEn: He finally fought back when he could no longer bear it.

explanation: 专心一意地刻苦工作。
explanationTraditional: 專心一意地刻苦工作。
explanationEn: To bury oneself in hard work; to work diligently and quietly.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文·中国人失掉自信力了吗》我们从古以来，就有埋头苦干的人。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文·中國人失掉自信力了嗎》我們從古以來，就有埋頭苦幹的人。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'Essays in the Semi-concession: Have the Chinese Lost Their Self-confidence?': 'From ancient times, we have had people who bury themselves in hard work.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容草木苍翠茂盛。也形容气势美好蓬勃。
explanationTraditional: 形容草木蒼翠茂盛。也形容氣勢美好蓬勃。
explanationEn: Lush and green; thriving and vigorous (of vegetation or atmosphere).
derivation: 汉·王充《论衡·吉验》城郭郁郁葱葱。”《后汉书·光武纪》望气者至南阳，曰‘气佳哉，郁郁葱葱！”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王充《論衡·吉驗》城郭鬱鬱蔥蔥。”《後漢書·光武紀》望氣者至南陽，曰‘氣佳哉，鬱鬱蔥蔥！”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Wang Chong's 'Lunheng: Auspicious Signs': 'The city walls are lush and green.' 'Book of Later Han: Annals of Emperor Guangwu': 'A qi observer went to Nanyang and said, 'The qi is excellent, lush and green!''
example: 远处是几个农村，丛树和屋舍密集重叠，大有～的气象。★叶圣陶《游泳》
exampleTraditional: 遠處是幾個農村，叢樹和屋舍密集重疊，大有～的氣象。★葉聖陶《游泳》
exampleEn: In the distance were several villages, with clusters of trees and houses overlapping, giving a lush and vigorous atmosphere. ★ Ye Shengtao's 'Swimming'

explanation: 指做事得法，因而费力小，收效大。
explanationTraditional: 指做事得法，因而費力小，收效大。
explanationEn: Half the work, double the result; to achieve more with less effort.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》故事半古之人，功必倍之，惟此时为然。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》故事半古之人，功必倍之，惟此時為然。”
derivationEn: Mencius, 'Gongsun Chou I': 'Thus, if one does half the work of the ancients, one will surely achieve double the results; only at this time is it so.'
example: 如能善用他的特长和经验，比较地容易获得～的效果。（邹韬奋《经历·前途》）
exampleTraditional: 如能善用他的特長和經驗，比較地容易獲得～的效果。（鄒韜奮《經歷·前途》）
exampleEn: If you can make good use of his expertise and experience, it is relatively easy to achieve twice the result with half the effort. (Zou Taofen, 'Experience: The Future')

explanation: 省知觉。指昏迷过去，失去知觉。也指不懂人情世故。
explanationTraditional: 省知覺。指昏迷過去，失去知覺。也指不懂人情世故。
explanationEn: To be unconscious or in a coma; also refers to being ignorant of the ways of the world.
derivation: 宋·汪应辰《与朱元晦》问其无所苦否，则曰‘无事，无事’。寻即不省人事。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·汪應辰《與朱元晦》問其無所苦否，則曰‘無事，無事’。尋即不省人事。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wang Yingchen: 'Asked if he was suffering, he said "Nothing, nothing." Soon after, he became unconscious.'
example: 大作又说我大声疾呼”之后，不过几年，青年就只能说外国话。我以为是～之谈。★鲁迅《集外集拾遗·报奇哉所谓……”》
exampleTraditional: 大作又說我大聲疾呼”之後，不過幾年，青年就只能說外國話。我以為是～之談。★魯迅《集外集拾遺·報奇哉所謂……”》
exampleEn: Your article says that after my 'loud outcry,' within a few years young people can only speak foreign languages. I think this is an unconscious remark. — Lu Xun, 'Collected Works, Supplement: In Response to "How Strange..."'

explanation: 分、别分辨、区别；门一般事物的分类；类许多相似或相同事物的综合。把一些事物按照特性和特征分别归入各种门类。
explanationTraditional: 分、別分辨、區別；門一般事物的分類；類許多相似或相同事物的綜合。把一些事物按照特性和特徵分別歸入各種門類。
explanationEn: To classify or categorize things according to their characteristics and features.
derivation: 清·梁章钜《浪迹丛谈·叶天士遗事》生平不事著述，今惟存《临证指南医案》十卷，亦其门人取其方药治验，分门别类，集为一书。”
derivationTraditional: 清·梁章鉅《浪跡叢談·葉天士遺事》生平不事著述，今惟存《臨證指南醫案》十卷，亦其門人取其方藥治驗，分門別類，集為一書。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Liang Zhangju: 'In his lifetime he did not write books; now only ten volumes of "Clinical Guide Medical Cases" remain, compiled by his disciples who took his prescriptions and treatments, classified them, and collected them into a book.'
example: 我只要现在的时务书，～的便好。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第三十四回
exampleTraditional: 我只要現在的時務書，～的便好。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第三十四回
exampleEn: I just need current affairs books, classified by category, that will do. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 34

explanation: 别另外；心裁心中的设计、筹划。另有一种构思或设计。指想出的办法与众不同。
explanationTraditional: 別另外；心裁心中的設計、籌劃。另有一種構思或設計。指想出的辦法與眾不同。
explanationEn: To have a different idea or design; to come up with a method that is different from the norm.
derivation: 明·李贽《水浒全书发凡》今别出心裁，不依旧样，或特标于目外，或叠采于回中。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《水滸全書發凡》今別出心裁，不依舊樣，或特標於目外，或疊採於回中。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Li Zhi: 'Now, with a different idea, not following the old pattern, either specially marked outside the title or repeatedly collected within the chapters.'
example: 只好～，鼓吹女人自杀。★鲁迅《坟·我之节烈观》
exampleTraditional: 只好～，鼓吹女人自殺。★魯迅《墳·我之節烈觀》
exampleEn: They had no choice but to come up with a different idea and advocate for women's suicide. — Lu Xun, 'Tomb: My View on Chastity'

explanation: 清清楚楚，明确无误；正大光明。
explanationTraditional: 清清楚楚，明確無誤；正大光明。
explanationEn: Clearly and unmistakably; open and aboveboard.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第45回账目已明明白白，并无分文来去。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第45回賬目已明明白白，並無分文來去。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 45: 'The accounts were clear and unmistakable, with no discrepancy whatsoever.'
example: 但须不设暗计，～，有手段平空拿我，吾即拜降。★《杨家将演义》第13回
exampleTraditional: 但須不設暗計，～，有手段平空拿我，吾即拜降。★《楊家將演義》第13回
exampleEn: But you must not set up secret schemes; openly and clearly, if you have the skill to capture me empty-handed, I will immediately surrender. — 'The Generals of the Yang Family', Chapter 13

explanation: 热烈的感情充分地流露出来。
explanationTraditional: 熱烈的感情充分地流露出來。
explanationEn: To be brimming with warm feelings; to express enthusiasm effusively.
derivation: 曹靖华《罗汉岭前吊秋白》对全世界来说，这些热情洋溢的报导，正是拨云雾而见青天啊！”
derivationTraditional: 曹靖華《羅漢嶺前吊秋白》對全世界來說，這些熱情洋溢的報導，正是撥雲霧而見青天啊！”
derivationEn: Cao Jinghua, 'At the Luo Han Ridge, Mourning for Qu Qiubai': 'To the whole world, these enthusiastic reports are like clearing the clouds to see the blue sky!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 张陈设，展示；旗鼓旗帜和战鼓。形容进攻的声势和规能大。也形容群众活动声势和规能大。
explanationTraditional: 張陳設，展示；旗鼓旗幟和戰鼓。形容進攻的聲勢和規能大。也形容群眾活動聲勢和規能大。
explanationEn: To make a big show of something; to do something on a large scale with great fanfare.
derivation: 清·张春帆《宦海》第九回李参戎带著这些人陆续出了镇南关，便大张旗鼓，排齐队伍，浩浩荡荡的向前进发。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張春帆《宦海》第九回李參戎帶著這些人陸續出了鎮南關，便大張旗鼓，排齊隊伍，浩浩蕩蕩的向前進發。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Chunfan's 'The Sea of Officialdom', Chapter 9: 'Li Canrong led these people out of Zhennan Pass, then made a big show, lined up the troops, and marched forward with great momentum.'
example: 至于那一部小说，本来当属于古董之部，若要～，颂为二十世纪的新作品，则小子不敏，实不敢也。★鲁迅《书信集·致胡适》
exampleTraditional: 至於那一部小說，本來當屬於古董之部，若要～，頌為二十世紀的新作品，則小子不敏，實不敢也。★魯迅《書信集·致胡適》
exampleEn: As for that novel, it originally belongs to the category of antiques. If one were to make a big show and praise it as a new work of the 20th century, I, being unwise, dare not do so. — Lu Xun, 'Letters to Hu Shi'

explanation: 防防备；胜尽。形容防备不过来。
explanationTraditional: 防防備；勝盡。形容防備不過來。
explanationEn: Impossible to guard against; too many to defend against.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四十七回这种小人，真是防不胜防。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四十七回這種小人，真是防不勝防。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Situations Observed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 47: 'Such petty people are truly impossible to guard against.'
example: 叭儿之类，是不足惧的，最可怕的确是口是心非的所谓战友”，因为～。★鲁迅《致杨霁云信》
exampleTraditional: 叭兒之類，是不足懼的，最可怕的確是口是心非的所謂戰友”，因為～。★魯迅《致楊霽雲信》
exampleEn: Mongrels are not to be feared; what is most frightening are the so-called 'comrades' who are hypocritical, because they are impossible to guard against. — Lu Xun, 'Letter to Yang Jiyun'

explanation: 指受惊后心情还没有平静下来。
explanationTraditional: 指受驚後心情還沒有平靜下來。
explanationEn: Still shaken from a frightening experience; not yet recovered from a shock.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《谢量移汝州表》只影自怜，命寄江湖之上；惊魂未定，梦游缧绁之中。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《謝量移汝州表》隻影自憐，命寄江湖之上；驚魂未定，夢遊縲紲之中。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Xie Yi Ru Zhou Biao': 'My shadow alone pities itself, my life entrusted to rivers and lakes; my frightened soul has not yet calmed, dreaming still of being in chains.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用欺骗的手段逃过关口。
explanationTraditional: 用欺騙的手段逃過關口。
explanationEn: To get by under false pretenses; to slip through by deception.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 你不要希望～。
exampleTraditional: 你不要希望～。
exampleEn: Don't hope to get by under false pretenses.

explanation: 错落参差不齐。致情趣。形容事物的布局虽然参差不齐，但却极有情趣，使人看了有好感。
explanationTraditional: 錯落參差不齊。致情趣。形容事物的佈局雖然參差不齊，但卻極有情趣，使人看了有好感。
explanationEn: Arranged in an interesting and pleasing pattern; well-proportioned despite irregularity.
derivation: 清·张集馨《道咸宦海见闻录》遍山皆青皮古松，不下数百株，太湖石亦高低错落有致，异鸟飞翔，唘音木杪，真蓬莱仙境也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張集馨《道鹹宦海見聞錄》遍山皆青皮古松，不下數百株，太湖石亦高低錯落有致，異鳥飛翔，唘音木杪，真蓬萊仙境也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Jixin's 'Daoxian Huanhai Jianwen Lu': 'The whole mountain is covered with green ancient pines, no less than several hundred; Taihu stones are also arranged in an interesting and pleasing pattern, with exotic birds flying and singing at the treetops, truly a fairyland.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容微小零星。
explanationTraditional: 形容微小零星。
explanationEn: Bit by bit; little by little; every tiny bit.
derivation: 方志敏《可爱的中国·清贫》为革命而筹集的金钱，是一点一滴的用之于革命事业。”
derivationTraditional: 方誌敏《可愛的中國·清貧》為革命而籌集的金錢，是一點一滴的用之於革命事業。”
derivationEn: From Fang Zhimin's 'Lovely China: Honesty': 'The money raised for the revolution is used bit by bit for the revolutionary cause.'
example: 我们要从～的小事做起。
exampleTraditional: 我們要從～的小事做起。
exampleEn: We must start from the little things, bit by bit.

explanation: 敷够，足。收入不够支出。
explanationTraditional: 敷夠，足。收入不夠支出。
explanationEn: Income cannot cover expenses; unable to make ends meet.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百七回但是家计萧条，入不敷出。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百七回但是家計蕭條，入不敷出。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 107: 'But the family is in decline, income cannot cover expenses.'
example: 他家人口太多，收入少，常常～。
exampleTraditional: 他家人口太多，收入少，常常～。
exampleEn: His family has too many people and little income, often unable to make ends meet.

explanation: 素平素，向来。不管人家怎样说，仍旧按照自己平素的一套去做。
explanationTraditional: 素平素，向來。不管人家怎樣說，仍舊按照自己平素的一套去做。
explanationEn: To go one's own way regardless of what others say; to stick to one's own way of doing things.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》君子素其位而行，不愿乎其外。素富贵行乎富贵，素贫贱行乎贫贱，素夷狄行乎夷狄，素患难行乎患难，君子无入而不自得焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》君子素其位而行，不願乎其外。素富貴行乎富貴，素貧賤行乎貧賤，素夷狄行乎夷狄，素患難行乎患難，君子無入而不自得焉。”
derivationEn: From 'The Doctrine of the Mean': 'The gentleman acts according to his position and does not wish to go beyond it. In a wealthy position, he acts as is fitting for wealth; in a poor position, he acts as is fitting for poverty; among barbarians, he acts as is fitting; in adversity, he acts as is fitting. The gentleman can find himself in no situation where he is not at ease with himself.'
example: 笑骂由人笑骂，～而已。★柔石《二月》十
exampleTraditional: 笑罵由人笑罵，～而已。★柔石《二月》十
exampleEn: Let others laugh and scold; I just go my own way. — Rou Shi, 'February', Chapter 10

explanation: 反复深入地考虑。
explanationTraditional: 反覆深入地考慮。
explanationEn: To think deeply and carefully; to deliberate thoroughly.
derivation: 《楚辞·渔父》何故深思高举，自令放为？”《史记·穰侯列传》愿君熟虑之。”
derivationTraditional: 《楚辭·漁父》何故深思高舉，自令放為？”《史記·穰侯列傳》願君熟慮之。”
derivationEn: From 'The Songs of Chu: The Fisherman': 'Why, with deep thought and lofty conduct, do you allow yourself to be banished?' and 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Marquis of Rang': 'I hope you will consider it carefully.'
example: 而其人亦得～，周旋于是，不过十年，将必有卓然可观者也。★宋·苏轼《策别第九》
exampleTraditional: 而其人亦得～，周旋於是，不過十年，將必有卓然可觀者也。★宋·蘇軾《策別第九》
exampleEn: And that person can also think deeply and carefully, maneuvering for about ten years, and then there will surely be remarkable achievements. — Song Dynasty Su Shi, 'Ce Bie Di Jiu'

explanation: 趋快走；鹜野鸭。象鸭子一样成群跑过去。比喻很多人争着赶去。
explanationTraditional: 趨快走；鶩野鴨。象鴨子一樣成群跑過去。比喻很多人爭著趕去。
explanationEn: To flock to something like ducks; to scramble for something eagerly.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十七回京外的官员，那个不趋之若鹜呢！”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十七回京外的官員，那個不趨之若鶩呢！”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 27: 'Which official in the capital would not flock to it like ducks!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 微微细；至到。没有一处细微的地方不照顾到。形容关怀、照顾得非常细心周到。
explanationTraditional: 微微細；至到。沒有一處細微的地方不照顧到。形容關懷、照顧得非常細心周到。
explanationEn: Attending to every detail; showing meticulous care and consideration.
derivation: 宋·魏了翁《辞免督视军马乞以参赞军事从丞相行奏札》臣窃念主忧臣辱，义不得辞，踨蹐受命，退而差辟官吏、条列事目、调遣将士，凡所以为速发之计者，靡微不周。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏了翁《辭免督視軍馬乞以參贊軍事從丞相行奏札》臣竊念主憂臣辱，義不得辭，踨蹐受命，退而差闢官吏、條列事目、調遣將士，凡所以為速發之計者，靡微不周。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wei Liaoweng: 'I humbly think that the ruler's worry is the minister's shame, and I cannot refuse. I accepted the order trembling, and then appointed officials, listed matters, and dispatched generals. Everything that could be done to hasten the plan was attended to without missing the smallest detail.'
example: 还是在剑波十八岁的时候，要到战斗部队去，姐姐对这将要离开自己的弟弟，照顾得～。★曲波《林海雪原》一
exampleTraditional: 還是在劍波十八歲的時候，要到戰鬥部隊去，姐姐對這將要離開自己的弟弟，照顧得～。★曲波《林海雪原》一
exampleEn: When Jianbo was eighteen and about to leave for the combat troops, his sister took care of him with meticulous attention. (Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 1)

explanation: 超出言语以外，指某种思想感情虽未说明却能使人体会出来。
explanationTraditional: 超出言語以外，指某種思想感情雖未說明卻能使人體會出來。
explanationEn: Showing clearly in one's expression or manner; feelings that are evident beyond words.
derivation: 明·朱舜水《答安东守约书三十首》来书十读，不忍释手，真挚之情，溢于言表。”
derivationTraditional: 明·朱舜水《答安東守約書三十首》來書十讀，不忍釋手，真摯之情，溢於言表。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Zhu Shunshui: 'I read your letter ten times and couldn't bear to put it down. Your sincere feelings overflow beyond words.'
example: 农民们互相传说，彼此相告，雀跃的欣喜的心情～。★陈残云《山谷风烟》第七章
exampleTraditional: 農民們互相傳說，彼此相告，雀躍的欣喜的心情～。★陳殘雲《山谷風煙》第七章
exampleEn: The farmers told each other, sharing the news, and their joyful excitement was evident beyond words. (Chen Canyun, 'Wind and Smoke in the Valley', Chapter 7)

explanation: 车象流水，马象游龙。形容来往车马很多，连续不断的热闹情景。
explanationTraditional: 車象流水，馬象游龍。形容來往車馬很多，連續不斷的熱鬧情景。
explanationEn: Heavy traffic; bustling with activity (lit. carriages like flowing water, horses like swimming dragons).
derivation: 《后汉书·明德马皇后纪》前过濯龙门上，见外家问起居者，车如流水，马如游龙。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·明德馬皇后紀》前過濯龍門上，見外家問起居者，車如流水，馬如游龍。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Empress Ma': 'When I passed by the Zhuolong Gate, I saw relatives visiting, with carriages like flowing water and horses like swimming dragons.'
example: 花天酒地，闹个不休，～，日无暇晷。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一回
exampleTraditional: 花天酒地，鬧個不休，～，日無暇晷。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一回
exampleEn: They indulged in pleasure day and night, with endless bustle and traffic, never a moment of rest. (Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 1)

explanation: 同德为同一目的而努力。指思想统一，信念一致。
explanationTraditional: 同德為同一目的而努力。指思想統一，信念一致。
explanationEn: Being of one mind and one purpose; united in thought and action.
derivation: 《尚书·泰誓中》予有乱臣十人，同心同德。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·泰誓中》予有亂臣十人，同心同德。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents: Great Declaration': 'I have ten capable ministers who are of one mind and one purpose.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 适归向；从跟从。不知听从哪一个好。指不知怎么办才好。
explanationTraditional: 適歸向；從跟從。不知聽從哪一個好。指不知怎麼辦才好。
explanationEn: Not knowing which course to follow; being at a loss what to do.
derivation: 《左传·僖公五年》一国三公，吾谁适从。”宋·姚宽《西溪从语》卷上源殊派异，无所适从。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公五年》一國三公，吾誰適從。”宋·姚寬《西溪從語》捲上源殊派異，無所適從。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's Fifth Year': 'With three rulers in one state, whom should I follow?' Song Dynasty, Yao Kuan: 'Different sources and branches, not knowing which to follow.'
example: 某书应读某音，敝处未得高明指教，往往读错，以致后学～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 某書應讀某音，敝處未得高明指教，往往讀錯，以致後學～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十六回
exampleEn: A certain book should be pronounced in a certain way, but without guidance from a master, we often mispronounce it, leaving later students at a loss. (Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 16)

explanation: 厉猛烈。指比原来更加发展。现指情况变得比本来更加严重。
explanationTraditional: 厲猛烈。指比原來更加發展。現指情況變得比本來更加嚴重。
explanationEn: To become even more extreme or aggravated; to intensify (often negatively).
derivation: 南朝·梁·萧统《文选·序》盖踵其事而增华，变其本而加厉，物既有之，文亦宜然。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·蕭統《文選·序》蓋踵其事而增華，變其本而加厲，物既有之，文亦宜然。”
derivationEn: Southern Liang Dynasty, Xiao Tong: 'Following the previous events and adding splendor, changing the original and making it more severe—things have always been so, and literature should be the same.'
example: 断句取义是在一句两句里拉出一个两个字来发挥，比起断章取义，真是～了。★朱自清《经典常谈·诗经第四》
exampleTraditional: 斷句取義是在一句兩句里拉出一個兩個字來發揮，比起斷章取義，真是～了。★朱自清《經典常談·詩經第四》
exampleEn: Taking words out of context by picking a few characters from a sentence is even more extreme than taking passages out of context. (Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Essentials: Book of Songs, Part 4')

explanation: 指勇士手腕被蝮蛇咬伤，就立即截断，以免毒性扩散全身。比喻作事要当机立断，不可迟疑、姑息。
explanationTraditional: 指勇士手腕被蝮蛇咬傷，就立即截斷，以免毒性擴散全身。比喻作事要當機立斷，不可遲疑、姑息。
explanationEn: A brave man cuts off his own wrist when bitten by a viper; to make a prompt decision and resolute action to avoid greater loss.
derivation: 唐·窦皐《述书赋下》君子弃瑕以拔才，壮士断腕以全质。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·竇皐《述書賦下》君子棄瑕以拔才，壯士斷腕以全質。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Dou Gao: 'A gentleman overlooks flaws to promote talent; a brave man cuts off his wrist to preserve his body.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 勃勃旺盛的样子。形容雄心很大，很有理想。
explanationTraditional: 勃勃旺盛的樣子。形容雄心很大，很有理想。
explanationEn: Ambitious and determined; having great aspirations.
derivation: 茅盾《新版后记》最初构思的时候，原也雄心勃勃，打算在我力所能及的广阔画面上把一些最典型的人物事态组织进去。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《新版後記》最初構思的時候，原也雄心勃勃，打算在我力所能及的廣闊畫面上把一些最典型的人物事態組織進去。”
derivationEn: Mao Dun: 'When I first conceived the idea, I was ambitious, planning to organize the most typical characters and events into a broad picture within my ability.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 崭突出；露显露。头上的角已明显地突出来了。指初显露优异的才能。
explanationTraditional: 嶄突出；露顯露。頭上的角已明顯地突出來了。指初顯露優異的才能。
explanationEn: To show one's talent or ability prominently; to stand out (lit. to show one's horns).
derivation: 唐·韩愈《柳子厚墓志铭》虽少年，已自成人，能取进士第，崭然见头角焉。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《柳子厚墓誌銘》雖少年，已自成人，能取進士第，嶄然見頭角焉。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu: 'Although young, he had already become a man, passed the imperial examination, and prominently showed his talent.'
example: 此番吴氏北返，独倡保定会议，无非欲～，力与段派抗衡。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一一五回
exampleTraditional: 此番吳氏北返，獨倡保定會議，無非欲～，力與段派抗衡。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一一五回
exampleEn: This time, Wu returned north and proposed the Baoding Conference, simply wanting to show his talent and compete with the Duan faction. (Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 115)

explanation: 用一个单位或地方的成功经验来带动许多单位或成片地区的工作。
explanationTraditional: 用一個單位或地方的成功經驗來帶動許多單位或成片地區的工作。
explanationEn: To use the successful experience of one unit or place to drive work in many units or a whole area.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为了实际应用而学习。
explanationTraditional: 為了實際應用而學習。
explanationEn: To learn for the purpose of practical application.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 学习科学文化知识要符合实际，学以致用。
exampleTraditional: 學習科學文化知識要符合實際，學以致用。
exampleEn: Learning scientific and cultural knowledge should be practical and aimed at application.

explanation: 对情况和问题有基本的了解，处理事情有一定把握。
explanationTraditional: 對情況和問題有基本的瞭解，處理事情有一定把握。
explanationEn: To have a clear understanding of the situation and be confident in handling matters.
derivation: 冯德英《迎春花》第八章春玲要先同儒春谈一次，摸摸他的底，心中有数，为她去和老东山交锋做准备。”
derivationTraditional: 馮德英《迎春花》第八章春玲要先同儒春談一次，摸摸他的底，心中有數，為她去和老東山交鋒做準備。”
derivationEn: Feng Deying's 'Spring Blossoms' Chapter 8: 'Chunling wanted to talk with Ruchun first to feel him out, have a clear picture in mind, and prepare for her confrontation with Old Dongshan.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指全国各地，有时也指世界各地。现有时也比喻广泛的团结。
explanationTraditional: 指全國各地，有時也指世界各地。現有時也比喻廣泛的團結。
explanationEn: Refers to all parts of the country or the world; sometimes also implies broad unity.
derivation: 《周礼·夏官·职方氏》其浸五湖。”《论语·颜渊》四海之内，皆兄弟也。”唐·吕岩《绝句》斗笠为帆扇作舟，五湖四海任遨游。”
derivationTraditional: 《周禮·夏官·職方氏》其浸五湖。”《論語·顏淵》四海之內，皆兄弟也。”唐·呂岩《絕句》斗笠為帆扇作舟，五湖四海任遨遊。”
derivationEn: 'Rites of Zhou·Summer Officials·Zhifangshi': 'Its waters spread across the five lakes.' 'Analects·Yan Yuan': 'Within the four seas, all are brothers.' Tang·Lü Yan's 'Quatrain': 'Straw hat as sail, fan as boat, roaming freely across the five lakes and four seas.'
example: 我们都是来自～，为了一个共同的革命目标，走到一起来了。★毛泽东《为人民服务》
exampleTraditional: 我們都是來自～，為了一個共同的革命目標，走到一起來了。★毛澤東《為人民服務》
exampleEn: We are all from the five lakes and four seas, gathered together for a common revolutionary goal. — Mao Zedong 'Serve the People'

explanation: 审仔细研究；时时局；度估计；势发展趋势。观察分析时势，估计情况的变化。
explanationTraditional: 審仔細研究；時時局；度估計；勢發展趨勢。觀察分析時勢，估計情況的變化。
explanationEn: To observe and analyze the current situation and estimate its development trends.
derivation: 明·沈德符《万历野获编·乡试遇水火灾》刘欲毕试以完大典，俱审时度势，切中事理。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《萬曆野獲編·鄉試遇水火災》劉欲畢試以完大典，俱審時度勢，切中事理。”
derivationEn: Ming·Shen Defu's 'Wanli Yehuo Bian·Provincial Exam Encounters Fire and Flood': 'Liu wanted to finish the exam to complete the grand ceremony, both assessing the situation and estimating the trends, hitting the crux of the matter.'
example: 大凡士人出处，不可苟且，须～，必可以得行其志，方可一出。（清·禇人获《隋唐演义》第七十八回）
exampleTraditional: 大凡士人出處，不可苟且，須～，必可以得行其志，方可一出。（清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》第七十八回）
exampleEn: A scholar's conduct should not be careless; one must assess the situation and estimate the trends, and only act when one's ambitions can be realized. — Qing·Chu Renhuo 'Sui and Tang Romance' Chapter 78

explanation: 择选择。指为了达到目的，什么手段都使得出来。
explanationTraditional: 擇選擇。指為了達到目的，什麼手段都使得出來。
explanationEn: To stop at nothing to achieve one's goal.
derivation: 鲁迅《三闲集·通信》要谋生，谋生之道，则不择手段。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《三閒集·通信》要謀生，謀生之道，則不擇手段。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'Three Leisures·Correspondence': 'To make a living, the way to make a living is to stop at nothing.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 大幅度地起落。形容变化大。
explanationTraditional: 大幅度地起落。形容變化大。
explanationEn: To rise and fall dramatically; describes great changes.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》她的喜怒哀乐都是大起大落，整出整落的。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》她的喜怒哀樂都是大起大落，整出整落的。”
derivationEn: Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof': 'Her joys and sorrows were all great rises and falls, whole and complete.'
example: 他的一生多次都是～的。
exampleTraditional: 他的一生多次都是～的。
exampleEn: His life has experienced many great ups and downs.

explanation: 厌嫌。不嫌麻烦。
explanationTraditional: 厭嫌。不嫌麻煩。
explanationEn: Not minding the trouble; to be very patient.
derivation: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一百三十八回评每阅数年，必综叙素臣生子生孙，娶妇嫁女，中科发甲。而读者不厌其烦，甚至一回之中，先后数见，绝无沓冗繁复之病。”
derivationTraditional: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一百三十八回評每閱數年，必綜敘素臣生子生孫，娶婦嫁女，中科發甲。而讀者不厭其煩，甚至一回之中，先後數見，絕無沓冗繁複之病。”
derivationEn: Qing·Xia Jingqu's 'A Country Codger's Words of Exposure' Chapter 138 commentary: 'Every few years, it must summarize Su Wen's sons and grandsons, marriages, and official successes. Yet readers do not tire of it, even within one chapter appearing several times without any sense of redundancy or complexity.'
example: 今之史学则异是，必致谨于闾阎日用之细，起居笑貌之琐，～，不嫌其鄙。★清·严复《道学外传》
exampleTraditional: 今之史學則異是，必致謹於閭閻日用之細，起居笑貌之瑣，～，不嫌其鄙。★清·嚴復《道學外傳》
exampleEn: Modern historiography is different; it must be meticulous about the trivial details of daily life, the minutiae of living and laughing, without tiring of it or despising its vulgarity. — Qing·Yan Fu 'Biography of a Taoist Scholar'

explanation: 比喻说话直截了当，切中要害。
explanationTraditional: 比喻說話直截了當，切中要害。
explanationEn: To hit the nail on the head; to speak directly and to the point.
derivation: 毛泽东《反对党八股》这不是把我们的毛病讲得一针见血么？不错，党八股中中国有，外国也有，可见是通病。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《反對黨八股》這不是把我們的毛病講得一針見血麼？不錯，黨八股中中國有，外國也有，可見是通病。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing': 'Isn't this hitting the nail on the head about our faults? Yes, stereotyped Party writing exists in China and abroad, so it's a common disease.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 四面八方都有路可通。形容交通极便利。也形容通向各方。
explanationTraditional: 四面八方都有路可通。形容交通極便利。也形容通向各方。
explanationEn: To have roads leading in all directions; describes very convenient transportation or access to all sides.
derivation: 《子华子·晏子问党》其途之所出，四通而八达，游士之所凑也。”
derivationTraditional: 《子華子·晏子問黨》其途之所出，四通而八達，遊士之所湊也。”
derivationEn: 'Zihua Zi·Yanzi Asks About the Party': 'The roads leading out are four-way and eight-directional, where wandering scholars gather.'
example: 滑台～，非帝王之所居。★《晋书·慕容德载记》
exampleTraditional: 滑臺～，非帝王之所居。★《晉書·慕容德載記》
exampleEn: Huatai is accessible in all directions, not a place for emperors and kings. — 'Book of Jin·Biography of Murong De'

explanation: 开打开，解开；交相错，纠缠。形容没法解开或摆脱。
explanationTraditional: 開打開，解開；交相錯，糾纏。形容沒法解開或擺脫。
explanationEn: To be unable to untangle or get rid of; describes a situation that is impossible to resolve or escape.
derivation: 清·姬文《市声》第二十四回两口子正在吵得不可开交。”
derivationTraditional: 清·姬文《市聲》第二十四回兩口子正在吵得不可開交。”
derivationEn: Qing·Ji Wen's 'Market Voice' Chapter 24: 'The couple was quarreling so fiercely that they couldn't be separated.'
example: 倘一加人为，一办”，那就舆论沸腾，～了。★鲁迅《而已集·谈所谓大内档案”》
exampleTraditional: 倘一加人為，一辦”，那就輿論沸騰，～了。★魯迅《而已集·談所謂大內檔案”》
exampleEn: If one adds 'artificial' or 'official', then public opinion will boil over and become inextricable. — Lu Xun 'And That's That·On the So-called 'Grand Archives''

explanation: 春天气候温暖，百花盛开，景色优美。比喻游览、观赏的大好时机。
explanationTraditional: 春天氣候溫暖，百花盛開，景色優美。比喻遊覽、觀賞的大好時機。
explanationEn: In spring, the weather is warm and flowers bloom, creating beautiful scenery. It metaphorically refers to a great time for sightseeing and enjoyment.
derivation: 明·朱国祯《涌幢小品·南内》春暖花开，命中贵陪内阁儒臣宴赏。
derivationTraditional: 明·朱國禎《湧幢小品·南內》春暖花開，命中貴陪內閣儒臣宴賞。
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Zhu Guozhen's 'Yongchuang Xiaopin · Nan Nei': 'In warm spring with flowers blooming, the emperor ordered eunuchs to accompany cabinet ministers for a banquet and sightseeing.'
example: ～，我好引着孩子们园里做活。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第40回
exampleTraditional: ～，我好引著孩子們園裡做活。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第40回
exampleEn: 'In warm spring with flowers blooming, I will lead the children to work in the garden.' — Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan's 'Qiludeng', Chapter 40

explanation: 经规范，原则；义正理。天地间历久不变的常道。指绝对正确，不能改变的道理。也指理所当然的事。
explanationTraditional: 經規範，原則；義正理。天地間歷久不變的常道。指絕對正確，不能改變的道理。也指理所當然的事。
explanationEn: An unchanging principle that is absolutely correct and natural, referring to something that is理所当然 (taken for granted) or universally accepted.
derivation: 《左传·昭公二十五年》夫礼，天之经也，地之义也，民之行也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公二十五年》夫禮，天之經也，地之義也，民之行也。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan · Duke Zhao's 25th Year': 'Ritual is the constant principle of heaven, the proper way of earth, and the conduct of the people.'
example: 学好科学文化知识是每个学生～的事。
exampleTraditional: 學好科學文化知識是每個學生～的事。
exampleEn: It is a matter of course for every student to learn scientific and cultural knowledge well.

explanation: 一直拖在那里，没有得到解决。
explanationTraditional: 一直拖在那裡，沒有得到解決。
explanationEn: Remaining unresolved or pending for a long time.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 像一窝蜂似地一拥而来。形容很多人乱哄哄地朝一个地方聚拢。
explanationTraditional: 像一窩蜂似地一擁而來。形容很多人亂哄哄地朝一個地方聚攏。
explanationEn: To swarm in like a hive of bees; describing a large crowd of people rushing to a place in a disorderly manner.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二十六回徐承志等他去远，刚要回船，前面尘头滚滚，喊声渐近，又来许多草寇。个个头戴浩然巾，手机器械，蜂拥而至。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二十六回徐承志等他去遠，剛要回船，前面塵頭滾滾，喊聲漸近，又來許多草寇。個個頭戴浩然巾，手機器械，蜂擁而至。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Jinghua Yuan', Chapter 26: 'Xu Chengzhi waited until they were far away, then was about to return to the boat, when dust rose ahead and shouts drew near, as many more bandits came, each wearing a haoran scarf, carrying weapons, and swarming in.'
example: 该处七哨匪徒，不下数十万人，每聚众时，用牛角一吹，无不～。★清·林则徐《筹办永昌哨匪起程日期折》
exampleTraditional: 該處七哨匪徒，不下數十萬人，每聚眾時，用牛角一吹，無不～。★清·林則徐《籌辦永昌哨匪起程日期折》
exampleEn: The bandits in that area, numbering no less than hundreds of thousands, whenever they gather, blow a horn and swarm in. — Qing Dynasty, Lin Zexu's 'Memorial on the Bandit Uprising in Yongchang'

explanation: 一句话也不说。
explanationTraditional: 一句話也不說。
explanationEn: Not saying a single word; remaining completely silent.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷一三巧儿听说丈夫把她休了，一言不发，啼哭起来。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷一三巧兒聽說丈夫把她休了，一言不發，啼哭起來。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 1: 'When Sanqiao'er heard that her husband had divorced her, she did not say a word and began to cry.'
example: 只见她～，回手拔出那把刀来。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第七回
exampleTraditional: 只見她～，回手拔出那把刀來。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第七回
exampleEn: She did not say a word, but turned back and drew the knife. — Qing Dynasty, Wenkang's 'The Story of a Heroic Girl', Chapter 7

explanation: 大模大样地径自走了。
explanationTraditional: 大模大樣地徑自走了。
explanationEn: To leave in a swaggering manner, without caring about others.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十二回（道士）道‘……千万不可照正面，只照背面，要紧，要紧！三日后我来收取，管叫你病好。’说毕，徉长而去。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十二回（道士）道‘……千萬不可照正面，只照背面，要緊，要緊！三日後我來收取，管叫你病好。’說畢，徉長而去。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 12: 'The Taoist said, '...Never look at the front, only the back. It's important! I'll come back in three days to collect it, and it will cure your illness.' Then he swaggered off.'
example: 说罢，深深一揖，～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一回
exampleTraditional: 說罷，深深一揖，～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一回
exampleEn: After saying this, he made a deep bow and swaggered off. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 1

explanation: 水落下去，水底的石头就露出来。比喻事情的真相完全显露出来。
explanationTraditional: 水落下去，水底的石頭就露出來。比喻事情的真相完全顯露出來。
explanationEn: When the water recedes, the stones emerge. Metaphorically, the truth of a matter becomes fully revealed.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《醉翁亭记》野芳发而幽香，佳木秀而繁阴，风霜高洁，水落而石出者，山间之四时也。”宋·苏轼《后赤壁赋》山高月小，水落石出。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《醉翁亭記》野芳發而幽香，佳木秀而繁陰，風霜高潔，水落而石出者，山間之四時也。”宋·蘇軾《後赤壁賦》山高月小，水落石出。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Ouyang Xiu's 'The Story of the Drunkard's Pavilion': 'Wild flowers bloom with fragrance, fine trees grow luxuriantly, the wind and frost are clear, and when the water recedes, the stones emerge—these are the four seasons in the mountains.' Also, Su Shi's 'Later Ode to the Red Cliff': 'The mountain is high and the moon small; when the water recedes, the stones emerge.'
example: 水山，不要急。事情早晚能弄个～。★冯德英《迎春花》第二十章
exampleTraditional: 水山，不要急。事情早晚能弄個～。★馮德英《迎春花》第二十章
exampleEn: Shuishan, don't worry. Things will eventually be clarified. — Feng Deying's 'Spring Flowers', Chapter 20

explanation: 开阔视野，增回见识。
explanationTraditional: 開闊視野，增回見識。
explanationEn: To broaden one's horizons and increase one's knowledge.
derivation: 唐·李瀎《松窗杂录·楚几》光业马上取笔答之，曰‘大开眼界莫言冤。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李瀎《松窗雜錄·楚幾》光業馬上取筆答之，曰‘大開眼界莫言冤。’”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Mo's 'Songchuang Zalu · Chu Ji': 'Guangye immediately took a brush and replied, saying, 'Don't complain about broadening your horizons.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 边唱歌，边跳舞。形容尽情欢乐。
explanationTraditional: 邊唱歌，邊跳舞。形容盡情歡樂。
explanationEn: Singing and dancing simultaneously; describing great joy and celebration.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 春节晚会上，穿着节日盛装的各族代表，在舞台上翩翩起舞，欢庆节日。
exampleTraditional: 春節晚會上，穿著節日盛裝的各族代表，在舞臺上翩翩起舞，歡慶節日。
exampleEn: At the Spring Festival gala, representatives of various ethnic groups in festive costumes danced gracefully on stage, celebrating the festival.

explanation: 子虚并非真实；乌有哪有。指假设的、不存在的、不真实的事情。
explanationTraditional: 子虛並非真實；烏有哪有。指假設的、不存在的、不真實的事情。
explanationEn: Refers to something that is fictitious, nonexistent, or unreal.
derivation: 汉·司马相如著《子虚赋》楚使子虚使于齐，王悉发车骑，与使者出畋。畋罢，子虚过奼乌有先生，亡是公存焉。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬相如著《子虛賦》楚使子虛使於齊，王悉發車騎，與使者出畋。畋罷，子虛過奼烏有先生，亡是公存焉。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Sima Xiangru's 'Zixu Fu': 'The envoy of Chu, Zixu, went to Qi. The king of Qi sent all his chariots and horsemen to hunt with the envoy. After the hunt, Zixu visited Master Wuyou and Sir Wangshi.'
example: 文贵征实，不蕲于振奇，所以愧文士～之习也。（清·沈惟贤《万国演义序》）
exampleTraditional: 文貴徵實，不蘄于振奇，所以愧文士～之習也。（清·沈惟賢《萬國演義序》）
exampleEn: Literature values factual evidence, not exaggeration; thus it shames the habit of literati to fabricate fictitious stories. — Qing Dynasty, Shen Weixian's 'Preface to the Universal History'

explanation: 了明白；指掌指着手掌。形容对事物了解得非常清楚，象把东西放在手掌里给人家看一样。
explanationTraditional: 了明白；指掌指著手掌。形容對事物瞭解得非常清楚，象把東西放在手掌裡給人家看一樣。
explanationEn: To understand something very clearly, as if showing it in the palm of one's hand.
derivation: 《论语·八佾》或问秂之说。子曰‘不知也；知其说者之于天下也，其如示诸斯乎！’指其掌。”何晏集解引包咸曰孔子谓或人言知秂礼之说者，于天下之事，如指示掌中之物，言其易了。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·八佾》或問秂之說。子曰‘不知也；知其說者之於天下也，其如示諸斯乎！’指其掌。”何晏集解引包鹹曰孔子謂或人言知秂禮之說者，於天下之事，如指示掌中之物，言其易了。”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius: 'Someone asked about the theory of the di sacrifice. Confucius said, "I do not know. One who knows it would see the world as clearly as this" — pointing to his palm.'
example: 只这一相形之下，美丑高低，便～了。★闻一多《冬夜评论》
exampleTraditional: 只這一相形之下，美醜高低，便～了。★聞一多《冬夜評論》
exampleEn: With this comparison, the difference between beauty and ugliness, high and low, becomes as clear as if shown in the palm of one's hand. — Wen Yiduo, 'Winter Night Review'

explanation: 历历清楚，分明的样子。指远方的景物看得清清楚楚，或过去的事情清清楚楚地重现在眼前。
explanationTraditional: 歷歷清楚，分明的樣子。指遠方的景物看得清清楚楚，或過去的事情清清楚楚地重現在眼前。
explanationEn: To see distant scenery clearly or to have past events vividly reappear before one's eyes.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《历历》诗历历开元事，分明在眼前。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《歷歷》詩歷歷開元事，分明在眼前。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Li Li': 'The events of the Kaiyuan era are clear, distinctly before my eyes.'
example: 雾开，峰峦～，登陟有路。★《清史稿·觉罗武默讷传》
exampleTraditional: 霧開，峰巒～，登陟有路。★《清史稿·覺羅武默訥傳》
exampleEn: When the fog lifted, the peaks were clearly visible, and there was a path to climb. — 'Draft History of Qing: Biography of Jueluo Wumone'

explanation: 迁就私情而违反法纪。
explanationTraditional: 遷就私情而違反法紀。
explanationEn: To bend the law to favor personal relationships.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他因～而致身败名裂。
exampleTraditional: 他因～而致身敗名裂。
exampleEn: He ruined his reputation and career by bending the law to favor personal relationships.

explanation: 象风云那样变化不定。比喻时局变化迅速，动向难以预料。
explanationTraditional: 象風雲那樣變化不定。比喻時局變化迅速，動向難以預料。
explanationEn: Constant changes like wind and clouds; metaphor for rapidly changing situations that are hard to predict.
derivation: 南朝·梁·庾信《入彭城馆》诗年代殊之民俗，风云更盛衰。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·庾信《入彭城館》詩年代殊之民俗，風雲更盛衰。”
derivationEn: From Yu Xin's poem 'Entering Pengcheng Inn': 'The customs of the times differ greatly, and the wind and clouds change in prosperity and decline.'
example: 然而那么～的事，恐怕世界上是不多有的，我没有料到，未曾描写，可见我还不很有毒笔”。★鲁迅《三闲集·通信》
exampleTraditional: 然而那麼～的事，恐怕世界上是不多有的，我沒有料到，未曾描寫，可見我還不很有毒筆”。★魯迅《三閒集·通信》
exampleEn: However, such rapidly changing events are rare in the world; I did not anticipate them and failed to describe them, showing that my pen is not poisonous enough. — Lu Xun, 'Three Idle Collections: Correspondence'

explanation: 指廉洁奉公，不循私情。
explanationTraditional: 指廉潔奉公，不循私情。
explanationEn: To be fair, honest, and not corrupt; to uphold integrity without favoritism.
derivation: 清·昭槤《啸亭杂录·金元史》劾其贪酷诸款，而后又言其公正廉洁、惜名器、重士节诸语。”
derivationTraditional: 清·昭槤《嘯亭雜錄·金元史》劾其貪酷諸款，而後又言其公正廉潔、惜名器、重士節諸語。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Zhao Lian's 'Xiaoting Miscellaneous Records: Jin and Yuan Histories': 'He impeached him for corruption and cruelty, but also praised his fairness, integrity, and respect for reputation and scholars.'
example: 他一辈子都要求自己～地做官。
exampleTraditional: 他一輩子都要求自己～地做官。
exampleEn: He always demanded that he be fair and honest in his official career.

explanation: 健康地成长。
explanationTraditional: 健康地成長。
explanationEn: To grow up healthy and strong.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 看到下一代健康活泼地～，为人父母者无不感到十分欣慰。
exampleTraditional: 看到下一代健康活潑地～，為人父母者無不感到十分欣慰。
exampleEn: Seeing the next generation growing up healthy and lively, every parent feels very gratified.

explanation: 千条丝，万条线。原形容一根又一根，数也数不清。现多形容相互之间种种密切而复杂的联系。
explanationTraditional: 千條絲，萬條線。原形容一根又一根，數也數不清。現多形容相互之間種種密切而複雜的聯繫。
explanationEn: Countless threads; metaphor for numerous and complex interconnections.
derivation: 宋·戴石屏《怜薄命》词道旁杨柳依依，千丝万缕，拧不住一分愁绪。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·戴石屏《憐薄命》詞道旁楊柳依依，千絲萬縷，擰不住一分愁緒。”
derivationEn: From Dai Shiping's poem 'Pitying the Thin Life': 'The willows by the roadside are tender, with thousands of threads, unable to hold a single strand of sorrow.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 奋勇向前，不考虑个人安危。
explanationTraditional: 奮勇向前，不考慮個人安危。
explanationEn: To dash forward bravely without considering personal safety.
derivation: 汉·司马迁《报任少卿书》常思奋不顾身以殉国家之急。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬遷《報任少卿書》常思奮不顧身以殉國家之急。”
derivationEn: From Sima Qian's 'Letter to Ren An': 'I often think of risking my life to sacrifice for the nation's urgent needs.'
example: 部下弟子，虽不敢谓久经训练，有勇知方，惟大义所在，却是～。（蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一百十五回）
exampleTraditional: 部下弟子，雖不敢謂久經訓練，有勇知方，惟大義所在，卻是～。（蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一百十五回）
exampleEn: Although my subordinates dare not claim to be well-trained and wise, when it comes to righteousness, they will risk their lives without hesitation. — Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 115

explanation: 原指描绘时用浅淡的颜色轻轻地着笔。现多指说话写文章把重要问题轻轻带过。
explanationTraditional: 原指描繪時用淺淡的顏色輕輕地著筆。現多指說話寫文章把重要問題輕輕帶過。
explanationEn: Originally meaning to paint lightly in pale colors; now refers to treating important issues lightly in speech or writing.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四十八回臬台见他说得这等轻描淡写，更是着急。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四十八回臬臺見他說得這等輕描淡寫，更是著急。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 48: 'The provincial judge, seeing him speak so lightly, became even more anxious.'
example: 写文章该详的地方要详，不可～。
exampleTraditional: 寫文章該詳的地方要詳，不可～。
exampleEn: When writing an article, important parts should be detailed, not treated lightly.

explanation: 缘缘分。不可分解的缘分。比喻不能解脱的联系或关系。
explanationTraditional: 緣緣分。不可分解的緣分。比喻不能解脫的聯繫或關係。
explanationEn: An indissoluble bond; a connection that cannot be broken.
derivation: 《古诗十九首》文彩双鸳鸯，裁为合欢被，著以长相思，缘以结不解。”
derivationTraditional: 《古詩十九首》文彩雙鴛鴦，裁為合歡被，著以長相思，緣以結不解。”
derivationEn: From 'Nineteen Ancient Poems': 'The colorful mandarin ducks are cut into a quilt of union, filled with everlasting longing, tied with a knot that cannot be undone.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 又像是有意的，又像是无意的。存心与不经意。
explanationTraditional: 又像是有意的，又像是無意的。存心與不經意。
explanationEn: Seemingly intentional yet unintentional; both deliberate and casual.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·文学》庾子嵩作意赋成，从子文康见，问曰若有意邪？非赋之所尽，若无意邪？复何所赋？答曰正在有意无意之间。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·文學》庾子嵩作意賦成，從子文康見，問曰若有意邪？非賦之所盡，若無意邪？復何所賦？答曰正在有意無意之間。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' of the Southern Dynasties: Yu Zisong finished his rhapsody, and his nephew Wenkang asked, 'If it is intentional, it cannot be fully expressed in a rhapsody; if unintentional, what is there to write?' He replied, 'It lies precisely between intentional and unintentional.'
example: 若以～可解不可解间求之，不免此诗第一耳。”★明·王世贞《艺苑卮言》卷四
exampleTraditional: 若以～可解不可解間求之，不免此詩第一耳。”★明·王世貞《藝苑卮言》卷四
exampleEn: If one seeks it between intentional and unintentional, between explicable and inexplicable, this poem is the first.' — Wang Shizhen, 'Yiyuan Zhiyan'

explanation: 顾看；义意义，含义。从名称想到所包含的意义。
explanationTraditional: 顧看；義意義，含義。從名稱想到所包含的意義。
explanationEn: Seeing the name, one thinks of its meaning; to understand something from its name.
derivation: 《三国志·魏书·王昶传》欲使汝曹顾名思义，不敢违越也。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏書·王昶傳》欲使汝曹顧名思義，不敢違越也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Wang Chang': 'I want you to think of the meaning when you see the name, and not dare to violate it.'
example: 桂花蝉～，想是香味如桂花，或因桂花开时乃有，未详。★鲁迅《两地书》七七
exampleTraditional: 桂花蟬～，想是香味如桂花，或因桂花開時乃有，未詳。★魯迅《兩地書》七七
exampleEn: The osmanthus cicada, as its name suggests, is thought to have a fragrance like osmanthus, or perhaps it appears when osmanthus blooms; details unknown.' — Lu Xun, 'Two Places'

explanation: 形容说话或表演精彩生动。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話或表演精彩生動。
explanationEn: Vivid and dramatic; full of sound and color, describing lively speech or performance.
derivation: 清·洪亮吉《北江诗话》卷一写月有声有色如此，后人复何着笔耶？”
derivationTraditional: 清·洪亮吉《北江詩話》卷一寫月有聲有色如此，後人復何著筆耶？”
derivationEn: From Hong Liangji's 'Beijiang Poetry Talks' of the Qing Dynasty: 'To write about the moon with such sound and color, how can later writers surpass it?'
example: 叙得头头是道，已经不易，叙得～，更难。★朱自清《经典常谈·春秋三传第六》
exampleTraditional: 敘得頭頭是道，已經不易，敘得～，更難。★朱自清《經典常談·春秋三傳第六》
exampleEn: To narrate methodically is already not easy; to narrate vividly and dramatically is even harder.' — Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Introductions'

explanation: 流离转徒离散。无处安身，到处流浪。
explanationTraditional: 流離轉徒離散。無處安身，到處流浪。
explanationEn: To wander about homeless; displaced and without shelter.
derivation: 《汉书·薛广德传》窃见关东困极，人民流离。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·薛廣德傳》竊見關東困極，人民流離。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Xue Guangde': 'I see that the east is in extreme distress, and the people are displaced.'
example: 年荒劫大，百姓们不是离家逃荒，～，便是等待饿死。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleTraditional: 年荒劫大，百姓們不是離家逃荒，～，便是等待餓死。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleEn: In years of famine and disaster, the common people either left their homes to flee famine, wandering homeless, or waited to starve to death.' — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng'

explanation: 诸众多；此这，这样。象这类的各种事物。
explanationTraditional: 諸眾多；此這，這樣。象這類的各種事物。
explanationEn: Things of this kind; and so on; and suchlike.
derivation: 《晋书·刘颂传》诸如此类 ，亦不得已已。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·劉頌傳》諸如此類 ，亦不得已已。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Liu Song': 'Things of this kind are unavoidable.'
example: 书法、绘画、吟诗，～，他无一不会。
exampleTraditional: 書法、繪畫、吟詩，～，他無一不會。
exampleEn: Calligraphy, painting, poetry recitation—things of this kind—he is proficient in all.'

explanation: 十分清楚、明白。
explanationTraditional: 十分清楚、明白。
explanationEn: Perfectly clear; very obvious.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》小顺儿样样事情都要闹个一清二楚，不然怎么能当好妈妈的保镖呢。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》小順兒樣樣事情都要鬧個一清二楚，不然怎麼能當好媽媽的保鏢呢。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof': 'Little Shun'er had to understand everything perfectly clear; otherwise, how could he be a good bodyguard for his mother?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 万众一心，象坚固的城墙一样不可摧毁。比喻团结一致，力量无比强大。
explanationTraditional: 萬眾一心，象堅固的城牆一樣不可摧毀。比喻團結一致，力量無比強大。
explanationEn: Unity is strength; a united people is as strong as a fortress.
derivation: 《国语·周语下》众心成城，众口铄金。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·周語下》眾心成城，眾口鑠金。”
derivationEn: From 'Guoyu: Zhouyu II': 'A united will becomes a city; unanimous opinion melts metal.'
example: 段祺瑞既得国务员同情，便以为～，正可一战。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第八十八回
exampleTraditional: 段祺瑞既得國務員同情，便以為～，正可一戰。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第八十八回
exampleEn: Once Duan Qirui gained the sympathy of his cabinet colleagues, he thought that with unity of purpose they could fight a battle.' — Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China'

explanation: 扶扶助，照料。抢救生命垂危的人，照顾受伤的人。现形容医务工作者全心全意为人民服务的精神。
explanationTraditional: 扶扶助，照料。搶救生命垂危的人，照顧受傷的人。現形容醫務工作者全心全意為人民服務的精神。
explanationEn: To rescue the dying and heal the injured; to provide medical care.
derivation: 汉·司马迁《报任少卿书》与单于连战，十有余日，所杀过半当，虏救死扶伤不给。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬遷《報任少卿書》與單于連戰，十有餘日，所殺過半當，虜救死扶傷不給。”
derivationEn: From Sima Qian's 'Letter to Ren An': 'They fought with the Chanyu for over ten days, killing more than half of the enemy, so that the enemy had no time to rescue their dying and heal their injured.'
example: 做外科医生的能够以肉补肉，以血补血，则～，造福人群，岂不大哉！★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十四章
exampleTraditional: 做外科醫生的能夠以肉補肉，以血補血，則～，造福人群，豈不大哉！★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十四章
exampleEn: A surgeon who can replace flesh with flesh and blood with blood, thus rescuing the dying and healing the injured for the benefit of humanity—isn't that great!' — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng'

explanation: 寐睡着。做梦的时候都在追求。形容迫切地期望着。
explanationTraditional: 寐睡著。做夢的時候都在追求。形容迫切地期望著。
explanationEn: To yearn for something even in dreams; to crave something intensely.
derivation: 《诗经·周南·关雎》窈窕淑女，寤寐求之。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周南·關雎》窈窕淑女，寤寐求之。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Zhou Nan: Guan Ju': 'A graceful and virtuous lady, he seeks her even in sleep.'
example: 这一切，也正是鲁迅所～并终生为之奋斗的！★茅盾《联系实际，学习鲁迅》
exampleTraditional: 這一切，也正是魯迅所～並終生為之奮鬥的！★茅盾《聯繫實際，學習魯迅》
exampleEn: All of this was exactly what Lu Xun yearned for even in his dreams and fought for all his life!' — Mao Dun, 'Connect with Reality, Learn from Lu Xun'

explanation: 逍遥优游自得的样子。指犯法的人没有受到法律制裁，仍然自由自在。
explanationTraditional: 逍遙優遊自得的樣子。指犯法的人沒有受到法律制裁，仍然自由自在。
explanationEn: To go unpunished; to be at large (of criminals).
derivation: 巴金《探索集·再说小骗子》那些造神召鬼、制造冤案、虚报产量、逼死人命等等、等等的大骗子是不会长期逍遥法外的。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《探索集·再說小騙子》那些造神召鬼、製造冤案、虛報產量、逼死人命等等、等等的大騙子是不會長期逍遙法外的。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin's 'Exploration Collection: More on Little Swindlers': 'Those big swindlers who create gods and ghosts, fabricate cases, inflate production figures, and cause deaths will not escape the law forever.'
example: 这些该死的反动派，当然也抓到一些，可是总还有～的。★丁玲《粮秣主任》
exampleTraditional: 這些該死的反動派，當然也抓到一些，可是總還有～的。★丁玲《糧秣主任》
exampleEn: Of course, some of these damned reactionaries were caught, but there were always those who remained at large.' — Ding Ling, 'The Grain Officer'

explanation: 按捺压抑，忍耐。心里急燥，克制不住。
explanationTraditional: 按捺壓抑，忍耐。心裡急燥，剋制不住。
explanationEn: Unable to restrain oneself; too agitated to control one's emotions.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言·白娘子水镇雷峰塔》不想遇着许宣……按捺不住，一时冒范天条。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言·白娘子水鎮雷峰塔》不想遇著許宣……按捺不住，一時冒範天條。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World': 'Unexpectedly meeting Xu Xuan... unable to restrain himself, he momentarily violated the heavenly laws.'
example: 他一听这话，一股无名火直往上窜，无论如何也～。
exampleTraditional: 他一聽這話，一股無名火直往上竄，無論如何也～。
exampleEn: Upon hearing this, a surge of inexplicable anger rose within him, and he could no longer restrain himself.

explanation: 信誓表示诚意的誓言；旦旦诚恳的样子。誓言说得真实可信。
explanationTraditional: 信誓表示誠意的誓言；旦旦誠懇的樣子。誓言說得真實可信。
explanationEn: To make a solemn and sincere vow; to pledge in all earnestness.
derivation: 《诗经·卫风·氓》言笑晏晏，信誓旦旦。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·衛風·氓》言笑晏晏，信誓旦旦。”
derivationEn: From the 'Book of Songs: Odes of Wei': 'With smiles and pleasant words, he swore solemn oaths.'
example: 臣乃脉定于内，心正于怀，～，秉志不回，翻然高举，与彼长辞。★鲁迅《汉文学史纲要》第十篇
exampleTraditional: 臣乃脈定於內，心正於懷，～，秉志不回，翻然高舉，與彼長辭。★魯迅《漢文學史綱要》第十篇
exampleEn: I am calm within, upright in heart, solemn in my vows, unwavering in my resolve, soaring high and bidding farewell to them forever. — Lu Xun, 'Outline of Chinese Literary History', Chapter 10

explanation: 没法计算数目。形容很多。
explanationTraditional: 沒法計算數目。形容很多。
explanationEn: Countless; too many to be counted.
derivation: 宋·魏了翁《奏措京湖诸郡》或谓官民兵在城内者约二十万，而散在四郊者，不计其数。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏了翁《奏措京湖諸郡》或謂官民兵在城內者約二十萬，而散在四郊者，不計其數。”
derivationEn: From Wei Liaoweng's 'Memorial on Managing Jinghu': 'It is said that the officials, militia, and civilians within the city number about two hundred thousand, while those scattered in the suburbs are countless.'
example: 去州桥河内周围上下点灯，～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十六回
exampleTraditional: 去州橋河內周圍上下點燈，～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十六回
exampleEn: Lamps were lit all around the river near the state bridge, countless in number. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 66

explanation: 少一样也不行。
explanationTraditional: 少一樣也不行。
explanationEn: Not a single one can be omitted; all are indispensable.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第二十回林冲道‘只今番克敌制胜，便见得先生妙法。正是鼎分三足，缺一不可，先生不必推却。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第二十回林沖道‘只今番克敵制勝，便見得先生妙法。正是鼎分三足，缺一不可，先生不必推卻。’”
derivationEn: From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 20: 'Lin Chong said, 'This time we will defeat the enemy and win, showing the master's wonderful strategy. It is like a tripod with three legs—not one can be missing. Master, please do not decline.''
example: 每个学生都要德智体全面发展，三者～。
exampleTraditional: 每個學生都要德智體全面發展，三者～。
exampleEn: Every student must develop morally, intellectually, and physically; none of the three can be omitted.

explanation: 原为道教用语。指修道者得道以后，就转凡胎为圣胎，换凡骨为仙骨。现比喻通过教育，思想得到彻底改造。
explanationTraditional: 原為道教用語。指修道者得道以後，就轉凡胎為聖胎，換凡骨為仙骨。現比喻通過教育，思想得到徹底改造。
explanationEn: Originally a Daoist term meaning to be reborn with a new body; now used metaphorically to describe a fundamental transformation of one's thinking through education.
derivation: 宋·释惠洪《冷斋夜话》卷一然不易其意而造其语，谓之换骨法；窥入其意而形容之，谓之夺胎法。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋惠洪《冷齋夜話》卷一然不易其意而造其語，謂之換骨法；窺入其意而形容之，謂之奪胎法。”
derivationEn: From Shi Huihong's 'Night Talks in a Cold Studio', Volume 1: 'To use the same meaning but create new wording is called the method of changing bones; to delve into the meaning and describe it is called the method of seizing the womb.'
example: 那长老自服了草还丹，真是～，神爽体健。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 那長老自服了草還丹，真是～，神爽體健。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十七回
exampleEn: After taking the herb of immortality, the elder was truly reborn, refreshed in spirit and strong in body. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 27

explanation: 心意真实诚恳，没有虚假。
explanationTraditional: 心意真實誠懇，沒有虛假。
explanationEn: Genuine and sincere; without pretense.
derivation: 元·无名氏《百花亭》第三折常言道海深须见底，各办着个真心实意。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《百花亭》第三折常言道海深須見底，各辦著個真心實意。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Pavilion of a Hundred Flowers', Act 3: 'As the saying goes, the sea is deep enough to see the bottom; each must act with genuine sincerity.'
example: ～，才能找到知己。
exampleTraditional: ～，才能找到知己。
exampleEn: Only with genuine sincerity can one find a true friend.

explanation: 簿文状、起诉书之类；对簿受审问；公堂旧指官吏审理案件的地方。在法庭上受审问。
explanationTraditional: 簿文狀、起訴書之類；對簿受審問；公堂舊指官吏審理案件的地方。在法庭上受審問。
explanationEn: To be interrogated in court; to face legal proceedings.
derivation: 《史记·李将军列传》大将军使长史急责广之幕府对簿。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·李將軍列傳》大將軍使長史急責廣之幕府對簿。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of General Li': 'The Grand General sent his chief clerk to urgently summon Li Guang's headquarters to face interrogation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指不辜负别人的差使。
explanationTraditional: 指不辜負別人的差使。
explanationEn: To fulfill one's mission without disgrace; to live up to the trust placed in one.
derivation: 郭沫若《洪波曲》第三章六寿昌大笑起来，掉头对着立群说‘不辱使命！’”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《洪波曲》第三章六壽昌大笑起來，掉頭對著立群說‘不辱使命！’”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'Hongbo Qu', Chapter 3, Section 6: 'Shouchang laughed heartily, turned to Liqun and said, 'I have not disgraced my mission!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指大风大雨。亦比喻猛烈的声势或处境险恶。
explanationTraditional: 指大風大雨。亦比喻猛烈的聲勢或處境險惡。
explanationEn: Violent wind and rain; also metaphorically refers to a fierce situation or perilous circumstances.
derivation: 《老子》第二十三章故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第二十三章故飄風不終朝，驟雨不終日。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi', Chapter 23: 'Therefore, a whirlwind does not last a whole morning, and a sudden rain does not last a whole day.'
example: 却遇了一阵～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》
exampleTraditional: 卻遇了一陣～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》
exampleEn: But they encountered a violent storm. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years'

explanation: 复再，又。过了一天又一天。比喻日子久，时间长。也形容光阴白白地过去。
explanationTraditional: 復再，又。過了一天又一天。比喻日子久，時間長。也形容光陰白白地過去。
explanationEn: Day after day; over a long period of time; also describes time passing idly.
derivation: 《后汉书·光武帝纪》天下重器，常恐不任，日复一日，安敢远期十岁乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·光武帝紀》天下重器，常恐不任，日復一日，安敢遠期十歲乎？”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Emperor Guangwu': 'The empire is a heavy vessel, and I often fear I cannot bear it. Day after day, how dare I hope for ten years?'
example: 年复一年，～，生涯几何，宁堪此弃掷哉？★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷一
exampleTraditional: 年復一年，～，生涯幾何，寧堪此棄擲哉？★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷一
exampleEn: Year after year, day after day, how long can life last? How can one bear to waste it like this? — Qing Dynasty, anonymous, 'Du Shi Yan Zhi', Volume 1

explanation: 苍苍灰白色。头发灰白。形容人的苍老。
explanationTraditional: 蒼蒼灰白色。頭髮灰白。形容人的蒼老。
explanationEn: Describes an old person with gray or white hair, indicating advanced age.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《祭十二郎文》吾年未四十，而视茫茫，而发苍苍，而齿牙动摇。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《祭十二郎文》吾年未四十，而視茫茫，而發蒼蒼，而齒牙動搖。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Sacrificial Essay to the Twelfth Lang' in Tang Dynasty: 'I am not yet forty, but my vision is dim, my hair is gray, and my teeth are loose.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容风景优美。
explanationTraditional: 形容風景優美。
explanationEn: Describes a scenic landscape with beautiful mountains and clear waters.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《蓦山溪·赠衡阳陈湘》眉黛敛秋波，尽湖南，山明水秀。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《驀山溪·贈衡陽陳湘》眉黛斂秋波，盡湖南，山明水秀。”
derivationEn: From Huang Tingjian's 'Mountainside Stream: To Chen Xiang of Hengyang' in Song Dynasty: 'Eyebrows like distant hills, autumn waves in eyes, all of Hunan, mountains bright and waters beautiful.'
example: 我的家乡是个～的好地方。
exampleTraditional: 我的家鄉是個～的好地方。
exampleEn: My hometown is a place with beautiful mountains and clear waters.

explanation: 随任凭；欲想要。随着自己的意思，想要干什么就干什么。
explanationTraditional: 隨任憑；欲想要。隨著自己的意思，想要幹什麼就幹什麼。
explanationEn: To follow one's heart's desires; to do whatever one wants.
derivation: 《论语·为政》七十而从心所欲，不逾矩。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·為政》七十而從心所欲，不逾矩。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius: Wei Zheng': 'At seventy, I could follow my heart's desire without overstepping the bounds.'
example: 我们二人并坐，～的漫谈。★臧克家《老舍永在》
exampleTraditional: 我們二人並坐，～的漫談。★臧克家《老舍永在》
exampleEn: We sat together and chatted freely as we pleased. — From Zang Kejia's 'Lao She Lives Forever'

explanation: 未来情况不能想象。指预料事情会发展到很坏的地步。
explanationTraditional: 未來情況不能想象。指預料事情會發展到很壞的地步。
explanationEn: The future situation is unimaginable; implies that things will develop into a very bad state.
derivation: 清·曾国藩《复吴南屏书》纵使十次速灭，而设一次迁延，则桑梓之患，不堪设想。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾國藩《復吳南屏書》縱使十次速滅，而設一次遷延，則桑梓之患，不堪設想。”
derivationEn: From Zeng Guofan's 'Reply to Wu Nanping' in Qing Dynasty: 'Even if it is extinguished ten times quickly, if there is one delay, the disaster to our homeland would be unimaginable.'
example: 倘使没有这个人来阻拦一下，那天的情形恐将～的了。★巴金《旅途通讯·桂林的受难》
exampleTraditional: 倘使沒有這個人來阻攔一下，那天的情形恐將～的了。★巴金《旅途通訊·桂林的受難》
exampleEn: If that person hadn't stopped it, the situation that day would have been unimaginable. — From Ba Jin's 'Travel Notes: Guilin's Suffering'

explanation: 原形容水势广大的样子◇形容事物的广阔壮大，或前进的人流声势浩大。
explanationTraditional: 原形容水勢廣大的樣子◇形容事物的廣闊壯大，或前進的人流聲勢浩大。
explanationEn: Originally describes vast and mighty water currents; later used to describe grand and powerful movements or large crowds.
derivation: 《尚书·尧典》汤汤洪水方割，荡荡怀山襄陵，浩浩滔天。”宋·范仲淹《岳阳楼记》浩浩荡荡，横夫际涯。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·堯典》湯湯洪水方割，蕩蕩懷山襄陵，浩浩滔天。”宋·范仲淹《岳陽樓記》浩浩蕩蕩，橫夫際涯。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Documents: Canon of Yao': 'The vast floods are cutting off the land, surging around the mountains and covering the hills, rolling on to the sky.' Also from Fan Zhongyan's 'Yueyang Tower' in Song Dynasty: 'The vast waters stretch to the horizon.'
example: 一时只见宁府大殡～，压地银山一般从北而至。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 一時只見寧府大殯～，壓地銀山一般從北而至。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十四回
exampleEn: For a moment, the grand funeral procession of the Ning Mansion came like a silver mountain pressing down from the north. — From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 14

explanation: 叹赞赏；观止看到这里就够了。指赞美所见到的事物好到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 嘆讚賞；觀止看到這裡就夠了。指讚美所見到的事物好到了極點。
explanationEn: To praise something as the ultimate; to acclaim something as the best one has ever seen.
derivation: 《左传·襄公二十九年》德至矣哉，大矣！如天之无不帱也，如地之无不载也。虽甚盛德，其蔑以加於同感于此矣，观止矣。若有他乐，吾不敢请已。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公二十九年》德至矣哉，大矣！如天之無不幬也，如地之無不載也。雖甚盛德，其蔑以加於同感於此矣，觀止矣。若有他樂，吾不敢請已。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The 29th Year of Duke Xiang': 'Virtue is perfect! Great! Like the sky covering everything, like the earth bearing everything. Though there is great virtue, nothing can surpass this. This is the ultimate. If there is other music, I dare not ask for it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 由不得自己，控制不住自己。
explanationTraditional: 由不得自己，控制不住自己。
explanationEn: Unable to control oneself; involuntarily.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第八十一回我也不很记得了，但觉自己身子不由自主，倒象有什么人，拉拉扯扯，要我杀人才好。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第八十一回我也不很記得了，但覺自己身子不由自主，倒象有什麼人，拉拉扯扯，要我殺人才好。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 81: 'I don't remember clearly, but I felt my body involuntarily, as if someone was pulling me to kill.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容没有人能比得上。
explanationTraditional: 形容沒有人能比得上。
explanationEn: Unmatched; the best under heaven; no one can compare.
derivation: 《后汉书·胡广传》试以章奏，安帝以广为天下第一。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·胡廣傳》試以章奏，安帝以廣為天下第一。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Hu Guang': 'When testing memorials, Emperor An considered Hu Guang the best under heaven.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 偿实现、满足。按所希望的那样得到满足。指愿望实现。
explanationTraditional: 償實現、滿足。按所希望的那樣得到滿足。指願望實現。
explanationEn: To have one's wishes fulfilled; to achieve what one desires.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一百一回况且他家里人既然有心弄死他，等如愿以偿之后，贼人心虚，怕人议论，岂有不尽力推在医生身上之理？”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一百一回況且他家裡人既然有心弄死他，等如願以償之後，賊人心虛，怕人議論，豈有不盡力推在醫生身上之理？”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' in Qing Dynasty, Chapter 101: 'Moreover, since his family intended to kill him, after they got their wish, with a guilty conscience, fearing gossip, wouldn't they try to put the blame on the doctor?'
example: 他终于～，考上的北京大学。
exampleTraditional: 他終於～，考上的北京大學。
exampleEn: He finally got his wish and was admitted to Peking University.

explanation: 吸取别人的长处，来弥补自己的不足之处。也泛指在同类事物中吸取这个的长处来弥补那个的短处。
explanationTraditional: 吸取別人的長處，來彌補自己的不足之處。也泛指在同類事物中吸取這個的長處來彌補那個的短處。
explanationEn: To learn from others' strengths to compensate for one's weaknesses; also refers to using the strengths of one thing to make up for the weaknesses of another.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公上》今滕绝长补短，将五十里也，犹可以为善国。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公上》今滕絕長補短，將五十里也，猶可以為善國。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Teng Wen Gong I': 'Now Teng, by cutting off the long and supplementing the short, will have a territory of fifty li, and can still be a good state.'
example: 外来干部和本地干部各有长处，也各有短处，必须互相～，才能有进步。★毛泽东《整顿党的作风》
exampleTraditional: 外來幹部和本地幹部各有長處，也各有短處，必須互相～，才能有進步。★毛澤東《整頓黨的作風》
exampleEn: Outside cadres and local cadres each have their strengths and weaknesses; they must learn from each other's strengths to make up for their weaknesses to make progress. — From Mao Zedong's 'Rectify the Party's Style of Work'

explanation: 看到的和听到的。
explanationTraditional: 看到的和聽到的。
explanationEn: What one sees and hears.
derivation: 宋·王安石《慈溪县学记》则士朝夕所见所闻，无非所以治天下国家之道。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王安石《慈溪縣學記》則士朝夕所見所聞，無非所以治天下國家之道。”
derivationEn: Wang Anshi of Song Dynasty, 'Record of Cixi County School': 'Then scholars, from morning to night, what they see and hear is nothing but the way to govern the world and the state.'
example: 我为甚么不将这～的，写封信告诉庄宫保呢？★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第六回
exampleTraditional: 我為甚麼不將這～的，寫封信告訴莊宮保呢？★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第六回
exampleEn: Why don't I write a letter to Lord Zhuang about what I have seen and heard? — Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 6

explanation: 咫尺很近的距离。形容距离很近。
explanationTraditional: 咫尺很近的距離。形容距離很近。
explanationEn: Very close; within a short distance.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《杭州谢上表》凛然威光，近在咫尺。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《杭州謝上表》凜然威光，近在咫尺。”
derivationEn: Su Shi of Song Dynasty, 'Memorial to the Throne on Taking Office in Hangzhou': 'Your majestic presence is as close as a few feet.'
example: 那马明明～，却误为丧失不见，就如心不在焉，视而不见”之意。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 那馬明明～，卻誤為喪失不見，就如心不在焉，視而不見”之意。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十七回
exampleEn: That horse was clearly within arm's reach, yet he mistakenly thought it lost, just like the saying 'the heart is absent, the eyes see not.' — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 17

explanation: 每句话，每个行动。
explanationTraditional: 每句話，每個行動。
explanationEn: Every word and every action.
derivation: 清·冯景《今世说序》则夫一言一行，传其人之神，何以异是。”
derivationTraditional: 清·馮景《今世說序》則夫一言一行，傳其人之神，何以異是。”
derivationEn: Feng Jing of Qing Dynasty, 'Preface to Tales of the World Today': 'Thus, every word and action conveys the spirit of the person; how could it be different?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 睹看。凄惨得叫人不忍心看。
explanationTraditional: 睹看。悽慘得叫人不忍心看。
explanationEn: Too horrible to look at; extremely tragic.
derivation: 唐·李华《吊古战场文》伤心惨目，有如是耶！”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李華《弔古戰場文》傷心慘目，有如是耶！”
derivationEn: Li Hua of Tang Dynasty, 'Essay on the Ancient Battlefield': 'The heart is wounded, the eyes are pained; is there anything like this?'
example: 他在一场车祸中不幸遇难，那场景真是～。
exampleTraditional: 他在一場車禍中不幸遇難，那場景真是～。
exampleEn: He died tragically in a car accident; the scene was too horrible to look at.

explanation: 一无全无。什么东西都没有获得。
explanationTraditional: 一無全無。什麼東西都沒有獲得。
explanationEn: To gain nothing; to come away empty-handed.
derivation: 五代·王定保《唐摭言》然日势既暮，寿儿且寄院中止宿，颢亦怀疑，因命搜寿儿怀袖，一无所得，颢不得已遂躬自操觚。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·王定保《唐摭言》然日勢既暮，壽兒且寄院中止宿，顥亦懷疑，因命搜壽兒懷袖，一無所得，顥不得已遂躬自操觚。”
derivationEn: Wang Dingbao of Five Dynasties, 'Records of Tang Scholars': 'But as the day was late, Shou'er stayed overnight at the hostel. Hao, suspicious, ordered a search of Shou'er's sleeves, but found nothing. Hao had no choice but to write himself.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指人们或集团已经获得的，法定的某种特别权益。
explanationTraditional: 指人們或集團已經獲得的，法定的某種特別權益。
explanationEn: Vested interests; benefits already obtained.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这既然是他的～，他当然不会轻言放弃。
exampleTraditional: 這既然是他的～，他當然不會輕言放棄。
exampleEn: Since this is his vested interest, he will not easily give it up.

explanation: 呼叫，喊。形容人像画得逼真，似乎叫一声就会从画中走出来。泛指文学作品中人物的描写十分生动。
explanationTraditional: 呼叫，喊。形容人像畫得逼真，似乎叫一聲就會從畫中走出來。泛指文學作品中人物的描寫十分生動。
explanationEn: To seem ready to come out at a call; vividly portrayed.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《郭忠恕画赞序》恕先在焉，呼之或出。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《郭忠恕畫贊序》恕先在焉，呼之或出。”
derivationEn: Su Shi of Song Dynasty, 'Preface to Guo Zhongshu's Painting Praise': 'Zhongshu was there; call him and he might come out.'
example: 海立山奔，烟云灭没，谓有龙焉，～。★明·张岱《木犹龙铭》
exampleTraditional: 海立山奔，煙雲滅沒，謂有龍焉，～。★明·張岱《木猶龍銘》
exampleEn: The sea rises, mountains gallop, smoke and clouds vanish; there is said to be a dragon, ready to come out at a call. — Zhang Dai of Ming Dynasty, 'Inscription on a Wooden Dragon'

explanation: 指人一生中最为宝贵的时期。也指国家政治、经济、文化最繁荣的时期。
explanationTraditional: 指人一生中最為寶貴的時期。也指國家政治、經濟、文化最繁榮的時期。
explanationEn: Golden age; prime of life; period of prosperity.
derivation: 谢觉哉《青年人怎样锻炼自己》人从十五岁至三十岁，是黄金时代。”
derivationTraditional: 謝覺哉《青年人怎樣鍛鍊自己》人從十五歲至三十歲，是黃金時代。”
derivationEn: Xie Juezai, 'How Young People Should Train Themselves': 'From fifteen to thirty is the golden age of a person.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指单方面的愿望或不考虑客观实际情况的主观意愿。同一相情愿”。
explanationTraditional: 指單方面的願望或不考慮客觀實際情況的主觀意願。同一相情願”。
explanationEn: One-sided wish; wishful thinking.
derivation: 蒋子龙《乔厂长上任记》有人说‘你这一厢情愿，石敢同意去吗？’”
derivationTraditional: 蔣子龍《喬廠長上任記》有人說‘你這一廂情願，石敢同意去嗎？’”
derivationEn: Jiang Zilong, 'Manager Qiao Takes Office': 'Someone said, 'Isn't this your wishful thinking? Will Shi Gan agree to go?''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伦比类比，匹敌。指事物非常完美，没有能跟它相比的。
explanationTraditional: 倫比類比，匹敵。指事物非常完美，沒有能跟它相比的。
explanationEn: Incomparable; unparalleled; without equal.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《论佛骨表》数千百年以来，未有伦比。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《論佛骨表》數千百年以來，未有倫比。”
derivationEn: Han Yu of Tang Dynasty, 'On the Buddha's Bone': 'In thousands of years, there has been nothing comparable.'
example: 在这段时间里，他受到祖国人民～的最热情的接待。★魏巍《东方·归来》
exampleTraditional: 在這段時間裡，他受到祖國人民～的最熱情的接待。★魏巍《東方·歸來》
exampleEn: During this time, he received the most enthusiastic reception from his countrymen, unparalleled by any other. — Wei Wei, 'The East', 'Return'

explanation: 道家认为，天下万物生于有，有生于无。把没有的说成有。比喻毫无事实，凭空捏造。
explanationTraditional: 道家認為，天下萬物生於有，有生於無。把沒有的說成有。比喻毫無事實，憑空捏造。
explanationEn: To fabricate something out of nothing; to create something from nothing.
derivation: 《老子》天下万物生于有，有生于无。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》天下萬物生於有，有生於無。”
derivationEn: From Laozi: 'All things under heaven are born of being; being is born of non-being.'
example: 子息从来天数，原非人力能为。最是～，堪令耳目新奇。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷三十八
exampleTraditional: 子息從來天數，原非人力能為。最是～，堪令耳目新奇。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷三十八
exampleEn: Children are always a matter of fate, originally not something human effort can achieve. The most extreme fabrication out of nothing can make ears and eyes feel novel. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Amazement at the Wonders' Volume 38

explanation: 形容在一个时期里到处传播，影响很大。
explanationTraditional: 形容在一個時期裡到處傳播，影響很大。
explanationEn: To cause a sensation for a time; to create a stir.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 治好了走出，没有知道，死掉了抬出，就～了。（鲁迅《马上日记》）
exampleTraditional: 治好了走出，沒有知道，死掉了抬出，就～了。（魯迅《馬上日記》）
exampleEn: When cured and discharged, no one knows; when dead and carried out, it causes a sensation. — Lu Xun, 'Immediate Diary'

explanation: 指大街小巷。
