explanationTraditional: 指大街小巷。
explanationEn: Streets and lanes; everywhere in the city.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷三十一问‘如何是学人转身处？’师日‘街头巷尾。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷三十一問‘如何是學人轉身處？’師日‘街頭巷尾。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Question: How does one turn around? Master said: In the streets and lanes.'
example: 上海的～的老虔婆，一知道近邻的阿二嫂家有野男人出入，津津乐道。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文二集·论人言可畏》
exampleTraditional: 上海的～的老虔婆，一知道近鄰的阿二嫂家有野男人出入，津津樂道。★魯迅《且介亭雜文二集·論人言可畏》
exampleEn: The old procuresses in Shanghai's streets and lanes, once they know that neighbor Ah Er's wife has a lover, they talk about it with great relish. — Lu Xun, 'Qie Jie Ting Essays II: On the Fear of Words'

explanation: 金石钟磬之类的乐器，声音清脆优美。比喻文章文辞优美，语言铿锵有力。
explanationTraditional: 金石鐘磬之類的樂器，聲音清脆優美。比喻文章文辭優美，語言鏗鏘有力。
explanationEn: To have a powerful and resonant effect; (of speech or writing) forceful and impressive.
derivation: 《晋书·孙绰传》卿试掷地，当作金石声也。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·孫綽傳》卿試擲地，當作金石聲也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Sun Chuo': 'Try throwing it to the ground, it should make a sound of metal and stone.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 戛象声词。形容声音突然终止。
explanationTraditional: 戛象聲詞。形容聲音突然終止。
explanationEn: To stop abruptly; to come to a sudden end.
derivation: 清·章学诚《文史统义·古文十弊》夫文章变化，侔于鬼神，斗然而来，戛然而止，何尝无此景象？”
derivationTraditional: 清·章學誠《文史統義·古文十弊》夫文章變化，侔於鬼神，斗然而來，戛然而止，何嘗無此景象？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zhang Xuecheng's 'General Principles of Literature: Ten Flaws of Ancient Prose': 'The changes in writing are like ghosts and gods, coming suddenly and stopping abruptly; how can there be no such scene?'
example: 就这一句，～，听来格外令人注意。★高阳《玉座珠帘》下册
exampleTraditional: 就這一句，～，聽來格外令人注意。★高陽《玉座珠簾》下冊
exampleEn: With this one sentence, it stopped abruptly, making it particularly striking to the listener. — Gao Yang, 'Jade Pearl Curtain' Volume 2

explanation: 念念时刻思念着。形容牢记于心，时刻不忘。
explanationTraditional: 念念時刻思念著。形容牢記於心，時刻不忘。
explanationEn: To bear in mind constantly; to never forget.
derivation: 《朱子全书·论语》言其于忠信笃敬，念念不忘。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子全書·論語》言其於忠信篤敬，念念不忘。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Xi's Complete Works: Analects': 'He speaks of being constantly mindful of loyalty, faithfulness, respect, and earnestness.'
example: 此吾所以感刻于心，而～者也。★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷三
exampleTraditional: 此吾所以感刻於心，而～者也。★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷三
exampleEn: This is why I am deeply grateful in my heart and never forget it. — Qing Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Commentary on Du Fu's Poetry' Volume 3

explanation: 原指商人为了牟取暴利而暗中降低产品质量，削减工料。现也指做事图省事，马虎敷衍。
explanationTraditional: 原指商人為了牟取暴利而暗中降低產品質量，削減工料。現也指做事圖省事，馬虎敷衍。
explanationEn: To skimp on work and materials; to do shoddy work and use inferior materials.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 做工作要认真负责，决不能偷工减料，马马虎虎。
exampleTraditional: 做工作要認真負責，決不能偷工減料，馬馬虎虎。
exampleEn: When doing work, one must be conscientious and responsible, never skimping on work and materials or being careless.

explanation: 津津兴趣浓厚的样子。指吃得很有味道或谈得很有兴趣。
explanationTraditional: 津津興趣濃厚的樣子。指吃得很有味道或談得很有興趣。
explanationEn: With great interest; with relish; enthusiastically.
derivation: 汉·王褒《洞箫赋》哀悁悁之可怀兮，良醰醰而有味。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王褒《洞簫賦》哀悁悁之可懷兮，良醰醰而有味。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Wang Bao's 'Ode to the Xiao Flute': 'The sorrowful feelings are cherished, truly rich and flavorful.'
example: 话是这样说，可是谈起理论，许宁还是一套套地向道静谈得～，头头是道。★杨沫《青春之歌》第一部第十二章
exampleTraditional: 話是這樣說，可是談起理論，許寧還是一套套地向道靜談得～，頭頭是道。★楊沫《青春之歌》第一部第十二章
exampleEn: Though he said that, when it came to theory, Xu Ning still talked to Daojing with great interest and in a systematic way. — Yang Mo, 'Song of Youth' Chapter 12, Part 1

explanation: 原指人的容貌发生了改变。现多比喻只改外表和形式，内容实质不变。
explanationTraditional: 原指人的容貌發生了改變。現多比喻只改外表和形式，內容實質不變。
explanationEn: To change the appearance but not the substance; to reform in name only.
derivation: 唐·寒山《诗三百三首》第二一四首改头换面孔，不离旧时人。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·寒山《詩三百三首》第二一四首改頭換面孔，不離舊時人。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Shan's 'Poem 300' No. 214: 'Change the head and face, but still the same old person.'
example: 冤债原从隔世深，相逢便起杀心。～犹相报，何况容颜俨在今。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷三十
exampleTraditional: 冤債原從隔世深，相逢便起殺心。～猶相報，何況容顏儼在今。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷三十
exampleEn: Karmic debts originate from past lives deep; meeting again stirs murderous intent. Changing appearance still brings retribution, let alone when the face remains as before. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Amazement at the Wonders' Volume 30

explanation: 将别人的东西拿来作为自己的。
explanationTraditional: 將別人的東西拿來作為自己的。
explanationEn: To take something for oneself; to appropriate.
derivation: 明·李开先《宝剑记》第二十四出先从片进，累建大功，童贯占为己有欺瞒皇上。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李開先《寶劍記》第二十四出先從片進，累建大功，童貫佔為己有欺瞞皇上。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Li Kaixian's 'Story of the Sword' Act 24: 'First entered with a small contribution, accumulated great achievements, but Tong Guan took credit for himself and deceived the emperor.'
example: 话说袁伯珍见王德黼的矿山苗旺，有利可图，便想夺他的利权，～。★清·无名氏《官场维新记》第六回
exampleTraditional: 話說袁伯珍見王德黼的礦山苗旺，有利可圖，便想奪他的利權，～。★清·無名氏《官場維新記》第六回
exampleEn: It is said that Yuan Bozhen, seeing Wang Defu's mine was thriving and profitable, wanted to seize his rights and take it for himself. — Qing Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Reform in Officialdom' Chapter 6

explanation: 大体相同，略有差异。
explanationTraditional: 大體相同，略有差異。
explanationEn: Largely the same but with minor differences.
derivation: 《庄子·天下》大同而与小同异，此之谓小同异；万物毕同毕异，此之谓大同异。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天下》大同而與小同異，此之謂小同異；萬物畢同畢異，此之謂大同異。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'The great similarity differs from the small similarity; this is called the small similarity-difference. All things are entirely similar and entirely different; this is called the great similarity-difference.'
example: 说的是侯统领一个，其实如今做官的人，无非与侯统领～罢了。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第八十四回
exampleTraditional: 說的是侯統領一個，其實如今做官的人，無非與侯統領～罷了。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第八十四回
exampleEn: It is said that there is only one Commander Hou, but in fact, officials nowadays are all largely the same but with minor differences. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years, Chapter 84

explanation: 指别人已有进步，不能再用老眼光去看他。
explanationTraditional: 指別人已有進步，不能再用老眼光去看他。
explanationEn: To look at someone with new eyes; to regard someone with increased respect due to their progress.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·吕蒙传》注引《江表传》士别三日，即更刮目相待。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·呂蒙傳》注引《江表傳》士別三日，即更刮目相待。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Three Kingdoms: 'A scholar who has been away for three days should be looked at with new eyes.'
example: 世界也～，东亚病夫居然奋起了，睡狮果然醒了。★朱自清《这一天》
exampleTraditional: 世界也～，東亞病夫居然奮起了，睡獅果然醒了。★朱自清《這一天》
exampleEn: The world also looks at us with new eyes; the sick man of East Asia has finally risen, and the sleeping lion has truly awakened. — Zhu Ziqing, This Day

explanation: 发指头发竖起来，形容极为愤怒。使人头发都竖起来了。形容使人极度愤怒。
explanationTraditional: 髮指頭髮豎起來，形容極為憤怒。使人頭髮都豎起來了。形容使人極度憤怒。
explanationEn: To make one's hair stand on end; extremely angry or furious.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》谒者入通，盗跖闻之大怒，目如明星，发上指冠。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》謁者入通，盜蹠聞之大怒，目如明星，髮上指冠。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'The attendant announced the visitor, and Robber Zhi, hearing this, became furious, his eyes like bright stars, his hair standing up and lifting his hat.'
example: 历年以来，不知害了我们多少同志，说来真真～。★清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第二回
exampleTraditional: 歷年以來，不知害了我們多少同志，說來真真～。★清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第二回
exampleEn: Over the years, we don't know how many of our comrades they have harmed; it is truly hair-raising. — Qing Dynasty, Lingnan Yiyi Nüshi, The Heroine of Eastern Europe, Chapter 2

explanation: 形容因吃惊或害怕而发愣的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容因吃驚或害怕而發愣的樣子。
explanationEn: Dumbfounded; stupefied; stunned (as from shock or fear).
derivation: 元·无名氏《赚蒯通》第一折吓得项王目瞪口呆，动弹不得。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《賺蒯通》第一折嚇得項王目瞪口呆，動彈不得。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play: 'Xiang Yu was so frightened that he was dumbfounded and unable to move.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 厉猛烈。象雷那样猛烈，象风那样快。比喻执行政策法令严厉迅速。也形容办事声势猛烈，行动迅速。
explanationTraditional: 厲猛烈。象雷那樣猛烈，象風那樣快。比喻執行政策法令嚴厲迅速。也形容辦事聲勢猛烈，行動迅速。
explanationEn: With the force of thunder and the speed of wind; vigorously and speedily; resolutely and efficiently.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《潮州刺史谢上表》陛下即位以来，躬亲听断，旋乾转坤；关机阖开，雷厉风行。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《潮州刺史謝上表》陛下即位以來，躬親聽斷，旋乾轉坤；關機闔開，雷厲風行。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Yu: 'Since Your Majesty ascended the throne, you have personally heard and decided matters, turning things around; the mechanisms open and close like thunder and wind.'
example: 今天调卷，明天提人，颇觉～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 今天調卷，明天提人，頗覺～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十三回
exampleEn: Today they summon files, tomorrow they bring people in for questioning; they act with great vigor and speed. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, Officialdom Unmasked, Chapter 33

explanation: 三个两个地在一起。形容人数不多。
explanationTraditional: 三個兩個地在一起。形容人數不多。
explanationEn: In twos and threes; in small groups.
derivation: 宋·郭茂倩《乐府诗集》卷四十七引晋人《娇女》诗鱼行不独自，三三两两俱。”宋·辛弃疾《念奴娇·双陆》词袖手旁观初未说，两两三三而已。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·郭茂倩《樂府詩集》卷四十七引晉人《嬌女》詩魚行不獨自，三三兩兩俱。”宋·辛棄疾《念奴嬌·雙陸》詞袖手旁觀初未說，兩兩三三而已。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Guo Maoqian's Collection of Yuefu Poems: 'Fish do not swim alone, but in twos and threes.' Also from Xin Qiji's poem: 'Watching with folded arms, initially silent, then in twos and threes.'
example: 时文林街一带已有歪戴呢帽的人～散在街上。★《闻一多全集·年谱》
exampleTraditional: 時文林街一帶已有歪戴呢帽的人～散在街上。★《聞一多全集·年譜》
exampleEn: At that time, on Wenlin Street, there were already people in tilted felt hats scattered in twos and threes. — The Complete Works of Wen Yiduo, Chronology

explanation: 不受刮风下雨的阻碍。指预先约好的事情，一定按期进行。
explanationTraditional: 不受颳風下雨的阻礙。指預先約好的事情，一定按期進行。
explanationEn: Regardless of wind or rain; no matter what the weather; without fail.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十二黄秀才从陆路短船，风雨无阻，所以赶着了。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十二黃秀才從陸路短船，風雨無阻，所以趕著了。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's Stories to Awaken the World: 'Scholar Huang took a boat by land route, regardless of wind or rain, so he caught up.'
example: 宝钗说道一月只要两次就够了。拟定日期，风雨无阻。”★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十七回
exampleTraditional: 寶釵說道一月只要兩次就夠了。擬定日期，風雨無阻。”★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十七回
exampleEn: Baochai said, 'Twice a month is enough. Set a date, rain or shine.' — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 37

explanation: 江郎指南朝江淹。原指江淹少有文名，晚年诗文无佳句。比喻才情减退。
explanationTraditional: 江郎指南朝江淹。原指江淹少有文名，晚年詩文無佳句。比喻才情減退。
explanationEn: To have one's literary talent exhausted; to lose one's creative ability.
derivation: 《南史·江淹传》淹乃探怀中得五色笔一以授之。尔后为诗绝无美句，时人谓之才尽。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·江淹傳》淹乃探懷中得五色筆一以授之。爾後為詩絕無美句，時人謂之才盡。”
derivationEn: From History of the Southern Dynasties: 'Jiang Yan took out a five-colored pen from his bosom and gave it to him. After that, his poems had no beautiful lines, and people said his talent was exhausted.'
example: 不，他不能和菊子散伙。散了伙，他必感到空虚，寂寞，无聊，或者还落个～，连诗也写不出了。★老舍《四世同堂》五十五
exampleTraditional: 不，他不能和菊子散夥。散了夥，他必感到空虛，寂寞，無聊，或者還落個～，連詩也寫不出了。★老舍《四世同堂》五十五
exampleEn: No, he couldn't break up with Juzi. If they broke up, he would feel empty, lonely, bored, and might even end up like Jiang Yan, unable to write poetry. — Lao She, Four Generations Under One Roof, Chapter 55

explanation: 轮高大；奂众多。形容房屋高大华丽。
explanationTraditional: 輪高大；奐眾多。形容房屋高大華麗。
explanationEn: Magnificent and splendid (describing grand and beautiful buildings).
derivation: 《礼记·檀弓下》晋献文子成室，晋大夫发焉。张老曰‘美哉轮焉，美哉奂焉。’”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·檀弓下》晉獻文子成室，晉大夫發焉。張老曰‘美哉輪焉，美哉奐焉。’”
derivationEn: From The Book of Rites: 'Zhang Lao said, 'How beautiful, how splendid!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 货物不是冒牌的，价钱也是实在的。形容实实在在，一点不假。
explanationTraditional: 貨物不是冒牌的，價錢也是實在的。形容實實在在，一點不假。
explanationEn: Genuine goods at fair prices; the real thing; out-and-out.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第五回但不知可有‘货真价实，童叟无欺’的字样没有？”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第五回但不知可有‘貨真價實，童叟無欺’的字樣沒有？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years: 'But I wonder if there is a sign saying 'Genuine goods at fair prices, old and young not cheated.''
example: 她现在要求再念一遍时的不笑倒是～的热心。（茅盾《无题》）
exampleTraditional: 她現在要求再念一遍時的不笑倒是～的熱心。（茅盾《無題》）
exampleEn: Her earnestness in asking to read it again now is a genuine enthusiasm. — Mao Dun, Untitled

explanation: 令命令；申表达，说明。多次命令和告诫。
explanationTraditional: 令命令；申表達，說明。多次命令和告誡。
explanationEn: To repeatedly give orders and warnings.
derivation: 《史记·孙子吴起列传》约束既布，乃设铁钺，即三令五申之。”汉·张衡《东京赋》三令五申，示戮斩牲。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孫子吳起列傳》約束既布，乃設鐵鉞，即三令五申之。”漢·張衡《東京賦》三令五申，示戮斬牲。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Sun Tzu and Wu Qi' and Zhang Heng's 'Eastern Metropolis Rhapsody'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 彼此和好地相处。
explanationTraditional: 彼此和好地相處。
explanationEn: To live together in harmony and get along well.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 邻里之间应当团结友爱，和睦相处。
exampleTraditional: 鄰里之間應當團結友愛，和睦相處。
exampleEn: Neighbors should unite, love, and live in harmony.

explanation: 因外界事物变化很大而引起许多感想、感触。
explanationTraditional: 因外界事物變化很大而引起許多感想、感觸。
explanationEn: To have a myriad of thoughts and feelings due to great changes in external things.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 金原指钱财，现泛指各种贵重物品；昧隐藏。拾到东西并不隐瞒下来据为己有。指良好的仆人道德和社会风尚。
explanationTraditional: 金原指錢財，現泛指各種貴重物品；昧隱藏。拾到東西並不隱瞞下來據為己有。指良好的僕人道德和社會風尚。
explanationEn: To not pocket the money one picks up; to return lost property to its owner.
derivation: 清·吴炽昌《客窗闲话·义丐》乃呼里长，为之谋宅于市廛，置货立业且表之以额曰‘拾金不昧’。”清·《歧路灯》第一百八回把家人名分扯倒，又表其拾金不昧。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳熾昌《客窗閒話·義丐》乃呼里長，為之謀宅於市廛，置貨立業且表之以額曰‘拾金不昧’。”清·《歧路燈》第一百八回把家人名分扯倒，又表其拾金不昧。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty works 'Ke Chuang Xian Hua' and 'The Road of Thornbushes'.
example: 我们每个人都应从小养成～的好品德。
exampleTraditional: 我們每個人都應從小養成～的好品德。
exampleEn: Each of us should cultivate the virtue of returning lost property from childhood.

explanation: 因人的不同而有所差异。
explanationTraditional: 因人的不同而有所差異。
explanationEn: To vary from person to person.
derivation: 鲁迅《准风月谈·难得糊涂》然而风格和情绪、倾向之类，不但因人而异，而且因事而异，因时而异。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《準風月談·難得糊塗》然而風格和情緒、傾向之類，不但因人而異，而且因事而異，因時而異。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Quasi-romantic Talk: Hard to Be Fooled'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 只是写在纸上没有兑现或不能兑现的东西。
explanationTraditional: 只是寫在紙上沒有兌現或不能兌現的東西。
explanationEn: A mere scrap of paper; an agreement or plan that is not carried out.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第十回活佛喇嘛毫无见识，一任外人播弄，徒凭袁总统一纸空文，岂即肯拱手听命，就此安静么？”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第十回活佛喇嘛毫無見識，一任外人播弄，徒憑袁總統一紙空文，豈即肯拱手聽命，就此安靜麼？”
derivationEn: From Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 管指笔。原指手握双笔同时作画◇比喻做一件事两个方面同时进行或两种方法同时使用。
explanationTraditional: 管指筆。原指手握雙筆同時作畫◇比喻做一件事兩個方面同時進行或兩種方法同時使用。
explanationEn: To paint with two brushes at the same time; to do two things simultaneously or use two methods at once.
derivation: 宋·郭若虚《图画见闻志·故事拾遗》唐张璪员外画山水松石名重于世。尤于画松特出意象，能手握双管一时齐下，一为生枝，一为枯干，势凌风雨，气傲烟霞。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·郭若虛《圖畫見聞志·故事拾遺》唐張璪員外畫山水松石名重於世。尤於畫松特出意象，能手握雙管一時齊下，一為生枝，一為枯乾，勢凌風雨，氣傲煙霞。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty Guo Ruoxu's 'Record of Paintings: Stories of the Past'.
example: 如此～，就有可能克服大地主大资产阶级的投降危险并争取时局的好转前途。★毛泽东《克服投降危险，力争时局好转》
exampleTraditional: 如此～，就有可能克服大地主大資產階級的投降危險並爭取時局的好轉前途。★毛澤東《克服投降危險，力爭時局好轉》
exampleEn: By doing so, it is possible to overcome the capitulationist danger from the big bourgeoisie and the landlords and strive for an improvement in the situation.

explanation: 不经考虑，随口说出。
explanationTraditional: 不經考慮，隨口說出。
explanationEn: To say something without thinking; to blurt out.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第八回虽然不至于通部滚瓜烂熟，大约一部之中，至少亦有一半看熟在肚里，不然怎么能够脱口而出呢？”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第八回雖然不至於通部滾瓜爛熟，大約一部之中，至少亦有一半看熟在肚裡，不然怎麼能夠脫口而出呢？”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Li Baojia's 'A Short History of Civilization'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 曾曾经；几何若干、多少。才有多少时候。指没过多久。
explanationTraditional: 曾曾經；幾何若干、多少。才有多少時候。指沒過多久。
explanationEn: It was not long ago; before long.
derivation: 宋·王安石《祭盛侍郎文》补官扬州，公得谢归。曾几何时，讣者来门。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王安石《祭盛侍郎文》補官揚州，公得謝歸。曾幾何時，訃者來門。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty Wang Anshi's 'Sacrificial Essay to Minister Sheng'.
example: ～，他自己去做了一个小小的官儿回来，而他又劝我去学法政了。★郭沫若《少年时代·反正前后》
exampleTraditional: ～，他自己去做了一個小小的官兒回來，而他又勸我去學法政了。★郭沫若《少年時代·反正前後》
exampleEn: Before long, he himself became a minor official and returned, and then he advised me to study law and government.

explanation: 本意是形容桃花茂盛艳丽◇借用逃之夭夭”表示逃跑，是诙谐的说法。
explanationTraditional: 本意是形容桃花茂盛豔麗◇借用逃之夭夭”表示逃跑，是詼諧的說法。
explanationEn: To escape; to get away (humorous usage, originally describing lush peach blossoms).
derivation: 《诗经·周南·桃夭》桃之夭夭，灼灼其华。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周南·桃夭》桃之夭夭，灼灼其華。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Zhou Nan: The Peach Tree'.
example: 撞人者～，众人向他投去愤怒的眼光。
exampleTraditional: 撞人者～，眾人向他投去憤怒的眼光。
exampleEn: The hit-and-run driver escaped, drawing angry looks from the crowd.

explanation: 心里完全愿意，没有一点勉强。多指自愿做出某种牺牲。
explanationTraditional: 心裡完全願意，沒有一點勉強。多指自願做出某種犧牲。
explanationEn: Willingly and without any reluctance, often referring to voluntary sacrifice.
derivation: 宋·王明清《摭青杂说·项四郎》此事儿甘心情愿也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王明清《摭青雜說·項四郎》此事兒甘心情願也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wang Mingqing's 'Zheqing Zashuo·Xiang Silang': 'This matter I am willing and happy to do.'
example: 温州不算十分穷苦的地方，也没碰着大荒年，干什么得了七个小毛钱，就～的将自己的小妹子捧给人家呢？★朱自清《温州的踪迹》
exampleTraditional: 溫州不算十分窮苦的地方，也沒碰著大荒年，幹什麼得了七個小毛錢，就～的將自己的小妹子捧給人家呢？★朱自清《溫州的蹤跡》
exampleEn: Wenzhou is not a very poor place, nor had they encountered a severe famine. Why would they willingly give away their little sister for just seven small coins? — Zhu Ziqing, 'Traces of Wenzhou'

explanation: 朝早晨；夕晚上。一个早晨或一个晚上。形容很短的时间。
explanationTraditional: 朝早晨；夕晚上。一個早晨或一個晚上。形容很短的時間。
explanationEn: One morning or one evening; describes a very short period of time.
derivation: 《周易·坤》臣弑其君，子弑其父，非一朝一夕之故，其所由来者渐矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·坤》臣弒其君，子弒其父，非一朝一夕之故，其所由來者漸矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes·Kun': 'A minister killing his ruler, a son killing his father—this is not the result of a single morning or evening; its causes have been gradually accumulating.'
example: 即如今日中倭之构难，究所由来，夫岂～之故也哉！★清·严复《论世变之亟》
exampleTraditional: 即如今日中倭之構難，究所由來，夫豈～之故也哉！★清·嚴復《論世變之亟》
exampleEn: For instance, the current conflict between China and Japan—if we trace its origins, how could it be the result of a single morning or evening? — Yan Fu, 'On the Urgency of World Change'

explanation: 倾倒出；荡扫除，弄光。全部家产都被弄光了。
explanationTraditional: 傾倒出；蕩掃除，弄光。全部家產都被弄光了。
explanationEn: To exhaust all family property; to lose everything.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀书·董和传》货殖之家，侯服玉食，婚姻葬送，倾家竭产。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀書·董和傳》貨殖之家，侯服玉食，婚姻葬送，傾家竭產。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms·Shu·Biography of Dong He': 'Merchant families, dressed in finery and eating delicacies, in marriages and funerals, exhaust their entire fortunes.'
example: 匪徒们眼瞪着他们的大锅盔，～。★曲波《林海雪原》三十
exampleTraditional: 匪徒們眼瞪著他們的大鍋盔，～。★曲波《林海雪原》三十
exampleEn: The bandits stared at their large helmets, having lost everything. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 30

explanation: 图谋取。有利益可谋求。
explanationTraditional: 圖謀取。有利益可謀求。
explanationEn: There is profit to be gained.
derivation: 清·无名氏《官场维新记》第六回等到有利可图，可否即允照办。”
derivationTraditional: 清·無名氏《官場維新記》第六回等到有利可圖，可否即允照辦。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty anonymous 'The Officialdom Reform' Chapter 6: 'When there is profit to be gained, can we then agree to proceed?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 确凿确实。证据确实可靠，无法否认。
explanationTraditional: 確鑿確實。證據確實可靠，無法否認。
explanationEn: Evidence is solid and undeniable.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第八十六回尸场检验，证据确凿。且并未用刑，尔兄自认斗杀，招供在案。今尔远来，并非目睹，何得捏词妄控。理应治罪，姑念为兄情切，且恕。不准。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第八十六回屍場檢驗，證據確鑿。且並未用刑，爾兄自認鬥殺，招供在案。今爾遠來，並非目睹，何得捏詞妄控。理應治罪，姑念為兄情切，且恕。不準。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 86: 'The corpse was examined at the scene, and the evidence is conclusive.'
example: 深恐不法勇丁，骚扰百姓，所以面谕本县倘有前项情事，～，准其到县指控。审明之后，即以军法从事，决不宽贷。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 深恐不法勇丁，騷擾百姓，所以面諭本縣倘有前項情事，～，準其到縣指控。審明之後，即以軍法從事，決不寬貸。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十五回
exampleEn: Deeply fearing that unruly soldiers might harass the people, the magistrate instructed that if such incidents occurred with conclusive evidence, the victims could file charges at the county office. Upon investigation, the offenders would be dealt with by military law without leniency. — Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 15

explanation: 千万人一条心。形容团结一致。
explanationTraditional: 千萬人一條心。形容團結一致。
explanationEn: Thousands of people united as one; describes solidarity.
derivation: 《后汉书·朱擕传》万人一心，犹不可当，况十万乎！”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·朱擕傳》萬人一心，猶不可當，況十萬乎！”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han·Biography of Zhu Jun': 'If ten thousand people are of one mind, even a hundred thousand cannot withstand them.'
example: ～，同声呼吁，力抗汉奸，唤醒政府。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一０八回
exampleTraditional: ～，同聲呼籲，力抗漢奸，喚醒政府。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一０八回
exampleEn: United as one, they cried out together, resisting traitors and awakening the government. — Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 108

explanation: 形容器物书画等富有古雅的色彩和情调。
explanationTraditional: 形容器物書畫等富有古雅的色彩和情調。
explanationEn: Describes objects such as paintings and artifacts that have an antique and elegant style.
derivation: 宋·赵希鹄《洞天清录》古画色墨，或淡墨，则积尘所成，有一种古香可爱。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·趙希鵠《洞天清錄》古畫色墨，或淡墨，則積塵所成，有一種古香可愛。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhao Xihu's 'Dongtian Qinglu': 'Ancient paintings have ink that is black or light, and accumulated dust gives them an antique fragrance.'
example: 你可以从明亮的窗玻璃后面看到～的字画、瓷器、铜鼎和小铜佛等等。★徐迟《真迹》
exampleTraditional: 你可以從明亮的窗玻璃後面看到～的字畫、瓷器、銅鼎和小銅佛等等。★徐遲《真跡》
exampleEn: Through the bright glass windows, you can see antique calligraphy, paintings, porcelain, bronze tripods, and small bronze Buddhas. — Xu Chi, 'The Genuine Artifact'

explanation: 铭刻在心灵深处。形容记忆深刻，永远不忘。
explanationTraditional: 銘刻在心靈深處。形容記憶深刻，永遠不忘。
explanationEn: Engraved on the heart and bones; describes deep memory that is never forgotten.
derivation: 唐·李白《上安州李长史书》深荷王公之德，铭刻心骨。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《上安州李長史書》深荷王公之德，銘刻心骨。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li Bai's 'Letter to Governor Li of Anzhou': 'Deeply grateful for the king's virtue, it is engraved on my heart and bones.'
example: 万望太尉慈悯，救拔深陷之人，得瞻天日，～，誓图死保。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 萬望太尉慈憫，救拔深陷之人，得瞻天日，～，誓圖死保。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第八十回
exampleEn: I earnestly beg the Grand Commandant to show mercy and rescue the deeply trapped person, allowing them to see the sun and sky again. This kindness will be engraved on my heart and bones, and I swear to repay it even at the cost of my life. — Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 80

explanation: 比喻阴谋已败露。
explanationTraditional: 比喻陰謀已敗露。
explanationEn: A metaphor for a conspiracy being exposed.
derivation: 元·孔文卿《东窗事犯》第二折吾乃地藏神，化为呆行者，在灵隐寺中，泄漏秦太师东窗事犯。”明·田汝成《西湖游览志馀·佞倖盘荒》可烦传语夫人，东窗事发矣。”
derivationTraditional: 元·孔文卿《東窗事犯》第二折吾乃地藏神，化為呆行者，在靈隱寺中，洩漏秦太師東窗事犯。”明·田汝成《西湖遊覽志餘·佞倖盤荒》可煩傳語夫人，東窗事發矣。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Kong Wenqing's 'Dongchuang Shifan' Act 2: 'I am the Earth Store Bodhisattva, disguised as a dull monk, revealing Prime Minister Qin's conspiracy at Lingyin Temple.' Ming Dynasty Tian Rucheng's 'West Lake Travelogue·Flattery and Tyranny': 'Please tell the lady that the east window plot has been exposed.'
example: 我早间见那做娘的打庆奴，晚间押番归却，打发我出门，莫是～”？★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 我早間見那做孃的打慶奴，晚間押番歸卻，打發我出門，莫是～”？★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷二十
exampleEn: Earlier I saw the mother beating Qingnu, and in the evening the officer returned and sent me out. Could it be that the east window plot has been exposed? — Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Warn the World', Volume 20

explanation: 打开门就能看见山。比喻说话或写文章直截了当谈本题，不拐弯抹角。
explanationTraditional: 打開門就能看見山。比喻說話或寫文章直截了當談本題，不拐彎抹角。
explanationEn: Open the door and see the mountain; metaphor for speaking or writing directly without beating around the bush.
derivation: 唐·刘得仁《青龙寺僧院》此地堪终日，开门见数峰。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉得仁《青龍寺僧院》此地堪終日，開門見數峰。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Deren's 'At the Qinglong Temple': 'This place is worth spending the whole day, opening the door to see several peaks.'
example: 说话要～，谭兄之意，欲以世兄读书之事，烦潜老照管理。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第二回
exampleTraditional: 說話要～，譚兄之意，欲以世兄讀書之事，煩潛老照管理。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第二回
exampleEn: Speak directly, Brother Tan. Your intention is to ask Brother Qian to oversee your son's studies. — Li Luyuan, 'The Road to the Lantern', Chapter 2

explanation: 蒸蒸一升、兴盛的样子。形容事业一天天向上发展。
explanationTraditional: 蒸蒸一升、興盛的樣子。形容事業一天天向上發展。
explanationEn: Describes a career or situation that is improving day by day, thriving and flourishing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们伟大的祖国生机勃勃，蒸蒸日上。
exampleTraditional: 我們偉大的祖國生機勃勃，蒸蒸日上。
exampleEn: Our great motherland is full of vitality and thriving day by day.

explanation: 卓绝极不平凡。坚忍刻苦的精神超过寻常。
explanationTraditional: 卓絕極不平凡。堅忍刻苦的精神超過尋常。
explanationEn: Describes extraordinary perseverance and hardship, surpassing the ordinary.
derivation: 《宋史·邵雍传》始为学，即坚苦刻厉，寒不炉，暑不扇，夜不席者数年。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·邵雍傳》始為學，即堅苦刻厲，寒不爐，暑不扇，夜不席者數年。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Shao Yong': 'When he began to study, he was resolute and hardworking, not using a stove in winter, not fanning in summer, and not sleeping on a mat for several years.'
example: 用儒家之道德，故艰苦卓厉者绝无，而冒没奔竞者皆是。★章炳麟《诸子学略说》
exampleTraditional: 用儒家之道德，故艱苦卓厲者絕無，而冒沒奔競者皆是。★章炳麟《諸子學略說》
exampleEn: Using Confucian morality, there are absolutely no people who are hardworking and persevering, but many who are reckless and competitive. — Zhang Binglin, 'A Brief Discussion of Various Schools'

explanation: 承接上面的，引起下面的。多用在写文章方面。
explanationTraditional: 承接上面的，引起下面的。多用在寫文章方面。
explanationEn: To connect the preceding and introduce the following, often used in writing.
derivation: 宋·张炎《词源·制曲》思量头如何起，尾如何结，方始选韵，而后述曲，最是过片不要断了曲意，须要承上启下。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張炎《詞源·制曲》思量頭如何起，尾如何結，方始選韻，而後述曲，最是過片不要斷了曲意，須要承上啟下。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhang Yan's 'Ciyuan: Making Melodies': 'Think about how to start and how to end, then choose the rhyme, and then compose the melody. The most important thing is not to break the musical idea in the transition, but to connect the preceding and introduce the following.'
example: 这两段文字中应有几句～的话。
exampleTraditional: 這兩段文字中應有幾句～的話。
exampleEn: There should be a few sentences that connect the preceding and introduce the following in these two paragraphs.

explanation: 大风刮起，乌云涌现。比喻新事物相继兴起，声势很盛。
explanationTraditional: 大風颳起，烏雲湧現。比喻新事物相繼興起，聲勢很盛。
explanationEn: Metaphor for new things emerging one after another with great momentum.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《后赤壁赋》划然长啸，草木震动，山鸣谷应，风起水涌。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《後赤壁賦》劃然長嘯，草木震動，山鳴谷應，風起水湧。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Later Ode to the Red Cliff': 'With a sharp whistle, the grass and trees shook, the mountains echoed, and the wind rose and water surged.'
example: 下笔～，能为载记之言。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·各本序跋题辞·唐序》
exampleTraditional: 下筆～，能為載記之言。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·各本序跋題辭·唐序》
exampleEn: When he writes, it is like wind rising and clouds surging, capable of recording narratives. — Qing Dynasty Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Prefaces and Postscripts'

explanation: 振奋振作奋发。使人们振作奋发。
explanationTraditional: 振奮振作奮發。使人們振作奮發。
explanationEn: To inspire and uplift people's spirits.
derivation: 峻青《火把赞》啊，火把，这饱经革命风暴的胶东老根据地的乡亲们手中高举的火把，是那么炽热，那么明亮，那么振奋人心。”
derivationTraditional: 峻青《火把贊》啊，火把，這飽經革命風暴的膠東老根據地的鄉親們手中高舉的火把，是那麼熾熱，那麼明亮，那麼振奮人心。”
derivationEn: From Jun Qing's 'Ode to the Torch': 'Ah, the torch, held high by the folks in the old revolutionary base area of Jiaodong, which has experienced many storms, is so hot, so bright, and so inspiring.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容无秩序，无条理，乱得不成样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容無秩序，無條理，亂得不成樣子。
explanationEn: Describes a state of disorder, chaos, and messiness.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第五回你看屋里的图书字画，家伙器皿，布置得清雅整洁，不象公坊以前乱七八糟的样子了，这是霞郎的成绩。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第五回你看屋裡的圖書字畫，傢伙器皿，佈置得清雅整潔，不象公坊以前亂七八糟的樣子了，這是霞郎的成績。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 5: 'Look at the books, paintings, and furniture in the room, arranged neatly and elegantly, not like the messy state before Gongfang, which is Xia Lang's achievement.'
example: 琴弹得～，可是她的嗓子怪清亮的。★老舍《二马》四
exampleTraditional: 琴彈得～，可是她的嗓子怪清亮的。★老舍《二馬》四
exampleEn: Her piano playing was messy, but her voice was strangely clear. — Lao She, 'Er Ma', Part 4

explanation: 浑身全身，指所有的；解数那套数，指武艺。所有的本领，全部的权术手腕。
explanationTraditional: 渾身全身，指所有的；解數那套數，指武藝。所有的本領，全部的權術手腕。
explanationEn: All one's skills, abilities, or tricks.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第七十三回浑身解数如花锦，双手腾那似辘轳。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第七十三回渾身解數如花錦，雙手騰那似轆轤。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 73: 'All his skills were like splendid brocade, and his hands moved like a pulley.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指不接受别人的劝告，顽固地按照自己的主观想法去做。
explanationTraditional: 指不接受別人的勸告，頑固地按照自己的主觀想法去做。
explanationEn: To act stubbornly according to one's own ideas, ignoring others' advice.
derivation: 《史记·酷吏列传》公卿相造请禹，禹终不报谢，务在绝知友宾客之请，孤立行一意而已。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·酷吏列傳》公卿相造請禹，禹終不報謝，務在絕知友賓客之請，孤立行一意而已。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Cruel Officials': 'When high officials visited Yu, he never thanked or reciprocated, insisting on cutting off friends and guests, and acting alone with his own will.'
example: 皇上和杨文弱、高起潜虽有意与虏议和，但迫于臣民清议，尚不敢公然～，与虏订城下之盟。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三章
exampleTraditional: 皇上和楊文弱、高起潛雖有意與虜議和，但迫於臣民清議，尚不敢公然～，與虜訂城下之盟。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三章
exampleEn: Although the emperor, Yang Wenruo, and Gao Qiqian intended to negotiate peace with the barbarians, they dared not openly act stubbornly and sign a treaty under the city walls due to public opinion. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 3

explanation: 形容某一种人为数不少。
explanationTraditional: 形容某一種人為數不少。
explanationEn: Describes a large number of people of a certain type.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·隋纪炀帝大业十一年》帝至东都，顾眄街衢，谓侍臣曰‘犹大有人在。’意谓向日平杨玄感，杀人尚少故也。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·隋紀煬帝大業十一年》帝至東都，顧眄街衢，謂侍臣曰‘猶大有人在。’意謂向日平楊玄感，殺人尚少故也。”
derivationEn: From 'Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government: Sui Annals, Daye 11th Year': 'The emperor arrived at the eastern capital, looked around the streets, and said to his attendants, 'There are still many people.' Meaning that when he suppressed Yang Xuangan earlier, he had not killed enough.'
example: 出面的虽是章士钊，其实黑幕中～。★《鲁迅书信集·致李秉中》
exampleTraditional: 出面的雖是章士釗，其實黑幕中～。★《魯迅書信集·致李秉中》
exampleEn: Although Zhang Shizhao appeared on the surface, there were many people behind the scenes. — Lu Xun, 'Letters to Li Bingzhong'

explanation: 一年又一年。比喻日子久，时间长。也形容光阴白白地过去。
explanationTraditional: 一年又一年。比喻日子久，時間長。也形容光陰白白地過去。
explanationEn: Year after year; describes a long period of time or time passing idly.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二回每逢闲暇，无非敲枰相聚。日复一日，年复一年，也不知人间岁月几何。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二回每逢閒暇，無非敲枰相聚。日復一日，年復一年，也不知人間歲月幾何。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 2: 'Whenever free, they would gather to play chess. Day after day, year after year, they did not know how many years had passed in the human world.'
example: ～，日复一日，生涯几何，宁堪此弃掷哉？★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷一
exampleTraditional: ～，日復一日，生涯幾何，寧堪此棄擲哉？★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷一
exampleEn: Year after year, day after day, how long is life? How can one bear to waste it like this? — Qing Dynasty Anonymous, 'Du Shi Yan Zhi', Volume 1

explanation: 对于一个地方的气候条件或饮食习惯不能适应。
explanationTraditional: 對於一個地方的氣候條件或飲食習慣不能適應。
explanationEn: Not acclimatized to the climate or diet of a new place.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·周瑜传》不习水土，必生疾病。”《宋书·索虏传》道理来远，或不服水土，药自可疗。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·周瑜傳》不習水土，必生疾病。”《宋書·索虜傳》道理來遠，或不服水土，藥自可療。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms' and 'Book of Song': 'Not accustomed to the local conditions will cause illness.'
example: 大抵此症，起于饮食失调，兼之～，食积于小腹之中，凝滞不消，遂至生热，升至胸中，便觉饥饿。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 大抵此症，起於飲食失調，兼之～，食積於小腹之中，凝滯不消，遂至生熱，升至胸中，便覺飢餓。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二十
exampleEn: Generally, this illness arises from improper diet and not being acclimatized, causing food to stagnate in the lower abdomen, leading to heat and hunger. (from Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World')

explanation: 只有一个，再没有别的。形容非常少有。
explanationTraditional: 只有一個，再沒有別的。形容非常少有。
explanationEn: Unique; extremely rare; one of a kind.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《上皇帝书》改过不吝，从善如流，此尧舜禹汤之所勉强而力行，秦汉以来之所绝无而仅有。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《上皇帝書》改過不吝，從善如流，此堯舜禹湯之所勉強而力行，秦漢以來之所絕無而僅有。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Letter to the Emperor': 'Correcting mistakes without hesitation, following good advice like water flowing—this is what Yao, Shun, Yu, and Tang strived for, and what has been absolutely unique since Qin and Han.'
example: 新的一辈继他们的父亲或者母亲之后成为作家的，可以说～。★秦牧《两代人》
exampleTraditional: 新的一輩繼他們的父親或者母親之後成為作家的，可以說～。★秦牧《兩代人》
exampleEn: It is extremely rare for the new generation to become writers following their parents. (from Qin Mu's 'Two Generations')

explanation: 奄奄呼吸微弱的样子。只剩下一口气。形容临近死亡。
explanationTraditional: 奄奄呼吸微弱的樣子。只剩下一口氣。形容臨近死亡。
explanationEn: At one's last gasp; on the verge of death; dying.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十七回惠王亲往问疾，见痤病势已重，奄奄一息。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十七回惠王親往問疾，見痤病勢已重，奄奄一息。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms': 'King Hui visited the ill and saw that the disease was severe, with only a faint breath left.'
example: 他已被打得体无完肤，～了。
exampleTraditional: 他已被打得體無完膚，～了。
exampleEn: He was beaten black and blue, and was at his last gasp.

explanation: 生生中国哲学术语，指变化和新生事物的发生；不已没有终止。不断地生长、繁殖。
explanationTraditional: 生生中國哲學術語，指變化和新生事物的發生；不已沒有終止。不斷地生長、繁殖。
explanationEn: Continuous growth and reproduction; endless cycle of life.
derivation: 《周易·系辞上》生生之谓易。”宋·周敦颐《太极图说》二气交感，化生万物，万物生生而变化无穷焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭上》生生之謂易。”宋·周敦頤《太極圖說》二氣交感，化生萬物，萬物生生而變化無窮焉。”
derivationEn: From 'I Ching': 'Production and reproduction is what is called change.' Also from Zhou Dunyi's 'Explanation of the Diagram of the Supreme Ultimate': 'The two qi interact, transforming and generating all things, which endlessly produce and reproduce.'
example: 在天地，则气化流行，～。（清·戴震《孟子字义疏证·道》）
exampleTraditional: 在天地，則氣化流行，～。（清·戴震《孟子字義疏證·道》）
exampleEn: In heaven and earth, qi transforms and flows, and all things endlessly produce and reproduce. (from Dai Zhen's 'Commentary on Mencius' Words')

explanation: 从开头到结尾。指某件事物的全过程或全部内容。
explanationTraditional: 從開頭到結尾。指某件事物的全過程或全部內容。
explanationEn: From beginning to end; the whole process or content.
derivation: 《朱子全书·孟子三》是金声底，从头到尾只是金声；是玉声底，从头到尾只是玉声；是丝竹之声，从头到尾只是丝竹之声。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子全書·孟子三》是金聲底，從頭到尾只是金聲；是玉聲底，從頭到尾只是玉聲；是絲竹之聲，從頭到尾只是絲竹之聲。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Xi's Complete Works': 'The sound of metal is metal from beginning to end; the sound of jade is jade from beginning to end.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 被逼得没有办法，不得不这样。
explanationTraditional: 被逼得沒有辦法，不得不這樣。
explanationEn: Have no alternative but to; be forced to do something.
derivation: 《汉书·王莽传上》为皇帝定立妃后，有司上名，公女为首，公深辞让，迫不得已然后受诏。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·王莽傳上》為皇帝定立妃後，有司上名，公女為首，公深辭讓，迫不得已然後受詔。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han': 'When establishing the empress, the officials recommended the duke's daughter, but the duke declined repeatedly, and only accepted the decree when forced.'
example: 吾之言爱国也，得毋为名乎，得毋为利乎，是毋为事势～乎。（清·梁启超《意大利建国三杰传·结论》）
exampleTraditional: 吾之言愛國也，得毋為名乎，得毋為利乎，是毋為事勢～乎。（清·梁啟超《意大利建國三傑傳·結論》）
exampleEn: My words of patriotism—are they for fame, for profit, or forced by circumstances? (from Liang Qichao's 'Conclusion of the Biography of the Three Founders of Italy')

explanation: 独唯独；善好，维护。原意是做不上官就修养好自身。现指只顾自己，不管别人。
explanationTraditional: 獨唯獨；善好，維護。原意是做不上官就修養好自身。現指只顧自己，不管別人。
explanationEn: To maintain one's own integrity; to look after oneself without caring about others.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》穷则独善其身，达则兼善天下。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》窮則獨善其身，達則兼善天下。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'If poor, one should attend to one's own virtue; if successful, one should benefit the whole world.'
example: ～尽日安，何须千古名不朽。（明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三十七回）
exampleTraditional: ～盡日安，何須千古名不朽。（明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三十七回）
exampleEn: Attending to one's own virtue all day brings peace; why seek eternal fame? (from Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms')

explanation: 指处理事情公正符合情理。
explanationTraditional: 指處理事情公正符合情理。
explanationEn: Fair and reasonable; just and equitable.
derivation: 毛泽东《三大运动的伟大胜利》只要美国政府愿意在公平合理的基础上解决问题，不再如过去那样用种种可耻的方法破坏和阻挠谈判的进行，则朝鲜的停战谈判是可能成功的。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《三大運動的偉大勝利》只要美國政府願意在公平合理的基礎上解決問題，不再如過去那樣用種種可恥的方法破壞和阻撓談判的進行，則朝鮮的停戰談判是可能成功的。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Great Victories of the Three Great Movements': 'As long as the US government is willing to solve problems on a fair and reasonable basis... the Korean armistice negotiations may succeed.'
example: 站好了队，排好了号，分果实分土地就～。★周立波《暴风骤雨》第二部
exampleTraditional: 站好了隊，排好了號，分果實分土地就～。★周立波《暴風驟雨》第二部
exampleEn: After lining up and numbering, the distribution of fruits and land becomes fair and reasonable. (from Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane')

explanation: 指说话做事恰好到了最合适的地步。
explanationTraditional: 指說話做事恰好到了最合適的地步。
explanationEn: Just right; to the point; perfectly appropriate.
derivation: 朱自清《经典常谈·春秋三传第六》只是平心静气的说，紧要关头却不放松一步；真所谓恰到好处。”
derivationTraditional: 朱自清《經典常談·春秋三傳第六》只是平心靜氣的說，緊要關頭卻不放鬆一步；真所謂恰到好處。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Ziqing's 'Classic Essays': 'Speaking calmly but not relaxing at critical moments—truly hitting the mark.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 触碰；即就。原指把箭扣在弦上，拉开弓等着射出去。比喻事态发展到了十分紧张的阶段，稍一触动就立即会爆发。
explanationTraditional: 觸碰；即就。原指把箭扣在弦上，拉開弓等著射出去。比喻事態發展到了十分緊張的階段，稍一觸動就立即會爆發。
explanationEn: Be on the verge of breaking out; touch-and-go; explosive situation.
derivation: 毛泽东《评蒋介石发言人的谈话》共产党主张成立联合政府，就为罅内战。现在蒋介石拒绝了这个主张，致使内战有一触即发之势。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《評蔣介石發言人的談話》共產黨主張成立聯合政府，就為罅內戰。現在蔣介石拒絕了這個主張，致使內戰有一觸即發之勢。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Comment on Chiang Kai-shek's Statement': 'The Communist Party advocates a coalition government to avoid civil war. Now Chiang Kai-shek rejects this, making civil war imminent.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容不负责任地胡乱议论。
explanationTraditional: 形容不負責任地胡亂議論。
explanationEn: To make irresponsible and groundless comments about others.
derivation: 清·崔灏《通俗编·言笑》莫学他人不知朝暮，走启蒙乡村，说三道四。”
derivationTraditional: 清·崔灝《通俗編·言笑》莫學他人不知朝暮，走啟蒙鄉村，說三道四。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cui Hao's 'General Customs: Words and Laughter': 'Don't imitate others who know no morning or evening, wandering in villages, gossiping.'
example: 有的人工作不努力，别人有了成绩，却整天～。
exampleTraditional: 有的人工作不努力，別人有了成績，卻整天～。
exampleEn: Some people don't work hard, but when others achieve success, they gossip all day.

explanation: 胜尽；枚个。不能一个个地列举出来。形容数量很多。
explanationTraditional: 勝盡；枚個。不能一個個地列舉出來。形容數量很多。
explanationEn: Too numerous to list individually.
derivation: 宋·王楙《野客丛书·俗语有所自》似此等语，不可枚举。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王楙《野客叢書·俗語有所自》似此等語，不可枚舉。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Wang Mao's 'Notes of a Rustic Scholar: Common Sayings and Their Origins': 'Such expressions cannot be enumerated one by one.'
example: 真是钉子之多，～。★鲁迅《书信集·致章廷谦》
exampleTraditional: 真是釘子之多，～。★魯迅《書信集·致章廷謙》
exampleEn: Truly, there are so many nails that they are too numerous to list. — Lu Xun, 'Letters: To Zhang Tingqian'

explanation: 抒抒发，发表。各人充分发表自己的意见。
explanationTraditional: 抒抒發，發表。各人充分發表自己的意見。
explanationEn: Each fully expresses their own opinion.
derivation: 唐·李翱《李文权文集·陵庙日时朔祭议》先儒穿凿，各伸己见，皆托古圣贤之名以信其语，故其所记各不同也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李翱《李文權文集·陵廟日時朔祭議》先儒穿鑿，各伸己見，皆託古聖賢之名以信其語，故其所記各不同也。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Ao's 'Collected Works of Li Wengong: Sacrificial Rites at Mausoleums and Temples': 'Earlier scholars were pedantic, each presenting their own views, all attributing them to ancient sages to lend credibility, so their records differ.'
example: 据我主意，何不～，出个式子，岂不新鲜些？★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十四回
exampleTraditional: 據我主意，何不～，出個式子，豈不新鮮些？★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十四回
exampleEn: In my opinion, why not each express their own views and come up with a pattern? Wouldn't that be fresh? — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 74

explanation: 意味情调，趣味。意思含畜深远，耐人寻味。
explanationTraditional: 意味情調，趣味。意思含畜深遠，耐人尋味。
explanationEn: Profound in meaning, thought-provoking.
derivation: 宋·程颢、程颐《河南程氏遗书》读之愈久，但觉意味深长。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·程顥、程頤《河南程氏遺書》讀之愈久，但覺意味深長。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Cheng Hao and Cheng Yi's 'Surviving Works of the Cheng Brothers': 'The longer you read it, the more you feel its profound meaning.'
example: 书中所述的人生哲理，～。★朱自清《经典常谈·四书第七》
exampleTraditional: 書中所述的人生哲理，～。★朱自清《經典常談·四書第七》
exampleEn: The life philosophies described in the book are profound and thought-provoking. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Introductions: The Four Books, Seventh'

explanation: 指有丰富敏捷的智力和显著的才能。
explanationTraditional: 指有豐富敏捷的智力和顯著的才能。
explanationEn: Rich and agile intelligence and remarkable talent.
derivation: 北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·治家》如有聪明才智，识达古今，正当辅佐君子，助其不足。”
derivationTraditional: 北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·治家》如有聰明才智，識達古今，正當輔佐君子，助其不足。”
derivationEn: From Northern Qi Dynasty, Yan Zhitui's 'Family Instructions of Master Yan: Managing the Household': 'If one has intelligence and talent, and understands past and present, they should assist their lord and help with his shortcomings.'
example: 因思姊姊同妹妹，～岂输男。★清·秋谨《精卫石》第二回
exampleTraditional: 因思姊姊同妹妹，～豈輸男。★清·秋謹《精衛石》第二回
exampleEn: Thinking that sisters and brothers, with their intelligence and talent, are no less than men. — Qing Dynasty, Qiu Jin, 'Jingwei Stone', Chapter 2

explanation: 生存或者死亡。形容局势或斗争的的发展已到最后关头。
explanationTraditional: 生存或者死亡。形容局勢或鬥爭的的發展已到最後關頭。
explanationEn: Life or death, survival or extinction. Describes a critical moment in a situation or struggle.
derivation: 《左传·定公十五年》夫礼，死生存亡之体也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·定公十五年》夫禮，死生存亡之體也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Ding's Fifteenth Year': 'Ritual is the essence of life and death, survival and extinction.'
example: 亲承懿旨到西宫，～掌握中。★元·无名氏《抱妆盒》第二折
exampleTraditional: 親承懿旨到西宮，～掌握中。★元·無名氏《抱妝盒》第二折
exampleEn: Having received the imperial decree at the West Palace, life and death are in my hands. — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Box', Act 2

explanation: 蠢蠢爬虫蠕动的样子。比喻敌人准备进攻或坏人阴谋捣乱。
explanationTraditional: 蠢蠢爬蟲蠕動的樣子。比喻敵人準備進攻或壞人陰謀搗亂。
explanationEn: To be ready to start an attack or cause trouble, like worms wriggling.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘敬叔《异苑·句容水脉》掘得一黑物，无有首尾，形如数百斛舡，长数十丈，蠢蠢而动。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉敬叔《異苑·句容水脈》掘得一黑物，無有首尾，形如數百斛舡，長數十丈，蠢蠢而動。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Song, Liu Jingshu's 'Strange Tales: The Water Vein of Jurong': 'They dug up a black creature with no head or tail, shaped like a hundred-hu boat, dozens of zhang long, wriggling and moving.'
example: 据点里的敌人又～。★峻青《爆炸远征队》五
exampleTraditional: 據點裡的敵人又～。★峻青《爆炸遠征隊》五
exampleEn: The enemies in the stronghold are again ready to stir. — Jun Qing, 'Explosive Commando', Chapter 5

explanation: 摇摇摇动，摇晃；坠落下。形容十分危险，很快就要掉下来，或不稳固，很快就要垮台。
explanationTraditional: 搖搖搖動，搖晃；墜落下。形容十分危險，很快就要掉下來，或不穩固，很快就要垮臺。
explanationEn: Shaky and about to fall; extremely unstable or on the verge of collapse.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百零四回众视之，见其色昏暗，摇摇欲坠。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百零四回眾視之，見其色昏暗，搖搖欲墜。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 104: 'Everyone looked and saw it was dim and shaky, about to fall.'
example: 战士们靠近边缘向下一看，头晕目眩，觉得眼前的大岩来回晃动，自己的身体～。★曲波《林海雪原》二七
exampleTraditional: 戰士們靠近邊緣向下一看，頭暈目眩，覺得眼前的大巖來回晃動，自己的身體～。★曲波《林海雪原》二七
exampleEn: The soldiers approached the edge and looked down, feeling dizzy, as if the great rock before them was shaking and they themselves were about to fall. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 27

explanation: 原指与现实社会隔绝、生活安乐的理想境界◇也指环境幽静生活安逸的地方。借指一种空想的脱离现实斗争的美好世界。
explanationTraditional: 原指與現實社會隔絕、生活安樂的理想境界◇也指環境幽靜生活安逸的地方。借指一種空想的脫離現實鬥爭的美好世界。
explanationEn: A peaceful, idyllic place isolated from the real world; a utopia.
derivation: 晋·陶潜《桃花园记》描述的一个与世隔绝，没有遭到祸乱的美好地方。
derivationTraditional: 晉·陶潛《桃花園記》描述的一個與世隔絕，沒有遭到禍亂的美好地方。
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Tao Qian's 'Peach Blossom Spring', describing a secluded place untouched by turmoil.
example: 在这儿，在这～的仙境中，有了人世喧嚣的声音。★杨沫《青春之歌》第一部第三章
exampleTraditional: 在這兒，在這～的仙境中，有了人世喧囂的聲音。★楊沫《青春之歌》第一部第三章
exampleEn: Here, in this fairyland of peace, there came the noise of the human world. — Yang Mo, 'Song of Youth', Part 1, Chapter 3

explanation: 滔滔形容流水不断。象流水那样毫不间断。指话很多，说起来没个完。
explanationTraditional: 滔滔形容流水不斷。象流水那樣毫不間斷。指話很多，說起來沒個完。
explanationEn: To speak incessantly and fluently, like a flowing stream.
derivation: 五代后周·王仁裕《开元天宝遗事·走丸之辩》张九龄善谈论，每与宾客议论经旨，滔滔不竭，如下阪走丸也。”
derivationTraditional: 五代後周·王仁裕《開元天寶遺事·走丸之辯》張九齡善談論，每與賓客議論經旨，滔滔不竭，如下阪走丸也。”
derivationEn: From Five Dynasties Later Zhou, Wang Renyu's 'Legends of Kaiyuan and Tianbao: Eloquence Like a Rolling Ball': 'Zhang Jiuling was good at debating; whenever he discussed classics with guests, he spoke endlessly, like a ball rolling down a slope.'
example: 斡离不得汪豹献了李刘隘口，无人阻当，～，把十万大兵尽数渡了黄河。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 斡離不得汪豹獻了李劉隘口，無人阻當，～，把十萬大兵盡數渡了黃河。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第二十回
exampleEn: Wolves were not able to stop Wang Bao from surrendering Li Liu Pass, and without resistance, they poured across the Yellow River with a hundred thousand troops. — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 20

explanation: 欣欣形容草木生长旺盛；荣茂盛。形容草木长得茂盛。比喻事业蓬勃发展，兴旺昌盛。
explanationTraditional: 欣欣形容草木生長旺盛；榮茂盛。形容草木長得茂盛。比喻事業蓬勃發展，興旺昌盛。
explanationEn: Thriving and flourishing; describing vigorous growth of plants, or metaphorically the prosperous development of a cause or business.
derivation: 晋·陶潜《归去来辞》木欣欣以向荣，泉涓涓而始流。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陶潛《歸去來辭》木欣欣以向榮，泉涓涓而始流。”
derivationEn: From Tao Qian's 'Returning to Live in the Countryside': 'Trees thrive and flourish, springs trickle and begin to flow.'
example: 在其间～的，只有鲜花和绿草，这是比喻对于将来的希望。★叶圣陶《搭班子》
exampleTraditional: 在其間～的，只有鮮花和綠草，這是比喻對於將來的希望。★葉聖陶《搭班子》
exampleEn: Among them, only flowers and grass are thriving, which is a metaphor for hope for the future. — Ye Shengtao, 'Forming a Team'

explanation: 比喻做一些工作，尽一点力量。
explanationTraditional: 比喻做一些工作，盡一點力量。
explanationEn: To do some work or contribute a little effort.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们要学好本领，将来为祖国建设添砖加瓦。
exampleTraditional: 我們要學好本領，將來為祖國建設添磚加瓦。
exampleEn: We must learn skills well, so that in the future we can contribute to the construction of our motherland.

explanation: 彼此没有多大差别。
explanationTraditional: 彼此沒有多大差別。
explanationEn: Not much difference; very similar.
derivation: 先秦·李耳《老子》唯之与阿，相去几何？美之与恶，相去何若？”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·李耳《老子》唯之與阿，相去幾何？美之與惡，相去何若？”
derivationEn: From Laozi's 'Tao Te Ching': 'What is the difference between yes and no? What is the difference between good and evil?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 动作或事物到来的气势很厉害。
explanationTraditional: 動作或事物到來的氣勢很厲害。
explanationEn: Describing a forceful or aggressive approach of an action or thing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 洪水虽然来势汹汹，但我们的抗洪工程安然无恙。
exampleTraditional: 洪水雖然來勢洶洶，但我們的抗洪工程安然無恙。
exampleEn: Although the flood came fiercely, our flood control project remained safe.

explanation: 难辨或难治的各种病症。比喻难以理解或解决的问题。
explanationTraditional: 難辨或難治的各種病症。比喻難以理解或解決的問題。
explanationEn: Difficult or hard-to-treat diseases; metaphorically, problems that are hard to understand or solve.
derivation: 鲁迅《二心集·风马牛》然而那下面的一个名词，却不写尚可，一写倒成了疑难杂症。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《二心集·風馬牛》然而那下面的一個名詞，卻不寫尚可，一寫倒成了疑難雜症。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Two Hearts Collection: Neither Fish nor Fowl': 'But that noun below, if not written, is fine; once written, it becomes a difficult problem.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 将来有那么一天。
explanationTraditional: 將來有那麼一天。
explanationEn: Someday; one day in the future.
derivation: 元·无名氏《博望烧屯》第一折有朝一日，我出矛庐指点世人迷，凭着我剑挥星斗，我志逐风雷。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《博望燒屯》第一折有朝一日，我出矛廬指點世人迷，憑著我劍揮星斗，我志逐風雷。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty anonymous play 'Burning Wang's Cottage' Act 1: 'Someday, I will leave my thatched hut to guide the world's lost, wielding my sword to shake the stars, my will chasing the wind and thunder.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指日可以指出日期，为期不远；待期待。为期不远，不久就可以实现。
explanationTraditional: 指日可以指出日期，為期不遠；待期待。為期不遠，不久就可以實現。
explanationEn: Can be expected soon; not far off.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第三十一回是以我主上神佑，泥马渡江，正位金陵，用贤任能，中兴指日可待。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第三十一回是以我主上神佑，泥馬渡江，正位金陵，用賢任能，中興指日可待。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei' Chapter 31: 'Thus, with the blessing of our emperor, crossing the river on a clay horse, ascending the throne in Jinling, employing the worthy and capable, the revival is just around the corner.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 越往下越明显。表示情况越来越坏。
explanationTraditional: 越往下越明顯。表示情況越來越壞。
explanationEn: Things get worse as they go on; deteriorating situation.
derivation: 《庄子·知北游》夫子之问也，固不及质，正获之问于监市履希也，每下愈况。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·知北遊》夫子之問也，固不及質，正獲之問於監市履希也，每下愈況。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Knowledge Wanders North': 'Your question, sir, does not reach the essence; it is like the warden asking the butcher about the pig's foot—the further down, the more obvious.'
example: 下品中的魏武帝，更真是～曹公古直，甚有悲凉之句”，仅仅这样的十个字而已。★郭沫若《论曹植》
exampleTraditional: 下品中的魏武帝，更真是～曹公古直，甚有悲涼之句”，僅僅這樣的十個字而已。★郭沫若《論曹植》
exampleEn: Emperor Wu of Wei in the lower grade is even worse—'Cao Gong is ancient and straightforward, with a very sad style,' just ten words. — Guo Moruo, 'On Cao Zhi'

explanation: 打规划。精密地计划，详细地计算。指在使用人力物力时计算得很精细。
explanationTraditional: 打規劃。精密地計劃，詳細地計算。指在使用人力物力時計算得很精細。
explanationEn: To plan carefully and calculate meticulously; to use resources frugally.
derivation: 茹志鹃《妯娌》再看红英自己，那是连半个钟头的工都不肯耽误的，也从没见她吃过一口零食，一看就知道是个会精打细算、会过日子的人。”
derivationTraditional: 茹誌鵑《妯娌》再看紅英自己，那是連半個鐘頭的工都不肯耽誤的，也從沒見她吃過一口零食，一看就知道是個會精打細算、會過日子的人。”
derivationEn: From Ru Zhijuan's 'Sisters-in-Law': 'Looking at Hongying, she wouldn't even waste half an hour of work, and never ate a snack; clearly she was someone who knew how to budget and live frugally.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 灼明白，透彻。正确而透彻的见解。
explanationTraditional: 灼明白，透徹。正確而透徹的見解。
explanationEn: Correct and penetrating insight; profound knowledge.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三真知灼见者，尚且有误，何况其他！”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三真知灼見者，尚且有誤，何況其他！”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World' Volume 3: 'Even those with true knowledge and clear insight can make mistakes, let alone others!'
example: 两家之学皆深入宋儒之室，但以汉学为不可废耳，多倚墙之见，依违之言，岂～者哉！★江藩《汉学师承记·顾炎武》
exampleTraditional: 兩家之學皆深入宋儒之室，但以漢學為不可廢耳，多倚牆之見，依違之言，豈～者哉！★江藩《漢學師承記·顧炎武》
exampleEn: Both schools of thought deeply entered the realm of Song Confucianism, but they considered Han learning indispensable; they had many fence-sitting views and ambiguous statements—how could these be true insights? — Jiang Fan, 'Han Learning Masters' Succession: Gu Yanwu'

explanation: 形容时间还远得很，不知道哪一天。
explanationTraditional: 形容時間還遠得很，不知道哪一天。
explanationEn: Describes a time that is still far away, with no definite date in sight.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这件事我不能～地等下去，希望能尽快给以解决。
exampleTraditional: 這件事我不能～地等下去，希望能儘快給以解決。
exampleEn: I cannot wait indefinitely for this matter; I hope it can be resolved soon.

explanation: 一代接一代地相继传下去。
explanationTraditional: 一代接一代地相繼傳下去。
explanationEn: Passed down from one generation to the next.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们一定要将林州人民战天斗地、艰苦创业的红旗渠精神”代代相传。
exampleTraditional: 我們一定要將林州人民戰天鬥地、艱苦創業的紅旗渠精神”代代相傳。
exampleEn: We must pass down the Hongqiqu spirit of fighting against nature and hard work from generation to generation.

explanation: 勇敢地一直向前进。
explanationTraditional: 勇敢地一直向前進。
explanationEn: To advance bravely and without hesitation.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子全书·道统一·周子书》不顾旁人是非，不计自己得失，勇往直前，说出人不敢说的道理。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子全書·道統一·周子書》不顧旁人是非，不計自己得失，勇往直前，說出人不敢說的道理。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi's 'Complete Works of Zhu Xi': 'Ignoring others' opinions and one's own gains and losses, advancing bravely and speaking truths that others dare not speak.'
example: 人人惧摩拳擦掌，个个～。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第七十三回
exampleTraditional: 人人懼摩拳擦掌，個個～。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第七十三回
exampleEn: Everyone was eager to fight, each one advancing bravely. — Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 73

explanation: 景境况，光景；长长久。美好的光景不能永远存在。
explanationTraditional: 景境況，光景；長長久。美好的光景不能永遠存在。
explanationEn: Good times do not last forever.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他们匆匆结合，总是好景不长的。
exampleTraditional: 他們匆匆結合，總是好景不長的。
exampleEn: Their hasty union never lasted long; good times were always short-lived.

explanation: 朝气早上的空气，引伸为新生向上，努力进取的气象；蓬勃旺盛的样子。形容充满了生命和活力。
explanationTraditional: 朝氣早上的空氣，引伸為新生向上，努力進取的氣象；蓬勃旺盛的樣子。形容充滿了生命和活力。
explanationEn: Full of vitality and energy; vigorous and dynamic.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 青年人富有理想，朝气蓬勃，是祖国的未来。
exampleTraditional: 青年人富有理想，朝氣蓬勃，是祖國的未來。
exampleEn: Young people are full of ideals and vitality; they are the future of the motherland.

explanation: 另外开辟一条路。比喻另创一种风格或方法。
explanationTraditional: 另外開闢一條路。比喻另創一種風格或方法。
explanationEn: To open up a new path; to create a new style or method.
derivation: 叶圣陶《倪焕之》对于这样另辟蹊径的教育宗旨与方法，自己确有坚强的信念。”
derivationTraditional: 葉聖陶《倪煥之》對於這樣另闢蹊徑的教育宗旨與方法，自己確有堅強的信念。”
derivationEn: Ye Shengtao's 'Ni Huanzhi': 'He had a firm belief in this educational purpose and method of blazing a new trail.'
example: 他泼辣大胆，勇于实践和～
exampleTraditional: 他潑辣大膽，勇於實踐和～
exampleEn: He is bold and daring, willing to practice and blaze new trails.

explanation: 看到怪异的现象不要大惊小怪。指遇到不常见的事物或意外情况，要沉着镇静。
explanationTraditional: 看到怪異的現象不要大驚小怪。指遇到不常見的事物或意外情況，要沉著鎮靜。
explanationEn: Not be surprised at unusual phenomena; remain calm in the face of strange occurrences.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《夷坚三志己》卷二畜生之言何足为信？我已数月来知之矣。见怪不怪，其怪自坏。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《夷堅三志己》卷二畜生之言何足為信？我已數月來知之矣。見怪不怪，其怪自壞。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Hong Mai's 'Yijian Sanzhi Ji': 'How can the words of a beast be trusted? I have known this for months. If you don't find it strange, the strangeness will dissipate.'
example: ～，其怪自败。”不用砍他，随他去就是了。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十四回
exampleTraditional: ～，其怪自敗。”不用砍他，隨他去就是了。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十四回
exampleEn: If you don't find it strange, the strangeness will defeat itself. Don't bother with him; just let him be. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 94

explanation: 逸安逸。辛苦一次，把事情办好，以后就可以不再费力了。
explanationTraditional: 逸安逸。辛苦一次，把事情辦好，以後就可以不再費力了。
explanationEn: To get something done once and for all; to make a permanent solution with one effort.
derivation: 汉·班固《封燕然山铭》兹可谓一劳而久逸，暂费而永无宁者也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·班固《封燕然山銘》茲可謂一勞而久逸，暫費而永無寧者也。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Ban Gu's 'Inscription on Mount Yanran': 'This can be called a single effort bringing long-lasting ease, a temporary expense bringing eternal peace.'
example: ～”的话，有是有的，而～”的事却极少。★鲁迅《花边文学·再论重译》
exampleTraditional: ～”的話，有是有的，而～”的事卻極少。★魯迅《花邊文學·再論重譯》
exampleEn: The saying 'once and for all' exists, but such things are extremely rare. — Lu Xun's 'Essays on Literature'

explanation: 指东西多，眼睛都看不过来。
explanationTraditional: 指東西多，眼睛都看不過來。
explanationEn: So many things to see that the eyes cannot take them all in.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》从山阴道上行，山川自相映发，使人应接不暇。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》從山陰道上行，山川自相映發，使人應接不暇。”
derivationEn: Southern Song Dynasty, Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'Walking on the Shanyin road, the mountains and rivers reflect each other, making one unable to take them all in.'
example: 一切艺术的道理也是这样，单一必然导致枯燥。而丰富多采、～则是绝大多数人所欢迎的。★秦牧《菊花与金鱼》
exampleTraditional: 一切藝術的道理也是這樣，單一必然導致枯燥。而豐富多采、～則是絕大多數人所歡迎的。★秦牧《菊花與金魚》
exampleEn: The same is true for all arts: monotony leads to boredom, while diversity and abundance are welcomed by most. — Qin Mu's 'Chrysanthemums and Goldfish'

explanation: 热气蒸腾的样子。形容气氛热烈或情绪高涨。
explanationTraditional: 熱氣蒸騰的樣子。形容氣氛熱烈或情緒高漲。
explanationEn: Steaming hot; describes a lively atmosphere or high spirits.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《中国现在记》第十一回只见小和用一个小托盘托了几碗盖碗茶，热气腾腾的端过来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《中國現在記》第十一回只見小和用一個小托盤託了幾碗蓋碗茶，熱氣騰騰的端過來。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'China Now': 'He saw a small tray with several covered bowls of tea, steaming hot, brought over.'
example: 中国是处在大革命中，全中国～。★毛泽东《丢掉幻想，准备斗争》
exampleTraditional: 中國是處在大革命中，全中國～。★毛澤東《丟掉幻想，準備鬥爭》
exampleEn: China is in the midst of a great revolution, and the whole country is seething with enthusiasm. — Mao Zedong, 'Discard Illusions, Prepare for Struggle'

explanation: 脍切细的肉；炙烤熟的肉。脍和炙都是人们爱吃的食物。指美味人人爱吃。比喻好的诗文受到人们和称赞和传讼。
explanationTraditional: 膾切細的肉；炙烤熟的肉。膾和炙都是人們愛吃的食物。指美味人人愛吃。比喻好的詩文受到人們和稱讚和傳訟。
explanationEn: A metaphor for good literary works that are widely praised and enjoyed by many people.
derivation: 五代·王定宝《唐摭言》卷十如‘水声常在耳，山色不离门’，又‘扫地树留影，拂床琴有声’……皆脍炙人口。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·王定寶《唐摭言》卷十如‘水聲常在耳，山色不離門’，又‘掃地樹留影，拂床琴有聲’……皆膾炙人口。”
derivationEn: From 'Tang Zhi Yan' by Wang Dingbao of the Five Dynasties: 'Verses like 'The sound of water is always in the ear, the color of mountains never leaves the door' and 'Sweeping the ground, the tree leaves a shadow; dusting the bed, the zither has sound'... are all widely acclaimed.'
example: 一部～的《国风》与《小雅》，也是三百篇”的最精采部分，便是诗歌合作中最美满的成绩。★闻一多《歌与诗》
exampleTraditional: 一部～的《國風》與《小雅》，也是三百篇”的最精采部分，便是詩歌合作中最美滿的成績。★聞一多《歌與詩》
exampleEn: A widely acclaimed 'Guofeng' and 'Xiaoya' are the most brilliant parts of the 'Three Hundred Poems', and are the most perfect achievements in poetic cooperation. ★ Wen Yiduo 'Song and Poetry'

explanation: 事事前一事”为动词，做；后一事”为名词，事情。闲着什么事都不干。
explanationTraditional: 事事前一事”為動詞，做；後一事”為名詞，事情。閒著什麼事都不幹。
explanationEn: To have nothing to do; to be idle and do nothing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 上承总统指挥，下受委员成议，镇（整）日间～，反象似赘瘤一般。（蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一五回）
exampleTraditional: 上承總統指揮，下受委員成議，鎮（整）日間～，反象似贅瘤一般。（蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一五回）
exampleEn: Under the command of the president and the decisions of the committee, he was idle all day, like an unnecessary appendage. (Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China' Chapter 15)

explanation: 甚很；嚣喧嚷。人声喧嚷，尘土飞扬。原形容军中正忙于准备的状态◇来形容消息普遍淬，议论纷纷。现多指反动言论十分嚣张。
explanationTraditional: 甚很；囂喧嚷。人聲喧嚷，塵土飛揚。原形容軍中正忙於準備的狀態◇來形容消息普遍淬，議論紛紛。現多指反動言論十分囂張。
explanationEn: Originally described the bustling state of military preparations; now refers to widespread discussion or rampant reactionary言论.
derivation: 《左传·成公十六年》王曰‘合谋也，张幕矣。’（伯州犁）曰‘虔卜於先君也，徹幕矣。’（楚王）曰‘将发命也。甚嚣，且尘上矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公十六年》王曰‘合謀也，張幕矣。’（伯州犁）曰‘虔卜於先君也，徹幕矣。’（楚王）曰‘將發命也。甚囂，且塵上矣。’”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The Sixteenth Year of Duke Cheng': 'The king said, 'They are consulting together, setting up tents.' (Bo Zhouli) said, 'They are divining before the former rulers, removing the tents.' (The king of Chu) said, 'They are about to issue orders. It is very noisy, and the dust is rising.'
example: 虽已电令燮元代理督军，同时苏人争请废督，～。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一百二十二回
exampleTraditional: 雖已電令燮元代理督軍，同時蘇人爭請廢督，～。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一百二十二回
exampleEn: Although he had telegraphed to appoint Xie Yuan as acting governor, the people of Jiangsu were simultaneously demanding the abolition of the governorship, and the clamor was widespread. ★ Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China' Chapter 122

explanation: 我待待我”的倒装，等待我。时间不会等待我们。指要抓紧时间。
explanationTraditional: 我待待我”的倒裝，等待我。時間不會等待我們。指要抓緊時間。
explanationEn: Time waits for no one; one must seize the moment.
derivation: 《论语·阳货》日月逝矣，岁不我与。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·陽貨》日月逝矣，歲不我與。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Yang Huo': 'The days and months pass away; the years do not wait for us.'
example: 这项任务十分紧迫，～。
exampleTraditional: 這項任務十分緊迫，～。
exampleEn: This task is very urgent; time waits for no one.

explanation: 原指形成一个整体。现多形容感情融洽，成为一体。
explanationTraditional: 原指形成一個整體。現多形容感情融洽，成為一體。
explanationEn: To become one integrated whole; to be in harmony with each other.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十五老僧四十年方打成一片。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十五老僧四十年方打成一片。”
derivationEn: From 'Five Lamps Meeting at the Source' by Shi Puji of the Song Dynasty: 'It took the old monk forty years to become one piece.'
example: 扬弃知识阶级的绅士身分，提高大众的鉴赏水准，这样～，平民化，大众化。★朱自清《论通俗化》
exampleTraditional: 揚棄知識階級的紳士身分，提高大眾的鑑賞水準，這樣～，平民化，大眾化。★朱自清《論通俗化》
exampleEn: To discard the gentlemanly status of the intellectual class, to raise the public's appreciation level, and thus to become one piece, popularized and democratized. ★ Zhu Ziqing 'On Popularization'

explanation: 成制定，形成。一经形成，不再改变。
explanationTraditional: 成制定，形成。一經形成，不再改變。
explanationEn: Once formed, it never changes; immutable.
derivation: 《礼记·王制》一成而不可变，故君子尽心焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·王制》一成而不可變，故君子盡心焉。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Royal Regulations': 'Once established, it cannot be changed, so the gentleman devotes his heart to it.'
example: 事物都是在发展的，世界上没有～的东西。
exampleTraditional: 事物都是在發展的，世界上沒有～的東西。
exampleEn: Things are always developing; there is nothing in the world that is immutable.

explanation: 把怨恨藏在心里。形容对人记下仇恨，以伺机报复。
explanationTraditional: 把怨恨藏在心裡。形容對人記下仇恨，以伺機報復。
explanationEn: To harbor resentment in one's heart; to bear a grudge.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》第二十四回知县听玉姐说了一会，叫‘皮氏，想你见那男子弃旧迎新，你怀恨在心，药死亲夫，此情理或有之。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》第二十四回知縣聽玉姐說了一會，叫‘皮氏，想你見那男子棄舊迎新，你懷恨在心，藥死親夫，此情理或有之。’”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World' Chapter 24: 'The magistrate listened to Yujie for a while, then said, 'Pishi, I think you saw that man abandon the old for the new, and you harbored resentment, poisoning your husband. This is plausible.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 总的说起来。
explanationTraditional: 總的說起來。
explanationEn: In short; to sum up.
derivation: 《容斋随笔·卷六·洗儿金钱》若总而言之，殆不可胜算。”
derivationTraditional: 《容齋隨筆·卷六·洗兒金錢》若總而言之，殆不可勝算。”
derivationEn: From 'Rong Zhai Essays: Volume 6: Washing Children's Money': 'If we sum it all up, it is almost incalculable.'
example: ～，长征是以我们胜利、敌人失败的结果而千结束。★《毛泽东选集·论反对帝国主义的策略》
exampleTraditional: ～，長征是以我們勝利、敵人失敗的結果而千結束。★《毛澤東選集·論反對帝國主義的策略》
exampleEn: In short, the Long March ended with our victory and the enemy's defeat. ★ Mao Zedong 'On Tactics Against Japanese Imperialism'

explanation: 指说话吞吞吐吐，含混躲闪。亦作支支梧梧”。
explanationTraditional: 指說話吞吞吐吐，含混躲閃。亦作支支梧梧”。
explanationEn: To speak hesitantly, evasively, or ambiguously.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第五回我既这等苦苦相问，你自然就该侃侃而谈，怎么问了半日，你一味的吞吞吐吐，支支吾吾？”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第五回我既這等苦苦相問，你自然就該侃侃而談，怎麼問了半日，你一味的吞吞吐吐，支支吾吾？”
derivationEn: From Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines' Chapter 5: 'Since I have asked you so earnestly, you should speak frankly. But after half a day, you are still stammering and evading.'
example: 指导员觉得黄金宝有点反常，两只眼映着灯闪光，好像含着泪，问他又～地不肯明说。★杨朔《熔炉》
exampleTraditional: 指導員覺得黃金寶有點反常，兩隻眼映著燈閃光，好像含著淚，問他又～地不肯明說。★楊朔《熔爐》
exampleEn: The指导员 felt that Huang Jinbao was acting strangely; his eyes glistened in the light as if holding tears, and when asked, he was evasive and unwilling to speak clearly. ★ Yang Shuo 'Furnace'

explanation: 艰难困苦地创办事业。
explanationTraditional: 艱難困苦地創辦事業。
explanationEn: To start an undertaking under difficult and arduous conditions.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他经过艰苦创业终于使公司壮大起来。
exampleTraditional: 他經過艱苦創業終於使公司壯大起來。
exampleEn: Through hard work and arduous efforts, he finally built up the company.

explanation: 务从事。指丢下本职工作不做，去搞其他的事情。
explanationTraditional: 務從事。指丟下本職工作不做，去搞其他的事情。
explanationEn: To neglect one's proper duties or profession and engage in other activities.
derivation: 明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第一回这人不甚读书，终日闲游浪荡，一自父母亡后，分外不务正业。”
derivationTraditional: 明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第一回這人不甚讀書，終日閒遊浪蕩，一自父母亡後，分外不務正業。”
derivationEn: From the first chapter of 'The Plum in the Golden Vase' by Ming dynasty author Lanling Xiaoxiao Sheng: 'This man did not study much, idled about all day, and after his parents died, he especially neglected his proper duties.'
example: 在那时候他们是被骂为～的青年，但没人知道当时的社会已无青年们可务的正业。★郭沫若《少年时代·我的童年》
exampleTraditional: 在那時候他們是被罵為～的青年，但沒人知道當時的社會已無青年們可務的正業。★郭沫若《少年時代·我的童年》
exampleEn: At that time, they were scolded as youths who neglected their proper duties, but no one knew that society at that time had no proper duties for youths to engage in. — Guo Moruo, 'Childhood: My Childhood'

explanation: 形容非常贫穷。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常貧窮。
explanationEn: To have not a single coin on one; extremely poor.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他北上求职，却遭到扒手扒窃，～，求告无门。
exampleTraditional: 他北上求職，卻遭到扒手扒竊，～，求告無門。
exampleEn: He went north to seek a job, but was pickpocketed, leaving him penniless and with no one to turn to.

explanation: 别另外。另有一种独特的风格。
explanationTraditional: 別另外。另有一種獨特的風格。
explanationEn: To have a unique style; distinctive.
derivation: 清·吕留良《与施愚山书》咏见赠诗，风力又别具一格。”
derivationTraditional: 清·呂留良《與施愚山書》詠見贈詩，風力又別具一格。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty author Lü Liuliang's 'Letter to Shi Yushan': 'The poem you presented to me has a unique style in its power.'
example: 这个画家的人物画拙中见巧，～。
exampleTraditional: 這個畫家的人物畫拙中見巧，～。
exampleEn: This painter's figure paintings are clumsy yet clever, with a unique style.

explanation: 治好惭人挽救过来。比喻帮助犯错误的人改正错误。
explanationTraditional: 治好慚人挽救過來。比喻幫助犯錯誤的人改正錯誤。
explanationEn: To cure the illness and save the patient; metaphorically, to help someone who has made mistakes to correct them.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 对犯有错误的同学，我们应采取治病救人的态度，帮助他们进步。
exampleTraditional: 對犯有錯誤的同學，我們應採取治病救人的態度，幫助他們進步。
exampleEn: Towards classmates who have made mistakes, we should adopt an attitude of 'curing the illness to save the patient' and help them improve.

explanation: 岌岌山高陡峭，就要倒下的样子。形容非常危险，快要倾覆或灭亡。
explanationTraditional: 岌岌山高陡峭，就要倒下的樣子。形容非常危險，快要傾覆或滅亡。
explanationEn: In imminent danger; precarious; on the verge of collapse or extinction.
derivation: 《孟子·万章下》于斯是也，天下殆哉，岌岌乎！”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章下》於斯是也，天下殆哉，岌岌乎！”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Wan Zhang II': 'At this point, the world is in danger, precarious indeed!'
example: 人声越发嘈杂，甚至拿砖头撞的二门冬冬的响，其势～。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第三回
exampleTraditional: 人聲越發嘈雜，甚至拿磚頭撞的二門鼕鼕的響，其勢～。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第三回
exampleEn: The noise grew louder, and even the second gate was being banged with bricks, making the situation extremely precarious. — Qing dynasty Li Baojia, 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 3

explanation: 丰大。伟大的功绩。
explanationTraditional: 豐大。偉大的功績。
explanationEn: Great achievements and merits; magnificent contributions.
derivation: 清·张春帆《宦海》第六回这位章制军在两广做了几年，也没有什么丰功伟绩。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張春帆《宦海》第六回這位章制軍在兩廣做了幾年，也沒有什麼豐功偉績。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Zhang Chunfan's 'The Sea of Officialdom', Chapter 6: 'This Governor Zhang served in Guangdong and Guangxi for several years without any great achievements.'
example: 纪念他在辛亥革命时期，领导人民推翻帝制、建立共和国的～。★毛泽东《纪念孙中山先生》
exampleTraditional: 紀念他在辛亥革命時期，領導人民推翻帝制、建立共和國的～。★毛澤東《紀念孫中山先生》
exampleEn: Commemorate his great achievements in leading the people to overthrow the monarchy and establish a republic during the Xinhai Revolution. — Mao Zedong, 'In Memory of Dr. Sun Yat-sen'

explanation: 比喻能帮助自己改正缺点的人或意见。
explanationTraditional: 比喻能幫助自己改正缺點的人或意見。
explanationEn: Stones from other hills; metaphorically, advice or criticism from others that can help one improve oneself.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·鹤鸣》他山之石，可以为错。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·鶴鳴》他山之石，可以為錯。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Xiaoya: He Ming': 'Stones from other hills can be used to polish jade.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指回避重的责任，只拣轻的来承担。也指回避要点，只谈无关紧要的事情。
explanationTraditional: 指回避重的責任，只揀輕的來承擔。也指回避要點，只談無關緊要的事情。
explanationEn: To avoid the heavy and take the light; to shirk serious responsibilities and choose easier ones; also, to avoid key points and talk about trivial matters.
derivation: 唐·李林甫《唐六典·工部尚书》技能功巧者，不得隐巧补拙，避重就轻。”宋·刘挚《侍御史黄君墓志铭》民始不以多男为患，父子始不以避重就轻相去。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李林甫《唐六典·工部尚書》技能功巧者，不得隱巧補拙，避重就輕。”宋·劉摯《侍御史黃君墓誌銘》民始不以多男為患，父子始不以避重就輕相去。”
derivationEn: From Tang dynasty Li Linfu's 'Tang Liudian: Ministry of Works': 'Those with skills should not hide their cleverness and show clumsiness, avoiding the heavy and taking the light.' Also from Song dynasty Liu Zhi's 'Epitaph of Imperial Censor Huang': 'The people no longer considered having many sons a burden, and fathers and sons no longer avoided the heavy and took the light.'
example: 恐将来弄出大祸，所以借了一件失察的事情参的，倒是～的意思，也未可知。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百二回
exampleTraditional: 恐將來弄出大禍，所以借了一件失察的事情參的，倒是～的意思，也未可知。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百二回
exampleEn: I fear that it will lead to a big disaster later, so I used a matter of negligence to impeach him; this is probably a way to avoid the heavy and take the light. — Qing dynasty Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 102

explanation: 部、班门类，次序；就归于。按照一定的步骤、顺序进行。也指按老规矩办事，缺乏创新精神。
explanationTraditional: 部、班門類，次序；就歸於。按照一定的步驟、順序進行。也指按老規矩辦事，缺乏創新精神。
explanationEn: To follow the prescribed order; to proceed step by step; also, to stick to old routines and lack innovation.
derivation: 晋·陆机《文赋》然后选义案部，考辞就班。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陸機《文賦》然後選義案部，考辭就班。”
derivationEn: From Jin dynasty Lu Ji's 'Essay on Literature': 'Then select the meaning according to the category, and arrange the words in order.'
example: 但黄公俊的祖父，他开始读了书，象一般读书人似的，他～的要将八股型的才学，货与帝王家”。★郑振铎《黄公俊之最后》
exampleTraditional: 但黃公俊的祖父，他開始讀了書，象一般讀書人似的，他～的要將八股型的才學，貨與帝王家”。★鄭振鐸《黃公俊之最後》
exampleEn: But Huang Gongjun's grandfather, when he began to read, like most scholars, he followed the prescribed order to sell his eight-legged essay talent to the emperor. — Zheng Zhenduo, 'The Last of Huang Gongjun'

explanation: 形容形势或文笔等突然转变，并且很快地顺势发展下去。
explanationTraditional: 形容形勢或文筆等突然轉變，並且很快地順勢發展下去。
explanationEn: To take a sudden turn and develop rapidly; to change abruptly and continue swiftly.
derivation: 叶剑英《伟大的战略决战》由于迅速而顺利地取得了辽沈战役的胜利，就使全国战局急转直下，使原来预计的战争进程大为缩短。”
derivationTraditional: 葉劍英《偉大的戰略決戰》由於迅速而順利地取得了遼瀋戰役的勝利，就使全國戰局急轉直下，使原來預計的戰爭進程大為縮短。”
derivationEn: From Ye Jianying's 'The Great Strategic Decisive Battle': 'Because the Liaoshen Campaign was won quickly and smoothly, the national war situation took a sudden turn and developed rapidly, greatly shortening the originally expected war process.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 做一件事得到两方面的好处。
explanationTraditional: 做一件事得到兩方面的好處。
explanationEn: To achieve two benefits from a single action.
derivation: 《晋书·束皙传》赐其十年炎复，以慰重迁之情，一举两得，外实内宽。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·束皙傳》賜其十年炎復，以慰重遷之情，一舉兩得，外實內寬。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Shu Xi': 'Grant them ten years of tax exemption to comfort their feelings of relocation, killing two birds with one stone, strengthening the border and enriching the interior.'
example: 一则免楚之患，二则激晋之来，岂非～？★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第六十一回
exampleTraditional: 一則免楚之患，二則激晉之來，豈非～？★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第六十一回
exampleEn: First, to eliminate the threat from Chu, and second, to provoke Jin to come. Isn't this killing two birds with one stone? — Ming Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 61

explanation: 兴原指志趣，后指兴致；采原指神采，后指精神；烈旺盛。原指文章志趣高尚，言词犀利◇多形容兴致高，精神饱满。
explanationTraditional: 興原指志趣，後指興致；採原指神采，後指精神；烈旺盛。原指文章志趣高尚，言詞犀利◇多形容興致高，精神飽滿。
explanationEn: In high spirits; elated; exuberant.
derivation: 南朝梁·刘勰《文心雕龙·体性》步夜俊侠，故兴高而采烈。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝梁·劉勰《文心雕龍·體性》步夜俊俠，故興高而采烈。”
derivationEn: From Liu Xie's 'The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons: Style and Nature' (Southern Dynasties): 'Bu Ye was chivalrous and unrestrained, so his interest was high and his expression was intense.'
example: 阿二忽然对于曾沧海的威吓全没怕惧，反而～的说起来了。（茅盾《子夜》四）
exampleTraditional: 阿二忽然對於曾滄海的威嚇全沒怕懼，反而～的說起來了。（茅盾《子夜》四）
exampleEn: A Er suddenly lost all fear of Zeng Canghai's threats and instead spoke with great elation. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 4

explanation: 心思想；协合。团结一致，共同努力。
explanationTraditional: 心思想；協合。團結一致，共同努力。
explanationEn: To work together with one heart and one mind; to unite in a concerted effort.
derivation: 汉·贾谊《过秦论》且天下尝同心并力攻秦矣，然困于险阻而不能进者，岂勇力智慧不足哉？”《周书·崔谦传》然后与宇文行台，同心协力，电讨不庭，则桓文之勋，复兴于兹日矣。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·賈誼《過秦論》且天下嘗同心並力攻秦矣，然困於險阻而不能進者，豈勇力智慧不足哉？”《周書·崔謙傳》然後與宇文行臺，同心協力，電討不庭，則桓文之勳，復興於茲日矣。”
derivationEn: From Jia Yi's 'On the Faults of Qin' (Han Dynasty): 'Moreover, the world once united to attack Qin, but was trapped by obstacles and could not advance. Was it due to lack of courage and wisdom?' And from 'Book of Zhou: Biography of Cui Qian': 'Then, together with Yuwen Xingtai, we will work in unison to punish the disobedient, and the achievements of Huan and Wen will be revived today.'
example: 只要我们大家～，就没有克服不了的困难。
exampleTraditional: 只要我們大家～，就沒有克服不了的困難。
exampleEn: As long as we all work together, there is no difficulty we cannot overcome.

explanation: 侃侃理直气壮，从容不迫。理直气壮、从容不迫地说话。
explanationTraditional: 侃侃理直氣壯，從容不迫。理直氣壯、從容不迫地說話。
explanationEn: To speak with confidence and composure; to talk in a calm and unhurried manner.
derivation: 《论语·乡党》朝，与下大夫言，侃侃如也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·鄉黨》朝，與下大夫言，侃侃如也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Xiangdang': 'At court, when speaking with lower officials, he was affable and composed.'
example: 却从来不曾见过象这位蛮子般的那末～，旁若无人的气概。★郑振铎《桂公塘·三》
exampleTraditional: 卻從來不曾見過象這位蠻子般的那末～，旁若無人的氣概。★鄭振鐸《桂公塘·三》
exampleEn: But he had never seen anyone like this barbarian who spoke so confidently and with such an air of disregard for others. — Zheng Zhenduo, 'Gui Gong Tang', Part 3

explanation: 由于羞愧到了极点，下不了台而发怒。
explanationTraditional: 由於羞愧到了極點，下不了臺而發怒。
explanationEn: To become angry from shame; to fly into a rage from embarrassment.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十一回乌额拉布见田小辫子说出这样的话来，便也恼羞成怒。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十一回烏額拉布見田小辮子說出這樣的話來，便也惱羞成怒。”
derivationEn: From Qing Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats Revealed', Chapter 31: 'Ulabu, hearing Tian Xiaobianzi say such things, became angry from shame.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 壤地。天和地，一极在上，一级在下，比喻差别极大。
explanationTraditional: 壤地。天和地，一極在上，一級在下，比喻差別極大。
explanationEn: As different as heaven and earth; a world of difference.
derivation: 《抱朴子·内篇·论仙》趋舍所尚，耳目之欲，其为不同，已有天壤之觉（较），冰炭之乖矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《抱朴子·內篇·論仙》趨舍所尚，耳目之欲，其為不同，已有天壤之覺（較），冰炭之乖矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Baopuzi: Inner Chapters: On Immortals': 'The preferences and desires of the ears and eyes are as different as heaven and earth, and as ice and charcoal.'
example: 按照一般人的生理机能来说，聪明与不聪明虽有差别，但并不存在～。
exampleTraditional: 按照一般人的生理機能來說，聰明與不聰明雖有差別，但並不存在～。
exampleEn: According to the normal physiological functions of people, although there are differences between the intelligent and the unintelligent, it is not a world of difference.

explanation: 咄咄使人惊奇的声音。形容气势汹汹，盛气凌人，使人难堪。也指形势发展迅速，给人压力。
explanationTraditional: 咄咄使人驚奇的聲音。形容氣勢洶洶，盛氣凌人，使人難堪。也指形勢發展迅速，給人壓力。
explanationEn: Overbearing; aggressive; threatening; also used to describe a situation that develops rapidly and puts pressure on people.
derivation: 晋·卫铄《与释某书》卫有一弟子王逸少，甚能学卫真书，咄咄逼人。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·衛鑠《與釋某書》衛有一弟子王逸少，甚能學衛真書，咄咄逼人。”
derivationEn: From Jin Wei Shuo's 'Letter to Shi Mou': 'Wei has a disciple named Wang Yishao, who is very good at learning Wei's regular script, and his skill is intimidating.'
example: 书中攻击杨朱、墨翟两派，辞锋～。★朱自清《经典常谈·四书第七》
exampleTraditional: 書中攻擊楊朱、墨翟兩派，辭鋒～。★朱自清《經典常談·四書第七》
exampleEn: The book attacks the schools of Yang Zhu and Mo Di, and its rhetoric is aggressive. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Introductions: Four Books, Seventh'

explanation: 一千篇文章都一个样。指文章公式化。也比喻办事按一个格式，非常机械。
explanationTraditional: 一千篇文章都一個樣。指文章公式化。也比喻辦事按一個格式，非常機械。
explanationEn: A thousand articles are all the same; stereotyped; following a single pattern.
derivation: 南朝梁·钟嵘《诗品》卷中张公虽复千篇，犹一体耳。”宋·苏轼《答王庠书》今程试文字，千人一律，考官亦厌之。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝梁·鍾嶸《詩品》卷中張公雖復千篇，猶一體耳。”宋·蘇軾《答王庠書》今程試文字，千人一律，考官亦厭之。”
derivationEn: From Zhong Rong's 'The Poetic Grades' (Southern Liang): 'Although Zhang Gong wrote a thousand poems, they are all of one style.' And from Su Shi's 'Letter to Wang Xiang': 'Now the examination essays are all the same, and the examiners are tired of them.'
example: 她又开始说起～的恳求的话语来了。★沙汀《磁力》
exampleTraditional: 她又開始說起～的懇求的話語來了。★沙汀《磁力》
exampleEn: She began to speak her stereotyped pleading words again. — Sha Ding, 'Magnetic Force'

explanation: 连一步都难以进行。形容走路困难。也比喻处境艰难。
explanationTraditional: 連一步都難以進行。形容走路困難。也比喻處境艱難。
explanationEn: Unable to move even a single step; to have difficulty walking; also metaphorically means to be in a difficult situation.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《九日寄岑参》出门复入门，雨脚但如旧。所向泥活活，思君令人瘦……寸步曲江头，难为一相就。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《九日寄岑參》出門復入門，雨腳但如舊。所向泥活活，思君令人瘦……寸步曲江頭，難為一相就。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's 'To Cen Shen on the Ninth Day' (Tang Dynasty): 'Going out and coming in again, the rain continues as before. The mud is so sticky that I think of you and feel thin... At Qujiang, even an inch of step is hard to take.'
example: 美娘赤了脚，～。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三
exampleTraditional: 美娘赤了腳，～。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三
exampleEn: Meiniang, barefoot, could not move an inch. — Ming Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 3

explanation: 嘘缓缓吹气。形容对人的生活十分关切，问冷问热。
explanationTraditional: 噓緩緩吹氣。形容對人的生活十分關切，問冷問熱。
explanationEn: To inquire about someone's warmth and cold; to show great concern for someone's well-being.
derivation: 冰心《关于女人·我最尊敬体贴她们》孩子们安静听话，太太笑脸相迎，嘘寒问暖。”
derivationTraditional: 冰心《關於女人·我最尊敬體貼她們》孩子們安靜聽話，太太笑臉相迎，噓寒問暖。”
derivationEn: From Bing Xin's 'About Women: The One I Respect and Love Most': 'The children are quiet and obedient, the wife greets with a smile, inquiring about warmth and cold.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 失耽误，错过。时机具有时间性的机会。不错过当前的机会。指办事要抓住适宜的时间和有利的机会。
explanationTraditional: 失耽誤，錯過。時機具有時間性的機會。不錯過當前的機會。指辦事要抓住適宜的時間和有利的機會。
explanationEn: Not missing the opportune moment; to seize the right time to act.
derivation: 周恩来《关于党的六大”的研究》这时离国共分裂还有两个月，如果……努力去做，还不失时机。”
derivationTraditional: 周恩來《關於黨的六大”的研究》這時離國共分裂還有兩個月，如果……努力去做，還不失時機。”
derivationEn: Zhou Enlai, 'Research on the Sixth National Congress of the Communist Party of China': 'At that time, there were still two months before the split between the Kuomintang and the Communist Party. If... efforts were made, the opportunity would not be missed.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容说话做事爽快、干脆。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話做事爽快、乾脆。
explanationEn: Straightforward and direct; to speak or act in a blunt and decisive manner.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十五回紫芝妹妹嘴虽利害，好在心口如一，直截了当，倒是一个极爽快的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十五回紫芝妹妹嘴雖利害，好在心口如一，直截了當，倒是一個極爽快的。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 65: 'Although Sister Zizhi has a sharp tongue, fortunately she is straightforward and direct, which is very refreshing.'
example: 他说话、办事～，认真干脆。
exampleTraditional: 他說話、辦事～，認真乾脆。
exampleEn: He speaks and acts straightforwardly and decisively.

explanation: 白手空手；起家创建家业。形容在没有基础和条件很差的情况下自力更生，艰苦创业。
explanationTraditional: 白手空手；起家創建家業。形容在沒有基礎和條件很差的情況下自力更生，艱苦創業。
explanationEn: To start from scratch; to build up a fortune or enterprise with no initial resources.
derivation: 《朱子语类》卷一０七今士大夫白屋起家，以致荣显。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子語類》卷一０七今士大夫白屋起家，以致榮顯。”
derivationEn: 'Zhu Zi Yu Lei', Volume 107: 'Nowadays, scholars start from humble beginnings and rise to glory.'
example: 你看，他发了多少财，～，靠的是谁？如今也忘了水源头了，墙上的草，两边倒着呢。★丁玲《太阳照在桑干河上》
exampleTraditional: 你看，他發了多少財，～，靠的是誰？如今也忘了水源頭了，牆上的草，兩邊倒著呢。★丁玲《太陽照在桑乾河上》
exampleEn: Look, he has made a fortune starting from scratch. Who did he rely on? Now he has forgotten the source of water, like grass on a wall, swaying both ways. — Ding Ling, 'The Sun Shines Over the Sanggan River'

explanation: 人已离去，楼中空空。比喻故地重游时睹物思人的感慨。
explanationTraditional: 人已離去，樓中空空。比喻故地重遊時睹物思人的感慨。
explanationEn: The person has left, and the building is empty; a feeling of nostalgia when revisiting a place after someone has gone.
derivation: 唐·崔颢《黄鹤楼》诗昔人已乘黄鹤去，此地空余黄鹤楼。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·崔顥《黃鶴樓》詩昔人已乘黃鶴去，此地空餘黃鶴樓。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Cui Hao, 'Yellow Crane Tower': 'The sage has gone riding a yellow crane, leaving only the Yellow Crane Tower here.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 置放，摆；若好象。放在一边，好象没有听见似的。指不予理睬。
explanationTraditional: 置放，擺；若好象。放在一邊，好象沒有聽見似的。指不予理睬。
explanationEn: To turn a deaf ear to; to ignore something as if not hearing it.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十六回宁荣两府上下内外人等，莫不置若罔闻，独有宝玉～。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十六回寧榮兩府上下內外人等，莫不置若罔聞，獨有寶玉～。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 16: 'All people, high and low, in the Ning and Rong mansions turned a deaf ear, only Baoyu...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 瞪瞪着眼；结舌说不出话来。瞪着眼睛说不出话来。形容窘困或惊呆的样子。
explanationTraditional: 瞪瞪著眼；結舌說不出話來。瞪著眼睛說不出話來。形容窘困或驚呆的樣子。
explanationEn: To stare wide-eyed and tongue-tied; to be stunned or speechless with astonishment.
