derivation: 清·霁园主人《夜谭随录·梨花》因耳语其故，公子大骇，入舱隐叩细君，细君结舌瞠目。”
derivationTraditional: 清·霽園主人《夜譚隨錄·梨花》因耳語其故，公子大駭，入艙隱叩細君，細君結舌瞠目。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Jiyuan Zhuren, 'Night Talks by the Candle', 'Pear Blossom': 'He whispered the reason in her ear, and the young man was greatly shocked. He went into the cabin and quietly asked his wife, who was tongue-tied and wide-eyed.'
example: 他问每个同学的时候，别的同学也不得不倾耳静听，注意前后情节的线索，否则突然问到，便不免～，不知所答。★邹韬奋《经历》
exampleTraditional: 他問每個同學的時候，別的同學也不得不傾耳靜聽，注意前後情節的線索，否則突然問到，便不免～，不知所答。★鄒韜奮《經歷》
exampleEn: When he questioned each student, the others had to listen attentively and follow the plot, otherwise they would be caught off guard and stare wide-eyed, unable to answer. — Zou Taofen, 'Experiences'

explanation: 跋涉翻山越岭、趟水过河。指远距离的翻山渡水。形容路途遥远，行路辛苦。
explanationTraditional: 跋涉翻山越嶺、趟水過河。指遠距離的翻山渡水。形容路途遙遠，行路辛苦。
explanationEn: A long and arduous journey; to travel a great distance over mountains and rivers.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第六十六回岳夫人道‘……怎敢劳姐长途跋涉，决难从命。’”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第六十六回嶽夫人道‘……怎敢勞姐長途跋涉，決難從命。’”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 66: 'Lady Yue said, '...How dare I trouble you, sister, to make such a long and arduous journey? I absolutely cannot agree.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 连说带笑。形容十分欢快。
explanationTraditional: 連說帶笑。形容十分歡快。
explanationEn: Talking and laughing; to be cheerful and animated in conversation.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《情变》第五回想起昨天晚上，还是有说有笑，相亲相爱的何等有趣，今天晚上变了这个情形。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《情變》第五回想起昨天晚上，還是有說有笑，相親相愛的何等有趣，今天晚上變了這個情形。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'The Change of Sentiment', Chapter 5: 'Recalling last night, they were talking and laughing, loving and affectionate, so interesting; tonight, the situation has changed.'
example: 林边场园里，晒豆子的，打芝麻的，剥包米的，到处～，是一派热闹的丰收景象。★《猎户》
exampleTraditional: 林邊場園裡，曬豆子的，打芝麻的，剝包米的，到處～，是一派熱鬧的豐收景象。★《獵戶》
exampleEn: In the field by the forest, people drying beans, beating sesame, and shelling corn are everywhere talking and laughing, a lively scene of harvest. — 'The Hunter'

explanation: 律约束。严格地约束自己。
explanationTraditional: 律約束。嚴格地約束自己。
explanationEn: To be strict with oneself; to exercise self-discipline.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《谢曾察院君》严于律己，出而见之事功；心乎爱民，动必关天治道。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《謝曾察院君》嚴於律己，出而見之事功；心乎愛民，動必關天治道。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Chen Liang, 'Thanking Supervisor Cai': 'Be strict with oneself, and when acting, see results in achievements; care for the people, and every move must align with the way of governance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 群大家，集体；策谋划，主意。指发挥集体的作用，大家一起来想办法，贡献力量。
explanationTraditional: 群大家，集體；策謀劃，主意。指發揮集體的作用，大家一起來想辦法，貢獻力量。
explanationEn: To pool wisdom and efforts; to work together as a group to solve problems and contribute strength.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·重黎》汉屈群策，群策屈群力。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·重黎》漢屈群策，群策屈群力。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Yang Xiong, 'Model Sayings', 'Chongli': 'Han used the collective wisdom of the masses, and the collective wisdom used the collective strength of the masses.'
example: 至于自强之道，求其在我，祸福无门，唯人自召。～，庶有成功。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 至於自強之道，求其在我，禍福無門，唯人自召。～，庶有成功。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第四十四回
exampleEn: As for the path to self-strengthening, it lies in our own efforts. Misfortune and fortune have no fixed door; they are summoned by people themselves. By pooling wisdom and efforts, we may achieve success. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 44

explanation: 鉴镜子，为教训。前面车子翻倒的教训。比喻先前的失败，可以做为以后的教训。
explanationTraditional: 鑑鏡子，為教訓。前面車子翻倒的教訓。比喻先前的失敗，可以做為以後的教訓。
explanationEn: A lesson from the failure of one's predecessor; a warning from past mistakes.
derivation: 《荀子·成相》前车已覆，后未知更何觉时！”汉·刘向《说苑·善说》前车覆，后车戒。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·成相》前車已覆，後未知更何覺時！”漢·劉向《說苑·善說》前車覆，後車戒。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi: 'The cart ahead has overturned; the one behind does not know when to be alert.' Also from Liu Xiang's Garden of Stories: 'The cart ahead overturns; the cart behind should take warning.'
example: ～，请自三思。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: ～，請自三思。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第二十五回
exampleEn: Please think carefully about this lesson from the past. — Chen Chen, Water Margin Sequel, Chapter 25

explanation: 一下子全都围上去。形容周围的人同时向一个目标猛挤过去。
explanationTraditional: 一下子全都圍上去。形容周圍的人同時向一個目標猛擠過去。
explanationEn: To swarm forward all at once; to crowd around a target simultaneously.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十七回吕蒙亲自擂鼓，士卒皆一拥而上，乱刀砍死朱光。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十七回呂蒙親自擂鼓，士卒皆一擁而上，亂刀砍死朱光。”
derivationEn: From Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Chapter 67: 'Lü Meng personally beat the drum, and the soldiers all swarmed forward, cutting down Zhu Guang with random knives.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 违犯法令，破坏纲纪。
explanationTraditional: 違犯法令，破壞綱紀。
explanationEn: To violate the law and disrupt discipline; to break rules and regulations.
derivation: 《后汉书·袁绍刘表列传上》而便放志专行，威劫省禁，卑侮王僚，败法乱纪，坐召三台，专制朝政。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·袁紹劉表列傳上》而便放志專行，威劫省禁，卑侮王僚，敗法亂紀，坐召三臺，專制朝政。”
derivationEn: From Book of the Later Han: 'They indulged their ambitions, acted arbitrarily, bullied officials, corrupted laws, and disrupted discipline.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 重大的政策与措施，引导事业前进的方向和指针。
explanationTraditional: 重大的政策與措施，引導事業前進的方向和指針。
explanationEn: Major policies and measures that guide the direction of an enterprise or cause.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第三十八回颇欲展施抱负，造成一法治国，所以一经就任，便草就大政方针宣言书，拟向国会宣布。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第三十八回頗欲展施抱負，造成一法治國，所以一經就任，便草就大政方針宣言書，擬向國會宣佈。”
derivationEn: From Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu, Popular Romance of the Republic, Chapter 38: 'He wished to display his ambition and create a rule-of-law state, so upon taking office, he drafted a declaration of major policies to announce to the National Assembly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指悲痛的心情平静以后，再追想当时所受的痛苦。超有警惕未来之意。
explanationTraditional: 指悲痛的心情平靜以後，再追想當時所受的痛苦。超有警惕未來之意。
explanationEn: To recall past pain after it has subsided; to reflect on a bitter experience with a warning for the future.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《与李翱书》今而思之，如痛定之人，思当痛之时，不知何能自处也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《與李翱書》今而思之，如痛定之人，思當痛之時，不知何能自處也。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's Letter to Li Ao: 'Now thinking back, like a person whose pain has subsided recalling the time of pain, I do not know how I endured.'
example: 境界危恶，层见错出，非人世所堪。～，痛何如哉！★宋·文天祥《指南录后序》
exampleTraditional: 境界危惡，層見錯出，非人世所堪。～，痛何如哉！★宋·文天祥《指南錄後序》
exampleEn: The situation was perilous and full of horrors beyond human endurance. Recalling the pain after it subsides, how painful it is! — Wen Tianxiang, Preface to Guide Record

explanation: 始开始；终结束。自始自终一个样子。指能坚持，不间断。
explanationTraditional: 始開始；終結束。自始自終一個樣子。指能堅持，不間斷。
explanationEn: Consistent from beginning to end; unswerving; constant.
derivation: 《荀子·议兵》虑必先事而申之以敬，慎终如始，终始如一，夫是之谓大吉。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·議兵》慮必先事而申之以敬，慎終如始，終始如一，夫是之謂大吉。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi: 'One must be cautious from start to finish, consistent throughout; this is called great good fortune.'
example: 吾观关胜义气凛然，～，军师不必多疑。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: 吾觀關勝義氣凜然，～，軍師不必多疑。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十七回
exampleEn: I see Guan Sheng's righteousness is awe-inspiring and consistent; the military advisor need not doubt. — Shi Nai'an, Water Margin, Chapter 67

explanation: 数计算。数都数不过来。形容数量极多，很难计算。
explanationTraditional: 數計算。數都數不過來。形容數量極多，很難計算。
explanationEn: Too numerous to count; countless.
derivation: 《方岩记静》类似这样的奇迹灵异，还数不胜数，所以一年四季，方岩香火不绝，而尤以春秋为盛。”
derivationTraditional: 《方巖記靜》類似這樣的奇蹟靈異，還數不勝數，所以一年四季，方巖香火不絕，而尤以春秋為盛。”
derivationEn: From Record of Fangyan: 'Similar miracles and wonders are too numerous to count, so incense never ceases at Fangyan, especially in spring and autumn.'
example: 我们决不能像旧学校那样，用～的，九分无用一分曲了的知识来充塞青年的头脑。★《论学习共产主义》
exampleTraditional: 我們決不能像舊學校那樣，用～的，九分無用一分曲了的知識來充塞青年的頭腦。★《論學習共產主義》
exampleEn: We must not, like the old schools, cram young minds with countless bits of knowledge that are nine-tenths useless and one-tenth distorted. — On Studying Communism

explanation: 啼哭；皆非都不是。哭也不是，笑也不是，不知如何才好。形容处境尴尬或既令人难受又令人发笑的行为。
explanationTraditional: 啼哭；皆非都不是。哭也不是，笑也不是，不知如何才好。形容處境尷尬或既令人難受又令人發笑的行為。
explanationEn: Not knowing whether to laugh or cry; in an awkward or embarrassing situation.
derivation: 沙汀《烦恼》刘久发啼笑皆非地站起来了。”
derivationTraditional: 沙汀《煩惱》劉久發啼笑皆非地站起來了。”
derivationEn: From Sha Ting's Annoyance: 'Liu Jiufa stood up, not knowing whether to laugh or cry.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 闻听。人家说的不听，也不主动去问。形容对事情不关心。
explanationTraditional: 聞聽。人家說的不聽，也不主動去問。形容對事情不關心。
explanationEn: To neither listen nor ask; to show no interest or concern.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第七十六回也不想想朝廷家平空的丢了一个太守，也就不闻不问，焉有是理。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第七十六回也不想想朝廷家平空的丟了一個太守，也就不聞不問，焉有是理。”
derivationEn: From Shi Yukun's Three Heroes and Five Gallants, Chapter 76: 'How could the court simply lose a prefect and neither inquire nor investigate? That is unreasonable.'
example: 大约这里的环境，本非有利于病，而不能完全～，也是使病缠绵之道。★《鲁迅书信集·致沈雁冰》
exampleTraditional: 大約這裡的環境，本非有利於病，而不能完全～，也是使病纏綿之道。★《魯迅書信集·致沈雁冰》
exampleEn: Probably the environment here is not conducive to illness, and being unable to completely ignore it is also a reason for the lingering disease. — Lu Xun, Letters to Shen Yanbing

explanation: 分不出高低好坏。形容水平相当。
explanationTraditional: 分不出高低好壞。形容水平相當。
explanationEn: Equal in level or quality; comparable; neck and neck.
derivation: 唐·陆龟蒙《蠹化》翳叶仰啮，如饥蚕之速，不相上下。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·陸龜蒙《蠹化》翳葉仰齧，如飢蠶之速，不相上下。”
derivationEn: From Lu Guimeng's On the Moth: 'It hides under leaves and eats upward, as fast as a hungry silkworm, and they are comparable.'
example: 以愚观之，晋楚互为雌雄，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 以愚觀之，晉楚互為雌雄，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五十五回
exampleEn: In my view, Jin and Chu are evenly matched, neither superior. — Feng Menglong, Romance of the Eastern Zhou, Chapter 55

explanation: 一生之中最后的年月，即余年。
explanationTraditional: 一生之中最後的年月，即餘年。
explanationEn: The remaining years of one's life; the rest of one's life.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第68回俾臣得保蚁命，此后有生之年，莫非主上所赐，惟求格外垂怜。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第68回俾臣得保蟻命，此後有生之年，莫非主上所賜，惟求格外垂憐。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 68: 'Allow me to preserve my humble life; henceforth, the remaining years of my life are all bestowed by Your Majesty, and I only beg for extra mercy.'
example: 只好用今后～的辛勤努力，来补偿过去的不足。★秦牧《序》
exampleTraditional: 只好用今後～的辛勤努力，來補償過去的不足。★秦牧《序》
exampleEn: I can only make up for past shortcomings with hard work in the remaining years of my life. — Qin Mu, 'Preface'

explanation: 给供给。依靠自己的生产，满足自己的需要。
explanationTraditional: 給供給。依靠自己的生產，滿足自己的需要。
explanationEn: Self-sufficient; relying on one's own production to meet one's own needs.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·步隲传》种瓜自给。”《列子·黄帝》不施不惠，而物自足。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·步隲傳》種瓜自給。”《列子·黃帝》不施不惠，而物自足。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Bu Zhi': 'Grew melons for self-sufficiency.' And 'Liezi: Huangdi': 'Without giving or receiving, things are self-sufficient.'
example: 人民在党和政府的组织领导下，展开了～的大生产运动。（冯德英《苦菜花》第九章）
exampleTraditional: 人民在黨和政府的組織領導下，展開了～的大生產運動。（馮德英《苦菜花》第九章）
exampleEn: Under the leadership and organization of the Party and government, the people launched a great production movement of self-sufficiency. — Feng Deying, 'Bitter Cauliflower', Chapter 9

explanation: 打草惊了草里的蛇。原比喻惩罚了甲而使乙有所警觉◇多比喻做法不谨慎，反使对方有所戒备。
explanationTraditional: 打草驚了草裡的蛇。原比喻懲罰了甲而使乙有所警覺◇多比喻做法不謹慎，反使對方有所戒備。
explanationEn: To beat the grass and scare the snake; originally meant punishing one person to warn another, but now often means acting carelessly and alerting the opponent.
derivation: 宋·郑文宝《南唐近事》王鲁为当涂宰，颇以资产为务，会部民连状诉主簿贪贿于县尹。鲁乃判曰‘汝虽打草，吾已惊蛇。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·鄭文寶《南唐近事》王魯為當塗宰，頗以資產為務，會部民連狀訴主簿貪賄於縣尹。魯乃判曰‘汝雖打草，吾已驚蛇。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zheng Wenbao's 'Recent Affairs of Southern Tang': 'Wang Lu, as magistrate of Dangtu, was preoccupied with assets. When citizens sued his clerk for bribery, he ruled: 'Though you beat the grass, I have already startled the snake.''
example: 空自去～”，倒吃他做了手脚，却是不好。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第二十九回
exampleTraditional: 空自去～”，倒吃他做了手腳，卻是不好。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第二十九回
exampleEn: If we rashly 'beat the grass and startle the snake', we might alert him and cause trouble. — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 29

explanation: 守望防守了望。为了对付来犯的敌人或意外的灾祸，邻近各村落互相警戒，互相援助。
explanationTraditional: 守望防守瞭望。為了對付來犯的敵人或意外的災禍，鄰近各村落互相警戒，互相援助。
explanationEn: To keep watch and help each other; neighboring villages mutually guard and assist against invaders or disasters.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公上》出入相友，守望相助，疾病相扶持。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公上》出入相友，守望相助，疾病相扶持。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Teng Wen Gong I': 'Go in and out as friends, watch and help each other, support each other in illness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鼓舞振作，奋发。振奋人们的信心。增强人们的勇气。
explanationTraditional: 鼓舞振作，奮發。振奮人們的信心。增強人們的勇氣。
explanationEn: To inspire people; to boost morale and courage.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·先知》鼓舞万物者，雷风乎？鼓舞万从者，号令乎？”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·先知》鼓舞萬物者，雷風乎？鼓舞萬從者，號令乎？”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Yang Xiong's 'Fayan: Xianzhi': 'What inspires all things? Thunder and wind. What inspires the masses? Orders and decrees.'
example: 也不过四处游说，～。★清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第四回
exampleTraditional: 也不過四處遊說，～。★清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第四回
exampleEn: He only traveled around to persuade and inspire people. — Qing Dynasty Lingnan Yiyi Nushi, 'Eastern European Heroines', Chapter 4

explanation: 几个人、几个人在一起。
explanationTraditional: 幾個人、幾個人在一起。
explanationEn: In groups of three or five; people gathering in small groups.
derivation: 明·余继登《典故纪闻》卷十二三五成群，高谈嬉笑。”
derivationTraditional: 明·餘繼登《典故紀聞》卷十二三五成群，高談嬉笑。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Yu Jideng's 'Records of Anecdotes', Volume 12: 'In groups of three or five, they chatted and laughed loudly.'
example: 一般也有轻薄少年及儿童之辈，见他又挑柴，又读书，～，把他嘲笑戏侮。★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷二十七
exampleTraditional: 一般也有輕薄少年及兒童之輩，見他又挑柴，又讀書，～，把他嘲笑戲侮。★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷二十七
exampleEn: There were also frivolous youths and children who, seeing him carrying firewood and reading, gathered in groups to mock and tease him. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New', Volume 27

explanation: 形容声音响亮而有劲。铿镪有节奏而响亮的声音。
explanationTraditional: 形容聲音響亮而有勁。鏗鏹有節奏而響亮的聲音。
explanationEn: Sonorous and forceful; describing a loud and powerful sound.
derivation: 郭小川《痛悼敬爱的周总理》诗我们的总理，回答得最为铿锵有力；不用语言，而用电闪雷鸣般的一生的经历。”
derivationTraditional: 郭小川《痛悼敬愛的周總理》詩我們的總理，回答得最為鏗鏘有力；不用語言，而用電閃雷鳴般的一生的經歷。”
derivationEn: From Guo Xiaochuan's poem 'Deeply Mourning Premier Zhou Enlai': 'Our Premier's reply was most sonorous and forceful; not with words, but with a lifetime of thunderous experience.'
example: 托卡力夫的声音～，完全不是平时那种沙哑的低音。★《筑路》
exampleTraditional: 託卡力夫的聲音～，完全不是平時那種沙啞的低音。★《築路》
exampleEn: Tokarev's voice was sonorous and forceful, completely unlike his usual hoarse whisper. — 'Building the Railway'

explanation: 指人们前脚跟着后脚，接连不断地来。形容来者很多，络绎不绝。
explanationTraditional: 指人們前腳跟著後腳，接連不斷地來。形容來者很多，絡繹不絕。
explanationEn: To come one after another; to follow in quick succession.
derivation: 《宋史·李显忠传》入城，宣布德意，不戮一人，中原归附者踵接。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·李顯忠傳》入城，宣佈德意，不戮一人，中原歸附者踵接。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Li Xianzhong': 'Entered the city, proclaimed virtue, killed no one, and those from the Central Plains who submitted came one after another.'
example: 整个的新饭碗”一时虽未找到，零碎的小事却～。★邹韬奋《经历·新饭碗问题》
exampleTraditional: 整個的新飯碗”一時雖未找到，零碎的小事卻～。★鄒韜奮《經歷·新飯碗問題》
exampleEn: Although the 'new rice bowl' was not yet found, trivial tasks came one after another. — Zou Taofen, 'Experience: The New Rice Bowl Issue'

explanation: 悦目看了舒服。指看到美好的景色而心情愉快。
explanationTraditional: 悅目看了舒服。指看到美好的景色而心情愉快。
explanationEn: Pleasing to the eye and heart; referring to the joy felt when seeing beautiful scenery.
derivation: 鲁迅《故事新编·采薇》两人到山脚下一看，只见新叶嫩碧，土地金黄，野草开着些红红白白的小花，真是连看看也赏心悦目。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《故事新編·采薇》兩人到山腳下一看，只見新葉嫩碧，土地金黃，野草開著些紅紅白白的小花，真是連看看也賞心悅目。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Old Tales Retold: Picking Vetch': 'When they reached the foot of the mountain, they saw tender green leaves, golden earth, and wildflowers in red and white—truly pleasing to the eye and heart.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 晚上连着白天。形容加紧工作或学习。
explanationTraditional: 晚上連著白天。形容加緊工作或學習。
explanationEn: Day and night; working or studying continuously without rest.
derivation: 《庄子·至乐》夫贵者，夜以继日，思虑善否。”《孟子·离娄下》仰而思之，夜以继日。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·至樂》夫貴者，夜以繼日，思慮善否。”《孟子·離婁下》仰而思之，夜以繼日。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Ultimate Joy': 'The noble, day and night, ponder over good and evil.' And 'Mencius: Li Lou II': 'Look up and think, day and night.'
example: 殷之季君，亦奏斯乐。酒池肉林，～。★三国魏·阮籍《乐论》
exampleTraditional: 殷之季君，亦奏斯樂。酒池肉林，～。★三國魏·阮籍《樂論》
exampleEn: The last ruler of Yin also played this music. With pools of wine and forests of meat, he indulged day and night. — Three Kingdoms Wei Dynasty Ruan Ji, 'On Music'

explanation: 起得早，睡得晚。形容辛勤劳动。
explanationTraditional: 起得早，睡得晚。形容辛勤勞動。
explanationEn: To start work early and finish late; to work hard from dawn to dusk.
derivation: 周立波《暴风骤雨》第一部九‘头年给你干一整年活，冲风冒雨，起早贪黑的。’郭全海说，气急眼了。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《暴風驟雨》第一部九‘頭年給你幹一整年活，衝風冒雨，起早貪黑的。’郭全海說，氣急眼了。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane' Part 1, Chapter 9: 'Last year I worked for you the whole year, braving wind and rain, starting early and working late.' Guo Quanhai said, extremely angry.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 释放下。喜爱得舍不得放手。
explanationTraditional: 釋放下。喜愛得捨不得放手。
explanationEn: To love something so much that one cannot bear to put it down.
derivation: 南朝·梁·萧统《陶渊明集序》余爱嗜其文，不能释手。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·蕭統《陶淵明集序》餘愛嗜其文，不能釋手。”
derivationEn: From Xiao Tong's 'Preface to the Collected Works of Tao Yuanming' (Southern Liang Dynasty): 'I love his writings and cannot put them down.'
example: 虽是不合他的路数，可奈文有定评，他看了也知道～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 雖是不合他的路數，可奈文有定評，他看了也知道～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十五回
exampleEn: Although it didn't match his style, the text had a fixed reputation; after reading it, he knew he would love it and not let it go. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 35

explanation: 措安放。手脚不知放到哪儿好。形容举动慌张，或无法应付。
explanationTraditional: 措安放。手腳不知放到哪兒好。形容舉動慌張，或無法應付。
explanationEn: At a loss what to do; flustered and unable to act.
derivation: 《论语·子路》刑罚不中，则民无所措手足。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子路》刑罰不中，則民無所措手足。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius·Zilu': 'If punishments are not appropriate, the people will not know where to put their hands and feet.'
example: 正忧疑不定，忽报宋兵到了，惊得～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 正憂疑不定，忽報宋兵到了，驚得～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十二回
exampleEn: While worrying and uncertain, suddenly news came that the Song army had arrived; he was so frightened that he was at a loss. — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'The Water Margin: Later Story', Chapter 12

explanation: 哲学用语，指事物作为矛盾的统一体，都包含着相互矛盾对立的两个方面。通常指全面看待人或事物，看到积极方面，也看到消极方面。
explanationTraditional: 哲學用語，指事物作為矛盾的統一體，都包含著相互矛盾對立的兩個方面。通常指全面看待人或事物，看到積極方面，也看到消極方面。
explanationEn: A philosophical term meaning that everything as a unity of opposites contains two contradictory aspects; usually refers to seeing both the positive and negative sides of a person or thing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容非常稀少，很难得到（多指人才或稀有物品）。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常稀少，很難得到（多指人才或稀有物品）。
explanationEn: Very rare; hard to come by (usually referring to talents or rare items).
derivation: 汉·王充《论衡·超奇篇》譬珠玉不可多得，以其珍也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王充《論衡·超奇篇》譬珠玉不可多得，以其珍也。”
derivationEn: From Wang Chong's 'Lunheng·Chapter on Transcendence' (Han Dynasty): 'Like pearls and jade, they are rare because they are precious.'
example: 盖北宋以睢漆擅名，今已～。★明·沈德符《万历野获编·时玩》
exampleTraditional: 蓋北宋以睢漆擅名，今已～。★明·沈德符《萬曆野獲編·時玩》
exampleEn: The Northern Song lacquerware was famous, but now it is rare to find. — Ming Dynasty, Shen Defu, 'Wanli Yehuo Bian·Current Curios'

explanation: 望希望，意料。由于没有想到的好事而非常高兴。
explanationTraditional: 望希望，意料。由於沒有想到的好事而非常高興。
explanationEn: Overjoyed at an unexpected turn of events; pleasantly surprised.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《与李之仪书》契阔八年，岂谓复有见日？渐近中原，辱书尤数，喜出望外。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《與李之儀書》契闊八年，豈謂復有見日？漸近中原，辱書尤數，喜出望外。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Letter to Li Zhiyi' (Song Dynasty): 'We have been apart for eight years; how could I expect to see you again? Approaching the Central Plains, I received many letters from you, and I was overjoyed beyond expectations.'
example: 这可真叫他～。（沙汀《催粮》）
exampleTraditional: 這可真叫他～。（沙汀《催糧》）
exampleEn: This really made him overjoyed. — Sha Ting, 'Collecting Grain'

explanation: 不著文字，口头相传。
explanationTraditional: 不著文字，口頭相傳。
explanationEn: Passed down orally without written records.
derivation: 宋·张君房《云笈七签》第七十二卷经云‘知白守黑，神明自来。’是知玄为万物母，圣人秘之，不形文字，口口相传。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》第七十二卷經雲‘知白守黑，神明自來。’是知玄為萬物母，聖人秘之，不形文字，口口相傳。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Junfang's 'Yunji Qiqian' (Song Dynasty), Volume 72: 'The scripture says: 'Know the white and keep the black; the spirit will come naturally.' Thus, the mysterious is the mother of all things; sages keep it secret, not in written form, but passed down orally.'
example: 虽然他败坏了～的韵事。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文·病后杂谈》
exampleTraditional: 雖然他敗壞了～的韻事。★魯迅《且介亭雜文·病後雜談》
exampleEn: Although he ruined the charm of oral tradition. — Lu Xun, 'Qie Jie Ting Essays·After Illness'

explanation: 朝早晨；夕晚上；朝夕形容时间短暂。比喻抓紧时间，力争在最短的时间内达到目的。
explanationTraditional: 朝早晨；夕晚上；朝夕形容時間短暫。比喻抓緊時間，力爭在最短的時間內達到目的。
explanationEn: To seize every moment; to race against time to achieve a goal in the shortest possible time.
derivation: 毛泽东《满江红·和郭沫若同志》天地转，光阴迫。一万年太久，只争朝夕。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《滿江紅·和郭沫若同志》天地轉，光陰迫。一萬年太久，只爭朝夕。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Man Jiang Hong·In Reply to Comrade Guo Moruo': 'Heaven and earth revolve; time presses. Ten thousand years are too long; seize the day, seize the hour.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容呼吸急促，大声喘气。
explanationTraditional: 形容呼吸急促，大聲喘氣。
explanationEn: Breathing heavily; panting.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二十六回一眼看见喜媚乌云散乱，气喘吁吁。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二十六回一眼看見喜媚烏雲散亂，氣喘吁吁。”
derivationEn: From Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' (Ming Dynasty), Chapter 26: 'At a glance, he saw Ximei with disheveled hair, panting heavily.'
example: 廖二嫂～，脸色铁青，奔到他面前来了。★沙汀《呼嚎》
exampleTraditional: 廖二嫂～，臉色鐵青，奔到他面前來了。★沙汀《呼嚎》
exampleEn: Liao Er's wife, panting heavily and with a livid face, rushed up to him. — Sha Ting, 'Howl'

explanation: 猝突然，出其不意。事情来得突然，来不及防备。
explanationTraditional: 猝突然，出其不意。事情來得突然，來不及防備。
explanationEn: Caught off guard; too sudden to defend against.
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·姑妄听之一》既不炳烛，又不扬声，猝不及防，突然相遇，是先生犯鬼，非鬼犯先生。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·姑妄聽之一》既不炳燭，又不揚聲，猝不及防，突然相遇，是先生犯鬼，非鬼犯先生。”
derivationEn: From Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Observations·Random Notes I' (Qing Dynasty): 'Without lighting a candle or making a sound, caught off guard, meeting suddenly—it is the gentleman who offends the ghost, not the ghost who offends the gentleman.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 示显示，表现。不甘心表示自己比别人差。表示要较量一下，比个高低。
explanationTraditional: 示顯示，表現。不甘心表示自己比別人差。表示要較量一下，比個高低。
explanationEn: Unwilling to show weakness; determined to compete and not be outdone.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文附集·我的第一个师父》台下有人骂起来。师父不甘示弱，也给他们一个回骂。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文附集·我的第一個師父》臺下有人罵起來。師父不甘示弱，也給他們一個回罵。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'My First Master': 'Someone in the audience cursed. The master, unwilling to show weakness, cursed back.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 亡逃亡，丢失；牢关牲口的圈。羊逃跑了再去修补羊圈，还不算晚。比喻出了问题以后想办法补救，可以防止继续受损失。
explanationTraditional: 亡逃亡，丟失；牢關牲口的圈。羊逃跑了再去修補羊圈，還不算晚。比喻出了問題以後想辦法補救，可以防止繼續受損失。
explanationEn: To mend the pen after the sheep is lost; it's not too late to take corrective action to prevent further loss.
derivation: 《战国策·楚策》见兔而顾犬，未为晚也；亡羊而补牢，未为迟也。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·楚策》見兔而顧犬，未為晚也；亡羊而補牢，未為遲也。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States': 'It is not too late to see the rabbit and call the dog; it is not too late to mend the pen after losing the sheep.'
example: 张学良始则失地，今幸固守锦州，～，可称晚悟。★章炳麟《与孙思昿论时事书》二
exampleTraditional: 張學良始則失地，今幸固守錦州，～，可稱晚悟。★章炳麟《與孫思昿論時事書》二
exampleEn: Zhang Xueliang first lost territory, but now fortunately holds Jinzhou firmly. Mending the pen after losing the sheep can be called late awakening. — Zhang Binglin

explanation: 意气意志和气概；风发象风吹一样迅猛。形容精神振奋，气概豪迈。
explanationTraditional: 意氣意志和氣概；風發象風吹一樣迅猛。形容精神振奮，氣概豪邁。
explanationEn: High-spirited and vigorous; full of energy and determination.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 伟大的中国人民正在意气风发地建设自己的祖国。
exampleTraditional: 偉大的中國人民正在意氣風發地建設自己的祖國。
exampleEn: The great Chinese people are building their motherland with high spirits and vigor.

explanation: 形容战斗或劳动之前，人们精神振奋，跃跃欲试的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容戰鬥或勞動之前，人們精神振奮，躍躍欲試的樣子。
explanationEn: To rub fists and palms; eager and ready for action, usually before a fight or hard work.
derivation: 元·康进之《李逵负荆》第二折俺可也摩拳擦掌，行行里按不住莽撞心头气。”
derivationTraditional: 元·康進之《李逵負荊》第二折俺可也摩拳擦掌，行行裡按不住莽撞心頭氣。”
derivationEn: From Yuan drama 'Li Kui Carries Thorns': 'I rub my fists and palms, unable to suppress my impulsive anger.'
example: 这是第一次出马，人们都～，心里突突跳着准备战斗。★梁斌《红旗谱》四十八
exampleTraditional: 這是第一次出馬，人們都～，心裡突突跳著準備戰鬥。★梁斌《紅旗譜》四十八
exampleEn: This was the first time out, and everyone was rubbing their fists and palms, hearts pounding, ready for battle. — Liang Bin, 'Red Flag'

explanation: 形容各类多，差别大。
explanationTraditional: 形容各類多，差別大。
explanationEn: A thousand differences and ten thousand distinctions; extremely varied and diverse.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷二十五僧问‘如何是无异底事？’师曰‘千差万别。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷二十五僧問‘如何是無異底事？’師曰‘千差萬別。’”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty 'Transmission of the Lamp': 'A monk asked, 'What is the matter without difference?' The master said, 'A thousand differences and ten thousand distinctions.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 喜欢、恼怒、悲哀、快乐。泛指人的各种不同的感情。
explanationTraditional: 喜歡、惱怒、悲哀、快樂。泛指人的各種不同的感情。
explanationEn: Joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness; the various emotions of human beings.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》喜怒哀乐之未发谓之中，发而皆中节谓之和。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》喜怒哀樂之未發謂之中，發而皆中節謂之和。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites': 'Before joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness arise, it is called the mean; when they arise in due measure, it is called harmony.'
example: 虽是海外之邦，不过言语不同，衣服有异，那～的人情，原是一样的。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 雖是海外之邦，不過言語不同，衣服有異，那～的人情，原是一樣的。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十一回
exampleEn: Although it is a foreign country, only the language and clothing differ; the human emotions of joy, anger, sorrow, and happiness are the same. — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel'

explanation: 指各种味道。比喻幸福、痛苦等各种境遇。
explanationTraditional: 指各種味道。比喻幸福、痛苦等各種境遇。
explanationEn: Sour, sweet, bitter, and spicy; all kinds of tastes, metaphorically referring to various experiences in life, both pleasant and unpleasant.
derivation: 《鹖冠子·环流五》阴阳不同气，然其为和同也；酸咸甘苦之味相反，然其为善均也。”
derivationTraditional: 《鶡冠子·環流五》陰陽不同氣，然其為和同也；酸鹹甘苦之味相反，然其為善均也。”
derivationEn: From 'He Guanzi': 'Yin and yang are different qi, yet they harmonize; sour, salty, sweet, and bitter flavors oppose each other, yet they are all good.'
example: ～，各种滋味搅和在一起，索性任情地倾吐。（叶圣陶《微波》）
exampleTraditional: ～，各種滋味攪和在一起，索性任情地傾吐。（葉聖陶《微波》）
exampleEn: Sour, sweet, bitter, spicy—all flavors mixed together, let them be poured out freely. — Ye Shengtao, 'Microwave'

explanation: 描写或模仿的非常逼真。
explanationTraditional: 描寫或模仿的非常逼真。
explanationEn: Remarkably lifelike; vividly portrayed or imitated.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 她扮演一位英雄的母亲，言谈举止，无不惟妙惟肖。
exampleTraditional: 她扮演一位英雄的母親，言談舉止，無不惟妙惟肖。
exampleEn: She played the role of a heroic mother, and her speech and mannerisms were remarkably lifelike.

explanation: 矛进攻敌人的刺击武器；盾保护自己的盾牌。比喻自己说话做事前后抵触。
explanationTraditional: 矛進攻敵人的刺擊武器；盾保護自己的盾牌。比喻自己說話做事前後牴觸。
explanationEn: Self-contradictory; to contradict oneself in speech or action.
derivation: 《韩非子·难一》楚人有鬻盾与矛者，誉之曰‘吾盾之坚，莫之能陷也。’又誉其矛曰‘吾矛之利，于物无不陷也。’或曰‘以子之矛陷子之盾，何如？’其人勿能应也。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·難一》楚人有鬻盾與矛者，譽之曰‘吾盾之堅，莫之能陷也。’又譽其矛曰‘吾矛之利，於物無不陷也。’或曰‘以子之矛陷子之盾，何如？’其人勿能應也。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi': 'A man of Chu selling shields and spears boasted, 'My shields are so hard that nothing can pierce them.' Then he boasted of his spears, 'My spears are so sharp that they can pierce anything.' Someone asked, 'What about using your spear to pierce your shield?' The man could not answer.'
example: 这些理论～。
exampleTraditional: 這些理論～。
exampleEn: These theories are self-contradictory.

explanation: 就象屹立在黄河急流中的砥柱山一样。比喻坚强独立的人能在动荡艰难的环境中起支柱作用。
explanationTraditional: 就象屹立在黃河急流中的砥柱山一樣。比喻堅強獨立的人能在動盪艱難的環境中起支柱作用。
explanationEn: A pillar in the middle of the current; a person who plays a crucial supporting role in difficult circumstances.
derivation: 《晏子春秋·内篇谏下》吾尝从君济于河，鼋衔左骖，以入砥柱之中流。”
derivationTraditional: 《晏子春秋·內篇諫下》吾嘗從君濟於河，黿銜左驂，以入砥柱之中流。”
derivationEn: From 'Yanzi Chunqiu': 'I once followed my lord to cross the river, and a turtle bit the left horse and entered the pillar in the middle of the current.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 大白彻底弄清楚。真实情况完全弄明白了。
explanationTraditional: 大白徹底弄清楚。真實情況完全弄明白了。
explanationEn: The truth has been fully revealed; the real situation is completely clear.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 经过公安干警一个多月的严密侦察，这桩案件终于真相大白。
exampleTraditional: 經過公安幹警一個多月的嚴密偵察，這樁案件終於真相大白。
exampleEn: After more than a month of intensive investigation by the public security officers, the case finally came to light.

explanation: 早晨出动，晚上归来。
explanationTraditional: 早晨出動，晚上歸來。
explanationEn: To go out early and return late; describes a hardworking person.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策六》女朝出而晚来，则吾倚门而望。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策六》女朝出而晚來，則吾倚門而望。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States·Strategies of Qi VI': 'A woman goes out in the morning and returns late, so I lean on the door and watch.'
example: 他按照～捕鱼撒网那股悠闲的心情撑着船，编算着使自己高兴也使别人高兴的事情。★孙犁《芦花荡》
exampleTraditional: 他按照～捕魚撒網那股悠閒的心情撐著船，編算著使自己高興也使別人高興的事情。★孫犁《蘆花蕩》
exampleEn: He rowed the boat with the leisurely mood of going out early and returning late to fish, planning things that would make himself and others happy. — Sun Li, 'Reed Marshes'

explanation: 繁荣兴旺发达；昌盛兴旺。指国家兴旺发达，欣欣向荣。
explanationTraditional: 繁榮興旺發達；昌盛興旺。指國家興旺發達，欣欣向榮。
explanationEn: Prosperous and thriving; describes a country or society that is flourishing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我国的戏剧艺术越来越繁荣昌盛了。
exampleTraditional: 我國的戲劇藝術越來越繁榮昌盛了。
exampleEn: The dramatic arts in our country are becoming more and more prosperous.

explanation: 不同的嘴说出相同的话。指大家说得都一样。
explanationTraditional: 不同的嘴說出相同的話。指大家說得都一樣。
explanationEn: Different mouths speak the same words; everyone says the same thing.
derivation: 《宋书·庾炳之传》伏复深思，只有愚滞，今之事迹，异口同音，便是彰著，政未测得物之数耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·庾炳之傳》伏復深思，只有愚滯，今之事蹟，異口同音，便是彰著，政未測得物之數耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Song·Biography of Yu Bingzhi': 'After careful consideration, I find only foolishness; now the facts are clear, and different mouths speak the same sound, which is evident.'
example: 众人～地叫着罚！罚！”★巴金《家》十三
exampleTraditional: 眾人～地叫著罰！罰！”★巴金《家》十三
exampleEn: Everyone shouted in unison, 'Punish him! Punish him!' — Ba Jin, 'Family', Chapter 13

explanation: 洋洋得意的样子。充满了欢喜的神色或气氛。
explanationTraditional: 洋洋得意的樣子。充滿了歡喜的神色或氣氛。
explanationEn: Full of joy and happiness; a cheerful atmosphere.
derivation: 宋·范仲淹《岳阳楼记》登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡，宠辱皆忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·范仲淹《岳陽樓記》登斯樓也，則有心曠神怡，寵辱皆忘，把酒臨風，其喜洋洋者矣。”
derivationEn: From Fan Zhongyan's 'Record of Yueyang Tower': 'When one ascends this tower, one feels relaxed and happy, forgetting favor and disgrace, holding a cup in the wind, filled with joy.'
example: 马上的将士们都　是精神抖擞，～，丝毫不象是吃过败仗。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十五章
exampleTraditional: 馬上的將士們都　是精神抖擻，～，絲毫不象是吃過敗仗。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十五章
exampleEn: The soldiers on horseback were all in high spirits, full of joy, not at all like they had just been defeated. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 35

explanation: 指带有原则性、根本性的是非问题。
explanationTraditional: 指帶有原則性、根本性的是非問題。
explanationEn: Major issues of principle; fundamental right and wrong.
derivation: 徐迟《歌德巴赫猜想》一页一页的历史写出来了，大是大非，终于有了无私的公论。”
derivationTraditional: 徐遲《歌德巴赫猜想》一頁一頁的歷史寫出來了，大是大非，終於有了無私的公論。”
derivationEn: From Xu Chi's 'Goldbach Conjecture': 'Page by page, history is written; major issues of right and wrong finally have impartial public opinion.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 依靠自己的劳动所得来生活。
explanationTraditional: 依靠自己的勞動所得來生活。
explanationEn: To live by one's own labor; to earn one's own living.
derivation: 《礼记·礼器》食力无数。”陈浩集说食力，自食其力之人。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮器》食力無數。”陳浩集說食力，自食其力之人。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites·Vessels of Rites': 'Those who eat by their own strength are countless.' Chen Hao's commentary: 'Those who eat by their own strength are people who live by their own labor.'
example: 居贫，～，隐田里间，以教授为业，非义不为，人敬惮之。★明·李昌祺《剪灯余话·泰山御史传》
exampleTraditional: 居貧，～，隱田裡間，以教授為業，非義不為，人敬憚之。★明·李昌祺《剪燈餘話·泰山御史傳》
exampleEn: He lived in poverty, supporting himself by his own labor, hiding in the fields, teaching for a living, doing nothing unjust, and people respected and feared him. — Ming Dynasty, Li Changqi, 'Supplementary Tales of the Wicks and Candles·Biography of the Imperial Censor of Mount Tai'

explanation: 言传用言语讲解、传授；身教以行动示范。既用言语来教导，又用行动来示范。指行动起模范作用。
explanationTraditional: 言傳用言語講解、傳授；身教以行動示範。既用言語來教導，又用行動來示範。指行動起模範作用。
explanationEn: To teach by words and example; to instruct and set an example through actions.
derivation: 《庄子·天道》语之所贵者意也，意有所随。意之所随者，不可以言传也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天道》語之所貴者意也，意有所隨。意之所隨者，不可以言傳也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi·Way of Heaven': 'What words value is meaning, and meaning has its basis. The basis of meaning cannot be conveyed by words.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容顽强地拼死战斗。
explanationTraditional: 形容頑強地拼死戰鬥。
explanationEn: To fight desperately; to engage in a bloody battle.
derivation: 杜鹏程《保卫延安》第六章一战士们在这十五昼十五夜中，不是浴血奋战就是急行军转移。”
derivationTraditional: 杜鵬程《保衛延安》第六章一戰士們在這十五晝十五夜中，不是浴血奮戰就是急行軍轉移。”
derivationEn: From Du Pengcheng's 'Defending Yan'an', Chapter 6: 'During these fifteen days and nights, the soldiers were either fighting desperately or marching quickly to transfer.'
example: 全班战士，个个奋勇当先，冲下山去与敌人浴血奋战。
exampleTraditional: 全班戰士，個個奮勇當先，衝下山去與敵人浴血奮戰。
exampleEn: The entire squad, each soldier taking the lead, charged down the mountain to fight desperately with the enemy.

explanation: 形容对没有什么了不起的的事情过分惊讶。
explanationTraditional: 形容對沒有什麼了不起的的事情過分驚訝。
explanationEn: To make a fuss over a trifle; to be overly surprised at something trivial.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《答林择之》要肱把此事做一平常事看，朴实头做将去，久之自然见效，不必如此大惊小怪，起模画样也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《答林擇之》要肱把此事做一平常事看，樸實頭做將去，久之自然見效，不必如此大驚小怪，起模畫樣也。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's 'Reply to Lin Zezhi': 'Treat this matter as ordinary, do it simply, and over time it will naturally take effect. There is no need to make such a fuss and create a model.'
example: 兄弟，休要～的，则他便是杨衙内，是个有权有势的的。★元·李文蔚《燕青博鱼》第一折
exampleTraditional: 兄弟，休要～的，則他便是楊衙內，是個有權有勢的的。★元·李文蔚《燕青博魚》第一折
exampleEn: Brother, don't make such a fuss. He is Yang Yanei, a powerful man. — Yuan Dynasty, Li Wenwei, 'Yan Qing Fishes for a Fish', First Act

explanation: 由危险转为平安（多指局势或病情）。
explanationTraditional: 由危險轉為平安（多指局勢或病情）。
explanationEn: To turn from danger to safety, often referring to a situation or illness.
derivation: 《晋书·谢安传》隐居会稽东山，年逾四十复出为桓温司马，累迁中书、司徒等要职，晋室赖以转危为安。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·謝安傳》隱居會稽東山，年逾四十復出為桓溫司馬，累遷中書、司徒等要職，晉室賴以轉危為安。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Xie An': He lived in seclusion in Dongshan, Kuaiji, and after forty he became Sima under Huan Wen, later holding key positions, relying on him to turn danger into safety for the Jin court.
example: 经医务人员的全力抢救，这名危重病人已经～。
exampleTraditional: 經醫務人員的全力搶救，這名危重病人已經～。
exampleEn: Thanks to the full efforts of the medical staff, this critically ill patient has turned from danger to safety.

explanation: 比喻尽可能利用一切可以利用的空间或时间。
explanationTraditional: 比喻儘可能利用一切可以利用的空間或時間。
explanationEn: To make use of every available space or time; to seize every opportunity.
derivation: 魏巍《东方》第三部第七章‘小钢炮后来打死敌人不少。’陈三又见缝插针地鼓励他。”
derivationTraditional: 魏巍《東方》第三部第七章‘小鋼炮後來打死敵人不少。’陳三又見縫插針地鼓勵他。”
derivationEn: From Wei Wei's 'The East', Part 3, Chapter 7: 'Little Steel Cannon later killed many enemies.' Chen San again seized the opportunity to encourage him.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 对人和蔼可亲，没有架子，使人容易接近。也指文字浅显，容易了解。
explanationTraditional: 對人和藹可親，沒有架子，使人容易接近。也指文字淺顯，容易瞭解。
explanationEn: Approachable and amiable, without airs; also refers to simple and easy-to-understand writing.
derivation: 《史记·鲁周公世家》平易近民，民必归之。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魯周公世家》平易近民，民必歸之。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Hereditary House of Lu Zhougong': Being approachable to the people, the people will surely return to him.
example: 凡昌黎（韩愈）与东野（孟郊）联句，必字字争胜，与他人联句，则～。★清·赵翼《瓯北诗话》卷三
exampleTraditional: 凡昌黎（韓愈）與東野（孟郊）聯句，必字字爭勝，與他人聯句，則～。★清·趙翼《甌北詩話》卷三
exampleEn: Whenever Changli (Han Yu) and Dongye (Meng Jiao) wrote joint poems, they competed in every word; when with others, he was approachable. — Qing Zhao Yi, 'Oubei Poetry Talks', Volume 3

explanation: 指从古代到现代，从国内到国外。泛指时间久远，空间广阔。
explanationTraditional: 指從古代到現代，從國內到國外。泛指時間久遠，空間廣闊。
explanationEn: From ancient to modern times, from domestic to foreign; spanning time and space.
derivation: 茅盾《子夜》九翻遍了古今中外的历史，没有一个国家曾经用这种所谓示威运动而变成了既富且强。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《子夜》九翻遍了古今中外的歷史，沒有一個國家曾經用這種所謂示威運動而變成了既富且強。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'Midnight', Chapter 9: Having searched through history, ancient and modern, Chinese and foreign, no country has become rich and strong through such demonstrations.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 载充满。怨恨的声音充满道路。形容人民群众普遍强烈不满。
explanationTraditional: 載充滿。怨恨的聲音充滿道路。形容人民群眾普遍強烈不滿。
explanationEn: Voices of discontent fill the roads; widespread public dissatisfaction.
derivation: 《诗比·大雅·生民》实覃实訏，厥声载路。”《后汉书·李固传》开门受赂，署用非次，天下纷然，怨声满道。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩比·大雅·生民》實覃實訏，厥聲載路。”《後漢書·李固傳》開門受賂，署用非次，天下紛然，怨聲滿道。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Greater Odes: Shengmin' and 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Li Gu': Accepting bribes, improper appointments, causing widespread resentment.
example: 凡有些余利的，一概入了官中，那时里外～，岂不失了你们这样人家的大体？★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 凡有些餘利的，一概入了官中，那時裡外～，豈不失了你們這樣人家的大體？★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十六回
exampleEn: If any surplus goes to the public treasury, then both inside and outside will be filled with complaints—wouldn't that ruin the dignity of a family like yours? — Qing Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 56

explanation: 鼎古代煮食器；沸沸腾。形容人群的声音吵吵嚷嚷，就象煮开了锅一样。
explanationTraditional: 鼎古代煮食器；沸沸騰。形容人群的聲音吵吵嚷嚷，就象煮開了鍋一樣。
explanationEn: A hubbub of voices, like a boiling cauldron; noisy and bustling.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十一日午后，刘方在店中收拾，只听得人声鼎沸。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十一日午後，劉方在店中收拾，只聽得人聲鼎沸。”
derivationEn: From Ming Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 11: In the afternoon, Liu Fang was tidying up the shop when he heard a hubbub of voices.
example: 广场这时已是一片锣鼓喧天，～。
exampleTraditional: 廣場這時已是一片鑼鼓喧天，～。
exampleEn: The square was now a scene of gongs and drums, with a hubbub of voices.

explanation: 迢迢遥远。形容路途遥远。
explanationTraditional: 迢迢遙遠。形容路途遙遠。
explanationEn: A long and arduous journey; far away.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《古今小说·范巨卿鸡黍死生交》辞亲别弟到山阳，千里迢迢客梦长。岂为友朋轻骨肉，只因信义迫中肠。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《古今小說·範巨卿雞黍死生交》辭親別弟到山陽，千里迢迢客夢長。豈為友朋輕骨肉，只因信義迫中腸。”
derivationEn: From Ming Feng Menglong's 'Stories Old and New: Fan Juqing's Chicken and Millet Friendship': Leaving family and friends for Shanyang, a thousand-mile journey with long dreams.
example: 李少荃要讲和，曾国荃只主战，派了唐景崧，～来把将军见。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第六回
exampleTraditional: 李少荃要講和，曾國荃只主戰，派了唐景崧，～來把將軍見。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第六回
exampleEn: Li Shaozheng wanted peace, Zeng Guoquan advocated war, sending Tang Jingsong on a thousand-mile journey to see the general. — Qing Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 6

explanation: 融会融合领会；贯通贯穿前后。把各方面的知识和道理融化汇合，得到全面透彻的理解。
explanationTraditional: 融會融合領會；貫通貫穿前後。把各方面的知識和道理融化匯合，得到全面透徹的理解。
explanationEn: To achieve a thorough understanding by integrating knowledge from various sources.
derivation: 《朱子全书·学三》举一而三反，闻一而知十，乃学者用功之深，穷理之熟，然后能融会贯通，以至于此。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子全書·學三》舉一而三反，聞一而知十，乃學者用功之深，窮理之熟，然後能融會貫通，以至於此。”
derivationEn: From 'Complete Works of Zhu Xi: Learning, Part 3': Learning deeply and reasoning thoroughly leads to integration and comprehension.
example: 要没有活泼的想象力，就只能做出点滴的饾饤的工作，决不能～的。★朱自清《中国学术的大损失》
exampleTraditional: 要沒有活潑的想象力，就只能做出點滴的餖飣的工作，決不能～的。★朱自清《中國學術的大損失》
exampleEn: Without lively imagination, one can only do piecemeal work, never achieving integration and comprehension. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Great Loss to Chinese Academia'

explanation: 整理好行装，等待出发。
explanationTraditional: 整理好行裝，等待出發。
explanationEn: To pack and be ready to depart.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们已经～，向五指山主峰挺进。
exampleTraditional: 我們已經～，向五指山主峰挺進。
exampleEn: We are already packed and ready to march towards the main peak of the Five Finger Mountains.

explanation: 得得到，想到；应反应，配合。心里怎么想，手就能怎么做。比喻技艺纯熟或做事情非常顺利。
explanationTraditional: 得得到，想到；應反應，配合。心裡怎麼想，手就能怎麼做。比喻技藝純熟或做事情非常順利。
explanationEn: To have everything under control; to do something with ease and skill.
derivation: 《庄子·天道》不徐不疾，得之于手而应于心。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天道》不徐不疾，得之於手而應於心。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: The Way of Heaven': Neither slow nor fast, it responds from the hand to the mind.
example: 挟了七八万现款的冯云卿就此走进了公债市场，半年来总算～，扯起息来，二分半是有的。★茅盾《子夜》
exampleTraditional: 挾了七八萬現款的馮雲卿就此走進了公債市場，半年來總算～，扯起息來，二分半是有的。★茅盾《子夜》
exampleEn: Feng Yunqing, with seventy to eighty thousand in cash, entered the bond market and for half a year managed smoothly, earning at least two and a half percent interest. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight'

explanation: 指军人或地方官有保卫国土的责任。
explanationTraditional: 指軍人或地方官有保衛國土的責任。
explanationEn: Refers to the duty of soldiers or local officials to defend the territory.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用恶语骂人。
explanationTraditional: 用惡語罵人。
explanationEn: To shout abuse; to hurl insults.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》茶房未及开口，那女人已经破口大骂起来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》茶房未及開口，那女人已經破口大罵起來。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Appearance': 'Before the waiter could speak, the woman had already started shouting abuse.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 磨灭消失。永远消失不了。指事迹言论等将始终保留在人们的记忆中。
explanationTraditional: 磨滅消失。永遠消失不了。指事蹟言論等將始終保留在人們的記憶中。
explanationEn: Indelible; cannot be erased; refers to deeds or words that will remain in people's memory forever.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《记旧本韩文后》韩氏之文，没而不见者二百年，而后大施于今，此又非特好恶之所上下，盖其久而愈明，不可磨灭，虽蔽于暂而终耀于无穷者，其道当然也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《記舊本韓文後》韓氏之文，沒而不見者二百年，而後大施於今，此又非特好惡之所上下，蓋其久而愈明，不可磨滅，雖蔽於暫而終耀於無窮者，其道當然也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'Postscript to the Old Edition of Han Yu's Works': 'Han Yu's writings were unseen for two hundred years, then flourished in the present. This is not merely a matter of likes and dislikes; it is because they become clearer over time, indelible, and though temporarily obscured, they shine eternally.'
example: 但是我又不知道这是～的事实。★巴金《春雨》八
exampleTraditional: 但是我又不知道這是～的事實。★巴金《春雨》八
exampleEn: But I don't know that this is an indelible fact. — Ba Jin, 'Spring Rain', Chapter 8

explanation: 止境尽头。永远没有到头的时候。
explanationTraditional: 止境盡頭。永遠沒有到頭的時候。
explanationEn: Endless; never coming to an end.
derivation: 茅盾《秦岭之夜》秦岭上还有积雪，秦岭的层岚屏障永无止境似的。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《秦嶺之夜》秦嶺上還有積雪，秦嶺的層嵐屏障永無止境似的。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'Night in Qinling': 'There is still snow on the Qinling Mountains, and the layered barriers of the Qinling peaks seem endless.'
example: 追求真理～。
exampleTraditional: 追求真理～。
exampleEn: The pursuit of truth is endless.

explanation: 犹豫迟疑。拿不定主意。
explanationTraditional: 猶豫遲疑。拿不定主意。
explanationEn: Hesitant; indecisive; unable to make up one's mind.
derivation: 《战国策·赵策三》平原君犹豫未有所决。”《周书·贺拔胜传》今乃顿兵不进，犹豫不决。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·趙策三》平原君猶豫未有所決。”《周書·賀拔勝傳》今乃頓兵不進，猶豫不決。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Zhao III': 'Lord Pingyuan hesitated and had not yet decided.' Also from 'Book of Zhou: Biography of Heba Sheng': 'Now you halt your troops and advance no further, hesitant and indecisive.'
example: 在决定这件事如何处理时，他变得～起来。
exampleTraditional: 在決定這件事如何處理時，他變得～起來。
exampleEn: When deciding how to handle this matter, he became hesitant.

explanation: 原指《西游记》中孙悟空能识别妖魔鬼怪的眼睛◇用以形容人的眼光锐利，能够识别真伪。
explanationTraditional: 原指《西遊記》中孫悟空能識別妖魔鬼怪的眼睛◇用以形容人的眼光銳利，能夠識別真偽。
explanationEn: Originally refers to Sun Wukong's eyes that can recognize demons and monsters; now used to describe sharp eyesight that can discern truth from falsehood.
derivation: 元·杨景贤《西游记杂剧》第三本第九出这厮瞒神唬鬼，铜筋铁骨，火眼金睛。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊景賢《西遊記雜劇》第三本第九齣這廝瞞神唬鬼，銅筋鐵骨，火眼金睛。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Yang Jingxian's 'Journey to the West' Play, Act 3, Scene 9: 'This scoundrel deceives ghosts and gods, with bronze tendons and iron bones, fiery eyes and golden pupils.'
example: 只是风搅得烟来，把一双眼炒红了，弄做个老害眼病，故唤作～。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第七回
exampleTraditional: 只是風攪得煙來，把一雙眼炒紅了，弄做個老害眼病，故喚作～。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第七回
exampleEn: But the smoke stirred by the wind reddened his eyes, causing an old eye ailment, hence called 'fiery eyes and golden pupils.' — Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 7

explanation: 把手笼在袖子里，在一旁观看。比喻置身事外，既不过问，也不协助别人。
explanationTraditional: 把手籠在袖子裡，在一旁觀看。比喻置身事外，既不過問，也不協助別人。
explanationEn: To stand by with folded arms; to look on unconcerned; to refrain from getting involved.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《祭柳子厚文》不善为斫，血指汗颜，巧匠旁观，缩手袖间。”宋·苏轼《朝辞赴定州论事状》奕棋者胜负之形，虽国工有所不尽，而袖手旁观者常尽之。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《祭柳子厚文》不善為斫，血指汗顏，巧匠旁觀，縮手袖間。”宋·蘇軾《朝辭赴定州論事狀》奕棋者勝負之形，雖國工有所不盡，而袖手旁觀者常盡之。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Eulogy for Liu Zihou': 'Unskilled at carving, bleeding fingers and sweating face; the skilled craftsman looks on, hands tucked in sleeves.' Also from Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Memorial on Leaving for Dingzhou': 'In chess, even a master may not fully see the outcome, but an onlooker with folded arms often sees it all.'
example: 荪老三的事就和我自己的事一样，我不能～。★茅盾《子夜》四
exampleTraditional: 蓀老三的事就和我自己的事一樣，我不能～。★茅盾《子夜》四
exampleEn: Sun Laosan's affair is like my own; I cannot stand by with folded arms. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 4

explanation: 苦口反复规劝；婆心仁慈的心肠。比喻善意而又耐心地劝导。
explanationTraditional: 苦口反覆規勸；婆心仁慈的心腸。比喻善意而又耐心地勸導。
explanationEn: To admonish earnestly and with good intentions; to counsel patiently and kindly.
derivation: 《宋史·赵普传》忠言苦口，三复来奏。”宋·释道原《景德传灯录·泉州道匡禅师》问‘学人根思迟回，乞师曲运慈悲，开一线道。’师曰‘这个是老婆心。’”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·趙普傳》忠言苦口，三複來奏。”宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄·泉州道匡禪師》問‘學人根思遲迴，乞師曲運慈悲，開一線道。’師曰‘這個是老婆心。’”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Zhao Pu': 'Loyal words are bitter to the mouth, repeated in memorials.' Also from Song Dynasty Shi Daoyuan's 'Records of the Transmission of the Lamp': 'A student said, 'My roots are dull and slow; I beg the master to show compassion and open a path.' The master said, 'This is a grandmotherly heart.''
example: 我和龙济光～的谈了十几点钟。★清·梁启超《护国之役回顾谈》
exampleTraditional: 我和龍濟光～的談了十幾點鐘。★清·梁啟超《護國之役回顧談》
exampleEn: I talked earnestly and patiently with Long Jiguang for over ten hours. — Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao, 'Review of the Campaign to Protect the Nation'

explanation: 刀刃运转于骨节空隙中，在有回旋的余地。比喻工作熟练，有实际经验，解决问题毫不费事。
explanationTraditional: 刀刃運轉於骨節空隙中，在有迴旋的餘地。比喻工作熟練，有實際經驗，解決問題毫不費事。
explanationEn: To handle a task with ease and skill; to have plenty of room for maneuver.
derivation: 语出《庄子·养生主》彼节者有间，而刀刃者无厚。以无厚入有间，恢恢乎其于游刃必有余地矣。”
derivationTraditional: 語出《莊子·養生主》彼節者有間，而刀刃者無厚。以無厚入有間，恢恢乎其於遊刃必有餘地矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: The Secret of Caring for Life': 'The joints have spaces, but the blade has no thickness. With no thickness entering spaces, there is ample room for the blade to move.'
example: 从前他们又要办厂，又要做公债，也居然稳渡了两次险恶的风波，现在他们全力来做公债，自然觉得～。★茅盾《子夜》十七
exampleTraditional: 從前他們又要辦廠，又要做公債，也居然穩渡了兩次險惡的風波，現在他們全力來做公債，自然覺得～。★茅盾《子夜》十七
exampleEn: Previously, they had to run factories and speculate in bonds, yet they managed to weather two dangerous storms. Now they focus entirely on bonds, naturally finding it easy. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 17

explanation: 渝改变，违背。自始自终一直不变。指守信用。
explanationTraditional: 渝改變，違背。自始自終一直不變。指守信用。
explanationEn: Unswerving; consistent from beginning to end; steadfast.
derivation: 《晋书·谢安传》安虽受朝寄，然东山之志始末不渝，每形于言色。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·謝安傳》安雖受朝寄，然東山之志始末不渝，每形於言色。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Xie An': 'Although Xie An received the court's trust, his intention to retire to the Eastern Hills never changed, often showing in his words and expressions.'
example: 区区之心，唯以地方秩序为主，以人民生命财产为重，～，天人共鉴。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第二十九回
exampleTraditional: 區區之心，唯以地方秩序為主，以人民生命財產為重，～，天人共鑑。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第二十九回
exampleEn: My humble heart only prioritizes local order and the lives and property of the people, unswerving from beginning to end, witnessed by heaven and man. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 29

explanation: 发展家业，使家庭变得富裕起来。
explanationTraditional: 發展家業，使家庭變得富裕起來。
explanationEn: To build up family property and become wealthy.
derivation: 魏巍《东方》第三部第一章这个村子里的‘大能人’，更关心的却是个人的发家致富。”
derivationTraditional: 魏巍《東方》第三部第一章這個村子裡的‘大能人’，更關心的卻是個人的發家致富。”
derivationEn: From Wei Wei's 'The East', Book 3, Chapter 1: 'The 'capable man' in this village was more concerned with personal wealth building.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 耿耿有心事的样子。不能忘怀，牵萦于心。
explanationTraditional: 耿耿有心事的樣子。不能忘懷，牽縈於心。
explanationEn: To brood over something; unable to forget or let go of a matter.
derivation: 《诗经·邶风·柏舟》耿耿不寐，如有隐忧。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·邶風·柏舟》耿耿不寐，如有隱憂。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Bei Feng, Bo Zhou': 'Restless, unable to sleep, as if harboring hidden sorrow.'
example: 同学之间应团结互助，绝不能因一点小事就～。
exampleTraditional: 同學之間應團結互助，絕不能因一點小事就～。
exampleEn: Classmates should unite and help each other, and never hold grudges over trivial matters.

explanation: 自然地产生（某种思想感情）。
explanationTraditional: 自然地產生（某種思想感情）。
explanationEn: To arise spontaneously (of thoughts or feelings).
derivation: 宋朝苏洵《族谱引》观吾之谱者，孝弟之心可以油然而生矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋朝蘇洵《族譜引》觀吾之譜者，孝弟之心可以油然而生矣。”
derivationEn: From Su Xun's 'Clan Genealogy Preface' (Song Dynasty): 'Those who view our genealogy will naturally feel filial piety and brotherly love arise.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 桅马群的劣马。比喻桅社会或集体的人。
explanationTraditional: 桅馬群的劣馬。比喻桅社會或集體的人。
explanationEn: A bad apple; someone who harms the group or community.
derivation: 《庄子·徐无鬼》夫为天下者，亦奚以异乎牧马者哉？亦去其害马者而已矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·徐無鬼》夫為天下者，亦奚以異乎牧馬者哉？亦去其害馬者而已矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi, Xu Wugui': 'Ruling the world is no different from herding horses—just get rid of the troublemakers.'
example: 赶走～的走狗！★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第三十八章
exampleTraditional: 趕走～的走狗！★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第三十八章
exampleEn: Drive away the lackeys of the black sheep! — Yang Mo, 'The Song of Youth', Part 2, Chapter 38

explanation: 权宜暂时适宜，变通；计计划，办法。指为了应付某种情况而暂时采取的办法。
explanationTraditional: 權宜暫時適宜，變通；計計劃，辦法。指為了應付某種情況而暫時採取的辦法。
explanationEn: A temporary expedient; a stopgap measure.
derivation: 《后汉书·王允传》及在际会，每乏温润之色，杖正持重，不循权宜之计，是以群下不甚附之。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·王允傳》及在際會，每乏溫潤之色，杖正持重，不循權宜之計，是以群下不甚附之。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han, Biography of Wang Yun': 'He was stern and upright, not resorting to expedient measures, so many subordinates did not follow him.'
example: 自成心中认为成立娘子军只是一时～，往后怎么个办法，他还没有想妥当。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十五章
exampleTraditional: 自成心中認為成立娘子軍只是一時～，往後怎麼個辦法，他還沒有想妥當。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十五章
exampleEn: Li Zicheng felt that forming the women's army was only a temporary expedient; he hadn't figured out the long-term plan. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Vol. 2, Chapter 15

explanation: 背离开；井古制八家为井，引伸为乡里，家宅。离开家乡到外地。
explanationTraditional: 背離開；井古制八家為井，引伸為鄉里，家宅。離開家鄉到外地。
explanationEn: To leave one's hometown; to be away from home.
derivation: 元·贾仲名《对玉梳》第一折送的他离乡背井，进退无门。
derivationTraditional: 元·賈仲名《對玉梳》第一折送的他離鄉背井，進退無門。
derivationEn: From Yuan drama 'Jade Comb' by Jia Zhongming, Act 1: 'Sending him away from home, with no way forward or back.'
example: ～，卧雪眠霜。★元·马致远《汉宫秋》第三折
exampleTraditional: ～，臥雪眠霜。★元·馬致遠《漢宮秋》第三折
exampleEn: Leaving home and sleeping in snow and frost. — Ma Zhiyuan, 'Han Palace Autumn', Act 3

explanation: 皆都。人人都高兴满意。
explanationTraditional: 皆都。人人都高興滿意。
explanationEn: Everyone is happy and satisfied.
derivation: 《金刚经》皆大欢喜，信守奉行。”
derivationTraditional: 《金剛經》皆大歡喜，信守奉行。”
derivationEn: From 'Diamond Sutra': 'All were greatly delighted, faithfully accepting and practicing.'
example: 正在～间，忽然太后密诏了清帝的本生父贤王来宫。（清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十六回）
exampleTraditional: 正在～間，忽然太后密詔了清帝的本生父賢王來宮。（清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十六回）
exampleEn: In the midst of universal joy, the Empress Dowager secretly summoned the biological father of the Qing Emperor to the palace. — Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 26

explanation: 支离零散，残缺。形容事物零散破碎，不完整。
explanationTraditional: 支離零散，殘缺。形容事物零散破碎，不完整。
explanationEn: Fragmented; broken into pieces; incomplete.
derivation: 清·魏僖《尧峰文钞·答陈霭公论文书一》而及其求之以道，则小者多支离破碎而不合，大者乃敢于披猖磔裂，尽决去圣人畔岸，而剪拔其藩篱。”
derivationTraditional: 清·魏僖《堯峰文鈔·答陳靄公論文書一》而及其求之以道，則小者多支離破碎而不合，大者乃敢於披猖磔裂，盡決去聖人畔岸，而剪拔其藩籬。”
derivationEn: From Wei Xi's 'Reply to Chen Aigong on Literary Discourse' (Qing Dynasty): 'When seeking the Way, minor points are often fragmented and inconsistent, while major ones are reckless and tear apart the sage's boundaries.'
example: 我们不要把文章分析得～。
exampleTraditional: 我們不要把文章分析得～。
exampleEn: We should not analyze the article into fragmented pieces.

explanation: 鼎鼎盛大的样子。形容名气很大。
explanationTraditional: 鼎鼎盛大的樣子。形容名氣很大。
explanationEn: Very famous; well-known.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十四回你一到京打听人家，像他这样大名鼎鼎，还怕有不晓得的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十四回你一到京打聽人家，像他這樣大名鼎鼎，還怕有不曉得的。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'Officialdom Unmasked' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 24: 'When you arrive in the capital and ask about him, with such a big name, how could anyone not know?'
example: 当时有华灵毡士者，～之学者。★清·梁启超《格致学沿革考略》
exampleTraditional: 當時有華靈氈士者，～之學者。★清·梁啟超《格致學沿革考略》
exampleEn: At that time, there was a scholar named Hua Lingzhan, a very famous scholar. — Liang Qichao, 'A Brief History of the Evolution of Science'

explanation: 指将两者合为一个整体。
explanationTraditional: 指將兩者合為一個整體。
explanationEn: To combine two into one.
derivation: 清·袁枚《新齐谐·佟觭角》一人劈面来，急走如飞，势甚猛，傅不及避，两胸相撞，竟与己身合二为一。”
derivationTraditional: 清·袁枚《新齊諧·佟觭角》一人劈面來，急走如飛，勢甚猛，傅不及避，兩胸相撞，竟與己身合二為一。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Mei's 'New Tales of Qi Xie: Tong Jiao Jiao' (Qing Dynasty): 'A person came rushing head-on, running swiftly with great force. Fu couldn't avoid it, and their chests collided, merging into one body.'
example: 我们要把这两个车间～。
exampleTraditional: 我們要把這兩個車間～。
exampleEn: We need to combine these two workshops into one.

explanation: 风稍一吹，草就摇晃。比喻微小的变动。
explanationTraditional: 風稍一吹，草就搖晃。比喻微小的變動。
explanationEn: A slight movement or change that indicates something is happening.
derivation: 《敦煌变文集·伍子胥变文》偷踪窃道，饮气吐声。风吹草动，即便藏形。”
derivationTraditional: 《敦煌變文集·伍子胥變文》偷蹤竊道，飲氣吐聲。風吹草動，即便藏形。”
derivationEn: From 'Dunhuang Bianwen Ji: The Story of Wu Zixu': 'Sneaking along, holding breath, at the slightest rustle of grass in the wind, he would hide.'
example: 万一后边有些～，被人发觉，不要说道无颜面见令尊，传将出去，小生如何做得人成？★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二十三
exampleTraditional: 萬一後邊有些～，被人發覺，不要說道無顏面見令尊，傳將出去，小生如何做得人成？★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二十三
exampleEn: If later there is any slight disturbance and we are discovered, not to mention losing face before your father, if it gets out, how can I become a man? — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Er Ke Pai An Jing Qi', Chapter 23

explanation: 依依依恋的样子；舍放弃。形容舍不得离开。
explanationTraditional: 依依依戀的樣子；舍放棄。形容捨不得離開。
explanationEn: Reluctant to part; unwilling to leave.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言·卢太学诗酒傲王候》那卢楠直送五百余里，两下依依不舍。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言·盧太學詩酒傲王候》那盧楠直送五百餘里，兩下依依不捨。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World: Lu Nan's Arrogance and Wine': 'Lu Nan escorted him for over five hundred li, both reluctant to part.'
example: 晚会结束已经大半天了，同学们才～地离去。
exampleTraditional: 晚會結束已經大半天了，同學們才～地離去。
exampleEn: It was already a long time after the party ended, but the students were still reluctant to leave.

explanation: 形容秋季晴空万里，天气清爽。
explanationTraditional: 形容秋季晴空萬里，天氣清爽。
explanationEn: Clear and crisp autumn weather; the sky is clear and the air is fresh.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《崔氏东山草堂》诗爱汝玉山草堂静，高秋爽气相鲜新。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《崔氏東山草堂》詩愛汝玉山草堂靜，高秋爽氣相鮮新。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Du Fu, 'Cui's Eastern Mountain Thatched Cottage': 'I love your jade mountain thatched cottage so quiet, the high autumn air is fresh and new.'
example: 方拟～，遣将西征。★清·梁晋竹《两般秋雨眖随笔·史阁部书》
exampleTraditional: 方擬～，遣將西征。★清·梁晉竹《兩般秋雨眖隨筆·史閣部書》
exampleEn: Just as we planned to send troops westward in the clear autumn weather. — Qing Dynasty, Liang Jinzhu, 'Two Autumn Rain Essays: Shi Gefa's Letter'

explanation: 挺身撑直身体。挺直身体站出来。形容面对着艰难或危险的事情，勇敢地站出来。
explanationTraditional: 挺身撐直身體。挺直身體站出來。形容面對著艱難或危險的事情，勇敢地站出來。
explanationEn: To step forward bravely; to stand up and offer to help in a difficult or dangerous situation.
derivation: 《旧五代史·周·唐景思传》后数日城陷，景思挺身而出。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊五代史·周·唐景思傳》後數日城陷，景思挺身而出。”
derivationEn: From 'Old History of the Five Dynasties: Zhou: Tang Jingsi's Biography': 'A few days later the city fell, and Tang Jingsi stepped forward bravely.'
example: 有的～，被关在拘押所里。★叶圣陶《多收了三五斗》
exampleTraditional: 有的～，被關在拘押所裡。★葉聖陶《多收了三五斗》
exampleEn: Some stepped forward bravely and were locked up in detention. — Ye Shengtao, 'Harvesting More Than Three or Five Bushels'

explanation: 遮掩别人的耳朵和眼睛。比喻用假象迷惑人，欺骗人。
explanationTraditional: 遮掩別人的耳朵和眼睛。比喻用假象迷惑人，欺騙人。
explanationEn: To deceive others; to cover up the truth to mislead people.
derivation: 《大宋宣和遗事》亨集虽欲掩人之耳目，不可得也。”
derivationTraditional: 《大宋宣和遺事》亨集雖欲掩人之耳目，不可得也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Great Song Dynasty's Xuanhe Legacy': 'Although he wanted to cover people's ears and eyes, it was impossible.'
example: 必须假手他人，死于道路，方可～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 必須假手他人，死於道路，方可～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十二回
exampleEn: He must be killed by someone else on the road to cover people's ears and eyes. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 12

explanation: 姗姗形容走得缓慢从容。慢腾腾地来晚了。
explanationTraditional: 姍姍形容走得緩慢從容。慢騰騰地來晚了。
explanationEn: To be late; to arrive slowly or behind schedule.
derivation: 《汉书·孝武李夫人传》立而望之，偏何姗姗其来迟。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·孝武李夫人傳》立而望之，偏何姍姍其來遲。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Lady Li': 'Standing and looking, why does she come so slowly?'
example: 什么事竟使你～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十八章
exampleTraditional: 什麼事竟使你～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十八章
exampleEn: What made you come so late? — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 18

explanation: 实实际的成就；至达到；名名誉；归到来。有了真正的学识、本领或功业，自然就有声誉。
explanationTraditional: 實實際的成就；至達到；名名譽；歸到來。有了真正的學識、本領或功業，自然就有聲譽。
explanationEn: When one has genuine achievements, fame naturally follows; recognition comes with merit.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十五回敦伦修行，终受当事之知；实至名归，反作终身之玷。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十五回敦倫修行，終受當事之知；實至名歸，反作終身之玷。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 15: 'Cultivating virtue and practicing morality will eventually be recognized by those in power; when substance is achieved, fame follows, but it may become a lifelong stain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 事实与愿望相反。指原来打算做的事没能做到。
explanationTraditional: 事實與願望相反。指原來打算做的事沒能做到。
explanationEn: Things turn out contrary to one's wishes; reality does not match expectations.
derivation: 三国魏·嵇康《幽愤》诗事与愿违，遘兹淹留。”
derivationTraditional: 三國魏·嵇康《幽憤》詩事與願違，遘茲淹留。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Wei, Ji Kang, 'Poem of Indignation': 'Things turn out contrary to my wishes, thus I am detained here.'
example: 不料后来～，现在这点局面小得很，应酬不开！★茅盾《子夜》十六
exampleTraditional: 不料後來～，現在這點局面小得很，應酬不開！★茅盾《子夜》十六
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, things turned out contrary to our wishes; now the situation is very small and cannot handle everything! — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 16

explanation: 形容轻快地跳起舞来。
explanationTraditional: 形容輕快地跳起舞來。
explanationEn: To dance gracefully; to dance lightly and elegantly.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·四牡》翩翩者鵻，载飞载下。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·四牡》翩翩者鵻，載飛載下。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Simu': 'The turtledove flutters, now flying up, now down.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指事物的花样或名称非常多。
explanationTraditional: 指事物的花樣或名稱非常多。
explanationEn: Having a great variety of names or items; numerous categories.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 凤凰的羽毛，麒麟的角。比喻珍贵而稀少的人或物。
explanationTraditional: 鳳凰的羽毛，麒麟的角。比喻珍貴而稀少的人或物。
explanationEn: Rare and precious person or thing, like phoenix feathers and unicorn horns.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·容止》大奴固自有凤毛。”《南史·谢超宗传》超宗殊有凤毛。”《北史·文苑传序》学者如牛毛，成者如麟角。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·容止》大奴固自有鳳毛。”《南史·謝超宗傳》超宗殊有鳳毛。”《北史·文苑傳序》學者如牛毛，成者如麟角。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' and 'History of the Northern Dynasties': 'Scholars are as many as ox hair, but successful ones are as rare as unicorn horns.'
example: 全县只考上你一个，无论如何是～。★梁斌《红旗谱》二十
exampleTraditional: 全縣只考上你一個，無論如何是～。★梁斌《紅旗譜》二十
exampleEn: You are the only one in the county who passed the exam, so you are indeed a rare talent. (from Liang Bin's 'Red Flag Chronicle')

explanation: 忍气受了气不发作；吞声不敢出声。指受了气勉强忍耐，有话不敢说出来。
explanationTraditional: 忍氣受了氣不發作；吞聲不敢出聲。指受了氣勉強忍耐，有話不敢說出來。
explanationEn: To swallow one's anger and endure silently, not daring to speak out.
derivation: 元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第四折从今后忍气吞声，再不敢嚎唃痛哭。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第四折從今後忍氣吞聲，再不敢嚎唃痛哭。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty play 'Xiaoxiang Rain' by Yang Xianzhi: 'From now on, I will swallow my anger and dare not cry out.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 濡沾湿；染沾染。耳朵经常听到，眼睛经常看到，不知不觉地受到影响。
explanationTraditional: 濡沾溼；染沾染。耳朵經常聽到，眼睛經常看到，不知不覺地受到影響。
explanationEn: To be imperceptibly influenced by what one frequently sees and hears.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《清河郡公房公墓碣铭》目濡耳染，不学以能。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《清河郡公房公墓碣銘》目濡耳染，不學以能。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Fang Gong': 'Eyes and ears are soaked and dyed, learning without effort.'
example: 她完全没有读过书，但她单凭～，也认得一些字，而且能够暗诵得好些唐诗。★郭沫若《少年时代·我的童年》
exampleTraditional: 她完全沒有讀過書，但她單憑～，也認得一些字，而且能夠闇誦得好些唐詩。★郭沫若《少年時代·我的童年》
exampleEn: She had never been to school, but through constant exposure, she learned some characters and could recite many Tang poems. (from Guo Moruo's 'My Childhood')

explanation: 天伦旧指父子、兄弟等亲属关系。泛指家庭的乐趣。
explanationTraditional: 天倫舊指父子、兄弟等親屬關係。泛指家庭的樂趣。
explanationEn: The happiness of family reunion and familial harmony.
derivation: 唐·李白《春夜宴从弟桃花园序》会桃花之芳园，序天伦之乐事。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《春夜宴從弟桃花園序》會桃花之芳園，序天倫之樂事。”
derivationEn: From Li Bai's 'Preface to the Spring Night Feast with Cousins': 'Gathering in the peach blossom garden, enjoying the joy of family.'
example: 这时父亲如果能够保持着相当丰裕的收入，家中当然充满一片～。★闻一多《关于儒、道、土匪》
exampleTraditional: 這時父親如果能夠保持著相當豐裕的收入，家中當然充滿一片～。★聞一多《關於儒、道、土匪》
exampleEn: If the father could maintain a decent income, the home would be filled with family happiness. (from Wen Yiduo's 'On Confucianism, Taoism, and Bandits')

explanation: 一口气做成。形容文章结构紧凑，文气连贯。也比喻做一件事安排紧凑，迅速不间断地完成。
explanationTraditional: 一口氣做成。形容文章結構緊湊，文氣連貫。也比喻做一件事安排緊湊，迅速不間斷地完成。
explanationEn: To accomplish something in one go, without interruption; often used for writing or tasks done smoothly and continuously.
derivation: 明·胡应麟《诗薮·近体中》若‘风急天高’，则一篇之中句句皆律，一句之中字字皆律，而实一意贯串，一气呵成。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡應麟《詩藪·近體中》若‘風急天高’，則一篇之中句句皆律，一句之中字字皆律，而實一意貫串，一氣呵成。”
derivationEn: From Hu Yinglin's 'Poetic Remarks': 'In a poem like 'Wind High and Sky Clear,' every line is regulated, and the whole is completed in one breath.'
example: 北曲之介白者每折不过数言，即抹去宾白而止阅填词，亦皆～，无有断续。★清·李渔《闲情偶寄·宾白第四》
exampleTraditional: 北曲之介白者每折不過數言，即抹去賓白而止閱填詞，亦皆～，無有斷續。★清·李漁《閒情偶寄·賓白第四》
exampleEn: In northern opera, each act has only a few lines of dialogue; even without them, the lyrics are coherent and completed in one go. (from Li Yu's 'Casual Expressions')

explanation: 一千年里也难碰到一次。形容机会极其难得。
explanationTraditional: 一千年裡也難碰到一次。形容機會極其難得。
explanationEn: Extremely rare opportunity, once in a thousand years.
derivation: 《南齐书·瘐杲之传》臣以凡庸，谬徼（侥）昌运，奖擢之厚，千载难逢。”唐·韩愈《潮州刺史谢上表》当此之际，所谓千载一时不可逢之嘉会。”
derivationTraditional: 《南齊書·瘐杲之傳》臣以凡庸，謬徼（僥）昌運，獎擢之厚，千載難逢。”唐·韓愈《潮州刺史謝上表》當此之際，所謂千載一時不可逢之嘉會。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Southern Qi' and Han Yu's 'Memorial to the Emperor': 'Such a rare opportunity is a blessed encounter that comes once in a thousand years.'
example: 天下竟有如此奇事！怪不得叔叔说是我们闺中～际遇，真是旷古少有。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十一回
exampleTraditional: 天下竟有如此奇事！怪不得叔叔說是我們閨中～際遇，真是曠古少有。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十一回
exampleEn: What a rare event! No wonder uncle says it's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity for us ladies. (from Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror')

explanation: 比喻眼前看到的都是灾祸的景象。
explanationTraditional: 比喻眼前看到的都是災禍的景象。
explanationEn: Everywhere one looks, there are scenes of devastation and disaster.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《北征》诗乾坤含疮痍，忧虞何时毕？”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《北征》詩乾坤含瘡痍，憂虞何時畢？”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Northern Expedition': 'The world is full of wounds; when will my worries end?'
example: 台风过处，～，给人们的生命财产造成了极大的桅。
exampleTraditional: 颱風過處，～，給人們的生命財產造成了極大的桅。
exampleEn: After the typhoon, the area was devastated, causing great damage to people's lives and property.

explanation: 聚集成堆，如同小山。形容极多。
explanationTraditional: 聚集成堆，如同小山。形容極多。
explanationEn: Piled up like a mountain; extremely abundant.
derivation: 宋·孟元老《东京梦华录·外诸司》每遇冬月，诸乡纳粟秆草，牛车阗塞道路，车尾相衔，数千万辆不绝，场内堆积如山。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·孟元老《東京夢華錄·外諸司》每遇冬月，諸鄉納粟稈草，牛車闐塞道路，車尾相銜，數千萬輛不絕，場內堆積如山。”
derivationEn: From Meng Yuanlao's 'Dreams of Splendor of the Eastern Capital': 'In winter, carts of grain straw fill the roads, and the piles are like mountains.'
example: 福王仓中的粮食～，朽得不能再吃。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第五十一章
exampleTraditional: 福王倉中的糧食～，朽得不能再吃。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第五十一章
exampleEn: The grain in Prince Fu's granary was piled up like a mountain and had rotted beyond consumption. (from Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng')

explanation: 什么也没有。指钱财，也指成绩、知识。
explanationTraditional: 什麼也沒有。指錢財，也指成績、知識。
explanationEn: To have nothing at all; destitute or lacking any achievement or knowledge.
derivation: 《敦煌变文集·庐山远公话》如水中之月，空里之风，万法皆无，一无所有。”
derivationTraditional: 《敦煌變文集·廬山遠公話》如水中之月，空裡之風，萬法皆無，一無所有。”
derivationEn: From 'Dunhuang Bianwen': 'Like the moon in water, wind in the sky, all things are empty, nothing exists.'
example: 如今凤姐儿～，贾琏外头债务满身。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百六回
exampleTraditional: 如今鳳姐兒～，賈璉外頭債務滿身。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百六回
exampleEn: Now Xifeng has nothing left, and Jia Lian is drowning in debt. (from Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber')

explanation: 指追溯事物发生的根源。同追本溯源”。
explanationTraditional: 指追溯事物發生的根源。同追本溯源”。
explanationEn: To trace back to the root or origin of something.
derivation: 晓剑《本市市长无房住》其实，若追根溯源，他还是为了使自己更能堂堂正正地搬进市长楼，而不至于落个将前人卸磨杀驴、扫地出门的恶名。”
derivationTraditional: 曉劍《本市市長無房住》其實，若追根溯源，他還是為了使自己更能堂堂正正地搬進市長樓，而不至於落個將前人卸磨殺驢、掃地出門的惡名。”
derivationEn: From Xiao Jian's 'The Mayor Has No House': 'Actually, if we trace back to the source, he did it to move into the mayor's building with a clear conscience.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 抖擞振动，引伸为振作。形容精神振奋。
explanationTraditional: 抖擻振動，引伸為振作。形容精神振奮。
explanationEn: Full of energy and spirit; vigorous and energetic.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录·杭州光庆寺遇安禅师》（僧）问‘光吞万象从师道，心月孤圆意若何？’师曰‘抖擞精神着。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄·杭州光慶寺遇安禪師》（僧）問‘光吞萬象從師道，心月孤圓意若何？’師曰‘抖擻精神著。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan's 'Jingde Chuandeng Lu': A monk asked a question, and the master replied 'Shake up your spirit.'
example: 我则见玳筵前摆列着英雄辈，一个个～。★元·无名氏《隔江斗智》第二折
exampleTraditional: 我則見玳筵前擺列著英雄輩，一個個～。★元·無名氏《隔江鬥智》第二折
exampleEn: I see heroes lined up before the tortoiseshell feast, each one full of energy. — Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'The Stratagem of the River' Act 2

explanation: 惶惶也作皇皇”，惊惶不安的样子。人们心中惊惶不安。
explanationTraditional: 惶惶也作皇皇”，驚惶不安的樣子。人們心中驚惶不安。
explanationEn: People are anxious and uneasy; widespread fear and unrest.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第四回今人心皇皇，见太叔势大力强，尽怀观望。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第四回今人心皇皇，見太叔勢大力強，盡懷觀望。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 4: 'Now people's hearts are anxious, seeing the prince's power and strength, all watch with hesitation.'
example: 无端起来胡闹，蒌喊一阵，西跑一阵，弄得～，不是扰乱治安是什么？★哇圣陶《丁祭》
exampleTraditional: 無端起來胡鬧，蔞喊一陣，西跑一陣，弄得～，不是擾亂治安是什麼？★哇聖陶《丁祭》
exampleEn: Suddenly causing trouble, shouting here and running there, making people anxious—isn't that disturbing public order? — Ye Shengtao 'Ding Sacrifice'

explanation: 从早到晚都在一起。形容常生活在一起，关系密切。
explanationTraditional: 從早到晚都在一起。形容常生活在一起，關係密切。
explanationEn: To be together from morning to night; to live closely and have a close relationship.
derivation: 冯玉祥《我的生活》第十四章这时我和梁（喜奎）同住一间房，朝夕相处，相爱如弟兄。”
derivationTraditional: 馮玉祥《我的生活》第十四章這時我和梁（喜奎）同住一間房，朝夕相處，相愛如弟兄。”
derivationEn: Feng Yuxiang's 'My Life' Chapter 14: 'At that time, Liang and I shared a room, living together day and night, loving each other like brothers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指以仁为任，无所谦让◇指遇到应该做的事就积极主动去做，不推让。
explanationTraditional: 原指以仁為任，無所謙讓◇指遇到應該做的事就積極主動去做，不推讓。
explanationEn: To not decline to do what is right; to take initiative in doing good deeds without hesitation.
derivation: 《论语·卫灵公》子曰‘当仁，不让于师。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·衛靈公》子曰‘當仁，不讓於師。’”
derivationEn: Confucian Analects, Wei Ling Gong: Confucius said, 'When it comes to benevolence, do not yield even to your teacher.'
example: 人家骂小弟鱼肉乡愚，这句话仔细想来，在小弟却是～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 人家罵小弟魚肉鄉愚，這句話仔細想來，在小弟卻是～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十七回
exampleEn: People accuse me of bullying the villagers; upon careful thought, I should not decline this accusation. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia 'The Bureaucrats' Chapter 17

explanation: 形容要求不遂就纠缠个没烷完。
explanationTraditional: 形容要求不遂就糾纏個沒烷完。
explanationEn: To be relentless and not let go; to keep pestering until one's demands are met.
derivation: 郝艳霞 王润生《三请薛仁贵》第三回李氏和柳大洪慌忙来到前厅，为银环求情。柳刚不依不饶。李氏急了，说‘你要杀银环，我就撞头！’”
derivationTraditional: 郝豔霞 王潤生《三請薛仁貴》第三回李氏和柳大洪慌忙來到前廳，為銀環求情。柳剛不依不饒。李氏急了，說‘你要殺銀環，我就撞頭！’”
derivationEn: Hao Yanxia and Wang Runsheng's 'Three Invitations to Xue Rengui' Chapter 3: 'Li and Liu Dahong hurried to the front hall to plead for Yinhuan. Liu Gang was relentless. Li said, 'If you kill Yinhuan, I'll hit my head!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 设设想。设想自己处在别人的那种境地。指替别人的处境着想。
explanationTraditional: 設設想。設想自己處在別人的那種境地。指替別人的處境著想。
explanationEn: To put oneself in someone else's shoes; to consider things from another's perspective.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》体群臣也。”朱熹注体，谓设以身处其地而察其心也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》體群臣也。”朱熹注體，謂設以身處其地而察其心也。”
derivationEn: The Book of Rites, Doctrine of the Mean: Zhu Xi's commentary: 'Ti means to put oneself in that person's place and examine their heart.'
example: 若非梦往神游，何谓～？（清·李渔《闲情偶寄》卷三《语求肖似》）
exampleTraditional: 若非夢往神遊，何謂～？（清·李漁《閒情偶寄》卷三《語求肖似》）
exampleEn: If not for dreaming and wandering in spirit, how could one put oneself in another's place? — Qing Dynasty, Li Yu 'Casual Expressions' Volume 3

explanation: 风景优美和有古代遗迹的著名地方。
explanationTraditional: 風景優美和有古代遺蹟的著名地方。
explanationEn: Famous scenic spots and historical sites.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 中国的名胜古迹值得我们去参观。
exampleTraditional: 中國的名勝古蹟值得我們去參觀。
exampleEn: China's famous scenic spots and historical sites are worth visiting.

explanation: 烧焦了头，灼伤了额。比喻非常狼狈窘迫。有时也形容忙得不知如何是好，带有夸张的意思。
explanationTraditional: 燒焦了頭，灼傷了額。比喻非常狼狽窘迫。有時也形容忙得不知如何是好，帶有誇張的意思。
explanationEn: To be in a terrible mess or predicament; also used hyperbolically to describe being extremely busy.
derivation: 《汉书·霍光传》曲突徙薪亡恩泽，焦头烂额为上客耶？”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·霍光傳》曲突徙薪亡恩澤，焦頭爛額為上客耶？”
derivationEn: Book of Han, Biography of Huo Guang: 'Those who suggested bending the chimney and moving the firewood are not rewarded, while those with burnt heads and foreheads become honored guests?'
example: 殡焰飞腾，众水手被火烧得～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二十六回
exampleTraditional: 殯焰飛騰，眾水手被火燒得～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二十六回
exampleEn: The flames soared, and the sailors were burnt and battered. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 26

explanation: 没有一点原因。
explanationTraditional: 沒有一點原因。
explanationEn: Without any reason or cause; for no reason at all.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十四回好好儿的，从那里说起！无缘无故白受了一场气！”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十四回好好兒的，從那裡說起！無緣無故白受了一場氣！”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 44: 'What's the matter? For no reason at all, I've suffered a fit of anger!'
example: 他的力量，力气，一向使他自尊自傲，可是在过去的这些日子，～的他受尽了委曲与困苦。★老舍《骆驼祥子》三
exampleTraditional: 他的力量，力氣，一向使他自尊自傲，可是在過去的這些日子，～的他受盡了委曲與困苦。★老舍《駱駝祥子》三
exampleEn: His strength and energy had always made him proud, but in these past days, he suffered humiliation and hardship for no reason. — Lao She 'Rickshaw Boy' Chapter 3

explanation: 一天一天地、一月一月地不断积累。指长时间不断地积累。
explanationTraditional: 一天一天地、一月一月地不斷積累。指長時間不斷地積累。
explanationEn: To accumulate over a long period; day by day and month by month.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《答周南仲书》随时体究，随时讨论，但使一日之间整顿得三五次，理会得三五事，则日积月累，自然纯熟，自然光明矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《答周南仲書》隨時體究，隨時討論，但使一日之間整頓得三五次，理會得三五事，則日積月累，自然純熟，自然光明矣。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi's 'Reply to Zhou Nanzhong': 'Examine and discuss at any time, so that in one day you sort out three to five times and understand three to five matters, then day by day and month by month, you will naturally become proficient and enlightened.'
example: 自是以后，～，千百成群，其为国之蠹害甚矣。（清·顾炎武《日知录》卷九）
exampleTraditional: 自是以後，～，千百成群，其為國之蠹害甚矣。（清·顧炎武《日知錄》卷九）
exampleEn: From then on, accumulating day by day and month by month, they formed thousands and hundreds, becoming a great pest to the country. — Qing Dynasty, Gu Yanwu 'Record of Daily Knowledge' Volume 9

explanation: 旷荒废，耽误。荒废时间，拖得很久。
explanationTraditional: 曠荒廢，耽誤。荒廢時間，拖得很久。
explanationEn: To waste time and drag on for a long time.
derivation: 《战国策·赵策四》今得强赵之兵，以杜燕将，旷日持久，数岁，令士大夫余子之力，尽于沟垒。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·趙策四》今得強趙之兵，以杜燕將，曠日持久，數歲，令士大夫餘子之力，盡於溝壘。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States·Strategy of Zhao IV': 'Now with the strong troops of Zhao, to block the Yan general, it will be time-consuming and protracted, for several years, exhausting the strength of the officers and their sons in the trenches.'
example: 这厮们死守不出，便要～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 這廝們死守不出，便要～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十八回
exampleEn: These scoundrels are determined to hold out and not come out, thus dragging on for a long time. — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 18

explanation: 胫小腿；走跑。没有腿却能跑。比喻事物无需推行，就已迅速地传播开去。
explanationTraditional: 脛小腿；走跑。沒有腿卻能跑。比喻事物無需推行，就已迅速地傳播開去。
explanationEn: To spread rapidly without any promotion, like something without legs that can run.
derivation: 汉·孔融《论盛孝章书》珠玉无胫而自至者，以人好之也，况贤者之有足乎？”
derivationTraditional: 漢·孔融《論盛孝章書》珠玉無脛而自至者，以人好之也，況賢者之有足乎？”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Kong Rong's 'On Sheng Xiaozhang': 'Jade and gems come without legs because people like them; how much more so for virtuous men who have feet?'
example: 袁伯珍慌忙把家里所有的东西，检点一番；别的一样不缺，只有金银首饰和钞票洋钱，却一概～。★清·无名氏《官场维新记》第四回
exampleTraditional: 袁伯珍慌忙把家裡所有的東西，檢點一番；別的一樣不缺，只有金銀首飾和鈔票洋錢，卻一概～。★清·無名氏《官場維新記》第四回
exampleEn: Yuan Bozhen hurriedly checked all the things in his house; nothing else was missing, but gold, silver jewelry, banknotes, and silver dollars had all spread without legs. — Qing Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Officialdom Reform', Chapter 4

explanation: 忍俊含笑；不禁无法控制自己。指忍不住要发笑。
explanationTraditional: 忍俊含笑；不禁無法控制自己。指忍不住要發笑。
explanationEn: Unable to help laughing; to be unable to suppress a smile.
derivation: 唐·赵璾《因话录》卷五柜初成，周戎时为吏部郎中，大书其上，戏作考词状‘当有千有万，忍俊不禁，考上下。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·趙璾《因話錄》卷五櫃初成，周戎時為吏部郎中，大書其上，戲作考詞狀‘當有千有萬，忍俊不禁，考上下。’”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Zhao Ji's 'Record of Conversations', Volume 5: 'When the cabinet was first completed, Zhou Rong, then a minister of personnel, wrote a large inscription on it, playfully composing an examination comment: 'There should be thousands and tens of thousands, unable to help laughing, examine the upper and lower.'
example: 大熊猫憨态可掬，小猴子顽皮可爱，使得周围的大人们～，孩子们更是笑得前仰后合。
exampleTraditional: 大熊貓憨態可掬，小猴子頑皮可愛，使得周圍的大人們～，孩子們更是笑得前仰後合。
exampleEn: The giant pandas were charmingly naive, and the little monkeys were naughty and cute, making the surrounding adults unable to help laughing, and the children laughed even more uncontrollably.

explanation: 成成为，变成。一群群人集合在一起。
explanationTraditional: 成成為，變成。一群群人集合在一起。
explanationEn: To gather in groups; to form crowds.
derivation: 《新编五代史平话·周史上》无奈那雀儿成群结队来偷吃谷粟，才赶得东边的云，又向西边来吃。”
derivationTraditional: 《新編五代史平話·周史上》無奈那雀兒成群結隊來偷吃谷粟，才趕得東邊的雲，又向西邊來吃。”
derivationEn: From 'New Edition of the History of the Five Dynasties·Pinghua of Zhou History': 'But the sparrows came in flocks to steal the grain, and as soon as they drove away the clouds in the east, they came to eat in the west.'
example: 常与这些轻薄少年，～，驰马试剑，黑夜里往来太行道上。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷三十
exampleTraditional: 常與這些輕薄少年，～，馳馬試劍，黑夜裡往來太行道上。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷三十
exampleEn: They often associated with these frivolous youths, forming groups, galloping horses and testing swords, traveling on the Taihang Road in the dark of night. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 30

explanation: 一个接着一个而不间断。
explanationTraditional: 一個接著一個而不間斷。
explanationEn: Continuously; one after another without interruption.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十三回陈设兵卫，自王宫起，直至光家之门，街衢皆满，接连不断。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十三回陳設兵衛，自王宮起，直至光家之門，街衢皆滿，接連不斷。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 73: 'They set up military guards from the king's palace all the way to the door of Guang's house, filling the streets, one after another without interruption.'
example: 只见人烟辏集，作买作卖，～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 只見人煙輳集，作買作賣，～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十一回
exampleEn: One could see a dense crowd of people buying and selling, one after another without interruption. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 11

explanation: 无稽无法考查。没有根据的说法。
explanationTraditional: 無稽無法考查。沒有根據的說法。
explanationEn: An unfounded statement; a baseless rumor.
derivation: 《尚书·大禹漠》无稽之言勿听。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·大禹漠》無稽之言勿聽。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents·Counsels of the Great Yu': 'Do not listen to baseless words.'
example: 既无其说，是为～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 既無其說，是為～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十七回
exampleEn: Since there is no such theory, it is an unfounded statement. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 17

explanation: 形容欠债很多。
explanationTraditional: 形容欠債很多。
explanationEn: To be heavily in debt; to be up to one's ears in debt.
derivation: 《汉书·诸侯王表序》分为二周，有逃债之台。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·諸侯王表序》分為二週，有逃債之臺。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han·Table of Princes': 'Divided into two Zhou, there was a platform for escaping debts.'
example: 由于经营不善，这家公司现已陷入～的境地。
exampleTraditional: 由於經營不善，這家公司現已陷入～的境地。
exampleEn: Due to poor management, this company is now deeply in debt.

explanation: 因根据；材资质；施施加；教教育。指针对学习的人的志趣、能力等具体情况进行不同的教育。
explanationTraditional: 因根據；材資質；施施加；教教育。指針對學習的人的志趣、能力等具體情況進行不同的教育。
explanationEn: To teach students according to their aptitude; to tailor education to individual abilities.
derivation: 《论语·为政》子游问孝”、子夏问孝”朱熹集注引宋程颐曰子游能养而或失于敬，子夏能直义而或少温润之色，各因其材之高下与其所失而告之，故不同也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·為政》子游問孝”、子夏問孝”朱熹集註引宋程頤曰子游能養而或失於敬，子夏能直義而或少溫潤之色，各因其材之高下與其所失而告之，故不同也。”
derivationEn: From 'Analects of Confucius·Wei Zheng': When Ziyou asked about filial piety and Zixia asked about filial piety, Zhu Xi's commentary quotes Cheng Yi: 'Ziyou can support but may lack respect, Zixia can be righteous but may lack warmth; each is taught according to his talent and shortcomings, so the teachings differ.'
example: 教师应当注意学生各方面的差异，以便～。
exampleTraditional: 教師應當注意學生各方面的差異，以便～。
exampleEn: Teachers should pay attention to the differences among students in various aspects in order to teach according to their aptitude.

explanation: 居处于；思想。虽然处在平安的环境里，也想到有出现危险的可能。指随时有应付意外事件的思想准备。
explanationTraditional: 居處於；思想。雖然處在平安的環境裡，也想到有出現危險的可能。指隨時有應付意外事件的思想準備。
explanationEn: To be prepared for danger in times of peace; to think of potential problems while in a safe situation.
derivation: 《左传·襄公十一年》居安思危，思则有备，有备无患。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公十一年》居安思危，思則有備，有備無患。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan·Duke Xiang's Eleventh Year': 'Be prepared for danger in times of peace, and preparation ensures safety, safety prevents disaster.'
example: 得宠思辱，～（清·钱彩《说岳全传》第六十回）
