exampleTraditional: 得寵思辱，～（清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第六十回）
exampleEn: When favored, think of disgrace; be prepared for danger in times of peace. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 60

explanation: 形容遇事慌张，不知如何是好。
explanationTraditional: 形容遇事慌張，不知如何是好。
explanationEn: To be in a flurry; to be flustered and at a loss.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》问‘如何是大悲境？’师曰‘千眼都来一只收。’曰‘如何是境中人？’师曰‘手忙脚乱。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》問‘如何是大悲境？’師曰‘千眼都來一隻收。’曰‘如何是境中人？’師曰‘手忙腳亂。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Question: 'What is the realm of Great Compassion?' Master: 'A thousand eyes all come to one hand.' Question: 'What is the person in the realm?' Master: 'Hands and feet in a flurry.'
example: 諕的我～紧收拾。★元·无名氏《百花亭》第三折
exampleTraditional: 諕的我～緊收拾。★元·無名氏《百花亭》第三折
exampleEn: I was so frightened that I hurriedly packed up in a flurry. — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Baihua Pavilion', Act 3

explanation: 指各种事情中有主要的和次要的，有急于要办的和可以慢一点办的。
explanationTraditional: 指各種事情中有主要的和次要的，有急於要辦的和可以慢一點辦的。
explanationEn: Refers to the relative importance and urgency of various matters, distinguishing between primary and secondary, urgent and less urgent.
derivation: 清·顾炎武《日知录》卷七古之人有至于张空弮、罗雀鼠而民无二志者，非上之信有以结其心乎？此又权于缓急轻重之间而为不得已之计也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·顧炎武《日知錄》卷七古之人有至於張空弮、羅雀鼠而民無二志者，非上之信有以結其心乎？此又權於緩急輕重之間而為不得已之計也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Gu Yanwu's 'Rizhilu', Volume 7: 'In ancient times, people sometimes had to resort to extreme measures, but the people remained loyal because the ruler had won their hearts. This is a matter of weighing urgency and importance as a last resort.'
example: 事有～，不能不从长计较哩。★清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第五回
exampleTraditional: 事有～，不能不從長計較哩。★清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第五回
exampleEn: Matters have their priorities and urgencies; we must consider them carefully. (From Qing Dynasty Lingnan Yuyi Nushi's 'Eastern European Heroines', Chapter 5)

explanation: 暇空闲。原形容景物繁多，来不及观赏◇多形容来人或事情太多，应付不过来。
explanationTraditional: 暇空閒。原形容景物繁多，來不及觀賞◇多形容來人或事情太多，應付不過來。
explanationEn: Originally described too many beautiful sights to take in; now often means too many people or things to handle.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》从山阴道上行，山川自相应发，使人应接不暇。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》從山陰道上行，山川自相應發，使人應接不暇。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' (Southern Song): 'Traveling along the Shanyin road, the mountains and rivers unfold continuously, leaving one with no time to take them all in.'
example: 汽车向神农架山区奔驰，只见奇峰异岭扑面而来，令人～。
exampleTraditional: 汽車向神農架山區奔馳，只見奇峰異嶺撲面而來，令人～。
exampleEn: As the car sped towards the Shennongjia forest region, the strange peaks and unusual ridges rushed towards us, leaving us with no time to take them all in.

explanation: 表示永远不变心。
explanationTraditional: 表示永遠不變心。
explanationEn: Means one's resolve never changes; unwavering commitment.
derivation: 《晋书·谢安传》安虽受朝寄，然东山之志始末不渝，每形于言色。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·謝安傳》安雖受朝寄，然東山之志始末不渝，每形於言色。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Xie An': 'Although Xie An received the court's commission, his aspiration for the Eastern Mountains never wavered, and it often showed in his words and expression.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 近在手边，一伸手就可以接触到。
explanationTraditional: 近在手邊，一伸手就可以接觸到。
explanationEn: Within easy reach; close at hand.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这东西就在你身边，你触手可及就可以拿到。
exampleTraditional: 這東西就在你身邊，你觸手可及就可以拿到。
exampleEn: This thing is right beside you; you can reach it with a touch.

explanation: 发启发；省醒悟。启发人深刻思考，有所醒悟。
explanationTraditional: 發啟發；省醒悟。啟發人深刻思考，有所醒悟。
explanationEn: To inspire deep thought and reflection; thought-provoking.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《游龙门奉先寺》诗欲觉闻晨钟，令人发深省。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《游龍門奉先寺》詩欲覺聞晨鐘，令人發深省。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Visiting Fengxian Temple at Longmen' (Tang Dynasty): 'About to wake, I hear the morning bell, which inspires deep reflection.'
example: 以当清夜闻钟，～。（《虞初新志·金忠洁公传评》）
exampleTraditional: 以當清夜聞鍾，～。（《虞初新志·金忠潔公傳評》）
exampleEn: It is like hearing a bell in the quiet night, inspiring deep reflection. (From 'Yuchu Xin Zhi: Biography of Jin Zhongjie')

explanation: 砸开门进去。多指盗贼行为。
explanationTraditional: 砸開門進去。多指盜賊行為。
explanationEn: To break into a door and enter; often refers to burglary.
derivation: 章炳麟《驳革命驳议》迨至群盗破门而入，即更不复能抵御。”
derivationTraditional: 章炳麟《駁革命駁議》迨至群盜破門而入，即更不復能抵禦。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Binglin's 'Refuting the Revolution': 'When the bandits break in, there is no longer any way to resist.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 工细致，巧妙；异不同的。不同的曲调演得同样好。比喻话的说法不一而用意相同，或一件事情的做法不同而都巧妙地达到目的。
explanationTraditional: 工細緻，巧妙；異不同的。不同的曲調演得同樣好。比喻話的說法不一而用意相同，或一件事情的做法不同而都巧妙地達到目的。
explanationEn: Different tunes played with equal skill; different approaches leading to the same excellent result.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《进学解》子云相如，同工异曲。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《進學解》子云相如，同工異曲。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Jinxue Jie' (Tang Dynasty): 'Ziyun and Xiangru, though different in style, are equally skillful.'
example: 至诚虽是个小弟弟，又是个书朋友，他的观察力和记忆力却髒髒乎与大哥～。★朱自清《序叶氏兄弟的第二个集子》
exampleTraditional: 至誠雖是個小弟弟，又是個書朋友，他的觀察力和記憶力卻髒髒乎與大哥～。★朱自清《序葉氏兄弟的第二個集子》
exampleEn: Although Zhicheng is the youngest brother and a bookish friend, his observation and memory are almost as remarkable as his elder brother's, achieving the same effect through different means. (From Zhu Ziqing's 'Preface to the Second Collection of the Ye Brothers')

explanation: 自己一个人低声嘀咕。
explanationTraditional: 自己一個人低聲嘀咕。
explanationEn: To talk to oneself; mutter under one's breath.
derivation: 元·无名氏《桃花女》第四折你这般鬼促促的，在这自言自语，莫不要出城去砍那桃树吗？”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《桃花女》第四折你這般鬼促促的，在這自言自語，莫不要出城去砍那桃樹嗎？”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'The Peach Blossom Girl', Act 4: 'You are so fidgety, muttering to yourself. Are you going out of the city to cut down that peach tree?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 左右的邻居。也比喻关系比较接近的其它单位。
explanationTraditional: 左右的鄰居。也比喻關係比較接近的其它單位。
explanationEn: Neighbors on all sides; also metaphorically refers to closely related units.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》云来雾去，走石飞砂，唬得我一家并左邻右舍，俱不得安生。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》雲來霧去，走石飛砂，唬得我一家並左鄰右舍，俱不得安生。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West': 'Riding clouds and mists, stirring up wind and sand, scaring my whole family and the neighbors left and right, none could rest in peace.'
example: 照顾‘～’，不能搞先进迁就落后，不能搞平均主义。★《人民日报》1984.8.3
exampleTraditional: 照顧‘～’，不能搞先進遷就落後，不能搞平均主義。★《人民日報》1984.8.3
exampleEn: Take care of the 'neighbors'; do not let the advanced lag behind, and avoid egalitarianism. (From 'People's Daily', August 3, 1984)

explanation: 喜欢做某事，并在其中获得乐趣。
explanationTraditional: 喜歡做某事，並在其中獲得樂趣。
explanationEn: To find joy in doing something; to derive pleasure from an activity.
derivation: 《论语·述而》饭疏食饮水，曲肱而枕之，乐亦在其中矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》飯疏食飲水，曲肱而枕之，樂亦在其中矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Shu Er': 'Eating coarse rice, drinking water, and pillowing one's head on the arm—there is joy in it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 身亲身，亲自；试尝试。试着亲身去做触犯法律的事。指明知故犯。
explanationTraditional: 身親身，親自；試嘗試。試著親身去做觸犯法律的事。指明知故犯。
explanationEn: To knowingly violate the law; to defy the law deliberately.
derivation: 《汉书·王尊传》明慎所职，毋以身试法。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·王尊傳》明慎所職，毋以身試法。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Wang Zun': 'Be cautious in your duties, do not defy the law.'
example: 我们每个公民都要奉公守法，不要～。
exampleTraditional: 我們每個公民都要奉公守法，不要～。
exampleEn: Every citizen should abide by the law and not defy it.

explanation: 指勉强养活家人，使不饿肚。
explanationTraditional: 指勉強養活家人，使不餓肚。
explanationEn: To support one's family; to earn a living for one's family.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 矢箭；的箭靶的中心。众箭所射的靶子。比喻大家攻击的对象。
explanationTraditional: 矢箭；的箭靶的中心。眾箭所射的靶子。比喻大家攻擊的對象。
explanationEn: Target of public criticism; object of general attack.
derivation: 《鲁迅书信集·致许寿裳》语堂为提倡语录体，在此几成众矢之的。”
derivationTraditional: 《魯迅書信集·致許壽裳》語堂為提倡語錄體，在此幾成眾矢之的。”
derivationEn: From 'Lu Xun's Letters: To Xu Shoushang': 'Yutang, for advocating the语录 style, has become the target of public criticism.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心情平静，态度温和。指不急躁，不生气。
explanationTraditional: 心情平靜，態度溫和。指不急躁，不生氣。
explanationEn: Calm and composed; even-tempered and unruffled.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《菜羹赋》先生心平而气和，故虽老而体胖。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《菜羹賦》先生心平而氣和，故雖老而體胖。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Vegetable Soup Ode': 'The gentleman is calm in heart and gentle in temper, so though old, he is stout.'
example: 一想到事情的前因后果，他也就～了。
exampleTraditional: 一想到事情的前因後果，他也就～了。
exampleEn: After thinking about the whole situation, he became calm and composed.

explanation: 形容各项事业蓬勃发展，日益富足强大。
explanationTraditional: 形容各項事業蓬勃發展，日益富足強大。
explanationEn: Prosperous and powerful; thriving and strong.
derivation: 峻青《壮志录》……使我们的祖国，更加繁荣富强。”
derivationTraditional: 峻青《壯志錄》……使我們的祖國，更加繁榮富強。”
derivationEn: From Jun Qing's 'Aspirations': '...make our motherland more prosperous and powerful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 隐隐约约，看不清楚。
explanationTraditional: 隱隱約約，看不清楚。
explanationEn: Faintly visible; indistinct; appearing and disappearing.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·珠儿》李惊，方将诘问，则见其若隐若现，恍惚如烟雾，宛转间已登榻。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·珠兒》李驚，方將詰問，則見其若隱若現，恍惚如煙霧，宛轉間已登榻。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Zhu Er': 'Li was startled and about to question, when he saw it faintly visible, like mist, and in a moment it had climbed onto the bed.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 以浮夸的言论迎合群众，骗取群众的信赖和支持。
explanationTraditional: 以浮誇的言論迎合群眾，騙取群眾的信賴和支持。
explanationEn: To curry favor by claptrap; to please the public with sensationalism.
derivation: 《汉书·艺文志》然惑者既失精微，而辟者又随时扬抑，违离道本，苟以哗众取宠。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·藝文志》然惑者既失精微，而闢者又隨時揚抑，違離道本，苟以譁眾取寵。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Yi Wen Zhi': 'But the confused lost the essence, and the deviant followed trends, departing from the truth, merely to curry favor.'
example: ～的人，是不受人欢迎的。
exampleTraditional: ～的人，是不受人歡迎的。
exampleEn: People who curry favor by claptrap are not well-liked.

explanation: 横的竖的交叉在一起。也形容情况复杂。
explanationTraditional: 橫的豎的交叉在一起。也形容情況複雜。
explanationEn: Crisscrossed; interwoven in a complex manner.
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷十七见《万法归宗》中载有是符，其画纵横交贯，略如小篆。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷十七見《萬法歸宗》中載有是符，其畫縱橫交貫，略如小篆。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Observations': 'In volume 17, it records a talisman from 'The Return of All Laws', with lines crisscrossed like small seal script.'
example: 我国是一个多山之国，山脉～。
exampleTraditional: 我國是一個多山之國，山脈～。
exampleEn: China is a mountainous country with crisscrossing mountain ranges.

explanation: 穴孔、洞；来招致。有了洞穴才进风。比喻消息和谣言的传播不是完全没有原因的。也比喻流言乘机会传开来。
explanationTraditional: 穴孔、洞；來招致。有了洞穴才進風。比喻消息和謠言的傳播不是完全沒有原因的。也比喻流言乘機會傳開來。
explanationEn: A groundless rumor; literally 'wind from an empty cave' meaning there is some basis for the rumor.
derivation: 战国·楚·宋玉《风赋》臣闻于师枳句来巢，空穴来风。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·宋玉《風賦》臣聞於師枳句來巢，空穴來風。”
derivationEn: From Warring States Chu Song Yu's 'Ode to the Wind': 'I have heard from my teacher: crooked trees attract birds, empty caves invite wind.'
example: 然而银行当事人，安能逃避责任，～，理有固然。★清·梁启超《续论市民与银行》
exampleTraditional: 然而銀行當事人，安能逃避責任，～，理有固然。★清·梁啟超《續論市民與銀行》
exampleEn: However, the bank personnel cannot escape responsibility; a groundless rumor has its reasons. — Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao's 'Continued Discussion on Citizens and Banks'

explanation: 不迭不停止。形容连声叫苦。
explanationTraditional: 不迭不停止。形容連聲叫苦。
explanationEn: To complain incessantly; to groan without stopping.
derivation: 宋·无名氏《大宋宣和遗事》享集徽宗叫苦不迭，向外榻上忽然惊觉来，吓得浑身冷汗。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·無名氏《大宋宣和遺事》享集徽宗叫苦不迭，向外榻上忽然驚覺來，嚇得渾身冷汗。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty anonymous 'Events of the Xuanhe Era': 'Emperor Huizong groaned incessantly, then suddenly woke up on the outer couch, drenched in cold sweat.'
example: 只见靠壁一个蓬头孩子，曲着身子，睡得好不自在，夫人暗暗～。（明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二十八）
exampleTraditional: 只見靠壁一個蓬頭孩子，曲著身子，睡得好不自在，夫人暗暗～。（明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二十八）
exampleEn: Seeing a disheveled child curled up on the wall sleeping soundly, the lady groaned incessantly. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 28

explanation: 因顺着；势趋势；利导引导。顺着事情发展的趋势，加以引导。
explanationTraditional: 因順著；勢趨勢；利導引導。順著事情發展的趨勢，加以引導。
explanationEn: To guide or channel according to the trend of development; to make the best use of the situation.
derivation: 《史记·孙子吴起列传》善战者因其势而利导之。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孫子吳起列傳》善戰者因其勢而利導之。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Sun Tzu and Wu Qi': 'A good commander guides according to the situation and leads advantageously.'
example: 所以开明的行政者对于民意是～的，民意得到畅达，社会也就健全地发展了起来。★郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年续篇》
exampleTraditional: 所以開明的行政者對於民意是～的，民意得到暢達，社會也就健全地發展了起來。★郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年續篇》
exampleEn: Therefore, enlightened administrators guide public opinion according to the trend; when public opinion is freely expressed, society develops healthily. (Guo Moruo, 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: Sequel to Ten Years of Creation')

explanation: 德品德；望声望。道德高尚，名望很大。
explanationTraditional: 德品德；望聲望。道德高尚，名望很大。
explanationEn: Having high moral character and great prestige; respected for one's virtue and reputation.
derivation: 《晋书·简文三子传》元显因讽礼官下仪，称已德隆望重，既录百揆，内外群僚皆应尽敬。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·簡文三子傳》元顯因諷禮官下儀，稱已德隆望重，既錄百揆，內外群僚皆應盡敬。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Prince Jianwen's Three Sons': 'Yuan Xian instructed the ritual officials to propose that he was of high virtue and great prestige, and all officials should show respect.'
example: 我们家～，呼韩邪单于保护我们、信任我们。★曹禺《王昭君》第三幕
exampleTraditional: 我們家～，呼韓邪單于保護我們、信任我們。★曹禺《王昭君》第三幕
exampleEn: Our family is of high virtue and great prestige; Huhanye Chanyu protects us and trusts us. (Cao Yu, 'Wang Zhaojun', Act 3)

explanation: 公众大表惊讶和不满。
explanationTraditional: 公眾大表驚訝和不滿。
explanationEn: Public opinion erupts in shock and discontent; widespread public outcry.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这名高级官员在演说中公然侮辱新闻记者，顿时～。
exampleTraditional: 這名高級官員在演說中公然侮辱新聞記者，頓時～。
exampleEn: The senior official publicly insulted journalists in his speech, immediately causing a public outcry.

explanation: 恃倚仗，依靠；恐害怕。因为有所依杖而毫不害怕，或毫无顾忌。
explanationTraditional: 恃倚仗，依靠；恐害怕。因為有所依杖而毫不害怕，或毫無顧忌。
explanationEn: To be emboldened by having something to rely on; to act without fear or scruple.
derivation: 《左传·僖公二十六年》室如悬罄，野无青草，何恃而不恐？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公二十六年》室如懸罄，野無青草，何恃而不恐？”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: 26th Year of Duke Xi': 'The rooms are empty as a hanging bell, the fields have no green grass—what do you rely on not to fear?'
example: 我们实在还有一个更正大的理由使自己有恃而无恐。★闻一多《演讲录·民盟的性质与作风》
exampleTraditional: 我們實在還有一個更正大的理由使自己有恃而無恐。★聞一多《演講錄·民盟的性質與作風》
exampleEn: We actually have a more legitimate reason to be emboldened without fear. (Wen Yiduo, 'Speech: The Nature and Style of the Democratic League')

explanation: 关天比喻关系重大。指有关人命的事情关系及重大。
explanationTraditional: 關天比喻關係重大。指有關人命的事情關係及重大。
explanationEn: A matter of life and death; something extremely serious involving human life.
derivation: 元·无名氏《杀狗劝夫》第四折人命关天，分甚么首从。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《殺狗勸夫》第四折人命關天，分甚麼首從。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Killing the Dog to Persuade the Husband', Act 4: 'A matter of life and death is of utmost importance; what distinction between principal and accessory?'
example: 这是～的大事，千万不能大意。
exampleTraditional: 這是～的大事，千萬不能大意。
exampleEn: This is a matter of life and death; we must not be careless.

explanation: 磅礴广大无边的样子。形容气势雄伟壮大。
explanationTraditional: 磅礴廣大無邊的樣子。形容氣勢雄偉壯大。
explanationEn: Of great momentum and grandeur; majestic and powerful.
derivation: 秦牧《古战场春晓》这是中国近代史上气势磅礴的一页。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《古戰場春曉》這是中國近代史上氣勢磅礴的一頁。”
derivationEn: From Qin Mu's 'Spring Breeze on Ancient Battlefield': 'This is a page of majestic momentum in modern Chinese history.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 昙花即优昙钵花，开放时间很短。比喻美好的事物或景象出现了一下，很快就消失。
explanationTraditional: 曇花即優曇缽花，開放時間很短。比喻美好的事物或景象出現了一下，很快就消失。
explanationEn: To bloom briefly like the epiphyllum; a short-lived appearance of something beautiful or remarkable.
derivation: 《妙法莲华经·方便品》佛告舍利佛，如是妙法，诸佛如来，时乃说之，如优昙钵花，时一现耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《妙法蓮華經·方便品》佛告舍利佛，如是妙法，諸佛如來，時乃說之，如優曇缽花，時一現耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Saddharma Pundarika Sutra: Skillful Means Chapter': 'The Buddha told Shariputra that such wonderful Dharma is spoken by the Tathagatas only occasionally, like the udumbara flower appearing once in a while.'
example: 这种盛况，只是～。
exampleTraditional: 這種盛況，只是～。
exampleEn: Such a grand occasion was only a flash in the pan.

explanation: 息平息；宁使安定。原指不生事，不骚扰百姓，后指调解纠纷，使事情平息下来，使人们平安相处。
explanationTraditional: 息平息；寧使安定。原指不生事，不騷擾百姓，後指調解糾紛，使事情平息下來，使人們平安相處。
explanationEn: To settle disputes and pacify people; to avoid trouble and keep the peace.
derivation: 《后汉书·章帝纪》其令有司，罪非殊死，且勿案验；及吏人条书相告，不得听受，冀以息事宁人。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·章帝紀》其令有司，罪非殊死，且勿案驗；及吏人條書相告，不得聽受，冀以息事寧人。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Annals of Emperor Zhang': 'Order the officials not to investigate crimes except for capital offenses, and not to accept accusations, hoping to settle matters and pacify the people.'
example: 我承认我是抱着～”的苦衷来接受它的。（闻一多《四杰》）
exampleTraditional: 我承認我是抱著～”的苦衷來接受它的。（聞一多《四傑》）
exampleEn: I admit I accepted it with the intention of settling matters and keeping the peace. (Wen Yiduo, 'Four Talents')

explanation: 每天每夜。形容延续的时间长。
explanationTraditional: 每天每夜。形容延續的時間長。
explanationEn: Day and night; continuously for a long time.
derivation: 洪深《青龙潭》第二幕这里，刘秀三日日夜夜的车水，车的晕倒在水车上。”
derivationTraditional: 洪深《青龍潭》第二幕這裡，劉秀三日日夜夜的車水，車的暈倒在水車上。”
derivationEn: From Hong Shen's 'Green Dragon Pool', Act 2: 'Here, Liu Xiu pumped water day and night for three days until he fainted by the waterwheel.'
example: 在重庆红岩的～，你英勇斗争，临危不惧。★郭小川《痛悼敬爱的周总理》诗
exampleTraditional: 在重慶紅巖的～，你英勇鬥爭，臨危不懼。★郭小川《痛悼敬愛的周總理》詩
exampleEn: In the day and night at Hongyan, Chongqing, you fought bravely and remained calm in danger. (Guo Xiaochuan, 'Poem: Mourning Premier Zhou with Deep Grief')

explanation: 荡然完全空无。形容东西完全失去，一点没有留下。
explanationTraditional: 蕩然完全空無。形容東西完全失去，一點沒有留下。
explanationEn: Completely gone; nothing left; utterly destroyed or lost.
derivation: 南朝·梁·任昿《为梁武帝集坟籍令》近灾起柏梁，遂延渠阁，青编素简，一同煨尽，湘囊綖帙，荡然无存。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·任昿《為梁武帝集墳籍令》近災起柏梁，遂延渠閣，青編素簡，一同煨盡，湘囊綖帙，蕩然無存。”
derivationEn: From Ren Fang's 'Edict for Emperor Wu of Liang to Collect Books': 'Recently, a fire started in the Bai Liang Palace and spread to the Qu Pavilion; all the blue and white bamboo slips were burned to ashes, and the silk scrolls were completely gone.'
example: 使民国政制，～，澔澔新邦，悬为虚器。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 使民國政制，～，澔澔新邦，懸為虛器。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第五十九回
exampleEn: The republican political system was completely destroyed, and the new nation became an empty vessel. (Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 59)

explanation: 欢欣欣喜；鼓舞振奋。形容高兴而振奋。
explanationTraditional: 歡欣欣喜；鼓舞振奮。形容高興而振奮。
explanationEn: Overjoyed and inspired; extremely happy and encouraged.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《上知府王龙图书》自公始至，释其重荷……是故莫不欢欣鼓舞之至。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《上知府王龍圖書》自公始至，釋其重荷……是故莫不歡欣鼓舞之至。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Letter to Prefect Wang Long': 'From the beginning of your arrival, you relieved their heavy burdens... therefore, everyone was overjoyed and inspired.'
example: 但在革命成功了的当时，我们一般的人是怎样地～哟！★郭沫若《少年时代·反正前后》
exampleTraditional: 但在革命成功了的當時，我們一般的人是怎樣地～喲！★郭沫若《少年時代·反正前後》
exampleEn: But at the time of the revolution's success, how overjoyed and inspired we ordinary people were! ★ Guo Moruo, 'Youth: Before and After the Revolution'

explanation: 惊惊动；动震撼。使天地惊动。形容某个事件的声势或意义极大。
explanationTraditional: 驚驚動；動震撼。使天地驚動。形容某個事件的聲勢或意義極大。
explanationEn: Shaking heaven and earth; describing an event of great magnitude or significance.
derivation: 唐·白居易《李白墓》诗可怜荒冢穷泉骨，曾有惊天动地文。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《李白墓》詩可憐荒冢窮泉骨，曾有驚天動地文。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Bai Juyi's 'Poem on Li Bai's Tomb': 'Pity the desolate grave in the wild, once had writings that shook heaven and earth.'
example: 比前番在梁山泊上更觉轰轰烈烈，做出～的事业来，功垂竹帛，世享荣华。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第一回
exampleTraditional: 比前番在梁山泊上更覺轟轟烈烈，做出～的事業來，功垂竹帛，世享榮華。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第一回
exampleEn: More spectacular than the previous time on Liangshan, they accomplished a heaven-shaking and earth-shattering cause, leaving a legacy in history and enjoying glory for generations. ★ Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen's 'Sequel to Water Margin', Chapter 1

explanation: 险阻危险和障碍。前进道路上的困难、危险和障碍。
explanationTraditional: 險阻危險和障礙。前進道路上的困難、危險和障礙。
explanationEn: Difficulties and obstacles; hardships and dangers on the path forward.
derivation: 《左传·僖公二十八年》险阻艰难备尝之矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公二十八年》險阻艱難備嘗之矣。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's 28th Year': 'He has tasted all hardships and obstacles.'
example: 南极考察队的队员们，战胜了各种～，终于完成了考察任务。
exampleTraditional: 南極考察隊的隊員們，戰勝了各種～，終於完成了考察任務。
exampleEn: The members of the Antarctic expedition team overcame various difficulties and obstacles and finally completed the mission.

explanation: 危险的局面不断产生。
explanationTraditional: 危險的局面不斷產生。
explanationEn: Dangerous situations arise one after another.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这次旅行真是险象环生、惊心动魄。
exampleTraditional: 這次旅行真是險象環生、驚心動魄。
exampleEn: This trip was full of dangers and thrills.

explanation: 不算第一也算第二。形容突出。
explanationTraditional: 不算第一也算第二。形容突出。
explanationEn: Among the best; ranking very high.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第七十九回这门亲原是老亲，且又和我们是同在户部挂名行商，也是数一数二的大门户。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第七十九回這門親原是老親，且又和我們是同在戶部掛名行商，也是數一數二的大門戶。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 79: 'This marriage is an old connection, and moreover, we are both registered merchants in the Ministry of Revenue, also one of the top families.'
example: 他的学习成绩在班里是～的。
exampleTraditional: 他的學習成績在班裡是～的。
exampleEn: His academic performance is among the best in the class.

explanation: 指自身遇到的经验。
explanationTraditional: 指自身遇到的經驗。
explanationEn: Personal experience; understanding gained from one's own encounter.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 只有～的经验才是真实而深刻的。
exampleTraditional: 只有～的經驗才是真實而深刻的。
exampleEn: Only personal experience is genuine and profound.

explanation: 以用；乱混乱。用假的东西去冒充或混杂真的东西。
explanationTraditional: 以用；亂混亂。用假的東西去冒充或混雜真的東西。
explanationEn: To pass off fake as genuine; to mix counterfeit with real.
derivation: 北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训》馀分闰位，谓以伪乱真耳。”
derivationTraditional: 北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓》餘分閏位，謂以偽亂真耳。”
derivationEn: Northern Qi, Yan Zhitui's 'Family Instructions of the Yan Clan': 'Surplus years and intercalary positions refer to using false to confuse true.'
example: 如此办法，势必～，以少报多。★清·李百川《绿野仙踪》第四卷
exampleTraditional: 如此辦法，勢必～，以少報多。★清·李百川《綠野仙蹤》第四卷
exampleEn: Such a method will inevitably lead to passing off fake as genuine and reporting less as more. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Baichuan's 'Green Wild Immortal', Volume 4

explanation: 不断地刮风下雨。比喻障碍重重。又比喻时代动荡，谣言纷传。
explanationTraditional: 不斷地颳風下雨。比喻障礙重重。又比喻時代動盪，謠言紛傳。
explanationEn: Constant wind and rain; metaphor for numerous obstacles or turbulent times and rumors.
derivation: 元·张可久《晋天乐·忆鉴湖》风风雨雨清明，莺莺燕燕关情。”
derivationTraditional: 元·張可久《晉天樂·憶鑑湖》風風雨雨清明，鶯鶯燕燕關情。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Zhang Kejiu's 'Joy of Heaven: Remembering Mirror Lake': 'Wind and rain during Qingming, orioles and swallows in love.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容天气极为寒冷。
explanationTraditional: 形容天氣極為寒冷。
explanationEn: Extremely cold weather; freezing cold.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十五回目今天寒地冻，军马难以久住，权且回山。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十五回目今天寒地凍，軍馬難以久住，權且回山。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 65: 'Now it is freezing cold, the army cannot stay long, so we should temporarily return to the mountain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容负债甚多。
explanationTraditional: 形容負債甚多。
explanationEn: Heavily in debt; burdened with many debts.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 该公司由于连年亏损，～，不久便宣告倒闭。
exampleTraditional: 該公司由於連年虧損，～，不久便宣告倒閉。
exampleEn: The company, due to consecutive losses and heavy debts, soon declared bankruptcy.

explanation: 任担当，经受。不怕吃苦，也不怕招怨。
explanationTraditional: 任擔當，經受。不怕吃苦，也不怕招怨。
explanationEn: To bear hardship and blame without complaint; to work hard and not be upset by criticism.
derivation: 汉·桓宽《盐铁论·刺权》夫食万人之力者，蒙其忧，任其怨劳。”《汉书·石显传》诚不能以一躯称快万众，任天下之怨。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·桓寬《鹽鐵論·刺權》夫食萬人之力者，蒙其憂，任其怨勞。”《漢書·石顯傳》誠不能以一軀稱快萬眾，任天下之怨。”
derivationEn: From Huan Kuan's 'Discourses on Salt and Iron' of the Han Dynasty: 'Those who rely on the labor of ten thousand people must bear their worries and endure their complaints.' Also from 'Book of Han: Biography of Shi Xian': 'Truly cannot satisfy everyone with one body, and must bear the world's resentment.'
example: 而杨嗣昌也完全执行他的主张，～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十九章
exampleTraditional: 而楊嗣昌也完全執行他的主張，～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十九章
exampleEn: And Yang Sichang fully carried out his ideas, working hard without complaint. ★ Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 19.

explanation: 投投奔。无路可走，已到绝境。比喻处境极困难，找不到出路。
explanationTraditional: 投投奔。無路可走，已到絕境。比喻處境極困難，找不到出路。
explanationEn: To have no way out; to be in a desperate situation with no escape.
derivation: 元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第三折淋的我走投无路，知他这沙门岛是何处鄷都？”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第三折淋的我走投無路，知他這沙門島是何處鄷都？”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Yang Xianzhi's 'Rain on the Xiao and Xiang Rivers', Act 3: 'Drenched, I have no way out; I wonder if this Shamen Island is the Fengdu of hell?'
example: 她真是～了，只好来求老主人。★鲁迅《彷徨·祝福》
exampleTraditional: 她真是～了，只好來求老主人。★魯迅《彷徨·祝福》
exampleEn: She really had no way out and had to come and beg the old master. ★ Lu Xun's 'Wandering: New Year's Sacrifice'.

explanation: 下令行动就立即行动，下令停止就立即停止。形容法令严正，执行认真。
explanationTraditional: 下令行動就立即行動，下令停止就立即停止。形容法令嚴正，執行認真。
explanationEn: Strict enforcement of orders and prohibitions; to execute orders promptly and stop immediately when told.
derivation: 《管子·立政》令则行，禁则止，宪之所及，俗之所破。如百体之从心，政之所期也。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·立政》令則行，禁則止，憲之所及，俗之所破。如百體之從心，政之所期也。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Establishing Government': 'Orders are carried out, prohibitions are heeded, as the constitution reaches and customs are broken. Like the body following the heart, this is what government hopes for.'
example: 以一新进小生，摧抑豪猾，乡中十余万人，～，赌盗之风顿息。★清·梁启超《诗话》
exampleTraditional: 以一新進小生，摧抑豪猾，鄉中十餘萬人，～，賭盜之風頓息。★清·梁啟超《詩話》
exampleEn: As a newcomer, he suppressed the powerful and cunning, and among the more than one hundred thousand people in the countryside, orders were strictly enforced, and gambling and theft ceased. ★ Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao's 'Poetry Talks'.

explanation: 蹈踏；覆翻；辙车轮辗过的痕迹。重新走上翻过车的老路。比喻不吸取教训，再走失败的老路。
explanationTraditional: 蹈踏；覆翻；轍車輪輾過的痕跡。重新走上翻過車的老路。比喻不吸取教訓，再走失敗的老路。
explanationEn: To repeat the same mistake; to follow the same disastrous path.
derivation: 《后汉书·窦武传》今不想前事之失，复循覆车之轨。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·竇武傳》今不想前事之失，復循覆車之軌。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Dou Wu': 'Now, not reflecting on the mistakes of the past, one again follows the track of the overturned cart.'
example: 要从失败中吸取教训，以免～。
exampleTraditional: 要從失敗中吸取教訓，以免～。
exampleEn: We must learn from failure to avoid repeating the same mistake.

explanation: 时时刻刻。表示毫不间断。
explanationTraditional: 時時刻刻。表示毫不間斷。
explanationEn: All the time; constantly; every moment.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷六自是行忘止，食忘餐，却象掉下了一件什么东西的，无时无刻不在心上。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷六自是行忘止，食忘餐，卻象掉下了一件什麼東西的，無時無刻不在心上。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Striking the Table in Amazement', Volume 6: 'Since then, he forgot to walk and eat, as if he had lost something, and it was on his mind every moment.'
example: 半个月来，她老是偷偷地看着剑波，她的心～不在恋着剑波，就好象是生活中不可缺少的空气一样。★曲波《林海雪原》九
exampleTraditional: 半個月來，她老是偷偷地看著劍波，她的心～不在戀著劍波，就好象是生活中不可缺少的空氣一樣。★曲波《林海雪原》九
exampleEn: For half a month, she had been secretly watching Jianbo, her heart constantly in love with him, as if he were as indispensable as air in life. ★ Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 9.

explanation: 指男的结了婚，有职业，能独立生活。
explanationTraditional: 指男的結了婚，有職業，能獨立生活。
explanationEn: To get married and start a career; to settle down and establish oneself.
derivation: 宋·吴自牧《梦梁录·恤贫济老》杭城富室多是外郡寓之人……四方百货，不趾而集，自此成家立业者众矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·吳自牧《夢梁錄·恤貧濟老》杭城富室多是外郡寓之人……四方百貨，不趾而集，自此成家立業者眾矣。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wu Zimu's 'Dreams of the Eastern Capital: Relieving the Poor and Helping the Aged': 'Many wealthy families in Hangzhou are from other prefectures... all kinds of goods gather without being summoned, and many have since married and established careers.'
example: 原来廉锦枫曾祖向居岭南，因避南北朝之乱，逃至海外，就在君子国～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十三回
exampleTraditional: 原來廉錦楓曾祖向居嶺南，因避南北朝之亂，逃至海外，就在君子國～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十三回
exampleEn: Originally, Lian Jinfeng's ancestors lived in Lingnan, but to avoid the chaos of the Northern and Southern Dynasties, they fled overseas and settled in the Land of Gentlemen, where they married and started careers. ★ Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 13.

explanation: 炎黄炎帝神农氏和黄帝有熊氏，代表中华民族的祖先。炎帝和黄帝的后代。指中华民族的后代。亦作黄炎子孙”。
explanationTraditional: 炎黃炎帝神農氏和黃帝有熊氏，代表中華民族的祖先。炎帝和黃帝的後代。指中華民族的後代。亦作黃炎子孫”。
explanationEn: Descendants of Yan and Huang; refers to the Chinese people as descendants of the legendary emperors Yan and Huang.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 张弓上弦。剑拔出来了，弓张开了。原形容书法笔力遒劲◇多形容气势逼人，或形势紧张，一触即发。
explanationTraditional: 張弓上弦。劍拔出來了，弓張開了。原形容書法筆力遒勁◇多形容氣勢逼人，或形勢緊張，一觸即發。
explanationEn: Swords drawn and bows stretched; describes a tense situation on the verge of conflict, or calligraphy with vigorous strokes.
derivation: 南朝·梁·袁昂《古今书评》韦诞书法如龙威虎振，剑拔驽张。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·袁昂《古今書評》韋誕書法如龍威虎振，劍拔駑張。”
derivationEn: From Southern Liang Dynasty Yuan Ang's 'Comments on Ancient and Modern Calligraphy': 'Wei Dan's calligraphy is like a dragon's might and tiger's power, with swords drawn and bows stretched.'
example: 法国兵舰在闽汪口出入频繁，而交涉方面～，看样子福州船局必难幸免法国兵舰的炮火。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 法國兵艦在閩汪口出入頻繁，而交涉方面～，看樣子福州船局必難倖免法國兵艦的炮火。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: French warships frequently entered and exited the Min River, and negotiations were tense, with swords drawn and bows stretched. It seemed the Fuzhou Shipyard would inevitably suffer French gunfire. ★ Gao Yang's 'Inside the Qing Palace', Volume 2.

explanation: 设身处地地为别人着想。
explanationTraditional: 設身處地地為別人著想。
explanationEn: To put oneself in another's shoes; to empathize with others.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类·大学三》俗语所谓将心比心，如此则各得其平矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類·大學三》俗語所謂將心比心，如此則各得其平矣。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's 'Classified Conversations of Master Zhu, Part 3': 'As the common saying goes, put yourself in another's place, and then each will be at peace.'
example: 太尉不将心比心，小子待将计就计。★明·汤显祖《紫钗记》第三十八出
exampleTraditional: 太尉不將心比心，小子待將計就計。★明·湯顯祖《紫釵記》第三十八出
exampleEn: If the Grand Marshal does not put himself in my shoes, I will use his own plan against him. ★ Ming Dynasty Tang Xianzu's 'The Purple Hairpin', Act 38.

explanation: 原指人手大，脚大◇多用来形容花钱、用东西不节省。
explanationTraditional: 原指人手大，腳大◇多用來形容花錢、用東西不節省。
explanationEn: Lavish; extravagant; spending money or using things wastefully.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十一回成年家大手大脚的，替太太不知背地里赔垫了多少东西，真真赔的是说不出来的，那里又和太太算去。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十一回成年家大手大腳的，替太太不知背地裡賠墊了多少東西，真真賠的是說不出來的，那裡又和太太算去。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 51: 'All year round, you are lavish, and you have secretly compensated the mistress with countless things, truly beyond words, and now you still have to settle accounts with her.'
example: 一样的～，好象伦敦的巡警都是一母所生的哥儿们。★老舍《二马》
exampleTraditional: 一樣的～，好象倫敦的巡警都是一母所生的哥兒們。★老舍《二馬》
exampleEn: Equally lavish, as if all London policemen were born brothers. ★ Lao She's 'Er Ma'.

explanation: 览看；余剩余。一眼看去，所有的景物全看见了。形容建筑物的结构没有曲折变化，或诗文内容平淡，没有回味。
explanationTraditional: 覽看；餘剩餘。一眼看去，所有的景物全看見了。形容建築物的結構沒有曲折變化，或詩文內容平淡，沒有回味。
explanationEn: To take in everything at a glance; describing a structure without twists or turns, or content that is plain and lacks aftertaste.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》江左地促，不如中国，若使阡陌条畅，则一览而尽，故纡余委曲，若不可测。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》江左地促，不如中國，若使阡陌條暢，則一覽而盡，故紆餘委曲，若不可測。”
derivationEn: Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' (Southern Dynasties): 'The land south of the Yangtze is cramped, unlike the Central Plains. If the paths were straight, one could see everything at a glance, so they are winding and seemingly unfathomable.'
example: 水中岸上都光光的；亏得湖里有五个洲子点缀着，不然便～了。★朱自清《南京》
exampleTraditional: 水中岸上都光光的；虧得湖裡有五個洲子點綴著，不然便～了。★朱自清《南京》
exampleEn: The water and shores were bare; fortunately, the five islets in the lake added some ornament, otherwise it would have been all in one view. — Zhu Ziqing's 'Nanjing'

explanation: 为做。本指做自己想做的事◇指想干什么就干什么。
explanationTraditional: 為做。本指做自己想做的事◇指想幹什麼就幹什麼。
explanationEn: To do whatever one wants; to act arbitrarily.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·周纪威烈王二十三年》子乃为所欲为，顾不易耶？何乃自苦如此？求以报仇，不亦难乎？”《隋书·天文志上》所以准验辰历，分考次度，其于揆测，唯所欲为之者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·周紀威烈王二十三年》子乃為所欲為，顧不易耶？何乃自苦如此？求以報仇，不亦難乎？”《隋書·天文志上》所以準驗辰歷，分考次度，其於揆測，唯所欲為之者也。”
derivationEn: 'Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government' (Zhou Ji): 'You can do whatever you want, isn't that easy? Why torment yourself like this?' and 'Book of Sui: Astronomy': 'Thus to verify the calendar and measure degrees, one can do whatever one wants in observation.'
example: 他们满以为有了如此强大精良的武器，就可以在别人的国土上横行霸道、～。★峻青《不尽巨涛滚滚来》
exampleTraditional: 他們滿以為有了如此強大精良的武器，就可以在別人的國土上橫行霸道、～。★峻青《不盡巨濤滾滾來》
exampleEn: They thought that with such powerful and sophisticated weapons, they could act arbitrarily and tyrannically on foreign soil. — Jun Qing's 'Endless Surging Waves'

explanation: 名名分，名义；顺合理、顺当。原指名分正当，说话合理◇多指做某事名义正当，道理也说得通。
explanationTraditional: 名名分，名義；順合理、順當。原指名分正當，說話合理◇多指做某事名義正當，道理也說得通。
explanationEn: To have a legitimate title and speak with reason; to do something with proper justification.
derivation: 《论语·子路》名不正则言不顺，言不顺则事不利。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子路》名不正則言不順，言不順則事不利。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects: Zilu': 'If names are not correct, speech is not reasonable; if speech is not reasonable, affairs cannot be accomplished.'
example: 待小生得官回来，谐两姓之好，却不～。★元·郑德辉《倩女离魂》第二折
exampleTraditional: 待小生得官回來，諧兩姓之好，卻不～。★元·鄭德輝《倩女離魂》第二折
exampleEn: Wait until I obtain an official position and return, then we can unite the two families properly and with justification. — Yuan drama 'Qiannu's Soul' by Zheng Dehui, Act 2

explanation: 在纸面上谈论打仗。比喻空谈理论，不能解决实际问题。也比喻空谈不能成为现实。
explanationTraditional: 在紙面上談論打仗。比喻空談理論，不能解決實際問題。也比喻空談不能成為現實。
explanationEn: To fight battles on paper; to engage in empty theorizing without practical application.
derivation: 《史记·廉颇蔺相如列传》记载战国时赵国名将赵奢之子赵括，年轻时学兵法，谈起兵事来父亲也难不倒他◇来他接替廉颇为赵将，在长平之战中。只知道根据兵书办，不知道变通，结果被秦军大败。
derivationTraditional: 《史記·廉頗藺相如列傳》記載戰國時趙國名將趙奢之子趙括，年輕時學兵法，談起兵事來父親也難不倒他◇來他接替廉頗為趙將，在長平之戰中。只知道根據兵書辦，不知道變通，結果被秦軍大敗。
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru': Zhao Kuo, son of Zhao She, studied military strategy and could outtalk his father, but when he replaced Lian Po as general, he rigidly followed the books and was defeated by Qin.
example: 新近有个大挑知县上了一个条陈，其中有些话都是窒碍难行，毕竟书生之见，全是～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 新近有個大挑知縣上了一個條陳，其中有些話都是窒礙難行，畢竟書生之見，全是～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十一回
exampleEn: Recently, a candidate for magistrate submitted a memorial, some parts of which were impractical. After all, it was just a scholar's view, all empty theorizing. — Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 31

explanation: 川河流。形容行人、车马等象水流一样连续不断。
explanationTraditional: 川河流。形容行人、車馬等象水流一樣連續不斷。
explanationEn: Flowing continuously like a river; describing a constant stream of people or vehicles.
derivation: 南朝·梁·周兴嗣《千字文》川流不息，渊澄取映。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·周興嗣《千字文》川流不息，淵澄取映。”
derivationEn: Zhou Xingsi's 'Thousand Character Classic' (Liang Dynasty): 'Rivers flow without ceasing, deep pools reflect clearly.'
example: 两个丫头，～的在家前屋后的走，叫的太太一片声响。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 兩個丫頭，～的在家前屋後的走，叫的太太一片聲響。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第二十七回
exampleEn: The two maids walked back and forth in front of and behind the house, calling out loudly to the mistress. — Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 27

explanation: 深夜没有人声，非常寂静。
explanationTraditional: 深夜沒有人聲，非常寂靜。
explanationEn: Deep in the night, when all is quiet and still.
derivation: 汉·蔡琰《胡茄十八折》更深夜阑兮，梦汝来期。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·蔡琰《胡茄十八折》更深夜闌兮，夢汝來期。”
derivationEn: Cai Yan's 'Eighteen Songs of a Nomad Flute' (Han Dynasty): 'Deep in the night, I dream of your coming.'
example: 听到月高初更后，果然弦索齐鸣。恰喜禁垣，～，琤璁齐应。（清·洪昻《长生殿·偷曲》）
exampleTraditional: 聽到月高初更後，果然絃索齊鳴。恰喜禁垣，～，琤璁齊應。（清·洪昻《長生殿·偷曲》）
exampleEn: After the first watch of the moon, the strings and pipes began to play. It was just the right time in the forbidden palace, deep in the night, with jingling sounds echoing. — Hong Sheng's 'The Palace of Eternal Life', Act 'Stealing the Tune'

explanation: 胜尽。美好的东西很多，一时看不过来。
explanationTraditional: 勝盡。美好的東西很多，一時看不過來。
explanationEn: So many beautiful things that one cannot take them all in; an overwhelming abundance of beauty.
derivation: 清·钱泳《履园丛话·艺能·治庖》惟鱼之一物，美不胜收。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢泳《履園叢話·藝能·治庖》惟魚之一物，美不勝收。”
derivationEn: Qian Yong's 'Notes from the Garden of Footsteps' (Qing Dynasty): 'Among all foods, fish is so beautiful that it is beyond capture.'
example: 展览馆里展出的各种工艺品琳琅满目，～。
exampleTraditional: 展覽館裡展出的各種工藝品琳琅滿目，～。
exampleEn: The various handicrafts displayed in the exhibition hall were dazzling and too many to be appreciated all at once.

explanation: 做事情有好的开头，也有好的结尾。形容办事认真。
explanationTraditional: 做事情有好的開頭，也有好的結尾。形容辦事認真。
explanationEn: To start well and end well; to do something thoroughly from beginning to end.
derivation: 《庄子·大宗师》善妖善老，善始善终。”《史记·陈丞相世家赞》以荣名终，称贤相，岂不善始善终哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·大宗師》善妖善老，善始善終。”《史記·陳丞相世家贊》以榮名終，稱賢相，豈不善始善終哉？”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: Great Ancestral Teacher': 'To be good in youth and good in old age, to start well and end well.' and 'Records of the Grand Historian: Commentary on Chen Ping': 'To end with honor and be called a worthy minister, is that not starting well and ending well?'
example: 不如早达时务，～，全了恩人生前一段美意。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷二十五
exampleTraditional: 不如早達時務，～，全了恩人生前一段美意。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷二十五
exampleEn: It would be better to recognize the situation early and start well and end well, fulfilling the benefactor's good intentions. — Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 25

explanation: 枝叶繁密茂盛。
explanationTraditional: 枝葉繁密茂盛。
explanationEn: With luxuriant branches and leaves; describing a plant that is thriving and lush.
derivation: 明·孙柚《琴心记》愿人间天上共效绸缪，贺郎君玉润水清，祝小姐枝繁叶茂。”
derivationTraditional: 明·孫柚《琴心記》願人間天上共效綢繆，賀郎君玉潤水清，祝小姐枝繁葉茂。”
derivationEn: Sun You's 'The Story of the Lute' (Ming Dynasty): 'May heaven and earth together be harmonious, congratulating the groom on his jade-like purity and the bride on her flourishing branches and leaves.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有想到的。
explanationTraditional: 沒有想到的。
explanationEn: Beyond one's expectations; unexpected.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十五回刚才唐兄说国王必是暂缓吉期，那知全出意料之外，并且大动干戈，用兵征剿。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十五回剛才唐兄說國王必是暫緩吉期，那知全出意料之外，並且大動干戈，用兵征剿。”
derivationEn: Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 35: 'Just now Brother Tang said the king would surely postpone the wedding, but it turned out completely unexpected, and moreover, war was waged.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容说话或行动坚决果断，毫不犹豫。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話或行動堅決果斷，毫不猶豫。
explanationEn: Resolute and decisive in speech or action, without hesitation.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷十七师谓众曰‘学佛法底人如斩钉截铁始得时。’”《朱子全书·孟子》君来惟是孟子说得斩钉截铁。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷十七師謂眾曰‘學佛法底人如斬釘截鐵始得時。’”《朱子全書·孟子》君來惟是孟子說得斬釘截鐵。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan's 'Jingde Chuandeng Lu' and Zhu Xi's 'Complete Works of Zhu Xi'.
example: 我喜欢那种～的作风。
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡那種～的作風。
exampleEn: I like that kind of resolute and decisive style.

explanation: 指活跃一时，言论行为能影响大局的人物。
explanationTraditional: 指活躍一時，言論行為能影響大局的人物。
explanationEn: A person who is active for a time and whose words and actions can influence the overall situation.
derivation: 毛泽东《别了，司徒雷登》因此被马歇尔看中，做了驻华大使，成为马歇尔系统中的风云人物之一。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《別了，司徒雷登》因此被馬歇爾看中，做了駐華大使，成為馬歇爾系統中的風雲人物之一。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'Farewell, Leighton Stuart'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 裨益益处、好处。形容益处很大。
explanationTraditional: 裨益益處、好處。形容益處很大。
explanationEn: Great benefit or advantage.
derivation: 《北齐书·唐邕传》比及武平之末，府藏渐虚，邕度支取金，大有裨益。”
derivationTraditional: 《北齊書·唐邕傳》比及武平之末，府藏漸虛，邕度支取金，大有裨益。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Northern Qi: Biography of Tang Yong'.
example: 其间卓然自得者，于圣经贤传，～。★明·焦竑《玉堂丛语·文学》
exampleTraditional: 其間卓然自得者，於聖經賢傳，～。★明·焦竑《玉堂叢語·文學》
exampleEn: Among them, those who achieve self-realization greatly benefit from the classics and teachings of sages. (Ming Dynasty, Jiao Hong's 'Yutang Congyu: Literature')

explanation: 微微小；杜堵住；渐指事物的开端。比喻在坏事情坏思想萌芽的时候就加以制止，不让它发展。
explanationTraditional: 微微小；杜堵住；漸指事物的開端。比喻在壞事情壞思想萌芽的時候就加以制止，不讓它發展。
explanationEn: To nip something in the bud; to stop bad things from developing at an early stage.
derivation: 晋·韦謏《启谏冉闵》清诛屏降胡，以单于之号以防微杜渐。”《后汉书·丁鸿传》若敕政责躬，杜渐防萌，则凶妖消灭，害除福凑矣。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·韋謏《啟諫冉閔》清誅屏降胡，以單于之號以防微杜漸。”《後漢書·丁鴻傳》若敕政責躬，杜漸防萌，則兇妖消滅，害除福湊矣。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Wei Xiao's 'Admonition to Ran Min' and 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Ding Hong'.
example: 有不尽者，亦宜～而禁于未然。★《元史·张桢传》
exampleTraditional: 有不盡者，亦宜～而禁於未然。★《元史·張楨傳》
exampleEn: If there are shortcomings, one should also prevent them at the start and stop them before they happen. (Yuan History: Biography of Zhang Zhen)

explanation: 踪踪迹。没有一点踪影。形容完全消失，不知去向。
explanationTraditional: 蹤蹤跡。沒有一點蹤影。形容完全消失，不知去向。
explanationEn: Without a trace; completely disappeared, whereabouts unknown.
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《东坡梦》第三折你那里挨挨桚桚，闪闪藏藏，无影无踪。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《東坡夢》第三折你那裡挨挨桚桚，閃閃藏藏，無影無蹤。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wu Changling's 'Dream of Dongpo' Act 3.
example: 那贾芸早说了几个不用费事”，去的～了。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十四回
exampleTraditional: 那賈芸早說了幾個不用費事”，去的～了。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十四回
exampleEn: Jia Yun had already said 'no need to trouble' and disappeared without a trace. (Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 24)

explanation: 一举手那样的辛劳。形容轻而易举，毫不费力。
explanationTraditional: 一舉手那樣的辛勞。形容輕而易舉，毫不費力。
explanationEn: As easy as lifting a hand; requiring little effort.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《应科目时与人书》如有力者，哀其穷而运转之，盖一举手一投足之劳也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《應科目時與人書》如有力者，哀其窮而運轉之，蓋一舉手一投足之勞也。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Letter to Someone on an Examination'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 合璧圆形有孔的玉叫璧，半圆形的叫半璧，两个半璧合成一个圆叫合璧”。比喻中国和外国的好东西合到一块。
explanationTraditional: 合璧圓形有孔的玉叫璧，半圓形的叫半璧，兩個半璧合成一個圓叫合璧”。比喻中國和外國的好東西合到一塊。
explanationEn: A combination of Chinese and Western elements; a blend of good things from both.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十一回这长苗子是我们中国原有的，如今搀在这德国操内，中又不中，外又不外，倒成了一个中外合璧。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十一回這長苗子是我們中國原有的，如今攙在這德國操內，中又不中，外又不外，倒成了一箇中外合璧。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revels' Chapter 31.
example: 她转过脸去看墙壁上的字画那也是～”的，张大千的老虎立轴旁边陪衬着两列五彩铜版印的西洋画。★茅盾《子夜》八
exampleTraditional: 她轉過臉去看牆壁上的字畫那也是～”的，張大千的老虎立軸旁邊陪襯著兩列五彩銅版印的西洋畫。★茅盾《子夜》八
exampleEn: She turned to look at the paintings on the wall, which were also a combination of Chinese and Western styles: a vertical scroll of a tiger by Zhang Daqian flanked by two rows of colorful copperplate prints of Western paintings. (Mao Dun's 'Midnight', Chapter 8)

explanation: 走马骑着马跑；任职务。旧指官吏到任。现比喻接任某项工作。
explanationTraditional: 走馬騎著馬跑；任職務。舊指官吏到任。現比喻接任某項工作。
explanationEn: To take up a post; to assume office (originally for officials).
derivation: 宋·孙光宪《北梦琐言》卷四先以陈公走马赴任，乃树一魁妖，共翼佐之。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·孫光憲《北夢瑣言》卷四先以陳公走馬赴任，乃樹一魁妖，共翼佐之。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Sun Guangxian's 'Beimeng Suoyan' Volume 4.
example: 你看他那种～的神气，你就可以知道他是一位全然不懂教育的外行乃至老腐败。★郭沫若《少年时代·反正前后》
exampleTraditional: 你看他那種～的神氣，你就可以知道他是一位全然不懂教育的外行乃至老腐敗。★郭沫若《少年時代·反正前後》
exampleEn: Seeing his air of taking up a new post, you can tell he is a complete outsider and old corrupt official who knows nothing about education. (Guo Moruo's 'Youth: Before and After the Revolution')

explanation: 快痛快。拍掌叫好。多指正义得到伸张或事情的结局使人感到满意。
explanationTraditional: 快痛快。拍掌叫好。多指正義得到伸張或事情的結局使人感到滿意。
explanationEn: To clap and cheer with satisfaction; often used when justice is served or a satisfactory outcome is achieved.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷三十五又见恶姑奸夫俱死，又无不拍手称快。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷三十五又見惡姑姦夫俱死，又無不拍手稱快。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement' Volume 35.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容言行慎重，不敢疏忽。
explanationTraditional: 形容言行慎重，不敢疏忽。
explanationEn: Cautious and careful in words and actions.
derivation: 《汉书·霍光传》出入禁闼二十余年，小心谨慎，未尝有过。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·霍光傳》出入禁闥二十餘年，小心謹慎，未嘗有過。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Huo Guang'.
example: 杜兴到此多时，～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第四回
exampleTraditional: 杜興到此多時，～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第四回
exampleEn: Du Xing had been here for a long time and was very cautious. (Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 4)

explanation: 纳容纳，包容。大海可以容得下成百上千条江河之水。比喻包容的东西非常广泛，而且数量很大。
explanationTraditional: 納容納，包容。大海可以容得下成百上千條江河之水。比喻包容的東西非常廣泛，而且數量很大。
explanationEn: The ocean can hold hundreds of rivers. It symbolizes great inclusiveness and vast capacity.
derivation: 晋·袁宏《三国名臣序赞》形器不存，方寸海纳。”李周翰注方寸之心，如海之纳百川也，言其包含广也。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·袁宏《三國名臣序贊》形器不存，方寸海納。”李周翰注方寸之心，如海之納百川也，言其包含廣也。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Yuan Hong's 'Eulogies of Famous Ministers of the Three Kingdoms': 'The heart is like the ocean that accepts all rivers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 来历由来。人或事物的来历与经过不清楚。
explanationTraditional: 來歷由來。人或事物的來歷與經過不清楚。
explanationEn: The origin or background of a person or thing is unclear.
derivation: 宋·周密《癸辛杂识·前集·郑仙姑》适新建县有阙氏者，雇一婢，来历不明。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《癸辛雜識·前集·鄭仙姑》適新建縣有闕氏者，僱一婢，來歷不明。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhou Mi's 'Guixin Miscellaneous Records': 'A newly hired maid had an unclear origin.'
example: 一时错把她认作了一个～之人，加上一番防范。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第五回
exampleTraditional: 一時錯把她認作了一個～之人，加上一番防範。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第五回
exampleEn: For a moment, she mistakenly regarded him as a person of unknown origin and added precautions. — Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 5

explanation: 浃湿透」流得满背都是。形容非常恐惧或非肠怕。现也形容出汗很多，背上的衣服都湿透了。
explanationTraditional: 浹溼透」流得滿背都是。形容非常恐懼或非腸怕。現也形容出汗很多，背上的衣服都溼透了。
explanationEn: Sweat soaks the back. Describes extreme fear or profuse sweating.
derivation: 《史记·陈丞相世家》勃又谢不知，汗出沾背，愧不能对。”《后汉书·伏皇后纪》操出，顾左右，汗流浃背。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·陳丞相世家》勃又謝不知，汗出沾背，愧不能對。”《後漢書·伏皇后紀》操出，顧左右，汗流浹背。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Chen Ping': 'Bó was too afraid to answer, sweat drenched his back.' Also from 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Empress Fu': 'Cao Cao came out, looked around, sweat streaming down his back.'
example: 在劳动竞赛中，大家干得～。
exampleTraditional: 在勞動競賽中，大家幹得～。
exampleEn: During the labor competition, everyone worked so hard that their backs were drenched in sweat.

explanation: 形容人多口杂。
explanationTraditional: 形容人多口雜。
explanationEn: Many people talking at once; a hubbub of voices.
derivation: 清·袁枚《牍外余言》故晋大夫七嘴八舌，冷讥热嘲，皆由于心之大公也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·袁枚《牘外餘言》故晉大夫七嘴八舌，冷譏熱嘲，皆由於心之大公也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Yuan Mei's 'Remaining Words Outside Letters': 'Therefore, the Jin officials talked all at once, with cold mockery and hot sarcasm, all due to their great impartiality.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 本树根；末树梢；置放。比喻把主次、轻重的位置弄颠倒了。
explanationTraditional: 本樹根；末樹梢；置放。比喻把主次、輕重的位置弄顛倒了。
explanationEn: Putting the cart before the horse; confusing the primary and secondary.
derivation: 金·无名氏《绥德州新学记》然非知治之审，则未尝不本末倒置。”
derivationTraditional: 金·無名氏《綏德州新學記》然非知治之審，則未嘗不本末倒置。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty anonymous 'New Learning Record of Suide Prefecture': 'But if one does not understand governance thoroughly, they often put the cart before the horse.'
example: 该简者你却详而不简，该详者你又简而不详。～，批评你还不愿意？乱弹琴！★曲波《林海雪原》一二
exampleTraditional: 該簡者你卻詳而不簡，該詳者你又簡而不詳。～，批評你還不願意？亂彈琴！★曲波《林海雪原》一二
exampleEn: You should be detailed where it's needed, but you are brief; and brief where you should be detailed. Putting the cart before the horse, and you still complain about criticism? Nonsense! — Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 12

explanation: 什么都不顾。
explanationTraditional: 什麼都不顧。
explanationEn: Regardless of everything; desperate.
derivation: 叶圣陶《孤独》既然见到一点儿光，便不得不不顾一切地逃开。”
derivationTraditional: 葉聖陶《孤獨》既然見到一點兒光，便不得不不顧一切地逃開。”
derivationEn: From Ye Shengtao's 'Solitude': 'Since I saw a glimmer of light, I had to flee regardless of everything.'
example: 我闭上眼睛，～的向着他手里的刀迎上去。★巴金《长生塔·塔的秘密》
exampleTraditional: 我閉上眼睛，～的向著他手裡的刀迎上去。★巴金《長生塔·塔的秘密》
exampleEn: I closed my eyes and rushed toward his knife regardless of everything. — Ba Jin's 'The Tower of Longevity: The Secret of the Tower'

explanation: 混淆混杂。用假象或谎言让旁人分辨不清是非。
explanationTraditional: 混淆混雜。用假象或謊言讓旁人分辨不清是非。
explanationEn: To confuse the public with falsehoods or lies.
derivation: 《三国志·袁尚传》裴松之注如此之类，正足以诬罔视听，贻误后生矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·袁尚傳》裴松之注如此之類，正足以誣罔視聽，貽誤後生矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Yuan Shang' annotated by Pei Songzhi: 'Such things are enough to deceive the public and mislead later generations.'
example: 那些人经常故意～，影响很坏。
exampleTraditional: 那些人經常故意～，影響很壞。
exampleEn: Those people often deliberately confuse the public, causing bad influence.

explanation: 比喻激情高涨。
explanationTraditional: 比喻激情高漲。
explanationEn: Blood boils with passion; extremely excited or indignant.
derivation: 刘白羽《红太阳颂》中国的天空在燃烧、大地在流血。不甘心作亡国奴隶的亿万人民满腔怒火，热血沸腾。”
derivationTraditional: 劉白羽《紅太陽頌》中國的天空在燃燒、大地在流血。不甘心作亡國奴隸的億萬人民滿腔怒火，熱血沸騰。”
derivationEn: From Liu Baiyu's 'Ode to the Red Sun': 'China's sky was burning, the earth bleeding. Hundreds of millions of people unwilling to be slaves were filled with rage, their blood boiling.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 左也不好，右也不是。形容无论怎样做都有难处。
explanationTraditional: 左也不好，右也不是。形容無論怎樣做都有難處。
explanationEn: In a dilemma; difficult to decide either way.
derivation: 元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第一折我欲待亲自去寻来，限次又紧，着老夫左右为难，如何是好！”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第一折我欲待親自去尋來，限次又緊，著老夫左右為難，如何是好！”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Yang Xianzhi's 'Rain on the Xiao and Xiang Rivers', Act 1: 'I wanted to go find him myself, but the deadline is tight. I am in a dilemma, what to do!'
example: 千思万想，～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百二十回
exampleTraditional: 千思萬想，～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百二十回
exampleEn: After much thought, he was in a dilemma. — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 120

explanation: 指没有风浪。比喻平静无事。
explanationTraditional: 指沒有風浪。比喻平靜無事。
explanationEn: Calm and peaceful; no trouble.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷七僧问‘风恬浪静时如何？’师曰‘吹倒南墙。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷七僧問‘風恬浪靜時如何？’師曰‘吹倒南牆。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting', Volume 7: 'A monk asked, 'What about when the wind is calm and waves are still?' The master replied, 'Blow down the south wall.''
example: 有孩儿在这里，不要怕他，包管～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 有孩兒在這裡，不要怕他，包管～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第十八回
exampleEn: With me here, don't be afraid. I guarantee everything will be calm and peaceful. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 18

explanation: 履践、踩在上面。象走在薄冰上一样。比喻行事极为谨慎，存有戒心。
explanationTraditional: 履踐、踩在上面。象走在薄冰上一樣。比喻行事極為謹慎，存有戒心。
explanationEn: To tread on thin ice; to be extremely cautious and wary.
derivation: 《诗·小雅·小昮》战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·小雅·小昮》戰戰兢兢，如臨深淵，如履薄冰。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs: 'Trembling and cautious, as if approaching a deep abyss, as if treading on thin ice.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 先天人或动物的胚胎时期。原指人或动物生下来体质就不好◇也指事物的根基差。
explanationTraditional: 先天人或動物的胚胎時期。原指人或動物生下來體質就不好◇也指事物的根基差。
explanationEn: Congenital deficiency; originally refers to a person or animal born with poor health, later also refers to a weak foundation.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二十六回小弟闻得仙人与虚合体，日中无影；又老人之子，先天不足，亦或日中无影。寿麻之人无影，不知何故？”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二十六回小弟聞得仙人與虛合體，日中無影；又老人之子，先天不足，亦或日中無影。壽麻之人無影，不知何故？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror': 'I heard that immortals have no shadow at noon; also, children of old people are congenitally deficient and may have no shadow at noon.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 撞骗寻机骗人。假借名义，进行蒙骗欺诈。
explanationTraditional: 撞騙尋機騙人。假借名義，進行矇騙欺詐。
explanationEn: To swindle by false pretenses; to bluff and deceive.
derivation: 《清会典事例·七四八·刑部·吏律职制》学臣应用员役，傥有招摇撞骗及受贿传递等弊，提调官不行访拿究治者，亦交部议处。”
derivationTraditional: 《清會典事例·七四八·刑部·吏律職制》學臣應用員役，儻有招搖撞騙及受賄傳遞等弊，提調官不行訪拿究治者，亦交部議處。”
derivationEn: From 'Collected Statutes of the Qing Dynasty': 'If scholars employ personnel who engage in swindling or bribery, the supervising official who fails to investigate will also be punished.'
example: 只是奴才们在外头～，闹出事来，我就耽不起。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一０六回
exampleTraditional: 只是奴才們在外頭～，鬧出事來，我就耽不起。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一０六回
exampleEn: But if the servants go out and swindle people, causing trouble, I can't bear the responsibility. — from Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 106

explanation: 解解释；释消除。解答疑难问题，消除困惑情绪。
explanationTraditional: 解解釋；釋消除。解答疑難問題，消除困惑情緒。
explanationEn: To resolve doubts and dispel confusion; to answer questions and clarify uncertainties.
derivation: 汉·孔融《荐祢衡表》使衡立朝，必有可观。飞辩骋辞，溢气坌涌，解疑释结，临敌有余。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·孔融《薦禰衡表》使衡立朝，必有可觀。飛辯騁辭，溢氣坌湧，解疑釋結，臨敵有餘。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Kong Rong's 'Recommendation of Mi Heng': 'If Mi Heng were in court, he would be impressive. His eloquence would resolve doubts and settle disputes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 速邀请。指没有邀请突然而来的客人。
explanationTraditional: 速邀請。指沒有邀請突然而來的客人。
explanationEn: An uninvited guest; someone who arrives without invitation.
derivation: 《周易·需》有不速之客三人来，敬之终吉。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·需》有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。”
derivationEn: From the 'Book of Changes': 'Three uninvited guests come; if treated with respect, the outcome will be auspicious.'
example: 这样出乎意外的～，却受着了真正是由衷而出的恳切的欢迎。★郭沫若《海涛集·跨着东海》
exampleTraditional: 這樣出乎意外的～，卻受著了真正是由衷而出的懇切的歡迎。★郭沫若《海濤集·跨著東海》
exampleEn: Such an unexpected uninvited guest received a truly heartfelt welcome. — from Guo Moruo's 'Crossing the East Sea'

explanation: 服信服。心里嘴上都信服。指真心信服。
explanationTraditional: 服信服。心裡嘴上都信服。指真心信服。
explanationEn: To be sincerely convinced; to admit defeat wholeheartedly.
derivation: 《庄子·寓言》利义陈乎前，而好恶是非直服人之口而已矣。使人乃以心服，而不敢蘤立，定天下之定。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·寓言》利義陳乎前，而好惡是非直服人之口而已矣。使人乃以心服，而不敢蘤立，定天下之定。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'When benefits and righteousness are presented, likes and dislikes, right and wrong only convince people's mouths. To make people convinced in their hearts is the true standard.'
example: 如今请出一个管得着的人来管一管，嫂子就～，也知道规矩了。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 如今請出一個管得著的人來管一管，嫂子就～，也知道規矩了。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十九回
exampleEn: Now if you find someone who can manage her, she will be sincerely convinced and know the rules. — from Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 59

explanation: 比喻零乱地加以拼凑。
explanationTraditional: 比喻零亂地加以拼湊。
explanationEn: To piece together from various sources; to scrape together.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第八回因是儿子的终身大事所关，说不得东拼西凑，恭恭敬敬封了二十四两贽见礼，带了秦钟到代儒家来拜见。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第八回因是兒子的終身大事所關，說不得東拼西湊，恭恭敬敬封了二十四兩贄見禮，帶了秦鍾到代儒家來拜見。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 8: 'Since it concerned his son's lifelong大事, he had to scrape together twenty-four taels of silver as a gift and took Qin Zhong to pay respects to Dai Ru.'
example: 当他在半路上，早已～，凑得三千银子，专为监中打点之用。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 當他在半路上，早已～，湊得三千銀子，專為監中打點之用。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十八回
exampleEn: He had already scraped together three thousand taels of silver on the way to bribe the prison officials. — from Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats', Chapter 28

explanation: 原指琴声陡然降落◇用来形容声誉、地位或经济状况急剧下降。
explanationTraditional: 原指琴聲陡然降落◇用來形容聲譽、地位或經濟狀況急劇下降。
explanationEn: To drop a thousand zhang in one fall; to suffer a sudden and severe decline in reputation, status, or economic conditions.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《听颖师弹琴》诗跻攀分寸不可上，失势一落千丈强。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《聽穎師彈琴》詩躋攀分寸不可上，失勢一落千丈強。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's poem 'Listening to Master Ying Play the Qin': 'Climbing inch by inch, but losing momentum, falling a thousand zhang.'
example: 所以喜奎一嫁，转瞬坤伶声势，～，伶界牛耳，又让男伶夺去。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一二六回
exampleTraditional: 所以喜奎一嫁，轉瞬坤伶聲勢，～，伶界牛耳，又讓男伶奪去。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一二六回
exampleEn: So as soon as Xikui married, the female performers' reputation plummeted, and the male performers regained dominance. — from Cai Dongfan's 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 126

explanation: 从头到尾按原来的样子。指详细叙述事情的全部起因和整个过程，一点不漏。
explanationTraditional: 從頭到尾按原來的樣子。指詳細敘述事情的全部起因和整個過程，一點不漏。
explanationEn: From beginning to end; to narrate the whole story in detail without omission.
derivation: 汉·班固《西都赋》元元本本，殚见洽闻。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·班固《西都賦》元元本本，殫見洽聞。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Ban Gu's 'Western Capital Rhapsody': 'From the very beginning, thoroughly informed.'
example: 差官便抢上一步，把这事情～详陈一遍。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 差官便搶上一步，把這事情～詳陳一遍。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第十二回
exampleEn: The officer stepped forward and recounted the whole story in detail. — from Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 12

explanation: 往火上倒油。比喻使人更加愤怒或使情况更加严重。
explanationTraditional: 往火上倒油。比喻使人更加憤怒或使情況更加嚴重。
explanationEn: To pour oil on the fire; to aggravate a situation or make someone angrier.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《金线池》第二折我见了他扑邓邓火上浇油。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《金線池》第二折我見了他撲鄧鄧火上澆油。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Golden Thread Pond': 'Seeing him, I was furious, like pouring oil on fire.'
example: 若吃此药，误用人参，犹如～，不出七天，必要命尽无常。★清·石昆玉《三侠五义》第四十一回
exampleTraditional: 若吃此藥，誤用人參，猶如～，不出七天，必要命盡無常。★清·石崑玉《三俠五義》第四十一回
exampleEn: If you take this medicine with ginseng, it's like pouring oil on fire; within seven days, you will surely die. — from Shi Yukun's 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants', Chapter 41

explanation: 按照事物本身的性质来评定是非得失。现常指仅从事物的表面现象孤立、静止、片面地议论。
explanationTraditional: 按照事物本身的性質來評定是非得失。現常指僅從事物的表面現象孤立、靜止、片面地議論。
explanationEn: To judge right and wrong based on the nature of the matter itself; now often refers to discussing only superficial phenomena in isolation, statically, and one-sidedly.
derivation: 明·沈德符《万历野获编·词臣论劾首揆》夺情大事，有关纲常，且就事论事，未尝旁及云。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《萬曆野獲編·詞臣論劾首揆》奪情大事，有關綱常，且就事論事，未嘗旁及雲。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shen Defu's 'Wanli Yehuo Bian': 'The matter of setting aside mourning is a great affair concerning moral principles, and we should judge it on its own merits without bringing in other issues.'
example: 世间有所谓～”的办法，现在就诗论诗，或者也可以说是无碍的罢。★鲁迅《且介亭集文二集·题未定”草》
exampleTraditional: 世間有所謂～”的辦法，現在就詩論詩，或者也可以說是無礙的罷。★魯迅《且介亭集文二集·題未定”草》
exampleEn: There is a so-called 'judge the matter on its own merits' approach; if we discuss the poem on its own, it might be harmless. — Lu Xun, 'Anding' Draft

explanation: 无穷尽。
explanationTraditional: 無窮盡。
explanationEn: Endless; without end.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他总是没完没了地缠着我。
exampleTraditional: 他總是沒完沒了地纏著我。
exampleEn: He keeps pestering me endlessly.

explanation: 既使人民劳苦，又耗费钱财。现也指滥用人力物力。
explanationTraditional: 既使人民勞苦，又耗費錢財。現也指濫用人力物力。
explanationEn: To tire the people and waste money; now also refers to misuse of manpower and resources.
derivation: 《周易·节》不伤财，不害民。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·節》不傷財，不害民。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes, Jie': 'Do not harm the people, do not waste wealth.'
example: 天下闻风皆争进奇巧，则～自此始矣。★明·余继登《典故纪闻》卷二
exampleTraditional: 天下聞風皆爭進奇巧，則～自此始矣。★明·餘繼登《典故紀聞》卷二
exampleEn: When the whole world hears the news, they compete to present ingenious novelties, and thus begins the waste of labor and money. — Ming Dynasty, Yu Jideng's 'Records of Anecdotes' Volume 2

explanation: 危言使人吃惊的话；耸惊动；耸听使听话的人吃惊。指故意说些夸大的吓人的话，使人惊疑震动。
explanationTraditional: 危言使人吃驚的話；聳驚動；聳聽使聽話的人吃驚。指故意說些誇大的嚇人的話，使人驚疑震動。
explanationEn: To deliberately say exaggerated or frightening words to shock or alarm people.
derivation: 郭小川《论听话”》这不是什么‘危言耸听’的道理，稍稍注意这个问题的人，是不难发现若干真凭实据的。”
derivationTraditional: 郭小川《論聽話”》這不是什麼‘危言聳聽’的道理，稍稍注意這個問題的人，是不難發現若干真憑實據的。”
derivationEn: Guo Xiaochuan's 'On Listening': 'This is not a 'scaremongering' argument; those who pay a little attention can easily find some solid evidence.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 煞委。形容费尽心思。
explanationTraditional: 煞委。形容費盡心思。
explanationEn: To take great pains; to expend much thought and effort.
derivation: 清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第三回这煎烟方法，我是煞费苦心，三番五次的试验，方才研究得精密。”
derivationTraditional: 清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第三回這煎煙方法，我是煞費苦心，三番五次的試驗，方才研究得精密。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Peng Yang'ou's 'The Opium Addict' Chapter 3: 'I took great pains in this method of smoking opium, experimenting repeatedly before perfecting it.'
example: 他～编造的谎言被人当场揭穿了。
exampleTraditional: 他～編造的謊言被人當場揭穿了。
exampleEn: The lie he concocted with great effort was exposed on the spot.

explanation: 天马神马。天马奔腾神速，象是腾起在空中飞行一样。比喻诗文气势豪放。也比喻人浮躁，不踏实。
explanationTraditional: 天馬神馬。天馬奔騰神速，象是騰起在空中飛行一樣。比喻詩文氣勢豪放。也比喻人浮躁，不踏實。
explanationEn: A heavenly horse galloping in the sky; metaphor for bold and unrestrained literary style, or for a person who is impetuous and not down-to-earth.
derivation: 元·刘廷振《萨天锡诗集序》其所以神化而超出于众表者，殆犹天马行空而步骤不凡。”
derivationTraditional: 元·劉廷振《薩天錫詩集序》其所以神化而超出於眾表者，殆猶天馬行空而步驟不凡。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Liu Tingzhen's 'Preface to Sa Tianxi's Poetry Collection': 'His divine transformation and surpassing others is like a heavenly horse galloping in the sky with extraordinary steps.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 欺骗自己，也欺骗别人。
explanationTraditional: 欺騙自己，也欺騙別人。
explanationEn: To deceive oneself and others.
derivation: 《朱子语类》因说自欺欺人曰欺人亦是自欺，此又是自欺之甚者。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子語類》因說自欺欺人曰欺人亦是自欺，此又是自欺之甚者。”
derivationEn: 'Zhu Xi's Classified Conversations': 'Speaking of self-deception and deceiving others, it is said that deceiving others is also self-deception, and this is the worst form of self-deception.'
example: 有人说中国的实业就会借此促进，那是～之谈。★鲁迅《两地书·二九》
exampleTraditional: 有人說中國的實業就會藉此促進，那是～之談。★魯迅《兩地書·二九》
exampleEn: Some say that China's industry will thus be promoted; that is self-deceptive talk. — Lu Xun, 'Two Letters' No. 29

explanation: 讳隐讳；深事件重大。原意为事件重大，讳而不言◇指把事情隐瞒得很紧。
explanationTraditional: 諱隱諱；深事件重大。原意為事件重大，諱而不言◇指把事情隱瞞得很緊。
explanationEn: To hide something deeply; originally meant to conceal a major event, now refers to keeping something very secret.
derivation: 《谷梁传·庄公三十二年》讳莫如深，深则隐。苟有所见，莫如深也。”
derivationTraditional: 《穀梁傳·莊公三十二年》諱莫如深，深則隱。苟有所見，莫如深也。”
derivationEn: 'Guliang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals, Year 32 of Duke Zhuang': 'Nothing is hidden as deeply as this; deep means concealed. If there is something to see, nothing is as deep as this.'
example: 中国则～，枢府举动，真相不知。★清·梁启超《论报馆有益于国事》
exampleTraditional: 中國則～，樞府舉動，真相不知。★清·梁啟超《論報館有益於國事》
exampleEn: China keeps it deeply secret; the actions of the central government are unknown. — Qing Dynasty, Liang Qichao's 'On the Benefit of Newspapers to the State'

explanation: 断截断；章音乐一曲为一章。指不顾全篇文章或谈话的内容，孤立地取其中的一段或一句的意思。指引用与原意不符。
explanationTraditional: 斷截斷；章音樂一曲為一章。指不顧全篇文章或談話的內容，孤立地取其中的一段或一句的意思。指引用與原意不符。
explanationEn: To quote out of context; to take a passage or phrase from a text or speech in isolation, disregarding the overall meaning.
derivation: 《左传·襄公二十八年》赋诗断章，余取所求焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公二十八年》賦詩斷章，餘取所求焉。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan, Year 28 of Duke Xiang': 'When reciting a poem, take the passage that suits your purpose.'
example: 宋人攻击王介甫，说他将明妃写成一个不忠君不爱国的人，其实是～，故入人罪。★朱自清《清华的一日》
exampleTraditional: 宋人攻擊王介甫，說他將明妃寫成一個不忠君不愛國的人，其實是～，故入人罪。★朱自清《清華的一日》
exampleEn: Song scholars attacked Wang Anshi, claiming he portrayed Wang Zhaojun as disloyal and unpatriotic, but that was actually quoting out of context to frame him. — Zhu Ziqing, 'One Day at Tsinghua'

explanation: 五彩各种颜色；缤纷繁多交错的样子。指颜色繁多，非趁看。
explanationTraditional: 五彩各種顏色；繽紛繁多交錯的樣子。指顏色繁多，非趁看。
explanationEn: Colorful; a riot of colors; multicolored and dazzling.
derivation: 峻青《地下水晶宫》墙壁上有着许多霜花似的花纹，在灯光的照耀下，满墙都放射着五彩缤纷的光芒，就好象是彩虹织成似的。”
derivationTraditional: 峻青《地下水晶宮》牆壁上有著許多霜花似的花紋，在燈光的照耀下，滿牆都放射著五彩繽紛的光芒，就好象是彩虹織成似的。”
derivationEn: Jun Qing's 'Underground Crystal Palace': 'On the walls were many frost-like patterns, and under the light, the walls radiated a riot of colors, as if woven by rainbows.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 前进和后退都难。比喻事情无法决定，因而难以行动。
explanationTraditional: 前進和後退都難。比喻事情無法決定，因而難以行動。
explanationEn: Difficult to advance or retreat; in a dilemma.
derivation: 宋·李靖《卫公兵法》凡攻城之兵……进退又难，前既不得上城，退则其师逼追。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李靖《衛公兵法》凡攻城之兵……進退又難，前既不得上城，退則其師逼追。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Li Jing's 'Wei Gong Bing Fa': 'For troops attacking a city... it is difficult to advance or retreat, unable to scale the walls, and retreating would be pursued.'
example: 孔明曰既主公在涪关～之际，亮不得不去。”★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: 孔明曰既主公在涪關～之際，亮不得不去。”★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十三回
exampleEn: Kongming said: 'Since my lord is in a dilemma at Fucheng Pass, I must go.' — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 63.

explanation: 自新自觉改正，重新做人。改正错误，重新做起。
explanationTraditional: 自新自覺改正，重新做人。改正錯誤，重新做起。
explanationEn: To correct one's errors and make a fresh start.
derivation: 《史记·孝文本纪》妾伤夫死者不可复生，刑者不可复属，虽复欲改过自新，其道无由也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孝文本紀》妾傷夫死者不可復生，刑者不可復屬，雖復欲改過自新，其道無由也。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Annals of Emperor Wen': 'I grieve that the dead cannot be revived, and the punished cannot be restored; even if they wish to reform, there is no way.'
example: 子能～，弃越归吴，寡人必当重用。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 子能～，棄越歸吳，寡人必當重用。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十回
exampleEn: If you can reform and abandon Yue for Wu, I will surely appoint you to an important post. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 80.

explanation: 一口咬住不放。比喻坚持一个廉洁，再不改口。
explanationTraditional: 一口咬住不放。比喻堅持一個廉潔，再不改口。
explanationEn: To insist stubbornly on a statement without changing it.
derivation: 清·无名氏《官场维新记》第十回先把住持僧慧修，严行审讯，问他将李国斌藏在何处，慧修一口咬定不认得李国斌。”
derivationTraditional: 清·無名氏《官場維新記》第十回先把住持僧慧修，嚴行審訊，問他將李國斌藏在何處，慧修一口咬定不認得李國斌。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, anonymous 'The New Officialdom': 'First, the abbot Huixiu was interrogated strictly, asking where Li Guobin was hidden; Huixiu insisted he did not know Li Guobin.'
example: 老山东摇摇头，～不用看，我心里有数！我家的秤老辈用的，十四两顶新秤一斤，错不了。”★冯德英《迎春花》第十一章
exampleTraditional: 老山東搖搖頭，～不用看，我心裡有數！我家的秤老輩用的，十四兩頂新秤一斤，錯不了。”★馮德英《迎春花》第十一章
exampleEn: Old Shandong shook his head, insisting there was no need to look; he knew it in his heart! Our family's scale was used by the elders, fourteen liang equals a new jin, no mistake. — Feng Deying's 'Spring Flowers', Chapter 11.

explanation: 急急切。急着要取得成功。
explanationTraditional: 急急切。急著要取得成功。
explanationEn: To be eager for success; to act with undue haste.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第45回二都督道‘急切不得下手！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第45回二都督道‘急切不得下手！’”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 45: 'The two commanders said, 'We cannot act hastily!''
example: 她怎样呢？还是那样～，不甘寂寞吗？★陆地《牙科大夫》
exampleTraditional: 她怎樣呢？還是那樣～，不甘寂寞嗎？★陸地《牙科大夫》
exampleEn: What about her? Still eager for success, unable to bear loneliness? — Lu Di's 'Dentist'.

explanation: 疲惫极度疲乏；不堪不能忍受。形容非常疲乏。
explanationTraditional: 疲憊極度疲乏；不堪不能忍受。形容非常疲乏。
explanationEn: Extremely tired; exhausted.
derivation: 刘操南《武松演义》第十回犯人一上梃棍，坐卧不得，只是局局促促地挤做一团，弄得疲惫不堪。”
derivationTraditional: 劉操南《武松演義》第十回犯人一上梃棍，坐臥不得，只是局侷促促地擠做一團，弄得疲憊不堪。”
derivationEn: Liu Caonan's 'Wu Song's Story', Chapter 10: 'Once the prisoner was on the rack, unable to sit or lie, cramped together, utterly exhausted.'
example: 这一趟出差弄得～。
exampleTraditional: 這一趟出差弄得～。
exampleEn: This business trip left me utterly exhausted.

explanation: 惩处罚；贷宽容。严厉惩罚，绝不宽恕。
explanationTraditional: 懲處罰；貸寬容。嚴厲懲罰，絕不寬恕。
explanationEn: To punish severely without leniency.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 对于那些屡教不改的不法分子，一定要严惩不贷。
exampleTraditional: 對於那些屢教不改的不法分子，一定要嚴懲不貸。
exampleEn: Those who repeatedly refuse to reform must be severely punished without leniency.

explanation: 折挫折；挠弯曲。比喻意志坚强，无论受到多少次挫折，毫不动摇退缩。
explanationTraditional: 折挫折；撓彎曲。比喻意志堅強，無論受到多少次挫折，毫不動搖退縮。
explanationEn: To be undaunted by repeated setbacks; persistent.
derivation: 汉·蔡邕《太尉乔玄碑》其性庄，疾华尚朴，有百折不挠，临大节而不可夺之风。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·蔡邕《太尉喬玄碑》其性莊，疾華尚樸，有百折不撓，臨大節而不可奪之風。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Cai Yong's 'Stele of Grand Commandant Qiao Xuan': 'His nature was solemn, despising vanity and valuing simplicity; he had a spirit of indomitable will, unshakable in great crises.'
example: 汉阳民军总司令黄兴，系湖南长沙县人，向来主张革命，屡仆屡起，～。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第三回
exampleTraditional: 漢陽民軍總司令黃興，系湖南長沙縣人，向來主張革命，屢仆屢起，～。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第三回
exampleEn: Huang Xing, commander of the Hanyang People's Army, was from Changsha, Hunan. He always advocated revolution, rising after repeated falls, undaunted by setbacks. — Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 3.

explanation: 指全家人。
explanationTraditional: 指全家人。
explanationEn: The entire family; all members of a household.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十回当日接了书信，便与弟曹德及一家老小四十余人，带从者百余人，车百余辆，径望兖州而来。”明·冯梦龙《警世通言》第七卷你若无事退回，我自养你一家老小，如要原钱还府，也是我出。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十回當日接了書信，便與弟曹德及一家老小四十餘人，帶從者百餘人，車百餘輛，徑望兗州而來。”明·馮夢龍《警世通言》第七卷你若無事退回，我自養你一家老小，如要原錢還府，也是我出。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 10: 'That day, he received the letter and went with his brother Cao De and the whole family of over forty people...' Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 7: 'If you return without incident, I will support your entire family.'
example: 你问我借盘缠，我一天杀一个猪，还赚不到钱把银子，都给你去丢在水里，叫我～喝西北风？★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleTraditional: 你問我借盤纏，我一天殺一個豬，還賺不到錢把銀子，都給你去丟在水裡，叫我～喝西北風？★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleEn: You ask me for travel money; I kill one pig a day and barely earn a few coins, yet you want me to throw it into the water and let my whole family drink the northwest wind? — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 3.

explanation: 显表露，表现；身手指本领。充分显示出本领和才能。
explanationTraditional: 顯表露，表現；身手指本領。充分顯示出本領和才能。
explanationEn: To fully display one's skills or abilities.
derivation: 茹志娟《高高的白杨树》爱唱的人，就在舞台上痛痛快快唱吧．种棉花的，就在连成片的土地上大显身手吧！”
derivationTraditional: 茹志娟《高高的白楊樹》愛唱的人，就在舞臺上痛痛快快唱吧．種棉花的，就在連成片的土地上大顯身手吧！”
derivationEn: Ru Zhijuan's 'The Tall White Poplar': 'Those who love to sing, sing heartily on stage; those who grow cotton, show their skills in the vast fields!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 头打破了，血流满面。多用来形容惨败。
explanationTraditional: 頭打破了，血流滿面。多用來形容慘敗。
explanationEn: To be badly battered; to suffer a crushing defeat.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第四十四回照道士脸上一刮，可怜就打得头破血流身倒地，皮开颈折脑浆倾。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第四十四回照道士臉上一刮，可憐就打得頭破血流身倒地，皮開頸折腦漿傾。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 44: 'A slap on the Taoist's face, pitifully beaten until his head broke and blood flowed, his skin split, neck broken, and brains spilled.'
example: 你若在继续顽抗下去，必定会碰得～！。
exampleTraditional: 你若在繼續頑抗下去，必定會碰得～！。
exampleEn: If you continue to resist stubbornly, you will surely end up battered and defeated!

explanation: 浑水不清的水。比喻乘混乱的时候从中捞取利益。
explanationTraditional: 渾水不清的水。比喻乘混亂的時候從中撈取利益。
explanationEn: To fish in troubled waters; to take advantage of a chaotic situation for personal gain.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》四十五其余那些人，有的是浑水摸鱼，乘机会弄个资格。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》四十五其餘那些人，有的是渾水摸魚，乘機會弄個資格。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof', chapter 45: 'The rest of them, some were fishing in troubled waters, taking the opportunity to get qualifications.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不允许有什么怀疑。表示论证严密，无可怀疑。
explanationTraditional: 不允許有什麼懷疑。表示論證嚴密，無可懷疑。
explanationEn: Not allowing any doubt; indisputable, unquestionable.
derivation: 宋·陆游《严州乌龙广济庙碑》盖其灵响暴著，亦有不容置疑者矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《嚴州烏龍廣濟廟碑》蓋其靈響暴著，亦有不容置疑者矣。”
derivationEn: From Lu You's 'Yanzhou Wulong Guangji Temple Stele' in the Song Dynasty: 'Its spiritual power is so manifest that there is no room for doubt.'
example: 报告的内容与群众反映的情况一致，～。
exampleTraditional: 報告的內容與群眾反映的情況一致，～。
exampleEn: The content of the report is consistent with the feedback from the masses, leaving no room for doubt.

explanation: 计计划，策略。长远的打算。
explanationTraditional: 計計劃，策略。長遠的打算。
explanationEn: A long-term plan or strategy.
derivation: 《战国策·赵策》岂非计久长，有子孙相继为王也哉。”《汉书·元帝纪》东垂被虐耗之害，关中有无聊之民，非长久之计。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·趙策》豈非計久長，有子孫相繼為王也哉。”《漢書·元帝紀》東垂被虐耗之害，關中有無聊之民，非長久之計。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Zhao Strategy': 'Isn't this a long-term plan for descendants to succeed as kings?' and 'Book of Han: Emperor Yuan's Record': 'The east is suffering from depletion, and the central region has idle people; this is not a long-term plan.'
example: 却把那袈裟留下，以为传家之宝，岂非子孙～耶？★明·吴承恩《西游记》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 卻把那袈裟留下，以為傳家之寶，豈非子孫～耶？★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十六回
exampleEn: Keeping that cassock as a family heirloom—isn't that a long-term plan for descendants? (from Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', chapter 16)

explanation: 孜孜勤勉，不懈怠。指工作或学习勤奋不知疲倦。
explanationTraditional: 孜孜勤勉，不懈怠。指工作或學習勤奮不知疲倦。
explanationEn: Diligent and tireless; working or studying with perseverance and without fatigue.
derivation: 《尚书·君陈》惟日孜孜，无敢逸豫。”《后汉书·鲁丕传》性沉深好学，孳孳不倦。”《三国志·蜀书·向朗传》乃更潜心典籍，孜孜不倦。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·君陳》惟日孜孜，無敢逸豫。”《後漢書·魯丕傳》性沉深好學，孳孳不倦。”《三國志·蜀書·向朗傳》乃更潛心典籍，孜孜不倦。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Lord Chen': 'Be diligent day and night, never indulging in ease.' and 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Lu Pi': 'He was deeply studious, tireless in his efforts.' and 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Book of Shu: Biography of Xiang Lang': 'He devoted himself to classics, tirelessly.'
example: 他长年累月～地工作。
exampleTraditional: 他長年累月～地工作。
exampleEn: He works tirelessly year after year.

explanation: 遐远；迩近。形容名声很大，远近都知道。
explanationTraditional: 遐遠；邇近。形容名聲很大，遠近都知道。
explanationEn: Well-known far and near; famous everywhere.
derivation: 《南齐书·高帝纪上》上流声议，遐迩所闻。”
derivationTraditional: 《南齊書·高帝紀上》上流聲議，遐邇所聞。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Southern Qi: Biography of Emperor Gao': 'His reputation spread far and wide.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 各种各样的艰难困苦。
explanationTraditional: 各種各樣的艱難困苦。
explanationEn: Countless hardships and difficulties.
derivation: 元·张之翰《元日》千辛万苦都尝遍，只有吴淞水最甘。”
derivationTraditional: 元·張之翰《元日》千辛萬苦都嚐遍，只有吳淞水最甘。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Zhihan's 'New Year's Day' in the Yuan Dynasty: 'Having tasted all kinds of hardships, only the water of Wusong is the sweetest.'
example: 侨胞的金钱不是容易得到的，是由于他们胼手胝足，～，省吃俭用，积累起来的。★邹韬奋《抗战以来·热烈爱国的千万侨胞》
exampleTraditional: 僑胞的金錢不是容易得到的，是由於他們胼手胝足，～，省吃儉用，積累起來的。★鄒韜奮《抗戰以來·熱烈愛國的千萬僑胞》
exampleEn: The overseas Chinese's money is not easily earned; it comes from their hard work, countless hardships, and frugality. (from Zou Taofen's 'Since the War of Resistance: The Passionate Millions of Overseas Chinese')

explanation: 指说话时做出各种动作。形容说话时放肆或得意忘形。
explanationTraditional: 指說話時做出各種動作。形容說話時放肆或得意忘形。
explanationEn: To gesticulate while speaking; to make gestures in an arrogant or unrestrained manner.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第七十五回见这李虞侯、张干办在宋江前面指手划脚，你来我去，都有心要杀这厮，只是碍着宋江一个，不敢下手。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第七十五回見這李虞侯、張幹辦在宋江前面指手劃腳，你來我去，都有心要殺這廝，只是礙著宋江一個，不敢下手。”
derivationEn: From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', chapter 75: 'Seeing Li Yuhou and Zhang Ganban gesticulating in front of Song Jiang, they all wanted to kill them but were hindered by Song Jiang.'
example: 站在他们前头领导他们呢？还是站在他们后头～地批评他们呢？★毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》
exampleTraditional: 站在他們前頭領導他們呢？還是站在他們後頭～地批評他們呢？★毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》
exampleEn: Should we lead them from the front, or stand behind them and criticize with gestures? (from Mao Zedong's 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan')

explanation: 赫赫显著盛大的样子。声名非常显赫。
explanationTraditional: 赫赫顯著盛大的樣子。聲名非常顯赫。
explanationEn: Very famous; illustrious and renowned.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·节南山》赫赫师尹，民具尔瞻。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·節南山》赫赫師尹，民具爾瞻。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Jie Nanshan': 'The illustrious Grand Master Yin, whom the people all look up to.'
example: 况且他罗家也是著名的盐商，不过近年稍为疲了点罢了，在外面还是～的，怕没人知道么？★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》
exampleTraditional: 況且他羅家也是著名的鹽商，不過近年稍為疲了點罷了，在外面還是～的，怕沒人知道麼？★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》
exampleEn: Moreover, his Luo family was a famous salt merchant, though somewhat declined in recent years; still, they are well-known outside—who wouldn't know them? (from Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years')

explanation: 灭顶水漫过头顶。指被水淹死。比喻毁灭性的灾难。
explanationTraditional: 滅頂水漫過頭頂。指被水淹死。比喻毀滅性的災難。
explanationEn: A disaster that overwhelms one; a catastrophic calamity, like drowning.
derivation: 《周易·大过》过渉灭顶，凶。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·大過》過渉滅頂，兇。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Changes: Da Guo': 'Crossing the river, the water covers the head—ominous.'
example: 动员了全国的老百姓，就造成了陷敌于～的汪洋大海。★毛泽东《论持久战》
exampleTraditional: 動員了全國的老百姓，就造成了陷敵於～的汪洋大海。★毛澤東《論持久戰》
exampleEn: Mobilizing the entire nation's people creates a vast ocean that engulfs the enemy in a catastrophic disaster. (from Mao Zedong's 'On Protracted War')

explanation: 好象影子总是跟着身体一样。比喻两个人关系亲密，常在一起。
explanationTraditional: 好象影子總是跟著身體一樣。比喻兩個人關係親密，常在一起。
explanationEn: Like a shadow following the body; very close, inseparable.
derivation: 《管子·任法》然故下之事上也，如响之应声也；臣之事主也，如影之从形也。”汉·刘向《说苑·君道》故天之应人，如影之随形，响之效声者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·任法》然故下之事上也，如響之應聲也；臣之事主也，如影之從形也。”漢·劉向《說苑·君道》故天之應人，如影之隨形，響之效聲者也。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Ren Fa': 'Thus, the subordinate serves the superior like an echo responding to sound; the minister serves the ruler like a shadow following the form.' and Liu Xiang's 'Shuo Yuan: Jun Dao': 'Thus, heaven responds to man like a shadow following the form, an echo responding to sound.'
example: 善恶昭彰，～。（清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十一回）
exampleTraditional: 善惡昭彰，～。（清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十一回）
exampleEn: Good and evil are manifest, like a shadow following the form. (from Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', chapter 71)

explanation: 调调和；顺和协。风雨及时适宜。形容风雨适合农时。
explanationTraditional: 調調和；順和協。風雨及時適宜。形容風雨適合農時。
explanationEn: Timely wind and rain; favorable weather for crops.
derivation: 《六韬》既而克殷，风凋雨顺。”
derivationTraditional: 《六韜》既而克殷，風凋雨順。”
derivationEn: From 'Six Strategies': 'After conquering Yin, the wind was timely and rain favorable.'
example: 自后国泰民安，～，五谷丰登，人物康阜，真是升平世界。（清·陈忱《水浒后传》第四十回）
exampleTraditional: 自後國泰民安，～，五穀豐登，人物康阜，真是昇平世界。（清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第四十回）
exampleEn: Since then, the country was peaceful, the weather favorable, the harvests abundant, and the people prosperous—truly a world of peace. (Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 40)

explanation: 作为作出成绩。没有做出任何成绩。指工作中安于现状，缺乏创造性。
explanationTraditional: 作為作出成績。沒有做出任何成績。指工作中安於現狀，缺乏創造性。
explanationEn: To accomplish nothing; to be content with the status quo and lack creativity.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 停止的论点，悲观的论点，无所作为和骄傲自满的论点，都是错误的。
exampleTraditional: 停止的論點，悲觀的論點，無所作為和驕傲自滿的論點，都是錯誤的。
exampleEn: The viewpoints of stagnation, pessimism, inaction, and complacency are all wrong.

explanation: 泛指休息或空闲的时候。
explanationTraditional: 泛指休息或空閒的時候。
explanationEn: Leisure time; spare time after tea or meals.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《斗鹌鹑·女校尉》曲茶余饭饱邀故友，谢馆秦楼，散闷消愁。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《鬥鵪鶉·女校尉》曲茶餘飯飽邀故友，謝館秦樓，散悶消愁。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing's 'Dou An Chou': 'After tea and meals, invite old friends to taverns and brothels to dispel boredom.'
example: 难道还只当作亭子间～”谈天的资料吗？★瞿秋白《普洛大众文艺的现实问题》
exampleTraditional: 難道還只當作亭子間～”談天的資料嗎？★瞿秋白《普洛大眾文藝的現實問題》
exampleEn: Should it only be treated as material for idle chat during leisure time? (Qu Qiubai, 'The Real Problem of Proletarian Popular Literature')

explanation: 涕眼泪。形容伤心到极点。
explanationTraditional: 涕眼淚。形容傷心到極點。
explanationEn: To cry bitterly; extremely sorrowful.
derivation: 《汉书·贾谊传》臣窃惟事势，可为痛哭者一，可为流涕者二，可为长太息者六。”《宋史·胡铨传》而此膝一屈不可复伸，国势陵夷不可复振，可为痛哭流涕长太息矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·賈誼傳》臣竊惟事勢，可為痛哭者一，可為流涕者二，可為長太息者六。”《宋史·胡銓傳》而此膝一屈不可復伸，國勢陵夷不可復振，可為痛哭流涕長太息矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Jia Yi': 'I consider the situation: there is one thing to weep over, two to shed tears over, and six to sigh deeply over.' Also 'Song History: Biography of Hu Quan': 'Once this knee bends, it cannot be straightened; the nation declines and cannot be revived—one can only weep bitterly and sigh deeply.'
