derivation: 《汉书·刘据传》太子进则不得见，退则困于乱臣，独冤结而亡告，不忍忿忿之心，起而杀充，恐惧逋逃。”唐·许嵩《建康实录》自尔愤愤不平，每酒后辄咏魏武帝乐府。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·劉據傳》太子進則不得見，退則困於亂臣，獨冤結而亡告，不忍忿忿之心，起而殺充，恐懼逋逃。”唐·許嵩《建康實錄》自爾憤憤不平，每酒後輒詠魏武帝樂府。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Liu Ju': 'The prince could not see the emperor when he went in, and was trapped by treacherous ministers when he went out. Alone in his grievance, unable to appeal, he could not bear his indignation, so he rose and killed Chong, then fled in fear.' Also from Xu Song's 'Jiankang Records': 'Since then, he was always indignant, and after drinking, he would recite Cao Cao's yuefu poems.'
example: 王子成父诸人，俱～，请于桓公，欲劫鲁侯，以报曹沫之辱。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 王子成父諸人，俱～，請於桓公，欲劫魯侯，以報曹沫之辱。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十八回
exampleEn: Prince Zicheng and others were all indignant and asked Duke Huan to kidnap the Duke of Lu to avenge the humiliation by Cao Mo. — Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 18

explanation: 绪丝头。比喻事情的开端，头绪非常多。也形容事情复杂纷乱。
explanationTraditional: 緒絲頭。比喻事情的開端，頭緒非常多。也形容事情複雜紛亂。
explanationEn: Thousands of threads and ends; metaphor for a complex situation with many beginnings or details.
derivation: 三国魏·曹植《自试令》机等吹毛求疵，千端万绪，然终无可言者。”
derivationTraditional: 三國魏·曹植《自試令》機等吹毛求疵，千端萬緒，然終無可言者。”
derivationEn: From Cao Zhi's 'Self-Test Edict' of the Three Kingdoms period: 'Ji and others blow on the hair to find flaws, with thousands of ends and threads, but in the end there is nothing to say.'
example: 一时间，～，让他无从谈起。
exampleTraditional: 一時間，～，讓他無從談起。
exampleEn: For a moment, with a thousand threads and ten thousand ends, he didn't know where to begin.

explanation: 得适合。自以为做的事情合乎道理，心里很坦然。
explanationTraditional: 得適合。自以為做的事情合乎道理，心裡很坦然。
explanationEn: To have a clear conscience and feel at ease, believing one's actions are reasonable.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 到后来忘却了真,相信了谎,也就～,天趣盎然了起来。（鲁迅《病后杂谈》）
exampleTraditional: 到後來忘卻了真,相信了謊,也就～,天趣盎然了起來。（魯迅《病後雜談》）
exampleEn: Later, forgetting the truth and believing the lie, he felt at ease and became full of natural joy. — Lu Xun, 'Miscellaneous Thoughts After Illness'

explanation: 一鼓第一次击鼓；作振作；气勇气。第一次击鼓时士气振奋。比喻趁劲头大的时候鼓起干劲，一口气把工作做完。
explanationTraditional: 一鼓第一次擊鼓；作振作；氣勇氣。第一次擊鼓時士氣振奮。比喻趁勁頭大的時候鼓起幹勁，一口氣把工作做完。
explanationEn: To get something done in one vigorous effort; to press on without letup, taking advantage of high morale.
derivation: 《左传·庄公十年》夫战，勇气也。一鼓作气，再而衰，三而竭。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·莊公十年》夫戰，勇氣也。一鼓作氣，再而衰，三而竭。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The Tenth Year of Duke Zhuang': 'In battle, courage is key. At the first drum, morale is high; at the second, it declines; at the third, it is exhausted.'
example: 初听这话，还是～的。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十八回
exampleTraditional: 初聽這話，還是～的。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十八回
exampleEn: When he first heard this, he was still full of enthusiasm to get it done in one go. — Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats Revealed', Chapter 48

explanation: 形容冰雪漫天盖地。
explanationTraditional: 形容冰雪漫天蓋地。
explanationEn: A world of ice and snow; describing extremely cold weather with snow covering everything.
derivation: 清·蒋士铨《鸡毛房》冰天雪地风如虎，裸而泣者无栖所。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蔣士銓《雞毛房》冰天雪地風如虎，裸而泣者無棲所。”
derivationEn: From Jiang Shiquan's 'Chicken Feather Room': 'In the icy sky and snowy ground, the wind is like a tiger; those naked and crying have no shelter.'
example: 你就在这儿吧，～的上哪儿去？★老舍《骆驼祥子》十二
exampleTraditional: 你就在這兒吧，～的上哪兒去？★老舍《駱駝祥子》十二
exampleEn: You stay here; where would you go in this icy sky and snowy ground? — Lao She, 'Rickshaw Boy', Chapter 12

explanation: 后来出现的或新成长起来的优秀人物。
explanationTraditional: 後來出現的或新成長起來的優秀人物。
explanationEn: An outstanding person who has emerged later; a rising star among the younger generation.
derivation: 《晋书·王忱传》卿风流俊望，真后来之秀。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王忱傳》卿風流俊望，真後來之秀。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Wang Chen': 'You are a talented and elegant figure, truly a rising star of later times.'
example: 及浪游南北，与乡里阔疏，～，不乏其人。★清·盛大士《溪山卧游录》卷三
exampleTraditional: 及浪遊南北，與鄉里闊疏，～，不乏其人。★清·盛大士《溪山臥遊錄》卷三
exampleEn: After traveling north and south, and being estranged from his hometown, there were many rising stars among the younger generation. — Sheng Dashi, 'Recluse Records of Streams and Mountains', Volume 3

explanation: 谨、慎小心，慎重。言语行动小心谨慎。
explanationTraditional: 謹、慎小心，慎重。言語行動小心謹慎。
explanationEn: To speak and act cautiously and prudently.
derivation: 《礼记·缁衣》君子道人以言而禁人以行，故言必虑其所终，而行必稽其所敝，则民谨于言而慎于行。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·緇衣》君子道人以言而禁人以行，故言必慮其所終，而行必稽其所敝，則民謹於言而慎於行。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Black Robes': 'A gentleman guides people with words and restrains them with actions. Therefore, he must consider the consequences of his words and examine the flaws of his actions, so that the people are cautious in speech and careful in conduct.'
example: 八十年来识更真，深知言行切修身；～无些过，细数吾乡有几人。★明·朱国桢《涌幢小品·笃行》
exampleTraditional: 八十年來識更真，深知言行切修身；～無些過，細數吾鄉有幾人。★明·朱國楨《湧幢小品·篤行》
exampleEn: In eighty years, I have learned more truly; I deeply know that words and actions are crucial for self-cultivation. Speaking cautiously and acting prudently without any fault; counting carefully, how many in our hometown can match this? — Zhu Guozhen, 'Yongchuang Essays: Devoted Conduct'

explanation: 迁变动。随着时间的推移，情况发生变化。
explanationTraditional: 遷變動。隨著時間的推移，情況發生變化。
explanationEn: As time passes, circumstances change.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国演义》第一０六回凡我国民，应尽吾雪耻这天职，并望勿为五分钟之热度，时过境迁，又复忘怀，则吾国真不救矣。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國演義》第一０六回凡我國民，應盡吾雪恥這天職，並望勿為五分鐘之熱度，時過境遷，又復忘懷，則吾國真不救矣。”
derivationEn: From Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'The Republic of China' (Chapter 106): 'All our countrymen should fulfill their duty to wipe out the shame, and should not be like a five-minute passion, forgetting after time passes and circumstances change, or our country will truly be beyond salvation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 敌对双方非争夺不可的战略要地。
explanationTraditional: 敵對雙方非爭奪不可的戰略要地。
explanationEn: A strategic location that both sides must fight for.
derivation: 《周书·王悦传》白马要冲，是必争之地。今城守寡弱，易可图也。”
derivationTraditional: 《周書·王悅傳》白馬要衝，是必爭之地。今城守寡弱，易可圖也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Zhou: Biography of Wang Yue': 'Baima is a vital thoroughfare, a place that must be contested. Now the city's defense is weak and sparse, easy to capture.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 居站在，处于；临面对。占据高处，俯视下面。形容占据的地势非常有利。
explanationTraditional: 居站在，處於；臨面對。佔據高處，俯視下面。形容佔據的地勢非常有利。
explanationEn: Occupying a high position and looking down; having a commanding advantage.
derivation: 《淮南子·原道训》登高临下，无失所秉，履危行险，无忘玄伏。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·原道訓》登高臨下，無失所秉，履危行險，無忘玄伏。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi: Original Dao': 'Ascending high and looking down, without losing what one holds; treading dangerous paths, without forgetting the mysterious.'
example: 敌～，我战地不利。★清·毕沅《续资治通鉴·宋纪高宗绍兴十一年》
exampleTraditional: 敵～，我戰地不利。★清·畢沅《續資治通鑑·宋紀高宗紹興十一年》
exampleEn: The enemy occupied a commanding position, and our battlefield was unfavorable. — Qing Dynasty Bi Yuan's 'Continuation of Zizhi Tongjian: Song Annals, Emperor Gaozong, Shaoxing 11th Year'

explanation: 唯只有；图图谋，追求。只要有利可图，什么事都干。
explanationTraditional: 唯只有；圖圖謀，追求。只要有利可圖，什麼事都幹。
explanationEn: To seek nothing but profit; to be bent solely on profit.
derivation: 《左传·成公十三年》余虽与晋出入，余唯利是视。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公十三年》餘雖與晉出入，餘唯利是視。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: 13th Year of Duke Cheng': 'Although I have dealings with Jin, I only look to profit.'
example: 原来这黄祸居乡，～，无恶不作。（清·颐琐《黄绣球》第五回）
exampleTraditional: 原來這黃禍居鄉，～，無惡不作。（清·頤瑣《黃繡球》第五回）
exampleEn: It turned out that this Huang Huo, living in the countryside, was solely profit-seeking and committed all kinds of evil. — Qing Dynasty Yi Suo's 'Yellow Embroidered Ball' (Chapter 5)

explanation: 事情不分大小。形容什么事都管。同事无大小”。
explanationTraditional: 事情不分大小。形容什麼事都管。同事無大小”。
explanationEn: Matters both large and small; to attend to everything regardless of size.
derivation: 《三国志·诸葛亮传》政事无巨细咸于亮。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·諸葛亮傳》政事無鉅細鹹於亮。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Zhuge Liang': 'All government affairs, large and small, were decided by Liang.'
example: 曾未期月，援溺振渴，～，悉究本末。★宋·邵博《闻见后录》卷十五
exampleTraditional: 曾未期月，援溺振渴，～，悉究本末。★宋·邵博《聞見後錄》卷十五
exampleEn: Within a month, he rescued the drowning and relieved the thirsty, attending to all matters large and small, investigating thoroughly. — Song Dynasty Shao Bo's 'Records of Things Heard and Seen' (Volume 15)

explanation: 孔小洞。比喻有空子就钻。
explanationTraditional: 孔小洞。比喻有空子就鑽。
explanationEn: To seize every opportunity; to be all-pervasive.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十五回况且上海办捐的人，钻头觅缝，无孔不入。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十五回況且上海辦捐的人，鑽頭覓縫，無孔不入。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' (Chapter 35): 'Moreover, the donation seekers in Shanghai burrow and pry, leaving no hole unentered.'
example: 帝国主义对其殖民地的经济掠夺是～的。
exampleTraditional: 帝國主義對其殖民地的經濟掠奪是～的。
exampleEn: Imperialists' economic plundering of their colonies is all-pervasive.

explanation: 来势迅猛，不可抵挡。
explanationTraditional: 來勢迅猛，不可抵擋。
explanationEn: Irresistible; overwhelming.
derivation: 《晋书·郗鉴传》群逆纵逸，其势不可当，可以算屈，难以力竞。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·郗鑑傳》群逆縱逸，其勢不可當，可以算屈，難以力競。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Xi Jian': 'The rebels are rampant, their momentum unstoppable; they can be overcome by strategy, not by force.'
example: 众将见西岐士马英雄，～，并无一筹可展，半策可施。（明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二十八回）
exampleTraditional: 眾將見西岐士馬英雄，～，並無一籌可展，半策可施。（明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二十八回）
exampleEn: The generals saw that the soldiers and horses of Xiyu were heroic and unstoppable, with no strategy to display and no plan to implement. — Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' (Chapter 28)

explanation: 象烟云消散一样。比喻事物消失得干干净净。
explanationTraditional: 象煙雲消散一樣。比喻事物消失得乾乾淨淨。
explanationEn: To vanish like smoke and disperse like clouds; to disappear completely.
derivation: 《朱子全书·治道二·祯异》使一日之间，云消雾散，尧天舜日，廓然清明。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子全書·治道二·禎異》使一日之間，雲消霧散，堯天舜日，廓然清明。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Xi's Complete Works: Governance Part 2: Omens': 'In one day, clouds dissipate and fog clears, the sky of Yao and sun of Shun, vast and clear.'
example: 他的兴致被突然传来的坏消息吹得～。
exampleTraditional: 他的興致被突然傳來的壞消息吹得～。
exampleEn: His enthusiasm was blown away by the sudden bad news.

explanation: 泛指在地上坐。
explanationTraditional: 泛指在地上坐。
explanationEn: To sit on the ground.
derivation: 《旧五代史·李茂贞传》但御军整众，都无纪律，当食造庖厨，往往席地而坐。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊五代史·李茂貞傳》但御軍整眾，都無紀律，當食造庖廚，往往席地而坐。”
derivationEn: From 'Old History of the Five Dynasties: Biography of Li Maozhen': 'But when commanding troops and organizing the masses, there was no discipline; when eating, they would go to the kitchen and often sit on the ground.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 豁然形容开阔；开朗开阔明亮。从黑暗狭窄变得宽敞明亮。比喻突然领悟了一个道理。
explanationTraditional: 豁然形容開闊；開朗開闊明亮。從黑暗狹窄變得寬敞明亮。比喻突然領悟了一個道理。
explanationEn: Suddenly see the light; to become enlightened or clear.
derivation: 晋·陶潜《桃花园记》极初狭，才通人。复行数十步，豁然开朗。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陶潛《桃花園記》極初狹，才通人。復行數十步，豁然開朗。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Tao Qian's 'Peach Blossom Spring': 'At first it was very narrow, barely allowing passage. After another few dozen steps, it suddenly opened up.'
example: 宝玉～笑道很是，很是。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十一回
exampleTraditional: 寶玉～笑道很是，很是。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十一回
exampleEn: Baoyu suddenly saw the light and laughed, saying, 'Very true, very true.' — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (Chapter 91)

explanation: 义愤对违反正义的事情所产生的愤怒；膺胸。发于正义的愤懑充满胸中。
explanationTraditional: 義憤對違反正義的事情所產生的憤怒；膺胸。發於正義的憤懣充滿胸中。
explanationEn: Righteous indignation fills one's chest; a feeling of anger aroused by injustice.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十五回珏斋不禁义愤填膺，自己办了个长电奏，力请宣战。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十五回珏齋不禁義憤填膺，自己辦了個長電奏，力請宣戰。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sorrows', Chapter 25: 'Juezhai couldn't help but feel righteous indignation, so he drafted a long telegram urging war.'
example: 畿辅士民，屡遭虏骑蹂躏，莫不～，恨之切骨。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二章
exampleTraditional: 畿輔士民，屢遭虜騎蹂躪，莫不～，恨之切骨。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二章
exampleEn: The people of the capital region, repeatedly trampled by enemy cavalry, were all filled with righteous indignation and bitter hatred. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Vol. 1, Chapter 2

explanation: 不前进就要后退。
explanationTraditional: 不前進就要後退。
explanationEn: Not to advance is to retreat; if you don't move forward, you will fall behind.
derivation: 《邓析子·无后篇》不进则退，不喜则忧，不得则亡，此世人之常。”
derivationTraditional: 《鄧析子·無後篇》不進則退，不喜則憂，不得則亡，此世人之常。”
derivationEn: From 'Deng Xizi: Wuhou Chapter': 'Not to advance is to retreat, not to be happy is to worry, not to gain is to lose—this is the common way of the world.'
example: 逆水行舟，～，学外语也是一样，一刻也放松不得。
exampleTraditional: 逆水行舟，～，學外語也是一樣，一刻也放鬆不得。
exampleEn: Sailing against the current, if you don't advance you retreat. Learning a foreign language is the same; you can't relax for a moment.

explanation: 作战时将领亲自带头，冲在士兵前面。现在也用来比喻领导带头，走在群众前面。
explanationTraditional: 作戰時將領親自帶頭，衝在士兵前面。現在也用來比喻領導帶頭，走在群眾前面。
explanationEn: A leader takes the lead and goes before the troops; to set an example for others.
derivation: 《史记·淮南衡山列传》当敌勇敢，常为士卒先。”《资治通鉴·隋纪炀帝大业九年》玄感每战，身先士卒，所向摧陷。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮南衡山列傳》當敵勇敢，常為士卒先。”《資治通鑑·隋紀煬帝大業九年》玄感每戰，身先士卒，所向摧陷。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the King of Huainan and Hengshan': 'When facing the enemy, he was brave and often took the lead among the soldiers.' Also from 'Zizhi Tongjian: Sui Annals': 'Xuanggan always took the lead in battle, and wherever he attacked, he broke through.'
example: 披坚执锐，临难不顾，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十二回
exampleTraditional: 披堅執銳，臨難不顧，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十二回
exampleEn: Wearing armor and holding weapons, facing danger without hesitation, taking the lead before the troops. — Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 72

explanation: 一概同一标准，一律。指处理事情或问题不分性质，不加区别，用同一标准来对待或处理。
explanationTraditional: 一概同一標準，一律。指處理事情或問題不分性質，不加區別，用同一標準來對待或處理。
explanationEn: To treat different things or people by the same standard; to lump together without distinction.
derivation: 《楚辞·九章·怀沙》同糅玉石兮，一而相量。”唐·刘知几《史通·叙事》而作者安可以方古，一概而论得失？”
derivationTraditional: 《楚辭·九章·懷沙》同糅玉石兮，一而相量。”唐·劉知幾《史通·敘事》而作者安可以方古，一概而論得失？”
derivationEn: From 'Chu Ci: Nine Chapters: Embracing Sand': 'Mixing jade and stone together, weighing them with the same measure.' Also from Tang Dynasty Liu Zhiji's 'Shitong: Narrative': 'How can authors compare ancient and modern, and judge gains and losses by the same standard?'
example: 我们对具体问题要做具体分析，决不能～。
exampleTraditional: 我們對具體問題要做具體分析，決不能～。
exampleEn: We must analyze specific problems concretely and never treat them all alike.

explanation: 敷衍做事不认真；了完。指办事马马虎虎，只求应付过去就算完事。
explanationTraditional: 敷衍做事不認真；了完。指辦事馬馬虎虎，只求應付過去就算完事。
explanationEn: To do something perfunctorily; to muddle through one's duties.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第一回也有先作揖，后磕头的，也有磕起头来，再作一个揖的。礼生见他们参差不齐，也只好由他们敷衍了事。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第一回也有先作揖，後磕頭的，也有磕起頭來，再作一個揖的。禮生見他們參差不齊，也只好由他們敷衍了事。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 1: 'Some bowed first then kowtowed, others kowtowed first then bowed. The master of ceremonies, seeing the disorder, had to let them muddle through.'
example: 我们办事要认真负责，不应采取～的态度。
exampleTraditional: 我們辦事要認真負責，不應採取～的態度。
exampleEn: We should handle our work conscientiously, not adopt a perfunctory attitude.

explanation: 垫高枕头睡觉，无忧无虑。比喻思想麻痹，丧失警惕。
explanationTraditional: 墊高枕頭睡覺，無憂無慮。比喻思想麻痺，喪失警惕。
explanationEn: To sleep peacefully without worries; to be free from anxiety, often implying complacency.
derivation: 《战国策·魏策一》事秦，则楚韩必不敢动，无楚韩之患，则大王高枕而卧，国必无忧矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·魏策一》事秦，則楚韓必不敢動，無楚韓之患，則大王高枕而臥，國必無憂矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Wei Strategy I': 'If we serve Qin, then Chu and Han will not dare to act. Without the threat of Chu and Han, Your Majesty can sleep on a high pillow and the state will be worry-free.'
example: 孔明已死，我等皆～矣。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百四回
exampleTraditional: 孔明已死，我等皆～矣。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百四回
exampleEn: With Kongming dead, we can all sleep peacefully. — Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 104

explanation: 变着法定出一些名目来达到某种不正当的目的。
explanationTraditional: 變著法定出一些名目來達到某種不正當的目的。
explanationEn: To invent various pretexts or names for an improper purpose.
derivation: 清·昭梿《啸亭杂录·卷三·朱白泉狱中上百朱二公书》乃星使临工，以为巧立名目，不容申辩。”
derivationTraditional: 清·昭槤《嘯亭雜錄·卷三·朱白泉獄中上百朱二公書》乃星使臨工，以為巧立名目，不容申辯。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhaolian's 'Xiaoting Miscellaneous Records: Volume 3: Zhu Baiquan's Letter to the Two Lords from Prison': 'When the imperial envoy arrived at the worksite, he considered it as inventing pretexts and would not allow any explanation.'
example: 向企业～收费的做法是不利于企业发展的。
exampleTraditional: 向企業～收費的做法是不利於企業發展的。
exampleEn: Charging fees to enterprises under various pretexts is not conducive to business development.

explanation: 表示无可奈何，不得不如此。
explanationTraditional: 表示無可奈何，不得不如此。
explanationEn: To have no alternative; to be forced to do something against one's will.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第十八卷娘子不须挂怀，三载夫妻，恩情不浅，此去也是万不得已，一年半载，便得相逢也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第十八卷娘子不須掛懷，三載夫妻，恩情不淺，此去也是萬不得已，一年半載，便得相逢也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 18: 'Madam, do not worry. Our three years of marriage have deep affection. This departure is absolutely necessary; we will meet again in a year or so.'
example: 今门之事，出于～，并非有意为之。★清·李渔《比目鱼》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 今門之事，出於～，並非有意為之。★清·李漁《比目魚》第十五回
exampleEn: This matter was done out of absolute necessity, not intentionally. — Qing Dynasty Li Yu, 'The Fish and the Pearl', Chapter 15

explanation: 形容声音很大，耳朵都快震聋了。
explanationTraditional: 形容聲音很大，耳朵都快震聾了。
explanationEn: Deafening; so loud that it almost deafens the ears.
derivation: 沙汀《呼嚎》每座茶馆里都人声鼎沸，而超越这个，则是茶堂倌震耳欲聋的吆喝。”
derivationTraditional: 沙汀《呼嚎》每座茶館裡都人聲鼎沸，而超越這個，則是茶堂倌震耳欲聾的吆喝。”
derivationEn: From Sha Ting's 'Howl': 'Every teahouse was abuzz with noise, and above that, the deafening shouts of the tea waiters.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 昔过去。现在不是过去能比得上的。多指形势、自然面貌等发生了巨大的变化。
explanationTraditional: 昔過去。現在不是過去能比得上的。多指形勢、自然面貌等發生了巨大的變化。
explanationEn: The present is not like the past; things have changed greatly, often for the better.
derivation: 宋·李曾伯《贺新郎·自和前韵》词问讯南州守。怅吾生，今非昔比，后犹在否？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李曾伯《賀新郎·自和前韻》詞問訊南州守。悵吾生，今非昔比，後猶在否？”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Li Zengbo's 'Congratulations to the Groom: Self-Harmonizing Rhyme': 'I ask the prefect of Nanzhou. Sighing over my life, the present is not like the past, will I still be here later?'
example: 胜败军家常事”，何得为愧。～，不可欺敌。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第三十八回
exampleTraditional: 勝敗軍家常事”，何得為愧。～，不可欺敵。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第三十八回
exampleEn: 'Victory and defeat are common in military affairs,' why feel ashamed? The present is not like the past; we cannot underestimate the enemy. — Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 38

explanation: 拉拉拢；结组织。组织帮派，搞小集团活动。
explanationTraditional: 拉拉攏；結組織。組織幫派，搞小集團活動。
explanationEn: To form cliques or factions; to engage in factional activities.
derivation: 《人民日报》1983.2.20对于少数人在改革中抵制、怠工、失职渎职；乘机制造思想混乱，拉帮结派，进行非法组织活动……就要严肃处理。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1983.2.20對於少數人在改革中抵制、怠工、失職瀆職；乘機制造思想混亂，拉幫結派，進行非法組織活動……就要嚴肅處理。”
derivationEn: From People's Daily, 1983.2.20: 'For a few people who resist, slack off, neglect duty, or abuse power during reforms; who take the opportunity to create ideological confusion, form cliques, and engage in illegal organizational activities... they will be dealt with seriously.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有一点忧愁和顾虑。
explanationTraditional: 沒有一點憂愁和顧慮。
explanationEn: Free from worry and anxiety; carefree.
derivation: 元·郑廷玉《忍字记》第二折我做了个草庵中无忧无虑的僧家。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭廷玉《忍字記》第二折我做了個草菴中無憂無慮的僧家。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zheng Tingyu's play 'Ren Zi Ji', Act 2: 'I have become a carefree monk in a thatched hut.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 蹈顿足踏地。两手舞动，两只脚也跳了起来。形容高兴到了极点。也手乱舞、脚乱跳的狂态。
explanationTraditional: 蹈頓足踏地。兩手舞動，兩隻腳也跳了起來。形容高興到了極點。也手亂舞、腳亂跳的狂態。
explanationEn: To dance with joy; to be extremely happy; also describes wild gesticulations.
derivation: 《诗经·周南·关雎·序》永（咏）歌之不足，不知手之舞之，足之蹈之也。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周南·關雎·序》永（詠）歌之不足，不知手之舞之，足之蹈之也。”
derivationEn: From the preface to 'Guan Ju' in the Book of Songs: 'When singing is not enough, one unconsciously dances with hands and feet.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容再三催促。
explanationTraditional: 形容再三催促。
explanationEn: To call out repeatedly; to urge again and again.
derivation: 唐·白居易《琵琶行》诗千呼万唤始出来，犹抱琵琶半遮面。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《琵琶行》詩千呼萬喚始出來，猶抱琵琶半遮面。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi's poem 'Pipa Xing': 'After a thousand calls and ten thousand entreaties, she finally appears, still half hiding her face behind her pipa.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 各自选取自己所需要的。
explanationTraditional: 各自選取自己所需要的。
explanationEn: Each takes what they need.
derivation: 巴金《在尼斯》读者们不是一块铁板，他们有各人的看法，他们是‘各取所需’。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《在尼斯》讀者們不是一塊鐵板，他們有各人的看法，他們是‘各取所需’。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin's 'In Nice': 'Readers are not a monolithic block; they have their own views and 'take what they need'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 遥遥远远。远远地走在最前面。
explanationTraditional: 遙遙遠遠。遠遠地走在最前面。
explanationEn: To be far ahead; to lead by a wide margin.
derivation: 罗来勇《世界在他们眼前展开》我们的声誉就是实力--遥遥领先的技术和工艺。”
derivationTraditional: 羅來勇《世界在他們眼前展開》我們的聲譽就是實力--遙遙領先的技術和工藝。”
derivationEn: From Luo Laiyong's 'The World Unfolds Before Their Eyes': 'Our reputation is strength—technology and craftsmanship that are far ahead.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 音信消息，回信。没有一点消息。
explanationTraditional: 音信消息，回信。沒有一點消息。
explanationEn: Without any news or trace; completely unheard from.
derivation: 宋·黄孝迈《咏水仙》词惊鸿去后，轻抛素袜，杳无音信。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃孝邁《詠水仙》詞驚鴻去後，輕拋素襪，杳無音信。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Huang Xiaomai's poem 'Ode to Narcissus': 'After the startled swan departed, lightly discarding plain socks, there has been no news at all.'
example: 孔明一去东吴，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十五回
exampleTraditional: 孔明一去東吳，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十五回
exampleEn: After Kongming went to Eastern Wu, there was no news at all. — Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 45

explanation: 濡沾湿；沫唾沫。泉水干了，鱼吐沫互相润湿。比喻一同在困难的处境里，用微薄的力量互相帮助。
explanationTraditional: 濡沾溼；沫唾沫。泉水乾了，魚吐沫互相潤溼。比喻一同在困難的處境裡，用微薄的力量互相幫助。
explanationEn: To help each other in difficult times with limited resources; mutual aid in adversity.
derivation: 《庄子·大宗师》泉涸，鱼相与处于陆，相呴以湿，相濡以沫，不如相忘于江湖。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·大宗師》泉涸，魚相與處於陸，相呴以溼，相濡以沫，不如相忘於江湖。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi, 'Great Master': 'When the spring dries up, fish are left on dry land; they moisten each other with spit and wet each other with foam—better to forget each other in rivers and lakes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指先听进去的话或先获得的印象往往在头脑中占有主导地位，以后再遇到不同的意见时，就不容易接受。
explanationTraditional: 指先聽進去的話或先獲得的印象往往在頭腦中佔有主導地位，以後再遇到不同的意見時，就不容易接受。
explanationEn: First impressions are strongest; preconceived notions dominate and hinder acceptance of different opinions.
derivation: 《汉书·息夫躬传》唯陛下观览古今，反复参考，无以先入之语为主。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·息夫躬傳》唯陛下觀覽古今，反覆參考，無以先入之語為主。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han', Biography of Xifu Gong: 'I hope Your Majesty will observe ancient and modern examples, repeatedly consider, and not let first-heard words dominate.'
example: 见长幼尊卑之节有一定不易之理，～，故后起之私心，终有所顾忌而不敢逞。★清·阮葵生《茶余客话》卷七
exampleTraditional: 見長幼尊卑之節有一定不易之理，～，故後起之私心，終有所顧忌而不敢逞。★清·阮葵生《茶餘客話》卷七
exampleEn: Seeing that the hierarchy of seniority and respect has an unchangeable standard, first impressions dominate, so later selfish thoughts are ultimately restrained and dare not act rashly. — Qing Dynasty Ruan Kuisheng, 'Tea Leftover Talks', Volume 7

explanation: 有的横，有的竖，杂乱无章。形容纵横杂乱。
explanationTraditional: 有的橫，有的豎，雜亂無章。形容縱橫雜亂。
explanationEn: In disorderly arrangement; scattered in all directions; messy.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第三十四回一片瓦砾场上，横七竖八，杀死的男子妇人，不计其数。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第三十四回一片瓦礫場上，橫七豎八，殺死的男子婦人，不計其數。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 34: 'On a piece of rubble field, men and women were killed, lying in disorder, countless in number.'
example: 床下～有几双花鞋。★曹禺《日出》第三幕
exampleTraditional: 床下～有幾雙花鞋。★曹禺《日出》第三幕
exampleEn: Under the bed were several pairs of embroidered shoes lying in disorder. — Cao Yu, 'Sunrise', Act 3

explanation: 疾首头痛。形容痛恨到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 疾首頭痛。形容痛恨到了極點。
explanationEn: To hate deeply or feel extreme regret and resentment.
derivation: 《左传·成公十三年》诸侯备闻此言，斯是用痛心疾首，匿就寡人。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公十三年》諸侯備聞此言，斯是用痛心疾首，匿就寡人。”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan: The 13th Year of Duke Cheng: 'The feudal lords heard these words, and thus felt deep pain and hatred, hiding from me.'
example: 瞿耐庵自从到任至今也有半年了。治下的百姓因他听断糊涂，一个个～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 瞿耐庵自從到任至今也有半年了。治下的百姓因他聽斷糊塗，一個個～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十二回
exampleEn: Qu Nai'an had been in office for half a year. The people under his rule, due to his confused judgments, all felt deep pain and hatred. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' (Chapter 42)

explanation: 可以有，也可以没有。指有没有都无关紧要。
explanationTraditional: 可以有，也可以沒有。指有沒有都無關緊要。
explanationEn: Optional; not essential; may or may not be needed.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十回因此把一切都看成浊物，可有可无。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十回因此把一切都看成濁物，可有可無。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (Chapter 20): 'Therefore, he regarded everything as worthless, optional.'
example: 她活了五十年，第一次感觉到自己还不是一个～的人。★茹志娟《如愿》
exampleTraditional: 她活了五十年，第一次感覺到自己還不是一個～的人。★茹志娟《如願》
exampleEn: At fifty, she felt for the first time that she was not an optional person. — Ru Zhijuan, 'As Desired'

explanation: 形容雄壮的队伍或浩大的声势。
explanationTraditional: 形容雄壯的隊伍或浩大的聲勢。
explanationEn: A mighty army or a great force; a vast and powerful multitude.
derivation: 《南史·陈庆之传》名军大将莫自牢，千兵万马避白袍。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·陳慶之傳》名軍大將莫自牢，千兵萬馬避白袍。”
derivationEn: History of the Southern Dynasties: Biography of Chen Qingzhi: 'Famous generals and great armies should not be complacent; a thousand soldiers and ten thousand horses avoid the white robe.'
example: 各方面竟如～地围困拢来，实在说，我是有被这班箭手底乱箭所射死的可能性的。★柔石《二月》二四
exampleTraditional: 各方面竟如～地圍困攏來，實在說，我是有被這班箭手底亂箭所射死的可能性的。★柔石《二月》二四
exampleEn: All sides surrounded me like a thousand troops and ten thousand horses; frankly, I might be shot dead by these archers' arrows. — Rou Shi, 'February' (Chapter 24)

explanation: 把一个整体分成许多零散部分。
explanationTraditional: 把一個整體分成許多零散部分。
explanationEn: To break up the whole into parts; to disperse a concentrated force.
derivation: 毛泽东《抗日游击战争的战略问题》一般地说来，游击队当分散使用，即所谓‘化整为零’。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《抗日遊擊戰爭的戰略問題》一般地說來，游擊隊當分散使用，即所謂‘化整為零’。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'Strategic Problems of the Anti-Japanese Guerrilla War': 'Generally speaking, guerrillas should be used dispersedly, that is, the so-called 'breaking up the whole into parts'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 阳表面上；奉遵守，听从；阴暗地里。指玩弄两面派手法，表面上遵从，暗地里违背。
explanationTraditional: 陽表面上；奉遵守，聽從；陰暗地裡。指玩弄兩面派手法，表面上遵從，暗地裡違背。
explanationEn: To comply in public but oppose in private; to feign obedience while acting contrary.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十七回亦曾当面劝过他，无如卜知府阳奉阴违，也就奈何他不得。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十七回亦曾當面勸過他，無如卜知府陽奉陰違，也就奈何他不得。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' (Chapter 47): 'He had also advised him face to face, but Prefect Bu complied in public and opposed in private, so nothing could be done.'
example: 我们说话、做事都应老老实实，不要～。
exampleTraditional: 我們說話、做事都應老老實實，不要～。
exampleEn: We should be honest in words and deeds, and not comply in public but oppose in private.

explanation: 沉默不出声；寡少。不声不响，很少说话。
explanationTraditional: 沉默不出聲；寡少。不聲不響，很少說話。
explanationEn: Quiet and reserved; taciturn; speaking little.
derivation: 《旧唐书·梁崇义传》梁崇义，长安人，以升斗给于市，有臀力，能卷金舒钩◇为羽林射生，从来瑱于襄阳，沉默寡言，众悦之，累迁为偏裨。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·梁崇義傳》梁崇義，長安人，以升斗給於市，有臀力，能卷金舒鉤◇為羽林射生，從來瑱於襄陽，沉默寡言，眾悅之，累遷為偏裨。”
derivationEn: Old Book of Tang: Biography of Liang Chongyi: 'Liang Chongyi, a native of Chang'an, sold goods in the market, had great strength, could roll gold and straighten hooks. He was a feather-forest archer, followed Lai Tian to Xiangyang, was taciturn, and everyone liked him.'
example: ～，深沉不露，令我忆君之丰采。★陈毅《哭叶军长希夷同志》诗
exampleTraditional: ～，深沉不露，令我憶君之丰采。★陳毅《哭葉軍長希夷同志》詩
exampleEn: Taciturn and reserved, not revealing depth, I recall your demeanor. — Chen Yi, 'Mourning General Ye Ting'

explanation: 形容竞赛激烈，大家都不甘落后。
explanationTraditional: 形容競賽激烈，大家都不甘落後。
explanationEn: To vie with each other; to compete fiercely, each trying to outdo the other.
derivation: 《新华半月刊》1960年第14期我们正处在一个你追我赶、飞跃向前的建设热潮中。”
derivationTraditional: 《新華半月刊》1960年第14期我們正處在一個你追我趕、飛躍向前的建設熱潮中。”
derivationEn: Xinhua Semimonthly, Issue 14, 1960: 'We are in a construction boom where everyone is vying with each other and leaping forward.'
example: 他们～，捷报频传。
exampleTraditional: 他們～，捷報頻傳。
exampleEn: They vied with each other, and good news came frequently.

explanation: 顺手把人家的羊牵走。比喻趁势将敌手捉住或乘机利用别人。现比喻乘机拿走别人的东西。
explanationTraditional: 順手把人家的羊牽走。比喻趁勢將敵手捉住或乘機利用別人。現比喻乘機拿走別人的東西。
explanationEn: To take something that does not belong to one when the opportunity arises; to walk off with something.
derivation: 《礼记·曲礼上》效马效羊者右牵之。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·曲禮上》效馬效羊者右牽之。”
derivationEn: Book of Rites: Qu Li I: 'When presenting a horse or a sheep, lead it with the right hand.'
example: 据说座山雕的部下有个～的老方子，一撮毛可能是想施展这个伎俩。★曲波《林海雪原》十二
exampleTraditional: 據說座山雕的部下有個～的老方子，一撮毛可能是想施展這個伎倆。★曲波《林海雪原》十二
exampleEn: It is said that one of Zuo Shandiao's men had an old trick of 'leading away a goat in passing', and Yi Cuo Mao might be trying to use this tactic. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest' (Chapter 12)

explanation: 佳好；境境地。原指甘蔗下端比上端甜，从上到下，越吃越甜◇比喻境况逐渐好转或兴趣逐渐浓厚。
explanationTraditional: 佳好；境境地。原指甘蔗下端比上端甜，從上到下，越吃越甜◇比喻境況逐漸好轉或興趣逐漸濃厚。
explanationEn: To gradually enter a better state; to become more enjoyable or improve step by step.
derivation: 《晋书·顾恺之传》恺之每食甘遮，恒自尾至本，人或怪之。云‘渐入佳境。’”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·顧愷之傳》愷之每食甘遮，恆自尾至本，人或怪之。雲‘漸入佳境。’”
derivationEn: Book of Jin: Biography of Gu Kaizhi: 'Whenever Kaizhi ate sugarcane, he always started from the tail to the root. People found it strange, and he said, 'Gradually entering a better state.'''
example: 行过了许多亭阁，真是个～。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第八十二回
exampleTraditional: 行過了許多亭閣，真是個～。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第八十二回
exampleEn: After passing many pavilions, it truly was a gradual entry into a better state. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West' (Chapter 82)

explanation: 听、任随，任凭；之代词，代人或事物。任凭事物存在发展而不去过问。
explanationTraditional: 聽、任隨，任憑；之代詞，代人或事物。任憑事物存在發展而不去過問。
explanationEn: To let things take their own course; to allow something to happen without interference.
derivation: 毛泽东《反对自由主义》见损害群众利益的行为不愤恨，不劝告，不制止，不解释，听之任之。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《反對自由主義》見損害群眾利益的行為不憤恨，不勸告，不制止，不解釋，聽之任之。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'Oppose Liberalism': 'When actions harmful to the masses are seen, one does not feel indignant, does not advise, does not stop, does not explain, but lets things take their own course.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 束手自缚其手，比喻不想方设法；就受；擒活捉。捆起手来让人捉住。指毫不抵抗，乖乖地让人捉住。
explanationTraditional: 束手自縛其手，比喻不想方設法；就受；擒活捉。捆起手來讓人捉住。指毫不抵抗，乖乖地讓人捉住。
explanationEn: To have one's hands tied and be captured; to submit without resistance.
derivation: 《宋史·苻彦卿传》与其束手就擒，曷若死战，然未必死。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·苻彥卿傳》與其束手就擒，曷若死戰，然未必死。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Fu Yanqing': 'Rather than be captured with hands tied, it is better to fight to the death, though death may not be certain.'
example: 宁王闹了两年，不想被新建伯王守仁一阵杀败，～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第八回
exampleTraditional: 寧王鬧了兩年，不想被新建伯王守仁一陣殺敗，～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第八回
exampleEn: The Prince of Ning had been causing trouble for two years, but unexpectedly was defeated by the newly appointed Wang Shouren and was captured without resistance. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 8

explanation: 旁；另外的；骛追求。心思没有另外的追求，形容心思集中，专心致志。
explanationTraditional: 旁；另外的；騖追求。心思沒有另外的追求，形容心思集中，專心致志。
explanationEn: To have no other distractions; to concentrate wholeheartedly.
derivation: 冰心《谈信纸信封》有不少人像我一样，在写信的时候，喜欢在一张白纸，或者只带着道道的纸上，不受拘束地，心无旁骛地抒写下去的。”
derivationTraditional: 冰心《談信紙信封》有不少人像我一樣，在寫信的時候，喜歡在一張白紙，或者只帶著道道的紙上，不受拘束地，心無旁騖地抒寫下去的。”
derivationEn: From Bing Xin's 'On Letter Paper and Envelopes': 'Many people, like me, when writing letters, like to write freely on a blank or lined paper, without distractions, pouring out their hearts.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有一点消息。见杳无音信”。
explanationTraditional: 沒有一點消息。見杳無音信”。
explanationEn: Without any news or information; completely unheard from.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 万一意外变化。用以防备难以预料的事情。
explanationTraditional: 萬一意外變化。用以防備難以預料的事情。
explanationEn: To be prepared for any contingency; just in case.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们要提高警惕，以防万一敌人来偷袭。
exampleTraditional: 我們要提高警惕，以防萬一敵人來偷襲。
exampleEn: We must heighten our vigilance to guard against a surprise attack by the enemy.

explanation: 聩天生耳聋，引伸为不明事理。声音很大，使耳聋的人也听得见。比喻用语言文字唤醒糊涂麻木的人，使他们清醒过来。
explanationTraditional: 聵天生耳聾，引伸為不明事理。聲音很大，使耳聾的人也聽得見。比喻用語言文字喚醒糊塗麻木的人，使他們清醒過來。
explanationEn: To make the deaf hear; to awaken the ignorant or confused with words.
derivation: 清·袁枚《随园诗话补遗》卷一此数言，振聋发聩，想当时必有迂儒曲士以经学谈诗者。”
derivationTraditional: 清·袁枚《隨園詩話補遺》卷一此數言，振聾發聵，想當時必有迂儒曲士以經學談詩者。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Yuan Mei's 'Random Notes on Poetry, Supplement, Volume 1': 'These words are so powerful that they make the deaf hear; there must have been pedantic scholars who discussed poetry with classical learning at that time.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 按情理，有可原谅的地方。
explanationTraditional: 按情理，有可原諒的地方。
explanationEn: To be excusable under the circumstances; understandable.
derivation: 《后汉书·霍胥传》光之所至，情既可原，而守阙连年，终不见理。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·霍胥傳》光之所至，情既可原，而守闕連年，終不見理。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Huo Xu': 'What Guang did is understandable in terms of circumstances, yet he has been waiting at the palace gate for years without being heard.'
example: 他既不是存心去参加，似乎～。★叶圣陶《一个练习生》
exampleTraditional: 他既不是存心去參加，似乎～。★葉聖陶《一個練習生》
exampleEn: Since he didn't intend to participate, it seems excusable. — Ye Shengtao, 'A Trainee'

explanation: 尽全部用出。用全部的力量去做。
explanationTraditional: 盡全部用出。用全部的力量去做。
explanationEn: To do one's utmost; to try one's best.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》以若所为求若所欲，尽心力而为之，后必有灾。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》以若所為求若所欲，盡心力而為之，後必有災。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: King Hui of Liang I': 'To do with all one's heart and strength what one seeks, there will inevitably be disaster.'
example: 但我看得目下决难挽回，丞相可去～。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第八回
exampleTraditional: 但我看得目下決難挽回，丞相可去～。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第八回
exampleEn: But I see it's hard to reverse the situation now; you, Prime Minister, can go and do your best. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'A Tale of Pain', Chapter 8

explanation: 指用不正当的手段谋取私利。也指靠小聪明占便宜。
explanationTraditional: 指用不正當的手段謀取私利。也指靠小聰明佔便宜。
explanationEn: To seek personal gain by dishonest means; to take advantage of loopholes.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 学习要勤奋刻苦，踏踏实实，不能靠投机取巧取得成功。
exampleTraditional: 學習要勤奮刻苦，踏踏實實，不能靠投機取巧取得成功。
exampleEn: Learning requires diligence and down-to-earth effort; one cannot succeed by cutting corners.

explanation: 指拿小题目作大文章。比喻不恰当地把小事当作大事来处理，有故意夸张的意思。
explanationTraditional: 指拿小題目作大文章。比喻不恰當地把小事當作大事來處理，有故意誇張的意思。
explanationEn: To make a big fuss over a small matter; to exaggerate.
derivation: 清·方东树《昭昧詹言》卷二十［山谷诗《云涛石》］全是以实形虚，小题大做，极远大之势可谓奇想高妙。”
derivationTraditional: 清·方東樹《昭昧詹言》卷二十［山谷詩《雲濤石》］全是以實形虛，小題大做，極遠大之勢可謂奇想高妙。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Fang Dongshu's 'Zhaomei Jian Yan, Volume 20': '[Huang Tingjian's poem 'Cloud Stone'] uses the concrete to depict the abstract, making a big issue out of a small topic, creating a grand momentum—truly a wonderful idea.'
example: 他用了多少本钱，费了多少手脚，只骗得七千银子，未免～了。★清·吴研人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: 他用了多少本錢，費了多少手腳，只騙得七千銀子，未免～了。★清·吳研人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第六十三回
exampleEn: He spent so much capital and effort to swindle only seven thousand silver taels; it's really making a mountain out of a molehill. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 63

explanation: 不屑不值得，不愿意；顾看。认为不值得一看。形容极端轻视。
explanationTraditional: 不屑不值得，不願意；顧看。認為不值得一看。形容極端輕視。
explanationEn: To not deign to look at; to regard as beneath one's notice.
derivation: 明·方孝儒《送龚彦佐序》夫禄之以天下而系马千驷，常人思以其身易之而不可得，而伊尹不屑一顾视焉。”
derivationTraditional: 明·方孝儒《送龔彥佐序》夫祿之以天下而繫馬千駟，常人思以其身易之而不可得，而伊尹不屑一顧視焉。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Fang Xiaoru's 'Preface to Seeing Off Gong Yanzu': 'Even if offered the world and a thousand teams of horses, ordinary people would want to exchange themselves for it but cannot, yet Yi Yin did not deign to give it a glance.'
example: 我的眼光是一直线，只看前面的，两旁和后方，悍都然～了。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 我的眼光是一直線，只看前面的，兩旁和後方，悍都然～了。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十八回
exampleEn: My gaze is a straight line, only looking ahead; I disdain to glance at the sides and rear. — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower of the Sea of Sins', Chapter 28

explanation: 原指订立法律与人民相约遵守◇泛指订立简单的条款。
explanationTraditional: 原指訂立法律與人民相約遵守◇泛指訂立簡單的條款。
explanationEn: Originally referred to establishing laws and making an agreement with the people to abide by them; later generally refers to making simple rules or agreements.
derivation: 《史记·高祖本纪》与父老约，法三章耳；杀人者死，伤人及盗抵罪。”《汉书·刑法志》高祖初入关，约法三章。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·高祖本紀》與父老約，法三章耳；殺人者死，傷人及盜抵罪。”《漢書·刑法志》高祖初入關，約法三章。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Basic Annals of Gaozu': 'Made an agreement with the elders, three chapters of law: those who kill shall die, those who injure others or steal shall be punished accordingly.' Also from 'Book of Han: Treatise on Penal Law': 'When Gaozu first entered the pass, he made three chapters of law.'
example: 我们很郑重地和工头～，什么时候交稿，什么时候看校，什么时候拼版。★邹韬奋《经历·种种尴尬》
exampleTraditional: 我們很鄭重地和工頭～，什麼時候交稿，什麼時候看校，什麼時候拼版。★鄒韜奮《經歷·種種尷尬》
exampleEn: We solemnly made a three-point agreement with the foreman: when to submit the manuscript, when to proofread, and when to lay out the pages. — Zou Taofen, 'Experiences: Various Embarrassments'

explanation: 圆圆满，周全。指说话的人能使自己的论点或谎话没有漏洞。
explanationTraditional: 圓圓滿，周全。指說話的人能使自己的論點或謊話沒有漏洞。
explanationEn: To make one's argument or lie consistent and without loopholes.
derivation: 清·方玉润《星烈日记》七十以世俗之情遇意外之事，实难自圆其说。”
derivationTraditional: 清·方玉潤《星烈日記》七十以世俗之情遇意外之事，實難自圓其說。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Fang Yurun's 'Xinglie Diary' vol. 70: 'With worldly feelings encountering unexpected events, it is truly difficult to justify oneself.'
example: 哈哈，单于殿下，你自己都不能～了吧。★曹禺《王昭君》第五幕
exampleTraditional: 哈哈，單于殿下，你自己都不能～了吧。★曹禺《王昭君》第五幕
exampleEn: Haha, Your Majesty the Chanyu, you yourself cannot justify your words. — Cao Yu, 'Wang Zhaojun', Act 5

explanation: 每个人都能充分发挥自己的才能。
explanationTraditional: 每個人都能充分發揮自己的才能。
explanationEn: Everyone can fully utilize their talents.
derivation: 《淮南子·兵略训》若乃人尽其才，悉用其力。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·兵略訓》若乃人盡其才，悉用其力。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi: Military Strategy': 'If each person fully uses their talent and all exert their strength.'
example: 如果能够～，物尽其用，我们的国家就会发展得更快。
exampleTraditional: 如果能夠～，物盡其用，我們的國家就會發展得更快。
exampleEn: If we can make the best use of everyone's talents and resources, our country will develop faster.

explanation: 走的欢送，来的欢迎。形容忙于交际应酬。
explanationTraditional: 走的歡送，來的歡迎。形容忙於交際應酬。
explanationEn: Welcoming those who come and seeing off those who leave; describes being busy with social engagements.
derivation: 《庄子·山木》其送往而迎来，来者勿禁，往者勿止。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·山木》其送往而迎來，來者勿禁，往者勿止。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Mountain Tree': 'Seeing off those who leave and welcoming those who come, not forbidding those who come, not stopping those who go.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①指富有财产，气派不凡。②指仗着钱财多而气势凌人。
explanationTraditional: ①指富有財產，氣派不凡。②指仗著錢財多而氣勢凌人。
explanationEn: 1. Having great wealth and an imposing manner. 2. Being arrogant because of one's wealth.
derivation: 刘绍棠《小荷才露尖尖角》五花婶子的这项收入十分可观。财大气粗，盖起这座青堂瓦舍的大宅院。”
derivationTraditional: 劉紹棠《小荷才露尖尖角》五花嬸子的這項收入十分可觀。財大氣粗，蓋起這座青堂瓦舍的大宅院。”
derivationEn: From Liu Shaotang's 'Little Lotus Just Shows Its Point': 'Aunt Wuhua's income from this business was considerable. With wealth and arrogance, she built this large mansion with green tiles.'
example: 那时他～，大进大出。★张周《步履艰难的中国》第二章
exampleTraditional: 那時他～，大進大出。★張周《步履艱難的中國》第二章
exampleEn: At that time, he was wealthy and arrogant, making big deals. — Zhang Zhou, 'China's Difficult Journey', Chapter 2

explanation: 从容舒缓，悠然。不慌不忙地应付答对。
explanationTraditional: 從容舒緩，悠然。不慌不忙地應付答對。
explanationEn: To respond calmly and unhurriedly.
derivation: 明·李贽《焚书·杂述·豫约》有问乃答，不问即默，安闲自在，从容应答，不敢慢之，不可敬之。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《焚書·雜述·豫約》有問乃答，不問即默，安閒自在，從容應答，不敢慢之，不可敬之。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Li Zhi's 'A Book to Burn: Miscellaneous: Covenant': 'Answer when asked, be silent when not asked, be at ease and leisurely, respond calmly, not daring to be slow, nor too respectful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 逐追随。随着波浪起伏，跟着流水漂荡。比喻没有坚定的立场，缺乏判断是非的能力，只能随着别人走。
explanationTraditional: 逐追隨。隨著波浪起伏，跟著流水漂盪。比喻沒有堅定的立場，缺乏判斷是非的能力，只能隨著別人走。
explanationEn: To drift with the current; metaphorically, to lack firm principles and follow others without independent judgment.
derivation: 《史记·屈原贾生列传》夫圣人者，不凝滞于物而能与世推移。举世混浊，何不随其流而扬其波？”《五灯会元》看风使舵，正是随波逐流。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·屈原賈生列傳》夫聖人者，不凝滯於物而能與世推移。舉世混濁，何不隨其流而揚其波？”《五燈會元》看風使舵，正是隨波逐流。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Qu Yuan and Jia Yi': 'A sage does not cling to things but adapts to the times. If the whole world is muddy, why not stir the waves and follow the current?' Also from 'Five Lamps Meeting the Source': 'To trim one's sails is precisely to drift with the current.'
example: 你心胸开阔，气度那么从容！你不～，也不故步自封。★郭沫若《屈原》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 你心胸開闊，氣度那麼從容！你不～，也不故步自封。★郭沫若《屈原》第一幕
exampleEn: You are broad-minded and so calm! You neither drift with the current nor stand still. — Guo Moruo, 'Qu Yuan', Act 1

explanation: 希望自己的子女能在学业和事业上有成就。
explanationTraditional: 希望自己的子女能在學業和事業上有成就。
explanationEn: To hope that one's children will achieve success in academics and career.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 家长要有望子成龙的愿望，更要有培养和教育孩子成材的行动。
exampleTraditional: 家長要有望子成龍的願望，更要有培養和教育孩子成材的行動。
exampleEn: Parents should have the desire for their children to succeed, but also the actions to cultivate and educate them.

explanation: 比喻无关紧要的琐碎事情。
explanationTraditional: 比喻無關緊要的瑣碎事情。
explanationEn: Metaphor for trivial and unimportant matters.
derivation: 孙犁《石猴——平分杂记》他们是为了报答你的恩情，才送给你；你倒说是鸡毛蒜皮。”
derivationTraditional: 孫犁《石猴——平分雜記》他們是為了報答你的恩情，才送給你；你倒說是雞毛蒜皮。”
derivationEn: From Sun Li's 'Stone Monkey: Notes on Equal Distribution': 'They gave it to you to repay your kindness, but you call it chicken feathers and garlic skins.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 肃然恭敬的样子；起敬产生敬佩的心情。形容产生严肃敬仰的感情。
explanationTraditional: 肅然恭敬的樣子；起敬產生敬佩的心情。形容產生嚴肅敬仰的感情。
explanationEn: To feel deep respect and admiration; to be filled with reverence.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·规箴》弟子中或有惰者，远公曰；‘桑榆之光，理无远照，但原朝阳之晖，与时并明耳。’执经登坐，讽诵朗暢，词色甚苦。高足之徒，皆肃然增敬。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·規箴》弟子中或有惰者，遠公曰；‘桑榆之光，理無遠照，但原朝陽之暉，與時並明耳。’執經登坐，諷誦朗暢，詞色甚苦。高足之徒，皆肅然增敬。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Admonitions': 'When some disciples were lazy, Master Huiyuan said: 'The light of the setting sun cannot shine far, but I hope the morning sun's radiance shines bright with time.' He then took the scriptures, sat down, and recited clearly and earnestly. The senior disciples all felt increased respect.'
example: 衍举眼观看仲连，神清骨爽，飘飘乎有神仙之度，不觉～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第一百回
exampleTraditional: 衍舉眼觀看仲連，神清骨爽，飄飄乎有神仙之度，不覺～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第一百回
exampleEn: Yan Ju looked at Zhong Lian, who had a clear spirit and elegant demeanor, ethereal like an immortal, and couldn't help feeling deep respect. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 100

explanation: 公平合理的买卖。
explanationTraditional: 公平合理的買賣。
explanationEn: Fair and reasonable transaction.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第68回公平交易，又不化他，又不抢他，何罪之有！”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第68回公平交易，又不化他，又不搶他，何罪之有！”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 68: 'Fair trade, neither begging nor robbing, what crime is there?'
example: 我们需要市场的～，才能保证市场繁荣。
exampleTraditional: 我們需要市場的～，才能保證市場繁榮。
exampleEn: We need fair trade in the market to ensure prosperity.

explanation: 高阁储藏器物的高架。捆起来以后放在高高的架子上。比喻放着不用。
explanationTraditional: 高閣儲藏器物的高架。捆起來以後放在高高的架子上。比喻放著不用。
explanationEn: To tie something up and put it on a high shelf; to shelve something and not use it.
derivation: 《晋书·庾翼传》此辈宜束之高阁，俟天下太平，然后议其任耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·庾翼傳》此輩宜束之高閣，俟天下太平，然後議其任耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Yu Yi': 'Such people should be shelved until the world is at peace, then consider their appointment.'
example: 如果有了正确的理论，只是把它空谈一阵，～，并不实行，那末，这种理论再好也是没有意义的。★毛泽东《实践论》
exampleTraditional: 如果有了正確的理論，只是把它空談一陣，～，並不實行，那末，這種理論再好也是沒有意義的。★毛澤東《實踐論》
exampleEn: If one has correct theory but only talks about it and shelves it without practice, then no matter how good the theory, it is meaningless. — Mao Zedong, 'On Practice'

explanation: 原意是说，因为有人吃饭噎死了，就想让天下人都不吃饭，这太荒谬了。比喻要做的事情由于出了点小毛病或怕出问题就索性不去干。
explanationTraditional: 原意是說，因為有人吃飯噎死了，就想讓天下人都不吃飯，這太荒謬了。比喻要做的事情由於出了點小毛病或怕出問題就索性不去幹。
explanationEn: To stop eating for fear of choking; to refrain from doing something necessary because of a minor risk.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·荡兵》夫有以噎死者，欲禁天下之食，悖。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·蕩兵》夫有以噎死者，欲禁天下之食，悖。”
derivationEn: From 'Lüshi Chunqiu: Dang Bing': 'If someone chokes to death, to forbid all eating is absurd.'
example: 若是后人不问来由，一律的奉以为法，岂不～了么？★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 若是後人不問來由，一律的奉以為法，豈不～了麼？★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第二十一回
exampleEn: If later generations blindly follow the same rule without understanding the reason, wouldn't that be stopping eating for fear of choking? — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 21

explanation: 常规沿袭下来的规矩。打破了一般的规矩或一向实行的规章制度。
explanationTraditional: 常規沿襲下來的規矩。打破了一般的規矩或一向實行的規章制度。
explanationEn: To break the routine; to break away from established rules or practices.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他此举就是想打破常规去实现他的梦想。
exampleTraditional: 他此舉就是想打破常規去實現他的夢想。
exampleEn: His move was to break the routine and realize his dream.

explanation: 另外重支炉灶。比喻放弃原来的，另外从头做起。
explanationTraditional: 另外重支爐灶。比喻放棄原來的，另外從頭做起。
explanationEn: To set up a new stove; to start all over again from scratch.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十四回必至闹到‘出而哇之’，饭粪莫辨，这才‘另起炉灶’。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十四回必至鬧到‘出而哇之’，飯糞莫辨，這才‘另起爐灶’。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 14: 'It will inevitably lead to vomiting, unable to distinguish food from filth, then start anew.'
example: 第二师范解散，要～重新招生，重新招聘教职员。★梁斌《红旗谱》五十
exampleTraditional: 第二師範解散，要～重新招生，重新招聘教職員。★梁斌《紅旗譜》五十
exampleEn: The Second Normal School was disbanded, and they had to start over, recruiting new students and staff. — Liang Bin, 'Red Flag'

explanation: 指人的日常生活。
explanationTraditional: 指人的日常生活。
explanationEn: Daily life; eating, drinking, and daily activities.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 各方面都能照顾到，没有遗漏疏忽。也指虽然照顾到各方面，但一般化。
explanationTraditional: 各方面都能照顧到，沒有遺漏疏忽。也指雖然照顧到各方面，但一般化。
explanationEn: To attend to every aspect; to be comprehensive and thorough.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十七回这位单道台办事一向是面面俱到，不肯落一点褒贬的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十七回這位單道臺辦事一向是面面俱到，不肯落一點褒貶的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'Officialdom Exposed', Chapter 57: 'This Magistrate Shan always handles matters comprehensively, never leaving any room for criticism.'
example: 宾馆服务周全，衣食住行～，令客人非常满意。
exampleTraditional: 賓館服務周全，衣食住行～，令客人非常滿意。
exampleEn: The hotel service is comprehensive, covering all aspects of daily needs, making guests very satisfied.

explanation: 青田时的青苗；黄成熟的谷物。旧粮已经吃完，新粮尚未接上。也比喻人才或物力前后接不上。
explanationTraditional: 青田時的青苗；黃成熟的穀物。舊糧已經吃完，新糧尚未接上。也比喻人才或物力前後接不上。
explanationEn: When the new crop is not yet ripe and the old is exhausted; a temporary shortage or gap in resources.
derivation: 《元典章·户部·仓库》即日正是青黄不接之际，各处物斛涌贵。”
derivationTraditional: 《元典章·戶部·倉庫》即日正是青黃不接之際，各處物斛湧貴。”
derivationEn: From 'Yuan Dianzhang: Hubu: Cangku': 'It is exactly the time when the old crop is exhausted and the new not yet ripe, and grain prices are soaring.'
example: 总算安然改业，否则也许还有一段～的失业时期。★邹韬奋《经历·英文教员》
exampleTraditional: 總算安然改業，否則也許還有一段～的失業時期。★鄒韜奮《經歷·英文教員》
exampleEn: Fortunately, I managed to change careers smoothly; otherwise, there might have been a period of unemployment between jobs. — Zou Taofen, 'Experience: English Teacher'

explanation: 形容极远的地方，或相隔极远。
explanationTraditional: 形容極遠的地方，或相隔極遠。
explanationEn: The ends of the earth; faraway places or great distances apart.
derivation: 南朝陈·徐陵《武皇帝作相时与岭南酋豪书》天涯藐藐，地角悠悠了，阴谋诡计　面无由，但以情企。”宋·张世南《游宦记闻》卷六今之远宦及远服贾者，皆曰天涯海角。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝陳·徐陵《武皇帝作相時與嶺南酋豪書》天涯藐藐，地角悠悠了，陰謀詭計　面無由，但以情企。”宋·張世南《遊宦記聞》卷六今之遠宦及遠服賈者，皆曰天涯海角。”
derivationEn: From Southern Chen Dynasty Xu Ling's 'Letter to the Chieftains of Lingnan': 'The sky is vast, the earth distant, but with heartfelt longing.' Song Dynasty Zhang Shinan's 'Youhuan Jiwen': 'Today, those who travel far for official or trade purposes all say they go to the ends of the earth.'
example: 我们俱系～之人，今幸得贤主人相邀一聚，也是三生之缘。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: 我們俱系～之人，今幸得賢主人相邀一聚，也是三生之緣。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回
exampleEn: We are all people from faraway places; it is our fortune to be invited by our gracious host to gather here. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 46

explanation: 伦次条理。话讲得乱七八糟，毫无次序。
explanationTraditional: 倫次條理。話講得亂七八糟，毫無次序。
explanationEn: To speak incoherently; to talk in a confused and illogical manner.
derivation: 宋·胡仔《苕溪渔隐丛话前集》卷七引《诗眼》古人律诗，亦是一片文章，语或似无伦次，而意若贯珠。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·胡仔《苕溪漁隱叢話前集》卷七引《詩眼》古人律詩，亦是一片文章，語或似無倫次，而意若貫珠。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Hu Zi's 'Tiaoxi Yuyinconghua' quoting 'Shiyan': 'Ancient regulated verses are also a piece of writing; the words may seem incoherent, but the meaning is like a string of pearls.'
example: 他～地向周围的人诉说自己的遭遇。
exampleTraditional: 他～地向周圍的人訴說自己的遭遇。
exampleEn: He spoke incoherently to those around him about his experiences.

explanation: 箭已搭在弦上。比喻为形势所迫，不得不采取某种行动。
explanationTraditional: 箭已搭在弦上。比喻為形勢所迫，不得不採取某種行動。
explanationEn: An arrow is on the bowstring. Metaphorically, it means that circumstances force one to take action.
derivation: 三国·魏·陈琳《为袁绍檄豫州》注引《魏志》矢在弦上，不可不发。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·陳琳《為袁紹檄豫州》注引《魏志》矢在弦上，不可不發。”
derivationEn: From Chen Lin's 'Proclamation to Yuzhou' in the Three Kingdoms period, annotated with 'The arrow is on the string, it cannot be left unfired.'
example: 我觉得以文字结怨于小人，是不值得的。至于我，其实乃是～。★《鲁迅书信集·致杨霁云》
exampleTraditional: 我覺得以文字結怨於小人，是不值得的。至於我，其實乃是～。★《魯迅書信集·致楊霽雲》
exampleEn: I think it's not worth making enemies with petty people through writing. As for me, it's actually like an arrow on the bowstring. — from Lu Xun's 'Letters to Yang Jiyun'

explanation: 指诵读诗文时的声音响亮而顺口。
explanationTraditional: 指誦讀詩文時的聲音響亮而順口。
explanationEn: Describes reading or reciting poetry or prose with a clear and smooth voice.
derivation: 老舍《诗与快板》散文就不受这么多的限制，虽然散文也讲究声调铿锵，能朗朗上口。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《詩與快板》散文就不受這麼多的限制，雖然散文也講究聲調鏗鏘，能朗朗上口。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Poetry and Quick Rhymes': 'Prose is not so restricted, although it also emphasizes sonorous tones and smooth recitation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 舍去近处的，追求远处的。形容做事走弯路。
explanationTraditional: 捨去近處的，追求遠處的。形容做事走彎路。
explanationEn: To give up what is near and seek what is far. Describes taking a roundabout way or doing things inefficiently.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄上》道在迩而求诸远。”《后汉书·臧宫传》舍近谋远者，劳而无功；舍远谋近者，逸而有终。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁上》道在邇而求諸遠。”《後漢書·臧宮傳》捨近謀遠者，勞而無功；舍遠謀近者，逸而有終。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'The Way is near, yet people seek it afar.' And from 'Book of the Later Han': 'Seeking far while neglecting near leads to toil without merit.'
example: 可见咱们天天是～。现有这样诗人在此，却天天去纸上谈兵。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第七十六回
exampleTraditional: 可見咱們天天是～。現有這樣詩人在此，卻天天去紙上談兵。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第七十六回
exampleEn: It seems we are always seeking far while neglecting near. With such a poet here, we talk about war on paper every day. — from Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 76

explanation: 身自身。把自己放在事情之外，毫不关心。
explanationTraditional: 身自身。把自己放在事情之外，毫不關心。
explanationEn: To place oneself outside the matter; to remain indifferent or uninvolved.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第三十五回这彭仲翔却在背后袖手旁观，置身事外。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第三十五回這彭仲翔卻在背後袖手旁觀，置身事外。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 35: 'Peng Zhongxiang stood by with folded arms, placing himself outside the matter.'
example: 悲观的由来，是在～不辩是非，而偏要关心于文坛，或者竟是自己坐在没落的营盘里。★鲁迅《准风月谈·中国文坛的悲观”》
exampleTraditional: 悲觀的由來，是在～不辯是非，而偏要關心於文壇，或者竟是自己坐在沒落的營盤裡。★魯迅《準風月談·中國文壇的悲觀”》
exampleEn: The reason for pessimism is to stand aloof without distinguishing right from wrong, yet still care about the literary world, or perhaps sit in a declining camp. — from Lu Xun's 'Random Thoughts on the Pessimism of the Chinese Literary World'

explanation: 指恭敬谨慎，竭尽心力。
explanationTraditional: 指恭敬謹慎，竭盡心力。
explanationEn: To bend one's back and exhaust one's strength; to be completely dedicated and exert all efforts.
derivation: 明·宋濂《先府君蓉峰处士阡表》祖妣夫人与显考鞠躬尽瘁，誓勿蹶其门。”
derivationTraditional: 明·宋濂《先府君蓉峰處士阡表》祖妣夫人與顯考鞠躬盡瘁，誓勿蹶其門。”
derivationEn: From Song Lian's 'Epitaph of the Late Father': 'My grandmother and my father bowed and exerted themselves, vowing not to let the family decline.'
example: 臣只有一片愚忠，～。★欧阳予倩《忠王李秀成》第三幕
exampleTraditional: 臣只有一片愚忠，～。★歐陽予倩《忠王李秀成》第三幕
exampleEn: I only have a foolish loyalty, to bend my back and exhaust my strength. — from Ouyang Yuqian's 'Prince Zhong Wang Li Xiucheng', Act 3

explanation: 欢蹦乱跳，活泼、欢乐，生气勃勃的样子。
explanationTraditional: 歡蹦亂跳，活潑、歡樂，生氣勃勃的樣子。
explanationEn: Lively and bouncing; full of vitality and joy.
derivation: 曹禺《日出》第四幕我一定可以把小东西还是活蹦乱跳地找回来。”
derivationTraditional: 曹禺《日出》第四幕我一定可以把小東西還是活蹦亂跳地找回來。”
derivationEn: From Cao Yu's 'Sunrise', Act 4: 'I can definitely find the little thing back, alive and kicking.'
example: 大水看到～的艾和尚一眨眼的工夫，就死在敌人枪弹之下，心里一阵疼。★孔厥、袁静《新儿女英雄传》第九回
exampleTraditional: 大水看到～的艾和尚一眨眼的工夫，就死在敵人槍彈之下，心裡一陣疼。★孔厥、袁靜《新兒女英雄傳》第九回
exampleEn: Dashui saw the lively and bouncing Ai Heshang die under enemy bullets in the blink of an eye, and felt a pang in his heart. — from Kong Jue and Yuan Jing's 'New Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 9

explanation: 栗畏惧，发抖。不冷而发抖。形容非常恐惧。
explanationTraditional: 慄畏懼，發抖。不冷而發抖。形容非常恐懼。
explanationEn: To shiver without feeling cold; extremely frightened.
derivation: 《史记·酷吏列传》是日皆报杀四百余人，其后郡中不寒而栗，滑民佐吏为治。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·酷吏列傳》是日皆報殺四百餘人，其後郡中不寒而慄，滑民佐吏為治。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Cruel Officials': 'That day, over four hundred people were executed, and afterwards the whole prefecture shivered without cold, and the cunning people helped the officials govern.'
example: 岂果脂粉之气，不势而威？胡乃肮脏之身，～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·马介甫》
exampleTraditional: 豈果脂粉之氣，不勢而威？胡乃骯髒之身，～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·馬介甫》
exampleEn: Could it be that the breath of rouge and powder intimidates without force? Why does this filthy body shiver without cold? — from Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Ma Jiefu'

explanation: 分清楚是和非、正确和错误。
explanationTraditional: 分清楚是和非、正確和錯誤。
explanationEn: To clearly distinguish between right and wrong.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》慎思之，明辩之，驾行之。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》慎思之，明辯之，駕行之。”
derivationEn: From 'The Doctrine of the Mean': 'Think carefully, distinguish clearly, and act earnestly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 赅完备。话不多，但意思都有了。形容说话写文章简明扼要。
explanationTraditional: 賅完備。話不多，但意思都有了。形容說話寫文章簡明扼要。
explanationEn: Concise in speech but comprehensive in meaning; describing writing or speech that is brief and to the point.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们作文应该言简意赅，不要拖泥带水。
exampleTraditional: 我們作文應該言簡意賅，不要拖泥帶水。
exampleEn: Our compositions should be concise and comprehensive, not long-winded.

explanation: 鸟叫得好听，花开得喷香。形容春天的美好景象。
explanationTraditional: 鳥叫得好聽，花開得噴香。形容春天的美好景象。
explanationEn: Birds sing and flowers give fragrance; describes the beautiful scenery of spring.
derivation: 宋·吕本中《紫薇·庵居》鸟语花香变夕阴，稍闲复恐病相寻。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·呂本中《紫薇·庵居》鳥語花香變夕陰，稍閒復恐病相尋。”
derivationEn: From Lü Benzhong's 'Song of the Purple Rose: Dwelling in a Hut': 'Birds sing and flowers fragrance change the evening shade, a little leisure and I fear illness will follow.'
example: 一路行来，山青水绿，～，真是个好风景也。★清·李渔《比目鱼·肥遁》
exampleTraditional: 一路行來，山青水綠，～，真是個好風景也。★清·李漁《比目魚·肥遁》
exampleEn: Along the way, the mountains are green, the waters clear, birds sing and flowers fragrance—truly a beautiful scene. — from Li Yu's 'The Mandarin Duck Fish: Escape'

explanation: 躲避开而不肯说。指有意回避事实。
explanationTraditional: 躲避開而不肯說。指有意迴避事實。
explanationEn: To evade and refuse to speak about something; deliberately avoid the facts.
derivation: 徐迟《一九五六年〈特写选〉序言》尖锐的矛盾，避而不谈，或加水冲淡了。”
derivationTraditional: 徐遲《一九五六年〈特寫選〉序言》尖銳的矛盾，避而不談，或加水沖淡了。”
derivationEn: Xu Chi's preface to 'Selected Special Reports of 1956': 'Sharp contradictions are avoided or diluted with water.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 本为佛家语，指道无所不在◇多形容说话做事很有条理。
explanationTraditional: 本為佛家語，指道無所不在◇多形容說話做事很有條理。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist term meaning the Way is everywhere; now describes speaking or acting in a clear and orderly manner.
derivation: 《续传灯录·慧力洞源禅师》方知头头皆是道，法法本圆成。”
derivationTraditional: 《續傳燈錄·慧力洞源禪師》方知頭頭皆是道，法法本圓成。”
derivationEn: 'Continued Transmission of the Lamp: Master Huili Dongyuan': 'Then one realizes that everything is the Way, and every dharma is inherently perfect.'
example: 再看他后面讲那汽机的做法用法，～，语语内行。★清·姬文《市声》第十三回
exampleTraditional: 再看他後面講那汽機的做法用法，～，語語內行。★清·姬文《市聲》第十三回
exampleEn: Looking at his later explanation of the steam engine's construction and usage, it was clear and orderly, every word like an expert. (Qing Dynasty, Ji Wen, 'Market Sounds', Chapter 13)

explanation: 安、扎建立，安置；寨防守用的栅栏。指部队驻扎下来。也比喻建立临时的劳动或工作基地。
explanationTraditional: 安、扎建立，安置；寨防守用的柵欄。指部隊駐紮下來。也比喻建立臨時的勞動或工作基地。
explanationEn: To set up a camp; also used metaphorically for establishing a temporary base for work or labor.
derivation: 元·无名氏《两军师隔江斗智》第二折这周瑜匹夫，累累兴兵来索瘸荆州地面，如今在柴桑渡口安营扎寨，其意非小。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《兩軍師隔江鬥智》第二折這周瑜匹夫，累累興兵來索瘸荊州地面，如今在柴桑渡口安營紮寨，其意非小。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Two Armies Compete in Wisdom Across the River', Act 2: 'This Zhou Yu fellow repeatedly raises troops to demand Jingzhou, and now he has set up camp at Chaisang Ferry, with no small intention.'
example: 打什么地方进兵，打什么地方退兵，什么地方可以～，什么地方可以埋伏，指手画脚的讲了一通。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 打什麼地方進兵，打什麼地方退兵，什麼地方可以～，什麼地方可以埋伏，指手畫腳的講了一通。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十四回
exampleEn: He talked at length about where to advance, where to retreat, where to set up camp, and where to ambush, gesticulating all the while. (Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats Revealed', Chapter 14)

explanation: 风尘指行旅，含有辛苦之意；仆仆行路劳累的样子。形容旅途奔波，忙碌劳累。
explanationTraditional: 風塵指行旅，含有辛苦之意；僕僕行路勞累的樣子。形容旅途奔波，忙碌勞累。
explanationEn: Describes the hardships and fatigue of travel; journey-worn.
derivation: 元·尚仲贤《柳毅传书》你索是远路风尘的故人。”
derivationTraditional: 元·尚仲賢《柳毅傳書》你索是遠路風塵的故人。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Shang Zhongxian, 'The Story of Liu Yi Delivering a Letter': 'You are an old friend who has traveled a long and dusty road.'
example: 三人拣了一家客店住下，一路上～，到了此时，不免早些歇息。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第八回
exampleTraditional: 三人揀了一家客店住下，一路上～，到了此時，不免早些歇息。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第八回
exampleEn: The three of them found an inn and settled down. After a journey full of hardships, they were eager to rest early. (Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'A History of Pain', Chapter 8)

explanation: 指以前的人从来没有做过的。也指空前的。
explanationTraditional: 指以前的人從來沒有做過的。也指空前的。
explanationEn: Something unprecedented; never done before by anyone.
derivation: 唐·陈子昂《登幽州台歌》前不见古人，后不见来者。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·陳子昂《登幽州臺歌》前不見古人，後不見來者。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Chen Zi'ang, 'Song on the Youzhou Tower': 'Looking back, I see no ancients; looking ahead, I see no comers.'
example: 二者皆句语雄峻，～。★宋·洪迈《容斋四笔》卷二
exampleTraditional: 二者皆句語雄峻，～。★宋·洪邁《容齋四筆》卷二
exampleEn: Both lines are bold and majestic, unprecedented. (Song Dynasty, Hong Mai, 'Rongzhai's Random Notes', Volume 2)

explanation: 非议责备，批评。没有什么可以指责的。表示做得妥当。
explanationTraditional: 非議責備，批評。沒有什麼可以指責的。表示做得妥當。
explanationEn: Nothing can be blamed. Means something is done properly and beyond reproach.
derivation: 欧阳山《三家巷》三一你们的盛情是可感的，动机是无可非议的。”
derivationTraditional: 歐陽山《三家巷》三一你們的盛情是可感的，動機是無可非議的。”
derivationEn: Ouyang Shan, 'Three Family Lane' 31: 'Your hospitality is touching, and your motives are beyond reproach.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 筋筋骨；尽完。形容非常疲乏，一点力气也没有了。
explanationTraditional: 筋筋骨；盡完。形容非常疲乏，一點力氣也沒有了。
explanationEn: Describes being extremely exhausted, with no strength left.
derivation: 汉·焦延寿《焦氏易林·巽》蹇驴不材，骏骥失时，筋劳力尽，罢于沙丘。”唐·韩愈《论淮西事宜状》虽时侵掠，小有所得，力尽筋疲，不偿其费。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·焦延壽《焦氏易林·巽》蹇驢不材，駿驥失時，筋勞力盡，罷於沙丘。”唐·韓愈《論淮西事宜狀》雖時侵掠，小有所得，力盡筋疲，不償其費。”
derivationEn: Han·Jiao Yanshou, 'Jiao's Forest of Changes·Xun': 'A lame donkey is useless, a fine steed misses its time, muscles and strength are exhausted, weary on the sand dunes.' Tang·Han Yu, 'On the Situation of Huaixi': 'Although they occasionally invade and plunder, gaining small advantages, they are exhausted and weary, not worth the cost.'
example: 赵家一门大小，日夜忙碌，早已弄得～，人仰马翻。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第一回
exampleTraditional: 趙家一門大小，日夜忙碌，早已弄得～，人仰馬翻。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第一回
exampleEn: The whole Zhao family, busy day and night, were already completely exhausted and in chaos. ★ Qing·Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' First Chapter

explanation: 没有什么不能做的。指样样能做。
explanationTraditional: 沒有什麼不能做的。指樣樣能做。
explanationEn: There is nothing one cannot do. Refers to being capable of everything.
derivation: 宋·沈括《梦溪笔谈》卷二十一近岁迎紫姑者极多，大率多能文章歌诗，有极工者，予屡见之，多自称蓬莱谪仙，医卜无所不能，棋与国手为敌。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·沈括《夢溪筆談》卷二十一近歲迎紫姑者極多，大率多能文章歌詩，有極工者，予屢見之，多自稱蓬萊謫仙，醫卜無所不能，棋與國手為敵。”
derivationEn: Song·Shen Kuo, 'Dream Pool Essays' Volume 21: 'In recent years, there are many who welcome the Zigu spirit, most are skilled in writing poetry, some extremely talented, I have seen them often, many claim to be banished immortals from Penglai, medicine and divination are nothing they cannot do, playing chess on par with national champions.'
example: 从小风流俊雅，～。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十三
exampleTraditional: 從小風流俊雅，～。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十三
exampleEn: From a young age, he was romantic and elegant, capable of everything. ★ Ming·Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 13

explanation: 指一回又一回，经过一段时间。表示逐渐的意思。
explanationTraditional: 指一回又一回，經過一段時間。表示逐漸的意思。
explanationEn: Refers to one time after another, after a period of time. Indicates gradually.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十八回一来二去，两个人就装糊涂了，倒象真的一样儿。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十八回一來二去，兩個人就裝糊塗了，倒象真的一樣兒。”
derivationEn: Qing·Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 58: 'Over time, the two of them pretended to be confused, as if it were real.'
example: 后来～，渐渐的熟识。（清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第二十一回）
exampleTraditional: 後來～，漸漸的熟識。（清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第二十一回）
exampleEn: Later, over time, they gradually became acquainted. (Qing·Shi Yukun, 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants' Chapter 21)

explanation: 没有经过认真准备和严密组织，一下子行动起来。同一哄而起”。
explanationTraditional: 沒有經過認真準備和嚴密組織，一下子行動起來。同一哄而起”。
explanationEn: To rush into action without careful preparation and organization. Same as '一哄而起'.
derivation: 《人民日报》1983.10.31在发展新‘三大件’和其他有前途的轻工行业时，决不能再像发展老‘三大件’那样，一见有利可图，便一哄而上。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1983.10.31在發展新‘三大件’和其他有前途的輕工行業時，決不能再像發展老‘三大件’那樣，一見有利可圖，便一哄而上。”
derivationEn: 'People's Daily' October 31, 1983: 'In developing the new 'three major items' and other promising light industries, we must never, as in the development of the old 'three major items', rush in as soon as profits are seen.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 挂上灯笼，系上彩绸。形容节日或有喜庆事情的景象。
explanationTraditional: 掛上燈籠，繫上綵綢。形容節日或有喜慶事情的景象。
explanationEn: Decorated with lanterns and colored streamers, describing a festive or celebratory scene.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十九回告谕城内居民，尽张灯结彩，庆赏佳节。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十九回告諭城內居民，盡張燈結綵，慶賞佳節。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 69: 'Informed the city residents to hang lanterns and tie colored silk to celebrate the festival.'
example: 国庆节期间，广场上～，好不热闹。
exampleTraditional: 國慶節期間，廣場上～，好不熱鬧。
exampleEn: During the National Day holiday, the square was decorated with lanterns and colored streamers, bustling with excitement.

explanation: 由听从，顺便；分说辩白，解说。不容人分辩解释。
explanationTraditional: 由聽從，順便；分說辯白，解說。不容人分辯解釋。
explanationEn: Not allowing someone to explain or argue; without listening to reason.
derivation: 元·武汉臣《生金阁》三折怎么不由分说，便将我飞拳走踢只是打。”
derivationTraditional: 元·武漢臣《生金閣》三折怎麼不由分說，便將我飛拳走踢只是打。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Wu Hanchen's 'Sheng Jin Ge', Act 3: 'Why, without letting me explain, do you just punch and kick me?'
example: 可是人们～，还是狠狠地打了他一顿，还用马刀把所有的布袋都砍破了，把车子也劈掉了。★邓洪《潘虎》
exampleTraditional: 可是人們～，還是狠狠地打了他一頓，還用馬刀把所有的布袋都砍破了，把車子也劈掉了。★鄧洪《潘虎》
exampleEn: But the people, without allowing any explanation, gave him a severe beating, cut all the cloth bags with sabers, and smashed the cart. — Deng Hong, 'Pan Hu'

explanation: 酣畅畅饮，引伸为舒适、畅快；淋漓畅快的样子。形容非常畅快。
explanationTraditional: 酣暢暢飲，引伸為舒適、暢快；淋漓暢快的樣子。形容非常暢快。
explanationEn: Describes something very enjoyable and unrestrained; thoroughly satisfying.
derivation: 《晋书·阮修传》常步行，以百姓挂杖头，至酒店，便独酣畅。”宋·欧阳修《释秘演诗集序》无所放其意，则往往从布衣野老，酣嬉淋漓，颠倒而不厌。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·阮修傳》常步行，以百姓掛杖頭，至酒店，便獨酣暢。”宋·歐陽修《釋秘演詩集序》無所放其意，則往往從布衣野老，酣嬉淋漓，顛倒而不厭。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Ruan Xiu': 'He often walked with a hundred coins on his staff, went to a tavern, and drank heartily alone.' Also from Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'Preface to the Collected Poems of Shi Mi': 'Having no outlet for his feelings, he would often join commoners and old rustics, drinking and playing heartily, topsy-turvy and never tired.'
example: 老舍先生写老张的钱本位”的哲学，确乎是～，阐扬尽致。★朱自清《〈老张的哲学〉与〈赵子曰〉》
exampleTraditional: 老舍先生寫老張的錢本位”的哲學，確乎是～，闡揚盡致。★朱自清《〈老張的哲學〉與〈趙子曰〉》
exampleEn: Lao She's portrayal of Old Zhang's 'money-based' philosophy is indeed thoroughly and vividly expressed. — Zhu Ziqing, 'On Lao She's Philosophy of Old Zhang and Zhao Ziyue'

explanation: 预预先；料料想，估计≤难预先想到。
explanationTraditional: 預預先；料料想，估計≤難預先想到。
explanationEn: Difficult to predict or estimate in advance.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《后出师表》凡事如是，难以逆料。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《後出師表》凡事如是，難以逆料。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Shu Han Zhuge Liang's 'Later Memorial to the Throne': 'All matters are like this, difficult to foresee.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 想往南而车子却向北行。比喻行动和目的正好相反。
explanationTraditional: 想往南而車子卻向北行。比喻行動和目的正好相反。
explanationEn: Wanting to go south but driving north; metaphor for action and goal being opposite.
derivation: 《战国策·魏策四》犹至楚而北行也。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·魏策四》猶至楚而北行也。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Wei Strategy IV': 'It is like going north when you want to reach Chu.'
example: 你想这六条要求，与中央开出的六条款约，简直是～，相差甚远，有甚么和议可言。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第六十八回
exampleTraditional: 你想這六條要求，與中央開出的六條款約，簡直是～，相差甚遠，有甚麼和議可言。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第六十八回
exampleEn: Do you think these six demands are completely opposite to the six terms proposed by the central government? They are far apart; what peace talks can there be? — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qifu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 68

explanation: 形容没有约束，十分安闲随意。
explanationTraditional: 形容沒有約束，十分安閒隨意。
explanationEn: Describes being without constraints, very leisurely and carefree.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷二十三问‘牛头未见四祖时如何？’师曰‘自由自在。’曰‘见后如何？’师曰‘自由自在。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷二十三問‘牛頭未見四祖時如何？’師曰‘自由自在。’曰‘見後如何？’師曰‘自由自在。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Daoyuan's 'Records of the Transmission of the Lamp', Volume 23: 'Question: 'How was it before Niutou saw the Fourth Patriarch?' Master said: 'Free and at ease.' 'How after seeing him?' Master said: 'Free and at ease.''
example: 看那些交了卷出去的人真象～的仙人。★叶圣陶《马铃瓜》
exampleTraditional: 看那些交了卷出去的人真象～的仙人。★葉聖陶《馬鈴瓜》
exampleEn: Those who had handed in their papers and left looked like carefree immortals. — Ye Shengtao, 'Ma Linggua'

explanation: 形容急急忙忙，冒冒失失的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容急急忙忙，冒冒失失的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes being in a hurry or acting rashly and impetuously.
derivation: 王吉呈《女御史》妈千叮咛万叮咛，务必要平稳，切不可像在娘家门上那样风风火火，得罪了人，日后过门咋做媳妇呢？”
derivationTraditional: 王吉呈《女御史》媽千叮嚀萬叮嚀，務必要平穩，切不可像在孃家門上那樣風風火火，得罪了人，日後過門咋做媳婦呢？”
derivationEn: From Wang Jicheng's 'Female Censor': 'Mother repeatedly urged to be steady, not to be as rash as at home, offending people, how would she be a daughter-in-law later?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 冒冒充，以假充真。为了达到自己的某种目的，假冒别人的姓名，代他去干事或窃取他的权力、地位。
explanationTraditional: 冒冒充，以假充真。為了達到自己的某種目的，假冒別人的姓名，代他去幹事或竊取他的權力、地位。
explanationEn: To assume someone else's name or identity to achieve one's own goals, such as taking their place or usurping their power or position.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十五回你走了便也罢，却怎么绑些柳树在此，冒名顶替。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十五回你走了便也罷，卻怎麼綁些柳樹在此，冒名頂替。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 25: 'You left, but why did you tie willow trees here to impersonate us?'
example: 《古文尚书》的运气真够坏的，不但没有能够露头角，还一而在的遭到了些～的事儿。★朱自清《经典常谈·尚书第三》
exampleTraditional: 《古文尚書》的運氣真夠壞的，不但沒有能夠露頭角，還一而在的遭到了些～的事兒。★朱自清《經典常談·尚書第三》
exampleEn: The luck of the 'Old Text Book of Documents' was really bad; not only did it fail to shine, but it repeatedly suffered from impersonation incidents. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Introductions: Book of Documents, Part 3'

explanation: 保卫家乡和祖国。
explanationTraditional: 保衛家鄉和祖國。
explanationEn: To defend one's hometown and motherland.
derivation: 冰心《跟小朋友谈访埃观感》在保家卫国的强烈感情里，我们两国人民是血肉相连的！”
derivationTraditional: 冰心《跟小朋友談訪埃觀感》在保家衛國的強烈感情裡，我們兩國人民是血肉相連的！”
derivationEn: From Bing Xin's 'Talking with Children about Impressions of Visiting Egypt': 'In the strong feeling of defending our homes and country, the people of our two countries are closely linked!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 年富未来的年岁多。形容年纪轻，精力旺盛。
explanationTraditional: 年富未來的年歲多。形容年紀輕，精力旺盛。
explanationEn: Describes being young and energetic, with many years ahead.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》后生可畏”宋·朱熹注孔子言后生年富力强，足以积学而有待，其势可畏。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》後生可畏”宋·朱熹注孔子言後生年富力強，足以積學而有待，其勢可畏。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Zihan': 'The young are to be respected.' Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's commentary: 'Confucius said the young are in their prime, strong enough to accumulate learning and have a future, their potential is awe-inspiring.'
example: 趁你们～的时候，为人民做出更多的贡献吧！（郭沫若《科学的春天》）
exampleTraditional: 趁你們～的時候，為人民做出更多的貢獻吧！（郭沫若《科學的春天》）
exampleEn: Take advantage of your youth and vigor to make more contributions to the people! — Guo Moruo, 'The Spring of Science'

explanation: 不义不正当，不合理。不应该得到的或以不正当的手段获得的钱财。
explanationTraditional: 不義不正當，不合理。不應該得到的或以不正當的手段獲得的錢財。
explanationEn: Ill-gotten wealth; money obtained through improper or dishonest means.
derivation: 汉·刘向《列女传·齐田稷母传》不义之财，非吾有也，不孝之子，非吾子也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《列女傳·齊田稷母傳》不義之財，非吾有也，不孝之子，非吾子也。”
derivationEn: From Liu Xiang's 'Biographies of Exemplary Women' of the Han Dynasty: 'Ill-gotten wealth is not mine; unfilial sons are not my sons.'
example: 这～，犬豕不顾，谁人要你的！★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》第二十二卷
exampleTraditional: 這～，犬豕不顧，誰人要你的！★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》第二十二卷
exampleEn: This ill-gotten wealth, even dogs and pigs would disdain; who would want yours? — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories Old and New', Volume 22.

explanation: 事情的发生是有原因的。
explanationTraditional: 事情的發生是有原因的。
explanationEn: There is a reason for the occurrence; everything happens for a reason.
derivation: 叶圣陶《得失》但是一想到事出有因，他就只好假装没有听见。”
derivationTraditional: 葉聖陶《得失》但是一想到事出有因，他就只好假裝沒有聽見。”
derivationEn: From Ye Shengtao's 'Gains and Losses': 'But thinking that there must be a reason, he had to pretend not to hear.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 看见人家有急难而不去救援。
explanationTraditional: 看見人家有急難而不去救援。
explanationEn: To see someone in danger but not offer help; to be indifferent to others' plight.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《救风尘》第二折你做的今见死不救，羞见这桃园中杀马宰乌牛。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《救風塵》第二折你做的今見死不救，羞見這桃園中殺馬宰烏牛。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'Rescuing a Courtesan' of the Yuan Dynasty: 'You now see death but do not rescue, ashamed to face the peach garden oath of brotherhood.'
example: 周金大哥死在国民党军阀、官僚手里，你们～。★欧阳山《三家巷》三一
exampleTraditional: 周金大哥死在國民黨軍閥、官僚手裡，你們～。★歐陽山《三家巷》三一
exampleEn: Brother Zhou Jin died at the hands of the Kuomintang warlords and bureaucrats, yet you saw him die without rescuing him. — Ouyang Shan's 'Three Family Lane', Chapter 31.

explanation: 模棱含糊，不明确；两可可以这样，也可以那样。指不表示明确的态度，或没有明确的主张。
explanationTraditional: 模稜含糊，不明確；兩可可以這樣，也可以那樣。指不表示明確的態度，或沒有明確的主張。
explanationEn: Ambiguous; equivocal; not taking a clear stance or having a definite opinion.
derivation: 《旧唐书·苏味道传》处事不欲决断明白，若有错误，必贻咎谴，但模棱以持两端可矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·蘇味道傳》處事不欲決斷明白，若有錯誤，必貽咎譴，但模稜以持兩端可矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Su Weidao': 'In handling affairs, one should not decide clearly; if there is a mistake, blame will follow. It is better to be ambiguous and hold both ends.'
example: 他害怕事情一旦变化，他将有不测大祸，所以跪在地上回答了一句～的话。（姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十章）
exampleTraditional: 他害怕事情一旦變化，他將有不測大禍，所以跪在地上回答了一句～的話。（姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十章）
exampleEn: Fearing that if things changed he would face disaster, he knelt and answered with an ambiguous remark. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 30.

explanation: 隔一天，或几乎每天。形容经常、频繁。
explanationTraditional: 隔一天，或幾乎每天。形容經常、頻繁。
explanationEn: Every other day or almost every day; frequently, often.
derivation: 周立波《暴风骤雨》第一部十二西北悬天起了乌黑的云朵，不大一会，瓢泼大雨到来了，夹着炸雷和闪电，因为三天两头地下雨，道上黑泥总是不干的，出门的人们都是光着脚丫子，顺着道沿走。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《暴風驟雨》第一部十二西北懸天起了烏黑的雲朵，不大一會，瓢潑大雨到來了，夾著炸雷和閃電，因為三天兩頭地下雨，道上黑泥總是不幹的，出門的人們都是光著腳丫子，順著道沿走。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane', Part 1, Chapter 12: 'Dark clouds gathered in the northwest sky, and soon a downpour came with thunder and lightning. Because it rained every other day, the mud on the road never dried, and people went out barefoot, walking along the edges.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 中饱从中得利。指侵吞经手的钱财使自己得利。
explanationTraditional: 中飽從中得利。指侵吞經手的錢財使自己得利。
explanationEn: To line one's pockets with public funds; to embezzle money for personal gain.
derivation: 《韩非子·外储说右下》薄疑谓赵简主曰‘君之国中饱。’简主欣然而喜曰‘何如焉？’对曰‘府库空虚于上，百姓贫饿于下，然而奸吏富矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·外儲說右下》薄疑謂趙簡主曰‘君之國中飽。’簡主欣然而喜曰‘何如焉？’對曰‘府庫空虛於上，百姓貧餓於下，然而奸吏富矣。’”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: Outer Congeries of Sayings, Lower Right': 'Bo Yi said to Zhao Jianzi, 'Your state is being lined.' Zhao Jianzi was pleased and asked, 'How so?' Bo Yi replied, 'The treasury above is empty, the people below are starving, but the corrupt officials are rich.'
example: 小人贪利，事本非常，所可恨者，银两～，不曾济国家之实用耳。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第七回
exampleTraditional: 小人貪利，事本非常，所可恨者，銀兩～，不曾濟國家之實用耳。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第七回
exampleEn: The petty man is greedy for profit; the matter is unusual. What is regrettable is that the silver lined his own pockets and did not benefit the nation. — Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan's 'Lamp at the Crossroads', Chapter 7.

explanation: 穷得象用水洗过似的，什么都没有。形容十分贫穷。
explanationTraditional: 窮得象用水洗過似的，什麼都沒有。形容十分貧窮。
explanationEn: As poor as if washed clean; utterly destitute, having nothing.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》楔子小生一贫如洗，流落在这楚州居住。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》楔子小生一貧如洗，流落在這楚州居住。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'The Injustice to Dou E' of the Yuan Dynasty, Prologue: 'I am as poor as if washed clean, drifting to live in Chuzhou.'
example: 当时父亲赤手空拳出来做官，家里～。★邹韬奋《我的母亲》
exampleTraditional: 當時父親赤手空拳出來做官，家裡～。★鄒韜奮《我的母親》
exampleEn: At that time, my father came out as an official empty-handed, and the family was as poor as if washed clean. — Zou Taofen's 'My Mother'.

explanation: 犹言不分白天夜晚。
explanationTraditional: 猶言不分白天夜晚。
explanationEn: Day and night; without distinction between day and night; continuously.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 贤德才兼备的人；齐相等。见到德才兼备的人就想赶上他。
explanationTraditional: 賢德才兼備的人；齊相等。見到德才兼備的人就想趕上他。
explanationEn: When seeing a virtuous person, one should strive to be their equal; to emulate the worthy.
derivation: 《论语·里仁》见贤思齐焉，见不贤而内自省也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·里仁》見賢思齊焉，見不賢而內自省也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Li Ren': 'When you see a worthy person, think of becoming equal to them; when you see an unworthy person, reflect inwardly on yourself.'
example: 则为他和曲填词，移宫换羽，使老夫～，回嗔作喜。★元·关汉卿《谢天香》第四折
exampleTraditional: 則為他和曲填詞，移宮換羽，使老夫～，回嗔作喜。★元·關漢卿《謝天香》第四折
exampleEn: Because he harmonized lyrics and composed tunes, shifting tones, he made me, an old man, want to emulate the worthy and turn anger into joy. — Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing's 'Xie Tianxiang', Act 4.

explanation: 戒警戒；备防备。警戒防备极严密。
explanationTraditional: 戒警戒；備防備。警戒防備極嚴密。
explanationEn: Tightly guarded; heavily fortified; strict security measures.
derivation: 《国语·晋三》日考而习，戒备毕矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·晉三》日考而習，戒備畢矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Guoyu: Jin Yu III': 'Daily inspections and drills, preparations are complete.'
example: 记得那日是烈日当空，两万多人席地坐在大操场上，场外～。★陈若曦《任秀兰》
exampleTraditional: 記得那日是烈日當空，兩萬多人席地坐在大操場上，場外～。★陳若曦《任秀蘭》
exampleEn: I remember that day was scorching hot; over twenty thousand people sat on the ground in the large sports field, and outside the field, security was extremely tight. — Chen Ruoxi's 'Ren Xiulan'.

explanation: 形容各种各样奇怪的事物。
explanationTraditional: 形容各種各樣奇怪的事物。
explanationEn: Describes all kinds of strange and bizarre things.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十一杀人竟不偿命，不杀人到要偿命，死者生者，怨气冲天，纵然官府不明，皇天自然鉴察，千奇百怪的，巧生出机会来了此公案。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十一殺人竟不償命，不殺人到要償命，死者生者，怨氣沖天，縱然官府不明，皇天自然鑑察，千奇百怪的，巧生出機會來了此公案。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Er Ke Pai An Jing Qi': 'Killing without paying with life, not killing but having to pay with life, the dead and the living, resentment fills the sky. Even if the officials are not clear, the heavenly emperor will surely observe, and a thousand strange and bizarre things will cleverly create opportunities to settle this case.'
example: 海洋里的生物～，非常迷人。
exampleTraditional: 海洋裡的生物～，非常迷人。
exampleEn: The creatures in the ocean are all kinds of strange and fascinating.

explanation: 麻痹肢体失去知觉和运动机能障碍，比喻失去警觉。指粗心、疏忽，对事物不敏感，失去警惕性。
explanationTraditional: 麻痺肢體失去知覺和運動機能障礙，比喻失去警覺。指粗心、疏忽，對事物不敏感，失去警惕性。
explanationEn: Refers to carelessness, negligence, insensitivity to things, and loss of vigilance.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我要当心，不能～，我应当找个隐蔽的地方。（巴金《坚强战士》）
exampleTraditional: 我要當心，不能～，我應當找個隱蔽的地方。（巴金《堅強戰士》）
exampleEn: I must be careful, I cannot be negligent, I should find a hidden place. (Ba Jin, 'Strong Soldier')

explanation: 载装载；归回来。装得满满地回来。形容收获很大。
explanationTraditional: 載裝載；歸回來。裝得滿滿地回來。形容收穫很大。
explanationEn: To return fully loaded; describes a great harvest or gain.
derivation: 明·李贽《焚书·又焦弱侯》然林汝宁向者三任，彼无一任不往，往必满载而归。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《焚書·又焦弱侯》然林汝寧曏者三任，彼無一任不往，往必滿載而歸。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Li Zhi's 'Fen Shu': 'But Lin Runing previously served three terms, and he never went without returning fully loaded.'
example: 将卫国府库，及民间存留金粟之类，劫掠一空，堕其城郭，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第二十三回
exampleTraditional: 將衛國府庫，及民間存留金粟之類，劫掠一空，墮其城郭，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第二十三回
exampleEn: They plundered the state treasury and the remaining gold and grain among the people, destroyed the city walls, and returned fully loaded. (Ming Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 23)

explanation: 至最。高到顶点，再也没有更高的了。
explanationTraditional: 至最。高到頂點，再也沒有更高的了。
explanationEn: Highest; so high that there is nothing higher.
derivation: 《淮南子·缪称训》道至高无上，至深无下，平乎准，直乎绳，圆乎规，方乎矩。”汉·许慎《说文解字·一部》天，颠也。至高无上，从一大。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·繆稱訓》道至高無上，至深無下，平乎準，直乎繩，圓乎規，方乎矩。”漢·許慎《說文解字·一部》天，顛也。至高無上，從一大。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi': 'The Way is supremely high with nothing above it, supremely deep with nothing below it.' Also from Xu Shen's 'Shuowen Jiezi': 'Tian (heaven) means the top, supremely high with nothing above it, from one and great.'
example: 只要能把国家从水深火热里救出来，他就是～的英雄。★梁斌《红旗谱》四十二
exampleTraditional: 只要能把國家從水深火熱裡救出來，他就是～的英雄。★梁斌《紅旗譜》四十二
