exampleEn: As long as he can save the country from deep water and scorching fire, he is the supremely high hero. (Liang Bin, 'Red Flag Chronicle', 42)

explanation: 比喻极微小的东西。
explanationTraditional: 比喻極微小的東西。
explanationEn: Metaphor for extremely tiny things.
derivation: 《后汉书·应劭传》春一草枯则为灾，秋一木华亦为异。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·應劭傳》春一草枯則為災，秋一木華亦為異。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han': 'If a single grass withers in spring, it is a disaster; if a single tree blooms in autumn, it is also an anomaly.'
example: 不许惊动，如有犯僖氏～者斩首！★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第三十九回
exampleTraditional: 不許驚動，如有犯僖氏～者斬首！★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第三十九回
exampleEn: No disturbance is allowed; anyone who touches even a single blade of grass or tree of the Xi family will be beheaded! (Ming Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 39)

explanation: 发挥或发扬优点或有利条件，克服或回避缺点或不利条件。
explanationTraditional: 發揮或發揚優點或有利條件，克服或迴避缺點或不利條件。
explanationEn: To develop or promote strengths or advantages, and overcome or avoid weaknesses or disadvantages.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们对待一切工作，都要从实际出发，～，讲求实效。
exampleTraditional: 我們對待一切工作，都要從實際出發，～，講求實效。
exampleEn: In all our work, we must proceed from reality, develop strengths and avoid weaknesses, and emphasize practical results.

explanation: 甘甜。共同享受幸福，共同担当艰苦。
explanationTraditional: 甘甜。共同享受幸福，共同擔當艱苦。
explanationEn: To share joys and hardships together.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策一》燕王吊死问生，与百姓同其甘苦。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策一》燕王吊死問生，與百姓同其甘苦。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States': 'The King of Yan mourned the dead and cared for the living, sharing hardships with the people.'
example: 夫耕于前，妻耘于后，～，相敬如宾。★明·李昌祺《剪灯余话·鸾鸾传》
exampleTraditional: 夫耕於前，妻耘於後，～，相敬如賓。★明·李昌祺《剪燈餘話·鸞鸞傳》
exampleEn: The husband plows in front, the wife weeds behind, sharing joys and hardships, respecting each other as guests. (Ming Li Changqi, 'Lamp Trimming Stories')

explanation: 原比喻防御十分坚固，不可摧毁。也比喻团结一致。
explanationTraditional: 原比喻防禦十分堅固，不可摧毀。也比喻團結一致。
explanationEn: Originally describes extremely strong defense that cannot be destroyed; also metaphor for unity.
derivation: 元·无名氏《谢金梧》楔子随他铜墙铁壁，也不怕不拆倒了他的。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《謝金梧》楔子隨他銅牆鐵壁，也不怕不拆倒了他的。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'Xie Jinwu': 'Even if it is a copper wall and iron barrier, I am not afraid to tear it down.'
example: 宋江自引了前部人马，转过独龙岗后面来看祝家庄时，后面都是～，把得严整。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十八回
exampleTraditional: 宋江自引了前部人馬，轉過獨龍崗後面來看祝家莊時，後面都是～，把得嚴整。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十八回
exampleEn: Song Jiang led the vanguard troops around Dulong Ridge to look at the Zhu family village; the rear was all copper walls and iron barriers, tightly guarded. (Ming Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 48)

explanation: 孜孜勤勉的样子。不知疲倦地探求。
explanationTraditional: 孜孜勤勉的樣子。不知疲倦地探求。
explanationEn: To diligently and tirelessly seek something.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他对真理有～的精神。
exampleTraditional: 他對真理有～的精神。
exampleEn: He has a spirit of tirelessly seeking truth.

explanation: 指十分伤心或感动，抱头大哭。
explanationTraditional: 指十分傷心或感動，抱頭大哭。
explanationEn: To hold one's head and cry bitterly, indicating extreme sadness or emotion.
derivation: 清·刘鹗《老残游记》第四回这里于家父子同他家里人抱头痛哭。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第四回這裡於家父子同他家裡人抱頭痛哭。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 4: 'Here the Yu family father and son held each other's heads and cried bitterly.'
example: 他的妻子不幸去世，他～，悲痛欲绝。
exampleTraditional: 他的妻子不幸去世，他～，悲痛欲絕。
exampleEn: His wife passed away unexpectedly; he held his head and cried bitterly, overwhelmed with grief.

explanation: 移改变；易变换。改变旧的风俗习惯。
explanationTraditional: 移改變；易變換。改變舊的風俗習慣。
explanationEn: To change old customs and habits.
derivation: 《荀子·乐论》乐者，圣人之所乐也，而可以善民心，其感人深，其移风易俗，故先王导之以礼乐而民和睦。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·樂論》樂者，聖人之所樂也，而可以善民心，其感人深，其移風易俗，故先王導之以禮樂而民和睦。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi's 'Discourse on Music': 'Music is what the sage delights in, and it can improve people's hearts, deeply moving them and changing customs. Therefore, ancient kings guided the people with rites and music, and the people became harmonious.'
example: 我们要～，形成讲科学的好风气。
exampleTraditional: 我們要～，形成講科學的好風氣。
exampleEn: We must change customs and form a good atmosphere of science.

explanation: 匠心巧妙的心思。具有独到的灵巧的心思。指在技巧和艺术方面的创造性。
explanationTraditional: 匠心巧妙的心思。具有獨到的靈巧的心思。指在技巧和藝術方面的創造性。
explanationEn: Having unique and ingenious creativity, especially in art or technique.
derivation: 《诗刊》1978年第3期诗味的浓淡，与比兴之运用关系非常密切。李贺的诗歌在这方面是独具匠心的。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩刊》1978年第3期詩味的濃淡，與比興之運用關係非常密切。李賀的詩歌在這方面是獨具匠心的。”
derivationEn: From 'Poetry Journal' 1978, Issue 3: 'The richness of poetic flavor is closely related to the use of metaphor and allusion. Li He's poetry is unique in this regard.'
example: 他的这种设计真是独具匠心。
exampleTraditional: 他的這種設計真是獨具匠心。
exampleEn: His design is truly ingenious.

explanation: 后悔也来不及了。
explanationTraditional: 後悔也來不及了。
explanationEn: Too late to regret; regret is useless.
derivation: 汉·晁错《上书言兵事》夫以人之死争胜，跌而不振，则悔之亡及也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·晁錯《上書言兵事》夫以人之死爭勝，跌而不振，則悔之亡及也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Chao Cuo's 'Memorial on Military Affairs': 'If one fights for victory at the cost of death and falls without recovery, regret will be too late.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 负承受，承担，引申为享有。长时期地享有好的名声。
explanationTraditional: 負承受，承擔，引申為享有。長時期地享有好的名聲。
explanationEn: To have long enjoyed a good reputation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 冷不热情，引伸为严峻；热温度高，引伸为辛辣。用尖刻辛辣的语言进行讥笑和讽刺。
explanationTraditional: 冷不熱情，引伸為嚴峻；熱溫度高，引伸為辛辣。用尖刻辛辣的語言進行譏笑和諷刺。
explanationEn: To ridicule and satirize with sharp and bitter language.
derivation: 清·袁枚《牍外余言》楚公子围为虢之会，其时子围篡国之状，人人知之，皆有不平之意，故晋大夫七嘴八舌，冷讥热嘲，皆由于心之大公也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·袁枚《牘外餘言》楚公子圍為虢之會，其時子圍篡國之狀，人人知之，皆有不平之意，故晉大夫七嘴八舌，冷譏熱嘲，皆由於心之大公也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Yuan Mei's 'Remaining Words from Letters': 'During the meeting of the Chu prince Wei in Guo, everyone knew his usurpation and felt indignant. Therefore, the Jin officials chattered and mocked coldly and hotly, all due to their great impartiality.'
example: 见了老徐，说了几句～的话儿。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一一六回
exampleTraditional: 見了老徐，說了幾句～的話兒。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一一六回
exampleEn: Seeing Old Xu, he said a few words of cold mockery and hot satire.

explanation: 江河湖泊的水溢出，造成灾害。比喻不好的文章或思想到处传播，影响极坏。
explanationTraditional: 江河湖泊的水溢出，造成災害。比喻不好的文章或思想到處傳播，影響極壞。
explanationEn: To overflow and cause disaster; metaphorically, bad ideas or writings spread widely and cause harm.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公上》洪水横流，泛滥于天下。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公上》洪水橫流，氾濫於天下。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'The floodwaters overflowed, inundating the land.'
example: 表报之多，闹得～。★毛泽东《论十大关系》
exampleTraditional: 表報之多，鬧得～。★毛澤東《論十大關係》
exampleEn: The multitude of reports has become a disaster.

explanation: 乱冲乱撞，蛮横无理。
explanationTraditional: 亂衝亂撞，蠻橫無理。
explanationEn: To charge about wildly and unreasonably.
derivation: 明·李贽《续焚书·与友人论文》凡作文皆从外边攻进里去，我谓文章就时而攻打出来，就他城池，食他粮草，统率他兵马，直冲横撞，搅得他粉碎，故不费一毫气力而自然有余也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《續焚書·與友人論文》凡作文皆從外邊攻進裡去，我謂文章就時而攻打出來，就他城池，食他糧草，統率他兵馬，直衝橫撞，攪得他粉碎，故不費一毫氣力而自然有餘也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Li Zhi's 'Continued Burning Books: Discussing Writing with Friends': 'When writing, one should attack from the outside in. I say that writing should break out from the inside, seize the city, eat its grain, command its troops, charge straight and crash horizontally, smashing it to pieces, thus without spending any effort and naturally having surplus.'
example: 只见三妖全身甲胄，～，左右厮杀。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第九十六回
exampleTraditional: 只見三妖全身甲冑，～，左右廝殺。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第九十六回
exampleEn: The three demons, fully armored, charged about wildly, attacking left and right.

explanation: 形容自以为不错而得意的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容自以為不錯而得意的樣子。
explanationEn: To be self-satisfied and complacent.
derivation: 《史记·魏其武安侯列传》魏其者，沾沾自喜耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魏其武安侯列傳》魏其者，沾沾自喜耳。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian: 'Wei Qi was self-satisfied.'
example: 然而象他那样的人，决不至于让某一件事的胜利弄得～，就此满足。★茅盾《子夜》五
exampleTraditional: 然而象他那樣的人，決不至於讓某一件事的勝利弄得～，就此滿足。★茅盾《子夜》五
exampleEn: However, a man like him would never let the success of one thing make him complacent and satisfied.

explanation: 比喻富有生命的活力和内容。多用来形容文艺作品中人物形象生动。
explanationTraditional: 比喻富有生命的活力和內容。多用來形容文藝作品中人物形象生動。
explanationEn: Lifelike and vivid; describing a well-rounded character in literature.
derivation: 朱自清《你我·子夜”》他笔下是些有血有肉能说能做的人，不是些扁平的人形，凝的影子。”
derivationTraditional: 朱自清《你我·子夜”》他筆下是些有血有肉能說能做的人，不是些扁平的人形，凝的影子。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Ziqing's 'You and I: Midnight': 'The characters in his works are flesh and blood, capable of action and speech, not flat figures or frozen shadows.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 奇奇异；艳色彩鲜艳。形容百花竞放，十分艳丽。
explanationTraditional: 奇奇異；豔色彩鮮豔。形容百花競放，十分豔麗。
explanationEn: To compete in beauty and splendor; describing flowers blooming in a riot of color.
derivation: 宋·吴曾《能改斋漫录·方物·芍药谱》名品相压，争妍斗奇，故者未厌，而新者已盛。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·吳曾《能改齋漫錄·方物·芍藥譜》名品相壓，爭妍鬥奇，故者未厭，而新者已盛。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wu Zeng's 'Notes on Capable Revisions': 'Famous varieties compete, vying in beauty and novelty; the old are not yet tired, while the new are already abundant.'
example: 尤其令邓幺姑神往的，就是讲到成都一般大户人家的生活，以及妇女们～的打扮。★李喆人《死水微澜》一
exampleTraditional: 尤其令鄧么姑神往的，就是講到成都一般大戶人家的生活，以及婦女們～的打扮。★李喆人《死水微瀾》一
exampleEn: What especially fascinated Deng Yaogu was the description of the life of Chengdu's wealthy families and the women's competitive dressing.

explanation: 恍忽糊里糊涂的样子。形容神思不定或神志不清。
explanationTraditional: 恍忽糊里糊塗的樣子。形容神思不定或神志不清。
explanationEn: In a daze; absent-minded; confused state of mind.
derivation: 战国·楚·宋玉《神女赋〉》精神恥忽，若有所喜。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·宋玉《神女賦〉》精神恥忽，若有所喜。”
derivationEn: From 'Goddess' Rhapsody' by Song Yu of the Warring States period: 'Spirit confused, as if delighted.'
example: 在大姐失踪之后，我～。领导上这时又要我写个大姐的简历，要进行追功。★茹志鹃《高高的白杨树》
exampleTraditional: 在大姐失蹤之後，我～。領導上這時又要我寫個大姐的簡歷，要進行追功。★茹誌鵑《高高的白楊樹》
exampleEn: After my elder sister disappeared, I was in a daze. The leadership then asked me to write a resume for her to commend her merits. — Ru Zhijuan, 'The Tall White Poplar'

explanation: 盘盘曲；错交错；节枝节。树木的根枝盘旋交错。比喻事情纷难复杂。
explanationTraditional: 盤盤曲；錯交錯；節枝節。樹木的根枝盤旋交錯。比喻事情紛難複雜。
explanationEn: Twisted roots and gnarled branches; complex and difficult to unravel.
derivation: 《后汉书·虞诩传》志不求易，事不避难，臣之职也；不遇盘根错节，何以别利器乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·虞詡傳》志不求易，事不避難，臣之職也；不遇盤根錯節，何以別利器乎？”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Yu Xu': 'One who seeks no easy goals and avoids no difficulties is fulfilling his duty; without encountering twisted roots and gnarled branches, how can one distinguish a sharp tool?'
example: 莫谓乡村阻力多，～须能手。★徐特立《毕业歌》
exampleTraditional: 莫謂鄉村阻力多，～須能手。★徐特立《畢業歌》
exampleEn: Do not say rural resistance is strong; twisted roots and gnarled branches require skilled hands. — Xu Teli, 'Graduation Song'

explanation: 兴创办；土木指建筑工程。大规模地盖房子。
explanationTraditional: 興創辦；土木指建築工程。大規模地蓋房子。
explanationEn: To go in for large-scale construction; to build extensively.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《容斋三笔》卷十一奸佞之臣，罔真宗以符端，大兴土木之役，以为通宫玉清昭应之建。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《容齋三筆》卷十一奸佞之臣，罔真宗以符端，大興土木之役，以為通宮玉清昭應之建。”
derivationEn: From Hong Mai's 'Rongzhai San Bi' of the Song Dynasty: 'Treacherous ministers deceived Emperor Zhenzong with auspicious signs, launching large-scale construction projects to build the Tonggong Jade Pure Palace.'
example: 灵王既归，耻其无功，乃～，欲以物力制度，夸示诸侯。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: 靈王既歸，恥其無功，乃～，欲以物力制度，誇示諸侯。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第六十七回
exampleEn: After King Ling returned, ashamed of his lack of achievement, he launched large-scale construction, intending to flaunt his power to the vassal states. — Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 67

explanation: 纵横交错。老人泪流满面，形容极度悲伤或激动。
explanationTraditional: 縱橫交錯。老人淚流滿面，形容極度悲傷或激動。
explanationEn: An old person's face streaming with tears; extremely sad or moved.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他的儿子在前线光荣牺牲，听到这个消息，他不禁老泪纵横。
exampleTraditional: 他的兒子在前線光榮犧牲，聽到這個消息，他不禁老淚縱橫。
exampleEn: Upon hearing the news that his son had died gloriously at the front, he could not help but weep bitterly.

explanation: 伟大的理想，宏伟的志愿。
explanationTraditional: 偉大的理想，宏偉的志願。
explanationEn: Great ambition and lofty aspirations.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 雄心壮志是促使一个人永远奋斗的发动机。
exampleTraditional: 雄心壯志是促使一個人永遠奮鬥的發動機。
exampleEn: Great ambition and lofty aspirations are the engine that drives a person to strive forever.

explanation: 用欺骗的手段在暗地里活动。
explanationTraditional: 用欺騙的手段在暗地裡活動。
explanationEn: To deceive someone by underhanded means; to act in secret.
derivation: 清·无名氏《三十六记》瞒天过海。”
derivationTraditional: 清·無名氏《三十六記》瞞天過海。”
derivationEn: From the Qing dynasty anonymous work 'The Thirty-Six Stratagems': 'Crossing the sea under camouflage.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 丧失理智，象发了疯一样。形容言行昏乱而荒谬，或残忍可恶到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 喪失理智，象發了瘋一樣。形容言行昏亂而荒謬，或殘忍可惡到了極點。
explanationEn: To lose one's mind; to be frenzied; to be perverse and vicious.
derivation: 《宋史·范如圭传》公不丧心病狂，奈何为此？必遗臭万世矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·範如圭傳》公不喪心病狂，奈何為此？必遺臭萬世矣。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Fan Rugui': 'If you are not insane, how could you do this? You will be reviled for ten thousand generations.'
example: 但是顽固派反对派对于进步文化机关的违法摧残其合法的事业，其～，可谓已达极点。★邹韬奋《患难余生记·进步文化的遭难》
exampleTraditional: 但是頑固派反對派對於進步文化機關的違法摧殘其合法的事業，其～，可謂已達極點。★鄒韜奮《患難餘生記·進步文化的遭難》
exampleEn: But the diehards' illegal destruction of progressive cultural institutions and their legitimate undertakings has reached the peak of insanity. — Zou Taofen, 'Memoirs of Hardship: Persecution of Progressive Culture'

explanation: 眼珠子一动不动地盯着看。形容注意力集中。
explanationTraditional: 眼珠子一動不動地盯著看。形容注意力集中。
explanationEn: To gaze fixedly; to stare without blinking; to be absorbed in watching.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十一老婆婆看着小官人，目不转睛，不觉两泪交流。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十一老婆婆看著小官人，目不轉睛，不覺兩淚交流。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 11: 'The old woman stared at the young man without blinking, and tears streamed down her face.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 相互相；安安稳。指彼此相处没有什么争执或冲突，还过得去。
explanationTraditional: 相互相；安安穩。指彼此相處沒有什麼爭執或衝突，還過得去。
explanationEn: To live in peace with each other; to coexist harmoniously without conflict.
derivation: 宋·邓牧《伯牙琴·吏道》古者君民间相安无事者，固不得无吏，而为员不多。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·鄧牧《伯牙琴·吏道》古者君民間相安無事者，固不得無吏，而為員不多。”
derivationEn: From Deng Mu's 'Boya Qin: On Officials' of the Song Dynasty: 'In ancient times, rulers and people lived in peace without conflict; officials were necessary but few.'
example: 难民母子～地在史太太家里住了两天两夜。★郭沫若《金刚坡下》
exampleTraditional: 難民母子～地在史太太家裡住了兩天兩夜。★郭沫若《金剛坡下》
exampleEn: The refugee mother and son lived peacefully in Mrs. Shi's house for two days and two nights. — Guo Moruo, 'Under the Jinfo Mountain'

explanation: 和和睦；同苟同⊥睦地相处，但不随便附和。
explanationTraditional: 和和睦；同苟同⊥睦地相處，但不隨便附和。
explanationEn: To be harmonious but not conformist; to get along harmoniously while maintaining one's own principles.
derivation: 《论语·子路》君子和而不同，小人同而不和。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子路》君子和而不同，小人同而不和。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Zilu': 'The gentleman is harmonious but not conformist; the petty person is conformist but not harmonious.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 乐好，喜欢。喜欢做善事，乐于拿财物接济有困难的人。
explanationTraditional: 樂好，喜歡。喜歡做善事，樂於拿財物接濟有困難的人。
explanationEn: Delighting in doing good deeds and being generous in giving to those in need.
derivation: 《史记·乐书二》闻徵音，使人乐善而好施；闻羽音，使人整齐而而好礼。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·樂書二》聞徵音，使人樂善而好施；聞羽音，使人整齊而而好禮。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Book of Music II': 'Hearing the zhi note makes people delight in goodness and be generous; hearing the yu note makes people orderly and courteous.'
example: 宋湜懿文多识，名动人主，至与李沅同命。虽去沅远甚，然～，士类归之，亦可尚也。★《宋史·陈彭年传论》
exampleTraditional: 宋湜懿文多識，名動人主，至與李沅同命。雖去沅遠甚，然～，士類歸之，亦可尚也。★《宋史·陳彭年傳論》
exampleEn: Song Shi, with his refined literary talent and extensive knowledge, impressed the ruler and was appointed alongside Li Hang. Although far inferior to Li Hang, he was charitable and generous, and scholars flocked to him, which is commendable. (From 'History of Song: Biography of Chen Pengnian')

explanation: 跑得很快的马再加上一鞭子，使马跑得更快。比喻快上加快，加速前进。
explanationTraditional: 跑得很快的馬再加上一鞭子，使馬跑得更快。比喻快上加快，加速前進。
explanationEn: To spur a fast horse to go even faster; metaphorically, to accelerate progress or speed up work.
derivation: 宋·陆游《村居》诗生僧快马随鞭影，宁作痴人记桔。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《村居》詩生僧快馬隨鞭影，寧作痴人記桔。”
derivationEn: From Lu You's poem 'Village Dwelling' in the Song Dynasty: 'I resent the swift horse following the whip's shadow, preferring to be a fool remembering the orange.'
example: 何不快马加鞭，径赶至苍山，求取伯伯。★明·徐姬《杀狗记》
exampleTraditional: 何不快馬加鞭，徑趕至蒼山，求取伯伯。★明·徐姬《殺狗記》
exampleEn: Why not spur the horse and rush straight to Cangshan to seek your uncle? (From Ming Dynasty Xu Ji's 'Story of Killing a Dog')

explanation: 向归向，指拥护；背背离，指反对。指人民大众的拥护或反对。
explanationTraditional: 向歸向，指擁護；背背離，指反對。指人民大眾的擁護或反對。
explanationEn: The support or opposition of the people; public sentiment for or against.
derivation: 明·余继登《典故纪闻》卷四顾自古国家未有不以勤而兴以怠而衰者，天命去留，人心向背，皆决于是。”
derivationTraditional: 明·餘繼登《典故紀聞》卷四顧自古國家未有不以勤而興以怠而衰者，天命去留，人心向背，皆決於是。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Yu Jideng's 'Records of Anecdotes and Institutions', Volume 4: 'Since ancient times, no state has not risen through diligence and fallen through idleness; the will of Heaven and the support of the people are decided by this.'
example: 国家的盛衰，在于～。
exampleTraditional: 國家的盛衰，在於～。
exampleEn: The rise and fall of a nation depends on the support or opposition of the people.

explanation: 紧要急切的，重要的。不重要，不会影响大局。
explanationTraditional: 緊要急切的，重要的。不重要，不會影響大局。
explanationEn: Of no importance; insignificant; not affecting the overall situation.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十七回可见字音一道，乃读书人不可忽略的。大贤学问渊博，故视为无关紧要；我们后学，却是不可少的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十七回可見字音一道，乃讀書人不可忽略的。大賢學問淵博，故視為無關緊要；我們後學，卻是不可少的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 17: 'Thus, the matter of pronunciation is something scholars cannot neglect. You, with your vast knowledge, regard it as unimportant; but we later learners find it indispensable.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 峰峦重叠环绕，山路蜿蜒曲折。形容山水名胜路径曲折复杂。
explanationTraditional: 峰巒重疊環繞，山路蜿蜒曲折。形容山水名勝路徑曲折複雜。
explanationEn: Peaks and valleys winding around, with mountain paths twisting and turning; describes scenic landscapes with intricate paths.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《欧阳文忠公集·三九·醉翁亭记》山行六七里，渐闻水声潺潺而泻出于两峰之间者，让泉也。峰回路转，有亭翼然临于泉上者，醉翁亭也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《歐陽文忠公集·三九·醉翁亭記》山行六七里，漸聞水聲潺潺而瀉出於兩峰之間者，讓泉也。峰迴路轉，有亭翼然臨於泉上者，醉翁亭也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'The Story of the Drunkard's Pavilion': 'After walking several miles along the mountain, one gradually hears the sound of gurgling water, which flows out between two peaks—that is the Rang Spring. As the peaks turn and the path twists, there stands a pavilion with wings overhanging the spring—that is the Drunkard's Pavilion.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时土葬，人死后埋入土中，死者方得其所，家属方觉心安。
explanationTraditional: 舊時土葬，人死後埋入土中，死者方得其所，家屬方覺心安。
explanationEn: In traditional burial customs, the deceased finds peace only after being buried in the ground, and the family feels at ease.
derivation: 明·冯惟敏《刷儿·骷髅诉冤》曲自古道盖棺事定，入土为安。”明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷三十一亲戚多道‘从来说入土为安，为何要拘定三年？’”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮惟敏《刷兒·骷髏訴冤》曲自古道蓋棺事定，入土為安。”明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷三十一親戚多道‘從來說入土為安，為何要拘定三年？’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Weimin's 'Song of the Skeleton's Complaint': 'Since ancient times, it is said that when the coffin lid is closed, the matter is settled; burial brings peace.' Also from Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 31: 'Many relatives said, 'It has always been said that burial brings peace; why must we wait three years?''
example: 舍妹已断了气，也该出殡了。在家虽好，但一则火烛当心，二者死者亦可以早些～。★清·吴趼人《糊涂世界》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 舍妹已斷了氣，也該出殯了。在家雖好，但一則火燭當心，二者死者亦可以早些～。★清·吳趼人《糊塗世界》第十二回
exampleEn: My younger sister has passed away, and it's time for her funeral. Staying at home is fine, but one must be careful with fire, and the deceased can rest in peace sooner. (From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Confused World', Chapter 12)

explanation: 闻听到。听到了从来没有听到过的事。形容事物新奇罕见。
explanationTraditional: 聞聽到。聽到了從來沒有聽到過的事。形容事物新奇罕見。
explanationEn: To hear something never heard before; describes something novel and rare.
derivation: 《史记·郦生陆贾列传》越中无足与语，至生来，令我日闻所未闻。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·酈生陸賈列傳》越中無足與語，至生來，令我日聞所未聞。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Li Yiji and Lu Jia': 'In Yue, there is no one worth talking to; since your arrival, I hear things I have never heard before every day.'
example: 今日见了紫菱姐姐飞来飞去，业已奇极；谁知还有海外这些异事，真是～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 今日見了紫菱姐姐飛來飛去，業已奇極；誰知還有海外這些異事，真是～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十回
exampleEn: Today, seeing Sister Ziling flying around is already extraordinary; who knew there would be such strange things overseas? Truly unheard of! (From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 60)

explanation: 依据道理，竭力维护自己方面的权益、观点等。
explanationTraditional: 依據道理，竭力維護自己方面的權益、觀點等。
explanationEn: To argue vigorously on the basis of reason; to defend one's rights or views with strong reasoning.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第三十八回老兄既管了一县的事，自己也应该有点主意。外国人呢，固然得罪不起，实在下不去的地方，也该据理力争。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第三十八回老兄既管了一縣的事，自己也應該有點主意。外國人呢，固然得罪不起，實在下不去的地方，也該據理力爭。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Modern Times', Chapter 38: 'Since you are in charge of the county, you should have your own opinions. Foreigners, of course, cannot be offended, but where it is truly unreasonable, you should argue on principle.'
example: 我们再去～，非达到目的不走。★巴金《家》八
exampleTraditional: 我們再去～，非達到目的不走。★巴金《家》八
exampleEn: We will argue on principle again and will not leave until we achieve our goal. (From Ba Jin's 'Family', Chapter 8)

explanation: 寸形容细微短小；铁指武器。手里没有任何武器。
explanationTraditional: 寸形容細微短小；鐵指武器。手裡沒有任何武器。
explanationEn: To have no weapon in hand; unarmed.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百九回郭淮引兵赶来；见维手无寸铁，乃骤马挺枪追之。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百九回郭淮引兵趕來；見維手無寸鐵，乃驟馬挺槍追之。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 109: 'Guo Huai led his troops in pursuit; seeing that Wei was unarmed, he spurred his horse and thrust his spear at him.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 虚空、白。没有空跑这一趟。表示某种行动还是有所收获的。
explanationTraditional: 虛空、白。沒有空跑這一趟。表示某種行動還是有所收穫的。
explanationEn: The trip was not in vain; it was worthwhile; having gained something from the journey.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四十回原来你这回到上海，干了这么一回事，也不虚此一行。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四十回原來你這回到上海，幹了這麼一回事，也不虛此一行。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 40: 'So you came to Shanghai and did such a thing; this trip was not in vain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 逃脱鱼网的鱼。比喻侥幸逃脱的罪犯或敌人。
explanationTraditional: 逃脫魚網的魚。比喻僥倖逃脫的罪犯或敵人。
explanationEn: A fish that escapes the net; a criminal or enemy who narrowly escapes capture.
derivation: 《史记·酷吏列传序》网漏于吞舟之鱼。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·酷吏列傳序》網漏於吞舟之魚。”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Cruel Officials: 'The net is so wide that it lets through fish as big as a boat.'
example: 他两个忙忙如丧家之狗，急急似漏网之鱼。★元·郑廷玉《后庭花》第二折
exampleTraditional: 他兩個忙忙如喪家之狗，急急似漏網之魚。★元·鄭廷玉《後庭花》第二折
exampleEn: The two of them were as frantic as lost dogs, as desperate as fish escaping the net. — Yuan Dynasty, Zheng Tingyu, 'Backyard Flowers', Act 2

explanation: 船只乘着风势破浪前进。比喻排除困难，奋勇前进。
explanationTraditional: 船隻乘著風勢破浪前進。比喻排除困難，奮勇前進。
explanationEn: To ride the wind and break the waves; to overcome difficulties and forge ahead courageously.
derivation: 《宋书·宗悫传》悫年少时，炳问其志，悫曰‘愿乘长风破万里浪。’”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·宗愨傳》愨年少時，炳問其志，愨曰‘願乘長風破萬里浪。’”
derivationEn: Book of Song: Biography of Zong Que: 'When Zong Que was young, his uncle Bing asked him about his ambition. Zong Que replied, 'I wish to ride the long wind and break the mighty waves.'
example: 轮船在～，汽车在驶过原野。★茅盾《子夜》五
exampleTraditional: 輪船在～，汽車在駛過原野。★茅盾《子夜》五
exampleEn: Steamships ride the wind and break the waves, cars speed across the plains. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 5

explanation: 拔超出；类同类；萃原为草丛生的样子，引伸为聚集。超出同类之上。多指人的品德才能。
explanationTraditional: 拔超出；類同類；萃原為草叢生的樣子，引伸為聚集。超出同類之上。多指人的品德才能。
explanationEn: To stand out from one's peers; to be outstanding in virtue or talent.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》出于其类，拔乎其萃，自生民以来，未有盛于孔子也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》出於其類，拔乎其萃，自生民以來，未有盛於孔子也。”
derivationEn: Mencius: Gongsun Chou I: 'He stands out from his kind, excels above the crowd. Since the beginning of humanity, there has been none greater than Confucius.'
example: 而在那海一样的人民当中，到处都有～的劳动英雄，这些英雄本身就是人民当中开出的鲜艳花朵。★杨朔《迎春词》
exampleTraditional: 而在那海一樣的人民當中，到處都有～的勞動英雄，這些英雄本身就是人民當中開出的鮮豔花朵。★楊朔《迎春詞》
exampleEn: Among the sea of people, there are labor heroes who stand out from the crowd; these heroes themselves are the bright flowers blooming among the people. — Yang Shuo, 'Spring Greeting'

explanation: 比喻想尽一切办法。
explanationTraditional: 比喻想盡一切辦法。
explanationEn: To rack one's brains; to think of every possible way.
derivation: 鲁迅《花边文学·考场三丑》例如问《十三经》是什么，文天祥是那朝人，全用不着自己来挖空心思做，一做，倒糟糕。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《花邊文學·考場三醜》例如問《十三經》是什麼，文天祥是那朝人，全用不著自己來挖空心思做，一做，倒糟糕。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun, 'Floral Marginalia: Three Ugly Scenes in the Examination Hall': 'For example, asking what the Thirteen Classics are or which dynasty Wen Tianxiang belonged to—there's no need to rack your brains over them; if you do, you'll end up in trouble.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 只要有人请求帮助，就一定答应。
explanationTraditional: 只要有人請求幫助，就一定答應。
explanationEn: To respond to every request; to grant whatever is asked.
derivation: 清·霁园主人《夜谭随录·崔秀才》往日良朋密友，有求必应。”
derivationTraditional: 清·霽園主人《夜譚隨錄·崔秀才》往日良朋密友，有求必應。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Ji Yuan Zhuren, 'Night Talks at the Sui Studio: Scholar Cui': 'In the past, good friends and close companions would respond to every request.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 暴露显露，显现；遗遗漏。全都暴露出来。
explanationTraditional: 暴露顯露，顯現；遺遺漏。全都暴露出來。
explanationEn: To be completely exposed; to be revealed without any concealment.
derivation: 周恩来《评马歇尔离华声明》美帝国主义的对华政策已原形毕露，蒋介石政府的卖国外交亦暴露无遗。”
derivationTraditional: 周恩來《評馬歇爾離華聲明》美帝國主義的對華政策已原形畢露，蔣介石政府的賣國外交亦暴露無遺。”
derivationEn: Zhou Enlai, 'Comment on Marshall's Statement on Leaving China': 'The U.S. imperialist policy toward China has been fully revealed, and the Chiang Kai-shek government's sellout diplomacy is also completely exposed.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 廉便宜。东西价钱便宜，质量又好。
explanationTraditional: 廉便宜。東西價錢便宜，質量又好。
explanationEn: Low price and fine quality; inexpensive and good.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《近十年之怪现状》第十回苏州有个朋友写信来，要印一部书。久仰贵局的价廉物美，所以特来求教。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《近十年之怪現狀》第十回蘇州有個朋友寫信來，要印一部書。久仰貴局的價廉物美，所以特來求教。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Ten Years', Chapter 10: 'A friend from Suzhou wrote to say he wanted to print a book. I have long heard that your press offers low prices and fine quality, so I came to ask for your advice.'
example: 福兴楼的清炖鱼翅，一元一大盘，～，现在不知增加了否？（鲁迅《彷徨·祝福》）
exampleTraditional: 福興樓的清燉魚翅，一元一大盤，～，現在不知增加了否？（魯迅《彷徨·祝福》）
exampleEn: The steamed shark's fin at Fuxing Restaurant costs one yuan per large plate, cheap and good. I wonder if it's still available now? — Lu Xun, 'Wandering: New Year's Sacrifice'

explanation: 形容漏洞、弊病很多，或破坏的程度严重。
explanationTraditional: 形容漏洞、弊病很多，或破壞的程度嚴重。
explanationEn: A thousand boils and a hundred holes; riddled with problems or severely damaged.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《与孟尚书书》汉室以来，群儒区区修补，百孔千疮，随乱随失，其危如一发引千钧。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《與孟尚書書》漢室以來，群儒區區修補，百孔千瘡，隨亂隨失，其危如一發引千鈞。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Letter to Meng Shangshu': 'Since the Han dynasty, scholars have patched things up here and there, but the country is full of holes and cracks, falling apart as soon as it's mended, as precarious as a hair pulling a thousand tons.'
example: 让他们都显显身手，谁能把这个～的中国从热火里救出来，算谁有本事。★梁斌《红旗谱》四十九
exampleTraditional: 讓他們都顯顯身手，誰能把這個～的中國從熱火裡救出來，算誰有本事。★梁斌《紅旗譜》四十九
exampleEn: Let them all show their skills. Whoever can save this battered China from the fire is truly capable. — Liang Bin, 'Red Flag Chronicle', Chapter 49

explanation: 嗤讥笑。用鼻子吭声冷笑。表示轻蔑。
explanationTraditional: 嗤譏笑。用鼻子吭聲冷笑。表示輕蔑。
explanationEn: To snort at; to despise; to treat with contempt.
derivation: 《后汉书·樊宏传》尝欲作器物，先种梓漆，时人嗤之。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·樊宏傳》嘗欲作器物，先種梓漆，時人嗤之。”
derivationEn: Book of Later Han: Biography of Fan Hong: 'He once wanted to make utensils, so he first planted catalpa and lacquer trees. People at the time sneered at him.'
example: 说于乡，乡人笑之；说于市，市人非之；请于巨绅贵族，更～。★清·颐琐《黄绣球》第七回
exampleTraditional: 說於鄉，鄉人笑之；說於市，市人非之；請於巨紳貴族，更～。★清·頤瑣《黃繡球》第七回
exampleEn: He spoke of it in the village, and the villagers laughed at him; he spoke of it in the market, and the market people criticized him; he begged the gentry and nobles, and they snorted at him. — Qing Dynasty, Gu Suo, 'Yellow Embroidered Ball', Chapter 7

explanation: 意意味；盎然洋溢，深厚。春天的意味正浓。
explanationTraditional: 意意味；盎然洋溢，深厚。春天的意味正濃。
explanationEn: Spring is in the air; the atmosphere is full of spring.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 北国依然春寒料峭，南国却已～了。
exampleTraditional: 北國依然春寒料峭，南國卻已～了。
exampleEn: The north is still chilly in early spring, but the south is already brimming with spring.

explanation: 一口咬定，死不承认。
explanationTraditional: 一口咬定，死不承認。
explanationEn: To flatly deny; to assert one's innocence stubbornly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 对于他所犯的罪行，他矢口否认。
exampleTraditional: 對於他所犯的罪行，他矢口否認。
exampleEn: He flatly denied the crimes he had committed.

explanation: 原封没有开封。原来贴的封口没有动过。比喻完全按照原样，一点不加变动。
explanationTraditional: 原封沒有開封。原來貼的封口沒有動過。比喻完全按照原樣，一點不加變動。
explanationEn: Completely unchanged; exactly as before.
derivation: 元·王仲文《救孝子》第四折是你的老婆，这等呵，我可也原封不动，送还你罢。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王仲文《救孝子》第四折是你的老婆，這等呵，我可也原封不動，送還你罷。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Wang Zhongwen's play 'Saving the Filial Son', Act 4: 'If she is your wife, then I will return her to you untouched.'
example: 他把那个人送来的礼物～地退了回去。
exampleTraditional: 他把那個人送來的禮物～地退了回去。
exampleEn: He returned the gift exactly as it was.

explanation: 比拟比较。没有可以相比的。
explanationTraditional: 比擬比較。沒有可以相比的。
explanationEn: Incomparable; unparalleled.
derivation: 毛泽东《新民主主义论》这是一个绝大的变化，这是自有世界历史和中国历史以来无可比拟的大变化。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《新民主主義論》這是一個絕大的變化，這是自有世界歷史和中國歷史以來無可比擬的大變化。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'On New Democracy': 'This is an immense change, an unparalleled change in world history and Chinese history.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 登上高处，看得更远。也比喻思想境界高，目光远大。
explanationTraditional: 登上高處，看得更遠。也比喻思想境界高，目光遠大。
explanationEn: To stand high and see far; to have a broad vision or lofty ideals.
derivation: 《荀子·劝学》我尝跂高而望矣，不如登高之博见也。”《吕氏春秋·顺说》顺风而呼，声不加疾也，际高而望，目不加明也，所因便也。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·勸學》我嘗跂高而望矣，不如登高之博見也。”《呂氏春秋·順說》順風而呼，聲不加疾也，際高而望，目不加明也，所因便也。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi's 'Encouraging Learning': 'I once stood on tiptoe to look far, but it was not as good as climbing high to see broadly.' Also from Lüshi Chunqiu: 'Shouting with the wind does not increase the sound, but standing high to look does not make the eyes brighter; it is because of the advantage.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 番遍数。一再，多次。
explanationTraditional: 番遍數。一再，多次。
explanationEn: Again and again; repeatedly; many times.
derivation: 元·郑德辉《王粲登楼》第一折你将书呈三番两次调发小生到此，萧条旅馆，个月期程，不蒙放参。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭德輝《王粲登樓》第一折你將書呈三番兩次調發小生到此，蕭條旅館，個月期程，不蒙放參。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zheng Dehui's play 'Wang Can Ascends the Tower', Act 1: 'You have sent letters repeatedly to summon me here...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在石板上钉上铁钉。比喻事情已经决定，不能改变。
explanationTraditional: 在石板上釘上鐵釘。比喻事情已經決定，不能改變。
explanationEn: To nail it down; something that is settled and cannot be changed.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第九十三回议亲之事，这三位老伯，并儿的外父一并说好，那就石板上钉钉，就如我爹订的一般。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第九十三回議親之事，這三位老伯，並兒的外父一併說好，那就石板上釘釘，就如我爹訂的一般。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Lüyuan's 'The Road to the Lamp', Chapter 93: 'This marriage proposal is agreed upon by the three elders and your father-in-law; it is as good as nailed down, just like my father's decision.'
example: 海云是已经定性、已经作了～的正式结论的阶级敌人。★王蒙《蝴蝶》
exampleTraditional: 海雲是已經定性、已經作了～的正式結論的階級敵人。★王蒙《蝴蝶》
exampleEn: Haiyun was already a class enemy with a final verdict nailed down. — Wang Meng's 'Butterfly'

explanation: 杞周代诸侯国名，在今河南杞县一带。杞国有个人怕天塌下来。比喻不必要的或缺乏根据的忧虑和担心。
explanationTraditional: 杞周代諸侯國名，在今河南杞縣一帶。杞國有個人怕天塌下來。比喻不必要的或缺乏根據的憂慮和擔心。
explanationEn: Unnecessary or groundless worry; like the man of Qi who feared the sky would fall.
derivation: 《列子·天瑞》杞国有人，忧天地崩坠，身亡所寄，废寝食者。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·天瑞》杞國有人，憂天地崩墜，身亡所寄，廢寢食者。”
derivationEn: From Liezi's 'Tian Rui': 'A man of Qi worried that the sky would fall and the earth would collapse, leaving him no place to live, so he abandoned sleep and food.'
example: ～，伯虑愁眼。（清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二十七回）
exampleTraditional: ～，伯慮愁眼。（清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二十七回）
exampleEn: Like the man of Qi worrying about the sky, and the man of Bo worrying about his eyes. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 27

explanation: 形容心中非常满意。
explanationTraditional: 形容心中非常滿意。
explanationEn: To be completely satisfied; contented.
derivation: 宋·吕祖谦《晋论》中君臣上下，自以为江东之业为万世之安，心满意足。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·呂祖謙《晉論》中君臣上下，自以為江東之業為萬世之安，心滿意足。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Lü Zuqian's 'On Jin': 'The ruler and ministers thought their Jiangdong enterprise would last forever, and they were fully satisfied.'
example: 两个小的，亦被武松搠死……武松道我方才～，走了罢休！”★明·施耐庵《水浒传》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 兩個小的，亦被武松搠死……武松道我方才～，走了罷休！”★明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第三十一回
exampleEn: The two young men were also killed by Wu Song... Wu Song said, 'Now I am fully satisfied, let's go!' — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 31

explanation: 到处都存在，到处都有。
explanationTraditional: 到處都存在，到處都有。
explanationEn: Omnipresent; existing everywhere.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 真理是无所不在的。
exampleTraditional: 真理是無所不在的。
exampleEn: Truth is omnipresent.

explanation: 荡摇动。动荡亿，不安定。形容局势不稳定，不平静。
explanationTraditional: 蕩搖動。動盪億，不安定。形容局勢不穩定，不平靜。
explanationEn: Turbulent; unstable; in a state of upheaval.
derivation: 欧阳山《三家巷》第十八章他和陈文婷谈起，两人都觉得纵然社会上动荡不安，革命的前途还是光明的，乐观的。”
derivationTraditional: 歐陽山《三家巷》第十八章他和陳文婷談起，兩人都覺得縱然社會上動盪不安，革命的前途還是光明的，樂觀的。”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Shan's 'Three Family Lane', Chapter 18: 'He and Chen Wenting talked, and both felt that although society was turbulent, the revolutionary future was still bright and optimistic.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一抬手，一动脚。形容轻而易举，毫不费力。
explanationTraditional: 一抬手，一動腳。形容輕而易舉，毫不費力。
explanationEn: A lift of the hand or a move of the foot. Describes something extremely easy and effortless.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《应科目时与人书》庸讵知有力者不哀其穷，而忘一举手一投足之劳而转之清波乎？”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《應科目時與人書》庸詎知有力者不哀其窮，而忘一舉手一投足之勞而轉之清波乎？”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Letter to Someone on the Subject of the Examination' in the Tang Dynasty: 'How do you know that a powerful person, pitying his poverty, would not forget the effort of a single lift of the hand or move of the foot and turn him into clear waves?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 张看。形容这里那里地到处看。
explanationTraditional: 張看。形容這裡那裡地到處看。
explanationEn: To look around in all directions; to glance this way and that.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷一三巧儿只为信了卖卦先生之语，一心只想丈夫回来，从此时常走向前楼，在帘内东张西望。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷一三巧兒只為信了賣卦先生之語，一心只想丈夫回來，從此時常走向前樓，在簾內東張西望。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories Old and New' in the Ming Dynasty: 'Sanqiao'er, believing the fortune-teller's words, only wanted her husband to return, so she often went to the front building and looked east and west from behind the curtain.'
example: 见范进抱着鸡，手里插个草标，一步一踱的，～，在那里寻人买。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleTraditional: 見范進抱著雞，手裡插個草標，一步一踱的，～，在那裡尋人買。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleEn: Seeing Fan Jin holding a chicken with a straw tag in his hand, pacing slowly, looking east and west, looking for someone to buy. — Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 3

explanation: 比喻三方面对立的局势。
explanationTraditional: 比喻三方面對立的局勢。
explanationEn: A situation of tripartite confrontation or balance of power.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》臣愿披腹心，输肝胆，效愚计，恐足下不能用也。诚能听臣之计，莫若两利而俱存之，三分天下，鼎足而居，其势莫敢先动。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》臣願披腹心，輸肝膽，效愚計，恐足下不能用也。誠能聽臣之計，莫若兩利而俱存之，三分天下，鼎足而居，其勢莫敢先動。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin': 'I wish to bare my heart, pour out my liver and gall, and offer a foolish plan, but I fear you cannot use it. If you can listen to my plan, nothing is better than benefiting both and preserving both, dividing the world into three parts, standing like a tripod, so that no one dares to move first.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 归还给。把物品还给原来的主人。
explanationTraditional: 歸還給。把物品還給原來的主人。
explanationEn: To return something to its original owner.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷三十五他不生儿女，就过继着你家儿子，承领了这家私，物归旧主，岂非天意。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷三十五他不生兒女，就過繼著你家兒子，承領了這傢俬，物歸舊主，豈非天意。”
derivationEn: From Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement, Part One' in the Ming Dynasty: 'He had no children, so he adopted your son to inherit the family property. Returning the property to its original owner is surely heaven's will.'
example: 不是没收吧？又～啦？这可是喜事！★老舍《茶馆》第三幕
exampleTraditional: 不是沒收吧？又～啦？這可是喜事！★老舍《茶館》第三幕
exampleEn: Isn't it confiscated? Returned to the original owner? This is a happy event! — Lao She, 'Teahouse', Act 3

explanation: 不以万里为远。形容不怕路途遥远。
explanationTraditional: 不以萬里為遠。形容不怕路途遙遠。
explanationEn: To not consider ten thousand li too far; to make light of traveling a great distance.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》王曰‘叟，不远千里而来，亦将有以利吾国乎？’”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》王曰‘叟，不遠千里而來，亦將有以利吾國乎？’”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: King Hui of Liang, Part I': 'The king said, 'Old man, you have come a thousand li without considering it far; will you bring profit to my kingdom?'
example: 受加拿大共产党和美国共产党的派遣，～，来到中国。★毛泽东《纪念白求恩》
exampleTraditional: 受加拿大共產黨和美國共產黨的派遣，～，來到中國。★毛澤東《紀念白求恩》
exampleEn: Sent by the Communist Party of Canada and the Communist Party of the United States, they came from afar, not considering ten thousand li too far. — Mao Zedong, 'In Memory of Norman Bethune'

explanation: 悬在半空中的阁楼。比喻虚幻的事物或脱离实际的空想。
explanationTraditional: 懸在半空中的閣樓。比喻虛幻的事物或脫離實際的空想。
explanationEn: A castle in the air; an illusion or unrealistic fantasy.
derivation: 《史记·天官书》海旁蜃气象楼台，广野气成宫阙然。”唐·宋之问《游法华寺》诗空中结楼殿，意表出云霞。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·天官書》海旁蜃氣象樓臺，廣野氣成宮闕然。”唐·宋之問《遊法華寺》詩空中結樓殿，意表出雲霞。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Book of Celestial Offices': 'By the sea, mirages form towers; in the wilds, vapors form palaces.' Also from Song Zhiwen's poem 'Visiting Fahua Temple': 'In the sky, buildings and halls are built; beyond thought, clouds and rosy clouds appear.'
example: 实者，就事敷陈，不假造作，有根有据之谓也；虚者，～，随意构成，无影无形之谓也。★清·李渔《闲情偶寄·结构第一》
exampleTraditional: 實者，就事敷陳，不假造作，有根有據之謂也；虛者，～，隨意構成，無影無形之謂也。★清·李漁《閒情偶寄·結構第一》
exampleEn: The real is to narrate facts without fabrication, with evidence; the unreal is a castle in the air, arbitrarily constructed, without form or shadow. — Li Yu, 'Casual Expressions of Idle Feelings: Structure First'

explanation: 指家庭日常生活琐事。
explanationTraditional: 指家庭日常生活瑣事。
explanationEn: Trivial domestic affairs; household chores and gossip.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第七十五回这一关了门，他再问我家长里短的事，我对不来，却不弄走了风，被他拿住？”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第七十五回這一關了門，他再問我家長裡短的事，我對不來，卻不弄走了風，被他拿住？”
derivationEn: From Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West' in the Ming Dynasty, Chapter 75: 'If he closes the door and asks me about family affairs, and I cannot answer, won't I reveal the secret and be caught?'
example: 便是禇大娘子，也和她两年有余不曾长篇大论的谈过个～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 便是禇大娘子，也和她兩年有餘不曾長篇大論的談過個～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十一回
exampleEn: Even Mrs. Chu had not had a long talk with her about family affairs for over two years. — Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroic Sons and Daughters', Chapter 21

explanation: 通宵通夜，整夜；达到；旦天亮。整整一夜，从天黑到天亮。
explanationTraditional: 通宵通夜，整夜；達到；旦天亮。整整一夜，從天黑到天亮。
explanationEn: All night long; from dusk to dawn.
derivation: 鲁迅《华盖集续编·无花的蔷薇之三》乙校昨夜通宵达旦，将赤化书籍完全焚烧矣。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《華蓋集續編·無花的薔薇之三》乙校昨夜通宵達旦，將赤化書籍完全焚燒矣。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'A Sequel to the Huagai Collection: Roses Without Thorns, Part 3': 'Last night, School B burned all the red books all night long until dawn.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指用钱满不在乎，一花就是一大笔。
explanationTraditional: 指用錢滿不在乎，一花就是一大筆。
explanationEn: To spend money extravagantly; to throw away a thousand gold pieces at one go.
derivation: 唐·吴象之《少年行》一掷千金浑是胆，家无四壁不知贫。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·吳象之《少年行》一擲千金渾是膽，家無四壁不知貧。”
derivationEn: From Wu Xiangzhi's 'Song of the Youth' in the Tang Dynasty: 'Throwing a thousand gold pieces at one go, he is bold; with not even four walls at home, he knows no poverty.'
example: 他仅用几句话，就把那种奢侈豪华，～的情景描绘出来了。
exampleTraditional: 他僅用幾句話，就把那種奢侈豪華，～的情景描繪出來了。
exampleEn: With just a few words, he depicted the luxurious and extravagant scene of spending money like water.

explanation: 凿凿确实。形容说得非常确实。
explanationTraditional: 鑿鑿確實。形容說得非常確實。
explanationEn: To speak with certainty; to say something convincingly.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·段氏》言之凿凿，确可信据。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·段氏》言之鑿鑿，確可信據。”
derivationEn: From Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Duan Family' in the Qing Dynasty: 'He spoke with certainty, and it could be reliably believed.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 挥洒，泼。形容天热出汗多。
explanationTraditional: 揮灑，潑。形容天熱出汗多。
explanationEn: To sweat profusely, usually due to hot weather or hard work.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策一》连衽成帷，举袂成幕，挥汗成雨。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策一》連衽成帷，舉袂成幕，揮汗成雨。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States·Qi Strategy I': 'When they join their lapels, they form a curtain; when they raise their sleeves, they form a screen; when they wipe off sweat, it falls like rain.'
example: 其人伏地惕息，～，自是怏怏如胅。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·滦阳消夏录五》
exampleTraditional: 其人伏地惕息，～，自是怏怏如胅。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·灤陽消夏錄五》
exampleEn: The man prostrated himself trembling, sweating like rain, and from then on he was dejected as if ill. — Qing Dynasty, Ji Yun, 'Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Scrutiny·Book Five of Luanyang Summer Records'

explanation: 神话传说，仙女的衣服没有衣缝。比喻事物周密完善，找不出什么毛病。
explanationTraditional: 神話傳說，仙女的衣服沒有衣縫。比喻事物周密完善，找不出什麼毛病。
explanationEn: Flawless; perfect; without any defects or loopholes.
derivation: 前蜀·牛峤《灵怪录·郭翰》徐视其衣并无缝，翰问之，曰‘天衣本非针线为也。’”
derivationTraditional: 前蜀·牛嶠《靈怪錄·郭翰》徐視其衣並無縫，翰問之，曰‘天衣本非針線為也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Strange Tales of the Supernatural·Guo Han' by Niu Qiao (Former Shu): 'He looked closely at her clothes and found no seams. When asked, she said, 'Heavenly garments are not made with needle and thread.''
example: 这篇文章立意明确，论述周到、深刻，真可谓～。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章立意明確，論述周到、深刻，真可謂～。
exampleEn: This article has a clear theme, thorough and profound discussion, truly flawless.

explanation: 好象鱼得到水一样。比喻有所凭借。也比喻得到跟自己十分投合的人或对自己很合适的环境。
explanationTraditional: 好象魚得到水一樣。比喻有所憑藉。也比喻得到跟自己十分投合的人或對自己很合適的環境。
explanationEn: Like a fish in water; to be in one's element; to have found a suitable environment or congenial person.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》孤之有孔明，犹鱼之有水也。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀書·諸葛亮傳》孤之有孔明，猶魚之有水也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms·Book of Shu·Biography of Zhuge Liang': 'I have Kongming, just as a fish has water.'
example: 若使他回来了，我们就应该～，欢喜的了不得，那里还有功夫在这里纳闷呢！★清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第三回
exampleTraditional: 若使他回來了，我們就應該～，歡喜的了不得，那裡還有功夫在這裡納悶呢！★清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第三回
exampleEn: If he returns, we should be as happy as a fish in water, and would have no time to be troubled here! — Qing Dynasty, Lingnan Yiyi Nushi, 'The Eastern European Heroine', Chapter 3

explanation: 和尚多，而供和尚喝的粥少。比喻物少人多，不够分配。
explanationTraditional: 和尚多，而供和尚喝的粥少。比喻物少人多，不夠分配。
explanationEn: Too many monks and too little gruel; not enough to go around; supply cannot meet demand.
derivation: 清·西周生《醒世姻缘传》第六十二回师爷的席面是看得见的东西，再要来一个撞席的，便就僧多粥薄，相公就不够吃了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·西周生《醒世姻緣傳》第六十二回師爺的席面是看得見的東西，再要來一個撞席的，便就僧多粥薄，相公就不夠吃了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Xi Zhousheng, 'Marriage That Awakens the World', Chapter 62: 'The teacher's feast is visible, but if another uninvited guest comes, then the monks are many and the gruel thin, and the gentleman will not have enough to eat.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 诿也作委”，推辞；推诿把责任推给别人。彼此之间互相推托，谁也不愿承担责任。
explanationTraditional: 諉也作委”，推辭；推諉把責任推給別人。彼此之間互相推託，誰也不願承擔責任。
explanationEn: To shift responsibility onto each other; to pass the buck.
derivation: 明·李贽《焚书·因记往事》甚至互相推托，以为能明哲。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《焚書·因記往事》甚至互相推託，以為能明哲。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Li Zhi, 'A Book to Burn·Recording Past Events': 'They even shift responsibility onto each other, thinking it wise to protect themselves.'
example: 彼此～，皆弃之不收，反遗之以与金人用。★《新刊大宋宣和遗事》利集
exampleTraditional: 彼此～，皆棄之不收，反遺之以與金人用。★《新刊大宋宣和遺事》利集
exampleEn: They shifted responsibility onto each other, all refusing to accept it, and instead left it for the Jin people. — 'Newly Printed Stories of the Great Song Dynasty·Xuanhe Legacy', Li Ji

explanation: 原为佛家语，指人的本性◇多比喻事物原来的模样。
explanationTraditional: 原為佛家語，指人的本性◇多比喻事物原來的模樣。
explanationEn: Original nature; true self; original state of affairs.
derivation: 唐·慧能《六祖坛经·行由品》不思善，不思恶，正与么时，那个是明上座本来面目。”宋·苏轼《老人行》诗一任秋霜换鬓毛，本来面目长如故。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·慧能《六祖壇經·行由品》不思善，不思惡，正與麼時，那個是明上座本來面目。”宋·蘇軾《老人行》詩一任秋霜換鬢毛，本來面目長如故。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Huineng, 'Platform Sutra·Chapter on Conduct': 'Think not of good, think not of evil; at that moment, what is the original face of Senior Ming?' Also Song Dynasty, Su Shi, 'Poem of the Old Man': 'Though autumn frost changes my temples, my original face remains as before.'
example: 这一润色，留传固然留传了，但可惜的是一定失去了许多～。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文·门外文谈》
exampleTraditional: 這一潤色，留傳固然留傳了，但可惜的是一定失去了許多～。★魯迅《且介亭雜文·門外文談》
exampleEn: This polishing preserves it, but unfortunately it must have lost much of its original form. — Lu Xun, 'Essays from the Semi-Concession·On Writing Outside the Door'

explanation: 拒拒绝。对于有所求而来的人或送上门来的东西概不拒绝。
explanationTraditional: 拒拒絕。對於有所求而來的人或送上門來的東西概不拒絕。
explanationEn: To refuse nobody; to accept all comers or all offers.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心下》夫子之设科也，往者不追，来者不拒。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心下》夫子之設科也，往者不追，來者不拒。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius·Jin Xin II': 'The Master sets up his teaching, not pursuing those who leave, nor refusing those who come.'
example: 弟子就学者不知多少，先生来者不拒，去者不追。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十七回
exampleTraditional: 弟子就學者不知多少，先生來者不拒，去者不追。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十七回
exampleEn: The disciples who came to study were countless; the Master refused none who came and did not pursue those who left. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 87

explanation: 欣喜快乐；若好象；狂失去控制。形容高兴到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 欣喜快樂；若好象；狂失去控制。形容高興到了極點。
explanationEn: To be wild with joy; to be ecstatic.
derivation: 清·霁园主人《夜谭随录·护军女》少年得其应答，惊喜若狂。”
derivationTraditional: 清·霽園主人《夜譚隨錄·護軍女》少年得其應答，驚喜若狂。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Jiyuan Zhuren, 'Tales Told at Night·The Guard's Daughter': 'The young man received her reply, surprised and wild with joy.'
example: 全班同学～，向取得第一名的同学庆祝。
exampleTraditional: 全班同學～，向取得第一名的同學慶祝。
exampleEn: The whole class was wild with joy, celebrating the classmate who won first place.

explanation: 呕吐；沥一滴一滴。比喻用尽心思。多形容为事业、工作、文艺创作等用心的艰苦。
explanationTraditional: 嘔吐；瀝一滴一滴。比喻用盡心思。多形容為事業、工作、文藝創作等用心的艱苦。
explanationEn: To work one's heart out; to expend all one's energy and effort; to take great pains.
derivation: 唐·李商隐《李长吉小传》是儿要当呕出心乃已尔。”唐·韩愈《归彭城》诗刳肝以为纸，沥血以书辞。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李商隱《李長吉小傳》是兒要當嘔出心乃已爾。”唐·韓愈《歸彭城》詩刳肝以為紙，瀝血以書辭。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Shangyin, 'A Short Biography of Li He': 'This child will surely vomit his heart out before he stops.' Also Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Returning to Pengcheng': 'I cut my liver to make paper, and drip blood to write words.'
example: ～，讴歌社会主义，受到群众的欢迎。★臧克家《老舍永在》
exampleTraditional: ～，謳歌社會主義，受到群眾的歡迎。★臧克家《老舍永在》
exampleEn: He worked his heart out eulogizing socialism and was welcomed by the masses. — Zang Kejia, 'Lao She Lives Forever'

explanation: 指农业上认真细致地耕作。
explanationTraditional: 指農業上認真細緻地耕作。
explanationEn: Intensive and meticulous farming; careful and detailed cultivation.
derivation: 毛泽东《做革命的促进派》我们靠精耕细作吃饭，人多一点，还是有饭吃。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《做革命的促進派》我們靠精耕細作吃飯，人多一點，還是有飯吃。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong, 'Be Activists in Promoting the Revolution': 'We rely on intensive farming to feed ourselves; with more people, we still have food.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 汗马将士骑的马奔驰出汗，比喻征战劳苦。指在战场上建立战功。现指辛勤工作做出的贡献。
explanationTraditional: 汗馬將士騎的馬奔馳出汗，比喻征戰勞苦。指在戰場上建立戰功。現指辛勤工作做出的貢獻。
explanationEn: Refers to achievements in battle or hard work that contributes to success.
derivation: 《韩非子·五蠹》弃私家之事，而必汗马之劳。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·五蠹》棄私家之事，而必汗馬之勞。”
derivationEn: From Han Feizi: 'Abandon private affairs to take on the toil of battle.'
example: 将俺丞相～一旦忘了，贬在济南府闲住。★元·王实甫《丽堂春》第四折
exampleTraditional: 將俺丞相～一旦忘了，貶在濟南府閒住。★元·王實甫《麗堂春》第四折
exampleEn: The prime minister's contributions were forgotten, and he was demoted to live idly in Jinan. — Yuan·Wang Shifu, 'The Hall of Spring' Act 4

explanation: 纵放；逝消失。稍微一放松就消失了。形容时间或机会等很容易过去。
explanationTraditional: 縱放；逝消失。稍微一放鬆就消失了。形容時間或機會等很容易過去。
explanationEn: Describes time or opportunity that passes quickly if not seized.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《文与可画画云当谷偃竹记》振笔直遂，以追其所见，如兔起鹘落，少纵则逝矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《文與可畫畫雲當谷偃竹記》振筆直遂，以追其所見，如兔起鶻落，少縱則逝矣。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi: 'Write swiftly to capture what you see, like a hawk striking a hare; a moment's delay and it's gone.'
example: 事机万变，～。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第三十四回
exampleTraditional: 事機萬變，～。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第三十四回
exampleEn: Opportunities change rapidly and are fleeting. — Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic' Chapter 34

explanation: 有远大的眼光和高明的见解。
explanationTraditional: 有遠大的眼光和高明的見解。
explanationEn: Having far-sighted vision and outstanding insight.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 共产党员应是实事求是的模范，又是具有～的模范。（毛泽东《中国共产党在民族战争中的地位》）
exampleTraditional: 共產黨員應是實事求是的模範，又是具有～的模範。（毛澤東《中國共產黨在民族戰爭中的地位》）
exampleEn: Communist Party members should be models of pragmatism and also of far-sightedness. — Mao Zedong, 'The Role of the Chinese Communist Party in the National War'

explanation: 比喻情况万分危急。
explanationTraditional: 比喻情況萬分危急。
explanationEn: Describes a situation of extreme danger, like a hair holding a thousand jun.
derivation: 《汉书·枚乘传》夫以一缕之任，系千钧之重，上悬无极之高，下垂不测之渊，虽甚愚之人，犹知哀其将绝也。”唐·韩愈《与孟尚书书》其危如一发引千钧。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·枚乘傳》夫以一縷之任，系千鈞之重，上懸無極之高，下垂不測之淵，雖甚愚之人，猶知哀其將絕也。”唐·韓愈《與孟尚書書》其危如一發引千鈞。”
derivationEn: From Han Shu: 'A single thread bearing a thousand jun, hanging from an infinite height.' Also from Han Yu: 'The danger is like a hair pulling a thousand jun.'
example: 正在～的时刻，一位不知名的解放军战士奋不顾身跳进冰冷的河水中，救起了落水儿童。
exampleTraditional: 正在～的時刻，一位不知名的解放軍戰士奮不顧身跳進冰冷的河水中，救起了落水兒童。
exampleEn: At the critical moment, an unknown PLA soldier jumped into the icy river to save the child.

explanation: 无须攻击，自己就会破灭。形容论点站不住脚，经不起反驳或攻击。
explanationTraditional: 無須攻擊，自己就會破滅。形容論點站不住腳，經不起反駁或攻擊。
explanationEn: Collapses on its own without attack; used for weak arguments or defenses.
derivation: 晋·干宝《晋记》是故不攻而自败也。”唐·顾德章《上中书门下及礼院详议东都太庙修废状》是有都立庙之言，不攻而自破也。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·幹寶《晉記》是故不攻而自敗也。”唐·顧德章《上中書門下及禮院詳議東都太廟修廢狀》是有都立廟之言，不攻而自破也。”
derivationEn: From Gan Bao's Jin Ji: 'Thus it collapses without attack.' Also from Gu Dezhang: 'The argument collapses without attack.'
example: 郢都无主，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十六回
exampleTraditional: 郢都無主，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十六回
exampleEn: Yingdu had no leader, so it fell without attack. — Ming·Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 76

explanation: 图谋求。振作精神，以求强盛。
explanationTraditional: 圖謀求。振作精神，以求強盛。
explanationEn: To rouse oneself and strive for strength and prosperity.
derivation: 郭沫若《科学的春天》我祝愿中年一代的科学工作者奋发图强，革命加拼命，勇攀世界科学高峰。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《科學的春天》我祝願中年一代的科學工作者奮發圖強，革命加拼命，勇攀世界科學高峰。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo: 'I wish the middle-aged scientists will work hard, strive for strength, and scale the world's scientific peaks.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 筹计谋、谋划；帷幄古代军中帐幕。指拟定作战策略。引申为筹划、指挥。
explanationTraditional: 籌計謀、謀劃；帷幄古代軍中帳幕。指擬定作戰策略。引申為籌劃、指揮。
explanationEn: To devise strategies within a command tent; to plan and direct operations.
derivation: 《史记·高祖本纪》夫运筹帷幄之中，决胜千里之外，吾不如子房。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·高祖本紀》夫運籌帷幄之中，決勝千里之外，吾不如子房。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian: 'Devising strategies within the tent and winning battles a thousand miles away, I am not as good as Zhang Liang.'
example: 妙算神机说子牙，～更无差。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 妙算神機說子牙，～更無差。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第五十六回
exampleEn: Ziya's divine calculations were flawless in the tent. — Ming·Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 56

explanation: 尽完。一起死亡或一同毁灭。
explanationTraditional: 盡完。一起死亡或一同毀滅。
explanationEn: To perish together or be completely destroyed.
derivation: 《列子·天瑞》天地终乎？与我偕终”卢重玄解大小虽殊，同归于尽耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·天瑞》天地終乎？與我偕終”盧重玄解大小雖殊，同歸於盡耳。”
derivationEn: From Liezi: 'Heaven and earth will end with me.' Annotated: 'Though different in size, they all end together.'
example: 只图自己安逸，那管世事艰难，弄到后来，不是～吗？★清·姬文《市声》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 只圖自己安逸，那管世事艱難，弄到後來，不是～嗎？★清·姬文《市聲》第十四回
exampleEn: Seeking only personal comfort, ignoring the world's difficulties, will it not end in mutual destruction? — Qing·Ji Wen, 'The Voice of the Market' Chapter 14

explanation: 并都；茂草木丰盛的样子，引伸为美好。指演唱的音色、唱腔和表达的感情都很动人。
explanationTraditional: 並都；茂草木豐盛的樣子，引伸為美好。指演唱的音色、唱腔和表達的感情都很動人。
explanationEn: Describes a performance where both vocal skill and emotional expression are excellent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 她的演唱声情并茂，极富艺术感染力。
exampleTraditional: 她的演唱聲情並茂，極富藝術感染力。
exampleEn: Her singing was both vocally and emotionally moving, with great artistic appeal.

explanation: 就随。在本地找需要的材料。比喻不依靠外力，充分发挥本单位的潜力。
explanationTraditional: 就隨。在本地找需要的材料。比喻不依靠外力，充分發揮本單位的潛力。
explanationEn: To use local materials or resources; to rely on local potential rather than external help.
derivation: 清·李渔《笠翁偶集·三·手足》噫，岂其娶妻必齐之姜，就地取材，但不失立言之大意而已矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《笠翁偶集·三·手足》噫，豈其娶妻必齊之姜，就地取材，但不失立言之大意而已矣。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu: 'Why must one marry a woman from Qi? Use local materials, as long as the meaning is not lost.'
example: 且此间风气不愿延请外省纂修，～，安得人人班、马？★清·刘坤一《复李少荃中堂》
exampleTraditional: 且此間風氣不願延請外省纂修，～，安得人人班、馬？★清·劉坤一《復李少荃中堂》
exampleEn: Since the local custom is not to hire outside compilers, we must use local talents; how can everyone be a Ban Gu or Sima Qian? — Qing·Liu Kunyi, 'Reply to Li Shaochun'

explanation: 颜开脸面舒开，指笑容。形容心里高兴，满面笑容。
explanationTraditional: 顏開臉面舒開，指笑容。形容心裡高興，滿面笑容。
explanationEn: Beaming with joy; face lit up with smiles.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十九回穿过牌楼，人来人往，莫不喜笑颜开。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十九回穿過牌樓，人來人往，莫不喜笑顏開。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 99: 'Passing through the archway, people came and went, all beaming with joy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 有说有笑，兴致高。形容谈话谈得高兴而有风趣。
explanationTraditional: 有說有笑，興致高。形容談話談得高興而有風趣。
explanationEn: Talk cheerfully and humorously; lively and witty conversation.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《念奴娇·赠夏成玉》词遐想后日蛾眉，两山横黛，谈笑风生颊。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《念奴嬌·贈夏成玉》詞遐想後日蛾眉，兩山橫黛，談笑風生頰。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Xin Qiji's poem 'Nian Nu Jiao: To Xia Chengyu': 'Imagining her future brows like distant mountains, talking and laughing with animated cheeks.'
example: 他嘻嘻笑着，让酒让菜，～，又谈起他的山林生活。★梁斌《播火记》十七
exampleTraditional: 他嘻嘻笑著，讓酒讓菜，～，又談起他的山林生活。★梁斌《播火記》十七
exampleEn: He chuckled, offered wine and dishes, talked cheerfully and humorously, and began to discuss his life in the mountains. ★ Liang Bin, 'Sowing the Flames', Chapter 17

explanation: 按止住。使军队暂不行动。现也比喻暂不开展工作。
explanationTraditional: 按止住。使軍隊暫不行動。現也比喻暫不開展工作。
explanationEn: Hold one's troops back; take no action; bide one's time.
derivation: 《荀子·王制》偃然按兵不动。”《吕氏春秋·恃君览》赵简子按兵而不动。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·王制》偃然按兵不動。”《呂氏春秋·恃君覽》趙簡子按兵而不動。”
derivationEn: 'Xunzi: Kingly System': 'Calmly hold the troops back without moving.' 'Lüshi Chunqiu: Lord of Shijun': 'Zhao Jianzi held his troops back and did not move.'
example: 又听得寨前炮响，史文恭～，只要等他入来，塌了陷坑，山后伏兵齐起，接应捉人。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十八回
exampleTraditional: 又聽得寨前炮響，史文恭～，只要等他入來，塌了陷坑，山後伏兵齊起，接應捉人。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十八回
exampleEn: Hearing the cannon fire outside the stockade, Shi Wengong held his troops back, waiting for them to enter and fall into the pit trap, then the ambush from the rear would rise to capture them. ★ Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 68

explanation: 原指一部合乎道德规范的经典◇用以形容态度庄重严肃，郑重其事。有时含讽刺意味。
explanationTraditional: 原指一部合乎道德規範的經典◇用以形容態度莊重嚴肅，鄭重其事。有時含諷刺意味。
explanationEn: In all seriousness; solemn and earnest; sometimes ironic.
derivation: 晋·葛洪《抱朴子·百家》正经为道义之渊海，子书为增深之川流。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·葛洪《抱朴子·百家》正經為道義之淵海，子書為增深之川流。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Ge Hong's 'Baopuzi: Hundred Schools': 'The orthodox classics are the deep sea of morality and righteousness; the various schools are the rivers that deepen the flow.'
example: 他说话从来都是～，不苟言笑。
exampleTraditional: 他說話從來都是～，不苟言笑。
exampleEn: He always speaks in all seriousness, never frivolous or laughing.

explanation: ①真实的刀枪。②比喻毫不作假，实实在在。
explanationTraditional: ①真實的刀槍。②比喻毫不作假，實實在在。
explanationEn: Real swords and guns; genuine and straightforward; not fake.
derivation: 老舍《龙须沟》第二幕他们在这儿，不是先给孩子们糖吃，然后才真刀真枪的一杀杀一大片？”欧阳山《苦斗》三八你知道么？人家是拿真刀真枪的。不比我们光拿铁笔、扁担。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《龍鬚溝》第二幕他們在這兒，不是先給孩子們糖吃，然後才真刀真槍的一殺殺一大片？”歐陽山《苦鬥》三八你知道麼？人家是拿真刀真槍的。不比我們光拿鐵筆、扁擔。”
derivationEn: Lao She, 'Dragon Beard Ditch', Act 2: 'They don't give candy to the children first, then kill with real swords and guns?' Ouyang Shan, 'Bitter Struggle', Chapter 38: 'You know, they use real swords and guns, not like us with only iron pens and carrying poles.'
example: 我的意思是大敌当前，民族危亡，一个热血男儿就应当～地干，光搞这些意思不大！★魏巍《火凤凰》一七
exampleTraditional: 我的意思是大敵當前，民族危亡，一個熱血男兒就應當～地幹，光搞這些意思不大！★魏巍《火鳳凰》一七
exampleEn: My point is that with the enemy at the gate and the nation in peril, a hot-blooded man should fight with real swords and guns, not just engage in these trivial activities! ★ Wei Wei, 'Fire Phoenix', Chapter 17

explanation: 化化生和养育。指适宜于草木生长的风雨。比喻良好的薰陶和教育。
explanationTraditional: 化化生和養育。指適宜於草木生長的風雨。比喻良好的薰陶和教育。
explanationEn: Life-giving spring breeze and rain; beneficial influence of education.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》有如时春风雨化之者。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》有如時春風雨化之者。”
derivationEn: 'Mencius: Jin Xin I': 'Like timely spring rain that transforms and nurtures.'
example: 满想在这～的环境里，多受一些教益，哪知道刚入党后的一点钟内，就要离开这块令人陶醉的土地。★李英儒《野火春风斗古城》十二章
exampleTraditional: 滿想在這～的環境裡，多受一些教益，哪知道剛入黨後的一點鐘內，就要離開這塊令人陶醉的土地。★李英儒《野火春風斗古城》十二章
exampleEn: Eager to receive more edification in this environment of spring breeze and rain, who would have thought that within an hour of joining the Party, I would have to leave this intoxicating land. ★ Li Yingru, 'Wildfire and Spring Wind in the Old City', Chapter 12

explanation: 天罗张在空中捕鸟的网。天空地面，遍张罗网。指上下四方设置的包围圈。比喻对敌人、逃犯等的严密包围。
explanationTraditional: 天羅張在空中捕鳥的網。天空地面，遍張羅網。指上下四方設置的包圍圈。比喻對敵人、逃犯等的嚴密包圍。
explanationEn: Net above and snare below; tight encirclement; no escape.
derivation: 《大宋宣和遣事》亨集才离阴府恓惶难，又值天罗地风灾。”元·无名氏《锁魔镜》第三折天兵下了天罗地网者，休要走了两洞妖魔。”
derivationTraditional: 《大宋宣和遣事》亨集才離陰府恓惶難，又值天羅地風災。”元·無名氏《鎖魔鏡》第三折天兵下了天羅地網者，休要走了兩洞妖魔。”
derivationEn: 'Da Song Xuanhe Yishi': 'Just escaped the misery of the underworld, only to encounter the net of heaven and the snare of earth.' Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Suo Mo Jing', Act 3: 'The heavenly troops have set up nets above and snares below; do not let the two cave demons escape.'
example: 形成一个使法西斯孙悟空无处逃跑的～，那就是敌人死亡之时了。★毛泽东《论持久战》
exampleTraditional: 形成一個使法西斯孫悟空無處逃跑的～，那就是敵人死亡之時了。★毛澤東《論持久戰》
exampleEn: Forming a tight encirclement from which the fascist Sun Wukong cannot escape—that is the time of their death. ★ Mao Zedong, 'On Protracted War'

explanation: 肩碰着肩，脚碰着脚。形容人多拥挤。
explanationTraditional: 肩碰著肩，腳碰著腳。形容人多擁擠。
explanationEn: Shoulder to shoulder and heel to heel; crowded with people.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策一》临淄之途，车毂击，人肩摩。”《宋史·李显忠传》入城，宣布德意，不戮一人，中原归附者踵接。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策一》臨淄之途，車轂擊，人肩摩。”《宋史·李顯忠傳》入城，宣佈德意，不戮一人，中原歸附者踵接。”
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy I': 'On the roads of Linzi, carriage hubs collide, people's shoulders rub.' 'Song History: Li Xianzhong Biography': 'Entering the city, he proclaimed virtue, killed no one, and those from the Central Plains who submitted followed heel to heel.'
example: 节日的公园里，游人～，十分拥挤。
exampleTraditional: 節日的公園裡，遊人～，十分擁擠。
exampleEn: In the park on holidays, visitors are shoulder to shoulder, extremely crowded.

explanation: 意外的灾祸。
explanationTraditional: 意外的災禍。
explanationEn: Unexpected disaster; sudden misfortune.
derivation: 《后汉书·周荣传》若卒遇飞祸，无得殡敛。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·周榮傳》若卒遇飛禍，無得殯斂。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Zhou Rong Biography': 'If one suddenly encounters a flying calamity, there is no need for burial.'
example: 不到得惹出～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷十一
exampleTraditional: 不到得惹出～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷十一
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, it brought about a sudden disaster. ★ Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Amazement', Volume 11

explanation: 指独出心裁，创造新花样。
explanationTraditional: 指獨出心裁，創造新花樣。
explanationEn: Innovate; create new styles or patterns.
derivation: 清·孙道干《小螺庵病榻忆语》附录·姜葆初《用十五咸全韵》天吴柴凤绣垂缪，花样翻新新色嵌。”
derivationTraditional: 清·孫道幹《小螺庵病榻憶語》附錄·姜葆初《用十五鹹全韻》天吳柴鳳繡垂繆，花樣翻新新色嵌。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Sun Daogan's 'Xiao Luo An Bing Ta Yi Lu' appendix, Jiang Baochu's 'Using the Fifteen Xian Rhyme': 'Embroidered with celestial Wu and Chai Feng, new patterns and fresh colors inlaid.'
example: ～，无奇不有。★孙犁《秀露集·第一个洞》
exampleTraditional: ～，無奇不有。★孫犁《秀露集·第一個洞》
exampleEn: Innovations abound, nothing is too strange. ★ Sun Li, 'Xiulu Collection: The First Cave'

explanation: 原指画竹子要在心里有一幅竹子的形象◇比喻在做事之前已经拿定主意。
explanationTraditional: 原指畫竹子要在心裡有一幅竹子的形象◇比喻在做事之前已經拿定主意。
explanationEn: To have a well-thought-out plan or idea before taking action.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《文与可画筼箉谷偃竹记》故画竹，必先得成竹于胸中。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《文與可畫篔箉谷偃竹記》故畫竹，必先得成竹於胸中。”
derivationEn: Su Shi of Song Dynasty: 'When painting bamboo, one must first have the complete image of bamboo in mind.'
example: 毛委员～，决定马上向南去追赶部队。★陈伯钧《毛主席率领我们上井岗山》
exampleTraditional: 毛委員～，決定馬上向南去追趕部隊。★陳伯鈞《毛主席率領我們上井崗山》
exampleEn: Commissioner Mao, having a well-thought-out plan, decided to immediately head south to catch up with the troops.

explanation: 指地理位置靠近山岭和水流。
explanationTraditional: 指地理位置靠近山嶺和水流。
explanationEn: Located near mountains and rivers; describing a scenic location.
derivation: 宋·叶適《安集两淮申省状》奔迸渡江求活者几二十万家，而依山傍水相保聚以自固者亦几二十万家。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·葉適《安集兩淮申省狀》奔迸渡江求活者幾二十萬家，而依山傍水相保聚以自固者亦幾二十萬家。”
derivationEn: Ye Shi of Song Dynasty: 'Nearly 200,000 families fled across the river to survive, and nearly 200,000 families gathered near mountains and rivers to protect themselves.'
example: 维曰陈仓城池坚固，郝昭守御甚密，又得王双相助，实不可取。不若令一大将，～，下寨固守。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十七回
exampleTraditional: 維曰陳倉城池堅固，郝昭守禦甚密，又得王雙相助，實不可取。不若令一大將，～，下寨固守。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十七回
exampleEn: Wei said: 'Chencang's city walls are solid, Hao Zhao defends it tightly, and with Wang Shuang's help, it's truly unassailable. It's better to send a general to camp near mountains and rivers and hold firm.'

explanation: 眈眈注视的样子。象老虎那样凶狠地盯着。形容心怀不善，伺机攫取。
explanationTraditional: 眈眈注視的樣子。象老虎那樣兇狠地盯著。形容心懷不善，伺機攫取。
explanationEn: To glare like a tiger; to watch covetously or menacingly, waiting for an opportunity to seize.
derivation: 《周易·颐》虎视耽耽，其欲逐逐。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·頤》虎視耽耽，其欲逐逐。”
derivationEn: Book of Changes: 'The tiger glares fiercely, its desire pursuing.'
example: 你看这里这些人，因见老太太多疼了宝玉和凤姐姐两个，他们尚～，背地里言三语四的，何况于我？★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十回
exampleTraditional: 你看這裡這些人，因見老太太多疼了寶玉和鳳姐姐兩個，他們尚～，背地裡言三語四的，何況於我？★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十回
exampleEn: Look at these people here; because the old lady dotes on Baoyu and Sister Feng, they glare covetously and gossip behind their backs, let alone me.

explanation: 吉吉利，顺利。什么事都很圆满顺利。也指一切事情都已办好。
explanationTraditional: 吉吉利，順利。什麼事都很圓滿順利。也指一切事情都已辦好。
explanationEn: Everything is going smoothly; all is well.
derivation: 宋·周密《癸辛杂志》盐官教谕黄谦之题桃符板，句云‘宜人新年怎生呵？百事大吉那般者。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《癸辛雜誌》鹽官教諭黃謙之題桃符板，句雲‘宜人新年怎生呵？百事大吉那般者。’”
derivationEn: Zhou Mi of Song Dynasty: 'Salt official Huang Qianzhi wrote on a peachwood charm: 'How will the new year be? Everything will be auspicious.''
example: 乡村里没有警察，没有宪兵，没有被捕的危险。即便有，在高粱地里一藏，～。★梁斌《红旗谱》五三
exampleTraditional: 鄉村裡沒有警察，沒有憲兵，沒有被捕的危險。即便有，在高粱地裡一藏，～。★梁斌《紅旗譜》五三
exampleEn: In the countryside, there are no police, no soldiers, no danger of arrest. Even if there is, just hide in the sorghum field, and everything will be fine.

explanation: 鳌头宫殿门前台阶上的鳌鱼浮雕，科举进士发榜时状元站此迎榜。科举时代指点状元。比喻占首位或第一名。
explanationTraditional: 鰲頭宮殿門前臺階上的鰲魚浮雕，科舉進士發榜時狀元站此迎榜。科舉時代指點狀元。比喻佔首位或第一名。
explanationEn: To come first; to be the top scorer or leader.
derivation: 元·无名氏《陈州粜米》楔子殿前曾献升平策，独占鳌头第一名。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《陳州糶米》楔子殿前曾獻昇平策，獨佔鰲頭第一名。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty anonymous: 'Presented peace strategies before the palace, stood alone on the turtle's head as the top scholar.'
example: 一战胜群贤，～高选。★明·谢谠《四喜记·乡荐荣欢》
exampleTraditional: 一戰勝群賢，～高選。★明·謝讜《四喜記·鄉薦榮歡》
exampleEn: Defeated all scholars in one battle, stood alone on the turtle's head as the top pick.

explanation: 从古到今。泛指很长一段时间。
explanationTraditional: 從古到今。泛指很長一段時間。
explanationEn: From ancient times to the present; throughout history.
derivation: 《淮南子·齐俗训》往古今来谓之宙，四方上下谓之宇。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·齊俗訓》往古今來謂之宙，四方上下謂之宇。”
derivationEn: Huainanzi: 'From past to present is called time, from all directions is called space.'
example: 虽然住了两三天，日子却不多，把～没见过的，没吃过的，没听见的，都经验过了。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 雖然住了兩三天，日子卻不多，把～沒見過的，沒吃過的，沒聽見的，都經驗過了。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十二回
exampleEn: Although we stayed only a few days, we experienced everything unseen, uneaten, and unheard from ancient to modern times.

explanation: 萎靡颓丧。形容精神不振，意志消沉。
explanationTraditional: 萎靡頹喪。形容精神不振，意志消沉。
explanationEn: Dejected and dispirited; lacking energy and will.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送高闲上人序》颓堕委靡，溃败不可收失。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送高閒上人序》頹墮委靡，潰敗不可收失。”
derivationEn: Han Yu of Tang Dynasty: 'Fallen and dispirited, defeated beyond recovery.'
example: 我们应该扫除这里的～之风，好好地大干一场。
exampleTraditional: 我們應該掃除這裡的～之風，好好地大幹一場。
exampleEn: We should sweep away this atmosphere of dejection and get down to work with vigor.

explanation: 舍己牺牲自己。不惜牺牲自己去救别人。
explanationTraditional: 捨己犧牲自己。不惜犧牲自己去救別人。
explanationEn: To sacrifice oneself to save others.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: ～也要凑好了机会，不然，你把肉割下来给别人吃，人们还说许说你的肉中含有传染病的细菌。（老舍《老张的哲学》）
exampleTraditional: ～也要湊好了機會，不然，你把肉割下來給別人吃，人們還說許說你的肉中含有傳染病的細菌。（老舍《老張的哲學》）
exampleEn: Sacrificing oneself to save others also requires the right opportunity; otherwise, even if you cut off your flesh for others to eat, they might say your flesh carries infectious diseases.

explanation: 欲想；罢停，歇。要停止也不能停止。
explanationTraditional: 欲想；罷停，歇。要停止也不能停止。
explanationEn: Unable to stop even if one wants to; compelled to continue.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》夫子循循善诱人，博我以文，约我以礼，欲罢不能。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》夫子循循善誘人，博我以文，約我以禮，欲罷不能。”
derivationEn: Analects: 'The Master skillfully leads people forward, broadens me with culture, restrains me with ritual, so I cannot stop.'
example: 设或命运坎坷，从中别生枝节，拖延日久，虽要将就了事，～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 設或命運坎坷，從中別生枝節，拖延日久，雖要將就了事，～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十二回
exampleEn: If fate is unfortunate and complications arise, delaying for long, even if one wants to settle, one cannot stop.

explanation: ①指欢庆棕。②形容大造声势，大肆进行舆论宣扬。
explanationTraditional: ①指歡慶棕。②形容大造聲勢，大肆進行輿論宣揚。
explanationEn: To beat gongs and drums; to celebrate or to create a big public stir.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 险险阻；夷平坦。化危险为平安。比喻转危为安。
explanationTraditional: 險險阻；夷平坦。化危險為平安。比喻轉危為安。
explanationEn: Turn danger into safety; avert a crisis.
derivation: 唐·韩云卿《平蛮颂序》变氛沴为阳煦，化险阻为夷途。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓雲卿《平蠻頌序》變氛沴為陽煦，化險阻為夷途。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yunqing's 'Preface to the Ode on Pacifying the Southern Barbarians': 'Turn miasma into warm sunshine, transform obstacles into smooth paths.'
example: 除夕遇险的一幕，自然又回忆起来，但我们这一次是～了，虽然费了一些周折。★郭沫若《革命春秋·南昌之一夜》
exampleTraditional: 除夕遇險的一幕，自然又回憶起來，但我們這一次是～了，雖然費了一些周折。★郭沫若《革命春秋·南昌之一夜》
exampleEn: The scene of the New Year's Eve danger naturally came to mind again, but this time we turned danger into safety, though it took some effort. — Guo Moruo, 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: One Night in Nanchang'

explanation: 穷极端。形容极端残暴凶恶。
explanationTraditional: 窮極端。形容極端殘暴兇惡。
explanationEn: Extremely vicious and evil; atrocious.
derivation: 《汉书·王莽传赞》穷他极恶，流毒诸夏。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·王莽傳贊》窮他極惡，流毒諸夏。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Wang Mang': 'Extreme cruelty and evil, poisoning all of China.'
example: 最后侯殿坤～，提起嗓子宣布谁也不准埋，谁埋与共产党同罪。”★曲波《林海雪原》二八
exampleTraditional: 最後侯殿坤～，提起嗓子宣佈誰也不準埋，誰埋與共產黨同罪。”★曲波《林海雪原》二八
exampleEn: Finally, Hou Diankun, in his extreme viciousness, raised his voice and announced that no one was allowed to bury [the dead], and anyone who did would be guilty of the same crime as the Communists. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest'

explanation: 忧喜、福祸彼此共同承担。形容关系密切，利害相同。
explanationTraditional: 憂喜、福禍彼此共同承擔。形容關係密切，利害相同。
explanationEn: Share joys and sorrows; stand together through thick and thin.
derivation: 《晋书·王导传》吾与元规休戚是同，悠悠之谈，宜绝智者之口。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王導傳》吾與元規休慼是同，悠悠之談，宜絕智者之口。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin: Biography of Wang Dao': 'I share weal and woe with Yuan Gui; let idle talk cease among the wise.'
example: 我们是～的好同学。
exampleTraditional: 我們是～的好同學。
exampleEn: We are classmates who share weal and woe.

explanation: 映对照，映衬。相互衬托着，显得很有趣味，很有意思。
explanationTraditional: 映對照，映襯。相互襯托著，顯得很有趣味，很有意思。
explanationEn: Set each other off beautifully; form a delightful contrast.
derivation: 秦牧《画蛋·练功》中外美术史上有些事情，可以说常常相映成趣。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《畫蛋·練功》中外美術史上有些事情，可以說常常相映成趣。”
derivationEn: Qin Mu, 'Drawing Eggs, Practicing Skills': 'Some things in Chinese and foreign art history often complement each other delightfully.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 索找；骥良马。按照画像去寻求好马。比喻墨守成规办事；也比喻按照线索去寻求。
explanationTraditional: 索找；驥良馬。按照畫像去尋求好馬。比喻墨守成規辦事；也比喻按照線索去尋求。
explanationEn: Look for a steed by following a picture; try to locate something by following a clue; be rigid in approach.
derivation: 《汉书·梅福传》今不循伯者之道，乃欲以三代选举之法取当时之士，犹察伯乐之图求骐骥于市，而不可得，变已明矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·梅福傳》今不循伯者之道，乃欲以三代選舉之法取當時之士，猶察伯樂之圖求騏驥於市，而不可得，變已明矣。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Mei Fu': 'If one does not follow the way of a hegemon but seeks to select scholars using the methods of the Three Dynasties, it is like looking for a fine horse in the market with Bole's picture—impossible, and the error is clear.'
example: 每见一班～者，多失于骊黄牝牡。★明·赵沺《葬书问对》
exampleTraditional: 每見一班～者，多失於驪黃牝牡。★明·趙沺《葬書問對》
exampleEn: Often those who follow the picture to find a steed miss the horse's true qualities. — Ming Dynasty, Zhao Tian, 'Questions on Burial Books'

explanation: 倚偏。不偏向任何一方。表示中立或公正。
explanationTraditional: 倚偏。不偏向任何一方。表示中立或公正。
explanationEn: Impartial; unbiased; exactly in the middle.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《中庸章句》题注中者，不偏不倚，无过不及之名。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《中庸章句》題注中者，不偏不倚，無過不及之名。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, 'Commentary on the Doctrine of the Mean': 'The mean means neither leaning nor inclining, without excess or deficiency.'
example: 只要办理得人，～，合乎中庸，一以国粹为归宿，那是决无流弊的。★鲁迅《彷徨·高老夫子》
exampleTraditional: 只要辦理得人，～，合乎中庸，一以國粹為歸宿，那是決無流弊的。★魯迅《彷徨·高老夫子》
exampleEn: As long as it is handled by the right person, impartially, in accordance with the golden mean, and with national essence as the归宿, there will be no drawbacks. — Lu Xun, 'Wandering: Old Master Gao'

explanation: 使线的一头通过针眼。比喻从中联系、拉拢。
explanationTraditional: 使線的一頭通過針眼。比喻從中聯繫、拉攏。
explanationEn: Act as a go-between; make a match; mediate.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·善说》缕困针而入，不因针而急；嫁女因媒而成，不因媒而亲。”明·周楫《西湖二集》卷一二万乞吴二娘怎生做个方便，到黄府亲见小姐询其下落，做个穿针引线之人。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·善說》縷困針而入，不因針而急；嫁女因媒而成，不因媒而親。”明·周楫《西湖二集》卷一二萬乞吳二孃怎生做個方便，到黃府親見小姐詢其下落，做個穿針引線之人。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Liu Xiang, 'Garden of Stories: Good Persuasion': 'Thread enters through the needle, not because of the needle's urgency; a daughter marries through a matchmaker, not because of the matchmaker's closeness.' Ming Dynasty, Zhou Ji, 'West Lake Stories': 'I beg Madam Wu to do me a favor, go to the Huang residence to see the young lady and inquire about her whereabouts, acting as a go-between.'
example: 从前是贩卖云土和军火的大商人，现在给老头子和外国人～……。★梁信《从奴隶到将军》上集第二章
exampleTraditional: 從前是販賣雲土和軍火的大商人，現在給老頭子和外國人～……。★梁信《從奴隸到將軍》上集第二章
exampleEn: He used to be a big merchant selling opium and arms, now he acts as a go-between for the old man and foreigners... — Liang Xin, 'From Slave to General', Chapter 2

explanation: 关起门来造车子。比喻脱离实际，只凭主观办事。
explanationTraditional: 關起門來造車子。比喻脫離實際，只憑主觀辦事。
explanationEn: Make a cart behind closed doors; act blindly without regard for reality.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《中庸或问》卷三古语所谓闭门造车，出门合辙，盖言其法之同。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《中庸或問》卷三古語所謂閉門造車，出門合轍，蓋言其法之同。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, 'Questions on the Doctrine of the Mean': 'The old saying goes: make a cart behind closed doors, and it will fit the ruts when taken out—this refers to the uniformity of the method.'
example: 自以为～，出而合辙，而门外之辙与其所造之车，果相合否。★严复《救亡决论》
exampleTraditional: 自以為～，出而合轍，而門外之轍與其所造之車，果相合否。★嚴復《救亡決論》
exampleEn: Thinking that making a cart behind closed doors will fit the ruts outside, but does the cart actually match the ruts? — Yan Fu, 'On Salvation'

explanation: 到一个地方，就顺从当地的习俗。
explanationTraditional: 到一個地方，就順從當地的習俗。
explanationEn: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
derivation: 《庄子·山木》入其俗，从其令。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·山木》入其俗，從其令。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: Mountain Tree': 'Enter their customs, follow their orders.'
example: 庞贝古城潜藏得过于轰轰烈烈，中国人温文尔雅，连自然力也～，一层层地慢慢来。★余秋雨《文化苦旅·五城记》
exampleTraditional: 龐貝古城潛藏得過於轟轟烈烈，中國人溫文爾雅，連自然力也～，一層層地慢慢來。★餘秋雨《文化苦旅·五城記》
exampleEn: The buried city of Pompeii is too spectacular; the Chinese are gentle and refined, and even natural forces follow local customs, layer by layer, slowly. — Yu Qiuyu, 'Cultural Journey: Five Cities'

explanation: 迎向着；头走在前面的。加紧追过最前面的。
explanationTraditional: 迎向著；頭走在前面的。加緊追過最前面的。
explanationEn: Try hard to catch up with the foremost; strive to overtake.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我国科学技术必须迎头赶上世界先进水平。
exampleTraditional: 我國科學技術必須迎頭趕上世界先進水平。
exampleEn: Our country's science and technology must strive to catch up with the world's advanced level.

explanation: 不堪经不起。形容力量薄弱，经不起一击。也形容论点不严密，经不起反驳。
explanationTraditional: 不堪經不起。形容力量薄弱，經不起一擊。也形容論點不嚴密，經不起反駁。
explanationEn: Cannot withstand a single blow; extremely fragile or weak.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这篇文章论点不严密，不堪一击。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章論點不嚴密，不堪一擊。
exampleEn: The argument in this article is not rigorous and cannot withstand a single rebuttal.

explanation: 具有才能和远见卓识的人。
explanationTraditional: 具有才能和遠見卓識的人。
explanationEn: A person of insight and foresight; a knowledgeable person.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·善说》天下有识之士，无不为足下寒心酸鼻者，千秋万岁之后，庙堂必不血食矣。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·善說》天下有識之士，無不為足下寒心酸鼻者，千秋萬歲之後，廟堂必不血食矣。”
derivationEn: Han·Liu Xiang 'Shuo Yuan·Shan Shuo': 'The knowledgeable people of the world all feel distressed for you...'
example: ～皆谓陛下厌闻人言，意轻边事，其兆见于此矣。★宋·苏轼《朝辞赴定州状》
exampleTraditional: ～皆謂陛下厭聞人言，意輕邊事，其兆見於此矣。★宋·蘇軾《朝辭赴定州狀》
exampleEn: All knowledgeable people say that Your Majesty is tired of hearing opinions and underestimates border affairs; the signs are already visible. (Song·Su Shi 'Ci Chao Fu Ding Zhou Zhuang')

explanation: 尔你；反通返”，回。原意是你怎样做，就会得到怎样的后果。现指人的言行反复无常，前后自相矛盾。
explanationTraditional: 爾你；反通返”，回。原意是你怎樣做，就會得到怎樣的後果。現指人的言行反覆無常，前後自相矛盾。
explanationEn: To contradict oneself; to be inconsistent in words and actions.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王下》出乎尔者，反乎尔者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王下》出乎爾者，反乎爾者也。”
derivationEn: 'Mencius·King Hui of Liang II': 'What goes out from you will return to you.'
example: 倘若不肯，也只好由他，我们不能做～的事。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 倘若不肯，也只好由他，我們不能做～的事。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十九回
exampleEn: If he is unwilling, we can only let him be; we cannot do things that contradict ourselves. (Qing·Li Baojia 'The Bureaucrats' Fifth Ninth Chapter)

explanation: 形容神态失常，失去自制。
explanationTraditional: 形容神態失常，失去自制。
explanationEn: As if drunk or in a trance; completely absorbed or infatuated.
derivation: 元·马致远《汉宫秋》第二折得见了王昭君，使朕如痴似醉。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《漢宮秋》第二折得見了王昭君，使朕如痴似醉。”
derivationEn: Yuan·Ma Zhiyuan 'Autumn in the Han Palace' Second Act: 'Seeing Wang Zhaojun made me as if drunk and infatuated.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 于在；一旦一天。在一天的功夫全被毁掉。多指长期劳动的成果一下子被毁掉。
explanationTraditional: 於在；一旦一天。在一天的功夫全被毀掉。多指長期勞動的成果一下子被毀掉。
explanationEn: To be destroyed in one day; to be ruined all at once.
derivation: 《后汉书·窦融传》百年累之，一朝毁之。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·竇融傳》百年累之，一朝毀之。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han·Dou Rong Biography': 'Accumulated over a hundred years, destroyed in one morning.'
example: 百余年辛苦经营的圆明园，～，更是令人椎心泣血的莫大恨事。（高阳《清宫外史》下册）
exampleTraditional: 百餘年辛苦經營的圓明園，～，更是令人椎心泣血的莫大恨事。（高陽《清宮外史》下冊）
exampleEn: The Yuanmingyuan, painstakingly built over a hundred years, was destroyed in one day, a great regret that makes one weep blood. (Gao Yang 'Qing Gong Wai Shi' Volume 2)

explanation: 覆翻过来。形容变化巨大。也形容闹得很凶。
explanationTraditional: 覆翻過來。形容變化巨大。也形容鬧得很兇。
explanationEn: Heaven and earth turning upside down; enormous changes or great upheaval.
derivation: 唐·刘商《胡笳十八拍》六天翻地覆谁得知？如今正南看北斗。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉商《胡笳十八拍》六天翻地覆誰得知？如今正南看北斗。”
derivationEn: Tang·Liu Shang 'Eighteen Beats of the Hu Jia' Sixth: 'Heaven and earth turned upside down, who knows? Now looking south to see the Big Dipper.'
example: 改革开放以来，我国农村发生了～的变化。
exampleTraditional: 改革開放以來，我國農村發生了～的變化。
exampleEn: Since the reform and opening up, earth-shaking changes have taken place in China's rural areas.

explanation: 个别词句或片断的话。
explanationTraditional: 個別詞句或片斷的話。
explanationEn: A few words or phrases; fragments of speech.
derivation: 高阳《胭脂井》其中或者有只言片语可采，敬烦删定。”
derivationTraditional: 高陽《胭脂井》其中或者有隻言片語可採，敬煩刪定。”
derivationEn: Gao Yang 'Yanzhi Well': 'There might be a few words worth adopting, please delete and edit.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 期约定时间。没有约定而遇见。指意外碰见。
explanationTraditional: 期約定時間。沒有約定而遇見。指意外碰見。
explanationEn: To meet unexpectedly; to encounter by chance.
derivation: 《谷梁传·隐公八年》不期而会曰遇。”
derivationTraditional: 《穀梁傳·隱公八年》不期而會曰遇。”
derivationEn: 'Guliang Zhuan·Yin Gong Eighth Year': 'Meeting without appointment is called encountering.'
example: 前在公主府内，也是我们姐妹三十三个先会面；今日～，又是如此。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十九回
exampleTraditional: 前在公主府內，也是我們姐妹三十三個先會面；今日～，又是如此。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十九回
exampleEn: Earlier at the princess's mansion, we thirty-three sisters met first; today we meet unexpectedly again. (Qing·Li Ruzhen 'Flowers in the Mirror' Sixty-Ninth Chapter)

explanation: 原指仁爱而有节操，能为正义牺牲生命的人。现在泛指爱国而为革命事业出力的人。
explanationTraditional: 原指仁愛而有節操，能為正義犧牲生命的人。現在泛指愛國而為革命事業出力的人。
explanationEn: People of benevolence and aspiration; those who sacrifice for a just cause.
derivation: 《论语·卫灵公》志士仁人，无求生以害仁，有杀身以成仁。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·衛靈公》志士仁人，無求生以害仁，有殺身以成仁。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects·Wei Ling Gong': 'A determined scholar and a benevolent man will not seek to live at the expense of benevolence, but will sacrifice themselves to achieve benevolence.'
example: 大批～，满腔悲愤，万种辛酸，想有所为而不能为，真是英雄无用武之地。★郭沫若《科学的春天》
exampleTraditional: 大批～，滿腔悲憤，萬種辛酸，想有所為而不能為，真是英雄無用武之地。★郭沫若《科學的春天》
exampleEn: A large number of people with lofty ideals, full of grief and indignation, wanted to act but could not, truly heroes with no place to use their strength. (Guo Moruo 'The Spring of Science')

explanation: 原指因受命奔走而搞得很累◇也指忙于奔走应付，弄得非常疲乏。
explanationTraditional: 原指因受命奔走而搞得很累◇也指忙於奔走應付，弄得非常疲乏。
explanationEn: To be exhausted from running around; to be worn out by constant activity.
derivation: 《左传·成公七年》余必使尔罢于奔命以死。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公七年》餘必使爾罷於奔命以死。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan·Cheng Gong Seventh Year': 'I will surely make you exhausted from running around until death.'
example: 彼方支吾未暇，而吾率步兵乘高而进，声东击西，形此而出彼，乘卒初锐而用之，彼亦～矣。★宋·陈亮《酌古论·先主》
