derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Song Fan Ye's 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Emperor Guangwu I': 'Spilled water cannot be gathered up; regret comes too late.'
example: 做事要小心，万一出了什么意外就～了。
exampleTraditional: 做事要小心，萬一出了什麼意外就～了。
exampleEn: Be careful in your actions; if something goes wrong, it will be too late for regrets.

explanation: 乘趁。趁着虚弱疏漏的地方进入。
explanationTraditional: 乘趁。趁著虛弱疏漏的地方進入。
explanationEn: Exploit a weakness or gap to enter; take advantage of a vulnerable point.
derivation: 宋·张君房《去笈七签》卷一二０将至所居，自后垣乘虚而入，径及庭中。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張君房《去笈七籤》卷一二０將至所居，自後垣乘虛而入，徑及庭中。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhang Junfang's 'Yunji Qiqian' Volume 120: 'When he arrived at his residence, he entered through the back wall by exploiting a gap and went straight into the courtyard.'
example: 若各存意见，不能和睦，是自己先孤了，别人安得不～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十四回
exampleTraditional: 若各存意見，不能和睦，是自己先孤了，別人安得不～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十四回
exampleEn: If each holds his own opinion and cannot be harmonious, they isolate themselves first; how can others not take advantage of the weakness? — From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 74

explanation: 形容不完整，不集中，不团结，不统一。
explanationTraditional: 形容不完整，不集中，不團結，不統一。
explanationEn: Disintegrate; fall apart; be divided and fragmented.
derivation: 《战国策·魏策一》张仪为秦连横说魏王曰‘魏南与楚而不与齐，则齐攻其东；东与齐而不与赵，则赵攻其北；不合于韩，是韩攻其西；不亲于楚，则楚攻其南此所谓四分五裂之道也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·魏策一》張儀為秦連橫說魏王曰‘魏南與楚而不與齊，則齊攻其東；東與齊而不與趙，則趙攻其北；不合於韓，是韓攻其西；不親於楚，則楚攻其南此所謂四分五裂之道也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Wei I': 'Zhang Yi, advocating horizontal alliance for Qin, said to King Wei: 'If Wei allies with Chu in the south but not with Qi, Qi will attack from the east; if it allies with Qi in the east but not with Zhao, Zhao will attack from the north; if it does not align with Han, Han will attack from the west; if it is not close to Chu, Chu will attack from the south. This is what is called the way of fragmentation.'
example: 故其端起于大夫士之怙私，而其祸可至于亡国灭种，～，而不可收拾。★严复《论世变之亟》
exampleTraditional: 故其端起於大夫士之怙私，而其禍可至於亡國滅種，～，而不可收拾。★嚴復《論世變之亟》
exampleEn: Thus, the trouble starts from the selfishness of officials and scholars, and its disaster can lead to the destruction of the state and extinction of the race, fragmentation, and irreparable chaos. — From Yan Fu's 'On the Urgency of World Change'

explanation: 莫不；及赶上。望见前面骑马的人走过扬起的尘土而不能赶上。比喻远远落在后面。
explanationTraditional: 莫不；及趕上。望見前面騎馬的人走過揚起的塵土而不能趕上。比喻遠遠落在後面。
explanationEn: Lag far behind; be unable to catch up; fall far short.
derivation: 《庄子·田子方》夫子奔逸绝尘，而回瞠若乎后矣。”《后汉书·赵咨传》令敦煌曹暠，咨之故孝廉也，迎路谒候，咨不为留。暠送至亭次，望尘不及。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·田子方》夫子奔逸絕塵，而回瞠若乎後矣。”《後漢書·趙諮傳》令敦煌曹暠，諮之故孝廉也，迎路謁候，諮不為留。暠送至亭次，望塵不及。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Tian Zifang': 'The Master runs swiftly and raises dust, while Hui stares from behind, unable to catch up.' Also from 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Zhao Zi': 'Cao Hao, a former filial and incorrupt candidate recommended by Zhao, waited on the road to pay respects, but Zhao did not stop. Cao Hao saw him off at the post station, watching the dust but unable to catch up.'
example: 闯王确实有许多非凡之处，为当今群雄所～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第五十五章
exampleTraditional: 闖王確實有許多非凡之處，為當今群雄所～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第五十五章
exampleEn: The Chuang King indeed has many extraordinary qualities that far surpass those of other heroes of the time. — From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng' Volume 2, Chapter 55

explanation: 英姿英勇威武的姿态；飒爽豪迈矫健。形容英俊威武、精神焕发的样子。
explanationTraditional: 英姿英勇威武的姿態；颯爽豪邁矯健。形容英俊威武、精神煥發的樣子。
explanationEn: Valiant and heroic bearing; spirited and dashing appearance.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《丹青引赠曹将军霸》褒公鄂公毛发动，英姿飒爽来酣战。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《丹青引贈曹將軍霸》褒公鄂公毛髮動，英姿颯爽來酣戰。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Fu's 'Song of the Danqing: Presented to General Cao Ba': 'The Duke of Bao and Duke of E, their hair and fur move; their heroic and spirited bearing comes to fight fiercely.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻由于偶然的因素而造成了差错。
explanationTraditional: 比喻由於偶然的因素而造成了差錯。
explanationEn: A mistake or error caused by unforeseen or accidental factors.
derivation: 明·王逵《蠡海集·历数》阴错阳差，有十二月，盖六十甲子分为四段，自甲子、己卯、甲午、己酉，各得十五辰。……甲子、甲午为阳辰，故有阴错；己卯、己酉为阴辰，故有阳差也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王逵《蠡海集·歷數》陰錯陽差，有十二月，蓋六十甲子分為四段，自甲子、己卯、甲午、己酉，各得十五辰。……甲子、甲午為陽辰，故有陰錯；己卯、己酉為陰辰，故有陽差也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wang Kui's 'Li Hai Ji · Li Shu': 'Yin error and Yang mistake, there are twelve months...'
example: 他们～地把多年渴望见面的机会失掉了。
exampleTraditional: 他們～地把多年渴望見面的機會失掉了。
exampleEn: They missed the opportunity they had longed for years due to a strange combination of circumstances.

explanation: 其代词，对方；不意没有料到。趁对方没有意料到就采取行动。
explanationTraditional: 其代詞，對方；不意沒有料到。趁對方沒有意料到就採取行動。
explanationEn: To take action when the other party is not expecting it.
derivation: 《孙子·计篇》攻其无备，出其不意。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·計篇》攻其無備，出其不意。”
derivationEn: From 'The Art of War' by Sun Tzu: 'Attack where the enemy is unprepared, appear where you are not expected.'
example: 今日是年晚，此老必定在家，须乘此时调兵围住，～，方无走失。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷四
exampleTraditional: 今日是年晚，此老必定在家，須乘此時調兵圍住，～，方無走失。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷四
exampleEn: Today is New Year's Eve, this old man must be at home. We should take this opportunity to surround him with troops and catch him off guard, so he cannot escape.

explanation: 形容人虚心礼让，小心谨慎。
explanationTraditional: 形容人虛心禮讓，小心謹慎。
explanationEn: Modest and prudent; humble and cautious.
derivation: 《晋书·张宾载记》封濮阳侯，任遇优显，宠冠当时，而谦虚敬慎，开襟下士。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·張賓載記》封濮陽侯，任遇優顯，寵冠當時，而謙虛敬慎，開襟下士。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin · Biography of Zhang Bin': 'He was granted the title of Marquis of Puyang, treated with great favor, and was modest and respectful, open-minded and humble.'
example: 务必使同志们继续保持～、不骄不躁的作风。★毛泽东《在中国共产党第七届中央委员会议上的报告》
exampleTraditional: 務必使同志們繼續保持～、不驕不躁的作風。★毛澤東《在中國共產黨第七屆中央委員會議上的報告》
exampleEn: We must ensure that comrades continue to maintain a modest, prudent, and not arrogant or impetuous style of work.

explanation: 头大如虎，尾细如蛇。比喻开始时声势很大，到后来劲头很小，有始无终。
explanationTraditional: 頭大如虎，尾細如蛇。比喻開始時聲勢很大，到後來勁頭很小，有始無終。
explanationEn: To start with great momentum but end weakly; to have a strong beginning but a weak finish.
derivation: 元·康进之《李逵负棘》第二折则为你两头白面搬兴废，转背言词说是非，这厮敢狗行狼心，虎头蛇尾。”
derivationTraditional: 元·康進之《李逵負棘》第二折則為你兩頭白面搬興廢，轉背言詞說是非，這廝敢狗行狼心，虎頭蛇尾。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Kang Jinzhi's 'Li Kui Carries Thorns', Act 2: 'You stir up trouble with double-dealing, slander behind backs, you are dog-hearted and wolf-minded, tiger-headed and snake-tailed.'
example: 小奇也许会写得好，就是她有一个毛病，～”。★冰心《陶奇的星期日记》
exampleTraditional: 小奇也許會寫得好，就是她有一個毛病，～”。★冰心《陶奇的星期日記》
exampleEn: Xiaoqi might write well, but she has a flaw: she starts strong and ends weak.

explanation: 丝得一根一根地抽，茧得一层一层地剥。形容分析事物极为细致，而且一步一步很有层次。
explanationTraditional: 絲得一根一根地抽，繭得一層一層地剝。形容分析事物極為細緻，而且一步一步很有層次。
explanationEn: To analyze something meticulously and step by step, like pulling silk from cocoons.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 崩倒塌；析分开。崩塌解体，四分五裂。形容国家或集团分裂瓦解。
explanationTraditional: 崩倒塌；析分開。崩塌解體，四分五裂。形容國家或集團分裂瓦解。
explanationEn: To disintegrate and fall apart; to split and collapse (of a country or group).
derivation: 《论语·季氏》远人不服而不能来也，邦分崩离析而不能守也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·季氏》遠人不服而不能來也，邦分崩離析而不能守也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects · Ji Shi': 'When distant people are not submissive, one cannot attract them; when the state is disintegrating, one cannot preserve it.'
example: 战争使全国～的局面变成了比较团结的局面。★毛泽东《和英国记者贝特兰的谈话》
exampleTraditional: 戰爭使全國～的局面變成了比較團結的局面。★毛澤東《和英國記者貝特蘭的談話》
exampleEn: The war turned the situation of national disintegration into one of relative unity.

explanation: 指蜻蜓在水面飞行时用尾部轻触水面的动作。比喻做事肤浅不深入。
explanationTraditional: 指蜻蜓在水面飛行時用尾部輕觸水面的動作。比喻做事膚淺不深入。
explanationEn: To touch superficially; to do something in a shallow or cursory manner.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《曲江》诗穿花蛱蝶深深见，点水蜻蜓款款飞。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《曲江》詩穿花蛺蝶深深見，點水蜻蜓款款飛。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Fu's poem 'Qujiang': 'Butterflies flit deeply among the flowers, dragonflies skim the water lightly.'
example: 下乡只是～式的，还要带白馒头。★郭小川《沉重的教训》
exampleTraditional: 下鄉只是～式的，還要帶白饅頭。★郭小川《沉重的教訓》
exampleEn: Going to the countryside is just a superficial visit, like a dragonfly skimming the water, and they even bring white buns.

explanation: 万道河，千重山。形容路途艰难遥远。
explanationTraditional: 萬道河，千重山。形容路途艱難遙遠。
explanationEn: Thousands of mountains and rivers; a long and arduous journey.
derivation: 唐·张乔《寄维阳故人》诗离别河边绾柳条，千山万水玉人遥。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·張喬《寄維陽故人》詩離別河邊綰柳條，千山萬水玉人遙。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Zhang Qiao's poem 'To an Old Friend in Weiyang': 'We parted by the river, tying willow branches, a thousand mountains and ten thousand rivers separate us.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 悖违背，冲突。同时进行，不相冲突。
explanationTraditional: 悖違背，衝突。同時進行，不相沖突。
explanationEn: To proceed simultaneously without conflict; to coexist without contradiction.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》万物并育而不相害，道并行而不相悖。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》萬物並育而不相害，道並行而不相悖。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites · The Doctrine of the Mean': 'All things are nurtured together without harming each other; the ways of the universe proceed together without conflicting.'
example: 但风雅之事，又怎么能够和卫道的精神～呢？★巴金《家》九
exampleTraditional: 但風雅之事，又怎麼能夠和衛道的精神～呢？★巴金《家》九
exampleEn: But how can elegant pursuits coexist with the spirit of defending morality?

explanation: 指有重大的消息时，人们奔跑着相互转告。
explanationTraditional: 指有重大的消息時，人們奔跑著相互轉告。
explanationEn: To run around spreading news; to pass on important news eagerly.
derivation: 《国语·鲁语下》士有陪乘，告奔走也。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·魯語下》士有陪乘，告奔走也。”
derivationEn: From 'Guoyu · Luyu Xia': 'The officers have attendants to run and spread news.'
example: 于是群情惊疑，～，以为又将重演十年前之惨剧。★毛泽东《向国民党的十点要求》
exampleTraditional: 於是群情驚疑，～，以為又將重演十年前之慘劇。★毛澤東《向國民黨的十點要求》
exampleEn: Thus the crowd was shocked and alarmed, running around telling each other, fearing that the tragedy of ten years ago would repeat.

explanation: 有什么问题都给以解答。
explanationTraditional: 有什麼問題都給以解答。
explanationEn: Answer every question asked.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 老师对学生提出的问题应该有问必答。
exampleTraditional: 老師對學生提出的問題應該有問必答。
exampleEn: Teachers should answer every question raised by students.

explanation: 按照身材裁剪衣服。比喻按照实际情况办事。
explanationTraditional: 按照身材裁剪衣服。比喻按照實際情況辦事。
explanationEn: Cut the garment according to the figure. Metaphor for acting according to actual circumstances.
derivation: 《墨子·鲁问》子观越王之志何若？意越王将听吾言，用我道，则翟将往，量腹面食，度身而衣，自比于群臣，奚能以封为哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《墨子·魯問》子觀越王之志何若？意越王將聽吾言，用我道，則翟將往，量腹面食，度身而衣，自比於群臣，奚能以封為哉？”
derivationEn: From Mozi · Lu Wen: 'I observe the king of Yue's intentions. If he listens to me and uses my way, then I will go, eat according to appetite, dress according to body, and compare myself to his ministers. How could I seek a fief?'
example: 俗话说到什么山上唱什么歌。”又说看菜吃饭，～。”我们无论做什么事都要看情形办理。★毛泽东《反对党八股》
exampleTraditional: 俗話說到什麼山上唱什麼歌。”又說看菜吃飯，～。”我們無論做什麼事都要看情形辦理。★毛澤東《反對黨八股》
exampleEn: As the saying goes, 'Sing different songs on different mountains,' and 'Cut the garment according to the figure.' We must handle affairs according to circumstances. — Mao Zedong, Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing

explanation: 形容证据确凿，象山一样不能动摇。
explanationTraditional: 形容證據確鑿，象山一樣不能動搖。
explanationEn: Ironclad evidence, as solid as a mountain.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这个坏分子，罪行累累，铁证如山，不容抵赖。
exampleTraditional: 這個壞分子，罪行累累，鐵證如山，不容抵賴。
exampleEn: This bad element has numerous crimes, ironclad evidence, and cannot be denied.

explanation: 指疯狂地轰炸。
explanationTraditional: 指瘋狂地轟炸。
explanationEn: Intensive and indiscriminate bombing.
derivation: 李若冰《瓦窑堡啊，一盏不灭的灯》天上飞机狂轰滥炸，地上发动武装大游行。”
derivationTraditional: 李若冰《瓦窯堡啊，一盞不滅的燈》天上飛機狂轟濫炸，地上發動武裝大遊行。”
derivationEn: From Li Ruobing, 'Wayaobao, an Everlasting Lamp': 'Enemy planes bombed indiscriminately from the sky, and armed mass demonstrations were launched on the ground.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 本指蔺相如将和氏璧完好地自秦送回赵国◇比喻把原物完好地归还本人。
explanationTraditional: 本指藺相如將和氏璧完好地自秦送回趙國◇比喻把原物完好地歸還本人。
explanationEn: Return the jade intact to Zhao. Metaphor for returning something to its owner in perfect condition.
derivation: 《史记·廉颇蔺相如列传》城入赵而璧留秦；城不入，臣请完璧归赵。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·廉頗藺相如列傳》城入趙而璧留秦；城不入，臣請完璧歸趙。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lin Xiangru and Lian Po: 'If the city enters Zhao, the jade stays in Qin; if not, I beg to return the jade intact to Zhao.'
example: 请放心，不要多久，这两件东西定会～。此事放在弟身上好啦。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十六章
exampleTraditional: 請放心，不要多久，這兩件東西定會～。此事放在弟身上好啦。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十六章
exampleEn: Rest assured, these two items will be returned intact soon. Leave it to me. — Yao Xueyin, Li Zicheng, Vol. 1, Ch. 26

explanation: 没有什么可以告诉对方的。
explanationTraditional: 沒有什麼可以告訴對方的。
explanationEn: No comment; nothing to tell.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 事关公司的财务机密，因此～。
exampleTraditional: 事關公司的財務機密，因此～。
exampleEn: It involves the company's financial secrets, so no comment.

explanation: 形容极其坚定、牢固。
explanationTraditional: 形容極其堅定、牢固。
explanationEn: Unshakable; extremely firm and solid.
derivation: 鲁迅《而已集·革首领”》虽然这‘北京文艺界’已被徐丹甫先生在《学灯》上指定，隐隐然不可动摇了，……。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《而已集·革首領”》雖然這‘北京文藝界’已被徐丹甫先生在《學燈》上指定，隱隱然不可動搖了，……。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun, 'And So On': 'Although the 'Beijing literary circle' has been designated by Xu Danfu in Xue Deng, seemingly unshakable...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 兼施同时施展。软的和硬的手段都用上了。
explanationTraditional: 兼施同時施展。軟的和硬的手段都用上了。
explanationEn: Use both soft and hard tactics simultaneously.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 敌人软硬兼施，也没有使他屈服。
exampleTraditional: 敵人軟硬兼施，也沒有使他屈服。
exampleEn: The enemy used both soft and hard tactics, but did not make him yield.

explanation: 意思是天道公平，作恶就要受惩罚，它看起来似乎很不周密，但最终不会放过一个坏人。比喻作恶的人逃脱不了国法的惩处。
explanationTraditional: 意思是天道公平，作惡就要受懲罰，它看起來似乎很不周密，但最終不會放過一個壞人。比喻作惡的人逃脫不了國法的懲處。
explanationEn: The net of Heaven is vast, but nothing escapes it. Metaphor for evil-doers not escaping punishment.
derivation: 《老子》天网恢恢，疏而不失。”《魏书·任城王传》天网恢恢，疏而不漏。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》天網恢恢，疏而不失。”《魏書·任城王傳》天網恢恢，疏而不漏。”
derivationEn: From Laozi: 'The net of Heaven is vast, sparse but nothing slips through.' From Book of Wei: 'The net of Heaven is vast, sparse but nothing slips through.'
example: 你可记得三年前蔡指挥的事么？天网恢恢，～。今日有何理说。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十六
exampleTraditional: 你可記得三年前蔡指揮的事麼？天網恢恢，～。今日有何理說。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十六
exampleEn: Do you remember the Cai commander incident three years ago? The net of Heaven is vast, sparse but nothing slips through. What do you have to say now? — Feng Menglong, Stories to Awaken the World, Vol. 36

explanation: 智智谋。紧急的时候，猛然想出办法。
explanationTraditional: 智智謀。緊急的時候，猛然想出辦法。
explanationEn: Suddenly come up with a solution in an emergency.
derivation: 唐·白居易《和微之诗二十三首序》今足下果用所长，过蒙见窘，然敌则气作，急则生智。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《和微之詩二十三首序》今足下果用所長，過蒙見窘，然敵則氣作，急則生智。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi, 'Preface to Poems in Reply to Hezhi': 'Now you indeed use your strengths to embarrass me, but when pressured, one becomes resourceful; in urgency, wisdom arises.'
example: 当我把《语丝》读完的时候，想念《莽原》的心思却忽然增高万倍，～，马上写了一封信给我的可爱的表弟。★鲁迅《田原思想》
exampleTraditional: 當我把《語絲》讀完的時候，想念《莽原》的心思卻忽然增高萬倍，～，馬上寫了一封信給我的可愛的表弟。★魯迅《田原思想》
exampleEn: When I finished reading Yusi, my longing for Mangyuan suddenly increased tenfold. In my urgency, I immediately wrote a letter to my dear cousin. — Lu Xun, Rural Thoughts

explanation: 监守监管；盗偷窃。窃取公务上自己看管的财物。
explanationTraditional: 監守監管；盜偷竊。竊取公務上自己看管的財物。
explanationEn: To steal property that one is entrusted to guard; embezzlement by a custodian.
derivation: 《汉书·刑法志》守县官财物而即盗之。已论命复有笞罪者，皆弃市。”颜师古注即今律所谓主守自盗者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·刑法志》守縣官財物而即盜之。已論命復有笞罪者，皆棄市。”顏師古注即今律所謂主守自盜者也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Treatise on Penal Law': 'One who steals the property of the county office under his supervision.' Annotated by Yan Shigu: 'This is what the current law calls theft by the custodian.'
example: 总之少了谷石，却无案卷可凭，这就是～的匮空。（清·李绿园《歧路灯》第九十四回）
exampleTraditional: 總之少了谷石，卻無案卷可憑，這就是～的匱空。（清·李綠園《歧路燈》第九十四回）
exampleEn: In short, the grain was missing, but there were no records to prove it—this was a case of embezzlement by the custodian. (From Li Lüyuan's 'The Lamp at the Crossroads', Chapter 94)

explanation: 闷闷心情不舒畅，心烦。形容心事放不下，心里不快活。
explanationTraditional: 悶悶心情不舒暢，心煩。形容心事放不下，心裡不快活。
explanationEn: To be in low spirits; to feel depressed and unhappy.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十八回意欲弃布他往，却又不忍；又恐被人嗤笑。乃终日闷闷不乐。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十八回意欲棄布他往，卻又不忍；又恐被人嗤笑。乃終日悶悶不樂。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 18: 'He wanted to leave Lü Bu and go elsewhere, but could not bear to; also feared being ridiculed. So he remained gloomy and unhappy all day.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心心意，思想感情；印符合。彼此的心意不用说出，就可以互相了解。形容彼此思想感情完全一致。
explanationTraditional: 心心意，思想感情；印符合。彼此的心意不用說出，就可以互相瞭解。形容彼此思想感情完全一致。
explanationEn: To have a tacit understanding; to be of one mind; hearts beat in unison.
derivation: 《六祖大师法宝坛经》吾传佛心印，安敢违于佛经。”《黄蘖传心法要》迦叶以来，以心印心，心心不异。”
derivationTraditional: 《六祖大師法寶壇經》吾傳佛心印，安敢違於佛經。”《黃櫱傳心法要》迦葉以來，以心印心，心心不異。”
derivationEn: From 'Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch': 'I transmit the Buddha's mind seal, how dare I violate the Buddha's scriptures?' From 'Huangbo's Transmission of Mind': 'Since Kasyapa, mind has been transmitted by mind, mind to mind without difference.'
example: 抚台看了，彼此～，断无驳回之理。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 撫臺看了，彼此～，斷無駁回之理。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十九回
exampleEn: The governor saw it, and they understood each other perfectly; there was no reason to reject it. (From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 59)

explanation: 杰杰出；灵好。指有杰出的人降生或到过，其地也就成了名胜之区。
explanationTraditional: 傑傑出；靈好。指有傑出的人降生或到過，其地也就成了名勝之區。
explanationEn: A place becomes famous because of the outstanding people born or living there; a remarkable place producing remarkable people.
derivation: 唐·王勃《滕王阁序》人杰地灵，徐孺下陈蕃之榻。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《滕王閣序》人傑地靈，徐孺下陳蕃之榻。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Bo's 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng': 'Outstanding people make the place famous; Xu Ru's couch was set up by Chen Fan.'
example: 实在襄阳的～，恐怕比它的山水形胜更值得人赞美。★闻一多《孟浩然》
exampleTraditional: 實在襄陽的～，恐怕比它的山水形勝更值得人讚美。★聞一多《孟浩然》
exampleEn: Indeed, the people and the land of Xiangyang are so remarkable that they deserve more praise than its scenic beauty. (From Wen Yiduo's 'Meng Haoran')

explanation: 堪可以忍受；回首回顾，回忆。指对过去的事情想起来就会感到痛苦，因而不忍去回忆。
explanationTraditional: 堪可以忍受；回首回顧，回憶。指對過去的事情想起來就會感到痛苦，因而不忍去回憶。
explanationEn: Cannot bear to look back; too painful to recall the past.
derivation: 唐·戴叔伦《哭朱放》最是不堪回首处，九泉烟冷树苍苍。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·戴叔倫《哭朱放》最是不堪回首處，九泉煙冷樹蒼蒼。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Dai Shulun's 'Mourning for Zhu Fang': 'The most unbearable thing is to look back, where the cold smoke over the nine springs and the trees are dark.'
example: 诚有令人～者，则我今日之临眺于此，虽百年之久，曾不能以一瞬尔。★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》
exampleTraditional: 誠有令人～者，則我今日之臨眺於此，雖百年之久，曾不能以一瞬爾。★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》
exampleEn: It truly makes one unable to bear looking back. So today, as I gaze here, even though a hundred years have passed, it feels like an instant. (From Qing Dynasty anonymous 'Commentary on Du Fu's Poetry')

explanation: 由听从。身体不由自己作主。
explanationTraditional: 由聽從。身體不由自己作主。
explanationEn: Involuntarily; unable to control one's own actions; not in command of oneself.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十四回上命差遣，身不由己。望君侯怜悯，誓以死报。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十四回上命差遣，身不由己。望君侯憐憫，誓以死報。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 74: 'Orders from above compel me; I am not my own master. I hope you will have mercy and swear to die in repayment.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 佛教指人的四苦，即出生、衰老、生病、死亡。今泛指生活中生育、养老、医疗、殡葬。
explanationTraditional: 佛教指人的四苦，即出生、衰老、生病、死亡。今泛指生活中生育、養老、醫療、殯葬。
explanationEn: Birth, aging, illness, and death—the four sufferings in Buddhism; now refers to the major events in life: childbirth, elderly care, medical treatment, and funeral.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·雅量》鸡猪鱼蒜，逢著便；生老病死，时至则行。”《仁王经·无常偈》生老病死，事与愿违。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·雅量》雞豬魚蒜，逢著便；生老病死，時至則行。”《仁王經·無常偈》生老病死，事與願違。”
derivationEn: From Southern Song Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'Chicken, pig, fish, garlic—eat when encountered; birth, aging, illness, death—go when time comes.' From 'Benevolent King Sutra': 'Birth, aging, illness, death—things go against one's wishes.'
example: 只是在家受不得那爱欲牵缠，～，世态炎凉，人情险恶。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 只是在家受不得那愛慾牽纏，～，世態炎涼，人情險惡。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十一回
exampleEn: But at home, he could not bear the entanglement of love and desire, the cycle of birth, aging, illness, and death, the fickleness of the world, and the dangers of human relationships. (From Qing Dynasty Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 31)

explanation: 捷报胜利的消息；频屡次。胜利的消息不断地传来。
explanationTraditional: 捷報勝利的消息；頻屢次。勝利的消息不斷地傳來。
explanationEn: Reports of victory keep pouring in; news of success arrives frequently.
derivation: 徐迟《地质之光》在六十年代里，华北大平原上捷报频传。以后大港油田、胜利油田、其他油田相继建成。”
derivationTraditional: 徐遲《地質之光》在六十年代裡，華北大平原上捷報頻傳。以後大港油田、勝利油田、其他油田相繼建成。”
derivationEn: From Xu Chi's 'Light of Geology': 'In the 1960s, reports of victory kept coming from the North China Plain. Subsequently, the Dagang Oilfield, Shengli Oilfield, and other oilfields were built one after another.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 粗粗蔬。指做事马虎，不细心。
explanationTraditional: 粗粗蔬。指做事馬虎，不細心。
explanationEn: Careless; negligent; inattentive.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类·学四》去尽皮方见肉，去尽肉方见骨，终骨方见髓，使粗心大气不得。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類·學四》去盡皮方見肉，去盡肉方見骨，終骨方見髓，使粗心大氣不得。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's 'Classified Conversations of Master Zhu': 'Remove the skin to see the flesh, remove the flesh to see the bone, finally remove the bone to see the marrow; one must not be careless.'
example: 这是我～，我若不进去，他怎得出来？★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第四回
exampleTraditional: 這是我～，我若不進去，他怎得出來？★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第四回
exampleEn: This was my carelessness. If I hadn't gone in, how could he have come out? (From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Couple', Chapter 4)

explanation: 开宗阐发宗旨；明义说明意思。指说话、写文章一开始就讲明主要意思。
explanationTraditional: 開宗闡發宗旨；明義說明意思。指說話、寫文章一開始就講明主要意思。
explanationEn: To state the main idea at the beginning; to make clear the purpose and theme from the start.
derivation: 《孝经·开宗明义》开宗明义章第一。”宋·邢昺题解开，张也；宗，本也；明，显也；义，理也。言此章开张一经之宗本，显明五孝之义理，故曰开宗明义章也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孝經·開宗明義》開宗明義章第一。”宋·邢昺題解開，張也；宗，本也；明，顯也；義，理也。言此章開張一經之宗本，顯明五孝之義理，故曰開宗明義章也。”
derivationEn: From 'Classic of Filial Piety: Opening the Doctrine and Explaining the Meaning': 'Chapter One: Opening the Doctrine and Explaining the Meaning.' Song Dynasty Xing Bing's annotation: 'Kai means to unfold; zong means the root; ming means to make clear; yi means the principle. This chapter unfolds the root of the classic and makes clear the principles of filial piety, hence the title.'
example: 在这～的第一信里，请你们容我在你们面前介绍我自己。★冰心《寄小读者·通讯一》
exampleTraditional: 在這～的第一信裡，請你們容我在你們面前介紹我自己。★冰心《寄小讀者·通訊一》
exampleEn: In this first letter that states the main idea, please allow me to introduce myself to you. (From Bing Xin's 'To Little Readers: Letter One')

explanation: 使人内心深深感动。
explanationTraditional: 使人內心深深感動。
explanationEn: To deeply move one's heart; to touch someone profoundly.
derivation: 常贵田《喇吧声声》轻重缓急，悠扬悦耳，动人心弦，感人肺腑。”
derivationTraditional: 常貴田《喇吧聲聲》輕重緩急，悠揚悅耳，動人心絃，感人肺腑。”
derivationEn: From Chang Guitian's 'The Sound of Trumpet': '...touching the heartstrings, moving people deeply.'
example: 他在会上的发言～。
exampleTraditional: 他在會上的發言～。
exampleEn: His speech at the meeting deeply moved everyone.

explanation: 像用瓢泼水那样的大雨。形容雨下得非常大的样子。
explanationTraditional: 像用瓢潑水那樣的大雨。形容雨下得非常大的樣子。
explanationEn: A downpour as if water is being poured from a gourd ladle; describing very heavy rain.
derivation: 周立波《暴风骤雨》第一部十二西北悬天起了乌黑的云朵，不大一会，瓢泼大雨到来了，夹着炸雷和闪电，因为三天两头地下雨，道上黑泥总是不干的，出门的人们都是光着脚丫子，顺着道沿走。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《暴風驟雨》第一部十二西北懸天起了烏黑的雲朵，不大一會，瓢潑大雨到來了，夾著炸雷和閃電，因為三天兩頭地下雨，道上黑泥總是不幹的，出門的人們都是光著腳丫子，順著道沿走。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane': 'Dark clouds appeared in the northwest sky, and soon a torrential rain arrived, accompanied by thunder and lightning.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 任任用；唯只；亲关系密切。指用人不问人的德才，只选跟自己关系亲密的人。
explanationTraditional: 任任用；唯只；親關係密切。指用人不問人的德才，只選跟自己關係親密的人。
explanationEn: To appoint people by favoritism; to select only those close to oneself regardless of merit.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 领导干部在用人时一定要考虑德才兼备，绝不能任人唯亲。
exampleTraditional: 領導幹部在用人時一定要考慮德才兼備，絕不能任人唯親。
exampleEn: When appointing people, leaders must consider both moral integrity and talent, and never practice nepotism.

explanation: 惴忧愁、恐惧。形容因害怕或担心而不安。
explanationTraditional: 惴憂愁、恐懼。形容因害怕或擔心而不安。
explanationEn: Anxious and uneasy; feeling fearful or worried.
derivation: 《诗经·秦风·黄鸟》临其穴，惴惴其栗。”宋·周孚《铅刀编·滁州奠枕楼记》乾道八年，济南辛侯（辛弃疾）自司农寺簿来守滁……民之居茅竹相比，每大风作，惴惴然不自安。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·秦風·黃鳥》臨其穴，惴惴其慄。”宋·周孚《鉛刀編·滁州奠枕樓記》乾道八年，濟南辛侯（辛棄疾）自司農寺簿來守滁……民之居茅竹相比，每大風作，惴惴然不自安。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Qin Feng: Yellow Bird': 'Approaching his grave, trembling with fear.' Also from Zhou Fu's 'Record of the Chuzhou Mourning Tower': '...when strong winds blew, they felt uneasy.'
example: 大家都认为这是震南村第一个大灾难，愁眉苦脸，～。★欧阳山《苦斗》六七
exampleTraditional: 大家都認為這是震南村第一個大災難，愁眉苦臉，～。★歐陽山《苦鬥》六七
exampleEn: Everyone thought this was the first great disaster in Zhennan Village, with worried faces and uneasy hearts. (Ouyang Shan, 'Struggle')

explanation: 沁渗入。原指芳香凉爽的空气或饮料使人感到舒适。也形容诗歌和文章优美动人，给人清新爽朗的感觉。
explanationTraditional: 沁滲入。原指芳香涼爽的空氣或飲料使人感到舒適。也形容詩歌和文章優美動人，給人清新爽朗的感覺。
explanationEn: Refreshing the heart; describing fragrant air or cool drinks that bring comfort, or beautiful poetry and prose that give a fresh and pleasant feeling.
derivation: 宋·林洪《冷泉亭》诗一泓清可沁诗脾。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·林洪《冷泉亭》詩一泓清可沁詩脾。”
derivationEn: From Lin Hong's poem 'Cold Spring Pavilion': 'A clear spring that refreshes the poetic spirit.'
example: 然而夜气很清爽，真所谓～”，我在北京遇着这样的好空气，仿佛这是第一遭了。★鲁迅《呐喊·社戏》
exampleTraditional: 然而夜氣很清爽，真所謂～”，我在北京遇著這樣的好空氣，彷彿這是第一遭了。★魯迅《吶喊·社戲》
exampleEn: However, the night air was very refreshing, truly 'refreshing the heart'; this was probably the first time I encountered such good air in Beijing. (Lu Xun, 'Outcry: Village Opera')

explanation: 昏昏沉沉，只想睡觉。形容极其疲劳或精神不振。
explanationTraditional: 昏昏沉沉，只想睡覺。形容極其疲勞或精神不振。
explanationEn: Drowsy and sleepy; describing extreme fatigue or low spirits.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·贾奉雉》是秋入闱复落，邑邑不得志，颇思郎言，遂取前所指示者强读之，未至终篇，昏昏欲睡，心惶惑无以自主。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·賈奉雉》是秋入闈復落，邑邑不得志，頗思郎言，遂取前所指示者強讀之，未至終篇，昏昏欲睡，心惶惑無以自主。”
derivationEn: From Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Jia Fengzhi': '...he forced himself to read the selected passages, but before finishing, he felt drowsy and confused.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指有这个意思，但没有在话里明说出来。
explanationTraditional: 指有這個意思，但沒有在話裡明說出來。
explanationEn: The implied meaning; what is meant but not explicitly stated.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《六一诗话》必能状难写之景，如在目前，含不尽之意，见于言外，然后为至矣。”宋·叶梦得《石林诗话》七言难于气象雄浑，句中有力而纡余，不失言外之意。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《六一詩話》必能狀難寫之景，如在目前，含不盡之意，見於言外，然後為至矣。”宋·葉夢得《石林詩話》七言難於氣象雄渾，句中有力而紆餘，不失言外之意。”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Xiu's 'Notes on Poetry of the Six One': 'One must be able to describe difficult scenes as if before the eyes, and contain endless meaning beyond words.' Also from Ye Mengde's 'Stone Forest Poetry': 'Seven-character poems are difficult to achieve grandeur, with strength in the lines and lingering meaning beyond words.'
example: 间有一二不尽之言，～，以少少许胜多多许者，是他一枝一节好处。★清·郑燮《潍县署中与舍弟第五书》
exampleTraditional: 間有一二不盡之言，～，以少少許勝多多許者，是他一枝一節好處。★清·鄭燮《濰縣署中與舍弟第五書》
exampleEn: Occasionally, there are incomplete words and implied meanings that achieve more with less; these are his strengths. (Zheng Xie, 'Fifth Letter to My Brother in Weixian')

explanation: 事由变化，在预料之中。形容原先预料的准确。
explanationTraditional: 事由變化，在預料之中。形容原先預料的準確。
explanationEn: As expected; within one's expectations; confirming a prediction.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第十回见你不在，我就猜着到这里来了，所以一直赶来，果然不出所料。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第十回見你不在，我就猜著到這裡來了，所以一直趕來，果然不出所料。”
derivationEn: From Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Evil': 'I guessed you would be here, so I came straight away, and sure enough, it was as expected.'
example: 果然～，”这样的一念闪过校长先生的心头。(叶圣陶《一篇宣言》)
exampleTraditional: 果然～，”這樣的一念閃過校長先生的心頭。(葉聖陶《一篇宣言》)
exampleEn: 'Sure enough, as expected,' this thought flashed through the principal's mind. (Ye Shengtao, 'A Declaration')

explanation: 采兴致。形容精神不振，提不起劲头。
explanationTraditional: 採興致。形容精神不振，提不起勁頭。
explanationEn: Listless; dispirited; lacking energy or enthusiasm.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十五回小红待要过去，又不敢过去，只得悄悄向潇湘馆，取了喷壶而回，无精打采，自向房内躺着。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十五回小紅待要過去，又不敢過去，只得悄悄向瀟湘館，取了噴壺而回，無精打采，自向房內躺著。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber': 'Xiaohong wanted to go over but dared not, so she quietly went to the Xiaoxiang Pavilion, took the watering can, and returned, listless, lying down in her room.'
example: 这时候贾大少爷见人家的条子都已到齐，瞧着眼热，自己一个人坐在那里，甚觉～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十四回
exampleTraditional: 這時候賈大少爺見人家的條子都已到齊，瞧著眼熱，自己一個人坐在那裡，甚覺～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十四回
exampleEn: At this time, seeing that everyone else's slips had arrived, Jia Daye felt envious and sat alone, feeling very listless. (Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure')

explanation: 形容文章自然不受约束，就象漂浮着的云和流动着的水一样。
explanationTraditional: 形容文章自然不受約束，就象漂浮著的雲和流動著的水一樣。
explanationEn: Natural and unconstrained; describing writing that flows freely like floating clouds and flowing water.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《答谢民师书》所示书教及诗赋杂文，观之熟矣；大略如行云流水，初无定质，但常行于所当行，止于不可不止。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《答謝民師書》所示書教及詩賦雜文，觀之熟矣；大略如行雲流水，初無定質，但常行於所當行，止於不可不止。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Reply to Xie Minshi': 'I have read your letters, poems, and essays thoroughly; they are like floating clouds and flowing water, without fixed form, but always moving when they should and stopping when they must.'
example: 结构如～，层次分明，先后呼应。★茅盾《〈力原〉读后感》
exampleTraditional: 結構如～，層次分明，先後呼應。★茅盾《〈力原〉讀後感》
exampleEn: The structure flows naturally like floating clouds and flowing water, with clear layers and coherent sequence. (Mao Dun, 'After Reading 'The Source of Strength'')

explanation: 畏惧害怕。什么也不怕。形容非常勇敢。
explanationTraditional: 畏懼害怕。什麼也不怕。形容非常勇敢。
explanationEn: Fearless; not afraid of anything; very brave.
derivation: 毛泽东《在中国共产党全国宣传工作会议上的讲话》为了达到建设新中国的目的，对于什么困难我们共产党人也是无所畏惧。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《在中國共產黨全國宣傳工作會議上的講話》為了達到建設新中國的目的，對於什麼困難我們共產黨人也是無所畏懼。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'Speech at the National Conference on Propaganda Work of the Chinese Communist Party': 'In order to achieve the goal of building a new China, we Communists are fearless in the face of any difficulty.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 穷指物质基础差；白指文化和科学落后。比喻基础差，底子薄。
explanationTraditional: 窮指物質基礎差；白指文化和科學落後。比喻基礎差，底子薄。
explanationEn: Poor and blank; refers to a weak material base and backward culture and science.
derivation: 毛泽东《论十大关系》十我曾经说过，我们一为‘穷’，二为‘白’。‘穷’就是没有多少工业，农业也不发达。‘白’就是一张白纸，文化水平、科学水平都不高。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《論十大關係》十我曾經說過，我們一為‘窮’，二為‘白’。‘窮’就是沒有多少工業，農業也不發達。‘白’就是一張白紙，文化水平、科學水平都不高。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'On the Ten Major Relationships': 'I once said we are 'poor' and 'blank.' 'Poor' means we have little industry and agriculture is underdeveloped. 'Blank' means we are like a blank sheet of paper, with low cultural and scientific levels.'
example: 在他们的意念中，一切都是为了迅速改变‘～’的面貌。★陶铸《松树的风格》
exampleTraditional: 在他們的意念中，一切都是為了迅速改變‘～’的面貌。★陶鑄《松樹的風格》
exampleEn: In their minds, everything is aimed at quickly changing the 'poor and blank' situation. — Tao Zhu, 'The Style of the Pine Tree'

explanation: 指高人一等。形容德才超众或成就突出。
explanationTraditional: 指高人一等。形容德才超眾或成就突出。
explanationEn: To stand out among others; to be outstanding in virtue or achievement.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《与梅圣俞书》老夫当避路，放他出一头地也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《與梅聖俞書》老夫當避路，放他出一頭地也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Ouyang Xiu, 'Letter to Mei Yaochen': 'I should step aside and let him have a head start.'
example: 孙俊英见人家看得起，能～，一呼百应，好不威风自在。★冯德英《迎春花》第八章
exampleTraditional: 孫俊英見人家看得起，能～，一呼百應，好不威風自在。★馮德英《迎春花》第八章
exampleEn: Sun Junying saw that others respected her, and she could stand out, commanding a following, enjoying great prestige and power. — Feng Deying, 'Spring Blossoms', Chapter 8

explanation: 赤子初生的婴儿。比喻人心地纯洁善良。
explanationTraditional: 赤子初生的嬰兒。比喻人心地純潔善良。
explanationEn: Pure and innocent heart; like a newborn baby's heart.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄下》大人者，不失其赤子之心者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁下》大人者，不失其赤子之心者也。”
derivationEn: Mencius, 'Li Lou II': 'A great man is one who does not lose his childlike heart.'
example: 尧、舜、禹、汤、周、孔，时刻以救民济世为心，所谓～，原不过是不忍”二字。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一一八回
exampleTraditional: 堯、舜、禹、湯、周、孔，時刻以救民濟世為心，所謂～，原不過是不忍”二字。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一一八回
exampleEn: Yao, Shun, Yu, Tang, Zhou, and Confucius always had the heart to save the people and help the world. The so-called 'pure heart' is essentially the word 'cannot bear.' — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 118

explanation: 切肤切身，亲身。亲身经受的痛苦。比喻感受深切。
explanationTraditional: 切膚切身，親身。親身經受的痛苦。比喻感受深切。
explanationEn: Deeply felt pain; personal experience of suffering.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·冤狱》带一名于纸尾，遂成附骨之疽，受万罪于公门，竞属切肤之痛。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·冤獄》帶一名於紙尾，遂成附骨之疽，受萬罪於公門，競屬切膚之痛。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Unjust Imprisonment': 'Adding a name at the end of a document becomes a deep-rooted disease; suffering countless wrongs in court is truly a personal pain.'
example: 对日本帝国主义的暴行，他有着～。
exampleTraditional: 對日本帝國主義的暴行，他有著～。
exampleEn: He had a deep personal pain from the atrocities of Japanese imperialism.

explanation: 顾顾虑；忌忌惮。没有什么顾虑、畏惧。
explanationTraditional: 顧顧慮；忌忌憚。沒有什麼顧慮、畏懼。
explanationEn: Without any scruples or fears; acting boldly.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十一回当初原为遮人耳目起见，不得不如此；等到后来张太太把抵押的凭据禀了上头存了案，他却无所顾忌了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十一回當初原為遮人耳目起見，不得不如此；等到後來張太太把抵押的憑據稟了上頭存了案，他卻無所顧忌了。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 51: 'Initially, it was done to cover up appearances; later, when Mrs. Zhang filed the mortgage evidence with the authorities, he had no scruples.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 功事业；告宣告。指巨大工程或重要任务宣告完成。
explanationTraditional: 功事業；告宣告。指巨大工程或重要任務宣告完成。
explanationEn: Great task accomplished; completion of a major project or important mission.
derivation: 《尚书·禹贡》讫于四海，禹锡玄圭，告厥成功。”《汉书·王莽传上》十万众并集，平作二旬，大功毕成。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·禹貢》訖於四海，禹錫玄圭，告厥成功。”《漢書·王莽傳上》十萬眾並集，平作二旬，大功畢成。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents: Tribute of Yu': 'Reached the four seas, Yu was given a black scepter, announcing his success.' 'Book of Han: Biography of Wang Mang': 'A hundred thousand people gathered, worked for twenty days, and the great task was completed.'
example: 及～，天下已定，而后实行其共和主义之政策，恢复我完全之金瓯。★章炳麟《驳革命驳议》
exampleTraditional: 及～，天下已定，而後實行其共和主義之政策，恢復我完全之金甌。★章炳麟《駁革命駁議》
exampleEn: When the great task was accomplished and the world was settled, then the republican policy was implemented to restore our complete territory. — Zhang Binglin, 'Refuting the Revolutionary Debate'

explanation: 拍桌子叫好。形容非常赞赏。
explanationTraditional: 拍桌子叫好。形容非常讚賞。
explanationEn: To slap the table and shout 'bravo'; to express great admiration.
derivation: 唐·田颖《博浪沙行序》不禁拍案呼奇。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·田穎《博浪沙行序》不禁拍案呼奇。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Tian Ying, 'Preface to the Journey of Bolangsha': 'Could not help slapping the table and exclaiming in wonder.'
example: 使人见之，一个个欢欣鼓舞，快意舒怀，不禁～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第一回
exampleTraditional: 使人見之，一個個歡欣鼓舞，快意舒懷，不禁～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第一回
exampleEn: Seeing it, everyone was overjoyed, delighted, and could not help slapping the table and shouting 'bravo.' — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 1

explanation: 且暂且。只要能够过得去，就这样过下去。形容胸无大志。
explanationTraditional: 且暫且。只要能夠過得去，就這樣過下去。形容胸無大志。
explanationEn: To muddle along; to get by as long as possible without ambition.
derivation: 元·无名氏《小孙屠》第四出孩儿，我听得道你要出外打旋，怕家中得过且过，出去做甚的？”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《小孫屠》第四齣孩兒，我聽得道你要出外打旋，怕家中得過且過，出去做甚的？”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Little Sun Tu', Act 4: 'Child, I heard you want to go out and wander. I fear that at home we just muddle along, so why go out?'
example: 但是吃烟人的脾气，总是～，那一个是真心肯戒。★清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第一回
exampleTraditional: 但是吃煙人的脾氣，總是～，那一個是真心肯戒。★清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第一回
exampleEn: But opium smokers always have the attitude of muddling along; who is truly determined to quit? — Qing Dynasty, Peng Yang'ou, 'The Opium Addict', Chapter 1

explanation: 举全。指全国上上下下的人。
explanationTraditional: 舉全。指全國上上下下的人。
explanationEn: The whole nation; from top to bottom, everyone in the country.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 奥运会上中国运动健儿喜获金牌，～欢腾一遍。
exampleTraditional: 奧運會上中國運動健兒喜獲金牌，～歡騰一遍。
exampleEn: When Chinese athletes won gold medals at the Olympics, the whole nation was jubilant.

explanation: 扬起眉头，吐出怨气。形容摆脱了长期受压状态后高兴痛快的样子。
explanationTraditional: 揚起眉頭，吐出怨氣。形容擺脫了長期受壓狀態後高興痛快的樣子。
explanationEn: To raise one's eyebrows and exhale resentment. Describes the feeling of relief and joy after being freed from long-term oppression.
derivation: 唐·李白《与韩荆州书》何惜阶前盈尺之地，不使白扬眉吐气，激昂青云耶？”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《與韓荊州書》何惜階前盈尺之地，不使白揚眉吐氣，激昂青雲耶？”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Bai's 'Letter to Han Jingzhou': 'Why begrudge a foot of space before the steps, not allowing me to raise my eyebrows and exhale resentment, and soar to the clouds?'
example: 只要将来做了八府巡按，妈也就可以～了。★巴金《家》十二
exampleTraditional: 只要將來做了八府巡按，媽也就可以～了。★巴金《家》十二
exampleEn: As long as I become an imperial inspector in the future, my mother can also raise her eyebrows and exhale resentment. ★ Ba Jin's 'Family', Chapter 12

explanation: 趁乘机。趁人家失火时去抢劫。比喻乘人之危谋取私利。
explanationTraditional: 趁乘機。趁人家失火時去搶劫。比喻乘人之危謀取私利。
explanationEn: To take advantage of someone's misfortune for personal gain, like looting a burning house.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第十六回正是财动人心，他也不救火，他也不叫水，拿着那袈裟，趁哄打劫，拽回云步，经转山洞而去。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十六回正是財動人心，他也不救火，他也不叫水，拿著那袈裟，趁哄打劫，拽回雲步，經轉山洞而去。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 16: 'Indeed, wealth moves the heart. He neither put out the fire nor called for water, but took the cassock, taking advantage of the chaos to loot, and retreated to a cave.'
example: 等警察赶到时，那几个～的流氓早已逃走了。
exampleTraditional: 等警察趕到時，那幾個～的流氓早已逃走了。
exampleEn: By the time the police arrived, those thugs who were taking advantage of the chaos had already fled.

explanation: 乌烟黑烟；瘴气热带山林中的一种湿热空气，旧时认为是瘴疠的病原。比喻环境嘈杂、秩序混乱或社会黑暗。
explanationTraditional: 烏煙黑煙；瘴氣熱帶山林中的一種溼熱空氣，舊時認為是瘴癘的病原。比喻環境嘈雜、秩序混亂或社會黑暗。
explanationEn: Black smoke and miasma. Metaphor for a chaotic, noisy environment or a dark, corrupt society.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这样，汪精卫派和国民党的反共顽固派两家里应外合，把时局闹得～了。（毛泽东《团结一切抗日力量，反对反共顽固派》）
exampleTraditional: 這樣，汪精衛派和國民黨的反共頑固派兩家裡應外合，把時局鬧得～了。（毛澤東《團結一切抗日力量，反對反共頑固派》）
exampleEn: Thus, Wang Jingwei's faction and the Kuomintang's anti-communist diehards colluded to create a chaotic situation. ★ Mao Zedong, 'Unite All Anti-Japanese Forces and Oppose the Anti-Communist Diehards'

explanation: 对同一个问题，不同的人从不同的立场或角度有不同的看法。
explanationTraditional: 對同一個問題，不同的人從不同的立場或角度有不同的看法。
explanationEn: Different people have different views on the same issue based on their own perspectives or positions.
derivation: 《周易·系辞上》仁者见之谓之仁，智者见之谓之智。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭上》仁者見之謂之仁，智者見之謂之智。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes, Xici I': 'The benevolent see it and call it benevolence; the wise see it and call it wisdom.'
example: ～，议论纷纭，却无非背后论人是非，在兆奎面前都有忌讳。★高阳《清宫外史》上册
exampleTraditional: ～，議論紛紜，卻無非背後論人是非，在兆奎面前都有忌諱。★高陽《清宮外史》上冊
exampleEn: Opinions vary, but they are all gossiping behind others' backs, and they are all cautious in front of Zhao Kui. ★ Gao Yang's 'History of the Qing Palace', Volume 1

explanation: 寸步形容距离很近。原指夫妻和睦，一步也不离开。现在泛指两人感情好，总在一起。
explanationTraditional: 寸步形容距離很近。原指夫妻和睦，一步也不離開。現在泛指兩人感情好，總在一起。
explanationEn: Originally described a harmonious couple never leaving each other's side; now generally refers to two people being inseparable due to close relationship.
derivation: 南朝·梁·任昿《述异记》吴黄龙中，吴郡海盐有陆东，妻朱氏，亦有容止，夫妻相重，寸步不离，时人号为比肩人。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·任昿《述異記》吳黃龍中，吳郡海鹽有陸東，妻朱氏，亦有容止，夫妻相重，寸步不離，時人號為比肩人。”
derivationEn: Southern Liang Dynasty, Ren Fang's 'Records of Strange Things': 'During the Wu Huanglong era, there was Lu Dong in Haiyan, Wu Commandery, whose wife Zhu was also beautiful. The couple valued each other and never left each other's side, and were called the 'shoulder-to-shoulder people' at the time.'
example: 他家女孩儿韩爱姐，逐日上去答应老太太，～，要一奉十，拣口儿吃用，换套穿衣。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第八十一回
exampleTraditional: 他家女孩兒韓愛姐，逐日上去答應老太太，～，要一奉十，揀口兒吃用，換套穿衣。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第八十一回
exampleEn: His daughter Han Aijie went to attend to the old lady every day, never leaving her side, fulfilling every request, choosing food by taste, and changing clothes as needed. ★ Ming Dynasty, Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng's 'Jin Ping Mei', Chapter 81

explanation: 形容景色柔和美好。
explanationTraditional: 形容景色柔和美好。
explanationEn: Describes a soft and beautiful scenery.
derivation: 秦牧《花市》人们怎能不热爱这个风光旖旎的南国花市，怎能不从这个盛大的花市享受着生活的温馨呢！”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《花市》人們怎能不熱愛這個風光旖旎的南國花市，怎能不從這個盛大的花市享受著生活的溫馨呢！”
derivationEn: Qin Mu's 'Flower Market': 'How can people not love this charming southern flower market, and not enjoy the warmth of life from this grand flower market!'
example: 南国的春天～，使人陶醉。
exampleTraditional: 南國的春天～，使人陶醉。
exampleEn: The spring scenery in the south is charming and intoxicating.

explanation: 原指各人都得到满足◇指每个人或事物都得到恰当的位置或安排。
explanationTraditional: 原指各人都得到滿足◇指每個人或事物都得到恰當的位置或安排。
explanationEn: Originally meant everyone gets what they want; now refers to each person or thing being in its proper place or arrangement.
derivation: 《周易·系辞下》日中为市，致天下之民，聚天下之货，交易而退，各得其所。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭下》日中為市，致天下之民，聚天下之貨，交易而退，各得其所。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes, Xici II': 'At midday, hold a market, attracting people from all over, gathering goods from everywhere, trading and returning, each getting what they need.'
example: 全国人民都要有说话的机会，都要有衣穿，有饭吃，有事做，有书读，总之是要～。★毛泽东《在陕甘宁边区参议会的演说》
exampleTraditional: 全國人民都要有說話的機會，都要有衣穿，有飯吃，有事做，有書讀，總之是要～。★毛澤東《在陝甘寧邊區參議會的演說》
exampleEn: All people across the country should have the opportunity to speak, have clothes to wear, food to eat, work to do, and books to read—in short, everyone should be properly provided for. ★ Mao Zedong, 'Speech at the Assembly of the Shaanxi-Gansu-Ningxia Border Region'

explanation: 碑指记功碑。所有人的嘴都是活的记功碑。比喻人人称赞。
explanationTraditional: 碑指記功碑。所有人的嘴都是活的記功碑。比喻人人稱讚。
explanationEn: Everyone's mouth is a living monument. Metaphor for being praised by everyone.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十七劝君不用镌顽石，路上行人口似碑。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十七勸君不用鐫頑石，路上行人口似碑。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Volume 17: 'I advise you not to engrave on hard stone; the mouths of people on the road are like monuments.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 既不是痛，也不是痒。原形容说不出的一种难受。现多比喻不触及实质，不切中要害，不解决问题。
explanationTraditional: 既不是痛，也不是癢。原形容說不出的一種難受。現多比喻不觸及實質，不切中要害，不解決問題。
explanationEn: Neither painful nor itchy. Originally described an indescribable discomfort; now metaphorically refers to something that does not touch the core, misses the point, or fails to solve the problem.
derivation: 明·吴炳《情邮记·反噬》这事不痛不痒，却是一个大题目。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳炳《情郵記·反噬》這事不痛不癢，卻是一個大題目。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Bing's 'Love Story: Counterattack': 'This matter is neither painful nor itchy, yet it is a big issue.'
example: 即如小弟幼时，忽从面上生一肉核，非疮非疣，～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二十六回
exampleTraditional: 即如小弟幼時，忽從面上生一肉核，非瘡非疣，～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二十六回
exampleEn: For example, when I was young, a flesh kernel suddenly grew on my face, neither a sore nor a wart, neither painful nor itchy. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 26

explanation: 济济形容人多。形容很多有才能的人聚集在一起。
explanationTraditional: 濟濟形容人多。形容很多有才能的人聚集在一起。
explanationEn: Describes many talented people gathering together.
derivation: 《尚书·大禹谟》济济有众，咸听朕命。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·大禹謨》濟濟有眾，鹹聽朕命。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents, Great Yu's Counsel': 'A multitude of people, all listen to my command.'
example: 摄影中～的满是儿童。★朱自清《海阔天空”与古今中外”》
exampleTraditional: 攝影中～的滿是兒童。★朱自清《海闊天空”與古今中外”》
exampleEn: The photo was filled with children gathered together. ★ Zhu Ziqing, 'Boundless Sky and Earth'

explanation: 不慌张，不忙乱。形容态度镇定，或办事稳重、踏实。
explanationTraditional: 不慌張，不忙亂。形容態度鎮定，或辦事穩重、踏實。
explanationEn: Calm and unhurried; composed and steady in attitude or action.
derivation: 元·高文秀《襄阳会》第三折轮起刀来望我脖子砍，不慌不忙缩了头。”
derivationTraditional: 元·高文秀《襄陽會》第三折輪起刀來望我脖子砍，不慌不忙縮了頭。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Gao Wenxiu's 'Meeting at Xiangyang', third act: 'He raised his knife to chop at my neck, but I calmly and unhurriedly withdrew my head.'
example: 公路在山上盘旋，车子～地打着圈子。★巴金《旅途杂记·成渝路上》
exampleTraditional: 公路在山上盤旋，車子～地打著圈子。★巴金《旅途雜記·成渝路上》
exampleEn: The road wound around the mountain, and the car circled calmly and unhurriedly. (Ba Jin, 'Travel Notes: On the Chengdu-Chongqing Road')

explanation: 去掉外饰，还其本质。比喻回复原来的自然状态。同返朴归真”。
explanationTraditional: 去掉外飾，還其本質。比喻回覆原來的自然狀態。同返樸歸真”。
explanationEn: To remove artificial adornment and return to one's original nature; to revert to a natural state.
derivation: 太平天国·洪仁玕《英杰归真》上帝基督化人，超凡入圣，返璞归真。”
derivationTraditional: 太平天國·洪仁玕《英傑歸真》上帝基督化人，超凡入聖，返璞歸真。”
derivationEn: From Hong Rengan's 'The Return of the Heroes to Truth' in the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom: 'God and Christ transform people, transcending the mundane to become saints, returning to simplicity and truth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 贪财图利的欲望迷住了心窍。
explanationTraditional: 貪財圖利的慾望迷住了心竅。
explanationEn: Obsessed with greed and material desires; blinded by profit and lust.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《赠别李次翁》诗利欲熏心，随人翕张，国好骏马，尽为王良。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《贈別李次翁》詩利慾薰心，隨人翕張，國好駿馬，盡為王良。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Huang Tingjian's poem 'Farewell to Li Ciweng': 'Greed and desire smoke the heart, following others' whims; the state loves fine horses, all become Wang Liang.'
example: 故凡进此阵内，为其蛊惑，若稍操持不定，～，无不心荡神迷，因而失据。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第一百回
exampleTraditional: 故凡進此陣內，為其蠱惑，若稍操持不定，～，無不心蕩神迷，因而失據。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第一百回
exampleEn: Therefore, those who enter this formation and are tempted, if they cannot hold steady and are obsessed with greed, will be utterly confused and lose their footing. (Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 100)

explanation: 才华表现于外的才能。多指文学艺术方面而言，很有才华。
explanationTraditional: 才華表現於外的才能。多指文學藝術方面而言，很有才華。
explanationEn: Full of talent; exceptionally gifted, especially in literature or art.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他从小就流露出才华横溢的天资来。
exampleTraditional: 他從小就流露出才華橫溢的天資來。
exampleEn: He showed signs of overflowing talent from a young age.

explanation: 既成已成。已经形成的事实。
explanationTraditional: 既成已成。已經形成的事實。
explanationEn: An accomplished fact; something that has already happened and cannot be changed.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《雨不绝》诗鸣雨既过渐细微，映空摇扬如丝飞。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《雨不絕》詩鳴雨既過漸細微，映空搖揚如絲飛。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Fu's poem 'The Rain Never Ceases': 'The loud rain has passed and gradually becomes fine, shimmering in the air like silk flying.'
example: 对于～的婚姻，我们要通过法律手段解决。
exampleTraditional: 對於～的婚姻，我們要通過法律手段解決。
exampleEn: For marriages that are already established facts, we must resolve them through legal means.

explanation: 比喻彼此地位或权力平等。
explanationTraditional: 比喻彼此地位或權力平等。
explanationEn: To be on an equal footing; to have equal status or power.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三回若是家门口这些做田的，扒粪的，不过是平头百姓，你若同他拱手作揖，平起平坐，这就是坏了学校规矩，连我脸上都无光了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三回若是家門口這些做田的，扒糞的，不過是平頭百姓，你若同他拱手作揖，平起平坐，這就是壞了學校規矩，連我臉上都無光了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 3: 'If you bow and scrape to these common farmers and dung collectors, treating them as equals, that would break school rules and bring shame on me.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 捐献；躯身体，指生命。为国家牺牲生命。
explanationTraditional: 捐獻；軀身體，指生命。為國家犧牲生命。
explanationEn: To sacrifice one's life for the country.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第五十二回可怜成汤首相，为国捐躯。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第五十二回可憐成湯首相，為國捐軀。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Creation of the Gods', Chapter 52: 'Pitiable the prime minister of Shang, who sacrificed his life for the country.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容心满意足，事情的发展完全符合心意。
explanationTraditional: 形容心滿意足，事情的發展完全符合心意。
explanationEn: To be completely satisfied; things develop exactly as one wishes.
derivation: 宋·朱敦儒《感皇恩》词称心如意，剩活人间几岁？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱敦儒《感皇恩》詞稱心如意，剩活人間幾歲？”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhu Dunru's poem 'Gratitude for Imperial Favor': 'Satisfied and content, how many more years to live in this world?'
example: 但是这个贵州，十分瘠苦，处万山之中，又是晴少雨多，吃的、用的、穿的，无一样能够～。★清·吴趼人《糊涂世界》卷五
exampleTraditional: 但是這個貴州，十分瘠苦，處萬山之中，又是晴少雨多，吃的、用的、穿的，無一樣能夠～。★清·吳趼人《糊塗世界》卷五
exampleEn: But this Guizhou province is extremely barren, located amidst thousands of mountains, with more rain than sun. Nothing—food, goods, clothing—can be satisfactory. (Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren, 'Confused World', Volume 5)

explanation: 千秋千年，引伸为久远。各有各的存在的价值。比喻各人有各人的长处，各人有各人的特色。
explanationTraditional: 千秋千年，引伸為久遠。各有各的存在的價值。比喻各人有各人的長處，各人有各人的特色。
explanationEn: Each has its own merits; each has its own distinctive features or strengths.
derivation: 汉·李陵《与苏武三首》嘉会难再遇，三载为千秋。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·李陵《與蘇武三首》嘉會難再遇，三載為千秋。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Li Ling's 'Three Poems to Su Wu': 'Happy meetings are hard to repeat; three years feel like a thousand autumns.'
example: 中国抒情诗与叙事诗一向同样地发展，～的呵。★茅盾《〈诗论〉管窥》
exampleTraditional: 中國抒情詩與敘事詩一向同樣地發展，～的呵。★茅盾《〈詩論〉管窺》
exampleEn: Chinese lyric poetry and narrative poetry have always developed side by side, each with its own merits. (Mao Dun, 'On Poetry')

explanation: 叱咤怒喝声。一声呼喊、怒喝，可以使风云翻腾起来。形容威力极大。
explanationTraditional: 叱吒怒喝聲。一聲呼喊、怒喝，可以使風雲翻騰起來。形容威力極大。
explanationEn: To command the wind and clouds; to have immense power and influence, able to shake the world.
derivation: 《梁书·元帝纪》叱咤则风云兴起，鼓动则嵩华倒拔。”
derivationTraditional: 《梁書·元帝紀》叱吒則風雲興起，鼓動則嵩華倒拔。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Liang: Biography of Emperor Yuan': 'A shout can stir up wind and clouds; a drumbeat can topple mountains.'
example: 因此，一变而为欺人与自欺，而应当～的武士都变成了小丑。★老舍《四世同堂》九
exampleTraditional: 因此，一變而為欺人與自欺，而應當～的武士都變成了小丑。★老舍《四世同堂》九
exampleEn: Thus, they turned into deceivers and self-deceivers, and the warriors who should have commanded the wind and clouds became clowns. (Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof', Chapter 9)

explanation: 终最后，结局。不知道结局或下落。
explanationTraditional: 終最後，結局。不知道結局或下落。
explanationEn: Not knowing the final outcome or whereabouts.
derivation: 《庄子·田子方》日夜无隙，而不知其所终。”《国语·越语下》遂乘扁舟，以浮于五湖，莫知其所终极。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·田子方》日夜無隙，而不知其所終。”《國語·越語下》遂乘扁舟，以浮於五湖，莫知其所終極。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi and Guoyu: 'Day and night without gap, yet not knowing its end.'
example: 余幼在湖口，有一僧持显者书，周行各郡县……后～。★清·采蘅子《虫鸣漫录》
exampleTraditional: 餘幼在湖口，有一僧持顯者書，周行各郡縣……後～。★清·採蘅子《蟲鳴漫錄》
exampleEn: When I was young at Hukou, a monk carrying a letter from a notable traveled through counties... later, his whereabouts were unknown.

explanation: 没有根据或没有道理地瞎说。
explanationTraditional: 沒有根據或沒有道理地瞎說。
explanationEn: To talk nonsense without basis or reason.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元·龙门远禅师法嗣》祕魔岩主擎个义儿，胡说乱道，遂将一掴成齑粉，散在十方世界。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元·龍門遠禪師法嗣》秘魔巖主擎個義兒，胡說亂道，遂將一摑成齏粉，散在十方世界。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Secret Devil Rock Master held a righteous child, talking nonsense, and smashed it into powder scattered in the ten directions.'
example: 为了造语惊人，对仗工稳起见，有些文豪们简直不恤～的。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文·病后杂谈》
exampleTraditional: 為了造語驚人，對仗工穩起見，有些文豪們簡直不恤～的。★魯迅《且介亭雜文·病後雜談》
exampleEn: For the sake of striking language and balanced couplets, some writers do not hesitate to talk nonsense.

explanation: 完全改变了平时的态度。
explanationTraditional: 完全改變了平時的態度。
explanationEn: Completely change one's usual attitude or behavior.
derivation: 郭澄清《大刀记》第十六章可是而今，他却一反常态，神采飞扬地高谈阔论起来。”
derivationTraditional: 郭澄清《大刀記》第十六章可是而今，他卻一反常態，神采飛揚地高談闊論起來。”
derivationEn: From Guo Chengqing's 'Broadsword Story': 'But now, he completely changed his usual attitude and talked with high spirits.'
example: 他平时总是有说有笑，今天却～，默不作声。
exampleTraditional: 他平時總是有說有笑，今天卻～，默不作聲。
exampleEn: He is usually cheerful and talkative, but today he completely changed his attitude and remained silent.

explanation: 大雁飞过时也能拔下毛来。原形容武艺高超◇比喻人爱占便宜，见有好处就要乘机捞一把。
explanationTraditional: 大雁飛過時也能拔下毛來。原形容武藝高超◇比喻人愛佔便宜，見有好處就要乘機撈一把。
explanationEn: To pluck feathers from a passing wild goose; originally describing superb martial skills, now metaphorically meaning to seize every opportunity for personal gain.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十一回他既没有那雁过拔毛的本事，就该悄悄儿走，怎么好好儿的把人家拆弄个稀烂。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十一回他既沒有那雁過拔毛的本事，就該悄悄兒走，怎麼好好兒的把人家拆弄個稀爛。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty's 'The Story of Heroes': 'Since he didn't have the skill to pluck feathers from a passing goose, he should have left quietly instead of messing things up.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 毅然顽强地；决然坚决地。意志坚决，毫不犹豫。
explanationTraditional: 毅然頑強地；決然堅決地。意志堅決，毫不猶豫。
explanationEn: Resolutely and determinedly, without hesitation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他毅然决然地抛弃了国外优裕的生活，回到了祖国。
exampleTraditional: 他毅然決然地拋棄了國外優裕的生活，回到了祖國。
exampleEn: He resolutely abandoned his comfortable life abroad and returned to his motherland.

explanation: 遇见不公平的事，挺身而出，帮助受欺负的一方。
explanationTraditional: 遇見不公平的事，挺身而出，幫助受欺負的一方。
explanationEn: To step forward to help the bullied when witnessing injustice.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十五回气的我只有替平儿打抱不平。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十五回氣的我只有替平兒打抱不平。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber': 'I was so angry that I had to defend Pinger's injustice.'
example: 扶正义，～，正是我们革命党我的本色。★吴玉章《从甲午战争前后到辛亥革命前后的回忆》
exampleTraditional: 扶正義，～，正是我們革命黨我的本色。★吳玉章《從甲午戰爭前後到辛亥革命前後的回憶》
exampleEn: Upholding justice and defending the wronged is exactly the nature of our revolutionaries.

explanation: 旧指神仙道士的法力。现比喻人具有支配自然的伟大力量。也可形容反动势力猖獗。
explanationTraditional: 舊指神仙道士的法力。現比喻人具有支配自然的偉大力量。也可形容反動勢力猖獗。
explanationEn: Originally referring to the magical powers of immortals; now metaphorically meaning to have great power over nature or to describe rampant reactionary forces.
derivation: 宋·孙觌《罨溪行》罨画溪头乌鸟乐，呼风唤雨不能休。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·孫覿《罨溪行》罨畫溪頭烏鳥樂，呼風喚雨不能休。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty's 'Yanxi Stream': 'Birds chirp endlessly by Yanxi Stream, calling wind and rain without rest.'
example: 兄弟，你真是玛志尼一流人物，天生成～，搅得一国的原动力的了。★清·梁启超《新中国未来记》第三回
exampleTraditional: 兄弟，你真是瑪志尼一流人物，天生成～，攪得一國的原動力的了。★清·梁啟超《新中國未來記》第三回
exampleEn: Brother, you are truly a Mazzini-like figure, born to stir up the whole country's dynamics.

explanation: 心怦怦地跳动。
explanationTraditional: 心怦怦地跳動。
explanationEn: Heart pounding with excitement or emotion.
derivation: 战国·楚·宋玉《九辩》私自怜兮何极，心怦怦兮谅直。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·宋玉《九辯》私自憐兮何極，心怦怦兮諒直。”
derivationEn: From Song Yu's 'Nine Arguments': 'I pity myself endlessly, my heart pounds with sincerity.'
example: 我一见到她就～。
exampleTraditional: 我一見到她就～。
exampleEn: My heart pounded the moment I saw her.

explanation: 指保养年寿。
explanationTraditional: 指保養年壽。
explanationEn: To nurture one's health and enjoy a long life.
derivation: 京剧《杨门女将》老太君年过百年，就该颐养天年，何必身履险地？”
derivationTraditional: 京劇《楊門女將》老太君年過百年，就該頤養天年，何必身履險地？”
derivationEn: From Peking Opera 'Women Generals of the Yang Family': 'Old Lady, you are over a hundred years old; you should enjoy your remaining years instead of risking danger.'
example: 他对佛教已经一往情深，肯定会抱守着这些陈旧的信条去～的。★《十月》1981年第1期
exampleTraditional: 他對佛教已經一往情深，肯定會抱守著這些陳舊的信條去～的。★《十月》1981年第1期
exampleEn: He was already deeply devoted to Buddhism and would surely cling to those outdated beliefs to nurture his old age.

explanation: 把人物的声音、神色都描绘出来了。形容叙述或描写生动逼真。
explanationTraditional: 把人物的聲音、神色都描繪出來了。形容敘述或描寫生動逼真。
explanationEn: To describe vividly and lifelike, capturing both voice and expression.
derivation: 清·朱庭珍《筱园诗话》卷一必使山情水性，因绘声绘色而曲得其真；务期天巧地灵，借人工人第而华传其妙。”
derivationTraditional: 清·朱庭珍《筱園詩話》卷一必使山情水性，因繪聲繪色而曲得其真；務期天巧地靈，借人工人第而華傳其妙。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty's 'Xiaoyuan Poetry Talk': 'One must make the mountain's nature and water's mood vividly portrayed to capture their truth.'
example: 尤其是谈她自己的儿女，那真是～，细致入微，没完没了。★冯德英《迎春花》第九章
exampleTraditional: 尤其是談她自己的兒女，那真是～，細緻入微，沒完沒了。★馮德英《迎春花》第九章
exampleEn: Especially when talking about her own children, she described them so vividly and meticulously that she would go on and on.

explanation: 适可恰好可以。到适当的程度就停下来，不要过头。
explanationTraditional: 適可恰好可以。到適當的程度就停下來，不要過頭。
explanationEn: Stop at the appropriate point; not overdo something.
derivation: 《论语·乡党》不多食”宋·朱熹注适可而止，无贪心也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·鄉黨》不多食”宋·朱熹注適可而止，無貪心也。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's commentary on The Analects: 'Stop at the appropriate point, without greed.'
example: 从来没有暴风雨能够持久的。果然持久了，我们也吃不消，所以我们要它～。★闻一多《宫体诗的自赎》
exampleTraditional: 從來沒有暴風雨能夠持久的。果然持久了，我們也吃不消，所以我們要它～。★聞一多《宮體詩的自贖》
exampleEn: No storm ever lasts forever. If it did, we couldn't bear it, so we want it to stop at the appropriate point. — Wen Yiduo, 'The Redemption of Palace Poetry'

explanation: 漫随便。随随便便，不放在心上。
explanationTraditional: 漫隨便。隨隨便便，不放在心上。
explanationEn: Careless; indifferent; not paying attention.
derivation: 闻一多《伟大的事实，不朽的意义》当时漫不经心，却等事后再去追怀。”
derivationTraditional: 聞一多《偉大的事實，不朽的意義》當時漫不經心，卻等事後再去追懷。”
derivationEn: From Wen Yiduo's 'Great Truth, Immortal Significance': 'At the time, I was careless, but later I recalled it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指吃苦耐劳、勤俭节约的作风。
explanationTraditional: 指吃苦耐勞、勤儉節約的作風。
explanationEn: Hardworking and thrifty; simple and frugal lifestyle.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十七章为实现这一远大的政治目的而在生活上竭力做到艰苦朴素。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十七章為實現這一遠大的政治目的而在生活上竭力做到艱苦樸素。”
derivationEn: From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 17: 'To achieve this far-reaching political goal, he strove to live a hardworking and thrifty life.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指看起来或听起来凝，不很清楚，感觉不很明显。
explanationTraditional: 指看起來或聽起來凝，不很清楚，感覺不很明顯。
explanationEn: Vague; indistinct; not clear to see or hear.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十回只见山坡旁隐隐约约，倒象撺出一箭，直向大虫面上射去。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十回只見山坡旁隱隱約約，倒象攛出一箭，直向大蟲面上射去。”
derivationEn: From Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 10: 'From the hillside, vaguely, an arrow seemed to shoot out, flying straight toward the tiger's face.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 碧翠绿色。形容建筑物装饰华丽，光彩夺目。
explanationTraditional: 碧翠綠色。形容建築物裝飾華麗，光彩奪目。
explanationEn: Resplendent; magnificent; brilliantly decorated (of buildings).
derivation: 宋·罗大经《鹤林玉露》补遗众以为金碧荧煌，臣以为涂膏衅血。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·羅大經《鶴林玉露》補遺眾以為金碧熒煌，臣以為塗膏釁血。”
derivationEn: From Luo Dajing's 'Crane Grove Jade Dew': 'The public thought it was gold and jade glittering, but I saw it as painted with blood and fat.'
example: 他便把门面装璜得～，把些光怪陆离的洋货，罗列在外。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第七十七回
exampleTraditional: 他便把門面裝璜得～，把些光怪陸離的洋貨，羅列在外。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第七十七回
exampleEn: He decorated the storefront resplendently, displaying all kinds of bizarre foreign goods outside. — Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 77

explanation: 睹看见。以能尽先看到为快乐。形容盼望殷切。
explanationTraditional: 睹看見。以能儘先看到為快樂。形容盼望殷切。
explanationEn: Consider it a pleasure to be the first to see something; eager to see something first.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《与少室李拾遗书》朝廷之士，引颈东望，若景星凤皇之始见也，争先睹之为快。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《與少室李拾遺書》朝廷之士，引頸東望，若景星鳳皇之始見也，爭先睹之為快。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Letter to Li Yi': 'Scholars at court crane their necks eastward, as if seeing a rare star or phoenix for the first time, competing to be the first to see it.'
example: 现在我们特地和西滢先生商量，把闲话”选集起来，印成专书，留心文艺界掌故的人，想必都以～。★鲁迅《而已集·革首领”》
exampleTraditional: 現在我們特地和西瀅先生商量，把閒話”選集起來，印成專書，留心文藝界掌故的人，想必都以～。★魯迅《而已集·革首領”》
exampleEn: Now we have specially consulted with Mr. Xizhou to select and publish his 'Idle Talks' as a book. Those interested in literary history will surely consider it a pleasure to be the first to see it. — Lu Xun, 'And So On: 'Chief'

explanation: 功功业。就达到。功绩取得了，名声也有了。
explanationTraditional: 功功業。就達到。功績取得了，名聲也有了。
explanationEn: Achieve success and gain fame; accomplish both merit and reputation.
derivation: 《墨子·修身》功成名遂，名誉不可虚假。”
derivationTraditional: 《墨子·修身》功成名遂，名譽不可虛假。”
derivationEn: From Mozi: 'When merit is achieved, fame follows; reputation cannot be false.'
example: 你则说做官的～，我则说出家的延年益寿。★元·范子安《陈季卿误上竹叶舟》第二折
exampleTraditional: 你則說做官的～，我則說出家的延年益壽。★元·範子安《陳季卿誤上竹葉舟》第二折
exampleEn: You say that as an official you achieve success and fame; I say that as a monk you prolong life. — Yuan drama, 'Chen Jiqing Mistakenly Boards the Bamboo Leaf Boat', Act 2

explanation: 人的言语、举动、行为。
explanationTraditional: 人的言語、舉動、行為。
explanationEn: Speech and behavior; manner of speaking and acting.
derivation: 清·黄宗羲《陈母沈孺人墓志铭》其言谈举止，不问可知胡先生弟子也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃宗羲《陳母沈孺人墓誌銘》其言談舉止，不問可知胡先生弟子也。”
derivationEn: From Huang Zongxi's 'Epitaph for Mrs. Shen': 'From her speech and behavior, one could tell she was a disciple of Mr. Hu.'
example: 她又长得好看，身子单薄，～非常斯文。★刘绍棠《蒲柳人家》
exampleTraditional: 她又長得好看，身子單薄，～非常斯文。★劉紹棠《蒲柳人家》
exampleEn: She was also good-looking, with a slender figure, and her speech and behavior were very gentle. — Liu Shaotang, 'Willow Village'

explanation: 风风声，消息。一听到风声，就立刻起来响应。
explanationTraditional: 風風聲，消息。一聽到風聲，就立刻起來響應。
explanationEn: Act immediately upon hearing the news; respond instantly to a signal.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《祭赵尉母夫人文》登堂莫及，闻风而起。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《祭趙尉母夫人文》登堂莫及，聞風而起。”
derivationEn: From Chen Liang's 'Eulogy for Mrs. Zhao': 'Unable to ascend the hall, I rise upon hearing the wind.'
example: 这时，石一歌”也～了。★王西彦《骗子和打手》
exampleTraditional: 這時，石一歌”也～了。★王西彥《騙子和打手》
exampleEn: At this time, 'Shi Yige' also acted immediately upon hearing the news. — Wang Xiyan, 'Swindlers and Hitters'

explanation: 徒只，仅仅。家里只有四面的墙壁。形容十分贫困，一无所有。
explanationTraditional: 徒只，僅僅。家裡只有四面的牆壁。形容十分貧困，一無所有。
explanationEn: Have nothing but four walls; be extremely poor.
derivation: 《史记·司马相如列传》文君夜亡奔相如，相如乃与驰归成都，家居徒四壁立。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·司馬相如列傳》文君夜亡奔相如，相如乃與馳歸成都，家居徒四壁立。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian: 'Wenjun eloped with Xiangru, and they returned to Chengdu, where his home had only four walls.'
example: 他已穷到～，身无分文的地步了。
exampleTraditional: 他已窮到～，身無分文的地步了。
exampleEn: He was so poor that his home had nothing but four walls, and he had not a penny to his name.

explanation: 掩遮蔽，遮盖；盗偷。偷铃铛怕别人听见而捂住自己的耳朵。比喻自己欺骗自己，明明掩盖不住的事情偏要想法子掩盖。
explanationTraditional: 掩遮蔽，遮蓋；盜偷。偷鈴鐺怕別人聽見而捂住自己的耳朵。比喻自己欺騙自己，明明掩蓋不住的事情偏要想法子掩蓋。
explanationEn: To deceive oneself by covering one's ears while stealing a bell; to try to cover up something that is obvious.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·自知》百姓有得钟者，欲负而走，则钟大不可负。以椎毁之，钟况然有声。恐人闻之而夺己也，遽掩其耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·自知》百姓有得鍾者，欲負而走，則鍾大不可負。以椎毀之，鍾況然有聲。恐人聞之而奪己也，遽掩其耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Lüshi Chunqiu · Self-Knowledge': A man got a bell and tried to carry it away, but it was too big. He broke it with a hammer, making a loud noise. Fearing others would hear and take it, he quickly covered his ears.
example: 硬把汉奸合法化了，只是～的笨拙的把戏。★闻一多《谨防汉奸合法化》
exampleTraditional: 硬把漢奸合法化了，只是～的笨拙的把戲。★聞一多《謹防漢奸合法化》
exampleEn: Forcing the legalization of traitors is just a clumsy trick of covering one's ears while stealing a bell. — Wen Yiduo, 'Beware of Traitors Legalization'

explanation: 枪杆象树林，子弹象下雨。形容战斗激烈。
explanationTraditional: 槍桿象樹林，子彈象下雨。形容戰鬥激烈。
explanationEn: A forest of guns and a rain of bullets; describes intense combat.
derivation: 冯德英《迎春花》第二章枪林弹雨战火纷飞的日子，江水山觉得还是才开始，却一晃就过去了四年多。”
derivationTraditional: 馮德英《迎春花》第二章槍林彈雨戰火紛飛的日子，江水山覺得還是才開始，卻一晃就過去了四年多。”
derivationEn: From Feng Deying's 'Spring Flowers', Chapter 2: In the days of gunfire and rain of bullets, Jiang Shuishan felt it had just begun, yet four years had passed.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 好象老虎长上了翅膀。比喻强有力的人得到帮助变得更加强有力。
explanationTraditional: 好象老虎長上了翅膀。比喻強有力的人得到幫助變得更加強有力。
explanationEn: Like a tiger with wings added; to become even more powerful with help.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《心书·兵机》将能执兵之权，操兵之势，而临群下，臂如猛虎加之羽翼，而翱翔四海。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《心書·兵機》將能執兵之權，操兵之勢，而臨群下，臂如猛虎加之羽翼，而翱翔四海。”
derivationEn: From Zhuge Liang's 'Xinshu · Military Strategy': A general who wields military power and commands troops is like a fierce tiger with wings, soaring across the world.
example: 因为匪徒们深知，这两件东西一掌握在姜青山手里，就～，再多的人也奈何不了他。★曲波《林海雪原》二七
exampleTraditional: 因為匪徒們深知，這兩件東西一掌握在姜青山手裡，就～，再多的人也奈何不了他。★曲波《林海雪原》二七
exampleEn: The bandits knew that once these two items were in Jiang Qingshan's hands, it would be like a tiger with wings, and no number of men could stop him. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 27

explanation: 连城连在一起的许多城池。形容物品十分贵重。
explanationTraditional: 連城連在一起的許多城池。形容物品十分貴重。
explanationEn: Worth several cities; extremely valuable.
derivation: 《史记·廉颇蔺相如列传》赵惠文王时，得楚和氏璧。秦昭王闻之，使人遗赵王书，原以十五城请易璧。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·廉頗藺相如列傳》趙惠文王時，得楚和氏璧。秦昭王聞之，使人遺趙王書，原以十五城請易璧。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian · Biographies of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru': King Zhao of Qin offered fifteen cities in exchange for the He family jade.
example: 周先生，此乃府上之宝，～。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第十回
exampleTraditional: 周先生，此乃府上之寶，～。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第十回
exampleEn: Mr. Zhou, this is a treasure of your house, worth several cities. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 10

explanation: 看到形势不好。
explanationTraditional: 看到形勢不好。
explanationEn: To see that the situation is unfavorable.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他见势不妙，乘机溜走了。
exampleTraditional: 他見勢不妙，乘機溜走了。
exampleEn: He saw the situation was unfavorable and slipped away.

explanation: 儆使人警醒，不犯错误；效仿效，效法；尤过失。指处理一个坏人或一件坏事，用来警告那些学着做坏事的人。
explanationTraditional: 儆使人警醒，不犯錯誤；效仿效，效法；尤過失。指處理一個壞人或一件壞事，用來警告那些學著做壞事的人。
explanationEn: To punish someone as a warning to others who might imitate them.
derivation: 《左传·庄公二十一年》郑伯效尤，其亦将有咎！”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·莊公二十一年》鄭伯效尤，其亦將有咎！”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan · Duke Zhuang's 21st Year': If Zheng Bo imitates wrongdoing, he will also incur blame.
example: 我以为各人均应先打屁股百下，～。★鲁迅《准风月谈·文床秋梦》
exampleTraditional: 我以為各人均應先打屁股百下，～。★魯迅《準風月談·文床秋夢》
exampleEn: I think each person should first be given a hundred strokes to serve as a warning to others. — Lu Xun, 'Quasi Fengyue Tan · Autumn Dream in Bed'

explanation: 不伦不同类。既非这一类，又非那一类，形容成样子或没有道理。
explanationTraditional: 不倫不同類。既非這一類，又非那一類，形容成樣子或沒有道理。
explanationEn: Neither one thing nor the other; nondescript or inappropriate.
derivation: 明·吴炳《疗炉羹·絮影》眼中人不伦不类，阱中人不伶不俐。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳炳《療爐羹·絮影》眼中人不倫不類，阱中人不伶不俐。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Wu Bing's 'Liao Du Ji · Xu Ying': The person in the eyes is neither fish nor fowl, the person in the trap is neither clever nor foolish.
example: 王夫人听了，早知道来意了。又见他说的～，也不便不理他。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: 王夫人聽了，早知道來意了。又見他說的～，也不便不理他。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十七回
exampleEn: Lady Wang already knew his intention. Seeing his words were neither here nor there, she had to respond. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 67

explanation: 身身分，地位；败毁坏；裂破损。地位丧失，名誉扫地。指做坏事而遭到彻底失败。
explanationTraditional: 身身分，地位；敗毀壞；裂破損。地位喪失，名譽掃地。指做壞事而遭到徹底失敗。
explanationEn: To lose status and reputation; to be utterly discredited.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《贺新郎·别茂嘉十二弟》词将军百战身名裂，向河梁，回头万里，故人长绝。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《賀新郎·別茂嘉十二弟》詞將軍百戰身名裂，向河梁，回頭萬里，故人長絕。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Xin Qiji's 'He Xinlang · Farewell to Jia Shu': The general's hundred battles ruined his body and name, facing the bridge, looking back thousands of miles, old friends forever parted.
example: 家里破产了——我父亲因为地权的事打了官司，闹得～。★杨沫《青春之歌》第一部第二章
exampleTraditional: 家裡破產了——我父親因為地權的事打了官司，鬧得～。★楊沫《青春之歌》第一部第二章
exampleEn: My family went bankrupt—my father lost a lawsuit over land rights, causing him to lose status and reputation. — Yang Mo, 'The Song of Youth', Part 1, Chapter 2

explanation: 形容波光明净。波光阳光或月光照在水波上反射过来的光。粼粼形容水石明净。
explanationTraditional: 形容波光明淨。波光陽光或月光照在水波上反射過來的光。粼粼形容水石明淨。
explanationEn: Sparkling and clear water; describes the shimmering light on water.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 波光粼粼的湖面上，渔帆点点。
exampleTraditional: 波光粼粼的湖面上，漁帆點點。
exampleEn: On the sparkling lake, fishing boats dot the surface.

explanation: 身旁好象没有人。形容态度傲慢，不把别人放在眼里。
explanationTraditional: 身旁好象沒有人。形容態度傲慢，不把別人放在眼裡。
explanationEn: As if there is no one else around; arrogant and self-important.
derivation: 《史记·刺客列传》荆轲嗜酒，日与狗屠及高渐离饮于燕市，酒酣以往，高渐离击筑，荆柯和而歌市中，相乐也，已而相泣，旁若无人者。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·刺客列傳》荊軻嗜酒，日與狗屠及高漸離飲於燕市，酒酣以往，高漸離擊築，荊柯和而歌市中，相樂也，已而相泣，旁若無人者。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian · Biography of Assassins': Jing Ke loved drinking, and daily drank with a dog butcher and Gao Jianli in the market. When drunk, Gao played the zhu, Jing Ke sang, and they wept, as if no one else was there.
example: 陈太尉初下船时，昂昂然，～，坐在中间。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第七十五回
exampleTraditional: 陳太尉初下船時，昂昂然，～，坐在中間。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第七十五回
exampleEn: When Chen Taifu first boarded the ship, he was haughty, as if no one else was around, and sat in the middle. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 75

explanation: 赶着装载很轻的车子走熟悉的路。比喻事情又熟悉又容易。
explanationTraditional: 趕著裝載很輕的車子走熟悉的路。比喻事情又熟悉又容易。
explanationEn: Driving a light carriage on a familiar road. Metaphor for something that is both familiar and easy to do.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送石处士序》若驷马驾轻车就熟路，而王良、造父为之先后也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送石處士序》若駟馬駕輕車就熟路，而王良、造父為之先後也。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Preface to Sending Off the Stone Scholar' in the Tang Dynasty: 'Like four horses pulling a light carriage on a familiar road, with Wang Liang and Zao Fu guiding them.'
example: 逸气轩眉宇，似王良～，骅骝欲舞。★宋·辛弃疾《贺新郎》词
exampleTraditional: 逸氣軒眉宇，似王良～，驊騮欲舞。★宋·辛棄疾《賀新郎》詞
exampleEn: With an air of ease, like Wang Liang driving a light carriage on a familiar road, the piebald horse wants to dance. — Xin Qiji's poem 'Congratulations to the Groom' in the Song Dynasty

explanation: 节、缩节省。省吃省穿。形容节约。
explanationTraditional: 節、縮節省。省吃省穿。形容節約。
explanationEn: To save on food and clothing. Describes being frugal and economical.
derivation: 《史记·贷殖列传》能薄饮食，忍嗜欲，节衣服。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·貸殖列傳》能薄飲食，忍嗜慾，節衣服。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Merchants': 'Able to eat sparingly, endure desires, and save on clothing.'
example: 本来，有关本业的东西，是无论怎样～也应该购买的。★《鲁迅书信集·致赵家璧》
exampleTraditional: 本來，有關本業的東西，是無論怎樣～也應該購買的。★《魯迅書信集·致趙家璧》
exampleEn: Originally, things related to one's profession should be purchased no matter how much one has to save on food and clothing. — Lu Xun's 'Letters to Zhao Jiabi'

explanation: 一句话也不说。
explanationTraditional: 一句話也不說。
explanationEn: Not saying a single word.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 讨论会上，大家都对提出的问题踊跃发表意见，而他却一直～。
exampleTraditional: 討論會上，大家都對提出的問題踴躍發表意見，而他卻一直～。
exampleEn: During the discussion, everyone actively expressed opinions on the issues raised, but he remained silent the whole time.

explanation: 肝胆比喻真心诚意。比喻以真心相见。
explanationTraditional: 肝膽比喻真心誠意。比喻以真心相見。
explanationEn: Liver and gall shine on each other. Metaphor for treating each other with utmost sincerity.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》臣愿披腹心，输肝胆，效愚计，恐足下不能用也。”宋·赵令畸《侯鲭录》同心相亲，照心照胆寿千春。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》臣願披腹心，輸肝膽，效愚計，恐足下不能用也。”宋·趙令畸《侯鯖錄》同心相親，照心照膽壽千春。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin': 'I wish to bare my heart and pour out my liver and gall to offer a foolish plan, fearing you may not use it.' Also from Zhao Lingzhi's 'Hou Qing Lu' in the Song Dynasty: 'With hearts united and livers shining, may we live a thousand springs.'
example: 弟与公子以～，互相知心，故敢以实言相告。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十八章
exampleTraditional: 弟與公子以～，互相知心，故敢以實言相告。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十八章
exampleEn: I and the young master treat each other with utmost sincerity and know each other's hearts, so I dare to tell you the truth. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 18

explanation: 尽全部用出；竭用尽。用尽心思，使出全力。形容做事十分努力。
explanationTraditional: 盡全部用出；竭用盡。用盡心思，使出全力。形容做事十分努力。
explanationEn: To use all one's heart and exert all one's strength. Describes doing something with great effort.
derivation: 汉·马融《忠经·武备章》行此六者，谓之有利，故得师尽其心，竭其力，致其命。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·馬融《忠經·武備章》行此六者，謂之有利，故得師盡其心，竭其力，致其命。”
derivationEn: From Ma Rong's 'Classic of Loyalty: Chapter on Military Preparedness' in the Han Dynasty: 'Practicing these six things is called beneficial, thus the general can make his soldiers use their hearts, exert their strength, and give their lives.'
example: 卿当～，务在必退周兵，以擒罪首。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第八十五回
exampleTraditional: 卿當～，務在必退周兵，以擒罪首。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第八十五回
exampleEn: You must do your utmost to defeat the Zhou army and capture the chief culprit. — Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 85 in the Ming Dynasty

explanation: 把不同内容、不同性质的东西收下来，保存起来。同兼收并蓄”。
explanationTraditional: 把不同內容、不同性質的東西收下來，保存起來。同兼收幷蓄”。
explanationEn: To take in and preserve things of different content and nature. Same as 'include and absorb everything'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 懈松懈，引伸为漏洞、破绽。没有一点弱点可以让人攻击。形容十分严密，找不到一点漏洞。
explanationTraditional: 懈鬆懈，引伸為漏洞、破綻。沒有一點弱點可以讓人攻擊。形容十分嚴密，找不到一點漏洞。
explanationEn: No weakness to attack. Describes something so perfect that no flaw can be found.
derivation: 《孙子·计》攻其无备，出其不意。”曹操注击其懈怠，出其空虚。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·計》攻其無備，出其不意。”曹操注擊其懈怠，出其空虛。”
derivationEn: From Sun Tzu's 'The Art of War: Planning': 'Attack where he is unprepared; appear where you are not expected.' Annotated by Cao Cao: 'Strike when he is lax; appear where he is empty.'
example: 前后不过四五个钟头。却也办得细密周到，～。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一二二回
exampleTraditional: 前後不過四五個鐘頭。卻也辦得細密周到，～。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一二二回
exampleEn: It took only four or five hours, but it was done meticulously and thoroughly, leaving no loophole. — Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 122

explanation: 里手内行人。指精通这种业务的人。
explanationTraditional: 裡手內行人。指精通這種業務的人。
explanationEn: An expert in a particular field; a connoisseur.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》批评东西的毛病，说那东西的出处，着实是个行家。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》批評東西的毛病，說那東西的出處，著實是個行家。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' in the Qing Dynasty: 'Criticizing the flaws of things and explaining their origins, he was indeed an expert.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 增加岁数，延长寿命。
explanationTraditional: 增加歲數，延長壽命。
explanationEn: To increase years and prolong life.
derivation: 战国楚·宋玉《高唐赋》九窍通郁，精神察滞，延年益寿千万岁。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國楚·宋玉《高唐賦》九竅通鬱，精神察滯，延年益壽千萬歲。”
derivationEn: From Song Yu's 'Ode to Gaotang' in the Warring States period (Chu): 'When the nine orifices are unobstructed and the spirit is clear, one can prolong life for thousands of years.'
example: 服肉芝～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九回
exampleTraditional: 服肉芝～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九回
exampleEn: Taking the flesh of the immortal fungus prolongs life. — Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 9 in the Qing Dynasty

explanation: 把事情说得超过原有的程度。
explanationTraditional: 把事情說得超過原有的程度。
explanationEn: To exaggerate; to describe something beyond its actual degree.
derivation: 宋·楼钥《攻媿集·论灾异》祥瑞之出，则润色而张大其词。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·樓鑰《攻媿集·論災異》祥瑞之出，則潤色而張大其詞。”
derivationEn: From Lou Yue's 'Collected Works of Gong Kui: On Disasters' in the Song Dynasty: 'When auspicious signs appear, they embellish and exaggerate them.'
example: 蔡京开边，祖道欲乘时徽富贵，诱王江酋，杨晟免等使纳士，～。★《宋史·王祖道传》
exampleTraditional: 蔡京開邊，祖道欲乘時徽富貴，誘王江酋，楊晟免等使納士，～。★《宋史·王祖道傳》
exampleEn: When Cai Jing opened the border, Wang Zudao wanted to seize the opportunity to gain wealth and honor, so he induced the chieftains Wang Jiang and Yang Shengmian to submit, exaggerating their deeds. — 'History of Song: Biography of Wang Zudao'

explanation: 跋山翻过山岭；涉水用脚趟着水渡过大河。翻山越岭，趟水过河。形容走远路的艰苦。
explanationTraditional: 跋山翻過山嶺；涉水用腳趟著水渡過大河。翻山越嶺，趟水過河。形容走遠路的艱苦。
explanationEn: To travel over mountains and cross rivers; to endure the hardships of a long journey.
derivation: 《诗经·鄘风·载驰》大夫跋涉，我心则忧。”《左传·襄公二十八年》跋山涉水，蒙犯霜露。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·鄘風·載馳》大夫跋涉，我心則憂。”《左傳·襄公二十八年》跋山涉水，蒙犯霜露。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs and Zuo Zhuan: 'The officer trudges over mountains and wades through rivers, my heart is worried.'
example: 同样的青春，同样的年龄，有人～，为改变祖国一穷二白的面貌而感到莫大的幸福。★魏巍《路标》
exampleTraditional: 同樣的青春，同樣的年齡，有人～，為改變祖國一窮二白的面貌而感到莫大的幸福。★魏巍《路標》
exampleEn: With the same youth and age, some people find great happiness in traveling over mountains and crossing rivers to change the poor and backward state of the motherland. — Wei Wei's 'Road Sign'

explanation: 本指身受重伤◇比喻事物受到重大损害。
explanationTraditional: 本指身受重傷◇比喻事物受到重大損害。
explanationEn: To suffer severe injury; to cause major damage to something.
derivation: 元·无名氏《蝴蝶梦》第二折打得来伤筋动骨，更疼似悬头刺股。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《蝴蝶夢》第二折打得來傷筋動骨，更疼似懸頭刺股。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'Butterfly Dream': 'Beaten so badly that muscles and bones are injured, more painful than hanging by the head and stabbing the thigh.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 仆倒下；继接着，跟上。前面的倒下了，后面的紧跟上去。形容斗争的英勇壮烈。
explanationTraditional: 仆倒下；繼接著，跟上。前面的倒下了，後面的緊跟上去。形容鬥爭的英勇壯烈。
explanationEn: As one falls, another steps forward; to advance wave after wave with indomitable spirit.
derivation: 唐·孙樵《祭梓潼神君文》跛马愠仆，前仆后踣。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·孫樵《祭梓潼神君文》跛馬慍僕，前僕後踣。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Sun Qiao's 'Sacrificial Oration to the God of Zitong': 'A lame horse stumbles, one falls and another stumbles.'
example: ～人应在，如君不愧轩辕孙！★清·秋瑾《吊吴烈士樾》
exampleTraditional: ～人應在，如君不愧軒轅孫！★清·秋瑾《吊吳烈士樾》
exampleEn: Those who fall are followed by others, worthy descendants of the Yellow Emperor! — Qiu Jin's 'Mourning for Wu Yue'

explanation: 略掠夺。攻打城市，掠夺土地。
explanationTraditional: 略掠奪。攻打城市，掠奪土地。
explanationEn: To attack cities and seize territory; to conquer land by force.
derivation: 《淮南子·兵略训》攻城略地，莫不降下。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·兵略訓》攻城略地，莫不降下。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi': 'Attacking cities and seizing land, none fail to surrender.'
example: 英法联军侵华的那几年，法国海军附带在越南～。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 英法聯軍侵華的那幾年，法國海軍附帶在越南～。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: During the years of the Anglo-French invasion of China, the French navy also attacked cities and seized territory in Vietnam. — Gao Yang's 'Inside Stories of the Qing Court'

explanation: 负依靠；隅山势弯曲险阻的地方。凭借险阻，顽固抵抗。指依仗某种条件，顽固进行抵抗。
explanationTraditional: 負依靠；隅山勢彎曲險阻的地方。憑藉險阻，頑固抵抗。指依仗某種條件，頑固進行抵抗。
explanationEn: To put up a stubborn fight relying on a strategic position; to resist desperately.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心下》有众逐虎。虎负嵎，莫之敢撄。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心下》有眾逐虎。虎負嵎，莫之敢攖。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'People chased a tiger. The tiger backed into a corner, and no one dared to confront it.'
example: 最后牛元峰逃到镇东头的小寨里，指挥着一个多营～，死不投降。★徐海东《奠基礼》
exampleTraditional: 最後牛元峰逃到鎮東頭的小寨裡，指揮著一個多營～，死不投降。★徐海東《奠基禮》
exampleEn: Finally, Niu Yuanfeng fled to a small fort in the east of the town, commanding more than a battalion to put up a stubborn fight, refusing to surrender. — Xu Haidong's 'Foundation Ceremony'

explanation: 风和影子都是抓不着的。比喻说话做事丝毫没有事实根据。
explanationTraditional: 風和影子都是抓不著的。比喻說話做事絲毫沒有事實根據。
explanationEn: To chase the wind and catch shadows; to speak or act without any factual basis.
derivation: 《汉书·郊祀志》听其言，洋洋满耳，若将可遇；求之，荡荡如系风捕景，终不可得。”《朱子全书》若悠悠地似做不做，如捕风捉影，有甚长进？”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·郊祀志》聽其言，洋洋滿耳，若將可遇；求之，蕩蕩如繫風捕景，終不可得。”《朱子全書》若悠悠地似做不做，如捕風捉影，有甚長進？”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han': 'Listening to his words, they fill the ears as if they could be encountered; seeking them, they are elusive like catching wind and shadow.'
example: 若被黜者一一求其所以得罪之故，～，捏造流言。★明·张居正《乞鉴别忠邪以定国上疏》
exampleTraditional: 若被黜者一一求其所以得罪之故，～，捏造流言。★明·張居正《乞鑑別忠邪以定國上疏》
exampleEn: If those dismissed seek reasons for their punishment, they chase the wind and catch shadows, fabricating rumors. — Zhang Juzheng's 'Memorial on Distinguishing Loyalty and Evil'

explanation: 越跨过；俎古代祭祀时摆祭品的礼器；庖厨师。主祭的人跨过礼器去代替厨师办席。比喻超出自己业务范围去处理别人所管的事。
explanationTraditional: 越跨過；俎古代祭祀時擺祭品的禮器；庖廚師。主祭的人跨過禮器去代替廚師辦席。比喻超出自己業務範圍去處理別人所管的事。
explanationEn: To exceed one's duties and meddle in others' affairs; to take over someone else's job.
derivation: 《庄子·逍遥游》庖人虽不治庖，尸祝不越樽俎而代之矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·逍遙遊》庖人雖不治庖，尸祝不越樽俎而代之矣。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'Though the cook does not manage the kitchen, the priest does not step over the wine and meat vessels to take his place.'
example: 孩子能做的事，父母不要～。
exampleTraditional: 孩子能做的事，父母不要～。
exampleEn: Parents should not exceed their duties and meddle in things their children can do.

explanation: 泛指文人、文士。
explanationTraditional: 泛指文人、文士。
