explanationEn: Literati; men of letters; scholars and poets.
derivation: 清·韩邦庆《海上花列传》而那些封建旧文化培养出来的文人墨客、风流雅士，置国事于不问，整天吃花酒，作艳诗。”
derivationTraditional: 清·韓邦慶《海上花列傳》而那些封建舊文化培養出來的文人墨客、風流雅士，置國事於不問，整天吃花酒，作豔詩。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Han Bangqing's 'Flowers of Shanghai': 'Those literati and elegant scholars nurtured by feudal culture ignored state affairs, spending their days drinking and writing erotic poems.'
example: ～大概是感性太锐敏了之故罢，向来就很娇气，什么也给他说不得，见不得，听不得，想不得。★《鲁迅全集·坟》
exampleTraditional: ～大概是感性太銳敏了之故罷，向來就很嬌氣，什麼也給他說不得，見不得，聽不得，想不得。★《魯迅全集·墳》
exampleEn: Literati are probably too sensitive; they have always been delicate, unable to hear, see, or think about anything. — Lu Xun's 'Grave'

explanation: 好喜欢、贪于。贪于吃喝，懒于做事。
explanationTraditional: 好喜歡、貪於。貪於吃喝，懶於做事。
explanationEn: To be fond of eating and averse to work; gluttonous and lazy.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二这样好吃懒做的淫妇，睡到这等日高才起来。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二這樣好吃懶做的淫婦，睡到這等日高才起來。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement': 'Such a gluttonous and lazy slut, sleeping until this late hour.'
example: 且人前人后，又怨他不会过，只一味～。（清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一回）
exampleTraditional: 且人前人後，又怨他不會過，只一味～。（清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一回）
exampleEn: Moreover, both in public and private, she complained that he was not thrifty, only fond of eating and averse to work. — Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber'

explanation: 祸灾难。指不幸的事接二连三地发生。
explanationTraditional: 禍災難。指不幸的事接二連三地發生。
explanationEn: Misfortunes never come singly; bad things happen in succession.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·权谋》此所谓福不重来，祸必重来者也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·權謀》此所謂福不重來，禍必重來者也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Liu Xiang's 'Shuo Yuan': 'This is what is meant by blessings do not come twice, misfortunes are sure to come again.'
example: ～，那个私立中学因为吃了一家钱庄的倒帐，发不出薪水了。★叶圣陶《得失》
exampleTraditional: ～，那個私立中學因為吃了一家錢莊的倒帳，發不出薪水了。★葉聖陶《得失》
exampleEn: Misfortunes never come singly; that private middle school couldn't pay salaries because a bank it dealt with failed. — Ye Shengtao's 'Gains and Losses'

explanation: 不能决定哪个是对的。形容意见分歧，没有一致的看法。
explanationTraditional: 不能決定哪個是對的。形容意見分歧，沒有一致的看法。
explanationEn: Unable to decide which is right; opinions differ and no consensus is reached.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《痛史》第三回诸将或言固守待援，或言决一死战，或言到临安求救。议论纷纷，莫衷一是。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《痛史》第三回諸將或言固守待援，或言決一死戰，或言到臨安求救。議論紛紛，莫衷一是。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Painful History', Chapter 3: 'The generals debated whether to hold fast and await reinforcements, to fight to the death, or to go to Lin'an for help. Discussions were diverse and no consensus was reached.'
example: 人们议论纷纷，～。
exampleTraditional: 人們議論紛紛，～。
exampleEn: People were discussing animatedly, unable to agree on which was right.

explanation: 牢牢固。异常坚固，不可摧毁。也用在指人固执己见或保守旧习。
explanationTraditional: 牢牢固。異常堅固，不可摧毀。也用在指人固執己見或保守舊習。
explanationEn: Extremely solid, indestructible; also used to describe stubborn adherence to one's views or conservative habits.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《平淮西碑》并为一谈，牢不可破。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《平淮西碑》併為一談，牢不可破。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Stele for Pacifying Huai Xi': 'Lumped together as one, unbreakable.'
example: 我们的团结和友谊是～的。
exampleTraditional: 我們的團結和友誼是～的。
exampleEn: Our unity and friendship are unbreakable.

explanation: 拘、束限制、约束。形容自由自在，没有牵挂。
explanationTraditional: 拘、束限制、約束。形容自由自在，沒有牽掛。
explanationEn: Free and unrestrained, without any constraints.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第二回逐日家无拘无束，自在逍遥此一长生之美。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二回逐日家無拘無束，自在逍遙此一長生之美。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 2: 'Day after day, free and unrestrained, carefree and enjoying the beauty of eternal life.'
example: 他放开缰绳，任由枣红马～和驰骋。
exampleTraditional: 他放開韁繩，任由棗紅馬～和馳騁。
exampleEn: He loosened the reins and let the chestnut horse gallop freely and unrestrainedly.

explanation: 明确指出姓和名。
explanationTraditional: 明確指出姓和名。
explanationEn: To mention someone's name explicitly.
derivation: 欧阳山《三家巷》一人家又没有指名道姓，你动不动就东拉西扯地胡缠些什么？”
derivationTraditional: 歐陽山《三家巷》一人家又沒有指名道姓，你動不動就東拉西扯地胡纏些什麼？”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Shan's 'Three Family Lane': 'They didn't mention any names, so why are you always rambling and making wild guesses?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 坚坚固，结实；磐大石头。象大石头一样坚固。比喻不可动摇。
explanationTraditional: 堅堅固，結實；磐大石頭。象大石頭一樣堅固。比喻不可動搖。
explanationEn: As solid as a rock; unshakable.
derivation: 古乐府《孔雀东南飞》磐石方且厚，可以卒千年。”《文选·古诗十九首》良无磐石固，虚名复何有？”
derivationTraditional: 古樂府《孔雀東南飛》磐石方且厚，可以卒千年。”《文選·古詩十九首》良無磐石固，虛名復何有？”
derivationEn: From ancient yuefu poem 'Peacock Flies Southeast': 'The rock is thick and solid, it can last a thousand years.' Also from 'Nineteen Old Poems': 'Truly without the solidity of a rock, what use is an empty name?'
example: 我们伟大的祖国～。
exampleTraditional: 我們偉大的祖國～。
exampleEn: Our great motherland is as solid as a rock.

explanation: 困难和曲折。
explanationTraditional: 困難和曲折。
explanationEn: Difficult and tortuous.
derivation: 毛泽东《关于正确处理人民内部矛盾的问题》任何新生事物的成长都是要经过艰难曲折的。在社会主义事业中，要想不经过艰难曲折。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《關於正確處理人民內部矛盾的問題》任何新生事物的成長都是要經過艱難曲折的。在社會主義事業中，要想不經過艱難曲折。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'On the Correct Handling of Contradictions Among the People': 'The growth of any new thing goes through difficult and tortuous processes. In socialist undertakings, one cannot avoid difficult and tortuous paths.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 云说；亦也。人家怎么说，自己也跟着怎么说。指没有主见，只会随声附和。
explanationTraditional: 雲說；亦也。人家怎麼說，自己也跟著怎麼說。指沒有主見，只會隨聲附和。
explanationEn: To echo what others say; to have no independent opinion and just follow others.
derivation: 金·蔡松年《槽声同彦高赋》诗槽床过竹春泉句，他日人云吾亦云。”
derivationTraditional: 金·蔡松年《槽聲同彥高賦》詩槽床過竹春泉句，他日人云吾亦云。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Cai Songnian's poem: 'The trough bed passes through bamboo, spring well verses; someday others will say what I say.'
example: 刊物内容如果只是～”，格式如果只是亦步亦趋”，那是刊物的尾巴主义。★邹韬奋《经历·几个原则》
exampleTraditional: 刊物內容如果只是～”，格式如果只是亦步亦趨”，那是刊物的尾巴主義。★鄒韜奮《經歷·幾個原則》
exampleEn: If the content of a publication merely echoes others and follows the same pattern, it is tailism. — Zou Taofen, 'Experience: Several Principles'

explanation: 悬崖高而陡的山崖；勒马收住缰绳，使马停步。在高高的山崖边上勒住马。比喻到了危险的边缘及时清醒回头。
explanationTraditional: 懸崖高而陡的山崖；勒馬收住韁繩，使馬停步。在高高的山崖邊上勒住馬。比喻到了危險的邊緣及時清醒回頭。
explanationEn: To rein in at the brink of a cliff; to wake up and turn back in time when at the edge of danger.
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》此书生悬崖勒马，可谓大智矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》此書生懸崖勒馬，可謂大智矣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage': 'This scholar reined in at the brink of a cliff; he can be called greatly wise.'
example: 您铸成大错在前，已经对不起天地祖宗，赶快～吧！★华而实《汉衣冠》三
exampleTraditional: 您鑄成大錯在前，已經對不起天地祖宗，趕快～吧！★華而實《漢衣冠》三
exampleEn: You have already made a great mistake, failing heaven and earth and your ancestors. Quickly rein in at the brink of the cliff! — Hua Ershi, 'Han Garments', Chapter 3

explanation: 原指一旦中了科举就扬名天下◇指一下子就出了名。
explanationTraditional: 原指一旦中了科舉就揚名天下◇指一下子就出了名。
explanationEn: To become famous overnight, originally referring to passing the imperial examination and gaining renown.
derivation: 《战国策·秦策》然则是一举而伯王之名可成也。” 唐·韩愈《唐故国子司业窦公墓志铭》公一举成名而东，遇其党必曰‘非我之才，维吾舅之私。’”。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·秦策》然則是一舉而伯王之名可成也。” 唐·韓愈《唐故國子司業竇公墓誌銘》公一舉成名而東，遇其黨必曰‘非我之才，維吾舅之私。’”。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qin Strategy': 'Thus, with one action, one can achieve the fame of a hegemon king.' Also from Tang Dynasty Han Yu's epitaph: 'He became famous with one action and went east, telling his peers: 'It is not my talent, but my uncle's favor.''
example: 十年窗下无人问，～天下知。★金·刘祁《归潜志》卷七
exampleTraditional: 十年窗下無人問，～天下知。★金·劉祁《歸潛志》卷七
exampleEn: Ten years of hard study unknown to all, once successful, the whole world knows. — Jin Dynasty Liu Qi, 'Gui Qian Zhi', Volume 7

explanation: 雨后转晴。也比喻政治上由黑暗到光明。
explanationTraditional: 雨後轉晴。也比喻政治上由黑暗到光明。
explanationEn: The rain clears and the sky becomes sunny; also metaphorically refers to a transition from darkness to light in politics.
derivation: 明·谢肇涮《文海披沙记》御批云‘雨过天青云破处，这般颜色做将来。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·謝肇涮《文海披沙記》御批雲‘雨過天青雲破處，這般顏色做將來。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xie Zhaozhe's 'Wen Hai Pi Sha Ji': 'The imperial comment said: 'After rain, the sky clears and clouds break, such colors will come in the future.''
example: ～的早晨，空气清新极了。
exampleTraditional: ～的早晨，空氣清新極了。
exampleEn: The morning after the rain cleared, the air was extremely fresh.

explanation: 变幻变化不可测度。变化很多，不能预料。
explanationTraditional: 變幻變化不可測度。變化很多，不能預料。
explanationEn: Unpredictable changes; constantly changing and impossible to anticipate.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《殿中少监马君墓志》当是时，见王于北亭，犹高山深林巨谷龙虎，变化不测，杰魁人也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《殿中少監馬君墓誌》當是時，見王於北亭，猶高山深林巨谷龍虎，變化不測，傑魁人也。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Epitaph for the Young Supervisor Ma' in the Tang Dynasty: 'At that time, I saw the prince at the North Pavilion, like high mountains, deep forests, giant valleys, dragons and tigers, changing unpredictably, a heroic figure.'
example: 吾红水阵”内夺壬癸之精，藏天乙之妙，～。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 吾紅水陣”內奪壬癸之精，藏天乙之妙，～。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第四十四回
exampleEn: Inside my 'Red Water Formation,' the essence of Ren and Gui is seized, the mystery of Tian Yi is hidden, and it is unpredictable. (From Fengshen Yanyi, Chapter 44)

explanation: 激冲去；浊脏水；清清水。冲去污水，让清水上来。比喻清除坏的，发扬好的。
explanationTraditional: 激衝去；濁髒水；清清水。衝去汙水，讓清水上來。比喻清除壞的，發揚好的。
explanationEn: To drain away the muddy and bring in the clear; metaphorically, to eliminate the bad and promote the good.
derivation: 《尸子·君治》扬清激浊，荡去滓秽，义也。”
derivationTraditional: 《屍子·君治》揚清激濁，蕩去滓穢，義也。”
derivationEn: From 'Shizi · Junzhi': 'To drain away the muddy and bring in the clear, to wash away dregs and filth, is righteousness.'
example: 待制为官，尽忠报国，～。★元·无名氏《陈州粜米》第二折
exampleTraditional: 待制為官，盡忠報國，～。★元·無名氏《陳州糶米》第二折
exampleEn: As a minister, he served the country with loyalty and eliminated the bad while promoting the good. (From Yuan dynasty anonymous play 'Chenzhou Selling Rice', Act 2)

explanation: 与赞许，赞助；为做；善好事。指赞成人学好。现指善意帮助人。
explanationTraditional: 與讚許，贊助；為做；善好事。指贊成人學好。現指善意幫助人。
explanationEn: To praise and support others in doing good; now means to help others with good intentions.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》取诸人以为善，是与人为善者也。故君子莫大乎与人为善。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》取諸人以為善，是與人為善者也。故君子莫大乎與人為善。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius · Gongsun Chou I': 'To take from others and do good is to be good with others. Therefore, nothing is greater for a gentleman than being good with others.'
example: 想你们教士也是～，断不肯叫我为难的。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第九回
exampleTraditional: 想你們教士也是～，斷不肯叫我為難的。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第九回
exampleEn: I thought you missionaries were also kind-hearted and would never make things difficult for me. (From Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 9)

explanation: 形容夜晚灯光明亮的繁华景象。
explanationTraditional: 形容夜晚燈光明亮的繁華景象。
explanationEn: Describes a brilliantly lit scene at night, indicating prosperity and bustle.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷二十二理宗皇帝游苑，登凤凰山，至夜望见西湖内灯火辉煌，一片光明。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷二十二理宗皇帝遊苑，登鳳凰山，至夜望見西湖內燈火輝煌，一片光明。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 22: 'Emperor Lizong toured the garden, climbed Phoenix Mountain, and at night saw the West Lake brilliantly lit with lanterns.'
example: 尤氏等送至大厅前，见～，众小厮都在丹墀侍立。★清·曹雪琴《红楼梦》第七回
exampleTraditional: 尤氏等送至大廳前，見～，眾小廝都在丹墀侍立。★清·曹雪琴《紅樓夢》第七回
exampleEn: Madam You and others escorted to the front hall, where lanterns were blazing and all the servants stood waiting in the courtyard. (From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 7)

explanation: 光天最大的天，大白天；化日生长万物的太阳。原形容太平盛世◇比喻大家看得非常清楚的场合。
explanationTraditional: 光天最大的天，大白天；化日生長萬物的太陽。原形容太平盛世◇比喻大家看得非常清楚的場合。
explanationEn: Originally described a peaceful and prosperous era; now refers to a place or occasion where everything is clearly visible to all.
derivation: 《尚书·益稷》帝光天之下，至于海隅苍生。”《后汉书·王符传》化国之日舒以长，故其民闲暇而力有余。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·益稷》帝光天之下，至於海隅蒼生。”《後漢書·王符傳》化國之日舒以長，故其民閒暇而力有餘。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents · Yi and Ji': 'The emperor's light shines under heaven, reaching the corners of the sea.' And 'Book of Later Han · Wang Fu's Biography': 'The days of a transformed country are long and leisurely, so its people have leisure and surplus energy.'
example: 彼残忍乖邪之气，不能荡溢于～之下。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二回
exampleTraditional: 彼殘忍乖邪之氣，不能蕩溢於～之下。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二回
exampleEn: That cruel and perverse qi cannot dissipate under the broad daylight. (From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 2)

explanation: 向归向，向往。指人民群众所拥护的，向往的。
explanationTraditional: 向歸向，嚮往。指人民群眾所擁護的，嚮往的。
explanationEn: The direction of people's hearts; what the masses support and yearn for.
derivation: 《晋书·熊远传》人心所归，惟道与义。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·熊遠傳》人心所歸，惟道與義。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin · Xiong Yuan's Biography': 'Where people's hearts return, only the Way and righteousness.'
example: 这是～，此人和之大利。★曲波《林海雪原》三七
exampleTraditional: 這是～，此人和之大利。★曲波《林海雪原》三七
exampleEn: This is what the people want, and this harmony brings great benefit. (From Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 37)

explanation: 形容零散稀疏的样子。特指原来又多又整齐的东西现在零散了。
explanationTraditional: 形容零散稀疏的樣子。特指原來又多又整齊的東西現在零散了。
explanationEn: Scattered and sparse; especially describes things that were originally numerous and orderly but are now in disarray.
derivation: 宋·惟白《建中靖国续灯录》卷六无味之谈，七零八落。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·惟白《建中靖國續燈錄》卷六無味之談，七零八落。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty Weibai's 'Jianzhong Jingguo Continuation of the Lamp Record', Volume 6: 'Tasteless talk, scattered and fragmented.'
example: 一个小小家当，弄得～。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十六
exampleTraditional: 一個小小家當，弄得～。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十六
exampleEn: A small family fortune was reduced to a mess. (From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 16)

explanation: 桑田农田。大海变成桑田，桑田变成大海。比喻世事变化很大。
explanationTraditional: 桑田農田。大海變成桑田，桑田變成大海。比喻世事變化很大。
explanationEn: The sea turns into mulberry fields and vice versa; metaphor for great changes in the world.
derivation: 晋·葛洪《神仙传·麻姑》麻姑自说云，接待以来，已见东海三为桑田。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·葛洪《神仙傳·麻姑》麻姑自說雲，接待以來，已見東海三為桑田。”
derivationEn: From Ge Hong's 'Biographies of Immortals · Magu': 'Magu said that since she came, she has seen the Eastern Sea turn into mulberry fields three times.'
example: ～，谓世事之多变。★清·程元升《幼学故事琼林·地舆》
exampleTraditional: ～，謂世事之多變。★清·程元升《幼學故事瓊林·地輿》
exampleEn: The sea changes into mulberry fields, indicating the many changes in the world. (From Cheng Yunsheng's 'Elementary Learning Stories · Geography')

explanation: 又是刮风，又是下雨。比喻几种灾难同时袭来。
explanationTraditional: 又是颳風，又是下雨。比喻幾種災難同時襲來。
explanationEn: Wind and rain occurring together; metaphor for several disasters striking simultaneously.
derivation: 清·梁章钜《浪迹丛谈·除夕元旦两诗》冬至前后，则连日阴噎，风雨交加，逾月不止。”
derivationTraditional: 清·梁章鉅《浪跡叢談·除夕元旦兩詩》冬至前後，則連日陰噎，風雨交加，逾月不止。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Liang Zhangju's 'Random Notes · Poems on New Year's Eve and New Year's Day': 'Around the winter solstice, it was overcast for days, with wind and rain together for over a month.'
example: 难以想象，他是怎样渡过那～的日子的。
exampleTraditional: 難以想象，他是怎樣渡過那～的日子的。
exampleEn: It is hard to imagine how he got through those days of wind and rain.

explanation: 呕恶心，想吐。比喻使人极端厌恶。
explanationTraditional: 嘔噁心，想吐。比喻使人極端厭惡。
explanationEn: To make one feel like vomiting; metaphor for something extremely disgusting.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他的下流动作真～。
exampleTraditional: 他的下流動作真～。
exampleEn: His vulgar actions are truly disgusting.

explanation: 心、意心思；回、转掉转。重新考虑，改变原来的想法和态度。
explanationTraditional: 心、意心思；回、轉掉轉。重新考慮，改變原來的想法和態度。
explanationEn: To change one's mind or attitude; to reconsider and alter one's original thoughts or stance.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类·训门人·五》且人一日间，此心是起多少私意，起多少计较，都不会略略回心转意去看。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類·訓門人·五》且人一日間，此心是起多少私意，起多少計較，都不會略略回心轉意去看。”
derivationEn: Zhu Xi's 'Classified Conversations of Zhu Xi': 'Moreover, in a single day, a person's mind generates so many selfish thoughts and calculations, yet they never slightly change their mind to look at it.'
example: 要不然时，叫他趁早～，有多少好处。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: 要不然時，叫他趁早～，有多少好處。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十六回
exampleEn: Otherwise, tell him to change his mind early, there are many benefits. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 46

explanation: 也称充血性心力衰竭或心功能不全。心脏因疾病、过劳、排血功能减弱，以至排血量不能满足器官及组织代谢的需要。主要症状是呼吸困难、喘息、水肿等。
explanationTraditional: 也稱充血性心力衰竭或心功能不全。心臟因疾病、過勞、排血功能減弱，以至排血量不能滿足器官及組織代謝的需要。主要症狀是呼吸困難、喘息、水腫等。
explanationEn: Also known as congestive heart failure or cardiac insufficiency. The heart's ability to pump blood is weakened due to disease or overwork, failing to meet the metabolic needs of organs and tissues. Main symptoms include dyspnea, wheezing, and edema.
derivation: 霍达《穆斯林的葬礼》第八章‘啊？心力衰竭？’天星把妹妹抱上病床，他的胳膊在抖，嘴唇也在抖，妹妹的惭他吓傻了，她还不满十八岁，怎么会……衰竭？”
derivationTraditional: 霍達《穆斯林的葬禮》第八章‘啊？心力衰竭？’天星把妹妹抱上病床，他的胳膊在抖，嘴唇也在抖，妹妹的慚他嚇傻了，她還不滿十八歲，怎麼會……衰竭？”
derivationEn: Huo Da, 'The Muslim Funeral', Chapter 8: 'Ah? Heart failure?' Tianxing carried his sister onto the hospital bed, his arms and lips trembling. His sister's condition scared him; she was not yet eighteen, how could she... fail?
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 畏恐惧，害怕。看见了就害怕。
explanationTraditional: 畏恐懼，害怕。看見了就害怕。
explanationEn: To be terrified at the sight; to feel fear upon seeing something or someone.
derivation: 《论语·尧曰》君子正其衣冠，尊其瞻视，俨然人望而畏之，斯不亦威而不猛乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·堯曰》君子正其衣冠，尊其瞻視，儼然人望而畏之，斯不亦威而不猛乎？”
derivationEn: 'The Analects of Confucius: Yao Yue': 'A gentleman adjusts his attire, respects his gaze, and appears dignified so that people look at him with awe. Is this not being majestic without being fierce?'
example: 加上他那黑而峻厉的面孔，颇使我～。★孙犁《远的怀念》
exampleTraditional: 加上他那黑而峻厲的面孔，頗使我～。★孫犁《遠的懷念》
exampleEn: Coupled with his dark and stern face, it made me quite fearful at the sight. — Sun Li, 'Remembrances of the Distant'

explanation: 是对，正确。没有一点儿对的或好的地方。
explanationTraditional: 是對，正確。沒有一點兒對的或好的地方。
explanationEn: Having no correct or good points; completely wrong or worthless.
derivation: 明·张岱《与胡季望》是犹三家村子，使之治山珍海错，烹饪燔炙，一无是处。明眼观之，只发一粲。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張岱《與胡季望》是猶三家村子，使之治山珍海錯，烹飪燔炙，一無是處。明眼觀之，只發一粲。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Zhang Dai, 'Letter to Hu Jiwang': 'It is like a village cook trying to prepare delicacies from mountains and seas; in cooking and roasting, there is nothing correct. To a discerning eye, it only provokes laughter.'
example: 我们看问题要全面、要一分为二，不要因为人家有缺点，就认为人家～。
exampleTraditional: 我們看問題要全面、要一分為二，不要因為人家有缺點，就認為人家～。
exampleEn: We should view problems comprehensively and dialectically; do not think that because someone has shortcomings, they are completely without merit.

explanation: 逊谦让，有礼貌。说话粗暴无礼。
explanationTraditional: 遜謙讓，有禮貌。說話粗暴無禮。
explanationEn: To speak rudely or insolently; to utter disrespectful words.
derivation: 《三国志·魏书·张郺传》郺快军败，出言不逊。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏書·張郺傳》郺快軍敗，出言不遜。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Book of Wei: Biography of Zhang He': 'Zhang He, frustrated by military defeat, spoke insolently.'
example: 八岁纵笔成文，本郡举他神童，起送至京。因～，冲突了试官，打落下去。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷三十一
exampleTraditional: 八歲縱筆成文，本郡舉他神童，起送至京。因～，衝突了試官，打落下去。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷三十一
exampleEn: At eight, he could write essays fluently; his county recommended him as a child prodigy and sent him to the capital. Because he spoke rudely and offended the examiner, he was dismissed. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 31

explanation: 磊落心地光明坦白。胸怀坦白，正大光明。
explanationTraditional: 磊落心地光明坦白。胸懷坦白，正大光明。
explanationEn: Open and aboveboard; having a clear conscience and acting with integrity.
derivation: 《晋书·右勒载记下》大丈夫行事，当礌（磊）落落，如日月皎然。”宋·朱熹《朱子语类》卷七十四譬如人光明磊落底便是好人，昏昧迷暗底便不是好人。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·右勒載記下》大丈夫行事，當礌（磊）落落，如日月皎然。”宋·朱熹《朱子語類》卷七十四譬如人光明磊落底便是好人，昏昧迷暗底便不是好人。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin: Biography of Shi Le': 'A great man should act with openness and brightness, like the sun and moon.' Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, 'Classified Conversations of Zhu Xi', Volume 74: 'For example, a person who is open and aboveboard is a good person; one who is confused and dark is not a good person.'
example: 公子光明磊落，为天人所钦瞩。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·聂小倩》
exampleTraditional: 公子光明磊落，為天人所欽矚。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·聶小倩》
exampleEn: The young master was open and aboveboard, admired by heaven and people. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Nie Xiaoqian'

explanation: 养育儿子是为了防备年老。亦泛指养育子女以防老年无依靠。
explanationTraditional: 養育兒子是為了防備年老。亦泛指養育子女以防老年無依靠。
explanationEn: To raise children to provide for oneself in old age; to have children as a safeguard against being alone in old age.
derivation: 宋·陈元靓《事林广记》养儿防老，积谷防饥。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳元靚《事林廣記》養兒防老，積穀防饑。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Chen Yuanliang, 'Shi Lin Guang Ji': 'Raise children to guard against old age, store grain to guard against famine.'
example: ～的观念应该改变了。
exampleTraditional: ～的觀念應該改變了。
exampleEn: The concept of raising children for old age should change.

explanation: 人寰人世。世界上再没有比这更惨痛的事。形容惨痛到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 人寰人世。世界上再沒有比這更慘痛的事。形容慘痛到了極點。
explanationEn: Extremely cruel or tragic; unparalleled in the world in terms of misery.
derivation: 峻青《故乡杂忆》指挥着几百万美械装备的大军，向解放区进行着惨绝人寰的大屠杀。”
derivationTraditional: 峻青《故鄉雜憶》指揮著幾百萬美械裝備的大軍，向解放區進行著慘絕人寰的大屠殺。”
derivationEn: Jun Qing, 'Miscellaneous Memories of Hometown': 'Commanding an army of millions equipped with American weapons, they carried out a massacre of unparalleled cruelty in the liberated areas.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 乌有哪有，何有。变得什么都没有。指全部消失或完全落空。
explanationTraditional: 烏有哪有，何有。變得什麼都沒有。指全部消失或完全落空。
explanationEn: To become nothing; to vanish completely or come to nothing.
derivation: 汉·司马相如《子虚赋》楚使子虚使于齐，王悉发车骑，与使者出畋。畋罢，子虚过姹乌有先生，亡是公存焉。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬相如《子虛賦》楚使子虛使於齊，王悉發車騎，與使者出畋。畋罷，子虛過奼烏有先生，亡是公存焉。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Sima Xiangru, 'Sir Vacuous': 'The King of Chu sent Sir Vacuous to Qi. The King of Qi mobilized all his chariots and horsemen to go hunting with the envoy. After the hunt, Sir Vacuous visited Master Nothing and Sir Nowhere.'
example: 岂意青州六从事，～一先生。★宋·苏轼《章质夫送酒六壶，书至而酒不达，戏作小诗问之》诗
exampleTraditional: 豈意青州六從事，～一先生。★宋·蘇軾《章質夫送酒六壺，書至而酒不達，戲作小詩問之》詩
exampleEn: Who would have thought that the six bottles of wine from Qingzhou would turn into nothing for a gentleman? — Song Dynasty, Su Shi, 'A Poem Asking Zhang Zhifu About the Wine That Did Not Arrive'

explanation: 比喻煽动别人闹事。
explanationTraditional: 比喻煽動別人鬧事。
explanationEn: To fan the flames; to incite others to cause trouble or stir up conflict.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 家家点上了灯。指天黑上灯的时候。也形容城市夜晚的景象。
explanationTraditional: 家家點上了燈。指天黑上燈的時候。也形容城市夜晚的景象。
explanationEn: Lamps are lit in every household. Refers to the time when night falls and lights come on. Also describes the night scene of a city.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第八回万家灯火吹箫路，五夜星辰赌酒天。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第八回萬家燈火吹簫路，五夜星辰賭酒天。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 8: 'With myriad lights, the flute accompanies the night; under the five-watch stars, we gamble for wine.'
example: 签后当日送出，我回家时已经～了。★邹韬奋《抗战以来·临行的一封信》
exampleTraditional: 籤後當日送出，我回家時已經～了。★鄒韜奮《抗戰以來·臨行的一封信》
exampleEn: After signing, I left that day. When I returned home, it was already time for myriad lights. ★ Zou Taofen, 'Since the War of Resistance: A Letter Before Departure'

explanation: 荡动摇；回回转。形容文章、乐曲十分婉转动人。
explanationTraditional: 蕩動搖；回回轉。形容文章、樂曲十分婉轉動人。
explanationEn: Describes music, literature, etc., that is deeply moving and stirring.
derivation: 战国·楚·宋玉《高唐赋》感心动耳，回肠伤气。”三国·魏·曹丕《大墙上蒿行》女娥长歌，声协宫商，感心动耳，荡气回肠。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·宋玉《高唐賦》感心動耳，迴腸傷氣。”三國·魏·曹丕《大牆上蒿行》女娥長歌，聲協宮商，感心動耳，蕩氣迴腸。”
derivationEn: Warring States, Chu, Song Yu's 'Gaotang Fu': 'Moves the heart and stirs the ear, twists the gut and hurts the spirit.' Three Kingdoms, Wei, Cao Pi's 'On the Great Wall': 'The female singers' long songs harmonize with the scale, moving the heart and stirring the ear, twisting the gut and stirring the spirit.'
example: 这首乐曲旋律优美动人，令人～。
exampleTraditional: 這首樂曲旋律優美動人，令人～。
exampleEn: This melody is beautiful and moving, stirring the heart and twisting the gut.

explanation: 挽挽回；狂澜猛烈的大波浪。比喻尽力挽回危险的局势。
explanationTraditional: 挽挽回；狂瀾猛烈的大波浪。比喻盡力挽回危險的局勢。
explanationEn: To do one's utmost to reverse a dangerous situation.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《进学解》障百川而东之，回狂澜于既倒。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《進學解》障百川而東之，回狂瀾於既倒。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'On Advancement': 'Block all rivers and turn them eastward, reversing the raging waves that are about to fall.'
example: 乾坤苍莽正风尘，～仗要人。★清·丘逢甲《岭云每日楼诗钞·村居书感次崧甫韵二首》
exampleTraditional: 乾坤蒼莽正風塵，～仗要人。★清·丘逢甲《嶺雲每日樓詩鈔·村居書感次崧甫韻二首》
exampleEn: The world is vast and chaotic; to reverse the raging waves relies on a capable person. ★ Qing Dynasty, Qiu Fengjia's 'Poems from Lingyun Daily Tower: Village Dwelling Feelings, Second Rhyme to Songfu'

explanation: 形容十分真挚诚恳。
explanationTraditional: 形容十分真摯誠懇。
explanationEn: Describes being extremely sincere and earnest.
derivation: 《后汉书·马援传》开心见诚，无所隐伏。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·馬援傳》開心見誠，無所隱伏。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Ma Yuan': 'Open-hearted and sincere, with nothing hidden.'
example: 大远的～来了，岂有个不叫你见个真佛儿去的呢？★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六回
exampleTraditional: 大遠的～來了，豈有個不叫你見個真佛兒去的呢？★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六回
exampleEn: Having come such a long distance with utmost sincerity, how could we not let you see the true Buddha? ★ Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 6

explanation: 赤光着。大部分身体或全身裸露。
explanationTraditional: 赤光著。大部分身體或全身裸露。
explanationEn: Having most or all of the body exposed; naked.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第84回耀武扬威，辱骂不绝；多有解衣卸甲，赤身裸体，或谁或坐。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第84回耀武揚威，辱罵不絕；多有解衣卸甲，赤身裸體，或誰或坐。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 84: 'Showing off their might, hurling endless insults; many took off their armor and clothes, naked, some standing, some sitting.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 矫扭转；枉弯曲。把弯的东西扳正，又歪到了另一边。比喻纠正错误超过了应有的限度。
explanationTraditional: 矯扭轉；枉彎曲。把彎的東西扳正，又歪到了另一邊。比喻糾正錯誤超過了應有的限度。
explanationEn: To overcorrect; to exceed the proper limits in correcting an error.
derivation: 《后汉书·仲长统传》逮至清世，则复入矫枉过正之检。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·仲長統傳》逮至清世，則復入矯枉過正之檢。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Zhongchang Tong': 'When it comes to a clear era, one again falls into the trap of overcorrection.'
example: 或有避其谤者，又每～，至坐视儿女之放纵，而不一置问。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·细柳》
exampleTraditional: 或有避其謗者，又每～，至坐視兒女之放縱，而不一置問。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·細柳》
exampleEn: Some, to avoid criticism, often overcorrect, even sitting idly by while their children indulge without a word. ★ Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Slender Willow'

explanation: 磅礴广大无边际的样子。形容气势浩大。
explanationTraditional: 磅礴廣大無邊際的樣子。形容氣勢浩大。
explanationEn: Describes a grand and powerful momentum.
derivation: 毛泽东《给陈毅同志谈诗的一封信》你的大作，大气磅礴。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《給陳毅同志談詩的一封信》你的大作，大氣磅礴。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'Letter to Comrade Chen Yi on Poetry': 'Your great work is grand and powerful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 噪群鸣。一时名声很大。名声传扬于一个时期。
explanationTraditional: 噪群鳴。一時名聲很大。名聲傳揚於一個時期。
explanationEn: To be famous for a period of time; to have one's name widely known for a while.
derivation: 明·沈德符《万历野获编·国师阅文偶误》娄上王辰玉、松江董元宰入都，名噪一时。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《萬曆野獲編·國師閱文偶誤》婁上王辰玉、松江董元宰入都，名噪一時。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shen Defu's 'Unofficial Gleanings of the Wanli Era: National Scholar's Occasional Misreading': 'Lou Shang Wang Chenyu and Songjiang Dong Qichang entered the capital, famous for a time.'
example: 朱半仙，时文中之能手也，～。★清·宣鼎《夜雨秋灯录三集·科场》
exampleTraditional: 朱半仙，時文中之能手也，～。★清·宣鼎《夜雨秋燈錄三集·科場》
exampleEn: Zhu Banxian, a master of contemporary prose, was famous for a time. ★ Qing Dynasty, Xuan Ding's 'Night Rain and Autumn Lamp: Three Collections: Imperial Examinations'

explanation: 苍白灰白。形容贫弱无力。
explanationTraditional: 蒼白灰白。形容貧弱無力。
explanationEn: Pale and feeble; lacking strength or vitality.
derivation: 朱自清《历史的战斗中》那拥抱过去的人虽不一定‘苍白无力’，那也不免外强中干。”
derivationTraditional: 朱自清《歷史的戰鬥中》那擁抱過去的人雖不一定‘蒼白無力’，那也不免外強中乾。”
derivationEn: Zhu Ziqing's 'In the Battle of History': 'Those who embrace the past may not be 'pale and feeble,' but they are outwardly strong and inwardly weak.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①形容人神志清爽，心情舒暢。②形容人长得神态清明，气质爽朗。
explanationTraditional: ①形容人神志清爽，心情舒暢。②形容人長得神態清明，氣質爽朗。
explanationEn: ① Describes a person with a clear mind and cheerful mood. ② Describes a person with a clear expression and refreshing temperament.
derivation: 宋·李昿《太平广记》卷十七引唐·牛僧孺《续玄怪录·裴谌》香风飒来，神清气爽，飘飘然有凌云之意。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李昿《太平廣記》卷十七引唐·牛僧孺《續玄怪錄·裴諶》香風颯來，神清氣爽，飄飄然有凌雲之意。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Li Fang's 'Extensive Records of the Taiping Era', Volume 17, citing Tang Dynasty, Niu Sengru's 'Sequel to the Strange Tales: Pei Chen': 'A fragrant breeze came, refreshing the spirit and clearing the mind, with a feeling of floating above the clouds.'
example: 长揖而坐，～，满坐风生，顾眄炜如也。★宋·张君房《云笈七签》卷一一二
exampleTraditional: 長揖而坐，～，滿坐風生，顧眄煒如也。★宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》卷一一二
exampleEn: He bowed and sat down, refreshed and clear-minded, filling the room with vitality, his gaze shining like fire. ★ Song Dynasty, Zhang Junfang's 'Seven Slips of a Cloudy Satchel', Volume 112

explanation: 形容关系密切，感情深厚。
explanationTraditional: 形容關係密切，感情深厚。
explanationEn: Describes a close relationship with deep affection.
derivation: 明·王世贞《鸣凤记·拜谒忠灵》与严家大相自幼往往来来，嘻嘻哈哈，同眠同坐，相亲相爱，就是一个人相交，不放下怀。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王世貞《鳴鳳記·拜謁忠靈》與嚴家大相自幼往往來來，嘻嘻哈哈，同眠同坐，相親相愛，就是一個人相交，不放下懷。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wang Shizhen's 'Ming Feng Ji': '...intimate and loving, like one person.'
example: 想起昨天晚上，还是有说有笑，～的何等有趣，今天晚上变了这个情形。★清·吴趼人《情变》第五回
exampleTraditional: 想起昨天晚上，還是有說有笑，～的何等有趣，今天晚上變了這個情形。★清·吳趼人《情變》第五回
exampleEn: Thinking of last night, they were talking and laughing, loving and happy, but tonight it's completely different.

explanation: 连珠串珠。巧妙风趣的话一个接一个。
explanationTraditional: 連珠串珠。巧妙風趣的話一個接一個。
explanationEn: Witty and humorous remarks come one after another.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他妙语连珠地发言让大家捧腹大笑。
exampleTraditional: 他妙語連珠地發言讓大家捧腹大笑。
exampleEn: His witty remarks made everyone laugh heartily.

explanation: 形容举止慌张，不稳重。
explanationTraditional: 形容舉止慌張，不穩重。
explanationEn: Describes flustered and unsteady behavior.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言·陈御史巧勘金钗钿》身上穿得整整齐齐，脚儿走得慌慌张张，望着园门欲进不进的。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言·陳御史巧勘金釵鈿》身上穿得整整齊齊，腳兒走得慌慌張張，望著園門欲進不進的。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Yu Shi Ming Yan': '...walking hurriedly, looking flustered.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 姹、嫣娇艳。形容各种花朵娇艳美丽。
explanationTraditional: 奼、嫣嬌豔。形容各種花朵嬌豔美麗。
explanationEn: Describes various flowers blooming in beautiful and bright colors.
derivation: 明·汤显祖《牡丹亭·惊梦》原来姹紫嫣红开遍，似这般都付与断井颓垣。”
derivationTraditional: 明·湯顯祖《牡丹亭·驚夢》原來奼紫嫣紅開遍，似這般都付與斷井頹垣。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Tang Xianzu's 'The Peony Pavilion': 'The garden is a riot of purple and red.'
example: 见垂柳拖丝，拂境清幽；～，迎风弄鸟，别有一种赏心之境。★清·禇人获《隋唐演义》六十九回
exampleTraditional: 見垂柳拖絲，拂境清幽；～，迎風弄鳥，別有一種賞心之境。★清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》六十九回
exampleEn: Seeing the willows trailing, the scene is serene; the flowers are gorgeous, welcoming the birds, creating a delightful atmosphere.

explanation: 想说，但又不痛痛快快地说。形容说话有顾虑。
explanationTraditional: 想說，但又不痛痛快快地說。形容說話有顧慮。
explanationEn: To speak hesitantly, not straightforwardly, due to concerns.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第五回你一味的吞吞吐吐，支支吾吾，你把我作何等人看待。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第五回你一味的吞吞吐吐，支支吾吾，你把我作何等人看待。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Legend of Heroes': 'You keep hemming and hawing, what do you take me for?'
example: 至于新作，现在可是难了，较好的简直无处发表，但若做得～，自己又觉无聊。（鲁迅《书信集·致曹靖华》）
exampleTraditional: 至於新作，現在可是難了，較好的簡直無處發表，但若做得～，自己又覺無聊。（魯迅《書信集·致曹靖華》）
exampleEn: As for new works, it's hard now; good ones have nowhere to publish, but if I write hesitantly, I feel bored myself.

explanation: 识知道。见过的多，知道的广。形容阅历深，经验多。
explanationTraditional: 識知道。見過的多，知道的廣。形容閱歷深，經驗多。
explanationEn: Having seen much and known widely, describing rich experience and knowledge.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷一还是大家宝眷，见多识广，比男子汉眼力到胜十倍。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷一還是大家寶眷，見多識廣，比男子漢眼力到勝十倍。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Gu Jin Xiao Shuo': '...well-traveled and knowledgeable, even better than men.'
example: 她是每天上街去买菜的，自然～，知道这东西的时价。★茅盾《过年》
exampleTraditional: 她是每天上街去買菜的，自然～，知道這東西的時價。★茅盾《過年》
exampleEn: She goes to the market every day, so naturally she is knowledgeable and knows the current price of this item.

explanation: 废被废置的事情；待等待；兴兴办。许多被搁置的事情等着要兴办。
explanationTraditional: 廢被廢置的事情；待等待；興興辦。許多被擱置的事情等著要興辦。
explanationEn: Many neglected things are waiting to be undertaken.
derivation: 王颖《海外赤子》百废待兴，一下子怎么能抓得过来。”
derivationTraditional: 王穎《海外赤子》百廢待興，一下子怎麼能抓得過來。”
derivationEn: From Wang Ying's 'Overseas Chinese': 'Everything is waiting to be done, we can't handle it all at once.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 雨大得象盆里的水直往下倒。形容雨大势急。
explanationTraditional: 雨大得象盆裡的水直往下倒。形容雨大勢急。
explanationEn: Rain falls as if poured from a basin, describing heavy and torrential rain.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《白帝》诗白帝城中云出门，白帝城下雨翻盆。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《白帝》詩白帝城中雲出門，白帝城下雨翻盆。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Fu's poem 'White Emperor': 'Clouds rise from White Emperor City, rain pours down from the city.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 自己开辟一条路。比喻独创一种风格或新的方法。
explanationTraditional: 自己開闢一條路。比喻獨創一種風格或新的方法。
explanationEn: To open a new path for oneself, metaphorically creating a unique style or new method.
derivation: 清·叶燮《原诗·外篇上》抹倒体裁，声调、气象、格力诸说，独辟蹊径。”
derivationTraditional: 清·葉燮《原詩·外篇上》抹倒體裁，聲調、氣象、格力諸說，獨闢蹊徑。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ye Xie's 'Yuan Shi': '...dismissing various theories and blazing a new trail.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 临面临∶象面对着强大的敌人。形容把本来不是很紧迫的形势看得十分严重。
explanationTraditional: 臨面臨∶象面對著強大的敵人。形容把本來不是很緊迫的形勢看得十分嚴重。
explanationEn: As if facing a formidable enemy, describing treating a not-so-urgent situation as very serious.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第五十八回到了抚院，又碰了止辕，衙门里扎了许多兵，如临大敌。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第五十八回到了撫院，又碰了止轅，衙門裡紮了許多兵，如臨大敵。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years': '...the yamen was full of soldiers, as if facing a great enemy.'
example: 他们全副武装地散开，～。
exampleTraditional: 他們全副武裝地散開，～。
exampleEn: They spread out fully armed, as if facing a great enemy.

explanation: 患祸患，灾难。事先有准备，就可以避免祸患。
explanationTraditional: 患禍患，災難。事先有準備，就可以避免禍患。
explanationEn: Preparedness prevents calamity. If you are prepared in advance, you can avoid disaster.
derivation: 《尚书·说命中》惟事事，乃其有备，有备无患。”《左传·襄公十一年》居安思危，思则有备，有备无患。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·說命中》惟事事，乃其有備，有備無患。”《左傳·襄公十一年》居安思危，思則有備，有備無患。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Charge to Yue' and 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xiang's 11th Year': 'Be prepared for everything, and you will have no trouble.'
example: 季斯预戒汶上百姓，修堤盖屋。不三日，果然天降大雨，汶水泛滥，鲁民～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十八回
exampleTraditional: 季斯預戒汶上百姓，修堤蓋屋。不三日，果然天降大雨，汶水氾濫，魯民～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十八回
exampleEn: Ji Si warned the people of Wenshang to repair dikes and roofs. Within three days, heavy rain fell and the Wen River flooded, but the people of Lu were prepared and thus avoided disaster. — Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 78

explanation: 指没有根据，不符实际的瞎说，或说胡话。
explanationTraditional: 指沒有根據，不符實際的瞎說，或說胡話。
explanationEn: To talk nonsense; to speak without basis or reality; to rave.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十六这二老汉，各人好与三十棒∥故？一个说长说短，一个胡言乱语。虽然如是，且放过一著。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十六這二老漢，各人好與三十棒∥故？一個說長說短，一個胡言亂語。雖然如是，且放過一著。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting the Source', Volume 16: 'One talks long and short, the other talks nonsense.'
example: 你则管哩便～，将我厮花白。★元·无名氏《渔樵记》第二折
exampleTraditional: 你則管哩便～，將我廝花白。★元·無名氏《漁樵記》第二折
exampleEn: You just keep talking nonsense and slandering me. — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Fisherman and the Woodcutter', Act 2

explanation: 催催促，促使。形容事迹十分感人，使人不禁流下眼泪。
explanationTraditional: 催催促，促使。形容事蹟十分感人，使人不禁流下眼淚。
explanationEn: To move someone to tears; describing a very touching story that makes people cry.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 积累少量的东西，能成为巨大的数量。
explanationTraditional: 積累少量的東西，能成為巨大的數量。
explanationEn: Many a little makes a mickle; accumulating small amounts results in a large quantity.
derivation: 《战国策·秦策四》积薄而为厚，聚少而为多。”《汉书·董仲舒传》聚少成多，积小致巨。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·秦策四》積薄而為厚，聚少而為多。”《漢書·董仲舒傳》聚少成多，積小致巨。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Qin IV' and 'Book of Han: Biography of Dong Zhongshu': 'Accumulate thin to become thick, gather little to become much.'
example: 其实一个人做一把刀、一个勺子是有限得很，然而～，这笔账就难算了，何况更是历年如此呢。★《二十年目睹之怪现状》第二十九回
exampleTraditional: 其實一個人做一把刀、一個勺子是有限得很，然而～，這筆賬就難算了，何況更是歷年如此呢。★《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第二十九回
exampleEn: Actually, one person making a knife or a spoon is very limited, but many a little makes a mickle, and this account is hard to calculate, especially over the years. — 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 29

explanation: 交一齐，同时；瘁疲劳。精神和体力都极度劳累。
explanationTraditional: 交一齊，同時；瘁疲勞。精神和體力都極度勞累。
explanationEn: Both mentally and physically exhausted; extreme fatigue of mind and body.
derivation: 冰心《南归—贡献给母亲在天之灵》我们心力交瘁，能报母亲的恩慈于万一么？”
derivationTraditional: 冰心《南歸—貢獻給母親在天之靈》我們心力交瘁，能報母親的恩慈於萬一麼？”
derivationEn: From Bing Xin's 'Returning South: Dedicated to My Mother in Heaven': 'We are mentally and physically exhausted; can we repay even a fraction of our mother's kindness?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指个人的私心、私利。
explanationTraditional: 指個人的私心、私利。
explanationEn: Personal selfishness or private interests.
derivation: 宋·李格非《书洛阳名园记后》放乎一己之私，自为之而忘天下之治，忽欲退享此得乎？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李格非《書洛陽名園記後》放乎一己之私，自為之而忘天下之治，忽欲退享此得乎？”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Li Gefei's 'Postscript to the Record of Luoyang Gardens': 'Indulging in personal selfishness, acting for oneself and forgetting the governance of the world.'
example: 上则扰乱政治，下则摇惑民心，皆由腐败官僚有意编造，以快～。★章炳麟《致报界俱进会书》
exampleTraditional: 上則擾亂政治，下則搖惑民心，皆由腐敗官僚有意編造，以快～。★章炳麟《致報界俱進會書》
exampleEn: Above, it disrupts politics; below, it confuses the people's hearts. All this is fabricated by corrupt officials to satisfy their personal selfishness. — Zhang Binglin, 'Letter to the Press Association'

explanation: 茅庐草房。原比喻新露头脚。现比喻刚离开家庭或学校出来工作。缺乏经验。
explanationTraditional: 茅廬草房。原比喻新露頭腳。現比喻剛離開家庭或學校出來工作。缺乏經驗。
explanationEn: Just starting out in one's career; lacking experience; literally 'first emergence from the thatched cottage' (referring to Zhuge Liang's first battle).
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三九回直须惊破曹公胆，初出茅庐第一功。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三九回直須驚破曹公膽，初出茅廬第一功。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 39: 'It startled Cao Cao's army, the first achievement of one just out of the thatched cottage.'
example: 那傻小子是～”，我们准可以扫光他！★鲁迅《彷惶·高老夫子》
exampleTraditional: 那傻小子是～”，我們準可以掃光他！★魯迅《彷惶·高老夫子》
exampleEn: That fool is just starting out; we can surely wipe him out! — Lu Xun, 'Wandering: Old Master Gao'

explanation: 形容待人处事随随便便，满不在乎。
explanationTraditional: 形容待人處事隨隨便便，滿不在乎。
explanationEn: Careless; casual; indifferent; describing a person who is easygoing and not meticulous.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他就是大大咧咧的性格。
exampleTraditional: 他就是大大咧咧的性格。
exampleEn: He is just a careless person.

explanation: 形容诗文结构严密自然，用词运典毫无斧凿痕迹。亦形容人的才德完美自然。
explanationTraditional: 形容詩文結構嚴密自然，用詞運典毫無斧鑿痕跡。亦形容人的才德完美自然。
explanationEn: Perfectly natural; like nature itself; describing a poem or writing with seamless structure and no trace of artificiality; also describing a person's talent and virtue as perfect and natural.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《上襄阳于相公书》阁下负超卓之奇才，蓄雄刚之俊德，浑然天成，无有畔岸。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《上襄陽於相公書》閣下負超卓之奇才，蓄雄剛之俊德，渾然天成，無有畔岸。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Letter to Minister Yu of Xiangyang': 'You possess extraordinary talent and majestic virtue, perfectly natural without boundaries.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 有的从南往北，有的从北往南。也泛指来来往往。
explanationTraditional: 有的從南往北，有的從北往南。也泛指來來往往。
explanationEn: Coming and going; traveling from south to north and north to south; referring to people moving in all directions.
derivation: 元·李行道《灰阑记》第三折但是南来北往，经商客旅，都来我这店里吃酒。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李行道《灰闌記》第三折但是南來北往，經商客旅，都來我這店裡吃酒。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Li Xingdao's 'The Chalk Circle', Act 3: 'All travelers coming from south and going north come to my inn for wine.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心意真实诚恳，没有虚假。
explanationTraditional: 心意真實誠懇，沒有虛假。
explanationEn: Sincere and genuine, without any pretense.
derivation: 元·无名氏《百花亭》第三折常言道海深须见底，各办着个真心实意。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《百花亭》第三折常言道海深須見底，各辦著個真心實意。”
derivationEn: From the third act of 'The Hundred Flowers Pavilion' by an anonymous Yuan author: 'As the saying goes, the deep sea must be seen to the bottom; each prepares a sincere heart and true intention.'
example: 他相信献忠确实是～地归顺朝廷。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十六章
exampleTraditional: 他相信獻忠確實是～地歸順朝廷。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十六章
exampleEn: He believed that Xianzhong was indeed sincerely surrendering to the court. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 16

explanation: 象牛身上的的毛那样多。形容极多。
explanationTraditional: 象牛身上的的毛那樣多。形容極多。
explanationEn: As numerous as the hairs on an ox; extremely abundant.
derivation: 《北史·文苑列传序》学者如牛毛，成者如麟角。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·文苑列傳序》學者如牛毛，成者如麟角。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Preface to the Literary Scholars' Biography': 'Scholars are as numerous as ox hairs, but those who succeed are as rare as unicorn horns.'
example: 老百姓痛恨官府催粮催捐，苛捐杂派～，逼得老百姓活不下去。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleTraditional: 老百姓痛恨官府催糧催捐，苛捐雜派～，逼得老百姓活不下去。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleEn: The common people hated the government's grain and tax collections; the numerous miscellaneous taxes and levies were as many as ox hairs, forcing them to live in misery. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 28

explanation: 心里急得像火烧一样。形容非常焦急。
explanationTraditional: 心裡急得像火燒一樣。形容非常焦急。
explanationEn: Extremely anxious, as if one's heart is burning like fire.
derivation: 清·吴璇《飞龙全传》那管院的太监，心燎意急，一筹莫展。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳璇《飛龍全傳》那管院的太監，心燎意急，一籌莫展。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Wu Xuan's 'The Complete Legend of the Flying Dragon': 'The eunuch in charge of the palace was so anxious that his heart was burning and his mind was blank.'
example: 铁头～，忽噜忽噜喝碗菜粥，摞下筷子。★管桦《上学》
exampleTraditional: 鐵頭～，忽嚕忽嚕喝碗菜粥，摞下筷子。★管樺《上學》
exampleEn: Tietou, extremely anxious, gulped down a bowl of vegetable porridge, put down his chopsticks. — Guan Hua, 'Going to School'

explanation: 颠沛跌倒，比喻穷困，受挫折；流离浪落。由于灾荒或战乱而流转离散。形容生活艰难，四处流浪。
explanationTraditional: 顛沛跌倒，比喻窮困，受挫折；流離浪落。由於災荒或戰亂而流轉離散。形容生活艱難，四處流浪。
explanationEn: To be destitute and wander about due to disasters or war; to live a hard life and drift from place to place.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·荡》人亦有言，颠沛之揭。”《汉书·薛广德传》窃见关东困极，人民流离。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·蕩》人亦有言，顛沛之揭。”《漢書·薛廣德傳》竊見關東困極，人民流離。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Daya: Dang' and 'The Book of Han: Biography of Xue Guangde': 'People have a saying: when falling, the roots are exposed.' 'I see that the east of the pass is extremely poor, and the people are displaced.'
example: 我所感到悲哀的，是有几个同我来的学生，至今还找不到学校进，还在～。★鲁迅《而已集·通信》
exampleTraditional: 我所感到悲哀的，是有幾個同我來的學生，至今還找不到學校進，還在～。★魯迅《而已集·通信》
exampleEn: What I feel sad about is that several students who came with me still cannot find schools to enter and are still wandering and displaced. — Lu Xun, 'And So On: Correspondence'

explanation: 逆着水流的方向行船。比喻不努力就要后退。
explanationTraditional: 逆著水流的方向行船。比喻不努力就要後退。
explanationEn: Sailing against the current; metaphor for needing to make constant effort to avoid falling behind.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文·门外文谈》即使目下还有点逆水行舟，也只好拉纤。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文·門外文談》即使目下還有點逆水行舟，也只好拉縴。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Qie Jie Ting Essays: Outside the Door of Literature': 'Even if it is still like sailing against the current, one has to pull the towline.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 势急心慌，顾不上选择道路。
explanationTraditional: 勢急心慌，顧不上選擇道路。
explanationEn: In a panic, one cannot choose the right path; to flee in any direction without thinking.
derivation: 元·施惠《幽闺记·山寒巡逻》陀满兴福来到此间，所谓慌不择路，饥不择食，只得结集亡命，哨聚山森。”
derivationTraditional: 元·施惠《幽閨記·山寒巡邏》陀滿興福來到此間，所謂慌不擇路，飢不擇食，只得結集亡命，哨聚山森。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty Shi Hui's 'The Story of the Secluded Boudoir: Patrol in the Cold Mountains': 'Tuoman Xingfu came here, so-called 'in panic one cannot choose the road, in hunger one cannot choose food', so he had to gather outlaws and gather in the mountains.'
example: 饥不择食，寒不择衣，～，贫不择妻。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第三回
exampleTraditional: 飢不擇食，寒不擇衣，～，貧不擇妻。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第三回
exampleEn: In hunger one cannot choose food, in cold one cannot choose clothes, in panic one cannot choose the road, in poverty one cannot choose a wife. — Ming dynasty Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 3

explanation: 号号令；施发布。发布命令。现在也用来形容指挥别人。
explanationTraditional: 號號令；施發佈。發佈命令。現在也用來形容指揮別人。
explanationEn: To issue orders; now also used to describe bossing others around.
derivation: 《尚书·冏命》发号施令，罔有不藏。”《淮南子·本经训》发号施令，天下莫不从风。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·冏命》發號施令，罔有不藏。”《淮南子·本經訓》發號施令，天下莫不從風。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Documents: Jiong Ming' and 'Huainanzi: Benjing Xun': 'Issuing orders, none are not good.' 'Issuing orders, the world follows like the wind.'
example: 我们历来主张革命要依靠人民群众，大家动手，反对只依靠少数人～。★《毛泽东选集·对晋绥日报编辑人员的谈话》
exampleTraditional: 我們歷來主張革命要依靠人民群眾，大家動手，反對只依靠少數人～。★《毛澤東選集·對晉綏日報編輯人員的談話》
exampleEn: We have always advocated that revolution should rely on the masses, with everyone taking action, and oppose relying only on a few to issue orders. — 'Selected Works of Mao Zedong: Talk with the Editors of the Shanxi-Chahar-Hebei Daily'

explanation: 投迎合；其代词，他，他的；好爱好。迎合别人的喜好。
explanationTraditional: 投迎合；其代詞，他，他的；好愛好。迎合別人的喜好。
explanationEn: To cater to someone's likes or preferences.
derivation: 《庄子·庚桑楚》是故非以其所好笼之而可得者，无有也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·庚桑楚》是故非以其所好籠之而可得者，無有也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Gengsang Chu': 'Therefore, without using what one likes to attract them, nothing can be obtained.'
example: 今王志在报吴，必先～，然后得制其命。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 今王志在報吳，必先～，然後得制其命。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十回
exampleEn: Now the king's ambition is to take revenge on Wu; he must first cater to his likes, then he can control his fate. — Ming dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 80

explanation: 老花招或老手法又重新施展。同故技重演”。
explanationTraditional: 老花招或老手法又重新施展。同故技重演”。
explanationEn: To repeat an old trick or tactic.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 一对盗贼～，但被当场抓获。
exampleTraditional: 一對盜賊～，但被當場抓獲。
exampleEn: A pair of thieves repeated their old trick but were caught on the spot.

explanation: 照按照；本书本；宣宣读；科科条，条文。照着本子念条文。形容讲课、发言等死板地按照课文、讲稿，没有发挥，不生动。
explanationTraditional: 照按照；本書本；宣宣讀；科科條，條文。照著本子念條文。形容講課、發言等死板地按照課文、講稿，沒有發揮，不生動。
explanationEn: To read aloud from a script or text without any creativity or liveliness; to be mechanical in teaching or speaking.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《西蜀梦》第三折也不用僧人持咒，道士宣科。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《西蜀夢》第三折也不用僧人持咒，道士宣科。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Dream of the Western Shu': 'No need for monks to chant spells, or Taoists to recite scriptures.'
example: 说法是～，十分单纯的。（郭沫若《少年时代·我的童年》）
exampleTraditional: 說法是～，十分單純的。（郭沫若《少年時代·我的童年》）
exampleEn: The explanation was simply reading from the script, very plain. — Guo Moruo, 'Youth: My Childhood'

explanation: 把一种花木的枝条或嫩芽嫁接在另一种花木上。比喻暗中用手段更换人或事物来欺骗别人。
explanationTraditional: 把一種花木的枝條或嫩芽嫁接在另一種花木上。比喻暗中用手段更換人或事物來欺騙別人。
explanationEn: To graft one flower onto another tree; metaphorically, to secretly replace one person or thing with another to deceive others.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十七同窗友认假作真，女秀才移花接木。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十七同窗友認假作真，女秀才移花接木。”
derivationEn: From Ling Mengchu's 'Er Ke Pai An Jing Qi', Volume 17: 'Classmates pretend false as true, a female scholar moves flowers and connects trees.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 每个人都感到自己不安全，有危险。
explanationTraditional: 每個人都感到自己不安全，有危險。
explanationEn: Everyone feels insecure and in danger.
derivation: 《史记·李斯列传》法令诛罚，日益深刻，群臣人人自危，欲畔者众。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·李斯列傳》法令誅罰，日益深刻，群臣人人自危，欲畔者眾。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Li Si': 'Laws and punishments became increasingly severe, and all officials felt insecure, with many wanting to rebel.'
example: 满京城的戚畹、勋旧和缙绅们为着李国瑞的事～，家家惊慌。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十章
exampleTraditional: 滿京城的戚畹、勳舊和縉紳們為著李國瑞的事～，家家驚慌。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十章
exampleEn: The imperial relatives, meritorious officials, and gentry in the capital were all panicked over Li Guoshi's case, every family in fear. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 30

explanation: 原指打仗时一个人上阵。比喻行动没人帮助。
explanationTraditional: 原指打仗時一個人上陣。比喻行動沒人幫助。
explanationEn: Originally meant fighting alone in battle; metaphorically, acting without help from others.
derivation: 五代·楚·汪遵《乌江》诗兵散弓残挫虎威，单枪匹马突重围。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·楚·汪遵《烏江》詩兵散弓殘挫虎威，單槍匹馬突重圍。”
derivationEn: From Wang Zun's poem 'Wu Jiang' in the Five Dynasties: 'Soldiers scattered, bow broken, tiger's might crushed, single spear and lone horse break through the siege.'
example: 冯寡妇大骂那些女人是熊包，自己～，趁人们在街上歇晌的当儿，故意在大街上向村西头走。★冯德英《迎春花》第十三章
exampleTraditional: 馮寡婦大罵那些女人是熊包，自己～，趁人們在街上歇晌的當兒，故意在大街上向村西頭走。★馮德英《迎春花》第十三章
exampleEn: Widow Feng cursed those women as cowards, and single-handedly, while people were resting in the streets during the noon break, deliberately walked toward the west end of the village. — Feng Deying, 'Spring Flowers', Chapter 13

explanation: 国是国事；国家的大政方针。共同商量国家的政策和方针。
explanationTraditional: 國是國事；國家的大政方針。共同商量國家的政策和方針。
explanationEn: To discuss national policies and guidelines together.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 嘶哑；竭尽。嗓子喊哑，气力用尽。形容竭力呼喊。
explanationTraditional: 嘶啞；竭盡。嗓子喊啞，氣力用盡。形容竭力呼喊。
explanationEn: Hoarse voice and exhausted strength; describes shouting with all one's might.
derivation: 闻一多《贾岛》眼看见前进也是枉然，不要说他们早已声嘶力竭。”
derivationTraditional: 聞一多《賈島》眼看見前進也是枉然，不要說他們早已聲嘶力竭。”
derivationEn: From Wen Yiduo's 'Jia Dao': 'Seeing that moving forward is futile, let alone that they are already hoarse and exhausted.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 尊称死者的精神。
explanationTraditional: 尊稱死者的精神。
explanationEn: A respectful term for the spirit of a deceased person.
derivation: 鲁迅《而已集·黄花节的杂感》我并非说，大家都须天天去痛哭流涕，以凭吊先烈的‘在天之灵’，一年中有一天记住他们就可以了。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《而已集·黃花節的雜感》我並非說，大家都須天天去痛哭流涕，以憑弔先烈的‘在天之靈’，一年中有一天記住他們就可以了。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Er Yi Ji: Miscellaneous Thoughts on Huanghua Hill': 'I don't mean that everyone should weep bitterly every day to pay homage to the martyrs' spirits in heaven; it's enough to remember them one day a year.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 举行动。指多余的，没有必要的举动。
explanationTraditional: 舉行動。指多餘的，沒有必要的舉動。
explanationEn: An unnecessary action; doing something superfluous.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第四回寅兄盛情，多此一举。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第四回寅兄盛情，多此一舉。”
derivationEn: From Li Lüyuan's 'Qixing Deng' in the Qing Dynasty, Chapter 4: 'Brother Yin's generous sentiment is an unnecessary move.'
example: 问起北京人来，只知道《三侠五义》，而南方人却只见有曲园老人的改本，此老实在可谓～。★《鲁迅书信集·致胡适》
exampleTraditional: 問起北京人來，只知道《三俠五義》，而南方人卻只見有曲園老人的改本，此老實在可謂～。★《魯迅書信集·致胡適》
exampleEn: When asking Beijing natives, they only know 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants', but southerners only see the revised version by Quyuan, which is indeed an unnecessary move. — 'Lu Xun's Letters: To Hu Shi'

explanation: 混搀杂，冒充。拿鱼眼睛冒充珍珠。比喻用假的冒充真的。
explanationTraditional: 混攙雜，冒充。拿魚眼睛冒充珍珠。比喻用假的冒充真的。
explanationEn: To pass off fish eyes as pearls; metaphorically, to pass off something fake as genuine.
derivation: 汉·魏伯阳《参同契》卷上鱼目岂为珠？蓬蒿不成槚。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·魏伯陽《參同契》捲上魚目豈為珠？蓬蒿不成檟。”
derivationEn: From Wei Boyang's 'Can Tong Qi' in the Han Dynasty, Volume 1: 'How can fish eyes be pearls? Fleabane does not become oak.'
example: 可是这些卖国的老爷们不是也在～，也在自称为爱国忧民的志士吗？★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第三十八章
exampleTraditional: 可是這些賣國的老爺們不是也在～，也在自稱為愛國憂民的志士嗎？★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第三十八章
exampleEn: But aren't those traitorous officials also passing off fish eyes as pearls, calling themselves patriotic and concerned citizens? — Yang Mo, 'The Song of Youth', Part 2, Chapter 38

explanation: 形容人规规矩矩，谨慎胆小的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容人規規矩矩，謹慎膽小的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes a person who is honest, well-behaved, and timid.
derivation: 周立波《暴风骤雨》第一部二这时他躺在炕上，光顾抽大烟，把一个老实巴交的老田头晾在一边。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《暴風驟雨》第一部二這時他躺在炕上，光顧抽大煙，把一個老實巴交的老田頭晾在一邊。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane', Part 1, Section 2: 'At that time, lying on the kang, he was only smoking opium, leaving the honest and timid Old Man Tian ignored.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 舟车船与车，泛指一切水陆交通工具。劳顿劳累疲倦。形容旅途疲劳困顿。
explanationTraditional: 舟車船與車，泛指一切水陸交通工具。勞頓勞累疲倦。形容旅途疲勞困頓。
explanationEn: Fatigue from travel by boat and carriage; describes exhaustion from a long journey.
derivation: 钱钟书《围城》第二章那两位记者都说‘今天方博士舟车劳顿，明天早晨到府聆教。’”
derivationTraditional: 錢鍾書《圍城》第二章那兩位記者都說‘今天方博士舟車勞頓，明天早晨到府聆教。’”
derivationEn: From Qian Zhongshu's 'Fortress Besieged', Chapter 2: 'Both reporters said, 'Dr. Fang is fatigued from travel today; we will visit you tomorrow morning to receive your instruction.''
example: 等回到保定，因为～，公事又多，曾国藩的眼疾，越发重了，而岁尾年头，不如意的事，纷至沓来。★高阳《慈禧全传》第二部二七
exampleTraditional: 等回到保定，因為～，公事又多，曾國藩的眼疾，越發重了，而歲尾年頭，不如意的事，紛至沓來。★高陽《慈禧全傳》第二部二七
exampleEn: After returning to Baoding, due to travel fatigue and many official duties, Zeng Guofan's eye disease worsened, and at the end of the year, unpleasant events came thick and fast. — Gao Yang, 'The Complete Story of Empress Dowager Cixi', Part 2, Section 27

explanation: 指很少见，很奇异，不同一般。
explanationTraditional: 指很少見，很奇異，不同一般。
explanationEn: Rare, strange, and unusual; out of the ordinary.
derivation: 清邵梅臣《画耕偶录》稀奇古怪，我法我派。一钱不值，万钱不卖。”
derivationTraditional: 清邵梅臣《畫耕偶錄》稀奇古怪，我法我派。一錢不值，萬錢不賣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Shao Meichen's 'Random Notes on Painting': 'Strange and rare, my method my school. Worthless for a penny, not sold for ten thousand.'
example: 老残道这也罢了，只是你赶紧说你那～的案情罢。”★《老残游记》第十三回
exampleTraditional: 老殘道這也罷了，只是你趕緊說你那～的案情罷。”★《老殘遊記》第十三回
exampleEn: Lao Can said, 'That's fine, but you should quickly tell me about your strange and unusual case.' — 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 13

explanation: 大计长远的重要的计划。指关系到长远利益的计划或措施。
explanationTraditional: 大計長遠的重要的計劃。指關係到長遠利益的計劃或措施。
explanationEn: A long-term and important plan; a matter of fundamental importance for many years to come.
derivation: 清·梁启超《论民族竞争之大势》数月之间，而其权力已深入巩固，而百年大计于以定矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·梁啟超《論民族競爭之大勢》數月之間，而其權力已深入鞏固，而百年大計於以定矣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao's 'On the Trend of National Competition': 'Within a few months, its power had penetrated deeply and become consolidated, and the century-long plan was thus settled.'
example: ～，教育为本。
exampleTraditional: ～，教育為本。
exampleEn: A century-long plan, education is the foundation.

explanation: 指形象丑恶，使人看不下去。
explanationTraditional: 指形象醜惡，使人看不下去。
explanationEn: Too ugly or disgusting to look at; unbearable to the eye.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二十三回此数肴也，以先生视之，固不堪入目矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二十三回此數餚也，以先生視之，固不堪入目矣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 23: 'These dishes, in your view, are certainly unbearable to the eye.'
example: 说着，早一屁股坐下，那种气极败坏的样子，实是～。★《晚清文学丛钞·瞎编奇闻》第三回
exampleTraditional: 說著，早一屁股坐下，那種氣極敗壞的樣子，實是～。★《晚清文學叢鈔·瞎編奇聞》第三回
exampleEn: With that, he sat down immediately, looking utterly disheartened, truly unbearable to the eye. — 'Late Qing Literature Series: Strange Stories', Chapter 3

explanation: 展舒展。由于忧愁而双眉紧锁。形容心事重重的样子。
explanationTraditional: 展舒展。由於憂愁而雙眉緊鎖。形容心事重重的樣子。
explanationEn: To knit one's brows in worry; to have a worried look; to be heavy-hearted.
derivation: 唐·姚鹄《随州献李侍御》之二旧隐每杯空竟夕，愁眉不展几经春。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·姚鵠《隨州獻李侍御》之二舊隱每杯空竟夕，愁眉不展幾經春。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Yao Hu's 'To Li Shiyu in Suizhou': 'Often recalling old times, empty all night; worried brows unknit for several springs.'
example: 后见统领端茶，只得退回家中，～的终日在家里对老婆孩子咳声叹气。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十回
exampleTraditional: 後見統領端茶，只得退回家中，～的終日在家裡對老婆孩子咳聲嘆氣。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十回
exampleEn: Later, seeing the commander finish tea, he had to return home, frowning all day, sighing to his wife and children. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats', Chapter 30

explanation: 末节小事情，小节。细小的树枝，策末的环节。比喻事情或问题的细小而无关紧要的部分。
explanationTraditional: 末節小事情，小節。細小的樹枝，策末的環節。比喻事情或問題的細小而無關緊要的部分。
explanationEn: Small and insignificant details; minor issues.
derivation: 《礼记·乐记》铺筵席，陈遵俎，列笾豆，以升降为礼者，礼之末节也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·樂記》鋪筵席，陳遵俎，列籩豆，以升降為禮者，禮之末節也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Record of Music': 'Spreading mats, arranging stands and vessels, setting out dishes—these are the minor details of rites.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 窍洞，指心窍。没有一窍是贯通的。比喻一点儿也不懂。
explanationTraditional: 竅洞，指心竅。沒有一竅是貫通的。比喻一點兒也不懂。
explanationEn: To know nothing about something; to be utterly ignorant.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·过理》杀比干而视其心，不适也。孔子闻之曰‘其窍通，则比干不死矣。’”高诱注纣性不仁，心不通，安于为恶，杀比干，故孔子言其一窍通则比干不见杀也。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·過理》殺比干而視其心，不適也。孔子聞之曰‘其竅通，則比干不死矣。’”高誘注紂性不仁，心不通，安於為惡，殺比干，故孔子言其一竅通則比干不見殺也。”
derivationEn: From 'Lüshi Chunqiu: Excessive Conduct': 'He killed Bigan and examined his heart, which was not suitable. Confucius heard and said, 'If his orifices were open, Bigan would not have died.'' Gao You's commentary: 'Zhou was unkind, his heart blocked, content in evil, killing Bigan; thus Confucius said if one orifice were open, Bigan would not have been killed.'
example: 虽然他是～的浑虫，可是双桥镇上并无镇长”之流的官儿，他也还明白。★茅盾《子夜》六
exampleTraditional: 雖然他是～的渾蟲，可是雙橋鎮上並無鎮長”之流的官兒，他也還明白。★茅盾《子夜》六
exampleEn: Although he was a complete ignoramus, he still understood that there was no such official as 'town mayor' in Shuangqiao Town. — Mao Dun's 'Midnight', Chapter 6

explanation: 和连同。连盘子也端出来了。比喻全都讲出来，毫不保留。
explanationTraditional: 和連同。連盤子也端出來了。比喻全都講出來，毫不保留。
explanationEn: To reveal everything without reservation; to disclose the whole truth.
derivation: 元·明本述《天目中峰和尚广录》卷十六今日特为你起模画样，和盘托出。”
derivationTraditional: 元·明本述《天目中峰和尚廣錄》卷十六今日特為你起模畫樣，和盤托出。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Mingben's 'Record of Tianmu Zhongfeng Guanglu', Volume 16: 'Today, I specially draw the model for you and present it on the plate.'
example: 现在除非把这事～，再添上些枝叶，或者可以激怒于他，稍助一臂之力。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 現在除非把這事～，再添上些枝葉，或者可以激怒於他，稍助一臂之力。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十七回
exampleEn: Now, unless we reveal everything and add some embellishments, we might be able to provoke him and get some help. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats', Chapter 27

explanation: 形容吃了败仗慌张逃跑。
explanationTraditional: 形容吃了敗仗慌張逃跑。
explanationEn: To flee in panic after a defeat; to take to flight.
derivation: 元·无名氏《马陵道》第三折你自慢慢的从大路上行，我便落慌而走。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《馬陵道》第三折你自慢慢的從大路上行，我便落慌而走。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Maling Dao', Act 3: 'You slowly go along the main road, while I will flee in panic.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 大体很好，但还有不足。
explanationTraditional: 大體很好，但還有不足。
explanationEn: A flaw in an otherwise perfect thing; a blemish; a fly in the ointment.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十七破镜重圆，离而复合，固是好事；但王夫人所遭不幸，失身为妾，又不曾根究奸人，报仇雪恨，尚为美中不足。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十七破鏡重圓，離而複合，固是好事；但王夫人所遭不幸，失身為妾，又不曾根究奸人，報仇雪恨，尚為美中不足。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 27: 'The broken mirror reunited, separation and reunion are good; but Lady Wang's misfortune, being taken as a concubine, and not punishing the villain, is a flaw.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 甘甘心；寂寞孤寂、冷落。形容不甘心被冷落或急于想参与某件事情。
explanationTraditional: 甘甘心；寂寞孤寂、冷落。形容不甘心被冷落或急於想參與某件事情。
explanationEn: Unwilling to remain idle or neglected; eager to join in or be active.
derivation: 清·吕留良《晚村文集·与高旦中书》卷二念头淡薄，自然删落，若不甘寂寞，虽外事清高，正是以退为进。”
derivationTraditional: 清·呂留良《晚村文集·與高旦中書》卷二念頭淡薄，自然刪落，若不甘寂寞，雖外事清高，正是以退為進。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Lü Liuliang's 'Collected Works: Letter to Gao Danzhong', Volume 2: 'If one's thoughts are indifferent, they naturally fade away; if unwilling to be lonely, even if outwardly aloof, it is actually retreating to advance.'
example: 从内务府垮下来的文锡，一向～。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 從內務府垮下來的文錫，一向～。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: Wen Xi, who had fallen from the Imperial Household Department, was always unwilling to remain idle. — Gao Yang's 'Inside the Qing Court', Volume 2

explanation: 在很窄的路上相遇，没有地方可让◇多用来指仇人相见，彼此都不肯轻易放过。
explanationTraditional: 在很窄的路上相遇，沒有地方可讓◇多用來指仇人相見，彼此都不肯輕易放過。
explanationEn: When two enemies meet on a narrow path, neither is willing to give way. It refers to an inevitable confrontation between adversaries.
derivation: 汉·乐府诗《相逢行》相逢狭路间，道隘不容车。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·樂府詩《相逢行》相逢狹路間，道隘不容車。”
derivationEn: From a Han Dynasty yuefu poem 'Meeting on a Narrow Path': 'Meeting on a narrow path, the road is too narrow for carriages to pass.'
example: ～这恶人，如何是好。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第七十二回
exampleTraditional: ～這惡人，如何是好。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第七十二回
exampleEn: Meeting this villain on a narrow path, what should we do? — Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 72

explanation: 喝水的时候想起水是从哪儿来的。比喻不忘本。
explanationTraditional: 喝水的時候想起水是從哪兒來的。比喻不忘本。
explanationEn: When drinking water, think of its source. It means not forgetting one's origins or the source of one's blessings.
derivation: 北周·庾信《徵调曲》落其实者思其树，饮其流者怀其源。”
derivationTraditional: 北周·庾信《徵調曲》落其實者思其樹，飲其流者懷其源。”
derivationEn: From Northern Zhou Dynasty, Yu Xin's 'Zhengdiao Qu': 'When eating the fruit, think of the tree; when drinking the water, think of the source.'
example: 这也是他～的意思。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第七十八回
exampleTraditional: 這也是他～的意思。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第七十八回
exampleEn: This is also his way of not forgetting his origins. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 78

explanation: 绰绰宽裕的样子。形容房屋或钱财非常宽裕，用不完。
explanationTraditional: 綽綽寬裕的樣子。形容房屋或錢財非常寬裕，用不完。
explanationEn: More than enough; ample; sufficient with room to spare.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·角弓》此令兄弟，绰绰有裕。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·角弓》此令兄弟，綽綽有裕。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Jiaogong': 'These brothers are harmonious, with ample generosity.'
example: 这寓所起先原是两人同住的，今去了魏撰之，房舍尽有，就安寓那闻俊卿主仆三人，还～。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十七
exampleTraditional: 這寓所起先原是兩人同住的，今去了魏撰之，房舍盡有，就安寓那聞俊卿主僕三人，還～。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十七
exampleEn: The house was originally shared by two, but after Wei Zhuanzhi left, there was plenty of room, and it could accommodate Wen Junqing and his three servants with more than enough space. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 17

explanation: 既得名声，又获利益。
explanationTraditional: 既得名聲，又獲利益。
explanationEn: To gain both fame and fortune simultaneously.
derivation: 清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第六回其实名利双收，三百六十行生意，再没有强如做官的了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第六回其實名利雙收，三百六十行生意，再沒有強如做官的了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Peng Yang'ou's 'The Opium Addict', Chapter 6: 'In fact, gaining both fame and fortune, no business is better than being an official.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容战斗频仍、激烈。
explanationTraditional: 形容戰鬥頻仍、激烈。
explanationEn: Describes frequent and intense battles; war-torn.
derivation: 浩然《艳阳天》第一二一章经过了这场灾祸的考验，好像当年跟着担架队闯了一趟战火纷飞的疆场回来。”
derivationTraditional: 浩然《豔陽天》第一二一章經過了這場災禍的考驗，好像當年跟著擔架隊闖了一趟戰火紛飛的疆場回來。”
derivationEn: From Hao Ran's 'Bright Sunny Days', Chapter 121: 'After the ordeal of this disaster, it was as if he had followed the stretcher team through a war-torn battlefield.'
example: 这种友谊来自～的年代。★李国文《月食》
exampleTraditional: 這種友誼來自～的年代。★李國文《月食》
exampleEn: This friendship originated from the war-torn years. — Li Guowen, 'Moon Eclipse'

explanation: 大庭宽大的场地；广众为数很多的人群。指聚集很多人的公开场合。
explanationTraditional: 大庭寬大的場地；廣眾為數很多的人群。指聚集很多人的公開場合。
explanationEn: In public; in front of a large audience; a public occasion with many people.
derivation: 《孔丛子·公孙龙》使此人于广庭大众之中，见侮而不敢斗，王将以为臣乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《孔叢子·公孫龍》使此人於廣庭大眾之中，見侮而不敢鬥，王將以為臣乎？”
derivationEn: From 'Kongcongzi, Gongsun Long': 'If this man is insulted in a public place and dares not fight, would you make him a minister?'
example: 这是秘密的事，他敢在～之下喧扬起来？★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第八十六回
exampleTraditional: 這是秘密的事，他敢在～之下喧揚起來？★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第八十六回
exampleEn: This is a secret matter; how dare he make a fuss in public? — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 86

explanation: 思考虑；前前因；后后果。对事情发生的缘由，发展后果，作再三考虑。
explanationTraditional: 思考慮；前前因；後後果。對事情發生的緣由，發展後果，作再三考慮。
explanationEn: To think over the causes and consequences; to ponder back and forth.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第五十二回且闻太师见后无袭兵，领人马徐徐而行；又见折了余庆，辛环带伤，太师十分不乐，一路上思前想后。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第五十二回且聞太師見後無襲兵，領人馬徐徐而行；又見折了餘慶，辛環帶傷，太師十分不樂，一路上思前想後。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 52: 'Grand Tutor Wen, seeing no pursuers, led his troops slowly; having lost Yu Qing and with Xin Dai wounded, he was very unhappy, thinking back and forth along the way.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 竭尽。精神、力气消耗已尽。形容非常疲劳。
explanationTraditional: 竭盡。精神、力氣消耗已盡。形容非常疲勞。
explanationEn: Exhausted; completely worn out; drained of energy and strength.
derivation: 宋·司马光《司马温公文集·卷二·道傍田家》诗筋疲力弊不入腹，未议县官租税促。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·司馬光《司馬溫公文集·卷二·道傍田家》詩筋疲力弊不入腹，未議縣官租稅促。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Sima Guang's poem 'By the Roadside': 'Exhausted and weak, unable to eat, yet still pressed by the county officials for taxes.'
example: 他～地倒在沙发靠背上，一口一口地喘着气。★巴金《秋》十四
exampleTraditional: 他～地倒在沙發靠背上，一口一口地喘著氣。★巴金《秋》十四
exampleEn: He collapsed onto the sofa backrest, exhausted, gasping for breath. — Ba Jin, 'Autumn', Chapter 14

explanation: 皆都。所有的人都知道。
explanationTraditional: 皆都。所有的人都知道。
explanationEn: Known to everyone; universally known.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》人人皆知以多胜少是最好的办法。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》人人皆知以多勝少是最好的辦法。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War': 'Everyone knows that using a larger force to defeat a smaller one is the best method.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 幸高兴。指人缺乏善意，在别人遇到灾祸时感到高兴。
explanationTraditional: 幸高興。指人缺乏善意，在別人遇到災禍時感到高興。
explanationEn: To take pleasure in others' misfortune; to gloat.
derivation: 《左传·僖公十四年》背施无亲，幸灾不仁。”又《庄公二十年》今王子颓歌舞不倦，乐祸也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公十四年》背施無親，幸災不仁。”又《莊公二十年》今王子頹歌舞不倦，樂禍也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan, Duke Xi 14th Year': 'To turn one's back on kindness is to have no affection; to gloat over disaster is inhumane.' Also 'Zhuang Gong 20th Year': 'Now Prince Tui dances and sings tirelessly, taking pleasure in calamity.'
example: 对于同学的缺点和错误，我们不应采取～的态度。
exampleTraditional: 對於同學的缺點和錯誤，我們不應採取～的態度。
exampleEn: We should not adopt an attitude of gloating over classmates' shortcomings and mistakes.

explanation: 衣袖中除清风外，别无所有。比喻做官廉洁。也比喻穷得一无所有。
explanationTraditional: 衣袖中除清風外，別無所有。比喻做官廉潔。也比喻窮得一無所有。
explanationEn: Having nothing but the wind in one's sleeves; describes an official who is incorruptible and honest, or extremely poor.
derivation: 元·陈基《次韵吴江道中》诗两袖清风身欲飘，杖藜随月步长桥。”
derivationTraditional: 元·陳基《次韻吳江道中》詩兩袖清風身欲飄，杖藜隨月步長橋。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Chen Ji's poem 'Ci Yun Wu Jiang Dao Zhong': 'Two sleeves of clear wind, body about to float; leaning on a staff, I walk the long bridge with the moon.'
example: 他自己做了几十年的官，依然是～。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 他自己做了幾十年的官，依然是～。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第十二回
exampleEn: He had been an official for decades, yet remained as pure as the wind in his sleeves. - Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 12

explanation: 回答的不是所问的内容。
explanationTraditional: 回答的不是所問的內容。
explanationEn: Answering a question with something irrelevant; not addressing the question asked.
derivation: 叶圣陶《隔膜》按照着次序一问一答，没有答非所问的弊病，就算情意格外浓厚。”
derivationTraditional: 葉聖陶《隔膜》按照著次序一問一答，沒有答非所問的弊病，就算情意格外濃厚。”
derivationEn: From Ye Shengtao's 'The Partition': 'Following the order, asking and answering one by one, without the flaw of answering irrelevantly, even if the feelings are especially deep.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指说话、写文章简单明了，能抓住要点。
explanationTraditional: 指說話、寫文章簡單明瞭，能抓住要點。
explanationEn: Concise and to the point; describing speech or writing that is simple, clear, and captures the essentials.
derivation: 毛泽东《党委会的工作方法》讲话、演说、写文章和写决议案，都应当简明扼要。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《黨委會的工作方法》講話、演說、寫文章和寫決議案，都應當簡明扼要。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Methods of Work of Party Committees': 'Speeches, talks, articles, and resolutions should all be concise and to the point.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 连一样事情也没有做成。指什么事情都做不成。形容毫无成就。
explanationTraditional: 連一樣事情也沒有做成。指什麼事情都做不成。形容毫無成就。
explanationEn: Having accomplished nothing; achieving nothing at all.
derivation: 唐·白居易《除夜寄微之》诗鬓毛不觉白毵毵，一事无成百不堪。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《除夜寄微之》詩鬢毛不覺白毿毿，一事無成百不堪。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Bai Juyi's poem 'To Weizhi on New Year's Eve': 'Temple hair turns white without notice, a hundred hardships, nothing accomplished.'
example: 员乃投镜于地，痛哭曰～，双鬓已斑，天乎，天乎！”（明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十二回）
exampleTraditional: 員乃投鏡於地，痛哭曰～，雙鬢已斑，天乎，天乎！”（明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十二回）
exampleEn: The man threw the mirror to the ground, crying, 'I have accomplished nothing, my temples are already gray. Heaven! Heaven!' - Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 72

explanation: 形对照；绌不够，不足⊥同类的事物相比较，显出不足。
explanationTraditional: 形對照；絀不夠，不足⊥同類的事物相比較，顯出不足。
explanationEn: When compared with similar things, one appears inferior or inadequate.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第九十回他一个部曹，戴了个水晶顶子去当会办，比着那红蓝色的顶子，未免相形见绌。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第九十回他一個部曹，戴了個水晶頂子去當會辦，比著那紅藍色的頂子，未免相形見絀。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 90: 'He, a department director, wearing a crystal button, went as a co-director; compared with the red and blue buttons, he inevitably appeared inferior.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 涛大波浪；骇使惊怕。汹涌吓人的浪涛。比喻险恶的环境或尖锐激烈的斗争。
explanationTraditional: 濤大波浪；駭使驚怕。洶湧嚇人的浪濤。比喻險惡的環境或尖銳激烈的鬥爭。
explanationEn: Frightening waves and billows; metaphor for a dangerous environment or fierce struggle.
derivation: 唐·田颖《玉山堂文集·海云楼记》人当既静之时，每思及前经所履之惊涛骇浪，未尝不惕然。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·田穎《玉山堂文集·海雲樓記》人當既靜之時，每思及前經所履之驚濤駭浪，未嘗不惕然。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Tian Ying's 'Yushantang Collection: Record of the Sea Cloud Tower': 'When a person is calm, they often think of the terrifying waves they have experienced before, and cannot help but be cautious.'
example: 又觉得身体动荡，仿佛在～的小船里。★叶圣陶《地动》
exampleTraditional: 又覺得身體動盪，彷彿在～的小船裡。★葉聖陶《地動》
exampleEn: He felt his body swaying, as if in a small boat amidst terrifying waves. - Ye Shengtao's 'Earthquake'

explanation: 不仁没有感觉。肢体麻痹，失去知觉。比喻对外界事物反应迟钝或漠不关心。
explanationTraditional: 不仁沒有感覺。肢體麻痺，失去知覺。比喻對外界事物反應遲鈍或漠不關心。
explanationEn: Numb and insensitive; describes being slow to react or indifferent to external things.
derivation: 明·薛己《医案·总论》一日皮死麻木不仁，二日肉死针刺不痛。”
derivationTraditional: 明·薛己《醫案·總論》一日皮死麻木不仁，二日肉死針刺不痛。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xue Ji's 'Medical Cases: General Discussion': 'First, skin death is numb and insensitive; second, flesh death is needle-prick without pain.'
example: 没有同情，没有热，是～？还是忘恩负义。★闻一多《伟大的事实，不朽的意义》
exampleTraditional: 沒有同情，沒有熱，是～？還是忘恩負義。★聞一多《偉大的事實，不朽的意義》
exampleEn: Without sympathy, without warmth, is it numbness or ingratitude? - Wen Yiduo's 'Great Fact, Immortal Meaning'

explanation: 觥古代的一种酒器；筹行酒令的筹码。酒杯和酒筹杂乱地放着。形容许多人聚会喝酒时的热闹场景。
explanationTraditional: 觥古代的一種酒器；籌行酒令的籌碼。酒杯和酒籌雜亂地放著。形容許多人聚會喝酒時的熱鬧場景。
explanationEn: Wine cups and game chips intermingle; describes a lively scene of many people drinking together.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《醉翁亭记》射者中，奕者胜，觥筹交错，坐起而喧哗者，众宾欢也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《醉翁亭記》射者中，奕者勝，觥籌交錯，坐起而喧譁者，眾賓歡也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'The Story of the Drunkard's Pavilion': 'The archers hit the target, the chess players win, wine cups and game chips intermingle, people stand up and shout, that is the joy of the guests.'
example: 余大先生抬头看尊经阁上绣衣朱履，～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十七回
exampleTraditional: 餘大先生抬頭看尊經閣上繡衣朱履，～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十七回
exampleEn: Mr. Yu looked up at the Zunjing Pavilion, where embroidered clothes and red shoes mingled, and wine cups and game chips intermingled. - Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 47

explanation: 不把个人的生死放在心上。
explanationTraditional: 不把個人的生死放在心上。
explanationEn: Disregarding one's own life and death; risking one's life without hesitation.
derivation: 元·无名氏《锁魔镜》第二折你须索舍死忘生，建立功勋。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《鎖魔鏡》第二折你須索捨死忘生，建立功勳。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'Suo Mo Jing', Act 2: 'You must risk your life and forget death to establish merit.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻违反事物发展的客观规律，急于求成，反而坏事。
explanationTraditional: 比喻違反事物發展的客觀規律，急於求成，反而壞事。
explanationEn: Pulling up seedlings to help them grow; metaphor for violating natural laws and being overeager, which leads to failure.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》宋人有闵其苗之不长而揠之者，茫茫然归，谓其人曰‘今日病矣，予助苗长矣。’其子趋而往视之，苗则槁矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》宋人有閔其苗之不長而揠之者，茫茫然歸，謂其人曰‘今日病矣，予助苗長矣。’其子趨而往視之，苗則槁矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gongsun Chou I': 'A man of Song, worried that his seedlings were not growing, pulled them up. He returned home tired and said, 'Today I am exhausted; I helped the seedlings grow.' His son ran to look, and the seedlings were withered.'
example: 那种不顾学生能否接受的填鸭式的教学方法，无异于～。
exampleTraditional: 那種不顧學生能否接受的填鴨式的教學方法，無異於～。
exampleEn: The cramming teaching method that disregards students' ability to absorb is like pulling up seedlings to help them grow.

explanation: 寿终年纪很大才死；正寝旧式住宅的正房。原指老死在家里。现比喻事物的灭亡。
explanationTraditional: 壽終年紀很大才死；正寢舊式住宅的正房。原指老死在家裡。現比喻事物的滅亡。
explanationEn: To die of old age at home; now used metaphorically to mean the end of something.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第十一回你道朕不能善终，你自夸寿终正寝，非侮君而何！”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第十一回你道朕不能善終，你自誇壽終正寢，非侮君而何！”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty novel 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 11: 'You claim I cannot die a natural death, yet you boast of dying in your own bed—is this not insulting the emperor?'
example: 这样看来，邮递这条路是要断绝了，刊物也就不免～了！★邹韬奋《患难余生记·流亡》
exampleTraditional: 這樣看來，郵遞這條路是要斷絕了，刊物也就不免～了！★鄒韜奮《患難餘生記·流亡》
exampleEn: Thus it seems the postal route will be cut off, and the publication will inevitably die a natural death. — Zou Taofen, 'Surviving Hardships: Exile'

explanation: 恶邪恶；务必须。清除坏人坏事必须干净彻底。
explanationTraditional: 惡邪惡；務必須。清除壞人壞事必須乾淨徹底。
explanationEn: To eradicate evil completely; to eliminate bad people or things thoroughly.
derivation: 《左传·哀公元年》树德莫如滋，云疾莫如尽。”《尚书·泰誓下》树德务滋，除恶务本。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·哀公元年》樹德莫如滋，雲疾莫如盡。”《尚書·泰誓下》樹德務滋，除惡務本。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan' (Duke Ai, Year 1): 'Planting virtue is like nurturing growth; removing evil must be thorough.' Also 'Book of Documents: Great Declaration': 'Plant virtue by nurturing; eradicate evil by its roots.'
example: 消息何殊马牛风，～不相容。★李木庵《一九四九年元旦献词》诗
exampleTraditional: 消息何殊馬牛風，～不相容。★李木庵《一九四九年元旦獻詞》詩
exampleEn: News is as different as horse and ox; evil must be eradicated completely, leaving no room. — Li Mu'an, 'New Year's Day Ode' (1949)

explanation: 驰奔跑；掣闪过。形容非常迅速，象风吹电闪一样。
explanationTraditional: 馳奔跑；掣閃過。形容非常迅速，象風吹電閃一樣。
explanationEn: Swift as wind and quick as lightning; extremely fast.
derivation: 《六韬·龙韬·王翼》奋威四人，主择材力，论兵革，风驰电掣，不知所由。”
derivationTraditional: 《六韜·龍韜·王翼》奮威四人，主擇材力，論兵革，風馳電掣，不知所由。”
derivationEn: From 'Six Secret Teachings: Dragon Secret: Wings of the King': 'Four men of valor, skilled in selecting talents and discussing military affairs, move like wind and lightning, unknown in origin.'
example: 黄飞虎枪法如～，往来如飞。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 黃飛虎槍法如～，往來如飛。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第六十回
exampleEn: Huang Feihu's spear technique was as swift as wind and lightning, coming and going like flying. — Ming Dynasty novel 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 60

explanation: 讳言有顾虑，不愿把真实情况说出来。丝毫也没有隐讳不说的。
explanationTraditional: 諱言有顧慮，不願把真實情況說出來。絲毫也沒有隱諱不說的。
explanationEn: To speak without any reservation; to not conceal anything.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 妄胡乱的；菲薄小看，轻视。过分看轻自己。形容自卑。
explanationTraditional: 妄胡亂的；菲薄小看，輕視。過分看輕自己。形容自卑。
explanationEn: To belittle oneself unduly; to be overly humble or self-deprecating.
derivation: 三国蜀·诸葛亮《前出师表》不宜妄自菲薄，引喻失义，以塞忠谏之路也。”
derivationTraditional: 三國蜀·諸葛亮《前出師表》不宜妄自菲薄，引喻失義，以塞忠諫之路也。”
derivationEn: From Zhuge Liang's 'First Memorial to the Throne' (Three Kingdoms period): 'One should not belittle oneself, use inappropriate analogies, or block the path of loyal remonstrance.'
example: 单靠这几个人办不出什么大事。但对于自己，荪甫从来不肯～”。★茅盾《子夜》三
exampleTraditional: 單靠這幾個人辦不出什麼大事。但對於自己，蓀甫從來不肯～”。★茅盾《子夜》三
exampleEn: Alone, these few cannot accomplish much. But for himself, Sunfu never belittled himself. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight' Chapter 3

explanation: 自然地发生，生长，又自然地消灭。形容自然发展，无人过问。
explanationTraditional: 自然地發生，生長，又自然地消滅。形容自然發展，無人過問。
explanationEn: To emerge and perish naturally; to develop or die out without external intervention.
derivation: 唐·白居易《岭上云》诗自生自灭成何事，能逐东风作雨无。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《嶺上雲》詩自生自滅成何事，能逐東風作雨無。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi's poem 'Clouds on Ling Mountain': 'Born and extinguished by themselves, what can they achieve? Can they follow the east wind to bring rain?'
example: 新生事物，如不关心和培育，就只能是～。
exampleTraditional: 新生事物，如不關心和培育，就只能是～。
exampleEn: New things, if not cared for and nurtured, can only be left to emerge and perish on their own.

explanation: 形容谈论广泛、生动而又风趣。
explanationTraditional: 形容談論廣泛、生動而又風趣。
explanationEn: To talk widely, vividly, and humorously; to engage in lively and witty discussion.
derivation: 宋王暐《道山清话》韩持国为人凝严方重，每兄弟聚话，玉汝、子华议论风生，持国未尝有一言。”
derivationTraditional: 宋王暐《道山清話》韓持國為人凝嚴方重，每兄弟聚話，玉汝、子華議論風生，持國未嘗有一言。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wang Wei's 'Dao Shan Qing Hua': 'Han Chiguo was solemn and dignified; whenever brothers gathered, Yuru and Zihua talked with wit and vigor, while Chiguo never said a word.'
example: 伊和女伴商量装饰，～，足以使大家心折。★叶圣陶《一个朋友》
exampleTraditional: 伊和女伴商量裝飾，～，足以使大家心折。★葉聖陶《一個朋友》
exampleEn: She discussed decorations with her female companions, talking with such wit and vigor that everyone was impressed. — Ye Shengtao, 'A Friend'

explanation: 比喻言语行动有条理、有步调。
explanationTraditional: 比喻言語行動有條理、有步調。
explanationEn: Methodical and orderly in speech or action; well-organized and rhythmic.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他说起话来有板有眼，办起事来头头是道。
exampleTraditional: 他說起話來有板有眼，辦起事來頭頭是道。
exampleEn: He speaks methodically and handles affairs systematically.

explanation: 只有一个人或一方面的力量，得不到外力援助。
explanationTraditional: 只有一個人或一方面的力量，得不到外力援助。
explanationEn: To be isolated and without support; to stand alone with no outside help.
derivation: 《后汉书·班超传》十八年，帝崩，焉耆以中国大丧，遂攻没都护陈睦，超孤立无援。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·班超傳》十八年，帝崩，焉耆以中國大喪，遂攻沒都護陳睦，超孤立無援。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Ban Chao': 'In the 18th year, the emperor died; Yanqi took advantage of the national mourning to attack and kill Protector Chen Mu. Ban Chao was isolated and without support.'
example: 庄公既碍姜氏之面，又度公孙滑～，不能有为。（明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五回）
exampleTraditional: 莊公既礙姜氏之面，又度公孫滑～，不能有為。（明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五回）
exampleEn: Duke Zhuang was hindered by his mother's face and judged that Gongsun Hua, isolated and without support, could not act. — Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 5

explanation: 喋喋形容说话多；体停止。唠唠叨叨，说个没完没了。
explanationTraditional: 喋喋形容說話多；體停止。嘮嘮叨叨，說個沒完沒了。
explanationEn: To talk endlessly; to chatter or nag without stopping.
derivation: 《汉书·张释之传》夫绛侯、东阳侯称为长者，此两人言事曾不能出口，岂效此啬夫喋喋利口捷给哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·張釋之傳》夫絳侯、東陽侯稱為長者，此兩人言事曾不能出口，豈效此嗇夫喋喋利口捷給哉！”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Zhang Shizhi': 'Marquis Jiang and Marquis Dongyang were called elders; these two could hardly speak in court. How could they imitate this petty official's glib tongue?'
example: 廖二嫂还满腹闷气，～。★沙汀《呼嚎》
exampleTraditional: 廖二嫂還滿腹悶氣，～。★沙汀《呼嚎》
exampleEn: Liao Er's wife was still full of pent-up anger, chattering endlessly. — Sha Ting, 'Howl'

explanation: 沆瀣指唐时的崔沆、崔瀣。比喻臭味相投的人结合在一起。
explanationTraditional: 沆瀣指唐時的崔沆、崔瀣。比喻臭味相投的人結合在一起。
explanationEn: People of similar ilk collude or band together, often with a negative connotation.
derivation: 宋·钱易《南部新书·戊集》又乾符二年，崔沆放崔瀣，谭者称座主门生，沆瀣一气。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·錢易《南部新書·戊集》又乾符二年，崔沆放崔瀣，譚者稱座主門生，沆瀣一氣。”
