explanationEn: To whisper in secret; to talk in low voices behind others' backs.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《顺宗实录·永贞五年》虽叛两使事，未尝以簿书为意，日引其党屏人切切细语，谋夺官者兵，以制四海之命。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《順宗實錄·永貞五年》雖叛兩使事，未嘗以簿書為意，日引其黨屏人切切細語，謀奪官者兵，以制四海之命。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Veritable Records of Emperor Shunzong, Fifth Year of Yongzhen': 'Although they were in charge of two military affairs, they never paid attention to official documents, but daily led their followers to whisper in private, plotting to seize the eunuchs' troops to control the realm.'
example: 又故意与行酒侍儿，～，羋氏两次问话，俱失应答。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: 又故意與行酒侍兒，～，羋氏兩次問話，俱失應答。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第四十六回
exampleEn: He deliberately whispered with the serving maid, and when Mi Shi asked him twice, he failed to answer. (From Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 46)

explanation: 不扬不好看。形容人容貌难看。
explanationTraditional: 不揚不好看。形容人容貌難看。
explanationEn: Ugly in appearance; having an unattractive face.
derivation: 《左传·昭公二十八年》今子少不扬，子若无言，吾几失子矣。”杜预注颜貌不显扬。”唐·裴度《自题写真赞》尔才不长，尔貌不扬。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公二十八年》今子少不揚，子若無言，吾幾失子矣。”杜預注顏貌不顯揚。”唐·裴度《自題寫真贊》爾才不長，爾貌不揚。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan, 28th Year of Duke Zhao': 'Now you are not handsome; if you had not spoken, I would have almost lost you.' Du Yu's annotation: 'Facial features are not prominent.' Also from Pei Du's 'Self-Portrait Inscription': 'Your talent is not great, your appearance is not handsome.'
example: 别看他～，可学习特别好。
exampleTraditional: 別看他～，可學習特別好。
exampleEn: Although he is not good-looking, he is excellent in his studies.

explanation: 象口渴思饮那样访求贤士。形容罗致人才的迫切。
explanationTraditional: 象口渴思飲那樣訪求賢士。形容羅致人才的迫切。
explanationEn: To seek talent eagerly, as if thirsty for water; to be desperate for capable people.
derivation: 《后汉书·周举传》昔在前世，求贤如渴。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·周舉傳》昔在前世，求賢如渴。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han, Biography of Zhou Ju': 'In former times, they sought talent as if thirsty.'
example: ～，从柬如流。★《宋史·窦贞固传》
exampleTraditional: ～，從柬如流。★《宋史·竇貞固傳》
exampleEn: He sought talent eagerly and followed good advice like water flowing. (From 'History of Song, Biography of Dou Zhengu')

explanation: 形容许多人一起涌上来。
explanationTraditional: 形容許多人一起湧上來。
explanationEn: To swarm forward; to rush up in a crowd.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九回墨雨遂掇起一根门闩，扫红、锄药手中都是马鞭子，蜂拥而上。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九回墨雨遂掇起一根門閂，掃紅、鋤藥手中都是馬鞭子，蜂擁而上。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 9: 'Mo Yu then picked up a door bolt, while Sao Hong and Chu Yao held horsewhips, and they swarmed forward.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指古代作战时摇着旗子，大声喊杀助威。现比喻给别人助长声势。
explanationTraditional: 原指古代作戰時搖著旗子，大聲喊殺助威。現比喻給別人助長聲勢。
explanationEn: Originally meant to wave flags and shout battle cries to boost morale; now figuratively means to cheer someone on or lend support.
derivation: 元·乔孟符《两世姻缘》第三折你这般摇旗呐喊，簸土扬沙。”
derivationTraditional: 元·喬孟符《兩世姻緣》第三折你這般搖旗吶喊，簸土揚沙。”
derivationEn: From Qiao Mengfu's 'Two Lives of Marriage', Act 3: 'You wave flags and shout, raising dust and sand.'
example: 球场上球迷们～，为各自的球队助威。
exampleTraditional: 球場上球迷們～，為各自的球隊助威。
exampleEn: In the stadium, fans waved flags and shouted to cheer for their respective teams.

explanation: 长长处、优点。各有各的长处、优点。一般多指人才而言。
explanationTraditional: 長長處、優點。各有各的長處、優點。一般多指人才而言。
explanationEn: Each has his own strengths; everyone has their own merits.
derivation: 《管子·形势解》明主之官物也，任其所长，不任其所短，故事无不成，而功无不立。乱主不知物之各有所长所短也。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·形勢解》明主之官物也，任其所長，不任其所短，故事無不成，而功無不立。亂主不知物之各有所長所短也。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi, Explanation of Circumstances': 'An enlightened ruler appoints officials according to their strengths, not their weaknesses, so no task fails and no merit is unestablished. A chaotic ruler does not know that each thing has its strengths and weaknesses.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为人处世的道理。
explanationTraditional: 為人處世的道理。
explanationEn: The ways of the world; worldly wisdom; knowledge of human affairs.
derivation: 宋·文天祥《送僧了敬序》姑与之委曲于人情世故之内。”明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第二十一卷可惜你满腹文章，看不出人情世故。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·文天祥《送僧了敬序》姑與之委曲於人情世故之內。”明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第二十一卷可惜你滿腹文章，看不出人情世故。”
derivationEn: From Wen Tianxiang's 'Preface to Seeing Off Monk Jing': 'I reluctantly deal with worldly affairs within human relationships.' Also from Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 21: 'It's a pity you are full of literary talent but cannot see through worldly affairs.'
example: 我说你到底没有经练，所以这些～一点也不懂。★清·吴研人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 我說你到底沒有經練，所以這些～一點也不懂。★清·吳研人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第十四回
exampleEn: I said you have no experience, so you don't understand these worldly affairs at all. (From Wu Jianren's 'Bizarre Happenings Witnessed in Twenty Years', Chapter 14)

explanation: 遂通随”，顺从。原为医学病症名，指半边身体不能随意转动。有时比喻诗文部分好，部分不好，不够匀称。
explanationTraditional: 遂通隨”，順從。原為醫學病症名，指半邊身體不能隨意轉動。有時比喻詩文部分好，部分不好，不夠勻稱。
explanationEn: Hemiplegia; paralysis of one side of the body. Sometimes used metaphorically to describe uneven quality in writing.
derivation: 汉·张仲景《金匮要略·中风历节》无风之为病，当半身不遂，或但臂不遂者，此为痹脉微而数中风使然。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·張仲景《金匱要略·中風歷節》無風之為病，當半身不遂，或但臂不遂者，此為痺脈微而數中風使然。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Zhongjing's 'Synopsis of Prescriptions of the Golden Chamber, Wind Stroke': 'When wind causes disease, it often results in hemiplegia, or if only one arm is affected, it is due to a weak pulse and wind.'
example: 蒋百里在宜山的南边路上，汽车坏了，他受了一下子凉，就有一点～的样子。★冯玉祥《我所认识的蒋介石》第三十一章
exampleTraditional: 蔣百里在宜山的南邊路上，汽車壞了，他受了一下子涼，就有一點～的樣子。★馮玉祥《我所認識的蔣介石》第三十一章
exampleEn: Jiang Baili's car broke down on the road south of Yishan, he caught a chill, and then showed signs of hemiplegia. (From Feng Yuxiang's 'Chiang Kai-shek I Know', Chapter 31)

explanation: 宣公开说出。保守秘密，不肯宣布。
explanationTraditional: 宣公開說出。保守秘密，不肯宣佈。
explanationEn: Keep a secret and not disclose it.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·董昭传》秘而不露，使权得志，非计之上。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·董昭傳》秘而不露，使權得志，非計之上。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Dong Zhao': 'Keep it secret and not reveal it, allowing Sun Quan to have his way, is not a good strategy.'
example: 泛音既有如此妙论，如何谱上都无此说？他却～，是个甚么意思。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十三回
exampleTraditional: 泛音既有如此妙論，如何譜上都無此說？他卻～，是個甚麼意思。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十三回
exampleEn: Since the overtone has such wonderful theory, why is it not mentioned in any score? He kept it secret, what does he mean? — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 73

explanation: 借着某件事情为题目来做文章，以表达自己真正的意见或主张。也指假借某事为由，去做其它的事。
explanationTraditional: 藉著某件事情為題目來做文章，以表達自己真正的意見或主張。也指假借某事為由，去做其它的事。
explanationEn: Use a topic as a pretext to express one's true opinions or to do something else.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《痛史》第七回我触动起来，顺口骂他两句。就是你们文人说的，甚么‘借题发挥’的意思呢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《痛史》第七回我觸動起來，順口罵他兩句。就是你們文人說的，甚麼‘借題發揮’的意思呢。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'The Painful History', Chapter 7: 'I was touched and scolded him casually. That's what you literati call 'using a topic to express one's views'.'
example: 尽管是～，而且是借错了题，我对王芸生的手法，依然是佩服的。★郭沫若《摩登唐吉诃德的一种手法》
exampleTraditional: 儘管是～，而且是借錯了題，我對王芸生的手法，依然是佩服的。★郭沫若《摩登唐吉訶德的一種手法》
exampleEn: Although it was using a topic to express views, and the topic was wrong, I still admire Wang Yunsheng's technique. — Guo Moruo, 'A Technique of Modern Don Quixote'

explanation: 早晨发布的命令，晚上就改了。比喻经常改变主张和办法，一会儿一个样。
explanationTraditional: 早晨發佈的命令，晚上就改了。比喻經常改變主張和辦法，一會兒一個樣。
explanationEn: Change one's mind frequently; make inconsistent policies.
derivation: 汉·鼌错《论贵粟疏》赋敛不时，朝令而暮改。”《汉书·食货志上》急政暴虐，赋敛不时，朝令而暮改。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·鼂錯《論貴粟疏》賦斂不時，朝令而暮改。”《漢書·食貨志上》急政暴虐，賦斂不時，朝令而暮改。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Chao Cuo, 'On the Importance of Grain': 'Taxes are levied at irregular times, orders are changed in the morning and altered in the evening.'
example: 政策要力求相对地稳定，不能～。
exampleTraditional: 政策要力求相對地穩定，不能～。
exampleEn: Policies should strive for relative stability and cannot be changed frequently.

explanation: 更改换；张给乐器上弦。改换、调整乐器上的弦，使声音和谐。比喻改革制度或变更计划、方法。
explanationTraditional: 更改換；張給樂器上弦。改換、調整樂器上的弦，使聲音和諧。比喻改革制度或變更計劃、方法。
explanationEn: Change one's approach or reform a system; make a fresh start.
derivation: 《汉书·董仲舒传》窃譬之琴瑟不调，甚者必解而更张之，乃可鼓也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·董仲舒傳》竊譬之琴瑟不調，甚者必解而更張之，乃可鼓也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Dong Zhongshu': 'If a zither is out of tune, one must remove the strings and replace them to play properly.'
example: 不～，使吏有士君子之行，而欲民生蒙福，教化淳美，犹欲其入而闭之门也。★清·阮葵生《茶余客话》卷七
exampleTraditional: 不～，使吏有士君子之行，而欲民生蒙福，教化淳美，猶欲其入而閉之門也。★清·阮葵生《茶餘客話》卷七
exampleEn: If we do not reform and make officials behave like gentlemen, yet hope the people enjoy blessings and education is pure, it is like wanting to enter but closing the door. — Qing Dynasty, Ruan Kuisheng, 'Tea Leftover Talks', Volume 7

explanation: 天天命，命运；尤怨恨，归咎。指遇到挫折或出了问题，一味报怨天，责怪别人。
explanationTraditional: 天天命，命運；尤怨恨，歸咎。指遇到挫折或出了問題，一味報怨天，責怪別人。
explanationEn: Blame heaven and others for one's misfortunes; complain about everything.
derivation: 《论语·宪问》不怨天，不尤人，下学而上达，知我者其天乎！”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·憲問》不怨天，不尤人，下學而上達，知我者其天乎！”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Xian Wen': 'I do not blame heaven, nor do I blame others. I learn from below and reach above. Only heaven knows me!'
example: 便是那愤懑不平之气，放诞无忌惮之言，心中口中，～个不了。★明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第六回
exampleTraditional: 便是那憤懣不平之氣，放誕無忌憚之言，心中口中，～個不了。★明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第六回
exampleEn: That angry and discontented spirit, those reckless and unrestrained words, in his heart and mouth, he never stops blaming heaven and others. — Ming Dynasty, Donglu Gukuang Sheng, 'Awakening from Drunkenness', Chapter 6

explanation: 循、蹈遵循，依照。规、矩是定方圆的标准工具，借指行为的准则。原指遵守规矩，不敢违反。现也指拘守旧准则，不敢稍做变动。
explanationTraditional: 循、蹈遵循，依照。規、矩是定方圓的標準工具，借指行為的準則。原指遵守規矩，不敢違反。現也指拘守舊準則，不敢稍做變動。
explanationEn: Follow rules and conventions strictly; behave properly and conservatively.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《答方宾王书》循涂守辙，犹言循规蹈矩云尔。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《答方賓王書》循塗守轍，猶言循規蹈矩云爾。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, 'Reply to Wang Binfang': 'Following the path and keeping to the track is like following rules and measuring with a square.'
example: 这唐僧～，同悟空、悟能、悟净，牵马挑担，径入山门。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第九十八回
exampleTraditional: 這唐僧～，同悟空、悟能、悟淨，牽馬挑擔，徑入山門。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第九十八回
exampleEn: This Tang Monk, following rules, together with Wukong, Wuneng, and Wujing, leading the horse and carrying the luggage, entered the mountain gate. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 98

explanation: 迎头一棍子。比喻受到严重警告或突然的打击。
explanationTraditional: 迎頭一棍子。比喻受到嚴重警告或突然的打擊。
explanationEn: A severe warning or sudden blow; a shock.
derivation: 《五灯会元·黄檗运禅师法嗣·临济义玄禅师》上堂，僧问‘如何是佛法大意？’师亦竖拂子，僧便喝，师亦喝。僧拟议，师便打。”
derivationTraditional: 《五燈會元·黃檗運禪師法嗣·臨濟義玄禪師》上堂，僧問‘如何是佛法大意？’師亦豎拂子，僧便喝，師亦喝。僧擬議，師便打。”
derivationEn: From 'Five Lamps Meeting at the Source: Linji Yixuan': 'A monk asked, 'What is the great meaning of Buddhism?' The master also raised his whisk, the monk shouted, the master also shouted. When the monk hesitated, the master hit him.'
example: 孔子好象受了～，亡魂失魄地坐着，恰如一段呆木头。★鲁迅《故事新编·出头》
exampleTraditional: 孔子好象受了～，亡魂失魄地坐著，恰如一段呆木頭。★魯迅《故事新編·出頭》
exampleEn: Confucius seemed to receive a sudden blow, sitting dazed like a piece of dead wood. — Lu Xun, 'Old Tales Retold: Out of the Ordinary'

explanation: 形容全屋子的人同时大笑。
explanationTraditional: 形容全屋子的人同時大笑。
explanationEn: The whole room bursts into laughter.
derivation: 唐·赵璾《因话录》卷五唐御史有台院、殿院、罕院，以一御史知杂事，谓之杂端。公堂会食，皆绝笑言。惟杂端笑而三院皆笑，谓之哄笑，则不罚。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·趙璾《因話錄》卷五唐御史有臺院、殿院、罕院，以一御史知雜事，謂之雜端。公堂會食，皆絕笑言。惟雜端笑而三院皆笑，謂之鬨笑，則不罰。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Zhao Lin, 'Yin Hua Lu', Volume 5: 'In the Tang court, there were Taiyuan, Dianyuan, and Hanyuan. One censor knew miscellaneous affairs, called Zaduang. During meals in the hall, all were silent. Only when Zaduang laughed did the three courts laugh, called 'hongxiao', and no punishment was given.'
example: 因把在筱亭客厅上的事情，说了一遍。大家～。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 因把在筱亭客廳上的事情，說了一遍。大家～。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第十四回
exampleEn: Then he recounted what happened in Xiaoting's living room. Everyone burst into laughter. — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower of the Sea of Sins', Chapter 14

explanation: 每家每户。指所有的人家。
explanationTraditional: 每家每戶。指所有的人家。
explanationEn: Every household; all families.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言·蒋兴哥重会珍珠衫》光阴似箭，不觉残年将尽，家家户户，闹轰轰的煖火盆，放爆竹，吃合家欢耍子。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言·蔣興哥重會珍珠衫》光陰似箭，不覺殘年將盡，家家戶戶，鬧轟轟的煖火盆，放爆竹，吃合家歡耍子。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Enlighten the World: Jiang Xingge Reunites with His Pearl Shirt': 'Time flies, and before we knew it, the year was ending. Every household was bustling with fire pots, setting off firecrackers, and eating family reunion dinners.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 宗宗教，家族。代后代。传延宗教，接续后代。旧指生了独生子可以使家世一代一代传下去。
explanationTraditional: 宗宗教，家族。代後代。傳延宗教，接續後代。舊指生了獨生子可以使家世一代一代傳下去。
explanationEn: Carry on the family line; have a son to continue the family lineage.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十九回自己辛苦了一辈子，挣了这分大家私，死下来又没有个传宗接代的人，不知当初要留着这些钱何用。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十九回自己辛苦了一輩子，掙了這分大傢俬，死下來又沒有個傳宗接代的人，不知當初要留著這些錢何用。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats', Chapter 49: 'He worked hard all his life to earn this large family fortune, but in the end, he had no one to carry on the family line. What was the use of keeping all that money?'
example: 我想劝他讨个小”，将来生个儿子也可以～。★巴金《秋》第三十七章
exampleTraditional: 我想勸他討個小”，將來生個兒子也可以～。★巴金《秋》第三十七章
exampleEn: I want to persuade him to take a concubine, so that in the future he can have a son to carry on the family line. — Ba Jin, 'Autumn', Chapter 37

explanation: 完善美好，没有缺点。
explanationTraditional: 完善美好，沒有缺點。
explanationEn: Perfect and flawless, without any defects.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 世界上根本不存在完美无缺的东西。
exampleTraditional: 世界上根本不存在完美無缺的東西。
exampleEn: There is no such thing as something perfect and flawless in the world.

explanation: 金榜科举时代称殿试揭晓的榜；题名写上名字。指科举得中。
explanationTraditional: 金榜科舉時代稱殿試揭曉的榜；題名寫上名字。指科舉得中。
explanationEn: To succeed in the imperial examination; to pass the highest level of the civil service exam.
derivation: 五代·五王保《唐摭言》卷三何扶，太和九年及第；明年，捷三篇，因以一绝寄旧同年曰‘金榜题名墨上新，今年依旧去年春。花间每被红妆问，何事重来只一人。’”
derivationTraditional: 五代·五王保《唐摭言》卷三何扶，太和九年及第；明年，捷三篇，因以一絕寄舊同年曰‘金榜題名墨上新，今年依舊去年春。花間每被紅妝問，何事重來只一人。’”
derivationEn: From 'Tangzhiyan' by Wang Bao of the Five Dynasties: He Fu passed the imperial exam in the ninth year of Taihe; the next year, he wrote a poem to his former classmates: 'The golden list shows new names, this year's spring is like last year's. Among the flowers, I am often asked by beauties, why have you come alone again?'
example: 旬月之间，～，已登三甲进士。（明·洪榝《清平山堂话本·陈巡检梅岭失妻记》）
exampleTraditional: 旬月之間，～，已登三甲進士。（明·洪樧《清平山堂話本·陳巡檢梅嶺失妻記》）
exampleEn: Within a month, he succeeded in the imperial examination and became a Jinshi. (From 'Qingpingshan Tang Huaben')

explanation: 黯然心里不舒服、情绪低落的样子；失色因惊恐而变以脸色。本指心怀不好，脸色难看◇多比喻相形之下很有差距，远远不如。
explanationTraditional: 黯然心裡不舒服、情緒低落的樣子；失色因驚恐而變以臉色。本指心懷不好，臉色難看◇多比喻相形之下很有差距，遠遠不如。
explanationEn: To be overshadowed; to pale in comparison; to lose luster.
derivation: 南朝·梁·江淹《别赋》黯然销魂者，惟别而已矣。”李善注黯然，失色貌”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·江淹《別賦》黯然銷魂者，惟別而已矣。”李善注黯然，失色貌”
derivationEn: From 'Farewell Fu' by Jiang Yan of the Southern Liang: 'The most heartbreaking thing is farewell.' Li Shan's commentary: 'Anran' means the appearance of losing color.
example: 所有同类题材的绘画和它比较起来，都～。★秦牧《艺海拾贝·〈最后的晚餐〉》
exampleTraditional: 所有同類題材的繪畫和它比較起來，都～。★秦牧《藝海拾貝·〈最後的晚餐〉》
exampleEn: All paintings of the same subject pale in comparison to it. (Qin Mu, 'Gleaning of Art')

explanation: 救拯救；亡危亡；图谋求；存生存。拯救国家的危亡，谋求国家的生存。
explanationTraditional: 救拯救；亡危亡；圖謀求；存生存。拯救國家的危亡，謀求國家的生存。
explanationEn: To save the nation from peril and ensure its survival.
derivation: 清·王无生《论小说与改良社会之关系》夫救亡图存，非仅恃一二才士所能为也；必使爱国思想，普及于最大多数之国民而后可。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王無生《論小說與改良社會之關係》夫救亡圖存，非僅恃一二才士所能為也；必使愛國思想，普及於最大多數之國民而後可。”
derivationEn: From 'On the Relationship between Novels and Social Reform' by Wang Wusheng of the Qing Dynasty: 'Saving the nation from peril cannot rely solely on a few talented individuals; patriotic thoughts must be spread among the majority of the people.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 张铺张，夸大。假装出强大的气势。指假造声势，借以吓人。
explanationTraditional: 張鋪張，誇大。假裝出強大的氣勢。指假造聲勢，藉以嚇人。
explanationEn: To make an empty show of strength; to bluff or bluster.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《论淮西事宜状》淄青、恒冀两道，与蔡州气类略同，今闻讨伐元济，人情必有救助之意，然皆暗弱，自保无暇，虚张声势，则必有之。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《論淮西事宜狀》淄青、恆冀兩道，與蔡州氣類略同，今聞討伐元濟，人情必有救助之意，然皆闇弱，自保無暇，虛張聲勢，則必有之。”
derivationEn: From 'On the Situation in Huaixi' by Han Yu of the Tang Dynasty: 'The two circuits of Ziqing and Hengji are similar to Caizhou. Now that we are attacking Yuanji, they will likely help him, but they are weak and can only bluff.'
example: 都只是～，止不过故意穷忙。★明·冯惟敏《不伏老》第一折
exampleTraditional: 都只是～，止不過故意窮忙。★明·馮惟敏《不伏老》第一折
exampleEn: They are just bluffing, only pretending to be busy. (Feng Weimin, 'Not Giving In', Ming Dynasty)

explanation: 博采广泛搜集采纳。从多方面吸取各家的长处。
explanationTraditional: 博採廣泛蒐集採納。從多方面吸取各家的長處。
explanationEn: To adopt and absorb the strengths of many sources; to learn from others' strong points.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·君道》凡处尊位者，必以敬下顺德规谏，必开不讳之门，蹲节安静以藉之，谏者勿振以威，母格其言，博采其辞，乃择可观。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·君道》凡處尊位者，必以敬下順德規諫，必開不諱之門，蹲節安靜以藉之，諫者勿振以威，母格其言，博採其辭，乃擇可觀。”
derivationEn: From 'Shuo Yuan' by Liu Xiang of the Han Dynasty: 'Those in high positions must respect subordinates, follow virtue, and accept advice. They should not intimidate advisors but should broadly adopt their words and choose the best.'
example: 他对学生、画友，从不以我画线，而是主张～，自立门户。★黄胄《怀念望云老师》
exampleTraditional: 他對學生、畫友，從不以我畫線，而是主張～，自立門戶。★黃胄《懷念望雲老師》
exampleEn: He never imposed his own style on students and fellow painters, but advocated learning from others' strengths and developing one's own style. (Huang Zhou, 'In Memory of Teacher Wang Yun')

explanation: 化改变，转变。原指大行其道，使天下化之◇形容做事情不小心谨慎。
explanationTraditional: 化改變，轉變。原指大行其道，使天下化之◇形容做事情不小心謹慎。
explanationEn: To be careless or sloppy; originally meant to greatly transform and influence the world.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心下》大而化之之谓圣。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心下》大而化之之謂聖。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jinxin Xia': 'One who greatly transforms and influences is called a sage.'
example: 这些新的又未免太无边际，～了。★朱自清《文心序》
exampleTraditional: 這些新的又未免太無邊際，～了。★朱自清《文心序》
exampleEn: These new ideas are too vague and careless. (Zhu Ziqing, 'Preface to Wenxin')

explanation: 招摇张扬炫耀；市闹市，指人多的地方。指在公开场合大摇大摆显示声势，引人注意。
explanationTraditional: 招搖張揚炫耀；市鬧市，指人多的地方。指在公開場合大搖大擺顯示聲勢，引人注意。
explanationEn: To swagger through the streets; to show off in public.
derivation: 《史记·孔子世家》居卫月余，灵公与夫人同车，宦者雍渠参乘，出，使孔子为次乘，招摇市过之。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孔子世家》居衛月餘，靈公與夫人同車，宦者雍渠參乘，出，使孔子為次乘，招搖市過之。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Confucius' Family': 'After living in Wei for over a month, Duke Ling and his wife rode in the same carriage, with eunuch Yong Qu as the third, and Confucius as the second, swaggering through the market.'
example: 这几个人，穿着奇装异服，～，得意洋洋。
exampleTraditional: 這幾個人，穿著奇裝異服，～，得意洋洋。
exampleEn: These people, dressed in strange clothes, swaggered through the streets triumphantly.

explanation: 指工作费力大，收效小。
explanationTraditional: 指工作費力大，收效小。
explanationEn: To achieve little result with great effort; to be inefficient.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》故事半古之人，功必倍之。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》故事半古之人，功必倍之。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gongsun Chou I': 'If one does half the work of the ancients, the result will be double.'
example: 把这民间事业整顿得件件整齐，桩桩发达，这岂不是～吗？★清·梁启超《新中国未来记》第三回
exampleTraditional: 把這民間事業整頓得件件整齊，樁樁發達，這豈不是～嗎？★清·梁啟超《新中國未來記》第三回
exampleEn: If we organize these folk undertakings properly, won't it be a case of achieving little with great effort? (Liang Qichao, 'The Future of New China', Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 收拾整顿、整理。指事物败坏到无法整顿或不可救药的地步。
explanationTraditional: 收拾整頓、整理。指事物敗壞到無法整頓或不可救藥的地步。
explanationEn: To be beyond repair or control; to be in a hopeless state.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送高闲上人序》泊与淡相遭，颓堕委靡，溃败不可收拾。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送高閒上人序》泊與淡相遭，頹墮委靡，潰敗不可收拾。”
derivationEn: From 'Seeing Off Monk Gao Xian' by Han Yu of the Tang Dynasty: 'When calmness meets indifference, one becomes decadent and disintegrated, beyond repair.'
example: 蒲殿俊辈登台之后，因为纵容兵士的结果，弄到了一个～的地步。★郭沫若《少年时代·反正前后》
exampleTraditional: 蒲殿俊輩登臺之後，因為縱容兵士的結果，弄到了一個～的地步。★郭沫若《少年時代·反正前後》
exampleEn: After Pu Dianjun and his group came to power, due to their indulgence of soldiers, things got to a point beyond repair. (Guo Moruo, 'Before and After the Revolution')

explanation: 心思灵敏，手艺巧妙（多用在女子）。
explanationTraditional: 心思靈敏，手藝巧妙（多用在女子）。
explanationEn: Clever mind and skillful hands (often used for women).
derivation: 清·孔尚任《桃花扇·栖真》香姐心灵手巧，一捻针线，就是不同的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·孔尚任《桃花扇·棲真》香姐心靈手巧，一捻針線，就是不同的。”
derivationEn: From Kong Shangren's 'Peach Blossom Fan': 'Xiangjie is clever and skillful, her needlework is extraordinary.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 老百姓所受的灾难，象水那样越来越深，象火那样越来越热。比喻人民生活极端痛苦。
explanationTraditional: 老百姓所受的災難，象水那樣越來越深，象火那樣越來越熱。比喻人民生活極端痛苦。
explanationEn: Deep water and scorching fire; metaphor for extreme suffering of the people.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王下》如水益深，如火益热，亦运而已矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王下》如水益深，如火益熱，亦運而已矣。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'Like water becoming deeper, like fire becoming hotter, it is just a matter of fate.'
example: 只要能把国家从～里救出来，他就是至高无上的英雄。★梁斌《红旗谱》四二
exampleTraditional: 只要能把國家從～裡救出來，他就是至高無上的英雄。★梁斌《紅旗譜》四二
exampleEn: As long as he can save the country from deep water and scorching fire, he is the supreme hero. — Liang Bin, 'Red Flag'

explanation: 比喻坚持不懈地改造自然和坚定不移地进行斗争。
explanationTraditional: 比喻堅持不懈地改造自然和堅定不移地進行鬥爭。
explanationEn: The Foolish Old Man removes the mountains; metaphor for perseverance in transforming nature and unwavering struggle.
derivation: 《列子·汤问》记载愚公家门前有两大座山挡着路，他决心把山平掉，另一个老人智叟笑他太傻，认为不能能。愚公说我死了有儿子，儿子死了还有孙子，子子孙孙是没有穷尽的，两座山终究会凿平。
derivationTraditional: 《列子·湯問》記載愚公家門前有兩大座山擋著路，他決心把山平掉，另一個老人智叟笑他太傻，認為不能能。愚公說我死了有兒子，兒子死了還有孫子，子子孫孫是沒有窮盡的，兩座山終究會鑿平。
derivationEn: From 'Liezi': The Foolish Old Man decided to level two mountains blocking his way. When mocked, he said, 'When I die, my sons will continue; my sons will have grandsons, and so on. The mountains will eventually be leveled.'
example: 在现代化建设中，我们要发扬～的精神。
exampleTraditional: 在現代化建設中，我們要發揚～的精神。
exampleEn: In modernization, we must carry forward the spirit of the Foolish Old Man removing the mountains.

explanation: 形容孤苦无依。
explanationTraditional: 形容孤苦無依。
explanationEn: Having no one to depend on; describing loneliness and helplessness.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十五天啊！只道与你一竹竿到底，白头相守，那里说起半路上就抛撇了，遗下许多儿女，无依无靠。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十五天啊！只道與你一竹竿到底，白頭相守，那裡說起半路上就拋撇了，遺下許多兒女，無依無靠。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World': 'Heaven! I thought we would be together forever, but you left me halfway, leaving many children with no one to depend on.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一下子就扫除干净。
explanationTraditional: 一下子就掃除乾淨。
explanationEn: Swept clean at once; completely cleared away.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《题王逸少帖》诗出林飞鸟一扫空。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《題王逸少帖》詩出林飛鳥一掃空。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's poem: 'Birds flying out of the forest are swept away in one stroke.'
example: 吴荪甫微笑地回答，脸上的阴沉气色又～了。★茅盾《子夜》
exampleTraditional: 吳蓀甫微笑地回答，臉上的陰沉氣色又～了。★茅盾《子夜》
exampleEn: Wu Sunfu replied with a smile, and the gloomy look on his face was swept clean. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight'

explanation: 花甲旧时用天干和地支相互配合作为纪年，六十年为一花甲，亦称一个甲子。花形容干支名号错综参差。指六十岁。
explanationTraditional: 花甲舊時用天干和地支相互配合作為紀年，六十年為一花甲，亦稱一個甲子。花形容干支名號錯綜參差。指六十歲。
explanationEn: The age of sixty; a cycle of sixty years in the Chinese calendar.
derivation: 宋·计有功《唐诗纪事》第六十六卷（赵牧）特大中、咸通中敩（效）李长吉为短歌，对酒曰‘……手埒六十花甲子，循环落落如弄珠。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·計有功《唐詩紀事》第六十六卷（趙牧）特大中、鹹通中斆（效）李長吉為短歌，對酒曰‘……手埒六十花甲子，循環落落如弄珠。’”
derivationEn: From Ji Yougong's 'Tang Shi Ji Shi': 'Zhao Mu imitated Li He's style, writing a short song: '...Sixty years cycle like pearls rolling.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 抛暴露。露出头和面孔。原指妇女出现在大庭广众之中。现指公开露面。
explanationTraditional: 拋暴露。露出頭和麵孔。原指婦女出現在大庭廣眾之中。現指公開露面。
explanationEn: To show one's face in public; originally referred to women appearing in public, now means appearing openly.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第三回倘久后此城一破，使我妻女擒往朝歌，露面抛头，尸骸残暴，惹天下诸侯笑我为无谋之辈；不若先杀其妻妇，然后自刎，庶几不失丈夫之所为。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第三回倘久後此城一破，使我妻女擒往朝歌，露面拋頭，屍骸殘暴，惹天下諸侯笑我為無謀之輩；不若先殺其妻婦，然後自刎，庶幾不失丈夫之所為。”
derivationEn: From Xu Zhonglin's 'Creation of the Gods': 'If the city falls, my wife and daughter will be taken to court, showing their faces in public, causing me shame.'
example: 却到这里来～，好不识羞！★叶圣陶《春光不是她的了》
exampleTraditional: 卻到這裡來～，好不識羞！★葉聖陶《春光不是她的了》
exampleEn: Coming here to show your face, aren't you ashamed! — Ye Shengtao, 'Spring Is Not Hers'

explanation: 念念头、主意；差错误。一个念头的差错（造成严重后果）。
explanationTraditional: 念念頭、主意；差錯誤。一個念頭的差錯（造成嚴重後果）。
explanationEn: A wrong thought; a momentary mistake leading to serious consequences.
derivation: 宋·曾憊《类说》卷四十七引《遁斋闲览》一念之误，乃至于此。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·曾憊《類說》卷四十七引《遁齋閒覽》一念之誤，乃至於此。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty 'Lei Shuo': 'A single mistaken thought leads to this.'
example: 世间孽子、孤臣、义夫、节妇，其贤不肖往往只在～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十回
exampleTraditional: 世間孽子、孤臣、義夫、節婦，其賢不肖往往只在～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十回
exampleEn: The difference between a virtuous and a wicked person often lies in a single wrong thought. — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror'

explanation: 原指封建官吏退堂时打鼓。现在比喻跟人共同做事中途退缩。
explanationTraditional: 原指封建官吏退堂時打鼓。現在比喻跟人共同做事中途退縮。
explanationEn: To beat the retreat drum; originally meant officials retreating from court, now means withdrawing midway from a joint endeavor.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》第二折左右，打散堂鼓，将马来，回私宅去也。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》第二折左右，打散堂鼓，將馬來，回私宅去也。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'Injustice to Dou E': 'Beat the court-dismissing drum, bring the horse, and return to my private residence.'
example: 敲败兵锣，～。★清·翟灏《通俗编》卷一
exampleTraditional: 敲敗兵鑼，～。★清·翟灝《通俗編》卷一
exampleEn: Beat the retreat drum. — Zhai Hao, 'Popular Compilation'

explanation: 阿迎合，偏袒。刚强正直，不逢迎，无偏私。
explanationTraditional: 阿迎合，偏袒。剛強正直，不逢迎，無偏私。
explanationEn: Upright and not yielding to flattery; firm and impartial.
derivation: 明·余继登《典故纪闻》卷十四有正大不阿，不行私谒者，便以为不贤。”
derivationTraditional: 明·餘繼登《典故紀聞》卷十四有正大不阿，不行私謁者，便以為不賢。”
derivationEn: From Yu Jideng's 'Records of Anecdotes': 'Those who are upright and do not engage in flattery are considered unworthy.'
example: 济南同知吴公，～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·一员官》
exampleTraditional: 濟南同知吳公，～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·一員官》
exampleEn: Assistant magistrate Wu of Jinan was upright and not yielding to flattery. — Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio'

explanation: 形容人手头很紧，一个钱也没有。
explanationTraditional: 形容人手頭很緊，一個錢也沒有。
explanationEn: Having empty hands; having no money at all.
derivation: 清·袁枚《子不语》卷二十三我客死于此，两手空空，……。”
derivationTraditional: 清·袁枚《子不語》卷二十三我客死於此，兩手空空，……。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Yuan Mei's 'Zibuyu' Volume 23: 'I died as a guest here, with empty hands...'
example: 你知道我做公债亏得一塌糊涂，差不多～了。★茅盾《子夜》八
exampleTraditional: 你知道我做公債虧得一塌糊塗，差不多～了。★茅盾《子夜》八
exampleEn: You know I lost heavily in government bonds and am almost empty-handed. ★ Mao Dun's 'Midnight' Chapter 8

explanation: 用牙咬来对付牙咬。比喻针锋相对地进行回击。
explanationTraditional: 用牙咬來對付牙咬。比喻針鋒相對地進行回擊。
explanationEn: Tooth for tooth; to retaliate in kind.
derivation: 《旧约全书·申命记》以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊約全書·申命記》以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳。”
derivationEn: Old Testament, Deuteronomy: 'Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.'
example: ‘犯而不校’是恕道，‘以眼还眼，～’是直道。★鲁迅《坟·论费厄泼赖”应该缓行》
exampleTraditional: ‘犯而不校’是恕道，‘以眼還眼，～’是直道。★魯迅《墳·論費厄潑賴”應該緩行》
exampleEn: 'Turning the other cheek' is the way of forgiveness, while 'an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth' is the way of justice. ★ Lu Xun's 'Grave: On 'Fair Play' Should Be Postponed'

explanation: 哑口象哑巴一样。象哑巴一样说不出话来。形容理屈词穷的样子。
explanationTraditional: 啞口象啞巴一樣。象啞巴一樣說不出話來。形容理屈詞窮的樣子。
explanationEn: Mute as a dumb person; speechless from being refuted.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷八‘他也有儿子，少不也要娶媳妇。看三朝可肯放回家去？闻得亲母是个知礼之人，亏他怎样说了出来？’一番言语，说得张六嫂哑口无言。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷八‘他也有兒子，少不也要娶媳婦。看三朝可肯放回家去？聞得親母是個知禮之人，虧他怎樣說了出來？’一番言語，說得張六嫂啞口無言。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 8: '...a speech that left Zhang Liuniu speechless.'
example: 他的一席话，使在场的人个个～。
exampleTraditional: 他的一席話，使在場的人個個～。
exampleEn: His remarks left everyone present speechless.

explanation: 宾客人；至到；归回到家中。客人到这里就象回到自己家里一样。形容招待客人热情周到。
explanationTraditional: 賓客人；至到；歸回到家中。客人到這裡就象回到自己家裡一樣。形容招待客人熱情周到。
explanationEn: Guests feel at home; to entertain guests warmly and thoughtfully.
derivation: 《左传·襄公三十一年》宾至如归，无宁灾患，不畏寇盗，而亦不患燥湿。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公三十一年》賓至如歸，無寧災患，不畏寇盜，而亦不患燥溼。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xiang's 31st Year': 'Guests feel at home, without worry of disaster, fear of thieves, or discomfort from dampness or dryness.'
example: 四方之客，一入鲁境，皆有常供，不至缺乏，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十八回
exampleTraditional: 四方之客，一入魯境，皆有常供，不至缺乏，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十八回
exampleEn: Travelers from all directions, upon entering Lu, are provided with constant supplies, lacking nothing, and feel at home. ★ Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 78

explanation: 在忙碌中抽出一点时间来做别的不关重要的事，或者消遣。
explanationTraditional: 在忙碌中抽出一點時間來做別的不關重要的事，或者消遣。
explanationEn: Snatch a little leisure from a busy life; to take a break from work.
derivation: 宋·陈造《同陈宰黄簿游灵山八首》自注宰云‘吾辈可谓忙里偷闲，苦中作乐。以八字为韵。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳造《同陳宰黃簿遊靈山八首》自注宰雲‘吾輩可謂忙裡偷閒，苦中作樂。以八字為韻。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Chen Zao's 'Traveling with Chen Zai and Huang Bo to Mount Ling' self-note: 'We can be said to snatch leisure from busyness and find joy in hardship.'
example: 原来阿妹去看瀑布，可谓～”了。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 原來阿妹去看瀑布，可謂～”了。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十九回
exampleEn: So Sister Ah is going to see the waterfall, which can be called 'snatching leisure from busyness.' ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 49

explanation: 深无限，没有穷尽。启发人深入地思考。形容语言或文章有深刻的含意，耐人寻味。
explanationTraditional: 深無限，沒有窮盡。啟發人深入地思考。形容語言或文章有深刻的含意，耐人尋味。
explanationEn: Set people thinking; to provoke deep thought.
derivation: 唐·刘禹锡《柳花词三进首（其二）》轻飞不假风，轻落不委地。撩乱舞晴空，发人无限思。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉禹錫《柳花詞三進首（其二）》輕飛不假風，輕落不委地。撩亂舞晴空，發人無限思。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Liu Yuxi's 'Three Poems on Willow Flowers (Second)': 'Lightly flying without wind, lightly falling without earth. Fluttering in the clear sky, provoking endless thought.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有什么不被包括。形容包含的东西非常多。
explanationTraditional: 沒有什麼不被包括。形容包含的東西非常多。
explanationEn: All-embracing; to include everything.
derivation: 清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷一‘荡胸’句，言其量之无所不包。”
derivationTraditional: 清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷一‘蕩胸’句，言其量之無所不包。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Anonymous 'Du Shi Yan Zhi' Volume 1: 'The phrase 'dilating the breast' speaks of its capacity to embrace everything.'
example: 写总结要突出重点，不要面面俱到，～。
exampleTraditional: 寫總結要突出重點，不要面面俱到，～。
exampleEn: When writing a summary, focus on key points; do not cover everything and be all-embracing.

explanation: 臂胳膊。指一部分力量或不大的力量。表示从旁帮一点忙。
explanationTraditional: 臂胳膊。指一部分力量或不大的力量。表示從旁幫一點忙。
explanationEn: A helping hand; to give some assistance.
derivation: 元·李寿卿《伍员吹箫》第三折若得此人助我一臂之力，愁甚冤仇不报。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李壽卿《伍員吹簫》第三折若得此人助我一臂之力，愁甚冤仇不報。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Li Shouqing's 'Wu Yuan Blows the Flute' Act 3: 'If I could get this man to lend me a hand, why worry about not avenging my grievance?'
example: 望孔明助～，同破曹贼。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 望孔明助～，同破曹賊。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十四回
exampleEn: I hope Kongming will lend me a hand to defeat Cao Cao together. ★ Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 44

explanation: 裹缠。停步不前，好象脚被缠住了一样。
explanationTraditional: 裹纏。停步不前，好象腳被纏住了一樣。
explanationEn: Hesitate to move forward; to stop as if one's feet are bound.
derivation: 秦·李斯《谏逐客书》使天下之士，退而不敢西向，裹足不入秦。”
derivationTraditional: 秦·李斯《諫逐客書》使天下之士，退而不敢西向，裹足不入秦。”
derivationEn: Qin Dynasty, Li Si's 'Memorial on Expelling Guests': 'Causing the scholars of the world to retreat and not dare to go west, binding their feet and not entering Qin.'
example: 我们不能做有名无实的党员，不能总在困难面前～。★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第二十九章
exampleTraditional: 我們不能做有名無實的黨員，不能總在困難面前～。★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第二十九章
exampleEn: We cannot be party members in name only, nor can we always hesitate before difficulties. ★ Yang Mo's 'Song of Youth' Part 2, Chapter 29

explanation: 原指作战要见机而行，不要做实际上无法办到的事◇泛指知道事情困难就后退。
explanationTraditional: 原指作戰要見機而行，不要做實際上無法辦到的事◇泛指知道事情困難就後退。
explanationEn: Beat a retreat in the face of difficulties; to withdraw after learning of difficulties.
derivation: 《左传·宣公十二年》见可而行，知难而退，军之善政也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公十二年》見可而行，知難而退，軍之善政也。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xuan's 12th Year': 'Advance when possible, retreat when knowing difficulties; this is good military strategy.'
example: 尤其是因为在那一级里有三、四个吵客”，弄得那位英文教员不得不～。★邹韬奋《经历·新饭碗问题》
exampleTraditional: 尤其是因為在那一級裡有三、四個吵客”，弄得那位英文教員不得不～。★鄒韜奮《經歷·新飯碗問題》
exampleEn: Especially because there were three or four 'troublemakers' in that class, the English teacher had to beat a retreat. ★ Zou Taofen's 'Experiences: The New Rice Bowl Issue'

explanation: 几句话。形容话很少。
explanationTraditional: 幾句話。形容話很少。
explanationEn: A few words; very brief speech.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《救风尘》第二折我到那里，三言两句，肯写休书，万事俱休。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《救風塵》第二折我到那裡，三言兩句，肯寫休書，萬事俱休。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Rescuing a Prostitute': 'When I get there, with a few words, if he agrees to write a divorce letter, everything will be fine.'
example: 若不是我这老手～拿他降伏住，还不晓得闹点什么事情出来哩。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十三回
exampleTraditional: 若不是我這老手～拿他降伏住，還不曉得鬧點什麼事情出來哩。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十三回
exampleEn: If it weren't for me, an old hand, subduing him with a few words, I don't know what trouble might have occurred. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene' Chapter 53

explanation: 神志不清，心神不定。
explanationTraditional: 神志不清，心神不定。
explanationEn: In a daze; absent-minded; unsettled.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心思不在这里。指思想不集中。
explanationTraditional: 心思不在這裡。指思想不集中。
explanationEn: Absent-minded; not paying attention.
derivation: 《礼记·大学》心不在焉，视而不见，听而不闻，食而不知其味。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·大學》心不在焉，視而不見，聽而不聞，食而不知其味。”
derivationEn: From 'The Great Learning' in the Book of Rites: 'When the mind is not present, we look but do not see, hear but do not understand, eat but do not taste.'
example: 讲话时做腔做势，而又带着～的样子，这似乎都是纨绔子弟的特征，普遍而一律的。★柔石《二月》六
exampleTraditional: 講話時做腔做勢，而又帶著～的樣子，這似乎都是紈絝子弟的特徵，普遍而一律的。★柔石《二月》六
exampleEn: When speaking, putting on airs and appearing absent-minded seems to be a common trait of dandies. — Rou Shi's 'February' Chapter 6

explanation: 搔抓。隔着靴子搔痒痒。比喻说话作文不中肯，不贴切，没有抓住要点。或做事没有抓住关键。
explanationTraditional: 搔抓。隔著靴子搔癢癢。比喻說話作文不中肯，不貼切，沒有抓住要點。或做事沒有抓住關鍵。
explanationEn: To scratch an itch through one's boot; to fail to address the key point; to be off the mark.
derivation: 宋·严羽《沧浪诗语·诗法》意贵透澈，不可隔靴搔痒。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·嚴羽《滄浪詩語·詩法》意貴透澈，不可隔靴搔癢。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Yan Yu's 'Canglang Poetry Talks': 'The meaning should be thorough, not like scratching an itch through a boot.'
example: 批语家也必须深入生活，否则，～的事情，总是难免的吧！★秦牧《鲜荔枝和干荔枝》
exampleTraditional: 批語家也必須深入生活，否則，～的事情，總是難免的吧！★秦牧《鮮荔枝和幹荔枝》
exampleEn: Critics must also go deep into life; otherwise, missing the point like scratching an itch through a boot is inevitable! — Qin Mu's 'Fresh Lychee and Dried Lychee'

explanation: 昭然明显、显著的样子；揭原意为高举，现也指揭开。形容真相全部暴露，一切都明明白白。
explanationTraditional: 昭然明顯、顯著的樣子；揭原意為高舉，現也指揭開。形容真相全部暴露，一切都明明白白。
explanationEn: Completely obvious; clearly exposed.
derivation: 《庄子·达生》昭昭乎若揭日月而行也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·達生》昭昭乎若揭日月而行也。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi's 'Mastering Life': 'Brightly as if holding up the sun and moon while walking.'
example: 承电示撤消军院，爱国之忱，～。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第七七回
exampleTraditional: 承電示撤消軍院，愛國之忱，～。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第七七回
exampleEn: Your telegram to abolish the military council shows your patriotic sincerity, which is as clear as day. — Cai Dongfan's 'Popular Romance of the Republic' Chapter 77

explanation: 肺腑指内心。出于内心的真诚的话。
explanationTraditional: 肺腑指內心。出於內心的真誠的話。
explanationEn: Words from the bottom of one's heart; sincere words.
derivation: 唐·白居易《代书诗一百韵寄微之》肺腑都无隔，形骸两不羁。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《代書詩一百韻寄微之》肺腑都無隔，形骸兩不羈。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Bai Juyi's 'Poem Sent to Yuan Zhen': 'No barrier in the heart, bodies unrestrained.'
example: 他了他这一番～，使我们陷入了沉思之中。
exampleTraditional: 他了他這一番～，使我們陷入了沉思之中。
exampleEn: His heartfelt words made us fall into deep thought.

explanation: 从容不慌不忙，很镇静；不迫不急促。不慌不忙，沉着镇定。
explanationTraditional: 從容不慌不忙，很鎮靜；不迫不急促。不慌不忙，沉著鎮定。
explanationEn: Calm and unhurried; composed.
derivation: 《旧唐书·刘世龙传》而思礼以为得计，从容自若，尝与相忤者，必引令枉诛。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·劉世龍傳》而思禮以為得計，從容自若，嘗與相忤者，必引令枉誅。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Liu Shilong': 'But Sili thought it was a good plan, calm and composed, and those who had offended him were falsely accused.'
example: 这些人～地叩了头，花费了半点钟以上的时间。★巴金《家》十五
exampleTraditional: 這些人～地叩了頭，花費了半點鐘以上的時間。★巴金《家》十五
exampleEn: These people kowtowed calmly, taking more than half an hour. — Ba Jin's 'Family' Chapter 15

explanation: 性格、志趣、境遇相同的人互相爱护、同情、支持。
explanationTraditional: 性格、志趣、境遇相同的人互相愛護、同情、支持。
explanationEn: People of similar character or interests admire and support each other.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》他若是共小生，厮觑定，隔墙儿酬和到天明，方信道惺惺的自古惜惺惺。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》他若是共小生，廝覷定，隔牆兒酬和到天明，方信道惺惺的自古惜惺惺。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Wang Shifu's 'The Western Chamber': 'If he and I gaze at each other, responding across the wall till dawn, then indeed the clever have always cherished the clever.'
example: 这是双方的互相倾慕，～，但是，又何尝不是一种缘分呢！★柳残阳《断肠花》第34章
exampleTraditional: 這是雙方的互相傾慕，～，但是，又何嘗不是一種緣分呢！★柳殘陽《斷腸花》第34章
exampleEn: This mutual admiration and sympathy between them is also a kind of fate. — Liu Can Yang's 'Heartbreaking Flower' Chapter 34

explanation: 形容公正严明，不怕权势，不讲情面。
explanationTraditional: 形容公正嚴明，不怕權勢，不講情面。
explanationEn: Impartial and incorruptible; strict and fair.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十五回我想必得你去做个‘监社御史’，铁面无私才好。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十五回我想必得你去做個‘監社御史’，鐵面無私才好。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 45: 'I think you must be the 'censor of the poetry club,' and be strictly impartial.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 悲伤、欢乐、离散、聚会。泛指生活中经历的各种境遇和由此产生的各种心情。
explanationTraditional: 悲傷、歡樂、離散、聚會。泛指生活中經歷的各種境遇和由此產生的各種心情。
explanationEn: Sorrows and joys, partings and reunions; the vicissitudes of life.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《水调歌头》词人有悲欢离合，月有阴睛阳缺，此事古难全。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《水調歌頭》詞人有悲歡離合，月有陰睛陽缺，此事古難全。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Water Melody' lyric: 'People have sorrow and joy, parting and reunion; the moon waxes and wanes, this has been ever so.'
example: 童年的记忆最单纯最真切，影响最深最久，种种～，回想起来最有意思。★朱自清《我是扬州人》
exampleTraditional: 童年的記憶最單純最真切，影響最深最久，種種～，回想起來最有意思。★朱自清《我是揚州人》
exampleEn: Childhood memories are the purest and most vivid, with the deepest and longest influence; the various joys and sorrows are most interesting in retrospect. — Zhu Ziqing's 'I Am a Yangzhou Native'

explanation: 山野和海里出产的各种珍贵食品。泛指丰富的菜肴。
explanationTraditional: 山野和海里出產的各種珍貴食品。泛指豐富的菜餚。
explanationEn: Delicacies from mountains and seas; a variety of rich dishes.
derivation: 唐·韦应物《长安道诗》山珍海错弃藩篱，烹犊羊羔如折葵。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韋應物《長安道詩》山珍海錯棄藩籬，烹犢羊羔如折葵。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Wei Yingwu's poem 'Chang'an Road': 'Mountain and sea delicacies are discarded like hedges, while boiled lamb and kid are like folding sunflowers.'
example: 调补剂不一定象～那样适味可口。★闻一多《邓以蛰〈诗与历史〉题记》
exampleTraditional: 調補劑不一定象～那樣適味可口。★聞一多《鄧以蟄〈詩與歷史〉題記》
exampleEn: Tonic supplements are not necessarily as palatable as delicacies from mountains and seas. — Wen Yiduo, 'Inscription for Deng Yizhe's Poetry and History'

explanation: 奋战尽全力地战斗。孤立无助的军队单独对敌作战。也比喻一个人或一个集体无人支援、帮助的情况下努力从事某项斗争。
explanationTraditional: 奮戰盡全力地戰鬥。孤立無助的軍隊單獨對敵作戰。也比喻一個人或一個集體無人支援、幫助的情況下努力從事某項鬥爭。
explanationEn: An isolated army fighting alone; metaphorically, an individual or group struggling without support.
derivation: 《魏书·赵瑕传》思祖率彭沛之众望阵奔退，瑕孤军奋击，独破仙瑅。”《隋书·虞庆则传》由是长儒孤军奋战，死者十八九。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·趙瑕傳》思祖率彭沛之眾望陣奔退，瑕孤軍奮擊，獨破仙瑅。”《隋書·虞慶則傳》由是長儒孤軍奮戰，死者十八九。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei: Biography of Zhao Xia': 'Sizu led the troops of Peng and Pei to flee, but Xia fought alone and defeated Xian Tan.' Also from 'Book of Sui: Biography of Yu Qingze': 'Thus Changru fought alone, with eight or nine out of ten dead.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 与山外、林外距离远的、人急至的山岭、森林。
explanationTraditional: 與山外、林外距離遠的、人急至的山嶺、森林。
explanationEn: Remote mountains and deep forests far from human habitation.
derivation: 秦牧《莽原语丝》还有些人，钻到深山老林里找人参、采木耳，摘蘑菇。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《莽原語絲》還有些人，鑽到深山老林裡找人參、採木耳，摘蘑菇。”
derivationEn: From Qin Mu's 'Words on the Wilderness': 'Some people go into deep mountains and old forests to find ginseng, pick fungus, and gather mushrooms.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 到处奔波。多指为生活所迫或为某一目的四处奔走活动。
explanationTraditional: 到處奔波。多指為生活所迫或為某一目的四處奔走活動。
explanationEn: To rush about busily; to run around for a living or a purpose.
derivation: 元·魏初《沁园春·留别张周卿韵》甚年来行役，交情契阔，东奔西走，水送山迎。”
derivationTraditional: 元·魏初《沁園春·留別張周卿韻》甚年來行役，交情契闊，東奔西走，水送山迎。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Wei Chu's 'Poem to Zhang Zhouqing': 'In recent years, traveling on duty, friendship distant, running east and west, seeing off mountains and rivers.'
example: 憔其为退头货，所以在山东河南～。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第七十九回
exampleTraditional: 憔其為退頭貨，所以在山東河南～。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第七十九回
exampleEn: Because he is a coward, he runs east and west in Shandong and Henan. — Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan, 'The Lantern of Divergent Paths', Chapter 79

explanation: 文文采；质实质；彬彬形容配合适当。原形容人既文雅又朴实，后形容人文雅有礼貌。
explanationTraditional: 文文采；質實質；彬彬形容配合適當。原形容人既文雅又樸實，後形容人文雅有禮貌。
explanationEn: Originally describing a person who is both refined and simple; now meaning elegant and polite.
derivation: 《论语·雍也》质胜文则野，文胜质则史，文质彬彬，然后君子。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·雍也》質勝文則野，文勝質則史，文質彬彬，然後君子。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Yong Ye': 'When substance overcomes refinement, one is rustic; when refinement overcomes substance, one is pedantic. Only when refinement and substance are balanced does one become a gentleman.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 顶礼佛教拜佛时的最敬礼，人跪下，两手伏地，以头顶着受礼人的脚；膜拜佛教徒的另一种敬礼，两手加额，跪下叩头。虔诚地跪拜。
explanationTraditional: 頂禮佛教拜佛時的最敬禮，人跪下，兩手伏地，以頭頂著受禮人的腳；膜拜佛教徒的另一種敬禮，兩手加額，跪下叩頭。虔誠地跪拜。
explanationEn: To prostrate oneself in worship; to show extreme reverence.
derivation: 清·俞万春《荡寇志》第一百十四回又添一个青年女子，顶礼膜拜，行状举止，仿佛慧娘。”
derivationTraditional: 清·俞萬春《蕩寇志》第一百十四回又添一個青年女子，頂禮膜拜，行狀舉止，彷彿慧娘。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Yu Wanchun's 'The Bandits Suppressed', Chapter 114: 'Another young woman appeared, prostrating herself in worship, her behavior resembling that of Huiniang.'
example: 这句话传扬开去，一时哄动了吉州百姓，扶老携幼，都来～。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 這句話傳揚開去，一時鬨動了吉州百姓，扶老攜幼，都來～。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第二十回
exampleEn: This saying spread, stirring up the people of Jizhou, who came with their families to prostrate themselves in worship. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'The Painful History', Chapter 20

explanation: 原是佛教用来比喻人没有一丝牵挂◇指人裸体。
explanationTraditional: 原是佛教用來比喻人沒有一絲牽掛◇指人裸體。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist term meaning to have no attachments; now means completely naked.
derivation: 《楞严经》一丝不挂，竿木随身。”
derivationTraditional: 《楞嚴經》一絲不掛，竿木隨身。”
derivationEn: From 'Shurangama Sutra': 'Not a thread hanging, a pole following the body.'
example: 放闸老兵殊耐冷，～下冰滩。★宋·杨万里《清晓洪泽放闸》诗
exampleTraditional: 放閘老兵殊耐冷，～下冰灘。★宋·楊萬里《清曉洪澤放閘》詩
exampleEn: The lock-keeper, enduring cold, goes naked on the icy beach. — Song Dynasty, Yang Wanli, 'Poem on Opening the Floodgate at Qingxiao Hongze'

explanation: 泛指一般的小病或小灾小难。
explanationTraditional: 泛指一般的小病或小災小難。
explanationEn: Minor ailments like headaches and fevers; trivial illnesses.
derivation: 元·孙仲章《勘头巾》第一折一百日以里，但有头疼脑热，都是你。”
derivationTraditional: 元·孫仲章《勘頭巾》第一折一百日以裡，但有頭疼腦熱，都是你。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Sun Zhongzhang's 'Examining the Head', Act 1: 'Within a hundred days, any headache or fever is yours.'
example: 北平的灾难恰似一个人免不了有些～，过几天自然会好了的。★老舍《四世同堂》
exampleTraditional: 北平的災難恰似一個人免不了有些～，過幾天自然會好了的。★老舍《四世同堂》
exampleEn: Beijing's calamities are like a person's inevitable headaches and fevers, which will heal in a few days. — Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof'

explanation: 应接应；合配合。外面攻打，里面接应。
explanationTraditional: 應接應；合配合。外面攻打，裡面接應。
explanationEn: To coordinate internal and external forces; to attack from outside while someone inside responds.
derivation: 元·杨梓《豫让吞炭》第三折反被韩，魏同谋，里应外合，决水淹我军，甲士溃乱，死者山积。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊梓《豫讓吞炭》第三折反被韓，魏同謀，裡應外合，決水淹我軍，甲士潰亂，死者山積。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Yang Zi's 'Yu Rang Swallows Charcoal', Act 3: 'Instead, Han and Wei conspired, coordinating inside and outside, flooding our army with water, causing chaos and heavy casualties.'
example: 过几日，我这里差人去投降，他们必然懈怠，我们却去劫寨，那时～，定获全胜。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 過幾日，我這裡差人去投降，他們必然懈怠，我們卻去劫寨，那時～，定獲全勝。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十七回
exampleEn: In a few days, we will send someone to surrender, making them careless. Then we will raid their camp, coordinating inside and outside, and win a complete victory. — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 17

explanation: 原意是天下是公众的，天子之位，传贤而不传子，后成为一种美好社会的政治理想。
explanationTraditional: 原意是天下是公眾的，天子之位，傳賢而不傳子，後成為一種美好社會的政治理想。
explanationEn: The world is shared by all; originally meaning the throne is passed to the worthy, not the son, later a political ideal of a just society.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》大道之行也，天下为公。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》大道之行也，天下為公。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Li Yun': 'When the Great Way prevails, the world is shared by all.'
example: 万古千秋业，～器。★陈毅《湖海诗社开征引》诗
exampleTraditional: 萬古千秋業，～器。★陳毅《湖海詩社開徵引》詩
exampleEn: For a thousand autumns and ten thousand years, the world is a vessel for all. — Chen Yi, 'Poem on Founding the Lake and Sea Poetry Society'

explanation: 故老朋友。初次见面就象老朋友一样合得来。
explanationTraditional: 故老朋友。初次見面就象老朋友一樣合得來。
explanationEn: To feel like old friends at the first meeting.
derivation: 《左传·襄公二十九年》见子产，如旧相识。”宋·张洎《贾氏谭录》李邺侯（泌）为相日，吴人顾况西游长安，邺侯一见如故。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公二十九年》見子產，如舊相識。”宋·張洎《賈氏譚錄》李鄴侯（泌）為相日，吳人顧況西遊長安，鄴侯一見如故。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The 29th Year of Duke Xiang' and Song Dynasty Zhang Ji's 'Jia Shi Tan Lu'.
example: 他们俩～，谈得很投机。
exampleTraditional: 他們倆～，談得很投機。
exampleEn: They felt like old friends at first sight and talked very congenially.

explanation: 指见到不平的事。
explanationTraditional: 指見到不平的事。
explanationEn: To witness an injustice.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第十七回俺却路见不平，直送他到沧州，救了他一命。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第十七回俺卻路見不平，直送他到滄州，救了他一命。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 17.
example: 他赶快转过口又说道‘我不过～，说几句气话罢哩！’★茅盾《霜叶红似二月花》十
exampleTraditional: 他趕快轉過口又說道‘我不過～，說幾句氣話罷哩！’★茅盾《霜葉紅似二月花》十
exampleEn: He quickly changed his tone and said, 'I just saw an injustice and spoke a few angry words!'

explanation: 霆极响的雷，比喻震怒。比喻大发脾气，大声斥责。
explanationTraditional: 霆極響的雷，比喻震怒。比喻大發脾氣，大聲斥責。
explanationEn: To fly into a rage; to lose one's temper violently.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·陆逊传》今不忍小忿而发雷霆之怒。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·陸遜傳》今不忍小忿而發雷霆之怒。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Biography of Lu Xun'.
example: 不知说了一句甚么话，符老爷登时～起来，把那独脚桌子一掀。(清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第七十四回)
exampleTraditional: 不知說了一句甚麼話，符老爺登時～起來，把那獨腳桌子一掀。(清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第七十四回)
exampleEn: I don't know what was said, but Master Fu suddenly flew into a rage and overturned the single-legged table.

explanation: 形容吃东西又猛又急的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容吃東西又猛又急的樣子。
explanationEn: To wolf down food; to eat greedily and hastily.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇·刘东山夸技顺城门》十人自来吃酒……须臾之间，狼飧虎咽，算来吃够有六七十斤肉。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇·劉東山誇技順城門》十人自來吃酒……須臾之間，狼飧虎嚥，算來吃夠有六七十斤肉。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement'.
example: 走了这半日，肚中饥饿，～吃了一回。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第五回
exampleTraditional: 走了這半日，肚中飢餓，～吃了一回。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第五回
exampleEn: After walking for half a day, he was hungry and wolfed down his food.

explanation: 执固执，坚持；迷迷惑；悟觉悟。坚持错误而不觉悟。
explanationTraditional: 執固執，堅持；迷迷惑；悟覺悟。堅持錯誤而不覺悟。
explanationEn: To persist in error; to be stubborn and not repent.
derivation: 唐·姚思廉《梁书·武帝纪》若执迷不悟，距逆王师，大军一临，刑兹罔郝，所谓火烈高原，芝兰同泯。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·姚思廉《梁書·武帝紀》若執迷不悟，距逆王師，大軍一臨，刑茲罔郝，所謂火烈高原，芝蘭同泯。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Yao Silian's 'Book of Liang: Annals of Emperor Wu'.
example: 快叫田见秀跟众贼将前来投降，不要～，自走绝路！★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第九章
exampleTraditional: 快叫田見秀跟眾賊將前來投降，不要～，自走絕路！★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第九章
exampleEn: Quickly tell Tian Jianxiu and the other bandit leaders to surrender, and not persist in error and walk into a dead end!

explanation: 物人物，人们。指跟别人往来接触。
explanationTraditional: 物人物，人們。指跟別人往來接觸。
explanationEn: The way one gets along with people; social interaction.
derivation: 汉·司马迁《报任少卿书》教以慎于接物，推贤士为务。”明·陶宗仪《辍耕录》卷五右二事可见前辈诸老谦恭退抑，汲引后进，待人接物者如此。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬遷《報任少卿書》教以慎於接物，推賢士為務。”明·陶宗儀《輟耕錄》卷五右二事可見前輩諸老謙恭退抑，汲引後進，待人接物者如此。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Sima Qian's 'Letter to Ren An' and Ming Dynasty Tao Zongyi's 'Chuo Geng Lu'.
example: 他对事能从各方面看，能有充分的谅解精神，因此他的～都有很合理的态度。★邹韬奋《患难余生记·流亡》
exampleTraditional: 他對事能從各方面看，能有充分的諒解精神，因此他的～都有很合理的態度。★鄒韜奮《患難餘生記·流亡》
exampleEn: He can look at things from all sides and has a great capacity for understanding, so his social interactions are very reasonable.

explanation: 清除旧思想，改变旧面貌。比喻彻底悔改。
explanationTraditional: 清除舊思想，改變舊面貌。比喻徹底悔改。
explanationEn: To turn over a new leaf; to thoroughly reform oneself.
derivation: 《周易·系辞上》圣人以此洗心，退藏于密。”《周易·革》君子豹变，小人革面。”《抱朴子·用刑》洗心而革面者，必若清波之涤轻尘。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭上》聖人以此洗心，退藏於密。”《周易·革》君子豹變，小人革面。”《抱朴子·用刑》洗心而革面者，必若清波之滌輕塵。”
derivationEn: From 'I Ching: Appended Judgments' and 'I Ching: Hexagram Ge' and 'Baopuzi: Using Punishments'.
example: 除非它真能放弃传统意识，完全～，重新做起。★闻一多《神话与诗·文学的历史动向》
exampleTraditional: 除非它真能放棄傳統意識，完全～，重新做起。★聞一多《神話與詩·文學的歷史動向》
exampleEn: Unless it can truly abandon traditional consciousness, completely turn over a new leaf, and start anew.

explanation: 怜怜悯，同情。比喻因有同样的遭遇或痛苦而互相同情。
explanationTraditional: 憐憐憫，同情。比喻因有同樣的遭遇或痛苦而互相同情。
explanationEn: Those who have the same illness sympathize with each other; fellow sufferers commiserate.
derivation: 汉·赵晔《吴越春秋·阖闾内传》子不闻河上之歌乎？同病相怜，同忧相救。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·趙曄《吳越春秋·闔閭內傳》子不聞河上之歌乎？同病相憐，同憂相救。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Zhao Ye's 'Wu and Yue Spring and Autumn Annals'.
example: ～，缀河上之悲曲。（南朝梁·刘璠《广绝交论》）
exampleTraditional: ～，綴河上之悲曲。（南朝梁·劉璠《廣絕交論》）
exampleEn: Those who share the same illness sympathize with each other, composing a sad song by the river.

explanation: 医治不好的病。也比喻无法挽救的祸患。
explanationTraditional: 醫治不好的病。也比喻無法挽救的禍患。
explanationEn: An incurable disease; also a metaphor for an irremediable problem.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十太医诊了诊脉，说道‘……此乃不治之症。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十太醫診了診脈，說道‘……此乃不治之症。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 10.
example: 假使她们真知道立国数千年的大中华民国”的国民，往往有自欺欺人的～，那可真是没有面子了。★鲁迅《二心集·以脚报国》
exampleTraditional: 假使她們真知道立國數千年的大中華民國”的國民，往往有自欺欺人的～，那可真是沒有面子了。★魯迅《二心集·以腳報國》
exampleEn: If they really knew that the citizens of the 'Great Chinese Republic' often have the incurable disease of self-deception, that would be truly embarrassing.

explanation: 形容兴奋得意，精神焕发的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容興奮得意，精神煥發的樣子。
explanationEn: In high spirits; beaming with joy and energy.
derivation: 丁玲《梦珂》她居然很能够安逸的，高贵的，走过去握那少年导演的手，又用那神采飞扬的眼光去照顾一下全室的人。”
derivationTraditional: 丁玲《夢珂》她居然很能夠安逸的，高貴的，走過去握那少年導演的手，又用那神采飛揚的眼光去照顧一下全室的人。”
derivationEn: From Ding Ling's 'Meng Ke'.
example: 他～地走向主席台开始做报告。
exampleTraditional: 他～地走向主席臺開始做報告。
exampleEn: He walked to the podium in high spirits to begin his report.

explanation: 舍除了。除了我还有哪一个？形容人敢于担当，遇有该做的事，决不退让。
explanationTraditional: 舍除了。除了我還有哪一個？形容人敢於擔當，遇有該做的事，決不退讓。
explanationEn: If not me, then who? Describes someone who is willing to take responsibility and never backs down when something needs to be done.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑下》如欲平治天下，当今之世，舍我其谁也？”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑下》如欲平治天下，當今之世，捨我其誰也？”
derivationEn: Mencius, Gongsun Chou II: 'If the world is to be pacified, who else but me in this age?'
example: 我嫡孙也，欲立太子，～！★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十九回
exampleTraditional: 我嫡孫也，欲立太子，～！★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十九回
exampleEn: I am the legitimate grandson; if the crown prince is to be established, who else but me? — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 79

explanation: 踏入社会都靠父母提供。指生活所依赖的人。
explanationTraditional: 踏入社會都靠父母提供。指生活所依賴的人。
explanationEn: Literally 'clothing and food parents'; refers to people on whom one depends for a living.
derivation: 明·汤显祖《南柯记》着甚么南庄田，北庄地，有溜二便是衣食父母。”
derivationTraditional: 明·湯顯祖《南柯記》著甚麼南莊田，北莊地，有溜二便是衣食父母。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Tang Xianzu, 'The Story of the Southern Bough': 'What matters are the southern fields and northern lands; having a scoundrel is like having clothing and food parents.'
example: 农民是他们的～。他们盼望农民有钱就象他们盼望自己一样。（茅盾《故乡杂记》）
exampleTraditional: 農民是他們的～。他們盼望農民有錢就象他們盼望自己一樣。（茅盾《故鄉雜記》）
exampleEn: The peasants are their clothing and food parents. They hope the peasants have money just as they hope for themselves. — Mao Dun, 'Notes from Hometown'

explanation: 实实际。原指言语浮夸，超过实际才能◇也指话说得过分，超过了实际情况。
explanationTraditional: 實實際。原指言語浮誇，超過實際才能◇也指話說得過分，超過了實際情況。
explanationEn: Words exceed reality; originally meant exaggerating one's abilities, later used for overstatement beyond the truth.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀书·马良传》马谡言过其实，不可大用。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀書·馬良傳》馬謖言過其實，不可大用。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Book of Shu, Biography of Ma Liang': 'Ma Su's words exceed his actual ability; he cannot be given great responsibility.'
example: 我不能不将他们那旗人的历史对你讲明，你好知道我不是～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第七回
exampleTraditional: 我不能不將他們那旗人的歷史對你講明，你好知道我不是～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第七回
exampleEn: I cannot help but tell you the history of those bannermen, so you know I am not exaggerating. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 7

explanation: 势气势，威力。形势就象劈竹子，头上几节破开以后，下面各节顺着刀势就分开了。比喻节节胜利，毫无阻碍。
explanationTraditional: 勢氣勢，威力。形勢就象劈竹子，頭上幾節破開以後，下面各節順著刀勢就分開了。比喻節節勝利，毫無阻礙。
explanationEn: Like splitting bamboo; describes a situation where victory comes easily without obstacles.
derivation: 《晋书·杜预传》今兵威已振，譬如破竹，数节之后，皆迎刃而解。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·杜預傳》今兵威已振，譬如破竹，數節之後，皆迎刃而解。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin, Biography of Du Yu': 'Now our military might is already strong, like splitting bamboo: after a few joints, the rest splits apart as the knife goes down.'
example: 关胜等众，乘势长驱，～，又克大谷县。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 關勝等眾，乘勢長驅，～，又克大谷縣。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第九十九回
exampleEn: Guan Sheng and his men took advantage of the momentum to drive forward, like splitting bamboo, and captured Dagu County. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 99

explanation: 反目翻脸了。翻脸而变成仇敌。一般指夫妻不和，矛盾激化，互相对立。
explanationTraditional: 反目翻臉了。翻臉而變成仇敵。一般指夫妻不和，矛盾激化，互相對立。
explanationEn: To turn against and become enemies; usually refers to marital discord escalating into mutual hostility.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十七回娶一个天仙来，也不过三夜五夜，也就撂在脖子后头了，甚于怜新弃旧，反目成仇的多着呢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十七回娶一個天仙來，也不過三夜五夜，也就撂在脖子後頭了，甚於憐新棄舊，反目成仇的多著呢。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 57: 'Even if you marry a celestial being, after three or five nights, they are cast aside; even more so, they may abandon the old for the new and turn against each other.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原意是如果对敌我双方的情况都能了解透彻，打起仗来就可以立于不败之地。泛指对双方情况都很了解。
explanationTraditional: 原意是如果對敵我雙方的情況都能瞭解透徹，打起仗來就可以立於不敗之地。泛指對雙方情況都很瞭解。
explanationEn: Know yourself and know your enemy; originally meant understanding both sides leads to victory in war, now refers to thorough understanding of both parties.
derivation: 《孙子·谋攻》知己知彼，百战不殆。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·謀攻》知己知彼，百戰不殆。”
derivationEn: 'The Art of War, Planning': 'Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated in a hundred battles.'
example: 对付敌人，一定要～，才能百战百胜。★曲波《林海雪原》十一
exampleTraditional: 對付敵人，一定要～，才能百戰百勝。★曲波《林海雪原》十一
exampleEn: To deal with the enemy, one must know oneself and the enemy to be victorious in every battle. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 11

explanation: 切齿咬紧牙齿，表示痛恨。形容极端仇视或痛恨。也形容把某种情绪或感觉竭力抑制住。
explanationTraditional: 切齒咬緊牙齒，表示痛恨。形容極端仇視或痛恨。也形容把某種情緒或感覺竭力抑制住。
explanationEn: To gnash one's teeth; describes extreme hatred or anger, or suppressing strong emotions.
derivation: 元·孙仲章《勘头巾》第二折为甚事咬牙切齿，諕的犯罪人面色如金纸。”
derivationTraditional: 元·孫仲章《勘頭巾》第二折為甚事咬牙切齒，諕的犯罪人面色如金紙。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Sun Zhongzhang, 'Examining the Head', Act 2: 'Why do you gnash your teeth, frightening the criminal's face as pale as gold paper?'
example: 只见水军头领早把张清解来。众多兄弟都被他打伤，～，尽要来杀张清。★明·施耐庵《水浒传》第七十回
exampleTraditional: 只見水軍頭領早把張清解來。眾多兄弟都被他打傷，～，盡要來殺張清。★明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第七十回
exampleEn: The naval leaders had already brought Zhang Qing in chains. Many brothers were injured by him, gnashing their teeth, all wanting to kill Zhang Qing. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 70

explanation: 用道理来说服人。
explanationTraditional: 用道理來說服人。
explanationEn: To convince people through reason.
derivation: 赖传珠《古田会议前后》毛党代表完全采用说服教育，以理服人的态度，而且还要我参加会议一起讨论。”
derivationTraditional: 賴傳珠《古田會議前後》毛黨代表完全採用說服教育，以理服人的態度，而且還要我參加會議一起討論。”
derivationEn: Lai Chuanzhu, 'Before and After the Gutian Conference': 'Comrade Mao Zedong completely adopted the attitude of persuasion and reasoning, and even asked me to participate in the discussion.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 非肠怕，脸色都变了。
explanationTraditional: 非腸怕，臉色都變了。
explanationEn: To turn pale with fright; extremely scared, face changes color.
derivation: 《汉书·霍光传》群臣皆惊愕失色，莫敢发言。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·霍光傳》群臣皆驚愕失色，莫敢發言。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han, Biography of Huo Guang': 'All the ministers were shocked and lost color, none dared to speak.'
example: 金方伯听见不是王慕维，又自称举人，不觉～。★清·张春帆《宦海》第二回
exampleTraditional: 金方伯聽見不是王慕維，又自稱舉人，不覺～。★清·張春帆《宦海》第二回
exampleEn: When Magistrate Jin heard that it was not Wang Muwei and that the man called himself a juren, he turned pale with fright. — Qing Dynasty, Zhang Chunfan, 'The Official World', Chapter 2

explanation: 纷纷众多；扬扬飘荡的样子。形容雪花飘落的样子。
explanationTraditional: 紛紛眾多；揚揚飄蕩的樣子。形容雪花飄落的樣子。
explanationEn: Numerous and fluttering; describes snowflakes falling thickly.
derivation: 元·无名氏《渔樵记》第一折今日遇着暮冬天道，纷纷扬扬，下着如此这般大雪。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《漁樵記》第一折今日遇著暮冬天道，紛紛揚揚，下著如此這般大雪。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Woodcutter and the Scholar', Act 1: 'Today meets the late winter weather, snow falling thickly and fluttering.'
example: 只见四下彤云密布，又见～，飞来一天瑞雪来。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第二回
exampleTraditional: 只見四下彤雲密佈，又見～，飛來一天瑞雪來。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第二回
exampleEn: They saw thick clouds gathering all around, and then snowflakes fell thickly and fluttering, bringing a day of auspicious snow. — Ming Dynasty, Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng, 'The Plum in the Golden Vase', Chapter 2

explanation: 成千上万匹刀在奔跑腾跃。形容群众性的活动声势浩大或场面热烈。
explanationTraditional: 成千上萬匹刀在奔跑騰躍。形容群眾性的活動聲勢浩大或場面熱烈。
explanationEn: Ten thousand horses galloping. Describes a grand and vigorous scene or a massive, lively activity.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇·钱多处白丁横带》空中如万马奔腾，树杪似千军拥沓。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇·錢多處白丁橫帶》空中如萬馬奔騰，樹杪似千軍擁沓。”
derivationEn: From 'The First Carving of the Tablets' by Ling Mengchu of the Ming Dynasty: 'In the sky like ten thousand horses galloping, on the treetops like a thousand troops surging.'
example: 外面的～似的爆竹声送进他的耳朵里来。他在房里坐不住，便信步走出来。★巴金《家》十三
exampleTraditional: 外面的～似的爆竹聲送進他的耳朵裡來。他在房裡坐不住，便信步走出來。★巴金《家》十三
exampleEn: The sound of firecrackers outside, like ten thousand horses galloping, came into his ears. He couldn't sit still in the room, so he walked out. — Ba Jin, 'Family', Chapter 13

explanation: 赤手空手。两手空空。比喻没有任何依靠。
explanationTraditional: 赤手空手。兩手空空。比喻沒有任何依靠。
explanationEn: Empty-handed and bare-fisted. Having no weapons or resources; relying on nothing.
derivation: 元·马致远《任风子》第一折争奈他赤手空拳。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《任風子》第一折爭奈他赤手空拳。”
derivationEn: From Ma Zhiyuan's Yuan Dynasty play 'Ren Fengzi', Act 1: 'But he is empty-handed and bare-fisted.'
example: 老人没了主意，日本兵有枪，他自己～。★老舍《四世同堂》三十五
exampleTraditional: 老人沒了主意，日本兵有槍，他自己～。★老舍《四世同堂》三十五
exampleEn: The old man was at a loss; the Japanese soldiers had guns, while he himself was empty-handed. — Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof', Chapter 35

explanation: 指极其紧要的契机或时刻。
explanationTraditional: 指極其緊要的契機或時刻。
explanationEn: A critical moment of life and death; a crucial juncture.
derivation: 明·高攀龙《讲义·仁远乎哉章》此一转念，是生死关头，千圣都从此做成。”
derivationTraditional: 明·高攀龍《講義·仁遠乎哉章》此一轉念，是生死關頭，千聖都從此做成。”
derivationEn: From Gao Panlong's Ming Dynasty 'Lectures: Benevolence is Far Away?': 'This change of thought is the critical moment of life and death, from which all sages have achieved.'
example: 现在是总罢工的～，没有时间让你去从容整理！★茅盾《子夜》十五
exampleTraditional: 現在是總罷工的～，沒有時間讓你去從容整理！★茅盾《子夜》十五
exampleEn: Now is the critical moment of the general strike; there is no time for you to organize leisurely! — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 15

explanation: 指隐藏才能，不使外露。
explanationTraditional: 指隱藏才能，不使外露。
explanationEn: To hide one's talents and bide one's time; to conceal one's abilities and wait for the right opportunity.
derivation: 《旧唐书·宣宗记》历太和会昌朝，愈事韬晦，群居游处，未尝有言。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·宣宗記》歷太和會昌朝，愈事韜晦，群居遊處，未嘗有言。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Emperor Xuanzong': 'During the Taihe and Huichang reigns, he increasingly concealed his brilliance, never speaking when in company.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 意气主观偏激的情绪；用事行事。缺乏理智，只凭一时的想法和情绪办事。
explanationTraditional: 意氣主觀偏激的情緒；用事行事。缺乏理智，只憑一時的想法和情緒辦事。
explanationEn: To act on impulse or emotion rather than reason; to be swayed by personal feelings.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回这是事势相逼，不得不尔。至今想来，究竟还是意气用事，并不曾报效得朝廷，倒惹得同官心中不快活，却也悔之无及。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回這是事勢相逼，不得不爾。至今想來，究竟還是意氣用事，並不曾報效得朝廷，倒惹得同官心中不快活，卻也悔之無及。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jingzi's Qing Dynasty novel 'The Scholars', Chapter 46: 'It was forced by circumstances. Even now, thinking back, it was still acting on impulse, not serving the court, but causing displeasure among colleagues—regret is too late.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 废停止。顾不得睡觉，忘记了吃饭。形容专心努力。
explanationTraditional: 廢停止。顧不得睡覺，忘記了吃飯。形容專心努力。
explanationEn: To neglect sleep and forget food; to be so absorbed in something that one forgets to eat and sleep.
derivation: 《列子·开瑞篇》杞国有人忧天地崩坠，身亡所寄，废寢食者。”南朝·齐·王融《曲水诗》序犹且具明废寝，昃晷忘餐。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·開瑞篇》杞國有人憂天地崩墜，身亡所寄，廢寢食者。”南朝·齊·王融《曲水詩》序猶且具明廢寢，昃晷忘餐。”
derivationEn: From 'Liezi: Tangwen' and Wang Rong's Southern Qi 'Preface to Qushui Poetry': 'A man of Qi worried about the sky falling... neglecting sleep and forgetting food.'
example: 但得个寄信传音，也省的人～。★元·曾瑞卿《留鞋记》第一折
exampleTraditional: 但得個寄信傳音，也省的人～。★元·曾瑞卿《留鞋記》第一折
exampleEn: If only I could send a letter, it would save people from neglecting sleep and forgetting food. — Zeng Ruiqing, Yuan Dynasty play 'Keeping the Shoe', Act 1

explanation: 分内自己，本分。本分之内的事情。指自己应负责任的事情。
explanationTraditional: 分內自己，本分。本分之內的事情。指自己應負責任的事情。
explanationEn: One's duty; a matter within one's responsibility or scope of duty.
derivation: 《圣谕广训·孝训》皆孝子分内之事也。”
derivationTraditional: 《聖諭廣訓·孝訓》皆孝子分內之事也。”
derivationEn: From 'Sacred Edict: Filial Piety': 'All are matters within a filial son's duty.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 亲身经历过很多次战斗。比喻况历多，经验丰富。
explanationTraditional: 親身經歷過很多次戰鬥。比喻況歷多，經驗豐富。
explanationEn: To have experienced a hundred battles; to be battle-hardened and experienced.
derivation: 《资志通鉴·后唐纪·庄宗同光三年》且群臣或从陛下岁久，身经百战，所得不过一州。”
derivationTraditional: 《資志通鑑·後唐紀·莊宗同光三年》且群臣或從陛下歲久，身經百戰，所得不過一州。”
derivationEn: From 'Zizhi Tongjian: Later Tang Annals': 'Many ministers have followed Your Majesty for years, experienced a hundred battles, and gained only one prefecture.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 笔文笔。指文章传神绝妙之处。
explanationTraditional: 筆文筆。指文章傳神絕妙之處。
explanationEn: The finishing touch; a crucial stroke that brings a work to life or highlights its essence.
derivation: 《晋书·顾恺之传》恺之每画人成，或数年不点目睛。人问其故。答曰‘四体妍蚩，本无阙少于妙处，传神写照，正在阿睹中。’”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·顧愷之傳》愷之每畫人成，或數年不點目睛。人問其故。答曰‘四體妍蚩，本無闕少於妙處，傳神寫照，正在阿睹中。’”
derivationEn: From 'Jin Shu: Biography of Gu Kaizhi': 'Gu Kaizhi often painted portraits but left the eyes unpainted for years. When asked why, he said: 'The limbs are fine, but the spirit lies in the eyes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 中；心中。怒火在心中燃烧。形容心中怀着极大的愤怒。
explanationTraditional: 中；心中。怒火在心中燃燒。形容心中懷著極大的憤怒。
explanationEn: Burning with rage; filled with intense anger.
derivation: 宋·王迈《舑轩集》虚舟相触何心在，怒火虽炎一响空。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王邁《舑軒集》虛舟相觸何心在，怒火雖炎一響空。”
derivationEn: From Wang Mai's Song Dynasty 'Xuanxuan Collection': 'An empty boat touches without intent; though anger burns, it vanishes in a moment.'
example: 这时见四个师弟非欲置自己和师父于死地，不由～。★古龙《长干行》
exampleTraditional: 這時見四個師弟非欲置自己和師父於死地，不由～。★古龍《長幹行》
exampleEn: Seeing the four junior brothers intent on killing him and his master, he burned with rage. — Gu Long, 'The Long and Short of It'

explanation: 谋面见面。指平素没有见过面。
explanationTraditional: 謀面見面。指平素沒有見過面。
explanationEn: Never met before; not acquainted.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 唳鹤叫声。形容惊慌失措，或自相惊忧。
explanationTraditional: 唳鶴叫聲。形容驚慌失措，或自相驚憂。
explanationEn: Panic-stricken; extremely frightened and suspicious.
derivation: 唐·房玄龄《晋书·谢玄传》闻风声鹤唳，皆以为王师已至。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·房玄齡《晉書·謝玄傳》聞風聲鶴唳，皆以為王師已至。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin' by Fang Xuanling: 'Hearing the wind and cranes' calls, they thought the imperial army had arrived.'
example: 直到后来，听到了那些～的传说，见到了举室仓皇的不安状态。★郁达夫《出奔》
exampleTraditional: 直到後來，聽到了那些～的傳說，見到了舉室倉皇的不安狀態。★郁達夫《出奔》
exampleEn: Until later, hearing those panic-stricken rumors and seeing the whole family in a state of panic. (Yu Dafu, 'Exodus')

explanation: 夺目耀眼。形容鲜艳耀眼。也用来形容某些艺术作品和艺术形象的极高成就。
explanationTraditional: 奪目耀眼。形容鮮豔耀眼。也用來形容某些藝術作品和藝術形象的極高成就。
explanationEn: Dazzlingly bright; resplendent; brilliant (also used for artistic achievements).
derivation: 宋·张君房《云笈七签》卷一百十三乃令左右引于宫内游观，玉台翠树，光彩夺目。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》卷一百十三乃令左右引於宮內遊觀，玉臺翠樹，光彩奪目。”
derivationEn: From 'Yunji Qiqian' by Zhang Junfang: 'Jade terraces and emerald trees, dazzlingly bright.'
example: 解开来，只见一团绵裹着寸许大一颗夜明珠，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷一
exampleTraditional: 解開來，只見一團綿裹著寸許大一顆夜明珠，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷一
exampleEn: Untying it, there was a ball of silk wrapping a night pearl the size of an inch, dazzlingly bright. (Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Vol. 1)

explanation: 指单独成立家庭。也指学术上不依赖前人而另立一派。现也指离开某一集体，自己另搞一套。
explanationTraditional: 指單獨成立家庭。也指學術上不依賴前人而另立一派。現也指離開某一集體，自己另搞一套。
explanationEn: To establish one's own family or school of thought; to become independent.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十一回要称我的心，除非自立门户。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十一回要稱我的心，除非自立門戶。”
derivationEn: From 'Flower in the Sea of Sin' by Zeng Pu: 'To satisfy my heart, I must establish my own household.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 膏肓古人把心尖脂肪叫膏”，心脏与膈膜之间叫肓”。形容病情十分严重，无法医治。比喻事情到了无法挽救的地步。
explanationTraditional: 膏肓古人把心尖脂肪叫膏”，心臟與膈膜之間叫肓”。形容病情十分嚴重，無法醫治。比喻事情到了無法挽救的地步。
explanationEn: Incurably ill; beyond cure; hopeless situation.
derivation: 《左传·成公十年》疾不可为也，在肓之上，膏之下，攻之不可，达之不及，药不至焉，不可为也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公十年》疾不可為也，在肓之上，膏之下，攻之不可，達之不及，藥不至焉，不可為也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan': 'The disease is incurable; it is above the diaphragm and below the heart.'
example: 吾观刘琦过于酒色，～，今见面黄羸瘦，气喘呕血，不过半年，其人必死。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十二回
exampleTraditional: 吾觀劉琦過於酒色，～，今見面黃羸瘦，氣喘嘔血，不過半年，其人必死。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十二回
exampleEn: I see Liu Qi is overly indulgent in wine and women, terminally ill; now he is sallow and thin, panting and vomiting blood. Within half a year, he will surely die. (Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Ch. 52)

explanation: 满全；在乎在意。丝毫不在意。形容对事情一点也不重视。
explanationTraditional: 滿全；在乎在意。絲毫不在意。形容對事情一點也不重視。
explanationEn: Completely indifferent; not caring at all.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 朱润身的呼吸有点急促，但脸上依然保持着～的样子。（茅盾《多角关系》）
exampleTraditional: 朱潤身的呼吸有點急促，但臉上依然保持著～的樣子。（茅盾《多角關係》）
exampleEn: Zhu Runshen's breathing was a bit rapid, but his face still maintained a completely indifferent expression. (Mao Dun, 'Multi-Angle Relations')

explanation: 一百个当中就挑出这一个来。形容人才出众。
explanationTraditional: 一百個當中就挑出這一個來。形容人才出眾。
explanationEn: One in a hundred; outstanding; exceptional.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百二十回姑爷年纪略大几岁，并没有娶过的，况且人物儿长的是百里挑一的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百二十回姑爺年紀略大幾歲，並沒有娶過的，況且人物兒長的是百裡挑一的。”
derivationEn: From 'Dream of the Red Chamber' by Cao Xueqin: 'The son-in-law is a bit older, but never married, and his appearance is one in a hundred.'
example: 对报名参军的人挑选很严格，可以说是～。
exampleTraditional: 對報名參軍的人挑選很嚴格，可以說是～。
exampleEn: The selection of volunteers for military service was very strict; it could be said they were one in a hundred.

explanation: 皱着眉头，哭丧着脸。形容愁苦的神色。
explanationTraditional: 皺著眉頭，哭喪著臉。形容愁苦的神色。
explanationEn: Worried and miserable expression; frowning and sad-faced.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第三本第二折对人前巧语花言，背地里愁眉泪脸。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第三本第二折對人前巧語花言，背地裡愁眉淚臉。”
derivationEn: From 'The Western Chamber' by Wang Shifu: 'In front of others, sweet words; behind, worried and tearful face.'
example: 成老爹气得～，只得自己走出去回那几个乡里人去了。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十八回
exampleTraditional: 成老爹氣得～，只得自己走出去回那幾個鄉里人去了。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十八回
exampleEn: Cheng Laoye was so angry that he had a worried and miserable expression, and had to go out alone to deal with those villagers. (Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Ch. 48)

explanation: 益更加。越多越好。
explanationTraditional: 益更加。越多越好。
explanationEn: The more the better; plenty is no plague.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》臣多多益善耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》臣多多益善耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'The more troops, the better.'
example: 这位公子却有钱癖，思量～，要学我这烧争之法。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 這位公子卻有錢癖，思量～，要學我這燒爭之法。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十五回
exampleEn: This young master had a passion for wealth, thinking the more the better, and wanted to learn my method of alchemy. (Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Ch. 15)

explanation: 形容人神志不清的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容人神志不清的樣子。
explanationEn: Dazed and confused; in a stupor; groggy.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第四本第三折准备着被儿枕儿，则索昏昏沉沉的睡。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第四本第三折準備著被兒枕兒，則索昏昏沉沉的睡。”
derivationEn: From 'The Western Chamber' by Wang Shifu: 'Prepare the pillow and quilt, and just sleep dazedly.'
example: 我努力睁大眼睛，我～地捱着时刻。★巴金《第四病室》
exampleTraditional: 我努力睜大眼睛，我～地捱著時刻。★巴金《第四病室》
exampleEn: I tried to open my eyes wide, and I endured the time dazedly. (Ba Jin, 'Fourth Ward')

explanation: 览看；遗遗留。一眼看去，所有的景物全看见了。形容建筑物的结构没有曲折变化，或诗文内容平淡，没有回味。
explanationTraditional: 覽看；遺遺留。一眼看去，所有的景物全看見了。形容建築物的結構沒有曲折變化，或詩文內容平淡，沒有回味。
explanationEn: To take in everything at a glance; describing a structure without twists or turns, or content that is plain and lacks aftertaste.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》江左地促，不如中国，若使阡陌条畅，则一览而尽，故纡余委曲，若不可测。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》江左地促，不如中國，若使阡陌條暢，則一覽而盡，故紆餘委曲，若不可測。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' (Southern Dynasties): 'The area south of the Yangtze is cramped, unlike the Central Plains. If the fields were orderly, one could see everything at a glance, so they are made winding and twisting to seem unfathomable.'
example: 又况此地平漫高亢，贼若据此俯视本关城内虚实强弱，～，为兵家所忌。★明·丛兰《预防边患事》
exampleTraditional: 又況此地平漫高亢，賊若據此俯視本關城內虛實強弱，～，為兵家所忌。★明·叢蘭《預防邊患事》
exampleEn: Moreover, this place is flat and high; if the enemy occupies it and looks down on our city, they can see all our strengths and weaknesses at a glance, which is a taboo in military strategy. — Ming Dynasty, Cong Lan, 'On Preventing Border Troubles'

explanation: 有好的一面，也有坏的一面。
explanationTraditional: 有好的一面，也有壞的一面。
explanationEn: Having both advantages and disadvantages.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 凡事～，我们只须多加防范弊害的发生，不必因噎废食。
exampleTraditional: 凡事～，我們只須多加防範弊害的發生，不必因噎廢食。
exampleEn: Everything has its pros and cons; we just need to guard against the drawbacks and not give up eating for fear of choking.

explanation: 指不管条件是否许可，一心想做大事立大功。多用以形容浮夸的作风。
explanationTraditional: 指不管條件是否許可，一心想做大事立大功。多用以形容浮誇的作風。
explanationEn: To crave greatness and success regardless of conditions; often describes a grandiose style.
derivation: 宋·罗泌《路史·前纪》卷四昔者汉之武帝，好大而喜功。”《新唐书·太宗纪赞》至其牵于多爱，复立浮屠，好大喜功，勤兵于远，此中材庸主之所常为。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·羅泌《路史·前紀》卷四昔者漢之武帝，好大而喜功。”《新唐書·太宗紀贊》至其牽於多愛，復立浮屠，好大喜功，勤兵於遠，此中材庸主之所常為。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Luo Mi's 'Lüshi' and 'New Book of Tang': 'Emperor Wu of Han loved greatness and sought achievements.' 'Emperor Taizong, fond of greatness and achievements, campaigned far away.'
example: 你在人前夸大嘴，说我怎样的～。★郭沫若《屈原》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 你在人前誇大嘴，說我怎樣的～。★郭沫若《屈原》第二幕
exampleEn: You boast in front of others, saying how I love greatness and seek achievements. — Guo Moruo, 'Qu Yuan', Act 2

explanation: 一家子被迫分离四散。
explanationTraditional: 一家子被迫分離四散。
explanationEn: A family forced to separate and scatter.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》父母冻饿，兄弟妻子离散，”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》父母凍餓，兄弟妻子離散，”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius, King Hui of Liang I': 'Parents suffer cold and hunger, brothers and wives are separated.'
example: 无辜人民之死伤成千累万，～啼饥号寒者到处皆是。★毛泽东《评国民党对战争责任问题的几种答案》
exampleTraditional: 無辜人民之死傷成千累萬，～啼飢號寒者到處皆是。★毛澤東《評國民黨對戰爭責任問題的幾種答案》
exampleEn: Countless innocent people were killed or injured, with families broken up and crying from hunger and cold everywhere. — Mao Zedong, 'Comments on the KMT's Answers on War Responsibility'

explanation: 夺胜过。人工的精巧胜过天然。形容技艺十分巧妙。
explanationTraditional: 奪勝過。人工的精巧勝過天然。形容技藝十分巧妙。
explanationEn: Artificial skill surpassing nature; describing exquisite craftsmanship.
derivation: 元·赵孟頫《赠放烟火者》诗人间巧艺夺天工，炼药燃灯清昼同。。”
derivationTraditional: 元·趙孟頫《贈放煙火者》詩人間巧藝奪天工，煉藥燃燈清晝同。。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zhao Mengfu's 'To the Firework Maker': 'Human skill surpasses nature, making lamps and burning gunpowder as bright as day.'
example: 天堑也能飞渡，人力～。★吴玉章《庆祝长江大桥通车》
exampleTraditional: 天塹也能飛渡，人力～。★吳玉章《慶祝長江大橋通車》
exampleEn: Natural moats can be crossed, and human skill surpasses nature. — Wu Yuzhang, 'Celebrating the Opening of the Yangtze River Bridge'

explanation: 象坐在插着针的毡子上。形容心神不定，坐立不安。
explanationTraditional: 象坐在插著針的氈子上。形容心神不定，坐立不安。
explanationEn: Like sitting on a bed of nails; describing extreme unease and restlessness.
derivation: 《晋书·杜锡传》累迁太子中舍人。性亮直忠烈，屡谏愍怀太子，言辞恳切，太子患之◇置针着锡常所坐处毡中，刺之流血。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·杜錫傳》累遷太子中舍人。性亮直忠烈，屢諫愍懷太子，言辭懇切，太子患之◇置針著錫常所坐處氈中，刺之流血。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin, Biography of Du Xi': 'Du Xi was upright and loyal, repeatedly admonishing the crown prince. The prince hated it and placed needles in the felt where Du Xi sat, causing him to bleed.'
example: 却说三巧儿自丈夫出堂之后，～，一闻得退衙，便迎住问个消息。★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷一
exampleTraditional: 卻說三巧兒自丈夫出堂之後，～，一聞得退衙，便迎住問個消息。★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷一
exampleEn: Sanqiao'er, since her husband left the court, felt like sitting on a bed of nails. As soon as he returned, she rushed to ask for news. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New', Vol. 1

explanation: 守口紧闭着嘴不讲话。闭口不谈，象瓶口塞紧了一般。形容说话谨慎，严守秘密。
explanationTraditional: 守口緊閉著嘴不講話。閉口不談，象瓶口塞緊了一般。形容說話謹慎，嚴守秘密。
explanationEn: To keep one's mouth shut like a bottle; describing caution in speech and keeping secrets.
derivation: 宋·周密《癸辛杂识别集》下富郑公有‘守口如瓶，防意如城’之语。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《癸辛雜識別集》下富鄭公有‘守口如瓶，防意如城’之語。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhou Mi's 'Guixin Miscellaneous Records': 'Duke Fu Zheng had a saying: 'Keep your mouth shut like a bottle, guard your mind like a city wall.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 循循有次序的样子；善善于；诱引导。指善于引导别人进行学习。
explanationTraditional: 循循有次序的樣子；善善於；誘引導。指善於引導別人進行學習。
explanationEn: To teach in a systematic and patient manner; good at guiding students.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》夫子循循然善诱人。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》夫子循循然善誘人。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects, Zihan': 'The Master skillfully leads people step by step.'
example: 先生～，余今日之尚能握管，先生力也。★清·沈复《浮生六记·闺房记乐》
exampleTraditional: 先生～，餘今日之尚能握管，先生力也。★清·沈復《浮生六記·閨房記樂》
exampleEn: The teacher guided me step by step; if I can still write today, it is due to his effort. — Qing Dynasty, Shen Fu, 'Six Records of a Floating Life', 'The Joys of the Boudoir'

explanation: 把姓张的帽子戴到姓李的头上。比喻认错了对象，弄错了事实。
explanationTraditional: 把姓張的帽子戴到姓李的頭上。比喻認錯了對象，弄錯了事實。
explanationEn: To put Zhang's hat on Li's head; metaphor for mistaking the object or confusing facts.
derivation: 明·田艺蘅《留青日札》卷二十二《张公帽赋》谚云‘张公帽掇在李公头上。’有人作赋云‘物各有主，貌贵相宜。窃张公之帽也，假李老而戴之。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·田藝蘅《留青日札》卷二十二《張公帽賦》諺雲‘張公帽掇在李公頭上。’有人作賦雲‘物各有主，貌貴相宜。竊張公之帽也，假李老而戴之。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Tian Yiheng's 'Liuqing Rizhao': 'A proverb says, 'Zhang's hat is put on Li's head.' Someone wrote a poem: 'Everything has its owner, appearances suit each other. Stealing Zhang's hat and putting it on Li's head.''
example: 但老船夫却作错了一件事情，把昨晚唱歌人～”了。★沈从文《边城》十四
exampleTraditional: 但老船伕卻作錯了一件事情，把昨晚唱歌人～”了。★沈從文《邊城》十四
exampleEn: But the old boatman made a mistake, putting the hat of last night's singer on the wrong person. — Shen Congwen, 'The Border Town', Chapter 14

explanation: 患忧患，担心。担心得不到，得到了又担心失掉。形容对个人得失看得很重。
explanationTraditional: 患憂患，擔心。擔心得不到，得到了又擔心失掉。形容對個人得失看得很重。
explanationEn: To worry about gaining and losing; describing someone overly concerned with personal得失.
derivation: 《论语·阳货》其未得之也，患得之；既得之，患失之。苟患失之，无所不至矣！”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·陽貨》其未得之也，患得之；既得之，患失之。苟患失之，無所不至矣！”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects, Yang Huo': 'Before gaining, one worries about not getting it; after gaining, one worries about losing it. If one worries about losing, there is nothing they won't do.'
example: 既无～”的念头，心情也自然安泰，决非欲骗人安心，所以这样说”的切祈明鉴为幸。★鲁迅《两地书》六○
exampleTraditional: 既無～”的念頭，心情也自然安泰，決非欲騙人安心，所以這樣說”的切祈明鑑為幸。★魯迅《兩地書》六○
exampleEn: Without the thought of worrying about gain and loss, one's mind is naturally at peace. This is not said to deceive others, so please understand. — Lu Xun, 'Letters from Two Places', No. 60

explanation: 没有声音，没有气味。比喻没有名声，不被人知道。
explanationTraditional: 沒有聲音，沒有氣味。比喻沒有名聲，不被人知道。
explanationEn: Without sound or smell. Figuratively, without fame or being known.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·文王》上天之载，无声无臭。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·文王》上天之載，無聲無臭。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Greater Odes, King Wen': 'The doings of high Heaven have neither sound nor smell.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 悠然闲适的样子；自得内心得意舒适。形容悠闲而舒适。
explanationTraditional: 悠然閒適的樣子；自得內心得意舒適。形容悠閒而舒適。
explanationEn: Leisurely and contented; describing a state of being relaxed and comfortable.
derivation: 唐·房玄龄等《晋书·苻坚载记·附王猛》自不参其神契，略不与交通，是以浮华之士咸轻而笑之。猛悠然自得，不以屑怀。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·房玄齡等《晉書·苻堅載記·附王猛》自不參其神契，略不與交通，是以浮華之士鹹輕而笑之。猛悠然自得，不以屑懷。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin, Biography of Fu Jian, Appendix Wang Meng' by Fang Xuanling et al. of Tang Dynasty: 'Wang Meng was leisurely and contented, not taking trivial matters to heart.'
example: 荒凉的甲板上，只有～的水手们。★华而实《汉衣冠》八
exampleTraditional: 荒涼的甲板上，只有～的水手們。★華而實《漢衣冠》八
exampleEn: On the desolate deck, only the sailors were leisurely and contented. (from Hua Ershi's 'Han Yiguan', Chapter 8)

explanation: 原意是政令出自几个卿大夫的门下。指中央领导软弱，国家权力分散。
explanationTraditional: 原意是政令出自幾個卿大夫的門下。指中央領導軟弱，國家權力分散。
explanationEn: Originally meant that government orders came from several high officials. Refers to weak central leadership and dispersed state power.
derivation: 《左传·成公十六年》鲁之有季孟，犹晋之有栾范也，政令于是乎成。今其谋曰‘晋政多门，不可从也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公十六年》魯之有季孟，猶晉之有欒範也，政令於是乎成。今其謀曰‘晉政多門，不可從也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan, 16th Year of Duke Cheng': 'The state of Jin has many sources of government orders, so we cannot follow them.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 宠宠爱。因为得到宠爱或赏识而又高兴，又不安。
explanationTraditional: 寵寵愛。因為得到寵愛或賞識而又高興，又不安。
explanationEn: To be overwhelmed by favor or appreciation, feeling both happy and uneasy.
derivation: 《老子》第十三章宠辱若惊……得之若惊，失之若惊，是谓宠辱若惊。”宋·苏轼《谢中书舍人启》省躬无有，被宠苦惊。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第十三章寵辱若驚……得之若驚，失之若驚，是謂寵辱若驚。”宋·蘇軾《謝中書舍人啟》省躬無有，被寵苦驚。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi', Chapter 13: 'Favor and disgrace cause alarm...' and Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Xie Zhongshu Sheren Qi': 'Reflecting on myself, I have no merit, yet I am overwhelmed by favor.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 自以为聪明而乱作主张。指过高地估计自己，主观地办事。
explanationTraditional: 自以為聰明而亂作主張。指過高地估計自己，主觀地辦事。
explanationEn: To think oneself clever and act on one's own; overestimating oneself and acting subjectively.
