explanationEn: To return a favor with a favor; to exchange gifts or courtesies.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·抑》投我以桃，报之以李。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·抑》投我以桃，報之以李。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Greater Odes: Suppression': 'You throw a peach to me, I give you a plum in return.'
example: 既戒以修德之事，而又言为德而人法之，犹～之必然也。★宋·朱熹《诗集传》卷十八
exampleTraditional: 既戒以修德之事，而又言為德而人法之，猶～之必然也。★宋·朱熹《詩集傳》卷十八
exampleEn: He admonishes with virtuous deeds, and when virtue is practiced, people follow it, just as inevitably as throwing a peach and receiving a plum. — Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, 'Collected Commentaries on the Book of Songs', Volume 18

explanation: 畏怕，惧。前也怕，后也怕。比喻做事胆子小，顾虑多。
explanationTraditional: 畏怕，懼。前也怕，後也怕。比喻做事膽子小，顧慮多。
explanationEn: To be afraid of the front and the rear; to be overly cautious and full of misgivings.
derivation: 《左传·文公十七年》畏首畏尾，身其余几？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·文公十七年》畏首畏尾，身其餘幾？”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Wen, 17th Year': 'Fear the head and fear the tail; how much body is left?'
example: 妹子平日但凡遇见吃酒行令，最是高兴，从不～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第八十四回
exampleTraditional: 妹子平日但凡遇見吃酒行令，最是高興，從不～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第八十四回
exampleEn: Whenever I encounter drinking games, I am always most enthusiastic and never timid. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 84

explanation: 没有地方可以让自己容身。形容非常羞愧。
explanationTraditional: 沒有地方可以讓自己容身。形容非常羞愧。
explanationEn: To have no place to hide oneself; to be extremely ashamed.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·管宁传》夙宵战怖，无地自厝。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·管寧傳》夙宵戰怖，無地自厝。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei: Biography of Guan Ning': 'Trembling day and night, with no place to hide.'
example: 大娘搜捉以出。女乃指福唾骂，福渐汗～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·仇大娘》
exampleTraditional: 大娘搜捉以出。女乃指福唾罵，福漸汗～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·仇大娘》
exampleEn: The woman searched and caught him. She then pointed at Fu and cursed him; Fu was so ashamed he wished he could sink into the ground. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Qiu Daniang'

explanation: 残垣倒了的短墙。残存和坍塌了的墙壁。形容残败的景象。
explanationTraditional: 殘垣倒了的短牆。殘存和坍塌了的牆壁。形容殘敗的景象。
explanationEn: Broken walls and ruined buildings; a scene of devastation.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一百八回走到也是园滨文述农门首，抬头一看，只见断壁颓垣，荒凉满目，看那光景是被火烧的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一百八回走到也是園濱文述農門首，抬頭一看，只見斷壁頹垣，荒涼滿目，看那光景是被火燒的。”
derivationEn: Wu Jianren of Qing Dynasty in 'Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 108: 'Arriving at the gate of Wen Shunong's residence on Yeyuan Bin, I looked up and saw broken walls and ruins, a desolate scene, as if destroyed by fire.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 眼力过高，手法过低。指要求的标准很高（甚至不切实际），但实际上自己也做不到。
explanationTraditional: 眼力過高，手法過低。指要求的標準很高（甚至不切實際），但實際上自己也做不到。
explanationEn: Having high standards but low ability; to be fastidious but incompetent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 不然，仍旧脱离不了教条主义和党八股，这叫做～，志大才疏，没有结果的。（毛泽东《反对党八股》）
exampleTraditional: 不然，仍舊脫離不了教條主義和黨八股，這叫做～，志大才疏，沒有結果的。（毛澤東《反對黨八股》）
exampleEn: Otherwise, they still cannot get rid of dogmatism and stereotyped Party writing, which is called 'having high standards but low ability, great ambition but little talent, and no results.' (Mao Zedong, 'Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing')

explanation: 原形原来的形状；毕完全。本来面目完全暴露。指伪装被彻底揭开。
explanationTraditional: 原形原來的形狀；畢完全。本來面目完全暴露。指偽裝被徹底揭開。
explanationEn: To reveal one's true colors; to show one's real nature completely.
derivation: 何其芳《理性与历史》白纸黑字，虽说印的是魑魅魍魉的话，也未始不可发生另外一种作用原形毕露，看它往哪里逃遁呵！”
derivationTraditional: 何其芳《理性與歷史》白紙黑字，雖說印的是魑魅魍魎的話，也未始不可發生另外一種作用原形畢露，看它往哪裡逃遁呵！”
derivationEn: He Qifang, 'Reason and History': 'In black and white, although it prints the words of monsters and demons, it may also have another effect: to reveal their true colors and see where they can flee!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 骄子父母溺爱骄纵的儿子。老天爷的宠儿。原指强盛的北方民族胡人，后也指为父母溺爱、放肆不受管束的儿子。
explanationTraditional: 驕子父母溺愛驕縱的兒子。老天爺的寵兒。原指強盛的北方民族胡人，後也指為父母溺愛、放肆不受管束的兒子。
explanationEn: God's favored one; originally referred to the powerful northern nomadic Hu people, later also used for a spoiled child who is indulged by parents and behaves willfully.
derivation: 《汉书·匈奴传上》南有大汉，北有强胡→者，天之骄子也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·匈奴傳上》南有大漢，北有強胡→者，天之驕子也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of the Xiongnu': 'In the south there is the great Han, in the north there is the strong Hu, who are God's favored ones.'
example: 有人能增加些美到世上去，这人便是～。★冰心《寄小读者·通讯九》
exampleTraditional: 有人能增加些美到世上去，這人便是～。★冰心《寄小讀者·通訊九》
exampleEn: Someone who can add beauty to the world is God's favored one. (Bing Xin, 'To Little Readers: Letter Nine')

explanation: 盖遮掩；弥更加；彰明显。想掩盖坏事的真相，结果反而更明显地暴露出来。
explanationTraditional: 蓋遮掩；彌更加；彰明顯。想掩蓋壞事的真相，結果反而更明顯地暴露出來。
explanationEn: The more one tries to cover up a wrongdoing, the more it becomes exposed.
derivation: 《左传·昭公三十一年》或求名而不得，或欲盖而名章，惩不义也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公三十一年》或求名而不得，或欲蓋而名章，懲不義也。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: The 31st Year of Duke Zhao': 'Some seek fame but do not get it; some want to cover up but their name becomes more prominent, to punish the unrighteous.'
example: 与其～，倒不如自己先认了。★闻一多《画展》
exampleTraditional: 與其～，倒不如自己先認了。★聞一多《畫展》
exampleEn: Rather than trying to cover up and making it more obvious, it's better to admit it first. (Wen Yiduo, 'Art Exhibition')

explanation: 比喻能担当大事的人才。
explanationTraditional: 比喻能擔當大事的人才。
explanationEn: A person of great ability who can shoulder important responsibilities; a pillar of the state.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 每个青年都应该努力向上，刻苦学习，使自己成为国家的～。
exampleTraditional: 每個青年都應該努力向上，刻苦學習，使自己成為國家的～。
exampleEn: Every young person should strive to work hard and study diligently, to become a pillar of the nation.

explanation: 妄胡乱，非分的，出了常规的。妄为胡作非为。指不顾一切由着自己的性子胡作非为。亦作肆意妄行”。
explanationTraditional: 妄胡亂，非分的，出了常規的。妄為胡作非為。指不顧一切由著自己的性子胡作非為。亦作肆意妄行”。
explanationEn: To act recklessly and willfully; to do whatever one wants without restraint.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不二指不是两极端；法门佧行入道的门径。原为佛家语，意为直接入道，不可言传的法门◇比喻最好的或独一无二的方法。
explanationTraditional: 不二指不是兩極端；法門佧行入道的門徑。原為佛家語，意為直接入道，不可言傳的法門◇比喻最好的或獨一無二的方法。
explanationEn: The one and only way; the best or unique method to achieve something.
derivation: 《维摩诘经·入不二法门品》如我意者，于一切法无言无说，无示无识，离诸问答，是为入不二法门。”
derivationTraditional: 《維摩詰經·入不二法門品》如我意者，於一切法無言無說，無示無識，離諸問答，是為入不二法門。”
derivationEn: 'Vimalakirti Sutra: Chapter on the Non-dual Dharma Door': 'As I understand it, to be without words, without speech, without indication, without knowledge, and to be free from all questions and answers—this is to enter the non-dual Dharma door.'
example: 历观战史，水战用火攻，是颠扑不破的～。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 歷觀戰史，水戰用火攻，是顛撲不破的～。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: Looking through the history of naval warfare, using fire in naval battles is an unbreakable and unique method. (Gao Yang, 'Inside the Qing Palace', Volume 2)

explanation: 强词强辩；夺争。指无理强辩，明明没理硬说有理。
explanationTraditional: 強詞強辯；奪爭。指無理強辯，明明沒理硬說有理。
explanationEn: To use lame arguments and sophistry; to argue irrationally and insist on being right.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十三回座上一人忽日‘孔明所言，皆强词夺理，均非正论，不必再言。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十三回座上一人忽日‘孔明所言，皆強詞奪理，均非正論，不必再言。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 43: 'Suddenly a man said, 'What Kongming says is all sophistry and not proper argument; there is no need to say more.'
example: 他的话简直就是～，你不要信他。
exampleTraditional: 他的話簡直就是～，你不要信他。
exampleEn: His words are just sophistry; don't believe him.

explanation: 重视或优待一方，轻视或怠慢另一方。比喻对两方面的待遇不同。
explanationTraditional: 重視或優待一方，輕視或怠慢另一方。比喻對兩方面的待遇不同。
explanationEn: To favor one over another; to treat differently.
derivation: 《梁书·贺琛传》所以然者，出嫁则有受我，出后则有传重，并欲薄于此而厚于彼，此服虽降，彼服则隆。”
derivationTraditional: 《梁書·賀琛傳》所以然者，出嫁則有受我，出後則有傳重，並欲薄於此而厚於彼，此服雖降，彼服則隆。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Liang: Biography of He Chen': 'The reason is that when a woman marries out, she is received; when she goes out, she is passed on; both want to be thin here and thick there. Although this mourning is reduced, that mourning is increased.'
example: 张树声出身淮军，对边军支援，～，已经有许多人说过话。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 張樹聲出身淮軍，對邊軍支援，～，已經有許多人說過話。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: Zhang Shusheng came from the Huai Army, and many had already spoken about his favoring one side over the other in supporting the border troops. (Gao Yang, 'Inside the Qing Palace', Volume 2)

explanation: 交同时；困困境。里里外外都处于困难的境地。
explanationTraditional: 交同時；困困境。裡裡外外都處於困難的境地。
explanationEn: To be beset with difficulties both at home and abroad; to be in trouble internally and externally.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十二章休再罗索！朕因流贼猖獗，东事日急，内外交困，不得不百计筹饷。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十二章休再羅索！朕因流賊猖獗，東事日急，內外交困，不得不百計籌餉。”
derivationEn: Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 32: 'Stop talking nonsense! Because the rebels are rampant, the eastern affairs are urgent, and we are beset with difficulties both at home and abroad, I have to raise funds by all means.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 损害别人，使自己得到好处。
explanationTraditional: 損害別人，使自己得到好處。
explanationEn: To harm others for one's own benefit.
derivation: 《旧唐书·陆象先传》为政者理则可矣，何必严刑树威。损人益己，恐非仁恕之道。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·陸象先傳》為政者理則可矣，何必嚴刑樹威。損人益己，恐非仁恕之道。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang·Biography of Lu Xiangxian': 'A ruler should govern with reason, not with harsh punishments. Harming others to benefit oneself is not the way of benevolence.'
example: 凡有～之心的人，其结果都不妙。★毛泽东《新民主主义的宪政》
exampleTraditional: 凡有～之心的人，其結果都不妙。★毛澤東《新民主主義的憲政》
exampleEn: Those who have the mindset of harming others for personal gain often end up badly. — Mao Zedong, 'New Democratic Constitutional Government'

explanation: 拿邻国当做大水坑，把本国的洪水排泄到那里去。比喻只图自己一方的利益，把困难或祸害转嫁给别人。
explanationTraditional: 拿鄰國當做大水坑，把本國的洪水排洩到那裡去。比喻只圖自己一方的利益，把困難或禍害轉嫁給別人。
explanationEn: To use one's neighbor as a drain; to shift one's difficulties or troubles onto others for one's own benefit.
derivation: 《孟子·告子下》是故禹以四海为壑。今吾子以邻国为壑。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·告子下》是故禹以四海為壑。今吾子以鄰國為壑。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius·Gaozi II': 'Thus Yu used the four seas as a drain. Now you use your neighbor as a drain.'
example: 有些自私自利的人，做事从来不为别人着想，甚至～。
exampleTraditional: 有些自私自利的人，做事從來不為別人著想，甚至～。
exampleEn: Some selfish people never consider others and even shift their troubles onto them.

explanation: 郑重审慎，严肃认真。形容说话做事时态度非常严肃认真。
explanationTraditional: 鄭重審慎，嚴肅認真。形容說話做事時態度非常嚴肅認真。
explanationEn: To take something seriously and handle it with due care and solemnity.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四回所以郑重其事，必得三日后方进门。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四回所以鄭重其事，必得三日後方進門。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 4: 'Thus they took it seriously, insisting on entering the door only after three days.'
example: 孙俊英背剪着手，～地在墙前站着看标语。★冯德英《迎春花》第六章
exampleTraditional: 孫俊英背剪著手，～地在牆前站著看標語。★馮德英《迎春花》第六章
exampleEn: Sun Junying stood with her hands behind her back, looking at the slogans on the wall with great seriousness. — Feng Deying, 'Spring Blossoms', Chapter 6

explanation: 光怪光彩奇异；陆离开卷参差。形容奇形怪状，五颜六色。
explanationTraditional: 光怪光彩奇異；陸離開卷參差。形容奇形怪狀，五顏六色。
explanationEn: Grotesque in shape and gaudy in color; bizarre and colorful.
derivation: 战国·楚·屈原《离骚》纷总总其离合兮，斑陆离其上下。”《三国志·吴志·孙坚传》裴松之注引《吴书》冢上有光怪，云气五色，上属于天，曼延数里。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·屈原《離騷》紛總總其離合兮，斑陸離其上下。”《三國志·吳志·孫堅傳》裴松之注引《吳書》冢上有光怪，雲氣五色，上屬於天，曼延數里。”
derivationEn: From Qu Yuan's 'Li Sao' (Warring States period): 'Numerous and varied, they merge and part; colorful and dazzling, they rise and fall.' Also from 'Records of the Three Kingdoms·Wu·Biography of Sun Jian' annotated by Pei Songzhi: 'A strange light appeared over the tomb, with colorful clouds reaching the sky for miles.'
example: 那柴烧的一块一块的，结成就和太湖石一般，～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 那柴燒的一塊一塊的，結成就和太湖石一般，～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第五十五回
exampleEn: The firewood burned into pieces, forming shapes like Taihu stones, bizarre and colorful. — Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 55

explanation: 出自恶毒用心去诽谤诬陷伤害别人，中伤说坏话攻击陷害别人。
explanationTraditional: 出自惡毒用心去誹謗誣陷傷害別人，中傷說壞話攻擊陷害別人。
explanationEn: To maliciously slander or defame others.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》利刀割肉疮犹合，恶语伤人恨不销。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》利刀割肉瘡猶合，惡語傷人恨不銷。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'A sharp knife cuts flesh, but the wound heals; malicious words hurt people, and the hatred never fades.'
example: 他只会一味地～别人。
exampleTraditional: 他只會一味地～別人。
exampleEn: He only knows how to maliciously slander others.

explanation: 一个在天上，一个在人间。多比喻境遇完全不同。
explanationTraditional: 一個在天上，一個在人間。多比喻境遇完全不同。
explanationEn: As different as heaven and earth; describing vastly different circumstances.
derivation: 南唐·李煜《浪淘沙》词流水落花春去也，天上人间。”
derivationTraditional: 南唐·李煜《浪淘沙》詞流水落花春去也，天上人間。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu's poem 'Waves Scour the Sand' (Southern Tang): 'Flowing water and fallen flowers, spring is gone; one in heaven, one among men.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 精诚真诚。一心一意，团结一致。
explanationTraditional: 精誠真誠。一心一意，團結一致。
explanationEn: To unite sincerely and wholeheartedly.
derivation: 《庄子·渔父》真者，精诚之至也，不精不诚，不能动人。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·漁父》真者，精誠之至也，不精不誠，不能動人。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi·The Fisherman': 'Sincerity is the utmost; without sincerity, one cannot move others.'
example: 困难当头，更要～。
exampleTraditional: 困難當頭，更要～。
exampleEn: In times of difficulty, we must unite more sincerely.

explanation: 从早到晚，勤于公务。
explanationTraditional: 從早到晚，勤於公務。
explanationEn: To be diligent in public affairs from morning till night.
derivation: 《诗经·召南·采蘩》被之僮僮，夙夜在公。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·召南·采蘩》被之僮僮，夙夜在公。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs·Shao Nan·Gathering White Artemisia': 'With headdress adorned, from dawn to night, I serve in the public hall.'
example: 毅～，坐而待旦。★《晋书·刘毅传》
exampleTraditional: 毅～，坐而待旦。★《晉書·劉毅傳》
exampleEn: Liu Yi was diligent in public affairs from morning till night, sitting and waiting for dawn. — 'Book of Jin·Biography of Liu Yi'

explanation: 访问贫苦的老百姓。
explanationTraditional: 訪問貧苦的老百姓。
explanationEn: To visit and inquire about the hardships of the poor.
derivation: 郭寿《迷路记》平地春雷响，来了共产党，访贫问苦下了乡，介梅见太阳。”
derivationTraditional: 郭壽《迷路記》平地春雷響，來了共產黨，訪貧問苦下了鄉，介梅見太陽。”
derivationEn: From Guo Shou's 'Lost Way': 'Spring thunder on the plain, the Communist Party arrived, visiting the poor and asking about hardships in the countryside, Jiemei saw the sun.'
example: 他已经不像前一段旅程中那样的沉默了，一直同向导闲谈着，问着这一带庄稼，以及那乡下的家庭生活状况，下像一般工作同志～那样。
exampleTraditional: 他已經不像前一段旅程中那樣的沉默了，一直同向導閒談著，問著這一帶莊稼，以及那鄉下的家庭生活狀況，下像一般工作同志～那樣。
exampleEn: He was no longer silent as in the previous part of the journey; he chatted with the guide, asking about the crops and the family life in the countryside, just like a comrade visiting the poor and asking about hardships.

explanation: ①原指军队中的兵员和马匹。亦泛指有战斗力的部队。②指充满活力的力量。
explanationTraditional: ①原指軍隊中的兵員和馬匹。亦泛指有戰鬥力的部隊。②指充滿活力的力量。
explanationEn: 1. Originally refers to troops and horses in the army; also means combat-effective forces. 2. Vital and dynamic strength.
derivation: 毛泽东《集中优势兵力，各个歼灭敌人》集中兵力各个歼敌的原则，以歼灭敌军有生力量为主要目标，不以保守或夺取地方为主要目标。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《集中優勢兵力，各個殲滅敵人》集中兵力各個殲敵的原則，以殲滅敵軍有生力量為主要目標，不以保守或奪取地方為主要目標。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Concentrate Superior Forces to Destroy the Enemy One by One': 'The principle of concentrating forces to destroy the enemy one by one aims primarily at annihilating the enemy's effective strength, not at holding or capturing territory.'
example: 青年突击队始终紧紧地结合社会的生产，一直保持着生气勃勃的、内容丰富的活动，成为一支推动生产的～。★《中国农村的社会主义高潮》
exampleTraditional: 青年突擊隊始終緊緊地結合社會的生產，一直保持著生氣勃勃的、內容豐富的活動，成為一支推動生產的～。★《中國農村的社會主義高潮》
exampleEn: The youth突击队始终紧密结合社会生产，保持生机勃勃的活动，成为推动生产的有生力量。 — 'The Socialist Upsurge in China's Countryside'

explanation: 看过就不忘记。形容记忆力非常强。
explanationTraditional: 看過就不忘記。形容記憶力非常強。
explanationEn: Never forget what one has seen; having a very retentive memory.
derivation: 《晋书·苻融载记》耳闻则育，过目不忘。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·苻融載記》耳聞則育，過目不忘。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Fu Rong': 'What one hears, one remembers; what one sees, one never forgets.'
example: 公～，真天下奇才也！★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 公～，真天下奇才也！★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十回
exampleEn: You never forget what you read; truly a genius under heaven! — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 60

explanation: 疾病多是由食物传染。比喻应该注意饮食卫生。
explanationTraditional: 疾病多是由食物傳染。比喻應該注意飲食衛生。
explanationEn: Diseases enter through the mouth; emphasizing the importance of food hygiene.
derivation: 晋·傅玄《口铭》病从口入，祸从口出。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·傅玄《口銘》病從口入，禍從口出。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Fu Xuan's 'Inscription on the Mouth': 'Diseases enter through the mouth, misfortunes come out through the mouth.'
example: 我们要讲究饮食卫生，防止～。
exampleTraditional: 我們要講究飲食衛生，防止～。
exampleEn: We must pay attention to food hygiene to prevent diseases from entering through the mouth.

explanation: 糊里糊涂，什么也不知道。
explanationTraditional: 糊里糊塗，什麼也不知道。
explanationEn: Muddled and confused; not knowing anything.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十八回呆子懵懵懂懂的，托着钵盂，拑着钉钯，与沙僧径直回来。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十八回呆子懵懵懂懂的，託著缽盂，拑著釘鈀，與沙僧徑直回來。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 28: 'The idiot, muddled and confused, carrying his alms bowl and holding his rake, returned straight with Sha Monk.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 喧声音大。客人的声音压倒了主人的声音。比喻外来的或次要的事物占据了原有的或主要的事物的位置。
explanationTraditional: 喧聲音大。客人的聲音壓倒了主人的聲音。比喻外來的或次要的事物佔據了原有的或主要的事物的位置。
explanationEn: The guest's voice overwhelms the host's; metaphor for secondary or external matters taking precedence over primary ones.
derivation: 清·杨宜治《俄程日记》近有喧宾夺主之势。”
derivationTraditional: 清·楊宜治《俄程日記》近有喧賓奪主之勢。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Yang Yizhi's 'Diary of a Journey to Russia': 'Recently, there is a tendency of the guest overwhelming the host.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原来的病又犯了。
explanationTraditional: 原來的病又犯了。
explanationEn: Relapse of an old illness.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》三十二回袁绍闻袁尚败回，又受了一惊，旧病复发，吐血数斗，昏倒在地。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》三十二回袁紹聞袁尚敗回，又受了一驚，舊病復發，吐血數鬥，昏倒在地。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 32: 'Yuan Shao heard that Yuan Shang had been defeated and suffered another shock; his old illness relapsed, he vomited several pints of blood, and fell unconscious.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指计划得很周密，考虑得很长远。
explanationTraditional: 指計劃得很周密，考慮得很長遠。
explanationEn: Deep plans and far-sighted considerations; careful and long-term planning.
derivation: 汉·贾谊《过秦论》深谋远虑，行军用兵之道，非及曩时之士也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·賈誼《過秦論》深謀遠慮，行軍用兵之道，非及曩時之士也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Jia Yi's 'On the Faults of Qin': 'Deep plans and far-sighted considerations in the art of war were not as good as those of the scholars of former times.'
example: 大王～，说得有理。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 大王～，說得有理。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十回
exampleEn: Your Majesty's deep plans and far-sighted considerations are reasonable. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 20

explanation: 云说。不知道说得是些么。形容说话内容混乱，无法理解。
explanationTraditional: 雲說。不知道說得是些麼。形容說話內容混亂，無法理解。
explanationEn: Not knowing what one is saying; describing speech that is incoherent or incomprehensible.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《出师表》临表涕泣，不知所云。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《出師表》臨表涕泣，不知所云。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms period, Shu Han, Zhuge Liang's 'Memorial on Sending Out the Troops': 'Facing the memorial, I weep, not knowing what I am saying.'
example: 这篇文章逻辑性太差，使人看了～。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章邏輯性太差，使人看了～。
exampleEn: This article is so illogical that readers are left not knowing what it is saying.

explanation: 花儿正盛开，月亮正圆满。比喻美好圆满。多用于棕人新婚。
explanationTraditional: 花兒正盛開，月亮正圓滿。比喻美好圓滿。多用於棕人新婚。
explanationEn: Flowers in full bloom and the moon perfectly round; metaphor for perfect happiness, often used for newlyweds.
derivation: 宋·张先《木兰花》词人意共怜花月满，花好月圆人又散。欢情去逐远云空，往事过如幽梦断。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張先《木蘭花》詞人意共憐花月滿，花好月圓人又散。歡情去逐遠雲空，往事過如幽夢斷。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Zhang Xian's poem 'Magnolia Flower': 'People's hearts pity the flowers and the full moon; flowers are good and the moon round, but people are apart.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 交头头靠着头；接耳嘴凑近耳朵。形容两个人凑近低声交谈。
explanationTraditional: 交頭頭靠著頭；接耳嘴湊近耳朵。形容兩個人湊近低聲交談。
explanationEn: Heads close together and whispering; describing two people talking in low voices.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《单刀会》第三折不许交头接耳，不许笑语喧哗。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《單刀會》第三折不許交頭接耳，不許笑語喧譁。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing's 'Single Sword Meeting', Act 3: 'No whispering, no loud laughter or talk.'
example: 看见门上那些人在那里～，好象要使贾政知道的似的，又不好明回，只管咕咕唧唧的说话。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十三回
exampleTraditional: 看見門上那些人在那裡～，好象要使賈政知道的似的，又不好明回，只管咕咕唧唧的說話。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十三回
exampleEn: Seeing the servants whispering among themselves, as if wanting to inform Jia Zheng but not daring to speak directly, they just muttered. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 93

explanation: 神、化指神妙的境域。极其高超的境界。形容文学艺术达到极高的成就。
explanationTraditional: 神、化指神妙的境域。極其高超的境界。形容文學藝術達到極高的成就。
explanationEn: Reaching the highest realm of excellence; describing literary or artistic achievement of supreme skill.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第二本第二折我不曾出声，他连忙答应。金圣叹‘真正出神入化之笔’。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第二本第二折我不曾出聲，他連忙答應。金聖嘆‘真正出神入化之筆’。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing', Act 2, Scene 2: 'Before I spoke, he quickly answered. Jin Shengtan commented: 'Truly a stroke of genius reaching the divine realm.''
example: 不知道这位老画师是观察了多少的活虾，才能够画虾画得这样～的。★秦牧《虾趣》
exampleTraditional: 不知道這位老畫師是觀察了多少的活蝦，才能夠畫蝦畫得這樣～的。★秦牧《蝦趣》
exampleEn: I wonder how many live shrimp this old painter observed before he could paint shrimp with such divine skill. — Qin Mu, 'The Charm of Shrimp'

explanation: 得意扬扬自得的样子。旧时形容考中进士后的兴奋心情◇形容职位升迁顺利。
explanationTraditional: 得意揚揚自得的樣子。舊時形容考中進士後的興奮心情◇形容職位升遷順利。
explanationEn: To be extremely proud and pleased with oneself; originally described the elation after passing the imperial examination, later used for smooth career advancement.
derivation: 唐·孟郊《登科后》诗春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·孟郊《登科後》詩春風得意馬蹄疾，一日看盡長安花。”
derivationEn: From Meng Jiao's poem 'After Passing the Imperial Examination' in Tang Dynasty: 'In the spring breeze, proud and pleased, my horse gallops fast; in one day I see all the flowers of Chang'an.'
example: 在这些伸手”派心目中，新社会也不过是一个猎场，可以任由他们在其中践踏一切，呼朋引类，～，纵马狩猎。★秦牧《手莫伸》
exampleTraditional: 在這些伸手”派心目中，新社會也不過是一個獵場，可以任由他們在其中踐踏一切，呼朋引類，～，縱馬狩獵。★秦牧《手莫伸》
exampleEn: In the eyes of these 'grabbers', the new society is just a hunting ground where they can trample everything, call their friends, be proud and pleased, and hunt freely. — Qin Mu, 'Don't Stretch Out Your Hand'

explanation: 把一个人或一方的意见、看法勉强加诸于别人。
explanationTraditional: 把一個人或一方的意見、看法勉強加諸於別人。
explanationEn: To force one's opinions or views onto others.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 不论所谈论的是政治、宗教或社会问题，均不应把自己的意见～，硬要别人接受。
exampleTraditional: 不論所談論的是政治、宗教或社會問題，均不應把自己的意見～，硬要別人接受。
exampleEn: No matter whether discussing political, religious, or social issues, one should not force one's own opinions onto others and insist they accept them.

explanation: 颐指动下巴示意，指挥别人；气使用神情气色支使人。不说话而用面部表示表情示意。形容有权势的人指挥别人的傲慢态度。
explanationTraditional: 頤指動下巴示意，指揮別人；氣使用神情氣色支使人。不說話而用面部表示表情示意。形容有權勢的人指揮別人的傲慢態度。
explanationEn: To order people about by facial expressions; describes the arrogant attitude of a powerful person commanding others without words.
derivation: 《汉书·贡禹传》家富势足，目指气使。”《资治通鉴·唐纪·昭宣帝天佑二年》见朝士，皆颐指气使，旁若无人。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·貢禹傳》家富勢足，目指氣使。”《資治通鑑·唐紀·昭宣帝天佑二年》見朝士，皆頤指氣使，旁若無人。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Gong Yu': 'Wealthy and powerful, they command by eye and breath.' And 'Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government: Tang Ji': 'When seeing court officials, they ordered them about by facial expressions, as if no one else was there.'
example: 他～，心狠手辣。★林平《从夏三虫说开去》
exampleTraditional: 他～，心狠手辣。★林平《從夏三蟲說開去》
exampleEn: He ordered people about by facial expressions and was ruthless. — Lin Ping, 'Starting from Three Summer Insects'

explanation: 陈陈旧，陈腐；滥浮泛不合实际。指陈腐、空泛的论调。
explanationTraditional: 陳陳舊，陳腐；濫浮泛不合實際。指陳腐、空泛的論調。
explanationEn: Stale and hackneyed phrases; clichés.
derivation: 闻一多《宫体诗的自赎》所以常常是那套褪色的陈词滥调，诗的本身并不能比题目给人以更深的印象。”
derivationTraditional: 聞一多《宮體詩的自贖》所以常常是那套褪色的陳詞濫調，詩的本身並不能比題目給人以更深的印象。”
derivationEn: From Wen Yiduo's 'The Redemption of Palace Poetry': 'So it's often that set of faded clichés; the poem itself cannot leave a deeper impression than the title.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 到处奔波。多指为生活所迫或为某一目的四处奔走活动。
explanationTraditional: 到處奔波。多指為生活所迫或為某一目的四處奔走活動。
explanationEn: To rush about; to be busy running around, often for a living or a goal.
derivation: 元·魏初《沁园春·留别张周卿韵》甚年来行役，交情契阔，东奔西走，水送山迎。”
derivationTraditional: 元·魏初《沁園春·留別張周卿韻》甚年來行役，交情契闊，東奔西走，水送山迎。”
derivationEn: From Wei Chu's poem 'Spring in the Garden: Farewell to Zhang Zhouqing' in Yuan Dynasty: 'In recent years, traveling on duty, friendship distant, rushing east and west, seeing mountains and rivers.'
example: 强如在中国～，受尽腌舎的气。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十回
exampleTraditional: 強如在中國～，受盡醃舎的氣。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十回
exampleEn: Better than rushing about in China, suffering all kinds of humiliation. — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 30

explanation: 一世一时。认为当代的人都不行。形容目空一切、狂妄自大到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 一世一時。認為當代的人都不行。形容目空一切、狂妄自大到了極點。
explanationEn: To consider oneself superior to everyone else; extremely arrogant and conceited.
derivation: 宋·罗大经《鹤林玉露补遗》卷十五荆公少年，不可一世。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·羅大經《鶴林玉露補遺》卷十五荊公少年，不可一世。”
derivationEn: From Luo Dajing's 'Crane Forest Jade Dew Supplement' in Song Dynasty: 'When young, Wang Anshi considered himself unmatched in his time.'
example: 盖兴会飙举，～矣。★柳亚子《燕子龛遗诗序》
exampleTraditional: 蓋興會飆舉，～矣。★柳亞子《燕子龕遺詩序》
exampleEn: His spirit soared, and he considered himself unmatched in his time. — Liu Yazi, 'Preface to Swallow Niche's Remaining Poems'

explanation: 穷困贫穷、困难；潦倒失意。生活贫困，失意颓丧。
explanationTraditional: 窮困貧窮、困難；潦倒失意。生活貧困，失意頹喪。
explanationEn: To be impoverished and frustrated; living in poverty and despair.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《登高》诗艰难苦恨繁霜鬓，潦倒新停浊酒杯。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《登高》詩艱難苦恨繁霜鬢，潦倒新停濁酒杯。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Climbing the Height' in Tang Dynasty: 'Hardships and bitter frost have left me with thick gray hair; frustrated, I have just stopped drinking from my cup.'
example: 破了房县，又有一些～而没有出路的读书人参加了他的义军。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十三章
exampleTraditional: 破了房縣，又有一些～而沒有出路的讀書人參加了他的義軍。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十三章
exampleEn: After capturing Fang County, some impoverished and frustrated intellectuals without a way out joined his rebel army. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 23

explanation: 神神妙；乎语助词，表感叹。神秘奇妙到了极点。形容非常奇妙神秘。
explanationTraditional: 神神妙；乎語助詞，表感嘆。神秘奇妙到了極點。形容非常奇妙神秘。
explanationEn: To be extremely mysterious and wonderful; to describe something as miraculous.
derivation: 《庄子·天地》深之又深而能物焉，神之又神而能精焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天地》深之又深而能物焉，神之又神而能精焉。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Heaven and Earth': 'Deep and deeper, yet it can produce things; divine and divine, yet it can produce essence.'
example: 向日闻得古人有袖占一课”之说，真是～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十五回
exampleTraditional: 向日聞得古人有袖佔一課”之說，真是～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十五回
exampleEn: I had heard that the ancients had the art of 'divining by sleeve', which was truly miraculous. — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 75

explanation: 抚拍，摸，引伸为注意，注视；追回想；昔过去。看看现在，想想过去。
explanationTraditional: 撫拍，摸，引伸為注意，注視；追回想；昔過去。看看現在，想想過去。
explanationEn: To reflect on the past in light of the present; to contemplate the present and recall the past.
derivation: 清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷五吾道洵堪千古，抚今追昔，能无黯然。”
derivationTraditional: 清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷五吾道洵堪千古，撫今追昔，能無黯然。”
derivationEn: From Ping Buqing's 'Miscellaneous Notes Outside the Rosy Clouds' in Qing Dynasty: 'Our way is truly eternal; reflecting on the present and recalling the past, how can one not feel desolate?'
example: ～，低徊不已，恭王不由得痛哭了一场。★高阳《慈禧前传》
exampleTraditional: ～，低徊不已，恭王不由得痛哭了一場。★高陽《慈禧前傳》
exampleEn: Reflecting on the present and recalling the past, he was filled with emotion, and Prince Gong could not help but weep bitterly. — Gao Yang, 'Before Empress Dowager Cixi'

explanation: 袖子长，有利于起舞。原指有所依靠，事情就容易成功◇形容有财势会耍手腕的人，善于钻营，会走门路。
explanationTraditional: 袖子長，有利於起舞。原指有所依靠，事情就容易成功◇形容有財勢會耍手腕的人，善於鑽營，會走門路。
explanationEn: Long sleeves help one dance well; originally meant that with resources, things are easier. Now describes a wealthy or powerful person who is good at socializing and currying favor.
derivation: 《韩非子·五蠹》长袖善舞，多钱善贾。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·五蠹》長袖善舞，多錢善賈。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: Five Vermin': 'Long sleeves help one dance well; much money helps one do business well.'
example: 李春山～，当时的一班名公巨卿，甚至连醇王都被他巴结上了。★高阳《清宫外史》上册
exampleTraditional: 李春山～，當時的一班名公巨卿，甚至連醇王都被他巴結上了。★高陽《清宮外史》上冊
exampleEn: Li Chunshan was skilled at currying favor; he managed to ingratiate himself with all the prominent officials of the time, even Prince Chun. — Gao Yang, 'History of the Qing Palace', Volume 1

explanation: 表外表；里内心。表面和内心象一个东西。形容言行和思想完全一致。
explanationTraditional: 表外表；裡內心。表面和內心象一個東西。形容言行和思想完全一致。
explanationEn: Being the same inside and outside; consistent in thought and action.
derivation: 南朝·梁·刘勰《文心雕龙·附会》首尾周密，表里一体。”《朱子全书·论语》行之以忠者，是事事要着实，故某集注云‘以忠，则表里如一。’”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·劉勰《文心雕龍·附會》首尾周密，表裡一體。”《朱子全書·論語》行之以忠者，是事事要著實，故某集註雲‘以忠，則表裡如一。’”
derivationEn: From Liu Xie's 'The Literary Mind and the Carving of Dragons' (Southern Dynasties) and 'Zhu Xi's Complete Works'.
example: 我言行一致，～。★郭沫若《屈原》第四幕
exampleTraditional: 我言行一致，～。★郭沫若《屈原》第四幕
exampleEn: I match my words with deeds, being consistent inside and out. — Guo Moruo, 'Qu Yuan', Act 4

explanation: 这一年吃了下一年的粮。比喻经济困难，收入不够支出，预先支用了以后的进项。比喻指经济困难，入不敷出。
explanationTraditional: 這一年吃了下一年的糧。比喻經濟困難，收入不夠支出，預先支用了以後的進項。比喻指經濟困難，入不敷出。
explanationEn: Eating next year's grain; living beyond one's means, spending future income in advance.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十五回就是我们总爷也是寅吃卯粮，先缺后空。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十五回就是我們總爺也是寅吃卯糧，先缺後空。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 15.
example: 自从有了孩子后，～，生活更加困难了。
exampleTraditional: 自從有了孩子後，～，生活更加困難了。
exampleEn: Since having children, we've been living beyond our means, and life has become even harder.

explanation: 腊月农历十二月。指冬季最寒冷的腊月天。
explanationTraditional: 臘月農曆十二月。指冬季最寒冷的臘月天。
explanationEn: The coldest month of winter; the depth of winter.
derivation: 汉·无名氏《别诗（骨肉缘枝叶）》征夫怀远路，游子恋故乡‘冬十二月，晨起践严霜。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·無名氏《別詩（骨肉緣枝葉）》征夫懷遠路，遊子戀故鄉‘冬十二月，晨起踐嚴霜。”
derivationEn: From an anonymous Han Dynasty poem 'Farewell Poem'.
example: ～大雪纷飞，漫山遍野一片白色。
exampleTraditional: ～大雪紛飛，漫山遍野一片白色。
exampleEn: In the depth of winter, heavy snow falls, covering the mountains and fields in white.

explanation: 按照惯例办理的公事。现在多指刻板的形式主义的工作。
explanationTraditional: 按照慣例辦理的公事。現在多指刻板的形式主義的工作。
explanationEn: Routine business; now often refers to formalistic work done perfunctorily.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《痛史》第十三回那一种凌虐苛刻，看的同例行公事一般，哪里还知道这是不应为而为之事。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《痛史》第十三回那一種凌虐苛刻，看的同例行公事一般，哪裡還知道這是不應為而為之事。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'History of Pain' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 13.
example: 回来等我把那些～办毕了，还有几句要紧的话同你商量呢。★清·王浚卿《冷眼观》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 回來等我把那些～辦畢了，還有幾句要緊的話同你商量呢。★清·王浚卿《冷眼觀》第十四回
exampleEn: Wait until I finish these routine tasks, then I have some important words to discuss with you. — Wang Junqing, 'Cold Eyes' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 14

explanation: 比喻追究底细。
explanationTraditional: 比喻追究底細。
explanationEn: Getting to the bottom of things; investigating thoroughly.
derivation: 老舍《老张的哲学》第三二一辆汽车碰在一株老树上，并没伤人……谁能刨根问底的要证据。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《老張的哲學》第三二一輛汽車碰在一株老樹上，並沒傷人……誰能刨根問底的要證據。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Philosophy of Old Zhang', Chapter 32.
example: 你～，是啥意思？你既不是治安组长，又不是民兵队长！★柳青《创业史》第一部第九章
exampleTraditional: 你～，是啥意思？你既不是治安組長，又不是民兵隊長！★柳青《創業史》第一部第九章
exampleEn: What do you mean by digging into the roots? You're neither the security chief nor the militia captain! — Liu Qing, 'The Builders', Part 1, Chapter 9

explanation: 因担心而手上出汗。形容非常紧张的心情。
explanationTraditional: 因擔心而手上出汗。形容非常緊張的心情。
explanationEn: Sweating with anxiety; being extremely nervous.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十二回赵姨娘正因彩云私赠了许多东西，被玉钏儿吵出，生恐查诘出来，每日捏一把汗打听信儿。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十二回趙姨娘正因彩雲私贈了許多東西，被玉釧兒吵出，生恐查詰出來，每日捏一把汗打聽信兒。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 62.
example: 我最初实在替这孩子～，待到掘出黄金一釜，这才觉得轻松。★鲁迅《朝花夕拾·二十四孝图》
exampleTraditional: 我最初實在替這孩子～，待到掘出黃金一釜，這才覺得輕鬆。★魯迅《朝花夕拾·二十四孝圖》
exampleEn: At first I was really sweating for the child; only when he dug up a pot of gold did I feel relieved. — Lu Xun, 'Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk: Twenty-Four Filial Exemplars'

explanation: 自己能从中得到乐趣。
explanationTraditional: 自己能從中得到樂趣。
explanationEn: Finding joy in one's own situation; being content with oneself.
derivation: 明·陶宗仪《辍耕录》卷二十白翎雀生于乌桓朔漠之地，雌雄和鸣，自得其乐。”
derivationTraditional: 明·陶宗儀《輟耕錄》卷二十白翎雀生於烏桓朔漠之地，雌雄和鳴，自得其樂。”
derivationEn: From Tao Zongyi's 'Records of Ceasing Plowing' (Ming Dynasty), Volume 20.
example: 老头儿有个老伴儿，带一个伙计，就这么活着，倒也～。★朱自清《杂文遗集·蒙自杂记》
exampleTraditional: 老頭兒有個老伴兒，帶一個夥計，就這麼活著，倒也～。★朱自清《雜文遺集·蒙自雜記》
exampleEn: The old man has a wife and a helper, and they live like this, quite content. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Miscellaneous Essays: Notes from Mengzi'

explanation: 躲避闪开，以免遇到某些情况。亦形容遮遮盖盖，支支吾吾，不坦率，不直爽。
explanationTraditional: 躲避閃開，以免遇到某些情況。亦形容遮遮蓋蓋，支支吾吾，不坦率，不直爽。
explanationEn: Dodging and evading; being evasive or secretive.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十九回三人于是躲躲闪闪，联步而行。一面走著，看那国人都是端方大雅；再看自己，只觉无穷丑态。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十九回三人於是躲躲閃閃，聯步而行。一面走著，看那國人都是端方大雅；再看自己，只覺無窮醜態。”
derivationEn: From Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 19.
example: 这一点事，也值得你～老半天总不肯说。★茅盾《霜叶红似二月花》六
exampleTraditional: 這一點事，也值得你～老半天總不肯說。★茅盾《霜葉紅似二月花》六
exampleEn: Such a small matter, yet you've been evasive for so long without telling me. — Mao Dun, 'Red Leaves Like February Flowers', Chapter 6

explanation: 六神道家认为人的心、肺、肝、肾、脾、胆各有神灵主宰，称为六神。形容惊慌着急，没了主意，不知如何才好。
explanationTraditional: 六神道家認為人的心、肺、肝、腎、脾、膽各有神靈主宰，稱為六神。形容驚慌著急，沒了主意，不知如何才好。
explanationEn: All six vital organs losing their master; extremely flustered and at a loss.
derivation: 汉·张衡《髑髅赋》五内皆还，六神皆复。” 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二十九吓得知县已是六神无主，不有甚心肠去吃酒。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·張衡《髑髏賦》五內皆還，六神皆復。” 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二十九嚇得知縣已是六神無主，不有甚心腸去吃酒。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Heng's 'Rhapsody on a Skull' (Han Dynasty) and Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' (Ming Dynasty).
example: 那里我这个人～，失张失智的。★朱自清《笑的历史·笑的历史》
exampleTraditional: 那裡我這個人～，失張失智的。★朱自清《笑的歷史·笑的歷史》
exampleEn: At that time I was completely at a loss, disoriented and confused. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Laughter's History: The History of Laughter'

explanation: 一夜分为五更，三更是午夜十二时。指深夜。
explanationTraditional: 一夜分為五更，三更是午夜十二時。指深夜。
explanationEn: In the dead of night; midnight.
derivation: 元·马致远《青衫泪》第三折这船上是什么人，半夜三更，大呼小叫的。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《青衫淚》第三折這船上是什麼人，半夜三更，大呼小叫的。”
derivationEn: From Ma Zhiyuan's 'Tears on the Blue Shirt' (Yuan Dynasty), Act 3.
example: 他常常工作到～。
exampleTraditional: 他常常工作到～。
exampleEn: He often works until the dead of night.

explanation: 勃然突然。突然变脸大发脾气。
explanationTraditional: 勃然突然。突然變臉大發脾氣。
explanationEn: To suddenly become very angry; to fly into a rage.
derivation: 汉·班固《汉书·谷永传》是故皇天勃然发怒，甲乙之间，暴风三溱拔树折木。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·班固《漢書·谷永傳》是故皇天勃然發怒，甲乙之間，暴風三溱拔樹折木。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty Ban Gu's 'Book of Han: Biography of Gu Yong': 'Therefore the great heaven suddenly became angry, and between the hours of jia and yi, a violent wind uprooted trees and broke branches.'
example: 周瑜听罢，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 周瑜聽罷，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十四回
exampleEn: Zhou Yu heard this and flew into a rage. — Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 44

explanation: 冷眼冷静或冷漠的眼光。指不参与其事，站在一旁看事情的发展。
explanationTraditional: 冷眼冷靜或冷漠的眼光。指不參與其事，站在一旁看事情的發展。
explanationEn: To look on coldly; to stand by and watch without getting involved.
derivation: 唐·徐夤《上卢三拾遗以言见黜》冷眼静看真好笑，倾怀与说却为冤。”宋·朱熹《答黄直卿》故其后复申炎所陈，荐举之说，乃是首尾专为王地，冷眼旁观，手足俱露，甚可笑也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·徐夤《上盧三拾遺以言見黜》冷眼靜看真好笑，傾懷與說卻為冤。”宋·朱熹《答黃直卿》故其後復申炎所陳，薦舉之說，乃是首尾專為王地，冷眼旁觀，手足俱露，甚可笑也。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty Xu Yin's 'Presented to Lu San Shiyi Who Was Dismissed for Remonstrance': 'Looking on coldly and quietly, it's truly laughable; pouring out my heart to you, it's unjust.' Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's 'Reply to Huang Zhiqing': 'Therefore, later he reiterated Chen's statement, recommending that the whole matter be solely for the king's benefit. Looking on coldly, his hands and feet were exposed, which was very ridiculous.'
example: 诗云一局输赢料不真，香销茶尽尚逡巡。欲知目下兴衰兆，顺问傍观冷眼人。”★《脂砚斋评红楼梦》第二回
exampleTraditional: 詩云一局輸贏料不真，香銷茶盡尚逡巡。欲知目下興衰兆，順問傍觀冷眼人。”★《脂硯齋評紅樓夢》第二回
exampleEn: The poem says: 'The outcome of a game is hard to predict; after incense is spent and tea finished, one still lingers. To know the signs of rise and fall, ask the cold-eyed bystander.' — 'Zhiyanzhai's Commentary on Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 2

explanation: 声势力量大。
explanationTraditional: 聲勢力量大。
explanationEn: Many people provide strength and power; to have numerical superiority.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十回话说金荣困人多势众，又兼贾瑞勒令赔了不是，给秦钟磕了头，宝玉方才不吵闹了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十回話說金榮困人多勢眾，又兼賈瑞勒令賠了不是，給秦鍾磕了頭，寶玉方才不吵鬧了。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 10: 'It is said that Jin Rong, relying on his numerical superiority and with Jia Rui forcing him to apologize, kowtowed to Qin Zhong, and only then did Baoyu stop making a fuss.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 先张扬自己的声势以压倒对方。也比喻做事抢先一步。
explanationTraditional: 先張揚自己的聲勢以壓倒對方。也比喻做事搶先一步。
explanationEn: To gain the upper hand by a show of strength; to steal a march on others.
derivation: 《左传·宣公十二年》军志曰‘先人有夺人之心，’薄之也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公十二年》軍志曰‘先人有奪人之心，’薄之也。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: The Twelfth Year of Duke Xuan': 'The military records say: 'To take the initiative is to seize the enemy's spirit,' meaning to attack them.'
example: 他深深懂得～的道理，就预先做了广告，因此货销售得很快。
exampleTraditional: 他深深懂得～的道理，就預先做了廣告，因此貨銷售得很快。
exampleEn: He deeply understood the principle of gaining the upper hand by a show of strength, so he advertised in advance, and the goods sold quickly.

explanation: 跟天和地存在的时间那样长。形容时间悠久。也形容永远不变（多指爱情）。
explanationTraditional: 跟天和地存在的時間那樣長。形容時間悠久。也形容永遠不變（多指愛情）。
explanationEn: As long as heaven and earth endure; everlasting and unchanging (often of love).
derivation: 《老子》第七章天长地久，天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。”唐·白居易《长恨歌》天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第七章天長地久，天地所以能長且久者，以其不自生，故能長生。”唐·白居易《長恨歌》天長地久有時盡，此恨綿綿無絕期。”
derivationEn: 'Laozi', Chapter 7: 'Heaven and earth are long-lasting. The reason heaven and earth can be long and lasting is that they do not live for themselves, thus they can live long.' Tang Dynasty Bai Juyi's 'Song of Everlasting Regret': 'Heaven and earth may last long, but someday they will end; this regret will last forever, without end.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指臣子先把人处决了，然后再报告帝王。现比喻未经请示就先做了某事，造成既成事实，然后再向上级报告。
explanationTraditional: 原指臣子先把人處決了，然後再報告帝王。現比喻未經請示就先做了某事，造成既成事實，然後再向上級報告。
explanationEn: To execute first and report afterwards; to act first and report later (often of taking decisive action without prior approval).
derivation: 《汉书·申屠嘉传》吾悔不先斩错乃请之。”颜师古注言先斩而后奏。”《新五代史·梁臣传·朱珍》珍偏将张仁遇珍曰‘ 军中有犯令者，请先斩而后白。’”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·申屠嘉傳》吾悔不先斬錯乃請之。”顏師古注言先斬而後奏。”《新五代史·梁臣傳·朱珍》珍偏將張仁遇珍曰‘ 軍中有犯令者，請先斬而後白。’”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Shen Tu Jia': 'I regret not having executed Chao Cuo first and then reported it.' Yan Shigu's commentary: 'Meaning to execute first and then report.' 'New History of the Five Dynasties: Biography of Zhu Zhen': 'Zhen's subordinate Zhang Ren said to Zhen: 'If anyone in the army violates orders, please allow me to execute first and then report.''
example: 圣人命俺巡抚江南，敕赐势剑金牌，体察奸蠹，理枉分冤，～。★元·无名氏《冯玉兰》第三折
exampleTraditional: 聖人命俺巡撫江南，敕賜勢劍金牌，體察奸蠹，理枉分冤，～。★元·無名氏《馮玉蘭》第三折
exampleEn: The sage ordered me to patrol Jiangnan, granting me the imperial sword and gold medal to investigate corruption, redress grievances, and execute first and report later. — Yuan Dynasty Anonymous 'Feng Yulan', Third Act

explanation: 力竭力；排排队；议议论、意见。竭力排除各种意议论，使自己的意见占上风。
explanationTraditional: 力竭力；排排隊；議議論、意見。竭力排除各種意議論，使自己的意見佔上風。
explanationEn: To refute all arguments; to prevail over all dissenting opinions.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十三回诸葛亮舌战群儒，鲁子敬力排众议。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十三回諸葛亮舌戰群儒，魯子敬力排眾議。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 43: 'Zhuge Liang debated with the scholars, and Lu Zijing refuted all dissenting opinions.'
example: 他在这次会议上～，终于使自己的观点得到了与会代表的支持。
exampleTraditional: 他在這次會議上～，終於使自己的觀點得到了與會代表的支持。
exampleEn: At this meeting, he refuted all dissenting opinions and finally gained support for his viewpoint from the representatives.

explanation: 穷途处境困窘。形容到了无路可走的地步。
explanationTraditional: 窮途處境困窘。形容到了無路可走的地步。
explanationEn: To be at the end of one's rope; to be in a desperate situation with no way out.
derivation: 《吴越春秋·王僚伎公子光传》子胥曰‘夫人赈穷途，少饭亦何嫌哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《吳越春秋·王僚伎公子光傳》子胥曰‘夫人賑窮途，少飯亦何嫌哉？”
derivationEn: 'Wu Yue Chun Qiu: Biography of Prince Guang of Liao': 'Zixu said: 'A lady helps those in desperate straits; even a little food is not to be refused.''
example: 你如今是～，举目无依。（清·文康《儿女英雄传》第五回）
exampleTraditional: 你如今是～，舉目無依。（清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第五回）
exampleEn: You are now at the end of your rope, with no one to turn to. — Qing Dynasty Wenkang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 5

explanation: 机机会；时时机∶的时机不可放过，失掉了不会再来。
explanationTraditional: 機機會；時時機∶的時機不可放過，失掉了不會再來。
explanationEn: Opportunity must not be missed; it may not come again.
derivation: 五代·安重荣《上石敬瑭表》须知机不可失，时不再来。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·安重榮《上石敬瑭表》須知機不可失，時不再來。”
derivationEn: Five Dynasties An Zhongrong's 'Memorial to Shi Jingtang': 'One must know that opportunity must not be missed, and time will not come again.'
example: ～，这正是革命力量重新振兴之时。★耿可员《孙中山与宋庆龄》第五场
exampleTraditional: ～，這正是革命力量重新振興之時。★耿可員《孫中山與宋慶齡》第五場
exampleEn: Opportunity must not be missed; this is precisely the time for the revolutionary forces to revive. — Geng Keyuan's 'Sun Yat-sen and Song Qingling', Scene 5

explanation: 由听从，随顺。听任事态自然发展变化，不做主观努力。也比喻碰机会，该怎么样就怎么样。
explanationTraditional: 由聽從，隨順。聽任事態自然發展變化，不做主觀努力。也比喻碰機會，該怎麼樣就怎麼樣。
explanationEn: To resign oneself to fate; to let things take their natural course without making any effort.
derivation: 清·刘鹗《老残游记续集》第二回死活存亡，听天由命去罢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉鶚《老殘遊記續集》第二回死活存亡，聽天由命去罷。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Sequel, Chapter 2: 'Life and death, survival or ruin, let fate decide.'
example: 我们应当与命运抗争，而不应～地生活。
exampleTraditional: 我們應當與命運抗爭，而不應～地生活。
exampleEn: We should struggle against fate, not live resigned to it.

explanation: 戒警惕，预防。警惕并防止产生骄傲和急躁情绪。
explanationTraditional: 戒警惕，預防。警惕並防止產生驕傲和急躁情緒。
explanationEn: To guard against arrogance and impatience; to remain humble and calm.
derivation: 毛泽东《在中国共产党全国代表会议上的讲话》戒骄戒躁，永远保持谦虚进取的精神。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《在中國共產黨全國代表會議上的講話》戒驕戒躁，永遠保持謙虛進取的精神。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's speech at the National Conference of the Communist Party of China: 'Guard against arrogance and impatience, and forever maintain a spirit of humility and enterprise.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 得了一寸，还想再进一尺。比喻贪心不足，有了小的，又要大的。
explanationTraditional: 得了一寸，還想再進一尺。比喻貪心不足，有了小的，又要大的。
explanationEn: To gain an inch and want a foot further; insatiable greed, wanting more after getting a little.
derivation: 《老子·道德经》不敢进寸而退尺。”《战国策·秦策三》王不如远交而近攻，得寸则王之寸， 得尺亦王之尺也。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子·道德經》不敢進寸而退尺。”《戰國策·秦策三》王不如遠交而近攻，得寸則王之寸， 得尺亦王之尺也。”
derivationEn: Laozi's Tao Te Ching: 'Dare not advance an inch but retreat a foot.' Strategies of the Warring States: 'The king should befriend distant states while attacking nearby ones; gain an inch and it is the king's inch, gain a foot and it is the king's foot.'
example: 法国～，五年以后吞并了整个南圻，而心犹未足，还打算攘夺北圻，仅留下中圻给越南。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 法國～，五年以後吞併了整個南圻，而心猶未足，還打算攘奪北圻，僅留下中圻給越南。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: France, gaining an inch and wanting a foot, swallowed up the whole of Cochinchina within five years, yet still unsatisfied, planned to seize Tonkin, leaving only Annam to Vietnam. — Gao Yang, The Qing Palace History, Volume 2

explanation: 把山上的草木都当做敌兵。形容人在惊慌时疑神疑鬼。
explanationTraditional: 把山上的草木都當做敵兵。形容人在驚慌時疑神疑鬼。
explanationEn: To see every bush and tree as an enemy soldier; to be extremely paranoid and suspicious in a state of panic.
derivation: 《晋书·苻坚载记》坚与苻融登城而望王师，见部阵齐整，将士精锐；又北望八公山上草森皆类人形，顾谓融曰‘此亦劲敌也，何谓少乎？’怃然有惧色。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·苻堅載記》堅與苻融登城而望王師，見部陣齊整，將士精銳；又北望八公山上草森皆類人形，顧謂融曰‘此亦勁敵也，何謂少乎？’憮然有懼色。”
derivationEn: Book of Jin, Biography of Fu Jian: 'Fu Jian and Fu Rong ascended the city wall to view the imperial army, seeing their formations orderly and soldiers elite; looking north at Mount Bagong, every grass and tree seemed like human forms. He turned to Fu Rong and said, 'These are formidable enemies too! How can we say they are few?' He looked dismayed and fearful.'
example: 这一天大家都是惊疑不定，～，迨及到了晚上，仍然毫无动静。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 這一天大家都是驚疑不定，～，迨及到了晚上，仍然毫無動靜。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第五十九回
exampleEn: That day everyone was alarmed and suspicious, seeing every bush and tree as an enemy; by nightfall, still no movement. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years, Chapter 59

explanation: 指子女对父母身前的赡养和死后的殡葬。
explanationTraditional: 指子女對父母身前的贍養和死後的殯葬。
explanationEn: To support one's parents in their old age and arrange their funeral after death; filial duty of children.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十七回生了奴奴，欲扳门第，配嫁他人，又恐老来无倚，只得将奴招了一个女婿，养老送终。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十七回生了奴奴，欲扳門第，配嫁他人，又恐老來無倚，只得將奴招了一個女婿，養老送終。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, Journey to the West, Chapter 27: 'She gave birth to me, wanting to marry me off to a good family, but fearing no support in old age, she took in a son-in-law to support her and arrange her funeral.'
example: 凤娇道‘我母年老，要你～。’马迪道‘你嫁了我，那养老送终之事，何须说得。’★清·如莲居士《薛刚反唐》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 鳳嬌道‘我母年老，要你～。’馬迪道‘你嫁了我，那養老送終之事，何須說得。’★清·如蓮居士《薛剛反唐》第四十四回
exampleEn: Fengjiao said, 'My mother is old, and you must support her and arrange her funeral.' Ma Di replied, 'If you marry me, the matter of supporting and burying her goes without saying.' — Qing Dynasty, Ru Lian Jushi, Xue Gang Rebels Against Tang, Chapter 44

explanation: 所有的人都说同样的话。
explanationTraditional: 所有的人都說同樣的話。
explanationEn: All people say the same thing; unanimous opinion.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《论议濮安懿王典礼札子》众口一辞（词），纷然不正。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《論議濮安懿王典禮札子》眾口一辭（詞），紛然不正。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Ouyang Xiu, Memorial on Discussing the Ritual for Prince Pu'an: 'All mouths speak with one voice (ci), in disorder and disagreement.'
example: 适才仇老所言姻事，～，此美事也，有何不可？★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十四
exampleTraditional: 適才仇老所言姻事，～，此美事也，有何不可？★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十四
exampleEn: Just now, the matter of marriage mentioned by old man Qiu is unanimously agreed upon; it is a good thing, why not? — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 24

explanation: 用较长的时间慎重考虑、仔细商量。
explanationTraditional: 用較長的時間慎重考慮、仔細商量。
explanationEn: To take time to consider carefully and discuss thoroughly; to deliberate at length.
derivation: 《左传·僖公四年》筮短龟长，不如从长。”元·李行道《灰阑记》楔子且待女孩儿到来，慢慢的与他从长计议，有何不可。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公四年》筮短龜長，不如從長。”元·李行道《灰闌記》楔子且待女孩兒到來，慢慢的與他從長計議，有何不可。”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan, Duke Xi's Fourth Year: 'The milfoil is short, the tortoise long; better to follow the long.' Yuan Dynasty, Li Xingdao, The Chalk Circle, Prologue: 'Wait until the daughter arrives, then slowly discuss with her at length; why not?'
example: 少奶奶到了此时，真是无可如何，只得说道公公婆婆，且先请起，凡事都可以～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第八十九回
exampleTraditional: 少奶奶到了此時，真是無可如何，只得說道公公婆婆，且先請起，凡事都可以～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第八十九回
exampleEn: The young mistress, at a loss, could only say, 'Father-in-law and mother-in-law, please rise first; everything can be discussed at length.' — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years, Chapter 89

explanation: 指自己认为非常满意的作品。
explanationTraditional: 指自己認為非常滿意的作品。
explanationEn: A work that one is very satisfied with; one's masterpiece or proudest creation.
derivation: 曹靖华《哪有闲情话年月》作者仿佛要为我开小型展览会似的，把自己的得意之作都陈列在我面前了。”
derivationTraditional: 曹靖華《哪有閒情話年月》作者彷彿要為我開小型展覽會似的，把自己的得意之作都陳列在我面前了。”
derivationEn: Cao Jinghua, No Leisure to Talk About the Past: 'The author seemed to want to hold a small exhibition for me, displaying all his proud works before me.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 说怎么样就怎么样。形容说话算数。
explanationTraditional: 說怎麼樣就怎麼樣。形容說話算數。
explanationEn: To mean what one says; to be as good as one's word; to be decisive and unchanging.
derivation: 清·张春帆《宦海》第四回这个时候的邵孝廉，就是个小小的制台一般，说一是一，说二是二，庄制军没有一回驳过他的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張春帆《宦海》第四回這個時候的邵孝廉，就是個小小的制臺一般，說一是一，說二是二，莊制軍沒有一回駁過他的。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Zhang Chunfan, The Official World, Chapter 4: 'At this time, Scholar Shao was like a minor governor-general; what he said was one, and what he said was two; Governor Zhuang never contradicted him.'
example: 穷苦人们起来，在村里～！★梁斌《红旗谱》十八
exampleTraditional: 窮苦人們起來，在村裡～！★梁斌《紅旗譜》十八
exampleEn: The poor rose up and were decisive in the village! — Liang Bin, Keep the Red Flag Flying, Chapter 18

explanation: 回天比喻力量大，能移转极难挽回的时势；乏术缺少方法。比喻局势或病情严重，已无法挽救。
explanationTraditional: 迴天比喻力量大，能移轉極難挽回的時勢；乏術缺少方法。比喻局勢或病情嚴重，已無法挽救。
explanationEn: To lack the means to reverse a critical situation; to be unable to save a desperate situation or a dying person.
derivation: 清·冯起凤《昔柳摭谈·秋风自悼》后探得的耗，万箭攒心，脏腑欲裂。但木已成舟，回天乏术。”
derivationTraditional: 清·馮起鳳《昔柳摭談·秋風自悼》後探得的耗，萬箭攢心，臟腑欲裂。但木已成舟，回天乏術。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Feng Qifeng, Reminiscences of the Past, Autumn Wind's Self-Lament: 'Later, when he learned the bad news, his heart was pierced with arrows, and his organs seemed to crack. But the wood had already become a boat, and there was no way to reverse the situation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 头发昏，眼发花。
explanationTraditional: 頭髮昏，眼發花。
explanationEn: To feel dizzy and have blurred vision; lightheaded and seeing stars.
derivation: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第八十七回方才外边的人，也都有些头晕眼花，闻了这香气，就清爽了许多。”
derivationTraditional: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第八十七回方才外邊的人，也都有些頭暈眼花，聞了這香氣，就清爽了許多。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Xia Jingqu, A Rustic's Idle Talk, Chapter 87: 'The people outside had also felt dizzy and blurred in vision, but after smelling this fragrance, they became much clearer.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 博丰富。指国家疆土辽阔，资源丰富。
explanationTraditional: 博豐富。指國家疆土遼闊，資源豐富。
explanationEn: Vast territory and abundant resources.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《平淮西碑》地大物博，蘖牙其间。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《平淮西碑》地大物博，櫱牙其間。”
derivationEn: Han Yu's 'Stele for Pacifying Huai Xi' in Tang Dynasty: 'Vast territory and abundant resources, with sprouts in between.'
example: 又因江南～，差使很多，大非别省可比。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十九回
exampleTraditional: 又因江南～，差使很多，大非別省可比。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十九回
exampleEn: Moreover, because Jiangnan has vast territory and abundant resources, there are many official positions, quite unlike other provinces. (Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 29)

explanation: 终人死；远指祖先。旧指慎重地办理父母丧事，虔诚地祭祀远代祖先◇也指谨慎从事，追念前贤。
explanationTraditional: 終人死；遠指祖先。舊指慎重地辦理父母喪事，虔誠地祭祀遠代祖先◇也指謹慎從事，追念前賢。
explanationEn: Carefully attend to parents' funerals and reverently honor distant ancestors; also means to act cautiously and remember past sages.
derivation: 《论语学而》曾子曰‘慎终追远，民德归厚矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語學而》曾子曰‘慎終追遠，民德歸厚矣。’”
derivationEn: The Analects of Confucius, Xue Er: 'Zengzi said, 'Carefully attend to the funeral of parents and reverently honor distant ancestors, then the people's virtue will return to honesty.''
example: 五间正殿前，悬一块闹龙填青匾，写道是～”。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十三回
exampleTraditional: 五間正殿前，懸一塊鬧龍填青匾，寫道是～”。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十三回
exampleEn: In front of the five main halls hung a plaque with dragons and blue background, inscribed with 'Carefully attend to funerals and honor ancestors.' (Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 53)

explanation: 功德功业和德行；无量无法计算。旧时指功劳恩德非常大。现多用来称赞做了好事。
explanationTraditional: 功德功業和德行；無量無法計算。舊時指功勞恩德非常大。現多用來稱讚做了好事。
explanationEn: Boundless merit and virtue; used to praise great kindness or good deeds.
derivation: 《汉书·丙吉传》所以拥全神灵，成育圣躬，功德已无量矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·丙吉傳》所以擁全神靈，成育聖躬，功德已無量矣。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han, Biography of Bing Ji': 'Thus protecting the spirit, nurturing the holy body, the merit is already boundless.'
example: 现在先生既然得到原文，我的希望是给他们彻底的修改一下，虽然牺牲太大，然而～。★《鲁迅书信集·致孟十还》
exampleTraditional: 現在先生既然得到原文，我的希望是給他們徹底的修改一下，雖然犧牲太大，然而～。★《魯迅書信集·致孟十還》
exampleEn: Now that you have obtained the original text, I hope to thoroughly revise it. Although the sacrifice is great, the merit will be boundless. (Lu Xun, 'Letters to Meng Shihuan')

explanation: 掬双手捧取。形容笑容满面。
explanationTraditional: 掬雙手捧取。形容笑容滿面。
explanationEn: Beaming with smiles; smiling broadly.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十五回果见孔明坐于城楼之上，笑容可掬，焚香操琴。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十五回果見孔明坐於城樓之上，笑容可掬，焚香操琴。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 95: 'Indeed, they saw Kongming sitting on the city tower, beaming with smiles, burning incense and playing the qin.'
example: 这些学生们一天总是那么活泼开朗，～。
exampleTraditional: 這些學生們一天總是那麼活潑開朗，～。
exampleEn: These students are always so lively and cheerful, beaming with smiles.

explanation: 虚无空虚；缥缈隐隐约约，若有若无的样子。形容空虚渺茫。
explanationTraditional: 虛無空虛；縹緲隱隱約約，若有若無的樣子。形容空虛渺茫。
explanationEn: Vague and illusory; ethereal and unreal.
derivation: 唐·白居易《长恨歌》忽闻海上有仙山，山在虚无缥缈间。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《長恨歌》忽聞海上有仙山，山在虛無縹緲間。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Bai Juyi, 'Song of Everlasting Sorrow': 'Suddenly heard of a fairy mountain on the sea, located in the vague and ethereal realm.'
example: 这都是～的事，那里有甚么神仙鬼怪！我却向来不信这个。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 這都是～的事，那裡有甚麼神仙鬼怪！我卻向來不信這個。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第二十五回
exampleEn: These are all illusory things; how could there be any immortals or ghosts! I have never believed in them. (Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Situations Observed in Twenty Years', Chapter 25)

explanation: 指官员之间互相包庇。
explanationTraditional: 指官員之間互相包庇。
explanationEn: Officials shield one another; bureaucratic collusion.
derivation: 元·无名氏《鸳鸯被》第四折好也，你两个官官相为我死也！”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《鴛鴦被》第四摺好也，你兩個官官相為我死也！”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Mandarin Duck Quilt', Act 4: 'Good, you two officials shield each other, I am dead!'
example: 你想，抚台一定发回原官审问，纵然派个委员前来会审，～，他又拿着人家的失单衣服来顶我们。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第五回
exampleTraditional: 你想，撫臺一定發回原官審問，縱然派個委員前來會審，～，他又拿著人家的失單衣服來頂我們。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第五回
exampleEn: You think, the governor will surely send the case back to the original official for trial. Even if a commissioner is sent to co-try, officials shield each other, and they will use the stolen clothes to frame us. (Qing Dynasty, Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 5)

explanation: 原形容身体各部位匀称、结实◇常形容说话做事稳当。也形容做事只求不出差错，缺乏积极创新精神。
explanationTraditional: 原形容身體各部位勻稱、結實◇常形容說話做事穩當。也形容做事只求不出差錯，缺乏積極創新精神。
explanationEn: Originally described a well-proportioned and sturdy body; now often means steady and reliable in speech or action, or overly cautious lacking innovation.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十四回戴宗、杨林看裴宣时，果然好表人物，生得面白肥胖，四平八稳，心中暗喜。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十四回戴宗、楊林看裴宣時，果然好表人物，生得面白肥胖，四平八穩，心中暗喜。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 44: 'Dai Zong and Yang Lin looked at Pei Xuan and saw he was indeed a fine figure, with a fair and plump face, steady and reliable, and they were secretly pleased.'
example: 总而言之，现在倘再发那些～的救救孩子”似的议论，连我自己听去，也觉得空空洞洞了。★鲁迅《而已集·答有恒先生》
exampleTraditional: 總而言之，現在倘再發那些～的救救孩子”似的議論，連我自己聽去，也覺得空空洞洞了。★魯迅《而已集·答有恆先生》
exampleEn: In short, if I now issue those steady and reliable 'save the children' remarks, even I find them hollow. (Lu Xun, 'And Set, Reply to Mr. Youheng')

explanation: 轻易地了结纠纷，心甘情愿地停止再闹。
explanationTraditional: 輕易地了結糾紛，心甘情願地停止再鬧。
explanationEn: To let the matter rest; to give up easily.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》奶奶就是让着他，他见奶奶比他标致，又比他得人心儿，他就善罢甘休了？”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》奶奶就是讓著他，他見奶奶比他標緻，又比他得人心兒，他就善罷甘休了？”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber': 'Even if you give in to her, when she sees that you are more beautiful and more popular than her, will she let it rest?'
example: 不去呢，她必不会～；去呢，她也不会绕了他。★老舍《骆驼祥子》
exampleTraditional: 不去呢，她必不會～；去呢，她也不會繞了他。★老舍《駱駝祥子》
exampleEn: If he doesn't go, she will certainly not let it rest; if he goes, she won't let him off either. (Lao She, 'Rickshaw Boy')

explanation: 从出生到现在。
explanationTraditional: 從出生到現在。
explanationEn: Since birth; in one's whole life.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百十八回况你自有生以来，自去世的老太太，以至老爷、太太，视如珍宝。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百十八回況你自有生以來，自去世的老太太，以至老爺、太太，視如珍寶。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 118: 'Moreover, since your birth, from the deceased old lady to the master and mistress, you have been treasured like a jewel.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 开拓疆域，扩展领土。
explanationTraditional: 開拓疆域，擴展領土。
explanationEn: To expand territory; to extend borders.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 蝉变为成虫时要脱去一层壳。比喻用计脱身，使人不能及时发觉。
explanationTraditional: 蟬變為成蟲時要脫去一層殼。比喻用計脫身，使人不能及時發覺。
explanationEn: A cicada sheds its shell when becoming an adult. Metaphorically, it means to escape by using a trick, so that others cannot detect it in time.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《谢天香》第二折”便使尽些伎俩，千愁断我肚肠，觅不的个金蝉脱壳这一个谎。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《謝天香》第二折”便使盡些伎倆，千愁斷我肚腸，覓不的個金蟬脫殼這一個謊。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'Xie Tianxiang' (Yuan Dynasty): 'Even if I use all my tricks, my heart is broken with sorrow, I cannot find a cicada shedding its shell as a lie.'
example: 如今便赶着躲了，料也躲不及，少不得要使个～”的法子。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 如今便趕著躲了，料也躲不及，少不得要使個～”的法子。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十七回
exampleEn: Now if I try to hide, it's too late; I have to use the trick of 'the cicada shedding its shell.' — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 27

explanation: 说大话，不感到难为情。
explanationTraditional: 說大話，不感到難為情。
explanationEn: To boast without feeling ashamed.
derivation: 《论语·宪问》子曰‘其言之不怍，则为之也难。’”宋·朱熹注大言不惭，则无必为之志，而不自度其能否也。欲践其言，其不难哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·憲問》子曰‘其言之不怍，則為之也難。’”宋·朱熹注大言不慚，則無必為之志，而不自度其能否也。欲踐其言，其不難哉！”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius': The Master said, 'If a person speaks without shame, it is difficult for them to act.' Zhu Xi's commentary: 'To boast without shame means one lacks the will to act and does not measure their ability.'
example: 严知孝听他这个得意的学生～的说着，脸上的愁闷就散开了。★梁斌《红旗谱》四二
exampleTraditional: 嚴知孝聽他這個得意的學生～的說著，臉上的愁悶就散開了。★梁斌《紅旗譜》四二
exampleEn: Yan Zhixiao listened to his proud student boasting without shame, and the worry on his face dissipated. — Liang Bin, 'Red Flag Chronicle', Chapter 42

explanation: 形容身体衰弱无气力。也可比喻处事不得力，不中用。
explanationTraditional: 形容身體衰弱無氣力。也可比喻處事不得力，不中用。
explanationEn: Describes a body that is weak and without strength. Also metaphorically refers to being ineffective or useless in handling matters.
derivation: 巴金《我的故事》你看我是一个多么软弱无力的人。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《我的故事》你看我是一個多麼軟弱無力的人。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin's 'My Story': 'You see what a weak and powerless person I am.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 山和水都到了尽头。比喻无路可走陷入绝境。
explanationTraditional: 山和水都到了盡頭。比喻無路可走陷入絕境。
explanationEn: When mountains and waters come to an end. Metaphorically, it means being in a desperate situation with no way out.
derivation: 宋·陆游《游山西村》诗山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《遊山西村》詩山重水複疑無路，柳暗花明又一村。”
derivationEn: From Lu You's poem 'Visit to Shanxi Village' (Song Dynasty): 'After endless mountains and rivers, I doubt there is a path; in the shade of willows, bright flowers, another village appears.'
example: 你们已经到了～的地步。★毛泽东《敦促杜聿明等投降书》
exampleTraditional: 你們已經到了～的地步。★毛澤東《敦促杜聿明等投降書》
exampleEn: You have reached the point of 'mountains and rivers ending.' — Mao Zedong, 'Urge Du Yuming to Surrender'

explanation: 天真指心地单纯，没有做作和虚伪；烂漫坦率自然的样子。形容儿童思想单纯、活泼可爱，没有做作和虚伪。
explanationTraditional: 天真指心地單純，沒有做作和虛偽；爛漫坦率自然的樣子。形容兒童思想單純、活潑可愛，沒有做作和虛偽。
explanationEn: Tianzhen means innocent and unaffected; Lanman means natural and frank. Describes children as simple, lively, cute, and without pretense or hypocrisy.
derivation: 宋·龚开《高马小儿图》此儿此马俱可怜，马方三齿儿未冠。天真烂漫好容仪，楚楚衣裳无不宜。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·龔開《高馬小兒圖》此兒此馬俱可憐，馬方三齒兒未冠。天真爛漫好容儀，楚楚衣裳無不宜。”
derivationEn: From Gong Kai's poem 'Picture of a Tall Horse and a Child' (Song Dynasty): 'This child and this horse are both pitiable; the horse is three years old, the child not yet capped. Innocent and natural, with fine appearance and proper clothes.'
example: 他的性情又是那样～，笃实敦厚。★邹韬奋《经历·难兄难弟”的又一个》
exampleTraditional: 他的性情又是那樣～，篤實敦厚。★鄒韜奮《經歷·難兄難弟”的又一個》
exampleEn: His disposition was so innocent and natural, honest and sincere. — Zou Taofen, 'Experience: Another of the 'Troubled Brothers'

explanation: 足够。穿的吃的都很丰富充足。形容生活富裕。
explanationTraditional: 足夠。穿的吃的都很豐富充足。形容生活富裕。
explanationEn: Zu means sufficient. Having ample clothing and food. Describes a life of abundance.
derivation: 五代·王定保《唐摭言》卷十五堂头官人，丰衣足食，所住无不克。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·王定保《唐摭言》卷十五堂頭官人，豐衣足食，所住無不克。”
derivationEn: From Wang Dingbao's 'Tang Zhiyan' (Five Dynasties): 'The hall officer, with ample clothing and food, lacks nothing in his dwelling.'
example: 我们用自己动手的方法，达到了～的目的。★《毛泽东选集·组织起来》
exampleTraditional: 我們用自己動手的方法，達到了～的目的。★《毛澤東選集·組織起來》
exampleEn: By our own efforts, we have achieved the goal of 'ample clothing and sufficient food.' — Mao Zedong, 'Selected Works: Organize Ourselves'

explanation: 人烟指住户、居民，因有炊烟的地方就有人居住。形容地方偏僻荒凉，见不到人家。
explanationTraditional: 人煙指住戶、居民，因有炊煙的地方就有人居住。形容地方偏僻荒涼，見不到人家。
explanationEn: Renyan refers to households and residents, as smoke from cooking indicates habitation. Describes a remote and desolate place with no sign of human life.
derivation: 穆欣《南线巡回·解放西昌之战》部队指战员忍饥受寒，翻越高达四千二百多米荒无人烟的大山。”
derivationTraditional: 穆欣《南線巡迴·解放西昌之戰》部隊指戰員忍飢受寒，翻越高達四千二百多米荒無人煙的大山。”
derivationEn: From Mu Xin's 'Southern Tour: Liberation of Xichang': 'The troops endured hunger and cold, crossing a desolate mountain over 4,200 meters high.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 爱爱惜；莫不。虽然心中关切同情，却没有力量帮助。
explanationTraditional: 愛愛惜；莫不。雖然心中關切同情，卻沒有力量幫助。
explanationEn: Ai means to cherish; Mo means cannot. Although one feels sympathy and concern, they lack the power to help.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·焌民》维仲山甫举之，爱莫助之。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·焌民》維仲山甫舉之，愛莫助之。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Greater Odes: Zheng Min': 'Zhong Shanfu lifts it, but love cannot help.'
example: 收到各处的回信，只是写些～”之类的抱歉话。★叶圣陶《得失》
exampleTraditional: 收到各處的回信，只是寫些～”之類的抱歉話。★葉聖陶《得失》
exampleEn: The replies from various places were just apologetic words like 'love cannot help.' — Ye Shengtao, 'Gains and Losses'

explanation: 概全。一概不能除外。指都在所指范围之内。
explanationTraditional: 概全。一概不能除外。指都在所指範圍之內。
explanationEn: Gai means all. None can be excluded. Refers to everything being within the scope mentioned.
derivation: 《后汉书·西域传》然好大不经，奇谲无已，虽邹衍谈天之辩，庄周蜗角之论，尚未足以概莫能外。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·西域傳》然好大不經，奇譎無已，雖鄒衍談天之辯，莊周蝸角之論，尚未足以概莫能外。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of the Western Regions': 'But such grand and extraordinary things, even the debates of Zou Yan and the arguments of Zhuang Zhou, cannot be entirely excluded.'
example: 这是共通的道理，古今中外，～。★毛泽东《矛盾论》
exampleTraditional: 這是共通的道理，古今中外，～。★毛澤東《矛盾論》
exampleEn: This is a universal truth, past and present, home and abroad, none can be excluded. — Mao Zedong, 'On Contradiction'

explanation: 为国家的前途和人民的命运而担忧。
explanationTraditional: 為國家的前途和人民的命運而擔憂。
explanationEn: To worry about the future of the country and the fate of the people.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策》寡人忧国爱民，固愿得士以治之。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策》寡人憂國愛民，固願得士以治之。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy': 'I worry about the country and love the people, and I wish to obtain scholars to govern them.'
example: 那时节，朕却～。★明·吴承恩《西游记》
exampleTraditional: 那時節，朕卻～。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》
exampleEn: At that time, I worried about the country and the people. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West'

explanation: 暴、骤急速，突然。又猛又急的大风雨。比喻声势浩大，发展急速而猛烈。
explanationTraditional: 暴、驟急速，突然。又猛又急的大風雨。比喻聲勢浩大，發展急速而猛烈。
explanationEn: A violent and sudden storm. Metaphor for a massive, rapid, and fierce development or movement.
derivation: 《老子》第二十三章故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第二十三章故飄風不終朝，驟雨不終日。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 23 of Laozi: 'Thus a whirlwind does not last a whole morning, nor a sudden rain a whole day.'
example: 有雌雄二鸟，原在一处同飞，忽被～惊散。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第六十九回
exampleTraditional: 有雌雄二鳥，原在一處同飛，忽被～驚散。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第六十九回
exampleEn: There were a male and a female bird, originally flying together, but were suddenly scattered by a violent storm. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, Journey to the West, Chapter 69

explanation: 璀璨美玉发光。光辉灿烂耀人眼睛。
explanationTraditional: 璀璨美玉發光。光輝燦爛耀人眼睛。
explanationEn: Dazzling and brilliant, shining brightly and capturing the eye.
derivation: 宋·周密《武林旧事》第三卷玉山宝带，尽壁寸珠，璀璨夺目。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《武林舊事》第三卷玉山寶帶，盡壁寸珠，璀璨奪目。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Zhou Mi, 'Old Stories of Wulin', Volume 3: 'Jade mountains and precious belts, every inch of jade and pearl, dazzling and brilliant.'
example: 方志敏同志和无数先烈为之奋斗……，～的革命红旗已经插遍祖国大地。★穆欣《南线巡回·又照秦淮一叶枫”》
exampleTraditional: 方誌敏同志和無數先烈為之奮鬥……，～的革命紅旗已經插遍祖國大地。★穆欣《南線巡迴·又照秦淮一葉楓”》
exampleEn: The revolutionary red flag, for which Comrade Fang Zhimin and countless martyrs fought... now flutters across the motherland, dazzling and brilliant. — Mu Xin, 'South Line Tour: Another Maple Leaf of Qinhuai'

explanation: 表示吃惊的声音。形容不合常理，难以理解的怪事。
explanationTraditional: 表示吃驚的聲音。形容不合常理，難以理解的怪事。
explanationEn: An exclamation of surprise. Describes a strange event that defies common sense and is hard to understand.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·黜免》殷中军（殷浩）被废在信安，终日恒书空作字，扬州吏民寻义逐之，窃视，唯作‘咄咄怪事’四字而已。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·黜免》殷中軍（殷浩）被廢在信安，終日恆書空作字，揚州吏民尋義逐之，竊視，唯作‘咄咄怪事’四字而已。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty, Liu Yiqing, 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'Yin Hao, after being dismissed, constantly wrote characters in the air; onlookers saw only the four characters 'duo duo guai shi' (what a strange affair).'
example: 噫！一小说之微，而竟有如斯之法律，以圭臬于著述界之前途，亦～，～。★清·陶曾佑《论小说之势力及其影响》
exampleTraditional: 噫！一小說之微，而竟有如斯之法律，以圭臬於著述界之前途，亦～，～。★清·陶曾佑《論小說之勢力及其影響》
exampleEn: Alas! A trivial novel could be subject to such laws, serving as a standard for the future of writing—what a strange affair, what a strange affair! — Qing Dynasty, Tao Zengyou, 'On the Power and Influence of Novels'

explanation: 感激的心情没有穷尽。形容非常感激。
explanationTraditional: 感激的心情沒有窮盡。形容非常感激。
explanationEn: Endless gratitude; extremely thankful.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷八驿官传扬都督之命，将十千钱赠为路费，又备下一辆车儿，差人夫送至姚州普渒驿中居住，张氏心中感激不尽。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷八驛官傳揚都督之命，將十千錢贈為路費，又備下一輛車兒，差人夫送至姚州普渒驛中居住，張氏心中感激不盡。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 8: 'The postmaster conveyed the governor's order, giving ten thousand coins as travel expenses and preparing a carriage to send her to Yao Prefecture; Lady Zhang felt endless gratitude.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①反复阐说。②犹言总而言之。
explanationTraditional: ①反覆闡說。②猶言總而言之。
explanationEn: 1. To say repeatedly. 2. In short; after all.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 俑古代殉葬用的木制或陶制的俑人。开始制作俑的人。比喻首先做某件坏事的人。
explanationTraditional: 俑古代殉葬用的木製或陶製的俑人。開始製作俑的人。比喻首先做某件壞事的人。
explanationEn: The first to make burial figurines. Metaphor for the initiator of a bad practice or evil deed.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》仲尼曰‘始作俑者，其无后乎。’为其象人而用之也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》仲尼曰‘始作俑者，其無後乎。’為其象人而用之也。”
derivationEn: From Mencius, King Hui of Liang I: 'Confucius said, 'The first to make burial figurines—may he have no descendants!' because they used human-like figures.'
example: 北镇抚司狱廷杖立枷诸制，此秦法所未有，～，罪可胜道哉！★清·张潮《虞初新志·姜贞毅先生传》
exampleTraditional: 北鎮撫司獄廷杖立枷諸制，此秦法所未有，～，罪可勝道哉！★清·張潮《虞初新志·姜貞毅先生傳》
exampleEn: The systems of the Northern Brocade Guard, such as court flogging and standing cangue, were not present in Qin law. The blame for these evils can be traced to the initiator! — Qing Dynasty, Zhang Chao, 'New Stories from the Beginning of Yu'

explanation: 风里夹着腥味，雨点带着鲜血。形容疯狂杀戮的凶险气氛或环境。
explanationTraditional: 風裡夾著腥味，雨點帶著鮮血。形容瘋狂殺戮的兇險氣氛或環境。
explanationEn: Wind carrying a bloody smell, rain with blood. Describes a dangerous atmosphere of brutal killing or violence.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第二十三回腥风血雨满松林，散乱毛发坠山奄。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第二十三回腥風血雨滿松林，散亂毛髮墜山奄。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 23: 'Bloody wind and rain filled the pine forest, scattered hair and fur fell on the mountain.'
example: 投身革命即为家，～应有涯。取义成仁今日事，人间遍种自由花。★陈毅《梅岭三章》诗
exampleTraditional: 投身革命即為家，～應有涯。取義成仁今日事，人間遍種自由花。★陳毅《梅嶺三章》詩
exampleEn: Devoted to revolution, I call home my life; bloody rain and foul wind have their end. Today I choose benevolence and righteousness, planting freedom flowers across the land. — Chen Yi, 'Three Poems at Meiling'

explanation: 丧丧失；天良良心。没有一点良心。形容恶毒到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 喪喪失；天良良心。沒有一點良心。形容惡毒到了極點。
explanationEn: To have lost all conscience; utterly devoid of moral sense. Describes extreme cruelty or wickedness.
derivation: 清·钱泳《履园丛话·臆论·利己》今人既富贵骄奢矣，而又丧尽天良。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢泳《履園叢話·臆論·利己》今人既富貴驕奢矣，而又喪盡天良。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Qian Yong, 'Notes from the Garden of Lu': 'Nowadays, people become wealthy and arrogant, and then lose all conscience.'
example: 如今～的官府要害他们，因此上我家里躲几天。★欧阳山《三家巷》二六
exampleTraditional: 如今～的官府要害他們，因此上我家裡躲幾天。★歐陽山《三家巷》二六
exampleEn: Now the heartless officials want to harm them, so they are hiding in my home for a few days. — Ouyang Shan, 'Three Family Lane', Chapter 26

explanation: 中医用语。望，指观气色；闻，指听声息；问；指询问症状；切；指摸脉象∠称四诊。
explanationTraditional: 中醫用語。望，指觀氣色；聞，指聽聲息；問；指詢問症狀；切；指摸脈象∠稱四診。
explanationEn: The four diagnostic methods in traditional Chinese medicine: observation (look), auscultation and olfaction (listen), inquiry (ask), and pulse-taking (feel).
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 张张开；舞挥舞。形容猛兽凶恶可怕。也比喻猖狂凶恶。
explanationTraditional: 張張開；舞揮舞。形容猛獸兇惡可怕。也比喻猖狂兇惡。
explanationEn: To bare fangs and brandish claws. Describes a ferocious beast or a person acting arrogantly and aggressively.
derivation: 《敦煌变文集·孔子项托相问书》附录二《新编小儿难孔子》鱼生三日游于江湖，龙生三日张牙舞爪。”
derivationTraditional: 《敦煌變文集·孔子項託相問書》附錄二《新編小兒難孔子》魚生三日遊於江湖，龍生三日張牙舞爪。”
derivationEn: From 'Dunhuang Bianwen Anthology': 'A fish swims in rivers and lakes three days after birth; a dragon bares fangs and brandishes claws three days after birth.'
example: 见了州官，州判老爷胆子也壮了，～，有句没句，跟着教习说了一大泡。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 見了州官，州判老爺膽子也壯了，～，有句沒句，跟著教習說了一大泡。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十五回
exampleEn: When seeing the prefect, the deputy magistrate's courage grew; he bared fangs and brandished claws, speaking incoherently after the instructor. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats Revealed', Chapter 55

explanation: 洋西洋，指西方国家；媚谄媚。崇拜西方一切，谄媚外国人。指丧失民族自尊心，一味奉承巴结外国人。
explanationTraditional: 洋西洋，指西方國家；媚諂媚。崇拜西方一切，諂媚外國人。指喪失民族自尊心，一味奉承巴結外國人。
explanationEn: Worship everything foreign and fawn on foreigners; lose national self-respect and blindly flatter foreigners.
derivation: 茅盾《向鲁迅学习》那时清王朝以及当权的洋务派崇洋媚外，出卖国家主权。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《向魯迅學習》那時清王朝以及當權的洋務派崇洋媚外，出賣國家主權。”
derivationEn: Mao Dun's 'Learning from Lu Xun': At that time, the Qing dynasty and the Westernizationists in power worshipped everything foreign and fawned on foreigners, betraying national sovereignty.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 大家心里明白，不必再用言语解释。
explanationTraditional: 大家心裡明白，不必再用言語解釋。
explanationEn: It goes without saying; everyone understands without verbal explanation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 散居世界各国的华侨，虽然不少已入外国籍，但其对祖国的忠诚仍是～的。
exampleTraditional: 散居世界各國的華僑，雖然不少已入外國籍，但其對祖國的忠誠仍是～的。
exampleEn: Overseas Chinese scattered around the world, though many have adopted foreign citizenship, their loyalty to the motherland goes without saying.

explanation: 指提升了官职，同时就能获得更多的物质财富。
explanationTraditional: 指提升了官職，同時就能獲得更多的物質財富。
explanationEn: To be promoted to a higher position and thus gain more material wealth.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 容容纳；包包含。把各个方面全都容纳包括进来。
explanationTraditional: 容容納；包包含。把各個方面全都容納包括進來。
explanationEn: To include and accommodate all aspects; to be all-embracing.
derivation: 《史记·司马相如列传》故驰骛乎兼容并包，而勤思乎参天贰地。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·司馬相如列傳》故馳騖乎兼容幷包，而勤思乎參天貳地。”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Sima Xiangru: 'Thus he galloped in all-embracing inclusion and diligently thought of participating in heaven and earth.'
example: 贫僧岂不知，圣贤学问，～，释氏左道旁门，难于抗衡。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第二回
exampleTraditional: 貧僧豈不知，聖賢學問，～，釋氏左道旁門，難於抗衡。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第二回
exampleEn: How could the poor monk not know that the learning of sages is all-embracing, while Buddhism is a heterodox path difficult to compete with? — Qing Dynasty, Xia Jingqu's 'A Country Codger's Exposure of Officialdom', Chapter 2

explanation: 平白凭空；故缘故。指无缘无故。
explanationTraditional: 平白憑空；故緣故。指無緣無故。
explanationEn: For no reason at all; without any cause.
derivation: 梁斌《红旗谱》三十二眼看平白无故被他们拿去。不，这等于是他们砸明火、路劫！”
derivationTraditional: 梁斌《紅旗譜》三十二眼看平白無故被他們拿去。不，這等於是他們砸明火、路劫！”
derivationEn: Liang Bin's 'Red Flag Chronicle' 32: 'Seeing that they were taken away for no reason at all. No, this is like them committing daylight robbery!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指温度不高不低，冷热适中。亦比喻对人态度一般。
explanationTraditional: 指溫度不高不低，冷熱適中。亦比喻對人態度一般。
explanationEn: Neither cold nor hot; lukewarm. Also used metaphorically to describe an indifferent attitude.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十五回便见他一只手高高儿的举了一碗熬得透、得到不冷不热、温凉适中、可口儿的普洱茶来。”巴金《寒夜》三这一天是这个山城里少有的不冷不热的好天。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十五回便見他一隻手高高兒的舉了一碗熬得透、得到不冷不熱、溫涼適中、可口兒的普洱茶來。”巴金《寒夜》三這一天是這個山城裡少有的不冷不熱的好天。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines' Chapter 35: 'Then he saw her holding high a bowl of well-brewed tea, neither cold nor hot, warm and moderate, tasty.' Ba Jin's 'Cold Night' 3: 'This day was one of those rare good days in this mountain city, neither cold nor hot.'
example: 他采取～的态度，和她保持若即若离的关系。★周而复《上海的早晨》第三部二七
exampleTraditional: 他採取～的態度，和她保持若即若離的關係。★周而復《上海的早晨》第三部二七
exampleEn: He adopted a lukewarm attitude, maintaining an aloof relationship with her. — Zhou Erfu's 'Morning in Shanghai' Part 3, Chapter 27

explanation: 定安定。形容心情不平静。
explanationTraditional: 定安定。形容心情不平靜。
explanationEn: To be restless and disturbed; unable to calm one's mind.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第33回（三藏）心神不宁道‘徒弟啊，我怎么打寒噤呢？’”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第33回（三藏）心神不寧道‘徒弟啊，我怎麼打寒噤呢？’”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West' Chapter 33: 'San Zang, restless in mind, said, 'Disciple, why am I shivering?''
example: 她自己也惊讶为什么如此～，最后她自慰地想到‘是因为等待慧来。’★茅盾《幻灭》
exampleTraditional: 她自己也驚訝為什麼如此～，最後她自慰地想到‘是因為等待慧來。’★茅盾《幻滅》
exampleEn: She herself was surprised why she was so restless. Finally, she comforted herself, thinking, 'It's because I'm waiting for Hui.' — Mao Dun's 'Disillusionment'

explanation: 勉勉强；为做。勉强去做能力所不及或不愿去做的事。
explanationTraditional: 勉勉強；為做。勉強去做能力所不及或不願去做的事。
explanationEn: To do something reluctantly or beyond one's ability; to force oneself to do something.
derivation: 梁信《从奴隶到将军》下集第四章可是，情况尚不分明，我怎样迎敌？好吧，勉为其难吧。”
derivationTraditional: 梁信《從奴隸到將軍》下集第四章可是，情況尚不分明，我怎樣迎敵？好吧，勉為其難吧。”
derivationEn: Liang Xin's 'From Slave to General' Part 4, Chapter 3: 'But the situation is unclear, how can I engage the enemy? Well, I'll do it reluctantly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不分白天黑夜拼命赶路。
explanationTraditional: 不分白天黑夜拼命趕路。
explanationEn: To travel day and night without rest; to hurry on with the journey day and night.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 祛去除。扶持正气，去除邪气。现用来指扶持好的事物，纠正错误倾向。
explanationTraditional: 祛去除。扶持正氣，去除邪氣。現用來指扶持好的事物，糾正錯誤傾向。
explanationEn: To support the good and eliminate the evil; to uphold healthy forces and correct erroneous tendencies.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 累重叠；牍古代写字的木片。形容篇幅过多，文辞冗长。
explanationTraditional: 累重疊；牘古代寫字的木片。形容篇幅過多，文辭冗長。
explanationEn: Describes lengthy and redundant writing, with excessive words and pages.
derivation: 《隋书·李谔传》连篇累牍，不出月露之形。”
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·李諤傳》連篇累牘，不出月露之形。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Sui: Biography of Li E': 'Continuous pages and piled-up tablets, nothing but the form of moon and dew.'
example: 学诗有三节其初不识好恶，～，肆笔而成。★宋·严羽《沧浪诗话·诗法》
exampleTraditional: 學詩有三節其初不識好惡，～，肆筆而成。★宋·嚴羽《滄浪詩話·詩法》
exampleEn: Learning poetry has three stages: at first, not knowing good from bad, one writes continuously and piles up pages. — Song Dynasty, Yan Yu, 'Canglang's Remarks on Poetry: Poetic Methods'

explanation: 纵横合纵连横；捭阖开合，战国时策士游说的一种方法。指在政治或外交上运用手段进行分化或拉拢。
explanationTraditional: 縱橫合縱連橫；捭闔開合，戰國時策士遊說的一種方法。指在政治或外交上運用手段進行分化或拉攏。
explanationEn: Refers to using political or diplomatic means to divide or win over others, employing strategies of alliance or persuasion.
derivation: 汉·刘向《战国策序》苏秦为从，张仪为横，横则秦帝，从则楚王，所在国重，所去国轻。”《鬼谷子·捭阖》捭之者，开也，言也，阳也；阖之者，闭也，默也，阴也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《戰國策序》蘇秦為從，張儀為橫，橫則秦帝，從則楚王，所在國重，所去國輕。”《鬼谷子·捭闔》捭之者，開也，言也，陽也；闔之者，閉也，默也，陰也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Liu Xiang, 'Preface to Strategies of the Warring States': 'Su Qin advocated vertical alliance, Zhang Yi advocated horizontal alliance; horizontal makes Qin emperor, vertical makes Chu king.' Also from 'Guiguzi: Opening and Closing': 'Opening is to speak, to be yang; closing is to be silent, to be yin.'
example: 政客错实力以自雄，军人假名流以为重，～，各戴一尊。★蔡东藩、许厪父《民国通俗演义》第一百三十五回
exampleTraditional: 政客錯實力以自雄，軍人假名流以為重，～，各戴一尊。★蔡東藩、許厪父《民國通俗演義》第一百三十五回
exampleEn: Politicians rely on power to assert themselves, military men use celebrities to gain importance, employing strategies of division and alliance, each supporting a leader. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Jinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 135

explanation: 舍舍弃；逐追求。抛弃根本的、主要的，而去追求枝节的、次要的。比喻不抓根本环节，而只在枝节问题上下功夫。
explanationTraditional: 舍捨棄；逐追求。拋棄根本的、主要的，而去追求枝節的、次要的。比喻不抓根本環節，而只在枝節問題上下功夫。
explanationEn: To abandon the fundamental and pursue the trivial; to focus on minor issues while neglecting the root cause.
derivation: 《汉书·食货志》弃本逐末，耕者不能半，奸邪不可禁，原起于钱。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·食貨志》棄本逐末，耕者不能半，奸邪不可禁，原起於錢。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Treatise on Food and Money': 'Abandon the fundamental and pursue the trivial, farmers cannot be half, evil cannot be prohibited, originating from money.'
example: 写文章只追求形式而不注重内容，那是～。
exampleTraditional: 寫文章只追求形式而不注重內容，那是～。
exampleEn: Writing articles that only pursue form without focusing on content is to abandon the fundamental and pursue the trivial.

explanation: 简简省。原指野兽藏在深密的地方，很少出现◇指常呆在家里，很少出门。
explanationTraditional: 簡簡省。原指野獸藏在深密的地方，很少出現◇指常呆在家裡，很少出門。
explanationEn: Originally meant animals hiding deep and rarely appearing; now refers to people staying at home and rarely going out.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送浮屠文畅师序》夫兽深居而简出，惧物之为己害也，犹且不脱焉。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送浮屠文暢師序》夫獸深居而簡出，懼物之為己害也，猶且不脫焉。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Preface to Sending Monk Wenchang on a Journey': 'Beasts hide deep and rarely come out, fearing harm from others, yet they still cannot escape.'
example: 自摈弃以来，尤自刻励，～，几不与世人相通。★宋·秦观《谢王学士书》
exampleTraditional: 自擯棄以來，尤自刻勵，～，幾不與世人相通。★宋·秦觀《謝王學士書》
exampleEn: Since being rejected, I have been especially strict with myself, staying at home and rarely going out, almost not interacting with the world. — Song Dynasty, Qin Guan, 'Letter to Minister Wang'

explanation: 厌满足。贪心永远没有满足的时候。
explanationTraditional: 厭滿足。貪心永遠沒有滿足的時候。
explanationEn: Greedy and never satisfied; insatiable desire.
derivation: 《左传·昭公二十八年》贪婪无厌，忿类无期。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公二十八年》貪婪無厭，忿類無期。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: 28th Year of Duke Zhao': 'Greedy and insatiable, angry and without limit.'
example: 他～的性子，随着年岁的增长，更加残忍了。★梁斌《红旗谱》八
exampleTraditional: 他～的性子，隨著年歲的增長，更加殘忍了。★梁斌《紅旗譜》八
exampleEn: His insatiable greed became even more cruel as he grew older. — Liang Bin, 'Red Flag Chronicle', Chapter 8

explanation: 浑浑深厚的样子；噩噩严肃的样子。原意是浑厚而严正。现形容糊里糊涂，愚昧无知。
explanationTraditional: 渾渾深厚的樣子；噩噩嚴肅的樣子。原意是渾厚而嚴正。現形容糊里糊塗，愚昧無知。
