explanationEn: Originally meant profound and solemn; now describes being muddle-headed, ignorant, and foolish.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·问神》虞夏之书浑浑尔，商书灏灏尔，周书噩噩尔。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·問神》虞夏之書渾渾爾，商書灝灝爾，周書噩噩爾。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Yang Xiong, 'Model Sayings: Questioning Spirit': 'The books of Yu and Xia are profound, the books of Shang are vast, the books of Zhou are solemn.'
example: 他自己在十六七岁时～的，所以觉得十六岁的女孩子便那么练达人情世故，不是寿相”。★茅盾《一个女性》
exampleTraditional: 他自己在十六七歲時～的，所以覺得十六歲的女孩子便那麼練達人情世故，不是壽相”。★茅盾《一個女性》
exampleEn: He himself was muddle-headed at sixteen or seventeen, so he thought a sixteen-year-old girl being so worldly-wise was not a sign of longevity. — Mao Dun, 'A Woman'

explanation: 用另一种眼光看待。指看待某个人不同一般。也指不被重视的人得到重视。
explanationTraditional: 用另一種眼光看待。指看待某個人不同一般。也指不被重視的人得到重視。
explanationEn: To regard someone with special respect or favor; to treat someone differently, especially after they gain importance.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷八不想一见大王，查问来历，我等一实对，便把我们另眼相看。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷八不想一見大王，查問來歷，我等一實對，便把我們另眼相看。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'First Slap of the Table', Volume 8: 'Unexpectedly meeting the king, he asked our origins, and we told the truth, so he treated us with special regard.'
example: 大家晓得他与中丞有旧，莫不～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 大家曉得他與中丞有舊，莫不～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十一回
exampleEn: Everyone knew he had old ties with the governor, so they all treated him with special regard. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'Officialdom Exposed', Chapter 11

explanation: 无常变化不定。形容常常变化，一会儿是这样，一会儿又是那样，变动不定。
explanationTraditional: 無常變化不定。形容常常變化，一會兒是這樣，一會兒又是那樣，變動不定。
explanationEn: Changeable and inconsistent; often changing one's mind or behavior unpredictably.
derivation: 南朝·梁·费昶《行路难》诗当年翻复无常定。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·費昶《行路難》詩當年翻覆無常定。”
derivationEn: From Southern Liang Dynasty, Fei Chang, poem 'Difficult Journey': 'In those years, it was changeable and inconsistent.'
example: 叫我怎么能赦你这～的罪呢！★清·曾朴《孽海花》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 叫我怎麼能赦你這～的罪呢！★清·曾樸《孽海花》第十七回
exampleEn: How can I forgive your changeable and inconsistent crime! — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sin', Chapter 17

explanation: 沽买；钓用饵引鱼上钩，比喻骗取。用某种不正当的手段捞取名誉。
explanationTraditional: 沽買；釣用餌引魚上鉤，比喻騙取。用某種不正當的手段撈取名譽。
explanationEn: To seek fame by dishonest means; to fish for praise or reputation.
derivation: 《管子·法法》钓名之人，无贤士焉。”《后汉书·逸民传序》彼虽硁硁有类沽名者。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·法法》釣名之人，無賢士焉。”《後漢書·逸民傳序》彼雖硜硜有類沽名者。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Law and Law': 'Those who fish for fame are not worthy scholars.' Also from 'Book of Later Han: Preface to Biographies of Hermits': 'Although they are stubborn, they seem to fish for fame.'
example: 我只道你只不过是～，却不道长他的志气，灭我的威风。★明·张凤翼《灌园记·齐王拒谏》
exampleTraditional: 我只道你只不過是～，卻不道長他的志氣，滅我的威風。★明·張鳳翼《灌園記·齊王拒諫》
exampleEn: I thought you were just fishing for fame, but you actually boosted his morale and dampened ours. — Ming Dynasty, Zhang Fengyi, 'Story of Irrigation Garden: King of Qi Refuses Admonition'

explanation: 酩酊沉醉的样子。形容醉得很厉害。
explanationTraditional: 酩酊沉醉的樣子。形容醉得很厲害。
explanationEn: Completely drunk; very intoxicated.
derivation: 北魏·郦道元《水经注·沔水》日暮倒载归，酩酊无所知。”
derivationTraditional: 北魏·酈道元《水經注·沔水》日暮倒載歸，酩酊無所知。”
derivationEn: From Northern Wei Dynasty, Li Daoyuan, 'Commentary on the Water Classic: Mian River': 'At dusk, returning home drunk, completely unaware.'
example: 不两个时辰，把李逵灌得～，立脚不住。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: 不兩個時辰，把李逵灌得～，立腳不住。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十三回
exampleEn: In less than two hours, Li Kui was completely drunk and couldn't stand steady. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 43

explanation: 象鹤站在鸡群中一样。比喻一个人的仪表或才能在周围一群人里显得很突出。
explanationTraditional: 象鶴站在雞群中一樣。比喻一個人的儀表或才能在周圍一群人裡顯得很突出。
explanationEn: Like a crane standing among chickens. It means a person's appearance or talent stands out among a group of people.
derivation: 晋·戴逵《竹林七贤论》嵇绍入洛，或谓王戎曰‘昨于稠人中始见嵇绍，昂昂然若野鹤之在鸡群。’”南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·容止》嵇延祖卓卓如野鹤之在鸡群。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·戴逵《竹林七賢論》嵇紹入洛，或謂王戎曰‘昨於稠人中始見嵇紹，昂昂然若野鶴之在雞群。’”南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·容止》嵇延祖卓卓如野鶴之在雞群。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Dai Kui's 'Bamboo Grove Seven Worthies' and Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': Ji Shao was described as 'towering like a wild crane among chickens.'
example: 正在谈论，谁知女儿国王忽见林之洋杂在众人中，如～一般。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十九回
exampleTraditional: 正在談論，誰知女兒國王忽見林之洋雜在眾人中，如～一般。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十九回
exampleEn: While talking, the daughter of the king suddenly saw Lin Zhizhen mixed in the crowd, like a crane among chickens. — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 39

explanation: 想找都找不到。原指急切企求，但不能得到◇多形容迫切希望得到。
explanationTraditional: 想找都找不到。原指急切企求，但不能得到◇多形容迫切希望得到。
explanationEn: Something one wishes for but cannot obtain. Often describes a strong desire to get something.
derivation: 《诗·周南·关雎》求之不得，寤寐思服。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·周南·關雎》求之不得，寤寐思服。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs·Zhou Nan·Guan Ju': 'To seek but not obtain, longing day and night.'
example: 岂有此理！你老弟台肯栽培，那是～的，那里有甚委屈的话。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 豈有此理！你老弟臺肯栽培，那是～的，那裡有甚委屈的話。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第九十九回
exampleEn: How absurd! If you, my younger brother, are willing to cultivate me, that is something I wish for but cannot obtain. How could there be any grievance? — Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 99

explanation: 比翼翅膀挨着翅膀。齐飞成双的并飞。比喻夫妻情投意合，在事业上并肩前进。
explanationTraditional: 比翼翅膀挨著翅膀。齊飛成雙的並飛。比喻夫妻情投意合，在事業上並肩前進。
explanationEn: Wings side by side, flying together. It describes a couple who are deeply in love and advance together in their careers.
derivation: 《尔雅·释地》南方有比翼鸟焉，不比不飞，其名谓之鹣鹣。”
derivationTraditional: 《爾雅·釋地》南方有比翼鳥焉，不比不飛，其名謂之鶼鶼。”
derivationEn: From 'Erya·Explanation of Land': 'In the south, there is a bird that flies only side by side, called jianjian.'
example: 居里夫妇在科学征途上～。
exampleTraditional: 居里夫婦在科學征途上～。
exampleEn: The Curies flew side by side on the scientific journey.

explanation: 佛教禅宗和尚接待初学的人常常用棒一击或大喝一声，促他醒悟。比喻严厉警告，促使人猛醒过来。
explanationTraditional: 佛教禪宗和尚接待初學的人常常用棒一擊或大喝一聲，促他醒悟。比喻嚴厲警告，促使人猛醒過來。
explanationEn: A Buddhist Chan master's method of striking or shouting at a novice to awaken them. It means a severe warning to make someone suddenly realize.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元·黄檗运禅师法嗣·临济义玄禅师》上堂，僧问‘如何是佛法大意？’师亦竖拂子，僧便喝，师亦喝。僧拟议，师便打。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元·黃檗運禪師法嗣·臨濟義玄禪師》上堂，僧問‘如何是佛法大意？’師亦豎拂子，僧便喝，師亦喝。僧擬議，師便打。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': Linji Yixuan's master used a shout and a blow to teach.
example: 那日程希明～，未免触动了天良。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 那日程希明～，未免觸動了天良。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第十四回
exampleEn: That day, Cheng Ximing's sudden warning touched his conscience. — Li Lüyuan, 'The Road to the Lamp', Chapter 14

explanation: 飞黄传说中神马名；腾达上升，引伸为发迹，宦途得意。形容骏马奔腾飞驰。比喻骤然得志，官职升得很快。
explanationTraditional: 飛黃傳說中神馬名；騰達上升，引伸為發跡，宦途得意。形容駿馬奔騰飛馳。比喻驟然得志，官職升得很快。
explanationEn: Feihuang is a mythical horse; tengda means to rise. It describes a horse galloping swiftly, metaphorically meaning sudden success and rapid promotion.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《符读书城南》诗飞黄腾踏去，不能顾蟾蜍。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《符讀書城南》詩飛黃騰踏去，不能顧蟾蜍。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's poem 'Fu Reading South of the City': 'Feihuang gallops away, unable to care for the toad.'
example: 他进过种种培植新政人才的讲习班和训练班，虽然结果没有一项使他～。★沙汀《防空》
exampleTraditional: 他進過種種培植新政人才的講習班和訓練班，雖然結果沒有一項使他～。★沙汀《防空》
exampleEn: He attended various training classes for cultivating new policies, but none led to his rapid rise. — Sha Ting, 'Air Defense'

explanation: 桅杆或杂技长竿的顶端。比喻极高的官位和功名，或学问、事业有很高的成就。
explanationTraditional: 桅杆或雜技長竿的頂端。比喻極高的官位和功名，或學問、事業有很高的成就。
explanationEn: The top of a mast or acrobatic pole. It metaphorically means a very high official position or great achievement in learning or career.
derivation: 唐·吴融《商人》诗百尺竿头五两斜，此生何处不为家。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·吳融《商人》詩百尺竿頭五兩斜，此生何處不為家。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wu Rong's poem 'Merchant': 'At the top of a hundred-foot pole, the flag tilts; in this life, where is not home?'
example: 功名～，自古及今，有几个干休。★元·张养浩《折桂令》曲
exampleTraditional: 功名～，自古及今，有幾個干休。★元·張養浩《折桂令》曲
exampleEn: Fame and fortune at the top of a hundred-foot pole, from ancient times to now, few have willingly stopped. — Zhang Yanghao, Yuan Dynasty, 'Song of Zhegui'

explanation: 惶恐惧。内心害怕，十分不安。
explanationTraditional: 惶恐懼。內心害怕，十分不安。
explanationEn: Fearful and uneasy; extremely anxious.
derivation: 《汉书·王莽传下》人民正营，无所措手足。”唐·颜师古注正营，惶恐不安之意也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·王莽傳下》人民正營，無所措手足。”唐·顏師古注正營，惶恐不安之意也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han·Biography of Wang Mang': 'People are at a loss, not knowing where to put hands and feet.' Tang Yan Shigu's note: 'Zhengying means fearful and uneasy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 迎着困难上。
explanationTraditional: 迎著困難上。
explanationEn: To advance in the face of difficulties.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们在学习中要知难而进，绝不可知难而退。
exampleTraditional: 我們在學習中要知難而進，絕不可知難而退。
exampleEn: In our studies, we should advance in the face of difficulties and never retreat.

explanation: 嘴里说出狂妄自大的话。指说话狂妄、放肆。也指胡说八道。
explanationTraditional: 嘴裡說出狂妄自大的話。指說話狂妄、放肆。也指胡說八道。
explanationEn: To utter arrogant words; to speak arrogantly and recklessly; also means to talk nonsense.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第七十二回宋江听得，慌忙过来看时，却是‘九纹龙’史进，‘没遮拦’穆弘，在阁子内吃得大醉，口出狂言。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第七十二回宋江聽得，慌忙過來看時，卻是‘九紋龍’史進，‘沒遮攔’穆弘，在閣子內吃得大醉，口出狂言。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 72: 'Shi Jin and Mu Hong were drunk and spoke arrogantly.'
example: 刺客姓李名景纯，直隶正定府人。身体短悍，面貌凶恶。手脚系以铁锁，依然～，侮蔑政府。★老舍《赵子曰》二十三
exampleTraditional: 刺客姓李名景純，直隸正定府人。身體短悍，面貌兇惡。手腳系以鐵鎖，依然～，侮蔑政府。★老舍《趙子曰》二十三
exampleEn: The assassin named Li Jingchun, from Zhengding Prefecture, Zhili. Short and fierce-looking. Though bound with chains, he still spoke arrogantly, insulting the government. — Lao She, 'Zhao Ziyue', Chapter 23

explanation: 形容姿态柔和而美好。
explanationTraditional: 形容姿態柔和而美好。
explanationEn: Describes a graceful and beautiful posture.
derivation: 古乐府《孔雀东南飞》四角龙幡，婀娜多姿随风传。”
derivationTraditional: 古樂府《孔雀東南飛》四角龍幡，婀娜多姿隨風傳。”
derivationEn: From ancient yuefu poem 'Peacock Flying Southeast': 'Four-cornered dragon banners, graceful and swaying with the wind.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象蜂群似的拥挤着过来。形容许多人一起过来。
explanationTraditional: 象蜂群似的擁擠著過來。形容許多人一起過來。
explanationEn: To swarm like bees; describing many people coming together in a crowd.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》陈涉首难，豪杰蜂起。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》陳涉首難，豪傑蜂起。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'Chen She initiated the rebellion, and heroes swarmed up.'
example: 又等了一会子，方见胡统领打着灯笼火把，一路～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 又等了一會子，方見胡統領打著燈籠火把，一路～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十二回
exampleEn: After waiting a while, they saw Commander Hu leading a group with torches and lanterns, swarming along the way. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' (Chapter 12)

explanation: 不停的哭泣。
explanationTraditional: 不停的哭泣。
explanationEn: To sob and weep incessantly.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十七回这如今才好些，又这样哭哭啼啼，岂不是自己糟蹋了自己身子。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十七回這如今才好些，又這樣哭哭啼啼，豈不是自己糟蹋了自己身子。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (Chapter 67): 'Now that you are better, why do you cry and sob like this? You are only harming your own health.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 卵蛋。为了要得到鸡蛋，不惜把鸡杀了。比喻贪图眼前的好处而不顾长远利益。
explanationTraditional: 卵蛋。為了要得到雞蛋，不惜把雞殺了。比喻貪圖眼前的好處而不顧長遠利益。
explanationEn: To kill the goose that lays the golden eggs; to sacrifice future gains for immediate benefits.
derivation: 《伊索寓言》
derivationTraditional: 《伊索寓言》
derivationEn: From 'Aesop's Fables'.
example: 请皇上勿再竭泽而渔，～，为小民留一线生机。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十二章
exampleTraditional: 請皇上勿再竭澤而漁，～，為小民留一線生機。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十二章
exampleEn: Please, Your Majesty, do not drain the pond to catch all the fish, or kill the hen for its eggs; leave a little hope for the common people. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng' (Volume 2, Chapter 32)

explanation: 形容一时特别兴盛或流行。
explanationTraditional: 形容一時特別興盛或流行。
explanationEn: To be extremely prosperous or popular for a time.
derivation: 清·方东树《刘悌堂诗集序》刘氏名弗耀于远，而其说盛行一时。”
derivationTraditional: 清·方東樹《劉悌堂詩集序》劉氏名弗耀於遠，而其說盛行一時。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Fang Dongshu, 'Preface to Liu Titang's Poetry Collection': 'Liu's name did not shine far, but his theory was prevalent for a time.'
example: 侨胞亦知崇拜本国至圣，保存东方文明，故能发扬光大，～也。★鲁迅《三闲集·述香港恭祝圣诞》
exampleTraditional: 僑胞亦知崇拜本國至聖，保存東方文明，故能發揚光大，～也。★魯迅《三閒集·述香港恭祝聖誕》
exampleEn: Overseas Chinese also know to worship their own supreme sage and preserve Eastern civilization, thus they can carry it forward and make it flourish for a time. — Lu Xun, 'Three Leisures: Hong Kong Christmas Celebration'

explanation: 指事先未经周密考虑。
explanationTraditional: 指事先未經周密考慮。
explanationEn: To do something without careful planning; to happen by chance or accident.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《双赴梦》第二折［牧羊关］板筑的商傅说，钓鱼儿姜吕望，这两个梦善感动历代君王，这梦先应先知，臣则是误打误撞。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《雙赴夢》第二折［牧羊關］板築的商傅說，釣魚兒姜呂望，這兩個夢善感動歷代君王，這夢先應先知，臣則是誤打誤撞。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, 'Double Dream' (Act 2): 'Fu Shuo built walls, Jiang Ziya fished; these dreams moved the kings of past dynasties. The dream was foreknown, but I just stumbled into it.'
example: 袭人笑道不过是～的遇见了，说约下了可是没有的事。”★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十二回
exampleTraditional: 襲人笑道不過是～的遇見了，說約下了可是沒有的事。”★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十二回
exampleEn: Xiren laughed and said, 'It was just a chance encounter; saying we made an appointment is not true.' — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (Chapter 62)

explanation: 经经历。指经过很久的时间；长时间。
explanationTraditional: 經經歷。指經過很久的時間；長時間。
explanationEn: Over many years and months; for a long time.
derivation: 明·孙仁孺《东郭记·为衣服》幸有章子前去，可以无虞，教俺不须记挂，但虽则如此，千山万水，经年累月，好是悬悬。”
derivationTraditional: 明·孫仁孺《東郭記·為衣服》幸有章子前去，可以無虞，教俺不須記掛，但雖則如此，千山萬水，經年累月，好是懸懸。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Sun Renru, 'The Story of Dongguo' (Act 'For Clothes'): 'Fortunately, Zhangzi has gone ahead, so we need not worry. But even so, over thousands of mountains and rivers, through years and months, it is still worrisome.'
example: 不要说十日半月，即～，也是烦难。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一○八回
exampleTraditional: 不要說十日半月，即～，也是煩難。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一○八回
exampleEn: Not to mention ten days or half a month, even after years and months, it is still difficult. — Qing Dynasty, Xia Jingqu, 'A Tale of Rustic Heroes' (Chapter 108)

explanation: 指因极度的疼痛或悲哀，晕过去，又醒过来。多形容被打得很惨，或哭得很厉害。
explanationTraditional: 指因極度的疼痛或悲哀，暈過去，又醒過來。多形容被打得很慘，或哭得很厲害。
explanationEn: To faint and come back to life due to extreme pain or grief; often describes severe beating or intense crying.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第三回柳知府已经吓得死去活来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第三回柳知府已經嚇得死去活來。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'A Brief History of Civilization' (Chapter 3): 'Governor Liu was so frightened that he fainted and came back to life.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 闻听见；睹看见。亲耳听到，亲眼看见。
explanationTraditional: 聞聽見；睹看見。親耳聽到，親眼看見。
explanationEn: To hear with one's own ears and see with one's own eyes; to witness personally.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·唐纪睿宗景云二年》口说不如身逢，耳闻不如目睹。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·唐紀睿宗景雲二年》口說不如身逢，耳聞不如目睹。”
derivationEn: From 'Zizhi Tongjian: Tang Annals, Ruizong Jingyun Year 2': 'Hearing is not as good as seeing; what one hears is not as reliable as what one sees.'
example: 我从乡下跑京城里，一转眼已经六年了，其间～的所谓国家大事，算起来也很不少。★鲁迅《呐喊·一件小事》
exampleTraditional: 我從鄉下跑京城裡，一轉眼已經六年了，其間～的所謂國家大事，算起來也很不少。★魯迅《吶喊·一件小事》
exampleEn: I came from the countryside to the capital, and in the blink of an eye, six years have passed. During this time, I have heard and seen many so-called national events. — Lu Xun, 'A Small Incident'

explanation: 形容认识一致，共同努力。
explanationTraditional: 形容認識一致，共同努力。
explanationEn: To be of one mind and work together; to make concerted efforts.
derivation: 《墨子·尚贤》《汤誓》曰‘聿求元圣，与之戮力同心，以治天下。’”
derivationTraditional: 《墨子·尚賢》《湯誓》曰‘聿求元聖，與之戮力同心，以治天下。’”
derivationEn: From 'Mozi: Exalting Worthiness': 'The 'Tang Oath' says: 'Seek the great sage and work with him with one heart and one mind to govern the world.''
example: 工人们～，只用一天时间就把道路修好了。
exampleTraditional: 工人們～，只用一天時間就把道路修好了。
exampleEn: The workers worked together with one heart and one mind and repaired the road in just one day.

explanation: 驰传播。形容名声传播得极远。
explanationTraditional: 馳傳播。形容名聲傳播得極遠。
explanationEn: To be renowned both at home and abroad; to have a widespread reputation.
derivation: 北魏·郦道元《水经注·涑水》赀拟王公，驰名天下。”
derivationTraditional: 北魏·酈道元《水經注·涑水》貲擬王公，馳名天下。”
derivationEn: From Northern Wei Dynasty, Li Daoyuan, 'Commentary on the Water Classic: Sushui': 'Wealth rivaled that of princes and dukes, and fame spread throughout the world.'
example: 国民革命军新编第四军抗战有功，～。★毛泽东《为皖南事变发表的命令和谈话》
exampleTraditional: 國民革命軍新編第四軍抗戰有功，～。★毛澤東《為皖南事變發表的命令和談話》
exampleEn: The New Fourth Army of the National Revolutionary Army has rendered meritorious service in the War of Resistance and is famous both at home and abroad. — Mao Zedong, 'Order and Statement on the Southern Anhui Incident'

explanation: 宁宁愿；毋不；滥过度。盐人才或挑选事物，宁可少一些，也不要不顾质量贪多凑数。
explanationTraditional: 寧寧願；毋不；濫過度。鹽人才或挑選事物，寧可少一些，也不要不顧質量貪多湊數。
explanationEn: Rather go without than have something shoddy; prefer quality over quantity.
derivation: 《左传·襄公二十六年》善为国者，赏不僭而刑不滥……若不幸而过，宁僭不滥。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公二十六年》善為國者，賞不僭而刑不濫……若不幸而過，寧僭不濫。”
derivationEn: From Zuo Zhuan: 'A good ruler rewards without excess and punishes without abuse... if unfortunately excessive, rather reward than punish.'
example: 前天晚上，我们不是决定了～”的宗旨么？（茅盾《子夜》五）
exampleTraditional: 前天晚上，我們不是決定了～”的宗旨麼？（茅盾《子夜》五）
exampleEn: The night before last, didn't we decide on the principle of 'rather go without than have something shoddy'? (Mao Dun, Midnight, Chapter 5)

explanation: 嫌弃贫穷，喜爱富有。指对人的好恶以其贫富为准。
explanationTraditional: 嫌棄貧窮，喜愛富有。指對人的好惡以其貧富為準。
explanationEn: Despise the poor and curry favor with the rich; judge people by their wealth.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《裴度还带》第二折有那等嫌贫爱富的儿曹辈，将俺这贫傲慢、把他那富追陪，那个肯恤孤念寡存仁义。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《裴度還帶》第二折有那等嫌貧愛富的兒曹輩，將俺這貧傲慢、把他那富追陪，那個肯恤孤念寡存仁義。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's play: 'There are those who despise the poor and love the rich, treating the poor with arrogance and flattering the rich.'
example: 有负义忘恩的强盗，有～的强盗。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十八回
exampleTraditional: 有負義忘恩的強盜，有～的強盜。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十八回
exampleEn: There are ungrateful robbers and robbers who despise the poor and love the rich. (Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 58)

explanation: 对某个人或事物心里很向往。
explanationTraditional: 對某個人或事物心裡很嚮往。
explanationEn: To admire or yearn for someone or something deeply.
derivation: 《史记·孔子世家》虽不能至，然心向往之。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孔子世家》雖不能至，然心嚮往之。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian: 'Though I cannot reach it, my heart yearns for it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 扔在东流的水里冲走。比喻希望落空，成果丧失，前功尽弃，好象随着流水冲走了一样。
explanationTraditional: 扔在東流的水裡沖走。比喻希望落空，成果喪失，前功盡棄，好象隨著流水沖走了一樣。
explanationEn: To be cast into the eastward flowing water; hopes dashed, efforts wasted, all in vain.
derivation: 唐·高适《封丘作》诗生事应须南亩田，世事尽付东流水。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·高適《封丘作》詩生事應須南畝田，世事盡付東流水。”
derivationEn: From Gao Shi's poem: 'Life's affairs should be on southern fields, worldly matters all cast to the eastward flowing water.'
example: 缉捕使臣等听得这话，传在耳朵里，也只好笑笑，谁敢向他家道个不”字？这件事只索～了。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 緝捕使臣等聽得這話，傳在耳朵裡，也只好笑笑，誰敢向他家道個不”字？這件事只索～了。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二十
exampleEn: When the arresting officers heard this, they could only laugh and dared not say 'no' to his family. This matter had to be abandoned. (Ling Mengchu, Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 20)

explanation: 恨到骨头里去。形容痛恨到极点。
explanationTraditional: 恨到骨頭裡去。形容痛恨到極點。
explanationEn: To hate someone to the bone; extreme hatred.
derivation: 《史记·秦本纪》缪公之怨此三人，入于骨髓。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·秦本紀》繆公之怨此三人，入於骨髓。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian: 'Duke Mu's resentment towards these three men penetrated to the marrow.'
example: 那知府亦～，一处处弄得天怒人怨，在他自己始终亦莫明其所以然。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 那知府亦～，一處處弄得天怒人怨，在他自己始終亦莫明其所以然。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十二回
exampleEn: That prefect also hated him to the bone, causing widespread resentment, yet he himself never understood why. (Li Baojia, The Bureaucrats, Chapter 42)

explanation: 心里挂着很多沉重的顾虑。
explanationTraditional: 心裡掛著很多沉重的顧慮。
explanationEn: To have a heavy heart; weighed down with worries.
derivation: 罗广斌、杨益言《红岩》第二七章毛人凤正心事重重地在地毯上来回走着。”
derivationTraditional: 羅廣斌、楊益言《紅巖》第二七章毛人鳳正心事重重地在地毯上來回走著。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guangbin and Yang Yiyan's Red Crag, Chapter 27: 'Mao Renfeng was pacing the carpet with a heavy heart.'
example: 她近日来愁眉不展，像是～的样子。
exampleTraditional: 她近日來愁眉不展，像是～的樣子。
exampleEn: She has been frowning lately, as if burdened with many worries.

explanation: 禁承受。形容身体娇弱，连风吹都经受不起。
explanationTraditional: 禁承受。形容身體嬌弱，連風吹都經受不起。
explanationEn: Too weak to withstand a gust of wind; extremely delicate.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《江雨有怀郑典设诗》乱波纷披已打岸，弱云狼藉不禁风。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《江雨有懷鄭典設詩》亂波紛披已打岸，弱雲狼藉不禁風。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem: 'Turbulent waves have already beaten the shore, weak clouds cannot withstand the wind.'
example: 如果不参加劳动，也就会沾上资产阶级的思想意识，而且～。★茅盾《一九六０年短篇小说漫评》
exampleTraditional: 如果不參加勞動，也就會沾上資產階級的思想意識，而且～。★茅盾《一九六０年短篇小說漫評》
exampleEn: If one does not participate in labor, one may also be contaminated by bourgeois ideology and be too weak to withstand the wind. (Mao Dun, A Review of Short Stories from 1960)

explanation: 高高贵。高贵的朋友坐满了席位。形容宾客很多。
explanationTraditional: 高高貴。高貴的朋友坐滿了席位。形容賓客很多。
explanationEn: A gathering of distinguished guests; a full house of honored friends.
derivation: 唐·王勃《滕王阁序》千里逢迎，高朋满座。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《滕王閣序》千里逢迎，高朋滿座。”
derivationEn: From Wang Bo's Preface to the Tengwang Pavilion: 'Guests come from a thousand li, filling the seats with honored friends.'
example: 邕～，闻粲至，倒履迎之。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十回
exampleTraditional: 邕～，聞粲至，倒履迎之。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十回
exampleEn: When Cai Yong had a full house of distinguished guests and heard that Wang Can had arrived, he put on his shoes backwards to welcome him. (Luo Guanzhong, Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Chapter 40)

explanation: 悔后悔；当初开头，起初◇悔不在当初采取另一种行动。
explanationTraditional: 悔後悔；當初開頭，起初◇悔不在當初採取另一種行動。
explanationEn: To regret not having acted differently in the first place.
derivation: 唐·薛昭纬《谢银工》诗早知文字多辛苦，悔不当初学冶银。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·薛昭緯《謝銀工》詩早知文字多辛苦，悔不當初學冶銀。”
derivationEn: From Xue Zhaowei's poem: 'Had I known the hardship of writing, I would have regretted not learning silversmithing in the beginning.'
example: 这一声叹息，大有～的意味。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 這一聲嘆息，大有～的意味。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: This sigh carried a strong sense of regret for not having acted differently. (Gao Yang, Inside the Qing Palace, Volume 2)

explanation: 六甲传说为上帝造物的日子。指妇女怀孕。
explanationTraditional: 六甲傳說為上帝造物的日子。指婦女懷孕。
explanationEn: To be pregnant (literally 'carrying the six jia', a term for the days of creation).
derivation: 《隋书·经籍志三》载有《六甲贯胎书》
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·經籍志三》載有《六甲貫胎書》
derivationEn: From Book of Sui: 'The Book of Six Jia and Fetal Transformation' is recorded.
example: 偏偏媳妇～，好容易逃至海外，生下红蕖孙女，就在此处敷衍度日。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十回
exampleTraditional: 偏偏媳婦～，好容易逃至海外，生下紅蕖孫女，就在此處敷衍度日。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十回
exampleEn: Unfortunately, his daughter-in-law was pregnant. They barely escaped overseas, where she gave birth to granddaughter Hongqu, and have been living here ever since. (Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 10)

explanation: 鼻子发青，脸部肿起。形容脸部伤势严重。
explanationTraditional: 鼻子發青，臉部腫起。形容臉部傷勢嚴重。
explanationEn: Black and blue nose, swollen face. Describes severe facial injuries.
derivation: 《三侠五义》第四四回这恶贼原想着是个暗算，趁着军官作下揖去，不能防备，这一脚定然鼻青脸肿。”
derivationTraditional: 《三俠五義》第四四回這惡賊原想著是個暗算，趁著軍官作下揖去，不能防備，這一腳定然鼻青臉腫。”
derivationEn: From 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants' Chapter 44: 'The villain thought to ambush, but when the officer bowed, he kicked him, leaving his face black and blue and swollen.'
example: 两条大汉子飞步闯出来，把沈建华拉下去，打得～。★杨大群《草头屯恩仇》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 兩條大漢子飛步闖出來，把沈建華拉下去，打得～。★楊大群《草頭屯恩仇》第十四回
exampleEn: Two big men rushed out and dragged Shen Jianhua down, beating him black and blue. ★ Yang Daqun, 'Grass Head屯 Enmity' Chapter 14

explanation: 批判地继承文化遗产，使之为今天的无产阶级政治服务。
explanationTraditional: 批判地繼承文化遺產，使之為今天的無產階級政治服務。
explanationEn: Critically inherit cultural heritage to serve today's proletarian politics.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 研究古典文学要坚持古为今用的原则。
exampleTraditional: 研究古典文學要堅持古為今用的原則。
exampleEn: The study of classical literature should adhere to the principle of making the past serve the present.

explanation: 惺忪刚苏醒的样子。形容睡觉的人刚睡醒，还没有完全清醒。
explanationTraditional: 惺忪剛甦醒的樣子。形容睡覺的人剛睡醒，還沒有完全清醒。
explanationEn: Eyes still heavy with sleep; just waking up and not fully alert.
derivation: 鲁迅《故事新编·采薇》街道上的行人还不多；所遇见的不过是睡眼惺忪的女人，在井边打水。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《故事新編·采薇》街道上的行人還不多；所遇見的不過是睡眼惺忪的女人，在井邊打水。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun, 'Old Tales Retold: Gathering Vetch': 'There were not many pedestrians on the street; the only people met were women with sleepy eyes drawing water at the well.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 知道满足，就总是快乐。形容安于已经得到的利益、地位。
explanationTraditional: 知道滿足，就總是快樂。形容安於已經得到的利益、地位。
explanationEn: Contentment brings happiness. Describes being satisfied with one's current benefits and status.
derivation: 先秦·李耳《老子》祸莫大于不知足，咎莫大于欲得，故知足之足常足矣。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·李耳《老子》禍莫大於不知足，咎莫大於欲得，故知足之足常足矣。”
derivationEn: From Laozi, 'Tao Te Ching': 'There is no greater disaster than discontent; no greater fault than wanting more. Therefore, he who knows contentment is always content.'
example: 一个快乐主义者首先得有知足的修养，就是古训所谓‘～’。★王西彦《古屋》第一部
exampleTraditional: 一個快樂主義者首先得有知足的修養，就是古訓所謂‘～’。★王西彥《古屋》第一部
exampleEn: A hedonist must first cultivate contentment, as the ancient saying goes: 'Contentment brings happiness.' ★ Wang Xiyan, 'Old House' Part 1

explanation: 绿油油的草好象地上铺的褥子。常指可供临时休憩的草地。亦作碧草如茵”。
explanationTraditional: 綠油油的草好象地上鋪的褥子。常指可供臨時休憩的草地。亦作碧草如茵”。
explanationEn: Green grass like a carpet. Often refers to a grassy area for temporary rest.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 说的是一套，做的又是另外一套。
explanationTraditional: 說的是一套，做的又是另外一套。
explanationEn: Saying one thing and doing another; inconsistency between words and deeds.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 为人处世要言行一致，不可言行不一。
exampleTraditional: 為人處世要言行一致，不可言行不一。
exampleEn: One should be consistent in words and deeds, not say one thing and do another.

explanation: 晃摇动。脑袋摇来摇去。形容自己感觉很有乐趣或自己认为很不差的样子。
explanationTraditional: 晃搖動。腦袋搖來搖去。形容自己感覺很有樂趣或自己認為很不差的樣子。
explanationEn: Shaking one's head back and forth. Describes a self-satisfied or proud demeanor.
derivation: 鲁迅《二心集·善于翻译的通信》摇头晃脑的读起来，真是音调铿锵，使人不自觉其头晕。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《二心集·善於翻譯的通信》搖頭晃腦的讀起來，真是音調鏗鏘，使人不自覺其頭暈。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun, 'Two Hearts Collection: On Translation Correspondence': 'Reading aloud with a swaying head, the tone is sonorous, making one dizzy without realizing it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 各个逐个；击攻。军事术语。指利用优势兵力将被分割开的敌军一部分一部分消灭。有时也比喻将问题逐个解决。
explanationTraditional: 各個逐個；擊攻。軍事術語。指利用優勢兵力將被分割開的敵軍一部分一部分消滅。有時也比喻將問題逐個解決。
explanationEn: To defeat enemy forces one by one by concentrating superior forces; also used for solving problems one by one.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国的红色政权为什么能够存在》集中红军相机应付当前之敌，反对分兵，避免被敌人各个击破。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國的紅色政權為什麼能夠存在》集中紅軍相機應付當前之敵，反對分兵，避免被敵人各個擊破。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'Why Can China's Red Political Power Exist?': 'Concentrate the Red Army to deal with the current enemy, oppose dividing forces, and avoid being defeated one by one by the enemy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 滔滔不绝的言论。多指内容烦琐、词句重复的长篇发言或文章。
explanationTraditional: 滔滔不絕的言論。多指內容煩瑣、詞句重複的長篇發言或文章。
explanationEn: A lengthy speech or article, often verbose and repetitive.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第七十八回原稿在哪里？倒要细细看看，长篇大论，不知说的是什么。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第七十八回原稿在哪裡？倒要細細看看，長篇大論，不知說的是什麼。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 78: 'Where is the original manuscript? Let me read it carefully. Such a long-winded discourse, I wonder what it says.'
example: 诗上所叙闺臣姐姐事迹，～，倒象替他题了一个小照。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第八十九回
exampleTraditional: 詩上所敘閨臣姐姐事蹟，～，倒象替他題了一個小照。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第八十九回
exampleEn: The poem narrates Sister Guichen's deeds in a lengthy discourse, as if painting a portrait of her. ★ Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 89

explanation: 看见人要掉进陷井里，不伸手救他，反而推他下去，又扔下石头。比喻乘人有危难时加以陷害。
explanationTraditional: 看見人要掉進陷井裡，不伸手救他，反而推他下去，又扔下石頭。比喻乘人有危難時加以陷害。
explanationEn: To push someone into a well and throw stones after them. Metaphor for taking advantage of someone's misfortune to harm them.
derivation: 语出唐·韩愈《柳子厚墓志铭》落陷阱，不一引手救，反挤之，又下石焉者，皆是也。”
derivationTraditional: 語出唐·韓愈《柳子厚墓誌銘》落陷阱，不一引手救，反擠之，又下石焉者，皆是也。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Liu Zihou': 'When someone falls into a trap, instead of reaching out to save them, they push them down and throw stones.'
example: 为什么要在别人危急的时刻，～……太不讲做人的道德了。★周而复《上海的早晨》第三部十九
exampleTraditional: 為什麼要在別人危急的時刻，～……太不講做人的道德了。★周而復《上海的早晨》第三部十九
exampleEn: Why would you throw stones at someone in their moment of crisis? ... It's utterly immoral. ★ Zhou Erfu, 'Morning in Shanghai' Part 3, Chapter 19

explanation: 步步表示距离很短；高升往上升。指职位不断上升。
explanationTraditional: 步步表示距離很短；高升往上升。指職位不斷上升。
explanationEn: Step by step rising higher. Refers to continuous promotion in position or status.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第88回并且事成之后，大人步步高升，扶摇直上，还望大人栽培呢！”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第88回並且事成之後，大人步步高昇，扶搖直上，還望大人栽培呢！”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Status Quo Witnessed in Twenty Years' Chapter 88: 'And after the matter succeeds, you will rise step by step, soaring straight up, and I hope you will cultivate me!'
example: 祝你今年～。
exampleTraditional: 祝你今年～。
exampleEn: I wish you a promotion step by step this year.

explanation: 行做，办；是对的。按照各自认为对的去做。比喻各搞一套。
explanationTraditional: 行做，辦；是對的。按照各自認為對的去做。比喻各搞一套。
explanationEn: Each acts as they think correct. Metaphor for each going their own way.
derivation: 《庄子·徐无鬼》天下非有公是也，而各是其所是。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·徐無鬼》天下非有公是也，而各是其所是。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Xu Wugui': 'The world does not have a universal standard of right, and each considers their own view as right.'
example: 我之求死，你之求生，是～。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 我之求死，你之求生，是～。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第二十一回
exampleEn: My seeking death and your seeking life are each going our own way. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren, 'History of Pain' Chapter 21

explanation: 顺着水流的方向推船。比喻顺着某个趋势或某种方便说话办事。
explanationTraditional: 順著水流的方向推船。比喻順著某個趨勢或某種方便說話辦事。
explanationEn: Push the boat along with the current. Metaphor for taking advantage of a trend or convenience to act or speak.
derivation: 元·关汉《窦娥冤》第三折天地也做得个怕硬欺软，却原来也这般顺水推船。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢《竇娥冤》第三折天地也做得個怕硬欺軟，卻原來也這般順水推船。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'The Injustice to Dou E' Act 3: 'Heaven and Earth also bully the weak and fear the strong, and thus push the boat along with the current.'
example: 他若留我，乐得～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十回
exampleTraditional: 他若留我，樂得～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十回
exampleEn: If he keeps me, I'll gladly push the boat along with the current. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia, 'Officialdom Exposed' Chapter 10

explanation: 匠心工巧的心思。独创性地运用精巧的心思。
explanationTraditional: 匠心工巧的心思。獨創性地運用精巧的心思。
explanationEn: Ingenious mind operates uniquely. Refers to original and skillful use of creative ideas.
derivation: 唐·王士源《孟浩然集序》文不按古，匠心独妙。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王士源《孟浩然集序》文不按古，匠心獨妙。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Shiyuan's 'Preface to Meng Haoran's Collection': 'His writing does not follow ancient ways, his ingenuity is uniquely subtle.'
example: 至～之作，色韵古雅，掌故淹通。★清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷七
exampleTraditional: 至～之作，色韻古雅，掌故淹通。★清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷七
exampleEn: Works of unique ingenuity have elegant colors and profound allusions. — Qing Dynasty Ping Buqing, 'Xiawai Juncui' Volume 7

explanation: 从开头至结尾。指某件事物的全过程或全部内容。
explanationTraditional: 從開頭至結尾。指某件事物的全過程或全部內容。
explanationEn: From beginning to end. Refers to the whole process or entire content of something.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类》卷二十今来所问，皆是不会仔细看书，又不曾从头到尾看，只是中间接起一句一字来备礼发问。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類》卷二十今來所問，皆是不會仔細看書，又不曾從頭到尾看，只是中間接起一句一字來備禮發問。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's 'Zhu Xi's Classified Conversations' Volume 20: 'Now your questions show you haven't read the book carefully, nor from beginning to end, but only picked a word or sentence to ask.'
example: 象一个人受了一辈子的冤屈，如今遇到一个亲人，他得～倾吐出来。★巴金《火》第二部第十节
exampleTraditional: 象一個人受了一輩子的冤屈，如今遇到一個親人，他得～傾吐出來。★巴金《火》第二部第十節
exampleEn: Like a person who has suffered injustice all his life, now meeting a relative, he must pour it out from beginning to end. — Ba Jin, 'Fire' Part 2, Chapter 10

explanation: 混杂在一起，形容极为混乱。
explanationTraditional: 混雜在一起，形容極為混亂。
explanationEn: Mixed together in chaos. Describes extreme disorder.
derivation: 鲁迅《热风·随感录三十三》他拿了儒、道士、和尚、耶教的糟粕，乱作一团，又密密的插入鬼话。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《熱風·隨感錄三十三》他拿了儒、道士、和尚、耶教的糟粕，亂作一團，又密密的插入鬼話。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Hot Wind: Random Thoughts 33': 'He took the dregs of Confucianism, Taoism, Buddhism, and Christianity, mixed them into a mess, and secretly inserted ghost talk.'
example: 他的队伍已经～，滚的滚下，栽倒的栽倒。★刘流《烈火金刚》第27回
exampleTraditional: 他的隊伍已經～，滾的滾下，栽倒的栽倒。★劉流《烈火金剛》第27回
exampleEn: His troops were already in chaos, some rolling down, some falling over. — Liu Liu, 'Fire Steel Heroes' Chapter 27

explanation: 比喻修改文章时稍稍改动原来的文字，就使它变得很出色。
explanationTraditional: 比喻修改文章時稍稍改動原來的文字，就使它變得很出色。
explanationEn: Touch stone and turn it into gold. Metaphor for making small changes to a text to greatly improve it.
derivation: 汉·刘向《列仙传》许逊，南昌人。晋初为旌阳令，点石化金，以足逋赋。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《列仙傳》許遜，南昌人。晉初為旌陽令，點石化金，以足逋賦。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Liu Xiang's 'Biographies of Immortals': 'Xu Xun, a native of Nanchang, served as Jingyang magistrate in early Jin, turned stone into gold to pay off overdue taxes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 多方面想了又想。
explanationTraditional: 多方面想了又想。
explanationEn: Think left and right. Means to think over and over from many angles.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十八回左思右想，欲求自脱之计。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十八回左思右想，欲求自脫之計。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 88: 'Thinking left and right, seeking a way to extricate himself.'
example: 如此～，一时五内沸然。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十四回
exampleTraditional: 如此～，一時五內沸然。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十四回
exampleEn: Thinking left and right, his mind was in turmoil. — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 34

explanation: 指亲缘关系近的家畜个体间交配繁殖。可以用于领导干部在自己权利范围内任人唯亲。
explanationTraditional: 指親緣關係近的家畜個體間交配繁殖。可以用於領導幹部在自己權利範圍內任人唯親。
explanationEn: Inbreeding among closely related livestock. Can refer to nepotism within a leader's sphere of power.
derivation: 张周《步履艰难的中国》第十章某省一位县委书记说，由于多年的近亲繁殖，如果查处一个科级干部，就会得罪半个县城。”
derivationTraditional: 張周《步履艱難的中國》第十章某省一位縣委書記說，由於多年的近親繁殖，如果查處一個科級幹部，就會得罪半個縣城。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Zhou's 'Difficult Steps of China' Chapter 10: 'A county party secretary said that due to years of inbreeding, investigating one section-level cadre would offend half the county.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一群龙没有领头的。比喻没有领头的，无法统一行动。
explanationTraditional: 一群龍沒有領頭的。比喻沒有領頭的，無法統一行動。
explanationEn: A group of dragons without a leader. Metaphor for lacking a leader, unable to act in unison.
derivation: 《易·乾》用九，见群龙无首，吉。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·乾》用九，見群龍無首，吉。”
derivationEn: From 'I Ching: Qian': 'Use nine, see a group of dragons without a leader, auspicious.'
example: 可是～，成不了大气候。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三十一章
exampleTraditional: 可是～，成不了大氣候。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三十一章
exampleEn: But without a leader, they cannot achieve much. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng' Volume 1, Chapter 31

explanation: 原指旧时诗文里经常描写的自然景物◇比喻堆砌词藻、内容贫乏空洞的诗文。也指爱情之事或花天酒地的荒淫生活。
explanationTraditional: 原指舊時詩文裡經常描寫的自然景物◇比喻堆砌詞藻、內容貧乏空洞的詩文。也指愛情之事或花天酒地的荒淫生活。
explanationEn: Originally referred to natural scenes often described in old poetry; later used to describe poetry or prose that is ornate but lacks substance. Also refers to romantic affairs or a life of debauchery.
derivation: 宋·邵雍《伊川击壤集序》虽死生荣辱，转战于前，曾未入于胸中，则何异四时风花雪月一过乎眼也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·邵雍《伊川擊壤集序》雖死生榮辱，轉戰於前，曾未入於胸中，則何異四時風花雪月一過乎眼也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Shao Yong's 'Yichuan Jirang Ji' preface: 'Though life and death, honor and disgrace, turn before one, they do not enter the heart; what difference is there from the four seasons' wind, flowers, snow, and moon passing before the eyes?'
example: 小弟每常见前辈批语，有些～的字样，被那些后生们看不见，便要想到诗词歌赋那条路上去，便要坏了心术。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》
exampleTraditional: 小弟每常見前輩批語，有些～的字樣，被那些後生們看不見，便要想到詩詞歌賦那條路上去，便要壞了心術。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》
exampleEn: I often see in the critiques of seniors some phrases like 'wind, flowers, snow, and moon,' which, when seen by the younger generation, lead them to think of poetry and songs, and thus corrupt their minds. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars'

explanation: 迷信的人认为人的一切遭遇都是命运预先决定的，人力无法挽回。
explanationTraditional: 迷信的人認為人的一切遭遇都是命運預先決定的，人力無法挽回。
explanationEn: Superstitious belief that all events in one's life are predetermined by fate and cannot be changed by human effort.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷七这是我命中注定，该做他家的女婿。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷七這是我命中註定，該做他家的女婿。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 7: 'This is my fate, destined to be his son-in-law.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容失败到了不可收拾的地步。
explanationTraditional: 形容失敗到了不可收拾的地步。
explanationEn: Describes a failure so complete that it is beyond recovery.
derivation: 《史记·高祖本纪》天下方扰，诸侯并起，今置将不善，壹败涂地。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·高祖本紀》天下方擾，諸侯並起，今置將不善，壹敗塗地。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Basic Annals of Gaozu': 'The world is in turmoil, the feudal lords rise together; if the general is not well chosen, one defeat will smear the ground.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 混淆使界限不清。故意把正确的说成错误的，把错误的说成正确的。
explanationTraditional: 混淆使界限不清。故意把正確的說成錯誤的，把錯誤的說成正確的。
explanationEn: To deliberately confuse right and wrong, saying correct things are wrong and wrong things are correct.
derivation: 清·陶曾佑《论文学之势力及其关系》锢蔽见闻，淆混是非。”
derivationTraditional: 清·陶曾佑《論文學之勢力及其關係》錮蔽見聞，淆混是非。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Tao Zengyou's 'On the Power and Influence of Literature': 'Obstructing views and confusing right and wrong.'
example: 他们颠倒黑白，～，结帮营私，横行霸道。★巴金《一封信》
exampleTraditional: 他們顛倒黑白，～，結幫營私，橫行霸道。★巴金《一封信》
exampleEn: They turn things upside down, confuse right and wrong, form cliques for private interests, and act tyrannically. — Ba Jin's 'A Letter'

explanation: 形容态度文雅从容，庄重大方。
explanationTraditional: 形容態度文雅從容，莊重大方。
explanationEn: Describes a person's demeanor as elegant, composed, and dignified.
derivation: 曹禺《王昭君》第一幕姜夫人雍容华贵地走下，盈盈和戚戚恭恭敬敬地陪送出去。”
derivationTraditional: 曹禺《王昭君》第一幕姜夫人雍容華貴地走下，盈盈和慼慼恭恭敬敬地陪送出去。”
derivationEn: Cao Yu's 'Wang Zhaojun' Act 1: 'Madam Jiang descends gracefully and elegantly, while Yingying and Qiqi respectfully escort her out.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 聊赖依赖。精神上无所寄托，感到什么都没意思。
explanationTraditional: 聊賴依賴。精神上無所寄託，感到什麼都沒意思。
explanationEn: Having nothing to rely on; feeling utterly bored and listless, with no spiritual sustenance.
derivation: 汉·蔡琰《悲愤》诗为复强视息，虽生何聊赖。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·蔡琰《悲憤》詩為復強視息，雖生何聊賴。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Cai Yan's poem 'Bei Fen': 'Forced to look around, even if alive, what joy is there?'
example: 在～中，随手抓过一本书来，科学也好，文学也好，横竖什么都一样。★鲁迅《彷徨·伤逝》
exampleTraditional: 在～中，隨手抓過一本書來，科學也好，文學也好，橫豎什麼都一樣。★魯迅《彷徨·傷逝》
exampleEn: In utter boredom, I grabbed a book at random—science or literature, it didn't matter. —Lu Xun, 'Wandering: Regret for the Past'

explanation: 滂沱雨大而多的样子。形容寸下得很大。
explanationTraditional: 滂沱雨大而多的樣子。形容寸下得很大。
explanationEn: Describing heavy rain; rain falling in torrents.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第二十八回行了数日，忽值大雨滂沱。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第二十八回行了數日，忽值大雨滂沱。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 28: 'After traveling for several days, they suddenly encountered a torrential downpour.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 隐约显现出刀剑的闪光和影子。形容环境充满了凶险的气氛。
explanationTraditional: 隱約顯現出刀劍的閃光和影子。形容環境充滿了兇險的氣氛。
explanationEn: The flash and shadow of knives and swords faintly visible; describing an atmosphere filled with danger and violence.
derivation: 南朝·梁·吴筠《战城南四首》剑光挥夜电，马汗昼夜泥。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·吳筠《戰城南四首》劍光揮夜電，馬汗晝夜泥。”
derivationEn: From Southern Liang Dynasty Wu Jun's 'Four Poems of Zhan Cheng Nan': 'Sword light flashes like night lightning, horse sweat stains the day and night mud.'
example: 多年阔别，一旦重逢尤其在此～的北中国一隅聚首，使人发生无限的感喟。★范长江《塞上行·从嘉峪关到山海关》
exampleTraditional: 多年闊別，一旦重逢尤其在此～的北中國一隅聚首，使人發生無限的感喟。★範長江《塞上行·從嘉峪關到山海關》
exampleEn: After years of separation, reuniting especially in this corner of northern China filled with the flash of knives and shadows of swords evokes infinite emotion. —Fan Changjiang, 'On the Great Wall: From Jiayuguan to Shanhaiguan'

explanation: 非命横死。在意外的灾祸中死亡。
explanationTraditional: 非命橫死。在意外的災禍中死亡。
explanationEn: To die an unnatural or violent death; to die in an unexpected disaster.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》桎梏死者，非正命也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》桎梏死者，非正命也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jin Xin I': 'Those who die in shackles do not die a proper death.'
example: 我三个若舍不得性命相帮他时，残酒为誓，教我们都遭横事，恶病临身，～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 我三個若捨不得性命相幫他時，殘酒為誓，教我們都遭橫事，惡病臨身，～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第十五回
exampleEn: If we three are not willing to risk our lives to help him, let this wine be our oath: may we all meet with misfortune, suffer deadly diseases, and die unnatural deaths. —Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 15

explanation: 不可能再增加。指程度达到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 不可能再增加。指程度達到了極點。
explanationEn: Cannot be increased further; reaching the utmost extreme.
derivation: 《左传·文公十七年》今大国曰‘尔未逞吾志。’敝邑有亡，无以加焉。”《汉书·王莽传下》且令万世之后无以复加也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·文公十七年》今大國曰‘爾未逞吾志。’敝邑有亡，無以加焉。”《漢書·王莽傳下》且令萬世之後無以復加也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Wen's 17th Year': 'Now the great state says, 'You have not satisfied my ambition.' Our state will perish; there is nothing more to add.' And 'Book of Han: Biography of Wang Mang II': 'Let future generations have nothing to add.'
example: 其便捷之法，殆～。★清·王韬《瀛壖杂志》
exampleTraditional: 其便捷之法，殆～。★清·王韜《瀛壖雜誌》
exampleEn: Its convenience is almost beyond compare. —Qing Dynasty Wang Tao, 'Miscellaneous Records of Yinghuan'

explanation: 改换了原来的姓名。
explanationTraditional: 改換了原來的姓名。
explanationEn: To change one's original name and surname.
derivation: 《史记·货殖列传》乃乘扁舟浮于江湖，变名易姓。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·貨殖列傳》乃乘扁舟浮於江湖，變名易姓。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of the Merchants': 'He took a small boat and drifted on the rivers and lakes, changing his name and surname.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 精神疲乏，气力用尽。形容精神和身体极度疲劳。
explanationTraditional: 精神疲乏，氣力用盡。形容精神和身體極度疲勞。
explanationEn: Exhausted both mentally and physically; completely worn out.
derivation: 汉·焦延寿《焦氏易林·巽》蹇驴不材，骏骥失时，筋劳力尽，罢于沙丘。”唐·韩愈《论淮西事宜状》虽时侵掠，小有所得，力尽筋疲，不偿其费。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·焦延壽《焦氏易林·巽》蹇驢不材，駿驥失時，筋勞力盡，罷於沙丘。”唐·韓愈《論淮西事宜狀》雖時侵掠，小有所得，力盡筋疲，不償其費。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Jiao Yanshou's 'Jiao's Book of Changes: Xun': 'A lame donkey is not useful, a fine horse misses its time, muscles and strength are exhausted, resting on a sand dune.' Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'On the Situation of Huaixi': 'Although they occasionally invade and plunder, gaining small profits, they are exhausted and the gain does not compensate for the loss.'
example: 我才逃到这里来，已经～了，还有什么办法呢？★巴金《寒夜》
exampleTraditional: 我才逃到這裡來，已經～了，還有什麼辦法呢？★巴金《寒夜》
exampleEn: I just escaped here, already exhausted, what else can I do? — Ba Jin, 'Cold Nights'

explanation: 形容说话浮夸不切实际。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話浮誇不切實際。
explanationEn: To talk big; to boast or exaggerate unrealistically.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十一回进了书房门，听见杨执中在内唂唂而谈，知道是他已来了，进去作揖同，同坐下。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十一回進了書房門，聽見楊執中在內唂唂而談，知道是他已來了，進去作揖同，同坐下。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 11: 'Entering the study, he heard Yang Zhizhong talking loudly inside, knowing he had already arrived, he went in to bow and sat down.'
example: 这种结论，不是甲乙丙丁的现象罗列，也不是～的滥调文章，而是科学的结论。★毛泽东《改造我们的学习》
exampleTraditional: 這種結論，不是甲乙丙丁的現象羅列，也不是～的濫調文章，而是科學的結論。★毛澤東《改造我們的學習》
exampleEn: This kind of conclusion is not a mere listing of phenomena like A, B, C, D, nor a bombastic essay, but a scientific conclusion. — Mao Zedong, 'Reform Our Study'

explanation: 手中掌握有很大权力。
explanationTraditional: 手中掌握有很大權力。
explanationEn: To hold great power in one's hands.
derivation: 蒲韧《二千年间》九王安石得到神宗皇帝的支持，大权在握，就全力来推行一些新的政治。”
derivationTraditional: 蒲韌《二千年間》九王安石得到神宗皇帝的支持，大權在握，就全力來推行一些新的政治。”
derivationEn: From Pu Ren's 'Two Thousand Years', Chapter 9: 'Wang Anshi, with the support of Emperor Shenzong, held great power and fully implemented new policies.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 线微小；生机生存的机会。还有一点儿生存的希望。
explanationTraditional: 線微小；生機生存的機會。還有一點兒生存的希望。
explanationEn: A slim chance of survival; a glimmer of hope.
derivation: 宋·罗大经《鹤林玉露》若借温太真之事，为小人开一线生路，借范尧夫之言，为君子忧后来之祸，则失之矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·羅大經《鶴林玉露》若借溫太真之事，為小人開一線生路，借範堯夫之言，為君子憂後來之禍，則失之矣。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Luo Dajing's 'Crane Grove Jade Dew': 'If one uses the story of Wen Tai to open a slim chance for petty people, and uses Fan Yaofu's words to worry about future disasters for gentlemen, then it is wrong.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心怀坦白，言行正派。
explanationTraditional: 心懷坦白，言行正派。
explanationEn: Open and aboveboard; upright and honest.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《答吕伯恭书》大抵圣贤之心，正大光明，洞然四达。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《答呂伯恭書》大抵聖賢之心，正大光明，洞然四達。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's 'Letter to Lü Bo Gong': 'Generally, the hearts of sages are upright and open, clear in all directions.'
example: 这会儿讲走门路，～大道儿，自然要让连公公，那是老牌子。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 這會兒講走門路，～大道兒，自然要讓連公公，那是老牌子。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十一回
exampleEn: At this moment, to seek connections, the proper and open way is naturally to go through Lord Lian, who is an old brand. — Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 21

explanation: 长驱不停顿地策马快跑；直入一直往前。指长距离不停顿的快速行进。形容进军迅猛，不可阻挡。
explanationTraditional: 長驅不停頓地策馬快跑；直入一直往前。指長距離不停頓的快速行進。形容進軍迅猛，不可阻擋。
explanationEn: To drive straight in; to advance rapidly and unopposed.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策二》轻卒锐兵，长驱至国。”汉·曹操《劳徐晃令》吾用兵三十余年，及所闻古之善用兵者，未有长驱直入敌围者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策二》輕卒銳兵，長驅至國。”漢·曹操《勞徐晃令》吾用兵三十餘年，及所聞古之善用兵者，未有長驅直入敵圍者也。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Yan Strategy 2': 'With light troops and sharp soldiers, drive straight to the capital.' Han Dynasty Cao Cao's 'Commendation for Xu Huang': 'In my thirty years of military command, and among the ancient masters of warfare I have heard of, none have driven straight into the enemy's encirclement.'
example: 我根据数日来的～，满相信着先头部队是已经进入了武昌。★郭沫若《革命春秋·北伐途次》
exampleTraditional: 我根據數日來的～，滿相信著先頭部隊是已經進入了武昌。★郭沫若《革命春秋·北伐途次》
exampleEn: Based on the rapid advance of the past few days, I fully believed that the vanguard had already entered Wuchang. — Guo Moruo, 'Spring and Autumn of the Revolution: Northern Expedition'

explanation: 怡然安适愉快的样子。形容高兴而满足的样子。
explanationTraditional: 怡然安適愉快的樣子。形容高興而滿足的樣子。
explanationEn: Contented and pleased; happily satisfied.
derivation: 《列子·黄帝》黄帝既寤，怡然自得。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·黃帝》黃帝既寤，怡然自得。”
derivationEn: From 'Liezi: Yellow Emperor': 'The Yellow Emperor, after waking, was contented and pleased.'
example: 刘厚守听了，～，坐在椅子上，尽兴地把身子乱摆，一声也不响。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》
exampleTraditional: 劉厚守聽了，～，坐在椅子上，盡興地把身子亂擺，一聲也不響。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》
exampleEn: Liu Houshou, upon hearing this, was contented and pleased, sitting in his chair, swaying his body freely, not making a sound. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure'

explanation: 涎口水。口水挂下三尺长。形容极其贪婪的样子。也形容非常眼热。
explanationTraditional: 涎口水。口水掛下三尺長。形容極其貪婪的樣子。也形容非常眼熱。
explanationEn: To drool with envy; extremely covetous or greedy.
derivation: 老舍《赵子曰》第三章对面坐着一个垂涎三尺的小黑白花狗，挤眉弄眼的希望吃些白薯须子和皮。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《趙子曰》第三章對面坐著一個垂涎三尺的小黑白花狗，擠眉弄眼的希望吃些白薯鬚子和皮。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Zhao Ziyue', Chapter 3: 'Opposite sat a small black-and-white dog drooling three feet long, winking and hoping to get some sweet potato scraps and skin.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 令使；智理智；昏昏乱，神智不清。因贪图私利而失去理智，把什么都忘了。
explanationTraditional: 令使；智理智；昏昏亂，神智不清。因貪圖私利而失去理智，把什麼都忘了。
explanationEn: To be blinded by greed; to lose reason due to selfish interests.
derivation: 《史记·平原君虞卿列传》鄙谚曰‘利令智昏。’平原君（赵胜）负冯亭邪说，使赵陷长平四十余万众，邯郸几亡。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原君虞卿列傳》鄙諺曰‘利令智昏。’平原君（趙勝）負馮亭邪說，使趙陷長平四十餘萬眾，邯鄲幾亡。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Lord Pingyuan and Yu Qing': 'A common saying goes: "Greed makes one lose reason." Lord Pingyuan (Zhao Sheng) was deceived by Feng Ting's evil talk, causing Zhao to lose over 400,000 troops at Changping, and Handan nearly fell.'
example: 独苦国人无识者，～，则不免受其饵矣。★章炳麟《敬告对待间谍者》
exampleTraditional: 獨苦國人無識者，～，則不免受其餌矣。★章炳麟《敬告對待間諜者》
exampleEn: It is only a pity that some ignorant countrymen, blinded by greed, cannot avoid being lured. — Zhang Binglin, 'Respectfully Addressing Those Dealing with Spies'

explanation: 指心神悲沮的样子。
explanationTraditional: 指心神悲沮的樣子。
explanationEn: Feeling dejected and sorrowful.
derivation: 清·百一居士《壶天录》女更黯然神伤，泫然流涕。”
derivationTraditional: 清·百一居士《壺天錄》女更黯然神傷，泫然流涕。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Baiyi Jushi's 'Hutian Lu': 'The woman was even more dejected and sorrowful, tears streaming down her face.'
example: 这个满脸胡须的中年人，扫头看见了船尾妇妇，～的目光突然发亮了。★从维煕《遗落在海滩上的脚印》
exampleTraditional: 這個滿臉鬍鬚的中年人，掃頭看見了船尾婦婦，～的目光突然發亮了。★從維煕《遺落在海灘上的腳印》
exampleEn: The bearded middle-aged man, upon seeing the woman at the stern, his dejected eyes suddenly lit up. — Cong Weixi's 'Footprints Left on the Beach'

explanation: 本不应该生枝的地方生枝。比喻在原有问题之外又岔出了新问题。多指故意设置障碍，使问题不能顺利解决。
explanationTraditional: 本不應該生枝的地方生枝。比喻在原有問題之外又岔出了新問題。多指故意設置障礙，使問題不能順利解決。
explanationEn: To deliberately create complications or raise new issues beyond the original problem, hindering smooth resolution.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《答吕方子约（九月十三日）》随语生解，节上生枝，则更读万卷书，亦无用处也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《答呂方子約（九月十三日）》隨語生解，節上生枝，則更讀萬卷書，亦無用處也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi's 'Reply to Lü Fangzi': 'If you interpret words arbitrarily and create branches on branches, even reading ten thousand books will be useless.'
example: 兀的是闲言语甚意思，他怎肯道～。★元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第二折
exampleTraditional: 兀的是閒言語甚意思，他怎肯道～。★元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第二折
exampleEn: What nonsense is this? How could he deliberately create complications? — Yuan Dynasty, Yang Xianzhi's 'Rain on the Xiao and Xiang Rivers', Act 2

explanation: 投相合。形容双方思想感情融洽，合得来。
explanationTraditional: 投相合。形容雙方思想感情融洽，合得來。
explanationEn: To have mutual affection and be in perfect harmony with each other.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十七回那镇元子与行者结为兄弟，两人情投意合。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十七回那鎮元子與行者結為兄弟，兩人情投意合。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 27: 'Zhen Yuanzi and the Monkey King became sworn brothers, and the two were in perfect harmony.'
example: 我们相聚既久，～，岂不知远别为悲？★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十八回
exampleTraditional: 我們相聚既久，～，豈不知遠別為悲？★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十八回
exampleEn: Having been together for so long and being in perfect harmony, how could we not know the sorrow of parting? — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 68

explanation: 指吉庆之事。
explanationTraditional: 指吉慶之事。
explanationEn: A symbol of auspiciousness and good fortune.
derivation: 《孔丛子·记问》天子布德，将致太平，则麟凤龟龙先为之呈祥。”
derivationTraditional: 《孔叢子·記問》天子佈德，將致太平，則麟鳳龜龍先為之呈祥。”
derivationEn: 'Kongcongzi·Jiwen': 'When the Son of Heaven spreads virtue and brings peace, the unicorn, phoenix, turtle, and dragon first appear as auspicious signs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻出名，显露才能。
explanationTraditional: 比喻出名，顯露才能。
explanationEn: To become famous or show one's talent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧指富贵以后回到故乡‖有向乡里夸耀的意思。
explanationTraditional: 舊指富貴以後回到故鄉‖有向鄉里誇耀的意思。
explanationEn: To return to one's hometown in silken robes, i.e., to return home after achieving wealth and honor, often to show off to the villagers.
derivation: 《旧唐书·姜暮传》衣锦还乡，古人所尚。今以本州相授，用答元功。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·姜暮傳》衣錦還鄉，古人所尚。今以本州相授，用答元功。”
derivationEn: 'Old Book of Tang·Biography of Jiang Mu': 'Returning home in silken robes is what the ancients valued. Now I grant you this prefecture to repay your great merit.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 兵戎武器。以武力相见。指用战争解决问题。
explanationTraditional: 兵戎武器。以武力相見。指用戰爭解決問題。
explanationEn: To meet with weapons; to resort to war to resolve a conflict.
derivation: 吴晗《朱元璋传》第三章二从至正十六年起，张士诚和朱元璋兵戎相见，大小数百战，互有胜负。”
derivationTraditional: 吳晗《朱元璋傳》第三章二從至正十六年起，張士誠和朱元璋兵戎相見，大小數百戰，互有勝負。”
derivationEn: Wu Han's 'Biography of Zhu Yuanzhang', Chapter 3, Section 2: 'From the sixteenth year of Zhizheng onward, Zhang Shicheng and Zhu Yuanzhang met with weapons, fighting hundreds of battles large and small, with victories and defeats on both sides.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 深而大的仇恨。
explanationTraditional: 深而大的仇恨。
explanationEn: Deep and intense hatred.
derivation: 元·杨显之《酷寒亭》第四折从今后深仇积恨都消解。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊顯之《酷寒亭》第四折從今後深仇積恨都消解。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Yang Xianzhi's 'The Cruel Cold Pavilion', Act 4: 'From now on, deep-seated grudges and accumulated hatred are all resolved.'
example: 多年积压的～，象火山的岩浆一样从江水山的身上暴发了！★冯德英《迎春花》第二章
exampleTraditional: 多年積壓的～，象火山的岩漿一樣從江水山的身上暴發了！★馮德英《迎春花》第二章
exampleEn: The deep hatred accumulated over many years erupted like volcanic magma from Jiang Shuishan's body! — Feng Deying's 'Spring Flowers', Chapter 2

explanation: 声名名誉；狼藉杂乱不堪。名声败坏到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 聲名名譽；狼藉雜亂不堪。名聲敗壞到了極點。
explanationEn: Having a very bad reputation; notorious.
derivation: 《史记·蒙恬列传》言其恶声狼藉，布于诸国。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·蒙恬列傳》言其惡聲狼藉，佈於諸國。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian·Biography of Meng Tian': 'Speaking of his evil reputation, it was spread among all the states.'
example: 因汪太史平日～，最不见重于官场，日前新督帅参劾劣绅十七名，实以汪某居首。★清·黄小配《廿载繁华梦》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 因汪太史平日～，最不見重於官場，日前新督帥參劾劣紳十七名，實以汪某居首。★清·黃小配《廿載繁華夢》第三十三回
exampleEn: Because Imperial Inspector Wang had long been notorious and least respected in official circles, when the new governor impeached seventeen corrupt gentry, Wang was ranked first. — Qing Dynasty, Huang Xiaopei's 'Twenty Years of Splendor', Chapter 33

explanation: 指缝隙严密闭合。
explanationTraditional: 指縫隙嚴密閉合。
explanationEn: To fit tightly without any gaps.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第七回外省的地平，多是用木板铺的，上面严丝合缝盖上，轻易看不出来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第七回外省的地平，多是用木板鋪的，上面嚴絲合縫蓋上，輕易看不出來。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 7: 'In other provinces, floors are often made of wooden boards, covered tightly without gaps, making them hard to notice.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 执言说公道话。为了正义说公道话。指能伸张正义。
explanationTraditional: 執言說公道話。為了正義說公道話。指能伸張正義。
explanationEn: To speak out for justice; to uphold righteousness by speaking boldly.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十二此人姓范名汝为，仗义执言，救民水火。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十二此人姓範名汝為，仗義執言，救民水火。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World' (Ming Dynasty): 'This man named Fan Ruwei spoke out for justice, saving the people from misery.'
example: 他性情耿直，总爱～。
exampleTraditional: 他性情耿直，總愛～。
exampleEn: He is straightforward and always speaks out for justice.

explanation: 依然仍旧；故过去，从前。指人没有什么长进，还是从前的老样子。
explanationTraditional: 依然仍舊；故過去，從前。指人沒有什麼長進，還是從前的老樣子。
explanationEn: Still the same as before; unchanged.
derivation: 唐·薛调《刘无双传》舅甥之分，依然如故。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·薛調《劉無雙傳》舅甥之分，依然如故。”
derivationEn: From Xue Diao's 'The Story of Liu Wushuang' (Tang Dynasty): 'The relationship between uncle and nephew remains the same as before.'
example: 他吃、喝、玩、耍，～。★叶圣陶《一个朋友》
exampleTraditional: 他吃、喝、玩、耍，～。★葉聖陶《一個朋友》
exampleEn: He still indulges in eating, drinking, and playing, just as before. — Ye Shengtao, 'A Friend'

explanation: 对答回答。回答问话象流水一样快。形容口才好，反应快。
explanationTraditional: 對答回答。回答問話象流水一樣快。形容口才好，反應快。
explanationEn: To answer fluently and quickly; to have a ready tongue.
derivation: 《北史·李孝伯传》风容闲雅，应答如流。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·李孝伯傳》風容閒雅，應答如流。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Li Xiaobo': 'He was elegant and answered like flowing water.'
example: 众人见孔明～，尽皆失色。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: 眾人見孔明～，盡皆失色。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十三回
exampleEn: Everyone was astonished at Zhuge Liang's fluent answers. — Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'

explanation: 认真学习，刻苦训练。
explanationTraditional: 認真學習，刻苦訓練。
explanationEn: To study diligently and train hard.
derivation: 秦牧《秘诀》他的儿子听后，再不敢妄图侥幸走上捷径，经过真正的勤学苦练，终于也成为书法家。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《秘訣》他的兒子聽後，再不敢妄圖僥倖走上捷徑，經過真正的勤學苦練，終於也成為書法家。”
derivationEn: From Qin Mu's 'The Secret': 'After hearing this, his son no longer dared to seek shortcuts and eventually became a calligrapher through diligent study and hard practice.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 血气精力；方正；刚强劲。形容年青人精力正旺盛。
explanationTraditional: 血氣精力；方正；剛強勁。形容年青人精力正旺盛。
explanationEn: Full of vigor and vitality; in the prime of youth.
derivation: 《论语·季氏》及其壮也，血气方刚，戒之在斗。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·季氏》及其壯也，血氣方剛，戒之在鬥。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Ji Shi': 'When a man is in his prime, his blood and qi are strong; he should guard against fighting.'
example: 公子杨干，乃悼公之同母弟，年方一十九岁，新拜中军戎御之职，～，未经战阵。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 公子楊幹，乃悼公之同母弟，年方一十九歲，新拜中軍戎御之職，～，未經戰陣。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第六十回
exampleEn: Prince Yang Gan, the younger brother of Duke Dao of Jin, was nineteen, newly appointed as a chariot officer, full of vigor but inexperienced in battle. — Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms'

explanation: 指有彩绘装饰的十分华丽的房屋。
explanationTraditional: 指有彩繪裝飾的十分華麗的房屋。
explanationEn: Carved beams and painted rafters; a richly ornamented building.
derivation: 元·王子一《误入桃源》第二折光闪闪贝阙珠宫，齐臻臻碧瓦朱甍，宽绰绰罗帏绣成栊，郁巍巍画梁雕栋。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王子一《誤入桃源》第二折光閃閃貝闕珠宮，齊臻臻碧瓦朱甍，寬綽綽羅幃繡成櫳，鬱巍巍畫樑雕棟。”
derivationEn: From Wang Ziyi's 'Mistaken Entry into the Peach Blossom Spring' (Yuan Dynasty): 'Glistening pearl palaces, neat green tiles and red roofs, spacious embroidered curtains, and majestic carved beams and painted rafters.'
example: 正面五间上房，皆是～，两边穿山游廊厢房，挂着各色鹉画眉等雀儿。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三回
exampleTraditional: 正面五間上房，皆是～，兩邊穿山遊廊廂房，掛著各色鵡畫眉等雀兒。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三回
exampleEn: The five main rooms in the front were all with carved beams and painted rafters, and the side corridors were hung with various parrots and thrushes. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber'

explanation: 孺小孩。妇女、小孩全都知道。指众所周知。
explanationTraditional: 孺小孩。婦女、小孩全都知道。指眾所周知。
explanationEn: Known to women and children alike; universally known.
derivation: 《星火燎原·湘西再起》可是提起他（贺龙）的名字，湘鄂本的人民差不多是妇孺皆知。”
derivationTraditional: 《星火燎原·湘西再起》可是提起他（賀龍）的名字，湘鄂本的人民差不多是婦孺皆知。”
derivationEn: From 'Sparks in the Prairie: Rising Again in Western Hunan': 'But when his (He Long's) name was mentioned, it was known to almost every woman and child in Hunan and Hubei.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 举起沉重的东西像是在摆弄轻的东西。比喻能力强，能够轻松地胜任繁重的工作或处理困难的问题。
explanationTraditional: 舉起沉重的東西像是在擺弄輕的東西。比喻能力強，能夠輕鬆地勝任繁重的工作或處理困難的問題。
explanationEn: To lift a heavy weight as if it were light; to handle difficult tasks with ease.
derivation: 清·赵翼《瓯北诗话·苏东坡诗》二坡诗不尚雄杰一派，其绝人处，在乎议论英爽，笔锋精锐，举重若轻，读之似不甚用力，而力已透十分。”
derivationTraditional: 清·趙翼《甌北詩話·蘇東坡詩》二坡詩不尚雄傑一派，其絕人處，在乎議論英爽，筆鋒精銳，舉重若輕，讀之似不甚用力，而力已透十分。”
derivationEn: From Zhao Yi's 'Notes on Poetry: Su Dongpo' (Qing Dynasty): 'Su Shi's poems do not emphasize grandeur; his excellence lies in clear argumentation, sharp writing, and handling heavy subjects lightly, as if with little effort, yet the force is fully felt.'
example: 公听视机警，受大任～。上爱其才敏，倚若股肱。★清·昭梿《啸亭杂录·七·裘文达公》
exampleTraditional: 公聽視機警，受大任～。上愛其才敏，倚若股肱。★清·昭槤《嘯亭雜錄·七·裘文達公》
exampleEn: He was alert and capable, handling great responsibilities with ease. The emperor loved his talent and relied on him as a pillar. — Zhao Lian, 'Miscellaneous Notes from the Xiaoting Pavilion'

explanation: 凡是知道的没有不说的。
explanationTraditional: 凡是知道的沒有不說的。
explanationEn: To say all that one knows; to be frank and outspoken.
derivation: 宋·苏洵《衡论·远虑》知无不言，言无不尽，百人誉之不加密，百人毁之不加疏。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇洵《衡論·遠慮》知無不言，言無不盡，百人譽之不加密，百人毀之不加疏。”
derivationEn: From Su Xun's 'On Weighing Matters: Far-Reaching Concerns' (Song Dynasty): 'Say all you know, and speak without reserve; do not be more secretive even if praised by a hundred, nor more distant if criticized by a hundred.'
example: 他非常直爽，别人对向他请教，他总是～。
exampleTraditional: 他非常直爽，別人對向他請教，他總是～。
exampleEn: He is very straightforward; whenever someone asks him for advice, he always tells everything he knows.

explanation: 沽卖。等有好价钱才卖。比喻谁给好的待遇就替谁工作。
explanationTraditional: 沽賣。等有好價錢才賣。比喻誰給好的待遇就替誰工作。
explanationEn: To wait for the right price to sell; to wait for a good opportunity to offer one's services.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》沽之哉！沽之哉！，我待贾者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》沽之哉！沽之哉！，我待賈者也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Zi Han': 'Sell it! Sell it! I am waiting for the right buyer.'
example: 象中世纪骑士那样站在虹的桥上，高揭着什么怪好听的旗号，而实在只是出风头，或竟是～。★茅盾《虹》一
exampleTraditional: 象中世紀騎士那樣站在虹的橋上，高揭著什麼怪好聽的旗號，而實在只是出風頭，或竟是～。★茅盾《虹》一
exampleEn: Like a medieval knight standing on a rainbow bridge, raising some fancy banner, but in reality just showing off, or waiting for the right price. — Mao Dun, 'Rainbow'

explanation: 物内容。文章或讲话有具体内容。
explanationTraditional: 物內容。文章或講話有具體內容。
explanationEn: Speech or writing that has substantial content.
derivation: 《周易·家人》君子以言有物而行有恒。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·家人》君子以言有物而行有恆。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Family': 'The gentleman speaks with substance and acts with constancy.'
example: 惟首两句笼罩全篇，末句总结大意，不必～。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 惟首兩句籠罩全篇，末句總結大意，不必～。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十回
exampleEn: Only the first two lines cover the whole chapter, and the last line summarizes the main idea, without necessarily having substantial content. ★ Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 20

explanation: 义道理。词言辞。道理正当公允，严肃的措词。亦作义正辞严”、辞严义正”、辞严意正”、词严理正”、正义严辞”。
explanationTraditional: 義道理。詞言辭。道理正當公允，嚴肅的措詞。亦作義正辭嚴”、辭嚴義正”、辭嚴意正”、詞嚴理正”、正義嚴辭”。
explanationEn: Righteous and stern in speech; speaking with justice and severity.
derivation: 明·胡应麟《少室山房笔丛·丹铅新录四》子玄之论，义正词严，圣人复起，弗能易矣。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡應麟《少室山房筆叢·丹鉛新錄四》子玄之論，義正詞嚴，聖人復起，弗能易矣。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Hu Yinglin's 'Shaoshi Shanfang Bicong: Danqian Xinlu IV': 'Zixuan's argument is righteous and stern; even if a sage were to rise again, it could not be changed.'
example: 本大臣、本部堂声罪致讨，～，断断不能再缓矣。★清·林则徐《会谕同知再行谕饬义律缴土交凶稿》
exampleTraditional: 本大臣、本部堂聲罪致討，～，斷斷不能再緩矣。★清·林則徐《會諭同知再行諭飭義律繳土交兇稿》
exampleEn: This minister and this department head declare the crime and punish, with righteous and stern words, and there can be no further delay. ★ Qing Dynasty, Lin Zexu's 'Joint Notice to the Tongzhi to Again Order Yili to Surrender Opium and Hand Over the Murderer'

explanation: 无常没有常态。指事物经常变化，没有规律性。
explanationTraditional: 無常沒有常態。指事物經常變化，沒有規律性。
explanationEn: Constantly changing without regularity.
derivation: 《庄子·天下》忽漠无形，变化无常。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天下》忽漠無形，變化無常。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Tianxia': 'Vague and formless, changing without constancy.'
example: 近来天气～，一会儿晴空万里，一会儿又大雨倾盆。
exampleTraditional: 近來天氣～，一會兒晴空萬里，一會兒又大雨傾盆。
exampleEn: Recently the weather has been constantly changing, sometimes clear and sunny, sometimes pouring rain.

explanation: 迷途迷失道路；返回来。迷了路知道回来。比喻发觉自己犯了错误，知道改正。
explanationTraditional: 迷途迷失道路；返回來。迷了路知道回來。比喻發覺自己犯了錯誤，知道改正。
explanationEn: To realize one's mistakes and turn back; to correct one's errors.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·袁术传》以身试祸，岂不痛哉！若迷而知反，尚可以免。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·袁術傳》以身試禍，豈不痛哉！若迷而知反，尚可以免。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Yuan Shu': 'To test disaster with one's own body, is it not painful! If one is lost and knows to return, it can still be avoided.'
example: 夫～，往哲是也。★南朝·梁·丘迟《与陈伯之书》
exampleTraditional: 夫～，往哲是也。★南朝·梁·丘遲《與陳伯之書》
exampleEn: To realize one's mistakes and turn back is the way of the ancients. ★ Southern Liang Dynasty, Qiu Chi's 'Letter to Chen Bozhi'

explanation: 耸直立，高起。高高地直立，直入云端。形容建筑物、山峰等高峻挺拔。
explanationTraditional: 聳直立，高起。高高地直立，直入雲端。形容建築物、山峰等高峻挺拔。
explanationEn: Towering into the clouds; extremely tall and majestic.
derivation: 刘伯承《回忆长征》翻越了高耸入云的雪山，跋涉了渺无人烟的草原。”
derivationTraditional: 劉伯承《回憶長征》翻越了高聳入雲的雪山，跋涉了渺無人煙的草原。”
derivationEn: From Liu Bocheng's 'Recalling the Long March': 'Crossed snow-capped mountains towering into the clouds, trekked through desolate grasslands.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容不畏艰险，在前开道。
explanationTraditional: 形容不畏艱險，在前開道。
explanationEn: To open a path when encountering mountains; to overcome obstacles and forge ahead.
derivation: 元·纪君祥《赵氏孤儿》楔子旁边转过一个壮士，一臂扶轮，一手策马，逢山开路，救出赵盾去了。”
derivationTraditional: 元·紀君祥《趙氏孤兒》楔子旁邊轉過一個壯士，一臂扶輪，一手策馬，逢山開路，救出趙盾去了。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Ji Junxiang's 'The Orphan of Zhao: Prologue': 'A strong man came from the side, supporting the wheel with one arm and whipping the horse with the other, opening paths when encountering mountains, and rescued Zhao Dun.'
example: 军旅～，遇水迭桥，岂有泥泞不堪之理。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十回
exampleTraditional: 軍旅～，遇水迭橋，豈有泥濘不堪之理。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十回
exampleEn: The army opens paths when encountering mountains and builds bridges when meeting rivers; how could it be unreasonable to be stuck in mud? ★ Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 50

explanation: 一个人呼喊，马上有很多人响应。
explanationTraditional: 一個人呼喊，馬上有很多人響應。
explanationEn: One call brings a hundred responses; to have many followers or supporters.
derivation: 汉·韩婴《韩诗外传》第五卷当前快意，一呼再诺者，人隶也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·韓嬰《韓詩外傳》第五卷當前快意，一呼再諾者，人隸也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Han Ying's 'Han Shi Wai Zhuan', Volume 5: 'Immediate gratification, one call and many responses, are the ways of servants.'
example: 农会会员漫山遍野，梭镖短棍～，土匪无处藏踪。★毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》
exampleTraditional: 農會會員漫山遍野，梭鏢短棍～，土匪無處藏蹤。★毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》
exampleEn: The peasant association members are everywhere, with spears and short clubs, and one call brings a hundred responses, leaving no place for bandits to hide. ★ Mao Zedong's 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan'

explanation: 舍古时行军计程以三十里为一舍。主动退让九十里。比喻退让和回避，避免冲突。
explanationTraditional: 舍古時行軍計程以三十里為一舍。主動退讓九十里。比喻退讓和迴避，避免衝突。
explanationEn: To retreat ninety li (about 30 miles) to avoid conflict; to yield and avoid confrontation.
derivation: 《左传·僖公二十三年》晋楚治兵，遇于中原，其辟君三舍。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公二十三年》晉楚治兵，遇於中原，其辟君三舍。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's 23rd Year': 'When Jin and Chu engage in battle, meeting in the central plains, I will retreat three she (90 li) for you.'
example: 我说姊姊不过，只得～了。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 我說姊姊不過，只得～了。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四十二回
exampleEn: I cannot argue with my sister, so I have to retreat and avoid conflict. ★ Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 42

explanation: 人才和文物众多，并聚集在一地。
explanationTraditional: 人才和文物眾多，並聚集在一地。
explanationEn: A gathering of talented people and cultural treasures; a place rich in culture and talent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这个地方山明水秀，～，是个值得浏览的好去处。
exampleTraditional: 這個地方山明水秀，～，是個值得瀏覽的好去處。
exampleEn: This place has beautiful mountains and rivers, and is a gathering of talented people and cultural treasures, making it a great place to visit.

explanation: 在困苦中勉强自寻欢乐。
explanationTraditional: 在困苦中勉強自尋歡樂。
explanationEn: To find joy in hardship; to seek pleasure amidst suffering.
derivation: 宋·陈造《同陈宰黄簿游灵山八首》自注宰运‘吾辈可谓忙里偷闲，苦中作乐。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳造《同陳宰黃簿遊靈山八首》自注宰運‘吾輩可謂忙裡偷閒，苦中作樂。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Chen Zao's 'Traveling with Chen Zai and Huang Bu to Lingshan, Eight Poems', self-annotation: 'The magistrate said, 'We can be said to snatch leisure from busyness and find joy in hardship.'''
example: 此第三首，则俗所谓～也。言山行之可畏若此，而于其中强寻乐处，则亦有可喜者。★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷十
exampleTraditional: 此第三首，則俗所謂～也。言山行之可畏若此，而於其中強尋樂處，則亦有可喜者。★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷十
exampleEn: This third poem is what the common people call finding joy in hardship. It describes the fearfulness of mountain travel, yet in the midst of it, one forcibly seeks joy, and there are also things to be happy about. ★ Qing Dynasty, Anonymous's 'Du Shi Yan Zhi', Volume 10

explanation: 从听从；善好的，正确的；如流好象流水向下，形容迅速。形容能迅速地接受别人的好意见。
explanationTraditional: 從聽從；善好的，正確的；如流好象流水向下，形容迅速。形容能迅速地接受別人的好意見。
explanationEn: To readily accept good advice; to follow good advice as naturally as water flows.
derivation: 《左传·成公八年》君子曰从善如流，宜哉。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公八年》君子曰從善如流，宜哉。”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan, Duke Cheng, 8th year: 'A gentleman said, "Following good advice is like water flowing—how fitting!"'
example: 八毛！”他也立刻懂得，将五分钱让去，真是～”，有正人君子的风度。★鲁迅《华盖集续编·马上日记》
exampleTraditional: 八毛！”他也立刻懂得，將五分錢讓去，真是～”，有正人君子的風度。★魯迅《華蓋集續編·馬上日記》
exampleEn: 'Eight cents!' He immediately understood and gave up the five cents, truly 'following good advice like water flowing,' with the demeanor of a righteous gentleman. —Lu Xun, Huagai Collection Continued, Diary on Horseback

explanation: 生生硬。指不顾实际情况，机械地运用别人的经验，照抄别人的办法。
explanationTraditional: 生生硬。指不顧實際情況，機械地運用別人的經驗，照抄別人的辦法。
explanationEn: To mechanically apply or copy others' methods without regard to actual circumstances; to use indiscriminately.
derivation: 马南邨《燕山夜话·不吃羊肉吃菜羹》有人背诵了几篇祭文，背得烂熟，到了考试的时候，题目是祝寿的，他居然生搬硬套地把祭文抄上去，弄得牛头不对马嘴。”
derivationTraditional: 馬南邨《燕山夜話·不吃羊肉吃菜羹》有人背誦了幾篇祭文，背得爛熟，到了考試的時候，題目是祝壽的，他居然生搬硬套地把祭文抄上去，弄得牛頭不對馬嘴。”
derivationEn: Ma Nancun, Yanshan Night Talks: 'Someone memorized several funeral orations and, when the exam topic was a birthday congratulation, he mechanically copied the funeral oration, resulting in a complete mismatch.'
example: 学习不是～，生活中的语言也不能原封不动地运用，需要提炼。★老舍《语言、人物、戏剧》
exampleTraditional: 學習不是～，生活中的語言也不能原封不動地運用，需要提煉。★老舍《語言、人物、戲劇》
exampleEn: Learning is not about mechanical copying; language in life cannot be used verbatim and needs refinement. —Lao She, Language, Characters, Drama

explanation: 薪柴草。睡觉睡在柴草上，吃饭睡觉都尝一尝苦胆。形容人刻苦自励，发奋图强。
explanationTraditional: 薪柴草。睡覺睡在柴草上，吃飯睡覺都嘗一嘗苦膽。形容人刻苦自勵，發奮圖強。
explanationEn: To sleep on brushwood and taste gall; to undergo self-imposed hardships to achieve a goal; to work hard with determination.
derivation: 《史记·越王勾践世家》越王勾路反国，乃苦身焦思，置胆于坐，坐卧即仰胆，饮食亦尝胆也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·越王勾踐世家》越王勾路反國，乃苦身焦思，置膽於坐，坐臥即仰膽，飲食亦嘗膽也。”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian, House of King Goujian of Yue: 'King Goujian of Yue, upon returning to his state, tormented himself and set gall beside his seat, looking at it when sitting or lying, and tasting it when eating or drinking.'
example: 中国足球要想冲出亚洲，必须～，刻苦训练。
exampleTraditional: 中國足球要想衝出亞洲，必須～，刻苦訓練。
exampleEn: For Chinese football to break into Asia, they must 'sleep on brushwood and taste gall' and train hard.

explanation: 故老友。不是亲属，也不是熟人。表示彼此没有什么关系。
explanationTraditional: 故老友。不是親屬，也不是熟人。表示彼此沒有什麼關係。
explanationEn: Neither relative nor friend; having no relationship with someone.
derivation: 唐·马戴《寄贾岛》诗佩玉与铿金，非亲亦非故。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·馬戴《寄賈島》詩佩玉與鏗金，非親亦非故。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Ma Dai, 'To Jia Dao': 'Wearing jade and striking gold, neither relative nor friend.'
example: 虽承王翁盛意，～，难以打搅。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三十四
exampleTraditional: 雖承王翁盛意，～，難以打攪。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三十四
exampleEn: Although I appreciate your kindness, we are neither relatives nor friends, so it's hard to impose. —Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, Stories to Caution the World, Chapter 34

explanation: 抬起头，挺起胸膛。形容斗志高，士气旺。
explanationTraditional: 抬起頭，挺起胸膛。形容鬥志高，士氣旺。
explanationEn: To hold one's head high and chest out; to be full of spirit and morale.
derivation: 欧阳予情《小英姑娘》她伸开两手昂首挺胸，狂了似的往外跑。”
derivationTraditional: 歐陽予情《小英姑娘》她伸開兩手昂首挺胸，狂了似的往外跑。”
derivationEn: Ouyang Yuqian, 'Miss Xiao Ying': 'She stretched out her arms, held her head high and chest out, and ran out like a madwoman.'
example: 个个视死如归，坚贞不屈，～站在那里。王之燕同志领头高呼起口号。★《上饶集中营·浩气长存》
exampleTraditional: 個個視死如歸，堅貞不屈，～站在那裡。王之燕同志領頭高呼起口號。★《上饒集中營·浩氣長存》
exampleEn: Each one faced death calmly, unyielding, standing with head high and chest out. Comrade Wang Zhiyan led the shouting of slogans. —Shangrao Concentration Camp, Eternal Spirit

explanation: 使、差指使∶象有鬼神在支使着一样，不自觉地做了原先没想到要做的事。
explanationTraditional: 使、差指使∶象有鬼神在支使著一樣，不自覺地做了原先沒想到要做的事。
explanationEn: As if driven by ghosts or gods; to do something unconsciously or unexpectedly.
derivation: 元·无名氏《碧桃花》第四折这一场悄促促似鬼使神差。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《碧桃花》第四折這一場悄促促似鬼使神差。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Peach Blossom', Act 4: 'This scene is quietly like being driven by ghosts and gods.'
example: 正是呢，这是一高兴起灶，～来了这些人。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 正是呢，這是一高興起灶，～來了這些人。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十九回
exampleEn: Exactly, it was a sudden whim to start a kitchen, and as if driven by ghosts and gods, these people came. —Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 49

explanation: 大势事情发展的趋势。有利的形势已经丧失，前途已经没有希望。
explanationTraditional: 大勢事情發展的趨勢。有利的形勢已經喪失，前途已經沒有希望。
explanationEn: The favorable situation is lost; there is no hope for the future.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子谏类》卷五十一程子说天命之改，莫是大势已去。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子諫類》卷五十一程子說天命之改，莫是大勢已去。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, Zhu Zi's Classified Conversations, Volume 51: 'Chengzi said that the change of heaven's mandate is probably when the general trend has passed.'
example: 纣王看见，不觉大惊，知～，非人力可挽。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第九十七回
exampleTraditional: 紂王看見，不覺大驚，知～，非人力可挽。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第九十七回
exampleEn: King Zhou was greatly shocked and realized that the general trend had passed and could not be saved by human effort. —Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, Investiture of the Gods, Chapter 97

explanation: 不住地叫苦。形容十分痛苦。
explanationTraditional: 不住地叫苦。形容十分痛苦。
explanationEn: To complain bitterly incessantly; to be in great pain or distress.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第五十五回你怎么正战到好处，却就叫苦连天的走了？”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第五十五回你怎麼正戰到好處，卻就叫苦連天的走了？”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, Journey to the West, Chapter 55: 'Why did you, in the midst of battle, cry out in pain and run away?'
example: 今番受了轮船火车上下劳顿，早害得他～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 今番受了輪船火車上下勞頓，早害得他～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十五回
exampleEn: This time, suffering from the fatigue of steamship and train travel, he was already complaining bitterly. —Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, The Bureaucrats Revealed, Chapter 35

explanation: 什么奇怪的事物都有。
explanationTraditional: 什麼奇怪的事物都有。
explanationEn: There is no strange thing that does not exist; all kinds of strange things can be found.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第九回上海地方，无奇不有，倘能在那里多盘桓些日子，新闻还多着呢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第九回上海地方，無奇不有，倘能在那裡多盤桓些日子，新聞還多著呢。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years, Chapter 9: 'Shanghai is a place where nothing is too strange; if you could stay there longer, there would be even more news.'
example: 海底世界～，光是已知的动物就有三万多种。
exampleTraditional: 海底世界～，光是已知的動物就有三萬多種。
exampleEn: The underwater world is full of wonders; there are over 30,000 known animal species alone.

explanation: 树种植，栽培。比喻培养人才是长期而艰巨的事。
explanationTraditional: 樹種植，栽培。比喻培養人才是長期而艱鉅的事。
explanationEn: It takes a hundred years to cultivate a person; nurturing talent is a long-term and arduous task.
derivation: 《管子·权修》一年之计，莫如树谷；十年之计，莫如树木，终身之计，莫如树人。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·權修》一年之計，莫如樹谷；十年之計，莫如樹木，終身之計，莫如樹人。”
derivationEn: Guanzi, 'On Power': 'A one-year plan is best for planting grain; a ten-year plan is best for planting trees; a lifelong plan is best for cultivating people.'
example: 古人都知道～的道理，我们更应该把培养人才这件大事抓好。
exampleTraditional: 古人都知道～的道理，我們更應該把培養人才這件大事抓好。
exampleEn: The ancients understood the principle of 'it takes a hundred years to cultivate a person,' and we should pay even more attention to the important task of nurturing talent.

explanation: 戮力并力；同心齐心。齐心合力。
explanationTraditional: 戮力併力；同心齊心。齊心合力。
explanationEn: To unite in a concerted effort; to work together with one heart.
derivation: 《墨子·尚贤》《汤誓》曰‘聿求元圣，与之戮力同心，以治天下。’”
derivationTraditional: 《墨子·尚賢》《湯誓》曰‘聿求元聖，與之戮力同心，以治天下。’”
derivationEn: From 'Mozi·Shangxian' quoting 'Tangshi': 'Seek the great sage, and unite with him in a concerted effort to govern the world.'
example: 以为足下当～，匡翼汉室，而阴谋不轨，以身试祸，岂不痛哉。★《三国志·魏志·袁术传》
exampleTraditional: 以為足下當～，匡翼漢室，而陰謀不軌，以身試禍，豈不痛哉。★《三國志·魏志·袁術傳》
exampleEn: I thought you would unite in a concerted effort to support the Han dynasty, but instead you plotted treason and brought disaster upon yourself—how painful!

explanation: 卑低、自卑；亢高傲。指对人有恰当的分寸，既不低声下气，也不傲慢自大。
explanationTraditional: 卑低、自卑；亢高傲。指對人有恰當的分寸，既不低聲下氣，也不傲慢自大。
explanationEn: Neither humble nor arrogant; to behave with appropriate dignity and modesty.
derivation: 明·朱之瑜《答小宅生顺书十九首》圣贤自有中正之道，不亢不卑，不骄不诌，何得如此也！”
derivationTraditional: 明·朱之瑜《答小宅生順書十九首》聖賢自有中正之道，不亢不卑，不驕不謅，何得如此也！”
derivationEn: From Zhu Zhiyu's 'Reply to Xiaozhai Shunsheng's Letter': 'The sage has a middle way, neither arrogant nor humble, neither proud nor flattering.'
example: 老张虽着急，可是龙树古～的支应，使老张无可发作。★老舍《老张的哲学》
exampleTraditional: 老張雖著急，可是龍樹古～的支應，使老張無可發作。★老舍《老張的哲學》
exampleEn: Although Old Zhang was anxious, Long Shugu's neither humble nor arrogant manner left him with nothing to vent.

explanation: 元勋有特大功绩的人。指为建立新的国家或朝代立大功的人。
explanationTraditional: 元勳有特大功績的人。指為建立新的國家或朝代立大功的人。
explanationEn: A founding father; a person who made great contributions to the establishment of a new country or dynasty.
derivation: 明·周楫《西湖二集·吴山顶上神仙》那时第一个开国元勋青田刘伯温先生与冷启敬相好，时常以道术互相参证。”
derivationTraditional: 明·周楫《西湖二集·吳山頂上神仙》那時第一個開國元勳青田劉伯溫先生與冷啟敬相好，時常以道術互相參證。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Zhou Ji's 'West Lake Stories': 'At that time, the first founding father, Liu Bowen of Qingtian, was close friends with Leng Qijing.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 毫无根据的话。指背后散布的诽谤性的坏话。
explanationTraditional: 毫無根據的話。指背後散佈的誹謗性的壞話。
explanationEn: Groundless rumors; slanderous gossip spread behind one's back.
derivation: 《礼记·儒行》久不相见，闻流言不信。”《史记·魏其武安侯列传》乃有蜚语，为恶言闻上。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·儒行》久不相見，聞流言不信。”《史記·魏其武安侯列傳》乃有蜚語，為惡言聞上。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites·Ruxing': 'Long without meeting, hearing rumors but not believing.' And 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'Then there were slanderous words, malicious talk reaching the emperor.'
example: 村里人传开了～，说什么夏家的寡妇不正派，伤风败俗。★杨朔《渔笛》
exampleTraditional: 村裡人傳開了～，說什麼夏家的寡婦不正派，傷風敗俗。★楊朔《漁笛》
exampleEn: Rumors spread in the village, saying that the widow of the Xia family was immoral and corrupting public morals.

explanation: 委曲曲意迁就。勉强迁就，以求保全。也指为了顾全大局而让步。
explanationTraditional: 委曲曲意遷就。勉強遷就，以求保全。也指為了顧全大局而讓步。
explanationEn: To compromise or make concessions for the sake of preserving something; to stoop in order to achieve a larger goal.
derivation: 《汉书·严彭祖传》何可委曲从俗，苟求富贵乎！”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·嚴彭祖傳》何可委曲從俗，苟求富貴乎！”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han·Yan Pengzu Biography': 'How can one stoop to follow custom and seek wealth and honor?'
example: ～的苟活决不是真正的生。★郭沫若《战声》诗
exampleTraditional: ～的苟活決不是真正的生。★郭沫若《戰聲》詩
exampleEn: A life of compromise and survival is not true life.

explanation: 居心存心；叵不可；测推测。指存心险恶，不可推测。
explanationTraditional: 居心存心；叵不可；測推測。指存心險惡，不可推測。
explanationEn: To harbor unfathomable evil intentions; to have a sinister motive that is hard to predict.
derivation: 清·洪楝园《县巗猿·归神》都是这一个狗才设计骗将出来，以为自己富贵之地，是以吾阁部为奇货，居心叵测，天理不容。”
derivationTraditional: 清·洪楝園《縣巗猿·歸神》都是這一個狗才設計騙將出來，以為自己富貴之地，是以吾閣部為奇貨，居心叵測，天理不容。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Hong Qiyuan's 'Xian Yan Yuan·Gui Shen': 'That scoundrel devised a scheme to deceive him for his own wealth and status, treating our governor as a rare commodity—his intentions are unfathomable and heaven cannot tolerate it.'
example: 他是个～的家伙，要多加提防。
exampleTraditional: 他是個～的傢伙，要多加提防。
exampleEn: He is a person with unfathomable intentions; we must be extra cautious.

explanation: 盐任用贤能的人。亦作选贤与能”、选贤举能”。
explanationTraditional: 鹽任用賢能的人。亦作選賢與能”、選賢舉能”。
explanationEn: To select and appoint virtuous and capable people.
derivation: 《旧唐书·食货志上》设官分职，选贤任能，得其人则有益于国家，非其才则贻患于黎庶，此以不可不知也。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·食貨志上》設官分職，選賢任能，得其人則有益於國家，非其才則貽患於黎庶，此以不可不知也。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang·Food and Goods': 'Establish officials and assign duties, select the virtuous and appoint the capable; if the right person is obtained, it benefits the state; if not, it harms the people.'
example: 以道言之，～以匡社稷者，天下之公也。★清王夫之《读通鉴论·汉成帝》
exampleTraditional: 以道言之，～以匡社稷者，天下之公也。★清王夫之《讀通鑑論·漢成帝》
exampleEn: From a moral perspective, selecting the virtuous and appointing the capable to rectify the state is a matter of public interest.
