explanation: 匠心巧妙的心思。指在技巧和艺术方面具有与众不同的巧妙构思。
explanationTraditional: 匠心巧妙的心思。指在技巧和藝術方面具有與眾不同的巧妙構思。
explanationEn: To have a unique and ingenious design or idea, especially in art or craftsmanship.
derivation: 唐·王士源《孟浩然集序》文不按古，匠心独妙。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王士源《孟浩然集序》文不按古，匠心獨妙。”
derivationEn: From Tang dynasty Wang Shiyuan's 'Preface to Meng Haoran's Collection': 'His writing does not follow ancient conventions, but his craftsmanship is uniquely ingenious.'
example: 《蕃锦集》运用成语，～。★清·陈廷焯《白雨斋词话》
exampleTraditional: 《蕃錦集》運用成語，～。★清·陳廷焯《白雨齋詞話》
exampleEn: The 'Fan Jin Ji' uses idioms with unique ingenuity.

explanation: 原指说话做事有条有理，不慌不忙。现也形容说话做事慢腾腾，不不慌不忙。
explanationTraditional: 原指說話做事有條有理，不慌不忙。現也形容說話做事慢騰騰，不不慌不忙。
explanationEn: To speak or act slowly and methodically, without haste; now often implies being leisurely or unhurried.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第三本第二折金圣叹批写红娘从张生边来入闺中，慢条斯理，如在意如不在意。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第三本第二折金聖嘆批寫紅娘從張生邊來入閨中，慢條斯理，如在意如不在意。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing', with commentary by Jin Shengtan: 'Hongniang comes from Zhang Sheng's side into the boudoir, slow and methodical, as if attentive yet indifferent.'
example: 办事要思量是对的”，老山东～的说，不过有的是明摆着的事，也不要掂量。”★冯德英《苦菜花》第八章
exampleTraditional: 辦事要思量是對的”，老山東～的說，不過有的是明擺著的事，也不要掂量。”★馮德英《苦菜花》第八章
exampleEn: 'One must think things through when handling affairs,' Old Shandong said slowly and methodically, 'but some things are obvious and need no deliberation.'

explanation: 搬弄是非，使别人不团结。
explanationTraditional: 搬弄是非，使別人不團結。
explanationEn: To sow discord; to stir up trouble and cause disunity among people.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: ～的人，有着不可告人的目的。
exampleTraditional: ～的人，有著不可告人的目的。
exampleEn: Those who sow discord have ulterior motives.

explanation: 恩、惠给人的好处。为了笼络人而给人的一点好处。
explanationTraditional: 恩、惠給人的好處。為了籠絡人而給人的一點好處。
explanationEn: Small favors or petty kindnesses given to win someone's favor or to manipulate them.
derivation: 清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第三回偶有一个狡猾的民贼出来，略用些小恩小惠来抚弄他，他便欢天喜地感恩戴德。”
derivationTraditional: 清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第三回偶有一個狡猾的民賊出來，略用些小恩小惠來撫弄他，他便歡天喜地感恩戴德。”
derivationEn: From 'The Eastern European Heroine' by Qing Dynasty author Lingnan Yiyi Nushi, Chapter 3: 'Occasionally a cunning tyrant would appear, using some small favors to placate the people, and they would be overjoyed and grateful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 士对人的尊称。指有理想有抱负的人。
explanationTraditional: 士對人的尊稱。指有理想有抱負的人。
explanationEn: A person with ideals and aspirations; a person of noble ambition.
derivation: 宋·陆九渊《与曾宅之书》惟其生于后世，学绝道丧，异端邪说充塞弥满，遂使有志之士罹此患害，乃与世间凡庸恣情纵欲之人均其陷溺，此岂非以学术杀天下哉。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸九淵《與曾宅之書》惟其生於後世，學絕道喪，異端邪說充塞彌滿，遂使有志之士罹此患害，乃與世間凡庸恣情縱欲之人均其陷溺，此豈非以學術殺天下哉。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Lu Jiuyuan's 'Letter to Zeng Zhaizhi': 'Born in later ages, learning is lost and the Way is abandoned, heresies fill the world, causing men of ambition to suffer this harm...'
example: 此洪君是广东～，与弟莫逆交，都不用客气。★清·黄小配《洪秀全演义》第五回
exampleTraditional: 此洪君是廣東～，與弟莫逆交，都不用客氣。★清·黃小配《洪秀全演義》第五回
exampleEn: This Mr. Hong is a man of ambition from Guangdong, and a close friend of mine; there is no need for formalities. (From Qing Dynasty Huang Xiaopei's 'The Romance of Hong Xiuquan', Chapter 5)

explanation: 革改变，革除；故旧的；鼎树立。旧指朝政变革或改朝换代。现泛指除去旧的，建立新的。
explanationTraditional: 革改變，革除；故舊的；鼎樹立。舊指朝政變革或改朝換代。現泛指除去舊的，建立新的。
explanationEn: To abolish the old and establish the new; to reform or innovate.
derivation: 《周易·杂卦》革，去故也，鼎，取新也。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·雜卦》革，去故也，鼎，取新也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Miscellaneous Hexagrams': 'Ge means removing the old; Ding means taking up the new.'
example: 北京地方，受历代君主的压力，害得毫无生气，此后～，当有一番佳境。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第七回
exampleTraditional: 北京地方，受歷代君主的壓力，害得毫無生氣，此後～，當有一番佳境。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第七回
exampleEn: Beijing, oppressed by successive emperors, has been lifeless; from now on, with reforms, there should be a better scene. (From Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 7)

explanation: 谆谆恳切、耐心的样子。恳切、耐心地教导。
explanationTraditional: 諄諄懇切、耐心的樣子。懇切、耐心地教導。
explanationEn: To teach earnestly and patiently.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·抑》诲尔谆谆，听我藐藐。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·抑》誨爾諄諄，聽我藐藐。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Greater Odes: Yi': 'I instruct you earnestly, but you listen carelessly.'
example: 父亲，您生前～我们，不要那种脱离人民的虚无主义、个人主义。★毛岸青《我们爱韶山的红杜鹃》
exampleTraditional: 父親，您生前～我們，不要那種脫離人民的虛無主義、個人主義。★毛岸青《我們愛韶山的紅杜鵑》
exampleEn: Father, you earnestly taught us not to embrace the nihilism and individualism that separates from the people. (From Mao Anqing's 'We Love the Red Azaleas of Shaoshan')

explanation: 罪恶大到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 罪惡大到了極點。
explanationEn: Extremely heinous; guilty of the most terrible crimes.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《纵囚论》刑入于死者，乃罪大恶极。”宋·罗大经《鹤林玉露》卷五矧如（秦）桧者，密奉虏谋，胁君误国，罪大恶极 ，岂可赦乎。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《縱囚論》刑入於死者，乃罪大惡極。”宋·羅大經《鶴林玉露》卷五矧如（秦）檜者，密奉虜謀，脅君誤國，罪大惡極 ，豈可赦乎。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'On Letting Prisoners Go': 'Those sentenced to death are guilty of the most heinous crimes.' Also from Song Dynasty Luo Dajing's 'Crane Forest Jade Dew': 'Qin Hui, secretly serving the enemy, coerced the ruler and harmed the state, his crimes were most heinous.'
example: 倘不如命地帮忙”，当然，～了。先将忘恩负义之罪，布告于天下。★鲁迅《而已集·新时代的放债法》
exampleTraditional: 倘不如命地幫忙”，當然，～了。先將忘恩負義之罪，佈告於天下。★魯迅《而已集·新時代的放債法》
exampleEn: If one does not 'help' as told, of course, it is a most heinous crime. First, the crime of ingratitude is announced to the world. (From Lu Xun's 'And So On: The New Way of Lending Money')

explanation: 所有的想法和打算都破灭了。形容极端灰心失望的心情。
explanationTraditional: 所有的想法和打算都破滅了。形容極端灰心失望的心情。
explanationEn: All hopes and thoughts are shattered; extremely disheartened and despairing.
derivation: 清·南亭亭长《中国现在记》三回官场上的人情，最是势利不过的。大家见抚台不理，谁还来理我呢，想到这里，万念俱灰。”
derivationTraditional: 清·南亭亭長《中國現在記》三回官場上的人情，最是勢利不過的。大家見撫臺不理，誰還來理我呢，想到這裡，萬念俱灰。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Nanting Tingzhang's 'China Now', Chapter 3: 'Officialdom is most fickle. Seeing that the governor ignored me, who would still care? Thinking of this, all hopes were shattered.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 装点装饰；门面指外观。比喻只把外表装饰得很漂亮。
explanationTraditional: 裝點裝飾；門面指外觀。比喻只把外表裝飾得很漂亮。
explanationEn: To decorate the facade; to maintain a superficial appearance.
derivation: 元·秦简夫《东堂老》第一折止则有这两件儿衣服，装点着门面。”
derivationTraditional: 元·秦簡夫《東堂老》第一折止則有這兩件兒衣服，裝點著門面。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Qin Jianfu's 'The Eastern Hall Elder', Act 1: 'I have only these two clothes to decorate the facade.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 享享受；成成果。自己不出力而享受别人取得的成果。
explanationTraditional: 享享受；成成果。自己不出力而享受別人取得的成果。
explanationEn: To sit back and enjoy the fruits of others' labor; to reap without sowing.
derivation: 清·叶廷琯《鸥陂渔话·葛苍公传》欲使他人干事，彼坐享其成，必误公事。”
derivationTraditional: 清·葉廷琯《鷗陂漁話·葛蒼公傳》欲使他人幹事，彼坐享其成，必誤公事。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ye Tingguan's 'Anecdotes from Oubi Fishing: Biography of Ge Canggong': 'He wants others to do the work while he sits back and enjoys the results, which will surely delay official business.'
example: 人要有勤奋自力，积极向上的精神，不可有～，好逸恶劳的思想。
exampleTraditional: 人要有勤奮自力，積極向上的精神，不可有～，好逸惡勞的思想。
exampleEn: People should be diligent and self-reliant, with a positive spirit; they should not have the mentality of reaping without sowing and being idle.

explanation: 平平稳；步行走；青云高空。指人一下子升到很高的地位上去。
explanationTraditional: 平平穩；步行走；青雲高空。指人一下子升到很高的地位上去。
explanationEn: To rapidly rise to a high position; to have a meteoric rise.
derivation: 《史记·范睢蔡泽列传》须贾顿首言死罪，曰‘贾不意君能自致于青云之上。’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·範睢蔡澤列傳》須賈頓首言死罪，曰‘賈不意君能自致於青雲之上。’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Fan Ju and Cai Ze': 'Xu Jia kowtowed and said, 'I did not expect you to reach such a high position on your own.''
example: 本图平步上青云，直为红颜滞此身。★元·关汉卿《谢天香》楔子
exampleTraditional: 本圖平步上青雲，直為紅顏滯此身。★元·關漢卿《謝天香》楔子
exampleEn: Originally aiming to rise swiftly to high office, but delayed by a beautiful woman. (From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Xie Tianxiang', Prologue)

explanation: 诚实在，的确；惶害怕；恐畏惧。非常小心谨慎以至达到害怕不安的程度。
explanationTraditional: 誠實在，的確；惶害怕；恐畏懼。非常小心謹慎以至達到害怕不安的程度。
explanationEn: In a state of extreme fear and trepidation; reverently and fearfully.
derivation: 汉·杜诗《乞退郡疏》奉职无效，久窃禄位，令功臣怀愠，诚惶诚恐。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·杜詩《乞退郡疏》奉職無效，久竊祿位，令功臣懷慍，誠惶誠恐。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Du Shi's 'Petition to Resign': 'I have been ineffective in my duties, long occupying a position without merit, causing resentment among meritorious officials; I am truly fearful and trembling.'
example: 一些成了惊弓之鸟的部员们算也～地先后把那段危险的地面通过了。★郭沫若《北伐途中》二十一
exampleTraditional: 一些成了驚弓之鳥的部員們算也～地先後把那段危險的地面通過了。★郭沫若《北伐途中》二十一
exampleEn: Some staff members, like birds startled by the mere twang of a bowstring, fearfully and tremblingly passed through that dangerous section one after another. (From Guo Moruo's 'During the Northern Expedition', Chapter 21)

explanation: 谈笑时的容貌和神态。用以怀念故人的声音容貌和神情。
explanationTraditional: 談笑時的容貌和神態。用以懷念故人的聲音容貌和神情。
explanationEn: The voice, appearance, and smile of a deceased person, used to recall their memory.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄上》恭俭岂可以声音笑貌为哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁上》恭儉豈可以聲音笑貌為哉？”
derivationEn: Mencius, Li Lou I: 'How can respect and frugality be expressed merely by voice and smile?'
example: 所以直到现在，先生的～，还在目前，而所讲的《说文解字》却一句也不记得了。（鲁迅《关于太炎先生二三事》）
exampleTraditional: 所以直到現在，先生的～，還在目前，而所講的《說文解字》卻一句也不記得了。（魯迅《關於太炎先生二三事》）
exampleEn: So even now, his voice and smile are still before my eyes, but I don't remember a single word of his lecture on 'Explaining Simple and Analyzing Compound Characters.' (Lu Xun, 'A Few Matters Concerning Mr. Taiyan')

explanation: 达官大官。指地位高的大官和出身侯门身价显赫的人。
explanationTraditional: 達官大官。指地位高的大官和出身侯門身價顯赫的人。
explanationEn: High-ranking officials and nobles; people of high status and power.
derivation: 《礼记·檀弓下》公子丧，诸达官之长杖。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·檀弓下》公子喪，諸達官之長杖。”
derivationEn: The Book of Rites, Tan Gong II: 'When a prince dies, all high officials and their eldest sons should use a staff.'
example: ～，略有些名目在世者，其死后必有部诗文刻集。★清·张贵胜《遣愁集·感慨》
exampleTraditional: ～，略有些名目在世者，其死後必有部詩文刻集。★清·張貴勝《遣愁集·感慨》
exampleEn: High officials and nobles, who have some reputation in the world, will inevitably have a collection of poems and essays published after their death. (Zhang Guisheng, 'Collected Sorrows: Emotions')

explanation: 形容黑暗没有灯光。
explanationTraditional: 形容黑暗沒有燈光。
explanationEn: Dark with no lights; pitch-black.
derivation: 端木蕻良《科尔沁旗草原》八呵，你这个时侯，走什么，黑灯瞎火的。”
derivationTraditional: 端木蕻良《科爾沁旗草原》八呵，你這個時侯，走什麼，黑燈瞎火的。”
derivationEn: Duanmu Hongliang, 'Horqin Banner Grassland' 8: 'Ah, why are you leaving at this hour, in the pitch dark?'
example: 老二，这是怎么回事，～的把我找来。★老舍《神拳》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 老二，這是怎麼回事，～的把我找來。★老舍《神拳》第二幕
exampleEn: Second Brother, what's the matter? You called me here in the pitch dark. (Lao She, 'The Boxer Rebellion' Act 2)

explanation: 不同一般的，奇奇怪怪的形状。
explanationTraditional: 不同一般的，奇奇怪怪的形狀。
explanationEn: Strange and unusual shapes; grotesque in form.
derivation: 《晋书·温峤传》至牛渚矶，水深不可测，世云其下多怪物，峤遂燃犀角而照之，须臾见水族覆火，奇形异状，或乘马车，著赤衣者。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·溫嶠傳》至牛渚磯，水深不可測，世雲其下多怪物，嶠遂燃犀角而照之，須臾見水族覆火，奇形異狀，或乘馬車，著赤衣者。”
derivationEn: Book of Jin, Biography of Wen Qiao: 'When he reached Niuzhu Ji, the water was deep and unfathomable. It was said that many monsters lived below. Qiao then lit a rhinoceros horn to illuminate them, and soon saw water creatures covering the fire, with strange shapes and unusual forms, some riding horse-drawn carriages and wearing red clothes.'
example: 铁索千寻取得来，～谁能识？★唐·吴融《太湖石歌》
exampleTraditional: 鐵索千尋取得來，～誰能識？★唐·吳融《太湖石歌》
exampleEn: A thousand-fathom iron chain was obtained; who can recognize its strange and unusual shapes? (Wu Rong, 'Song of Taihu Stone')

explanation: 形容关系十分亲密。
explanationTraditional: 形容關係十分親密。
explanationEn: To be very close and intimate with someone; to be on very good terms.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们厂的领导与群众～。
exampleTraditional: 我們廠的領導與群眾～。
exampleEn: The leaders of our factory are very close with the masses.

explanation: 狼狈窘迫的样子。困顿、窘迫得不能忍受。形容非常窘迫的样子。
explanationTraditional: 狼狽窘迫的樣子。困頓、窘迫得不能忍受。形容非常窘迫的樣子。
explanationEn: In a difficult and embarrassing situation; extremely distressed and flustered.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀志·马超传》宽、衢闭冀城门，超不得入。进退狼狈，乃奔汉中依张鲁。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀志·馬超傳》寬、衢閉冀城門，超不得入。進退狼狽，乃奔漢中依張魯。”
derivationEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms, Book of Shu, Biography of Ma Chao: 'Kuan and Qu closed the city gates of Ji, so Chao could not enter. Advancing and retreating were both difficult, so he fled to Hanzhong to seek refuge with Zhang Lu.'
example: 掌声如翻腾的怒海汹涌的扑向台上去，弄得这些丑类面红耳赤，～。★刘白羽《雷电颂——怀念郭沫若同志》
exampleTraditional: 掌聲如翻騰的怒海洶湧的撲向臺上去，弄得這些醜類面紅耳赤，～。★劉白羽《雷電頌——懷念郭沫若同志》
exampleEn: The applause surged like a raging sea towards the stage, making those villains blush and feel extremely embarrassed. (Liu Baiyu, 'Thunderbolt Ode—In Memory of Comrade Guo Moruo')

explanation: 本指秋收后结算账目。比喻待到事后再对反对自己的一方行清算处理。
explanationTraditional: 本指秋收後結算賬目。比喻待到事後再對反對自己的一方行清算處理。
explanationEn: Originally meaning to settle accounts after the autumn harvest; now refers to settling scores with opponents after an event.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 身披星星，头戴月亮。形容连夜奔波或早出晚归，十分辛苦。
explanationTraditional: 身披星星，頭戴月亮。形容連夜奔波或早出晚歸，十分辛苦。
explanationEn: To travel or work from before dawn until after dark; to be extremely hardworking.
derivation: 元·无名氏《冤家债主》第一的这大的孩儿披星戴月，早起晚眠。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《冤家債主》第一的這大的孩兒披星戴月，早起晚眠。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Debtor' Act 1: 'This eldest son works from before dawn until after dark, rising early and sleeping late.'
example: 经过二十多天～的风尘奔波，到襄阳后一定要休息几天。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十章
exampleTraditional: 經過二十多天～的風塵奔波，到襄陽後一定要休息幾天。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十章
exampleEn: After more than twenty days of traveling under the stars and moon, he must rest for a few days upon arriving in Xiangyang. (Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng' Volume 2, Chapter 20)

explanation: 街坊邻居。指住处邻近的人。亦作街坊四邻”。
explanationTraditional: 街坊鄰居。指住處鄰近的人。亦作街坊四鄰”。
explanationEn: Neighbors; people living nearby.
derivation: 元·李行道《灰阑记》第一折他无过是指着收生老娘和街坊邻里做证见，我已都用银子买转了，这衙门以外的事，不要你费心。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李行道《灰闌記》第一折他無過是指著收生老孃和街坊鄰里做證見，我已都用銀子買轉了，這衙門以外的事，不要你費心。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Li Xingdao, 'The Chalk Circle' Act 1: 'He just points to the midwife and neighbors as witnesses, but I have already bribed them all. Matters outside this yamen need not concern you.'
example: 奴丈夫脾性是不好惹的，他说得来，干得去，这时怕嘈闹起来，惊动了～，面子不知怎好见人了。★清·黄小配《廿载繁华梦》第七回
exampleTraditional: 奴丈夫脾性是不好惹的，他說得來，幹得去，這時怕嘈鬧起來，驚動了～，面子不知怎好見人了。★清·黃小配《廿載繁華夢》第七回
exampleEn: My husband has a bad temper; he says what he means and does what he says. I'm afraid if he makes a scene, it will disturb the neighbors, and I won't know how to face them. (Huang Xiaopei, 'Twenty Years of Splendor' Chapter 7)

explanation: 聊依赖，凭借。指老百姓无以为生，活不下去。
explanationTraditional: 聊依賴，憑藉。指老百姓無以為生，活不下去。
explanationEn: The people have no means of livelihood; they cannot survive.
derivation: 《史记·张耳陈余列传》财匮力尽，民不聊生。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·張耳陳餘列傳》財匱力盡，民不聊生。”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian, Biographies of Zhang Er and Chen Yu: 'Resources are exhausted and strength is used up; the people have no means of livelihood.'
example: 在那些年月，军阀混战，土匪横行，～。★冯德英《迎春花》第八章
exampleTraditional: 在那些年月，軍閥混戰，土匪橫行，～。★馮德英《迎春花》第八章
exampleEn: In those years, warlords fought, bandits ran rampant, and the people had no means of livelihood. (Feng Deying, 'Spring Flowers' Chapter 8)

explanation: 依依留恋的样子；惜别舍不得分别。形容十分留恋，舍不得分开。
explanationTraditional: 依依留戀的樣子；惜別捨不得分別。形容十分留戀，捨不得分開。
explanationEn: Reluctant to part; showing deep attachment and unwillingness to separate.
derivation: 宋·陆游《舟中对月》百壶载酒游凌云，醉中挥袖别故人，依依向我不忍别，谁似峨嵋半轮月。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《舟中對月》百壺載酒遊凌雲，醉中揮袖別故人，依依向我不忍別，誰似峨嵋半輪月。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Lu You's poem 'Facing the Moon on the Boat': 'A hundred pots of wine carried to roam in Lingyun, drunk I wave my sleeve to bid farewell to old friends, reluctant to leave me, who is like the half moon over Mount Emei?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 只恨相见得太晚。形容一见如故，意气极其相投。
explanationTraditional: 只恨相見得太晚。形容一見如故，意氣極其相投。
explanationEn: Regret not having met earlier; describing a strong mutual affinity and congeniality at first meeting.
derivation: 《史记·平津侯主父列传》天子召见三人，谓曰‘公等皆安在？何相见之晚也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平津侯主父列傳》天子召見三人，謂曰‘公等皆安在？何相見之晚也。’”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of the Marquis of Pingjin and Lord Zhufu': 'The emperor summoned the three men and said, 'Where have you all been? Why have we met so late?''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原形容马跑得很快◇比喻进展极快。
explanationTraditional: 原形容馬跑得很快◇比喻進展極快。
explanationEn: Originally described a horse galloping very fast; now metaphorically means rapid progress.
derivation: 《庄子·秋水》骐、骥、骅、骝，一日而驰千里。”《史记·刺客列传》臣闻骐骥盛壮之时，—日而驰千里；至其衰老；驾马先之。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·秋水》騏、驥、驊、騮，一日而馳千里。”《史記·刺客列傳》臣聞騏驥盛壯之時，—日而馳千里；至其衰老；駕馬先之。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: Autumn Floods': 'Fine horses like Qi, Ji, Hua, and Liu gallop a thousand li in a day.' 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Assassin': 'I have heard that when a fine horse is in its prime, it can gallop a thousand li in a day; when it grows old, even a nag can outrun it.'
example: 由于负责干部的艰苦奋斗，业务更～，异常发达，不到一年，全国分店已达五十余处。★邹韬奋《患难余生记·进步文化的遭难》
exampleTraditional: 由於負責幹部的艱苦奮鬥，業務更～，異常發達，不到一年，全國分店已達五十餘處。★鄒韜奮《患難餘生記·進步文化的遭難》
exampleEn: Thanks to the hard work of the responsible cadres, the business progressed rapidly, achieving remarkable growth. Within less than a year, there were already over fifty branches nationwide. (Zou Taofen, 'Surviving Calamity: The Persecution of Progressive Culture')

explanation: 做贼的人喊捉贼。比喻坏人为了自己逃脱，故意制造混乱，转移目标，把别人说成是坏人。
explanationTraditional: 做賊的人喊捉賊。比喻壞人為了自己逃脫，故意製造混亂，轉移目標，把別人說成是壞人。
explanationEn: A thief crying 'Stop thief!'; metaphor for a villain trying to divert attention by accusing others of his own crimes.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这个狡滑的小偷，偷了人家的钱后，还贼喊捉贼，嫁祸于人。
exampleTraditional: 這個狡滑的小偷，偷了人家的錢後，還賊喊捉賊，嫁禍於人。
exampleEn: The cunning thief, after stealing the money, cried 'Stop thief!' to shift the blame onto others.

explanation: 促靠近；促膝膝碰膝，坐得很近。形容亲密地谈心里话。
explanationTraditional: 促靠近；促膝膝碰膝，坐得很近。形容親密地談心裡話。
explanationEn: Sit knee to knee and have a heart-to-heart talk; describing intimate conversation.
derivation: 唐·田颖《揽云台记》即有友人，不过十余知音之侣，来则促膝谈心，率皆圣贤之道，不敢稍涉异言。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·田穎《攬雲臺記》即有友人，不過十餘知音之侶，來則促膝談心，率皆聖賢之道，不敢稍涉異言。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty Tian Ying's 'Record of the Cloud-Gazing Terrace': 'When friends come, no more than a dozen kindred spirits, we sit knee to knee and talk heart to heart, all about the ways of sages, never daring to touch upon heresy.'
example: 依弟愚见，这厅事也太阔落，意欲借尊斋，只需一席酒，我四人～，方才畅快。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十回
exampleTraditional: 依弟愚見，這廳事也太闊落，意欲借尊齋，只需一席酒，我四人～，方才暢快。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十回
exampleEn: In my humble opinion, this hall is too spacious. I would like to borrow your study, where we four can sit knee to knee and talk freely over a single feast. (Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 10)

explanation: 寡少；敌抵挡；众多。人少的抵挡不住人多的。
explanationTraditional: 寡少；敵抵擋；眾多。人少的抵擋不住人多的。
explanationEn: The few cannot withstand the many; outnumbered and unable to resist.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》寡固不可以敌众。”《韩非子·难三》夫物众而智穷，寡不胜众。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》寡固不可以敵眾。”《韓非子·難三》夫物眾而智窮，寡不勝眾。”
derivationEn: 'Mencius: King Hui of Liang I': 'The few cannot withstand the many.' 'Han Feizi: Difficulties III': 'When things are many and wisdom is limited, the few cannot overcome the many.'
example: 王朗～，与白虎、周昕杀条血路，走入城中，拽起吊桥，坚闭城门。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 王朗～，與白虎、周昕殺條血路，走入城中，拽起吊橋，堅閉城門。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十五回
exampleEn: Wang Lang, outnumbered, fought his way with Bai Hu and Zhou Xin into the city, pulled up the drawbridge, and closed the city gates tightly. (Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 15)

explanation: 形容沉湎在酒色之中。花，指妓女。
explanationTraditional: 形容沉湎在酒色之中。花，指妓女。
explanationEn: Indulge in wine and women; a life of debauchery. 'Flowers' refers to prostitutes.
derivation: 清·郭麐《摸鱼儿》词一篷儿，花天酒地，消磨风月如许。”
derivationTraditional: 清·郭麐《摸魚兒》詞一篷兒，花天酒地，消磨風月如許。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Guo Lin's poem to the tune 'Mo Yu Er': 'In a small boat, amidst flowers and wine, dissipating such wind and moonlight.'
example: 南京秦淮河一带仍是～，听歌狎妓。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十七章
exampleTraditional: 南京秦淮河一帶仍是～，聽歌狎妓。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十七章
exampleEn: The Qinhuai River area in Nanjing was still a place of debauchery, listening to songs and visiting prostitutes. (Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 17)

explanation: 儆警告。处死一个人，借以警戒许多人。
explanationTraditional: 儆警告。處死一個人，藉以警戒許多人。
explanationEn: Execute one to warn a hundred; make an example of someone to deter others.
derivation: 《汉书·尹翁归传》其有所取也，以一警百，吏民皆服，恐惧改行自新。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·尹翁歸傳》其有所取也，以一警百，吏民皆服，恐懼改行自新。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Yin Wenggui': 'When he punished someone, it served as a warning to a hundred, so officials and people all feared and reformed their ways.'
example: 如果遇到抗拒，就～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十四章
exampleTraditional: 如果遇到抗拒，就～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十四章
exampleEn: If there is resistance, make an example of one to warn the rest. (Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 14)

explanation: 水边的楼台先得到月光。比喻能优先得到利益或便利的某种地位或关系。
explanationTraditional: 水邊的樓臺先得到月光。比喻能優先得到利益或便利的某種地位或關係。
explanationEn: A waterside pavilion gets the moonlight first; metaphor for a position or relationship that offers priority access to benefits or advantages.
derivation: 宋·俞文豹《清夜录》范文正公镇钱塘，兵官皆被荐，独巡检苏麟不见录，乃献诗云‘近水楼台先得月，向阳花木易逢春。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·俞文豹《清夜錄》范文正公鎮錢塘，兵官皆被薦，獨巡檢蘇麟不見錄，乃獻詩云‘近水樓臺先得月，向陽花木易逢春。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Yu Wenbao's 'Qingye Records': 'Fan Zhongyan governed Qiantang, and all military officers were recommended except Inspector Su Lin, who presented a poem: 'The waterside pavilion gets the moonlight first; the sun-facing flowers and trees are the first to spring.''
example: 他的表兄调任了，调到他去年教课的那所中学校来当校长了。～，自然容易得月。★叶圣陶《得失》
exampleTraditional: 他的表兄調任了，調到他去年教課的那所中學校來當校長了。～，自然容易得月。★葉聖陶《得失》
exampleEn: His cousin was transferred to become the principal of the middle school where he had taught last year. Being in a favorable position, he naturally got the benefit first. (Ye Shengtao, 'Gains and Losses')

explanation: 不把国家法律放在眼里。形容胡作非为，无法无天。
explanationTraditional: 不把國家法律放在眼裡。形容胡作非為，無法無天。
explanationEn: Disregard the law; act lawlessly and outrageously.
derivation: 清·孙雨林《皖江血》且尔捣毁学堂，亦属目无法纪。”
derivationTraditional: 清·孫雨林《皖江血》且爾搗毀學堂，亦屬目無法紀。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Sun Yulin's 'Blood of the Wan River': 'Moreover, you destroyed the school, which is also a disregard for the law.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容达到极深极重的程度。
explanationTraditional: 形容達到極深極重的程度。
explanationEn: To the marrow; deeply ingrained or extreme in degree.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第八十回高太尉着令医人治疗，见丘岳重伤，恨梁山泊深入骨髓。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第八十回高太尉著令醫人治療，見丘嶽重傷，恨梁山泊深入骨髓。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 80: 'Gao Qiu ordered doctors to treat Qiu Yue, who was severely wounded, and hated the Liangshan bandits to the marrow.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 项颈的后部。望见他的颈项和后背。比喻赶得上。
explanationTraditional: 項頸的後部。望見他的頸項和後背。比喻趕得上。
explanationEn: To see someone's neck and back; metaphorically meaning to be able to catch up or match.
derivation: 清·汪琬《与周处士书》言论之超卓雄伟，真有与诗书六艺相表里者，非后世能文章家所得望其肩项也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·汪琬《與周處士書》言論之超卓雄偉，真有與詩書六藝相表裡者，非後世能文章家所得望其肩項也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wang Wan's 'Letter to Zhou Chushi': 'His words are so outstanding and majestic that they truly complement the Six Classics; later writers cannot hope to match his shoulders and neck.'
example: 他已窥破喜奎和小雀儿的深情密爱，万万不是本人所能～。★蔡东藩、许厪父《民国通俗演义》第一百二十七回
exampleTraditional: 他已窺破喜奎和小雀兒的深情密愛，萬萬不是本人所能～。★蔡東藩、許厪父《民國通俗演義》第一百二十七回
exampleEn: He had already seen through the deep affection between Xikui and Xiaoque, which was far beyond his ability to match. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Jin's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 127

explanation: 比喻言语、行动有条理或合规矩。有时也比喻做事死板，不懂得灵活掌握。
explanationTraditional: 比喻言語、行動有條理或合規矩。有時也比喻做事死板，不懂得靈活掌握。
explanationEn: Following a strict pattern; methodical and orderly, but also rigid and inflexible.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他办事因循守旧，一板一眼，从不敢越雷池一步。
exampleTraditional: 他辦事因循守舊，一板一眼，從不敢越雷池一步。
exampleEn: He handles affairs conservatively, following a strict pattern, never daring to step out of line.

explanation: 做种种坏事。同为非作歹”。
explanationTraditional: 做種種壞事。同為非作歹”。
explanationEn: To do all kinds of evil; synonymous with '为非作歹'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原为佛家语，称颂释迦牟尼最高贵、最伟大。现指认为只有自己最了不起。形容极端自高自大。
explanationTraditional: 原為佛家語，稱頌釋迦牟尼最高貴、最偉大。現指認為只有自己最了不起。形容極端自高自大。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist term praising Shakyamuni as the most noble and great; now refers to someone who considers themselves the only important one, extremely arrogant.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷一天上天下，唯吾独尊。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷一天上天下，唯吾獨尊。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Above heaven and below earth, I alone am the honored one.'
example: 孤家看来，朝里朝外，～。★元·无名氏《连环计》第一折
exampleTraditional: 孤家看來，朝裡朝外，～。★元·無名氏《連環計》第一折
exampleEn: I think that in the court and outside, I alone am the honored one. — Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'The Chain of Schemes', Act 1

explanation: 躬自身；省检查。回过头来检查自己的言行得失。
explanationTraditional: 躬自身；省檢查。回過頭來檢查自己的言行得失。
explanationEn: To turn around and examine one's own words and deeds; self-reflection.
derivation: 《礼记·乐记》好恶无节于内，知诱于外，不能反躬，天理灭矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·樂記》好惡無節於內，知誘於外，不能反躬，天理滅矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Record of Music': 'If likes and dislikes are not regulated within, and knowledge is seduced from without, one cannot reflect on oneself, and the principle of heaven is extinguished.'
example: 这次事故，你是有责任的，你应该～。
exampleTraditional: 這次事故，你是有責任的，你應該～。
exampleEn: You are responsible for this accident; you should reflect on yourself.

explanation: 原指轻浮地议论妇女的容貌。现也比喻任意挑剔。
explanationTraditional: 原指輕浮地議論婦女的容貌。現也比喻任意挑剔。
explanationEn: Originally frivolously commenting on women's appearance; now also means to nitpick arbitrarily.
derivation: 清·黄小配《大马扁》第四回那全副精神又注在各妓，那个好颜色，那个好太度，评头品足，少不免要乱哦几句诗出来了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃小配《大馬扁》第四回那全副精神又注在各妓，那個好顏色，那個好太度，評頭品足，少不免要亂哦幾句詩出來了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Huang Xiaopei's 'The Great Horse': 'His whole spirit was focused on the prostitutes, commenting on their looks and manners, and inevitably reciting a few poems.'
example: 你应该多干点实事，不要总～。
exampleTraditional: 你應該多幹點實事，不要總～。
exampleEn: You should do more practical work instead of always nitpicking.

explanation: 莺黄鹂。形容江南暮春的景色。
explanationTraditional: 鶯黃鸝。形容江南暮春的景色。
explanationEn: Grass growing and orioles flying; describes the scenery of late spring in the Jiangnan region.
derivation: 南朝·梁·丘迟《与陈伯之书》暮春三月，江南草长，杂花生树，群莺乱飞。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·丘遲《與陳伯之書》暮春三月，江南草長，雜花生樹，群鶯亂飛。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Liang Qiu Chi's 'Letter to Chen Bo': 'In late spring, the grass grows in Jiangnan, various flowers bloom, and flocks of orioles fly.'
example: 这样看来，花香鸟语，～，都是大自然的语言。★竺可桢《大自然的语言》
exampleTraditional: 這樣看來，花香鳥語，～，都是大自然的語言。★竺可楨《大自然的語言》
exampleEn: Thus, the fragrance of flowers, the songs of birds, the growing grass, and the flying orioles are all the language of nature. — Zhu Kezhen's 'The Language of Nature'

explanation: 东西还是原来的东西，可是人已不是原来的人了。多用于表达事过境迁。因而怀念故人。
explanationTraditional: 東西還是原來的東西，可是人已不是原來的人了。多用於表達事過境遷。因而懷念故人。
explanationEn: Things are still the same, but the people are no longer who they were; often used to express the change of circumstances and nostalgia for the past.
derivation: 宋·李清照《武陵春》词物是人非事事休，欲语泪先流。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李清照《武陵春》詞物是人非事事休，欲語淚先流。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Li Qingzhao's poem 'Wu Ling Chun': 'Things are the same, but people are no more; before speaking, tears flow.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 整整顿，收拾。比喻失败之后，整顿力量，准备再干。
explanationTraditional: 整整頓，收拾。比喻失敗之後，整頓力量，準備再幹。
explanationEn: To reorganize and prepare for another attempt after a failure.
derivation: 清·萧山湘灵子《轩亭冤》卷上依欲重振旗鼓，烦你拟篇男女乎权文，劝戒女子。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蕭山湘靈子《軒亭冤》捲上依欲重振旗鼓，煩你擬篇男女乎權文，勸戒女子。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Xiaoshan Xianglingzi's 'The Pavilion of Xuan Ting', Volume 1: 'I want to reorganize the flag and drum, and ask you to draft a text on gender equality to admonish women.'
example: 至清室已覆，袁为总统，他自然～，又复上台。”★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第四十八回
exampleTraditional: 至清室已覆，袁為總統，他自然～，又覆上臺。”★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第四十八回
exampleEn: After the Qing dynasty fell and Yuan became president, he naturally reorganized his forces and came back to power. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Jin's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 48

explanation: 厥其，他的；词文辞，言辞。原指铺张词藻或畅所欲言。现用来指大发议论。
explanationTraditional: 厥其，他的；詞文辭，言辭。原指鋪張詞藻或暢所欲言。現用來指大發議論。
explanationEn: To speak or write at length, often boastfully or with exaggerated rhetoric.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《祭柳子厚文》玉佩琼琚，大放厥词。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《祭柳子厚文》玉佩瓊琚，大放厥詞。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Sacrificial Ode to Liu Zihou': 'Jade pendants and fine gems, he spoke at length.'
example: 也许他认定我年轻无知，才毫无顾虑地在我面前～。★郭良蕙《焦点》十
exampleTraditional: 也許他認定我年輕無知，才毫無顧慮地在我面前～。★郭良蕙《焦點》十
exampleEn: Perhaps he thought I was young and ignorant, so he spoke at length in front of me without any scruples. (From Guo Lianghui's 'Focus', Chapter 10)

explanation: 奋笔提起笔来。指精神昂扬地挥笔快速书写。
explanationTraditional: 奮筆提起筆來。指精神昂揚地揮筆快速書寫。
explanationEn: To write quickly and vigorously, with great enthusiasm.
derivation: 宋·张克庄《题方汝一班师赞后》或隐匿未彰，而奋笔疾书；或一语之乖谬，或一行之谄曲，虽其人之骨已朽，必绳以《春秋》之法，读之使人汗出。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張克莊《題方汝一班師贊後》或隱匿未彰，而奮筆疾書；或一語之乖謬，或一行之諂曲，雖其人之骨已朽，必繩以《春秋》之法，讀之使人汗出。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhang Kezhuang's 'Preface to Fang Ruyi's Ban Shi Zan': '...or hidden and not yet revealed, he would write vigorously and quickly...'
example: 世贞昼夜伏案，～，日书一回，不得片刻喘息。★《金瓶梅传奇》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 世貞晝夜伏案，～，日書一回，不得片刻喘息。★《金瓶梅傳奇》第二十七回
exampleEn: Shizhen worked day and night, writing vigorously and quickly, completing one chapter a day without a moment's rest. (From 'The Legend of Jin Ping Mei', Chapter 27)

explanation: 全身的皮肤没有一块好的。形容遍体都是伤。也比喻理由全部被驳倒，或被批评、责骂得很厉害。
explanationTraditional: 全身的皮膚沒有一塊好的。形容遍體都是傷。也比喻理由全部被駁倒，或被批評、責罵得很厲害。
explanationEn: Covered with wounds all over the body; also used figuratively to mean thoroughly refuted or severely criticized.
derivation: 《三国志·魏书·邓艾传》子忠与艾俱死”裴松之注引《世语》师纂亦与艾俱死……死之日体无完皮。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏書·鄧艾傳》子忠與艾俱死”裴松之注引《世語》師纂亦與艾俱死……死之日體無完皮。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Wei Shu, Biography of Deng Ai' annotated by Pei Songzhi quoting 'Shi Yu': '...the day he died, his body had no intact skin.'
example: 他就静悄悄地看下去，看到把各种责难都驳斥得～之后，他又低声念起来。
exampleTraditional: 他就靜悄悄地看下去，看到把各種責難都駁斥得～之後，他又低聲念起來。
exampleEn: He quietly read on, and after seeing all criticisms thoroughly refuted, he began to read aloud again.

explanation: 刚强的和柔和的互相调剂。
explanationTraditional: 剛強的和柔和的互相調劑。
explanationEn: To balance firmness with gentleness; to combine strength and softness harmoniously.
derivation: 《周易·蒙》刚柔节也。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·蒙》剛柔節也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes, Meng Hexagram': 'Firmness and gentleness are tempered.'
example: 凡为将者，当以～，不可徒恃其勇。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十一回
exampleTraditional: 凡為將者，當以～，不可徒恃其勇。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十一回
exampleEn: A general should balance firmness with gentleness, not rely solely on bravery. (From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 71)

explanation: 形容百花齐放，色彩艳丽。也比喻事物丰富多彩。
explanationTraditional: 形容百花齊放，色彩豔麗。也比喻事物豐富多彩。
explanationEn: A myriad of purple and red; describes a profusion of colorful flowers, also used metaphorically for a rich variety of things.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《春日》诗等闲识得东风面，万紫千红总是春。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《春日》詩等閒識得東風面，萬紫千紅總是春。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's poem 'Spring Day': 'I recognize the face of the east wind easily; a myriad of purple and red always spring.'
example: 整个文坛出现了前所未有的百花齐放、～的大好局面。
exampleTraditional: 整個文壇出現了前所未有的百花齊放、～的大好局面。
exampleEn: The entire literary scene has seen an unprecedented situation of a hundred flowers blooming and a myriad of purple and red.

explanation: 弹丸弹弓所用的铁丸或泥丸。弹丸那么大的地方。形容地方非常狭小。
explanationTraditional: 彈丸彈弓所用的鐵丸或泥丸。彈丸那麼大的地方。形容地方非常狹小。
explanationEn: A place as small as a pellet; a very small area.
derivation: 《史记·平原君虞卿列传》此弹丸之地弗予，令秦来年复攻王，王得无割其内而媾乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原君虞卿列傳》此彈丸之地弗予，令秦來年復攻王，王得無割其內而媾乎？”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian, Biography of Lord Pingyuan and Yu Qing': 'If you do not give this pellet-sized land, Qin will attack again next year...'
example: 西歧城不过～，姜子牙不过浅行之夫。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 西歧城不過～，姜子牙不過淺行之夫。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第四十四回
exampleEn: Xiqicheng is but a pellet-sized place, and Jiang Ziya is but a shallow man. (From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 44)

explanation: 驰奔驰。心神奔向所向往的事物。形容一心向往。
explanationTraditional: 馳奔馳。心神奔向所向往的事物。形容一心向往。
explanationEn: To be deeply attracted and yearning for something; one's heart flies to the object of desire.
derivation: 《隋书·史祥传》身在边隅，情驰魏阙。”
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·史祥傳》身在邊隅，情馳魏闕。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Sui, Biography of Shi Xiang': 'Though my body is at the border, my heart flies to the Wei Palace.'
example: 那美丽如画的山水真让我～。
exampleTraditional: 那美麗如畫的山水真讓我～。
exampleEn: The beautiful landscape truly made my heart fly to it.

explanation: 说坏话的和说好话的各占一半。表示对人的评价没有一致的意见。
explanationTraditional: 說壞話的和說好話的各佔一半。表示對人的評價沒有一致的意見。
explanationEn: Half praise and half blame; mixed reviews about someone or something.
derivation: 茅盾《温故以知新》正常的现象是毁誉参半。这个毁誉参半……会争出一个对作品既不偏高，也不偏低的恰好评价。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《溫故以知新》正常的現象是譭譽參半。這個譭譽參半……會爭出一個對作品既不偏高，也不偏低的恰好評價。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'Knowing the New by Reviewing the Old': 'The normal phenomenon is half praise and half blame...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 体贴细心体谅别人的心情和处境，给予关心和照顾；入微达到细微的程度。形容对人照顾或关怀非常细心、周到。
explanationTraditional: 體貼細心體諒別人的心情和處境，給予關心和照顧；入微達到細微的程度。形容對人照顧或關懷非常細心、周到。
explanationEn: To show meticulous care and consideration for someone's feelings and needs.
derivation: 清·赵翼《瓯北诗话·杜少陵诗·四》至于寻常写景，不必有意惊人，而体贴入微，亦复人不能到。”
derivationTraditional: 清·趙翼《甌北詩話·杜少陵詩·四》至於尋常寫景，不必有意驚人，而體貼入微，亦復人不能到。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhao Yi's 'Oubei Poetry Talks, Du Shaoling's Poems, Part 4': '...even ordinary scenery descriptions, without intending to amaze, show meticulous care that others cannot achieve.'
example: 这却全在美人心意上着想，倒也～。（清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第三十九回）
exampleTraditional: 這卻全在美人心意上著想，倒也～。（清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第三十九回）
exampleEn: This all depends on the beauty's thoughts, and it is indeed meticulous care. (From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Situations Observed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 39)

explanation: 形容人性情浮躁，做事不踏实。
explanationTraditional: 形容人性情浮躁，做事不踏實。
explanationEn: To be impetuous and restless; lacking patience and steadiness.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容用各种理由或方式请求或劝说。
explanationTraditional: 形容用各種理由或方式請求或勸說。
explanationEn: To use all kinds of reasons or methods to request or persuade someone.
derivation: 《文明小史》第三回掌柜的便同他们好说歹说，说我们都是乡邻，你们也犯不着来害我。”
derivationTraditional: 《文明小史》第三回掌櫃的便同他們好說歹說，說我們都是鄉鄰，你們也犯不著來害我。”
derivationEn: From 'A Brief History of Civilization' Chapter 3: The shopkeeper tried every possible way to persuade them, saying we are all neighbors, you shouldn't harm me.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 得到广大人民的热烈拥护。
explanationTraditional: 得到廣大人民的熱烈擁護。
explanationEn: To win the warm support of the broad masses.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他在任内大施德政，～，因此虽已逝去多年，仍然为人所追思、怀念。
exampleTraditional: 他在任內大施德政，～，因此雖已逝去多年，仍然為人所追思、懷念。
exampleEn: During his tenure, he implemented benevolent policies and deeply won people's hearts, so even after his death, he is still remembered and missed.

explanation: 把账一笔抹掉。比喻把一切全部取消。
explanationTraditional: 把賬一筆抹掉。比喻把一切全部取消。
explanationEn: To write off a debt at one stroke. Metaphorically, to cancel everything completely.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《五朝名臣言行录》卷七公揉簿，视不才监司，每见一人姓名，一笔勾之。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《五朝名臣言行錄》卷七公揉簿，視不才監司，每見一人姓名，一筆勾之。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's 'Records of the Words and Deeds of Famous Ministers of the Five Dynasties' Volume 7: He reviewed the records, and whenever he saw an incompetent official, he would strike out the name with one stroke.
example: 如有班部监司，不才官吏，～，永不叙用。★元·无名氏《延安府》第二折
exampleTraditional: 如有班部監司，不才官吏，～，永不敘用。★元·無名氏《延安府》第二折
exampleEn: If there are incompetent officials in the ministry, they will be struck off and never reappointed. — Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Yan'an Prefecture' Act 2

explanation: 察详审。观察别人的说话或脸色。多指揣摸别人的心意。
explanationTraditional: 察詳審。觀察別人的說話或臉色。多指揣摸別人的心意。
explanationEn: To observe a person's words and facial expressions. Often refers to trying to discern someone's intentions.
derivation: 《论语·颜渊》夫达也者，质直而好义，察言而观色，虑以下人。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·顏淵》夫達也者，質直而好義，察言而觀色，慮以下人。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius·Yan Yuan': A person of understanding is straightforward and fond of righteousness, observes words and expressions, and is considerate to others.
example: 宝钗见此景况，～，早知觉了七八分。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十二回
exampleTraditional: 寶釵見此景況，～，早知覺了七八分。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十二回
exampleEn: Baochai saw this scene, observed his words and expressions, and already understood seven or eight parts of it. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 32

explanation: 劫强取；济救济。夺取富人的财产，救济穷人。
explanationTraditional: 劫強取；濟救濟。奪取富人的財產，救濟窮人。
explanationEn: To rob the rich and give to the poor.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十五回老汉平生最喜欢劫富济贫，抑强扶弱，打抱不平。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十五回老漢平生最喜歡劫富濟貧，抑強扶弱，打抱不平。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins' Chapter 35: The old man all his life loved to rob the rich and help the poor, suppress the strong and support the weak, and fight for justice.
example: 会因南北统一，所谋未遂，乃想学王天纵的行为，～，自张一帜。（蔡东藩、许厪父《民国通俗演义》第二十五回）
exampleTraditional: 會因南北統一，所謀未遂，乃想學王天縱的行為，～，自張一幟。（蔡東藩、許厪父《民國通俗演義》第二十五回）
exampleEn: Because the north-south unification failed, his plans were not realized, so he wanted to imitate Wang Tianzong's behavior, robbing the rich to help the poor, and raising his own banner. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Jin 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China' Chapter 25

explanation: 令使，让；神往心神向往。使人非常向往。
explanationTraditional: 令使，讓；神往心神嚮往。使人非常向往。
explanationEn: To make people yearn for something; to be fascinating.
derivation: 明·胡应麟《少室山房笔丛》卷二十七今著术湮没，怅望当时蹈海之风，令人神往不已。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡應麟《少室山房筆叢》卷二十七今著術湮沒，悵望當時蹈海之風，令人神往不已。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Hu Yinglin's 'Shaoshi Shanfang Bicong' Volume 27: Now the works are lost, and I look back with longing at the wind of crossing the sea, which makes people yearn endlessly.
example: 景山诸乐部尝演习十番笛，第于月下听之，如云環叠奏，～。★清·钱泳《履园丛话·艺能·十番》
exampleTraditional: 景山諸樂部嘗演習十番笛，第於月下聽之，如雲環疊奏，～。★清·錢泳《履園叢話·藝能·十番》
exampleEn: The Jingshan music troupes often practiced the ten-string flute; listening under the moonlight, it was like layered clouds playing in harmony, making people yearn. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Yong 'Lüyuan Conghua·Yineng·Shifan'

explanation: 不生长草木庄稼的荒地。形容荒凉、贫瘠。
explanationTraditional: 不生長草木莊稼的荒地。形容荒涼、貧瘠。
explanationEn: Barren land where no grass or crops grow. Describes desolate and infertile land.
derivation: 《公羊传·宣公十二年》锡（赐）之不毛之地．”
derivationTraditional: 《公羊傳·宣公十二年》錫（賜）之不毛之地．”
derivationEn: From 'Gongyang Zhuan·Duke Xuan's 12th Year': Granting barren land.
example: 南方～，瘴疫之乡；丞相秉钧衡之重任，而自远征，非所宜也。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八十七回
exampleTraditional: 南方～，瘴疫之鄉；丞相秉鈞衡之重任，而自遠征，非所宜也。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八十七回
exampleEn: The southern region is a barren land of miasma and disease; the Prime Minister holds the heavy responsibility of the state, yet goes on a distant expedition, which is not appropriate. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 87

explanation: 软外皮中塞得圆鼓鼓的；藏物凸起的样子。
explanationTraditional: 軟外皮中塞得圓鼓鼓的；藏物凸起的樣子。
explanationEn: Bulging; describing something stuffed and protruding.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第四十九回看见皮瓠藤篮之类，鼓鼓囊囊的装着许多东西。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第四十九回看見皮瓠藤籃之類，鼓鼓囊囊的裝著許多東西。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization' Chapter 49: He saw leather gourds and wicker baskets bulging with many things.
example: 把他们～的一小袋金子往柜台上一扔。
exampleTraditional: 把他們～的一小袋金子往櫃檯上一扔。
exampleEn: They threw their bulging small bag of gold on the counter.

explanation: 形容万分思念。
explanationTraditional: 形容萬分思念。
explanationEn: To be deeply obsessed and constantly think of someone or something.
derivation: 宋·刘过《醉太平》词思君忆君，魂牵梦萦，翠销香暖云屏，更哪堪酒醒。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·劉過《醉太平》詞思君憶君，魂牽夢縈，翠銷香暖雲屏，更哪堪酒醒。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Liu Guo's 'Drunk Taiping' lyric: Thinking of you, remembering you, soul pulled and dreams haunted, the green incense fades and warm clouds screen, how can one bear the sobering from wine.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 就顺着。指事情已经做错了，索性顺着错误继续做下去。
explanationTraditional: 就順著。指事情已經做錯了，索性順著錯誤繼續做下去。
explanationEn: To follow the mistake; to continue doing something even after realizing it's wrong.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十六将错就错，西方极乐。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十六將錯就錯，西方極樂。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting' Volume 16: If you make a mistake, follow it; the Western Paradise is bliss.
example: 有人说是上头看时叠错的，那些阅卷的只好～。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 有人說是上頭看時疊錯的，那些閱卷的只好～。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第十四回
exampleEn: Some said the exam papers were misordered by the superiors, and the graders had to follow the mistake. — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu 'Flower in the Sea of Sins' Chapter 14

explanation: 原指演员擅长的剧目。泛指最擅长的本领。
explanationTraditional: 原指演員擅長的劇目。泛指最擅長的本領。
explanationEn: Originally refers to a play that an actor excels in. Generally means one's forte or specialty.
derivation: 峻青《壮志录》最后，当老场长的拿手好戏《借东风》收场的时候，三星高高地升起，天已经是在半夜了。”
derivationTraditional: 峻青《壯志錄》最後，當老場長的拿手好戲《借東風》收場的時候，三星高高地升起，天已經是在半夜了。”
derivationEn: From Jun Qing's 'Ambition Record': 'Finally, when the old farm manager's specialty 'Borrowing the East Wind' ended, the stars were high in the sky, and it was midnight.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 自知自己了解自己；明看清事物的能力。指了解自己的情况，对自己有正确的估计。
explanationTraditional: 自知自己瞭解自己；明看清事物的能力。指了解自己的情況，對自己有正確的估計。
explanationEn: Knowing oneself; having a clear understanding of one's own abilities and limitations.
derivation: 《老子》第三十三章知人者智也，自知者明也。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第三十三章知人者智也，自知者明也。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi', Chapter 33: 'He who knows others is wise; he who knows himself is enlightened.'
example: 一个严于解剖自己的人，往往是有～的。
exampleTraditional: 一個嚴於解剖自己的人，往往是有～的。
exampleEn: A person who is strict with self-analysis often has self-knowledge.

explanation: 嬉游戏。比喻不论什么题材和形式，都能任意发挥，写出好文章来。
explanationTraditional: 嬉遊戲。比喻不論什麼題材和形式，都能任意發揮，寫出好文章來。
explanationEn: Joking, laughing, anger, and scolding. Refers to the ability to express freely and write excellent articles regardless of the subject or form.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《东坡先生真赞》东坡之酒，赤壁之笛，嬉笑怒骂，皆成文章。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《東坡先生真贊》東坡之酒，赤壁之笛，嬉笑怒罵，皆成文章。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Huang Tingjian's 'Portrait of Mr. Dongpo': 'Dongpo's wine, Chibi's flute, jesting, laughter, anger, and curses all become literature.'
example: 设科之～。如白描人物，须眉毕观，引人入胜者，全借乎此。★清·孔尚任《桃花扇·凡例》
exampleTraditional: 設科之～。如白描人物，鬚眉畢觀，引人入勝者，全借乎此。★清·孔尚任《桃花扇·凡例》
exampleEn: The setting of subjects, jesting, laughter, anger, and curses, like line-drawing figures, with every detail vivid and captivating, all rely on this. — Qing Dynasty Kong Shangren's 'Peach Blossom Fan: General Rules'

explanation: 原指射箭技术高超，一箭射中两只雕◇比喻做一件事达到两个目的。
explanationTraditional: 原指射箭技術高超，一箭射中兩隻雕◇比喻做一件事達到兩個目的。
explanationEn: Originally meant superb archery, hitting two vultures with one arrow. Metaphorically means achieving two goals with one action.
derivation: 《北史·长孙晟传》尝有二雕飞而争肉，因以箭两只与晟，请射取之。晟驰往，遇雕相攫，遂一发双贯焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·長孫晟傳》嘗有二雕飛而爭肉，因以箭兩隻與晟，請射取之。晟馳往，遇雕相攫，遂一發雙貫焉。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Zhangsun Sheng': 'Once, two vultures were fighting over meat, so [the emperor] gave two arrows to Sheng and asked him to shoot them. Sheng galloped over, and as the vultures were grappling, he shot one arrow through both.'
example: 因为凤珠也是十六岁的人了，胡统领早存了个得陇望蜀的心思，想慢慢施展他～的手段。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 因為鳳珠也是十六歲的人了，胡統領早存了個得隴望蜀的心思，想慢慢施展他～的手段。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十二回
exampleEn: Because Fengzhu was also sixteen, Commander Hu had long harbored the desire to gain more, and wanted to slowly use his method of killing two birds with one stone. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene 12

explanation: 斟、酌反复考虑。指写文章或说话时慎重细致，一字一句地推敲琢磨。
explanationTraditional: 斟、酌反覆考慮。指寫文章或說話時慎重細緻，一字一句地推敲琢磨。
explanationEn: Weighing every word and sentence. Describes careful and meticulous consideration when writing or speaking.
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷一宋儒积一生精力，字斟句酌，亦断非汉儒所及。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷一宋儒積一生精力，字斟句酌，亦斷非漢儒所及。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage': 'Song Confucians spent their whole lives weighing every word and sentence, which was certainly beyond the reach of Han Confucians.'
example: 他说话从不随随便便，而是～。
exampleTraditional: 他說話從不隨隨便便，而是～。
exampleEn: He never speaks casually, but weighs every word.

explanation: 群雄旧指许多有军事势力的人。逐鹿比喻争夺帝王之位。形容各派势力争夺最高统治地位。
explanationTraditional: 群雄舊指許多有軍事勢力的人。逐鹿比喻爭奪帝王之位。形容各派勢力爭奪最高統治地位。
explanationEn: Many heroes chase the deer. Describes various factions competing for supreme power.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为作为；期日期，期限。指快到规定或算定的日子。
explanationTraditional: 為作為；期日期，期限。指快到規定或算定的日子。
explanationEn: The period is not far off. Means that the specified or expected time is approaching.
derivation: 毛泽东《在新政治协商会议筹备会上的讲话》肃清这一部分残余敌军，还需要一些时间，但已为期不远了。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《在新政治協商會議籌備會上的講話》肅清這一部分殘餘敵軍，還需要一些時間，但已為期不遠了。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Speech at the Preparatory Meeting of the New Political Consultative Conference': 'It will still take some time to eliminate this remaining part of the enemy forces, but it is not far off.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 急得不能等待。形容心怀急切或形势紧迫。
explanationTraditional: 急得不能等待。形容心懷急切或形勢緊迫。
explanationEn: Too impatient to wait. Describes extreme urgency or eagerness.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十四回六个人刚刚坐定，胡统领已急不可耐，头一个开口就说‘我们今日非往常可比，须大家尽兴一乐。’”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十四回六個人剛剛坐定，胡統領已急不可耐，頭一個開口就說‘我們今日非往常可比，須大家盡興一樂。’”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene 14: 'As soon as the six people sat down, Commander Hu was already impatient and spoke first, saying, 'Today is not like usual; we must all enjoy ourselves to the fullest.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 辞推托；劳苦劳累辛苦。不逃避劳累辛苦。形容人不怕吃苦，毅力强。
explanationTraditional: 辭推託；勞苦勞累辛苦。不逃避勞累辛苦。形容人不怕吃苦，毅力強。
explanationEn: Not shirking hardship. Describes someone who is not afraid of hard work and has strong perseverance.
derivation: 唐·牛肃《纪闻·吴保安》今日之事，请不辞劳苦。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·牛肅《紀聞·吳保安》今日之事，請不辭勞苦。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Niu Su's 'Ji Wen: Wu Bao'an': 'In today's matter, please do not shirk hardship.'
example: 真正难得的，是她那不会厌倦的同情和～的服务。★朱自清《刘云波女医师》
exampleTraditional: 真正難得的，是她那不會厭倦的同情和～的服務。★朱自清《劉雲波女醫師》
exampleEn: What is truly rare is her tireless sympathy and service without shirking hardship. — Zhu Ziqing's 'Dr. Liu Yunbo'

explanation: 高声歌唱，勇猛前进。形容在前进的道路上，充满乐观精神。
explanationTraditional: 高聲歌唱，勇猛前進。形容在前進的道路上，充滿樂觀精神。
explanationEn: Singing loudly and advancing bravely. Describes moving forward with optimism and vigor.
derivation: 《解放日报》1996.6.13我国广告业高歌猛进。”
derivationTraditional: 《解放日報》1996.6.13我國廣告業高歌猛進。”
derivationEn: From 'Liberation Daily' June 13, 1996: 'China's advertising industry is advancing with high spirits.'
example: 中国的体育健儿正再接再厉，高歌猛进。
exampleTraditional: 中國的體育健兒正再接再厲，高歌猛進。
exampleEn: China's athletes are continuing their efforts, singing loudly and advancing bravely.

explanation: 饱充分。沧桑沧海变桑田的简缩。泛指世事的变化。经历过多次的世事变化，生活经历极为丰富。
explanationTraditional: 飽充分。滄桑滄海變桑田的簡縮。泛指世事的變化。經歷過多次的世事變化，生活經歷極為豐富。
explanationEn: Having experienced many changes in the world; having been through a lot of vicissitudes.
derivation: 王蒙《轮下》而你是一个四十六岁的男人，饱经沧桑，眼角皱纹细密如网。”
derivationTraditional: 王蒙《輪下》而你是一個四十六歲的男人，飽經滄桑，眼角皺紋細密如網。”
derivationEn: Wang Meng's 'Under the Wheel': 'And you are a forty-six-year-old man, having experienced many vicissitudes, with fine wrinkles at the corners of your eyes like a net.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 唯一留存下来的大果子。比喻由于时间的推移，留存下来仅存的人或事物。
explanationTraditional: 唯一留存下來的大果子。比喻由於時間的推移，留存下來僅存的人或事物。
explanationEn: The only remaining large fruit; metaphor for the sole survivor or remaining person or thing after the passage of time.
derivation: 《易·剥》上九，硕果不食。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·剝》上九，碩果不食。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes: Bo Hexagram': 'The top nine, the large fruit is not eaten.'
example: 我只得随手把这个～的银角子交给他们。★邹韬奋《经历·再被羁押》
exampleTraditional: 我只得隨手把這個～的銀角子交給他們。★鄒韜奮《經歷·再被羈押》
exampleEn: I had no choice but to hand over this only remaining silver coin to them. — Zou Taofen, 'Experience: Re-arrested'

explanation: 指相提并论。
explanationTraditional: 指相提並論。
explanationEn: To mention in the same breath; to equate or compare.
derivation: 《战国策·赵策二》夫破人之与破于人也，臣人之与臣于人也，岂可同日而言之哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·趙策二》夫破人之與破於人也，臣人之與臣於人也，豈可同日而言之哉？”
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States: Zhao Strategy II': 'How can defeating others and being defeated by others, making others your subjects and being made a subject by others, be spoken of on the same day?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 背背诵。把书或文章倒过来背，背得像流水一样流畅。形容背得非常熟练，记得非常牢。
explanationTraditional: 背背誦。把書或文章倒過來背，背得像流水一樣流暢。形容背得非常熟練，記得非常牢。
explanationEn: To recite backwards as fluently as flowing water; to know something by heart extremely well.
derivation: 郭沫若《苏联纪行·六月二十七日》她把说明小册子的英文部分似乎已经读得倒背如流了。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《蘇聯紀行·六月二十七日》她把說明小冊子的英文部分似乎已經讀得倒背如流了。”
derivationEn: Guo Moruo's 'Soviet Travels: June 27': 'She seemed to have read the English part of the instruction booklet so well that she could recite it backwards.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指宫室建筑结构的交错和精巧◇比喻用尽心机，明争暗斗。
explanationTraditional: 原指宮室建築結構的交錯和精巧◇比喻用盡心機，明爭暗鬥。
explanationEn: Originally referred to the intricate and exquisite structure of palace buildings; now metaphorically means to scheme against each other and engage in open strife and veiled struggle.
derivation: 唐·杜牧《阿房宫赋》各报地势，钩心斗角。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜牧《阿房宮賦》各報地勢，鉤心鬥角。”
derivationEn: Du Mu's 'Epang Palace Fu' of the Tang Dynasty: 'Each building vies for the best position, with hooks and angles interlocking.'
example: 在这件事上，他们最是赤祼祼地毫无～的意思。★茅盾《虹》九
exampleTraditional: 在這件事上，他們最是赤祼祼地毫無～的意思。★茅盾《虹》九
exampleEn: In this matter, they are completely without any intention of scheming against each other. — Mao Dun, 'Rainbow', Chapter 9

explanation: ①泛指烹调佐料。比喻另外添加的原来没有的内容。②指琐碎庸俗。
explanationTraditional: ①泛指烹調佐料。比喻另外添加的原來沒有的內容。②指瑣碎庸俗。
explanationEn: ① General term for cooking condiments; metaphor for additional content not originally present. ② Trivial and vulgar matters.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第三十二回景翼便把阿良那节事写信给鸿甫，信里面总是加了些油盐酱醋。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第三十二回景翼便把阿良那節事寫信給鴻甫，信裡面總是加了些油鹽醬醋。”
derivationEn: Wu Jianren's 'Strange Situations Observed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 32: 'Jingyi then wrote a letter to Hongfu about that incident with Aliang, adding some oil, salt, sauce, and vinegar to the letter.'
example: 我想女子之中，若通些文墨，必竟脱俗；就是不美，自有一种文雅可观，料不是～的恶气。★《天雨花》第一回
exampleTraditional: 我想女子之中，若通些文墨，必竟脫俗；就是不美，自有一種文雅可觀，料不是～的惡氣。★《天雨花》第一回
exampleEn: I think if a woman is somewhat literate, she must be refined; even if not beautiful, she has a kind of elegance, not the vulgarity of oil, salt, sauce, and vinegar. — 'Rain of Heavenly Flowers', Chapter 1

explanation: 包承担全部任务，负责完成。将打天下的整个任务承担下来。常指人逞强争胜。
explanationTraditional: 包承擔全部任務，負責完成。將打天下的整個任務承擔下來。常指人逞強爭勝。
explanationEn: To take on the entire task of conquering the world; often refers to someone who tries to do everything themselves or is overly competitive.
derivation: 《求是》1996年第17期这类机构并不影响各个公司、企业实施光彩事业项目，更不能包打天下。”
derivationTraditional: 《求是》1996年第17期這類機構並不影響各個公司、企業實施光彩事業項目，更不能包打天下。”
derivationEn: 'Qiushi' Magazine, Issue 17, 1996: 'Such institutions do not affect the implementation of the Glorious Cause projects by various companies and enterprises, nor can they take on the whole world.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 和风指春天的风。温和的风，细小的雨。比喻方式和缓，不粗暴。
explanationTraditional: 和風指春天的風。溫和的風，細小的雨。比喻方式和緩，不粗暴。
explanationEn: Gentle wind and fine rain; metaphor for a mild and gentle approach, not rough.
derivation: 南朝·陈·张正见《陪衡阳王游耆阇寺》清风吹麦垄，细雨濯梅林。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·陳·張正見《陪衡陽王遊耆闍寺》清風吹麥壟，細雨濯梅林。”
derivationEn: Zhang Zhengjian's 'Accompanying Prince Hengyang on a Visit to Qishe Temple' of the Southern Dynasties: 'Clear wind blows over wheat ridges, fine rain washes plum groves.'
example: 正不寒不暖，～，困人天气。★宋·张先《八宝装》词
exampleTraditional: 正不寒不暖，～，困人天氣。★宋·張先《八寶裝》詞
exampleEn: It is neither cold nor warm, with gentle wind and fine rain, weather that makes one drowsy. — Zhang Xian's 'Eight Treasures' lyric of the Song Dynasty

explanation: 古稀指七十岁。年纪将近七十岁。
explanationTraditional: 古稀指七十歲。年紀將近七十歲。
explanationEn: Nearly seventy years old; 'ancient rarity' refers to the age of seventy.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 防防备；测预测。用来防备不曾料想到的事。
explanationTraditional: 防防備；測預測。用來防備不曾料想到的事。
explanationEn: To guard against unforeseen events; to take precautions against unexpected occurrences.
derivation: 张中明《人生劫》我们必须全力以赴，做好抢险的一切准备，以防不测，绝不能有一丝一毫的侥幸心理。”
derivationTraditional: 張中明《人生劫》我們必須全力以赴，做好搶險的一切準備，以防不測，絕不能有一絲一毫的僥倖心理。”
derivationEn: Zhang Zhongming's 'Life's Calamity': 'We must go all out, make all preparations for rescue, to guard against unforeseen events, and not have the slightest bit of luck.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 英雄杰出的人才。杰出人物的本来面貌。多指杰出的人物必然有非凡的行为、举动。
explanationTraditional: 英雄傑出的人才。傑出人物的本來面貌。多指傑出的人物必然有非凡的行為、舉動。
explanationEn: The true qualities of a hero; the inherent nature of an outstanding person, often manifested in extraordinary actions.
derivation: 明·方汝浩《禅真逸史》第三十四回段韶道‘元帅所言，正是英雄本色，但要用心莫作等闲，挫动锐气。’”清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十二回四公子道‘这才是英雄本色。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·方汝浩《禪真逸史》第三十四回段韶道‘元帥所言，正是英雄本色，但要用心莫作等閒，挫動銳氣。’”清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十二回四公子道‘這才是英雄本色。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Fang Ruhao's 'Zen Zhen Yi Shi' and Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars'.
example: 母舅虽系绿林聚义，山寨生涯，然须保善锄强，不愧～。★清·吴璿《飞龙全传》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 母舅雖系綠林聚義，山寨生涯，然須保善鋤強，不愧～。★清·吳璿《飛龍全傳》第二十五回
exampleEn: Although my uncle is a bandit in the greenwood, he must protect the good and eliminate the evil, living up to the true qualities of a hero. — Qing Dynasty Wu Xuan's 'The Legend of Feilong' Chapter 25

explanation: 夺门破门，奋力冲开门。猛然奋力冲开门出去。形容迫不及待。
explanationTraditional: 奪門破門，奮力衝開門。猛然奮力衝開門出去。形容迫不及待。
explanationEn: To rush out of the door forcefully; to leave in a hurry, unable to wait.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 轻轻拨开门闩，拿在手中，预备当作兵器，可以～。（清·李嘉宝《官场现形记》第三十一回）
exampleTraditional: 輕輕撥開門閂，拿在手中，預備當作兵器，可以～。（清·李嘉寶《官場現形記》第三十一回）
exampleEn: He gently lifted the latch, took the door in hand as a weapon, ready to rush out. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Chapter 31

explanation: 着接触；边际边界，边缘。挨不着边儿。多指说话空泛，不接触实际。
explanationTraditional: 著接觸；邊際邊界，邊緣。挨不著邊兒。多指說話空泛，不接觸實際。
explanationEn: Not to the point; irrelevant or vague, especially in speech.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第十九回何涛思想在此不着边际，怎生奈何！我须用自去一遭。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第十九回何濤思想在此不著邊際，怎生奈何！我須用自去一遭。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 19.
example: 周氏和张氏又谈了一些～的闲话。★巴金《春》十五
exampleTraditional: 周氏和張氏又談了一些～的閒話。★巴金《春》十五
exampleEn: Zhou and Zhang chatted about some irrelevant topics. — Ba Jin's 'Spring' Chapter 15

explanation: 倾心爱慕。初次见面就十分爱幕。
explanationTraditional: 傾心愛慕。初次見面就十分愛幕。
explanationEn: To fall in love at first sight; to be deeply attracted upon first meeting.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·晋孝武帝太元九年》主上与将军风殊类别，一见倾心，亲如宗戚。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·晉孝武帝太元九年》主上與將軍風殊類別，一見傾心，親如宗戚。”
derivationEn: From 'Zizhi Tongjian' (Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government), Jin Dynasty, Taiyuan 9th year.
example: 袁小姐对于我们的太太是～，说我们的太太浑身都是曲线，是他眼中的第一美人。（冰心《我们太太的客厅》）
exampleTraditional: 袁小姐對於我們的太太是～，說我們的太太渾身都是曲線，是他眼中的第一美人。（冰心《我們太太的客廳》）
exampleEn: Miss Yuan was deeply attracted to our Mrs. Tai at first sight, saying she was all curves and the most beautiful woman in her eyes. — Bing Xin's 'Our Mrs. Tai's Living Room'

explanation: 指出人意料。
explanationTraditional: 指出人意料。
explanationEn: Beyond expectations; unexpected.
derivation: 柯云路《三千万》白莎轻微地一怔，她对丁猛的平淡反应出乎预料。”
derivationTraditional: 柯雲路《三千萬》白莎輕微地一怔，她對丁猛的平淡反應出乎預料。”
derivationEn: From Ke Yunlu's 'Three Million'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 炯炯明亮的样子。形容人的眼睛发亮，很有精神。
explanationTraditional: 炯炯明亮的樣子。形容人的眼睛發亮，很有精神。
explanationEn: Bright and piercing eyes; describing eyes that are shining and full of spirit.
derivation: 明·李开先《闲居集·九·泾野吕亚卿传》先生头颅圆阔，体貌丰隆，海口童颜，轮耳方面，两目炯炯有神，须虽整秀，异不多耳。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李開先《閒居集·九·涇野呂亞卿傳》先生頭顱圓闊，體貌豐隆，海口童顏，輪耳方面，兩目炯炯有神，須雖整秀，異不多耳。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Li Kaixian's 'Xianju Ji'.
example: ～的眼光，足够表现出他是一个有志的少年。★郑振铎《黄公俊之最后》
exampleTraditional: ～的眼光，足夠表現出他是一個有志的少年。★鄭振鐸《黃公俊之最後》
exampleEn: His bright and piercing eyes were enough to show he was a promising young man. — Zheng Zhenduo's 'The Last of Huang Gongjun'

explanation: 留着位置等待。
explanationTraditional: 留著位置等待。
explanationEn: To leave a position vacant for someone; to reserve a seat for a worthy person.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》宁可虚位以待人，不可以人而滥位。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》寧可虛位以待人，不可以人而濫位。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 白白付出劳动而没有成效。
explanationTraditional: 白白付出勞動而沒有成效。
explanationEn: To work hard but achieve nothing; to make a futile effort.
derivation: 《庄子·天运》推舟于陆也，劳而无功。”《管子·形势》与不可，强不能，告不知，谓之劳而无功。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天運》推舟於陸也，勞而無功。”《管子·形勢》與不可，強不能，告不知，謂之勞而無功。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi' and 'Guanzi'.
example: 博洛兴师动众，旷费时日，～。★华而实《汉衣冠》七
exampleTraditional: 博洛興師動眾，曠費時日，～。★華而實《漢衣冠》七
exampleEn: Boluo mobilized the army, wasted time and resources, but achieved nothing. — Hua Ershi's 'Han Yiguan' Chapter 7

explanation: 养指生活。指生活在有人伺候、条件优裕的环境中。
explanationTraditional: 養指生活。指生活在有人伺候、條件優裕的環境中。
explanationEn: To live in comfort and luxury, waited on hand and foot; to enjoy a privileged life.
derivation: 宋·苏洵《上韩枢密书》天子者，养尊而处优，树恩而收名，与天下为喜乐者也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇洵《上韓樞密書》天子者，養尊而處優，樹恩而收名，與天下為喜樂者也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Xun's 'Letter to Han Shu'.
example: 父亲孤身在外，无人侍奉，甥女却在家中～，一经想起，更是坐立不宁。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十四回
exampleTraditional: 父親孤身在外，無人侍奉，甥女卻在家中～，一經想起，更是坐立不寧。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十四回
exampleEn: My father is alone outside with no one to serve him, while I live in comfort at home; the thought makes me restless. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 54

explanation: 丧胆吓破了胆。听到风声，就吓得丧失的勇气。形容对某种力量非常恐惧。
explanationTraditional: 喪膽嚇破了膽。聽到風聲，就嚇得喪失的勇氣。形容對某種力量非常恐懼。
explanationEn: To be terrified at the news; to lose courage upon hearing something frightening.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我军如下山猛虎，敌人闻风丧胆，溃不成军。
exampleTraditional: 我軍如下山猛虎，敵人聞風喪膽，潰不成軍。
exampleEn: Our army was like a fierce tiger descending the mountain; the enemy was terrified and fled in disarray.

explanation: 故故意；弄玩弄；玄虚用来掩盖真相，使人迷惑的欺骗手段。故意玩弄花招，迷惑人，欺骗人。
explanationTraditional: 故故意；弄玩弄；玄虛用來掩蓋真相，使人迷惑的欺騙手段。故意玩弄花招，迷惑人，欺騙人。
explanationEn: Deliberately playing tricks to confuse or deceive people.
derivation: 《韩非子·解老》圣人观其玄虚，用其周行，强字之曰道。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·解老》聖人觀其玄虛，用其周行，強字之曰道。”
derivationEn: From 'Hanfeizi·Jielao': 'The sage observes its mystery, uses its universal action, and reluctantly names it Tao.'
example: 似乎在～，不叫人懂，真使人纳闷。★邓拓《你看山水风景美不美》
exampleTraditional: 似乎在～，不叫人懂，真使人納悶。★鄧拓《你看山水風景美不美》
exampleEn: It seems deliberately mystifying, not meant to be understood, truly puzzling. — Deng Tuo, 'Do You Think the Landscape Is Beautiful?'

explanation: 利用职权，非法取得财物，过着奢侈糜烂的生活。
explanationTraditional: 利用職權，非法取得財物，過著奢侈糜爛的生活。
explanationEn: Using one's position to illegally obtain money and lead a corrupt and decadent life.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 自私自利，消极怠工，～，风头主义等等，是最可鄙的。（毛泽东《中国共产党在民族战争中的地位》）
exampleTraditional: 自私自利，消極怠工，～，風頭主義等等，是最可鄙的。（毛澤東《中國共產黨在民族戰爭中的地位》）
exampleEn: Selfishness, passive attitude, corruption, and seeking the limelight are most despicable. — Mao Zedong, 'The Role of the Chinese Communist Party in the National War'

explanation: 耀显扬。炫耀武力，显示威风。
explanationTraditional: 耀顯揚。炫耀武力，顯示威風。
explanationEn: To flaunt one's military strength and display one's power.
derivation: 元·乔孟符《两世姻缘》第三折你这般耀武扬威待怎么！”
derivationTraditional: 元·喬孟符《兩世姻緣》第三折你這般耀武揚威待怎麼！”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Qiao Mengfu's 'Two Lifetimes' Act 3: 'How dare you flaunt your power like this!'
example: 共涛、吞珪船到岛边，～，统兵上岸。童威、童猛谨守寨栅，不与交战。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 共濤、吞珪船到島邊，～，統兵上岸。童威、童猛謹守寨柵，不與交戰。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十二回
exampleEn: Gong Tao and Tun Pei arrived at the island, flaunting their power and leading troops ashore. Tong Wei and Tong Meng guarded the camp and did not engage. — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel' Chapter 12

explanation: 指同时占有或具有几种事物。
explanationTraditional: 指同時佔有或具有幾種事物。
explanationEn: To possess or have several things simultaneously.
derivation: 《墨子·法仪》奚以知天兼而爱之，兼而利之也？以其兼而有之，兼而食之也。”
derivationTraditional: 《墨子·法儀》奚以知天兼而愛之，兼而利之也？以其兼而有之，兼而食之也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mozi·Fayi': 'How do we know Heaven loves and benefits all? Because it possesses and nourishes all.'
example: 在科学研究方面，基础科学知识和应用科学知识应该～。
exampleTraditional: 在科學研究方面，基礎科學知識和應用科學知識應該～。
exampleEn: In scientific research, both basic and applied scientific knowledge should be possessed simultaneously.

explanation: 镜里的花，水里的月。原指诗中灵活而不可捉摸的意境，后比喻虚幻的景象。
explanationTraditional: 鏡裡的花，水裡的月。原指詩中靈活而不可捉摸的意境，後比喻虛幻的景象。
explanationEn: Flowers in a mirror and the moon in water; originally refers to an elusive poetic mood, later used to describe illusory scenes.
derivation: 唐·裴休《唐故左街僧录内供奉三教谈论引驾大德安国寺上座赐紫方袍大达法师元秘塔碑铭》峥嵘栋梁，一旦而摧。水月镜像，无心去来。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·裴休《唐故左街僧錄內供奉三教談論引駕大德安國寺上座賜紫方袍大達法師元秘塔碑銘》崢嶸棟樑，一旦而摧。水月鏡像，無心去來。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Pei Xiu's epitaph: 'The towering beams suddenly collapse. Water and moon, mirror image, come and go without intention.'
example: 我喜欢那种锤炼，那种色彩的配合，那种～。★何其芳《梦中道路》
exampleTraditional: 我喜歡那種錘鍊，那種色彩的配合，那種～。★何其芳《夢中道路》
exampleEn: I like that refinement, that color coordination, that mirror flower and water moon. — He Qifang, 'Dream Road'

explanation: 比喻玩弄手法，串通做弊。
explanationTraditional: 比喻玩弄手法，串通做弊。
explanationEn: To manipulate and collude in cheating.
derivation: 《左传·襄公二十六年》记载伯州犁有意偏袒公子围，叫皇颉作证，并向皇虻示，举起手说夫子为王子围，寡君之贵介弟也。”把手放下说此子可为穿封戍，方城外之县尹也，谁获子？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公二十六年》記載伯州犁有意偏袒公子圍，叫皇頡作證，並向皇虻示，舉起手說夫子為王子圍，寡君之貴介弟也。”把手放下說此子可為穿封戍，方城外之縣尹也，誰獲子？”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan·Xianggong 26th Year': Bo Zhouli favored Prince Wei, raised his hand saying 'This is the prince,' lowered it saying 'This is the county magistrate,' to confuse the witness.
example: 亏得尚有巧妙不同”一句注脚，还可～一番。★朱自靖《海阔天空”与古今中外”》
exampleTraditional: 虧得尚有巧妙不同”一句註腳，還可～一番。★朱自靖《海闊天空”與古今中外”》
exampleEn: Fortunately, there is a note 'ingeniously different,' allowing some manipulation. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Boundless Sky and Ancient and Modern'

explanation: 见一面的缘分。
explanationTraditional: 見一面的緣分。
explanationEn: A chance to meet someone once.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一回若问此物，倒有一面之缘。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一回若問此物，倒有一面之緣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 1: 'If you ask about this object, it has a one-meeting fate.'
example: 尽管他与那位郭小姐只～，然而她的形象却像用刀刻下来似的。★叶永烈《并蒂莲》
exampleTraditional: 儘管他與那位郭小姐只～，然而她的形象卻像用刀刻下來似的。★葉永烈《並蒂蓮》
exampleEn: Although he had only a one-meeting fate with Miss Guo, her image was carved into his memory. — Ye Yonglie, 'Twin Lotus Flowers'

explanation: 聪明智力发达，天资高。伶俐灵活、乖巧。形容小孩头脑机灵，活泼且乖巧。
explanationTraditional: 聰明智力發達，天資高。伶俐靈活、乖巧。形容小孩頭腦機靈，活潑且乖巧。
explanationEn: Intelligent, clever, and agile; describes a child who is bright, lively, and well-behaved.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十九回原来这乐和是一个聪明伶俐的人；诸般乐品学着便会；作事道头知尾；说起枪棒武艺，如糖似蜜价爱。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十九回原來這樂和是一個聰明伶俐的人；諸般樂品學著便會；作事道頭知尾；說起槍棒武藝，如糖似蜜價愛。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 49: 'This Le He was a clever and agile person; he learned all kinds of music easily and understood everything at once.'
example: 这个人真是～；她东问西找，竟然到了我们这里。★吴强《红日》第八章
exampleTraditional: 這個人真是～；她東問西找，竟然到了我們這裡。★吳強《紅日》第八章
exampleEn: This person is really clever and agile; she asked around and finally found us. — Wu Qiang, 'Red Sun' Chapter 8

explanation: 形容事情紧急到了极点（多用于公文、电报等）。
explanationTraditional: 形容事情緊急到了極點（多用於公文、電報等）。
explanationEn: Describes an extremely urgent matter (often used in official documents, telegrams, etc.).
derivation: 曹禺《王昭君》第二幕启奏陛下！鸡鹿寨十万火急，羽书传到长安，请圣裁。”
derivationTraditional: 曹禺《王昭君》第二幕啟奏陛下！雞鹿寨十萬火急，羽書傳到長安，請聖裁。”
derivationEn: From Cao Yu's 'Wang Zhaojun' Act 2: 'Your Majesty! The Jiluzhai fortress is extremely urgent; the feather dispatch has reached Chang'an, awaiting your decision.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指事情要靠人去做的。在一定的条件下，事情能否做成要看人的主观努力如何。
explanationTraditional: 指事情要靠人去做的。在一定的條件下，事情能否做成要看人的主觀努力如何。
explanationEn: Things depend on human effort; under certain conditions, success depends on one's subjective efforts.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第六十九回事在人为耳，彼朽骨者何知。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第六十九回事在人為耳，彼朽骨者何知。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 69: 'Things depend on human effort; those dead bones know nothing.'
example: 俗语说～，只要你勤奋努力，一定能有所作为。
exampleTraditional: 俗語說～，只要你勤奮努力，一定能有所作為。
exampleEn: As the saying goes, things depend on human effort; if you work hard, you will surely achieve something.

explanation: 聚细沙成宝塔。原指儿童堆塔游戏◇比喻积少成多。
explanationTraditional: 聚細沙成寶塔。原指兒童堆塔遊戲◇比喻積少成多。
explanationEn: Many a little makes a mickle; accumulation of small things leads to a large amount.
derivation: 《妙法莲华经·方便品》乃至童子戏，聚沙为佛塔。”
derivationTraditional: 《妙法蓮華經·方便品》乃至童子戲，聚沙為佛塔。”
derivationEn: From the Lotus Sutra: 'Even children at play, gathering sand to build a pagoda.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指人的一肚子委曲、不满的情绪。
explanationTraditional: 指人的一肚子委曲、不滿的情緒。
explanationEn: Full of grievances and discontent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他对上级的分工总是～。
exampleTraditional: 他對上級的分工總是～。
exampleEn: He is always full of complaints about his superiors' assignments.

explanation: 比喻没有油水的机构或地方。
explanationTraditional: 比喻沒有油水的機構或地方。
explanationEn: An institution or place with no extra benefits or perks; a clean but poor organization.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 深得无法测量。比喻对事物的情况捉摸不透。
explanationTraditional: 深得無法測量。比喻對事物的情況捉摸不透。
explanationEn: Too deep to be measured; unfathomable; enigmatic.
derivation: 明·袁宏道《吼山》山下石骨为匠者搜去，积水为潭，望之洞黑如墨汁，深不可测。”
derivationTraditional: 明·袁宏道《吼山》山下石骨為匠者搜去，積水為潭，望之洞黑如墨汁，深不可測。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Yuan Hongdao's 'Roar Mountain': 'The stone bones at the foot of the mountain were taken by craftsmen, water accumulated into a pool, looking dark as ink, unfathomable.'
example: 隆武帝～地微笑。★华而实《汉衣冠》一
exampleTraditional: 隆武帝～地微笑。★華而實《漢衣冠》一
exampleEn: Longwu Emperor smiled unfathomably. (from Hua Ershi's 'Han Crowns')

explanation: 怒放盛开。心里高兴得象花儿盛开一样。形容极其高兴。
explanationTraditional: 怒放盛開。心裡高興得象花兒盛開一樣。形容極其高興。
explanationEn: Heart blossoms with joy; extremely delighted.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第六十回平中丞此时喜得心花怒放，连说‘难为他了，难为他了。’”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第六十回平中丞此時喜得心花怒放，連說‘難為他了，難為他了。’”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 60: 'Ping Zhongcheng was so overjoyed that his heart blossomed, repeatedly saying 'He did it, he did it.''
example: 想起这件高兴事，不觉～。
exampleTraditional: 想起這件高興事，不覺～。
exampleEn: Thinking of this happy event, he couldn't help but feel his heart blossom with joy.

explanation: 形容人多手杂，动作纷乱。
explanationTraditional: 形容人多手雜，動作紛亂。
explanationEn: Many people with busy hands and feet; all in a bustle; disorderly.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷二十上堂七手八脚，三头两面，耳听不闻，眼觑不见，苦乐逆顺，打成一片。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷二十上堂七手八腳，三頭兩面，耳聽不聞，眼覷不見，苦樂逆順，打成一片。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting', Volume 20: 'In the hall, seven hands and eight feet, three heads and two faces, ears hear not, eyes see not, suffering and joy, adversity and prosperity, all become one.'
example: 众人～将他扛抬了出来。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleTraditional: 眾人～將他扛抬了出來。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleEn: Everyone carried him out with bustling hands and feet. (from Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 3)

explanation: 巧取软骗；豪夺强抢。旧时形容达官富豪谋取他人财物的手段。现指用各种方法谋取财物。
explanationTraditional: 巧取軟騙；豪奪強搶。舊時形容達官富豪謀取他人財物的手段。現指用各種方法謀取財物。
explanationEn: To obtain by trickery or by force; rapacious acquisition.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《次韵米黻二王书跋尾》巧偷豪夺古来有，一笑谁似痴虎头。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《次韻米黻二王書跋尾》巧偷豪奪古來有，一笑誰似痴虎頭。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Rhyming with Mi Fu's Postscript to Two Kings' Calligraphy': 'Cunning theft and forceful seizure have existed since ancient times, who laughs like a fool?'
example: ～”这成语，不正好用韩非的名言儒以文乱法，侠以武犯禁”来说明吗？★闻一多《关于儒、道、土匪》
exampleTraditional: ～”這成語，不正好用韓非的名言儒以文亂法，俠以武犯禁”來說明嗎？★聞一多《關於儒、道、土匪》
exampleEn: The idiom 'cunning theft and forceful seizure' can be explained by Han Fei's famous saying: 'Confucians use literature to disrupt law, knights use martial arts to violate prohibitions.' (from Wen Yiduo's 'On Confucianism, Chivalry, and Bandits')

explanation: 尸位空占职位，不尽职守；素餐白吃饭。空占着职位而不做事，白吃饭。
explanationTraditional: 尸位空佔職位，不盡職守；素餐白吃飯。空佔著職位而不做事，白吃飯。
explanationEn: To hold a position without doing any work; to be a sinecure holder.
derivation: 《汉书·朱云传》今朝廷大臣，上不能匡主，下亡以益民，皆尸位素餐。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·朱雲傳》今朝廷大臣，上不能匡主，下亡以益民，皆尸位素餐。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Zhu Yun': 'The current court ministers cannot assist the ruler above nor benefit the people below; they all hold positions without doing work.'
example: 在我们这里既没有老虎”可打，也没有苍蝇”可欺，所以简直有～”之嫌，心里很觉得不安。★邹韬奋《经历·临时的组织》
exampleTraditional: 在我們這裡既沒有老虎”可打，也沒有蒼蠅”可欺，所以簡直有～”之嫌，心裡很覺得不安。★鄒韜奮《經歷·臨時的組織》
exampleEn: In our place, there are no 'tigers' to beat nor 'flies' to bully, so I feel uneasy about being a sinecure holder. (from Zou Taofen's 'Experience: Temporary Organization')

explanation: 比喻叙述事情或转述别人的话，为了夸大，添上原来没有的内容。
explanationTraditional: 比喻敘述事情或轉述別人的話，為了誇大，添上原來沒有的內容。
explanationEn: To add inflammatory details; to exaggerate or embellish a story.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 你说话要实事求是，不要添油加醋。
exampleTraditional: 你說話要實事求是，不要添油加醋。
exampleEn: You should speak based on facts, not add fuel to the fire.

explanation: 原指古代军队中先行开路和打头阵的将领。现比喻进行某项工作的先遣人员。
explanationTraditional: 原指古代軍隊中先行開路和打頭陣的將領。現比喻進行某項工作的先遣人員。
explanationEn: Pioneer; pathbreaker; vanguard.
derivation: 清·张南庄《何典》第十回便即点起阴兵，教活死人挂了骑印做大元帅，冒失鬼为开路先锋，地里鬼、雌雄人为参谋，引兵前去救应。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張南莊《何典》第十回便即點起陰兵，教活死人掛了騎印做大元帥，冒失鬼為開路先鋒，地裡鬼、雌雄人為參謀，引兵前去救應。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Nanzhuang's 'What Book?', Chapter 10: 'He then mustered ghost soldiers, made Huo Guiren the grand marshal, Maoshi Gui the vanguard, and Dili Gui and Ci Xiongren as advisors, leading troops to rescue.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 又是打雷，又是闪电。交加一起袭来。两种事物同时或错杂出现。
explanationTraditional: 又是打雷，又是閃電。交加一起襲來。兩種事物同時或錯雜出現。
explanationEn: Thunder and lightning occur simultaneously; two things happen together or intermingle.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷三十八忽然阴云四合，空中雷电交加，李三身上枷钮尽行脱落。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷三十八忽然陰雲四合，空中雷電交加，李三身上枷鈕盡行脫落。”
derivationEn: From 'Erke Pai'an Jingqi' by Ling Mengchu of Ming Dynasty: 'Suddenly dark clouds gathered, thunder and lightning struck together, and the shackles on Li San fell off.'
example: 是夜二更，风雨大作，～，喊杀之声，闻数十里。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第七卷
exampleTraditional: 是夜二更，風雨大作，～，喊殺之聲，聞數十里。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第七卷
exampleEn: That night at the second watch, wind and rain raged, thunder and lightning struck together, and the sound of shouting and killing could be heard for dozens of miles. — From 'Yushi Mingyan' by Feng Menglong of Ming Dynasty, Chapter 7

explanation: 风度风采气度，指美好的举止姿态；翩翩文雅的样子。举止文雅优美。
explanationTraditional: 風度風采氣度，指美好的舉止姿態；翩翩文雅的樣子。舉止文雅優美。
explanationEn: Elegant and graceful in demeanor; having a refined and charming bearing.
derivation: 《史记·平原君列传》平原君，翩翩浊世之佳公子也。”《新唐书·张九龄传》风度能若张九龄乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原君列傳》平原君，翩翩濁世之佳公子也。”《新唐書·張九齡傳》風度能若張九齡乎？”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lord Pingyuan': 'Lord Pingyuan was a graceful and refined gentleman in a chaotic world.' Also from 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Zhang Jiuling': 'Can one's demeanor match that of Zhang Jiuling?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 若好象；悬河激流倾泻。讲起话来滔滔不绝，象瀑布不停地奔流倾泻。形容能说会辨，说起来没个完。
explanationTraditional: 若好象；懸河激流傾瀉。講起話來滔滔不絕，象瀑布不停地奔流傾瀉。形容能說會辨，說起來沒個完。
explanationEn: Speak with a flow of words like a waterfall; eloquent and talkative, unable to stop.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·赏誉》郭子玄语议如悬河泻水，注而不竭。”唐·韩愈《石鼓歌》安能以此上论列，愿借辩口如悬河。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·賞譽》郭子玄語議如懸河瀉水，注而不竭。”唐·韓愈《石鼓歌》安能以此上論列，願借辯口如懸河。”
derivationEn: From 'Shishuo Xinyu' by Liu Yiqing of Southern Song: 'Guo Zixuan's speech was like a waterfall, pouring endlessly.' Also from 'Stone Drum Song' by Han Yu of Tang: 'How can I discuss this at court? I wish to borrow a glib tongue like a waterfall.'
example: 知县见他说的～，又是本朝确切贼，不由得不信。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四回
exampleTraditional: 知縣見他說的～，又是本朝確切賊，不由得不信。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四回
exampleEn: The magistrate, hearing him speak with such eloquence and about a real thief of the dynasty, could not help but believe him. — From 'The Scholars' by Wu Jingzi of Qing, Chapter 4

explanation: 璧平圆形中间有孔的玉。珍珠联串在一起，美玉结合在一块。比喻杰出的人才或美好的事物结合在一起。
explanationTraditional: 璧平圓形中間有孔的玉。珍珠聯串在一起，美玉結合在一塊。比喻傑出的人才或美好的事物結合在一起。
explanationEn: Pearls strung together and jade combined; a perfect match of outstanding talents or beautiful things.
derivation: 《汉书·律历志上》日月如合璧，五星如连珠。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·律曆志上》日月如合璧，五星如連珠。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Treatise on Calendar': 'The sun and moon fit together like a jade disc, and the five planets string like pearls.'
example: 便是你两个，当日无心相遇，也想不到今日～，作了同床姐妹。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 便是你兩個，當日無心相遇，也想不到今日～，作了同床姐妹。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十八回
exampleEn: Even you two, meeting by chance that day, never imagined that you would later become sisters in marriage, a perfect union. — From 'The Story of a Heroic Youth' by Wen Kang of Qing, Chapter 28

explanation: 只坐着吃，山也要空。指光是消费而不从事生产，即使有堆积如山的财富，也要耗尽。
explanationTraditional: 只坐著吃，山也要空。指光是消費而不從事生產，即使有堆積如山的財富，也要耗盡。
explanationEn: Sit idle and eat away a mountain; if one only consumes without producing, even vast wealth will be exhausted.
derivation: 元·秦简夫《东堂老》第一折便好道坐吃山空，立吃地陷。”
derivationTraditional: 元·秦簡夫《東堂老》第一折便好道坐吃山空，立吃地陷。”
derivationEn: From 'Dongtang Lao' by Qin Jianfu of Yuan: 'As the saying goes, sit idle and eat away a mountain, stand idle and eat away the earth.'
example: 到京之后，住在店里，已经是当卖度日，～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 到京之後，住在店裡，已經是當賣度日，～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十八回
exampleEn: After arriving in the capital, staying at an inn, they had already pawned their belongings to live, and soon they would exhaust their resources. — From 'The Bureaucrats' by Li Baojia of Qing, Chapter 28

explanation: 哄吵闹。形容聚在一起的人一下子吵吵嚷嚷地走散了。
explanationTraditional: 哄吵鬧。形容聚在一起的人一下子吵吵嚷嚷地走散了。
explanationEn: A crowd suddenly disperses noisily and chaotically.
derivation: 明·沈德符《万历野获编·壬戌科罢选吉士》第十卷御笔硃书四大字，曰‘今年且罢。’于是一哄而散。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《萬曆野獲編·壬戌科罷選吉士》第十卷御筆硃書四大字，曰‘今年且罷。’於是一鬨而散。”
derivationEn: From 'Wanli Yehuo Bian' by Shen Defu of Ming: 'The emperor wrote four large characters in vermilion: 'This year, we stop.' Then the crowd dispersed noisily.'
example: 白凤、阿男早收拾好钱文，向众人道谢，看的就～了。★清·吴趼人《情变》第六回
exampleTraditional: 白鳳、阿男早收拾好錢文，向眾人道謝，看的就～了。★清·吳趼人《情變》第六回
exampleEn: Bai Feng and A Nan quickly collected the money, thanked the crowd, and the onlookers dispersed noisily. — From 'Love Changes' by Wu Jianren of Qing, Chapter 6

explanation: 鱼骨头卡在喉咙里。比喻心里有话没有说出来，非常难受。
explanationTraditional: 魚骨頭卡在喉嚨裡。比喻心裡有話沒有說出來，非常難受。
explanationEn: Like a fishbone stuck in the throat; having something to say but unable to express it, causing discomfort.
derivation: 汉·许慎《说文解字》鲠，食骨留咽中也。”段玉裁注韦曰‘骨所以鲠，刺人也。’忠言逆耳，如食骨在喉，故云骨鲠之臣。《汉书》以下皆作骨鲠，字从鱼，谓留咽者鱼骨较多也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·許慎《說文解字》鯁，食骨留咽中也。”段玉裁注韋曰‘骨所以鯁，刺人也。’忠言逆耳，如食骨在喉，故云骨鯁之臣。《漢書》以下皆作骨鯁，字從魚，謂留咽者魚骨較多也。”
derivationEn: From 'Shuowen Jiezi' by Xu Shen of Han: 'Geng means a bone stuck in the throat.' Duan Yucai's commentary: 'Wei says: bones cause obstruction. Loyal words are unpleasant to the ear, like a bone in the throat, hence the term 'bone-geng minister'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 奇奇兵，奇计；制制服。出奇兵战胜敌人。比喻用对方意料不到的方法取得胜利。
explanationTraditional: 奇奇兵，奇計；制制服。出奇兵戰勝敵人。比喻用對方意料不到的方法取得勝利。
explanationEn: Defeat the enemy with a surprise attack; achieve victory by unexpected means.
derivation: 《孙子·势篇》凡战者，以正合，以奇胜。故善出奇者，无穷如天地，不竭如江河。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·勢篇》凡戰者，以正合，以奇勝。故善出奇者，無窮如天地，不竭如江河。”
derivationEn: From 'The Art of War: Potential' by Sunzi: 'In all battles, use the orthodox to engage and the unorthodox to win. Thus one who is skilled at using the unorthodox is as infinite as heaven and earth, as inexhaustible as rivers.'
example: 统率所部，～，将法人所占越南各城，迅图恢复。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 統率所部，～，將法人所佔越南各城，迅圖恢復。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: Commanding his troops, he used surprise tactics to quickly recover the cities occupied by the French in Vietnam. — From 'History of the Qing Court' by Gao Yang, Volume 2

explanation: 大义正义；凛然严肃、或敬畏的样子。由于胸怀正义而神态庄严，令人敬畏。
explanationTraditional: 大義正義；凜然嚴肅、或敬畏的樣子。由於胸懷正義而神態莊嚴，令人敬畏。
explanationEn: Solemn and awe-inspiring due to upholding righteousness; dignified and fearless in the face of injustice.
derivation: 宋·曹辅《唐颜文忠公新庙记》大义凛然，奋裙首倡。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·曹輔《唐顏文忠公新廟記》大義凜然，奮裙首倡。”
derivationEn: From 'Tang Yan Wenzhong Gong Xin Miao Ji' by Cao Fu of Song: 'With great righteousness and awe-inspiring dignity, he was the first to rise up.'
example: 因想起文丞相和谢先生，一般的～，使宋室虽亡，犹有余荣。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 因想起文丞相和謝先生，一般的～，使宋室雖亡，猶有餘榮。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第二十二回
exampleEn: Thinking of Prime Minister Wen and Mr. Xie, both so awe-inspiring in their righteousness, even though the Song dynasty fell, they left behind glory. — From 'History of Pain' by Wu Jianren of Qing, Chapter 22

explanation: 一个先唱，一个随声应和。原形容两人感情相通。现也比喻二人互相配合，互相呼应。
explanationTraditional: 一個先唱，一個隨聲應和。原形容兩人感情相通。現也比喻二人互相配合，互相呼應。
explanationEn: One sings and the other joins in; originally describes two people in harmony, now also means two people cooperate and echo each other.
derivation: 《诗经·郑风·萚兮》叔兮伯兮，倡予和女。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·鄭風·蘀兮》叔兮伯兮，倡予和女。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Zheng Feng: Tuo Xi': 'Uncles and brothers, I sing and you harmonize.'
example: 自此～，渐渐情熟，往来不绝。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三十四
exampleTraditional: 自此～，漸漸情熟，往來不絕。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三十四
exampleEn: From then on, they sang in harmony, gradually becoming intimate, and visited each other frequently. — From 'Jingshi Tongyan' by Feng Menglong of Ming, Chapter 34

explanation: 暴暴烈，急躁。急怒叫跳，象打雷一样猛烈。形容又急又怒，大发脾气的样子。
explanationTraditional: 暴暴烈，急躁。急怒叫跳，象打雷一樣猛烈。形容又急又怒，大發脾氣的樣子。
explanationEn: To fly into a violent rage; to be furious and jump about like thunder.
derivation: 《古诗为焦仲卿妻作》我有亲父兄，性行暴如雷。”
derivationTraditional: 《古詩為焦仲卿妻作》我有親父兄，性行暴如雷。”
derivationEn: From 'The Ancient Poem for Jiao Zhongqing's Wife': 'I have a father and elder brother, whose temper is violent as thunder.'
example: 他哥哥知道了，气得～。叫了他去骂。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第二十三回
exampleTraditional: 他哥哥知道了，氣得～。叫了他去罵。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第二十三回
exampleEn: When his elder brother found out, he was furious and called him over to scold him. (from Wu Jianren's 'Strange Status Quo Witnessed in Twenty Years', Chapter 23)

explanation: 指对恶劣的环境或无礼的待遇采取顺从和忍受的态度。
explanationTraditional: 指對惡劣的環境或無禮的待遇採取順從和忍受的態度。
explanationEn: To meekly submit to oppression, maltreatment, or unfavorable circumstances; to take things as they come.
