derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Zhao Yi's 'Notes on the Twenty-Two Histories', Volume 28: 'Since ancient times, large-scale military campaigns and corvée labor have never failed to cause popular discontent and lead to the downfall of the state and the death of the ruler.'
example: 上半年在那里办过几个月厘局，不该应要钱的心太狠了，直弄得～，有无数商人来省上控。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五回
exampleTraditional: 上半年在那裡辦過幾個月釐局，不該應要錢的心太狠了，直弄得～，有無數商人來省上控。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五回
exampleEn: He had been in charge of the tax bureau there for half a year, but his greed was so excessive that it caused widespread popular discontent, and countless merchants came to the provincial capital to appeal. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 5

explanation: 泛指所有的人。
explanationTraditional: 泛指所有的人。
explanationEn: Men and women, old and young; people of all ages and genders.
derivation: 光未然《黄河大合唱·黄水谣》麦苗肥，稻花香，男女老少喜洋洋。”
derivationTraditional: 光未然《黃河大合唱·黃水謠》麥苗肥，稻花香，男女老少喜洋洋。”
derivationEn: Guang Weiran's 'Yellow River Cantata', 'Song of the Yellow River': 'Wheat seedlings are fat, rice flowers are fragrant, men and women, old and young, are all joyful.'
example: 你要通知到村里的～。
exampleTraditional: 你要通知到村裡的～。
exampleEn: You must inform all the villagers, men and women, old and young.

explanation: 最好的地方。指首都。
explanationTraditional: 最好的地方。指首都。
explanationEn: The best place; refers to the capital city.
derivation: 《汉书·儒林传序》故教化之行也，建首善，自京师始。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·儒林傳序》故教化之行也，建首善，自京師始。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han', Biography of the Confucian Scholars: 'Therefore, the implementation of education begins with establishing the best example, starting from the capital.'
example: 当章氏势焰熏天时，我也曾环顾这～，寻求所谓公理”、道义”之类而不得。（鲁迅《华盖集·公理”的把戏》）
exampleTraditional: 當章氏勢焰熏天時，我也曾環顧這～，尋求所謂公理”、道義”之類而不得。（魯迅《華蓋集·公理”的把戲》）
exampleEn: When Zhang's power was at its height, I looked around this capital city, seeking so-called 'justice' and 'morality', but found none. (Lu Xun's 'Huagai Collection', 'The Trick of 'Justice'')

explanation: 损伤美好的景致。比喻败坏兴致。
explanationTraditional: 損傷美好的景緻。比喻敗壞興致。
explanationEn: To spoil the beautiful scenery; to ruin the fun or mood.
derivation: 唐·李商隐《杂纂》把花间喝道”、月下把火”等列为杀风景”的事情。
derivationTraditional: 唐·李商隱《雜纂》把花間喝道”、月下把火”等列為殺風景”的事情。
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty Li Shangyin's 'Miscellaneous Compilation' lists things like 'shouting while walking among flowers' and 'holding a torch under the moon' as acts that spoil the scenery.
example: 安公子高高兴兴的一个酒场，再不想作了这等一个～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十回
exampleTraditional: 安公子高高興興的一個酒場，再不想作了這等一個～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十回
exampleEn: An Gongzi had a joyful drinking party, but never expected it to turn into such a mood spoiler. — Qing Dynasty Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 30

explanation: 风云比喻难得的机会；际会遇合。比喻有能力的人遇上好机会。
explanationTraditional: 風雲比喻難得的機會；際會遇合。比喻有能力的人遇上好機會。
explanationEn: Wind and clouds meeting; metaphor for capable people encountering good opportunities.
derivation: 《周易·乾·文言》云从龙，风从虎，圣人作万物睹。”汉·王充《论衡·偶会》良辅超拔于际会。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·乾·文言》雲從龍，風從虎，聖人作萬物睹。”漢·王充《論衡·偶會》良輔超拔於際會。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes: Qian·Wenyan': 'Clouds follow the dragon, wind follows the tiger, the sage acts and all things see.' Han Dynasty Wang Chong's 'Lunheng: Ouhui': 'Good ministers are promoted at the right time.'
example: 盖圣上既奉天运承了大统，天下闺中自应广育英才，以为辅弼，亦如古之八元、八恺，～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五回
exampleTraditional: 蓋聖上既奉天運承了大統，天下閨中自應廣育英才，以為輔弼，亦如古之八元、八愷，～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五回
exampleEn: Since the emperor has ascended the throne by heavenly mandate, the realm should cultivate talents to assist him, just like the ancient eight talents and eight virtuous ones, meeting at an opportune time. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 5

explanation: 妙美妙。形容好得难以用文字、语言表达。
explanationTraditional: 妙美妙。形容好得難以用文字、語言表達。
explanationEn: So wonderful that words cannot describe it.
derivation: 晋·郭璞《江赋》经纪天地，错综人术，妙不可尽之于言，事不可穷之于笔。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·郭璞《江賦》經紀天地，錯綜人術，妙不可盡之於言，事不可窮之於筆。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty Guo Pu's 'Rhapsody on the Yangtze River': 'Managing heaven and earth, interweaving human affairs, the wonder cannot be fully expressed in words, nor the matter fully captured by the pen.'
example: 公子侧会其意，一吸而尽，觉甘香快嗓，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 公子側會其意，一吸而盡，覺甘香快嗓，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五十九回
exampleEn: The prince understood the meaning, drank it all in one gulp, and felt it sweet and refreshing, indescribably wonderful. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 59

explanation: 发誓立志，决不改变。
explanationTraditional: 發誓立志，決不改變。
explanationEn: To swear an oath and resolve never to change.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·仇大娘》仲叔尚廉利其嫁，屡劝驾，邵氏矢志不摇。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·仇大娘》仲叔尚廉利其嫁，屢勸駕，邵氏矢志不搖。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Qiu Daniang': 'Zhongshu Shanglian wanted her to remarry, repeatedly urging, but Shao's resolve was unshaken.'
example: 他是以这样的精神品质来～地为人民服务。★冯雪峰《论》
exampleTraditional: 他是以這樣的精神品質來～地為人民服務。★馮雪峰《論》
exampleEn: With such a spirit and quality, he serves the people unwaveringly. — Feng Xuefeng, 'On...'

explanation: 形容夫妻互相尊敬，象对待宾客一样。
explanationTraditional: 形容夫妻互相尊敬，象對待賓客一樣。
explanationEn: To treat each other with mutual respect, like honored guests; describes a harmonious couple.
derivation: 《左传·僖公三十三年》臼季使过冀，见冀缺耨，其妻饁之，敬，相待如宾。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公三十三年》臼季使過冀，見冀缺耨，其妻饁之，敬，相待如賓。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's 33rd Year': 'Jiu Ji passed through Ji, saw Ji Que weeding, and his wife brought him food, respectful, treating each other as guests.'
example: 夫耕于前，妻耘于后，同甘共苦，～。★明·李昌祺《剪灯余话·鸾鸾传》
exampleTraditional: 夫耕於前，妻耘於後，同甘共苦，～。★明·李昌祺《剪燈餘話·鸞鸞傳》
exampleEn: The husband plows in front, the wife weeds behind, sharing joys and sorrows, respecting each other like guests. — Ming Dynasty Li Changqi, 'Lamplight Stories: Luanluan's Tale'

explanation: 胸臆胸腔，内心，引申为心意。直率地抒发自己的思想感情。
explanationTraditional: 胸臆胸腔，內心，引申為心意。直率地抒發自己的思想感情。
explanationEn: To express one's true feelings directly and candidly.
derivation: 明·胡震亨《唐音癸签》第十回杜公七律，正以其负力之大，寄悰之深，能直抒胸臆，广酬事物之变而无碍。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡震亨《唐音癸籤》第十回杜公七律，正以其負力之大，寄悰之深，能直抒胸臆，廣酬事物之變而無礙。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Hu Zhenheng's 'Tang Yin Gui Qian' Chapter 10: 'Du Fu's seven-character regulated verses, precisely because of his great strength and deep emotions, can directly express his feelings and widely respond to changes in things without hindrance.'
example: 古诗章节未谐，尤多趁韵；然～，语皆有物。★清·李慈铭《越缦堂诗话》卷中
exampleTraditional: 古詩章節未諧，尤多趁韻；然～，語皆有物。★清·李慈銘《越縵堂詩話》卷中
exampleEn: The ancient poem's rhythm is not harmonious, and it often forces rhymes; but it directly expresses feelings, and every word has substance. — Qing Dynasty Li Ciming, 'Yue Man Tang Poetry Notes', Volume 2

explanation: 昂仰，高抬。抬起头迈开大步向前。形容精神抖擞，意气风发。
explanationTraditional: 昂仰，高抬。抬起頭邁開大步向前。形容精神抖擻，意氣風發。
explanationEn: To hold one's head high and stride forward; describes being energetic and spirited.
derivation: 老舍《鼓书艺人》二十四新郎昂首阔步，在他身边迈着鸭子步，为的是显摆他那马靴和银马刺。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《鼓書藝人》二十四新郎昂首闊步，在他身邊邁著鴨子步，為的是顯擺他那馬靴和銀馬刺。”
derivationEn: Lao She's 'Drum Artists' Chapter 24: 'The groom walked with head high and strides wide, waddling beside him to show off his riding boots and silver spurs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 苟苟且。不敢随便地同意。指对人对事抱慎重态度。
explanationTraditional: 苟苟且。不敢隨便地同意。指對人對事抱慎重態度。
explanationEn: To not dare to agree casually; to hold a cautious attitude towards people or matters.
derivation: 明·王世贞《蔺相如完璧归赵论》蔺相如完璧归赵，人人都称赞他。但我不敢苟同这一看法。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王世貞《藺相如完璧歸趙論》藺相如完璧歸趙，人人都稱讚他。但我不敢苟同這一看法。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Wang Shizhen's 'On Lin Xiangru Returning the Jade Intact to Zhao': 'Lin Xiangru returned the jade intact to Zhao, everyone praised him. But I dare not casually agree with this view.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 城里到处刮风下雨。原形容重阳节前的雨景◇比喻某一事件传播很广，到处议论纷纷。
explanationTraditional: 城裡到處颳風下雨。原形容重陽節前的雨景◇比喻某一事件傳播很廣，到處議論紛紛。
explanationEn: Wind and rain all over the city; originally described the rainy scene before the Double Ninth Festival; later metaphor for a widely spread event causing much discussion.
derivation: 宋·潘大林《题壁》诗满城风雨近重阳。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·潘大林《題壁》詩滿城風雨近重陽。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Pan Dalin's poem on a wall: 'The wind and rain fill the city as the Double Ninth Festival approaches.'
example: 为什么倒弄得闹闹攘攘，～的呢？★鲁迅《花边文学·零食》
exampleTraditional: 為什麼倒弄得鬧鬧攘攘，～的呢？★魯迅《花邊文學·零食》
exampleEn: Why has it become so noisy and full of rumors? — Lu Xun, 'Flower Border Literature: Snacks'

explanation: 比喻帮助坏人干坏事。
explanationTraditional: 比喻幫助壞人幹壞事。
explanationEn: To help a tyrant do evil; metaphor for helping bad people do bad things.
derivation: 《史记·留侯世家》今始入秦，即安其乐，此所谓助桀为虐。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·留侯世家》今始入秦，即安其樂，此所謂助桀為虐。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: House of the Marquis of Liu': 'Now that we have entered Qin, to indulge in its pleasures is what is called helping Jie do evil.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 聪听觉灵敏；明眼力敏锐。听得清楚，看得明白。形容头脑清楚，眼光敏锐。
explanationTraditional: 聰聽覺靈敏；明眼力敏銳。聽得清楚，看得明白。形容頭腦清楚，眼光敏銳。
explanationEn: Having sharp ears and keen eyes; clear-headed and perceptive.
derivation: 《周易·鼎》巽而，耳目聪明，柔进而上行。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·鼎》巽而，耳目聰明，柔進而上行。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Changes: 'The Ding hexagram says: Xun and, ears and eyes are sharp and clear, the soft advances upward.'
example: 此时服了朱草，只觉～，谁知回想幼年所读经书，不但丝毫不忘，就是平时所作诗文，也都如在目前。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九回
exampleTraditional: 此時服了朱草，只覺～，誰知回想幼年所讀經書，不但絲毫不忘，就是平時所作詩文，也都如在目前。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九回
exampleEn: After taking the purple herb, he felt his ears and eyes sharp and clear. Unexpectedly, when recalling the classics he read in childhood, not only did he remember them perfectly, but even his usual poems and essays appeared before his eyes. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 9

explanation: 番次。一次又一次。形容次数之多。
explanationTraditional: 番次。一次又一次。形容次數之多。
explanationEn: Time and again; repeatedly.
derivation: 清·顾琐《黄绣球》第四回本官到任以来，就几次三番的传谕董事，出过告示。”
derivationTraditional: 清·顧瑣《黃繡球》第四回本官到任以來，就幾次三番的傳諭董事，出過告示。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Gu Suo, The Story of Huang Xiuqiu, Chapter 4: 'Since taking office, the magistrate has repeatedly instructed the directors and issued notices.'
example: 但一位先生却以为这客店也包办囚人的饭食，我住在那里不相宜，几次三番，几次三番地说。（鲁迅《朝花夕拾·滕野先生》）
exampleTraditional: 但一位先生卻以為這客店也包辦囚人的飯食，我住在那裡不相宜，幾次三番，幾次三番地說。（魯迅《朝花夕拾·滕野先生》）
exampleEn: But a gentleman thought that this inn also provided meals for prisoners, and it was unsuitable for me to stay there, so he said it time and again, time and again. — Lu Xun, Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk, 'Mr. Fujino'

explanation: 维相当于是”；谷比喻困境。无论是进还是退，都是处在困境之中。形容进退两难。
explanationTraditional: 維相當於是”；谷比喻困境。無論是進還是退，都是處在困境之中。形容進退兩難。
explanationEn: In a dilemma; between the devil and the deep blue sea.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·桑柔》人亦有言，进退维谷。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·桑柔》人亦有言，進退維谷。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs, Greater Odes, 'Sang Rou': 'People also have a saying: in a dilemma whether to advance or retreat.'
example: 在我自己的思想上也正感受着一种～的苦闷。★郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年》
exampleTraditional: 在我自己的思想上也正感受著一種～的苦悶。★郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年》
exampleEn: In my own thoughts, I was also experiencing a bitter dilemma. — Guo Moruo, Revolutionary Spring and Autumn, 'The Creative Decade'

explanation: 树叶从树根生发出来，凋落后最终还是回到树根。比喻事物总有一定的归宿。多指作客他乡的人最终要回到本乡。
explanationTraditional: 樹葉從樹根生髮出來，凋落後最終還是回到樹根。比喻事物總有一定的歸宿。多指作客他鄉的人最終要回到本鄉。
explanationEn: Falling leaves return to the roots; a person residing elsewhere eventually returns to his hometown.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷五叶落归根，来时无口。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷五葉落歸根，來時無口。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan, Records of the Transmission of the Lamp, Volume 5: 'Leaves fall and return to the root; when coming, there is no mouth.'
example: 树高千丈，～，将来总得有个着落，不能不说说明白。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 樹高千丈，～，將來總得有個著落，不能不說說明白。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十二回
exampleEn: A tree may grow a thousand feet high, but its leaves fall and return to the roots. Eventually, there must be a settlement, and it cannot be left unexplained. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, The Bureaucrats, Chapter 22

explanation: 夫妻永远和好之意。
explanationTraditional: 夫妻永遠和好之意。
explanationEn: A harmonious union for a hundred years; a wish for a happy married life.
derivation: 《粉妆楼》第一回百年和合，千载团圆恭喜！”
derivationTraditional: 《粉妝樓》第一回百年和合，千載團圓恭喜！”
derivationEn: From The Powdered Makeup, Chapter 1: 'A hundred years of harmony, a thousand years of reunion, congratulations!'
example: 今日你们缔结了良缘，祝福你们～，万事如意。
exampleTraditional: 今日你們締結了良緣，祝福你們～，萬事如意。
exampleEn: Today you have formed a blessed union. May you have a harmonious marriage for a hundred years and all the best.

explanation: 灿烂鲜明耀眼。形容光彩四射，鲜明耀眼。也比喻成绩卓著，十分引人注目。
explanationTraditional: 燦爛鮮明耀眼。形容光彩四射，鮮明耀眼。也比喻成績卓著，十分引人注目。
explanationEn: Brilliant and splendid; dazzling and magnificent. Also metaphorically refers to outstanding achievements.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十八回只觉金光万道，瑞气千条，灿烂辉煌，华彩夺目。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十八回只覺金光萬道，瑞氣千條，燦爛輝煌，華彩奪目。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 48: 'Only felt golden rays and auspicious clouds, brilliant and splendid, dazzling and eye-catching.'
example: 《西江月》领导全靠共产党，胜利～。”★刘流《烈火金钢·开头语》
exampleTraditional: 《西江月》領導全靠共產黨，勝利～。”★劉流《烈火金鋼·開頭語》
exampleEn: The Moon over the West River: 'Leadership depends on the Communist Party, victory is brilliant and splendid.' — Liu Liu, Heroes of Fire and Steel, Opening Words

explanation: 假借↑狸假借老虎的威势。比喻依仗别人的势力欺压人。
explanationTraditional: 假借↑狸假借老虎的威勢。比喻依仗別人的勢力欺壓人。
explanationEn: A fox borrows the tiger's might; to bully others by flaunting one's powerful connections.
derivation: 《战国策·楚策一》虎求百兽而食之，得狐。……虎以为然，故遂与之行。兽见之皆走，虎不知兽畏己而走也，以为畏狐也。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·楚策一》虎求百獸而食之，得狐。……虎以為然，故遂與之行。獸見之皆走，虎不知獸畏己而走也，以為畏狐也。”
derivationEn: From Strategies of the Warring States, Chu Strategy I: 'A tiger seeks all beasts to eat, and catches a fox... The tiger thought it was true, so it walked with the fox. The beasts saw them and fled. The tiger did not know that the beasts fled from him, thinking they fled from the fox.'
example: 果然府中来借，怎好不借？只怕被别人～的诓的去，这个却保不得他。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 果然府中來借，怎好不借？只怕被別人～的誆的去，這個卻保不得他。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二十
exampleEn: Indeed, if the prefecture comes to borrow, how can we refuse? But I'm afraid others might use the fox's borrowed tiger might to swindle it away, and we cannot guarantee that. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 20

explanation: 文、饰掩饰；过、非错误。用漂亮的言词掩饰自己的过失和错误。
explanationTraditional: 文、飾掩飾；過、非錯誤。用漂亮的言詞掩飾自己的過失和錯誤。
explanationEn: To cover up one's faults and mistakes with fine words.
derivation: 《论语·子张》小人之过也必文。”《庄子·盗跖》辩足以饰非。”唐·刘知几《史通·惑经》岂与夫庸儒末学，文过饰非，使夫问者缄辞社口，怀疑不展，若斯而已哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子張》小人之過也必文。”《莊子·盜蹠》辯足以飾非。”唐·劉知幾《史通·惑經》豈與夫庸儒末學，文過飾非，使夫問者緘辭社口，懷疑不展，若斯而已哉？”
derivationEn: From the Analects, 'Zi Zhang': 'A petty man's faults are always glossed over.' Zhuangzi, 'Robber Zhi': 'Eloquence suffices to cover up faults.' Tang Dynasty, Liu Zhiji, General History, 'Perplexing Classics': 'How can it be compared to mediocre scholars who cover up faults and mistakes, making questioners silent and doubtful, as if that were enough?'
example: 其实错了就老实自己承认，倒是精神安泰的事情；～是最苦痛的勾当。★邹韬奋《论文、杂感、随笔·硬吞香蕉皮》
exampleTraditional: 其實錯了就老實自己承認，倒是精神安泰的事情；～是最苦痛的勾當。★鄒韜奮《論文、雜感、隨筆·硬吞香蕉皮》
exampleEn: Actually, admitting mistakes honestly brings peace of mind; covering up faults and mistakes is the most painful thing. — Zou Taofen, Essays, Miscellanies, and Random Thoughts, 'Swallowing Banana Skins Raw'

explanation: 得得利。失失利。成功与失败，得到的与丢掉的。
explanationTraditional: 得得利。失失利。成功與失敗，得到的與丟掉的。
explanationEn: Success and failure, gains and losses.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·步骘》女配太子，受礼若吊，慷忾之趋，惟笃之物，成败得失，皆如所虑，可谓守道见机，好古之士也。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·步騭》女配太子，受禮若吊，慷愾之趨，惟篤之物，成敗得失，皆如所慮，可謂守道見機，好古之士也。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Three Kingdoms, Book of Wu, 'Biography of Bu Zhi': 'The daughter married the crown prince, receiving gifts as if in mourning, the trend of generosity, only the sincere, success and failure, gains and losses, all as anticipated, can be called a man of virtue who sees the opportunity, a scholar of antiquity.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容妇女妆饰打扮得十分艳丽。
explanationTraditional: 形容婦女妝飾打扮得十分豔麗。
explanationEn: To wear heavy makeup and dress gaudily.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》每日只是浓妆艳抹，和西门庆做一处取乐。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》每日只是濃妝豔抹，和西門慶做一處取樂。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, Water Margin: 'Every day she wore heavy makeup and gaudy dress, and had fun with Ximen Qing.'
example: 她穿得比以前漂亮，而且是～，还戴了一副长耳坠。★巴金《家》
exampleTraditional: 她穿得比以前漂亮，而且是～，還戴了一副長耳墜。★巴金《家》
exampleEn: She was dressed more beautifully than before, and heavily made up, even wearing long earrings. — Ba Jin, Family

explanation: 为了劫夺财物，害人性命。
explanationTraditional: 為了劫奪財物，害人性命。
explanationEn: To murder someone for their property.
derivation: 元·曾瑞卿《留鞋记》第二折你如今将俺主人摆布死了，故意将这绣鞋揣在怀里，正是你图财致命，便待干罢。”
derivationTraditional: 元·曾瑞卿《留鞋記》第二折你如今將俺主人擺佈死了，故意將這繡鞋揣在懷裡，正是你圖財致命，便待幹罷。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'Liu Xie Ji' by Zeng Ruiqui: 'You have murdered my master and deliberately hid this embroidered shoe in your bosom, which is exactly plotting for property and taking life.'
example: 血池狱、阿鼻狱、秤杆狱，脱皮露骨，折臂断筋，也只为～，宰畜屠生。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 血池獄、阿鼻獄、秤桿獄，脫皮露骨，折臂斷筋，也只為～，宰畜屠生。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十一回
exampleEn: The Blood Pool Hell, Avici Hell, and Scales Hell, where skin is peeled and bones exposed, arms broken and tendons severed, all for murdering for property and slaughtering livestock. (from 'Journey to the West' by Wu Cheng'en)

explanation: 邪不正当、不正派；归回到。从邪路上回到正路上来，不再做坏事。
explanationTraditional: 邪不正當、不正派；歸回到。從邪路上回到正路上來，不再做壞事。
explanationEn: To give up evil and return to the right path; to reform.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第九十一回将军弃邪归正，与宋某等同替国家出力，朝廷自当重用。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第九十一回將軍棄邪歸正，與宋某等同替國家出力，朝廷自當重用。”
derivationEn: From 'Water Margin' by Shi Nai'an: 'General, abandon evil and return to righteousness, work for the country alongside us, and the court will surely give you an important post.'
example: 这才叫～，惩创善心。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 這才叫～，懲創善心。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十四回
exampleEn: This is called 'reforming and returning to righteousness, punishing evil and encouraging good.' (from 'Journey to the West' by Wu Cheng'en)

explanation: 了了结，解决。把一件主要的事情了结以后，其余有关的事情也跟着了结。
explanationTraditional: 了了結，解決。把一件主要的事情了結以後，其餘有關的事情也跟著了結。
explanationEn: Once the main issue is resolved, all related matters are settled as well.
derivation: 《朱子语类》卷八有资质甚高者，一了一切了，即不须节节用工也。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子語類》卷八有資質甚高者，一了一切了，即不須節節用工也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Xi's Classified Conversations': 'For those of high aptitude, once one thing is understood, everything is understood, so there is no need for step-by-step effort.'
example: 非但扣押，依我之见，立刻把他杀了，～。★曹禺《王昭君》第三幕
exampleTraditional: 非但扣押，依我之見，立刻把他殺了，～。★曹禺《王昭君》第三幕
exampleEn: Not just detain him; in my opinion, kill him immediately, and then everything will be settled. (from 'Wang Zhaojun' by Cao Yu)

explanation: 勇清代指战争期间临时招募的士兵。原指没有统帅的逃散士兵。现有指没有组织的集体队伍里独自行动的人。
explanationTraditional: 勇清代指戰爭期間臨時招募的士兵。原指沒有統帥的逃散士兵。現有指沒有組織的集體隊伍裡獨自行動的人。
explanationEn: Stray soldiers without a commander; individuals acting alone without organization.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国人民解放军布告》为着确保城乡治安、安定社会秩序的目的，一切散兵游勇，均应向当地人民解放军或人民政府投诚报到。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國人民解放軍佈告》為著確保城鄉治安、安定社會秩序的目的，一切散兵遊勇，均應向當地人民解放軍或人民政府投誠報到。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Proclamation of the People's Liberation Army': 'For the purpose of ensuring urban and rural security and maintaining social order, all straggling soldiers should report to the local People's Liberation Army or People's Government.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 彪小老虎，比喻躯干壮大；汉男子。身材高大、结实的男子。
explanationTraditional: 彪小老虎，比喻軀幹壯大；漢男子。身材高大、結實的男子。
explanationEn: A tall and sturdy man; a burly fellow.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《痛史》第十一回金奎也选了二十名彪形大汉，教他们十八般武艺。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《痛史》第十一回金奎也選了二十名彪形大漢，教他們十八般武藝。”
derivationEn: From 'A Tale of Pain' by Wu Jianren: 'Jinkui also selected twenty burly men and taught them the eighteen martial arts.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 包包容。形容胆子极大。
explanationTraditional: 包包容。形容膽子極大。
explanationEn: Extremely bold; audacious beyond measure.
derivation: 清·杨潮观《吟风阁杂剧·黄石婆授计逃关》因此上胆大包天，一铁锺，几乎把秦王断送。”
derivationTraditional: 清·楊潮觀《吟風閣雜劇·黃石婆授計逃關》因此上膽大包天，一鐵鍾，幾乎把秦王斷送。”
derivationEn: From 'Yinfeng Pavilion Plays' by Yang Chaoguan: 'Thus, with audacity that could encompass the sky, he almost killed the First Emperor of Qin with an iron hammer.'
example: 我虽年幼，～，小小秦庭，何足道哉。★欧阳予倩《荆轲》第四幕
exampleTraditional: 我雖年幼，～，小小秦庭，何足道哉。★歐陽予倩《荊軻》第四幕
exampleEn: Though young, I am extremely bold; the small court of Qin is nothing to me. (from 'Jing Ke' by Ouyang Yuqian)

explanation: 指各在天底下的一个地方。形容相隔极远，见面困难。
explanationTraditional: 指各在天底下的一個地方。形容相隔極遠，見面困難。
explanationEn: To be far apart from each other, making meetings difficult.
derivation: 汉·苏武《古诗四首》良友远离别，各在天一方。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·蘇武《古詩四首》良友遠離別，各在天一方。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty poem by Su Wu: 'Good friends are separated far away, each in a corner of the sky.'
example: 先生此去，～，未知相会却在何日。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三十六回
exampleTraditional: 先生此去，～，未知相會卻在何日。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三十六回
exampleEn: After you leave, we will be far apart, and I don't know when we will meet again. (from 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' by Luo Guanzhong)

explanation: 恣意任意，随意；妄为胡作非为。随心所欲，胡作非为。
explanationTraditional: 恣意任意，隨意；妄為胡作非為。隨心所欲，胡作非為。
explanationEn: To act willfully and recklessly; to do as one pleases without restraint.
derivation: 《清史稿·列传二·诸王一》乾隆十三年，诏责神保住瓷意妄为，致两目成眚，又虐待兄女，夺爵。”
derivationTraditional: 《清史稿·列傳二·諸王一》乾隆十三年，詔責神保住瓷意妄為，致兩目成眚，又虐待兄女，奪爵。”
derivationEn: From 'Draft History of Qing': 'In the thirteenth year of Qianlong, an edict reprimanded Shen Baozhu for acting willfully, causing blindness in both eyes, and abusing his brother's daughter, leading to the revocation of his title.'
example: 察其原因，不外有少数顽固分子，不顾民族国家利益，～。★毛泽东《陕甘宁边区政府、第八路军后方留守处布告》
exampleTraditional: 察其原因，不外有少數頑固分子，不顧民族國家利益，～。★毛澤東《陝甘寧邊區政府、第八路軍後方留守處佈告》
exampleEn: The reason is that a few diehards, disregarding national and ethnic interests, act willfully. (from Mao Zedong's 'Proclamation of the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region Government and the Eighth Route Army Rear Office')

explanation: 栉梳头发；沐洗头发。风梳发，雨洗头。形容人经常在外面不顾风雨地辛苦奔波。
explanationTraditional: 櫛梳頭髮；沐洗頭髮。風梳髮，雨洗頭。形容人經常在外面不顧風雨地辛苦奔波。
explanationEn: To endure hardship while traveling or working outdoors; lit. combed by the wind and washed by the rain.
derivation: 《庄子·天下》沐甚雨，栉疾风。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天下》沐甚雨，櫛疾風。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi': 'Washed by heavy rain, combed by swift wind.'
example: ～三十余年，扫荡群凶，与百姓除害，使汉室复存。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十一回
exampleTraditional: ～三十餘年，掃蕩群兇，與百姓除害，使漢室復存。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十一回
exampleEn: For over thirty years, enduring hardships, sweeping away the villains, and eliminating harm for the people, restoring the Han dynasty. (from 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' by Luo Guanzhong)

explanation: 持抓住不放。各人都坚持自己的意见。
explanationTraditional: 持抓住不放。各人都堅持自己的意見。
explanationEn: Each sticks to their own opinion; to hold different views.
derivation: 宋·钱易《南部新书·乙》凡中书有军国政事，则中书舍人各执所见，杂署其名，谓之五花判事。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·錢易《南部新書·乙》凡中書有軍國政事，則中書舍人各執所見，雜署其名，謂之五花判事。”
derivationEn: From 'New Stories of the South' by Qian Yi: 'Whenever there are military or state affairs in the Secretariat, the secretaries each hold their own opinions and sign their names, which is called 'five-flower judgment.''
example: 然此辈执术疏，谋生急，信口欺诈，言人人殊，甚至徒毁其师，子讥其父，～，彼此相非。★清·黄钧宰《金壶七墨·堪舆》
exampleTraditional: 然此輩執術疏，謀生急，信口欺詐，言人人殊，甚至徒毀其師，子譏其父，～，彼此相非。★清·黃鈞宰《金壺七墨·堪輿》
exampleEn: But these people have shallow skills, are anxious for a living, and deceive with lies, each saying different things, even disciples slandering masters, sons mocking fathers, each holding their own views, criticizing each other. (from 'Golden Pot and Seven Inkstones' by Huang Junzai)

explanation: 现多形容敌人在行动前频繁活动。
explanationTraditional: 現多形容敵人在行動前頻繁活動。
explanationEn: Describes the enemy's frequent activities before taking action.
derivation: 《乐府诗集·木兰诗》小弟闻姊来，磨刀霍霍向猪羊。”
derivationTraditional: 《樂府詩集·木蘭詩》小弟聞姊來，磨刀霍霍向豬羊。”
derivationEn: From 'Ballad of Mulan' in Yuefu Poetry Collection: 'When the younger brother heard that his sister was coming, he sharpened the knife towards the pig and sheep.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有根据的、不怀好意的、带有讥讽的话。另指私下议论暗中传说。
explanationTraditional: 沒有根據的、不懷好意的、帶有譏諷的話。另指私下議論暗中傳說。
explanationEn: Unfounded, malicious, or sarcastic remarks; also refers to private gossip or rumors spread secretly.
derivation: 汉·焦赣《易林》华言风语，乱相诳误。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·焦贛《易林》華言風語，亂相誑誤。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Jiao Gan's 'Yi Lin': 'Flowery words and wind-borne talk, confusing and misleading each other.'
example: 为她高高丰满的胸脯和厚实的脚板，母亲忍受过许多～的责难。★冯德英《苦菜花》第一章
exampleTraditional: 為她高高豐滿的胸脯和厚實的腳板，母親忍受過許多～的責難。★馮德英《苦菜花》第一章
exampleEn: For her tall and full chest and thick soles, her mother endured many such groundless accusations. (Feng Deying, 'Bitter Cauliflower', Chapter 1)

explanation: 一只手把天遮住。形容依仗权势，玩弄手段，蒙蔽群众。
explanationTraditional: 一隻手把天遮住。形容依仗權勢，玩弄手段，矇蔽群眾。
explanationEn: To cover the sky with one hand; describes relying on power, using tricks to deceive the masses.
derivation: 唐·曹邺《读李斯传》诗难将一人手，掩得天下目。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·曹鄴《讀李斯傳》詩難將一人手，掩得天下目。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Cao Ye's poem 'Reading Li Si's Biography': 'It is hard for one person's hand to cover the eyes of the world.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容事情曲折复杂，不是一句话能说清楚的（用在不好的事）。
explanationTraditional: 形容事情曲折複雜，不是一句話能說清楚的（用在不好的事）。
explanationEn: Describes a complicated or twisted situation that cannot be explained in a few words (used for bad things).
derivation: 元·李直夫《虎头牌》第一折我一言难尽，来探望你这歹孩儿索是远路风尘。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李直夫《虎頭牌》第一折我一言難盡，來探望你這歹孩兒索是遠路風塵。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Li Zhifu's play 'Tiger Head Pai', first act: 'I cannot say it all in one word; coming to visit you, my bad child, is a long journey through wind and dust.'
example: 说起这件事，真是～，等有时间我们再详谈。
exampleTraditional: 說起這件事，真是～，等有時間我們再詳談。
exampleEn: Speaking of this matter, it's really hard to explain in a few words; let's talk in detail when we have time.

explanation: 形容东西非常混杂，或事情非常杂乱。
explanationTraditional: 形容東西非常混雜，或事情非常雜亂。
explanationEn: Describes things that are very mixed or matters that are very messy.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十三回窃取陈编，以为己有，惟恐别人看出，不免又添些自己意思，杂七杂八，强为贯串，以为掩人耳目。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十三回竊取陳編，以為己有，惟恐別人看出，不免又添些自己意思，雜七雜八，強為貫串，以為掩人耳目。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 73: 'Stealing from old texts and claiming them as one's own, fearing others might see, one adds some own ideas, mixing all sorts of things, forcing them together to cover up.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 乏缺少；其那，那些。那样的人并不少。
explanationTraditional: 乏缺少；其那，那些。那樣的人並不少。
explanationEn: There is no lack of such people; such people are not few.
derivation: 鲁迅《朝花夕拾·后记》但这种意见，恐怕是怀抱者不乏其人，而且由来已久的，不过大抵不敢毅然删改，笔之于书。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《朝花夕拾·後記》但這種意見，恐怕是懷抱者不乏其人，而且由來已久的，不過大抵不敢毅然刪改，筆之於書。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk', postscript: 'But this opinion, I fear, has no lack of holders, and has been around for a long time, but most dare not delete it outright and write it down.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容长年刻苦读书。
explanationTraditional: 形容長年刻苦讀書。
explanationEn: Describes years of hard study.
derivation: 元·刘祁《归潜志》卷七古人谓十年窗下无人问，一举成名天天下知。”
derivationTraditional: 元·劉祁《歸潛志》卷七古人謂十年窗下無人問，一舉成名天天下知。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Liu Qi's 'Gui Qian Zhi', Volume 7: 'The ancients said, ten years by the cold window, unknown to all; once successful, known under heaven.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 从大坛子里捉王八。比喻想要捕捉的对象已在掌握之中。形容手到擒来，轻易而有把握。
explanationTraditional: 從大罈子裡捉王八。比喻想要捕捉的對象已在掌握之中。形容手到擒來，輕易而有把握。
explanationEn: To catch a turtle in a jar; metaphor for having the target already under control, easily and surely.
derivation: 元·康进之《李逵负荆》第四折这是揉着我山儿的痒处，管教他瓮中捉鳖，手到拿来。”
derivationTraditional: 元·康進之《李逵負荊》第四折這是揉著我山兒的癢處，管教他甕中捉鱉，手到拿來。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Kang Jinzhi's 'Li Kui Carries Thorns', fourth act: 'This tickles my fancy; I'll make him catch the turtle in the jar, easily get it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 血战非常激烈地拼死地战斗。指激烈战斗到最后时刻。
explanationTraditional: 血戰非常激烈地拼死地戰鬥。指激烈戰鬥到最後時刻。
explanationEn: To fight a bloody battle to the very end; to fight fiercely until the last moment.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《送灵州李判官》诗血战乾坤赤，氛迷日月黄。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《送靈州李判官》詩血戰乾坤赤，氛迷日月黃。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Fu's poem 'Seeing Off Magistrate Li of Lingzhou': 'Bloody battle turns the universe red, mist and dust dim the sun and moon.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 子孙后裔；世世代代的意思。
explanationTraditional: 子孫後裔；世世代代的意思。
explanationEn: Descendants; generation after generation.
derivation: 《书·梓材》欲至于万年惟王，子子孙孙永保民。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·梓材》欲至於萬年惟王，子子孫孫永保民。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents', 'Zi Cai' chapter: 'May the king last for ten thousand years, and his sons and grandsons forever protect the people.'
example: 造下十大功劳，指望～，世享富贵。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第三十一卷
exampleTraditional: 造下十大功勞，指望～，世享富貴。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第三十一卷
exampleEn: He made ten great contributions, hoping that his descendants would enjoy wealth and honor for generations. (Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 31)

explanation: 原形容颜色和香气不同于一般花卉的牡丹花◇也形容女子的美丽。
explanationTraditional: 原形容顏色和香氣不同於一般花卉的牡丹花◇也形容女子的美麗。
explanationEn: Originally described the unique color and fragrance of peonies; also used to describe a woman's extraordinary beauty.
derivation: 唐·李浚《摭异记》国色朝酣酒，天香夜染衣。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李浚《摭異記》國色朝酣酒，天香夜染衣。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Jun's 'Zhi Yi Ji': 'National beauty drunk at dawn, heavenly fragrance dyes clothes at night.'
example: 于那娉婷妩媚之中，无不带著一团书卷秀气，虽非～，却是斌斌儒雅。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十六回
exampleTraditional: 於那娉婷嫵媚之中，無不帶著一團書卷秀氣，雖非～，卻是斌斌儒雅。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十六回
exampleEn: Among her graceful charm, there was always a touch of scholarly elegance; though not of national beauty and heavenly fragrance, she was refined and cultured. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 66

explanation: 指平时说话不多。
explanationTraditional: 指平時說話不多。
explanationEn: Refers to someone who usually speaks little.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容强大无比，可以战胜一切。也比喻办任何事情都能成功。
explanationTraditional: 形容強大無比，可以戰勝一切。也比喻辦任何事情都能成功。
explanationEn: Describes invincibility in battle; also metaphorically means success in any endeavor.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策二》战无不胜而不知止者，身且死，爵且后归，犹为蛇足也。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策二》戰無不勝而不知止者，身且死，爵且後歸，猶為蛇足也。”
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States·Qi Strategy II': 'One who is invincible in battle but does not know when to stop will die, and his title will pass to others, like adding legs to a snake.'
example: 自先王以来，楚兵～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十九回
exampleTraditional: 自先王以來，楚兵～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十九回
exampleEn: Since the time of the former kings, the Chu army has been invincible in battle. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 19

explanation: 拨开乌云见到太阳。比喻冲破黑暗见到光明。也比喻疑团消除，心里顿时明白。
explanationTraditional: 撥開烏雲見到太陽。比喻衝破黑暗見到光明。也比喻疑團消除，心裡頓時明白。
explanationEn: Parting the clouds to see the sun. Metaphor for dispelling darkness to see the light, or clearing up doubts to suddenly understand.
derivation: 《晋书·乐广传》此人之水镜，见之莹然，若披云雾而睹青天也。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·樂廣傳》此人之水鏡，見之瑩然，若披雲霧而睹青天也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin·Biography of Yue Guang': 'This man is a mirror of water; seeing him is clear, as if parting the clouds to see the blue sky.'
example: 晚生得蒙老先生指教，如～，感激不尽。（清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三十九回）
exampleTraditional: 晚生得蒙老先生指教，如～，感激不盡。（清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三十九回）
exampleEn: Thanks to your guidance, I feel as if parting the clouds to see the sun, deeply grateful. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 39

explanation: 形容佯作进攻，以便退却。
explanationTraditional: 形容佯作進攻，以便退卻。
explanationEn: Describes feigning an attack in order to retreat.
derivation: 清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三回栾廷玉抵当不住，虚晃一枪，败阵而走。”
derivationTraditional: 清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三回欒廷玉抵當不住，虛晃一槍，敗陣而走。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 3: 'Luan Tingyu could not withstand the attack, so he feigned a thrust and fled in defeat.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 延缓对方进攻的计策。指拖延时间，然后再想办法。
explanationTraditional: 延緩對方進攻的計策。指拖延時間，然後再想辦法。
explanationEn: A strategy to delay the enemy's advance; refers to stalling for time to think of a solution.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十九回孔明用缓兵之计，渐退汉中，都督何故怀疑，不早追之？”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十九回孔明用緩兵之計，漸退漢中，都督何故懷疑，不早追之？”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 99: 'Kong Ming used a delaying tactic to gradually retreat to Hanzhong; why does the governor hesitate and not pursue?'
example: 话大决意要杀陶三，监生恐闹出事来，原为～。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第七十二回
exampleTraditional: 話大決意要殺陶三，監生恐鬧出事來，原為～。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第七十二回
exampleEn: The magistrate was determined to kill Tao San, but the warden, fearing trouble, originally proposed this as a delaying tactic. — Qing Dynasty, Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 72

explanation: 焕发光彩四射的样子。形容精神振作，情绪饱满。
explanationTraditional: 煥發光彩四射的樣子。形容精神振作，情緒飽滿。
explanationEn: Describes being full of energy and high spirits.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·莲香》生觉丹田火热，精神焕发。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·蓮香》生覺丹田火熱，精神煥發。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio·Lian Xiang': 'He felt a warmth in his dantian and his spirit radiated.'
example: 在故乡，我到处都可以看到那种久经战争锻炼的、在任何时候都是～斗志昂扬勇往直前的人们。★峻青《故乡杂记》
exampleTraditional: 在故鄉，我到處都可以看到那種久經戰爭鍛鍊的、在任何時候都是～鬥志昂揚勇往直前的人們。★峻青《故鄉雜記》
exampleEn: In my hometown, I could see everywhere those who, tempered by long wars, were always spirited, high in morale, and brave in progress. — Jun Qing's 'Notes on Hometown'

explanation: 从前没有过，今后也不会再有。夸张性地形容独一无二。
explanationTraditional: 從前沒有過，今後也不會再有。誇張性地形容獨一無二。
explanationEn: Never before and never again; hyperbolically describes uniqueness.
derivation: 宋·赵佶《宣和画谱》顾（顾恺之，晋代画家）冠于前，张（张僧繇，南朝梁代画家）绝于后，而道子（吴道子，唐代画家）乃兼有之。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·趙佶《宣和畫譜》顧（顧愷之，晉代畫家）冠於前，張（張僧繇，南朝梁代畫家）絕於後，而道子（吳道子，唐代畫家）乃兼有之。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhao Ji's 'Xuanhe Painting Manual': 'Gu (Gu Kaizhi) excelled before, Zhang (Zhang Sengyou) surpassed after, and Daozhi (Wu Daozi) combined both.'
example: 祖孙三代倒做了三朝元老，真可以算得～”的了。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 祖孫三代倒做了三朝元老，真可以算得～”的了。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第十六回
exampleEn: Three generations of the family served as senior officials in three dynasties, truly unprecedented and unrepeatable. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'History of Pain', Chapter 16

explanation: 临靠近；渊深水坑。如同处于深渊边缘一般。比喻存有戒心，行事极为谨慎。
explanationTraditional: 臨靠近；淵深水坑。如同處於深淵邊緣一般。比喻存有戒心，行事極為謹慎。
explanationEn: As if standing on the edge of an abyss; metaphor for being extremely cautious and vigilant.
derivation: 《诗·小雅·小昮》战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·小雅·小昮》戰戰兢兢，如臨深淵，如履薄冰。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs·Xiaoya·Xiaomin': 'Trembling and cautious, as if standing on the edge of an abyss, as if treading on thin ice.'
example: 黄帝居人上，惴惴～。★明·李贽《初潭集·君臣一》
exampleTraditional: 黃帝居人上，惴惴～。★明·李贄《初潭集·君臣一》
exampleEn: The Yellow Emperor, being above others, was anxious as if standing on the edge of an abyss. — Ming Dynasty, Li Zhi's 'A Collection of Initial Tan·Monarchs and Ministers I'

explanation: 鸿巨，大。形容工程大，功夫深的著作。
explanationTraditional: 鴻巨，大。形容工程大，功夫深的著作。
explanationEn: Describes a monumental work of great scale and depth.
derivation: 清·皮锡瑞《经学历史·经学复盛时代》今鸿篇巨制，照耀寰区。”
derivationTraditional: 清·皮錫瑞《經學歷史·經學復盛時代》今鴻篇鉅製，照耀寰區。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Pi Xirui's 'History of Classical Studies·Era of Revival': 'Today, monumental works illuminate the world.'
example: 那时候，～如《世界文学》和《世界文库》之类，还没有诞生。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文末篇·〈译文〉复刊词》
exampleTraditional: 那時候，～如《世界文學》和《世界文庫》之類，還沒有誕生。★魯迅《且介亭雜文末篇·〈譯文〉復刊詞》
exampleEn: At that time, monumental works like 'World Literature' and 'World Library' had not yet been born. — Lu Xun's 'Essays of Qiejieting·Postscript to 'Yiwen' Reissue'

explanation: 一拍桌子猛地站起来。形容非常愤慨。
explanationTraditional: 一拍桌子猛地站起來。形容非常憤慨。
explanationEn: To strike the table and stand up abruptly, expressing great indignation.
derivation: 毛泽东《别了，司徒雷登》闻一多拍案而起，横眉怒对国民党的手枪，宁可倒下去，不愿屈服。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《別了，司徒雷登》聞一多拍案而起，橫眉怒對國民黨的手槍，寧可倒下去，不願屈服。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'Farewell, Leighton Stuart': Wen Yiduo struck the table and stood up, glaring at the Kuomintang's guns, preferring to fall rather than yield.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 朝早晨；暮晚上。早晚都想念。形容非常想念或经常想着某一件事。
explanationTraditional: 朝早晨；暮晚上。早晚都想念。形容非常想念或經常想著某一件事。
explanationEn: To think of someone or something from morning till night; to yearn day and night.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世恒言》卷二十四再说沈洪自从中秋夜见了玉姐，到如今朝思暮想，废寝忘餐。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世恆言》卷二十四再說沈洪自從中秋夜見了玉姐，到如今朝思暮想，廢寢忘餐。”
derivationEn: Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 24: Since Shen Hong saw Yujie on the Mid-Autumn night, he has been thinking of her day and night, neglecting sleep and meals.
example: 他终于回到了阔别多年、～的故乡。
exampleTraditional: 他終於回到了闊別多年、～的故鄉。
exampleEn: He finally returned to his hometown, which he had missed day and night for years.

explanation: 画蛇时给蛇添上脚。比喻做了多余的事，非但无益，反而不合适。也比喻虚构事实，无中生有。
explanationTraditional: 畫蛇時給蛇添上腳。比喻做了多餘的事，非但無益，反而不合適。也比喻虛構事實，無中生有。
explanationEn: To draw legs on a snake; to add something superfluous, making it inappropriate or unnecessary.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策二》蛇固无足，子安能为之足？” 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第一百十回将军功绩已成，威声大震，可以止矣。今若前进，倘不如意，正如‘画蛇添足’也。”。
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策二》蛇固無足，子安能為之足？” 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第一百十回將軍功績已成，威聲大震，可以止矣。今若前進，倘不如意，正如‘畫蛇添足’也。”。
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States·Qi Strategy II': A snake has no legs; how can you add them? Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 110: Your achievements are complete, your prestige is great, you can stop. If you advance now and things go wrong, it would be like 'drawing legs on a snake'.
example: 这也是一则事实，并非做书的人～，为此奇谈。★《花月痕》第五一回
exampleTraditional: 這也是一則事實，並非做書的人～，為此奇談。★《花月痕》第五一回
exampleEn: This is also a fact, not the author adding superfluous details to make it a strange tale. - 'Flower Moon Marks', Chapter 51

explanation: 原指凶恶的神◇用来形容非常凶恶的人。
explanationTraditional: 原指兇惡的神◇用來形容非常兇惡的人。
explanationEn: Originally refers to fierce gods; now used to describe extremely vicious people.
derivation: 元·无名氏《桃花女》第三折又犯着金神七煞上路，又犯着太岁，遭这般凶神恶煞，必然板僵身死了也。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《桃花女》第三折又犯著金神七煞上路，又犯著太歲，遭這般凶神惡煞，必然板僵身死了也。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'The Peach Blossom Girl', Act 3: Encountering the Golden Star and Seven Evil Spirits on the road, and also the Tai Sui, such fierce gods and evil spirits will surely cause stiff death.
example: 大家一看见金四和那些～的家丁，就知道是怎么一回事了。★马忆湘《朝阳花》第一章
exampleTraditional: 大家一看見金四和那些～的家丁，就知道是怎麼一回事了。★馬憶湘《朝陽花》第一章
exampleEn: As soon as everyone saw Jin Si and those fierce-looking servants, they knew what was happening. - Ma Yixiang's 'Morning Flower', Chapter 1

explanation: 大肆任意，放纵。无节制地大量花钱。
explanationTraditional: 大肆任意，放縱。無節制地大量花錢。
explanationEn: To spend money extravagantly and without restraint.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们不能大肆挥霍，要注意勤俭节约。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能大肆揮霍，要注意勤儉節約。
exampleEn: We must not spend extravagantly; we should pay attention to thrift and economy.

explanation: 旧的朝代为新的朝代所代替。
explanationTraditional: 舊的朝代為新的朝代所代替。
explanationEn: The replacement of one dynasty by another.
derivation: 陶菊隐《北洋军阀统治时期史话》第四章但是袁所提的其他五个条件，与改朝换代只有程度上的差别。”
derivationTraditional: 陶菊隱《北洋軍閥統治時期史話》第四章但是袁所提的其他五個條件，與改朝換代只有程度上的差別。”
derivationEn: Tao Juyin's 'History of the Northern Warlords Period', Chapter 4: But the other five conditions proposed by Yuan were only different in degree from a change of dynasty.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 蛮粗野。不讲道理，纠缠不放。
explanationTraditional: 蠻粗野。不講道理，糾纏不放。
explanationEn: To argue unreasonably and pester someone.
derivation: 明·杨尔曾《韩湘子全集》第二十八回我两个是惯弄障眼法儿的，你们快去投别人做师父，莫在此胡缠乱搅。”
derivationTraditional: 明·楊爾曾《韓湘子全集》第二十八回我兩個是慣弄障眼法兒的，你們快去投別人做師父，莫在此胡纏亂攪。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Yang Erzeng's 'Complete Story of Han Xiangzi', Chapter 28: We two are used to playing tricks; you should go find someone else as a teacher, don't pester here.
example: 我说的正经话，你不听，～的说了这些闲篇儿，谁来听你。★清·邵振华《侠义佳人》第一回
exampleTraditional: 我說的正經話，你不聽，～的說了這些閒篇兒，誰來聽你。★清·邵振華《俠義佳人》第一回
exampleEn: I'm talking seriously, but you won't listen; instead, you talk nonsense and pester me. Who would listen to you? - Qing Dynasty Shao Zhenhua's 'Chivalrous Beauties', Chapter 1

explanation: 禹三皇五帝时中原的领袖。大禹治理水患为百姓谋福。
explanationTraditional: 禹三皇五帝時中原的領袖。大禹治理水患為百姓謀福。
explanationEn: Yu the Great controlled the flood, bringing benefits to the people.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 你知道大禹治水的故事吗？
exampleTraditional: 你知道大禹治水的故事嗎？
exampleEn: Do you know the story of Yu the Great controlling the flood?

explanation: 空头有名无实的。指不能兑现，即取不到钱的支票。比喻不准备实现的诺言。
explanationTraditional: 空頭有名無實的。指不能兌現，即取不到錢的支票。比喻不準備實現的諾言。
explanationEn: A bad check; a promise that is not intended to be kept.
derivation: 茹志娟《在果树园里》我知道会上根本没研究她的什么事，心里有些怪黎凤乱开空头支票。”
derivationTraditional: 茹志娟《在果樹園裡》我知道會上根本沒研究她的什麼事，心裡有些怪黎鳳亂開空頭支票。”
derivationEn: Ru Zhijuan's 'In the Orchard': I knew the meeting didn't discuss her matter at all, and I felt a bit annoyed at Li Feng for making empty promises.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹言谁对谁错。
explanationTraditional: 猶言誰對誰錯。
explanationEn: To distinguish who is right and who is wrong.
derivation: 元·李致远《还牢末》第一折谁与你挑唇料嘴，辨别个谁是谁非。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李致遠《還牢末》第一折誰與你挑唇料嘴，辨別個誰是誰非。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty Li Zhiyuan's 'Return to the Prison', Act 1: Who is arguing with you, distinguishing who is right and who is wrong?
example: ～谁曲谁直，没梁桶儿一再休提！★明·刘兑《金童玉女娇红记》
exampleTraditional: ～誰曲誰直，沒梁桶兒一再休提！★明·劉兌《金童玉女嬌紅記》
exampleEn: Who is right and who is wrong, who is crooked and who is straight, don't mention it again! - Ming Dynasty Liu Dui's 'Golden Boy and Jade Girl'

explanation: 象暂时聚合的一群乌鸦。比喻临时杂凑的、毫无组织纪律的一群人。
explanationTraditional: 象暫時聚合的一群烏鴉。比喻臨時雜湊的、毫無組織紀律的一群人。
explanationEn: A disorderly crowd; a mob without discipline or organization.
derivation: 《后汉书·耿弇传》归发突骑以辚乌合之众，如摧枯折腐耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·耿弇傳》歸發突騎以轔烏合之眾，如摧枯折腐耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Geng Yan': 'Send cavalry to crush this rabble like breaking rotten wood.'
example: 外边虽有些人，也是～，不相统摄。★清·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 外邊雖有些人，也是～，不相統攝。★清·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第十二回
exampleEn: Although there are some people outside, they are a disorderly crowd without unity. — Qing Dynasty, Dong Lu Gu Kuang Sheng, 'Awakening from Drunkenness', Chapter 12

explanation: 没有哪件坏事不干的。指干尽了坏事。
explanationTraditional: 沒有哪件壞事不幹的。指幹盡了壞事。
explanationEn: To commit all kinds of evil; to stop at no evil.
derivation: 清·郑燮《范县署中寄舍弟墨书》五宋自绍兴以来，主和议，增岁币，送尊号，处卑朝，括民膏，戮大将，无恶不作，无陋不为。”
derivationTraditional: 清·鄭燮《範縣署中寄舍弟墨書》五宋自紹興以來，主和議，增歲幣，送尊號，處卑朝，括民膏，戮大將，無惡不作，無陋不為。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zheng Xie's 'Letter to My Brother in Fan County': 'Since Shaoxing period of Song, they made peace, increased tribute, offered titles, humbled themselves, extorted people, killed generals—no evil left undone.'
example: 八国联军侵略中国时，在北京杀人放火，～。
exampleTraditional: 八國聯軍侵略中國時，在北京殺人放火，～。
exampleEn: When the Eight-Power Allied Forces invaded China, they killed and burned in Beijing, committing all kinds of evil.

explanation: 出出现；没消失。象神鬼那样出没无常。形容出没无常，不可捉摸◇泛指行动变化迅速。
explanationTraditional: 出出現；沒消失。象神鬼那樣出沒無常。形容出沒無常，不可捉摸◇泛指行動變化迅速。
explanationEn: To appear and disappear unpredictably; to be elusive and swift.
derivation: 《淮南子·兵略训》善者之动也，神出而鬼行。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·兵略訓》善者之動也，神出而鬼行。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi: Military Strategy': 'The movement of a good commander is like spirits appearing and ghosts disappearing.'
example: 抗日游击队～，打得日本鬼子魂飞魄散。
exampleTraditional: 抗日遊擊隊～，打得日本鬼子魂飛魄散。
exampleEn: The anti-Japanese guerrilla forces appeared and disappeared unpredictably, terrifying the Japanese soldiers.

explanation: 气势伟大美丽。
explanationTraditional: 氣勢偉大美麗。
explanationEn: Magnificent and impressive; grand and spectacular.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们来到～的金门桥时，顿时感到心胸开朗。
exampleTraditional: 我們來到～的金門橋時，頓時感到心胸開朗。
exampleEn: When we arrived at the magnificent Golden Gate Bridge, we felt our hearts open wide.

explanation: 以此事为光荣。
explanationTraditional: 以此事為光榮。
explanationEn: To take pride in something; to regard something as an honor.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》七四他们一向规规矩矩，也把儿女们调教的规规矩矩，这是他们引以为荣的事。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》七四他們一向規規矩矩，也把兒女們調教的規規矩矩，這是他們引以為榮的事。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof': 'They had always been proper and raised their children to be proper, which they took pride in.'
example: 中国是一个伟大的国家，有永远值得～的历史和文化，但是现在确实需要发展。★《心愿》
exampleTraditional: 中國是一個偉大的國家，有永遠值得～的歷史和文化，但是現在確實需要發展。★《心願》
exampleEn: China is a great country with a history and culture that we can always take pride in, but it does need development now. — 'Heart's Desire'

explanation: 争嬜，争夺；风风韵，多指女子。指因男女关系而妒忌、争吵。
explanationTraditional: 爭嬜，爭奪；風風韻，多指女子。指因男女關係而妒忌、爭吵。
explanationEn: To be jealous and quarrel over romantic rivalry.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷一那时我争风吃醋便迟了。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷一那時我爭風吃醋便遲了。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World': 'Then it would be too late for me to be jealous.'
example: 凌家这两个婆娘，彼此疑惑，你疑惑我多得了主子的钱，我疑惑你多得了主子的钱，～争吵起来。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十五回
exampleTraditional: 凌家這兩個婆娘，彼此疑惑，你疑惑我多得了主子的錢，我疑惑你多得了主子的錢，～爭吵起來。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十五回
exampleEn: The two women in the Ling family suspected each other, each thinking the other got more money from the master, and they quarreled out of jealousy. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 45

explanation: 水滴下去就结成冰。形容天气十分寒冷。
explanationTraditional: 水滴下去就結成冰。形容天氣十分寒冷。
explanationEn: So cold that water freezes instantly; extremely cold weather.
derivation: 宋·钱易《南部新书》严冬冱寒，滴水成冰。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·錢易《南部新書》嚴冬冱寒，滴水成冰。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Qian Yi's 'New Stories from the South': 'In severe winter, water freezes as it drips.'
example: 有一节苦处，任你～的天气，少不得向水孔中洗浣污秽衣服，还要憎嫌洗得不洁净，加一场咒骂。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷二十七
exampleTraditional: 有一節苦處，任你～的天氣，少不得向水孔中洗浣汙穢衣服，還要憎嫌洗得不潔淨，加一場咒罵。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷二十七
exampleEn: One hardship: no matter how freezing the weather, she had to wash dirty clothes in the water hole, and was scolded for not washing cleanly. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Chapter 27

explanation: 询问打听人的姓名。
explanationTraditional: 詢問打聽人的姓名。
explanationEn: To ask someone's full name; what is your surname and given name?
derivation: 元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》第一折［孛老云］兀那婆婆，你是那里人氏？姓甚名谁？因甚着这个人将你勒死？ ”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》第一折［孛老雲］兀那婆婆，你是那裡人氏？姓甚名誰？因甚著這個人將你勒死？ ”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing's 'The Injustice to Dou E': 'Old man: You there, old woman, where are you from? What is your name? Why did this person try to strangle you?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 寿命很长，能活到一百岁。常用作祝福长寿之词。
explanationTraditional: 壽命很長，能活到一百歲。常用作祝福長壽之詞。
explanationEn: Long life; may you live to be a hundred (a blessing).
derivation: 元·无名氏《蓝采和》第四折这厮淡则淡到长命百岁。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《藍采和》第四折這廝淡則淡到長命百歲。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Lan Caihe': 'This fellow may live to be a hundred.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 凭个人的爱憎或一时的感情冲动处理事情。
explanationTraditional: 憑個人的愛憎或一時的感情衝動處理事情。
explanationEn: To act impulsively based on personal feelings or emotions.
derivation: 梁信《从奴隶到将军》下集第一章感情用事罗霄长叹一声‘小马！不是～的时候。’”
derivationTraditional: 梁信《從奴隸到將軍》下集第一章感情用事羅霄長嘆一聲‘小馬！不是～的時候。’”
derivationEn: From Liang Xin's 'From Slave to General': 'Luo Xiao sighed: 'Xiao Ma, this is not the time to act on emotion.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 处处平安无事。指大治之世。
explanationTraditional: 處處平安無事。指大治之世。
explanationEn: Peace and tranquility everywhere; refers to a time of great order and harmony.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·大乐》天下太平，万物安宁。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·大樂》天下太平，萬物安寧。”
derivationEn: From 'Lüshi Chunqiu · Great Music': 'When the world is at peace, all things are tranquil.'
example: 人人好公，则～；人人营私，则天下大乱。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第九回
exampleTraditional: 人人好公，則～；人人營私，則天下大亂。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第九回
exampleEn: If everyone is just, the world will be at peace; if everyone is selfish, the world will be in chaos. — Qing Dynasty, Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 9

explanation: 恩恩惠；负违背；义情谊，恩谊。忘记别人对自己的好处，反而做出对不起别人的事。
explanationTraditional: 恩恩惠；負違背；義情誼，恩誼。忘記別人對自己的好處，反而做出對不起別人的事。
explanationEn: To forget the kindness one has received and act against the benefactor; ungrateful and treacherous.
derivation: 《魏书·萧宝夤传》背恩忘义，枭獍其心。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·蕭寶夤傳》背恩忘義，梟獍其心。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei · Biography of Xiao Baoyin': 'Ungrateful and forgetful of kindness, with a heart like that of an owl.'
example: 此人好夸大，且～，你要仔细识他才好。★清·黄小配《大马扁》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 此人好誇大，且～，你要仔細識他才好。★清·黃小配《大馬扁》第十六回
exampleEn: This person is boastful and ungrateful; you must be careful in dealing with him. — Qing Dynasty, Huang Xiaopei, 'The Great Swindler', Chapter 16

explanation: 美谈人们津津乐道的好事。指传扬开去，成为人们赞美、称颂的事情。
explanationTraditional: 美談人們津津樂道的好事。指傳揚開去，成為人們讚美、稱頌的事情。
explanationEn: To be spread as a praiseworthy story; something that becomes a subject of admiration and praise.
derivation: 《公羊传·闵公二年》鲁人至今以为美谈。”
derivationTraditional: 《公羊傳·閔公二年》魯人至今以為美談。”
derivationEn: From 'Gongyang Zhuan · Duke Min Year 2': 'The people of Lu still regard it as a fine tale.'
example: 元旦昧爽，复衣冠送出，萧山至今～。★明·张岱《募造无主祠堂疏》
exampleTraditional: 元旦昧爽，復衣冠送出，蕭山至今～。★明·張岱《募造無主祠堂疏》
exampleEn: At dawn on New Year's Day, he dressed and saw off the guest, and this has been passed down as a fine tale in Xiaoshan. — Ming Dynasty, Zhang Dai, 'A Proposal to Build a Shrine for the Unburied'

explanation: 容光脸上的光彩；焕发光彩四射的样子。形容身体好，精神饱满。
explanationTraditional: 容光臉上的光彩；煥發光彩四射的樣子。形容身體好，精神飽滿。
explanationEn: Radiant with health and energy; one's face glowing with vitality.
derivation: 方纪《歌声和笛音》我望着他那年青的，容光焕发，毫无倦色的脸，不知怎么，竟想伸手去抚摸他的孩子般的蓬松的头发。”
derivationTraditional: 方紀《歌聲和笛音》我望著他那年青的，容光煥發，毫無倦色的臉，不知怎麼，竟想伸手去撫摸他的孩子般的蓬鬆的頭髮。”
derivationEn: From Fang Ji, 'Song and Flute': 'Looking at his young, radiant, and tireless face, I somehow wanted to reach out and touch his childlike fluffy hair.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 按照规定办理事情。
explanationTraditional: 按照規定辦理事情。
explanationEn: To handle matters according to regulations; to act in accordance with rules.
derivation: 陈世旭《将军镇》第十章三那就更得让她学会照章办事。国有国法，院有院规，不然，还得了？”
derivationTraditional: 陳世旭《將軍鎮》第十章三那就更得讓她學會照章辦事。國有國法，院有院規，不然，還得了？”
derivationEn: From Chen Shixu, 'General Town' Chapter 10, Section 3: 'Then she must learn to act according to regulations. The state has its laws, the hospital its rules; otherwise, what would happen?'
example: 法律虽然铁面无私，～，至少没那么不知趣，会去干涉一位大爷的私事。★《警察和赞美诗》
exampleTraditional: 法律雖然鐵面無私，～，至少沒那麼不知趣，會去幹涉一位大爺的私事。★《警察和讚美詩》
exampleEn: Although the law is impartial and acts according to regulations, at least it is not so tactless as to interfere in a gentleman's private affairs. — 'The Cop and the Anthem'

explanation: 穷竭尽；黩随便，任意。随意使用武力，不断发动侵略战争。形容极其好战。
explanationTraditional: 窮竭盡；黷隨便，任意。隨意使用武力，不斷髮動侵略戰爭。形容極其好戰。
explanationEn: To exhaust military strength and engage in frequent wars; extremely bellicose.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·陆抗传》而听诸将徇名，穷兵黩武，动费万计，士卒雕瘁，寇不为衰，见我已大病矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·陸抗傳》而聽諸將徇名，窮兵黷武，動費萬計，士卒雕瘁，寇不為衰，見我已大病矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms · Book of Wu · Biography of Lu Kang': 'But you listen to generals seeking fame, exhausting troops and waging war recklessly, wasting tens of thousands, wearing down soldiers, while the enemy does not weaken and sees our great illness.'
example: 王氏今降心纳贡，愿修旧好，明公乃欲～，残灭同盟，天下其谓公何？★宋·孙光宪《北梦琐言》卷十七
exampleTraditional: 王氏今降心納貢，願修舊好，明公乃欲～，殘滅同盟，天下其謂公何？★宋·孫光憲《北夢瑣言》卷十七
exampleEn: Now the Wang family has submitted and offered tribute, willing to restore old ties. If you insist on exhausting troops and waging war, destroying allies, what will the world say of you? — Song Dynasty, Sun Guangxian, 'Beimeng Suoyan', Volume 17

explanation: 霆急雷；钧古代重量单位，三十斤为一钧。形容威力极大，无法阻挡。
explanationTraditional: 霆急雷；鈞古代重量單位，三十斤為一鈞。形容威力極大，無法阻擋。
explanationEn: As powerful as a thunderbolt or a weight of 30,000 jin; overwhelming force.
derivation: 汉·贾山《至言》雷霆之所击，无不摧折者；万钧之所压，无不糜灭者。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·賈山《至言》雷霆之所擊，無不摧折者；萬鈞之所壓，無不糜滅者。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Jia Shan, 'Zhi Yan': 'What thunder strikes is inevitably shattered; what a weight of 30,000 jin presses is inevitably crushed.'
example: 唯独共产主义的思想体系和社会制度正以排山倒海之势，～之力，磅礴于全世界，……★毛泽东《新民主主义论》
exampleTraditional: 唯獨共產主義的思想體系和社會制度正以排山倒海之勢，～之力，磅礴於全世界，……★毛澤東《新民主主義論》
exampleEn: Only the communist ideology and social system are sweeping across the world with the force of an avalanche and the power of thunder and lightning. — Mao Zedong, 'On New Democracy'

explanation: 指不谋私利，为国家和人民效力。
explanationTraditional: 指不謀私利，為國家和人民效力。
explanationEn: To act for the country and the people; not seeking personal gain but serving the nation and its citizens.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旅途平安（多用于祝人）。
explanationTraditional: 旅途平安（多用於祝人）。
explanationEn: A smooth journey; used to wish someone a safe trip.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十九回忽然，一路顺风里说到想要告休归里。”清·俞万春《荡寇志》第一二二回且喜连冬过春，徐槐一边久无消息，更喜云陈两处亦无动静，一路顺风无些毫打叉之事，以是吴用渐渐向愈。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十九回忽然，一路順風裡說到想要告休歸裡。”清·俞萬春《蕩寇志》第一二二回且喜連冬過春，徐槐一邊久無消息，更喜雲陳兩處亦無動靜，一路順風無些毫打叉之事，以是吳用漸漸向愈。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 19: 'Suddenly, in the midst of a smooth journey, he mentioned wanting to retire and return home.' Also from Qing Dynasty, Yu Wanchun, 'The Scattered Heroes', Chapter 122: 'Fortunately, through winter and spring, there was no news from Xu Huai, and no movement from Yun and Chen; the journey was smooth without any hitches, so Wu Yong gradually recovered.'
example: 我们这次出门旅行真是～，沿途一点儿也没有耽误。
exampleTraditional: 我們這次出門旅行真是～，沿途一點兒也沒有耽誤。
exampleEn: Our trip was smooth sailing all the way, with no delays at all.

explanation: 推抵拒，推托；就靠拢，迎上去。一面推辞，一面靠拢上去。形容装腔作势假意推辞的样子。
explanationTraditional: 推抵拒，推託；就靠攏，迎上去。一面推辭，一面靠攏上去。形容裝腔作勢假意推辭的樣子。
explanationEn: To half refuse and half accept; to pretend to decline while actually being willing.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第四本第一折半推半就，又惊又爱，檀口揾香腮。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第四本第一折半推半就，又驚又愛，檀口搵香腮。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu, 'The Story of the Western Wing', Act 4, Scene 1: 'Half refusing, half accepting, both startled and delighted, with fragrant lips pressing against fragrant cheeks.'
example: 与其学那俗态，～，耽搁工夫；据俺主意，不如从实收了，倒也爽快。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三回
exampleTraditional: 與其學那俗態，～，耽擱工夫；據俺主意，不如從實收了，倒也爽快。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三回
exampleEn: Rather than imitating that vulgar manner of half refusing and half accepting, wasting time, I think it's better to accept honestly and be done with it. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 3

explanation: 指自己做了坏事，自己受到损害或惩罚。
explanationTraditional: 指自己做了壞事，自己受到損害或懲罰。
explanationEn: To reap what one has sown; to suffer the consequences of one's own actions.
derivation: 茅盾《〈呼兰河传〉序》除了因为愚昧保守而自食其果，这些人物的的生活原也悠然自得其乐。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《〈呼蘭河傳〉序》除了因為愚昧保守而自食其果，這些人物的的生活原也悠然自得其樂。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's preface to 'The Legend of Hulan River': 'Apart from reaping what they sowed due to ignorance and conservatism, these characters also lived leisurely and contentedly.'
example: 玩火者只会自食其果。
exampleTraditional: 玩火者只會自食其果。
exampleEn: Those who play with fire will only reap what they sow.

explanation: 蛊惑迷惑。指用欺骗引诱等手段迷惑人，搞乱人的思想。
explanationTraditional: 蠱惑迷惑。指用欺騙引誘等手段迷惑人，搞亂人的思想。
explanationEn: To confuse and mislead people; to stir up trouble by spreading fallacies.
derivation: 《元史·刑法志》诸阴阳家者流，辄为人燃灯祭星，蛊惑人心者，禁之。”
derivationTraditional: 《元史·刑法志》諸陰陽家者流，輒為人燃燈祭星，蠱惑人心者，禁之。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Yuan: Criminal Law': 'Those who practice divination and light lamps to worship stars, confusing people's minds, are prohibited.'
example: 却胆敢把这个反天逆地、阻碍进化、～的邪说谬论说将出来。★清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第三回
exampleTraditional: 卻膽敢把這個反天逆地、阻礙進化、～的邪說謬論說將出來。★清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第三回
exampleEn: But they dared to speak this heretical theory that defies heaven and earth, hinders evolution, and confuses people's minds. — Qing Dynasty, Lingnan Yiyi Nushi, 'The Heroine of Eastern Europe', Chapter 3

explanation: 茅塞喻人思路闭塞或不懂事；顿立刻。原来心里好象有茅草堵塞着，现在忽然被打开了。形容思想忽然开窍，立刻明白了某个道理。
explanationTraditional: 茅塞喻人思路閉塞或不懂事；頓立刻。原來心裡好象有茅草堵塞著，現在忽然被打開了。形容思想忽然開竅，立刻明白了某個道理。
explanationEn: Suddenly see the light; to have one's mind suddenly enlightened.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心下》山径之蹊间，介然用之而成路；为间不用，则茅塞之矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心下》山徑之蹊間，介然用之而成路；為間不用，則茅塞之矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jinxin II': 'A mountain path becomes a road if used frequently; if unused for a while, it becomes blocked by weeds.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 念思念；兹此，这个。泛指念念不忘某一件事情。
explanationTraditional: 念思念；茲此，這個。泛指念念不忘某一件事情。
explanationEn: To bear something constantly in mind; to be always mindful of something.
derivation: 《尚书·大禹漠》帝念哉！念兹在兹，释兹在兹。名言兹在兹，允出兹在兹，惟帝念功。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·大禹漠》帝念哉！念茲在茲，釋茲在茲。名言茲在茲，允出茲在茲，惟帝念功。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Counsels of the Great Yu': 'The emperor thought of it! He thought of this and this, and let go of this and this. His words were about this, and his actions were about this, only the emperor remembered the merit.'
example: 他们和Ｆ总长，都～”，在尘埃中间和破纸旁边离不开。★鲁迅《而已集·谈所谓大内档案”》
exampleTraditional: 他們和Ｆ總長，都～”，在塵埃中間和破紙旁邊離不開。★魯迅《而已集·談所謂大內檔案”》
exampleEn: They, along with Minister F, were always mindful of it, inseparable from the dust and broken papers. — Lu Xun, 'And That's That: On the So-Called 'Grand Inner Archive''

explanation: 头脑发胀，脚下无力。形容身体不适。也比喻基础不牢固。
explanationTraditional: 頭腦發脹，腳下無力。形容身體不適。也比喻基礎不牢固。
explanationEn: Top-heavy; feeling dizzy and weak; also metaphorically refers to an unstable foundation.
derivation: 明·天然痴叟《石点头·侯官县烈女歼仇》他的酒量原不济，三瓯落肚，渐觉头重脚轻。”
derivationTraditional: 明·天然痴叟《石點頭·侯官縣烈女殲仇》他的酒量原不濟，三甌落肚，漸覺頭重腳輕。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Tianran Chisou, 'Stone Nods: The Filial Woman of Houguan County': 'His tolerance for alcohol was originally poor; after three cups, he gradually felt top-heavy.'
example: 墙上芦苇，～要底浅；山间竹笋，嘴尖皮厚腹中空。★毛泽东《改造我们的学习》
exampleTraditional: 牆上蘆葦，～要底淺；山間竹筍，嘴尖皮厚腹中空。★毛澤東《改造我們的學習》
exampleEn: The reed on the wall is top-heavy with shallow roots; the bamboo shoot in the mountain has a sharp mouth and thick skin but a hollow belly. — Mao Zedong, 'Reform Our Study'

explanation: 趾高走路时脚抬得很高；气扬意气扬扬。走路时脚抬得很高，神气十足。形容骄傲自满，得意忘形的样子。
explanationTraditional: 趾高走路時腳抬得很高；氣揚意氣揚揚。走路時腳抬得很高，神氣十足。形容驕傲自滿，得意忘形的樣子。
explanationEn: To strut about with one's nose in the air; to be arrogant and self-satisfied.
derivation: 《左传·桓公十三年》举趾高，心不固矣。”《史记·管晏列传》意气扬扬，甚自得也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·桓公十三年》舉趾高，心不固矣。”《史記·管晏列傳》意氣揚揚，甚自得也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Huan's Thirteenth Year': 'He lifts his feet high, his heart is not steady.' And 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Guan and Yan': 'He was full of pride and self-satisfaction.'
example: 但是那种～的神情总嫌有些不够大方罢。★闻一多《复古的空气》
exampleTraditional: 但是那種～的神情總嫌有些不夠大方罷。★聞一多《復古的空氣》
exampleEn: But that kind of arrogant demeanor always seems a bit lacking in grace. — Wen Yiduo, 'The Air of Restoration'

explanation: 复又，再。刚得到又失去了。
explanationTraditional: 復又，再。剛得到又失去了。
explanationEn: To gain something only to lose it again.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十六回孔明变色曰‘是何言也！得而复失，与不得同。公以此贺我，实足使我愧赧耳！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十六回孔明變色曰‘是何言也！得而復失，與不得同。公以此賀我，實足使我愧赧耳！’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 96: 'Zhuge Liang changed color and said, 'What words are these! To gain and then lose is the same as not gaining. You congratulate me with this, truly making me ashamed!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 随顺从；遇遭遇。指能顺应环境，在任何境遇中都能满足。
explanationTraditional: 隨順從；遇遭遇。指能順應環境，在任何境遇中都能滿足。
explanationEn: To adapt to circumstances; to be content with one's situation.
derivation: 清·刘献廷《广阳杂记》一随寓而安，斯真隐矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉獻廷《廣陽雜記》一隨寓而安，斯真隱矣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Liu Xianting, 'Miscellaneous Notes from Guangyang': 'To be content wherever one is, that is truly a recluse.'
example: 不过能够～——即有船坐船云云——则比起幻想太多的人们来，可以稍为安稳，能够敷衍下去而已。★鲁迅《两地书》六
exampleTraditional: 不過能夠～——即有船坐船云云——則比起幻想太多的人們來，可以稍為安穩，能夠敷衍下去而已。★魯迅《兩地書》六
exampleEn: But being able to adapt to circumstances—that is, taking a boat when available—compared to those with too many fantasies, can be a bit more stable and just enough to get by. — Lu Xun, 'Letters from Two Places', No. 6

explanation: 把已经搁置的事情重新提出。
explanationTraditional: 把已經擱置的事情重新提出。
explanationEn: To bring up old matters again; to reopen old issues.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 过去的恩恩怨怨早已时过境迁，又何必～呢？
exampleTraditional: 過去的恩恩怨怨早已時過境遷，又何必～呢？
exampleEn: The past grievances have long since passed; why bring up old matters again?

explanation: 形身体；只单独。只有自己的身体和自己的影子。形容孤独，没有同伴。
explanationTraditional: 形身體；只單獨。只有自己的身體和自己的影子。形容孤獨，沒有同伴。
explanationEn: To be alone and solitary; to have only one's shadow for company.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《祭十二郎文》承先人后者，在孙惟汝，在子惟吾，两世一身，形单影只。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《祭十二郎文》承先人後者，在孫惟汝，在子惟吾，兩世一身，形單影隻。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Sacrificial Essay to My Nephew Shi'er': 'Among the descendants of our ancestors, there is only you and me, two generations, each alone, solitary in form and shadow.'
example: 因得常哭于芸娘之墓，影单形只，备极凄凉。★清·沈复《浮生六记·坎坷记愁》
exampleTraditional: 因得常哭於芸娘之墓，影單形只，備極淒涼。★清·沈復《浮生六記·坎坷記愁》
exampleEn: Thus he often wept at Yuniang's grave, solitary in form and shadow, extremely desolate. — Qing Dynasty, Shen Fu, 'Six Records of a Floating Life: Record of Hardships'

explanation: 比喻坏人、坏事虽已清除，但不良的影响还在起作用。
explanationTraditional: 比喻壞人、壞事雖已清除，但不良的影響還在起作用。
explanationEn: Describes evil people or things that, though eliminated, still have lingering negative influence.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 纲鱼网上的总绳；举提起。把大绳子一提起来，一个个网眼就都张开。比喻抓住事物的关键，带动其他环节。也比喻文章条理分明。
explanationTraditional: 綱魚網上的總繩；舉提起。把大繩子一提起來，一個個網眼就都張開。比喻抓住事物的關鍵，帶動其他環節。也比喻文章條理分明。
explanationEn: When the main rope of a net is lifted, all the meshes open. Metaphorically, grasping the key link brings everything else into place. Also used to describe clear organization in writing.
derivation: 汉·班固《白虎通·三纲六纪》若罗网之有纪纲而万目张也。”汉·郑玄《诗谱序》举一纲而万目张，解一卷而众篇明。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·班固《白虎通·三綱六紀》若羅網之有紀綱而萬目張也。”漢·鄭玄《詩譜序》舉一綱而萬目張，解一卷而眾篇明。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Ban Gu's 'Bai Hu Tong': 'Just as a net has a main rope and all meshes open.' Han Dynasty, Zheng Xuan's 'Preface to the Book of Songs': 'Lift one main rope and all meshes open; unravel one scroll and all chapters become clear.'
example: 有句古语，～”。拿起纲，目才能张，纲就是主题。★毛泽东《善于农业互助合作的两次谈话》
exampleTraditional: 有句古語，～”。拿起綱，目才能張，綱就是主題。★毛澤東《善於農業互助合作的兩次談話》
exampleEn: As the old saying goes, 'When the main rope is lifted, the meshes open.' The main rope is the theme. — Mao Zedong, 'Talks on Agricultural Cooperation'

explanation: 形容气氛不活泼。也形容人精神消沉，不振作。
explanationTraditional: 形容氣氛不活潑。也形容人精神消沉，不振作。
explanationEn: Describes a lifeless atmosphere or a person who is dispirited and unenergetic.
derivation: 冯德英《迎春花》第八章我要是能把他拖出那死气沉沉的顽固家庭，送去参了军，他不就变好啦！”
derivationTraditional: 馮德英《迎春花》第八章我要是能把他拖出那死氣沉沉的頑固家庭，送去參了軍，他不就變好啦！”
derivationEn: Feng Deying's 'Spring Flowers': 'If I could drag him out of that lifeless, stubborn family and send him to the army, wouldn't he become better!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 投机意见相合。形容话说不到一起。
explanationTraditional: 投機意見相合。形容話說不到一起。
explanationEn: Describes when people cannot find common ground in conversation; talk at cross purposes.
derivation: 元·王子一《误入桃源》第三折吃紧的理不服人，言不谙典，话不投机。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王子一《誤入桃源》第三折吃緊的理不服人，言不諳典，話不投機。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wang Ziyi's 'Mistaken Entry into Peach Blossom Spring', Act 3: 'The truth does not convince, words are not apt, and conversation does not agree.'
example: 宝玉听来，～，便靠在桌上睡去。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一一三回
exampleTraditional: 寶玉聽來，～，便靠在桌上睡去。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一一三回
exampleEn: Baoyu heard this, and since their conversation did not agree, he leaned on the table and fell asleep. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 113

explanation: 滂沱大雨的样子。形容雨下得很大。
explanationTraditional: 滂沱大雨的樣子。形容雨下得很大。
explanationEn: Describes heavy rain; torrential downpour.
derivation: 《诗·小雅·渐渐之石》月离于毕，俾滂沱矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·小雅·漸漸之石》月離於畢，俾滂沱矣。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Jianjian zhi Shi': 'When the moon leaves the Pleiades, it brings a downpour.'
example: 只见～，一似瓢泼盆倾，下有半个时辰。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第十回
exampleTraditional: 只見～，一似瓢潑盆傾，下有半個時辰。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第十回
exampleEn: Then came a torrential rain, like a basin being overturned, lasting for half an hour. — Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 10

explanation: 九鼎古代国家的宝器，相传为夏禹所铸。一句话抵得上九鼎重。比喻说话力量大，能起很大作用。
explanationTraditional: 九鼎古代國家的寶器，相傳為夏禹所鑄。一句話抵得上九鼎重。比喻說話力量大，能起很大作用。
explanationEn: A single word is as heavy as nine tripods (ancient national treasures). Describes words that carry great weight and influence.
derivation: 《史记·平原君列传》毛先生一至楚而使赵重于九鼎大吕。毛先生以三寸之舌，强于百万之师。胜不敢复相士。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原君列傳》毛先生一至楚而使趙重於九鼎大呂。毛先生以三寸之舌，強於百萬之師。勝不敢復相士。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian, Biography of Lord Pingyuan': 'When Mr. Mao arrived in Chu, he made Zhao more important than the nine tripods and the great bells. Mr. Mao's tongue is stronger than a million soldiers.'
example: 你若是专家或者要人，～，那自当别论。★朱自清《很好》
exampleTraditional: 你若是專家或者要人，～，那自當別論。★朱自清《很好》
exampleEn: If you are an expert or a VIP, your words carry great weight, and that is a different matter. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Very Good'

explanation: 烟波雾霭苍茫的水面；浩渺水面辽阔。形容烟雾笼罩的江湖水面广阔无边。
explanationTraditional: 煙波霧靄蒼茫的水面；浩渺水面遼闊。形容煙霧籠罩的江湖水面廣闊無邊。
explanationEn: Describes a vast, mist-covered expanse of water, like a lake or river, stretching endlessly.
derivation: 唐·崔致远《将归海东巉山春望》目极烟波浩渺间，晓乌飞处认乡关。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·崔致遠《將歸海東巉山春望》目極煙波浩渺間，曉烏飛處認鄉關。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Cui Zhiyuan's 'Spring View from the Mountain Looking East to the Sea': 'As far as the eye can see, the misty waves stretch vast; recognizing my hometown where dawn birds fly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 作战中弹药用完了，粮食也断绝了。指无法继续作战的危险处境。
explanationTraditional: 作戰中彈藥用完了，糧食也斷絕了。指無法繼續作戰的危險處境。
explanationEn: In battle, ammunition is exhausted and food supplies are cut off. Describes a dangerous situation where combat cannot continue.
derivation: 宋·杨万里《钤辖赵公墓志铭》公挺身与兵，屡捷。七年，粮尽援绝，势不能复支，遂率所部数千人南归。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·楊萬里《鈐轄趙公墓誌銘》公挺身與兵，屢捷。七年，糧盡援絕，勢不能復支，遂率所部數千人南歸。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Yang Wanli's 'Epitaph of Zhao Gong': 'The duke personally led troops and won many battles. In the seventh year, food ran out and reinforcements ceased, so he led his thousands southward.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 星斗变动位置。指季节或时间的变化。
explanationTraditional: 星斗變動位置。指季節或時間的變化。
explanationEn: The stars change position. Describes the passage of time or change of seasons.
derivation: 元·马致远《陈抟高卧》第三折直睡的陵迁谷变，石烂松枯，斗转星移。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《陳摶高臥》第三折直睡的陵遷谷變，石爛松枯，斗轉星移。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan's 'Chen Tuan Sleeping on the High Bed', Act 3: 'Sleeping until hills change and valleys shift, rocks rot and pines wither, the Dipper turns and stars move.'
example: 直吃的昏惨惨更阑夜深，直熬的明皎皎～。★明·无名氏《锁白猿》第一折
exampleTraditional: 直吃的昏慘慘更闌夜深，直熬的明皎皎～。★明·無名氏《鎖白猿》第一折
exampleEn: Drinking until the night is deep and dark, staying awake until the bright Dipper turns and stars move. — Ming Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Locking the White Ape', Act 1

explanation: 从戎从军，参军。扔掉笔去参军。指文人从军。
explanationTraditional: 從戎從軍，參軍。扔掉筆去參軍。指文人從軍。
explanationEn: Throw away the pen and join the army. Describes a scholar giving up literary pursuits to serve in the military.
derivation: 《后汉书·班超传》大丈夫无他志略，犹当效傅介子，张骞立功异域，以取封侯，安能久事笔砚间乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·班超傳》大丈夫無他志略，猶當效傅介子，張騫立功異域，以取封侯，安能久事筆硯間乎？”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han, Biography of Ban Chao': 'A great man should emulate Fu Jiezi and Zhang Qian, achieving merit in foreign lands to earn a marquisate. How can he spend his days with pen and ink?'
example: 他象同世交子弟闲话一样，问了问贺人龙的家庭情形，～”的经过。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十二章
exampleTraditional: 他象同世交子弟閒話一樣，問了問賀人龍的家庭情形，～”的經過。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十二章
exampleEn: He asked about He Renlong's family background and his experience of 'throwing away the pen to join the army' as if chatting with a family friend. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 22

explanation: 豪迈的情感，远大的志向。
explanationTraditional: 豪邁的情感，遠大的志向。
explanationEn: Lofty sentiments and high aspirations.
derivation: 茅盾《温故以知新》他们大多数两鬓添霜，然而豪情壮志，现见坚强。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《溫故以知新》他們大多數兩鬢添霜，然而豪情壯志，現見堅強。”
derivationEn: Mao Dun's 'Learning from the Past to Understand the New': 'Most of them have gray temples, yet their lofty sentiments and high aspirations are still strong.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容人动作琐细，言语罗唆。也形容人感情脆弱。
explanationTraditional: 形容人動作瑣細，言語羅唆。也形容人感情脆弱。
explanationEn: Describes a person who is fussy, long-winded, or overly sentimental.
derivation: 余秋雨《文化苦旅·上海人》上海下层社会中也有不少喜欢议论别人的婆婆妈妈。”
derivationTraditional: 餘秋雨《文化苦旅·上海人》上海下層社會中也有不少喜歡議論別人的婆婆媽媽。”
derivationEn: Yu Qiuyu's 'Cultural Journey: Shanghai People': 'In Shanghai's lower society, there are also many gossiping busybodies.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 惑，迷惑；解理解。感到非常迷惑，不能理解。
explanationTraditional: 惑，迷惑；解理解。感到非常迷惑，不能理解。
explanationEn: To be extremely puzzled and unable to understand.
derivation: 《庄子·天地》大惑者终身不解，大愚者终身不灵。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天地》大惑者終身不解，大愚者終身不靈。”
derivationEn: Zhuangzi: 'The greatly perplexed are never enlightened; the greatly foolish are never wise.'
example: 母疑涉妄，然窥女无他，～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·土偶》
exampleTraditional: 母疑涉妄，然窺女無他，～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·土偶》
exampleEn: The mother suspected it was false, but observing her daughter's normal behavior, she was greatly puzzled. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Clay Figure'

explanation: 展把卷画打开，比喻实现；宏图比喻宏伟远大的谋略与计划。大规模地实施宏伟远大的计划或抱负。
explanationTraditional: 展把卷畫打開，比喻實現；宏圖比喻宏偉遠大的謀略與計劃。大規模地實施宏偉遠大的計劃或抱負。
explanationEn: To carry out grand plans or ambitions on a large scale.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《为裴相公让官表》启中兴之宏图，当太平之昌历。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《為裴相公讓官表》啟中興之宏圖，當太平之昌歷。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Memorial for Prime Minister Pei': 'To initiate the grand plan of revival, to encounter the prosperous era of peace.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 尽用尽；能才能。各人尽自己的能力去做。
explanationTraditional: 盡用盡；能才能。各人儘自己的能力去做。
explanationEn: Each person does their best according to their ability.
derivation: 《后汉书·曹褒传》汉遭秦余，礼坏乐崩，且因循故事，未可观省，有知其说者，各尽所能。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·曹褒傳》漢遭秦餘，禮壞樂崩，且因循故事，未可觀省，有知其說者，各盡所能。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Cao Bao': 'The Han Dynasty inherited the remnants of Qin, with rites ruined and music collapsed, and followed old practices without examination. Those who knew the principles each did their best.'
example: 其次，是许多人梦想着将来的好社会，～”呀，大同世界”呀，很有些越轨”气息了。★鲁迅《南腔北调集·听说梦》
exampleTraditional: 其次，是許多人夢想著將來的好社會，～”呀，大同世界”呀，很有些越軌”氣息了。★魯迅《南腔北調集·聽說夢》
exampleEn: Secondly, many people dream of a future good society, 'each according to his ability,' 'great harmony,' with some rebellious overtones. — Lu Xun's 'Southern Tunes and Northern Tunes: Hearing Dreams'

explanation: 强弩所发的矢，飞行已达末程。比喻强大的力量已经衰弱，起不了什么作用。
explanationTraditional: 強弩所發的矢，飛行已達末程。比喻強大的力量已經衰弱，起不了什麼作用。
explanationEn: An arrow at the end of its flight from a strong crossbow; metaphor for a powerful force that has weakened and is ineffective.
derivation: 《史记·韩安国列传》强弩之极，矢不能穿鲁缟。”《汉书·韩安国传》且臣闻之，冲风之衰，不能起毛羽；强弩之末，力不能入鲁缟。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·韓安國列傳》強弩之極，矢不能穿魯縞。”《漢書·韓安國傳》且臣聞之，衝風之衰，不能起毛羽；強弩之末，力不能入魯縞。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Han Anguo': 'An arrow at the extreme of a strong crossbow cannot pierce thin silk.' 'Book of Han: Biography of Han Anguo': 'Moreover, I have heard that the decline of a strong wind cannot lift feathers; the end of a strong crossbow's arrow cannot penetrate thin silk.'
example: 至于军阀，那是～了。★欧阳山《三家巷》二四
exampleTraditional: 至於軍閥，那是～了。★歐陽山《三家巷》二四
exampleEn: As for the warlords, they are at the end of their strength. — Ouyang Shan's 'Three Families' Alley' Chapter 24

explanation: 指罪恶极大，不可饶恕。
explanationTraditional: 指罪惡極大，不可饒恕。
explanationEn: Refers to heinous crimes that are unforgivable.
derivation: 《隋书·刑法志》又列重罪十条……其犯此十者，不在八议论赎之限。”元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》第四折这药死公公的罪名，犯在十恶不赦。”
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·刑法志》又列重罪十條……其犯此十者，不在八議論贖之限。”元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》第四折這藥死公公的罪名，犯在十惡不赦。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Sui: Criminal Law': 'Also listed ten major crimes... those who commit these ten are not eligible for the eight deliberations or redemption.' Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing's 'The Injustice to Dou E' Act 4: 'The crime of poisoning her father-in-law is one of the ten unpardonable sins.'
example: 这个暴徒，拦路抢劫，谋财害命，真是～。
exampleTraditional: 這個暴徒，攔路搶劫，謀財害命，真是～。
exampleEn: This thug, who robbed and murdered, is truly unpardonable.

explanation: 洋洋得意的样子。形容称心如意、沾沾自喜的样子。
explanationTraditional: 洋洋得意的樣子。形容稱心如意、沾沾自喜的樣子。
explanationEn: A smug, self-satisfied look; describes being complacent and pleased with oneself.
derivation: 《史记·管晏列传》意气扬扬，甚自得也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·管晏列傳》意氣揚揚，甚自得也。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Guan Zhong and Yan Ying': 'With high spirits and great self-satisfaction.'
example: 单道台～的答道忙虽忙，然而并不觉得其苦。”★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十七回
exampleTraditional: 單道臺～的答道忙雖忙，然而並不覺得其苦。”★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十七回
exampleEn: Shan Daotai replied smugly, 'Busy as I am, I don't find it hard.' — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Fifth Chapter

explanation: 见人钱财，动起歹念。
explanationTraditional: 見人錢財，動起歹念。
explanationEn: To be tempted by money and conceive evil intentions.
derivation: 元·无名氏《硃砂担》第四折刚道个一声儿恶人回避，早激的他恶哏哏闹是非，那里也见财起意。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《硃砂擔》第四折剛道個一聲兒惡人迴避，早激的他惡哏哏鬧是非，那裡也見財起意。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous 'The Cinnabar Pouch' Act 4: 'Just as he said a word to avoid the villain, it provoked him to make a fierce scene; that's where he conceived evil intentions upon seeing wealth.'
example: 这厮原是远流配军，如何不做贼，以定是一时～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第三十回
exampleTraditional: 這廝原是遠流配軍，如何不做賊，以定是一時～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第三十回
exampleEn: This fellow was originally a banished soldier; how could he not become a thief? He must have been tempted by money. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 30

explanation: 好象懂，又好象不懂。
explanationTraditional: 好象懂，又好象不懂。
explanationEn: To seem to understand but not really understand.
derivation: 叶圣陶《得失》然而学生还是似懂非懂，教他们回讲往往讲不出来。”
derivationTraditional: 葉聖陶《得失》然而學生還是似懂非懂，教他們回講往往講不出來。”
derivationEn: Ye Shengtao's 'Gains and Losses': 'Yet the students seemed to understand but not, and when asked to retell, they often couldn't.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把内心的话说尽，毫不保留。
explanationTraditional: 把內心的話說盡，毫不保留。
explanationEn: To say everything without reservation; to speak one's mind fully.
derivation: 《北齐书·高德政传》德政与帝旧相昵爱，言无不尽。”
derivationTraditional: 《北齊書·高德政傳》德政與帝舊相暱愛，言無不盡。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Northern Qi: Biography of Gao Dezheng': 'Dezheng and the emperor were old friends and close, speaking without reservation.'
example: 故情无不通，～。★宋·司马光《乞改求谏诏书札子》
exampleTraditional: 故情無不通，～。★宋·司馬光《乞改求諫詔書札子》
exampleEn: Therefore, feelings are always understood, and words are spoken without reserve. ★ Song Dynasty, Sima Guang, 'Memorial Requesting Revision of the Edict Seeking Admonitions'

explanation: 表表面；里本质。从表面现象看到本质。
explanationTraditional: 表表面；裡本質。從表面現象看到本質。
explanationEn: From the surface to the essence; to see through appearances to the core.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 看问题要由表及里。
exampleTraditional: 看問題要由表及裡。
exampleEn: When looking at problems, one must go from the surface to the essence.

explanation: 捶敲打；顿跺。敲胸口，跺双脚。形容非常懊丧，或非常悲痛。
explanationTraditional: 捶敲打；頓跺。敲胸口，跺雙腳。形容非常懊喪，或非常悲痛。
explanationEn: To beat one's chest and stamp one's feet; describing extreme regret or grief.
derivation: 元·萧德祥《杀狗劝夫》第二折我衷肠，除告天，奈天高，又不知，只落的捶胸顿足空流泪。”
derivationTraditional: 元·蕭德祥《殺狗勸夫》第二折我衷腸，除告天，奈天高，又不知，只落的捶胸頓足空流淚。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Xiao Dexiang, 'Killing the Dog to Persuade the Husband', Act 2: 'I pour out my heart, but can only appeal to heaven, yet heaven is high and unknown, leaving me to beat my chest and stamp my feet in vain tears.'
example: 孔明说罢，触动玄德衷肠，真个～，放声大哭。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 孔明說罷，觸動玄德衷腸，真個～，放聲大哭。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十六回
exampleEn: After Kongming finished speaking, it touched Xuande's heart, and he truly beat his chest and stamped his feet, crying loudly. ★ Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 56

explanation: 声声张。指造成要攻打东边的声势，实际上却攻打西边。是使对方产生错觉以出奇制胜的一种战术。
explanationTraditional: 聲聲張。指造成要攻打東邊的聲勢，實際上卻攻打西邊。是使對方產生錯覺以出奇制勝的一種戰術。
explanationEn: To make a feint to the east while attacking the west; a tactic to mislead the enemy.
derivation: 《淮南子·兵略训》故用兵之道，示之以柔而迎之以刚，示之以弱而乘之以强，为之以歙而应之以张，将欲西而示之以东，……”唐·杜佑《通典·兵六》说声言击东，其实击西。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·兵略訓》故用兵之道，示之以柔而迎之以剛，示之以弱而乘之以強，為之以歙而應之以張，將欲西而示之以東，……”唐·杜佑《通典·兵六》說聲言擊東，其實擊西。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi: Military Strategy': 'Thus the art of war is to show weakness while meeting with strength, to show timidity while taking advantage of strength, to contract while expanding, to intend to go west while showing east...' Tang Dynasty, Du You, 'Tongdian: Military Six': 'Say you will attack east, but actually attack west.'
example: 蜀人或～，指南攻北，吾兵必须分头守把。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百十一回
exampleTraditional: 蜀人或～，指南攻北，吾兵必須分頭守把。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百十一回
exampleEn: The Shu forces may feint east while attacking west, or point south while striking north; our troops must defend separately. ★ Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 111

explanation: 色彩光亮耀眼。多比喻前程的远大或事业的伟大。
explanationTraditional: 色彩光亮耀眼。多比喻前程的遠大或事業的偉大。
explanationEn: Bright and dazzling; often describes a promising future or great achievements.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十一灼然一切处，光明灿烂去。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十一灼然一切處，光明燦爛去。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji, 'Five Lamps Meeting at the Source', Volume 11: 'Truly, everywhere is bright and radiant.'
example: 其中有着时代的眉目，也决不是英雄们的八宝箱，一朝打开，便见～。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文·序言》
exampleTraditional: 其中有著時代的眉目，也決不是英雄們的八寶箱，一朝打開，便見～。★魯迅《且介亭雜文·序言》
exampleEn: Among them are the features of the times, and they are certainly not the treasure chests of heroes; once opened, they will be brilliant and splendid. ★ Lu Xun, 'Preface to 'Essays from the Qie Jie Ting'

explanation: 克战胜；制胜取得胜利。制服敌人，取得胜利。
explanationTraditional: 克戰勝；制勝取得勝利。制服敵人，取得勝利。
explanationEn: To defeat the enemy and achieve victory.
derivation: 《孙子·虚实》人皆知我所以胜之形，而莫知吾所以制胜之形。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·虛實》人皆知我所以勝之形，而莫知吾所以制勝之形。”
derivationEn: From 'Sunzi: Weaknesses and Strengths': 'All men know the form by which I achieve victory, but none know the form by which I ensure victory.'
example: 只今番～，便见得先生妙法。（明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第二十回）
exampleTraditional: 只今番～，便見得先生妙法。（明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第二十回）
exampleEn: Only this time, defeating the enemy and achieving victory will demonstrate your wonderful method. ★ Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 20

explanation: 捧腹捂着肚子。让人捂着肚子。形容笑得很厉害。
explanationTraditional: 捧腹捂著肚子。讓人捂著肚子。形容笑得很厲害。
explanationEn: To make someone hold their belly with laughter; extremely funny.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第七十九回要丑的掉舌鼓唇，令人捧腹。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第七十九回要醜的掉舌鼓唇，令人捧腹。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan, 'Lamp at the Crossroads', Chapter 79: 'The clownish antics and witty remarks make people hold their bellies with laughter.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 闭关封闭关口；锁封锁。闭关自守，不与外国往来。
explanationTraditional: 閉關封閉關口；鎖封鎖。閉關自守，不與外國往來。
explanationEn: To close the country to international intercourse; isolationist policy.
derivation: 《周易·复》先王以至日闭关，商旅不行，后不省方。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·復》先王以至日閉關，商旅不行，後不省方。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Changes: Fu': 'The ancient kings closed the passes on the winter solstice, so merchants and travelers did not move, and the king did not inspect the provinces.'
example: 严复的译事三难信达雅”为打破～，西学东渐开了先河。★柯灵《序》
exampleTraditional: 嚴復的譯事三難信達雅”為打破～，西學東漸開了先河。★柯靈《序》
