exampleEn: Yan Fu's three difficulties in translation—faithfulness, expressiveness, and elegance—paved the way for breaking the policy of closing the country and introducing Western learning to the East. ★ Ke Ling, 'Preface'

explanation: 歌、颂颂扬。颂扬功绩和德行。
explanationTraditional: 歌、頌頌揚。頌揚功績和德行。
explanationEn: To sing the praises of someone's achievements and virtues; to eulogize.
derivation: 《史记·周本纪》民皆歌乐之，颂其德。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·周本紀》民皆歌樂之，頌其德。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Zhou Annals': 'The people all sang and rejoiced, praising his virtue.'
example: 保持艰苦奋斗作风，制止～现象。★毛泽东《党委会的工作方法》
exampleTraditional: 保持艱苦奮鬥作風，制止～現象。★毛澤東《黨委會的工作方法》
exampleEn: Maintain the style of hard work and plain living, and stop the practice of singing praises and eulogizing virtues. ★ Mao Zedong, 'Methods of Work of Party Committees'

explanation: 魄迷信者指依附人形体而存在的精神。形容使人感动或令人震惊。
explanationTraditional: 魄迷信者指依附人形體而存在的精神。形容使人感動或令人震驚。
explanationEn: To stir one's soul; deeply moving or shocking.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第二十四回那秦淮到了有月色的时候，越是夜色已深，更有那细吹细唱的船来，凄清委婉，动人心魄。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第二十四回那秦淮到了有月色的時候，越是夜色已深，更有那細吹細唱的船來，悽清委婉，動人心魄。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 24: 'When the Qinhuai River is under moonlight, the deeper the night, the more there are boats with soft music, plaintive and touching, stirring the soul.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 关心得无微不至。
explanationTraditional: 關心得無微不至。
explanationEn: To show the utmost care and concern for someone, attending to every detail.
derivation: 刘白羽《海天集·伟大创业者》总理对人总是关怀备至，体贴入微。”
derivationTraditional: 劉白羽《海天集·偉大創業者》總理對人總是關懷備至，體貼入微。”
derivationEn: From Liu Baiyu's 'Sea and Sky Collection: Great Founder': 'The Premier always showed the utmost care and concern for people, attending to their every need.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指避开敌人的主力，找敌人的弱点进攻。又指谈问题回避要害。
explanationTraditional: 指避開敵人的主力，找敵人的弱點進攻。又指談問題迴避要害。
explanationEn: To avoid the enemy's main strength and strike at their weak points; also used figuratively to mean avoiding the crux of an issue.
derivation: 《孙子·虚实》兵之形，避实而击虚。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·虛實》兵之形，避實而擊虛。”
derivationEn: From 'The Art of War' by Sun Tzu: 'In battle, avoid the strong and strike at the weak.'
example: 但执笔之际，～，顾彼忌此，实在气闷。★鲁迅《致台静农》
exampleTraditional: 但執筆之際，～，顧彼忌此，實在氣悶。★魯迅《致臺靜農》
exampleEn: But when writing, one must avoid the strong and strike at the weak, being cautious of this and that, which is truly frustrating. — Lu Xun, 'Letter to Tai Jingnong'

explanation: 像游鱼那样连贯着出现。
explanationTraditional: 像游魚那樣連貫著出現。
explanationEn: To come out in a continuous line like fish swimming one after another.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第八回三人急不暇择，从窦中鱼贯而出，外面正是一条逼狭的胡同，还静悄悄的没人阻住。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第八回三人急不暇擇，從竇中魚貫而出，外面正是一條逼狹的衚衕，還靜悄悄的沒人阻住。”
derivationEn: From Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 8: 'The three men, in a hurry, had no time to choose, and came out of the cave one after another like fish.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时恳求人原谅或饶恕的话。意思是您一抬手我就过去了。
explanationTraditional: 舊時懇求人原諒或饒恕的話。意思是您一抬手我就過去了。
explanationEn: An old expression used to beg for forgiveness or mercy, meaning 'if you raise your hand, I can pass'.
derivation: 宋·邵雍《伊川击壤集·谢宁寺丞惠希夷》能斟时事高抬贵手，善酌人情略拨头。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·邵雍《伊川擊壤集·謝寧寺丞惠希夷》能斟時事高抬貴手，善酌人情略撥頭。”
derivationEn: From Shao Yong's 'Collected Works of Yichuan' in the Song Dynasty: 'Able to judge the times, please raise your noble hand; good at weighing human feelings, slightly tilt your head.'
example: 娘是小的一个主儿，娘不～，小的一时儿存站不的。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第二十三回
exampleTraditional: 娘是小的一個主兒，娘不～，小的一時兒存站不的。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第二十三回
exampleEn: You are my master; if you don't raise your noble hand, I cannot stand for a moment. — Ming Dynasty, Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng, 'Jin Ping Mei', Chapter 23

explanation: 尽心地思索和想象。
explanationTraditional: 盡心地思索和想象。
explanationEn: To think deeply and rack one's brains.
derivation: 巴金《创作回忆录·关于二》我拿起笔从来不苦思冥想，我照例写得快，说我‘粗制滥造’也可以，反正有作品在。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《創作回憶錄·關於二》我拿起筆從來不苦思冥想，我照例寫得快，說我‘粗製濫造’也可以，反正有作品在。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin's 'Creative Memoirs: About Two': 'I never rack my brains when I pick up my pen; I write quickly as usual. Call it 'crude production' if you like, but the works are there.'
example: 设计人员在搞设计之前，不只是埋头翻资料，或者捧着脑袋～，而是跟着余师傅上沸腾的建筑工地?★《人民文学》1976年第5期
exampleTraditional: 設計人員在搞設計之前，不只是埋頭翻資料，或者捧著腦袋～，而是跟著餘師傅上沸騰的建築工地?★《人民文學》1976年第5期
exampleEn: Before designing, the designers do not just bury themselves in materials or rack their brains, but follow Master Yu to the bustling construction site. — 'People's Literature', Issue 5, 1976

explanation: 缕线；析剖析。有条有理地细细分析。
explanationTraditional: 縷線；析剖析。有條有理地細細分析。
explanationEn: To analyze methodically and in detail, like sorting threads.
derivation: 清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷五说经之书甚多，以及文集说部，皆有可采。窃欲析缕分条，加以翦截。”
derivationTraditional: 清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷五說經之書甚多，以及文集說部，皆有可採。竊欲析縷分條，加以翦截。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Ping Buqing's 'Xiawaijuan', Volume 5: 'There are many books on classics, as well as collections and novels, all worth adopting. I wish to analyze them thread by thread and cut them appropriately.'
example: 凡译此类书，宜悉仿内典分析之例，～，庶易晓畅，省读者心力。★清·梁启超《变法通议》
exampleTraditional: 凡譯此類書，宜悉仿內典分析之例，～，庶易曉暢，省讀者心力。★清·梁啟超《變法通議》
exampleEn: When translating such books, one should follow the example of Buddhist scripture analysis, analyzing them methodically and in detail, so that they are easy to understand and save the reader's effort. — Qing Dynasty, Liang Qichao, 'On Reform'

explanation: 心心指所有的心思；念念指所有的念头。心里老是想着。指想做某件事或得到某种东西。
explanationTraditional: 心心指所有的心思；念念指所有的念頭。心裡老是想著。指想做某件事或得到某種東西。
explanationEn: To constantly think about something; to have one's mind set on something.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十五心心不停，念念不住。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十五心心不停，念念不住。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting at the Source', Volume 15: 'The mind never stops; thoughts never cease.'
example: 有人遇一事，则～不肯舍，毕竟何益？★宋《二程全书·遗书二上》
exampleTraditional: 有人遇一事，則～不肯舍，畢竟何益？★宋《二程全書·遺書二上》
exampleEn: When someone encounters a matter, they constantly think about it and refuse to let go—what benefit does it bring? — Song Dynasty, 'Complete Works of the Two Chengs', 'Posthumous Writings II'

explanation: 不跟社会上的人发生争执。这是一种消极的回避矛盾的处世态度。
explanationTraditional: 不跟社會上的人發生爭執。這是一種消極的迴避矛盾的處世態度。
explanationEn: To have no conflicts with the world; a passive attitude of avoiding disputes.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他总是持着与世无争的态度。
exampleTraditional: 他總是持著與世無爭的態度。
exampleEn: He always holds an attitude of having no conflicts with the world.

explanation: 闲与正事无关；碎指说话唠叨。唠叨些与正事无关的话。
explanationTraditional: 閒與正事無關；碎指說話嘮叨。嘮叨些與正事無關的話。
explanationEn: Idle chatter or gossip unrelated to important matters.
derivation: 明·冯惟敏《正宫端正好·徐我亭归田》一个道紧急军情奉火牌，闲言碎语须耽待。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮惟敏《正宮端正好·徐我亭歸田》一個道緊急軍情奉火牌，閒言碎語須耽待。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Weimin's 'Zheng Palace Duanzheng Hao: Xu Wo Ting Returns to the Fields': 'One says urgent military orders require immediate action; idle chatter must be endured.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 招展飘动，摇动。形容旗子等随风飘扬。
explanationTraditional: 招展飄動，搖動。形容旗子等隨風飄揚。
explanationEn: To flutter or wave in the wind, as a flag.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 红旗一面～，附近至少一公里的半径内都可以望见。（郭沫若《洪波曲·南京印象》六）
exampleTraditional: 紅旗一面～，附近至少一公里的半徑內都可以望見。（郭沫若《洪波曲·南京印象》六）
exampleEn: A red flag fluttered in the wind, visible from at least a kilometer away. — Guo Moruo, 'Hongbo Qu: Nanjing Impression', Chapter 6

explanation: 高雅的厅堂。比喻高的要求，完美的境界。
explanationTraditional: 高雅的廳堂。比喻高的要求，完美的境界。
explanationEn: Elegant hall; metaphor for high standards or perfect realm.
derivation: 清·袁枚《与陈刺史虚斋》未登大雅之堂，还望刺史陶冶而成全之。”
derivationTraditional: 清·袁枚《與陳刺史虛齋》未登大雅之堂，還望刺史陶冶而成全之。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Yuan Mei: 'Not yet entered the elegant hall, hope the prefect cultivates and perfects it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 众多人一个脸谱。多用以讥讽文艺创作上的雷同。
explanationTraditional: 眾多人一個臉譜。多用以譏諷文藝創作上的雷同。
explanationEn: Thousands of people with the same face; used to criticize stereotyped artistic creation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 纲鱼网的总绳；挈提起。抓住网的总绳，提住衣的领子。比喻抓住要领，简明扼要。
explanationTraditional: 綱魚網的總繩；挈提起。抓住網的總繩，提住衣的領子。比喻抓住要領，簡明扼要。
explanationEn: To grasp the main point; to bring out the essentials concisely.
derivation: 《韩非子·外储说右下》善张网者引其纲，不一一摄万目而后得。”《荀子·劝学》若挈裘领，诎五指而而顿之，顺者不可胜数也。”《宋史·职官志八》提纲而众目张，振领而群毛理。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·外儲說右下》善張網者引其綱，不一一攝萬目而後得。”《荀子·勸學》若挈裘領，詘五指而而頓之，順者不可勝數也。”《宋史·職官志八》提綱而眾目張，振領而群毛理。”
derivationEn: 'Han Feizi': 'A good netter pulls the main rope, not each mesh.' 'Xunzi': 'Like lifting a fur coat by the collar.' 'Song History': 'Lift the outline and all eyes open, shake the collar and all hairs are in order.'
example: 因此便想到一个～的法子。（清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第六十回）
exampleTraditional: 因此便想到一個～的法子。（清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第六十回）
exampleEn: Therefore, he thought of a method to grasp the essentials. (Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Scene')

explanation: 诺诺答应的声音。形容自己没有主意，一味附和，恭顺听从的样子。
explanationTraditional: 諾諾答應的聲音。形容自己沒有主意，一味附和，恭順聽從的樣子。
explanationEn: To be subservient and agree without own opinion; to follow obediently.
derivation: 《韩非子·八奸》此人主未命而唯唯，未使而诺诺，先意承旨，观貌察色，以先主心者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·八奸》此人主未命而唯唯，未使而諾諾，先意承旨，觀貌察色，以先主心者也。”
derivationEn: 'Han Feizi': 'Before the ruler commands, they say yes; before being ordered, they say yes, anticipating his will.'
example: 他思念父母面上，一体同气，听其教诲，～，并不违拗。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二
exampleTraditional: 他思念父母面上，一體同氣，聽其教誨，～，並不違拗。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二
exampleEn: He thought of his parents' kindness, listened to their teachings, and was subservient without disobedience. (Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World')

explanation: 三再三，表示多次。指经过反复考虑，然后再去做。
explanationTraditional: 三再三，表示多次。指經過反覆考慮，然後再去做。
explanationEn: To think thrice before acting; to consider carefully before doing something.
derivation: 《南齐书·公冶度》季文子三思而后行。”
derivationTraditional: 《南齊書·公冶度》季文子三思而後行。”
derivationEn: 'Nan Qi Shu': 'Ji Wenzi thinks thrice before acting.'
example: 终身大事也应该～。★欧阳山《三家巷》三０
exampleTraditional: 終身大事也應該～。★歐陽山《三家巷》三０
exampleEn: A lifelong matter should also be considered thrice before acting. (Ouyang Shan, 'Three Family Lane')

explanation: 调动兵力，派遣将领。泛指调动安排人力。
explanationTraditional: 調動兵力，派遣將領。泛指調動安排人力。
explanationEn: To deploy troops and dispatch generals; to arrange manpower.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十七回写书教太师知道，早早调兵遣将，剿除贼寇报仇。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十七回寫書教太師知道，早早調兵遣將，剿除賊寇報仇。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin': 'Write to the Grand Preceptor to deploy troops and dispatch generals to eliminate the bandits.'
example: 我闻得海上倭贼利害，自去厮杀不成？只是～，罚罪赏功而已。★明·无名氏《鸣凤记·文华祭海》
exampleTraditional: 我聞得海上倭賊利害，自去廝殺不成？只是～，罰罪賞功而已。★明·無名氏《鳴鳳記·文華祭海》
exampleEn: I heard the Japanese pirates are fierce; should I fight myself? Just deploy troops and dispatch generals, punish and reward. (Ming Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Phoenix Pavilion')

explanation: 非常吉祥、顺利。旧时用于占卜和祝福。
explanationTraditional: 非常吉祥、順利。舊時用於占卜和祝福。
explanationEn: Very auspicious and smooth; used in divination and blessings.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十四回孔明曰‘来意亮已知道了。适间卜《易》，得一大吉大利之兆。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十四回孔明曰‘來意亮已知道了。適間卜《易》，得一大吉大利之兆。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms': 'Zhuge Liang said: I already know your intention. I just divined the I Ching and got a very auspicious omen.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 谆谆教诲不倦的样子；告诫规劝。恳切耐心地劝告。
explanationTraditional: 諄諄教誨不倦的樣子；告誡規勸。懇切耐心地勸告。
explanationEn: To earnestly and patiently advise or warn.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·抑》诲尔谆谆，听我藐藐。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·抑》誨爾諄諄，聽我藐藐。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs': 'I teach you earnestly, but you listen carelessly.'
example: 督促提督吴永安等，相机前进，并与广西抚臣徐延旭联络会商，和衷共济，仰副圣意～之至意。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 督促提督吳永安等，相機前進，並與廣西撫臣徐延旭聯絡會商，和衷共濟，仰副聖意～之至意。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: Urge Admiral Wu Yuen to advance opportunely, coordinate with Guangxi Governor Xu Yanshu, and work together to fulfill the imperial earnest advice. (Gao Yang, 'Inside the Qing Court')

explanation: 长生永生。原为道教的话，后也用作对年长者的祝愿语。
explanationTraditional: 長生永生。原為道教的話，後也用作對年長者的祝願語。
explanationEn: Eternal life; originally Taoist term, later used as blessing for elders.
derivation: 《太上纯阳真经·了三得一经》天一生水，人同自然，肾为北极之枢，精食万化，滋养百骸，赖以永年而长生不老。”
derivationTraditional: 《太上純陽真經·了三得一經》天一生水，人同自然，腎為北極之樞，精食萬化，滋養百骸，賴以永年而長生不老。”
derivationEn: 'Tai Shang Chun Yang Zhen Jing': 'Heaven generates water, humans follow nature; kidneys are the pivot, essence nourishes all, ensuring longevity and eternal life.'
example: 逍遥自在，超为上仙。正是玉室丹书著姓，～人家。★明·洪榝《清平山堂话本·蓝桥记》
exampleTraditional: 逍遙自在，超為上仙。正是玉室丹書著姓，～人家。★明·洪樧《清平山堂話本·藍橋記》
exampleEn: Carefree and transcendent, becoming an immortal. Indeed, jade records name the family, and they enjoy eternal life. (Ming Dynasty, Hong Pian, 'Qingping Mountain Tales')

explanation: 形容力量非常强大，没有什么坚固的东西不能摧毁。
explanationTraditional: 形容力量非常強大，沒有什麼堅固的東西不能摧毀。
explanationEn: Nothing is indestructible; extremely powerful.
derivation: 《旧唐书·孔巢文传》（田）悦酒酣，自其骑之艺，拳勇之略，因曰‘若蒙见用，无坚不摧。’”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·孔巢文傳》（田）悅酒酣，自其騎之藝，拳勇之略，因曰‘若蒙見用，無堅不摧。’”
derivationEn: 'Old Tang History': 'Tian Yue, drunk, boasted of his riding skills and bravery, saying: If employed, nothing is indestructible.'
example: 其神勇艰苦的精神，充分显示了共产主义运动顽强的生命力，表现了共产党领导的军队～的战斗力量。★刘伯承《回顾长征》
exampleTraditional: 其神勇艱苦的精神，充分顯示了共產主義運動頑強的生命力，表現了共產黨領導的軍隊～的戰鬥力量。★劉伯承《回顧長征》
exampleEn: Their heroic and arduous spirit fully demonstrated the tenacious vitality of the communist movement and the invincible combat power of the army led by the Communist Party. (Liu Bocheng, 'Reviewing the Long March')

explanation: 火树火红的树，指树上挂满灯彩；银花银白色的花，指灯光雪亮。形容张灯结彩或大放焰火的灿烂夜景。
explanationTraditional: 火樹火紅的樹，指樹上掛滿燈綵；銀花銀白色的花，指燈光雪亮。形容張燈結綵或大放焰火的燦爛夜景。
explanationEn: Fiery trees and silver flowers; describes a brilliantly lit scene with lanterns and fireworks.
derivation: 唐·苏味道《正月十五夜》诗火树银花合，尽桥铁锁开。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·蘇味道《正月十五夜》詩火樹銀花合，盡橋鐵鎖開。”
derivationEn: From Su Weidao's poem 'On the Night of the Fifteenth of the First Month' in the Tang Dynasty: 'Fiery trees and silver flowers merge, the bridge's iron locks are opened.'
example: ～不夜天，弟兄姐妹舞翩跹，歌声唱彻月儿圆。★柳亚子《浣溪沙》词
exampleTraditional: ～不夜天，弟兄姐妹舞翩躚，歌聲唱徹月兒圓。★柳亞子《浣溪沙》詞
exampleEn: Fiery trees and silver flowers light up the night, brothers and sisters dance gracefully, songs fill the air under the full moon. - Liu Yazi's poem 'Silk-Washing Stream'

explanation: 眉头舒展，眼含笑意。形容高兴愉快的样子。
explanationTraditional: 眉頭舒展，眼含笑意。形容高興愉快的樣子。
explanationEn: Eyebrows relax and eyes smile; describes a very happy and delighted expression.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第二本第二折彼见昨日惊魂魂魄，今日眉花眼笑。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第二本第二折彼見昨日驚魂魂魄，今日眉花眼笑。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing' (Yuan Dynasty): 'Seeing him yesterday frightened out of his wits, today he is all smiles.'
example: 等他吃足了烟，他坐起来，～。★清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第三回
exampleTraditional: 等他吃足了煙，他坐起來，～。★清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第三回
exampleEn: After he finished smoking opium, he sat up, eyebrows relaxed and eyes smiling. - Peng Yang'ou's 'The Ghost of Opium' (Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 古代帝王的自称◇指脱离群众，孤立无助的人。
explanationTraditional: 古代帝王的自稱◇指脫離群眾，孤立無助的人。
explanationEn: A solitary person; originally a self-reference of ancient emperors, now refers to someone isolated and without support.
derivation: 《礼记·玉藻》凡自称，小国之君曰孤。”《孟子·梁惠王上》寡人之于国也，尽心焉耳矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·玉藻》凡自稱，小國之君曰孤。”《孟子·梁惠王上》寡人之於國也，盡心焉耳矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Jade Pendants': 'A small state's ruler calls himself 'Gu'.' And from Mencius: 'I have done my utmost for my kingdom.'
example: 到了今日，云岫竟变了个～了。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第六十五回
exampleTraditional: 到了今日，雲岫竟變了個～了。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第六十五回
exampleEn: By now, Yunxiu had become a solitary person. - Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Past Twenty Years' (Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 金属造的城，滚水形成的护城河。形容工事无比坚固。
explanationTraditional: 金屬造的城，滾水形成的護城河。形容工事無比堅固。
explanationEn: As solid as metal walls and moats of boiling water; describes an impregnable fortification.
derivation: 《汉书·蒯通传》必将婴城固守，皆为金城汤池，不可攻也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·蒯通傳》必將嬰城固守，皆為金城湯池，不可攻也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Han: Biography of Kuai Tong': 'They will surely defend the city, making it a metal city and a boiling moat, impossible to attack.'
example: 大沽口的炮台，如能得他允许保护，～。★高阳《胭脂井》
exampleTraditional: 大沽口的炮臺，如能得他允許保護，～。★高陽《胭脂井》
exampleEn: If the Dagu forts could be protected by him, they would be as solid as metal walls and boiling moats. - Gao Yang's 'Yanzhi Well'

explanation: 四书亦称四子书，即《大学》、《中庸》、《论语》、《孟子》；五经《诗》、《书》、《礼》、《易》、《春秋》。指儒家经典。
explanationTraditional: 四書亦稱四子書，即《大學》、《中庸》、《論語》、《孟子》；五經《詩》、《書》、《禮》、《易》、《春秋》。指儒家經典。
explanationEn: The Four Books and Five Classics; the canonical texts of Confucianism.
derivation: 汉·班固《白虎通·五经》五经何谓？谓《易》、《尚书》、《诗》、《礼》、《春秋》也。”宋·朱熹著有《四书集注》。
derivationTraditional: 漢·班固《白虎通·五經》五經何謂？謂《易》、《尚書》、《詩》、《禮》、《春秋》也。”宋·朱熹著有《四書集註》。
derivationEn: From Ban Gu's 'Bai Hu Tong: Five Classics' (Han Dynasty): 'What are the Five Classics? They are the Book of Changes, Book of Documents, Book of Songs, Book of Rites, and Spring and Autumn Annals.' Zhu Xi of the Song Dynasty wrote 'Collected Commentaries on the Four Books.'
example: 君子是只读～，做八股，非常规矩的。★鲁迅《二心集·上海文艺之一瞥》
exampleTraditional: 君子是隻讀～，做八股，非常規矩的。★魯迅《二心集·上海文藝之一瞥》
exampleEn: A gentleman only reads the Four Books and Five Classics and writes eight-legged essays, being very proper. - Lu Xun's 'Two Hearts Collection: A Glimpse of Shanghai Literature'

explanation: 没有老师的传授就能通晓。
explanationTraditional: 沒有老師的傳授就能通曉。
explanationEn: To understand without a teacher; self-taught.
derivation: 唐·贾岛《送贺兰上人》诗无师禅自解，有格句堪說。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·賈島《送賀蘭上人》詩無師禪自解，有格句堪說。”
derivationEn: From Jia Dao's poem 'Seeing Off the Monk Helan' (Tang Dynasty): 'Without a teacher, Zen is self-understood; with a pattern, verses can be spoken.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一手指一个人；包办总揽一切，独自办理。指一人独揽，不让别人插手。
explanationTraditional: 一手指一個人；包辦總攬一切，獨自辦理。指一人獨攬，不讓別人插手。
explanationEn: To handle everything by oneself; to monopolize and not let others participate.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第四十三回你一手包揽，我只崝我的头钱。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第四十三回你一手包攬，我只崝我的頭錢。”
derivationEn: From Li Luyuan's 'Lamp of the Thorny Path' (Qing Dynasty): 'You handle everything yourself, I only take my cut.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 顾拜访；茅庐草屋。原为汉末刘备访聘诸葛亮的故事。比喻真心诚意，一再邀请。
explanationTraditional: 顧拜訪；茅廬草屋。原為漢末劉備訪聘諸葛亮的故事。比喻真心誠意，一再邀請。
explanationEn: To visit a thatched cottage three times; originally referred to Liu Bei's repeated visits to recruit Zhuge Liang, now means sincerely and repeatedly inviting someone.
derivation: 三国蜀·诸葛亮《出师表》先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中。”
derivationTraditional: 三國蜀·諸葛亮《出師表》先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顧臣於草廬之中。”
derivationEn: From Zhuge Liang's 'Memorial on Sending Out the Troops' (Three Kingdoms): 'The late emperor did not consider me humble, but condescended to visit me three times in my thatched cottage.'
example: 我住着半间儿草舍，再谁承望～。★元·马致远《荐福碑》第一折
exampleTraditional: 我住著半間兒草舍，再誰承望～。★元·馬致遠《薦福碑》第一折
exampleEn: I live in a half-ruined thatched cottage; who would expect three visits to my humble abode? - Ma Zhiyuan's 'The Story of the Blessing Stele' (Yuan Dynasty)

explanation: 便便肥胖的样子。形容肥胖的样子。
explanationTraditional: 便便肥胖的樣子。形容肥胖的樣子。
explanationEn: A big belly; describes a fat or obese person.
derivation: 《后汉书·边韶传》边孝先，腹便便。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·邊韶傳》邊孝先，腹便便。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Later Han: Biography of Bian Shao': 'Bian Xiaoxian, with a big belly.'
example: 室如悬磬待遗秉，～乃空洞。★清·姚鼐《王君病起有诗见和因复次韵赠之》
exampleTraditional: 室如懸磬待遺秉，～乃空洞。★清·姚鼐《王君病起有詩見和因複次韻贈之》
exampleEn: The room is empty like an upside-down basket waiting for grain, yet the big belly is empty. - Yao Nai's poem 'Reply to Wang Jun's Poem' (Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 升平太平。边歌边舞，庆祝太平。有粉饰太平的意思。
explanationTraditional: 昇平太平。邊歌邊舞，慶祝太平。有粉飾太平的意思。
explanationEn: To sing and dance to celebrate peace; often implies whitewashing a peaceful situation.
derivation: 《左传·襄公三十一年》文王之初，天下诵而歌舞之。”汉·张衡《东京赋》躬自菲薄，治致升平之德。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公三十一年》文王之初，天下誦而歌舞之。”漢·張衡《東京賦》躬自菲薄，治致昇平之德。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xiang's 31st Year': 'When King Wen began, the world sang and danced.' And Zhang Heng's 'Eastern Metropolis Rhapsody' (Han Dynasty): 'He lived frugally, bringing about peace and virtue.'
example: 但一班醉生梦死的达官贵人，却又个个兴高采烈，～起来。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第六回
exampleTraditional: 但一班醉生夢死的達官貴人，卻又個個興高采烈，～起來。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第六回
exampleEn: But the drunken and dreamy high officials were all elated, singing and dancing to celebrate peace. - Zeng Pu's 'Flower of the Sea of Sin' (Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 两立双方并立。指敌对的双方不能同时存在。比喻矛盾不可调和。
explanationTraditional: 兩立雙方並立。指敵對的雙方不能同時存在。比喻矛盾不可調和。
explanationEn: Two opposing sides cannot coexist; irreconcilable conflict.
derivation: 《战国策·楚策一》秦之所害于天下莫如楚，楚强则秦弱，楚弱则秦强，此其势不两立。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·楚策一》秦之所害於天下莫如楚，楚強則秦弱，楚弱則秦強，此其勢不兩立。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Chu I': 'What Qin fears most in the world is Chu. If Chu is strong, Qin is weak; if Chu is weak, Qin is strong. This is a situation where the two cannot coexist.'
example: 这饮马川贼人这等可恶！几番来搅扰，与他～！★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 這飲馬川賊人這等可惡！幾番來攪擾，與他～！★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第二十回
exampleEn: These bandits of Yinma River are so hateful! They have come to disturb us several times. We cannot coexist with them! — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 20

explanation: 养保养；精精神；蓄积蓄；锐锐气。保养精神，蓄集力量。
explanationTraditional: 養保養；精精神；蓄積蓄；銳銳氣。保養精神，蓄集力量。
explanationEn: To conserve energy and build up strength.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第34回且待半年，养精蓄锐，刘表，孙权可一鼓而下也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第34回且待半年，養精蓄銳，劉表，孫權可一鼓而下也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 34: 'Wait half a year, conserve energy and build up strength, then Liu Biao and Sun Quan can be defeated in one fell swoop.'
example: 他们个个像跑道上的选手，～，伸足擦腿，准备显身手。★叶圣陶《四三集·得失》
exampleTraditional: 他們個個像跑道上的選手，～，伸足擦腿，準備顯身手。★葉聖陶《四三集·得失》
exampleEn: They were like runners on the track, conserving energy and stretching their legs, ready to show their skills. — Ye Shengtao, 'Collection of Four Three: Gain and Loss'

explanation: 指对人或对事物顷注了很深的感情，向往而不能克制。
explanationTraditional: 指對人或對事物頃注了很深的感情，嚮往而不能剋制。
explanationEn: To be deeply attached to someone or something, unable to restrain one's feelings.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·任诞》桓子野每闻清歌。辄唤奈何！谢公闻之曰‘子野可谓一往有深情。’”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·任誕》桓子野每聞清歌。輒喚奈何！謝公聞之曰‘子野可謂一往有深情。’”
derivationEn: From Southern Song Dynasty, Liu Yiqing, 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Unrestrained': 'Whenever Huan Ziye heard a clear song, he would exclaim, 'What can I do!' Xie Gong heard this and said, 'Ziye can be said to have deep feelings.'
example: ～深几许？深山夕照深秋雨。★清·纳兰性德《蝶恋花·出塞》词
exampleTraditional: ～深幾許？深山夕照深秋雨。★清·納蘭性德《蝶戀花·出塞》詞
exampleEn: How deep is the attachment? Deep mountain sunset, deep autumn rain. — Qing Dynasty, Nalan Xingde, 'Butterfly in Love with Flowers: Out of the Pass'

explanation: 形容说话不流利。也比喻凑合，勉强。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話不流利。也比喻湊合，勉強。
explanationEn: To speak haltingly or stammer; also means barely managing or makeshift.
derivation: 老舍《骆驼祥子》十三结结巴巴的，他把昨夜晚的事说了一遍，虽然费力，可是说的不算不完全。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《駱駝祥子》十三結結巴巴的，他把昨夜晚的事說了一遍，雖然費力，可是說的不算不完全。”
derivationEn: From Lao She, 'Rickshaw Boy', Chapter 13: 'Stammering, he told the story of last night, though laboriously, not incompletely.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 甘甜，比喻幸福。艰难的日子过完，美好的日子来到了。
explanationTraditional: 甘甜，比喻幸福。艱難的日子過完，美好的日子來到了。
explanationEn: After hardship comes happiness; sweet after bitter.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第四本第一折忘餐废寝舒心害，若不是真心耐，志诚捱，怎能勾这相思苦尽甘来。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第四本第一折忘餐廢寢舒心害，若不是真心耐，志誠捱，怎能勾這相思苦盡甘來。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu, 'The Story of the Western Wing', Act 4, Scene 1: 'Forgetting to eat and sleep, suffering in heart, if not for true patience and sincere endurance, how could this lovesickness turn from bitter to sweet?'
example: 更不想你生下这猴子，又得岳丈为我报仇。真是～，莫大之喜。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第九回
exampleTraditional: 更不想你生下這猴子，又得岳丈為我報仇。真是～，莫大之喜。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第九回
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, you gave birth to this monkey, and my father-in-law avenged me. This is truly the sweetness after bitterness, a great joy. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 9

explanation: 绞尽脑汁，苦思苦想。
explanationTraditional: 絞盡腦汁，苦思苦想。
explanationEn: To rack one's brains and think hard.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风风声。听到风声，立即逃跑。
explanationTraditional: 風風聲。聽到風聲，立即逃跑。
explanationEn: To flee upon hearing the news (of danger).
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十二回只要望见土匪的影子，早已闻风而逃。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十二回只要望見土匪的影子，早已聞風而逃。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 12: 'As soon as they saw the shadow of the bandits, they fled upon hearing the wind.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 优柔犹豫不决；寡少。指做事犹豫，缺乏决断。
explanationTraditional: 優柔猶豫不決；寡少。指做事猶豫，缺乏決斷。
explanationEn: Indecisive; hesitant and lacking in resolution.
derivation: 《韩非子·亡征》缓心而无成，柔茹而寡断，好恶无决，而无所定立者，可亡也。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·亡徵》緩心而無成，柔茹而寡斷，好惡無決，而無所定立者，可亡也。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: Signs of Ruin': 'Slow in mind and without accomplishment, soft and indecisive, with likes and dislikes unresolved and no fixed stance, such a state can be ruined.'
example: 他做什么事都没有主见，是一个～的人。
exampleTraditional: 他做什麼事都沒有主見，是一個～的人。
exampleEn: He has no opinion in anything he does; he is an indecisive person.

explanation: 指无法无天的强暴行为。
explanationTraditional: 指無法無天的強暴行為。
explanationEn: To commit murder and arson; violent and lawless behavior.
derivation: 元·无名氏《黄花峪》第二折听的道杀人放火偏精细，显出我些英雄神威。”清·钱彩《说岳全传》第五十五回他本是杀人放火为生的主儿，被杨元帅收伏在麾下。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《黃花峪》第二折聽的道殺人放火偏精細，顯出我些英雄神威。”清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第五十五回他本是殺人放火為生的主兒，被楊元帥收伏在麾下。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Yellow Flower Valley', Act 2: 'Hearing of murder and arson, I am particularly meticulous, showing my heroic power.' Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 55: 'He was originally a man who lived by murder and arson, but was subdued by General Yang.'
example: 也有钻穴逾垣在那里偷窃的，也有～在那里抢劫的。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 也有鑽穴逾垣在那裡偷竊的，也有～在那裡搶劫的。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十九回
exampleEn: Some were stealing through holes and climbing walls, others were committing murder and arson and robbing. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 99

explanation: 边幅布帛的边缘，比喻人的衣着、仪表。原形容随随便便，不拘小节◇形容不注意衣着或容貌的整洁。
explanationTraditional: 邊幅布帛的邊緣，比喻人的衣著、儀表。原形容隨隨便便，不拘小節◇形容不注意衣著或容貌的整潔。
explanationEn: Unkempt; not caring about one's appearance or dress.
derivation: 《后汉书·马援传》公孙不吐哺走迎国士，与图成败，反修饰边幅，如偶人形。此子何足久稽天下士乎？”《北齐书·颜之推传》好饮酒，多任纵，不修边幅。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·馬援傳》公孫不吐哺走迎國士，與圖成敗，反修飾邊幅，如偶人形。此子何足久稽天下士乎？”《北齊書·顏之推傳》好飲酒，多任縱，不修邊幅。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Ma Yuan': 'Gongsun did not spit out food to welcome the scholar and discuss success or failure, but instead trimmed his appearance like a puppet. How can this man detain the world's scholars for long?' 'Book of Northern Qi: Biography of Yan Zhitui': 'He loved drinking, was often willful, and did not care about his appearance.'
example: 他又～，穿着一件稀烂的直裰，靸着一双破不过的蒲鞋。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 他又～，穿著一件稀爛的直裰，靸著一雙破不過的蒲鞋。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第五十五回
exampleEn: He was also unkempt, wearing a tattered robe and a pair of broken straw sandals. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 55

explanation: 以手牵牵拉拉。借指拉扯私欲关系。
explanationTraditional: 以手牽牽拉拉。借指拉扯私慾關係。
explanationEn: To pull and drag; figuratively, to engage in improper personal relationships or favoritism.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十一回怪热的，拉拉扯扯的做什么！”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十一回怪熱的，拉拉扯扯的做什麼！”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 31: 'It's so hot, what are you pulling and dragging for?'
example: 说着，才大家嘻嘻哈哈～奔了那座财神殿去了。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十八回
exampleTraditional: 說著，才大家嘻嘻哈哈～奔了那座財神殿去了。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十八回
exampleEn: Saying this, they all laughed and chattered as they rushed towards that wealth temple. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 38

explanation: 营谋求；舞玩弄；弊指坏事。因图谋私利而玩弄欺骗手段做犯法的事。
explanationTraditional: 營謀求；舞玩弄；弊指壞事。因圖謀私利而玩弄欺騙手段做犯法的事。
explanationEn: To engage in fraud or malpractice for personal gain; to exploit one's position for selfish ends.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第十四回南洋兵船虽然不少，叵耐管带一味知道营私舞弊，那里还有公事在他心上。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第十四回南洋兵船雖然不少，叵耐管帶一味知道營私舞弊，那裡還有公事在他心上。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 14: 'Although there were many naval ships in the South Seas, the captains were only interested in embezzlement and fraud, with no regard for official duties.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指一个人的是非功过到死后才能做出结论。同盖棺论定”。
explanationTraditional: 指一個人的是非功過到死後才能做出結論。同蓋棺論定”。
explanationEn: Only after death can a person's merits and faults be finally judged; final judgment is made after one's death.
derivation: 明·吕坤《大明嘉议大夫刑部左侍郎新吾吕君墓志铭》善恶在我，毁誉由人，盖棺定论，无藉于子孙之乞言耳。”
derivationTraditional: 明·呂坤《大明嘉議大夫刑部左侍郎新吾呂君墓誌銘》善惡在我，譭譽由人，蓋棺定論，無藉於子孫之乞言耳。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Lü Kun's 'Epitaph of Lord Lü Xinwu': 'Good and evil are in myself, praise and blame depend on others; the final judgment is made after the coffin is closed, without relying on descendants' pleas.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指朋友或亲人在长久分别之后再次见面。
explanationTraditional: 指朋友或親人在長久分別之後再次見面。
explanationEn: To meet again after a long separation; reunion after a long time.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第三回多年不见了，说了几句久别重逢的话，招呼大家坐下，书僮送上茶来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第三回多年不見了，說了幾句久別重逢的話，招呼大家坐下，書僮送上茶來。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu's 'Flower of the Sea of Sins', Chapter 3: 'After many years of not seeing each other, they exchanged words of reunion after long separation, invited everyone to sit down, and the servant brought tea.'
example: 与队员诸兄姐相别，瞬已晚年，～，情逾骨肉，竟有因感激而流涕者。★郭沫若《洪波曲》第十章
exampleTraditional: 與隊員諸兄姐相別，瞬已晚年，～，情逾骨肉，竟有因感激而流涕者。★郭沫若《洪波曲》第十章
exampleEn: Having been separated from my fellow team members for many years, meeting again after such a long time, our bond was deeper than flesh and blood, and some even shed tears of gratitude. — Guo Moruo, 'Hongbo Qu', Chapter 10

explanation: 枯燥单调。形容单调，没有趣味。
explanationTraditional: 枯燥單調。形容單調，沒有趣味。
explanationEn: Dry and tasteless; dull and uninteresting.
derivation: 毛泽东《反对党八股》因此，群众就不欢迎他们枯燥无味的宣传，我们也不需要这样憋脚的不中用的宣传家。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《反對黨八股》因此，群眾就不歡迎他們枯燥無味的宣傳，我們也不需要這樣憋腳的不中用的宣傳家。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing': 'Therefore, the masses do not welcome their dry and uninteresting propaganda, and we do not need such clumsy and useless propagandists.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指着鹿，说是马。比喻故意颠倒黑白，混淆是非。
explanationTraditional: 指著鹿，說是馬。比喻故意顛倒黑白，混淆是非。
explanationEn: To point at a deer and call it a horse; deliberately misrepresent or confuse right and wrong.
derivation: 《史记·秦始皇本纪》赵高欲为乱，恐群臣不听，乃先设验，持鹿献于二世，曰‘马也。’二世笑曰‘丞相误邪？谓鹿为马。’问左右，左右或默，或言马以阿顺赵高。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·秦始皇本紀》趙高欲為亂，恐群臣不聽，乃先設驗，持鹿獻於二世，曰‘馬也。’二世笑曰‘丞相誤邪？謂鹿為馬。’問左右，左右或默，或言馬以阿順趙高。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Qin Shihuang': 'Zhao Gao wanted to rebel but feared the ministers would not obey, so he first tested them by presenting a deer to the Second Emperor, calling it a horse. The Emperor laughed and said, 'Is the Chancellor mistaken? Calling a deer a horse.' He asked those around him; some remained silent, while some called it a horse to flatter Zhao Gao.'
example: 东床已招佳婿，何似以羊易牛；西邻纵有责言，终难～。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷七
exampleTraditional: 東床已招佳婿，何似以羊易牛；西鄰縱有責言，終難～。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷七
exampleEn: The eastern bed has already recruited a good son-in-law, why exchange a sheep for an ox? Even if the western neighbor has complaints, it's hard to point at a deer and call it a horse. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 7

explanation: 泛泛平常，不深入。一般地浮泛地谈谈。
explanationTraditional: 泛泛平常，不深入。一般地浮泛地談談。
explanationEn: To speak in general terms; to discuss superficially without depth.
derivation: 茅盾《怎样评价〈青春之歌〉》也由于时间关系，不能把《青春之歌》重读一遍然后执笔，故而只能泛泛而谈，不能引证原文作具体的分析。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《怎樣評價〈青春之歌〉》也由於時間關係，不能把《青春之歌》重讀一遍然後執筆，故而只能泛泛而談，不能引證原文作具體的分析。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'How to Evaluate 'The Song of Youth'': 'Due to time constraints, I could not reread 'The Song of Youth' before writing, so I can only speak in general terms without citing specific textual analysis.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 悔悔改；过错误；自新使自己重新做人。悔恨以前的过失，决心重新作人。
explanationTraditional: 悔悔改；過錯誤；自新使自己重新做人。悔恨以前的過失，決心重新作人。
explanationEn: To repent one's past mistakes and resolve to turn over a new leaf.
derivation: 《史记·吴王濞列传》于古法当诛，文帝弗忍，因赐几杖。德至厚，当改过自新。《新唐书·冯元常传》元常喻以恩信，约悔过自新，贼相率脱甲而缚。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·吳王濞列傳》於古法當誅，文帝弗忍，因賜几杖。德至厚，當改過自新。《新唐書·馮元常傳》元常喻以恩信，約悔過自新，賊相率脫甲而縛。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of King Pi of Wu': 'According to ancient law, he should have been executed, but Emperor Wen could not bear it and gave him a staff. The kindness was profound, and he should reform and start anew.' Also from 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Feng Yuanchang': 'Yuanchang persuaded them with kindness and trust, and they agreed to repent and start anew, surrendering their weapons.'
example: 只要你真能～，本部堂可以饶你的活命。★郭沫若《南冠草》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 只要你真能～，本部堂可以饒你的活命。★郭沫若《南冠草》第一幕
exampleEn: As long as you truly repent and turn over a new leaf, I can spare your life. — Guo Moruo, 'Southern Crown', Act 1

explanation: 投机利用时机钻空子。利用时机，以囤积居奇、买空卖空、掺杂作假、操纵物价等手段牟取暴利。
explanationTraditional: 投機利用時機鑽空子。利用時機，以囤積居奇、買空賣空、摻雜作假、操縱物價等手段牟取暴利。
explanationEn: To engage in speculation and profiteering; to exploit opportunities for illegal gain through hoarding, short-selling, adulteration, or price manipulation.
derivation: 浩然《艳阳天》第47章投机倒把是不符合政策条文的事情，弯弯绕那家伙能干这样傻事？”
derivationTraditional: 浩然《豔陽天》第47章投機倒把是不符合政策條文的事情，彎彎繞那傢伙能幹這樣傻事？”
derivationEn: From Hao Ran's 'Bright Sunny Skies', Chapter 47: 'Speculation and profiteering are against policy; would a cunning fellow like that do such a stupid thing?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 赴走往；汤热水；蹈踩。沸水敢蹚，烈火敢踏。比喻不避艰险，奋勇向前。
explanationTraditional: 赴走往；湯熱水；蹈踩。沸水敢蹚，烈火敢踏。比喻不避艱險，奮勇向前。
explanationEn: To go through boiling water and tread on fire; to brave any danger or difficulty without hesitation.
derivation: 《荀子·议兵》以桀诈尧，譬之若以卵投石，以指挠沸，若赴水火，入焉焦没耳。”晋·稽康《与山巨源绝交书》长而见羁，则狂顾顿缨，赴汤蹈火。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·議兵》以桀詐堯，譬之若以卵投石，以指撓沸，若赴水火，入焉焦沒耳。”晉·稽康《與山巨源絕交書》長而見羈，則狂顧頓纓，赴湯蹈火。”
derivationEn: From 'Xunzi: On Military Affairs': 'Using Jie to deceive Yao is like throwing an egg at a stone, or stirring boiling water with a finger; if you go into fire or water, you will be scorched or drowned.' Also from Jin Dynasty, Ji Kang's 'Letter Breaking Off Relations with Shan Tao': 'If I am long restrained, I will wildly look back and break the reins, going through fire and water.'
example: 有三个人，义胆包身，武艺出众，敢～，同死同生。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 有三個人，義膽包身，武藝出眾，敢～，同死同生。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第十五回
exampleEn: There were three men, loyal and brave, with outstanding martial arts, daring to go through fire and water, sharing life and death. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 15

explanation: 奇怪的不合情理的言论。
explanationTraditional: 奇怪的不合情理的言論。
explanationEn: Strange and unreasonable remarks or opinions.
derivation: 清·钱泳《履园丛话·耆旧·仲子教授》乾隆戊申岁，余往汴梁，遇毕秋帆中丞幕中，两眼若漆，奇谈怪论，咸视为异物，无一人与言者。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢泳《履園叢話·耆舊·仲子教授》乾隆戊申歲，餘往汴梁，遇畢秋帆中丞幕中，兩眼若漆，奇談怪論，鹹視為異物，無一人與言者。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Qian Yong's 'Lv Yuan Cong Hua': In the year of Qianlong Wushen, I went to Bianliang and met Bi Qiufan in his tent. His eyes were like lacquer, and he made strange and unreasonable remarks, regarded as a freak, with no one speaking to him.
example: 对社会上的一些～，我们要有识别能力。
exampleTraditional: 對社會上的一些～，我們要有識別能力。
exampleEn: We must have the ability to identify some strange and unreasonable remarks in society.

explanation: 上下一心。
explanationTraditional: 上下一心。
explanationEn: Unity of purpose from top to bottom.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十七章自成虽然新遭大败，但此人百折不挠，锐意进取，加之重要将领均在，上下同心，亲密无向，又善于整饬军纪，救民之急，所以只要他喘息一下，重振旗鼓不难。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十七章自成雖然新遭大敗，但此人百折不撓，銳意進取，加之重要將領均在，上下同心，親密無向，又善於整飭軍紀，救民之急，所以只要他喘息一下，重振旗鼓不難。”
derivationEn: Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 17: Although Zicheng had just suffered a major defeat, he was indomitable and aggressive. Moreover, important generals were all present, united in purpose, close and without conflict, and good at rectifying military discipline and relieving the people's urgency. So as long as he caught his breath, it would not be difficult to rally again.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 博广泛。广泛地阅读各种书。形容读书很多。
explanationTraditional: 博廣泛。廣泛地閱讀各種書。形容讀書很多。
explanationEn: To read widely and extensively; well-read.
derivation: 《周书·庾信传》庾信，字子山，南阳新野人也。……幼而俊迈，聪敏绝伦，博览群书，尤善《春秋左氏传》。”
derivationTraditional: 《周書·庾信傳》庾信，字子山，南陽新野人也。……幼而俊邁，聰敏絕倫，博覽群書，尤善《春秋左氏傳》。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Zhou: Biography of Yu Xin': Yu Xin, courtesy name Zishan, was a native of Xinye, Nanyang. ... He was talented and outstanding from childhood, exceptionally intelligent, read widely, and was especially proficient in 'Zuo's Commentary on Spring and Autumn Annals'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 师军队。利顺利。出战不顺利。形容事情刚开始，就遭受败绩。
explanationTraditional: 師軍隊。利順利。出戰不順利。形容事情剛開始，就遭受敗績。
explanationEn: To encounter setbacks at the very beginning; to have an unfavorable start.
derivation: 王朔《顽主》续篇二‘出师不利出师不利。’马青探头探脑往前后胡同口张望，见确实没有作家追杀而来，这才放下心，对于观说，‘谁想到今儿作家全出街了。’ ”
derivationTraditional: 王朔《頑主》續篇二‘出師不利出師不利。’馬青探頭探腦往前後衚衕口張望，見確實沒有作家追殺而來，這才放下心，對於觀說，‘誰想到今兒作家全出街了。’ ”
derivationEn: Wang Shuo's 'Wan Zhu' Sequel 2: 'Bad start, bad start.' Ma Qing craned his neck to look around the alley, and only when he confirmed that no writer was chasing them did he relax. He said to Yu Guan, 'Who would have thought all the writers would be out on the streets today.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把大的材料当成小的材料用。比喻使用不当，浪费人才。
explanationTraditional: 把大的材料當成小的材料用。比喻使用不當，浪費人才。
explanationEn: To use a talented person in a minor position; to waste talent.
derivation: 晋·石崇《许巢论》盖闻圣人在位，则群材必举，官才任能，轻重允宜，大任已备，则不抑大材使居小位；小材已极其分，则不以积久而合处过材之位。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·石崇《許巢論》蓋聞聖人在位，則群材必舉，官才任能，輕重允宜，大任已備，則不抑大材使居小位；小材已極其分，則不以積久而合處過材之位。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Shi Chong's 'Xu Chao Lun': I have heard that when a sage is in power, all talents are promoted. Officials are appointed according to their abilities, with appropriate weight. When major positions are filled, great talents are not suppressed to minor posts; when minor talents have reached their limit, they are not kept in positions beyond their capacity due to long service.
example: ～古所叹，管仲萧何实流业。★宋·陆游《送辛幼安殿撰造朝》诗
exampleTraditional: ～古所嘆，管仲蕭何實流業。★宋·陸游《送辛幼安殿撰造朝》詩
exampleEn: Using a great talent for a trivial task has been lamented since ancient times; Guan Zhong and Xiao He were indeed such cases. - Song Dynasty, Lu You's poem 'Seeing Xin You'an off to the Capital as an Official'

explanation: 择挑拣。不管什么都吃。比喻需要急迫，顾不得选择。
explanationTraditional: 擇挑揀。不管什麼都吃。比喻需要急迫，顧不得選擇。
explanationEn: When hungry, one does not choose food. It describes a situation where urgent need forces one to accept whatever is available without choice.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷三十问‘如何是和尚家风？’师曰‘饥不择食。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷三十問‘如何是和尚家風？’師曰‘飢不擇食。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting the Source', Volume 30: 'What is the master's style?' The master replied, 'When hungry, one does not choose food.'
example: 自古有几般～，寒不择衣，慌不择路，贫不择妻。（明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第三回）
exampleTraditional: 自古有幾般～，寒不擇衣，慌不擇路，貧不擇妻。（明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第三回）
exampleEn: Since ancient times, there are cases of 'when hungry, one does not choose food; when cold, one does not choose clothes; when in panic, one does not choose the road; when poor, one does not choose a wife.' (Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 3)

explanation: 教和学两方面互相影响和促进，都得到提高。
explanationTraditional: 教和學兩方面互相影響和促進，都得到提高。
explanationEn: Teaching and learning promote each other; both are enhanced through interaction.
derivation: 《礼记·学记》是故学然后知不足，教然后知困。知不足然后能自反也，知困然后能自强也。故曰教学相长也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·學記》是故學然後知不足，教然後知困。知不足然後能自反也，知困然後能自強也。故曰教學相長也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Rites: Record on the Subject of Education': 'Therefore, after learning, one realizes one's deficiencies; after teaching, one realizes one's difficulties. Knowing deficiencies leads to self-reflection; knowing difficulties leads to self-improvement. Hence it is said that teaching and learning promote each other.'
example: 再如教员天天在堂上给大家讲，不特不能减其所有，反可得～的益处。★清·梁启超《知不可而为”主义与为而不有”主义》
exampleTraditional: 再如教員天天在堂上給大家講，不特不能減其所有，反可得～的益處。★清·梁啟超《知不可而為”主義與為而不有”主義》
exampleEn: Moreover, when teachers lecture in class every day, not only do they not diminish their own knowledge, but they also gain the benefit of mutual promotion between teaching and learning. (Qing Dynasty, Liang Qichao, 'The Doctrine of Acting as if Not Acting and Having as if Not Having')

explanation: 指只了解一二。
explanationTraditional: 指只瞭解一二。
explanationEn: To see only a part or a glimpse; to have a limited understanding.
derivation: 《高子遗书·会语九八》一向不知阳明、象山学问来历，前在舟中似窥见其一斑。”
derivationTraditional: 《高子遺書·會語九八》一向不知陽明、象山學問來歷，前在舟中似窺見其一斑。”
derivationEn: 'Gaozi's Posthumous Writings: Conversations 98': 'I have never known the origins of Wang Yangming and Lu Xiangshan's learning, but previously on the boat I seemed to glimpse a part of it.'
example: 明代吴中山歌的风靡流布，还可以从明代小说中的描写～。★关德栋《序》
exampleTraditional: 明代吳中山歌的風靡流佈，還可以從明代小說中的描寫～。★關德棟《序》
exampleEn: The popularity of Wu Mountain songs in the Ming Dynasty can also be glimpsed from descriptions in Ming novels. (Guan Dedong, 'Preface')

explanation: 形容情况非常确实。
explanationTraditional: 形容情況非常確實。
explanationEn: Absolutely true; completely certain.
derivation: 应修人《金字塔银宝塔》一这个南乡人，还说这个新闻是千真万确的。”
derivationTraditional: 應修人《金字塔銀寶塔》一這個南鄉人，還說這個新聞是千真萬確的。”
derivationEn: Ying Xiuren, 'The Golden Pyramid and Silver Treasure Pagoda' 1: 'This man from the southern countryside also said that the news was absolutely true.'
example: 我是从何营长的小公馆里得来的。营长的姨太太已经避到县里去了。还是雇的王麻子的船，～！★茅盾《子夜》四
exampleTraditional: 我是從何營長的小公館裡得來的。營長的姨太太已經避到縣裡去了。還是僱的王麻子的船，～！★茅盾《子夜》四
exampleEn: I got it from Battalion Commander He's private residence. The battalion commander's concubine has already taken refuge in the county. They hired Wang Mazi's boat. It's absolutely true! (Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 4)

explanation: 腰缠指随身携带的财物；贯旧时用绳索穿钱，每一千文为一贯。比喻钱财极多。
explanationTraditional: 腰纏指隨身攜帶的財物；貫舊時用繩索穿錢，每一千文為一貫。比喻錢財極多。
explanationEn: To have a lot of money; extremely wealthy. 'Guan' is a string of 1,000 copper coins.
derivation: 南朝梁·殷芸《小说》有客相从，各言所志，或原为扬州刺史，或原多赀财，或原骑鹤上升。其一人曰‘腰缠十万贯，骑鹤上扬州。’欲兼三者。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝梁·殷芸《小說》有客相從，各言所志，或原為揚州刺史，或原多貲財，或原騎鶴上升。其一人曰‘腰纏十萬貫，騎鶴上揚州。’欲兼三者。”
derivationEn: Southern Liang Dynasty, Yin Yun, 'Anecdotes': 'Some guests were discussing their aspirations: one wished to be the governor of Yangzhou, another wished to have much wealth, and another wished to ride a crane to ascend to heaven. One person said, 'I want to have a hundred thousand strings of cash around my waist and ride a crane to Yangzhou,' wanting to combine all three.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 许多星星衬托着月亮。比喻众人拥护着一个他们所尊敬爱戴的人。
explanationTraditional: 許多星星襯托著月亮。比喻眾人擁護著一個他們所尊敬愛戴的人。
explanationEn: Many stars surround the moon. It metaphorically means that many people support a person they respect and love.
derivation: 《论语·为政》为致以德，譬如北辰，居其所而众星共之。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·為政》為致以德，譬如北辰，居其所而眾星共之。”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius: 'He who governs by virtue is like the North Star, which remains in its place while all other stars revolve around it.'
example: 乘着这个改朝换代的时机，咱们得～，把他抬出去！★老舍《四世同堂》七
exampleTraditional: 乘著這個改朝換代的時機，咱們得～，把他抬出去！★老舍《四世同堂》七
exampleEn: Taking advantage of this dynastic change, we must support him like stars surrounding the moon! — Lao She, Four Generations Under One Roof, Chapter 7

explanation: 本根本；溯探求。追究根本，探索源头，比喻追寻根源。
explanationTraditional: 本根本；溯探求。追究根本，探索源頭，比喻追尋根源。
explanationEn: To trace back to the root or source; to investigate the origin.
derivation: 石三友《金陵野史·圆明园与基泰工程司》说到这八座模型，追本溯源，不能不提到北洋政府时的总长朱启钤。”
derivationTraditional: 石三友《金陵野史·圓明園與基泰工程司》說到這八座模型，追本溯源，不能不提到北洋政府時的總長朱啟鈐。”
derivationEn: From Shi Sanyou's Jinling Wild History: 'Speaking of these eight models, tracing back to the source, we cannot avoid mentioning Zhu Qiqian, the Chief of the Beiyang Government.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用短柄刀直接刺入。原比喻认定目标，勇猛精进◇比喻说话直接了当，不绕弯子。
explanationTraditional: 用短柄刀直接刺入。原比喻認定目標，勇猛精進◇比喻說話直接了當，不繞彎子。
explanationEn: Originally means to thrust directly with a short knife; metaphorically means to speak directly without beating around the bush.
derivation: 宋·释道元《景德传灯录》卷十二若是作家战将，便请单刀直入，更莫如何若何。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道元《景德傳燈錄》卷十二若是作家戰將，便請單刀直入，更莫如何若何。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty's Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp, Volume 12: 'If you are a warrior general, then please charge straight in with a single knife, without any hesitation.'
example: 上面一篇嗣汉六十二代天师正一真人张元旭”的序文，尤为～。★鲁迅《热风》三十三
exampleTraditional: 上面一篇嗣漢六十二代天師正一真人張元旭”的序文，尤為～。★魯迅《熱風》三十三
exampleEn: The preface by Zhang Yuanxu, the 62nd Heavenly Master of the Zhengyi Sect, is particularly straightforward. — Lu Xun, Hot Wind, No. 33

explanation: 指待人和善能招财进宝。
explanationTraditional: 指待人和善能招財進寶。
explanationEn: Being amiable brings wealth; harmony attracts fortune.
derivation: 鲁迅《彷徨·离婚》一个人总要和气些，‘和气生财’，对不对？”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《彷徨·離婚》一個人總要和氣些，‘和氣生財’，對不對？”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's Wandering: 'A person should be amiable; 'amiability brings wealth,' right?'
example: 老人一辈子最重要的格言是‘～’。★老舍《四世同堂》
exampleTraditional: 老人一輩子最重要的格言是‘～’。★老舍《四世同堂》
exampleEn: The most important motto of the old man's life is 'amiability brings wealth.' — Lao She, Four Generations Under One Roof

explanation: 支撑住。快乐到不能撑持的地步。形容欣喜到极点。
explanationTraditional: 支撐住。快樂到不能撐持的地步。形容欣喜到極點。
explanationEn: So happy that one cannot bear it; extremely delighted.
derivation: 汉·班固《东观汉记·张堪传》桑无附枝，麦穗两歧，张君为政，乐不可支。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·班固《東觀漢記·張堪傳》桑無附枝，麥穗兩歧，張君為政，樂不可支。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty's Dongguan Han Ji: 'Mulberry trees have no side branches, wheat ears have two spikes; Zhang Kan's governance brings joy beyond measure.'
example: 兰言夫子听了宝云夫子之话，正中心怀，～，如何肯去拦阻。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第八十四回
exampleTraditional: 蘭言夫子聽了寶雲夫子之話，正中心懷，～，如何肯去攔阻。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第八十四回
exampleEn: When Lan Yanzifu heard Baoyunzifu's words, it struck a chord, and he was overjoyed beyond measure, how could he refuse? — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 84

explanation: 蒂花或瓜果跟枝茎相连的部分。瓜熟了，瓜蒂自然脱落。指时机一旦成熟，事情自然成功。
explanationTraditional: 蒂花或瓜果跟枝莖相連的部分。瓜熟了，瓜蒂自然脫落。指時機一旦成熟，事情自然成功。
explanationEn: When the melon is ripe, it falls off the stem. It means that when conditions are ripe, things will naturally succeed.
derivation: 宋·张君房《云笈七签》卷五十六体地法天，负阴抱阳，喻瓜熟蒂落，啐啄同时。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》卷五十六體地法天，負陰抱陽，喻瓜熟蒂落，啐啄同時。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty's Yunji Qiqian, Volume 56: 'The body follows the earth, the law of heaven, embracing yin and yang, like a ripe melon falling from its stem, simultaneous peck and hatch.'
example: 况吉人天相，自然～，何须过虑。★清·禇人获《隋唐演义》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 況吉人天相，自然～，何須過慮。★清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》第十一回
exampleEn: Moreover, heaven helps the virtuous; naturally, when the melon is ripe, it falls. Why worry? — Qing Dynasty, Chu Renhuo, Sui and Tang Romance, Chapter 11

explanation: 人民富裕，国家强盛。
explanationTraditional: 人民富裕，國家強盛。
explanationEn: The people are wealthy and the country is strong.
derivation: 汉·赵晔《吴越春秋·勾践归国外传》越王内实府库，垦其田畴，民富国强，众安道泰。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·趙曄《吳越春秋·勾踐歸國外傳》越王內實府庫，墾其田疇，民富國強，眾安道泰。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty's Records of Wu and Yue: 'King Goujian of Yue filled the treasury, cultivated the fields, making the people wealthy and the country strong, with peace and prosperity.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 机关周密、巧妙的计谋。比喻用尽心思。
explanationTraditional: 機關周密、巧妙的計謀。比喻用盡心思。
explanationEn: To exhaust all schemes and tricks; to use every stratagem.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《牧童歌》诗多少长安名利客，机关用尽不如君。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《牧童歌》詩多少長安名利客，機關用盡不如君。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty's Huang Tingjian's poem 'Song of the Shepherd Boy': 'How many people in Chang'an chase fame and profit, exhausting their schemes but not as good as you.'
example: ～太聪明，反算了卿卿性命。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五回
exampleTraditional: ～太聰明，反算了卿卿性命。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五回
exampleEn: Too clever by half, you schemed your life away, but in the end, it cost you your own life. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 5

explanation: 的靶心；矢箭。没有目标乱射箭。比喻说话做事没有明确目的，或不切合实际。
explanationTraditional: 的靶心；矢箭。沒有目標亂射箭。比喻說話做事沒有明確目的，或不切合實際。
explanationEn: To shoot an arrow without a target; to speak or act without a clear purpose or relevance.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 不是有的放矢，而是～。（毛泽东《改造我们的学习》）
exampleTraditional: 不是有的放矢，而是～。（毛澤東《改造我們的學習》）
exampleEn: It is not shooting the arrow at the target, but shooting without a target. — Mao Zedong, Reform Our Study

explanation: 让歉让。互不谦让、让步。
explanationTraditional: 讓歉讓。互不謙讓、讓步。
explanationEn: Neither side yields to the other; mutual refusal to give in.
derivation: 冯玉祥《我的生活》第二十三章于是两方明争暗斗，各不相让，一天利（历）害一天。”
derivationTraditional: 馮玉祥《我的生活》第二十三章於是兩方明爭暗鬥，各不相讓，一天利（歷）害一天。”
derivationEn: From Feng Yuxiang's My Life, Chapter 23: 'Thus the two sides engaged in open and covert struggles, each refusing to yield, and the situation became increasingly intense.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 全部计算在内。
explanationTraditional: 全部計算在內。
explanationEn: Counting everything in; including all factors.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第39回孔夫子给子华他们老太太的米，那是行人情，自然给的是串过的细米，那得满打满算。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第39回孔夫子給子華他們老太太的米，那是行人情，自然給的是串過的細米，那得滿打滿算。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wenkang's 'The Story of Heroes' Chapter 39: 'Confucius gave rice to Zihua's mother as a gift, naturally it was refined rice, which must be counted in full.'
example: 作计划时不能～，要留有余地。
exampleTraditional: 作計劃時不能～，要留有餘地。
exampleEn: When making plans, you cannot count everything in; you must leave some leeway.

explanation: 原为佛教故事天女散花以试菩萨和声闻弟子的道行，花至菩萨身上即落去，至弟子身上便不落◇多形容抛洒东西或大雪纷飞的样子。
explanationTraditional: 原為佛教故事天女散花以試菩薩和聲聞弟子的道行，花至菩薩身上即落去，至弟子身上便不落◇多形容拋灑東西或大雪紛飛的樣子。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist story where a heavenly maiden scatters flowers to test the spiritual attainment of bodhisattvas and disciples; flowers fall on bodhisattvas but stick to disciples. Now often describes scattering things or heavy snowfall.
derivation: 《维摩经·观众生品》时维摩诘室有一天女，见诸大人闻所说说法，便现其身，即以天华散诸菩萨、大弟子上，华至诸菩萨即皆堕落，至大弟子便著不堕。一切弟子神力去华，不能令去。”
derivationTraditional: 《維摩經·觀眾生品》時維摩詰室有一天女，見諸大人聞所說說法，便現其身，即以天華散諸菩薩、大弟子上，華至諸菩薩即皆墮落，至大弟子便著不墮。一切弟子神力去華，不能令去。”
derivationEn: From 'Vimalakirti Sutra': 'At that time, a heavenly maiden in Vimalakirti's room saw the great ones listening to the Dharma, appeared, and scattered heavenly flowers over the bodhisattvas and great disciples. The flowers fell off the bodhisattvas but stuck to the disciples.'
example: ～，缀山林之草树。★唐·宋之问《设斋叹佛文》
exampleTraditional: ～，綴山林之草樹。★唐·宋之問《設齋嘆佛文》
exampleEn: The heavenly maiden scatters flowers, adorning the trees and grass of the mountain forest. — Tang Dynasty Song Zhiwen's 'Prayer for Buddha'

explanation: 惨狠毒，残暴。残酷狠毒到极点，如野兽一样。
explanationTraditional: 慘狠毒，殘暴。殘酷狠毒到極點，如野獸一樣。
explanationEn: Extremely cruel and brutal, like a beast.
derivation: 蔡东藩《唐史演义》第五十二回将妃、主等人，一一剖心致祭，惨无人道。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩《唐史演義》第五十二回將妃、主等人，一一剖心致祭，慘無人道。”
derivationEn: From Cai Dongfan's 'History of the Tang Dynasty' Chapter 52: 'They cut open the hearts of princesses and consorts as sacrifices, extremely cruel and inhuman.'
example: 杀我人民，系累我妇孺，～。★杨玉如《辛亥革命先著记》
exampleTraditional: 殺我人民，繫累我婦孺，～。★楊玉如《辛亥革命先著記》
exampleEn: They killed our people, captured our women and children, extremely cruel and inhuman. — Yang Yuru's 'Records of the 1911 Revolution'

explanation: 陈旧不合理的规章制度或习惯。
explanationTraditional: 陳舊不合理的規章制度或習慣。
explanationEn: Outdated and unreasonable rules, regulations, or customs.
derivation: 老舍《鼓书艺人》十七要是我们不抗战，今天早已经亡国了。陈规陋习也一样，你不跟它斗，它就会压垮你。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《鼓書藝人》十七要是我們不抗戰，今天早已經亡國了。陳規陋習也一樣，你不跟它鬥，它就會壓垮你。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Drum Singers' Chapter 17: 'If we hadn't resisted the Japanese, we would have been conquered long ago. Outdated customs are the same; if you don't fight them, they will crush you.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 只要低下头来捡取，到处都是。形容多而易得。
explanationTraditional: 只要低下頭來撿取，到處都是。形容多而易得。
explanationEn: So numerous that one can pick them up everywhere; easily available.
derivation: 唐·司空图《诗品·自然》俯拾即是，不取诸邻。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·司空圖《詩品·自然》俯拾即是，不取諸鄰。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Sikong Tu's 'Poetry Styles: Nature': 'Pick them up everywhere, without taking from neighbors.'
example: 松树林里，松果密密麻麻落在地上，～。
exampleTraditional: 松樹林裡，松果密密麻麻落在地上，～。
exampleEn: In the pine forest, pine cones are densely scattered on the ground, everywhere to be picked up.

explanation: 水面的光和掠过的影子，一晃就消逝。比喻观察不细致，学习不深入，印象不深刻。
explanationTraditional: 水面的光和掠過的影子，一晃就消逝。比喻觀察不細緻，學習不深入，印象不深刻。
explanationEn: Superficial understanding or impression that fades quickly, like light on water or a passing shadow.
derivation: 唐·禇亮《临高台》诗浮光随日度，漾影逐波深。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·禇亮《臨高臺》詩浮光隨日度，漾影逐波深。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Chu Liang's poem 'Ascending the High Terrace': 'Floating light follows the sun, rippling shadows deepen with the waves.'
example: 学问从实地上用功，议论自然确有根据；若～，中无成见，自然随波逐流，无所适从。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 學問從實地上用功，議論自然確有根據；若～，中無成見，自然隨波逐流，無所適從。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十八回
exampleEn: Learning must be grounded in practice; then arguments are well-founded. If superficial, without firm views, one will drift with the tide and be at a loss. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 18

explanation: 无为无所作为；治治理。自己无所作为而使天下得到治理。原指舜当政的时候，沿袭尧的主张，不做丝毫改变◇泛指以德化民。
explanationTraditional: 無為無所作為；治治理。自己無所作為而使天下得到治理。原指舜當政的時候，沿襲堯的主張，不做絲毫改變◇泛指以德化民。
explanationEn: Governing by non-action; ruling by virtue without imposing one's will. Originally referred to Emperor Shun following Yao's policies without change.
derivation: 《论语·卫灵公》无为而治者，其舜也与？”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·衛靈公》無為而治者，其舜也與？”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Duke Ling of Wei': 'Was it not Shun who governed by non-action?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 潭深水坑。一池子死水。比喻停滞不前的沉闷局面。
explanationTraditional: 潭深水坑。一池子死水。比喻停滯不前的沉悶局面。
explanationEn: A pool of stagnant water; metaphor for a stagnant, unchanging situation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 假如把中国封建社会比喻做～的话，那么异族的侵入就象突然投入一块大石头。（蒲韧《二千年间》八）
exampleTraditional: 假如把中國封建社會比喻做～的話，那麼異族的侵入就象突然投入一塊大石頭。（蒲韌《二千年間》八）
exampleEn: If Chinese feudal society is compared to a pool of stagnant water, then foreign invasions are like suddenly throwing a big stone into it. — Pu Ren's 'Two Thousand Years' Chapter 8

explanation: 泻水往下直注。形容江河奔流直下，流得又快又远。也比喻文笔或乐曲气势奔放。也形容价格猛跌不止。
explanationTraditional: 瀉水往下直注。形容江河奔流直下，流得又快又遠。也比喻文筆或樂曲氣勢奔放。也形容價格猛跌不止。
explanationEn: Rushing down a thousand miles; describes a river flowing swiftly and far. Also metaphor for powerful writing or music, or a sharp price drop.
derivation: 唐·李白《赠从弟宣州长史昭》诗长川豁中流，千里泻吴会。”宋·陈亮《与辛幼安殿撰书》大江在河，一泻千里。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《贈從弟宣州長史昭》詩長川豁中流，千里瀉吳會。”宋·陳亮《與辛幼安殿撰書》大江在河，一瀉千里。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li Bai's poem 'To My Cousin': 'The long river opens in midstream, rushing a thousand miles to Wu.' Song Dynasty Chen Liang's letter: 'The great river flows, rushing a thousand miles.'
example: 方希直如奔流滔滔，～，而潆洄滉瀥之状颇少。（明·王世贞《文评》）
exampleTraditional: 方希直如奔流滔滔，～，而瀠洄滉瀥之狀頗少。（明·王世貞《文評》）
exampleEn: Fang Xiaoru's writing is like a surging torrent, rushing a thousand miles, but lacks twists and turns. — Ming Dynasty Wang Shizhen's 'Literary Criticism'

explanation: 形容态度十分恭敬。
explanationTraditional: 形容態度十分恭敬。
explanationEn: Extremely respectful and deferential.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·小弁》维桑与梓，必恭敬止，靡瞻匪父，靡依匪母。”郭沫若《洪波曲》第十章五军长为李玉堂，一山东大汉，抵军部时，在门外相迎，毕恭毕敬。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·小弁》維桑與梓，必恭敬止，靡瞻匪父，靡依匪母。”郭沫若《洪波曲》第十章五軍長為李玉堂，一山東大漢，抵軍部時，在門外相迎，畢恭畢敬。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Xiaopan': 'Toward the mulberry and catalpa, one must be respectful.' Guo Moruo's 'Hongbo Qu' Chapter 10: 'The army commander Li Yutang, a Shandong man, greeted me at the gate with utmost respect.'
example: ［韩老六］对于穷人的～的招呼从不理睬，而对于有钱的人，有说有笑。★周立波《暴风骤雨》第一部二
exampleTraditional: ［韓老六］對於窮人的～的招呼從不理睬，而對於有錢的人，有說有笑。★周立波《暴風驟雨》第一部二
exampleEn: Han Laoliu never responded to the respectful greetings of the poor, but chatted and laughed with the rich. — Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane' Part 1, Chapter 2

explanation: 得意称心如意；门生亲授业的弟子或科举中试者对座师的自称◇泛指学生。最满意的弟子或学生。
explanationTraditional: 得意稱心如意；門生親授業的弟子或科舉中試者對座師的自稱◇泛指學生。最滿意的弟子或學生。
explanationEn: A favorite student or disciple, one who is most satisfactory and cherished by the teacher.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二回他虽然和咱们满州汉军隔旗，却是我第一个得意门生，他待我也实在亲热，那个人将来不可限量。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二回他雖然和咱們滿州漢軍隔旗，卻是我第一個得意門生，他待我也實在親熱，那個人將來不可限量。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 2: 'Although he is from a different banner than our Manchu Han army, he is my first favorite student. He treats me with great warmth, and his future is limitless.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 零碎的，少量的。形容零散而不完整。
explanationTraditional: 零碎的，少量的。形容零散而不完整。
explanationEn: Scattered and fragmentary; in small amounts or bits.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 荣华草木开花，比喻兴盛或显达。形容有钱有势。
explanationTraditional: 榮華草木開花，比喻興盛或顯達。形容有錢有勢。
explanationEn: Wealth and honor; high position and great wealth.
derivation: 《管子·重令》而群臣必通外请谒，取权道，行事便辟，以贵富为荣华以相稚也，谓之逆。”汉·王符《潜夫论·论荣》所谓贤人君子者，非必高位厚禄富贵荣华之谓也。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·重令》而群臣必通外請謁，取權道，行事便辟，以貴富為榮華以相稚也，謂之逆。”漢·王符《潛夫論·論榮》所謂賢人君子者，非必高位厚祿富貴榮華之謂也。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Chongling' and Han Dynasty, Wang Fu's 'Qianfu Lun: On Honor': 'What are called worthy gentlemen are not necessarily those with high positions and great wealth.'
example: 话说人生～，眼前的多是空花，不可认为实相。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》二十二
exampleTraditional: 話說人生～，眼前的多是空花，不可認為實相。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》二十二
exampleEn: As the saying goes, the glory and wealth in life are often like flowers in a mirror, not to be taken as reality. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'First Slap of the Table'

explanation: 极顶点；反向反面转化。事物发展到极点，会向相反方向转化。
explanationTraditional: 極頂點；反向反面轉化。事物發展到極點，會向相反方向轉化。
explanationEn: When a thing reaches its extreme, it turns into its opposite.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·博志》全则必缺，极则必反。”《鹖冠子·环流》物极则反，命曰环流。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·博志》全則必缺，極則必反。”《鶡冠子·環流》物極則反，命曰環流。”
derivationEn: From 'Lüshi Chunqiu: Bozhi' and 'He Guanzi: Huanliu': 'When completeness is reached, deficiency follows; when the extreme is reached, reversal occurs.'
example: ～”，错误成了堆，光明就会到来。★毛泽东《我们党的一些历史经验》
exampleTraditional: ～”，錯誤成了堆，光明就會到來。★毛澤東《我們黨的一些歷史經驗》
exampleEn: When errors pile up, light will come. — Mao Zedong, 'Some Experiences in Our Party's History'

explanation: 只是微笑着，不作正面回答。
explanationTraditional: 只是微笑著，不作正面回答。
explanationEn: To smile without answering; to give no direct reply.
derivation: 唐·李白《山中问答》诗问余何意栖碧山，笑而不答心自闲。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《山中問答》詩問餘何意棲碧山，笑而不答心自閒。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Bai's poem 'Question and Answer in the Mountains': 'You ask why I dwell in the green mountains; I smile without answering, my heart at ease.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 宁愿死也不屈服。
explanationTraditional: 寧願死也不屈服。
explanationEn: Rather die than submit; to prefer death over surrender.
derivation: 明·赵弼《宋进士袁镛忠义传》以大义拒敌，宁死不屈，竟燎身于烈焰中。”
derivationTraditional: 明·趙弼《宋進士袁鏞忠義傳》以大義拒敵，寧死不屈，竟燎身於烈焰中。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Zhao Bi's 'Biography of Song Jinshi Yuan Yong': 'He resisted the enemy with great righteousness, preferring death over surrender, and finally perished in the flames.'
example: 许大马棒转回身，提着枪，恶狠狠地瞅着～工作队的同志们。★曲波《林海雪原》二
exampleTraditional: 許大馬棒轉回身，提著槍，惡狠狠地瞅著～工作隊的同志們。★曲波《林海雪原》二
exampleEn: Xu Dama stick turned back, raised his gun, and glared fiercely at the comrades of the work team who would rather die than surrender. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest'

explanation: 理处理，办理；万机种种事务。形容政务繁忙，工作辛苦。
explanationTraditional: 理處理，辦理；萬機種種事務。形容政務繁忙，工作辛苦。
explanationEn: To handle myriad affairs daily; to be busy with state affairs.
derivation: 《尚书·皋陶谟》兢兢业业，一日二日万机。”《汉书·百官公卿表上》相国、丞相，皆秦官，金印紫绶，掌丞天子助理万机。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·皋陶謨》兢兢業業，一日二日萬機。”《漢書·百官公卿表上》相國、丞相，皆秦官，金印紫綬，掌丞天子助理萬機。”
derivationEn: From 'Shangshu: Gaoyao Mo' and 'Hanshu: Table of Hundred Officials': 'Be cautious and diligent, handling affairs day after day.'
example: 建国以后，我们敬爱的周总理～，夜以继日，成年很少有休息的机会。★余敏《深情忆念周伯伯》
exampleTraditional: 建國以後，我們敬愛的周總理～，夜以繼日，成年很少有休息的機會。★餘敏《深情憶念周伯伯》
exampleEn: After the founding of the nation, our beloved Premier Zhou handled myriad affairs daily, working day and night, with few opportunities for rest. — Yu Min, 'Deeply Remembering Uncle Zhou'

explanation: 这也怀疑，那也怀疑。形容非常多疑。
explanationTraditional: 這也懷疑，那也懷疑。形容非常多疑。
explanationEn: To be suspicious of everything; to be overly paranoid.
derivation: 鲁迅《准风月谈·前记》然而这么一来，却又使一些看文字不用视觉，专靠嗅觉的‘文学家’疑神疑鬼。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《準風月談·前記》然而這麼一來，卻又使一些看文字不用視覺，專靠嗅覺的‘文學家’疑神疑鬼。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Quasi Fengyue Tan: Preface': 'However, this made some 'literati' who read with their noses instead of their eyes become suspicious of everything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 成竹现成完整的竹子。画竹前竹的全貌已在胸中。比喻在做事之前已经拿定主义。
explanationTraditional: 成竹現成完整的竹子。畫竹前竹的全貌已在胸中。比喻在做事之前已經拿定主義。
explanationEn: To have a well-thought-out plan or idea in mind before taking action.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《文与可画筼箉谷偃竹记》故画竹，必先得成竹于胸中。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《文與可畫篔箉谷偃竹記》故畫竹，必先得成竹於胸中。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'On Wen Yuke's Painting of Bamboo': 'When painting bamboo, one must first have the complete bamboo in mind.'
example: 他回答老师的问题从容不迫，～。
exampleTraditional: 他回答老師的問題從容不迫，～。
exampleEn: He answered the teacher's questions calmly and confidently, having a well-thought-out plan in mind.

explanation: 颠跌；扑敲。无论怎样摔打都破不了。比喻理论学说完全正确，不会被驳倒推翻。
explanationTraditional: 顛跌；撲敲。無論怎樣摔打都破不了。比喻理論學說完全正確，不會被駁倒推翻。
explanationEn: Unbreakable; irrefutable; a theory or truth that cannot be overthrown.
derivation: 《朱子全书·性理三》既能体之而乐，则亦不患不能守，须如此而言，方是颠扑不破，绝渗漏，无曹耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子全書·性理三》既能體之而樂，則亦不患不能守，須如此而言，方是顛撲不破，絕滲漏，無曹耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Zi Quan Shu: Xing Li': 'If one can experience it and find joy, then one need not worry about not being able to uphold it. This is an unbreakable truth, without any flaw.'
example: 何况六斤比伊的的曾祖，少了三斤，比伊的父亲七斤，又少了一斤，这真是一条～的实例。★鲁迅《呐喊·风波》
exampleTraditional: 何況六斤比伊的的曾祖，少了三斤，比伊的父親七斤，又少了一斤，這真是一條～的實例。★魯迅《吶喊·風波》
exampleEn: Moreover, Six Jin was three jin lighter than her great-grandfather and one jin lighter than her father Seven Jin. This was truly an irrefutable example. — Lu Xun, 'The True Story of Ah Q'

explanation: 宗宗族；祖祖先。指子孙做了官出了名，使祖先和家族都荣耀。
explanationTraditional: 宗宗族；祖祖先。指子孫做了官出了名，使祖先和家族都榮耀。
explanationEn: To bring honor to one's ancestors and family, typically by achieving success or high status.
derivation: 元·石君宝《曲江池》第四折今幸得一举登科，荣宗耀祖。”
derivationTraditional: 元·石君寶《曲江池》第四折今幸得一舉登科，榮宗耀祖。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'Qujiang Pool' by Shi Junbao: 'Now fortunate to pass the imperial exam, bringing glory to ancestors and clan.'
example: 儿子管他，也为的是光宗耀祖。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 兒子管他，也為的是光宗耀祖。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十三回
exampleEn: His son managed him, also for the sake of bringing glory to his ancestors. (from Dream of the Red Chamber by Cao Xueqin, Chapter 33)

explanation: 精心细致地雕刻。形容创作艺术品时的苦心刻画。也比喻认真细致地加工。
explanationTraditional: 精心細緻地雕刻。形容創作藝術品時的苦心刻畫。也比喻認真細緻地加工。
explanationEn: To carve or sculpt with meticulous care; to work on something with great attention to detail.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这个贝雕画确实是精雕细刻。
exampleTraditional: 這個貝雕畫確實是精雕細刻。
exampleEn: This shell carving is indeed meticulously crafted.

explanation: 不轨越出常轨，不守法度。谋划越出常规、法度之事。
explanationTraditional: 不軌越出常軌，不守法度。謀劃越出常規、法度之事。
explanationEn: To plot something illegal or rebellious; to conspire against the law or authority.
derivation: 《晋书·王彬传》兄抗旌犯顺，杀戮忠良，谋图不轨，祸及门户。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王彬傳》兄抗旌犯順，殺戮忠良，謀圖不軌，禍及門戶。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Wang Bin': 'Brother raised a banner against the emperor, killed loyal officials, plotted rebellion, bringing disaster to the family.'
example: 你们给我们来的公函，说我们～……我们此行纯为爱国而来，绝无越轨行为。★杨沫《青春之歌》第七章
exampleTraditional: 你們給我們來的公函，說我們～……我們此行純為愛國而來，絕無越軌行為。★楊沫《青春之歌》第七章
exampleEn: The official letter you sent us accused us of plotting rebellion... Our trip is purely patriotic, with no illegal behavior. (from Song of Youth by Yang Mo, Chapter 7)

explanation: 耿耿忠诚的样子。形容非常忠诚。
explanationTraditional: 耿耿忠誠的樣子。形容非常忠誠。
explanationEn: Loyal and devoted; extremely faithful and dedicated.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十七回当日令尊伯伯为国损躯，虽大事未成，然忠心耿耿，自能名垂不朽。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十七回當日令尊伯伯為國損軀，雖大事未成，然忠心耿耿，自能名垂不朽。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'Flowers in the Mirror' by Li Ruzhen, Chapter 57: 'Your father sacrificed for the country; though the great cause failed, his loyalty shines forever.'
example: 卢永祥见一个～的陈乐山忽然变了样子，还不晓是何缘故，十分诧异。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一五八回
exampleTraditional: 盧永祥見一個～的陳樂山忽然變了樣子，還不曉是何緣故，十分詫異。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一五八回
exampleEn: Lu Yongxiang saw that his utterly loyal Chen Leshan had suddenly changed, and was greatly puzzled. (from Popular Romance of the Republic by Cai Dongfan and Xu Xufu, Chapter 158)

explanation: 反唇回嘴、顶嘴。受到指责不服气，反过来讥讽对方。
explanationTraditional: 反唇回嘴、頂嘴。受到指責不服氣，反過來譏諷對方。
explanationEn: To retort sarcastically or counterattack verbally when criticized.
derivation: 《汉书·贾谊传》妇姑不相说（悦），则反唇而相稽。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·賈誼傳》婦姑不相說（悅），則反唇而相稽。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Jia Yi': 'If mother-in-law and daughter-in-law are not pleased, they retort and argue.'
example: 济渡满不买帐，～皇上信得过我，干您哪一条？”★华而实《汉衣冠》七
exampleTraditional: 濟渡滿不買帳，～皇上信得過我，幹您哪一條？”★華而實《漢衣冠》七
exampleEn: Ji Duman refused to accept the criticism and retorted, 'The emperor trusts me, what business is it of yours?' (from Han Yiguan by Hua Ershi, Chapter 7)

explanation: 由衰老恢复青春。形容老年人充满了活力。
explanationTraditional: 由衰老恢復青春。形容老年人充滿了活力。
explanationEn: To regain youth from old age; to become young again, often describing elderly people full of vitality.
derivation: 汉·史游《急就篇》长乐无极老复丁。”《旧唐书·宦官书》可愈痿弱重膇之疾，复能返老还童。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·史游《急就篇》長樂無極老復丁。”《舊唐書·宦官書》可愈痿弱重膇之疾，復能返老還童。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty 'Jijiu Chapter' by Shi You: 'Eternal joy without end, old age returns to youth.' Also from 'Old Book of Tang: Eunuch Biography': 'Can cure weakness and heavy leg diseases, and restore youth.'
example: ～容易得，超凡入圣路非遥。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第一百五回
exampleTraditional: ～容易得，超凡入聖路非遙。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第一百五回
exampleEn: Regaining youth is easy, but attaining immortality is not. (from Journey to the West by Wu Cheng'en, Chapter 105)

explanation: 双方对立，彼此相持，不肯让步。
explanationTraditional: 雙方對立，彼此相持，不肯讓步。
explanationEn: To be locked in a stalemate; both sides hold their ground without yielding.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》楚汉久相持未决，丁壮苦军旅，老弱罢（疲）转漕。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》楚漢久相持未決，丁壯苦軍旅，老弱罷（疲）轉漕。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'Chu and Han were locked in a long stalemate, with soldiers suffering and the old and weak exhausted from transport.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 既有钱财，又有势力。
explanationTraditional: 既有錢財，又有勢力。
explanationEn: To have both wealth and power; rich and influential.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十九回毛太公那厮，有钱有势。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十九回毛太公那廝，有錢有勢。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty novel 'Water Margin' by Shi Nai'an, Chapter 49: 'That Mao Taigong is rich and powerful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 哀鸿哀鸣的鸿雁。比喻啼饥号寒的灾民。比喻在天灾人祸中到处都是流离失所、呻吟呼号的饥民。
explanationTraditional: 哀鴻哀鳴的鴻雁。比喻啼飢號寒的災民。比喻在天災人禍中到處都是流離失所、呻吟呼號的饑民。
explanationEn: A land filled with starving and homeless people; widespread suffering and misery due to disasters or war.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·鸿雁》鸿雁于飞，哀鸣嗷嗷。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·鴻雁》鴻雁于飛，哀鳴嗷嗷。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Hongyan': 'Wild geese in flight, crying mournfully.'
example: 我记得历史上的罗马何等殷阗繁盛，怎么今日却是～，春燕无归，满眼凄惶。★清·梁启超《新罗马》
exampleTraditional: 我記得歷史上的羅馬何等殷闐繁盛，怎麼今日卻是～，春燕無歸，滿眼悽惶。★清·梁啟超《新羅馬》
exampleEn: I recall how prosperous Rome was in history, yet now it is filled with wailing refugees and desolation. (from New Rome by Liang Qichao, Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 一种花独自开放。与百花齐放”相对，常比喻缺少各种不同形式、风格的艺术作品。
explanationTraditional: 一種花獨自開放。與百花齊放”相對，常比喻缺少各種不同形式、風格的藝術作品。
explanationEn: A single flower blooming alone; metaphor for a lack of diversity, especially in art or culture, as opposed to 'a hundred flowers blooming'.
derivation: 姚荣铨《无边秋色入画图》人民的审美要求多种多样，只有一个画种，那么就没有万紫千红，只有一花独放了。”
derivationTraditional: 姚榮銓《無邊秋色入畫圖》人民的審美要求多種多樣，只有一個畫種，那麼就沒有萬紫千紅，只有一花獨放了。”
derivationEn: From Yao Rongquan's 'Boundless Autumn Scenery in Paintings': 'People's aesthetic needs are diverse; if there is only one type of painting, then there is no variety, only a single flower blooming.'
example: ～红一点，百花盛开春满园。★京剧《龙江颂》
exampleTraditional: ～紅一點，百花盛開春滿園。★京劇《龍江頌》
exampleEn: A single flower blooming makes a red spot; a hundred flowers blooming bring spring to the garden. (from Peking Opera 'Longjiang Song')

explanation: 中伤攻击和陷害别人。制造谣言，陷害别人。
explanationTraditional: 中傷攻擊和陷害別人。製造謠言，陷害別人。
explanationEn: To spread rumors and slander others, harming and framing them.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这人品质恶劣，对别人惯会造谣中伤。
exampleTraditional: 這人品質惡劣，對別人慣會造謠中傷。
exampleEn: This person has a bad character and is used to spreading rumors and slandering others.

explanation: 意思是设伏兵于十面以围歼敌军。
explanationTraditional: 意思是設伏兵於十面以圍殲敵軍。
explanationEn: To set up ambushes on all sides to surround and annihilate the enemy.
derivation: 元·无名氏《抱妆盒》第二折从今后跳出了九重围子连环寨，脱离了十面埋伏大会垓。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《抱妝盒》第二折從今後跳出了九重圍子連環寨，脫離了十面埋伏大會垓。”
derivationEn: From the second act of 'The Story of the Jade Box' by an anonymous Yuan dynasty author: 'From now on, I have escaped the nine-layered siege and the chain camp, and have broken free from the ten-sided ambush and the great encirclement.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 飞扬放纵；跋扈蛮横。原指意态狂豪，不爱约束。现多形容骄横放肆，目中无人。
explanationTraditional: 飛揚放縱；跋扈蠻橫。原指意態狂豪，不愛約束。現多形容驕橫放肆，目中無人。
explanationEn: Originally meant to be unrestrained and arrogant; now describes someone who is domineering, reckless, and looks down on others.
derivation: 《北史·齐高祖纪》景专制河南十四年矣，常有飞扬跋扈志。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·齊高祖紀》景專制河南十四年矣，常有飛揚跋扈志。”
derivationEn: From 'The Northern History: Biography of Emperor Gao of Qi': 'Jing has ruled Henan for fourteen years and has always had a domineering ambition.'
example: 痛饮狂歌空度日，～为谁雄？★唐·杜甫《赠李白》诗
exampleTraditional: 痛飲狂歌空度日，～為誰雄？★唐·杜甫《贈李白》詩
exampleEn: Drinking wildly and singing madly, wasting days in vain; for whom is this arrogance and domineering? — from Du Fu's poem 'To Li Bai'

explanation: 咎责怪。原指已经做完或做过的事，就不必再责怪了。现指对以往的过错不再责备。
explanationTraditional: 咎責怪。原指已經做完或做過的事，就不必再責怪了。現指對以往的過錯不再責備。
explanationEn: To not blame someone for past mistakes; to forgive past offenses.
derivation: 《论语·八佾》成事不说，逐事不谏，既往不咎。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·八佾》成事不說，逐事不諫，既往不咎。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Ba Yi': 'Things that are done, do not discuss; things that are past, do not criticize; things that are over, do not blame.'
example: ～，以后再办起事来，审慎点就是了。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第十三回
exampleTraditional: ～，以後再辦起事來，審慎點就是了。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第十三回
exampleEn: Let bygones be bygones; just be more careful in the future. — from Wu Jianren's 'A Tale of Pain' Chapter 13

explanation: 形容以零零碎碎、断断续续的方式进行或处理。
explanationTraditional: 形容以零零碎碎、斷斷續續的方式進行或處理。
explanationEn: To do something in a piecemeal, intermittent, or fragmented manner.
derivation: 毛泽东《的序言一》没有一省一县一区一乡的完整的规划，只是零敲碎打地在那里做。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《的序言一》沒有一省一縣一區一鄉的完整的規劃，只是零敲碎打地在那裡做。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Preface to 'The Socialist Upsurge in China's Countryside'': 'Without a complete plan for a province, a county, a district, or a township, they just work in a piecemeal way.'
example: 我算了算，加上一次～的开销，数目不会小呵！★沙汀《淘金记》
exampleTraditional: 我算了算，加上一次～的開銷，數目不會小呵！★沙汀《淘金記》
exampleEn: I calculated that, including the piecemeal expenses, the total amount would not be small! — from Sha Ting's 'Gold Rush'

explanation: 一天能收进一斗黄金。形容发大财。
explanationTraditional: 一天能收進一斗黃金。形容發大財。
explanationEn: To earn a fortune daily; to make a lot of money.
derivation: 《胡雪岩》这个职位，一望而知是日进斗金的好差使。”
derivationTraditional: 《胡雪巖》這個職位，一望而知是日進斗金的好差使。”
derivationEn: From 'Hu Xueyan': 'This position is obviously a lucrative job that brings in a fortune every day.'
example: 我们希望能有～的好差使。
exampleTraditional: 我們希望能有～的好差使。
exampleEn: We hope to have a lucrative job that brings in a fortune every day.

explanation: 争争夺；强优胜；好喜爱。争为强者，事事处处都喜欢超过和压倒别人。
explanationTraditional: 爭爭奪；強優勝；好喜愛。爭為強者，事事處處都喜歡超過和壓倒別人。
explanationEn: To strive to be the best and to surpass others in everything.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第35回任是争强好胜的，偏逢用违所长。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第35回任是爭強好勝的，偏逢用違所長。”
derivationEn: From Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines' Chapter 35: 'Even those who are competitive and eager to excel may find themselves in unsuitable roles.'
example: 个人的～，狗屁不值。★杨朔《北线》
exampleTraditional: 個人的～，狗屁不值。★楊朔《北線》
exampleEn: Personal competitiveness and desire to excel are worthless. — from Yang Shuo's 'Northern Front'

explanation: 尔你；虞、诈欺骗。表示彼此互相欺骗。
explanationTraditional: 爾你；虞、詐欺騙。表示彼此互相欺騙。
explanationEn: Each trying to cheat or outwit the other; mutual deception.
derivation: 《左传·宣公十五年》我无尔诈，尔无我虞。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公十五年》我無爾詐，爾無我虞。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The Fifteenth Year of Duke Xuan': 'I will not deceive you, and you should not deceive me.'
example: 国内，南方各会党首领之间，也是互相猜忌，勾心斗角，～，售价烦恼。（任光春《戊戌喋血记》第十七章）
exampleTraditional: 國內，南方各會黨首領之間，也是互相猜忌，勾心鬥角，～，售價煩惱。（任光春《戊戌喋血記》第十七章）
exampleEn: Domestically, the leaders of various southern guilds were suspicious of each other, scheming, and deceiving one another, causing much trouble. — from Ren Guangchun's 'The Bloody Incident of 1898' Chapter 17

explanation: 指共过患难的人或彼此处于同样困境的人。
explanationTraditional: 指共過患難的人或彼此處於同樣困境的人。
explanationEn: People who have shared hardships or are in similar difficult situations.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 其以半殖民地的风貌出现于世界也，和我们实在是～。（郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年续编》）
exampleTraditional: 其以半殖民地的風貌出現於世界也，和我們實在是～。（郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年續編》）
exampleEn: Its appearance in the world as a semi-colonial country makes it truly a fellow sufferer with us. — from Guo Moruo's 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: A Sequel to Ten Years of Creation'

explanation: 喜欢新的，厌弃旧的。多指爱情不专一。
explanationTraditional: 喜歡新的，厭棄舊的。多指愛情不專一。
explanationEn: To like the new and dislike the old; often refers to being fickle in love.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这种见异思迁、喜新厌旧的不道德行为，应当受到全社会的遣责。
exampleTraditional: 這種見異思遷、喜新厭舊的不道德行為，應當受到全社會的遣責。
exampleEn: Such immoral behavior of being fickle and liking the new while disliking the old should be condemned by the whole society.

explanation: 变坏事为好事。
explanationTraditional: 變壞事為好事。
explanationEn: To turn misfortune into a blessing; to get good out of bad.
derivation: 《史记·管晏列传》其为政也，善因祸为福，转败为功。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·管晏列傳》其為政也，善因禍為福，轉敗為功。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Guan and Yan': 'In governing, he was good at turning misfortune into fortune and defeat into success.'
example: 伯翁，你说我误事不误事，如今不是～吗？★清·姬文《市声》第六回
exampleTraditional: 伯翁，你說我誤事不誤事，如今不是～嗎？★清·姬文《市聲》第六回
exampleEn: Uncle Bo, you say I messed things up, but now isn't it turning misfortune into a blessing? (from Qing Dynasty Ji Wen's 'City Sounds', Chapter 6)

explanation: 暇空闲。光顾自己还来不及。指没有力量再照顾别人。
explanationTraditional: 暇空閒。光顧自己還來不及。指沒有力量再照顧別人。
explanationEn: Unable to take care of oneself, let alone others; too busy to attend to others.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十回今虽略有生机，但自顾不暇，何能另有安顿哥哥之处。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十回今雖略有生機，但自顧不暇，何能另有安頓哥哥之處。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 60: 'Now although there is a slight chance of survival, I am too busy to take care of myself, how can I find a place for you, brother?'
example: 其以满洲为可倚赖乎？彼～，何有于汉人。★清·陈天华《狮子吼》第七回
exampleTraditional: 其以滿洲為可倚賴乎？彼～，何有於漢人。★清·陳天華《獅子吼》第七回
exampleEn: Can the Manchus be relied upon? They are too busy with themselves, what do they care about the Han? (from Qing Dynasty Chen Tianhua's 'Lion's Roar', Chapter 7)

explanation: 筹筹码，古代用以计数的工具，多用竹子制成。比较起来，稍微好一些。
explanationTraditional: 籌籌碼，古代用以計數的工具，多用竹子製成。比較起來，稍微好一些。
explanationEn: Slightly better; a notch above.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·辛十四娘》小生所以忝出君上者，以起处数语，略高一筹耳。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·辛十四娘》小生所以忝出君上者，以起處數語，略高一籌耳。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Xin Shisi Niang': 'The reason I am slightly above you is due to a few phrases at the beginning.'
example: 这时，只要不是下等签，他就会感到一些满足，何况这比中下”还～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十九章
exampleTraditional: 這時，只要不是下等籤，他就會感到一些滿足，何況這比中下”還～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十九章
exampleEn: At this time, as long as it was not a bad lot, he would feel some satisfaction, especially since this was slightly better than 'below average'. (from Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 19)

explanation: 这件事性质重要，关系重大。
explanationTraditional: 這件事性質重要，關係重大。
explanationEn: This matter is of great importance; it is a significant affair.
derivation: 汉·班固《典引》兹事体大而允，寤寐次于圣心。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·班固《典引》茲事體大而允，寤寐次於聖心。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Ban Gu's 'Dian Yin': 'This matter is indeed great and proper, and it occupies the emperor's mind day and night.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容名气很大。
explanationTraditional: 形容名氣很大。
explanationEn: Very famous; renowned; of great reputation.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十四回你一到京打听人家，像他这样大名鼎鼎，还怕有不晓得的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十四回你一到京打聽人家，像他這樣大名鼎鼎，還怕有不曉得的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 24: 'When you arrive in the capital and inquire about people, with such a great reputation, how could you not know him?'
example: 为我们讲经学的一位～的成都名士只拿着一本《左传事纬》照本宣科。★郭沫若《少年时代·反正前后》
exampleTraditional: 為我們講經學的一位～的成都名士只拿著一本《左傳事緯》照本宣科。★郭沫若《少年時代·反正前後》
exampleEn: The famous Chengdu scholar who taught us classics only read from 'Zuo Zhuan Shi Wei' verbatim. (from Guo Moruo's 'Youth: Before and After the Revolution')

explanation: 胜尽。列举也列举不完。形容数量很多。
explanationTraditional: 勝盡。列舉也列舉不完。形容數量很多。
explanationEn: Too numerous to mention; countless.
derivation: 鲁迅《伪自由书·后记》引谷春帆《谈文人先行”》公开告密，卖友求荣，卖身投靠的勾当，举不胜举。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《偽自由書·後記》引谷春帆《談文人先行”》公開告密，賣友求榮，賣身投靠的勾當，舉不勝舉。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Pseudo-Free Book: Postscript' quoting Gu Chunfan's 'On Literati's Advance': 'Acts of public denunciation, betrayal for personal gain, and selling out are too numerous to mention.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 当应该；益更加；壮雄壮。年纪虽老而志气更旺盛，干劲更足。
explanationTraditional: 當應該；益更加；壯雄壯。年紀雖老而志氣更旺盛，幹勁更足。
explanationEn: Old but vigorous; more energetic with age.
derivation: 《后汉书·马援传》丈夫为志，穷当益坚，老当益壮。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·馬援傳》丈夫為志，窮當益堅，老當益壯。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Ma Yuan': 'A man's ambition should be firmer in poverty and stronger in old age.'
example: 剑波朝着这两位坚守职务的老森铁员工，伸了一下大拇指头，真英雄，～。”★曲波《林海雪原》一六
exampleTraditional: 劍波朝著這兩位堅守職務的老森鐵員工，伸了一下大拇指頭，真英雄，～。”★曲波《林海雪原》一六
exampleEn: Jianbo gave a thumbs-up to the two old forest railway workers who stuck to their posts: 'True heroes, old but vigorous!' (from Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 16)

explanation: 指财物等身体以外的东西，表示无足轻重的意思。
explanationTraditional: 指財物等身體以外的東西，表示無足輕重的意思。
explanationEn: External possessions; things that are not essential to one's being.
derivation: 元·蒋子正《山房随笔》引刘改之（过）诗拔毫已付管城子，烂首曾封关内候。死后不知身外物，也随尊酒伴风流。”
derivationTraditional: 元·蔣子正《山房隨筆》引劉改之（過）詩拔毫已付管城子，爛首曾封關內候。死後不知身外物，也隨尊酒伴風流。”
