derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Jiang Zizheng's 'Mountain House Essays' quoting Liu Gaizhi's poem: 'The brush has been used, the head is sealed as a marquis; after death, external possessions are nothing, they accompany wine and romance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伶仃孤独，没有依靠。孤单困苦，没有依靠。
explanationTraditional: 伶仃孤獨，沒有依靠。孤單困苦，沒有依靠。
explanationEn: Orphaned and helpless; lonely and miserable.
derivation: 晋·李密《陈情表》臣少多疾病，九岁不行。零丁孤苦，至于成立。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·李密《陳情表》臣少多疾病，九歲不行。零丁孤苦，至於成立。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Li Mi's 'Chen Qing Biao': 'I was often ill as a child, unable to walk at nine. Orphaned and helpless until I grew up.'
example: 头里有老太太，到底还疼我些；如今也死了，留下我～，如何了局？★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一一二回
exampleTraditional: 頭裡有老太太，到底還疼我些；如今也死了，留下我～，如何了局？★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一一二回
exampleEn: In the past, with the old lady, I was at least pitied; now she is dead, leaving me lonely and helpless. What will become of me? (from Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 112)

explanation: 量估量。按照自己力量的大小去做，不要勉强。
explanationTraditional: 量估量。按照自己力量的大小去做，不要勉強。
explanationEn: To act according to one's ability; to do what one is capable of.
derivation: 《左传·昭公十五年》力能则进，否则退，量力而行。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公十五年》力能則進，否則退，量力而行。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Zhao's 15th Year': 'If one's strength allows, advance; if not, retreat. Act according to one's ability.'
example: 法物所须，各以差降，士民之类，可～之。（宋·张君房《云笈七签》卷一○三卷）
exampleTraditional: 法物所須，各以差降，士民之類，可～之。（宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》卷一○三卷）
exampleEn: The required ritual objects should be graded according to rank; commoners can act according to their ability. (from Song Dynasty Zhang Junfang's 'Yun Ji Qi Qian', Volume 103)

explanation: 飒爽豪迈矫健；英姿英勇威武的姿态。形容英俊威武、精神焕发的样子。
explanationTraditional: 颯爽豪邁矯健；英姿英勇威武的姿態。形容英俊威武、精神煥發的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes a person who is handsome, valiant, and spirited.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《丹青引赠曹将军霸》褒公鄂公毛发动，英姿飒爽来酣战。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《丹青引贈曹將軍霸》褒公鄂公毛髮動，英姿颯爽來酣戰。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Dan Qing Yin' in Tang Dynasty: 'The hairs of Duke Bao and Duke E move, their heroic and spirited postures come to fight fiercely.'
example: ～五尺枪，曙光初照演兵场。中华儿女多奇志，不爱红装爱武装。★毛泽东《为女民兵题照》诗
exampleTraditional: ～五尺槍，曙光初照演兵場。中華兒女多奇志，不愛紅裝愛武裝。★毛澤東《為女民兵題照》詩
exampleEn: With a five-foot rifle, heroic and spirited, the drill ground is bathed in the first light of dawn. Chinese daughters have extraordinary aspirations, they love military uniforms rather than red dresses. — Mao Zedong's poem 'Inscription for Female Militia'

explanation: 性情直爽，有话就说。
explanationTraditional: 性情直爽，有話就說。
explanationEn: Straightforward and outspoken; says what one thinks without hesitation.
derivation: 元·张国宾《罗李郎》第四折哥哥是心直口快射粮军，哥哥是好人。”
derivationTraditional: 元·張國賓《羅李郎》第四折哥哥是心直口快射糧軍，哥哥是好人。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'Luo Li Lang' by Zhang Guobin, Act 4: 'Brother is a straightforward and outspoken soldier, a good man.'
example: 这是一个～，喜欢吵吵闹闹的人。★沙汀《磁力》
exampleTraditional: 這是一個～，喜歡吵吵鬧鬧的人。★沙汀《磁力》
exampleEn: He is a straightforward and outspoken person who likes to make a fuss. — Sha Ding's 'Magnetism'

explanation: 象血和肉一样相互联系着。比喻关系十分密切，不可分离。
explanationTraditional: 象血和肉一樣相互聯繫著。比喻關係十分密切，不可分離。
explanationEn: As closely connected as flesh and blood; describes an inseparable relationship.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《雷击王四》趋视之，二百钱乃在其胁下皮内，与血肉相连。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《雷擊王四》趨視之，二百錢乃在其脅下皮內，與血肉相連。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty 'Lei Ji Wang Si' by Hong Mai: 'Approaching to see, the two hundred coins were under the skin on his ribs, connected with flesh and blood.'
example: 你和党的关系，不能不是这样息息相关，～呵。★闻捷《布沙热，我要为你唱一支歌》
exampleTraditional: 你和黨的關係，不能不是這樣息息相關，～呵。★聞捷《布沙熱，我要為你唱一支歌》
exampleEn: Your relationship with the Party cannot but be so closely linked and inseparable. — Wen Jie's 'Bushare, I Want to Sing a Song for You'

explanation: 叛背叛；离离开。众人反对，亲人背离。形容完全孤立。
explanationTraditional: 叛背叛；離離開。眾人反對，親人背離。形容完全孤立。
explanationEn: Opposed by the masses and deserted by one's followers; completely isolated.
derivation: 《左传·隐公四年》阻兵无众，安忍无亲，众叛亲离，难以济矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公四年》阻兵無眾，安忍無親，眾叛親離，難以濟矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan', Year 4 of Duke Yin: 'Relying on arms leads to no followers, being cruel leads to no relatives; when the masses rebel and relatives leave, it is hard to succeed.'
example: 他坚持与人民为敌，以至～，死无葬身之地。
exampleTraditional: 他堅持與人民為敵，以至～，死無葬身之地。
exampleEn: He persisted in opposing the people, leading to his isolation and a death without a burial place.

explanation: 不惑遇到事情能明辨不疑。以此作为40岁的代称。
explanationTraditional: 不惑遇到事情能明辨不疑。以此作為40歲的代稱。
explanationEn: The age of forty, when one is no longer perplexed and can discern things clearly.
derivation: 《论语·为政》有四十而不惑”的说法。
derivationTraditional: 《論語·為政》有四十而不惑”的說法。
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius', 'Wei Zheng': 'At forty, I had no doubts.'
example: 他大学毕业年仅20，而光阴飞转，很快已近～了。
exampleTraditional: 他大學畢業年僅20，而光陰飛轉，很快已近～了。
exampleEn: He graduated from university at only 20, but time flies, and soon he will be approaching the age of forty.

explanation: 杀鸡给猴子看。比喻用惩罚一个人的办法来警告别的人。
explanationTraditional: 殺雞給猴子看。比喻用懲罰一個人的辦法來警告別的人。
explanationEn: Kill the chicken to warn the monkey; punish someone as a warning to others.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 驱除干净，彻底消灭。比喻残忍狠毒，不留余地。
explanationTraditional: 驅除乾淨，徹底消滅。比喻殘忍狠毒，不留餘地。
explanationEn: Drive out and exterminate completely; be ruthless and leave no room for mercy.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第三十三回黄天禄上马，提枪出营，见余化曰‘匹夫赶尽杀绝，但不知你可有造化受其功禄！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第三十三回黃天祿上馬，提槍出營，見餘化曰‘匹夫趕盡殺絕，但不知你可有造化受其功祿！’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty 'Fengshen Yanyi' by Xu Zhonglin, Chapter 33: 'Huang Tianlu mounted his horse, took his spear, and went out of the camp, saying to Yu Hua: 'You villain, you want to exterminate us completely, but I wonder if you have the fortune to enjoy the reward!''
example: 杀戮是对待他们的最简截的办法，正如同要消灭蝗灾只有去～了蝗虫。★老舍《四世同堂》三十三
exampleTraditional: 殺戮是對待他們的最簡截的辦法，正如同要消滅蝗災只有去～了蝗蟲。★老舍《四世同堂》三十三
exampleEn: Killing is the simplest way to deal with them, just as to eliminate locusts one must exterminate them completely. — Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof', Chapter 33

explanation: 全世界找不到第二个。
explanationTraditional: 全世界找不到第二個。
explanationEn: Unmatched in the world; unique.
derivation: 汉·东方朔《答客难一首》好学乐道之效明白甚矣，自以为智能海内无双，则可谓博闻。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·東方朔《答客難一首》好學樂道之效明白甚矣，自以為智能海內無雙，則可謂博聞。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty 'Answer to a Guest' by Dongfang Shuo: 'The effect of loving learning and enjoying the Way is very clear; I think my intelligence is unmatched within the seas, which can be called extensive knowledge.'
example: 他说善于玩把戏，空前绝后，～，人们从来就没有看见过；一见之后，便即解烦释闷，天下太平。★鲁迅《故事新编·铸剑》
exampleTraditional: 他說善於玩把戲，空前絕後，～，人們從來就沒有看見過；一見之後，便即解煩釋悶，天下太平。★魯迅《故事新編·鑄劍》
exampleEn: He said he was good at performing tricks, unprecedented and unmatched, never seen before; once seen, it would relieve boredom and bring peace to the world. — Lu Xun's 'Old Tales Retold: Forging the Sword'

explanation: 形容困难和危险极多。
explanationTraditional: 形容困難和危險極多。
explanationEn: Countless difficulties and dangers.
derivation: 元·杨景贤《西游记》第五本第四折火焰山千难万险。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊景賢《西遊記》第五本第四折火焰山千難萬險。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty 'Journey to the West' by Yang Jingxian, Act 4, Scene 5: 'The Flaming Mountain has a thousand difficulties and ten thousand dangers.'
example: 他历尽了～终于回到了阔别五十年的老家。
exampleTraditional: 他歷盡了～終於回到了闊別五十年的老家。
exampleEn: He went through countless difficulties and dangers before finally returning to his hometown after fifty years.

explanation: 粟谷子，即小米。大海里的一粒谷子。比喻非常渺小。
explanationTraditional: 粟穀子，即小米。大海里的一粒穀子。比喻非常渺小。
explanationEn: A grain of millet in the vast ocean; describes something extremely small or insignificant.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《前赤壁赋》寄蜉蝣天天地，渺苍海之一粟。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《前赤壁賦》寄蜉蝣天天地，渺蒼海之一粟。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty 'Former Ode to the Red Cliff' by Su Shi: 'Like a mayfly in the vast world, a grain of millet in the boundless ocean.'
example: 我本人只是～，渺小得很。真正伟大的是中国人民，是中国共产党，是中华人民共和国！★钱学森《在授奖仪式上的讲话》
exampleTraditional: 我本人只是～，渺小得很。真正偉大的是中國人民，是中國共產黨，是中華人民共和國！★錢學森《在授獎儀式上的講話》
exampleEn: I myself am just a drop in the ocean, very insignificant. What is truly great are the Chinese people, the Chinese Communist Party, and the People's Republic of China! — Qian Xuesen's speech at the award ceremony

explanation: 形容办事果断，考虑周密。
explanationTraditional: 形容辦事果斷，考慮周密。
explanationEn: Describes someone who is decisive in action but careful in planning.
derivation: 《旧唐书·孙思邈传》胆欲大而心欲小，智欲圆而行欲方。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·孫思邈傳》膽欲大而心欲小，智欲圓而行欲方。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Sun Simiao': 'Be bold in ambition but cautious in mind, wise in strategy but upright in conduct.'
example: 以～勇猛灵活的战斗作风，炸死炸伤了几百名敌人。★峻青《不尽巨涛滚滚来》
exampleTraditional: 以～勇猛靈活的戰鬥作風，炸死炸傷了幾百名敵人。★峻青《不盡巨濤滾滾來》
exampleEn: With a bold but cautious fighting style, they killed or wounded hundreds of enemies. (From Jun Qing's 'Endless Giant Waves Roll In')

explanation: 名字落在榜末孙山的后面。指考试或盐没有录取。
explanationTraditional: 名字落在榜末孫山的後面。指考試或鹽沒有錄取。
explanationEn: To fail an exam or selection; literally, one's name falls behind Sun Shan's on the list.
derivation: 宋·范公偁《过庭录》吴人孙山，滑稽才子也。赴举他郡，乡人讬以子偕往。乡人子失意，山缀榜末，先归。乡人问其子得失，山曰‘解名尽处是孙山，贤郎更在孙山外。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·范公偁《過庭錄》吳人孫山，滑稽才子也。赴舉他郡，鄉人託以子偕往。鄉人子失意，山綴榜末，先歸。鄉人問其子得失，山曰‘解名盡處是孫山，賢郎更在孫山外。’”
derivationEn: From Fan Gongcheng's 'Record of Passing the Court': Sun Shan, a witty scholar, was last on the list. When asked about his companion, he said, 'The last name on the list is Sun Shan; your son is even beyond Sun Shan.'
example: 若不幸～，那时更自难堪。★清·黄小配《大马扁》第一回
exampleTraditional: 若不幸～，那時更自難堪。★清·黃小配《大馬扁》第一回
exampleEn: If unfortunately I fail the exam, it will be even more embarrassing. (From Huang Xiaopei's 'The Big Horse Whip', Chapter 1)

explanation: 形容得意时神气十足的姿态。
explanationTraditional: 形容得意時神氣十足的姿態。
explanationEn: Describes a proud and self-satisfied demeanor.
derivation: 《史记·管晏列传》意气扬扬，甚自得也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·管晏列傳》意氣揚揚，甚自得也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Guan Zhong and Yan Ying': 'With high spirits, he was very self-satisfied.'
example: 一席话说得夏作人～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 一席話說得夏作人～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第五十六回
exampleEn: After hearing this speech, Xia Zuoren was extremely pleased with himself. (From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 56)

explanation: 表面与内在不一样。
explanationTraditional: 表面與內在不一樣。
explanationEn: One's outward appearance does not match one's inner thoughts or character.
derivation: 《逸周书·谥法解》行见中外曰悫。”
derivationTraditional: 《逸周書·諡法解》行見中外曰愨。”
derivationEn: From 'Lost Book of Zhou: Explanation of Posthumous Titles': 'One's conduct seen from both inside and outside is called sincerity.'
example: 我们不能做～的人。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能做～的人。
exampleEn: We should not be people who are inconsistent inside and out.

explanation: 抹角挨墙角绕过。沿着弯弯曲曲的路走。比喻说话绕弯，不直截了当。
explanationTraditional: 抹角挨牆角繞過。沿著彎彎曲曲的路走。比喻說話繞彎，不直截了當。
explanationEn: To speak in a roundabout way, not directly; literally, to go around corners.
derivation: 元·秦简夫《东堂老》第一折转变抹角，可早来到李家门首。”
derivationTraditional: 元·秦簡夫《東堂老》第一折轉變抹角，可早來到李家門首。”
derivationEn: From Yuan drama 'The Eastern Hall Elder' by Qin Jianfu: 'Turning corners, we soon arrived at the Li family's door.'
example: ～，记的土地庙儿，照走过的小巷口，径上碧草轩来。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第八十八回
exampleTraditional: ～，記的土地廟兒，照走過的小巷口，徑上碧草軒來。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第八十八回
exampleEn: Going around corners, remembering the temple, following the alley, they went straight to the Green Vine Studio. (From Li Lüyuan's 'Lamp of the Forked Road', Chapter 88)

explanation: 根据外貌来判别一个的的品质才能。
explanationTraditional: 根據外貌來判別一個的的品質才能。
explanationEn: To judge someone's character or ability based solely on their appearance.
derivation: 《史记·仲尼弟子列传》吾以言取人，失之宰之；以貌取人，失之子羽。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·仲尼弟子列傳》吾以言取人，失之宰之；以貌取人，失之子羽。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Confucius's Disciples': 'I judged people by their words and missed Zai Yu; I judged by appearance and missed Ziyu.'
example: 真是糟糕，他早又不说，但也只怪我们～，在事前没有经过一道甄别了。★郭沫若《涂家埠》
exampleTraditional: 真是糟糕，他早又不說，但也只怪我們～，在事前沒有經過一道甄別了。★郭沫若《塗家埠》
exampleEn: It's too bad he didn't say it earlier, but we can only blame ourselves for judging by appearance without prior screening. (From Guo Moruo's 'Tu Jia Bu')

explanation: 高兴到极点时，发生使人悲伤的事。
explanationTraditional: 高興到極點時，發生使人悲傷的事。
explanationEn: Extreme joy begets sorrow; when happiness reaches its peak, sadness follows.
derivation: 《史记·滑稽列传》酒极则乱，乐极则悲，万事尽然，言不可极，极之而衰。”《淮南子·道应训》夫物盛而衰，乐极则悲。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·滑稽列傳》酒極則亂，樂極則悲，萬事盡然，言不可極，極之而衰。”《淮南子·道應訓》夫物盛而衰，樂極則悲。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Comedians': 'Excessive drinking leads to chaos, extreme joy leads to sorrow.' Also from 'Huainanzi': 'Things flourish then decline, extreme joy then sorrow.'
example: 谁知～，一朝触犯了朝廷，阖门待勘，未知生死。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十七
exampleTraditional: 誰知～，一朝觸犯了朝廷，闔門待勘，未知生死。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十七
exampleEn: Who would have thought that extreme joy would lead to sorrow? Once they offended the court, the whole family was under investigation, life or death unknown. (From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World', Volume 17)

explanation: 疾又快又猛；骤突然而猛烈。形容风雨来势猛。比喻迅猛激烈的斗争。
explanationTraditional: 疾又快又猛；驟突然而猛烈。形容風雨來勢猛。比喻迅猛激烈的鬥爭。
explanationEn: A violent wind and sudden rain; metaphor for a fierce and rapid struggle or change.
derivation: 《淮南子·兵略训》何谓隐之天？大寒甚暑，疾风暴雨，大雾冥晦，因此而为变者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·兵略訓》何謂隱之天？大寒甚暑，疾風暴雨，大霧冥晦，因此而為變者也。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi: Military Strategy': 'What is called hidden weather? Great cold or heat, violent wind and rain, dense fog and darkness, using these to create change.'
example: 十来个妇人，一个个粗脚大手，祼臂揎拳，如～而来。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十四
exampleTraditional: 十來個婦人，一個個粗腳大手，祼臂揎拳，如～而來。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十四
exampleEn: A dozen women, all with big hands and feet, bare arms and fists, came like a violent storm. (From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 34)

explanation: 形容婴儿咿咿呀呀地学大人说话的神情。
explanationTraditional: 形容嬰兒咿咿呀呀地學大人說話的神情。
explanationEn: Describes a baby learning to speak, making babbling sounds.
derivation: 唐·司空图《障车文》二女则牙牙学语，五男则雁雁成行。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·司空圖《障車文》二女則牙牙學語，五男則雁雁成行。”
derivationEn: From Sikong Tu's 'Carriage Blocking Essay' of Tang Dynasty: 'The two daughters are babbling to learn speech, the five sons are in a row like geese.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为了公事而不考虑私事，为了集体利益而不考虑个人得失。
explanationTraditional: 為了公事而不考慮私事，為了集體利益而不考慮個人得失。
explanationEn: To prioritize public affairs over private interests; selfless dedication to the common good.
derivation: 郭沫若《水平线下·到宜兴去》像他这样不折不扣的国而忘家，公而忘私的人，泱泱的中国中，究竟能有几个？”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《水平線下·到宜興去》像他這樣不折不扣的國而忘家，公而忘私的人，泱泱的中國中，究竟能有幾個？”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'To Yixing': 'How many people in this vast China are truly selfless, forgetting family for the country and forgetting private for public?'
example: 这两位同学的破釜沉舟，～的勇气，是使我私心佩服的，★郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年续篇》
exampleTraditional: 這兩位同學的破釜沉舟，～的勇氣，是使我私心佩服的，★郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年續篇》
exampleEn: The courage of these two classmates to burn their boats and be selfless for the public is something I privately admire. (From Guo Moruo's 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: Sequel to Creative Decade')

explanation: 手足比喻兄弟。交情很深，如同兄弟一样。
explanationTraditional: 手足比喻兄弟。交情很深，如同兄弟一樣。
explanationEn: Describes a deep friendship, as close as brothers.
derivation: 唐·李华《吊古战场文》谁无兄弟，如足如手。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李華《弔古戰場文》誰無兄弟，如足如手。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Hua's 'Elegy for the Ancient Battlefield': 'Who has no brothers, like hands and feet.'
example: 名虽各姓，～。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第四十一回
exampleTraditional: 名雖各姓，～。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第四十一回
exampleEn: Though they have different surnames, they are as close as brothers. — Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 41

explanation: 一夜分为五更，三更是午夜十二时。指深夜。
explanationTraditional: 一夜分為五更，三更是午夜十二時。指深夜。
explanationEn: Refers to late night, around midnight.
derivation: 《宋史·赵昌言传》四人者（陈象舆、胡旦、董俨、梁灝）日夕会昌言第。京师为之语曰‘陈三更，董半夜’。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·趙昌言傳》四人者（陳象輿、胡旦、董儼、梁灝）日夕會昌言第。京師為之語曰‘陳三更，董半夜’。”
derivationEn: 'History of Song: Biography of Zhao Changyan': 'Four men (Chen Xiangyu, Hu Dan, Dong Yan, Liang Hao) gathered daily at Changyan's residence. The capital said: 'Chen at the third watch, Dong at midnight.''
example: 他常常工作到～。
exampleTraditional: 他常常工作到～。
exampleEn: He often works until the middle of the night.

explanation: 时间长，日子久。
explanationTraditional: 時間長，日子久。
explanationEn: A long period of time; days and months passing.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十回但只是天长日久，尽着这么闹，可叫人怎么过呢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十回但只是天長日久，盡著這麼鬧，可叫人怎麼過呢。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 20: 'But as time goes on, if we keep making such a fuss, how can we get by?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 际边缘处。形容范围极为广阔。
explanationTraditional: 際邊緣處。形容範圍極為廣闊。
explanationEn: Describes an extremely vast scope, boundless.
derivation: 清·钱采《说岳全传》第66回白茫茫一片无边无际，原来是太湖边上。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢採《說岳全傳》第66回白茫茫一片無邊無際，原來是太湖邊上。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 66: 'A vast white expanse, boundless, turned out to be the edge of Lake Tai.'
example: 山路通过涧上一座毛竹小桥，重又隐没到～的大竹林里了。★《霹雳》
exampleTraditional: 山路通過澗上一座毛竹小橋，重又隱沒到～的大竹林裡了。★《霹靂》
exampleEn: The mountain path crossed a small bamboo bridge over a stream and then disappeared again into the boundless bamboo forest. — 'Pi Li'

explanation: 行尸可以走动的尸体；走肉会走动而没有灵魂的躯壳。比喻不动脑筋，不起作用，糊里糊涂过日子的人。
explanationTraditional: 行屍可以走動的屍體；走肉會走動而沒有靈魂的軀殼。比喻不動腦筋，不起作用，糊里糊塗過日子的人。
explanationEn: A walking corpse; a person who lives without purpose or thought.
derivation: 晋·王嘉《拾遗记》卷六夫人好学，虽死若存；不学者，虽存，谓之行尸走肉耳。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王嘉《拾遺記》卷六夫人好學，雖死若存；不學者，雖存，謂之行屍走肉耳。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Wang Jia's 'Records of Gleanings', Volume 6: 'A person who loves learning, though dead, lives on; one who does not learn, though alive, is called a walking corpse.'
example: 在他们的心目中，任何貌似强大的侵略者，都只不过是一群徒有虚表的～而已。★峻青《不尽巨涛滚滚来》
exampleTraditional: 在他們的心目中，任何貌似強大的侵略者，都只不過是一群徒有虛表的～而已。★峻青《不盡巨濤滾滾來》
exampleEn: In their eyes, any seemingly powerful invader is nothing but a group of walking corpses with a false appearance. — Jun Qing's 'Endless Great Waves Rolling In'

explanation: 心中不服，感到气愤。同愤愤不平”。
explanationTraditional: 心中不服，感到氣憤。同憤憤不平”。
explanationEn: Feeling indignant and dissatisfied; resentful.
derivation: 《禅真逸史》第一回此时过往人众，见齐德受亏，俱忿忿不平。”
derivationTraditional: 《禪真逸史》第一回此時過往人眾，見齊德受虧，俱忿忿不平。”
derivationEn: 'The True Story of Chan Yi', Chapter 1: 'At that time, passersby, seeing Qi De suffer, were all indignant.'
example: 高战也是～，点点头。★古龙《长干行》三
exampleTraditional: 高戰也是～，點點頭。★古龍《長幹行》三
exampleEn: Gao Zhan was also indignant and nodded. — Gu Long's 'Chang Gan Xing', Part 3

explanation: 象龙在飞腾，虎在跳跃。形容跑跳时动作矫健有力。也比喻奋起行动，有所作为。
explanationTraditional: 象龍在飛騰，虎在跳躍。形容跑跳時動作矯健有力。也比喻奮起行動，有所作為。
explanationEn: Like a dragon soaring and a tiger leaping; describes vigorous and powerful movements, or rising to action.
derivation: 唐·严从《拟三国名臣赞序》圣人受命，贤人受任，龙腾虎跃，风流云蒸，求之精微，其道莫不咸系乎天者也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·嚴從《擬三國名臣贊序》聖人受命，賢人受任，龍騰虎躍，風流雲蒸，求之精微，其道莫不鹹系乎天者也。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Yan Cong's 'Preface to Praising Famous Ministers of the Three Kingdoms': 'When the sage receives the mandate, the worthy take office, dragons soar and tigers leap, the wind flows and clouds rise.'
example: 但是他的心情十分敞朗，坚信只要度过这段困难日子，局势就会好转，任自己～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十七章
exampleTraditional: 但是他的心情十分敞朗，堅信只要度過這段困難日子，局勢就會好轉，任自己～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十七章
exampleEn: But his mood was very cheerful, firmly believing that once this difficult period was over, the situation would improve and he could act freely. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 27

explanation: 指挑挑拣拣，嫌这嫌那。
explanationTraditional: 指挑挑揀揀，嫌這嫌那。
explanationEn: To pick and choose, being overly selective or critical.
derivation: 徐特立《让革命的红旗世代相传》他们一旦了解了过去的痛苦，就会懂得今天我们对工作挑三拣四是多幺不对！”
derivationTraditional: 徐特立《讓革命的紅旗世代相傳》他們一旦瞭解了過去的痛苦，就會懂得今天我們對工作挑三揀四是多么不對！”
derivationEn: Xu Teli's 'Let the Red Flag Pass Down from Generation to Generation': 'Once they understand the suffering of the past, they will realize how wrong it is to be picky about our work today.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 呼吸也相互关联。形容彼此的关系非常密切。
explanationTraditional: 呼吸也相互關聯。形容彼此的關係非常密切。
explanationEn: Breathing in unison; describes a very close relationship.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 水是生命的源泉，水与生命的起源息息相通。
exampleTraditional: 水是生命的源泉，水與生命的起源息息相通。
exampleEn: Water is the source of life; water and the origin of life are closely connected.

explanation: 指把少有的货物囤积起来，等待高价出售。也比喻拿某种专长或独占的东西作为资本，等待时机，以捞取名利地位。
explanationTraditional: 指把少有的貨物囤積起來，等待高價出售。也比喻拿某種專長或獨佔的東西作為資本，等待時機，以撈取名利地位。
explanationEn: To hoard a rare commodity for a high price; also metaphorically to use one's specialty or exclusive asset to wait for opportunities to gain fame or profit.
derivation: 《史记·吕不韦列传》吕不韦贾邯郸，见（子楚）而怜之，曰‘此奇货可居。’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·呂不韋列傳》呂不韋賈邯鄲，見（子楚）而憐之，曰‘此奇貨可居。’”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lü Buwei': 'Lü Buwei traded in Handan, saw Zichu and pitied him, saying: 'This is a rare commodity to hoard.''
example: 可是他们把票子当做～，非要足了钱不肯放回。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十五章
exampleTraditional: 可是他們把票子當做～，非要足了錢不肯放回。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十五章
exampleEn: But they treated the tickets as a rare commodity and refused to let them go until they got enough money. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 25

explanation: 说话不算数，没有信用。
explanationTraditional: 說話不算數，沒有信用。
explanationEn: To break one's word; to be untrustworthy.
derivation: 《谷梁传·僖公二十二年》言之所以为言者，信也。言而不信，何以为言？”
derivationTraditional: 《穀梁傳·僖公二十二年》言之所以為言者，信也。言而不信，何以為言？”
derivationEn: From 'Guliang Zhuan: Duke Xi, 22nd Year': 'What makes words words is trust. If words are not trustworthy, how can they be words?'
example: 老孙若不与你，恐人说我～。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第六十一回
exampleTraditional: 老孫若不與你，恐人說我～。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第六十一回
exampleEn: If Old Sun doesn't give it to you, I'm afraid people will say I break my word. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 61

explanation: 慷慨情绪激动，充满正气；陈陈述；词言词。指意气激昂地陈述自己的见解。
explanationTraditional: 慷慨情緒激動，充滿正氣；陳陳述；詞言詞。指意氣激昂地陳述自己的見解。
explanationEn: To state one's views with fervor and righteousness.
derivation: 宋·陆九渊《荆国王文公祠堂记》元丰之末，附丽匪人，自为定策，至造诈以诬首相，则畴昔从容问学，慷慨陈义，而诸君子之所深与者也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸九淵《荊國王文公祠堂記》元豐之末，附麗匪人，自為定策，至造詐以誣首相，則疇昔從容問學，慷慨陳義，而諸君子之所深與者也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Lu Jiuyuan's 'Inscription for Wang Jinggong's Ancestral Hall': '...those who once calmly studied and generously stated their righteousness were deeply valued by the gentlemen.'
example: 元末群盗纵横，时事不堪言矣。诗家～，多衰飒无余地。★潘德舆《养一斋诗话》
exampleTraditional: 元末群盜縱橫，時事不堪言矣。詩家～，多衰颯無餘地。★潘德輿《養一齋詩話》
exampleEn: At the end of the Yuan Dynasty, bandits ran rampant, and the state of affairs was unbearable. Poets who spoke with fervor often expressed a desolate tone. — Pan Deyu, 'Nourishing One's Studio Poetry Talks'

explanation: 在地上画一个圈当做监狱。比喻只许在指定的范围内活动。
explanationTraditional: 在地上畫一個圈當做監獄。比喻只許在指定的範圍內活動。
explanationEn: To draw a circle on the ground as a prison; to restrict someone to a limited area.
derivation: 汉·司马迁《报任少卿书》故士有画地为牢，势不可入，削木为吏，议不可对，定计于鲜也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬遷《報任少卿書》故士有畫地為牢，勢不可入，削木為吏，議不可對，定計於鮮也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Sima Qian's 'Letter to Ren An': 'Thus a scholar, even if a prison is drawn on the ground, cannot enter; even if a wooden jailer is carved, he cannot argue; he must decide quickly.'
example: 这一封号，虽是几根柳森片门户，一张红纸的封条，法令所在，也同～，再没人敢任意行动。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十四回
exampleTraditional: 這一封號，雖是幾根柳森片門戶，一張紅紙的封條，法令所在，也同～，再沒人敢任意行動。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十四回
exampleEn: This seal, though just a few willow branches as a door and a red paper seal, was as effective as drawing a circle as a prison; no one dared to act freely. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 34

explanation: 工巧独特的艺术构思。
explanationTraditional: 工巧獨特的藝術構思。
explanationEn: To have unique and ingenious artistic conception.
derivation: 柯岩《奇异的书简·阳光和风雨谱写的歌》编导和演员门匠心独具地从生活出发……成功地刻划了以小强为主角的一代少年儿童形象。”
derivationTraditional: 柯巖《奇異的書簡·陽光和風雨譜寫的歌》編導和演員門匠心獨具地從生活出發……成功地刻劃了以小強為主角的一代少年兒童形象。”
derivationEn: From Ke Yan's 'Strange Books: Songs Composed by Sunshine and Rain': 'The directors and actors, with unique ingenuity, started from life... successfully portrayed the image of a generation of children with Xiaoqiang as the protagonist.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 龙马古代传说中形状象龙的骏马。比喻人精神旺盛。
explanationTraditional: 龍馬古代傳說中形狀象龍的駿馬。比喻人精神旺盛。
explanationEn: Vigorous spirit; full of energy (like a mythical dragon-horse).
derivation: 唐·李郢《上裴晋公》诗四朝忧国鬓如丝，龙马精神鹤姿。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李郢《上裴晉公》詩四朝憂國鬢如絲，龍馬精神鶴姿。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Ying's poem 'Presented to Duke Pei Jin': 'Worried for the state for four dynasties, temples gray as silk; with dragon-horse spirit and crane's posture.'
example: 见那些大哥哥还在～地说话，她也听不出味道，就打了两个哈欠，悄悄溜了出来。★欧阳山《三家巷》九
exampleTraditional: 見那些大哥哥還在～地說話，她也聽不出味道，就打了兩個哈欠，悄悄溜了出來。★歐陽山《三家巷》九
exampleEn: Seeing that the older brothers were still talking with dragon-horse spirit, she found it uninteresting, yawned twice, and quietly slipped out. — Ouyang Shan, 'Three Family Lane', Chapter 9

explanation: 荒诞荒唐离奇；不经不合常理。形容言论荒谬，不合情理。
explanationTraditional: 荒誕荒唐離奇；不經不合常理。形容言論荒謬，不合情理。
explanationEn: Absurd and unreasonable; preposterous.
derivation: 《史记·孟子荀卿列传》其语闳大不经，必先验小物，推而大之，至于无垠。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孟子荀卿列傳》其語閎大不經，必先驗小物，推而大之，至於無垠。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Mencius and Xunzi': 'His words were grand and unreasonable; he would first verify small things and then extend them to infinity.'
example: 如果用世俗的眼光看来，这些内容几乎都是～的。★秦牧《幻想的彩翼》
exampleTraditional: 如果用世俗的眼光看來，這些內容幾乎都是～的。★秦牧《幻想的彩翼》
exampleEn: If judged by worldly standards, these contents are almost all absurd and unreasonable. — Qin Mu, 'Wings of Fantasy'

explanation: 后悔已经晚了。
explanationTraditional: 後悔已經晚了。
explanationEn: It is too late to regret.
derivation: 《大宋宣和遗事》万一有奸邪叵测之情，陛下悔之晚矣！”
derivationTraditional: 《大宋宣和遺事》萬一有奸邪叵測之情，陛下悔之晚矣！”
derivationEn: From 'The Great Song Dynasty's Xuanhe Legacy': 'If there is any treacherous and unpredictable situation, Your Majesty will regret it too late!'
example: 小沛原非久居之地。今徐州既有可乘之隙，失此不取，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 小沛原非久居之地。今徐州既有可乘之隙，失此不取，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十四回
exampleEn: Xiaopei is not a place for long-term stay. Now that there is an opportunity in Xuzhou, if we miss it, it will be too late to regret. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 14

explanation: 党集团；营谋求。坏人集结在一起，谋求私利，专干坏事。
explanationTraditional: 黨集團；營謀求。壞人集結在一起，謀求私利，專幹壞事。
explanationEn: To form a clique for selfish interests; to gang up for personal gain.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱文公文集》十一宰相植党营私，孤负任使。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱文公文集》十一宰相植黨營私，孤負任使。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi's 'Collection of Zhu Wengong': 'The prime minister formed a clique for selfish interests, betraying the emperor's trust.'
example: 但昔日既与叛逆结盟，究非安分之辈。今名登黄榜，将来出仕，恐不免～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七回
exampleTraditional: 但昔日既與叛逆結盟，究非安分之輩。今名登黃榜，將來出仕，恐不免～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七回
exampleEn: But since he once allied with rebels, he is not a peaceful person. Now that he is on the list of successful candidates, if he becomes an official, he may form a clique for selfish interests. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 7

explanation: 形容子孙后代人很多。
explanationTraditional: 形容子孫後代人很多。
explanationEn: To have a large family with many descendants.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这一家子真是人丁兴旺。
exampleTraditional: 這一家子真是人丁興旺。
exampleEn: This family truly has many descendants.

explanation: 没有空子可钻。
explanationTraditional: 沒有空子可鑽。
explanationEn: No loophole to exploit; no opportunity to take advantage of.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 各种花草树木竞相开放出艳丽的花朵。
explanationTraditional: 各種花草樹木競相開放出豔麗的花朵。
explanationEn: A hundred flowers contend in beauty; refers to various flowers blooming in competition, symbolizing a flourishing scene.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 北方的夏天绿树成荫，百花争艳。
exampleTraditional: 北方的夏天綠樹成蔭，百花爭豔。
exampleEn: In the northern summer, trees are green and a hundred flowers contend in beauty.

explanation: 比喻对事物只凭片面的了解或局部的经验，就乱加猜测，想做出全面的判断。
explanationTraditional: 比喻對事物只憑片面的瞭解或局部的經驗，就亂加猜測，想做出全面的判斷。
explanationEn: Blind men touch an elephant; metaphor for making a judgment based on only partial understanding or limited experience.
derivation: 《大般涅槃经》三二其触牙者即言象形如芦菔根，其触耳者言象如箕，其触头者言象如石，其触鼻者言象如杵，其触脚者言象如木臼，其触脊者言象如床，其触腹者言象如畒，其触尾者言象如绳。”
derivationTraditional: 《大般涅槃經》三二其觸牙者即言象形如蘆菔根，其觸耳者言象如箕，其觸頭者言象如石，其觸鼻者言象如杵，其觸腳者言象如木臼，其觸脊者言象如床，其觸腹者言象如畒，其觸尾者言象如繩。”
derivationEn: From the Mahaparinirvana Sutra: 'Those who touched the tusk said the elephant was like a radish root; those who touched the ear said it was like a winnowing fan...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 由神灵帮助而写出的作品。形容作品文句精彩。
explanationTraditional: 由神靈幫助而寫出的作品。形容作品文句精彩。
explanationEn: A stroke of genius; describes a piece of writing or artwork that is exceptionally brilliant, as if inspired by a divine spirit.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第37回这三张东西，我自己画的也觉得意，真是神来之笔。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第37回這三張東西，我自己畫的也覺得意，真是神來之筆。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 37: 'These three pieces, I felt, were truly inspired, a stroke of genius.'
example: 自己也觉得仿佛是～，如用别的韵语形式去写，便决不能有此力量。★周作人《知堂回想录》
exampleTraditional: 自己也覺得彷彿是～，如用別的韻語形式去寫，便決不能有此力量。★周作人《知堂回想錄》
exampleEn: He himself felt it was like a stroke of genius; if written in another poetic form, it could never have such power. — Zhou Zuoren, 'Memories of Zhitang'

explanation: 生下来没有遇到好时候。旧时指命运不好。
explanationTraditional: 生下來沒有遇到好時候。舊時指命運不好。
explanationEn: Born at the wrong time; refers to having bad luck or not meeting favorable circumstances in life.
derivation: 《诗·大雅·桑柔》 我生不辰，逢天僤怒。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·大雅·桑柔》 我生不辰，逢天僤怒。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs, 'Daya·Sangrou': 'I was born in an unlucky time, encountering heaven's anger.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 腹指前面；背指后面。前后受到敌人的夹攻。
explanationTraditional: 腹指前面；背指後面。前後受到敵人的夾攻。
explanationEn: Attacked from front and rear; to be caught in a pincer attack.
derivation: 《魏书·崔浩传》裕西入函谷，则进退路穷，腹背受敌；北上岸则姚军必不出关助我。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·崔浩傳》裕西入函谷，則進退路窮，腹背受敵；北上岸則姚軍必不出關助我。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei·Biography of Cui Hao': 'If Yu enters Hangu Pass, his advance and retreat will be blocked, and he will be attacked from front and rear.'
example: 他只有奋力冲上这座山峰，才有可能摆脱～的困境。
exampleTraditional: 他只有奮力衝上這座山峰，才有可能擺脫～的困境。
exampleEn: He had to fight his way to the top of the mountain to escape the predicament of being attacked from front and rear.

explanation: 寥寥稀少，很少。形容很少，数得出来。
explanationTraditional: 寥寥稀少，很少。形容很少，數得出來。
explanationEn: Very few; so few that they can be counted easily.
derivation: 唐·刘长卿《过郑山人所居》寂寂孤莺啼杏园，寥寥一犬吠桃源。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉長卿《過鄭山人所居》寂寂孤鶯啼杏園，寥寥一犬吠桃源。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Changqing's poem 'Visiting Zheng's Mountain Dwelling': 'Lonely, a single oriole sings in the apricot garden; few, a single dog barks in the peach blossom source.'
example: 而公卿大臣，抗节效忠者，～。（清·方苞《请矫除积习兴起人才札子》）
exampleTraditional: 而公卿大臣，抗節效忠者，～。（清·方苞《請矯除積習興起人才札子》）
exampleEn: But the ministers and high officials who resisted and remained loyal were few and far between. — Fang Bao, Qing Dynasty

explanation: 凌欺凌。依仗强大，欺侮弱小。
explanationTraditional: 凌欺凌。依仗強大，欺侮弱小。
explanationEn: To bully the weak by relying on one's strength; to use one's power to oppress the weak.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三那桀纣有何罪过？也无非倚贵欺贱，恃强凌弱，总来不过是使势而已。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三那桀紂有何罪過？也無非倚貴欺賤，恃強凌弱，總來不過是使勢而已。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 3: 'What crime did Jie and Zhou commit? They merely relied on their nobility to bully the lowly, and used their strength to oppress the weak.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 请命请示保全生命。泛指有相当地位的人代表百姓向当权者陈述困难，提出要求。
explanationTraditional: 請命請示保全生命。泛指有相當地位的人代表百姓向當權者陳述困難，提出要求。
explanationEn: To plead for the people; refers to someone in a position of authority speaking to the rulers on behalf of the common people to request relief or justice.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》因民之欲，西乡为百姓请命，则天下风走而响应矣，孰敢不听！”《汉书·蒯通传》西乡为百姓请命。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》因民之慾，西鄉為百姓請命，則天下風走而響應矣，孰敢不聽！”《漢書·蒯通傳》西鄉為百姓請命。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian·Biography of Han Xin': 'Following the people's desires, go west to plead for the people's lives, then the world will respond like wind.'
example: 只是这种居高临下，～的怜愍态度，在现在已无多少价值可言罢了。★朱自清《熬波图”》
exampleTraditional: 只是這種居高臨下，～的憐愍態度，在現在已無多少價值可言罷了。★朱自清《熬波圖”》
exampleEn: But this condescending attitude of pleading for the people is now of little value. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Bo Tu Tu'

explanation: 形形态。形容高兴得失去了常态。
explanationTraditional: 形形態。形容高興得失去了常態。
explanationEn: To be so pleased with oneself as to lose one's composure; to be beside oneself with joy.
derivation: 《晋书·阮籍传》嗜酒能啸，善弹琴。当其得意，忽忘形骸。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·阮籍傳》嗜酒能嘯，善彈琴。當其得意，忽忘形骸。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin·Biography of Ruan Ji': 'He loved to drink and could whistle, and was good at playing the qin. When he was pleased, he would suddenly forget his physical form.'
example: 他把科长看成有天那么大，把他和科长连在一块，他没法不～。★老舍《四世同堂》三十二
exampleTraditional: 他把科長看成有天那麼大，把他和科長連在一塊，他沒法不～。★老舍《四世同堂》三十二
exampleEn: He regarded the section chief as immensely important, and linking himself with the section chief, he couldn't help but be beside himself with joy. — Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof'

explanation: 形容做事马虎粗心，不是丢了这个，就是忘了那个。
explanationTraditional: 形容做事馬虎粗心，不是丟了這個，就是忘了那個。
explanationEn: To be forgetful and careless; to miss this and forget that.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十七回咱们家没人，俗语说的‘夯雀儿先飞’，省的临时丢三落四的不齐全，令人笑话。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十七回咱們家沒人，俗語說的‘夯雀兒先飛’，省的臨時丟三落四的不齊全，令人笑話。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 67: 'Our family has no one; as the saying goes, 'the slow sparrow should start flying early,' to avoid being forgetful and careless at the last moment.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为做，引伸为谋求。剥削者为了发财致富，心狠手毒，没有一点儿仁慈的心肠。
explanationTraditional: 為做，引伸為謀求。剝削者為了發財致富，心狠手毒，沒有一點兒仁慈的心腸。
explanationEn: Refers to those who become rich by unscrupulous means, lacking any kindness or mercy.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公上》为富不仁矣，为仁不富矣。。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公上》為富不仁矣，為仁不富矣。。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'Being rich without benevolence, being benevolent without wealth.'
example: 自古道～”。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第二回
exampleTraditional: 自古道～”。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第二回
exampleEn: As the old saying goes, 'The rich are not benevolent.' — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel' Chapter 2

explanation: 旧指世家望族中有才德的女子。也泛指有钱有势人家的女儿。
explanationTraditional: 舊指世家望族中有才德的女子。也泛指有錢有勢人家的女兒。
explanationEn: A well-bred daughter from a distinguished family; a girl from a wealthy and influential family.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·贤媛》顾家妇清心玉映，自是闺房之秀。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·賢媛》顧家婦清心玉映，自是閨房之秀。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'The Gu family's daughter is pure-hearted and jade-like, truly a beauty of the boudoir.'
example: 姑娘既是位～，怎生来得到此？★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第八回
exampleTraditional: 姑娘既是位～，怎生來得到此？★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第八回
exampleEn: Since you are a young lady from a distinguished family, how did you come here? — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Son and Daughter' Chapter 8

explanation: 颜脸面。指人脸皮厚，不知羞耻。
explanationTraditional: 顏臉面。指人臉皮厚，不知羞恥。
explanationEn: Thick-skinned and shameless; having no sense of shame.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·巧言》巧言如簧，颜之厚矣。”南朝·齐·孔稚圭《北山移文》岂可使芳杜厚颜，薜荔蒙耻。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·巧言》巧言如簧，顏之厚矣。”南朝·齊·孔稚圭《北山移文》豈可使芳杜厚顏，薜荔蒙恥。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs': 'Sweet words like a reed, thick-faced indeed.' And from Kong Zhigui's 'North Mountain Proclamation': 'How can the fragrant angelica be thick-faced and the ivy be disgraced?'
example: 此种自私自利完全蔑视国家利益之理由，北平各团体竟敢说出，吾人殊服其～。★鲁迅《伪自由书·战略关系》引周敬侪《奇文共赏》
exampleTraditional: 此種自私自利完全蔑視國家利益之理由，北平各團體竟敢說出，吾人殊服其～。★魯迅《偽自由書·戰略關係》引周敬儕《奇文共賞》
exampleEn: Such selfish reasons that completely disregard national interests, dared to be uttered by various groups in Beiping, we are amazed at their shamelessness. — Lu Xun's 'Pseudo-Free Speech: Strategic Relations' quoting Zhou Jingchai's 'A Strange Article Worth Appreciating'

explanation: 彻贯通；云霄高空。形容声音响亮，好象可以穿过云层，直达高空。
explanationTraditional: 徹貫通；雲霄高空。形容聲音響亮，好象可以穿過雲層，直達高空。
explanationEn: Describes a sound so loud that it seems to pierce through the clouds and reach the sky.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 教室里学生们的情绪高涨，歌声～。
exampleTraditional: 教室裡學生們的情緒高漲，歌聲～。
exampleEn: The students in the classroom were in high spirits, and their singing resounded through the skies.

explanation: 指意外的灾祸或事故。特指人的死亡。
explanationTraditional: 指意外的災禍或事故。特指人的死亡。
explanationEn: Refers to an unexpected misfortune or accident, especially death.
derivation: 明·范文若《鸳鸯棒·恚剔》我还怕薄情郎折倒我的女儿，须一路寻上去，万一有三长两短，定要讨个明白。”
derivationTraditional: 明·範文若《鴛鴦棒·恚剔》我還怕薄情郎折倒我的女兒，須一路尋上去，萬一有三長兩短，定要討個明白。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Fan Wenruo's 'Yuanyang Stick': 'I fear the fickle lover will harm my daughter; I must go and find out. If anything untoward happens, I will demand an explanation.'
example: 要是万一李嫂子有～，真是可惜！★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十七章
exampleTraditional: 要是萬一李嫂子有～，真是可惜！★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十七章
exampleEn: If anything untoward happens to Sister Li, it would be a great pity! — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng' Volume 1, Chapter 17

explanation: 万道河，千重山。形容路途艰难遥远。
explanationTraditional: 萬道河，千重山。形容路途艱難遙遠。
explanationEn: Ten thousand rivers and a thousand mountains; describes a long and arduous journey.
derivation: 唐·张乔《寄维阳故人》诗离别河边绾柳条，千山万水玉人遥。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·張喬《寄維陽故人》詩離別河邊綰柳條，千山萬水玉人遙。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Zhang Qiao's poem: 'Parting by the river, tying willow twigs, a thousand mountains and ten thousand waters separate the beloved.'
example: ～路，孤舟几月程。★唐·贾岛《送耿处士》诗
exampleTraditional: ～路，孤舟幾月程。★唐·賈島《送耿處士》詩
exampleEn: A journey of ten thousand rivers and a thousand mountains, how many months will the lone boat take? — Tang Dynasty, Jia Dao's poem 'Seeing Off Geng Chu Shi'

explanation: 除草时要连根除掉，使草不能再长。比喻除去祸根，以免后患。
explanationTraditional: 除草時要連根除掉，使草不能再長。比喻除去禍根，以免後患。
explanationEn: When weeding, remove the roots to prevent regrowth; metaphorically, to eliminate the source of trouble completely.
derivation: 《左传·隐公六年》为国家者，见恶如农夫之务去草焉，芟夷蕰崇之，绝其本根，勿使能殖，则善者信矣。”北齐·魏收《为侯景叛移梁朝文》若抽薪止沸，剪草除根。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公六年》為國家者，見惡如農夫之務去草焉，芟夷薀崇之，絕其本根，勿使能殖，則善者信矣。”北齊·魏收《為侯景叛移梁朝文》若抽薪止沸，剪草除根。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan': 'For the state, see evil like a farmer weeding, cutting off the roots so it cannot grow.' And from Northern Qi, Wei Shou's 'Proclamation': 'Like removing the fuel to stop boiling, cut the grass and remove the roots.'
example: ～，萌芽不发；斩草若不除根，春至萌芽再发。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三十七
exampleTraditional: ～，萌芽不發；斬草若不除根，春至萌芽再發。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三十七
exampleEn: Cut the grass and remove the roots, so sprouts won't grow; if you don't remove the roots, they will sprout again in spring. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World' Volume 37

explanation: 从眼前飘过的云烟。原比喻身外之物，不必重视◇比喻很快就消失的事物。
explanationTraditional: 從眼前飄過的雲煙。原比喻身外之物，不必重視◇比喻很快就消失的事物。
explanationEn: Clouds and smoke passing before the eyes; originally referred to worldly possessions not worth cherishing; now describes things that quickly disappear.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《宝绘堂记》见可喜者，虽时复蓄之，然为人取去，亦不复惜也。譬之烟云之过眼，百鸟之感耳，岂不欣然接之，然去而不复念也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《寶繪堂記》見可喜者，雖時復蓄之，然為人取去，亦不復惜也。譬之煙雲之過眼，百鳥之感耳，豈不欣然接之，然去而不復念也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Record of the Hall of Treasured Paintings': 'When I see something delightful, I may collect it, but if taken, I don't regret it. It's like smoke and clouds passing before the eyes.'
example: 尽道是用不尽的金银，享不完的福禄了，谁知～，容易消歇。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十九
exampleTraditional: 盡道是用不盡的金銀，享不完的福祿了，誰知～，容易消歇。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十九
exampleEn: They say there is endless gold and silver, endless blessings, but who knows they are like passing clouds and smoke, easily dissipated. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Striking the Table in Amazement' Volume 19

explanation: 指戏演得逼真或把假的事情当作真的来做。
explanationTraditional: 指戲演得逼真或把假的事情當作真的來做。
explanationEn: To perform a play so realistically that it seems real; or to treat a fake situation as real.
derivation: 洪深《电影戏剧表演术》第三章表演的所以能感动人，就是因为演员的诚恳，所谓‘假戏真做’。”
derivationTraditional: 洪深《電影戲劇表演術》第三章表演的所以能感動人，就是因為演員的誠懇，所謂‘假戲真做’。”
derivationEn: From Hong Shen's 'The Art of Film and Drama Performance' Chapter 3: 'The reason acting can move people is the actor's sincerity, so-called 'playing a fake role as if it were real.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 坚坚定；贞有节操；屈屈服、低头。意志坚定，决不屈服。
explanationTraditional: 堅堅定；貞有節操；屈屈服、低頭。意志堅定，決不屈服。
explanationEn: Firm and unyielding; steadfast in integrity and refusing to submit.
derivation: 《荀子·法行》坚强而不屈，义也。”《后汉书·王龚传》王公束修厉节，敦乐爇文，不求苟得，不为苟行，但以坚贞之操，违俗失众，横为谗佞所构毁。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·法行》堅強而不屈，義也。”《後漢書·王龔傳》王公束脩厲節，敦樂爇文，不求苟得，不為苟行，但以堅貞之操，違俗失眾，橫為讒佞所構毀。”
derivationEn: From 'Xunzi': 'Strong and unyielding, that is righteousness.' And from 'Book of Later Han': 'Wang Gong cultivated his conduct, adhered to integrity, and was firm and unyielding.'
example: 而那些共产党人的～、为了人民和祖国视死如归的伟大精神更深深使他向往。★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第四十四章
exampleTraditional: 而那些共產黨人的～、為了人民和祖國視死如歸的偉大精神更深深使他嚮往。★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第四十四章
exampleEn: And the unyielding spirit of those Communists, their willingness to die for the people and the country, deeply inspired him. — Yang Mo's 'Song of Youth' Part 2, Chapter 44

explanation: 囊口袋。拿出财物帮助别人。
explanationTraditional: 囊口袋。拿出財物幫助別人。
explanationEn: To help someone by offering money or resources; to give financial assistance.
derivation: 元·无名氏《来生债》但见个贫的呵，我早则倾囊儿资助。”明·张岱《娘嬛文集·募修岳鄂王祠募疏》若有贤士大夫解囊乐助，自为王所式凭。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《來生債》但見個貧的呵，我早則傾囊兒資助。”明·張岱《娘嬛文集·募修嶽鄂王祠募疏》若有賢士大夫解囊樂助，自為王所式憑。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Lai Sheng Zhai': 'Whenever I see a poor person, I immediately empty my purse to help them.' Also from Ming Dynasty Zhang Dai's 'Lang Huan Wen Ji': 'If virtuous scholars and officials are willing to open their purses to help, they will surely be blessed by the king.'
example: 每当同学有困难时，老师总是～。
exampleTraditional: 每當同學有困難時，老師總是～。
exampleEn: Whenever a classmate is in difficulty, the teacher always helps generously.

explanation: 草菅野草。把人命看作野草。比喻反动统治者随意谑杀人民。
explanationTraditional: 草菅野草。把人命看作野草。比喻反動統治者隨意謔殺人民。
explanationEn: To treat human life as if it were worthless; to kill people indiscriminately, like cutting grass.
derivation: 《汉书·贾谊传》其视杀人，若艾草菅然。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·賈誼傳》其視殺人，若艾草菅然。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Jia Yi': 'He regards killing people as if cutting down grass and weeds.'
example: 象某人这样的官，真正是～了。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十七回
exampleTraditional: 象某人這樣的官，真正是～了。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十七回
exampleEn: An official like that person truly treats human life as nothing. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 47

explanation: 从竹管的小孔里看豹，只看到豹身上的一块斑纹。比喻只看到事物的一部分，指所见不全面或略有所得。
explanationTraditional: 從竹管的小孔裡看豹，只看到豹身上的一塊斑紋。比喻只看到事物的一部分，指所見不全面或略有所得。
explanationEn: To look at a leopard through a bamboo tube; to see only a part of something, implying limited or partial understanding.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·方正》此郎亦管中窥豹，时见一斑。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·方正》此郎亦管中窺豹，時見一斑。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Uprightness': 'This young man is like looking at a leopard through a tube—he sees only a spot.'
example: 向～寻知外，坐井观天又出来，运斧般门志何大，出削个好歹。★元·周德清《一枝花·遗张伯元》
exampleTraditional: 向～尋知外，坐井觀天又出來，運斧般門志何大，出削個好歹。★元·周德清《一枝花·遺張伯元》
exampleEn: Looking for knowledge through a tube, like a frog at the bottom of a well, boasting before an expert—how great is his ambition, but he only shows his ignorance. — Yuan Dynasty Zhou Deqing, 'A Branch of Flowers: To Zhang Boyuan'

explanation: 挥霍摇手称挥，反手称攉，意即动作敏捷，引伸为用钱没有节制；无度没有限度。指滥用金钱，没有节制。
explanationTraditional: 揮霍搖手稱揮，反手稱攉，意即動作敏捷，引伸為用錢沒有節制；無度沒有限度。指濫用金錢，沒有節制。
explanationEn: To spend money extravagantly and without restraint; to squander money excessively.
derivation: 冯玉祥《我的生活》第二十五章尤其许多骄奢淫逸的官僚军阀，富户买办，成天为自己挥霍无度。”
derivationTraditional: 馮玉祥《我的生活》第二十五章尤其許多驕奢淫逸的官僚軍閥，富戶買辦，成天為自己揮霍無度。”
derivationEn: From Feng Yuxiang's 'My Life', Chapter 25: 'Especially many extravagant and corrupt bureaucrats, warlords, rich compradors, spend their days squandering money without limit.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 盛夏已过，寒冬将至。泛指时光流逝。
explanationTraditional: 盛夏已過，寒冬將至。泛指時光流逝。
explanationEn: As summer passes and winter arrives; the passage of time; the cycle of seasons.
derivation: 《周易·系辞下》寒往则暑来，暑往则寒来，寒暑相推，而岁成焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭下》寒往則暑來，暑往則寒來，寒暑相推，而歲成焉。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Appended Remarks, Part 2': 'Cold goes then heat comes, heat goes then cold comes; cold and heat push each other, and the year is completed.'
example: 则他这兔走乌飞，～，春日花开，可又早秋天月朗。★元·武汉臣《生金阁》第二折
exampleTraditional: 則他這兔走烏飛，～，春日花開，可又早秋天月朗。★元·武漢臣《生金閣》第二折
exampleEn: Thus the sun and moon race, cold comes and heat goes, spring flowers bloom, and soon autumn moon shines bright. — Yuan Dynasty Wu Hanchen, 'Golden Ingot', Act 2

explanation: 发愤决心努力；图谋求。决心奋斗，努力谋求强盛。
explanationTraditional: 發憤決心努力；圖謀求。決心奮鬥，努力謀求強盛。
explanationEn: To resolve to work hard and strive for strength or prosperity; to make a determined effort to become strong.
derivation: 老舍《鼓书艺人》十七你越是发愤图强，遇到的困难就越多。你得下决心克服一切困难，否则就一事无成。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《鼓書藝人》十七你越是發憤圖強，遇到的困難就越多。你得下決心克服一切困難，否則就一事無成。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Drum Singers', Chapter 17: 'The more you strive to become strong, the more difficulties you encounter. You must resolve to overcome all obstacles, or you will achieve nothing.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 舍舍弃；生生命；取求取；义正义。舍弃生命以正义。指为正义而牺牲生命。
explanationTraditional: 舍捨棄；生生命；取求取；義正義。捨棄生命以正義。指為正義而犧牲生命。
explanationEn: To sacrifice one's life for righteousness; to give up life for a just cause.
derivation: 《孟子·告子上》生，亦我所欲也，义，亦我所欲也。二者不可得兼，舍生而取义者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·告子上》生，亦我所欲也，義，亦我所欲也。二者不可得兼，捨生而取義者也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gaozi, Part 1': 'Life is what I desire; righteousness is also what I desire. If I cannot have both, I will sacrifice life and choose righteousness.'
example: ～兮捐微躯，谁云女妇兮夫弗如？★明·李昌祺《剪灯余话·鸾鸾传》
exampleTraditional: ～兮捐微軀，誰雲女婦兮夫弗如？★明·李昌祺《剪燈餘話·鸞鸞傳》
exampleEn: Sacrificing life for righteousness, giving up the humble body; who says women are inferior to men? — Ming Dynasty Li Changqi, 'Remaining Tales from Trimming the Lamp: The Story of Luan Luan'

explanation: 把锅里开着的水舀起来再倒回去，使它凉下来不沸腾。比喻办法不彻底，不能从根本上解决问题。
explanationTraditional: 把鍋裡開著的水舀起來再倒回去，使它涼下來不沸騰。比喻辦法不徹底，不能從根本上解決問題。
explanationEn: To try to stop water from boiling by scooping it up and pouring it back; a temporary or ineffective solution that does not address the root cause.
derivation: 汉·枚乘《上书谏吴王》欲汤之沧，一人炊之，百人扬之，无益也；不如绝薪止火而已。”《三国志·魏书·刘弇传》扬汤止沸，使不焦烂。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·枚乘《上書諫吳王》欲湯之滄，一人炊之，百人揚之，無益也；不如絕薪止火而已。”《三國志·魏書·劉弇傳》揚湯止沸，使不焦爛。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Mei Cheng's 'Letter to the King of Wu': 'If you want the soup to cool, one person stirs it while a hundred scoop it, but it's useless; better to remove the firewood.' Also from 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Liu Yi': 'Scooping soup to stop boiling only prevents it from scorching.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 苟暂且，勉强；延延续；残喘临死前的喘息。勉强延续临死前的喘息。比喻暂时勉强维持生存。
explanationTraditional: 苟暫且，勉強；延延續；殘喘臨死前的喘息。勉強延續臨死前的喘息。比喻暫時勉強維持生存。
explanationEn: To barely manage to survive; to prolong one's last breath; to eke out a meager existence.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《与韩忠献王》遽来居颖，苟存残喘，承赐恤问，敢此勉述。”明·马中锡《中山狼传》今日之事，何不使我得早处囊中，以苟延残喘乎？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《與韓忠獻王》遽來居穎，苟存殘喘，承賜卹問，敢此勉述。”明·馬中錫《中山狼傳》今日之事，何不使我得早處囊中，以苟延殘喘乎？”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'Letter to Han Zhongxian': 'I came to Ying to barely preserve my last breath.' Also from Ming Dynasty Ma Zhongxi's 'The Story of the Zhongshan Wolf': 'Why not let me hide in the bag early to prolong my dying breath?'
example: 穷得当卖全无，虽只区区四金，到也不无小补，又可以～得好几日了。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 窮得當賣全無，雖只區區四金，到也不無小補，又可以～得好幾日了。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十八回
exampleEn: Having pawned everything, though only four silver pieces, it's still a little help, allowing me to barely survive for a few more days. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 28

explanation: 色彩鲜美艳丽，十分引人注目。
explanationTraditional: 色彩鮮美豔麗，十分引人注目。
explanationEn: Bright and dazzling; brilliantly colored and eye-catching.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十五回底下绿裤红鞋，鲜艳夺目。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十五回底下綠褲紅鞋，鮮豔奪目。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 65: 'Below, green trousers and red shoes, bright and dazzling.'
example: 顾八奶由右门出，她穿戴仍然～，气势汹汹地走进来。★曹禺《日出》第四幕
exampleTraditional: 顧八奶由右門出，她穿戴仍然～，氣勢洶洶地走進來。★曹禺《日出》第四幕
exampleEn: Mrs. Gu enters from the right door, dressed still brightly and dazzlingly, storming in with an imposing manner. — Cao Yu, 'Sunrise', Act 4

explanation: 颜面容；悦愉快；色脸色。脸色和霭喜悦。形容和善可亲。
explanationTraditional: 顏面容；悅愉快；色臉色。臉色和靄喜悅。形容和善可親。
explanationEn: A pleasant and amiable facial expression; describes someone who is kind and approachable.
derivation: 《论语·季氏》友便辟，友善柔、友便佞，损也。”邢昺疏善柔，谓面柔，和颜悦色以诱人者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·季氏》友便辟，友善柔、友便佞，損也。”邢昺疏善柔，謂面柔，和顏悅色以誘人者也。”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius, 'Ji Shi': 'Friends who are glib, friends who are soft, and friends who are glib-tongued are harmful.' Xing Bing's commentary: 'Soft means a soft face, using a pleasant expression to lure people.'
example: 申子平急上前，～的把原委说了一遍。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第八回
exampleTraditional: 申子平急上前，～的把原委說了一遍。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第八回
exampleEn: Shen Ziping hurried forward and explained the whole story with a pleasant expression. (From Liu E's The Travels of Lao Can, Chapter 8)

explanation: 索然没有意味、没有兴趣的样子。形容事物枯燥无味（多指文章）。
explanationTraditional: 索然沒有意味、沒有興趣的樣子。形容事物枯燥無味（多指文章）。
explanationEn: Completely uninteresting; dull and insipid (often referring to writing).
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文附集·立此存照”（三）》我情愿做一回‘文剪公’，因为事情和文章都有意思，太删节了怕会索然无味。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文附集·立此存照”（三）》我情願做一回‘文剪公’，因為事情和文章都有意思，太刪節了怕會索然無味。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Miscellaneous Notes of Qiejieting, Appendix: A Record of This Existence (III)': 'I am willing to be a 'scissors editor' because the events and articles are interesting; cutting too much would make them utterly dull.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻面子丧失干净。
explanationTraditional: 比喻面子喪失乾淨。
explanationEn: To lose all face or dignity completely.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 壁壁垒。原指双方交战，自己站在壁垒上旁观◇多比喻站在一旁看着，不动手帮助。
explanationTraditional: 壁壁壘。原指雙方交戰，自己站在壁壘上旁觀◇多比喻站在一旁看著，不動手幫助。
explanationEn: Originally meaning to watch from the sidelines during a battle; now metaphorically means to stand by and watch without offering help.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》及楚击秦，诸将皆从壁上观。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》及楚擊秦，諸將皆從壁上觀。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian, 'Biography of Xiang Yu': 'When Chu attacked Qin, the other generals all watched from their fortifications.'
example: 我以为对于校长主张去留的人，俱不免各有其复杂的背景，所以我是袖手～的。（鲁迅《两地书·七》）
exampleTraditional: 我以為對於校長主張去留的人，俱不免各有其複雜的背景，所以我是袖手～的。（魯迅《兩地書·七》）
exampleEn: I think that those who advocate for the principal's resignation all have their own complex backgrounds, so I just stand by and watch. (From Lu Xun's Letters from Two Places, No. 7)

explanation: 指区分不出两者的差别。
explanationTraditional: 指區分不出兩者的差別。
explanationEn: Indistinguishable; no difference between two things.
derivation: 郭沫若《海涛集·徐家埠》江西境内的风物，太平淡无奇了，这儿和长江沿岸所见到的别无二致。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《海濤集·徐家埠》江西境內的風物，太平淡無奇了，這兒和長江沿岸所見到的別無二致。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'Sea Tides: Xujia Bu': 'The scenery in Jiangxi is too plain and unremarkable; it is no different from what one sees along the Yangtze River.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 隔着河看人家着火。比喻对别人的危难不去求助，在一旁看热闹。
explanationTraditional: 隔著河看人家著火。比喻對別人的危難不去求助，在一旁看熱鬧。
explanationEn: Watching a fire from the opposite bank; metaphorically, watching others' troubles without offering help, just looking on.
derivation: 唐·乾康《投谒齐已》隔岸红尘忙似火，当轩青嶂冷如冰。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·乾康《投謁齊已》隔岸紅塵忙似火，當軒青嶂冷如冰。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty poet Qian Kang's 'Visiting Qi Ji': 'On the opposite bank, the red dust is busy as fire; before the window, the green peak is cold as ice.'
example: 他原是在～呀。★郭沫若《南冠草》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 他原是在～呀。★郭沫若《南冠草》第二幕
exampleEn: He was just watching the fire from the opposite bank! (From Guo Moruo's Southern Grass, Act 2)

explanation: 前进和后退都失去了依据。形容无处容身。也指进退两难。
explanationTraditional: 前進和後退都失去了依據。形容無處容身。也指進退兩難。
explanationEn: Having no basis for either advance or retreat; describes being in a dilemma or having no place to stay.
derivation: 《后汉书·樊英传》而子始以不訾之身，怒万乘之主；及其享受爵禄，又不闻匡救之术，进退无所据矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·樊英傳》而子始以不訾之身，怒萬乘之主；及其享受爵祿，又不聞匡救之術，進退無所據矣。”
derivationEn: From Book of the Later Han, 'Biography of Fan Ying': 'You began by offending the emperor with your priceless body, and when you received rank and salary, you did not offer any remedy; you have no basis for advance or retreat.'
example: ～，两无所容，此可谓调和者之戒矣。★章炳麟《诸子学略说》
exampleTraditional: ～，兩無所容，此可謂調和者之戒矣。★章炳麟《諸子學略說》
exampleEn: Having no basis for advance or retreat, and no place to accommodate oneself—this can be a warning for those who compromise. (From Zhang Binglin's Brief Discussion of Various Schools)

explanation: 背离开；井古制八家为井，引伸为乡里，家宅。离开家乡到外地。
explanationTraditional: 背離開；井古制八家為井，引伸為鄉里，家宅。離開家鄉到外地。
explanationEn: To leave one's hometown and go to another place.
derivation: 元·贾仲名《对玉梳》第一折送的他离乡背井，进退无门。”
derivationTraditional: 元·賈仲名《對玉梳》第一折送的他離鄉背井，進退無門。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Jia Zhongming's 'Jade Comb' Act 1: 'Sending him away from his hometown, with no way forward or back.'
example: 有许多本地的干部，现在要～，到前方去。★毛泽东《关于重庆谈判》
exampleTraditional: 有許多本地的幹部，現在要～，到前方去。★毛澤東《關於重慶談判》
exampleEn: Many local cadres now have to leave their hometown and go to the front. (From Mao Zedong's On the Chongqing Negotiations)

explanation: 故故人，老友。有亲戚朋友的关系。
explanationTraditional: 故故人，老友。有親戚朋友的關係。
explanationEn: To have some connection through kinship or friendship.
derivation: 元·高文秀《黑旋风》第四折因此上装一个送饭的沾亲带友，那一个管牢的便不乱扯胡揪。”
derivationTraditional: 元·高文秀《黑旋風》第四折因此上裝一個送飯的沾親帶友，那一個管牢的便不亂扯胡揪。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Gao Wenxiu's 'Black Whirlwind' Act 4: 'Therefore, I disguise as a food deliverer with some kinship or friendship, so the jailer won't recklessly pull and grab.'
example: 于是～，平日受过赈济，平粜过米粮，城里城外的士民百姓，十分中倒来了九分九厘。★《醒世姻缘》第九十回
exampleTraditional: 於是～，平日受過賑濟，平糶過米糧，城裡城外的士民百姓，十分中倒來了九分九釐。★《醒世姻緣》第九十回
exampleEn: Thus, those who were related or friends, who had received relief or bought grain at reduced prices, came from the city and countryside, nine out of ten. (From The Marriage That Awakens the World, Chapter 90)

explanation: ①寻认祖先，并归还本宗。②喻指回归故土。
explanationTraditional: ①尋認祖先，並歸還本宗。②喻指回歸故土。
explanationEn: ① To acknowledge one's ancestors and return to one's original clan. ② Metaphorically, to return to one's homeland.
derivation: 元·无名氏《合同文字》第四折我只为认祖归宗，迟眠早起，登山涉水，甫能勾到庭帏。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《合同文字》第四折我只為認祖歸宗，遲眠早起，登山涉水，甫能勾到庭幃。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'Contract Text' Act 4: 'I only want to acknowledge my ancestors and return to my clan, waking early and sleeping late, climbing mountains and crossing rivers, finally reaching the courtyard.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 挑、拣选择；肥肥肉；瘦瘦肉。比喻挑挑拣拣，光要对自己有利的。
explanationTraditional: 挑、揀選擇；肥肥肉；瘦瘦肉。比喻挑挑揀揀，光要對自己有利的。
explanationEn: To pick and choose only what is beneficial to oneself.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他是个极端自私的人，干什么事都爱挑肥拣瘦。
exampleTraditional: 他是個極端自私的人，幹什麼事都愛挑肥揀瘦。
exampleEn: He is an extremely selfish person who always picks and chooses in everything he does.

explanation: 形容兴趣浓厚。
explanationTraditional: 形容興趣濃厚。
explanationEn: Having a strong interest; very interested.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风里夹着腥味，雨点带着鲜血。形容疯狂杀戮的凶险气氛或环境。
explanationTraditional: 風裡夾著腥味，雨點帶著鮮血。形容瘋狂殺戮的兇險氣氛或環境。
explanationEn: A foul wind and a rain of blood; describes a dangerous atmosphere of brutal killing.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第二十三回腥风血雨满松林，散乱毛发坠山奄。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第二十三回腥風血雨滿松林，散亂毛髮墜山奄。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 23 of Water Margin by Shi Nai'an of the Ming Dynasty: 'A foul wind and a rain of blood filled the pine forest, scattered hair and feathers fell on the mountain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 开怀心情无所拘束，十分畅快。比喻敞开胸怀，尽情饮酒。
explanationTraditional: 開懷心情無所拘束，十分暢快。比喻敞開胸懷，盡情飲酒。
explanationEn: To drink heartily and freely, without restraint.
derivation: 元·无名氏《射柳棰丸》第三折令人们安排酒肴，与众大人每玩赏端阳，开怀畅饮。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《射柳棰丸》第三折令人們安排酒餚，與眾大人每玩賞端陽，開懷暢飲。”
derivationEn: From the Yuan Dynasty play 'Shooting the Willow and Beating the Ball' by an anonymous author: 'Let the attendants prepare food and drink, so that the officials may enjoy the Dragon Boat Festival and drink heartily.'
example: 李逵不知是计，只顾～，全不记宋江吩咐的言语。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: 李逵不知是計，只顧～，全不記宋江吩咐的言語。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十三回
exampleEn: Li Kui, unaware of the trick, only drank heartily, completely forgetting the words Song Jiang had told him. — From Chapter 43 of Water Margin by Shi Nai'an of the Ming Dynasty

explanation: 人马被打得仰翻在地。形容被打得惨败。也比喻乱得一塌糊涂，不可收拾。
explanationTraditional: 人馬被打得仰翻在地。形容被打得慘敗。也比喻亂得一塌糊塗，不可收拾。
explanationEn: Men and horses thrown to the ground; describes a crushing defeat or a state of utter chaos.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百十五回贾琏家下无人，请了王仁来在外帮着料理。那巧姐儿是日夜哭母，也是病了。所以荣府中又闹得马仰人翻。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百十五回賈璉家下無人，請了王仁來在外幫著料理。那巧姐兒是日夜哭母，也是病了。所以榮府中又鬧得馬仰人翻。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 115 of Dream of the Red Chamber by Cao Xueqin of the Qing Dynasty: 'With no one at home, Jia Lian invited Wang Ren to help manage affairs. Qiaojie cried for her mother day and night and fell ill. Thus the Rong Mansion was again in chaos.'
example: 这么晴朗的天气，天空是湛蓝湛蓝的，真不象双方就要杀得～！★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十六章
exampleTraditional: 這麼晴朗的天氣，天空是湛藍湛藍的，真不象雙方就要殺得～！★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十六章
exampleEn: In such clear weather, with the sky deep blue, it really didn't seem like the two sides were about to fight a bloody battle that would leave men and horses sprawling. — From Chapter 2, Volume 2 of Li Zicheng by Yao Xueyin

explanation: 徇曲从。不曲从私人交情。指为人公正，秉公处事。
explanationTraditional: 徇曲從。不曲從私人交情。指為人公正，秉公處事。
explanationEn: Not to be swayed by personal relationships; to be impartial and fair.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 脂胭脂。搽胭脂抹粉。指妇女打扮。也比喻为遮掩丑恶的本质而粉饰打扮。
explanationTraditional: 脂胭脂。搽胭脂抹粉。指婦女打扮。也比喻為遮掩醜惡的本質而粉飾打扮。
explanationEn: To apply rouge and powder; to dress up. Also used metaphorically to gloss over ugly realities.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇·赵县君乔送黄柑》其涂脂抹粉，惯卖风情，挑逗那富家郎君。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇·趙縣君喬送黃柑》其塗脂抹粉，慣賣風情，挑逗那富家郎君。”
derivationEn: From 'The Second Collection of Striking the Table in Surprise' by Ling Mengchu of the Ming Dynasty: 'She applied rouge and powder, was skilled in flirtation, and seduced wealthy young men.'
example: 我照作品的年月看下去，这些不肯～的青年们的魂灵便依次屹立在我眼前。★鲁迅《野草·一觉》
exampleTraditional: 我照作品的年月看下去，這些不肯～的青年們的魂靈便依次屹立在我眼前。★魯迅《野草·一覺》
exampleEn: As I read through the works by year, the souls of these young people who refused to apply rouge and powder stood before me one by one. — From 'Wild Grass: A Glimpse' by Lu Xun

explanation: 乐乐意；为做。有什么不乐于去做的呢？表示愿意去做。
explanationTraditional: 樂樂意；為做。有什麼不樂於去做的呢？表示願意去做。
explanationEn: Why not do it? Indicates willingness to do something because it is beneficial.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十六回此地河道，为患已久，居民被害已深，闻贵人修治河道，虽士商人等，亦必乐于从事；况又发给工钱饭食，那些小民，何乐不为？”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十六回此地河道，為患已久，居民被害已深，聞貴人修治河道，雖士商人等，亦必樂於從事；況又發給工錢飯食，那些小民，何樂不為？”
derivationEn: From Chapter 36 of Flowers in the Mirror by Li Ruzhen of the Qing Dynasty: 'The river here has long caused trouble, and the residents have suffered greatly. Hearing that you will repair the river, even the gentry and merchants will be happy to help; moreover, you provide wages and food. Why wouldn't the common people be willing?'
example: 这件事对国家对个人都有益处，～？
exampleTraditional: 這件事對國家對個人都有益處，～？
exampleEn: This matter benefits both the country and the individual—why not do it?

explanation: 形容不重天伦，不通人情，对亲属都不顾。有时也指对谁都不讲情面。
explanationTraditional: 形容不重天倫，不通人情，對親屬都不顧。有時也指對誰都不講情面。
explanationEn: To disregard one's family and relatives; to show no consideration for anyone, even close kin.
derivation: 冯德英《苦菜花》第三章我丢了差事云找他，他不惟不帮忙，反倒六亲不认了。”
derivationTraditional: 馮德英《苦菜花》第三章我丟了差事雲找他，他不惟不幫忙，反倒六親不認了。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 3 of Bitter Flower by Feng Deying: 'I lost my job and went to him for help, but not only did he not help, he even disregarded our kinship.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指说话、做事很讲道理。
explanationTraditional: 指說話、做事很講道理。
explanationEn: To be reasonable and sensible in speech and action.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他是个通情达理的人，从来不胡搅蛮缠。
exampleTraditional: 他是個通情達理的人，從來不胡攪蠻纏。
exampleEn: He is a reasonable person who never argues irrationally.

explanation: 敌匹敌。私人拥有的财富可与国家的资财相匹敌。形容极为富有。
explanationTraditional: 敵匹敵。私人擁有的財富可與國家的資財相匹敵。形容極為富有。
explanationEn: Having wealth comparable to that of a nation; extremely rich.
derivation: 《汉书·邓通传》邓氏钱布天下，其富如此。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·鄧通傳》鄧氏錢布天下，其富如此。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Deng Tong': 'Deng's money spread across the world, such was his wealth.'
example: 盖卞滨自他祖父遗下家业，到他手里，单以各处田地而论，已有一万余顷，其余可想而知，真是～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》六十四回
exampleTraditional: 蓋卞濱自他祖父遺下家業，到他手裡，單以各處田地而論，已有一萬餘頃，其餘可想而知，真是～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》六十四回
exampleEn: Since the property left by his grandfather, by the time it reached Bian Bi, just counting the fields in various places, there were over ten thousand hectares, and the rest can be imagined. Truly, his wealth could rival a nation. (from Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 64)

explanation: 孤芳独秀一时的香花。把自己比做仅有的香花而自我欣赏。比喻自命清高。
explanationTraditional: 孤芳獨秀一時的香花。把自己比做僅有的香花而自我欣賞。比喻自命清高。
explanationEn: To admire oneself as a solitary fragrant flower; to be self-appreciating and aloof.
derivation: 宋·张孝祥《念奴娇·过洞庭》词应念岭表经年，孤芳自赏，肝胆皆冰雪。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張孝祥《念奴嬌·過洞庭》詞應念嶺表經年，孤芳自賞，肝膽皆冰雪。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Xiaoxiang's poem 'Nian Nu Jiao: Crossing Dongting': 'Thinking of the years beyond the mountains, a solitary fragrance self-admired, my heart and soul are pure as ice and snow.'
example: 然而忆到这～，别有怀抱的句子，又不禁喜悦的笑了。★冰心《寄小读者·通讯九》
exampleTraditional: 然而憶到這～，別有懷抱的句子，又不禁喜悅的笑了。★冰心《寄小讀者·通訊九》
exampleEn: Yet recalling this line about 'solitary fragrance self-admired, with a different feeling in the heart', I couldn't help but smile with joy. (from Bing Xin's 'To Little Readers: Letter Nine')

explanation: 水的冷暖，只有饮者自己知道。佛教禅宗用以比喻自己证悟的境界。也比喻学习心得深浅，只有自己知道。
explanationTraditional: 水的冷暖，只有飲者自己知道。佛教禪宗用以比喻自己證悟的境界。也比喻學習心得深淺，只有自己知道。
explanationEn: Only the drinker knows whether water is cold or warm; metaphor for knowing one's own experience or understanding.
derivation: 唐·善无畏《大日经疏》卷十二如饮水者，冷热自知。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·善無畏《大日經疏》卷十二如飲水者，冷熱自知。”
derivationEn: From Shan Wuwei's 'Commentary on the Mahavairocana Sutra', Volume 12: 'Like drinking water, one knows its temperature oneself.'
example: 今蒙指授入处，如人饮水，～。今行者即是某人师也。★宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷四
exampleTraditional: 今蒙指授入處，如人飲水，～。今行者即是某人師也。★宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷四
exampleEn: Now that I have been instructed on the entry point, it is like drinking water—one knows its temperature oneself. Now the practitioner is my teacher. (from 'Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp', Volume 4)

explanation: 无妄意想不到的。指平白无故受到的灾祸或损害。
explanationTraditional: 無妄意想不到的。指平白無故受到的災禍或損害。
explanationEn: An unexpected calamity; undeserved misfortune.
derivation: 《周易·无妄》六三，无妄之灾。或系之牛，行人之得。邑人之灾。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·無妄》六三，無妄之災。或繫之牛，行人之得。邑人之災。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Wu Wang': 'Six in the third place: unexpected calamity. Someone ties up an ox, a passerby takes it, and the villager suffers.'
example: 能解百冤之结，能消～。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 能解百冤之結，能消～。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十二回
exampleEn: Able to resolve all grievances and eliminate unexpected calamities. (from Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 12)

explanation: 原指音乐的余音。比喻言外之意，即在话里间接透露，而不是明说出来的意思。
explanationTraditional: 原指音樂的餘音。比喻言外之意，即在話裡間接透露，而不是明說出來的意思。
explanationEn: Overtones; implied meaning beyond the literal words.
derivation: 南朝宋·范晔《狱中与诸甥侄书》弦外之意，虚响之音，不知所从而来。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·范曄《獄中與諸甥侄書》弦外之意，虛響之音，不知所從而來。”
derivationEn: From Fan Ye's 'Letter to My Nephews from Prison': 'The meaning beyond the strings, the sound of empty resonance, unknown from where it comes.'
example: 自以为这一句是一唱三叹，那一句是～。（刘半农《奉答王敬轩先生》）
exampleTraditional: 自以為這一句是一唱三嘆，那一句是～。（劉半農《奉答王敬軒先生》）
exampleEn: I thought this line had a lingering charm, and that line had an overtone. (from Liu Bannong's 'Reply to Mr. Wang Jingxuan')

explanation: 确凿的凭据。
explanationTraditional: 確鑿的憑據。
explanationEn: Solid evidence; conclusive proof.
derivation: 清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第五回我本是个安分良民，人家说我私贬鸦片，都是雠扳，没有什么真凭实据。”
derivationTraditional: 清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第五回我本是個安分良民，人家說我私貶鴉片，都是讎扳，沒有什麼真憑實據。”
derivationEn: From Peng Yang'ou's 'The Opium Addict's Ghost', Chapter 5: 'I am a law-abiding citizen. People say I secretly deal opium, but it's all false accusation without any solid evidence.'
example: 处理任何案件，都必须有～。
exampleTraditional: 處理任何案件，都必須有～。
exampleEn: Every case must be handled with solid evidence.

explanation: 人情指社会上的人情世故；冷冷淡；暖亲热。泛指人情的变化。指在别人得势时就奉承巴结，失势时就不理不睬。
explanationTraditional: 人情指社會上的人情世故；冷冷淡；暖親熱。泛指人情的變化。指在別人得勢時就奉承巴結，失勢時就不理不睬。
explanationEn: The fickleness of human relationships; people's attitudes change with one's fortune.
derivation: 唐·白居易《迁叟》诗冷暖俗情谙世路，是非闲论任交亲。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《遷叟》詩冷暖俗情諳世路，是非閒論任交親。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi's poem 'The Old Man': 'Knowing the warmth and coldness of worldly ways, letting friends discuss right and wrong.'
example: 节物后先南北异，～古今同。★宋·周密《齐东野语》卷十一
exampleTraditional: 節物後先南北異，～古今同。★宋·周密《齊東野語》卷十一
exampleEn: The seasons differ between north and south, but the fickleness of human relationships is the same in ancient and modern times. (from Zhou Mi's 'Qidong Yeyu', Volume 11)

explanation: 学学问；术技能。原指没有学问因而没有办法。现指没有学问，没有本领。
explanationTraditional: 學學問；術技能。原指沒有學問因而沒有辦法。現指沒有學問，沒有本領。
explanationEn: Without learning and without skill; ignorant and incompetent.
derivation: 《汉书·霍光传赞》然光不学亡术，暗于大理。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·霍光傳贊》然光不學亡術，暗於大理。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Huo Guang': 'But Huo Guang, without learning and without skill, was ignorant of great principles.'
example: 都说他的人是个好的，只可惜了一件，是犯了～”四个字的毛病。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 都說他的人是個好的，只可惜了一件，是犯了～”四個字的毛病。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十六回
exampleEn: Everyone says he is a good person, but unfortunately he suffers from the four-character disease of 'without learning and without skill'. (from Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats Revealed', Chapter 56)

explanation: 阿谀用言语恭维别人；奉承恭维，讨好。曲从拍马，迎合别人，竭力向人讨好。
explanationTraditional: 阿諛用言語恭維別人；奉承恭維，討好。曲從拍馬，迎合別人，竭力向人討好。
explanationEn: To flatter and fawn on someone; to curry favor.
derivation: 明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第八回他却小器易盈，况且是个小人，在人前不过一味阿谀奉承。”
derivationTraditional: 明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第八回他卻小器易盈，況且是個小人，在人前不過一味阿諛奉承。”
derivationEn: From Donglu Gukuang Sheng's 'Awakening from Drunkenness', Chapter 8: 'But he was petty and easily satisfied, and being a mean person, he only knew how to flatter and fawn on others.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 浪子二流子。不务正业的人改邪归正。
explanationTraditional: 浪子二流子。不務正業的人改邪歸正。
explanationEn: A prodigal son returns; a wastrel reforms and turns over a new leaf.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他终于～，改邪归正了。
exampleTraditional: 他終於～，改邪歸正了。
exampleEn: He finally turned over a new leaf and reformed.

explanation: 社会的风气，人们的思想。
explanationTraditional: 社會的風氣，人們的思想。
explanationEn: The ways of the world and people's thoughts; social morals and public sentiment.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 有一个高僧在沙漠中修行，忽然想到亚历山大府的名妓泰绮思，是一个贻害～的人物。（鲁迅《且介亭杂文二集·京派”和海派”》
exampleTraditional: 有一個高僧在沙漠中修行，忽然想到亞歷山大府的名妓泰綺思，是一個貽害～的人物。（魯迅《且介亭雜文二集·京派”和海派”》
exampleEn: A senior monk was practicing in the desert when he suddenly thought of Thaïs, a famous courtesan in Alexandria, who was a person who harmed social morals and public sentiment. (Lu Xun, 'Qie Jie Ting Za Wen Er Ji: 'Beijing School' and 'Shanghai School')

explanation: 绝处死路。形容在最危险的时候得到生路。
explanationTraditional: 絕處死路。形容在最危險的時候得到生路。
explanationEn: To find a way out of a desperate situation; to be rescued from a dire predicament.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《钱大尹知勘绯衣梦·正名》李庆安绝处幸逢生。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《錢大尹知勘緋衣夢·正名》李慶安絕處幸逢生。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, 'Qian Da Yin Zhi Kan Fei Yi Meng: Zheng Ming' Li Qing'an jueshi xing feng sheng.
example: 常言吉人天相，绝处逢生。”★明·冯梦龙《警世通言·桂员外途穷忏悔》
exampleTraditional: 常言吉人天相，絕處逢生。”★明·馮夢龍《警世通言·桂員外途窮懺悔》
exampleEn: As the saying goes, 'Heaven helps the good, and one finds a way out of a desperate situation.' (Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Jingshi Tongyan: Gui Yuanwai Tuqiong Chanhui')

explanation: 朗明朗。形容天空晴朗，空气清新。
explanationTraditional: 朗明朗。形容天空晴朗，空氣清新。
explanationEn: The sky is clear and the air is fresh; fine weather.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《兰亭集序》是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅，仰观宇宙之大，俯察品类之盛。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《蘭亭集序》是日也，天朗氣清，惠風和暢，仰觀宇宙之大，俯察品類之盛。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Wang Xizhi, 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection' On that day, the sky was clear and the air was fresh, with a gentle breeze. Looking up at the vast universe and down at the abundance of things...
example: 其日～，惠风庆云，真是昌期应运，太平景象，自然迥别。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第九十八回
exampleTraditional: 其日～，惠風慶雲，真是昌期應運，太平景象，自然迥別。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第九十八回
exampleEn: On that day, the sky was clear and the air was fresh, with auspicious winds and clouds. Truly a time of prosperity and peace, the scene was naturally different. (Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 98)

explanation: 为别人（或事)牺牲自己。
explanationTraditional: 為別人（或事)犧牲自己。
explanationEn: Self-sacrifice; sacrificing oneself for others or a cause.
derivation: 陶铸《松树的风格》我对松树怀有敬意的更重要的原因却是它那种自我牺牲的精神。”
derivationTraditional: 陶鑄《松樹的風格》我對松樹懷有敬意的更重要的原因卻是它那種自我犧牲的精神。”
derivationEn: Tao Zhu, 'The Style of the Pine Tree' The more important reason for my respect for the pine tree is its spirit of self-sacrifice.
example: 中华民族富于～的传统精神，在无数民族，革命先烈身上都可得到印证。
exampleTraditional: 中華民族富於～的傳統精神，在無數民族，革命先烈身上都可得到印證。
exampleEn: The Chinese nation is rich in the traditional spirit of self-sacrifice, which can be seen in countless national and revolutionary martyrs.

explanation: 不值得批驳。
explanationTraditional: 不值得批駁。
explanationEn: Not worth refuting; beneath refutation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 对于他所提有关修改方案的提议，完全没有事实根据，～。
exampleTraditional: 對於他所提有關修改方案的提議，完全沒有事實根據，～。
exampleEn: His proposal regarding the modification plan is completely unfounded and not worth refuting.

explanation: 舌头灵巧，象簧片一样能发出动听的乐音。形容花言巧语，能说会道。
explanationTraditional: 舌頭靈巧，象簧片一樣能發出動聽的樂音。形容花言巧語，能說會道。
explanationEn: To have a glib tongue; to be eloquent and persuasive, often in a deceptive way.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·巧言》巧言如簧，颜之厚矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·巧言》巧言如簧，顏之厚矣。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Qiaoyan' Glib words are like a reed organ, and his face is thick.
example: 这个商人～，把次品说成是优等品，欺骗消费者。
exampleTraditional: 這個商人～，把次品說成是優等品，欺騙消費者。
exampleEn: This merchant, with his glib tongue, passed off defective goods as high-quality ones, deceiving consumers.

explanation: 泛指没有劳动力而又没有亲属供养的人。
explanationTraditional: 泛指沒有勞動力而又沒有親屬供養的人。
explanationEn: Widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless; people without labor force and family support.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王下》老而无妻曰鳏，老而无夫曰寡，老而无子曰独，幼而无父曰孤；此四者，天下之穷民而无告者。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王下》老而無妻曰鰥，老而無夫曰寡，老而無子曰獨，幼而無父曰孤；此四者，天下之窮民而無告者。”
derivationEn: 'Mencius, King Hui of Liang II' The old without wives are called widowers, the old without husbands are called widows, the old without children are called childless, and the young without fathers are called orphans. These four are the poorest people in the world with no one to turn to.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 制造谣言，迷惑群众。
explanationTraditional: 製造謠言，迷惑群眾。
explanationEn: To spread rumors to confuse the public.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 敌人搞阴谋，惯用的手法之一，就是造谣惑众。
exampleTraditional: 敵人搞陰謀，慣用的手法之一，就是造謠惑眾。
exampleEn: One of the common tactics used by enemies in their conspiracies is to spread rumors to confuse the public.

explanation: 手脚动作很轻，使没有响声。
explanationTraditional: 手腳動作很輕，使沒有響聲。
explanationEn: To move quietly and gently; to be light-footed.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 她是个文静的姑娘，干什么都轻手轻脚的。
exampleTraditional: 她是個文靜的姑娘，幹什麼都輕手輕腳的。
exampleEn: She is a quiet girl and does everything gently and quietly.

explanation: 引拉长；吭嗓子，喉咙。放开嗓子大声歌唱。
explanationTraditional: 引拉長；吭嗓子，喉嚨。放開嗓子大聲歌唱。
explanationEn: To sing loudly and heartily; to lift one's voice in song.
derivation: 叶圣陶《醉后》她们引吭高歌的时候，曳声很长，抑扬起落。”
derivationTraditional: 葉聖陶《醉後》她們引吭高歌的時候，曳聲很長，抑揚起落。”
derivationEn: Ye Shengtao, 'After Getting Drunk' When they sang loudly, their voices were long and undulating.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 层峦山连着山；迭障许多高险的象屏障一样的山。形容山峰多而险峻。
explanationTraditional: 層巒山連著山；迭障許多高險的象屏障一樣的山。形容山峰多而險峻。
explanationEn: Peaks rising one after another; steep and numerous mountains.
derivation: 宋·陆九渊《与王谦仲书》方丈檐间，层峦叠嶂，奔腾飞动，近者数十里，远者数百里，争奇竞秀。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸九淵《與王謙仲書》方丈簷間，層巒疊嶂，奔騰飛動，近者數十里，遠者數百里，爭奇競秀。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Lu Jiuyuan's 'Letter to Wang Qianzhong': 'From the abbot's eaves, layers of peaks and ridges, galloping and flying, near for dozens of li, far for hundreds of li, vying in beauty and grandeur.'
example: ～，出没翠涛。★明·袁宏道《西洞庭》
exampleTraditional: ～，出沒翠濤。★明·袁宏道《西洞庭》
exampleEn: Peaks rising one after another, emerging from emerald waves. — Ming Dynasty, Yuan Hongdao's 'West Dongting'

explanation: 找各种借口推托。
explanationTraditional: 找各種藉口推託。
explanationEn: To make various excuses to decline or evade.
derivation: 元·无名氏《隔江斗智》第一折我如今并不推三阻四，任哥哥自主之。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《隔江鬥智》第一折我如今並不推三阻四，任哥哥自主之。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'The Stratagem of the River' Act 1: 'I now make no excuses at all, and leave it to my brother to decide.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 晚节指晚年的节操。已经到了晚年却未能保住自己的节操。也指事情快成功的时候却失败了。
explanationTraditional: 晚節指晚年的節操。已經到了晚年卻未能保住自己的節操。也指事情快成功的時候卻失敗了。
explanationEn: To fail to maintain one's integrity in later years; to fail at the last moment.
derivation: 宋·杨万里《清虚子此君轩赋》愿坚晚节于岁寒。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·楊萬里《清虛子此君軒賦》願堅晚節於歲寒。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Yang Wanli's 'Inscription on the Qingxuzi Bamboo Pavilion': 'Wish to hold firm to integrity in the cold of the year.'
example: 有些节操高尚的人，晚年时倒未能经受住考验，～，弄得身败名裂。
exampleTraditional: 有些節操高尚的人，晚年時倒未能經受住考驗，～，弄得身敗名裂。
exampleEn: Some people of noble character fail the test in their later years, losing their integrity and ruining their reputation.

explanation: 眉、目眉毛和眼睛，泛指容貌。形容人容貌清秀不俗气。
explanationTraditional: 眉、目眉毛和眼睛，泛指容貌。形容人容貌清秀不俗氣。
explanationEn: Having delicate features; handsome and refined appearance.
derivation: 元·无名氏《合同文学》第一折有个小孩唤做按住，今年三岁，生得眉清目秀，是好一个孩儿也。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《合同文學》第一折有個小孩喚做按住，今年三歲，生得眉清目秀，是好一個孩兒也。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Contract Literature' Act 1: 'There is a child named Anzhu, three years old, born with clear brows and beautiful eyes, a fine child indeed.'
example: 因为本是贵族子弟，所以往往～，举止娴雅，而知识水准也相当高。★闻一多《屈原问题》
exampleTraditional: 因為本是貴族子弟，所以往往～，舉止嫻雅，而知識水準也相當高。★聞一多《屈原問題》
exampleEn: Because they were originally from noble families, they often had delicate features, graceful manners, and a high level of knowledge. — Wen Yiduo's 'On Qu Yuan'

explanation: 比喻人出了名或有了钱财就容易惹人注意，引起麻烦。
explanationTraditional: 比喻人出了名或有了錢財就容易惹人注意，引起麻煩。
explanationEn: A person of prominence or wealth attracts attention and trouble.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第三十三回这正是树大招风风撼树，人为名高名丧人。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三十三回這正是樹大招風風撼樹，人為名高名喪人。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West' Chapter 33: 'This is exactly: a tall tree attracts the wind that shakes it; a man of high fame invites slander that ruins him.'
example: 再者～，土地、山峦多了容易显眼，惹人反对。★冯德英《迎春花》第四章
exampleTraditional: 再者～，土地、山巒多了容易顯眼，惹人反對。★馮德英《迎春花》第四章
exampleEn: Moreover, a tall tree catches the wind; having too much land and property makes one conspicuous and invites opposition. — Feng Deying's 'Spring Blossoms' Chapter 4

explanation: 英雄层出不穷。
explanationTraditional: 英雄層出不窮。
explanationEn: Heroes emerge in large numbers.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 《青梅煮酒》三国时期，是一个～的年代。
exampleTraditional: 《青梅煮酒》三國時期，是一個～的年代。
exampleEn: 'Green Plum Steamed Wine': The Three Kingdoms period was an era when heroes emerged in succession.

explanation: 奉奉行；公公务。奉公行事，遵守法令。形容办事守规矩。
explanationTraditional: 奉奉行；公公務。奉公行事，遵守法令。形容辦事守規矩。
explanationEn: To act with integrity and obey the law; to be law-abiding.
derivation: 《史记·廉颇蔺相如列传》以君之贵，奉公如法则上下平，上下平则国强。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·廉頗藺相如列傳》以君之貴，奉公如法則上下平，上下平則國強。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru': 'If you, with your high rank, act for the public good and obey the law, then superiors and inferiors will be harmonious, and the state will be strong.'
example: 我们每个人都要～，决不能做违法乱纪的事。
exampleTraditional: 我們每個人都要～，決不能做違法亂紀的事。
exampleEn: Each of us must be law-abiding and never do anything illegal or against discipline.

explanation: 身家本人和家庭。本人和全家人的生命。
explanationTraditional: 身家本人和家庭。本人和全家人的生命。
explanationEn: One's own life and the lives of one's family; everything one holds dear.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第一○八回倘举事一有不当，那些全躯保妻子的，随而媒孽其短，身家性命，都在权奸掌握之中。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第一○八回倘舉事一有不當，那些全軀保妻子的，隨而媒孽其短，身家性命，都在權奸掌握之中。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 108: 'If the uprising is not handled properly, those who care only for their wives and children will seize upon our faults, and our lives and families will be in the hands of treacherous officials.'
example: 我若没有还他，这件事就要破！～关系，我所以和老哥商议。（清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三十二回）
exampleTraditional: 我若沒有還他，這件事就要破！～關係，我所以和老哥商議。（清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三十二回）
exampleEn: If I don't return it to him, this matter will be exposed! It concerns my life and my family, so I must discuss it with you, brother. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars' Chapter 32

explanation: 已停止。指无法控制自己，使激动的情绪平静下来。
explanationTraditional: 已停止。指無法控制自己，使激動的情緒平靜下來。
explanationEn: Unable to control oneself; unable to calm one's emotions.
derivation: 唐·卢照邻《寄裴舍人书》慨然而咏‘富贵他人合，贫贱亲戚离’，因泣下交颐，不能自已。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·盧照鄰《寄裴舍人書》慨然而詠‘富貴他人合，貧賤親戚離’，因泣下交頤，不能自已。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Lu Zhaolin's 'Letter to Pei Sheren': 'Sighing and singing, 'The rich are joined by others, the poor are abandoned by relatives,' tears streamed down his cheeks, unable to stop.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹火烧火燎。
explanationTraditional: 猶火燒火燎。
explanationEn: Extremely urgent; in a great hurry.
derivation: 《人民文学》1977年4期整个发电厂都火急火燎地动员起来。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民文學》1977年4期整個發電廠都火急火燎地動員起來。”
derivationEn: 'People's Literature' 1977 Issue 4: 'The entire power plant was mobilized with great urgency.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻方法本来不恰当，却侥幸得到满意的结果。也比喻原意本不在此，却凑巧和别人的想法符合。
explanationTraditional: 比喻方法本來不恰當，卻僥倖得到滿意的結果。也比喻原意本不在此，卻湊巧和別人的想法符合。
explanationEn: To succeed by luck or accident despite using inappropriate methods; to hit the target by a fluke.
derivation: 清·西周生《醒世姻缘传》第二回将药煎中，打发晁大舍吃将下去。想歪打正着，又是杨太医运好的时节，吃了药就安稳睡了一觉。”
derivationTraditional: 清·西周生《醒世姻緣傳》第二回將藥煎中，打發晁大舍吃將下去。想歪打正著，又是楊太醫運好的時節，吃了藥就安穩睡了一覺。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'Xingshi Yinyuan Zhuan' by Xi Zhousheng: 'The medicine was brewed and given to Chao Dashe to drink. It was a fluke, and by luck, Dr. Yang's prescription worked, and he slept peacefully.'
example: 他有种非智慧的智慧，最善于～。（老舍《牛天赐传》）
exampleTraditional: 他有種非智慧的智慧，最善於～。（老舍《牛天賜傳》）
exampleEn: He has a kind of non-intellectual wisdom, best at hitting the mark by a fluke. (Lao She, 'The Biography of Niu Tianci')

explanation: 不是鱼死，就是网破。指拼个你死我活。
explanationTraditional: 不是魚死，就是網破。指拼個你死我活。
