explanationEn: Either the fish dies or the net breaks; to fight to the death, a life-and-death struggle.
derivation: 《杜鹃山》第五场他就是张网捕鱼，我也拼他个鱼死网破。”
derivationTraditional: 《杜鵑山》第五場他就是張網捕魚，我也拼他個魚死網破。”
derivationEn: From the play 'Cuckoo Mountain' Act 5: 'He sets the net to catch fish, but I'll fight to the death, either fish dies or net breaks.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 真实的情意。
explanationTraditional: 真實的情意。
explanationEn: Genuine feelings and sincere intentions.
derivation: 明·李东阳《求退录·诗话》诗有别材，非关书也，诗有别趣，非关理也……彼小夫贱隶妇人女子真情实意，喑合而偶中，固不待于教。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李東陽《求退錄·詩話》詩有別材，非關書也，詩有別趣，非關理也……彼小夫賤隸婦人女子真情實意，喑合而偶中，固不待於教。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Li Dongyang's 'Qiutui Lu: Shihua': 'Poetry has a different material, not about books; poetry has a different interest, not about reason... Those commoners, women, and children with genuine feelings and sincere intentions, coincidentally hit the mark without teaching.'
example: 她有时觉得他是～地爱她，但有时却怪他既然爱她为什么不肯和妻子离婚？★草明《乘风破浪》九
exampleTraditional: 她有時覺得他是～地愛她，但有時卻怪他既然愛她為什麼不肯和妻子離婚？★草明《乘風破浪》九
exampleEn: Sometimes she felt he loved her with genuine feelings, but other times she wondered why he wouldn't divorce his wife if he loved her. (Cao Ming, 'Riding the Wind and Waves', Chapter 9)

explanation: 形容射箭或打枪准确，每次都命中目标。也比喻做事有充分把握。
explanationTraditional: 形容射箭或打槍準確，每次都命中目標。也比喻做事有充分把握。
explanationEn: To hit the target every time; to be highly accurate in shooting or archery; also used metaphorically for doing something with full assurance of success.
derivation: 《战国策·西周策》楚有养由基者，善射，去柳叶百步而射之，百发百中。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·西周策》楚有養由基者，善射，去柳葉百步而射之，百發百中。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategies of Western Zhou': 'In Chu, there was a man named Yang Youji, skilled in archery; shooting at a willow leaf from a hundred paces, he hit it every time.'
example: 回见子牙，叩头在地丞相妙计，～。”★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第三十六回
exampleTraditional: 回見子牙，叩頭在地丞相妙計，～。”★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第三十六回
exampleEn: Returning to Ziya, he kowtowed on the ground: 'Prime Minister, your brilliant plan hits the mark every time.' (Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 36)

explanation: 猴、马十二生肖之一。泛指未来的岁月。
explanationTraditional: 猴、馬十二生肖之一。泛指未來的歲月。
explanationEn: An indefinite future time; a time that will never come (lit. 'Year of the Monkey, Month of the Horse').
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 你这样下去，猴年马月才能完成。
exampleTraditional: 你這樣下去，猴年馬月才能完成。
exampleEn: If you keep going like this, it will take until the Year of the Monkey and Month of the Horse to finish.

explanation: 临到打仗时逃跑了。也比喻到了紧要关头退缩逃避。
explanationTraditional: 臨到打仗時逃跑了。也比喻到了緊要關頭退縮逃避。
explanationEn: To flee from battle; to shrink back or escape at a critical moment.
derivation: 明·徐光启《疏辩》在法，初逃者从重捆打，再逃则斩矣；临阵脱逃，初次即斩矣，亦求危其怨乎。”
derivationTraditional: 明·徐光啟《疏辯》在法，初逃者從重捆打，再逃則斬矣；臨陣脫逃，初次即斬矣，亦求危其怨乎。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xu Guangqi's 'Shu Bian': 'According to law, first-time deserters are severely beaten, second-time deserters are beheaded; fleeing from battle is beheaded on the first offense, so why fear their resentment?'
example: 你们中国的兵勇，一到有起事来，不是半途溃散，便是～，那是不关我教习的事。★清·无名氏《官场维新记》第四回
exampleTraditional: 你們中國的兵勇，一到有起事來，不是半途潰散，便是～，那是不關我教習的事。★清·無名氏《官場維新記》第四回
exampleEn: Your Chinese soldiers, when trouble arises, either scatter halfway or flee from battle; that's not my concern as an instructor. (Qing Dynasty anonymous, 'The New Officialdom', Chapter 4)

explanation: 一二形容为数不多。略微知道一点。
explanationTraditional: 一二形容為數不多。略微知道一點。
explanationEn: To know a little about something; to have a slight knowledge of.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第四十二回花子道‘武艺也略知一二。’”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第四十二回花子道‘武藝也略知一二。’”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 42: 'The beggar said, 'I also know a little about martial arts.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形表现；色脸色。内心的喜悦表现在脸上。形容抑制不住内心的喜悦。
explanationTraditional: 形表現；色臉色。內心的喜悅表現在臉上。形容抑制不住內心的喜悅。
explanationEn: Joy appears on the face; to be visibly delighted.
derivation: 唐·吴兢《贞观政要·纳谏》太宗闻其言，喜形于色，谓群臣曰‘……及见魏征所论，始觉大非道理。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·吳兢《貞觀政要·納諫》太宗聞其言，喜形於色，謂群臣曰‘……及見魏徵所論，始覺大非道理。’”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wu Jing's 'Zhenguan Zhengyao: Accepting Remonstrance': 'Emperor Taizong heard his words, joy appeared on his face, and he said to his ministers, '...When I heard Wei Zheng's argument, I realized it was not reasonable.''
example: 章奇先生～了。★蒋光慈《短裤党》二
exampleTraditional: 章奇先生～了。★蔣光慈《短褲黨》二
exampleEn: Zhang Qixian was visibly delighted. (Jiang Guangci, 'Short Pants', Chapter 2)

explanation: 梗阻塞，妨碍。在事情进行中，设置障碍，故意为难。
explanationTraditional: 梗阻塞，妨礙。在事情進行中，設置障礙，故意為難。
explanationEn: To create obstacles or cause trouble in the middle of a process; to deliberately make things difficult.
derivation: 清·张集馨《道咸宦海见闻录》是以粮道必应酬将军者，畏其从中作梗也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張集馨《道鹹宦海見聞錄》是以糧道必應酬將軍者，畏其從中作梗也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Jixin's 'Daoxian Huanhai Jianwen Lu': 'Therefore, the grain intendant must entertain the general, fearing he might create obstacles.'
example: 英、美两公使不免恐慌，暗想日、俄两国～，定是不怀好意。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第十回
exampleTraditional: 英、美兩公使不免恐慌，暗想日、俄兩國～，定是不懷好意。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第十回
exampleEn: The British and American ministers were panicked, suspecting that Japan and Russia were creating obstacles with ill intentions. (Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 10)

explanation: 指无聊的人随意议论妇女的容貌体态。现亦比喻在小节上一味挑剔。同品头题足”。
explanationTraditional: 指無聊的人隨意議論婦女的容貌體態。現亦比喻在小節上一味挑剔。同品頭題足”。
explanationEn: To make frivolous comments about a woman's appearance; to nitpick or find fault with trivial matters.
derivation: 郭澄清《大刀记》开篇十二他们指手划脚，品头论足。”
derivationTraditional: 郭澄清《大刀記》開篇十二他們指手劃腳，品頭論足。”
derivationEn: From Guo Chengqing's 'The Big Knife' opening chapter 12: 'They pointed and gesticulated, making comments and criticisms.'
example: 我们都应当投身到四化建设中大干一场，不应当站在一边～，徘徊观望。
exampleTraditional: 我們都應當投身到四化建設中大幹一場，不應當站在一邊～，徘徊觀望。
exampleEn: We should all throw ourselves into the Four Modernizations, not stand aside making comments and criticisms, hesitating.

explanation: 玩世以消极、玩弄的态度对待生活；不恭不严肃。因对现实不满而采取的一种不严肃、不认真的生活态度。
explanationTraditional: 玩世以消極、玩弄的態度對待生活；不恭不嚴肅。因對現實不滿而採取的一種不嚴肅、不認真的生活態度。
explanationEn: To treat life with a cynical or flippant attitude due to dissatisfaction with reality.
derivation: 《汉书·东方朔传赞》依隐玩世，诡时不逢。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·東方朔傳贊》依隱玩世，詭時不逢。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Dongfang Shuo' — 'Relying on obscurity to toy with the world, deceiving the times without encountering misfortune.'
example: 余乡殷生文屏，毕司农之妹夫也，为人～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·颠道人》
exampleTraditional: 餘鄉殷生文屏，畢司農之妹夫也，為人～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·顛道人》
exampleEn: In my hometown, Scholar Yin Wenping, brother-in-law of Minister Si, treated life with cynicism. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: The Mad Taoist'

explanation: 蚕吐丝作茧，把自己裹在里面。比喻做了某件事，结果使自己受困。也比喻自己给自己找麻烦。
explanationTraditional: 蠶吐絲作繭，把自己裹在裡面。比喻做了某件事，結果使自己受困。也比喻自己給自己找麻煩。
explanationEn: To spin a cocoon around oneself; to be caught in one's own trap or create trouble for oneself.
derivation: 唐·白居易《江州赴忠州至江陵已来舟中示舍弟五十韵》诗烛蛾谁救护，蚕茧自缠萦。”宋·陆游《剑南诗稿·书叹》人生如春蚕，作茧自缠裹。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《江州赴忠州至江陵已來舟中示舍弟五十韻》詩燭蛾誰救護，蠶繭自纏縈。”宋·陸游《劍南詩稿·書嘆》人生如春蠶，作繭自纏裹。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Bai Juyi's poem: 'Who saves the moth from the candle? The silkworm entangles itself.' Song Dynasty, Lu You's poem: 'Life is like a spring silkworm, spinning a cocoon to bind itself.'
example: 我们需要制定必要的规章制度，但不可过于繁琐，弄得～，捆住自己的手脚。
exampleTraditional: 我們需要制定必要的規章制度，但不可過於繁瑣，弄得～，捆住自己的手腳。
exampleEn: We need to establish necessary rules, but they should not be too cumbersome, lest we tie our own hands.

explanation: 其中的乐趣没有穷尽。指朝廷某一工作，感到乐在其中。
explanationTraditional: 其中的樂趣沒有窮盡。指朝廷某一工作，感到樂在其中。
explanationEn: Endless joy; finding infinite pleasure in doing something.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这里条件很艰苦，但跟困难做斗争，其乐无穷。
exampleTraditional: 這裡條件很艱苦，但跟困難做鬥爭，其樂無窮。
exampleEn: The conditions here are tough, but struggling against difficulties brings endless joy.

explanation: 指社会风气一天不如一天。
explanationTraditional: 指社會風氣一天不如一天。
explanationEn: The moral standards of society are deteriorating day by day.
derivation: 欧阳山《苦斗》五二真是人心不同，各如其面！说世风日下，就是～！”
derivationTraditional: 歐陽山《苦鬥》五二真是人心不同，各如其面！說世風日下，就是～！”
derivationEn: Ouyang Shan, 'Struggle' Chapter 52: 'Truly, hearts differ! To say the world is declining—that is it!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容人或动物消瘦露骨。
explanationTraditional: 形容人或動物消瘦露骨。
explanationEn: Extremely thin and bony; emaciated.
derivation: 高云览《小城春秋》第十八章秀苇看见一个光着上身、瘦骨嶙峋的童工，提着一簸箕的泥灰，在一条悬空吊着的跳板上，吃力的走着。”
derivationTraditional: 高雲覽《小城春秋》第十八章秀葦看見一個光著上身、瘦骨嶙峋的童工，提著一簸箕的泥灰，在一條懸空吊著的跳板上，吃力的走著。”
derivationEn: Gao Yunlan, 'Spring in a Small Town' Chapter 18: 'Xiuwei saw a bare-chested, bony child worker carrying a basket of mortar on a suspended plank, walking with difficulty.'
example: 这次，这只～的黑狗的干嗥竟然使形神枯槁的老马也竖了一下耳朵。★王蒙《杂色》
exampleTraditional: 這次，這隻～的黑狗的幹嗥竟然使形神枯槁的老馬也豎了一下耳朵。★王蒙《雜色》
exampleEn: This time, the bony black dog's hoarse bark even made the withered old horse prick up its ears. — Wang Meng, 'Miscellaneous Colors'

explanation: 一点儿小火星可以把整个原野烧起来。常比喻新生事物开始时力量虽然很小，但有旺盛的生命力，前途无限。
explanationTraditional: 一點兒小火星可以把整個原野燒起來。常比喻新生事物開始時力量雖然很小，但有旺盛的生命力，前途無限。
explanationEn: A single spark can start a prairie fire; small beginnings can grow into a mighty force.
derivation: 《书·盘庚上》若火之燎于原，不可向迩。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·盤庚上》若火之燎於原，不可向邇。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents: Pan Geng I': 'Like a fire blazing across the plain, impossible to approach.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 明察看清；秋毫秋天鸟兽身上新长的细毛。原形容人目光敏锐，任何细小的事物都能看得很清楚◇多形容人能洞察事理。
explanationTraditional: 明察看清；秋毫秋天鳥獸身上新長的細毛。原形容人目光敏銳，任何細小的事物都能看得很清楚◇多形容人能洞察事理。
explanationEn: To have eyes sharp enough to perceive the tip of an autumn hair; to be perceptive and see clearly.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》明足以察秋毫之末，而不见舆薪，则王许之乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》明足以察秋毫之末，而不見輿薪，則王許之乎？”
derivationEn: 'Mencius: King Hui of Liang I': 'My eyesight is sharp enough to see the tip of an autumn hair, but not a cartload of firewood—would Your Majesty accept that?'
example: 余忆童稚时，能张目对日，～，见藐小微物，必细察其纹理。★清·沈复《浮生六记·闲情记趣》
exampleTraditional: 餘憶童稚時，能張目對日，～，見藐小微物，必細察其紋理。★清·沈復《浮生六記·閒情記趣》
exampleEn: I recall in childhood, I could stare at the sun with open eyes and see clearly the tiniest things, examining their textures. — Qing Dynasty, Shen Fu, 'Six Records of a Floating Life: Chapters of Idle Pleasures'

explanation: 象游鱼一样一个跟着一个地接连着走。形容一个接一个地依次序进入。
explanationTraditional: 象游魚一樣一個跟著一個地接連著走。形容一個接一個地依次序進入。
explanationEn: To enter in single file, one after another like fish.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·邓艾传》将士皆攀木缘崖，鱼贯而进。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·鄧艾傳》將士皆攀木緣崖，魚貫而進。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Deng Ai': 'The soldiers climbed trees and cliffs, advancing like fish in single file.'
example: 众才女除卞、孟两家姊妹在后，其余都是按名～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: 眾才女除卞、孟兩家姊妹在後，其餘都是按名～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十七回
exampleEn: All the talented women, except the Bian and Meng sisters who were at the back, entered in single file according to their names. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 67

explanation: 形容人反复无常或惯于耍手段。
explanationTraditional: 形容人反覆無常或慣於耍手段。
explanationEn: To turn clouds into rain with a flip of the hand; to be fickle or manipulative.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《贫交行》翻手作云覆手雨，纷纷轻薄何须数。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《貧交行》翻手作雲覆手雨，紛紛輕薄何須數。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Du Fu's poem 'On Friendship': 'Turning the hand to make clouds, covering the hand to make rain—so many frivolous people, why count them?'
example: 你不合打凤牢龙，～，陷人坑阱。★元·乔孟符《扬州梦》第四折
exampleTraditional: 你不合打鳳牢龍，～，陷人坑阱。★元·喬孟符《揚州夢》第四折
exampleEn: You should not have trapped the dragon and phoenix, turning clouds into rain, setting traps. — Yuan Dynasty, Qiao Mengfu, 'Dream of Yangzhou' Act 4

explanation: 扭转败局，变为胜利。
explanationTraditional: 扭轉敗局，變為勝利。
explanationEn: To turn defeat into victory.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十六回将军在匆忙之中，能整兵坚垒，任谤任劳，使反败为胜，虽古之名将，何以加兹！”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十六回將軍在匆忙之中，能整兵堅壘，任謗任勞，使反敗為勝，雖古之名將，何以加茲！”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 16: 'In the midst of haste, you could organize troops, fortify defenses, endure slander and hardship, and turn defeat into victory—even ancient famous generals could not surpass this!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容人来人往，非常热闹拥挤。
explanationTraditional: 形容人來人往，非常熱鬧擁擠。
explanationEn: Describes a bustling scene with people coming and going, very lively and crowded.
derivation: 《史记·货殖列传》天下熙熙，皆为利来；天下攘攘，皆为利往。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·貨殖列傳》天下熙熙，皆為利來；天下攘攘，皆為利往。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of the Merchants': 'The world bustles, all for profit; the world hustles, all for gain.'
example: 人们～地汇集在广场上。
exampleTraditional: 人們～地彙集在廣場上。
exampleEn: People gathered in the square, bustling and jostling.

explanation: 魂、魄旧指人身中离开形体能存在的精神为魂，依附形体而显现的精神为魄。形容惊慌忧虑、心神不定、行动失常的样子。
explanationTraditional: 魂、魄舊指人身中離開形體能存在的精神為魂，依附形體而顯現的精神為魄。形容驚慌憂慮、心神不定、行動失常的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes a state of being extremely frightened, anxious, or disoriented, as if one's soul has left the body.
derivation: 元·无名氏《看钱奴》第二折饿的我肚里饥失魂丧魄，冻的我身上冷无颜落色。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《看錢奴》第二折餓的我肚裡飢失魂喪魄，凍的我身上冷無顏落色。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'The Miser': 'Hunger makes my soul lost and spirit scattered; cold makes me pale and colorless.'
example: 那知我福气薄，叫神鬼支使的～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百七回
exampleTraditional: 那知我福氣薄，叫神鬼支使的～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百七回
exampleEn: But I am unlucky, and the gods have made me lose my soul and spirit. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 107

explanation: 指极其节省文字，不多费笔墨。
explanationTraditional: 指極其節省文字，不多費筆墨。
explanationEn: Refers to being extremely economical with words, not using more ink than necessary.
derivation: 清·李渔《闲情偶寄·词曲·格局》文章所忌者，开口骂题。便说几句闲文，才归正传，亦未尝不可，胡遽惜字如金，而作此卤莽灭裂之状也！”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《閒情偶寄·詞曲·格局》文章所忌者，開口罵題。便說幾句閒文，才歸正傳，亦未嘗不可，胡遽惜字如金，而作此鹵莽滅裂之狀也！”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Yu, 'Casual Expressions: Lyrics and Drama': 'What writing abhors is starting with the topic. It's not unacceptable to write a few idle words before getting to the main point, so why be so sparing with words as to be rash and destructive?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 留下无穷的祸患。
explanationTraditional: 留下無窮的禍患。
explanationEn: Leaves endless troubles or calamities.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 除恶务尽，否则贻害无穷。
exampleTraditional: 除惡務盡，否則貽害無窮。
exampleEn: Evil must be eradicated completely, otherwise it will cause endless harm.

explanation: 指象野兽远远跑掉，象鸟儿远远飞走。比喻人跑到很远的地方去。多指摆脱困境去寻找出路。
explanationTraditional: 指象野獸遠遠跑掉，象鳥兒遠遠飛走。比喻人跑到很遠的地方去。多指擺脫困境去尋找出路。
explanationEn: Like an animal running far away or a bird flying high; metaphorically, to go far away, often to escape difficulties and seek a way out.
derivation: 《后汉书·卓茂传》汝独不欲修之，宁能高飞远走，不在人间邪？”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·卓茂傳》汝獨不欲修之，寧能高飛遠走，不在人間邪？”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Zhuo Mao': 'Why do you alone not cultivate virtue? Can you fly high and run far, beyond the human world?'
example: 孙行者！好男子不可～！快向前与我交战三合。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第六十五回
exampleTraditional: 孫行者！好男子不可～！快向前與我交戰三合。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第六十五回
exampleEn: Sun Wukong! A good man should not run far away! Come forward quickly and fight three rounds with me. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 65

explanation: 等闲寻常，一般。把它看成平常的事，不预重视。
explanationTraditional: 等閒尋常，一般。把它看成平常的事，不預重視。
explanationEn: To regard something as ordinary or unimportant, not taking it seriously.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十五回汝勿以等闲视之，失吾大事。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十五回汝勿以等閒視之，失吾大事。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 95: 'Do not treat this lightly and ruin my great plan.'
example: 但是确实存在着这种典型，而且为数相当地多，为害相当地大，不可～的。★毛泽东《改造我们的学习》
exampleTraditional: 但是確實存在著這種典型，而且為數相當地多，為害相當地大，不可～的。★毛澤東《改造我們的學習》
exampleEn: But such typical cases do exist, and they are quite numerous and harmful; they cannot be taken lightly. — Mao Zedong, 'Reform Our Study'

explanation: 凌乱的样子。也形容思绪纷乱。
explanationTraditional: 凌亂的樣子。也形容思緒紛亂。
explanationEn: Describes a state of disorder or confusion, also used for tangled thoughts.
derivation: 战国宋玉《神女赋·序》精神恍惚，若有所喜，纷纷扰扰，未知何意。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國宋玉《神女賦·序》精神恍惚，若有所喜，紛紛擾擾，未知何意。”
derivationEn: From Warring States period, Song Yu, 'Preface to the Goddess Fu': 'In a trance, as if delighted, confused and disturbed, not knowing what it means.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 虚谦虚；谷山谷。胸怀象山谷一样深广。形容十分谦虚，能容纳别人的意见。
explanationTraditional: 虛謙虛；谷山谷。胸懷象山谷一樣深廣。形容十分謙虛，能容納別人的意見。
explanationEn: Describes a very humble person who is open to others' opinions, like a valley that is deep and spacious.
derivation: 《老子》敦兮其若朴，旷兮其若谷。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》敦兮其若樸，曠兮其若谷。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi': 'Sincere, like unhewn wood; open, like a valley.'
example: 每个人都应有～的态度，遇事不固执己见。
exampleTraditional: 每個人都應有～的態度，遇事不固執己見。
exampleEn: Everyone should have a humble attitude like a valley, not stubbornly clinging to their own opinions.

explanation: 有面子；头面人物。
explanationTraditional: 有面子；頭面人物。
explanationEn: Having prestige or being a prominent figure.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指前后连接不断。同首尾相继”。
explanationTraditional: 指前後連接不斷。同首尾相繼”。
explanationEn: Refers to connecting end to end, forming a continuous sequence.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 黑色与白色对比鲜明。比喻事非界限很清楚。也形容字迹、画面清楚。
explanationTraditional: 黑色與白色對比鮮明。比喻事非界限很清楚。也形容字跡、畫面清楚。
explanationEn: Black and white are clearly contrasted. It means the distinction between right and wrong is very clear. Also used to describe clear handwriting or images.
derivation: 汉·董仲舒《春秋繁露·保位权》黑白分明，然后民知所去就。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·董仲舒《春秋繁露·保位權》黑白分明，然後民知所去就。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Dong Zhongshu's 'Spring and Autumn Annals: Preserving Authority': 'When black and white are clearly distinguished, then the people know what to reject and what to follow.'
example: 再翻下去是穆少英先生的《墨绿衫的小姐》里，有三幅插画，有些象麦绥莱勒的手笔，～。★鲁迅《花边文学·奇怪（三）》
exampleTraditional: 再翻下去是穆少英先生的《墨綠衫的小姐》裡，有三幅插畫，有些象麥綏萊勒的手筆，～。★魯迅《花邊文學·奇怪（三）》
exampleEn: Turning further down was Mr. Mu Shaoying's 'The Lady in the Dark Green Shirt', which had three illustrations, somewhat in the style of Masereel, with clear black and white contrast. ★ Lu Xun, 'Trivial Talks: Strange (III)'

explanation: 画个饼来解除饥饿。比喻用空想来安慰自己。
explanationTraditional: 畫個餅來解除飢餓。比喻用空想來安慰自己。
explanationEn: Draw a cake to satisfy hunger. It means to comfort oneself with illusions.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·卢毓传》选举莫取有名，名如画地作饼，不可啖也。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·盧毓傳》選舉莫取有名，名如畫地作餅，不可啖也。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Lu Yu': 'When selecting officials, do not take those with empty reputations; a reputation is like drawing a cake on the ground—it cannot be eaten.'
example: 小生待～，小姐似望梅止渴。（明·汤显祖《牡丹亭》第十六出）
exampleTraditional: 小生待～，小姐似望梅止渴。（明·湯顯祖《牡丹亭》第十六出）
exampleEn: The young scholar tries to satisfy his hunger with a drawn cake, while the young lady quenches her thirst by looking at plums. (Ming Dynasty, Tang Xianzu, 'The Peony Pavilion', Act 16)

explanation: 两手、两膝和头一起着地。是佛教一种最恭敬的行礼仪式。比喻佩服到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 兩手、兩膝和頭一起著地。是佛教一種最恭敬的行禮儀式。比喻佩服到了極點。
explanationEn: Both hands, both knees, and the head touch the ground. It is the most respectful bowing ceremony in Buddhism. It means to admire someone to the utmost.
derivation: 唐·玄奘《大唐西域记·三国》致敬之式，其仪九等一、发言慰问，二、俯首示敬，三、举手高揖，四、合掌平拱，五、屈膝，六、长跪，七、手膝踞地，八、五轮俱屈，九、五体投地。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·玄奘《大唐西域記·三國》致敬之式，其儀九等一、發言慰問，二、俯首示敬，三、舉手高揖，四、合掌平拱，五、屈膝，六、長跪，七、手膝踞地，八、五輪俱屈，九、五體投地。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Xuanzang's 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions: Volume 3': 'The forms of respect have nine levels: 1. verbal greeting, 2. bowing the head, 3. raising hands in salute, 4. joining palms, 5. bending the knee, 6. kneeling, 7. kneeling with hands and knees on the ground, 8. bending all five limbs, 9. prostrating with five limbs on the ground.'
example: 屡闻至论，本极佩服，今日之说，则更～。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第六回
exampleTraditional: 屢聞至論，本極佩服，今日之說，則更～。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第六回
exampleEn: Having heard your profound arguments many times, I have always admired them greatly. Today's discourse makes me prostrate myself in admiration. ★ Qing Dynasty, Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 6

explanation: 虚假；委蛇随便应顺。指对人虚情假意，敷衍应酬。
explanationTraditional: 虛假；委蛇隨便應順。指對人虛情假意，敷衍應酬。
explanationEn: False; to go along casually. It means to treat someone insincerely, to deal with them perfunctorily.
derivation: 《庄子·应帝王》乡吾示之以未始出吾宗，吾与之虚而委蛇。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·應帝王》鄉吾示之以未始出吾宗，吾與之虛而委蛇。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: The Responding Sovereign': 'I showed him the state before the beginning of my ancestral lineage, and I dealt with him emptily and compliantly.'
example: 他也要同你～了。★闻一多《诗与批评·戏剧的歧途》
exampleTraditional: 他也要同你～了。★聞一多《詩與批評·戲劇的歧途》
exampleEn: He will also treat you insincerely. ★ Wen Yiduo, 'Poetry and Criticism: The Wrong Path of Drama'

explanation: 原指君王施行仁政，与百姓休戚与共，同享欢乐◇泛指领导与群众一起游乐，共享幸福。
explanationTraditional: 原指君王施行仁政，與百姓休慼與共，同享歡樂◇泛指領導與群眾一起遊樂，共享幸福。
explanationEn: Originally meant that a king practices benevolent governance, sharing joys and sorrows with the people, and enjoying happiness together. Later refers to leaders sharing joy with the masses.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王下·庄暴见孟子》今王四猎于此，百姓闻王车马之音，见羽旄之美，举欣欣然有喜色而相告曰‘吾王庶几无疾病与，何以能田猎也？’此无他，与民同乐也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王下·莊暴見孟子》今王四獵於此，百姓聞王車馬之音，見羽旄之美，舉欣欣然有喜色而相告曰‘吾王庶幾無疾病與，何以能田獵也？’此無他，與民同樂也。”
derivationEn: 'Mencius: King Hui of Liang II: Zhuang Bao Sees Mencius': 'Now when the king goes hunting here, the people hear the sound of his chariots and see the beauty of his banners, and they all joyfully tell each other: 'Our king must be free from illness, how else could he go hunting?' This is nothing else but sharing joy with the people.'
example: 人人都到五凤楼前，端门之下，插金花，赏御酒，国家～。★明·洪榝《清平山堂话本·戒指儿记》
exampleTraditional: 人人都到五鳳樓前，端門之下，插金花，賞御酒，國家～。★明·洪樧《清平山堂話本·戒指兒記》
exampleEn: Everyone goes to the front of the Five Phoenix Tower, under the Duan Gate, wearing golden flowers and tasting imperial wine. The nation shares joy with the people. ★ Ming Dynasty, Hong Pian, 'Qingping Mountain Hall Stories: The Ring Story'

explanation: 争夺权力和利益。
explanationTraditional: 爭奪權力和利益。
explanationEn: To struggle for power and profit.
derivation: 郭沫若《蔡文姬》第三幕他们就只晓得争权夺利，草菅人命。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《蔡文姬》第三幕他們就只曉得爭權奪利，草菅人命。”
derivationEn: Guo Moruo, 'Cai Wenji', Act 3: 'They only know how to struggle for power and profit, and treat human life as nothing.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 滔天漫天。比喻罪恶极大。
explanationTraditional: 滔天漫天。比喻罪惡極大。
explanationEn: Towering crimes; heinous crimes. It means extremely great sins.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 九·一八”事变后，日本侵略军对中国人民犯下了滔天罪行。
exampleTraditional: 九·一八”事變後，日本侵略軍對中國人民犯下了滔天罪行。
exampleEn: After the September 18th Incident, the Japanese invaders committed heinous crimes against the Chinese people.

explanation: 空有名望。指有名无实。
explanationTraditional: 空有名望。指有名無實。
explanationEn: To have an undeserved reputation; to exist in name only.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十五回却说司马懿回到寨中，使人打听是何将引兵守街亭。回报曰‘乃马良之弟马谡也。’懿笑曰‘徒有虚名，乃庸才耳！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十五回卻說司馬懿回到寨中，使人打聽是何將引兵守街亭。回報曰‘乃馬良之弟馬謖也。’懿笑曰‘徒有虛名，乃庸才耳！’”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 95: 'Sima Yi returned to his camp and sent someone to inquire which general was leading the troops to guard Jieting. The reply was: 'It is Ma Su, the younger brother of Ma Liang.' Sima Yi laughed and said: 'He has an undeserved reputation; he is merely a mediocre talent!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容学问贯通了中国和西方的种种知识。
explanationTraditional: 形容學問貫通了中國和西方的種種知識。
explanationEn: To have a thorough knowledge of both Chinese and Western learning.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第八十一回本领事久闻这位某观察，是曾经某制军保举过他留心时务、学贯中西的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第八十一回本領事久聞這位某觀察，是曾經某制軍保舉過他留心時務、學貫中西的。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 81: 'I have long heard that this inspector was once recommended by a governor as someone who pays attention to current affairs and has a thorough knowledge of both Chinese and Western learning.'
example: 曹汝霖、章宗祥都是～的人物，但结果却都做卖国害民的事。（冯玉祥《我的生活》第二十八章）
exampleTraditional: 曹汝霖、章宗祥都是～的人物，但結果卻都做賣國害民的事。（馮玉祥《我的生活》第二十八章）
exampleEn: Cao Rulin and Zhang Zongxiang were both figures with a thorough knowledge of Chinese and Western learning, but in the end they both engaged in traitorous acts that harmed the nation. (Feng Yuxiang, 'My Life', Chapter 28)

explanation: 憎恨。爱和恨的立场和态度十分鲜明。
explanationTraditional: 憎恨。愛和恨的立場和態度十分鮮明。
explanationEn: To have a clear distinction between love and hate; to be clear-cut in one's likes and dislikes.
derivation: 陈若曦《耿尔在北京》他很困惑，也很痛苦，想不到爱憎分明、坚强独立的小睛会怕人‘闲话’。”
derivationTraditional: 陳若曦《耿爾在北京》他很困惑，也很痛苦，想不到愛憎分明、堅強獨立的小睛會怕人‘閒話’。”
derivationEn: Chen Ruoxi, 'Geng Er in Beijing': 'He was very confused and pained, never expecting that Xiao Jing, who was so clear-cut in love and hate and strong-willed, would be afraid of gossip.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 白驹白色骏马，比喻太阳；隙缝隙。象凶马在细小的缝隙前跑过一样。形容时间过得极快。
explanationTraditional: 白駒白色駿馬，比喻太陽；隙縫隙。象兇馬在細小的縫隙前跑過一樣。形容時間過得極快。
explanationEn: Time passes extremely quickly, like a white colt flashing past a crack in a wall.
derivation: 《庄子·知北游》人生天地之间，若白驹之过卻，忽然而已。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·知北遊》人生天地之間，若白駒之過卻，忽然而已。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'Human life between heaven and earth is like a white colt passing a gap, suddenly gone.'
example: ～，日月穿梭，才见梅开腊底，又早天气回阳。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第二回
exampleTraditional: ～，日月穿梭，才見梅開臘底，又早天氣回陽。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第二回
exampleEn: Time flies like a white colt passing a gap; just as we see plum blossoms at the end of winter, soon the weather turns warm again. — Ming Dynasty, Jin Ping Mei, Chapter 2

explanation: 在生死问题上互相依靠。形容同命运，共存亡。
explanationTraditional: 在生死問題上互相依靠。形容同命運，共存亡。
explanationEn: To rely on each other in life and death; to share the same fate and coexist.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻有极大的可能性。
explanationTraditional: 比喻有極大的可能性。
explanationEn: Very likely; in eight or nine cases out of ten.
derivation: 清·刘献廷《广阳杂记》第二卷十之八九皆守之以僧，名不正，言不顺，莫此为甚。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉獻廷《廣陽雜記》第二卷十之八九皆守之以僧，名不正，言不順，莫此為甚。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Liu Xianting's Guangyang Zaji, Volume 2: 'In eight or nine cases out of ten, they are guarded by monks; the name is not proper, the words are not smooth, nothing is more extreme than this.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 果充实，饱。指吃不饱肚子。形容生活贫困。
explanationTraditional: 果充實，飽。指吃不飽肚子。形容生活貧困。
explanationEn: Unable to fill one's stomach; to have insufficient food to eat, describing a life of poverty.
derivation: 《庄子·逍遥游》適莽苍者，三飡而反，腹犹果然。”唐·段成式《酉阳杂俎·诺皋记下》和州刘录事者，大历中罢官居和州旁县，食兼数人，尤能食鲙，常言鲙味未尝果腹。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·逍遙遊》適莽蒼者，三飡而反，腹猶果然。”唐·段成式《酉陽雜俎·諾皋記下》和州劉錄事者，大曆中罷官居和州旁縣，食兼數人，尤能食鱠，常言鱠味未嘗果腹。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'Those who go to the countryside eat three meals and return, their stomachs still full.' Also from Tang Dynasty, Duan Chengshi's Youyang Zazu: 'He could eat for several people, especially raw fish, and often said the taste never filled his stomach.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 水光与天色相浑。形容水天相接的辽阔景象。
explanationTraditional: 水光與天色相渾。形容水天相接的遼闊景象。
explanationEn: The water and the sky merge into one color; a vast scene where water and sky meet.
derivation: 唐·王勃《滕王阁诗序》落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《滕王閣詩序》落霞與孤鶩齊飛，秋水共長天一色。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Wang Bo's Preface to the Prince Teng's Pavilion: 'Falling clouds fly together with the solitary duck, autumn water shares the same color with the vast sky.'
example: 那洞庭湖真个波涛万顷，～。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 那洞庭湖真個波濤萬頃，～。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第四十九回
exampleEn: Dongting Lake truly has vast waves, water and sky merging into one color. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai's The Complete Story of Yue Fei, Chapter 49

explanation: 万古千秋万代。千秋万代都象松柏一样永远苍翠。比喻崇高的精神或深厚的友谊永远不会消失。
explanationTraditional: 萬古千秋萬代。千秋萬代都象松柏一樣永遠蒼翠。比喻崇高的精神或深厚的友誼永遠不會消失。
explanationEn: To remain evergreen for all eternity; to last forever, like a pine or cypress. Describes noble spirit or deep friendship that never fades.
derivation: 元·无名氏《谢金梧》第四折也论功增封食邑，共皇家万古长春。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《謝金梧》第四折也論功增封食邑，共皇家萬古長春。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, anonymous Xie Jinwu, Act 4: 'Also for merit, increase fief and salary, sharing the royal family's eternal spring.'
example: 不信请看看我们～的祖国吧，那一天不在开着各色各样的奇花？★杨朔《迎春词》
exampleTraditional: 不信請看看我們～的祖國吧，那一天不在開著各色各樣的奇花？★楊朔《迎春詞》
exampleEn: If you don't believe, look at our ever-green motherland; which day does it not bloom with all kinds of exotic flowers? — Yang Shuo, Spring Greeting

explanation: 比喻俱为所欲，难于取舍之物。
explanationTraditional: 比喻俱為所欲，難於取捨之物。
explanationEn: Both are desirable but hard to choose between; a dilemma of choosing between two valuable things.
derivation: 语本《孟子·告子上》鱼我所欲也，熊掌亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍鱼而取熊掌者也。”
derivationTraditional: 語本《孟子·告子上》魚我所欲也，熊掌亦我所欲也；二者不可得兼，舍魚而取熊掌者也。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'Fish is what I want; bear's paw is also what I want. If I cannot have both, I will give up fish and take bear's paw.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 地主当地的主人；谊义务。住在本地的人对外地客人的招待义务。
explanationTraditional: 地主當地的主人；誼義務。住在本地的人對外地客人的招待義務。
explanationEn: The hospitality owed by a host to a guest from another place.
derivation: 《左传·哀公十二年》子服景伯谓子财曰‘夫诸侯之会，事既毕矣，侯伯致礼，地主归饩，以相辞也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·哀公十二年》子服景伯謂子財曰‘夫諸侯之會，事既畢矣，侯伯致禮，地主歸餼，以相辭也。’”
derivationEn: From Zuo Zhuan, 12th Year of Duke Ai: 'When the lords meet, after the business is done, the host offers gifts and the local host provides food, to bid farewell.'
example: 晚生得蒙青目，一日～也不曾尽得，如何便要去？★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 晚生得蒙青目，一日～也不曾盡得，如何便要去？★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第二十二回
exampleEn: I have received your favor, but I have not yet fulfilled the duty of a host even for one day; how can I leave? — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's The Scholars, Chapter 22

explanation: 刚一打开旗帜进入战斗，就取得了胜利。比喻事情刚一开始，就取得好成绩。
explanationTraditional: 剛一打開旗幟進入戰鬥，就取得了勝利。比喻事情剛一開始，就取得好成績。
explanationEn: To win victory as soon as the flag is unfurled; to succeed at the very beginning of an undertaking.
derivation: 元·无名氏《射柳捶丸》第四折托赖主人洪福，旗开得胜，马到成功。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《射柳捶丸》第四折托賴主人洪福，旗開得勝，馬到成功。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, anonymous She Liu Chui Wan, Act 4: 'Relying on the master's great fortune, the flag opens with victory, the horse arrives and succeeds.'
example: ～姜文焕，一怒横行劈董忠。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第九十四回
exampleTraditional: ～姜文煥，一怒橫行劈董忠。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第九十四回
exampleEn: The flag opened with victory for Jiang Wenhuan, who in anger split Dong Zhong with one blow. — Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's Investiture of the Gods, Chapter 94

explanation: 熟练了，就能找到窍门。
explanationTraditional: 熟練了，就能找到竅門。
explanationEn: Practice makes perfect; proficiency leads to skill.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 要想掌握技术，只有勤学苦练，才能熟能生巧。
exampleTraditional: 要想掌握技術，只有勤學苦練，才能熟能生巧。
exampleEn: To master a skill, one must study hard and practice diligently; only then can practice make perfect.

explanation: 原形容雨势大，后形容力量或声势非常壮大。
explanationTraditional: 原形容雨勢大，後形容力量或聲勢非常壯大。
explanationEn: Originally describes heavy rain; later used to describe immense power or momentum.
derivation: 唐·李筌《太白阴经·祭风伯文》鼓怒而走石飞沙，翻江倒海。”宋·陆游《夜宿阳山矶》诗五更颠风吹急雨，倒海翻江洗残暑。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李筌《太白陰經·祭風伯文》鼓怒而走石飛沙，翻江倒海。”宋·陸游《夜宿陽山磯》詩五更顛風吹急雨，倒海翻江洗殘暑。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty Li Quan's 'Taibai Yin Jing': 'Raging winds stir up stones and sand, overturning rivers and seas.' Song Dynasty Lu You's poem: 'The fierce wind at midnight brings urgent rain, overturning seas and rivers to wash away the lingering heat.'
example: 且说薛姨妈家中被金桂搅得～，看见婆子回来，说起岫烟的事，宝钗母女二人不免滴下泪来。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十回
exampleTraditional: 且說薛姨媽家中被金桂攪得～，看見婆子回來，說起岫煙的事，寶釵母女二人不免滴下淚來。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十回
exampleEn: Moreover, Xue's household was thrown into chaos by Jin Gui. When the old servant returned and reported about Xiuyan's matter, Baochai and her mother couldn't help but shed tears. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 90

explanation: 客人反过来成为主人。比喻变被动为主动。
explanationTraditional: 客人反過來成為主人。比喻變被動為主動。
explanationEn: The guest becomes the host. Metaphor for turning passivity into initiative.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十一回拔寨前进，步步为营，诱渊来战而擒之，此乃反客为主之法。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十一回拔寨前進，步步為營，誘淵來戰而擒之，此乃反客為主之法。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 71: 'Advance the camp step by step, lure Yuan into battle and capture him—this is the strategy of turning guest into host.'
example: 心里正在为难，只听得那女子～，让着说道尊客，请屋里坐。”★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第四回
exampleTraditional: 心裡正在為難，只聽得那女子～，讓著說道尊客，請屋裡坐。”★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第四回
exampleEn: While feeling troubled, he heard the woman take the initiative and say, 'Honored guest, please sit inside.' — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 4

explanation: 毕露完全显露。锐气和才华全都显露出来。多指人好表现自己。
explanationTraditional: 畢露完全顯露。銳氣和才華全都顯露出來。多指人好表現自己。
explanationEn: Fully revealing one's sharpness and talent; often refers to someone who likes to show off.
derivation: 华而实《汉衣冠》二黄熙胤奉承地解释，想借着师友渊源、故旧情谊来笼络这位锋芒毕露的身居要位的武将。”
derivationTraditional: 華而實《漢衣冠》二黃熙胤奉承地解釋，想借著師友淵源、故舊情誼來籠絡這位鋒芒畢露的身居要位的武將。”
derivationEn: Hua Ershi's 'Han Yiguan', Part 2: 'Huang Xiyun flatteringly explained, trying to use teacher-student connections and old friendships to win over this sharp-tongued, high-ranking military officer.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 揽把持。一个人把持着权力，独断专行。
explanationTraditional: 攬把持。一個人把持著權力，獨斷專行。
explanationEn: One person monopolizes power and makes arbitrary decisions.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第六回他却忘其所以，大权独揽，只弄些小聪明，闹些空意气。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第六回他卻忘其所以，大權獨攬，只弄些小聰明，鬧些空意氣。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sin', Chapter 6: 'He forgot his place, monopolized power, and only played petty tricks, causing empty trouble.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 色种类。各种类别，各种式样。
explanationTraditional: 色種類。各種類別，各種式樣。
explanationEn: Various types and styles.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第87回却说盛公子一派话儿，把官亲投任的人，各色各样，形容的一个详而且尽。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第87回卻說盛公子一派話兒，把官親投任的人，各色各樣，形容的一個詳而且盡。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Li Lüyuan's 'The Lamp of Divergent Paths', Chapter 87: 'Master Sheng described all kinds of people who went to take up official posts, in great detail.'
example: 那天楼底下坐着许多老百姓，男女老少，～的人物都有。★冯玉祥《我的生活》第34章
exampleTraditional: 那天樓底下坐著許多老百姓，男女老少，～的人物都有。★馮玉祥《我的生活》第34章
exampleEn: That day, many common people sat downstairs, men and women, old and young, all kinds of people. — Feng Yuxiang, 'My Life', Chapter 34

explanation: 原指战国时代楚国民间流行的一种歌曲。比喻通俗的文学艺术。
explanationTraditional: 原指戰國時代楚國民間流行的一種歌曲。比喻通俗的文學藝術。
explanationEn: Originally a popular folk song in the State of Chu during the Warring States period. Metaphor for popular literature and art.
derivation: 战国楚·宋玉《对楚王问》客有歌于郢中者，其始曰‘下里巴人’，国中属而和者数千人。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國楚·宋玉《對楚王問》客有歌於郢中者，其始曰‘下里巴人’，國中屬而和者數千人。”
derivationEn: Warring States Chu, Song Yu's 'Reply to the King of Chu': 'A guest sang in Yingdu, starting with 'Xialiba Ren', and thousands in the state joined in.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 说的话有道理。
explanationTraditional: 說的話有道理。
explanationEn: What is said is reasonable.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第四十八回陈老道‘言之有理。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第四十八回陳老道‘言之有理。’”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 48: 'Elder Chen said, 'What you say is reasonable.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 生灵百姓；涂泥沼；炭炭火。人民陷在泥塘和火坑里。形容人民处于极端困苦的境地。
explanationTraditional: 生靈百姓；塗泥沼；炭炭火。人民陷在泥塘和火坑裡。形容人民處於極端困苦的境地。
explanationEn: The people are trapped in mud and fire. Describes people in extreme misery.
derivation: 《尚书·仲虺之诰》有夏昏德，民坠涂炭。”《晋书·苻丕载记》先帝晏驾贼庭，京师鞠为戎穴，神州萧条，生灵涂炭。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·仲虺之誥》有夏昏德，民墜塗炭。”《晉書·苻丕載記》先帝晏駕賊庭，京師鞠為戎穴，神州蕭條，生靈塗炭。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents': 'Xia's ruler was benighted, the people fell into mud and fire.' 'Book of Jin': 'The late emperor died among rebels, the capital became a den of thieves, the land desolate, the people in misery.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指偷窃的行为。也指不正经的勾当。
explanationTraditional: 指偷竊的行為。也指不正經的勾當。
explanationEn: Refers to stealing or improper activities.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十六回小人如今在此，只做得些偷鸡盗狗的勾当，几时是了；跟随的二位哥哥上山去，却不好？”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十六回小人如今在此，只做得些偷雞盜狗的勾當，幾時是了；跟隨的二位哥哥上山去，卻不好？”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 46: 'I only do petty theft here; when will it end? Better to follow you two brothers up the mountain.'
example: 成日家～，腥的臭的，都拉了你屋里去！★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 成日家～，腥的臭的，都拉了你屋裡去！★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十四回
exampleEn: Every day you engage in petty theft and bring all sorts of smelly things into your room! — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 44

explanation: 眼睛被一片树叶挡住，指看不到事物的全貌。
explanationTraditional: 眼睛被一片樹葉擋住，指看不到事物的全貌。
explanationEn: A leaf blocking the eye prevents seeing the whole picture.
derivation: 毛泽东《论持久战》一叶障目，不见泰山，而自以为是。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《論持久戰》一葉障目，不見泰山，而自以為是。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'On Protracted War': 'A leaf before the eye blocks Mount Tai, yet one is self-righteous.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 汝你。玉汝像爱惜玉一样爱护、帮助你。爱你如玉，帮助你，使你成功。多用于艰难困苦条件下。
explanationTraditional: 汝你。玉汝像愛惜玉一樣愛護、幫助你。愛你如玉，幫助你，使你成功。多用於艱難困苦條件下。
explanationEn: To cherish and help you like jade, enabling you to succeed. Often used in the context of difficult conditions.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 孑单独。孤孤单单一个人。
explanationTraditional: 孑單獨。孤孤單單一個人。
explanationEn: All alone; solitary.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·陆瑁传》若实孑然，无所凭赖，其畏怖远迸，或难卒灭。”宋·周煇《清波杂志》卷八兼渠孑然一身，无所依倚，处性不能自立。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·陸瑁傳》若實孑然，無所憑賴，其畏怖遠迸，或難卒滅。”宋·周煇《清波雜誌》卷八兼渠孑然一身，無所依倚，處性不能自立。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms·Book of Wu·Biography of Lu Mao': 'If truly alone, with nothing to rely on, their fear and flight may be hard to end.' Also from Song Dynasty Zhou Hui's 'Qingbo Magazine': 'And he, all alone, with no one to depend on, unable to establish himself.'
example: 只是公子～，又没盘缠，怎能够装载回去。（明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二十七）
exampleTraditional: 只是公子～，又沒盤纏，怎能夠裝載回去。（明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二十七）
exampleEn: But the young master was all alone, with no travel money, how could he load and go back? (From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 27)

explanation: 颦皱眉。指忧和喜的表情。
explanationTraditional: 顰皺眉。指憂和喜的表情。
explanationEn: Expressions of worry and happiness; every frown and smile.
derivation: 《韩非子·内储说左上》吾闻明主之爱，一颦一笑，颦有为颦，而笑有为笑。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·內儲說左上》吾聞明主之愛，一顰一笑，顰有為顰，而笑有為笑。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi·Inner Congeries of Sayings, Upper Left': 'I have heard that a wise ruler's love is shown in every frown and smile; a frown for a reason, and a smile for a reason.'
example: 金门玉堂临水居，～千万余。★南朝梁·萧统《龙笛曲》
exampleTraditional: 金門玉堂臨水居，～千萬餘。★南朝梁·蕭統《龍笛曲》
exampleEn: By the golden gate and jade hall near the water, a thousand frowns and smiles. (From Southern Liang Dynasty Xiao Tong's 'Dragon Flute Song')

explanation: 度考虑。放在考虑之外。指不把个人的生死利害等放在心上。
explanationTraditional: 度考慮。放在考慮之外。指不把個人的生死利害等放在心上。
explanationEn: To disregard; to not take into consideration (usually personal gains, losses, life, death, etc.).
derivation: 《后汉书·隗嚣传》帝积苦兵间，以嚣子内侍，公孙述远据边陲，乃谓诸将曰‘且当置此两子于度外耳。’”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·隗囂傳》帝積苦兵間，以囂子內侍，公孫述遠據邊陲，乃謂諸將曰‘且當置此兩子於度外耳。’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han·Biography of Wei Xiao': 'The emperor, weary of war, with Wei Xiao's son as a hostage and Gongsun Shu far away, said to his generals: 'Let us put these two aside for now.''
example: 七十老翁，死生早～，由他去吧。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 七十老翁，死生早～，由他去吧。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十七回
exampleEn: A seventy-year-old man has long disregarded life and death; let him go. (From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Retribution', Chapter 27)

explanation: 白搞清楚。没有得到辩白或洗刷的冤屈。
explanationTraditional: 白搞清楚。沒有得到辯白或洗刷的冤屈。
explanationEn: An unredressed injustice; a wrong that has not been cleared up.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第四十二回唅之逃，非贪生怕死，实欲为太叔伸不白之冤耳！”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第四十二回唅之逃，非貪生怕死，實欲為太叔伸不白之冤耳！”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 42: 'My escape was not out of fear of death, but to clear the unredressed injustice for the Grand Uncle!'
example: 若非屡次验明，则其姊受～，未老先生亦蒙羞于地下，不孝子弟，罪不容诛。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 若非屢次驗明，則其姊受～，未老先生亦蒙羞於地下，不孝子弟，罪不容誅。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第十八回
exampleEn: If not repeatedly verified, his sister would suffer an unredressed injustice, and the old gentleman would be disgraced in the underworld; the unfilial son deserves death. (From Qing Dynasty Xia Jingqu's 'Exposure of the Marvelous', Chapter 18)

explanation: 胆子非常小，怕事情落在自己头上，怕惹麻烦。
explanationTraditional: 膽子非常小，怕事情落在自己頭上，怕惹麻煩。
explanationEn: Timid and afraid of getting into trouble; overly cautious.
derivation: 巴金《谈〈寒夜〉》他后来竟变成了一个胆小怕事、见人低头、懦弱安分、甘受欺侮的小公务员。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《談〈寒夜〉》他後來竟變成了一個膽小怕事、見人低頭、懦弱安分、甘受欺侮的小公務員。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin's 'On 'Cold Nights'': 'He later became a timid, submissive, weak, and obedient petty clerk who endured bullying.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 道家指侍奉仙人的童男童女◇泛指天真无邪的男孩女孩。
explanationTraditional: 道家指侍奉仙人的童男童女◇泛指天真無邪的男孩女孩。
explanationEn: In Taoism, the boy and girl attendants of immortals; later, innocent and pure boys and girls.
derivation: 唐·徐彦伯《幸白鹿观应制》诗金童擎紫药，玉女献青莲。”元·李好古《张生煮海》第一折金童玉女意投机，才子佳人世罕稀。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·徐彥伯《幸白鹿觀應制》詩金童擎紫藥，玉女獻青蓮。”元·李好古《張生煮海》第一折金童玉女意投機，才子佳人世罕稀。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Xu Yanbo's poem 'Responding to the Imperial Visit to White Deer Temple': 'Golden boy holding purple medicine, jade girl offering green lotus.' Also from Yuan Dynasty Li Haogu's 'Zhang Sheng Boils the Sea', first act: 'Golden boy and jade girl share mutual affection; talented scholars and beautiful women are rare in the world.'
example: 刚一到上海这魔窟”，吴老太爷的～”就变了！★茅盾《子夜》一
exampleTraditional: 剛一到上海這魔窟”，吳老太爺的～”就變了！★茅盾《子夜》一
exampleEn: As soon as they arrived in Shanghai, this 'den of devils', Old Master Wu's 'golden boy and jade girl' changed! (From Mao Dun's 'Midnight', Chapter 1)

explanation: 原指人呼吸时，吐出浊气，吸进新鲜空气。现多用来比喻扬弃旧的、不好的，吸收新的，好的。
explanationTraditional: 原指人呼吸時，吐出濁氣，吸進新鮮空氣。現多用來比喻揚棄舊的、不好的，吸收新的，好的。
explanationEn: Originally, to exhale stale air and inhale fresh air; now metaphorically, to discard the old and absorb the new.
derivation: 《庄子·刻意》吹呴呼吸，吐故纳新。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·刻意》吹呴呼吸，吐故納新。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi·Deliberate Action': 'Exhaling and inhaling, expelling the stale and taking in the fresh.'
example: 最人涅伏，～，败果既落，新葩欲吐。★鲁迅《集外集·说鈤》
exampleTraditional: 最人涅伏，～，敗果既落，新葩欲吐。★魯迅《集外集·說鈤》
exampleEn: The most advanced nerves, expelling the stale and taking in the fresh; as the rotten fruit falls, new buds are about to bloom. (From Lu Xun's 'Collection of Essays·On Radium')

explanation: 趁着双方争执不下而从中得到好处。同渔人得利”。
explanationTraditional: 趁著雙方爭執不下而從中得到好處。同漁人得利”。
explanationEn: To profit from a dispute between others; same as '渔人得利'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 道貌正经严肃的容貌；岸然高傲的样子。指神态严肃，一本正经的样子。
explanationTraditional: 道貌正經嚴肅的容貌；岸然高傲的樣子。指神態嚴肅，一本正經的樣子。
explanationEn: To appear stern and solemn; to look righteous and dignified.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·成仙》又八九年，成忽自至，黄巾氅服，岸然道貌。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·成仙》又八九年，成忽自至，黃巾氅服，岸然道貌。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio·Cheng the Immortal': 'After another eight or nine years, Cheng suddenly appeared, wearing a yellow turban and a cloak, with a stern and solemn demeanor.'
example: 因看见端甫～，不敢造次。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一百四回
exampleTraditional: 因看見端甫～，不敢造次。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一百四回
exampleEn: Seeing Duanfu's stern and solemn appearance, he dared not act rashly. (From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 104)

explanation: 涕眼泪。一下子停止了哭泣，露出笑容。形容转悲为喜。
explanationTraditional: 涕眼淚。一下子停止了哭泣，露出笑容。形容轉悲為喜。
explanationEn: To turn tears into laughter; to change from sadness to joy.
derivation: 晋·刘琨《答卢堪书》时复相与举觞对膝，破涕为笑。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·劉琨《答盧堪書》時復相與舉觴對膝，破涕為笑。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Liu Kun's 'Reply to Lu Chen's Letter': 'Sometimes we would raise our glasses face to face, turning tears into laughter.'
example: 她很高兴地赞同这个计划，并且～地说她有逃的办法。★巴金《家》二十八
exampleTraditional: 她很高興地贊同這個計劃，並且～地說她有逃的辦法。★巴金《家》二十八
exampleEn: She happily agreed to the plan and, turning tears into laughter, said she had a way to escape. ★ Ba Jin's 'Family' Chapter 28

explanation: 丧丧失；辱使受到耻辱。丧失主权，使国家蒙受耻辱。
explanationTraditional: 喪喪失；辱使受到恥辱。喪失主權，使國家蒙受恥辱。
explanationEn: To forfeit sovereignty and bring humiliation to the nation; to sign treaties that harm national interests.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 清政府腐败无能，与英法等列强签订了许多丧权辱国的不平行条约。
exampleTraditional: 清政府腐敗無能，與英法等列強簽訂了許多喪權辱國的不平行條約。
exampleEn: The corrupt and incompetent Qing government signed many treaties that forfeited sovereignty and humiliated the nation with the British, French, and other powers.

explanation: 由从；衷内心。话不是打心眼里说出来的，即说的不是真心话。指心口不一致。
explanationTraditional: 由從；衷內心。話不是打心眼裡說出來的，即說的不是真心話。指心口不一致。
explanationEn: Words not from the heart; to speak insincerely or with a hidden agenda.
derivation: 《左传·隐公三年》 信不由中，质无益也。”杨伯峻注人言为信，中同衷。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公三年》 信不由中，質無益也。”楊伯峻注人言為信，中同衷。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: The Third Year of Duke Yin': 'If trust does not come from within, pledges are useless.' Yang Bojun's annotation: 'Words from a person constitute trust; zhong (heart) is the same as zhong (inner).'
example: 旋复下一通令，洋洋洒洒，约一二千言，小子因他～，不愿详录。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 旋復下一通令，洋洋灑灑，約一二千言，小子因他～，不願詳錄。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第二十八回
exampleEn: Then another order was issued, lengthy and verbose, about a thousand words. I, the author, found it insincere and did not wish to record it in detail. ★ Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China' Chapter 28

explanation: 招招收；贤有德有才的人；纳接受；士指读书人。招收贤士，接纳书生。指网罗人才。
explanationTraditional: 招招收；賢有德有才的人；納接受；士指讀書人。招收賢士，接納書生。指網羅人才。
explanationEn: To recruit virtuous and talented people; to welcome scholars and talents.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策一》燕昭王即位，卑身厚币以招贤者。”元·马致远《陈抟高卧》第二折早则是泽及黎民，又待要招贤纳士礼殷勤，币帛降玄纁。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策一》燕昭王即位，卑身厚幣以招賢者。”元·馬致遠《陳摶高臥》第二折早則是澤及黎民，又待要招賢納士禮殷勤，幣帛降玄纁。”
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States: Yan Strategy I': 'King Zhao of Yan ascended the throne, humbled himself, and offered generous gifts to recruit the virtuous.' Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan's 'Chen Tuan Lies Aloft' Act 2: 'He has already benefited the people, and now he wants to recruit the virtuous and talented with courtesy and gifts of silk and jade.'
example: 这里有个～好汉柴大官人。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第九回
exampleTraditional: 這裡有個～好漢柴大官人。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第九回
exampleEn: There is a generous man named Chai who recruits the virtuous and talented. ★ Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 9

explanation: 碧空浅蓝色的天空。蓝色的天空明净得像洗过一样。形容天气晴朗。
explanationTraditional: 碧空淺藍色的天空。藍色的天空明淨得像洗過一樣。形容天氣晴朗。
explanationEn: The blue sky is as clear as if washed; describing a very clear and sunny day.
derivation: 宋·张元干《水调歌头》词万里碧空如洗，寒浸十分明月，帘卷玉波流。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張元幹《水調歌頭》詞萬里碧空如洗，寒浸十分明月，簾卷玉波流。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhang Yuangan's 'Prelude to Water Melody': 'The vast blue sky is as clear as washed, the cold moon soaks the bright moonlight, the curtain rolls over the jade waves.'
example: 其时～，有一群大雁鹅正排成人字从高空中飞过。★沈从文《长河·秋（动中有静）》
exampleTraditional: 其時～，有一群大雁鵝正排成人字從高空中飛過。★沈從文《長河·秋（動中有靜）》
exampleEn: At that time, the sky was clear as washed, and a flock of wild geese was flying in a V-formation high above. ★ Shen Congwen's 'Long River: Autumn (Stillness in Motion)'

explanation: 逸放荡。原指骄横、奢侈、荒淫、放荡四种恶习◇形容生活放纵奢侈，荒淫无度。
explanationTraditional: 逸放蕩。原指驕橫、奢侈、荒淫、放蕩四種惡習◇形容生活放縱奢侈，荒淫無度。
explanationEn: Arrogant, extravagant, licentious, and idle; describing a life of luxury and debauchery.
derivation: 《左传·隐公三年》骄奢淫佚，所自邪也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公三年》驕奢淫佚，所自邪也。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: The Third Year of Duke Yin': 'Arrogance, extravagance, licentiousness, and idleness are the paths to evil.'
example: 况且是丰厚这之家，本有～之资；况且是寡妇之子，又有信惯纵放之端。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 況且是豐厚這之家，本有～之資；況且是寡婦之子，又有信慣縱放之端。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第二十一回
exampleEn: Moreover, being from a wealthy family, they had the means for arrogance, extravagance, licentiousness, and idleness; moreover, being the son of a widow, there was a tendency to spoil and indulge. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan's 'The Lantern at the Crossroads' Chapter 21

explanation: 替百姓除祸害。
explanationTraditional: 替百姓除禍害。
explanationEn: To remove evils or pests for the people; to eliminate harmful elements for the public good.
derivation: 汉·陈琳《檄吴将校部曲文》丞相衔奉国威，为民除害，元恶大憝，心当枭夷。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·陳琳《檄吳將校部曲文》丞相銜奉國威，為民除害，元惡大憝，心當梟夷。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Chen Lin's 'Proclamation to Wu Generals and Soldiers': 'The Prime Minister, upholding the nation's prestige, removes evils for the people; the chief villain and great criminal will surely be executed.'
example: 自然以～为主。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第七回
exampleTraditional: 自然以～為主。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第七回
exampleEn: Naturally, the main goal is to remove evils for the people. ★ Qing Dynasty, Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can' Chapter 7

explanation: 忠忠诚；贞有操守；渝改变。忠诚坚定，永不改变。
explanationTraditional: 忠忠誠；貞有操守；渝改變。忠誠堅定，永不改變。
explanationEn: Loyal and steadfast, never changing; unwavering in loyalty and commitment.
derivation: 张扬《第二次握手》我始终期望着，有朝一日，把自己的学识、才能献给祖国；同时把自己忠贞不渝的感情，完美无缺地献给你。”
derivationTraditional: 張揚《第二次握手》我始終期望著，有朝一日，把自己的學識、才能獻給祖國；同時把自己忠貞不渝的感情，完美無缺地獻給你。”
derivationEn: Zhang Yang's 'The Second Handshake': 'I have always hoped that one day I could dedicate my knowledge and talent to my motherland, and offer my unwavering loyalty and perfect love to you.'
example: 他对党对人民的～。
exampleTraditional: 他對黨對人民的～。
exampleEn: His unwavering loyalty to the Party and the people.

explanation: 天下闻名。形容名声极大。
explanationTraditional: 天下聞名。形容名聲極大。
explanationEn: Famous throughout the world; having a great reputation everywhere.
derivation: 《管子·白心》名满于天下，不若其已也。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·白心》名滿於天下，不若其已也。”
derivationEn: 'Guanzi: Baixin': 'Being famous throughout the world is not as good as stopping.'
example: 执事～，而位不过五品，其容色温然而不怒，其文章宽厚敦朴而无怨言。★宋·苏轼《上梅直讲书》
exampleTraditional: 執事～，而位不過五品，其容色溫然而不怒，其文章寬厚敦樸而無怨言。★宋·蘇軾《上梅直講書》
exampleEn: Your reputation is known throughout the world, yet your rank is only fifth grade. Your countenance is warm and without anger, your writings are generous and honest without complaint. ★ Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Letter to Magistrate Mei'

explanation: 心怀恻隐而不忍下手。
explanationTraditional: 心懷惻隱而不忍下手。
explanationEn: Soft-hearted and hesitant to act; to be lenient or reluctant to use force.
derivation: 金近《他叫东郭先生”》他下定决心，往后不再心慈手软了。”
derivationTraditional: 金近《他叫東郭先生”》他下定決心，往後不再心慈手軟了。”
derivationEn: Jin Jin's 'He Is Called Mr. Dongguo': 'He made up his mind not to be soft-hearted anymore.'
example: 在这场斗争中，我们决不能～。★《人民日报》1976.11.4
exampleTraditional: 在這場鬥爭中，我們決不能～。★《人民日報》1976.11.4
exampleEn: In this struggle, we must not be soft-hearted. ★ 'People's Daily' November 4, 1976

explanation: 悲天哀叹时世；悯人怜惜众人。指哀叹时世的艰难，怜惜人们的痛苦。
explanationTraditional: 悲天哀嘆時世；憫人憐惜眾人。指哀嘆時世的艱難，憐惜人們的痛苦。
explanationEn: To lament the hardships of the times and pity the suffering of the people.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《争臣论》彼二圣一贤者，岂不知自安佚之为乐哉？诚畏天命而悲人穷也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《爭臣論》彼二聖一賢者，豈不知自安佚之為樂哉？誠畏天命而悲人窮也。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Disputation on the Minister': 'Those two sages and one worthy, how could they not know the comfort of self-indulgence? Truly they feared the mandate of heaven and pitied the poverty of the people.'
example: 君生平绝口弗谈政治，独其～之怀，流露于不自觉，有如此者。★柳亚子《燕子龛遗诗序》
exampleTraditional: 君生平絕口弗談政治，獨其～之懷，流露於不自覺，有如此者。★柳亞子《燕子龕遺詩序》
exampleEn: Throughout his life, he never spoke of politics, yet his compassionate heart for the times and people revealed itself unconsciously, as seen here. — Liu Yazi, 'Preface to the Remaining Poems of Swallow Niche'

explanation: 具体各部分已大体具备；微微小。指事物的各个组成部分大体都有了，不过形状和规模比较小些。
explanationTraditional: 具體各部分已大體具備；微微小。指事物的各個組成部分大體都有了，不過形狀和規模比較小些。
explanationEn: Having all the parts but on a smaller scale; miniature but complete in form.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》冉牛、闵子、颜渊，则具体而微。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》冉牛、閔子、顏淵，則具體而微。”
derivationEn: 'Mencius, Gongsun Chou I': 'Ran Niu, Min Zi, and Yan Yuan are complete in essentials but on a smaller scale.'
example: 所居有池五六亩，竹数千竿，乔木数十株，台榭舟桥，～。★唐·白居易《醉吟先生传》
exampleTraditional: 所居有池五六畝，竹數千竿，喬木數十株，臺榭舟橋，～。★唐·白居易《醉吟先生傳》
exampleEn: His residence had a pond of about five mu, thousands of bamboo, dozens of tall trees, and pavilions, terraces, boats, and bridges, all complete in miniature. — Tang Dynasty, Bai Juyi, 'Biography of Drunken Hermit'

explanation: 顽固地坚持自己的意见，不肯改变。
explanationTraditional: 頑固地堅持自己的意見，不肯改變。
explanationEn: Stubbornly adhere to one's own opinions, refusing to change.
derivation: 《旧唐书·李纲传》时左仆射杨素、苏威当朝，纲每固执所见，不与之同，由是二人深恶之。”《宋史·陈宓传》固执己见，动失人心。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·李綱傳》時左僕射楊素、蘇威當朝，綱每固執所見，不與之同，由是二人深惡之。”《宋史·陳宓傳》固執己見，動失人心。”
derivationEn: 'Old Book of Tang, Biography of Li Gang': 'At that time, Left Vice Director Yang Su and Su Wei were in power, but Li Gang always stubbornly held his own views, disagreeing with them, thus deeply hated by the two.' 'History of Song, Biography of Chen Mi': 'Stubbornly clinging to one's own views, losing people's hearts.'
example: 冯贵堂听父亲不赞成他的主张，他想到人，一上了年纪，就爱～，偏重保守了！”★梁斌《红旗谱》八
exampleTraditional: 馮貴堂聽父親不贊成他的主張，他想到人，一上了年紀，就愛～，偏重保守了！”★梁斌《紅旗譜》八
exampleEn: Feng Guitang, hearing his father disapproved of his ideas, thought that once people get old, they tend to be stubborn and conservative! — Liang Bin, 'Red Flag Chronicle' Chapter 8

explanation: 原比喻不知政权会落在谁的手里。现在也泛指在竞赛中不知谁会取得最后的胜利。
explanationTraditional: 原比喻不知政權會落在誰的手裡。現在也泛指在競賽中不知誰會取得最後的勝利。
explanationEn: Originally meant not knowing who would seize political power; now generally refers to uncertainty about the final winner in a competition.
derivation: 《晋书·石勒载记下》朕若逢高皇，当北面而事之，与韩、彭鞭而争先耳；脱遇光武，当并驱于中原，未知鹿死谁手。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·石勒載記下》朕若逢高皇，當北面而事之，與韓、彭鞭而爭先耳；脫遇光武，當並驅於中原，未知鹿死誰手。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin, Biography of Shi Le, Part 2': 'If I met Emperor Gaozu, I would serve him facing north, and compete with Han Xin and Peng Yue for precedence; if I met Emperor Guangwu, I would race with him in the central plains, not knowing who would catch the deer.'
example: 古人把争天下比做逐鹿中原”。也只有稳据中原，才能定～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第四十七章
exampleTraditional: 古人把爭天下比做逐鹿中原”。也只有穩據中原，才能定～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第四十七章
exampleEn: The ancients compared the struggle for the world to 'chasing the deer in the central plains.' Only by firmly controlling the central plains can one determine who will win. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng' Volume 2, Chapter 47

explanation: 药治疗。病已重到无法用药医治的程度。比喻已经到了无法挽救的地步。
explanationTraditional: 藥治療。病已重到無法用藥醫治的程度。比喻已經到了無法挽救的地步。
explanationEn: Beyond cure; incurable; hopeless.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·板》匪我言耄，尔用忧谑。多将熇熇，不可救药。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·板》匪我言耄，爾用憂謔。多將熇熇，不可救藥。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs, Greater Odes, Ban': 'It is not that I am old and foolish, but you use seriousness as a joke. When things are raging, they are beyond cure.'
example: 但彼此内溃已久，～，只能听之而已。★鲁迅《书信集·致许寿裳》
exampleTraditional: 但彼此內潰已久，～，只能聽之而已。★魯迅《書信集·致許壽裳》
exampleEn: But internal decay had long been beyond cure, so we could only let it be. — Lu Xun, 'Collected Letters: To Xu Shoushang'

explanation: 一刀斩为两段。比喻坚决断绝关系。
explanationTraditional: 一刀斬為兩段。比喻堅決斷絕關係。
explanationEn: To cut in two with one stroke; to make a clean break.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十二一刀两段，未称宗师。”《朱子语类》卷四十四观此可见克己者是从根源上一刀两断，便斩绝了，更不复萌。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十二一刀兩段，未稱宗師。”《朱子語類》卷四十四觀此可見克己者是從根源上一刀兩斷，便斬絕了，更不復萌。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting the Source' Volume 12: 'Cutting in two with one stroke is not yet a true master.' 'Zhu Xi's Classified Conversations' Volume 44: 'This shows that self-restraint is to cut off at the root with one stroke, never to sprout again.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指官职。
explanationTraditional: 泛指官職。
explanationEn: A minor official post; some sort of government position.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第四本第四折都则为一官半职，阻隔千山万水。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第四本第四折都則為一官半職，阻隔千山萬水。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing' Act 4, Scene 4: 'All because of a minor official post, blocking thousands of mountains and rivers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 江河的水一天天地向下流。比喻情况一天天地坏下去。
explanationTraditional: 江河的水一天天地向下流。比喻情況一天天地壞下去。
explanationEn: Things go from bad to worse; to deteriorate day by day.
derivation: 宋·苏辙《栾城集·应诏进策·君术策第五道》其状如长江大河，日夜浑浑趋于下而不能止。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇轍《欒城集·應詔進策·君術策第五道》其狀如長江大河，日夜渾渾趨於下而不能止。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Su Zhe's 'Collected Works of Luancheng, Memorials, Strategy for the Sovereign, Fifth': 'Its condition is like the Yangtze and Yellow Rivers, flowing turbulently day and night downward without stopping.'
example: 不瞒大师说，现在的时势，实在是～了！★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十九回
exampleTraditional: 不瞞大師說，現在的時勢，實在是～了！★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十九回
exampleEn: To be honest with you, Master, the current situation is indeed going from bad to worse! — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure' Chapter 29

explanation: 过高地看待自己。形容狂妄自大，不把别人放眼里。
explanationTraditional: 過高地看待自己。形容狂妄自大，不把別人放眼裡。
explanationEn: To be overweening; to be arrogant and self-important.
derivation: 《后汉书·马援传》子阳井底蛙耳，而妄自尊大，不如专意东方。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·馬援傳》子陽井底蛙耳，而妄自尊大，不如專意東方。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Later Han, Biography of Ma Yuan': 'Ziyang is a frog at the bottom of a well, yet he is arrogantly self-important; it is better to focus on the east.'
example: 王冕接过来看，才晓得危素归降之后，～，在太祖面前自称老臣。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第一回
exampleTraditional: 王冕接過來看，才曉得危素歸降之後，～，在太祖面前自稱老臣。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第一回
exampleEn: Wang Mian took it and read, only then realizing that after Wei Su surrendered to the Ming, he became arrogant, calling himself an old minister in front of Emperor Taizu. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars' Chapter 1

explanation: 囫囵整个儿。把枣整个咽下去，不加咀嚼，不辨滋味。比喻对事物不加分析思考。
explanationTraditional: 囫圇整個兒。把棗整個嚥下去，不加咀嚼，不辨滋味。比喻對事物不加分析思考。
explanationEn: To swallow a date whole; to read or learn without understanding or analyzing.
derivation: 宋·圆悟禅师《碧岩录》卷三若是知有底人，细嚼来咽；若是不知有底人，一似浑仑吞个枣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·圓悟禪師《碧巖錄》卷三若是知有底人，細嚼來咽；若是不知有底人，一似渾侖吞個棗。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Yuanwu Keqin's 'Blue Cliff Record' Volume 3: 'If one knows the truth, chew carefully and swallow; if not, it's like swallowing a date whole.'
example: 一个高中文科的学生，与其～或走马看花地读十部诗集，不如仔仔细细地背诵三百首诗。★朱自清《论诗学门径》
exampleTraditional: 一個高中文科的學生，與其～或走馬看花地讀十部詩集，不如仔仔細細地背誦三百首詩。★朱自清《論詩學門徑》
exampleEn: A high school liberal arts student would be better off carefully memorizing three hundred poems than swallowing ten poetry collections whole or skimming them. — Zhu Ziqing, 'On the Approach to Poetry'

explanation: 又想这样又想那样，犹豫不定。常指不安心，不专一。
explanationTraditional: 又想這樣又想那樣，猶豫不定。常指不安心，不專一。
explanationEn: To be indecisive or wavering, often implying lack of concentration or single-mindedness.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《救风尘》第一折争奈是匪妓，都三心二意。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《救風塵》第一折爭奈是匪妓，都三心二意。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'Rescuing a Prostitute' in the Yuan Dynasty: 'But she is a prostitute, always half-hearted.'
example: 可是眼下大敌当前，后有追兵，你可千万不要～，迟疑不决，误了大事。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第四章
exampleTraditional: 可是眼下大敵當前，後有追兵，你可千萬不要～，遲疑不決，誤了大事。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第四章
exampleEn: But now with the enemy in front and pursuers behind, you must not be indecisive and delay the important matter. (Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Vol. 1, Ch. 4)

explanation: 饱充分；经经历；风霜比喻艰难困苦。形容经历过长期的艰难困苦的生活和斗争。
explanationTraditional: 飽充分；經經歷；風霜比喻艱難困苦。形容經歷過長期的艱難困苦的生活和鬥爭。
explanationEn: To have experienced many hardships and difficulties in life.
derivation: 清·孔尚任《桃花扇》第二十一出鸡皮瘦损，看饱经雪霜，丝鬓如银。”
derivationTraditional: 清·孔尚任《桃花扇》第二十一出雞皮瘦損，看飽經雪霜，絲鬢如銀。”
derivationEn: From Kong Shangren's 'The Peach Blossom Fan' in the Qing Dynasty: 'Skin wrinkled and thin, having weathered storms, hair like silver threads.'
example: 人们那被晒黑的～的脸上，显出严肃而紧张的神情。★冯德英《苦菜花》第一章
exampleTraditional: 人們那被曬黑的～的臉上，顯出嚴肅而緊張的神情。★馮德英《苦菜花》第一章
exampleEn: Their sunburned, weather-beaten faces showed a serious and tense expression. (Feng Deying, 'Bitter Cauliflower', Ch. 1)

explanation: 随附和。原指封建社会认为妻子必须服从丈夫，后比喻夫妻和好相处。
explanationTraditional: 隨附和。原指封建社會認為妻子必須服從丈夫，後比喻夫妻和好相處。
explanationEn: Originally meant that a wife should obey her husband in feudal society; now used to describe a harmonious couple.
derivation: 《关尹子·三极》天下之理，夫者倡，妇者随。”
derivationTraditional: 《關尹子·三極》天下之理，夫者倡，婦者隨。”
derivationEn: From 'Master Guan Yin·Three Extremes': 'The principle of the world: the husband leads, the wife follows.'
example: 春郎夫妻也各自默默地祷祝。自此上下和睦，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 春郎夫妻也各自默默地禱祝。自此上下和睦，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十
exampleEn: The couple Chunlang and his wife silently prayed. From then on, the family was harmonious, and the husband and wife lived in harmony. (Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Amazement', Vol. 20)

explanation: 招展迎风摆动的样子。形容打扮得十分艳丽。
explanationTraditional: 招展迎風擺動的樣子。形容打扮得十分豔麗。
explanationEn: Describes a woman dressed very showily or gaudily.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十二回袭人等捧过茶来，才吃了一口，平儿也打扮的花枝招展的来了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十二回襲人等捧過茶來，才吃了一口，平兒也打扮的花枝招展的來了。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Ch. 62: 'Xiren brought tea, and just as she took a sip, Ping'er arrived, dressed in all her finery.'
example: 墙边一排一排的板凳上，坐着粉白黛绿，～的妇女们，笑语盈盈的不休。★冰心《六一姊》
exampleTraditional: 牆邊一排一排的板凳上，坐著粉白黛綠，～的婦女們，笑語盈盈的不休。★冰心《六一姊》
exampleEn: On the benches along the wall sat women with powdered faces and painted eyebrows, dressed in all their finery, chatting and laughing endlessly. (Bing Xin, 'Sixth Sister')

explanation: 饴麦芽糖‖着糖逗小孙子玩。形容晚年生活的乐趣。
explanationTraditional: 飴麥芽糖‖著糖逗小孫子玩。形容晚年生活的樂趣。
explanationEn: To enjoy the pleasures of old age by playing with grandchildren.
derivation: 《后汉书·明德马皇后纪》吾但当含饴弄孙，不能复知政事。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·明德馬皇后紀》吾但當含飴弄孫，不能復知政事。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han·Biography of Empress Ma': 'I only want to play with my grandchildren and not be involved in politics.'
example: 佳儿佳妇，吾将～，不复理家政矣。★清·淮阴百一居士《壶天录》
exampleTraditional: 佳兒佳婦，吾將～，不復理家政矣。★清·淮陰百一居士《壺天錄》
exampleEn: With good sons and daughters-in-law, I will enjoy playing with my grandchildren and no longer manage household affairs. (Huaiyin Baiyi Jushi, 'Records of the Sky')

explanation: 布满山岭田野。形容数量多或范围广。
explanationTraditional: 佈滿山嶺田野。形容數量多或範圍廣。
explanationEn: Covering mountains and fields; describes a large number or wide range.
derivation: 杜鹏程《保卫延安》第二章他坐镇延安，用红蓝铅笔在地图上乱画，我们就满山遍野乱窜！”
derivationTraditional: 杜鵬程《保衛延安》第二章他坐鎮延安，用紅藍鉛筆在地圖上亂畫，我們就滿山遍野亂竄！”
derivationEn: From Du Pengcheng's 'Defending Yan'an', Ch. 2: 'He sat in Yan'an, scribbling on the map with a red and blue pencil, and we ran all over the mountains and fields!'
example: 这时候就像塌了天一样，～都是大人哭孩子叫的声音。
exampleTraditional: 這時候就像塌了天一樣，～都是大人哭孩子叫的聲音。
exampleEn: At that moment, it was as if the sky had fallen, with adults crying and children screaming all over the mountains and fields.

explanation: 丝丝每一根丝；扣织机上的主要机件之一。织布时每条丝线都要从筘齿间穿过。比喻做得十分细致，有条不紊，一一合拍。
explanationTraditional: 絲絲每一根絲；扣織機上的主要機件之一。織布時每條絲線都要從筘齒間穿過。比喻做得十分細緻，有條不紊，一一合拍。
explanationEn: Describes doing something meticulously, in perfect order, and in harmony.
derivation: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第二十七回此为丝丝入扣，暗中抛索，如道家所云三神山舟不得近，近者辄被风引回也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第二十七回此為絲絲入扣，暗中拋索，如道家所云三神山舟不得近，近者輒被風引回也。”
derivationEn: From Xia Jingqu's 'A Rustic's Idle Talk' in the Qing Dynasty, Ch. 27: 'This is like every thread going through the reed, secretly casting a line, like the three divine mountains in Taoism that cannot be approached.'
example: 而那些曲折微妙的声口，也～，千载如出。（朱自清《经典常谈·战国策第八》）
exampleTraditional: 而那些曲折微妙的聲口，也～，千載如出。（朱自清《經典常談·戰國策第八》）
exampleEn: And those subtle and intricate tones are also perfectly matched, as if from a thousand years ago. (Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Talks·Warring States Policy VIII')

explanation: 揠拔。把苗拔起，以助其生长。比喻违反事物发展的客观规律，急于求成，反而把事情弄糟。
explanationTraditional: 揠拔。把苗拔起，以助其生長。比喻違反事物發展的客觀規律，急於求成，反而把事情弄糟。
explanationEn: To pull up seedlings to help them grow; metaphor for being too eager for quick results, which spoils things.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》宋人有闵其苗之不长而揠之者，茫茫然归，谓其人曰‘今日病矣，予助苗长矣。’其子趋而往视之，苗则槁矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》宋人有閔其苗之不長而揠之者，茫茫然歸，謂其人曰‘今日病矣，予助苗長矣。’其子趨而往視之，苗則槁矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius·Gongsun Chou I': 'A man of Song, worried about his seedlings not growing, pulled them up. He returned home tired and said, 'I am exhausted today, I helped the seedlings grow.' His son ran to look, and the seedlings were withered.'
example: 对学生的教育既不能～，也不能放任自流。
exampleTraditional: 對學生的教育既不能～，也不能放任自流。
exampleEn: Education of students should neither be forced like pulling up seedlings nor left unchecked.

explanation: 关起门来不外出，指杜绝与外界交往。
explanationTraditional: 關起門來不外出，指杜絕與外界交往。
explanationEn: To shut oneself indoors and not go out; to cut off contact with the outside world.
derivation: 南朝·宋·范晔《后汉书·史弼传》荆竟归田里，称病闭门不出。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·范曄《後漢書·史弼傳》荊竟歸田裡，稱病閉門不出。”
derivationEn: From Fan Ye's 'Book of the Later Han·Biography of Shi Bi': 'Shi Bi finally returned to his hometown, claiming illness and staying indoors.'
example: 他总是～。
exampleTraditional: 他總是～。
exampleEn: He always stays indoors and never goes out.

explanation: 偏面地听了一方面的话就信以为真。多指处理事情的态度不公正。
explanationTraditional: 偏面地聽了一方面的話就信以為真。多指處理事情的態度不公正。
explanationEn: To believe only one side of a story; often refers to an unfair attitude in handling matters.
derivation: 汉·王符《潜夫论·明暗》君之所以明者，兼听也；其所以暗者，偏信也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王符《潛夫論·明暗》君之所以明者，兼聽也；其所以暗者，偏信也。”
derivationEn: From Wang Fu's 'Qianfu Lun·Ming and Dark' in the Han Dynasty: 'A ruler is wise because he listens to all sides; he is blind because he believes only one side.'
example: 他总是乐于听取大家的意见，从不～。
exampleTraditional: 他總是樂於聽取大家的意見，從不～。
exampleEn: He always likes to listen to everyone's opinions and never listens only to one side.

explanation: 破除旧的，建立新的。
explanationTraditional: 破除舊的，建立新的。
explanationEn: To break the old and establish the new.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们要～改变封建意识。
exampleTraditional: 我們要～改變封建意識。
exampleEn: We must break the old and establish the new to change feudal ideas.

explanation: 泛指人的喜、怒、哀、乐和嗜欲等。
explanationTraditional: 泛指人的喜、怒、哀、樂和嗜慾等。
explanationEn: Generally refers to human emotions and desires, such as joy, anger, sorrow, happiness, and various appetites.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》七情喜怒哀惧爱恶欲。六欲生死耳目口鼻。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》七情喜怒哀懼愛惡欲。六慾生死耳目口鼻。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Li Yun': The seven emotions are joy, anger, sorrow, fear, love, hate, and desire. The six desires are life, death, ears, eyes, mouth, and nose.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用柔软的去克制刚强的。
explanationTraditional: 用柔軟的去剋制剛強的。
explanationEn: To overcome hardness with softness.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《将苑》善将者，其刚不可折，其柔不可卷，故以弱制强，以柔制刚。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《將苑》善將者，其剛不可折，其柔不可卷，故以弱制強，以柔制剛。”
derivationEn: From Zhuge Liang's 'The Art of War': A good general is neither too hard to break nor too soft to bend, thus overcoming strength with weakness and hardness with softness.
example: 他要拼老命，孤注一掷，我们则要忍耐，力避同敌人正面交锋，～，在敌人的后方狠狠地打。★李连庆《风云急》
exampleTraditional: 他要拼老命，孤注一擲，我們則要忍耐，力避同敵人正面交鋒，～，在敵人的後方狠狠地打。★李連慶《風雲急》
exampleEn: He wants to risk everything on a single throw, but we must be patient, avoid direct confrontation, overcome hardness with softness, and strike hard behind enemy lines. — Li Lianqing 'Stormy Times'

explanation: 戈古代的一种兵器；旦早晨。意思是立志杀敌，枕着武器睡觉等天亮。形容时刻准备作战，。
explanationTraditional: 戈古代的一種兵器；旦早晨。意思是立志殺敵，枕著武器睡覺等天亮。形容時刻準備作戰，。
explanationEn: To sleep with one's weapon as a pillow and wait for dawn, meaning to be ready for battle at any moment.
derivation: 《晋书·刘琨传》吾枕戈待旦，志枭逆虏。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·劉琨傳》吾枕戈待旦，志梟逆虜。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Liu Kun': I sleep with my weapon as a pillow, waiting for dawn, determined to behead the enemy.
example: 我先前只知道武将大抵通文，当～”的时候，就会做骈体电报，这回才明白虽是文官，也有深谙韬略的了。★鲁迅《准风月谈·冲》
exampleTraditional: 我先前只知道武將大抵通文，當～”的時候，就會做駢體電報，這回才明白雖是文官，也有深諳韜略的了。★魯迅《準風月談·衝》
exampleEn: I used to think that military officers were generally literate, and when they 'slept with their weapons waiting for dawn,' they would write parallel prose telegrams. Now I realize that even civil officials can be well-versed in strategy. — Lu Xun 'Essays from the Semi-Journal: Rush'

explanation: 吓得连魂魄都离开人体飞散了。形容惊恐万分，极端害怕。
explanationTraditional: 嚇得連魂魄都離開人體飛散了。形容驚恐萬分，極端害怕。
explanationEn: So frightened that one's soul leaves the body; extremely terrified.
derivation: 《左传·昭公二十五年》心之精爽，是谓魂魄；魂魄去之，何以能久？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公二十五年》心之精爽，是謂魂魄；魂魄去之，何以能久？”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Zhao's 25th Year': The essence of the heart is called the soul; if the soul leaves, how can one last long?
example: 猛然间一个人从身后冒冒失失的按住，也不出声，二人唬得～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 猛然間一個人從身後冒冒失失的按住，也不出聲，二人唬得～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十五回
exampleEn: Suddenly, someone grabbed them from behind without warning, and they were so scared that their souls flew away and scattered. — Cao Xueqin 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 15

explanation: 比喻夫妻失散或离婚后重新团聚。
explanationTraditional: 比喻夫妻失散或離婚後重新團聚。
explanationEn: A metaphor for a separated or divorced couple reuniting.
derivation: 唐·韦述《两京新记》卷三
derivationTraditional: 唐·韋述《兩京新記》卷三
derivationEn: From Wei Shu's 'Two Capitals New Records', Volume 3.
example: 破镜重圆从古有，何须疑虑反生愁？★元·施君美《幽闺记·推就红丝》
exampleTraditional: 破鏡重圓從古有，何須疑慮反生愁？★元·施君美《幽閨記·推就紅絲》
exampleEn: Since ancient times, broken mirrors have been reunited; why worry and be sad? — Shi Junmei 'The Secluded Boudoir: Pushing the Red Silk'

explanation: 罄尽，完；竹古时用来写字的竹简。形容罪行多得写不完。
explanationTraditional: 罄盡，完；竹古時用來寫字的竹簡。形容罪行多得寫不完。
explanationEn: Too numerous to record (of crimes); literally, using up all bamboo slips to write.
derivation: 《旧唐书·李密传》磬南山之竹，书罪未穷；决东海之波，流恶难尽。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·李密傳》磬南山之竹，書罪未窮；決東海之波，流惡難盡。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Li Mi': Using all the bamboo of the southern mountains, one cannot write all the crimes; draining the water of the eastern sea, one cannot wash away all the evil.
example: 沦陷区的同胞在抗战中所表现的奇迹，真是所谓～。★邹韬奋《抗战以来》
exampleTraditional: 淪陷區的同胞在抗戰中所表現的奇蹟，真是所謂～。★鄒韜奮《抗戰以來》
exampleEn: The miracles performed by compatriots in the occupied areas during the War of Resistance are truly too numerous to record. — Zou Taofen 'Since the War of Resistance'

explanation: 头脑昏晕，眼睛发花。
explanationTraditional: 頭腦昏暈，眼睛發花。
explanationEn: Dizzy and seeing stars; lightheaded and blurred vision.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十一回瞿耐庵到任不多几日，不要说别的，但是本衙门的开销，什么差役工食、犯人口粮，他胸中毫无主宰，早弄得头昏眼花，七颠八倒。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十一回瞿耐庵到任不多幾日，不要說別的，但是本衙門的開銷，什麼差役工食、犯人口糧，他胸中毫無主宰，早弄得頭昏眼花，七顛八倒。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 41: Qu Nai'an had been in office for only a few days, and not to mention other things, just the expenses of the yamen, such as wages for servants and rations for prisoners, left him utterly confused, dizzy, and disoriented.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 疑义可疑的道理。一点也没有可以使人怀疑的地方。
explanationTraditional: 疑義可疑的道理。一點也沒有可以使人懷疑的地方。
explanationEn: Without any doubt; unquestionable.
derivation: 清·刘鹗《老残游记》第16回怎幺他毫无疑义，就照五百两一条命算呢？”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第16回怎么他毫無疑義，就照五百兩一條命算呢？”
derivationEn: From Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 16: How could he have no doubt and simply calculate it as five hundred taels per life?
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把心比作琴，拨动了心中的琴弦。形容事物激动人心。
explanationTraditional: 把心比作琴，撥動了心中的琴絃。形容事物激動人心。
explanationEn: To touch one's heartstrings; deeply moving.
derivation: 魏巍《依依惜别的深情》这些动人心弦的赠礼，使得另一些战士们难熬了。”
derivationTraditional: 魏巍《依依惜別的深情》這些動人心絃的贈禮，使得另一些戰士們難熬了。”
derivationEn: From Wei Wei's 'Reluctant Farewell': These heart-touching gifts made other soldiers feel uneasy.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 昏暗得看不到天上的日光。形容在反动势力统治下社会的黑暗。
explanationTraditional: 昏暗得看不到天上的日光。形容在反動勢力統治下社會的黑暗。
explanationEn: So dark that not even the sun can be seen; describes extreme social darkness under reactionary rule.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·老龙船户》剖腹沉石，惨冤已甚，而木雕之有司，绝不少关痛痒，岂特粤东之暗无天日哉！”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·老龍船戶》剖腹沉石，慘冤已甚，而木雕之有司，絕不少關痛癢，豈特粵東之暗無天日哉！”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio': 'Bodies cut open and stones sunk, the injustice was extreme, yet the wooden officials showed no concern. How could it be only Guangdong that was so dark?'
example: 上自王后，下至弄臣，骇得凝结着的神色也应声活动起来，似乎感到～的悲哀。★鲁迅《故事新编·铸剑》
exampleTraditional: 上自王后，下至弄臣，駭得凝結著的神色也應聲活動起來，似乎感到～的悲哀。★魯迅《故事新編·鑄劍》
exampleEn: From the queen down to the jesters, their frozen expressions stirred as if feeling the sorrow of such darkness. — Lu Xun, 'Old Tales Retold: Forging the Sword'

explanation: 信任凭，听任；雌黄即鸡冠石，黄色矿物，用作颜料。古人用黄纸写字，写错了，用雌黄涂抹后改写。比喻不顾事实，随口乱说。
explanationTraditional: 信任憑，聽任；雌黃即雞冠石，黃色礦物，用作顏料。古人用黃紙寫字，寫錯了，用雌黃塗抹後改寫。比喻不顧事實，隨口亂說。
explanationEn: To make irresponsible statements; to talk nonsense without regard for facts.
derivation: 晋·孙盛《晋阳秋》王衍，字夷甫，能言，于意有不安者，辄更易之，时号口中雌黄。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·孫盛《晉陽秋》王衍，字夷甫，能言，於意有不安者，輒更易之，時號口中雌黃。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Sun Sheng's 'Jin Yang Qiu': 'Wang Yan, styled Yifu, was eloquent; whenever he felt uneasy about something, he would change his words, earning the nickname 'or-piment in his mouth.'
example: 如果孙俊英按事实讲也没有什么，但是她加油添醋，～，凭空捏造，极尽诬蔑挑拨之能事。★冯德英《迎春花》第二十一章
exampleTraditional: 如果孫俊英按事實講也沒有什麼，但是她加油添醋，～，憑空捏造，極盡誣衊挑撥之能事。★馮德英《迎春花》第二十一章
exampleEn: If Sun Junying had stuck to the facts, it would have been fine, but she exaggerated, talked nonsense, fabricated lies, and did her utmost to slander and sow discord. — Feng Deying, 'Spring Flowers' Chapter 21

explanation: 形容被杀的人极多。
explanationTraditional: 形容被殺的人極多。
explanationEn: Describes a massive slaughter with blood flowing like a river.
derivation: 《旧唐书·李密传》尸骸蔽野，血流成河，积怨满于山川，号哭动于天地。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·李密傳》屍骸蔽野，血流成河，積怨滿於山川，號哭動於天地。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Li Mi': 'Corpses cover the fields, blood flows into rivers, grievances fill the mountains and rivers, cries shake heaven and earth.'
example: 须臾～，顷刻尸如山积。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第一百九回
exampleTraditional: 須臾～，頃刻屍如山積。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第一百九回
exampleEn: In an instant, blood flowed like a river, and soon corpses piled up like mountains. — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin' Chapter 109

explanation: 情风情；俏俏皮、风趣。指男女调情。
explanationTraditional: 情風情；俏俏皮、風趣。指男女調情。
explanationEn: To flirt and tease between a man and a woman.
derivation: 明·董说《西游补》第一回在那里采野花，结草卦，抱儿携女，打情骂俏。”
derivationTraditional: 明·董說《西遊補》第一回在那裡採野花，結草卦，抱兒攜女，打情罵俏。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Dong Shuo's 'Supplement to Journey to the West' Chapter 1: 'There, picking wildflowers, tying grass knots, carrying children, flirting and teasing.'
example: 高兴起来，简直不分主仆，～的搅做一团。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 高興起來，簡直不分主僕，～的攪做一團。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十五回
exampleEn: When happy, they would forget master-servant distinctions and flirt and tease together. — Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins' Chapter 35

explanation: 愤憎恶，痛恨；嫉仇恨，痛恨；世、俗当时的社会状况。有正义感的人对黑暗的现实社会和不合理的习俗表示愤恨、憎恶。
explanationTraditional: 憤憎惡，痛恨；嫉仇恨，痛恨；世、俗當時的社會狀況。有正義感的人對黑暗的現實社會和不合理的習俗表示憤恨、憎惡。
explanationEn: To detest the world and its ways; to be cynical about social injustices and unreasonable customs.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《杂说》然吾观于人，其能尽其性而不类于禽兽异物者，希矣。将愤世嫉邪长往而不来者之所为乎？”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《雜說》然吾觀於人，其能盡其性而不類於禽獸異物者，希矣。將憤世嫉邪長往而不來者之所為乎？”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Miscellaneous Sayings': 'But I observe people; few can fully realize their nature without resembling beasts. Is this not the act of those who hate the world and evil and retreat forever?'
example: 不见面就罢，一见面就是～地破口大骂，要不就是针针见血地讽刺不休。★欧阳山《苦斗》四八
exampleTraditional: 不見面就罷，一見面就是～地破口大罵，要不就是針針見血地諷刺不休。★歐陽山《苦鬥》四八
exampleEn: Whenever they met, they would either curse the world cynically or satirize sharply. — Ouyang Shan, 'Struggle' Section 48

explanation: 厉同砺”，磨；兵兵器；秣喂牲口。磨好兵器，喂好马。形容准备战斗。
explanationTraditional: 厲同礪”，磨；兵兵器；秣喂牲口。磨好兵器，喂好馬。形容準備戰鬥。
explanationEn: To sharpen weapons and feed horses; to prepare for battle.
derivation: 《左传·僖公三十三年》郑穆公使视客馆，则束载厉兵秣马矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公三十三年》鄭穆公使視客館，則束載厲兵秣馬矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's 33rd Year': 'Duke Mu of Zheng sent someone to inspect the guesthouse, where they found bundles packed, weapons sharpened, and horses fed.'
example: 孙权克仗先烈，雄据江东，举贤任能，～，以伺中国之变。★宋·陈亮《酌古论·吕蒙》
exampleTraditional: 孫權克仗先烈，雄據江東，舉賢任能，～，以伺中國之變。★宋·陳亮《酌古論·呂蒙》
exampleEn: Sun Quan, inheriting his ancestor's legacy, dominated Jiangdong, promoted talents, sharpened weapons, and fed horses, waiting for changes in the Central Plains. — Song Dynasty Chen Liang, 'Commentaries on Ancient Figures: Lü Meng'

explanation: 敌军已来到自己的城墙下面。比喻情势十分危急。
explanationTraditional: 敵軍已來到自己的城牆下面。比喻情勢十分危急。
explanationEn: The enemy army has arrived at the city walls; describes a critical situation.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策二》齐必举兵伐梁，梁、齐之兵连于城下不能去，王以其间伐韩。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策二》齊必舉兵伐梁，梁、齊之兵連於城下不能去，王以其間伐韓。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy II': 'Qi will surely attack Liang, and the armies of Liang and Qi will be locked at the city walls, unable to leave. The king can take the opportunity to attack Han.'
example: 若侯～，将至壕边，然后拒敌，事已迟矣。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 若侯～，將至壕邊，然後拒敵，事已遲矣。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三十一回
exampleEn: If we wait until the enemy is at the city walls and the moat before resisting, it will be too late. — Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 31

explanation: 形容人的容貌一副善良的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容人的容貌一副善良的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes a kind and benevolent appearance.
derivation: 老舍《老张的哲学》圆圆的脸，长满银灰的胡子，慈眉善目的。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《老張的哲學》圓圓的臉，長滿銀灰的鬍子，慈眉善目的。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Philosophy of Old Zhang': 'A round face with silver-gray beard, kind-eyed and benevolent.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容春色正浓，情趣盎然。
explanationTraditional: 形容春色正濃，情趣盎然。
explanationEn: Describes the vibrant spring scenery and a sense of romance.
derivation: 宋·叶绍翁《游小园不值》春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·葉紹翁《遊小園不值》春色滿園關不住，一枝紅杏出牆來。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Ye Shaoweng's 'Visiting a Small Garden without Meeting the Owner': 'The garden is full of spring, which cannot be contained; a branch of red apricot stretches out of the wall.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 街坊邻居。指住处邻近的人。同街坊邻里”。
explanationTraditional: 街坊鄰居。指住處鄰近的人。同街坊鄰里”。
explanationEn: Neighbors; people living nearby.
derivation: 《春阿氏谋夫案》第六回街坊四邻，你们都听听。如今这年月，颠倒儿颠拉，媳妇是祖宗，婆婆是家奴，你们给评评，是我昏瞶了，是她欺辱我。”
derivationTraditional: 《春阿氏謀夫案》第六回街坊四鄰，你們都聽聽。如今這年月，顛倒兒顛拉，媳婦是祖宗，婆婆是家奴，你們給評評，是我昏瞶了，是她欺辱我。”
derivationEn: From 'The Case of Chun A's Conspiracy' Chapter 6: 'Neighbors, listen! Nowadays, the world is upside down; the daughter-in-law is the master, the mother-in-law the slave. Judge for yourselves: am I senile, or is she bullying me?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为国家竭尽忠诚，牺牲一切。
explanationTraditional: 為國家竭盡忠誠，犧牲一切。
explanationEn: To serve one's country with utmost loyalty and sacrifice everything.
derivation: 《北史·颜之仪传》公等备受朝恩，当尽忠报国。”《宋史·岳飞传》初命何铸鞫之，飞裂裳以背示铸，有‘尽忠报国’四大字，深入肤理。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·顏之儀傳》公等備受朝恩，當盡忠報國。”《宋史·岳飛傳》初命何鑄鞫之，飛裂裳以背示鑄，有‘盡忠報國’四大字，深入膚理。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Yan Zhiyi' and 'History of Song: Biography of Yue Fei', where Yue Fei had 'serve with utmost loyalty' tattooed on his back.
example: 我今日祝告天地祖宗，要在你背上刺下～”四字。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 我今日祝告天地祖宗，要在你背上刺下～”四字。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第二十二回
exampleEn: Today I pray to heaven and earth and ancestors, to tattoo 'serve with utmost loyalty' on your back. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Complete Tale of Yue Fei', Chapter 22

explanation: 内心痛苦得象刀割一样。
explanationTraditional: 內心痛苦得象刀割一樣。
explanationEn: Heart feels as if cut by a knife; extreme mental pain.
derivation: 元·秦简夫《赵礼让肥》第一折待着些粗粝，眼睁睁俺子母各天涯，想起来我心如刀割。”
