derivationTraditional: 元·秦簡夫《趙禮讓肥》第一折待著些粗糲，眼睜睜俺子母各天涯，想起來我心如刀割。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Qin Jianfu, 'Zhao Li Rang Fei', Act 1: 'Thinking of it, my heart feels as if cut by a knife.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伤妨碍、败坏；风化风俗教化。败坏、损害社会的风俗和教化。指对社会风俗、教育有不好影响的言行。
explanationTraditional: 傷妨礙、敗壞；風化風俗教化。敗壞、損害社會的風俗和教化。指對社會風俗、教育有不好影響的言行。
explanationEn: Harmful to public morals; damaging to social customs and education.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《裴度还带》第四折你道做了有伤风化，谁就你那燕尔新婚。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《裴度還帶》第四折你道做了有傷風化，誰就你那燕爾新婚。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, 'Pei Du Returns the Belt', Act 4: 'You have done something harmful to public morals.'
example: 王谓丘作《五伦全备传奇》，～，失文宗体。（明·杨仪《明良记》第十四节）
exampleTraditional: 王謂丘作《五倫全備傳奇》，～，失文宗體。（明·楊儀《明良記》第十四節）
exampleEn: Wang said Qiu wrote 'The Complete Legend of Five Ethics', which is harmful to public morals and loses the style of a literary master. — Ming Dynasty, Yang Yi, 'Ming Liang Ji', Section 14

explanation: 指隐藏着未被发现的人才，也指隐藏不露的人才。
explanationTraditional: 指隱藏著未被發現的人才，也指隱藏不露的人才。
explanationEn: Hidden talents or undiscovered geniuses; concealed but capable individuals.
derivation: 北周·庾信《同会河阳公新造山地聊得寓目》诗暗石疑藏虎，盘根似卧龙。”
derivationTraditional: 北周·庾信《同會河陽公新造山地聊得寓目》詩暗石疑藏虎，盤根似臥龍。”
derivationEn: From Northern Zhou, Yu Xin, poem: 'Dark rocks hide a tiger, twisted roots resemble a crouching dragon.'
example: 在中州地面，四通八达，乃是～之地，英雄荟萃之区，非同小地方可比。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十六章
exampleTraditional: 在中州地面，四通八達，乃是～之地，英雄薈萃之區，非同小地方可比。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第十六章
exampleEn: In the Central Plains, it's a place of hidden dragons and crouching tigers, a gathering of heroes, unlike small places. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 16

explanation: 风烛被风吹的蜡烛，容易熄灭；残年残余的岁月，指在世不太久。比喻人到了接近死亡的晚年。
explanationTraditional: 風燭被風吹的蠟燭，容易熄滅；殘年殘餘的歲月，指在世不太久。比喻人到了接近死亡的晚年。
explanationEn: Old age like a candle in the wind; nearing the end of one's life.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《题卫夫人笔陈图后》时年五十有三，或恐风烛奄及，聊遗教于子孙耳。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《題衛夫人筆陳圖後》時年五十有三，或恐風燭奄及，聊遺教於子孫耳。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Wang Xizhi, 'Postscript to Lady Wei's Brush Formation': 'At fifty-three, fearing the candle in the wind, I leave instructions for descendants.'
example: 有许多象祁老者的老人，希望在太平中度过～，而侵略者的枪炮打碎了他们的希望。★老舍《四世同堂》六
exampleTraditional: 有許多象祁老者的老人，希望在太平中度過～，而侵略者的槍炮打碎了他們的希望。★老舍《四世同堂》六
exampleEn: Many old people like Qi the Elder hoped to spend their remaining years in peace, but the invaders' guns shattered their hopes. — Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof', Chapter 6

explanation: 乘着云，驾着雾。原是传说中指会法术的人乘云雾飞行，后形容奔驰迅速或头脑发昏。
explanationTraditional: 乘著雲，駕著霧。原是傳說中指會法術的人乘雲霧飛行，後形容奔馳迅速或頭腦發昏。
explanationEn: Riding clouds and mist; originally refers to magical flight, now describes fast movement or dizziness.
derivation: 元·郑德辉《老君堂》第二折恨不的驾雾腾云，臂生两翅，飞出狱院。”明·吴承恩《西游记》第三回他放下心，日逐腾云驾雾，遨游四海，行乐千山。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭德輝《老君堂》第二折恨不的駕霧騰雲，臂生兩翅，飛出獄院。”明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三回他放下心，日逐騰雲駕霧，遨遊四海，行樂千山。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Zheng Dehui, 'Lao Jun Tang', Act 2: 'Wishing to ride clouds and mist, grow wings, and fly out of prison.' Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 3: 'He rode clouds and mist daily, roaming the seas and mountains.'
example: 这简直不是马，是一条～的白龙！一条白龙。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三章
exampleTraditional: 這簡直不是馬，是一條～的白龍！一條白龍。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三章
exampleEn: This is not a horse, but a white dragon riding clouds and mist! A white dragon. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 3

explanation: 鬼怪迷惑住心窍。指对问题认识不清。
explanationTraditional: 鬼怪迷惑住心竅。指對問題認識不清。
explanationEn: Bewitched by ghosts; confused or misled in judgment.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第六十回一时鬼迷心窍，后悔不及。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第六十回一時鬼迷心竅，後悔不及。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan, 'The Lamp at the Crossroads', Chapter 60: 'Bewitched by ghosts for a moment, regret is too late.'
example: 我真象从前的人说的～”了，现在可算把鬼打跑了！★赵树理《表明态度》
exampleTraditional: 我真象從前的人說的～”了，現在可算把鬼打跑了！★趙樹理《表明態度》
exampleEn: I was truly 'bewitched by ghosts' as the ancients said, but now the ghost is driven away! — Zhao Shuli, 'State Your Attitude'

explanation: 三个脑袋，六条胳臂。原为佛家语，指佛的法相◇比喻神奇的本领。
explanationTraditional: 三個腦袋，六條胳臂。原為佛家語，指佛的法相◇比喻神奇的本領。
explanationEn: Three heads and six arms; originally Buddhist term for a deity's form, now metaphor for extraordinary abilities.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷十三三头六臂擎天地，忿怒那吒扑帝钟。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷十三三頭六臂擎天地，忿怒那吒撲帝鍾。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan, 'Transmission of the Lamp', Volume 13: 'Three heads and six arms holding heaven and earth, wrathful Nata striking the imperial bell.'
example: 吕岳在金眼驼上，现出～，大显神通。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 呂嶽在金眼駝上，現出～，大顯神通。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第五十九回
exampleEn: Lü Yue appeared on his golden-eyed camel, manifesting three heads and six arms, displaying great divine power. — Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 59

explanation: 发发动；制控制，制服。等对方先动手，再抓住有利时机反击，制服对方。
explanationTraditional: 發發動；制控制，制服。等對方先動手，再抓住有利時機反擊，制服對方。
explanationEn: To gain mastery by striking only after the enemy has struck; to wait for the opponent to move first and then counterattack.
derivation: 《荀子·议兵》后之发，先之至，此用兵之要术也。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·議兵》後之發，先之至，此用兵之要術也。”
derivationEn: From 'Xunzi: On Military Affairs': 'Strike later but arrive first; this is the essential art of war.'
example: 秦晋淝水之战等等有名的大战，都是双方强弱不同，弱者先让一步，～，因而战胜的。★毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》
exampleTraditional: 秦晉淝水之戰等等有名的大戰，都是雙方強弱不同，弱者先讓一步，～，因而戰勝的。★毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》
exampleEn: Famous battles like the Qin-Jin Fei River Battle were all cases where the weaker side let the enemy strike first, then gained mastery by striking later, thus winning. — Mao Zedong, 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War'

explanation: 挥挥笔；酒洒墨。形容画画、写字、作文，运笔能随心所欲。
explanationTraditional: 揮揮筆；酒灑墨。形容畫畫、寫字、作文，運筆能隨心所欲。
explanationEn: To wield the brush freely and effortlessly; to write or paint with ease and skill.
derivation: 唐·李颀《赠张旭》兴来洒素壁，挥笔如流星。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李頎《贈張旭》興來灑素壁，揮筆如流星。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Qi, 'To Zhang Xu': 'When inspired, he splashed ink on plain walls, wielding his brush like a meteor.'
example: 家人送上一枝蘸满墨水的笔。珏斋提笔，在纸上～的写了一百多字。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 家人送上一枝蘸滿墨水的筆。珏齋提筆，在紙上～的寫了一百多字。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十五回
exampleEn: A servant handed him a brush dipped in ink. Juezhai took it and wrote over a hundred characters freely and effortlessly on paper. — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 25

explanation: 狼和狈一同出外伤害牲畜，狼用前腿，狈用后腿，既跑得快，又能爬高。比喻互相勾结干坏事。
explanationTraditional: 狼和狽一同出外傷害牲畜，狼用前腿，狽用後腿，既跑得快，又能爬高。比喻互相勾結幹壞事。
explanationEn: Collaborate in evil deeds; act in collusion for illicit purposes.
derivation: 唐·段成式《酉阳杂俎》十六故世言事乖者称狼狈。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·段成式《酉陽雜俎》十六故世言事乖者稱狼狽。”
derivationEn: From Duan Chengshi's 'Youyang Zazu' of the Tang Dynasty: 'Therefore, the world calls those who are at odds as 'langbei'.'
example: 帝国主义与封建势力永远是互相勾结，～的。★闻一多《谨防汉奸合法化》
exampleTraditional: 帝國主義與封建勢力永遠是互相勾結，～的。★聞一多《謹防漢奸合法化》
exampleEn: Imperialism and feudalism always collude with each other, acting in collusion for illicit purposes. — Wen Yiduo, 'Beware of Traitors Legalization'

explanation: 文文才；武武艺。能文能武，文才和武艺都很出众。
explanationTraditional: 文文才；武武藝。能文能武，文才和武藝都很出眾。
explanationEn: Be adept with both the pen and the sword; be well-versed in both literary and martial arts.
derivation: 《旧唐书·李光弼传》蕴孙、吴之略、有文武之才。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·李光弼傳》蘊孫、吳之略、有文武之才。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Li Guangbi': 'He possessed the strategies of Sun and Wu, and had both literary and martial talents.'
example: 此人姓姜，名维，字伯约，天水冀人也；事母至孝，～，智勇足备，真当世之英杰也。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十三回
exampleTraditional: 此人姓姜，名維，字伯約，天水冀人也；事母至孝，～，智勇足備，真當世之英傑也。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十三回
exampleEn: This man, named Jiang Wei, styled Boyue, is from Tianshui, Ji County; he is filial to his mother, adept in both civil and military arts, wise and brave, truly a hero of the time. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 93

explanation: 风味原指美好的口味，引伸为事物的特色。另有一种美好的口味。比喻事物所另外具有的特殊色彩或趣味。
explanationTraditional: 風味原指美好的口味，引伸為事物的特色。另有一種美好的口味。比喻事物所另外具有的特殊色彩或趣味。
explanationEn: Have a distinctive flavor; have a special charm or interest.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五回此时只觉四处焦香扑鼻，倒也别有风味。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五回此時只覺四處焦香撲鼻，倒也別有風味。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 5: 'At this moment, only the scorched fragrance assails the nose, which is quite distinctive.'
example: 酣眠固不可少，小睡也～的。★朱自清《荷塘月色》
exampleTraditional: 酣眠固不可少，小睡也～的。★朱自清《荷塘月色》
exampleEn: Deep sleep is certainly indispensable, but a short nap also has its own charm. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Moonlight over the Lotus Pond'

explanation: 公事按公事的原则办，不讲私人情面。
explanationTraditional: 公事按公事的原則辦，不講私人情面。
explanationEn: Do official business according to official principles; not let personal considerations interfere with public duty.
derivation: 宋·魏了翁《奏外寇未静二相不咸旷天工而违明几》自今公事公言，进而明目张胆以陈之论奏，退而同心协虑以见之施行，毋面从而背违也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏了翁《奏外寇未靜二相不鹹曠天工而違明幾》自今公事公言，進而明目張膽以陳之論奏，退而同心協慮以見之施行，毋面從而背違也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Wei Liaoweng's 'Memorial on External Threats and Internal Discord': 'From now on, public affairs should be discussed openly, with clear arguments presented in memorials, and implemented with concerted efforts, without duplicity.'
example: 藩台见人家不来打点，他便有心～，先从余荩臣下手。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 藩臺見人家不來打點，他便有心～，先從餘藎臣下手。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十三回
exampleEn: When the provincial governor saw that no one came to bribe him, he decided to do official business strictly, starting with Yu Jinchen. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 33

explanation: 科旧指法律条文；律规章，法则。原形容法令条文的尽善尽美。现比喻必须遵守、不能变更的信条。
explanationTraditional: 科舊指法律條文；律規章，法則。原形容法令條文的盡善盡美。現比喻必須遵守、不能變更的信條。
explanationEn: Infallible law; golden rule; universally accepted principle.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《剧秦美新》懿律嘉量，金科玉条。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《劇秦美新》懿律嘉量，金科玉條。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Yang Xiong's 'Critique of Qin and New': 'Excellent laws and good measures, golden rules and jade regulations.'
example: 他把他家里那种种可笑规矩，看成圣贤的～。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第一百三回
exampleTraditional: 他把他家裡那種種可笑規矩，看成聖賢的～。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第一百三回
exampleEn: He regarded the ridiculous rules of his family as sacred golden rules. — Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan, 'The Story of a Lantern', Chapter 103

explanation: 貌外表；神内心。表面上关系很密切，实际上是两条心。
explanationTraditional: 貌外表；神內心。表面上關係很密切，實際上是兩條心。
explanationEn: Seemingly united but actually at odds; be in agreement only in appearance.
derivation: 《素书·遵义》貌合心离者孤，亲谗远忠者亡。”
derivationTraditional: 《素書·遵義》貌合心離者孤，親讒遠忠者亡。”
derivationEn: From 'Su Shu: Zun Yi': 'Those who are united in appearance but divided in heart are isolated; those who favor slanderers and distance the loyal perish.'
example: 但一从我做了他的党代表之后，便由志同道合”一变而为～”。★郭沫若《涂家埠》
exampleTraditional: 但一從我做了他的黨代表之後，便由志同道合”一變而為～”。★郭沫若《塗家埠》
exampleEn: But from the moment I became his party representative, our 'shared ideals and goals' turned into 'seeming unity but actual divergence'. — Guo Moruo, 'Tujiabu'

explanation: 义道理；辞言辞。理由正当充足，措词严正有力。
explanationTraditional: 義道理；辭言辭。理由正當充足，措詞嚴正有力。
explanationEn: Speak with the force of justice; be severe in tone and just in argument.
derivation: 宋·张孝祥《明守赵敷文》欧公书岂惟翰墨之妙，而辞严义正，千载之下，见者兴起，某何足以辱公此赐也哉。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張孝祥《明守趙敷文》歐公書豈惟翰墨之妙，而辭嚴義正，千載之下，見者興起，某何足以辱公此賜也哉。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Zhang Xiaoxiang's 'Letter to Zhao Fuwen': 'Ouyang Xiu's calligraphy is not only superb, but his words are stern and his arguments just, inspiring generations. How can I be worthy of such a gift?'
example: 魏竹冈拆开看时，不料上面写的甚是～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 魏竹岡拆開看時，不料上面寫的甚是～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十七回
exampleEn: When Wei Zhugang opened it, he saw that the content was written with great justice and stern words. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 17

explanation: 狗急了也能跳过墙去。比喻坏人在走投无路时豁出去，不顾一切地捣乱。
explanationTraditional: 狗急了也能跳過牆去。比喻壞人在走投無路時豁出去，不顧一切地搗亂。
explanationEn: A cornered beast will do desperate things; be driven to a wall and fight back desperately.
derivation: 《敦煌变文集·燕子赋》人急烧香，狗急蓦墙。”
derivationTraditional: 《敦煌變文集·燕子賦》人急燒香，狗急驀牆。”
derivationEn: From 'Dunhuang Bianwen Ji: Yanzi Fu': 'When a man is desperate, he burns incense; when a dog is desperate, it jumps over the wall.'
example: 今儿我听了他的短儿，人急造反，～”，不但生事，而且我还没趣。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 今兒我聽了他的短兒，人急造反，～”，不但生事，而且我還沒趣。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十二回
exampleEn: Today I heard his secret, and 'a desperate man will rebel, a cornered dog will jump the wall', not only causing trouble but also embarrassing myself. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 22

explanation: 形容颜色过分鲜艳繁杂。也比喻浮华而不实在。
explanationTraditional: 形容顏色過分鮮豔繁雜。也比喻浮華而不實在。
explanationEn: Gaudy; showy but without substance; flashy.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第二十九回一同进到房里，见满桌堆着都是选的刻本文章，红笔对的样，花里胡哨的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第二十九回一同進到房裡，見滿桌堆著都是選的刻本文章，紅筆對的樣，花裡胡哨的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 29: 'They entered the room together and saw the table piled with selected printed essays, marked in red, gaudy and flashy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用喝酒来浇灭郁积在心中的气愤或愁闷。
explanationTraditional: 用喝酒來澆滅鬱積在心中的氣憤或愁悶。
explanationEn: Drown one's sorrows in wine; drink to dispel melancholy.
derivation: 明·李开先《后冈陈提学传》只恁以酒浇愁，愁不能遣，而且日增。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李開先《後岡陳提學傳》只恁以酒澆愁，愁不能遣，而且日增。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Li Kaixian's 'Biography of Chen Xuezheng Hougang': 'He tried to drown his sorrows in wine, but sorrow could not be dispelled and only increased daily.'
example: 龟井的文章，立意的大部分是在给他们国内的人看的，当然不免有'～'的气味。★鲁迅《书信集·致胡风》
exampleTraditional: 龜井的文章，立意的大部分是在給他們國內的人看的，當然不免有'～'的氣味。★魯迅《書信集·致胡風》
exampleEn: The main intention of Kamei's articles is for his domestic audience, so inevitably they have the flavor of 'drowning sorrows in wine'. — Lu Xun, 'Letters: To Hu Feng'

explanation: 尊地位高；卑低下。在封建社会里男子地位高，女子地位卑下。这是重男轻女的不平等封建礼教。
explanationTraditional: 尊地位高；卑低下。在封建社會里男子地位高，女子地位卑下。這是重男輕女的不平等封建禮教。
explanationEn: Men are superior, women are inferior. In feudal society, men held high status while women were low. This is an unequal feudal ethical code that values men over women.
derivation: 元·无名氏《举案齐眉》第三折虽不曾夫贵妻荣，我只知是男尊女卑。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《舉案齊眉》第三折雖不曾夫貴妻榮，我只知是男尊女卑。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Lifting the Tray to the Eyebrows', Act 3: 'Although not yet husband honored and wife glorious, I only know that men are noble and women humble.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 拿腔拿调，故意做作想引人注意或吓唬人。
explanationTraditional: 拿腔拿調，故意做作想引人注意或嚇唬人。
explanationEn: To put on airs; to act affectedly or pretentiously in order to attract attention or intimidate others.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这种装腔作势，没有真情实感的作品，根本不值得一读。
exampleTraditional: 這種裝腔作勢，沒有真情實感的作品，根本不值得一讀。
exampleEn: This kind of pretentious work without genuine emotion is not worth reading at all.

explanation: 呻吟病痛时的低哼。没病瞎哼哼。比喻没有值得忧伤的事情而叹息感慨。也比喻文艺作品没有真实感情，装腔作势。
explanationTraditional: 呻吟病痛時的低哼。沒病瞎哼哼。比喻沒有值得憂傷的事情而嘆息感慨。也比喻文藝作品沒有真實感情，裝腔作勢。
explanationEn: To moan without being ill; to sigh and lament over nonexistent sorrows. Also refers to literary works that lack genuine emotion and are pretentious.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《临江仙》词百年光景百年心，更欢须叹息，无病也呻吟。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《臨江仙》詞百年光景百年心，更歡須嘆息，無病也呻吟。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Xin Qiji, 'Poem of Linjiang Immortal': 'A hundred years of life, a hundred years of heart; even in joy one must sigh, moaning without illness.'
example: 后来的叹老嗟卑也正是～。★朱自清《论书生的酸气》
exampleTraditional: 後來的嘆老嗟卑也正是～。★朱自清《論書生的酸氣》
exampleEn: Later lamenting over aging and poverty is also moaning without illness. — Zhu Ziqing, 'On the Sourness of Scholars'

explanation: 指人民安居乐业则国家太平。
explanationTraditional: 指人民安居樂業則國家太平。
explanationEn: When the people live in peace and contentment, the country is stable and peaceful.
derivation: 《书·五子之歌》民惟邦本，本固邦宁。”孔传言人君当固民以安国。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·五子之歌》民惟邦本，本固邦寧。”孔傳言人君當固民以安國。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents: Songs of the Five Sons': 'The people are the foundation of the state; when the foundation is solid, the state is peaceful.' Kong's commentary: 'The ruler should solidify the people to stabilize the country.'
example: 自古道，立国基，民为邦本；衣食足，知荣辱，～。★京剧《串龙珠》
exampleTraditional: 自古道，立國基，民為邦本；衣食足，知榮辱，～。★京劇《串龍珠》
exampleEn: Since ancient times, establishing the foundation of the state relies on the people as the base; with sufficient food and clothing, knowing honor and disgrace, the foundation is solid and the state is peaceful. — Peking Opera 'Stringing the Dragon Pearl'

explanation: 荒、乱指社会秩序不安定。形容战争期间社会混乱不安的景象。
explanationTraditional: 荒、亂指社會秩序不安定。形容戰爭期間社會混亂不安的景象。
explanationEn: Describes a state of social chaos and disorder during wartime.
derivation: 元·无名氏《梧桐叶》第四折那兵荒马乱，定然遭驱被掳。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《梧桐葉》第四折那兵荒馬亂，定然遭驅被擄。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Wutong Leaf', Act 4: 'In those times of war and chaos, one would surely be driven and captured.'
example: 此时四处～，朝秦暮楚，我勉强做了一部《旧唐书》，那里还有闲情逸志弄这笔墨。”★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第一回
exampleTraditional: 此時四處～，朝秦暮楚，我勉強做了一部《舊唐書》，那裡還有閒情逸志弄這筆墨。”★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第一回
exampleEn: At that time, there was chaos everywhere, and people shifted allegiances. I barely managed to write a 'Book of Tang', how could I have the leisure to dabble in writing? — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 1

explanation: 气势可以吞没山河。形容气魄很大。
explanationTraditional: 氣勢可以吞沒山河。形容氣魄很大。
explanationEn: With a momentum that can swallow mountains and rivers; describes great boldness and ambition.
derivation: 元·金仁杰《追韩信》第二折背楚投汉，气吞山河。知音未遇，弹琴空歌。”
derivationTraditional: 元·金仁杰《追韓信》第二折背楚投漢，氣吞山河。知音未遇，彈琴空歌。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Jin Renjie, 'Chasing Han Xin', Act 2: 'Turning against Chu and joining Han, with spirit swallowing mountains and rivers. Not meeting a knowing friend, I play the lute and sing in vain.'
example: 这号人，在困难中不是低头叹息，而是奋发图强，壮志凌云，～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleTraditional: 這號人，在困難中不是低頭嘆息，而是奮發圖強，壯志凌雲，～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleEn: Such people, in difficulties, do not bow their heads and sigh, but strive vigorously, with lofty aspirations and a spirit that can swallow mountains and rivers. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 28

explanation: 回忆过去的苦难，回想今天的幸福生活。
explanationTraditional: 回憶過去的苦難，回想今天的幸福生活。
explanationEn: To recall past hardships and appreciate present happiness.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他经常给年轻人讲忆苦思甜的故事。
exampleTraditional: 他經常給年輕人講憶苦思甜的故事。
exampleEn: He often tells young people stories of recalling past bitterness and thinking of present sweetness.

explanation: 枯、朽枯草朽木。摧折枯朽的草木。形容轻而易举。也比喻摧毁腐朽势力的强大气势。
explanationTraditional: 枯、朽枯草朽木。摧折枯朽的草木。形容輕而易舉。也比喻摧毀腐朽勢力的強大氣勢。
explanationEn: To break rotten wood and withered grass; describes something done with extreme ease, or the powerful momentum of destroying decadent forces.
derivation: 《后汉书·耿弇传》归发突骑，以辚乌合之众，如摧枯折腐耳。”《晋书·甘卓传》将军之举武昌，若摧枯拉朽。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·耿弇傳》歸發突騎，以轔烏合之眾，如摧枯折腐耳。”《晉書·甘卓傳》將軍之舉武昌，若摧枯拉朽。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Later Han: Geng Yan Biography': 'Return and dispatch突击 cavalry to crush the motley crowd, like breaking rotten wood and withered grass.' 'Book of Jin: Gan Zhuo Biography': 'If the general attacks Wuchang, it will be like crushing rotten wood and withered grass.'
example: 拣着个精壮的村夫，赶上一拳打去，只望先打倒一个硬的，其余的便如～了。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十四
exampleTraditional: 揀著個精壯的村夫，趕上一拳打去，只望先打倒一個硬的，其餘的便如～了。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十四
exampleEn: He picked a sturdy villager, stepped forward and punched him, hoping to knock down the tough one first, and the rest would be like crushing rotten wood and withered grass. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 34

explanation: 原意是指希奇少见的花草。也比喻美妙的文章作品等。
explanationTraditional: 原意是指希奇少見的花草。也比喻美妙的文章作品等。
explanationEn: Rare and exotic flowers and plants. Also metaphorically refers to wonderful literary works.
derivation: 《西京杂记》卷三奇树异草，靡不具植。”
derivationTraditional: 《西京雜記》卷三奇樹異草，靡不具植。”
derivationEn: 'Miscellaneous Records of the Western Capital', Volume 3: 'Rare trees and exotic plants, all were planted.'
example: 命岸贾于绛州城内，起一座花园，遍求～，种植其中。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五十回
exampleTraditional: 命岸賈於絳州城內，起一座花園，遍求～，種植其中。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五十回
exampleEn: He ordered Jia An to build a garden in Jiangzhou city, seeking rare flowers and exotic plants to plant inside. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 50

explanation: 入合乎∠乎常情和道理。
explanationTraditional: 入合乎∠乎常情和道理。
explanationEn: Reasonable and logical; in accordance with common sense and reason.
derivation: 清·陈天华《狮子吼》第五回何尝不说得入情入理，但是事实上那里有人听他的呢！”
derivationTraditional: 清·陳天華《獅子吼》第五回何嘗不說得入情入理，但是事實上那裡有人聽他的呢！”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Chen Tianhua, 'The Lion's Roar', Chapter 5: 'Why didn't he speak reasonably and logically? But in reality, who would listen to him!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 每战必胜的指挥官。
explanationTraditional: 每戰必勝的指揮官。
explanationEn: A commander who wins every battle.
derivation: 《后汉书·藏宫传》常胜之家，难于虑敌。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·藏宮傳》常勝之家，難於慮敵。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Zang Gong': 'A constant victor finds it hard to anticipate the enemy.'
example: 我们不能要求事实上的～，这是自古以来就很少的。★毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》
exampleTraditional: 我們不能要求事實上的～，這是自古以來就很少的。★毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》
exampleEn: We cannot demand a factual 'ever-victorious general'; such have been rare since ancient times. — Mao Zedong, 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War'

explanation: 事情要抓紧时机快做，不宜拖延。
explanationTraditional: 事情要抓緊時機快做，不宜拖延。
explanationEn: Matters should be handled promptly without delay.
derivation: 元·贾仲名《萧淑兰》第四的事不宜迟，收拾了便令媒人速去。”
derivationTraditional: 元·賈仲名《蕭淑蘭》第四的事不宜遲，收拾了便令媒人速去。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Jia Zhongming's 'Xiao Shulan', Act 4: 'The matter should not be delayed; pack up and send the matchmaker quickly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻人的刚正不阿，坚强不屈的骨气。
explanationTraditional: 比喻人的剛正不阿，堅強不屈的骨氣。
explanationEn: Metaphor for a person's unyielding and upright character.
derivation: 柯岩《奇异的书简·美的追求者》狂风暴雨刮走的只是枯枝败叶，留下的却是铮铮铁骨。”
derivationTraditional: 柯巖《奇異的書簡·美的追求者》狂風暴雨刮走的只是枯枝敗葉，留下的卻是錚錚鐵骨。”
derivationEn: From Ke Yan's 'Strange Letters: A Pursuer of Beauty': 'The storm only blows away dead branches and leaves, leaving behind the clanking iron bones.'
example: 铁窗生活并没有销磨他的～。★袁鹰《悲欢·不灭的诗魂》
exampleTraditional: 鐵窗生活並沒有銷磨他的～。★袁鷹《悲歡·不滅的詩魂》
exampleEn: Prison life did not wear away his 'iron bones'. — Yuan Ying, 'Sorrow and Joy: The Undying Soul of Poetry'

explanation: 残伤害。自己人互相杀害。
explanationTraditional: 殘傷害。自己人互相殺害。
explanationEn: To kill each other; mutual slaughter among one's own side.
derivation: 《晋书·石季龙载记下》季龙十三子，五人为冉闵所杀，八人自相残杀。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·石季龍載記下》季龍十三子，五人為冉閔所殺，八人自相殘殺。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Shi Jilong, Part 2': 'Of Jilong's thirteen sons, five were killed by Ran Min, and eight killed each other.'
example: 他成日间叫我们～，要我们自家人都互相杀尽了，好叫他那些骚鞑子来占据我们的好土地。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第三回
exampleTraditional: 他成日間叫我們～，要我們自家人都互相殺盡了，好叫他那些騷韃子來佔據我們的好土地。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第三回
exampleEn: He constantly sets us against each other, wanting us to destroy ourselves so that his barbarians can take our land. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren, 'History of Pain', Chapter 3

explanation: 测估测。变化很多，不能预料。
explanationTraditional: 測估測。變化很多，不能預料。
explanationEn: Unpredictable changes; too variable to anticipate.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《殿中少监马君墓志》当是时，见王于北亭，犹高山深林巨谷龙虎，变化不测，杰魁人也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《殿中少監馬君墓誌》當是時，見王於北亭，猶高山深林巨谷龍虎，變化不測，傑魁人也。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Ma Jun, Junior Supervisor of the Palace': 'At that time, seeing the prince at the North Pavilion, he was like a high mountain, deep forest, giant valley, dragon or tiger—unpredictable and extraordinary.'
example: 七十二座天门阵～，昼则凄风冷雨，夜则鬼哭神号。★明·无名氏《杨家将演义》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 七十二座天門陣～，晝則悽風冷雨，夜則鬼哭神號。★明·無名氏《楊家將演義》第二十五回
exampleEn: The seventy-two Heaven-and-Earth formations are unpredictable, with cold winds and rain by day, and ghostly wails by night. — Ming Dynasty Anonymous, 'Romance of the Yang Family Generals', Chapter 25

explanation: 回春使春天重返，比喻将快死的人救活。指医生医术高明。
explanationTraditional: 回春使春天重返，比喻將快死的人救活。指醫生醫術高明。
explanationEn: To bring the dying back to life; describes a doctor's superb medical skill.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十回但是药铺门里门外，足足挂着二三十块匾额什么‘功同良相’，什么‘扁鹊复生’，什么‘妙手回春’……”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十回但是藥鋪門裡門外，足足掛著二三十塊匾額什麼‘功同良相’，什麼‘扁鵲復生’，什麼‘妙手回春’……”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 20: 'But the pharmacy had twenty or thirty plaques hanging inside and out, with inscriptions like 'Merits Equal to a Good Minister', 'Bian Que Reborn', 'Wonderful Hands Bring Spring'...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 舍放下。形容感情很好，不愿分离。亦作难分难舍。”。
explanationTraditional: 舍放下。形容感情很好，不願分離。亦作難分難捨。”。
explanationEn: Reluctant to part; deep emotional attachment making separation difficult.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十一回不免盟山誓海，难舍难分。”清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》难舍难分，所以一直就在船上打了‘水公馆’。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十一回不免盟山誓海，難捨難分。”清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》難捨難分，所以一直就在船上打了‘水公館’。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 21: 'Inevitably they swore oaths and were reluctant to part.' Also from Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure': 'So reluctant to part that they stayed on the boat as a floating home.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 奇异常。极大的耻辱。
explanationTraditional: 奇異常。極大的恥辱。
explanationEn: Extraordinary shame and humiliation.
derivation: 欧阳山《三家巷》一七我们和帝国主义结下了深仇大恨，我们忘不了那些奇耻大辱。”
derivationTraditional: 歐陽山《三家巷》一七我們和帝國主義結下了深仇大恨，我們忘不了那些奇恥大辱。”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Shan's 'Three Family Lane', Chapter 17: 'We have deep hatred for the imperialists; we cannot forget those extraordinary shames and humiliations.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 山岳倒塌，大地裂开。形容响声巨大或变化剧烈。
explanationTraditional: 山嶽倒塌，大地裂開。形容響聲巨大或變化劇烈。
explanationEn: Mountains collapse and the earth splits; describes a loud noise or drastic change.
derivation: 《汉书·元帝纪》山崩地裂，水泉涌出。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·元帝紀》山崩地裂，水泉湧出。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Annals of Emperor Yuan': 'Mountains collapsed, the earth split, and springs gushed forth.'
example: 这正是～有人见，捉生替死却难逢！★明·吴承恩《西游记》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 這正是～有人見，捉生替死卻難逢！★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十二回
exampleEn: This is exactly 'mountains collapse and earth splits, yet someone sees; life is taken and death substituted, but rarely encountered!' — Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 12

explanation: 指隐藏着未被发现的人才，也指隐藏不露的人才。
explanationTraditional: 指隱藏著未被發現的人才，也指隱藏不露的人才。
explanationEn: Hidden talents or undiscovered geniuses; also refers to concealed abilities.
derivation: 北周·庾信《同会河阳公新造山地聊得寓目》诗暗石疑藏虎，盘根似卧龙。”
derivationTraditional: 北周·庾信《同會河陽公新造山地聊得寓目》詩暗石疑藏虎，盤根似臥龍。”
derivationEn: From Northern Zhou Dynasty Yu Xin's poem 'Visiting the New Mountain Residence Built by Heyang Duke': 'Dark rocks seem to hide tigers, twisted roots resemble crouching dragons.'
example: 这所大学～，人才济济。
exampleTraditional: 這所大學～，人才濟濟。
exampleEn: This university is a place of 'hidden dragons and crouching tigers', with a wealth of talent.

explanation: 周游全都走到，游遍。原指孔丘带着他的学生周游当时的许多国家，希望得到重用，以便推行儒家的政治主张◇指走遍各地。
explanationTraditional: 周遊全都走到，遊遍。原指孔丘帶著他的學生周遊當時的許多國家，希望得到重用，以便推行儒家的政治主張◇指走遍各地。
explanationEn: To travel around many countries, originally referring to Confucius traveling with his students to various states seeking to promote his political ideas; now means to travel extensively.
derivation: 曹余章《上下五千年·孔子周游列国》孔子的学生说‘鲁君不办正事，咱们走吧！’打那以后，孔子离开鲁国，带着一批学生周游列国，希望找个机会实行他的政治主张。”
derivationTraditional: 曹餘章《上下五千年·孔子周遊列國》孔子的學生說‘魯君不辦正事，咱們走吧！’打那以後，孔子離開魯國，帶著一批學生周遊列國，希望找個機會實行他的政治主張。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of Confucius Traveling Around the States' by Cao Yuzhang: Confucius' students said, 'The ruler of Lu is not doing proper business, let's go!' After that, Confucius left Lu and traveled around the states with his students, hoping to find an opportunity to implement his political ideas.
example: 扁鹊深入民间，‘～’，‘随俗为变’，解除人民疾病的痛苦。★陶铸《崇高的理想》
exampleTraditional: 扁鵲深入民間，‘～’，‘隨俗為變’，解除人民疾病的痛苦。★陶鑄《崇高的理想》
exampleEn: Bian Que went deep into the people, 'traveling around the states', 'changing with customs', to relieve people's diseases and pains. ★ Tao Zhu's 'Lofty Ideals'

explanation: 祸、殃损害。使国家受害，百姓遭殃。
explanationTraditional: 禍、殃損害。使國家受害，百姓遭殃。
explanationEn: To bring disaster to the country and the people; to harm the nation and its citizens.
derivation: 章炳麟《正学报缘起·例言》如去岁兖州之变，西报指斥疆臣，谓其祸国殃民，肉不足以啖狗彘。”
derivationTraditional: 章炳麟《正學報緣起·例言》如去歲兗州之變，西報指斥疆臣，謂其禍國殃民，肉不足以啖狗彘。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Binglin's 'Preface to the Journal of Rectification': 'Like the incident in Yanzhou last year, Western newspapers accused the local officials of bringing disaster to the country and the people, saying their flesh is not enough to feed dogs and pigs.'
example: 第八条罪状是传播出去，～。★毛泽东《反对党八股》
exampleTraditional: 第八條罪狀是傳播出去，～。★毛澤東《反對黨八股》
exampleEn: The eighth crime is spreading it, bringing disaster to the country and the people. ★ Mao Zedong's 'Oppose Party Formalism'

explanation: 稳有把握；操掌握；胜券能够制胜的计谋。指有把握取得胜利。
explanationTraditional: 穩有把握；操掌握；勝券能夠制勝的計謀。指有把握取得勝利。
explanationEn: To have a sure grasp of victory; to be certain of success.
derivation: 《管子·明法解》故明操必胜之数，以治必用之民。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·明法解》故明操必勝之數，以治必用之民。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Mingfa Jie': 'Therefore, the wise ruler holds the strategy of certain victory to govern the people who must be used.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 毕完全。凶恶的面目完全暴露了出来。
explanationTraditional: 畢完全。兇惡的面目完全暴露了出來。
explanationEn: To reveal one's ferocious nature completely; to show one's true vicious colors.
derivation: 柯岩《追赶太阳的人》吴丙治向他征收税款时，他～地威胁'谁有钱给你，小心你的脑袋吧！'”
derivationTraditional: 柯巖《追趕太陽的人》吳丙治向他徵收稅款時，他～地威脅'誰有錢給你，小心你的腦袋吧！'”
derivationEn: From Ke Yan's 'The Man Chasing the Sun': 'When Wu Bingzhi collected taxes from him, he threatened ferociously, 'Who has money to give you? Watch your head!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 攻治。中医用语，指用含有毒性的药物治疗毒疮等恶性病。比喻利用不良事物本身的矛盾来反对不良事物，或利用恶人来对付恶人。
explanationTraditional: 攻治。中醫用語，指用含有毒性的藥物治療毒瘡等惡性病。比喻利用不良事物本身的矛盾來反對不良事物，或利用惡人來對付惡人。
explanationEn: To use poison as an antidote for poison; to fight evil with evil; to use a bad person to deal with another bad person.
derivation: 明·陶宗仪《辍耕录》卷二十九骨咄犀，蛇角也，其性至毒，而能解毒，盖以毒攻毒也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·陶宗儀《輟耕錄》卷二十九骨咄犀，蛇角也，其性至毒，而能解毒，蓋以毒攻毒也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Tao Zongyi's 'Chuogeng Lu', Volume 29: 'Guduxi, a snake horn, is extremely toxic but can detoxify, thus using poison to attack poison.'
example: ～，反而证明了反对白话者自己的不识字，不通文。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文二集·从别字”说开去》
exampleTraditional: ～，反而證明了反對白話者自己的不識字，不通文。★魯迅《且介亭雜文二集·從別字”說開去》
exampleEn: Using poison to attack poison, it instead proves that those who oppose vernacular Chinese are illiterate and illogical. ★ Lu Xun's 'Essays from Qiejieting: On 'Wrong Characters''

explanation: 惜吝惜。指舍得出本钱。
explanationTraditional: 惜吝惜。指捨得出本錢。
explanationEn: To spare no expense; to be willing to invest heavily.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第七十三回姓方的瞧着眼热，有凡家该钱的，也就不惜工本，公开一个学堂。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第七十三回姓方的瞧著眼熱，有凡家該錢的，也就不惜工本，公開一個學堂。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 73: 'A man named Fang saw it with envy, and some wealthy families spared no expense to open a school.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风和雪同时袭来。
explanationTraditional: 風和雪同時襲來。
explanationEn: Wind and snow occurring simultaneously; a blizzard.
derivation: 范长江《塞上行·行纪·百灵庙战行·三》尽管是在风雪交加的时节，我们的视线仍可以入到非常遥远。”
derivationTraditional: 範長江《塞上行·行紀·百靈廟戰行·三》儘管是在風雪交加的時節，我們的視線仍可以入到非常遙遠。”
derivationEn: From Fan Changjiang's 'On the Great Wall: Journey to Bailing Temple, Part 3': 'Even in the season of wind and snow, our vision could still reach very far.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 有开头也有收尾。指做事能坚持到底。
explanationTraditional: 有開頭也有收尾。指做事能堅持到底。
explanationEn: To have a beginning and an end; to finish what one starts; to be consistent throughout.
derivation: 《论语·子张》有始有卒者，其惟圣人乎！”《魏书·袁翻传》伏愿天地成造，有始有终，矜臣疲病，乞臣骸骨。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子張》有始有卒者，其惟聖人乎！”《魏書·袁翻傳》伏願天地成造，有始有終，矜臣疲病，乞臣骸骨。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Zizhang': 'Only the sage can have a beginning and an end.' From 'Weishu: Yuan Fan Biography': 'I beg the emperor to have a beginning and an end, to pity my illness, and to allow me to retire.'
example: 同学之间要～地保持友好关系。
exampleTraditional: 同學之間要～地保持友好關係。
exampleEn: Classmates should maintain friendly relations from beginning to end.

explanation: 比喻因不受重视而担任清闲的职务。也比喻长期等候工作或长久地等待接见。
explanationTraditional: 比喻因不受重視而擔任清閒的職務。也比喻長期等候工作或長久地等待接見。
explanationEn: To sit on a cold bench; to be sidelined or ignored; to hold a minor or idle position; to wait for a long time.
derivation: 高阳《胭脂井》昨天慈圣召见，特别提到，说‘只要我一天管事，决不会让李某人坐冷板凳。’”
derivationTraditional: 高陽《胭脂井》昨天慈聖召見，特別提到，說‘只要我一天管事，決不會讓李某人坐冷板凳。’”
derivationEn: From Gao Yang's 'Rouge Well': 'Yesterday, the Empress Dowager mentioned specifically, 'As long as I am in charge, I will never let Li sit on a cold bench.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 厌世厌弃人世。对生活失去信心，精神颓丧，厌弃人世。
explanationTraditional: 厭世厭棄人世。對生活失去信心，精神頹喪，厭棄人世。
explanationEn: To be pessimistic and weary of life; to lose hope and become disillusioned with the world.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 生活的艰辛，爱憎的苦恼，使她产生了悲观厌世的情绪。
exampleTraditional: 生活的艱辛，愛憎的苦惱，使她產生了悲觀厭世的情緒。
exampleEn: The hardships of life and the pains of love made her pessimistic and weary of the world.

explanation: 身体前后晃动。形容大笑或困倦得直不起腰的样子。
explanationTraditional: 身體前後晃動。形容大笑或睏倦得直不起腰的樣子。
explanationEn: Rocking back and forth, unable to straighten up due to laughter or drowsiness.
derivation: 明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第四十回把李瓶儿笑的前仰后合。”
derivationTraditional: 明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第四十回把李瓶兒笑的前仰後合。”
derivationEn: From 'The Plum in the Golden Vase' by Lanling Xiaoxiao Sheng, Chapter 40: 'Li Pinger laughed so hard she rocked back and forth.'
example: 众人听了，越发哄然大笑的～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 眾人聽了，越發鬨然大笑的～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十二回
exampleEn: Upon hearing this, the crowd burst into even louder laughter, rocking back and forth. (From 'Dream of the Red Chamber' by Cao Xueqin, Chapter 42)

explanation: 切切合；中恰好对上；弊害处。指发表的言论正好击中当时社会的弊病。
explanationTraditional: 切切合；中恰好對上；弊害處。指發表的言論正好擊中當時社會的弊病。
explanationEn: To hit the current social ills precisely; to criticize the malpractices of the time accurately.
derivation: 丁一岚《不单是为了纪念》这些杂文旗帜鲜明、爱憎分明、切中时弊而又短小精炼、妙趣横生、富有寓意，博得了广大读者的欢迎和支持。”
derivationTraditional: 丁一嵐《不單是為了紀念》這些雜文旗幟鮮明、愛憎分明、切中時弊而又短小精煉、妙趣橫生、富有寓意，博得了廣大讀者的歡迎和支持。”
derivationEn: From Ding Yilan's 'Not Just for Commemoration': 'These essays are clear-cut, love and hate distinct, hit current ills, and are short, concise, witty, and meaningful, winning wide readership and support.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 昏天黑。天地昏黑无光。形容刮大风时漫天沙土的景象。也比喻政治腐败，社会黑暗。
explanationTraditional: 昏天黑。天地昏黑無光。形容颳大風時漫天沙土的景象。也比喻政治腐敗，社會黑暗。
explanationEn: The sky and earth are dark and gloomy; describes a sandstorm or metaphorically corrupt politics and dark society.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《龙移》诗天昏地黑蛟龙移，雷惊电激雄雌随。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《龍移》詩天昏地黑蛟龍移，雷驚電激雄雌隨。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's poem 'Dragon Moves': 'The sky darkens, the earth blackens, the dragon moves; thunder startles, lightning excites, male and female follow.'
example: 只见狂风四起，飞沙走石，～，日月无光。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 只見狂風四起，飛沙走石，～，日月無光。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十回
exampleEn: Suddenly a strong wind arose, sand and stones flew, the sky darkened and the earth dimmed, sun and moon lost their light. (From 'Water Margin' by Shi Nai'an, Chapter 60)

explanation: 珠、宝指首饰；光、气形容闪耀着光彩。旧时形容妇女服饰华贵富丽，闪耀着珍宝的光色。
explanationTraditional: 珠、寶指首飾；光、氣形容閃耀著光彩。舊時形容婦女服飾華貴富麗，閃耀著珍寶的光色。
explanationEn: Glittering with jewels; describes women's luxurious and ornate attire, shining with the luster of gems.
derivation: 鲁迅《准风月谈·难得糊涂》这光芒要是只在字和词，那就象古墓里的贵妇人似的，满身都是珠光宝气了。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《準風月談·難得糊塗》這光芒要是隻在字和詞，那就象古墓裡的貴婦人似的，滿身都是珠光寶氣了。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Quasi Fengyue Tan: Hard to Be Confused': 'If this light is only in words and phrases, it is like a noblewoman in an ancient tomb, covered in pearls and jewels.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 同生共死，相依为命。形容情谊极深重。
explanationTraditional: 同生共死，相依為命。形容情誼極深重。
explanationEn: To share life and death; to be deeply bonded, willing to live or die together.
derivation: 《深情忆念周伯伯》几十年来，周总理与我父亲生死与共，休戚相关。”
derivationTraditional: 《深情憶念周伯伯》幾十年來，周總理與我父親生死與共，休慼相關。”
derivationEn: From 'Deep Memories of Uncle Zhou': 'For decades, Premier Zhou and my father shared life and death, joys and sorrows.'
example: 让我们在这斗争的风暴中，～呵，走向胜利！★贺敬之《放歌集·胜利和我们在一起》
exampleTraditional: 讓我們在這鬥爭的風暴中，～呵，走向勝利！★賀敬之《放歌集·勝利和我們在一起》
exampleEn: Let us, in this storm of struggle, share life and death and march toward victory! (From He Jingzhi's 'Song Collection: Victory Is with Us')

explanation: 形容动作的反复或交替。
explanationTraditional: 形容動作的反覆或交替。
explanationEn: Describes repeated or alternating actions; back and forth.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第六十七回行者暗笑道‘好是耳聋口哑！不要走！看棍！’那怪更不怕，乱舞枪遮拦。在那半空中，一来一往，一上一下，斗到三更时分，未见胜败。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第六十七回行者暗笑道‘好是耳聾口啞！不要走！看棍！’那怪更不怕，亂舞槍遮攔。在那半空中，一來一往，一上一下，鬥到三更時分，未見勝敗。”
derivationEn: From 'Journey to the West' by Wu Cheng'en, Chapter 67: 'The Monkey King laughed secretly: "Deaf and mute! Don't run! Watch my staff!" The monster was fearless and parried wildly. In midair, they went back and forth, up and down, fighting until midnight without victory.'
example: 到天色晚了，每船两盏明角灯，～，映著河里，上下明亮。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十一回
exampleTraditional: 到天色晚了，每船兩盞明角燈，～，映著河裡，上下明亮。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十一回
exampleEn: By evening, each boat had two bright horn lanterns, going back and forth, reflecting on the river, bright above and below. (From 'The Scholars' by Wu Jingzi, Chapter 41)

explanation: 形容地形险要，利于作战的地方。比喻可以施展自己才能的地方或机会。
explanationTraditional: 形容地形險要，利於作戰的地方。比喻可以施展自己才能的地方或機會。
explanationEn: A place favorable for military operations; metaphorically, a place or opportunity to display one's talents.
derivation: 《晋书·姚襄载记》洛阳虽小，山河四塞，亦是用武之地。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·姚襄載記》洛陽雖小，山河四塞，亦是用武之地。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Yao Xiang': 'Though Luoyang is small, it is surrounded by mountains and rivers on all sides, making it a place for military action.'
example: 你自己先把根基弄坏了，将来就有～，也不能做个大英雄，岂不是自暴自弃？★冰心《两个家庭》
exampleTraditional: 你自己先把根基弄壞了，將來就有～，也不能做個大英雄，豈不是自暴自棄？★冰心《兩個家庭》
exampleEn: If you ruin your foundation first, even if you have a place to use your talents in the future, you cannot become a great hero. Isn't that self-abandonment? (From Bing Xin's 'Two Families')

explanation: 戈闪耀着金光，马配备了铁甲。比喻战争。也形容战士持枪驰马的雄姿。
explanationTraditional: 戈閃耀著金光，馬配備了鐵甲。比喻戰爭。也形容戰士持槍馳馬的雄姿。
explanationEn: Golden spears and iron horses; metaphor for war, or describes the heroic posture of soldiers with weapons and armored horses.
derivation: 《新五代史·李袭吉传》金戈铁马，蹂践于明时。”
derivationTraditional: 《新五代史·李襲吉傳》金戈鐵馬，蹂踐於明時。”
derivationEn: From 'New History of the Five Dynasties: Biography of Li Xiji': 'Golden spears and iron horses trample in the bright era.'
example: 想当年～，气吞万里如虎。★宋·辛弃疾《永遇乐·京口北固亭怀古》词
exampleTraditional: 想當年～，氣吞萬里如虎。★宋·辛棄疾《永遇樂·京口北固亭懷古》詞
exampleEn: Thinking of those years, with golden spears and iron horses, we swallowed thousands of miles like a tiger. (From Xin Qiji's poem 'Eternal Joy: Nostalgia at Jingkou Beigu Pavilion')

explanation: 躬亲亲自。不论什么事一定要亲自去做，亲自过问。形容办事认真，毫不懈怠。
explanationTraditional: 躬親親自。不論什麼事一定要親自去做，親自過問。形容辦事認真，毫不懈怠。
explanationEn: To attend to everything personally; to handle all matters oneself, showing diligence and responsibility.
derivation: 《诗·小雅·节南山》弗躬弗亲，庶民弗信。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·小雅·節南山》弗躬弗親，庶民弗信。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Jie Nanshan': 'If you do not personally attend, the common people will not trust you.'
example: 于舅太爷却勤勤恳恳，～，于这位外甥的事格外当心。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十九回
exampleTraditional: 於舅太爺卻勤勤懇懇，～，於這位外甥的事格外當心。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十九回
exampleEn: But Uncle Yu was diligent and attended to everything personally, especially careful with his nephew's affairs. (From 'The Bureaucrats' by Li Baojia, Chapter 59)

explanation: 迷信指有被杀的灾祸，
explanationTraditional: 迷信指有被殺的災禍，
explanationEn: Superstitious belief of a calamity involving bloodshed or death.
derivation: 元·无名氏《盆儿鬼》楔子此卦洽谈室一百日内，有血光之灾，只怕躲不过去。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《盆兒鬼》楔子此卦洽談室一百日內，有血光之災，只怕躲不過去。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty anonymous play 'The Ghost in the Basin' prologue: 'This divination indicates that within a hundred days, there will be a disaster of blood, and it may be unavoidable.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 逆叛逆；道指封建道德；不道违反封建道德。旧时统治阶级对破坏封建秩序的人所加的重大罪名。
explanationTraditional: 逆叛逆；道指封建道德；不道違反封建道德。舊時統治階級對破壞封建秩序的人所加的重大罪名。
explanationEn: A major crime against feudal morality, used by ruling classes to condemn those who disrupt feudal order.
derivation: 《史记·高祖本纪》天下所不容，大逆无道。”《汉书·杨恽传》为妖恶言，大逆不道，请逮捕治。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·高祖本紀》天下所不容，大逆無道。”《漢書·楊惲傳》為妖惡言，大逆不道，請逮捕治。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Annals of Gaozu': 'Unacceptable to the world, great rebellion without morality.' And 'Book of Han: Biography of Yang Yun': 'Spreading evil words, great rebellion without morality, please arrest and punish.'
example: 汝赖吾玉玺，僭称帝号，背反汉室，～！吾方欲加兵问罪，岂肯反助贼乎！★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 汝賴吾玉璽，僭稱帝號，背反漢室，～！吾方欲加兵問罪，豈肯反助賊乎！★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十七回
exampleEn: You rely on my jade seal to falsely claim the title of emperor, betraying the Han dynasty—this is great rebellion without morality! I was about to raise an army to punish you, how could I instead help the rebels? — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 17

explanation: 善容易。经常发愁和伤感。形容人思想空虚，感情脆弱。
explanationTraditional: 善容易。經常發愁和傷感。形容人思想空虛，感情脆弱。
explanationEn: Often worried and sentimental; describes a person with an empty mind and fragile emotions.
derivation: 唐·陆龟蒙《自遣诗三十首》多情善感自难忘，只有风流共古长。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·陸龜蒙《自遣詩三十首》多情善感自難忘，只有風流共古長。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Lu Guimeng, 'Thirty Poems of Self-Expression': 'Sentimental and hard to forget, only romance lasts as long as ancient times.'
example: 过去，我～，看什么都没有意思；父母对我不好，引起我对世界上一切都憎恨。★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第一章
exampleTraditional: 過去，我～，看什麼都沒有意思；父母對我不好，引起我對世界上一切都憎恨。★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第一章
exampleEn: In the past, I was sentimental and saw nothing meaningful; my parents' mistreatment made me hate everything in the world. — Yang Mo, 'The Song of Youth', Chapter 1, Part 2

explanation: 邦国家。国家多灾多难，在一定条件下可以激励人民奋发图强，战胜困难，使国家强盛起来。
explanationTraditional: 邦國家。國家多災多難，在一定條件下可以激勵人民奮發圖強，戰勝困難，使國家強盛起來。
explanationEn: A nation may become stronger through many hardships, as they can inspire people to strive and overcome difficulties.
derivation: 《左传·昭公四年》邻国之难，不可虞也。或多难以固其国，启其疆土；或无难以丧其国，失其守宇。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公四年》鄰國之難，不可虞也。或多難以固其國，啟其疆土；或無難以喪其國，失其守宇。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Zhao's Fourth Year': 'Neighboring states' difficulties should not be taken lightly. Sometimes many hardships strengthen a country and expand its territory; sometimes no hardships lead to the loss of the country and its territory.'
example: 现在这样的局面，我们是有办法对付的，要迎接困难，～”。★《周恩来选集》下卷
exampleTraditional: 現在這樣的局面，我們是有辦法對付的，要迎接困難，～”。★《周恩來選集》下卷
exampleEn: In such a situation, we have ways to deal with it. We must face difficulties, and 'a nation may become stronger through many hardships.' — 'Selected Works of Zhou Enlai', Volume 2

explanation: 国家富足，人民强健。
explanationTraditional: 國家富足，人民強健。
explanationEn: The country is prosperous and the people are strong.
derivation: 汉·赵晔《吴越春秋》民富国强，众安道泰。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·趙曄《吳越春秋》民富國強，眾安道泰。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Zhao Ye, 'Spring and Autumn of Wu and Yue': 'People rich and country strong, all peaceful and prosperous.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 灰心心如熄灭了的死灰；丧失去。形容因失败或不顺利而失去信心，意志消沉。
explanationTraditional: 灰心心如熄滅了的死灰；喪失去。形容因失敗或不順利而失去信心，意志消沉。
explanationEn: Losing heart and being disheartened; describes losing confidence and becoming despondent due to failure or setbacks.
derivation: 明·吕坤《呻吟语·下·建功立业》是以志趋不坚，人言是恤者，辄灰心丧气，竟不卒功。”
derivationTraditional: 明·呂坤《呻吟語·下·建功立業》是以志趨不堅，人言是恤者，輒灰心喪氣，竟不卒功。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Lü Kun, 'Groaning Words: Part 2: Establishing Merit': 'Therefore, those with weak will and easily swayed by others' words often lose heart and give up, ultimately failing to achieve success.'
example: 因为遭受了很大的损失，都有些～了。★吴玉章《论辛亥革命》
exampleTraditional: 因為遭受了很大的損失，都有些～了。★吳玉章《論辛亥革命》
exampleEn: Because they suffered great losses, they all became somewhat disheartened. — Wu Yuzhang, 'On the Xinhai Revolution'

explanation: 形容天色昏暗。也比喻社会黑暗混乱。
explanationTraditional: 形容天色昏暗。也比喻社會黑暗混亂。
explanationEn: Describes dark skies; also metaphorically refers to social darkness and chaos.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二十五郑蕊珠昏天黑地，不认得这条路是那里，离家是近是远。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二十五鄭蕊珠昏天黑地，不認得這條路是那裡，離家是近是遠。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement, Second Series', Volume 25: 'Zheng Ruizhu, in the pitch darkness, could not recognize which road this was or whether home was near or far.'
example: 加以象现在的～，你若打开窗子说亮话，还是免不了做牺牲。★鲁迅《两地书》九
exampleTraditional: 加以象現在的～，你若打開窗子說亮話，還是免不了做犧牲。★魯迅《兩地書》九
exampleEn: Moreover, in such a dark and chaotic time, if you speak plainly, you will still end up a sacrifice. — Lu Xun, 'Letters from Two Places', No. 9

explanation: 旧时迷信的人认为命里注定要遭受的灾难是无法逃脱的。现有时也用来指某种灾害不可避免。
explanationTraditional: 舊時迷信的人認為命裡註定要遭受的災難是無法逃脫的。現有時也用來指某種災害不可避免。
explanationEn: Superstitious belief that a destined disaster is unavoidable; now sometimes used to mean that certain calamities are inevitable.
derivation: 毛泽东《论持久战》‘在劫难逃’，于是形成了绝对的敌对。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《論持久戰》‘在劫難逃’，於是形成了絕對的敵對。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong, 'On Protracted War': 'If you are doomed, you cannot escape,' thus forming absolute hostility.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 精减人员，缩减机构。
explanationTraditional: 精減人員，縮減機構。
explanationEn: To streamline troops and simplify administration; reduce personnel and cut down institutions.
derivation: 郭沫若《洪波曲》第十四章只要肯认真抗战，这种精兵简政，分头并进，倒也似乎更要合理些了。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《洪波曲》第十四章只要肯認真抗戰，這種精兵簡政，分頭並進，倒也似乎更要合理些了。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo, 'Waves of Hongqu', Chapter 14: 'As long as they are serious about resisting Japan, this policy of streamlining troops and simplifying administration, with separate advances, seems more reasonable.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 讨招惹。自己找苦吃。
explanationTraditional: 討招惹。自己找苦吃。
explanationEn: To ask for trouble; to bring suffering upon oneself.
derivation: 鲁迅《华盖集·碰壁”之后》可是我有一种毛病，自己也疑心是自讨苦吃的要苗，就是偶尔要想想。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《華蓋集·碰壁”之後》可是我有一種毛病，自己也疑心是自討苦吃的要苗，就是偶爾要想想。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun, 'Huagai Collection: After 'Bumping into a Wall'': 'But I have a problem, which I suspect is a tendency to ask for trouble, that is, I occasionally think.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 期时间。以后何时相会还没有一定的日期。
explanationTraditional: 期時間。以後何時相會還沒有一定的日期。
explanationEn: No fixed date for future meeting; uncertain when we will meet again.
derivation: 北朝·魏衒之《洛阳伽蓝记·大统寺》老翁送元宝出，云‘后会难期。’以为凄恨，别甚殷勤。”
derivationTraditional: 北朝·魏衒之《洛陽伽藍記·大統寺》老翁送元寶出，雲‘後會難期。’以為悽恨，別甚殷勤。”
derivationEn: From Northern Wei, Yang Xuanzhi, 'Records of Luoyang's Temples: Datong Temple': 'The old man saw Yuan Bao off and said, 'It will be hard to meet again.' They felt sorrowful and parted with great reluctance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鬻卖。形容政治腐败，统治阶级靠出卖官职来搜刮财富。
explanationTraditional: 鬻賣。形容政治腐敗，統治階級靠出賣官職來搜刮財富。
explanationEn: Selling official positions and titles; describes political corruption where the ruling class sells government posts to extort wealth.
derivation: 《宋书·邓琬传》父子并卖官鬻爵。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·鄧琬傳》父子並賣官鬻爵。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Song: Biography of Deng Wan': 'Father and son both sold official positions and titles.'
example: 昔黄巾造反，其原皆由十常侍～，非亲不用，非仇不诛，以致天下大乱。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第二回
exampleTraditional: 昔黃巾造反，其原皆由十常侍～，非親不用，非仇不誅，以致天下大亂。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第二回
exampleEn: In the past, the Yellow Turban Rebellion was caused by the Ten Regular Attendants selling official positions and titles, employing only relatives and killing enemies, leading to chaos. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 2

explanation: 恍仿佛；世三十年为一世。仿佛隔了一个时代。指一种因人事或景物变化很大而引起的感触。
explanationTraditional: 恍彷彿；世三十年為一世。彷彿隔了一個時代。指一種因人事或景物變化很大而引起的感觸。
explanationEn: As if separated by a lifetime; a feeling caused by great changes in people or scenery.
derivation: 宋·范成大《吴船录下》发常州，平江亲戚故旧来相迓者，陆续于道，恍然如隔世焉。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·范成大《吳船錄下》發常州，平江親戚故舊來相迓者，陸續於道，恍然如隔世焉。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Fan Chengda, 'Record of the Wu Boat': 'When I left Changzhou, old friends and relatives from Pingjiang came to greet me on the road, and it felt as if a lifetime had passed.'
example: 盖聪明灵性，经一病而汩没销枕，遂举昔日所为，～耳。★清·淮阴百一居士《壶天录》卷下
exampleTraditional: 蓋聰明靈性，經一病而汩沒銷枕，遂舉昔日所為，～耳。★清·淮陰百一居士《壺天錄》卷下
exampleEn: Due to illness, his intelligence and spirit were lost, and everything he had done before seemed like a different world. — Qing Dynasty, Huaiyin Baiyi Jushi, 'Records of the Gourd' Volume 2

explanation: 如此象这样；而已罢了。就是这样罢了。
explanationTraditional: 如此象這樣；而已罷了。就是這樣罷了。
explanationEn: That's all; just like that.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》无为其所不为，无欲其所不欲，如此而已矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》無為其所不為，無慾其所不欲，如此而已矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jin Xin I': 'Do not do what you should not do, do not desire what you should not desire, that's all.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 瞑目闭眼。死了也不闭眼。原指人死的时候心里还有放不下的事。现常用来形容极不甘心。
explanationTraditional: 瞑目閉眼。死了也不閉眼。原指人死的時候心裡還有放不下的事。現常用來形容極不甘心。
explanationEn: Die with eyes open; unwilling to die in peace; describes extreme unwillingness or regret.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·孙坚传》今不夷汝三族，悬示四海，则吾死不瞑目。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·孫堅傳》今不夷汝三族，懸示四海，則吾死不瞑目。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Book of Wu: Biography of Sun Jian': 'If I do not exterminate your three clans and display them to the world, I will die with my eyes open.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 从近处到远处。比喻事物的影响逐渐推广，思想认识不断深入。
explanationTraditional: 從近處到遠處。比喻事物的影響逐漸推廣，思想認識不斷深入。
explanationEn: From near to far; describes the gradual spread of influence or deepening of understanding.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 窦孔穴；情窦情意的发生或男女爱情萌动。指刚刚懂得爱情（多指少女）。
explanationTraditional: 竇孔穴；情竇情意的發生或男女愛情萌動。指剛剛懂得愛情（多指少女）。
explanationEn: First awakening of love; refers to a young person (especially a girl) just beginning to understand romantic feelings.
derivation: 宋·郭印《次韵正纪见贻之计》情窦欲开先自窒，心里已净弗须锄。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·郭印《次韻正紀見貽之計》情竇欲開先自窒，心裡已淨弗須鋤。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Guo Yin, 'Reply to Zheng Ji's Poem': 'When love's door is about to open, first block it; when the mind is pure, no need to weed.'
example: 我和你自～之际，就等到如今了。（清·李渔《蜃中楼·耳卜》）
exampleTraditional: 我和你自～之際，就等到如今了。（清·李漁《蜃中樓·耳卜》）
exampleEn: Since the first awakening of our love, we have waited until now. — Qing Dynasty, Li Yu, 'The Conch in the Mansion: Ear Divination'

explanation: 聚集一帮人到处惹事，制造纠纷。
explanationTraditional: 聚集一幫人到處惹事，製造糾紛。
explanationEn: Gather a crowd to cause trouble; create disturbances.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他们爱聚众滋事，影响极坏。
exampleTraditional: 他們愛聚眾滋事，影響極壞。
exampleEn: They love to gather crowds and cause trouble, having a very bad influence.

explanation: 中内心。悲痛的感情从内心涌出来。
explanationTraditional: 中內心。悲痛的感情從內心湧出來。
explanationEn: Grief wells up from within; sadness surges from the heart.
derivation: 三国·魏·曹操《短歌行》悲从中来，不可断绝。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·曹操《短歌行》悲從中來，不可斷絕。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms, Wei, Cao Cao, 'Short Song Style': 'Grief comes from within, unceasing.'
example: 大家联了此语，益觉～，泣不可抑。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 大家聯了此語，益覺～，泣不可抑。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第二十回
exampleEn: Hearing this, everyone felt grief welling up and could not stop crying. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 20

explanation: 噤闭口不作声。象深秋的蝉那样一声不吭。比喻因害怕有所顾虑而不敢说话。
explanationTraditional: 噤閉口不作聲。象深秋的蟬那樣一聲不吭。比喻因害怕有所顧慮而不敢說話。
explanationEn: As silent as a cicada in cold weather; describes someone who is silent out of fear or caution.
derivation: 《后汉书·杜密传》刘胜位为大夫，见礼上宾，而知善不荐，闻恶无言，隐情惜己，自同寒蝉，此罪人也。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·杜密傳》劉勝位為大夫，見禮上賓，而知善不薦，聞惡無言，隱情惜己，自同寒蟬，此罪人也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Du Mi': 'Liu Sheng, as a high official, knew good but did not recommend, heard evil but did not speak, hid his feelings and cherished himself, like a cicada in cold weather—this is a sinner.'
example: 他的话完了，台下有几个人拚命地高声鼓掌，而更多的人却～、面面相觑。★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第三十八章
exampleTraditional: 他的話完了，臺下有幾個人拚命地高聲鼓掌，而更多的人卻～、面面相覷。★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第三十八章
exampleEn: After his speech, a few people in the audience applauded loudly, but many more were as silent as cicadas in winter, looking at each other in dismay. — Yang Mo, 'Song of Youth', Part 2, Chapter 38

explanation: 形容夫妻或相爱的男女十分亲昵。
explanationTraditional: 形容夫妻或相愛的男女十分親暱。
explanationEn: Deeply in love; describes a couple or lovers being very affectionate.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·惑溺》亲卿爱卿，是以卿卿，我不卿卿，谁当卿卿？”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·惑溺》親卿愛卿，是以卿卿，我不卿卿，誰當卿卿？”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Song, Liu Yiqing, 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Infatuation': 'I love you, so I call you 'qingqing'; if I don't call you 'qingqing', who will?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 辽远广阔，看不到边际。
explanationTraditional: 遼遠廣闊，看不到邊際。
explanationEn: Stretching as far as the eye can see; vast and boundless.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: ～的蓝色大海，令人心旷神怡。
exampleTraditional: ～的藍色大海，令人心曠神怡。
exampleEn: The boundless blue sea is refreshing and relaxing.

explanation: 畸偏。有时偏轻，有时偏重。形容事物发展不均衡，或对待事物的态度不公正。
explanationTraditional: 畸偏。有時偏輕，有時偏重。形容事物發展不均衡，或對待事物的態度不公正。
explanationEn: Sometimes too light, sometimes too heavy; describing unbalanced development or unfair treatment.
derivation: 宋·黄六鸿《福惠全书》丁与粮无畸轻畸重之弊。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃六鴻《福惠全書》丁與糧無畸輕畸重之弊。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Huang Liuhong's 'Fuhui Quanshu': 'There is no bias of being too light or too heavy between land and grain.'
example: 于行政立法两方权力，～，未剂于平，致滋口实。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第八十四回
exampleTraditional: 於行政立法兩方權力，～，未劑於平，致滋口實。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第八十四回
exampleEn: In the powers of administration and legislation, there was imbalance, not adjusted to fairness, causing criticism. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 84

explanation: ①犹言硬碰硬。比喻说话办事坚决、干脆。②比喻已成定论。
explanationTraditional: ①猶言硬碰硬。比喻說話辦事堅決、乾脆。②比喻已成定論。
explanationEn: ① Firm and resolute in speech or action. ② Already settled; unchangeable.
derivation: 范乃成《小技术员战胜神仙手》［老汉］右手的烟袋朝着支书手中的计划点了几点，铁板钉钉似的崩出来三个字‘我反对！’”
derivationTraditional: 範乃成《小技術員戰勝神仙手》［老漢］右手的菸袋朝著支書手中的計劃點了幾點，鐵板釘釘似的崩出來三個字‘我反對！’”
derivationEn: Fan Naicheng's 'Little Technician Defeats the Immortal Hand': 'The old man tapped his pipe on the plan in the secretary's hand a few times, and uttered three words as firmly as nailing iron plates: 'I oppose!''
example: 大红门里的叶处长就是二妞儿，已经～，不容怀疑了。★《花城》1981年第6期
exampleTraditional: 大紅門裡的葉處長就是二妞兒，已經～，不容懷疑了。★《花城》1981年第6期
exampleEn: Ye Chang, the head of the Red Gate, was Er Niu'er, already nailed down, beyond doubt. — 'Flower City', 1981, Issue 6

explanation: 指尽情说出要说的话而感到畅快。
explanationTraditional: 指盡情說出要說的話而感到暢快。
explanationEn: To feel relieved after speaking one's mind fully.
derivation: 谌容《真真假假》仿佛全是他积郁在胸中多时的由衷之言，今日终于得以一吐为快。”
derivationTraditional: 諶容《真真假假》彷彿全是他積鬱在胸中多時的由衷之言，今日終於得以一吐為快。”
derivationEn: Chen Rong's 'True or False': 'It seemed like heartfelt words pent up in his chest for a long time, finally able to be spoken out.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 嘴里说得很好，心里想的却是另一套。指心口不一致。
explanationTraditional: 嘴裡說得很好，心裡想的卻是另一套。指心口不一致。
explanationEn: Saying one thing but meaning another; duplicitous.
derivation: 汉·桓谭《新论·辨惑》如非其人，口是而心非者，虽寸断支解，而道犹不出也。”《抱朴子·微旨》口是心非，背向异辞。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·桓譚《新論·辨惑》如非其人，口是而心非者，雖寸斷支解，而道猶不出也。”《抱朴子·微旨》口是心非，背向異辭。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Huan Tan's 'Xinlun': 'If a person is not the right one, saying yes but meaning no, even if cut into pieces, the Way will not come out.' 'Baopuzi': 'Saying yes but meaning no, speaking differently behind one's back.'
example: 俺哥哥原来是～，不是好人了也。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第七十三回
exampleTraditional: 俺哥哥原來是～，不是好人了也。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第七十三回
exampleEn: My elder brother turns out to be a hypocrite, not a good person! — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 73

explanation: 除去杂质，留取精华。
explanationTraditional: 除去雜質，留取精華。
explanationEn: To discard the dross and select the essential.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 对于古典文学，我们要去粗取精，辩证对待。
exampleTraditional: 對於古典文學，我們要去粗取精，辯證對待。
exampleEn: For classical literature, we should discard the dross and select the essential, treating it dialectically.

explanation: 指不偏不倚，折中调和的处世态度。
explanationTraditional: 指不偏不倚，折中調和的處世態度。
explanationEn: The doctrine of the mean; a moderate and conciliatory attitude.
derivation: 《论语·庸也》中庸之为德也，其至矣乎。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·庸也》中庸之為德也，其至矣乎。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects': 'The virtue of the mean is the highest of all.'
example: 他一面想，这既无闭关自守之操切，也没有开放门户之不安是很合于～”的。★鲁迅《彷徨·幸福的家庭》
exampleTraditional: 他一面想，這既無閉關自守之操切，也沒有開放門戶之不安是很合於～”的。★魯迅《彷徨·幸福的家庭》
exampleEn: He thought, 'This is neither as radical as closing the country nor as uneasy as opening the door, very much in line with the 'doctrine of the mean'.' — Lu Xun, 'Wandering: A Happy Family'

explanation: 苍青色。翠青绿色。指四季常青的松柏。比喻具有高贵品质、坚定节操的人。
explanationTraditional: 蒼青色。翠青綠色。指四季常青的松柏。比喻具有高貴品質、堅定節操的人。
explanationEn: Evergreen pines and cypresses; metaphor for people of noble character and firm integrity.
derivation: 清·萧执中《勉县定军山武侯墓楹联》古石幽香名士骨；苍松翠柏老臣心。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蕭執中《勉縣定軍山武侯墓楹聯》古石幽香名士骨；蒼松翠柏老臣心。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Xiao Zhizhong's couplet at Wuhou Temple in Mian County: 'Ancient stones fragrant with the bones of famous scholars; green pines and cypresses embody the heart of an old minister.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 至最；名有名声的。最正确的道理，最精辟的言论。
explanationTraditional: 至最；名有名聲的。最正確的道理，最精闢的言論。
explanationEn: The most correct truth; the most insightful saying.
derivation: 老舍《鼓书艺人》十二‘你不自轻自贱，人家就不能看轻你’。这话倒说得不错，这也是至理名言。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《鼓書藝人》十二‘你不自輕自賤，人家就不能看輕你’。這話倒說得不錯，這也是至理名言。”
derivationEn: Lao She's 'Drum Singers', Chapter 12: 'If you don't belittle yourself, others won't look down on you.' That's well said, and it's a most insightful saying.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 依、顺顺从。什么都依从。形容一切都顺从别人。
explanationTraditional: 依、順順從。什麼都依從。形容一切都順從別人。
explanationEn: Obeying in everything; completely compliant.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》第十三卷做爷娘的百依百顺，没一事违拗了他。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》第十三卷做爺孃的百依百順，沒一事違拗了他。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 13: 'Parents obeyed in everything, never going against him.'
example: 这安公子是那女孩儿一般～的人。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三回
exampleTraditional: 這安公子是那女孩兒一般～的人。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三回
exampleEn: This young master An was like a girl, completely compliant. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 3

explanation: 草草形容草率、马虎；了办完，结束。草率地把事情结束了。
explanationTraditional: 草草形容草率、馬虎；了辦完，結束。草率地把事情結束了。
explanationEn: To finish something hastily and carelessly.
derivation: 明·朱国桢《涌幢小品·实录》陈文端请修正史，分各志二十八，务于详备，一志多至四五十万余言。未几，文端薨，各志草草了事。”
derivationTraditional: 明·朱國楨《湧幢小品·實錄》陳文端請修正史，分各志二十八，務於詳備，一志多至四五十萬餘言。未幾，文端薨，各志草草了事。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Zhu Guozhen's 'Yongchuang Xiaopin': Chen Wenduan requested to revise the history, dividing it into 28 sections, each detailed, some up to 400,000-500,000 words. Soon after, Chen died, and the sections were finished hastily.
example: 虽说僧经道忏，吊祭供饭，络绎不绝，终是钱银吝啬，谁肯踊跃，不过～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百一十回
exampleTraditional: 雖說僧經道懺，弔祭供飯，絡繹不絕，終是錢銀吝嗇，誰肯踴躍，不過～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百一十回
exampleEn: Although monks chanted sutras and held memorial services continuously, in the end they were stingy with money, and who would be willing to be enthusiastic? They just finished hastily. — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 110

explanation: 过超过；望希望。结果比原来希望的还好，因而感到特别高兴。
explanationTraditional: 過超過；望希望。結果比原來希望的還好，因而感到特別高興。
explanationEn: To be overjoyed because the result exceeds one's expectations.
derivation: 《史记·黥布传》出就舍，张御食饮从官如汉王居，布又大喜过望。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·黥布傳》出就舍，張御食飲從官如漢王居，布又大喜過望。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Qing Bu': When he went to his residence, the imperial attendants served food and drink as if he were the King of Han, and Qing Bu was overjoyed beyond his expectations.
example: 灿若灯下一看，正是前日相逢之人，不觉～，方才放下了心。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷十六
exampleTraditional: 燦若燈下一看，正是前日相逢之人，不覺～，方才放下了心。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷十六
exampleEn: Canruo looked under the lamp and saw it was the person he had met before; he was overjoyed beyond his expectations and finally felt relieved. — Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Striking the Table in Surprise at the Wondrous Tales', Volume 16

explanation: 分毫形容很少的数量，十丝为一毫，十毫为一厘，十厘为一分。差差错。没有一点儿差错。
explanationTraditional: 分毫形容很少的數量，十絲為一毫，十毫為一釐，十釐為一分。差差錯。沒有一點兒差錯。
explanationEn: Without the slightest error; exactly accurate.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十四大尹将所报伤处，将卷对看，分毫不差。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十四大尹將所報傷處，將卷對看，分毫不差。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World': The magistrate compared the reported injuries with the records and found not a single discrepancy.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻不懂事物已发展变化而仍静止地看问题。
explanationTraditional: 比喻不懂事物已發展變化而仍靜止地看問題。
explanationEn: To take measures without regard to changes in circumstances; to be rigidly inflexible.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·察今》》楚人有涉江者，其剑自舟中坠于水，遽契其舟曰‘是吾剑之所从坠。’舟止，从其所契者入水求之。舟已行矣，而剑不行，求剑若此，不亦惑乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·察今》》楚人有涉江者，其劍自舟中墜於水，遽契其舟曰‘是吾劍之所從墜。’舟止，從其所契者入水求之。舟已行矣，而劍不行，求劍若此，不亦惑乎？”
derivationEn: From 'Lüshi Chunqiu: Examining the Present': A man from Chu dropped his sword into the river from a boat and immediately notched the boat, saying, 'This is where my sword fell.' When the boat stopped, he entered the water at the notch to search for the sword. The boat had moved, but the sword had not. Isn't this a foolish way to find a sword?
example: 似你这样寻根究底，便是～，胶柱鼓瑟了！★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百二十回
exampleTraditional: 似你這樣尋根究底，便是～，膠柱鼓瑟了！★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百二十回
exampleEn: To investigate so thoroughly like you is like carving a mark on the boat to find a sword, or gluing the strings of a se! — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 120

explanation: 物华万物的精华；天宝天然的宝物。指各种珍美的宝物。
explanationTraditional: 物華萬物的精華；天寶天然的寶物。指各種珍美的寶物。
explanationEn: The essence of things and treasures of nature; refers to various precious and beautiful things.
derivation: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王阁饯别序》物华天宝，龙光射牛斗之墟。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王閣餞別序》物華天寶，龍光射牛鬥之墟。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Bo's 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng': The essence of things and treasures of nature, the dragon's light shines on the Bull and Di constellations.
example: ～动和风，一派箫韶仙苑同。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第四十回
exampleTraditional: ～動和風，一派簫韶仙苑同。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第四十回
exampleEn: The essence of things and treasures of nature stirs the harmonious wind, and a school of Xiao and Shao music is the same as in the fairy garden. — Qing Dynasty Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 40

explanation: 无拘无束，安闲自得。
explanationTraditional: 無拘無束，安閒自得。
explanationEn: Free and unfettered; leisurely and carefree.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷二十九丈夫运用堂堂，逍遥自在无妨。” 宋·释普济《五灯会元》二十四腊，逍遥自在，逢人则喜，见佛不拜。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷二十九丈夫運用堂堂，逍遙自在無妨。” 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》二十四臘，逍遙自在，逢人則喜，見佛不拜。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Daoyuan's 'Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp': A husband's conduct is dignified, free and unfettered without hindrance. Also from Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': Twenty-four years, free and unfettered, happy when meeting people, not bowing to Buddha.
example: 倒不如院长，放下名心，～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 倒不如院長，放下名心，～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十四回
exampleEn: It would be better for the dean to let go of his fame-seeking mind and be free and unfettered. — Qing Dynasty Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 14

explanation: 没有经过认真准备和严密组织，一下子行动起来。
explanationTraditional: 沒有經過認真準備和嚴密組織，一下子行動起來。
explanationEn: To start an action without careful preparation or organization; to rush into something.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》地方上百姓动了公愤，一哄而起。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》地方上百姓動了公憤，一哄而起。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats': The local people were stirred up by public anger and rushed into action.
example: 然而也有并不～的人，当时好像落后，但因为也不一哄而散，后来成为中坚。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文末编》
exampleTraditional: 然而也有並不～的人，當時好像落後，但因為也不一鬨而散，後來成為中堅。★魯迅《且介亭雜文末編》
exampleEn: However, there were also those who did not rush into action; they seemed backward at the time, but because they did not scatter in a flurry, they later became the backbone. — Lu Xun's 'Essays from the Semi-Concession'

explanation: 自己做了蠢事坏事，自己倒霉。
explanationTraditional: 自己做了蠢事壞事，自己倒黴。
explanationEn: To suffer the consequences of one's own actions; to reap what one sows.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》僧问金山颖‘一百二十斤铁枷，教阿谁担？’颖曰‘自作自受。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》僧問金山穎‘一百二十斤鐵枷，教阿誰擔？’穎曰‘自作自受。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': A monk asked Jinshan Ying, 'Who will carry the 120-jin iron cangue?' Ying replied, 'One who makes his own bed must lie on it.'
example: 他这会子不说保养着些，还要捉弄人；明儿病了，叫他～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十一回
exampleTraditional: 他這會子不說保養著些，還要捉弄人；明兒病了，叫他～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十一回
exampleEn: He doesn't take care of himself now, but still wants to tease others; when he gets sick tomorrow, let him suffer the consequences of his own actions. — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 51

explanation: 做了许多坏事。指罪恶累累。
explanationTraditional: 做了許多壞事。指罪惡累累。
explanationEn: To have committed many evil deeds; to be guilty of numerous crimes.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第四十二回想当初作恶多端，这三四日斋戒，那里就积得过来。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第四十二回想當初作惡多端，這三四日齋戒，那裡就積得過來。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 42: Thinking back to when I committed many evil deeds, how could three or four days of fasting make up for it?
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指有才貌的男女。
explanationTraditional: 泛指有才貌的男女。
explanationEn: A gifted scholar and a beautiful woman; a perfect couple.
derivation: 唐·李隐《潇湘录·呼延冀》妾既与君匹偶，诸邻皆谓之才子佳人。”宋·晁补之《鹧鸪天》词夕阳芳草本无恨，才子佳人自多愁。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李隱《瀟湘錄·呼延冀》妾既與君匹偶，諸鄰皆謂之才子佳人。”宋·晁補之《鷓鴣天》詞夕陽芳草本無恨，才子佳人自多愁。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li Yin's 'Xiaoxiang Lu: Huyan Ji': Since I am married to you, all neighbors call us a gifted scholar and a beautiful woman. Also from Song Dynasty Chao Buzhi's poem 'Partridge Sky': The setting sun and fragrant grass have no inherent sorrow; gifted scholars and beautiful women naturally have much melancholy.
example: 此番招赘进蘧公孙来，门户又相称，才貌又相当，真个是～，一双两好”。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 此番招贅進蘧公孫來，門戶又相稱，才貌又相當，真個是～，一雙兩好”。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十一回
exampleEn: This time, recruiting Lu Gongsun as a son-in-law, the family status matches, and both talent and appearance are suitable; truly a gifted scholar and a beautiful woman, a perfect match. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 11

explanation: 非非原为佛家语，表示虚幻的境界。想到非常玄妙虚幻的地方去了。形容完全脱离现实地胡思乱想。
explanationTraditional: 非非原為佛家語，表示虛幻的境界。想到非常玄妙虛幻的地方去了。形容完全脫離現實地胡思亂想。
explanationEn: To indulge in wild and fanciful thoughts; to be lost in unrealistic fantasies.
derivation: 《楞严经》如存不存，若尽不尽，如是一类，名非想非非想处。”
derivationTraditional: 《楞嚴經》如存不存，若盡不盡，如是一類，名非想非非想處。”
derivationEn: From the Surangama Sutra: 'Like existence yet not existence, like cessation yet not cessation, such a state is called the place of neither thought nor non-thought.'
example: 当下～，一头说一头要弄计赚骗缪寄萍的书。★清·黄小配《大马扁》第二回
exampleTraditional: 當下～，一頭說一頭要弄計賺騙繆寄萍的書。★清·黃小配《大馬扁》第二回
exampleEn: At that moment, he was lost in wild fantasies, and while talking, he tried to scheme and trick Miao Jiping's books. — Qing Dynasty, Huang Xiaopei, 'The Great Horse Whip' Chapter 2

explanation: 又有智谋，又很勇敢。
explanationTraditional: 又有智謀，又很勇敢。
explanationEn: Both wise and brave; possessing both intelligence and courage.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《五侯宴》第三折某文通三略，武解六韬，智勇双全 。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《五侯宴》第三折某文通三略，武解六韜，智勇雙全 。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing's 'The Five Marquises' Banquet' third act: 'I am versed in civil strategies and military tactics, both wise and brave.'
example: 要讲究策略，有勇有谋，～。
exampleTraditional: 要講究策略，有勇有謀，～。
exampleEn: We must pay attention to strategy, be both resourceful and courageous, and be wise and brave.

explanation: 卓尔特出的样子；不群与众不同。指才德超出寻常，与众不同。
explanationTraditional: 卓爾特出的樣子；不群與眾不同。指才德超出尋常，與眾不同。
explanationEn: Outstanding and beyond comparison; exceptionally talented and different from the ordinary.
derivation: 《汉书·河间献王传赞》夫唯大雅，卓尔不群。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·河間獻王傳贊》夫唯大雅，卓爾不群。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of King Xian of Hejian': 'Only the truly refined are outstanding and beyond comparison.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容步子跨得大，走得快。
explanationTraditional: 形容步子跨得大，走得快。
explanationEn: To walk with long, quick strides; to stride briskly.
derivation: 周立波《暴风骤雨》第二部二四听到叫他名，他大步流星地迈过去，把它牵上。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《暴風驟雨》第二部二四聽到叫他名，他大步流星地邁過去，把它牽上。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Libo's 'The Storm' Part 2, Chapter 24: 'Hearing his name called, he strode over quickly and led it away.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 藕已折断，但还有许多丝连接着未断开。比喻没有彻底断绝关系。多指男女之间情思难断。
explanationTraditional: 藕已折斷，但還有許多絲連接著未斷開。比喻沒有徹底斷絕關係。多指男女之間情思難斷。
explanationEn: The lotus root is broken but the fibers remain connected; metaphor for a relationship that is not completely severed, especially lingering affection between lovers.
derivation: 唐·孟郊《去妇》诗妾心藕中丝，虽断犹相连。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·孟郊《去婦》詩妾心藕中絲，雖斷猶相連。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Meng Jiao's poem 'The Departed Wife': 'My heart is like the fibers in the lotus root, though broken, still connected.'
example: 算了吧，你也不必看得过于眼紧，反正他们是～的。★欧阳山《三家巷》二二
exampleTraditional: 算了吧，你也不必看得過於眼緊，反正他們是～的。★歐陽山《三家巷》二二
exampleEn: Forget it, you don't need to be too strict; anyway, they are still lingering on. — Ouyang Shan, 'Three Family Lane' Chapter 22

explanation: 形容举目文雅。
explanationTraditional: 形容舉目文雅。
explanationEn: Elegant and refined in manner; genteel.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第七回人家的孩子都是斯斯文文的惯了，乍见了你这破落户，还被人笑话死了呢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第七回人家的孩子都是斯斯文文的慣了，乍見了你這破落戶，還被人笑話死了呢。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 7: 'Other people's children are used to being refined and genteel; seeing you, a slob, they would be laughed to death.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不以为意，神情如常。形容在紧急情况下沉着镇定，不慌不乱。
explanationTraditional: 不以為意，神情如常。形容在緊急情況下沉著鎮定，不慌不亂。
explanationEn: Calm and composed; to remain unperturbed in an emergency.
derivation: 华而实《汉衣冠》三施天福坦率地注视郑成功，泰然自若地摇头。”
derivationTraditional: 華而實《漢衣冠》三施天福坦率地注視鄭成功，泰然自若地搖頭。”
derivationEn: From Hua Ershi's 'Han Crown' 3: 'Shi Tianfu looked at Zheng Chenggong frankly, shaking his head calmly and composedly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 过过失；则就。听到别人批评自己的缺点或错误，表示欢迎和高兴。指虚心接受意见。
explanationTraditional: 過過失；則就。聽到別人批評自己的缺點或錯誤，表示歡迎和高興。指虛心接受意見。
explanationEn: To feel happy when told of one's errors; to be glad to hear criticism.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》子路人告之以有过则喜。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》子路人告之以有過則喜。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gongsun Chou I': 'When Zilu was told of his faults, he was delighted.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 掉摇动。尾巴太大，掉转不灵。旧时比喻部下的势力很大，无法指挥调度。现比喻机构庞大，指挥不灵。
explanationTraditional: 掉搖動。尾巴太大，掉轉不靈。舊時比喻部下的勢力很大，無法指揮調度。現比喻機構龐大，指揮不靈。
explanationEn: The tail is too big to wag; metaphor for a subordinate being too powerful to control, or an organization being too large to manage effectively.
derivation: 《左传·昭公十一年》末大必折，尾大不掉，君所知也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公十一年》末大必折，尾大不掉，君所知也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The 11th Year of Duke Zhao': 'If the end is too large, it will break; if the tail is too big, it cannot wag. This you know.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 宠宠爱。受宠受辱都不在乎。指不因个人得失而动心。
explanationTraditional: 寵寵愛。受寵受辱都不在乎。指不因個人得失而動心。
explanationEn: To be indifferent to favor or disgrace; to remain unmoved by personal gains or losses.
derivation: 晋·潘岳《在怀县》诗宠辱易不惊，恋本难为思。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·潘岳《在懷縣》詩寵辱易不驚，戀本難為思。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Pan Yue's poem 'In Huai County': 'Favor and disgrace are not easily disturbing, but longing for home is hard to forget.'
example: 不过他经的大风大浪太多，虽未到～，名利皆忘的境地，却已能不动声色，淡然置之。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: 不過他經的大風大浪太多，雖未到～，名利皆忘的境地，卻已能不動聲色，淡然置之。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: However, he had experienced too many storms; though not yet completely indifferent to favor or disgrace and forgetting fame and gain, he could remain calm and take things lightly. — Gao Yang, 'Inside the Qing Palace' Volume 2

explanation: 形容壮健憨厚的样子（多指儿童）。
explanationTraditional: 形容壯健憨厚的樣子（多指兒童）。
explanationEn: Describes a sturdy and honest appearance, often used for children.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这个小男孩长得虎头虎脑，非常可爱。
exampleTraditional: 這個小男孩長得虎頭虎腦，非常可愛。
exampleEn: This little boy looks sturdy and honest, very cute.

explanation: 泰然安然，不以为意的样子；处处理，对待。形容毫不在意，沉着镇定。
explanationTraditional: 泰然安然，不以為意的樣子；處處理，對待。形容毫不在意，沉著鎮定。
explanationEn: To handle a situation calmly and composedly, without being affected.
derivation: 晋·袁宏《三国名臣序赞》爰初发迹，遘此颠沛，神情玄定，处之弥泰。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·袁宏《三國名臣序贊》爰初發跡，遘此顛沛，神情玄定，處之彌泰。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Yuan Hong's 'Preface to the Famous Ministers of the Three Kingdoms': 'From the beginning, encountering hardships, with a calm spirit, he handled it with great composure.'
example: 老东山已松开孙若西，他平了平气，眼睛半闭，～，稳立不动。★冯德英《迎春花》第二十二章
exampleTraditional: 老東山已鬆開孫若西，他平了平氣，眼睛半閉，～，穩立不動。★馮德英《迎春花》第二十二章
exampleEn: Old Dongshan had already released Sun Ruoxi, he calmed his breath, half-closed his eyes, and stood firmly without moving. (Feng Deying, 'Spring Blossoms', Chapter 22)

explanation: 自己保不住自己。
explanationTraditional: 自己保不住自己。
explanationEn: Unable to protect oneself.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》我想江西不沉却好，若沉了时节，正是‘泥菩萨落水，自身难保’，还保得别人？”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》我想江西不沉卻好，若沉了時節，正是‘泥菩薩落水，自身難保’，還保得別人？”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World': 'I thought, if Jiangxi does not sink, it's fine; but if it does, it's like a clay Buddha crossing a river—unable to protect itself, let alone others.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指识大体，顾大局。
explanationTraditional: 指識大體，顧大局。
explanationEn: To understand the general principles and put the overall situation first.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十五回只是要娶到家来作个媳妇，世上这般双瞳如豆、一叶迷山的，以至糊涂下人，又有几个深明大义的呢！”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十五回只是要娶到家來作個媳婦，世上這般雙瞳如豆、一葉迷山的，以至糊塗下人，又有幾個深明大義的呢！”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Couple', Chapter 25: 'But to marry her as a daughter-in-law, in this world where many are short-sighted and confused, how many truly understand the greater good?'
example: 那严仲子为人～，我想二弟此去一定可以做些不会辱没母亲的事情。★郭沫若《棠棣之花》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 那嚴仲子為人～，我想二弟此去一定可以做些不會辱沒母親的事情。★郭沫若《棠棣之花》第一幕
exampleEn: That Yan Zhongzi is a man of great integrity; I believe my second brother will do nothing to disgrace our mother. (Guo Moruo, 'The Peach and Plum Blossoms', Act 1)

explanation: 得病后就再也起不了床。比喻得病后病情一天天恶化，终至死亡。
explanationTraditional: 得病後就再也起不了床。比喻得病後病情一天天惡化，終至死亡。
explanationEn: To fall ill and never recover, eventually leading to death.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《夷坚乙志·光禄寺》蒋安礼为光禄丞，斋宿寺舍，因喷嚏，鼻涕堕桌上，皆成小木人，雕刻之工极精，揽取之则已失矣，顷之复尔。凡堕木人千百，蒋一病不起。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《夷堅乙志·光祿寺》蔣安禮為光祿丞，齋宿寺舍，因噴嚏，鼻涕墮桌上，皆成小木人，雕刻之工極精，攬取之則已失矣，頃之復爾。凡墮木人千百，蔣一病不起。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Hong Mai's 'Yi Jian Zhi Yi: Guanglu Temple': 'Jiang Anli was the assistant minister of Guanglu Temple, staying overnight in the temple. He sneezed, and mucus fell on the table, turning into small wooden figures of exquisite carving. When he picked them up, they disappeared. This happened repeatedly, with thousands of wooden figures falling. Jiang fell ill and never recovered.'
example: 大崽又得个伤寒，～。（周立波《山乡巨变》）
exampleTraditional: 大崽又得個傷寒，～。（周立波《山鄉鉅變》）
exampleEn: The eldest child caught typhoid and never recovered. (Zhou Libo, 'Great Changes in a Mountain Village')

explanation: 故旧；故步旧时行步之法，引伸为旧法；封限制在一定的范围内。比喻守着老一套，不求进步。
explanationTraditional: 故舊；故步舊時行步之法，引伸為舊法；封限制在一定的範圍內。比喻守著老一套，不求進步。
explanationEn: To be complacent and conservative, sticking to old ways without seeking improvement.
derivation: 《汉书·叙传上》昔有学步于邯郸者，曾未得其仿佛，又复失其故步，遂匍匐而归耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·敘傳上》昔有學步於邯鄲者，曾未得其彷彿，又復失其故步，遂匍匐而歸耳。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biographies of the Xun Family': 'Once, a man went to Handan to learn how to walk. Not only did he fail to learn the new way, but he also forgot his original way, so he had to crawl back.'
example: 你心胸开阔，气度那么从容！你不随波逐流，也不～。（郭沫若《屈原》第一幕）
exampleTraditional: 你心胸開闊，氣度那麼從容！你不隨波逐流，也不～。（郭沫若《屈原》第一幕）
exampleEn: You are broad-minded and calm! You neither follow the crowd nor stick to old ways. (Guo Moruo, 'Qu Yuan', Act 1)

explanation: 能善于。形容能说会道，有辩才。
explanationTraditional: 能善於。形容能說會道，有辯才。
explanationEn: Eloquent and skilled in argumentation.
derivation: 元·无名氏《气英布》第一折恰才灵壁之战，项王遣使征布会，布与龙且有隙，称病不赴，若得能言巧辩之士，说他归降，纵项王驰还……破项王必矣。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《氣英布》第一折恰才靈壁之戰，項王遣使徵佈會，布與龍且有隙，稱病不赴，若得能言巧辯之士，說他歸降，縱項王馳還……破項王必矣。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Qi Ying Bu', Act 1: 'During the battle at Lingbi, King Xiang sent an envoy to summon Bu to meet. Bu had a grudge against Longqie and claimed illness. If we can send an eloquent speaker to persuade him to surrender, even if King Xiang returns... we will surely defeat him.'
example: 而且伶牙俐齿，～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 而且伶牙俐齒，～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十八回
exampleEn: Moreover, he is sharp-tongued and eloquent. (Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 18)

explanation: 佛教用语。原指皈依佛法的男女◇泛指信仰佛教的男男女女。
explanationTraditional: 佛教用語。原指皈依佛法的男女◇泛指信仰佛教的男男女女。
explanationEn: Buddhist term for devout men and women who follow the Buddha's teachings.
derivation: 《金刚经·善现启请分》善男子，善女子，发阿耨多罗三藐三菩提心。”
derivationTraditional: 《金剛經·善現啟請分》善男子，善女子，發阿耨多羅三藐三菩提心。”
derivationEn: 'Diamond Sutra: Chapter of Goodness': 'Good men and good women who have aroused the supreme, perfect enlightenment.'
example: 但～们不远千里朝拜金顶的仍然在老河口、石花街和草店的大道上络绎不绝。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十六章
exampleTraditional: 但～們不遠千里朝拜金頂的仍然在老河口、石花街和草店的大道上絡繹不絕。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十六章
exampleEn: But devout believers traveling thousands of miles to worship at the Golden Summit still streamed endlessly on the roads of Laohukou, Shihuajie, and Caodian. (Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 16)

explanation: 没有踪迹可以寻求。多指处事为文不着痕迹。
explanationTraditional: 沒有蹤跡可以尋求。多指處事為文不著痕跡。
explanationEn: No trace can be found; often used to describe subtlety in handling affairs or writing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 勇猛，善于战斗。
explanationTraditional: 勇猛，善於戰鬥。
explanationEn: Brave and skilled in battle.
derivation: 《南齐书·戴僧静传》其党辅国将军孙昙瓘骁勇善战，每荡一合，辄大杀伤，官军死者百于人。”
derivationTraditional: 《南齊書·戴僧靜傳》其黨輔國將軍孫曇瓘驍勇善戰，每蕩一合，輒大殺傷，官軍死者百於人。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Southern Qi: Biography of Dai Sengjing': 'His follower, General Sun Tanwan, was brave and skilled in battle. In every skirmish, he inflicted heavy casualties, with over a hundred government soldiers dead.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 道指教师指引的应该遵循的道理，也指教师传授的知识。尊敬师长，重视老师的教导。
explanationTraditional: 道指教師指引的應該遵循的道理，也指教師傳授的知識。尊敬師長，重視老師的教導。
explanationEn: Respect teachers and value their teachings.
derivation: 《后汉书·孔僖传》臣闻明王圣主，莫不尊师贵道。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·孔僖傳》臣聞明王聖主，莫不尊師貴道。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Kong Xi': 'I have heard that enlightened kings and sage rulers all respect teachers and value their teachings.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 常时常；备防备，准备；懈懈怠，放松。时刻准备着，毫不忪懈。
explanationTraditional: 常時常；備防備，準備；懈懈怠，放鬆。時刻準備著，毫不忪懈。
explanationEn: Be always prepared; maintain constant vigilance.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: ～的国防力量是国家安全的保证。
exampleTraditional: ～的國防力量是國家安全的保證。
exampleEn: A constantly prepared national defense force is the guarantee of national security.

explanation: 芥蒂本指细小的梗塞物，后比喻心里的不满或不快。指心里对人对事有怨恨或不愉快的情绪。
explanationTraditional: 芥蒂本指細小的梗塞物，後比喻心裡的不滿或不快。指心裡對人對事有怨恨或不愉快的情緒。
explanationEn: Have a grudge or ill feeling against someone.
derivation: 汉·司马相如《子虚赋》吞若云梦者八九于其胸中，曾不芥蒂。”
