derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬相如《子虛賦》吞若雲夢者八九於其胸中，曾不芥蒂。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Sima Xiangru's 'Zixu Fu': 'Swallowing something like Yunmeng Marsh in his chest, without any resentment.'
example: 若在平时，吴佩孚定要反对，此际却～，貌为客气。★蔡东藩、许厪父《民国通俗演义》第一百二十六回
exampleTraditional: 若在平時，吳佩孚定要反對，此際卻～，貌為客氣。★蔡東藩、許厪父《民國通俗演義》第一百二十六回
exampleEn: In normal times, Wu Peifu would have opposed it, but at this moment he harbored a grudge and pretended to be polite. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Jinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 126

explanation: 拂袖甩袖子，表示生气。形容生了气，一甩袖子就走了。
explanationTraditional: 拂袖甩袖子，表示生氣。形容生了氣，一甩袖子就走了。
explanationEn: Leave in anger; fling one's sleeves and go.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·方正》王子敬数岁时，尝看诸门生樗蒲，见有胜负，因曰‘南风不竞。’……子敬瞋目曰‘远惭荀奉倩，近愧刘真长。’遂拂袖而去。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·方正》王子敬數歲時，嘗看諸門生樗蒲，見有勝負，因曰‘南風不競。’……子敬瞋目曰‘遠慚荀奉倩，近愧劉真長。’遂拂袖而去。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Song Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Uprightness': 'Prince Zijing, when a child, once watched some disciples playing dice... He glared and said, 'I am ashamed of Xun Fengqian in the past and Liu Zhenchang in the present.' Then he flicked his sleeves and left.'
example: 我是愿意人对我反抗，不合则～。★鲁迅《两地书·一三五》
exampleTraditional: 我是願意人對我反抗，不合則～。★魯迅《兩地書·一三五》
exampleEn: I prefer people to resist me, and if not, I will leave in anger. — Lu Xun, 'Two Places, Letter 135'

explanation: 各人都坚持自己的意见。
explanationTraditional: 各人都堅持自己的意見。
explanationEn: Each sticks to his own opinion.
derivation: 宋·钱易《南部新书·乙》凡中书有军国政事，则中书舍人各执所见，杂署其名，谓之五花判事。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·錢易《南部新書·乙》凡中書有軍國政事，則中書舍人各執所見，雜署其名，謂之五花判事。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Qian Yi's 'New Stories from the South: Part B': 'Whenever there are military or state affairs in the Secretariat, the secretaries each hold their own views and sign their names, called 'five-flower judgment'.'
example: 两人终日谈论，～，不相上下。★明·北梦龙《古今小说·明悟禅师赶五戒》
exampleTraditional: 兩人終日談論，～，不相上下。★明·北夢龍《古今小說·明悟禪師趕五戒》
exampleEn: The two talked all day, each sticking to his own opinion, neither yielding. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New: The Enlightenment of Zen Master Mingwu and the Five Precepts'

explanation: 襟怀胸怀；坦白正直无私。形容心地纯洁，光明正大。
explanationTraditional: 襟懷胸懷；坦白正直無私。形容心地純潔，光明正大。
explanationEn: Open-hearted and aboveboard; honest and straightforward.
derivation: 宋·黄榦《黄勉斋文集·七·祭李贯之》贯之性质粹美，襟怀坦夷，凝静有常。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃榦《黃勉齋文集·七·祭李貫之》貫之性質粹美，襟懷坦夷，凝靜有常。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Huang Gan's 'Collected Works of Huang Mianzhai: Volume 7: Sacrifice to Li Guanzhi': 'Li Guanzhi's nature was pure and beautiful, his mind open and calm, with constant composure.'
example: 一个共产党员，应该是～，忠实，积极，以革命利益为第一生命，以个人利益服从革命利益。★毛泽东《反对自由主义》
exampleTraditional: 一個共產黨員，應該是～，忠實，積極，以革命利益為第一生命，以個人利益服從革命利益。★毛澤東《反對自由主義》
exampleEn: A Communist should be open-hearted, loyal, active, regard revolutionary interests as his first life, and subordinate personal interests to revolutionary interests. — Mao Zedong, 'Combat Liberalism'

explanation: 骥良马，千里马；枥马槽，养马的地方。比喻有志向的人虽然年老，仍有雄心壮志。
explanationTraditional: 驥良馬，千里馬；櫪馬槽，養馬的地方。比喻有志向的人雖然年老，仍有雄心壯志。
explanationEn: An old steed in the stable still aspires to gallop a thousand li; a person with high aspirations despite old age.
derivation: 三国·魏·曹操《步出夏门行》诗老骥伏枥，志在千里。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·曹操《步出夏門行》詩老驥伏櫪，志在千里。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Wei Cao Cao's poem 'Stepping Out of the Xia Gate': 'An old steed in the stable still aspires to gallop a thousand li.'
example: 用飞龙在天，对～。★宋·陆游《老学庵笔记》卷一
exampleTraditional: 用飛龍在天，對～。★宋·陸游《老學庵筆記》卷一
exampleEn: Using 'flying dragon in the sky' to match 'old steed in the stable'. — Song Dynasty Lu You, 'Notes from the Old School Hut', Volume 1

explanation: 指故意示警，使人震动。同敲山振虎”。
explanationTraditional: 指故意示警，使人震動。同敲山振虎”。
explanationEn: Make a move to warn someone; a deliberate show of force to intimidate.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 出超出；右上，古代以右为尊。没有能超过他的。
explanationTraditional: 出超出；右上，古代以右為尊。沒有能超過他的。
explanationEn: Second to none; nobody surpasses him.
derivation: 《史记·田叔列传》上尽召见，与语，汉廷臣毋能出其右者。”《汉书·高帝纪下》贤赵臣田叔、孟舒等十人，如见与语，汉庭臣无能出其右者。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·田叔列傳》上盡召見，與語，漢廷臣毋能出其右者。”《漢書·高帝紀下》賢趙臣田叔、孟舒等十人，如見與語，漢庭臣無能出其右者。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Tian Shu': 'The emperor summoned them all and talked with them; none of the Han court officials could surpass them.' Also 'Book of Han: Annals of Emperor Gaozu, Part 2': 'He praised Zhao officials Tian Shu, Meng Shu, and others; when he met and talked with them, none of the Han court officials could surpass them.'
example: 此二方专治一切肿毒，初起者速服速消，已溃者亦能败毒收口，大约古人痈疽各方，～了。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十回
exampleTraditional: 此二方專治一切腫毒，初起者速服速消，已潰者亦能敗毒收口，大約古人癰疽各方，～了。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十回
exampleEn: These two prescriptions specialize in treating all kinds of swellings and toxins; if taken early, they quickly reduce swelling, and even if ulcerated, they can expel pus and heal. Generally speaking, among ancient prescriptions for carbuncles, none surpass these. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 30

explanation: 玲珑精巧细致，指人灵活、敏捷。本指窗户明亮轩敞◇用来形容人处世圆滑，待人接物面面俱到。
explanationTraditional: 玲瓏精巧細緻，指人靈活、敏捷。本指窗戶明亮軒敞◇用來形容人處世圓滑，待人接物面面俱到。
explanationEn: Be smooth and slick in dealing with people; be all things to all people.
derivation: 唐·卢纶《赋得彭祖楼送杨宗德归徐州幕》诗四户八窗明，玲珑逼上清。”宋·夏元鼎《满庭芳》词虽是无为清静，依然要八面玲珑。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·盧綸《賦得彭祖樓送楊宗德歸徐州幕》詩四戶八窗明，玲瓏逼上清。”宋·夏元鼎《滿庭芳》詞雖是無為清靜，依然要八面玲瓏。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Lu Lun's poem 'Written on Pengzu Tower for Yang Zongde Returning to Xuzhou': 'Four doors and eight windows bright, exquisite and clear to the sky.' Song Dynasty Xia Yuanding's 'Man Ting Fang' lyrics: 'Although it is inaction and purity, still one must be eight-sided exquisite.'
example: 原来宝廷的为人，是～，却十分落拓。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第七回
exampleTraditional: 原來寶廷的為人，是～，卻十分落拓。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第七回
exampleEn: It turned out that Baoting's character was eight-sided exquisite, yet very down-and-out. — Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu, 'Flower of the Sea of Sins', Chapter 7

explanation: 比翼翅膀挨着翅膀。双飞成双的并飞。比喻夫妻情投意合，在事业上并肩前进。
explanationTraditional: 比翼翅膀挨著翅膀。雙飛成雙的並飛。比喻夫妻情投意合，在事業上並肩前進。
explanationEn: Fly wing to wing. A metaphor for a loving couple who are well-matched and advance together in their careers.
derivation: 《尔雅·释地》南方有比翼鸟焉，不比不飞，其名谓之鹣鹣。”
derivationTraditional: 《爾雅·釋地》南方有比翼鳥焉，不比不飛，其名謂之鶼鶼。”
derivationEn: From 'Erya: Explanation of Lands': 'In the south, there are birds that fly wing to wing; they do not fly singly, and are called jianjian.'
example: 不是妾身多薄幸，只因司马太风骚，效神凤，下丹霄，～上泬寥。★明·朱权《卓文君》
exampleTraditional: 不是妾身多薄倖，只因司馬太風騷，效神鳳，下丹霄，～上泬寥。★明·朱權《卓文君》
exampleEn: It is not that I am unlucky, but because Sima is too romantic, imitating the divine phoenix descending from the sky, flying wing to wing in the vast sky. — Ming Dynasty, Zhu Quan, 'Zhuo Wenjun'

explanation: 垂将近。临死前的挣扎，妄想延长生命。比喻行将灭亡之时的孤注一掷。
explanationTraditional: 垂將近。臨死前的掙扎，妄想延長生命。比喻行將滅亡之時的孤注一擲。
explanationEn: Struggle desperately before death. A metaphor for a last-ditch effort when facing extinction.
derivation: 冯德英《迎春花》第十七章不料，炸成重伤的蒋子金，垂死挣扎地用手里的小剜刀去刺好的腿。”
derivationTraditional: 馮德英《迎春花》第十七章不料，炸成重傷的蔣子金，垂死掙扎地用手裡的小剜刀去刺好的腿。”
derivationEn: From Feng Deying's 'Spring Blossoms', Chapter 17: 'Unexpectedly, Jiang Zijin, severely wounded, struggled desperately, using his small knife to stab at the good leg.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 童未成年的孩子；叟年老的男人；欺蒙骗。既不欺骗小孩也不欺骗老人。指买卖公平。
explanationTraditional: 童未成年的孩子；叟年老的男人；欺矇騙。既不欺騙小孩也不欺騙老人。指買賣公平。
explanationEn: Cheat neither children nor old people. Refers to fair dealing in business.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第五回但不知可有‘货真价实，童叟无欺’的字样没有？”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第五回但不知可有‘貨真價實，童叟無欺’的字樣沒有？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 5: 'But I wonder if there is the phrase 'genuine goods at fair prices, cheat neither children nor old people'?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 战战恐惧的样子；兢兢小心谨慎的样子。形容非肠怕而微微发抖的样子。也形容小心谨慎的样子。
explanationTraditional: 戰戰恐懼的樣子；兢兢小心謹慎的樣子。形容非腸怕而微微發抖的樣子。也形容小心謹慎的樣子。
explanationEn: Trembling with fear or acting with extreme caution.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·小昮》战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·小昮》戰戰兢兢，如臨深淵，如履薄冰。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Xiaomin': 'Trembling and cautious, as if approaching a deep abyss, as if treading on thin ice.'
example: 那小孩～地走着，唯恐摔倒。
exampleTraditional: 那小孩～地走著，唯恐摔倒。
exampleEn: The child walked tremblingly, afraid of falling.

explanation: 丢脸，出丑。
explanationTraditional: 丟臉，出醜。
explanationEn: Lose face; make a fool of oneself.
derivation: 杨朔《春子姑娘》你看我弄的婆家婆家不要，娘家娘家讨厌，丢人现眼的，哪有脸见她！”
derivationTraditional: 楊朔《春子姑娘》你看我弄的婆家婆家不要，孃家孃家討厭，丟人現眼的，哪有臉見她！”
derivationEn: From Yang Shuo's 'Spring Girl': 'Look at me, my husband's family doesn't want me, my own family dislikes me, I've lost face and have no shame to see anyone!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 永远不会消灭。
explanationTraditional: 永遠不會消滅。
explanationEn: Never fade away; eternal.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他为中国革命建立了永不磨灭的功勋。
exampleTraditional: 他為中國革命建立了永不磨滅的功勳。
exampleEn: He made indelible contributions to the Chinese revolution.

explanation: 弗不。自己惭愧不如别人。
explanationTraditional: 弗不。自己慚愧不如別人。
explanationEn: Feel ashamed that one is not as good as others.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策一》明日徐公来，熟视之，自以为不如。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策一》明日徐公來，熟視之，自以為不如。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy I': 'The next day, when Xu Gong came, he looked at himself carefully and thought he was not as good.'
example: 在那地方，圣裔们繁殖得非常多，成着使释迦牟怪和苏格拉底都～的特权阶级。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文二集·在现代中国的孔夫子》
exampleTraditional: 在那地方，聖裔們繁殖得非常多，成著使釋迦牟怪和蘇格拉底都～的特權階級。★魯迅《且介亭雜文二集·在現代中國的孔夫子》
exampleEn: In that place, the descendants of the sage multiplied so much that they became a privileged class that would make even Sakyamuni and Socrates feel inferior. — Lu Xun, 'Essays from Qiejieting, Part II: Confucius in Modern China'

explanation: 相互勾结，一个鼻孔出气。
explanationTraditional: 相互勾結，一個鼻孔出氣。
explanationEn: Collude; act in collusion with each other.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十六回怪道！你们串通一气来算计我。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十六回怪道！你們串通一氣來算計我。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 46: 'No wonder! You are all in collusion to plot against me.'
example: 他们和赌馆的人虽然～，惟恐怕他们冒冒失失的放枪拒敌……★清·张春帆《宦海》第二回
exampleTraditional: 他們和賭館的人雖然～，惟恐怕他們冒冒失失的放槍拒敵……★清·張春帆《宦海》第二回
exampleEn: Although they were in collusion with the gambling den people, they were afraid that if they recklessly fired guns to resist... — Qing Dynasty, Zhang Chunfan's 'The Sea of Officialdom', Chapter 2

explanation: 居心存心；良善。存心不善。指内心存在着恶意或阴谋。
explanationTraditional: 居心存心；良善。存心不善。指內心存在著惡意或陰謀。
explanationEn: Have ulterior motives; harbor evil intentions.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》卿居心不净，乃复强欲滓秽太清耶。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》卿居心不淨，乃復強欲滓穢太清耶。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty, Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Speech': 'Your heart is impure, and yet you insist on defiling the pure void.'
example: 讵料它们～，渐渐变坏。★丰子恺《口中剿匪”记》
exampleTraditional: 詎料它們～，漸漸變壞。★豐子愷《口中剿匪”記》
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, they harbored evil intentions and gradually turned bad. — Feng Zikai, 'On 'Eliminating Bandits in the Mouth''

explanation: 周密的筹划，深远的打算。形容人办事精明老练。
explanationTraditional: 周密的籌劃，深遠的打算。形容人辦事精明老練。
explanationEn: Cunning and experienced; shrewd and far-sighted.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十九回沉毅哉！老谋深算，革命军之军事家。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十九回沉毅哉！老謀深算，革命軍之軍事家。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sin', Chapter 29: 'How resolute! Cunning and experienced, a military strategist of the revolutionary army.'
example: 现在他颇有点后悔刚才的失恋”，他的～走了这么一个方面。★茅盾《子夜》第四章
exampleTraditional: 現在他頗有點後悔剛才的失戀”，他的～走了這麼一個方面。★茅盾《子夜》第四章
exampleEn: Now he somewhat regretted his recent 'loss of love'; his cunning and experienced mind had taken such a direction. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 4

explanation: 绘画，画树木粗枝大叶，不用工笔。比喻工作粗糙，不认真细致。
explanationTraditional: 繪畫，畫樹木粗枝大葉，不用工筆。比喻工作粗糙，不認真細緻。
explanationEn: Describes work that is rough, careless, and lacking in detail.
derivation: 《朱子语类》卷七八《书序》恐不是孔安国做，汉文粗枝大叶，今《书序》细腻，只似六朝时文字。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子語類》卷七八《書序》恐不是孔安國做，漢文粗枝大葉，今《書序》細膩，只似六朝時文字。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Zi Yu Lei' volume 78: 'The Book of Documents preface is probably not by Kong Anguo; Han texts are rough and careless, but the current preface is delicate, like texts from the Six Dynasties.'
example: 这么细细给你说，三天三夜也说不完，还是～告诉你吧！★赵树理《地板》
exampleTraditional: 這麼細細給你說，三天三夜也說不完，還是～告訴你吧！★趙樹理《地板》
exampleEn: If I tell you in such detail, it would take three days and nights to finish. Let me just give you a rough idea. (Zhao Shuli, 'Floor')

explanation: 把散乱的事物合在一起。
explanationTraditional: 把散亂的事物合在一起。
explanationEn: To combine scattered things into one whole.
derivation: 《史记·春申君列传》臣为王虑，莫若善楚。秦楚合而为一以临韩，韩必敛手。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·春申君列傳》臣為王慮，莫若善楚。秦楚合而為一以臨韓，韓必斂手。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lord Chunshen': 'I advise you to befriend Chu. If Qin and Chu unite as one, Han will surely submit.'
example: 学者能集众长～，若易牙以五味调和，则为全味矣。（明·谢榛《四溟诗话》第三卷）
exampleTraditional: 學者能集眾長～，若易牙以五味調和，則為全味矣。（明·謝榛《四溟詩話》第三卷）
exampleEn: A scholar can gather the strengths of many and combine them into one, just as Yi Ya blends the five flavors to create a perfect taste. (Ming Dynasty, Xie Zhen, 'Four Seas Poetry Talks', Volume 3)

explanation: 指昏迷不醒，失去知觉。
explanationTraditional: 指昏迷不醒，失去知覺。
explanationEn: To be unconscious and unaware of one's surroundings.
derivation: 《醒世恒言·乔太守乱点鸳鸯谱》谁想刘璞因冒风之后，出汗虚了，变为寒症，人事不省，十分危笃。”
derivationTraditional: 《醒世恆言·喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜》誰想劉璞因冒風之後，出汗虛了，變為寒症，人事不省，十分危篤。”
derivationEn: From 'Stories to Awaken the World: Qiao Taishou Randomly Matches Couples': 'Who would have thought that Liu Pu, after catching a cold, became weak from sweating, turned into a cold syndrome, fell unconscious, and was in critical condition.'
example: 周婶子和同院的女人把玉宝妈从地下抬到草垫子上，她已经～了。★高玉宝《高玉宝》第十三章
exampleTraditional: 周嬸子和同院的女人把玉寶媽從地下抬到草墊子上，她已經～了。★高玉寶《高玉寶》第十三章
exampleEn: Aunt Zhou and the women in the courtyard lifted Yubao's mother from the ground onto a straw mat; she was already unconscious. (Gao Yubao, 'Gao Yubao', Chapter 13)

explanation: 说话靠得住，有信用。
explanationTraditional: 說話靠得住，有信用。
explanationEn: To be reliable and keep one's word.
derivation: 《论语·学而》与朋友交，言而有信。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·學而》與朋友交，言而有信。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Xue Er': 'In dealing with friends, be true to your word.'
example: 则要你～，休担阁了少年人。★元·戴善夫《风光好》第三折
exampleTraditional: 則要你～，休擔閣了少年人。★元·戴善夫《風光好》第三折
exampleEn: You must keep your word and not delay the young man. (Yuan Dynasty, Dai Shanfu, 'Fengguang Hao', Third Act)

explanation: 根据不同时期的具体情况，采取适当的措施。
explanationTraditional: 根據不同時期的具體情況，採取適當的措施。
explanationEn: To take appropriate measures according to the specific circumstances of different times.
derivation: 《淮南子·氾论训》器械者，因时变而制宜适也。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·氾論訓》器械者，因時變而制宜適也。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi: Fanlun Xun': 'Tools and equipment should be adapted according to the changes of the times.'
example: 除了几处通商口岸，稍能～，欺侮十八行省，那一处不是执迷不化，捍格不通呢？★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第一回
exampleTraditional: 除了幾處通商口岸，稍能～，欺侮十八行省，那一處不是執迷不化，捍格不通呢？★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第一回
exampleEn: Except for a few treaty ports that can adapt to the times, the other eighteen provinces are all stubborn and unyielding. (Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 1)

explanation: 聊略微。比没有要好一点。
explanationTraditional: 聊略微。比沒有要好一點。
explanationEn: Something is better than nothing.
derivation: 晋·陶潜《和刘柴桑》诗弱女虽非男，慰情聊胜无。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陶潛《和劉柴桑》詩弱女雖非男，慰情聊勝無。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Tao Qian's poem 'To Liu Chaisang': 'A weak daughter is not a son, but it comforts the heart, better than nothing.'
example: 王二瞎子一听仍是衙门里的人，就是声光比账房差些，尚属慰情～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十五回
exampleTraditional: 王二瞎子一聽仍是衙門裡的人，就是聲光比賬房差些，尚屬慰情～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十五回
exampleEn: When Wang Erxiaozi heard that it was still someone from the yamen, though less prestigious than the accountant, it was still comforting, better than nothing. (Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats Exposed', Chapter 45)

explanation: 机灵聪明，办事能力强。
explanationTraditional: 機靈聰明，辦事能力強。
explanationEn: Clever, intelligent, and capable in handling affairs.
derivation: 《新唐书·苏弁传》弁通学术，吏事精明，承延龄后，平赋缓役，略烦苛，人赖其宽。”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·蘇弁傳》弁通學術，吏事精明，承延齡後，平賦緩役，略煩苛，人賴其寬。”
derivationEn: From 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Su Bian': 'Su Bian was well-versed in learning and shrewd in official affairs; following Yanling, he balanced taxes and eased corvée, simplifying burdens, and people relied on his leniency.'
example: 吴为成的脸方上透露着～的神气。★茅盾《子夜》十
exampleTraditional: 吳為成的臉方上透露著～的神氣。★茅盾《子夜》十
exampleEn: Wu Weicheng's face revealed an air of shrewdness and capability. (Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 10)

explanation: 形容关怀体贴备至。
explanationTraditional: 形容關懷體貼備至。
explanationEn: To show great care and concern for someone's well-being.
derivation: 康濯《我在乡下》他短不了上我屋里来拉扯个时事，还常常问寒问暖问吃问住，亲热的不行。”
derivationTraditional: 康濯《我在鄉下》他短不了上我屋裡來拉扯個時事，還常常問寒問暖問吃問住，親熱的不行。”
derivationEn: From Kang Zhuo's 'In the Countryside': 'He often came to my room to chat about current events and frequently asked about my warmth and cold, food and lodging, showing great warmth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 是对；非错。把错的说成对的，对的说成错的。把是非弄颠倒了。
explanationTraditional: 是對；非錯。把錯的說成對的，對的說成錯的。把是非弄顛倒了。
explanationEn: To confuse right and wrong, deliberately reversing truth and falsehood.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《施先生墓铭》古圣人言，其旨密微，笺注纷罗，颠倒是非。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《施先生墓銘》古聖人言，其旨密微，箋註紛羅，顛倒是非。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Mr. Shi': 'The words of ancient sages were profound and subtle, but commentaries and annotations were chaotic, confusing right and wrong.'
example: 我们希望这种～的时代快些过去。★毛泽东《论联合政府》
exampleTraditional: 我們希望這種～的時代快些過去。★毛澤東《論聯合政府》
exampleEn: We hope that this era of confusing right and wrong will soon pass. (Mao Zedong, 'On Coalition Government')

explanation: 古人认为礼定贵贱尊卑，义为行动准绳，廉为廉洁方正，耻为有知耻之心。指封建社会的道德标准和行为规范。
explanationTraditional: 古人認為禮定貴賤尊卑，義為行動準繩，廉為廉潔方正，恥為有知恥之心。指封建社會的道德標準和行為規範。
explanationEn: The four moral principles of propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame, which were the ethical standards and behavioral norms in feudal society.
derivation: 《管子·牧民》何谓维？一曰礼，二曰义，三曰廉，四曰耻。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·牧民》何謂維？一曰禮，二曰義，三曰廉，四曰恥。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Shepherding the People': 'What are the four dimensions? First, propriety; second, righteousness; third, integrity; fourth, shame.'
example: 古之贤君必厉士气，当务求难合自重之士，以养成～之风。★宋·苏轼《乞录用郑侠王斿状》
exampleTraditional: 古之賢君必厲士氣，當務求難合自重之士，以養成～之風。★宋·蘇軾《乞錄用鄭俠王斿狀》
exampleEn: Ancient wise rulers must inspire morale and seek hard-to-please, self-respecting scholars to cultivate the ethos of propriety, righteousness, integrity, and shame. (Song Dynasty, Su Shi, 'Petition for the Appointment of Zheng Xia and Wang You')

explanation: 失笑忍不住地笑起来。禁不住笑出声来。
explanationTraditional: 失笑忍不住地笑起來。禁不住笑出聲來。
explanationEn: Unable to suppress a laugh; to burst out laughing involuntarily.
derivation: 汉·赵晔《吴越春秋·越王无余外传》禹乃哑然而笑。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·趙曄《吳越春秋·越王無餘外傳》禹乃啞然而笑。”
derivationEn: From 'Wu Yue Chun Qiu' by Zhao Ye of Han Dynasty: 'Yu then laughed silently.'
example: 王子安方寸之中，顷刻万绪，想鬼狐窃笑已久，故乘其醉而玩弄之，床头人醒，宁不～哉。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·王子安》
exampleTraditional: 王子安方寸之中，頃刻萬緒，想鬼狐竊笑已久，故乘其醉而玩弄之，床頭人醒，寧不～哉。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·王子安》
exampleEn: In Wang Zi'an's mind, a thousand thoughts surged in an instant; he thought the ghosts and foxes had long been laughing secretly, so they took advantage of his drunkenness to toy with him. When the person by his pillow woke up, how could he not burst out laughing? — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Lonely Studio: Wang Zi'an'

explanation: 指新的一年的开始。并常以下句万象更新”合成春联。
explanationTraditional: 指新的一年的開始。並常以下句萬象更新”合成春聯。
explanationEn: Refers to the beginning of a new year; often used with the phrase 'everything takes on a new look' in Spring Festival couplets.
derivation: 《公羊传·隐公元年》元者何？君之始年也。春者何？岁之始也。”
derivationTraditional: 《公羊傳·隱公元年》元者何？君之始年也。春者何？歲之始也。”
derivationEn: From 'Gongyang Zhuan: Duke Yin Year 1': 'What is Yuan? It is the first year of the ruler. What is Spring? It is the beginning of the year.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 啧争辩；烦言气愤不满的话。形容议论纷纷，报怨责备。
explanationTraditional: 嘖爭辯；煩言氣憤不滿的話。形容議論紛紛，報怨責備。
explanationEn: Describes widespread discussion and complaints; murmurs of discontent.
derivation: 《左传·定公四年》会同难，啧有烦言，莫之治也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·定公四年》會同難，嘖有煩言，莫之治也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Ding Year 4': 'Meetings are difficult; there are murmurs of discontent, and no one can manage them.'
example: 我辈与之遗老，本不能志同道合，其～，正是应有之事。★《鲁迅书信集·致许寿裳》
exampleTraditional: 我輩與之遺老，本不能志同道合，其～，正是應有之事。★《魯迅書信集·致許壽裳》
exampleEn: We and those loyalists were never like-minded; their murmurs of discontent are only to be expected. — 'Lu Xun's Letters: To Xu Shoushang'

explanation: 龙钟行动不灵便的样子。形容年老体衰，行动不灵便。
explanationTraditional: 龍鍾行動不靈便的樣子。形容年老體衰，行動不靈便。
explanationEn: Describes an old person who is feeble and moves with difficulty.
derivation: 唐·李端《赠谢戴》交结渐时辈，龙钟似老翁。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李端《贈謝戴》交結漸時輩，龍鍾似老翁。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li Duan's poem 'To Xie Dai': 'Associating with contemporaries gradually, I am like an old man, decrepit.'
example: 有一位～的工兵营营长吴某到站台迎接，并且报告锦州形势混乱，火车不能开过。★陶菊隐《北洋军阀统治时期史话》第六十九回
exampleTraditional: 有一位～的工兵營營長吳某到站臺迎接，並且報告錦州形勢混亂，火車不能開過。★陶菊隱《北洋軍閥統治時期史話》第六十九回
exampleEn: An old and decrepit engineer battalion commander named Wu came to the platform to greet us and reported that the situation in Jinzhou was chaotic and the train could not proceed. — Tao Juyin, 'History of the Warlord Period in Northern China', Chapter 69

explanation: 形容非常广阔，一眼望不到边。也指谈话或写文章没有中心，离题很远。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常廣闊，一眼望不到邊。也指談話或寫文章沒有中心，離題很遠。
explanationEn: Describes something vast and boundless; also refers to speech or writing that lacks focus and strays far from the topic.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 只向黎说了一些海阔天空、～的话。（陶菊隐《北洋军阀统治时期史话》第二十四章）
exampleTraditional: 只向黎說了一些海闊天空、～的話。（陶菊隱《北洋軍閥統治時期史話》第二十四章）
exampleEn: He only spoke to Li about some vague and rambling topics. — Tao Juyin, 'History of the Warlord Period in Northern China', Chapter 24

explanation: 男女之间有严格区别。旧时用以强调应严守封建礼教。
explanationTraditional: 男女之間有嚴格區別。舊時用以強調應嚴守封建禮教。
explanationEn: There should be strict distinctions between men and women; used in old times to emphasize adherence to feudal ethics.
derivation: 《礼记·效特性》男女有别，然后父子亲；父子亲，然后义生；义生，然后礼作；礼作，然后万物安。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·效特性》男女有別，然後父子親；父子親，然後義生；義生，然後禮作；禮作，然後萬物安。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Jiao Te Sheng': 'When there are distinctions between men and women, then father and son are close; when father and son are close, then righteousness arises; when righteousness arises, then rites are established; when rites are established, then all things are at peace.'
example: 你我萍水相逢，况且～，你与我无干，我管你不着。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第五回
exampleTraditional: 你我萍水相逢，況且～，你與我無干，我管你不著。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第五回
exampleEn: We are strangers meeting by chance, and besides, there are distinctions between men and women. You have nothing to do with me, and I cannot control you. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 5

explanation: 因胜利而头脑发热，不能总冷静思考和谨慎行事。
explanationTraditional: 因勝利而頭腦發熱，不能總冷靜思考和謹慎行事。
explanationEn: To become dizzy with success; to lose the ability to think calmly and act cautiously due to victory.
derivation: 李欣《无限风光在险峰”》胜利之后，也不‘万事大吉’，不可冲昏头脑，否则还可能丧失胜利的果实。”
derivationTraditional: 李欣《無限風光在險峰”》勝利之後，也不‘萬事大吉’，不可衝昏頭腦，否則還可能喪失勝利的果實。”
derivationEn: From Li Xin's 'Infinite Scenery in Dangerous Peaks': 'After victory, do not think everything is fine; do not let success go to your head, or you may lose the fruits of victory.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 戴尊奉，推崇。感激别人的恩惠和好处。
explanationTraditional: 戴尊奉，推崇。感激別人的恩惠和好處。
explanationEn: To be deeply grateful for someone's kindness and favors.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·骆统传》今皆感恩戴义，怀欲报之心。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·駱統傳》今皆感恩戴義，懷欲報之心。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Luo Tong's Biography': 'Now all are grateful for your kindness and righteousness, and harbor the desire to repay.'
example: 偶有一个狡滑的民贼出来，略用些小恩小惠来抚弄他，他便欢天喜地～。★清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第三回
exampleTraditional: 偶有一個狡滑的民賊出來，略用些小恩小惠來撫弄他，他便歡天喜地～。★清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第三回
exampleEn: Occasionally, a cunning villain emerges, using small favors to manipulate them, and they become overjoyed and deeply grateful. — Qing Dynasty, Lingnan Yiyi Nushi, 'The Heroine of Eastern Europe', Chapter 3

explanation: 涕眼泪；零落。因感激而流泪。形容极度感激。
explanationTraditional: 涕眼淚；零落。因感激而流淚。形容極度感激。
explanationEn: To shed tears of gratitude; extremely grateful.
derivation: 唐·刘禹锡《平蔡行》诗路旁老人忆旧事，相与感激皆涕零。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉禹錫《平蔡行》詩路旁老人憶舊事，相與感激皆涕零。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Yuxi's poem 'Ping Cai Xing': 'An old man by the road recalls old times, and they all shed tears of gratitude.'
example: 贾政听了，～，叩首不已。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一○七回
exampleTraditional: 賈政聽了，～，叩首不已。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一○七回
exampleEn: Jia Zheng, upon hearing this, shed tears of gratitude and kowtowed repeatedly. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 107

explanation: 泯泯灭。年岁虽大但仍有天真之心。形容成年人还有着孩子的天真。
explanationTraditional: 泯泯滅。年歲雖大但仍有天真之心。形容成年人還有著孩子的天真。
explanationEn: To retain a childlike heart despite one's age; describes an adult who still has the innocence of a child.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻利用别人的矛盾而从中获利。
explanationTraditional: 比喻利用別人的矛盾而從中獲利。
explanationEn: To profit from others' conflict; to reap the spoils of a fight between others.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策二》今者臣来，过易水，蚌方出曝，而鹬啄其肉，蚌合而拑其喙。……两者不肯相舍，渔者得而并禽之。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策二》今者臣來，過易水，蚌方出曝，而鷸啄其肉，蚌合而拑其喙。……兩者不肯相舍，漁者得而並禽之。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Yan Strategy II': A clam opened its shell to sun, and a snipe pecked its flesh; the clam closed its shell and clamped the snipe's beak. Neither would let go, and a fisherman caught them both.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 极尽；眺望。尽眼力之所及眺望远方。
explanationTraditional: 極盡；眺望。盡眼力之所及眺望遠方。
explanationEn: To look as far as the eye can see; to gaze into the distance.
derivation: 三国·魏·王朗《与许靖书》子虽在裔土，想亦极目而迥望，侧耳而遐听，延颈而鹤立。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·王朗《與許靖書》子雖在裔土，想亦極目而迥望，側耳而遐聽，延頸而鶴立。”
derivationEn: From Wang Lang's 'Letter to Xu Jing' (Three Kingdoms period): 'Though you are in a distant land, I imagine you strain your eyes to look far, cock your ears to listen afar, and stretch your neck like a crane.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容人精力充沛，风度不凡。
explanationTraditional: 形容人精力充沛，風度不凡。
explanationEn: Having an imposing appearance; dignified and impressive in manner.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十三回张昭等见孔明丰神飘洒，器宇轩昂，料到此人必来游说。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十三回張昭等見孔明丰神飄灑，器宇軒昂，料到此人必來遊說。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' (Chapter 43): 'Zhang Zhao and others saw Zhuge Liang's elegant demeanor and imposing bearing, and knew he had come to persuade.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻虚诞、离奇的议论。
explanationTraditional: 比喻虛誕、離奇的議論。
explanationEn: An incredible or fantastic story; something absurd or preposterous.
derivation: 即阿拉伯民间故事《一千零一夜》。
derivationTraditional: 即阿拉伯民間故事《一千零一夜》。
derivationEn: From the Arabian Nights (One Thousand and One Nights).
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 估量不透。捉摸猜测，预料。
explanationTraditional: 估量不透。捉摸猜測，預料。
explanationEn: Difficult to predict or fathom; elusive.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第二回却说朱武、杨春两个正在寨里猜疑，捉摸不定。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第二回卻說朱武、楊春兩個正在寨裡猜疑，捉摸不定。”
derivationEn: From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' (Chapter 2): 'Zhu Wu and Yang Chun were in the stronghold, suspicious and uncertain, unable to fathom the situation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 高深的程度无法揣测。形容使人难以理解。
explanationTraditional: 高深的程度無法揣測。形容使人難以理解。
explanationEn: Too profound to be understood; unfathomable; enigmatic.
derivation: 《汉书·严延年传》吏民莫能测其意深浅，战栗不敢犯禁。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·嚴延年傳》吏民莫能測其意深淺，戰慄不敢犯禁。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Yan Yannian': 'Officials and commoners could not fathom his depth, and trembled in fear, not daring to violate the law.'
example: 他说话常故弄玄虚，使人感到～。
exampleTraditional: 他說話常故弄玄虛，使人感到～。
exampleEn: He often speaks mysteriously, making people feel unfathomable.

explanation: 看到钱财，眼睛就睁大了。形容人贪财。
explanationTraditional: 看到錢財，眼睛就睜大了。形容人貪財。
explanationEn: To open one's eyes wide at the sight of money; to be money-grubbing.
derivation: 明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第八十一回弃旧迎新，见钱眼开，自然之理。”
derivationTraditional: 明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第八十一回棄舊迎新，見錢眼開，自然之理。”
derivationEn: From Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng's 'Jin Ping Mei' (Chapter 81): 'Abandoning the old for the new, eyes open at the sight of money—this is natural.'
example: 现在的这位中丞，面子上虽然清廉，骨底子是个～的人。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十三回
exampleTraditional: 現在的這位中丞，面子上雖然清廉，骨底子是個～的人。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十三回
exampleEn: The current governor, though outwardly incorruptible, is at heart a man who opens his eyes at the sight of money.

explanation: 行走时身体故意左右扭动亿。形容举止言谈不爽快，不大方或故做姿态和。
explanationTraditional: 行走時身體故意左右扭動億。形容舉止言談不爽快，不大方或故做姿態和。
explanationEn: To walk with a affected sway; to behave in a coy, unnatural, or hesitant manner.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第三十四回那般娇娇啻啻，扭扭捏捏，就象那老怪的行动。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三十四回那般嬌嬌啻啻，扭扭捏捏，就象那老怪的行動。”
derivationEn: From Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West' (Chapter 34): 'She acted so coyly, twisting and turning, just like the old monster's movements.'
example: 难为你说的齐全，别象他们～的蚊子似的。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 難為你說的齊全，別象他們～的蚊子似的。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十七回
exampleEn: It's hard for you to speak so completely; don't be like those mosquitoes that twist and turn.

explanation: 原形容大风大雨◇也比喻处境险恶或声势猛烈。
explanationTraditional: 原形容大風大雨◇也比喻處境險惡或聲勢猛烈。
explanationEn: Fierce wind and torrential rain; metaphor for a violent or turbulent situation.
derivation: 《老子》第二十三章故飘风不终朝，骤雨不终日。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第二十三章故飄風不終朝，驟雨不終日。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi' (Chapter 23): 'Therefore, a strong wind does not last all morning, a sudden rain does not last all day.'
example: 我沉吟罢仔细听来，原来是唤醒人～。★元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第四折
exampleTraditional: 我沉吟罷仔細聽來，原來是喚醒人～。★元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第四折
exampleEn: After pondering, I listened carefully; it turned out to be a fierce wind and sudden rain awakening people.

explanation: 脸色发黄，身体瘦削。形容人营养不良或有病的样子。
explanationTraditional: 臉色發黃，身體瘦削。形容人營養不良或有病的樣子。
explanationEn: Sallow and emaciated; looking gaunt and malnourished.
derivation: 元·无名氏《独角牛》第一折哥也，你这般面黄肌廲，怎生赢的人也。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《獨角牛》第一折哥也，你這般面黃肌廲，怎生贏的人也。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty anonymous play 'The Lone Bull' (Act 1): 'Brother, with your sallow face and thin body, how can you win?'
example: 寻到厨房后面一间小屋，见几个老和尚坐地，一个个～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六回
exampleTraditional: 尋到廚房後面一間小屋，見幾個老和尚坐地，一個個～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六回
exampleEn: They found a small room behind the kitchen, where several old monks sat, each sallow and emaciated.

explanation: 左右手都能射箭。比喻两只手轮流做同一动作或同时做几项工作。
explanationTraditional: 左右手都能射箭。比喻兩隻手輪流做同一動作或同時做幾項工作。
explanationEn: To shoot arrows with both hands; metaphorically, to do two things simultaneously or to perform actions alternately with both hands.
derivation: 元·白朴《梧桐雨》楔子臣左右开弓，一十八般武艺，无有不会。”
derivationTraditional: 元·白樸《梧桐雨》楔子臣左右開弓，一十八般武藝，無有不會。”
derivationEn: From Bai Pu's 'Wutong Yu' of the Yuan Dynasty: 'I can shoot with both hands and master all eighteen martial arts.'
example: 那兴儿真个自己～，打了自己十几个嘴巴。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: 那興兒真個自己～，打了自己十幾個嘴巴。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十七回
exampleEn: Xing'er really started hitting himself left and right, slapping his own face more than a dozen times. — from Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 67

explanation: 莫不能；辩辩白。即使有一百张嘴也辩白不清。形容不管怎样辩白也说不清楚。
explanationTraditional: 莫不能；辯辯白。即使有一百張嘴也辯白不清。形容不管怎樣辯白也說不清楚。
explanationEn: Even with a hundred mouths, one cannot justify oneself; unable to explain or defend despite all efforts.
derivation: 宋·刘过《建康狱中上吴居父》虽有百口而莫辩其辜。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·劉過《建康獄中上吳居父》雖有百口而莫辯其辜。”
derivationEn: From Liu Guo's 'Letter to Wu Jufu in Jiankang Prison' of the Song Dynasty: 'Even with a hundred mouths, I cannot argue my innocence.'
example: 玉林和忠和醒悟了，一打便是祸事，若是李三顺身上有了伤，便～，官司”非输不可。★高阳《清宫外史》上册
exampleTraditional: 玉林和忠和醒悟了，一打便是禍事，若是李三順身上有了傷，便～，官司”非輸不可。★高陽《清宮外史》上冊
exampleEn: Yulin and Zhonghe realized that a beating would bring disaster; if Li Sanshun had any injuries, they would be unable to defend themselves, and the lawsuit would be lost. — from Gao Yang's 'Inside the Qing Court', Volume 1

explanation: 高山比喻高尚的品德。比喻对高尚的品德的仰慕。
explanationTraditional: 高山比喻高尚的品德。比喻對高尚的品德的仰慕。
explanationEn: To look up to a high mountain; metaphorically, to admire someone's noble character or virtue.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·车辖》高山仰止，景行行止。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·車轄》高山仰止，景行行止。”
derivationEn: From the 'Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Chexia': 'The high mountain is looked up to; the great road is traveled.'
example: 夫岂不怀，～，愿言敏德，啜菽饮水。★唐·王勃《倬彼我系》
exampleTraditional: 夫豈不懷，～，願言敏德，啜菽飲水。★唐·王勃《倬彼我係》
exampleEn: How could I not cherish it? I look up to the high mountain, wishing to cultivate virtue, even if it means simple living. — from Wang Bo's 'Zhuo Bi Wo Xi' of the Tang Dynasty

explanation: 勇勇气；谋计谋。既有胆量又有计谋。
explanationTraditional: 勇勇氣；謀計謀。既有膽量又有計謀。
explanationEn: Having both courage and strategy; brave and resourceful.
derivation: 晋·陈寿《三国志·魏志·董卓传》裴松之注引《献帝起居注》吕布受恩而反图之，斯须之间，头悬竿端，此有勇而无谋也。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陳壽《三國志·魏志·董卓傳》裴松之注引《獻帝起居注》呂布受恩而反圖之，斯須之間，頭懸竿端，此有勇而無謀也。”
derivationEn: From Chen Shou's 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Wei Shu, Biography of Dong Zhuo' with commentary by Pei Songzhi: 'Lü Bu received favor but plotted against him, and in an instant his head hung from a pole—this is courage without strategy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 水不停地滴，石头也能被滴穿。比喻只要有恒心，不断努力，事情就一定能成功。
explanationTraditional: 水不停地滴，石頭也能被滴穿。比喻只要有恆心，不斷努力，事情就一定能成功。
explanationEn: Dripping water can penetrate stone; with persistence and effort, any difficulty can be overcome.
derivation: 《汉书·枚乘传》泰山之靋穿石，单极之绠断干。水非石之钻，索非木之锯，渐靡使之然也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·枚乘傳》泰山之靋穿石，單極之綆斷幹。水非石之鑽，索非木之鋸，漸靡使之然也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han, Biography of Mei Cheng': 'Water dripping from Mount Tai wears through stone; a single rope cuts through wood. It is not that water is a stone drill or rope a wood saw, but gradual wear makes it so.'
example: 乖崖援笔判云一日一钱，千日千钱；绳锯木断，～。”★宋·罗大经《鹤林玉露》卷十
exampleTraditional: 乖崖援筆判雲一日一錢，千日千錢；繩鋸木斷，～。”★宋·羅大經《鶴林玉露》卷十
exampleEn: Guaiya wrote with his brush: 'One coin a day, a thousand coins in a thousand days; a rope can saw through wood, dripping water can penetrate stone.' — from Luo Dajing's 'Crane Grove Jade Dew', Volume 10 of the Song Dynasty

explanation: 发动军队，声讨对方罪过。也指大闹意见，集合一伙人去上门责问。
explanationTraditional: 發動軍隊，聲討對方罪過。也指大鬧意見，集合一夥人去上門責問。
explanationEn: To dispatch troops to denounce someone's crimes; also, to gather a group to confront and accuse someone.
derivation: 宋·沈括《梦溪笔谈》卷二十五元昊乃改元，制衣冠礼乐，下令国中，悉用蕃书、胡礼，自称大夏。朝廷兴师问罪。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·沈括《夢溪筆談》卷二十五元昊乃改元，製衣冠禮樂，下令國中，悉用蕃書、胡禮，自稱大夏。朝廷興師問罪。”
derivationEn: From Shen Kuo's 'Dream Pool Essays', Volume 25 of the Song Dynasty: 'Yuanhao changed the reign title, made new clothes and rituals, ordered the state to use barbarian script and customs, and called himself Great Xia. The court sent troops to denounce his crimes.'
example: 他们哪里是来拜望我的呵，他们是来～的。★蒋光慈《田野的风》
exampleTraditional: 他們哪裡是來拜望我的呵，他們是來～的。★蔣光慈《田野的風》
exampleEn: They didn't come to visit me; they came to denounce me. — from Jiang Guangci's 'Wind in the Fields'

explanation: 书写。大写特写。指对意义重大的事情特别郑重地加以记载。
explanationTraditional: 書寫。大寫特寫。指對意義重大的事情特別鄭重地加以記載。
explanationEn: To write about something extensively and emphatically; to record an important event with great attention.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《答元侍御书》而足下年尚强，嗣德有继，将大书特书，屡书不一书而已也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《答元侍御書》而足下年尚強，嗣德有繼，將大書特書，屢書不一書而已也。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Reply to Imperial Censor Yuan' of the Tang Dynasty: 'You are still strong, and your virtue continues; you will write about it extensively, repeatedly, and not just once.'
example: 倘令为林文忠作传，则烧鸦片一事，固当～。★清·吴汝纶《答严几道》
exampleTraditional: 倘令為林文忠作傳，則燒鴉片一事，固當～。★清·吳汝綸《答嚴幾道》
exampleEn: If one were to write a biography of Lin Wenzhong, the burning of opium should certainly be recorded extensively. — from Wu Rulun's 'Reply to Yan Jidao' of the Qing Dynasty

explanation: 指严重隐患或要害部门的大患。同心腹重患”。
explanationTraditional: 指嚴重隱患或要害部門的大患。同心腹重患”。
explanationEn: A serious hidden danger or a major threat to a vital part; a grave concern.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 拿仇恨回报所受的恩惠。指忘恩负义。
explanationTraditional: 拿仇恨回報所受的恩惠。指忘恩負義。
explanationEn: To repay kindness with enmity; to be ungrateful and return evil for good.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第三十回我若一口说出，他就把公主杀了，此却不是恩将仇报？”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三十回我若一口說出，他就把公主殺了，此卻不是恩將仇報？”
derivationEn: From Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 30 of the Ming Dynasty: 'If I speak out, he will kill the princess—wouldn't that be repaying kindness with enmity?'
example: 亏这官人救了性命，今反～，天理何在！★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十
exampleTraditional: 虧這官人救了性命，今反～，天理何在！★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十
exampleEn: This official saved his life, yet he repays kindness with enmity—where is justice? — from Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 30 of the Ming Dynasty

explanation: 彻底改变原来的面貌。指改造社会，改造自然。
explanationTraditional: 徹底改變原來的面貌。指改造社會，改造自然。
explanationEn: To completely transform the world; to remake society or nature on a grand scale.
derivation: 丁玲《杜晚香》外边的惊天动地，改天换地，并没有震动过这偏僻的山沟。”
derivationTraditional: 丁玲《杜晚香》外邊的驚天動地，改天換地，並沒有震動過這偏僻的山溝。”
derivationEn: From Ding Ling's 'Du Wanxiang': 'The earth-shattering changes outside, the transformation of heaven and earth, had not shaken this remote mountain valley.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 善亲善，友好。强调来人不怀好意，要警惕防范。
explanationTraditional: 善親善，友好。強調來人不懷好意，要警惕防範。
explanationEn: The one who comes is not friendly; indicates that the newcomer has ill intentions and one should be vigilant.
derivation: 《老子》善者不辩，辩者不善。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》善者不辯，辯者不善。”
derivationEn: From Laozi: 'The good do not argue; those who argue are not good.'
example: ～，善者不来”，亦本《老子》善者不辩，辩者不善”句。★清·赵翼《陔余丛考·成语》
exampleTraditional: ～，善者不來”，亦本《老子》善者不辯，辯者不善”句。★清·趙翼《陔餘叢考·成語》
exampleEn: He who comes is not friendly, and he who is friendly does not come.' This also originates from Laozi's saying. — Qing Dynasty, Zhao Yi, 'Notes on Idioms from the Collected Works of Gaoyu'

explanation: 弥天满天。形容天大的谎话。
explanationTraditional: 彌天滿天。形容天大的謊話。
explanationEn: A monstrous lie; a lie as big as the sky.
derivation: 冯德英《迎春花》第十四章‘谁撒这个弥天大谎啊，’胖老婆道‘那可丧尽天良啊！’”
derivationTraditional: 馮德英《迎春花》第十四章‘誰撒這個彌天大謊啊，’胖老婆道‘那可喪盡天良啊！’”
derivationEn: From Feng Deying's 'Spring Blossoms', Chapter 14: 'Who is telling such a monstrous lie?' said the fat wife. 'That would be utterly heartless!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人世间的活地狱。比喻黑暗的社会。
explanationTraditional: 人世間的活地獄。比喻黑暗的社會。
explanationEn: A living hell on earth; a metaphor for a dark society.
derivation: 叶元《林则徐》许多烟鬼横在地上，象蛆虫似地在那里蠕动，吞云吐雾，活象人间地狱。”
derivationTraditional: 葉元《林則徐》許多煙鬼橫在地上，象蛆蟲似地在那裡蠕動，吞雲吐霧，活象人間地獄。”
derivationEn: From Ye Yuan's 'Lin Zexu': 'Many opium addicts lay on the ground, writhing like maggots, puffing smoke, resembling a living hell.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 思想转变很快，彻底悔悟。
explanationTraditional: 思想轉變很快，徹底悔悟。
explanationEn: To suddenly realize one's mistakes and repent thoroughly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他苦口婆心地劝解终使他～，及时回头。
exampleTraditional: 他苦口婆心地勸解終使他～，及時回頭。
exampleEn: His earnest persuasion finally made him repent thoroughly and turn back in time.

explanation: 古道上古时代的风俗习惯，形容厚道；热肠热心肠。指待人真诚、热情。
explanationTraditional: 古道上古時代的風俗習慣，形容厚道；熱腸熱心腸。指待人真誠、熱情。
explanationEn: Having an ancient, generous disposition and a warm heart; treating others sincerely and warmly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 几个人当中，毕竟是老头子秦梅士～。（清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十四回）
exampleTraditional: 幾個人當中，畢竟是老頭子秦梅士～。（清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十四回）
exampleEn: Among the few, it was the old man Qin Meishi who was most warm-hearted and sincere. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 44

explanation: 原形容山势的蜿蜒雄壮，后也形容书法笔势有力，灵活舒展。
explanationTraditional: 原形容山勢的蜿蜒雄壯，後也形容書法筆勢有力，靈活舒展。
explanationEn: Originally describes the winding and majestic terrain; later also describes vigorous and graceful calligraphy strokes.
derivation: 汉·张衡《东京赋》我世祖龙飞白水，凤翔参墟。”宋·苏轼《表忠观碑》天目之山，苕水出焉，龙飞凤舞，萃于临安。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·張衡《東京賦》我世祖龍飛白水，鳳翔參墟。”宋·蘇軾《表忠觀碑》天目之山，苕水出焉，龍飛鳳舞，萃於臨安。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Zhang Heng's 'Rhapsody on the Eastern Capital': 'Our founding emperor rose like a dragon from the White Water, and soared like a phoenix over the ruins.' Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Stele of the Temple of Loyalty': 'The Tianmu Mountain, where the Tiao River originates, dragons fly and phoenixes dance, gathering at Lin'an.'
example: 抬头看见北墙上挂着四幅大屏，草书得～，出色惊人。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第九回
exampleTraditional: 抬頭看見北牆上掛著四幅大屏，草書得～，出色驚人。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第九回
exampleEn: Looking up, he saw four large screens hanging on the north wall, with calligraphy so vigorous and graceful that it was astonishing. — Qing Dynasty, Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 9

explanation: 指谦虚而严格要求自己的人。
explanationTraditional: 指謙虛而嚴格要求自己的人。
explanationEn: A modest and self-disciplined gentleman.
derivation: 《易·谦》谦谦君子，卑以自牧也。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·謙》謙謙君子，卑以自牧也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes', Hexagram Qian: 'A modest gentleman, humbly cultivating himself.'
example: 俺这等～，须不比泛泛庸徒。★元·无名氏《渔樵记》第一折
exampleTraditional: 俺這等～，須不比泛泛庸徒。★元·無名氏《漁樵記》第一折
exampleEn: We such modest gentlemen are not like ordinary vulgar people. — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Story of the Woodcutter', Act 1

explanation: 传说汉朝淮南王刘安修炼成仙后，把剩下的药撒在院子里，鸡和狗吃了，也都升天了◇比喻一个人做了官，和他有关的人也跟着得势。
explanationTraditional: 傳說漢朝淮南王劉安修煉成仙後，把剩下的藥撒在院子裡，雞和狗吃了，也都昇天了◇比喻一個人做了官，和他有關的人也跟著得勢。
explanationEn: When a person rises to power, all associated with him also benefit; literally, chickens and dogs ascend to heaven.
derivation: 汉·王充《论衡·道虚》淮南王刘安坐反而死，天下并闻，当时并见，儒书尚有言其得道仙去，鸡犬升天者。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王充《論衡·道虛》淮南王劉安坐反而死，天下並聞，當時並見，儒書尚有言其得道仙去，雞犬升天者。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Wang Chong's 'Lunheng': 'Liu An, the King of Huainan, died for rebellion, known to all. Yet Confucian books still say he became an immortal and ascended, with his chickens and dogs also rising to heaven.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 故态老脾气，老样子；复又；萌发生。指旧的习气或毛病等又出现了。
explanationTraditional: 故態老脾氣，老樣子；復又；萌發生。指舊的習氣或毛病等又出現了。
explanationEn: Old habits or faults reappear; to revert to one's old ways.
derivation: 明·梅鼎祚《玉合记·嗣音》不欺师父，韩郎遣信到此，不觉故态复萌，情缘难断。”
derivationTraditional: 明·梅鼎祚《玉合記·嗣音》不欺師父，韓郎遣信到此，不覺故態復萌，情緣難斷。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Mei Dingzuo's 'Jade Box': 'I dare not deceive you, Master. Han Lang sent a letter, and I unconsciously reverted to my old ways, unable to break the bond of love.'
example: 马阮心上好不痛快。便又～，横征暴敛，报复冤仇，享受着这小朝廷的大臣们的最高权威。★郑振铎《毁灭》八
exampleTraditional: 馬阮心上好不痛快。便又～，橫徵暴斂，報復冤仇，享受著這小朝廷的大臣們的最高權威。★鄭振鐸《毀滅》八
exampleEn: Ma and Ruan were very unhappy. They then reverted to their old ways, imposing heavy taxes and taking revenge, enjoying the highest authority in this small court. — Zheng Zhenduo, 'Destruction', Chapter 8

explanation: 怀怀藏；才才能。胸怀才学但生不逢时，难以施展；多指屈居微贱而不得志。
explanationTraditional: 懷懷藏；才才能。胸懷才學但生不逢時，難以施展；多指屈居微賤而不得志。
explanationEn: To have talent but not be recognized or given opportunity; to be in a low position despite one's abilities.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷五眼见别人才学万倍不如他的，一个个出身显通，享用爵禄偏则自家怀才不遇。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷五眼見別人才學萬倍不如他的，一個個出身顯通，享用爵祿偏則自家懷才不遇。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 5: 'Seeing others with far less talent than himself succeed and enjoy high positions, he felt he alone was unrecognized.'
example: 高曾祖考，俱是～的秀才。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一回
exampleTraditional: 高曾祖考，俱是～的秀才。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一回
exampleEn: His ancestors were all talented scholars who never got their due. — Qing Dynasty, Xia Jingqu's 'A Rustic's Idle Talk', Chapter 1

explanation: 擒捉。原指作战一下子就能把敌人捉拿过来，后比喻做事有把握，不费力就做好了。
explanationTraditional: 擒捉。原指作戰一下子就能把敵人捉拿過來，後比喻做事有把握，不費力就做好了。
explanationEn: To capture an enemy with ease; to accomplish something effortlessly and with certainty.
derivation: 元·康进之《李逵负荆》第四折这是揉着我山儿的痒处，管教他瓮中捉鳖，手到拿来。”
derivationTraditional: 元·康進之《李逵負荊》第四折這是揉著我山兒的癢處，管教他甕中捉鱉，手到拿來。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty drama 'Li Kui Carries Thorns' by Kang Jinzhi: 'This is like catching a turtle in a jar, reaching out and grabbing it.'
example: 行者道这个容易，老孙去～。”★明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十四回
exampleTraditional: 行者道這個容易，老孫去～。”★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十四回
exampleEn: The Monkey King said, 'This is easy, I'll go and capture him with ease.' — from 'Journey to the West' by Wu Cheng'en, Chapter 24.

explanation: 触类接触某一方面的事物；旁通相互贯通。掌握了某一事物的知识或规律，进而推知同类事物的知识或规律。
explanationTraditional: 觸類接觸某一方面的事物；旁通相互貫通。掌握了某一事物的知識或規律，進而推知同類事物的知識或規律。
explanationEn: To understand a class of things by analogy; to infer the rest from one instance.
derivation: 《周易·系辞上》引而伸之，触类而长之，天下之能事毕矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭上》引而伸之，觸類而長之，天下之能事畢矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Appended Judgments': 'Extend it and draw inferences, touch one category and understand the rest.'
example: 我真高兴，得着两个新鲜的意思，让我对于生活的方法，能～的思索一回。★朱自清《海阔天空”与古今中外”》
exampleTraditional: 我真高興，得著兩個新鮮的意思，讓我對於生活的方法，能～的思索一回。★朱自清《海闊天空”與古今中外”》
exampleEn: I am very glad to have two fresh ideas that allow me to think by analogy about the methods of life. — from Zhu Ziqing's 'Boundless Sky and Earth'.

explanation: 古指古代的社会风尚。旧时指人心奸诈、刻薄，没有古人淳厚。
explanationTraditional: 古指古代的社會風尚。舊時指人心奸詐、刻薄，沒有古人淳厚。
explanationEn: People's hearts are not as virtuous as in ancient times; lamenting the decline of morality.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十五回奈近来人心不古，都尚奢华。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十五回奈近來人心不古，都尚奢華。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'Flowers in the Mirror' by Li Ruzhen, Chapter 55: 'But nowadays people's hearts are not as virtuous as in ancient times, all are extravagant.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容歌声优美，给人留下难忘的印象。
explanationTraditional: 形容歌聲優美，給人留下難忘的印象。
explanationEn: The lingering sound of music that seems to wrap around the beams; a beautiful melody that leaves a deep impression.
derivation: 《列子·汤问》昔韩娥东之齐，匮粮，过雍门，鬻歌假食，既去而余音绕梁，三日不绝，左右以其人弗去。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·湯問》昔韓娥東之齊，匱糧，過雍門，鬻歌假食，既去而餘音繞樑，三日不絕，左右以其人弗去。”
derivationEn: From 'Liezi: Tang Wen': 'Once Han E sang in Yongmen, and after she left, the sound lingered around the beams for three days.'
example: 受罪半天，能听到一段回肠荡气的唱儿，就很值得，～，三日不绝”，确是真有那种感觉。★梁实秋《听戏》
exampleTraditional: 受罪半天，能聽到一段迴腸蕩氣的唱兒，就很值得，～，三日不絕”，確是真有那種感覺。★梁實秋《聽戲》
exampleEn: After suffering for half a day, hearing a soul-stirring aria is worth it; 'the lingering sound wraps around the beams for three days' is indeed a true feeling. — from Liang Shiqiu's 'Listening to Opera'.

explanation: ①分别治理。②利用手段使国家、民族或宗教等产生分裂，然后对其进行控制和统治。
explanationTraditional: ①分別治理。②利用手段使國家、民族或宗教等產生分裂，然後對其進行控制和統治。
explanationEn: To divide and rule; to govern separately or to cause division for control.
derivation: 清·俞樾《群经平议·周官二》巫马下士二人医四人”凡邦之有疾病者，痟疡者造焉，则使医分而治之，是亦不自医也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·俞樾《群經平議·周官二》巫馬下士二人醫四人”凡邦之有疾病者，痟瘍者造焉，則使醫分而治之，是亦不自醫也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty scholar Yu Yue's 'Commentaries on the Classics: Zhou Officials': 'When there are diseases and ulcers, let the doctors treat them separately.'
example: 维护国与国之间友爱关系，互利与和平事业，反对民族奴役，反对～的策略。★宋庆龄《人民团结起来是不可战胜的》
exampleTraditional: 維護國與國之間友愛關係，互利與和平事業，反對民族奴役，反對～的策略。★宋慶齡《人民團結起來是不可戰勝的》
exampleEn: To maintain friendly relations between nations, mutual benefit and peace, oppose national enslavement, and oppose the strategy of divide and rule. — from Soong Ching-ling's 'The People United Are Invincible'.

explanation: 象从瓜蔓上掉下来的瓜那样熟。形容读书或背书流利纯熟。
explanationTraditional: 象從瓜蔓上掉下來的瓜那樣熟。形容讀書或背書流利純熟。
explanationEn: To be extremely fluent in reading or reciting; to know something by heart.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十一回十一二岁就讲书、读文章，先把一部王守溪的稿子读的滚瓜烂熟。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十一回十一二歲就講書、讀文章，先把一部王守溪的稿子讀的滾瓜爛熟。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'The Scholars' by Wu Jingzi, Chapter 11: 'At eleven or twelve, he studied books and essays, and first read Wang Shouxi's essays until they were as ripe as a melon falling from the vine.'
example: 曹寅从小对唐诗就背得～。★端木蕻良《曹雪芹》四
exampleTraditional: 曹寅從小對唐詩就背得～。★端木蕻良《曹雪芹》四
exampleEn: Cao Yin had memorized Tang poems fluently since childhood. — from Duanmu Hongliang's 'Cao Xueqin', Chapter 4.

explanation: 师军队；名名义，引伸为理由。出兵必有正当的理由◇比喻做某事有充足的理由。
explanationTraditional: 師軍隊；名名義，引伸為理由。出兵必有正當的理由◇比喻做某事有充足的理由。
explanationEn: To have a just reason for sending troops; to do something with good reason.
derivation: 《礼记·檀弓下》师必有名。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·檀弓下》師必有名。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Tan Gong II': 'An army must have a just cause.'
example: 这会儿我们突然转回去再搜，来他个措手不及，而且是～哩。★曲波《林海雪原》十三
exampleTraditional: 這會兒我們突然轉回去再搜，來他個措手不及，而且是～哩。★曲波《林海雪原》十三
exampleEn: Now we suddenly turn back to search again, catching them off guard, and we have a just reason for it. — from Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 13.

explanation: 数数着说；典指历来的制度、事迹。谈论历来的制度、事迹时，把自己祖先的职守都忘了。比喻忘本。也比喻对于本国历史的无知。
explanationTraditional: 數數著說；典指歷來的制度、事蹟。談論歷來的制度、事蹟時，把自己祖先的職守都忘了。比喻忘本。也比喻對於本國曆史的無知。
explanationEn: To forget one's origins or ancestors; to be ignorant of one's own history.
derivation: 《左传·昭公十五年》籍父其无后乎！数典而忘其祖。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公十五年》籍父其無後乎！數典而忘其祖。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Zhao's 15th Year': 'Ji Fu will have no descendants! He counts the records but forgets his ancestors.'
example: 我们要重视中国历史知识的学习，免得出现～的笑话。
exampleTraditional: 我們要重視中國歷史知識的學習，免得出現～的笑話。
exampleEn: We must attach importance to learning Chinese history to avoid the embarrassment of forgetting our origins.

explanation: 楚楚鲜明整洁的样子。形容美好的样子引人怜爱。
explanationTraditional: 楚楚鮮明整潔的樣子。形容美好的樣子引人憐愛。
explanationEn: Delicate and charming; describing a person's beauty that evokes affection.
derivation: 《诗经·曹风·蜉蝣》蜉蝣之羽，衣裳楚楚。”金·元好问《杂言》诸郎楚楚皆玉立。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·曹風·蜉蝣》蜉蝣之羽，衣裳楚楚。”金·元好問《雜言》諸郎楚楚皆玉立。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Cao Feng: Mayfly': 'The wings of the mayfly, the clothes are neat and bright.' And from Jin Dynasty poet Yuan Haowen's 'Miscellaneous Poems': 'All the young men are jade-like and charming.'
example: 有卖鱼阿土者，见一女从屋中出，年二十许，～。★清·淮阴百一居士《壶天录》卷下
exampleTraditional: 有賣魚阿土者，見一女從屋中出，年二十許，～。★清·淮陰百一居士《壺天錄》卷下
exampleEn: There was a fishmonger named A Tu who saw a woman coming out of a house, about twenty years old, delicate and charming. — from Qing Dynasty 'Records of a Pot' by Huaiyin Baiyi Jushi, Volume 2.

explanation: 不失时机，寻欢作乐。
explanationTraditional: 不失時機，尋歡作樂。
explanationEn: To enjoy life while one can; to seize the moment for pleasure.
derivation: 汉乐府《西门行》诗夫为乐，为乐当及时。”《古诗十九首·生年不满百》 为乐当及时，何能待来兹”。
derivationTraditional: 漢樂府《西門行》詩夫為樂，為樂當及時。”《古詩十九首·生年不滿百》 為樂當及時，何能待來茲”。
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty yuefu poem 'West Gate Walk': 'Enjoyment, enjoyment should be timely.' And from 'Nineteen Ancient Poems: Life is Short': 'Enjoyment should be timely, why wait for the future?'
example: 此时离行期尚远，正当～，反要伤悲，岂不将好好时光都变成苦海吗？★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十八回
exampleTraditional: 此時離行期尚遠，正當～，反要傷悲，豈不將好好時光都變成苦海嗎？★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十八回
exampleEn: Since the departure date is still far away, it is the right time to enjoy life; why be sad and waste the good times in a sea of bitterness? — from Qing Dynasty novel 'Flowers in the Mirror' by Li Ruzhen, Chapter 68.

explanation: 战、斗泛指斗争。形容征服和改造大自然的英雄气慨。
explanationTraditional: 戰、鬥泛指鬥爭。形容征服和改造大自然的英雄氣慨。
explanationEn: To fight against heaven and earth; describes the heroic spirit of conquering and transforming nature.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 灾区人民以战天斗地的英雄气慨，克服洪水带来的困难，恢复生产，重建家园。
exampleTraditional: 災區人民以戰天鬥地的英雄氣慨，克服洪水帶來的困難，恢復生產，重建家園。
exampleEn: The people in the disaster area, with the heroic spirit of fighting against heaven and earth, overcame the difficulties brought by the flood, resumed production, and rebuilt their homes.

explanation: 指没有生机和活力。死又死不了，活着又受罪。
explanationTraditional: 指沒有生機和活力。死又死不了，活著又受罪。
explanationEn: Half-dead; lacking vitality and energy, in a state between life and death, suffering.
derivation: 参见半死半生”。
derivationTraditional: 參見半死半生”。
derivationEn: See 'half dead half alive'.
example: 想跑，水裹住他的脚，他就那么～的，低着头一步一步的往前曳。★老舍《骆驼祥子》十八
exampleTraditional: 想跑，水裹住他的腳，他就那麼～的，低著頭一步一步的往前曳。★老舍《駱駝祥子》十八
exampleEn: He wanted to run, but the water wrapped around his feet, so he, half-dead, lowered his head and dragged forward step by step. — Lao She, 'Rickshaw Boy', Chapter 18

explanation: 臭得使人受不了。比喻人名声极坏。
explanationTraditional: 臭得使人受不了。比喻人名聲極壞。
explanationEn: So stinky that it's unbearable; metaphorically refers to a person with a very bad reputation.
derivation: 见臭不可当”
derivationTraditional: 見臭不可當”
derivationEn: See 'stinky unbearable'.
example: 呕出黑渖数斗，～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·酒狂》
exampleTraditional: 嘔出黑瀋數鬥，～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·酒狂》
exampleEn: He vomited several dou of black liquid, so stinky that it was unbearable. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio', 'Drunken Madness'

explanation: 快速彻底，不拖泥带水。
explanationTraditional: 快速徹底，不拖泥帶水。
explanationEn: Clean and neat; quick and thorough, without dragging.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指男女相爱时立下的誓言，爱情要象山和海一样永恒不变。
explanationTraditional: 指男女相愛時立下的誓言，愛情要象山和海一樣永恆不變。
explanationEn: Oath of the sea and pledge of the mountain; refers to vows made by lovers that their love will be as eternal as the mountains and seas.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《南乡子·赠妓》别泪没些些，海誓山盟总是赊。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《南鄉子·贈妓》別淚沒些些，海誓山盟總是賒。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Xin Qiji, 'Song of the Southern Countryside: To a Courtesan': 'Don't shed tears, the sea oath and mountain pledge are always empty.'
example: 非是我夸清正，只为他星前月下，亲曾设～。★元·石君宝《曲江池》第三折
exampleTraditional: 非是我誇清正，只為他星前月下，親曾設～。★元·石君寶《曲江池》第三折
exampleEn: It's not that I boast of purity, but because under the stars and moon, he once personally made a sea oath and mountain pledge. — Yuan Dynasty, Shi Junbao, 'Qujiang Pool', Act 3

explanation: 表示后悔过去的作为。
explanationTraditional: 表示後悔過去的作為。
explanationEn: Why did it have to be like this in the beginning? Expresses regret over past actions.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他因一念之差误入歧途，断送美好前程，如今后悔莫及，人皆谓其既知今日，～。
exampleTraditional: 他因一念之差誤入歧途，斷送美好前程，如今後悔莫及，人皆謂其既知今日，～。
exampleEn: Because of a momentary misstep, he went astray and ruined his bright future. Now he regrets it deeply, and people say, 'If you knew today, why did it have to be like this in the beginning?'

explanation: 虚假。装着对人热情，不是真心实意。
explanationTraditional: 虛假。裝著對人熱情，不是真心實意。
explanationEn: False feelings and fake intentions; pretending to be warm and sincere, but not genuine.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第三十回那妖精巧语花言，虚情假意的答道‘主公，微臣自幼儿好习弓马，采猎为生。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三十回那妖精巧語花言，虛情假意的答道‘主公，微臣自幼兒好習弓馬，採獵為生。’”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 30: 'The demon, with sweet words and false feelings, replied, 'My lord, since childhood I have been fond of archery and hunting.''
example: 在我是～，你听了一样的难过。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 在我是～，你聽了一樣的難過。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十一回
exampleEn: If I am false and insincere, you will feel just as sad when you hear it. — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Retribution', Chapter 31

explanation: 肝肠一寸寸断开。比喻伤心到极点。
explanationTraditional: 肝腸一寸寸斷開。比喻傷心到極點。
explanationEn: Liver and intestines broken into inches; describes extreme grief.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策三》吾要且死，子肠亦且寸绝。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策三》吾要且死，子腸亦且寸絕。”
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Yan': 'When I am about to die, your intestines will also be broken inch by inch.'
example: 一时想起碑中记中薄命之话，再看看书香、秀英诸人前车之鉴，不由不毛骨悚然，～。（清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十九回）
exampleTraditional: 一時想起碑中記中薄命之話，再看看書香、秀英諸人前車之鑑，不由不毛骨悚然，～。（清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十九回）
exampleEn: Suddenly recalling the words about ill-fated women in the stele inscription, and seeing the examples of Shuxiang and Xiuying, he couldn't help but shudder and feel his liver and intestines break into inches. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 99

explanation: 天下指全国。原指统一的国家，现多指某一地区或某一机构不贯彻上级意图而形成的独立王国。也泛指为少数人所霸占的某一领域。
explanationTraditional: 天下指全國。原指統一的國家，現多指某一地區或某一機構不貫徹上級意圖而形成的獨立王國。也泛指為少數人所霸佔的某一領域。
explanationEn: To unify the whole country; originally referred to a unified nation, now often refers to a region or organization that does not follow higher-level intentions, forming an independent kingdom, or a field monopolized by a few.
derivation: 《公羊传·成公十五年》王者欲一乎天下。”又，《隐公元年》何言乎王正月，大一统也。”
derivationTraditional: 《公羊傳·成公十五年》王者欲一乎天下。”又，《隱公元年》何言乎王正月，大一統也。”
derivationEn: 'Gongyang Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals: Duke Cheng's 15th Year': 'The king desires to unify the world.' Also, 'Duke Yin's 1st Year': 'Why speak of the king's first month? It is the great unification.'
example: 汉朝自高祖斩白蛇而起义，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一回
exampleTraditional: 漢朝自高祖斬白蛇而起義，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一回
exampleEn: The Han dynasty, since Emperor Gaozu killed the white snake and started the uprising, unified the whole country. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 1

explanation: 声说话的声音；色脸上的表情。心里的打算不在说话和脸色上显露出来。
explanationTraditional: 聲說話的聲音；色臉上的表情。心裡的打算不在說話和臉色上顯露出來。
explanationEn: Not revealing one's voice or expression; one's inner thoughts are not shown in speech or facial expression.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·唐玄宗开元二十四年》好以甘言啗人，而阴中伤之，不露辞色。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·唐玄宗開元二十四年》好以甘言啗人，而陰中傷之，不露辭色。”
derivationEn: 'Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government: Tang Xuanzong Kaiyuan 24th Year': 'He was good at sweet-talking people while secretly slandering them, without revealing his words or expressions.'
example: 你看它，埋没地下，～，生命的每一秒种都在为完成自己的使命而苦斗。★曹石《根的情操》
exampleTraditional: 你看它，埋沒地下，～，生命的每一秒種都在為完成自己的使命而苦鬥。★曹石《根的情操》
exampleEn: Look at it, buried underground, not revealing its voice or expression, every second of life is struggling to fulfill its mission. — Cao Shi, 'The Sentiment of Roots'

explanation: 分外格外；妖娆妖媚艳丽。形容景色异常艳丽。
explanationTraditional: 分外格外；妖嬈妖媚豔麗。形容景色異常豔麗。
explanationEn: Extremely enchanting and beautiful, describing scenery that is exceptionally gorgeous.
derivation: 毛泽东《沁园春·雪》词须晴日，看红妆素裹，分外妖娆。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《沁園春·雪》詞須晴日，看紅妝素裹，分外妖嬈。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's poem 'Qinyuanchun·Snow': 'On a fine day, the red and white attire is exceptionally enchanting.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 删除去；就趋向。去掉繁杂部分，使它趋于简明。
explanationTraditional: 刪除去；就趨向。去掉繁雜部分，使它趨於簡明。
explanationEn: To simplify by removing unnecessary parts; to make something concise.
derivation: 《尚书·纬》删夷繁乱。”宋·严羽《历代诗话·诗法家数》绝句之法，要婉曲回环，删芜就简。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·緯》刪夷繁亂。”宋·嚴羽《歷代詩話·詩法家數》絕句之法，要婉曲迴環，刪蕪就簡。”
derivationEn: From 'Shangshu·Wei': 'Remove the complex and chaotic.' Also from Song Dynasty Yan Yu's 'Canglang Poetry Talks': 'The method of quatrains is to be winding and circuitous, removing the redundant to achieve simplicity.'
example: ～三秋树，领异标新二月花。（清·郑燮《楹联》）
exampleTraditional: ～三秋樹，領異標新二月花。（清·鄭燮《楹聯》）
exampleEn: Simplify the complex to create three autumn trees, lead with novelty and mark with February flowers. (From Qing Dynasty Zheng Xie's couplet)

explanation: 擂打鼓。自己吹喇叭，自己打鼓。比喻自我吹嘘。
explanationTraditional: 擂打鼓。自己吹喇叭，自己打鼓。比喻自我吹噓。
explanationEn: To blow one's own trumpet; to boast about oneself.
derivation: 茅盾《联系实际，学习鲁迅》就这样，清朝统治集团所自吹自擂的‘中兴大业’，转眼间已成一场春梦。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《聯繫實際，學習魯迅》就這樣，清朝統治集團所自吹自擂的‘中興大業’，轉眼間已成一場春夢。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'Connect with Reality, Learn from Lu Xun': 'Thus, the 'great revival' that the Qing ruling clique boasted about turned into a spring dream in an instant.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 打与某些动词结合成为一个词，表示进行的意思；冷宫古代皇帝把失宠的后妃软禁于冷僻宫内。比喻人不被重视或把事情搁置一边。
explanationTraditional: 打與某些動詞結合成為一個詞，表示進行的意思；冷宮古代皇帝把失寵的后妃軟禁於冷僻宮內。比喻人不被重視或把事情擱置一邊。
explanationEn: To be relegated to a cold palace; metaphorically, to be ignored or shelved.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 她已经被打入冷宫。
exampleTraditional: 她已經被打入冷宮。
exampleEn: She has been relegated to the cold palace.

explanation: 转眼一眨眼。一眨眼的时间。形容极短的时间。
explanationTraditional: 轉眼一眨眼。一眨眼的時間。形容極短的時間。
explanationEn: In the blink of an eye; a very short time.
derivation: 明·胡文焕《群音类选·葛衣记·荐之知信》无端平地起波涛，转眼之间忘久要。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡文煥《群音類選·葛衣記·薦之知信》無端平地起波濤，轉眼之間忘久要。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Hu Wenhuan's 'Qun Yin Lei Xuan': 'Suddenly waves arise on flat ground, and in the blink of an eye, long-time friendship is forgotten.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 涣散散漫，松懈。思想不统一。形容人心不齐。
explanationTraditional: 渙散散漫，鬆懈。思想不統一。形容人心不齊。
explanationEn: Lack of unity; disunity among people.
derivation: 清·毕沅《续资治通鉴·元纪·顺帝至正二十四》由是法度不行，人心涣散，遂至天下骚动。”
derivationTraditional: 清·畢沅《續資治通鑑·元紀·順帝至正二十四》由是法度不行，人心渙散，遂至天下騷動。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Bi Yuan's 'Continuation of Zizhi Tongjian': 'Thus the laws were not enforced, people's hearts were scattered, and the world fell into turmoil.'
example: 越国～，能否自立，尚未可知。★《清史稿·越南传》
exampleTraditional: 越國～，能否自立，尚未可知。★《清史稿·越南傳》
exampleEn: With the people of Yue disunited, whether they can stand on their own is unknown. (From 'Qing History Manuscript·Vietnam Biography')

explanation: 象胶和漆那样黏结。形容感情炽烈，难舍难分。多指夫妻恩爱。
explanationTraditional: 象膠和漆那樣黏結。形容感情熾烈，難捨難分。多指夫妻恩愛。
explanationEn: Sticky as glue and lacquer; describing deep affection and inseparable relationship, often between lovers.
derivation: 《史记·鲁仲连邹阳列传》感于心，合于行，亲于胶漆，昆弟不能离，岂惑于众口哉。”《古诗十九首·孟冬寒气至》以胶投漆中，谁能别离此。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魯仲連鄒陽列傳》感於心，合於行，親於膠漆，昆弟不能離，豈惑於眾口哉。”《古詩十九首·孟冬寒氣至》以膠投漆中，誰能別離此。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'Moved in heart, united in action, close as glue and lacquer, not even brothers can separate them.' Also from 'Nineteen Ancient Poems': 'Throw glue into lacquer, who can separate them?'
example: 那张三和这婆惜，～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 那張三和這婆惜，～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第二十回
exampleEn: Zhang San and this woman were as inseparable as glue and lacquer. (From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 20)

explanation: 旧指宗教或学术上的各种流派。也指社会上各行各业的人。
explanationTraditional: 舊指宗教或學術上的各種流派。也指社會上各行各業的人。
explanationEn: Various religious and academic schools; also refers to people from all walks of life.
derivation: 宋·赵彦卫《云麓漫钞》卷六（梁武）帝问三教九流及汉朝旧事，了如目前。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·趙彥衛《雲麓漫鈔》卷六（梁武）帝問三教九流及漢朝舊事，瞭如目前。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhao Yanwei's 'Yunlu Manchao': 'Emperor Wu of Liang asked about the three religions and nine schools and the old affairs of Han, as if they were before his eyes.'
example: 他是个社会活动家，朋友遍及～。
exampleTraditional: 他是個社會活動家，朋友遍及～。
exampleEn: He is a social activist with friends from all walks of life.

explanation: 异不同。原指夫妇生活在一起，但感情不和。比喻同做一件事而心里各有各的打算。
explanationTraditional: 異不同。原指夫婦生活在一起，但感情不和。比喻同做一件事而心裡各有各的打算。
explanationEn: To share the same bed but have different dreams; metaphorically, to work together but with different intentions.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《与朱元晦秘书书》同床各做梦，周公且不能学得，何必一一说到孔明哉！”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《與朱元晦秘書書》同床各做夢，周公且不能學得，何必一一說到孔明哉！”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Chen Liang's 'Letter to Zhu Xi': 'Sharing the same bed but each dreaming different dreams, even the Duke of Zhou cannot learn from it, let alone Kong Ming.'
example: 但彼等乌合之众，～，一战即溃。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第一章
exampleTraditional: 但彼等烏合之眾，～，一戰即潰。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第一章
exampleEn: But they are a motley crowd with different dreams, and will be defeated at the first encounter. (From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 1)

explanation: 旖旎柔和美丽。柔和而美丽的韵致风采或自然风景。
explanationTraditional: 旖旎柔和美麗。柔和而美麗的韻致風采或自然風景。
explanationEn: Gentle and beautiful scenery or charm.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》一霎时局已到齐，真正是翠绕珠围，金迷纸醉，说不尽温柔景象，旖旎风光。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》一霎時局已到齊，真正是翠繞珠圍，金迷紙醉，說不盡溫柔景象，旖旎風光。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats': 'In an instant, the scene was full of emerald coils and pearl circles, gold and paper intoxication, indescribable gentle scenery and charming sights.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 龇露齿。张着嘴巴，露出牙齿。形容凶狠或疼痛难忍的样子。
explanationTraditional: 齜露齒。張著嘴巴，露出牙齒。形容兇狠或疼痛難忍的樣子。
explanationEn: To show one's teeth and grin; describes a fierce expression or the look of extreme pain.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第五回即咨牙咧嘴道‘不好吃！不好吃！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第五回即諮牙咧嘴道‘不好吃！不好吃！’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 5: 'He grinned and said, 'Not tasty! Not tasty!''
example: ?糜两岸上的狗，吃死尸都吃红了眼，见了生人就～。★峻青《秋色赋·故乡杂忆》
exampleTraditional: ?糜兩岸上的狗，吃死屍都吃紅了眼，見了生人就～。★峻青《秋色賦·故鄉雜憶》
exampleEn: The dogs on both sides of the river, having eaten dead bodies until their eyes were red, would bare their teeth and snarl at strangers. — Jun Qing, 'Autumn Colors: Hometown Memories'

explanation: 认识凝，不明事理。也形容思想处于凝不清的状态。
explanationTraditional: 認識凝，不明事理。也形容思想處於凝不清的狀態。
explanationEn: Confused, muddled, or unclear in understanding; describes a state of mental confusion.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 糊里糊涂是办不好事的。
exampleTraditional: 糊里糊塗是辦不好事的。
exampleEn: Being muddle-headed is not good for getting things done.

explanation: 把鸡吓得飞起来，把狗吓得到处乱跳。形容惊慌得乱成一团。
explanationTraditional: 把雞嚇得飛起來，把狗嚇得到處亂跳。形容驚慌得亂成一團。
explanationEn: Chickens flying and dogs jumping; describes a state of panic and chaos.
derivation: 茅盾《锻炼》然而陈克明却在这里想象，一方面疑神疑鬼，又一方面畏惧怨恨所造成的鸡飞狗跳、人人自危的情形。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《鍛鍊》然而陳克明卻在這裡想象，一方面疑神疑鬼，又一方面畏懼怨恨所造成的雞飛狗跳、人人自危的情形。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'Exercise': 'But Chen Keming imagined here, on one hand suspicious and fearful, on the other hand resentful, causing a scene of chickens flying and dogs jumping, everyone in fear.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 早上出发晚上就能到达。形容路程不远或交通方便。
explanationTraditional: 早上出發晚上就能到達。形容路程不遠或交通方便。
explanationEn: To depart in the morning and arrive in the evening; describes a short distance or convenient transportation.
derivation: 北魏·郦道元《水经注·注水》或王命急宣，有时朝发白帝，暮到江陵。”唐·韩愈《祭鳄鱼文》以生以食，鳄鱼朝发而夕至也。”
derivationTraditional: 北魏·酈道元《水經注·注水》或王命急宣，有時朝發白帝，暮到江陵。”唐·韓愈《祭鱷魚文》以生以食，鱷魚朝發而夕至也。”
derivationEn: From Northern Wei Dynasty Li Daoyuan's 'Commentary on the Water Classic': 'Sometimes an imperial order was urgently proclaimed, and one could depart from Baidi in the morning and arrive at Jiangling in the evening.' Also from Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Sacrificial Crocodile Text': 'To live and eat, the crocodile departs in the morning and arrives in the evening.'
example: 防边防海，转运枪炮，～。★高阳《清宫外史》上册
exampleTraditional: 防邊防海，轉運槍炮，～。★高陽《清宮外史》上冊
exampleEn: Defending the coast and borders, transporting guns and ammunition, they could depart in the morning and arrive in the evening. — Gao Yang, 'Inside Stories of the Qing Palace', Volume 1

explanation: 欢笑的声音象雷一样响着。形容热烈欢乎的动人场面。
explanationTraditional: 歡笑的聲音象雷一樣響著。形容熱烈歡乎的動人場面。
explanationEn: Cheers as loud as thunder; describes a scene of enthusiastic celebration.
derivation: 唐·令狐楚《贺敕表》欢声雷动，喜气云腾。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·令狐楚《賀敕表》歡聲雷動，喜氣雲騰。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Linghu Chu's 'Congratulations to the Emperor': 'Cheers resounded like thunder, joy filled the clouds.'
example: 这里众位也有坐轿的，也有走的，见两边百姓，扶老携幼，挨挤着来看，～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三十七回
exampleTraditional: 這裡眾位也有坐轎的，也有走的，見兩邊百姓，扶老攜幼，挨擠著來看，～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三十七回
exampleEn: Here, some were in sedan chairs, some were walking, and they saw the common people on both sides, supporting the elderly and leading the young, crowding to watch, with cheers like thunder. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 37

explanation: 浓厚的情意难以推辞。
explanationTraditional: 濃厚的情意難以推辭。
explanationEn: It is difficult to decline a generous offer or warm hospitality.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 朋友们再三要为我饯行，因～，我只好接受了。
exampleTraditional: 朋友們再三要為我餞行，因～，我只好接受了。
exampleEn: My friends repeatedly insisted on giving me a farewell dinner, and since their kindness was hard to refuse, I had to accept.

explanation: 世态人情世故；炎热，亲热；凉冷淡。指一些人在别人得势时百般奉承，别人失势时就十分冷淡。
explanationTraditional: 世態人情世故；炎熱，親熱；涼冷淡。指一些人在別人得勢時百般奉承，別人失勢時就十分冷淡。
explanationEn: The fickleness of the world; describes how people treat others warmly when they are powerful and coldly when they are not.
derivation: 元·无名氏《冻苏秦》第四折”也索把世态炎凉，心中暗忖。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《凍蘇秦》第四折”也索把世態炎涼，心中暗忖。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Freezing Su Qin', Act 4: 'One must also consider the fickleness of the world in one's heart.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 色脸色。原指被老虎咬过的人才真正知道虎的厉害◇比喻一提到自己害怕的事就情绪紧张起来。
explanationTraditional: 色臉色。原指被老虎咬過的人才真正知道虎的厲害◇比喻一提到自己害怕的事就情緒緊張起來。
explanationEn: To turn pale at the mention of a tiger; describes a person who becomes nervous at the mere mention of something they fear.
derivation: 《二程全书·遗书二上》真知与常知异。尝见一田夫曾被虎伤，有人说虎伤人，众莫不惊，独田夫色动异于众。”
derivationTraditional: 《二程全書·遺書二上》真知與常知異。嘗見一田夫曾被虎傷，有人說虎傷人，眾莫不驚，獨田夫色動異於眾。”
derivationEn: From 'The Complete Works of the Cheng Brothers', Book 2, Part 1: 'True knowledge differs from ordinary knowledge. Once a farmer was injured by a tiger. When others talked about tigers hurting people, everyone was afraid, but the farmer's expression changed more than others.'
example: 有光生长穷乡，～，安能默然而已。★明·归有光《论三区赋役水利书》
exampleTraditional: 有光生長窮鄉，～，安能默然而已。★明·歸有光《論三區賦役水利書》
exampleEn: Having grown up in a poor village, I turn pale at the mention of tigers; how can I remain silent? — Ming Dynasty Gui Youguang, 'On the Tax and Water Conservancy of Three Districts'

explanation: 德恩惠。怨仇恨。不记别人的仇，反而给他好处。
explanationTraditional: 德恩惠。怨仇恨。不記別人的仇，反而給他好處。
explanationEn: To repay resentment with kindness; to return good for evil.
derivation: 《论语·宪问》或曰‘以德报怨何如？’子曰‘何以报德？以直报怨，以德报德。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·憲問》或曰‘以德報怨何如？’子曰‘何以報德？以直報怨，以德報德。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius', Chapter Xianwen: 'Someone asked, 'What do you think of repaying resentment with kindness?' Confucius replied, 'Then how would you repay kindness? Repay resentment with justice, and repay kindness with kindness.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指对罪犯加重处罚。
explanationTraditional: 指對罪犯加重處罰。
explanationEn: To increase the severity of a punishment; to impose a heavier penalty on a criminal.
derivation: 清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第五回你为着吃烟，这才犯法，我们来拿你，倒来吃你的烟，本官知道，办起来罪加一等。”
derivationTraditional: 清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第五回你為著吃煙，這才犯法，我們來拿你，倒來吃你的煙，本官知道，辦起來罪加一等。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Peng Yang'ou's 'The Opium Addict's Ghost', Chapter 5: 'You broke the law by smoking opium, and we came to arrest you, but instead we smoked your opium. If the magistrate finds out, he will punish you with an additional degree of guilt.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 注灌入。形容寸下得很大，雨水象往下灌似的。
explanationTraditional: 注灌入。形容寸下得很大，雨水象往下灌似的。
explanationEn: Describes heavy rain, as if water is being poured down.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言·俞伯牙摔琴谢知音》偶然风狂浪涌，大雨如注，舟楫不能前进，泊于山崖之下。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言·俞伯牙摔琴謝知音》偶然風狂浪湧，大雨如注，舟楫不能前進，泊于山崖之下。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World': 'Suddenly the wind was fierce and the waves surged, rain poured down like a torrent, and the boat could not advance, so it anchored under the cliff.'
example: 又三日，率众诅龙潭，以激神怒，～。★明·朱国桢《涌幢小品·山子道气》
exampleTraditional: 又三日，率眾詛龍潭，以激神怒，～。★明·朱國楨《湧幢小品·山子道氣》
exampleEn: After three days, they led the crowd to curse the dragon pool to provoke the god's anger, and the rain poured down like a torrent. — Zhu Guozhen, 'Yongchuang Xiaopin'

explanation: 庞然高大的样子。指高大笨重的东西。现也用来形容表面上很强大但实际上很虚弱的事物。
explanationTraditional: 龐然高大的樣子。指高大笨重的東西。現也用來形容表面上很強大但實際上很虛弱的事物。
explanationEn: Refers to a huge and bulky object; also used to describe something that appears powerful but is actually weak.
derivation: 唐·柳宗元《黔之驴》虎见之，庞然大物也，以为神，蔽林间窥之。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·柳宗元《黔之驢》虎見之，龐然大物也，以為神，蔽林間窺之。”
derivationEn: From Liu Zongyuan's 'The Donkey of Guizhou': 'The tiger saw it, a huge thing, thought it was divine, and hid in the forest to spy on it.'
example: 这家伙看上去像个～，其实一点能耐也没有。
exampleTraditional: 這傢伙看上去像個～，其實一點能耐也沒有。
exampleEn: This guy looks like a huge thing, but actually has no ability at all.

explanation: 乔迁鸟儿飞离深谷，迁到高大的树木上去∝人迁居或贺人官职升迁之辞。
explanationTraditional: 喬遷鳥兒飛離深谷，遷到高大的樹木上去∝人遷居或賀人官職升遷之辭。
explanationEn: Congratulations on moving to a new home or getting a promotion.
derivation: 《诗·小雅·伐木》伐木丁丁，鸟鸣嘤嘤，出自幽谷，迁于乔木。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·小雅·伐木》伐木丁丁，鳥鳴嚶嚶，出自幽谷，遷於喬木。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Felling Trees': 'Felling trees goes ding-ding, birds sing ying-ying, they leave the deep valley and move to the tall trees.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻无缘无故地遭受祸害。
explanationTraditional: 比喻無緣無故地遭受禍害。
explanationEn: Metaphor for suffering disaster without cause.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·必己》宋桓司马有宝珠，抵罪出亡，王使人问珠之所在，曰‘投之池中。’于是竭池而求之，无得，鱼死焉。此言祸福之相及也。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·必己》宋桓司馬有寶珠，抵罪出亡，王使人問珠之所在，曰‘投之池中。’於是竭池而求之，無得，魚死焉。此言禍福之相及也。”
derivationEn: From 'Master Lü's Spring and Autumn Annals': 'Sima Huan of Song had a precious pearl, and when he was guilty and fled, the king sent someone to ask where the pearl was, and he said, 'Thrown into the pond.' So they drained the pond to find it, but got nothing, and the fish died. This speaks of the mutual relation of disaster and fortune.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻容易引起嫌疑的场合。
explanationTraditional: 比喻容易引起嫌疑的場合。
explanationEn: Metaphor for situations that easily arouse suspicion.
derivation: 《北史·袁翻传》瓜田李下，古人所慎。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·袁翻傳》瓜田李下，古人所慎。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties, Biography of Yuan Fan': 'In a melon field or under a plum tree, the ancients were cautious.'
example: 但～，嫌疑难辩，万一已拘者畏法混供，也甚怕堂讯之下，玉石不分。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第五十一回
exampleTraditional: 但～，嫌疑難辯，萬一已拘者畏法混供，也甚怕堂訊之下，玉石不分。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第五十一回
exampleEn: But in a melon field or under a plum tree, suspicion is hard to avoid; if the arrested person falsely confesses out of fear, it may be hard to distinguish truth from falsehood in court. — Li Lüyuan, 'Qixingdeng' Chapter 51

explanation: 论按照。按功劳的大小给于奖赏。
explanationTraditional: 論按照。按功勞的大小給於獎賞。
explanationEn: To reward according to merit.
derivation: 《韩非子·八说》计功而行赏，程能而授事。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·八說》計功而行賞，程能而授事。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi, Eight Arguments': 'Reward according to merit, assign tasks according to ability.'
example: 这春彩，臣等断不敢受。请留待他时～。★清·洪昻《长生殿·献饭》
exampleTraditional: 這春彩，臣等斷不敢受。請留待他時～。★清·洪昻《長生殿·獻飯》
exampleEn: We dare not accept these spring rewards. Please keep them for future rewards according to merit. — Hong Sheng, 'Palace of Eternal Life, Offering Food'

explanation: 原指古凉州治内贺兰山一带◇泛指塞外富庶之地。同塞北江南”。
explanationTraditional: 原指古涼州治內賀蘭山一帶◇泛指塞外富庶之地。同塞北江南”。
explanationEn: Originally referred to the Helan Mountain area in ancient Liangzhou; now generally refers to fertile lands beyond the Great Wall. Same as 'Sai Bei Jiang Nan'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把剑柄交给别人。比喻将权力交给别人或让人抓住缺点、失误，使自己被动。
explanationTraditional: 把劍柄交給別人。比喻將權力交給別人或讓人抓住缺點、失誤，使自己被動。
explanationEn: To hand the sword handle to others; metaphor for giving power to others or letting them grasp one's weaknesses, leading to passivity.
derivation: 汉书·梅福传》倒持泰阿，授楚其柄。”
derivationTraditional: 漢書·梅福傳》倒持泰阿，授楚其柄。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han, Biography of Mei Fu': 'Holding the Ta'a sword upside down, handing the handle to Chu.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指不正派，也指不象样子。
explanationTraditional: 指不正派，也指不象樣子。
explanationEn: Refers to improper or indecent behavior; also means not up to standard.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第七回这伙人不三不四，又不肯近前来，莫不要攧洒家。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第七回這夥人不三不四，又不肯近前來，莫不要攧灑家。”
derivationEn: From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 7: 'These people are neither three nor four, and they won't come closer; they must be up to no good.'
example: 也该撒泡尿自己照照！～，就想天鹅屁吃！★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleTraditional: 也該撒泡尿自己照照！～，就想天鵝屁吃！★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleEn: You should take a piss and look at yourself! Neither three nor four, and you want to eat swan meat! — Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars' Chapter 3

explanation: 乘人家危难的时候去威胁损害。
explanationTraditional: 乘人家危難的時候去威脅損害。
explanationEn: To take advantage of someone's difficulties to threaten or harm them.
derivation: 《后汉书·盖勋传》谋事杀良，非忠也；乘人之危，非仁也。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·蓋勳傳》謀事殺良，非忠也；乘人之危，非仁也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han, Biography of Gai Xun': 'Plotting to kill a good man is not loyal; taking advantage of someone's danger is not benevolent.'
example: 那种～，大发横财的人，是缺德的人。
exampleTraditional: 那種～，大發橫財的人，是缺德的人。
exampleEn: Those who take advantage of others' danger to make huge profits are immoral people.

explanation: 效仿效；颦皱眉头。比喻胡乱模仿，效果极坏。
explanationTraditional: 效仿效；顰皺眉頭。比喻胡亂模仿，效果極壞。
explanationEn: Blind imitation with ludicrous effect.
derivation: 《庄子·天运》故西施病心而矉其里，其里之丑人见而美之，归亦捧心而矉其里。其里之富人见之，坚闭门而不出；贫人见之，絜妻子而去之走。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天運》故西施病心而矉其裡，其裡之醜人見而美之，歸亦捧心而矉其裡。其裡之富人見之，堅閉門而不出；貧人見之，絜妻子而去之走。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: The beautiful Xi Shi frowned due to heartache; an ugly woman in her village saw her and thought it was beautiful, so she also clutched her chest and frowned. The rich saw her and shut their doors; the poor saw her and fled with their families.
example: 若真也葬花，可谓～”了，不但不为新奇，而且更是可厌。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十回
exampleTraditional: 若真也葬花，可謂～”了，不但不為新奇，而且更是可厭。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十回
exampleEn: If she really is burying flowers, it would be like 'Dong Shi imitating Xi Shi's frown'—not novel at all, but rather detestable. (from Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 30)

explanation: 指吃现成饭。形容不劳而获，坐享其成。
explanationTraditional: 指吃現成飯。形容不勞而獲，坐享其成。
explanationEn: To have everything provided for one; to enjoy the fruits of others' labor without lifting a finger.
derivation: 《金瓶梅词话》第七六回那婆子道‘我的奶奶，你饭来张口，水来湿手，这等插金带银，呼奴使婢，又惹什么气？’”
derivationTraditional: 《金瓶梅詞話》第七六回那婆子道‘我的奶奶，你飯來張口，水來溼手，這等插金帶銀，呼奴使婢，又惹什麼氣？’”
derivationEn: From Jin Ping Mei: 'My lady, you have food put in your mouth, water to wet your hands, wear gold and silver, order servants around—what anger is there to provoke?'
example: 朱延年一辈子娇生惯养，做惯了大老板，～，衣来伸手，吃的好，穿得美，哪里吃过这样的苦头？★周而复《上海的早晨》第三部二十
exampleTraditional: 朱延年一輩子嬌生慣養，做慣了大老闆，～，衣來伸手，吃的好，穿得美，哪裡吃過這樣的苦頭？★周而復《上海的早晨》第三部二十
exampleEn: Zhu Yannian, pampered all his life, used to being a big boss, with food put in his mouth and clothes handed to him, eating well and dressing finely—how could he endure such hardship? (from Zhou Erfu, Morning in Shanghai, Part 3, Chapter 20)

explanation: 起开头；承承接上文加以申述；转转折；合结束。泛指文章的做法。也比喻固定呆板的形式。
explanationTraditional: 起開頭；承承接上文加以申述；轉轉折；合結束。泛指文章的做法。也比喻固定呆板的形式。
explanationEn: The four steps of composing an essay: introduction, elucidation, transition, and conclusion. Also refers to a rigid, formulaic structure.
derivation: 清·金圣叹《西厢记读法》有此许多起承转合，便令题目透出文字。”
derivationTraditional: 清·金聖嘆《西廂記讀法》有此許多起承轉合，便令題目透出文字。”
derivationEn: From Jin Shengtan's commentary on The Western Chamber: 'With so many transitions and conclusions, the topic is revealed through the text.'
example: 然而不得已，也只好～，上台去说几句。★鲁迅《而已集·通信》
exampleTraditional: 然而不得已，也只好～，上臺去說幾句。★魯迅《而已集·通信》
exampleEn: But reluctantly, I had to follow the formula—introduction, elucidation, transition, conclusion—and go on stage to say a few words. (from Lu Xun, 'Communication' in And That's That)

explanation: 亡失去，死亡；息废，灭。旧指一个掌握政权的人死了，他的政治措施也跟着停顿下来。
explanationTraditional: 亡失去，死亡；息廢，滅。舊指一個掌握政權的人死了，他的政治措施也跟著停頓下來。
explanationEn: When a leader dies, his policies also cease.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》文武之政，布在方策。其人存，则其政举；其人亡，则其政息。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》文武之政，布在方策。其人存，則其政舉；其人亡，則其政息。”
derivationEn: From The Doctrine of the Mean: 'The policies of Kings Wen and Wu are recorded in documents. When the right men are alive, their policies are implemented; when they die, their policies cease.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 小家子旧指出身低微的人。形容人的言谈举止及做事不大方。
explanationTraditional: 小家子舊指出身低微的人。形容人的言談舉止及做事不大方。
explanationEn: Petty; small-minded; lacking in generosity or grace.
derivation: 《汉书·霍光传》使乐成小家子得幸将军同，至九卿封侯。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·霍光傳》使樂成小家子得幸將軍同，至九卿封侯。”
derivationEn: From Book of Han: 'Shi Lecheng, a man of humble birth, gained favor with the general and rose to high rank.'
example: 若题目过于新巧，韵过于险，再不得好诗，倒～。（清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十七回）
exampleTraditional: 若題目過於新巧，韻過於險，再不得好詩，倒～。（清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十七回）
