exampleEn: If the topic is too novel and the rhyme too risky, you won't write good poems; instead, you'll appear petty. (from Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 37)

explanation: 妖怪和魔鬼。比喻各种桅人民利益的邪恶势力。
explanationTraditional: 妖怪和魔鬼。比喻各種桅人民利益的邪惡勢力。
explanationEn: Monsters and demons; evil forces that harm the people.
derivation: 元·李好古《张生煮海》第一折我家东人好傻也，安知他不是个妖魔鬼怪，便信着他跟将去了。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李好古《張生煮海》第一折我家東人好傻也，安知他不是個妖魔鬼怪，便信著他跟將去了。”
derivationEn: From Yuan drama: 'My master is foolish—how does he know it's not a demon or monster, and he follows it?'
example: 师父，我不是～，亦不是魍魉鬼怪了？★明·吴承恩《西游记》第三十七回
exampleTraditional: 師父，我不是～，亦不是魍魎鬼怪了？★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三十七回
exampleEn: Master, I am not a demon or monster, nor a ghost or goblin! (from Journey to the West, Chapter 37)

explanation: 重洋辽阔无边的海洋。远远地渡过海洋。
explanationTraditional: 重洋遼闊無邊的海洋。遠遠地渡過海洋。
explanationEn: To travel across vast oceans; to go on a long overseas journey.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他早年远涉重洋，历尽艰辛才创下这番基业。
exampleTraditional: 他早年遠涉重洋，歷盡艱辛才創下這番基業。
exampleEn: In his early years, he traveled across the oceans and endured many hardships to build this enterprise.

explanation: 适适应；履鞋。因为鞋小脚大，就把脚削去一块来凑和鞋的大小。比喻不合理的牵就凑合或不顾具体条件，生搬硬套。
explanationTraditional: 適適應；履鞋。因為鞋小腳大，就把腳削去一塊來湊和鞋的大小。比喻不合理的牽就湊合或不顧具體條件，生搬硬套。
explanationEn: To cut the feet to fit the shoes; to force something to fit a rigid pattern regardless of suitability.
derivation: 《淮南子·说林训》夫所以养而害所养，譬犹削足而适履，杀头而便冠。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·說林訓》夫所以養而害所養，譬猶削足而適履，殺頭而便冠。”
derivationEn: From Huainanzi: 'To harm what sustains life for the sake of what is sustained is like cutting the feet to fit the shoes, or trimming the head to fit the hat.'
example: 是借用，就难免有～”和挂一漏万”的毛病了。★闻一多《四杰》
exampleTraditional: 是借用，就難免有～”和掛一漏萬”的毛病了。★聞一多《四傑》
exampleEn: When borrowing, it's inevitable to have the flaw of 'cutting the feet to fit the shoes' or 'missing one out of ten thousand.' (from Wen Yiduo, 'The Four Masters')

explanation: 指形势发展很快，迫使人不得不更加努力。
explanationTraditional: 指形勢發展很快，迫使人不得不更加努力。
explanationEn: The situation is pressing; circumstances compel one to work harder.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 可以逼得喜冷的人也热起来，～，不热不可。（谢觉哉《冷和热》）
exampleTraditional: 可以逼得喜冷的人也熱起來，～，不熱不可。（謝覺哉《冷和熱》）
exampleEn: It can force even those who prefer cold to feel hot—the situation is compelling, and one cannot help but be hot. (from Xie Juezai, 'Cold and Hot')

explanation: 经历许多次战役，都没有遭到危险。形容善于用兵。
explanationTraditional: 經歷許多次戰役，都沒有遭到危險。形容善於用兵。
explanationEn: To be invincible in a hundred battles; to be ever-victorious.
derivation: 《孙子·谋攻》知彼知己者百战不殆。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·謀攻》知彼知己者百戰不殆。”
derivationEn: From Sun Tzu: 'Know the enemy and know yourself, and you can fight a hundred battles without disaster.'
example: 自古名将料敌制胜，训练士兵，故可使赴汤蹈火，～。★《金史·刘炳传》
exampleTraditional: 自古名將料敵制勝，訓練士兵，故可使赴湯蹈火，～。★《金史·劉炳傳》
exampleEn: Since ancient times, famous generals who assess the enemy and train their soldiers can make them go through fire and water and be invincible in a hundred battles. (from History of Jin, Biography of Liu Bing)

explanation: 保持一致，行动起来像一个人。形容关系极为亲密。
explanationTraditional: 保持一致，行動起來像一個人。形容關係極為親密。
explanationEn: To stick together and act as one, describing a very close relationship.
derivation: 程树榛《大学时代》刘向明和另外两人，抱成一团，异想天开地搞什么科学研究，在同学中造成很坏的影响。”
derivationTraditional: 程樹榛《大學時代》劉向明和另外兩人，抱成一團，異想天開地搞什麼科學研究，在同學中造成很壞的影響。”
derivationEn: From Cheng Shuzhen's 'University Times': Liu Xiangming and two others stuck together and whimsically engaged in scientific research, causing a bad influence among classmates.
example: 他们相互～，结党营私。
exampleTraditional: 他們相互～，結黨營私。
exampleEn: They stick together to form cliques for selfish interests.

explanation: 指名利地位。
explanationTraditional: 指名利地位。
explanationEn: Refers to fame, fortune, and official position.
derivation: 郭沫若《南冠草》第一幕只因功名利禄得不到保障，所以他们便想到要和流寇苟合，铤而走险。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《南冠草》第一幕只因功名利祿得不到保障，所以他們便想到要和流寇苟合，鋌而走險。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'Southern Crown Herb', Act 1: Because fame and fortune are not guaranteed, they think of colluding with rebels and taking risks.
example: 牛启东素不喜章句之学，认为那是腐儒伪装道学的幌子，驵侩谋求～的阶梯，无关乎国计民生。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十九章
exampleTraditional: 牛啟東素不喜章句之學，認為那是腐儒偽裝道學的幌子，駔儈謀求～的階梯，無關乎國計民生。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十九章
exampleEn: Niu Qidong never liked the study of classics, considering it a facade for hypocritical Confucians and a stepping stone for merchants seeking fame and fortune, irrelevant to national welfare. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Vol. 1, Ch. 19

explanation: 良好；辰时日；吉吉利。美好的时辰，吉利的日子◇常用以称宜于成亲的日子。
explanationTraditional: 良好；辰時日；吉吉利。美好的時辰，吉利的日子◇常用以稱宜於成親的日子。
explanationEn: A good time and an auspicious day, often used for weddings.
derivation: 战国·楚·屈原《九歌·东皇太一》 吉日兮辰良，穆将愉兮上皇。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·屈原《九歌·東皇太一》 吉日兮辰良，穆將愉兮上皇。”
derivationEn: From Qu Yuan's 'Nine Songs: The Great Unity, Lord of the East': On an auspicious day with a good hour, reverently we honor the Supreme.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 堪可，能；入耳听。指说的话使人听不进去（多指脏话）。
explanationTraditional: 堪可，能；入耳聽。指說的話使人聽不進去（多指髒話）。
explanationEn: Unbearable to the ear, referring to offensive or vulgar speech.
derivation: 明·李开先《市井艳词序》二词哗于市井，虽儿女子初学言者，亦知歌之，但淫艳亵狎，不堪入耳。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李開先《市井豔詞序》二詞譁於市井，雖兒女子初學言者，亦知歌之，但淫豔褻狎，不堪入耳。”
derivationEn: From Li Kaixian's 'Preface to Market Love Songs': These songs are noisy in the market, even children learning to speak can sing them, but they are lewd and vulgar, unbearable to the ear.
example: 姚老夫子见他们所说的都是一派污秽之言，～。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 姚老夫子見他們所說的都是一派汙穢之言，～。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第十六回
exampleEn: Old Master Yao saw that what they said was all filthy talk, unbearable to the ear. — Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Ch. 16

explanation: 该赏的赏，该罚的罚，绝不含糊。
explanationTraditional: 該賞的賞，該罰的罰，絕不含糊。
explanationEn: To reward and punish clearly without ambiguity.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 为人主管者必须公正无私，～，才能树立良好的纪律，使众人信服。
exampleTraditional: 為人主管者必須公正無私，～，才能樹立良好的紀律，使眾人信服。
exampleEn: A manager must be fair and impartial, with clear rewards and punishments, to establish good discipline and win the trust of others.

explanation: 批判地吸收外国文化中一切有益的东西，为我所用。
explanationTraditional: 批判地吸收外國文化中一切有益的東西，為我所用。
explanationEn: To critically absorb beneficial elements from foreign cultures for our own use.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: ～和古为今用要有机地结合。
exampleTraditional: ～和古為今用要有機地結合。
exampleEn: Making foreign things serve China and making the past serve the present should be organically combined.

explanation: 附庸依傍，追随；风雅泛指诗歌。指缺乏文化修养的人为了装点门面而结交文人，参加有关文化活动。
explanationTraditional: 附庸依傍，追隨；風雅泛指詩歌。指缺乏文化修養的人為了裝點門面而結交文人，參加有關文化活動。
explanationEn: To associate with literati or engage in cultural activities to pretend to be cultured.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十二回喜欢便宜，暗中上当，附庸风雅，忙里偷闲。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十二回喜歡便宜，暗中上當，附庸風雅，忙裡偷閒。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats Revealed', Ch. 42: Likes bargains, secretly falls into traps, pretends to be cultured, steals time for leisure.
example: 却偏要～，在扬州盖造了不少的花园，因此种花之风，遍及扬州。★清·吴趼人《情变》第八回
exampleTraditional: 卻偏要～，在揚州蓋造了不少的花園，因此種花之風，遍及揚州。★清·吳趼人《情變》第八回
exampleEn: But he insisted on pretending to be cultured, building many gardens in Yangzhou, thus the trend of gardening spread throughout Yangzhou. — Wu Jianren's 'The Change of Sentiment', Ch. 8

explanation: 国家正面临着巨大的灾难。
explanationTraditional: 國家正面臨著巨大的災難。
explanationEn: The nation is facing a great disaster.
derivation: 鲁迅《答徐懋庸并关于抗日统一战线问题》在国难当头的现在，白天里讲些冠冕堂皇的话……不就正是这些人吗。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《答徐懋庸並關於抗日統一戰線問題》在國難當頭的現在，白天裡講些冠冕堂皇的話……不就正是這些人嗎。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Reply to Xu Maoyong on the United Front Against Japan': At a time of national crisis, those who speak high-sounding words in the daytime... aren't they exactly these people?
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 眼泪象泉水一样直往外涌。形容悲痛或害怕之极。
explanationTraditional: 眼淚象泉水一樣直往外湧。形容悲痛或害怕之極。
explanationEn: Tears gush out like a spring, describing extreme grief or fear.
derivation: 唐·刘损《愤惋诗三首（其三）》莫道诗成无泪下，泪如泉滴亦须干。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉損《憤惋詩三首（其三）》莫道詩成無淚下，淚如泉滴亦須幹。”
derivationEn: From Liu Sun's 'Three Poems of Grief and Resentment (No. 3)': Don't say that writing poems brings no tears, tears flow like a spring and must dry up.
example: 允曰汝可怜汉天下生灵！”言讫，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八回
exampleTraditional: 允曰汝可憐漢天下生靈！”言訖，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八回
exampleEn: Wang Yun said, 'Do you pity the people of the Han Empire?' With that, tears gushed like a spring. — Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Ch. 8

explanation: 孟轲的母亲为选择良好的环境教育孩子，三次迁居。
explanationTraditional: 孟軻的母親為選擇良好的環境教育孩子，三次遷居。
explanationEn: Mencius' mother moved three times to provide a good environment for her son's education.
derivation: 汉·赵歧《孟子题词》孟子生有淑质，幼被慈母三迁之教。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·趙歧《孟子題詞》孟子生有淑質，幼被慈母三遷之教。”
derivationEn: From Zhao Qi's 'Preface to Mencius': Mencius was born with good nature, and as a child was taught by his mother's three moves.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 勃勃旺盛的样子。形容人或社会富有朝气，充满活力。
explanationTraditional: 勃勃旺盛的樣子。形容人或社會富有朝氣，充滿活力。
explanationEn: Full of vitality and energy; describing a person or society that is vibrant and dynamic.
derivation: 徐迟《特写选·序言》生活中最主要的仍然是那些向上的，生气勃勃、充满热情和活力的，带有极大想象的东西。”
derivationTraditional: 徐遲《特寫選·序言》生活中最主要的仍然是那些向上的，生氣勃勃、充滿熱情和活力的，帶有極大想象的東西。”
derivationEn: Xu Chi, 'Preface to Special Feature Selections': 'The most important things in life are still those that are upward, full of vitality, enthusiasm, and energy, with great imagination.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 扔掉它未免可惜。
explanationTraditional: 扔掉它未免可惜。
explanationEn: It's a pity to discard it.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·武帝纪》裴松之注引《九州春秋》夫鸡肋，弃之如可惜，食之无所得，以比汉中，知王欲还也。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·武帝紀》裴松之注引《九州春秋》夫雞肋，棄之如可惜，食之無所得，以比漢中，知王欲還也。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Wei Shu, Biography of Emperor Wu' annotated by Pei Songzhi quoting 'Chronicles of the Nine Provinces': 'A chicken rib—discarding it seems a pity, but eating it yields nothing. Comparing it to Hanzhong, I know the king wants to return.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容事物不清晰或关系不亲密。
explanationTraditional: 形容事物不清晰或關係不親密。
explanationEn: Describing something indistinct or a relationship that is not close.
derivation: 明·洪应明《菜根谭·闲适》若有若无，半真半幻，最足以悦人心目而豁人性灵。真天地间一妙境也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·洪應明《菜根譚·閒適》若有若無，半真半幻，最足以悅人心目而豁人性靈。真天地間一妙境也。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Hong Yingming, 'Caigentan: Leisure': 'Indistinct yet present, half real and half illusory, most pleasing to the eye and enlightening to the soul. Truly a wonderful realm in the world.'
example: 她很清楚，他对她早已～，不放在心上了。★沙汀《淘金记》八
exampleTraditional: 她很清楚，他對她早已～，不放在心上了。★沙汀《淘金記》八
exampleEn: She was well aware that he had long regarded her as barely there, no longer caring. — Sha Ting, 'Gold Rush', Chapter 8

explanation: 逸安闲；致情趣。指悠闲的心情和安逸的兴致。
explanationTraditional: 逸安閒；致情趣。指悠閒的心情和安逸的興致。
explanationEn: Leisurely mood and carefree interest; a relaxed and elegant state of mind.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第一百回此时四处兵荒马乱，朝秦暮楚，我勉强做了一部《旧唐书》，那里还有闲情逸致弄这笔墨。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第一百回此時四處兵荒馬亂，朝秦暮楚，我勉強做了一部《舊唐書》，那裡還有閒情逸致弄這筆墨。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 100: 'At a time of chaos and constant change, I barely managed to write an 'Old Book of Tang'; how could I have the leisure and elegance to wield this brush and ink?'
example: 古人所谓穷愁著书”的话，是不大可靠的。穷到透顶，愁得要死的人，那里还有这许多～来著书？★鲁迅《华盖集·碰壁”之后》
exampleTraditional: 古人所謂窮愁著書”的話，是不大可靠的。窮到透頂，愁得要死的人，那裡還有這許多～來著書？★魯迅《華蓋集·碰壁”之後》
exampleEn: The ancients' saying 'write in poverty and sorrow' is unreliable. How could someone utterly destitute and worried have such leisure and elegance to write? — Lu Xun, 'Huagai Collection: After 'Bumping into a Wall''

explanation: 一句话包含两个意思。
explanationTraditional: 一句話包含兩個意思。
explanationEn: A statement with two meanings; a pun.
derivation: 浩然《艳阳天》第86章又转脸看看弯弯绕这伙子人，一语双关地说‘我再宣布一声，谁想浑水摸鱼，挑拨是非，那是办不到。’”
derivationTraditional: 浩然《豔陽天》第86章又轉臉看看彎彎繞這夥子人，一語雙關地說‘我再宣佈一聲，誰想渾水摸魚，挑撥是非，那是辦不到。’”
derivationEn: Hao Ran, 'Bright Sunny Skies', Chapter 86: 'He turned to look at the group of crooked people and said with a pun, 'I announce again: anyone trying to fish in troubled waters or stir up trouble will not succeed.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 寄托或隐含的意思很深（多指语言文字或艺术作品）。
explanationTraditional: 寄託或隱含的意思很深（多指語言文字或藝術作品）。
explanationEn: Having profound implied meaning (often of language or art).
derivation: 宋·沈作喆《寓简》卷一诗之作也，其寓意深远，后之人莫能知之其意之所在也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·沈作喆《寓簡》卷一詩之作也，其寓意深遠，後之人莫能知之其意之所在也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shen Zuozhe, 'Simple Notes', Volume 1: 'The creation of poetry has deep implied meanings, which later people cannot know where the meaning lies.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 每战必胜。形容所向无敌。
explanationTraditional: 每戰必勝。形容所向無敵。
explanationEn: Win every battle; invincible.
derivation: 《孙子·谋攻》百战百胜，非善之善者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·謀攻》百戰百勝，非善之善者也。”
derivationEn: 'The Art of War: Planning Attacks': 'To win every battle is not the supreme excellence.'
example: 项籍唯不能忍，是以～而轻用其锋。★宋·苏轼《留侯论》
exampleTraditional: 項籍唯不能忍，是以～而輕用其鋒。★宋·蘇軾《留侯論》
exampleEn: Xiang Yu could not endure, so although he won every battle, he used his edge lightly. — Song Dynasty, Su Shi, 'On Liu Hou'

explanation: 没有完全成熟或未烹煮至可食用的程度。比喻不熟悉；不熟练。
explanationTraditional: 沒有完全成熟或未烹煮至可食用的程度。比喻不熟悉；不熟練。
explanationEn: Not fully ripe or cooked; figuratively, unfamiliar or unskilled.
derivation: 参见半生半熟”。
derivationTraditional: 參見半生半熟”。
derivationEn: See 'half-raw half-cooked'.
example: 五个中间的老徐能说几句～的广府话。★茅盾《过封锁线》
exampleTraditional: 五個中間的老徐能說幾句～的廣府話。★茅盾《過封鎖線》
exampleEn: The middle one of the five, Old Xu, could speak a few half-baked Cantonese words. — Mao Dun, 'Crossing the Blockade'

explanation: 指由于一心爱财而心中糊涂。
explanationTraditional: 指由於一心愛財而心中糊塗。
explanationEn: Obsessed with money to the point of foolishness.
derivation: 孙犁《秀露集·耕堂读书记（三）》如果当时这位作者，明达冷静一些，不财迷心窍，天下原可以平安无事的。”
derivationTraditional: 孫犁《秀露集·耕堂讀書記（三）》如果當時這位作者，明達冷靜一些，不財迷心竅，天下原可以平安無事的。”
derivationEn: Sun Li, 'Xiulu Collection: Reading Notes (3)': 'If the author had been clear-headed and calm at that time, not blinded by greed, the world could have been peaceful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 禽鸟；兽野兽。飞翔的禽鸟，奔跑的野兽。泛指鸟类和兽类。
explanationTraditional: 禽鳥；獸野獸。飛翔的禽鳥，奔跑的野獸。泛指鳥類和獸類。
explanationEn: Flying birds and running beasts; general term for birds and animals.
derivation: 汉·王延寿《鲁灵光殿赋》飞禽走兽，因木生姿。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王延壽《魯靈光殿賦》飛禽走獸，因木生姿。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Wang Yanshou, 'Ode to the Lingguang Hall': 'Flying birds and running beasts, taking shape from the wood.'
example: 铃儿乃金丹之宝，又不是～，如何辨得雌雄？★明·吴承恩《西游记》第七十一回
exampleTraditional: 鈴兒乃金丹之寶，又不是～，如何辨得雌雄？★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第七十一回
exampleEn: The bell is a treasure of the golden elixir, not a bird or beast; how can one distinguish male from female? — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 71

explanation: 腋腋下，指狐狸腋下的皮毛；裘皮衣↑狸腋下的皮虽很小，但聚集起来就能制一件皮袍。比喻积少成多。
explanationTraditional: 腋腋下，指狐狸腋下的皮毛；裘皮衣↑狸腋下的皮雖很小，但聚集起來就能制一件皮袍。比喻積少成多。
explanationEn: Many a little makes a mickle. It means that small contributions can accumulate into a large amount.
derivation: 《慎子·知忠》狐白之裘，盖非一狐之皮也。”
derivationTraditional: 《慎子·知忠》狐白之裘，蓋非一狐之皮也。”
derivationEn: From 'Shenzi: Knowing Loyalty': 'A fox-fur coat is not made from the fur of a single fox.'
example: 如今弄多少是多少，也只好是～了。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三回
exampleTraditional: 如今弄多少是多少，也只好是～了。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三回
exampleEn: Now, whatever we can get, we'll just have to make do with it, like gathering bits of fur to make a robe. (from Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 3)

explanation: 牛郎织女为神话人物，从牵牛星、织女星的星名衍化而来。比喻分居两地的夫妻。也泛指一对恋人。
explanationTraditional: 牛郎織女為神話人物，從牽牛星、織女星的星名衍化而來。比喻分居兩地的夫妻。也泛指一對戀人。
explanationEn: The Cowherd and the Weaver Girl, mythological figures derived from the stars Altair and Vega. It metaphorically refers to a married couple living apart, or generally to a pair of lovers.
derivation: 《古诗十九首》迢迢牵牛星，皎皎河汉女。纤纤擢素手，札札弄机杼。终日不成章，泣涕零如雨∮汉清且浅，相去复几许？盈盈一水间，脉脉不得语。”
derivationTraditional: 《古詩十九首》迢迢牽牛星，皎皎河漢女。纖纖擢素手，札札弄機杼。終日不成章，泣涕零如雨∮漢清且淺，相去復幾許？盈盈一水間，脈脈不得語。”
derivationEn: From 'Nineteen Old Poems': 'Far, far away, the Cowherd Star; Bright, bright, the Weaver Maid. Slender, slender, she lifts her white hand; Click, click, her shuttle moves. All day she weaves, but cannot finish; Her tears fall like rain. The River Han is shallow and clear; How far apart are they? Full, full, the river's water; They gaze but cannot speak.'
example: 尝笔唐人《七夕》诗，咏～，皆作会别可怜之语，殊失命名本旨。★清·郑燮《范县署中寄余弟墨粉四书》
exampleTraditional: 嘗筆唐人《七夕》詩，詠～，皆作會別可憐之語，殊失命名本旨。★清·鄭燮《範縣署中寄餘弟墨粉四書》
exampleEn: I once read Tang Dynasty poems about the Seventh Night, all describing the Cowherd and Weaver Girl's meeting as pitiful, which misses the original meaning of their names. (from Qing Dynasty, Zheng Xie's 'Letter to My Brother from Fan County')

explanation: 黄莺在歌唱，小燕子在飞舞。形容春天鸟儿喧闹活跃的景象。现常比喻革命和建设蓬勃兴旺的景象。
explanationTraditional: 黃鶯在歌唱，小燕子在飛舞。形容春天鳥兒喧鬧活躍的景象。現常比喻革命和建設蓬勃興旺的景象。
explanationEn: Orioles sing and swallows dance. It describes the lively scene of birds in spring, and now often metaphorically refers to a thriving and prosperous situation in revolution or construction.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《锦被亭》词烟红露绿晓风香，燕舞莺啼春日长。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《錦被亭》詞煙紅露綠曉風香，燕舞鶯啼春日長。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Su Shi's poem 'Jin Bei Ting': 'Smoke red, dew green, morning wind fragrant; Swallows dance, orioles sing, spring days long.'
example: 千里来寻故地，旧貌变新颜。到处～，更有潺潺流水，高路入云端。★毛泽东《水调歌头·重上井冈山》词
exampleTraditional: 千里來尋故地，舊貌變新顏。到處～，更有潺潺流水，高路入雲端。★毛澤東《水調歌頭·重上井岡山》詞
exampleEn: Coming a thousand li to seek our old haunts, old looks have changed into new. Everywhere orioles sing, swallows dance, streams murmur, and high roads climb into the clouds. (from Mao Zedong's poem 'Water Melody: Reascending Jinggangshan')

explanation: 比喻经历了种种艰难困苦。
explanationTraditional: 比喻經歷了種種艱難困苦。
explanationEn: Wind, frost, rain, and snow. It metaphorically refers to having experienced various hardships and difficulties.
derivation: 元·马致远《黄梁梦》第四折一梦中十八年，见了酒色财气，人我是非，贪嗔痴爱，风霜雨雪。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《黃梁夢》第四折一夢中十八年，見了酒色財氣，人我是非，貪嗔痴愛，風霜雨雪。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan's 'Yellow Millet Dream', Act 4: 'In one dream, eighteen years passed, seeing wine, sex, wealth, anger, right and wrong, greed, hatred, love, wind, frost, rain, and snow.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 头发长而散乱。形容仪容不整。
explanationTraditional: 頭髮長而散亂。形容儀容不整。
explanationEn: With hair disheveled and hanging loose. It describes an untidy appearance.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第二十二回那张三又挑唆阎婆去厅上披头散发来告道‘宋江实是宋清隐藏在家，不令出官。相公如何不与老身做主去拿宋江。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第二十二回那張三又挑唆閻婆去廳上披頭散髮來告道‘宋江實是宋清隱藏在家，不令出官。相公如何不與老身做主去拿宋江。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 22: 'That Zhang San again incited Yan Po to go to the court with disheveled hair and accuse: 'Song Jiang is indeed hidden at home by Song Qing, not allowed to come out. Why doesn't Your Honor do justice for me and arrest Song Jiang?''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 倾倒出；巢巢穴。比喻敌人出动全部兵力进行侵扰。
explanationTraditional: 傾倒出；巢巢穴。比喻敵人出動全部兵力進行侵擾。
explanationEn: To turn out in full force. It originally means the whole nest turns out, and metaphorically refers to the enemy mobilizing all its troops to invade.
derivation: 南朝·梁·沈约《齐故安陆昭王碑文》由是倾巢举落，望德如归。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·沈約《齊故安陸昭王碑文》由是傾巢舉落，望德如歸。”
derivationEn: From Southern Liang Dynasty, Shen Yue's 'Epitaph for Prince Anlu of Qi': 'Hence, the whole nest and tribe turned out, looking up to virtue as if returning home.'
example: 平日不大出门的人，这两天也都～。（端木蕻良《曹雪芹》第十二章）
exampleTraditional: 平日不大出門的人，這兩天也都～。（端木蕻良《曹雪芹》第十二章）
exampleEn: People who usually don't go out much have all turned out these past two days. (from Duanmu Hongliang's 'Cao Xueqin', Chapter 12)

explanation: 汗珠象下雨似的往下掉。形容出汗很多。
explanationTraditional: 汗珠象下雨似的往下掉。形容出汗很多。
explanationEn: Sweat falls like rain. It describes sweating profusely.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷四十七三冬汗如雨。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷四十七三冬汗如雨。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting at the Source', Volume 47: 'In the third winter, sweat like rain.'
example: 不防一块石头绊了一跤，犹如梦醒一般，浑身～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一○一回
exampleTraditional: 不防一塊石頭絆了一跤，猶如夢醒一般，渾身～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一○一回
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, he tripped over a stone and fell, as if waking from a dream, his whole body drenched in sweat. (from Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 101)

explanation: 眼里没有别人。形容骄傲自大，看不起人。
explanationTraditional: 眼裡沒有別人。形容驕傲自大，看不起人。
explanationEn: To have no one in one's eyes. It describes being arrogant and looking down on others.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第九十六回赵奢子赵括，自少喜谈兵法，家传《六韬》、《三略》之书，一览而尽；尝与父奢论兵，指天画地，目中无人，虽奢亦不能难也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第九十六回趙奢子趙括，自少喜談兵法，家傳《六韜》、《三略》之書，一覽而盡；嘗與父奢論兵，指天畫地，目中無人，雖奢亦不能難也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 96: 'Zhao She's son Zhao Kuo, since childhood loved to discuss military strategy. He read the family's books on the Six Arts and Three Strategies at a glance; once arguing with his father about military matters, he pointed at the sky and drew on the ground, acting as if no one else existed, and even Zhao She could not refute him.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 尽最大努力忍受痛苦或克服困难。
explanationTraditional: 盡最大努力忍受痛苦或克服困難。
explanationEn: To clench one's teeth. It means to endure pain or overcome difficulties with utmost effort.
derivation: 清·韩邦庆《海上花列传》第十三回一面问个着落，一面咬紧牙关把朴斋腿膀狠命的摔一把。朴斋忍不住叫声‘阿呀’。”
derivationTraditional: 清·韓邦慶《海上花列傳》第十三回一面問個著落，一面咬緊牙關把樸齋腿膀狠命的摔一把。樸齋忍不住叫聲‘阿呀’。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Han Bangqing's 'The Sing-song Girls of Shanghai', Chapter 13: 'While asking for whereabouts, he clenched his teeth and fiercely twisted Pu Zhai's leg. Pu Zhai couldn't help but cry out 'Ouch'.'
example: 他～，忍受剐心似的痛楚。★周而复《上海的早晨》第一部四
exampleTraditional: 他～，忍受剮心似的痛楚。★周而復《上海的早晨》第一部四
exampleEn: He clenched his teeth and endured the heart-wrenching pain. (from Zhou Erfu's 'Morning in Shanghai', Part 1, Chapter 4)

explanation: 揭高举；竿竹竿，代旗帜。砍了树干当武器，举起竹竿当旗帜，进行反抗。指人民起义。
explanationTraditional: 揭高舉；竿竹竿，代旗幟。砍了樹幹當武器，舉起竹竿當旗幟，進行反抗。指人民起義。
explanationEn: To raise the standard of revolt. It means to cut down trees for weapons and raise bamboo poles as flags, referring to a popular uprising.
derivation: 汉·贾谊《过秦论》斩木为兵，揭竿为旗。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·賈誼《過秦論》斬木為兵，揭竿為旗。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Jia Yi's 'On the Faults of Qin': 'They cut down trees for weapons and raised bamboo poles as flags.'
example: 一时各路人马，～，不分昼夜，兼水路纷纷入鄂。★白先勇《梁父吟》
exampleTraditional: 一時各路人馬，～，不分晝夜，兼水路紛紛入鄂。★白先勇《梁父吟》
exampleEn: At that time, various groups rose up in revolt, day and night, by water and land, streaming into Hubei. (from Bai Xianyong's 'Lament for the Father')

explanation: 捆住手脚。形容胆子小，顾虑多。
explanationTraditional: 捆住手腳。形容膽子小，顧慮多。
explanationEn: To be overly cautious and constrained, lacking boldness.
derivation: 毛泽东《在省市自治区党委书记会议上的讲话》按照法律办事，不等于束手束脚。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《在省市自治區黨委書記會議上的講話》按照法律辦事，不等於束手束腳。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's speech: 'Acting according to law does not mean being overly cautious.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 对奇异的事情拍着桌子惊叹。
explanationTraditional: 對奇異的事情拍著桌子驚歎。
explanationEn: To strike the table in amazement at something extraordinary.
derivation: 明末·凌蒙初有拟话本《初刻拍案惊奇》、《二刻拍案惊奇》。
derivationTraditional: 明末·淩濛初有擬話本《初刻拍案驚奇》、《二刻拍案驚奇》。
derivationEn: Ling Mengchu's Ming dynasty story collections 'Slapping the Table in Amazement' (first and second series).
example: 更令人～的是杜诗‘老妻画纸为棋局，稚子敲针作钓钩’。★《人民日报》（海外版）1982.1.2
exampleTraditional: 更令人～的是杜詩‘老妻畫紙為棋局，稚子敲針作釣鉤’。★《人民日報》（海外版）1982.1.2
exampleEn: Even more astonishing is Du Fu's poem: 'The old wife draws a chessboard on paper, the child taps a hook from a needle.' — People's Daily (Overseas Edition), Jan 2, 1982

explanation: 追究根底。一般指追问一件事的原由。
explanationTraditional: 追究根底。一般指追問一件事的原由。
explanationEn: To get to the bottom of something; to investigate thoroughly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 学习上追根究底的精神，是非常可贵的。
exampleTraditional: 學習上追根究底的精神，是非常可貴的。
exampleEn: The spirit of getting to the bottom of things in learning is very valuable.

explanation: 大家旧指有声望地位的高门贵族。风范风度、气派。出自高贵人家特有的气派。
explanationTraditional: 大家舊指有聲望地位的高門貴族。風範風度、氣派。出自高貴人家特有的氣派。
explanationEn: The dignified manner of a noble or distinguished family.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第十八回献茶已毕，叙起话来，问答如流，气度从容，真是大家风范，把个狄后乐了个了不得。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第十八回獻茶已畢，敘起話來，問答如流，氣度從容，真是大家風範，把個狄後樂了個了不得。”
derivationEn: Qing dynasty Shi Yukun's 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants': 'After tea, they conversed fluently with composed demeanor, truly the manner of a noble family.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 日以继夜的赶路。
explanationTraditional: 日以繼夜的趕路。
explanationEn: To travel day and night without rest.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十六回林如海已葬入祖坟了，诸事停妥，贾琏方进京的。本该出月到家，因闻得元春喜信，遂昼夜兼程而进，一路俱各平安。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十六回林如海已葬入祖墳了，諸事停妥，賈璉方進京的。本該出月到家，因聞得元春喜信，遂晝夜兼程而進，一路俱各平安。”
derivationEn: Qing dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber': 'Jia Lian traveled day and night upon hearing the good news of Yuanchun.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 脸色不变。形容从容镇静的样子。
explanationTraditional: 臉色不變。形容從容鎮靜的樣子。
explanationEn: To remain calm and composed without changing facial expression.
derivation: 元·秦简夫《赵礼让肥》第二折我这虎头寨上，但凡拿住的人呵，见了俺，丧胆亡魂，今朝拿住这厮，面不改色。”
derivationTraditional: 元·秦簡夫《趙禮讓肥》第二折我這虎頭寨上，但凡拿住的人呵，見了俺，喪膽亡魂，今朝拿住這廝，面不改色。”
derivationEn: Yuan dynasty Qin Jianfu's 'Zhao Li Yields to Kindness': 'Everyone captured here loses their wits, but this man remains calm without changing color.'
example: （秦王）叱左右前缚（蔺）相如，相如～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第九十六回
exampleTraditional: （秦王）叱左右前縛（藺）相如，相如～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第九十六回
exampleEn: (King of Qin) ordered attendants to bind Lin Xiangru, but Lin remained calm without changing color. — Ming Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms'

explanation: 形容象泰山一样稳固，不可动摇。
explanationTraditional: 形容象泰山一樣穩固，不可動搖。
explanationEn: As stable and immovable as Mount Tai.
derivation: 汉·枚乘《上书谏吴王》变所欲为，易于反掌，安于泰山。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·枚乘《上書諫吳王》變所欲為，易於反掌，安於泰山。”
derivationEn: Han dynasty Mei Cheng's 'Letter Advising the King of Wu': 'Changing what you desire is easier than turning over your hand, and as stable as Mount Tai.'
example: 武后恃有高关，又仗武氏弟兄骁勇，自谓～，十分得意。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三回
exampleTraditional: 武后恃有高關，又仗武氏弟兄驍勇，自謂～，十分得意。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三回
exampleEn: Empress Wu, relying on the high passes and her brave brothers, considered herself as stable as Mount Tai and was very pleased. — Qing Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror'

explanation: 搬弄挑拔。把别人的话传来传去，有意挑拔，或在背后乱加议论，引起纠纷。
explanationTraditional: 搬弄挑拔。把別人的話傳來傳去，有意挑拔，或在背後亂加議論，引起糾紛。
explanationEn: To sow discord or gossip behind people's backs, causing trouble.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》摇唇鼓舌，擅生是非。”元·李寿卿《伍员吹箫》第一折他在平公面前，搬弄我许多事非。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》搖唇鼓舌，擅生是非。”元·李壽卿《伍員吹簫》第一折他在平公面前，搬弄我許多事非。”
derivationEn: Zhuangzi: 'To wag one's tongue and stir up trouble.' Yuan Li Shouqing's 'Wu Yuan Plays the Flute': 'He sowed many troubles before Lord Ping.'
example: 况三姑六婆，里外搬弄是非，何能不生事端。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 況三姑六婆，裡外搬弄是非，何能不生事端。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十二回
exampleEn: Moreover, the three aunts and six old women sow discord inside and out, inevitably causing incidents. — Qing Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror'

explanation: 指情况出于不得已。
explanationTraditional: 指情況出於不得已。
explanationEn: To be compelled by circumstances; to have no choice.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 秋水比喻人的眼睛。眼睛都望穿了。形容对远地亲友的殷切盼望。
explanationTraditional: 秋水比喻人的眼睛。眼睛都望穿了。形容對遠地親友的殷切盼望。
explanationEn: To eagerly await someone's return, with eyes strained from longing.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第三本第二折望穿他盈盈秋水，蹙损他淡淡春山。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第三本第二折望穿他盈盈秋水，蹙損他淡淡春山。”
derivationEn: Yuan Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing': 'Straining his eyes through the clear autumn waters, furrowing his light spring brows.'
example: 听蕉声一阵一阵细雨下，何处与人闲嗑牙？～，不见还家，潸潸泪似麻。★清·蒲松龄这《聊斋志异·凤阳士人》
exampleTraditional: 聽蕉聲一陣一陣細雨下，何處與人閒嗑牙？～，不見還家，潸潸淚似麻。★清·蒲松齡這《聊齋志異·鳳陽士人》
exampleEn: Listening to the rain, one after another, where can one chat idly? Straining eyes through autumn waters, not seeing return, tears like hemp. — Qing Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio'

explanation: 床上搁床，屋上架屋。比喻重复、累赘。
explanationTraditional: 床上擱床，屋上架屋。比喻重複、累贅。
explanationEn: Repeating or piling up unnecessary things; redundant.
derivation: 北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·序致》魏晋已来，所著诸子，理重事複，递相模学，犹屋下架屋，床上施床耳。”
derivationTraditional: 北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·序致》魏晉已來，所著諸子，理重事複，遞相模學，猶屋下架屋，床上施床耳。”
derivationEn: From Yan Zhitui's 'Family Instructions of the Yan Clan' in the Northern Qi Dynasty: 'Since the Wei and Jin dynasties, many writings have repeated the same ideas and events, like building a house under a house or adding a bed on top of a bed.'
example: 说话写文章应力求简明扼要，切忌～，使人不得要领。
exampleTraditional: 說話寫文章應力求簡明扼要，切忌～，使人不得要領。
exampleEn: When speaking or writing, one should strive for conciseness and avoid redundancy, which makes it hard for others to grasp the main point.

explanation: 风风度；绰约女子姿态柔美。形容女子风韵姿态柔美动人。
explanationTraditional: 風風度；綽約女子姿態柔美。形容女子風韻姿態柔美動人。
explanationEn: Graceful and charming; describes a woman's elegant and attractive demeanor.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 她那风姿绰约的神态让我着迷。
exampleTraditional: 她那風姿綽約的神態讓我著迷。
exampleEn: Her graceful and charming demeanor fascinated me.

explanation: 黔今贵州省一带；技技能；穷尽。比喻有限的一点本领也已经用完了。
explanationTraditional: 黔今貴州省一帶；技技能；窮盡。比喻有限的一點本領也已經用完了。
explanationEn: To have exhausted one's limited abilities; at one's wit's end.
derivation: 唐·柳宗元《三戒·黔之驴》
derivationTraditional: 唐·柳宗元《三戒·黔之驢》
derivationEn: From Liu Zongyuan's 'Three Admonitions: The Donkey of Guizhou' in the Tang Dynasty.
example: 他们不过是～，想求个活命罢了。★陈立德《前驱》三十八
exampleTraditional: 他們不過是～，想求個活命罷了。★陳立德《前驅》三十八
exampleEn: They are just at their wit's end, trying to save their lives.

explanation: 用各种手段使对方过不去。
explanationTraditional: 用各種手段使對方過不去。
explanationEn: To create difficulties for someone in every possible way; to make things hard for someone.
derivation: 郭戈《金瓶梅传奇》第十一回柔玉不便道出自己身世，编个话儿与她道‘奴家父母早逝，自幼跟哥嫂度日。只是嫂嫂容不得，百般刁难，与其受人凌辱，倒不如自寻清净，避开人世烦恼。’”
derivationTraditional: 郭戈《金瓶梅傳奇》第十一回柔玉不便道出自己身世，編個話兒與她道‘奴家父母早逝，自幼跟哥嫂度日。只是嫂嫂容不得，百般刁難，與其受人凌辱，倒不如自尋清淨，避開人世煩惱。’”
derivationEn: From Guo Ge's 'The Legend of Jin Ping Mei', Chapter 11: 'Rouyu could not reveal her background, so she made up a story: 'My parents died early, and I lived with my brother and sister-in-law. But my sister-in-law couldn't tolerate me and made things difficult for me in every way...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指与工作无关的人员。
explanationTraditional: 指與工作無關的人員。
explanationEn: People who are not involved or have no business; unauthorized personnel.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百三回若七日内主灯不灭，吾寿可增一纪；如灯灭，吾必死矣。闲杂人等，休教放入。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百三回若七日內主燈不滅，吾壽可增一紀；如燈滅，吾必死矣。閒雜人等，休教放入。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 103: 'If the main lamp does not go out within seven days, my life can be extended by twelve years; if it goes out, I will surely die. No unauthorized persons should be allowed in.'
example: 外来的如吹鼓手、厨茶房，以至抬夫、轿夫这些～过多。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十二回
exampleTraditional: 外來的如吹鼓手、廚茶房，以至抬夫、轎伕這些～過多。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十二回
exampleEn: There were too many outsiders, such as trumpeters, cooks, porters, and sedan chair bearers.

explanation: 药治疗。病已重到无法用药医治的程度。比喻已经到了无法挽救的地步。
explanationTraditional: 藥治療。病已重到無法用藥醫治的程度。比喻已經到了無法挽救的地步。
explanationEn: Beyond cure; incurable; hopeless.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·板》匪我言耄，尔用忧谑。多将熇熇，不可救药。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·板》匪我言耄，爾用憂謔。多將熇熇，不可救藥。”
derivationEn: From the 'Book of Songs, Greater Odes, Ban': 'It is not that I am old and foolish, but you use worry as a joke. When the fire blazes high, it cannot be cured.'
example: 怀疑与猜忌，难道就竟已成了他们～的根性了吗？★郑振铎《桂公塘》十四
exampleTraditional: 懷疑與猜忌，難道就竟已成了他們～的根性了嗎？★鄭振鐸《桂公塘》十四
exampleEn: Has suspicion and doubt become their incurable root nature?

explanation: 没有亲属和故旧。形容孤单。
explanationTraditional: 沒有親屬和故舊。形容孤單。
explanationEn: Without relatives or friends; all alone.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 殷指商朝后期；鉴镜子。指殷商子孙应以夏的灭亡为借戒◇泛指前人的教训就在眼前。
explanationTraditional: 殷指商朝後期；鑑鏡子。指殷商子孫應以夏的滅亡為借戒◇泛指前人的教訓就在眼前。
explanationEn: The lesson of Yin is not far off; a warning from recent history.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·荡》殷鉴不远，在夏后之世。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·蕩》殷鑑不遠，在夏後之世。”
derivationEn: From the 'Book of Songs, Greater Odes, Dang': 'The lesson of Yin is not far off; it lies in the era of the Xia dynasty.'
example: 宋与金的历史，对崇桢说来，～，而他绝不愿在臣民心目和后代史书中被看成是懦弱无能的君主。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十二章
exampleTraditional: 宋與金的歷史，對崇楨說來，～，而他絕不願在臣民心目和後代史書中被看成是懦弱無能的君主。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十二章
exampleEn: For Chongzhen, the history of the Song and Jin dynasties was a recent lesson, and he absolutely did not want to be seen as a weak and incompetent ruler in the eyes of his subjects and in later historical records.

explanation: 模凝糊，不真切。
explanationTraditional: 模凝糊，不真切。
explanationEn: Vague; indistinct; shadowy.
derivation: 明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第六十二回我不知怎的，但没人在房里，心里只害怕，恰似影影绰绰，有人在眼前一般。”
derivationTraditional: 明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第六十二回我不知怎的，但沒人在房裡，心裡只害怕，恰似影影綽綽，有人在眼前一般。”
derivationEn: From Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng's 'Jin Ping Mei', Chapter 62: 'I don't know why, but when no one is in the room, I feel scared, as if there is a shadowy figure before my eyes.'
example: 宝玉一见，喜得赶出来，但见鸳鸯在前，～的走，只是赶不上。（清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百十六回）
exampleTraditional: 寶玉一見，喜得趕出來，但見鴛鴦在前，～的走，只是趕不上。（清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百十六回）
exampleEn: Baoyu was delighted to see her and rushed out, but saw Yuanyang walking vaguely ahead, and he could not catch up.

explanation: 奉信奉；圭测日影器；臬射箭的靶子；圭臬比喻事物的准则。比喻把某些言论或事当成自己的准则。
explanationTraditional: 奉信奉；圭測日影器；臬射箭的靶子；圭臬比喻事物的準則。比喻把某些言論或事當成自己的準則。
explanationEn: To regard as a standard or criterion; to hold as a guiding principle.
derivation: 清·钱大昕《六书音韵表序》此书出，将使海内说经之家奉为圭皋，而因文字音声以求训诂古义之兴有日矣，讵独以存古音布局哉。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢大昕《六書音韻表序》此書出，將使海內說經之家奉為圭皋，而因文字音聲以求訓詁古義之興有日矣，詎獨以存古音佈局哉。”
derivationEn: From Qian Daxin's 'Preface to the Table of Six Books and Phonetic Rhymes' in the Qing Dynasty: 'This book will make scholars of classics across the country regard it as a standard...'
example: 适应之说，迄今学人犹～。★鲁迅《坟·人之历史》
exampleTraditional: 適應之說，迄今學人猶～。★魯迅《墳·人之歷史》
exampleEn: The theory of adaptation has been regarded as a standard by scholars up to the present day.

explanation: 偷取炉中烤熟的栗子。比喻受人利用，冒险出力却一无所得。
explanationTraditional: 偷取爐中烤熟的栗子。比喻受人利用，冒險出力卻一無所得。
explanationEn: To pull chestnuts out of the fire; to be used by someone to take risks without gaining anything.
derivation: 十七世纪法国寓言诗人拉·封丹的寓言《猴子与猫》载猴子骗猫取火中栗子，栗子让猴子吃了，猫却把脚上的毛烧掉了。
derivationTraditional: 十七世紀法國寓言詩人拉·封丹的寓言《猴子與貓》載猴子騙貓取火中栗子，栗子讓猴子吃了，貓卻把腳上的毛燒掉了。
derivationEn: From La Fontaine's fable 'The Monkey and the Cat', where the monkey tricks the cat into retrieving chestnuts from the fire, but the cat burns its paws while the monkey eats the chestnuts.
example: 我们目前自顾不暇，郑成功不来就是天主保佑了，我们还好去惹他么。我们不能为别人～。★郭沫若《郑成功》第五章
exampleTraditional: 我們目前自顧不暇，鄭成功不來就是天主保佑了，我們還好去惹他麼。我們不能為別人～。★郭沫若《鄭成功》第五章
exampleEn: We have enough trouble of our own; if Zheng Chenggong doesn't come, it's heaven's blessing. How can we provoke him? We cannot pull chestnuts out of the fire for others. — Guo Moruo, Zheng Chenggong, Chapter 5

explanation: 笼络笼和络原是羁绊牲口的工具，引伸为用手段拉拢。耍弄手段，拉拢别人。
explanationTraditional: 籠絡籠和絡原是羈絆牲口的工具，引伸為用手段拉攏。耍弄手段，拉攏別人。
explanationEn: To win people's hearts by scheming; to manipulate others to gain support.
derivation: 《宋史·胡安国传》自蔡京得政，士大夫无不受其笼络，超然远迹不为所污者如安国者实鲜。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·胡安國傳》自蔡京得政，士大夫無不受其籠絡，超然遠跡不為所汙者如安國者實鮮。”
derivationEn: From History of Song: Biography of Hu Anguo: 'Since Cai Jing came to power, scholars and officials were all won over by him; few remained aloof and uncorrupted like Anguo.'
example: 因为当时那元主，要～，访求宋朝遗逸，中外鞑官和一班反颜事敌的宋朝旧臣，都交章保荐谢枋得。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 因為當時那元主，要～，訪求宋朝遺逸，中外韃官和一班反顏事敵的宋朝舊臣，都交章保薦謝枋得。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第二十回
exampleEn: At that time, the Yuan ruler wanted to win people's hearts by seeking out Song dynasty recluses. Both Chinese and Mongol officials, as well as former Song officials who had turned against their country, recommended Xie Fangde. — Wu Jianren, The Painful History, Chapter 20

explanation: 原指生财有个大原则，后指搞钱很有办法。
explanationTraditional: 原指生財有個大原則，後指搞錢很有辦法。
explanationEn: To have a knack for making money; to know the right way to generate wealth.
derivation: 《礼记·大学》生财有大道生之者众，食之者寡，为之者疾，用之者舒，则财恒足矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·大學》生財有大道生之者眾，食之者寡，為之者疾，用之者舒，則財恆足矣。”
derivationEn: From The Book of Rites: The Great Learning: 'There is a great principle for generating wealth: let the producers be many and the consumers few; let the workers be diligent and the users frugal; then wealth will always be sufficient.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不破除旧的，就不能建立新的。
explanationTraditional: 不破除舊的，就不能建立新的。
explanationEn: Without destroying the old, the new cannot be established.
derivation: 毛泽东《新民主主义论》不把这种东西打倒，什么新文化都是建立不起来的。不破不立，不塞不流，不止不行。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《新民主主義論》不把這種東西打倒，什麼新文化都是建立不起來的。不破不立，不塞不流，不止不行。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's On New Democracy: 'If this thing is not overthrown, no new culture can be established. Without destruction, there can be no construction; without a halt, no flow; without stoppage, no movement.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把零散的部分集中为一个整体。
explanationTraditional: 把零散的部分集中為一個整體。
explanationEn: To assemble scattered parts into a whole; to concentrate dispersed forces.
derivation: 毛泽东《抗日游击战争的战略问题》集中使用兵力，即所谓化零为整”的办法，多半是在敌人进攻之时为了消灭敌人而采取的。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《抗日遊擊戰爭的戰略問題》集中使用兵力，即所謂化零為整”的辦法，多半是在敵人進攻之時為了消滅敵人而採取的。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's Strategic Problems of the Anti-Japanese Guerrilla War: 'The method of concentrating forces, i.e., the method of 'assembling scattered parts into a whole', is mostly adopted when the enemy attacks, in order to annihilate the enemy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 迷信的人认为可以办事的吉利日子。
explanationTraditional: 迷信的人認為可以辦事的吉利日子。
explanationEn: A lucky day; an auspicious day for undertaking important activities according to superstition.
derivation: 元·无名氏《连环计》第四折今日是皇道吉日，满朝众公卿都在银台门，敦请太师入朝授禅。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《連環計》第四折今日是皇道吉日，滿朝眾公卿都在銀臺門，敦請太師入朝授禪。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty anonymous play The Stratagem of the Linked Rings, Act 4: 'Today is an auspicious day; all the ministers are at the Silver Terrace Gate, inviting the Grand Tutor to enter the court for the abdication ceremony.'
example: 次日是～，就着杨老妈为媒，说不舍得放女儿出门，把张幼谦赘了过来。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十九
exampleTraditional: 次日是～，就著楊老媽為媒，說不捨得放女兒出門，把張幼謙贅了過來。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十九
exampleEn: The next day was an auspicious day, so Old Lady Yang was sent as matchmaker, saying they were unwilling to let their daughter marry out, and instead had Zhang Youqian marry into the family. — Ling Mengchu, Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 29

explanation: 惶恐惧。内心害怕，十分不安。
explanationTraditional: 惶恐懼。內心害怕，十分不安。
explanationEn: To be extremely anxious and uneasy; to be in a state of fear and restlessness.
derivation: 《汉书·王莽传下》人民正营，无所措手足。”唐·颜师古注正营，惶恐不安之意也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·王莽傳下》人民正營，無所措手足。”唐·顏師古注正營，惶恐不安之意也。”
derivationEn: From Book of Han: Biography of Wang Mang, Part 2: 'The people were in a panic, not knowing where to put their hands and feet.' Tang dynasty Yan Shigu's commentary: 'Zhengying means a state of fear and unease.'
example: 董卓屯兵城外，每日带铁甲马军入城，横行街市，百姓～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三回
exampleTraditional: 董卓屯兵城外，每日帶鐵甲馬軍入城，橫行街市，百姓～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三回
exampleEn: Dong Zhuo stationed his troops outside the city, and daily led armored cavalry into the city, rampaging through the streets, causing the people to be extremely anxious. — Luo Guanzhong, Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Chapter 3

explanation: 制造谣言，挑起事端。
explanationTraditional: 製造謠言，挑起事端。
explanationEn: To spread rumors and stir up trouble; to create incidents by fabricating stories.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》尔作言造语，妄称文武。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》爾作言造語，妄稱文武。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: Robber Zhi: 'You make up words and fabricate stories, falsely claiming to follow King Wen and King Wu.'
example: 有许多言论是荒唐无知、捕风捉影、～。★郭小川《沉重的教训》
exampleTraditional: 有許多言論是荒唐無知、捕風捉影、～。★郭小川《沉重的教訓》
exampleEn: Many remarks are absurd, ignorant, based on hearsay, and intended to stir up trouble. — Guo Xiaochuan, A Heavy Lesson

explanation: 比喻一个学术流派、技艺的开创者。
explanationTraditional: 比喻一個學術流派、技藝的開創者。
explanationEn: The founding father; the originator of a school of thought, art, or technique.
derivation: 孙犁《关于中篇小说》鲁迅先生的《阿q正传》，是中国中篇小说的开山鼻祖。”
derivationTraditional: 孫犁《關於中篇小說》魯迅先生的《阿q正傳》，是中國中篇小說的開山鼻祖。”
derivationEn: From Sun Li's On the Novella: 'Lu Xun's The True Story of Ah Q is the founding work of Chinese novellas.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 下面的情况或意见能够通达于上。
explanationTraditional: 下面的情況或意見能夠通達於上。
explanationEn: To ensure that information from above reaches those below; to communicate higher-level directives downward.
derivation: 《管子·明法》下情不上通，谓之塞。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·明法》下情不上通，謂之塞。”
derivationEn: From Guanzi: Mingfa: 'If the situation below cannot reach above, it is called obstruction.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 大器比喻大才。指能担当重任的人物要经过长期的锻炼，所以成就较晚。也用做对长期不得志的人的安慰话。
explanationTraditional: 大器比喻大才。指能擔當重任的人物要經過長期的鍛鍊，所以成就較晚。也用做對長期不得志的人的安慰話。
explanationEn: A great talent matures late; used to describe someone who achieves success later in life after long training, or as consolation for those who have not yet succeeded.
derivation: 《老子》四十二章大方无隅，大器晚成。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》四十二章大方無隅，大器晚成。”
derivationEn: From Laozi, Chapter 42: 'The greatest square has no corners; the great vessel is late in completing.'
example: 二位先生高才久屈，将来定是～的。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 二位先生高才久屈，將來定是～的。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十九回
exampleEn: Both gentlemen have long been unrecognized for their talents, but they will surely achieve great success later. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, The Scholars, Chapter 49

explanation: 诲教导。教导人特别耐心，从不厌倦。
explanationTraditional: 誨教導。教導人特別耐心，從不厭倦。
explanationEn: To teach with tireless patience; never getting tired of instructing others.
derivation: 《论语·述而》学而不厌，诲人不倦，何有于我哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》學而不厭，誨人不倦，何有於我哉？”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius, Shu Er: 'Learn without satiety, teach without weariness; what are these to me?'
example: 圣人说～”，你又来问我，我岂有不说的理！★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十八回
exampleTraditional: 聖人說～”，你又來問我，我豈有不說的理！★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十八回
exampleEn: The sage said 'teach without weariness,' and since you ask me, how could I not explain? — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 48

explanation: 绽裂开。皮肉都裂开了。形容伤势严重。多指受残酷拷打。
explanationTraditional: 綻裂開。皮肉都裂開了。形容傷勢嚴重。多指受殘酷拷打。
explanationEn: Skin torn and flesh split; describing severe injuries, usually from brutal beating.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《包待制三勘蝴蝶梦》第二折浑身是口怎支吾，恰似个没嘴的葫芦，打的来皮开肉绽损肌肤。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《包待制三勘蝴蝶夢》第二折渾身是口怎支吾，恰似個沒嘴的葫蘆，打的來皮開肉綻損肌膚。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, The Butterfly Dream, Act 2: 'Beaten until skin is torn and flesh splits, damaging the body.'
example: 那两个举起大板，打的～，喊叫连声。（清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十一回）
exampleTraditional: 那兩個舉起大板，打的～，喊叫連聲。（清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十一回）
exampleEn: The two raised large clubs and beat him until his skin was torn and flesh split, and he cried out repeatedly. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 51

explanation: 倾倒出；巢巢穴。比喻敌人出动全部兵力进行侵扰。
explanationTraditional: 傾倒出；巢巢穴。比喻敵人出動全部兵力進行侵擾。
explanationEn: The whole nest turns out; used to describe the enemy deploying all their forces for an invasion.
derivation: 南朝·梁·沈约《齐故安陆昭王碑文》由是倾巢举落，望德如归。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·沈約《齊故安陸昭王碑文》由是傾巢舉落，望德如歸。”
derivationEn: From Southern Liang Dynasty, Shen Yue, Inscription for Prince Anlu of Qi: 'Thus the whole nest and tribe came out, looking up to virtue as if returning home.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容嬉笑不严肃的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容嬉笑不嚴肅的樣子。
explanationEn: Grinning cheekily; describing a frivolous and unserious manner.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十回你见我和谁玩过！有和你素日嬉皮笑脸的那些姑娘们，你该问他们去！”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十回你見我和誰玩過！有和你素日嬉皮笑臉的那些姑娘們，你該問他們去！”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 30: 'You see me playing with whom? You should ask those girls you usually grin cheekily with!'
example: 班长随又～岔了一句。（沙汀《一个秋天晚上》）
exampleTraditional: 班長隨又～岔了一句。（沙汀《一個秋天晚上》）
exampleEn: The squad leader then changed the subject with a cheeky grin. — Sha Ting, An Autumn Night

explanation: 比喻碰壁或受斥责。
explanationTraditional: 比喻碰壁或受斥責。
explanationEn: To get a noseful of dust; metaphor for being rebuffed or scolded.
derivation: 《红楼梦》五五回幸而平姐姐在这里，没得臊一鼻子灰，趁早知会他们去。”
derivationTraditional: 《紅樓夢》五五回幸而平姐姐在這裡，沒得臊一鼻子灰，趁早知會他們去。”
derivationEn: From Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 55: 'Fortunately, Sister Ping was here, so I didn't get a noseful of shame; I'll inform them early.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 安安然，坦然；之代词，指人或物；素平常。安然相处，和往常一样，不觉得有什么不合适。
explanationTraditional: 安安然，坦然；之代詞，指人或物；素平常。安然相處，和往常一樣，不覺得有什麼不合適。
explanationEn: To bear something with equanimity; to feel at ease and treat it as normal, without finding it inappropriate.
derivation: 清·范寅《越谚·附论·论堕贫》贪逸欲而逃勤苦，丧廉耻而习谄谀，甘居人下，安之若素。”
derivationTraditional: 清·範寅《越諺·附論·論墮貧》貪逸欲而逃勤苦，喪廉恥而習諂諛，甘居人下，安之若素。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Fan Yin, Yue Proverb: 'Greedy for ease and lazy in work, losing integrity and flattering, willingly inferior, bearing it with equanimity.'
example: 第二天宝小姐酒醒，很觉得过意不去◇来彼此熟了，见瞿太太常常如此，也就～了。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十八回
exampleTraditional: 第二天寶小姐酒醒，很覺得過意不去◇來彼此熟了，見瞿太太常常如此，也就～了。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十八回
exampleEn: The next day, Miss Bao woke up from her hangover and felt very sorry. Later, as they became familiar, seeing Mrs. Qu often like this, she also took it in stride. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, The Bureaucrats, Chapter 38

explanation: 个中其中；滋味味道，情味。其中的味道。指切身体会的甘苦。
explanationTraditional: 箇中其中；滋味味道，情味。其中的味道。指切身體會的甘苦。
explanationEn: The taste of it; referring to the personal experience of joys and sorrows.
derivation: 宋·向子谚《西江月·绍兴丁巳，遍走浙东诸郡……》居士何如学士，翰林休笑芗林。个中真味少知音，不是清狂太甚。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·向子諺《西江月·紹興丁巳，遍走浙東諸郡……》居士何如學士，翰林休笑薌林。箇中真味少知音，不是清狂太甚。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Xiang Ziyi, West River Moon: 'What is a layman compared to a scholar? Don't laugh at the forest of fragrance. The true taste of it has few connoisseurs, not because of madness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻著作有价值，流传广。
explanationTraditional: 比喻著作有價值，流傳廣。
explanationEn: Paper becomes expensive in Luoyang; metaphor for a work being so valuable that it is widely circulated.
derivation: 《晋书·左思传》于是豪贵之家竞相传写，洛阳为之纸贵。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·左思傳》於是豪貴之家競相傳寫，洛陽為之紙貴。”
derivationEn: From Book of Jin, Biography of Zuo Si: 'Then wealthy families competed to copy it, causing paper to become expensive in Luoyang.'
example: 人说～”，谁知今日闹到长安扇贵”。此时画的手也酸了，眼也花了。（清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十七回）
exampleTraditional: 人說～”，誰知今日鬧到長安扇貴”。此時畫的手也酸了，眼也花了。（清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十七回）
exampleEn: People say 'paper becomes expensive in Luoyang,' but now fans become expensive in Chang'an. At this moment, my hands are sore and eyes tired from painting. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 77

explanation: 登上。一步跨上青天。比喻一下子就达到很高的境界或程度。有时也用来比喻人突然得志，爬上高位。
explanationTraditional: 登上。一步跨上青天。比喻一下子就達到很高的境界或程度。有時也用來比喻人突然得志，爬上高位。
explanationEn: To reach the sky in one step; metaphor for suddenly reaching a very high level or status, often used for someone who rises to power quickly.
derivation: 清·徐珂《清稗类钞·三十四》巡检作巡抚，一步登天，监生当监临，斯文扫地。”
derivationTraditional: 清·徐珂《清稗類鈔·三十四》巡檢作巡撫，一步登天，監生當監臨，斯文掃地。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Xu Ke, Qing Unofficial Anecdotes: 'A patrol officer becomes governor, reaching the sky in one step; a supervisor becomes a supervisor, sweeping the ground with dignity.'
example: 知识要通过学习逐渐积累，想～是不可能的。
exampleTraditional: 知識要通過學習逐漸積累，想～是不可能的。
exampleEn: Knowledge must be accumulated gradually through learning; it is impossible to reach the sky in one step.

explanation: 伶、俐聪明，灵活。形容人机灵，很会说话。
explanationTraditional: 伶、俐聰明，靈活。形容人機靈，很會說話。
explanationEn: Describes someone who is clever and articulate, very good at speaking.
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《张天师》第三折你休那里便伶牙俐齿，调三干四，说人好歹，讦人暧昧，损人行止。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《張天師》第三折你休那裡便伶牙俐齒，調三幹四，說人好歹，訐人曖昧，損人行止。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Wu Changling's 'Zhang Tianshi', third act: 'You there, with your glib tongue and sharp teeth, stirring up trouble.'
example: 碧莲本来生得～，最会随机应变，把个言中丞及四姨太太巴结的十分喜欢。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第八十四回
exampleTraditional: 碧蓮本來生得～，最會隨機應變，把個言中丞及四姨太太巴結的十分喜歡。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第八十四回
exampleEn: Bilian was naturally glib-tongued and sharp-toothed, best at adapting to situations, and she flattered Governor Yan and his fourth concubine so much that they were very pleased. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 84

explanation: 前先前。从来没有听说过。
explanationTraditional: 前先前。從來沒有聽說過。
explanationEn: Never heard of before; unprecedented.
derivation: 宋·周密《齐东野语·黄婆》此事前所未闻，是知穷荒绝檄，天奇地怪，亦何所不有，未可以见闻所未及，遂以为诞也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《齊東野語·黃婆》此事前所未聞，是知窮荒絕檄，天奇地怪，亦何所不有，未可以見聞所未及，遂以為誕也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhou Mi's 'Qidong Yeyu: Huang Po': 'This matter has never been heard of before; thus one knows that in remote and desolate places, strange wonders abound.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 夜郎汉代西南地区的一个小国。比喻人无知而又狂妄自大。
explanationTraditional: 夜郎漢代西南地區的一個小國。比喻人無知而又狂妄自大。
explanationEn: Refers to someone who is ignorant and arrogantly self-important, like the king of Yelang who thought his small state was larger than Han.
derivation: 《史记·西南夷列传》滇王与汉使者言曰‘汉孰与我大？’及夜郎侯亦然。以道不通，故各以为一州主，不知汉广大。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·西南夷列傳》滇王與漢使者言曰‘漢孰與我大？’及夜郎侯亦然。以道不通，故各以為一州主，不知漢廣大。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Southwest Yi': 'The king of Dian asked the Han envoy, 'Which is larger, Han or my state?' The king of Yelang asked similarly, because the roads were blocked, each thought they were the ruler of a whole region, unaware of Han's vastness.'
example: 驾炮车之狂云，遂以～。恃贪之逆气，漫以河伯为尊。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·绛妃》
exampleTraditional: 駕炮車之狂雲，遂以～。恃貪之逆氣，漫以河伯為尊。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·絳妃》
exampleEn: The wild clouds driving cannon carts then became arrogantly self-important like Yelang. Relying on the rebellious air of greed, they presumptuously regarded the River Earl as supreme. — Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Jiang Fei'

explanation: 表示真心佩服，自认不如。
explanationTraditional: 表示真心佩服，自認不如。
explanationEn: To willingly admit defeat or acknowledge someone's superiority.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》如此议论，才见读书人自有卓见，真是家学渊源，妹子甘拜下风。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》如此議論，才見讀書人自有卓見，真是家學淵源，妹子甘拜下風。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror': 'Such arguments show that a scholar has unique insights; truly a family tradition of learning. I willingly bow to your superiority.'
example: 君神人也，吾等～矣。★清·和邦额《夜谭随录·三官保》
exampleTraditional: 君神人也，吾等～矣。★清·和邦額《夜譚隨錄·三官保》
exampleEn: You are a divine being; we willingly admit defeat. — Qing Dynasty He Bang'e's 'Night Tales: Three Officers'

explanation: 故土出生地，或过去住过的地方，这里指故乡、祖国。难于离开故乡的土地。形容对家乡或祖国有无限的眷恋之情。
explanationTraditional: 故土出生地，或過去住過的地方，這裡指故鄉、祖國。難於離開故鄉的土地。形容對家鄉或祖國有無限的眷戀之情。
explanationEn: Describes a deep attachment to one's homeland, making it hard to leave.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 果真是这样。指不出所料。
explanationTraditional: 果真是這樣。指不出所料。
explanationEn: Indeed it is so; as expected.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·张既传》诸葛恪多辈耳！近张敬仲县论格，以为必见杀，今果然如此。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·張既傳》諸葛恪多輩耳！近張敬仲縣論格，以為必見殺，今果然如此。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Zhang Ji': 'Zhuge Ke is just a youngster! Recently Zhang Jingzhong discussed Ke and predicted he would be killed; now it has indeed turned out so.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一根汗毛也不肯拔。原指杨朱的极端为我主义◇形容为人非常吝啬自私。
explanationTraditional: 一根汗毛也不肯拔。原指楊朱的極端為我主義◇形容為人非常吝嗇自私。
explanationEn: Describes someone who is extremely stingy and selfish, unwilling to give even a single hair.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》杨子取为我，拔一毛而利天下，不为也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》楊子取為我，拔一毛而利天下，不為也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jinxin I': 'Yangzi advocated for oneself; even if pulling out one hair would benefit the world, he would not do it.'
example: 沈姑娘，你也太拿老了！叫我们管山吃山，管水吃水，都象你这～，我们喝西北风。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十一回
exampleTraditional: 沈姑娘，你也太拿老了！叫我們管山吃山，管水吃水，都象你這～，我們喝西北風。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十一回
exampleEn: Miss Shen, you are too arrogant! We live off the mountain and water, but if you are so stingy, we'll have to drink the northwest wind. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 41

explanation: 冷意含讥讽。带讥讽意味的冷冰冰的话。
explanationTraditional: 冷意含譏諷。帶譏諷意味的冷冰冰的話。
explanationEn: Sarcastic and cold remarks; words with a biting tone.
derivation: 《宝林禅师语录》山门疏关着门，尽是自家屋里，何须冷言冷语，暗地敲人？”明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十七只这冷言冷语，带讥带讪的，教人怎么当得！”
derivationTraditional: 《寶林禪師語錄》山門疏關著門，盡是自家屋裡，何須冷言冷語，暗地敲人？”明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十七隻這冷言冷語，帶譏帶訕的，教人怎麼當得！”
derivationEn: From 'Baolin Chan Master's Sayings': 'With the door closed, all are within one's own house; why use cold words and cold phrases to secretly attack others?' Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 37: 'Such cold words and cold phrases, with sarcasm and ridicule, how can one bear them!'
example: 朱老忠一问，严志和又火呛起来，～说那谁又知道呢？”★梁斌《红旗谱》三十六
exampleTraditional: 朱老忠一問，嚴志和又火嗆起來，～說那誰又知道呢？”★梁斌《紅旗譜》三十六
exampleEn: As soon as Zhu Laozhong asked, Yan Zhihe became angry again and said coldly, 'Who knows that?' — Liang Bin's 'Red Flag Chronicle', Chapter 36

explanation: 履踩。像走在平地上一样。比喻从事某项活动十分顺利。
explanationTraditional: 履踩。像走在平地上一樣。比喻從事某項活動十分順利。
explanationEn: As if walking on level ground; describes doing something with great ease and smoothness.
derivation: 唐·裴铏《周邯》因夷人卖奴，年十四五，视其貌甚慧黠。言善入水，如履平地。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·裴鉶《周邯》因夷人賣奴，年十四五，視其貌甚慧黠。言善入水，如履平地。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Pei Xing's 'Zhou Han': 'A barbarian sold a slave, about fourteen or fifteen, with a clever look. He said he was good at entering water, as if walking on level ground.'
example: 一个最勇敢的叫徐骧，生的矮小精悍，膂力过人，跳山越涧，～。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 一個最勇敢的叫徐驤，生的矮小精悍，膂力過人，跳山越澗，～。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十三回
exampleEn: The bravest one, named Xu Xiang, was short but sturdy, with extraordinary strength; he could leap over mountains and streams as if walking on level ground. — Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower of the Sea', Chapter 33

explanation: 朝朝见；凤凤凰，古代传说中的鸟王。旧时喻指君主圣明而天下依附，后也比喻德高望重者众望所归。
explanationTraditional: 朝朝見；鳳鳳凰，古代傳說中的鳥王。舊時喻指君主聖明而天下依附，後也比喻德高望重者眾望所歸。
explanationEn: Hundred birds paying homage to the phoenix; metaphor for a virtuous ruler attracting widespread support, or a highly respected person receiving universal acclaim.
derivation: 宋·李昿等《太平御览》九百一十五卷引《唐书》海州言凤见于城上，群鸟数百随之，东北飞向苍梧山。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李昿等《太平御覽》九百一十五卷引《唐書》海州言鳳見於城上，群鳥數百隨之，東北飛向蒼梧山。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Li Fang et al.'s 'Taiping Imperial Reader', Volume 915, quoting 'Tang Shu': 'A phoenix was seen on the city wall in Haizhou, followed by hundreds of birds flying northeast toward Cangwu Mountain.'
example: 那些玉斝中的长春露酒也都由站在身边侍候的宫女接过去倾入一只绘着～的大瓷缸中。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十一章
exampleTraditional: 那些玉斝中的長春露酒也都由站在身邊侍候的宮女接過去傾入一隻繪著～的大瓷缸中。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十一章
exampleEn: The cups of Changchun dew wine were taken by the attending maids and poured into a large porcelain jar painted with a scene of a hundred birds paying homage to the phoenix. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 31

explanation: 本指游乐休息的环境◇多指谈情说爱的处所。
explanationTraditional: 本指遊樂休息的環境◇多指談情說愛的處所。
explanationEn: Originally refers to an environment for leisure and entertainment; later mostly refers to a place for romantic dating.
derivation: 唐·白居易《老病》诗尽听笙歌夜醉眠，若非月下即花前。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《老病》詩盡聽笙歌夜醉眠，若非月下即花前。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi's poem 'Old and Ill': 'Listening to songs and drunk at night, if not under the moon, then before flowers.'
example: ～，几度销魂，未识多情面，空遗泪痕。★明·胡文焕《群音类选·红叶记·红叶重逢》
exampleTraditional: ～，幾度銷魂，未識多情面，空遺淚痕。★明·胡文煥《群音類選·紅葉記·紅葉重逢》
exampleEn: Before flowers and under the moon, how many times have I been enchanted, not knowing the affectionate face, leaving only tear stains. — Ming Dynasty, Hu Wenhuan's 'Selected Tunes: Red Leaf Story'

explanation: 早晨不能知道晚上会变成什么样子或发生什么情况。形容形势危急，难以预料。
explanationTraditional: 早晨不能知道晚上會變成什麼樣子或發生什麼情況。形容形勢危急，難以預料。
explanationEn: In the morning, one cannot be sure of what will happen by evening. Describes a critical and unpredictable situation.
derivation: 晋·李密《陈情表》人命危浅，朝不虑夕。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·李密《陳情表》人命危淺，朝不慮夕。”
derivationEn: From Li Mi's 'Chen Qing Biao' of Jin Dynasty: 'Human life is precarious, not even sure of the evening in the morning.'
example: 这通告示，轰动了整个固始城，津津乐道，竟似忘了身在危城，～。★高阳《清宫外史》上册
exampleTraditional: 這通告示，轟動了整個固始城，津津樂道，竟似忘了身在危城，～。★高陽《清宮外史》上冊
exampleEn: This notice stirred the entire city of Gushi, people talked about it with relish, as if forgetting they were in a dangerous city, uncertain of the evening. — Gao Yang's 'Inside the Qing Palace' Volume 1

explanation: 长江的水往东奔流而去◇借用为词牌名。多表示陈迹消逝，历史向前发展。
explanationTraditional: 長江的水往東奔流而去◇借用為詞牌名。多表示陳跡消逝，歷史向前發展。
explanationEn: The Yangtze River flows eastward; later used as a ci poetry title. Often indicates the passing of old traces and the forward movement of history.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《赤壁怀古》大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《赤壁懷古》大江東去，浪淘盡，千古風流人物。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Remembering the Past at Red Cliff': 'The great river flows east, washing away all the gallant figures of the ages.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 数量多，速度快，质量好，成本省。
explanationTraditional: 數量多，速度快，質量好，成本省。
explanationEn: More quantity, faster speed, better quality, and lower cost.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 挂钩取，这里指说到，提到；漏遗漏。形容说得不全，遗漏很多。
explanationTraditional: 掛鉤取，這裡指說到，提到；漏遺漏。形容說得不全，遺漏很多。
explanationEn: To mention one item while missing ten thousand. Describes an incomplete account with many omissions.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《南山》诗团辞试提挈，挂一念万漏。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《南山》詩團辭試提挈，掛一念萬漏。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's poem 'South Mountain' of Tang Dynasty: 'Trying to summarize with words, mentioning one but missing ten thousand.'
example: 相望二千里外，明月此心，恳恳侧厘，～。★宋·文天祥《与游提刑汶》
exampleTraditional: 相望二千里外，明月此心，懇懇側釐，～。★宋·文天祥《與遊提刑汶》
exampleEn: Separated by two thousand miles, this heart is sincere and earnest, but I fear I have mentioned one and missed ten thousand. — Song Dynasty, Wen Tianxiang's 'Letter to You Tixing Wen'

explanation: 错交叉，错杂。比喻交界线很曲折，象狗牙那样参差不齐。也比喻情况复杂，双方有多种因素参差交错。
explanationTraditional: 錯交叉，錯雜。比喻交界線很曲折，象狗牙那樣參差不齊。也比喻情況複雜，雙方有多種因素參差交錯。
explanationEn: Interlocking like dog's teeth. Describes a zigzag boundary or a complex situation with multiple interwoven factors.
derivation: 《汉书·中山靖王传》诸侯王自以骨肉至亲，先帝所以广封连城，犬牙相错者，为盘石宗也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·中山靖王傳》諸侯王自以骨肉至親，先帝所以廣封連城，犬牙相錯者，為盤石宗也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Prince Zhongshan Jing': 'The feudal princes, being close relatives, were granted contiguous territories interlocking like dog's teeth to form a solid foundation.'
example: 而苗疆多与邻省～，又必归并事权，始可一劳永逸。（《清史稿·土司一》）
exampleTraditional: 而苗疆多與鄰省～，又必歸併事權，始可一勞永逸。（《清史稿·土司一》）
exampleEn: The Miao region often interlocked with neighboring provinces, and only by unifying authority could lasting peace be achieved. — 'Draft History of Qing: Chieftains 1'

explanation: 斑鸠不会做窠，常强占喜鹊的窠。比喻强占别人的住屋。
explanationTraditional: 斑鳩不會做窠，常強佔喜鵲的窠。比喻強佔別人的住屋。
explanationEn: The turtledove cannot build a nest and often occupies the magpie's nest. Metaphor for forcibly occupying someone else's home.
derivation: 《诗经·召南·鹊巢》维雀有巢，维鸠居上。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·召南·鵲巢》維雀有巢，維鳩居上。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Shao Nan: Magpie's Nest': 'The magpie has a nest, the turtledove occupies it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人定指人谋。指人力能够战胜自然。
explanationTraditional: 人定指人謀。指人力能夠戰勝自然。
explanationEn: Human determination can overcome nature. Refers to human effort prevailing over natural forces.
derivation: 《逸周书·文传》人强胜天。”宋·刘过《襄阳歌》人定兮胜天，半壁久无胡日月。”
derivationTraditional: 《逸周書·文傳》人強勝天。”宋·劉過《襄陽歌》人定兮勝天，半壁久無胡日月。”
derivationEn: From 'Yi Zhou Shu: Wen Zhuan': 'Human strength overcomes heaven.' Also from Liu Guo's 'Xiangyang Song' of Song Dynasty: 'Human determination overcomes heaven, half the land long without barbarian sun and moon.'
example: 彼虽不来，宁禁我不往，登门就之，或～不可知？★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·萧七》
exampleTraditional: 彼雖不來，寧禁我不往，登門就之，或～不可知？★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·蕭七》
exampleEn: Even if he does not come, can I not go to him? If I visit him, perhaps human determination can overcome heaven? — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Xiao Qi'

explanation: 指过恣意享乐的生活。
explanationTraditional: 指過恣意享樂的生活。
explanationEn: Indulging in eating, drinking, and seeking pleasure; living a life of dissipation.
derivation: 魏巍《路标》却有人认为糊糊涂涂地吃喝玩乐，那才算没有虚掷自己的年华。”
derivationTraditional: 魏巍《路標》卻有人認為糊糊塗塗地吃喝玩樂，那才算沒有虛擲自己的年華。”
derivationEn: From Wei Wei's 'Road Sign': 'Some think that muddling through life with eating, drinking, and pleasure is not wasting one's youth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 佛家语，指有罪的人只要回心转意，痛改前非，就能登上彼岸”，获得超度◇比喻做坏事的人，只要决心悔改，就有出路。
explanationTraditional: 佛家語，指有罪的人只要回心轉意，痛改前非，就能登上彼岸”，獲得超度◇比喻做壞事的人，只要決心悔改，就有出路。
explanationEn: Buddhist term: a sinner who repents and reforms can reach the 'other shore' and attain salvation. Metaphor for evildoers who resolve to mend their ways will find a way out.
derivation: 元·无名氏《度翠柳》第一折世俗人没来由，争长竞短，你死我活。有呵吃些个，有呵穿些个。苦海无边，回头是岸。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《度翠柳》第一折世俗人沒來由，爭長競短，你死我活。有呵吃些個，有呵穿些個。苦海無邊，回頭是岸。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Du Cui Liu' Act 1: 'Worldly people have no reason to compete over length and life. If you have some, eat; if you have some, wear. The sea of suffering is boundless, but turning back leads to the shore.'
example: 只要他们认破迷津，那便～。★郭沫若《南冠草》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 只要他們認破迷津，那便～。★郭沫若《南冠草》第一幕
exampleEn: As long as they recognize the maze of delusion, then turning back leads to the shore. — Guo Moruo's 'Southern Crown' Act 1

explanation: 形容相同的自然景观一个接一个不间断地出现。
explanationTraditional: 形容相同的自然景觀一個接一個不間斷地出現。
explanationEn: Describes a continuous, unbroken sequence of similar natural landscapes.
derivation: 《孔子家语·观周》涓涓不雍，终为江河；绵绵不绝，或成网罗。”
derivationTraditional: 《孔子家語·觀周》涓涓不雍，終為江河；綿綿不絕，或成網羅。”
derivationEn: From 'The Family Sayings of Confucius: Observing Zhou': 'A trickling stream that is not blocked will eventually become a river; a continuous thread that is not broken may form a net.'
example: ～的游行队伍正往这边涌来。
exampleTraditional: ～的遊行隊伍正往這邊湧來。
exampleEn: The endless procession of marchers is surging this way.

explanation: 合配合∶象是上天给予安排，很完美地配合到一起。祝人婚姻美满的话。
explanationTraditional: 合配合∶象是上天給予安排，很完美地配合到一起。祝人婚姻美滿的話。
explanationEn: A match made in heaven; a perfect union arranged by fate, often used to bless a marriage.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·大明》天监在下，有命既集，文王初载，天作之合。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·大明》天監在下，有命既集，文王初載，天作之合。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Greater Odes: Da Ming': 'Heaven oversees below, its decree has been gathered; in King Wen's early years, heaven made a match for him.'
example: 年长兄，我同你是～”，不比寻常同年弟兄。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第七回
exampleTraditional: 年長兄，我同你是～”，不比尋常同年弟兄。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第七回
exampleEn: Elder brother, you and I are a match made in heaven, not like ordinary fellow graduates. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 7

explanation: 指盛产鱼和稻米的富饶地方。
explanationTraditional: 指盛產魚和稻米的富饒地方。
explanationEn: A land of fish and rice; a fertile and prosperous region abundant in natural resources.
derivation: 唐·王睃《清移突厥降人于南中安置疏》谄以缯帛之利，示以麋鹿之饶，说其鱼米之乡，陈其畜牧之地。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王睃《清移突厥降人於南中安置疏》諂以繒帛之利，示以麋鹿之饒，說其魚米之鄉，陳其畜牧之地。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Wang Jun's 'Memorial on Relocating the Surrendered Turks to the South': 'Tempt them with the benefits of silk, show them the abundance of deer, speak of the land of fish and rice, and describe the place of pastures.'
example: 我知江州是个好地面，～，特地使钱买将那里去。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第三十六回
exampleTraditional: 我知江州是個好地面，～，特地使錢買將那裡去。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第三十六回
exampleEn: I know Jiangzhou is a good place, a land of fish and rice; I spent money to be sent there. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 36

explanation: 奸坏事；科法律条文。为非作歹，触犯法令。
explanationTraditional: 奸壞事；科法律條文。為非作歹，觸犯法令。
explanationEn: To commit crimes and violate the law; to engage in evil deeds and break legal statutes.
derivation: 三国蜀·诸葛亮《出师表》若有作奸犯科及为忠善者，宜付有司论其刑赏。”
derivationTraditional: 三國蜀·諸葛亮《出師表》若有作奸犯科及為忠善者，宜付有司論其刑賞。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Shu, Zhuge Liang's 'Memorial on Sending Out the Troops': 'If there are those who commit crimes or do good, they should be handed over to the authorities for judgment and reward or punishment.'
example: 今儿子既在你处，必然是你～，诱藏了我娘子，有甚么得解说？★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷三十八
exampleTraditional: 今兒子既在你處，必然是你～，誘藏了我娘子，有甚麼得解說？★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷三十八
exampleEn: Now that my son is with you, you must have committed crimes and lured away my wife; what explanation do you have? — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 38

explanation: 丈夫死了不再嫁人，这时旧时束缚妇女的封建礼教。
explanationTraditional: 丈夫死了不再嫁人，這時舊時束縛婦女的封建禮教。
explanationEn: To remain faithful to one's husband until death, even after his death; a feudal moral code binding women to lifelong fidelity.
derivation: 《周易·恒》曰妇人贞洁，从一而终也。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·恆》曰婦人貞潔，從一而終也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Heng': 'It is said that a woman's chastity means following one man to the end.'
example: 同一个人，怎的女子就该～，男子便许大妻大妾？★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 同一個人，怎的女子就該～，男子便許大妻大妾？★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十七回
exampleEn: For the same person, why should a woman be faithful to one man for life, while a man may have many wives and concubines? — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of a Heroic Couple', Chapter 27

explanation: 在急流中勇敢地立即退却。比喻做官的人在得意时为了避祸而及时引退。
explanationTraditional: 在急流中勇敢地立即退卻。比喻做官的人在得意時為了避禍而及時引退。
explanationEn: To resolutely retreat in a swift current; metaphorically, to retire from official life at the height of one's career to avoid disaster.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《赠善相程杰》诗火色上腾虽有数，急流勇退岂无人。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《贈善相程傑》詩火色上騰雖有數，急流勇退豈無人。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Su Shi's poem 'Presented to the Physiognomist Cheng Jie': 'Though the fiery color rises, there are numbers; who says there is no one to bravely retreat in the rapids?'
example: 官人宜～，为山林娱老之计。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三十一
exampleTraditional: 官人宜～，為山林娛老之計。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三十一
exampleEn: Sir, you should bravely retreat in the rapids and plan for a life of leisure in the mountains and forests. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 31

explanation: 矫使弯的变成直的；揉使直的变成弯的。比喻故意做作，不自然。
explanationTraditional: 矯使彎的變成直的；揉使直的變成彎的。比喻故意做作，不自然。
explanationEn: To make crooked straight and straight crooked; to be artificial and affected, lacking naturalness.
derivation: 《周易·说卦》坎，为矫揉，为引轮。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·說卦》坎，為矯揉，為引輪。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Shuo Gua': 'Kan represents bending and straightening, and pulling wheels.'
example: 他们原是好好妇人，却要装作男人，可谓～了。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十二回
exampleTraditional: 他們原是好好婦人，卻要裝作男人，可謂～了。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十二回
exampleEn: They are originally good women, but they pretend to be men; this can be called artificial and affected. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 32

explanation: 流流传；芳香，指好名声；百世时间久远∶的名声永远流传下去。
explanationTraditional: 流流傳；芳香，指好名聲；百世時間久遠∶的名聲永遠流傳下去。
explanationEn: To leave a good name for a hundred generations; to have one's reputation handed down through the ages.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·后妃传》并以圣明，流芳上世。”《晋书·桓温传》既不能流芳百世，亦不足复遗臭万载耶！”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·后妃傳》並以聖明，流芳上世。”《晉書·桓溫傳》既不能流芳百世，亦不足復遺臭萬載耶！”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei: Biography of Empress Dowager Bian': 'Both were sage and bright, leaving fragrance in previous ages.' Also 'Book of Jin: Biography of Huan Wen': 'If I cannot leave a good name for a hundred generations, why not leave a stench for ten thousand years?'
example: 将军若扶汉室，乃忠臣也，青史传名，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九回
exampleTraditional: 將軍若扶漢室，乃忠臣也，青史傳名，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九回
exampleEn: General, if you support the Han dynasty, you are a loyal minister, and your name will be recorded in history and handed down for a hundred generations. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 9

explanation: 舛不顺，不幸。命运充满不顺。指一生坎坷，屡受挫折。
explanationTraditional: 舛不順，不幸。命運充滿不順。指一生坎坷，屢受挫折。
explanationEn: A life full of misfortune; to experience many setbacks and hardships.
derivation: 唐·王勃《滕王阁饯别序》时运不齐，命途多舛。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《滕王閣餞別序》時運不齊，命途多舛。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Wang Bo's 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng': 'Fate is unfavorable, and the course of life is full of adversity.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 玩玩赏；丧丧失；志志气。指迷恋于所玩赏的事物而消磨了积极进取的志气。
explanationTraditional: 玩玩賞；喪喪失；志志氣。指迷戀於所玩賞的事物而消磨了積極進取的志氣。
explanationEn: To be obsessed with trivial pleasures and lose one's ambition; to indulge in hobbies to the detriment of one's goals.
derivation: 《书·旅獒》玩人丧德，玩物丧志。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·旅獒》玩人喪德，玩物喪志。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Journey of the Dog': 'Playing with people loses virtue; playing with things loses ambition.'
example: 道学家教人少作诗文，说是～”，说是害道”，那么诗文成了废话，这所谓诗文指表情的作品而言。★朱自清《论废话》
exampleTraditional: 道學家教人少作詩文，說是～”，說是害道”，那麼詩文成了廢話，這所謂詩文指表情的作品而言。★朱自清《論廢話》
exampleEn: Moralists teach people to write less poetry and prose, saying it is 'playing with things and losing ambition' or 'harming the Way'; thus poetry and prose become mere words, referring to works of emotion. — Zhu Ziqing, 'On Nonsense'

explanation: 这里起来，那里下去。形容接连不断。
explanationTraditional: 這裡起來，那裡下去。形容接連不斷。
explanationEn: Rising here and falling there. Describes a continuous succession.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》时大时小时缩时伸是经常的，此起彼落也往往发生。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》時大時小時縮時伸是經常的，此起彼落也往往發生。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War': 'Sometimes large, sometimes small; sometimes contracting, sometimes expanding; this is common, and rising here and falling there often occurs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 传说一种叫蜮的动物，在水中含沙喷射人的影子，使人生病。比喻暗中攻击或陷害人。
explanationTraditional: 傳說一種叫蜮的動物，在水中含沙噴射人的影子，使人生病。比喻暗中攻擊或陷害人。
explanationEn: A legendary creature called yu spits sand at people's shadows to cause illness. Metaphor for attacking or framing someone covertly.
derivation: 晋·干宝《搜神记》卷十二其名曰蜮，一曰短狐，能含沙射人，所中者则身体筋急，头痛、发热，剧者至死。”南朝宋·鲍照《苦热行》含沙射流影，吹蛊痛行晖。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·幹寶《搜神記》卷十二其名曰蜮，一曰短狐，能含沙射人，所中者則身體筋急，頭痛、發熱，劇者至死。”南朝宋·鮑照《苦熱行》含沙射流影，吹蠱痛行暉。”
derivationEn: Gan Bao, 'Sou Shen Ji', vol. 12: 'Its name is yu, also called short fox, can spit sand to hit people; those hit suffer muscle spasms, headache, fever, and severe cases lead to death.' Bao Zhao, 'Bitter Heat': 'Spitting sand hits flowing shadows, blowing poison harms moving light.'
example: 张氏昨日又在《青光》栏上登一启事，～，肆意诬毁。★鲁迅《伪自由书·后记》引黎烈文启事
exampleTraditional: 張氏昨日又在《青光》欄上登一啟事，～，肆意誣毀。★魯迅《偽自由書·後記》引黎烈文啟事
exampleEn: Mr. Zhang recently published a notice in the 'Qingguang' column, covertly attacking and slandering. (Lu Xun, 'Pseudo-Free Book: Postscript', citing Li Liewen's notice)

explanation: 很快乐，不思念蜀国。比喻在新环境中得到乐趣，不再想回到原来环境中去。
explanationTraditional: 很快樂，不思念蜀國。比喻在新環境中得到樂趣，不再想回到原來環境中去。
explanationEn: So happy that one forgets about Shu. Metaphor for enjoying a new environment so much that one no longer wants to return to the original one.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀书·后主传》裴松之注引《汉晋春秋》问禅曰‘颇思蜀否？’禅曰‘此间乐，不思蜀。’”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀書·後主傳》裴松之注引《漢晉春秋》問禪曰‘頗思蜀否？’禪曰‘此間樂，不思蜀。’”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Book of Shu: Biography of the Later Lord', Pei Songzhi's annotation citing 'Han Jin Chun Qiu': 'Sima Zhao asked Liu Shan, 'Do you miss Shu?' Liu Shan replied, 'I am happy here and do not miss Shu.''
example: 那麦思敦更觉气色傲然，或饮或食，忽踊忽歌，大有此间～”之意。★鲁迅《月界旅行》第七回
exampleTraditional: 那麥思敦更覺氣色傲然，或飲或食，忽踴忽歌，大有此間～”之意。★魯迅《月界旅行》第七回
exampleEn: Maisden looked even more proud, eating, drinking, jumping, and singing, as if he had the intention of 'being happy here and not missing Shu.' (Lu Xun, 'Journey to the Moon', Chapter 7)

explanation: 形容工作全面展开，没有重点。
explanationTraditional: 形容工作全面展開，沒有重點。
explanationEn: Launching attacks on all fronts. Describes working comprehensively without focus.
derivation: 毛泽东《不要四面出击》总之不要四面出击。四面出击，全国紧张，很不好。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《不要四面出擊》總之不要四面出擊。四面出擊，全國緊張，很不好。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'Don't Attack on All Fronts': 'In short, don't attack on all fronts. Attacking on all fronts makes the whole country tense, which is very bad.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 载装载，引伸为阐明；道道理，泛指思想。指文章是为了说明道理的。
explanationTraditional: 載裝載，引伸為闡明；道道理，泛指思想。指文章是為了說明道理的。
explanationEn: Writing is used to convey truth. Refers to the idea that articles are meant to explain principles.
derivation: 宋·周敦颐《通书·文辞》文所以载道也。轮辕饰而人弗庸，徒饰也，况虚车乎。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周敦頤《通書·文辭》文所以載道也。輪轅飾而人弗庸，徒飾也，況虛車乎。”
derivationEn: Zhou Dunyi, 'Tongshu: Wenci': 'Writing is the vehicle for truth. If the wheels and shafts are decorated but not used, it's just decoration, let alone an empty carriage.'
example: 古人说～”，用现在的话说，写文章就是表达思想。★郭沫若《关于文风问题答〈新观察〉记者问》
exampleTraditional: 古人說～”，用現在的話說，寫文章就是表達思想。★郭沫若《關於文風問題答〈新觀察〉記者問》
exampleEn: The ancients said 'writing is for conveying truth'; in modern terms, writing expresses thoughts. (Guo Moruo, 'On Style Issues in Answer to Xin Guancha Reporter')

explanation: 指修养身心，以期保健延年的方法。
explanationTraditional: 指修養身心，以期保健延年的方法。
explanationEn: Methods of nurturing health and prolonging life.
derivation: 《庄子·养生主》吾闻庖丁之言，得养生焉。”唐·成玄英疏遂悟养生之道也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·養生主》吾聞庖丁之言，得養生焉。”唐·成玄英疏遂悟養生之道也。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: The Secret of Caring for Life': 'I have learned the way of nurturing life from the cook's words.' Tang Dynasty Cheng Xuanying's commentary: 'Thus he understood the way of nurturing life.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 所作所为把自己引上绝路。
explanationTraditional: 所作所為把自己引上絕路。
explanationEn: One's own actions lead to one's doom.
derivation: 《阴符经》卷下沉水入火，自取灭亡。”
derivationTraditional: 《陰符經》卷下沉水入火，自取滅亡。”
derivationEn: 'Yinfu Jing', vol. 2: 'Sinking into water and entering fire is self-destruction.'
example: 倭兵犯顺，～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 倭兵犯順，～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十五回
exampleEn: The Japanese troops invaded and brought destruction upon themselves. (Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 35)

explanation: 辄即；咎过失，罪责。动不动就受到指摘或责难。
explanationTraditional: 輒即；咎過失，罪責。動不動就受到指摘或責難。
explanationEn: Every move invites blame or criticism.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《进学解》跋前踬后，动辄得咎。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《進學解》跋前躓後，動輒得咎。”
derivationEn: Han Yu, 'Jinxue Jie': 'Stumbling forward and falling backward, every move invites blame.'
example: 小厮因～，只得说道请问主人前引也不好，后随也不好，并行也不好，究竟怎样才好呢？”★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十八回
exampleTraditional: 小廝因～，只得說道請問主人前引也不好，後隨也不好，並行也不好，究竟怎樣才好呢？”★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十八回
exampleEn: The servant, being blamed for every move, had to ask: 'May I ask the master, if leading is wrong, following is wrong, and walking side by side is also wrong, then what is the right way?' (Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 78)

explanation: 指以名利地位引诱别人来帮助自己达到不正当的目的。
explanationTraditional: 指以名利地位引誘別人來幫助自己達到不正當的目的。
explanationEn: To promise official positions and rewards to lure others into helping achieve improper goals.
derivation: 陶菊隐《北洋军阀统治时期史话》第七十一章尽管一再限期攻下怀来，并且用封官许愿的办法来鼓励将士，但是他的阵地始终没有进展一步。”
derivationTraditional: 陶菊隱《北洋軍閥統治時期史話》第七十一章儘管一再限期攻下懷來，並且用封官許願的辦法來鼓勵將士，但是他的陣地始終沒有進展一步。”
derivationEn: Tao Juyin, 'History of the Warlord Period in the Northern Warlords', Chapter 71: 'Although he repeatedly set deadlines to capture Huailai and encouraged soldiers with promises of official positions and rewards, his front line never advanced a step.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 九霄高空。在九重天的外面。比喻无限远的地方或远得无影无踪。
explanationTraditional: 九霄高空。在九重天的外面。比喻無限遠的地方或遠得無影無蹤。
explanationEn: Beyond the nine heavens. Metaphor for an infinitely distant place or completely out of sight.
derivation: 北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·文章》一事惬当，一句清巧，神厉九霄，志凌千载。”元·无名氏《抱妆盒》第二折太子也你在这七宝盒中，我陈琳早魂飞九霄云外。”
derivationTraditional: 北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·文章》一事愜當，一句清巧，神厲九霄，志凌千載。”元·無名氏《抱妝盒》第二折太子也你在這七寶盒中，我陳琳早魂飛九霄雲外。”
derivationEn: Yan Zhitui, 'Yan Family Instructions: Literature': 'When a matter is appropriate and a phrase is clever, the spirit soars to the nine heavens, the will transcends a thousand years.' Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Bao Zhuang He', Act 2: 'Prince, you are in this seven-treasure box, and I, Chen Lin, have already flown beyond the nine clouds.'
example: 婶娘那时怎样疼我来，如今就忘在～？★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百一回
exampleTraditional: 嬸孃那時怎樣疼我來，如今就忘在～？★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百一回
exampleEn: How much did Auntie dote on me then, and now I am forgotten beyond the nine clouds? (Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 101)

explanation: 四海天下。名声传扬到天下。形容名声很大。
explanationTraditional: 四海天下。名聲傳揚到天下。形容名聲很大。
explanationEn: One's fame spreads all over the world; to be known far and wide.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《五侯宴》第四折雄纠纠名扬四海，喜孜孜笑满腮。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《五侯宴》第四折雄糾糾名揚四海，喜孜孜笑滿腮。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'The Banquet of the Five Marquises', fourth act: 'With heroic spirit, fame spreads across the four seas; with joy, smiles fill the cheeks.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 叶公春秋时楚国贵族，名子高，封于叶（古邑名，今河南叶县）。比喻口头上说爱好某事物，实际上并不真爱好。
explanationTraditional: 葉公春秋時楚國貴族，名子高，封於葉（古邑名，今河南葉縣）。比喻口頭上說愛好某事物，實際上並不真愛好。
explanationEn: To profess a liking for something while actually fearing it; to be insincere in one's stated interests.
derivation: 汉·刘向《新序·杂事》记载叶公子高非常喜欢龙，器物上刻着龙，房屋上也画着龙。真龙知道了，来到叶公家里，把头探进窗子。叶公一见，吓得拔腿就跑。
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《新序·雜事》記載葉公子高非常喜歡龍，器物上刻著龍，房屋上也畫著龍。真龍知道了，來到葉公家裡，把頭探進窗子。葉公一見，嚇得拔腿就跑。
derivationEn: From Liu Xiang's 'New Prefaces' of the Han Dynasty: Lord Ye of the Spring and Autumn period loved dragons so much that he decorated his home with dragon motifs. When a real dragon visited, he fled in terror.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一寸土地也不让人。
explanationTraditional: 一寸土地也不讓人。
explanationEn: Not to yield an inch of land; to defend every inch of territory.
derivation: 张震《英明的预见，正确的战役方针——回忆淮海战役》寸土必守，寸土不让，坚决守住阵地。”
derivationTraditional: 張震《英明的預見，正確的戰役方針——回憶淮海戰役》寸土必守，寸土不讓，堅決守住陣地。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Zhen's 'Wise Foresight, Correct Battle Strategy—Recalling the Huaihai Campaign': 'Defend every inch of land, yield not an inch, and resolutely hold the position.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 欺骗世人，窃取名誉。
explanationTraditional: 欺騙世人，竊取名譽。
explanationEn: To deceive the world and steal fame; to gain reputation by fraud.
derivation: 《荀子·不苟》夫富贵者则类傲之；夫贫贱者则求柔之。是非仁人之情也，是奸人将以盗名于暗世者也，险莫大焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·不苟》夫富貴者則類傲之；夫貧賤者則求柔之。是非仁人之情也，是奸人將以盜名於暗世者也，險莫大焉。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi's 'Bu Gou': 'The wealthy and noble are often arrogant; the poor and humble are often submissive. This is not the sentiment of a benevolent person, but that of a villain who steals fame in a dark age. There is no greater danger.'
example: 不知平日所讲何学，居然～。★清·阮葵生《茶余客话》卷十
exampleTraditional: 不知平日所講何學，居然～。★清·阮葵生《茶餘客話》卷十
exampleEn: I wonder what learning he usually professes, yet he actually deceives the world and steals fame. — from Ruan Kuisheng's 'Tea Guest Talks' Volume 10, Qing Dynasty.

explanation: 象刚从梦中醒来。比喻过去一直糊涂，在别人或事实的启发下，刚刚明白过来。
explanationTraditional: 象剛從夢中醒來。比喻過去一直糊塗，在別人或事實的啟發下，剛剛明白過來。
explanationEn: As if waking from a dream; to suddenly realize the truth after being confused.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十一回寡人闻仲之言，如梦初醒。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十一回寡人聞仲之言，如夢初醒。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 11: 'Upon hearing Zhong's words, I feel as if waking from a dream.'
example: 众人听了，～，尽皆喜悦。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十回
exampleTraditional: 眾人聽了，～，盡皆喜悅。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十回
exampleEn: Upon hearing this, everyone felt as if waking from a dream and were all delighted. — from Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 30, Qing Dynasty.

explanation: 声歌舞；色女色；犬养狗；马骑马。形容剥削阶级荒淫无耻的生活方式。
explanationTraditional: 聲歌舞；色女色；犬養狗；馬騎馬。形容剝削階級荒淫無恥的生活方式。
explanationEn: Music, women, dogs, and horses—referring to the decadent and hedonistic lifestyle of the exploiting class.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·续黄梁》声色狗马，昼夜荒淫，国计民生，罔存念虑。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·續黃梁》聲色狗馬，晝夜荒淫，國計民生，罔存念慮。”
