derivationEn: From Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio', 'Continued Yellow Millet Dream': 'With music, women, dogs, and horses, indulging day and night in debauchery, with no thought for the nation's welfare.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 词牌名。
explanationTraditional: 詞牌名。
explanationEn: A name of a Chinese poetic form (ci poetry).
derivation: 相传隋炀帝开汴河时曾制《水调歌》，唐人演为大曲。大曲有散序、中序、入破三部分，歌头”当为中序的第一章。双调九十四字至九十七字，前后片各四平韵。宋人于前后片中的各两个六字句，多夹叶仄韵。也有平仄互叶几乎句句押韵的。共八体。
derivationTraditional: 相傳隋煬帝開汴河時曾制《水調歌》，唐人演為大麴。大麴有散序、中序、入破三部分，歌頭”當為中序的第一章。雙調九十四字至九十七字，前後片各四平韻。宋人於前後片中的各兩個六字句，多夾葉仄韻。也有平仄互葉幾乎句句押韻的。共八體。
derivationEn: It is said that Emperor Yang of Sui composed 'Water Melody' when digging the Bian River. The Tang dynasty developed it into a grand suite. 'Song Head' likely refers to the first stanza of the middle section. It has 94 to 97 characters in double stanzas, with four level tones per stanza. Song poets often inserted oblique rhymes in the two six-character lines of each stanza. There are eight variations.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 至最。旧时特指孔子。
explanationTraditional: 至最。舊時特指孔子。
explanationEn: The Supreme Sage and Foremost Teacher—a traditional title for Confucius.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》唯天下至圣，为能联盟睿知，足以有临也。”《礼记·文王世子》凡始立学者，必释奠于先圣先师。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》唯天下至聖，為能聯盟睿知，足以有臨也。”《禮記·文王世子》凡始立學者，必釋奠於先聖先師。”
derivationEn: From 'The Doctrine of the Mean': 'Only the supreme sage under heaven is wise and insightful, capable of ruling.' And from 'The Record of Rites': 'When establishing a school, one must offer sacrifices to the former sage and former teacher.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 连最普通的丁”字也不认识。形容一个字也不认得。
explanationTraditional: 連最普通的丁”字也不認識。形容一個字也不認得。
explanationEn: Not to know even the simplest character 'ding'; to be completely illiterate.
derivation: 《旧唐书·张弘靖传》今天下无事，汝辈挽得两石力弓，不如识一丁字。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·張弘靖傳》今天下無事，汝輩挽得兩石力弓，不如識一丁字。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang', Biography of Zhang Hongjing: 'In these peaceful times, you might as well draw a bow of two stone strength, but it's better to know one character 'ding'.'
example: 我试问如果你母亲要把你嫁给一个～的俗商，或者一个中年官僚，或者一个纨裦子弟，你难产也不反抗？★巴金《家》二十五
exampleTraditional: 我試問如果你母親要把你嫁給一個～的俗商，或者一箇中年官僚，或者一個紈裦子弟，你難產也不反抗？★巴金《家》二十五
exampleEn: I ask you, if your mother wanted to marry you to an illiterate vulgar merchant, or a middle-aged bureaucrat, or a dandy, would you not resist? — from Ba Jin's 'Family', Chapter 25.

explanation: 犹言好不容易。
explanationTraditional: 猶言好不容易。
explanationEn: Extremely difficult; with great difficulty.
derivation: 元·金仁杰《追韩信》第二折干功名千难万难，求身仕两次三番。”
derivationTraditional: 元·金仁杰《追韓信》第二折幹功名千難萬難，求身仕兩次三番。”
derivationEn: From Jin Renjie's 'Pursuing Han Xin', second act: 'To achieve merit is a thousand difficulties and ten thousand hardships; to seek officialdom is twice and thrice.'
example: 小生来这里走一遭，～。★明·施耐庵《水浒传》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 小生來這裡走一遭，～。★明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第十五回
exampleEn: I came here after a thousand difficulties and ten thousand hardships. — from Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 15, Ming Dynasty.

explanation: 侠客的肝，义士的胆。形容见义勇为、锄强扶弱、打抱不平的心肠和行动。
explanationTraditional: 俠客的肝，義士的膽。形容見義勇為、鋤強扶弱、打抱不平的心腸和行動。
explanationEn: Chivalrous liver and righteous gall. Describes a person who is courageous in helping the weak and standing up for justice.
derivation: 《蒲柳人家·后记》一家听着，先是生气，担惊，继而又被赵录明的侠肝义胆和一片热心所感动了。”
derivationTraditional: 《蒲柳人家·後記》一家聽著，先是生氣，擔驚，繼而又被趙錄明的俠肝義膽和一片熱心所感動了。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of Pu Liu's Family: Postscript': 'The family listened, first angry and worried, then moved by Zhao Luming's chivalrous liver and righteous gall and his warm heart.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻时间一拖长，情况可能发生不利的变化。
explanationTraditional: 比喻時間一拖長，情況可能發生不利的變化。
explanationEn: A long night brings many dreams. Metaphor for the possibility of unfavorable changes if time drags on.
derivation: 清·吕留良《家训真迹》荐举事近复纷纭，夜长梦多，巩将来有意外，奈何？”
derivationTraditional: 清·呂留良《家訓真跡》薦舉事近復紛紜，夜長夢多，鞏將來有意外，奈何？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Lü Liuliang's 'Family Instructions': 'The recommendation matter has recently become complicated; a long night brings many dreams, I fear unexpected troubles in the future, what to do?'
example: 这件事要赶紧解决，免得～，再出问题。
exampleTraditional: 這件事要趕緊解決，免得～，再出問題。
exampleEn: This matter needs to be resolved quickly, lest a long night brings many dreams and further problems arise.

explanation: 执行法律象山一样不可动摇。
explanationTraditional: 執行法律象山一樣不可動搖。
explanationEn: Enforce the law like a mountain. Describes unwavering and impartial enforcement of the law.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这位法官一贯秉公办案，执法如山，不徇私情。
exampleTraditional: 這位法官一貫秉公辦案，執法如山，不徇私情。
exampleEn: This judge has always handled cases impartially, enforcing the law like a mountain without favoritism.

explanation: 纵南北方向；横东西方向；驰骋纵马疾驰。不受阻挡地往来奔驰。形容英勇战斗，所向无敌。也比喻写作上才思奔放，意到笔随。
explanationTraditional: 縱南北方向；橫東西方向；馳騁縱馬疾馳。不受阻擋地往來奔馳。形容英勇戰鬥，所向無敵。也比喻寫作上才思奔放，意到筆隨。
explanationEn: Gallop freely in all directions. Describes heroic fighting with invincible force, or unrestrained creativity in writing.
derivation: 宋·谢尧仁《张于湖先生集序》以至唐末诸诗人，雕肝琢肺，求工于一言一字间，在于人力固可以无恨，而概之前数公纵横驰骋之才，则又有间矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·謝堯仁《張於湖先生集序》以至唐末諸詩人，雕肝琢肺，求工於一言一字間，在於人力固可以無恨，而概之前數公縱橫馳騁之才，則又有間矣。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Xie Yaoren's 'Preface to Zhang Yuhu's Collection': 'Even the late Tang poets, carving their livers and lungs, striving for perfection in every word, could not match the galloping freedom of the earlier masters.'
example: 作家应当有自在翱翔、～的广阔天地。★柯灵《香雪海·题材问题一解》
exampleTraditional: 作家應當有自在翱翔、～的廣闊天地。★柯靈《香雪海·題材問題一解》
exampleEn: Writers should have the vast space to soar freely and gallop in all directions. — Ke Ling, 'Xiangxue Sea: A Solution to Theme Issues'

explanation: 孽罪恶。指做了很大的坏事，犯了很大的罪。
explanationTraditional: 孽罪惡。指做了很大的壞事，犯了很大的罪。
explanationEn: Heavy with sin and guilt. Refers to having committed great evil or serious crimes.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·鲁公女》罪孽深重，死无归所。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·魯公女》罪孽深重，死無歸所。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Miss Lu': 'Heavy with sin and guilt, with no place to return after death.'
example: 这个汉奸自知～，难逃惩处，而自尽身亡。
exampleTraditional: 這個漢奸自知～，難逃懲處，而自盡身亡。
exampleEn: This traitor, knowing his sins were heavy and punishment unavoidable, committed suicide.

explanation: 乘趁，因；兴兴致，兴趣。趁着兴致来到，结果很扫兴的回去。
explanationTraditional: 乘趁，因；興興致，興趣。趁著興致來到，結果很掃興的回去。
explanationEn: Come on an impulse of joy. To arrive with high spirits but leave disappointed.
derivation: 《晋书·王徽之传》人问其故，徽之曰‘本乘兴而来，兴尽而反，何心见安道邪？’”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王徽之傳》人問其故，徽之曰‘本乘興而來，興盡而反，何心見安道邪？’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Wang Huizhi': 'When asked why, Huizhi said, 'I came on an impulse of joy, and now my joy is spent, so I return. Why must I see Andao?'
example: 正是～，败兴而返。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第一回
exampleTraditional: 正是～，敗興而返。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第一回
exampleEn: Exactly, coming on an impulse of joy and returning disappointed. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 1

explanation: 故意装糊涂蒙骗人。
explanationTraditional: 故意裝糊塗矇騙人。
explanationEn: Play the fool to deceive. Deliberately act confused to cheat someone.
derivation: 老舍《华实春秋》他这是打马虎眼，麻痹我们大伙儿，假充好人，想混过这一关去！”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《華實春秋》他這是打馬虎眼，麻痺我們大夥兒，假充好人，想混過這一關去！”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Hua Shi Chun Qiu': 'He is playing the fool to deceive us, pretending to be a good guy to get through this.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 粉饰涂饰表面。把社会黑暗混乱的状况掩饰成太平的景象。
explanationTraditional: 粉飾塗飾表面。把社會黑暗混亂的狀況掩飾成太平的景象。
explanationEn: Whitewash peace. To cover up social chaos and darkness as a scene of peace and prosperity.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《再上皇帝书》岂有别生义理，曲加粉饰而能欺天下哉。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《再上皇帝書》豈有別生義理，曲加粉飾而能欺天下哉。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Second Memorial to the Emperor': 'How could there be a different reasoning that, with embellishment, can deceive the world?'
example: 有着～的职责的人们是可原谅的，因为他们也有理由麻木。★闻一多《可怕的冷静》
exampleTraditional: 有著～的職責的人們是可原諒的，因為他們也有理由麻木。★聞一多《可怕的冷靜》
exampleEn: Those who have the duty to whitewash peace are forgivable, for they have reason to be numb. — Wen Yiduo, 'Terrible Calm'

explanation: 筋骨象钢铁打铸的一般。形容身体健壮有力或意志坚强不屈。
explanationTraditional: 筋骨象鋼鐵打鑄的一般。形容身體健壯有力或意志堅強不屈。
explanationEn: Steel tendons and iron bones. Describes a strong and robust body or an unyielding will.
derivation: 曹禺《半日的旅行”》在一间放着垫子和各种各样举重器械的房间里，我遇见了一群钢筋铁骨的青年。”
derivationTraditional: 曹禺《半日的旅行”》在一間放著墊子和各種各樣舉重器械的房間裡，我遇見了一群鋼筋鐵骨的青年。”
derivationEn: From Cao Yu's 'Half-Day Trip': 'In a room filled with mats and various weightlifting equipment, I met a group of youths with steel tendons and iron bones.'
example: 风餐露宿，转战南北，锤炼出一副～，赤胆忠心。★《人民文学》1977年第8期
exampleTraditional: 風餐露宿，轉戰南北，錘鍊出一副～，赤膽忠心。★《人民文學》1977年第8期
exampleEn: Enduring wind and dew, fighting north and south, they forged a body of steel tendons and iron bones and a loyal heart. — 'People's Literature', Issue 8, 1977

explanation: 劳伯劳。伯劳、燕子各飞东西。比喻夫妻、情侣别离。
explanationTraditional: 勞伯勞。伯勞、燕子各飛東西。比喻夫妻、情侶別離。
explanationEn: The shrike and swallow fly in different directions. Metaphor for the separation of a couple or lovers.
derivation: 《乐府诗集·东飞伯劳歌》东飞伯劳西飞燕，黄姑织女时相见。”
derivationTraditional: 《樂府詩集·東飛伯勞歌》東飛伯勞西飛燕，黃姑織女時相見。”
derivationEn: From 'Collection of Yuefu Poems: East Flying Shrike Song': 'East flies the shrike, west flies the swallow; the Cowherd and Weaver Girl meet only at times.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 湛湛蓝天，没有一丝云彩。形容天气晴朗。
explanationTraditional: 湛湛藍天，沒有一絲雲彩。形容天氣晴朗。
explanationEn: A clear blue sky without a single cloud; describing fine weather.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第三本第二折碧天万里无云，空劳倦客身心。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第三本第二折碧天萬里無雲，空勞倦客身心。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing' (Yuan Dynasty): 'The blue sky stretches for ten thousand miles without a cloud, idly wearying the traveler's body and mind.'
example: ～贺六龙，千林不放鸟飞空。地燃石裂江湖沸，不见南来一点风。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第三十三卷
exampleTraditional: ～賀六龍，千林不放鳥飛空。地燃石裂江湖沸，不見南來一點風。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第三十三卷
exampleEn: The sky is clear for ten thousand miles without a cloud, celebrating the six dragons; a thousand forests release no birds to fly. The earth burns, rocks crack, rivers and lakes boil, and not a breath of wind comes from the south. — Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World' (Ming Dynasty), Volume 33.

explanation: 怨怨恨，悔恨；艾割草，比喻改正错误。原意是悔恨自己的错误，自己改正。现在只指悔恨自己的错误。
explanationTraditional: 怨怨恨，悔恨；艾割草，比喻改正錯誤。原意是悔恨自己的錯誤，自己改正。現在只指悔恨自己的錯誤。
explanationEn: To regret one's mistakes and correct oneself; now only refers to regretting one's own errors.
derivation: 《孟子·万章上》太甲悔过，自怨自艾。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章上》太甲悔過，自怨自艾。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Wan Zhang I': 'Tai Jia repented of his faults, regretting and correcting himself.'
example: 但倘有不知道～的人，想将这位先生送进疯人院”去，我可要拚命反对，尽力呼冤的。★鲁迅《集外集·音乐”》
exampleTraditional: 但倘有不知道～的人，想將這位先生送進瘋人院”去，我可要拚命反對，盡力呼冤的。★魯迅《集外集·音樂”》
exampleEn: But if someone who does not know how to regret and correct themselves tries to send this gentleman to the 'madhouse,' I will desperately oppose it and cry out for justice. — Lu Xun, 'Collected Works: Music'

explanation: 不因袭陈旧的格式。
explanationTraditional: 不因襲陳舊的格式。
explanationEn: Not following conventional patterns; original and unconventional.
derivation: 贺宜《序言》这个作品的结构也比较新颖，不落俗套。”
derivationTraditional: 賀宜《序言》這個作品的結構也比較新穎，不落俗套。”
derivationEn: From He Yi's 'Preface': 'The structure of this work is quite novel, not falling into conventional patterns.'
example: 我学习写评论性质的文章，给自己立了两个标准。一个是独立思考，另一个是～。★臧克家《京华练笔三十年》
exampleTraditional: 我學習寫評論性質的文章，給自己立了兩個標準。一個是獨立思考，另一個是～。★臧克家《京華練筆三十年》
exampleEn: When I learned to write critical essays, I set two standards for myself: one is independent thinking, and the other is not falling into conventional patterns. — Zang Kejia, 'Thirty Years of Practice in Beijing'

explanation: 仓皇匆忙，慌张。慌慌张张地外出逃跑。
explanationTraditional: 倉皇匆忙，慌張。慌慌張張地外出逃跑。
explanationEn: To flee in panic and haste.
derivation: 南唐·李煜《破阵子》最是仓皇离庙日，教坊犹奏别离歌。”
derivationTraditional: 南唐·李煜《破陣子》最是倉皇離廟日，教坊猶奏別離歌。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu's (Southern Tang) poem 'Po Zhen Zi': 'Most panicked was the day of leaving the temple, when the court musicians still played farewell songs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用敲锣等发出信号撤兵回营。比喻战斗暂时结束。
explanationTraditional: 用敲鑼等發出信號撤兵回營。比喻戰鬥暫時結束。
explanationEn: To signal retreat by beating gongs; metaphorically, to temporarily end a battle or conflict.
derivation: 《荀子·议兵》闻鼓声而进，闻金声而退。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·議兵》聞鼓聲而進，聞金聲而退。”
derivationEn: From 'Xunzi: On Military Affairs': 'Advance at the sound of drums, retreat at the sound of gongs.'
example: 见孙安勇猛，卢先锋令～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第九十七回
exampleTraditional: 見孫安勇猛，盧先鋒令～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第九十七回
exampleEn: Seeing Sun An's bravery, Lu先锋 ordered the beating of gongs to recall the troops. — Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' (Ming Dynasty), Chapter 97.

explanation: 蔚茂盛；大观盛大的景象。发展成为盛大壮观的景象。形容事物美好繁多，给人一种盛大的印象。
explanationTraditional: 蔚茂盛；大觀盛大的景象。發展成為盛大壯觀的景象。形容事物美好繁多，給人一種盛大的印象。
explanationEn: To develop into a magnificent spectacle; describing something rich and varied that leaves a grand impression.
derivation: 鲁迅《两地书》五一乡村风景，甚觉宜人，野外花园，殊有清趣，树木蔚为大观。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《兩地書》五一鄉村風景，甚覺宜人，野外花園，殊有清趣，樹木蔚為大觀。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Letters from Two Places': 'The rural scenery is very pleasant, and the wild gardens have a pure charm, with trees forming a magnificent view.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原为弃妇诉说原夫再娶与新欢作乐，后反其意，用作庆贺新婚之辞。形容新婚时的欢乐。
explanationTraditional: 原為棄婦訴說原夫再娶與新歡作樂，後反其意，用作慶賀新婚之辭。形容新婚時的歡樂。
explanationEn: Originally referred to a deserted wife lamenting her husband's remarriage and new joy; later used as a congratulatory phrase for newlyweds, describing the joy of a new marriage.
derivation: 《诗经·邶风·谷风》燕尔新婚，如兄如弟。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·邶風·穀風》燕爾新婚，如兄如弟。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Bei Feng: Gu Feng': 'Happy is the new marriage, like brothers.'
example: 俺两个相见时，则他那旧性全无，共妾身～。★元·戴善夫《风光好》第四折
exampleTraditional: 俺兩個相見時，則他那舊性全無，共妾身～。★元·戴善夫《風光好》第四折
exampleEn: When we meet, his old habits are gone, and he treats me like a new bride in our happy marriage. — Dai Shanfu's 'The Story of Fengguang' (Yuan Dynasty), Act 4.

explanation: 不认为是可耻的。指不知羞耻。
explanationTraditional: 不認為是可恥的。指不知羞恥。
explanationEn: Not considering something as shameful; having no sense of shame.
derivation: 《邓析子·转辞》今墨劓不以为耻，斯民所以乱多治少也。”
derivationTraditional: 《鄧析子·轉辭》今墨劓不以為恥，斯民所以亂多治少也。”
derivationEn: From 'Deng Xizi: Zhuan Ci': 'Now people do not consider tattooing and nose-cutting as shameful, which is why there are so many disorders among the people.'
example: 对于自己的历史一点不懂，或懂得甚少，～，反以为荣。★毛泽东《改造我们的学习》
exampleTraditional: 對於自己的歷史一點不懂，或懂得甚少，～，反以為榮。★毛澤東《改造我們的學習》
exampleEn: Some people know nothing or very little about their own history, yet they do not consider it shameful; instead, they take pride in it. — Mao Zedong, 'Reform Our Study'

explanation: 单凭口说，不足为据。
explanationTraditional: 單憑口說，不足為據。
explanationEn: Verbal statements are not reliable evidence.
derivation: 元·乔梦符《扬州梦》第四折你不合打凤牢龙，翻云覆雨，陷人坑井。咱两个口说无凭。”
derivationTraditional: 元·喬夢符《揚州夢》第四折你不合打鳳牢龍，翻雲覆雨，陷人坑井。咱兩個口說無憑。”
derivationEn: From Qiao Mengfu's 'Dream of Yangzhou' (Yuan Dynasty), Act 4: 'You should not have trapped me like a phoenix and dragon, turning things upside down. Our words alone are not proof.'
example: 此皆～，待我亲去踏看明。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十二
exampleTraditional: 此皆～，待我親去踏看明。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十二
exampleEn: These are just words without proof; let me go and investigate personally. — Ling Mengchu's 'Striking the Table in Amazement' (Ming Dynasty), Volume 12.

explanation: 不管多远之处，没有不到的。
explanationTraditional: 不管多遠之處，沒有不到的。
explanationEn: No place is too far to reach; to reach everywhere.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指事情的是非曲直公众自然会有评论。
explanationTraditional: 指事情的是非曲直公眾自然會有評論。
explanationEn: The public will naturally have a fair judgment on the rights and wrongs of a matter.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·品藻》抜庾公呴又问‘何者居其右？’王曰‘自有人。’又问‘何者是？’王曰‘噫！其自有公论。’”明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一回朝廷自有公论，汝岂可造次？”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·品藻》抜庾公呴又問‘何者居其右？’王曰‘自有人。’又問‘何者是？’王曰‘噫！其自有公論。’”明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一回朝廷自有公論，汝豈可造次？”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' and Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.
example: 虽然是非曲直，～；但是现在的世人，总是人云亦云的居多。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一百一回
exampleTraditional: 雖然是非曲直，～；但是現在的世人，總是人云亦云的居多。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一百一回
exampleEn: Although right and wrong will naturally be judged by the public, most people nowadays just follow the crowd. — Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 101

explanation: 舍放弃。不放弃白天和黑夜。比喻夜以继日。
explanationTraditional: 舍放棄。不放棄白天和黑夜。比喻夜以繼日。
explanationEn: Not giving up day or night; metaphor for working tirelessly around the clock.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》子在川上曰‘逝者如斯夫，不舍昼夜。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》子在川上曰‘逝者如斯夫，不捨晝夜。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius, Zihan': 'The Master standing by a stream said, "It passes on like this, never ceasing day or night."'
example: 道若途若川，车航混混，～。★汉·扬雄《法言·问道》
exampleTraditional: 道若途若川，車航混混，～。★漢·揚雄《法言·問道》
exampleEn: The Way is like a road or a river, where carts and boats flow ceaselessly day and night. — Yang Xiong, 'Model Sayings', Chapter 'Asking about the Way'

explanation: 白头头发白。夫妻相亲相爱，一直到老。
explanationTraditional: 白頭頭髮白。夫妻相親相愛，一直到老。
explanationEn: To grow old together with white hair; describes a couple loving each other until old age.
derivation: 《诗经·卫风·氓》及尔偕老。”明·陆采《怀香记·奉诏班师》孩儿，我与你母亲白头偕老，富贵双全。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·衛風·氓》及爾偕老。”明·陸採《懷香記·奉詔班師》孩兒，我與你母親白頭偕老，富貴雙全。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Odes of Wei, Meng' and Lu Cai's 'Embracing the Fragrant Notes'.
example: 小娘半老之际，风波历尽，刚好遇到个老成的孤老，两下志同道合，收绳卷索，～。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三
exampleTraditional: 小娘半老之際，風波歷盡，剛好遇到個老成的孤老，兩下志同道合，收繩卷索，～。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三
exampleEn: When a courtesan reaches middle age and has weathered many storms, she may meet an old and steady lover; they share the same ideals and goals, and together they grow old. — Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 3

explanation: 形容读书声音响亮。
explanationTraditional: 形容讀書聲音響亮。
explanationEn: Describes the sound of reading aloud clearly and loudly.
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷三明季有书生独行丛莽间，闻书声琅琅，怪旷野那得有是。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷三明季有書生獨行叢莽間，聞書聲琅琅，怪曠野那得有是。”
derivationEn: From Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Observations', Volume 3.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 自己甘心思想行为向坏的方向发展。
explanationTraditional: 自己甘心思想行為向壞的方向發展。
explanationEn: To willingly degenerate or sink into bad behavior.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 虽然受过高等教育，但他～常与流氓混在一起，终于走上犯罪的道路。
exampleTraditional: 雖然受過高等教育，但他～常與流氓混在一起，終於走上犯罪的道路。
exampleEn: Although he received a higher education, he willingly degenerated, often hanging out with gangsters, and eventually embarked on a path of crime.

explanation: 一会儿高兴，一会儿生气。形容态度多变。
explanationTraditional: 一會兒高興，一會兒生氣。形容態度多變。
explanationEn: Alternating between happiness and anger; describes a changeable mood.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋· 诬徒》喜怒无处，言谈日易。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋· 誣徒》喜怒無處，言談日易。”
derivationEn: From 'Master Lü's Spring and Autumn Annals, Deceitful Teaching': 'Joy and anger have no fixed place, words and discussions change daily.'
example: 宝玉和黛玉是从小儿一处长大的，他兄妹间多有不避嫌疑之处，嘲笑不忌，～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 寶玉和黛玉是從小兒一處長大的，他兄妹間多有不避嫌疑之處，嘲笑不忌，～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十七回
exampleEn: Baoyu and Daiyu grew up together, and they often spoke without caution, teasing each other without restraint, their moods changeable. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 27

explanation: 原指仁爱而有节操，能为正义牺牲生命的人。现在泛指爱国而为革命事业出力的人。
explanationTraditional: 原指仁愛而有節操，能為正義犧牲生命的人。現在泛指愛國而為革命事業出力的人。
explanationEn: Originally refers to people with benevolence and integrity who sacrifice their lives for justice; now generally refers to patriots who work for the revolutionary cause.
derivation: 《论语·卫灵公》志士仁人，无求生以害仁，有杀身以成仁。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·衛靈公》志士仁人，無求生以害仁，有殺身以成仁。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius, Wei Linggong': 'A determined scholar and a benevolent man will not seek life at the expense of benevolence; they will sacrifice their lives to achieve benevolence.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形秽形态丑陋，引伸为缺点。因为自己不如别人而感到渐愧。
explanationTraditional: 形穢形態醜陋，引伸為缺點。因為自己不如別人而感到漸愧。
explanationEn: To feel ashamed of one's own inferiority compared to others.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·容止》珠玉在侧，觉我形秽。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·容止》珠玉在側，覺我形穢。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World, Appearance and Behavior': 'With a pearl and jade by my side, I feel my own form is ugly.'
example: 她～般只呆在一个黑暗的角落里，不敢发一言。★杨沫《青春之歌》第一部第十一章
exampleTraditional: 她～般只呆在一個黑暗的角落裡，不敢發一言。★楊沫《青春之歌》第一部第十一章
exampleEn: She felt so inferior that she only stayed in a dark corner, not daring to say a word. — Yang Mo, 'The Song of Youth', Chapter 11, Part 1

explanation: 指到处挪借款项。
explanationTraditional: 指到處挪借款項。
explanationEn: To borrow money from various sources.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第26回来京引见的人，有几个腰里常常带着几十万银子？不过也是东挪西借，得了缺再去还人家。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第26回來京引見的人，有幾個腰裡常常帶著幾十萬銀子？不過也是東挪西借，得了缺再去還人家。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Revelations', Chapter 26.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 九泉地下。死人埋葬的地方，即在阴间。
explanationTraditional: 九泉地下。死人埋葬的地方，即在陰間。
explanationEn: Under the nine springs; refers to the place where the dead are buried, i.e., the underworld.
derivation: 汉·阮瑀《七哀》诗冥冥九泉室，漫漫长夜台。”《魏书·阳平王传》若为死鬼，永旷天颜，九泉之下，实深重恨。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·阮瑀《七哀》詩冥冥九泉室，漫漫長夜臺。”《魏書·陽平王傳》若為死鬼，永曠天顏，九泉之下，實深重恨。”
derivationEn: From Ruan Yu's poem 'Seven Sorrows' and 'Book of Wei, Biography of Yangping Wang'.
example: 替你孩儿，尽养生送死之礼，我便～，可也瞑目。★元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》第四折
exampleTraditional: 替你孩兒，盡養生送死之禮，我便～，可也瞑目。★元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》第四折
exampleEn: If I can fulfill the rites of raising and burying your child, then even under the nine springs, I will die content. — Guan Hanqing, 'The Injustice to Dou E', Act 4

explanation: 指愤怒得头发直竖，顶着帽子。形容极端愤怒。
explanationTraditional: 指憤怒得頭髮直豎，頂著帽子。形容極端憤怒。
explanationEn: Extremely angry, with hair standing on end so it lifts the hat.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》盗跖闻之大怒，目如明星，发上指冠。”《史记·廉颇蔺相如列传》相如因持璧却立倚柱，怒发上冲冠。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》盜蹠聞之大怒，目如明星，髮上指冠。”《史記·廉頗藺相如列傳》相如因持璧卻立倚柱，怒髮上衝冠。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi·Dao Zhi' and 'Records of the Grand Historian·Biographies of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru'.
example: ～，凭栏处，潇潇雨歇。★宋·岳飞《满江红》词
exampleTraditional: ～，憑欄處，瀟瀟雨歇。★宋·岳飛《滿江紅》詞
exampleEn: In extreme anger, leaning on the railing, the drizzling rain ceases. — Song Dynasty, Yue Fei's poem 'Man Jiang Hong'.

explanation: 古时一种耕种方法，把地上的草烧成灰做肥料，就地挖坑下种。
explanationTraditional: 古時一種耕種方法，把地上的草燒成灰做肥料，就地挖坑下種。
explanationEn: An ancient farming method where grass is burned as fertilizer and seeds are planted in holes.
derivation: 《旧唐书·严震传》梁汉之间，刀耕火耨。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·嚴震傳》梁漢之間，刀耕火耨。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang·Biography of Yan Zhen'.
example: 随着农业机械化的普及，～的那种原始的农业耕作技术已逐渐消失了。
exampleTraditional: 隨著農業機械化的普及，～的那種原始的農業耕作技術已逐漸消失了。
exampleEn: With the popularization of agricultural mechanization, the primitive farming technique of slash-and-burn has gradually disappeared.

explanation: 青史古代在竹简上记事，因称史书。把姓名事迹记载在历史书籍上。形容功业巨大，永垂不朽。
explanationTraditional: 青史古代在竹簡上記事，因稱史書。把姓名事蹟記載在歷史書籍上。形容功業巨大，永垂不朽。
explanationEn: One's name recorded in history books; achieving great deeds that are immortal.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《赠郑十八贲》诗古人日以远，青史字不泯。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《贈鄭十八賁》詩古人日以遠，青史字不泯。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Du Fu's poem 'To Zheng Shiba'.
example: 无不希望捧着张献忠成就大事，自己成为开国功臣，封侯拜相，封妻荫子，并且～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十三章
exampleTraditional: 無不希望捧著張獻忠成就大事，自己成為開國功臣，封侯拜相，封妻廕子，並且～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十三章
exampleEn: Everyone hoped to help Zhang Xianzhong achieve great things, become founding heroes, and have their names recorded in history. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng' Volume 2, Chapter 23.

explanation: 比喻藏着不可告人的心事。
explanationTraditional: 比喻藏著不可告人的心事。
explanationEn: To harbor ulterior motives or secrets.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》谁知素梅心怀鬼胎，只是长吁短叹，好生愁闷，默默归房去了。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》誰知素梅心懷鬼胎，只是長吁短嘆，好生愁悶，默默歸房去了。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'Er Ke Pai An Jing Qi'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻失败后，整顿再起。
explanationTraditional: 比喻失敗後，整頓再起。
explanationEn: To regroup and start anew after a defeat.
derivation: 清·湘灵子《轩亭冤·惊梦》侬欲重振旗鼓，烦你拟篇男女平权文劝戒女子。”
derivationTraditional: 清·湘靈子《軒亭冤·驚夢》儂欲重振旗鼓，煩你擬篇男女平權文勸戒女子。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Xiang Lingzi's 'Xuan Ting Yuan·Jing Meng'.
example: 我深信我们在这样挣扎苦斗中所获得的极可宝贵的经验，对于将来～的《生活日报》是有很大的裨益的。★邹韬奋《经历》五九
exampleTraditional: 我深信我們在這樣掙扎苦鬥中所獲得的極可寶貴的經驗，對於將來～的《生活日報》是有很大的裨益的。★鄒韜奮《經歷》五九
exampleEn: I firmly believe that the valuable experience gained from this struggle will greatly benefit the future revival of 'Life Daily'. — Zou Taofen's 'Experience' 59.

explanation: 出头摆脱困境等。指从困厄、冤屈、压抑的处境中摆脱出来的日子。
explanationTraditional: 出頭擺脫困境等。指從困厄、冤屈、壓抑的處境中擺脫出來的日子。
explanationEn: The day when one escapes from hardship, injustice, or oppression.
derivation: 元·无名氏《庞娟夜走马陵道》第三折如今佯推风疾举发，白日里与儿童作戏，到晚间共羊犬同眠。不知几时才得个出头之日。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《龐娟夜走馬陵道》第三折如今佯推風疾舉發，白日裡與兒童作戲，到晚間共羊犬同眠。不知幾時才得個出頭之日。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'Pang Juan Ye Zou Ma Ling Dao' Act 3.
example: 照此下去，我要躲到何年何月方有～！★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 照此下去，我要躲到何年何月方有～！★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十八回
exampleEn: If this continues, when will I ever have a day to emerge? — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Chapter 28.

explanation: 两边肋骨插上刀，表示不怕死。比喻承担极大的牺牲。
explanationTraditional: 兩邊肋骨插上刀，表示不怕死。比喻承擔極大的犧牲。
explanationEn: To risk one's life for a friend; to make great sacrifices.
derivation: 蒋子龙《乔厂长上任记》让老乔先撤，你为他两肋插刀顶上一阵。”
derivationTraditional: 蔣子龍《喬廠長上任記》讓老喬先撤，你為他兩肋插刀頂上一陣。”
derivationEn: From Jiang Zilong's 'Qiao Changchang Takes Office'.
example: 为朋友～，不算什么。★高云览《小城春秋》第29章
exampleTraditional: 為朋友～，不算什麼。★高雲覽《小城春秋》第29章
exampleEn: It's nothing to risk my life for a friend. — Gao Yunlan's 'Xiao Cheng Chun Qiu' Chapter 29.

explanation: 浮萍随水漂泊，聚散不定。比喻向来不认识的人偶然相遇。
explanationTraditional: 浮萍隨水漂泊，聚散不定。比喻向來不認識的人偶然相遇。
explanationEn: Strangers meeting by chance, like drifting duckweed.
derivation: 唐·王勃《滕王阁序》萍水相逢，尽是他乡之客。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《滕王閣序》萍水相逢，盡是他鄉之客。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Bo's 'Preface to Tengwang Pavilion'.
example: 此生平第二知心交也。惜～，聚首无多日耳。★清·沈复《浮生六记·浪游记快》
exampleTraditional: 此生平第二知心交也。惜～，聚首無多日耳。★清·沈復《浮生六記·浪遊記快》
exampleEn: This is my second close friend in life. It's a pity we met by chance and have few days together. — Qing Dynasty Shen Fu's 'Six Records of a Floating Life'.

explanation: 躁急躁。不骄傲，不急躁。形容人态度谦逊，工作谨慎踏实。
explanationTraditional: 躁急躁。不驕傲，不急躁。形容人態度謙遜，工作謹慎踏實。
explanationEn: Not arrogant or impatient; humble and cautious in attitude and work.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 在成绩面前，要始终保持谦虚谨慎，不骄不躁的作风。
exampleTraditional: 在成績面前，要始終保持謙虛謹慎，不驕不躁的作風。
exampleEn: In the face of achievements, one must always maintain a modest, prudent, and not arrogant or impatient attitude.

explanation: 不足不值得；挂齿放在嘴上讲。表示不值得一提。
explanationTraditional: 不足不值得；掛齒放在嘴上講。表示不值得一提。
explanationEn: Not worth mentioning; insignificant.
derivation: 《史记·刘敬叔孙叔通传》此特群盗鼠窃狗盗耳，何足置之齿牙间？”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·劉敬叔孫叔通傳》此特群盜鼠竊狗盜耳，何足置之齒牙間？”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian·Biographies of Liu Jing and Shusun Tong'.
example: 宋江答道无能小将，～。”★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第八十七回
exampleTraditional: 宋江答道無能小將，～。”★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第八十七回
exampleEn: Song Jiang replied, 'I am an incompetent general, not worth mentioning.' — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 87.

explanation: 没有儿子，也没有孙子。指没有后代。
explanationTraditional: 沒有兒子，也沒有孫子。指沒有後代。
explanationEn: To have no sons or grandsons; to have no descendants.
derivation: 明·柯丹丘《荆钗记·执柯》你再不娶亲，我只愁你断子绝孙谁拜坟。”
derivationTraditional: 明·柯丹丘《荊釵記·執柯》你再不娶親，我只愁你斷子絕孫誰拜墳。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ke Danqiu's 'The Thorn Hairpin': 'If you don't marry again, I fear you'll have no descendants to visit your grave.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容战火遍及各地。
explanationTraditional: 形容戰火遍及各地。
explanationEn: War flames spreading everywhere; describing war raging across the land.
derivation: 汉·蔡邕《蔡中郎集·外纪上·汉书十志疏》其时鲜卑连犯云中五原，一月之中烽火不绝，埃尘连天。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·蔡邕《蔡中郎集·外紀上·漢書十志疏》其時鮮卑連犯雲中五原，一月之中烽火不絕，埃塵連天。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Cai Yong's 'Cai Zhonglang Ji': 'At that time, the Xianbei repeatedly invaded Yunzhong and Wuyuan; within a month, beacon fires were unceasing and dust filled the sky.'
example: 倾城将士，两两相遇，虽然是件韵事，倘使相遇在～之下，便不欢乐了。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十二回
exampleTraditional: 傾城將士，兩兩相遇，雖然是件韻事，倘使相遇在～之下，便不歡樂了。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十二回
exampleEn: When soldiers from the whole city meet, though it is a romantic affair, if they meet amidst war flames, it is no longer joyful. — Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 32

explanation: 至极，最；尽全部用出。竭尽仁义之道。指人的善意和帮助已经做到了最大限度。
explanationTraditional: 至極，最；盡全部用出。竭盡仁義之道。指人的善意和幫助已經做到了最大限度。
explanationEn: To have done everything possible to help; to have reached the utmost limits of benevolence and righteousness.
derivation: 《礼记·郊特牲》蜡之祭，仁之至，义之尽也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·郊特牲》蠟之祭，仁之至，義之盡也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Suburban Sacrifices': 'The sacrifice at the end of the year is the utmost of benevolence and the fullest of righteousness.'
example: 况且他们还说和我们共同管理，总算是～的了！★冰心《斯人独憔悴》
exampleTraditional: 況且他們還說和我們共同管理，總算是～的了！★冰心《斯人獨憔悴》
exampleEn: Moreover, they said they would manage together with us; that is already the utmost of benevolence and righteousness! — Bing Xin's 'Alone in the Crowd'

explanation: 谲诡怪异，变化∶象云彩和水波那样，形态不可捉摸。原形容房屋构造就象云彩、波浪一样千姿百态◇多形容事物变幻莫测。
explanationTraditional: 譎詭怪異，變化∶象雲彩和水波那樣，形態不可捉摸。原形容房屋構造就象雲彩、波浪一樣千姿百態◇多形容事物變幻莫測。
explanationEn: As changeable as waves and clouds; describing things that are unpredictable and ever-changing.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《甘泉赋》于是大厦云谲波诡，摧摧而成观。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《甘泉賦》於是大廈雲譎波詭，摧摧而成觀。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Yang Xiong's 'Sweet Springs Palace Rhapsody': 'Thus the great hall was as changeable as clouds and waves, towering into a magnificent sight.'
example: 这其间的悲欢离合，～，令人在冷静沉默中回想起来，抚今追昔，实不胜其感慨系之.★邹韬奋《抗战以来·开匙》
exampleTraditional: 這其間的悲歡離合，～，令人在冷靜沉默中回想起來，撫今追昔，實不勝其感慨系之.★鄒韜奮《抗戰以來·開匙》
exampleEn: The joys and sorrows, partings and reunions, as changeable as waves and clouds, make one sigh with emotion when recalling the past in calm silence. — Zou Taofen's 'Since the War of Resistance: The Key'

explanation: 难灾祸；临来到。大祸落到头上。
explanationTraditional: 難災禍；臨來到。大禍落到頭上。
explanationEn: A great disaster is about to befall someone.
derivation: 鲁迅《彷徨·弟兄》他仿佛已经有什么大难临头似的，说话有些口吃了，声音也发着抖。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《彷徨·弟兄》他彷彿已經有什麼大難臨頭似的，說話有些口吃了，聲音也發著抖。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Wandering: Brothers': 'He seemed as if some great disaster was about to befall him; he stammered and his voice trembled.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指对谋事非常疑惑，很不理解。同大惑不解”。
explanationTraditional: 指對謀事非常疑惑，很不理解。同大惑不解”。
explanationEn: To be very puzzled and unable to understand something.
derivation: 老舍《鼓书艺人》二十七她鞠了个躬，转身慢慢走进了下场门。掌声很热烈。听众瞧着她，迷惑不解。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《鼓書藝人》二十七她鞠了個躬，轉身慢慢走進了下場門。掌聲很熱烈。聽眾瞧著她，迷惑不解。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Drum Singers': 'She bowed and turned slowly into the wings. The applause was warm. The audience looked at her, puzzled and unable to understand.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 舞、弄故意玩弄；文、墨文笔。故意玩弄文笔。原指曲引法律条文作弊◇常指玩弄文字技巧。
explanationTraditional: 舞、弄故意玩弄；文、墨文筆。故意玩弄文筆。原指曲引法律條文作弊◇常指玩弄文字技巧。
explanationEn: To play with words and phrases; originally meant to manipulate legal terms for fraud, now often refers to showing off literary skill.
derivation: 《隋书·王充传》明习法令，而舞弄文墨，高下其心。”
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·王充傳》明習法令，而舞弄文墨，高下其心。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Sui: Biography of Wang Chong': 'He was well-versed in laws and decrees, and played with words and phrases to manipulate their meaning.'
example: 而写碑的人偏要～，所以反面越舞越糊涂。★鲁迅《华盖集续编的续编·厦门通信》
exampleTraditional: 而寫碑的人偏要～，所以反面越舞越糊塗。★魯迅《華蓋集續編的續編·廈門通信》
exampleEn: But those who write inscriptions deliberately play with words, so the more they write, the more confused it becomes. — Lu Xun's 'Huagai Ji: Xubian: Xiamen Correspondence'

explanation: 擒捉；纵放。故意先放开他，使他放松戒备，充分暴露，然后再把他捉住。
explanationTraditional: 擒捉；縱放。故意先放開他，使他放鬆戒備，充分暴露，然後再把他捉住。
explanationEn: To let someone off deliberately in order to catch them later; to give the enemy rope to hang themselves.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第七十回大人这里还不要就答应他，放出一个欲擒故纵的手段，然后许其成事。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第七十回大人這裡還不要就答應他，放出一個欲擒故縱的手段，然後許其成事。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 70: 'The adult should not agree immediately, but use the tactic of letting go to catch, then allow the matter to succeed.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 等同等；量衡量，估量；齐一齐，同样。指对有差别的事物同等看待。
explanationTraditional: 等同等；量衡量，估量；齊一齊，同樣。指對有差別的事物同等看待。
explanationEn: To regard different things as equal; to treat unequal things alike.
derivation: 清·况周颐《惠风词话》托雨露而成润，意境可以稍变，然而乌可等量齐观也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·況周頤《惠風詞話》託雨露而成潤，意境可以稍變，然而烏可等量齊觀也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Kuang Zhouyi's 'Huifeng's Remarks on Ci Poetry': 'Relying on rain and dew to become moist, the artistic conception may change slightly, but how can they be regarded as equal?'
example: 后来列国纷纷称王，国王更不算回事，他们至多能和宋、鲁等小国君主～罢了。★朱自清《经典常谈·战国策八》
exampleTraditional: 後來列國紛紛稱王，國王更不算回事，他們至多能和宋、魯等小國君主～罷了。★朱自清《經典常談·戰國策八》
exampleEn: Later, various states proclaimed themselves kings, and kings became less significant; they could at most be regarded as equal to small states like Song and Lu. — Zhu Ziqing's 'Classic Introductions: Strategies of the Warring States'

explanation: 风雅而有情趣的事。旧指文人诗歌吟咏及琴棋书画等活动。也指男女私情。
explanationTraditional: 風雅而有情趣的事。舊指文人詩歌吟詠及琴棋書畫等活動。也指男女私情。
explanationEn: Elegant and romantic affairs; originally referred to literary activities like poetry and painting, but also used for romantic relationships.
derivation: 清·王韬《瀛壖杂志》人各却步立，不敢询姓氏，及移烛烛之，则倩扶也。一座哗然，此亦风流之韵事，承平之佳话。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王韜《瀛壖雜誌》人各卻步立，不敢詢姓氏，及移燭燭之，則倩扶也。一座譁然，此亦風流之韻事，承平之佳話。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wang Tao's 'Miscellaneous Records of Yinghuan': 'Everyone stepped back, not daring to ask names, until a candle was brought; then it was revealed to be Qianfu. The whole hall burst into laughter; this was indeed a romantic affair and a peaceful scene.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指体形高大的马。也比喻人的体形高大。
explanationTraditional: 指體形高大的馬。也比喻人的體形高大。
explanationEn: Refers to a tall and large horse. Also used metaphorically to describe a person of tall and sturdy build.
derivation: 清·禇人获《隋唐演义》第十一回这个人浑身都是新衣服，铺盖齐整，随身有兵器，骑的是高头大马。”
derivationTraditional: 清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》第十一回這個人渾身都是新衣服，鋪蓋齊整，隨身有兵器，騎的是高頭大馬。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 11 of 'Sui and Tang Romance' by Chu Renhuo of the Qing Dynasty: 'This man was dressed in new clothes from head to toe, with neat bedding, carried weapons, and rode a tall horse.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 锦衣鲜艳华美的衣服；玉食珍美的食品。精美的衣食。形容豪华奢侈的生活。
explanationTraditional: 錦衣鮮豔華美的衣服；玉食珍美的食品。精美的衣食。形容豪華奢侈的生活。
explanationEn: Fine clothes and exquisite food. Describes a luxurious and extravagant life.
derivation: 《魏书·常景传》锦衣玉食，可颐其形。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·常景傳》錦衣玉食，可頤其形。”
derivationEn: From 'Biography of Chang Jing' in 'Book of Wei': 'Fine clothes and exquisite food can nourish one's body.'
example: 况～者未必能安于荆钗布裙也，与其后悔，莫若无成。★清·沈复《浮生六记·坎坷记愁》
exampleTraditional: 況～者未必能安於荊釵布裙也，與其後悔，莫若無成。★清·沈復《浮生六記·坎坷記愁》
exampleEn: Moreover, those accustomed to luxury may not be content with simple living; it is better to regret nothing than to have regrets later. — From 'Six Records of a Floating Life' by Shen Fu of the Qing Dynasty.

explanation: 瑕玉上面的斑点，比喻缺点；掩遮盖；瑜美玉的光泽，比喻优点。比喻缺点掩盖不了优点，缺点是次要的，优点是主要的。
explanationTraditional: 瑕玉上面的斑點，比喻缺點；掩遮蓋；瑜美玉的光澤，比喻優點。比喻缺點掩蓋不了優點，缺點是次要的，優點是主要的。
explanationEn: A flaw does not overshadow the virtue. Metaphorically, minor defects cannot obscure the main merits.
derivation: 《礼记·聘义》瑕不掩瑜，瑜不掩瑕，忠也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·聘義》瑕不掩瑜，瑜不掩瑕，忠也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: The Meaning of the Exchange of Gifts': 'A flaw does not conceal the jade's brilliance, nor does the jade's brilliance conceal its flaw; this is loyalty.'
example: 柳之文长于记，特惜～，恶敢与泰山北斗并驾齐驱。★清·陶曾佑《中国文学之概观》
exampleTraditional: 柳之文長於記，特惜～，惡敢與泰山北斗並駕齊驅。★清·陶曾佑《中國文學之概觀》
exampleEn: Liu's prose excels in records, but unfortunately, flaws do not overshadow virtues; how can it be compared to the great masters? — From 'Overview of Chinese Literature' by Tao Zengyou of the Qing Dynasty.

explanation: 坐着躺着都不安宁。形容因忧愁恐惧而不安的样子。
explanationTraditional: 坐著躺著都不安寧。形容因憂愁恐懼而不安的樣子。
explanationEn: Unable to sit or lie still. Describes a state of anxiety or fear.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十回自从哥哥吃官事，兄弟坐立不安，又无路可救。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十回自從哥哥吃官事，兄弟坐立不安，又無路可救。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 40 of 'Water Margin' by Shi Nai'an of the Ming Dynasty: 'Since my brother got into trouble, I have been restless and unable to find a way to help.'
example: 一连数日，神思恍惚，～。★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷六
exampleTraditional: 一連數日，神思恍惚，～。★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷六
exampleEn: For several days in a row, he was in a daze and restless. — From 'Stories Old and New' by Feng Menglong of the Ming Dynasty, Volume 6.

explanation: 羁约束。放纵任性，不加检点，不受约束。
explanationTraditional: 羈約束。放縱任性，不加檢點，不受約束。
explanationEn: Unrestrained and uninhibited. Describes someone who acts freely without self-discipline or constraints.
derivation: 《晋书·王长文传》少以才学知名，而放荡不羁，州府辟命皆不就。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王長文傳》少以才學知名，而放蕩不羈，州府辟命皆不就。”
derivationEn: From 'Biography of Wang Changwen' in 'Book of Jin': 'He was known for his talent and learning from a young age, but was unrestrained and uninhibited, refusing all official appointments.'
example: 平时与一班好朋友，只以诗酒娱心，或以山水纵目，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷十六
exampleTraditional: 平時與一班好朋友，只以詩酒娛心，或以山水縱目，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷十六
exampleEn: He usually spent time with good friends, entertaining with poetry and wine, or enjoying landscapes, unrestrained and uninhibited. — From 'Striking the Table in Amazement, First Series' by Ling Mengchu of the Ming Dynasty, Chapter 16.

explanation: 荏苒时间一点一点的流逝。指时间渐渐地过去了。
explanationTraditional: 荏苒時間一點一點的流逝。指時間漸漸地過去了。
explanationEn: Time passes gradually. Refers to the slow passage of time.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三十七回玄德回新野之后，光阴荏苒，双是新春。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三十七回玄德回新野之後，光陰荏苒，雙是新春。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 37 of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' by Luo Guanzhong of the Ming Dynasty: 'After Xuande returned to Xinye, time passed gradually, and it was spring again.'
example: ～须当惜，风雨阴睛任变迁。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: ～須當惜，風雨陰睛任變遷。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十二回
exampleEn: Time passes gradually and should be cherished; wind and rain, clear or cloudy, change as they will. — From 'Dream of the Red Chamber' by Cao Xueqin of the Qing Dynasty, Chapter 22.

explanation: 迷信者认为，人死后可将灵魂附于他人尸体而复活。比喻已经消灭或没落的事物又以另一种形式出现。
explanationTraditional: 迷信者認為，人死後可將靈魂附於他人屍體而復活。比喻已經消滅或沒落的事物又以另一種形式出現。
explanationEn: Superstitious belief that a dead person's soul can revive by attaching to another's corpse. Metaphorically, something that has disappeared or declined reappears in a new form.
derivation: 元·岳伯川《铁拐李·楔子》岳寿，谁想你浑家将你尸骸烧化了，我如今着你借尸还魂，尸骸是小李屠，魂灵是岳寿。”
derivationTraditional: 元·嶽伯川《鐵柺李·楔子》嶽壽，誰想你渾家將你屍骸燒化了，我如今著你借屍還魂，屍骸是小李屠，魂靈是嶽壽。”
derivationEn: From the prologue of 'Iron Crutch Li' by Yue Bochuan of the Yuan Dynasty: 'Yue Shou, who would have thought your wife would cremate your remains? Now I let you revive by borrowing a corpse; the corpse is Li the butcher's, the soul is Yue Shou's.'
example: 可是地主就在那边，工作团刚刚走，斗争刚刚过后，人家就来报仇，也能够～哩！★孙犁《诉苦翻心》
exampleTraditional: 可是地主就在那邊，工作團剛剛走，鬥爭剛剛過後，人家就來報仇，也能夠～哩！★孫犁《訴苦翻心》
exampleEn: But the landlord was right there; the work team had just left, the struggle had just ended, and then someone came for revenge, and they could also revive by borrowing a corpse! — From 'Complaint and Change of Heart' by Sun Li.

explanation: 原指事物到了尽头就要发生变化。现指在穷困艰难的时候，就要想办法改变现状。
explanationTraditional: 原指事物到了盡頭就要發生變化。現指在窮困艱難的時候，就要想辦法改變現狀。
explanationEn: Originally meant that when things reach an extreme, they must change. Now refers to the need to find ways to change when in poverty or difficulty.
derivation: 《易·系辞下》《易》穷则变，变则通，通则久。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·繫辭下》《易》窮則變，變則通，通則久。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Appended Judgments, Part 2': 'When things are at an extreme, they change; when they change, they become fluent; when fluent, they last long.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 生让人活；杀处死；予给予；夺剥夺。形容反动统治者掌握生死、赏罚大权。
explanationTraditional: 生讓人活；殺處死；予給予；奪剝奪。形容反動統治者掌握生死、賞罰大權。
explanationEn: Life and death, reward and punishment. Describes the absolute power of rulers over life, death, and rewards.
derivation: 《韩非子·三守》使杀生之机，予夺之要在大臣，如是者侵。”《荀子·王制》故丧祭、朝聘、师旅一也。贵贱、杀生、与夺一也。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·三守》使殺生之機，予奪之要在大臣，如是者侵。”《荀子·王制》故喪祭、朝聘、師旅一也。貴賤、殺生、與奪一也。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: Three Safeguards': 'If the power over life and death, reward and punishment lies with ministers, then it is an infringement.' Also from 'Xunzi: Royal Regulations': 'Thus mourning, court visits, military campaigns are all unified. Nobility and baseness, life and death, giving and taking are unified.'
example: 干这种职务的人大半是带工的亲戚，或者是在地方上有一点势力的流氓，所以在这种地方，他们差不多有～的权利。★夏衍《包身工》
exampleTraditional: 幹這種職務的人大半是帶工的親戚，或者是在地方上有一點勢力的流氓，所以在這種地方，他們差不多有～的權利。★夏衍《包身工》
exampleEn: Most of those who do this job are relatives of the foremen or local thugs with some influence, so in such places, they almost have the power of life and death. — From 'Indentured Laborers' by Xia Yan.

explanation: 迎头迎面，当头；痛狠狠地。迎上去给敌人以狠狠的打击。
explanationTraditional: 迎頭迎面，當頭；痛狠狠地。迎上去給敵人以狠狠的打擊。
explanationEn: To strike a severe blow head-on. To deliver a heavy blow to the enemy directly.
derivation: 鲁迅《华盖集·并非闲话（三）》我只见到对青年作家的迎头痛击，冷笑，抹杀，却很少见诱掖奖劝的意思的批评。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《華蓋集·並非閒話（三）》我只見到對青年作家的迎頭痛擊，冷笑，抹殺，卻很少見誘掖獎勸的意思的批評。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Huagai Collection: Not Idle Talk (3)': 'I only see head-on blows, sneers, and obliteration directed at young writers, but rarely see criticism that encourages and guides.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 张贴的名单上没有名字。泛指落选。
explanationTraditional: 張貼的名單上沒有名字。泛指落選。
explanationEn: Not on the list of successful candidates; to fail in an examination or selection.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》第十七卷谁知三场得意，榜上无名。自五岁进场，到今二十一岁，三科不中。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》第十七卷誰知三場得意，榜上無名。自五歲進場，到今二十一歲，三科不中。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World', Volume 17: 'Who would have thought that despite success in three rounds, his name was not on the list. From age five to twenty-one, he failed three exams.'
example: 这话令兄也说过，若～，大家莫想他回来。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 這話令兄也說過，若～，大家莫想他回來。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十二回
exampleEn: As your brother said, if he is not on the list, don't expect him to return. — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 42

explanation: 知知识。探求知识像口渴想喝水一样迫切。形容求知愿望十分迫切。
explanationTraditional: 知知識。探求知識像口渴想喝水一樣迫切。形容求知願望十分迫切。
explanationEn: Thirst for knowledge; having a strong desire to learn.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指人用心不忠厚，不正派。
explanationTraditional: 指人用心不忠厚，不正派。
explanationEn: Having a dishonest or evil mind; not upright in character.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十九回宫日‘汝心术不正，我故弃汝！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十九回宮日‘汝心術不正，我故棄汝！’”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 19: 'Chen Gong said, 'Your heart is not upright, so I left you!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 卖卖弄。仗着岁数大，摆老资格。
explanationTraditional: 賣賣弄。仗著歲數大，擺老資格。
explanationEn: To flaunt one's seniority; to act presumptuously because of age or experience.
derivation: 元·无名氏《谢金梧》第一折我尽让你说几句便罢，则管里倚老卖老，口里唠唠叨叨说个不了。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《謝金梧》第一折我儘讓你說幾句便罷，則管裡倚老賣老，口裡嘮嘮叨叨說個不了。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty anonymous play 'Xie Jinwu', Act 1: 'I let you speak a few words, but you keep flaunting your age and nagging endlessly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 故意装成疯疯癫癫，傻里傻气。
explanationTraditional: 故意裝成瘋瘋癲癲，傻里傻氣。
explanationEn: To pretend to be crazy or stupid; to feign madness or ignorance.
derivation: 王愿坚《三张纸条》那是国民党白鬼子的天下嘛，我就给他个装疯卖傻、一问三不知。”
derivationTraditional: 王願堅《三張紙條》那是國民黨白鬼子的天下嘛，我就給他個裝瘋賣傻、一問三不知。”
derivationEn: From Wang Yuanjian's 'Three Slips of Paper': 'That was the world of the White Devils (Kuomintang), so I pretended to be crazy and stupid, answering 'I don't know' to everything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 长白山和黑龙江。泛指我国东北地区。
explanationTraditional: 長白山和黑龍江。泛指我國東北地區。
explanationEn: White Mountain and Black Water; referring to the Changbai Mountains and Heilongjiang River, symbolizing Northeast China.
derivation: 《金史·世纪》生女之地有混同江、长白山。混同江亦号黑龙江，所谓‘白山黑水’是也。”
derivationTraditional: 《金史·世紀》生女之地有混同江、長白山。混同江亦號黑龍江，所謂‘白山黑水’是也。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Jin', 'Annals of the World': 'The land of the Jurchens has the Huntong River and Changbai Mountain. The Huntong River is also called Heilongjiang, hence 'White Mountain and Black Water'.'
example: ～之间，是我大清发祥地，你们去看看体验一下也好。★唐明浩《曾国藩》第三部第四章
exampleTraditional: ～之間，是我大清發祥地，你們去看看體驗一下也好。★唐明浩《曾國藩》第三部第四章
exampleEn: Between the White Mountain and Black Water is the birthplace of our Qing dynasty. It would be good for you to visit and experience it. — Tang Minghao, 'Zeng Guofan', Part 3, Chapter 4

explanation: 火烧到眉毛。比喻事到眼前，非常急迫。
explanationTraditional: 火燒到眉毛。比喻事到眼前，非常急迫。
explanationEn: Eyebrows on fire; describing an extremely urgent situation.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷十六问‘如何是急切一句？’诗曰‘火烧眉毛。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷十六問‘如何是急切一句？’詩曰‘火燒眉毛。’”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting at the Source', Volume 16: 'Question: 'What is an urgent phrase?' Answer: 'Eyebrows on fire.''
example: ～，且顾眼前。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: ～，且顧眼前。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十五回
exampleEn: When eyebrows are on fire, one must attend to the immediate. — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 35

explanation: 形容用眉眼传情。
explanationTraditional: 形容用眉眼傳情。
explanationEn: To exchange flirtatious glances; to make eyes at each other.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《满江红·赣州席上呈太守陈季陵侍郎》落日苍茫，风才定，片帆无力。还记得眉来眼去，水光山色。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《滿江紅·贛州席上呈太守陳季陵侍郎》落日蒼茫，風才定，片帆無力。還記得眉來眼去，水光山色。”
derivationEn: From Xin Qiji's 'Man Jiang Hong' (Song dynasty): 'In the vast sunset, the wind just stops, the sail is powerless. I still remember the flirtatious glances between the water and the mountains.'
example: 日渐情熟，～，情不能已。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷二
exampleTraditional: 日漸情熟，～，情不能已。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷二
exampleEn: As days passed and they became intimate, they exchanged flirtatious glances, unable to contain their feelings. — Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Warn the World', Volume 2

explanation: 本来是假装的，结果却弄成了真的。
explanationTraditional: 本來是假裝的，結果卻弄成了真的。
explanationEn: What was pretended becomes reality; a pretense turns into fact.
derivation: 宋·邵雍《弄笔吟》弄假像真终是假，将勤补拙总轮勤。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·邵雍《弄筆吟》弄假像真終是假，將勤補拙總輪勤。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty Shao Yong's 'Playing with the Pen': 'Pretending to be real ends up fake; using diligence to compensate for clumsiness always results in diligence.'
example: 那一个掌亲的，怎知道～。★元·无名氏《隔江斗智》第二折
exampleTraditional: 那一個掌親的，怎知道～。★元·無名氏《隔江鬥智》第二折
exampleEn: Who would have known that the matchmaker's pretense would turn into reality? — Yuan dynasty anonymous play 'Stratagem of the River' (Gedu Jiang Zhi), Act 2

explanation: 楚楚鲜明、整洁的样子。衣帽穿戴得很整齐，很漂亮。
explanationTraditional: 楚楚鮮明、整潔的樣子。衣帽穿戴得很整齊，很漂亮。
explanationEn: Dressed neatly and elegantly; impeccably attired.
derivation: 《诗经·曹风·蜉蝣》蜉蝣之羽，衣裳楚楚。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·曹風·蜉蝣》蜉蝣之羽，衣裳楚楚。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs', 'Cao Feng', 'Mayfly': 'The wings of the mayfly, the clothes so neat.'
example: 他整天～，但对工作却漠然置之。
exampleTraditional: 他整天～，但對工作卻漠然置之。
exampleEn: He is always impeccably dressed, but indifferent to his work.

explanation: 兵武器；刃刀剑等的锋利部分。兵器上没有沾上血。形容未经战斗就轻易取得了胜利。
explanationTraditional: 兵武器；刃刀劍等的鋒利部分。兵器上沒有沾上血。形容未經戰鬥就輕易取得了勝利。
explanationEn: To win victory without firing a shot or without bloodshed.
derivation: 《荀子·议兵》故近者亲其善，远方慕其德，兵不血刃，远迩来服。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·議兵》故近者親其善，遠方慕其德，兵不血刃，遠邇來服。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi: 'Thus those near admire his goodness, those far admire his virtue; without bloodshed, distant and near come to submit.'
example: ～，就平了广西省多年的乱党。★清·张春帆《宦海》第七回
exampleTraditional: ～，就平了廣西省多年的亂黨。★清·張春帆《宦海》第七回
exampleEn: Without bloodshed, they pacified the long-standing rebels in Guangxi province. — Qing Dynasty, Zhang Chunfan, 'The Sea of Officialdom', Chapter 7

explanation: 痴心沉迷于某人或某事的心思；妄想荒诞的打算。一心想着不可能实现的事。也指愚蠢荒唐的想法。
explanationTraditional: 痴心沉迷於某人或某事的心思；妄想荒誕的打算。一心想著不可能實現的事。也指愚蠢荒唐的想法。
explanationEn: To indulge in wishful thinking or absurd fantasies; to have unrealistic hopes.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《平妖传》第五回谁知那道也自痴心妄想，魂颠梦倒，分明是癞蛤蟆想着天鹅肉吃。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《平妖傳》第五回誰知那道也自痴心妄想，魂顛夢倒，分明是癩蛤蟆想著天鵝肉吃。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Ping Yao Zhuan', Chapter 5: 'Who knew that Daoist was also wishfully thinking, dreaming upside down, clearly a toad wanting to eat swan meat.'
example: 大凡人不做指望，到也不在心上；一做指望，便～，时刻难过。★明·冯梦龙《古今小说·蒋兴哥重会珍珠衫》
exampleTraditional: 大凡人不做指望，到也不在心上；一做指望，便～，時刻難過。★明·馮夢龍《古今小說·蔣興哥重會珍珠衫》
exampleEn: Generally, if one does not expect something, it does not weigh on the mind; but once expectations arise, one becomes wishfully thinking and the time becomes hard to bear. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New: Jiang Xingge Reencounters the Pearl Shirt'

explanation: 整个园子里一片春天的景色。比喻欣欣向荣的景象。
explanationTraditional: 整個園子裡一片春天的景色。比喻欣欣向榮的景象。
explanationEn: A garden full of spring scenery; metaphor for a thriving and prosperous scene.
derivation: 宋·叶绍翁《游小园不值》诗春色满园关不住，一枝红杏出墙来。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·葉紹翁《遊小園不值》詩春色滿園關不住，一枝紅杏出牆來。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Ye Shaoweng, 'Visiting a Small Garden Without Meeting the Owner': 'The garden's spring scenery cannot be contained; a branch of red apricot stretches out from the wall.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 炊做饭。比喻缺少必要条件无法办成的事。
explanationTraditional: 炊做飯。比喻缺少必要條件無法辦成的事。
explanationEn: To cook a meal without rice; metaphor for an impossible task due to lack of necessary conditions.
derivation: 宋·陆游《老学庵笔记》卷三晏景初尚书，请僧住院，僧辞以穷陋不可为。景初曰‘高才固易耳。’僧曰‘巧妇安能作无面汤饼乎？’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《老學庵筆記》卷三晏景初尚書，請僧住院，僧辭以窮陋不可為。景初曰‘高才固易耳。’僧曰‘巧婦安能作無麵湯餅乎？’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Lu You, 'Notes from the Old Scholar's Hut', Volume 3: 'Minister Yan Jingchu invited a monk to take charge of a temple, but the monk declined citing poverty. Yan said, 'A talented person should find it easy.' The monk replied, 'How can a clever woman make soup without flour?'
example: ～，是人力所做不到的。★鲁迅《两地书》八三
exampleTraditional: ～，是人力所做不到的。★魯迅《兩地書》八三
exampleEn: A meal without rice is something human effort cannot achieve. — Lu Xun, 'Letters from Two Places', No. 83

explanation: 犹言渔人之利。
explanationTraditional: 猶言漁人之利。
explanationEn: The fisherman's gain; metaphor for profiting from a conflict between others.
derivation: 清·刘鹗《老残游记》第十一回甲午为日本侵我东三省，俄、德出为调停，借收渔翁之利，大局又为之一变。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第十一回甲午為日本侵我東三省，俄、德出為調停，借收漁翁之利，大局又為之一變。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 11: 'In 1894, Japan invaded our northeast; Russia and Germany mediated, thereby reaping the fisherman's gain, and the situation changed again.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时所谓秉承天命降世的皇帝。
explanationTraditional: 舊時所謂秉承天命降世的皇帝。
explanationEn: The true Son of Heaven; a term for a legitimate emperor ordained by heaven in ancient times.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第十四卷先生二十五六年前，便识透宋朝的真命天子了。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第十四卷先生二十五六年前，便識透宋朝的真命天子了。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 14: 'Twenty-five or six years ago, the gentleman already recognized the true Son of Heaven of the Song Dynasty.'
example: 我早就算定～已经降世。★《二十年目睹之怪现象》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 我早就算定～已經降世。★《二十年目睹之怪現象》第八十回
exampleEn: I had long calculated that the true Son of Heaven had already descended. — 'Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 80

explanation: 查究起来，没有确实的根据或证据。
explanationTraditional: 查究起來，沒有確實的根據或證據。
explanationEn: Investigation yields no concrete evidence; unsubstantiated.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 不过废纸簏如果难以检查，也就成了事出有因，～”的疑案。（鲁迅《做杂文”也不易》）
exampleTraditional: 不過廢紙簏如果難以檢查，也就成了事出有因，～”的疑案。（魯迅《做雜文”也不易》）
exampleEn: But if the wastepaper basket is hard to examine, it becomes a case of 'there is reason, but no evidence.' — Lu Xun, 'It's Not Easy to Write Essays'

explanation: 古时传说狐狸能够变成人形来迷惑人，但它的尾巴却始终变不了，成为妖的标志。比喻坏人的本来面目或迷惑人的罪证。
explanationTraditional: 古時傳說狐狸能夠變成人形來迷惑人，但它的尾巴卻始終變不了，成為妖的標誌。比喻壞人的本來面目或迷惑人的罪證。
explanationEn: Fox's tail; metaphor for the true nature or incriminating evidence of a villain.
derivation: 北魏·杨衒之《洛阳伽蓝记·法云寺》孙岩娶妻三年，不脱衣而卧。岩私怪之，伺其睡，阴解其衣，有尾长三尺似狐尾。岩惧而出之。”
derivationTraditional: 北魏·楊衒之《洛陽伽藍記·法雲寺》孫巖娶妻三年，不脫衣而臥。巖私怪之，伺其睡，陰解其衣，有尾長三尺似狐尾。巖懼而出之。”
derivationEn: From Northern Wei, Yang Xuanzhi, 'Records of the Buddhist Temples in Luoyang', 'Fayun Temple': 'Sun Yan married a woman who slept without undressing for three years. Suspicious, he secretly removed her clothes while she slept and found a tail three feet long like a fox's. Frightened, he divorced her.'
example: 但是他的话未免说的太露骨，已经明明白白把他的～显露出来了。★冯玉祥《我的生活》第十一章
exampleTraditional: 但是他的話未免說的太露骨，已經明明白白把他的～顯露出來了。★馮玉祥《我的生活》第十一章
exampleEn: But his words were too explicit, clearly revealing his fox's tail. — Feng Yuxiang, 'My Life', Chapter 11

explanation: 泛指一些吃喝玩乐、不务正业的朋友。
explanationTraditional: 泛指一些吃喝玩樂、不務正業的朋友。
explanationEn: A pack of disreputable friends; bad company.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《单刀会》第三折他那里暗暗的藏，我须索紧紧的防，都是些狐朋狗党。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《單刀會》第三折他那裡暗暗的藏，我須索緊緊的防，都是些狐朋狗黨。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, 'Single Sword Meeting', Act 3: 'He hides there secretly, I must guard tightly; they are all fox friends and dog parties.'
example: 恼的是那～，搬弄是非，调三窝四；气的是为他兄弟不学好，不上心念书。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十回
exampleTraditional: 惱的是那～，搬弄是非，調三窩四；氣的是為他兄弟不學好，不上心念書。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十回
exampleEn: What annoyed her were those fox friends and dog companions who stirred up trouble and gossiped; what angered her was her brother's lack of diligence in studying. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 10

explanation: 宁安宁。形容骚扰得厉害，连鸡狗都不得安宁。
explanationTraditional: 寧安寧。形容騷擾得厲害，連雞狗都不得安寧。
explanationEn: Even chickens and dogs are not left in peace; describes severe disturbance or harassment.
derivation: 唐·柳宗元《捕蛇者说》哗然而骇者，虽鸡狗不得宁焉。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·柳宗元《捕蛇者說》譁然而駭者，雖雞狗不得寧焉。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Liu Zongyuan, 'The Snake Catcher': 'The clamor and terror were such that even chickens and dogs could not find peace.'
example: 你弟兄窝藏强盗，闹了两座军州，自去落草。官府着落地方搜缉，搅得～！★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 你弟兄窩藏強盜，鬧了兩座軍州，自去落草。官府著落地方搜緝，攪得～！★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十六回
exampleEn: You brothers harbored bandits, stirred up two prefectures, and became outlaws. The authorities ordered a search, causing such disturbance that even chickens and dogs are not at peace! — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 16

explanation: 旧小说里描写足智多谋的人把对付敌方的计策写在纸条上，放在锦囊里，以便当事人在紧急时拆阅。比喻有准备的巧妙办法。
explanationTraditional: 舊小說裡描寫足智多謀的人把對付敵方的計策寫在紙條上，放在錦囊裡，以便當事人在緊急時拆閱。比喻有準備的巧妙辦法。
explanationEn: A stratagem prepared in advance to deal with an emergency, often kept secret until needed.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十四回汝保主公入吴，当领此三个锦囊。囊中有三条妙计，依次而行。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十四回汝保主公入吳，當領此三個錦囊。囊中有三條妙計，依次而行。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 54: 'You should take these three brocade bags when escorting the lord to Wu. Each contains a brilliant plan, to be opened in sequence.'
example: 为什么叫麻烦？你的～在哪里呢？★叶圣陶《倪焕之》
exampleTraditional: 為什麼叫麻煩？你的～在哪裡呢？★葉聖陶《倪煥之》
exampleEn: Why call it trouble? Where is your prepared stratagem? — Ye Shengtao, 'Ni Huanzhi'

explanation: 牢骚抑郁不平之感。一肚子的不满情绪。形容心情极为抑郁，很不得意。
explanationTraditional: 牢騷抑鬱不平之感。一肚子的不滿情緒。形容心情極為抑鬱，很不得意。
explanationEn: Full of grievances and discontent; extremely dissatisfied.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伤、败败坏。指败坏社会风俗。多用来遣责道德败坏的行为。
explanationTraditional: 傷、敗敗壞。指敗壞社會風俗。多用來遣責道德敗壞的行為。
explanationEn: To corrupt public morals; often used to condemn immoral behavior.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《论佛骨表》伤风败俗，传笑四方，非细事也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《論佛骨表》傷風敗俗，傳笑四方，非細事也。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Memorial on the Buddha's Bone': 'Corrupting morals and customs, spreading ridicule across the land, is no small matter.'
example: 纣王以为妲己好意，岂知内藏～之情，大坏纲常礼义之防。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第十九回
exampleTraditional: 紂王以為妲己好意，豈知內藏～之情，大壞綱常禮義之防。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第十九回
exampleEn: King Zhou thought Daji meant well, but little did he know it concealed corruption of morals and destruction of propriety. — Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 19

explanation: 年纪还不大就衰老了。多指由于精神或体力负担过重而导致过早衰老。
explanationTraditional: 年紀還不大就衰老了。多指由於精神或體力負擔過重而導致過早衰老。
explanationEn: To age prematurely, often due to excessive mental or physical burden.
derivation: 清·汪琬《与参议施先生书》琬殷忧（车感）轲，未老先衰。”
derivationTraditional: 清·汪琬《與參議施先生書》琬殷憂（車感）軻，未老先衰。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wang Wan's 'Letter to Counselor Mr. Shi': 'I am burdened with sorrow and hardship, aging before my time.'
example: 北京老将军们的歌声，是应该使一切精神上～的假老头儿”惭愧的吧！★秦牧《不老》
exampleTraditional: 北京老將軍們的歌聲，是應該使一切精神上～的假老頭兒”慚愧的吧！★秦牧《不老》
exampleEn: The songs of the old generals in Beijing should make those spiritually premature 'fake old men' feel ashamed! — Qin Mu, 'Not Aging'

explanation: 扔一颗石子打到两只鸟。比喻做一件事情得到两样好处。
explanationTraditional: 扔一顆石子打到兩隻鳥。比喻做一件事情得到兩樣好處。
explanationEn: To kill two birds with one stone; achieve two goals with a single action.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指没有东西吃。
explanationTraditional: 指沒有東西吃。
explanationEn: To have nothing to eat; to go hungry.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十一回叫我们管山吃山，管水吃水，都象你这一毛不拔，我们喝西北风。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十一回叫我們管山吃山，管水吃水，都象你這一毛不拔，我們喝西北風。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 41: 'You tell us to live off the mountains and waters, but if everyone is as stingy as you, we'll have to drink the northwest wind.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 搔用手指梳。形容装腔作势卖弄风情。
explanationTraditional: 搔用手指梳。形容裝腔作勢賣弄風情。
explanationEn: To pose and preen in a coquettish manner; to show off one's charms.
derivation: 南朝·宋·范晔《后汉书·李固传》大行在殡，路人掩涕。固独胡粉饰貌，搔头弄姿，槃旋偃仰，从容冶步，曾无惨怛之心。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·范曄《後漢書·李固傳》大行在殯，路人掩涕。固獨胡粉飾貌，搔頭弄姿，槃旋偃仰，從容冶步，曾無慘怛之心。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Fan Ye's 'Book of the Later Han', Biography of Li Gu: 'While the emperor lay in state and passersby wept, Gu powdered his face, posed coquettishly, and strutted about without a hint of sorrow.'
example: 又开始～，掸掸衣服。★曹禺《日出》第三幕
exampleTraditional: 又開始～，撣撣衣服。★曹禺《日出》第三幕
exampleEn: She began to pose and preen, dusting off her clothes. — Cao Yu, 'Sunrise', Act 3

explanation: 用言语或行动为自己掩盖或辩解被人嘲笑的事。
explanationTraditional: 用言語或行動為自己掩蓋或辯解被人嘲笑的事。
explanationEn: To make excuses or cover up for oneself when ridiculed; to laugh at oneself.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《解嘲》哀帝时，丁傅董贤用事，诸附离之者起家至二千石。时雄方草创《大玄》，有以自守，泊如也。人有嘲雄以玄之尚白，雄解之，号曰《解嘲》。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《解嘲》哀帝時，丁傅董賢用事，諸附離之者起家至二千石。時雄方草創《大玄》，有以自守，泊如也。人有嘲雄以玄之尚白，雄解之，號曰《解嘲》。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Yang Xiong's 'Self-Mockery': 'During Emperor Ai's reign, Ding, Fu, and Dong Xian held power, and those who flattered them rose to high rank. Yang Xiong, however, remained aloof, working on his 'Great Mystery'. When someone mocked him for his white hair, he wrote 'Self-Mockery' in reply.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在极周密的考虑中偶然出现了一点疏忽。
explanationTraditional: 在極周密的考慮中偶然出現了一點疏忽。
explanationEn: A single oversight in an otherwise thorough plan; a minor slip in careful consideration.
derivation: 清·魏源《庸易通义》至道问学之有知无行，分温故为存心，知新为致知，而敦厚为存心，崇礼为致知，此皆百密一疏。”
derivationTraditional: 清·魏源《庸易通義》至道問學之有知無行，分溫故為存心，知新為致知，而敦厚為存心，崇禮為致知，此皆百密一疏。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wei Yuan's 'On the Easy and Difficult of the Mean': 'In the pursuit of the Way, there is knowledge without action, dividing reviewing the old as preserving the mind, and learning the new as extending knowledge... these are all cases of a single oversight in a hundred careful considerations.'
example: 深知杜竹斋为人的吴荪甫此时却～，竟没有看透竹斋的心曲。他一而再，再而三的，用鼓励，用反激。★茅盾《子夜》十
exampleTraditional: 深知杜竹齋為人的吳蓀甫此時卻～，竟沒有看透竹齋的心曲。他一而再，再而三的，用鼓勵，用反激。★茅盾《子夜》十
exampleEn: Wu Sunfu, who knew Du Zhuzhai well, made a rare oversight this time, failing to see through Zhuzhai's true feelings. He repeatedly encouraged and provoked him. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 10

explanation: 指大怒。
explanationTraditional: 指大怒。
explanationEn: To become very angry; to fly into a rage.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 见到不务正业的他，父亲一定大动肝火。
exampleTraditional: 見到不務正業的他，父親一定大動肝火。
exampleEn: Seeing him idle and neglecting his duties, his father would surely fly into a rage.

explanation: 比喻刚开始显示出力量或才能。
explanationTraditional: 比喻剛開始顯示出力量或才能。
explanationEn: To show one's talent or ability for the first time.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他在这次比赛中初露锋芒，夺得第一名。
exampleTraditional: 他在這次比賽中初露鋒芒，奪得第一名。
exampleEn: He showed his talent for the first time in this competition and won first place.

explanation: 浩盛大、刚直的样子；气指精神。指浩大刚正的精神。
explanationTraditional: 浩盛大、剛直的樣子；氣指精神。指浩大剛正的精神。
explanationEn: A noble and righteous spirit; a vast and upright moral force.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》我善养吾浩然之气。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》我善養吾浩然之氣。”
derivationEn: From Mencius, Gongsun Chou I: 'I am skilled in nourishing my vast, flowing passion-nature.'
example: 贫毖人灰，且养就这～。★元·汤显祖《牡丹亭·言怀》
exampleTraditional: 貧毖人灰，且養就這～。★元·湯顯祖《牡丹亭·言懷》
exampleEn: Though poor and lowly, one can cultivate this noble spirit. — Tang Xianzu, The Peony Pavilion

explanation: 人的真诚的意志所到。
explanationTraditional: 人的真誠的意志所到。
explanationEn: Where sincerity reaches, even metal and stone can be moved.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 精诚所至，金石为开。
exampleTraditional: 精誠所至，金石為開。
exampleEn: Sincerity can make metal and stone open.

explanation: 一千年，一万代。指世世代代，时间久长。
explanationTraditional: 一千年，一萬代。指世世代代，時間久長。
explanationEn: For thousands of generations; forever and ever.
derivation: 《韩非子·显学》今巫祝之祝人曰‘使若千秋万岁。’千秋万岁之声恬耳，而一日之寿无征于人，此人所以简巫祝也。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·顯學》今巫祝之祝人曰‘使若千秋萬歲。’千秋萬歲之聲恬耳，而一日之壽無徵於人，此人所以簡巫祝也。”
derivationEn: From Han Feizi, Xianxue: 'Now wizards pray saying, 'May you live a thousand autumns and ten thousand years.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧指时机来了，命运也有了转机。指境况好转。
explanationTraditional: 舊指時機來了，命運也有了轉機。指境況好轉。
explanationEn: One's luck turns for the better; circumstances improve.
derivation: 《白雪遗音·马头调·麻衣神相》奴怎比韩氏素梅，生在烟花，时来运转，贵人提拔，才把君恩拜。”
derivationTraditional: 《白雪遺音·馬頭調·麻衣神相》奴怎比韓氏素梅，生在煙花，時來運轉，貴人提拔，才把君恩拜。”
derivationEn: From Snowy Relics, Matou Tune: 'How can I compare to Han Su Mei, born in brothels, but when her time came, fortune turned, and a nobleman promoted her.'
example: 然后渐渐～，建功立业，加官进爵。★清·褚人获《隋唐演义》第八十三回
exampleTraditional: 然後漸漸～，建功立業，加官進爵。★清·褚人獲《隋唐演義》第八十三回
exampleEn: Then gradually his luck turned, he achieved merit and was promoted. — Qing, Chu Renhuo, Romance of Sui and Tang, Chapter 83

explanation: 对证核实。当事人已死，无法核对事实。
explanationTraditional: 對證核實。當事人已死，無法核對事實。
explanationEn: The dead cannot testify; no way to verify the facts because the person involved is dead.
derivation: 元·无名氏《抱妆盒》第三折那厮死了，可不好了，你做的个死无对证。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《抱妝盒》第三折那廝死了，可不好了，你做的個死無對證。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty, anonymous, The Box of Treasures, Act 3: 'That fellow is dead, that's bad, you've made it so the dead cannot testify.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伥伥鬼，古时传说被老虎吃掉的人，死后变成伥鬼，专门引诱人来给老虎吃。替老虎做伥鬼。比喻充当恶人的帮凶。
explanationTraditional: 倀倀鬼，古時傳說被老虎吃掉的人，死後變成倀鬼，專門引誘人來給老虎吃。替老虎做倀鬼。比喻充當惡人的幫兇。
explanationEn: To act as a helper to a tiger; to be an accomplice to evil.
derivation: 《太平广记》卷四百三十伥鬼，被虎所食之人也，为虎前呵道耳。”宋·孙光宪《北梦琐言逸文》卷四凡死于虎，溺于水之鬼号为伥，须得一人代之。”
derivationTraditional: 《太平廣記》卷四百三十倀鬼，被虎所食之人也，為虎前呵道耳。”宋·孫光憲《北夢瑣言逸文》卷四凡死於虎，溺於水之鬼號為倀，須得一人代之。”
derivationEn: From Extensive Records of the Taiping Era, vol. 430: 'The chang ghost is a person eaten by a tiger, who then leads others to the tiger.'
example: 为着要得虎子而身入虎穴，决不是身入虎穴去～。★郭沫若《〈闻一多全集〉序》
exampleTraditional: 為著要得虎子而身入虎穴，決不是身入虎穴去～。★郭沫若《〈聞一多全集〉序》
exampleEn: To get the tiger's cub, one must enter the tiger's den, but not to act as its accomplice. — Guo Moruo, Preface to Wen Yiduo's Complete Works

explanation: 形容留下的血架多。
explanationTraditional: 形容留下的血架多。
explanationEn: Covered with bloodstains; marked with blood.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 脂、膏脂肪。比喻人民用血汗换来的财富。多用于指反动统治阶级压榨人民来养肥自己的场合。
explanationTraditional: 脂、膏脂肪。比喻人民用血汗換來的財富。多用於指反動統治階級壓榨人民來養肥自己的場合。
explanationEn: The fat and marrow of the people; the fruits of the people's labor, often referring to wealth extracted by oppressive rulers.
derivation: 五代·后蜀·孟昶《戒石文》尔俸尔禄，民膏民脂。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·後蜀·孟昶《戒石文》爾俸爾祿，民膏民脂。”
derivationEn: From Five Dynasties, Later Shu, Meng Chang's Admonition on Stone: 'Your salary and emolument are the people's fat and marrow.'
example: 可怜民膏民脂，弃之无用之地。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 可憐民膏民脂，棄之無用之地。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二十五回
exampleEn: Pity that the people's fat and marrow are cast away in useless places. — Ming, Xu Zhonglin, Creation of the Gods, Chapter 25

explanation: 字许配；闺女子卧室。留在闺房之中，等待许嫁。旧指女子成年待聘。
explanationTraditional: 字許配；閨女子臥室。留在閨房之中，等待許嫁。舊指女子成年待聘。
explanationEn: To remain in the boudoir awaiting marriage; said of a young woman not yet betrothed.
derivation: 《礼记·曲礼上》女子待嫁，笄而字。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·曲禮上》女子待嫁，笄而字。”
derivationEn: From The Book of Rites, Qu Li I: 'A woman awaiting marriage is capped and given a style name.'
example: 养成一个如珠似玉的女儿，不特好才貌，还缠得一双小足儿，现年十七岁，待字深闺。★清·黄小配《廿载繁华梦》第二回
exampleTraditional: 養成一個如珠似玉的女兒，不特好才貌，還纏得一雙小足兒，現年十七歲，待字深閨。★清·黃小配《廿載繁華夢》第二回
exampleEn: She raised a daughter as precious as pearl and jade, not only talented and beautiful but also with bound feet. At seventeen, she remained in the boudoir awaiting marriage. — Qing, Huang Xiaopei, Twenty Years of Splendor, Chapter 2

explanation: 过去，两个戏班子为了抢生意，有时候会硐一时间演同样的戏，称为唱对台戏。比喻采取与对方相对的行动，来反对或搞垮对方。
explanationTraditional: 過去，兩個戲班子為了搶生意，有時候會硐一時間演同樣的戲，稱為唱對臺戲。比喻採取與對方相對的行動，來反對或搞垮對方。
explanationEn: To put on a rival show; to compete with someone by doing the opposite thing to oppose or undermine them.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 《太白》创刊之初，原有一点同当时风行的《论语》、《人间世》～的意思。（唐弢《忆〈太白〉》）
exampleTraditional: 《太白》創刊之初，原有一點同當時風行的《論語》、《人間世》～的意思。（唐弢《憶〈太白〉》）
exampleEn: At the start of 'The Great White' magazine, it originally had some intention of competing with the then-popular 'The Analects' and 'The World of Man'.

explanation: 掉转武器向自己原来所属的阵营进行攻击。
explanationTraditional: 掉轉武器向自己原來所屬的陣營進行攻擊。
explanationEn: To turn one's weapon around and strike; to attack one's own side after switching sides.
derivation: 《尚书·武成》前徙倒戈，攻于后以北。”明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十七回吾与杨将军反戈击之。但看火起为号，温侯以兵相应可也。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·武成》前徙倒戈，攻於後以北。”明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十七回吾與楊將軍反戈擊之。但看火起為號，溫侯以兵相應可也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Completion of the War': 'The front troops turned their weapons and attacked those behind.' Also in Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'.
example: 又因为从旧垒中来，情形看得较为分明，～，易制强敌的死命。★鲁迅《坟·写在〈坟〉后面》
exampleTraditional: 又因為從舊壘中來，情形看得較為分明，～，易制強敵的死命。★魯迅《墳·寫在〈墳〉後面》
exampleEn: Moreover, because I came from the old camp, I saw the situation more clearly, and by turning my weapon to strike, I could easily hit the enemy's vital point.

explanation: 指死去。
explanationTraditional: 指死去。
explanationEn: To pass away suddenly; to die.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他写了遗嘱和吩咐后事不久，即～。
exampleTraditional: 他寫了遺囑和吩咐後事不久，即～。
exampleEn: Soon after he wrote his will and gave instructions, he passed away.

explanation: 不正当的、不正派的压不倒正当的、正派的事物。
explanationTraditional: 不正當的、不正派的壓不倒正當的、正派的事物。
explanationEn: Evil cannot prevail over good; the upright will triumph over the crooked.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 寻求欢快，设法取乐。形容追求享乐。
explanationTraditional: 尋求歡快，設法取樂。形容追求享樂。
explanationEn: To seek pleasure and amusement; to indulge in merrymaking.
derivation: 清·吴梅《风洞山》附《先导》风尘倾洞，天地丘墟，这班人儿还要演起戏来寻欢作乐。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳梅《風洞山》附《先導》風塵傾洞，天地丘墟，這班人兒還要演起戲來尋歡作樂。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Mei's 'Wind Cave Mountain': 'In times of chaos and ruin, these people still put on plays to seek pleasure.'
example: 也是地主恶霸～的场所。★陈登科《赤龙与丹凤》
exampleTraditional: 也是地主惡霸～的場所。★陳登科《赤龍與丹鳳》
exampleEn: It was also a place where landlords and bullies sought pleasure and amusement.

explanation: 形形原指生出这种形体；色色原指生出这种颜色。指各式各样，种类很多。
explanationTraditional: 形形原指生出這種形體；色色原指生出這種顏色。指各式各樣，種類很多。
explanationEn: Of all forms and colors; all kinds; diverse.
derivation: 《列子·天瑞》有形者，有形形者，有色者，有色色者。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·天瑞》有形者，有形形者，有色者，有色色者。”
derivationEn: From 'Liezi: Heaven's Gifts': 'There are things that give form, and there are forms that give color.'
example: 人上一百，～，难免良莠不一，何况是上千上万。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第六章
exampleTraditional: 人上一百，～，難免良莠不一，何況是上千上萬。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第六章
exampleEn: With a hundred people, there are all kinds, and it's hard to avoid mixing good and bad, let alone thousands.

explanation: 永远没有安宁的翌日，指社会不安。
explanationTraditional: 永遠沒有安寧的翌日，指社會不安。
explanationEn: Never a day of peace; endless turmoil.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 若不将这些十恶不赦的歹徒绳之以法，社会将～。
exampleTraditional: 若不將這些十惡不赦的歹徒繩之以法，社會將～。
exampleEn: If these heinous criminals are not brought to justice, society will never have a day of peace.

explanation: 止达到；至最，极。达到极完美的境界。
explanationTraditional: 止達到；至最，極。達到極完美的境界。
explanationEn: To reach the highest excellence; to achieve perfection.
derivation: 《礼记·大学》大学之道，在明明德，在亲民，在止于至善。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·大學》大學之道，在明明德，在親民，在止於至善。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: The Great Learning': 'The way of the Great Learning lies in illuminating virtue, in loving the people, and in resting in the highest good.'
example: 革命无止境，倘使世上真有什么～”，这人间世便同时变了凝固的东西了。★鲁迅《而已集·黄花节的杂感》
exampleTraditional: 革命無止境，倘使世上真有什麼～”，這人間世便同時變了凝固的東西了。★魯迅《而已集·黃花節的雜感》
exampleEn: Revolution has no end; if there were truly a 'resting in the highest good,' this world would become something frozen.

explanation: 鼎鼎盛大的样子。非常有名。
explanationTraditional: 鼎鼎盛大的樣子。非常有名。
explanationEn: Very famous; renowned.
derivation: 宋·陆游《岁晚书怀》残岁堂堂去，新春鼎鼎来。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《歲晚書懷》殘歲堂堂去，新春鼎鼎來。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Lu You's 'Year-End Book': 'The old year passes grandly, the new spring arrives grandly.'
example: 走在最后的两个穿布长衫的老头子，是～的委员呢。★叶圣陶《某镇纪事》
exampleTraditional: 走在最後的兩個穿布長衫的老頭子，是～的委員呢。★葉聖陶《某鎮紀事》
exampleEn: The two old men in cloth gowns walking at the back are the very famous committee members.

explanation: 树树立；传传记。原指把某人生平事迹刻在石碑上或写成传记，使他的名声世代流传下去。现比喻树立个人威信，抬高个人声望。
explanationTraditional: 樹樹立；傳傳記。原指把某人生平事蹟刻在石碑上或寫成傳記，使他的名聲世代流傳下去。現比喻樹立個人威信，抬高個人聲望。
explanationEn: To erect a monument and write a biography; to glorify someone and build up their reputation.
derivation: 南朝·宋·范晔《后汉书·桓彬传》蔡邕等共论序其志，佥以为彬有过人者四……乃共树碑而颂焉。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·范曄《後漢書·桓彬傳》蔡邕等共論序其志，僉以為彬有過人者四……乃共樹碑而頌焉。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Fan Ye's 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Huan Bin': 'Cai Yong and others discussed his aspirations and thought Bin had four virtues... so they erected a monument to praise him.'
example: 为自己歌功颂德，～，又充当打手。★刘梦溪《文学是战斗的》
exampleTraditional: 為自己歌功頌德，～，又充當打手。★劉夢溪《文學是戰鬥的》
exampleEn: To sing one's own praises, erect monuments and write biographies, and also act as a thug.

explanation: 百所有的，不论什么；禁忌忌讳。什么都不忌讳。
explanationTraditional: 百所有的，不論什麼；禁忌忌諱。什麼都不忌諱。
explanationEn: No taboos at all; nothing is forbidden.
derivation: 清·范寅《越谚·名物·风俗》百无禁忌，诸邪回避。”
derivationTraditional: 清·範寅《越諺·名物·風俗》百無禁忌，諸邪迴避。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Fan Yin's 'Yue Yue · Ming Wu · Feng Su': 'No taboos at all, all evils avoid.'
example: 则知太公封神，古有此说。今人于门户每书姜太公在此，～，亦非无所本矣。★鲁迅《小说旧闻钞·封神传衍义》
exampleTraditional: 則知太公封神，古有此說。今人於門戶每書姜太公在此，～，亦非無所本矣。★魯迅《小說舊聞鈔·封神傳衍義》
exampleEn: Then it is known that Jiang Ziya's canonization of gods has an ancient origin. Nowadays, people often write 'Jiang Ziya is here, no taboos at all' on doors, which is not without basis. ★ Lu Xun's 'Anecdotes of Old Novels · The Romance of the Canonization of the Gods'

explanation: 暴暴徒；良善良的人。铲除强暴，安抚善良的人民。
explanationTraditional: 暴暴徒；良善良的人。剷除強暴，安撫善良的人民。
explanationEn: Eliminate the violent and pacify the good people.
derivation: 宋·李昿《太平广记》舍之职责，在乎除暴安良。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李昿《太平廣記》舍之職責，在乎除暴安良。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Li Fang's 'Taiping Guangji': 'The duty of a house is to eliminate the violent and pacify the good.'
example: 俺闻剑客行为莫不至公无私，倘心存偏袒，未有不遭恶报；至除暴安良，尤为切要。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 俺聞劍客行為莫不至公無私，倘心存偏袒，未有不遭惡報；至除暴安良，尤為切要。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十回
exampleEn: I have heard that the actions of swordsmen are always impartial and selfless. If they are partial, they will inevitably suffer bad retribution; eliminating the violent and pacifying the good is especially important. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 60

explanation: 宽宽容。以宽宏大度的态度来对待别人。
explanationTraditional: 寬寬容。以寬宏大度的態度來對待別人。
explanationEn: Treat others with leniency and magnanimity.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十回某素知刘备宽以待人，柔能克刚，英雄莫敌。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十回某素知劉備寬以待人，柔能克剛，英雄莫敵。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 60: 'I have long known that Liu Bei treats others with leniency, softness overcomes hardness, and no hero can match him.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容落花纷纷飘落的美丽情景。
explanationTraditional: 形容落花紛紛飄落的美麗情景。
explanationEn: Falling petals in profusion; a beautiful scene of falling flowers.
derivation: 晋·陶潜《桃花源记》忽逢桃花林，夹岸数百步，中无杂树，芳草鲜美，落英缤纷，渔人甚异之。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陶潛《桃花源記》忽逢桃花林，夾岸數百步，中無雜樹，芳草鮮美，落英繽紛，漁人甚異之。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Tao Qian's 'Peach Blossom Spring': 'Suddenly he came upon a peach grove, which extended for several hundred paces along both banks. There were no other trees, but fragrant grasses, fresh and beautiful, and falling petals in profusion. The fisherman was extremely surprised.'
example: 四次来游，满天满谷的～；树上剩得青叶与绿叶，更何处寻那淡红娇嫩的樱。★周恩来《四次游中山公园》
exampleTraditional: 四次來遊，滿天滿谷的～；樹上剩得青葉與綠葉，更何處尋那淡紅嬌嫩的櫻。★周恩來《四次遊中山公園》
exampleEn: Visiting four times, the mountains and valleys were full of falling petals in profusion; only green leaves remained on the trees, where could one find the light red and delicate cherry blossoms? ★ Zhou Enlai's 'Four Visits to Zhongshan Park'

explanation: 哪有这个道理。指别人的言行或某一事物极其荒谬。
explanationTraditional: 哪有這個道理。指別人的言行或某一事物極其荒謬。
explanationEn: How can this be reasonable?; an expression of indignation at absurdity.
derivation: 《南齐书·虞悰传》郁林（王）废，悰窃叹日‘王、徐遂缚裦废一天子，天下岂有此理邪？’”
derivationTraditional: 《南齊書·虞悰傳》鬱林（王）廢，悰竊嘆日‘王、徐遂縛裦廢一天子，天下豈有此理邪？’”
derivationEn: 'Book of Southern Qi · Yu Cong Biography': 'When Prince Yulin was deposed, Yu Cong sighed and said, 'Wang and Xu have bound and deposed a son of Heaven. How can this be reasonable in the world?''
example: 人家好心问你，你倒说这种话！真正～！（巴金《家》十六）
exampleTraditional: 人家好心問你，你倒說這種話！真正～！（巴金《家》十六）
exampleEn: Others kindly ask you, but you speak like this! Truly, how can this be reasonable! (Ba Jin's 'Family', Chapter 16)

explanation: 鸣表示，以为。自以为了不起，表示很得意。
explanationTraditional: 鳴表示，以為。自以為了不起，表示很得意。
explanationEn: Show self-satisfaction; preen oneself; be very pleased with oneself.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·江城》姊妹相逢无他语，惟各以阃威自鸣得意。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·江城》姊妹相逢無他語，惟各以閫威自鳴得意。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio · Jiangcheng': 'When sisters met, they had no other words, only each boasted of her domestic authority, showing self-satisfaction.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风流有才学而不拘礼法；倜傥卓异，洒脱不拘。形容人有才华而言行不受世俗礼节的拘束。
explanationTraditional: 風流有才學而不拘禮法；倜儻卓異，灑脫不拘。形容人有才華而言行不受世俗禮節的拘束。
explanationEn: Talented and unrestrained; elegant and unconventional.
derivation: 明·许三阶《节侠记·私仰》羡英年壮节堪多，似冰心在玉壶，散财结客，侠比三河，风流倜傥，名倾六辅。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許三階《節俠記·私仰》羨英年壯節堪多，似冰心在玉壺，散財結客，俠比三河，風流倜儻，名傾六輔。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Xu Sanjie's 'Jie Xia Ji · Si Yang': 'Admiring the heroic spirit and strong integrity in youth, like an ice heart in a jade pot, scattering wealth and making friends, chivalrous as the three rivers, talented and unrestrained, famous in the six regions.'
example: 其中虢国夫人，更～，玄宗常与相狎，凡宫中的服食器用，时蒙赐赉，又另赐第宅一所于集庆坊。★清·禇人获《隋唐演义》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 其中虢國夫人，更～，玄宗常與相狎，凡宮中的服食器用，時蒙賜賚，又另賜第宅一所於集慶坊。★清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》第八十回
exampleEn: Among them, Lady Guo Guo was even more talented and unrestrained. Emperor Xuanzong often flirted with her, and all the palace supplies and utensils were often bestowed upon her, and another mansion was given to her in Jiqing Ward. ★ Qing Dynasty, Chu Renhuo's 'Sui and Tang Romance', Chapter 80

explanation: 看风向转发动舵柄。比喻看势头或看别人的眼色行事。
explanationTraditional: 看風向轉發動舵柄。比喻看勢頭或看別人的眼色行事。
explanationEn: Trim one's sails; adapt oneself to circumstances; change one's attitude or behavior according to the situation.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》看风使舵，正是随波逐流。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》看風使舵，正是隨波逐流。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Trim the sails according to the wind, just going with the flow.'
example: 他们也就～，凡事一混了之。★朱自清《闻一多全集编后记》
exampleTraditional: 他們也就～，凡事一混了之。★朱自清《聞一多全集編後記》
exampleEn: They also trim their sails, muddling through everything. ★ Zhu Ziqing's 'Postscript to Wen Yiduo's Complete Works'

explanation: 象喝醉酒和做梦那样，昏昏沉沉，糊里糊涂地过日子。
explanationTraditional: 象喝醉酒和做夢那樣，昏昏沉沉，糊里糊塗地過日子。
explanationEn: Live as if drunk or dreaming; lead a befuddled life; live a life of debauchery.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《小学》卷五引程灏曰虽高才明智，胶于见闻，醉生梦死，不自觉也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《小學》卷五引程灝曰雖高才明智，膠於見聞，醉生夢死，不自覺也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi's 'Elementary Learning', Volume 5, quoting Cheng Hao: 'Even the highly talented and wise, stuck in what they see and hear, live as if drunk or dreaming, unaware of it.'
example: 一切有志者都不应该～、浑浑噩噩地虚度年华。
exampleTraditional: 一切有志者都不應該～、渾渾噩噩地虛度年華。
exampleEn: All ambitious people should not live as if drunk or dreaming, muddling away their years.

explanation: 比喻社会黑暗，见不到一点光明。
explanationTraditional: 比喻社會黑暗，見不到一點光明。
explanationEn: Cannot see the sky or the sun; metaphor for social darkness, without any light.
derivation: 宋·魏泰《东轩笔录》卷八福州之人，以为终世不见天日也，岂料端公赐问，然某尤为绛所苦者也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏泰《東軒筆錄》卷八福州之人，以為終世不見天日也，豈料端公賜問，然某尤為絳所苦者也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wei Tai's 'Dongxuan Records', Volume 8: 'The people of Fuzhou thought they would never see the sky or the sun in their lifetime, but unexpectedly you asked, though I am especially troubled by Jiang.'
example: 俺平生只是性情不好，不肯做那～的勾当，才走到这山穷水尽的地步。★清·遁庐《童子军·越墙》
exampleTraditional: 俺平生只是性情不好，不肯做那～的勾當，才走到這山窮水盡的地步。★清·遁廬《童子軍·越牆》
exampleEn: I have always had a bad temper and refused to do such shady deeds that cannot see the sky or the sun, only then did I end up in this desperate situation. ★ Qing Dynasty, Dun Lu's 'Child Soldier · Crossing the Wall'

explanation: 振作起精神。
explanationTraditional: 振作起精神。
explanationEn: To muster one's spirits; to brace oneself up.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录·杭州光庆寺遇安禅师》（僧）问‘光吞万象从师道，心月孤圆意若何？’师曰‘抖擞精神着。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄·杭州光慶寺遇安禪師》（僧）問‘光吞萬象從師道，心月孤圓意若何？’師曰‘抖擻精神著。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan's 'Jingde Chuandeng Lu': A monk asked a question, and the master replied 'Muster your spirits.'
example: 飞～，酣战吕布。连斗五十余合，不分胜负。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五回
exampleTraditional: 飛～，酣戰呂布。連鬥五十餘合，不分勝負。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五回
exampleEn: Fei braced himself and fought fiercely with Lü Bu. They fought over fifty bouts without a clear winner. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 5

explanation: 闲暇舒适，无忧无虑。
explanationTraditional: 閒暇舒適，無憂無慮。
explanationEn: Leisurely and carefree; at ease and free from worry.
derivation: 清·张贵胜《遗愁集·忠义》卷四此之谓从容就义也，死是何等事，乃能夫妇同心，又做得如此悠闲自在。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張貴勝《遺愁集·忠義》卷四此之謂從容就義也，死是何等事，乃能夫婦同心，又做得如此悠閒自在。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Zhang Guisheng's 'Yichou Ji': This is called dying with composure. Death is such a serious matter, yet the couple could be so leisurely and carefree about it.
