example: 有许多写田园生活”的诗和文章把农民生活写得十分～，但那其实出于不是农民的士大夫诗人的想象。★蒲韧《二千年间》五
exampleTraditional: 有許多寫田園生活”的詩和文章把農民生活寫得十分～，但那其實出於不是農民的士大夫詩人的想象。★蒲韌《二千年間》五
exampleEn: Many poems and articles about 'pastoral life' depict farmers as very leisurely and carefree, but that is actually the imagination of literati who are not farmers. — Pu Ren's 'Two Thousand Years', Chapter 5

explanation: 三、四表示杂乱。形容说话做事错杂紊乱。
explanationTraditional: 三、四表示雜亂。形容說話做事錯雜紊亂。
explanationEn: Disorderly; confused; topsy-turvy.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第四十四回连拜了三四日，就把子牙拜的颠三倒四，坐卧不安。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第四十四回連拜了三四日，就把子牙拜的顛三倒四，坐臥不安。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 44: After worshipping for three or four days, Ziya was thrown into confusion and couldn't sit or sleep peacefully.
example: 奶奶年岁大了，做起事来常常是～的。
exampleTraditional: 奶奶年歲大了，做起事來常常是～的。
exampleEn: Grandma is getting on in years and often does things in a confused manner.

explanation: 论定下结论。盖上棺材盖，才能下结论。人死后对其一生作出评价。
explanationTraditional: 論定下結論。蓋上棺材蓋，才能下結論。人死後對其一生作出評價。
explanationEn: Only after a person's death can a final judgment be made; one's merits or demerits can only be judged after death.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《同冠峡》诗行矣且无然，盖棺事乃了。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《同冠峽》詩行矣且無然，蓋棺事乃了。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's poem 'Tongxia Gorge': Go on, don't worry; only when the coffin is closed can matters be settled.
example: 在过去说来，她这个小命运已是被～了，然而在今天，这一切都要重新估计。★茹志娟《在果树园里》
exampleTraditional: 在過去說來，她這個小命運已是被～了，然而在今天，這一切都要重新估計。★茹志娟《在果樹園裡》
exampleEn: In the past, her little fate had been sealed, but today everything must be reassessed. — Ru Zhijuan's 'In the Orchard'

explanation: 指情急时说话不能正确用词表达或指说话随便。
explanationTraditional: 指情急時說話不能正確用詞表達或指說話隨便。
explanationEn: To speak without careful choice of words; to blurt out inappropriate remarks.
derivation: 《北史·魏艾陵伯子华传》性甚褊急，当其急也，口不择言，手自捶击。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·魏艾陵伯子華傳》性甚褊急，當其急也，口不擇言，手自捶擊。”
derivationEn: 'History of the Northern Dynasties': He was very irritable, and when anxious, he would speak without choosing his words and even hit himself.
example: 周近他居然这样～，他怎么能这样说！★郭沫若《蔡文姬》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 周近他居然這樣～，他怎麼能這樣說！★郭沫若《蔡文姬》第一幕
exampleEn: Zhou Jin actually spoke so carelessly! How could he say that! — Guo Moruo's 'Cai Wenji', Act 1

explanation: 醉得瘫成一团，扶都扶不住。形容大醉的样子。
explanationTraditional: 醉得癱成一團，扶都扶不住。形容大醉的樣子。
explanationEn: Dead drunk; so drunk that one cannot stand.
derivation: 《后汉书·儒林传下·周泽》一岁三百六十日，三百五十九日斋”唐·李贤注《汉官仪》此下云‘一日不斋醉如泥。’”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·儒林傳下·周澤》一歲三百六十日，三百五十九日齋”唐·李賢注《漢官儀》此下雲‘一日不齋醉如泥。’”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han': 'One day not fasting, drunk as mud.' — Li Xian's commentary quoting 'Han Gong Yi'.
example: 二人纵饮甚欢，相得恨晚，自辰以迄四漏，计各举壶。曾～，沉睡座间。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·黄英》
exampleTraditional: 二人縱飲甚歡，相得恨晚，自辰以迄四漏，計各舉壺。曾～，沉睡座間。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·黃英》
exampleEn: The two drank heartily, regretting they hadn't met earlier. From morning till late night, they each drank several jugs. Zeng was dead drunk and fell asleep at the table. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio', 'Huang Ying'

explanation: 共同享受安乐，共同承担危难。形容关系密切，利害相连。
explanationTraditional: 共同享受安樂，共同承擔危難。形容關係密切，利害相連。
explanationEn: To share safety and danger together; to share weal and woe.
derivation: 三国·魏·曹植《求自试表》而臣敢陈闻于陛下者，诚与国分形同气，忧患共之者也。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·曹植《求自試表》而臣敢陳聞於陛下者，誠與國分形同氣，憂患共之者也。”
derivationEn: Three Kingdoms, Wei, Cao Zhi's 'Request for Self-Test': I dare to speak to Your Majesty because I share the same body and breath with the state, and share its worries.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容文思跌荡，放得开，收得拢。
explanationTraditional: 形容文思跌蕩，放得開，收得攏。
explanationEn: Describes a literary style that is bold and unrestrained, able to open up and close tightly.
derivation: 清·赵翼《忧旱》今年天作奇文章，大开大合为弛张。”
derivationTraditional: 清·趙翼《憂旱》今年天作奇文章，大開大合為弛張。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Zhao Yi's poem 'Worrying about Drought': This year Heaven writes a marvelous essay, opening wide and closing tight to relax and tighten.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 金石金属和石头，比喻最坚硬的东西。连金石都被打开了。形容一个人心诚志坚，力量无穷。
explanationTraditional: 金石金屬和石頭，比喻最堅硬的東西。連金石都被打開了。形容一個人心誠志堅，力量無窮。
explanationEn: Sincerity can make metal and stone open; extreme sincerity can move even the hardest heart.
derivation: 汉·刘向《新序·杂事四》熊渠子见其诚心，而金石为之开，况人心乎？”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《新序·雜事四》熊渠子見其誠心，而金石為之開，況人心乎？”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Liu Xiang's 'Xinxu': Xiong Quzi saw his sincerity, and even metal and stone were opened by it, let alone human hearts.
example: 精诚所至。贞心不寐，死后重谐。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷九
exampleTraditional: 精誠所至。貞心不寐，死後重諧。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷九
exampleEn: Sincerity can move even metal and stone. With a faithful heart that never sleeps, harmony is restored after death. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 9

explanation: 临到，快要；阵阵地、战场；枪指梭镖、长矛一类的武器。到了快要上阵打仗的时候才磨刀擦枪。比喻事到临头才匆忙准备。
explanationTraditional: 臨到，快要；陣陣地、戰場；槍指梭鏢、長矛一類的武器。到了快要上陣打仗的時候才磨刀擦槍。比喻事到臨頭才匆忙準備。
explanationEn: To sharpen one's spear just before battle; to make last-minute preparations.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第七十回‘临阵磨枪’，也不中用！有这会子着急，天天写写念念，有多少完不了的？”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第七十回‘臨陣磨槍’，也不中用！有這會子著急，天天寫寫念念，有多少完不了的？”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 70: 'Sharpening the spear just before battle' is useless! If you were anxious now, writing and reciting every day, how much could you have finished?
example: 学习要靠平时努力，不要～，到考试前才用功。
exampleTraditional: 學習要靠平時努力，不要～，到考試前才用功。
exampleEn: Study should rely on daily effort, not on cramming just before exams.

explanation: 形容山势险峻。同悬崖峭壁”。
explanationTraditional: 形容山勢險峻。同懸崖峭壁”。
explanationEn: Describes extremely steep and dangerous mountain terrain, same as '悬崖峭壁'.
derivation: 方纪《三峡之秋》爬上悬崖绝壁，听见虎豹的叫声。”
derivationTraditional: 方紀《三峽之秋》爬上懸崖絕壁，聽見虎豹的叫聲。”
derivationEn: Fang Ji, 'Autumn in the Three Gorges': 'Climbing the steep cliffs, one could hear the roars of tigers and leopards.'
example: 但是把人的心灵带到一种崇高的境界的，却是那些吸翠霞而夭矫”的松树，它们不怕山高，把根扎在～的隙缝，身子扭的像盘龙柱子。★李健吾《雨中登泰山》
exampleTraditional: 但是把人的心靈帶到一種崇高的境界的，卻是那些吸翠霞而夭矯”的松樹，它們不怕山高，把根紮在～的隙縫，身子扭的像盤龍柱子。★李健吾《雨中登泰山》
exampleEn: But what brings people's minds to a sublime state are those pines that 'absorb the rosy clouds and soar gracefully'. They are not afraid of the mountain's height, rooting themselves in the crevices of the steep cliffs, their trunks twisted like coiled dragon pillars. ★ Li Jianwu, 'Climbing Mount Tai in the Rain'

explanation: 逆耳不顺耳。正直的劝告听起来不顺耳，但有利于改正缺点错误。
explanationTraditional: 逆耳不順耳。正直的勸告聽起來不順耳，但有利於改正缺點錯誤。
explanationEn: Honest advice may be unpleasant to hear but is beneficial for correcting mistakes.
derivation: 《韩非子·外储说左上》夫良药苦于口，而智者劝而饮之，知其入而已己疾也；忠言拂于耳，而明主听之，知其可以致功也。”《史记·留侯世家》忠言逆耳利于行。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·外儲說左上》夫良藥苦於口，而智者勸而飲之，知其入而已己疾也；忠言拂於耳，而明主聽之，知其可以致功也。”《史記·留侯世家》忠言逆耳利於行。”
derivationEn: 'Hanfeizi': 'Good medicine tastes bitter, but the wise drink it knowing it cures their illness; honest advice is grating to the ear, but enlightened rulers heed it knowing it leads to success.' 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'Honest advice is unpleasant to the ear but beneficial to conduct.'
example: 烟馆里的人，都看这人来历不明，劝他不要与那人要好，却是～，哪里听得。★清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第十三回
exampleTraditional: 煙館裡的人，都看這人來歷不明，勸他不要與那人要好，卻是～，哪裡聽得。★清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第十三回
exampleEn: People in the opium den, seeing the man's suspicious background, advised him not to associate with that person, but honest advice is unpleasant to the ear, and he would not listen. ★ Qing Dynasty, Peng Yang'ou, 'The Wronged Soul of the Black Opium' Chapter 13

explanation: 旧小说中多指打抱不平。
explanationTraditional: 舊小說中多指打抱不平。
explanationEn: In old novels, refers to stepping in to uphold justice or defend the wronged.
derivation: 宋·释道元《景德传灯录》卷二十二师曰‘路见不平，所以按剑。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道元《景德傳燈錄》卷二十二師曰‘路見不平，所以按劍。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan, 'Transmission of the Lamp': 'The master said, 'Seeing injustice on the road, I draw my sword.''
example: 路见不平，～。★元·马致远《陈抟高卧》第一折
exampleTraditional: 路見不平，～。★元·馬致遠《陳摶高臥》第一折
exampleEn: Seeing injustice on the road, he draws his sword to help. ★ Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan, 'Chen Tuan Lies Down' Act 1

explanation: 比喻经过长期锻炼，变得非常坚强。
explanationTraditional: 比喻經過長期鍛鍊，變得非常堅強。
explanationEn: Metaphor for becoming very strong and resilient after long training or hardship.
derivation: 汉·陈琳《武军赋》铠则东胡阙巩，百炼精刚。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·陳琳《武軍賦》鎧則東胡闕鞏，百鍊精剛。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Chen Lin, 'Ode to the Military': 'Armor from Donghu and Quegong, refined a hundred times to become strong steel.'
example: 他周大勇的战士却在战争中～，精通了打击敌人的本领。★杜鹏程《保卫延安》第七章
exampleTraditional: 他周大勇的戰士卻在戰爭中～，精通了打擊敵人的本領。★杜鵬程《保衛延安》第七章
exampleEn: His soldiers, through war, became steeled and skilled in striking the enemy. ★ Du Pengcheng, 'Defending Yan'an' Chapter 7

explanation: 陋浅陋；寡少。形容学识浅陋，见闻不广。
explanationTraditional: 陋淺陋；寡少。形容學識淺陋，見聞不廣。
explanationEn: Describes having shallow knowledge and limited experience.
derivation: 《礼记·学记》独学而无友，则孤陋而寡闻。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·學記》獨學而無友，則孤陋而寡聞。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Rites': 'Learning alone without friends leads to being ignorant and ill-informed.'
example: 某～，不足当公之荐。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十回
exampleTraditional: 某～，不足當公之薦。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十回
exampleEn: I am ignorant and ill-informed, unworthy of your recommendation. ★ Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 10

explanation: 指双方争吵、斗争、比赛等相持不下，难以分开。有时也形容双方关系十分亲密，分不开。
explanationTraditional: 指雙方爭吵、鬥爭、比賽等相持不下，難以分開。有時也形容雙方關係十分親密，分不開。
explanationEn: Describes a stalemate in a quarrel, competition, or fight; also describes an inseparable relationship.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第六十九回一员将使五股托天叉；一员将使八楞熟铜锤；一员将使五爪烂银抓；三将大战，杀得难解难分。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第六十九回一員將使五股託天叉；一員將使八楞熟銅錘；一員將使五爪爛銀抓；三將大戰，殺得難解難分。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 69: 'One general used a five-pronged spear; another an eight-sided bronze hammer; another a five-clawed silver claw; the three fought fiercely, locked in an inextricable battle.'
example: 这盘棋，两人杀得～，不分高下。
exampleTraditional: 這盤棋，兩人殺得～，不分高下。
exampleEn: In this chess game, the two players were locked in an inextricable struggle, with no clear winner.

explanation: 温温习；故旧的。温习旧的知识，得到新的理解和体会。也指回忆过去，能更好地认识现在。
explanationTraditional: 溫溫習；故舊的。溫習舊的知識，得到新的理解和體會。也指回憶過去，能更好地認識現在。
explanationEn: Reviewing the old enables one to gain new understanding; also refers to recalling the past to better understand the present.
derivation: 《论语·为政》温故而知新，可以为师矣。”汉·班固《东都赋》温故知新已难，而知德者鲜矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·為政》溫故而知新，可以為師矣。”漢·班固《東都賦》溫故知新已難，而知德者鮮矣。”
derivationEn: 'Analects': 'Reviewing the old and learning the new makes one a teacher.' Han Dynasty, Ban Gu, 'Eastern Capital Rhapsody': 'It is already difficult to review the old and learn the new, and those who understand virtue are rare.'
example: ～是学习上的重要方法。
exampleTraditional: ～是學習上的重要方法。
exampleEn: Reviewing the old to gain new insights is an important method in learning.

explanation: 挠搔。抓抓耳朵，搔搔肋帮子。形容心里焦急而无法可想的样子。
explanationTraditional: 撓搔。抓抓耳朵，搔搔肋幫子。形容心裡焦急而無法可想的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes scratching one's ears and cheeks in anxiety or agitation, unable to find a solution.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十一大郎听罢，气得抓耳挠腮，没有是处。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十一大郎聽罷，氣得抓耳撓腮，沒有是處。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement' Volume 11: 'Upon hearing this, the eldest brother was so angry he scratched his ears and cheeks, at a loss.'
example: 孙悟空在旁闻讲，喜得他～，眉花眼笑。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第二回
exampleTraditional: 孫悟空在旁聞講，喜得他～，眉花眼笑。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二回
exampleEn: Sun Wukong, listening nearby, was so delighted that he scratched his ears and cheeks, beaming with joy. ★ Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West' Chapter 2

explanation: 形容明媚的春天景象。也形容颜色鲜艳纷繁。
explanationTraditional: 形容明媚的春天景象。也形容顏色鮮豔紛繁。
explanationEn: Describes the bright and colorful scenery of spring; also describes a variety of bright colors.
derivation: 五代·蜀·魏承班《生查子》词花红柳绿间晴空。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·蜀·魏承班《生查子》詞花紅柳綠間晴空。”
derivationEn: Five Dynasties, Shu, Wei Chengban, 'Song of Raw Hawthorn': 'Red flowers and green willows brighten the clear sky.'
example: 史见那郊园野旷，景物芳菲，～，仕女游人不断头的走的。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第八十九回
exampleTraditional: 史見那郊園野曠，景物芳菲，～，仕女遊人不斷頭的走的。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第八十九回
exampleEn: One could see the suburban fields vast and open, the scenery fragrant and beautiful, with red flowers and green willows, and endless streams of ladies and gentlemen strolling. ★ Ming Dynasty, Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng, 'The Plum in the Golden Vase' Chapter 89

explanation: 屏气抑制呼吸；凝神聚精会神。形容注意力高度集中，违心一致。
explanationTraditional: 屏氣抑制呼吸；凝神聚精會神。形容注意力高度集中，違心一致。
explanationEn: Holding one's breath and concentrating attention, describing extreme focus and single-mindedness.
derivation: 《论语·乡党》摄齐升堂，鞠躬如也，屏气似不息者。”《庄子·达生》用志不分，乃凝于神。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·鄉黨》攝齊升堂，鞠躬如也，屏氣似不息者。”《莊子·達生》用志不分，乃凝於神。”
derivationEn: 'Analects': 'Lifting his robe, he ascended the hall, bowing as if holding his breath.' 'Zhuangzi': 'Focusing the mind without distraction, one becomes one with the spirit.'
example: 愈唱愈低，愈低愈细，那声音渐渐的就听不见了。满园子的人都～，不敢少动。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第二回
exampleTraditional: 愈唱愈低，愈低愈細，那聲音漸漸的就聽不見了。滿園子的人都～，不敢少動。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第二回
exampleEn: The singing grew softer and softer, until it gradually became inaudible. Everyone in the garden held their breath and concentrated, not daring to move. ★ Qing Dynasty, Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can' Chapter 2

explanation: 一再表示感恩和谢意。
explanationTraditional: 一再表示感恩和謝意。
explanationEn: Expressing gratitude and thanks repeatedly.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第一百四回李助是个星卜家，得了银子，千恩万谢的辞了范全、王庆，来到段家庄回复。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第一百四回李助是個星卜家，得了銀子，千恩萬謝的辭了範全、王慶，來到段家莊回覆。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 104: 'Li Zhu, a fortune teller, received silver and thanked Fan Quan and Wang Qing profusely before leaving to return to Duan Family Village.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 珠玑珠子。每个字都像珍珠一样。比喻说话、文章的词句十分优美。
explanationTraditional: 珠璣珠子。每個字都像珍珠一樣。比喻說話、文章的詞句十分優美。
explanationEn: Every word is like a pearl; describing speech or writing as exceptionally beautiful.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》任凭是篇篇锦绣，字字珠玑，会不上一名进士。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》任憑是篇篇錦繡，字字珠璣，會不上一名進士。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Couple': 'Even if every piece is splendid and every word a gem, one may still fail to become a Jinshi.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鞭辟鞭策，激励；里最里层。形容作学问切实。也形容分析透彻，切中要害。
explanationTraditional: 鞭闢鞭策，激勵；裡最裡層。形容作學問切實。也形容分析透徹，切中要害。
explanationEn: Describing thorough analysis that hits the nail on the head; also used for diligent study.
derivation: 盛宣怀《上张香帅书》侄忝承付托，责无旁贷，必当鞭辟入里，成一完全商办大厂，为天下创。”
derivationTraditional: 盛宣懷《上張香帥書》侄忝承付託，責無旁貸，必當鞭辟入裡，成一完全商辦大廠，為天下創。”
derivationEn: From Sheng Xuanhuai's 'Letter to Governor Zhang Xiang': 'Entrusted with the task, I must spare no effort to penetrate deeply and establish a fully commercial large factory, pioneering for the world.'
example: 他们的思力不足，不足剖析入微，～。★朱自清《山野掇拾》
exampleTraditional: 他們的思力不足，不足剖析入微，～。★朱自清《山野掇拾》
exampleEn: Their thinking is insufficient to analyze meticulously and penetrate deeply. ★ Zhu Ziqing 'Gleaning in the Mountains'

explanation: 形容事业或经济状况发达昌盛，生机蓬勃。
explanationTraditional: 形容事業或經濟狀況發達昌盛，生機蓬勃。
explanationEn: Describing a thriving and prosperous economy or career, full of vitality.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 祖国的繁荣兴旺是我们的义务。
exampleTraditional: 祖國的繁榮興旺是我們的義務。
exampleEn: The prosperity and flourishing of our motherland is our duty.

explanation: 疾憎恨；恶指坏人坏事。憎恨坏人坏事就象憎恨仇人一样。
explanationTraditional: 疾憎恨；惡指壞人壞事。憎恨壞人壞事就象憎恨仇人一樣。
explanationEn: Hating evil as if it were a personal enemy.
derivation: 汉·孔融《荐祢衡表》见善若惊，疾恶若仇。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·孔融《薦禰衡表》見善若驚，疾惡若仇。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Kong Rong's 'Recommendation of Mi Heng': 'Seeing good is like being startled, hating evil is like hating an enemy.'
example: 他对军阀、政客，～。★梁斌《红旗谱》二十二
exampleTraditional: 他對軍閥、政客，～。★梁斌《紅旗譜》二十二
exampleEn: He hated warlords and politicians as if they were his enemies. ★ Liang Bin 'Red Flag Chronicle' 22

explanation: 智力过人，心思敏锐。
explanationTraditional: 智力過人，心思敏銳。
explanationEn: Having exceptional intelligence and sharp mind.
derivation: 明·周楫《西湖二集·洒雪堂巧结良缘》不觉魏鹏渐渐长大……聪明智慧，熟于经史。”
derivationTraditional: 明·周楫《西湖二集·灑雪堂巧結良緣》不覺魏鵬漸漸長大……聰明智慧，熟於經史。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Zhou Ji's 'West Lake Stories': 'Unconsciously, Wei Peng grew up... intelligent and wise, well-versed in classics and history.'
example: 要论这小姐的模样儿，～，根基家当，倒也配的过。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十九回
exampleTraditional: 要論這小姐的模樣兒，～，根基家當，倒也配的過。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十九回
exampleEn: As for the young lady's appearance, intelligence, family background, she is quite a match. ★ Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 29

explanation: 比喻为达到某种目的，在某些问题上横生枝节，或借题发挥，扩大事态。
explanationTraditional: 比喻為達到某種目的，在某些問題上橫生枝節，或借題發揮，擴大事態。
explanationEn: Metaphor for creating trouble or exaggerating issues to achieve certain goals.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他拿此小事大做文章来对付你们。
exampleTraditional: 他拿此小事大做文章來對付你們。
exampleEn: He made a big fuss over this trivial matter to deal with you.

explanation: 等闲寻常，一般。无足轻重的寻常人。
explanationTraditional: 等閒尋常，一般。無足輕重的尋常人。
explanationEn: An ordinary person of little importance.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》魏有邓艾，足智多谋，非等闲之辈。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》魏有鄧艾，足智多謀，非等閒之輩。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms': 'Wei has Deng Ai, who is resourceful and not an ordinary person.'
example: 一看他就知他非～。
exampleTraditional: 一看他就知他非～。
exampleEn: One look and you can tell he is no ordinary person.

explanation: 指长辈去世，子孙身披麻布服，头上戴白，表示哀悼。
explanationTraditional: 指長輩去世，子孫身披麻布服，頭上戴白，表示哀悼。
explanationEn: Wearing mourning clothes of sackcloth and white headdress to express grief for deceased elders.
derivation: 元·无名氏《冤家债主》第二折你也想着一家儿披麻带孝为何由，故来这灵堂里寻斗殴。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《冤家債主》第二折你也想著一家兒披麻帶孝為何由，故來這靈堂裡尋鬥毆。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'The Debtor's Revenge' Act 2: 'You also think why the whole family wears mourning, so you come to the funeral hall to pick a fight.'
example: 我如今教他～，与亲儿一般行礼，一应殡殓之费，都要他支持。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言·蒋兴歌重会珍珠衫》
exampleTraditional: 我如今教他～，與親兒一般行禮，一應殯殮之費，都要他支持。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言·蔣興歌重會珍珠衫》
exampleEn: I now make him wear mourning and perform rites like a biological son, and all funeral expenses are to be borne by him. ★ Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong 'Stories to Awaken the World'

explanation: 本指老师受到尊敬，他所传授的道理、知识、技能才能得到尊重◇多指为师之道尊贵、庄严。
explanationTraditional: 本指老師受到尊敬，他所傳授的道理、知識、技能才能得到尊重◇多指為師之道尊貴、莊嚴。
explanationEn: The dignity and respect of the teaching profession; the principle that teachers should be respected for their knowledge to be valued.
derivation: 《礼记·学记》凡学之道，严师为难。师严然后道尊，道尊然后民知敬学。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·學記》凡學之道，嚴師為難。師嚴然後道尊，道尊然後民知敬學。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Record on the Subject of Education': 'In all learning, respecting the teacher is the hardest. When the teacher is respected, the Way is honored; when the Way is honored, the people know to respect learning.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风行象刮风一样流行。形容事物在一个时期内非常盛行。
explanationTraditional: 風行象颳風一樣流行。形容事物在一個時期內非常盛行。
explanationEn: To be popular for a period of time, like the wind blowing.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第三回不是弟妄下雌黄，只怕唐兄印行的《不息斋稿》，虽然风行一时，决不能望《五丁阁稿》的项背哩！”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第三回不是弟妄下雌黃，只怕唐兄印行的《不息齋稿》，雖然風行一時，決不能望《五丁閣稿》的項背哩！”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower of the Sea of Evil': 'It is not that I am making irresponsible remarks, but I am afraid that Tang's published 'Bu Xi Zhai Manuscript', though popular for a time, can never match the 'Wu Ding Ge Manuscript'!'
example: 特别是一政法学校的设立～，在成都一个省城里，竟有了四五十座私立政法学校出现。★郭沫若《学生时代·我的学生时代》
exampleTraditional: 特別是一政法學校的設立～，在成都一個省城裡，竟有了四五十座私立政法學校出現。★郭沫若《學生時代·我的學生時代》
exampleEn: Especially with the establishment of a political and law school, in Chengdu, a provincial capital, there were as many as forty or fifty private political and law schools. ★ Guo Moruo 'Student Era: My Student Era'

explanation: 窟洞穴。狡猾的兔子准备好几个藏身的窝。比喻隐蔽的地方或方法多。
explanationTraditional: 窟洞穴。狡猾的兔子準備好幾個藏身的窩。比喻隱蔽的地方或方法多。
explanationEn: A cunning rabbit has three burrows. Metaphor for having multiple hiding places or methods.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策四》狡兔有三窟，仅得兔其死耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策四》狡兔有三窟，僅得兔其死耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy IV': 'A cunning rabbit has three burrows, only then can it avoid death.'
example: 见柴曰汝～，何归为？”★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·邵九娘》
exampleTraditional: 見柴曰汝～，何歸為？”★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·邵九娘》
exampleEn: Seeing Chai, he said, 'You have three burrows, why return?' ★ Qing Dynasty Pu Songling 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Shao Jiuniang'

explanation: 珍异难得的宝物。
explanationTraditional: 珍異難得的寶物。
explanationEn: Rare and precious treasures.
derivation: 宋·胡仔《苕溪渔隐丛话后集·东坡四》嗟呼，世不乏奇珍异宝，乏识者耳。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·胡仔《苕溪漁隱叢話後集·東坡四》嗟呼，世不乏奇珍異寶，乏識者耳。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Hu Zi's 'Tiaoxi Yuyin Conghua: Later Collection: Dongpo IV': 'Alas, the world does not lack rare treasures, but lacks those who recognize them.'
example: 卿既不受职，朕所有黄金白璧，奇珍异宝，惟卿所好。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言·李谪仙醉草吓蛮书》
exampleTraditional: 卿既不受職，朕所有黃金白璧，奇珍異寶，惟卿所好。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言·李謫仙醉草嚇蠻書》
exampleEn: Since you refuse to take office, all my gold, white jade, rare treasures, are yours to enjoy. ★ Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong 'Stories to Warn the World: Li Bai Drunk Writes Scare Letter'

explanation: 欲欲望；壑深谷。形容欲望象深谷一样，很难填满。指贪心重，没法满足。
explanationTraditional: 欲慾望；壑深谷。形容慾望象深谷一樣，很難填滿。指貪心重，沒法滿足。
explanationEn: Desire is like a deep valley, hard to fill. Refers to insatiable greed.
derivation: 《国语·晋语八》叔鱼生其母视之，曰‘是虎目而豕喙，鸢肩而牛腹，豨壑可盈，是不可餍也，必以贿死。’”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·晉語八》叔魚生其母視之，曰‘是虎目而豕喙，鳶肩而牛腹，豨壑可盈，是不可饜也，必以賄死。’”
derivationEn: From 'Guoyu: Jin Yu VIII': 'When Shuyu was born, his mother looked at him and said, 'This child has tiger eyes and a pig's mouth, a kite's shoulders and an ox's belly. A ravine can be filled, but this one cannot be satisfied; he will surely die from bribery.''
example: 衙门口人～，也不好太懦弱了，尽着他们的口胃，他们得着口胃，就咽不满的馋涎了。★清·颐琐《黄绣球》第四回
exampleTraditional: 衙門口人～，也不好太懦弱了，盡著他們的口胃，他們得著口胃，就咽不滿的饞涎了。★清·頤瑣《黃繡球》第四回
exampleEn: The yamen gatekeepers are insatiable, and one should not be too weak; if you indulge their appetite, they will never be satisfied. ★ Qing Dynasty Yi Suo 'Huang Xiuqiu' Chapter 4

explanation: 树木已经做成了船。比喻事情已成定局，无法改变。
explanationTraditional: 樹木已經做成了船。比喻事情已成定局，無法改變。
explanationEn: The wood has already been made into a boat. Metaphor for something that is already settled and cannot be changed.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十四回如今木已成舟，也是林兄命定如此了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十四回如今木已成舟，也是林兄命定如此了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 34: 'Now that the wood has been made into a boat, it is also Lin's fate.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 推崇推重，敬佩。极其推重和敬佩。
explanationTraditional: 推崇推重，敬佩。極其推重和敬佩。
explanationEn: To hold in the highest esteem and admiration.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第八回所谈西国政治、艺术，石破天惊，推崇备至，私心窃以为过当。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第八回所談西國政治、藝術，石破天驚，推崇備至，私心竊以為過當。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower of the Sea of Evil' Chapter 8: 'The discussion of Western politics and art was earth-shattering, and he held them in the highest esteem, though privately I thought it excessive.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 招引进财气、财宝。
explanationTraditional: 招引進財氣、財寶。
explanationEn: To attract wealth and treasures.
derivation: 元·刘唐卿《降桑椹》第二折招财进宝臻佳瑞，合家无虑保安存。”
derivationTraditional: 元·劉唐卿《降桑椹》第二折招財進寶臻佳瑞，閤家無慮保安存。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Liu Tangqing's 'Descending Mulberry' Act 2: 'Attracting wealth and treasures brings good fortune, the whole family is safe and secure.'
example: 你们家这棵大树，树大根深，受日月精华滋养，本是棵～的摇钱树。★谌容《万年青》
exampleTraditional: 你們家這棵大樹，樹大根深，受日月精華滋養，本是棵～的搖錢樹。★諶容《萬年青》
exampleEn: Your family's big tree, with deep roots and lush leaves, nourished by the essence of sun and moon, is a money tree that attracts wealth. ★ Chen Rong 'Wannian Qing'

explanation: 短见本指见识短浅，引申为自杀。自己认为无法活下去而寻死。
explanationTraditional: 短見本指見識短淺，引申為自殺。自己認為無法活下去而尋死。
explanationEn: To take one's own life out of despair.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十六回人家并没有威胁他，是他自寻短见。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十六回人家並沒有威脅他，是他自尋短見。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 66: 'No one threatened him; he took his own life.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 孤立无援的军队单独奋战。比喻单独办事，没有人支援。
explanationTraditional: 孤立無援的軍隊單獨奮戰。比喻單獨辦事，沒有人支援。
explanationEn: An isolated army fighting alone. Metaphor for doing something without support.
derivation: 《隋书·虞庆则传》由是长儒孤军奋战，死者十八九。”
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·虞慶則傳》由是長儒孤軍奮戰，死者十八九。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Sui: Yu Qingze Biography': 'Thus Changru fought alone, with eight or nine out of ten dead.'
example: 我们已经脱离了过去那种慢慢发展的～的情况。★《毛泽东选集·中国革命战争的战略问题》
exampleTraditional: 我們已經脫離了過去那種慢慢發展的～的情況。★《毛澤東選集·中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》
exampleEn: We have moved away from the slow development of fighting alone. ★ Mao Zedong 'Selected Works: Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War'

explanation: 给别人的损害非常之大。
explanationTraditional: 給別人的損害非常之大。
explanationEn: To cause great harm to others.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十五回即如今人凡遇小儿惊风，害人不浅。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十五回即如今人凡遇小兒驚風，害人不淺。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 95: 'For example, nowadays whenever a child has convulsions, it causes great harm.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 假假真真，以假乱真。指军事上讲究策略，善于迷惑对方。也指文艺作品中虚写、实写并用，表现方法耐人思索回味。
explanationTraditional: 假假真真，以假亂真。指軍事上講究策略，善於迷惑對方。也指文藝作品中虛寫、實寫並用，表現方法耐人思索回味。
explanationEn: Mixing the false with the true; using deception to confuse the enemy. Also refers to the interplay of implicit and explicit descriptions in literary works, leaving room for thought.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十九回岂不闻兵法‘虚虚实实’之论？操虽能用兵，只此可以瞒过他也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十九回豈不聞兵法‘虛虛實實’之論？操雖能用兵，只此可以瞞過他也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 49: 'Have you not heard the military tactic of mixing the false with the true? Although Cao Cao is skilled in warfare, this can deceive him.'
example: 此诗～，何能逆料就是才女。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十回
exampleTraditional: 此詩～，何能逆料就是才女。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十回
exampleEn: This poem mixes the false with the true; how can one predict it is from a talented woman? — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 90

explanation: 足充实，足够；智聪明、智慧；谋计谋。富有智慧，善于谋划。形容人善于料事和用计。
explanationTraditional: 足充實，足夠；智聰明、智慧；謀計謀。富有智慧，善於謀劃。形容人善於料事和用計。
explanationEn: Wise and full of stratagems; resourceful and shrewd in planning.
derivation: 元·无名氏《连环计》第一折此人足智多谋，可与共事。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《連環計》第一折此人足智多謀，可與共事。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'The Stratagem of the Linked Rings', Act 1: 'This man is wise and resourceful; one can work with him.'
example: ～之士，能征惯战之将，何止一二千人。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: ～之士，能征慣戰之將，何止一二千人。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十三回
exampleEn: There are no less than one or two thousand wise and resourceful scholars and battle-hardened generals. — Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 43

explanation: 降落下。比喻突然遭到了意外的灾祸。
explanationTraditional: 降落下。比喻突然遭到了意外的災禍。
explanationEn: Disaster falls from heaven; an unexpected calamity.
derivation: 《旧唐书·刘瞻传》咸云宗召荷恩之日，寸禄不沾，进药之时，又不同义，此乃祸从天降，罪匪己为。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·劉瞻傳》鹹雲宗召荷恩之日，寸祿不沾，進藥之時，又不同義，此乃禍從天降，罪匪己為。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang', Biography of Liu Zhan: 'They all say that on the day Zong Zhao received favor, he did not get a single inch of salary, and when medicine was presented, he had no part in it. This is a disaster falling from heaven, a crime not committed by oneself.'
example: 正是～，灾向地生。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: 正是～，災向地生。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十六回
exampleEn: It was a disaster falling from heaven, calamity coming from the earth. — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 46

explanation: 指大白天。也比喻明显的事情或高洁的品德。
explanationTraditional: 指大白天。也比喻明顯的事情或高潔的品德。
explanationEn: Broad daylight; also metaphor for something obvious or a noble character.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《与崔群书》青天白日，奴隶亦知其清明。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《與崔群書》青天白日，奴隸亦知其清明。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Letter to Cui Qun': 'Even a slave knows the clarity of the bright sun and blue sky.'
example: 其为汉复仇之志，如～，人人得而知之。★宋·朱熹《答魏元履书》
exampleTraditional: 其為漢復仇之志，如～，人人得而知之。★宋·朱熹《答魏元履書》
exampleEn: His ambition to avenge the Han dynasty is as clear as the bright sun and blue sky, known to all. — Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's 'Reply to Wei Yuanli's Letter'

explanation: 比喻被迫起来反抗。现也比喻被迫采取某种行动。
explanationTraditional: 比喻被迫起來反抗。現也比喻被迫採取某種行動。
explanationEn: Driven to join the Liangshan rebels; forced to revolt or take a certain action.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第十一回林冲雪夜上梁山。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第十一回林沖雪夜上梁山。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 11: 'Lin Chong goes to Liangshan in the snow.'
example: 可以说差不多的人都是～的。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十八章
exampleTraditional: 可以說差不多的人都是～的。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十八章
exampleEn: It can be said that almost everyone was driven to join the Liangshan rebels. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 28

explanation: 指避免走漏消息。
explanationTraditional: 指避免走漏消息。
explanationEn: To avoid leaking information; to keep something secret from others.
derivation: 清·俞达《青楼梦》第二十八回我欲姐姐迁个住处，他日相迎，亦可以避人耳目。”
derivationTraditional: 清·俞達《青樓夢》第二十八回我欲姐姐遷個住處，他日相迎，亦可以避人耳目。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Yu Da, 'Dream of Green Mansions', Chapter 28: 'I want my sister to move to another place, so that when we meet in the future, we can avoid being noticed.'
example: 以后切记在心，汝等亦不许向后花园闲玩，当～。★《驻春园小史》第四回
exampleTraditional: 以後切記在心，汝等亦不許向後花園閒玩，當～。★《駐春園小史》第四回
exampleEn: In the future, remember this in your heart, and you are not allowed to play in the back garden; you should avoid being noticed. (From 'The Story of a Young Scholar in Zhuyuan', Chapter 4)

explanation: 指把能参加战斗的人民全都武装起来，随时准备歼灭入侵之敌。
explanationTraditional: 指把能參加戰鬥的人民全都武裝起來，隨時準備殲滅入侵之敵。
explanationEn: To mobilize all people capable of fighting, ready to annihilate any invading enemy.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 该赏的赏，该罚的罚。形容处理事情严格而公正。
explanationTraditional: 該賞的賞，該罰的罰。形容處理事情嚴格而公正。
explanationEn: To reward and punish strictly and fairly; to handle matters with strictness and justice.
derivation: 汉·王符《潜夫论·实贡》赏罚严明，治之材也。”《汉书·张敞传》敞为人敏疾，赏罚分明。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王符《潛夫論·實貢》賞罰嚴明，治之材也。”《漢書·張敞傳》敞為人敏疾，賞罰分明。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Wang Fu, 'Qianfu Lun', 'Shi Gong': 'Rewards and punishments are strict and clear, which is the material of governance.' Also 'Book of Han', 'Biography of Zhang Chang': 'Zhang Chang was quick and decisive, with clear rewards and punishments.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 纨裤细绢裤。衣着华美的年轻人。旧时指官僚、地主等有钱有势人家成天吃喝玩乐、不务正业的子弟。
explanationTraditional: 紈褲細絹褲。衣著華美的年輕人。舊時指官僚、地主等有錢有勢人家成天吃喝玩樂、不務正業的子弟。
explanationEn: A dandy; a young man from a wealthy or influential family who spends his time in pleasure-seeking and idleness.
derivation: 《汉书·叙传上》出与王、许子弟为群，在于绮襦纨裤之间，非其好也。”《宋史·鲁宗道传》馆阁育天下英才，岂纨绔子弟得以恩泽处耶？”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·敘傳上》出與王、許子弟為群，在於綺襦紈褲之間，非其好也。”《宋史·魯宗道傳》館閣育天下英才，豈紈絝子弟得以恩澤處耶？”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han', 'Biography of Xu': 'He associated with the sons of Wang and Xu, among the silk and fine trousers, which was not his preference.' Also 'History of Song', 'Biography of Lu Zongdao': 'The imperial academy nurtures the talents of the world; how can dandies be placed there by favor?'
example: 钱正兴在他眼底中，不过是一个～，同世界上一切～一样的。★柔石《二月》六
exampleTraditional: 錢正興在他眼底中，不過是一個～，同世界上一切～一樣的。★柔石《二月》六
exampleEn: In his eyes, Qian Zhengxing was nothing but a dandy, like all dandies in the world. (From Rou Shi, 'February', Chapter 6)

explanation: 问询问。仔细地问，表示关心。
explanationTraditional: 問詢問。仔細地問，表示關心。
explanationEn: To ask many questions in detail, showing concern.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百二十五回王夫人更不用说拉着甄宝玉问长问短，觉得比自己家的宝玉老成些。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百二十五回王夫人更不用說拉著甄寶玉問長問短，覺得比自己家的寶玉老成些。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 125: 'Lady Wang, needless to say, pulled Zhen Baoyu and asked him many questions, feeling that he was more mature than her own Baoyu.'
example: 另外有许多人却挤着庄寿香，～，寿香手舞足蹈的讲给他们听。（清·曾朴《孽海花》第五回）
exampleTraditional: 另外有許多人卻擠著莊壽香，～，壽香手舞足蹈的講給他們聽。（清·曾樸《孽海花》第五回）
exampleEn: Many others crowded around Zhuang Shouxiang, asking him many questions, and Shouxiang talked animatedly, telling them stories. (From Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower of the Sea of Sins', Chapter 5)

explanation: 分不出第一第二。
explanationTraditional: 分不出第一第二。
explanationEn: Unable to distinguish who is first or second; equally matched.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 两位追求者的才学、家世都一样优秀，～，让她不知如何抉择。
exampleTraditional: 兩位追求者的才學、家世都一樣優秀，～，讓她不知如何抉擇。
exampleEn: The two suitors are equally excellent in talent and family background, making it hard for her to choose.

explanation: 赤比喻真纯。形容十分忠诚。
explanationTraditional: 赤比喻真純。形容十分忠誠。
explanationEn: Extreme loyalty and devotion.
derivation: 明·汤显祖《还魂记·淮警》贼子豪雄是李全，忠心赤胆向胡天，靴尖踢倒长天堑，却笑江南土不坚。”
derivationTraditional: 明·湯顯祖《還魂記·淮警》賊子豪雄是李全，忠心赤膽向胡天，靴尖踢倒長天塹，卻笑江南土不堅。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Tang Xianzu's 'The Peony Pavilion': 'The traitor hero is Li Quan, with loyal heart and red gall toward the barbarian sky.'
example: 又有公子一个嬷嬷爹，这人姓华名忠，年纪五十岁光景，一生耿直，～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第一回
exampleTraditional: 又有公子一個嬤嬤爹，這人姓華名忠，年紀五十歲光景，一生耿直，～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第一回
exampleEn: There was also a nanny's father of the young master, named Hua Zhong, about fifty years old, upright all his life, with utmost loyalty. (Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Son and Daughter', Chapter 1)

explanation: 官运官场中的运气；亨通顺利。指仕途顺利，步步高升。
explanationTraditional: 官運官場中的運氣；亨通順利。指仕途順利，步步高昇。
explanationEn: Smooth progress in one's official career; rapid promotion.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第四十三回正碰着官运亨通，那年修理堤工案内，得了个异常劳绩，保举免补本班，以府经补用。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第四十三回正碰著官運亨通，那年修理堤工案內，得了個異常勞績，保舉免補本班，以府經補用。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 43: 'Just when his official career was flourishing, he got an extraordinary merit in the river repair project that year.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 保持自己纯洁，不同流合污。也指怕招惹是非，只顾自己好，不关心公众事情。
explanationTraditional: 保持自己純潔，不同流合汙。也指怕招惹是非，只顧自己好，不關心公眾事情。
explanationEn: To keep oneself pure and avoid associating with corrupt influences; also, to mind one's own business to avoid trouble.
derivation: 《孟子·万章上》归洁其身而已矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章上》歸潔其身而已矣。”
derivationEn: Mencius, 'Wan Zhang I': 'He keeps his person pure, that is all.'
example: 纵为生活所迫，不得不按时上班，也当～，不与人同桌进食，同杯用茶，以免传布病菌，贻害他人。★巴金《寒夜》
exampleTraditional: 縱為生活所迫，不得不按時上班，也當～，不與人同桌進食，同杯用茶，以免傳佈病菌，貽害他人。★巴金《寒夜》
exampleEn: Even if forced by life to go to work on time, one should keep oneself clean, not eat with others or share cups to avoid spreading germs and harming others. (Ba Jin's 'Cold Nights')

explanation: 经纶整理丝缕，引伸为人的才学、本领。形容人极有才干和智谋。
explanationTraditional: 經綸整理絲縷，引伸為人的才學、本領。形容人極有才幹和智謀。
explanationEn: Full of talent and strategy; extremely capable and wise.
derivation: 《周易·屯》云雷屯，君子以经纶。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·屯》雲雷屯，君子以經綸。”
derivationEn: The Book of Changes, 'Zhun': 'Clouds and thunder form Zhun; the gentleman uses it to order and regulate.'
example: 仲老，真佩服，～！这果然是奥妙！★茅盾《子夜》二
exampleTraditional: 仲老，真佩服，～！這果然是奧妙！★茅盾《子夜》二
exampleEn: Elder Zhong, I truly admire you! Full of brilliant schemes! This is indeed profound! (Mao Dun's 'Midnight', Chapter 2)

explanation: 旧指洋人较多的地方。多形容旧时的上海。
explanationTraditional: 舊指洋人較多的地方。多形容舊時的上海。
explanationEn: A place with many foreigners; often refers to old Shanghai.
derivation: 茅盾《健美》我们这十里洋场实在还不过是畸形的殖民地化的资本主义社会。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《健美》我們這十里洋場實在還不過是畸形的殖民地化的資本主義社會。”
derivationEn: Mao Dun's 'Health': 'This ten-mile foreign field of ours is nothing but a deformed colonial capitalist society.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时指小户人家美丽的年轻女子。
explanationTraditional: 舊時指小戶人家美麗的年輕女子。
explanationEn: A pretty young woman from a humble family.
derivation: 《乐府诗集·碧玉歌》碧玉小家女，不敢攀贵德。感郎义气重，遂得结金兰。”
derivationTraditional: 《樂府詩集·碧玉歌》碧玉小家女，不敢攀貴德。感郎義氣重，遂得結金蘭。”
derivationEn: 'Yuefu Poems: Song of the Green Jade': 'Green jade, a girl from a small family, dares not aspire to noble virtue. Moved by your deep affection, we become sworn siblings.'
example: 无论南部烟花，～，只要有宜男相，便算得如意珠。★清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 無論南部煙花，～，只要有宜男相，便算得如意珠。★清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第二十一回
exampleEn: Whether it's a southern beauty or a girl from a small family, as long as she has a son-bearing appearance, she is considered a treasure. (Qing Dynasty, Peng Yang'ou's 'The Opium Addict', Chapter 21)

explanation: 自扰自找麻烦。指本来没事，自己找麻烦。
explanationTraditional: 自擾自找麻煩。指本來沒事，自己找麻煩。
explanationEn: To worry about imaginary troubles; to create unnecessary problems for oneself.
derivation: 《新唐书·陆象先传》天下本无事，庸人扰之而烦耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·陸象先傳》天下本無事，庸人擾之而煩耳。”
derivationEn: 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Lu Xiangxian': 'The world is originally peaceful, but fools disturb it and cause trouble.'
example: 他在房里踱了半圈，在门口停下，背对着郑成功，警告似地说不要～。”★华而实《汉衣冠》三
exampleTraditional: 他在房裡踱了半圈，在門口停下，背對著鄭成功，警告似地說不要～。”★華而實《漢衣冠》三
exampleEn: He paced half a circle in the room, stopped at the door, and said warningly to Zheng Chenggong, 'Don't borrow trouble.' (Hua Ershi's 'Han Crown', Chapter 3)

explanation: 知了解，知道；任任用，使用。善于认识人的品德和才能，最合理地使用。
explanationTraditional: 知了解，知道；任任用，使用。善於認識人的品德和才能，最合理地使用。
explanationEn: To understand a person's character and abilities and assign them the most suitable role.
derivation: 汉·班彪《王命论》盖在高祖，其兴也有五一曰帝尧之功裔，二曰体貌多奇异，三曰神武有征应，四曰宽明而仁恕，五曰知人善任使。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·班彪《王命論》蓋在高祖，其興也有五一曰帝堯之功裔，二曰體貌多奇異，三曰神武有徵應，四曰寬明而仁恕，五曰知人善任使。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Ban Biao's 'On the Mandate of Kings': 'As for Gaozu, his rise had five reasons: first, he was a descendant of Emperor Yao; second, his appearance was extraordinary; third, he was divinely martial and responsive; fourth, he was broad-minded and benevolent; fifth, he knew people and appointed them well.'
example: 只有～，才能人尽其才。
exampleTraditional: 只有～，才能人盡其才。
exampleEn: Only by knowing people and assigning them well can everyone's talents be fully utilized.

explanation: 卑躬低头弯腰；屈膝下跪。形容没有骨气，低声下气地讨好奉承。
explanationTraditional: 卑躬低頭彎腰；屈膝下跪。形容沒有骨氣，低聲下氣地討好奉承。
explanationEn: To bow and scrape; to act obsequiously and servilely.
derivation: 宋·魏了翁《江陵州丛兰精舍记》公卿大臣皆卑躬屈膝唯后，虽谢安石之贤也，而犹不能免。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏了翁《江陵州叢蘭精舍記》公卿大臣皆卑躬屈膝唯後，雖謝安石之賢也，而猶不能免。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wei Liaoweng's 'Record of the Conglan Fine House in Jiangling Prefecture': 'High ministers and officials all bowed and scraped, even the virtuous Xie An could not avoid it.'
example: 不管有多大困难也不能向朝廷～，用变节投降的办法，苟安一时。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十四章
exampleTraditional: 不管有多大困難也不能向朝廷～，用變節投降的辦法，苟安一時。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十四章
exampleEn: No matter how great the difficulty, one must not bow and scrape to the court, using treacherous surrender to gain temporary peace. (Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 14)

explanation: 修建立；睦和睦。人与人之间，国与国之间，讲究信用，谋求和睦。
explanationTraditional: 修建立；睦和睦。人與人之間，國與國之間，講究信用，謀求和睦。
explanationEn: To emphasize trust and seek harmony among people or nations.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》选贤与能，讲信修睦。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》選賢與能，講信修睦。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: The Conveyance of Rites': 'Select the worthy and capable, emphasize trust and seek harmony.'
example: 我国民务扩新知，多尽义务，对于内则父诏兄勉，对于外则～。★蔡东藩、许厪父《民国通俗演义》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 我國民務擴新知，多盡義務，對於內則父詔兄勉，對於外則～。★蔡東藩、許厪父《民國通俗演義》第四十四回
exampleEn: Our people should expand their knowledge, fulfill their duties, and at home follow the teachings of fathers and brothers, while abroad practice trust and harmony. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Jingfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 44

explanation: 与山外、林外距离远的、人急至的山岭、森林。
explanationTraditional: 與山外、林外距離遠的、人急至的山嶺、森林。
explanationEn: Remote mountains and dense forests far from human habitation.
derivation: 鲁迅《彷徨·伤逝》我看见怒涛中的渔夫，战壕中的兵士，摩托车中的贵人，洋场上的投机家，深山密林中的豪杰。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《彷徨·傷逝》我看見怒濤中的漁夫，戰壕中的兵士，摩托車中的貴人，洋場上的投機家，深山密林中的豪傑。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Wandering: Regret for the Past': 'I saw fishermen in angry waves, soldiers in trenches, nobles in motorcycles, speculators in foreign concessions, and heroes in deep mountains and dense forests.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 捂着鼻子走过去。形容对腥臭肮脏的东西的嫌恶。
explanationTraditional: 捂著鼻子走過去。形容對腥臭骯髒的東西的嫌惡。
explanationEn: To cover one's nose and pass by; to show disgust for something filthy or foul.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄下》西子蒙不洁，则人皆掩鼻而过之。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁下》西子蒙不潔，則人皆掩鼻而過之。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Li Lou II': 'If Xi Shi were covered with filth, everyone would cover their noses and pass by her.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 空空洞洞，没有什么内容。多指言谈、文章极其空泛。
explanationTraditional: 空空洞洞，沒有什麼內容。多指言談、文章極其空泛。
explanationEn: Empty and devoid of content; often refers to speech or writing that is extremely vague.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·排调》此中空洞无物，然容卿辈数百人。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·排調》此中空洞無物，然容卿輩數百人。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Witty Remarks': 'This place is empty and devoid of content, yet it can accommodate hundreds of people like you.'
example: 出了口吻、技巧和声调之外，八股文里是～的。★朱自清《经典常谈·文第十三》
exampleTraditional: 出了口吻、技巧和聲調之外，八股文裡是～的。★朱自清《經典常談·文第十三》
exampleEn: Apart from tone, technique, and style, the eight-legged essay is empty and devoid of content. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Essays: Literature Chapter 13'

explanation: 绵绵连续不断的样子。形容多，连续不断。
explanationTraditional: 綿綿連續不斷的樣子。形容多，連續不斷。
explanationEn: Continuous and unbroken; describes a large number or continuous flow.
derivation: 三国·魏·王肃《孔子家语·观周》涓涓不壅，终为江河，绵绵不绝，或成网罗。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·王肅《孔子家語·觀周》涓涓不壅，終為江河，綿綿不絕，或成網羅。”
derivationEn: From Wang Su's 'Family Sayings of Confucius: Observing Zhou': 'If a trickle is not blocked, it becomes a river; if continuous, it may form a net.'
example: 正是清明时节，少不得天公应时，催花雨下，那阵雨下得～。★《警世通言·白娘子永镇雷峰塔》
exampleTraditional: 正是清明時節，少不得天公應時，催花雨下，那陣雨下得～。★《警世通言·白娘子永鎮雷峰塔》
exampleEn: It was the Qingming Festival, and as expected, the rain fell continuously, drizzling without end. — 'Stories to Caution the World: The White Snake'

explanation: 垂接近，快要。事情在将要成功的时候遭到了失败。
explanationTraditional: 垂接近，快要。事情在將要成功的時候遭到了失敗。
explanationEn: To fail when success is within reach; a setback at the brink of achievement.
derivation: 《三国志·杨阜传》弃垂成之功，陷不义之名，阜以死守之。”《晋书·谢玄传论》庙算有余，良图不果；降龄何促，功败垂成。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·楊阜傳》棄垂成之功，陷不義之名，阜以死守之。”《晉書·謝玄傳論》廟算有餘，良圖不果；降齡何促，功敗垂成。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Yang Fu': 'Abandoning nearly accomplished merit and falling into unrighteousness, I will defend to the death.' And 'Book of Jin: Biography of Xie Xuan': 'Strategies were ample, but good plans were not realized; why was his life so short, causing failure at the brink of success?'
example: 况且十二道金牌，他未必不知道是假的，何必就班师回去，以致～。（清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第六十一回）
exampleTraditional: 況且十二道金牌，他未必不知道是假的，何必就班師回去，以致～。（清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第六十一回）
exampleEn: Moreover, the twelve gold medals were probably fake, so why retreat and cause failure at the brink of success? — Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 61

explanation: 自己过了河，便把桥拆掉。比喻达到目的后，就把帮助过自己的人一脚踢开。
explanationTraditional: 自己過了河，便把橋拆掉。比喻達到目的後，就把幫助過自己的人一腳踢開。
explanationEn: To burn the bridge after crossing the river; to discard those who helped one after achieving one's goal.
derivation: 元·康进之《李逵负棘》第三折你休得顺水推船，偏不许我过河拆桥。”
derivationTraditional: 元·康進之《李逵負棘》第三折你休得順水推船，偏不許我過河拆橋。”
derivationEn: From Yuan drama 'Li Kui Carries Thorns' by Kang Jinzhi, Act 3: 'You should not go with the current, but you won't allow me to burn the bridge after crossing the river.'
example: 祥子受了那么多的累，～，老头子翻脸不认人，他们替祥子不平。★老舍《骆驼祥子》十四
exampleTraditional: 祥子受了那麼多的累，～，老頭子翻臉不認人，他們替祥子不平。★老舍《駱駝祥子》十四
exampleEn: Xiangzi had endured so much hardship, but the old man turned his back on him after crossing the river, and they felt indignant for Xiangzi. — Lao She, 'Rickshaw Boy', Chapter 14

explanation: 瓮一种陶制的盛器。比喻用某人整治别人的办法来整治他自己。
explanationTraditional: 甕一種陶製的盛器。比喻用某人整治別人的辦法來整治他自己。
explanationEn: To use someone's own methods against them; to make someone suffer the same fate they intended for others.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·唐纪·则天皇后天授二年》兴曰‘此甚易尔！取大瓮，令囚入中，何事不承！’俊臣乃索大瓮，火围如兴法，因起谓兴曰‘有内状推兄，请兄入此瓮。’兴惶恐叩头伏罪。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·唐紀·則天皇后天授二年》興曰‘此甚易爾！取大甕，令囚入中，何事不承！’俊臣乃索大甕，火圍如興法，因起謂興曰‘有內狀推兄，請兄入此甕。’興惶恐叩頭伏罪。”
derivationEn: From 'Comprehensive Mirror for Aid in Government: Tang Records': 'Zhou Xing said, 'This is easy! Get a large vat, put the prisoner inside, and he will confess anything!' Lai Junchen then ordered a vat, surrounded it with fire as Zhou had described, and said to Zhou, 'There is an imperial order to interrogate you, please enter the vat.' Zhou kowtowed in fear and confessed.'
example: 掬西江之水，为尔洗肠，即烧东壁之床，～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·席方平》
exampleTraditional: 掬西江之水，為爾洗腸，即燒東壁之床，～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·席方平》
exampleEn: Scoop up water from the West River to wash your intestines, then burn the eastern wall bed and invite you into the vat. — Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Xi Fangping'

explanation: 弊害处，坏处。兴办对国家人民有益利的事业，除去各种弊端。
explanationTraditional: 弊害處，壞處。興辦對國家人民有益利的事業，除去各種弊端。
explanationEn: To promote beneficial undertakings and eliminate harmful practices.
derivation: 《管子·君臣下》为民兴利除害，正民之德。”宋·王安石《答司马谏议书》举先王之政，以兴利除弊，不为生事。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·君臣下》為民興利除害，正民之德。”宋·王安石《答司馬諫議書》舉先王之政，以興利除弊，不為生事。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Ruler and Ministers': 'Promote benefits and eliminate harms for the people, correct their virtue.' And Wang Anshi's 'Reply to Sima Guang's Letter': 'Implement the policies of former kings to promote benefits and eliminate harms, not to create trouble.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 眼睛看到四面八方。形容机智灵活，遇事能多方观察，全面了解。
explanationTraditional: 眼睛看到四面八方。形容機智靈活，遇事能多方觀察，全面瞭解。
explanationEn: To have eyes that see in all directions; to be alert and observant, able to perceive situations from multiple angles.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第53回为将之道，身临战场，务要眼观四处，耳听八方。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第53回為將之道，身臨戰場，務要眼觀四處，耳聽八方。”
derivationEn: From Ming novel 'Investiture of the Gods' by Xu Zhonglin, Chapter 53: 'As a general on the battlefield, one must look in all directions and listen to all sides.'
example: 要是没有一种～，耳听八方到处显出精明强干的能力，任凭你有天好的本事，满肚子的学问。★老舍《赵子曰》
exampleTraditional: 要是沒有一種～，耳聽八方到處顯出精明強幹的能力，任憑你有天好的本事，滿肚子的學問。★老舍《趙子曰》
exampleEn: Without the ability to see in all directions and listen to all sides, showing sharpness and competence, no matter how great your talent or knowledge, it is useless. — Lao She, 'Zhao Ziyue'

explanation: 酬实现。旧指潦倒的一生，志向没有实现就衰老了。也指抱负没有实现就去世了。
explanationTraditional: 酬實現。舊指潦倒的一生，志向沒有實現就衰老了。也指抱負沒有實現就去世了。
explanationEn: To have one's lofty aspirations unfulfilled; to die before realizing one's ambitions.
derivation: 唐·李频《春日思归》壮志未酬三尺剑，故乡空隔万重山。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李頻《春日思歸》壯志未酬三尺劍，故鄉空隔萬重山。”
derivationEn: From Li Pin's poem 'Spring Day Longing for Home' in the Tang Dynasty: 'My lofty aspirations unfulfilled, a three-foot sword in hand; my hometown is separated by thousands of mountains.'
example: 这些感情炽烈的诗篇，抒发了作者～的愤懑之情。
exampleTraditional: 這些感情熾烈的詩篇，抒發了作者～的憤懣之情。
exampleEn: These passionate poems express the author's indignation over his unfulfilled ambitions.

explanation: 支支持；绌屈曲，引伸为不足。原指弯弓射箭的姿势，左手支持，右手屈曲。指力量不足，应付了这方面，那方面又出了问题。
explanationTraditional: 支支持；絀屈曲，引伸為不足。原指彎弓射箭的姿勢，左手支持，右手屈曲。指力量不足，應付了這方面，那方面又出了問題。
explanationEn: To be unable to cope with a situation; to have too many problems to handle at once.
derivation: 《战国策·西周策》我不能教子支左屈右。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·西周策》我不能教子支左屈右。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Western Zhou': 'I cannot teach you to support with the left and bend with the right.'
example: 两路夹攻，杀得冷军～，只好弃甲曳兵，败阵下去。★蔡东藩、许厪父《民国通俗演义》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 兩路夾攻，殺得冷軍～，只好棄甲曳兵，敗陣下去。★蔡東藩、許厪父《民國通俗演義》第二十八回
exampleEn: Attacked from both sides, the cold army was unable to cope, so they abandoned their armor and fled in defeat.

explanation: 怅然形容不如意、不痛快。象失去什么似的烦恼不快。
explanationTraditional: 悵然形容不如意、不痛快。象失去什麼似的煩惱不快。
explanationEn: To feel disappointed and lost, as if something is missing.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·雅量》殷怅然自失。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·雅量》殷悵然自失。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' in the Southern Dynasties: 'Yin felt disappointed and lost.'
example: 忠泣诉父名，主人～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·牛成章》
exampleTraditional: 忠泣訴父名，主人～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·牛成章》
exampleEn: Zhong wept and told his father's name, and the host felt disappointed and lost.

explanation: 饱含温情，默默地用眼神表达自己的感情。常用以形容少女面对意中人稍带娇羞但又无限关切的表情。
explanationTraditional: 飽含溫情，默默地用眼神表達自己的感情。常用以形容少女面對意中人稍帶嬌羞但又無限關切的表情。
explanationEn: To be full of tender affection, silently expressing feelings with the eyes; often describes a shy but caring look from a young woman toward her beloved.
derivation: 唐·李德裕《二芳丛赋》一则含情脉脉，如有思而不得，类西施之容冶，眼红罗之盛饰。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李德裕《二芳叢賦》一則含情脈脈，如有思而不得，類西施之容冶，眼紅羅之盛飾。”
derivationEn: From Li Deyu's 'Ode to Two Fragrant Clusters' in the Tang Dynasty: 'One is full of tender affection, as if thinking but unable to attain, like the beauty of Xi Shi, with red silk adorning her eyes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 立即行动起来，努力追赶上去。
explanationTraditional: 立即行動起來，努力追趕上去。
explanationEn: To immediately take action and strive to catch up.
derivation: 宋·孙觌《鸿庆居士文集》故今日之乱，且置无丰，元祐勿论，宜度时之所宜为者，急起而趋之，如拯焚救罔，不然，袭常祖故，以乱救乱，天下纷纷，何时而定也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·孫覿《鴻慶居士文集》故今日之亂，且置無豐，元祐勿論，宜度時之所宜為者，急起而趨之，如拯焚救罔，不然，襲常祖故，以亂救亂，天下紛紛，何時而定也。”
derivationEn: From Sun Di's 'Collected Works of Hongqing Jushi' in the Song Dynasty: 'Therefore, in today's chaos, set aside the disputes of Yuanfeng and Yuanyou, and act according to what is timely, as if rescuing from fire or flood.'
example: 值此建设时代，内乱外患，险象环生，各行政官力负责任，～。★蔡东藩、许厪父《民国通俗演义》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 值此建設時代，內亂外患，險象環生，各行政官力負責任，～。★蔡東藩、許厪父《民國通俗演義》第三十五回
exampleEn: In this era of construction, with internal strife and external threats, administrative officials must take responsibility and strive to catch up.

explanation: 玲珑精巧细致；剔透孔穴明晰。形容器物精致通明，结构细巧。也比喻人精明灵活。
explanationTraditional: 玲瓏精巧細緻；剔透孔穴明晰。形容器物精緻通明，結構細巧。也比喻人精明靈活。
explanationEn: Exquisitely carved and transparent; also describes a person who is clever and quick-witted.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《救风尘》第二折那厮爱女娘的心，见的便似驴共狗，卖弄他玲珑剔透。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《救風塵》第二折那廝愛女娘的心，見的便似驢共狗，賣弄他玲瓏剔透。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'Rescuing a Prostitute' in the Yuan Dynasty: 'That fellow's love for women is like a donkey or a dog, showing off his cleverness.'
example: 走上冈子一看，有座天，直靠在海外，如建康燕子矶一样，～，文采可观。（清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十六回）
exampleTraditional: 走上岡子一看，有座天，直靠在海外，如建康燕子磯一樣，～，文采可觀。（清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十六回）
exampleEn: Climbing up the hill, one sees a tower leaning against the sea, like the Swallow Rock in Jiankang, exquisitely carved and beautifully patterned.

explanation: 神魂精神，神志。精神恍惚，颠三倒四，失去常态。
explanationTraditional: 神魂精神，神志。精神恍惚，顛三倒四，失去常態。
explanationEn: To be infatuated or obsessed to the point of losing one's senses.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十六小娘们多有爱他的，奉得神魂颠倒，连家里也不思想。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十六小娘們多有愛他的，奉得神魂顛倒，連家裡也不思想。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' in the Ming Dynasty: 'Many young women loved him, doting on him to the point of infatuation, even forgetting about home.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 如焚象火烧一样。心里愁得象火烧一样。形容非常忧虑焦急。
explanationTraditional: 如焚象火燒一樣。心裡愁得象火燒一樣。形容非常憂慮焦急。
explanationEn: To be extremely worried and anxious, as if one's heart is burning.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·节南山》忧心如焚，不敢戏谈。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·節南山》憂心如焚，不敢戲談。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Minor Odes: Jie Nan Shan': 'Worry burns like fire, dare not jest or play.'
example: ～，命不久矣。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八十回
exampleTraditional: ～，命不久矣。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八十回
exampleEn: His heart burning with worry, his life was soon to end.

explanation: 指符合道义者则能得到多数人的帮助。
explanationTraditional: 指符合道義者則能得到多數人的幫助。
explanationEn: A just cause gains abundant support.
derivation: 先秦·孟轲《孟子·公孙丑下》得道者多助，失道者寡助。寡助之至，亲戚畔之。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·孟軻《孟子·公孫丑下》得道者多助，失道者寡助。寡助之至，親戚畔之。”
derivationEn: From Mencius' 'Mencius: Gongsun Chou II': 'He who has the Way will have many to help him; he who has not the Way will have few to help him.'
example: 我则～，彼则众叛亲离。★孙中山《军人精神教育》第二章
exampleTraditional: 我則～，彼則眾叛親離。★孫中山《軍人精神教育》第二章
exampleEn: We will have abundant support, while they will be deserted by their followers.

explanation: 名声传扬到各地，形容名声很大。
explanationTraditional: 名聲傳揚到各地，形容名聲很大。
explanationEn: To be famous far and near; to have a widespread reputation.
derivation: 《魏书·崔浩传》奚斤辨捷智谋，名闻遐迩。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·崔浩傳》奚斤辨捷智謀，名聞遐邇。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Wei: Biography of Cui Hao': 'Xi Jin was eloquent and resourceful, famous far and near.'
example: 中国的长城～。
exampleTraditional: 中國的長城～。
exampleEn: China's Great Wall is famous far and near.

explanation: 各种丑恶的样子都表现出来了。
explanationTraditional: 各種醜惡的樣子都表現出來了。
explanationEn: All sorts of ugly behaviors are displayed.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十七回得失心未免过重，以致弄的忽哭忽笑，丑态百出。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十七回得失心未免過重，以致弄的忽哭忽笑，醜態百出。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 67: 'He was too concerned with gain and loss, causing him to cry and laugh alternately, making a complete fool of himself.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 臭味气味；相投互相投合。彼此的思想作风、兴趣等相同，很合得来（常指坏的）。
explanationTraditional: 臭味氣味；相投互相投合。彼此的思想作風、興趣等相同，很合得來（常指壞的）。
explanationEn: People with similar bad habits or interests get along well.
derivation: 《左传·襄公八年》今譬于草木，寡君在君，君之臭味也『·蔡邕《玄文先生李休碑》凡其亲昭朋徒、臭味相与，大会而葬之。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公八年》今譬於草木，寡君在君，君之臭味也『·蔡邕《玄文先生李休碑》凡其親昭朋徒、臭味相與，大會而葬之。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan', Duke Xiang, Year 8: 'Now compare to plants and trees; our lord is in your lord's presence, like your lord's odor.' Also Cai Yong, 'Epitaph for Mr. Xuanwen Li Xiu': 'All his relatives and friends, sharing the same odor, gathered for his burial.'
example: 两情不谋而合，况是彼此熟识，一经会面，～，当即互相借重，定名为请愿联合会。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第四八回
exampleTraditional: 兩情不謀而合，況是彼此熟識，一經會面，～，當即互相借重，定名為請願聯合會。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第四八回
exampleEn: The two had the same ideas without prior consultation, and since they were already acquainted, upon meeting they found each other congenial, and immediately joined forces, naming their group the 'Petition Federation.' — Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 48

explanation: 甘甜；饴麦芽糖浆。感到象糖那样甜。指为了从事某种工作，甘愿承受艰难、痛苦。
explanationTraditional: 甘甜；飴麥芽糖漿。感到象糖那樣甜。指為了從事某種工作，甘願承受艱難、痛苦。
explanationEn: To willingly endure hardship or pain as if it were sweet.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·绵》堇茶如饴。”郑玄笺其所生菜，虽有性苦者，甘如饴也。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·綿》堇茶如飴。”鄭玄箋其所生菜，雖有性苦者，甘如飴也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs', 'Daya', 'Mian': 'The bitter herbs are as sweet as malt sugar.' Zheng Xuan's commentary: 'The vegetables that grow there, though bitter in nature, are as sweet as malt sugar.'
example: 背书背不出，老师”往往大发娇嗔，自然骂得人下不了台，而张曜～。★高阳《清宫外史》上册
exampleTraditional: 背書背不出，老師”往往大發嬌嗔，自然罵得人下不了臺，而張曜～。★高陽《清宮外史》上冊
exampleEn: When he couldn't recite his lessons, the teacher would often lose her temper and scold him harshly, but Zhang Yao took it as sweet as malt sugar. — Gao Yang, 'Inside the Qing Palace', Volume 1

explanation: 筹筹码。比别人高出一个筹码。指比别人高明一些。
explanationTraditional: 籌籌碼。比別人高出一個籌碼。指比別人高明一些。
explanationEn: To be a cut above others; to be superior.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十五回孙文慨然道‘公系我国的政治家，一切设施，比文等高出一筹，文亦不必参议。’”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十五回孫文慨然道‘公系我國的政治家，一切設施，比文等高出一籌，文亦不必參議。’”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 15: 'Sun Wen said with emotion: 'You are a statesman of our country; your policies are a cut above mine, so I need not offer my opinions.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 击鼓和奏乐声一齐响。形容热闹景象。
explanationTraditional: 擊鼓和奏樂聲一齊響。形容熱鬧景象。
explanationEn: Drums and music sound together; a scene of great festivity.
derivation: 郭沫若《虎符》第二幕群众起来，鼓乐齐鸣。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《虎符》第二幕群眾起來，鼓樂齊鳴。”
derivationEn: Guo Moruo, 'Lord Xinling', Act 2: 'The crowd rises, drums and music sound together.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 狂妄极端的自高自大。指极其放肆，自高自大，自中无人。
explanationTraditional: 狂妄極端的自高自大。指極其放肆，自高自大，自中無人。
explanationEn: Extremely arrogant and conceited; self-important.
derivation: 《旧唐书·皇甫榑传》执谊，叔文乘时多僻，而欲斡运六合，斟酌万几；……而狂妄之甚也。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·皇甫榑傳》執誼，叔文乘時多僻，而欲斡運六合，斟酌萬幾；……而狂妄之甚也。”
derivationEn: 'Old Book of Tang', Biography of Huangfu Bo: 'Zhiyi and Shuwen took advantage of troubled times, trying to manage the whole world and weigh myriad affairs... such extreme arrogance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 双方互相看着，发出会心的微笑。形容二者情合意洽的情态。
explanationTraditional: 雙方互相看著，發出會心的微笑。形容二者情合意洽的情態。
explanationEn: To look at each other and smile knowingly; indicating mutual understanding and harmony.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指平庸的人。
explanationTraditional: 泛指平庸的人。
explanationEn: Ordinary, common people; mediocrities.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第四十三回吾等又不是凡夫俗子，恃强斗勇，皆非仙体。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第四十三回吾等又不是凡夫俗子，恃強鬥勇，皆非仙體。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 43: 'We are not ordinary mortals who rely on strength and fight; we are not of the immortal kind.'
example: 瞧我这～，不能交通神明，所以梦都没有一个儿。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一○九回
exampleTraditional: 瞧我這～，不能交通神明，所以夢都沒有一個兒。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一○九回
exampleEn: Look at me, a common mortal, unable to communicate with the gods, so I don't have a single dream. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 109

explanation: 灾祸从口里产生出来。指说话不谨慎容易惹祸。
explanationTraditional: 災禍從口裡產生出來。指說話不謹慎容易惹禍。
explanationEn: Disaster comes from the mouth; careless talk leads to trouble.
derivation: 晋·傅玄《口铭》病从口入，祸从口出。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·傅玄《口銘》病從口入，禍從口出。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Fu Xuan, 'Inscription on the Mouth': 'Disease enters by the mouth, disaster comes out of the mouth.'
example: 在这样～”之秋，给自己也辩护得周到一点罢。★鲁迅《华盖集续编·再来一次》
exampleTraditional: 在這樣～”之秋，給自己也辯護得周到一點罷。★魯迅《華蓋集續編·再來一次》
exampleEn: In this era of 'disaster from the mouth,' it's better to defend yourself a bit more. — Lu Xun, 'Huagai Collection Continued: Once More'

explanation: 指苦心钻研，到了别人所达不到的地步。也指为寻求解决问题的办法而煞费苦心。
explanationTraditional: 指苦心鑽研，到了別人所達不到的地步。也指為尋求解決問題的辦法而煞費苦心。
explanationEn: To make painstaking efforts to achieve something unique or to find a solution.
derivation: 清·翁方纲《复初斋文集·格调论下》今且勿以意匠之独运者言之，且勿以苦心孤诣戛戛独造者言之，公且以效古之作若规仿格调者言之。”
derivationTraditional: 清·翁方綱《復初齋文集·格調論下》今且勿以意匠之獨運者言之，且勿以苦心孤詣戛戛獨造者言之，公且以效古之作若規仿格調者言之。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Weng Fanggang, 'Fuchuzhai Essays: On Style': 'Now let's not talk about the unique craftsmanship of the mind, nor about painstaking efforts that are uniquely original; let's talk about works that imitate the ancients in style.'
example: ～地运动着做了一次大总统，后来被人赶跑了，跑向天津。★郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年》
exampleTraditional: ～地運動著做了一次大總統，後來被人趕跑了，跑向天津。★郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年》
exampleEn: He painstakingly maneuvered to become president once, but was later driven away and fled to Tianjin. — Guo Moruo, 'Revolutionary Spring and Autumn: The Creative Decade'

explanation: 比喻说话做事漏洞非常多。
explanationTraditional: 比喻說話做事漏洞非常多。
explanationEn: Full of flaws or loopholes; said of speech or actions that have many inconsistencies.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他的话破绽百出，十分可疑。
exampleTraditional: 他的話破綻百出，十分可疑。
exampleEn: His speech was full of flaws and very suspicious.

explanation: 探头或上体向前伸出。伸着头向左右张望。形容鬼鬼祟祟的探望。
explanationTraditional: 探頭或上體向前伸出。伸著頭向左右張望。形容鬼鬼祟祟的探望。
explanationEn: To poke one's head out and look around furtively; to act sneakily.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十五回却好交五更时候，只见那个头陀挟着木鱼，来巷口探头探脑。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十五回卻好交五更時候，只見那個頭陀挾著木魚，來巷口探頭探腦。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 45 of 'Water Margin' by Shi Nai'an of the Ming Dynasty: 'Just at the fifth watch, the monk with a wooden fish came to the alley entrance, poking his head and looking around.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹真心实意。
explanationTraditional: 猶真心實意。
explanationEn: Genuine and sincere feelings; wholeheartedness.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十九回那黛玉偏生也是个有些痴病的，也每用假情试探。因你也将真心真意瞒起来，我也将真心真意瞒起来，都只用假意试探。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十九回那黛玉偏生也是個有些痴病的，也每用假情試探。因你也將真心真意瞞起來，我也將真心真意瞞起來，都只用假意試探。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 29 of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' by Cao Xueqin of the Qing Dynasty: 'Daiyu was also somewhat sickly and often tested with false feelings. Because you hide your true heart, and I hide mine, we both use pretense to test each other.'
example: 你猜炳哥怎么说的？他说他从前～爱过的，只有一个人。真心真意好过的，也只有一个人。★欧阳山《苦斗》第二十二章
exampleTraditional: 你猜炳哥怎麼說的？他說他從前～愛過的，只有一個人。真心真意好過的，也只有一個人。★歐陽山《苦鬥》第二十二章
exampleEn: Guess what Brother Bing said? He said that in the past, he had truly loved only one person. He had been wholeheartedly devoted to only one person. — Ouyang Shan, 'Struggle', Chapter 22

explanation: 揽采摘。到天的最高处去摘月。常形容壮志豪情。
explanationTraditional: 攬採摘。到天的最高處去摘月。常形容壯志豪情。
explanationEn: To pluck the moon from the highest heavens; often describes lofty aspirations and heroic spirit.
derivation: 唐·李白《宣州谢眺楼饯别校书叔云》诗俱怀逸兴壮思飞，欲上青天揽明月。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《宣州謝眺樓餞別校書叔雲》詩俱懷逸興壯思飛，欲上青天攬明月。”
derivationEn: From Li Bai's poem 'Farewell to Uncle Yun, Imperial Librarian, at Xie Tiao's Pavilion in Xuanzhou' of the Tang Dynasty: 'We both cherish lofty sentiments and soaring thoughts, wanting to pluck the bright moon from the blue sky.'
example: 可上～，可下五洋捉鳖。★毛泽东《水调歌头·重上井冈山》词
exampleTraditional: 可上～，可下五洋捉鱉。★毛澤東《水調歌頭·重上井岡山》詞
exampleEn: We can pluck the moon from the nine heavens and catch turtles in the five oceans. — Mao Zedong, 'Water Melody: Reascending Jinggangshan'

explanation: 本指身躯、四肢、须发、皮肤，后亦泛指自己身体的全部，自身。
explanationTraditional: 本指身軀、四肢、鬚髮、皮膚，後亦泛指自己身體的全部，自身。
explanationEn: Refers to one's entire body, including limbs, hair, and skin; later extended to mean one's whole self.
derivation: 《孝经·开宗明义》身体发肤，受之父母，不敢毁伤，孝之始也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孝經·開宗明義》身體髮膚，受之父母，不敢毀傷，孝之始也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Classic of Filial Piety: Opening the Explanation and Illustrating the Meaning': 'Our bodies, limbs, hair, and skin are received from our parents; we dare not injure them—this is the beginning of filial piety.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 凭弱小的力量战胜力量强大的。
explanationTraditional: 憑弱小的力量戰勝力量強大的。
explanationEn: To defeat a stronger opponent with weaker forces; to overcome strength with weakness.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 以弱胜强的例子举不胜举。
exampleTraditional: 以弱勝強的例子舉不勝舉。
exampleEn: Examples of the weak defeating the strong are too numerous to mention.

explanation: 悱恻悲苦的样子。旧时形容内心痛苦难以排解。也指文章感情婉转凄凉。
explanationTraditional: 悱惻悲苦的樣子。舊時形容內心痛苦難以排解。也指文章感情婉轉淒涼。
explanationEn: Describes deep emotional distress that is hard to resolve; also refers to writing that is emotionally moving and sorrowful.
derivation: 晋·潘岳《寡妇赋》思缠绵以瞀乱兮，心摧伤以怆恻。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·潘岳《寡婦賦》思纏綿以瞀亂兮，心摧傷以愴惻。”
derivationEn: From Pan Yue's 'Rhapsody on a Widow' of the Jin Dynasty: 'Thoughts entangled and confused, heart wounded and sorrowful.'
example: 他是个忠臣，而且是个～的忠臣。★朱自清《经典常谈·辞赋》
exampleTraditional: 他是個忠臣，而且是個～的忠臣。★朱自清《經典常談·辭賦》
exampleEn: He was a loyal minister, and a deeply sorrowful one. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Introductions: Ci and Fu'

explanation: 飞蛾扑到火上，比喻自取灭亡。
explanationTraditional: 飛蛾撲到火上，比喻自取滅亡。
explanationEn: A moth flying into a flame; metaphor for seeking one's own destruction.
derivation: 《梁书·到溉传》如飞蛾之赴火，岂焚身之可吝。”
derivationTraditional: 《梁書·到溉傳》如飛蛾之赴火，豈焚身之可吝。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Liang: Biography of Dao Gai': 'Like a moth flying into a fire, how could it regret being burned?'
example: 他今日自来投到，岂不是～，自讨死吃的。★元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第二折
exampleTraditional: 他今日自來投到，豈不是～，自討死吃的。★元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第二折
exampleEn: He came to us today of his own accord—isn't that like a moth flying into a flame, seeking death? — Yuan Dynasty, Yang Xianzhi, 'Rain on the Xiao and Xiang Rivers', Act 2

explanation: 指整个天下；遍天下。
explanationTraditional: 指整個天下；遍天下。
explanationEn: All under heaven; the entire world; everywhere.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·北山》溥天之下，莫非王土；率土之滨，莫非王臣。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·北山》溥天之下，莫非王土；率土之濱，莫非王臣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Lesser Odes: Northern Mountains': 'All under heaven is the king's land; all within the borders is the king's subject.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 衣食不足。指贫穷。亦作缺食无衣”。
explanationTraditional: 衣食不足。指貧窮。亦作缺食無衣”。
explanationEn: Lacking clothing and food; to be poor and destitute.
derivation: 明李贽《焚书·复李渐老书》即此衣食之赐，既深以为喜，则缺衣少食之烦恼不言而知也。”
derivationTraditional: 明李贄《焚書·復李漸老書》即此衣食之賜，既深以為喜，則缺衣少食之煩惱不言而知也。”
derivationEn: From Li Zhi's 'A Book to Burn: Reply to Li Jianlao' of the Ming Dynasty: 'Since I am deeply grateful for the gift of food and clothing, the troubles of lacking clothes and food are self-evident.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻没有月光风也很大的夜晚。比喻险恶的环境。
explanationTraditional: 比喻沒有月光風也很大的夜晚。比喻險惡的環境。
explanationEn: Describes a dark, windy night, often implying a dangerous or sinister environment.
derivation: 元·元怀《拊掌录》欧阳公与人行令，各作诗两句，须犯徒以上罪者……一云‘月黑杀人夜，风高放火天。’”
derivationTraditional: 元·元懷《拊掌錄》歐陽公與人行令，各作詩兩句，須犯徒以上罪者……一雲‘月黑殺人夜，風高放火天。’”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Yuan Huai's 'Fu Zhang Lu': Ouyang Xiu and others made a drinking game, each composing two lines of poetry that must involve crimes... one said 'On a moonless night, murder is done; on a windy night, arson is set.'
example: 遇上～的晚上，飞砂走石，满地乱滚，长城就在咬牙切齿骂人了。★杨朔《秋风萧瑟》
exampleTraditional: 遇上～的晚上，飛砂走石，滿地亂滾，長城就在咬牙切齒罵人了。★楊朔《秋風蕭瑟》
exampleEn: On a dark and windy night, with sand and stones flying and rolling everywhere, the Great Wall seemed to be cursing through gritted teeth. — Yang Shuo, 'The Autumn Wind'

explanation: 表示又爱又恨的意思。小说戏曲中多用作对情人或儿女的亲热称呼。
explanationTraditional: 表示又愛又恨的意思。小說戲曲中多用作對情人或兒女的親熱稱呼。
explanationEn: Refers to a lover or spouse with whom one has a love-hate relationship; often used as an affectionate term for a sweetheart or child in novels and dramas.
derivation: 元·童童学士《新水令·念远》生也因他，死也因他，恩爱人儿，冤家。”
derivationTraditional: 元·童童學士《新水令·念遠》生也因他，死也因他，恩愛人兒，冤家。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Tong Tong Scholar's 'New Water Order: Thinking of the Distance': 'Living because of him, dying because of him, loving person, yet a foe.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 好象在哭泣，又象在诉说。形容声音悲切。
explanationTraditional: 好象在哭泣，又象在訴說。形容聲音悲切。
explanationEn: Describes a sound that seems to be crying and telling a story, expressing deep sorrow or pathos.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《前赤壁赋》其声呜呜然，如怨如慕，如泣如诉。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《前赤壁賦》其聲嗚嗚然，如怨如慕，如泣如訴。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'First Ode to Red Cliff': 'Its sound was mournful, like resentment, like admiration, like weeping, like诉说.'
example: 风声～，墓地凄然悲凉。★冯德英《迎春花》第十九章
exampleTraditional: 風聲～，墓地悽然悲涼。★馮德英《迎春花》第十九章
exampleEn: The sound of the wind was like weeping and诉说, making the graveyard desolate and sad. — Feng Deying, 'Winter Jasmine' Chapter 19

explanation: 象山一样高耸，如水一般长流。原比喻人的风范或声誉象高山一样永远存在◇比喻恩德深厚。
explanationTraditional: 象山一樣高聳，如水一般長流。原比喻人的風範或聲譽象高山一樣永遠存在◇比喻恩德深厚。
explanationEn: Originally metaphor for a person's character or reputation enduring like mountains and rivers; later also means deep kindness or lasting influence.
derivation: 唐·刘禹锡《望赋》龙门不见兮，云雾苍苍。乔木何许兮，山高水长。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉禹錫《望賦》龍門不見兮，雲霧蒼蒼。喬木何許兮，山高水長。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Yuxi's 'Fu on Gazing': 'The dragon gate is unseen, clouds and mist vast. The tall trees, where are they? Mountains high and waters long.'
example: 云山苍苍，江水泱泱。先生之风，～。★宋·范仲淹《严先生祠堂记》
exampleTraditional: 雲山蒼蒼，江水泱泱。先生之風，～。★宋·范仲淹《嚴先生祠堂記》
exampleEn: The clouds on the mountains are vast, the river waters are mighty. The gentleman's virtue is like mountains high and waters long. — Song Dynasty Fan Zhongyan, 'Inscription for Mr. Yan's Ancestral Hall'

explanation: 比喻很有把握。
explanationTraditional: 比喻很有把握。
explanationEn: Means very confident or certain of success.
derivation: 明·阮大铖《燕子笺·购幸》此是十拿九稳，必中的计较。”
derivationTraditional: 明·阮大鋮《燕子箋·購幸》此是十拿九穩，必中的計較。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ruan Dacheng's 'Swallow Note: Buying Luck': 'This is a ten-out-of-nine sure thing, a certain calculation.'
example: 他的学习成绩非趁，考大学应当是～的事。
exampleTraditional: 他的學習成績非趁，考大學應當是～的事。
exampleEn: His academic performance is excellent; passing the college entrance exam should be a sure thing.

explanation: 指从来少有的绝妙佳作。
explanationTraditional: 指從來少有的絕妙佳作。
explanationEn: Refers to an extremely rare and superb masterpiece that has never been seen before.
derivation: 明·李贽《与汪鼎甫书》所谓水中盐味，可取不可得，是为千古绝唱，当与古文远垂不朽者也。”清·采蘅子《虫鸣漫录》卷二‘茶龟’对‘酒鳖’，真千古绝唱也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《與汪鼎甫書》所謂水中鹽味，可取不可得，是為千古絕唱，當與古文遠垂不朽者也。”清·採蘅子《蟲鳴漫錄》卷二‘茶龜’對‘酒鱉’，真千古絕唱也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Li Zhi's 'Letter to Wang Dingfu': 'Like the taste of salt in water, it can be obtained but not taken; this is a masterpiece for the ages, destined to be immortal alongside ancient texts.' Also Qing Dynasty Cai Quzi's 'Chong Ming Man Lu' vol. 2: 'Tea turtle' paired with 'wine turtle' is truly a masterpiece for the ages.
example: 一物而兼三名，原不为奇，最难得都是叠韵。古人命名之巧，无出其右，这可算得～了。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十二回
exampleTraditional: 一物而兼三名，原不為奇，最難得都是疊韻。古人命名之巧，無出其右，這可算得～了。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十二回
exampleEn: One object with three names is not strange, but the rarest thing is that they are all rhyming compounds. The ancients' cleverness in naming is unmatched; this can be considered a masterpiece for the ages. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 92

explanation: 做了坏事满不再乎，一点儿也不感到羞耻。
explanationTraditional: 做了壞事滿不再乎，一點兒也不感到羞恥。
explanationEn: Describes someone who does bad things without any shame or guilt.
derivation: 唐·冯贽《云仙杂记》卷八倪芳饮后，必有狂怪，恬然不耻。”宋·吕祖谦《左氏博议·卫礼至为铭》卫礼至行险，侥幸而取其国，恬不知耻，反勒其功于铭，以章示后。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·馮贄《雲仙雜記》卷八倪芳飲後，必有狂怪，恬然不恥。”宋·呂祖謙《左氏博議·衛禮至為銘》衛禮至行險，僥倖而取其國，恬不知恥，反勒其功於銘，以章示後。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Feng Zhi's 'Yun Xian Za Ji' vol. 8: 'Ni Fang, after drinking, always acts wildly and strangely, yet remains unashamed.' Song Dynasty Lü Zuqian's 'Zuo Shi Bo Yi: Wei Li Zhi Wei Ming': 'Wei Li Zhi took risks and luckily seized the state, yet felt no shame, instead inscribing his achievement on a stele to show later generations.'
example: 打这个～的走狗！”台下一片激怒的喊声，还是震动了台上的胡博士。★杨沫《青春之歌》第四十三章
exampleTraditional: 打這個～的走狗！”臺下一片激怒的喊聲，還是震動了臺上的胡博士。★楊沫《青春之歌》第四十三章
exampleEn: Strike this shameless lackey!' A burst of angry shouts from the audience still shook Dr. Hu on the stage. — Yang Mo, 'Song of Youth' Chapter 43

explanation: 杨柳古诗文中杨柳通用，泛指柳树。依依轻柔的样子。古人送行，折柳相赠，表示依依惜别。比喻依依不舍的惜别之情。
explanationTraditional: 楊柳古詩文中楊柳通用，泛指柳樹。依依輕柔的樣子。古人送行，折柳相贈，表示依依惜別。比喻依依不捨的惜別之情。
explanationEn: In ancient poetry, 'willow' often refers to the willow tree. 'Yiyi' describes a gentle, swaying manner. People used to break willow branches as a farewell gift, symbolizing reluctant parting. This idiom expresses deep attachment and reluctance to part.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容很少的数量。
explanationTraditional: 形容很少的數量。
explanationEn: Describes a very small amount or quantity.
derivation: 朱自清《给亡妇》那里有一分一毫想着你自己。”
derivationTraditional: 朱自清《給亡婦》那裡有一分一毫想著你自己。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Ziqing's 'To My Deceased Wife': 'Was there even a single bit of thought for yourself?'
example: 我们不能拿群众的～。
exampleTraditional: 我們不能拿群眾的～。
exampleEn: We must not take even a single cent from the masses.

explanation: 马前马后。指追随左右。
explanationTraditional: 馬前馬後。指追隨左右。
explanationEn: Means to follow closely behind someone, often serving or attending to them.
derivation: 王树元《杜鹃山》第五嘲前马后跟你跑，出生入死为你干。”
derivationTraditional: 王樹元《杜鵑山》第五嘲前馬後跟你跑，出生入死為你幹。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shuyuan's 'Azalea Mountain' Scene 5: 'I followed you before and after the saddle, running and working, risking my life for you.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 春风指笑容。比喻人喜悦舒畅的表情。形容和蔼愉快的面容。
explanationTraditional: 春風指笑容。比喻人喜悅舒暢的表情。形容和藹愉快的面容。
explanationEn: Beaming with joy; a face full of spring breeze, describing a cheerful and pleasant expression.
derivation: 宋·程节斋《沁园春》词满面春风，一团和气，发露胸中书与诗。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·程節齋《沁園春》詞滿面春風，一團和氣，發露胸中書與詩。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Cheng Jiezhai's poem 'Qinyuanchun': 'Face full of spring breeze, full of harmony, revealing the poetry and books in the heart.'
example: 只见路旁走过两个老者，都是鹤发童颜，～，举止大雅。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 只見路旁走過兩個老者，都是鶴髮童顏，～，舉止大雅。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十一回
exampleEn: Two old men passed by on the road, both with white hair and ruddy complexions, beaming with joy, and their manners were elegant. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 11

explanation: 谓下面的情况或意见能够通达于上。
explanationTraditional: 謂下面的情況或意見能夠通達於上。
explanationEn: The situation or opinions of the lower levels can reach the higher authorities.
derivation: 语出《管子·明法》下情不上通，谓之塞。”
derivationTraditional: 語出《管子·明法》下情不上通，謂之塞。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi·Mingfa': 'If the feelings of the lower levels do not reach the upper, it is called obstruction.'
example: 可是唐代中叶以后，这个尺度似乎已经暗地里独立运用，这已经不是上德化下的尺度，而是～的尺度了。★朱自清《文学的标准与尺度》
exampleTraditional: 可是唐代中葉以後，這個尺度似乎已經暗地裡獨立運用，這已經不是上德化下的尺度，而是～的尺度了。★朱自清《文學的標準與尺度》
exampleEn: But after the mid-Tang Dynasty, this standard seemed to have been secretly used independently. It was no longer a standard for the upper to transform the lower, but a standard for the lower to reach the upper. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Literary Standards and Scales'

explanation: 吁叹息。长一声、短一声不住地叹气。形容发愁的神情。
explanationTraditional: 吁嘆息。長一聲、短一聲不住地嘆氣。形容發愁的神情。
explanationEn: Sighing deeply and frequently; to heave sighs of distress or worry.
derivation: 《乐府群珠·无名氏＜金字经＞》短叹长吁三两声。”
derivationTraditional: 《樂府群珠·無名氏＜金字經＞》短嘆長吁三兩聲。”
derivationEn: From 'Yuefu Qunzhu·Anonymous·Jinzi Jing': 'Short sighs and long sighs, two or three sounds.'
example: 少可有一万声～，五千遍捣枕槌床。★元·王实甫《西厢记》第一本第二折
exampleTraditional: 少可有一萬聲～，五千遍搗枕槌床。★元·王實甫《西廂記》第一本第二折
exampleEn: At least ten thousand long sighs and short sighs, five thousand times of pounding the pillow and beating the bed. — Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu, 'The Story of the Western Wing', Act 1, Scene 2

explanation: 当底。虽然大，却无底。原指大得无边际◇多用作表示大得不切合实际、不合用。
explanationTraditional: 當底。雖然大，卻無底。原指大得無邊際◇多用作表示大得不切合實際、不合用。
explanationEn: Large but impractical; grandiose but useless.
derivation: 《庄子·逍遥游》肩吾问于连叔曰‘吾闻言于接舆，大而无当，往而不返，吾惊怖其言，犹河汉而无极也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·逍遙遊》肩吾問於連叔曰‘吾聞言於接輿，大而無當，往而不返，吾驚怖其言，猶河漢而無極也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi·Xiaoyaoyou': 'Jianwu asked Lianshu: 'I heard Jieyu speak, large but impractical, going on without returning, I was astonished by his words, like the Milky Way without end.''
example: 要而言之，《全上古秦汉三国六朝文》实在的是～的书，可供陈列而不适于实用的。★鲁迅《书信集·致章廷谦》
exampleTraditional: 要而言之，《全上古秦漢三國六朝文》實在的是～的書，可供陳列而不適於實用的。★魯迅《書信集·致章廷謙》
exampleEn: In short, 'The Complete Works of Pre-Qin, Han, Three Kingdoms, and Six Dynasties' is indeed a large but impractical book, suitable for display but not for practical use. — Lu Xun, 'Letters·To Zhang Tingqian'

explanation: 沙土飞扬，石块滚动。形容风势狂暴。
explanationTraditional: 沙土飛揚，石塊滾動。形容風勢狂暴。
explanationEn: Sand flying and stones rolling; describing a violent windstorm.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·陆凯传》苍梧、南海，岁有风瘴气之害，风则折木，飞沙转石，气则雾郁，飞鸟不经。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·陸凱傳》蒼梧、南海，歲有風瘴氣之害，風則折木，飛沙轉石，氣則霧鬱，飛鳥不經。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms·Wu·Lu Kai's Biography': 'Cangwu and Nanhai have annual wind and miasma disasters; the wind breaks trees, flies sand and rolls stones.'
example: 尤窍怒号天噫气，～乱伤人。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 尤竅怒號天噫氣，～亂傷人。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第二十八回
exampleEn: The furious wind howled, the sky sighed, flying sand and rolling stones injured people. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 28

explanation: 浪迹到处流浪。到处流浪，足迹遍天下。
explanationTraditional: 浪跡到處流浪。到處流浪，足跡遍天下。
explanationEn: Roaming the world; wandering far and wide.
derivation: 宋·李楙《野客丛书·李白事说者不一》为同列者所谤，诏令归山，遂浪迹天下。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李楙《野客叢書·李白事說者不一》為同列者所謗，詔令歸山，遂浪跡天下。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Li Mao's 'Yeke Congshu·Li Bai's Different Accounts': 'Slandered by colleagues, ordered to return to the mountains, thus roamed the world.'
example: 我们做这体面憋脚生意，～，那社会上奇闻怪事，与此事相仿的，也说不尽许多。★清·壮者《扫迷帚》
exampleTraditional: 我們做這體面憋腳生意，～，那社會上奇聞怪事，與此事相仿的，也說不盡許多。★清·壯者《掃迷帚》
exampleEn: We do this decent but shabby business, roaming the world; the strange events in society similar to this are countless. — Qing Dynasty, Zhuang Zhe, 'Sweeping Away Superstition'

explanation: 狰狞面目凶恶。形容面目凶狠可怕。亦作面貌狰狞”、狰狞面目”。
explanationTraditional: 猙獰面目兇惡。形容面目兇狠可怕。亦作面貌猙獰”、猙獰面目”。
explanationEn: Fierce and ferocious in appearance; grim and terrifying.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 留着毒疮不去医治，就会成为后患。比喻纵容包庇坏人坏事，结果会遭受祸害。
explanationTraditional: 留著毒瘡不去醫治，就會成為後患。比喻縱容包庇壞人壞事，結果會遭受禍害。
explanationEn: To nurse a boil and leave trouble; to tolerate or shield evil, leading to future disaster.
derivation: 《后汉书·冯衍传》李贤注引冯衍《与妇弟任武达书》养痈长疽，自生祸殃。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·馮衍傳》李賢注引馮衍《與婦弟任武達書》養癰長疽，自生禍殃。”
derivationEn: From 'Hou Han Shu·Feng Yan's Biography' Li Xian's annotation quoting Feng Yan's 'Letter to Wife and Brother': 'Nurturing a boil and growing an ulcer, bringing disaster upon oneself.'
example: 博善化之虚名，溃败决裂乃至此，～，我之谓也夫。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·槐西杂志一》
exampleTraditional: 博善化之虛名，潰敗決裂乃至此，～，我之謂也夫。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·槐西雜誌一》
exampleEn: Seeking a reputation for benevolence, leading to such collapse and ruin; nurturing a boil and leaving trouble, that is what I call it. — Qing Dynasty, Ji Yun, 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage·West of the Locust Tree'

explanation: 振挥动。挥动手臂呼喊（多用在号召）。
explanationTraditional: 振揮動。揮動手臂呼喊（多用在號召）。
explanationEn: To raise one's arm and shout; to call for action or rally people.
derivation: 汉·李陵《答苏武书》然陵振臂一呼，创病皆起。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·李陵《答蘇武書》然陵振臂一呼，創病皆起。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Li Ling's 'Reply to Su Wu': 'However, I raised my arm and shouted, and the wounded and sick all rose up.'
example: 此话甚有道理。目前百姓生活于水深火热之中，朝不保夕，只要有人～，谁不揭竿而起。★姚雪垠《李自成》
exampleTraditional: 此話甚有道理。目前百姓生活於水深火熱之中，朝不保夕，只要有人～，誰不揭竿而起。★姚雪垠《李自成》
exampleEn: These words are very reasonable. Currently, the people live in deep suffering, not knowing if they will see the evening. As long as someone raises their arm and shouts, who would not rise up in rebellion? — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng'

explanation: 指迫不得已。
explanationTraditional: 指迫不得已。
explanationEn: To be forced to do something against one's will; to have no alternative.
derivation: 《云笈七签》卷八五[程伟]欲从求方，终不可得，云伟骨未应得之，逼不得已，妻尸解而去。”
derivationTraditional: 《雲笈七籤》卷八五[程偉]欲從求方，終不可得，雲偉骨未應得之，逼不得已，妻尸解而去。”
derivationEn: From 'Yunji Qiqian' Volume 85: 'Cheng Wei wanted to obtain the formula but could not; it was said that Wei's bones were not yet worthy. Forced with no alternative, his wife died and left.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 户门。夜里睡觉不用闩上门。形容社会治安情况良好。
explanationTraditional: 戶門。夜裡睡覺不用閂上門。形容社會治安情況良好。
explanationEn: Doors are not bolted at night. Describes a society with good public security.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》是故谋闭而不兴，盗窃乱贼而不作，故外户而不闭，是谓大同。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》是故謀閉而不興，盜竊亂賊而不作，故外戶而不閉，是謂大同。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Li Yun': 'Therefore, schemes are shut out and do not arise; thieves and robbers do not occur; thus outer doors are not closed. This is called the Great Harmony.'
example: 两川之民，忻乐太平，～，路不拾遗。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八十七回
exampleTraditional: 兩川之民，忻樂太平，～，路不拾遺。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八十七回
exampleEn: The people of the two rivers were joyful and peaceful, doors were not bolted at night, and no one picked up lost items on the road. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 87

explanation: 比喻为了追逐名利，不择手段，象苍蝇一样飞来飞去，象狗一样的不识羞耻。
explanationTraditional: 比喻為了追逐名利，不擇手段，象蒼蠅一樣飛來飛去，象狗一樣的不識羞恥。
explanationEn: To shamelessly seek fame and gain by any means, like flies buzzing around and dogs behaving without shame.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送穷文》蝇营狗苟，驱去复返。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送窮文》蠅營狗苟，驅去復返。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Sending Away Poverty': 'Flies buzz and dogs shamelessly scurry, driven away only to return.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 显示或宣扬自己的优点，使自己突出。
explanationTraditional: 顯示或宣揚自己的優點，使自己突出。
explanationEn: To display or promote one's own strengths, making oneself stand out.
derivation: 苏雪林《郁达夫及其作品》现代文艺里‘自我表现’，之特多，原是当然的道理。”
derivationTraditional: 蘇雪林《郁達夫及其作品》現代文藝裡‘自我表現’，之特多，原是當然的道理。”
