derivationEn: Su Xuelin, 'On Yu Dafu and His Works': 'In modern literature, the prevalence of 'self-expression' is naturally justified.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 峭壁陡直的石壁。形容山势险峻。
explanationTraditional: 峭壁陡直的石壁。形容山勢險峻。
explanationEn: Steep cliffs and precipices. Describes a dangerous mountain terrain.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第八十六回四面尽是高山，左右是悬崖峭壁，只见高山峻岭，无路可登。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第八十六回四面盡是高山，左右是懸崖峭壁，只見高山峻嶺，無路可登。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 86: 'Surrounded by high mountains, with steep cliffs on left and right, only lofty peaks and no path to ascend.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 百年也碰不到。形容罕见或很不容易碰到。
explanationTraditional: 百年也碰不到。形容罕見或很不容易碰到。
explanationEn: Not encountered even in a hundred years. Describes something extremely rare or hard to come by.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第九回若说一样的动心，把这等终身要紧的大事、百年难遇的良缘，倒扔开自己，双手送给我这样一个初次见面旁不相干的张金凤，尤其不是情理。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第九回若說一樣的動心，把這等終身要緊的大事、百年難遇的良緣，倒扔開自己，雙手送給我這樣一個初次見面旁不相干的張金鳳，尤其不是情理。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 9: 'If one were equally moved, to give away such a lifelong important matter, a once-in-a-century rare opportunity, to a stranger like Zhang Jinfeng, would be unreasonable.'
example: 这种怪事～，今天倒开了眼界。
exampleTraditional: 這種怪事～，今天倒開了眼界。
exampleEn: Such a strange event is rare even in a hundred years; today I have truly witnessed it.

explanation: 看见某种严重情况，心里感到震惊。
explanationTraditional: 看見某種嚴重情況，心裡感到震驚。
explanationEn: To be shocked and alarmed upon seeing a serious situation.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《昌黎集·贞曜先生墓志铭》及其为诗，刿目怵心。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《昌黎集·貞曜先生墓誌銘》及其為詩，劌目怵心。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Epitaph for Mr. Zhen Yao': 'When he wrote poetry, it was piercing to the eye and startling to the heart.'
example: 你记得复辟与龙旗的不可分离性，你便会原谅我看见龙凤”二字而不禁～的苦衷了。★闻一多《龙凤》
exampleTraditional: 你記得復辟與龍旗的不可分離性，你便會原諒我看見龍鳳”二字而不禁～的苦衷了。★聞一多《龍鳳》
exampleEn: You remember the inseparable connection between restoration and the dragon flag, so you will forgive my shock and alarm upon seeing the words 'dragon and phoenix'. — Wen Yiduo, 'Dragon and Phoenix'

explanation: 睹看；思思念。看见死去或离别的人留下的东西就想起了这个人。
explanationTraditional: 睹看；思思念。看見死去或離別的人留下的東西就想起了這個人。
explanationEn: To see an object and think of the person who owned it or is associated with it, especially someone deceased or far away.
derivation: 唐·裴铏《传奇·颜睿》贵妃赠辟（避）尘犀簪一枚，曰‘异日睹物思人。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·裴鉶《傳奇·顏睿》貴妃贈闢（避）塵犀簪一枚，曰‘異日睹物思人。’”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Pei Xing, 'Tales of Marvels: Yan Rui': 'The imperial consort gave a rhinoceros hairpin to avoid dust, saying, 'One day, seeing this object will make you think of me.''
example: 俗语说～”，天下的水总归一源，不拘那里的水舀一碗，看着哭去，也就尽情了。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 俗語說～”，天下的水總歸一源，不拘那裡的水舀一碗，看著哭去，也就盡情了。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十四回
exampleEn: As the saying goes, 'seeing the object reminds one of the person.' All water under heaven comes from the same source; just scoop a bowl of water from anywhere and cry while looking at it, and you will have expressed your feelings. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 44

explanation: 屈屈服。坚韧、刚毅，毫不屈服。
explanationTraditional: 屈屈服。堅韌、剛毅，毫不屈服。
explanationEn: Firm and unyielding; resolute and not giving in.
derivation: 《荀子·法行》坚强而不屈，义也。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·法行》堅強而不屈，義也。”
derivationEn: From 'Xunzi: Fa Xing': 'Firm and unyielding, that is righteousness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指另找一份职业，意即辞去原职。
explanationTraditional: 指另找一份職業，意即辭去原職。
explanationEn: To seek another job, implying resignation from the current position.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他在此处无法发挥所长，只好～。
exampleTraditional: 他在此處無法發揮所長，只好～。
exampleEn: He could not fully utilize his talents here, so he had to seek another position.

explanation: 态度粗暴，不讲道理。
explanationTraditional: 態度粗暴，不講道理。
explanationEn: Rude and unreasonable; behaving in a rough and irrational manner.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 呵哟，你是野人哪，这样～。（艾芜《纺车复活的时候》）
exampleTraditional: 呵喲，你是野人哪，這樣～。（艾蕪《紡車復活的時候》）
exampleEn: Oh, you are a savage, so rude and unreasonable! — Ai Wu, 'When the Spinning Wheel Revives'

explanation: 黄花菊花。原指重阳节过后逐渐萎谢的菊花◇多比喻过时的事物或消息。
explanationTraditional: 黃花菊花。原指重陽節過後逐漸萎謝的菊花◇多比喻過時的事物或消息。
explanationEn: Chrysanthemums after the Double Ninth Festival; refers to things that are outdated or past their prime.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《九日次韵王巩》诗相逢不用忙归去，明日黄花蝶也愁。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《九日次韻王鞏》詩相逢不用忙歸去，明日黃花蝶也愁。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's poem 'Jiuri Ciyun Wang Gong': 'Don't rush to leave when we meet, the chrysanthemums of tomorrow will make butterflies sad.'
example: 过时之物，曰～。★宋·胡继宗《书言故事·花木类》
exampleTraditional: 過時之物，曰～。★宋·胡繼宗《書言故事·花木類》
exampleEn: Outdated things are called 'tomorrow's chrysanthemums.' — Song Hu Jizong's 'Shuyan Gushi: Huamu Lei'

explanation: 形容情况或条件有很大的好转。
explanationTraditional: 形容情況或條件有很大的好轉。
explanationEn: Describes a significant improvement in conditions or circumstances.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十六回那个气好比烟袋换吹筒，吹筒换鸟枪，鸟枪换炮，越吹越壮了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十六回那個氣好比菸袋換吹筒，吹筒換鳥槍，鳥槍換炮，越吹越壯了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Wenkang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 36: 'It's like swapping a pipe for a blowpipe, a blowpipe for a shotgun, and a shotgun for a cannon—the more you blow, the stronger it gets.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 四海之内，犹如一家。形容天下一统。
explanationTraditional: 四海之內，猶如一家。形容天下一統。
explanationEn: All within the four seas are like one family; describes the unification of the world.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹言洋洋得意。形容得意时神气十足的姿态。
explanationTraditional: 猶言洋洋得意。形容得意時神氣十足的姿態。
explanationEn: Describes a very pleased and proud demeanor; smug and self-satisfied.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 迂回回旋，环绕。弯弯曲曲，绕来绕去。常比喻事物发展的曲折性。
explanationTraditional: 迂迴迴旋，環繞。彎彎曲曲，繞來繞去。常比喻事物發展的曲折性。
explanationEn: Twisting and turning; often used to describe the tortuous nature of development.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》打破‘围剿’的过程往往是迂回曲折的，不是径情直遂的。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》打破‘圍剿’的過程往往是迂迴曲折的，不是徑情直遂的。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War': 'The process of breaking the 'encirclement and suppression' is often tortuous, not straightforward.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 杀气凶恶的气势；腾腾气势旺盛的样子。形容充满了要杀人的凶狠气势。
explanationTraditional: 殺氣兇惡的氣勢；騰騰氣勢旺盛的樣子。形容充滿了要殺人的兇狠氣勢。
explanationEn: Describes a fierce and murderous atmosphere or demeanor.
derivation: 元·无名氏《气英布》第四折杀气腾腾蔽远空，一声传语似金钟，两家赌战分成败，只在来人启口中。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《氣英布》第四折殺氣騰騰蔽遠空，一聲傳語似金鐘，兩家賭戰分成敗，只在來人啟口中。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty anonymous play 'Qi Yingbu', Act 4: 'Murderous aura fills the distant sky, a single call sounds like a golden bell.'
example: 监狱内～，突然充满了火药气味。★杨沫《青春之歌》第一部第七章
exampleTraditional: 監獄內～，突然充滿了火藥氣味。★楊沫《青春之歌》第一部第七章
exampleEn: The prison was filled with a murderous atmosphere, suddenly reeking of gunpowder. — Yang Mo's 'Song of Youth', Chapter 7, Part 1

explanation: 夙早；兴起来；寐睡。早起晚睡。形容勤奋。
explanationTraditional: 夙早；興起來；寐睡。早起晚睡。形容勤奮。
explanationEn: Rising early and sleeping late; describes diligence and hard work.
derivation: 《诗经·魏风·氓》夙兴夜寐，靡有朝矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·魏風·氓》夙興夜寐，靡有朝矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Wei Feng: Mang': 'Rise early and sleep late, there is no day off.'
example: 可怜数载宫闱，克勤克俭，～，何敢轻为妄作，有黍姆训。（明·许仲琳《封神演义》第七回）
exampleTraditional: 可憐數載宮闈，克勤克儉，～，何敢輕為妄作，有黍姆訓。（明·許仲琳《封神演義》第七回）
exampleEn: For several years in the palace, she was diligent and frugal, rising early and sleeping late, never daring to act rashly. — Ming Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 7

explanation: 化改变。坚持错误，不肯改悔。
explanationTraditional: 化改變。堅持錯誤，不肯改悔。
explanationEn: Stubborn and unyielding; persisting in errors and refusing to reform.
derivation: 梁信《从奴隶到将军》上集第六章说我顽固不化，为游击主义翻案；蔑视中央，搅乱军心等待。”
derivationTraditional: 梁信《從奴隸到將軍》上集第六章說我頑固不化，為遊擊主義翻案；蔑視中央，攪亂軍心等待。”
derivationEn: From Liang Xin's 'From Slave to General', Part 1, Chapter 6: 'He called me stubborn and unyielding, overturning guerrilla doctrine, defying the central authority, and disturbing military morale.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 策计策、办法。极其周到的计谋、办法。
explanationTraditional: 策計策、辦法。極其周到的計謀、辦法。
explanationEn: A completely safe and reliable plan or strategy.
derivation: 《韩非子·饰邪》而道法万全，智能多失。夫悬衡而知平，设规而知圆，万全之道也。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·飾邪》而道法萬全，智能多失。夫懸衡而知平，設規而知圓，萬全之道也。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: Shixie': 'The Way and law are completely safe, while intelligence often fails. Using a balance to know weight, a compass to know roundness—these are the ways of complete safety.'
example: 必思一～，方可无虞。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十二回
exampleTraditional: 必思一～，方可無虞。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十二回
exampleEn: One must devise a completely safe plan to avoid worry. — Ming Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 72

explanation: 逢遭遇；凶不幸；吉吉利、吉祥。遇到凶险转化为吉祥、顺利。这是带有迷信的说法。
explanationTraditional: 逢遭遇；兇不幸；吉吉利、吉祥。遇到兇險轉化為吉祥、順利。這是帶有迷信的說法。
explanationEn: To turn misfortune into good fortune; a superstitious expression.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十二回豪杰交游满天下，逢凶化吉天生成。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十二回豪傑交遊滿天下，逢凶化吉天生成。”
derivationEn: From Ming Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 42: 'A hero's friendships span the world, turning misfortune into good fortune is heaven-sent.'
example: 我今叩求皇天保佑，在监的～，有病的早早安身。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一○六回
exampleTraditional: 我今叩求皇天保佑，在監的～，有病的早早安身。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一○六回
exampleEn: I now pray to Heaven to bless those in prison to turn misfortune into good fortune, and the sick to recover soon. — Qing Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 106

explanation: 巾帼古代妇女配戴的头巾和发饰，后借指妇女。指女子中的英雄。
explanationTraditional: 巾幗古代婦女配戴的頭巾和髮飾，後借指婦女。指女子中的英雄。
explanationEn: A heroic woman; a female hero.
derivation: 清·湘灵子《轩亭冤·赏花》新世界，旧乾坤，巾帼英雄叫九阍。”
derivationTraditional: 清·湘靈子《軒亭冤·賞花》新世界，舊乾坤，巾幗英雄叫九閽。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Xianglingzi's 'Xuanting Pavilion·Appreciating Flowers': 'New world, old universe, a female hero calls to the nine heavens.'
example: 因为穆桂英这个～，不过是人们凭想象创造出来的。（王朝闻《论凤姐》第三章）
exampleTraditional: 因為穆桂英這個～，不過是人們憑想象創造出來的。（王朝聞《論鳳姐》第三章）
exampleEn: Because this female hero, Mu Guiying, is merely a product of people's imagination. (Wang Chaowen, 'On Fengjie', Chapter 3)

explanation: 心、德心意。思想不统一，信念也不一致。指不一条心。
explanationTraditional: 心、德心意。思想不統一，信念也不一致。指不一條心。
explanationEn: Disunity and discord; lack of cohesion and shared purpose.
derivation: 《尚书·泰誓中》受（纣）有亿兆夷人，离心离德。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·泰誓中》受（紂）有億兆夷人，離心離德。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents·Great Declaration II': 'Shou (Zhou) has hundreds of millions of people, but they are divided in heart and virtue.'
example: 黎民～，祸生不测。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 黎民～，禍生不測。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第十七回
exampleEn: The people are disunited, and calamities arise unexpectedly. (Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 17)

explanation: 形容神气十足，声势慑人。
explanationTraditional: 形容神氣十足，聲勢懾人。
explanationEn: Impressive and awe-inspiring in every way; commanding presence.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原意是只有君王才能独揽权威，行赏行罚◇泛指凭借职位，滥用权力。
explanationTraditional: 原意是隻有君王才能獨攬權威，行賞行罰◇泛指憑藉職位，濫用權力。
explanationEn: To abuse one's power; to act tyrannically and arbitrarily.
derivation: 语出《书·洪范》惟辟作福，惟辟作威，惟辟玉食。臣无有作福作威玉食。”
derivationTraditional: 語出《書·洪範》惟闢作福，惟闢作威，惟闢玉食。臣無有作福作威玉食。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents·Great Plan': 'Only the sovereign can dispense favors and exercise authority; ministers must not do so.'
example: 姜三膘子一辈子是～，花天酒地。★曲波《林海雪原》二
exampleTraditional: 姜三膘子一輩子是～，花天酒地。★曲波《林海雪原》二
exampleEn: Jiang Sanbiaozi spent his whole life abusing his power and living extravagantly. (Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 2)

explanation: 成成就。成全别人的好事。
explanationTraditional: 成成就。成全別人的好事。
explanationEn: To help others achieve their goals; to facilitate a good deed.
derivation: 《论语·颜渊》君子成人之美，不成人之恶。小人反是。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·顏淵》君子成人之美，不成人之惡。小人反是。”
derivationEn: From 'Analects·Yan Yuan': 'A gentleman helps others to achieve good, not evil. A petty person does the opposite.'
example: 敝人向来最赞成一切牺牲，也最乐于～”，况且我们是同志，我当然应该给你想一个完全的办法。★鲁迅《华盖集·牺牲谟》
exampleTraditional: 敝人向來最贊成一切犧牲，也最樂於～”，況且我們是同志，我當然應該給你想一個完全的辦法。★魯迅《華蓋集·犧牲謨》
exampleEn: I have always been in favor of all sacrifices and most willing to help others achieve their goals. Since we are comrades, I should certainly find a complete solution for you. (Lu Xun, 'Huagai Collection·On Sacrifice')

explanation: 一会儿说东，一会儿说西。指说话条理斋乱，没有中心。
explanationTraditional: 一會兒說東，一會兒說西。指說話條理齋亂，沒有中心。
explanationEn: To talk incoherently; to ramble without focus.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第八十二回更有一种可笑的，肚子里原没有什么，东拉西扯，弄的牛鬼蛇神，还自以为博奥。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第八十二回更有一種可笑的，肚子裡原沒有什麼，東拉西扯，弄的牛鬼蛇神，還自以為博奧。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 82: 'There is another ridiculous type who has nothing in their stomach but rambles on, mixing ghosts and monsters, yet thinks themselves profound.'
example: 倘在学校，谁都可以直冲而入，并无可谈，而～，坐着不走，殊讨厌也。（鲁迅《两地书·九三》）
exampleTraditional: 倘在學校，誰都可以直衝而入，並無可談，而～，坐著不走，殊討厭也。（魯迅《兩地書·九三》）
exampleEn: If at school, one could barge in and talk without substance, rambling on and refusing to leave, which is quite annoying. (Lu Xun, 'Letters Between Two Places', No. 93)

explanation: 下棋时走错一步，整个棋就输掉。比喻因受某一局部的影响而使全局归于失败。
explanationTraditional: 下棋時走錯一步，整個棋就輸掉。比喻因受某一局部的影響而使全局歸於失敗。
explanationEn: To lose the whole game due to one wrong move; a single mistake leads to total failure.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 师军队；名名义，引伸为理由。出兵没有正当理由。也引申为做某事没有正当理由。
explanationTraditional: 師軍隊；名名義，引伸為理由。出兵沒有正當理由。也引申為做某事沒有正當理由。
explanationEn: To act without just cause; to undertake an action without legitimate reason.
derivation: 《礼记·檀弓下》君王计敝邑之罪，又矜而赦之，师与有无名乎？”《汉书·高帝纪》兵出无名，事故不成。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·檀弓下》君王計敝邑之罪，又矜而赦之，師與有無名乎？”《漢書·高帝紀》兵出無名，事故不成。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites·Tan Gong II': 'Your Majesty, when punishing our state, you also show mercy and pardon. Is there no reason for the army?' Also 'Book of Han·Annals of Emperor Gao': 'If an army acts without reason, it cannot succeed.'
example: 且劳民伤财，穷兵默武，～，皆非盛世所宜有者也。（明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二回）
exampleTraditional: 且勞民傷財，窮兵默武，～，皆非盛世所宜有者也。（明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二回）
exampleEn: Moreover, to exhaust the people and waste resources, to wage war aggressively without just cause, is not appropriate for a prosperous era. (Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 2)

explanation: 以用；易改变，更换；暴残暴。用残暴势力代替残暴势力。指统治者换了，暴虐的统治没有改变。
explanationTraditional: 以用；易改變，更換；暴殘暴。用殘暴勢力代替殘暴勢力。指統治者換了，暴虐的統治沒有改變。
explanationEn: To replace one tyranny with another; to substitute one form of violence with another.
derivation: 《史记·伯夷列传》登彼西山兮，采其薇矣，以暴易暴兮，不知其非矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·伯夷列傳》登彼西山兮，採其薇矣，以暴易暴兮，不知其非矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian·Biographies of Boyi and Shuqi': 'Climbing that western mountain, picking its ferns, replacing tyranny with tyranny, unaware of its wrong.'
example: 吏转念去一狐，得一狐，是～也，游移不敢即应。（清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·周三》）
exampleTraditional: 吏轉念去一狐，得一狐，是～也，遊移不敢即應。（清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·週三》）
exampleEn: The official thought, 'Removing one fox only to get another is replacing tyranny with tyranny,' and hesitated to agree. (Qing Dynasty Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio·Zhou San')

explanation: 即使是一点点土地，也要和敌人争夺。形容对敌斗争毫不退让。
explanationTraditional: 即使是一點點土地，也要和敵人爭奪。形容對敵鬥爭毫不退讓。
explanationEn: To contest every inch of land; to fight fiercely for every piece of territory.
derivation: 元·金好问《鸿沟同钦叔赋》雌雄自决已无策，尺寸必争唯上流。”
derivationTraditional: 元·金好問《鴻溝同欽叔賦》雌雄自決已無策，尺寸必爭唯上流。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Jin Haowen's 'Poem on Honggou with Qinshu': 'The contest between male and female is already undecided, but every inch must be fought for only on the upper reaches.'
example: 我们是针锋相对，～，绝不让国民党轻轻易易地占我们的地方，杀我们的人。★毛泽东《抗日战争胜利后的时局和我们的方针》
exampleTraditional: 我們是針鋒相對，～，絕不讓國民黨輕輕易易地佔我們的地方，殺我們的人。★毛澤東《抗日戰爭勝利後的時局和我們的方針》
exampleEn: We are tit-for-tat, contesting every inch of land, and will never allow the Kuomintang to easily occupy our places or kill our people. (Mao Zedong, 'The Situation and Our Policy After the Victory in the War of Resistance Against Japan')

explanation: 和声音相应。自己没有主见，别人怎么说，就跟着怎么说。
explanationTraditional: 和聲音相應。自己沒有主見，別人怎麼說，就跟著怎麼說。
explanationEn: To echo what others say without having one's own opinion; to follow others blindly.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第十一回崇侯虎不过随声附和，实非本心。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第十一回崇侯虎不過隨聲附和，實非本心。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'The Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 11: 'Chong Houhu merely echoed others, not his true intention.'
example: 放翁（陆游）晚年有得，非～以道学为名高者矣。★清·赵翼《瓯北诗话》卷六
exampleTraditional: 放翁（陸游）晚年有得，非～以道學為名高者矣。★清·趙翼《甌北詩話》卷六
exampleEn: In his later years, Fang Weng (Lu You) had insights, not like those who merely echoed others to gain fame as Neo-Confucians. — Qing Dynasty Zhao Yi's 'Oubei Poetry Talks', Volume 6

explanation: 桃花嫣红，柳枝碧绿。形容花木繁盛、色彩鲜艳的春景。
explanationTraditional: 桃花嫣紅，柳枝碧綠。形容花木繁盛、色彩鮮豔的春景。
explanationEn: Peach blossoms are red, willow branches are green. Describes a spring scene with lush flowers and vibrant colors.
derivation: 唐·王维《田园》诗桃红复含宿雨，柳绿更带春烟。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王維《田園》詩桃紅復含宿雨，柳綠更帶春煙。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Wei's poem 'Pastoral': 'Peach blossoms red with lingering rain, willow green with spring mist.'
example: 背着香袋来到西湖朝拜的善男信女，心中并无多少教义的踪影，眼角却时时关注着～、莼菜醋鱼。★余秋雨《文化苦旅·西湖梦》
exampleTraditional: 揹著香袋來到西湖朝拜的善男信女，心中並無多少教義的蹤影，眼角卻時時關注著～、蓴菜醋魚。★餘秋雨《文化苦旅·西湖夢》
exampleEn: Pilgrims carrying incense bags to worship at West Lake had little religious doctrine in mind, but their eyes often lingered on the peach red and willow green, water shield and vinegar fish. — Yu Qiuyu's 'Cultural Journey: West Lake Dream'

explanation: 礼礼貌；兵武力。先按通常的礼节同对方交涉，如果行不能，再用武力或其他强硬手段解决。
explanationTraditional: 禮禮貌；兵武力。先按通常的禮節同對方交涉，如果行不能，再用武力或其他強硬手段解決。
explanationEn: To first use polite measures in dealing with someone, and if that fails, resort to force or other tough means.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十一回刘备远来救援，先礼后兵，主公当用好言答之，以慢备心，然后进兵攻城，城可破也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十一回劉備遠來救援，先禮後兵，主公當用好言答之，以慢備心，然後進兵攻城，城可破也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 11: 'Liu Bei came from afar to rescue, first polite then forceful. You should answer him gently to slow his resolve, then attack the city.'
example: 你这～方法实在高明。
exampleTraditional: 你這～方法實在高明。
exampleEn: Your method of being polite first and then forceful is very clever.

explanation: 秀色美女姿容或自然美景；餐吃。原形容妇女美貌◇也形容景物秀丽。
explanationTraditional: 秀色美女姿容或自然美景；餐吃。原形容婦女美貌◇也形容景物秀麗。
explanationEn: Originally describes a woman's beauty; also used to describe scenic beauty that is so delightful it can be 'eaten'.
derivation: 晋·陆机《日出东南隅行》鲜肤一何润，秀色若可餐。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陸機《日出東南隅行》鮮膚一何潤，秀色若可餐。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Lu Ji's poem 'The Sun Rises from the Southeast Corner': 'Fresh skin so smooth, beauty as if edible.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹万箭攒心。形容万分伤痛。
explanationTraditional: 猶萬箭攢心。形容萬分傷痛。
explanationEn: Like ten thousand arrows piercing the heart; describes extreme pain or sorrow.
derivation: 《野叟曝言》第七回[璇姑]再听到哥子末后一段说话，真如万箭穿心，竟放声大哭起来。”
derivationTraditional: 《野叟曝言》第七回[璇姑]再聽到哥子末後一段說話，真如萬箭穿心，竟放聲大哭起來。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of an Old Man' (Ye Sou Pu Yan), Chapter 7: '[Xuan Gu] hearing her brother's final words felt like ten thousand arrows piercing her heart, and burst into loud crying.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 信、由听任。骑着马无目的地闲逛。比喻随便走走。也比喻无主见，随外力而转移。
explanationTraditional: 信、由聽任。騎著馬無目的地閒逛。比喻隨便走走。也比喻無主見，隨外力而轉移。
explanationEn: To ride a horse without guiding it; to wander aimlessly. Also metaphorically means to act without direction or to be easily influenced.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第八十六回却说王氏是一个昏天黑地的母亲，绍闻是一个信马由缰的儿子。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第八十六回卻說王氏是一個昏天黑地的母親，紹聞是一個信馬由韁的兒子。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Lüyuan's 'Lamp at the Crossroads', Chapter 86: 'But Wang was a muddled mother, and Shaowen was a son who let the horse follow the reins.'
example: 他～地走到中央公园，糊里糊涂地买了一张门券进去。（老舍《老张的哲学》第三十二章）
exampleTraditional: 他～地走到中央公園，糊里糊塗地買了一張門券進去。（老舍《老張的哲學》第三十二章）
exampleEn: He wandered aimlessly to Central Park, bought a ticket in a daze and went in. — Lao She's 'Philosophy of Lao Zhang', Chapter 32

explanation: 旧指在争夺政权斗争中，成功了的就是合法的，称帝称王；失败了的就是非法的，被称为寇贼‖有成功者权势在手，无人敢责难，失败者却有口难辩的意思。
explanationTraditional: 舊指在爭奪政權鬥爭中，成功了的就是合法的，稱帝稱王；失敗了的就是非法的，被稱為寇賊‖有成功者權勢在手，無人敢責難，失敗者卻有口難辯的意思。
explanationEn: In a struggle for power, the winner is hailed as a king, the loser as a bandit. Implies that success justifies everything, while failure leaves no room for defense.
derivation: 柳亚子《题战史》诗成王败寇漫相呼，直笔何人纵董狐。”
derivationTraditional: 柳亞子《題戰史》詩成王敗寇漫相呼，直筆何人縱董狐。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yazi's poem 'On War History': 'Success makes kings, failure makes bandits; who dares to write straight history?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 浩气即正气，刚直正大的精神∑然之气永远长存。
explanationTraditional: 浩氣即正氣，剛直正大的精神∑然之氣永遠長存。
explanationEn: Noble spirit or righteous energy that lasts forever.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 精精巧。绝伦无与伦比。精巧美妙到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 精精巧。絕倫無與倫比。精巧美妙到了極點。
explanationEn: Exquisitely ingenious and unparalleled; extremely delicate and wonderful.
derivation: 宋·周密《武林旧事·灯品》灯只至多。苏、福为冠，新安晚出，精妙绝伦。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《武林舊事·燈品》燈只至多。蘇、福為冠，新安晚出，精妙絕倫。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhou Mi's 'Old Stories of Wulin: Lanterns': 'Lanterns are many. Suzhou and Fujian are best, Xin'an later produced ones that are exquisitely unparalleled.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不留一点空余的地方。多形容言语、行动没有留下可回旋的余地。
explanationTraditional: 不留一點空餘的地方。多形容言語、行動沒有留下可迴旋的餘地。
explanationEn: To leave no room; often describes speech or action that leaves no leeway for retreat.
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷十一此狐眼光如镜，然词锋太利，未免不留余地矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷十一此狐眼光如鏡，然詞鋒太利，未免不留餘地矣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage', Volume 11: 'This fox's eyes are like mirrors, but his words are too sharp, leaving no room.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不仅是当面告诉他，而且是提着他的耳朵向他讲。形容长辈教导热心恳切。
explanationTraditional: 不僅是當面告訴他，而且是提著他的耳朵向他講。形容長輩教導熱心懇切。
explanationEn: To instruct earnestly and repeatedly, not only by telling face to face but also by pulling the ear.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·抑》匪面命之，言提其耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·抑》匪面命之，言提其耳。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs, 'Da Ya · Yi': 'Not only instruct him face to face, but also pull his ear and tell him.'
example: 有一种文字，即有一种文字之法脉准绳，载之于书者，不异～。★清·李渔《曲话·结构》
exampleTraditional: 有一種文字，即有一種文字之法脈準繩，載之於書者，不異～。★清·李漁《曲話·結構》
exampleEn: There is a kind of writing that has its own rules and standards, recorded in books, no different from earnest instruction. — Qing Dynasty, Li Yu, 'On Drama: Structure'

explanation: 姑息为求苟安，无原则地宽容；养助长；奸坏人坏事。无原则地宽容，只会助长坏人作恶。
explanationTraditional: 姑息為求苟安，無原則地寬容；養助長；奸壞人壞事。無原則地寬容，只會助長壞人作惡。
explanationEn: To tolerate or be lenient without principle, which only encourages evil deeds.
derivation: 《礼记·檀弓上》细人之爱人也以姑息。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·檀弓上》細人之愛人也以姑息。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Rites, 'Tan Gong I': 'A petty person's love for others is through leniency.'
example: 为有勾结匪类，荡轶范围情事，尤为法律所不容，切勿～，致贻隐患。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 為有勾結匪類，蕩軼範圍情事，尤為法律所不容，切勿～，致貽隱患。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第三十三回
exampleEn: If there are cases of colluding with bandits and exceeding boundaries, especially those not tolerated by law, never be lenient and foster evil, lest hidden dangers remain. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 33

explanation: 一个巴掌拍不响。比喻力量孤单，难以成事。
explanationTraditional: 一個巴掌拍不響。比喻力量孤單，難以成事。
explanationEn: One hand cannot clap; metaphor for being unable to achieve something alone due to lack of support.
derivation: 《韩非子·功名》人主之患在莫之应，故曰一手独拍，虽疾无声。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·功名》人主之患在莫之應，故曰一手獨拍，雖疾無聲。”
derivationEn: From Han Feizi, 'Achievements and Reputation': 'The trouble with a ruler is that no one responds; thus, one hand clapping alone makes no sound even if fast.'
example: 为见解珍、解宝是个好汉，有心要救他，史是单丝不线，～，只报得他一个信。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 為見解珍、解寶是個好漢，有心要救他，史是單絲不線，～，只報得他一個信。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十九回
exampleEn: Seeing that Xie Zhen and Xie Bao were good men, he wanted to save them, but a single thread cannot make a line, and one hand cannot clap; he could only send them a message. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 49

explanation: 贫穷和疾病一起压在身上。
explanationTraditional: 貧窮和疾病一起壓在身上。
explanationEn: To be afflicted by both poverty and illness simultaneously.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 因为贫病交加，他过早地离开了人世。
exampleTraditional: 因為貧病交加，他過早地離開了人世。
exampleEn: Because of poverty and illness, he left the world prematurely.

explanation: 欺负人太过分了，令人不能容忍。
explanationTraditional: 欺負人太過分了，令人不能容忍。
explanationEn: To bully others excessively, beyond what is tolerable.
derivation: 元·郑廷玉《楚昭公》第四折主公着他做了盟府，又与他一口宝剑，筵前举鼎，欺人太甚。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭廷玉《楚昭公》第四折主公著他做了盟府，又與他一口寶劍，筵前舉鼎，欺人太甚。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Zheng Tingyu, 'The Lord of Chu Zhao', Act 4: 'The lord made him the alliance leader and gave him a sword; at the banquet, he lifted the tripod, bullying others too much.'
example: 郑彩使劲把匣子摔到地上，撕裂的嗓声，疯狂地大叫你们不要～。”★华而实《汉衣冠》六
exampleTraditional: 鄭彩使勁把匣子摔到地上，撕裂的嗓聲，瘋狂地大叫你們不要～。”★華而實《漢衣冠》六
exampleEn: Zheng Cai threw the box to the ground with force, his voice tearing, shouting madly: 'Don't bully others too much!' — Hua Ershi, 'Han Crown', Chapter 6

explanation: 指从事征战的生活、经历。
explanationTraditional: 指從事征戰的生活、經歷。
explanationEn: A life or experience of military service and warfare.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 脸朝上平卧或身向后摔倒的样子。
explanationTraditional: 臉朝上平臥或身向後摔倒的樣子。
explanationEn: To lie flat on one's back or fall backward with face upward.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第四十九回江樊往后退了几步，身不由己的也就仰面朝天的躺下了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第四十九回江樊往後退了幾步，身不由己的也就仰面朝天的躺下了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Shi Yukun, 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants', Chapter 49: 'Jiang Fan stepped back a few steps, involuntarily fell flat on his back.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指人烟稠密。
explanationTraditional: 指人煙稠密。
explanationEn: To hear the sounds of chickens and dogs from neighboring places; indicating a densely populated area.
derivation: 先秦·李耳《老子》甘其食，美其服，安其居，乐其俗。邻国相望，鸡犬之声相闻，民至老死不相往来。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·李耳《老子》甘其食，美其服，安其居，樂其俗。鄰國相望，雞犬之聲相聞，民至老死不相往來。”
derivationEn: From pre-Qin, Li Er, 'Laozi': 'They enjoy their food, admire their clothes, are content with their homes, and delight in their customs. Neighboring states see each other, hear the sounds of chickens and dogs, and the people grow old and die without visiting each other.'
example: 阡陌交通，～。★晋·陶潜《桃花源记》
exampleTraditional: 阡陌交通，～。★晉·陶潛《桃花源記》
exampleEn: Paths crisscross, and the sounds of chickens and dogs are heard. — Jin Dynasty, Tao Qian, 'The Peach Blossom Spring'

explanation: 代上天主持公道。封建社会里农民起义多以此作为动员、组织群众的口号。
explanationTraditional: 代上天主持公道。封建社會里農民起義多以此作為動員、組織群眾的口號。
explanationEn: To act on behalf of Heaven to uphold justice; a slogan often used by peasant rebels in feudal society to mobilize the masses.
derivation: 元·康进之《李逵负荆》第一折你山上头领，都是替天行道的好汉。”
derivationTraditional: 元·康進之《李逵負荊》第一折你山上頭領，都是替天行道的好漢。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Kang Jinzhi, 'Li Kui Carries Thorns', Act 1: 'The leaders on your mountain are all good men who act on behalf of Heaven to uphold justice.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 以良好的德行使百姓归顺、服从统治者。
explanationTraditional: 以良好的德行使百姓歸順、服從統治者。
explanationEn: To make people submit or obey through virtuous conduct and moral influence.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 诡欺诈，奸滑。指暗地里策划坏的害人的坏主意。
explanationTraditional: 詭欺詐，奸滑。指暗地裡策劃壞的害人的壞主意。
explanationEn: Schemes and intrigues; underhand plots.
derivation: 毛泽东《〈共产党人〉发刊词》党处于敌人和同盟者的阴谋诡计的包围中，但是没有警觉性。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《〈共產黨人〉發刊詞》黨處於敵人和同盟者的陰謀詭計的包圍中，但是沒有警覺性。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'Preface to the Communist' magazine: 'The party is surrounded by the schemes and intrigues of enemies and allies, but lacks vigilance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 暴损害，糟蹋；殄灭绝；天物指自然生物。原指残害灭绝天生万物◇指任意糟蹋东西，不知爱惜。
explanationTraditional: 暴損害，糟蹋；殄滅絕；天物指自然生物。原指殘害滅絕天生萬物◇指任意糟蹋東西，不知愛惜。
explanationEn: To waste or destroy natural resources wantonly; to be extremely wasteful.
derivation: 《尚书·武成》今商王受无道，暴殄天物，害虐焌民。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·武成》今商王受無道，暴殄天物，害虐焌民。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents: Completion of War': 'Now the king of Shang, Shou, is without virtue, wasting the creatures of Heaven, and cruelly oppressing the good people.'
example: 既有许多值钱有东西，任人作践了，也似乎～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 既有許多值錢有東西，任人作踐了，也似乎～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十六回
exampleEn: With so many valuable things, letting them be destroyed is like wasting the gifts of Heaven. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 56

explanation: 原指玩弄手法欺骗人◇用来比喻常常变卦，反复无常。
explanationTraditional: 原指玩弄手法欺騙人◇用來比喻常常變卦，反覆無常。
explanationEn: To change one's mind frequently; to be fickle or inconsistent.
derivation: 《庄子·齐物论》狙公赋芧，曰‘朝三而暮四。’众狙皆怒。曰‘然则朝四而暮三。’众狙皆悦。名实未亏而喜怒为用，亦因是也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·齊物論》狙公賦芧，曰‘朝三而暮四。’眾狙皆怒。曰‘然則朝四而暮三。’眾狙皆悅。名實未虧而喜怒為用，亦因是也。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: On the Equality of Things': 'A monkey keeper gave out acorns, saying, 'Three in the morning and four in the evening.' The monkeys were all angry. Then he said, 'Four in the morning and three in the evening.' The monkeys were all pleased. The name and reality were not diminished, but the joy and anger were used accordingly.'
example: 厘定规则怎样服役，怎样纳粮，怎样磕头，怎样颂圣。而且这规则是不象现在那样～的。★鲁迅《坟·灯下漫笔》
exampleTraditional: 釐定規則怎樣服役，怎樣納糧，怎樣磕頭，怎樣頌聖。而且這規則是不象現在那樣～的。★魯迅《墳·燈下漫筆》
exampleEn: Setting rules for how to serve, pay taxes, kowtow, and praise the sage. And these rules are not as changeable as 'three in the morning, four in the evening' as they are now. — Lu Xun, 'Essays: Random Thoughts under a Lamp'

explanation: 参天高入云天。古老的树木枝茂叶繁异常高大。
explanationTraditional: 參天高入雲天。古老的樹木枝茂葉繁異常高大。
explanationEn: Ancient trees towering into the sky; very tall and old trees.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 二致两样。丝毫没有什么两样。指完全一样。
explanationTraditional: 二致兩樣。絲毫沒有什麼兩樣。指完全一樣。
explanationEn: Without the slightest difference; exactly the same.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十九回佘道台见了这副神气，更觉得同花小红一式一样，毫无二致。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十九回佘道臺見了這副神氣，更覺得同花小紅一式一樣，毫無二致。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 29: 'Yu Daotai saw this expression and felt it was exactly the same as Hua Xiaohong's, without any difference.'
example: 那时候的文体的变革和近代的文学革命，由文言文改为白话文的，实在是～。★郭沫若《屈原研究》
exampleTraditional: 那時候的文體的變革和近代的文學革命，由文言文改為白話文的，實在是～。★郭沫若《屈原研究》
exampleEn: The change in writing style at that time and the modern literary revolution, from classical Chinese to vernacular, are exactly the same. — Guo Moruo, 'Research on Qu Yuan'

explanation: 拱手双手合抱在胸前，以示敬意。恭顺地让给别人。形容怯弱可欺或甘心为奴仆、附庸。
explanationTraditional: 拱手雙手合抱在胸前，以示敬意。恭順地讓給別人。形容怯弱可欺或甘心為奴僕、附庸。
explanationEn: To give up something to others without a fight; to yield submissively.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第四十一回明知众寡不敌，守不住这个青岛，但若拱手让人，殊不甘心。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第四十一回明知眾寡不敵，守不住這個青島，但若拱手讓人，殊不甘心。”
derivationEn: Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 41: 'Knowing that we are outnumbered and cannot defend Qingdao, but if we yield it to others without a fight, we are unwilling.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 巴、蜀指四川一带。四川一带的山山水水。
explanationTraditional: 巴、蜀指四川一帶。四川一帶的山山水水。
explanationEn: The mountains and rivers of Sichuan (Ba and Shu regions).
derivation: 萧白《晚祷》多少思怀在这圆圆月中，一次偶然的月下促膝，常成一生追念，于是巴山蜀水近来，洞庭湘河近来，扬子江钟山也近来……”
derivationTraditional: 蕭白《晚禱》多少思懷在這圓圓月中，一次偶然的月下促膝，常成一生追念，於是巴山蜀水近來，洞庭湘河近來，揚子江鐘山也近來……”
derivationEn: Xiao Bai, 'Evening Prayer': 'How much longing is in this full moon; a chance moonlit talk often becomes a lifelong memory. Thus the mountains and waters of Ba and Shu come near, the Dongting and Xiang rivers come near, the Yangtze and Zhongshan also come near...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象冰那样清澈透明，象玉那样洁白无瑕。比喻人的操行清白（多用于女子）。
explanationTraditional: 象冰那樣清澈透明，象玉那樣潔白無瑕。比喻人的操行清白（多用於女子）。
explanationEn: Pure and spotless as ice and jade; morally upright (often used for women).
derivation: 汉·司马迁《与挚伯陵书》伏唯伯陵材能绝人，高尚其志，以善厥身，冰清玉洁，不以细行。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬遷《與摯伯陵書》伏唯伯陵材能絕人，高尚其志，以善厥身，冰清玉潔，不以細行。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Sima Qian, 'Letter to Zhi Boling': 'I believe that Boling's talent surpasses others, his ambition is lofty, he cultivates his virtue, pure as ice and clean as jade, not engaging in petty conduct.'
example: 我这一去～，干事回还，管着你们喝采他。★元·无名氏《陈州粜米》楔子
exampleTraditional: 我這一去～，幹事回還，管著你們喝采他。★元·無名氏《陳州糶米》楔子
exampleEn: I will go and return after completing the task, pure as ice and clean as jade, and you will applaud me. — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Chenzhou Selling Rice', Wedge

explanation: 盟盟约；誓誓言。指男女相爱时立下的誓言，表示爱情要象山和海一样永恒不变。
explanationTraditional: 盟盟約；誓誓言。指男女相愛時立下的誓言，表示愛情要象山和海一樣永恆不變。
explanationEn: A solemn pledge of love, as enduring as mountains and seas.
derivation: 元·无名氏《碧桃花》第三折他将山盟海誓言，向罗帏锦帐眠。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《碧桃花》第三折他將山盟海誓言，向羅幃錦帳眠。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Peach Blossom in the Green Tower', Act 3: 'He made vows of eternal love, sleeping in the embroidered curtain.'
example: 想当初～，可现在怎么就要分手了？
exampleTraditional: 想當初～，可現在怎麼就要分手了？
exampleEn: We once made vows of eternal love, but now why are we breaking up?

explanation: 天下指中国或世界。全国或全世界的局势动荡不安。
explanationTraditional: 天下指中國或世界。全國或全世界的局勢動盪不安。
explanationEn: Great disorder under heaven; nationwide or worldwide turmoil.
derivation: 《后汉书·曹节传》天下大乱，曹节、王甫幽杀太后，常侍侯览多杀党人，公卿皆尸禄，无有忠方者。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·曹節傳》天下大亂，曹節、王甫幽殺太后，常侍侯覽多殺黨人，公卿皆尸祿，無有忠方者。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Cao Jie': 'The world was in great disorder; Cao Jie and Wang Fu killed the Empress Dowager, the eunuch Hou Lan killed many party members, and the high officials were all corrupt and lacked loyalty.'
example: 如今朝廷不明，～，天子昏昧，奸臣弄权，我等归顺宋公明，且居水泊。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: 如今朝廷不明，～，天子昏昧，奸臣弄權，我等歸順宋公明，且居水泊。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十七回
exampleEn: Now the court is unwise, the world is in great disorder, the emperor is benighted, and treacherous ministers manipulate power. We should submit to Song Gongming and stay at the marsh. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 67

explanation: 说出话来就成文章。形容文思敏捷，口才好。
explanationTraditional: 說出話來就成文章。形容文思敏捷，口才好。
explanationEn: Words flow out like a written essay. Describes quick thinking and eloquence.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·都人士》彼都人士，狐裘黄黄，其容不改，出言成章。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·都人士》彼都人士，狐裘黃黃，其容不改，出言成章。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Dushi Ren': 'That gentleman of the capital, in his fox-fur robe, his countenance unchanged, his words form essays.'
example: 人皆言子建～，臣未深信。主上可召入，以才试之。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十九回
exampleTraditional: 人皆言子建～，臣未深信。主上可召入，以才試之。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十九回
exampleEn: Everyone says Zijian can speak eloquently; I do not fully believe it. Your Majesty may summon him to test his talent. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 79

explanation: 淡然不经心，不在意；处处理，对待。以漫不经心的态度对待事物。
explanationTraditional: 淡然不經心，不在意；處處理，對待。以漫不經心的態度對待事物。
explanationEn: To treat something with indifference or nonchalance.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们对此不能～，要引起高度重视。
exampleTraditional: 我們對此不能～，要引起高度重視。
exampleEn: We cannot treat this indifferently; we must pay close attention.

explanation: ①犹言差不多。②犹言零零碎碎，各式各样。
explanationTraditional: ①猶言差不多。②猶言零零碎碎，各式各樣。
explanationEn: ① More or less; almost. ② Miscellaneous; all kinds of.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指世代都是读书人的家庭。
explanationTraditional: 指世代都是讀書人的家庭。
explanationEn: A family of scholars for generations.
derivation: 高云览《小城春秋》第十三章刘眉尽管把鼻子都气歪了，也还是保持着书香世家的风度。”
derivationTraditional: 高雲覽《小城春秋》第十三章劉眉儘管把鼻子都氣歪了，也還是保持著書香世家的風度。”
derivationEn: From Gao Yunlan, 'Spring in a Small Town', Chapter 13: 'Liu Mei, though furious, still maintained the demeanor of a scholarly family.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 紧闭着嘴，什么也不说。
explanationTraditional: 緊閉著嘴，什麼也不說。
explanationEn: To keep one's mouth shut and say nothing.
derivation: 汉·桓宽《盐铁论·刺复》是以曹丞相日饮醇酒，倪大夫闭口不言。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·桓寬《鹽鐵論·刺復》是以曹丞相日飲醇酒，倪大夫閉口不言。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Huan Kuan, 'Discourses on Salt and Iron, Thorny Rebuttal': 'Thus Prime Minister Cao drank fine wine daily, and Minister Ni kept his mouth shut and said nothing.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 疾急速。徐缓慢。不急不慢。指处事能掌握适度的节律，不太快或不太慢。
explanationTraditional: 疾急速。徐緩慢。不急不慢。指處事能掌握適度的節律，不太快或不太慢。
explanationEn: Neither fast nor slow; to handle matters at a moderate pace.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《王纯中墓志铭》君调用财力，不疾不徐，劳民劝功，公私以济。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《王純中墓誌銘》君調用財力，不疾不徐，勞民勸功，公私以濟。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Huang Tingjian, 'Epitaph of Wang Chunzhong': 'The gentleman managed finances neither hastily nor slowly, laboring the people and encouraging merit, benefiting both public and private.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 照查考，察看。写下字据保存进来，以作凭证。
explanationTraditional: 照查考，察看。寫下字據保存進來，以作憑證。
explanationEn: To write a document and keep it as evidence.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们担心时间长了就空口无凭，只好～。
exampleTraditional: 我們擔心時間長了就空口無憑，只好～。
exampleEn: We fear that after a long time, words alone will be no proof, so we must write this down for evidence.

explanation: 蔽遮。衣服破烂，连身子都遮盖不住。形容生活贫苦。
explanationTraditional: 蔽遮。衣服破爛，連身子都遮蓋不住。形容生活貧苦。
explanationEn: Clothes too ragged to cover the body; describes extreme poverty.
derivation: 秦牧《土地》衣不蔽体、家里正在愁吃愁穿的农民望了这群不知稼穑艰难的人们一眼，一句话也没说。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《土地》衣不蔽體、家裡正在愁吃愁穿的農民望了這群不知稼穡艱難的人們一眼，一句話也沒說。”
derivationEn: From Qin Mu, 'The Land': 'Farmers with clothes too ragged to cover their bodies, worrying about food at home, glanced at these people who knew nothing of farming hardships and said not a word.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 自命自认为；凡平凡。自以为不平凡，比别人高明。
explanationTraditional: 自命自認為；凡平凡。自以為不平凡，比別人高明。
explanationEn: To consider oneself extraordinary and superior to others.
derivation: 清·淮阴百一居士《壶天录》娄县沈童者，年甫冠，习帖括，自命不凡，有太阿出匣遽化长虹之概。”
derivationTraditional: 清·淮陰百一居士《壺天錄》婁縣沈童者，年甫冠，習帖括，自命不凡，有太阿出匣遽化長虹之概。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Huaiyin Baiyi Jushi, 'Records of the Gourd': 'A young man from Lou County, just capped, studied the eight-legged essay, considered himself extraordinary, with an air of a great sword unsheathed turning into a rainbow.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指独腿站立的一种武术姿势◇也指用一足站立。
explanationTraditional: 指獨腿站立的一種武術姿勢◇也指用一足站立。
explanationEn: A martial arts posture standing on one leg; also means standing on one foot.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十四回我是‘金鸡独立’，要一足微长。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十四回我是‘金雞獨立’，要一足微長。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 74: 'I am doing the golden rooster standing on one leg, with one leg slightly extended.'
example: 你站在这桌子上，～，那一条腿不许放下来。★茅盾《子夜》十七
exampleTraditional: 你站在這桌子上，～，那一條腿不許放下來。★茅盾《子夜》十七
exampleEn: Stand on this table, on one leg like a golden rooster, and do not put the other leg down. — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 17

explanation: 文的武的都行。现常指既能动笔也有实际工作能力。
explanationTraditional: 文的武的都行。現常指既能動筆也有實際工作能力。
explanationEn: Able to wield both the pen and the sword; capable of both intellectual and practical work.
derivation: 清·钱采《说岳全传》第三十八回能文能武，方是男子汉。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢採《說岳全傳》第三十八回能文能武，方是男子漢。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 38: 'One who is able in both civil and military affairs is a true man.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 稍稍微；逊逊色。比较起来，稍微差一点。
explanationTraditional: 稍稍微；遜遜色。比較起來，稍微差一點。
explanationEn: Slightly inferior; a notch below.
derivation: 清·李渔《闲情偶寄·演习·脱套》才锋笔藻可继还魂，其稍逊一筹者，则在气与力之间耳。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《閒情偶寄·演習·脫套》才鋒筆藻可繼還魂，其稍遜一籌者，則在氣與力之間耳。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Yu, 'Casual Notes of Idle Feeling', Section 'Performance, Breaking Conventions': 'His literary talent could rival that of the Return of the Soul, but what made him slightly inferior was the gap in spirit and strength.'
example: 而后起的模拟者总不免比创始者要～。★范文澜《中国通史》第三编第七章第五节
exampleTraditional: 而後起的模擬者總不免比創始者要～。★范文瀾《中國通史》第三編第七章第五節
exampleEn: Later imitators are inevitably slightly inferior to the originator. ★ Fan Wenlan, 'General History of China', Volume 3, Chapter 7, Section 5

explanation: 窈窕美好的样子。美好的女子。
explanationTraditional: 窈窕美好的樣子。美好的女子。
explanationEn: A graceful and virtuous young lady.
derivation: 《诗经·周南·关睢》窈窕淑女，君子好逑。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周南·關睢》窈窕淑女，君子好逑。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Songs', 'Zhou Nan', 'Guan Ju': 'A graceful and virtuous young lady is a good match for a gentleman.'
example: 因为在前边领路的那位～明明很从容地就走过去了。★萧乾《海外行踪》
exampleTraditional: 因為在前邊領路的那位～明明很從容地就走過去了。★蕭乾《海外行蹤》
exampleEn: Because the graceful and virtuous young lady leading the way ahead clearly walked past calmly. ★ Xiao Qian, 'Overseas Travels'

explanation: 客死死在异乡或国外。死在离家乡很遥远的地方。
explanationTraditional: 客死死在異鄉或國外。死在離家鄉很遙遠的地方。
explanationEn: To die in a foreign land or away from one's hometown.
derivation: 元·无名氏《合同文字》第一折不争我病势正昏沉，更那堪苦事难支遣，忙赶上头里的丧车不远，眼见客死他乡有谁祭奠。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《合同文字》第一折不爭我病勢正昏沉，更那堪苦事難支遣，忙趕上頭裡的喪車不遠，眼見客死他鄉有誰祭奠。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Contract Text', First Act: 'Before I knew it, my illness was severe, and the hardships were unbearable. I hurried to catch up with the hearse ahead, only to see that I would die in a foreign land with no one to mourn me.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象天塌下、地裂开那样。比喻重大的事变。
explanationTraditional: 象天塌下、地裂開那樣。比喻重大的事變。
explanationEn: Heaven falls and earth cracks; a metaphor for a major upheaval or catastrophe.
derivation: 《战国策·赵策三》天崩地坼，天子下席。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·趙策三》天崩地坼，天子下席。”
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States', 'Strategy of Zhao III': 'Heaven collapses and earth splits, the emperor descends from his throne.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容仪容不整，作风散漫，态度不严肃或不认真。
explanationTraditional: 形容儀容不整，作風散漫，態度不嚴肅或不認真。
explanationEn: Slovenly, careless, and unserious in appearance or behavior.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 你不能总是这样吊儿郎当的好不好？
exampleTraditional: 你不能總是這樣吊兒郎當的好不好？
exampleEn: Can't you stop being so slovenly and irresponsible?

explanation: 愎任性；刚愎强硬回执；自用自以为是。十分固执自信，不考虑别人的意见。
explanationTraditional: 愎任性；剛愎強硬回執；自用自以為是。十分固執自信，不考慮別人的意見。
explanationEn: Obstinate and self-opinionated; stubbornly adhering to one's own views despite others' advice.
derivation: 《左传·宣公十二年》其佐先穣，刚愎不仁，未肯用命。”《尚书·仲虺之诰》好问则裕，自用则小。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公十二年》其佐先穣，剛愎不仁，未肯用命。”《尚書·仲虺之誥》好問則裕，自用則小。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan', Year 12 of Duke Xuan: 'His assistant Xian Hu was stubborn and unkind, unwilling to follow orders.' 'Book of Documents', 'Announcement of Zhong Hui': 'Inquiring leads to abundance, self-opinion leads to narrowness.'
example: 他想起李玉亭所说荪甫的～来了。他决定了主意不跟着荪甫跑了。（茅盾《子夜》十）
exampleTraditional: 他想起李玉亭所說蓀甫的～來了。他決定了主意不跟著蓀甫跑了。（茅盾《子夜》十）
exampleEn: He recalled Li Yuting's comment about Sunfu's obstinacy and self-opinion. He decided not to follow Sunfu anymore. (Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 10)

explanation: 为干，做。喜欢自己亲手去做。
explanationTraditional: 為幹，做。喜歡自己親手去做。
explanationEn: To like to do things oneself; to act on one's own.
derivation: 《淮南子·本经训》君人者不任能，而好自为之，则智日困而自负其责也。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·本經訓》君人者不任能，而好自為之，則智日困而自負其責也。”
derivationEn: 'Huainanzi', 'Basic Norms': 'A ruler who does not delegate to the capable but likes to do everything himself will become increasingly ignorant and bear the consequences.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 此生此世。指有生之年。
explanationTraditional: 此生此世。指有生之年。
explanationEn: This present life; the duration of one's lifetime.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》第一折这歪剌骨便是黄花女儿，刚刚扯的一把，也不消这等使性，平空的推了我一交，我肯干罢！就当面赌个誓与你我今生今世不要他做老婆，我也不算好男子。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》第一折這歪剌骨便是黃花女兒，剛剛扯的一把，也不消這等使性，平空的推了我一交，我肯幹罷！就當面賭個誓與你我今生今世不要他做老婆，我也不算好男子。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, 'The Injustice to Dou E', First Act: 'This shrew is still a virgin. Just a pull, and she makes such a fuss, pushing me to the ground. I swear: if I ever want her as my wife in this life, I'm not a real man.'
example: 扰了这一家人家，～还不的他，来生来世是必填还他则个。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷三十五
exampleTraditional: 擾了這一家人家，～還不的他，來生來世是必填還他則個。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷三十五
exampleEn: Having troubled this family, I cannot repay them in this life; I must repay them in the next life. ★ Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Amazement', Volume 35

explanation: 原指戏曲的南北腔调。现形容说话口音不纯，搀杂着方言。
explanationTraditional: 原指戲曲的南北腔調。現形容說話口音不純，攙雜著方言。
explanationEn: A mixture of southern and northern accents; speaking with a mixed dialect.
derivation: 清·赵翼《檐曝杂记》卷一每数十步间一戏台，南腔北调，备四方之乐。”
derivationTraditional: 清·趙翼《簷曝雜記》卷一每數十步間一戲臺，南腔北調，備四方之樂。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Zhao Yi, 'Miscellaneous Notes under the Eaves', Volume 1: 'Every few dozen steps there is a stage, with southern and northern tunes, providing music from all directions.'
example: 这个说话～的人，不适合当解说员。
exampleTraditional: 這個說話～的人，不適合當解說員。
exampleEn: This person who speaks with a mixed accent is not suitable to be a commentator.

explanation: 人按照其品行、爱好而形成团体，因而能互相区别。指好人总跟好人结成朋友，坏人总跟坏人聚在一起。
explanationTraditional: 人按照其品行、愛好而形成團體，因而能互相區別。指好人總跟好人結成朋友，壞人總跟壞人聚在一起。
explanationEn: People are grouped according to their character and interests, thus distinguishing each other. It means that good people tend to be friends with good people, and bad people tend to gather with bad people.
derivation: 《易·系辞上》方以类聚，物以群分，吉凶生矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·繫辭上》方以類聚，物以群分，吉凶生矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Appended Remarks' (《易·系辞上》): 'Things of one kind come together, people of one group are divided, and good and bad fortune arise.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 善好的。报报应。做好事必有好的报答。常与恶有恶报”连用。
explanationTraditional: 善好的。報報應。做好事必有好的報答。常與惡有惡報”連用。
explanationEn: Good deeds will be rewarded with good outcomes. Often used together with 'evil has its retribution'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心肠硬得象铁和石头一样。形容心肠很硬，不为感情所动。
explanationTraditional: 心腸硬得象鐵和石頭一樣。形容心腸很硬，不為感情所動。
explanationEn: A heart as hard as iron and stone. Describes someone who is very hard-hearted and unmoved by emotion.
derivation: 唐·皮日休《宋瓃集序》宋广平刚态毅状，疑其铁石心肠。”宋·苏轼《与李公择书》虽兄之受我厚，然仆本以铁石心肠待公。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·皮日休《宋瓃集序》宋廣平剛態毅狀，疑其鐵石心腸。”宋·蘇軾《與李公擇書》雖兄之受我厚，然僕本以鐵石心腸待公。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Pi Rixiu's 'Preface to Song Lu Collection' (《宋瓃集序》): 'Song Guangping was firm and resolute, suspected to have an iron and stone heart.' Also from Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Letter to Li Gongze' (《与李公择书》): 'Although you treat me generously, I have always treated you with an iron and stone heart.'
example: 如果再不给你回信，那简直是～了。★闻一多《给臧克家先生》
exampleTraditional: 如果再不給你回信，那簡直是～了。★聞一多《給臧克家先生》
exampleEn: If I still don't reply to your letter, it would be like having an iron and stone heart. — Wen Yiduo, 'To Mr. Zang Kejia'

explanation: 指对等行动。所指因文而异。
explanationTraditional: 指對等行動。所指因文而異。
explanationEn: Refers to reciprocal actions. The meaning varies depending on the context.
derivation: 陶行知《怎样做小先生》十一你既虚心的请教他，他也会虚心的请教你。最好的教育是有来有往。”
derivationTraditional: 陶行知《怎樣做小先生》十一你既虛心的請教他，他也會虛心的請教你。最好的教育是有來有往。”
derivationEn: From Tao Xingzhi's 'How to Be a Little Teacher' (《怎样做小先生》): 'If you humbly ask him for advice, he will also humbly ask you. The best education is reciprocal.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 耳朵同时察听各方面来的声音。形容人很机警。
explanationTraditional: 耳朵同時察聽各方面來的聲音。形容人很機警。
explanationEn: Ears simultaneously listen to sounds from all directions. Describes a person who is very alert.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第十六回为将之道，须要眼观四处，耳听八方。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第十六回為將之道，須要眼觀四處，耳聽八方。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei' (《说岳全传》): 'The way of a general requires eyes to see in all directions and ears to listen from all sides.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 说话带刺，待人冷酷。
explanationTraditional: 說話帶刺，待人冷酷。
explanationEn: Speaking with a sharp tongue and treating others coldly.
derivation: 宋·陈抟《心相编》愚鲁人说话尖酸刻薄。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳摶《心相編》愚魯人說話尖酸刻薄。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Chen Tuan's 'Heart Physiognomy' (《心相编》): 'Foolish and rude people speak sharply and harshly.'
example: 舜英姐姐安心要～，我也不来分辨，随他说去。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十六回
exampleTraditional: 舜英姐姐安心要～，我也不來分辨，隨他說去。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十六回
exampleEn: Sister Shunying is determined to be sharp and harsh, I won't argue with her, let her say what she wants. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' (《镜花缘》), Chapter 66

explanation: 原形容暮春景色衰败◇常用来比喻被打得大败。
explanationTraditional: 原形容暮春景色衰敗◇常用來比喻被打得大敗。
explanationEn: Originally described the decline of late spring scenery. Later often used to describe being badly defeated.
derivation: 唐·李群玉《奉和张舍人送秦炼师归岑公山》诗兰浦苍苍春欲暮，落花流水怨离襟。”五代南唐·李煜《浪淘沙》词流水落花春去也，天上人间”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李群玉《奉和張舍人送秦鍊師歸岑公山》詩蘭浦蒼蒼春欲暮，落花流水怨離襟。”五代南唐·李煜《浪淘沙》詞流水落花春去也，天上人間”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Qunyu's poem 'Feng He Zhang Sheren Song Qin Lianshi Gui Censhan Gong' (《奉和张舍人送秦炼师归岑公山》): 'The orchids are green, spring is about to end, falling flowers and flowing water express parting sorrow.' Also from Five Dynasties, Li Yu's 'Lang Tao Sha' (《浪淘沙》): 'Flowing water and falling flowers, spring is gone, heaven above and earth below.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 情意对人的感情。绵绵延续不断的样子。形容情意深长，不能解脱。
explanationTraditional: 情意對人的感情。綿綿延續不斷的樣子。形容情意深長，不能解脫。
explanationEn: Affection is deep and continuous. Describes deep and unbreakable feelings.
derivation: 周恩来《别李愚如并示述弟》何况情意绵绵，‘藕断丝不断’。”
derivationTraditional: 周恩來《別李愚如並示述弟》何況情意綿綿，‘藕斷絲不斷’。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Enlai's 'Farewell to Li Yuru and Show to Shudi' (《别李愚如并示述弟》): 'Moreover, affection is deep and continuous, 'the lotus root breaks but the fibers remain connected'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 文文字，指字面；义意义。不了解某一词句的确切涵义，光从字面上去牵强附会，做出不确切的解释。
explanationTraditional: 文文字，指字面；義意義。不瞭解某一詞句的確切涵義，光從字面上去牽強附會，做出不確切的解釋。
explanationEn: To interpret the meaning of a word or phrase solely from its literal appearance without understanding its true meaning, leading to a forced and inaccurate interpretation.
derivation: 清·张之洞《輶轩语·语学》空谈臆说，望文生意。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張之洞《輶軒語·語學》空談臆說，望文生意。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zhang Zhidong's 'You Xuan Yu: Yu Xue' (《輶轩语·语学》): 'Empty talk and subjective speculation, interpreting meaning from the text.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 胜能承受。喜欢得控制不了自己。形容非常高兴。
explanationTraditional: 勝能承受。喜歡得控制不了自己。形容非常高興。
explanationEn: Happiness that one cannot contain. Describes extreme joy.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第五本第四折小生去时，承夫人亲自饯行，喜不自胜。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第五本第四折小生去時，承夫人親自餞行，喜不自勝。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing' (《西厢记》): 'When I left, the lady personally saw me off, and I was overjoyed.'
example: 国太只道孙权好意，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 國太只道孫權好意，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十五回
exampleEn: The Empress Dowager only thought Sun Quan meant well, and was overjoyed. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' (《三国演义》), Chapter 55

explanation: 指应该和有关的人一起商量或一起做的事，却独自办理，不让旁人参与。
explanationTraditional: 指應該和有關的人一起商量或一起做的事，卻獨自辦理，不讓旁人參與。
explanationEn: To take everything on oneself without consulting others, depriving them of participation.
derivation: 周立波《暴风骤雨》第二部二三媒婆真是包办代替的老祖宗，可真是把人坑害死了。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《暴風驟雨》第二部二三媒婆真是包辦代替的老祖宗，可真是把人坑害死了。”
derivationEn: Zhou Libo, 'The Hurricane' Part 2, Chapter 23: 'Matchmakers are truly the ancestors of doing everything for others, they really harm people to death.'
example: 我们工作同志作好参谋，不要指手划脚，～。★陈残云《山谷风烟》第三四章
exampleTraditional: 我們工作同志作好參謀，不要指手劃腳，～。★陳殘雲《山谷風煙》第三四章
exampleEn: We comrades should act as good advisors, not point fingers and do everything for others. ★ Chen Canyun, 'Valley Wind and Smoke' Chapter 34

explanation: 逢遇到；场演戏的场地。原指旧时走江湖的艺人遇到适合的场合就表演◇指遇到机会，偶尔凑凑热闹。
explanationTraditional: 逢遇到；場演戲的場地。原指舊時走江湖的藝人遇到適合的場合就表演◇指遇到機會，偶爾湊湊熱鬧。
explanationEn: To join in the fun occasionally; to play along when the opportunity arises.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷六竿木随身，逢场作戏。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷六竿木隨身，逢場作戲。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan, 'Transmission of the Lamp' Volume 6: 'Carrying a pole, play along when you meet a venue.'
example: 不过借他船坐坐舒服些，用他菜吃适口些，～，这有何妨。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第七回
exampleTraditional: 不過借他船坐坐舒服些，用他菜吃適口些，～，這有何妨。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第七回
exampleEn: It's just borrowing his boat for comfort, eating his food for taste, playing along—what harm is there? ★ Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins' Chapter 7

explanation: 缄封闭。封住嘴巴，不开口说话。
explanationTraditional: 緘封閉。封住嘴巴，不開口說話。
explanationEn: To keep one's mouth shut; to remain silent.
derivation: 《明史·何遵传》正德间，给事、御史挟势凌人，趋权择便，凡朝廷大阙失，群臣大奸恶，缄口不言。”
derivationTraditional: 《明史·何遵傳》正德間，給事、御史挾勢凌人，趨權擇便，凡朝廷大闕失，群臣大奸惡，緘口不言。”
derivationEn: 'History of Ming', Biography of He Zun: 'During the Zhengde era, censors and supervising secretaries bullied others, sought power, and chose convenience. Whenever there were major faults in the court or great evils among officials, they kept silent.'
example: 商民工匠，见诸官绅，皆～，恐犯当道之怒，祸生不测云。★清·郑观应《盛世危言·商务》
exampleTraditional: 商民工匠，見諸官紳，皆～，恐犯當道之怒，禍生不測雲。★清·鄭觀應《盛世危言·商務》
exampleEn: Merchants, commoners, and artisans, when seeing officials and gentry, all kept silent, fearing to offend the authorities and bring unexpected disaster. ★ Qing Dynasty, Zheng Guanying, 'Words of Warning for a Prosperous Age: Commerce'

explanation: 憎厌恶。面貌神情卑陋，使人看了厌恶。
explanationTraditional: 憎厭惡。面貌神情卑陋，使人看了厭惡。
explanationEn: Repulsive in appearance; loathsome looks.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送穷文》凡所以使吾面目可憎，语言无味者，皆子之志也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送窮文》凡所以使吾面目可憎，語言無味者，皆子之志也。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Sending Off Poverty': 'All that makes my face repulsive and my speech dull is your doing.'
example: 士人三日不读书，则～，语言无味。★明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第七回
exampleTraditional: 士人三日不讀書，則～，語言無味。★明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第七回
exampleEn: If a scholar does not read for three days, his face becomes repulsive and his speech dull. ★ Ming Dynasty, Donglu Gu Kuang Sheng, 'Awakening from Drunkenness' Chapter 7

explanation: 当事人被碰到的问题搞糊涂了，旁边观看的人却看得很清楚。
explanationTraditional: 當事人被碰到的問題搞糊塗了，旁邊觀看的人卻看得很清楚。
explanationEn: The onlooker sees the game best; bystanders are clear-headed.
derivation: 《旧唐书·元行冲传》当局称迷，傍观见审。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·元行衝傳》當局稱迷，傍觀見審。”
derivationEn: 'Old Book of Tang', Biography of Yuan Xingchong: 'Those involved are confused, while onlookers see clearly.'
example: 俗话说～。”这几年姑娘冷眼看着，或有该添减的去处，二奶奶没行到，姑娘竟一添减。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 俗話說～。”這幾年姑娘冷眼看著，或有該添減的去處，二奶奶沒行到，姑娘竟一添減。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五十五回
exampleEn: As the saying goes, 'The onlooker sees the game best.' In recent years, you have observed coldly; perhaps there are additions or reductions that the Second Mistress hasn't made, and you could do so. ★ Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 55

explanation: 畏惧退缩，不敢前进。
explanationTraditional: 畏懼退縮，不敢前進。
explanationEn: To shrink back in fear; to hesitate to advance.
derivation: 宋·魏泰《东轩笔录》唐介始弹张尧佐，谏官皆上疏，及弹文彦博，则吴奎畏缩不前，当时谓拽动阵脚。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏泰《東軒筆錄》唐介始彈張堯佐，諫官皆上疏，及彈文彥博，則吳奎畏縮不前，當時謂拽動陣腳。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wei Tai, 'Records of the Eastern Pavilion': 'Tang Jie first impeached Zhang Yaozuo, and all remonstrating officials submitted memorials. When he impeached Wen Yanbo, Wu Qu shrank back, and it was said he pulled back the battle line.'
example: 尤其是她自己，起先虽然颇有～的心情，此时却已鼓起勇士临阵似的气慨了。★叶圣陶《平常的故事》
exampleTraditional: 尤其是她自己，起先雖然頗有～的心情，此時卻已鼓起勇士臨陣似的氣慨了。★葉聖陶《平常的故事》
exampleEn: Especially she herself, though initially hesitant to advance, now mustered the courage of a warrior going into battle. ★ Ye Shengtao, 'An Ordinary Story'

explanation: 依依恋。象小鸟那样依傍着人。形容少女或小孩娇小可爱的样子。
explanationTraditional: 依依戀。象小鳥那樣依傍著人。形容少女或小孩嬌小可愛的樣子。
explanationEn: To be as endearing as a little bird; describes a cute and lovable girl or child.
derivation: 《旧唐书·长孙无忌传》禇遂良学问稍长，性亦坚正，既写忠诚，甚亲附于朕，譬如飞鸟依人，自加怜爱。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·長孫無忌傳》禇遂良學問稍長，性亦堅正，既寫忠誠，甚親附於朕，譬如飛鳥依人，自加憐愛。”
derivationEn: 'Old Book of Tang', Biography of Zhangsun Wuji: 'Chu Suiliang's learning has grown, his nature is firm and upright. He is loyal and close to me, like a bird clinging to a person, naturally lovable.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 遇水阻拦，就架桥通过。形容不怕阻力，奋勇前进。
explanationTraditional: 遇水阻攔，就架橋通過。形容不怕阻力，奮勇前進。
explanationEn: To build a bridge when encountering water; to overcome obstacles and advance bravely.
derivation: 康濯《太阳初升的时候·竞赛》他们的劲头都鼓的当当响，真是逢山开路，遇水架桥，一气儿跑步向前。”
derivationTraditional: 康濯《太陽初升的時候·競賽》他們的勁頭都鼓的當當響，真是逢山開路，遇水架橋，一氣兒跑步向前。”
derivationEn: Kang Zhuo, 'At the Beginning of the Sun Rising: Competition': 'Their momentum was booming, truly cutting through mountains and building bridges when meeting water, running forward in one breath.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 甲为乙的外表，乙为甲的内里。比喻互相依存，互相接受。
explanationTraditional: 甲為乙的外表，乙為甲的內裡。比喻互相依存，互相接受。
explanationEn: To complement each other; to be mutually dependent and interactive.
derivation: 晋·陈寿《三国志·董允传》陈祗代允为侍中，与黄皓互为表里。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陳壽《三國志·董允傳》陳祗代允為侍中，與黃皓互為表裡。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Chen Shou, 'Records of the Three Kingdoms', Biography of Dong Yun: 'Chen Zhi replaced Yun as Attendant, and together with Huang Hao, they complemented each other.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 井底的蛙只能看到井口那么大的一块天。比喻见识狭窄的人。
explanationTraditional: 井底的蛙只能看到井口那麼大的一塊天。比喻見識狹窄的人。
explanationEn: A frog at the bottom of a well; a person with a very narrow outlook.
derivation: 《庄子·秋水》井蛙不可以语于海者，拘于虚也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·秋水》井蛙不可以語於海者，拘於虛也。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi', Autumn Floods: 'You cannot discuss the sea with a well frog—it is confined to its space.'
example: ～，所见不大；萤火之光，其亮不远。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: ～，所見不大；螢火之光，其亮不遠。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二十五回
exampleEn: A frog at the bottom of a well sees little; the light of a firefly does not shine far. ★ Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, 'Creation of the Gods' Chapter 25

explanation: 同类的东西聚在一起。指坏人彼此臭味相投，勾结在一起。
explanationTraditional: 同類的東西聚在一起。指壞人彼此臭味相投，勾結在一起。
explanationEn: Things of the same kind gather together. It refers to people of similar bad character associating with each other.
derivation: 《易·系辞上》方以类聚，物以群分。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·繫辭上》方以類聚，物以群分。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Appended Remarks' - 'Birds of a feather flock together; things of a kind gather together.'
example: 自古道～。过迁性喜游荡，就有一班浮浪子弟引诱打合。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十七
exampleTraditional: 自古道～。過遷性喜遊蕩，就有一班浮浪子弟引誘打合。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十七
exampleEn: As the old saying goes, 'Birds of a feather flock together.' Guo Qian, being fond of wandering, was soon led astray by a group of frivolous youths. (from Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Chapter 17)

explanation: 怀怀藏。胸有远大志向。
explanationTraditional: 懷懷藏。胸有遠大志向。
explanationEn: To harbor great ambitions; to have lofty aspirations.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第二十一回夫英雄者，胸怀大志，腹有良谋，有包藏宇宙之机，吞吐天地之志者也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第二十一回夫英雄者，胸懷大志，腹有良謀，有包藏宇宙之機，吞吐天地之志者也。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 21: 'A hero is one who harbors great ambitions, has excellent strategies, and possesses the ability to encompass the universe and swallow heaven and earth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 进行最后的较量以决定高下。
explanationTraditional: 進行最後的較量以決定高下。
explanationEn: To have a final contest to determine the winner.
derivation: 宋·司马光《与王介甫书》介甫之意，必欲力战天下之人，与之一决胜负，不复顾义理之是非，生民之忧乐，国家之安危。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·司馬光《與王介甫書》介甫之意，必欲力戰天下之人，與之一決勝負，不復顧義理之是非，生民之憂樂，國家之安危。”
derivationEn: From Sima Guang's 'Letter to Wang Anshi': 'Your intention is to fight fiercely with the people of the world and decide victory or defeat with them, disregarding right and wrong, the joys and sorrows of the people, and the safety of the nation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 从一片树叶的凋落，知道秋天的到来。比喻通过个别的细微的迹象，可以看到整个形势的发展趋向与结果。
explanationTraditional: 從一片樹葉的凋落，知道秋天的到來。比喻通過個別的細微的跡象，可以看到整個形勢的發展趨向與結果。
explanationEn: From the falling of one leaf, one knows the arrival of autumn. It means that from a small sign one can see the overall trend or outcome.
derivation: 《淮南子·说山训》见一叶落而知岁之将暮。”宋·唐庚《文录》引唐人诗山僧不解数甲子，一叶落知天下秋。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·說山訓》見一葉落而知歲之將暮。”宋·唐庚《文錄》引唐人詩山僧不解數甲子，一葉落知天下秋。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi: Discourse on Mountains': 'Seeing one leaf fall, one knows the year is about to end.' Also from Tang Geng's 'Record of Literature' quoting a Tang poem: 'The mountain monk does not know how to count the years, but seeing one leaf fall, he knows autumn is here.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻玩弄手段蒙骗人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻玩弄手段矇騙人。
explanationEn: To pretend to be a god or ghost; to play tricks to deceive people.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十七回你们别和我装神弄鬼的，什么事我不知道？”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十七回你們別和我裝神弄鬼的，什麼事我不知道？”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 37: 'Don't play tricks on me; what do I not know?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 败兴遇到和想象不一致的事而情绪低落。扫兴地归来。
explanationTraditional: 敗興遇到和想象不一致的事而情緒低落。掃興地歸來。
explanationEn: To return disappointed; to come back in low spirits because things did not turn out as expected.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第一回各军士未及领赏，草草而散。正是乘兴而来，败兴而返。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第一回各軍士未及領賞，草草而散。正是乘興而來，敗興而返。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 1: 'The soldiers dispersed hastily without receiving rewards. It was exactly 'setting out with high spirits and returning disappointed.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 微风轻拂，浮云淡薄。形容天气晴好。同风轻云净”、云淡风轻”。
explanationTraditional: 微風輕拂，浮雲淡薄。形容天氣晴好。同風輕雲淨”、雲淡風輕”。
explanationEn: Light breeze and thin clouds; describing fine weather. Same as '风轻云净' or '云淡风轻'.
derivation: 元·杨暹《西游记》第四本第十三出元定下的夫妻怎断，咱茶浓酒酣，趁着风轻云淡，省得着我倚门终日盼停骖。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊暹《西遊記》第四本第十三出元定下的夫妻怎斷，咱茶濃酒酣，趁著風輕雲淡，省得著我倚門終日盼停驂。”
derivationEn: From Yang Xian's 'Journey to the West' (Yuan dynasty), Act 4, Scene 13: 'The couple destined by fate cannot be separated; our tea is strong and wine mellow, taking advantage of the light breeze and thin clouds, so I don't have to lean on the gate all day waiting for the carriage.'
example: 寒食春归御柳条，～日轮高。★明·无心子《金雀记·定婚》
exampleTraditional: 寒食春歸御柳條，～日輪高。★明·無心子《金雀記·定婚》
exampleEn: On the Cold Food Festival, spring returns to the imperial willows; with light breeze and thin clouds, the sun is high. (from Ming dynasty play 'The Golden Sparrow' by Wu Xinzhi)

explanation: 鸡飞走了，蛋打破了。比喻两头落空，一无所得。
explanationTraditional: 雞飛走了，蛋打破了。比喻兩頭落空，一無所得。
explanationEn: The chicken has flown and the eggs are broken. It means both sides are lost; to end up with nothing.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·阿霞》人之无良，舍其旧而新是谋，卒之卵覆鸟亦飞，天之所报亦惨矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·阿霞》人之無良，舍其舊而新是謀，卒之卵覆鳥亦飛，天之所報亦慘矣。”
derivationEn: From Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: A Xia': 'A person without conscience abandons the old and seeks the new, and in the end the egg breaks and the bird flies away; heaven's retribution is also severe.'
example: 只要他一进关抄了咱们的后路，那就～，不可收拾了。★周骥良《吉鸿昌》
exampleTraditional: 只要他一進關抄了咱們的後路，那就～，不可收拾了。★周驥良《吉鴻昌》
exampleEn: As soon as he enters the pass and attacks our rear, it will be like 'the chicken flies and the eggs break'—irreparable. (from Zhou Jiliang's 'Ji Hongchang')

explanation: 无论到哪儿没有不胜利的。
explanationTraditional: 無論到哪兒沒有不勝利的。
explanationEn: To be invincible; to win wherever one goes.
derivation: 京剧《红色娘子军》第二场连长，我们军民一心，就无往不胜！”
derivationTraditional: 京劇《紅色娘子軍》第二場連長，我們軍民一心，就無往不勝！”
derivationEn: From the Peking opera 'The Red Detachment of Women', Act 2: 'Company commander, if we are united as one, we will be invincible!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 陋简陋；就将就。原意是因循原来的的简陋，不求改进◇指就着原来简陋的条件办事。
explanationTraditional: 陋簡陋；就將就。原意是因循原來的的簡陋，不求改進◇指就著原來簡陋的條件辦事。
explanationEn: To make do with existing简陋 conditions; to do things simply and thriftily without seeking improvement.
derivation: 汉·刘歆《移书让太常博士》苟因陋就寡，分文析字。烦言碎辞，学者罢老且不能究其一艺。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉歆《移書讓太常博士》苟因陋就寡，分文析字。煩言碎辭，學者罷老且不能究其一藝。”
derivationEn: From Liu Xin's 'Letter to the Grand Historians': 'If one follows the old and simple ways, splitting words and analyzing characters with tedious and trivial phrases, scholars will grow old and still not master one art.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 功德佛教用语，指诵经、布施等。多指诵经等佛事结束。比喻举办事情圆满结束。
explanationTraditional: 功德佛教用語，指誦經、佈施等。多指誦經等佛事結束。比喻舉辦事情圓滿結束。
explanationEn: A Buddhist term referring to the completion of meritorious deeds such as chanting sutras or giving alms. It metaphorically means the successful conclusion of an event or task.
derivation: 隋·隋炀帝《入朝遣使参书》奉五月二日诲，用慰驰结，仰承衡岳，功德圆满，便致荆巫。”
derivationTraditional: 隋·隋煬帝《入朝遣使參書》奉五月二日誨，用慰馳結，仰承衡嶽，功德圓滿，便致荊巫。”
derivationEn: From Emperor Yang of Sui's 'Letter to the Envoy on Entering the Court': 'I received your letter on the second day of May, which comforted my restless heart. I heard that you have reached Hengyue and completed your meritorious deeds, then you will go to Jingwu.'
example: 兄弟算是原经手，了此一事，～。★茅盾《清明前后》
exampleTraditional: 兄弟算是原經手，了此一事，～。★茅盾《清明前後》
exampleEn: Brother is the original handler, and after finishing this matter, it will be a perfect conclusion. (Mao Dun, 'Before and After Qingming')

explanation: 舍住宅，比喻人的躯壳。灵魂离开了躯壳。指人之将死。也形容精神恍惚。
explanationTraditional: 舍住宅，比喻人的軀殼。靈魂離開了軀殼。指人之將死。也形容精神恍惚。
explanationEn: The soul has left the body, indicating a person is near death or in a state of mental distraction.
derivation: 《三国志·管辂传》裴松之注引《辂别传》何之视侯，则魂不守宅，血不华色，精爽烟浮，容若槁木，谓之鬼幽。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·管輅傳》裴松之注引《輅別傳》何之視侯，則魂不守宅，血不華色，精爽煙浮，容若槁木，謂之鬼幽。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Guan Lu' with annotation by Pei Songzhi: 'When He Yan looked at the marquis, his soul was not in his body, his blood lacked color, his spirit floated like smoke, and his appearance was like withered wood—this is called ghostly gloom.'
example: 我看宝玉竟是～，起动是不怕的。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十五回
exampleTraditional: 我看寶玉竟是～，起動是不怕的。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十五回
exampleEn: I think Baoyu is indeed absent-minded; moving about is not a concern. (Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 15)

explanation: 媒妁说合婚姻的人。媒人的介绍。
explanationTraditional: 媒妁說合婚姻的人。媒人的介紹。
explanationEn: The words of a matchmaker; refers to the introduction by a go-between in marriage.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公下》不待父母之命，媒妁之言，钻穴隙相窥，踰墙相从，则父母国人皆贱之。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公下》不待父母之命，媒妁之言，鑽穴隙相窺，踰牆相從，則父母國人皆賤之。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Teng Wen Gong II': 'If a man and woman do not wait for their parents' command and the matchmaker's words, but bore holes to peek at each other and climb over walls to follow each other, then their parents and all people will despise them.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 乘趁。利用别人没有防备的时机，去侵害对方。
explanationTraditional: 乘趁。利用別人沒有防備的時機，去侵害對方。
explanationEn: To take advantage of someone's unpreparedness to attack or harm them.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十八回我乘其不备而更追之，故能胜也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十八回我乘其不備而更追之，故能勝也。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 18: 'I attacked them when they were unprepared and pursued them, so I was able to win.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 良美好；辰时辰。美好的时光和景物。
explanationTraditional: 良美好；辰時辰。美好的時光和景物。
explanationEn: Beautiful time and scenery; a delightful moment and pleasant surroundings.
derivation: 南朝·宋·谢灵运《拟魏太子邺中集诗序》天下良辰、美景、赏心、乐事，四者难并。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·謝靈運《擬魏太子鄴中集詩序》天下良辰、美景、賞心、樂事，四者難並。”
derivationEn: From Xie Lingyun's 'Preface to Poems of the Ye Zhong Collection': 'In the world, fine times, beautiful scenery, pleasing hearts, and joyful events are hard to have all four together.'
example: 虚度了丽日风和，枉误了～。★元·关汉卿《金线池》第三折
exampleTraditional: 虛度了麗日風和，枉誤了～。★元·關漢卿《金線池》第三折
exampleEn: Wasting the gentle breeze and bright sun, and missing the fine times and beautiful scenery. (Guan Hanqing, 'Golden Thread Pond', Act 3)

explanation: 逊次、差；筹算筹。比较起来，稍微差一点。
explanationTraditional: 遜次、差；籌算籌。比較起來，稍微差一點。
explanationEn: To be slightly inferior or a little less good compared to something else.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用瞪眼回击瞪眼。比喻用对方使用的手段来回击对方。
explanationTraditional: 用瞪眼回擊瞪眼。比喻用對方使用的手段來回擊對方。
explanationEn: To retaliate with the same method used by the opponent; an eye for an eye.
derivation: 《旧约全书·申命记》以眼还眼，以牙还牙，以手还手，以脚还脚。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊約全書·申命記》以眼還眼，以牙還牙，以手還手，以腳還腳。”
derivationEn: From the Old Testament, Deuteronomy: 'Eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.'
example: 我们～，以牙还牙！敌人用大炮来轰我们，我们也用大炮去回答他们。★张天翼《新生》
exampleTraditional: 我們～，以牙還牙！敵人用大炮來轟我們，我們也用大炮去回答他們。★張天翼《新生》
exampleEn: We will give an eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth! If the enemy bombards us with cannons, we will answer them with cannons. (Zhang Tianyi, 'New Life')

explanation: 将映在酒杯里的弓影误认为蛇。比喻因疑神疑鬼而引起恐惧。
explanationTraditional: 將映在酒杯裡的弓影誤認為蛇。比喻因疑神疑鬼而引起恐懼。
explanationEn: Mistaking the reflection of a bow in a cup for a snake; describes extreme suspicion and fear.
derivation: 汉·应劭《风俗通义·世间多有见怪》时北壁上有悬赤弩照于杯，形如蛇。宣畏恶之，然不敢不饮。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·應劭《風俗通義·世間多有見怪》時北壁上有懸赤弩照於杯，形如蛇。宣畏惡之，然不敢不飲。”
derivationEn: From Ying Shao's 'Comprehensive Meaning of Customs and Habits': 'At that time, a red crossbow hung on the north wall was reflected in the cup like a snake. Xuan was terrified but dared not not drink.'
example: 金玦厖凉含隐痛，～负奇冤。★清·黄遵宪《感事》诗
exampleTraditional: 金玦厖涼含隱痛，～負奇冤。★清·黃遵憲《感事》詩
exampleEn: The golden jade pendant hides hidden pain; the cup bow snake shadow bears strange injustice. (Huang Zunxian, 'Poem on Feeling Events')

explanation: 有不少从前的事可以作为例子。
explanationTraditional: 有不少從前的事可以作為例子。
explanationEn: There are many precedents; not lacking in previous examples.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第四卷第十四章明末起义首领中一向重视养子，而且以养子继承皇位的事在五代不乏先例。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第四卷第十四章明末起義首領中一向重視養子，而且以養子繼承皇位的事在五代不乏先例。”
derivationEn: From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 4, Chapter 14: 'Among the leaders of the late Ming uprising, adopting sons was always valued, and there were no lack of precedents for adopted sons inheriting the throne in the Five Dynasties.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把恶毒的语言加到别人身上。
explanationTraditional: 把惡毒的語言加到別人身上。
explanationEn: To heap abusive language on someone; to use harsh words against others.
derivation: 冯玉祥《我的生活》第十六章日常士兵偶有不是，动辄恶语相加，痛施体罚。”
derivationTraditional: 馮玉祥《我的生活》第十六章日常士兵偶有不是，動輒惡語相加，痛施體罰。”
derivationEn: From Feng Yuxiang's 'My Life', Chapter 16: 'Whenever ordinary soldiers made minor mistakes, they would often be subjected to abusive language and severe corporal punishment.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风华风采才华；绝代冠绝当世。意思是风采才华为当世第一。
explanationTraditional: 風華風采才華；絕代冠絕當世。意思是風采才華為當世第一。
explanationEn: Unparalleled elegance and talent; outstanding in one's generation.
derivation: 《南史·谢晦传》时谢混风华为江左第一，尝与晦俱在武帝前，帝目之曰‘一时顿有两玉人耳。’”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·謝晦傳》時謝混風華為江左第一，嘗與晦俱在武帝前，帝目之曰‘一時頓有兩玉人耳。’”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Southern Dynasties: Biography of Xie Hui': 'At that time, Xie Hun's elegance was the best in Jiangdong. Once, he and Xie Hui were both before Emperor Wu, who remarked, 'Suddenly there are two jade-like men.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指师徒间口头传授，内心领会。
explanationTraditional: 指師徒間口頭傳授，內心領會。
explanationEn: Oral teaching that inspires true understanding; direct transmission from master to student.
derivation: 明·解缙《春雨杂述·评书》学书之法，非口传心授，不得其精。”
derivationTraditional: 明·解縉《春雨雜述·評書》學書之法，非口傳心授，不得其精。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xie Jin's 'Miscellaneous Notes on Spring Rain: Comments on Calligraphy': 'The method of learning calligraphy cannot be mastered without oral teaching and mental understanding.'
example: 尽管在旧社会得不到出版发行的便利，千百年来通过无数艺人的～，终于很好地保留下来了。★光未然《戏曲遗产中的现实意义》
exampleTraditional: 儘管在舊社會得不到出版發行的便利，千百年來通過無數藝人的～，終於很好地保留下來了。★光未然《戲曲遺產中的現實意義》
exampleEn: Although there was no convenience of publication and distribution in the old society, through the oral teaching and mental understanding of countless artists over thousands of years, it has been well preserved. — Guang Weiran, 'The Realistic Significance of Opera Heritage'

explanation: 形容度量大，能容人。
explanationTraditional: 形容度量大，能容人。
explanationEn: Magnanimous; generous and tolerant.
derivation: 元·无名氏《鱼樵记》第三折我则道相公不知打我多少，元（原）来那相公宽宏大量。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《魚樵記》第三折我則道相公不知打我多少，元（原）來那相公寬宏大量。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'The Fisherman and the Woodcutter' Act 3: 'I thought the lord would beat me severely, but unexpectedly the lord is magnanimous.'
example: 你们怎么这样爱她们而不跟我讲些～的呢？★老舍《赵子曰》
exampleTraditional: 你們怎麼這樣愛她們而不跟我講些～的呢？★老舍《趙子曰》
exampleEn: Why do you love them so much and not speak to me about magnanimity? — Lao She, 'Zhao Ziyue'

explanation: 传说老子过函谷关之前，关尹喜见有紫气从东而来，知道将有圣人过关。果然老子骑着青牛而来。旧时比喻吉祥的征兆。
explanationTraditional: 傳說老子過函谷關之前，關尹喜見有紫氣從東而來，知道將有聖人過關。果然老子騎著青牛而來。舊時比喻吉祥的徵兆。
explanationEn: Auspicious sign; purple vapor coming from the east, indicating the arrival of a sage.
derivation: 汉·刘向《列仙传》老子西游，关令尹喜望见有紫气浮关，而老子果乘青牛而过也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《列仙傳》老子西遊，關令尹喜望見有紫氣浮關，而老子果乘青牛而過也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Liu Xiang's 'Biographies of Immortals': 'When Laozi traveled west, the gatekeeper Yin Xi saw purple vapor floating over the pass, and indeed Laozi came riding a green ox.'
example: ～，瑶池西望，翩翩青鸟舞前降。★清·洪昻《长生殿》第十六出
exampleTraditional: ～，瑤池西望，翩翩青鳥舞前降。★清·洪昻《長生殿》第十六出
exampleEn: Purple vapor comes from the east, overlooking the west of Yaochi, the green bird dances before the descent. — Qing Dynasty Hong Sheng, 'Palace of Eternal Life' Act 16

explanation: 上不去，下不来。形容进退两难。
explanationTraditional: 上不去，下不來。形容進退兩難。
explanationEn: In a dilemma; unable to advance or retreat.
derivation: 《庄子·达生》上而不下，则使人善怒；下而不上，则使人善忘；不上不下，中身当心，则为病。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·達生》上而不下，則使人善怒；下而不上，則使人善忘；不上不下，中身當心，則為病。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Attaining Life': 'If it goes up but not down, it makes people prone to anger; if it goes down but not up, it makes people prone to forgetfulness; if it neither goes up nor down, it is in the middle of the body and causes illness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容神态失常，失去自制。
explanationTraditional: 形容神態失常，失去自制。
explanationEn: As if drunk or stupefied; completely absorbed or infatuated.
derivation: 元·马致远《汉宫秋》第二折得见了王昭君，使朕如痴似醉。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《漢宮秋》第二折得見了王昭君，使朕如痴似醉。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Ma Zhiyuan's 'Autumn in the Han Palace' Act 2: 'Having seen Wang Zhaojun, I am as if drunk and stupefied.'
example: 真也弄得个～，眠思梦想。★明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第十三回
exampleTraditional: 真也弄得個～，眠思夢想。★明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第十三回
exampleEn: He was truly as if drunk and stupefied, lost in thoughts and dreams. — Ming Dynasty Donglu Gu Kuangsheng, 'Awakening from a Drunken Stone' Chapter 13

explanation: 指屡次，多次。
explanationTraditional: 指屢次，多次。
explanationEn: Again and again; repeatedly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 恰巧碰上那个机会或时机。同适逢其会”。
explanationTraditional: 恰巧碰上那個機會或時機。同適逢其會”。
explanationEn: To happen to be at the right time; to coincide with the opportunity.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容说话和态度卑下恭顺的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話和態度卑下恭順的樣子。
explanationEn: Humble and submissive in speech and manner.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三更瘦小低声下气，送暖偷寒，逢其所喜，避其所讳。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三更瘦小低聲下氣，送暖偷寒，逢其所喜，避其所諱。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 3: 'Even more humble and submissive, sending warmth and stealing cold, pleasing what they like and avoiding what they dislike.'
example: 宝玉背地里拉着他，～，要问黛玉的话，紫娟从没好话回答。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一○○回
exampleTraditional: 寶玉背地裡拉著他，～，要問黛玉的話，紫娟從沒好話回答。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一○○回
exampleEn: Baoyu pulled her aside and, in a humble and submissive manner, asked about Daiyu's words, but Zijuan never answered kindly. — Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 100

explanation: 在一旁助威增加他人的愤怒或助长事态的发展。
explanationTraditional: 在一旁助威增加他人的憤怒或助長事態的發展。
explanationEn: To add fuel to the fire; to aggravate a situation or increase anger.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五回三荷包也不睬他，把他气得越发火上加油了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五回三荷包也不睬他，把他氣得越發火上加油了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure' Chapter 5: 'Sanhebao ignored him, which only added fuel to his anger.'
example: 这是一个重要的西洋古典，主上不懂得运用，而公开的说出‘自由民治’的真面目，那就一定要～的更激起匪徒的暴乱的。★瞿秋白《论文学革命及语言文字问题·学阀万岁》
exampleTraditional: 這是一個重要的西洋古典，主上不懂得運用，而公開的說出‘自由民治’的真面目，那就一定要～的更激起匪徒的暴亂的。★瞿秋白《論文學革命及語言文字問題·學閥萬歲》
exampleEn: This is an important Western classic; if the ruler does not know how to use it and openly reveals the true face of 'liberal democracy', it will only add fuel to the fire and further incite the bandits' riots. — Qu Qiubai, 'On Literary Revolution and Language Issues: Long Live the Pedants'

explanation: 什么都不放在眼里。形容极端骄傲自大。
explanationTraditional: 什麼都不放在眼裡。形容極端驕傲自大。
explanationEn: To consider nothing and no one as worthy of attention; extremely arrogant and self-important.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十二回但他恃著自己学问，目空一切，每每把人不放在眼内。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十二回但他恃著自己學問，目空一切，每每把人不放在眼內。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 52: 'But he, relying on his own knowledge, considered everything beneath him and often looked down on others.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 薄迫近。太阳快落山了。比喻人已经衰老或事物衰败腐朽，临近死亡。
explanationTraditional: 薄迫近。太陽快落山了。比喻人已經衰老或事物衰敗腐朽，臨近死亡。
explanationEn: The sun is setting beyond the western hills; metaphor for a person nearing death or a thing declining and approaching its end.
derivation: 晋·李密《陈情表》但以刘日薄西山，气息奄奄，人命危浅，朝不虑夕。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·李密《陳情表》但以劉日薄西山，氣息奄奄，人命危淺，朝不慮夕。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Li Mi's 'Chen Qing Biao': 'But my grandmother is like the sun setting beyond the western hills, her breath faint, her life precarious, and she cannot last from morning to evening.'
example: 君须听取怕～，易生愁阻。★明·瞿佑《剪灯新话·爱卿传》
exampleTraditional: 君須聽取怕～，易生愁阻。★明·瞿佑《剪燈新話·愛卿傳》
exampleEn: You must listen, fearing that the sun will set beyond the western hills, easily giving rise to sorrow and worry. — Ming Dynasty Qu You's 'New Tales of the Trimmed Lamp: The Story of Aiqing'

explanation: 嘴唇没有了，牙齿就会感到寒冷。比喻利害密要相关。
explanationTraditional: 嘴唇沒有了，牙齒就會感到寒冷。比喻利害密要相關。
explanationEn: If the lips are gone, the teeth will feel cold; metaphor for close interdependence where one's loss harms the other.
derivation: 《左传·哀公八年》夫鲁，齐晋之唇，唇亡齿寒，君所知也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·哀公八年》夫魯，齊晉之唇，唇亡齒寒，君所知也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan', Duke Ai, Year 8: 'Lu is the lips of Qi and Jin; if the lips are gone, the teeth will feel cold—this you know.'
example: 这两家公司有着多种业务关系，正所谓是～。
exampleTraditional: 這兩家公司有著多種業務關係，正所謂是～。
exampleEn: These two companies have multiple business relationships, truly a case of 'if the lips are gone, the teeth will feel cold.'

explanation: 使国家富足，兵力强大。
explanationTraditional: 使國家富足，兵力強大。
explanationEn: To make the country wealthy and its military powerful.
derivation: 《商君书·壹言》故治国者，其专力也，以富国强兵也。”
derivationTraditional: 《商君書·壹言》故治國者，其專力也，以富國強兵也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Lord Shang: Unifying Words': 'Therefore, the ruler who governs the state focuses his efforts on enriching the country and strengthening the army.'
example: 起感恩无已，慨然以～自任。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十六回
exampleTraditional: 起感恩無已，慨然以～自任。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十六回
exampleEn: Wu Qi was deeply grateful and resolutely took it upon himself to enrich the country and strengthen the army. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 86

explanation: 格规格，标准。降低标准去寻求。
explanationTraditional: 格規格，標準。降低標準去尋求。
explanationEn: To lower one's standards in seeking something.
derivation: 鲁迅《坟·灯下漫笔》那么，到亲戚朋友那里借现钱去罢，怎么会有？于是降格以求，不讲爱国了，要外国银行的钞票。”
