derivationTraditional: 宋·葉適《水心文集·答少詹書》少詹既未能從人而捨己，又疑人之不相與，而以為外己，所以枝節橫生，意見多疑。”
derivationEn: From Ye Shi's 'Collected Works of Shuixin: Reply to Shao Zhan' of the Song Dynasty: 'Shao Zhan could neither follow others nor abandon himself, and suspected others of not being close to him, thus branches and knots grew sideways, and opinions were full of doubt.'
example: 唯其有谣言，不宜～，反引起格外的猜疑。★高阳《清宫外史》上册
exampleTraditional: 唯其有謠言，不宜～，反引起格外的猜疑。★高陽《清宮外史》上冊
exampleEn: Only because of rumors, it is not appropriate to create unexpected complications, which would cause additional suspicion. — Gao Yang, 'History of the Qing Palace', Volume 1

explanation: 用眼睛、眉毛示意。
explanationTraditional: 用眼睛、眉毛示意。
explanationEn: To wink and make facial gestures to convey a message or signal.
derivation: 元·王实甫《破窑记》第一折挤眉弄眼，伶齿俐牙，攀高接贵，顺水推船。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《破窯記》第一折擠眉弄眼，伶齒俐牙，攀高接貴，順水推船。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shifu's 'Broken Kiln' of the Yuan Dynasty, Act 1: 'Winking and making eyes, sharp-tongued and clever, climbing high and attaching to the noble, going with the flow.'
example: 不料偏又有几个滑贼看出形景来，都背后～，或是咳嗽扬声。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九回
exampleTraditional: 不料偏又有幾個滑賊看出形景來，都背後～，或是咳嗽揚聲。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九回
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, a few sly thieves saw the situation and behind their backs they winked and made eyes, or coughed loudly to signal. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 9

explanation: 象锦绣那样的前程。形容前途十分美好。
explanationTraditional: 象錦繡那樣的前程。形容前途十分美好。
explanationEn: A bright and splendid future; a future as beautiful as brocade.
derivation: 元·贾仲名《对玉梳》第四折想着咱锦片前程，十分恩爱。”
derivationTraditional: 元·賈仲名《對玉梳》第四折想著咱錦片前程，十分恩愛。”
derivationEn: From Jia Zhongming's 'Jade Comb' of the Yuan Dynasty, Act 4: 'Thinking of our brocade-like future, full of deep affection.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指父、母、妻、子等全家人。
explanationTraditional: 指父、母、妻、子等全家人。
explanationEn: One's entire family, including parents, wife, and children.
derivation: 明·梁辰鱼《浣纱记·见王》你一向远出，可速与妻儿老小相聚。”
derivationTraditional: 明·梁辰魚《浣紗記·見王》你一向遠出，可速與妻兒老小相聚。”
derivationEn: From Liang Chenyu's 'Washing Silk' of the Ming Dynasty, Scene 'Meeting the King': 'You have been away for a long time; you should quickly reunite with your wife, children, and elderly.'
example: 谁都有～的。
exampleTraditional: 誰都有～的。
exampleEn: Everyone has their own family.

explanation: 利用机会顺便给人的好处。也指不费力的人情。
explanationTraditional: 利用機會順便給人的好處。也指不費力的人情。
explanationEn: A favor done with little effort or at no cost, taking advantage of an opportunity.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第九十九回守将和军卒都受了贿赂，落得做个顺水人情。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第九十九回守將和軍卒都受了賄賂，落得做個順水人情。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' of the Ming Dynasty, Chapter 99: 'The defenders and soldiers all accepted bribes and were happy to do a favor going with the current.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容又愚笨又没有知识。
explanationTraditional: 形容又愚笨又沒有知識。
explanationEn: Ignorant and stupid; lacking knowledge and understanding.
derivation: 秦牧《天坛幻想录》想到这些，不禁令人憬然于天下本无神秘的事物，神秘只是欺骗或者愚昧无知的代名词而已。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《天壇幻想錄》想到這些，不禁令人憬然於天下本無神秘的事物，神秘只是欺騙或者愚昧無知的代名詞而已。”
derivationEn: Qin Mu's 'Fantasy of the Temple of Heaven': 'Thinking of this, one can't help but realize that there is nothing mysterious in the world; mystery is just a synonym for deception or ignorance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 疾又快又猛；暴突然而猛烈。形容风雨来势猛。比喻迅猛激烈的斗争。
explanationTraditional: 疾又快又猛；暴突然而猛烈。形容風雨來勢猛。比喻迅猛激烈的鬥爭。
explanationEn: Violent wind and rain; metaphor for a fierce and rapid struggle or situation.
derivation: 《淮南子·兵略训》何谓隐之天？大寒甚暑，疾风暴雨，大雾冥晦，因此而为变者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·兵略訓》何謂隱之天？大寒甚暑，疾風暴雨，大霧冥晦，因此而為變者也。”
derivationEn: 'Huainanzi: Military Strategy': 'What is called hidden weather? Severe cold or heat, violent wind and rain, thick fog and darkness, these are the changes that cause variations.'
example: 斧照伯当上三路，如飘泼盆倾，～，砍剁下来。★清·禇人获《隋唐演义》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 斧照伯當上三路，如飄潑盆傾，～，砍剁下來。★清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》第二十二回
exampleEn: The axe came down on Bo Dang's upper body like a pouring basin, like a violent wind and rain, chopping and slashing. — Qing Dynasty, Chu Renhuo, 'Sui and Tang Romance', Chapter 22

explanation: 看具体情况灵活办事。
explanationTraditional: 看具體情況靈活辦事。
explanationEn: To act according to the circumstances; to do as the situation dictates.
derivation: 《周易·系辞下》君子见几而作，不俟终日。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭下》君子見幾而作，不俟終日。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes: Appended Judgments': 'The superior man sees the opportunity and acts, without waiting for the end of the day.'
example: 你去～，得回再回方好。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十八回
exampleTraditional: 你去～，得回再回方好。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十八回
exampleEn: You go and act according to the circumstances; it's best to come back only after achieving something. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 98

explanation: 枳落叶灌木，味苦酸，球形。也叫枸橘。南方之橘移植淮河之北就会变成枳。比喻同一物种因环境条件不同而发生变异。
explanationTraditional: 枳落葉灌木，味苦酸，球形。也叫枸橘。南方之橘移植淮河之北就會變成枳。比喻同一物種因環境條件不同而發生變異。
explanationEn: Southern orange becomes northern trifoliate orange when transplanted; metaphor for how environment changes a thing's nature.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指人年纪虽轻，却很老练。现在也指年轻人缺乏朝气。
explanationTraditional: 原指人年紀雖輕，卻很老練。現在也指年輕人缺乏朝氣。
explanationEn: Young but mature and experienced; now also refers to young people lacking vitality.
derivation: 汉·赵岐《三辅决录·韦康》韦元将年十五，身长八尺五寸，为郡主簿。杨彪称曰‘韦主簿年虽少，有老成之风，昂昂千里之驹。’”
derivationTraditional: 漢·趙岐《三輔決錄·韋康》韋元將年十五，身長八尺五寸，為郡主簿。楊彪稱曰‘韋主簿年雖少，有老成之風，昂昂千里之駒。’”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Zhao Qi's 'Three Auxiliary Decisions: Wei Kang': 'Wei Yuanjiang, at fifteen, was eight feet five inches tall and served as a county recorder. Yang Biao praised him, saying, 'Chief Clerk Wei, though young, has the demeanor of maturity, like a noble steed.'
example: 叙话中间，说起兴哥～，这般大事，亏他独立支持。★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷一
exampleTraditional: 敘話中間，說起興哥～，這般大事，虧他獨立支持。★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷一
exampleEn: During the conversation, they mentioned that Xing Ge, though young, was mature and experienced, and managed such a big affair independently. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New', Volume 1

explanation: 关闭关口，不和外人来往。比喻因循保守，不愿接触外界事物。
explanationTraditional: 關閉關口，不和外人來往。比喻因循保守，不願接觸外界事物。
explanationEn: To close the passes and refuse to trade with outsiders; metaphor for being conservative and unwilling to interact with the outside world.
derivation: 《新编五代史平话·周史上》无事则民勤于耕稼，以广军储；有事则民习于弓矢，以莅武事。此真霸王之资也。闭关自守，又何忧乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《新編五代史平話·周史上》無事則民勤於耕稼，以廣軍儲；有事則民習於弓矢，以蒞武事。此真霸王之資也。閉關自守，又何憂乎？”
derivationEn: 'New Compilation of the History of the Five Dynasties: Pinghua of Zhou History': 'In peacetime, the people diligently farm to increase military supplies; in wartime, they practice archery to prepare for military affairs. This is truly the foundation for a hegemon or king. Closing the passes and defending oneself, what worry is there?'
example: 而且厦大也太过于～，此后还应该与他大学往还。★鲁迅《两地书》五十八
exampleTraditional: 而且廈大也太過於～，此後還應該與他大學往還。★魯迅《兩地書》五十八
exampleEn: Moreover, Xiamen University is too closed off and self-contained; it should interact with other universities in the future. — Lu Xun, 'Two Places', Letter 58

explanation: 节俭有助于养成质朴勤劳的德操。
explanationTraditional: 節儉有助於養成質樸勤勞的德操。
explanationEn: Frugality helps cultivate virtuous character.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《诫子书》夫君子之行，静以修身，俭以养德。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《誡子書》夫君子之行，靜以修身，儉以養德。”
derivationEn: Three Kingdoms, Shu Han, Zhuge Liang's 'Admonition to My Son': 'The conduct of a gentleman cultivates virtue through tranquility and frugality.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指佛教徒所遵守的规则和戒条。现比喻束缚人的繁琐不合理的规章制度。
explanationTraditional: 原指佛教徒所遵守的規則和戒條。現比喻束縛人的繁瑣不合理的規章制度。
explanationEn: Originally refers to rules and precepts observed by Buddhists; now metaphor for cumbersome and unreasonable regulations that bind people.
derivation: 《释门正统》百丈山怀海禅师始立天下禅林规式，谓之清规。”
derivationTraditional: 《釋門正統》百丈山懷海禪師始立天下禪林規式，謂之清規。”
derivationEn: 'Shimen Zhengtong': 'Zen Master Huaihai of Baizhang Mountain first established the rules for Chan monasteries, called pure regulations.'
example: 老先生～很多，学生们都很怕他。
exampleTraditional: 老先生～很多，學生們都很怕他。
exampleEn: The old gentleman has many rules and precepts, and the students are all afraid of him.

explanation: 时代变迁，世事也不一样。
explanationTraditional: 時代變遷，世事也不一樣。
explanationEn: Times change and circumstances differ.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容人高大粗壮，身材魁梧。
explanationTraditional: 形容人高大粗壯，身材魁梧。
explanationEn: Describes a person who is tall and sturdy, with a strong build.
derivation: 梁斌《播火记》猛回头，身后站着一个五大三粗的人，仔细一看是大贵。”
derivationTraditional: 梁斌《播火記》猛回頭，身後站著一個五大三粗的人，仔細一看是大貴。”
derivationEn: Liang Bin's 'Sowing the Flames': 'Turning around suddenly, there stood a tall and sturdy man behind him; looking closely, it was Da Gui.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 仗凭借，依靠。依仗某种权势欺压人。
explanationTraditional: 仗憑藉，依靠。依仗某種權勢欺壓人。
explanationEn: To bully others by relying on one's power or influence.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第五本第三折他学师友，君子务本；你倚父兄，仗势欺人。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第五本第三折他學師友，君子務本；你倚父兄，仗勢欺人。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing': 'You rely on your father and brother, bullying others by relying on your power.'
example: 许多人发展了官僚主义的作风，～，用强迫命令的方法去完成工作任务。★毛泽东《在晋绥干部会议上的讲话》
exampleTraditional: 許多人發展了官僚主義的作風，～，用強迫命令的方法去完成工作任務。★毛澤東《在晉綏幹部會議上的講話》
exampleEn: Many people have developed a bureaucratic style, bullying others by relying on their power, using coercive methods to complete work tasks. — Mao Zedong's speech at the Shanxi-Suiyuan Cadres Conference

explanation: 患难忧虑和灾难。指经受过困苦考验，能够同甘共苦的夫妻。
explanationTraditional: 患難憂慮和災難。指經受過困苦考驗，能夠同甘共苦的夫妻。
explanationEn: A couple who have endured hardships together and share weal and woe.
derivation: 唐·元稹《遣悲怀·二》情知此恨人人有，贫贱夫妻百事哀。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·元稹《遣悲懷·二》情知此恨人人有，貧賤夫妻百事哀。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Zhen's 'Two Poems of Mourning': 'Knowing that this regret is universal, a poor and humble couple suffers in every way.'
example: 只怕有了恩爱夫妻，就不要～了。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十三回
exampleTraditional: 只怕有了恩愛夫妻，就不要～了。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十三回
exampleEn: I'm afraid that once you have a loving couple, you'll forget the couple who shared hardships. — Wenkang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines'

explanation: 有话说在头里。指事先打了招呼。
explanationTraditional: 有話說在頭裡。指事先打了招呼。
explanationEn: To have said something beforehand; to have given prior notice.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二十二他有言在先，你今日不须惊怕。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二十二他有言在先，你今日不須驚怕。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World': 'He has said it beforehand, so you need not be afraid today.'
example: 况且你们已经～，又何得反悔？★清·吴趼人《痛史》第七回
exampleTraditional: 況且你們已經～，又何得反悔？★清·吳趼人《痛史》第七回
exampleEn: Moreover, you have already said it beforehand, so why go back on your word? — Wu Jianren's 'The Painful History'

explanation: 带着罪过或错误去创立功勋，以功赎罪。
explanationTraditional: 帶著罪過或錯誤去創立功勳，以功贖罪。
explanationEn: To perform meritorious service to atone for one's crimes or mistakes.
derivation: 明·王守仁《案行漳南道守巡官戴罪督兵剿贼》其覃恒等所统军，就仰高伟管领，戴罪杀贼立功自赎。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王守仁《案行漳南道守巡官戴罪督兵剿賊》其覃恆等所統軍，就仰高偉管領，戴罪殺賊立功自贖。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shouren's 'Order to Zhangnan Circuit Officials to Lead Troops to Suppress Bandits While Under Sentence': 'Let Qin Heng and his troops be led by Gao Wei, and let them kill bandits to atone for their crimes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻另择新主，另找依靠。
explanationTraditional: 比喻另擇新主，另找依靠。
explanationEn: To change one's allegiance or seek a new patron.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》九四如今长期失业在家，回英国府的希望越来越渺茫了，得早日改换门庭，另找洋主子才好。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》九四如今長期失業在家，回英國府的希望越來越渺茫了，得早日改換門庭，另找洋主子才好。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof': 'Now that he has been unemployed for a long time and the hope of returning to the British mansion is increasingly slim, he must change his allegiance and find a new foreign master.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 连盘子也端出来了。比喻全都讲出来，毫不保留。
explanationTraditional: 連盤子也端出來了。比喻全都講出來，毫不保留。
explanationEn: To reveal everything without reservation; to spill the beans.
derivation: 元·明本述《天目中峰和尚广录》卷十六今日特为你起模画样，和盘托出。”
derivationTraditional: 元·明本述《天目中峰和尚廣錄》卷十六今日特為你起模畫樣，和盤托出。”
derivationEn: From Mingben's 'Recorded Sayings of Master Zhongfeng': 'Today, I have specially drawn a model for you and revealed everything.'
example: 洋人见他们有点肯的意思了，便将芜湖道的说话～。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 洋人見他們有點肯的意思了，便將蕪湖道的說話～。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第四十四回
exampleEn: When the foreigners saw that they were somewhat willing, they revealed everything about the Wuhu Circuit Intendant's words. — Li Baojia's 'A Short History of Civilization'

explanation: 玩玩弄；焚烧。玩火的必定会烧了自己。比喻干冒险或害人的勾当，最后受害的还是自己。
explanationTraditional: 玩玩弄；焚燒。玩火的必定會燒了自己。比喻幹冒險或害人的勾當，最後受害的還是自己。
explanationEn: He who plays with fire will get burned; to engage in risky or harmful activities that ultimately harm oneself.
derivation: 《左传·隐公四年》夫兵，犹火也，弗戢，将自焚也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公四年》夫兵，猶火也，弗戢，將自焚也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan': 'War is like fire; if not restrained, it will burn oneself.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用应有的礼节接待。
explanationTraditional: 用應有的禮節接待。
explanationEn: To treat someone with due respect and courtesy.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第八十九回赵枢密留住禇坚，以礼相待。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第八十九回趙樞密留住禇堅，以禮相待。”
derivationEn: From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin': 'Commissioner Zhao detained Chu Jian and treated him with courtesy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 壮志宏大的志愿；凌云直上云霄。形容理想宏伟远大。
explanationTraditional: 壯志宏大的志願；凌雲直上雲霄。形容理想宏偉遠大。
explanationEn: To have lofty aspirations; to aim high.
derivation: 《汉书·扬雄传下》往时武帝好神仙，相如上《大人赋》，欲以风，帝反缥缥有凌云之志。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·揚雄傳下》往時武帝好神仙，相如上《大人賦》，欲以風，帝反縹縹有凌雲之志。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han': 'Emperor Wu admired immortals, and Sima Xiangru presented the 'Ode to the Great Man' to admonish him, but the emperor instead felt a soaring ambition.'
example: 这号人，在困难中不是低头叹气，而是奋发图强，～，气吞山河。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleTraditional: 這號人，在困難中不是低頭嘆氣，而是奮發圖強，～，氣吞山河。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十八章
exampleEn: Such people, in times of difficulty, do not bow their heads and sigh, but strive to be strong, with lofty aspirations that shake the mountains and rivers. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng'

explanation: 栋梁支撑房架的大梁。这里比喻责任或作用大。肩负国家重任的人。
explanationTraditional: 棟樑支撐房架的大梁。這裡比喻責任或作用大。肩負國家重任的人。
explanationEn: A pillar of the state; a person who bears the heavy responsibility of the nation.
derivation: 元·无名氏《冻苏秦》第三折真乃国家栋梁。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《凍蘇秦》第三折真乃國家棟梁。”
derivationEn: From an anonymous Yuan play 'Su Qin Freezes to Death': 'Truly a pillar of the state.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 除去前头后头两部分，也比喻除去没有用的部分。
explanationTraditional: 除去前頭後頭兩部分，也比喻除去沒有用的部分。
explanationEn: Remove the head and tail; also metaphorically refers to removing useless parts.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他引用那篇文章时，掐头去尾，断章取义，影响很坏。
exampleTraditional: 他引用那篇文章時，掐頭去尾，斷章取義，影響很壞。
exampleEn: When he quoted that article, he cut off the beginning and end, taking it out of context, which had a bad influence.

explanation: 什么都有（多指不好的事物）。
explanationTraditional: 什麼都有（多指不好的事物）。
explanationEn: Everything exists (often referring to bad things).
derivation: 唐·李朝威《柳毅传》始见台阁相向，门户千万，奇草珍木，无所不有。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李朝威《柳毅傳》始見臺閣相向，門戶千萬，奇草珍木，無所不有。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li Chaowei's 'The Story of Liu Yi': 'I saw pavilions facing each other, thousands of doors, strange grasses and precious trees, everything.'
example: 此录二十卷，天上天下，方内方外，～。★明·毛晋《酉阳杂俎后识》
exampleTraditional: 此錄二十卷，天上天下，方內方外，～。★明·毛晉《酉陽雜俎後識》
exampleEn: This record in twenty volumes covers heaven and earth, inside and outside, everything. — Ming Dynasty Mao Jin's 'Postscript to Youyang Zazu'

explanation: 跟老虎商量要它的皮。比喻跟恶人商量要他放弃自己的利益，绝对办不到。
explanationTraditional: 跟老虎商量要它的皮。比喻跟惡人商量要他放棄自己的利益，絕對辦不到。
explanationEn: Negotiate with a tiger for its skin; metaphor for trying to persuade an evil person to give up their own interests, which is impossible.
derivation: 《太平御览》卷二０八引《符子》欲为千金之裘而与狐谋其皮，欲具少牢之珍而与羊谋其羞，言未卒，狐相率逃于重丘之下，羊相呼藏于深林之中。”
derivationTraditional: 《太平御覽》卷二０八引《符子》欲為千金之裘而與狐謀其皮，欲具少牢之珍而與羊謀其羞，言未卒，狐相率逃於重丘之下，羊相呼藏於深林之中。”
derivationEn: From 'Taiping Yulan' vol. 208 quoting 'Fuzi': 'Wanting a thousand-gold fur coat and negotiating with a fox for its skin, wanting a sacrificial feast and negotiating with a sheep for its meat; before the words were finished, the foxes fled to the hills and the sheep hid in the deep forest.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 至到；渝改变。到死都不改变。
explanationTraditional: 至到；渝改變。到死都不改變。
explanationEn: Until death, never change.
derivation: 西汉·戴圣《礼记·中庸》国无道，至死不变，强哉矫！”
derivationTraditional: 西漢·戴聖《禮記·中庸》國無道，至死不變，強哉矯！”
derivationEn: From Western Han Dai Sheng's 'Book of Rites·The Doctrine of the Mean': 'When the country is without the Way, to be unyielding until death—how strong and resolute!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 道主张，思想。安于贫穷，以坚持自己的信念为乐。旧时士大夫所主张的为人处世之道。
explanationTraditional: 道主張，思想。安於貧窮，以堅持自己的信念為樂。舊時士大夫所主張的為人處世之道。
explanationEn: Be content in poverty and delight in the Way (one's principles); the old scholar-official's philosophy of life.
derivation: 《后汉书·杨彪传》安贫乐道，恬于进趣，三辅诸儒莫不慕仰之。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·楊彪傳》安貧樂道，恬於進趣，三輔諸儒莫不慕仰之。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han·Biography of Yang Biao': 'He was content in poverty and delighted in the Way, indifferent to advancement, admired by all Confucian scholars in the three regions.'
example: 劝人～是古今治国平天下的大经络，开过的方子也很多，但都没有十全大补的功效。★鲁迅《花边文学·安贫乐道法》
exampleTraditional: 勸人～是古今治國平天下的大經絡，開過的方子也很多，但都沒有十全大補的功效。★魯迅《花邊文學·安貧樂道法》
exampleEn: Advising people to be content in poverty and delight in the Way is a great principle for governing the country throughout history, and many prescriptions have been given, but none have a perfect effect. — Lu Xun's 'Hua Bian Literature·The Method of Being Content in Poverty and Delighting in the Way'

explanation: 戏剧开台前的一阵节奏急促的锣鼓。比喻公开活动前的紧张准备。
explanationTraditional: 戲劇開臺前的一陣節奏急促的鑼鼓。比喻公開活動前的緊張準備。
explanationEn: Fast-paced gongs and drums before a play starts; metaphor for intense preparations before a public activity.
derivation: 陈残云《山谷风烟》第18章如今村子上在密锣紧鼓地查什么阴谋，你走路也得当心呵，要带眼识人。”
derivationTraditional: 陳殘雲《山谷風煙》第18章如今村子上在密鑼緊鼓地查什麼陰謀，你走路也得當心呵，要帶眼識人。”
derivationEn: From Chen Canyun's 'Valley Wind and Smoke' Chapter 18: 'Now the village is investigating some conspiracy with intense preparations; you must be careful when walking and keep your eyes open.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻取得别人的信赖。
explanationTraditional: 比喻取得別人的信賴。
explanationEn: Win the trust of others.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为营救将被斩首的人而向主持或执行斩首的人发出的留人一命的紧急呼吁。
explanationTraditional: 為營救將被斬首的人而向主持或執行斬首的人發出的留人一命的緊急呼籲。
explanationEn: An urgent plea to spare the life of someone about to be executed.
derivation: 元·李文蔚《燕青捕鱼》刀下留人！哥哥息怒。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李文蔚《燕青捕魚》刀下留人！哥哥息怒。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Li Wenwei's 'Yan Qing Catches Fish': 'Spare the life under the knife! Brother, calm your anger.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 交交情，朋友。在一起经历过艰难困苦的朋友。
explanationTraditional: 交交情，朋友。在一起經歷過艱難困苦的朋友。
explanationEn: Friends who have been through hardships together.
derivation: 明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第十回浦肫夫患难之交，今日年兄为我们看他，异日我们也代年兄看他。”
derivationTraditional: 明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第十回浦肫夫患難之交，今日年兄為我們看他，異日我們也代年兄看他。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Donglu Gukuang Sheng's 'Awakening from Drunkenness' Chapter 10: 'Pu Tunfu is a friend in need; today you look after him for us, and another day we will look after him for you.'
example: 然而正感谢有这一些的打，你把铁打成了钢，把泛泛的朋友都打成了～了。★郭沫若《南京印象》十六
exampleTraditional: 然而正感謝有這一些的打，你把鐵打成了鋼，把泛泛的朋友都打成了～了。★郭沫若《南京印象》十六
exampleEn: But thanks to these beatings, you turned iron into steel, and turned casual friends into friends in need. — Guo Moruo's 'Nanjing Impressions' 16

explanation: 说话罗嗦，一说起来没个完。
explanationTraditional: 說話羅嗦，一說起來沒個完。
explanationEn: Talkative and long-winded, going on and on.
derivation: 宋·郑思肖《答吴山人问远游观地理书》古人胸中高明，一见便了……未若后世唠唠叨叨，支支离离，弃本逐末，侈为乖谬。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·鄭思肖《答吳山人問遠遊觀地理書》古人胸中高明，一見便了……未若後世嘮嘮叨叨，支支離離，棄本逐末，侈為乖謬。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zheng Sixiao's 'Reply to Wu Shanren's Question on Traveling to Observe Geography': 'The ancients had clear minds and understood at a glance... not like later generations who are long-winded, fragmented, abandoning the root for the branch, and indulging in absurdities.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把破损的罐子摔破。比喻有了缺点、错误不改正，反而有意向更坏的方向发展。
explanationTraditional: 把破損的罐子摔破。比喻有了缺點、錯誤不改正，反而有意向更壞的方向發展。
explanationEn: To smash a broken pot even further. It describes someone who, after making mistakes or having shortcomings, gives up on self-improvement and intentionally behaves worse.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 好些年来，他自轻自贱，成了习惯，破罐子破摔，不想学好了。（周立波《暴风骤雨》第二部第十七章）
exampleTraditional: 好些年來，他自輕自賤，成了習慣，破罐子破摔，不想學好了。（周立波《暴風驟雨》第二部第十七章）
exampleEn: For many years, he had been self-deprecating and formed a habit of giving up on himself, like smashing a broken pot, no longer wanting to improve. (Zhou Libo, 'The Hurricane', Part 2, Chapter 17)

explanation: 蒸上升；蔚聚集。象云霞升腾聚集起来。形容景物灿烂绚丽。
explanationTraditional: 蒸上升；蔚聚集。象雲霞升騰聚集起來。形容景物燦爛絢麗。
explanationEn: Clouds rising and mists gathering. It describes a scene of magnificent and colorful scenery.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》千岩竞秀，万壑争流。草木蒙笼其上，若云兴霞蔚。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》千巖競秀，萬壑爭流。草木蒙籠其上，若雲興霞蔚。”
derivationEn: Liu Yiqing of the Southern Dynasties, 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'A thousand cliffs compete in beauty, ten thousand streams vie in flow. The vegetation covers them like clouds rising and mists gathering.'
example: 抬头望处，已到巫山。上面阳光垂照下来，下面浓雾滚涌上去，～，颇为壮观。★刘白羽《长江三日》
exampleTraditional: 抬頭望處，已到巫山。上面陽光垂照下來，下面濃霧滾湧上去，～，頗為壯觀。★劉白羽《長江三日》
exampleEn: Looking up, we had reached Mount Wu. The sunlight shone down from above, while thick fog rolled up from below, creating a magnificent spectacle of clouds and mists. (Liu Baiyu, 'Three Days on the Yangtze River')

explanation: 形容牲畜肥壮结实。
explanationTraditional: 形容牲畜肥壯結實。
explanationEn: Describes livestock that are plump and strong.
derivation: 碧野《天山景物记》它们吃了含有乳汁的酥油草，膘肥体壮，毛色格外发亮。”
derivationTraditional: 碧野《天山景物記》它們吃了含有乳汁的酥油草，膘肥體壯，毛色格外發亮。”
derivationEn: Bi Ye, 'Scenery of the Tianshan Mountains': 'They ate the butter-rich grass, becoming plump and strong, with unusually shiny coats.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 兵力强盛，战马健壮。形容军队实力强，富有战斗力。
explanationTraditional: 兵力強盛，戰馬健壯。形容軍隊實力強，富有戰鬥力。
explanationEn: Strong soldiers and sturdy horses. Describes an army with great strength and combat effectiveness.
derivation: 《新五代史·安重荣传》尝谓人曰‘天子宁有种耶？兵强马壮者为之尔。’”
derivationTraditional: 《新五代史·安重榮傳》嘗謂人曰‘天子寧有種耶？兵強馬壯者為之爾。’”
derivationEn: 'New History of the Five Dynasties: Biography of An Zhongrong': 'He once said to others, 'Is the Son of Heaven born? Only those with strong soldiers and sturdy horses can become one.''
example: 时孔明～，粮草丰足，所用之物，一切完备，正要出师。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十七回
exampleTraditional: 時孔明～，糧草豐足，所用之物，一切完備，正要出師。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十七回
exampleEn: At that time, Kongming had strong soldiers and sturdy horses, ample provisions, and all necessary equipment, and was about to set out on an expedition. (Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 97)

explanation: 东晋王朝在江南建立后，北方士族纷纷来到江南，当时有人说过江名士多于鲫”。比喻某种时兴的事物非常多。
explanationTraditional: 東晉王朝在江南建立後，北方士族紛紛來到江南，當時有人說過江名士多於鯽”。比喻某種時興的事物非常多。
explanationEn: Like the many fish crossing the river. It refers to a large number of people or things that are fashionable or popular at a certain time.
derivation: 宋·刘克庄《竹溪生日二首》试把过江人物数，溪翁之外更谁哉。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·劉克莊《竹溪生日二首》試把過江人物數，溪翁之外更誰哉。”
derivationEn: Liu Kezhuang of the Song Dynasty, 'Two Poems for Zhu Xi's Birthday': 'Try to count the figures crossing the river; besides the old man by the stream, who else is there?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 出了很多力，吃了很多苦，立下了很大的功劳。
explanationTraditional: 出了很多力，吃了很多苦，立下了很大的功勞。
explanationEn: Having endured much hardship and performed great deeds. Describes someone who has worked hard and achieved significant merits.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》劳苦而功高如此。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》勞苦而功高如此。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'Such hardship and such great merit.'
example: 这是决战的最后五分钟了！这一班～的英雄”，手颤颤地举着胜利之杯”，心头还不免有些怔忡不定。★茅盾《子夜》十五
exampleTraditional: 這是決戰的最後五分鐘了！這一班～的英雄”，手顫顫地舉著勝利之杯”，心頭還不免有些怔忡不定。★茅盾《子夜》十五
exampleEn: This was the final five minutes of the decisive battle! These heroes who had endured hardship and achieved great merit, holding the 'cup of victory' with trembling hands, still felt a little uneasy in their hearts. (Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 15)

explanation: 牛头的鬼，蛇身的神。原形容虚幻怪诞◇比喻社会上形形色色的坏人。
explanationTraditional: 牛頭的鬼，蛇身的神。原形容虛幻怪誕◇比喻社會上形形色色的壞人。
explanationEn: Ox-headed ghosts and snake-bodied gods. Originally described something bizarre and fantastic; now refers to all kinds of evil people in society.
derivation: 唐·李贺《李贺集序》鲸吸鳌掷，牛鬼蛇神，不足为其虚荒诞幻也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李賀《李賀集序》鯨吸鰲擲，牛鬼蛇神，不足為其虛荒誕幻也。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li He, 'Preface to Li He's Collection': 'Whales sucking and alligators throwing, ox-headed ghosts and snake-bodied gods are not enough to describe its absurdity and fantasy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 先以公事为重，然后考虑私事。
explanationTraditional: 先以公事為重，然後考慮私事。
explanationEn: To put public affairs first and personal matters second.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·杜恕传》忧公忘私者必不然，但先公后私即自办也。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·杜恕傳》憂公忘私者必不然，但先公後私即自辦也。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Du Shu': 'Those who worry about public affairs and forget personal matters are certainly not common, but putting public affairs before private matters is something one can do.'
example: 卿～，可谓大忠矣。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第九十七回
exampleTraditional: 卿～，可謂大忠矣。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第九十七回
exampleEn: You put public affairs before private matters; you can be called truly loyal. (Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 97)

explanation: 拿蛋去碰石头。比喻不估计自己的力量，自取灭亡。
explanationTraditional: 拿蛋去碰石頭。比喻不估計自己的力量，自取滅亡。
explanationEn: To strike a stone with an egg. It means to overestimate one's own strength and court destruction.
derivation: 《荀子·议兵》经桀作尧，譬之若以卵投石，以指绕沸。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·議兵》經桀作堯，譬之若以卵投石，以指繞沸。”
derivationEn: 'Xunzi: On Military Affairs': 'Comparing Jie to Yao is like throwing an egg at a stone or stirring boiling water with a finger.'
example: 刘豫州不识天时，强欲与争，正如～，安得不败乎？★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: 劉豫州不識天時，強欲與爭，正如～，安得不敗乎？★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十三回
exampleEn: Liu Yuzhou does not recognize the times and insists on competing; it is like striking a stone with an egg—how can he not be defeated? (Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 43)

explanation: 案案卷，文书。指有证据可查。
explanationTraditional: 案案卷，文書。指有證據可查。
explanationEn: There are records that can be checked. It means there is evidence to verify something.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指太阳刚落山时，由于光线反射而发生的天空中短时发亮的现象。比喻人死前精神突然兴奋。也比喻事物灭亡前夕的表面兴旺。
explanationTraditional: 指太陽剛落山時，由於光線反射而發生的天空中短時發亮的現象。比喻人死前精神突然興奮。也比喻事物滅亡前夕的表面興旺。
explanationEn: A final burst of energy or activity before death or decline; a temporary revival before the end.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元·黄龙南禅师法嗣》诸禅德若能一念回光返照，到自己脚跟下，褫剥究竟，将来可谓洞门豁开，楼阁重重，十分普视，海会齐彰。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元·黃龍南禪師法嗣》諸禪德若能一念迴光返照，到自己腳跟下，褫剝究竟，將來可謂洞門豁開，樓閣重重，十分普視，海會齊彰。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting the Source': 'If all Chan practitioners can turn the light back and reflect, reaching their own heels...'
example: 所以唐末宋初，骈体文又～了一下。★朱自清《经典常谈·文第十三》
exampleTraditional: 所以唐末宋初，駢體文又～了一下。★朱自清《經典常談·文第十三》
exampleEn: Thus, at the end of Tang and beginning of Song, parallel prose experienced a temporary revival. (Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic Essays: Literature No. 13')

explanation: 单凭嘴说而没有什么作为凭据。只要用实物来证明。
explanationTraditional: 單憑嘴說而沒有什麼作為憑據。只要用實物來證明。
explanationEn: Verbal statements without evidence are unreliable; words alone are not proof.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十七回空口无凭的话，门生也不敢朝着老师来说。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十七回空口無憑的話，門生也不敢朝著老師來說。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'Officialdom Unmasked', Chapter 27: 'Words without proof, I dare not say to my teacher.'
example: 你说的这些事，～，我无法相信。
exampleTraditional: 你說的這些事，～，我無法相信。
exampleEn: These things you said are without proof; I cannot believe them.

explanation: 败衰败。干枯的树枝，衰败的花叶。形容荒凉、破坏的样子。
explanationTraditional: 敗衰敗。乾枯的樹枝，衰敗的花葉。形容荒涼、破壞的樣子。
explanationEn: Dry branches and withered leaves; describes a scene of desolation and decay.
derivation: 清·孔尚任《桃花扇·余韵》鸽翎蝠粪满堂抛，枯枝败叶当阶罩。”
derivationTraditional: 清·孔尚任《桃花扇·餘韻》鴿翎蝠糞滿堂拋，枯枝敗葉當階罩。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Kong Shangren's 'Peach Blossom Fan: Remaining Rhyme': 'Pigeon feathers and bat droppings fill the hall, dry branches and withered leaves cover the steps.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 取消已公布的命令或决定。
explanationTraditional: 取消已公佈的命令或決定。
explanationEn: To revoke an already issued order or decision.
derivation: 《诗经·周颂·昊天有成命》昊天有成命，二后受之。”清·黄宗羲《辞张郡候请修郡志书》伏望明府，哀其弗及，收回成命。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周頌·昊天有成命》昊天有成命，二後受之。”清·黃宗羲《辭張郡候請修郡志書》伏望明府，哀其弗及，收回成命。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Zhou Hymns: Heaven Has a Decree'; Qing Dynasty, Huang Zongxi's 'Declining the Prefect's Request to Compile County Records': 'I humbly hope the wise prefect, pitying my inability, will revoke the order.'
example: 初，林公遣戍，御史陈庆镛抗疏力争，请上～。★清·黄钧宰《金壶七墨·吴门秀士书》
exampleTraditional: 初，林公遣戍，御史陳慶鏞抗疏力爭，請上～。★清·黃鈞宰《金壺七墨·吳門秀士書》
exampleEn: Initially, when Lin was exiled, Imperial Censor Chen Qingyong submitted a memorial, requesting the emperor to revoke the order. (Qing Dynasty, Huang Junzai, 'Golden Pot Seven Inks: Scholar Wu's Letter')

explanation: 比喻为人方正。也形容脸色严峻。
explanationTraditional: 比喻為人方正。也形容臉色嚴峻。
explanationEn: Having edges and corners; metaphorically, being upright and principled, or having a stern expression.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 那是你的事，我没法管！”寇先生的脸板得～的说。（老舍《四世同堂·偷生》）
exampleTraditional: 那是你的事，我沒法管！”寇先生的臉板得～的說。（老舍《四世同堂·偷生》）
exampleEn: 'That's your business, I can't control it!' Mr. Kou's face was stern and angular. (Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof: Stealing Life')

explanation: 谷粮食。指粮价过低，使农民受到损害。
explanationTraditional: 谷糧食。指糧價過低，使農民受到損害。
explanationEn: Low grain prices hurt farmers; when crop prices are too low, farmers suffer losses.
derivation: 《汉书·食货志上》籴甚贵，伤民；甚贱，伤农。民伤则离散，农伤则国贫。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·食貨志上》糴甚貴，傷民；甚賤，傷農。民傷則離散，農傷則國貧。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Treatise on Food and Money, Part 1': 'If grain is very expensive, it harms the people; if very cheap, it harms farmers. Harming the people leads to dispersal, harming farmers leads to national poverty.'
example: ～”的古语成为都市间报上的时行标题。（叶圣陶《多收了三五斗》）
exampleTraditional: ～”的古語成為都市間報上的時行標題。（葉聖陶《多收了三五斗》）
exampleEn: The old saying 'low grain prices hurt farmers' became a fashionable headline in city newspapers. (Ye Shengtao, 'Harvesting Fifty More Bushels')

explanation: 横行指行动蛮横；无忌无所顾忌。指倚仗暴力，毫无顾忌地干坏事。
explanationTraditional: 橫行指行動蠻橫；無忌無所顧忌。指倚仗暴力，毫無顧忌地幹壞事。
explanationEn: To act tyrannically and without scruples; to do evil deeds with impunity.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十三回横行无忌，朝廷无人敢言。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十三回橫行無忌，朝廷無人敢言。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 13: 'He acted tyrannically without scruples, and no one in the court dared to speak.'
example: 他倚了夫家之势，又会谄媚太后，得其欢心，因便骄奢淫佚，与太平公主一样～。★清·禇人获《隋唐演义》第七十五回
exampleTraditional: 他倚了夫家之勢，又會諂媚太后，得其歡心，因便驕奢淫佚，與太平公主一樣～。★清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》第七十五回
exampleEn: Relying on her husband's power and flattering the Empress Dowager to gain favor, she became arrogant and dissolute, acting tyrannically without scruples like Princess Taiping. (Qing Dynasty, Chu Renhuo, 'Sui and Tang Romance', Chapter 75)

explanation: 贤者之间的交情，平淡如水，不尚虚华。
explanationTraditional: 賢者之間的交情，平淡如水，不尚虛華。
explanationEn: The friendship of virtuous people is as plain as water, without ostentation.
derivation: 《庄子·山木》且君子之交淡若水，小人之交甘若醴；君子淡以亲，小人甘以绝。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·山木》且君子之交淡若水，小人之交甘若醴；君子淡以親，小人甘以絕。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: Mountain Trees': 'The friendship of gentlemen is insipid as water, that of petty men is sweet as wine; gentlemen are close despite insipidity, petty men are estranged despite sweetness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 出于人们的意料之外，都没想到的。
explanationTraditional: 出於人們的意料之外，都沒想到的。
explanationEn: Beyond people's expectations; unexpected.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷一却又有转眼贫富出人意外，眼前事分毫算不得准的哩！”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷一卻又有轉眼貧富出人意外，眼前事分毫算不得準的哩！”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'First Slap the Table in Surprise', Volume 1: 'Yet there are sudden changes in wealth and poverty beyond expectations, and nothing can be predicted accurately.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 阿迎合，偏袒。刚强正直，不逢迎，无偏私。
explanationTraditional: 阿迎合，偏袒。剛強正直，不逢迎，無偏私。
explanationEn: Upright and unyielding; not flattering or biased.
derivation: 明·余继登《典故纪闻》卷十四有正大不阿，不行私谒者，便以为不贤。”
derivationTraditional: 明·餘繼登《典故紀聞》卷十四有正大不阿，不行私謁者，便以為不賢。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Yu Jideng's 'Records of Anecdotes', Volume 14: 'Those who are upright and do not engage in private visits are considered unworthy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 握手谈笑。多形容发生不和，以后又和好。
explanationTraditional: 握手談笑。多形容發生不和，以後又和好。
explanationEn: To shake hands and talk cheerfully, often used to describe reconciliation after a disagreement.
derivation: 《后汉书·李通传》及相见，共语移日，握手极欢。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·李通傳》及相見，共語移日，握手極歡。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Li Tong': 'When they met, they talked for a long time, shaking hands with great joy.'
example: 文于去年北上，与公～，闻公谆谆以国家与人民为念，以一日在职为苦。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第二八回
exampleTraditional: 文於去年北上，與公～，聞公諄諄以國家與人民為念，以一日在職為苦。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第二八回
exampleEn: Last year, Wen went north and shook hands with you in friendship, hearing that you earnestly think of the country and the people, and consider it a hardship to be in office for a single day. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 28

explanation: 什么事情都知道，没有不懂得的。
explanationTraditional: 什麼事情都知道，沒有不懂得的。
explanationEn: To know everything; omniscient.
derivation: 《列子·黄帝》圣人无所不知，无所不通，故得引而使之焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·黃帝》聖人無所不知，無所不通，故得引而使之焉。”
derivationEn: From 'Liezi: Yellow Emperor': 'The sage knows everything and understands everything, so he can lead and use them.'
example: 知之者为主，是故虽～，而有所不能行。★宋·苏轼《中庸论上》
exampleTraditional: 知之者為主，是故雖～，而有所不能行。★宋·蘇軾《中庸論上》
exampleEn: The one who knows is the master, thus although he knows everything, there are things he cannot do. — Song Dynasty, Su Shi, 'On the Doctrine of the Mean'

explanation: 求助自己比求助他人会得到更多的幸福。
explanationTraditional: 求助自己比求助他人會得到更多的幸福。
explanationEn: Seeking happiness from oneself brings more blessings than seeking from others.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·文王》无念尔祖，聿修厥德。永言配命，自求多福。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·文王》無念爾祖，聿修厥德。永言配命，自求多福。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Greater Odes: King Wen': 'Think of your ancestors, cultivate your virtue. Always match the mandate, seek much happiness from yourself.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 捉摸揣测，预料。指对人或事物无法猜测和估量。
explanationTraditional: 捉摸揣測，預料。指對人或事物無法猜測和估量。
explanationEn: Unfathomable; difficult to predict or estimate.
derivation: 明·谢肇渏《五杂俎·人部四》及一厕足，不能自返，而故为不可摸捉之言以掩之。”
derivationTraditional: 明·謝肇渏《五雜俎·人部四》及一廁足，不能自返，而故為不可摸捉之言以掩之。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Xie Zhaozhe, 'Five Assorted Offerings: Section on People': 'Once he steps in, he cannot return, so he deliberately speaks unfathomable words to cover up.'
example: 可是，这个夹肉片和那的嚼饭，都似含着一些～的秘密。★老舍《赵子曰》第十八卷
exampleTraditional: 可是，這個夾肉片和那的嚼飯，都似含著一些～的秘密。★老舍《趙子曰》第十八卷
exampleEn: But this meat slice and that chewed rice both seemed to contain some unfathomable secret. — Lao She, 'Zhao Ziyue', Chapter 18

explanation: 门户都关闭起来。形容冷清寥落。
explanationTraditional: 門戶都關閉起來。形容冷清寥落。
explanationEn: To close doors and shut windows; describes a desolate and lonely scene.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第三回风起处，惊散了那傲来国君王，三街六市，都慌得关门闭户，无人敢走。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三回風起處，驚散了那傲來國君王，三街六市，都慌得關門閉戶，無人敢走。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 3: 'When the wind arose, it startled the king of Aolai Kingdom, and all the streets and markets panicked, closing doors and shutting windows, with no one daring to go out.'
example: 家家～，镇里镇外死气沉沉。★刘流《烈火金钢》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 家家～，鎮裡鎮外死氣沉沉。★劉流《烈火金鋼》第十四回
exampleEn: Every family closed their doors and windows, and the town was dead and silent. — Liu Liu, 'Steel Fire and Gold', Chapter 14

explanation: 指闯荡江湖靠卖假药、算命等骗人谋生的人或招摇撞骗的人。
explanationTraditional: 指闖蕩江湖靠賣假藥、算命等騙人謀生的人或招搖撞騙的人。
explanationEn: A swindler who travels around selling fake medicine, fortune-telling, or engaging in fraud.
derivation: 王仲方《序》近几年来，发生了不少诈骗事件，出现了一些各式各样的骗子，其中有政治骗子、经济骗子、文化骗子和江湖骗子。”
derivationTraditional: 王仲方《序》近幾年來，發生了不少詐騙事件，出現了一些各式各樣的騙子，其中有政治騙子、經濟騙子、文化騙子和江湖騙子。”
derivationEn: From Wang Zhongfang, 'Preface': 'In recent years, many fraud incidents have occurred, and various kinds of swindlers have appeared, including political swindlers, economic swindlers, cultural swindlers, and itinerant swindlers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 坐镇指挥千里之外的战局。形容将帅雄才大略，指挥若定。
explanationTraditional: 坐鎮指揮千里之外的戰局。形容將帥雄才大略，指揮若定。
explanationEn: To decide the outcome of a battle a thousand miles away; describes a general's brilliant strategy and calm command.
derivation: 《史记·留侯世家》运筹帷帐中，决胜千里外，子房功也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·留侯世家》運籌帷帳中，決勝千里外，子房功也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: House of Marquis of Liu': 'Planning within the tent and deciding victory a thousand miles away, that is Zifang's achievement.'
example: 东夏克平，南国底定，参谋帷幄，～。★《隋书·苏威传》
exampleTraditional: 東夏克平，南國底定，參謀帷幄，～。★《隋書·蘇威傳》
exampleEn: He pacified the east and subdued the south, planning in the tent and deciding victory a thousand miles away. — 'Book of Sui: Biography of Su Wei'

explanation: 索孤单。离开集体或群众，过孤独的生活。
explanationTraditional: 索孤單。離開集體或群眾，過孤獨的生活。
explanationEn: To live apart from society or the group, leading a solitary life.
derivation: 《礼记·檀弓上》吾离群而索居，亦已久矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·檀弓上》吾離群而索居，亦已久矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Tan Gong I': 'I have left the group and lived alone for a long time.'
example: ～，日对古人，研精覃思，宁无心得，未若取径乎此之捷而适也。★清·况周颐《蕙风词话》卷一
exampleTraditional: ～，日對古人，研精覃思，寧無心得，未若取徑乎此之捷而適也。★清·況周頤《蕙風詞話》卷一
exampleEn: Living apart from society, facing the ancients daily, studying deeply and thinking carefully, one may gain insights, but it is not as quick and suitable as taking this path. — Qing Dynasty, Kuang Zhouyi, 'Huifeng's Remarks on Ci Poetry', Volume 1

explanation: 采精神。形容精神不振，提不起劲头。
explanationTraditional: 採精神。形容精神不振，提不起勁頭。
explanationEn: Listless; dispirited; lacking energy.
derivation: 清·曹雪琴《红楼梦》第八十七回贾宝玉满肚疑团，没精打采的归至怡红院中”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪琴《紅樓夢》第八十七回賈寶玉滿肚疑團，沒精打采的歸至怡紅院中”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 87: 'Jia Baoyu, full of doubts, returned listlessly to the Happy Red Court.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 是命令就服从，不敢有半点违抗。
explanationTraditional: 是命令就服從，不敢有半點違抗。
explanationEn: To obey orders without any hesitation or resistance.
derivation: 《左传·昭公十二年》今周与四国服事君王，将唯命是从，岂其爱鼎？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公十二年》今周與四國服事君王，將唯命是從，豈其愛鼎？”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Zhao's 12th Year': 'Now Zhou and the four states serve the king, obeying only your orders; how could they begrudge the tripod?'
example: 尔本贵人，故重其值，但输券之后，当～，不得韦许。★明·邵景詹《觅灯因话·姚公子传》
exampleTraditional: 爾本貴人，故重其值，但輸券之後，當～，不得韋許。★明·邵景詹《覓燈因話·姚公子傳》
exampleEn: You are a noble, so I value your worth, but after signing the deed, you must obey only my orders and not make any promises. — Ming Dynasty, Shao Jingzhan, 'Stories from the Lantern: Biography of Mr. Yao'

explanation: 冤冤仇；报报复，报应。佛家语，认为冤仇总会有报应。
explanationTraditional: 冤冤仇；報報復，報應。佛家語，認為冤仇總會有報應。
explanationEn: Buddhist concept that enmity will eventually be repaid; tit for tat.
derivation: 元·无名氏《货郎担》第四折又谁知苍天有眼，偏争他来早来迟，到今日冤冤相报，解愁眉顿作欢眉。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《貨郎擔》第四折又誰知蒼天有眼，偏爭他來早來遲，到今日冤冤相報，解愁眉頓作歡眉。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'The Peddler' (fourth act): 'Who knows heaven has eyes, it just comes early or late; today enmity is repaid, sorrow turns to joy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 弊坏事；清洁净。贪污、舞弊的事情没有了。形容坏事绝迹，社会风气良好。
explanationTraditional: 弊壞事；清潔淨。貪汙、舞弊的事情沒有了。形容壞事絕跡，社會風氣良好。
explanationEn: No corrupt practices; a clean and honest society.
derivation: 宋·周敦颐《拙赋》上安下顺，弊绝风清。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周敦頤《拙賦》上安下順，弊絕風清。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhou Dunyi's 'Essay on Clumsiness': 'Those above are peaceful, those below are obedient; corrupt practices are eliminated, the atmosphere is pure.'
example: 从前的赌痞”，现在自己在那里禁赌了，农会势盛的地方和牌一样～。★毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》
exampleTraditional: 從前的賭痞”，現在自己在那裡禁賭了，農會勢盛的地方和牌一樣～。★毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》
exampleEn: The former gamblers are now banning gambling themselves. In places where the peasant associations are powerful, gambling and cards have been completely eliminated.

explanation: 不说话，闷声不响。
explanationTraditional: 不說話，悶聲不響。
explanationEn: Not speaking a word; silent and unresponsive.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言·吴衙内邻舟赴约》秀娥一心忆着吴衙内，坐在旁边，不言不语，如醉如痴，酒也不沾一滴，箸也不动一动。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言·吳衙內鄰舟赴約》秀娥一心憶著吳衙內，坐在旁邊，不言不語，如醉如痴，酒也不沾一滴，箸也不動一動。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World': 'Xiuying, thinking only of Wu Yanei, sat beside him without speaking, silent and dazed, not touching a drop of wine or moving her chopsticks.'
example: 王中见母子说话没缝，只得起来。～，走到前厅，看见主人灵柩。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第32回
exampleTraditional: 王中見母子說話沒縫，只得起來。～，走到前廳，看見主人靈柩。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第32回
exampleEn: Seeing that mother and son had no room for conversation, Wang Zhong had to get up. Without a word, he walked to the front hall and saw his master's coffin.

explanation: 指非凡的才智和勇气。
explanationTraditional: 指非凡的才智和勇氣。
explanationEn: Extraordinary wisdom and courage.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们很佩服他在处理此事过程中所展示的大智大勇。
exampleTraditional: 我們很佩服他在處理此事過程中所展示的大智大勇。
exampleEn: We greatly admire the great wisdom and courage he displayed in handling this matter.

explanation: 形容态度卑贱低下也指工作性质卑贱低下。
explanationTraditional: 形容態度卑賤低下也指工作性質卑賤低下。
explanationEn: Humble and servile; lowly status or work.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十回我常州姓沈的，不是甚么低三下四的人家。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十回我常州姓沈的，不是甚麼低三下四的人家。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars' (Chapter 40): 'Our Shen family in Changzhou is not a lowly family.'
example: 想当初，我在城里头作艺，不肯～地侍候有势力的人，教人家打了一顿。★老舍《龙须沟》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 想當初，我在城裡頭作藝，不肯～地侍候有勢力的人，教人家打了一頓。★老舍《龍鬚溝》第一幕
exampleEn: In the old days, when I performed in the city, I refused to serve influential people in a servile manner, and I got beaten for it.

explanation: 应付对付，处置。自如按自己的心愿做事。处理事情从容不迫，很有办法。
explanationTraditional: 應付對付，處置。自如按自己的心願做事。處理事情從容不迫，很有辦法。
explanationEn: Handle with ease; deal with calmly and competently.
derivation: 茅盾《子夜》五这样才能应付自如，所向必利。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《子夜》五這樣才能應付自如，所向必利。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'Midnight' (Chapter 5): 'Only then can one handle things with ease and be invincible.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指在某一方面的学问或技术有独到的见解或独特的做法，能自成体系。
explanationTraditional: 指在某一方面的學問或技術有獨到的見解或獨特的做法，能自成體系。
explanationEn: Form one's own unique style or school in art or scholarship.
derivation: 《北史·祖莹传》作文须自出机杼，成一家风骨。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·祖瑩傳》作文須自出機杼，成一家風骨。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Zu Ying': 'Writing must come from one's own creativity, forming a unique style.'
example: 乃公之文章，则～，足以千秋不朽。★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷十二
exampleTraditional: 乃公之文章，則～，足以千秋不朽。★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷十二
exampleEn: His writings have formed a school of their own, enough to be immortal for a thousand years.

explanation: ①平平淡淡；普普通通。②指冷言嘲笑。
explanationTraditional: ①平平淡淡；普普通通。②指冷言嘲笑。
explanationEn: ① Ordinary, plain; ② Sarcastic remarks.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指封建礼教的规章制度遭到极大的破坏。
explanationTraditional: 指封建禮教的規章制度遭到極大的破壞。
explanationEn: The collapse of feudal rites and music; breakdown of traditional moral order.
derivation: 清·章炳麟《与简竹居书》中唐以来，礼崩乐坏，狂狡有作，自己制则，而事不稽古。”
derivationTraditional: 清·章炳麟《與簡竹居書》中唐以來，禮崩樂壞，狂狡有作，自己制則，而事不稽古。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Binglin's 'Letter to Jian Zhuju': 'Since the mid-Tang, rites have collapsed and music has been ruined; the arrogant have made their own rules without consulting the ancients.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 道道义；寡少。做事违反正义的人，一定得不到别人的支持和帮助。
explanationTraditional: 道道義；寡少。做事違反正義的人，一定得不到別人的支持和幫助。
explanationEn: An unjust cause finds little support.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑下》得道者多助，失道者寡助。寡助之至，亲戚畔之；多助之至，天下顺之。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑下》得道者多助，失道者寡助。寡助之至，親戚畔之；多助之至，天下順之。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'A just cause gains abundant support; an unjust cause finds little support. When support is minimal, even relatives turn against him; when support is abundant, the whole world follows.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 当抵挡。形容来势十分迅猛，不能抵挡。
explanationTraditional: 當抵擋。形容來勢十分迅猛，不能抵擋。
explanationEn: Irresistible; describing a force that is so powerful it cannot be stopped.
derivation: 《晋书·郗鉴传》群逆纵逸，其势不可当，可以算屈，难以力竞。”明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百十九回山上数处精兵杀下，势不可当，前军大败。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·郗鑑傳》群逆縱逸，其勢不可當，可以算屈，難以力競。”明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百十九回山上數處精兵殺下，勢不可當，前軍大敗。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Xi Jian': 'The rebels are rampant, their momentum is irresistible; they can be outwitted but not easily defeated by force.' Also in Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 119: 'Elite troops from the mountain attacked with irresistible force, causing the front army to suffer a great defeat.'
example: 擒兵捉将，～。★清·吴璿《飞龙全传》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 擒兵捉將，～。★清·吳璿《飛龍全傳》第十一回
exampleEn: Capturing soldiers and generals, irresistible. — Qing Dynasty Wu Quan's 'The Complete Legend of Feilong' Chapter 11

explanation: 指通过文字来结交朋友。
explanationTraditional: 指通過文字來結交朋友。
explanationEn: To make friends through literary or scholarly pursuits.
derivation: 《论语·颜渊》君子以文会友，以友辅人。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·顏淵》君子以文會友，以友輔人。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius: Yan Yuan': 'The gentleman makes friends through culture, and uses friends to cultivate virtue.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①上下一贯。②从上到下，从头到脚。③形容陡直。
explanationTraditional: ①上下一貫。②從上到下，從頭到腳。③形容陡直。
explanationEn: ① Consistent from top to bottom. ② From head to toe. ③ Steep and vertical.
derivation: 《朱子全书》卷四凡事都分做两边，是底放一边，非底放一边。是底是天理，非底是人欲。是即守而勿失，非即去而不留此治一身之法也。治一家则分别一家之是非，治一邑则分别一邑之邪正，推而一州一路以至天下，莫不皆然此～之道。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子全書》卷四凡事都分做兩邊，是底放一邊，非底放一邊。是底是天理，非底是人慾。是即守而勿失，非即去而不留此治一身之法也。治一家則分別一家之是非，治一邑則分別一邑之邪正，推而一州一路以至天下，莫不皆然此～之道。”
derivationEn: From 'Complete Works of Zhu Xi' Volume 4: 'Everything is divided into two sides... this is the way of being consistent from top to bottom.'
example: ②明·施耐庵《水浒传》第六十七回官道旁边，只见走过一条大汉，直上直下相李逵。”③这楼梯～，不好走。
exampleTraditional: ②明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第六十七回官道旁邊，只見走過一條大漢，直上直下相李逵。”③這樓梯～，不好走。
exampleEn: ② Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 67: 'On the official road, a big man appeared and looked Li Kui up and down.' ③ 'This staircase is steep and hard to climb.'

explanation: 九五指帝位。旧指帝王的尊位。
explanationTraditional: 九五指帝位。舊指帝王的尊位。
explanationEn: The imperial throne; the supreme position of an emperor.
derivation: 《周易·乾》九五，飞龙在天，利见大人。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·乾》九五，飛龍在天，利見大人。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Qian': 'Nine in the fifth place: the flying dragon is in the sky; it is advantageous to see the great man.'
example: 接成汤之胤，位～，承帝王之统。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: 接成湯之胤，位～，承帝王之統。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第六十三回
exampleEn: Succeeding the lineage of Cheng Tang, occupying the imperial throne, inheriting the rule of the emperor. — Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 63

explanation: 睡不好觉，吃不好饭。十分忧虑担心的样子。
explanationTraditional: 睡不好覺，吃不好飯。十分憂慮擔心的樣子。
explanationEn: Unable to sleep or eat properly; extremely worried and anxious.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策五》秦王恐之，寝不安席，食不甘味。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策五》秦王恐之，寢不安席，食不甘味。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Qi V': 'The King of Qin was terrified, unable to sleep peacefully or eat with appetite.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指形成自己独特的风格。
explanationTraditional: 指形成自己獨特的風格。
explanationEn: To form one's own unique style.
derivation: 清·赵翼《瓯北诗话·白香山诗》香山于古诗律诗中，又多创体，自成一格。”
derivationTraditional: 清·趙翼《甌北詩話·白香山詩》香山於古詩律詩中，又多創體，自成一格。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhao Yi's 'Oubei Poetry Talks: Bai Xiangshan's Poems': 'Xiangshan created many new forms in ancient and regulated poetry, forming his own style.'
example: 自然，各人的做法不尽同……办得各有特色，～。★《新华日报》1943.3.5
exampleTraditional: 自然，各人的做法不盡同……辦得各有特色，～。★《新華日報》1943.3.5
exampleEn: Naturally, each person's approach is different... each has its own characteristics and forms its own style. — 'Xinhua Daily' March 5, 1943

explanation: 布安排，开展。清除旧的，建立新的。以新的代替旧的。
explanationTraditional: 布安排，開展。清除舊的，建立新的。以新的代替舊的。
explanationEn: To remove the old and establish the new; to replace the old with the new.
derivation: 《左传·昭公十七年》彗，所以除旧布新也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公十七年》彗，所以除舊佈新也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Zhao's Seventeenth Year': 'Comets are used to remove the old and establish the new.'
example: ～识君意，烂烂一星光射人。★清·黄遵宪《西乡星歌》
exampleTraditional: ～識君意，爛爛一星光射人。★清·黃遵憲《西鄉星歌》
exampleEn: Knowing your intention to remove the old and establish the new, a brilliant star shines upon people. — Qing Dynasty Huang Zunxian's 'Song of the Western Star'

explanation: 惜、怜爱怜；玉、香比喻女子。比喻男子对所爱女子的照顾体贴。
explanationTraditional: 惜、憐愛憐；玉、香比喻女子。比喻男子對所愛女子的照顧體貼。
explanationEn: To show tenderness and care towards women (literally 'pity the fragrance, cherish the jade').
derivation: 元·尚仲贤《柳毅传书》第四折相逢没话说，不见却思量，全不肯惜玉怜香，则他那古敝性尚然强。”
derivationTraditional: 元·尚仲賢《柳毅傳書》第四折相逢沒話說，不見卻思量，全不肯惜玉憐香，則他那古敝性尚然強。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Shang Zhongxian's 'The Story of Liu Yi Delivering the Letter' Act 4: 'Meeting without words, missing when apart, utterly unwilling to cherish jade and pity fragrance, his old stubborn nature still strong.'
example: 想着他酒席儿上～。★明·刘兑《金童玉女娇红记》
exampleTraditional: 想著他酒席兒上～。★明·劉兌《金童玉女嬌紅記》
exampleEn: Thinking of him at the banquet, showing tenderness and care towards women. — Ming Dynasty Liu Dui's 'The Story of Jin Tong and Yu Nu'

explanation: 三个人谎报城市里有老虎，听的人就信以为真。比喻说的人多了，就能使人们把谣言当事实。
explanationTraditional: 三個人謊報城市裡有老虎，聽的人就信以為真。比喻說的人多了，就能使人們把謠言當事實。
explanationEn: Three people spreading a rumor about a tiger can make people believe it; repeated rumors can make people accept falsehood as truth.
derivation: 《战国策·魏策二》夫市之无虎明矣，然而三人言而成虎。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·魏策二》夫市之無虎明矣，然而三人言而成虎。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Wei II': 'It is clear there is no tiger in the market, but three people speaking of one create a tiger.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 团结一致，共同努力。
explanationTraditional: 團結一致，共同努力。
explanationEn: To unite and work together with one heart and one mind.
derivation: 《书·泰誓中》予有乱臣十人，同心同德。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·泰誓中》予有亂臣十人，同心同德。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Great Declaration of Tai Shi': 'I have ten capable ministers who are of one heart and one virtue.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻暗中改变事物的真相，以达到蒙混欺骗的目的。
explanationTraditional: 比喻暗中改變事物的真相，以達到矇混欺騙的目的。
explanationEn: To secretly change the truth of things in order to deceive or cheat.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十三回且说尹子崇自从做了这一番偷天换日的大事业，等到银子到手，便把原有的股东一齐写信去招呼。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十三回且說尹子崇自從做了這一番偷天換日的大事業，等到銀子到手，便把原有的股東一齊寫信去招呼。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene': 'Yin Zichong, after pulling off this great feat of stealing the sky and changing the sun, once he got the money, he wrote letters to all the original shareholders.'
example: 他所玩弄的～的鬼把戏，早被大家识破了。
exampleTraditional: 他所玩弄的～的鬼把戲，早被大家識破了。
exampleEn: The trick of stealing the sky and changing the sun that he played was long seen through by everyone.

explanation: 鹬蚌相争，渔翁得利”的省语。比喻双方相持不下，而使第三者从中得利。
explanationTraditional: 鷸蚌相爭，漁翁得利”的省語。比喻雙方相持不下，而使第三者從中得利。
explanationEn: A shortened form of 'When the snipe and the clam grapple, the fisherman profits.' It means that when two parties are locked in a stalemate, a third party benefits.
derivation: 清·湘灵子《轩亭冤·哭墓》波翻血海全球悯，问谁敢野蛮法律骂强秦？笑他鹬蚌相争演出风云阵。”
derivationTraditional: 清·湘靈子《軒亭冤·哭墓》波翻血海全球憫，問誰敢野蠻法律罵強秦？笑他鷸蚌相爭演出風雲陣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Xiang Lingzi's 'The Grave of Xuanting': 'Waves of blood and seas of sorrow move the world; who dares to curse the strong Qin with barbaric laws? Laugh at the snipe and clam fighting, creating a storm of clouds.'
example: 肃清日寇吾侪事，～笑列侯。★朱德《和董必武同志七绝》之三
exampleTraditional: 肅清日寇吾儕事，～笑列侯。★朱德《和董必武同志七絕》之三
exampleEn: Eliminating the Japanese invaders is our task; the snipe and clam fight makes the princes laugh. — Zhu De's poem 'Reply to Comrade Dong Biwu' (third of seven)

explanation: 振振理直气壮的样子。形容自以为理由充分，说个没完。
explanationTraditional: 振振理直氣壯的樣子。形容自以為理由充分，說個沒完。
explanationEn: To speak confidently and endlessly, believing one's reasons are sound.
derivation: 清·梁启超《关税权问题》今者外人之以排外相诬者，既振振有词，其乌可更为无谋之举，以授之口实也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·梁啟超《關稅權問題》今者外人之以排外相誣者，既振振有詞，其烏可更為無謀之舉，以授之口實也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao's 'On Tariff Rights': 'Now that foreigners accuse us of xenophobia with such confidence, how can we take unwise actions that give them a pretext?'
example: 小顺儿的妈的北平话，遇到理直气壮～的时候，是词汇丰富，而语调清脆，象清夜的叙子似的。★老舍《四世同堂》八
exampleTraditional: 小順兒的媽的北平話，遇到理直氣壯～的時候，是詞彙豐富，而語調清脆，象清夜的敘子似的。★老舍《四世同堂》八
exampleEn: When Little Shun'er's mother spoke Beijing dialect with confidence and eloquence, her words were rich and her tone crisp, like a storyteller's clapper on a clear night. — Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof' (Chapter 8)

explanation: 戴加在头上或用头顶着。不愿和仇敌在一个天底下并存。形容仇恨极深。
explanationTraditional: 戴加在頭上或用頭頂著。不願和仇敵在一個天底下並存。形容仇恨極深。
explanationEn: Unwilling to coexist under the same sky with an enemy; describes extreme hatred.
derivation: 《礼记·曲礼上》父之仇，弗与共戴天。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·曲禮上》父之仇，弗與共戴天。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: Qu Li I': 'The enemy of one's father, one should not live under the same sky with him.'
example: 这亘古未有的壮举，像一柄锋利的匕首，直刺～的死敌。”★齐怀《刑场上的婚礼》
exampleTraditional: 這亙古未有的壯舉，像一柄鋒利的匕首，直刺～的死敵。”★齊懷《刑場上的婚禮》
exampleEn: This unprecedented feat, like a sharp dagger, stabbed straight at the mortal enemy with whom we cannot share the same sky. — Qi Huai's 'Wedding on the Execution Ground'

explanation: 封建时代官吏出门时，前面开路的人敲锣喝令行人让路。比喻为某种事物的出现，制造声势，开辟道路。
explanationTraditional: 封建時代官吏出門時，前面開路的人敲鑼喝令行人讓路。比喻為某種事物的出現，製造聲勢，開闢道路。
explanationEn: In feudal times, officials had people beat gongs and clear the way ahead. Now it means to create a stir and pave the way for something.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《糊涂世界》卷六时而作一得意想，便仿佛坐在四人大轿里，鸣锣开道的去接印一般。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《糊塗世界》卷六時而作一得意想，便彷彿坐在四人大轎裡，鳴鑼開道的去接印一般。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'The World of Confusion' (Volume 6): 'Sometimes, when he thought of success, he felt as if he were sitting in a sedan chair carried by four men, with gongs beating to clear the way as he went to take office.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 炯炯明亮的样子。两眼明亮有神。
explanationTraditional: 炯炯明亮的樣子。兩眼明亮有神。
explanationEn: Eyes bright and full of spirit.
derivation: 清·叶廷琯《鸥陂渔话·葛苍公传》先达葛苍公讳麟，号瞿庵，性敏多才，状奇伟，目光炯炯有英气，胆力过人。”
derivationTraditional: 清·葉廷琯《鷗陂漁話·葛蒼公傳》先達葛蒼公諱麟，號瞿庵，性敏多才，狀奇偉，目光炯炯有英氣，膽力過人。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ye Tingguan's 'Oubei Yuhua: Biography of Ge Cang': 'The late scholar Ge Cang, styled Lin, was intelligent and talented, with a strange and majestic appearance, eyes bright and spirited, and extraordinary courage.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 非常杰出的才智和谋略。
explanationTraditional: 非常傑出的才智和謀略。
explanationEn: Outstanding talent and great strategic vision.
derivation: 《汉书·武帝纪赞》如武帝之雄才大略，不改文、景之恭俭以济斯民，虽《诗》、《书》所称，何有加焉？”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·武帝紀贊》如武帝之雄才大略，不改文、景之恭儉以濟斯民，雖《詩》、《書》所稱，何有加焉？”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Emperor Wu': 'Emperor Wu's great talent and bold strategy, combined with the frugality and reverence of Emperors Wen and Jing to benefit the people, surpasses even what the 'Book of Songs' and 'Book of Documents' praise.'
example: 汉武帝～，命卫青、霍去病两员大将分路出兵，直扫匈奴巢穴，千古第一快事。★清·陈天华《狮子吼》第二回
exampleTraditional: 漢武帝～，命衛青、霍去病兩員大將分路出兵，直掃匈奴巢穴，千古第一快事。★清·陳天華《獅子吼》第二回
exampleEn: Emperor Wu of Han, with his great talent and bold strategy, ordered Generals Wei Qing and Huo Qubing to attack the Xiongnu's lair from different routes, a truly unprecedented feat. — Qing Dynasty Chen Tianhua's 'Lion's Roar' (Chapter 2)

explanation: 言语是思想的反映，从一个人的话里可以知道他的思想感情。
explanationTraditional: 言語是思想的反映，從一個人的話裡可以知道他的思想感情。
explanationEn: Speech is the reflection of thought; one can know a person's thoughts from their words.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·问神》故言，心声也；书，心画也。声画形，君子小人见矣。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·問神》故言，心聲也；書，心畫也。聲畫形，君子小人見矣。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Yang Xiong's 'Fa Yan: Asking the Spirit': 'Thus, speech is the voice of the heart; writing is the picture of the heart. When the voice and picture are formed, the gentleman and the petty person are revealed.'
example: ～，从一个人平时的言谈之中，就可以了解他的思想状况。
exampleTraditional: ～，從一個人平時的言談之中，就可以瞭解他的思想狀況。
exampleEn: Speech is the voice of the heart; from a person's daily conversation, one can understand their state of mind.

explanation: 指不洁净，肮脏。也指因忌讳而感觉不洁净。也可形容语文不文明。
explanationTraditional: 指不潔淨，骯髒。也指因忌諱而感覺不潔淨。也可形容語文不文明。
explanationEn: Unclean, dirty; also refers to feeling unclean due to taboo; can also describe indecent language.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十六回不干不净，也不知道毛病儿，买了来三日两日，又弄鬼掉猴的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十六回不乾不淨，也不知道毛病兒，買了來三日兩日，又弄鬼掉猴的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (Chapter 46): 'Unclean and dirty, I don't know what's wrong with it; if you buy it, in a few days it will be up to mischief again.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 羽毛比喻人的声望。比喻为珍惜自己的名声，行事十分谨慎。
explanationTraditional: 羽毛比喻人的聲望。比喻為珍惜自己的名聲，行事十分謹慎。
explanationEn: To cherish one's reputation and act with great caution.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·杂言》夫君子爱口，孔雀爱羽，虎豹爱爪，此皆所以治身法也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·雜言》夫君子愛口，孔雀愛羽，虎豹愛爪，此皆所以治身法也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Liu Xiang's 'Shuo Yuan: Za Yan': 'The gentleman cherishes his mouth, the peacock cherishes its feathers, the tiger and leopard cherish their claws—these are all ways to cultivate oneself.'
example: 灰鹤与他都是高傲的，～的，而他与它们的高傲只是一种姿态而已，没有用，没有任何的用。★老舍《四世同堂》五十
exampleTraditional: 灰鶴與他都是高傲的，～的，而他與它們的高傲只是一種姿態而已，沒有用，沒有任何的用。★老舍《四世同堂》五十
exampleEn: The cranes and he were both proud and cherished their feathers, but their pride was merely a pose, useless and without any effect. — Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof' (Chapter 50)

explanation: 暮傍晚。佛教规矩，寺里晚上打鼓，晚上敲钟。比喻可以使人警觉醒悟的话。
explanationTraditional: 暮傍晚。佛教規矩，寺裡晚上打鼓，晚上敲鐘。比喻可以使人警覺醒悟的話。
explanationEn: Words that can alert and awaken people, like the morning bell and evening drum in a temple.
derivation: 唐·李咸用《山中》诗朝钟暮鼓不到耳，明月孤云长挂情。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李鹹用《山中》詩朝鐘暮鼓不到耳，明月孤雲長掛情。”
derivationEn: From Li Xianyong's poem 'In the Mountains' of Tang Dynasty: 'The morning bell and evening drum do not reach the ear; the bright moon and lonely cloud always hang in the heart.'
example: 但见丹霞翠壁远近映楼阁，～杳霭罗幡幢。★宋·欧阳修《庐山高》诗
exampleTraditional: 但見丹霞翠壁遠近映樓閣，～杳靄羅幡幢。★宋·歐陽修《廬山高》詩
exampleEn: But see the red clouds and green cliffs reflecting the pavilions far and near, the morning bell and evening drum in the misty veil of banners. (Ouyang Xiu's poem 'The Height of Lushan')

explanation: 过去说过的，现在又提起了。
explanationTraditional: 過去說過的，現在又提起了。
explanationEn: To bring up a past topic again.
derivation: 柯岩《寻找回来的世界》迟威他们不再决定调吴家驹时就抛这个材料，现在都旧话重提，原因何在呢？”
derivationTraditional: 柯巖《尋找回來的世界》遲威他們不再決定調吳家駒時就拋這個材料，現在都舊話重提，原因何在呢？”
derivationEn: From Ke Yan's 'The Returned World': 'Chi Wei and others decided not to use this material when transferring Wu Jiaju, but now they are bringing up the old topic again. What is the reason?'
example: 我不想～。
exampleTraditional: 我不想～。
exampleEn: I don't want to bring up old topics again.

explanation: 修长。茂密高大的树林竹林。
explanationTraditional: 修長。茂密高大的樹林竹林。
explanationEn: Dense forests and tall bamboos.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《兰亭集序》此地有崇山峻岭，茂林修竹。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《蘭亭集序》此地有崇山峻嶺，茂林修竹。”
derivationEn: From Wang Xizhi's 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection' of Jin Dynasty: 'This place has high mountains and lofty ridges, dense forests and tall bamboos.'
example: 刚过了小桥曲水，又见些～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十二回
exampleTraditional: 剛過了小橋曲水，又見些～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十二回
exampleEn: Just passed the small bridge and winding stream, and saw dense forests and tall bamboos. (Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 72)

explanation: 倾倾覆；城国。原指因女色而亡国◇多形容妇女容貌极美。
explanationTraditional: 傾傾覆；城國。原指因女色而亡國◇多形容婦女容貌極美。
explanationEn: Extremely beautiful; originally referred to a woman whose beauty could cause the downfall of a city or state.
derivation: 《诗·大雅·瞻卬》哲夫成城，哲妇倾城。”《汉书·外戚传》北方有佳人，绝世而独立，一顾倾人城，再顾倾人国。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·大雅·瞻卬》哲夫成城，哲婦傾城。”《漢書·外戚傳》北方有佳人，絕世而獨立，一顧傾人城，再顧傾人國。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs·Daya·Zhanyang': 'A wise man builds a city, a wise woman overthrows it.' And 'Book of Han·Biography of Consort Families': 'In the north there is a beauty, peerless and independent; one glance overthrows a city, another glance overthrows a state.'
example: 一个太真妃～。★元·白朴《梧桐雨》第一折
exampleTraditional: 一個太真妃～。★元·白樸《梧桐雨》第一折
exampleEn: A Taizhen consort, beautiful enough to overthrow cities and states. (Bai Pu's 'Wutong Rain', Act 1)

explanation: 像花和玉那样美好。形容女子姿容出众。
explanationTraditional: 像花和玉那樣美好。形容女子姿容出眾。
explanationEn: As beautiful as flowers and jade; describes a woman's outstanding appearance.
derivation: 《诗·魏风·汾沮洳》彼其之子，美如英……彼其之子，美如玉。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·魏風·汾沮洳》彼其之子，美如英……彼其之子，美如玉。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs·Wei Feng·Fen Juru': 'That man, beautiful as a flower... That man, beautiful as jade.'
example: 假如不幸我庄周死后，你这般～的年纪，难道捱得过三年五载？★明·冯梦龙《警世通言·庄子休鼓盆成大道》
exampleTraditional: 假如不幸我莊周死後，你這般～的年紀，難道捱得過三年五載？★明·馮夢龍《警世通言·莊子休鼓盆成大道》
exampleEn: If unfortunately I, Zhuang Zhou, die, can you, at such a young and beautiful age, endure for three or five years? (Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World')

explanation: 时时机。时机错过就不会再来了。指行事不要放过时机。
explanationTraditional: 時時機。時機錯過就不會再來了。指行事不要放過時機。
explanationEn: Opportunity will not come again; one should not miss the chance.
derivation: 《国语·越语下》得时无怠，时不再来，天予不取，反为之灾。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·越語下》得時無怠，時不再來，天予不取，反為之災。”
derivationEn: From 'Guoyu·Yueyu Part 2': 'When you have the opportunity, do not be idle; opportunity will not come again. If heaven gives and you do not take, it will turn into disaster.'
example: 事机一失，～，惟望宸断。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第七回
exampleTraditional: 事機一失，～，惟望宸斷。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第七回
exampleEn: Once the opportunity is lost, it will not come again. I only hope for the emperor's decision. (Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 7)

explanation: 因用以指思想保守的人。
explanationTraditional: 因用以指思想保守的人。
explanationEn: A person with conservative ideas, like a woman with bound feet.
derivation: 毛泽东《关于农业合作化问题》一我们的某些同志却象一个小脚女人，东摇西摆地在那里走路，老是埋怨旁人说走快了，走快了。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《關於農業合作化問題》一我們的某些同志卻象一個小腳女人，東搖西擺地在那裡走路，老是埋怨旁人說走快了，走快了。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'On the Question of Agricultural Cooperation': 'Some of our comrades are like women with bound feet, swaying as they walk, always complaining that others are walking too fast.'
example: ［高金海］大肆吹嘘自己，并且暗暗讽刺刘秋果是～，老牛破车。★刘绍棠《田野落霞》一
exampleTraditional: ［高金海］大肆吹噓自己，並且暗暗諷刺劉秋果是～，老牛破車。★劉紹棠《田野落霞》一
exampleEn: Gao Jinhai boasted about himself and secretly satirized Liu Qiuguo as a 'woman with bound feet' and an old ox pulling a broken cart. (Liu Shaotang's 'Sunset in the Fields', Chapter 1)

explanation: 在一百步远以外射中杨柳的叶子。形容箭法或枪法十分高明。
explanationTraditional: 在一百步遠以外射中楊柳的葉子。形容箭法或槍法十分高明。
explanationEn: To shoot an arrow through a willow leaf from a hundred paces away; describes excellent archery or marksmanship.
derivation: 《史记·周本纪》楚有养由基者，善射者也，去柳叶百步而射之，百发而百中之。”《战国策·西周策》楚有养由基者，善射；去柳叶百步而射之，百发百中。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·周本紀》楚有養由基者，善射者也，去柳葉百步而射之，百發而百中之。”《戰國策·西周策》楚有養由基者，善射；去柳葉百步而射之，百發百中。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian·Zhou Benji': 'In Chu, there was Yang Youji, skilled in archery; he shot willow leaves from a hundred paces away, hitting every time.' And 'Strategies of the Warring States·Western Zhou Strategy': 'In Chu, there was Yang Youji, skilled in archery; he shot willow leaves from a hundred paces away, hitting every time.'
example: （关羽）带箭回寨，方知黄忠有百步穿杨之能。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十三回
exampleTraditional: （關羽）帶箭回寨，方知黃忠有百步穿楊之能。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十三回
exampleEn: Guan Yu returned to his camp with an arrow, realizing that Huang Zhong had the skill of shooting a willow leaf from a hundred paces. (Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 53)

explanation: 百多次；解理解。百般思索也无法理解。
explanationTraditional: 百多次；解理解。百般思索也無法理解。
explanationEn: To be unable to understand despite thinking a hundred times; to be puzzled.
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷十三此真百思不得其故矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷十三此真百思不得其故矣。”
derivationEn: From Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage' of Qing Dynasty, Volume 13: 'This is truly something that cannot be understood after a hundred thoughts.'
example: ～，五夜踌蹰，故乘隙邀君一面，以决中疑。★清·无名氏《葛仙翁全传》
exampleTraditional: ～，五夜躊躕，故乘隙邀君一面，以決中疑。★清·無名氏《葛仙翁全傳》
exampleEn: Unable to understand after a hundred thoughts, and hesitating for five nights, I took the opportunity to invite you for a meeting to resolve my doubts. (Anonymous 'Complete Biography of Ge Xianweng' of Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 踌躇迟疑不决的样子。犹豫不决，不敢前进。
explanationTraditional: 躊躇遲疑不決的樣子。猶豫不決，不敢前進。
explanationEn: To hesitate and not dare to advance.
derivation: 东汉·班固《汉书·孝武李夫人传》哀裴回以踌躇。”
derivationTraditional: 東漢·班固《漢書·孝武李夫人傳》哀裴回以躊躇。”
derivationEn: From Ban Gu's 'Book of Han·Biography of Lady Li Xiaowu' of Eastern Han: 'Sorrowfully lingering and hesitating.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 苞花苞；欲将要；放开放。形容花将开而未开时的样子。
explanationTraditional: 苞花苞；欲將要；放開放。形容花將開而未開時的樣子。
explanationEn: Describing a flower that is about to bloom but has not yet opened; figuratively, a young girl just reaching puberty.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 卜占卜，打卦，古人用火灼龟甲，看灼开的裂纹推测未来的吉凶祸富。没有占卜便能事先知道。形容有预见。
explanationTraditional: 卜占卜，打卦，古人用火灼龜甲，看灼開的裂紋推測未來的吉凶禍富。沒有占卜便能事先知道。形容有預見。
explanationEn: To know beforehand without divination; having foresight or prescience.
derivation: 元·无名氏《桃花女》第三折卖弄杀《周易》阴阳谁似你，还有个未卜先知意。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《桃花女》第三折賣弄殺《周易》陰陽誰似你，還有個未卜先知意。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'The Peach Blossom Girl', third act: 'You boast of the Yin and Yang of the Book of Changes, but there is also the meaning of knowing without divination.'
example: 有这等事，真个～！★明·许恒《二奇缘传奇》二
exampleTraditional: 有這等事，真個～！★明·許恆《二奇緣傳奇》二
exampleEn: Such a thing! Truly knowing without divination! — Ming Dynasty Xu Heng, 'The Tale of Two Marvels', chapter 2

explanation: 五毒多指蛇、蝎、蜈蚣、壁虎、蟾蜍五种动物。指违法乱纪，各种坏事都做。
explanationTraditional: 五毒多指蛇、蠍、蜈蚣、壁虎、蟾蜍五種動物。指違法亂紀，各種壞事都做。
explanationEn: Refers to all kinds of evils or vices; engaging in all sorts of illegal and immoral activities.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 咫古代长度单位，周制八寸，合今市尺六寸二分二厘；咫尺比喻距离很近。比喻距离虽近，但很难相见，象是远在天边一样。
explanationTraditional: 咫古代長度單位，周制八寸，合今市尺六寸二分二釐；咫尺比喻距離很近。比喻距離雖近，但很難相見，象是遠在天邊一樣。
explanationEn: Although physically close, it feels as far as the horizon; unable to meet despite being near.
derivation: 《左传·僖公九年》天威不违颜咫尺。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公九年》天威不違顏咫尺。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan', Duke Xi's 9th year: 'The majesty of Heaven is not far from one's face, though it is but a foot away.'
example: 左右如今也不容相近，～一般，有甚舍不得处？★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》第二十二卷
exampleTraditional: 左右如今也不容相近，～一般，有甚捨不得處？★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》第二十二卷
exampleEn: Now we are not allowed to be close, like a foot away yet a world apart. What is there to be reluctant about? — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New', Volume 22

explanation: 满面整个面部。形容心情舒畅，精神健旺的样子。
explanationTraditional: 滿面整個面部。形容心情舒暢，精神健旺的樣子。
explanationEn: One's face glowing with health and happiness; radiant with joy and vitality.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他满面红光，看样子精神很好。
exampleTraditional: 他滿面紅光，看樣子精神很好。
exampleEn: His face was glowing, and he seemed to be in high spirits.

explanation: 排挤、清除和自己意见不同或不属于自己集团派系的人。
explanationTraditional: 排擠、清除和自己意見不同或不屬於自己集團派系的人。
explanationEn: To exclude or eliminate those who hold different opinions or belong to different factions.
derivation: 《晋书·殷顗传》顗见江绩亦以正直为仲堪所斥，知仲堪当逐异己，树置所亲。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·殷顗傳》顗見江績亦以正直為仲堪所斥，知仲堪當逐異己，樹置所親。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin', Biography of Yin Yi: 'Yin Yi saw that Jiang Ji was also expelled by Zhongkan for his integrity, and knew that Zhongkan would drive away dissidents and install his own favorites.'
example: 明年诸葛恪被杀后，孙峻、孙林兄弟相继专权，更加残暴，～，淫污宫廷。（吕振羽《简明中国通史》第十章）
exampleTraditional: 明年諸葛恪被殺後，孫峻、孫林兄弟相繼專權，更加殘暴，～，淫汙宮廷。（呂振羽《簡明中國通史》第十章）
exampleEn: The following year, after Zhuge Ke was killed, Sun Jun and his brother Sun Lin successively monopolized power, becoming even more brutal, eliminating dissidents and defiling the palace. — Lü Zhenyu, 'A Concise History of China', Chapter 10

explanation: 四方天下。有远大的抱负和理想。
explanationTraditional: 四方天下。有遠大的抱負和理想。
explanationEn: To have lofty ambitions and aspirations; to aim for the four corners of the world.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第二十五回妾闻‘男子志在四方’。君壮年不出图仕，乃区区守妻子坐困乎？”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第二十五回妾聞‘男子志在四方’。君壯年不出圖仕，乃區區守妻子坐困乎？”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 25: 'I have heard that a man's ambition lies in the four corners. Why do you, in your prime, not go out to seek office, but instead stay home with your wife and children?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 安置家庭，创立基业或事业。也指长期在一个地方劳动和生活。
explanationTraditional: 安置家庭，創立基業或事業。也指長期在一個地方勞動和生活。
explanationEn: To settle down and establish a career; to start a family and build a livelihood.
derivation: 染斌《红旗谱》第一卷你们父子帮助我安家立业，我一辈子也忘不了。”
derivationTraditional: 染斌《紅旗譜》第一卷你們父子幫助我安家立業，我一輩子也忘不了。”
derivationEn: From Liang Bin, 'The Story of the Red Flag', Volume 1: 'You father and son helped me settle down and establish a career; I will never forget it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 垂帘太后或皇后临朝听政，殿上用帘子遮隔。听治理。指太后临朝管理国家政事。
explanationTraditional: 垂簾太后或皇后臨朝聽政，殿上用簾子遮隔。聽治理。指太后臨朝管理國家政事。
explanationEn: To hold court from behind a screen (said of an empress dowager or queen regent); to rule in place of a child emperor.
derivation: 《旧唐书·高宗纪下》时帝风疹不能听朝，政事皆决于天后。自诛上官仪后，上每视朝，天后垂帘于御座后，政事大小皆预闻之，内外称为二圣。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·高宗紀下》時帝風疹不能聽朝，政事皆決於天后。自誅上官儀後，上每視朝，天后垂簾於御座後，政事大小皆預聞之，內外稱為二聖。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang', Annals of Emperor Gaozong, Part 2: 'At that time, the emperor suffered from wind rash and could not hold court; all political affairs were decided by the Empress. After executing Shangguan Yi, whenever the emperor held court, the Empress would sit behind a screen, and all matters, great or small, were heard, and they were called the Two Sages.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 揽把持。一个人把持着权力，独断专行。
explanationTraditional: 攬把持。一個人把持著權力，獨斷專行。
explanationEn: To monopolize power; to arrogate all authority to oneself.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容走得非常快，好象脚尖都未着地。同脚不点地”。
explanationTraditional: 形容走得非常快，好象腳尖都未著地。同腳不點地”。
explanationEn: Describes walking very fast, as if one's toes never touch the ground.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十回那李嬷嬷脚不沾地，跟着凤姐儿走了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十回那李嬤嬤腳不沾地，跟著鳳姐兒走了。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 20: 'That old nurse Li, without her feet touching the ground, followed Xifeng away.'
example: 近几天来，他都是～，身不沾家的。他忙着对各种各样的人解释这样，说明那样。★周立波《暴风骤雨》第一部十
exampleTraditional: 近幾天來，他都是～，身不沾家的。他忙著對各種各樣的人解釋這樣，說明那樣。★周立波《暴風驟雨》第一部十
exampleEn: In recent days, he has been constantly on the move, never at home. He is busy explaining this and that to all kinds of people. ★ Zhou Libo, 'The Hurricane', Part 1, Chapter 10

explanation: 一定的规律或规则。比喻已打定的主意。
explanationTraditional: 一定的規律或規則。比喻已打定的主意。
explanationEn: A fixed rule or pattern. Metaphorically refers to a predetermined plan.
derivation: 郭小川《新路歌》历史的发展，有它新陈代谢的一定之规。”
derivationTraditional: 郭小川《新路歌》歷史的發展，有它新陳代謝的一定之規。”
derivationEn: Guo Xiaochuan, 'Song of New Roads': 'The development of history has its own fixed rules of metabolism.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 逸安闲；劳疲劳。指在战争中做好充分准备，养精蓄锐，等疲乏的敌人来犯时给以迎头痛击。
explanationTraditional: 逸安閒；勞疲勞。指在戰爭中做好充分準備，養精蓄銳，等疲乏的敵人來犯時給以迎頭痛擊。
explanationEn: To wait at ease for the exhausted enemy; to conserve one's strength and strike when the enemy is fatigued.
derivation: 《孙子·军争》以近待远，以佚待劳，以饱待饥，此治力者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·軍爭》以近待遠，以佚待勞，以飽待飢，此治力者也。”
derivationEn: 'The Art of War' by Sun Tzu, 'Military Combat': 'Approach the enemy from near, wait for them from afar; wait rested for the weary, wait well-fed for the hungry—this is the method of managing strength.'
example: 他踞了碉楼，～，我们倒难以刻期取胜。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: 他踞了碉樓，～，我們倒難以刻期取勝。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十三回
exampleEn: He occupied the watchtower, waiting at ease for the exhausted enemy, making it difficult for us to win quickly. ★ Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 43

explanation: 指睡眠尚未清醒。
explanationTraditional: 指睡眠尚未清醒。
explanationEn: Half asleep, half awake; not fully conscious.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 说来说去，我究竟在半梦半醒之间，做了些甚么呢？★倪匡《卖命·半梦半醒》
exampleTraditional: 說來說去，我究竟在半夢半醒之間，做了些甚麼呢？★倪匡《賣命·半夢半醒》
exampleEn: After all, what did I do in that half-dreaming, half-awake state? ★ Ni Kuang, 'Selling Life: Half Dream, Half Awake'

explanation: 后生年轻人，后辈；畏敬畏。年轻人是可敬畏的。形容青年人能超过前辈。
explanationTraditional: 後生年輕人，後輩；畏敬畏。年輕人是可敬畏的。形容青年人能超過前輩。
explanationEn: The younger generation is formidable; they may surpass their elders.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》后生可畏，焉知来者之不如今也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》後生可畏，焉知來者之不如今也。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects of Confucius', 'Zihan': 'The young are to be regarded with awe; how do we know that the future will not be as good as the present?'
example: ～，非虚言也。★宋·朱熹《寄陈同甫书》十二
exampleTraditional: ～，非虛言也。★宋·朱熹《寄陳同甫書》十二
exampleEn: 'The younger generation is formidable' is not an empty saying. ★ Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, 'Letter to Chen Tongfu', 12

explanation: 自若自然，不变常态。神情态度仍和原来一样。
explanationTraditional: 自若自然，不變常態。神情態度仍和原來一樣。
explanationEn: To remain calm and composed; one's expression unchanged.
derivation: 马南邨《燕山夜话·编一套特技”丛书吧》举出最普通的例子来说，当你随便走进一家澡堂的时候，你就会发现有些老工人，能够在滚开的热水中拧手巾，神情自若，并不烫手。”
derivationTraditional: 馬南邨《燕山夜話·編一套特技”叢書吧》舉出最普通的例子來說，當你隨便走進一家澡堂的時候，你就會發現有些老工人，能夠在滾開的熱水中擰手巾，神情自若，並不燙手。”
derivationEn: Ma Nancun, 'Yanshan Night Talks: Compiling a Series of 'Special Skills' Books': 'Take the most common example: when you casually walk into a bathhouse, you will find some old workers who can wring towels in boiling hot water, looking completely calm and not burned.'
example: 周培公～地瞟了一眼王辅臣，带着轻蔑的微笑开口了。★二月河《康熙大帝》第二卷第四十四章
exampleTraditional: 周培公～地瞟了一眼王輔臣，帶著輕蔑的微笑開口了。★二月河《康熙大帝》第二卷第四十四章
exampleEn: Zhou Peigong glanced at Wang Fuchen with a composed expression and spoke with a slight smile of contempt. ★ Eryue He, 'Emperor Kangxi', Volume 2, Chapter 44

explanation: 旧指做事残忍，灭绝人性，为天理所不容。
explanationTraditional: 舊指做事殘忍，滅絕人性，為天理所不容。
explanationEn: Heaven's principles cannot tolerate such cruelty; describes an act so heinous it is unforgivable.
derivation: 元·无名氏《朱砂担》第四折才见得冤冤相报，方信道天理难容。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《硃砂擔》第四折才見得冤冤相報，方信道天理難容。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Cinnabar Burden', Act 4: 'Only then do we see retribution for wrongs, and realize that heaven's principles are hard to tolerate.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 夸夸赞。自己卖的东西自己夸好。比喻为自己吹嘘。
explanationTraditional: 誇誇贊。自己賣的東西自己誇好。比喻為自己吹噓。
explanationEn: To praise the goods one sells; metaphorically, to boast about oneself.
derivation: 杨啸《大字报》这是我出的大字报呵！那不成了老王卖瓜，自卖自夸了吗？”
derivationTraditional: 楊嘯《大字報》這是我出的大字報呵！那不成了老王賣瓜，自賣自誇了嗎？”
derivationEn: Yang Xiao, 'Big Character Poster': 'This is my big character poster! Isn't that like an old Wang selling melons, praising his own wares?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 白费劲，没有一点用处。
explanationTraditional: 白費勁，沒有一點用處。
explanationEn: To make a futile effort; to be of no use.
derivation: 清·林则徐《查勘矿厂情形试行开采折》倘实系硐产全枯，徒劳无益，则名是实非之厂。”
derivationTraditional: 清·林則徐《查勘礦廠情形試行開採折》倘實系硐產全枯，徒勞無益，則名是實非之廠。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Lin Zexu, 'Memorial on Inspecting Mining Conditions and Trial Mining': 'If the mine is truly exhausted, then it is a futile effort with no benefit, and the mine is in name only.'
example: 做事要讲效益，～的事不要去做。
exampleTraditional: 做事要講效益，～的事不要去做。
exampleEn: Work should be efficient; doing things that are futile and useless should be avoided.

explanation: 籁从孔穴中发出的声音；万籁自然界中万物发出的各种声响；寂静。形容周围环境非常安静，一点儿声响都没有。
explanationTraditional: 籟從孔穴中發出的聲音；萬籟自然界中萬物發出的各種聲響；寂靜。形容周圍環境非常安靜，一點兒聲響都沒有。
explanationEn: All sounds are still; complete silence.
derivation: 唐·常建《题破山寺后禅院》诗万赖此俱寂，唯闻钟磬音。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·常建《題破山寺後禪院》詩萬賴此俱寂，唯聞鐘磬音。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Chang Jian, 'Inscribed on the Rear Zen Temple of Poshan': 'All sounds are still here, only the sound of bells and chimes is heard.'
example: 这时～，只听到滴搭的钟声和可以微闻得到的母亲的呼吸。★邹韬奋《我的母亲》
exampleTraditional: 這時～，只聽到滴搭的鐘聲和可以微聞得到的母親的呼吸。★鄒韜奮《我的母親》
exampleEn: At that moment, all was silent, only the ticking of the clock and the faint breathing of my mother could be heard. ★ Zou Taofen, 'My Mother'

explanation: 怎能忍心。即内心不忍。
explanationTraditional: 怎能忍心。即內心不忍。
explanationEn: How can one bear to do it? It means one's heart cannot endure it.
derivation: 明·王世桢《鸣凤记》第十六出若如此，杨公命尽此刻矣！我和你不惟不能救，且监斩他，于心何忍。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王世楨《鳴鳳記》第十六出若如此，楊公命盡此刻矣！我和你不惟不能救，且監斬他，於心何忍。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wang Shizhen's 'Ming Feng Ji', Act 16: 'If so, Yang Gong's life ends at this moment! You and I not only cannot save him, but also supervise his execution. How can our hearts bear it?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 彻明白；悟领会。形容彻底醒悟。
explanationTraditional: 徹明白；悟領會。形容徹底醒悟。
explanationEn: Thorough understanding and complete awakening. Describes a total realization.
derivation: 元·郑德辉《伊尹耕莘》楔子盖凡升天之时，先参贫道，授与仙诀，大彻大悟后，方得升九天朝真而观元始。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭德輝《伊尹耕莘》楔子蓋凡昇天之時，先參貧道，授與仙訣，大徹大悟後，方得升九天朝真而觀元始。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zheng Dehui's 'Yi Yin Geng Xin', prologue: 'Generally, when ascending to heaven, one first visits me, receives immortal secrets, and after great awakening, can ascend to the nine heavens to pay homage to the primordial.'
example: 这一回，得看你是不是～，决心离开下流社会，迈步走进上流社会了。★欧阳山《苦斗》四三
exampleTraditional: 這一回，得看你是不是～，決心離開下流社會，邁步走進上流社會了。★歐陽山《苦鬥》四三
exampleEn: This time, it depends on whether you can thoroughly awaken, resolve to leave the lower-class society, and step into the upper-class society. (Ouyang Shan, 'Struggle', 43)

explanation: 邯郸战国时赵国的都城；学步学习走路。比喻模仿人不到家，反把原来自己会的东西忘了。
explanationTraditional: 邯鄲戰國時趙國的都城；學步學習走路。比喻模仿人不到家，反把原來自己會的東西忘了。
explanationEn: To imitate others slavishly and lose one's own originality.
derivation: 《庄子·秋水》且子独不闻夫寿陵余子之学行于邯郸与？未得国能，又失其故行矣，直匍匐而归耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·秋水》且子獨不聞夫壽陵餘子之學行於邯鄲與？未得國能，又失其故行矣，直匍匐而歸耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Autumn Floods': 'Have you not heard of the young man of Shouling who went to Handan to learn how to walk? He not only failed to acquire the skill of the Handan people, but also forgot his original way of walking, so he had to crawl back.'
example: 半臂添寒尚书醉，屏后金钗楚楚，齐俯首～。（清·梁绍任《两般秋雨庵随笔》卷一）
exampleTraditional: 半臂添寒尚書醉，屏後金釵楚楚，齊俯首～。（清·梁紹任《兩般秋雨庵隨筆》卷一）
exampleEn: Half-armed adding cold, the minister is drunk; behind the screen, golden hairpins bow, all imitating Handan walking. (Qing Dynasty Liang Shaoren, 'Two Baskets of Autumn Rain Essays', Volume 1)

explanation: 指工艺技术高明的人。
explanationTraditional: 指工藝技術高明的人。
