exampleTraditional: 否則怎樣，他卻沒有說。但這是～”的，否則，就不給。★魯迅《華蓋集續編·記發薪”》
exampleEn: Otherwise, what would happen, he did not say. But this was 'as clear as looking at a fire' - if not, he wouldn't give it. - Lu Xun's 'Huagai Collection Continued: On Paying Salary'

explanation: 雌雄比喻胜负、高下。决一胜负，比个高下。
explanationTraditional: 雌雄比喻勝負、高下。決一勝負，比個高下。
explanationEn: Decide which is male and which is female. To fight it out and determine the winner.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》愿与汉王挑战，决雌雄。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》願與漢王挑戰，決雌雄。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian, Biography of Xiang Yu': 'I wish to challenge the King of Han to a duel to decide who is the victor.'
example: 吾自历战数十场，不意今日狼狈至此！此天丧吾也！汝等各回本州，誓与曹贼～。（明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三十一回）
exampleTraditional: 吾自歷戰數十場，不意今日狼狽至此！此天喪吾也！汝等各回本州，誓與曹賊～。（明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三十一回）
exampleEn: I have fought dozens of battles, but never expected to be in such a predicament today! Heaven is destroying me! Each of you return to your own province, and I swear to fight it out with that Cao thief. - Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 31

explanation: 形容人风度潇洒，秀美多姿。亦作临风玉树”。
explanationTraditional: 形容人風度瀟灑，秀美多姿。亦作臨風玉樹”。
explanationEn: Describes a person with elegant and graceful demeanor, handsome and charming.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比肩并肩。肩并肩地站立。比喻彼此距离极近。
explanationTraditional: 比肩並肩。肩並肩地站立。比喻彼此距離極近。
explanationEn: Stand shoulder to shoulder; metaphorically means very close to each other.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策三》寡人闻之，千里而一士，是比肩而立；百世而一圣，若随踵而至。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策三》寡人聞之，千里而一士，是比肩而立；百世而一聖，若隨踵而至。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States·Qi Strategy III': 'I have heard that a scholar in a thousand miles is like standing shoulder to shoulder; a sage in a hundred generations is like following heel to heel.'
example: 虽使间世而生，何异～！★宋·陈亮《贺周丞相启》
exampleTraditional: 雖使間世而生，何異～！★宋·陳亮《賀周丞相啟》
exampleEn: Even if they are born in different generations, how is it different from standing shoulder to shoulder? ★ Song Dynasty, Chen Liang, 'Congratulations to Prime Minister Zhou'

explanation: 机灵聪明，办事能力强。
explanationTraditional: 機靈聰明，辦事能力強。
explanationEn: Intelligent and capable, with strong ability to handle affairs.
derivation: 《新唐书·苏弁传》弁通学术，吏事精明，承延龄后，平赋缓役，略烦苛，人赖其宽。”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·蘇弁傳》弁通學術，吏事精明，承延齡後，平賦緩役，略煩苛，人賴其寬。”
derivationEn: From 'New Book of Tang·Biography of Su Bian': 'Su Bian was versed in learning, shrewd in official affairs, following Yan Ling, he equalized taxes and eased corvée, simplifying burdens, and people relied on his leniency.'
example: 承辉这个人，甚是～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一百六回
exampleTraditional: 承輝這個人，甚是～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一百六回
exampleEn: This person Chenghui is very intelligent and capable. ★ Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Situations Observed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 106

explanation: 形容心境平静，毫无杂念。
explanationTraditional: 形容心境平靜，毫無雜念。
explanationEn: Describes a calm mind without any distracting thoughts.
derivation: 唐·白居易《祭李侍郎文》浩浩世途，是非同轨；齿牙相轧，波澜四起。公独何人，心如止水；风雨如晦，鸡鸣不已。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《祭李侍郎文》浩浩世途，是非同軌；齒牙相軋，波瀾四起。公獨何人，心如止水；風雨如晦，雞鳴不已。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Bai Juyi, 'Sacrificial Essay for Minister Li': 'The vast worldly path, right and wrong on the same track; teeth grind each other, waves rise everywhere. Who is that man? His heart is like still water; wind and rain darken, the rooster crows unceasingly.'
example: 屡遭情变之后，她已然～，古井无波。
exampleTraditional: 屢遭情變之後，她已然～，古井無波。
exampleEn: After repeated romantic setbacks, she has become calm as still water, without any ripples.

explanation: 息呼吸，气息；尚还。还有一口气。指生命的最后阶段。
explanationTraditional: 息呼吸，氣息；尚還。還有一口氣。指生命的最後階段。
explanationEn: Still have a breath left; refers to the last stage of life.
derivation: 《论语·泰伯》死而后已，不亦远乎！”朱熹注一息尚存，此志不容少懈，可谓远矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·泰伯》死而後已，不亦遠乎！”朱熹注一息尚存，此志不容少懈，可謂遠矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Analects·Taibo': 'Only with death does it stop. Is it not far?' Zhu Xi's annotation: 'As long as there is a breath left, this ambition cannot be slackened even a little. It can be said to be far.'
example: 我下定决心，象陈毅同志病中表现的那样，～，努力不懈！★张茜《陈毅诗词选集·序言》
exampleTraditional: 我下定決心，象陳毅同志病中表現的那樣，～，努力不懈！★張茜《陳毅詩詞選集·序言》
exampleEn: I am determined, like Comrade Chen Yi's performance in illness, as long as there is a breath left, I will work tirelessly! ★ Zhang Qian, 'Preface to Selected Poems of Chen Yi'

explanation: 指天气由阴暗转为明朗。常用以比喻怨愤、疑虑得以消除。
explanationTraditional: 指天氣由陰暗轉為明朗。常用以比喻怨憤、疑慮得以消除。
explanationEn: Refers to weather turning from dark to bright; often used metaphorically for the dissipation of resentment or doubt.
derivation: 宋·陶佃《王君仪》诗云开雾散却晴霁，清风淅淅无纤尘。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陶佃《王君儀》詩云開霧散卻晴霽，清風淅淅無纖塵。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Tao Dian, 'Poem for Wang Junyi': 'Clouds open and mist disperses, then it clears; a gentle breeze blows without a speck of dust.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 珍贵重的；奇特殊的。珍奇的飞禽，罕见的走兽。
explanationTraditional: 珍貴重的；奇特殊的。珍奇的飛禽，罕見的走獸。
explanationEn: Precious birds and rare animals.
derivation: 《尚书·旅獒》犬马非其土性不畜，珍禽奇兽不育于国。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·旅獒》犬馬非其土性不畜，珍禽奇獸不育於國。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents·Tribute of Lu': 'Dogs and horses not native to the land are not raised; precious birds and strange animals are not bred in the country.'
example: 灯作伞形，六角间有圆者，镂人物花卉，～。★清·王韬《瀛壖杂志》
exampleTraditional: 燈作傘形，六角間有圓者，鏤人物花卉，～。★清·王韜《瀛壖雜誌》
exampleEn: The lanterns are umbrella-shaped, hexagonal with round ones, carved with figures, flowers, and precious birds and strange animals. ★ Qing Dynasty, Wang Tao, 'Miscellaneous Records of Yinghuan'

explanation: 用木棒打散一双鸳鸯。比喻拆散恩爱的夫妻或情侣。
explanationTraditional: 用木棒打散一雙鴛鴦。比喻拆散恩愛的夫妻或情侶。
explanationEn: Beat a pair of mandarin ducks with a stick; metaphorically means to break up a loving couple or lovers.
derivation: 明·孟称舜《鹦鹉墓贞文记》他一双儿女两情坚，休得棒打鸳鸯作话传。”
derivationTraditional: 明·孟稱舜《鸚鵡墓貞文記》他一雙兒女兩情堅，休得棒打鴛鴦作話傳。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Meng Chengshun, 'Parrot Tomb·Chaste Story': 'Their love is strong, do not beat the mandarin ducks apart.'
example: 啼痕界破残妆面，德言分镜几时圆？远水高山，眼睁睁～散。★明·李开先《宝剑记》第十九出
exampleTraditional: 啼痕界破殘妝面，德言分鏡幾時圓？遠水高山，眼睜睜～散。★明·李開先《寶劍記》第十九出
exampleEn: Tears mark the ruined makeup face, when will the mirror be reunited? Distant mountains and waters, watching helplessly as the mandarin ducks are beaten apart. ★ Ming Dynasty, Li Kaixian, 'Story of the Sword', Act 19

explanation: 某些才智出众的人，看来好象愚笨，不露锋芒。
explanationTraditional: 某些才智出眾的人，看來好象愚笨，不露鋒芒。
explanationEn: Some people of great talent appear foolish, not showing their sharpness.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《贺欧阳少师致仕启》大勇若怯，大智如愚。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《賀歐陽少師致仕啟》大勇若怯，大智如愚。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Su Shi, 'Congratulations on the Retirement of Ouyang Xiu': 'Great courage seems cowardly, great wisdom seems foolish.'
example: 执雌守黑，不敢自遂，～，于是乎在。★章炳麟《箴新党论》
exampleTraditional: 執雌守黑，不敢自遂，～，於是乎在。★章炳麟《箴新黨論》
exampleEn: Holding the feminine and keeping dark, not daring to assert oneself, great wisdom seems foolish, thus it is. ★ Zhang Binglin, 'Admonishing the New Party'

explanation: 指四方、到处、各地、普天下或方向；亦指到处飘泊，行踪不定。
explanationTraditional: 指四方、到處、各地、普天下或方向；亦指到處飄泊，行蹤不定。
explanationEn: Refers to all directions, everywhere, various places, the whole world, or direction; also means drifting around with no fixed whereabouts.
derivation: 《左传·襄公二十九年》东西南北，谁敢安处。”《礼记·檀弓上》今丘（孔子）也，东西南北之人也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公二十九年》東西南北，誰敢安處。”《禮記·檀弓上》今丘（孔子）也，東西南北之人也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan·Twenty-ninth Year of Duke Xiang': 'East, west, south, north, who dares to settle down?' From 'Book of Rites·Tan Gong I': 'Now Qiu (Confucius) is a man of east, west, south, north.'
example: 后以奔走四方，～，驰驱少暇。★清·黄遵宪《人境庐诗草自序》
exampleTraditional: 後以奔走四方，～，馳驅少暇。★清·黃遵憲《人境廬詩草自序》
exampleEn: Later, rushing around, east, west, south, north, with little leisure. ★ Qing Dynasty, Huang Zunxian, 'Preface to Poems from the Hut of Human Realm'

explanation: 形容壮丽华美的祖国山河。
explanationTraditional: 形容壯麗華美的祖國山河。
explanationEn: Describes the magnificent and beautiful landscape of one's motherland.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《清明二首（其二）》秦城楼阁烟花里，汉主山河锦绣中。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《清明二首（其二）》秦城樓閣煙花裡，漢主山河錦繡中。”
derivationEn: Du Fu's poem 'Two Poems of Qingming (Part 2)': 'In the mist of Qin city's towers, the Han emperor's mountains and rivers are amidst brocade.'
example: ～收拾好，万民尽作主人翁。★朱德《寄南征诸将》诗
exampleTraditional: ～收拾好，萬民盡作主人翁。★朱德《寄南征諸將》詩
exampleEn: The splendid rivers and mountains are well managed, and all people become masters. — Zhu De's poem 'To the Generals on the Southern Expedition'

explanation: 猜猜疑。男女小时候在一起玩耍，没有猜疑。
explanationTraditional: 猜猜疑。男女小時候在一起玩耍，沒有猜疑。
explanationEn: Describes a boy and a girl who grew up together and have no suspicions between them.
derivation: 唐·李白《长干行》诗同居长干里，两小无嫌猜。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《長幹行》詩同居長幹裡，兩小無嫌猜。”
derivationEn: Li Bai's poem 'Song of Changgan': 'We lived together in Changgan Lane, two children without suspicion.'
example: 翁有女，小字江城，与生同甲，时皆八、九岁，～，日共嬉戏。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·江城》
exampleTraditional: 翁有女，小字江城，與生同甲，時皆八、九歲，～，日共嬉戲。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·江城》
exampleEn: The old man had a daughter, named Jiangcheng, who was the same age as the boy, both eight or nine years old. They were innocent playmates and played together every day. — Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Jiangcheng'

explanation: 泛指旧时鼓吹的道德规范。
explanationTraditional: 泛指舊時鼓吹的道德規範。
explanationEn: Refers to the moral norms advocated in old times, such as benevolence, righteousness, and morality.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《原道》后之人，其欲闻仁义道德之说，孰从而听之。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《原道》後之人，其欲聞仁義道德之說，孰從而聽之。”
derivationEn: Han Yu's 'On the Way': 'Later people, who want to hear about benevolence, righteousness, and morality, from whom can they listen?'
example: 你说凡是一口～的人，都是些伪君子，真是一点也不错。★郭沫若《屈原》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 你說凡是一口～的人，都是些偽君子，真是一點也不錯。★郭沫若《屈原》第二幕
exampleEn: You say that anyone who talks about benevolence, righteousness, and morality is a hypocrite, and that is absolutely correct. — Guo Moruo's 'Qu Yuan', Act 2

explanation: 洋洋盛大、众多的样子；洒洒明白、流畅的样子。形容文章或谈话丰富明快，连续不断。
explanationTraditional: 洋洋盛大、眾多的樣子；灑灑明白、流暢的樣子。形容文章或談話豐富明快，連續不斷。
explanationEn: Describes a speech or article that is rich, fluent, and continuous.
derivation: 邹韬奋《抗战以来·来宾”的建议》局面询问也用不着洋洋洒洒的大文章。”
derivationTraditional: 鄒韜奮《抗戰以來·來賓”的建議》局面詢問也用不著洋洋灑灑的大文章。”
derivationEn: Zou Taofen's 'Since the War of Resistance: The 'Guest' Suggestion': 'There is no need for lengthy articles when asking about the situation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 金风指秋天的风。古时以阴阳五行解释季节，秋为金。秋风带来了凉意。
explanationTraditional: 金風指秋天的風。古時以陰陽五行解釋季節，秋為金。秋風帶來了涼意。
explanationEn: The autumn wind brings coolness. 'Golden wind' refers to autumn wind, as in ancient Chinese philosophy autumn corresponds to the element metal.
derivation: 鲁迅《述香港恭祝圣诞》金风送爽，凉露惊秋。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《述香港恭祝聖誕》金風送爽，涼露驚秋。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'Reporting on the Celebration of Christmas in Hong Kong': 'The golden wind brings coolness, the cold dew startles autumn.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指文艺作品中环境的描写、气氛的渲染跟人物思想感情的抒发结合得很紧密。
explanationTraditional: 指文藝作品中環境的描寫、氣氛的渲染跟人物思想感情的抒發結合得很緊密。
explanationEn: Refers to the close integration of environmental description and atmosphere rendering with the expression of characters' thoughts and feelings in literary works.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 好的诗篇必然是情景交融，理在其中。
exampleTraditional: 好的詩篇必然是情景交融，理在其中。
exampleEn: Good poems are inevitably a fusion of feeling and setting, with reason embedded within.

explanation: 仇敌相逢在窄路上。指仇人或不愿意见面的人偏偏相遇。
explanationTraditional: 仇敵相逢在窄路上。指仇人或不願意見面的人偏偏相遇。
explanationEn: Enemies meet on a narrow path. Refers to people who are enemies or unwilling to see each other meeting by chance.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷三十真是冤家路窄，今日一命讨了一命。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷三十真是冤家路窄，今日一命討了一命。”
derivationEn: Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 30': 'Truly, enemies meet on a narrow path; today one life pays for another.'
example: 却不防～，倒被阳伯偷看了去。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 卻不防～，倒被陽伯偷看了去。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十二回
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, enemies meet on a narrow path, and Yang Bo secretly saw it. — Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sin', Chapter 22

explanation: 等着米来下锅烧饭。比喻生活困难，缺少钱用。
explanationTraditional: 等著米來下鍋燒飯。比喻生活困難，缺少錢用。
explanationEn: Waiting for rice to cook. Describes a difficult life with a shortage of money.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十九回我在这衙门内已经三代了，外头也有些体面，家里还过得，就规规矩矩伺候本官升了还能够，不象那些等米下锅的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十九回我在這衙門內已經三代了，外頭也有些體面，家裡還過得，就規規矩矩伺候本官升了還能夠，不象那些等米下鍋的。”
derivationEn: Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 99: 'I have been in this yamen for three generations, and I have some dignity outside. My family is still well-off, so I can serve the magistrate properly. I am not like those who wait for rice to cook.'
example: 岂但不肯多出钱，照时值估价，还要少几两，分明知道我～，要杀我的巧。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 豈但不肯多出錢，照時值估價，還要少幾兩，分明知道我～，要殺我的巧。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十六回
exampleEn: Not only would he not pay more, but he also deducted a few taels from the market price. He clearly knew that I was waiting for rice to cook and wanted to take advantage of me. — Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 16

explanation: 格打；格杀打死；勿论不论罪。指把拒捕、行凶或违反禁令的人当场打死而不以杀人论罪。
explanationTraditional: 格打；格殺打死；勿論不論罪。指把拒捕、行兇或違反禁令的人當場打死而不以殺人論罪。
explanationEn: To kill on the spot without being charged with murder. Refers to the immediate execution of those who resist arrest, commit violent acts, or violate prohibitions.
derivation: 《后汉书·刘盆子传》诸卿皆老傭也。今日设君臣之礼，反更殽乱，儿戏尚不如此，皆可格杀。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·劉盆子傳》諸卿皆老傭也。今日設君臣之禮，反更殽亂，兒戲尚不如此，皆可格殺。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Liu Penzi': 'You are all old servants. Today we establish the rites of ruler and subject, but you are even more disorderly. Even children's games are not like this. You may all be killed.'
example: 如有白拒捕等事，～。★《负曝闲谈》第三回
exampleTraditional: 如有白拒捕等事，～。★《負曝閒談》第三回
exampleEn: If there is resistance or violent acts, they shall be killed on the spot without mercy. — 'Exposure of Officialdom', Chapter 3

explanation: 莫逆没有抵触，感情融洽；交交往，友谊。指非常要好的朋友。
explanationTraditional: 莫逆沒有牴觸，感情融洽；交交往，友誼。指非常要好的朋友。
explanationEn: A very close and intimate friendship. 'Mo ni' means no conflict, harmonious feelings.
derivation: 《庄子·大宗师》四人相视而笑，莫逆于心，遂相与为友。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·大宗師》四人相視而笑，莫逆於心，遂相與為友。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: The Great Ancestral Teacher': 'The four men looked at each other and smiled, feeling no conflict in their hearts, so they became friends.'
example: 少与崔浩为～。★《北史·眭夸传》
exampleTraditional: 少與崔浩為～。★《北史·眭誇傳》
exampleEn: In his youth, he became a close friend of Cui Hao. — 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Sui Kua'

explanation: 释放下；卷指书籍。书本不离手。形容勤奋好学。
explanationTraditional: 釋放下；卷指書籍。書本不離手。形容勤奮好學。
explanationEn: Always have a book in hand; describes someone who is diligent and fond of learning.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·吕蒙传》注引《江表传》光武当兵马之务，手不释卷。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·呂蒙傳》注引《江表傳》光武當兵馬之務，手不釋卷。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Book of Wu, Biography of Lü Meng' quoting 'Anecdotes of the Yangtze River': 'Emperor Guangwu, even amidst military affairs, always had a book in hand.'
example: 闵象南老好观书，年七十余，每夜漏下二三十筹，～。（清·王晫《今世说·德行》）
exampleTraditional: 閔象南老好觀書，年七十餘，每夜漏下二三十籌，～。（清·王晫《今世說·德行》）
exampleEn: Min Xiangnan loved reading in his old age; over seventy, he would read until late into the night, always with a book in hand. (From Qing Dynasty Wang Zhuo's 'Jinshi Shuo: Virtue')

explanation: 指光说不做。也指卖弄口才（含贬义）。
explanationTraditional: 指光說不做。也指賣弄口才（含貶義）。
explanationEn: To talk without taking action; also refers to showing off one's eloquence (derogatory).
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 缘木爬树。爬到树上去找鱼。比喻方向或办法不对头，不可能达到目的。
explanationTraditional: 緣木爬樹。爬到樹上去找魚。比喻方向或辦法不對頭，不可能達到目的。
explanationEn: To climb a tree to catch fish; metaphor for using the wrong method to achieve a goal, which is impossible.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》以若所为，求若所欲，犹缘木而求鱼也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》以若所為，求若所欲，猶緣木而求魚也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: King Hui of Liang I': 'Doing what you do to seek what you desire is like climbing a tree to catch fish.'
example: 若想善出此关，大王乃～，非徒无益，而又害之也。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 若想善出此關，大王乃～，非徒無益，而又害之也。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第三十三回
exampleEn: If you want to pass this pass safely, Your Majesty is like climbing a tree to catch fish—not only useless but also harmful. (From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 33)

explanation: 泛指邻居。
explanationTraditional: 泛指鄰居。
explanationEn: Neighbors in general.
derivation: 欧阳山《苦斗》五十八左邻右里的贫苦农民带着红糖、生姜、糯米……来探望她。”
derivationTraditional: 歐陽山《苦鬥》五十八左鄰右里的貧苦農民帶著紅糖、生薑、糯米……來探望她。”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Shan's 'Bitter Struggle' 58: 'The poor farmers from the left and right neighbors brought brown sugar, ginger, glutinous rice... to visit her.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容人到老年还依然威猛，不减当年。
explanationTraditional: 形容人到老年還依然威猛，不減當年。
explanationEn: Describes an elderly person who is still vigorous and formidable, as in their prime.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 爷爷虽然年纪很大了，但宝刀未老，依然每天出去晨练。
exampleTraditional: 爺爺雖然年紀很大了，但寶刀未老，依然每天出去晨練。
exampleEn: Although Grandpa is very old, he is still vigorous and goes out for morning exercise every day.

explanation: 穷尽，终结。形容不断变化，没有止境。
explanationTraditional: 窮盡，終結。形容不斷變化，沒有止境。
explanationEn: Endless changes; describes continuous change without limit.
derivation: 战国·楚·宋玉《高唐赋》须臾之间，变化无穷。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·宋玉《高唐賦》須臾之間，變化無窮。”
derivationEn: From Warring States Chu Song Yu's 'Gaotang Fu': 'In a moment, changes are endless.'
example: 如今三公子神通广大，～。★明·无名氏《杨家将演义》第五十七回
exampleTraditional: 如今三公子神通廣大，～。★明·無名氏《楊家將演義》第五十七回
exampleEn: Now the third young master's supernatural powers are vast and his changes are endless. (From Ming Dynasty anonymous 'Generals of the Yang Family', Chapter 57)

explanation: 除此之外没有多余的东西。同别无长物”。
explanationTraditional: 除此之外沒有多餘的東西。同別無長物”。
explanationEn: Having nothing else besides; same as '别无长物' (having no extra possessions).
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第七卷伯桃视之，止有一塌，塌上堆积书卷，别无他物。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第七卷伯桃視之，止有一塌，塌上堆積書卷，別無他物。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World' Volume 7: 'Bo Tao looked and saw only a couch piled with books, nothing else.'
example: 偌大的个戏台，空空洞洞，～，看了不觉有些好笑。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第二回
exampleTraditional: 偌大的個戲臺，空空洞洞，～，看了不覺有些好笑。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第二回
exampleEn: The huge stage was empty and hollow, with nothing else, which made one laugh involuntarily. (From Qing Dynasty Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 2)

explanation: 苟且得过且过；偷生苟且地活着。得过且过，勉强活着。
explanationTraditional: 苟且得過且過；偷生苟且地活著。得過且過，勉強活著。
explanationEn: To drift along and live a barely acceptable life; to live on just to get by.
derivation: 《荀子·荣辱》今夫偷生浅知之属，曾比而不知也。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·榮辱》今夫偷生淺知之屬，曾比而不知也。”
derivationEn: From 'Xunzi: Honor and Disgrace': 'Now those who live a barely acceptable life and are shallow-minded do not even understand this.'
example: 但他知道，那种高官厚禄、那种的～，是比死还要可怕。★郭沫若《屈原》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 但他知道，那種高官厚祿、那種的～，是比死還要可怕。★郭沫若《屈原》第一幕
exampleEn: But he knew that such high positions and wealth, such a life of drifting along, was more terrifying than death. (From Guo Moruo's 'Qu Yuan', Act 1)

explanation: 寥稀疏。稀少得好象早晨的星星。指为数极少。
explanationTraditional: 寥稀疏。稀少得好象早晨的星星。指為數極少。
explanationEn: As sparse as morning stars; describes very few in number.
derivation: 南朝·齐谢眺《京路夜发》晓星正寥落，晨光复映漭。”唐·韩愈《华山女》诗黄衣道士亦讲说，座下寥落如明星。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·齊謝眺《京路夜發》曉星正寥落，晨光復映漭。”唐·韓愈《華山女》詩黃衣道士亦講說，座下寥落如明星。”
derivationEn: From Southern Qi Xie Tiao's 'Night Journey on the Capital Road': 'The morning stars are sparse, and the dawn light spreads.' Tang Han Yu's poem 'Huashan Woman': 'The yellow-robed Taoist also preaches, but the audience is sparse like stars.'
example: 内山书店书店经常去，但不是每天，漫谈的人材也～，令人感到寂寞。★鲁迅《书信集·致山本初枝》
exampleTraditional: 內山書店書店經常去，但不是每天，漫談的人材也～，令人感到寂寞。★魯迅《書信集·致山本初枝》
exampleEn: I often go to Uchiyama Bookstore, but not every day, and the people to chat with are as sparse as morning stars, making one feel lonely. (From Lu Xun's 'Letters: To Yamamoto Hatsue')

explanation: 自身性命遭杀害的大祸。
explanationTraditional: 自身性命遭殺害的大禍。
explanationEn: A great disaster in which one's own life is taken.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 高一声低一声地乱叫乱喊。
explanationTraditional: 高一聲低一聲地亂叫亂喊。
explanationEn: To shout and yell loudly in a disorderly manner.
derivation: 元·无名氏《谢金吾》是什么人在门口大呼小叫，我去看咱。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《謝金吾》是什麼人在門口大呼小叫，我去看咱。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous 'Xie Jinwu': 'Someone is shouting loudly at the door, let me go see.'
example: 擎火把的都是年轻的农民，另一只手提着枪，也有拿镐的，～的嚷嚷着。★杨朔《雪花飘飘》
exampleTraditional: 擎火把的都是年輕的農民，另一隻手提著槍，也有拿鎬的，～的嚷嚷著。★楊朔《雪花飄飄》
exampleEn: The torchbearers were young peasants, holding guns or picks in the other hand, shouting loudly. — Yang Shuo 'Snowflakes Flying'

explanation: 形容态度傲慢，目中无人的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容態度傲慢，目中無人的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes an arrogant and supercilious manner.
derivation: 明·王世桢《鸣凤记》第二十三出又见他烈烈轰轰，呼呼喝喝，大模大样，前遮后拥，把那街上闲人尽打开。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王世楨《鳴鳳記》第二十三出又見他烈烈轟轟，呼呼喝喝，大模大樣，前遮後擁，把那街上閒人盡打開。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Wang Shizhen 'Ming Feng Ji' Act 23: 'He is grand and imposing, shouting and yelling, arrogant and supercilious, with a crowd clearing the way.'
example: 安禄山，我且问你，这般～是几时起的？★清·洪昻《长生殿》第十三出
exampleTraditional: 安祿山，我且問你，這般～是幾時起的？★清·洪昻《長生殿》第十三出
exampleEn: An Lushan, I ask you, since when have you become so arrogant? — Qing Dynasty, Hong Sheng 'The Palace of Eternal Life' Act 13

explanation: 指不追求名利才能使志趣高洁。
explanationTraditional: 指不追求名利才能使志趣高潔。
explanationEn: To show high ideals by leading a simple life without seeking fame or wealth.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《戒子书》非淡泊无以明志，非宁静无以致远。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《戒子書》非淡泊無以明志，非寧靜無以致遠。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms, Shu, Zhuge Liang 'Admonition to My Son': 'Without indifference, one cannot clarify his aspirations; without tranquility, one cannot reach far.'
example: 至于宽闲之野，寂寞之滨，每自寓其天怀之乐，而～，宁静致远，未尝不处处流露。★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷三
exampleTraditional: 至於寬閒之野，寂寞之濱，每自寓其天懷之樂，而～，寧靜致遠，未嘗不處處流露。★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷三
exampleEn: In the remote fields and lonely shores, he often expresses his natural joy, and the principle of 'indifference clarifies aspirations, tranquility reaches far' is always revealed. — Qing Dynasty, Anonymous 'Du Shi Yan Zhi' Vol. 3

explanation: 荡摇动。动荡亿，不安定。形容局势不稳定，不平静。
explanationTraditional: 蕩搖動。動盪億，不安定。形容局勢不穩定，不平靜。
explanationEn: Unstable and turbulent; describes an unsettled situation.
derivation: 陶菊隐《北洋军阀统治时期史话》第77章粤系军队又侵入湘南，两湖局势也在动荡不定中。”
derivationTraditional: 陶菊隱《北洋軍閥統治時期史話》第77章粵系軍隊又侵入湘南，兩湖局勢也在動盪不定中。”
derivationEn: From Tao Juyin 'History of the Northern Warlords Period' Chapter 77: 'The Cantonese army invaded southern Hunan, and the situation in Hunan and Hubei was also in turmoil.'
example: 在～的岁月里，他始终保持这个良好习惯。
exampleTraditional: 在～的歲月裡，他始終保持這個良好習慣。
exampleEn: In those turbulent years, he always maintained this good habit.

explanation: 比喻悍妒的妻子对丈夫大吵大闹。
explanationTraditional: 比喻悍妒的妻子對丈夫大吵大鬧。
explanationEn: Metaphor for a jealous and fierce wife shouting at her husband.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《寄吴德仁兼简陈季常》诗龙丘居士亦可怜，谈空说有夜不眠■闻河东师子吼，拄杖落手心茫然。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《寄吳德仁兼簡陳季常》詩龍丘居士亦可憐，談空說有夜不眠■聞河東師子吼，拄杖落手心茫然。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Su Shi 'To Wu Deren and Chen Jichang': 'Mr. Longqiu is also pitiable, talking about emptiness and existence all night without sleep; suddenly hearing the roar of the lion from Hedong, his staff drops and his mind is lost.'
example: 少不得太太面前还要趋奉趋奉，防是～起来，要不太平。（清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第二十二回）
exampleTraditional: 少不得太太面前還要趨奉趨奉，防是～起來，要不太平。（清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第二十二回）
exampleEn: He must flatter his wife to avoid her roaring like a lion from Hedong, which would cause trouble. — Qing Dynasty, Peng Yang'ou 'The Opium Addict' Chapter 22

explanation: 贯贯穿。正义的精神直上高空，穿过彩虹。形容精神极其崇高，气概极其豪壮。
explanationTraditional: 貫貫穿。正義的精神直上高空，穿過彩虹。形容精神極其崇高，氣概極其豪壯。
explanationEn: Righteous spirit soaring up to the sky and piercing the rainbow; describes extremely lofty spirit and heroic mettle.
derivation: 《礼记·聘义》气如白虹，天也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·聘義》氣如白虹，天也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: The Meaning of the Exchange of Missions': 'The spirit is like a white rainbow, reaching the sky.'
example: 斗争结盟友，殉难慷慨同。　人民柴市节，浩气贯长虹。★陈毅《纪念李大钊同志殉难三十周年》诗
exampleTraditional: 鬥爭結盟友，殉難慷慨同。　人民柴市節，浩氣貫長虹。★陳毅《紀念李大釗同志殉難三十週年》詩
exampleEn: Fighting together as allies, dying generously in the same cause. At the people's market, your noble spirit pierces the rainbow. — Chen Yi 'Commemorating the Martyrdom of Comrade Li Dazhao'

explanation: 指每个人各自有不同的志向愿望，不能勉为其难。
explanationTraditional: 指每個人各自有不同的志向願望，不能勉為其難。
explanationEn: Everyone has their own aspirations and wishes; one should not force others.
derivation: 汉·王粲《咏史诗》人生各有志，终不为此移，同知埋身剧，心亦有所施。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王粲《詠史詩》人生各有志，終不為此移，同知埋身劇，心亦有所施。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Wang Can 'Poem on History': 'Everyone has their own aspirations, and will not change for this; though they know burial is painful, their hearts still have their aims.'
example: 此乃～，志各不同。大抵名公夙成蕴藉，非俺辈所能深知。★明·无心子《金雀记·投笺》
exampleTraditional: 此乃～，志各不同。大抵名公夙成蘊藉，非俺輩所能深知。★明·無心子《金雀記·投箋》
exampleEn: This is a matter of personal aspiration, each with different goals. Generally, gentlemen have their own refined tastes, which we cannot fully understand. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Xinzi 'The Golden Sparrow' 'Throwing a Note'

explanation: 所到之处，没有不顺利的。指处处行得通，办得好。
explanationTraditional: 所到之處，沒有不順利的。指處處行得通，辦得好。
explanationEn: To succeed wherever one goes; to be able to do everything smoothly.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十回贫道今日幸把些尘垢全都拭净，此后是皓月当空，一无渣滓，诸位才女定是无往不利。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十回貧道今日幸把些塵垢全都拭淨，此後是皓月當空，一無渣滓，諸位才女定是無往不利。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 90: 'Today I have wiped away all the dust, and from now on, like the bright moon in the sky, without any dregs, you talented ladies will surely succeed in everything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心意好象猴子跳、马奔跑一样控制不住。形容心里东想西想，安静不下来。
explanationTraditional: 心意好象猴子跳、馬奔跑一樣控制不住。形容心裡東想西想，安靜不下來。
explanationEn: The mind is like a jumping monkey and a galloping horse; describes being restless and unable to concentrate.
derivation: 汉·魏伯阳《参同契》注心猿不定，意马四驰。”唐·许浑《题杜居士》诗机尽心猿伏，神闲意马行。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·魏伯陽《參同契》注心猿不定，意馬四馳。”唐·許渾《題杜居士》詩機盡心猿伏，神閒意馬行。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Wei Boyang 'The Kinship of the Three' commentary: 'The mind is an unsettled monkey, the will a galloping horse.' Tang Dynasty, Xu Hun 'To Hermit Du': 'When the mind is exhausted, the monkey rests; when the spirit is idle, the horse goes.'
example: 俺从今把～紧牢拴，将繁华不挂眼。★元·关汉卿《望江亭》第一折
exampleTraditional: 俺從今把～緊牢拴，將繁華不掛眼。★元·關漢卿《望江亭》第一折
exampleEn: From now on, I will tightly tie up my restless mind and not be distracted by worldly splendor. — Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing 'Wangjiang Pavilion' Act 1

explanation: 把别人的成败得失作为自己的借鉴。
explanationTraditional: 把別人的成敗得失作為自己的借鑑。
explanationEn: To use others' successes and failures as one's own mirror.
derivation: 《墨子·非攻中》君子不镜于水而镜於人。镜于水，见面之容；镜于人，则知吉与凶。”
derivationTraditional: 《墨子·非攻中》君子不鏡於水而鏡於人。鏡於水，見面之容；鏡於人，則知吉與兇。”
derivationEn: From 'Mozi: Against Offensive Wars II': 'The gentleman does not mirror himself in water but in others. Mirroring in water shows the face; mirroring in others tells good fortune from bad.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 庸平庸。指平凡无奇。
explanationTraditional: 庸平庸。指平凡無奇。
explanationEn: Mediocre and unremarkable; ordinary and without distinction.
derivation: 明·余继登《典故纪闻》卷三卿等居持衡秉鉴之任，宜在公平以辨别贤否，毋但庸庸碌碌充位而已。”
derivationTraditional: 明·餘繼登《典故紀聞》卷三卿等居持衡秉鑑之任，宜在公平以辨別賢否，毋但庸庸碌碌充位而已。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Yu Jideng's 'Records of Anecdotes' Volume 3: 'You who hold the balance and mirror should be fair in distinguishing the worthy from the unworthy, not just mediocrely filling positions.'
example: 若有变动，吾与兄正好扬眉吐气，干一番事业。难道还要～的过活？★清·褚人获《隋唐演义》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 若有變動，吾與兄正好揚眉吐氣，幹一番事業。難道還要～的過活？★清·褚人獲《隋唐演義》第十一回
exampleEn: If there is a change, you and I can hold our heads high and accomplish something. Should we still live a mediocre life? — Qing Dynasty Chu Renhuo, 'Sui and Tang Romance' Chapter 11

explanation: 跋扈霸道，不讲理。专断蛮横，任意妄为，蛮不讲理。
explanationTraditional: 跋扈霸道，不講理。專斷蠻橫，任意妄為，蠻不講理。
explanationEn: Arbitrary and domineering; acting willfully and unreasonably.
derivation: 《后汉书·梁冀传》帝少而聪慧，知冀骄横，尝朝群臣，目冀曰‘此跋扈将军也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·梁冀傳》帝少而聰慧，知冀驕橫，嘗朝群臣，目冀曰‘此跋扈將軍也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Liang Ji': 'The emperor, young and intelligent, knew Ji was arrogant and once said to the courtiers, pointing at Ji, 'This is a domineering general.''
example: 领导者～，就得不到群众的信任和支持。
exampleTraditional: 領導者～，就得不到群眾的信任和支持。
exampleEn: If a leader is arbitrary and domineering, they will not gain the trust and support of the masses.

explanation: 指经历的时间极久。
explanationTraditional: 指經歷的時間極久。
explanationEn: Refers to an extremely long period of time; everlasting.
derivation: 唐·李贺《致酒行》吾闻马周昔作新丰客，天荒地老无人识。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李賀《致酒行》吾聞馬周昔作新豐客，天荒地老無人識。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li He's 'Toasting Song': 'I heard that Ma Zhou was once a guest in Xinfeng, unknown until heaven and earth grew old.'
example: 然而海枯石烂，此恨难消，～，此情不泯！★明·瞿佑《剪灯新话·绿衣人传》
exampleTraditional: 然而海枯石爛，此恨難消，～，此情不泯！★明·瞿佑《剪燈新話·綠衣人傳》
exampleEn: Yet even if the seas dry up and rocks crumble, this hatred is hard to dispel; even if the earth grows old and heaven ages, this love will not fade! — Ming Dynasty Qu You, 'Stories of the Green Dress'

explanation: 讥笑听话的人不懂对方说得是什么。用以讥笑说话的人不看对象。
explanationTraditional: 譏笑聽話的人不懂對方說得是什麼。用以譏笑說話的人不看對象。
explanationEn: To play music to a cow; to talk over someone's head or to address the wrong audience.
derivation: 汉·牟融《理惑论》公明仪为牛弹清角之操，伏食如枚。非牛不闻，不合其耳矣。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·牟融《理惑論》公明儀為牛彈清角之操，伏食如枚。非牛不聞，不合其耳矣。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Mou Rong's 'Treatise on Removing Doubts': 'Gongming Yi played the Qingjiao tune for a cow, but the cow continued eating as before. It's not that the cow didn't hear; the tune didn't suit its ears.'
example: ～，牛不入耳，骂得很好，咱们一总再算账！★清·李当珍《镜花缘》第九十回
exampleTraditional: ～，牛不入耳，罵得很好，咱們一總再算賬！★清·李當珍《鏡花緣》第九十回
exampleEn: Playing music to a cow, the cow doesn't hear it; well scolded, we'll settle accounts later! — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 90

explanation: 走跑。形容缝纫技术非常熟练。
explanationTraditional: 走跑。形容縫紉技術非常熟練。
explanationEn: Flying needle and running thread; describes very skilled sewing or embroidery.
derivation: 《祖堂集·洛甫和尚》问‘孤灯不自照，室内事如何？’师云‘飞针走线时人会，两边绣过却还稀。’”
derivationTraditional: 《祖堂集·洛甫和尚》問‘孤燈不自照，室內事如何？’師雲‘飛針走線時人會，兩邊繡過卻還稀。’”
derivationEn: From 'Ancestral Hall Collection: Luofu Monk': 'Question: 'The solitary lamp does not illuminate itself; what happens inside the room?' The master said: 'When the flying needle and running thread are understood, both sides are embroidered but still sparse.''
example: 若提起女工一事，～，出人意表。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三
exampleTraditional: 若提起女工一事，～，出人意表。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三
exampleEn: When it comes to needlework, her flying needle and running thread are beyond expectation. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 3

explanation: 狠暴戾，凶恶，残忍。爱逞威风，喜欢斗欧。形容人凶强好斗。
explanationTraditional: 狠暴戾，兇惡，殘忍。愛逞威風，喜歡鬥歐。形容人兇強好鬥。
explanationEn: Fond of bravery and fighting; aggressive and belligerent.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄下》好勇斗很，以危其父母，一不孝也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁下》好勇鬥很，以危其父母，一不孝也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Li Lou II': 'Loving bravery and fighting, thereby endangering one's parents, is the first unfilial act.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 嫁转移。把自己的祸事推给别人。
explanationTraditional: 嫁轉移。把自己的禍事推給別人。
explanationEn: To shift the blame or misfortune onto someone else.
derivation: 《史记·赵世家》韩氏所以不入于秦者，欲嫁祸于赵也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·趙世家》韓氏所以不入於秦者，欲嫁禍於趙也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Zhao Aristocratic Family': 'The reason Han did not enter Qin was to shift the blame onto Zhao.'
example: 他们这样说，固然也许是因为失败之后，～，或者因为自己变计，须有借口之故。（鲁迅《两地书》一○六）
exampleTraditional: 他們這樣說，固然也許是因為失敗之後，～，或者因為自己變計，須有藉口之故。（魯迅《兩地書》一○六）
exampleEn: They say so, perhaps because after failure they shift the blame onto others, or because they need an excuse for changing their plan. — Lu Xun, 'Two Letters' No. 106

explanation: 指双方争吵、斗争、比赛等相持不下，难以分开。有时也形容双方关系十分亲密，分不开。
explanationTraditional: 指雙方爭吵、鬥爭、比賽等相持不下，難以分開。有時也形容雙方關係十分親密，分不開。
explanationEn: Inseparable; describes a stalemate in a quarrel, competition, or fight, or a very close relationship.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第六十九回一员将使五股托天叉；一员将使八楞熟铜锤；一员将使五爪烂银抓；三将大战，杀得难解难分。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第六十九回一員將使五股託天叉；一員將使八楞熟銅錘；一員將使五爪爛銀抓；三將大戰，殺得難解難分。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 69: 'One general used a five-pronged spear; another used an eight-cornered bronze hammer; another used a five-clawed silver claw; the three fought fiercely, locked in an inseparable battle.'
example: 这盘棋，两人杀得～，不分高下。
exampleTraditional: 這盤棋，兩人殺得～，不分高下。
exampleEn: In this chess game, the two players are locked in an inseparable battle, evenly matched.

explanation: 寻求，找。闹着要死要活。多指用自杀来吓唬人。
explanationTraditional: 尋求，找。鬧著要死要活。多指用自殺來嚇唬人。
explanationEn: To seek death or act as if dying; to threaten suicide, often to scare others.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《金钱池》第二折只为杜蕊娘他把俺赤心相待，时常与这虔婆合气，寻死觅活，无非是为俺家的缘故。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《金錢池》第二折只為杜蕊娘他把俺赤心相待，時常與這虔婆合氣，尋死覓活，無非是為俺家的緣故。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Gold Coin Pond' Act 2: 'It's only because Du Ruiniang treats me with sincerity, and often quarrels with this madam, seeking death and acting as if dying, all for my sake.'
example: 直至日晚，身边无银子还酒钱，便放无赖，～，自割自吊。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷六
exampleTraditional: 直至日晚，身邊無銀子還酒錢，便放無賴，～，自割自吊。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷六
exampleEn: Until evening, having no money to pay for wine, he acted shamelessly, seeking death and cutting himself. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Caution the World' Volume 6

explanation: 许多星星聚集、环绕着月亮。比喻众人拥戴一人或众物围绕一物。同众星攒月”。
explanationTraditional: 許多星星聚集、環繞著月亮。比喻眾人擁戴一人或眾物圍繞一物。同眾星攢月”。
explanationEn: Many stars surrounding the moon; metaphor for many people supporting one person or many things surrounding one thing.
derivation: 徐迟《搜尽奇峰打草稿》而在那个主要工程的位置上，则缀有一颗大红宝石。在它的周围又加众星拱月，环绕着好些较小的红宝石。”
derivationTraditional: 徐遲《搜盡奇峰打草稿》而在那個主要工程的位置上，則綴有一顆大紅寶石。在它的周圍又加眾星拱月，環繞著好些較小的紅寶石。”
derivationEn: From Xu Chi's 'Searching Every Peak for Drafts': 'And at the position of the main project, a large ruby was set. Around it, like stars surrounding the moon, were many smaller rubies.'
example: 像～似的，学生们围在老教授身边，肩膀靠着肩膀，胳膊挽着胳膊。★碧野《报晓峰》
exampleTraditional: 像～似的，學生們圍在老教授身邊，肩膀靠著肩膀，胳膊挽著胳膊。★碧野《報曉峰》
exampleEn: Like stars surrounding the moon, the students gathered around the old professor, shoulder to shoulder, arm in arm. — Bi Ye, 'Reporting Peak'

explanation: 国家覆灭、家庭毁灭。
explanationTraditional: 國家覆滅、家庭毀滅。
explanationEn: The country is defeated and the family is destroyed.
derivation: 晋·刘琨《答卢谌书》国破家亡，亲友雕残。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·劉琨《答盧諶書》國破家亡，親友雕殘。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Liu Kun's 'Reply to Lu Chen's Letter': 'The country is defeated and the family is destroyed; relatives and friends are scattered.'
example: 天荒地老英雄丧，～事业休。★明·赵弼《续宋丞相文文山传》
exampleTraditional: 天荒地老英雄喪，～事業休。★明·趙弼《續宋丞相文文山傳》
exampleEn: The world is desolate and heroes are lost; the country is defeated and the family is destroyed, and the cause is over. — Ming Dynasty, Zhao Bi's 'Continuation of Song Prime Minister Wen Wen's Biography'

explanation: 黄粱小米。比喻虚幻不能实现的梦想。
explanationTraditional: 黃粱小米。比喻虛幻不能實現的夢想。
explanationEn: A dream of millet; metaphor for an illusory dream that cannot be realized.
derivation: 唐·沈既济《枕中记》怪曰‘岂其梦寐耶？’翁笑曰‘人世之事亦犹是矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·沈既濟《枕中記》怪曰‘豈其夢寐耶？’翁笑曰‘人世之事亦猶是矣。’”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Shen Jiji's 'The Story of the Pillow': 'The strange man said, 'Was it a dream?' The old man smiled and said, 'Human affairs are just like this.''
example: 应举不第，道经邯郸，得遇正阳子师父，点化～，遂成仙道。★元·范康《竹叶舟》第一折
exampleTraditional: 應舉不第，道經邯鄲，得遇正陽子師父，點化～，遂成仙道。★元·範康《竹葉舟》第一折
exampleEn: Failed the imperial exam, passed through Handan, met Master Zhengyangzi, who enlightened him about the dream of millet, and thus became an immortal. — Yuan Dynasty, Fan Kang's 'Bamboo Leaf Boat', first act

explanation: 累土可以堆成山，比喻积少成多。
explanationTraditional: 累土可以堆成山，比喻積少成多。
explanationEn: Accumulating soil can form a mountain; metaphor for many small things adding up to a large amount.
derivation: 荀况《荀子·劝学》积土成山，风雨兴焉；积水成渊，蛟龙生焉。”
derivationTraditional: 荀況《荀子·勸學》積土成山，風雨興焉；積水成淵，蛟龍生焉。”
derivationEn: Xun Kuang's 'Xunzi: Encouraging Learning': 'Accumulating soil forms a mountain, and wind and rain arise from it; accumulating water forms a deep pool, and dragons are born from it.'
example: ～，积水成渊
exampleTraditional: ～，積水成淵
exampleEn: Accumulating soil forms a mountain, accumulating water forms a deep pool.

explanation: 塞边界险要之处；翁老头。比喻一时虽然受到损失，也许反而因此能得到好处。也指坏事在一定条件下可变为好事。
explanationTraditional: 塞邊界險要之處；翁老頭。比喻一時雖然受到損失，也許反而因此能得到好處。也指壞事在一定條件下可變為好事。
explanationEn: The old man at the frontier lost his horse; metaphor for a loss that may turn out to be a gain, or bad things turning into good under certain conditions.
derivation: 《淮南子·人间训》近塞上之人有善术者，马无故亡而入胡。人皆吊之。其父曰‘此何遽不为铬？’居数月，其马将胡骏马而归。人皆贺之。…故福之为祸，祸之为福，化不可极，深不可测也。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·人間訓》近塞上之人有善術者，馬無故亡而入胡。人皆吊之。其父曰‘此何遽不為鉻？’居數月，其馬將胡駿馬而歸。人皆賀之。…故福之為禍，禍之為福，化不可極，深不可測也。”
derivationEn: 'Huainanzi: Human Affairs': 'A man near the frontier was good at divination. His horse went into the Hu territory for no reason. Everyone consoled him. His father said, 'How do you know this isn't a blessing?' A few months later, the horse returned with a fine Hu horse. Everyone congratulated him... Thus, blessing turns into disaster, disaster turns into blessing, the transformation is endless and unfathomable.'
example: 处士有志未遂，甚为可惜，然～，安知非福”。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七回
exampleTraditional: 處士有志未遂，甚為可惜，然～，安知非福”。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七回
exampleEn: The scholar's ambition was unfulfilled, which was a pity, but the old man lost his horse—who knows if it's not a blessing? — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 7

explanation: 泰山压在头上。比喻遭遇到极大的压力和打击。
explanationTraditional: 泰山壓在頭上。比喻遭遇到極大的壓力和打擊。
explanationEn: Mount Tai pressing down on the head; metaphor for encountering great pressure or a heavy blow.
derivation: 明·贾凫西《木皮词·正传》给了他个泰山压顶没有躲闪，把那助纣为虐的杀个净，直杀的血流飘杵，堵了城门。”
derivationTraditional: 明·賈鳧西《木皮詞·正傳》給了他個泰山壓頂沒有躲閃，把那助紂為虐的殺個淨，直殺的血流飄杵，堵了城門。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Jia Fuxi's 'Wooden Skin Poetry: Main Biography': 'He gave him Mount Tai pressing down on the head with no escape, and killed all those who helped the tyrant, until blood flowed like pestle and blocked the city gate.'
example: 一个棍起处似～，打下来举手无措。（清·文康《儿女英雄传》第六回）
exampleTraditional: 一個棍起處似～，打下來舉手無措。（清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第六回）
exampleEn: A club rises like Mount Tai pressing down on the head, and when it strikes, one is helpless. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 6

explanation: 泛指一般的小病或小灾小难。同头疼脑热”。
explanationTraditional: 泛指一般的小病或小災小難。同頭疼腦熱”。
explanationEn: Refers to minor illnesses or minor troubles.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指来客很多。
explanationTraditional: 指來客很多。
explanationEn: The door is full of guests; means many visitors.
derivation: 《旧唐书·窦威传》时诸兄并以军功致仕通显，交结豪贵，宾客盈门，而威职掌闲散。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·竇威傳》時諸兄並以軍功緻仕通顯，交結豪貴，賓客盈門，而威職掌閒散。”
derivationEn: 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Dou Wei': 'At that time, all the brothers achieved high official positions through military merit, associating with the wealthy and noble, with guests filling the door, while Dou Wei held a leisurely post.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指日常衣食费用。
explanationTraditional: 指日常衣食費用。
explanationEn: Refers to daily expenses for food and clothing.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十五回他近日所见的这几个三等仆妇，吃穿用度，已是不凡了，何况今至其家。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十五回他近日所見的這幾個三等僕婦，吃穿用度，已是不凡了，何況今至其家。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 15: 'The few third-class maids she had seen recently were already extraordinary in their food, clothing, and expenses, let alone when she arrived at their home.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伐讨伐，攻击。指结帮分派，偏向同伙，打击不同意见的人。
explanationTraditional: 伐討伐，攻擊。指結幫分派，偏向同夥，打擊不同意見的人。
explanationEn: Forming cliques and factions, favoring one's own side and attacking those with different opinions.
derivation: 《后汉书·党锢传序》自武帝以后，崇尚儒学，怀经协术，所在雾会。至有石渠分争之论，党同伐异之说。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·黨錮傳序》自武帝以後，崇尚儒學，懷經協術，所在霧會。至有石渠分爭之論，黨同伐異之說。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of the Partisan Prohibitions': 'Since Emperor Wu, Confucianism was revered, and those who studied the classics gathered like clouds. There were debates like those at the Stone Canal, and theories of siding with one's own party and attacking dissenters.'
example: 读者幸勿比例惴测，谓此事为某人写照，此名为某人化身，致生种种～意见。★清·梁启超《新中国未来记·绪言》
exampleTraditional: 讀者幸勿比例惴測，謂此事為某人寫照，此名為某人化身，致生種種～意見。★清·梁啟超《新中國未來記·緒言》
exampleEn: Readers should not speculate and think that this matter portrays someone or this name is an incarnation of someone, leading to various opinions of siding with one's own party and attacking dissenters. — Qing Dynasty, Liang Qichao's 'Preface to The Future of New China'

explanation: 军队从几个方向前进，协同围击同一目标。
explanationTraditional: 軍隊從幾個方向前進，協同圍擊同一目標。
explanationEn: Military forces advance from several directions and coordinate to attack the same target.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》第五章第六节将敌军对我军的战略上的分进合击，改为我军对敌军的战役或战斗上的分进合击。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》第五章第六節將敵軍對我軍的戰略上的分進合擊，改為我軍對敵軍的戰役或戰鬥上的分進合擊。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War', Chapter 5, Section 6: 'Change the enemy's strategic converging attack on us into our tactical converging attack on the enemy.'
example: 这份电报全部暴露了敌人对我‘～’的战役企图和敌人各路兵力的部署。★曹丹辉《在一九三一年间》
exampleTraditional: 這份電報全部暴露了敵人對我‘～’的戰役企圖和敵人各路兵力的部署。★曹丹輝《在一九三一年間》
exampleEn: This telegram fully exposed the enemy's campaign intention of 'converging attack' and the deployment of their various forces. — Cao Danhui's 'In the Year 1931'

explanation: 惊恐害怕；万状各种样子，表示程度极深。形容害怕到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 驚恐害怕；萬狀各種樣子，表示程度極深。形容害怕到了極點。
explanationEn: Extremely terrified; frightened to the utmost degree.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《谢杨解元启》忧患百罹而未艾，惊惶万状而莫支。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《謝楊解元啟》憂患百罹而未艾，驚惶萬狀而莫支。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Chen Liang's 'Xie Yang Jie Yuan Qi': 'Suffering from numerous calamities without end, terrified in countless ways and unable to support oneself.'
example: 大家定睛看时，原来是一群野雉，象是大敌袭来，～地向南飞去。★曲波《林海雪原》三十四
exampleTraditional: 大家定睛看時，原來是一群野雉，象是大敵襲來，～地向南飛去。★曲波《林海雪原》三十四
exampleEn: When everyone looked closely, it turned out to be a flock of pheasants, as if a great enemy was approaching, flying south in extreme terror. — Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 34

explanation: 勤奋能够弥补不足。
explanationTraditional: 勤奮能夠彌補不足。
explanationEn: Diligence can compensate for lack of ability.
derivation: 宋·邵雍《弄笔吟》弄假像真终是假，将勤补拙总轮勤。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·邵雍《弄筆吟》弄假像真終是假，將勤補拙總輪勤。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shao Yong's 'Nong Bi Yin': 'Making false things seem real is ultimately false; using diligence to make up for clumsiness always relies on diligence.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 晓使人知道。把事情的利害关系给人讲清楚。
explanationTraditional: 曉使人知道。把事情的利害關係給人講清楚。
explanationEn: To explain the pros and cons of a matter to someone clearly.
derivation: 《北齐书·薛修义传》遂轻诣垒下，晓以利害。”
derivationTraditional: 《北齊書·薛修義傳》遂輕詣壘下，曉以利害。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Northern Qi, Biography of Xue Xiuyi': 'He lightly went to the base of the fortification and explained the advantages and disadvantages.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 既有胆量又有见识。
explanationTraditional: 既有膽量又有見識。
explanationEn: Having both courage and insight.
derivation: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第四十回金羽妹子，绝世聪明，有胆有识，今年也是七岁，可怜有才无命。”
derivationTraditional: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第四十回金羽妹子，絕世聰明，有膽有識，今年也是七歲，可憐有才無命。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Xia Jingqu's 'Ye Sou Pu Yan', Chapter 40: 'Sister Jinyu is extremely intelligent, courageous and insightful, also seven years old this year, but pitifully talented without luck.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 俱全，都；焚烧。美玉和石头一样烧坏。比喻好坏不分，同归于尽。
explanationTraditional: 俱全，都；焚燒。美玉和石頭一樣燒壞。比喻好壞不分，同歸於盡。
explanationEn: Jade and stone burn together; metaphor for不分好坏，同归于尽 (not distinguishing good from bad, both perish together).
derivation: 《尚书·胤征》火焱昆岗，玉石俱焚。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·胤徵》火焱昆崗，玉石俱焚。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents, Yin Zheng': 'Fire blazes on Kunlun, jade and stone burn together.'
example: 内无良将，外无救兵，若然攻破，～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 內無良將，外無救兵，若然攻破，～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十二回
exampleEn: Inside there are no good generals, outside no relief troops; if it is breached, jade and stone will burn together. — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 12

explanation: 峻山高而陡。又高又险的山岭。
explanationTraditional: 峻山高而陡。又高又險的山嶺。
explanationEn: High and steep mountains.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第八十六回众人打一看时，四面尽是高山，左右是悬崖峭壁，只见高山峻岭，无路可登。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第八十六回眾人打一看時，四面盡是高山，左右是懸崖峭壁，只見高山峻嶺，無路可登。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 86: 'When everyone looked, there were high mountains all around, with cliffs on left and right; only high and steep mountains, no road to climb.'
example: 三峡之中，唯巫峡最长。两岸都是～，古木阴森，映蔽江面，止露得中间一线的青天。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第二十五卷
exampleTraditional: 三峽之中，唯巫峽最長。兩岸都是～，古木陰森，映蔽江面，止露得中間一線的青天。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第二十五卷
exampleEn: Among the Three Gorges, only Wu Gorge is the longest. Both banks are high mountains and steep ridges, with ancient trees casting deep shadows, covering the river, leaving only a strip of blue sky in the middle. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 25

explanation: 指在单位内外调查事情的真实情况。
explanationTraditional: 指在單位內外調查事情的真實情況。
explanationEn: To investigate the true situation both inside and outside an organization.
derivation: 《人民日报》1983.11.29经过一个星期的内查外调，掌握了大量证据，很快就挖出了这个由八人组成的贪污盗窃团伙。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1983.11.29經過一個星期的內查外調，掌握了大量證據，很快就挖出了這個由八人組成的貪汙盜竊團伙。”
derivationEn: 'People's Daily', November 29, 1983: 'After a week of internal and external investigations, they gathered a large amount of evidence and quickly uncovered a corruption and theft gang of eight people.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象吃蜡一样，没有一点儿味。形容语言或文章枯燥无味。
explanationTraditional: 象吃蠟一樣，沒有一點兒味。形容語言或文章枯燥無味。
explanationEn: Tasteless like chewing wax; describes language or writing that is dull and uninteresting.
derivation: 《楞严经》卷八当横陈时，味同嚼醋。”
derivationTraditional: 《楞嚴經》卷八當橫陳時，味同嚼醋。”
derivationEn: 'Shurangama Sutra', Volume 8: 'When presented horizontally, it tastes like chewing vinegar.'
example: 但世人一见了功名，便舍着性命去求他，及至到手之后，～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第一回
exampleTraditional: 但世人一見了功名，便舍著性命去求他，及至到手之後，～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第一回
exampleEn: But as soon as people see fame and fortune, they risk their lives to seek them, and when they obtain them, it is like chewing wax. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 1

explanation: 泛指世界各地。
explanationTraditional: 泛指世界各地。
explanationEn: Refers to all parts of the world.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指事物经常变化，没有规律性。
explanationTraditional: 指事物經常變化，沒有規律性。
explanationEn: Refers to things that change frequently and irregularly.
derivation: 《庄子·天下》忽漠无形，变化无常。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天下》忽漠無形，變化無常。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi, Tianxia': 'Vague and formless, changing without constancy.'
example: 唐古拉山天气～，往往大晴天里忽然刮起了风雪。
exampleTraditional: 唐古拉山天氣～，往往大晴天裡忽然颳起了風雪。
exampleEn: The weather on the Tanggula Mountains is changeable and unpredictable; often a snowstorm suddenly arises on a clear day.

explanation: 分说辩白，解说。不容人分辩解释。
explanationTraditional: 分說辯白，解說。不容人分辯解釋。
explanationEn: Not allowing any explanation or argument; to brook no explanation.
derivation: 元·武汉臣《生金阁》三折怎么不由分说，便将我飞拳走踢只是打。”
derivationTraditional: 元·武漢臣《生金閣》三折怎麼不由分說，便將我飛拳走踢只是打。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'The Golden Ingot' by Wu Hanchen: 'Without allowing any explanation, they started beating me with fists and kicks.'
example: 宝钗～，笑灌了湘云一杯。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十二回
exampleTraditional: 寶釵～，笑灌了湘雲一杯。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十二回
exampleEn: Baochai, without allowing any explanation, forced Xiangyun to drink a cup of wine. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 62

explanation: 老气老年人的气派；横充满。形容老练而自负的神态。现形容自高自大，摆老资格。也形容缺乏朝气。
explanationTraditional: 老氣老年人的氣派；橫充滿。形容老練而自負的神態。現形容自高自大，擺老資格。也形容缺乏朝氣。
explanationEn: Arrogant on account of one's seniority; lacking youthful vigor; self-important and conceited.
derivation: 南朝·齐·孔稚珪《北山移文》风情张日，霜气横秋。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·齊·孔稚珪《北山移文》風情張日，霜氣橫秋。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty, Qi, Kong Zhigui's 'The Northern Mountain Relocation': 'His demeanor blocks the sun, his frosty air fills autumn.'
example: 众人取笑了一回，见新人～的那个样子，便纷纷散去。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第七十回
exampleTraditional: 眾人取笑了一回，見新人～的那個樣子，便紛紛散去。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第七十回
exampleEn: The crowd teased him for a while, but seeing his arrogant and old-fashioned manner, they dispersed. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 70

explanation: 豪杰指才能出众的人。女性中的杰出人物。
explanationTraditional: 豪傑指才能出眾的人。女性中的傑出人物。
explanationEn: An outstanding woman; a heroine among women.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三十二十娘钟情所欢，不以贫寠易心，此乃女中豪杰。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三十二十娘鍾情所歡，不以貧寠易心，此乃女中豪傑。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World', Volume 32: 'Shiniang, devoted to her beloved, did not change her heart due to poverty—truly a heroine among women.'
example: 过学士儿子百般用计求他，他有本事百般拒绝，又是个～，正好与中玉作配。★明·名教中人《好逑传》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 過學士兒子百般用計求他，他有本事百般拒絕，又是個～，正好與中玉作配。★明·名教中人《好逑傳》第十四回
exampleEn: The son of Scholar Guo tried every means to win her, but she skillfully refused him every time. She was a heroine among women, perfectly matched with Zhongyu. — Ming Dynasty, Mingjiao Zhongren, 'The Goodly Union', Chapter 14

explanation: 形容炮火非常猛烈。
explanationTraditional: 形容炮火非常猛烈。
explanationEn: Gunfire and artillery fill the sky; intense bombardment.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第八十九回他父子并唐僧在城楼上点劄，旌旗蔽日，炮火连天。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第八十九回他父子並唐僧在城樓上點劄，旌旗蔽日，炮火連天。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 89: 'He and his son, along with Tang Sanzang, were on the city tower; banners obscured the sun, and gunfire filled the sky.'
example: 这不过演放两三响已经这样了，何况～，亲临大敌呢，自然也要逃走了。（清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第十六回）
exampleTraditional: 這不過演放兩三響已經這樣了，何況～，親臨大敵呢，自然也要逃走了。（清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第十六回）
exampleEn: Just two or three shots were fired, and it was already like this. How much more so when gunfire fills the sky and one faces the enemy? Naturally, they would flee. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 16

explanation: 天下找不出第二个。形容出类拔萃，独一无二。
explanationTraditional: 天下找不出第二個。形容出類拔萃，獨一無二。
explanationEn: Unmatched in the world; peerless; unique.
derivation: 《史记·信陵君列传》始吾闻夫人弟公子天下无双。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·信陵君列傳》始吾聞夫人弟公子天下無雙。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lord Xinling': 'I have heard that your younger brother is unmatched in the world.'
example: 夜半，有女子可年十五六，姿颜服饰，～。★鲁迅《古小说钩沉·列异传》
exampleTraditional: 夜半，有女子可年十五六，姿顏服飾，～。★魯迅《古小說鉤沉·列異傳》
exampleEn: At midnight, a girl of about fifteen or sixteen appeared, with unparalleled beauty and attire. — Lu Xun, 'Ancient Stories Collected: Biographies of the Strange'

explanation: 文弱文雅而体弱。举目文雅，身体柔弱的读书人。
explanationTraditional: 文弱文雅而體弱。舉目文雅，身體柔弱的讀書人。
explanationEn: A frail scholar; a gentle and physically weak intellectual.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·赏誉下》士龙为人，文弱可爱。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·賞譽下》士龍為人，文弱可愛。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty, Song, Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Appreciation': 'Shilong is gentle and frail, lovable.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻虽然年龄已大或脱离本行已久，但功夫技术并没减退。
explanationTraditional: 比喻雖然年齡已大或脫離本行已久，但功夫技術並沒減退。
explanationEn: One's skills or abilities have not diminished despite age or long absence from the field.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十回忠（黄忠）怒曰‘竖子欺吾年老！吾手中宝刀却不老。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十回忠（黃忠）怒曰‘豎子欺吾年老！吾手中寶刀卻不老。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 70: 'Huang Zhong angrily said, 'Do you dare to mock my age? My precious sword is not old!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 受承受，担待；过过失，过错。替别人承担过错的责任。
explanationTraditional: 受承受，擔待；過過失，過錯。替別人承擔過錯的責任。
explanationEn: To bear the blame for someone else; to suffer for another's fault.
derivation: 陶菊隐《北洋军阀统治时期史话》各省系军阀慑于人民的巨大力量，都不肯代人受过，曹辊也就不敢一意孤行。”
derivationTraditional: 陶菊隱《北洋軍閥統治時期史話》各省系軍閥懾於人民的巨大力量，都不肯代人受過，曹輥也就不敢一意孤行。”
derivationEn: From Tao Juyin's 'Historical Account of the Warlord Period in Northern China': 'The provincial warlords, fearing the people's power, were unwilling to bear the blame for others, so Cao Kun dared not act arbitrarily.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①破旧锈烂无用的铜铁器。②泛指各种破旧无用的器物。
explanationTraditional: ①破舊鏽爛無用的銅鐵器。②泛指各種破舊無用的器物。
explanationEn: Rusty and useless copper and iron; any worthless old objects.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 困在瓮中的甲鱼。比喻已在掌握之中，逃跑不了的东西。
explanationTraditional: 困在甕中的甲魚。比喻已在掌握之中，逃跑不了的東西。
explanationEn: A turtle in a jar; someone or something that cannot escape; a sure catch.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷十八杨八老和一群百姓们，都被倭奴擒了，好似瓮中之鳖，釜中之鱼，没处躲闪，只得随顺以图苟活。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷十八楊八老和一群百姓們，都被倭奴擒了，好似甕中之鱉，釜中之魚，沒處躲閃，只得隨順以圖苟活。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 18: 'Yang Balao and a group of commoners were captured by the Japanese pirates, like turtles in a jar or fish in a pot, with no place to hide, so they had to submit to survive.'
example: 这几个小南蛮，只算得个～，不消费得僧家大刀，管教他一个个束手就缚。（清·钱彩《说岳全传》第七十六回）
exampleTraditional: 這幾個小南蠻，只算得個～，不消費得僧家大刀，管教他一個個束手就縛。（清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第七十六回）
exampleEn: These few southern barbarians are no more than turtles in a jar. Without wasting my monk's great sword, I'll have them bound hand and foot. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 76

explanation: 淑善，美。指女子嫁了一个品质不好的丈夫。
explanationTraditional: 淑善，美。指女子嫁了一個品質不好的丈夫。
explanationEn: To meet an unkind or bad person, especially referring to a woman marrying a bad husband.
derivation: 《诗经·王风·中谷有蓷》有女仳离，条其啸矣。条其啸矣，遇人之不涉淑矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·王風·中谷有蓷》有女仳離，條其嘯矣。條其嘯矣，遇人之不涉淑矣。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs: 'A woman is divorced, she sighs deeply. She sighs deeply, for she has met a man not good.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 金玉黄金和美玉。比喻可贵而有价值的劝告。
explanationTraditional: 金玉黃金和美玉。比喻可貴而有價值的勸告。
explanationEn: Valuable advice; golden words.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第四本第三折小姐金玉之言，小生一一铭之肺腑。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第四本第三折小姐金玉之言，小生一一銘之肺腑。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing': 'Miss's golden words, I will engrave them on my heart.'
example: 老哥哥教导的话，句句是～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 老哥哥教導的話，句句是～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十一回
exampleEn: The old brother's teachings are all golden words. ★ Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' (Chapter 11)

explanation: 孔孔子；孟孟子。指儒家学说。
explanationTraditional: 孔孔子；孟孟子。指儒家學說。
explanationEn: The teachings of Confucius and Mencius; Confucianism.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十回松闻曹丞相文不明孔孟之道，武不达孙吴之机，专务强霸而居大位，安能有所教诲，以开发明公耶？”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十回松聞曹丞相文不明孔孟之道，武不達孫吳之機，專務強霸而居大位，安能有所教誨，以開發明公耶？”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' (Chapter 60): 'I hear that Prime Minister Cao is not versed in the way of Confucius and Mencius, nor in the strategies of Sun and Wu...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 铺铺陈；叙叙述。说话或写文章不加修饰，没有起伏，重点不突出。
explanationTraditional: 鋪鋪陳；敘敘述。說話或寫文章不加修飾，沒有起伏，重點不突出。
explanationEn: To narrate in a plain, straightforward manner without embellishment or climax.
derivation: 清·钱谦益《初学集》卷八十三吾读子瞻《司马温公行状》之类，平铺直序（叙），以为古今未有此体。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢謙益《初學集》卷八十三吾讀子瞻《司馬溫公行狀》之類，平鋪直序（敘），以為古今未有此體。”
derivationEn: From Qian Qianyi's 'Chuxue Collection' (Volume 83): 'I read Zizhan's 'Sima Wengong's Biography' and found it plain and straightforward, thinking there had never been such a style.'
example: 这篇小说尽管大都是～，但读起来却令人潸然泪下。
exampleTraditional: 這篇小說盡管大都是～，但讀起來卻令人潸然淚下。
exampleEn: Although this novel is mostly plain and straightforward, it still brings tears to the reader's eyes.

explanation: 原指轻浮地议论妇女的容貌。现也比喻任意挑剔。
explanationTraditional: 原指輕浮地議論婦女的容貌。現也比喻任意挑剔。
explanationEn: Originally, to frivolously comment on a woman's appearance; now, to nitpick or find fault.
derivation: 清·黄小配《大马扁》第四回那全副精神又注在各妓，那个好颜色，那个好太度，评头品足，少不免要乱哦几句诗出来了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃小配《大馬扁》第四回那全副精神又注在各妓，那個好顏色，那個好太度，評頭品足，少不免要亂哦幾句詩出來了。”
derivationEn: From Huang Xiaopei's 'The Great Horse' (Chapter 4): 'His whole spirit was focused on the prostitutes, commenting on their looks and manners, and inevitably reciting a few poems.'
example: 你应该多干点实事，不要总～。
exampleTraditional: 你應該多幹點實事，不要總～。
exampleEn: You should do more practical work instead of always nitpicking.

explanation: 同生共死的交谊。
explanationTraditional: 同生共死的交誼。
explanationEn: A friendship that lasts through life and death; a sworn brotherhood.
derivation: 元·郑德辉《绉梅香》晋公在枪刀险难之中，我父亲挺身赴战，救他一命，身中六枪，因此上与俺父亲结为生死之交。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭德輝《縐梅香》晉公在槍刀險難之中，我父親挺身赴戰，救他一命，身中六槍，因此上與俺父親結為生死之交。”
derivationEn: From Zheng Dehui's 'Zou Meixiang': 'In the midst of danger, my father risked his life to save the Duke, and thus they became friends through life and death.'
example: 对于在老阎和梁建这一对～的老战友之间所发生的严重分歧，深深感到烦恼。★胡采《序》
exampleTraditional: 對於在老閻和梁建這一對～的老戰友之間所發生的嚴重分歧，深深感到煩惱。★胡採《序》
exampleEn: The serious differences between old Yan and Liang Jian, a pair of friends through life and death, deeply troubled him. ★ Hu Cai's 'Preface'

explanation: 大水来了，用土堵住。比喻敌人来犯，就引兵抵抗。
explanationTraditional: 大水來了，用土堵住。比喻敵人來犯，就引兵抵抗。
explanationEn: When water comes, use earth to block it; to take appropriate measures against an enemy or difficulty.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十三回岂不闻水来土掩，将至兵迎”？”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十三回豈不聞水來土掩，將至兵迎”？”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' (Chapter 73): 'Have you not heard that when water comes, earth blocks it, and when an enemy comes, troops meet him?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鹦鹉学人说话。比喻人家怎么说，他也跟着怎么说。
explanationTraditional: 鸚鵡學人說話。比喻人家怎麼說，他也跟著怎麼說。
explanationEn: To repeat others' words like a parrot; to echo without understanding.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷二十八如鹦鹉只学人言，不得人意。经传佛意；不得佛意而但诵，是学语人，所以不许。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷二十八如鸚鵡只學人言，不得人意。經傳佛意；不得佛意而但誦，是學語人，所以不許。”
derivationEn: From the 'Transmission of the Lamp' (Volume 28): 'Like a parrot that only repeats human speech without understanding the meaning.'
example: 领导说什么，他就说什么，简直是～。
exampleTraditional: 領導說什麼，他就說什麼，簡直是～。
exampleEn: Whatever the leader says, he repeats it; he's just parroting.

explanation: 双方不经过书面签字，只以口头承诺或交换函件而订立的协定，它与书面条约具有同等的效力。本用于国际事务间，后亦用为事先约定的套语。又称作绅士协定”。
explanationTraditional: 雙方不經過書面簽字，只以口頭承諾或交換函件而訂立的協定，它與書面條約具有同等的效力。本用於國際事務間，後亦用為事先約定的套語。又稱作紳士協定”。
explanationEn: A gentleman's agreement; an unwritten agreement based on trust.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 刻苦很能吃苦；耐禁得起、受得住。工作勤奋，经得住繁重的劳累。
explanationTraditional: 刻苦很能吃苦；耐禁得起、受得住。工作勤奮，經得住繁重的勞累。
explanationEn: To work hard and endure hardship; industrious and enduring.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 青云指青天；直上直线上升。指迅速升到很高的地位。
explanationTraditional: 青雲指青天；直上直線上升。指迅速升到很高的地位。
explanationEn: Rapid promotion to a high position.
derivation: 《史记·范睢蔡泽列传》贾不意君能自致于青云之上。”南朝齐·孔稚圭《北山移文》度白雪以方洁，干青云而直上。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·範睢蔡澤列傳》賈不意君能自致於青雲之上。”南朝齊·孔稚圭《北山移文》度白雪以方潔，幹青雲而直上。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian' and 'The Northern Mountain Relocation' by Kong Zhigui.
example: 洪承畴是万历年间的进士出身，登第时年岁很轻，从此步步～，一帆风顺。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第五章
exampleTraditional: 洪承疇是萬曆年間的進士出身，登第時年歲很輕，從此步步～，一帆風順。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第五章
exampleEn: Hong Chengchou was a Jinshi in the Wanli period, very young when he passed the imperial examination, and from then on he rose step by step, smoothly sailing. ★ Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 5

explanation: 寿命象终南山那样长久。用于祝人长寿。
explanationTraditional: 壽命象終南山那樣長久。用於祝人長壽。
explanationEn: Longevity as enduring as the Zhongnan Mountain. Used to wish someone a long life.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·天保》如月之恒，如日之升，如南山之寿。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·天保》如月之恆，如日之升，如南山之壽。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Tianbao': 'Like the moon ever waxing, like the sun ever rising, like the longevity of the Southern Mountain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 大白天做梦。比喻根本不能实现的梦想。
explanationTraditional: 大白天做夢。比喻根本不能實現的夢想。
explanationEn: Daydreaming; a fantasy that can never come true.
derivation: 明·豫章醉月子《精选雅笑·送匾》以为必中而遍问星相者，亦是白日做梦。”
derivationTraditional: 明·豫章醉月子《精選雅笑·送匾》以為必中而遍問星相者，亦是白日做夢。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty 'Selected Elegant Laughs: Sending Plaques' by Drunken Zuiyuezi of Yuzhang.
example: 换抠三县鬼迷心窍妄想回头！明摆着的，是你抠三县～。★谌容《万年青》五十七
exampleTraditional: 換摳三縣鬼迷心竅妄想回頭！明擺著的，是你摳三縣～。★諶容《萬年青》五十七
exampleEn: To think that Kou Sanxian is obsessed with turning back the clock! It's obvious, you Kou Sanxian are daydreaming. ★ Chen Rong, 'Wannian Qing', Chapter 57

explanation: 招招供。旧指没有用刑就招供。比喻做了坏事或有坏的意图自我暴露出来。
explanationTraditional: 招招供。舊指沒有用刑就招供。比喻做了壞事或有壞的意圖自我暴露出來。
explanationEn: To confess without being tortured; to reveal one's own guilt or bad intentions inadvertently.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第十七回也是个不打自招的怪物，他忽然说出道后日是他母难之日，邀请诸邪来作生日。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十七回也是個不打自招的怪物，他忽然說出道後日是他母難之日，邀請諸邪來作生日。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 17: 'He is also a monster who confesses without being beaten.'
example: 但是我还要说重庆发言人是个蠢猪，他～，向人国人民泄露了日本帝国主义的计划。★毛泽东《为皖南事变发表的命令和谈话》
exampleTraditional: 但是我還要說重慶發言人是個蠢豬，他～，向人國人民洩露了日本帝國主義的計劃。★毛澤東《為皖南事變發表的命令和談話》
exampleEn: But I still say that the Chongqing spokesman is a stupid pig; he confessed without being beaten, leaking the Japanese imperialists' plan to the Chinese people. ★ Mao Zedong, 'Orders and Talks on the Southern Anhui Incident'

explanation: 服信服。心里嘴上都信服。指真心信服。
explanationTraditional: 服信服。心裡嘴上都信服。指真心信服。
explanationEn: To be sincerely convinced, both in words and in heart.
derivation: 《庄子·寓言》利义陈乎前，而好恶是非直服人之口而已矣。使人乃以心服，而不敢蘤立，定天下之定。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·寓言》利義陳乎前，而好惡是非直服人之口而已矣。使人乃以心服，而不敢蘤立，定天下之定。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi, Fables': 'Setting forth benefits and righteousness before them, likes and dislikes, right and wrong only convince people's mouths. To make people convinced in their hearts...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 梁房梁。躲在梁上的君子。窃贼的代称。现在有时也指脱离实际、脱离群众的人。
explanationTraditional: 梁房梁。躲在樑上的君子。竊賊的代稱。現在有時也指脫離實際、脫離群眾的人。
explanationEn: A thief; also used metaphorically for someone out of touch with reality or the masses.
derivation: 《后汉书·陈寔传》时岁荒民俭，有盗夜入其室，止于梁上。寔阴见，乃起自整拂，呼命子孙，正色训之曰‘夫人不可以不自勉。不善之人未必本恶，習以性成，遂至于此。梁上君子者是矣！”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·陳寔傳》時歲荒民儉，有盜夜入其室，止於樑上。寔陰見，乃起自整拂，呼命子孫，正色訓之曰‘夫人不可以不自勉。不善之人未必本惡，習以性成，遂至於此。樑上君子者是矣！”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han, Biography of Chen Shi': 'During a famine, a thief entered his room at night and hid on a beam. Chen saw him, called his descendants, and said, 'A gentleman on the beam is like this!''
example: 邑西某乙，故～也。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·某乙》
exampleTraditional: 邑西某乙，故～也。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·某乙》
exampleEn: A certain Yi in the west of the city was formerly a gentleman on the beam. ★ Qing dynasty Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, A Certain Yi'

explanation: 上下有共同的愿望，谓众心齐一。
explanationTraditional: 上下有共同的願望，謂眾心齊一。
explanationEn: Unity of purpose from top to bottom; all share the same desire.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一听到消息就来。形容行动迅速。
explanationTraditional: 一聽到消息就來。形容行動迅速。
explanationEn: To arrive upon hearing the news; to act swiftly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 雪洗刷掉。报冤仇，除仇恨。
explanationTraditional: 雪洗刷掉。報冤仇，除仇恨。
explanationEn: To take revenge and wipe out a grudge.
derivation: 《淮南子·氾论训》（文）种辅翼越王勾践。而为之报怨雪耻。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·氾論訓》（文）種輔翼越王勾踐。而為之報怨雪恥。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi, On the Art of Ruling': 'Wen Zhong assisted King Goujian of Yue to take revenge and wipe out shame.'
example: 滥官害民贱徒，把我全家诛戮，今日正好报仇雪恨！★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第五十八回
exampleTraditional: 濫官害民賤徒，把我全家誅戮，今日正好報仇雪恨！★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第五十八回
exampleEn: The corrupt officials harmed the people and killed my whole family; today I will take revenge and wipe out the grudge! ★ Ming dynasty Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 58

explanation: 朝野指朝廷和民间；上下从中央到地方。指从中央到地方，从做官的到老百姓。
explanationTraditional: 朝野指朝廷和民間；上下從中央到地方。指從中央到地方，從做官的到老百姓。
explanationEn: From the court to the countryside, from the central to the local; all levels of society.
derivation: 清·魏源《治篇十一》其朝野上下，莫不玩细娱而苟近安，安其危而利其害。”
derivationTraditional: 清·魏源《治篇十一》其朝野上下，莫不玩細娛而苟近安，安其危而利其害。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Wei Yuan's 'On Governance, Chapter 11': 'The court and the countryside, from top to bottom, all indulge in trivial pleasures and seek temporary peace.'
example: 若其栋梁方颓，樽俎犹昔，～，犹嘤鸣娱乐，颜色无改，斯非意重辞复，难可曲喻。★章炳麟《〈正学报〉缘起》
exampleTraditional: 若其棟樑方頹，樽俎猶昔，～，猶嚶鳴娛樂，顏色無改，斯非意重辭復，難可曲喻。★章炳麟《〈正學報〉緣起》
exampleEn: If the pillars are about to collapse, yet the feasting continues as before, and from court to countryside, from top to bottom, they still sing and entertain with unchanged expressions, this is hard to explain. ★ Zhang Binglin, 'Preface to the Zhengxuebao'

explanation: 造制作；设安排。指事物自然形成，合乎理想，不必再加人工。
explanationTraditional: 造製作；設安排。指事物自然形成，合乎理想，不必再加人工。
explanationEn: Naturally formed or arranged, ideal without artificial modification.
derivation: 宋·赵佶（徽宗）《艮岳记》真天造地设，神谋化力，非人力所能为者。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·趙佶（徽宗）《艮嶽記》真天造地設，神謀化力，非人力所能為者。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Zhao Ji (Emperor Huizong) 'Gen Yue Ji': 'Truly created by heaven and arranged by earth, divinely planned, not something human power can achieve.'
example: ～，待人而发。★宋·楼钥《扬州平山堂记》
exampleTraditional: ～，待人而發。★宋·樓鑰《揚州平山堂記》
exampleEn: Waiting for people to discover. (Song Dynasty Lou Yao 'Yangzhou Pingshan Hall Record')

explanation: 同时具有文才和武才，文武双全。亦作文武兼济”、文武兼全”。
explanationTraditional: 同時具有文才和武才，文武雙全。亦作文武兼濟”、文武兼全”。
explanationEn: Having both literary and martial abilities; versatile in civil and military affairs.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 交共。悲伤和喜悦的心情交织在一起。
explanationTraditional: 交共。悲傷和喜悅的心情交織在一起。
explanationEn: Mixed feelings of sadness and joy intertwined.
derivation: 《晋书·王弇传》当大明之盛，而守局遐外，不得奉瞻大礼，闻问之日，悲喜交集。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王弇傳》當大明之盛，而守局遐外，不得奉瞻大禮，聞問之日，悲喜交集。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin: Biography of Wang Yan': 'In the era of great prosperity, I was stationed far away, unable to attend the grand ceremony. Upon hearing the news, I felt a mix of sadness and joy.'
example: ～的父亲紧紧抱住了久别的儿子。
exampleTraditional: ～的父親緊緊抱住了久別的兒子。
exampleEn: The father, with mixed feelings of sadness and joy, tightly hugged his long-lost son.

explanation: 锐锐气；当抵挡。形容勇往直前的气势，不可抵挡。
explanationTraditional: 銳銳氣；當抵擋。形容勇往直前的氣勢，不可抵擋。
explanationEn: Describing an unstoppable forward momentum; overwhelming force.
derivation: 《后汉书·吴汉传》其锋不可当。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·吳漢傳》其鋒不可當。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Wu Han': 'His edge is irresistible.'
example: 那是～，无坚不摧的。★欧阳山《三家巷》八
exampleTraditional: 那是～，無堅不摧的。★歐陽山《三家巷》八
exampleEn: It was unstoppable and invincible. (Ouyang Shan 'Three Family Lane' Chapter 8)

explanation: 一脉一个血统。从同一血统、派别世代相承流传下来。批某种思想、行为或学说之间有继承关系。
explanationTraditional: 一脈一個血統。從同一血統、派別世代相承流傳下來。批某種思想、行為或學說之間有繼承關係。
explanationEn: Passed down from the same bloodline or school through generations; referring to inheritance in thought, behavior, or doctrine.
derivation: 鲁迅《华盖集续编·无花的蔷薇之三》北京的流言报，是从袁世凯称帝，张勋复辟，章士钊‘整顿学风’以还，一脉相传，历来如此的。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《華蓋集續編·無花的薔薇之三》北京的流言報，是從袁世凱稱帝，張勳復辟，章士釗‘整頓學風’以還，一脈相傳，歷來如此的。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun 'Huagai Collection Continued: Roses Without Thorns III': 'Beijing's rumor newspapers have been passed down in a continuous line from Yuan Shikai's monarchy, Zhang Xun's restoration, Zhang Shizhao's 'rectification of academic style' to the present.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 迷糊涂，迷惑。指当事人反而糊涂。
explanationTraditional: 迷糊塗，迷惑。指當事人反而糊塗。
explanationEn: Those involved in a situation are often confused; outsiders see more clearly.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《恋绣衾·无题》我自是笑别人的，却元来当局者迷。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《戀繡衾·無題》我自是笑別人的，卻元來當局者迷。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Xin Qiji 'Love Embroidered Jacket: Untitled': 'I laugh at others, but it turns out the one involved is confused.'
example: 希望我们大家互相勉励……～，旁观者清，我们应该有则改之，无则加勉。★邹韬奋《事业管理与职业修养·关于工作与学习五》
exampleTraditional: 希望我們大家互相勉勵……～，旁觀者清，我們應該有則改之，無則加勉。★鄒韜奮《事業管理與職業修養·關於工作與學習五》
exampleEn: I hope we can encourage each other... 'The onlooker sees the game best'; we should correct if we have faults and guard against them if not. (Zou Taofen 'Career Management and Professional Ethics: On Work and Study V')

explanation: 佛教指阿弥陀佛居住的地方◇泛指幸福安乐的地方。
explanationTraditional: 佛教指阿彌陀佛居住的地方◇泛指幸福安樂的地方。
explanationEn: In Buddhism, the paradise where Amitabha resides; generally refers to a place of happiness and bliss.
derivation: 《阿弥陀经》从是西方，过十万亿佛土，有世界名曰极乐。”
derivationTraditional: 《阿彌陀經》從是西方，過十萬億佛土，有世界名曰極樂。”
derivationEn: 'Amitabha Sutra': 'From here to the west, past a hundred thousand billion Buddha lands, there is a world called Ultimate Bliss.'
example: 细观此景，与我大唐何异！所为～，诚此之谓也。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第八十八回
exampleTraditional: 細觀此景，與我大唐何異！所為～，誠此之謂也。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第八十八回
exampleEn: Looking closely at this scene, how is it different from our Tang Dynasty! This is what is called the Ultimate Bliss World. (Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en 'Journey to the West' Chapter 88)

explanation: 重新来到曾经居住过或游览过的地方。
explanationTraditional: 重新來到曾經居住過或遊覽過的地方。
explanationEn: To revisit a place where one has lived or traveled before.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他此番～，感慨万千。
exampleTraditional: 他此番～，感慨萬千。
exampleEn: He revisited the old place, filled with myriad emotions.

explanation: 旦夕早晚之间，形容极短的时间。生命垂危，很快会死去。
explanationTraditional: 旦夕早晚之間，形容極短的時間。生命垂危，很快會死去。
explanationEn: Life hanging by a thread; on the verge of death.
derivation: 唐·陈子昂《为建安王与诸将书》尽病水肿，命在旦夕。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·陳子昂《為建安王與諸將書》盡病水腫，命在旦夕。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty Chen Zi'ang 'Letter to the Princes for Jian'an': 'Suffering from edema, life hangs in the balance.'
example: 今日之中国，又积数千年之沈疴，合四百兆之痼疾，盘踞膏肓，～者也。★清·梁启超《新民说·附录》
exampleTraditional: 今日之中國，又積數千年之沈痾，合四百兆之痼疾，盤踞膏肓，～者也。★清·梁啟超《新民說·附錄》
exampleEn: Today's China, with accumulated chronic illnesses and deep-rooted diseases, is on the brink of death. (Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao 'New Citizen Theory: Appendix')

explanation: 形容极度不安。
explanationTraditional: 形容極度不安。
explanationEn: Feeling extremely uneasy, as if having thorns on one's back.
derivation: 《汉书·霍光传》宣帝始立，谒见高庙，大将军光从骖乘。上内严惮之，若有芒刺在背。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·霍光傳》宣帝始立，謁見高廟，大將軍光從驂乘。上內嚴憚之，若有芒刺在背。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Huo Guang': 'When Emperor Xuan first ascended, he visited the Gaomiao Temple, with General Huo Guang riding as his attendant. The emperor was deeply afraid of him, as if having thorns on his back.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 行动笨拙的鸟要先飞。比喻能力差的人怕落后，做事比别人先动手。
explanationTraditional: 行動笨拙的鳥要先飛。比喻能力差的人怕落後，做事比別人先動手。
explanationEn: A clumsy bird must start flying early. Used to describe someone who is less capable but works harder or starts earlier to avoid falling behind.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《陈母教子》第一折我和你有个比喻我似那灵禽在后，你这等坌（笨）鸟先飞。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《陳母教子》第一折我和你有個比喻我似那靈禽在後，你這等坌（笨）鳥先飛。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's play 'Chen Mu Teaches Her Son': 'I am like the clever bird flying behind, while you are like the clumsy bird flying ahead.'
example: 女儿刻苦、自觉、用功，全靠～保持了各门功课全班第一。★毕飞宇《九层电梯》
exampleTraditional: 女兒刻苦、自覺、用功，全靠～保持了各門功課全班第一。★畢飛宇《九層電梯》
exampleEn: My daughter is hardworking, self-disciplined, and diligent. She relies on the principle of 'the slow need to start early' to maintain top grades in all subjects. (Bi Feiyu, 'Nine-Story Elevator')

explanation: 神速特别迅速。用兵贵在行动特别迅速。
explanationTraditional: 神速特別迅速。用兵貴在行動特別迅速。
explanationEn: Speed is crucial in military operations. Emphasizes the importance of swift action in warfare.
derivation: 《孙子·九地》兵之情主速。”《三国志·魏书·郭嘉传》太祖将征袁尚及三郡乌丸。……嘉言曰‘兵贵神速。’”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·九地》兵之情主速。”《三國志·魏書·郭嘉傳》太祖將徵袁尚及三郡烏丸。……嘉言曰‘兵貴神速。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Art of War' by Sun Tzu: 'Speed is the essence of war.' And 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Guo Jia': 'The Emperor was about to attack Yuan Shang and the three Wuhuan tribes... Guo Jia said: 'Speed is vital in military operations.''
example: ～，今夜分四路去劫大寨，杀得他只轮不返。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第七回
exampleTraditional: ～，今夜分四路去劫大寨，殺得他隻輪不返。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第七回
exampleEn: Speed is crucial in war. Tonight we will attack the enemy camp from four directions, leaving them no chance to escape. (Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 7)

explanation: 插上翅膀也难逃走。比喻陷入困境，怎么也逃不了。
explanationTraditional: 插上翅膀也難逃走。比喻陷入困境，怎麼也逃不了。
explanationEn: Even with wings, it's hard to escape. Describes a situation where escape is impossible.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《寄崔二十六立之》诗安有巢中鷇，插翅飞天陲。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《寄崔二十六立之》詩安有巢中鷇，插翅飛天陲。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's poem 'To Cui Lishi': 'How can a nestling, even with wings, fly to the edge of the sky?'
example: 重耳虽～也。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第三十六回
exampleTraditional: 重耳雖～也。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第三十六回
exampleEn: Even if Chong'er had wings, he could not escape. (Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 36)

explanation: 插锥尖的一点地方。形容极小的一块地方。也指极小的安身之处。
explanationTraditional: 插錐尖的一點地方。形容極小的一塊地方。也指極小的安身之處。
explanationEn: A place just big enough to stick an awl. Refers to a very small piece of land or a tiny place to live.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》尧舜有天下，子孙无置锥之地。”《史记·留侯世家》灭六国之后，使无立锥之地。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》堯舜有天下，子孫無置錐之地。”《史記·留侯世家》滅六國之後，使無立錐之地。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Robber Zhi': 'Yao and Shun had the world, but their descendants had no place to stick an awl.' And 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Zhang Liang': 'After destroying the six states, they left them no place to stand an awl.'
example: 天地如此之大，难道竟连一个十八岁的女孩子的～都没有？★杨沫《青春之歌》第一部第四章
exampleTraditional: 天地如此之大，難道竟連一個十八歲的女孩子的～都沒有？★楊沫《青春之歌》第一部第四章
exampleEn: The world is so vast, yet there is no place for an eighteen-year-old girl to stand? (Yang Mo, 'The Song of Youth', Chapter 4)

explanation: 逢相遇。下棋遇到对手。比喻争斗的双方本领不相上下。
explanationTraditional: 逢相遇。下棋遇到對手。比喻爭鬥的雙方本領不相上下。
explanationEn: Meeting one's match in chess. Describes two opponents who are evenly matched in skill.
derivation: 《晋书·谢安传》安常棋劣于玄，是日玄惧，便为敌手而又不胜。”唐·杜荀鹤《观棋》诗有时逢敌手，对局到深更。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·謝安傳》安常棋劣於玄，是日玄懼，便為敵手而又不勝。”唐·杜荀鶴《觀棋》詩有時逢敵手，對局到深更。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Xie An': 'An was usually inferior to Xuan in chess, but that day Xuan was afraid and played as an equal but lost.' And Tang Dynasty Du Xunhe's poem 'Watching Chess': 'Sometimes meeting a worthy opponent, playing until late at night.'
example: 他两个在半空中，这场好杀～，将遇良才。（明·吴承恩《西游记》第三十四回）
exampleTraditional: 他兩個在半空中，這場好殺～，將遇良才。（明·吳承恩《西遊記》第三十四回）
exampleEn: The two of them fought in midair, a fine battle of equals meeting their match. (Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 34)

explanation: 与邻者亲近，与邻邦友好。
explanationTraditional: 與鄰者親近，與鄰邦友好。
explanationEn: To be close to benevolent people and maintain good relations with neighbors. Emphasizes harmony and kindness in interpersonal and international relations.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 《周易》称爻连的为阳卦，断的为阴爻，正月为泰卦，三阳生于下；冬去春来，阴消阳长，有吉亨之象。常用以称颂岁首或寓意吉祥。
explanationTraditional: 《周易》稱爻連的為陽卦，斷的為陰爻，正月為泰卦，三陽生於下；冬去春來，陰消陽長，有吉亨之象。常用以稱頌歲首或寓意吉祥。
explanationEn: Three yangs bring prosperity. Refers to the beginning of spring when yin wanes and yang waxes, symbolizing good fortune and auspiciousness, often used to celebrate the New Year.
derivation: 《易·泰》泰，小往大来，吉亨。”《宋史·乐志》三阳交泰，日新惟良。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·泰》泰，小往大來，吉亨。”《宋史·樂志》三陽交泰，日新惟良。”
derivationEn: From 'I Ching: Tai Hexagram': 'Tai means small goes and great comes, good fortune.' And 'History of Song: Music Records': 'Three yangs intermingle, daily renewal is good.'
example: 设此三羊，以应开泰之言，唤做～”，破解你师之否塞也。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第九十一回
exampleTraditional: 設此三羊，以應開泰之言，喚做～”，破解你師之否塞也。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第九十一回
exampleEn: Set these three sheep to symbolize the beginning of prosperity, called 'Three Yangs Bring Prosperity', to break your master's misfortune. (Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 91)

explanation: 态度傲慢，对人不讲礼节。
explanationTraditional: 態度傲慢，對人不講禮節。
explanationEn: Arrogant and disrespectful. Describes someone who is haughty and lacks manners.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·三嗣主传》裴松之注引孙皓侍中李仁之言视人君相忤，是乃祀所谓傲慢；傲慢则无礼，无礼则不臣，不臣则犯罪，犯罪则陷不测矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·三嗣主傳》裴松之注引孫皓侍中李仁之言視人君相忤，是乃祀所謂傲慢；傲慢則無禮，無禮則不臣，不臣則犯罪，犯罪則陷不測矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Biography of the Three Lords' annotated by Pei Songzhi: 'To be arrogant is to be rude, to be rude is to be disloyal, to be disloyal is to commit a crime, and to commit a crime leads to disaster.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 壁立峭壁陡立。形容岩石高耸。
explanationTraditional: 壁立峭壁陡立。形容岩石高聳。
explanationEn: A cliff stands a thousand ren high. Describes a steep, towering rock face.
derivation: 晋·张载《剑阁铭》惟蜀之门，作固作镇，是日剑阁，壁立千仞。”《水经·河水注》其山惟石，壁立千仞，临之目眩。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·張載《劍閣銘》惟蜀之門，作固作鎮，是日劍閣，壁立千仞。”《水經·河水注》其山惟石，壁立千仞，臨之目眩。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Zhang Zai's 'Inscription on Sword Pass': 'The gate of Shu is a solid fortress, called Sword Pass, with cliffs a thousand ren high.' And 'Commentary on the Water Classic: River Waters': 'The mountain is all rock, cliffs a thousand ren high, dazzling to look at.'
example: 海纳百川，有容乃大。～，无欲则刚。
exampleTraditional: 海納百川，有容乃大。～，無欲則剛。
exampleEn: The sea accepts all rivers, thus it is vast. A cliff stands a thousand ren high, thus it is desireless.

explanation: 单刀一把刀，指一个人。原指蜀将关羽只带一口刀和少数随从赴东吴宴会◇泛指一个人冒险赴约。有赞扬赴会者的智略和胆识之意。
explanationTraditional: 單刀一把刀，指一個人。原指蜀將關羽只帶一口刀和少數隨從赴東吳宴會◇泛指一個人冒險赴約。有讚揚赴會者的智略和膽識之意。
explanationEn: To attend a meeting alone with a single sword. Refers to someone going to a dangerous meeting alone, showing courage and resourcefulness.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·鲁肃传》肃邀羽相见，各驻兵马百步上，但请将军单刀赴会。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·魯肅傳》肅邀羽相見，各駐兵馬百步上，但請將軍單刀赴會。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Biography of Lu Su': 'Lu Su invited Guan Yu to meet, each stationing their troops a hundred paces away, and asked the general to come alone with a single sword.'
example: 吾来日独驾小舟，只用亲随十余人，～，看鲁肃如何近我。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十六回
exampleTraditional: 吾來日獨駕小舟，只用親隨十餘人，～，看魯肅如何近我。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十六回
exampleEn: Tomorrow I will sail a small boat with only a dozen attendants, and go to the meeting alone with a single sword, to see how Lu Su can approach me. (Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 66)

explanation: 形容中年妇女仍然保留着优美的风姿。
explanationTraditional: 形容中年婦女仍然保留著優美的風姿。
explanationEn: Describes a middle-aged woman who still retains her graceful charm.
derivation: 清·王韬《淞隐漫录》其母虽属徐娘，丰韵犹饶，老蚌固宜出此明珠。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王韜《淞隱漫錄》其母雖屬徐娘，丰韻猶饒，老蚌固宜出此明珠。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wang Tao's 'Songyin Manlu': 'Her mother, though middle-aged, still had abundant charm; an old clam should indeed produce such a pearl.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 郎旧指女子对丈夫或情人的称呼。男的有才气，女的有美貌。形容男女双方很相配。
explanationTraditional: 郎舊指女子對丈夫或情人的稱呼。男的有才氣，女的有美貌。形容男女雙方很相配。
explanationEn: The man is talented and the woman is beautiful; describes a well-matched couple.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《望乡亭》第一折您两口子正是郎才女貌，天然配合。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《望鄉亭》第一折您兩口子正是郎才女貌，天然配合。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing's 'Wangxiang Ting', first act: 'You two are exactly a talented man and a beautiful woman, a natural match.'
example: 夫人太过虑，小生空妄想，～合相仿。（元·王实甫《西厢记》第一本第二折）
exampleTraditional: 夫人太過慮，小生空妄想，～合相仿。（元·王實甫《西廂記》第一本第二折）
