derivationEn: From Qing Liang Qichao, 'On the Young China': 'If they treat it indifferently, it is understandable; if we treat it indifferently, it is unforgivable.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 无所不知，无所不能。
explanationTraditional: 無所不知，無所不能。
explanationEn: Omniscient and omnipotent; knowing everything and being capable of everything.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 宇宙尚且有缺点，世界上并无～的上帝。（茅盾《锻炼》十三）
exampleTraditional: 宇宙尚且有缺點，世界上並無～的上帝。（茅盾《鍛鍊》十三）
exampleEn: Even the universe has flaws, and there is no omniscient and omnipotent God in the world. (Mao Dun, 'Exercise' Chapter 13)

explanation: 旧时比喻女子老了被轻视，就象因年代久远而失去光泽的珍珠一样不值钱。
explanationTraditional: 舊時比喻女子老了被輕視，就象因年代久遠而失去光澤的珍珠一樣不值錢。
explanationEn: A metaphor for a woman who is despised as she ages, like a pearl that has lost its luster over time.
derivation: 明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第二回娘子正在青年，翻身的日子很有呢，不像俺是人老珠黄不值钱呢。”
derivationTraditional: 明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第二回娘子正在青年，翻身的日子很有呢，不像俺是人老珠黃不值錢呢。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng, 'Jin Ping Mei' Chapter 2: 'You are still young, with plenty of time to turn things around. Unlike me, who is old and worthless like a yellowed pearl.'
example: 真正～不值钱，走了这点点路，果然就吃力起来，我也要回去睡个觉呢。（清·吴趼人《瞎编奇闻》第七回）
exampleTraditional: 真正～不值錢，走了這點點路，果然就吃力起來，我也要回去睡個覺呢。（清·吳趼人《瞎編奇聞》第七回）
exampleEn: Truly, when one is old and worthless like a yellowed pearl, even walking a short distance becomes tiring. I should go back and take a nap. (Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Stories' Chapter 7)

explanation: 误耽误。指因无才或不负责任而耽误人家后辈学生。
explanationTraditional: 誤耽誤。指因無才或不負責任而耽誤人家後輩學生。
explanationEn: To harm or delay the education of young students due to incompetence or irresponsibility.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第19回先生犯了这样小错，就要打手心，那终日旷功误人子弟的，岂不都要打杀么？”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第19回先生犯了這樣小錯，就要打手心，那終日曠功誤人子弟的，豈不都要打殺麼？”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 19: 'If a teacher makes such a small mistake and gets his palm beaten, then those who waste time and harm students all day should be beaten to death, shouldn't they?'
example: 不料‘思想权威者’或‘思想界先驱者’这一顶‘纸糊的假冠’，竟又是如此～。★鲁迅《华盖集续编的续编·厦门通信三》
exampleTraditional: 不料‘思想權威者’或‘思想界先驅者’這一頂‘紙糊的假冠’，竟又是如此～。★魯迅《華蓋集續編的續編·廈門通信三》
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, the 'thought authority' or 'pioneer of thought' crown made of paper turned out to be so harmful to the younger generation. (Lu Xun, 'Huagai Collection Continued Sequel: Xiamen Correspondence 3')

explanation: 言句首助词，无义。指彼此重新和好。
explanationTraditional: 言句首助詞，無義。指彼此重新和好。
explanationEn: To reconcile and become friendly again.
derivation: 《左传·僖公九年》凡我同盟之人，既盟之后，言归于好。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公九年》凡我同盟之人，既盟之後，言歸於好。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's Ninth Year': 'All of us who are allies, after forming the alliance, shall return to goodwill.'
example: 奉教撤兵，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五回
exampleTraditional: 奉教撤兵，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五回
exampleEn: Following the instruction to withdraw troops, they reconciled and became friendly again. (Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 5)

explanation: 经经过。一定要经过的道路。亦作必由之路”。
explanationTraditional: 經經過。一定要經過的道路。亦作必由之路”。
explanationEn: A road that must be taken; a necessary path.
derivation: 老舍《无名高地有了名》十九二十五号才是敌人反扑必经之路，那里高，那里窄，我们不易仰攻，也无法多用人力。我们须在适当时间，放弃了它，坚守主峰和二十七号。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《無名高地有了名》十九二十五號才是敵人反撲必經之路，那裡高，那裡窄，我們不易仰攻，也無法多用人力。我們須在適當時間，放棄了它，堅守主峰和二十七號。”
derivationEn: Lao She, 'The Nameless Heights Have a Name' Chapter 19: 'Hill 25 is the only way for the enemy to counterattack. It is high and narrow, making it difficult for us to attack from below or use many troops. We must, at the right time, abandon it and hold the main peak and Hill 27.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 造次仓促、莽撞。指不敢匆忙地或鲁莽地从事。
explanationTraditional: 造次倉促、莽撞。指不敢匆忙地或魯莽地從事。
explanationEn: Not daring to act hastily or rashly.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷十九恁么即某甲不敢造次。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷十九恁麼即某甲不敢造次。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan, 'Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp' Volume 19: 'In that case, I dare not act rashly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 放浪放荡；形骸人的形体。指行动不受世俗礼节的束缚。
explanationTraditional: 放浪放蕩；形骸人的形體。指行動不受世俗禮節的束縛。
explanationEn: To be unrestrained and free from世俗 conventions; to let one's behavior go beyond social norms.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《兰亭集序》或因寄所托，放浪形骸之外。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《蘭亭集序》或因寄所託，放浪形骸之外。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Wang Xizhi, 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection': 'Some entrust their feelings and let their bodies roam freely beyond the confines of the physical form.'
example: 惟有与宝翟谝黄穑他才可以忘却自己的身份，～，领略人贵适意”的真趣。★高阳《玉座珠帘》上册
exampleTraditional: 惟有與寶翟諞黃穡他才可以忘卻自己的身份，～，領略人貴適意”的真趣。★高陽《玉座珠簾》上冊
exampleEn: Only with Bao Zhai could he forget his status, let himself go beyond conventions, and experience the true pleasure of 'being at ease.' (Gao Yang, 'Jade Pearl Throne' Volume 1)

explanation: 被围困的野兽还要作最后挣扎。比喻在绝境中还要挣扎抵抗。
explanationTraditional: 被圍困的野獸還要作最後掙扎。比喻在絕境中還要掙扎抵抗。
explanationEn: A trapped beast still fights; someone in a desperate situation will still struggle and resist.
derivation: 《左传·定公四年》困兽犹斗，况人呼？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·定公四年》困獸猶鬥，況人呼？”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Ding's Fourth Year': 'A trapped beast still fights, let alone a man?'
example: 况～，背城一战，尚有不可测之事乎？★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十九
exampleTraditional: 況～，背城一戰，尚有不可測之事乎？★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十九
exampleEn: Moreover, a trapped beast still fights; if we make a last stand, who knows what might happen? (Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 79)

explanation: 立身做人；处世在社会上活动，与人交往。指人在社会上待人接物的种种活动。
explanationTraditional: 立身做人；處世在社會上活動，與人交往。指人在社會上待人接物的種種活動。
explanationEn: To conduct oneself in society; to behave and interact with others.
derivation: 晋·无名氏《沙弥十戒法并威仪序》夫乾坤覆载，以人为贵；立身处世，以礼仪为本。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·無名氏《沙彌十戒法並威儀序》夫乾坤覆載，以人為貴；立身處世，以禮儀為本。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Preface to the Ten Precepts for Novices and the Rules of Conduct': 'Heaven and earth cover and support all things, with humans being the most precious; to conduct oneself in society, propriety and righteousness are the foundation.'
example: 我们要在社会里混出头，只求不僵，只求不落伍，这是现代人～的名言。★鲁迅《伪自由书·颂萧》
exampleTraditional: 我們要在社會里混出頭，只求不僵，只求不落伍，這是現代人～的名言。★魯迅《偽自由書·頌蕭》
exampleEn: To get ahead in society, we only need to avoid being rigid or left behind. This is the motto of modern people in conducting themselves. (Lu Xun, 'Pseudo-Free Book: In Praise of Xiao')

explanation: 改变原来外形，使人不认识他。
explanationTraditional: 改變原來外形，使人不認識他。
explanationEn: To disguise oneself; to change one's appearance so as not to be recognized.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 每个国家都应严防他国～的间谍与特务分子的渗透。
exampleTraditional: 每個國家都應嚴防他國～的間諜與特務分子的滲透。
exampleEn: Every country should guard against infiltration by disguised spies and agents from other countries.

explanation: 两种言论或行为完全一样。
explanationTraditional: 兩種言論或行為完全一樣。
explanationEn: Two statements or actions are exactly the same.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 烁光亮的样子。震动古代，显耀当世。形容事业或功绩非常伟大。
explanationTraditional: 爍光亮的樣子。震動古代，顯耀當世。形容事業或功績非常偉大。
explanationEn: Shaking the ancient and shining in the present; describes a great achievement or merit.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一二六回吴帅无论怎样威望，怎比得上老帅的勋高望重，震古烁今。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一二六回吳帥無論怎樣威望，怎比得上老帥的勳高望重，震古爍今。”
derivationEn: Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 126: 'No matter how prestigious General Wu is, he cannot compare to the old general's high merit and great reputation, shaking the ancient and shining in the present.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 争夺名位和利益。
explanationTraditional: 爭奪名位和利益。
explanationEn: To vie for fame and gain.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第一回争名夺利几时休？早起迟眠不自由！”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第一回爭名奪利幾時休？早起遲眠不自由！”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 1: 'When will the struggle for fame and gain ever cease? Rising early and sleeping late, without freedom!'
example: 我如今也谱得《道情》十首，无非唤醒痴聋，销除烦恼……若遇～之场，正好觉人觉世。★清·关燮《序》
exampleTraditional: 我如今也譜得《道情》十首，無非喚醒痴聾，銷除煩惱……若遇～之場，正好覺人覺世。★清·關燮《序》
exampleEn: Now I have also composed ten 'Daoist Songs', nothing more than to awaken the deaf and foolish, to eliminate worries... If one encounters a place of vying for fame and gain, it is just the time to awaken people and enlighten the world. — Qing Dynasty, Guan Xie, 'Preface'

explanation: 准备好了，以备急用，眼下暂存不用。
explanationTraditional: 準備好了，以備急用，眼下暫存不用。
explanationEn: Prepared but not used; kept for emergency but temporarily unused.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《糊涂世界》虽说备而不用，到得那时候，听凭兵丁造一句谣言，开上几排枪，那人可就死了不少。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《糊塗世界》雖說備而不用，到得那時候，聽憑兵丁造一句謠言，開上幾排槍，那人可就死了不少。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'The World of Confusion': 'Although it is prepared but not used, when the time comes, if the soldiers make a rumor and fire a few volleys, many people will die.'
example: 凡是零星物件，本地买不出，一定要用，或是～的，也都齐全。★清·颐琐《黄绣球》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 凡是零星物件，本地買不出，一定要用，或是～的，也都齊全。★清·頤瑣《黃繡球》第十七回
exampleEn: All miscellaneous items that cannot be bought locally, but must be used, or those prepared but not used, are all complete. — Qing Dynasty, Yi Suo, 'Huang Xiuqiu', Chapter 17

explanation: 原指符合封建秩序的姻缘◇泛指美好的姻缘。
explanationTraditional: 原指符合封建秩序的姻緣◇泛指美好的姻緣。
explanationEn: Originally refers to a marriage that conforms to feudal order; generally refers to a happy marriage.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五回都道是金玉良缘，俺只念木石前盟。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五回都道是金玉良緣，俺只念木石前盟。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 5: 'Everyone says it is a golden and jade marriage, but I only think of the stone and wood alliance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 卷帙书籍或书籍的篇章。形容书籍很多或一部书的部头很大。
explanationTraditional: 卷帙書籍或書籍的篇章。形容書籍很多或一部書的部頭很大。
explanationEn: Describes a vast number of books or a very large volume.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》第九十六回卷帙浩繁，也恐一时纸价腾贵，赀力不给。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》第九十六回卷帙浩繁，也恐一時紙價騰貴，貲力不給。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Luyuan, 'The Lantern at the Crossroads', Chapter 96: 'The volumes are vast and numerous, and I fear that the price of paper may soar and funds may be insufficient.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 孔甚，很。形容人很有力气。
explanationTraditional: 孔甚，很。形容人很有力氣。
explanationEn: Describes a person who is very strong.
derivation: 《诗经·郑风·羔裘》羔裘豹饰，孔武有力，彼其之子，邦之司直。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·鄭風·羔裘》羔裘豹飾，孔武有力，彼其之子，邦之司直。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Songs, Zheng Feng, Lamb Fur': 'Lamb fur with leopard trim, very martial and strong; that man is the director of the state.'
example: 孜渐长，～，喜田猎，不务生产，乐斗好杀。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·鸦头》
exampleTraditional: 孜漸長，～，喜田獵，不務生產，樂鬥好殺。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·鴉頭》
exampleEn: Zi gradually grew up, was very martial and strong, loved hunting, did not engage in production, and enjoyed fighting and killing. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio, Crow Head'

explanation: 六畜牛、马、羊、猪、鸡、狗。指各种牲畜、家禽繁衍兴旺。
explanationTraditional: 六畜牛、馬、羊、豬、雞、狗。指各種牲畜、家禽繁衍興旺。
explanationEn: The six domestic animals (ox, horse, sheep, pig, chicken, dog) are thriving; refers to the prosperity of livestock and poultry.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 五谷丰登，六畜兴旺。
exampleTraditional: 五穀豐登，六畜興旺。
exampleEn: Abundant harvest of five grains, thriving of six domestic animals.

explanation: 盐任用贤能的人。与，通举”。亦作选贤任能”、选贤举能”。
explanationTraditional: 鹽任用賢能的人。與，通舉”。亦作選賢任能”、選賢舉能”。
explanationEn: To select the virtuous and appoint the capable. '与' is a variant of '举' (to recommend). Also written as '选贤任能' or '选贤举能'.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》大道之行也，天下为公，选贤与能，讲售修睦。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》大道之行也，天下為公，選賢與能，講售修睦。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Rites, Li Yun': 'When the great Way prevails, the world is for all; select the virtuous and appoint the capable, speak of trust and cultivate harmony.'
example: ～，于今虽重。★唐韩愈《除崔群户部侍郎制》
exampleTraditional: ～，於今雖重。★唐韓愈《除崔群戶部侍郎制》
exampleEn: Selecting the virtuous and appointing the capable is important even today. — Tang Dynasty, Han Yu, 'Edict Appointing Cui Qun as Vice Minister of Revenue'

explanation: 如是如此，这样；观看，看法。抱这样的看法。泛指对某一事物作如此的看法。
explanationTraditional: 如是如此，這樣；觀看，看法。抱這樣的看法。泛指對某一事物作如此的看法。
explanationEn: To hold such a view; generally refers to having a particular perspective on something.
derivation: 《金刚经》一切有为法，如梦幻泡影，如露亦如电，应作如是观。”
derivationTraditional: 《金剛經》一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，如露亦如電，應作如是觀。”
derivationEn: 'The Diamond Sutra': 'All conditioned phenomena are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, shadows, like dew and lightning; thus should they be contemplated.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 恩恩惠；德恩德，好处。巨大的恩德，形容恩泽深厚。
explanationTraditional: 恩恩惠；德恩德，好處。巨大的恩德，形容恩澤深厚。
explanationEn: Great kindness and virtue; immense favor and benevolence.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第17卷若非妹丈救我性命，必作异乡之鬼矣。大恩大德，将何补报！”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第17卷若非妹丈救我性命，必作異鄉之鬼矣。大恩大德，將何補報！”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 17: 'If not for my brother-in-law saving my life, I would have died in a foreign land. How can I repay such great kindness and virtue?'
example: 我一定要报答你的～。
exampleTraditional: 我一定要報答你的～。
exampleEn: I must repay your great kindness and virtue.

explanation: 由这一等逐级往下。指跟某一事物比较起来更差。
explanationTraditional: 由這一等逐級往下。指跟某一事物比較起來更差。
explanationEn: To be graded downward; to be inferior compared to something else.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类》卷六十五等而下之，如医技养生家之说，皆不离阴阳二者。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類》卷六十五等而下之，如醫技養生家之說，皆不離陰陽二者。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's 'Classified Conversations of Zhu Xi', Volume 65: 'Going down from this level, even the theories of medicine and health preservation do not depart from the two principles of yin and yang.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指诗文的构思有独到的地方◇泛指想出的办法与众不同。
explanationTraditional: 原指詩文的構思有獨到的地方◇泛指想出的辦法與眾不同。
explanationEn: To show originality in one's ideas or methods; to be unconventional.
derivation: 明·李贽《水浒全书发凡》今别出心裁，不依旧样，或特标于目外，或叠采于回中。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《水滸全書發凡》今別出心裁，不依舊樣，或特標於目外，或疊採於回中。”
derivationEn: From Li Zhi's 'General Principles of the Complete Water Margin': 'Now, departing from the usual pattern, either highlighting outside the table of contents or layering within the chapters.'
example: 王弼注释《周易》，撇了象占旧解，～，畅言义理，于是天下后世，凡言《易》言，莫不宗之。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 王弼註釋《周易》，撇了象佔舊解，～，暢言義理，於是天下後世，凡言《易》言，莫不宗之。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十八回
exampleEn: Wang Bi, in annotating the 'Book of Changes', set aside the old interpretations of images and divination, and uniquely expressed his own ideas, discussing principles freely. Hence, all later scholars of the 'Book of Changes' regarded him as their master. — From Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 18.

explanation: 江东古指长江以南芜湖以下地区；父老父兄辈人。泛指家乡的父兄长辈。
explanationTraditional: 江東古指長江以南蕪湖以下地區；父老父兄輩人。泛指家鄉的父兄長輩。
explanationEn: Elders and fellow countrymen from Jiangdong (the region south of the Yangtze River).
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》项王笑曰‘籍与江东子弟八千人，渡江而西，今无一人还，纵江东父兄怜而王我，和何面目见之？’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》項王笑曰‘籍與江東子弟八千人，渡江而西，今無一人還，縱江東父兄憐而王我，和何面目見之？’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'Xiang Yu laughed and said, 'I led eight thousand sons of Jiangdong across the river to the west, and now not one returns. Even if the elders of Jiangdong pity me and make me king, how could I face them?''
example: 待回归，有何颜见得～兄妹。（明·胡文焕《跃鲤记·芦林相会》）
exampleTraditional: 待迴歸，有何顏見得～兄妹。（明·胡文煥《躍鯉記·蘆林相會》）
exampleEn: When I return, how can I face the elders and siblings of Jiangdong? — From Hu Wenhuan's 'Leaping Carp: Meeting at Reed Grove'.

explanation: 在江河湖海抢劫行凶的强盗。
explanationTraditional: 在江河湖海搶劫行兇的強盜。
explanationEn: A pirate or robber who commits crimes on rivers, lakes, or seas.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷十九小妇人父及夫，俱为江洋大盗所杀。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷十九小婦人父及夫，俱為江洋大盜所殺。”
derivationEn: From Ling Mengchu's 'Striking the Table in Amazement', Volume 19: 'My father and husband were both killed by river pirates.'
example: 他一向本是～，因他善于使船，专能抢上风，踅顺水。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 他一向本是～，因他善於使船，專能搶上風，踅順水。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十一回
exampleEn: He was originally a river pirate, skilled in boat handling, adept at catching the wind and turning against the current. — From Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroic Sons and Daughters', Chapter 21.

explanation: 脸上露出为难的神色。
explanationTraditional: 臉上露出為難的神色。
explanationEn: To show a troubled or reluctant expression on one's face.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一片渺茫，没有人家。
explanationTraditional: 一片渺茫，沒有人家。
explanationEn: Desolate and uninhabited; no sign of human habitation.
derivation: 《花月痕》第四七回不上一月，将淮北千里，扫荡个渺无人烟。”
derivationTraditional: 《花月痕》第四七回不上一月，將淮北千里，掃蕩個渺無人煙。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of Flowers and Moon', Chapter 47: 'In less than a month, the thousand li of Huaihe region were swept clean, leaving it desolate and uninhabited.'
example: 长征中，红军斩关夺隘……跋涉了～的草原。★刘伯承《回顾长征》
exampleTraditional: 長征中，紅軍斬關奪隘……跋涉了～的草原。★劉伯承《回顧長征》
exampleEn: During the Long March, the Red Army captured passes and forded rivers... trekking through the uninhabited grasslands. — From Liu Bocheng's 'Recalling the Long March'.

explanation: 形容一场大梦，或比喻一场空欢喜。
explanationTraditional: 形容一場大夢，或比喻一場空歡喜。
explanationEn: A grand dream; a fantasy or illusory joy.
derivation: 唐·李公佐《南柯太守传》
derivationTraditional: 唐·李公佐《南柯太守傳》
derivationEn: From Li Gongzuo's 'The Story of the Governor of Nanke' (Tang Dynasty).
example: 看荣华眨眼般疾，更疾如南柯一梦。★元·郑廷玉《金凤钗》楔子
exampleTraditional: 看榮華眨眼般疾，更疾如南柯一夢。★元·鄭廷玉《金鳳釵》楔子
exampleEn: The glory and wealth pass as quickly as a blink, even faster than the dream of Nanke. — From Zheng Tingyu's 'The Golden Hairpin' (Yuan Dynasty), prologue.

explanation: 穿着铁甲，拿着武器。形容全副武装。
explanationTraditional: 穿著鐵甲，拿著武器。形容全副武裝。
explanationEn: To wear armor and carry weapons; to be fully armed for battle.
derivation: 《战国策·楚策一》吾被坚执锐，赴强敌而死。”《史记·项羽本纪》夫被（披）坚执锐，义不如公。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·楚策一》吾被堅執銳，赴強敵而死。”《史記·項羽本紀》夫被（披）堅執銳，義不如公。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Chu I': 'I wear armor and carry weapons to face the strong enemy and die.' Also from 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'In wearing armor and carrying weapons, I am not as good as you.'
example: ～，虽未经于戎行；制胜伐谋，亦常习于事业。★唐·刘禹锡《请赴行营表》
exampleTraditional: ～，雖未經於戎行；制勝伐謀，亦常習於事業。★唐·劉禹錫《請赴行營表》
exampleEn: Though I have not yet experienced military campaigns, I have often studied the arts of war and strategy. — From Liu Yuxi's 'Memorial Requesting to Join the Campaign' (Tang Dynasty).

explanation: 皂黑色。青、红、黑、白四色。比喻事情的是非或原因。
explanationTraditional: 皂黑色。青、紅、黑、白四色。比喻事情的是非或原因。
explanationEn: Black and white; right and wrong; the truth or reasons behind something.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十四回妈妈和哥哥且别叫喊，消消停停的，就有个青红皂白了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十四回媽媽和哥哥且別叫喊，消消停停的，就有個青紅皂白了。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 34: 'Mother and brother, don't shout; calm down and then we'll see what's what.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 山光明媚，水色秀丽。形容风景优美。
explanationTraditional: 山光明媚，水色秀麗。形容風景優美。
explanationEn: Bright mountains and beautiful waters; describes a scenic landscape.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《蓦山溪·赠衡阳陈湘》眉黛敛秋波，尽湖南，山明水秀。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《驀山溪·贈衡陽陳湘》眉黛斂秋波，盡湖南，山明水秀。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Huang Tingjian's 'Mo Shan Xi: To Chen Xiang of Hengyang': 'Eyebrows like distant hills, autumn waves in eyes, all of Hunan, bright mountains and beautiful waters.'
example: 在一个～的村庄里，她认识了一个佃户的女儿名叫黑妮，接着她们成了好朋友。★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第八章
exampleTraditional: 在一個～的村莊裡，她認識了一個佃戶的女兒名叫黑妮，接著她們成了好朋友。★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第八章
exampleEn: In a village with bright mountains and beautiful waters, she met a tenant farmer's daughter named Hei Ni, and they became good friends. (Yang Mo, 'The Song of Youth', Chapter 2, Part 8)

explanation: 天和地，一极在上，一极在下。比喻差别极大。
explanationTraditional: 天和地，一極在上，一極在下。比喻差別極大。
explanationEn: A difference as vast as between heaven and the abyss; a huge disparity.
derivation: 《抱朴子·内篇·论仙》趋舍所尚，耳目之欲，其为不同，已有天壤之觉（较），冰炭之乖矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《抱朴子·內篇·論仙》趨舍所尚，耳目之欲，其為不同，已有天壤之覺（較），冰炭之乖矣。”
derivationEn: 'Baopuzi: Inner Chapters: On Immortals': 'The pursuits and desires of the ear and eye differ as much as heaven and earth, or ice and charcoal.'
example: 这华得夫客店，是纽约第一个著明客店，比起日本帝国大客店来，有～了。（清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第五十一回）
exampleTraditional: 這華得夫客店，是紐約第一個著明客店，比起日本帝國大客店來，有～了。（清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第五十一回）
exampleEn: This Waldorf Hotel, the most famous hotel in New York, is as different from the Imperial Hotel of Japan as heaven from the abyss. (Li Baojia, 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 51)

explanation: 形容路程很遥远。
explanationTraditional: 形容路程很遙遠。
explanationEn: Thousands of miles away; a very long distance.
derivation: 清·刘献廷《广阳杂记》卷四女家贫，人口众，万里迢迢，何以当此。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉獻廷《廣陽雜記》卷四女家貧，人口眾，萬里迢迢，何以當此。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Liu Xianting's 'Miscellaneous Notes from Guangyang', Volume 4: 'The woman's family was poor with many mouths to feed, and thousands of miles away, how could they bear this?'
example: 中国的茶籽，便带着一片翠绿的梦，～到非洲。★李瑛《茶》诗
exampleTraditional: 中國的茶籽，便帶著一片翠綠的夢，～到非洲。★李瑛《茶》詩
exampleEn: China's tea seeds, carrying a green dream, traveled thousands of miles to Africa. (Li Ying, 'Tea' poem)

explanation: 不住口地称赞。
explanationTraditional: 不住口地稱讚。
explanationEn: To praise without stopping; to be full of praise.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第六十一回丁大爷听了，越想越是，不由的赞口不绝。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第六十一回丁大爺聽了，越想越是，不由的讚口不絕。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Shi Yukun's 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants', Chapter 61: 'Master Ding listened, thought more and more it was right, and could not stop praising.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 过过失。关起门来反省。
explanationTraditional: 過過失。關起門來反省。
explanationEn: To shut the door and reflect on one's mistakes; to introspect in seclusion.
derivation: 《汉书·韩延寿传》因入卧传舍，闭阁思过。”三国·蜀·诸葛亮《黜来敏教》自谓能敦厉薄俗，帅之以义。今既不能，表退职，使闭门思愆。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·韓延壽傳》因入臥傳舍，閉閣思過。”三國·蜀·諸葛亮《黜來敏教》自謂能敦厲薄俗，帥之以義。今既不能，表退職，使閉門思愆。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Han Yanshou': 'He entered the lodging, closed the door, and reflected on his faults.' Three Kingdoms, Shu, Zhuge Liang's 'Edict to Dismiss Lai Min': 'He claimed to be able to reform the vulgar, but now he cannot, so I dismiss him to shut the door and repent.'
example: 小仙自知身获重罪，追悔莫及，惟有～，敬听天命。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六回
exampleTraditional: 小仙自知身獲重罪，追悔莫及，惟有～，敬聽天命。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六回
exampleEn: The immortal knew he had committed a grave sin, regretted it deeply, and could only shut the door and reflect, awaiting heaven's judgment. (Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 6)

explanation: 当面对。面对着强敌。形容形势严峻。
explanationTraditional: 當面對。面對著強敵。形容形勢嚴峻。
explanationEn: A formidable enemy is present; facing a powerful adversary; describes a critical situation.
derivation: 清·刘鹗《老残游记续集》第一回大敌当前，全无准备，溶之道，不待智者而决矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉鶚《老殘遊記續集》第一回大敵當前，全無準備，溶之道，不待智者而決矣。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Sequel, Chapter 1: 'With a great enemy before us, completely unprepared, the way of melting is clear even to the foolish.'
example: ～，自然以收揽民心，合力御侮为顶要的事。★高阳《清宫外史》下册
exampleTraditional: ～，自然以收攬民心，合力禦侮為頂要的事。★高陽《清宮外史》下冊
exampleEn: With a great enemy before us, the most important thing is to win the people's hearts and unite against the invaders. (Gao Yang, 'Inside the Qing Palace', Volume 2)

explanation: 公平正直，廉洁严明。
explanationTraditional: 公平正直，廉潔嚴明。
explanationEn: Fair, upright, honest, and strict; just and incorruptible.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十七回二则象大帅这样公正廉明，做属员的人，只要自己谨慎小心……还愁将来不得差缺吗？”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十七回二則象大帥這樣公正廉明，做屬員的人，只要自己謹慎小心……還愁將來不得差缺嗎？”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 37: 'Secondly, with a commander as fair and incorruptible as you, subordinates need only be cautious... and they will surely get a post.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 从思想上瓦解敌人的斗志为上策。
explanationTraditional: 從思想上瓦解敵人的鬥志為上策。
explanationEn: To attack the enemy's mind is the best strategy; to undermine morale is paramount.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀志·马谡传》每引见谈论，自昼达夜。”裴松之注引《襄阳记》用兵之道，攻心为上，攻城为下。心战为上，兵战为下。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀志·馬謖傳》每引見談論，自晝達夜。”裴松之注引《襄陽記》用兵之道，攻心為上，攻城為下。心戰為上，兵戰為下。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Shu: Biography of Ma Su' with Pei Songzhi's annotation quoting 'Xiangyang Ji': 'In warfare, attacking the mind is the best, attacking cities is inferior; psychological warfare is best, military warfare is inferior.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 逑，通仇”。仇配偶。原指君子的佳偶◇遂用为男子追求佳偶之套语。
explanationTraditional: 逑，通仇”。仇配偶。原指君子的佳偶◇遂用為男子追求佳偶之套語。
explanationEn: A gentleman's good match; originally referred to a nobleman's ideal spouse, later used as a cliché for a man pursuing a partner.
derivation: 语出《诗·周南·关雎》窈窕淑女，君子好逑。”《毛传》逑，匹也。言后妃有关雎之德，是幽间贞专之善女，宜为君子之好匹。”
derivationTraditional: 語出《詩·周南·關雎》窈窕淑女，君子好逑。”《毛傳》逑，匹也。言后妃有關雎之德，是幽間貞專之善女，宜為君子之好匹。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Zhou Nan: Guan Ju': 'A modest, virtuous maiden, a gentleman's good match.' Mao's commentary: 'Qiu means mate. It says the queen has the virtue of the osprey, a quiet and chaste good woman, suitable as a gentleman's good mate.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用眼色传递情意。多用于男女之间。
explanationTraditional: 用眼色傳遞情意。多用於男女之間。
explanationEn: To convey feelings through eye expressions; often between lovers.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第三本第一折只你那眉眼传情未了时。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第三本第一折只你那眉眼傳情未了時。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing', Act 3, Scene 1: 'Only your eyebrows and eyes convey feelings that have not yet ended.'
example: 因而乘机百般撩拨，～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十四回
exampleTraditional: 因而乘機百般撩撥，～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十四回
exampleEn: Thus, she took every opportunity to flirt and convey feelings through her eyes. (Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 64)

explanation: 插上翅膀也难飞走。比喻陷入困境，怎么也逃不了。
explanationTraditional: 插上翅膀也難飛走。比喻陷入困境，怎麼也逃不了。
explanationEn: Even with wings, it's hard to fly away. Describes being trapped in a predicament with no escape.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《寄崔二十六立之》诗安有巢中鷇，插翅飞天陲。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《寄崔二十六立之》詩安有巢中鷇，插翅飛天陲。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's poem 'To Cui Lishi' in Tang Dynasty: 'How can a nestling, even with wings, fly to the edge of the sky?'
example: 则不与他城子，便相如插翅也飞不出函谷关去。★元·高文秀《保成公径赴渑池会》第一折
exampleTraditional: 則不與他城子，便相如插翅也飛不出函谷關去。★元·高文秀《保成公徑赴澠池會》第一折
exampleEn: If we don't give him the city, even Xiangru with wings can't escape from Hangu Pass. — Yuan Dynasty, Gao Wenxiu, 'The Meeting at Mianchi' Act 1

explanation: 指交情甚浅，见了面只不过点点头而已。
explanationTraditional: 指交情甚淺，見了面只不過點點頭而已。
explanationEn: A nodding acquaintance; a very superficial friendship where people only nod when they meet.
derivation: 周而复《上海的早晨》第一部少说也有百儿八十，点头之交，那就数不清了。”
derivationTraditional: 周而復《上海的早晨》第一部少說也有百兒八十，點頭之交，那就數不清了。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Erfu's 'Morning in Shanghai' Part 1: 'At least a hundred or so, nodding acquaintances are countless.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 与人无争，只求相安无事的人。
explanationTraditional: 與人無爭，只求相安無事的人。
explanationEn: A person who avoids conflict and seeks peace at all costs; a yes-man.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》南郡庞士元闻司马德操在颍川”刘孝标注引《司马徽别传》载司马徽称一切东西皆佳”，故有好好先生”之号。
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》南郡龐士元聞司馬德操在潁川”劉孝標註引《司馬徽別傳》載司馬徽稱一切東西皆佳”，故有好好先生”之號。
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' in Southern Dynasty, with annotation quoting 'Sima Hui's Biography': Sima Hui praised everything as 'good', hence the nickname 'Mr. Good-good'.
example: 我们没来由今日为他得罪严老大，老虎头上扑苍蝇，怎的？落得做～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第六回
exampleTraditional: 我們沒來由今日為他得罪嚴老大，老虎頭上撲蒼蠅，怎的？落得做～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第六回
exampleEn: Why should we offend Elder Yan for him today? It's like swatting a fly on a tiger's head. Better to be a 'Mr. Good-good'. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars' Chapter 6

explanation: 经常看到，习以为常。
explanationTraditional: 經常看到，習以為常。
explanationEn: So accustomed to something that it no longer causes surprise.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 正法执行死刑。在犯罪的当地执行死刑。
explanationTraditional: 正法執行死刑。在犯罪的當地執行死刑。
explanationEn: To execute a criminal on the spot where the crime was committed.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第六十五回因为案情重大，并且是积案累累的，就办了个就地正法。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第六十五回因為案情重大，並且是積案累累的，就辦了個就地正法。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' in Qing Dynasty, Chapter 65: 'Because the case was serious and the criminal had many accumulated offenses, they executed him on the spot.'
example: 且地方坤民，困受该逆之害，伏辕固请将该逆～，以快人心。★清·刘坤一《禀张中丞》
exampleTraditional: 且地方坤民，困受該逆之害，伏轅固請將該逆～，以快人心。★清·劉坤一《稟張中丞》
exampleEn: The local gentry and people, suffering from the rebel's harm, petitioned to have him executed on the spot to satisfy public outrage. — Qing Dynasty, Liu Kunyi, 'Report to Governor Zhang'

explanation: 好药往往味苦难吃。比喻衷心的劝告，尖锐的批评，听起来觉得不舒服，但对改正缺点错误很有好处。
explanationTraditional: 好藥往往味苦難吃。比喻衷心的勸告，尖銳的批評，聽起來覺得不舒服，但對改正缺點錯誤很有好處。
explanationEn: Good medicine tastes bitter. Sincere advice or sharp criticism may be unpleasant but is beneficial for correcting mistakes.
derivation: 《孔子家语·六本》良药苦于口而利于病，忠言逆于耳而利于行。”
derivationTraditional: 《孔子家語·六本》良藥苦於口而利於病，忠言逆於耳而利於行。”
derivationEn: From 'The Family Sayings of Confucius' Chapter 6: 'Good medicine is bitter to the mouth but beneficial to the disease; loyal advice is unpleasant to the ear but beneficial to conduct.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把破旧的修补好，把废物利用起来。指厉行节约。
explanationTraditional: 把破舊的修補好，把廢物利用起來。指厲行節約。
explanationEn: To repair old items and make use of waste materials; to practice thrift and economy.
derivation: 《汉书·司马迁传》幽、厉之后，王道缺，礼乐衰，孔子修旧起废，论《诗》、《书》，作《春秋》，则学者至今则之，”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·司馬遷傳》幽、厲之後，王道缺，禮樂衰，孔子修舊起廢，論《詩》、《書》，作《春秋》，則學者至今則之，”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Sima Qian': 'After the reigns of You and Li, the kingly way declined, rites and music decayed. Confucius repaired the old and revived the abandoned, discussing the Book of Songs and Book of Documents, and composing the Spring and Autumn Annals.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 当相当。一个人抵挡十个人。形容军队英勇善战。
explanationTraditional: 當相當。一個人抵擋十個人。形容軍隊英勇善戰。
explanationEn: One against ten. Describes an army that is extremely brave and skilled in battle.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策一》一而当十，十而当百，百而当千。”《史记·项羽本纪》楚战士无不一以当十，楚兵呼声动天，诸侯军无不人人惴恐。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策一》一而當十，十而當百，百而當千。”《史記·項羽本紀》楚戰士無不一以當十，楚兵呼聲動天，諸侯軍無不人人惴恐。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy 1': 'One equals ten, ten equals a hundred, a hundred equals a thousand.' And 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'The Chu soldiers fought each one against ten, their shouts shaking the heavens.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 哀悲哀；伤伤害。忧愁而不悲伤，形容感情有节制；另形容诗歌、音乐优美雅致，感情适度。比喻做事没有过头也无不及。
explanationTraditional: 哀悲哀；傷傷害。憂愁而不悲傷，形容感情有節制；另形容詩歌、音樂優美雅緻，感情適度。比喻做事沒有過頭也無不及。
explanationEn: Sorrowful but not hurtful. Describes emotions expressed with restraint, or poetry/music that is elegant and moderate. Means doing things without excess or deficiency.
derivation: 《论语·八佾》子曰‘《关雎》乐而不淫，哀而不伤。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·八佾》子曰‘《關雎》樂而不淫，哀而不傷。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Eight Rows': 'The Master said, 'The Guan Ju is joyful but not licentious, sorrowful but not hurtful.''
example: 她喜欢打扮，愿意有朋友，可是这都不过是一些小小的、～的、青春的游戏。★老舍《四世同堂》四十三
exampleTraditional: 她喜歡打扮，願意有朋友，可是這都不過是一些小小的、～的、青春的遊戲。★老舍《四世同堂》四十三
exampleEn: She liked to dress up and have friends, but these were just small, sorrowful-but-not-hurtful games of youth. — Lao She, 'Four Generations Under One Roof' Chapter 43

explanation: 犹比肩继踵。形容人很多或接连不断。
explanationTraditional: 猶比肩繼踵。形容人很多或接連不斷。
explanationEn: Shoulder to shoulder and heel to heel. Describes a large crowd of people or continuous succession.
derivation: 清·戴名世《序》其间名臣巨儒、魁奇俊伟豪杰不群之士，比肩接踵而出。”又《序》天下之谬悠庸烂者，比肩接踵，不可胜数。”
derivationTraditional: 清·戴名世《序》其間名臣巨儒、魁奇俊偉豪傑不群之士，比肩接踵而出。”又《序》天下之謬悠庸爛者，比肩接踵，不可勝數。”
derivationEn: From Dai Mingshi's 'Preface' in Qing Dynasty: 'Famous ministers, great scholars, outstanding and heroic individuals emerged shoulder to shoulder and heel to heel.' Also: 'The mediocre and corrupt people of the world are countless, shoulder to shoulder and heel to heel.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指得与失，成功与失败。
explanationTraditional: 指得與失，成功與失敗。
explanationEn: Gains and losses, success and failure.
derivation: 晋·陆机《五等诸侯论》五等之制，始于黄、唐郡县之治，创自秦、汉。得失成败，备在曲谟，是以其祥，可得而言。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陸機《五等諸侯論》五等之制，始於黃、唐郡縣之治，創自秦、漢。得失成敗，備在曲謨，是以其祥，可得而言。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Lu Ji's 'On the Five Ranks of Nobility': The system of five ranks began with Huang and Tang; the prefecture and county governance was created by Qin and Han. Gains and losses, success and failure are all recorded in the classics, thus their details can be discussed.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把狗血喷在头上。形容言辞刻毒，大肆辱骂。也形容骂得痛快淋漓。
explanationTraditional: 把狗血噴在頭上。形容言辭刻毒，大肆辱罵。也形容罵得痛快淋漓。
explanationEn: To pour dog blood on someone's head. Describes harsh and abusive language, or scolding thoroughly.
derivation: 明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第六十四回一清早晨，吃他骂的狗血喷了头。”
derivationTraditional: 明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第六十四回一清早晨，吃他罵的狗血噴了頭。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng's 'Jin Ping Mei', Chapter 64: In the early morning, he was scolded so badly that dog blood was poured on his head.
example: 范进因没有盘费，走去同丈人商议，被胡屠夫一口啐在脸上，骂了一个～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleTraditional: 范進因沒有盤費，走去同丈人商議，被胡屠夫一口啐在臉上，罵了一個～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三回
exampleEn: Fan Jin, lacking travel expenses, went to discuss with his father-in-law, but Hu Tuhu spat in his face and scolded him thoroughly. (Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 3)

explanation: 用冷淡的态度接待。比喻不欢迎或看不起。
explanationTraditional: 用冷淡的態度接待。比喻不歡迎或看不起。
explanationEn: To treat with cold indifference, implying unwelcome or disdain.
derivation: 蔡东藩《明史演义》第二十回哪知太祖反冷眼相待，并不升赏。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩《明史演義》第二十回哪知太祖反冷眼相待，並不升賞。”
derivationEn: Cai Dongfan's 'History of the Ming Dynasty', Chapter 20: Unexpectedly, Emperor Taizu treated him coldly and did not promote or reward him.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 勤奋学习，不懂的就问。比喻善于学习。
explanationTraditional: 勤奮學習，不懂的就問。比喻善於學習。
explanationEn: Diligent in learning and eager to ask questions. Describes a good learner.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指今生、来世以至永世。
explanationTraditional: 指今生、來世以至永世。
explanationEn: This life, the next life, and forever.
derivation: 《南史·王敬则传》唯愿后身生生世世不复天王作因缘。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·王敬則傳》唯願後身生生世世不復天王作因緣。”
derivationEn: 'History of the Southern Dynasties: Biography of Wang Jingze': I only wish that in future lives, life after life, I will never be associated with the Heavenly King.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指种种不同的味道。常用以比喻生活上的种种遭遇和复杂感受。
explanationTraditional: 指種種不同的味道。常用以比喻生活上的種種遭遇和複雜感受。
explanationEn: Various tastes: sweet, sour, bitter, spicy. Often used metaphorically for life's experiences and complex feelings.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 有开始没有结尾。指做事不做到底。
explanationTraditional: 有開始沒有結尾。指做事不做到底。
explanationEn: To start but not finish. Refers to not seeing something through to the end.
derivation: 《晋书·刘聪载记》小人有始无终，不能如贯高之流也。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·劉聰載記》小人有始無終，不能如貫高之流也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin: Biography of Liu Cong': Petty people start but do not finish, unlike Guan Gao who persevered.
example: 我们做事情不要～，半途而废。
exampleTraditional: 我們做事情不要～，半途而廢。
exampleEn: We should not start but not finish, giving up halfway.

explanation: 泽恩泽，恩惠。被覆盖。恩惠遍及到后代的人民。
explanationTraditional: 澤恩澤，恩惠。被覆蓋。恩惠遍及到後代的人民。
explanationEn: Benefits extend to future generations.
derivation: 陶铸《崇高的理想》李冰父子为了解决当时成都平原的水利问题，不知克服了多少困难，终于修成了泽被后世的都江堰。”
derivationTraditional: 陶鑄《崇高的理想》李冰父子為了解決當時成都平原的水利問題，不知克服了多少困難，終於修成了澤被後世的都江堰。”
derivationEn: Tao Zhu's 'Lofty Ideals': Li Bing and his son, to solve the irrigation problem of the Chengdu Plain at that time, overcame countless difficulties and finally built the Dujiangyan, which has benefited future generations.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 坐着躺着都不安宁。常形容心绪烦乱。
explanationTraditional: 坐著躺著都不安寧。常形容心緒煩亂。
explanationEn: Unable to sit or lie still. Often describes a restless state of mind.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十四回各事冗杂，亦难尽述，因此忙的凤姐茶饭无心，坐卧不宁。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十四回各事冗雜，亦難盡述，因此忙的鳳姐茶飯無心，坐臥不寧。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 14: With numerous affairs, it's hard to describe, so Xifeng was so busy she had no appetite for tea or food, and could not sit or lie still.
example: 那劣绅不知何日要戴高帽子，每日在家放心不下，～。★毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》
exampleTraditional: 那劣紳不知何日要戴高帽子，每日在家放心不下，～。★毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》
exampleEn: The despotic gentry, not knowing when he would be forced to wear a tall hat, was uneasy at home every day, unable to sit or lie still. (Mao Zedong's 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan')

explanation: 指最大最美的声音乃无声之音。
explanationTraditional: 指最大最美的聲音乃無聲之音。
explanationEn: The greatest sound is silent.
derivation: 《老子》大音希声，大象无形。”王弼注听之不闻名曰希，不可得闻之音也。有声则有分，有分则不宫而商矣。分则不能统众，故有声者非大音也。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》大音希聲，大象無形。”王弼注聽之不聞名曰希，不可得聞之音也。有聲則有分，有分則不宮而商矣。分則不能統眾，故有聲者非大音也。”
derivationEn: 'Laozi': The greatest sound is silent, the greatest form is shapeless. Wang Bi's commentary: Listening but not hearing is called 'xi', a sound that cannot be heard. Sound that can be heard has distinctions; with distinctions, it is not the great sound.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伉俪夫妻，配偶。夫妻之间的感情深厚。
explanationTraditional: 伉儷夫妻，配偶。夫妻之間的感情深厚。
explanationEn: Deep affection between husband and wife.
derivation: 明·沈得符《万历野获编》盖圣德仁厚，加以中宫前后同忧患者积年，伉俪情更加笃挚。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈得符《萬曆野獲編》蓋聖德仁厚，加以中宮前後同憂患者積年，伉儷情更加篤摯。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shen Defu's 'Wanli Ye Huo Bian': 'The sage's virtue is benevolent and thick, coupled with the empress's shared hardships over the years, the conjugal love is even more sincere.'
example: 纵使你～，一时未忍，久后这中馈乏人，总不是事。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第七十回
exampleTraditional: 縱使你～，一時未忍，久後這中饋乏人，總不是事。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第七十回
exampleEn: Even if you are deeply in love, unable to bear parting for a while, in the long run, the lack of a hostess is still a problem. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Situations Observed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 70.

explanation: 美好新奇的事物太多，眼睛来不及看。
explanationTraditional: 美好新奇的事物太多，眼睛來不及看。
explanationEn: Too many beautiful or novel things to see; eyes cannot take them all in.
derivation: 清·吴璿《飞龙全传》序于是检向时所鄙之《飞龙传》，为之删其繁文，汰其俚句，布以雅训之格，间以清隽之辞，传神写物，尽态极妍，庶足令阅者惊奇拍案，目不暇给矣！”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳璿《飛龍全傳》序於是檢向時所鄙之《飛龍傳》，為之刪其繁文，汰其俚句，布以雅訓之格，間以清雋之辭，傳神寫物，盡態極妍，庶足令閱者驚奇拍案，目不暇給矣！”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Xuan's preface to 'The Complete Legend of the Flying Dragon': 'Thus, I took the previously despised 'Legend of the Flying Dragon', deleted its redundancies, refined its vulgar phrases, adorned it with elegant patterns, interspersed with pure and witty words, vividly depicting scenes and characters, so that readers would be amazed, clap in surprise, and find their eyes too busy to take it all in.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指情感深远、恩义厚重。
explanationTraditional: 指情感深遠、恩義厚重。
explanationEn: Deep feelings and profound righteousness.
derivation: 晋·温峤《重与陶侃书》且自顷之顾，绸缪往来，情深义重，著于人士之口。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·溫嶠《重與陶侃書》且自頃之顧，綢繆往來，情深義重，著於人士之口。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Wen Qiao's 'Second Letter to Tao Kan': 'Moreover, since the recent care, the intimate exchanges have been deep in affection and heavy in righteousness, renowned among the people.'
example: 那～的也不过临风对月，洒泪悲啼。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百十三回
exampleTraditional: 那～的也不過臨風對月，灑淚悲啼。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百十三回
exampleEn: Those with deep affection and heavy righteousness can only face the wind and moon, shedding tears and lamenting. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 113.

explanation: 三生佛家指前生、今生、来生；幸幸运。三世都很幸运。比喻非常幸运。
explanationTraditional: 三生佛家指前生、今生、來生；倖幸運。三世都很幸運。比喻非常幸運。
explanationEn: Extremely fortunate; blessed in three lifetimes (past, present, and future).
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《东坡梦》第一折久闻老师父大名，今日得睹尊颜，三生有幸。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《東坡夢》第一折久聞老師父大名，今日得睹尊顏，三生有幸。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wu Changling's 'Dream of Dongpo', First Act: 'I have long heard of the great master's name; today I am fortunate to see your face, blessed in three lifetimes.'
example: 贱妾蒲柳之姿，幸蒙太太见爱，今日登宝地，真是～。（清·曾朴《孽海花》第十二回）
exampleTraditional: 賤妾蒲柳之姿，幸蒙太太見愛，今日登寶地，真是～。（清·曾樸《孽海花》第十二回）
exampleEn: I, a humble and lowly person, am fortunate to be favored by you, madam. Today, visiting this precious place is truly a blessing of three lifetimes. — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu's 'Flower of the Sea of Sins', Chapter 12.

explanation: 身价指社会地位。指名誉地位一下子大提高。
explanationTraditional: 身價指社會地位。指名譽地位一下子大提高。
explanationEn: One's social status or reputation rises dramatically.
derivation: 唐·李白《与韩荆州书》一登龙门，则声价十倍。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《與韓荊州書》一登龍門，則聲價十倍。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Bai's 'Letter to Han Jingzhou': 'Once you ascend the Dragon Gate, your reputation increases tenfold.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 流动的水不会发臭，经常转动的门轴不会被虫蛀。比喻经常运动的东西不容易受侵蚀。也比喻人经常运动可以强身。
explanationTraditional: 流動的水不會發臭，經常轉動的門軸不會被蟲蛀。比喻經常運動的東西不容易受侵蝕。也比喻人經常運動可以強身。
explanationEn: Flowing water does not stink; a moving door hinge does not get worm-eaten. Metaphor for things that are constantly active are less likely to decay.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·尽数》流水不腐，户枢不蝼，动也。”唐·马总《意林》卷二引作户枢不蠹”。
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·盡數》流水不腐，戶樞不螻，動也。”唐·馬總《意林》卷二引作戶樞不蠹”。
derivationEn: 'Lüshi Chunqiu·Jinshu': 'Flowing water does not stink, a moving door hinge does not get worm-eaten, because of movement.' Tang Dynasty, Ma Zong's 'Yilin', Volume 2, quotes it as 'door hinge does not get worm-eaten.'
example: 流水不腐，～”，是说它们在不停的运动中抵抗了微生物或其他生物的侵蚀。★毛泽东《论联合政府》
exampleTraditional: 流水不腐，～”，是說它們在不停的運動中抵抗了微生物或其他生物的侵蝕。★毛澤東《論聯合政府》
exampleEn: 'Flowing water does not stink, a moving door hinge does not get worm-eaten' means that they resist erosion by microorganisms or other organisms through constant movement. — Mao Zedong's 'On Coalition Government'.

explanation: 黄钟我国古代音韵十二律中六种阳律的第一律。大吕六种阴律的第四律。形容音乐或言辞庄严、正大、高妙、和谐。
explanationTraditional: 黃鐘我國古代音韻十二律中六種陽律的第一律。大呂六種陰律的第四律。形容音樂或言辭莊嚴、正大、高妙、和諧。
explanationEn: Describes music or speech that is solemn, grand, harmonious, and sublime.
derivation: 《周礼·春官·大司乐》乃奏黄钟，歌大吕，舞云门，以祀天神。”郑玄注以黄钟之钟，大吕之声为均者，黄钟阳声之首，大吕为之合。”
derivationTraditional: 《周禮·春官·大司樂》乃奏黃鐘，歌大呂，舞雲門，以祀天神。”鄭玄注以黃鐘之鐘，大呂之聲為均者，黃鐘陽聲之首，大呂為之合。”
derivationEn: 'Zhouli·Chunguan·Dasiyue': 'Then play the Yellow Bell, sing the Great Pitch, dance the Cloud Gate, to worship the heavenly gods.' Zheng Xuan's commentary: 'Using the Yellow Bell bell and the Great Pitch sound as the basis, the Yellow Bell is the head of the yang sounds, and the Great Pitch matches it.'
example: 先生之文如～，发达九地，黄启洙泗邹鲁之秘，其可不传耶？★宋·陆九渊《语录下》
exampleTraditional: 先生之文如～，發達九地，黃啟洙泗鄒魯之秘，其可不傳耶？★宋·陸九淵《語錄下》
exampleEn: Your writings are like the Yellow Bell and Great Pitch, reaching the ninefold earth, revealing the secrets of the Confucian classics; how could they not be passed down? — Song Dynasty, Lu Jiuyuan's 'Quotations', Part 2.

explanation: 归根到底。
explanationTraditional: 歸根到底。
explanationEn: Ultimately; when all is said and done.
derivation: 秦兆阳《回答》我这个糟老头子捡点破烂，虽说有点霸道，九九归一，也是生活逼的。”
derivationTraditional: 秦兆陽《回答》我這個糟老頭子撿點破爛，雖說有點霸道，九九歸一，也是生活逼的。”
derivationEn: Qin Zhaoyang's 'Answer': 'This old fool picks up scraps, though a bit domineering, in the end, it's life that forces me.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 上上等，引申为最好的。兵指战争，引申为用兵。伐讨伐，攻打。伐谋用计谋粉碎敌人的计策。用兵的上策，是以谋略取胜。
explanationTraditional: 上上等，引申為最好的。兵指戰爭，引申為用兵。伐討伐，攻打。伐謀用計謀粉碎敵人的計策。用兵的上策，是以謀略取勝。
explanationEn: The best military strategy is to defeat the enemy's plans through strategy.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指人心胸开阔，外貌就安详◇用来指心情愉快，无所牵挂，因而人也发胖。
explanationTraditional: 原指人心胸開闊，外貌就安詳◇用來指心情愉快，無所牽掛，因而人也發胖。
explanationEn: Originally meant that a person with a broad mind appears serene; later used to describe someone who is carefree and thus gains weight.
derivation: 《礼记·大学》富润屋，德润身，心广体胖。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·大學》富潤屋，德潤身，心廣體胖。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Rites·Great Learning': 'Wealth adorns a house, virtue adorns the body; with a broad mind, the body is at ease.'
example: ～的老板，满面春风地迎上来，拉大家进店休息。
exampleTraditional: ～的老闆，滿面春風地迎上來，拉大家進店休息。
exampleEn: The broad-minded and plump boss greeted everyone with a beaming face and invited them into the shop to rest.

explanation: 睚眦发怒时瞪眼睛，借指极小的仇恨。象瞪一下眼睛那样极小的怨仇也要报复。比喻心胸极狭窄。
explanationTraditional: 睚眥發怒時瞪眼睛，借指極小的仇恨。象瞪一下眼睛那樣極小的怨仇也要報復。比喻心胸極狹窄。
explanationEn: To seek revenge for the slightest grievance; extremely narrow-minded.
derivation: 《史记·范睢蔡泽列传》一饭之德必偿，睚眦之怨必报。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·範睢蔡澤列傳》一飯之德必償，睚眥之怨必報。”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Fan Sui and Cai Ze: 'One repays a meal's kindness and avenges a glare's grudge.'
example: 瓒恃其才力，不恤百姓，记过忘善，～。★《后汉书·公孙瓒传》
exampleTraditional: 瓚恃其才力，不恤百姓，記過忘善，～。★《後漢書·公孫瓚傳》
exampleEn: Gongsun Zan, relying on his talent and power, did not care for the people, remembered faults and forgot kindness, and would avenge even a glare. (Book of the Later Han: Biography of Gongsun Zan)

explanation: 土乡土；重看得重，不轻易。安于本乡本土，不愿轻易迁移。
explanationTraditional: 土鄉土；重看得重，不輕易。安於本鄉本土，不願輕易遷移。
explanationEn: To be attached to one's native land and unwilling to move easily.
derivation: 《汉书·元帝纪》安土重迁，黎民之性；骨肉相附，人情所愿也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·元帝紀》安土重遷，黎民之性；骨肉相附，人情所願也。”
derivationEn: Book of Han: Annals of Emperor Yuan: 'Being attached to one's homeland and reluctant to move is the nature of the people; being close to family is what people desire.'
example: 自古道～。”说了离乡背井，那一个不怕的。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第七十八回
exampleTraditional: 自古道～。”說了離鄉背井，那一個不怕的。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第七十八回
exampleEn: As the old saying goes, 'One is attached to one's homeland and reluctant to move.' Who is not afraid of leaving home? (Feng Menglong, Romance of the Eastern Zhou, Chapter 78)

explanation: 白纸上写下了黑字。比喻有确凿的文字凭据，不容抵赖或悔改。
explanationTraditional: 白紙上寫下了黑字。比喻有確鑿的文字憑據，不容抵賴或悔改。
explanationEn: Written in black and white; clear and irrefutable written evidence.
derivation: 元·无名氏《看钱奴买冤家债主》第二折不要闲说，白纸上写着黑字哩。若有反悔之人，罚宝钞一千贯与不反悔之人使用。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《看錢奴買冤家債主》第二折不要閒說，白紙上寫著黑字哩。若有反悔之人，罰寶鈔一千貫與不反悔之人使用。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty anonymous play: The Miserly Buyer of Servants: 'Don't talk nonsense; it's written in black and white. If anyone goes back on their word, they must pay a thousand strings of cash.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鸣发出声音，指有所抒发或表示。指受到委曲和压迫就要发出不满和反抗的呼声。
explanationTraditional: 鳴發出聲音，指有所抒發或表示。指受到委曲和壓迫就要發出不滿和反抗的呼聲。
explanationEn: Where there is injustice, there will be an outcry; to express discontent when wronged.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送孟东野序》大凡物不得其平则鸣。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送孟東野序》大凡物不得其平則鳴。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty Han Yu: 'Generally, when things are not in balance, they make a sound.'
example: ～”，看看现时的情况，难怪学生们厉声疾呼——革命、救国。★杨沫《青春之歌》第二部第二十七章
exampleTraditional: ～”，看看現時的情況，難怪學生們厲聲疾呼——革命、救國。★楊沫《青春之歌》第二部第二十七章
exampleEn: 'Where there is injustice, there will be an outcry.' Seeing the current situation, no wonder students cry out for revolution and national salvation. (Yang Mo, The Song of Youth, Part 2, Chapter 27)

explanation: 简单爽快。
explanationTraditional: 簡單爽快。
explanationEn: Simple and straightforward; crisp and decisive.
derivation: 南怀瑾《论语别裁·子罕》因为我的老朋友太多，而有许多老朋友真可怜，死得不干脆利落，拖累了别人，也苦了自己。”
derivationTraditional: 南懷瑾《論語別裁·子罕》因為我的老朋友太多，而有許多老朋友真可憐，死得不乾脆利落，拖累了別人，也苦了自己。”
derivationEn: Nan Huaijin: 'Because I have many old friends, and some of them are truly pitiful, dying not cleanly and quickly, burdening others and suffering themselves.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 寡、鲜少。旧指不廉洁，不知耻。现指不知羞耻。
explanationTraditional: 寡、鮮少。舊指不廉潔，不知恥。現指不知羞恥。
explanationEn: Shameless; lacking a sense of honor or shame.
derivation: 汉·司马相如《喻巴蜀檄》父兄之教不先，子弟之率不谨，寡廉鲜耻，而俗不长厚也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬相如《喻巴蜀檄》父兄之教不先，子弟之率不謹，寡廉鮮恥，而俗不長厚也。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty Sima Xiangru: 'If fathers and brothers do not teach first, and sons and younger brothers are not careful in their conduct, they become shameless and the customs become unvirtuous.'
example: 只为自己贪财克剥，～。★明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第七回
exampleTraditional: 只為自己貪財剋剝，～。★明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第七回
exampleEn: Only for his own greed and exploitation, he was shameless. (Ming Dynasty Donglu Gukuangsheng, Awakening from Drunkenness, Chapter 7)

explanation: 比喻居心不良，当面一套，背后一套。
explanationTraditional: 比喻居心不良，當面一套，背後一套。
explanationEn: Double-dealing; to say one thing and do another behind someone's back.
derivation: 元·李行道《灰阑记》第二折岂知他有两面三刀，向夫主厮搬调。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李行道《灰闌記》第二折豈知他有兩面三刀，向夫主廝搬調。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty Li Xingdao: 'Who knew he was double-dealing, slandering to her husband.'
example: 你这～”的东西，我不稀罕。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十二回
exampleTraditional: 你這～”的東西，我不稀罕。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十二回
exampleEn: You double-dealing thing, I don't care for it. (Cao Xueqin, Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 62)

explanation: 指门前警卫戒备很严密。
explanationTraditional: 指門前警衛戒備很嚴密。
explanationEn: Strictly guarded entrance; tight security at the gate.
derivation: 杨沫《青春之歌》第一部第二章林公馆门禁森严，进去不得。”
derivationTraditional: 楊沫《青春之歌》第一部第二章林公館門禁森嚴，進去不得。”
derivationEn: Yang Mo, The Song of Youth, Part 1, Chapter 2: 'The Lin mansion was strictly guarded, impossible to enter.'
example: 他的别墅花园～，好不气派。
exampleTraditional: 他的別墅花園～，好不氣派。
exampleEn: His villa garden was strictly guarded, very imposing.

explanation: 秋季为农作物收获季节，冬季则贮藏果实以待一年之需要。比喻一年的农事。
explanationTraditional: 秋季為農作物收穫季節，冬季則貯藏果實以待一年之需要。比喻一年的農事。
explanationEn: Harvest in autumn and store in winter; refers to the annual cycle of farming.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指有才能的人因沉迷于爱情而丧失进取心。
explanationTraditional: 指有才能的人因沉迷於愛情而喪失進取心。
explanationEn: A hero's spirit is dampened; refers to a talented person losing ambition due to romantic attachment.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 倘若有冒功等事，岂不使～，谁肯替国家出力！（清·钱彩《说岳全传》第二十三回）
exampleTraditional: 倘若有冒功等事，豈不使～，誰肯替國家出力！（清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第二十三回）
exampleEn: If there were cases of false claims, wouldn't that dampen heroes' spirits, and who would be willing to serve the country? (Qing Dynasty Qian Cai, The Story of Yue Fei, Chapter 23)

explanation: 指仇人，仇敌。
explanationTraditional: 指仇人，仇敵。
explanationEn: Enemy, adversary.
derivation: 清·李渔《慎鸾交·狠图》谁想才学之才与钱财之财两下里是冤家对头，从来不肯见面的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《慎鸞交·狠圖》誰想才學之才與錢財之財兩下里是冤家對頭，從來不肯見面的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Yu's 'The Cautious Lovebird': 'Who would have thought that talent and money are natural enemies, never willing to meet.'
example: 还争什么强，要结下下一辈的～吗！★骆宾基《胶东的暴民”》
exampleTraditional: 還爭什麼強，要結下下一輩的～嗎！★駱賓基《膠東的暴民”》
exampleEn: Why strive for dominance, only to create enemies for the next generation? — Luo Binji, 'The Rioters of Jiaodong'

explanation: 期时间。以后有见面的时候（用在分别时安慰对方）。
explanationTraditional: 期時間。以後有見面的時候（用在分別時安慰對方）。
explanationEn: We'll meet again (used to comfort each other when parting).
derivation: 元·乔梦符《扬州梦》第三折小官公事忙，后会也有期。”
derivationTraditional: 元·喬夢符《揚州夢》第三折小官公事忙，後會也有期。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Qiao Mengfu's 'Yangzhou Dream', Act 3: 'I have urgent official business, but we will meet again.'
example: 女菩萨千万保重！我们～，暂且失陪。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十一回
exampleTraditional: 女菩薩千萬保重！我們～，暫且失陪。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十一回
exampleEn: Take care, Bodhisattva! We'll meet again, for now we must take leave. — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 51

explanation: 缓慢；济救助。缓慢的行动适应不了紧急的需要。
explanationTraditional: 緩慢；濟救助。緩慢的行動適應不了緊急的需要。
explanationEn: Slow action cannot meet urgent needs.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十三回正愁缓不济急，恰好有现任杭州织造的富周三爷，是门生的大舅子，他有托门生带京一万银子。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十三回正愁緩不濟急，恰好有現任杭州織造的富週三爺，是門生的大舅子，他有託門生帶京一萬銀子。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 13: 'Just as I worried that slow action wouldn't meet urgent needs, it happened that...'
example: 看看还差个八百多两银子，没有法子想，要变卖东西，却又～。★清·吴趼人《糊涂世界》第六回
exampleTraditional: 看看還差個八百多兩銀子，沒有法子想，要變賣東西，卻又～。★清·吳趼人《糊塗世界》第六回
exampleEn: Still short by over eight hundred taels of silver, with no way out, selling things wouldn't help as it's too slow. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren, 'The World of Confusion', Chapter 6

explanation: 比喻天下太平，不再用兵。现形容思想麻痹。
explanationTraditional: 比喻天下太平，不再用兵。現形容思想麻痺。
explanationEn: Metaphor for peace and no longer using military force; now describes ideological complacency.
derivation: 《尚书·武成》王来自商，至于丰，乃偃武修文，归马于华山之阳，放牛于桃林之野，示天下弗服。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·武成》王來自商，至於豐，乃偃武修文，歸馬於華山之陽，放牛於桃林之野，示天下弗服。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Completion of the War': 'The king returned from Shang to Feng, then ceased military activities and promoted culture, releasing horses to the south of Mount Hua and cattle to the fields of Taolin, showing the world that he would not use them.'
example: 其时天下太平已久，真个是～，刀枪入库；五谷丰登，万民乐业。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第一回
exampleTraditional: 其時天下太平已久，真個是～，刀槍入庫；五穀豐登，萬民樂業。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第一回
exampleEn: At that time, the world had been at peace for long, truly with horses released to the southern mountains and weapons stored away; abundant harvests and people enjoying their lives. — Qing Dynasty Qian Cai, 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 1

explanation: 从里、外两方面配合同时进攻。
explanationTraditional: 從裡、外兩方面配合同時進攻。
explanationEn: Attack from both inside and outside simultaneously.
derivation: 元·郑廷玉《楚昭公》第一折那其间内外夹攻，方能取胜。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭廷玉《楚昭公》第一折那其間內外夾攻，方能取勝。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zheng Tingyu's 'The Prince of Chu', Act 1: 'Then attack from both inside and outside to achieve victory.'
example: 这件事情，须得我同你两个～。★郭沫若《屈原》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 這件事情，須得我同你兩個～。★郭沫若《屈原》第二幕
exampleEn: This matter requires both of us to attack from inside and outside. — Guo Moruo, 'Qu Yuan', Act 2

explanation: 辜罪。形容罪大恶极，即使处死刑也抵偿不了他的罪恶。
explanationTraditional: 辜罪。形容罪大惡極，即使處死刑也抵償不了他的罪惡。
explanationEn: Even death is insufficient punishment for one's crimes; describes heinous crimes.
derivation: 《汉书·路温舒传》盖奏当之成，虽咎繇听之，犹以为死有余辜。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·路溫舒傳》蓋奏當之成，雖咎繇聽之，猶以為死有餘辜。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Lu Wenshu': 'When the memorials of condemnation are completed, even Gao Yao would consider them deserving of death beyond their guilt.'
example: 这个杀人犯，谋财害命，真是～。
exampleTraditional: 這個殺人犯，謀財害命，真是～。
exampleEn: This murderer, who killed for money, truly deserves death beyond his guilt.

explanation: 用软硬兼施的手段，企图使人屈服。
explanationTraditional: 用軟硬兼施的手段，企圖使人屈服。
explanationEn: Use both coercion and bribery to make someone yield.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 温柔温和柔顺；敦厚厚道。原指态度温和，朴实厚道◇也泛指待人温和宽厚。
explanationTraditional: 溫柔溫和柔順；敦厚厚道。原指態度溫和，樸實厚道◇也泛指待人溫和寬厚。
explanationEn: Gentle and kind; originally described a mild and honest attitude, later generally refers to treating others gently and generously.
derivation: 《礼记·经解》温柔敦厚，《诗》教也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·經解》溫柔敦厚，《詩》教也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: The Classics': 'Gentleness and honesty are the teachings of the Book of Songs.'
example: 依孔子的见解，诗的灵魂是要～”的。★闻一多《诗人的横蛮》
exampleTraditional: 依孔子的見解，詩的靈魂是要～”的。★聞一多《詩人的橫蠻》
exampleEn: According to Confucius, the soul of poetry should be 'gentle and honest'. — Wen Yiduo, 'The Poet's Arrogance'

explanation: 对整个局势没有关系或没有影响。
explanationTraditional: 對整個局勢沒有關係或沒有影響。
explanationEn: Does not affect the overall situation.
derivation: 毛泽东《介绍一个合作社》至死不变，愿意带着花岗岩头脑去见上帝的人，肯定是有的，那也无关大局。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《介紹一個合作社》至死不變，願意帶著花崗岩頭腦去見上帝的人，肯定是有的，那也無關大局。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Introducing a Cooperative': 'There are certainly those who will remain unchanged until death, willing to meet God with granite-like brains, but that does not affect the overall situation.'
example: 他的临阵脱逃对整个队来说是～的。
exampleTraditional: 他的臨陣脫逃對整個隊來說是～的。
exampleEn: His desertion in battle does not affect the overall situation for the team.

explanation: 丘土山；貉一种形似狐狸的野兽。一个土山里的貉。比喻彼此同是丑类，没有什么差别。
explanationTraditional: 丘土山；貉一種形似狐狸的野獸。一個土山裡的貉。比喻彼此同是醜類，沒有什麼差別。
explanationEn: Jackals from the same lair; metaphor for people of the same ilk, with no difference.
derivation: 《汉书·杨恽传》若秦时但任小臣，诛杀忠良，竟以灭亡，令亲任大臣，即至今耳，古与今如一丘之貉。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·楊惲傳》若秦時但任小臣，誅殺忠良，竟以滅亡，令親任大臣，即至今耳，古與今如一丘之貉。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Yang Yun': 'In the Qin dynasty, they only employed petty officials and killed loyalists, leading to its downfall. If they had employed great ministers, it might have lasted till now. The past and present are like jackals from the same lair.'
example: 否塞晦盲，真若～。★严复《救亡决论》
exampleTraditional: 否塞晦盲，真若～。★嚴復《救亡決論》
exampleEn: Obscure and blind, truly like jackals from the same lair. — Yan Fu, 'A Final Decision on Saving the Nation'

explanation: 一个人的手足。指单薄的力量。同一手一足”。
explanationTraditional: 一個人的手足。指單薄的力量。同一手一足”。
explanationEn: One's own hands and feet; refers to a single, weak force. Same as '一手一足'.
derivation: 郭沫若《棠棣之华》第五幕我们的父亲死得很早，是我们的母亲把我们姐弟两人一手一脚抚养成人。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《棠棣之華》第五幕我們的父親死得很早，是我們的母親把我們姐弟兩人一手一腳撫養成人。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'The Flower of Tangdi', Act 5: 'Our father died very early, and it was our mother who raised us siblings with her own hands and feet.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鱼肉指受宰割者◇比喻用暴力欺凌，任意残害无辜的人们。
explanationTraditional: 魚肉指受宰割者◇比喻用暴力欺凌，任意殘害無辜的人們。
explanationEn: To treat the common people like fish and meat; metaphorically, to oppress and cruelly harm innocent people through violence.
derivation: 《后汉书·仲长统传》于是骄逸自恣，志意无厌，鱼肉百姓，以盈其欲。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·仲長統傳》於是驕逸自恣，志意無厭，魚肉百姓，以盈其欲。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Zhongchang Tong': 'Then they became arrogant and self-indulgent, insatiable in their desires, treating the people like fish and meat to satisfy their greed.'
example: 所率部队，毫不训练，本不打算作战，故亦不能作战，只是用做搜刮地方，～的工具而已。★冯玉祥《我的生活》第二十二章
exampleTraditional: 所率部隊，毫不訓練，本不打算作戰，故亦不能作戰，只是用做搜刮地方，～的工具而已。★馮玉祥《我的生活》第二十二章
exampleEn: The troops under his command were not trained at all, never intended to fight, and thus could not fight; they were merely used as tools to plunder the land and oppress the people. — Feng Yuxiang, 'My Life', Chapter 22

explanation: 窒阻塞不通。阻碍太多，难以实行。
explanationTraditional: 窒阻塞不通。阻礙太多，難以實行。
explanationEn: Obstructed and difficult to implement; too many obstacles to put into practice.
derivation: 清·龚自珍《答人问关内侯》夫支孽尽封，则国祚愈长久，愈窒碍难行，寰海不能容支孽。”
derivationTraditional: 清·龔自珍《答人問關內侯》夫支孽盡封，則國祚愈長久，愈窒礙難行，寰海不能容支孽。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Gong Zizhen's 'Answering Someone's Question about Guan Nei Hou': 'If all collateral branches are enfeoffed, the dynasty's longevity will be prolonged, but it will become increasingly obstructed and difficult to implement, and the world cannot accommodate all collateral branches.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 坐能言，起能行。原指言论必须切实可行，后比喻说了就做。
explanationTraditional: 坐能言，起能行。原指言論必須切實可行，後比喻說了就做。
explanationEn: When sitting, one can speak; when rising, one can act. Originally meant that words must be practical and feasible; later used to mean saying something and then doing it.
derivation: 《荀子·性恶》故坐而言之，起而可设，张而可施行。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·性惡》故坐而言之，起而可設，張而可施行。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi's 'Human Nature is Evil': 'Therefore, when sitting, one speaks of it; when rising, one can set it up; when spreading it, one can put it into practice.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在鲁班门前舞弄斧子。比喻在行家面前卖弄本领，不自量力。
explanationTraditional: 在魯班門前舞弄斧子。比喻在行家面前賣弄本領，不自量力。
explanationEn: To wield an axe at the door of Master Ban (the legendary carpenter). Metaphor for showing off one's skills in front of an expert, overestimating one's abilities.
derivation: 唐·柳宗元《王氏伯仲唱和诗序》操斧于班、郢之门，斯强颜耳。”宋·欧阳修《与梅圣俞书》昨在真定，有诗七八首，今录去，班门弄斧，可笑可笑。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·柳宗元《王氏伯仲唱和詩序》操斧於班、郢之門，斯強顏耳。”宋·歐陽修《與梅聖俞書》昨在真定，有詩七八首，今錄去，班門弄斧，可笑可笑。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Zongyuan's 'Preface to the Wang Brothers' Poems': 'Wielding an axe at the door of Ban and Ying is indeed a shameless act.' Song Dynasty Ouyang Xiu's 'Letter to Mei Shengyu': 'Yesterday in Zhending, I wrote seven or eight poems; now I send them to you, like wielding an axe at Ban's door, laughable indeed.'
example: 闻得亭亭姐姐学问渊博，妹子何敢～，同他乱谈。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十二回
exampleTraditional: 聞得亭亭姐姐學問淵博，妹子何敢～，同他亂談。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十二回
exampleEn: I heard that Sister Tingting is profoundly learned; how dare I wield an axe at Ban's door and talk nonsense with her? — Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 52

explanation: 指思想品德和学识学问。
explanationTraditional: 指思想品德和學識學問。
explanationEn: Refers to moral character and scholarly knowledge.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《渔家傲·为余伯熙察院寿》道德文章传几世，到君合上三台位。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《漁家傲·為餘伯熙察院壽》道德文章傳幾世，到君合上三臺位。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Xin Qiji's 'Yujia Ao: Birthday for Yu Boxi, Censor': 'Moral character and scholarly knowledge have been passed down for generations; now it is your turn to ascend to the highest position.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鼾声熟睡时发出的鼻息声。形容睡得很深，鼾声很大。
explanationTraditional: 鼾聲熟睡時發出的鼻息聲。形容睡得很深，鼾聲很大。
explanationEn: Snoring sounds like thunder; describes sleeping deeply with loud snores.
derivation: 宋·沈括《梦溪笔谈》第九章上使人微觇准所为，而准方酣寝于中书，鼻息如雷。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·沈括《夢溪筆談》第九章上使人微覘準所為，而準方酣寢於中書，鼻息如雷。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shen Kuo's 'Dream Pool Essays', Chapter 9: 'The emperor sent someone to secretly observe Kou Zhun, but Kou was sleeping soundly in the central secretariat, his snoring like thunder.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹投笔从戎。指文人弃文就武。
explanationTraditional: 猶投筆從戎。指文人棄文就武。
explanationEn: Same as '投笔从戎'; refers to a scholar abandoning the pen to join the military.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 所处所，地方；得其所得到合适的地方。指死得有价值，有意义。
explanationTraditional: 所處所，地方；得其所得到合適的地方。指死得有價值，有意義。
explanationEn: To die in the right place; means to die a worthy and meaningful death.
derivation: 《魏书·张普惠传》人生有死，死得其所，夫复何恨。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·張普惠傳》人生有死，死得其所，夫復何恨。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei: Biography of Zhang Puhui': 'Everyone has a death; to die in the right place, what regret is there?'
example: 我们为人民而死，就是～。★毛泽东《为人民服务》
exampleTraditional: 我們為人民而死，就是～。★毛澤東《為人民服務》
exampleEn: If we die for the people, that is dying a worthy death. — Mao Zedong, 'Serve the People'

explanation: 万物泛指天地间的所有生物；灵聪明、灵巧。世上一切物种中最有灵性的。指人而言。
explanationTraditional: 萬物泛指天地間的所有生物；靈聰明、靈巧。世上一切物種中最有靈性的。指人而言。
explanationEn: The most intelligent among all things in the universe; refers to humans.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 畏惧退缩，不敢前进。
explanationTraditional: 畏懼退縮，不敢前進。
explanationEn: To be timid and shrink back, not daring to advance.
derivation: 宋·魏泰《东轩笔录》唐介始弹张尧佐，谏官皆上疏，及弹文彦博，则吴奎畏葸不前，当时谓拽动阵前。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·魏泰《東軒筆錄》唐介始彈張堯佐，諫官皆上疏，及彈文彥博，則吳奎畏葸不前，當時謂拽動陣前。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wei Tai's 'Dongxuan Records': Tang Jie first impeached Zhang Yaozuo, and the remonstrance officials all submitted memorials. When impeaching Wen Yanbo, Wu Kui was timid and shrank back, which was called 'pulling the front line.'
example: 在困难面前～，不是我们的作风。
exampleTraditional: 在困難面前～，不是我們的作風。
exampleEn: Shrinking back in the face of difficulties is not our style.

explanation: 韬指《六韬》，古代兵书，内容分文、武、龙、虎、豹、犬六韬；略指《三略》，古代兵书，凡三卷。比喻用兵的谋略。
explanationTraditional: 韜指《六韜》，古代兵書，內容分文、武、龍、虎、豹、犬六韜；略指《三略》，古代兵書，凡三卷。比喻用兵的謀略。
explanationEn: Refers to military strategy and tactics; metaphor for the art of warfare.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四十七回你便有文韬武略，怎逃出地网天罗。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四十七回你便有文韜武略，怎逃出地網天羅。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 47: 'Even if you have literary and military strategies, how can you escape the net of heaven and earth?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 阋争斗。兄弟之间的纠纷，也比喻内部争斗。
explanationTraditional: 鬩爭鬥。兄弟之間的糾紛，也比喻內部爭鬥。
explanationEn: Quarrels between brothers; also metaphor for internal strife.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·常棣》兄弟阋于墙，外御其侮。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·常棣》兄弟鬩於牆，外禦其侮。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs, Xiaoya, Changdi': 'Brothers quarrel within the walls, but unite against external insults.'
example: 而侠累那家伙，偏偏要～，引狼入室！★郭沫若《棠棣之花》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 而俠累那傢伙，偏偏要～，引狼入室！★郭沫若《棠棣之花》第二幕
exampleEn: But that fellow Xialei insists on internal strife and inviting wolves into the house! — Guo Moruo, 'The Ballad of Tangdi', Act 2

explanation: 虚空；表表面，外貌。空有好看的外表，实际上不行。指有名无实。
explanationTraditional: 虛空；表表面，外貌。空有好看的外表，實際上不行。指有名無實。
explanationEn: Having a good appearance but lacking substance; more show than substance.
derivation: 唐·郑处诲《明皇杂录》嵩既成，上掷其草于地，曰‘虚有其表耳。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·鄭處誨《明皇雜錄》嵩既成，上擲其草於地，曰‘虛有其表耳。’”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Zheng Chuhui's 'Minghuang Miscellany': 'Song completed it, and the emperor threw the draft on the ground, saying, 'It only has a false appearance.''
example: 表面看上去他挺精明的，可实际上却是～，什么事也办不好。
exampleTraditional: 表面看上去他挺精明的，可實際上卻是～，什麼事也辦不好。
exampleEn: He looks smart on the surface, but in reality he is all show and can't handle anything.

explanation: 意气志趣性格；投合得来。指志趣和性格相同的人，彼此投合。
explanationTraditional: 意氣志趣性格；投合得來。指志趣和性格相同的人，彼此投合。
explanationEn: Having similar interests and temperaments; congenial.
derivation: 元·官大用《范张鸡黍》咱意气相投，你知我心忧。”
derivationTraditional: 元·官大用《范張雞黍》咱意氣相投，你知我心憂。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Guan Dayong's 'Fan Zhang Ji Shu': 'We are congenial in spirit, you know my worries.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻自己不出面，借别人的手去害人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻自己不出面，借別人的手去害人。
explanationEn: To harm someone by using another person's hand; to kill with a borrowed knife.
derivation: 明·汪廷讷《三祝记·造陷》恩相明日奏仲淹为环庆路经略招讨使，以平无昊，这所谓借刀杀人。”
derivationTraditional: 明·汪廷訥《三祝記·造陷》恩相明日奏仲淹為環慶路經略招討使，以平無昊，這所謂借刀殺人。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wang Tingna's 'Three Blessings: Framing': 'Tomorrow, the prime minister will recommend Zhongyan as the military commissioner of Huanqing to pacify Wuyuan. This is what is called killing with a borrowed knife.'
example: 凤姐虽恨秋桐，且喜借他先可发脱二姐，用～之法。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十九回
exampleTraditional: 鳳姐雖恨秋桐，且喜借他先可發脫二姐，用～之法。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十九回
exampleEn: Although Xifeng hated Qiutong, she was glad to use her to get rid of Erjie first, employing the method of killing with a borrowed knife. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 69

explanation: 形容女子姿态美好。
explanationTraditional: 形容女子姿態美好。
explanationEn: Describing a woman's graceful and charming appearance.
derivation: 南朝陈·徐陵《杂曲》诗绿黛红颜两相发，千娇百态情无歇。”唐·张文成《游仙窟》千娇百媚，造次无可比方；弱体轻身，谈之不能备尽。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝陳·徐陵《雜曲》詩綠黛紅顏兩相發，千嬌百態情無歇。”唐·張文成《遊仙窟》千嬌百媚，造次無可比方；弱體輕身，談之不能備盡。”
derivationEn: Southern Dynasties Chen, Xu Ling's 'Miscellaneous Poem': 'Green eyebrows and red cheeks glow together, a thousand charms and hundred postures without end.' Tang Dynasty, Zhang Wencheng's 'Youxian Cave': 'A thousand charms and hundred graces, incomparable in a casual manner; delicate body and light form, indescribable in full.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 圆圆通；方方正。比喻人表面随和，内心严正。
explanationTraditional: 圓圓通；方方正。比喻人表面隨和，內心嚴正。
explanationEn: Smooth on the outside but principled on the inside; outwardly accommodating, inwardly strict.
derivation: 南朝·宋·范晔《后汉书·郅恽传》案延资性贪邪，外方内圆，朋党构奸，罔上害人。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·范曄《後漢書·郅惲傳》案延資性貪邪，外方內圓，朋黨構奸，罔上害人。”
derivationEn: Southern Dynasties Song, Fan Ye's 'Book of Later Han, Biography of Zhi Yun': 'An Yan is greedy and evil by nature, outwardly square but inwardly round, forming cliques and committing treachery, deceiving the emperor and harming others.'
example: 静女士时常想学慧的老练精干，学王女士的～，又能随和，又有定见。★茅盾《幻灭》
exampleTraditional: 靜女士時常想學慧的老練精幹，學王女士的～，又能隨和，又有定見。★茅盾《幻滅》
exampleEn: Miss Jing often wanted to learn Hui's sophistication and Wang's outward roundness and inward squareness, being both accommodating and principled. — Mao Dun, 'Disillusionment'

explanation: 心里没有远大志向。
explanationTraditional: 心裡沒有遠大志向。
explanationEn: Having no great ambition in one's heart.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十六章至于回、革等人，实系凡庸之辈，胸无大志，三年来观望风色，动摇不前。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十六章至於回、革等人，實系凡庸之輩，胸無大志，三年來觀望風色，動搖不前。”
derivationEn: Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 36: 'As for Hui, Ge, and others, they are truly mediocre, with no great ambition, watching the wind and hesitating for three years.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 欲想要。想求快速，反而不能达到目的。
explanationTraditional: 欲想要。想求快速，反而不能達到目的。
explanationEn: Trying to be fast leads to failure; haste makes waste.
derivation: 先秦·孔子《论语·子路》无欲速，无见小利。欲速则不达，见小利则大事不成。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·孔子《論語·子路》無慾速，無見小利。欲速則不達，見小利則大事不成。”
derivationEn: Pre-Qin, Confucius's 'Analects, Zilu': 'Do not desire speed, do not see small gains. Haste makes waste, and seeing small gains prevents great achievements.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 登升。一步步地升高。多形容仕途顺利，职位不断高升。
explanationTraditional: 登升。一步步地升高。多形容仕途順利，職位不斷高升。
explanationEn: To rise step by step; often describes a smooth career with continuous promotions.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷三十曰‘步步登高时如何？’师曰‘云生足下。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷三十曰‘步步登高時如何？’師曰‘雲生足下。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting' volume 30: 'What about rising step by step?' The master said, 'Clouds grow beneath your feet.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象做了一场大梦才醒。比喻被错误的东西蒙蔽了许久，开始醒悟过来。
explanationTraditional: 象做了一場大夢才醒。比喻被錯誤的東西蒙蔽了許久，開始醒悟過來。
explanationEn: Like waking from a great dream; metaphor for finally realizing one's mistakes after being misled for a long time.
derivation: 《庄子·齐物论》且有大觉，而后知此其大梦也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·齊物論》且有大覺，而後知此其大夢也。”
derivationEn: Zhuangzi, 'Discussion on Making All Things Equal': 'Only after great awakening does one know this is a great dream.'
example: 从一九年以来，她才仿佛从～似的，又从事于版画了。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文末编·〈凯绥·珂勒惠支版画选集〉序目》
exampleTraditional: 從一九年以來，她才彷彿從～似的，又從事於版畫了。★魯迅《且介亭雜文末編·〈凱綏·珂勒惠支版畫選集〉序目》
exampleEn: Since 1919, she seemed to have woken from a great dream and returned to printmaking. — Lu Xun, 'Postscript to Kaethe Kollwitz Print Collection'

explanation: 原指用手指一点使铁变成金的法术。比喻修改文章时稍稍改动原来的文字，就使它变得很出色。
explanationTraditional: 原指用手指一點使鐵變成金的法術。比喻修改文章時稍稍改動原來的文字，就使它變得很出色。
explanationEn: Originally refers to the magic of turning iron into gold by touching it; metaphor for improving a piece of writing by making small changes that greatly enhance it.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《答洪驹父书》古之能为文章者，真能陶冶万物，虽取古人之陈言入于翰墨，如灵丹一粒，点铁成金也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《答洪駒父書》古之能為文章者，真能陶冶萬物，雖取古人之陳言入於翰墨，如靈丹一粒，點鐵成金也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Huang Tingjian's 'Letter to Hong Jufu': 'Ancient masters of writing could truly refine all things, taking old sayings into their works like a magic pill that turns iron into gold.'
example: 真是～，会者不难，只改得二三十个字，便通篇改观了。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: 真是～，會者不難，只改得二三十個字，便通篇改觀了。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四十三回
exampleEn: Truly turning iron into gold—easy for the skilled. With just twenty or thirty words changed, the whole piece was transformed. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 43

explanation: 绝顶极端。形容异常聪明。
explanationTraditional: 絕頂極端。形容異常聰明。
explanationEn: Extremely intelligent; exceptionally clever.
derivation: 郭沫若《庄子的批判》庄子是绝顶聪明的人，他的门徒大约也是些～的人。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《莊子的批判》莊子是絕頂聰明的人，他的門徒大約也是些～的人。”
derivationEn: Guo Moruo, 'Critique of Zhuangzi': 'Zhuangzi was an extremely intelligent person, and his disciples were probably also extremely intelligent.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 芒刺细刺。象有芒和刺扎在背上一样。形容内心惶恐，坐立不安。
explanationTraditional: 芒刺細刺。象有芒和刺紮在背上一樣。形容內心惶恐，坐立不安。
explanationEn: Like having thorns on one's back; describes extreme unease and restlessness.
derivation: 《汉书·霍光传》宣帝始立，谒见高庙，大将军光从骖乘，上内严惮之，若有芒刺在背。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·霍光傳》宣帝始立，謁見高廟，大將軍光從驂乘，上內嚴憚之，若有芒刺在背。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han, Biography of Huo Guang': 'When Emperor Xuan first ascended, he visited the ancestral temple. General Huo Guang rode in the same chariot. The emperor was deeply afraid, feeling as if thorns were on his back.'
example: 现在被献忠这样一看，感到踨蹐不安，犹如～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十七章
exampleTraditional: 現在被獻忠這樣一看，感到踨蹐不安，猶如～。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十七章
exampleEn: Now, being stared at by Zhang Xianzhong, he felt uneasy, as if thorns were on his back. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 27

explanation: 形容一片黑暗，没有一点光明。也形容对事情一无所知。
explanationTraditional: 形容一片黑暗，沒有一點光明。也形容對事情一無所知。
explanationEn: Describes complete darkness with no light; also refers to knowing nothing about a matter.
derivation: 毛泽东《改造我们的学习》不论是近百年的和古代的中国史，在许多党员的心目中还是漆黑一团。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《改造我們的學習》不論是近百年的和古代的中國史，在許多黨員的心目中還是漆黑一團。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong, 'Reform Our Study': 'For many Party members, both recent and ancient Chinese history remain pitch black.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 谋求安吉，避开灾难。
explanationTraditional: 謀求安吉，避開災難。
explanationEn: To seek good fortune and avoid disaster.
derivation: 明·沈鲸《双珠记·母子分珠》趋吉避凶，儒者之事。”明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十二回不然。圣人云至诚之道，可以前知。吾等问于高明之人，当趋吉避凶。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈鯨《雙珠記·母子分珠》趨吉避凶，儒者之事。”明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十二回不然。聖人云至誠之道，可以前知。吾等問於高明之人，當趨吉避凶。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shen Jing's 'Double Pearl Story: Mother and Son Part': 'Seeking good fortune and avoiding disaster is the way of a scholar.' Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 62: 'The sage says sincerity can foresee the future. We should consult wise men to seek good fortune and avoid disaster.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 整个军队全部被消灭。比喻事情彻底失败。
explanationTraditional: 整個軍隊全部被消滅。比喻事情徹底失敗。
explanationEn: The entire army is wiped out; metaphor for complete failure of an endeavor.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第九十三回梅山七怪化成人形，与周兵屡战，俱被陆续诛灭，复现原形，大失朝廷体面，全军覆没；臣等只得逃回。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第九十三回梅山七怪化成人形，與周兵屢戰，俱被陸續誅滅，復現原形，大失朝廷體面，全軍覆沒；臣等只得逃回。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 93: 'The seven monsters of Meishan transformed into human forms and fought repeatedly with Zhou's army, but were all killed one by one, reverting to their original forms, greatly disgracing the court. The whole army was annihilated; we ministers had to flee back.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指为了应付某种情况而暂时采取的办法。同权宜之计”。
explanationTraditional: 指為了應付某種情況而暫時採取的辦法。同權宜之計”。
explanationEn: A temporary measure to deal with a situation; same as 'expedient measure'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻不务正业的妇女。
explanationTraditional: 比喻不務正業的婦女。
explanationEn: Metaphor for women who do not engage in proper work; refers to various types of women often associated with gossip or mischief.
derivation: 元·陶宗仪《辍耕录》卷十三三姑者，尼姑、道姑、卦姑也；六婆者，牙婆、媒婆、师婆、虔婆、药婆、稳婆也。”
derivationTraditional: 元·陶宗儀《輟耕錄》卷十三三姑者，尼姑、道姑、卦姑也；六婆者，牙婆、媒婆、師婆、虔婆、藥婆、穩婆也。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Tao Zongyi's 'Notes from the Plowing and Weaving Studio', Volume 13: 'The three aunts are nuns, Taoist nuns, and fortune-tellers; the six grannies are matchmakers, procuresses, sorceresses, brothel keepers, herbalists, and midwives.'
example: 吾闻贵地有～，一经招引入门，妇女无知，往往为其所害，或哄骗银钱，或拐带衣物。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 吾聞貴地有～，一經招引入門，婦女無知，往往為其所害，或哄騙銀錢，或拐帶衣物。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十二回
exampleEn: I have heard that in your honorable region there are three aunts and six grannies. Once they enter a household, ignorant women are often harmed by them, either cheated of money or abducted. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 12

explanation: 一句话说出了口，就是套上四匹马拉的车也难追上。指话说出口，就不能再收回，一定要算数。
explanationTraditional: 一句話說出了口，就是套上四匹馬拉的車也難追上。指話說出口，就不能再收回，一定要算數。
explanationEn: A word spoken cannot be taken back even by a team of four horses. It means that once a promise is made, it must be kept.
derivation: 《论语·颜渊》夫子之说君子也，驷不及舌。”《邓析子·转辞》一言而非，驷马不能追；一言而急，驷马不能及。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·顏淵》夫子之說君子也，駟不及舌。”《鄧析子·轉辭》一言而非，駟馬不能追；一言而急，駟馬不能及。”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius and Dengxi Zi: 'A word spoken cannot be overtaken by a team of four horses.'
example: 大丈夫一言既出，～，岂有翻悔之理！★元·李寿卿《伍员吹箫》第三折
exampleTraditional: 大丈夫一言既出，～，豈有翻悔之理！★元·李壽卿《伍員吹簫》第三折
exampleEn: A true man's word is his bond; how could he go back on it? — Yuan Dynasty, Li Shouqing's Wu Yuan Blows the Flute, Act 3

explanation: 生死与共，形容情谊极深。
explanationTraditional: 生死與共，形容情誼極深。
explanationEn: To live and die together, describing a very deep friendship or bond.
derivation: 《隋书·郑译传》郑译与朕同生共死，间关危难，兴言急此，何日忘之。”
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·鄭譯傳》鄭譯與朕同生共死，間關危難，興言急此，何日忘之。”
derivationEn: From Book of Sui: 'Zheng Yi and I have lived and died together through hardships.'
example: 一对～的战友，肩并着肩；火热的手，紧紧地握在一起。★罗广斌、杨益言《在烈火中永生》
exampleTraditional: 一對～的戰友，肩並著肩；火熱的手，緊緊地握在一起。★羅廣斌、楊益言《在烈火中永生》
exampleEn: A pair of comrades who lived and died together, shoulder to shoulder, their hands tightly clasped. — Luo Guangbin and Yang Yiyan's Eternity in Flames

explanation: 心里明白，眼睛雪亮。形容看问题敏锐，能辨别是非。
explanationTraditional: 心裡明白，眼睛雪亮。形容看問題敏銳，能辨別是非。
explanationEn: Clear-minded and sharp-eyed; describes someone who sees issues clearly and can distinguish right from wrong.
derivation: 老舍《神拳》神团办事，心明眼亮。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《神拳》神團辦事，心明眼亮。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's The Boxer Rebellion: 'The Boxers act with clear minds and sharp eyes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指很短的时间。
explanationTraditional: 指很短的時間。
explanationEn: A very short period of time.
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《张天师》吾今用你坛前仗剑等待，休错吾一时半刻。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《張天師》吾今用你壇前仗劍等待，休錯吾一時半刻。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Wu Changling's Zhang Tianshi: 'I need you to wait by the altar with your sword, do not miss a moment.'
example: 你这么个明白人，怎么～的就不会体应该人。（清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十二回）
exampleTraditional: 你這麼個明白人，怎麼～的就不會體應該人。（清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十二回）
exampleEn: You are such a sensible person, how could you fail to understand for just a moment? — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's Dream of the Red Chamber, Chapter 32

explanation: 有开头，有结尾。指做事能坚持到底。
explanationTraditional: 有開頭，有結尾。指做事能堅持到底。
explanationEn: Having a beginning and an end; refers to doing things with persistence and completeness.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第二十二回却才说不了，他便是真大丈夫，有头有尾，有始有终，我如今只等病好时，便去投奔他。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第二十二回卻才說不了，他便是真大丈夫，有頭有尾，有始有終，我如今只等病好時，便去投奔他。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an's Water Margin, Chapter 22: 'He is a true man, with a beginning and an end, with a start and a finish.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 淡薄，与浓”相对。菜肴因盐少而没有味道。亦泛指清淡无味。亦形容说话、写文章内容平淡，无趣味。
explanationTraditional: 淡薄，與濃”相對。菜餚因鹽少而沒有味道。亦泛指清淡無味。亦形容說話、寫文章內容平淡，無趣味。
explanationEn: Bland and tasteless; refers to food lacking salt, or figuratively to speech or writing that is dull and uninteresting.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十二回庶民因其淡而无味，不及米谷之香，吃者甚少。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十二回庶民因其淡而無味，不及米穀之香，吃者甚少。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 12: 'Common people find it bland and tasteless, not as fragrant as rice and grains, so few eat it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鸿鹄天鹅，比喻志向远大的人；志志向。比喻远大志向。
explanationTraditional: 鴻鵠天鵝，比喻志向遠大的人；志志向。比喻遠大志向。
explanationEn: The ambition of a swan; metaphor for a lofty and far-reaching aspiration.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·士容》夫骥骜之气，鸿鹄之志，有谕乎人心者，诚也。”《史记·陈涉世家》嗟乎！燕雀安知鸿鹄之志哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·士容》夫驥驁之氣，鴻鵠之志，有諭乎人心者，誠也。”《史記·陳涉世家》嗟乎！燕雀安知鴻鵠之志哉！”
derivationEn: From Master Lü's Spring and Autumn Annals and Records of the Grand Historian: 'Alas! How can a sparrow know the ambition of a swan?'
example: 大丈夫仗～，据英杰之才。★元·郑德辉《王粲登楼》第一折
exampleTraditional: 大丈夫仗～，據英傑之才。★元·鄭德輝《王粲登樓》第一折
exampleEn: A man of great ambition, relying on his outstanding talent. — Yuan Dynasty, Zheng Dehui's Wang Can Ascends the Tower, Act 1

explanation: 形容事情顺利，一开始就取得胜利。
explanationTraditional: 形容事情順利，一開始就取得勝利。
explanationEn: To achieve success immediately upon arrival; describes things going smoothly and winning from the start.
derivation: 元·郑廷玉《楚昭公》第四折只愿你马到功成，奏凯而还。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭廷玉《楚昭公》第四折只願你馬到功成，奏凱而還。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Zheng Tingyu's Prince Zhao of Chu, Act 4: 'I wish you immediate success and a triumphant return.'
example: 向使微臣督剿江、淮、豫、楚间，果能运筹制胜，～，各省抚臣岂易于为力？★明·卢象昻《剿荡衍期听候处分并陈贼势兵情疏》
exampleTraditional: 向使微臣督剿江、淮、豫、楚間，果能運籌制勝，～，各省撫臣豈易於為力？★明·盧象昻《剿蕩衍期聽候處分並陳賊勢兵情疏》
