derivationEn: From Cheng Jiezhai's Song Dynasty poem 'Spring in the Garden': 'A face full of spring breeze, an air of harmony, revealing the poetry and books in the heart.'
example: ～乐醄醄，一场长笑海山高。★元·无名氏《九世同堂》第四折》
exampleTraditional: ～樂醄醄，一場長笑海山高。★元·無名氏《九世同堂》第四折》
exampleEn: With a face full of spring breeze and joy, a long laugh echoes over the mountains and seas. (From Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Nine Generations Under One Roof', Act 4)

explanation: 父亲生前的债务，由子女负责偿还。也指父辈的过错累及子女。
explanationTraditional: 父親生前的債務，由子女負責償還。也指父輩的過錯累及子女。
explanationEn: The debts of a father are to be repaid by his children; also refers to children bearing the consequences of their parents' mistakes.
derivation: 祝兴义《此生此夜》我知道自己出身不好，在娘胎就背上父辈罪恶的包袱。就算是‘父债子还’吧。”
derivationTraditional: 祝興義《此生此夜》我知道自己出身不好，在孃胎就背上父輩罪惡的包袱。就算是‘父債子還’吧。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xingyi's 'This Life This Night': 'I knew my family background was bad, and I was burdened with my father's sins from the womb. Even if it's 'the son pays for the father's debts.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 吉星指福、禄、寿三星。吉祥之星高高照临。
explanationTraditional: 吉星指福、祿、壽三星。吉祥之星高高照臨。
explanationEn: The lucky star shines high; metaphor for good fortune.
derivation: 陈残云《热带惊涛录》那是他在香港当学徒时刺上的，带有'吉星高照'之意。”
derivationTraditional: 陳殘雲《熱帶驚濤錄》那是他在香港當學徒時刺上的，帶有'吉星高照'之意。”
derivationEn: From Chen Canyun's 'Tropical Storm': 'It was tattooed when he was an apprentice in Hong Kong, carrying the meaning of 'the lucky star shines high.'
example: 此后，～，他在政治上将有飞黄腾达的日子。★徐迟《牡丹》
exampleTraditional: 此後，～，他在政治上將有飛黃騰達的日子。★徐遲《牡丹》
exampleEn: After that, with the lucky star shining high, he would have a meteoric rise in politics. (From Xu Chi's 'Peony')

explanation: 指自己特别擅长的本领。
explanationTraditional: 指自己特別擅長的本領。
explanationEn: One's special skill or expertise.
derivation: 李劼人《天魔舞》?3章她不等他说真心话，她的看家本事就拿出来了。”
derivationTraditional: 李劼人《天魔舞》?3章她不等他說真心話，她的看家本事就拿出來了。”
derivationEn: From Li Jieren's 'Demon Dance' Chapter 3: 'Before he could speak his true feelings, she brought out her special skill.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 做事不要使自己人痛心，使敌人高兴。指某种举坳只利于敌人，不利于自己。
explanationTraditional: 做事不要使自己人痛心，使敵人高興。指某種舉坳只利於敵人，不利於自己。
explanationEn: Actions that grieve one's own side and delight the enemy; doing something that benefits the enemy and harms oneself.
derivation: 汉·朱浮《与彭宠书》凡举事无为亲厚者所痛，而为见仇者所快。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·朱浮《與彭寵書》凡舉事無為親厚者所痛，而為見仇者所快。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Zhu Fu's 'Letter to Peng Chong': 'In all actions, do not cause pain to those close to you and delight to your enemies.'
example: 现在许多人的文章上常常有一句话，说是无使～”。★毛泽东《和中央社、扫荡报、新民报三记者的谈话》
exampleTraditional: 現在許多人的文章上常常有一句話，說是無使～”。★毛澤東《和中央社、掃蕩報、新民報三記者的談話》
exampleEn: Many people's articles often have a phrase: 'Do not cause grief to friends and joy to foes.' — Mao Zedong's talk with reporters from Central News Agency, Saodang Bao, and Xinmin Bao

explanation: 秋毫鸟兽秋天新换的绒毛，比喻极细微的东西；犯侵犯。指军纪严明，丝毫不侵犯人民的利益。
explanationTraditional: 秋毫鳥獸秋天新換的絨毛，比喻極細微的東西；犯侵犯。指軍紀嚴明，絲毫不侵犯人民的利益。
explanationEn: Disciplined military forces that do not harm the people in the slightest.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》吾入关，秋毫不敢有所近，籍吏民，封府库，而待将军。”《后汉书·岑彭传》持军整齐，秋毫无犯。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》吾入關，秋毫不敢有所近，籍吏民，封府庫，而待將軍。”《後漢書·岑彭傳》持軍整齊，秋毫無犯。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'When I entered the pass, I dared not touch even the smallest thing.' And 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Cen Peng': 'He kept the army orderly and did not harm the people.'
example: 老夫一生公廉正直，与人～。★元·岳伯川《铁拐李》第二折
exampleTraditional: 老夫一生公廉正直，與人～。★元·嶽伯川《鐵柺李》第二折
exampleEn: All my life I have been just and upright, and have never harmed anyone. — Yuan Dynasty Yue Bochuan's 'Iron Crutch Li', Act 2

explanation: 比喻牵强附会，生拖死拽。
explanationTraditional: 比喻牽強附會，生拖死拽。
explanationEn: To force a connection or interpretation; to drag someone or something forcibly.
derivation: 曹禺《日出》第四幕福升生拉活扯地将黄省三向外拖。”
derivationTraditional: 曹禺《日出》第四幕福升生拉活扯地將黃省三向外拖。”
derivationEn: From Cao Yu's 'Sunrise' Act 4: 'Fusheng dragged Huang Sheng San out by force.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 疆界限。万年长寿，永远生存。用于祝人长寿。
explanationTraditional: 疆界限。萬年長壽，永遠生存。用於祝人長壽。
explanationEn: Long life without end; used to wish someone longevity.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·天保》君曰卜尔，万寿无疆。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·天保》君曰卜爾，萬壽無疆。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Tianbao': 'The lord says, may you have boundless longevity.'
example: 陛下已过大难，定然～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十七回
exampleTraditional: 陛下已過大難，定然～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十七回
exampleEn: Your Majesty has survived great calamities, and surely will have boundless longevity. — Qing Dynasty Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel' Chapter 37

explanation: 比喻事情还没有着落或还没有决定。
explanationTraditional: 比喻事情還沒有著落或還沒有決定。
explanationEn: Something that is not yet settled or decided.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十回莫若此时趁事在成败未定之天，自己先留个地步。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十回莫若此時趁事在成敗未定之天，自己先留個地步。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Couple' Chapter 10: 'Better to leave oneself a way out while the matter is still undecided.'
example: 事情还在～，你们忙些啥？★周立波《暴风骤雨》第二部
exampleTraditional: 事情還在～，你們忙些啥？★周立波《暴風驟雨》第二部
exampleEn: The matter is still undecided, why are you in such a hurry? — Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane' Part 2

explanation: 指事物之间相互关联，犹如一条脉络贯穿下来可以互通。
explanationTraditional: 指事物之間相互關聯，猶如一條脈絡貫穿下來可以互通。
explanationEn: Things that are interconnected or share a common origin.
derivation: 鲁迅《花边文学·谁在没落》倘说中国画和印象主义有一脉相通，那倒还说得下去的。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《花邊文學·誰在沒落》倘說中國畫和印象主義有一脈相通，那倒還說得下去的。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Essays on Flowery Literature: Who Is Declining?': 'If one says that Chinese painting and Impressionism are connected, that is acceptable.'
example: 人们对《飞天》的喜爱和上面提到的那个鲁班故事所包含的美学思想，实际上有其～之处。★秦牧《艺海拾贝·鲁班的妙手》
exampleTraditional: 人們對《飛天》的喜愛和上面提到的那個魯班故事所包含的美學思想，實際上有其～之處。★秦牧《藝海拾貝·魯班的妙手》
exampleEn: People's love for 'Flying Apsaras' and the aesthetic ideas in the story of Lu Ban are actually interconnected. — Qin Mu's 'Gleaning from the Sea of Art: Lu Ban's Magic Hands'

explanation: 有开头没有收尾。指没有把事情做完。
explanationTraditional: 有開頭沒有收尾。指沒有把事情做完。
explanationEn: To start something but not finish it; to leave a task incomplete.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷五曰‘有头无尾时如何？’师曰‘吐得黄金堪作什么？’”《朱子语类》若是有头无尾底人，便是忠也不久。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷五曰‘有頭無尾時如何？’師曰‘吐得黃金堪作什麼？’”《朱子語類》若是有頭無尾底人，便是忠也不久。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'What about having a beginning but no end?' The master said, 'What use is spitting gold?' And 'Zhu Xi's Analects': 'If a person has a beginning but no end, even loyalty will not last.'
example: 倘若不幸而至于～，你又有颁布者什么说？★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一四五回
exampleTraditional: 倘若不幸而至於～，你又有頒佈者什麼說？★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一四五回
exampleEn: If unfortunately it ends up with a beginning but no end, what will you have to say? — Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic' Chapter 145

explanation: 形容别人对自己的毁誉。
explanationTraditional: 形容別人對自己的譭譽。
explanationEn: Refers to others' praise or blame of oneself.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公下》《春秋》，天子之事也。是故孔子曰‘知我者，其惟《春秋》乎！罪我者，其惟《春秋》乎！’”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公下》《春秋》，天子之事也。是故孔子曰‘知我者，其惟《春秋》乎！罪我者，其惟《春秋》乎！’”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Duke Wen of Teng II': 'The Spring and Autumn Annals are the emperor's business. Therefore Confucius said: 'Those who understand me will do so through the Spring and Autumn Annals; those who condemn me will also do so through the Spring and Autumn Annals.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指被打倒的阶级敌人或反动势力纠集起来向革命人民进行反扑报复。
explanationTraditional: 指被打倒的階級敵人或反動勢力糾集起來向革命人民進行反撲報復。
explanationEn: The counterattack and retaliation by overthrown class enemies or reactionary forces against the revolutionary people.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 非常快乐，竟忘记回家。形容沉迷于某种场合，舍不得离开。
explanationTraditional: 非常快樂，竟忘記回家。形容沉迷於某種場合，捨不得離開。
explanationEn: So happy that one forgets to return home; describes being deeply engrossed in a place or activity and reluctant to leave.
derivation: 《史记·秦本纪》第五卷造父以善御幸于周缪王……西巡狩，乐而忘归。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·秦本紀》第五卷造父以善御幸於周繆王……西巡狩，樂而忘歸。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Annals of Qin' Volume 5: 'Zaofu, favored by King Mu of Zhou for his skill in charioteering... went on a western tour, was so happy he forgot to return.'
example: 但凡有可以消遣处，不是十天，就是半月，～。★清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第八十九回
exampleTraditional: 但凡有可以消遣處，不是十天，就是半月，～。★清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第八十九回
exampleEn: Whenever there was a place for amusement, he would stay for ten days or half a month, so happy he forgot to return. — Qing Dynasty, Shi Yukun, 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants', Chapter 89

explanation: 扭转亏损，增加盈利。
explanationTraditional: 扭轉虧損，增加盈利。
explanationEn: To reverse losses and increase profits.
derivation: 《人民日报》1983.12.30这说明工业企业扭亏增盈的任务依然相当艰巨。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1983.12.30這說明工業企業扭虧增盈的任務依然相當艱鉅。”
derivationEn: From 'People's Daily' December 30, 1983: 'This shows that the task of reversing losses and increasing profits for industrial enterprises remains quite arduous.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 臭气味。身上的奶腥气还没有退尽。对年轻人表示轻蔑的说法。
explanationTraditional: 臭氣味。身上的奶腥氣還沒有退盡。對年輕人表示輕蔑的說法。
explanationEn: Still smelling of mother's milk; a derogatory term for a young person, implying inexperience or immaturity.
derivation: 《汉书·高帝纪上》是口尚乳臭，不能当韩信。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·高帝紀上》是口尚乳臭，不能當韓信。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Annals of Emperor Gaozu, Part 1': 'His mouth still smells of milk; he cannot match Han Xin.'
example: 这些故事，作为闲谈来听听是不算很坏的，但万一有谁相信了，照办了，那就会成为～的吉呵德。（鲁迅《且介亭杂文·难行和不信》）
exampleTraditional: 這些故事，作為閒談來聽聽是不算很壞的，但萬一有誰相信了，照辦了，那就會成為～的吉呵德。（魯迅《且介亭雜文·難行和不信》）
exampleEn: These stories are not bad to listen to as idle talk, but if anyone believes them and acts accordingly, they would become a Don Quixote still wet behind the ears. — Lu Xun, 'Essays from Qiejieting: Difficult to Practice and Unbelievable'

explanation: 比喻势力强大，根基牢固。
explanationTraditional: 比喻勢力強大，根基牢固。
explanationEn: A big tree with deep roots; metaphor for a powerful and well-established force or influence.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 天自然规律；人人事；际际遇。自然和人事之间的相互关系。
explanationTraditional: 天自然規律；人人事；際際遇。自然和人事之間的相互關係。
explanationEn: The relationship between nature (heaven) and human affairs; the interplay of natural laws and human activities.
derivation: 汉·司马迁《报任少卿书》亦欲以究天人之际，通古今之变，成一家之言。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·司馬遷《報任少卿書》亦欲以究天人之際，通古今之變，成一家之言。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Sima Qian, 'Letter to Ren An': 'I also wish to explore the relationship between heaven and man, understand the changes of past and present, and establish my own school of thought.'
example: 是以臣每察～，观祸乱之由，迹帝王之事，念先师之说，昭然著明，信不欺尔。★唐·陈子昂《谏政理书》
exampleTraditional: 是以臣每察～，觀禍亂之由，跡帝王之事，念先師之說，昭然著明，信不欺爾。★唐·陳子昂《諫政理書》
exampleEn: Therefore, whenever I observe the relationship between heaven and man, examine the causes of chaos and calamity, trace the deeds of emperors and kings, and recall the teachings of the sages, it is all clear and evident, truly not deceptive. — Tang Dynasty, Chen Zi'ang, 'Memorial on Governance'

explanation: 形容文章、言论书法等气势豪放，潇洒自如。同汪洋自肆”。
explanationTraditional: 形容文章、言論書法等氣勢豪放，瀟灑自如。同汪洋自肆”。
explanationEn: Describes writing, speech, or calligraphy as bold, unrestrained, and free-flowing; same as '汪洋自肆'.
derivation: 唐·柳宗元《直城县开国伯柳公行状》凡为文，去藻饰之华靡，汪洋自肆，以适己为用。” 明·归有光《与潘子实书》听其言汪洋恣肆，而实无所折衷，此今世之通患也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·柳宗元《直城縣開國伯柳公行狀》凡為文，去藻飾之華靡，汪洋自肆，以適己為用。” 明·歸有光《與潘子實書》聽其言汪洋恣肆，而實無所折衷，此今世之通患也。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Liu Zongyuan, 'Epitaph of Duke Liu of Yicheng': 'In all his writings, he removed ornate embellishments, was unrestrained and free-flowing, using them for his own purposes.' Ming Dynasty, Gui Youguang, 'Letter to Pan Zishi': 'Listening to his words, they are vast and unrestrained, but in reality, they lack compromise; this is a common ailment of today.'
example: 他激动地铺开稿纸，提笔写下了小说的题目，便～地写起来。★刘绍棠《春草》
exampleTraditional: 他激動地鋪開稿紙，提筆寫下了小說的題目，便～地寫起來。★劉紹棠《春草》
exampleEn: He excitedly spread out the manuscript paper, wrote the title of the novel, and then began writing with bold and unrestrained freedom. — Liu Shaotang, 'Spring Grass'

explanation: 没能够摆脱开自己不以为然的风俗习惯。
explanationTraditional: 沒能夠擺脫開自己不以為然的風俗習慣。
explanationEn: Unable to break away from customs that one disapproves of; to follow the crowd reluctantly.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·任诞》未能免俗，聊复尔耳。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·任誕》未能免俗，聊復爾耳。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Song, Liu Yiqing, 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Unrestrained': 'Unable to avoid vulgarity, I just follow suit.'
example: 倘使揭穿了这谜底，便是所谓杀风景”，也就是俗人，而且带累了雅人，使他雅不下去，～”了。★鲁迅《论俗人应避雅人》
exampleTraditional: 倘使揭穿了這謎底，便是所謂殺風景”，也就是俗人，而且帶累了雅人，使他雅不下去，～”了。★魯迅《論俗人應避雅人》
exampleEn: If the mystery is revealed, it is called 'spoiling the fun,' and one becomes a vulgar person, dragging the refined person down, making him 'unable to avoid vulgarity.' — Lu Xun, 'On Vulgar People Should Avoid Refined People'

explanation: 心里想的和嘴上说的不一样。形容人的虚伪、诡诈。
explanationTraditional: 心裡想的和嘴上說的不一樣。形容人的虛偽、詭詐。
explanationEn: What one thinks is different from what one says; describes hypocrisy or deceit.
derivation: 《醒世姻缘传》第八十二回我是这们个直性子，媳就说媳，不是这们心口不一的。”
derivationTraditional: 《醒世姻緣傳》第八十二回我是這們個直性子，媳就說媳，不是這們心口不一的。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of a Marriage That Awakens the World', Chapter 82: 'I am such a straightforward person; I say what I think, not like those who are duplicitous.'
example: 我竟失态到这地步，但我仍然～的。★俞天白《危栏》
exampleTraditional: 我竟失態到這地步，但我仍然～的。★俞天白《危欄》
exampleEn: I was so out of control, yet I still spoke insincerely. — Yu Tianbai, 'Dangerous Railing'

explanation: 低着眉头，两眼流露出顺从的神情。形容驯良、顺从。
explanationTraditional: 低著眉頭，兩眼流露出順從的神情。形容馴良、順從。
explanationEn: With lowered eyebrows and submissive eyes; describes a docile and obedient demeanor.
derivation: 鲁迅《南腔北调集·上海的儿童》就是钩头耸背，低眉顺眼，一副死板板的脸相的所谓‘好孩子’。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《南腔北調集·上海的兒童》就是鉤頭聳背，低眉順眼，一副死板板的臉相的所謂‘好孩子’。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun, 'Southern Tunes and Northern Tunes: Children in Shanghai': 'Those so-called 'good children' with hunched backs, lowered eyebrows, and submissive eyes, with a stiff face.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原为道家语，指神道居住的名山胜地◇多比喻风景优美的地方。
explanationTraditional: 原為道家語，指神道居住的名山勝地◇多比喻風景優美的地方。
explanationEn: Originally a Taoist term for famous mountains and scenic spots where immortals dwell; now often used to describe beautiful places.
derivation: 唐·杜光庭《洞天福地记》列出十大洞天、三十六小洞天、七十二福地的名称。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜光庭《洞天福地記》列出十大洞天、三十六小洞天、七十二福地的名稱。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Du Guangting, 'Records of Cavern Heavens and Blessed Lands': Lists the names of ten major cavern heavens, thirty-six minor cavern heavens, and seventy-two blessed lands.
example: 如此～，倘得几间幽室，在此暂住几时，也不枉人生一世。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 如此～，倘得幾間幽室，在此暫住幾時，也不枉人生一世。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十九回
exampleEn: Such a blessed spot, if one could have a few quiet rooms and stay here for a while, it would not be a wasted life. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 99

explanation: 好爱好。各人有各人的爱好。指人的爱好出自人的本性，只应听其自然。
explanationTraditional: 好愛好。各人有各人的愛好。指人的愛好出自人的本性，只應聽其自然。
explanationEn: Each has his own preference. It means that everyone has their own likes and dislikes, which are inherent in human nature and should be allowed to follow naturally.
derivation: 唐·萧颖士《仰答韦司业垂访五首》缅怀云岩路，欲往无由缘；物各有所好，违之伤自然。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·蕭穎士《仰答韋司業垂訪五首》緬懷雲巖路，欲往無由緣；物各有所好，違之傷自然。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Xiao Yingshi, 'Respectfully Answering Minister Wei's Five Visits': 'Cherishing the memory of the cloud-covered rocky road, I wish to go but have no way; each thing has its own preference, going against it harms the natural.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 老花招或老手法又重新施展。
explanationTraditional: 老花招或老手法又重新施展。
explanationEn: To repeat an old trick or tactic.
derivation: 《人民日报》1966.1.7所谓‘停止轰炸’，这不过是约翰逊政府的故技重演。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1966.1.7所謂‘停止轟炸’，這不過是約翰遜政府的故技重演。”
derivationEn: People's Daily, January 7, 1966: 'The so-called "cessation of bombing" is nothing but the Johnson administration's repetition of an old trick.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 本来并不高深，故意装出高深的样子。多指文章故意用些艰深词语，掩饰内容的浅薄。
explanationTraditional: 本來並不高深，故意裝出高深的樣子。多指文章故意用些艱深詞語，掩飾內容的淺薄。
explanationEn: To pretend to be profound; deliberately using difficult words to cover up shallowness, especially in writing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻将对方控制在自己势力范围内，然后进行有效打击。
explanationTraditional: 比喻將對方控制在自己勢力範圍內，然後進行有效打擊。
explanationEn: To shut the door and beat the dog; a metaphor for trapping the opponent within one's own sphere of influence and then effectively striking.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人马都很疲乏。形容旅途劳累。
explanationTraditional: 人馬都很疲乏。形容旅途勞累。
explanationEn: Both men and horses are exhausted; describes the fatigue of a journey or campaign.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第七十七回马步三军没了气力，人困马乏。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第七十七回馬步三軍沒了氣力，人困馬乏。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 77: 'The infantry and cavalry had no strength left, men weary and horses spent.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容威力或声势极大。
explanationTraditional: 形容威力或聲勢極大。
explanationEn: Describes an extremely powerful force or momentum.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第四十三回这场大战，真个是天摇地动，日色无光。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第四十三回這場大戰，真個是天搖地動，日色無光。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 43: 'This great battle was truly heaven-shaking and earth-moving, the sunlight dimmed.'
example: 刚一迷糊眼儿，半天空里咕隆隆地一声响，从西半天响到东半天，震得～。★梁斌《播火记》二四
exampleTraditional: 剛一迷糊眼兒，半天空裡咕隆隆地一聲響，從西半天響到東半天，震得～。★梁斌《播火記》二四
exampleEn: Just as he was getting drowsy, there was a rumbling sound in the sky, spreading from the west to the east, shaking heaven and earth. ★ Liang Bin, 'Sowing the Flames', 24

explanation: 孝敬父母的有德行的子孙。
explanationTraditional: 孝敬父母的有德行的子孫。
explanationEn: Filial sons and virtuous descendants; refers to dutiful and virtuous offspring.
derivation: 元·刘唐卿《降桑椹》圣人喜的是义夫节妇，爱的是孝子贤孙。”
derivationTraditional: 元·劉唐卿《降桑椹》聖人喜的是義夫節婦，愛的是孝子賢孫。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Liu Tangqing, 'The Mulberry': 'The sage delights in righteous husbands and chaste wives, and loves filial sons and virtuous descendants.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 徇曲从；枉使歪曲。曲从私情，歪曲和破坏法律，胡乱断案。
explanationTraditional: 徇曲從；枉使歪曲。曲從私情，歪曲和破壞法律，胡亂斷案。
explanationEn: To bend the law to favor personal relationships; to pervert justice for personal gain.
derivation: 元·王謦《中书右丞相史公神道碑》使官吏一心奉公，而不敢为徇情枉法之私。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王謦《中書右丞相史公神道碑》使官吏一心奉公，而不敢為徇情枉法之私。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wang Qing, 'Epitaph of the Right Prime Minister Shi': 'So that officials are single-minded in serving the public, and dare not engage in bending the law for personal favor.'
example: 雨村便～，胡乱判断了此案。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四回
exampleTraditional: 雨村便～，胡亂判斷了此案。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四回
exampleEn: Yucun then bent the law to favor personal relationships and hastily judged the case. ★ Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 4

explanation: 言说。虽然有嘴，但话难以说出口。指有话不便说或不敢说。
explanationTraditional: 言說。雖然有嘴，但話難以說出口。指有話不便說或不敢說。
explanationEn: Having a mouth but unable to speak; refers to being unable to express something due to difficulty or fear.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《醉睡者》诗有道难行不如醉，有口难言不如睡。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《醉睡者》詩有道難行不如醉，有口難言不如睡。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Su Shi, poem 'The Drunk Sleeper': 'The Way is hard to follow, better to be drunk; having a mouth, it's hard to speak, better to sleep.'
example: 如今轮到你山阳县，这都是官吏每无心正法，使百姓～。★元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》第三折
exampleTraditional: 如今輪到你山陽縣，這都是官吏每無心正法，使百姓～。★元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》第三折
exampleEn: Now it's your turn in Shanyang County, all because the officials have no heart for justice, causing the common people to have mouths but cannot speak. ★ Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, 'The Injustice to Dou E', Act 3

explanation: 全部杀光。比喻做事不留余地。
explanationTraditional: 全部殺光。比喻做事不留餘地。
explanationEn: To kill all; to exterminate completely. Also used metaphorically to mean leaving no room for compromise.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第五十三回我本待斩尽杀绝，争奈你不曾犯法。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第五十三回我本待斬盡殺絕，爭奈你不曾犯法。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 53: 'I intended to kill them all, but it's a pity you haven't committed any crime.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧指爱恋极深但感情上得不到满足的男女。
explanationTraditional: 舊指愛戀極深但感情上得不到滿足的男女。
explanationEn: Refers to men and women deeply in love but emotionally unsatisfied.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五回厚地高天，堪叹古今情不尽；痴男怨女，可怜风月债难酬。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五回厚地高天，堪嘆古今情不盡；痴男怨女，可憐風月債難酬。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 5: 'High heaven and deep earth, alas, endless love from ancient times; lovesick men and resentful women, pitiable, the debt of romance hard to repay.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 杜绝堵塞、断绝；患祸害、祸患。指彻底消除以后可能产生的祸患。
explanationTraditional: 杜絕堵塞、斷絕；患禍害、禍患。指徹底消除以後可能產生的禍患。
explanationEn: To completely eliminate future troubles or disasters.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《平妖传》第四十回那安放白玉炉的山峰崩将下来，恰好堵了洞门。雾幙白玉炉仍收回天上，从此白云洞再无人到。此是玉帝杜绝后患之意。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《平妖傳》第四十回那安放白玉爐的山峰崩將下來，恰好堵了洞門。霧幙白玉爐仍收回天上，從此白雲洞再無人到。此是玉帝杜絕後患之意。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Ping Yao Zhuan', Chapter 40: 'The peak where the white jade furnace was placed collapsed, just blocking the cave entrance. The mist and white jade furnace were taken back to heaven, and from then on, no one reached White Cloud Cave. This was the Jade Emperor's intention to eliminate future troubles.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 水波泛出秀色，山上景物明净。形容山水景色秀丽。
explanationTraditional: 水波泛出秀色，山上景物明淨。形容山水景色秀麗。
explanationEn: Describes beautiful scenery with clear water and bright mountains.
derivation: 唐·白居易《菩提寺上方晚眺》诗楼阁高低树浅深，山光水色暝暝沈沈。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《菩提寺上方晚眺》詩樓閣高低樹淺深，山光水色暝暝沈沈。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Bai Juyi's poem 'Viewing from the Top of Bodhi Temple': 'Pavilions high and low, trees shallow and deep, mountain light and water color dim and deep.'
example: 一叶逡巡送客归，～自相依。★元·范子安《竹叶舟》第三折
exampleTraditional: 一葉逡巡送客歸，～自相依。★元·範子安《竹葉舟》第三折
exampleEn: A boat leisurely sees off the guest, mountain light and water color depend on each other. ★ Yuan Dynasty Fan Zi'an's 'Bamboo Leaf Boat', Act 3

explanation: 古代所谓四民，指读书的、种田的、做工的、经商的。
explanationTraditional: 古代所謂四民，指讀書的、種田的、做工的、經商的。
explanationEn: The four traditional classes in ancient China: scholars, farmers, artisans, and merchants.
derivation: 《管子·小匡》士农工商四民者，国之石（柱石）民也。”《淮南子·齐俗训》是以人不兼官， 官不兼事，士农工商，乡别州异，是故农与农言力，士与士言行，工与工言巧， 商与商言数。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·小匡》士農工商四民者，國之石（柱石）民也。”《淮南子·齊俗訓》是以人不兼官， 官不兼事，士農工商，鄉別州異，是故農與農言力，士與士言行，工與工言巧， 商與商言數。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi·Xiao Kuang': 'Scholars, farmers, artisans, and merchants are the pillar people of the state.' From 'Huainanzi·Qi Su Xun': 'Thus people do not hold concurrent offices, officials do not handle multiple tasks; scholars, farmers, artisans, and merchants are distinguished by region and profession.'
example: 下面密密层层，有亿万人来来往往，都想争夺此物。细细看去，～，三教九流，无一不有。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 下面密密層層，有億萬人來來往往，都想爭奪此物。細細看去，～，三教九流，無一不有。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十九回
exampleEn: Below, densely packed, millions of people come and go, all wanting to seize this object. Looking closely, scholars, farmers, artisans, merchants, and all three religions and nine schools are present. ★ Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 99

explanation: 事情不分大小。形容什么事都管。
explanationTraditional: 事情不分大小。形容什麼事都管。
explanationEn: Regardless of size, everything is attended to; describes someone who manages all affairs.
derivation: 《文选·诸葛亮〈出师表〉》愚以为宫中之事，事无大小，悉以咨之。”宋·司马光《资治通鉴》卷第一百八十五委萧瑀以庶政，事无大小，莫不关掌。”
derivationTraditional: 《文選·諸葛亮〈出師表〉》愚以為宮中之事，事無大小，悉以諮之。”宋·司馬光《資治通鑑》卷第一百八十五委蕭瑀以庶政，事無大小，莫不關掌。”
derivationEn: From 'Selected Works·Zhuge Liang's Memorial to the Throne': 'I think that for matters in the palace, regardless of size, all should be consulted.' From Song Dynasty Sima Guang's 'Zizhi Tongjian', Volume 185: 'Entrust Xiao Yu with all government affairs, matters great and small, all under his control.'
example: 却说诸葛丞相在于成都，～，皆亲自从公决断。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八十七回
exampleTraditional: 卻說諸葛丞相在於成都，～，皆親自從公決斷。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八十七回
exampleEn: But Chancellor Zhuge Liang in Chengdu, regardless of size, personally decided all matters. ★ Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 87

explanation: 指谈恋爱。
explanationTraditional: 指談戀愛。
explanationEn: To talk about love; to be in a romantic relationship.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 天坍塌，地裂陷。比喻重大灾变。
explanationTraditional: 天坍塌，地裂陷。比喻重大災變。
explanationEn: Heaven collapses and earth cracks; metaphor for a great catastrophe.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十九回我有了这件东西，说到得了天塌地陷也是瞎话，横竖咱们大清国万万年，我邓振彪也万万年了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十九回我有了這件東西，說到得了天塌地陷也是瞎話，橫豎咱們大清國萬萬年，我鄧振彪也萬萬年了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 39: 'With this thing, even if heaven collapses and earth cracks, it's nonsense, but at least our Great Qing will last ten thousand years, and I, Deng Zhenbiao, will also last ten thousand years.'
example: 一阵机关枪响之后，紧接着就是～似的几阵大声，门窗震动。★冰心《我的邻居》
exampleTraditional: 一陣機關槍響之後，緊接著就是～似的幾陣大聲，門窗震動。★冰心《我的鄰居》
exampleEn: After a burst of machine gun fire, there were several loud noises like heaven collapsing and earth cracking, shaking doors and windows. ★ Bing Xin's 'My Neighbor'

explanation: 形容对人外表和气，却阴险毒辣。
explanationTraditional: 形容對人外表和氣，卻陰險毒辣。
explanationEn: Describes someone who appears friendly but is actually sinister and malicious.
derivation: 《旧唐书·李义府传》义府貌状温恭，与人语必嬉怡微笑，而褊忌阴贼。既处要权，欲人附己，微忤意者，辄加倾陷。故时人言义府笑中有刀。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·李義府傳》義府貌狀溫恭，與人語必嬉怡微笑，而褊忌陰賊。既處要權，欲人附己，微忤意者，輒加傾陷。故時人言義府笑中有刀。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang·Biography of Li Yifu': 'Li Yifu appeared gentle and respectful, always smiling when speaking with others, but was narrow-minded and insidious. When in power, he wanted others to submit to him; those who slightly offended him would be framed. So people at the time said Li Yifu had a knife hidden in his smile.'
example: 他把我丕的来药倒，烟生七窍，冰浸四稍，谁承望～，眼见的丧荒郊。★元·孟汉卿《魔合罗》第二折
exampleTraditional: 他把我丕的來藥倒，煙生七竅，冰浸四稍，誰承望～，眼見的喪荒郊。★元·孟漢卿《魔合羅》第二折
exampleEn: He knocked me down, smoke from seven orifices, ice soaking all limbs; who would expect a knife hidden in a smile, seeing death in the wilderness. ★ Yuan Dynasty Meng Hanqing's 'Moheluo', Act 2

explanation: 心思想；协合。团结一致，共同努力。
explanationTraditional: 心思想；協合。團結一致，共同努力。
explanationEn: To unite and work together with one heart.
derivation: 汉·贾谊《过秦论》且天下尝同心并力攻秦矣，然困于险阻而不能进者，岂勇力智慧不足哉？”《周书·崔谦传》然后与宇文行台，同心协力，电讨不庭，则桓文之勋，复兴于兹日矣。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·賈誼《過秦論》且天下嘗同心並力攻秦矣，然困於險阻而不能進者，豈勇力智慧不足哉？”《周書·崔謙傳》然後與宇文行臺，同心協力，電討不庭，則桓文之勳，復興於茲日矣。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Jia Yi's 'On the Faults of Qin': 'Moreover, the world once united with one heart and strength to attack Qin, but was trapped by dangers and could not advance; was it due to lack of courage and wisdom?' From 'Zhou Shu·Biography of Cui Qian': 'Then with Yuwen Xingtai, work with one heart and strength, punish the disobedient, then the achievements of Huan and Wen will revive today.'
example: 我三人结为兄弟，～，然后可图大事。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一回
exampleTraditional: 我三人結為兄弟，～，然後可圖大事。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一回
exampleEn: We three become sworn brothers, work with one heart and strength, then we can plan great affairs. ★ Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 1

explanation: 形容十分害怕。同心惊胆战”。
explanationTraditional: 形容十分害怕。同心驚膽戰”。
explanationEn: Extremely frightened; same as 'heart trembling and gallbladder cold'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 血海形容杀人流血很多。形容仇恨极大、极深。多指人被杀而引起的仇恨。
explanationTraditional: 血海形容殺人流血很多。形容仇恨極大、極深。多指人被殺而引起的仇恨。
explanationEn: A deep-seated hatred, often due to bloodshed or murder.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他转回身来，面向着哀悼的人群，我们要把悲痛变成力量，我们要誓死报这场～。”（曲波《林海雪原》十八）
exampleTraditional: 他轉回身來，面向著哀悼的人群，我們要把悲痛變成力量，我們要誓死報這場～。”（曲波《林海雪原》十八）
exampleEn: He turned around, facing the mourning crowd, and said, 'We must turn grief into strength, and swear to avenge this blood-deep hatred.' (from Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', chapter 18)

explanation: 比喻留名声于身后。
explanationTraditional: 比喻留名聲於身後。
explanationEn: A metaphor for leaving a good reputation after one's death.
derivation: 元·马致远《汉宫秋》第四折见被你冷落了潇湘暮景，更打动我边塞离情。还说甚雁过留声，那堪更瑶阶夜永，嫌杀月儿明！”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《漢宮秋》第四折見被你冷落了瀟湘暮景，更打動我邊塞離情。還說甚雁過留聲，那堪更瑤階夜永，嫌殺月兒明！”
derivationEn: From Ma Zhiyuan's 'Autumn in the Han Palace', fourth act: 'Seeing you left alone in the Xiaoxiang twilight, it stirs my border farewell. Why mention the wild goose leaving its call? How can I bear the long night on the jade steps, hating the bright moon?'
example: 我也闹了一辈子，人过留名，～，算是这么件事。老弟，你瞧着行得行不得？★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十二回
exampleTraditional: 我也鬧了一輩子，人過留名，～，算是這麼件事。老弟，你瞧著行得行不得？★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十二回
exampleEn: I've been busy all my life. 'A man leaves his name, a wild goose leaves its call.' That's the way it is. Brother, do you think it's acceptable? (from Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', chapter 32)

explanation: 指一个人的意见。
explanationTraditional: 指一個人的意見。
explanationEn: One's own opinion; a personal view.
derivation: 宋·周煇《清波杂志》卷八近时曾公端伯亦编皇宋百家诗选，去取任一己之见。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周煇《清波雜誌》卷八近時曾公端伯亦編皇宋百家詩選，去取任一己之見。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Hui's 'Qingbo Magazine', volume 8: 'Recently, Zeng Duanbo compiled the 'Selected Poems of a Hundred Poets of the Imperial Song', making selections based solely on his own opinion.'
example: 永乐间，儒臣奉敕纂修考订，悉取其不悖本旨者，录之天下。习学已久，洪谟乃以～纷更，不许行。★明·沈德符《野获编·科场·减场解元》
exampleTraditional: 永樂間，儒臣奉敕纂修考訂，悉取其不悖本旨者，錄之天下。習學已久，洪謨乃以～紛更，不許行。★明·沈德符《野獲編·科場·減場解元》
exampleEn: During the Yongle era, Confucian officials were ordered to compile and revise, selecting only those that did not deviate from the original meaning. The world had studied them for a long time. How could Hong Mo change them based on his own opinion? (from Shen Defu's 'Unofficial Gleanings', section on examinations)

explanation: 这四个字都是文言虚词，讽刺人说话喜欢咬文嚼字。也形容半文不白的话或文章。
explanationTraditional: 這四個字都是文言虛詞，諷刺人說話喜歡咬文嚼字。也形容半文不白的話或文章。
explanationEn: These four words are classical Chinese particles, used to mock someone who speaks in a pedantic or overly literary manner.
derivation: 宋·文莹《湘山野录》之乎者也，助得甚事？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·文瑩《湘山野錄》之乎者也，助得甚事？”
derivationEn: From Wen Ying's 'Xiangshan Wild Records': 'Zhi, hu, zhe, ye—what use are they?'
example: 他对人说话，总是满口～，叫人半懂不懂的。
exampleTraditional: 他對人說話，總是滿口～，叫人半懂不懂的。
exampleEn: When he talks to people, he always uses 'zhi, hu, zhe, ye,' making it hard for others to understand.

explanation: 体统格局，规矩。指言行没有规矩，不成样子。
explanationTraditional: 體統格局，規矩。指言行沒有規矩，不成樣子。
explanationEn: Improper; lacking in decorum or proper form.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十三回刻印不及，以锥画之，全不成体统。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十三回刻印不及，以錐畫之，全不成體統。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', chapter 13: 'The seal was not carved properly, but drawn with an awl, completely lacking in proper form.'
example: 此时官厅上乱烘烘的，闹了个～。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 此時官廳上亂烘烘的，鬧了個～。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第二十七回
exampleEn: At that time, the official hall was in chaos, making a scene that was completely improper. (from Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', chapter 27)

explanation: 亨通达，顺利。发财的运道好，赚钱很顺利。
explanationTraditional: 亨通達，順利。發財的運道好，賺錢很順利。
explanationEn: Good fortune in making money; smooth sailing in financial matters.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》谁知财运亨通，飘到长人国，那酒坛竟大获其利。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》誰知財運亨通，飄到長人國，那酒罈竟大獲其利。”
derivationEn: From Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror': 'Who would have thought that his fortune in wealth would be so good that when he drifted to the Land of Giants, the wine jars brought him great profit.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 承欢旧指侍奉父母；膝下子女幼时依于父母膝下，故表示幼年。旧指侍奉父母。
explanationTraditional: 承歡舊指侍奉父母；膝下子女幼時依於父母膝下，故表示幼年。舊指侍奉父母。
explanationEn: To serve and please one's parents while they are alive.
derivation: 《孝经·圣治》故亲生之膝下，以养父母曰严。”
derivationTraditional: 《孝經·聖治》故親生之膝下，以養父母曰嚴。”
derivationEn: From the 'Classic of Filial Piety': 'Therefore, affection is born at the knee, and to support parents is called reverence.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象狗见了主人那样低着头，耷拉着耳朵。形容卑屈驯服的样子。
explanationTraditional: 象狗見了主人那樣低著頭，耷拉著耳朵。形容卑屈馴服的樣子。
explanationEn: To be docile and submissive, like a dog with its head down and ears drooping.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《应科目时与人书》若俯首帖耳，摇尾而乞怜者，非我之志也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《應科目時與人書》若俯首帖耳，搖尾而乞憐者，非我之志也。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Letter to Someone on the Subject of Examinations': 'To bow the head and droop the ears, wagging the tail and begging for mercy, is not my intention.'
example: 他们习惯于猛于虎的官威，以为老百姓只要一加威吓，便自会～。★郭沫若《少年时代·反正前后》
exampleTraditional: 他們習慣於猛於虎的官威，以為老百姓只要一加威嚇，便自會～。★郭沫若《少年時代·反正前後》
exampleEn: They were accustomed to the tyranny of officials, believing that as long as they threatened the people, they would become docile and submissive. (from Guo Moruo's 'Before and After the Revolution')

explanation: 禧吉祥幸福。恭敬地棕新年幸福吉祥如意∝年的常用语。
explanationTraditional: 禧吉祥幸福。恭敬地棕新年幸福吉祥如意∝年的常用語。
explanationEn: Happy New Year; respectfully wishing a happy and auspicious new year.
derivation: 罗广斌、杨益言《红岩》第一章街道两旁的高楼大厦……全都张灯结彩，高悬着‘庆祝元旦’、‘恭贺新禧’之类的大字装饰。”
derivationTraditional: 羅廣斌、楊益言《紅巖》第一章街道兩旁的高樓大廈……全都張燈結綵，高懸著‘慶祝元旦’、‘恭賀新禧’之類的大字裝飾。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guangbin and Yang Yiyan's 'Red Crag', chapter 1: 'The high-rise buildings along the street were decorated with lanterns and banners, displaying large characters such as 'Celebrate New Year's Day' and 'Happy New Year'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 横扫扫荡、扫除。把大量敌军象扫地似地一阵子扫除掉。
explanationTraditional: 橫掃掃蕩、掃除。把大量敵軍象掃地似地一陣子掃除掉。
explanationEn: To sweep away a large enemy force as if sweeping away dust.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《醉歌行》词源倒流三峡水，笔阵独扫千人军。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《醉歌行》詞源倒流三峽水，筆陣獨掃千人軍。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's 'Song of a Drunken Song': 'The source of words flows backward like the Three Gorges, the brush array alone sweeps away a thousand troops.'
example: 七百里驱十五日，赣水苍茫闽山碧，～如卷席。★毛泽东《渔家傲·反第二次大围剿》词
exampleTraditional: 七百里驅十五日，贛水蒼茫閩山碧，～如卷席。★毛澤東《漁家傲·反第二次大圍剿》詞
exampleEn: Seven hundred li in fifteen days, the Gan River vast and the Min Mountains green, sweeping away a thousand troops like rolling up a mat. (from Mao Zedong's poem 'Pride of Fishermen: Countering the Second Encirclement Campaign')

explanation: 原比喻言论正确，极有力量，影响深远。现多比喻能挽回严重局势的力量。
explanationTraditional: 原比喻言論正確，極有力量，影響深遠。現多比喻能挽回嚴重局勢的力量。
explanationEn: Originally referred to the power of correct speech that is extremely influential and far-reaching. Now it often means the power to reverse a critical situation.
derivation: 《魏书·帝纪篇末史臣总论》佞阉处当轴之权，婢媪擅回天之力，卖官鬻狱，乱政淫刑。”《新唐书·张玄素传》张公论事，有回天之力。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·帝紀篇末史臣總論》佞閹處當軸之權，婢媼擅回天之力，賣官鬻獄，亂政淫刑。”《新唐書·張玄素傳》張公論事，有回天之力。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei: Biography of Emperor's Final Chapter' and 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Zhang Xuan Su': 'Zhang Gong's discussion has the power to turn the tide.'
example: ～，全寄托在这个奏折上，所以曹毓英笔下虽快，却是握管踌躇。★高阳《玉座珠帘》上册
exampleTraditional: ～，全寄託在這個奏摺上，所以曹毓英筆下雖快，卻是握管躊躇。★高陽《玉座珠簾》上冊
exampleEn: The power to reverse the situation rested entirely on this memorial, so although Cao Yuying wrote quickly, he hesitated with the pen. — Gao Yang, 'Jade Pearl Curtain' Volume 1

explanation: 荟萃草木繁茂，引申为杰出人物或精美东西的聚集；一堂指在一个厅堂里。形容难逢的盛会。
explanationTraditional: 薈萃草木繁茂，引申為傑出人物或精美東西的聚集；一堂指在一個廳堂裡。形容難逢的盛會。
explanationEn: Describes a rare gathering of outstanding people or fine things in one place.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 《西游记》中的一个妖怪。比喻扰乱世界、给人们带来严重灾难的人。有时也指成天吃喝玩乐、到处胡闹的有钱有势人家的子弟。
explanationTraditional: 《西遊記》中的一個妖怪。比喻擾亂世界、給人們帶來嚴重災難的人。有時也指成天吃喝玩樂、到處胡鬧的有錢有勢人家的子弟。
explanationEn: A monster from 'Journey to the West'. Metaphor for someone who disrupts the world and brings severe disasters, or a wealthy and powerful person who indulges in pleasure and mischief.
derivation: 清·梁启超《新罗马·会议》多谢戮力同心，拽倒十余年混世魔王。”
derivationTraditional: 清·梁啟超《新羅馬·會議》多謝戮力同心，拽倒十餘年混世魔王。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao's 'New Rome: Meeting': 'Thanks to our united efforts, we have overthrown the decade-long demon king of the world.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 萧墙古代宫室内当门的小墙。指祸乱发生在家里。比喻内部发生祸乱。
explanationTraditional: 蕭牆古代宮室內當門的小牆。指禍亂髮生在家裡。比喻內部發生禍亂。
explanationEn: Refers to trouble arising within the family or internal strife.
derivation: 《论语·季氏》吾恐季孙之忧，不在颛臾，而在萧墙之内也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·季氏》吾恐季孫之憂，不在顓臾，而在蕭牆之內也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Ji Shi': 'I fear that the trouble of the Ji family lies not in Zhuan Yu but within the screen wall.'
example: 不照这么办法，恐～，势且波及全国，总统不如通权达变，暂歇风潮为是。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 不照這麼辦法，恐～，勢且波及全國，總統不如通權達變，暫歇風潮為是。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第八十回
exampleEn: If not handled this way, I fear trouble will arise within, and the situation may spread nationwide. The President should adapt to circumstances and temporarily calm the storm. — Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China' Chapter 80

explanation: 兼善使大家都有好处。使天下人都得到好处。
explanationTraditional: 兼善使大家都有好處。使天下人都得到好處。
explanationEn: To benefit all people in the world.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》穷则独善其身，达则兼善天下。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》窮則獨善其身，達則兼善天下。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jin Xin I': 'In poverty, one cultivates his own virtue; in success, he benefits the whole world.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 提高嗓门又哭又叫。
explanationTraditional: 提高嗓門又哭又叫。
explanationEn: To cry out loudly and bitterly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 花费了力气，却没有收到成效。
explanationTraditional: 花費了力氣，卻沒有收到成效。
explanationEn: To exert effort but achieve no result.
derivation: 《管子·形势篇》与不可，强不能，告不知，谓之劳而无功。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·形勢篇》與不可，強不能，告不知，謂之勞而無功。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: On Circumstances': 'Dealing with the unworthy, forcing the incapable, and informing the ignorant is called labor without merit.'
example: 不注意科学，一味地蛮干，结果必定是～。
exampleTraditional: 不注意科學，一味地蠻幹，結果必定是～。
exampleEn: If you don't pay attention to science and blindly work hard, the result will be labor without merit.

explanation: 谋谋划，安排。根据个人的能力策划事情。
explanationTraditional: 謀謀劃，安排。根據個人的能力策劃事情。
explanationEn: Planning matters depends on human effort.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》孔明叹曰‘谋事在人，成事在天，不可强也！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》孔明嘆曰‘謀事在人，成事在天，不可強也！’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms': 'Kong Ming sighed: 'Planning lies with man, but success depends on Heaven; it cannot be forced!''
example: 不过剩下的五百万就没有把握。～，成事在天！★茅盾《子夜》
exampleTraditional: 不過剩下的五百萬就沒有把握。～，成事在天！★茅盾《子夜》
exampleEn: But the remaining five million are uncertain. Planning lies with man, success depends on Heaven! — Mao Dun, 'Midnight'

explanation: 相传鹏鸟能飞万里路程。比喻前程远大。
explanationTraditional: 相傳鵬鳥能飛萬里路程。比喻前程遠大。
explanationEn: Refers to a bright and promising future.
derivation: 《庄子·逍遥游》鹏之徙于南冥也，水击三千里，抟扶摇而上者九万里。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·逍遙遊》鵬之徙於南冥也，水擊三千里，摶扶搖而上者九萬里。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Free and Easy Wandering': 'When the Peng migrates to the Southern Ocean, it stirs up water for three thousand li and rises on a whirlwind to ninety thousand li.'
example: 俺也曾蠹简三冬依雪聚，怕不的～信风扶。★元·无名氏《渔樵记》第一折
exampleTraditional: 俺也曾蠹簡三冬依雪聚，怕不的～信風扶。★元·無名氏《漁樵記》第一折
exampleEn: I once studied by snowlight in winter, and I fear not the roc's journey of ten thousand miles with the wind. — Yuan Dynasty Anonymous, 'The Fisherman and the Woodcutter' Act 1

explanation: 翩翩形容举止洒脱。形容言谈举止洒脱的青年男子。
explanationTraditional: 翩翩形容舉止灑脫。形容言談舉止灑脫的青年男子。
explanationEn: Describes a young man with elegant and unrestrained demeanor.
derivation: 《史记·平原君虞卿列传》平原君翩翩浊世之佳公子也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原君虞卿列傳》平原君翩翩濁世之佳公子也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lord Pingyuan and Yu Qing': 'Lord Pingyuan was a graceful young gentleman of a turbulent age.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 无家可归的狗。比喻无处投奔，到处乱窜的人。
explanationTraditional: 無家可歸的狗。比喻無處投奔，到處亂竄的人。
explanationEn: A homeless dog. Metaphor for a person who has nowhere to go and wanders around in a panic.
derivation: 《史记·孔子世家》东门有人，其颡似尧，其项类皋陶，其肩类子产，然自要以下不及禹三寸，累累若丧家之狗。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孔子世家》東門有人，其顙似堯，其項類皋陶，其肩類子產，然自要以下不及禹三寸，累累若喪家之狗。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: The Hereditary House of Confucius': 'There is a man at the east gate, his forehead like Yao, his neck like Gaoyao, his shoulders like Zichan, but from the waist down he is three inches shorter than Yu, looking weary like a homeless dog.'
example: 敌人溃不成军，惶惶如～。
exampleTraditional: 敵人潰不成軍，惶惶如～。
exampleEn: The enemy troops were utterly defeated, panicked like homeless dogs.

explanation: 神气自以为得意傲慢的神情。形容摆出一副自以为高人一等而了不起的样子。
explanationTraditional: 神氣自以為得意傲慢的神情。形容擺出一副自以為高人一等而了不起的樣子。
explanationEn: Looking very proud and arrogant, putting on airs of superiority.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 农会于是～了。（毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》）
exampleTraditional: 農會於是～了。（毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》）
exampleEn: The peasant association then became very arrogant. (Mao Zedong, 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan')

explanation: 习习惯；焉语气词，有于此”的意思；察觉察。指经常接触某种事物，反而觉察不到其中存在的问题。
explanationTraditional: 習習慣；焉語氣詞，有於此”的意思；察覺察。指經常接觸某種事物，反而覺察不到其中存在的問題。
explanationEn: To be so accustomed to something that one fails to notice its problems.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》行之而不著焉，习矣而不察焉，终身由之而不知其道者，众也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》行之而不著焉，習矣而不察焉，終身由之而不知其道者，眾也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jinxin I': 'They practice it without understanding, are accustomed to it without noticing, follow it all their lives without knowing its way—such are the multitude.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容人姬妾多（多见于旧小说）。
explanationTraditional: 形容人姬妾多（多見於舊小說）。
explanationEn: To have many concubines (often seen in old novels).
derivation: 《战国策·楚策四》左抱幼妾，右拥嬖女，与之驰骋乎高蔡之中，而不以国家为事。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·楚策四》左抱幼妾，右擁嬖女，與之馳騁乎高蔡之中，而不以國家為事。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Chu IV': 'Holding a young concubine on the left and a favored woman on the right, galloping with them in the highlands of Caizhong, without attending to state affairs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 草莽草丛，草野。旧时指在山林出没的农民起义或强盗们中的著名人物。
explanationTraditional: 草莽草叢，草野。舊時指在山林出沒的農民起義或強盜們中的著名人物。
explanationEn: A hero from the wilderness; refers to famous figures among peasant rebels or bandits in the mountains and forests in old times.
derivation: 清·黄小配《洪秀全演义》第五回昔刘邦以亭长而定汉基，朱元璋以布衣而奠明祚……天命所属，多在草泽英雄。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃小配《洪秀全演義》第五回昔劉邦以亭長而定漢基，朱元璋以布衣而奠明祚……天命所屬，多在草澤英雄。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Huang Xiaopei's 'The Complete Story of Hong Xiuquan', Chapter 5: 'In the past, Liu Bang founded the Han dynasty as a village head, and Zhu Yuanzhang established the Ming as a commoner... The mandate of heaven often lies with heroes from the grass and marshes.'
example: 胸前和肩膀上缠着眩着人眼的红色标帜，真是个～”的气慨。★冯铿《红的日记》
exampleTraditional: 胸前和肩膀上纏著眩著人眼的紅色標幟，真是個～”的氣慨。★馮鏗《紅的日記》
exampleEn: With red insignias dazzling on his chest and shoulders, he truly had the air of a 'grassland hero'. (Feng Keng, 'Red Diary')

explanation: 涎口水。馋得口水都要滴下来了。形容极其贪馋的样子。也形容非常眼红。
explanationTraditional: 涎口水。饞得口水都要滴下來了。形容極其貪饞的樣子。也形容非常眼紅。
explanationEn: Saliva dripping from greed; extremely greedy or envious.
derivation: 唐·柳宗元《招海贾文》垂涎闪舌兮，挥霍旁午。”宋·苏轼《将之湖州》诗吴儿鲙缕薄欲飞，未去先说馋涎垂。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·柳宗元《招海賈文》垂涎閃舌兮，揮霍旁午。”宋·蘇軾《將之湖州》詩吳兒鱠縷薄欲飛，未去先說饞涎垂。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Zongyuan's 'Summoning the Sea Merchant': 'Drooling and flashing tongue, bustling about.' Song Dynasty Su Shi's poem 'About to Go to Huzhou': 'The Wu boy's fish slices are thin and flying, before leaving I already drool with greed.'
example: 此时听得子肃说有那样的好烟，不觉～。★清·姬文《市声》第二十六回
exampleTraditional: 此時聽得子肅說有那樣的好煙，不覺～。★清·姬文《市聲》第二十六回
exampleEn: Hearing Zisu mention such good tobacco, he couldn't help but drool with greed. (Qing Dynasty Ji Wen, 'Market Sounds', Chapter 26)

explanation: 鼎古代烹调食物的器具，三足两耳；鼐大鼎。于鼎鼐中调味。比喻处理国家大事。多指宰相职责。
explanationTraditional: 鼎古代烹調食物的器具，三足兩耳；鼐大鼎。於鼎鼐中調味。比喻處理國家大事。多指宰相職責。
explanationEn: To season the tripod and cauldron; metaphor for handling state affairs, often referring to the duties of a prime minister.
derivation: 《旧唐书·裴度传》果闻勿药之喜，更喜调鼎之功。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·裴度傳》果聞勿藥之喜，更喜調鼎之功。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Pei Du': 'Indeed, we hear the joy of no medicine, and further rejoice in the merit of seasoning the tripod.'
example: 司徒，你怎生立一人之下，坐万人之上，～，燮理阴阳。（元·无名氏《连环计》第二折）
exampleTraditional: 司徒，你怎生立一人之下，坐萬人之上，～，燮理陰陽。（元·無名氏《連環計》第二折）
exampleEn: Minister, how can you stand above one person and below ten thousand, seasoning the tripod and cauldron, harmonizing yin and yang? (Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Chain of Schemes', Act 2)

explanation: 各人为自己的主人效力。
explanationTraditional: 各人為自己的主人效力。
explanationEn: Each person serves their own master.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·曹爽传》裴松之注引《世语》及爽解印绶，将出，主簿杨综止之曰‘公挟主握权，舍此以至东市乎？’爽不从。有司奏综导爽反，宣王曰‘各为其主也。’宥之，以为尚书郎。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·曹爽傳》裴松之注引《世語》及爽解印綬，將出，主簿楊綜止之曰‘公挾主握權，舍此以至東市乎？’爽不從。有司奏綜導爽反，宣王曰‘各為其主也。’宥之，以為尚書郎。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wei Shu: Biography of Cao Shuang' Pei Songzhi's annotation quoting 'Shiyu': 'When Cao Shuang was about to leave after surrendering his seal, his secretary Yang Zong stopped him... Xuan Wang said, 'Each serves his own master,' and pardoned him.'
example: 徐茂公，你放手，往日咱两个是朋友，今日～也。★元·尚仲贤《单鞭夺槊》第三折
exampleTraditional: 徐茂公，你放手，往日咱兩個是朋友，今日～也。★元·尚仲賢《單鞭奪槊》第三折
exampleEn: Xu Maogong, let go! In the past we were friends, but today each serves his own master. (Yuan Dynasty, Shang Zhongxian, 'Single Whip Seizes the Halberd', Act 3)

explanation: 看到从来没有看到过的。形容事物十分稀罕。
explanationTraditional: 看到從來沒有看到過的。形容事物十分稀罕。
explanationEn: To see what one has never seen before; describes something extremely rare.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·渊骞》日闻所不闻，见所不见。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·淵騫》日聞所不聞，見所不見。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Yang Xiong's 'Model Sayings: Yuan Qian': 'Daily hear what one has not heard, see what one has not seen.'
example: 许多奇事，则～，闻所未闻。★毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》
exampleTraditional: 許多奇事，則～，聞所未聞。★毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》
exampleEn: Many strange things are seen that have never been seen before, and heard that have never been heard before. (Mao Zedong, 'Report on an Investigation of the Peasant Movement in Hunan')

explanation: 指某地方人口很多。
explanationTraditional: 指某地方人口很多。
explanationEn: Describes a place with a large population.
derivation: 明·方汝浩《禅真逸史》第二十七回景和一力荐拔为延州府太守，管辖二州七县，地方广阔，钱粮极多，人烟稠密，百姓富庶，是一个膏腴的都会。”
derivationTraditional: 明·方汝浩《禪真逸史》第二十七回景和一力薦拔為延州府太守，管轄二州七縣，地方廣闊，錢糧極多，人煙稠密，百姓富庶，是一個膏腴的都會。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Fang Ruhao's 'Zen Master Yi's Unofficial History', Chapter 27: 'Jing Yi recommended him as the prefect of Yanzhou, governing two prefectures and seven counties, with vast territory, abundant taxes, dense population, wealthy people, a fertile metropolis.'
example: 那个地方虽然很小，但是人烟稠密。
exampleTraditional: 那個地方雖然很小，但是人煙稠密。
exampleEn: Although that place is small, it is densely populated.

explanation: 四肢不劳动，形容脱离劳动。
explanationTraditional: 四肢不勞動，形容脫離勞動。
explanationEn: Not using one's four limbs; describes someone who does not engage in physical labor.
derivation: 先秦·孔子《论语·微子》子路问曰‘子见夫子乎？’丈人曰‘四体不勤，五谷不分，孰为夫子？’”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·孔子《論語·微子》子路問曰‘子見夫子乎？’丈人曰‘四體不勤，五穀不分，孰為夫子？’”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius, 'Wei Zi' chapter: Zilu asked, 'Have you seen the Master?' The old man replied, 'He who does not work with his four limbs and cannot distinguish the five grains—how can he be called Master?'
example: 你也该学一学人家眉妹子，不应～，好逸恶劳。★刘绍棠《瓜棚柳巷》
exampleTraditional: 你也該學一學人家眉妹子，不應～，好逸惡勞。★劉紹棠《瓜棚柳巷》
exampleEn: You should learn from Sister Mei, and not be idle and fond of leisure. (Liu Shaotang, 'Melon Shed and Willow Lane')

explanation: 花、柳原指春景，旧时亦指娼妓。原指赏玩春天的景色◇旧小说用来指宿娼。
explanationTraditional: 花、柳原指春景，舊時亦指娼妓。原指賞玩春天的景色◇舊小說用來指宿娼。
explanationEn: Originally meant to enjoy spring scenery; later used to refer to visiting prostitutes.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《严中丞枉驾见过》诗元戎小队出郊坰，问柳寻花到野处。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《嚴中丞枉駕見過》詩元戎小隊出郊坰，問柳尋花到野處。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Visited by Vice Governor Yan': 'The general's small team goes out to the suburbs, asking about willows and seeking flowers in the wild.'
example: 只等的红雨散，绿云收，我那其间～，重到岳阳楼。（元·谷子敬《城南柳》楔子）
exampleTraditional: 只等的紅雨散，綠雲收，我那其間～，重到岳陽樓。（元·穀子敬《城南柳》楔子）
exampleEn: Only when the red rain scatters and the green clouds gather, then I will seek flowers and ask about willows, and return to Yueyang Tower. (Yuan drama 'The Willow in the South of the City')

explanation: 仪态姿态，容貌；万方多方面。形容容貌、姿态各方面都很美。
explanationTraditional: 儀態姿態，容貌；萬方多方面。形容容貌、姿態各方面都很美。
explanationEn: Describes a person's appearance and demeanor as extremely beautiful in every aspect.
derivation: 汉·张衡《同声赋》素女为我师，仪态盈万方。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·張衡《同聲賦》素女為我師，儀態盈萬方。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Heng's 'Ode to the Same Sound': 'The goddess Su Nu is my teacher, her bearing is full of grace.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 走马骑着马跑。骑在奔跑的马上看花。原形容事情如意，心境愉快◇多指大略地观察一下。
explanationTraditional: 走馬騎著馬跑。騎在奔跑的馬上看花。原形容事情如意，心境愉快◇多指大略地觀察一下。
explanationEn: Originally meant to be in a happy mood; now mostly refers to taking a cursory glance at something.
derivation: 唐·孟郊《登科后》诗春风得意马蹄疾，一日看尽长安花。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·孟郊《登科後》詩春風得意馬蹄疾，一日看盡長安花。”
derivationEn: From Meng Jiao's poem 'After Passing the Imperial Exam': 'The spring breeze makes me proud as my horse gallops, in one day I see all the flowers of Chang'an.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 中伤攻击和谄害别人。用恶毒的话污蔑、陷害人。
explanationTraditional: 中傷攻擊和諂害別人。用惡毒的話汙衊、陷害人。
explanationEn: To slander or harm others with malicious words.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元·洪州法昌倚遇禅师》利刀割肉疮犹合；恶语伤人恨不销。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元·洪州法昌倚遇禪師》利刀割肉瘡猶合；惡語傷人恨不銷。”
derivationEn: From 'Five Lamps Meeting at Yuan': 'A sharp knife cuts flesh, the wound still heals; malicious words hurt people, the hatred never fades.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 做事马马虎虎应付一下，塞责了事。
explanationTraditional: 做事馬馬虎虎應付一下，塞責了事。
explanationEn: To do something perfunctorily, just to get by or shirk responsibility.
derivation: 《文明小史》第十一回抄上几十联，也可以敷衍搪塞。”
derivationTraditional: 《文明小史》第十一回抄上幾十聯，也可以敷衍搪塞。”
derivationEn: From 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 11: 'Copying a few dozen couplets can also be a perfunctory excuse.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 亘古人人有责从古代到现在。从古到今都不曾有过。
explanationTraditional: 亙古人人有責從古代到現在。從古到今都不曾有過。
explanationEn: Something that has never existed from ancient times to the present.
derivation: 《北齐书·王纮传》冒死效命之士反见屠戮，旷古未有此事。”清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷四太青晚作《嘉莲》诗，七言今体至四百余首，亘古未有。”
derivationTraditional: 《北齊書·王紘傳》冒死效命之士反見屠戮，曠古未有此事。”清·平步青《霞外捃屑》卷四太青晚作《嘉蓮》詩，七言今體至四百餘首，亙古未有。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Northern Qi: Biography of Wang Hong': 'Scholars who risk their lives for loyalty are instead slaughtered; such a thing has never happened since ancient times.' Also from Qing dynasty work 'Xiawai Juncui'.
example: 雄伟的南京长江大桥，在我国建桥史上是～的。
exampleTraditional: 雄偉的南京長江大橋，在我國建橋史上是～的。
exampleEn: The majestic Nanjing Yangtze River Bridge is unprecedented in the history of bridge building in our country.

explanation: 公家和个人双方的利益都得到照顾。
explanationTraditional: 公家和個人雙方的利益都得到照顧。
explanationEn: Taking into account the interests of both the public and the individual.
derivation: 毛泽东《抗日时期的经济问题和财政问题》在公私关系上，就是'公私兼顾'，或叫'军民兼顾'。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《抗日時期的經濟問題和財政問題》在公私關係上，就是'公私兼顧'，或叫'軍民兼顧'。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Economic and Financial Issues during the Anti-Japanese War': 'In the relationship between public and private, it is 'considering both public and private interests', or 'considering both military and civilian needs'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 佛教规矩，寺里晚上打鼓，早晨敲钟。比喻可以使人警觉醒悟的话。
explanationTraditional: 佛教規矩，寺裡晚上打鼓，早晨敲鐘。比喻可以使人警覺醒悟的話。
explanationEn: Buddhist temple drums at dusk and bells at dawn; metaphor for words that can awaken or alert people.
derivation: 唐·李咸中《山中》诗朝钟暮鼓不到耳，明月孤云长挂情。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李鹹中《山中》詩朝鐘暮鼓不到耳，明月孤雲長掛情。”
derivationEn: From Li Xianzhong's poem 'In the Mountains': 'Morning bells and evening drums do not reach my ears; bright moon and solitary clouds always hang in my heart.'
example: 我委实的捱不彻～。★元·纪君祥《赵氏孤儿》第二折
exampleTraditional: 我委實的捱不徹～。★元·紀君祥《趙氏孤兒》第二折
exampleEn: I truly cannot endure the evening drums and morning bells. (Yuan drama 'The Orphan of Zhao', Act 2)

explanation: 忧虑在天下人之先，安乐在天下人之后。比喻吃苦在先，享受在后。
explanationTraditional: 憂慮在天下人之先，安樂在天下人之後。比喻吃苦在先，享受在後。
explanationEn: To worry before the people and enjoy after them; to be the first to bear hardships and the last to enjoy comforts.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·谈丛》先忧事者后乐，先傲世者后忧。”宋·范仲淹《岳阳楼记》先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·談叢》先憂事者後樂，先傲世者後憂。”宋·范仲淹《岳陽樓記》先天下之憂而憂，後天下之樂而樂。”
derivationEn: From Liu Xiang's 'Shuo Yuan': 'He who worries first will later enjoy; he who is arrogant first will later worry.' Also from Fan Zhongyan's 'Record of Yueyang Tower': 'Worry before the world's worries, enjoy after the world's joys.'
example: 你～师忠彦，由义居仁效昔贤。★明·无名氏《鸣凤记·邹林游学》
exampleTraditional: 你～師忠彥，由義居仁效昔賢。★明·無名氏《鳴鳳記·鄒林遊學》
exampleEn: You first worry and later enjoy, following the loyal and virtuous; by living in benevolence and righteousness, you emulate the ancient sages. (Ming dynasty play 'The Phoenix's Cry')

explanation: 一点点小火星。比喻开始时策小，但有远大发展前途的新事物。
explanationTraditional: 一點點小火星。比喻開始時策小，但有遠大發展前途的新事物。
explanationEn: A small spark. Metaphor for a small beginning with great potential for development.
derivation: 《书·盘庚上》若火之燎于原，不可向迩。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·盤庚上》若火之燎於原，不可向邇。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents·Pan Geng I': 'A fire blazing across the plain cannot be approached.'
example: ～，可以燎原。
exampleTraditional: ～，可以燎原。
exampleEn: A single spark can start a prairie fire.

explanation: 姿容威武雄壮。
explanationTraditional: 姿容威武雄壯。
explanationEn: Heroic and spirited bearing.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《念妈娇·赤壁怀古》词遥想公瑾当年，小乔出嫁了，雄姿英发。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《念媽嬌·赤壁懷古》詞遙想公瑾當年，小喬出嫁了，雄姿英發。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's poem 'Remembering the Past at Red Cliff': 'Thinking of Zhou Yu in those days, just married to Xiao Qiao, heroic and spirited.'
example: 想君当年，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十七回
exampleTraditional: 想君當年，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十七回
exampleEn: Thinking of you in those days, heroic and spirited. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 57

explanation: 要简要；烦烦琐。指说话或写文章简单扼要，不烦琐。
explanationTraditional: 要簡要；煩煩瑣。指說話或寫文章簡單扼要，不煩瑣。
explanationEn: Concise and not verbose; speaking or writing succinctly without redundancy.
derivation: 《三国志·魏书·管辂传》晏含笑而赞之曰‘可谓要言不烦也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏書·管輅傳》晏含笑而贊之曰‘可謂要言不煩也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms·Wei Shu·Guan Lu Biography': 'He Yan smiled and praised, saying, 'Truly concise and not verbose.'''
example: 是的，那——《中国国粹义务论》，真真～，百读不厌！★鲁迅《彷徨·高老夫子》
exampleTraditional: 是的，那——《中國國粹義務論》，真真～，百讀不厭！★魯迅《彷徨·高老夫子》
exampleEn: Yes, that — 'The Chinese National Essence Compulsory Course' is truly concise and not verbose, never tiring to read! — Lu Xun, 'Wandering·Old Master Gao'

explanation: 度揣度，推测。用自己的心思（多指不好的）去猜度别人。
explanationTraditional: 度揣度，推測。用自己的心思（多指不好的）去猜度別人。
explanationEn: To judge others by oneself (often with negative connotations).
derivation: 汉·韩婴《韩诗外传》卷三然则圣人何以不可欺也？曰圣人以己度人者也，以心度心，以情度情，以类度类，古今一也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·韓嬰《韓詩外傳》卷三然則聖人何以不可欺也？曰聖人以己度人者也，以心度心，以情度情，以類度類，古今一也。”
derivationEn: From Han Ying's 'Han Shi Wai Zhuan' Volume 3: 'The sage judges others by himself, measures hearts by his heart, emotions by his emotions, categories by his categories, ancient and modern are one.'
example: 夫论事料敌，当～。★《三国志·魏志·钟毓传》
exampleTraditional: 夫論事料敵，當～。★《三國志·魏志·鍾毓傳》
exampleEn: When discussing affairs and estimating enemies, one should judge others by oneself. — 'Records of the Three Kingdoms·Wei Zhi·Zhong Yu Biography'

explanation: 形容音乐悦耳动听，令人沉醉。
explanationTraditional: 形容音樂悅耳動聽，令人沉醉。
explanationEn: Describes music that is melodious and enchanting, lingering in the air.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《前赤壁赋》其声呜呜然，如怨如慕，如泣如诉；余音袅袅，不绝如缕。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《前赤壁賦》其聲嗚嗚然，如怨如慕，如泣如訴；餘音嫋嫋，不絕如縷。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Former Ode to Red Cliff': 'The sound was mournful, like resentment, like admiration, like weeping, like complaining; the lingering notes, delicate and continuous, like a thread.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 坦率地发表自己的意见。
explanationTraditional: 坦率地發表自己的意見。
explanationEn: To express one's opinions frankly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 讨论会上，大家热涌跃发言，直抒己见。
exampleTraditional: 討論會上，大家熱湧躍發言，直抒己見。
exampleEn: At the discussion meeting, everyone enthusiastically spoke up and expressed their opinions frankly.

explanation: 碍阻碍。妨碍别人做事。
explanationTraditional: 礙阻礙。妨礙別人做事。
explanationEn: To be in the way; to hinder others from doing things.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》第三十二卷后边有些嫌忌起来，碍手碍脚，到底不妙。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》第三十二卷後邊有些嫌忌起來，礙手礙腳，到底不妙。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'First Slap of the Table' Volume 32: 'Later, some became jealous and obstructive, being in the way, ultimately unfavorable.'
example: 宝钗因说道咱们别在这里～。”说着，和宝玉等便往迎春房中来。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 寶釵因說道咱們別在這裡～。”說著，和寶玉等便往迎春房中來。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十八回
exampleEn: Baochai said, 'Let's not be in the way here.' Then she and Baoyu went to Yingchun's room. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 18

explanation: 形容品质恶劣，不顾羞耻。
explanationTraditional: 形容品質惡劣，不顧羞恥。
explanationEn: Despicable and shameless; of low character without any sense of shame.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十五回办你个‘胆大钻营，卑鄙无耻！’下去候着吧。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十五回辦你個‘膽大鑽營，卑鄙無恥！’下去候著吧。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene' Chapter 35: 'Charge you with 'audacious scheming, despicable and shameless!' Go down and wait.'
example: 世界上的事就是这样越是～、自私自利的人，越是得势，横行霸道。★茅盾《霜叶红似二月花》
exampleTraditional: 世界上的事就是這樣越是～、自私自利的人，越是得勢，橫行霸道。★茅盾《霜葉紅似二月花》
exampleEn: Things in the world are like this: the more despicable, shameless, and selfish a person is, the more they gain power and act tyrannically. — Mao Dun, 'Frost Leaves Red as February Flowers'

explanation: 利用别人有困难时加以要挟或陷害。
explanationTraditional: 利用別人有困難時加以要挾或陷害。
explanationEn: To take advantage of someone's difficulty to coerce or harm them.
derivation: 蒋子龙《开拓者，开拓者》十六金城扭头瞪他一眼‘去你妈的！君子不趁人之危。’”
derivationTraditional: 蔣子龍《開拓者，開拓者》十六金城扭頭瞪他一眼‘去你媽的！君子不趁人之危。’”
derivationEn: From Jiang Zilong's 'Pioneer, Pioneer' 16: 'Jincheng turned his head and glared at him, 'Go to hell! A gentleman does not take advantage of others in crisis.'''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指寓褒贬于曲折的文笔之中。
explanationTraditional: 指寓褒貶於曲折的文筆之中。
explanationEn: A style of writing that implies praise or criticism through subtle and indirect wording.
derivation: 《史记·孔子世家》孔子在位听讼，文辞有可与人共者，弗独有也。至于为《春秋》，笔则笔，削则削，子夏之徒不能赞一词。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孔子世家》孔子在位聽訟，文辭有可與人共者，弗獨有也。至於為《春秋》，筆則筆，削則削，子夏之徒不能贊一詞。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian·Confucius' Family': 'When Confucius was in office hearing lawsuits, he shared his writings with others, not keeping them to himself. As for writing the 'Spring and Autumn Annals', he wrote what should be written and deleted what should be deleted, so that even Zixia's disciples could not add a word.'
example: 初意却不过贪图少写一个字，并非有什么～。★鲁迅《热风·反对含泪”的批评家》
exampleTraditional: 初意卻不過貪圖少寫一個字，並非有什麼～。★魯迅《熱風·反對含淚”的批評家》
exampleEn: Initially, I just wanted to save a word, not to employ the 'Spring and Autumn' style. — Lu Xun, 'Hot Wind·Against the 'Tearful' Critic'

explanation: 不慌不忙，得心应手。
explanationTraditional: 不慌不忙，得心應手。
explanationEn: Calm and unhurried, doing things with ease and skill.
derivation: 吴伯箫《记一辆纺车》熟练的纺手趁着一线灯光或者朦胧的月色也能摇车，抽线，上线，一切做得从容自如。”
derivationTraditional: 吳伯簫《記一輛紡車》熟練的紡手趁著一線燈光或者朦朧的月色也能搖車，抽線，上線，一切做得從容自如。”
derivationEn: Wu Boqiao, 'Remembering a Spinning Wheel': 'Skilled spinners could also spin, draw thread, and wind thread calmly and unhurriedly under a single lamp or hazy moonlight.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容结婚的景象。
explanationTraditional: 形容結婚的景象。
explanationEn: Describes the scene of a wedding.
derivation: 北周·庾信《和咏舞》诗洞房花烛明，燕余双舞轻。”
derivationTraditional: 北周·庾信《和詠舞》詩洞房花燭明，燕餘雙舞輕。”
derivationEn: Northern Zhou Dynasty, Yu Xin, poem 'Harmonizing with a Dance': 'In the bridal chamber, candles bright; after swallows rest, a double dance light.'
example: ～之夜，两新人原是旧相知，又多是吃惊吃吓，哭哭啼啼，死边过的，竟得团圆，其乐不可名状。★《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十九
exampleTraditional: ～之夜，兩新人原是舊相知，又多是吃驚吃嚇，哭哭啼啼，死邊過的，竟得團圓，其樂不可名狀。★《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十九
exampleEn: On the night of the wedding, the two lovers, who were old acquaintances and had gone through many scares and tears, finally reunited, their joy beyond description. (Chuke Pai'an Jingqi, Volume 29)

explanation: 虑考虑，思虑。指在错误或坏事刚露头的时候，就加以防止，并考虑长远的计策。
explanationTraditional: 慮考慮，思慮。指在錯誤或壞事剛露頭的時候，就加以防止，並考慮長遠的計策。
explanationEn: To prevent errors or bad things at the earliest stage and consider long-term strategies.
derivation: 唐·郑亚《唐丞相太尉卫国公李德裕会昌一品制集序》由是洞启宸衷，大破群议，运筹制胜，举无遗策，防微虑远。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·鄭亞《唐丞相太尉衛國公李德裕會昌一品制集序》由是洞啟宸衷，大破群議，運籌制勝，舉無遺策，防微慮遠。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Zheng Ya, 'Preface to the Collected Works of Li Deyu': 'Thus, he enlightened the emperor's mind, broke through many objections, planned and won, leaving no loopholes, preventing problems early and thinking far ahead.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容不扎实，不仔细。
explanationTraditional: 形容不紮實，不仔細。
explanationEn: Describes doing something superficially and carelessly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 疾急速。说话急躁，脸色严厉。形容对人发怒说话时的神情。
explanationTraditional: 疾急速。說話急躁，臉色嚴厲。形容對人發怒說話時的神情。
explanationEn: Hasty speech and stern expression; describes the look of someone speaking angrily.
derivation: 《后汉书·刘宽传》虽在仓卒，未尝疾言遽色。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·劉寬傳》雖在倉卒，未嘗疾言遽色。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han, Biography of Liu Kuan': 'Even in haste, he never spoke hastily or looked stern.'
example: 对于这种学生，我易于～，似乎予人以难堪，事后往往后悔。★邹韬奋《经历·一种有趣的工作》
exampleTraditional: 對於這種學生，我易於～，似乎予人以難堪，事後往往後悔。★鄒韜奮《經歷·一種有趣的工作》
exampleEn: For such students, I easily become harsh in speech and stern in expression, as if making them feel embarrassed, and I often regret it later. (Zou Taofen, 'Experience: An Interesting Job')

explanation: 踽踽孤零的样子。孤零零地独自走着。形容非常孤独。
explanationTraditional: 踽踽孤零的樣子。孤零零地獨自走著。形容非常孤獨。
explanationEn: Walking alone in a lonely manner; describes extreme loneliness.
derivation: 《诗经·唐风·杕杜》独行踽踽，岂无他人，不如我同父。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·唐風·杕杜》獨行踽踽，豈無他人，不如我同父。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs, Tang Feng, Di Du': 'Walking alone, lonely; though there are others, they are not like my own brothers.'
example: 他成了一个～，形单影只，自言自语，孤苦伶仃的畸形人。长空里，一只孤雁。★徐迟《歌德巴赫猜想》
exampleTraditional: 他成了一個～，形單影隻，自言自語，孤苦伶仃的畸形人。長空裡，一隻孤雁。★徐遲《歌德巴赫猜想》
exampleEn: He became a lonely figure, walking alone, talking to himself, a deformed person in solitude. In the vast sky, a solitary goose. (Xu Chi, 'Goldbach Conjecture')

explanation: 明德美德；惟是；馨散发的香气。真正能够发出香气的是美德。
explanationTraditional: 明德美德；惟是；馨散發的香氣。真正能夠發出香氣的是美德。
explanationEn: Virtue alone emits fragrance; true fragrance comes from virtue.
derivation: 《尚书·君陈》至治馨香，感于神明。黍稷非馨，明德惟馨。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·君陳》至治馨香，感於神明。黍稷非馨，明德惟馨。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents, Jun Chen': 'The utmost governance is fragrant, affecting the gods. Millet is not fragrant; bright virtue is fragrant.'
example: 知几其神乎！古人以为难。交疏吐诚，今人以为难。今君一面尽二难之道，可谓～。★南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·规箴》
exampleTraditional: 知幾其神乎！古人以為難。交疏吐誠，今人以為難。今君一面盡二難之道，可謂～。★南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·規箴》
exampleEn: How divine it is to know the subtle! The ancients found it difficult. To speak sincerely with a distant friend is hard for moderns. You, sir, have achieved both difficult things in one meeting—truly, bright virtue is fragrant. (Liu Yiqing, 'Shishuo Xinyu, Guizhen')

explanation: 赏心心情欢畅。欢畅的心情，快乐的事情。
explanationTraditional: 賞心心情歡暢。歡暢的心情，快樂的事情。
explanationEn: A joyful heart and happy events; describes delightful moods and pleasures.
derivation: 南朝宋·谢灵运《拟魏太子邺中集诗八首序》天下良辰、美景、赏心、乐事，四者难并。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·謝靈運《擬魏太子鄴中集詩八首序》天下良辰、美景、賞心、樂事，四者難並。”
derivationEn: Southern Dynasty Song, Xie Lingyun, 'Preface to Eight Poems Imitating the Prince of Wei's Gathering at Ye': 'The world's fine times, beautiful scenes, joyful hearts, and happy events—these four are hard to have together.'
example: 你看这郊外人稠物穰，都是～，真个好热闹也。★元·武汉臣《玉壶春》第一折
exampleTraditional: 你看這郊外人稠物穰，都是～，真個好熱鬧也。★元·武漢臣《玉壺春》第一折
exampleEn: Look at the bustling suburbs, full of joyful hearts and happy events—truly lively! (Yuan Dynasty, Wuhan Chen, 'Jade Pot Spring', Act 1)

explanation: 连续不倦地谈论着。
explanationTraditional: 連續不倦地談論著。
explanationEn: To talk tirelessly and engagingly.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文二集·〈中国新文学大系〉小说二集序》然而他并不拙笨”，却也不矫揉造作，只如熟人相对，娓娓而谈。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文二集·〈中國新文學大系〉小說二集序》然而他並不拙笨”，卻也不矯揉造作，只如熟人相對，娓娓而談。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun, 'Essays from the Qie Jie Ting, Part 2: Preface to the Second Collection of Novels in the New Chinese Literature Series': 'Yet he was not clumsy, nor pretentious, but talked as if with an acquaintance, chatting tirelessly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有地方不能达到。
explanationTraditional: 沒有地方不能達到。
explanationEn: Nowhere that cannot be reached; all-encompassing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻对事物一知半解，不对全局作判断。
explanationTraditional: 比喻對事物一知半解，不對全局作判斷。
explanationEn: Blind men touching an elephant; metaphor for people who only understand part of something and make judgments without seeing the whole picture.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 文雅大方，有气量，有风度。
explanationTraditional: 文雅大方，有氣量，有風度。
explanationEn: Elegant and generous, with magnanimity and grace.
derivation: 西汉·司马迁《史记·高祖本纪》常有大度，不事家人生产作业。”
derivationTraditional: 西漢·司馬遷《史記·高祖本紀》常有大度，不事家人生產作業。”
derivationEn: From Sima Qian's 'Records of the Grand Historian: Basic Annals of Gaozu': 'He often had great magnanimity and did not engage in household production.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 说死没死，说活未活。形容没有生气或处境尴尬。
explanationTraditional: 說死沒死，說活未活。形容沒有生氣或處境尷尬。
explanationEn: Neither dead nor alive; describes something lifeless or an awkward situation.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类》卷四八箕子虽不死，然便死却又到了，唯是被囚不死不活，这地位如何处，直是难。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類》卷四八箕子雖不死，然便死卻又到了，唯是被囚不死不活，這地位如何處，直是難。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's 'Classified Conversations of Zhu Xi': 'Although Jizi was not dead, if he had died, it would have been over; but being imprisoned, neither dead nor alive, how difficult that position is!'
example: 你买东西忙什么呢？先来给我送个信儿多好，叫人家盼望的～的干么呢？★清·刘鹗《老残游记续集》第三回
exampleTraditional: 你買東西忙什麼呢？先來給我送個信兒多好，叫人家盼望的～的幹麼呢？★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記續集》第三回
exampleEn: What are you busy buying? It would have been better to send me a message first, making me wait in a state of neither dead nor alive. — Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can', Sequel, Chapter 3

explanation: 开创事业是艰难的。
explanationTraditional: 開創事業是艱難的。
explanationEn: Starting an undertaking is difficult.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻贤才逢明时。
explanationTraditional: 比喻賢才逢明時。
explanationEn: A red phoenix facing the sun; metaphor for a talented person meeting a wise ruler or good times.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·卷阿》凤凰鸣矣，于彼高冈。梧桐生矣，于彼朝阳。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·卷阿》鳳凰鳴矣，於彼高岡。梧桐生矣，於彼朝陽。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Greater Odes: Juan A': 'The phoenix sings, on that high ridge. The wutong tree grows, facing the morning sun.'
example: 前后同心八谏臣，朝阳丹凤一齐鸣。除奸反正扶明主，留得功勋耀古今。（明·王世贞《鸣凤记》第一出）
exampleTraditional: 前後同心八諫臣，朝陽丹鳳一齊鳴。除奸反正扶明主，留得功勳耀古今。（明·王世貞《鳴鳳記》第一齣）
exampleEn: Eight remonstrating officials united in heart, the morning phoenixes sing together. Removing traitors and supporting the wise ruler, leaving merits shining through the ages. — Wang Shizhen, 'The Phoenix' (Act 1)

explanation: 谲欺诈；诡谲怪异。形容人的性情怪异多变。
explanationTraditional: 譎欺詐；詭譎怪異。形容人的性情怪異多變。
explanationEn: Deceptive and changeable; describes a person's temperament as strange and unpredictable.
derivation: 晋·张协《玄武馆赋》于是崇墉四匝，丰厦诡谲，烂若丹霞，皎如素雪。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·張協《玄武館賦》於是崇墉四匝，豐廈詭譎，爛若丹霞，皎如素雪。”
derivationEn: From Zhang Xie's 'Fu on the Xuanwu Pavilion': 'Thus the high walls surround, the grand halls are strange and magnificent, brilliant like red clouds, pure like white snow.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 老马认识路。比喻有经验的人对事情比较熟悉。
explanationTraditional: 老馬認識路。比喻有經驗的人對事情比較熟悉。
explanationEn: An old horse knows the way; metaphor for an experienced person who is familiar with things.
derivation: 《韩非子·说林上》管仲、隰朋从于桓公伐孤竹，春往冬返，迷惑失道。管仲曰‘老马之智可用也。’乃放老马而随之。遂得道。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·說林上》管仲、隰朋從於桓公伐孤竹，春往冬返，迷惑失道。管仲曰‘老馬之智可用也。’乃放老馬而隨之。遂得道。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: Shuo Lin Shang': 'Guan Zhong and Xi Peng followed Duke Huan of Qi to attack Guzhu. They went in spring and returned in winter, lost and confused. Guan Zhong said, 'The wisdom of an old horse can be used.' So they let the old horse go and followed it, thus finding the way.'
example: ～添病骨，穷猿投树择深枝。★清·黄仲则《立秋后二日》
exampleTraditional: ～添病骨，窮猿投樹擇深枝。★清·黃仲則《立秋後二日》
exampleEn: The old horse knows the way, adding to my sickly bones; the poor ape chooses a tree to hide in the deep branches. — Huang Jingren, 'Two Days after the Start of Autumn'

explanation: 人事不熟，地方陌生。指初到一地，对当地的人事和地理都不熟悉。
explanationTraditional: 人事不熟，地方陌生。指初到一地，對當地的人事和地理都不熟悉。
explanationEn: Unfamiliar with people and places; describes being new to a place and not knowing the local people or geography.
derivation: 鲁迅《伪自由书·前记》《自由谈》的编辑新换了黎烈文先生了，但他才从法国回来，人地生疏，怕一时搞不起稿子，要我去投几回稿。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《偽自由書·前記》《自由談》的編輯新換了黎烈文先生了，但他才從法國回來，人地生疏，怕一時搞不起稿子，要我去投幾回稿。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Pseudo-Free Talk: Preface': 'The editor of 'Free Talk' had just changed to Mr. Li Liewen, who had just returned from France and was unfamiliar with people and places, afraid he couldn't get contributions right away, so he asked me to submit a few articles.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 英俊而富有朝气的样子。
explanationTraditional: 英俊而富有朝氣的樣子。
explanationEn: Heroic and vigorous appearance; full of youthful spirit.
derivation: 刘白羽《火》这时，我看见躺在病床上的青年人，他的面颊烧黑了，头发烧焦了，可是从他向上扬着的短短眉毛上，还显露出一种英姿勃勃的神气。”
derivationTraditional: 劉白羽《火》這時，我看見躺在病床上的青年人，他的面頰燒黑了，頭髮燒焦了，可是從他向上揚著的短短眉毛上，還顯露出一種英姿勃勃的神氣。”
derivationEn: From Liu Baiyu's 'Fire': 'At that time, I saw the young man lying on the sickbed, his cheeks burned black, his hair scorched, but from his slightly raised short eyebrows, there still appeared a heroic and vigorous spirit.'
example: 十个～的姑娘，像十只带火比翼的彩燕。★林玉《带火的彩燕》诗
exampleTraditional: 十個～的姑娘，像十隻帶火比翼的彩燕。★林玉《帶火的彩燕》詩
exampleEn: Ten heroic and vigorous girls, like ten fiery colorful swallows flying side by side. — Lin Yu, 'Colorful Swallows on Fire' (poem)

explanation: 假装傻头傻脑的样子。
explanationTraditional: 假裝傻頭傻腦的樣子。
explanationEn: Pretend to be stupid or naive.
derivation: 老舍《神拳》第二幕你这是装傻充愣！除了闹义和团，咱们还有第二条路走吗？”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《神拳》第二幕你這是裝傻充愣！除了鬧義和團，咱們還有第二條路走嗎？”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Boxer Uprising' (Act 2): 'You are pretending to be stupid! Besides starting the Boxer Rebellion, do we have any other way?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指在敌方兵临城下时被迫签订的屈服的和约。
explanationTraditional: 指在敵方兵臨城下時被迫簽訂的屈服的和約。
explanationEn: A treaty signed under duress when the enemy is at the city gates, implying a forced and humiliating agreement.
derivation: 《左传·桓公十二年》大败之，为城下之盟而还。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·桓公十二年》大敗之，為城下之盟而還。”
derivationEn: From Zuo Zhuan, Duke Huan's 12th year: 'They were heavily defeated and forced to sign a treaty under the city walls before returning.'
example: 国有已困之形，人有不困之志。君民效死，与城俱碎，岂肯为～哉。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五十五回
exampleTraditional: 國有已困之形，人有不困之志。君民效死，與城俱碎，豈肯為～哉。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五十五回
exampleEn: The state was in dire straits, but the people had no intention of surrendering. The ruler and his subjects were ready to die together with the city. How could they agree to a treaty signed under duress? — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 55

explanation: 形容拿不定主意。
explanationTraditional: 形容拿不定主意。
explanationEn: Hesitant and unable to make a decision.
derivation: 《宋史·侯益传》尔往至彼，如益来，即置勿问，苟迟疑不决，即以便宜从事。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·侯益傳》爾往至彼，如益來，即置勿問，苟遲疑不決，即以便宜從事。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song', Biography of Hou Yi: 'When you go there, if Yi comes, do not question him; if he hesitates and cannot decide, act according to what is convenient.'
example: 我做了她的俘虏，她反而有点～了。★巴金《春天里的秋天》
exampleTraditional: 我做了她的俘虜，她反而有點～了。★巴金《春天裡的秋天》
exampleEn: I had become her captive, but she seemed hesitant and unable to decide. — Ba Jin, 'Spring in Autumn'

explanation: 明显地出现好转的样子（多指焕散的工作或觉重的疾病）。
explanationTraditional: 明顯地出現好轉的樣子（多指煥散的工作或覺重的疾病）。
explanationEn: Showing significant improvement (often referring to a disorganized situation or a serious illness).
derivation: 清·张集馨《道咸宦海见闻录》皖省惟英、霍有零贼，余亦肃清，南中军务，大有起色。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張集馨《道鹹宦海見聞錄》皖省惟英、霍有零賊，餘亦肅清，南中軍務，大有起色。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zhang Jixin's 'Records of Official Life during Daoxian': 'In Anhui province, only Ying and Huo had scattered bandits; the rest were cleared. The military affairs in the south have shown great improvement.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 刻绘龙凤。
explanationTraditional: 刻繪龍鳳。
explanationEn: Carved dragons and painted phoenixes; ornate decoration.
derivation: 胡世香《巧取陈家寨》门上雕龙画凤，粉壁衬着红漆家具，分外耀眼。”
derivationTraditional: 胡世香《巧取陳家寨》門上雕龍畫鳳，粉壁襯著紅漆傢俱，分外耀眼。”
derivationEn: From Hu Shixiang's 'Capturing the Chen Family Village': 'The doors were carved with dragons and painted with phoenixes, and the pink walls set off the red lacquer furniture, making it exceptionally dazzling.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 续连接。晋代皇帝的侍从官员用作帽子的装饰。指封官太滥。亦比喻拿不好的东西补接在好的东西后面，前后两部分非常不相称。
explanationTraditional: 續連接。晉代皇帝的侍從官員用作帽子的裝飾。指封官太濫。亦比喻拿不好的東西補接在好的東西后面，前後兩部分非常不相稱。
explanationEn: Literally 'a dog's tail joined to a sable'; refers to an inferior continuation or addition to a fine work, or excessive conferment of titles.
derivation: 《晋书·赵王伦传》奴卒厮役亦加以爵位。每朝会，貂蝉盈坐，时人为之谚曰‘貂不足，狗尾续。’”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·趙王倫傳》奴卒廝役亦加以爵位。每朝會，貂蟬盈坐，時人為之諺曰‘貂不足，狗尾續。’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin', Biography of Zhao Wang Lun: 'Even servants and menial workers were given noble titles. At court gatherings, sable tails filled the seats, and people made a proverb: 'Not enough sables, use dog tails instead.''
example: 圣叹断定《水浒》只有七十回，而骂罗贯中为～。★胡適《〈水浒传〉考证》四
exampleTraditional: 聖嘆斷定《水滸》只有七十回，而罵羅貫中為～。★胡適《〈水滸傳〉考證》四
exampleEn: Sheng Tan concluded that 'Water Margin' only had seventy chapters, and criticized Luo Guanzhong for adding a dog's tail to a sable. — Hu Shi, 'Textual Research on Water Margin', Part 4

explanation: 形容极度紧张或非常劳累。
explanationTraditional: 形容極度緊張或非常勞累。
explanationEn: Sweat streaming down the face; describes extreme nervousness or exhaustion.
derivation: 鲁迅《彷徨·伤逝》况且她又这样地终日汗流满面，短发都粘在脑额上；两只手又只是这样地粗糙起来。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《彷徨·傷逝》況且她又這樣地終日汗流滿面，短髮都粘在腦額上；兩隻手又只是這樣地粗糙起來。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Wandering: Regret for the Past': 'Moreover, she was sweating all over her face all day long, her short hair sticking to her forehead; her hands were becoming rough.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 好美好，友善。指友善和中听的言语。
explanationTraditional: 好美好，友善。指友善和中聽的言語。
explanationEn: Kind and pleasant words; friendly and agreeable speech.
derivation: 洪深《香稻米》第三幕我晓得乡下人是刁恶不过，好言好语不肯听的！”
derivationTraditional: 洪深《香稻米》第三幕我曉得鄉下人是刁惡不過，好言好語不肯聽的！”
derivationEn: From Hong Shen's 'Fragrant Rice', Act 3: 'I know country folk are stubborn and wicked; they won't listen to kind words!'
example: 我～批评他，挨了一顿骂。★魏巍《老烟筒》
exampleTraditional: 我～批評他，捱了一頓罵。★魏巍《老煙筒》
exampleEn: I criticized him with kind words, but got scolded in return. — Wei Wei, 'Old Smoke Pipe'

explanation: 形容时间久远。
explanationTraditional: 形容時間久遠。
explanationEn: A long period of time; many years.
derivation: 元·李行道《灰阑记》第二折我老娘收生，一日至少也收七八个，这等年深岁久的事，那时记得。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李行道《灰闌記》第二折我老孃收生，一日至少也收七八個，這等年深歲久的事，那時記得。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Li Xingdao's 'The Chalk Circle', Act 2: 'I, as a midwife, deliver at least seven or eight babies a day. How could I remember such old matters from years ago?'
example: 自别了长安，～，就有些盘缠也使尽了。★明·吴承恩《西游记》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 自別了長安，～，就有些盤纏也使盡了。★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第五十六回
exampleEn: Since leaving Chang'an, after many years, even the travel money was used up. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 56

explanation: 高低差别就象天上的云彩和地下的泥土那样悬殊。
explanationTraditional: 高低差別就象天上的雲彩和地下的泥土那樣懸殊。
explanationEn: As different as clouds and mud; a vast difference in status or quality.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《送韦书记赴西安》诗夫子歘通贵，云泥相望悬。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《送韋書記赴西安》詩夫子歘通貴，雲泥相望懸。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Du Fu's poem 'Seeing Secretary Wei Off to Xi'an': 'Sir, you suddenly become noble; clouds and mud look at each other from afar.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 多处弯曲，不断转变方向。也形容做事不直截了当。同七湾八拐”。
explanationTraditional: 多處彎曲，不斷轉變方向。也形容做事不直截了當。同七灣八拐”。
explanationEn: Many twists and turns; constantly changing direction. Also describes not being straightforward in doing things.
derivation: 《十月》1981年第1期过了一岗又一岗，一坡又一坡，上上下下，七弯八拐，又走了十多里才真正到了狼牙山脚下、我们要住下的村子。”
derivationTraditional: 《十月》1981年第1期過了一崗又一崗，一坡又一坡，上上下下，七彎八拐，又走了十多里才真正到了狼牙山腳下、我們要住下的村子。”
derivationEn: From 'October' magazine, 1981, Issue 1: 'After passing one hill after another, going up and down, with many twists and turns, they walked over ten more li before finally reaching the foot of Langya Mountain, the village where they were to stay.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 裙带比喻妻女、姊妹的亲属。指相互勾结攀援的妇女姻亲关系。
explanationTraditional: 裙帶比喻妻女、姊妹的親屬。指相互勾結攀援的婦女姻親關係。
explanationEn: Nepotism; favoritism shown to relatives, especially in appointing them to positions.
derivation: 宋·赵昻《朝野类要》卷三亲王南班之婿，号曰西宫，即所谓郡马也，俗谓裙带头官。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·趙昻《朝野類要》卷三親王南班之婿，號曰西宮，即所謂郡馬也，俗謂裙帶頭官。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhao Ang's 'Chaoye Leiyao' volume 3: 'The son-in-law of a prince is called a 'county consort', commonly known as a 'skirt-ribbon official'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 三、五表示大概数量；载年。指多年。
explanationTraditional: 三、五表示大概數量；載年。指多年。
explanationEn: Several years; a period of three to five years.
derivation: 元·杨文奎《儿女团圆》第二折也须知俺这三年五载，看看衰迈，还有甚精金响钞，暗暗藏埋。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊文奎《兒女團圓》第二折也須知俺這三年五載，看看衰邁，還有甚精金響鈔，暗暗藏埋。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Yang Wenkui's 'Children Reunited' Act 2: 'You must know that in these three to five years, I have grown old and weak.'
example: 要一一介绍出来，恐怕～也说不完。★马烽《吕梁英雄传·起头的话》
exampleTraditional: 要一一介紹出來，恐怕～也說不完。★馬烽《呂梁英雄傳·起頭的話》
exampleEn: To introduce them one by one would probably take several years and still not be finished. — Ma Feng, 'The Luliang Heroes: Opening Words'

explanation: 是对；非错。把错的说成对的，对的说成错的。把是非弄颠倒了。
explanationTraditional: 是對；非錯。把錯的說成對的，對的說成錯的。把是非弄顛倒了。
explanationEn: To confuse right and wrong; to reverse truth and falsehood.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《施先生墓铭》古圣人言，其旨密微，笺注纷罗，颠倒是非。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《施先生墓銘》古聖人言，其旨密微，箋註紛羅，顛倒是非。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Mr. Shi': 'The words of ancient sages are subtle and profound, but commentaries are numerous and confuse right and wrong.'
example: 阳世全凭一张纸，～多因此。（明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十六）
exampleTraditional: 陽世全憑一張紙，～多因此。（明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十六）
exampleEn: In the world of the living, everything depends on a piece of paper; right and wrong are often reversed because of it. — Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement' Volume 16

explanation: 具有新的道德品质的人和体现新的高尚社会风尚的事。
explanationTraditional: 具有新的道德品質的人和體現新的高尚社會風尚的事。
explanationEn: New people and new things; people with new moral qualities and events reflecting new noble social trends.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 润细腻光滑。象珠子一样圆，象玉石一样光润。比喻歌声宛转优美，或文字流畅明快。
explanationTraditional: 潤細膩光滑。象珠子一樣圓，象玉石一樣光潤。比喻歌聲宛轉優美，或文字流暢明快。
explanationEn: Smooth and elegant; describes a singing voice or writing style that is melodious and fluent.
