derivation: 唐·张文琮《咏水诗》方流涵玉润，圆折动珠光。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·張文琮《詠水詩》方流涵玉潤，圓折動珠光。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Zhang Wenzong's 'Ode to Water': 'Flowing water contains jade's smoothness, ripples move like pearls' light.'
example: 北宋词多就景叙情，故～，四照玲珑。★清·周济《词辨》
exampleTraditional: 北宋詞多就景敘情，故～，四照玲瓏。★清·賙濟《詞辨》
exampleEn: Northern Song lyrics often describe scenes and express emotions, so they are smooth and elegant, shining in all directions. — Qing Dynasty Zhou Ji, 'On Ci Poetry'

explanation: 饱学学识渊博。指学识渊博的人。
explanationTraditional: 飽學學識淵博。指學識淵博的人。
explanationEn: A learned person; an erudite scholar.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十六回公等皆饱学之士，登此高台，可不进佳章以纪一时胜事乎？”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十六回公等皆飽學之士，登此高臺，可不進佳章以紀一時勝事乎？”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 56: 'You are all learned scholars; ascending this high platform, how can you not present fine verses to record this grand occasion?'
example: 那位老先生也许是个～，一笔字也写得挺好。★张天冀《新生》
exampleTraditional: 那位老先生也許是個～，一筆字也寫得挺好。★張天冀《新生》
exampleEn: That old gentleman might be a learned scholar, and his handwriting is quite good. — Zhang Tianyi, 'New Life'

explanation: 炬火把。一把火全部烧了。同付之一炬”。
explanationTraditional: 炬火把。一把火全部燒了。同付之一炬”。
explanationEn: To commit to the flames; to burn something completely.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第四十六回在这许多名片里面，捡出一张，上写着颜轶回，……其余都付诸一炬。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第四十六回在這許多名片裡面，撿出一張，上寫著顏軼回，……其餘都付諸一炬。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Modern Times' Chapter 46: 'Among these many name cards, he picked out one that read 'Yan Yihui'... and the rest were all committed to the flames.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 高人比一般人高；筹筹码。比一般人高出一个筹码。指胜过别人。
explanationTraditional: 高人比一般人高；籌籌碼。比一般人高出一個籌碼。指勝過別人。
explanationEn: To be a cut above others; to surpass others.
derivation: 明·归有光《震川集·别集·七·与沈敬甫七首》圹志、子建云亦似。但千古哭声未尝不同，何论前世有屈原，贾生耶？以发吾之愤愤而已！钦甫云更似高人一筹也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·歸有光《震川集·別集·七·與沈敬甫七首》壙志、子建雲亦似。但千古哭聲未嘗不同，何論前世有屈原，賈生耶？以發吾之憤憤而已！欽甫雲更似高人一籌也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Gui Youguang's 'Collected Works: Letters to Shen Jingfu': 'Qin Fu said it was a cut above others.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 借假借；喻比喻。假借古人古事比喻现实中的今人今事。
explanationTraditional: 借假借；喻比喻。假借古人古事比喻現實中的今人今事。
explanationEn: To use ancient events to allude to the present; to draw parallels from history.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻用别人的东西做人情。
explanationTraditional: 比喻用別人的東西做人情。
explanationEn: To offer a gift that is not one's own; to use someone else's things to curry favor.
derivation: 《过去现在因果经》一今我女弱不能得前，请寄二花以献于佛。”
derivationTraditional: 《過去現在因果經》一今我女弱不能得前，請寄二花以獻於佛。”
derivationEn: From 'Sutra of Cause and Effect in the Past and Present': 'Now I, a weak woman, cannot go forward; please offer these two flowers to the Buddha on my behalf.'
example: 今儿有人送极新鲜的山鸡，烫了吃，很好的，我就～了。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第六回
exampleTraditional: 今兒有人送極新鮮的山雞，燙了吃，很好的，我就～了。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第六回
exampleEn: Today someone sent very fresh pheasants; they are delicious when boiled. I'll just offer them as a gift. — Qing Dynasty Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can' Chapter 6

explanation: 原形容花木枝叶美好◇多指皇族子孙。现也比喻出身高贵或娇嫩柔弱的人。
explanationTraditional: 原形容花木枝葉美好◇多指皇族子孫。現也比喻出身高貴或嬌嫩柔弱的人。
explanationEn: Originally described beautiful flowers and trees; now refers to descendants of royalty or people of noble birth, or those who are delicate and pampered.
derivation: 晋·崔豹《古今注·舆服》与蚩尤战于涿鹿之野，常有五色云气金枝玉叶止于帝上。”唐·王建《宫中调笑》词胡蝶、胡蝶，飞上金枝玉叶。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·崔豹《古今注·輿服》與蚩尤戰於涿鹿之野，常有五色雲氣金枝玉葉止於帝上。”唐·王建《宮中調笑》詞胡蝶、胡蝶，飛上金枝玉葉。”
derivationEn: Jin·Cui Bao's 'Notes on Ancient and Modern Times: Chariots and Robes': 'When fighting against Chiyou in the wilderness of Zhuolu, there were often five-colored clouds and golden branches and jade leaves resting on the emperor.' Tang·Wang Jian's 'Palace Tune': 'Butterflies, butterflies, fly onto golden branches and jade leaves.'
example: 嫂又～，吹股风都要生病。★沙汀《一个秋天的晚上》
exampleTraditional: 嫂又～，吹股風都要生病。★沙汀《一個秋天的晚上》
exampleEn: Sister-in-law is a delicate flower; even a gust of wind could make her sick. — Sha Ting's 'An Autumn Night'

explanation: 全国上下，团结一致。
explanationTraditional: 全國上下，團結一致。
explanationEn: The whole nation united as one.
derivation: 毛泽东《论持久战》所有问题的中心点还是中国全体人民团结起来，树立举国一致的抗日阵线。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《論持久戰》所有問題的中心點還是中國全體人民團結起來，樹立舉國一致的抗日陣線。”
derivationEn: Mao Zedong's 'On Protracted War': 'The central issue is still the unity of all Chinese people to establish a nationwide united anti-Japanese front.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容来往行人众多，很拥挤。
explanationTraditional: 形容來往行人眾多，很擁擠。
explanationEn: Describes a crowded street with many pedestrians.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 大街上人来人往，～，十分热闹。
exampleTraditional: 大街上人來人往，～，十分熱鬧。
exampleEn: The streets are bustling with people, rubbing shoulders and brushing heels, very lively.

explanation: 丢弃邪恶行为去做好事。
explanationTraditional: 丟棄邪惡行為去做好事。
explanationEn: To abandon evil and do good deeds.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心地仁慈，医术高明。
explanationTraditional: 心地仁慈，醫術高明。
explanationEn: Kind-hearted and highly skilled in medicine.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄上》今有仁心仁闻，而民不被其泽，不可法于后世者，不行先王之道也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁上》今有仁心仁聞，而民不被其澤，不可法於後世者，不行先王之道也。”
derivationEn: Mencius, 'Li Lou I': 'Now if one has a benevolent heart and a benevolent reputation, yet the people do not receive his benefits, and he cannot be a model for later generations, it is because he does not practice the way of the former kings.'
example: 他送给张医生一块牌匾，上面写着～四字，表扬张医生医德高尚，医术精湛。
exampleTraditional: 他送給張醫生一塊牌匾，上面寫著～四字，表揚張醫生醫德高尚，醫術精湛。
exampleEn: He gave Dr. Zhang a plaque inscribed with 'Benevolent Heart and Skillful Art' to praise his noble medical ethics and superb medical skills.

explanation: 一天能走一千里。形容速度惊人。
explanationTraditional: 一天能走一千里。形容速度驚人。
explanationEn: To travel a thousand li in a day; describes extremely fast speed.
derivation: 《魏书·吐谷浑传》吐谷浑尝得波斯草马，放入海，因生骢驹，能日行千里，世传青海骢者是也。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·吐谷渾傳》吐谷渾嘗得波斯草馬，放入海，因生驄駒，能日行千里，世傳青海驄者是也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Wei: Biography of Tuyuhun': 'Tuyuhun once obtained a Persian mare and put it into the sea, where it gave birth to a piebald colt that could travel a thousand li a day, known in the world as the Qinghai piebald.'
example: 云锦队中曾赛，每闻伯乐声嘶，登山度岭去如飞，真个～。★《平妖传》第28回
exampleTraditional: 雲錦隊中曾賽，每聞伯樂聲嘶，登山度嶺去如飛，真個～。★《平妖傳》第28回
exampleEn: Once raced in the cloud brocade team, often hearing Bole's neighing, climbing mountains and crossing ridges as if flying, truly traveling a thousand li a day. — 'Ping Yao Zhuan' Chapter 28

explanation: 什么也没有得到。形容毫无收获。
explanationTraditional: 什麼也沒有得到。形容毫無收穫。
explanationEn: To gain nothing at all; describes having no harvest.
derivation: 五代·王定保《唐摭言》卷八然日势既暮，寿儿且寄院中止宿，颢亦怀疑，因命寿儿怀袖，一无所得，颢不得已遂躬自操觚。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·王定保《唐摭言》卷八然日勢既暮，壽兒且寄院中止宿，顥亦懷疑，因命壽兒懷袖，一無所得，顥不得已遂躬自操觚。”
derivationEn: Five Dynasties·Wang Dingbao's 'Tang Zhiyan' Volume 8: 'But as the day was getting late, Shou'er stayed overnight in the hostel. Hao was suspicious and ordered Shou'er to search his sleeves, but found nothing. Hao had no choice but to write himself.'
example: 但现在寻起来，～，想必是十七那夜统统烧掉了，那里我还没有知道被捕的也有白莽。★鲁迅《南腔北调集·为了忘却的记念》
exampleTraditional: 但現在尋起來，～，想必是十七那夜統統燒掉了，那裡我還沒有知道被捕的也有白莽。★魯迅《南腔北調集·為了忘卻的記念》
exampleEn: But now searching, I found nothing; presumably they were all burned on the night of the 17th, when I did not yet know that Bai Mang had been arrested. — Lu Xun's 'In Memory of Forgetting'

explanation: 使用人的专长。
explanationTraditional: 使用人的專長。
explanationEn: To make use of someone's strengths or expertise.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 便宜方便，适宜。指可以根据实际情况斟酌处理，不必请示。
explanationTraditional: 便宜方便，適宜。指可以根據實際情況斟酌處理，不必請示。
explanationEn: To act according to circumstances without seeking approval; to use discretion.
derivation: 《史记·萧相国世家》即不及奏上，辄以便宜施行，上来以闻。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·蕭相國世家》即不及奏上，輒以便宜施行，上來以聞。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Prime Minister Xiao': 'If there was no time to report to the emperor, he would act according to convenience and then report.'
example: 既然大权交代于你，你就得～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 既然大權交代於你，你就得～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十二回
exampleEn: Since you have been given full authority, you should act according to circumstances. — Qing·Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Chapter 12

explanation: 比喻行动敏捷。
explanationTraditional: 比喻行動敏捷。
explanationEn: Describes moving with great agility and speed.
derivation: 《孙子·九地》是故始如处女，敌人开户；后如脱兔，敌不及拒。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·九地》是故始如處女，敵人開戶；後如脫兔，敵不及拒。”
derivationEn: 'The Art of War: Nine Terrains': 'Thus, at first be like a maiden, so the enemy opens his door; afterwards, be like a fleeing rabbit, and the enemy cannot resist.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用恶毒的语言污蔑、伤害人。
explanationTraditional: 用惡毒的語言汙衊、傷害人。
explanationEn: To hurt someone with malicious words.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元·洪州法昌倚遇禅师》利刀割肉疮犹合；恶语伤人恨不销。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元·洪州法昌倚遇禪師》利刀割肉瘡猶合；惡語傷人恨不銷。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'A sharp knife cuts flesh, but the wound can heal; malicious words hurt people, and the hatred never fades.'
example: 别人行甜言美语三冬暖，我跟前，～六月寒。★元·王实甫《西厢记》第三本第二折
exampleTraditional: 別人行甜言美語三冬暖，我跟前，～六月寒。★元·王實甫《西廂記》第三本第二折
exampleEn: Others' sweet words bring warmth in winter, but before me, malicious words hurt like cold in June. — Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu's 'The Western Chamber' Act 3, Scene 2

explanation: 开山指在名山创立寺院；祖师第一代创业和尚。原指开创寺院的和尚◇借指某一事业的创始人。
explanationTraditional: 開山指在名山創立寺院；祖師第一代創業和尚。原指開創寺院的和尚◇借指某一事業的創始人。
explanationEn: Founder of a school or enterprise; originally refers to the first monk to establish a temple on a mountain.
derivation: 宋·辛弃疾《水龙吟》词只应白发是开山祖。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·辛棄疾《水龍吟》詞只應白髮是開山祖。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Xin Qiji's poem 'Water Dragon Chant': 'Only white hair is the founder.'
example: 迨今龙济奉为重～。★明·李昌祺《剪灯余话·听经猿记》
exampleTraditional: 迨今龍濟奉為重～。★明·李昌祺《剪燈餘話·聽經猿記》
exampleEn: Later, Longji was revered as the founder. — Ming Dynasty, Li Changqi's 'Lamplight Tales: The Ape Listening to Sutras'

explanation: 指儿女成家。
explanationTraditional: 指兒女成家。
explanationEn: The marriage of sons and daughters; children settling down.
derivation: 语出《后汉书·逸民传·向长》建武中，男女聚嫁既毕，[长]敕断家事勿相关，当如我死也。”唐·刘禹锡《哭吕衡州时予方谪居》诗空怀济世安人略，不见男婚女嫁时。”
derivationTraditional: 語出《後漢書·逸民傳·向長》建武中，男女聚嫁既畢，[長]敕斷家事勿相關，當如我死也。”唐·劉禹錫《哭呂衡州時予方謫居》詩空懷濟世安人略，不見男婚女嫁時。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biographies of Recluses: Xiang Chang': 'In the Jianwu period, after his sons and daughters were married, Xiang Chang cut off family affairs.' Tang Dynasty, Liu Yuxi's poem 'Mourning Lü Hengzhou': 'Harboring the strategy to help the world, but not seeing the time of sons marrying and daughters marrying.'
example: ～，大事都完了。★冰心《南归》
exampleTraditional: ～，大事都完了。★冰心《南歸》
exampleEn: The great events of sons marrying and daughters marrying are all finished. — Bing Xin's 'Returning South'

explanation: 行将将要；木指棺材。指人寿命已经不长，快要进棺材了。
explanationTraditional: 行將將要；木指棺材。指人壽命已經不長，快要進棺材了。
explanationEn: To be near death; one foot in the grave.
derivation: 《左传·僖公二十三年》我二十五年矣，又如是而嫁，则就木焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公二十三年》我二十五年矣，又如是而嫁，則就木焉。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's 23rd Year': 'I am twenty-five years old, and if I marry again like this, I will be in the coffin.'
example: 但老夫～，只求晚年残喘。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 但老夫～，只求晚年殘喘。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第二十五回
exampleEn: But I am near death, only seeking a brief respite in my final years. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'The Painful History' Chapter 25

explanation: 春秋时鲁国的柳下惠将受冻的女子裹于怀中，没有发生非礼行为。形容男子在两性关系方面作风正派。
explanationTraditional: 春秋時魯國的柳下惠將受凍的女子裹於懷中，沒有發生非禮行為。形容男子在兩性關係方面作風正派。
explanationEn: To be upright and not seduced by a woman; describes a man of moral integrity in sexual matters.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·巷伯》毛亨传子何不若柳下惠然，妪不逮门之女，国人不称其乱。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·巷伯》毛亨傳子何不若柳下惠然，嫗不逮門之女，國人不稱其亂。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Xiangbo' Mao Heng's commentary: 'Why not be like Liu Xiahui, who held a cold woman in his arms without improper behavior?'
example: 人人都说他无行，其实水秀才原是～的。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 人人都說他無行，其實水秀才原是～的。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第五十六回
exampleEn: Everyone says he is immoral, but actually Scholar Shui was one who could hold a woman in his arms without being disturbed. — Ming Dynasty, Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng's 'The Plum in the Golden Vase' Chapter 56

explanation: 指缺乏阅历经验的读书人。也指面孔白净的读书人。
explanationTraditional: 指缺乏閱歷經驗的讀書人。也指面孔白淨的讀書人。
explanationEn: A young scholar with little experience; a pale-faced intellectual.
derivation: 《宋书·沈庆之传》陛下今欲伐国，而与白面书生辈谋之，事何由济。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·沈慶之傳》陛下今欲伐國，而與白面書生輩謀之，事何由濟。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Song: Shen Qingzhi's Biography': 'Your Majesty now wants to attack a country, but if you discuss it with pale-faced scholars, how can it succeed?'
example: 雪儿呵，偏则把～奚落。★明·汤显祖《牡丹亭》第二十二出
exampleTraditional: 雪兒呵，偏則把～奚落。★明·湯顯祖《牡丹亭》第二十二出
exampleEn: Snow, why do you mock the pale-faced scholar? — Ming Dynasty, Tang Xianzu's 'The Peony Pavilion' Scene 22

explanation: 名用言语说出；状描绘，形容。无法用语言来形容。
explanationTraditional: 名用言語說出；狀描繪，形容。無法用語言來形容。
explanationEn: Indescribable; beyond words.
derivation: 《老子》第十四章绳绳不可名，复归于无物，是谓无状之状，无物之象。”晋·葛洪《神仙记·王远》衣有文采，又非锦绮，光彩耀目，不可名状。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第十四章繩繩不可名，復歸於無物，是謂無狀之狀，無物之象。”晉·葛洪《神仙記·王遠》衣有文采，又非錦綺，光彩耀目，不可名狀。”
derivationEn: 'Laozi' Chapter 14: 'Continuous and unnameable, it returns to nothingness, which is the shape of no shape.' Jin Dynasty, Ge Hong's 'Biographies of Immortals: Wang Yuan': 'The clothes had patterns, not brocade, but dazzling and indescribable.'
example: 拜住不敢十分抬头，已自看得较切，不比前日墙外影响，心中喜不～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷九
exampleTraditional: 拜住不敢十分抬頭，已自看得較切，不比前日牆外影響，心中喜不～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷九
exampleEn: Baizhu dared not raise his head too much, but he had already seen clearly, unlike the vague glimpse over the wall before, and his joy was indescribable. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Striking the Table in Surprise' Volume 9

explanation: 分身分出精力照顾其他方面。没有一身同时兼顾几个方面的法术。
explanationTraditional: 分身分出精力照顧其他方面。沒有一身同時兼顧幾個方面的法術。
explanationEn: Unable to attend to multiple tasks at once; no ability to be in two places at the same time.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 对有才有德的人以礼相待，对一般有才能的人不计自己的身分去结交。
explanationTraditional: 對有才有德的人以禮相待，對一般有才能的人不計自己的身分去結交。
explanationEn: To treat worthy people with courtesy and humble oneself to associate with talented individuals.
derivation: 《宋书·江夏文献王义恭传》礼贤下士，圣人垂训；骄多矜尚，先哲所去。”《新唐书·李勉传》其在朝廷，鲠亮廉介，这宗臣表，礼贤下士有始终，尝引李巡、张参在幕府。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·江夏文獻王義恭傳》禮賢下士，聖人垂訓；驕多矜尚，先哲所去。”《新唐書·李勉傳》其在朝廷，鯁亮廉介，這宗臣表，禮賢下士有始終，嘗引李巡、張參在幕府。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Song: Jiangxia Wenxian Wang Yigong's Biography': 'Treating the worthy with courtesy and humbling oneself to scholars is a sage's teaching.' 'New Book of Tang: Li Mian's Biography': 'In court, he was upright and incorruptible, a model minister, treating the worthy with courtesy and humbling himself to scholars from beginning to end.'
example: 我今天看见了一位～的大人先生，在今世只怕是要算绝少的了。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四回
exampleTraditional: 我今天看見了一位～的大人先生，在今世只怕是要算絕少的了。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四回
exampleEn: Today I saw a great gentleman who treats the worthy with courtesy and humbles himself to scholars; in this world, I'm afraid he is extremely rare. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Situations Observed in the Past Twenty Years' Chapter 4

explanation: 不声不响，闭口无言。
explanationTraditional: 不聲不響，閉口無言。
explanationEn: Silent and speechless; without saying a word.
derivation: 元·无名氏《连环计》第二折忧的我神思竭，默默无言；愁的我魂胆丧，兢兢打战。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《連環計》第二折憂的我神思竭，默默無言；愁的我魂膽喪，兢兢打戰。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'The Stratagem of the Linked Rings' Act 2: 'Worried to the point of exhaustion, silent and speechless; frightened to the point of losing courage, trembling with fear.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻自不量力，招致失败。同螳臂当车”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻自不量力，招致失敗。同螳臂當車”。
explanationEn: To overestimate one's own strength and invite failure; like a mantis trying to stop a chariot.
derivation: 李一《荆宜施鹤光复记》武汉义师之崛起也，以一隅而待北方数省之兵，盖有螳臂挡车之势，危莫甚焉。”
derivationTraditional: 李一《荊宜施鶴光復記》武漢義師之崛起也，以一隅而待北方數省之兵，蓋有螳臂擋車之勢，危莫甚焉。”
derivationEn: From Li Yi's 'Record of the Restoration of Jingyi Shiguang': 'The uprising of the Wuhan righteous army, with one corner facing the troops of several northern provinces, was like a mantis trying to stop a chariot, extremely dangerous.'
example: 飞蛾扑火，～，最终逃脱不了灭亡的命运。★白桦《梅园青松·周总理您在亿万人民心中永生》诗
exampleTraditional: 飛蛾撲火，～，最終逃脫不了滅亡的命運。★白樺《梅園青松·周總理您在億萬人民心中永生》詩
exampleEn: Like a moth darting into a flame, or a mantis trying to stop a chariot, they ultimately cannot escape the fate of destruction. ★ From Bai Hua's poem 'Plum Garden Green Pines: Premier Zhou Lives Forever in the Hearts of Millions'

explanation: 比喻脱离羁绊的人或失去了控制的事物。
explanationTraditional: 比喻脫離羈絆的人或失去了控制的事物。
explanationEn: A person or thing that has broken free from restraint or control.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他像～一样无拘无束。
exampleTraditional: 他像～一樣無拘無束。
exampleEn: He is as unrestrained as a horse that has slipped its halter.

explanation: 及涉及；义正经的道理。指净说些无聊的话，没有一句正经的。
explanationTraditional: 及涉及；義正經的道理。指淨說些無聊的話，沒有一句正經的。
explanationEn: To talk only about trivial matters and never about serious or righteous topics.
derivation: 《论语·魏灵公》群居终日，言不及义，好行小慧，难矣哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·魏靈公》群居終日，言不及義，好行小慧，難矣哉！”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius, 'Wei Ling Gong': 'Spending the whole day together, talking about nothing righteous, and indulging in petty cleverness—how difficult it is!'
example: 真所谓～”，那里有好事情串出来。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一百四回
exampleTraditional: 真所謂～”，那裡有好事情串出來。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一百四回
exampleEn: Truly 'talking about nothing righteous'—how can any good come out of it? ★ From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 104

explanation: 原指古代经过阳关通向西域的大道，后泛指宽阔的长路，也比喻光明的前途。
explanationTraditional: 原指古代經過陽關通向西域的大道，後泛指寬闊的長路，也比喻光明的前途。
explanationEn: Originally the road through Yangguan to the Western Regions; now refers to a broad road or a bright future.
derivation: 唐·王维《送刘司直赴安西》诗绝域阳关道，胡沙与塞尘。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王維《送劉司直赴安西》詩絕域陽關道，胡沙與塞塵。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Wei's poem 'Seeing Off Liu Si Zhi to Anxi': 'The distant road through Yangguan, with desert sands and frontier dust.'
example: 他们已经跳过了可怕的阶级分化的历史道路，走上社会主义的～了。★秦牧《原始公社的影子》
exampleTraditional: 他們已經跳過了可怕的階級分化的歷史道路，走上社會主義的～了。★秦牧《原始公社的影子》
exampleEn: They have already leaped over the terrifying historical path of class differentiation and stepped onto the socialist broad road. ★ From Qin Mu's 'Shadow of the Primitive Commune'

explanation: 妖言迷惑人的邪说。用荒谬的鬼话迷惑人。
explanationTraditional: 妖言迷惑人的邪說。用荒謬的鬼話迷惑人。
explanationEn: To spread false and absurd words to deceive people.
derivation: 《汉书·眭弘传》妄设妖言惑众，大逆不道。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·眭弘傳》妄設妖言惑眾，大逆不道。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Sui Hong': 'Spreading false rumors to deceive the masses is a great rebellion against the Way.'
example: 世上这些～的人，怎么没人治他一下子！★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: 世上這些～的人，怎麼沒人治他一下子！★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十七回
exampleEn: Why doesn't someone punish those who spread false rumors to deceive the masses! ★ From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 67

explanation: 尸体为鱼所食。指淹死于水中。
explanationTraditional: 屍體為魚所食。指淹死於水中。
explanationEn: To be drowned in water; literally, to have one's body fed to the fish.
derivation: 战国·楚·屈原《渔父》宁赴湘流，葬于江鱼之腹中。安能以皓皓之白，而蒙世俗之尘磅？”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·屈原《漁父》寧赴湘流，葬於江魚之腹中。安能以皓皓之白，而蒙世俗之塵磅？”
derivationEn: From Warring States period Qu Yuan's 'The Fisherman': 'I would rather go to the Xiang River and be buried in the belly of a fish. How can I let my pure whiteness be sullied by worldly dust?'
example: 只要你舍得这辆汽车，我就奉陪三百回合，直到大雨把汽车冲进大河，咱俩一同～。★刘绍棠《十步芳草》
exampleTraditional: 只要你捨得這輛汽車，我就奉陪三百回合，直到大雨把汽車衝進大河，咱倆一同～。★劉紹棠《十步芳草》
exampleEn: As long as you are willing to give up this car, I will accompany you for three hundred rounds until the rain washes the car into the river and we both end up in the fish's belly. ★ From Liu Shaotang's 'Ten Steps of Fragrant Grass'

explanation: 秉持，握住。写史书根据事实记录，不隐讳。
explanationTraditional: 秉持，握住。寫史書根據事實記錄，不隱諱。
explanationEn: To write history or records truthfully without concealment or bias.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十五回我是秉笔直书，悬之国门，不能增损一字。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十五回我是秉筆直書，懸之國門，不能增損一字。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 35: 'I write with an honest pen, hanging it at the city gate, not a single word can be added or removed.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 喻说明，告知。不能用言语来说明。
explanationTraditional: 喻說明，告知。不能用言語來說明。
explanationEn: Indescribable; cannot be expressed in words.
derivation: 宋·沈括《梦溪笔谈·象数一》其术可以心得，不可言喻。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·沈括《夢溪筆談·象數一》其術可以心得，不可言喻。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shen Kuo's 'Dream Pool Essays: On Astronomy': 'The technique can be understood by the mind but cannot be expressed in words.'
example: 希白见女子容颜秀丽，词气清扬，喜悦之心，～。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十
exampleTraditional: 希白見女子容顏秀麗，詞氣清揚，喜悅之心，～。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十
exampleEn: Xi Bai saw the woman's beautiful appearance and elegant speech, and his joy was indescribable. ★ From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World', Volume 10

explanation: 不肖不象，不贤。指品德差，没出息，不能继承先辈事业的子孙或晚辈。
explanationTraditional: 不肖不象，不賢。指品德差，沒出息，不能繼承先輩事業的子孫或晚輩。
explanationEn: Unworthy descendants who fail to inherit the virtues or achievements of their ancestors.
derivation: 《庄子·天地》亲之所言而然，所行而善，则世俗谓之不肖子。”《孟子·万章上》丹朱之不肖，舜之子亦不肖。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天地》親之所言而然，所行而善，則世俗謂之不肖子。”《孟子·萬章上》丹朱之不肖，舜之子亦不肖。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Heaven and Earth': 'If one agrees with whatever parents say and approves whatever they do, the world calls him an unworthy son.' Also from 'Mencius: Wan Zhang I': 'Dan Zhu was unworthy, and Shun's son was also unworthy.'
example: 造庙的时候，他的祖宗就捐过钱，现在他却要来吹熄长明灯，这不是～？★鲁迅《彷徨·长明灯》
exampleTraditional: 造廟的時候，他的祖宗就捐過錢，現在他卻要來吹熄長明燈，這不是～？★魯迅《彷徨·長明燈》
exampleEn: When the temple was built, his ancestors donated money, but now he wants to blow out the eternal lamp—isn't he an unworthy descendant? ★ From Lu Xun's 'Wandering: The Eternal Lamp'

explanation: 高楼大屋，眼看就要倒了。比喻即将来临的崩溃局势。
explanationTraditional: 高樓大屋，眼看就要倒了。比喻即將來臨的崩潰局勢。
explanationEn: A great building is about to collapse; metaphor for an impending catastrophic situation.
derivation: 《文中子·事君》大厦将颠，非一木所支也。”
derivationTraditional: 《文中子·事君》大廈將顛，非一木所支也。”
derivationEn: From 'Wen Zhongzi: Serving the Ruler': 'When a great building is about to topple, it cannot be supported by a single beam.'
example: 其实，这也难怪，～，独木难支，谁又不是这样？★罗广斌、杨益言《红岩》
exampleTraditional: 其實，這也難怪，～，獨木難支，誰又不是這樣？★羅廣斌、楊益言《紅巖》
exampleEn: In fact, it's no wonder—when a great building is about to fall, a single beam cannot support it. Who isn't like this? ★ From Luo Guangbin and Yang Yiyan's 'Red Crag'

explanation: 以钟发声，以磬收韵，奏乐从始至终。比喻音韵响亮、和谐。也比喻人的知识渊博，才学精到。
explanationTraditional: 以鍾發聲，以磬收韻，奏樂從始至終。比喻音韻響亮、和諧。也比喻人的知識淵博，才學精到。
explanationEn: Describes melodious and harmonious sound, or a person of profound knowledge and refined talent.
derivation: 《孟子·万章下》集大成也者，金声而玉振之也。金声也者，始条理也；玉振之也者，终条理也。始条理者，智之事也；终条理者，圣之事也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章下》集大成也者，金聲而玉振之也。金聲也者，始條理也；玉振之也者，終條理也。始條理者，智之事也；終條理者，聖之事也。”
derivationEn: From Mencius: 'The collection of great achievements is like the sound of metal and the vibration of jade.'
example: ～，寥亮于区寓。★南朝齐·王俭《褚渊碑文》
exampleTraditional: ～，寥亮於區寓。★南朝齊·王儉《褚淵碑文》
exampleEn: Resonant and harmonious, filling the realm. — Wang Jian, Southern Qi Dynasty

explanation: 比喻声名迅速增高。
explanationTraditional: 比喻聲名迅速增高。
explanationEn: Describes a reputation that rises rapidly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 恃依靠、凭借；物人，公众。仗着自己有才能，看不起人。
explanationTraditional: 恃依靠、憑藉；物人，公眾。仗著自己有才能，看不起人。
explanationEn: To rely on one's own talent and look down on others.
derivation: 《南史·萧子显传》恃才傲物，宜谥曰骄。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·蕭子顯傳》恃才傲物，宜諡曰驕。”
derivationEn: From History of the Southern Dynasties: 'Relying on talent and being arrogant, he should be posthumously named Jiao (arrogant).'
example: 唐薛澄州昭纬，即保逊之子也。～，亦有父风。★宋·孙光宪《北梦琐言》卷四
exampleTraditional: 唐薛澄州昭緯，即保遜之子也。～，亦有父風。★宋·孫光憲《北夢瑣言》卷四
exampleEn: Xue Zhaowei of Tang, son of Baoxun, relied on his talent and was arrogant, inheriting his father's style. — Sun Guangxian, Northern Song

explanation: 像笑又不笑。
explanationTraditional: 像笑又不笑。
explanationEn: A facial expression that seems like a smile but is not quite a smile.
derivation: 鲁迅《彷徨·祝福》后来大家又都知道了她的脾气，只要有孩子在眼前，便似笑非笑的先问她。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《彷徨·祝福》後來大家又都知道了她的脾氣，只要有孩子在眼前，便似笑非笑的先問她。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'The New Year's Sacrifice': 'Later everyone knew her temper; whenever a child was present, she would ask with a half-smile.'
example: 后来见的次数多了，大家～，用以代替招呼。★苏青《结婚十年》第四章
exampleTraditional: 後來見的次數多了，大家～，用以代替招呼。★蘇青《結婚十年》第四章
exampleEn: Later, when we met more often, everyone used a half-smile to greet each other. — Su Qing, 'Ten Years of Marriage'

explanation: 既害了别人，又害了自己。
explanationTraditional: 既害了別人，又害了自己。
explanationEn: To harm both others and oneself.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原为道家语，形容道的微妙无形◇多形容非常奥妙，不易理解。
explanationTraditional: 原為道家語，形容道的微妙無形◇多形容非常奧妙，不易理解。
explanationEn: Originally a Taoist term describing the subtlety of the Tao; now refers to something extremely profound and difficult to understand.
derivation: 《老子》第一章玄之又玄，众妙之门。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第一章玄之又玄，眾妙之門。”
derivationEn: From Laozi: 'Mystery upon mystery, the gate of all wonders.'
example: 第六客是～的鬼学家。★刘半农《作揖主义》
exampleTraditional: 第六客是～的鬼學家。★劉半農《作揖主義》
exampleEn: The sixth guest was a profound occultist. — Liu Bannong, 'The Art of Yielding'

explanation: 血债未报的杀人深仇；累累形容很多。指杀人很多，罪恶极大。
explanationTraditional: 血債未報的殺人深仇；累累形容很多。指殺人很多，罪惡極大。
explanationEn: Describes someone who has committed numerous murders and is deeply guilty.
derivation: 冯德英《迎春花》第二章这个狗仗官势、血债累累的地头蛇，被暴怒的人们活活地埋进沙坑。”
derivationTraditional: 馮德英《迎春花》第二章這個狗仗官勢、血債累累的地頭蛇，被暴怒的人們活活地埋進沙坑。”
derivationEn: From Feng Deying's 'Spring Flowers': 'This local tyrant, relying on power and with a heavy blood debt, was buried alive by the furious crowd.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 遗老旧称前朝的旧臣；遗少留恋旧时代的少年。改朝换代后仍效忠前朝的老人和青年。也泛指留恋过去、思想顽固陈旧的人。
explanationTraditional: 遺老舊稱前朝的舊臣；遺少留戀舊時代的少年。改朝換代後仍效忠前朝的老人和青年。也泛指留戀過去、思想頑固陳舊的人。
explanationEn: Refers to people who remain loyal to the previous dynasty after a change of regime, or those who are stubbornly conservative.
derivation: 鲁迅《南腔北调集·作文秘诀》这一个所谓‘错’，就使《文选》之类在遗老遗少们的心眼里保住了威灵。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《南腔北調集·作文秘訣》這一個所謂‘錯’，就使《文選》之類在遺老遺少們的心眼裡保住了威靈。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Essays': 'This so-called 'mistake' made 'Selections of Refined Literature' retain its prestige in the hearts of the old and young loyalists.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原意是如果对敌我双方的情况都能了解透彻，打起仗来就可以立于不败之地。泛指对双方情况都很了解。
explanationTraditional: 原意是如果對敵我雙方的情況都能瞭解透徹，打起仗來就可以立於不敗之地。泛指對雙方情況都很瞭解。
explanationEn: To understand both the enemy and oneself thoroughly, ensuring victory in battle; generally means to have a clear understanding of both sides.
derivation: 《孙子·谋攻》知己知彼，百战不殆。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·謀攻》知己知彼，百戰不殆。”
derivationEn: From Sun Tzu's The Art of War: 'Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated.'
example: 对付敌人，一定要～，才能百战百胜。
exampleTraditional: 對付敵人，一定要～，才能百戰百勝。
exampleEn: To deal with the enemy, one must know both the enemy and oneself to be invincible.

explanation: 在天下任意往来，没有阻挡。
explanationTraditional: 在天下任意往來，沒有阻擋。
explanationEn: To roam freely across the world without obstacles.
derivation: 元·陈以仁《存孝打虎》第一折黄巢纵横天下，朝中文武并不以社稷为重。”
derivationTraditional: 元·陳以仁《存孝打虎》第一折黃巢縱橫天下，朝中文武並不以社稷為重。”
derivationEn: From Yuan drama: 'Huang Chao roamed freely across the world, and the court officials did not care about the state.'
example: 健儿掷杯砍案曰吾～三十年矣，未逢敌手，有能取我腰间物者，当叩首降之。★清·李渔《秦淮健儿传》
exampleTraditional: 健兒擲杯砍案曰吾～三十年矣，未逢敵手，有能取我腰間物者，當叩首降之。★清·李漁《秦淮健兒傳》
exampleEn: The brave man threw his cup and said, 'I have roamed the world for thirty years without meeting a match. If anyone can take my sword, I will bow and surrender.' — Li Yu, Qing Dynasty

explanation: 比喻左右为难，不好处理。也形容样子别扭。
explanationTraditional: 比喻左右為難，不好處理。也形容樣子彆扭。
explanationEn: Describes a situation where one is in a dilemma, difficult to handle. Also describes an awkward appearance.
derivation: 宋·吴泳《赋半斋送张清分教嘉定》道如大路皆可遵，不尴不尬难为人。”《朱子语类》卷三四圣人全体极至，没那不间不界底事。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·吳泳《賦半齋送張清分教嘉定》道如大路皆可遵，不尷不尬難為人。”《朱子語類》卷三四聖人全體極至，沒那不間不界底事。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wu Yong's poem 'Fu Ban Zhai Song Zhang Qing Fen Jiao Jia Ding': 'The Way is like a broad road, all can follow; not awkward, not embarrassing, hard to be a person.' Zhu Xi's 'Classified Conversations of Master Zhu' vol. 34: 'The sage is whole and utmost, without that awkward and embarrassing matter.'
example: 外甥女少不得的是我们养着，牛姑爷也该做出一个主意来，只管～住着，也不是事。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 外甥女少不得的是我們養著，牛姑爺也該做出一個主意來，只管～住著，也不是事。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第二十二回
exampleEn: We have to support our niece, and Uncle Niu should come up with a plan. Just staying here awkwardly is not a solution. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 22

explanation: 比喻见效快。
explanationTraditional: 比喻見效快。
explanationEn: Metaphor for achieving quick results.
derivation: 《人民日报》1975.7.8有人提出多派些人到外地搞副业，抓现钱，说这个办法‘吹糠见米’，收效快。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民日報》1975.7.8有人提出多派些人到外地搞副業，抓現錢，說這個辦法‘吹糠見米’，收效快。”
derivationEn: 'People's Daily', July 8, 1975: 'Some suggested sending more people to work in other places to earn quick cash, saying this method is like blowing away chaff to see rice—quick results.'
example: 这个办法可以有～的效果。
exampleTraditional: 這個辦法可以有～的效果。
exampleEn: This method can have the effect of blowing away chaff to see rice.

explanation: 敬业违心于学业；乐群乐于与好朋友相处。专心学习，和同学融洽相处。
explanationTraditional: 敬業違心於學業；樂群樂於與好朋友相處。專心學習，和同學融洽相處。
explanationEn: Dedicated to studies and happy to be with good friends. Focus on learning and get along harmoniously with classmates.
derivation: 《礼记·学记》一年视离经辨志，三年视敬业乐群。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·學記》一年視離經辨志，三年視敬業樂群。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Rites: Record on the Subject of Education': 'In the first year, examine the student's ability to interpret classics and aspirations; in the third year, examine their dedication to studies and enjoyment of company.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容呼吸微弱，快要断气的样子。也比喻事物衰败没落，即将灭亡。
explanationTraditional: 形容呼吸微弱，快要斷氣的樣子。也比喻事物衰敗沒落，即將滅亡。
explanationEn: Describes breathing weakly, on the verge of death. Also metaphor for something declining and about to perish.
derivation: 晋·李密《陈情表》但以刘日薄西山，乞息奄奄，人命危浅，朝不虑夕。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·李密《陳情表》但以劉日薄西山，乞息奄奄，人命危淺，朝不慮夕。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Li Mi's 'Chen Qing Biao': 'But my grandmother Liu is like the sun setting behind the western hills, her breath faint, her life precarious, not knowing morning from evening.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 琼美玉。用美玉制成的浆液，古代传说饮了它可以成仙。比喻美酒或甘美的浆汁。
explanationTraditional: 瓊美玉。用美玉製成的漿液，古代傳說飲了它可以成仙。比喻美酒或甘美的漿汁。
explanationEn: Jade-like liquid; in ancient legend, drinking it could make one immortal. Metaphor for fine wine or sweet nectar.
derivation: 汉·王逸《九思·疾世》吮玉液兮止渴，啮芝华兮疗饥。”战国楚·宋玉《招魂》华酌既陈，有琼浆些。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王逸《九思·疾世》吮玉液兮止渴，齧芝華兮療飢。”戰國楚·宋玉《招魂》華酌既陳，有瓊漿些。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Wang Yi's 'Nine Longings: Sick World': 'Suck jade liquid to quench thirst, eat ganoderma to cure hunger.' Warring States, Chu, Song Yu's 'Summons of the Soul': 'The ornate goblets are set out, there is jade-like nectar.'
example: 师父，我这酒赛过～哩。★元·马致远《岳阳楼》第一折
exampleTraditional: 師父，我這酒賽過～哩。★元·馬致遠《岳陽樓》第一折
exampleEn: Master, this wine of mine surpasses jade nectar and jade liquid. — Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan, 'Yueyang Tower', Act 1

explanation: 形容男女邂逅钟情，随即分离之后，男子追念旧事的情形。
explanationTraditional: 形容男女邂逅鍾情，隨即分離之後，男子追念舊事的情形。
explanationEn: Describes a situation where a man and woman meet by chance and fall in love, then separate, and the man recalls the past.
derivation: 唐·崔护《题都城南庄》诗去年今日此门中，人面桃花相映红。人面不知何处去，桃花依旧笑春风。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·崔護《題都城南莊》詩去年今日此門中，人面桃花相映紅。人面不知何處去，桃花依舊笑春風。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Cui Hu's poem 'Written in a Village South of the Capital': 'On this day last year, in this very door, a face and peach blossoms reflected each other's red. The face is gone, I know not where, but the peach blossoms still smile in the spring breeze.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用以形容光阴如流水一去不返。
explanationTraditional: 用以形容光陰如流水一去不返。
explanationEn: Used to describe time passing like flowing water, never to return.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》子在川上曰‘逝者如斯夫！不舍昼夜。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》子在川上曰‘逝者如斯夫！不捨晝夜。’”
derivationEn: 'The Analects: Zihan': 'The Master standing by the river said, 'Thus it passes away, like this, never ceasing day or night!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹言惟命是听。指绝对服从。
explanationTraditional: 猶言惟命是聽。指絕對服從。
explanationEn: Means to obey absolutely, to do whatever is ordered.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 至到。指没有不到的地方。也指什么坏事都做绝了。
explanationTraditional: 至到。指沒有不到的地方。也指什麼壞事都做絕了。
explanationEn: Means there is no place it does not reach. Also means to stop at nothing (in doing evil).
derivation: 《论语·阳货》既得之，患失之，苟患失之，无所不至矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·陽貨》既得之，患失之，苟患失之，無所不至矣。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects: Yang Huo': 'Having obtained it, he worries about losing it; if he worries about losing it, he will stop at nothing.'
example: 夜间絮絮叨叨，你问我答，凡街坊秽亵之谈，～。★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷一
exampleTraditional: 夜間絮絮叨叨，你問我答，凡街坊穢褻之談，～。★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷一
exampleEn: At night, they chattered endlessly, asking and answering, covering all sorts of vulgar street talk, stopping at nothing. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New', Volume 1

explanation: 形容心地高傲或所想超过现实。
explanationTraditional: 形容心地高傲或所想超過現實。
explanationEn: Describes a person with lofty ambitions or unrealistic expectations.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第五回霁月难逢，彩云易散。心比天高，身为下贱。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第五回霽月難逢，彩雲易散。心比天高，身為下賤。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 5: 'A clear moon is hard to meet, colorful clouds easily scatter. Her heart is higher than the sky, but her status is lowly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 洋洋盛大、众多的样子；大观丰富多采的景象。形容美好的事物众多丰盛。
explanationTraditional: 洋洋盛大、眾多的樣子；大觀豐富多采的景象。形容美好的事物眾多豐盛。
explanationEn: Magnificent and abundant; a grand and impressive sight of numerous beautiful things.
derivation: 《庄子·天地》夫道，覆载万物者也，洋洋乎大哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天地》夫道，覆載萬物者也，洋洋乎大哉！”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Heaven and Earth': 'The Way covers and supports all things, vast and great!'
example: 到了《诗经》时代，有了琴瑟钟鼓，已是～了。★朱自清《经典常谈·诗经第四》
exampleTraditional: 到了《詩經》時代，有了琴瑟鐘鼓，已是～了。★朱自清《經典常談·詩經第四》
exampleEn: By the time of the 'Book of Songs', with lutes, zithers, bells, and drums, it was already a magnificent spectacle. ★ Zhu Ziqing, 'Classic of Poetry: Fourth'

explanation: 根据这一事物的道理，去推出与此类似的其他事物的道理。
explanationTraditional: 根據這一事物的道理，去推出與此類似的其他事物的道理。
explanationEn: To infer the rest from one instance; to deduce other similar things based on this principle.
derivation: 宋·周煇《清波杂志》卷六宣和间，宗室围炉次，索炭，既至，诃斥左右云‘炭色红，今黑，非是。’盖尝供熟火也。以此类推之，岂识世事艰难！”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周煇《清波雜誌》卷六宣和間，宗室圍爐次，索炭，既至，訶斥左右雲‘炭色紅，今黑，非是。’蓋嘗供熟火也。以此類推之，豈識世事艱難！”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhou Hui's 'Qingbo Magazine' Volume 6: 'During the Xuanhe period, a clansman was warming himself by the fire and asked for charcoal. When it arrived, he scolded the servant, saying, "The charcoal should be red, but it's black, so it's wrong." It turned out he was used to having hot coals. From this, one can infer how little he knew of the world's hardships.'
example: 先生不信，拣几个岛名试试他，果然记得，那真没法难他了。～，可见浅近的物理学，生理学等类，他都晓得。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 先生不信，揀幾個島名試試他，果然記得，那真沒法難他了。～，可見淺近的物理學，生理學等類，他都曉得。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第二十五回
exampleEn: The gentleman didn't believe it, so he tested him with a few island names, and he indeed remembered them, leaving him no way to stump him. By this analogy, it was clear that he knew shallow physics, physiology, and such. ★ Qing Dynasty Li Baojia, 'A Brief History of Civilization' Chapter 25

explanation: 原意是另有一种别人无法体会的离愁别恨的滋味，指亡国之痛◇泛指文学艺术的情调、意蕴另有种动人的美感和趣味。
explanationTraditional: 原意是另有一種別人無法體會的離愁別恨的滋味，指亡國之痛◇泛指文學藝術的情調、意蘊另有種動人的美感和趣味。
explanationEn: Originally meaning a unique, indescribable feeling of sorrow at parting, referring to the pain of national subjugation; later extended to describe a special aesthetic appeal or interest in literature and art.
derivation: 南唐·李煜《乌夜啼》词剪不断，理还乱，是离愁，别是一番滋味在尽头。”
derivationTraditional: 南唐·李煜《烏夜啼》詞剪不斷，理還亂，是離愁，別是一番滋味在盡頭。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu's poem 'Crows Crying at Night' of the Southern Tang: 'Cut it, yet it won't break; sort it, yet it's still tangled. Such is the sorrow of parting, a taste quite different in the end.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 迟暮黄昏，比喻晚年。指人至老年。
explanationTraditional: 遲暮黃昏，比喻晚年。指人至老年。
explanationEn: Late years; old age; the twilight years of one's life.
derivation: 《清朝野史大观·第九卷·两大文章》痛思臣母迟暮之年，不幸身婴残疾。”
derivationTraditional: 《清朝野史大觀·第九卷·兩大文章》痛思臣母遲暮之年，不幸身嬰殘疾。”
derivationEn: From 'Unofficial History of the Qing Dynasty: Volume 9: Two Great Essays': 'I painfully think of my mother in her twilight years, unfortunately afflicted with illness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 慈用爱护心给予众生以安乐；悲用怜悯心解除众生的痛苦；慈悲佛家语，救人苦难。形容人心肠慈善。
explanationTraditional: 慈用愛護心給予眾生以安樂；悲用憐憫心解除眾生的痛苦；慈悲佛家語，救人苦難。形容人心腸慈善。
explanationEn: Great compassion and mercy; extremely kind-hearted and charitable, originally a Buddhist term for saving sentient beings from suffering.
derivation: 《妙法莲花经·譬喻品》大慈大悲，常无懈倦，恒求善事，利益一切。”
derivationTraditional: 《妙法蓮花經·譬喻品》大慈大悲，常無懈倦，恆求善事，利益一切。”
derivationEn: From 'Saddharma Puṇḍarīka Sūtra: Parable Chapter': 'Great compassion and mercy, never weary, always seeking good deeds to benefit all.'
example: 万望长老收录，～，看赵某薄面，披剃为僧。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第四回
exampleTraditional: 萬望長老收錄，～，看趙某薄面，披剃為僧。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第四回
exampleEn: I earnestly beg the abbot to accept him, showing great compassion, and for my sake, shave his head and ordain him as a monk. ★ Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin' Chapter 4

explanation: 比喻对听到的话毫不在意。
explanationTraditional: 比喻對聽到的話毫不在意。
explanationEn: To take no notice of; to treat advice as a passing wind; to ignore completely.
derivation: 《吴越春秋·吴王寿梦传》富贵之于我，如秋风之过耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《吳越春秋·吳王壽夢傳》富貴之於我，如秋風之過耳。”
derivationEn: From 'Spring and Autumn of Wu and Yue: King Shoumeng of Wu': 'Wealth and honor to me are like the autumn wind passing by the ear.'
example: 他把爹妈的劝告～，结果一误再误，后来竟铸成大错。
exampleTraditional: 他把爹媽的勸告～，結果一誤再誤，後來竟鑄成大錯。
exampleEn: He treated his parents' advice as a passing wind, and as a result, he made repeated mistakes, eventually committing a grave error.

explanation: 用手握腕，长声叹息。形容情绪激动的神态。
explanationTraditional: 用手握腕，長聲嘆息。形容情緒激動的神態。
explanationEn: To wring one's hands and sigh deeply; to express intense emotion, such as regret or indignation.
derivation: 《晋书·刘琨传》臣所以泣血宵吟，扼腕长叹者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·劉琨傳》臣所以泣血宵吟，扼腕長嘆者也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Liu Kun': 'I weep blood and sigh at night, wringing my hands and sighing deeply.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 克克制。儒家指约束自己，使每件事都归于礼”。
explanationTraditional: 剋剋制。儒家指約束自己，使每件事都歸於禮”。
explanationEn: To restrain oneself and return to propriety; a Confucian concept meaning to overcome selfish desires and act in accordance with ritual and moral norms.
derivation: 《论语·颜渊》颜渊问仁。子曰‘克己复礼为仁。一日克己复礼，天下归仁焉！为仁由己，而由人乎哉？’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·顏淵》顏淵問仁。子曰‘克己復禮為仁。一日克己復禮，天下歸仁焉！為仁由己，而由人乎哉？’”
derivationEn: From 'Analects: Yan Yuan': 'Yan Yuan asked about benevolence. The Master said, "To restrain oneself and return to propriety is benevolence. If for one day one can restrain oneself and return to propriety, all under heaven will return to benevolence. Does benevolence come from oneself, or from others?"'
example: 小官公谨忠信，～，奉公守法，正直无私。★明·无名氏《紫泥宣》第一折
exampleTraditional: 小官公謹忠信，～，奉公守法，正直無私。★明·無名氏《紫泥宣》第一折
exampleEn: I, a minor official, am loyal and trustworthy, restrain myself and return to propriety, abide by the law, and am upright and selfless. ★ Ming Dynasty Anonymous, 'Purple Clay Edict' First Act

explanation: 莠狗尾草，很象谷子，常混在禾苗中∶人坏人都有，混杂在一起，难以分辨。
explanationTraditional: 莠狗尾草，很象穀子，常混在禾苗中∶人壞人都有，混雜在一起，難以分辨。
explanationEn: Unable to distinguish the good from the bad; a mixture of good and bad people or things that are hard to tell apart.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十六回且说彼时捐例大开，各省侯补人员十分拥挤，其中鱼龙混杂，良莠不齐。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十六回且說彼時捐例大開，各省侯補人員十分擁擠，其中魚龍混雜，良莠不齊。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'Officialdom Unmasked' Chapter 56: 'At that time, the donation system was wide open, and provincial candidates were extremely crowded, with a mix of fish and dragons, good and bad.'
example: 驭夷长策，当先剿后抚，未剿遽抚，～。兵至，相率归诚；兵退，复出焚掠。★《清史稿·吴杰传》
exampleTraditional: 馭夷長策，當先剿後撫，未剿遽撫，～。兵至，相率歸誠；兵退，復出焚掠。★《清史稿·吳傑傳》
exampleEn: The long-term strategy for managing barbarians is to first suppress and then pacify. If you pacify without suppressing, you cannot distinguish good from bad. When troops arrive, they surrender; when troops withdraw, they burn and plunder again. ★ 'Draft History of Qing: Biography of Wu Jie'

explanation: 形容气氛更加热烈。
explanationTraditional: 形容氣氛更加熱烈。
explanationEn: To add fuel to the fire; to make a situation even more intense or lively.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第13回眼见不日又有一件非常的喜事，真是烈火烹油、鲜花着锦之盛。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第13回眼見不日又有一件非常的喜事，真是烈火烹油、鮮花著錦之盛。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 13: 'Soon there will be another extraordinary happy event, truly like adding fuel to a blazing fire or embroidering brocade with flowers.'
example: 这下子可不得了啦！真好像～，会场一下子炸了——空前的大爆炸。★《花城》1981年第4期
exampleTraditional: 這下子可不得了啦！真好像～，會場一下子炸了——空前的大爆炸。★《花城》1981年第4期
exampleEn: This was too much! It was like adding fuel to a blazing fire—the meeting exploded into an unprecedented uproar. ★ 'Flower City' 1981 Issue 4

explanation: 明明知道，还故意问人。
explanationTraditional: 明明知道，還故意問人。
explanationEn: To ask a question while already knowing the answer.
derivation: 清·无名氏《绣花鞋》明人何必细说。你也知道是谁，却就是明知故问呢！”
derivationTraditional: 清·無名氏《繡花鞋》明人何必細說。你也知道是誰，卻就是明知故問呢！”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty anonymous work 'Embroidered Shoes': 'You know who it is, yet you ask knowingly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指浓艳和淡雅两种不同的妆饰。参见淡妆浓抹”。
explanationTraditional: 指濃豔和淡雅兩種不同的妝飾。參見淡妝濃抹”。
explanationEn: Refers to two different styles of makeup: heavy and light.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容情爱深厚，像大海一样不可量。
explanationTraditional: 形容情愛深厚，像大海一樣不可量。
explanationEn: Describes deep affection as vast as the ocean.
derivation: 明·崔时佩《西厢记》春闷好难捱，毕竟情深似海。”
derivationTraditional: 明·崔時佩《西廂記》春悶好難捱，畢竟情深似海。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Cui Shipei's 'The Story of the Western Wing': 'Spring melancholy is hard to bear, after all, love is as deep as the sea.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 熔化在同一个炉内。比喻多种事物相互间结合紧密，浑然一体，难分难解。
explanationTraditional: 熔化在同一個爐內。比喻多種事物相互間結合緊密，渾然一體，難分難解。
explanationEn: To melt in the same furnace; metaphor for blending multiple things into an inseparable whole.
derivation: 卞之琳《冯文炳选集·序》废名在解放前，特别在抗战前，似曾以他独特的方式，把儒释道熔于一炉。”
derivationTraditional: 卞之琳《馮文炳選集·序》廢名在解放前，特別在抗戰前，似曾以他獨特的方式，把儒釋道熔於一爐。”
derivationEn: From Bian Zhilin's preface to 'Selected Works of Feng Wenbing': 'Fei Ming, before the liberation, especially before the Anti-Japanese War, seemed to have blended Confucianism, Buddhism, and Taoism into one furnace in his unique way.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 铁树也叫苏铁，常绿乔木，不常开花。比喻事情非潮见或极难实现。
explanationTraditional: 鐵樹也叫蘇鐵，常綠喬木，不常開花。比喻事情非潮見或極難實現。
explanationEn: Iron tree (sago palm) blooming; metaphor for something extremely rare or very difficult to achieve.
derivation: 明·王济《君子堂日询手镜》吴浙间尝有俗谚云，见事难成，则云须铁树开花。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王濟《君子堂日詢手鏡》吳浙間嘗有俗諺雲，見事難成，則雲鬚鐵樹開花。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Wang Ji's 'Gentleman's Hall Daily Inquiries': 'In Wu and Zhe, there is a common saying: when something is hard to achieve, they say it requires the iron tree to bloom.'
example: 大军抗日渡金沙，铁树要开花。★陈毅《赣南游击词》
exampleTraditional: 大軍抗日渡金沙，鐵樹要開花。★陳毅《贛南遊擊詞》
exampleEn: The army crossed the Jinsha River to resist Japan; the iron tree is about to bloom. — Chen Yi 'Guerrilla Songs in Southern Jiangxi'

explanation: 指文人之间互相看不起。
explanationTraditional: 指文人之間互相看不起。
explanationEn: Literati belittling each other.
derivation: 三国魏·曹丕《典论·论文》文人相轻，自古而然。”
derivationTraditional: 三國魏·曹丕《典論·論文》文人相輕，自古而然。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Wei Cao Pi's 'Discourse on Literature': 'Literati belittling each other has been so since ancient times.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 秦始皇曾下过逐客令，要驱逐从各国来的客卿。泛指主人赶走不受欢迎的客人。
explanationTraditional: 秦始皇曾下過逐客令，要驅逐從各國來的客卿。泛指主人趕走不受歡迎的客人。
explanationEn: To order an unwelcome guest to leave; to show someone the door.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻泄露秘密。
explanationTraditional: 比喻洩露秘密。
explanationEn: To divulge a secret; to let the cat out of the bag.
derivation: 宋·陆游《醉中草书因戏作此》诗稚子问翁新语处，欲言直恐泄天机。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《醉中草書因戲作此》詩稚子問翁新語處，欲言直恐洩天機。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty Lu You's poem 'Writing in Drunkenness, Playing with Calligraphy': 'The child asks where the old man's new words come from; I want to speak but fear revealing heaven's secrets.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 兴办对国家人民有益利的事业，除去各种弊端。
explanationTraditional: 興辦對國家人民有益利的事業，除去各種弊端。
explanationEn: To promote what is beneficial and abolish what is harmful.
derivation: 《管子·君臣下》为民兴利除害，正民之德。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·君臣下》為民興利除害，正民之德。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Lord and Minister II': 'Promote benefits and eliminate harms for the people, correct the people's virtue.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 胡须头发全都白了。指年事以高。
explanationTraditional: 鬍鬚頭髮全都白了。指年事以高。
explanationEn: Beard and hair all white; indicating advanced age.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第二回那太公年近六旬之上，须发皆白，头戴遮尘暖帽，身穿直缝宽衫，腰系皂丝绦，足穿熟皮靴。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第二回那太公年近六旬之上，鬚髮皆白，頭戴遮塵暖帽，身穿直縫寬衫，腰繫皂絲絛，足穿熟皮靴。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 2: 'The old man was nearly sixty, with white beard and hair, wearing a warm hat, a straight-seamed wide gown, a black silk belt, and leather boots.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一眼看不到边际，形容地域十分辽阔。
explanationTraditional: 一眼看不到邊際，形容地域十分遼闊。
explanationEn: Stretching as far as the eye can see; describing a vast expanse.
derivation: 周而复《上海的早晨》第四部在鄱阳湖旁边的一座大山上，太阳刚刚出来，把一望无边的湖水照得金光闪闪。”
derivationTraditional: 周而復《上海的早晨》第四部在鄱陽湖旁邊的一座大山上，太陽剛剛出來，把一望無邊的湖水照得金光閃閃。”
derivationEn: Zhou Erfu, 'Morning in Shanghai', Part 4: 'On a large mountain beside Poyang Lake, the sun had just risen, shining on the boundless lake water, making it glitter.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容妇女的衣着穿戴十分华丽（多指人多的场合）。借指妇女。
explanationTraditional: 形容婦女的衣著穿戴十分華麗（多指人多的場合）。借指婦女。
explanationEn: Describes women's luxurious attire and makeup (often in crowded settings); also refers to women.
derivation: 北周·庾信《春赋》屋里衣香不如花。”唐·李贺《咏怀》诗弹琴看文君，春风吹鬓影。”
derivationTraditional: 北周·庾信《春賦》屋裡衣香不如花。”唐·李賀《詠懷》詩彈琴看文君，春風吹鬢影。”
derivationEn: Northern Zhou Dynasty, Yu Xin, 'Spring Rhapsody': 'The fragrance of clothes indoors is not as good as flowers.' Tang Dynasty, Li He, 'Poem on Feelings': 'Playing the zither, watching Wenjun, spring breeze blows the hair by the temples.'
example: 那红楼画阁，卷上珠帘，二作婵娟，倚栏而望，～，掩映霏微。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第九回
exampleTraditional: 那紅樓畫閣，捲上珠簾，二作嬋娟，倚欄而望，～，掩映霏微。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第九回
exampleEn: In that red mansion with painted pavilions, beaded curtains rolled up, beauties leaning on the railing, their fragrant clothes and shadowy hair faintly visible. — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 9

explanation: 曾经经历过；沧海大海。比喻曾经见过大世面，不把平常事物放在眼里。
explanationTraditional: 曾經經歷過；滄海大海。比喻曾經見過大世面，不把平常事物放在眼裡。
explanationEn: Having experienced great things; not easily impressed by ordinary matters.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》故观于海者难为水，游于圣人之门者难为言。”唐·元稹《离思》诗曾经沧海难为水，除却巫山不是云。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》故觀於海者難為水，遊於聖人之門者難為言。”唐·元稹《離思》詩曾經滄海難為水，除卻巫山不是雲。”
derivationEn: Mencius, 'Jin Xin I': 'One who has seen the ocean finds it difficult to be impressed by rivers; one who has studied under a sage finds it hard to be impressed by ordinary words.' Tang Dynasty, Yuan Zhen, 'Thoughts': 'Having crossed the vast sea, no other water can compare; except for the clouds of Mount Wu, no other clouds are worth seeing.'
example: 老兄是～，车皮底下也呆过三天三夜，这一点挤，而且不过两个钟头，不算什么，算不了什么。★茅盾《一个够程度的人》
exampleTraditional: 老兄是～，車皮底下也呆過三天三夜，這一點擠，而且不過兩個鐘頭，不算什麼，算不了什麼。★茅盾《一個夠程度的人》
exampleEn: Old brother, you have experienced great things and even stayed three days and nights under a train carriage; this little squeeze, and only two hours, is nothing, absolutely nothing. — Mao Dun, 'A Person of Sufficient Level'

explanation: 问津询问渡口，问路。指高贵的、深奥的事物不敢过问或尝试。
explanationTraditional: 問津詢問渡口，問路。指高貴的、深奧的事物不敢過問或嘗試。
explanationEn: Not daring to inquire about or attempt something noble or profound.
derivation: 《论语·微子》长沮、桀溺耦而耕，孔子过之，使子路问津焉。” 唐·宋子问《明河篇》明河可望不可亲，愿得乘槎一问津。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·微子》長沮、桀溺耦而耕，孔子過之，使子路問津焉。” 唐·宋子問《明河篇》明河可望不可親，願得乘槎一問津。”
derivationEn: Analects, 'Weizi': 'Changju and Jieni were plowing together; Confucius passed by and sent Zilu to ask for the ford.' Tang Dynasty, Song Zhiwen, 'Song of the Bright River': 'The bright river can be seen but not approached; I wish to take a raft and ask for the ford.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 处理重大事情的权力落到旁人手里（多指领导人被架空）。
explanationTraditional: 處理重大事情的權力落到旁人手裡（多指領導人被架空）。
explanationEn: Power falls into the hands of others (often referring to a leader being sidelined).
derivation: 明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第十一回借光唬百兽，大权叹旁落。”
derivationTraditional: 明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第十一回借光唬百獸，大權嘆旁落。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Donglu Gu Kuang Sheng, 'Awakening from Drunkenness', Chapter 11: 'Borrowing light to scare the hundred beasts, lamenting that great power has fallen into others' hands.'
example: 现在京里，很有人说亲家的闲话说亲家请了一位洋人做老夫子，～，自己一点事不问。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十八回
exampleTraditional: 現在京裡，很有人說親家的閒話說親家請了一位洋人做老夫子，～，自己一點事不問。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十八回
exampleEn: Now in the capital, many people gossip about your relative, saying he hired a foreign teacher and let power fall into others' hands, not attending to matters himself. — Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats', Chapter 58

explanation: 形容极为慌张。
explanationTraditional: 形容極為慌張。
explanationEn: Extremely flustered and panicked.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十五回萧长贵正在自己兵船上睡觉，忽听得外面一派人声，接着又有洋枪、洋炮声音，拿他从睡梦中惊醒，直把他吓得索索的抖，在被窝里慌作一团。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十五回蕭長貴正在自己兵船上睡覺，忽聽得外面一派人聲，接著又有洋槍、洋炮聲音，拿他從睡夢中驚醒，直把他嚇得索索的抖，在被窩裡慌作一團。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats', Chapter 55: 'Xiao Changgui was sleeping on his warship when he suddenly heard voices outside, followed by gunfire. Awakened from his dream, he trembled with fear and was flustered under the covers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 毁破坏，毁坏；纾缓和，解除。捐献所有家产，帮助国家减轻困难。
explanationTraditional: 毀破壞，毀壞；紓緩和，解除。捐獻所有家產，幫助國家減輕困難。
explanationEn: To donate all family property to help alleviate national difficulties.
derivation: 《左传·庄公三十年》斗穣于菟为令尹，自毁其家以纾楚国之难。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·莊公三十年》鬥穣於菟為令尹，自毀其家以紓楚國之難。”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan, 'Duke Zhuang, 30th Year': 'Dou Guwutu became prime minister and destroyed his own family to relieve the state of Chu's difficulties.'
example: 某等愿从众志，～，兴复宋室。★清·吴趼人《痛史》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 某等願從眾志，～，興復宋室。★清·吳趼人《痛史》第二十五回
exampleEn: We are willing to follow the public will, destroy our families to relieve the state's difficulties, and restore the Song dynasty. — Wu Jianren, 'The Painful History', Chapter 25

explanation: 指长期所形成的错误，往往被当作正确的。
explanationTraditional: 指長期所形成的錯誤，往往被當作正確的。
explanationEn: Long-standing errors are often accepted as correct.
derivation: 清·戴震《孟子字义疏证·原善序》治经之士，莫能综贯，习所见闻，积非成是，余言恐未足以振兹坠绪也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·戴震《孟子字義疏證·原善序》治經之士，莫能綜貫，習所見聞，積非成是，餘言恐未足以振茲墜緒也。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Dai Zhen, 'Preface to the Commentary on Mencius' Words and Meanings': 'Scholars of the classics cannot grasp the whole, accustomed to what they see and hear, errors accumulate and become accepted as correct; my words may not be enough to revive this fallen tradition.'
example: 对于一些早已～、具有广泛群众基础的误读音，就不能太拘泥于语音本身的发展规律。★胡明扬《词典学概论》第七章第二节
exampleTraditional: 對於一些早已～、具有廣泛群眾基礎的誤讀音，就不能太拘泥於語音本身的發展規律。★胡明揚《詞典學概論》第七章第二節
exampleEn: For some mispronunciations that have long been accepted as correct and have a broad public base, one should not be too rigid about the phonetic development itself. — Hu Mingyang, 'Dictionary Studies', Chapter 7, Section 2

explanation: 竭尽，用尽。用尽全部力量。
explanationTraditional: 竭盡，用盡。用盡全部力量。
explanationEn: To exert all one's strength and effort.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·贾逵传》裴松之注引《魏略》竭尽心力，奉宣科法。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·賈逵傳》裴松之注引《魏略》竭盡心力，奉宣科法。”
derivationEn: Records of the Three Kingdoms, 'Wei Shu, Biography of Jia Kui', Pei Songzhi's annotation quoting 'Wei Lue': 'Exerting all his heart and strength to promote and enforce the law.'
example: 所以无人再逢者，当由过去生中原未受恩，故不肯～缩地补天耳。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·槐西杂志四》
exampleTraditional: 所以無人再逢者，當由過去生中原未受恩，故不肯～縮地補天耳。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·槐西雜誌四》
exampleEn: The reason no one meets again is probably because in past lives they did not receive kindness, so they are unwilling to exert all their heart and strength to mend the sky and shorten the earth. — Ji Yun, 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage', 'Huai Xi Magazine', Chapter 4

explanation: 暗中勾结外国，阴谋叛国。
explanationTraditional: 暗中勾結外國，陰謀叛國。
explanationEn: To collude secretly with foreign countries, plotting treason.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文·病后杂谈之余》大则指为‘里通外国’，就是现在之所谓‘汉奸’。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文·病後雜談之餘》大則指為‘裡通外國’，就是現在之所謂‘漢奸’。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun, 'Essays in the Semi-Concession', 'After Illness, Miscellaneous Talks': 'At worst, it was labeled as 'colluding with foreign countries,' which is what is now called 'traitor.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 死灰已冷却的灰烬。原指心境淡漠，毫无情感。现也形容意志消沉，态度冷漠到极点。
explanationTraditional: 死灰已冷卻的灰燼。原指心境淡漠，毫無情感。現也形容意志消沉，態度冷漠到極點。
explanationEn: Heart like dead ashes. Originally meant indifferent and emotionless; now also describes extreme discouragement and apathy.
derivation: 《庄子·齐物论》形固可使如槁木，而心固可使如死灰乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·齊物論》形固可使如槁木，而心固可使如死灰乎？”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi, 'On the Equality of Things': 'The body may be made like withered wood, and the heart like dead ashes.'
example: 我纵然～，也难把往事轻易忘记。★巴金《家》二十
exampleTraditional: 我縱然～，也難把往事輕易忘記。★巴金《家》二十
exampleEn: Even if my heart is like dead ashes, it's hard to easily forget the past. — Ba Jin, 'Family' Chapter 20

explanation: 形容佩服爱幕到极点。同心醉魂迷”。
explanationTraditional: 形容佩服愛幕到極點。同心醉魂迷”。
explanationEn: Describes being infatuated or admiring to the utmost.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指微小而不定的数量。
explanationTraditional: 指微小而不定的數量。
explanationEn: Refers to a tiny and indefinite amount.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第34回倘或不防，前后错了一点半点，不论真假。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第34回倘或不防，前後錯了一點半點，不論真假。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 34: 'If by chance you are not careful, and make a slight mistake, whether true or false...'
example: 沉寂的寒夜，静悄悄已没～风意。★瞿秋白《饿乡纪程》
exampleTraditional: 沉寂的寒夜，靜悄悄已沒～風意。★瞿秋白《餓鄉紀程》
exampleEn: In the silent cold night, there is not a bit of wind. — Qu Qiubai, 'Journey to the Hungry Country'

explanation: 一点没有成就。
explanationTraditional: 一點沒有成就。
explanationEn: Having no achievement at all.
derivation: 清·黄遵楷《跋》读先兄病笃之书，谓平生怀抱，一无所成，惟近古体诗能自立耳。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃遵楷《跋》讀先兄病篤之書，謂平生懷抱，一無所成，惟近古體詩能自立耳。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Huang Zunkai's 'Postscript': 'Reading my late brother's dying letter, he said his lifelong aspirations were all unfulfilled, except for his recent classical poems which could stand on their own.'
example: 而又在外游荡着，～，将如何的伤了祖母、母亲、岳父以及一切亲友的心呢。★郑振铎《离别》
exampleTraditional: 而又在外遊蕩著，～，將如何的傷了祖母、母親、岳父以及一切親友的心呢。★鄭振鐸《離別》
exampleEn: And yet wandering outside, achieving nothing, how it will hurt the hearts of grandmother, mother, father-in-law, and all relatives and friends. — Zheng Zhenduo, 'Parting'

explanation: ①严肃而认真。②形容正大光明。
explanationTraditional: ①嚴肅而認真。②形容正大光明。
explanationEn: ① Serious and earnest. ② Describes being upright and honorable.
derivation: 清·李渔《怜香伴·狂喜》哄我正正经经听了半日，只说当真，原来又是说笑。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《憐香伴·狂喜》哄我正正經經聽了半日，只說當真，原來又是說笑。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Yu's 'Lian Xiang Ban: Ecstasy': 'You fooled me into listening seriously for half a day, thinking it was true, but it turned out to be a joke again.'
example: 你现在能～地当个新中国的人了，还不该高兴吗？★海默《从城里来的姑娘》
exampleTraditional: 你現在能～地當個新中國的人了，還不該高興嗎？★海默《從城裡來的姑娘》
exampleEn: Now you can be a serious new Chinese person, shouldn't you be happy? — Hai Mo, 'The Girl from the City'

explanation: 这里起来，那里下去。形容接连不断。
explanationTraditional: 這裡起來，那裡下去。形容接連不斷。
explanationEn: Here it rises, there it falls. Describes something happening continuously.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十二章远远地传过来隐约的画角声，此伏彼起。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第二十二章遠遠地傳過來隱約的畫角聲，此伏彼起。”
derivationEn: From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 2, Chapter 22: 'Faint bugle sounds came from afar, rising and falling one after another.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 见当耳边风”。当做耳边吹过的风。比喻对所听的话不放在心上。
explanationTraditional: 見當耳邊風”。當做耳邊吹過的風。比喻對所聽的話不放在心上。
explanationEn: Treating words as wind passing the ear. Metaphor for not taking what is heard to heart.
derivation: 语出汉·赵晔《吴越春秋·吴王寿梦传》富贵之於我，如秋风之过耳。”
derivationTraditional: 語出漢·趙曄《吳越春秋·吳王壽夢傳》富貴之於我，如秋風之過耳。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Zhao Ye's 'Wu and Yue Spring and Autumn Annals: King Shoumeng of Wu': 'Wealth and honor to me are like autumn wind passing the ear.'
example: 袭人道‘一百年还记着呢！比不得你，拿着我的话～，夜里说了，早起就忘了。’★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十一
exampleTraditional: 襲人道‘一百年還記著呢！比不得你，拿著我的話～，夜裡說了，早起就忘了。’★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十一
exampleEn: Xiren said, 'I'll remember it for a hundred years! Not like you, who treat my words as wind passing the ear, saying them at night and forgetting them in the morning.' — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 21

explanation: 形容人很幸运，有福气。
explanationTraditional: 形容人很幸運，有福氣。
explanationEn: Describes a person being very lucky and blessed.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十九回管保你这一瞧，就抵得个福星高照。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十九回管保你這一瞧，就抵得個福星高照。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Legend of Heroes', Chapter 39: 'I guarantee that one look from you will be as good as having the star of fortune shining high.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 皓白；首头发；穷经专心研究经书和古籍。一直到年老头白之时还在深入钻研经书和古籍。
explanationTraditional: 皓白；首頭髮；窮經專心研究經書和古籍。一直到年老頭白之時還在深入鑽研經書和古籍。
explanationEn: White-haired, delving into classics. Describes studying classics and ancient texts deeply even into old age.
derivation: 唐·韩偓《赠易卜崔江处士》白首穷经通秘义，青山养老度危时。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓偓《贈易卜崔江處士》白首窮經通秘義，青山養老度危時。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Wo's 'To Yi Bu Cui Jiang Chu Shi': 'White-haired, delving into classics to understand secret meanings; spending old age in green mountains, passing dangerous times.'
example: 青春作赋，～；笔下虽有千言，胸中实无一策。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十三回
exampleTraditional: 青春作賦，～；筆下雖有千言，胸中實無一策。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十三回
exampleEn: Writing rhapsodies in youth, delving into classics in old age; though having thousands of words under the pen, there is no real strategy in the heart. — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 43

explanation: 平阳地势平坦明亮的地方。老虎离开深山，落到平地里受困。比喻失势。
explanationTraditional: 平陽地勢平坦明亮的地方。老虎離開深山，落到平地裡受困。比喻失勢。
explanationEn: Tiger falls on the plain. A tiger leaving the deep mountains and being trapped on flat ground. Metaphor for losing power or influence.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第四回虎落平川被犬欺。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第四回虎落平川被犬欺。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 4: 'A tiger on the plain is bullied by dogs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 能干的人做事多、劳累也多。
explanationTraditional: 能幹的人做事多、勞累也多。
explanationEn: Able people do more work and are more tired.
derivation: 《庄子·列御寇》巧者劳而知（智）者忧，无能者无所求，饱食而敖游。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·列禦寇》巧者勞而知（智）者憂，無能者無所求，飽食而敖遊。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'The skillful are busy, the wise are worried; the incapable have nothing to seek, they eat their fill and roam freely.'
example: 官厅子上，有些同寅见了面，都恭维他～”。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十七回
exampleTraditional: 官廳子上，有些同寅見了面，都恭維他～”。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十七回
exampleEn: In the government office, some colleagues greeted him and praised him as 'able people do more work'. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Chapter 57

explanation: 形容树木枝繁叶茂，可以遮住阳光。
explanationTraditional: 形容樹木枝繁葉茂，可以遮住陽光。
explanationEn: Describes trees with dense foliage that can block sunlight.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指对所学的古代知识理解得不深不透，不善于按现在的情况来运用，跟吃不东西不消化一样。
explanationTraditional: 指對所學的古代知識理解得不深不透，不善於按現在的情況來運用，跟吃不東西不消化一樣。
explanationEn: Refers to learning ancient knowledge without deep understanding, unable to apply it to current situations, like eating without digesting.
derivation: 清·陈撰《玉几山房画外录》卷下载恽向《题自作画册》可见定欲为古人而食古不化，画虎不成、刻舟求剑之类也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·陳撰《玉幾山房畫外錄》卷下載惲向《題自作畫冊》可見定欲為古人而食古不化，畫虎不成、刻舟求劍之類也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Chen Zhuan's 'Yuji Shanfang Painting Notes': 'One who insists on imitating the ancients without digesting their essence is like drawing a tiger that ends up looking like a dog, or carving a mark on a boat to find a lost sword.'
example: 如果不用辩证唯物主义观点去研究古代文化遗产，就会～。
exampleTraditional: 如果不用辯證唯物主義觀點去研究古代文化遺產，就會～。
exampleEn: If we do not use dialectical materialism to study ancient cultural heritage, we will become 'undigested learners of the ancients'.

explanation: 仰依赖；息呼吸时进出的气。依赖别人的呼吸来生活。比喻依赖别人，不能自主。
explanationTraditional: 仰依賴；息呼吸時進出的氣。依賴別人的呼吸來生活。比喻依賴別人，不能自主。
explanationEn: To depend on others for breath; metaphorically, to rely on others and lack autonomy.
derivation: 《后汉书·袁绍传》袁绍孤客穷军，仰我鼻息，譬如婴儿在股掌之上，绝其哺乳，立可饿杀。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·袁紹傳》袁紹孤客窮軍，仰我鼻息，譬如嬰兒在股掌之上，絕其哺乳，立可餓殺。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Yuan Shao': 'Yuan Shao, a lonely guest with a depleted army, depends on my breath like an infant in the palm; cut off its milk, and it will starve to death.'
example: 百年梦，国势弱，叹蹉跎。～，奴才思想奈天何！★陈毅《水调歌头·四游良口》词
exampleTraditional: 百年夢，國勢弱，嘆蹉跎。～，奴才思想奈天何！★陳毅《水調歌頭·四遊良口》詞
exampleEn: A hundred years of dreams, the nation weak, sighing at wasted time. Depending on others' breath, slave mentality, what can be done? — Chen Yi, 'Song of Water Tune: Fourth Visit to Liangkou'

explanation: 泛指人的本性。
explanationTraditional: 泛指人的本性。
explanationEn: Generally refers to human nature, including eating, drinking, and sexual desires.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》饮食男女，人之大欲存焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》飲食男女，人之大欲存焉。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Li Yun': 'Eating, drinking, and sexual desires are among the great desires of humans.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 温复习，指回忆，体味。比喻再经历一次过去的光景。
explanationTraditional: 溫複習，指回憶，體味。比喻再經歷一次過去的光景。
explanationEn: To relive a past experience or scene.
derivation: 清·丘逢甲《岭云每日楼诗钞·重过感旧园二首》诗水木清华负郭园，三年客梦此重温。眼中故物诗留壁，身后浮文酒满樽。”
derivationTraditional: 清·丘逢甲《嶺雲每日樓詩鈔·重過感舊園二首》詩水木清華負郭園，三年客夢此重溫。眼中故物詩留壁，身後浮文酒滿樽。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Qiu Fengjia's poem: 'The beautiful garden near the city, three years of dreams revisited here.'
example: 开始写《第四病室》的时候，因为记忆犹新”，我的确有～”的感觉。★巴金《谈〈第四病室〉》
exampleTraditional: 開始寫《第四病室》的時候，因為記憶猶新”，我的確有～”的感覺。★巴金《談〈第四病室〉》
exampleEn: When I started writing 'The Fourth Ward', because the memory was still fresh, I indeed felt like 'reliving an old dream'. — Ba Jin, 'On 'The Fourth Ward'

explanation: 稽考查。十分荒唐，不可凭信。
explanationTraditional: 稽考查。十分荒唐，不可憑信。
explanationEn: Extremely absurd and unreliable.
derivation: 清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第三回那个神字，原是野蛮世界拿出来哄著愚人的话，如今科学大明，这些荒诞无稽的谬说，那里还能立足呢？”
derivationTraditional: 清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第三回那個神字，原是野蠻世界拿出來哄著愚人的話，如今科學大明，這些荒誕無稽的謬說，那裡還能立足呢？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Lingnan Yuyi Nushi's 'Eastern European Heroines' Chapter 3: 'The concept of gods was originally used to fool the ignorant in savage times; now that science is clear, such absurd and unfounded fallacies can no longer stand.'
example: 对于这种～的传闻，大家都不可相信。
exampleTraditional: 對於這種～的傳聞，大家都不可相信。
exampleEn: No one should believe such absurd and unfounded rumors.

explanation: 指毫无声息，默默无闻，没有名气。
explanationTraditional: 指毫無聲息，默默無聞，沒有名氣。
explanationEn: Refers to being silent, obscure, and without fame.
derivation: 清·钱学伦《语新》上卷虽与予居不远，几年来寂寂无闻。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢學倫《語新》上卷雖與予居不遠，幾年來寂寂無聞。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Qian Xuelun's 'New Words' Volume 1: 'Although he lived not far from me, he remained obscure for years.'
example: 许多人过去有大学问，在社会上有地位，今日却～。★徐特立《读书日记·日本战败的原因》
exampleTraditional: 許多人過去有大學問，在社會上有地位，今日卻～。★徐特立《讀書日記·日本戰敗的原因》
exampleEn: Many people who were once learned and held high social status are now obscure. — Xu Teli, 'Reading Diary: Reasons for Japan's Defeat'

explanation: 大小都没有遗漏。
explanationTraditional: 大小都沒有遺漏。
explanationEn: Nothing, big or small, is omitted.
derivation: 冯骥才、李定兴《义和拳》然后急不可待地像倒水一般，把所知道的一切，巨细无遗地告诉给刘黑塔他们。”
derivationTraditional: 馮驥才、李定興《義和拳》然後急不可待地像倒水一般，把所知道的一切，鉅細無遺地告訴給劉黑塔他們。”
derivationEn: From Feng Jicai and Li Dingxing's 'Boxer Rebellion': 'Then, impatiently, like pouring water, he told Liu Heita and the others everything he knew, leaving nothing out, big or small.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻贤者择主而事。
explanationTraditional: 比喻賢者擇主而事。
explanationEn: Metaphor for a wise person choosing the right master to serve.
derivation: 《左传·哀公十一年》鸟则择木，木岂能择鸟。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·哀公十一年》鳥則擇木，木豈能擇鳥。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Ai's 11th Year': 'Birds choose their trees; how can a tree choose its birds?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指聚集山林反抗封建统治阶级的人们。旧时也指聚众行劫的群盗股匪。
explanationTraditional: 指聚集山林反抗封建統治階級的人們。舊時也指聚眾行劫的群盜股匪。
explanationEn: Refers to people who gather in the mountains to resist the feudal ruling class, or bandits who rob in groups.
derivation: 《后汉书·刘玄传》王莽末，南方饥馑，人庶群入野泽，掘凫芘而食之，更相侵夺。……于是诸亡命马武、王常、成丹等往从之；共攻离乡聚，臧于绿林中，数月间至七八千人。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·劉玄傳》王莽末，南方饑饉，人庶群入野澤，掘鳧芘而食之，更相侵奪。……於是諸亡命馬武、王常、成丹等往從之；共攻離鄉聚，臧於綠林中，數月間至七八千人。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Liu Xuan': At the end of Wang Mang's reign, there was famine in the south, and people flocked to the wild marshes to dig for edible plants, fighting over them. Then fugitives like Ma Wu, Wang Chang, and Cheng Dan joined them, attacking villages and hiding in the Green Forest, gathering thousands in a few months.
example: 收了无数的～，查拿海寇。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十一回
exampleTraditional: 收了無數的～，查拿海寇。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十一回
exampleEn: They recruited countless 'greenwood heroes' to hunt down pirates. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 21

explanation: 指人是有思想感情的，容易为外界事物所打动，不同于无生命、无知觉、无感情的树木石头。同人非木石”。
explanationTraditional: 指人是有思想感情的，容易為外界事物所打動，不同於無生命、無知覺、無感情的樹木石頭。同人非木石”。
explanationEn: Means that humans have thoughts and feelings and are easily moved by external things, unlike inanimate, unconscious, and unfeeling plants and stones.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第十七回众人道‘上复观察，小人们人非草木，岂不省的？’”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第十七回眾人道‘上覆觀察，小人們人非草木，豈不省的？’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 17: The crowd said, 'We are not plants or stones; how could we not understand?'
example: 庞涓复问曰‘然则兄长亦还忆故乡坟墓否？’膑曰‘～，能忘本原？’先生于吾临行，亦言‘功名终在故土。　★《东周列国志》第八十八回
exampleTraditional: 龐涓復問曰‘然則兄長亦還憶故鄉墳墓否？’臏曰‘～，能忘本原？’先生於吾臨行，亦言‘功名終在故土。　★《東周列國志》第八十八回
exampleEn: Pang Juan asked again, 'Then does my elder brother still remember his hometown and ancestral graves?' Sun Bin replied, 'Humans are not plants or stones; how could they forget their origins?' When I left, my teacher also said, 'Your fame will ultimately be in your homeland.' — 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 88

explanation: 自若如常，象原来的样子。神情脸色毫无异样。形容态度镇静。
explanationTraditional: 自若如常，象原來的樣子。神情臉色毫無異樣。形容態度鎮靜。
explanationEn: Describes a calm and composed demeanor, with no change in expression, showing self-possession.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·任诞》文王曰‘嗣宗毁顿如此，君不能共忧之，何谓？且有疾而饮酒食肉，固丧礼也。’籍饮啖不辍，神色自若。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·任誕》文王曰‘嗣宗毀頓如此，君不能共憂之，何謂？且有疾而飲酒食肉，固喪禮也。’籍飲啖不輟，神色自若。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Song, Liu Yiqing, 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Unrestrained': Prince Wen said, 'Ji Kang is so distressed, how can you not share his sorrow? And it is proper to drink and eat meat during mourning.' Ji Kang continued eating and drinking, his expression unchanged.
example: 裘副主委一个个听汇报，手在小本子上作记录。现在他～，脸上已一点也没有不自然的神情了。★徐迟《真迹》
exampleTraditional: 裘副主委一個個聽彙報，手在小本子上作記錄。現在他～，臉上已一點也沒有不自然的神情了。★徐遲《真跡》
exampleEn: Deputy Director Qiu listened to each report, taking notes in his small notebook. Now he was calm and composed, with no trace of awkwardness on his face. — Xu Chi, 'The Authentic Work'

explanation: 五味酸甜苦辣咸的合称。形容调味齐全适宜。
explanationTraditional: 五味酸甜苦辣鹹的合稱。形容調味齊全適宜。
explanationEn: Refers to all five flavors (sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, salty) being present, indicating well-seasoned food.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》五味六和，十二食，还相为质也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》五味六和，十二食，還相為質也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: The Conveyance of Rites': The five flavors and six harmonies, and the twelve foods, each returning to its essence.
example: 大人你明如镜，清似水，照妾身肝胆虚实，那羹本～。★元·关汉卿《窦娥冤》第二折
exampleTraditional: 大人你明如鏡，清似水，照妾身肝膽虛實，那羹本～。★元·關漢卿《竇娥冤》第二折
exampleEn: My lord, you are as bright as a mirror and as clear as water, seeing the truth of my heart. That soup had all five flavors. — Yuan Dynasty, Guan Hanqing, 'The Injustice to Dou E', Act 2

explanation: 晓使人明白。把道理对人讲清楚。
explanationTraditional: 曉使人明白。把道理對人講清楚。
explanationEn: Means to explain the principles clearly to someone, making them understand the righteousness of the matter.
derivation: 吴玉章《从甲午战争前后到辛亥革命前后的回忆》第十四篇林时爽误信其中颇有党人，合欲晓以大义。”
derivationTraditional: 吳玉章《從甲午戰爭前後到辛亥革命前後的回憶》第十四篇林時爽誤信其中頗有黨人，合欲曉以大義。”
derivationEn: From Wu Yuzhang, 'Memories from Before and After the Sino-Japanese War to the Xinhai Revolution', Chapter 14: Lin Shiwu mistakenly believed there were party members among them and wanted to explain the great principles to them.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 语言语，也指文句。语句平淡，没有令人震惊的地方。
explanationTraditional: 語言語，也指文句。語句平淡，沒有令人震驚的地方。
explanationEn: Describes language or writing that is plain and unremarkable, not startling.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《江上值水如海势聊短述》诗为人性僻耽佳句，语不惊人死不休。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《江上值水如海勢聊短述》詩為人性僻耽佳句，語不驚人死不休。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Du Fu, 'A Short Poem on the River': 'I have a peculiar love for fine phrases, and will not rest until my words startle.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 黄龙即黄龙府，辖地在今吉林一带，为金人的腹了。一直打到黄龙府。指捣毁敌人的巢穴。
explanationTraditional: 黃龍即黃龍府，轄地在今吉林一帶，為金人的腹了。一直打到黃龍府。指搗毀敵人的巢穴。
explanationEn: Means to directly attack the enemy's stronghold or headquarters.
derivation: 《宋史·岳飞传》金将军韩常欲以五万众内附。飞大喜，语其下曰‘直抵黄龙府，与诸君痛饮尔！’”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·岳飛傳》金將軍韓常欲以五萬眾內附。飛大喜，語其下曰‘直抵黃龍府，與諸君痛飲爾！’”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Yue Fei': General Han Chang of Jin wanted to surrender with 50,000 troops. Yue Fei was overjoyed and said to his men, 'Let's go straight to Huanglong Prefecture and drink together!'
example: ～君莫懈，福星高照古神州。★吴玉章《和印泉老兄七七”三年抗战纪念感赋原韵》
exampleTraditional: ～君莫懈，福星高照古神州。★吳玉章《和印泉老兄七七”三年抗戰紀念感賦原韻》
exampleEn: Do not slack in directly attacking the enemy's lair; the lucky star shines high over ancient China. — Wu Yuzhang, 'Harmonizing with Elder Brother Yinchuan's Original Rhyme on the Third Anniversary of the War of Resistance'

explanation: 指客居异地又逢夜雨缠绵的孤寂情景。
explanationTraditional: 指客居異地又逢夜雨纏綿的孤寂情景。
explanationEn: Describes the lonely scene of being in a foreign land on a rainy night, often evoking melancholy.
derivation: 唐·李商隐《夜雨寄北》君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池∥当共剪西窗烛，却说巴山夜雨时。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李商隱《夜雨寄北》君問歸期未有期，巴山夜雨漲秋池∥當共剪西窗燭，卻說巴山夜雨時。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Shangyin, 'Written on a Rainy Night to My Wife in the North': 'You ask when I will return, but I have no fixed date; the night rain in the Ba Mountains swells the autumn pond. When shall we together trim the candle by the west window, and talk of the night rain in the Ba Mountains?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 薪柴草。抱着柴草去救火。比喻用错误的方法去消除灾祸，结果使灾祸反而扩大。
explanationTraditional: 薪柴草。抱著柴草去救火。比喻用錯誤的方法去消除災禍，結果使災禍反而擴大。
explanationEn: Means to use the wrong method to solve a problem, making it worse.
derivation: 《史记·魏世家》且夫以地事秦，譬犹抱薪救火，薪不尽，火不灭。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魏世家》且夫以地事秦，譬猶抱薪救火，薪不盡，火不滅。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Hereditary House of Wei': 'Giving land to appease Qin is like carrying firewood to put out a fire; the fire will not stop until the wood is exhausted.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 长歌长声歌咏，也指写诗；当当作。用长声歌咏或写诗文来代替痛哭，借以抒发心中的悲愤。
explanationTraditional: 長歌長聲歌詠，也指寫詩；噹噹作。用長聲歌詠或寫詩文來代替痛哭，藉以抒發心中的悲憤。
explanationEn: Means to express grief through singing or writing poetry instead of crying.
derivation: 宋·郭茂倩《乐府诗集·杂曲歌辞·悲歌》悲歌可以当泣，远望可以当归。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·郭茂倩《樂府詩集·雜曲歌辭·悲歌》悲歌可以當泣，遠望可以當歸。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Guo Maoqian, 'Collection of Yuefu Poems: Miscellaneous Songs: Sad Song': 'A sad song can serve as weeping; gazing into the distance can serve as returning home.'
example: 感怀触绪，聊赋四章，匪曰无故呻吟，亦～之意耳。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第八十七回
exampleTraditional: 感懷觸緒，聊賦四章，匪曰無故呻吟，亦～之意耳。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第八十七回
exampleEn: Moved by emotions, I wrote four stanzas, not to moan without reason, but to express my grief through song. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 87

explanation: 东风春风。指吹着强劲的春风。形容春风吹拂大地，大地即将万象更新，面貌焕然。
explanationTraditional: 東風春風。指吹著強勁的春風。形容春風吹拂大地，大地即將萬象更新，面貌煥然。
explanationEn: The east wind is mighty. Describes a strong spring wind blowing across the land, heralding renewal and a fresh appearance.
derivation: 唐·李咸用《春日》浩荡东风里，裴回无所亲。危城三面水，古树一边春。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李鹹用《春日》浩蕩東風裡，裴回無所親。危城三面水，古樹一邊春。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Xianyong's 'Spring Day': 'In the mighty east wind, I wander without close kin. The dangerous city is surrounded by water on three sides, ancient trees have spring on one side.'
example: 宋·陆游《剑南诗稿·感兴》一尊且作寻春汁，又见东风～时。”
exampleTraditional: 宋·陸游《劍南詩稿·感興》一尊且作尋春汁，又見東風～時。”
exampleEn: Song Dynasty, Lu You's 'Jiannan Poetry Draft: Feeling Inspired': 'A cup of wine for seeking spring, again see the east wind mighty time.'

explanation: 表示决心从侵略者手中夺回本属于自己的国土。
explanationTraditional: 表示決心從侵略者手中奪回本屬於自己的國土。
explanationEn: Expresses determination to reclaim one's own territory from invaders.
derivation: 宋·赵与时《宾退录》第五卷徽宗尝梦吴越钱王引徽宗御衣云‘我好来朝，便终于还我河山。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·趙與時《賓退錄》第五卷徽宗嘗夢吳越錢王引徽宗御衣雲‘我好來朝，便終於還我河山。’”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhao Yushi's 'Bin Tui Lu', Volume 5: 'Emperor Huizong once dreamed that King Qian of Wuyue pulled his imperial robe and said, 'I came to court, so finally return my rivers and mountains to me.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 黄发老年人头发由白转黄；垂髫古时单童子未冠者头发下垂。指老人与儿童。
explanationTraditional: 黃髮老年人頭髮由白轉黃；垂髫古時單童子未冠者頭髮下垂。指老人與兒童。
explanationEn: Yellow hair (old people whose hair turns from white to yellow) and hanging hair (children in ancient times with hair hanging down). Refers to the elderly and children.
derivation: 《诗经·鲁颂·閟宫》黄发台背。”晋·潘岳《藉田赋》垂髫总发。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·魯頌·閟宮》黃髮臺背。”晉·潘岳《藉田賦》垂髫總髮。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Lu Song: Bi Gong': 'Yellow hair and hunched back.' Jin Dynasty, Pan Yue's 'Ji Tian Fu': 'Hanging hair and loose hair.'
example: 男女衣著，悉如外人；～，并怡然自乐。★晋·陶潜《桃花源诗并记》
exampleTraditional: 男女衣著，悉如外人；～，並怡然自樂。★晉·陶潛《桃花源詩並記》
exampleEn: Men and women dressed like outsiders; yellow hair and hanging hair, all happy and content. ★ Jin Dynasty, Tao Qian's 'Peach Blossom Spring and Its Poem'

explanation: 古代传说，殷纣以酒为池，以肉为林，为长夜之饮。原指荒淫腐化、极端奢侈的生活，后也形容酒肉极多。
explanationTraditional: 古代傳說，殷紂以酒為池，以肉為林，為長夜之飲。原指荒淫腐化、極端奢侈的生活，後也形容酒肉極多。
explanationEn: Ancient legend says King Zhou of Yin made a pool of wine and a forest of meat for all-night drinking. Originally refers to decadent, luxurious life; later also describes an abundance of wine and meat.
derivation: 《史记·殷本纪》以酒为池，悬肉为林。”《汉书·张骞传》行赏赐，酒池肉林。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·殷本紀》以酒為池，懸肉為林。”《漢書·張騫傳》行賞賜，酒池肉林。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Yin Benji': 'Made a pool of wine and hung meat as a forest.' 'Book of Han: Zhang Qian Biography': 'Gave rewards, with a pool of wine and a forest of meat.'
example: 纣王听信妲己，造～，一无忌惮，朝纲不整，任意荒淫。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第十七回
exampleTraditional: 紂王聽信妲己，造～，一無忌憚，朝綱不整，任意荒淫。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第十七回
exampleEn: King Zhou listened to Daji, created a pool of wine and a forest of meat, without restraint, neglecting court affairs and indulging in debauchery. ★ Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 17

explanation: 举动不俗气，不做作。形容人行为动作不拘束，堂堂正正。
explanationTraditional: 舉動不俗氣，不做作。形容人行為動作不拘束，堂堂正正。
explanationEn: Behaving without vulgarity or affectation. Describes a person's actions as unrestrained and dignified.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第二十一回若是正经的女子，见了人一样，不见人也是一样，举止大方，不轻言笑的，那怕他在街上走路，又碍甚么呢？”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第二十一回若是正經的女子，見了人一樣，不見人也是一樣，舉止大方，不輕言笑的，那怕他在街上走路，又礙甚麼呢？”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 21: 'If a proper woman behaves the same whether seen or not, with dignified manners and not given to frivolous talk, even if she walks on the street, what harm is there?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 三元科举制度称乡试、会试、殿试的第一名为解元、会元、状元，合称三元”。接连在乡试、会试、殿试中考中了第一名。
explanationTraditional: 三元科舉制度稱鄉試、會試、殿試的第一名為解元、會元、狀元，合稱三元”。接連在鄉試、會試、殿試中考中了第一名。
explanationEn: Three yuan: the first place in the provincial examination (jieyuan), metropolitan examination (huiyuan), and palace examination (zhuangyuan). Consecutively winning first place in all three exams.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十八论他的志气，便象冯京商辂连中三元，也只算他便袋里东西，真个是足蹑风云，气冲斗牛。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十八論他的志氣，便象馮京商輅連中三元，也只算他便袋裡東西，真個是足躡風雲，氣衝斗牛。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 18: 'Considering his ambition, even if he won three yuan in a row like Feng Jing and Shang Lu, it would be like something in his bag, truly treading wind and clouds, spirit soaring to the Dipper and Ox.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 身体前后晃动。形容大笑或困倦得直不起腰的样子。
explanationTraditional: 身體前後晃動。形容大笑或睏倦得直不起腰的樣子。
explanationEn: Body swaying forward and backward. Describes laughing so hard or being so sleepy that one cannot stand straight.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 太阳升起有三根竹竿那样高。形容太阳升得很高，时间不早了。也形容人起床太晚。
explanationTraditional: 太陽昇起有三根竹竿那樣高。形容太陽昇得很高，時間不早了。也形容人起床太晚。
explanationEn: The sun has risen as high as three bamboo poles. Describes the sun being high, indicating it is late in the day. Also describes someone getting up very late.
derivation: 《南齐书·天文志上》永明五年十一月丁亥，日出高三竿，朱色赤黄。”唐·韩愈《岁华纪丽》卷一日上三竿。古诗云日上三竿风露消。”
derivationTraditional: 《南齊書·天文志上》永明五年十一月丁亥，日出高三竿，硃色赤黃。”唐·韓愈《歲華紀麗》卷一日上三竿。古詩云日上三竿風露消。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Southern Qi: Astronomy Part 1': 'On the day of Dinghai in the eleventh month of the fifth year of Yongming, the sun rose three poles high, with a red color.' Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Sui Hua Ji Li', Volume 1: 'Sun three poles high. An ancient poem says: Sun three poles high, wind and dew fade.'
example: 及～，方有旨意出来道朕心不快，众官免朝。”★明·吴承恩《西游记》第十回
exampleTraditional: 及～，方有旨意出來道朕心不快，眾官免朝。”★明·吳承恩《西遊記》第十回
exampleEn: When the sun was three poles high, an imperial decree came: 'My heart is unwell, all officials are excused from court.' ★ Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 10

explanation: 原指生硬搬用别人诗文的词句。现比喻生硬地接受或机械的搬用经验、理论等。
explanationTraditional: 原指生硬搬用別人詩文的詞句。現比喻生硬地接受或機械的搬用經驗、理論等。
explanationEn: Originally meant to forcibly borrow phrases from others' poetry. Now metaphorically describes mechanically accepting or copying experiences, theories, etc.
derivation: 唐·刘肃《大唐新语·谱谑》有枣强尉张怀庆，好偷名士文章，人为之谚云‘活剥王昌龄，生吞郭正一。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉肅《大唐新語·譜謔》有棗強尉張懷慶，好偷名士文章，人為之諺雲‘活剝王昌齡，生吞郭正一。’”
