derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Liu Su's 'New Anecdotes of the Great Tang: Humor': 'There was Zhang Huaiqing, the magistrate of Zaoqiang, who liked to steal famous scholars' writings. People made a proverb: 'Skin Wang Changling alive, swallow Guo Zhengyi raw.''
example: 他们从欧美日本回来，只知～地谈外国。★毛泽东《改造我们的学习》
exampleTraditional: 他們從歐美日本回來，只知～地談外國。★毛澤東《改造我們的學習》
exampleEn: They returned from Europe, America, and Japan, only knowing how to talk about foreign things by swallowing them raw and skinning them alive. ★ Mao Zedong's 'Reform Our Study'

explanation: 国家小，人民少。
explanationTraditional: 國家小，人民少。
explanationEn: A small state with few people.
derivation: 《老子》小国寡民，使有什伯之器而不用，使民重死而不远徙。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》小國寡民，使有什伯之器而不用，使民重死而不遠徙。”
derivationEn: 'Laozi': 'A small state with few people, so that even though there are various tools, they are not used; the people value their lives and do not move far away.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 许预先答应给与。把身体献给国家。指尽忠报国，临难不顾。
explanationTraditional: 許預先答應給與。把身體獻給國家。指盡忠報國，臨難不顧。
explanationEn: To dedicate oneself to the service of the country, ready to sacrifice one's life for the nation.
derivation: 《南史·羊侃传》久以汝为死，犹在邪？吾以身许国，誓死行阵，终不以尔而生进退。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·羊侃傳》久以汝為死，猶在邪？吾以身許國，誓死行陣，終不以爾而生進退。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Southern Dynasties: Biography of Yang Kan': 'I have long thought you dead, yet you still live? I have dedicated myself to the country, vowing to die in battle, and will not let you affect my advance or retreat.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 罢黜废弃不用。原指排除诸子杂说，专门推行儒家学说。也比喻只要一种形式，不要其他形式。
explanationTraditional: 罷黜廢棄不用。原指排除諸子雜說，專門推行儒家學說。也比喻只要一種形式，不要其他形式。
explanationEn: Originally meant to reject all other schools of thought and exclusively promote Confucianism; now also used metaphorically to mean allowing only one form and excluding others.
derivation: 《汉书·武帝纪赞》孝武初立，卓然罢黜百家，表章《六经》。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·武帝紀贊》孝武初立，卓然罷黜百家，表章《六經》。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Emperor Wu': 'When Emperor Wu first ascended the throne, he distinctly rejected the hundred schools and honored the Six Classics.'
example: ……只认朗诵词和诗。笔者却不能够赞成这～”的作风★朱自清《论朗诵诗》
exampleTraditional: ……只認朗誦詞和詩。筆者卻不能夠贊成這～”的作風★朱自清《論朗誦詩》
exampleEn: ...only recognizing recitation and poetry. The author cannot agree with this 'rejecting all other schools' style. ★ Zhu Ziqing, 'On Recitation Poetry'

explanation: 堑壕沟。长江为天然的坑堑、险要。旧时形容长江地势险要，不可逾越。
explanationTraditional: 塹壕溝。長江為天然的坑塹、險要。舊時形容長江地勢險要，不可逾越。
explanationEn: The Yangtze River as a natural moat, historically describing its strategic and impassable nature.
derivation: 《南史·孙范传》隋师将济江，群官请为备防，范奏曰‘长江天堑，古来险隔，虏军岂能飞渡？’”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·孫範傳》隋師將濟江，群官請為備防，範奏曰‘長江天塹，古來險隔，虜軍豈能飛渡？’”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Southern Dynasties: Biography of Sun Fan': 'When the Sui army was about to cross the river, officials requested preparations. Sun Fan memorialized: 'The Yangtze River is a natural moat, a barrier since ancient times. How could the enemy troops fly across?''
example: 占据江南八郡，隔着～，双比淮西差多少来去。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第一百十回
exampleTraditional: 佔據江南八郡，隔著～，雙比淮西差多少來去。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第一百十回
exampleEn: Occupying the eight southern prefectures, separated by the Yangtze River natural moat, how much difference is there from Huai Xi? ★ Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 110

explanation: 熹微天色微明。早上天色微明。
explanationTraditional: 熹微天色微明。早上天色微明。
explanationEn: The dim light of early morning; daybreak.
derivation: 晋·陶潜《归去来辞》问征夫以前路，恨晨光之熹微。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陶潛《歸去來辭》問征夫以前路，恨晨光之熹微。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Tao Qian's 'Returning Home': 'I asked the traveler about the road ahead, regretting that the morning light was so dim.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 呆呆板，不灵活。形容思想、行动迟钝笨拙。
explanationTraditional: 呆呆板，不靈活。形容思想、行動遲鈍笨拙。
explanationEn: Stupid and dull; describing someone slow and clumsy in thought and action.
derivation: 元·马致远《岳阳楼》第三折似这等呆脑呆头劝不回，呸！可不干赚了我奔走红尘九千里。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《岳陽樓》第三折似這等呆腦呆頭勸不回，呸！可不幹賺了我奔走紅塵九千里。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan's 'Yueyang Tower', Act 3: 'Such a dull-witted person cannot be persuaded, bah! I have wasted my efforts traveling nine thousand miles in the mortal world.'
example: 小凤仙的脾气，人家说她不合时宜，其实她也是～，不惯作妓女腔，与人不合。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第五十一回
exampleTraditional: 小鳳仙的脾氣，人家說她不合時宜，其實她也是～，不慣作妓女腔，與人不合。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第五十一回
exampleEn: Xiao Fengxian's temper was said to be out of step with the times. Actually, she was also dull-witted, unaccustomed to acting like a prostitute, and did not get along with others. ★ Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 51

explanation: 心里完全愿意，没有一点勉强。多指自愿作出某种牺牲。
explanationTraditional: 心裡完全願意，沒有一點勉強。多指自願作出某種犧牲。
explanationEn: Completely willing, without any reluctance; often refers to voluntary sacrifice.
derivation: 宋·王明清《摭青杂说·项四郎》此事儿甘心情愿也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王明清《摭青雜說·項四郎》此事兒甘心情願也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Wang Mingqing's 'Miscellaneous Stories of Zhiqing: Xiang Silang': 'This matter is my willing choice.'
example: 还必须使全国广大人民群众觉悟，～和我们一起奋斗，去争取胜利。★毛泽东《愚公移山》
exampleTraditional: 還必須使全國廣大人民群眾覺悟，～和我們一起奮鬥，去爭取勝利。★毛澤東《愚公移山》
exampleEn: It is also necessary to make the broad masses of the people throughout the country conscious and willing to strive together with us for victory. ★ Mao Zedong, 'The Foolish Old Man Removes the Mountains'

explanation: 形容事情或说话十分可笑。
explanationTraditional: 形容事情或說話十分可笑。
explanationEn: Describing something extremely ridiculous or laughable.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第二回最令人喷饭的，那小耗子又要舞，又怕猫，躲躲藏藏，贼头贼脑，任他装出斯文样子，终失不了偷油的身分。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第二回最令人噴飯的，那小耗子又要舞，又怕貓，躲躲藏藏，賊頭賊腦，任他裝出斯文樣子，終失不了偷油的身分。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 2: 'The most laughable thing was that the little mouse wanted to dance but was afraid of the cat, hiding and peeping, no matter how it pretended to be refined, it could not lose its identity as a oil thief.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一着下棋时下一子或走一步。棋艺高人一步。也比喻技高一等。
explanationTraditional: 一著下棋時下一子或走一步。棋藝高人一步。也比喻技高一等。
explanationEn: To be superior in chess skills; also metaphorically means to be one step ahead in skill or strategy.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二正所谓‘棋高一着，缚手缚脚’。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二正所謂‘棋高一著，縛手縛腳’。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 2: 'As the saying goes, 'If your opponent is one move better, you are tied hand and foot.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 青面脸上泛着青色；獠牙露在外面的长牙。旧时神怪故事中形容凶神恶鬼的面貌。现形容人面貌极其凶恶。
explanationTraditional: 青面臉上泛著青色；獠牙露在外面的長牙。舊時神怪故事中形容凶神惡鬼的面貌。現形容人面貌極其兇惡。
explanationEn: Green-faced and long-toothed; originally describing ferocious gods and demons in myths, now used to describe a person's extremely fierce appearance.
derivation: 明·张岱《水浒牌序》吴道子画地狱变相，青面獠牙，尽化作一团清气。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張岱《水滸牌序》吳道子畫地獄變相，青面獠牙，盡化作一團清氣。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Zhang Dai's 'Preface to Water Margin Cards': 'When Wu Daozi painted the hell transformation, the green-faced and long-toothed all turned into a mass of clear air.'
example: 子牙见对营门一人，三首六臂，～。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: 子牙見對營門一人，三首六臂，～。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第六十三回
exampleEn: Ziya saw a man at the enemy camp gate with three heads, six arms, green face, and long teeth. ★ Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 63

explanation: 成成全；仁仁爱，儒家道德的最高标准。指为正义而牺牲生命◇泛指为了维护正义事业而舍弃自己的生命。
explanationTraditional: 成成全；仁仁愛，儒家道德的最高標準。指為正義而犧牲生命◇泛指為了維護正義事業而捨棄自己的生命。
explanationEn: To sacrifice one's life for righteousness; generally refers to giving up one's life to uphold a just cause.
derivation: 《论语·卫灵公》志士仁人，无求生以害仁，有杀身以成仁。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·衛靈公》志士仁人，無求生以害仁，有殺身以成仁。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Wei Ling Gong': 'A determined scholar and a humane person will not seek to live at the expense of benevolence, but will sacrifice themselves to achieve benevolence.'
example: 若得着死难者的热情的全部，便可以追他们的踪迹，～了。★闻一多《文艺与爱国——纪念三月十八》
exampleTraditional: 若得著死難者的熱情的全部，便可以追他們的蹤跡，～了。★聞一多《文藝與愛國——紀念三月十八》
exampleEn: If one can grasp the full passion of those who died for the cause, one can follow their footsteps and sacrifice oneself for righteousness. ★ Wen Yiduo, 'Literature and Patriotism: Commemorating March 18'

explanation: 形容技艺或手法十分高明。
explanationTraditional: 形容技藝或手法十分高明。
explanationEn: Describes extremely superb skills or techniques.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容心里有事，吃东西也不香。同食不甘味”。
explanationTraditional: 形容心裡有事，吃東西也不香。同食不甘味”。
explanationEn: Describes being so preoccupied that one cannot enjoy food; same as '食不甘味'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指周文王、周武王治理国家的方法。
explanationTraditional: 指周文王、周武王治理國家的方法。
explanationEn: Refers to the governance methods of King Wen and King Wu of Zhou.
derivation: 先秦·孔子《论语·子张》文武之道未坠于地，在人，贤者识其大者。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·孔子《論語·子張》文武之道未墜於地，在人，賢者識其大者。”
derivationEn: Pre-Qin, Confucius, The Analects: 'The way of Wen and Wu has not fallen to the ground; it is in men. The wise remember its great principles.'
example: ～，厥猷未坠。★晋·应贞《晋武帝华林园集诗》
exampleTraditional: ～，厥猷未墜。★晉·應貞《晉武帝華林園集詩》
exampleEn: The way of Wen and Wu, their plans have not fallen. (Jin Dynasty, Ying Zhen, Poem for the Jin Wudi Huayuan Garden Gathering)

explanation: 比喻政治与军事。
explanationTraditional: 比喻政治與軍事。
explanationEn: Metaphor for political and military achievements.
derivation: 《礼记·祭法》文王以文治，武王以武治，去民之灾，比皆有功烈于民者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·祭法》文王以文治，武王以武治，去民之災，比皆有功烈於民者也。”
derivationEn: Book of Rites, Sacrificial Methods: 'King Wen governed with culture, King Wu with military, removing calamities from the people, both had great merits among the people.'
example: 唐太宗雄才大略，～都有辉煌的成就。
exampleTraditional: 唐太宗雄才大略，～都有輝煌的成就。
exampleEn: Emperor Taizong of Tang was a man of great talent and bold vision, with brilliant achievements in both civil and military affairs.

explanation: 修建桥梁，补好道路。旧喻热心公益，解囊行善。
explanationTraditional: 修建橋樑，補好道路。舊喻熱心公益，解囊行善。
explanationEn: Building bridges and repairing roads; old metaphor for being philanthropic and doing good deeds.
derivation: 元·无名氏《看钱奴》第一折我贾仁也会斋僧布施，盖寺建塔，修桥补路，惜孤念寡，敬老怜贫。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《看錢奴》第一折我賈仁也會齋僧佈施，蓋寺建塔，修橋補路，惜孤念寡，敬老憐貧。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, The Miser: 'I, Jia Ren, also give alms to monks, build temples and pagodas, repair bridges and roads, pity the orphaned and widowed, and respect the old and pity the poor.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一点踪迹都没有。谓不知去向。
explanationTraditional: 一點蹤跡都沒有。謂不知去向。
explanationEn: No trace at all; indicating that someone or something has disappeared without a trace.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第四十三回李逵叫娘吃水，杳无踪迹，叫了几声不应。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第四十三回李逵叫娘吃水，杳無蹤跡，叫了幾聲不應。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, Water Margin, Chapter 43: 'Li Kui called for his mother to drink water, but there was no trace; he called several times but got no response.'
example: 四面搜寻，～。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 四面搜尋，～。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第二十二回
exampleEn: Searching all around, there was no trace. (Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, A Short History of Civilization, Chapter 22)

explanation: 闻见闻。形容知识丰富，记忆力强。
explanationTraditional: 聞見聞。形容知識豐富，記憶力強。
explanationEn: Having extensive knowledge and a strong memory.
derivation: 《荀子·解蔽》博闻强志，不合王制，君子贱之。”《礼记·曲礼上》博闻强识而让，敦善行而不怠，谓之君子。”《史记·屈原贾生列传》博闻强志，明于治乱，娴于辞令。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·解蔽》博聞強志，不合王制，君子賤之。”《禮記·曲禮上》博聞強識而讓，敦善行而不怠，謂之君子。”《史記·屈原賈生列傳》博聞強志，明於治亂，嫻於辭令。”
derivationEn: Xunzi, Dispelling Blindness: 'Broad learning and strong memory, but not in line with the king's system, the gentleman despises it.' Book of Rites, Qu Li I: 'Broad learning and strong memory, yet humble; doing good diligently without tiring, that is a gentleman.' Records of the Grand Historian, Biography of Qu Yuan and Jia Yi: 'Broad learning and strong memory, well-versed in governance and chaos, skilled in rhetoric.'
example: 粲～，人皆不及。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十回
exampleTraditional: 粲～，人皆不及。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十回
exampleEn: Wang Can was broad in learning and strong in memory, which others could not match. (Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, Romance of the Three Kingdoms, Chapter 40)

explanation: 猖獗凶猛而放肆。形容坏人或反动势力一时间显得特别凶猛放肆。
explanationTraditional: 猖獗兇猛而放肆。形容壞人或反動勢力一時間顯得特別兇猛放肆。
explanationEn: Describes evil forces or people being particularly fierce and rampant for a period of time.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 每天的早晨和黄昏，指短暂的时间。
explanationTraditional: 每天的早晨和黃昏，指短暫的時間。
explanationEn: Every morning and evening; refers to a short period of time.
derivation: 战国·楚·宋玉《高唐赋》妾在巫山之阳，高丘之阻，旦为朝云，暮为行雨。朝朝暮暮，阳台之下。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·宋玉《高唐賦》妾在巫山之陽，高丘之阻，旦為朝雲，暮為行雨。朝朝暮暮，陽臺之下。”
derivationEn: Warring States, Chu, Song Yu, Gaotang Fu: 'I am at the sunny side of Witch Mountain, on the high hill; in the morning I am the morning cloud, in the evening I am the evening rain. Morning and evening, under the balcony.'
example: 银河碧落神仙配，地久天长，岂但～期。★清·洪昻《长生殿·怂合》
exampleTraditional: 銀河碧落神仙配，地久天長，豈但～期。★清·洪昻《長生殿·慫合》
exampleEn: The Milky Way and the blue sky are the match of immortals; eternal as heaven and earth, how can it be only a morning and evening period? (Qing Dynasty, Hong Sheng, Palace of Eternal Life, Chapter 20)

explanation: 喜欢女色、玩弄女性之人。
explanationTraditional: 喜歡女色、玩弄女性之人。
explanationEn: A person who is fond of women and engages in womanizing.
derivation: 清·张南庄《何典》第八回无知骨子里是个好色之徒，怎敖得住！家里不能做手脚，便在外面寻花问柳。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張南莊《何典》第八回無知骨子裡是個好色之徒，怎敖得住！家裡不能做手腳，便在外面尋花問柳。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Zhang Nanzhuang, He Dian, Chapter 8: 'Little did he know that at heart he was a lecher; unable to do anything at home, he went out to seek pleasure.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①佛教语。指屏弃世俗一切杂念，彻悟因杂念而迷失了的本性（即佛性）。②指率真地表现心性。
explanationTraditional: ①佛教語。指屏棄世俗一切雜念，徹悟因雜念而迷失了的本性（即佛性）。②指率真地表現心性。
explanationEn: A Buddhist term meaning to discard all worldly distractions and fully realize one's true nature (Buddha-nature). Also refers to expressing one's innate nature sincerely.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 冥顽愚钝无知；不灵不聪明。形容愚昧无知。
explanationTraditional: 冥頑愚鈍無知；不靈不聰明。形容愚昧無知。
explanationEn: Stubborn, ignorant, and dull-witted; describes someone who is foolish and unenlightened.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《祭鳄鱼文》不然则是鳄鱼冥顽不灵，刺史虽有言，不闻不知也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《祭鱷魚文》不然則是鱷魚冥頑不靈，刺史雖有言，不聞不知也。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Sacrificial Crocodile Text' of the Tang Dynasty: 'Otherwise, the crocodile is stubborn and unenlightened; although the prefect has spoken, it neither hears nor understands.'
example: ～藐王章，羊狠狼贪性狂恣。★清·叶廷琯《鸥陂渔话·严戊卿捕鳄行纪诛潮匪事》
exampleTraditional: ～藐王章，羊狠狼貪性狂恣。★清·葉廷琯《鷗陂漁話·嚴戊卿捕鱷行紀誅潮匪事》
exampleEn: Stubborn and unenlightened, defying royal law, wolfish and gluttonous, wild and unrestrained. — Qing Dynasty, Ye Tingguan, 'Oubi Fisherman's Tales'

explanation: 追求根底。一般指追问一件事的原由。
explanationTraditional: 追求根底。一般指追問一件事的原由。
explanationEn: To get to the bottom of things; to inquire into the root cause of a matter.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百二十回似你这样寻根究底，便是刻舟求剑，胶柱鼓瑟了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百二十回似你這樣尋根究底，便是刻舟求劍，膠柱鼓瑟了。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 120: 'To be so thorough in seeking the root is like carving a boat for a sword or gluing the strings of a zither.'
example: 这个学生对学习有股钻劲，什么问题都想～。
exampleTraditional: 這個學生對學習有股鑽勁，什麼問題都想～。
exampleEn: This student has a drive for learning and wants to get to the bottom of every question.

explanation: 形容勇猛无畏地前进。同一往无前”。
explanationTraditional: 形容勇猛無畏地前進。同一往無前”。
explanationEn: To advance bravely and fearlessly; same as '一往无前' (press forward with indomitable spirit).
derivation: 陶成章《浙案纪略》第四章第二节其行事也，常鼓一往直前之气，而不虑其他。”
derivationTraditional: 陶成章《浙案紀略》第四章第二節其行事也，常鼓一往直前之氣，而不慮其他。”
derivationEn: From Tao Chengzhang's 'Brief Account of the Zhejiang Case', Chapter 4, Section 2: 'In his actions, he often spurred forward with a spirit of going straight ahead, without considering other consequences.'
example: 他们把互相的爱悦和义无返顾、～的心情发挥到了淋漓尽致的程度。★欧阳山《三家巷》十三
exampleTraditional: 他們把互相的愛悅和義無返顧、～的心情發揮到了淋漓盡致的程度。★歐陽山《三家巷》十三
exampleEn: They expressed their mutual affection and their unwavering, forward-charging feelings to the fullest. — Ouyang Shan, 'Three Family Lane', Chapter 13

explanation: 自以为了不起。
explanationTraditional: 自以為了不起。
explanationEn: To think highly of oneself; to be conceited and arrogant.
derivation: 北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·勉学》见人读数十卷书，便自高大，凌忽长者，轻慢同列。”
derivationTraditional: 北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·勉學》見人讀數十卷書，便自高大，凌忽長者，輕慢同列。”
derivationEn: From Yan Zhitui's 'Family Instructions of the Yan Clan' of the Northern Qi Dynasty: 'Seeing someone who has read dozens of books, they become arrogant, disrespecting elders and slighting peers.'
example: 人要是～，瞧不起别人，就不能进步。
exampleTraditional: 人要是～，瞧不起別人，就不能進步。
exampleEn: If a person is conceited and looks down on others, they cannot make progress.

explanation: 形容非常伤心或很是感动的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常傷心或很是感動的樣子。
explanationEn: To cry with heads in each other's arms; describes extreme sadness or deep emotion.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》两人抱头大哭，哭了一场坐下。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》兩人抱頭大哭，哭了一場坐下。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars' of the Qing Dynasty: 'The two men cried in each other's arms, then sat down after crying.'
example: 这一对被海峡分割了40年的夫妻，一经相见，～，慨叹不已。
exampleTraditional: 這一對被海峽分割了40年的夫妻，一經相見，～，慨嘆不已。
exampleEn: The couple, separated by the Taiwan Strait for 40 years, cried in each other's arms upon reunion, sighing endlessly.

explanation: 利锋利。指战舰坚固，大炮猛烈。形容海军强盛。
explanationTraditional: 利鋒利。指戰艦堅固，大炮猛烈。形容海軍強盛。
explanationEn: Strong ships and powerful guns; describes a strong navy.
derivation: 清·林则徐等《会奏穿鼻尖沙嘴叠次轰击夷船情形折》此次士密等前来寻衅……无非恃其般坚炮利，以悍济贪。”
derivationTraditional: 清·林則徐等《會奏穿鼻尖沙嘴疊次轟擊夷船情形折》此次士密等前來尋釁……無非恃其般堅炮利，以悍濟貪。”
derivationEn: From Lin Zexu et al.'s 'Joint Memorial on Repeated Bombardment of Foreign Ships at Chuanbi and Jianshazui': 'This time, Smith and others came to provoke... relying solely on their strong ships and powerful guns, using ferocity to aid greed.'
example: 欧洲富强之本，不尽在于～而在于人能尽其才，地能尽其利。★孙中山《上李鸿章书》
exampleTraditional: 歐洲富強之本，不盡在於～而在於人能盡其才，地能盡其利。★孫中山《上李鴻章書》
exampleEn: The root of Europe's wealth and power lies not entirely in strong ships and powerful guns, but in fully utilizing human talent and land resources. — Sun Yat-sen, 'Letter to Li Hongzhang'

explanation: 指两家儿女结为婚姻的亲戚关系。
explanationTraditional: 指兩家兒女結為婚姻的親戚關係。
explanationEn: The relationship between families whose children are married to each other.
derivation: 《花月痕》第52回历有数年，便发起财，也娶了亲，与秃头做个儿女亲家。”
derivationTraditional: 《花月痕》第52回曆有數年，便發起財，也娶了親，與禿頭做個兒女親家。”
derivationEn: From 'Flower Moon Marks', Chapter 52: 'After several years, he became wealthy, married, and became a marriage relative with Bald Head.'
example: 不管中人保人，你和他是～，你也好帮帮他的忙。★洪深《香稻米》第二幕
exampleTraditional: 不管中人保人，你和他是～，你也好幫幫他的忙。★洪深《香稻米》第二幕
exampleEn: Regardless of the mediator, you and he are marriage relatives; you should help him out. — Hong Shen, 'Fragrant Rice', Act 2

explanation: 晏平静。黄河水清了，大海没有浪了。比喻天下太平。
explanationTraditional: 晏平靜。黃河水清了，大海沒有浪了。比喻天下太平。
explanationEn: The sea is calm and the Yellow River is clear; a metaphor for peace and order under heaven.
derivation: 唐·薛逢《九日曲池游眺》正当海晏河清日，便是修文偃武时。”唐·郑锡《日中有王子赋》河清海晏，时和岁丰。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·薛逢《九日曲池遊眺》正當海晏河清日，便是修文偃武時。”唐·鄭錫《日中有王子賦》河清海晏，時和歲豐。”
derivationEn: From Xue Feng's 'Wandering at Nine-Bend Pond' of the Tang Dynasty: 'When the sea is calm and the river clear, it is time to cultivate culture and cease arms.' Also from Zheng Xi's 'Ode to the Prince in the Sun': 'River clear and sea calm, seasons harmonious and harvests abundant.'
example: 如今～，重逢太平，重乐太平。★元·施惠《幽闺记·和寇还朝》
exampleTraditional: 如今～，重逢太平，重樂太平。★元·施惠《幽閨記·和寇還朝》
exampleEn: Now the sea is calm and the river clear, we meet again in peace and enjoy peace. — Yuan Dynasty, Shi Hui, 'The Secluded Boudoir: Making Peace with the Bandits'

explanation: 嘉、懿善、美。有教育意义的好言语和好行为。
explanationTraditional: 嘉、懿善、美。有教育意義的好言語和好行為。
explanationEn: Good words and virtuous deeds that are instructive.
derivation: 《尚书·大禹谟》若允兹，嘉言罔攸伏，野无遗贤，万邦贤宁。”宋·朱熹《朱子全书·学五》见人嘉言善行，则敬慕而记录之。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·大禹謨》若允茲，嘉言罔攸伏，野無遺賢，萬邦賢寧。”宋·朱熹《朱子全書·學五》見人嘉言善行，則敬慕而記錄之。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Counsels of the Great Yu': 'If you allow this, good words will not be hidden, no worthy men will be left in the wild, and all states will be at peace.' Also from Zhu Xi's 'Complete Works of Zhu Xi: Learning 5': 'When seeing others' good words and virtuous deeds, one should respect and record them.'
example: 这部书叫《帝鉴图说》，出于明朝张居正的手笔，辑录历代贤主的～。★高阳《玉座珠帘》上册
exampleTraditional: 這部書叫《帝鑑圖說》，出於明朝張居正的手筆，輯錄歷代賢主的～。★高陽《玉座珠簾》上冊
exampleEn: This book, called 'Emperor's Mirror Illustrated', was compiled by Zhang Juzheng of the Ming Dynasty, collecting the good words and virtuous deeds of past wise rulers. — Gao Yang, 'Jade Pearl Curtain', Volume 1

explanation: 明亮的眼睛，洁白的牙齿。形容女子容貌美丽，也指美丽的女子。
explanationTraditional: 明亮的眼睛，潔白的牙齒。形容女子容貌美麗，也指美麗的女子。
explanationEn: Bright eyes and white teeth. Describes a woman's beautiful appearance, or a beautiful woman.
derivation: 三国魏·曹植《洛神赋》丹唇外朗，皓齿内鲜，明眸善睐，靥辅承权。”
derivationTraditional: 三國魏·曹植《洛神賦》丹唇外朗，皓齒內鮮，明眸善睞，靨輔承權。”
derivationEn: From Cao Zhi's 'Ode to the Goddess of the Luo River' (Three Kingdoms Wei): 'Red lips bright outside, white teeth fresh inside, bright eyes good at glancing, dimples supporting the cheeks.'
example: ～今何在，血污游魂归不得。★唐·杜甫《哀江头》诗
exampleTraditional: ～今何在，血汙遊魂歸不得。★唐·杜甫《哀江頭》詩
exampleEn: Where are the bright eyes and white teeth now? The blood-stained wandering soul cannot return. — Du Fu's poem 'Lament Along the River' (Tang Dynasty)

explanation: 喷吐出云雾来。
explanationTraditional: 噴吐出雲霧來。
explanationEn: To emit clouds and spout fog. Describes smoking opium or cigarettes.
derivation: 安正福《敌后插刀》炕上还斜躺着几个，正在喷云吐雾抽大烟。”
derivationTraditional: 安正福《敵後插刀》炕上還斜躺著幾個，正在噴雲吐霧抽大煙。”
derivationEn: From An Zhengfu's 'Behind Enemy Lines': 'Several were lying slantwise on the kang, emitting clouds and spouting fog while smoking opium.'
example: 他一抽烟就～。
exampleTraditional: 他一抽菸就～。
exampleEn: Whenever he smokes, he emits clouds and spouts fog.

explanation: 减轻徭役，降低赋税。同轻繇薄赋”。
explanationTraditional: 減輕徭役，降低賦稅。同輕繇薄賦”。
explanationEn: To lighten corvée and reduce taxes. Same as '轻繇薄赋'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指边界连接在一起。
explanationTraditional: 指邊界連接在一起。
explanationEn: Mountains and rivers are connected. Refers to borders being adjacent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 兴味兴趣、趣味；索然毫无兴致的样子。一点儿兴趣都没有。
explanationTraditional: 興味興趣、趣味；索然毫無興致的樣子。一點兒興趣都沒有。
explanationEn: Completely uninterested; having no interest at all.
derivation: 清·王韬《瀛壖杂志》卓午来游者，络绎不绝。溽暑蒸郁，看花之兴味索然矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王韜《瀛壖雜誌》卓午來遊者，絡繹不絕。溽暑蒸鬱，看花之興味索然矣。”
derivationEn: From Wang Tao's 'Miscellaneous Records of Yinghuan' (Qing Dynasty): 'Visitors came in an endless stream at noon. The humid heat was oppressive, and the interest in viewing flowers was completely lost.'
example: 这篇文章内容空洞，语言贫乏，读起来使人～。
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章內容空洞，語言貧乏，讀起來使人～。
exampleEn: This article is empty in content and poor in language, making it utterly uninteresting to read.

explanation: 原指龙在云中，东露一鳞，西露半爪，看不到它的全貌。比喻零星片段的事物。
explanationTraditional: 原指龍在雲中，東露一鱗，西露半爪，看不到它的全貌。比喻零星片段的事物。
explanationEn: Originally refers to a dragon in the clouds revealing one scale here and half a claw there, so the whole cannot be seen. Metaphor for fragmentary bits of things.
derivation: 唐·高仲武《中兴闲气集·苏涣》三年中作变律诗九首，上广州李帅，其文意长于讽刺，亦有陈拾遗一鳞半甲。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·高仲武《中興閒氣集·蘇渙》三年中作變律詩九首，上廣州李帥，其文意長於諷刺，亦有陳拾遺一鱗半甲。”
derivationEn: From Gao Zhongwu's 'Collected Poems of the Flourishing Tang' (Tang Dynasty): 'In three years, he wrote nine poems on changing rhythms, presented to Governor Li of Guangzhou. The style excels in satire, and also has a scale or half a claw of Chen Ziang.'
example: 身后著作，年久多散佚，余遍为蒷罗，仅得诗三帙，丛残不具首尾，于诸集殆不过～耳。★清·叶廷琯《鸥波渔话·莪洲公诗》
exampleTraditional: 身後著作，年久多散佚，餘遍為蒷羅，僅得詩三帙，叢殘不具首尾，於諸集殆不過～耳。★清·葉廷琯《鷗波漁話·莪洲公詩》
exampleEn: After his death, his works were scattered over the years. I searched extensively and only obtained three volumes of poetry, incomplete and without beginning or end, barely a scale or half a claw of his collected works. — Ye Tingguan's 'Oubō Yúhuà' (Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 鲍咸鱼；肆店铺。卖咸鱼的店。比喻坏人成堆的地方。
explanationTraditional: 鮑鹹魚；肆店鋪。賣鹹魚的店。比喻壞人成堆的地方。
explanationEn: A shop selling salted fish. Metaphor for a place where bad people gather.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·杂言》与恶人居，如入鲍鱼之肆，久而不闻其臭，亦与之化矣。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·雜言》與惡人居，如入鮑魚之肆，久而不聞其臭，亦與之化矣。”
derivationEn: From Liu Xiang's 'Garden of Stories' (Han Dynasty): 'Living with evil people is like entering a shop of salted fish; after a long time, you no longer smell the stench, having become assimilated.'
example: 智者见智，仁者见仁，入～，而不自知其臭，其斯之谓乎？★清·忧患余生《〈官场现形记〉序》
exampleTraditional: 智者見智，仁者見仁，入～，而不自知其臭，其斯之謂乎？★清·憂患餘生《〈官場現形記〉序》
exampleEn: The wise see wisdom, the benevolent see benevolence. Entering a shop of salted fish without knowing its stench—is that not the case? — Youhuàn Yúshēng's preface to 'The Officialdom Unmasked' (Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 教教育；诛处罚，杀死。不警告就处死。指事先不教育人，一犯错误就加以惩罚。
explanationTraditional: 教教育；誅處罰，殺死。不警告就處死。指事先不教育人，一犯錯誤就加以懲罰。
explanationEn: To punish without prior warning or education. Refers to punishing someone for a mistake without first instructing them.
derivation: 《荀子·富国》故不教而诛，则刑繁而邪不胜；教而不诛，则奸民不惩。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·富國》故不教而誅，則刑繁而邪不勝；教而不誅，則奸民不懲。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi's 'Enriching the State': 'Thus, punishing without teaching leads to many penalties but evil still prevails; teaching without punishing leads to unpunished villains.'
example: 大人限他们三个月叫他们戒烟，宽之以期限，动之以厉害，不忍～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 大人限他們三個月叫他們戒菸，寬之以期限，動之以厲害，不忍～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十回
exampleEn: You gave them three months to quit smoking, setting a deadline and explaining the consequences, unwilling to punish without teaching. — Li Baojia's 'The Officialdom Unmasked' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 20

explanation: 比喻起善心，做好事。
explanationTraditional: 比喻起善心，做好事。
explanationEn: To show great mercy or compassion; to do a good deed.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第九十二回他说三天之内，照着祖爷爷的吩咐送过来。请祖爷爷大发慈悲，代他们打点打点！”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第九十二回他說三天之內，照著祖爺爺的吩咐送過來。請祖爺爺大發慈悲，代他們打點打點！”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 92: 'He said that within three days, he would deliver as per the grandfather's instructions. Please show great mercy and help them out!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容男女之间强烈情欲要求，多用于不正当的男女关系。也形容情绪高涨。
explanationTraditional: 形容男女之間強烈情慾要求，多用於不正當的男女關係。也形容情緒高漲。
explanationEn: Describes strong sexual desire between a man and a woman, often for illicit relationships. Also describes high spirits.
derivation: 明·周楫《西湖二集·侠女散财殉节》这烈火干柴怎得瞒。”
derivationTraditional: 明·周楫《西湖二集·俠女散財殉節》這烈火乾柴怎得瞞。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Ji's 'West Lake Stories' (Ming Dynasty): 'How could this blazing fire and dry firewood be hidden?'
example: 真是一对烈火干柴，如胶如漆，燕尔新婚，连日那里拆得开。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十九回
exampleTraditional: 真是一對烈火乾柴，如膠如漆，燕爾新婚，連日那裡拆得開。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十九回
exampleEn: Truly a pair of dry firewood and blazing fire, inseparable like glue and lacquer, newly married, how could they be separated for days? — Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 69

explanation: 指一方面具有圣人的才德，一方面又能施行王道。这是道家的政治思想。
explanationTraditional: 指一方面具有聖人的才德，一方面又能施行王道。這是道家的政治思想。
explanationEn: Refers to having the virtue of a sage internally while practicing benevolent governance externally; a Taoist political ideal.
derivation: 《庄子·天下》是故内圣外王之道暗而不明，郁而不发，天下之人各为其所欲焉，以自为方。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天下》是故內聖外王之道暗而不明，鬱而不發，天下之人各為其所欲焉，以自為方。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'The way of inner sage and outer king became obscured and unexpressed, and everyone in the world followed their own desires.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 只与清风、明月为伴。比喻不随便结交朋友。也比喻清闲无事。
explanationTraditional: 只與清風、明月為伴。比喻不隨便結交朋友。也比喻清閒無事。
explanationEn: Accompanied only by clear breeze and bright moon; metaphor for being selective in making friends or leading a leisurely life.
derivation: 《南史·谢惠传》入吾室者，但有清风；对吾饮者，惟当明月。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·謝惠傳》入吾室者，但有清風；對吾飲者，惟當明月。”
derivationEn: From History of the Southern Dynasties: 'Those who enter my chamber are but the clear breeze; those who drink with me are only the bright moon.'
example: 金马玉堂三学士，～两闲人。★宋·欧阳修《会老堂致语》
exampleTraditional: 金馬玉堂三學士，～兩閒人。★宋·歐陽修《會老堂致語》
exampleEn: Three scholars of golden horses and jade halls, two idle men with clear breeze and bright moon. — Ouyang Xiu

explanation: 原形容天地的广大，后形容恩德极深厚。也比喻事情的艰巨、严重，关系的重大。
explanationTraditional: 原形容天地的廣大，後形容恩德極深厚。也比喻事情的艱鉅、嚴重，關係的重大。
explanationEn: Originally described the vastness of heaven and earth; later used to express profound kindness or the gravity of a situation.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·正月》谓天盖高，不敢不局；谓地盖厚，不敢不脊。”《荀子·劝学》故不登高山，不知天之高也；不临深豨，不知地之厚也。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·正月》謂天蓋高，不敢不局；謂地蓋厚，不敢不脊。”《荀子·勸學》故不登高山，不知天之高也；不臨深豨，不知地之厚也。”
derivationEn: From Book of Songs: 'Heaven is high, yet we dare not but stoop; Earth is thick, yet we dare not but tread lightly.' Also from Xunzi: 'Without climbing a high mountain, one does not know the height of heaven; without approaching a deep valley, one does not know the thickness of earth.'
example: 门生受恩师三番知遇，今日小小效劳，止可少答科举而已，～，未酬万一。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十八
exampleTraditional: 門生受恩師三番知遇，今日小小效勞，止可少答科舉而已，～，未酬萬一。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十八
exampleEn: The student has received the teacher's kindness three times; today's small service barely repays the examination favor, but the depth of heaven and earth's kindness remains unrequited. — Feng Menglong

explanation: 兔子死了，狐狸感到悲伤。比喻因同类的死亡而感到悲伤。
explanationTraditional: 兔子死了，狐狸感到悲傷。比喻因同類的死亡而感到悲傷。
explanationEn: When the rabbit dies, the fox grieves; metaphor for feeling sorrow over the death of a kindred spirit.
derivation: 《宋史·李全传》狐死兔泣，李氏灭，夏氏宁独存？”元·无名氏《赚蒯通》第四折今日油烹蒯彻，正所谓兔死狐悲，芝焚蕙叹。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·李全傳》狐死兔泣，李氏滅，夏氏寧獨存？”元·無名氏《賺蒯通》第四折今日油烹蒯徹，正所謂兔死狐悲，芝焚蕙嘆。”
derivationEn: From History of Song: 'If the fox dies and the rabbit weeps, when the Li family is destroyed, can the Xia family survive alone?' Also from Yuan drama: 'Today, Kuai Tong is boiled in oil, truly a case of the rabbit dying and the fox grieving.'
example: 鼋鸣而鳖应，兔死则狐悲。★明·田艺蘅《玉笑零音》
exampleTraditional: 黿鳴而鱉應，兔死則狐悲。★明·田藝蘅《玉笑零音》
exampleEn: When the turtle cries, the clam responds; when the rabbit dies, the fox grieves. — Tian Yiheng

explanation: 遐远；迩近。形容名声很大，远近都知道。
explanationTraditional: 遐遠；邇近。形容名聲很大，遠近都知道。
explanationEn: Famous far and near; widely known.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 江西景德镇的瓷器质地优良，工艺精美，一向～。
exampleTraditional: 江西景德鎮的瓷器質地優良，工藝精美，一向～。
exampleEn: The porcelain from Jingdezhen, Jiangxi, is of excellent quality and exquisite craftsmanship, and has always been famous far and near.

explanation: 形容刻苦学习。
explanationTraditional: 形容刻苦學習。
explanationEn: Describes studying with extreme diligence.
derivation: 西汉·刘向《战国策·秦策一》（苏秦）读书欲睡，引锥自刺其股，血流至足。”东汉·班固《汉书》孙敬字文宝，好学，晨夕不休。及至眠睡疲寝，以绳系头，悬屋梁。”
derivationTraditional: 西漢·劉向《戰國策·秦策一》（蘇秦）讀書欲睡，引錐自刺其股，血流至足。”東漢·班固《漢書》孫敬字文寶，好學，晨夕不休。及至眠睡疲寢，以繩系頭，懸屋樑。”
derivationEn: From Strategies of the Warring States: 'Su Qin, when sleepy while studying, would prick his thigh with an awl until blood flowed.' From Book of Han: 'Sun Jing tied his hair to a beam to stay awake while studying.'
example: 我～年复年，把铜雀磨穿。★清·李渔《比目鱼·赠行》
exampleTraditional: 我～年復年，把銅雀磨穿。★清·李漁《比目魚·贈行》
exampleEn: I studied with hair tied to a beam and thigh pricked year after year, until I wore through the bronze inkstone. — Li Yu

explanation: 善终正常死亡。指人不得好死。常指恶人应有的坏下场。
explanationTraditional: 善終正常死亡。指人不得好死。常指惡人應有的壞下場。
explanationEn: To not die a natural death; often refers to the bad end of an evil person.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六回坚指天为誓曰‘吾若果得此宝，私自藏匿，异日不得善终，死于刀箭之下！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六回堅指天為誓曰‘吾若果得此寶，私自藏匿，異日不得善終，死於刀箭之下！’”
derivationEn: From Romance of the Three Kingdoms: 'Sun Jian swore to heaven: If I secretly keep this treasure, may I die an unnatural death under swords and arrows.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 姑暂且；妄随便，胡乱。姑且随便听听，不一定就相信。
explanationTraditional: 姑暫且；妄隨便，胡亂。姑且隨便聽聽，不一定就相信。
explanationEn: To listen casually without necessarily believing.
derivation: 《庄子·齐物论》予尝为女妄言之，女亦以妄听之奚。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·齊物論》予嘗為女妄言之，女亦以妄聽之奚。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi: 'I once spoke to you casually, and you listened casually.'
example: 即使是饭后的公评，酒后的宏议，也何尝不可～呢？★鲁迅《华盖集续编·送灶日漫笔》
exampleTraditional: 即使是飯後的公評，酒後的宏議，也何嘗不可～呢？★魯迅《華蓋集續編·送灶日漫筆》
exampleEn: Even after-dinner comments and drinking talks can be listened to casually. — Lu Xun

explanation: 和连着；卧躺下。穿着衣服躺下睡觉。
explanationTraditional: 和連著；臥躺下。穿著衣服躺下睡覺。
explanationEn: To lie down to sleep with one's clothes on.
derivation: 明·明教中人《好俅传》第六回因挣扎走了几步，身体愈觉困倦，坐不得一刻，就和衣而睡。”
derivationTraditional: 明·明教中人《好俅傳》第六回因掙扎走了幾步，身體愈覺睏倦，坐不得一刻，就和衣而睡。”
derivationEn: From The Tale of a Good Son-in-Law: 'After struggling a few steps, he felt even more tired, and without sitting for a moment, he lay down in his clothes to sleep.'
example: 老程师爷是喝得当面退席，～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 老程師爺是喝得當面退席，～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十八回
exampleEn: Old Master Cheng was so drunk that he left the table and lay down in his clothes. — Wen Kang

explanation: 古代传说，龙生有九子，九子不成龙，各有所好。比喻同胞兄弟品质、爱好各不相同。
explanationTraditional: 古代傳說，龍生有九子，九子不成龍，各有所好。比喻同胞兄弟品質、愛好各不相同。
explanationEn: An ancient legend that a dragon has nine sons, none of whom are dragons, each with different preferences; metaphor for brothers with different qualities and tastes.
derivation: 明·徐应秋《玉芝堂谈荟·龙生九子》龙生九子不成龙，各有所好。”
derivationTraditional: 明·徐應秋《玉芝堂談薈·龍生九子》龍生九子不成龍，各有所好。”
derivationEn: From Yuzhitang Tanhui: 'The dragon's nine sons are not dragons, each has its own preference.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 磨好兵器，喂好马。形容准备战斗。
explanationTraditional: 磨好兵器，喂好馬。形容準備戰鬥。
explanationEn: Sharpen weapons and feed horses; prepare for battle.
derivation: 《左传·僖公三十三年》郑穆公使视客馆，则束载厉兵秣马矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·僖公三十三年》鄭穆公使視客館，則束載厲兵秣馬矣。”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xi's 33rd year: 'Zheng Mugong sent someone to inspect the guest house, and saw them bundling luggage, sharpening weapons, and feeding horses.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容惊慌或欣喜到极点。
explanationTraditional: 形容驚慌或欣喜到極點。
explanationEn: Extremely frightened or overjoyed.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十六回”送尚烧得头焦额烂，麻婆子赶得屁滚尿流。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十六回”送尚燒得頭焦額爛，麻婆子趕得屁滾尿流。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, Water Margin, Chapter 66: 'The monk was burned head and face, and the pockmarked woman chased him until he was scared shitless.'
example: 那小船上的水手，吓得～。（清·钱彩《说岳全传》第二十八回）
exampleTraditional: 那小船上的水手，嚇得～。（清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第二十八回）
exampleEn: The boatman was scared shitless. (Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, The Story of Yue Fei, Chapter 28)

explanation: 指无所作为地把时间荒废掉了。
explanationTraditional: 指無所作為地把時間荒廢掉了。
explanationEn: To waste time without achieving anything.
derivation: 明·张凤翼《灌园记·君后授衣》倘我不能报复而死，埋没了龙家的豹韬，枉蹉跎岁月一死鸿毛。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張鳳翼《灌園記·君後授衣》倘我不能報復而死，埋沒了龍家的豹韜，枉蹉跎歲月一死鴻毛。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Zhang Fengyi, The Story of Guan Yuan: 'If I die without revenge, burying the dragon's strategy, I have wasted time and died as light as a feather.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 诛杀死。比喻罪恶深重，为天地所不容。
explanationTraditional: 誅殺死。比喻罪惡深重，為天地所不容。
explanationEn: Heaven and earth destroy; used for a grave sin that cannot be tolerated by heaven and earth.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第十五回我等六人中但有私意者，天地诛灭，神明鉴查。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第十五回我等六人中但有私意者，天地誅滅，神明鑑查。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, Water Margin, Chapter 15: 'If any of us six has selfish intentions, may heaven and earth destroy him, and gods and spirits witness.'
example: 人不为己，～”，是剥削阶级的人生观。
exampleTraditional: 人不為己，～”，是剝削階級的人生觀。
exampleEn: 'Everyone for himself, and the devil take the hindmost' is the outlook of the exploiting class.

explanation: 拉大车的，做小买卖的。指平民百胜。
explanationTraditional: 拉大車的，做小買賣的。指平民百勝。
explanationEn: Cart pullers and peddlers; common people.
derivation: 西汉·司马迁《史记·魏公子列传》公子引车入市，侯生下见其客朱亥。”
derivationTraditional: 西漢·司馬遷《史記·魏公子列傳》公子引車入市，侯生下見其客朱亥。”
derivationEn: Western Han, Sima Qian, Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lord Wei: 'The lord drove his cart into the market, and Hou Sheng got down to see his friend Zhu Hai.'
example: 因为文体卑下，是‘～者流’所用的话。★鲁迅《呐喊·阿q正传》
exampleTraditional: 因為文體卑下，是‘～者流’所用的話。★魯迅《吶喊·阿q正傳》
exampleEn: Because the style is lowly, it is the language used by 'cart pullers and peddlers.' ★ Lu Xun, Call to Arms: The True Story of Ah Q

explanation: 铸铸造，把金属熔化后倒入模具内制成器物；错错误。指造成严重的错误。
explanationTraditional: 鑄鑄造，把金屬熔化後倒入模具內製成器物；錯錯誤。指造成嚴重的錯誤。
explanationEn: To make a serious mistake.
derivation: 《资治通鉴·唐纪·昭宗天佑三年》合六州四十三县铁，不能为此错也。”
derivationTraditional: 《資治通鑑·唐紀·昭宗天佑三年》合六州四十三縣鐵，不能為此錯也。”
derivationEn: Zizhi Tongjian, Tang Annals: 'Even if we melt all the iron from six prefectures and forty-three counties, we cannot make such a mistake.'
example: 倘若我晚回一步，岂不～！★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十五章
exampleTraditional: 倘若我晚回一步，豈不～！★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十五章
exampleEn: If I had returned a step later, wouldn't I have made a serious mistake! ★ Yao Xueyin, Li Zicheng, Volume 1, Chapter 15

explanation: 妍美、艳。形容繁华盛开，生气勃勃的景象。
explanationTraditional: 妍美、豔。形容繁華盛開，生氣勃勃的景象。
explanationEn: Hundreds of flowers compete in beauty; a scene of flourishing blossoms and vitality.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 春风一到，公园里百花争妍。
exampleTraditional: 春風一到，公園裡百花爭妍。
exampleEn: When spring comes, the park is full of flowers competing in beauty.

explanation: 百样之中无一有用的。形容毫无用处。
explanationTraditional: 百樣之中無一有用的。形容毫無用處。
explanationEn: Of a hundred things, none is useful; completely useless.
derivation: 清·黄景仁《杂感》十有九人堪白眼，百无一用是书生。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃景仁《雜感》十有九人堪白眼，百無一用是書生。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Huang Jingren, Miscellaneous Feelings: 'Nine out of ten people deserve disdain, and the scholar is the most useless.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 仁仁爱；义道义。不讲仁德，不讲道义。形容品性卑劣、残忍。
explanationTraditional: 仁仁愛；義道義。不講仁德，不講道義。形容品性卑劣、殘忍。
explanationEn: Lacking benevolence and righteousness; describing a vile and cruel character.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类·大学三》害人与穿窬，因为不仁不义。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類·大學三》害人與穿窬，因為不仁不義。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi, Zhu Xi's Analects: 'Harming others and stealing are indeed lacking benevolence and righteousness.'
example: 窥若辈之倒行逆施，是直欲陷吾元首于～之中。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第四十五回
exampleTraditional: 窺若輩之倒行逆施，是直欲陷吾元首於～之中。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第四十五回
exampleEn: Seeing their perverse actions, they are trying to trap our president in a state of lacking benevolence and righteousness. ★ Cai Dongfan, Popular Romance of the Republic, Chapter 45

explanation: 犹言心平气和。
explanationTraditional: 猶言心平氣和。
explanationEn: To calm one's mind and be even-tempered.
derivation: 瞿秋白《文艺杂著·荒漠里》我走着不敢说疲乏，我忍着不敢说饥渴；且沉心静气的听，听荒漠里的天籁。”
derivationTraditional: 瞿秋白《文藝雜著·荒漠裡》我走著不敢說疲乏，我忍著不敢說飢渴；且沉心靜氣的聽，聽荒漠裡的天籟。”
derivationEn: Qu Qiubai, Literary Miscellany: In the Desert: 'I walk without daring to say tired, I endure without daring to say thirsty; and calmly listen to the sounds of nature in the desert.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 胆子小得象老鼠。形容非常胆小。
explanationTraditional: 膽子小得象老鼠。形容非常膽小。
explanationEn: As timid as a mouse; extremely cowardly.
derivation: 《魏书·汝阴王天赐传》言同百舌，胆若鼷鼠。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·汝陰王天賜傳》言同百舌，膽若鼷鼠。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei: Biography of Prince Ruyin Tianci': 'Words like a hundred tongues, courage like a shrew.'
example: 他们样子往往很凶，其实～。★郭小川《文学工作不能跃进》
exampleTraditional: 他們樣子往往很兇，其實～。★郭小川《文學工作不能躍進》
exampleEn: They often look fierce, but in fact they are as timid as mice. ★ Guo Xiaochuan, 'Literature Work Cannot Leap Forward'

explanation: 旧指洒脱不拘，富有才学的人。
explanationTraditional: 舊指灑脫不拘，富有才學的人。
explanationEn: A talented and romantic scholar; a person of free and unrestrained talent.
derivation: 唐·元稹《莺莺传》风流才子多春思，肠断萧娘一纸书。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·元稹《鶯鶯傳》風流才子多春思，腸斷蕭娘一紙書。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Yuan Zhen's 'The Story of Yingying': 'A romantic scholar has many spring thoughts, heartbroken over a letter from a beauty.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时形容有钱有势。
explanationTraditional: 舊時形容有錢有勢。
explanationEn: Wealth and honor; riches and high position.
derivation: 《管子·重令》而群臣必通外请谒，取权道，行事便辟，以贵富为荣华以相稚也，谓之逆。”汉·王符《潜夫论·论荣》所谓贤人君子者，非必高位厚禄富贵荣华之谓也。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·重令》而群臣必通外請謁，取權道，行事便辟，以貴富為榮華以相稚也，謂之逆。”漢·王符《潛夫論·論榮》所謂賢人君子者，非必高位厚祿富貴榮華之謂也。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Heavy Orders' and Han Dynasty Wang Fu's 'Qianfulun: On Honor': 'Wealth and honor are not necessarily the mark of a worthy person.'
example: 亏得儿子已得了官，还有～日子在后面。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十二
exampleTraditional: 虧得兒子已得了官，還有～日子在後面。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十二
exampleEn: Fortunately, his son had obtained an official position, and there were days of wealth and honor ahead. ★ Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Amazement, First Collection' Volume 22

explanation: 没有地方用他的心。指不动脑筋，什么事情都不关心。
explanationTraditional: 沒有地方用他的心。指不動腦筋，什麼事情都不關心。
explanationEn: Not using one's mind at all; to be idle and indifferent to everything.
derivation: 《论语·阳货》饱食终日，无所用心，难矣哉。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·陽貨》飽食終日，無所用心，難矣哉。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Yang Huo': 'Eating all day without using one's mind—how difficult!'
example: 至于那些下民，他们有的是榆叶和海苔，他们饱食终日，～”—就是并不劳心，原只要吃这些就够。★鲁迅《故事新编·理水》
exampleTraditional: 至於那些下民，他們有的是榆葉和海苔，他們飽食終日，～”—就是並不勞心，原只要吃這些就夠。★魯迅《故事新編·理水》
exampleEn: As for those common people, they have elm leaves and seaweed to eat; they eat all day and use not their minds—that is, they do not labor mentally, and it is enough to eat these. ★ Lu Xun, 'Old Tales Retold: Controlling the Flood'

explanation: 修心使心灵纯洁；养性使本性不受损害。通过自我反省体察，使身心达到完美的境界。
explanationTraditional: 修心使心靈純潔；養性使本性不受損害。通過自我反省體察，使身心達到完美的境界。
explanationEn: To cultivate the mind and nurture one's nature; to achieve spiritual perfection through self-reflection.
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《东坡梦》第二折则被这东坡学士相调戏，可着我满寺里告他谁，我如今修心养性在庐山内，怎生瞒过了子瞻，赚上了牡丹，却教谁人来替？”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《東坡夢》第二折則被這東坡學士相調戲，可著我滿寺裡告他誰，我如今修心養性在廬山內，怎生瞞過了子瞻，賺上了牡丹，卻教誰人來替？”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Wu Changling's 'Dream of Dongpo' Act 2: 'I now cultivate my mind and nurture my nature within Mount Lu.'
example: 我纵欲～，那得此半年空闲，幕天席地的日子？★冰心《寄小读者》
exampleTraditional: 我縱慾～，那得此半年空閒，幕天席地的日子？★冰心《寄小讀者》
exampleEn: Even if I wanted to cultivate my mind and nurture my nature, where would I find half a year of leisure, living under the sky and on the ground? ★ Bing Xin, 'To Little Readers'

explanation: 仪态姿态，容貌。形容容貌、姿态各方面都很美。
explanationTraditional: 儀態姿態，容貌。形容容貌、姿態各方面都很美。
explanationEn: Having a myriad of graceful postures; extremely beautiful in appearance and demeanor.
derivation: 汉·张衡《同声赋》素女为我师，仪态盈万方。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·張衡《同聲賦》素女為我師，儀態盈萬方。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Zhang Heng's 'Poem of the Same Sound': 'The goddess Su Nu is my teacher, her bearing full of grace.'
example: 湖上的明月和落日，湖上的浓阴和微雨，我都见过了，真是～。★冰心《寄小读者·通讯七》
exampleTraditional: 湖上的明月和落日，湖上的濃陰和微雨，我都見過了，真是～。★冰心《寄小讀者·通訊七》
exampleEn: I have seen the moon and sunset over the lake, the dense shade and light rain—truly a myriad of graces. ★ Bing Xin, 'To Little Readers, Letter Seven'

explanation: 连一步都难移动。形容走路困难。也比喻处境艰难。
explanationTraditional: 連一步都難移動。形容走路困難。也比喻處境艱難。
explanationEn: Unable to move even a step; having difficulty walking; also metaphorically in a difficult situation.
derivation: 元·郑廷玉《楚昭公》第四折想当年在小舟中，寸步难移。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭廷玉《楚昭公》第四折想當年在小舟中，寸步難移。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zheng Tingyu's 'The Prince of Chu Zhao' Act 4: 'Thinking back then in the small boat, unable to move an inch.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻立志奋发图强。
explanationTraditional: 比喻立志奮發圖強。
explanationEn: To strike the oar midstream; metaphor for being determined to strive for progress.
derivation: 《晋书·祖逖传》中流击楫而誓曰‘祖逖不能清中原而复济者，有如大江。’”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·祖逖傳》中流擊楫而誓曰‘祖逖不能清中原而復濟者，有如大江。’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Zu Ti': 'Striking the oar midstream, he swore: 'If I cannot clear the Central Plains and return, may I be like this great river.''
example: ～，着祖生之鞭；下濑横戈，成汉武之志。★《晚清文学丛钞·童子军·草檄》
exampleTraditional: ～，著祖生之鞭；下瀨橫戈，成漢武之志。★《晚清文學叢鈔·童子軍·草檄》
exampleEn: Striking the oar midstream, following Zu Ti's whip; crossing the rapids with a halberd, fulfilling Emperor Wu's ambition. ★ 'Late Qing Literature Series: Boy Scouts, Drafting a Proclamation'

explanation: 年老者能有个合适的归宿。
explanationTraditional: 年老者能有個合適的歸宿。
explanationEn: The elderly have a proper place to settle; to have a secure old age.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》故人不独亲其亲，不独子其子，使老有所终，壮有所用，幼有所长，矜寡孤独，废疾者，皆有所养。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》故人不獨親其親，不獨子其子，使老有所終，壯有所用，幼有所長，矜寡孤獨，廢疾者，皆有所養。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: The Conveyance of Rites': 'Thus people not only care for their own parents and children, but ensure that the elderly have a place to end, the strong have a use, the young have a way to grow, and the widowed, orphaned, lonely, and disabled are all provided for.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 杂杂乱，多种多样。谈论的人多，说法多种多样。也指在场的人多，七嘴八舌。
explanationTraditional: 雜雜亂，多種多樣。談論的人多，說法多種多樣。也指在場的人多，七嘴八舌。
explanationEn: Many people, many voices; a crowd of people talking at once; diverse opinions.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十九回闺臣恐人多嘴杂，说话不便，即同良箴、红蕖、紫绡另在一房居住。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十九回閨臣恐人多嘴雜，說話不便，即同良箴、紅蕖、紫綃另在一房居住。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 59: 'Guichen, fearing that many people would cause a lot of talk and make it inconvenient to speak, went with Liangzhen, Hongqu, and Zixiao to stay in another room.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有人居住的地方。
explanationTraditional: 沒有人居住的地方。
explanationEn: A place where no one lives; an uninhabited area.
derivation: 宋·杨万里《国势中》不茸一垒，不置一卒，使寇之去来，如入无人之境。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·楊萬里《國勢中》不茸一壘，不置一卒，使寇之去來，如入無人之境。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Yang Wanli's 'On National Power': 'Not building a single fort, not stationing a single soldier, allowing the enemy to come and go as if entering an uninhabited land.'
example: 只是镇静地缓缓前行，坦然如入～。★鲁迅《彷徨·伤逝》
exampleTraditional: 只是鎮靜地緩緩前行，坦然如入～。★魯迅《彷徨·傷逝》
exampleEn: He simply advanced calmly and slowly, as if entering an uninhabited land. ★ Lu Xun, 'Wandering: Regret for the Past'

explanation: 留着毒疮不去医治，就会成为后患。比喻纵容包庇坏人坏事，结果会遭受祸害。
explanationTraditional: 留著毒瘡不去醫治，就會成為後患。比喻縱容包庇壞人壞事，結果會遭受禍害。
explanationEn: To leave a boil untreated, which will later cause trouble. Metaphor for indulging or shielding evil, leading to disaster.
derivation: 《后汉书·冯衍传》李贤注引冯衍《与妇弟任武达书》养痈长疽，自生祸殃。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·馮衍傳》李賢注引馮衍《與婦弟任武達書》養癰長疽，自生禍殃。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Feng Yan' annotated by Li Xian, quoting Feng Yan's 'Letter to His Wife's Brother Ren Wuda': 'Nurturing a boil and letting it grow, one brings calamity upon oneself.'
example: 我们对待缺点错误的态度，应是做坚决的斗争，决不能～。
exampleTraditional: 我們對待缺點錯誤的態度，應是做堅決的鬥爭，決不能～。
exampleEn: Our attitude towards shortcomings and mistakes should be to resolutely fight them, never to indulge them and cause future trouble.

explanation: 知道了受人家的恩惠就报答人家的恩惠。
explanationTraditional: 知道了受人家的恩惠就報答人家的恩惠。
explanationEn: To repay a kindness after receiving it.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第五本第三折掩家里有信行，知恩报恩。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第五本第三折掩家裡有信行，知恩報恩。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing' Act 5, Scene 3: 'My family is trustworthy and knows to repay kindness.'
example: 这虽是小事，也可见得他～的诚心。★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 這雖是小事，也可見得他～的誠心。★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四十二回
exampleEn: Although it is a small matter, it shows his sincerity in repaying kindness. ★ Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' Chapter 42

explanation: 秉掌握，主持。公公法。根据公道办事。
explanationTraditional: 秉掌握，主持。公公法。根據公道辦事。
explanationEn: To handle matters impartially according to the law.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十七回本部院凡事秉公办理，从不假手旁人。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十七回本部院凡事秉公辦理，從不假手旁人。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'Officialdom Unmasked' Chapter 57: 'This ministry handles all matters impartially and never delegates to others.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鱼见之沉入水底，雁见之降落沙洲。形容女子容貌美丽。
explanationTraditional: 魚見之沉入水底，雁見之降落沙洲。形容女子容貌美麗。
explanationEn: Fish sink and geese land when seeing her beauty. Describes a woman's stunning appearance.
derivation: 《庄子·齐物论》毛嫱、丽姬，人之所美也；鱼见之深入，鸟见之高飞，麋鹿见之决骤，四者孰知天下之正色哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·齊物論》毛嬙、麗姬，人之所美也；魚見之深入，鳥見之高飛，麋鹿見之決驟，四者孰知天下之正色哉？”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: On the Equality of Things': 'Mao Qiang and Li Ji are considered beautiful by humans; but fish see them and dive deep, birds see them and fly high, deer see them and gallop away. Who among these four knows the true beauty of the world?'
example: 他二人长的一个是～之容，一个是闭月羞花之貌。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 他二人長的一個是～之容，一個是閉月羞花之貌。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十二回
exampleEn: One had a face that could make fish sink and geese land, the other a countenance that could outshine the moon and shame flowers. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'Officialdom Unmasked' Chapter 12

explanation: 雏幼鸟。幼鹰展开翅膀飞翔。比喻青年人开始独立生活、工作。
explanationTraditional: 雛幼鳥。幼鷹展開翅膀飛翔。比喻青年人開始獨立生活、工作。
explanationEn: A young eagle spreads its wings to fly. Metaphor for young people starting independent life or work.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 大学已经毕业了，这正是他～的时侯。
exampleTraditional: 大學已經畢業了，這正是他～的時侯。
exampleEn: Having graduated from university, this is the time for him to spread his wings like a young eagle.

explanation: 皇帝、王侯、及文臣武将。指封建时代上层统治者。
explanationTraditional: 皇帝、王侯、及文臣武將。指封建時代上層統治者。
explanationEn: Emperors, kings, generals, and ministers. Refers to the ruling class in feudal society.
derivation: 《史记·陈涉世家》且壮士不死即日已，死即举大名耳，王侯将相宁有种乎！”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·陳涉世家》且壯士不死即日已，死即舉大名耳，王侯將相寧有種乎！”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Chen She's Family': 'Moreover, a brave man does not die unless he makes a name; if he dies, he should leave a great name. How can kings, princes, generals, and ministers be born to their status?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 很有智谋，又善于判断。
explanationTraditional: 很有智謀，又善於判斷。
explanationEn: Resourceful and decisive; having both wisdom and the ability to make good judgments.
derivation: 晋·陆机《辨亡论》而加之笃敬，申之以节俭，畴谘峻茂，好谋善断。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陸機《辨亡論》而加之篤敬，申之以節儉，疇諮峻茂，好謀善斷。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Lu Ji's 'Essay on the Fall of Wu': 'In addition, they were respectful, frugal, consulted widely, and were good at planning and making decisions.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 殍人饿死后的尸体。到处是饿死的人。形容老百姓因饥饿而大量死亡的悲惨景象。
explanationTraditional: 殍人餓死後的屍體。到處是餓死的人。形容老百姓因飢餓而大量死亡的悲慘景象。
explanationEn: Corpses of starved people everywhere. Describes a tragic scene of mass starvation.
derivation: 先秦·孟轲《孟子·梁惠王上》庖有肥肉，厩有肥马，民有饥色，野有饿莩，此率兽而食人也。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·孟軻《孟子·梁惠王上》庖有肥肉，廄有肥馬，民有飢色，野有餓莩，此率獸而食人也。”
derivationEn: Pre-Qin, Mencius' 'Mencius: King Hui of Liang I': 'In the kitchen there is fat meat, in the stables there are fat horses, but the people have hungry looks, and in the fields there are dead bodies. This is leading animals to devour men.'
example: 是岁大荒百姓皆食枣菜，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》
exampleTraditional: 是歲大荒百姓皆食棗菜，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》
exampleEn: That year there was a great famine; the people ate dates and wild vegetables, and corpses of the starved were everywhere. ★ Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'

explanation: 刻写在心上骨上，形容记忆深刻，难以忘记。
explanationTraditional: 刻寫在心上骨上，形容記憶深刻，難以忘記。
explanationEn: Engraved on the heart and bones; describes an unforgettable memory or deep gratitude.
derivation: 唐·李白《上安州李长史书》深荷王公之德，铭刻心骨。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《上安州李長史書》深荷王公之德，銘刻心骨。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Bai's 'Letter to Governor Li of Anzhou': 'Deeply grateful for the king's virtue, engraved on heart and bones.'
example: 恩同海岳，～难忘。★明·李开先《林冲宝剑记》
exampleTraditional: 恩同海嶽，～難忘。★明·李開先《林沖寶劍記》
exampleEn: His kindness is as deep as the sea and mountains, unforgettable and engraved on my heart and bones. ★ Ming Dynasty, Li Kaixian's 'The Story of Lin Chong and the Sword'

explanation: 比喻追究底细。同刨根问底”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻追究底細。同刨根問底”。
explanationEn: To get to the bottom of something; to investigate thoroughly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 图地图；穷尽；见现。比喻事情发展到最后，真相或本意显露了出来。
explanationTraditional: 圖地圖；窮盡；見現。比喻事情發展到最後，真相或本意顯露了出來。
explanationEn: When the map is unrolled, the dagger is revealed. It means that when things develop to the end, the truth or true intention is exposed.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策三》秦王谓轲曰‘起，取武阳所持图。’轲既取图奉之。发图，图穷而匕首见。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策三》秦王謂軻曰‘起，取武陽所持圖。’軻既取圖奉之。發圖，圖窮而匕首見。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Yan Strategy III': 'The King of Qin said to Jing Ke, 'Get up, take the map that Wu Yang brought.' Jing Ke took the map and presented it. When the map was unrolled, the dagger was revealed.'
example: 不意先生乃蓄别抱，～，爰有斯言。（叶圣陶《一个青年》）
exampleTraditional: 不意先生乃蓄別抱，～，爰有斯言。（葉聖陶《一個青年》）
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, the gentleman had ulterior motives, and the dagger was revealed, hence these words. (Ye Shengtao, 'A Young Man')

explanation: 对平凡人物的蔑称。
explanationTraditional: 對平凡人物的蔑稱。
explanationEn: A derogatory term for an insignificant or unknown person.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指不满意的话；没有根据的话。
explanationTraditional: 指不滿意的話；沒有根據的話。
explanationEn: Unpleasant remarks; unfounded gossip.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 故事成例。照例应付，敷衍了事。指用敷衍的态度对待工作。
explanationTraditional: 故事成例。照例應付，敷衍了事。指用敷衍的態度對待工作。
explanationEn: To go through the motions; to do something perfunctorily or as a mere formality.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十一回他既自己情愿，你们代我著实重打，若再虚应故事，定要狗命。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十一回他既自己情願，你們代我著實重打，若再虛應故事，定要狗命。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 51: 'Since he is willing, you should beat him severely on my behalf. If you go through the motions again, I will surely have your dog's life.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 学海知识。学问的海洋无边无际。
explanationTraditional: 學海知識。學問的海洋無邊無際。
explanationEn: The ocean of learning is boundless; knowledge is infinite.
derivation: 明·张岱《小序》学海无边，书囊无底。世间书怎读得尽。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張岱《小序》學海無邊，書囊無底。世間書怎讀得盡。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Zhang Dai's 'Short Preface': 'The sea of learning has no shore, and the book bag has no bottom. How can one finish reading all the books in the world?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指某一时期的优秀人才。
explanationTraditional: 指某一時期的優秀人才。
explanationEn: An outstanding talent of a certain period.
derivation: 《新唐书·韦抗传》它所辟举，如王维、王缙、崔殷等，皆一时选云。”宋·曾巩《〈范宽之奏议集〉序》其所引拔以言为职者，如公，皆一时之选。”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·韋抗傳》它所辟舉，如王維、王縉、崔殷等，皆一時選雲。”宋·曾鞏《〈范寬之奏議集〉序》其所引拔以言為職者，如公，皆一時之選。”
derivationEn: From 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Wei Kang': 'The people he recommended, such as Wang Wei, Wang Jin, Cui Yin, etc., were all outstanding talents of the time.' Also from Song Dynasty Zeng Gong's 'Preface to Fan Kuangzhi's Memorials': 'Those he recommended for speech positions, like the Duke, were all outstanding talents of the time.'
example: 馀如兴平师夔……蓝田张德直、叶县刘从益皆清慎才敏，极～。★《金史·循吏传论》
exampleTraditional: 餘如興平師夔……藍田張德直、葉縣劉從益皆清慎才敏，極～。★《金史·循吏傳論》
exampleEn: Others like Xingping Shifu... Lantian Zhang Dezhi, Yexian Liu Congyi were all honest and capable, truly outstanding talents of the time. (From 'History of Jin: Biographies of Upright Officials')

explanation: 一看就明白。
explanationTraditional: 一看就明白。
explanationEn: To understand at a glance; to be obvious.
derivation: 清·李绿园《歧路灯》又说了一回话，大约言语甜俗，意味粗浅，中藏早是一望而知的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李綠園《歧路燈》又說了一回話，大約言語甜俗，意味粗淺，中藏早是一望而知的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Luyuan's 'The Road to the Lantern': 'After talking for a while, the words were sweet but vulgar, the meaning shallow, and the inner thoughts were obvious at a glance.'
example: 而且～情商也没用，因为客堂里都搭起床铺。★叶圣陶《潘先生在难中》
exampleTraditional: 而且～情商也沒用，因為客堂裡都搭起床鋪。★葉聖陶《潘先生在難中》
exampleEn: Moreover, it was obvious at a glance that emotional intelligence was useless, because beds were set up in the living room. (Ye Shengtao, 'Mr. Pan in Distress')

explanation: 月亮明亮时，星星就显得稀疏了。
explanationTraditional: 月亮明亮時，星星就顯得稀疏了。
explanationEn: When the moon is bright, the stars appear sparse.
derivation: 三国·魏·曹操《短歌行》月明星稀，乌鹊南飞。绕树三匝，何枝可依？”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·曹操《短歌行》月明星稀，烏鵲南飛。繞樹三匝，何枝可依？”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Wei Dynasty Cao Cao's 'Short Song Style': 'The moon is bright, the stars are sparse; magpies fly south. They circle the tree three times, but which branch can they rest on?'
example: 河湾子修堰坝的工地，～，小河水静静流入水渠。★李准《李双双》
exampleTraditional: 河灣子修堰壩的工地，～，小河水靜靜流入水渠。★李準《李雙雙》
exampleEn: At the river bend where the dam was being built, the moon was bright and the stars sparse, and the small river flowed quietly into the canal. (Li Zhun, 'Li Shuangshuang')

explanation: 邦泛指国家。使国家安定巩固。
explanationTraditional: 邦泛指國家。使國家安定鞏固。
explanationEn: To bring peace and stability to the country; to secure the state.
derivation: 宋·无名氏《新编五代史平话·周史》卷上我这剑要卖与烈士，大则安邦定国，小则御侮捍身，您孩儿每识个什么？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·無名氏《新編五代史平話·周史》捲上我這劍要賣與烈士，大則安邦定國，小則禦侮捍身，您孩兒每識個什麼？”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty anonymous 'New Edition of the History of the Five Dynasties: Zhou History', Volume 1: 'I want to sell this sword to a hero, for great purposes it can secure the state, for small purposes it can resist insults and protect the body. What do you children know?'
example: 荐贤举善是吾心，～访知音。★明·无名氏《伐晋兴齐》第一折
exampleTraditional: 薦賢舉善是吾心，～訪知音。★明·無名氏《伐晉興齊》第一折
exampleEn: Recommending the virtuous and promoting the good is my heart; to secure the state and find a confidant. (From Ming Dynasty anonymous 'Felling Jin and Reviving Qi', First Act)

explanation: 闭藏。使月亮躲藏，使花儿羞惭。形容女子容貌美丽。
explanationTraditional: 閉藏。使月亮躲藏，使花兒羞慚。形容女子容貌美麗。
explanationEn: Describes a woman's beauty that outshines the moon and shames flowers.
derivation: 元·王子一《误入桃源》第四折引动这撩云拨雨心，想起那闭月羞花貌，撇的似绕朱门燕子寻巢。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王子一《誤入桃源》第四折引動這撩雲撥雨心，想起那閉月羞花貌，撇的似繞朱門燕子尋巢。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'Mistaken Entry into Peach Blossom Spring' by Wang Ziyi.
example: 此时鲁小姐卸了浓装，换了几件雅淡衣服，蘧公子举眼细看，真有沉鱼落雁之容，～之貌。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十回
exampleTraditional: 此時魯小姐卸了濃裝，換了幾件雅淡衣服，蘧公子舉眼細看，真有沉魚落雁之容，～之貌。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十回
exampleEn: At that time, Miss Lu removed her heavy makeup and changed into simple clothes. Mr. Qu raised his eyes and looked carefully, truly having the appearance that sinks fish and drops wild geese, and the beauty that outshines the moon and shames flowers.

explanation: 九泉地下深处，旧指人死之后埋葬的地方。也作黄泉”。在九泉之下满含笑容。表示死后也感到欣慰和高兴。
explanationTraditional: 九泉地下深處，舊指人死之後埋葬的地方。也作黃泉”。在九泉之下滿含笑容。表示死後也感到欣慰和高興。
explanationEn: To be content and happy even after death, smiling in the underworld.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三回我儿前去，得能替我出半臂之劳，我亦含笑九泉。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三回我兒前去，得能替我出半臂之勞，我亦含笑九泉。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'Flowers in the Mirror' by Li Ruzhen.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为遭受冤屈而喊叫。
explanationTraditional: 為遭受冤屈而喊叫。
explanationEn: To cry out about grievances and injustices suffered.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第八十三回那宝蟾只管喊冤叫屈，那里理会他。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第八十三回那寶蟾只管喊冤叫屈，那裡理會他。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'Dream of the Red Chamber' by Cao Xueqin.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 储存粮食，防备饥荒。
explanationTraditional: 儲存糧食，防備饑荒。
explanationEn: To store grain to prevent famine; to save for future needs.
derivation: 元·高则诚《琵琶记·谏父》又道是养儿代老，积谷防饥。”
derivationTraditional: 元·高則誠《琵琶記·諫父》又道是養兒代老，積穀防饑。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'The Story of the Lute' by Gao Zecheng.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 两种事物同时出现或同时加在一个人身上，又惊又喜。
explanationTraditional: 兩種事物同時出現或同時加在一個人身上，又驚又喜。
explanationEn: To be filled with both surprise and joy simultaneously.
derivation: 金·董解元《西厢记》卷四生闻之，惊喜交集。”
derivationTraditional: 金·董解元《西廂記》卷四生聞之，驚喜交集。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty 'The Story of the Western Wing' by Dong Jieyuan.
example: 此时忽然的骨肉团圆，～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第八回
exampleTraditional: 此時忽然的骨肉團圓，～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第八回
exampleEn: At this moment, the sudden reunion of flesh and blood brought both surprise and joy.

explanation: 胯下两条腿之间。从胯下爬过的耻辱。
explanationTraditional: 胯下兩條腿之間。從胯下爬過的恥辱。
explanationEn: The humiliation of crawling between someone's legs; a great disgrace.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》淮阴屠中有侮信者，曰‘若虽长大，好带刀剑，中情怯耳。’众辱之曰‘信能死，刺我，不能死，出我胯下。’于是信孰视之，俛出胯下，蒲伏。一市人皆笑信，以为怯。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》淮陰屠中有侮信者，曰‘若雖長大，好帶刀劍，中情怯耳。’眾辱之曰‘信能死，刺我，不能死，出我胯下。’於是信孰視之，俛出胯下，蒲伏。一市人皆笑信，以為怯。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin' by Sima Qian.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 气味比喻性格和志趣；投投合。指人思想作风相同，彼此很合得来。
explanationTraditional: 氣味比喻性格和志趣；投投合。指人思想作風相同，彼此很合得來。
explanationEn: To have similar temperament and interests; to be kindred spirits.
derivation: 明·冯惟敏《天香引·送陈震南》气味相投，风情迥别，议论通玄。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮惟敏《天香引·送陳震南》氣味相投，風情迥別，議論通玄。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty 'Tianxiang Yin' by Feng Weimin.
example: 前者妹子同表妹舜英进京，曾与此女中途相遇，因他学问甚优，兼之～，所以结伴同行。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六十二回
exampleTraditional: 前者妹子同表妹舜英進京，曾與此女中途相遇，因他學問甚優，兼之～，所以結伴同行。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六十二回
exampleEn: Earlier, my cousin Shunying and I met this girl on the road. Because of her excellent learning and our similar temperament, we traveled together.

explanation: 形容双方就像水火一样互相对立，不能相容。
explanationTraditional: 形容雙方就像水火一樣互相對立，不能相容。
explanationEn: To be incompatible like fire and water; to be in total opposition.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀志·魏延传》惟杨仪不假借延，延以为至忿，有如水火。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀志·魏延傳》惟楊儀不假借延，延以為至忿，有如水火。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Wei Yan' by Chen Shou.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 物换景物变幻；星移星辰移位。景物改变了，星辰的位置也移动了。比喻时间的变化。
explanationTraditional: 物換景物變幻；星移星辰移位。景物改變了，星辰的位置也移動了。比喻時間的變化。
explanationEn: Things change and stars move; the passage of time brings changes.
derivation: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王阁饯别序》闲云潭影日悠悠，物换星移几度秋。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王閣餞別序》閒雲潭影日悠悠，物換星移幾度秋。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng' by Wang Bo.
example: 兔走乌飞，搬不尽古今兴废，急回来～，成就了凤鸾交莺燕侣。★元·王子一《误入桃源》第三折
exampleTraditional: 兔走烏飛，搬不盡古今興廢，急回來～，成就了鳳鸞交鶯燕侶。★元·王子一《誤入桃源》第三折
exampleEn: Time flies like an arrow, bringing endless changes of rise and fall; things change and stars move, fulfilling the union of phoenix and swallow.

explanation: 指刚强正直，勇敢热情的男子汉。
explanationTraditional: 指剛強正直，勇敢熱情的男子漢。
explanationEn: A man of strong character, integrity, and courage; a true man.
derivation: 明·名教中人《好逑传》第六回你小姐乃是闺阁中的须眉男子，我铁挺生也是个血性男儿。”
derivationTraditional: 明·名教中人《好逑傳》第六回你小姐乃是閨閣中的鬚眉男子，我鐵挺生也是個血性男兒。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty novel 'The Lucky Match' by Mingjiao Zhongren.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 决心永远牢记着。
explanationTraditional: 決心永遠牢記著。
explanationEn: Determined to remember forever.
derivation: 《诗经·卫风·考盘》独寐寤言，永矢弗谖。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·衛風·考盤》獨寐寤言，永矢弗諼。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs, Wei Feng, Kao Pan: 'Alone I sleep and wake, speaking my mind, determined never to forget.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 终日整天。整天吃饱饭，不动脑筋，不干什么正经事。
explanationTraditional: 終日整天。整天吃飽飯，不動腦筋，不幹什麼正經事。
explanationEn: To be well-fed all day without using one's mind or doing anything serious.
derivation: 《论语·阳货》饱食终日，无所用心，难矣哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·陽貨》飽食終日，無所用心，難矣哉！”
derivationEn: From The Analects, Yang Huo: 'To be well-fed all day without applying one's mind—how difficult it is!'
example: 人如果～，无所用心，那是最没有出息的。
exampleTraditional: 人如果～，無所用心，那是最沒有出息的。
exampleEn: If a person is well-fed all day without using their mind, they are the most hopeless.

explanation: 狼藉象狼窝里的草那样散乱。杯子盘子乱七八糟地放着。形容吃喝以后桌面杂乱的样子。
explanationTraditional: 狼藉象狼窩裡的草那樣散亂。杯子盤子亂七八糟地放著。形容吃喝以後桌面雜亂的樣子。
explanationEn: Cups and plates scattered messily, describing a messy table after eating and drinking.
derivation: 《史记·滑稽列传》日暮酒阑，合尊促坐，男女同席，履舄交错，杯盘狠藉。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·滑稽列傳》日暮酒闌，合尊促坐，男女同席，履舄交錯，杯盤狠藉。”
derivationEn: From Records of the Grand Historian, Biographies of Comedians: 'As dusk fell and the feast ended, cups and plates were in disarray.'
example: 这桌子微醺，那桌子半酣，～，言语喧哗。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第八十八回
exampleTraditional: 這桌子微醺，那桌子半酣，～，言語喧譁。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第八十八回
exampleEn: This table is slightly tipsy, that table half-drunk, cups and plates in disarray, voices and laughter mingling. — Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan, The Road to Enlightenment, Chapter 88

explanation: 惨淡暗淡。原指阴沉沉的云层遮得天色暗淡无光。也用以形容使人感到忧愁、压抑的景象或气氛。
explanationTraditional: 慘淡暗淡。原指陰沉沉的雲層遮得天色暗淡無光。也用以形容使人感到憂愁、壓抑的景象或氣氛。
explanationEn: Originally refers to dark clouds dimming the sky; also describes a sorrowful, oppressive scene or atmosphere.
derivation: 唐·岑参《白雪歌送武判官归京》翰海阑干百丈冰，愁云惨淡万里凝。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·岑參《白雪歌送武判官歸京》翰海闌干百丈冰，愁雲慘淡萬里凝。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Cen Shen's 'Song of White Snow in Farewell to Secretary Wu Going Back to the Capital': 'The desert is crossed with a hundred feet of ice, sorrowful clouds darken ten thousand miles.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 丹书用朱砂写字；铁契用铁制的凭证。古代帝王赐给功臣世代享受优遇或免罪的凭证。文凭用丹书写铁板上，故名。
explanationTraditional: 丹書用硃砂寫字；鐵契用鐵製的憑證。古代帝王賜給功臣世代享受優遇或免罪的憑證。文憑用丹書寫鐵板上，故名。
explanationEn: A certificate written in cinnabar on an iron tablet, granted by ancient emperors to meritorious officials for privileges or exemption from punishment.
derivation: 《后汉书·祭遵传》丹书铁券，传于无穷。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·祭遵傳》丹書鐵券，傳於無窮。”
derivationEn: From Book of the Later Han, Biography of Zun Zun: 'The iron certificate in cinnabar writing, passed down endlessly.'
example: 先朝赐有～，安居乐业。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第二十七回
exampleTraditional: 先朝賜有～，安居樂業。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第二十七回
exampleEn: The previous dynasty granted an iron certificate in cinnabar, allowing a peaceful and happy life. — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, Sequel to Water Margin, Chapter 27

explanation: 耳边无事噪聒。指无事打扰。
explanationTraditional: 耳邊無事噪聒。指無事打擾。
explanationEn: No noise or disturbance around the ears; free from trouble.
derivation: 《集论》卷一何等耳根？谓四大种所造，耳识所依清静色。”
derivationTraditional: 《集論》卷一何等耳根？謂四大種所造，耳識所依清靜色。”
derivationEn: From Collected Treatises, Volume 1: 'What is the ear faculty? It is the pure form created by the four great elements, the basis of auditory consciousness.'
example: 张海棠也，自从嫁了员外，好～也呵。★元·李行道《灰阑记》第一折
exampleTraditional: 張海棠也，自從嫁了員外，好～也呵。★元·李行道《灰闌記》第一折
exampleEn: Zhang Haitang, since marrying the squire, my ears have been at peace. — Yuan Dynasty, Li Xingdao, The Chalk Circle, Act 1

explanation: 讲传宗教经典，宣扬宗教教义。亦指引经据典地谈说议论。
explanationTraditional: 講傳宗教經典，宣揚宗教教義。亦指引經據典地談說議論。
explanationEn: To expound religious scriptures and preach religious doctrines; also to discuss and argue citing classics.
derivation: 《西游记·南游记》第一回到今日来，灵山兴旺，今十大弟子，讲经说法。”
derivationTraditional: 《西遊記·南遊記》第一回到今日來，靈山興旺，今十大弟子，講經說法。”
derivationEn: From Journey to the West, Southern Journey, Chapter 1: 'To this day, the Spirit Mountain thrives, and the ten great disciples expound scriptures and preach doctrines.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 料预料。预料事情象神仙一样准确。形容预料事情非常准确。
explanationTraditional: 料預料。預料事情象神仙一樣準確。形容預料事情非常準確。
explanationEn: To predict events as accurately as a god; extremely accurate in foreseeing things.
derivation: 宋·杨万里《提刑徽猷检正王公墓志铭》公器识宏深，襟度宽博，议论施加人数等，料事如神，物无遁情。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·楊萬里《提刑徽猷檢正王公墓誌銘》公器識宏深，襟度寬博，議論施加人數等，料事如神，物無遁情。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Yang Wanli's 'Epitaph for Wang Gong': 'His insight was profound, his mind broad, his discussions surpassed others, he predicted events like a god, nothing escaped him.'
example: 我又不能～，除了硬挺之外，总不免要吃点小亏。★清·吴趼人《近十年之怪现状》第四回
exampleTraditional: 我又不能～，除了硬挺之外，總不免要吃點小虧。★清·吳趼人《近十年之怪現狀》第四回
exampleEn: I cannot predict events like a god; besides enduring, I inevitably suffer a little loss. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, Strange Events of the Last Decade, Chapter 4

explanation: 没齿终身。一辈子也忘不了。
explanationTraditional: 沒齒終身。一輩子也忘不了。
explanationEn: Unforgettable for a lifetime; never to be forgotten.
derivation: 唐·李商隐《为汝南公华州贺赦表》司马谈阙陪盛礼，没齿难忘。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李商隱《為汝南公華州賀赦表》司馬談闕陪盛禮，沒齒難忘。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Li Shangyin's 'Memorial for the Prince of Runan': 'Sima Tan missed the grand ceremony, unforgettable for life.'
example: 遽然拆散更堞怜，何时结草报衔环，～感二天。★明·杨柔胜《玉环记·范张别皋》
exampleTraditional: 遽然拆散更堞憐，何時結草報銜環，～感二天。★明·楊柔勝《玉環記·範張別皋》
exampleEn: Suddenly separated, how pitiful! When will I repay kindness with grass and rings? Grateful and unforgettable for life. — Ming Dynasty, Yang Rousheng, The Jade Ring, Fan Zhang Farewell

explanation: 比喻不必要的或缺乏根据的忧虑和担心。同杞人忧天”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻不必要的或缺乏根據的憂慮和擔心。同杞人憂天”。
explanationEn: Unnecessary or groundless worry and anxiety; same as 'the man of Qi worried about the sky falling'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 有都能的人不容易得到。多指要爱惜人才。
explanationTraditional: 有都能的人不容易得到。多指要愛惜人才。
explanationEn: Talented people are hard to come by. Often used to emphasize the need to cherish talent.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《谢宣召入院状》首择辅臣，次求法从，知人才之难得，采虚名而用。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《謝宣召入院狀》首擇輔臣，次求法從，知人才之難得，採虛名而用。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Xie Xuanzhao Ruyuan Zhuang': 'First select ministers, then seek legal advisors, knowing that talent is rare, and employ them based on empty reputation.'
example: 一则也是他福至心灵，处处懂得巴结；二则也是～，近来居然升了二买办了。★清·吴趼人《发屠秘诀》第九回
exampleTraditional: 一則也是他福至心靈，處處懂得巴結；二則也是～，近來居然升了二買辦了。★清·吳趼人《發屠秘訣》第九回
exampleEn: On one hand, he was blessed with intelligence and knew how to flatter; on the other hand, talent was rare, and he had recently been promoted to second purchasing manager. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Fa Tu Mi Jue', Chapter 9

explanation: 好象丢了什么似的。形容心神不定的样子。也形容心里感到空虚。
explanationTraditional: 好象丟了什麼似的。形容心神不定的樣子。也形容心裡感到空虛。
explanationEn: As if something is lost. Describes a state of restlessness or feeling of emptiness.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·黄九郎》生邑邑若有所失，忘啜废枕，日渐委悴。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·黃九郎》生邑邑若有所失，忘啜廢枕，日漸委悴。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Huang Jiuniang': 'He felt dejected as if he had lost something, forgot to eat and sleep, and gradually became emaciated.'
example: 他整天必事重重，～。
exampleTraditional: 他整天必事重重，～。
exampleEn: He was preoccupied all day, as if he had lost something.

explanation: 五岳泰山、华山、衡山、嵩山、恒山。泛指名山或各地。
explanationTraditional: 五嶽泰山、華山、衡山、嵩山、恆山。泛指名山或各地。
explanationEn: Refers to famous mountains or various places. 'Three Mountains' and 'Five Sacred Mountains' (Mount Tai, Mount Hua, Mount Heng, Mount Song, Mount Heng).
derivation: 清·曹寅《舟中望惠山举酒调培山》三山五岳渺何许？云烟汗漫空竛竮。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹寅《舟中望惠山舉酒調培山》三山五嶽渺何許？雲煙汗漫空竛竮。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Yin's 'Boat Trip to Huishan, Toasting Peishan': 'Where are the Three Mountains and Five Sacred Mountains? Vast clouds and mist drift aimlessly.'
example: ～的好汉们各引着同宗同派，摆开了阵势，拚一个你死我活。★茅盾《我们这文坛》
exampleTraditional: ～的好漢們各引著同宗同派，擺開了陣勢，拚一個你死我活。★茅盾《我們這文壇》
exampleEn: Heroes from all over, each leading their own factions, arrayed their forces to fight to the death. — Mao Dun, 'Our Literary World'

explanation: 识字。指有一点文化知识。
explanationTraditional: 識字。指有一點文化知識。
explanationEn: Literate. Refers to having some basic education.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十八回当着人家识文断字的人儿呢？别抡荤，看人家笑话。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十八回當著人家識文斷字的人兒呢？別掄葷，看人家笑話。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 38: 'In front of a literate person, don't be crude, lest you be laughed at.'
example: 你看，先父是个举人，我自幼就～。★老舍《女店员》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 你看，先父是個舉人，我自幼就～。★老舍《女店員》第一幕
exampleEn: You see, my late father was a juren, and I have been literate since childhood. — Lao She, 'The Salesgirls', Act 1

explanation: 比喻同胞的兄弟姐妹。
explanationTraditional: 比喻同胞的兄弟姐妹。
explanationEn: Metaphor for siblings.
derivation: 南朝梁·周兴嗣《千字文》孔怀兄弟，同气连枝。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝梁·周興嗣《千字文》孔懷兄弟，同氣連枝。”
derivationEn: Southern Liang Dynasty, Zhou Xingsi's 'Thousand Character Classic': 'Brothers are of the same breath and connected branches.'
example: 我自然爱我的弟弟，我们原是～的。★冰心《寄小读者·横滨》
exampleTraditional: 我自然愛我的弟弟，我們原是～的。★冰心《寄小讀者·橫濱》
exampleEn: I naturally love my younger brother, for we are siblings. — Bing Xin, 'To Little Readers: Yokohama'

explanation: 宏大；旨意义，目的⊥主要意思没有关系。指意义不大或关系不大。
explanationTraditional: 宏大；旨意義，目的⊥主要意思沒有關係。指意義不大或關係不大。
explanationEn: Of little significance or relevance. 'Hong' means great, 'zhi' means purpose or meaning.
derivation: 章炳麟《答梦庵》《大乘缘起说》者，无过考证之文，不关宏旨。”
derivationTraditional: 章炳麟《答夢庵》《大乘緣起說》者，無過考證之文，不關宏旨。”
derivationEn: Zhang Binglin's 'Answering Meng'an': 'The theory of Mahayana origin is nothing more than textual research, not of great significance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 就里其中，内情。不知道内幕。
explanationTraditional: 就裡其中，內情。不知道內幕。
explanationEn: Unaware of the inside story. 'Jiuli' means internal details.
derivation: 清·宣鼎《夜雨秋灯录·麻疯女邱丽玉》生不知就里，趋近软语，代为卸妆。”
derivationTraditional: 清·宣鼎《夜雨秋燈錄·麻瘋女邱麗玉》生不知就裡，趨近軟語，代為卸妝。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Xuan Ding's 'Night Rain and Autumn Lamp: Qiu Liren': 'The scholar, unaware of the inside story, approached softly and helped her remove her makeup.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 参差长短、高低、大小不一致。错落交错、交织的样子。各种不同的事物，错综复杂地交织在一起。
explanationTraditional: 參差長短、高低、大小不一致。錯落交錯、交織的樣子。各種不同的事物，錯綜複雜地交織在一起。
explanationEn: Irregular and interwoven. Describes various things mixed together in a complex way.
derivation: 《史记·滑稽列传》臣饮一斗亦醉，一石亦醉。……饮五六斗……八斗而醉。”《古文观止》注上云，一斗一石，此又添二斗、五六斗，八斗，参差错落。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·滑稽列傳》臣飲一斗亦醉，一石亦醉。……飲五六鬥……八斗而醉。”《古文觀止》註上雲，一斗一石，此又添二斗、五六鬥，八斗，參差錯落。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Jesters': 'I can get drunk with one dou or one shi... five or six dou... eight dou.' Annotated in 'Guwen Guanzhi': 'One dou, one shi, then two dou, five or six dou, eight dou, irregular and interwoven.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 果结果；因原因。把结果当成原因，颠倒了因果关系。
explanationTraditional: 果結果；因原因。把結果當成原因，顛倒了因果關係。
explanationEn: Reversing cause and effect. Treating the result as the cause.
derivation: 鲁迅《坟·科学史教篇》日颂当前之结果，于学者独恝然而置之，倒果为因，莫此为甚。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《墳·科學史教篇》日頌當前之結果，於學者獨恝然而置之，倒果為因，莫此為甚。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'Grave: History of Science': 'Praising the current results while ignoring scholars, reversing cause and effect, nothing is worse than this.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心宫室中心；角檐角。原指宫室建筑结构的交错和精巧◇比喻用尽心机，明争暗斗。
explanationTraditional: 心宮室中心；角簷角。原指宮室建築結構的交錯和精巧◇比喻用盡心機，明爭暗鬥。
explanationEn: Originally described the intricate and exquisite structure of palace buildings. Later used metaphorically to mean scheming against each other.
derivation: 唐·杜牧《阿房宫赋》各报地势，钩心斗角。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜牧《阿房宮賦》各報地勢，鉤心鬥角。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Du Mu's 'Epang Palace Fu': 'Each building vied for position, with interlocking hearts and contending eaves.'
example: 但他人谁会想到他为了争一点无聊的名声，竟肯如此～，无所不至呢。（鲁迅《两地书》十五）
exampleTraditional: 但他人誰會想到他為了爭一點無聊的名聲，竟肯如此～，無所不至呢。（魯迅《兩地書》十五）
exampleEn: But who would have thought that for a bit of insignificant fame, he would go to such lengths of scheming? — Lu Xun, 'Two Places', Letter 15

explanation: 指新奇的技艺和作品。
explanationTraditional: 指新奇的技藝和作品。
explanationEn: Novel and ingenious skills or works, often with a negative connotation of being excessively ornate or frivolous.
derivation: 《书·泰誓下》作奇技淫巧，以悦妇人。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·泰誓下》作奇技淫巧，以悅婦人。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Oath of Tai Shi' (《书·泰誓下》): 'They made strange inventions and cunning devices to please women.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容愤恨到极点。
explanationTraditional: 形容憤恨到極點。
explanationEn: To hate with extreme bitterness, to the point of gnashing one's teeth.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 饱经战争创作的人，对侵略者是切齿痛恨的。
exampleTraditional: 飽經戰爭創作的人，對侵略者是切齒痛恨的。
exampleEn: Those who have suffered from war gnash their teeth in hatred against the aggressors.

explanation: 天外意料不到的地方◇指事情出乎意料地发生，凭空而来。
explanationTraditional: 天外意料不到的地方◇指事情出乎意料地發生，憑空而來。
explanationEn: Something that comes unexpectedly, as if from beyond the sky; an unforeseen event or occurrence.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在树干上添上些枝叶。比喻叙述事情或转述别人的话，为了夸大，添上原来没有的内容。
explanationTraditional: 在樹幹上添上些枝葉。比喻敘述事情或轉述別人的話，為了誇大，添上原來沒有的內容。
explanationEn: To add branches and leaves to a tree; figuratively, to embellish a story or add false details to exaggerate.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《答黄子耕》今人生出重重障碍，添枝接叶，无有了期。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《答黃子耕》今人生出重重障礙，添枝接葉，無有了期。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's 'Reply to Huang Zigen' (宋·朱熹《答黄子耕》): 'Now people create many obstacles, adding branches and leaves without end.'
example: 杨子荣为了消磨时间，大为～，渲染逗趣。★曲波《林海雪原》十七
exampleTraditional: 楊子榮為了消磨時間，大為～，渲染逗趣。★曲波《林海雪原》十七
exampleEn: To kill time, Yang Zirong greatly embellished the story, adding details for amusement. (from Qu Bo's 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', chapter 17)

explanation: 泛指文人、文士。
explanationTraditional: 泛指文人、文士。
explanationEn: Literati and scholars; men of letters.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①形容树木华美。②比喻贵家子弟。
explanationTraditional: ①形容樹木華美。②比喻貴家子弟。
explanationEn: ① Describes trees as beautiful as jade and coral. ② A metaphor for children of noble or wealthy families.
derivation: 唐·李煜《破阵子》词凤阙龙楼连霄汉，玉树琼枝作烟萝，几曾识干戈。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李煜《破陣子》詞鳳闕龍樓連霄漢，玉樹瓊枝作煙蘿，幾曾識干戈。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu's poem 'Po Zhen Zi' (唐·李煜《破阵子》): 'Phoenix towers and dragon pavilions reach the sky, jade trees and coral branches like misty vines, how could they know war?'
example: 愁肠种种，种种难消受。我是～，到做风中飞柳，堪忧。★明·杨琫《龙膏记·砥节》
exampleTraditional: 愁腸種種，種種難消受。我是～，到做風中飛柳，堪憂。★明·楊琫《龍膏記·砥節》
exampleEn: My sorrows are many, hard to bear. I, once a jade tree and coral branch, am now like a willow in the wind, pitiful. (from Ming drama 'Long Gao Ji' by Yang Jiong)

explanation: 四个地支。多指事理。
explanationTraditional: 四個地支。多指事理。
explanationEn: The first four Earthly Branches; often used to refer to the basics or details of a matter.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷五曰‘如何是十二时？’师曰‘子丑寅卯。’僧礼拜。师 示颂曰‘十二时中那事别，子丑寅卯吾今说。若会唯心万法空，释迦、弥勒从兹决 。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷五曰‘如何是十二時？’師曰‘子醜寅卯。’僧禮拜。師 示頌曰‘十二時中那事別，子醜寅卯吾今說。若會唯心萬法空，釋迦、彌勒從茲決 。’”
derivationEn: From 'Five Lamps Meeting the Source' (宋·释普济《五灯会元》): 'Someone asked: What are the twelve hours? The master said: Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao. The monk bowed. The master recited a verse: In the twelve hours, things differ; Zi, Chou, Yin, Mao I now explain. If you understand that all dharmas are empty, Sakyamuni and Maitreya will decide from this.'
example: 他对此事说不出个子丑寅卯。
exampleTraditional: 他對此事說不出個子醜寅卯。
exampleEn: He couldn't explain the ins and outs of the matter.

explanation: 再不做坏事，决心做好人。
explanationTraditional: 再不做壞事，決心做好人。
explanationEn: To abandon evil and follow good; to reform and become a good person.
derivation: 《飞龙全传》二十一回应该隐姓埋名，改恶从善，才是正理。”
derivationTraditional: 《飛龍全傳》二十一回應該隱姓埋名，改惡從善，才是正理。”
derivationEn: From 'The Complete Tale of Feilong' (《飞龙全传》): 'One should hide one's name, abandon evil and follow good, that is the right way.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容愤怒之极，无法抑制。
explanationTraditional: 形容憤怒之極，無法抑制。
explanationEn: Blazing with anger; fury that reaches the sky, describing extreme rage.
derivation: 老舍《龙须沟》第一幕［程娘子］怒火冲天，不顾一切地冲向狗子拚命，却被狗子一把抓住。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《龍鬚溝》第一幕［程娘子］怒火沖天，不顧一切地衝向狗子拚命，卻被狗子一把抓住。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Dragon Beard Ditch' (老舍《龙须沟》): 'Cheng Niangzi, with fury reaching the sky, rushed at Gouzi regardless of everything, but was grabbed by him.'
example: 他登时～，霍地立起身来……一阵猛扫，把四五个敌人都打倒了。★魏巍《东方》第五部第六章
exampleTraditional: 他登時～，霍地立起身來……一陣猛掃，把四五個敵人都打倒了。★魏巍《東方》第五部第六章
exampleEn: He immediately flew into a towering rage, stood up... and swept a burst of fire, knocking down four or five enemies. (from Wei Wei's 'East', Part 5, Chapter 6)

explanation: 泰山东岳，在山东省泰安市；北斗北斗星。比喻道德高、名望重或有卓越成就为众人所敬仰的人。
explanationTraditional: 泰山東嶽，在山東省泰安市；北斗北斗星。比喻道德高、名望重或有卓越成就為眾人所敬仰的人。
explanationEn: Mount Tai and the Big Dipper; a metaphor for a person of great virtue, high prestige, or outstanding achievements who is revered by all.
derivation: 《新唐书·韩愈传赞》自愈没，其言大行，学者仰之如泰山北斗云。”
