derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·韓愈傳贊》自愈沒，其言大行，學者仰之如泰山北斗雲。”
derivationEn: From 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Han Yu' (《新唐书·韩愈传赞》): 'Since Han Yu's death, his words have prevailed, and scholars look up to him as Mount Tai and the Big Dipper.'
example: 五兄梦中题孔子庙棂星门柱联有～，景星庆云”之语，敬意如此者，士之望、人之瑞，一代不过数人。★清·恽敬《答姚秋农书》
exampleTraditional: 五兄夢中題孔子廟欞星門柱聯有～，景星慶雲”之語，敬意如此者，士之望、人之瑞，一代不過數人。★清·惲敬《答姚秋農書》
exampleEn: In a dream, Brother Wu wrote a couplet on the pillars of the Confucius Temple: 'Mount Tai and the Big Dipper, auspicious star and cloud.' Such respect shows that he is the hope of scholars, the fortune of the age, only a few in a generation. (from Qing Dynasty Yun Jing's 'Reply to Yao Qiunong')

explanation: 惺惺虚伪的样子。故意做出一种姿态。形容虚伪不老实。
explanationTraditional: 惺惺虛偽的樣子。故意做出一種姿態。形容虛偽不老實。
explanationEn: To put on a hypocritical act; to be insincere and pretentious.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他偏偏爱～。
exampleTraditional: 他偏偏愛～。
exampleEn: He especially likes to put on a hypocritical act.

explanation: 已经约定好了。指事情的处理方案已事先定好。
explanationTraditional: 已經約定好了。指事情的處理方案已事先定好。
explanationEn: To have a prior agreement; something has been arranged beforehand.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 跃跳。跳上骏马，举起马鞭。形容扬鞭催马急驰而去的样子。也比喻热火朝天地进行建设。
explanationTraditional: 躍跳。跳上駿馬，舉起馬鞭。形容揚鞭催馬急馳而去的樣子。也比喻熱火朝天地進行建設。
explanationEn: To leap onto a horse and raise the whip; to ride off at full speed. Also metaphorically means to carry out construction with great enthusiasm.
derivation: 元·王实甫《丽春堂》第一折一个个跃马扬鞭，插箭弯弓。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《麗春堂》第一折一個個躍馬揚鞭，插箭彎弓。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing' (Yuan Dynasty): 'Each one leaps onto a horse and raises the whip, with arrows inserted and bows drawn.'
example: 亲承顾命赈饥荒，～到此方。★明·高则诚《琵琶记·义仓赈济》
exampleTraditional: 親承顧命賑饑荒，～到此方。★明·高則誠《琵琶記·義倉賑濟》
exampleEn: Having personally received the imperial order to relieve the famine, I leap onto my horse and raise my whip to come here. — Ming Dynasty, Gao Zecheng's 'The Story of the Lute'

explanation: 仗义讲义气；疏财分散家财。旧指讲义气，拿出自己的钱财来帮助别人。
explanationTraditional: 仗義講義氣；疏財分散家財。舊指講義氣，拿出自己的錢財來幫助別人。
explanationEn: To be chivalrous and generous with one's money; to help others by giving away one's wealth.
derivation: 元·无名氏《来生债》第四折则为我救困扶危，疏财仗义，都做了注福消愆。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《來生債》第四折則為我救困扶危，疏財仗義，都做了注福消愆。”
derivationEn: From an anonymous Yuan Dynasty play 'The Debt of the Next Life': 'Because I help the needy and relieve the distressed, and give away my wealth for justice, I have accumulated blessings and reduced sins.'
example: 自己只是在家中广行善事，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 自己只是在家中廣行善事，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十
exampleEn: He himself only does good deeds at home, being chivalrous and generous with his money. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement'

explanation: 抹角挨着墙角绕走。沿着弯弯曲曲的路走。比喻说话绕弯，不直截了当。
explanationTraditional: 抹角挨著牆角繞走。沿著彎彎曲曲的路走。比喻說話繞彎，不直截了當。
explanationEn: To go along winding paths; to speak in a roundabout way, not directly.
derivation: 元·秦简夫《东堂老》转弯抹角，可早来到李家门前。”
derivationTraditional: 元·秦簡夫《東堂老》轉彎抹角，可早來到李家門前。”
derivationEn: From Qin Jianfu's 'The Eastern Hall Elder' (Yuan Dynasty): 'Turning corners and going around bends, we soon arrive at Li's front door.'
example: 他说话总是直来直去，从不～。
exampleTraditional: 他說話總是直來直去，從不～。
exampleEn: He always speaks directly and never beats around the bush.

explanation: 漫漫无边际的样子。漫长的黑夜无边无际。多用来比喻社会的黑暗。
explanationTraditional: 漫漫無邊際的樣子。漫長的黑夜無邊無際。多用來比喻社會的黑暗。
explanationEn: The long night is endless; often used metaphorically to describe social darkness.
derivation: 《淮南子·宁戚〈饭牛歌〉》生不逢尧与舜禅，短布单衣才至骭，从昏饭牛薄夜半，长夜漫漫何时旦。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·甯戚〈飯牛歌〉》生不逢堯與舜禪，短布單衣才至骭，從昏飯牛薄夜半，長夜漫漫何時旦。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi' and Ning Qi's 'Song of the Oxherd': 'Born not in the times of Yao and Shun, wearing short cloth clothes barely covering the shins, feeding the ox from dusk till midnight, the long night is endless, when will dawn come?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 陇指甘肃一带；蜀指四川一带。已经取得陇右，还想攻取西蜀。比喻贪得无厌。
explanationTraditional: 隴指甘肅一帶；蜀指四川一帶。已經取得隴右，還想攻取西蜀。比喻貪得無厭。
explanationEn: To have insatiable desires; after gaining one thing, to covet another.
derivation: 《后汉书·岑彭传》人苦不知足，既平陇，复望蜀，每一发兵，头鬓为白。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·岑彭傳》人苦不知足，既平隴，復望蜀，每一發兵，頭鬢為白。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Cen Peng': 'People suffer from not knowing contentment; having pacified Long, they look to Shu. Every time troops are sent, the hair on the temples turns white.'
example: 我很希望兄有空，再画几幅，虽然太有些～。★《鲁迅书信集·致陶元庆》
exampleTraditional: 我很希望兄有空，再畫幾幅，雖然太有些～。★《魯迅書信集·致陶元慶》
exampleEn: I hope you have time to draw a few more pictures, although it might be a bit greedy. — From 'Lu Xun's Letters to Tao Yuanqing'

explanation: 盖世压倒当世。超出当代所有的人。用以形容非常杰出的英雄人物。
explanationTraditional: 蓋世壓倒當世。超出當代所有的人。用以形容非常傑出的英雄人物。
explanationEn: A hero who surpasses all others in the world; an outstanding heroic figure.
derivation: 元·无名氏《马陵道》第一折遮莫他盖世英雄，驱兵拥众。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《馬陵道》第一折遮莫他蓋世英雄，驅兵擁眾。”
derivationEn: From an anonymous Yuan Dynasty play 'The Strategy of Sun Bin': 'Even if he is a hero who surpasses the world, leading troops and gathering crowds...'
example: 是～，始信短如春梦。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十九回
exampleTraditional: 是～，始信短如春夢。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十九回
exampleEn: He is a hero who surpasses the world, but his life is as short as a spring dream. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines'

explanation: 夸父古传说中的人名。夸父拚命追赶太阳。比喻人有大志，也比喻不自量力。
explanationTraditional: 夸父古傳說中的人名。夸父拚命追趕太陽。比喻人有大志，也比喻不自量力。
explanationEn: Kuafu chasing the sun; metaphorically describes someone with great ambition or someone who overestimates their abilities.
derivation: 《列子·汤问》夸父不量力，欲追日影，逐之于隅谷之际。渴欲 得饮，赴饮河渭∮渭不足，将走北饮大泽。未至，道渴而死。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·湯問》夸父不量力，欲追日影，逐之於隅谷之際。渴欲 得飲，赴飲河渭∮渭不足，將走北飲大澤。未至，道渴而死。”
derivationEn: From 'Liezi: Tang Wen': 'Kuafu, not measuring his strength, wanted to chase the sun's shadow and pursued it to the corner of the valley. Thirsty, he wanted to drink, so he went to the Yellow River and the Wei River; the rivers were not enough, so he went north to drink from the Great Lake. Before reaching it, he died of thirst on the way.'
example: 真谓～，必渴死者也。★南朝·宋·僧愍《戎华论折顾道士夷夏论》
exampleTraditional: 真謂～，必渴死者也。★南朝·宋·僧愍《戎華論折顧道士夷夏論》
exampleEn: Truly, it can be said that Kuafu chasing the sun will surely die of thirst. — Southern Dynasty, Seng Min's 'On the Barbarians'

explanation: 利害所关。指有密切的利害关系。
explanationTraditional: 利害所關。指有密切的利害關係。
explanationEn: To be closely related to one's interests; to have a vital stake in something.
derivation: 《周礼·夏宫·职方氏》周知其利害。”
derivationTraditional: 《周禮·夏宮·職方氏》周知其利害。”
derivationEn: From 'Rites of Zhou: Summer Offices: Zhi Fang Shi': 'To know the advantages and disadvantages of the Zhou.'
example: 解决环境污染问题，是与人民健康～的一件大事。
exampleTraditional: 解決環境汙染問題，是與人民健康～的一件大事。
exampleEn: Solving environmental pollution is a matter of vital importance to people's health.

explanation: 比喻乱闯乱碰的人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻亂闖亂碰的人。
explanationEn: A person who rushes around aimlessly or blindly.
derivation: 清·俞万春《荡寇志》第97回上年往东京买卖，与那个没头苍蝇牛信曾相认识。”
derivationTraditional: 清·俞萬春《蕩寇志》第97回上年往東京買賣，與那個沒頭蒼蠅牛信曾相認識。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Yu Wanchun's 'Quelling the Bandits' Chapter 97: 'Last year, when I went to Tokyo for business, I got to know that headless fly Niu Xin.'
example: 没有训练的部队是乌合之众，不讲战术的指挥员是～。★《刘伯承回忆录·治军必先治校》
exampleTraditional: 沒有訓練的部隊是烏合之眾，不講戰術的指揮員是～。★《劉伯承回憶錄·治軍必先治校》
exampleEn: An untrained army is a mob, and a commander who doesn't use tactics is a headless fly. ★ Liu Bocheng's Memoirs: Governing the Army Must First Govern the School

explanation: 形容弯曲多。
explanationTraditional: 形容彎曲多。
explanationEn: Describes something very winding or crooked.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 舍身舍弃身体；求法寻求佛法。原指佛教徒不惜牺牲自己，远道求经◇比喻为了追求真理而不惜牺牲自己。
explanationTraditional: 捨身捨棄身體；求法尋求佛法。原指佛教徒不惜犧牲自己，遠道求經◇比喻為了追求真理而不惜犧牲自己。
explanationEn: Originally refers to Buddhists sacrificing themselves to seek scriptures; metaphorically means sacrificing oneself for truth.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文·中国人失掉自信了吗》我们从古以来，就有埋头苦干的人，有拼命硬干的人，有为民请命的人，有舍身求法的人。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文·中國人失掉自信了嗎》我們從古以來，就有埋頭苦幹的人，有拼命硬幹的人，有為民請命的人，有捨身求法的人。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Have the Chinese Lost Their Self-Confidence?': 'Since ancient times, we have had those who worked hard, those who fought tenaciously, those who pleaded for the people, and those who sacrificed themselves for truth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 食物虽在口中但咽不下去。形容忧心忡忡，不思饮食。
explanationTraditional: 食物雖在口中但咽不下去。形容憂心忡忡，不思飲食。
explanationEn: Food cannot be swallowed; describes being so worried that one cannot eat.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《张中丞传后叙》霁云（南霁云）慷慨语曰‘云来时，睢阳之人不食月余日矣！云虽欲独食，义不忍；虽食，且不下咽。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《張中丞傳後敘》霽雲（南霽雲）慷慨語曰‘雲來時，睢陽之人不食月餘日矣！雲雖欲獨食，義不忍；雖食，且不下嚥。’”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's 'Postscript to the Biography of Zhang Xun': 'Ji Yun said with emotion: When I came, the people of Suiyang had not eaten for over a month! Though I want to eat alone, righteousness forbids it; even if I eat, I cannot swallow.'
example: 这顿饭虽说也有鸡、鸭、鱼、肉，可是当伙计的都提心吊胆，～。★欧阳山《苦斗》七三
exampleTraditional: 這頓飯雖說也有雞、鴨、魚、肉，可是當夥計的都提心吊膽，～。★歐陽山《苦鬥》七三
exampleEn: Although the meal had chicken, duck, fish, and meat, the waiters were all on tenterhooks and couldn't swallow. ★ Ouyang Shan's 'Bitter Struggle' Chapter 73

explanation: 比喻为找某种东西历尽困难，花费极大的力气。
explanationTraditional: 比喻為找某種東西曆盡困難，花費極大的力氣。
explanationEn: To go through great hardships and efforts in search of something.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》正是踏破铁鞋无觅处，得来全不费工夫！”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》正是踏破鐵鞋無覓處，得來全不費工夫！”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World': 'Just as one wears out iron shoes in vain, yet finds it without any effort.'
example: 各种工具书，宁可备而不用，比临时手忙脚乱、～，得不到恰当解决。★曹靖华《飞花集·叹往昔·独木桥头徘徊无终期》
exampleTraditional: 各種工具書，寧可備而不用，比臨時手忙腳亂、～，得不到恰當解決。★曹靖華《飛花集·嘆往昔·獨木橋頭徘徊無終期》
exampleEn: It's better to have various reference books on hand even if unused, than to be flustered and wear out iron shoes without finding a proper solution. ★ Cao Jinghua's 'Collection of Flying Flowers: Sighing the Past, Wandering Alone at the Single-Plank Bridge Without End'

explanation: 枉白白地，徒然。白费心思。
explanationTraditional: 枉白白地，徒然。白費心思。
explanationEn: To waste one's mental efforts; to rack one's brains in vain.
derivation: 元·无名氏《隔江斗智》第二折你使这般科段，敢可也枉用心机。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《隔江鬥智》第二折你使這般科段，敢可也枉用心機。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'Stratagem Across the River' Act 2: 'Even if you use such tricks, you are just wasting your mental efforts.'
example: ～空费力，雪消春水一场空。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第四十回
exampleTraditional: ～空費力，雪消春水一場空。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第四十回
exampleEn: Wasting mental efforts in vain, like snow melting in spring water, all comes to nothing. ★ Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 40

explanation: 威信威望和信誉。威望、信誉全部丧失。比喻威望和信誉完全丧失。
explanationTraditional: 威信威望和信譽。威望、信譽全部喪失。比喻威望和信譽完全喪失。
explanationEn: Complete loss of prestige and credibility.
derivation: 杨朔《世界之王”》有心勾销这次旅行吧，那就会威信扫地，还是得硬着头皮去碰一碰。”
derivationTraditional: 楊朔《世界之王”》有心勾銷這次旅行吧，那就會威信掃地，還是得硬著頭皮去碰一碰。”
derivationEn: From Yang Shuo's 'The King of the World': 'If I cancel this trip, I will lose all prestige; I still have to grit my teeth and go.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 远远地对着。多形容两样事物的性质或形状相类似，配得上。
explanationTraditional: 遠遠地對著。多形容兩樣事物的性質或形狀相類似，配得上。
explanationEn: To face each other from a distance; often describes two things that are similar in nature or form and match each other.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第五十六回两边行军队伍，已分为甲乙两垒，大家占着一块地面，作遥遥相对之势。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第五十六回兩邊行軍隊伍，已分為甲乙兩壘，大家佔著一塊地面，作遙遙相對之勢。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization' Chapter 56: 'The marching troops on both sides had already formed two camps, each occupying a piece of land, facing each other from a distance.'
example: 五七那天，章宅的事情，和我校的可算是～。（鲁迅《两地书》二十）
exampleTraditional: 五七那天，章宅的事情，和我校的可算是～。（魯迅《兩地書》二十）
exampleEn: The events at Zhang's house on May 7th and those at our school can be said to mirror each other from afar. (Lu Xun, 'Letters from Two Places' 20)

explanation: 放冷箭伤害人。比喻暗地里用某种手段伤害人。
explanationTraditional: 放冷箭傷害人。比喻暗地裡用某種手段傷害人。
explanationEn: To harm someone by underhand means; to stab in the back.
derivation: 宋·刘炎《迩言》卷六暗箭中人，其深次骨，人之怨之，亦必次骨，以其掩人所不备也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·劉炎《邇言》卷六暗箭中人，其深次骨，人之怨之，亦必次骨，以其掩人所不備也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Liu Yan's 'Er Yan' Volume 6: 'An arrow shot in the dark wounds deeply, and the resentment it causes is also deep, because it catches one off guard.'
example: 有荼毒生灵的强盗，有～的强盗。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十八回
exampleTraditional: 有荼毒生靈的強盜，有～的強盜。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十八回
exampleEn: There are bandits who massacre living beings, and bandits who stab in the back. ★ Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror' Chapter 58

explanation: 生病不用吃药而自行痊愈。
explanationTraditional: 生病不用吃藥而自行痊癒。
explanationEn: To recover from an illness without taking medicine.
derivation: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第37回老伯不必多虑，世妹之病，大约可以不药而愈。”
derivationTraditional: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第37回老伯不必多慮，世妹之病，大約可以不藥而癒。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Xia Jingqu's 'A Country Codger's Exposé of Officialdom' Chapter 37: 'Uncle, don't worry too much; your niece's illness will likely heal without medicine.'
example: 刚才着了凉的不爽快，也就～了。★叶圣陶《马铃瓜》
exampleTraditional: 剛才著了涼的不爽快，也就～了。★葉聖陶《馬鈴瓜》
exampleEn: The discomfort from catching a chill just now healed without medicine. ★ Ye Shengtao's 'Ma Linggua'

explanation: 众多人物聚集在一起。亦作成群结队”。
explanationTraditional: 眾多人物聚集在一起。亦作成群結隊”。
explanationEn: To gather in groups or crowds.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十二回料着安老爷家办过喜事，一定人人歇乏，不加防范，便成群结伙而来，想要下手。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十二回料著安老爺家辦過喜事，一定人人歇乏，不加防範，便成群結夥而來，想要下手。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 32: 'Expecting that after the wedding, everyone at Master An's house would be resting and off guard, they came in groups to take action.'
example: 在下的和光同尘，～，他就有什么不好，狐兔相为，怎能吹到主人耳朵？★清·西周生《醒世姻缘传》第五十四回
exampleTraditional: 在下的和光同塵，～，他就有什麼不好，狐兔相為，怎能吹到主人耳朵？★清·西周生《醒世姻緣傳》第五十四回
exampleEn: He went along with the crowd and formed groups; even if he had faults, foxes and rabbits help each other, how could it reach the master's ears? — Qing Dynasty, Xi Zhousheng's 'The Marriage That Awakens the World', Chapter 54

explanation: 冲口脱口，一下子说出。形容不加思索地说出来。
explanationTraditional: 衝口脫口，一下子說出。形容不加思索地說出來。
explanationEn: To blurt out without thinking.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《跋欧阳公书》此数十纸，皆文公冲口而出，纵手而成，初不加意者也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《跋歐陽公書》此數十紙，皆文公衝口而出，縱手而成，初不加意者也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Postscript to Ouyang Xiu's Calligraphy': 'These dozens of sheets were all blurted out by Lord Wen, written freely without prior thought.'
example: 无如他此时是满怀的遂心快意，满面的吐气扬眉，话挤话不由得～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十七回
exampleTraditional: 無如他此時是滿懷的遂心快意，滿面的吐氣揚眉，話擠話不由得～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十七回
exampleEn: But at that moment, he was full of satisfaction and pride, and words crowded out and blurted out involuntarily. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 37

explanation: 犹虎头蛇尾”。比喻做事前紧后松，有始无终。
explanationTraditional: 猶虎頭蛇尾”。比喻做事前緊後松，有始無終。
explanationEn: To start strong but end weak; to have a beginning without an end.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十三回这是中国官踌事一向大头小尾惯的，并不是做书的人先祥后略，有始无终也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十三回這是中國官躊事一向大頭小尾慣的，並不是做書的人先祥後略，有始無終也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 33: 'This is how Chinese officials have always handled matters, starting big and ending small, not that the author is detailed first and brief later, having a beginning but no end.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指应该决断的时候不能决断。
explanationTraditional: 指應該決斷的時候不能決斷。
explanationEn: To fail to make a decision when one should.
derivation: 《史记·齐悼惠王世空》当断不断，反受其乱。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·齊悼惠王世空》當斷不斷，反受其亂。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: The Hereditary House of King Daohui of Qi': 'If you do not decide when you should, you will suffer the consequences.'
example: 段失之太刚，黎又失之太柔，～，反受其乱。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第八十一回
exampleTraditional: 段失之太剛，黎又失之太柔，～，反受其亂。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第八十一回
exampleEn: Duan was too rigid, Li was too soft; failing to decide when they should, they suffered the consequences. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 81

explanation: 戟古代一种兵器，合戈、矛为一体，既能直刺，又能横击。古代用于砍、刺的四种常用兵器。亦用于泛指兵器。
explanationTraditional: 戟古代一種兵器，合戈、矛為一體，既能直刺，又能橫擊。古代用於砍、刺的四種常用兵器。亦用於泛指兵器。
explanationEn: Various types of weapons; general term for weapons.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八十七回却教帐中排开七重刽子手，刀枪剑戟，灿若霜雪。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八十七回卻教帳中排開七重劊子手，刀槍劍戟，燦若霜雪。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 87: 'But in the tent, seven rows of executioners were arranged, with swords, spears, and halberds gleaming like frost and snow.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 对处境危急、困难的人给以救济帮助。
explanationTraditional: 對處境危急、困難的人給以救濟幫助。
explanationEn: To help those in danger or difficulty.
derivation: 元·无名氏《魏徵改诏》第三折楔子今日个扶危救困休辞惮，疾便的牵战马上雕鞍。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《魏徵改詔》第三折楔子今日個扶危救困休辭憚，疾便的牽戰馬上雕鞍。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous's 'Wei Zheng Changes the Edict', Act 3, Wedge: 'Today, do not shirk from helping the endangered and rescuing the distressed; quickly mount your war horse and saddle up.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 眼睛不忍看，形容景象很凄惨。
explanationTraditional: 眼睛不忍看，形容景象很悽慘。
explanationEn: Too horrible to look at; a scene too tragic to behold.
derivation: 清·薛福成《观巴黎油画记》而军士之折臂断足，血流殷地，偃仰僵仆者，令人目不忍睹。”
derivationTraditional: 清·薛福成《觀巴黎油畫記》而軍士之折臂斷足，血流殷地，偃仰僵仆者，令人目不忍睹。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Xue Fucheng's 'Viewing the Paris Oil Painting': 'The soldiers with broken arms and legs, blood flowing on the ground, lying dead or dying, were too horrible to look at.'
example: 尸横遍野、白骨累累，令人～。
exampleTraditional: 屍橫遍野、白骨累累，令人～。
exampleEn: Corpses strewn across the fields, bones piled up, it was too horrible to look at.

explanation: 除自身外再没有多余的东西。形容贫穷。
explanationTraditional: 除自身外再沒有多餘的東西。形容貧窮。
explanationEn: To have no extra possessions; to be extremely poor.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·德行》对曰‘ 丈人不悉恭，恭作人无长物。’”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·德行》對曰‘ 丈人不悉恭，恭作人無長物。’”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty, Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Virtuous Conduct': 'He replied, 'You do not know me; I have no extra possessions.''
example: 这些逃难人虽则～，因为一到惠阳就逢到数十年来从未有过的冷。★茅盾《归途杂拾·韩江船》
exampleTraditional: 這些逃難人雖則～，因為一到惠陽就逢到數十年來從未有過的冷。★茅盾《歸途雜拾·韓江船》
exampleEn: Although these refugees had no extra possessions, as soon as they arrived in Huiyang, they encountered a cold never seen in decades. — Mao Dun's 'Miscellaneous Notes on the Return Journey: Hanjiang Boat'

explanation: 一点踪迹都没有。指不知去向。同杳无踪迹”。
explanationTraditional: 一點蹤跡都沒有。指不知去向。同杳無蹤跡”。
explanationEn: Without a trace; completely disappeared.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在在于，决定于；举举动，行动。指事情的成败就决定于这一次的行动。
explanationTraditional: 在在於，決定於；舉舉動，行動。指事情的成敗就決定於這一次的行動。
explanationEn: Success or failure depends on this one action.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》国家安危，在此一举。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》國家安危，在此一舉。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: The Basic Annals of Xiang Yu': 'The safety of the nation depends on this one action.'
example: 擒拿杨么，～。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第五十三回
exampleTraditional: 擒拿楊麼，～。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第五十三回
exampleEn: Capturing Yang Yao depends on this one action. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai's 'The Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 53

explanation: 忠心耿耿，仗义行事。
explanationTraditional: 忠心耿耿，仗義行事。
explanationEn: Loyal and righteous; having unwavering loyalty and a strong sense of justice.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二回丞相金銮直谏君，忠肝义胆孰能群。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二回丞相金鑾直諫君，忠肝義膽孰能群。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 2: 'The prime minister remonstrates the emperor in the golden hall; who can match his loyal heart and righteous courage?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指熬夜。
explanationTraditional: 指熬夜。
explanationEn: To stay up all night; to work or be awake through the night.
derivation: 《人民文学》1977年1第一期总理经常熬更守夜，废寝忘食地工作。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民文學》1977年1第一期總理經常熬更守夜，廢寢忘食地工作。”
derivationEn: From 'People's Literature' 1977, Issue 1: 'The Premier often stayed up all night, working tirelessly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 识认识，理解；抬举赞扬，器重。不懂得人家对自己的好意。
explanationTraditional: 識認識，理解；抬舉讚揚，器重。不懂得人家對自己的好意。
explanationEn: To not appreciate someone's kindness or favor; to be ungrateful for praise or promotion.
derivation: 明·许仲琳《封神演义》第七回这贱人不识抬举。”
derivationTraditional: 明·許仲琳《封神演義》第七回這賤人不識抬舉。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 7: 'This lowly person does not appreciate kindness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 凡总共。不知道一共有多少。指同类的事物很多。
explanationTraditional: 凡總共。不知道一共有多少。指同類的事物很多。
explanationEn: Numerous; countless; too many to count.
derivation: 唐·郭受《寄杜员外》诗春兴不知凡几首，衡阳纸价顿能高。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·郭受《寄杜員外》詩春興不知凡幾首，衡陽紙價頓能高。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Guo Shou's poem 'To Du Fu': 'How many spring poems have you written? The price of paper in Hengyang has soared.'
example: 所作酬应文字，类此者～，殆亦文人通病，乌得以咎趼人？★鲁迅《小说旧闻钞·二十年目睹之怪现状》
exampleTraditional: 所作酬應文字，類此者～，殆亦文人通病，烏得以咎趼人？★魯迅《小說舊聞鈔·二十年目睹之怪現狀》
exampleEn: The number of such occasional writings is countless; perhaps it is a common fault of literati, so how can we blame the author? — Lu Xun, 'Anecdotes of Old Novels: Strange Events of the Past Twenty Years'

explanation: 恩恩情；义情义。感情破裂。多指夫妻离异。
explanationTraditional: 恩恩情；義情義。感情破裂。多指夫妻離異。
explanationEn: To break off all ties of kindness and affection; often refers to the separation of a couple.
derivation: 元·马致远《任风子》第三折咱两个思断义绝，花残月缺，再谁恋锦帐罗帏。”
derivationTraditional: 元·馬致遠《任風子》第三折咱兩個思斷義絕，花殘月缺，再誰戀錦帳羅幃。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Ma Zhiyuan's 'Ren Fengzi', Act 3: 'Our kindness and affection are severed, flowers withered and moon waning; who still longs for the brocade curtain and silk tent?'
example: 今与郎君～矣，天荒地老，永无见期。★清·徐瑶《太狠生传》
exampleTraditional: 今與郎君～矣，天荒地老，永無見期。★清·徐瑤《太狠生傳》
exampleEn: Now I am severed from you in kindness and affection; the world may grow old, but we shall never meet again. — Qing Dynasty Xu Yao, 'Biography of Tai Hen'

explanation: 形容极远的地方，或彼此相隔极远。
explanationTraditional: 形容極遠的地方，或彼此相隔極遠。
explanationEn: The ends of the earth; extremely distant places; far apart from each other.
derivation: 唐·白居易《春生》春生何处暗周游，海角天涯遍始休。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《春生》春生何處暗周遊，海角天涯遍始休。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Bai Juyi's 'Spring's Arrival': 'Where does spring come from, wandering in darkness? It travels to the ends of the earth before stopping.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 济拯救。拯治时世救济人民。
explanationTraditional: 濟拯救。拯治時世救濟人民。
explanationEn: To help the world and save the people; to assist society and rescue humanity.
derivation: 宋·张君房《云笈七签》第一百一十三卷乃命其子命龙宫药方三十首与先生，此真道者，可以济世救人。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》第一百一十三卷乃命其子命龍宮藥方三十首與先生，此真道者，可以濟世救人。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhang Junfang's 'Yunji Qiqian', Volume 113: 'Then he ordered his son to give the thirty prescriptions of the Dragon Palace to the master; this is the true way, which can help the world and save people.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 十分奇特少见。
explanationTraditional: 十分奇特少見。
explanationEn: Strange and bizarre; extremely unusual and rare.
derivation: 苏曼殊《与刘三书》曼近日所遭，离奇古怪，待长者今冬回申，当极谈耳。”
derivationTraditional: 蘇曼殊《與劉三書》曼近日所遭，離奇古怪，待長者今冬回申，當極談耳。”
derivationEn: From Su Manshu's 'Letter to Liu San': 'What I have encountered recently is strange and bizarre; I will talk about it in detail when you return to Shanghai this winter.'
example: 一时间好像沉进洪荒远古的宁静里，忘记自己，脑子里幻出～的神话。★杨朔《赤道雪》
exampleTraditional: 一時間好像沉進洪荒遠古的寧靜裡，忘記自己，腦子裡幻出～的神話。★楊朔《赤道雪》
exampleEn: For a moment, it felt like sinking into the ancient tranquility of the primordial times, forgetting oneself, and conjuring up strange and bizarre myths in the mind. — Yang Shuo, 'Red Snow'

explanation: 指能力做不到。
explanationTraditional: 指能力做不到。
explanationEn: To be unable to do something due to lack of ability or strength; beyond one's power.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他一直希望能化解这两家的仇恨，但～，他们仍然争吵不休。
exampleTraditional: 他一直希望能化解這兩家的仇恨，但～，他們仍然爭吵不休。
exampleEn: He had always hoped to resolve the conflict between the two families, but it was beyond his power, and they continued to argue incessantly.

explanation: 一片铠甲都没留下来。形容全军覆没。
explanationTraditional: 一片鎧甲都沒留下來。形容全軍覆沒。
explanationEn: Not even a single piece of armor remains; describes a complete defeat or annihilation of an army.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第二三回为兄的在此札营，意欲等候番兵到来，杀他一个片甲不留。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第二三回為兄的在此札營，意欲等候番兵到來，殺他一個片甲不留。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 23: 'I have set up camp here, intending to wait for the enemy troops and annihilate them completely.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 清白廉洁，为人正直不阿。
explanationTraditional: 清白廉潔，為人正直不阿。
explanationEn: Honest and upright, incorruptible and just.
derivation: 《韩非子·奸劫弑臣》我不以清廉方正奉法，乃以贪污之心枉法以取私利，是犹上高陵之颠，堕峻溪之下以求生，凶不几矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·奸劫弒臣》我不以清廉方正奉法，乃以貪汙之心枉法以取私利，是猶上高陵之顛，墮峻溪之下以求生，兇不幾矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: On the Treacherous and the Regicide': 'If I do not uphold the law with integrity and uprightness, but instead use corrupt intentions to bend the law for personal gain, it is like climbing to the top of a high mountain and then falling into a deep stream to seek survival—there is hardly any hope.'
example: 亲自问杀人贼，全不论～，倒不如懵懵遇痴。★元·孙仲章《勘头巾》第三折
exampleTraditional: 親自問殺人賊，全不論～，倒不如懵懵遇痴。★元·孫仲章《勘頭巾》第三折
exampleEn: Personally interrogating the murderer, completely disregarding honesty and uprightness, it would be better to be muddled and foolish. — Yuan Dynasty, Sun Zhongzhang, 'Kan Tou Jin', third act

explanation: 喻事物的繁荣兴盛。亦形容逃跑。桃，谐音逃”。有时含诙谐义。
explanationTraditional: 喻事物的繁榮興盛。亦形容逃跑。桃，諧音逃”。有時含詼諧義。
explanationEn: Describes the flourishing of things; also used to mean 'to escape' (with 'tao' homophonous to 'flee'). Sometimes humorous.
derivation: 《诗经·周南·桃夭》桃之夭夭，灼灼其华。”毛传桃有华之盛者，夭夭，其少壮也。”《礼记·大学》诗云，‘桃之夭夭，其叶蓁蓁，之子于归，宜其家人。’宜其家人，而后可以教国人。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周南·桃夭》桃之夭夭，灼灼其華。”毛傳桃有華之盛者，夭夭，其少壯也。”《禮記·大學》詩云，‘桃之夭夭，其葉蓁蓁，之子于歸，宜其家人。’宜其家人，而後可以教國人。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Zhou Nan: The Peach Tree': 'The peach tree is young and elegant, brilliant its flowers.' Mao's commentary: 'The peach tree has abundant blossoms, young and vigorous.' Also in 'The Great Learning': 'The poem says, "The peach tree is young and elegant, its leaves luxuriant. This girl is going to her husband's home, fitting her family."'
example: 那知卢才听见钮成死了，料道不肯干休，已先～，不在话下。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第二十九卷
exampleTraditional: 那知盧才聽見鈕成死了，料道不肯干休，已先～，不在話下。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第二十九卷
exampleEn: Then Lu Cai heard that Niu Cheng was dead, knowing he would not let it go, he had already fled. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 29

explanation: 头脑昏晕，眼睛发花。同头昏目晕”。
explanationTraditional: 頭腦昏暈，眼睛發花。同頭昏目暈”。
explanationEn: Dizziness and blurred vision; same as '头昏目晕'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容善于讲话，使人喜欢听。
explanationTraditional: 形容善於講話，使人喜歡聽。
explanationEn: Describes someone who speaks eloquently and pleasingly.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第三十四回就把英语来对答，倒也说得清脆悠扬，娓娓动听。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第三十四回就把英語來對答，倒也說得清脆悠揚，娓娓動聽。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 34: 'He then answered in English, speaking clearly and melodiously, eloquently and pleasingly.'
example: 她讲得～，妹仔细听着忽而笑容满面，忽而愁眉双锁。★邹韬奋《我的母亲》
exampleTraditional: 她講得～，妹仔細聽著忽而笑容滿面，忽而愁眉雙鎖。★鄒韜奮《我的母親》
exampleEn: She spoke so eloquently that her younger sister listened attentively, sometimes smiling, sometimes frowning. — Zou Taofen, 'My Mother'

explanation: 犹言邪不犯正。指邪妖之法不能压倒刚正之气。
explanationTraditional: 猶言邪不犯正。指邪妖之法不能壓倒剛正之氣。
explanationEn: Evil cannot prevail over righteousness; evil forces cannot overcome righteous spirit.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指军队士气涣散，跟敌人一接触就崩溃。
explanationTraditional: 指軍隊士氣渙散，跟敵人一接觸就崩潰。
explanationEn: Describes an army with low morale that collapses at the first contact with the enemy.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我军已兵临城下，敌人军心涣散，一触即溃。
exampleTraditional: 我軍已兵臨城下，敵人軍心渙散，一觸即潰。
exampleEn: Our army is at the city gates; the enemy's morale is shattered and they collapse at the first encounter.

explanation: 满天满地。形容到处都是。
explanationTraditional: 滿天滿地。形容到處都是。
explanationEn: Everywhere; all over the place.
derivation: 清·西周生《醒世姻缘传》第三十四回又兼狄家的觅汉伙伴不曾分得银钱的，心里气他不过，到处去彰扬，不止他本村扬说的一天一地，就是邻庄外县，都当了一件异事传说。”
derivationTraditional: 清·西周生《醒世姻緣傳》第三十四回又兼狄家的覓漢夥伴不曾分得銀錢的，心裡氣他不過，到處去彰揚，不止他本村揚說的一天一地，就是鄰莊外縣，都當了一件異事傳說。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Xi Zhou Sheng, 'Marriage Destinies to Awaken the World', Chapter 34: 'Moreover, the hired hands of the Di family who did not get any silver were resentful and spread the news everywhere, not only in their own village but also in neighboring counties, making it known far and wide.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容说话轻浮油滑，不诚恳，不严肃。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話輕浮油滑，不誠懇，不嚴肅。
explanationEn: Describes frivolous and insincere speech; glib and oily.
derivation: 清·王士祯《师友诗传录》若不多读书，多贯穿，而遽言性情，则开后学油腔滑调，信口成章之恶习矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王士禎《師友詩傳錄》若不多讀書，多貫穿，而遽言性情，則開後學油腔滑調，信口成章之惡習矣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wang Shizhen, 'Records of Poetry Teaching among Friends': 'If one does not read many books and gain broad knowledge, but hastily talks about temperament, it opens the door to the bad habit of glib and oily speech and writing casually.'
example: 人们——特别是小何还是认定他～。★茹志娟《新当选的团支书》
exampleTraditional: 人們——特別是小何還是認定他～。★茹志娟《新當選的團支書》
exampleEn: People—especially Xiao He—still thought he was glib and oily. — Ru Zhijuan, 'The Newly Elected League Branch Secretary'

explanation: 原指诸侯相继朝觐一辈子◇形容接连不断地到来。
explanationTraditional: 原指諸侯相繼朝覲一輩子◇形容接連不斷地到來。
explanationEn: Originally meant feudal lords coming to court one after another; later describes a continuous stream of arrivals.
derivation: 《孟子·万章上》欲常常而见之，故源源而来。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章上》欲常常而見之，故源源而來。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Wan Zhang I': 'He wished to see him often, so they came one after another.'
example: 果然有了此好，方士～，零零星星，也弄去了好些银子，受过了好些丹客的哄骗。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷十八
exampleTraditional: 果然有了此好，方士～，零零星星，也弄去了好些銀子，受過了好些丹客的哄騙。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷十八
exampleEn: Indeed, with this hobby, alchemists came continuously, and bit by bit, they swindled a lot of silver, having been deceived by many alchemists. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement', Volume 18

explanation: 糟糠穷人用来充饥的酒渣、米糠等粗劣食物。借指共过患难的妻子。
explanationTraditional: 糟糠窮人用來充飢的酒渣、米糠等粗劣食物。借指共過患難的妻子。
explanationEn: A wife who has shared her husband's hardships; literally 'wife who ate husks and chaff'.
derivation: 《后汉书·宋弘传》（光武帝）谓弘曰‘谚言贵易交，富易妻，人情乎？’弘曰‘臣闻贫贱之知不可忘，糟糠之妻不下堂。’”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·宋弘傳》（光武帝）謂弘曰‘諺言貴易交，富易妻，人情乎？’弘曰‘臣聞貧賤之知不可忘，糟糠之妻不下堂。’”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Song Hong': 'Emperor Guangwu said, "The proverb says, when rich, change friends; when noble, change wife. Is that human nature?" Song Hong replied, "I have heard that a friend in need is a friend indeed, and a wife who shared husks and chaff should not be divorced."'
example: 生辞曰‘～不下堂，宁死不敢承命。王如听臣自赎，倾家可也。’★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·八大王》
exampleTraditional: 生辭曰‘～不下堂，寧死不敢承命。王如聽臣自贖，傾家可也。’★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·八大王》
exampleEn: The scholar declined, saying, 'A wife who shared husks and chaff should not be divorced; I would rather die than accept this command. If the king allows me to redeem myself, I will give my entire fortune.' — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio', 'The Eight Princes'

explanation: 招致蜜蜂，吸引蝴蝶。比喻吸引别人的注意。
explanationTraditional: 招致蜜蜂，吸引蝴蝶。比喻吸引別人的注意。
explanationEn: To attract bees and butterflies; metaphorically, to attract attention, often in a flirtatious or showy manner.
derivation: 叶文玲《独特的歌》没准是很爱卖弄俊俏，四送秋波的人呢，嘿，招蜂引蝶之流，对不起，本人向来深恶痛绝。”
derivationTraditional: 葉文玲《獨特的歌》沒準是很愛賣弄俊俏，四送秋波的人呢，嘿，招蜂引蝶之流，對不起，本人向來深惡痛絕。”
derivationEn: From Ye Wenling's 'Unique Song': 'Maybe someone who loves to show off and cast flirtatious glances, hey, the kind that attracts bees and butterflies, sorry, I have always detested that.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻毛病很多，问题严重，已经到了难以收拾的地步。
explanationTraditional: 比喻毛病很多，問題嚴重，已經到了難以收拾的地步。
explanationEn: A hundred holes and a thousand sores; metaphorically, riddled with problems or flaws, extremely serious and hard to remedy.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《与孟尚书书》汉室以来，群儒区区修补，百孔千疮，随乱随失，其危如一发引千钧。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《與孟尚書書》漢室以來，群儒區區修補，百孔千瘡，隨亂隨失，其危如一發引千鈞。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Letter to Meng Shangshu' in Tang Dynasty: 'Since the Han dynasty, scholars have been making minor repairs, but it is full of holes and sores, falling apart as soon as fixed, as precarious as a hair pulling a thousand jun.'
example: 他身上的缺点虽然不少，但却不是～，不可救药。
exampleTraditional: 他身上的缺點雖然不少，但卻不是～，不可救藥。
exampleEn: Although he has many shortcomings, he is not beyond cure like a hundred holes and a thousand sores.

explanation: 嘴唇红，牙齿白。形容人容貌俊美。
explanationTraditional: 嘴唇紅，牙齒白。形容人容貌俊美。
explanationEn: Red lips and white teeth; describes a person's handsome or beautiful appearance.
derivation: 明·胡文焕《琼琚记·桑下戏妻》只见唇红齿白，桃花脸，绿鬓朱颜柳叶眉，因此不忍而去。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡文煥《瓊琚記·桑下戲妻》只見唇紅齒白，桃花臉，綠鬢朱顏柳葉眉，因此不忍而去。”
derivationEn: From Hu Wenhuan's 'Qiong Ju Ji: Flirting Under the Mulberry' in Ming Dynasty: 'Seeing red lips and white teeth, a peach-blossom face, green hair and red cheeks, willow-leaf eyebrows, so I couldn't bear to leave.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在大海里捞一根针。形容很难找到。
explanationTraditional: 在大海里撈一根針。形容很難找到。
explanationEn: To fish for a needle at the bottom of the sea; describes something extremely difficult to find.
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《二郎收猪八戒》第三折俊儿夫似海内寻针，姻缘事在天数临，无缘分怎的消任？直耽搁到如今。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《二郎收豬八戒》第三折俊兒夫似海內尋針，姻緣事在天數臨，無緣分怎的消任？直耽擱到如今。”
derivationEn: From Wu Changling's 'Erlang Captures the Pig Demon' in Yuan Dynasty, Act 3: 'My husband is like finding a needle in the sea, marriage is determined by fate, without luck how can one endure? It has been delayed until now.'
example: 一面点起民壮，分头追捕，多应是～，那寻一个？★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 一面點起民壯，分頭追捕，多應是～，那尋一個？★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十
exampleEn: They immediately raised the militia and sent out searches, but it was like fishing for a needle at the bottom of the sea; where could they find him? — from Ling Mengchu's 'First Collection of Striking the Table' in Ming Dynasty, Volume 20.

explanation: 连篇整篇。整篇都是空话，缺乏具体内容。
explanationTraditional: 連篇整篇。整篇都是空話，缺乏具體內容。
explanationEn: A whole page of empty words; describes speech or writing that is full of empty talk and lacks substance.
derivation: 毛泽东《反对党八股》党八股的第一条罪状是空话连篇，言之无物。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《反對黨八股》黨八股的第一條罪狀是空話連篇，言之無物。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Oppose Stereotyped Party Writing': 'The first crime of stereotyped party writing is empty talk, devoid of content.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻好名声永远流传。
explanationTraditional: 比喻好名聲永遠流傳。
explanationEn: One's name will be remembered for thousands of years; describes a good reputation that lasts forever.
derivation: 余秋雨《文化苦旅·五城记》六朝金粉足能使它名垂千古，何况它还有明、清两代的政治大潮，还有近代和现代的殷殷血火。”
derivationTraditional: 餘秋雨《文化苦旅·五城記》六朝金粉足能使它名垂千古，何況它還有明、清兩代的政治大潮，還有近代和現代的殷殷血火。”
derivationEn: From Yu Qiuyu's 'Cultural Journey: Five Cities': 'The splendor of the Six Dynasties was enough to make it famous for thousands of years, let alone the political tides of the Ming and Qing dynasties and the bloody fires of modern and contemporary times.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指荒谬的东西一代代地传下去。
explanationTraditional: 泛指荒謬的東西一代代地傳下去。
explanationEn: The spread of erroneous or absurd ideas from generation to generation.
derivation: 《宋史·选举志二》所取之士既不精，数年之后，复俾之主文，是非颠倒愈甚，时谓之缪种流传。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·選舉志二》所取之士既不精，數年之後，復俾之主文，是非顛倒愈甚，時謂之繆種流傳。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Records of Elections II': 'Since the selected scholars are not refined, after a few years they are put in charge of examinations, causing even greater confusion of right and wrong, which is called the spread of erroneous seeds.'
example: 然有可解者，～已数十年。★清·恽敬《与饶陶南》
exampleTraditional: 然有可解者，～已數十年。★清·惲敬《與饒陶南》
exampleEn: But it is understandable that erroneous seeds have been spreading for decades. — from Yun Jing's 'Letter to Rao Taonan' in Qing Dynasty.

explanation: 没有什么能超过这个的了。多指不良倾向或形势严重。
explanationTraditional: 沒有什麼能超過這個的了。多指不良傾向或形勢嚴重。
explanationEn: Nothing is more extreme than this; often refers to a bad tendency or serious situation.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《容斋三笔》卷四名不雅古，莫此为甚。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《容齋三筆》卷四名不雅古，莫此為甚。”
derivationEn: From Hong Mai's 'Rong Zhai San Bi' in Song Dynasty, Volume 4: 'The name is not elegant and ancient; nothing is more extreme than this.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指各行各业。
explanationTraditional: 泛指各行各業。
explanationEn: Seventy-two trades; refers to all kinds of professions or occupations.
derivation: 陶行知《自动学胸诗》有个学校真奇怪，小孩自动教小孩。七十二行皆先生，先生不在学如在。”
derivationTraditional: 陶行知《自動學胸詩》有個學校真奇怪，小孩自動教小孩。七十二行皆先生，先生不在學如在。”
derivationEn: From Tao Xingzhi's 'Poem on Automatic Learning': 'There is a strange school where children teach children automatically. All seventy-two trades are teachers, and learning goes on even without the teacher.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象兄弟一样的亲密。多形容朋友的情谊深厚。
explanationTraditional: 象兄弟一樣的親密。多形容朋友的情誼深厚。
explanationEn: As close as brothers; describes deep friendship between friends.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《魔合罗》第四折想兄弟情亲如手足。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《魔合羅》第四折想兄弟情親如手足。”
derivationEn: From Guan Hanqing's 'Mo He Luo' in Yuan Dynasty, Act 4: 'Thinking of brotherly affection as close as hands and feet.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容神态失常，不能自制。亦指为某人某事所倾倒。同如醉如狂”。
explanationTraditional: 形容神態失常，不能自制。亦指為某人某事所傾倒。同如醉如狂”。
explanationEn: Describes a state of mental derangement or loss of self-control; also refers to being infatuated with someone or something.
derivation: 《孽海花》第七回倾城士女如痴如狂，一条七里山塘，停满了画船歌舫，真个靓妆藻野，炫服缛川，好不热闹。”
derivationTraditional: 《孽海花》第七回傾城士女如痴如狂，一條七里山塘，停滿了畫船歌舫，真個靚妝藻野，炫服縟川，好不熱鬧。”
derivationEn: From 'Nie Hai Hua', Chapter 7: 'The entire city, men and women, were as if mad and crazy; the seven-mile-long Shantang River was filled with painted boats and song vessels, truly a bustling scene.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 本用以形容美女头上金钗之多，后喻指众多的妃嫔或姬妾。
explanationTraditional: 本用以形容美女頭上金釵之多，後喻指眾多的妃嬪或姬妾。
explanationEn: Originally used to describe the numerous gold hairpins on a woman's head, later metaphorically refers to a large group of concubines or maids.
derivation: 南朝·梁武帝《河中之水歌》头上金钗十二行，足下丝履五文章。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁武帝《河中之水歌》頭上金釵十二行，足下絲履五文章。”
derivationEn: From Emperor Wu of Liang's poem 'Song of the River': 'On her head twelve rows of gold hairpins, on her feet shoes of five-colored silk.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 到水中去捞月亮。比喻去做根本做不到的事情，只能白费力气。
explanationTraditional: 到水中去撈月亮。比喻去做根本做不到的事情，只能白費力氣。
explanationEn: To scoop up the moon from the water; a metaphor for attempting something impossible, resulting in wasted effort.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《沁园春》词镜里拈花，水中捉月，觑着无由得近伊。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《沁園春》詞鏡裡拈花，水中捉月，覷著無由得近伊。”
derivationEn: From Huang Tingjian's 'Qinyuanchun' lyrics: 'Picking flowers in a mirror, catching the moon in water, gazing but unable to get close.'
example: 恰便似沙里淘金，石中取火，～。★元·杨景贤《刘行首》第三折
exampleTraditional: 恰便似沙裡淘金，石中取火，～。★元·楊景賢《劉行首》第三折
exampleEn: Just like sifting gold from sand, extracting fire from stone, or fishing the moon from water. — Yuan Dynasty, Yang Jingxian, 'Liu Xing Shou', Act 3

explanation: 殊不同。说的话个个不同。指各人有各人的意见。
explanationTraditional: 殊不同。說的話個個不同。指各人有各人的意見。
explanationEn: Each person says something different; refers to everyone having their own opinion.
derivation: 《史记·曹相国世家》尽召长老诸生，问所以安集百姓，如齐故诸儒以百数，言人人殊。参未知所定。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·曹相國世家》盡召長老諸生，問所以安集百姓，如齊故諸儒以百數，言人人殊。參未知所定。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Cao Can': 'He summoned all the elders and scholars to ask how to pacify the people, but the hundreds of Confucian scholars from Qi each spoke differently, and Cao Can did not know what to decide.'
example: 然此辈执术疏，谋生急，信口欺诈，～，甚至徒毁其师，子讥其父，各持己见，彼此相非。★清·黄钧宰《金壶七墨·堪舆》
exampleTraditional: 然此輩執術疏，謀生急，信口欺詐，～，甚至徒毀其師，子譏其父，各持己見，彼此相非。★清·黃鈞宰《金壺七墨·堪輿》
exampleEn: However, these people are unskilled in their craft and anxious to make a living, so they deceive with lies, each saying something different, even to the point of disciples slandering their masters and sons mocking their fathers, each holding their own views and criticizing each other. — Qing Dynasty, Huang Junzai, 'Jinhu Qimo: Geomancy'

explanation: 直公正、正直。以公道对待自己怨恨的人。
explanationTraditional: 直公正、正直。以公道對待自己怨恨的人。
explanationEn: To repay resentment with fairness; to treat those you resent with justice.
derivation: 《论语·宪问》以直报怨，以德报德。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·憲問》以直報怨，以德報德。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Xian Wen': 'Repay resentment with fairness, repay kindness with kindness.'
example: 这叫做～，以德报德。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十一
exampleTraditional: 這叫做～，以德報德。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十一
exampleEn: This is called repaying resentment with fairness and repaying kindness with kindness. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 11

explanation: 形容大胆的手法来自高超的技艺。
explanationTraditional: 形容大膽的手法來自高超的技藝。
explanationEn: Describes boldness derived from superb skill.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 见过龙门石窟的宏伟雕像者，无不赞叹只有～的人才能创造出这样的杰作。
exampleTraditional: 見過龍門石窟的宏偉雕像者，無不讚嘆只有～的人才能創造出這樣的傑作。
exampleEn: Those who have seen the magnificent sculptures of the Longmen Grottoes cannot help but admire that only those with superb skill and boldness could create such masterpieces.

explanation: 窠鸟巢；臼舂米的石器。比喻有独创风格，不落旧套。
explanationTraditional: 窠鳥巢；臼舂米的石器。比喻有獨創風格，不落舊套。
explanationEn: Not falling into a set pattern; having original style, not following old conventions.
derivation: 宋·吴可《学诗》诗跳出少陵窠臼外，丈夫志气本冲天。”明·胡应麟《诗薮·内编》四初学必从此入门，庶不落小家窠臼。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·吳可《學詩》詩跳出少陵窠臼外，丈夫志氣本沖天。”明·胡應麟《詩藪·內編》四初學必從此入門，庶不落小家窠臼。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Wu Ke's 'On Poetry': 'Jump out of Du Fu's mold; a man's ambition should reach the sky.' Ming Dynasty, Hu Yinglin's 'Shi Sou: Nei Bian': 'Beginners must enter through this door to avoid falling into a minor mold.'
example: 这凸”凹”历来用的人最少，如今直用作轩馆之名，更觉新鲜，～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第七十六回
exampleTraditional: 這凸”凹”歷來用的人最少，如今直用作軒館之名，更覺新鮮，～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第七十六回
exampleEn: The characters 'convex' and 'concave' have rarely been used, but now they are directly used as names for pavilions and halls, which is even more novel and does not fall into a set pattern. — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 76

explanation: 春天的花朵，秋天的月亮。泛指春秋美景。
explanationTraditional: 春天的花朵，秋天的月亮。泛指春秋美景。
explanationEn: Spring flowers and autumn moon; generally refers to the beautiful scenery of spring and autumn.
derivation: 南唐·李煜《虞美人》词春花秋月何时了，往事知多少。”
derivationTraditional: 南唐·李煜《虞美人》詞春花秋月何時了，往事知多少。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu's 'The Beautiful Lady Yu': 'When will the spring flowers and autumn moon end? How much do I know of the past?'
example: 冬天去了，春天又回来了。吟诵这些诗句，～，一年四季都沉醉在诗的意境里。★于漪《我与〈千家诗〉》
exampleTraditional: 冬天去了，春天又回來了。吟誦這些詩句，～，一年四季都沉醉在詩的意境裡。★於漪《我與〈千家詩〉》
exampleEn: Winter is gone, spring returns. Reciting these verses, with spring flowers and autumn moon, one is immersed in the poetic realm all year round. — Yu Yi, 'I and 'A Thousand Poems''

explanation: 在反动统治者的残酷剥削和压迫下，人民无法生活，被迫奋起反抗。
explanationTraditional: 在反動統治者的殘酷剝削和壓迫下，人民無法生活，被迫奮起反抗。
explanationEn: Under the cruel exploitation and oppression of reactionary rulers, the people are forced to rise up in resistance.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十八回广西事情一半是官逼民反。正经说起来，三天亦说不完。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十八回廣西事情一半是官逼民反。正經說起來，三天亦說不完。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene': 'Half of the Guangxi affair was caused by officials forcing the people to rebel. To speak properly, it cannot be finished in three days.'
example: ～”，也是人之常情，梁山泊的英雄正是被压迫的人民想望的。★朱自清《论雅俗共赏》
exampleTraditional: ～”，也是人之常情，梁山泊的英雄正是被壓迫的人民想望的。★朱自清《論雅俗共賞》
exampleEn: 'Officials force the people to rebel' is also a matter of human nature; the heroes of Liangshan Marsh are exactly what the oppressed people yearn for. — Zhu Ziqing, 'On Refined and Popular Tastes'

explanation: 宁安宁。国家没有太平的时候。
explanationTraditional: 寧安寧。國家沒有太平的時候。
explanationEn: The country has no days of peace; the nation is not at peace.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十一回宋大国也，起倾国兵，盛气而来……吾国无宁日矣。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十一回宋大國也，起傾國兵，盛氣而來……吾國無寧日矣。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 11: 'Song is a great state, raising the whole country's army in full force... our country will have no peaceful days.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 酒喝多了以后，不能自持，说了不该说的话。
explanationTraditional: 酒喝多了以後，不能自持，說了不該說的話。
explanationEn: To say something inappropriate due to being drunk.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第四十六回杨雄道‘兄弟，你休怪我。是我一时愚蠢，不是了，酒后失言，反被那婆娘瞒过了，怪兄弟相闹不得。我今特来寻贤弟，负荆请罪。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第四十六回楊雄道‘兄弟，你休怪我。是我一時愚蠢，不是了，酒後失言，反被那婆娘瞞過了，怪兄弟相鬧不得。我今特來尋賢弟，負荊請罪。’”
derivationEn: From Chapter 46 of 'Water Margin' by Shi Nai'an of Ming Dynasty: Yang Xiong said, 'Brother, don't blame me. I was foolish for a moment, not myself, and after drinking I said things I shouldn't, but was deceived by that woman. I blame you for the quarrel. Now I've come to find you and apologize.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指表面上升官，而实际上被削去权力。
explanationTraditional: 指表面上升官，而實際上被削去權力。
explanationEn: To be promoted in title but actually stripped of power.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第36回就是再添一千个都老爷，也抵不上两个监督、一个织造的好这叫做‘明升暗降’。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第36回就是再添一千個都老爺，也抵不上兩個監督、一個織造的好這叫做‘明升暗降’。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 36 of 'The Bureaucrats' by Li Baojia of Qing Dynasty: 'Even if a thousand censors were added, they couldn't match the two supervisors and one weaver. This is called 'promotion in name but demotion in reality'.'
example: 明眼人可以看出你这是～的把戏。
exampleTraditional: 明眼人可以看出你這是～的把戲。
exampleEn: A discerning person can see that this is your trick of 'promotion in name but demotion in reality'.

explanation: 吸入新鲜空气像渗入内脏一样感到舒畅。
explanationTraditional: 吸入新鮮空氣像滲入內臟一樣感到舒暢。
explanationEn: Refreshing and penetrating to the lungs and viscera; describing fresh air or fragrance that is deeply soothing.
derivation: 明·张岱《陶庵梦忆》玉液珠胶，雪腴霜腻；吹气胜兰，沁人肺腑。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張岱《陶庵夢憶》玉液珠膠，雪腴霜膩；吹氣勝蘭，沁人肺腑。”
derivationEn: From 'Dream Memories of Tao'an' by Zhang Dai of Ming Dynasty: 'Jade liquid, pearl glue, snow fat, frost grease; breath better than orchid, refreshing the lungs and viscera.'
example: 闻到一股子～的新麦的清香。★浩然《艳阳天》第129章
exampleTraditional: 聞到一股子～的新麥的清香。★浩然《豔陽天》第129章
exampleEn: Smelling a scent of new wheat that refreshes the lungs and viscera. ★ Hao Ran, 'Bright Sunny Skies', Chapter 129

explanation: 求仁德便得到仁德。比喻理想和愿望实现。
explanationTraditional: 求仁德便得到仁德。比喻理想和願望實現。
explanationEn: To seek benevolence and obtain it; meaning one's ideals and wishes are fulfilled.
derivation: 《论语·述而》求仁而得仁，又何怨。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》求仁而得仁，又何怨。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects, Shu Er': 'He sought benevolence and obtained it; what is there to complain about?'
example: 君所谓～，亦复何怨老夫耄矣，不能驱役鬼神，预人家儿女事。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷十七
exampleTraditional: 君所謂～，亦復何怨老夫耄矣，不能驅役鬼神，預人家兒女事。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷十七
exampleEn: You have what is called 'seeking benevolence and obtaining it'; why should you complain about me being old and unable to drive ghosts and gods to meddle in people's family affairs? ★ Ji Yun, 'Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Observations', Volume 17

explanation: 互相协助进行或互相配合使用。
explanationTraditional: 互相協助進行或互相配合使用。
explanationEn: To proceed in mutual assistance or to be used in coordination.
derivation: 明·张岱《历书眼序》诹日者与推命者必相辅而行，而后两者之说始得无蔽。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張岱《曆書眼序》諏日者與推命者必相輔而行，而後兩者之說始得無蔽。”
derivationEn: From 'Preface to the Almanac' by Zhang Dai of Ming Dynasty: 'Those who choose auspicious days and those who predict fate must proceed in mutual assistance, so that the theories of both can be without bias.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 依照相传下来的一套慢慢地成了习惯。
explanationTraditional: 依照相傳下來的一套慢慢地成了習慣。
explanationEn: To become a custom through long-standing tradition.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 挑选邻居好的地方居住。
explanationTraditional: 挑選鄰居好的地方居住。
explanationEn: To choose a place to live based on good neighbors.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容神情鬼鬼祟祟。
explanationTraditional: 形容神情鬼鬼祟祟。
explanationEn: Describing a furtive and sneaky appearance.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第三回只见小和尚左手拿一只灯，右手提一壶茶，走进来贼眉贼眼，将灯放下，又将茶壶放在桌上，两只贼眼东瞧西看，连话也不说，回头就走。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第三回只見小和尚左手拿一隻燈，右手提一壺茶，走進來賊眉賊眼，將燈放下，又將茶壺放在桌上，兩隻賊眼東瞧西看，連話也不說，回頭就走。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 3 of 'The Three Heroes and Five Gallants' by Shi Yukun of Qing Dynasty: 'The little novice monk entered with a lamp in one hand and a teapot in the other, looking furtive and sneaky, put down the lamp and teapot on the table, his thievish eyes darting around, without saying a word, and then turned and left.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 命认为。自以自为清高。
explanationTraditional: 命認為。自以自為清高。
explanationEn: To consider oneself as pure and lofty.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》还自命清高，反说富贵的是俗人。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》還自命清高，反說富貴的是俗人。”
derivationEn: From 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' by Wu Jianren of Qing Dynasty: 'He still considered himself pure and lofty, and instead said that the rich and noble were vulgar.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 班调回。调动出征的军队返回首都，指出征的军队胜利返回朝廷。
explanationTraditional: 班調回。調動出征的軍隊返回首都，指出徵的軍隊勝利返回朝廷。
explanationEn: To recall troops to the capital; referring to a victorious army returning to court.
derivation: 元·乔孟符《两世姻缘》第三折你奉圣旨破吐蕃，定西夏，班师回朝，便当请功受赏。”
derivationTraditional: 元·喬孟符《兩世姻緣》第三折你奉聖旨破吐蕃，定西夏，班師回朝，便當請功受賞。”
derivationEn: From Act 3 of 'Two Lives of Marriage' by Qiao Mengfu of Yuan Dynasty: 'You received the imperial order to conquer Tubo and pacify Xixia, and now you recall the troops to court, so you should request rewards and honors.'
example: 后主（刘禅）下诏，宣孔明班师回朝。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百回
exampleTraditional: 後主（劉禪）下詔，宣孔明班師回朝。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百回
exampleEn: The later ruler (Liu Shan) issued an edict, ordering Kongming to recall the troops to court. ★ Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 100

explanation: 侧斜着。斜着眼睛看人。形容憎恨或又怕又愤恨。
explanationTraditional: 側斜著。斜著眼睛看人。形容憎恨或又怕又憤恨。
explanationEn: To look askance at someone, expressing hatred or a mix of fear and anger.
derivation: 《史记·汲郑列传》今天下重足而立，侧目而视矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·汲鄭列傳》今天下重足而立，側目而視矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Ji and Zheng': 'Today, the people stand with feet together and look askance.'
example: 诸君记得当年常肃剥皮做衮州府的时候，何尝不是这样？总是做得人人～就完了。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第三回
exampleTraditional: 諸君記得當年常肅剝皮做袞州府的時候，何嘗不是這樣？總是做得人人～就完了。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第三回
exampleEn: Do you remember when Chang Su was the governor of Gunzhou? Wasn't it always like this? In the end, everyone looked askance at him. — Liu E, 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 3

explanation: 行事专断，不考虑别人的意见。形容作风不民主。
explanationTraditional: 行事專斷，不考慮別人的意見。形容作風不民主。
explanationEn: To act arbitrarily without considering others' opinions; describes undemocratic behavior.
derivation: 清·容闳《西学东渐记》第十九章予已预备随时辞职，以便足下独断独行。”
derivationTraditional: 清·容閎《西學東漸記》第十九章予已預備隨時辭職，以便足下獨斷獨行。”
derivationEn: From Rong Hong's 'My Life in China and America', Chapter 19: 'I am ready to resign at any time so that you can act arbitrarily.'
example: 他也不信任母亲，有意见就～。★柔石《二月》五
exampleTraditional: 他也不信任母親，有意見就～。★柔石《二月》五
exampleEn: He didn't trust his mother either and acted arbitrarily whenever he had an opinion. — Rou Shi, 'February', Chapter 5

explanation: 光复恢复；旧物旧有的东西。指收复曾被敌人侵占的祖国山河。
explanationTraditional: 光復恢復；舊物舊有的東西。指收復曾被敵人侵佔的祖國山河。
explanationEn: To recover lost territory or restore what was once possessed, especially the motherland occupied by enemies.
derivation: 《晋书·桓温传》光复旧京，疆理华夏。”宋·辛弃疾《美芹十论》臣愿陛下姑以光复旧物而自期。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·桓溫傳》光復舊京，疆理華夏。”宋·辛棄疾《美芹十論》臣願陛下姑以光復舊物而自期。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Huan Wen': 'Restore the old capital and govern China.' Also from Xin Qiji's 'Ten Essays on the Beautiful Thorn': 'I hope Your Majesty will aim to restore the old possessions.'
example: 往昔所希，惟在～，政俗革新，不图废清甚易，改政易俗，竟无毫铢可望，而腐败反甚于前。★章炳麟《与龚未生书》
exampleTraditional: 往昔所希，惟在～，政俗革新，不圖廢清甚易，改政易俗，竟無毫銖可望，而腐敗反甚於前。★章炳麟《與龔未生書》
exampleEn: In the past, my only hope was to restore the old possessions and reform politics and customs. Unexpectedly, overthrowing the Qing was easy, but reforming politics and customs showed no progress, and corruption was worse than before. — Zhang Binglin, 'Letter to Gong Weisheng'

explanation: 喜欢多事或好管闲事的人。
explanationTraditional: 喜歡多事或好管閒事的人。
explanationEn: A person who likes to meddle or is overly curious about others' affairs.
derivation: 《孟子·万章上》好事者为之也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章上》好事者為之也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Wan Zhang I': 'It was done by a meddlesome person.'
example: 可是中国真也还有～，竟有人不怕中暑的跑到真茹的望岁小农居”这洋楼底下去请教他了。★鲁迅《伪自由书·后记》
exampleTraditional: 可是中國真也還有～，竟有人不怕中暑的跑到真茹的望歲小農居”這洋樓底下去請教他了。★魯迅《偽自由書·後記》
exampleEn: But there are indeed meddlesome people in China who, despite the heat, went to the 'Wangsui Small Residence' in Zhenru to consult him. — Lu Xun, 'Pseudo-Free Talk: Postscript'

explanation: 筋筋骨；竭完。形容非常疲乏，一点力气也没有了。
explanationTraditional: 筋筋骨；竭完。形容非常疲乏，一點力氣也沒有了。
explanationEn: Completely exhausted, with no strength left.
derivation: 汉·焦延寿《焦氏易林·巽》蹇驴不材，骏骥失时，筋劳力尽，罢于沙丘。”唐·韩愈《论淮西事宜状》虽时侵掠，小有所得，力尽筋疲，不偿其费。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·焦延壽《焦氏易林·巽》蹇驢不材，駿驥失時，筋勞力盡，罷於沙丘。”唐·韓愈《論淮西事宜狀》雖時侵掠，小有所得，力盡筋疲，不償其費。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Jiao Yanshou's 'Jiao's Forest of Changes': 'A lame donkey is not useful, a fine horse misses its time, muscles and strength are exhausted, tired on the sand dunes.' Also from Han Yu's 'On the Situation of Huaixi': 'Although they occasionally invade and gain small gains, they are exhausted and the cost outweighs the gain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在危急关头勇于献出生命。
explanationTraditional: 在危急關頭勇於獻出生命。
explanationEn: To sacrifice one's life willingly in a moment of crisis.
derivation: 《论语·宪问》见利思义，见危授命。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·憲問》見利思義，見危授命。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Xian Wen': 'When seeing profit, think of righteousness; when facing danger, give one's life.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指各种精美的丝织品。
explanationTraditional: 泛指各種精美的絲織品。
explanationEn: A general term for various fine silk fabrics.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十二回京城地方的局面越大，人的眼皮子越薄，金子是黄的，银子是白的，绫罗绸缎是红的绿的，这些人的眼珠子可是黑的，一时看在眼里，议论纷纷。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十二回京城地方的局面越大，人的眼皮子越薄，金子是黃的，銀子是白的，綾羅綢緞是紅的綠的，這些人的眼珠子可是黑的，一時看在眼裡，議論紛紛。”
derivationEn: From Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Couple', Chapter 32: 'In the capital, the situation is grand, people's eyes are shallow; gold is yellow, silver is white, silks and satins are red and green, but these people's eyes are black, and they gossip when they see them.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指毫无消息。
explanationTraditional: 指毫無消息。
explanationEn: Completely without any news or information.
derivation: 吴运铎《把一切献给党·新任务》太阳下了山，同志们打起灯笼火把，披开一丛丛的荒草搜寻，炮弹还是渺无音讯。”
derivationTraditional: 吳運鐸《把一切獻給黨·新任務》太陽下了山，同志們打起燈籠火把，披開一叢叢的荒草搜尋，炮彈還是渺無音訊。”
derivationEn: From Wu Yunduo's 'Give Everything to the Party: New Task': 'The sun set, comrades lit torches, parted the thickets to search, but the shells were still without any news.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指思念中的那个人。
explanationTraditional: 指思念中的那個人。
explanationEn: Refers to the person one is thinking of or longing for.
derivation: 《诗·秦风·蒹葭》蒹葭苍苍，白露为霜；所谓伊人，在水一方。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·秦風·蒹葭》蒹葭蒼蒼，白露為霜；所謂伊人，在水一方。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Qin Feng: Jian Jia': 'The reeds are lush, the white dew turns to frost; the so-called person is on the other side of the water.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 神、妙形容高明；机、算指计谋。惊人的机智，巧妙的计谋。形容善于估计复杂的变化的情势，决定策略。
explanationTraditional: 神、妙形容高明；機、算指計謀。驚人的機智，巧妙的計謀。形容善於估計複雜的變化的情勢，決定策略。
explanationEn: Remarkable ingenuity and clever strategy; describes the ability to assess complex situations and devise effective plans.
derivation: 《后汉书·王涣传》又能以谲数发擿奸伏，京师称叹，以为涣有神算。”李贤注智算若神也。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·王渙傳》又能以譎數發擿奸伏，京師稱歎，以為渙有神算。”李賢注智算若神也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Wang Huan': 'He could also use clever methods to expose hidden crimes, and the capital praised him, thinking he had divine calculations.' Li Xian's commentary: 'His wisdom and calculations were like those of a god.'
example: （周）瑜大惊，慨然叹日‘孔明～，吾不如也。’★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: （周）瑜大驚，慨然嘆日‘孔明～，吾不如也。’★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十六回
exampleEn: Zhou Yu was greatly surprised and sighed, 'Kongming's divine strategy and wonderful calculations are beyond my reach.' — Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 46

explanation: 议论别人的好坏是非。
explanationTraditional: 議論別人的好壞是非。
explanationEn: To gossip about others' merits and faults.
derivation: 汉·崔瑗《座佑铭》无道人之短，无说己之长。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·崔瑗《座佑銘》無道人之短，無說己之長。”
derivationEn: Han·Cui Yuan's 'Zuo You Ming': 'Do not speak of others' shortcomings, nor boast of your own strengths.'
example: 这些缙绅士大夫家筵席间，定要几个梨园中人，杂坐衣冠队中，～，这个成何体统！★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第五十三回
exampleTraditional: 這些縉紳士大夫家筵席間，定要幾個梨園中人，雜坐衣冠隊中，～，這個成何體統！★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第五十三回
exampleEn: At the banquets of these gentry families, they must have several opera performers mingling among the guests, gossiping about this and that—how improper! ★ Qing·Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 53

explanation: 谲诡怪异，变化∶象云彩和水波那样，形态不可捉摸。原形容房屋构造就象云彩、波浪一样千姿百态◇多形容事物变幻莫测。
explanationTraditional: 譎詭怪異，變化∶象雲彩和水波那樣，形態不可捉摸。原形容房屋構造就象雲彩、波浪一樣千姿百態◇多形容事物變幻莫測。
explanationEn: Bizarre and unpredictable, like clouds and waves; originally described buildings as varied as clouds and waves, now often used to describe things that are ever-changing and unfathomable.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《甘泉赋》于是大厦云谲波诡，摧摧而成观。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《甘泉賦》於是大廈雲譎波詭，摧摧而成觀。”
derivationEn: Han·Yang Xiong's 'Sweet Springs Ode': 'Thus the grand hall is as varied as clouds and waves, towering into a magnificent view.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹包罗万象。
explanationTraditional: 猶包羅萬象。
explanationEn: To encompass everything; all-encompassing.
derivation: 郭沫若《浪漫主义和现实主义》他所关心的事，真是包罗万有。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《浪漫主義和現實主義》他所關心的事，真是包羅萬有。”
derivationEn: Guo Moruo's 'Romanticism and Realism': 'The things he cared about truly encompassed everything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻到处奔走。
explanationTraditional: 比喻到處奔走。
explanationEn: To run around busily; to rush about everywhere.
derivation: 周立波《暴风骤雨》十四他和他的那个组，打地，评等级，品好赖，臂青苗，东跑西颠，整整地忙了五天。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《暴風驟雨》十四他和他的那個組，打地，評等級，品好賴，臂青苗，東跑西顛，整整地忙了五天。”
derivationEn: Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane' 14: 'He and his group worked on land division, grading, quality assessment, and crop evaluation, running around busily for a full five days.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻天地广阔，征程遥远。
explanationTraditional: 比喻天地廣闊，征程遙遠。
explanationEn: Vast as the sea and high as the sky; metaphor for a broad world and a long journey.
derivation: 唐·刘氏瑶《杂曲歌辞·暗别离》青鸾脉脉西飞去，海阔天高不知处。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉氏瑤《雜曲歌辭·暗別離》青鸞脈脈西飛去，海闊天高不知處。”
derivationEn: Tang·Liu Shiyao's 'Miscellaneous Songs: Secret Parting': 'The green phoenix flies westward slowly, the sea is vast and the sky high, unknown where it goes.'
example: 鸿鹄冥冥乌鹊暮，～，翼短迷征路。★明·刘基《苏幕遮·次韵和刘宗保》词
exampleTraditional: 鴻鵠冥冥烏鵲暮，～，翼短迷徵路。★明·劉基《蘇幕遮·次韻和劉宗保》詞
exampleEn: The swan flies in the dark, the crow at dusk; the sea is vast and the sky high, wings short and lost on the journey. ★ Ming·Liu Ji's 'Silk Screen Curtain: Matching Rhymes with Liu Zongbao' lyrics

explanation: 胡古代指北方和西文的少数民族。指学习胡人的短打服饰，同时也学习他们的骑马、射箭等武艺。
explanationTraditional: 胡古代指北方和西文的少數民族。指學習胡人的短打服飾，同時也學習他們的騎馬、射箭等武藝。
explanationEn: To adopt the clothing and martial arts of the northern nomads; refers to learning from the Hu people's short garments and their skills in horseback riding and archery.
derivation: 《战国策·赵策二》今吾（赵武灵王）将胡服骑射以教百姓。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·趙策二》今吾（趙武靈王）將胡服騎射以教百姓。”
derivationEn: 'Strategies of the Warring States: Zhao Strategy II': 'Now I (King Wuling of Zhao) will adopt Hu clothing and teach horseback archery to the people.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 附依附。灵魂离开了身体。形容极端惊恐或在某种事物诱惑下失去常态。
explanationTraditional: 附依附。靈魂離開了身體。形容極端驚恐或在某種事物誘惑下失去常態。
explanationEn: Soul leaves the body; describes extreme terror or being so captivated by something that one loses self-control.
derivation: 元·乔梦符《金钱记》第一折使小生魂不附体。”
derivationTraditional: 元·喬夢符《金錢記》第一折使小生魂不附體。”
derivationEn: Yuan·Qiao Mengfu's 'The Gold Coin' Act 1: 'It made my soul leave my body.'
example: 承惊觉，不见诏书，～，手脚慌乱。（明·罗贯中《三国演义》第二十回）
exampleTraditional: 承驚覺，不見詔書，～，手腳慌亂。（明·羅貫中《三國演義》第二十回）
exampleEn: Cheng was startled, and when he saw the imperial edict was missing, his soul left his body, and he was flustered. ★ Ming·Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 20

explanation: 本为唐代诗人顾况以白居易的名字开玩笑◇比喻居住在大城市，生活不容易维持。
explanationTraditional: 本為唐代詩人顧況以白居易的名字開玩笑◇比喻居住在大城市，生活不容易維持。
explanationEn: Originally a joke by Tang poet Gu Kuang about Bai Juyi's name; now means it is difficult to make a living in a big city.
derivation: 唐·张固《幽闲鼓吹》白尚书应举，初至京，以诗谒著作顾况，顾睹姓名，熟视白公曰‘米价方贵，居亦弗易。’”
derivationTraditional: 唐·張固《幽閒鼓吹》白尚書應舉，初至京，以詩謁著作顧況，顧睹姓名，熟視白公曰‘米價方貴，居亦弗易。’”
derivationEn: Tang·Zhang Gu's 'Leisurely Anecdotes': 'Minister Bai (Juyi) went to the capital for the imperial exam and visited Gu Kuang with his poems. Gu looked at his name and said, 'Rice is expensive here, living is not easy either.''
example: 我虽不惮荒凉，但若购买食物，须奔波数里，则亦～耳。★《鲁讯书信集·致许寿裳》
exampleTraditional: 我雖不憚荒涼，但若購買食物，須奔波數里，則亦～耳。★《魯訊書信集·致許壽裳》
exampleEn: Although I don't mind the desolation, if I have to travel several miles to buy food, then living is not easy either. ★ Lu Xun's 'Letters: To Xu Shoushang'

explanation: 妻妾众多的意思。
explanationTraditional: 妻妾眾多的意思。
explanationEn: Having many wives and concubines.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 在今天，男人三妻四妾是可耻的事，还有什么值得骄傲的？
exampleTraditional: 在今天，男人三妻四妾是可恥的事，還有什麼值得驕傲的？
exampleEn: Today, it is shameful for a man to have many wives and concubines; what is there to be proud of?

explanation: 象流水那样易变，象杨花那样轻飘。比喻妇女在感情上不专一。
explanationTraditional: 象流水那樣易變，象楊花那樣輕飄。比喻婦女在感情上不專一。
explanationEn: As changeable as water and as light as willow catkins; describes a woman who is fickle in love.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十二回大凡女人都是水性杨花。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十二回大凡女人都是水性楊花。”
derivationEn: Qing·Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 92: 'Generally, women are all fickle.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 做了事情以后，还有剩余的精力和时间。
explanationTraditional: 做了事情以後，還有剩餘的精力和時間。
explanationEn: Having surplus energy and time after doing something.
derivation: 《论语·学而》行有余力，则以学文。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·學而》行有餘力，則以學文。”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius, Xue Er: 'After doing something, if you have surplus energy, then study literature.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 滔天漫天，弥天。形容罪恶极大。
explanationTraditional: 滔天漫天，彌天。形容罪惡極大。
explanationEn: Describing extremely great sins or crimes.
derivation: 宋·周密《齐东野语》卷十七今开庆误国之人，罪恶滔天。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·周密《齊東野語》卷十七今開慶誤國之人，罪惡滔天。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Mi's 'Qidong Yeyu' of the Song Dynasty: 'The person who wronged the country in the Kaiqing era has sins that reach the sky.'
example: 若是高俅在内，必然阻住，此贼累辱朝廷，～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第七十五回
exampleTraditional: 若是高俅在內，必然阻住，此賊累辱朝廷，～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第七十五回
exampleEn: If Gao Qiu were inside, he would surely obstruct. This villain has repeatedly humiliated the court, his sins are monstrous. — From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 75

explanation: 不懂得事情要紧不要紧。
explanationTraditional: 不懂得事情要緊不要緊。
explanationEn: Not understanding the importance or seriousness of a matter.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·本生》今世之人，惑者多以性养物，则不知轻重也。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·本生》今世之人，惑者多以性養物，則不知輕重也。”
derivationEn: From 'Lüshi Chunqiu', Bensheng: 'People of today are confused, often using their nature to nourish things, thus not knowing the relative importance.'
example: 婆子们～，说是这两日有些病，恐不能就好，到这里问大夫。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一０九回
exampleTraditional: 婆子們～，說是這兩日有些病，恐不能就好，到這裡問大夫。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一０九回
exampleEn: The old women didn't know the seriousness, saying he had been ill for a couple of days and might not recover, so they came to ask the doctor. — From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 109

explanation: 形容不整齐或不一致。同参差不齐”。
explanationTraditional: 形容不整齊或不一致。同參差不齊”。
explanationEn: Describing unevenness or inconsistency; same as '参差不齐'.
derivation: 《南齐书·礼志上》至于嗣位之君，参差不一，宜有定制。”《隋书·后妃传》周公定礼，内职始备列焉。秦、汉以下，代有沿革，品秩差次，前史载之详矣。齐、梁以降，历魏暨周，废置益损，参差不一。”
derivationTraditional: 《南齊書·禮志上》至於嗣位之君，參差不一，宜有定製。”《隋書·后妃傳》周公定禮，內職始備列焉。秦、漢以下，代有沿革，品秩差次，前史載之詳矣。齊、梁以降，歷魏暨周，廢置益損，參差不一。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Southern Qi', Rites: 'As for the succeeding rulers, they were uneven and inconsistent, so a fixed system should be established.'
example: 月梅便把一叠钞票交给紫旒，紫旒接过来一点，只见汇丰的、麦加利的、十元的、五元的、一元的，乱七八糟，～。★清·吴趼人《近代社会龌龊史》第二回
exampleTraditional: 月梅便把一疊鈔票交給紫旒，紫旒接過來一點，只見滙豐的、麥加利的、十元的、五元的、一元的，亂七八糟，～。★清·吳趼人《近代社會齷齪史》第二回
exampleEn: Yue Mei handed a stack of banknotes to Ziliu, who took them and counted: HSBC, Mercantile, ten-yuan, five-yuan, one-yuan, all mixed up, uneven and inconsistent. — From Wu Jianren's 'Modern Society's Filthy History', Chapter 2

explanation: 象鼎的三只脚一样，三者各立一方。比喻三方面分立相持的局面。
explanationTraditional: 象鼎的三隻腳一樣，三者各立一方。比喻三方面分立相持的局面。
explanationEn: Like the three legs of a tripod, each standing on its own. Metaphor for three parties standing in a stalemate.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》臣愿披腹心，输肝胆，效愚计，恐足下不能用也。诚能听臣之计，莫若两利而俱存之，三分天下，鼎足而居，其势莫敢先动。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》臣願披腹心，輸肝膽，效愚計，恐足下不能用也。誠能聽臣之計，莫若兩利而俱存之，三分天下，鼎足而居，其勢莫敢先動。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian', Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin: 'I wish to bare my heart and offer my humble plan, fearing you may not use it. If you can listen to my plan, it is better to benefit both and let them coexist, dividing the world into three parts, standing like a tripod, so that no one dares to move first.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一个肥胖的脑袋，两只大耳朵。形容体态肥胖，有时指小孩可爱。
explanationTraditional: 一個肥胖的腦袋，兩隻大耳朵。形容體態肥胖，有時指小孩可愛。
explanationEn: A fat head and big ears. Describes a plump physique, sometimes referring to a cute child.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十二回看上去有七八岁光景，倒生得肥头大耳。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十二回看上去有七八歲光景，倒生得肥頭大耳。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 22: 'He looked about seven or eight years old, and was born with a fat head and big ears.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 古代神话。同夸父逐日”。
explanationTraditional: 古代神話。同夸父逐日”。
explanationEn: An ancient myth. Same as '夸父逐日'.
derivation: 毛泽东《矛盾论》神话中的许多变化，例如《山海经》中所说的‘夸父追日’……这种神话中所说的矛盾的互相变化，乃是无数复杂的现实矛盾的互相变化对于人们所引起的一种幼稚的、想象的、主观幻想的变化……”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《矛盾論》神話中的許多變化，例如《山海經》中所說的‘夸父追日’……這種神話中所說的矛盾的互相變化，乃是無數複雜的現實矛盾的互相變化對於人們所引起的一種幼稚的、想象的、主觀幻想的變化……”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'On Contradiction': 'Many changes in myths, such as 'Kuafu chasing the sun' in the 'Classic of Mountains and Seas'... the contradictory changes in such myths are a kind of naive, imaginative, subjective fantasy caused by the mutual changes of countless complex real contradictions.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 讳言不敢说或不愿说。没有什么不可以直说的。指可以坦率地说。
explanationTraditional: 諱言不敢說或不願說。沒有什麼不可以直說的。指可以坦率地說。
explanationEn: Nothing that cannot be said frankly; meaning it can be said openly.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第三十五回事实俱在，无可讳言。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第三十五回事實俱在，無可諱言。”
derivationEn: From Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu's 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 35: 'The facts are all there, and there is nothing to hide.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 万里指面积大，距离长。形容天气晴朗。
explanationTraditional: 萬里指面積大，距離長。形容天氣晴朗。
explanationEn: Describing clear and sunny weather.
derivation: 权延赤《走下圣坛的周恩来·休息与娱乐》冰峰林立，白云徜徉其间；碧空万里，与皑皑白雪上下辉映，幻化流转着七彩光芒。”
derivationTraditional: 權延赤《走下聖壇的周恩來·休息與娛樂》冰峰林立，白雲徜徉其間；碧空萬里，與皚皚白雪上下輝映，幻化流轉著七彩光芒。”
derivationEn: From Quan Yanshi's 'Zhou Enlai's Rest and Recreation': 'Ice peaks stand tall, white clouds wander among them; the clear sky stretches for miles, reflecting with the pure white snow, shimmering with colorful light.'
example: 二百万年前的一天，～无云，太阳炙烤着大地。★《黄河象》
exampleTraditional: 二百萬年前的一天，～無雲，太陽炙烤著大地。★《黃河象》
exampleEn: Two million years ago, the sky was clear and cloudless, the sun scorching the earth. — From 'The Yellow River Elephant'

explanation: 形容不知利害，冒昧从事。
explanationTraditional: 形容不知利害，冒昧從事。
explanationEn: Describing acting recklessly without regard for consequences.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷三十彼时日色将晚，前无行人，就把他尽力一推，推落崖下，不知死活。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷三十彼時日色將晚，前無行人，就把他盡力一推，推落崖下，不知死活。”
derivationEn: From Ling Mengchu's 'First Collection of Surprising Tales', Volume 30: 'At that time, the sun was setting, and there were no pedestrians ahead. He pushed him hard, sending him off the cliff, not knowing whether he was dead or alive.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容文章或言谈中不必要的废话太多。
explanationTraditional: 形容文章或言談中不必要的廢話太多。
explanationEn: Describes a speech or writing that is full of unnecessary nonsense.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他的文章真是～，言之无物。
exampleTraditional: 他的文章真是～，言之無物。
exampleEn: His article is really full of nonsense and lacks substance.

explanation: 归结到根本上。
explanationTraditional: 歸結到根本上。
explanationEn: To boil down to the fundamentals.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文二集·叶紫作〈丰收〉序》天才们无论怎样说大话，归根结蒂，还是不能凭空创造。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文二集·葉紫作〈豐收〉序》天才們無論怎樣說大話，歸根結蒂，還是不能憑空創造。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'Essays in the Semi-concessions, Volume 2: Preface to Ye Zi's 'Harvest'': 'No matter how geniuses boast, in the final analysis, they cannot create something out of nothing.'
example: ～，俄国的力量是在工农兵苏维埃这方面。★毛泽东《和美国记者安娜·路易斯·斯特朗的谈话》
exampleTraditional: ～，俄國的力量是在工農兵蘇維埃這方面。★毛澤東《和美國記者安娜·路易斯·斯特朗的談話》
exampleEn: In the final analysis, Russia's strength lies in the Soviets of workers, peasants, and soldiers. ★ Mao Zedong's 'Talk with the American Correspondent Anna Louise Strong'

explanation: 整严整；暇不急迫。形容既严整，又从容。也指事情虽多，仍旧从容不迫。
explanationTraditional: 整嚴整；暇不急迫。形容既嚴整，又從容。也指事情雖多，仍舊從容不迫。
explanationEn: Describes being both orderly and unhurried; also refers to handling many matters with composure.
derivation: 《左传·成公十六年》日臣之使于楚也，子重问晋国之勇，臣对曰‘好以众整。’曰‘又何如？’臣对曰‘好以暇。’”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·成公十六年》日臣之使於楚也，子重問晉國之勇，臣對曰‘好以眾整。’曰‘又何如？’臣對曰‘好以暇。’”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: The 16th Year of Duke Cheng': 'When I was on a mission to Chu, Zi Zhong asked about the bravery of Jin. I replied, 'They like to be orderly in numbers.' He asked, 'What else?' I replied, 'They like to be unhurried.'
example: 在这种人心惶惶的时候，珏斋却～，大有轻裘缓带的气象，只把军队移驻山海关。（清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十五回）
exampleTraditional: 在這種人心惶惶的時候，珏齋卻～，大有輕裘緩帶的氣象，只把軍隊移駐山海關。（清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十五回）
exampleEn: In this time of panic, Jue Zhai remained composed and unhurried, with a grand air, only moving the troops to Shanhaiguan. (Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Evil', Chapter 25)

explanation: 结发束发，意即年轻时。年轻时结成的夫妻。指原配夫妻。
explanationTraditional: 結髮束髮，意即年輕時。年輕時結成的夫妻。指原配夫妻。
explanationEn: A couple married when young; refers to one's first and original spouse.
derivation: 汉·苏武《诗四首》三结发为夫妻，恩爱两不疑。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·蘇武《詩四首》三結髮為夫妻，恩愛兩不疑。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Su Wu's 'Four Poems' (3): 'We tied our hair and became husband and wife, loving each other without doubt.'
example: 官人，我与你～，苦乐同受。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷九
exampleTraditional: 官人，我與你～，苦樂同受。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷九
exampleEn: My husband, I am your original wife, sharing joys and sorrows with you. ★ Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 9

explanation: 谢推辞；不敏不聪明，没有才能。恭敬地表示能力不够或不能接受。多作推辞做某事的婉辞。
explanationTraditional: 謝推辭；不敏不聰明，沒有才能。恭敬地表示能力不夠或不能接受。多作推辭做某事的婉辭。
explanationEn: To politely decline due to lack of ability; a courteous way to refuse a task.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《寄卢仝》诗买羊沽酒谢不敏，偶逢明月曜桃李。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《寄盧仝》詩買羊沽酒謝不敏，偶逢明月曜桃李。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Poem to Lu Tong': 'Buying wine and sheep to apologize for my incompetence, occasionally meeting the bright moon shining on peach and plum.'
example: 若曰凡为诗者，必须意深思远，神韵悠然，则～矣。★清·得硕亭《〈草珠一串〉一序》
exampleTraditional: 若曰凡為詩者，必須意深思遠，神韻悠然，則～矣。★清·得碩亭《〈草珠一串〉一序》
exampleEn: If it is said that all poets must have profound thoughts and graceful charm, then I must respectfully decline. ★ Qing Dynasty, De Shuo Ting's 'Preface to 'A String of Strawberries'

explanation: 天天意；命命运。安于自己的处境，由命运安排。这是相信宿命论的人生观。
explanationTraditional: 天天意；命命運。安於自己的處境，由命運安排。這是相信宿命論的人生觀。
explanationEn: To be content with one's circumstances and accept fate; a fatalistic outlook on life.
derivation: 《周易·系辞上》乐天知命，故不忧。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭上》樂天知命，故不憂。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes: Appended Remarks, Part 1': 'To be content with heaven's will and know fate, thus not worrying.'
example: 近来我在林下，倒常教他做几首诗，吟咏性情，要他知道～的道理，在我膝下承欢便了。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第八回
exampleTraditional: 近來我在林下，倒常教他做幾首詩，吟詠性情，要他知道～的道理，在我膝下承歡便了。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第八回
exampleEn: Recently, while living in seclusion, I often teach him to write poems to express his feelings, so he understands the principle of being content with fate and enjoying my company. ★ Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 8

explanation: 男做盗贼，女为娼妓。形容男女都做坏事或思想极其腐朽卑劣。
explanationTraditional: 男做盜賊，女為娼妓。形容男女都做壞事或思想極其腐朽卑劣。
explanationEn: Men become thieves, women become prostitutes; describes people who do evil or are extremely corrupt and despicable.
derivation: 鲁迅《坟·论他妈的！”》口上仁义礼智，心里男盗女娼。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《墳·論他媽的！”》口上仁義禮智，心裡男盜女娼。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'Tomb: On 'Damn It!': 'Mouths speak of benevolence and righteousness, but hearts harbor thoughts of men as thieves and women as prostitutes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 本指白杨木受到外力作用，只会断折，不会弯曲变形◇用来比喻宁可死也绝不屈服妥协。
explanationTraditional: 本指白楊木受到外力作用，只會斷折，不會彎曲變形◇用來比喻寧可死也絕不屈服妥協。
explanationEn: Originally refers to white poplar wood that breaks rather than bends under force; metaphorically means preferring death over submission.
derivation: 《齐民要术·卷五·种榆白杨》白杨性甚劲直，堪为屋材，折则折矣，终不曲挠。”
derivationTraditional: 《齊民要術·卷五·種榆白楊》白楊性甚勁直，堪為屋材，折則折矣，終不曲撓。”
derivationEn: 'Essential Techniques for the Common People, Volume 5: Planting Elms and White Poplars': 'White poplar is very strong and straight, suitable for building materials; it breaks but never bends.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容十分珍爱。
explanationTraditional: 形容十分珍愛。
explanationEn: To cherish something very much.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一百十八回当此圣世，咱们世受国恩，祖父锦衣玉食；况你自有生以来，自去世的老太太，以及老爷太太，视如珍宝。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一百十八回當此聖世，咱們世受國恩，祖父錦衣玉食；況你自有生以來，自去世的老太太，以及老爺太太，視如珍寶。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 118: 'In this sage era, our family has received the nation's grace; our ancestors enjoyed luxury. Since you were born, from the late matriarch to the master and mistress, you have been treasured like a precious gem.'
example: 令尊只亲生你一个儿子，～。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 令尊只親生你一個兒子，～。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第十四回
exampleEn: Your father only has you as his son, and he treasures you like a precious gem. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Lüyuan's 'The Road to Enlightenment', Chapter 14

explanation: 芳香，指美名∶名声永远流传。
explanationTraditional: 芳香，指美名∶名聲永遠流傳。
explanationEn: A good name that will be remembered forever.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·排调》头责秦子羽云。”刘孝标注引张敏《头责子羽文》子欲为名高也，则当如许由、子威、卞随、务光，洗耳逃禄，千载流芳。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·排調》頭責秦子羽雲。”劉孝標註引張敏《頭責子羽文》子欲為名高也，則當如許由、子威、卞隨、務光，洗耳逃祿，千載流芳。”
derivationEn: Southern Song, Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Banter', with annotation by Liu Xiaobiao quoting Zhang Min's 'The Head Blames Zi Yu': 'If you want a high reputation, you should be like Xu You, Zi Wei, Bian Sui, and Wu Guang, who washed their ears and fled from fame, leaving a fragrance for a thousand years.'
example: 汉廷黯忠，唐室魏征良，见如今千载明扬，～。★元·无名氏《延安府》第三折
exampleTraditional: 漢廷黯忠，唐室魏徵良，見如今千載明揚，～。★元·無名氏《延安府》第三折
exampleEn: Han's Zhuo Zhong was loyal, Tang's Wei Zheng was virtuous; now they are praised for a thousand years, their fragrance flows forever. ★ Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous's 'Yan'an Prefecture', Third Act

explanation: 比喻徒有外表而无学识才能的人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻徒有外表而無學識才能的人。
explanationEn: Refers to someone who is outwardly attractive but lacks real ability or knowledge.
derivation: 清·彭养鸥《黑籍冤魂》第六回顶冠束带，居然官宦人家，谁敢说他是个绣花枕头，外面绣得五色灿烂，里面却包着一包稻草。”
derivationTraditional: 清·彭養鷗《黑籍冤魂》第六回頂冠束帶，居然官宦人家，誰敢說他是個繡花枕頭，外面繡得五色燦爛，裡面卻包著一包稻草。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Peng Yangou's 'The Ghost of Opium' Chapter 6: 'Wearing a hat and belt, he looks like an official; who dares say he is an embroidered pillow, with colorful embroidery outside but a bundle of straw inside?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指主管婚姻的神仙◇泛指媒人。简称月老”。
explanationTraditional: 原指主管婚姻的神仙◇泛指媒人。簡稱月老”。
explanationEn: Originally refers to the god of marriage; later used as a general term for a matchmaker. Abbreviated as 'Yuelao'.
derivation: 唐·李复言《续幽怪录》记载传说故事唐朝的韦固路过宋城，遇一老人在月光下翻检一本书。询问后，知道老人是专管人间婚姻的神，翻检的书是婚姻簿子。
derivationTraditional: 唐·李復言《續幽怪錄》記載傳說故事唐朝的韋固路過宋城，遇一老人在月光下翻檢一本書。詢問後，知道老人是專管人間婚姻的神，翻檢的書是婚姻簿子。
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li Fuyan's 'Sequel to Youguai Lu': A story about Wei Gu meeting an old man reading a book under the moonlight in Song City. The old man was the god in charge of human marriages, and the book was the marriage register.
example: 正是一对佳人才子。虽在海外，也是一国驸马，富贵无穷。况天缘是～赤绳系定的，不必多疑。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 正是一對佳人才子。雖在海外，也是一國駙馬，富貴無窮。況天緣是～赤繩系定的，不必多疑。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十二回
exampleEn: Indeed a perfect couple. Although abroad, he is a prince consort of a country, with endless wealth. Moreover, the heavenly fate is tied by the red thread of the matchmaker under the moon; there is no need to doubt. — Qing Dynasty Chen Chen's 'Water Margin Sequel' Chapter 12

explanation: 赤空。形容天灾或战争造成大量土地荒凉的景象。
explanationTraditional: 赤空。形容天災或戰爭造成大量土地荒涼的景象。
explanationEn: Describes a vast area of barren land caused by natural disasters or war.
derivation: 《韩非子·十过》晋国大旱，赤地千里。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·十過》晉國大旱，赤地千里。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: The Faults of the Ten': 'Jin state suffered a great drought, leaving a thousand li of barren land.'
example: 说者谓当兵燹之余，污菜遍野，版籍荡然，人民死亡，～。★清·阮葵生《茶余客话》卷三
exampleTraditional: 說者謂當兵燹之餘，汙菜遍野，版籍蕩然，人民死亡，～。★清·阮葵生《茶餘客話》卷三
exampleEn: It is said that after the war, the land was overgrown with weeds, records were lost, people died, and a thousand li of barren land remained. — Qing Dynasty Ruan Kuisheng's 'Tea Leftovers' Volume 3

explanation: 比喻既有情致，又有胆识（旧小说多用来形容能文能武的才子）。
explanationTraditional: 比喻既有情致，又有膽識（舊小說多用來形容能文能武的才子）。
explanationEn: Metaphor for someone who is both refined and courageous (often used in old novels to describe a talented person skilled in both civil and martial arts).
derivation: 元·吴莱《寄董与几》诗小榻琴心展，长缨剑胆舒。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳萊《寄董與幾》詩小榻琴心展，長纓劍膽舒。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Wu Lai's poem 'To Dong and Ji': 'The small couch reveals a zither heart, the long tassel shows a sword gall.'
example: 说实在话，简直是出类拔萃，～。★欧阳山《三家巷》二十
exampleTraditional: 說實在話，簡直是出類拔萃，～。★歐陽山《三家巷》二十
exampleEn: To be honest, he is outstanding, with both sword gall and zither heart. — Ouyang Shan's 'Three Family Lane' Chapter 20

explanation: 另外请一个较高明的人，意即不想受委托或聘请。
explanationTraditional: 另外請一個較高明的人，意即不想受委託或聘請。
explanationEn: To ask someone else more capable; implies unwillingness to accept a commission or invitation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这件事我无能为力，你还是～吧！
exampleTraditional: 這件事我無能為力，你還是～吧！
