exampleEn: Chunlan, being newly arrived, was not at all shy. — Liang Bin, Red Flag Chronicle

explanation: 沙场战场。鲜血染红了战场。指在战场上牺牲。
explanationTraditional: 沙場戰場。鮮血染紅了戰場。指在戰場上犧牲。
explanationEn: Blood stains the battlefield; to die in battle.
derivation: 明·无名氏《杨家将演义》卷二设将军等今日不来，吾辈血染沙场早矣。”
derivationTraditional: 明·無名氏《楊家將演義》卷二設將軍等今日不來，吾輩血染沙場早矣。”
derivationEn: Ming anonymous, The Yang Family Generals, Volume 2: 'If you generals had not come today, we would have long stained the battlefield with our blood.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 寐睡着。形容因心中有事，晚上怎么也睡不着觉。
explanationTraditional: 寐睡著。形容因心中有事，晚上怎麼也睡不著覺。
explanationEn: Unable to sleep at night due to worry or preoccupation.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《夷坚志·乙志卷八·虔州城楼》明日而先公言‘汝夜何所往？吾闻抱关老卒云，楼故多怪，每夕必出。’予因道昨见者。是日徒于孤独，竟夜不能寐。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《夷堅志·乙志卷八·虔州城樓》明日而先公言‘汝夜何所往？吾聞抱關老卒雲，樓故多怪，每夕必出。’予因道昨見者。是日徒於孤獨，竟夜不能寐。”
derivationEn: Song Hong Mai, Yijian Zhi, Volume 8: 'The next day, my father said, 'Where did you go last night? I heard the gatekeeper say the building is haunted.' I then told him what I saw. That day I moved to a lonely place and could not sleep all night.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一抔一捧。一捧黄土。借指坟墓。现多比喻不多的土地或没落、渺小的反动势力。
explanationTraditional: 一抔一捧。一捧黃土。借指墳墓。現多比喻不多的土地或沒落、渺小的反動勢力。
explanationEn: A handful of yellow earth; refers to a grave; also used metaphorically for a small piece of land or a declining force.
derivation: 《史记·张释之列传》假令愚民取长陵一抔土，陛下何以加其法乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·張釋之列傳》假令愚民取長陵一抔土，陛下何以加其法乎？”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian, Biography of Zhang Shizhi: 'If a foolish person takes a handful of earth from the Changling tomb, how would Your Majesty punish him?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 华丽的车子，珍贵的宝马。指考究的车骑。
explanationTraditional: 華麗的車子，珍貴的寶馬。指考究的車騎。
explanationEn: Fine horses and fragrant carriages; luxurious vehicles.
derivation: 唐·韦应物《长安道》诗宝马横来下建章，香车却转避驰道。
derivationTraditional: 唐·韋應物《長安道》詩寶馬橫來下建章，香車卻轉避馳道。
derivationEn: Tang Wei Yingwu, 'Chang'an Road' poem: 'Fine horses come from the Jianzhang Palace, fragrant carriages turn to avoid the imperial road.'
example: 冷落了歌儿舞女，空闲了～。★元·王实甫《丽春堂》第三折
exampleTraditional: 冷落了歌兒舞女，空閒了～。★元·王實甫《麗春堂》第三折
exampleEn: The singing girls and dancers are neglected, the fine horses and fragrant carriages are idle. — Yuan Wang Shifu, The Hall of Spring

explanation: 补补助，补益。多少有一点益处或多少有一点帮助。
explanationTraditional: 補補助，補益。多少有一點益處或多少有一點幫助。
explanationEn: Not without some benefit; somewhat helpful.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《〈尚书〉一·纲领》诸家虽或浅近，要亦不无小补，但在详择之耳。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《〈尚書〉一·綱領》諸家雖或淺近，要亦不無小補，但在詳擇之耳。”
derivationEn: Song Zhu Xi, 'Preface to the Book of Documents': 'Although various commentaries may be shallow, they are not without some benefit, but one must choose carefully.'
example: 穷得当卖全无，虽只区区四金，倒也～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 窮得當賣全無，雖只區區四金，倒也～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十八回
exampleEn: When one is utterly destitute, even a small sum of four gold pieces is not without some help. — Qing Li Baojia, The Bureaucrats

explanation: 划拳行酒令。形容宴饮欢畅。猜拳饮酒时两人同时伸出手指并说一数，如数与两人伸出手指的总数相符为胜，输者罚酒。
explanationTraditional: 划拳行酒令。形容宴飲歡暢。猜拳飲酒時兩人同時伸出手指並說一數，如數與兩人伸出手指的總數相符為勝，輸者罰酒。
explanationEn: Playing finger-guessing games and drinking games; describes a lively banquet.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二十七汪秀才解带脱衣，尽情欢宴，猜拳行令，不存一毫形迹。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二十七汪秀才解帶脫衣，盡情歡宴，猜拳行令，不存一毫形跡。”
derivationEn: Ming Ling Mengchu, Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 27: 'Scholar Wang untied his belt and took off his clothes, feasting heartily, playing finger-guessing games and drinking games without any restraint.'
example: 这里摆酒上席，依次坐了。宾主七八个人，～，大盘大碗，吃了个尽兴。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第五十二回
exampleTraditional: 這裡擺酒上席，依次坐了。賓主七八個人，～，大盤大碗，吃了個盡興。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第五十二回
exampleEn: They set out wine and took seats. The seven or eight guests and hosts played finger-guessing games and drank heartily, eating to their fill. — Qing Wu Jingzi, The Scholars

explanation: 法法律；阿偏袒。法律即使是对高贵的人，有权势的人也不徇情。形容执法公正，法律面前人人平等。
explanationTraditional: 法法律；阿偏袒。法律即使是對高貴的人，有權勢的人也不徇情。形容執法公正，法律面前人人平等。
explanationEn: The law does not favor the noble; justice is impartial, and all are equal before the law.
derivation: 《韩非子·有度》法不阿贵，绳不绕曲。法之所加，智者弗能辞，勇者弗敢争，刑过不避大臣，赏善不遗匹夫。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·有度》法不阿貴，繩不繞曲。法之所加，智者弗能辭，勇者弗敢爭，刑過不避大臣，賞善不遺匹夫。”
derivationEn: Han Feizi, 'On Having Standards': 'The law does not favor the noble, nor does the plumb line bend around a curve. Where the law applies, the wise cannot argue, the brave cannot contend; punishment does not avoid ministers, and rewards do not overlook commoners.'
example: 做到～可能会遇到种种习惯势力的阻挠，因此，我们一定执法守法，坚决顶住歪风邪气的侵袭。
exampleTraditional: 做到～可能會遇到種種習慣勢力的阻撓，因此，我們一定執法守法，堅決頂住歪風邪氣的侵襲。
exampleEn: Achieving impartial law enforcement may encounter resistance from various customary forces; therefore, we must uphold the law and resolutely resist the invasion of unhealthy trends.

explanation: 形容不畏艰险，在前开路。常与遇水叠桥”连用。
explanationTraditional: 形容不畏艱險，在前開路。常與遇水疊橋”連用。
explanationEn: Describes overcoming obstacles and forging ahead fearlessly, often used together with '遇水叠桥' (building bridges when encountering water).
derivation: 元·关汉卿《哭存孝》第二折三千鸦兵为先锋，逢山开道，遇水叠桥。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《哭存孝》第二折三千鴉兵為先鋒，逢山開道，遇水疊橋。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Crying for Cunxiao', Act 2: 'Three thousand crow soldiers as vanguard, opening roads when meeting mountains, building bridges when encountering water.'
example: 我今日同你两个来这杏花庄上呵，倒做了～。★元·康进之《李逵负荆》第三折
exampleTraditional: 我今日同你兩個來這杏花莊上呵，倒做了～。★元·康進之《李逵負荊》第三折
exampleEn: Today, as I come with you two to this Apricot Blossom Village, I have instead become one who opens roads when meeting mountains. — Yuan Dynasty Kang Jinzhi's 'Li Kui Apologizes', Act 3

explanation: 指幸运的事不会接连到来。
explanationTraditional: 指幸運的事不會接連到來。
explanationEn: Refers to the idea that fortunate events do not come in succession.
derivation: 汉·刘向《说苑·权谋》此所谓福不重至，祸必重来者也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉向《說苑·權謀》此所謂福不重至，禍必重來者也。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Liu Xiang's 'Garden of Stories: Strategies': 'This is what is meant by blessings do not come twice, misfortunes are sure to come repeatedly.'
example: 宋江听罢，扯定两个公人说道却是苦也！正是‘～，祸不单行。’”★明·施耐庵《水浒会传》第三十七回
exampleTraditional: 宋江聽罷，扯定兩個公人說道卻是苦也！正是‘～，禍不單行。’”★明·施耐庵《水滸會傳》第三十七回
exampleEn: Song Jiang heard this, grabbed the two escorts and said, 'This is bitter! Indeed, blessings never come in pairs, misfortunes never come singly.' — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 37

explanation: 旧时官场中有固定格式和套语的例行公文。比喻光注意形式，没有实际内容的空话，或照例敷衍的虚文滥调。
explanationTraditional: 舊時官場中有固定格式和套語的例行公文。比喻光注意形式，沒有實際內容的空話，或照例敷衍的虛文濫調。
explanationEn: Refers to official documents with fixed formats and clichés in old government offices. Metaphorically, it means empty words that focus on formality without substance, or perfunctory routine writings.
derivation: 宋·吴处厚《青箱杂记·文章官样》王安国曰‘文章格调须是官样。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·吳處厚《青箱雜記·文章官樣》王安國曰‘文章格調須是官樣。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Wu Chuhou's 'Qingxiang Miscellanies: Official Style of Writing': 'Wang Anguo said, 'The style of writing must be official.'
example: 但此辈有运动而无文学，则亦殊令出版者为难，盖～究不能令人自动购读也。★《鲁迅书信集·致李小峰》
exampleTraditional: 但此輩有運動而無文學，則亦殊令出版者為難，蓋～究不能令人自動購讀也。★《魯迅書信集·致李小峰》
exampleEn: But these people have movements without literature, which makes it difficult for publishers, as official-style articles ultimately cannot compel people to buy and read. — Lu Xun's 'Letters to Li Xiaofeng'

explanation: 犹浩浩荡荡。指水势壮阔的样子。
explanationTraditional: 猶浩浩蕩蕩。指水勢壯闊的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes a vast and mighty water scene, similar to '浩浩荡荡'.
derivation: 宋·范仲淹《岳阳楼记》浩浩汤汤，横无际涯。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·范仲淹《岳陽樓記》浩浩湯湯，橫無際涯。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Fan Zhongyan's 'Record of Yueyang Tower': 'Vast and mighty, stretching endlessly.'
example: 大江洪河出三峡，下底柱，奔腾冲突于平原之地，～，莫之能御矣。★清·薛福成《论俄罗斯立国之势》
exampleTraditional: 大江洪河出三峽，下底柱，奔騰衝突於平原之地，～，莫之能御矣。★清·薛福成《論俄羅斯立國之勢》
exampleEn: The great rivers and mighty torrents emerge from the Three Gorges, rush down the bottom pillar, surge and clash across the plains, vast and mighty, unstoppable. — Qing Dynasty Xue Fucheng's 'On Russia's National Power'

explanation: 积聚；毁毁谤；销熔化。指不断的毁谤能使人毁灭。
explanationTraditional: 積聚；毀毀謗；銷熔化。指不斷的毀謗能使人毀滅。
explanationEn: Accumulated slander can destroy a person; constant defamation leads to ruin.
derivation: 《史记·张仪列传》众口铄金，积毁销骨。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·張儀列傳》眾口鑠金，積毀銷骨。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Zhang Yi': 'Public opinion can melt metal, accumulated slander can dissolve bones.'
example: 而股肱之臣不惟国体，职竞寻常，自相楚剥，为害转深，～。★《晋书·刘乔传》
exampleTraditional: 而股肱之臣不惟國體，職競尋常，自相楚剝，為害轉深，～。★《晉書·劉喬傳》
exampleEn: But the ministers do not consider the state's interests, competing in trivial matters, harming each other, deepening the damage, accumulated slander dissolving bones. — 'Book of Jin: Biography of Liu Qiao'

explanation: 形容感情激动或害羞的样子。亦作脸红耳热”。
explanationTraditional: 形容感情激動或害羞的樣子。亦作臉紅耳熱”。
explanationEn: Describes a person's face turning red due to strong emotion or embarrassment.
derivation: 萧殷《桃子又熟了》一没有等翻译同志把所有的问题都提出来，那个美国人竟脸红耳赤地吼起来。”
derivationTraditional: 蕭殷《桃子又熟了》一沒有等翻譯同志把所有的問題都提出來，那個美國人竟臉紅耳赤地吼起來。”
derivationEn: From Xiao Yin's 'The Peaches Are Ripe Again' 1: 'Before the translator could finish asking all the questions, the American shouted with a red face and ears.'
example: 只要我们聚在一起，哪怕是吵得～，心里也是甜滋滋的。★陈宜浩《冤家》
exampleTraditional: 只要我們聚在一起，哪怕是吵得～，心裡也是甜滋滋的。★陳宜浩《冤家》
exampleEn: As long as we gather together, even if we argue until our faces are red and ears are hot, our hearts feel sweet. — Chen Yihao's 'Enemies'

explanation: 形容口吃的人吐辞重复，说话不流利。
explanationTraditional: 形容口吃的人吐辭重複，說話不流利。
explanationEn: Describes stuttering or speaking with hesitation and repetition.
derivation: 《史记·张丞相列传》臣口不能言，然臣期期知其不可；陛下虽欲废太子，臣期期不奉诏。”南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》邓艾口吃，语称艾艾。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·張丞相列傳》臣口不能言，然臣期期知其不可；陛下雖欲廢太子，臣期期不奉詔。”南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》鄧艾口吃，語稱艾艾。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Prime Minister Zhang': 'I cannot speak fluently, but I know it is wrong; even if Your Majesty wants to depose the crown prince, I firmly oppose it.' And from Liu Yiqing's 'New Tales of the World: Speech': 'Deng Ai stuttered, often saying 'Ai, Ai.'
example: 感情的激动使我说话～了。★茅盾《腐蚀·十月十日》
exampleTraditional: 感情的激動使我說話～了。★茅盾《腐蝕·十月十日》
exampleEn: Emotional excitement made me stutter and stammer. — Mao Dun's 'Corrosion: October 10'

explanation: 光线青荧的油灯和纸张泛黄的书卷。借指清苦的攻读生活。
explanationTraditional: 光線青熒的油燈和紙張泛黃的書卷。借指清苦的攻讀生活。
explanationEn: Refers to a dim oil lamp and yellowed books, symbolizing a life of hard study in poverty.
derivation: 元·叶飆《书舍寒灯》诗青灯黄卷伴更长，花落银鈍午夜香。”元·关汉卿《拜月亭》第四折你既爱青灯黄卷，却不要随机而变。”
derivationTraditional: 元·葉飆《書舍寒燈》詩青燈黃卷伴更長，花落銀鈍午夜香。”元·關漢卿《拜月亭》第四折你既愛青燈黃卷，卻不要隨機而變。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Ye Biao's poem 'Lamp in the Study': 'Green lamp and yellow scrolls accompany the long night, flowers fall on the silver candle at midnight.' Also from Guan Hanqing's 'Pavilion of Worshiping the Moon', Act 4: 'Since you love the green lamp and yellow scrolls, do not change with circumstances.'
example: 十载～，萤窗苦勉旃。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第三十六回
exampleTraditional: 十載～，螢窗苦勉旃。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第三十六回
exampleEn: Ten years with green lamp and yellow scrolls, diligently studying by the firefly window. — Ming Dynasty Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng's 'Jin Ping Mei', Chapter 36

explanation: 行装简便，随从人少。
explanationTraditional: 行裝簡便，隨從人少。
explanationEn: Traveling with light luggage and few attendants.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 省吃省穿。泛指生活节俭。
explanationTraditional: 省吃省穿。泛指生活節儉。
explanationEn: To economize on food and clothing; to live frugally.
derivation: 宋·陆游《剑南诗稿·秋获歌》我愿邻曲谨盖藏，缩衣节食勤耕桑。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《劍南詩稿·秋獲歌》我願鄰曲謹蓋藏，縮衣節食勤耕桑。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Lu You's 'Poems of Jiannan: Song of Autumn Harvest': 'I wish neighbors to store carefully, tighten clothes and save food, diligently plow and weave.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 花费的钱财不计其数。
explanationTraditional: 花費的錢財不計其數。
explanationEn: The cost is incalculable; an enormous amount of money is spent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 别人往自己脸上吐唾沫，不擦掉而让它自干。形容受了污辱，极度容忍，不加反抗。
explanationTraditional: 別人往自己臉上吐唾沫，不擦掉而讓它自幹。形容受了汙辱，極度容忍，不加反抗。
explanationEn: To endure extreme humiliation without resistance; to tolerate insult with great forbearance.
derivation: 《新唐书·娄师德传》其弟守代州，辞之官，教之耐事。弟曰‘有人唾面，洁之乃已。’师德曰‘未也，洁之，是违其怒，正使自干耳。’”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·婁師德傳》其弟守代州，辭之官，教之耐事。弟曰‘有人唾面，潔之乃已。’師德曰‘未也，潔之，是違其怒，正使自幹耳。’”
derivationEn: From the New Book of Tang, Biography of Lou Shide: When his brother was about to take office, Lou advised him to be patient. The brother said, 'If someone spits on my face, I will wipe it off.' Lou replied, 'No, wiping it off shows anger; let it dry on its own.'
example: 若讲能够忍耐的，莫若本朝去世不久的娄师德了他告诉兄弟，教他～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第三十八回
exampleTraditional: 若講能夠忍耐的，莫若本朝去世不久的婁師德了他告訴兄弟，教他～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第三十八回
exampleEn: Speaking of those who can endure, none surpass Lou Shide of our dynasty. He told his brother to let the spittle dry on its own. — Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 38

explanation: 心里焦躁，像着了火一样。形容心情焦灼难忍。
explanationTraditional: 心裡焦躁，像著了火一樣。形容心情焦灼難忍。
explanationEn: Anxious and restless, as if on fire; extremely worried.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻虚幻的梦想。
explanationTraditional: 比喻虛幻的夢想。
explanationEn: A fleeting dream; an illusory fantasy.
derivation: 唐·沉既济《枕中记》载，卢生在邯郸旅店中昼寝入梦，历尽富贵荣华，一觉醒来，主人黄粱尚未熟。
derivationTraditional: 唐·沉既濟《枕中記》載，盧生在邯鄲旅店中晝寢入夢，歷盡富貴榮華，一覺醒來，主人黃粱尚未熟。
derivationEn: From Shen Jiji's 'The World Inside a Pillow' in the Tang Dynasty: Lu Sheng fell asleep in a Handan inn, dreamed of a life of wealth and honor, and woke to find the millet still uncooked.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 语言的真正用意没有明白说出来，细细体会就知道。
explanationTraditional: 語言的真正用意沒有明白說出來，細細體會就知道。
explanationEn: The true meaning is implied rather than explicitly stated; read between the lines.
derivation: 宋·胡仔《苕溪渔隐丛话后集》卷十五此绝句极佳，意在言外，而幽怨之情自见，不待明言之也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·胡仔《苕溪漁隱叢話後集》卷十五此絕句極佳，意在言外，而幽怨之情自見，不待明言之也。”
derivationEn: From Hu Zi's 'Tiaoxi Fishing Hermit's Collected Talks' (Later Collection), Volume 15: 'This quatrain is excellent; the meaning lies beyond the words, and the melancholy is naturally revealed without explicit statement.'
example: 无奈红蕖～，总要侍奉祖父百年后方肯远离。任凭若劝，执意不从。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十回
exampleTraditional: 無奈紅蕖～，總要侍奉祖父百年後方肯遠離。任憑若勸，執意不從。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十回
exampleEn: But Hongqu's meaning lay beyond her words; she insisted on serving her grandfather until his death before leaving. No amount of persuasion could change her mind. — Li Ruzhen, Flowers in the Mirror, Chapter 10

explanation: 惧害怕。有胆量的人无所畏惧。
explanationTraditional: 懼害怕。有膽量的人無所畏懼。
explanationEn: A brave person is fearless.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》子曰‘知者不惑，仁者不忧，勇者不惧。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》子曰‘知者不惑，仁者不憂，勇者不懼。’”
derivationEn: From the Analects, Zihan: The Master said, 'The wise are not perplexed, the benevolent are not worried, the brave are not afraid.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 莫不。真假分辨不清。
explanationTraditional: 莫不。真假分辨不清。
explanationEn: Unable to distinguish truth from falsehood.
derivation: 鲁迅《华盖集续编·马上支日记》上午，空六来谈；全谈些报纸上所载的事，真伪莫辨。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《華蓋集續編·馬上支日記》上午，空六來談；全談些報紙上所載的事，真偽莫辨。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Random Notes on Horseback' in 'A Sequel to the Flower Market': 'In the morning, Kong Liu came to talk; we discussed only what was reported in the newspapers, unable to distinguish truth from falsehood.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 由忧愁转为欢喜。
explanationTraditional: 由憂愁轉為歡喜。
explanationEn: To turn sorrow into joy; to change from worry to happiness.
derivation: 明·陆采《怀香记·池塘唔语》解双眉转愁为喜，订芳期欢声和气。”
derivationTraditional: 明·陸採《懷香記·池塘唔語》解雙眉轉愁為喜，訂芳期歡聲和氣。”
derivationEn: From Lu Cai's 'Fragrant Notes, Pond Whisperings' in the Ming Dynasty: 'Unknit the brows, turn sorrow to joy; set a happy date with harmony and laughter.'
example: 昔人云，未有小人才于内，而大将立功于外者，正今日之谓也。”岑浚方始～。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一百回
exampleTraditional: 昔人云，未有小人才於內，而大將立功於外者，正今日之謂也。”岑浚方始～。★清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第一百回
exampleEn: As the ancients said, 'There has never been a case where petty men are within and great generals achieve merit without.' This is exactly today's situation. Cen Jun then turned sorrow into joy. — Xia Jingqu, A Rustic's Idle Talk, Chapter 100

explanation: 犯干犯。封建统治者指人民的反抗、起义。
explanationTraditional: 犯干犯。封建統治者指人民的反抗、起義。
explanationEn: To defy superiors and start a rebellion; to rebel against authority.
derivation: 《论语·学而》不好犯上，而好作乱者，未之有也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·學而》不好犯上，而好作亂者，未之有也。”
derivationEn: From the Analects, Xue'er: 'Those who do not defy superiors but start rebellions have never existed.'
example: 在封建社会的教条之下束缚久了的人，最怕的是～，不忠不义”的罪名。★郭沫若《少年时代·反正前后》
exampleTraditional: 在封建社會的教條之下束縛久了的人，最怕的是～，不忠不義”的罪名。★郭沫若《少年時代·反正前後》
exampleEn: People long bound by feudal ethics were most afraid of the charge of 'defying superiors and starting rebellions, being disloyal and unfilial.' — Guo Moruo, Youth, Before and After the Revolution

explanation: 指恣意行事，不受约束。
explanationTraditional: 指恣意行事，不受約束。
explanationEn: Unrestrained and uninhibited; acting willfully without constraints.
derivation: 《晋书·外戚传·王濛》濛少时放纵不羁，不为乡曲所齿，晚节始克己励行，有风流美誉。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·外戚傳·王濛》濛少時放縱不羈，不為鄉曲所齒，晚節始克己勵行，有風流美譽。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Jin, Biography of Wang Meng: 'When young, Wang Meng was unrestrained and uninhibited, not respected by his neighbors; only later did he restrain himself and cultivate virtue, gaining a reputation for elegance.'
example: 有一少年子，～……乃不娶妻，不事生产作业，每以轻财仗义为志。★明·陶宗仪《辍耕录·飞云渡》
exampleTraditional: 有一少年子，～……乃不娶妻，不事生產作業，每以輕財仗義為志。★明·陶宗儀《輟耕錄·飛雲渡》
exampleEn: There was a young man who was unrestrained and uninhibited... He neither married nor engaged in production, but prided himself on generosity and chivalry. — Tao Zongyi, Records of Chuogeng, Feiyun Ferry

explanation: 指关系最密切的亲属。
explanationTraditional: 指關係最密切的親屬。
explanationEn: Refers to the closest relatives, such as parents, children, siblings.
derivation: 《三国志·魏书·鲜卑传》不如还我，我与汝是骨肉至亲，，岂与仇等。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏書·鮮卑傳》不如還我，我與汝是骨肉至親，，豈與仇等。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Book of Wei, Biography of Xianbei': 'Better to return me, you and I are flesh and blood, how can we be like enemies?'
example: 萧队长又说，贫雇是农是～，我才敢说话。★曲波《暴风骤雨》二十五
exampleTraditional: 蕭隊長又說，貧僱是農是～，我才敢說話。★曲波《暴風驟雨》二十五
exampleEn: Captain Xiao also said, 'The poor and hired peasants are our flesh and blood, only then dare I speak.' — Qu Bo, 'Storm' Chapter 25

explanation: 借贷借钱。没有地方借钱。
explanationTraditional: 借貸借錢。沒有地方借錢。
explanationEn: Having no place to borrow money; unable to get a loan.
derivation: 《夜雨秋灯录·义猫》翁家乏食，借贷无门，典质已尽。”
derivationTraditional: 《夜雨秋燈錄·義貓》翁家乏食，借貸無門，典質已盡。”
derivationEn: From 'Night Rain and Autumn Lamp Records: The Righteous Cat': 'The old man's family lacked food, had no way to borrow, and had pawned everything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 怒目睁大眼睛，眼珠突出。形容面目威猛可畏。
explanationTraditional: 怒目睜大眼睛，眼珠突出。形容面目威猛可畏。
explanationEn: Describes a fierce and awe-inspiring appearance, like a guardian deity with glaring eyes.
derivation: 《太平广记》卷一七四引《谈薮》金刚努目，所以降伏四魔；菩萨低眉，所以慈悲六道。”
derivationTraditional: 《太平廣記》卷一七四引《談藪》金剛努目，所以降伏四魔；菩薩低眉，所以慈悲六道。”
derivationEn: From 'Extensive Records of the Taiping Era' Vol. 174 quoting 'Tan Sou': 'The Vajra with glaring eyes subdues the four demons; the Bodhisattva with lowered eyes shows compassion to all beings.'
example: 不料他竟一点不窘，立刻用～”式，向我大喝一声。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文末编·我的第一个师父》
exampleTraditional: 不料他竟一點不窘，立刻用～”式，向我大喝一聲。★魯迅《且介亭雜文末編·我的第一個師父》
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, he was not at all embarrassed, and immediately assumed a 'Vajra glaring' posture, shouting at me. — Lu Xun, 'Qiejieting Essays: My First Master'

explanation: 元老政界年辈资望高的人。指建国时资历声望高的人。
explanationTraditional: 元老政界年輩資望高的人。指建國時資歷聲望高的人。
explanationEn: A founding elder; a person of high seniority and prestige who contributed to the establishment of a nation.
derivation: 《北史·赵普传》伏见山南东道节度使赵普，开国元老，参谋缔构，厚重有识。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·趙普傳》伏見山南東道節度使趙普，開國元老，參謀締構，厚重有識。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties, Biography of Zhao Pu': 'I humbly observe that Zhao Pu, the military governor of Shannan East Circuit, is a founding elder who participated in strategic planning and is knowledgeable and prudent.'
example: 秉忠自幼为僧，世祖至大都见之，乃以释服相从军旅间，未年始就冠服，为元朝～，非偶然也。★明·李贽《焚书·与周友山书》
exampleTraditional: 秉忠自幼為僧，世祖至大都見之，乃以釋服相從軍旅間，未年始就冠服，為元朝～，非偶然也。★明·李贄《焚書·與周友山書》
exampleEn: Bingzhong became a monk as a child, followed the emperor in military campaigns in monastic robes, and only later donned official attire, becoming a founding elder of the Yuan dynasty, not by chance. — Ming Li Zhi, 'Burning Books: Letter to Friend Zhou Youshan'

explanation: 由于羞愧到了极点，下不了台而发怒。
explanationTraditional: 由於羞愧到了極點，下不了臺而發怒。
explanationEn: To become angry due to extreme embarrassment and loss of face.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十一回乌额拉布见田小辫子说出这样的话来，便也恼羞成怒。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十一回烏額拉布見田小辮子說出這樣的話來，便也惱羞成怒。”
derivationEn: From Qing Li Baojia's 'Officialdom Unmasked' Chapter 31: 'Ulab saw Tian Xiaobianzi say such words, and thus became angry from shame.'
example: 那家伙～，逼着她往前走。★梁斌十三《红旗谱》
exampleTraditional: 那傢伙～，逼著她往前走。★梁斌十三《紅旗譜》
exampleEn: That fellow, enraged from shame, forced her to move forward. — Liang Bin, 'Thirteen: The Red Flag'

explanation: 旧时迷信说法，命运早已决定安排好了。亦作命中注定”。
explanationTraditional: 舊時迷信說法，命運早已決定安排好了。亦作命中註定”。
explanationEn: Superstitious belief that one's fate is predetermined and arranged by destiny.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指帝王的妃嫔。
explanationTraditional: 泛指帝王的妃嬪。
explanationEn: Refers to the imperial consorts and concubines in the palace.
derivation: 元·无名氏《抱妆盒》楔子兀那三宫六院，妃嫔彩女听者明日圣驾亲到御园，打一金弹，金弹落处，有拾得者。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《抱妝盒》楔子兀那三宮六院，妃嬪綵女聽者明日聖駕親到御園，打一金彈，金彈落處，有拾得者。”
derivationEn: From Yuan anonymous 'The Box of Embracing the Child' Prologue: 'Listen, all consorts and concubines of the three palaces and six courtyards: tomorrow the emperor will visit the imperial garden and shoot a golden pellet; whoever picks it up...'
example: 天子封我掌国邦，～皆钦付。★弹词《英烈春秋》
exampleTraditional: 天子封我掌國邦，～皆欽付。★彈詞《英烈春秋》
exampleEn: The emperor enfeoffed me to govern the state, and all the three palaces and six courtyards are under my command. — Tanci 'The Spring and Autumn of Yinglie'

explanation: 倏忽然，极快地。指极短的时间。
explanationTraditional: 倏忽然，極快地。指極短的時間。
explanationEn: In an instant; a very short period of time.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 数屡次；鲜新杀的禽兽，引伸为新鲜。本指对于常来之客，就不宰杀禽兽招待◇指常常见到，并不新奇。
explanationTraditional: 數屢次；鮮新殺的禽獸，引伸為新鮮。本指對於常來之客，就不宰殺禽獸招待◇指常常見到，並不新奇。
explanationEn: Commonly seen; not novel or surprising because it happens often.
derivation: 《史记·郦生陆贾列传》一岁中往来过他客，率不过再三过，数见不鲜，无久慁公为也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·酈生陸賈列傳》一歲中往來過他客，率不過再三過，數見不鮮，無久慁公為也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian, Biographies of Li Yiji and Lu Jia': 'In a year, he visited other guests no more than two or three times; frequent visits are not fresh, do not trouble him.'
example: 这种谣言，在各处所发生的真～了。（鲁迅《集外集拾遗·启事》）
exampleTraditional: 這種謠言，在各處所發生的真～了。（魯迅《集外集拾遺·啟事》）
exampleEn: Such rumors are truly common everywhere. — Lu Xun, 'Collection of Extracollected Works: Announcement'

explanation: 天不成全美事。多指要进行的事情因刮风下雨而受到了影响。
explanationTraditional: 天不成全美事。多指要進行的事情因颳風下雨而受到了影響。
explanationEn: The weather does not cooperate; circumstances are unfavorable, especially due to rain or wind.
derivation: 孙犁《芸斋琐谈（四）》天不作美，忽然飘起雪花来。”
derivationTraditional: 孫犁《芸齋瑣談（四）》天不作美，忽然飄起雪花來。”
derivationEn: From Sun Li's 'Trivial Talks on the Study (4)': 'Heaven did not make things beautiful, suddenly snowflakes began to fall.'
example: 不想～，将近黎明时分，又淅淅地下起小雨来。★魏巍《火凤凰》六九
exampleTraditional: 不想～，將近黎明時分，又淅淅地下起小雨來。★魏巍《火鳳凰》六九
exampleEn: Unexpectedly, heaven did not cooperate, and near dawn, a light rain began to fall. — Wei Wei, 'Fire Phoenix' Chapter 69

explanation: 朗明朗。形容天空晴朗，空气清新。
explanationTraditional: 朗明朗。形容天空晴朗，空氣清新。
explanationEn: Describes clear sky and fresh air.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《兰亭集序》是日也，天朗气清，惠风和畅，仰观宇宙之大，俯察品类之盛。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《蘭亭集序》是日也，天朗氣清，惠風和暢，仰觀宇宙之大，俯察品類之盛。”
derivationEn: From Wang Xizhi's 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection': 'On that day, the sky was clear and the air fresh, with a gentle breeze.'
example: 今日～，道清，你与我叫门公王安，打扫凉棚下干净，我操琴则个。★明·无名氏《女真观》楔子
exampleTraditional: 今日～，道清，你與我叫門公王安，打掃涼棚下乾淨，我操琴則個。★明·無名氏《女真觀》楔子
exampleEn: Today the sky is clear and the air fresh. Daoqing, tell the gatekeeper Wang An to sweep the cool pavilion clean so I can play the zither. — Ming Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Female Immortal' (wedge)

explanation: 比喻能言善辩。
explanationTraditional: 比喻能言善辯。
explanationEn: Metaphor for being eloquent and argumentative.
derivation: 《花城》1981年第5期你看他真是铁嘴钢牙。”
derivationTraditional: 《花城》1981年第5期你看他真是鐵嘴鋼牙。”
derivationEn: From 'Flower City' (1981, Issue 5): 'Look at him, truly iron mouth and steel teeth.'
example: 一开始这林德厚不服气儿，～，就是不承认。★单田芳《童林传》第二一九回
exampleTraditional: 一開始這林德厚不服氣兒，～，就是不承認。★單田芳《童林傳》第二一九回
exampleEn: At first, Lin Dehou was unconvinced, with iron mouth and steel teeth, refusing to admit. — Shan Tianfang, 'Tong Lin's Biography' (Chapter 219)

explanation: 横溢的才华与潇洒的风度。亦指才华横溢与风度潇洒的人物。
explanationTraditional: 橫溢的才華與瀟灑的風度。亦指才華橫溢與風度瀟灑的人物。
explanationEn: Refers to brilliant literary talent and elegant demeanor, or a person with such qualities.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《丹青引赠曹将军霸》诗英雄割据虽已矣，文采风流今尚存。”清·恽敬《同游海幢寺记》夫士大夫登朝之后，大都为世事牵挽，一二有性情者，方能以文采风流、友朋意气相尚。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《丹青引贈曹將軍霸》詩英雄割據雖已矣，文采風流今尚存。”清·惲敬《同遊海幢寺記》夫士大夫登朝之後，大都為世事牽挽，一二有性情者，方能以文采風流、友朋意氣相尚。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Song of the Painting to General Cao Ba': 'Though heroes have passed, their literary grace and elegance still remain.'
example: 金陵古称佳丽地，衣冠文物，盛于江南；～，甲于海内。★清·余怀《〈板桥杂记〉序》
exampleTraditional: 金陵古稱佳麗地，衣冠文物，盛於江南；～，甲於海內。★清·餘懷《〈板橋雜記〉序》
exampleEn: Jinling has long been known as a land of beauty, with rich culture and flourishing arts; its literary grace and elegance surpass all within the seas. — Qing Dynasty, Yu Huai, 'Preface to 'Stories of the Board Bridge'

explanation: 比喻凝恍惚、不明真相的境界。
explanationTraditional: 比喻凝恍惚、不明真相的境界。
explanationEn: Metaphor for being in a daze or unclear about the truth.
derivation: 南朝·宋·范晔《后汉书·张楷传》性好道术，能作五里雾。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·范曄《後漢書·張楷傳》性好道術，能作五里霧。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Zhang Kai': 'He was fond of Taoist arts and could create a five-mile fog.'
example: 对于政协各项协议不大明了的朋友，或许到现在都还在～吧。★郭沫若《关于非正式五人小组》
exampleTraditional: 對於政協各項協議不大明瞭的朋友，或許到現在都還在～吧。★郭沫若《關於非正式五人小組》
exampleEn: Friends who are not well-informed about the various agreements of the CPPCC might still be in a fog. — Guo Moruo, 'On the Informal Five-Person Group'

explanation: 说说笑笑，和柔温顺。
explanationTraditional: 說說笑笑，和柔溫順。
explanationEn: Describes talking and laughing gently and harmoniously.
derivation: 《诗·卫风·氓》总角之宴，言笑晏晏。”毛传晏晏，和柔也。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·衛風·氓》總角之宴，言笑晏晏。”毛傳晏晏，和柔也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Wei Feng: Meng': 'In the days of our youth, we talked and laughed gently.' Mao's commentary: 'Yanyan means gentle and harmonious.'
example: 复有公子女郎共十数辈，青衣黄头亦十数人，步月徐来，～。★唐·任蕃《梦游录·独孤遐叔》
exampleTraditional: 復有公子女郎共十數輩，青衣黃頭亦十數人，步月徐來，～。★唐·任蕃《夢遊錄·獨孤遐叔》
exampleEn: Again, there were a dozen or so young ladies and gentlemen, with as many maids and servants, strolling slowly in the moonlight, talking and laughing gently. — Tang Dynasty, Ren Fan, 'Dream Travels: Dugu Xiashu'

explanation: 指脸上的表情。同一颦一笑”。
explanationTraditional: 指臉上的表情。同一顰一笑”。
explanationEn: Refers to facial expressions; same as 'a smile or a frown'.
derivation: 茅盾《子夜》十大客厅上有几个人，都屏息侧立，在伺察吴荪甫的一笑一颦。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《子夜》十大客廳上有幾個人，都屏息側立，在伺察吳蓀甫的一笑一顰。”
derivationEn: From Mao Dun's 'Midnight': 'Several people in the living room stood aside, holding their breath, observing Wu Sunfu's every smile and frown.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容美妙的诗文、歌曲或可口的食物耐人回味。
explanationTraditional: 形容美妙的詩文、歌曲或可口的食物耐人回味。
explanationEn: Describes a wonderful poem, song, or delicious food that leaves a lasting impression.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 经治理。整顿军队，经营武备。
explanationTraditional: 經治理。整頓軍隊，經營武備。
explanationEn: To reorganize the army and manage military affairs.
derivation: 《左传·宣公十二年》见可而进，知难而退，军之善政也；兼弱攻昧，武之善经也。子姑整军而经武乎。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公十二年》見可而進，知難而退，軍之善政也；兼弱攻昧，武之善經也。子姑整軍而經武乎。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xuan's 12th Year': 'Advance when possible, retreat when difficult—this is good military strategy. Attack the weak and punish the ignorant—this is good martial governance. You should reorganize the army and manage military affairs.'
example: 一旦国家无内顾之忧，陛下可以～，对东虏大张挞伐，以雪今日之耻，永绝边境之患。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三章
exampleTraditional: 一旦國家無內顧之憂，陛下可以～，對東虜大張撻伐，以雪今日之恥，永絕邊境之患。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第三章
exampleEn: Once the country has no internal worries, Your Majesty can reorganize the army and manage military affairs, launch a punitive expedition against the Eastern Tartars to avenge today's shame and forever eliminate border troubles. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng' (Volume 1, Chapter 3)

explanation: 原指了解一个人并研究他所处的时代背景。现也指鉴别人物的好坏，议论世事的得失。
explanationTraditional: 原指了解一個人並研究他所處的時代背景。現也指鑑別人物的好壞，議論世事的得失。
explanationEn: Originally meant to understand a person and study the era they lived in; now also refers to judging people's merits and discussing world affairs.
derivation: 《孟子·万章下》颂其诗，读其书，不知其人可乎？是以论其世也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章下》頌其詩，讀其書，不知其人可乎？是以論其世也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Wan Zhang II': 'When reciting their poems and reading their books, can we not know the person? Therefore, we discuss their era.'
example: 不过倘要研究文学或某一作家，所谓～”，那么，足以应用的选本就很难得。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文二集·题未定”草》
exampleTraditional: 不過倘要研究文學或某一作家，所謂～”，那麼，足以應用的選本就很難得。★魯迅《且介亭雜文二集·題未定”草》
exampleEn: However, if one wants to study literature or a particular writer, the so-called 'knowing the person and discussing the era' requires a well-chosen anthology, which is hard to find. — Lu Xun, 'Essays from the Qiejieting: On 'Unsettled' (Part 2)'

explanation: 众人辗转述说。见众口交传”。
explanationTraditional: 眾人輾轉述說。見眾口交傳”。
explanationEn: Spread by many people through word of mouth; same as '众口交传'.
derivation: 黄仁宇《万历十五年》礼部的调查毫无结果，于是只能回奏当时众口相传，首先讹传者无法查明。”
derivationTraditional: 黃仁宇《萬曆十五年》禮部的調查毫無結果，於是只能回奏當時眾口相傳，首先訛傳者無法查明。”
derivationEn: From Huang Renyu's '1587, a Year of No Significance': 'The Ministry of Rites' investigation yielded no results, so they could only report that it was widely spread by many people, and the original source could not be identified.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指追溯事物发生的根源。同追本溯源”。
explanationTraditional: 指追溯事物發生的根源。同追本溯源”。
explanationEn: To trace something back to its root or origin.
derivation: 张周《步履艰难的中国》第四章追根求源，倒溯黑幕，岑长进现出了面目。”
derivationTraditional: 張周《步履艱難的中國》第四章追根求源，倒溯黑幕，岑長進現出了面目。”
derivationEn: Zhang Zhou, 'The Difficult Steps of China', Chapter 4: 'Tracing back to the source, uncovering the inside story, Cen Changjin revealed his true face.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 关起门来在家里读书。原意是独自学习，而不与别人切磋◇也用以形容专心埋头苦读。
explanationTraditional: 關起門來在家裡讀書。原意是獨自學習，而不與別人切磋◇也用以形容專心埋頭苦讀。
explanationEn: To study behind closed doors, originally meaning to learn alone without discussing with others; also used to describe concentrating on reading diligently.
derivation: 北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·勉学》盖须切磋相起明也。见闭门读书，师心自是。稠人广坐，谬误差失者多矣。”
derivationTraditional: 北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·勉學》蓋須切磋相起明也。見閉門讀書，師心自是。稠人廣坐，謬誤差失者多矣。”
derivationEn: Yan Zhitui, 'Family Instructions of the Yan Clan', Chapter 'Encouraging Learning': 'One must discuss and compare to clarify. Seeing someone studying behind closed doors, trusting his own heart, among a crowd, many mistakes and errors occur.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不畏惧艰难险阻。
explanationTraditional: 不畏懼艱難險阻。
explanationEn: Not to avoid difficulties and dangers.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀志·关羽传》随先主周旋，不避艰险。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀志·關羽傳》隨先主周旋，不避艱險。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms', 'Biography of Guan Yu': 'He followed the former lord through thick and thin, not avoiding hardships and dangers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 驰传扬。形容名声传播得很远。
explanationTraditional: 馳傳揚。形容名聲傳播得很遠。
explanationEn: To be famous far and wide; to have one's reputation spread across the world.
derivation: 北魏·郦道元《水经注·涑水》赀拟王公，驰名天下。”
derivationTraditional: 北魏·酈道元《水經注·涑水》貲擬王公，馳名天下。”
derivationEn: Li Daoyuan, 'Commentary on the Water Classic', 'Sushui': 'Wealth rivaling princes, famous throughout the world.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻做事要抓紧时机，加速进行。
explanationTraditional: 比喻做事要抓緊時機，加速進行。
explanationEn: To strike while the iron is hot; to seize the opportunity to act quickly.
derivation: 骆宾基《胶东的暴民》打铁趁热，放火趁风，你们不等这时万人一心的功夫，调动他们还等什么！”
derivationTraditional: 駱賓基《膠東的暴民》打鐵趁熱，放火趁風，你們不等這時萬人一心的功夫，調動他們還等什麼！”
derivationEn: Luo Binji, 'The Violent People of Jiaodong': 'Strike while the iron is hot, fan the fire while the wind blows. If you don't mobilize them when everyone is united, what are you waiting for?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指祖国。
explanationTraditional: 指祖國。
explanationEn: One's motherland; the country of one's ancestors.
derivation: 《论语·微子》枉道而事人，何必去父母之邦。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·微子》枉道而事人，何必去父母之邦。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects', 'Weizi': 'If one serves a ruler by bending the Way, why must one leave the land of one's parents?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻暂时经手大量钱财的人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻暫時經手大量錢財的人。
explanationEn: A person who temporarily handles large sums of money but does not own it.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 恒河南亚的大河。象恒河里的沙粒一样，无法计算。形容数量很多。
explanationTraditional: 恆河南亞的大河。象恆河裡的沙粒一樣，無法計算。形容數量很多。
explanationEn: As numerous as the sands of the Ganges; countless.
derivation: 《金刚经·无为福胜分第十一》以七宝满尔所恒河沙数三千大世界，以用布施。”
derivationTraditional: 《金剛經·無為福勝分第十一》以七寶滿爾所恆河沙數三千大世界，以用佈施。”
derivationEn: 'Diamond Sutra', 'Chapter 11: The Supremacy of Unattached Giving': 'If one filled as many worlds as the sands of the Ganges with the seven treasures and gave them as alms...'
example: 吾愿～仙人，并遣娇女，婚嫁人间，则贫穷海中，少苦众生矣。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·凤仙》
exampleTraditional: 吾願～仙人，並遣嬌女，婚嫁人間，則貧窮海中，少苦眾生矣。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·鳳仙》
exampleEn: I wish that countless immortals would send their daughters to marry among mortals, so that the sea of poverty would have fewer suffering beings. — Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio', 'Fengxian'

explanation: 艰深文辞深奥难懂；晦涩意义隐晦，不顺口。形容笔调深僻、寓意难以理解的文章。
explanationTraditional: 艱深文辭深奧難懂；晦澀意義隱晦，不順口。形容筆調深僻、寓意難以理解的文章。
explanationEn: Difficult and obscure; describing writing that is deep and hard to understand.
derivation: 宋·黄伯思《东观余论·校定楚辞序》故分章办事，以其所对，别附于问，庶几览者莹然，知子厚之文不苟为艰深也。”宋·陈振孙《直斋书录解题·别集上》为文而晦涩若此，其湮弗没传也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃伯思《東觀餘論·校定楚辭序》故分章辦事，以其所對，別附於問，庶幾覽者瑩然，知子厚之文不苟為艱深也。”宋·陳振孫《直齋書錄解題·別集上》為文而晦澀若此，其湮弗沒傳也。”
derivationEn: Huang Bosi, 'Dongguan Observations', 'Preface to the Collated Chu Ci': 'Therefore, dividing chapters and handling affairs, attaching answers to questions, so that readers can see clearly and know that Zihou's writing is not deliberately difficult.' Chen Zhensun, 'Direct Solutions to Library Catalogues', 'Supplementary Collection': 'Writing that is obscure like this will be buried and not transmitted.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 看到货财，要想到道义。
explanationTraditional: 看到貨財，要想到道義。
explanationEn: To think of righteousness when seeing profit; to consider moral principles when faced with gain.
derivation: 《论语·宪问》见利思义，见危授命，久要不忘平生之言，亦可以为成人矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·憲問》見利思義，見危授命，久要不忘平生之言，亦可以為成人矣。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects', 'Xianwen': 'When seeing profit, think of righteousness; when facing danger, be ready to give one's life; if one remembers these for a long time without forgetting, one can be considered a complete person.'
example: 财利迷心，人情世态，～，于君无愧。★明·胡文焕《群音类选·还带记》
exampleTraditional: 財利迷心，人情世態，～，於君無愧。★明·胡文煥《群音類選·還帶記》
exampleEn: Profit blinds the heart, human feelings and worldly affairs; thinking of righteousness when seeing profit, you have no shame. — Hu Wenhuan, 'Group Tunes Selected', 'Returning the Belt'

explanation: 在一起只是吃喝玩乐而不干正经事的朋友。
explanationTraditional: 在一起只是吃喝玩樂而不幹正經事的朋友。
explanationEn: Friends who only enjoy eating, drinking, and having fun together without engaging in serious matters.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《单刀会》关云长是我酒肉朋友，我交他两只手送与你那荆州来。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《單刀會》關雲長是我酒肉朋友，我交他兩隻手送與你那荊州來。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Single Sword Meeting': 'Guan Yunchang is my wine-and-meat friend; I will make him hand over Jingzhou to you with both hands.'
example: 今虽势力滂沛，大抵是～耳。★章炳麟《致伯中书一》
exampleTraditional: 今雖勢力滂沛，大抵是～耳。★章炳麟《致伯中書一》
exampleEn: Although his power is vast now, most are just fair-weather friends. — Zhang Binglin's 'Letter to Bo Zhongshu'

explanation: 形容对人态度傲慢。
explanationTraditional: 形容對人態度傲慢。
explanationEn: Describes an arrogant attitude towards others.
derivation: 先秦·孟轲《孟子·告子下》诣诣之声音颜色，距人于千里之外。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·孟軻《孟子·告子下》詣詣之聲音顏色，距人於千里之外。”
derivationEn: From pre-Qin Mencius' 'Mencius·Gaozi II': 'The tone and expression of arrogance keep people at a distance of a thousand li.'
example: 他摆出一幅～的傲慢神态。
exampleTraditional: 他擺出一幅～的傲慢神態。
exampleEn: He put on an arrogant expression that kept people at a distance.

explanation: 形容心肠象狼和狗一样凶恶狠毒。
explanationTraditional: 形容心腸象狼和狗一樣兇惡狠毒。
explanationEn: Describes a heart as cruel and vicious as a wolf's or a dog's.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三十那知这贼子恁般狼心狗肺，负恩忘义。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三十那知這賊子恁般狼心狗肺，負恩忘義。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 30: 'Who would have thought that villain was so wolf-hearted and dog-lunged, ungrateful and forgetful of kindness.'
example: 你这个～的烂货，你想把我气死了，你们去过快活日子。★清·李宝嘉《中国现在记》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 你這個～的爛貨，你想把我氣死了，你們去過快活日子。★清·李寶嘉《中國現在記》第十二回
exampleEn: You wolf-hearted, dog-lunged scum! You want to anger me to death so you can live a happy life. — Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'China Today' Chapter 12

explanation: 泛指别离、团聚、悲哀、喜悦的种种遭遇和心态。
explanationTraditional: 泛指別離、團聚、悲哀、喜悅的種種遭遇和心態。
explanationEn: Refers to various experiences and emotions of separation, reunion, sorrow, and joy.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《水调歌头·丙辰中秋兼怀子由》人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《水調歌頭·丙辰中秋兼懷子由》人有悲歡離合，月有陰晴圓缺，此事古難全。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Water Melody·Mid-Autumn Festival': 'People have sorrow and joy, parting and reunion; the moon waxes and wanes, clear and dim. This has been imperfect since ancient times.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 死灰冷却的灰烬。形容因心情沮丧或受惊吓而脸色灰白。
explanationTraditional: 死灰冷卻的灰燼。形容因心情沮喪或受驚嚇而臉色灰白。
explanationEn: Dead ashes: cold ashes. Describes a face ashen due to extreme disappointment or fear.
derivation: 《淮南子·修务训》昼吟宵哭，面若死灰，颜色霉墨，涕液交集。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·修務訓》晝吟宵哭，面若死灰，顏色黴墨，涕液交集。”
derivationEn: From 'Huainanzi·Cultivation': 'Moaning by day and crying by night, face like dead ashes, complexion dark, tears and mucus mingling.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻不重要。
explanationTraditional: 比喻不重要。
explanationEn: Metaphor for something unimportant.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容不多几下拳打脚踢。
explanationTraditional: 形容不多幾下拳打腳踢。
explanationEn: Describes just a few punches and kicks.
derivation: 《金瓶梅词话》第一回三拳两脚，和大虫敌斗，把大虫登时打死了。”
derivationTraditional: 《金瓶梅詞話》第一回三拳兩腳，和大蟲敵鬥，把大蟲登時打死了。”
derivationEn: From 'The Plum in the Golden Vase' Chapter 1: 'With three punches and two kicks, he fought with the tiger and killed it on the spot.'
example: 也就经不起～，一样跌倒地下，想《拳经》不起来了。★《何典》第二回
exampleTraditional: 也就經不起～，一樣跌倒地下，想《拳經》不起來了。★《何典》第二回
exampleEn: He couldn't withstand a few punches and kicks, fell to the ground, and couldn't get up. — 'What Ghosts?' Chapter 2

explanation: 少年轻；更经历。年纪轻，没有经历过什么事情。指经验不多。
explanationTraditional: 少年輕；更經歷。年紀輕，沒有經歷過什麼事情。指經驗不多。
explanationEn: Young and inexperienced; having not experienced many things.
derivation: 《隋书·李雄传》吾儿既少，更事未多。”
derivationTraditional: 《隋書·李雄傳》吾兒既少，更事未多。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Sui·Biography of Li Xiong': 'My son is young and has not experienced much.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用绳当锯子，也能把木头锯断。比喻力量虽小，只要坚持下去，事情就能成功。
explanationTraditional: 用繩當鋸子，也能把木頭鋸斷。比喻力量雖小，只要堅持下去，事情就能成功。
explanationEn: Using a rope as a saw can cut through wood. Metaphor: persistence can achieve success despite limited strength.
derivation: 宋·罗大经《鹤林玉露》卷十一日一钱，千日千钱，绳锯木断，水滴石穿。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·羅大經《鶴林玉露》卷十一日一錢，千日千錢，繩鋸木斷，水滴石穿。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Luo Dajing's 'Crane Forest Jade Dew' Volume 11: 'One coin a day, a thousand coins in a thousand days; a rope saws through wood, water drips through stone.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 征远行。上万里路的远行。形容极摇远的征程。
explanationTraditional: 徵遠行。上萬里路的遠行。形容極搖遠的征程。
explanationEn: A journey of ten thousand li. Describes an extremely long expedition.
derivation: 唐·王昌龄《出塞》诗秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王昌齡《出塞》詩秦時明月漢時關，萬里長征人未還。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Changling's 'Going to the Frontier': 'The moon of Qin and the pass of Han, the men of ten thousand li have not returned.'
example: 夺取全国胜利，这只是～走完了第一步。★毛泽东《在中国共产党第七届中央委员会第二次全体会议上的报告》
exampleTraditional: 奪取全國勝利，這只是～走完了第一步。★毛澤東《在中國共產黨第七屆中央委員會第二次全體會議上的報告》
exampleEn: Winning nationwide victory is only the first step in a long march of ten thousand li. — Mao Zedong's 'Report to the Second Plenary Session of the Seventh Central Committee of the Communist Party of China'

explanation: 隙空子、机会；乘利用。没有空子可钻。
explanationTraditional: 隙空子、機會；乘利用。沒有空子可鑽。
explanationEn: No loophole to exploit; no opportunity to take advantage of.
derivation: 《宋书·律历志下》臣其历七曜，咸始上元，无隙可乘。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·律曆志下》臣其歷七曜，鹹始上元，無隙可乘。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Song: Treatise on Calendar' by Shen Yue: 'I calculated the seven luminaries, all starting from the first epoch, with no loophole to exploit.'
example: 每羡暹罗繁富之国，要来吞并，只是～。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 每羨暹羅繁富之國，要來吞併，只是～。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十五回
exampleEn: Every time they envied Siam's prosperous country and wanted to annex it, but there was no opportunity to exploit. — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 35

explanation: 形容日出日落时霞光散射的美丽景象。也形容某种珍宝放出耀眼的光辉。
explanationTraditional: 形容日出日落時霞光散射的美麗景象。也形容某種珍寶放出耀眼的光輝。
explanationEn: Describes the beautiful scene of colorful rays scattering at sunrise or sunset; also describes a treasure emitting dazzling light.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十一回但见个东西映着日光，霞光万道，瑞气千条，从门里就冲着他怀里飞来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十一回但見個東西映著日光，霞光萬道，瑞氣千條，從門裡就衝著他懷裡飛來。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 31: 'But seeing something reflecting sunlight, with myriad rays of rosy clouds and thousand auspicious airs, flying towards him from the door.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 血与泪俱在实证物。
explanationTraditional: 血與淚俱在實證物。
explanationEn: Full of blood and tears; evidence of suffering.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这一幅幅～的照片，正控诉着侵略者的杀人暴行。
exampleTraditional: 這一幅幅～的照片，正控訴著侵略者的殺人暴行。
exampleEn: These photos, stained with blood and tears, are denouncing the murderous atrocities of the invaders.

explanation: 用防御作为击破敌人的手段。
explanationTraditional: 用防禦作為擊破敵人的手段。
explanationEn: Use defense as a means to attack the enemy.
derivation: 宋·秦观《边防策下》盖充国以先零穷寇，急与之角，则中国必有馈挽转输之劳，故罢骑留屯而图以期月，此则以守为攻者也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·秦觀《邊防策下》蓋充國以先零窮寇，急與之角，則中國必有饋挽轉輸之勞，故罷騎留屯而圖以期月，此則以守為攻者也。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Qin Guan's 'On Border Defense, Part 3': 'Because Chongguo faced desperate bandits, engaging them directly would burden the central state with transport costs, so he halted cavalry and stationed troops to plan over months—this is using defense as offense.'
example: 我军决定暂时～，消耗敌人兵力，然后再集中力量突过河去，全歼敌人。★李天银《扼住敌人的咽喉》
exampleTraditional: 我軍決定暫時～，消耗敵人兵力，然後再集中力量突過河去，全殲敵人。★李天銀《扼住敵人的咽喉》
exampleEn: Our army decided to temporarily use defense as offense, deplete the enemy's strength, then concentrate forces to cross the river and annihilate the enemy. — Li Tianyin, 'Gripping the Enemy's Throat'

explanation: 复又，再。也是这样。
explanationTraditional: 復又，再。也是這樣。
explanationEn: Also the same; likewise.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·尤悔》刘琨善能招延，而拙于抚御，一日虽有数千人归投，其逃散而去，亦复如此。所以卒无所建。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·尤悔》劉琨善能招延，而拙於撫御，一日雖有數千人歸投，其逃散而去，亦復如此。所以卒無所建。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Regret': 'Liu Kun was good at recruiting but poor at managing; though thousands joined daily, those who fled and scattered were also like this. So he ultimately achieved nothing.'
example: 这先生方伸手按在右手脉上，调息了至数，凝神细诊了半刻功夫。换过左手，～。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十回
exampleTraditional: 這先生方伸手按在右手脈上，調息了至數，凝神細診了半刻功夫。換過左手，～。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十回
exampleEn: This gentleman then extended his hand to press on the right wrist, regulated his breath, and diagnosed carefully for half a moment. Then he changed to the left hand, and it was also the same. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 10

explanation: 耐心恳切地教诲、诱导。
explanationTraditional: 耐心懇切地教誨、誘導。
explanationEn: To teach and guide patiently and earnestly.
derivation: 宋·刘挚《乞重修太学条制疏》昔之设学校，教养之法，师生问对，愤悱开发，相与曲折反复，谆谆善诱。 ”
derivationTraditional: 宋·劉摯《乞重修太學條制疏》昔之設學校，教養之法，師生問對，憤悱開發，相與曲折反覆，諄諄善誘。 ”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Liu Zhi's 'Petition to Revise Imperial Academy Regulations': 'In the past, when establishing schools, the method of education involved teachers and students questioning and answering, with frustration and inspiration, repeatedly and earnestly guiding.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 俱全，都。许多已经荒废了的事情一下子都兴办起来。
explanationTraditional: 俱全，都。許多已經荒廢了的事情一下子都興辦起來。
explanationEn: All neglected tasks are being undertaken; many things that have been abandoned are now being revived.
derivation: 宋·范仲淹《岳阳楼记》政通人和，百废具（俱）兴。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·范仲淹《岳陽樓記》政通人和，百廢具（俱）興。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Fan Zhongyan's 'Record of Yueyang Tower': 'Government is efficient and people are harmonious; all neglected tasks are being revived.'
example: 四川屡经兵燹，廷相莅任，～，民不知扰。★《清史稿·郎廷佐传》
exampleTraditional: 四川屢經兵燹，廷相蒞任，～，民不知擾。★《清史稿·郎廷佐傳》
exampleEn: Sichuan had suffered many wars; when Tingxiang took office, all neglected tasks were revived, and the people were not disturbed. — 'Draft History of Qing: Biography of Lang Tingzuo'

explanation: 文言和白话夹杂。亦作半文不白”。
explanationTraditional: 文言和白話夾雜。亦作半文不白”。
explanationEn: A mixture of classical Chinese and vernacular; also written as '半文不白'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这篇文章……唯一的缺点，是～，似通非通”★琼瑶《匆匆太匆匆》
exampleTraditional: 這篇文章……唯一的缺點，是～，似通非通”★瓊瑤《匆匆太匆匆》
exampleEn: The only flaw of this article is that it is half classical and half vernacular, seemingly fluent but not. — Qiong Yao, 'Too Hasty'

explanation: 天地境界。比喻另有一番境界。形容风景或艺术创作的境界引人入胜。
explanationTraditional: 天地境界。比喻另有一番境界。形容風景或藝術創作的境界引人入勝。
explanationEn: A different world; another realm. Describes scenery or artistic creation that is fascinating and unique.
derivation: 唐·李白诗《山中问答》桃花流水窅然去，别有天地非人间。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白詩《山中問答》桃花流水窅然去，別有天地非人間。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Li Bai's poem 'Mountain Dialogue': 'Peach blossoms flow away with the stream, a different world not of the mortal realm.'
example: 出了山洞口，只见小桥流水，竹篱茅舍，真是～。
exampleTraditional: 出了山洞口，只見小橋流水，竹籬茅舍，真是～。
exampleEn: Out of the cave, they saw a small bridge over flowing water, bamboo fences and thatched cottages—truly a different world.

explanation: 恻隐对别人的不幸表示同情。形容对人寄予同情。
explanationTraditional: 惻隱對別人的不幸表示同情。形容對人寄予同情。
explanationEn: Compassion; sympathy for others' misfortune.
derivation: 《孟子·告子上》恻隐之心，人皆有之。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·告子上》惻隱之心，人皆有之。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gaozi I': 'The feeling of compassion is inherent in all people.'
example: 此人为官清正，作事廉明，每怀～，常有仁慈之念。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第十三回
exampleTraditional: 此人為官清正，作事廉明，每懷～，常有仁慈之念。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第十三回
exampleEn: This man is upright in office, honest in conduct, always harboring a compassionate heart and often having benevolent thoughts. — Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 13

explanation: 泛指桅人畜的各种猛兽。也比喻凶残的恶人。
explanationTraditional: 泛指桅人畜的各種猛獸。也比喻兇殘的惡人。
explanationEn: Refers to various ferocious beasts that harm humans and livestock, also used metaphorically for cruel and vicious people.
derivation: 清·刘鹗《老残游记》第八回实在可怕的是豺狼虎豹。天晚了，倘若出来个把，我们就坏了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第八回實在可怕的是豺狼虎豹。天晚了，倘若出來個把，我們就壞了。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 8 of 'The Travels of Lao Can' by Liu E in the Qing Dynasty: 'What is truly terrifying are jackals, wolves, tigers, and leopards. If it gets dark and one of them appears, we will be in trouble.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指很值得看，很值得重视。
explanationTraditional: 指很值得看，很值得重視。
explanationEn: Indicates something is well worth seeing or paying attention to.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这个捐款也就～了。（清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第七回）
exampleTraditional: 這個捐款也就～了。（清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第七回）
exampleEn: This donation is quite considerable. (From Chapter 7 of 'A Brief History of Civilization' by Li Baojia in the Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 指责别人说话或文章极不通顺。
explanationTraditional: 指責別人說話或文章極不通順。
explanationEn: Criticizes someone's speech or writing as extremely incoherent or nonsensical.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第35回柳老赖婚狼心推测，冯生联句狗屁不通。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第35回柳老賴婚狼心推測，馮生聯句狗屁不通。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 35 of 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants' by Shi Yukun in the Qing Dynasty: 'Old Liu refuses the marriage with a wolfish heart, Feng's couplets are dog farts not making sense.'
example: 你的文章尽管～，有人争先恐后的请你做广告。★邹韬奋《无所不专的专家》
exampleTraditional: 你的文章儘管～，有人爭先恐後的請你做廣告。★鄒韜奮《無所不專的專家》
exampleEn: Even though your article is utter nonsense, some people rush to ask you to write advertisements. (Zou Taofen, 'The Expert Who Specializes in Everything')

explanation: 足值得；挂齿提及，谈及。哪里值得挂在嘴上。不值一提的意思。
explanationTraditional: 足值得；掛齒提及，談及。哪裡值得掛在嘴上。不值一提的意思。
explanationEn: Means something is not worth mentioning; a polite expression indicating something is trivial.
derivation: 《汉书·叔孙通传》此特群盗鼠窃狗盗，何足置齿牙间哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·叔孫通傳》此特群盜鼠竊狗盜，何足置齒牙間哉？”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Han: Biography of Shusun Tong': 'These are just thieves and robbers, why should they be worth mentioning?'
example: 不过先人留下来的几本破书，卖又不值钱，随便带在行箧解解闷儿，当小说书看罢了，～。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第三回
exampleTraditional: 不過先人留下來的幾本破書，賣又不值錢，隨便帶在行篋解解悶兒，當小說書看罷了，～。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第三回
exampleEn: They are just a few old books left by my ancestors, not worth selling, so I brought them along to pass the time, reading them like novels. They are not worth mentioning. (From Chapter 3 of 'The Travels of Lao Can' by Liu E in the Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 掎拉住，指拉住腿；角指抓住角；掎角夹击敌人。原指从两方面夹攻敌人。现比喻分出兵力，造成牵制敌人或互相支援的形势。
explanationTraditional: 掎拉住，指拉住腿；角指抓住角；掎角夾擊敵人。原指從兩方面夾攻敵人。現比喻分出兵力，造成牽制敵人或互相支援的形勢。
explanationEn: Originally refers to attacking the enemy from two sides; now metaphorically means dividing forces to create a situation of mutual support or containment.
derivation: 《左传·襄公十四年》譬如捕鹿，晋人角之，诸戎掎之，与晋掊之。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公十四年》譬如捕鹿，晉人角之，諸戎掎之，與晉掊之。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The 14th Year of Duke Xiang': 'It is like catching a deer: the Jin people hold its horns, the various Rong hold its legs, and together with Jin they pull it down.'
example: 不若分兵屯小沛，守邳城，为掎角之势，以防曹操。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 不若分兵屯小沛，守邳城，為掎角之勢，以防曹操。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第二十二回
exampleEn: It would be better to divide our troops to garrison Xiaopei and defend Pizhou, forming a pincer formation to guard against Cao Cao. (From Chapter 22 of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' by Luo Guanzhong in the Ming Dynasty)

explanation: 指言语中暗藏讽刺。
explanationTraditional: 指言語中暗藏諷刺。
explanationEn: Refers to speech that contains hidden sarcasm or veiled attacks.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三十一回姑娘倒寻上我的晦气。又不像是恼我，又不像是恼二爷，夹枪带棒，终久是个什么主意？”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三十一回姑娘倒尋上我的晦氣。又不像是惱我，又不像是惱二爺，夾槍帶棒，終久是個什麼主意？”
derivationEn: From Chapter 31 of 'Dream of the Red Chamber' by Cao Xueqin in the Qing Dynasty: 'Miss, you are picking on me. It doesn't seem like you are angry with me or with Master Bao. With all these veiled barbs, what is your intention?'
example: 敏之究竟持重一点，她怕太说得明白了，二姨太～一阵乱嚷嚷，就更是不好收拾。因之找了别的几件事来谈着，把这话扯了开去。★张恨水《金粉世家》第一百三回
exampleTraditional: 敏之究竟持重一點，她怕太說得明白了，二姨太～一陣亂嚷嚷，就更是不好收拾。因之找了別的幾件事來談著，把這話扯了開去。★張恨水《金粉世家》第一百三回
exampleEn: Minzhi was more cautious; she was afraid that if she spoke too clearly, the second concubine would start a noisy argument with veiled attacks, making things even harder to handle. So she brought up other topics to divert the conversation. (From Chapter 103 of 'The Golden Family' by Zhang Henshui)

explanation: 指前进之道反若后退。
explanationTraditional: 指前進之道反若後退。
explanationEn: Indicates that the path of progress may seem like retreat.
derivation: 《老子》明道若昧，进道若退。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》明道若昧，進道若退。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi': 'The bright path seems dim; the advancing path seems to retreat.'
example: 虽老氏曲全，～，然行亦以需。★《后汉书·张衡传》
exampleTraditional: 雖老氏曲全，～，然行亦以需。★《後漢書·張衡傳》
exampleEn: Although Laozi advocates yielding and the advancing path seems to retreat, action still requires patience. (From 'The Book of Later Han: Biography of Zhang Heng')

explanation: 惊慌之极而面目变色。
explanationTraditional: 驚慌之極而面目變色。
explanationEn: Describes being so frightened that one's face changes color.
derivation: 清·石玉昆《三侠五义》第七十三回倪太守正与倪忠毫无主意，看见开门，以为恶奴前来陷害，不由的惊慌失色。”
derivationTraditional: 清·石玉昆《三俠五義》第七十三回倪太守正與倪忠毫無主意，看見開門，以為惡奴前來陷害，不由的驚慌失色。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 73 of 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants' by Shi Yukun in the Qing Dynasty: 'Magistrate Ni and Ni Zhong were at a loss, and when they saw the door open, thinking that evil servants had come to harm them, they turned pale with fright.'
example: 次日，燕紫琼、宰玉蟾闻得丈夫又困在阵内，吓的～，坐立不宁。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 次日，燕紫瓊、宰玉蟾聞得丈夫又困在陣內，嚇的～，坐立不寧。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十九回
exampleEn: The next day, Yan Ziqiong and Zai Yuchan heard that their husbands were trapped in the formation again, and they were so frightened that their faces changed color and they could not sit still. (From Chapter 99 of 'Flowers in the Mirror' by Li Ruzhen in the Qing Dynasty)

explanation: 旷世当代没有能相比的。指当代少见的奇才。
explanationTraditional: 曠世當代沒有能相比的。指當代少見的奇才。
explanationEn: Refers to a rare genius unparalleled in the contemporary era.
derivation: 明·屠隆《彩毫记·祖饯都门》李公旷世奇才，正宜匡扶社稷。”
derivationTraditional: 明·屠隆《彩毫記·祖餞都門》李公曠世奇才，正宜匡扶社稷。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of the Colorful Brush: Farewell at the Capital Gate' by Tu Long in the Ming Dynasty: 'Li Bai is a rare genius of the age, just the person to support the state.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 抛弃旧的，谋求新的。多指由坏的转向好的，离开错误的道路走向正确的道路。
explanationTraditional: 拋棄舊的，謀求新的。多指由壞的轉向好的，離開錯誤的道路走向正確的道路。
explanationEn: Means to abandon the old and seek the new; often refers to turning from bad to good, leaving the wrong path for the right one.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国共产党在民族战争中的地位》出岔子不可救药者外，不是采取排斥态度，而是采取规劝态度，使之翻然改进，弃旧图新。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國共產黨在民族戰爭中的地位》出岔子不可救藥者外，不是採取排斥態度，而是採取規勸態度，使之翻然改進，棄舊圖新。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'The Role of the Chinese Communist Party in the National War': 'Except for those who are hopelessly wrong, we should not adopt an attitude of rejection but one of persuasion, enabling them to change for the better and abandon the old for the new.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 受甲的气向乙发泄或自己不如意时拿别人出气。
explanationTraditional: 受甲的氣向乙發洩或自己不如意時拿別人出氣。
explanationEn: To vent one's anger on someone who is not responsible, or to take out one's frustration on others.
derivation: 《论语·雍也》有颜回者好学，不迁怒，不贰过。”朱熹注怒于甲者，不移于乙。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·雍也》有顏回者好學，不遷怒，不貳過。”朱熹注怒於甲者，不移於乙。”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius, Yong Ye: 'Yan Hui was fond of learning; he did not transfer his anger, nor did he repeat a mistake.' Zhu Xi's commentary: 'Anger at A is not transferred to B.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 意指曲子要天天唱，才会熟练精妙。比喻熟能生巧。
explanationTraditional: 意指曲子要天天唱，才會熟練精妙。比喻熟能生巧。
explanationEn: Practice makes perfect; one must sing tunes daily to master them.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 居停留。指时光流逝。
explanationTraditional: 居停留。指時光流逝。
explanationEn: Time does not stand still; time flies.
derivation: 汉·孔融《论盛孝章书》岁月不居，时节如流，五十之年，忽焉已至。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·孔融《論盛孝章書》歲月不居，時節如流，五十之年，忽焉已至。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty, Kong Rong's 'On Sheng Xiaozhang': 'Time does not stay, seasons flow like water; fifty years have suddenly arrived.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 无起始，无终了。表示无丝毫时间限制的状态。
explanationTraditional: 無起始，無終了。表示無絲毫時間限制的狀態。
explanationEn: Without beginning or end; describing a state with no temporal limits.
derivation: 《淮南子·说林训》无古无今，无始无终，未有天地而生天地，至深微广大矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·說林訓》無古無今，無始無終，未有天地而生天地，至深微廣大矣。”
derivationEn: From Huainanzi, 'Shuolin Xun': 'No ancient, no present; no beginning, no end; before heaven and earth existed, it gave birth to heaven and earth—extremely profound and vast.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 稀世世所稀有。世上稀有的珍宝。
explanationTraditional: 稀世世所稀有。世上稀有的珍寶。
explanationEn: A rare treasure; something extremely rare in the world.
derivation: 宋·黄休复《益州名画录》当时卿相及好事者，得居寀父子图障卷簇，家藏户宝，为稀世之珍。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃休復《益州名畫錄》當時卿相及好事者，得居寀父子圖障卷簇，家藏戶寶，為稀世之珍。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Huang Xiufu's 'Records of Famous Paintings in Yizhou': 'At that time, ministers and connoisseurs obtained scrolls by Huang Jucai and his son, treasuring them as rare treasures.'
example: 难道你不希望我们中国人的艺术品在外国人眼里被看作～吗？★何力力《落日夏威夷》
exampleTraditional: 難道你不希望我們中國人的藝術品在外國人眼裡被看作～嗎？★何力力《落日夏威夷》
exampleEn: Don't you hope that our Chinese artworks are regarded as rare treasures in the eyes of foreigners? ★ He Lili, 'Sunset Hawaii'

explanation: 华丽的车子，珍贵的宝马。指考究的车骑。
explanationTraditional: 華麗的車子，珍貴的寶馬。指考究的車騎。
explanationEn: Luxurious carriages and precious horses; refers to elegant vehicles.
derivation: 唐·韦应物《长安道》诗宝马横来下建章，香车却转避驰道。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韋應物《長安道》詩寶馬橫來下建章，香車卻轉避馳道。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Wei Yingwu's poem 'Chang'an Road': 'Precious horses gallop from Jianzhang, fragrant carriages turn to avoid the imperial way.'
example: 你看那～，来往交杂，正好赏心乐事也呵。★元·武汉臣《玉壶春》第一折
exampleTraditional: 你看那～，來往交雜，正好賞心樂事也呵。★元·武漢臣《玉壺春》第一折
exampleEn: Look at the luxurious carriages and precious horses coming and going; it's truly a joyful sight. ★ Yuan Dynasty, Wuhan Chen, 'Jade Pot' Act 1

explanation: 要简要。概括地说，简单地说。
explanationTraditional: 要簡要。概括地說，簡單地說。
explanationEn: In brief; to put it concisely.
derivation: 晋·陆机《五等论》且要而言之，五等之君为己思治，郡县之长为利图物。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陸機《五等論》且要而言之，五等之君為己思治，郡縣之長為利圖物。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Lu Ji's 'On the Five Ranks': 'And to put it briefly, the lords of the five ranks govern for their own sake, while county magistrates seek profit for others.'
example: ～，《全上古文》实在是大而无当的书，可供陈列而不适于实用的。（鲁迅《书信集·致章廷谦》）
exampleTraditional: ～，《全上古文》實在是大而無當的書，可供陳列而不適於實用的。（魯迅《書信集·致章廷謙》）
exampleEn: In brief, 'Complete Prose of the Ancient Era' is a book too large to be useful, suitable for display but not for practical use. (Lu Xun, 'Letters to Zhang Tingqian')

explanation: 形容意见不一，议论很多。
explanationTraditional: 形容意見不一，議論很多。
explanationEn: Diverse opinions and much discussion; widespread debate.
derivation: 语出《后汉书·袁绍传》是以远近狐疑，议论纷错者也。”
derivationTraditional: 語出《後漢書·袁紹傳》是以遠近狐疑，議論紛錯者也。”
derivationEn: From Book of the Later Han, 'Biography of Yuan Shao': 'Thus, far and near, there was suspicion and conflicting opinions.'
example: 东汉之末，礼乐萧条，虽东观石渠～，无济于事。★《通志乐府总序》
exampleTraditional: 東漢之末，禮樂蕭條，雖東觀石渠～，無濟於事。★《通志樂府總序》
exampleEn: At the end of the Eastern Han, rites and music declined; although the Eastern Pavilion and Stone Canal saw much debate, it was of no avail. ★ 'General Preface to Music Bureau Poems'

explanation: 在景色的描写中寄托情感。
explanationTraditional: 在景色的描寫中寄託情感。
explanationEn: To express emotions through the description of scenery.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 像梳子的齿和鱼的鳞，密密地排列着。亦作栉比鳞差”。亦作栉比鳞臻”。
explanationTraditional: 像梳子的齒和魚的鱗，密密地排列著。亦作櫛比鱗差”。亦作櫛比鱗臻”。
explanationEn: Arranged closely together like the teeth of a comb or the scales of a fish; densely packed.
derivation: 《元史·河渠志三》岸善崩者，密筑江石以护之，上植杨柳，旁种蔓荆，栉比鳞次，赖以为固。”
derivationTraditional: 《元史·河渠志三》岸善崩者，密築江石以護之，上植楊柳，旁種蔓荊，櫛比鱗次，賴以為固。”
derivationEn: From History of Yuan, 'Treatise on Rivers and Canals 3': 'Where the banks easily collapse, build dense stone revetments, plant willows above, and thorny shrubs beside, arranged closely like comb teeth and fish scales, relying on them for stability.'
example: 万绿丛中的土屋，～的排列着。★冰心《最后的安息》
exampleTraditional: 萬綠叢中的土屋，～的排列著。★冰心《最後的安息》
exampleEn: The earthen houses amidst the lush greenery are arranged closely like comb teeth and fish scales. ★ Bing Xin, 'The Last Rest'

explanation: 原意是力量相当的两军对阵，悲愤的一方获得胜利◇指因受欺侮而奋起抵抗的军队，必定能取胜。
explanationTraditional: 原意是力量相當的兩軍對陣，悲憤的一方獲得勝利◇指因受欺侮而奮起抵抗的軍隊，必定能取勝。
explanationEn: An army burning with righteous indignation is bound to win.
derivation: 《老子》第六十九章祸莫大于轻敌，轻敌几丧吾宝，故抗兵相加，哀者胜矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第六十九章禍莫大於輕敵，輕敵幾喪吾寶，故抗兵相加，哀者勝矣。”
derivationEn: From Laozi, Chapter 69: 'There is no calamity greater than underestimating the enemy; underestimating the enemy almost destroys my treasure. Therefore, when armies are equally matched, the one with righteous indignation will win.'
example: 不，～！不要乐，要哀，何小姐能弹《易水吟》的谱子吗？★张恨水《啼笑因缘续集》第十回
exampleTraditional: 不，～！不要樂，要哀，何小姐能彈《易水吟》的譜子嗎？★張恨水《啼笑因緣續集》第十回
exampleEn: No, 'an army burning with righteous indignation is bound to win'! Don't be joyful, be sorrowful. Miss He, can you play the tune of 'Yi Shui Yin'? (Zhang Henshui, 'Fate in Tears and Laughter, Sequel', Chapter 10)

explanation: 指独创一格，与众不同。
explanationTraditional: 指獨創一格，與眾不同。
explanationEn: To create a new style or idea that is original and different from others.
derivation: 宋·司马光《与王介甫书》大抵所利不能补其所伤，所得不能偿其所亡，徒欲别出新意，以自为功名耳。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·司馬光《與王介甫書》大抵所利不能補其所傷，所得不能償其所亡，徒欲別出新意，以自為功名耳。”
derivationEn: From Sima Guang's 'Letter to Wang Anshi': 'Generally, the benefits cannot compensate for the losses, and the gains cannot make up for the sacrifices. They merely want to create new ideas to gain fame for themselves.'
example: 泰西诸国，研精器数，创造火轮舟车……又于古圣新制车舟外，～，以夺造化之工。★清·薛福成《代李伯相议请试办铁路疏》
exampleTraditional: 泰西諸國，研精器數，創造火輪舟車……又於古聖新制車舟外，～，以奪造化之工。★清·薛福成《代李伯相議請試辦鐵路疏》
exampleEn: The Western countries study machinery and numbers, invent steamships and trains... and beyond the ancient sage's new inventions of boats and carts, they create new ideas to surpass nature's work. (Xue Fucheng, 'Memorial on Behalf of Li Hongzhang on Trial Railway')

explanation: 存保留。指把问题保留下来，暂不讨论。
explanationTraditional: 存保留。指把問題保留下來，暫不討論。
explanationEn: To leave a question aside without discussion.
derivation: 《庄子·齐物论》六合之外，圣人存而不论。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·齊物論》六合之外，聖人存而不論。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi, 'Discussion on Making All Things Equal': 'The sage leaves matters beyond the six directions aside without discussion.'
example: 其源虽出于《洪范》，然既为术数之学，则治经者～可矣。★清·陈澧《东塾读书记·尚书》
exampleTraditional: 其源雖出於《洪範》，然既為術數之學，則治經者～可矣。★清·陳澧《東塾讀書記·尚書》
exampleEn: Although its origin is from the 'Hong Fan', since it is a divination technique, scholars of classics can leave it aside without discussion. (Chen Li, 'Reading Notes of Dongshu: Book of Documents')

explanation: 无所事事，到处闲诳。同东游西荡”。
explanationTraditional: 無所事事，到處閒誑。同東遊西蕩”。
explanationEn: To wander around idly with nothing to do.
derivation: 《人民文学》1978年第2期‘四人帮’横行时，有些学生基本上不上课，东游西逛，学得‘油腔滑调’。”
derivationTraditional: 《人民文學》1978年第2期‘四人幫’橫行時，有些學生基本上不上課，東遊西逛，學得‘油腔滑調’。”
derivationEn: From 'People's Literature', 1978, Issue 2: 'When the Gang of Four was rampant, some students basically did not attend classes, wandering around idly and learning to be slick.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 稽考查。十分荒唐，不可凭信。
explanationTraditional: 稽考查。十分荒唐，不可憑信。
explanationEn: Absurd and unfounded; not to be believed.
derivation: 清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第三回那个神字，原是野蛮世界拿出来哄著愚人的话，如今科学大明，这些荒诞无稽的谬说，那里还能立足呢？”
derivationTraditional: 清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第三回那個神字，原是野蠻世界拿出來哄著愚人的話，如今科學大明，這些荒誕無稽的謬說，那裡還能立足呢？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Lingnan Yiyi Nushi's 'Heroine of Eastern Europe', Chapter 3: 'The word 'god' was originally used by the barbaric world to fool the ignorant. Now that science is clear, these absurd and unfounded fallacies can no longer stand.'
example: 他的大九州之说，在当年虽是～，而在现代则毫不足惊异了。★郭沫若《文艺论集·惠施的性格与思想》
exampleTraditional: 他的大九州之說，在當年雖是～，而在現代則毫不足驚異了。★郭沫若《文藝論集·惠施的性格與思想》
exampleEn: His theory of the great continents, though absurd and unfounded in those days, is no longer surprising in modern times. (Guo Moruo, 'On Literature and Art: Hui Shi's Character and Thought')

explanation: 截取长的，补充短的。比喻用长处补短处。
explanationTraditional: 截取長的，補充短的。比喻用長處補短處。
explanationEn: To cut off from the long to supplement the short; to use strengths to make up for weaknesses.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公上》今滕绝长补短，将五十里也，犹可以为善国。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公上》今滕絕長補短，將五十里也，猶可以為善國。”
derivationEn: From Mencius, 'Teng Wen Gong I': 'Now Teng, cutting off the long and supplementing the short, will be about fifty li, and can still be a good state.'
example: 迨工员报销，～，蕲合成例，言官以浮冒入奏。★《清史稿·姚祖同传》
exampleTraditional: 迨工員報銷，～，蘄合成例，言官以浮冒入奏。★《清史稿·姚祖同傳》
exampleEn: When the workers reimbursed, they cut off the long to supplement the short, hoping to meet the regulations, and the censors impeached them for false reporting. ('Draft History of Qing: Biography of Yao Zutong')

explanation: 旧时以此为人生四戒。泛指各种不良品德、习气。
explanationTraditional: 舊時以此為人生四戒。泛指各種不良品德、習氣。
explanationEn: Wine, women, wealth, and temper; the four vices that people were advised to avoid in ancient times.
derivation: 《后汉书·杨秉传》尝从容言曰‘我有三不惑酒、色、财也。’”元·马致远《黄梁梦》第四折一梦中十八年，见了酒色财气，人我是非，贪嗔痴爱，风霜雨雪。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·楊秉傳》嘗從容言曰‘我有三不惑酒、色、財也。’”元·馬致遠《黃梁夢》第四折一夢中十八年，見了酒色財氣，人我是非，貪嗔痴愛，風霜雨雪。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Yang Bing': 'He once said leisurely: 'I have three things that do not confuse me: wine, women, and wealth.'' Also from Yuan Dynasty, Ma Zhiyuan's 'Yellow Millet Dream', Act 4: 'In a dream of eighteen years, I saw wine, women, wealth, and temper, right and wrong, greed, anger, and love, wind, frost, rain, and snow.'
example: 李生起而观之，乃是一首词，名《西江月》，是说～四件的短处。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷十一
exampleTraditional: 李生起而觀之，乃是一首詞，名《西江月》，是說～四件的短處。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷十一
exampleEn: Li Sheng stood up and looked at it; it was a poem titled 'Moon over the West River', talking about the shortcomings of the four vices: wine, women, wealth, and temper. (Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 11)

explanation: 原为佛家语，形容深重无比的苦难。惩回头是岸”连用。
explanationTraditional: 原為佛家語，形容深重無比的苦難。懲回頭是岸”連用。
explanationEn: The boundless sea of suffering; a Buddhist term for the endless misery of worldly life. Often used with '回头是岸' (repentance is the shore).
derivation: 元·无名氏《度翠柳》第一折世俗人没来由，争长竞短，你死我活。有呵吃些个，有呵穿些个。苦海无边，回头是岸。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《度翠柳》第一折世俗人沒來由，爭長競短，你死我活。有呵吃些個，有呵穿些個。苦海無邊，回頭是岸。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Du Cui Liu', Act 1: 'Worldly people have no reason to compete for length and shortness, life and death. If you have some, eat some; if you have some, wear some. The sea of suffering is boundless, but repentance is the shore.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 到口渴才掘井。比喻事先没有准备，临时才想办法。
explanationTraditional: 到口渴才掘井。比喻事先沒有準備，臨時才想辦法。
explanationEn: To dig a well when thirsty; to act without preparation and only seek a solution when in trouble.
derivation: 《黄帝内经·素问·四气调神大论》夫病已成而后药之，乱已成而后治之，譬犹渴而穿井，斗而铸锥，不亦晚乎！”
derivationTraditional: 《黃帝內經·素問·四氣調神大論》夫病已成而後藥之，亂已成而後治之，譬猶渴而穿井，鬥而鑄錐，不亦晚乎！”
derivationEn: From 'Yellow Emperor's Inner Canon: Plain Questions: Four Qi Regulating Spirit': 'If you treat a disease after it has developed, or govern after chaos has arisen, it is like digging a well when thirsty, or casting weapons when fighting—is it not too late?'
example: 一着空虚百着空。～，悔之何及。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 一著空虛百著空。～，悔之何及。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第三十五回
exampleEn: One empty move leads to a hundred empty moves. Digging a well when thirsty—regret is too late. (Xu Zhonglin, 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 35)

explanation: 高深的程度无法揣测。指处世的态度、或说话、文章的内容（多不用在正面，带贬义）。
explanationTraditional: 高深的程度無法揣測。指處世的態度、或說話、文章的內容（多不用在正面，帶貶義）。
explanationEn: Impossible to fathom or measure; often used negatively to describe someone's attitude, speech, or writing as deliberately obscure.
derivation: 《汉书·严延年传》吏民莫能测其意深浅。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·嚴延年傳》吏民莫能測其意深淺。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Yan Yannian': 'Officials and commoners could not fathom his intentions.'
example: 知县当然别有我们所～的妙法在。★鲁迅《华盖集·这个与那个》
exampleTraditional: 知縣當然別有我們所～的妙法在。★魯迅《華蓋集·這個與那個》
exampleEn: The magistrate certainly has his own mysterious methods that we cannot fathom. (Lu Xun, 'Huagai Collection: This and That')

explanation: 名用言语说出；状描绘，形容。不能用言语来形容。指事物极复杂微妙，无法描述。
explanationTraditional: 名用言語說出；狀描繪，形容。不能用言語來形容。指事物極複雜微妙，無法描述。
explanationEn: Indescribable; beyond description; too complex or subtle to be expressed in words.
derivation: 清·张潮《虞初新志·林四娘记》少选复出，则一国色丽人，云鬟靓妆，袅袅婷婷而至，衣皆鲛绡雾縠，亦无缝缀之迹，香气飘扬，莫可名状，自称为林四娘。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張潮《虞初新志·林四娘記》少選復出，則一國色麗人，雲鬟靚妝，嫋嫋婷婷而至，衣皆鮫綃霧縠，亦無縫綴之跡，香氣飄揚，莫可名狀，自稱為林四娘。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Chao's 'Yu Chu Xin Zhi: The Story of Lin Siniang': 'After a short while, she reappeared, a stunning beauty with cloud-like hair and elegant attire, gracefully approaching. Her clothes were made of fine silk and gauze, without any seams, and a fragrance wafted, indescribable. She called herself Lin Siniang.'
example: 这信该收束了，我心中～，我觉得非常的荣幸！★冰心《寄小读者·通讯一》
exampleTraditional: 這信該收束了，我心中～，我覺得非常的榮幸！★冰心《寄小讀者·通訊一》
exampleEn: This letter should be concluded. I feel indescribable in my heart; I feel very honored! — Bing Xin, 'To Little Readers: Letter One'

explanation: 毫无根据的擅加伪做。
explanationTraditional: 毫無根據的擅加偽做。
explanationEn: To fabricate something without any basis; to make up a false story out of thin air.
derivation: 明·沈德符《万历野获编补遗·土司·土官承袭》近世作伪者多凭空捏造 ，苟得金钱，兵部武选司吏胥概为准行。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《萬曆野獲編補遺·土司·土官承襲》近世作偽者多憑空捏造 ，苟得金錢，兵部武選司吏胥概為準行。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shen Defu's 'Wanli Ye Huo Bian Supplement: Local Officials: Inheritance of Local Offices': 'In recent times, forgers often fabricate out of thin air. If they obtain money, the clerks in the Ministry of War's Selection Department generally approve it.'
example: 天女如何下降，不知与天孙织女作何称呼？小子尚不敢～，是从史籍上翻阅得来。★蔡东藩《清史演义》第一回
exampleTraditional: 天女如何下降，不知與天孫織女作何稱呼？小子尚不敢～，是從史籍上翻閱得來。★蔡東藩《清史演義》第一回
exampleEn: How did the heavenly maiden descend? I wonder how she is related to the Weaving Maiden. I dare not fabricate out of thin air; I have gleaned this from historical records. — Cai Dongfan, 'History of the Qing Dynasty', First Chapter

explanation: 房屋多厕而有围墙的院子。旧时多指富贵人家。
explanationTraditional: 房屋多廁而有圍牆的院子。舊時多指富貴人家。
explanationEn: A large compound with many houses and surrounding walls; traditionally refers to the residence of wealthy or influential families.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《救风尘》第二折他每待强巴劫深宅大院，便侍折摧了舞榭歌楼。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《救風塵》第二折他每待強巴劫深宅大院，便侍折摧了舞榭歌樓。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Rescuing a Prostitute', Act 2: 'They insist on forcing their way into the deep mansion and large courtyard, and then they will destroy the dance pavilion and song house.'
example: 婶子在里面住着，～，那里就知道了。（清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十四回）
exampleTraditional: 嬸子在裡面住著，～，那裡就知道了。（清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十四回）
exampleEn: Auntie lives inside, in a deep mansion and large courtyard, so how could she know? — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 64

explanation: 渝改变。无论活着还是死去都不会改变。形容对理想、信念、友谊、盟约等忠贞不移。
explanationTraditional: 渝改變。無論活著還是死去都不會改變。形容對理想、信念、友誼、盟約等忠貞不移。
explanationEn: Unchanging through life and death; steadfast and loyal to ideals, beliefs, friendship, or vows until death.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人体的各个部分。泛指全身。
explanationTraditional: 人體的各個部分。泛指全身。
explanationEn: All parts of the human body; the entire body.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 痛到骨头里。比喻痛恨或悲伤之极。
explanationTraditional: 痛到骨頭裡。比喻痛恨或悲傷之極。
explanationEn: Pain that penetrates to the marrow; extreme hatred or grief.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策三》樊将军仰天太息流涕曰‘吾每念常痛于骨髓，顾计不知所出耳！’”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策三》樊將軍仰天太息流涕曰‘吾每念常痛於骨髓，顧計不知所出耳！’”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Yan Strategy Three': 'General Fan looked up to the sky, sighed, and wept, saying, 'Whenever I think of it, the pain penetrates to my marrow, but I do not know what plan to devise!''
example: 宋襄公志欲求伯，被楚人捉弄一场，反受大辱，怨恨之情，～，但恨力不能报。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第三十四回
exampleTraditional: 宋襄公志欲求伯，被楚人捉弄一場，反受大辱，怨恨之情，～，但恨力不能報。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第三十四回
exampleEn: Duke Xiang of Song, ambitious to become hegemon, was tricked by the people of Chu and suffered great humiliation. His resentment penetrated to the marrow, but he regretted that his strength was insufficient for revenge. — Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 34

explanation: 烹烧煮。兔子死了，猎狗就被人烹食。比喻给统治者效劳的人事成后被抛弃或杀掉。
explanationTraditional: 烹燒煮。兔子死了，獵狗就被人烹食。比喻給統治者效勞的人事成後被拋棄或殺掉。
explanationEn: When the rabbits are dead, the hunting dogs are cooked and eaten. Metaphor for being discarded or killed after serving a ruler successfully.
derivation: 《史记·越王勾践世家》飞鸟尽，良弓藏；狡兔死，走狗烹。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·越王勾踐世家》飛鳥盡，良弓藏；狡兔死，走狗烹。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: The House of King Goujian of Yue': 'When the flying birds are gone, the good bow is put away; when the cunning rabbits are dead, the running dogs are cooked.'
example: 大凡古来有识见的英雄功成名就，便拂袖而去，免使后来有鸟尽弓藏，～”之祸。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第九回
exampleTraditional: 大凡古來有識見的英雄功成名就，便拂袖而去，免使後來有鳥盡弓藏，～”之禍。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第九回
exampleEn: Generally, wise heroes of ancient times, after achieving merit and fame, would leave promptly to avoid the disaster of 'when the birds are gone, the bow is put away; when the rabbits are dead, the dogs are cooked.' — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 9

explanation: 君主时代指大臣中地位最高的人。
explanationTraditional: 君主時代指大臣中地位最高的人。
explanationEn: The highest-ranking minister under a monarch; the pinnacle of officialdom.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书· 孙林传》因缘肺腑，位极人臣。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書· 孫林傳》因緣肺腑，位極人臣。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Book of Wu: Biography of Sun Lin': 'By virtue of being a relative by marriage, he reached the highest position among the ministers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 销消瘦。形容身体非常消瘦。
explanationTraditional: 銷消瘦。形容身體非常消瘦。
explanationEn: Emaciated; reduced to a skeleton; extremely thin.
derivation: 《南史·梁本纪》帝形容本壮，及至都，销毁骨立。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·梁本紀》帝形容本壯，及至都，銷燬骨立。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Southern Dynasties: Annals of Liang': 'The emperor's body was originally strong, but when he arrived at the capital, he became emaciated, reduced to a skeleton.'
example: 及放榜时，依然铩羽。生嗒丧而归，愧负知己，～，痴若木偶。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·叶生》
exampleTraditional: 及放榜時，依然鎩羽。生嗒喪而歸，愧負知己，～，痴若木偶。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·葉生》
exampleEn: When the list was posted, he still failed. The scholar returned dejectedly, ashamed of failing his benefactor, and became emaciated, like a wooden puppet. — Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Ye Sheng'

explanation: 雪泥融化着雪水的泥土。大雁在雪泥上踏过留下的爪印。比喻往事遗留的痕迹。
explanationTraditional: 雪泥融化著雪水的泥土。大雁在雪泥上踏過留下的爪印。比喻往事遺留的痕跡。
explanationEn: A swan's footprints in the snow; traces left by past events.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《和子由渑池怀旧》诗人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥。泥上偶然留指爪，鸿飞那复计东西。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《和子由澠池懷舊》詩人生到處知何似，應似飛鴻踏雪泥。泥上偶然留指爪，鴻飛那復計東西。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's poem 'Harmonizing with Ziyou's Nostalgia at Mianchi': 'Life is like a swan's footprints in the snow. By chance it leaves its claws in the mud; the swan flies away, caring not for east or west.'
example: ～，惟留一幅悲怆之影于吾汉族历史之中，良可慨已。★清·陶宗佑《中国文学之概观》
exampleTraditional: ～，惟留一幅悲愴之影於吾漢族歷史之中，良可慨已。★清·陶宗佑《中國文學之概觀》
exampleEn: Only a sorrowful shadow remains in the history of our Han race, like a swan's footprints in the snow. How lamentable! — Tao Zongyou, 'An Overview of Chinese Literature'

explanation: 寻找；章篇章；摘摘录。旧时读书人从书本中搜寻摘抄片断语句，在写作时套用。指写作时堆砌现成词句，缺乏创造性。
explanationTraditional: 尋找；章篇章；摘摘錄。舊時讀書人從書本中搜尋摘抄片斷語句，在寫作時套用。指寫作時堆砌現成詞句，缺乏創造性。
explanationEn: To cull phrases and sentences from books; to write in a derivative manner without creativity.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·孙权传》遣都尉赵咨使魏。”裴松之注引《吴书》虽有余闲，博览书传历史，藉采奇异，不效诸生寻章摘句而已。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·孫權傳》遣都尉趙諮使魏。”裴松之注引《吳書》雖有餘閒，博覽書傳歷史，藉採奇異，不效諸生尋章摘句而已。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Biography of Sun Quan' with commentary by Pei Songzhi: 'Though having leisure, he extensively read books and histories, seeking out the unusual, not imitating students who merely cull phrases and sentences.'
example: ～老雕虫，晓月当帘挂玉弓。★唐·李贺《南园》诗
exampleTraditional: ～老鵰蟲，曉月當簾掛玉弓。★唐·李賀《南園》詩
exampleEn: Culling phrases and sentences like an old bookworm, the dawn moon hangs like a jade bow before the curtain. — Li He, 'Southern Garden'

explanation: 愈仰望愈觉得其崇高。表示极其敬仰之意。
explanationTraditional: 愈仰望愈覺得其崇高。表示極其敬仰之意。
explanationEn: The more one looks up, the higher it seems; expressing great admiration.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》颜渊喟然叹曰‘仰之弥高，钻之弥坚，瞻之在前，忽焉在后，夫子循循然诱人。博我以文，约我以礼，欲罢不能，既竭吾才，如有所立卓尔，未由也已。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》顏淵喟然嘆曰‘仰之彌高，鑽之彌堅，瞻之在前，忽焉在後，夫子循循然誘人。博我以文，約我以禮，欲罷不能，既竭吾才，如有所立卓爾，未由也已。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Zihan': Yan Yuan sighed, 'The more I look up, the higher it seems; the more I delve, the harder it becomes. I see it before me, then suddenly it is behind. The Master skillfully leads me forward.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 每天多次地自我反省。
explanationTraditional: 每天多次地自我反省。
explanationEn: To reflect on oneself multiple times a day.
derivation: 《论语·学而》曾子曰‘吾日三省吾身。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·學而》曾子曰‘吾日三省吾身。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Xue'er': Zengzi said, 'I daily examine myself on three points.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 趑趄迟疑不敢前进。形容犹豫畏缩不敢前进。
explanationTraditional: 趑趄遲疑不敢前進。形容猶豫畏縮不敢前進。
explanationEn: To hesitate and dare not advance; to be timid and reluctant to move forward.
derivation: 《周易·夬》臀无肤，其行次且。”唐·韩愈《送李愿归盘谷序》足将进而趑趄，口将言而嗫嚅。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·夬》臀無膚，其行次且。”唐·韓愈《送李願歸盤谷序》足將進而趑趄，口將言而囁嚅。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Guai': 'The buttocks have no skin, and the movement is hesitant.' Also from Han Yu's 'Seeing Li Yuan off to Return to Pangu': 'The foot is about to advance but hesitates; the mouth is about to speak but stammers.'
example: 不由自主的便上了包车，仍回到鸿仁里，望着自己门口，倒有点～之态。（清·吴趼人《近十年之怪现状》第七回）
exampleTraditional: 不由自主的便上了包車，仍回到鴻仁裡，望著自己門口，倒有點～之態。（清·吳趼人《近十年之怪現狀》第七回）
exampleEn: Involuntarily, he got into the rickshaw and returned to Hongren Lane, looking at his own door, he felt somewhat hesitant to advance. — Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Decade', Chapter 7

explanation: 形容象泰山一样稳固，不可动摇。
explanationTraditional: 形容象泰山一樣穩固，不可動搖。
explanationEn: As stable as Mount Tai; unshakable.
derivation: 汉·枚乘《上书谏吴王》变所欲为，易于反掌，安于泰山。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·枚乘《上書諫吳王》變所欲為，易於反掌，安於泰山。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Mei Cheng's 'Letter to the King of Wu': 'To change what you desire is easier than turning over your hand, and more stable than Mount Tai.'
example: 在敌人的强大攻势下，我军阵地～。
exampleTraditional: 在敵人的強大攻勢下，我軍陣地～。
exampleEn: Under the enemy's fierce attack, our army's position was as stable as Mount Tai.

explanation: 从容不慌不忙，很镇静；自若自在，如常，保持原样。不慌不忙，沉着镇定。
explanationTraditional: 從容不慌不忙，很鎮靜；自若自在，如常，保持原樣。不慌不忙，沉著鎮定。
explanationEn: Calm and composed; unhurried and steady.
derivation: 《旧唐书·刘世龙传》而思礼以为得计，从容自若，尝与相忤者，必引令枉诛。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·劉世龍傳》而思禮以為得計，從容自若，嘗與相忤者，必引令枉誅。”
derivationEn: From 'Old Book of Tang: Biography of Liu Shilong': 'But Sili thought he had succeeded, and was calm and composed, often leading to the wrongful execution of those who opposed him.'
example: 请你数一数高家究竟有几个象样的人！”觉民～地嘲讽道，仿佛他自己并不是高家的子弟。★巴金《春》三十一
exampleTraditional: 請你數一數高家究竟有幾個象樣的人！”覺民～地嘲諷道，彷彿他自己並不是高家的子弟。★巴金《春》三十一
exampleEn: 'Please count how many decent people there are in the Gao family!' Jue Min said calmly and sarcastically, as if he himself were not a member of the Gao family. — Ba Jin, 'Spring', Chapter 31

explanation: 人心即民心。指受百姓热烈拥护。
