explanationTraditional: 人心即民心。指受百姓熱烈擁護。
explanationEn: To win great popular support; to be widely acclaimed by the people.
derivation: 《魏书·昭成子孙传》太祖命督屯田于河北，自五原至棝杨塞外，分农稼，大得人心。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·昭成子孫傳》太祖命督屯田於河北，自五原至棝楊塞外，分農稼，大得人心。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei: Biographies of the Descendants of Zhaocheng': 'The太祖 ordered him to supervise farming north of the Yellow River, from Wuyuan to Gushu Pass, distributing crops and greatly winning the people's hearts.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 纷纷众多；攘攘杂乱的样子。众多且杂乱。形容人群杂乱。
explanationTraditional: 紛紛眾多；攘攘雜亂的樣子。眾多且雜亂。形容人群雜亂。
explanationEn: Numerous and chaotic; describing a disorderly crowd.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷十八杨八老看见乡村百姓，纷纷攘攘，都来城中逃难。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷十八楊八老看見鄉村百姓，紛紛攘攘，都來城中逃難。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 18: 'Yang Bala saw the villagers, numerous and chaotic, all coming to take refuge in the city.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 极言风景之佳胜。
explanationTraditional: 極言風景之佳勝。
explanationEn: Indescribably beautiful scenery; boundless natural beauty.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《六先生画像·濂溪先生》风月无边，庭草交翠。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《六先生畫像·濂溪先生》風月無邊，庭草交翠。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhu Xi's 'Six Portraits of Scholars: Mr. Lianxi': 'Boundless wind and moon, grass and trees intertwined.'
example: 西湖～景，都在诗翁杖履中。★金·侯克中《过友生新居》诗
exampleTraditional: 西湖～景，都在詩翁杖履中。★金·侯克中《過友生新居》詩
exampleEn: The boundless scenery of West Lake is all within the poet's staff and shoes. — Jin Dynasty Hou Kezhong, 'Visiting a Friend's New Residence'

explanation: 羁马笼头，引伸为束缚。形容人性情豪迈，不受拘束。
explanationTraditional: 羈馬籠頭，引伸為束縛。形容人性情豪邁，不受拘束。
explanationEn: Bold and uninhibited; unrestrained and free-spirited.
derivation: 《北史·张彝传》彝少而豪放，出入殿庭，步眄高上，无所顾忌。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·張彝傳》彝少而豪放，出入殿庭，步眄高上，無所顧忌。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Zhang Yi': 'Zhang Yi was bold and uninhibited from youth, entering and leaving the palace with a lofty gaze, without scruples.'
example: 方岳宗是现任松江知府方岳贡的哥哥，为人慷慨侠义，～，喜欢喝酒，十分健谈。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十六章
exampleTraditional: 方岳宗是現任松江知府方岳貢的哥哥，為人慷慨俠義，～，喜歡喝酒，十分健談。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第十六章
exampleEn: Fang Yuezhong was the elder brother of Fang Yuegong, the current prefect of Songjiang. He was generous and chivalrous, bold and uninhibited, loved drinking, and was very talkative. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 16

explanation: 形容行动坚决迅速。同剑及屦及”。
explanationTraditional: 形容行動堅決迅速。同劍及屨及”。
explanationEn: Describes acting resolutely and swiftly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 揖拱手作礼。开门请强盗进来。比喻引进坏人，招来祸患。
explanationTraditional: 揖拱手作禮。開門請強盜進來。比喻引進壞人，招來禍患。
explanationEn: To open the door and invite the robber in; metaphor for bringing in bad people and inviting disaster.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·吴主传》况今奸宄竞逐，豺狼满道，乃欲哀亲戚，顾礼制，是犹开门而揖盗，未可以为仁也。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·吳主傳》況今奸宄競逐，豺狼滿道，乃欲哀親戚，顧禮制，是猶開門而揖盜，未可以為仁也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Biography of Sun Quan': 'How much more so now when villains are contending and wolves fill the roads, yet you want to mourn relatives and observe rites—this is like opening the door to invite the robber in, which cannot be considered benevolent.'
example: 失守城池，要按军法；况又有禀帖到杨太守差我保守，我是你徒弟，～，岂不是私通叛寇？★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三回
exampleTraditional: 失守城池，要按軍法；況又有稟帖到楊太守差我保守，我是你徒弟，～，豈不是私通叛寇？★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三回
exampleEn: Losing the city would be a violation of military law; moreover, there is a report that Yang Taishou ordered me to defend it. I am your disciple, and opening the door to invite the robber in would be secretly colluding with rebels? — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 3

explanation: 感到惭愧，承当不起。
explanationTraditional: 感到慚愧，承當不起。
explanationEn: To feel ashamed and unworthy of a compliment or honor.
derivation: 清·郑燮《刘柳村册子》紫琼崖道人，慎郡王也，赠诗‘按拍遥传月殿曲，走盘乱泻蛟宫珠。’愧不敢当，然亦佳句。”
derivationTraditional: 清·鄭燮《劉柳村冊子》紫瓊崖道人，慎郡王也，贈詩‘按拍遙傳月殿曲，走盤亂瀉蛟宮珠。’愧不敢當，然亦佳句。”
derivationEn: From Zheng Xie's 'Liu Liu Cun Zi': 'The Taoist of Purple Jade Cliff, Prince Shen of Jun, presented a poem: 'Clapping to the beat, the moon palace tune travels far; pearls scatter and dance like palace dragons.' I am ashamed and dare not accept, but it is still a fine verse.'
example: 却做梦也想不到受了两位国家领导人的夸奖，实在～！★周疲鹃《寄侨居海外的女儿》
exampleTraditional: 卻做夢也想不到受了兩位國家領導人的誇獎，實在～！★周疲鵑《寄僑居海外的女兒》
exampleEn: But I never dreamed of being praised by two national leaders; I really feel ashamed and unworthy! — Zhou Pijuan, 'Letter to My Daughter Living Overseas'

explanation: 体温随环境温度的改变而变化的动物。比喻缺乏感情、对人对事冷漠的人。
explanationTraditional: 體溫隨環境溫度的改變而變化的動物。比喻缺乏感情、對人對事冷漠的人。
explanationEn: An animal whose body temperature changes with the environment; metaphor for a person lacking emotion and indifferent to others.
derivation: 钱钟书《围城》李先生本来像冬蛰的冷血动物，给顾先生当众恭维得春气入身，蠕蠕欲活。”
derivationTraditional: 錢鍾書《圍城》李先生本來像冬蟄的冷血動物，給顧先生當眾恭維得春氣入身，蠕蠕欲活。”
derivationEn: From Qian Zhongshu's 'Fortress Besieged': 'Mr. Li, originally like a hibernating cold-blooded animal, was warmed by Gu's public flattery and began to stir as if spring had entered his body.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 蒙骗上级，压迫下属和人民。
explanationTraditional: 矇騙上級，壓迫下屬和人民。
explanationEn: To deceive superiors and oppress subordinates and the people.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 如今还不能替老百姓想，～，咱简直不是个人啦！（丁玲《太阳照在桑干河上》）
exampleTraditional: 如今還不能替老百姓想，～，咱簡直不是個人啦！（丁玲《太陽照在桑乾河上》）
exampleEn: Now we still can't think for the common people, deceiving superiors and oppressing subordinates—we're not even human! — Ding Ling, 'The Sun Shines Over the Sanggan River'

explanation: 原是车胤用口袋装萤火虫来照书本，孙康利用雪的反光勤奋苦学的故事◇形容刻苦攻读。
explanationTraditional: 原是車胤用口袋裝螢火蟲來照書本，孫康利用雪的反光勤奮苦學的故事◇形容刻苦攻讀。
explanationEn: Originally refers to Che Yin using a bag of fireflies to read and Sun Kang using snow reflection to study diligently; describes hard study.
derivation: 元·贾仲名《萧淑兰》第一折虽无汗马眠霜苦，曾受囊萤映雪劳。”
derivationTraditional: 元·賈仲名《蕭淑蘭》第一折雖無汗馬眠霜苦，曾受囊螢映雪勞。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Jia Zhongming's 'Xiao Shulan', Act 1: 'Though I have not endured the hardship of sleeping on frost while sweating on horseback, I have suffered the toil of reading by firefly light and snow reflection.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 睡觉也不能安于枕席。形容心事重重，睡不着觉。
explanationTraditional: 睡覺也不能安於枕蓆。形容心事重重，睡不著覺。
explanationEn: Unable to sleep peacefully on the mat; describes being so worried that one cannot sleep.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策五》秦王恐之，寝不安席，食不甘味。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策五》秦王恐之，寢不安席，食不甘味。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy V': 'The King of Qin was terrified, unable to sleep peacefully or eat with appetite.'
example: 臣受命之日，～，食不甘味。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第九十七回
exampleTraditional: 臣受命之日，～，食不甘味。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第九十七回
exampleEn: Since receiving the order, I have been unable to sleep peacefully or eat with appetite. — Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 97

explanation: 清静空闲，无拘无束。形容生活安闲舒适。
explanationTraditional: 清靜空閒，無拘無束。形容生活安閒舒適。
explanationEn: Peaceful, leisurely, and unrestrained; describes a comfortable and carefree life.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第十四卷昼之所思，夜之所梦，连睡去的魂魄，都是忙的，那得清闲自在。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第十四卷晝之所思，夜之所夢，連睡去的魂魄，都是忙的，那得清閒自在。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 14: 'What one thinks by day, one dreams by night; even the sleeping soul is busy, how can one be peaceful and leisurely?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人世间的情态。多指人与人之间的交往情分。
explanationTraditional: 人世間的情態。多指人與人之間的交往情分。
explanationEn: The ways of the world, especially interpersonal relationships.
derivation: 明·陈所闻《新水令·填归去来词》套曲俺与那人情世态既相违，披襟散发最相宜。”明·洪应明《菜根谭·闲适》人情世态，倏忽万端，不宜认得太真。”
derivationTraditional: 明·陳所聞《新水令·填歸去來詞》套曲俺與那人情世態既相違，披襟散發最相宜。”明·洪應明《菜根譚·閒適》人情世態，倏忽萬端，不宜認得太真。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Chen Suowen's 'New Water Tune: Filling the Song of Returning Home' suite: 'Since I am at odds with the ways of the world, it is best to let my hair down and be free.' Also from Ming Dynasty Hong Yingming's 'Caigentan: Leisure': 'The ways of the world change rapidly; one should not take them too seriously.'
example: 小说的许多章节便刻画出生动的～。★杨朔《〈六十年的变迁〉书后》
exampleTraditional: 小說的許多章節便刻畫出生動的～。★楊朔《〈六十年的變遷〉書後》
exampleEn: Many chapters of the novel vividly depict the ways of the world. — Yang Shuo, 'Afterword to 'Sixty Years of Change''

explanation: 好象明亮，又好象昏暗。比喻对情况的了解或对问题的认识不清楚。
explanationTraditional: 好象明亮，又好象昏暗。比喻對情況的瞭解或對問題的認識不清楚。
explanationEn: Seemingly bright, yet seemingly dim; metaphor for unclear understanding or knowledge of a situation.
derivation: 毛泽东《改造我们的学习》在这种态度下，就是对周围环境不作系统的周密的研究，单凭主观热情去工作，对于中国今天的面目若明若暗。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《改造我們的學習》在這種態度下，就是對周圍環境不作系統的周密的研究，單憑主觀熱情去工作，對於中國今天的面目若明若暗。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Reform Our Study': 'With this attitude, one does not conduct systematic and thorough research on the surrounding environment, but works with subjective enthusiasm, having only a vague understanding of China's current situation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 俗指笔、墨、纸、砚。
explanationTraditional: 俗指筆、墨、紙、硯。
explanationEn: The four treasures of the study: brush, ink, paper, and inkstone.
derivation: 宋·梅尧臣《再和潘歙州纸砚》诗文房四宝出二郡，迩来赏玩君与予。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·梅堯臣《再和潘歙州紙硯》詩文房四寶出二郡，邇來賞玩君與予。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Mei Yaochen's poem 'Again with Pan Shezhou Paper and Inkstone': 'The four treasures of the study come from two prefectures, recently you and I have enjoyed them.'
example: 天子被逼不过，只得命取绝笔。奶子随即取捧过～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第八十一回
exampleTraditional: 天子被逼不過，只得命取絕筆。奶子隨即取捧過～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第八十一回
exampleEn: The emperor was forced to order the pen. The nurse immediately took and presented the four treasures of the study. ★ Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 81

explanation: 千言长篇大论。形容文思敏捷，写作迅速。
explanationTraditional: 千言長篇大論。形容文思敏捷，寫作迅速。
explanationEn: Writing a thousand words at once; describes quick thinking and fast writing.
derivation: 宋·曾巩《送丰稷》读书一见若经诵，下笔千言能立成。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·曾鞏《送豐稷》讀書一見若經誦，下筆千言能立成。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zeng Gong's 'Seeing off Feng': 'Reading once is like reciting from memory, writing a thousand words can be done instantly.'
example: 你这傻小子如果同女朋友写情书，大概～，倚马可待啦！★唐人《一个万能情报员的经历》
exampleTraditional: 你這傻小子如果同女朋友寫情書，大概～，倚馬可待啦！★唐人《一個萬能情報員的經歷》
exampleEn: If you, silly boy, write a love letter to your girlfriend, you can probably write a thousand words at once, waiting for the horse! ★ Tang Ren, 'The Experience of a Universal Intelligence Agent'

explanation: 犹口口声声。
explanationTraditional: 猶口口聲聲。
explanationEn: Repeatedly saying the same thing; insisting.
derivation: 《金瓶梅词话》第七回西门庆那里肯，一口一声只叫‘姑娘请受礼。’”
derivationTraditional: 《金瓶梅詞話》第七回西門慶那裡肯，一口一聲只叫‘姑娘請受禮。’”
derivationEn: 'The Plum in the Golden Vase', Chapter 7: 'Ximen Qing refused, and kept saying 'Miss, please accept the gift.''
example: 每到一处先替他向人报告，说这位就是唐观察；有些扯顺风旗的，亦就～的观察。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十五回
exampleTraditional: 每到一處先替他向人報告，說這位就是唐觀察；有些扯順風旗的，亦就～的觀察。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十五回
exampleEn: Everywhere he went, he first reported for him, saying this gentleman is Tang Observer; some who went along with the trend also called him Observer repeatedly. ★ Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 35

explanation: 形容非常光亮润泽。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常光亮潤澤。
explanationEn: Very shiny and lustrous.
derivation: 鲁迅《朝花夕拾·藤野先生》也有解散辫子，盘得平的，除下帽来，油光可鉴，宛如小姑娘的发髻一般，还要将脖子扭几扭。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《朝花夕拾·藤野先生》也有解散辮子，盤得平的，除下帽來，油光可鑑，宛如小姑娘的髮髻一般，還要將脖子扭幾扭。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun, 'Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk: Mr. Fujino': 'Some had undone their braids, coiled them flat, and when they took off their caps, their hair was so shiny it could be used as a mirror, like a young girl's bun, and they would twist their necks a few times.'
example: 他年近三十岁，留着‘西洋装’的头，梳的蓬蓬的，～。★吴组缃《山洪》五
exampleTraditional: 他年近三十歲，留著‘西洋裝’的頭，梳的蓬蓬的，～。★吳組緗《山洪》五
exampleEn: He was nearly thirty, with a 'Western-style' head, hair fluffy and shiny enough to be used as a mirror. ★ Wu Zuxiang, 'Mountain Torrent', Chapter 5

explanation: 重复好几次。
explanationTraditional: 重複好幾次。
explanationEn: Repeatedly; over and over again.
derivation: 《儒林外史》第二十五回再三再四拉他丛，他又跪下告了坐，方敢在底下一个凳子上坐了。”
derivationTraditional: 《儒林外史》第二十五回再三再四拉他叢，他又跪下告了坐，方敢在底下一個凳子上坐了。”
derivationEn: 'The Scholars', Chapter 25: 'He repeatedly pulled him to sit, and after he knelt and thanked, he dared to sit on a stool below.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 砍断门闩，攻破城门，夺取关隘。形容军队作战勇敢，势不可挡。
explanationTraditional: 砍斷門閂，攻破城門，奪取關隘。形容軍隊作戰勇敢，勢不可擋。
explanationEn: Cutting through barriers and capturing passes; describes an army fighting bravely and irresistibly.
derivation: 刘伯承《回顾长征》长征中，红军斩关夺隘，抢险飞渡，杀退了千万追兵阻敌。”
derivationTraditional: 劉伯承《回顧長征》長征中，紅軍斬關奪隘，搶險飛渡，殺退了千萬追兵阻敵。”
derivationEn: Liu Bocheng, 'Reviewing the Long March': 'During the Long March, the Red Army cut through barriers, captured passes, crossed dangerous waters, and repelled thousands of pursuing and blocking enemies.'
example: ［红三军］一路上克服了……严重困难，跋山涉水，～，粉碎了敌人的前堵后追，消灭许多敌人。★许光达等《湘鄂西和湘鄂川黔的武装斗争》
exampleTraditional: ［紅三軍］一路上克服了……嚴重困難，跋山涉水，～，粉碎了敵人的前堵後追，消滅許多敵人。★許光達等《湘鄂西和湘鄂川黔的武裝鬥爭》
exampleEn: [The Third Red Army] overcame severe difficulties... trekking over mountains and crossing rivers, cutting through barriers and capturing passes, smashing the enemy's front and rear attacks, and eliminating many enemies. ★ Xu Guangda et al., 'The Armed Struggle in Western Hunan, Hubei, and Sichuan-Guizhou'

explanation: 疏粗疏，薄弱。指人志向大而才具不够。
explanationTraditional: 疏粗疏，薄弱。指人志向大而才具不夠。
explanationEn: Having great ambitions but little talent; aspiring high but lacking ability.
derivation: 《后汉书·孔融传》融负其高气，志在靖难，而才疏意广，迄无成功。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·孔融傳》融負其高氣，志在靖難，而才疏意廣，迄無成功。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Kong Rong': 'Kong Rong relied on his high spirit, aimed to quell disasters, but his talent was shallow and his ambition broad, ultimately without success.'
example: 此人言过其实，～。
exampleTraditional: 此人言過其實，～。
exampleEn: This person's words exceed his deeds; he has great ambitions but little talent.

explanation: 后尘走路或行车时后面扬起的尘土。指跟在人家后面走。比喻追随模仿，学人家的样子，没有创造性。
explanationTraditional: 後塵走路或行車時後面揚起的塵土。指跟在人家後面走。比喻追隨模仿，學人家的樣子，沒有創造性。
explanationEn: Following in someone's footsteps; imitating others without originality.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《戏为六绝句》诗窃攀屈宋宜方驾，恐与齐梁作后尘。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《戲為六絕句》詩竊攀屈宋宜方駕，恐與齊梁作後塵。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Du Fu's poem 'Playfully Written for Six Quatrains': 'I secretly strive to match Qu Yuan and Song Yu, fearing to follow the dust of Qi and Liang.'
example: 有科学上，我们要勇于走自己的路，绝不可～。
exampleTraditional: 有科學上，我們要勇於走自己的路，絕不可～。
exampleEn: In science, we must dare to take our own path and never follow in others' footsteps.

explanation: 郁低沉郁积。指诗文的风格深沉蕴籍，语势有停顿转折。
explanationTraditional: 鬱低沉鬱積。指詩文的風格深沉蘊籍，語勢有停頓轉折。
explanationEn: Describes a literary style that is profound, restrained, and with rhythmic pauses and turns.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《进雕赋表》至于沉郁顿挫，随时敏捷，而扬雄、枚皋之徒，庶可跂及也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《進雕賦表》至於沉鬱頓挫，隨時敏捷，而揚雄、枚皋之徒，庶可跂及也。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Du Fu's 'Memorial Presenting the Fu': 'As for being profound and restrained, with timely agility, I can barely catch up with Yang Xiong and Mei Gao.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 发表达，传达。尽情地发表各种意见和评论。
explanationTraditional: 發表達，傳達。盡情地發表各種意見和評論。
explanationEn: To express various opinions and comments freely.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第76回文琴便扯天扯地的大谈起来，一会儿大发议论，一会儿又竭力恭维。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第76迴文琴便扯天扯地的大談起來，一會兒大發議論，一會兒又竭力恭維。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 76: 'Wen Qin then talked endlessly, sometimes making grand speeches, sometimes flattering vigorously.'
example: 他总喜欢在别人面前～。
exampleTraditional: 他總喜歡在別人面前～。
exampleEn: He always likes to make grand speeches in front of others.

explanation: 大声叫嚷，形容大肆宣传，大造舆论。
explanationTraditional: 大聲叫嚷，形容大肆宣傳，大造輿論。
explanationEn: To shout loudly; to make a big fuss or widespread propaganda.
derivation: 陶菊隐《北洋军阀统治时期史话》第59章吴毓鳞首先大喊大叫，‘内阁不能统一，我们不如及早下台。’”
derivationTraditional: 陶菊隱《北洋軍閥統治時期史話》第59章吳毓鱗首先大喊大叫，‘內閣不能統一，我們不如及早下臺。’”
derivationEn: Tao Juyin's 'History of the Northern Warlords Period', Chapter 59: 'Wu Yulin first shouted loudly, 'The cabinet cannot unify, we might as well step down early.''
example: 他急得～。
exampleTraditional: 他急得～。
exampleEn: He was so anxious that he started shouting loudly.

explanation: 比喻积少成多。
explanationTraditional: 比喻積少成多。
explanationEn: Many drops of water make a river; small amounts accumulate to form a large quantity.
derivation: 周立波《山乡世变》上一几年过去，聚少成多，滴水成河，手里以有几块花边了。”
derivationTraditional: 周立波《山鄉世變》上一幾年過去，聚少成多，滴水成河，手裡以有幾塊花邊了。”
derivationEn: Zhou Libo's 'Mountain Village Upheaval', Part 1: 'Over the years, many small amounts add up, drops of water become a river, and he had a few silver coins in hand.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象风和云那样流动散开。比喻在一起的人分散到四面八方。
explanationTraditional: 象風和雲那樣流動散開。比喻在一起的人分散到四面八方。
explanationEn: Scattered like wind and clouds; people who were together disperse in all directions.
derivation: 三国·魏·王粲《赠蔡子笃》诗风流云散，一别如雨。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·王粲《贈蔡子篤》詩風流雲散，一別如雨。”
derivationEn: Wang Can's poem 'To Cai Zidu' (Three Kingdoms, Wei): 'Like wind and clouds scattering, a parting like rain.'
example: 今则天各一方，～，兼之玉碎香埋，不堪回首矣。★清·沈复《浮生六记·闲情记趣》
exampleTraditional: 今則天各一方，～，兼之玉碎香埋，不堪回首矣。★清·沈復《浮生六記·閒情記趣》
exampleEn: Now we are separated far apart, scattered like wind and clouds, and with the jade shattered and fragrance buried, it is unbearable to look back. — Shen Fu, 'Six Records of a Floating Life', Qing Dynasty

explanation: 姑且随便说说，不一定有什么道理。
explanationTraditional: 姑且隨便說說，不一定有什麼道理。
explanationEn: To speak casually without necessarily having a point; to say something for what it's worth.
derivation: 《庄子·齐物论》予尝为女（汝）妄言之，女（汝）亦以妄听之奚。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·齊物論》予嘗為女（汝）妄言之，女（汝）亦以妄聽之奚。”
derivationEn: Zhuangzi, 'Discussion on Making All Things Equal': 'I once spoke to you casually, and you listened casually as well.'
example: 这不过～罢了，哪一个能办这件事？★《九命奇冤》第二十九回
exampleTraditional: 這不過～罷了，哪一個能辦這件事？★《九命奇冤》第二十九回
exampleEn: This is just a casual remark; who can actually handle this matter? — 'Nine Murders' (Chapter 29)

explanation: 形容江面宽阔，水天相接。
explanationTraditional: 形容江面寬闊，水天相接。
explanationEn: The river and sky merge into one color; describing a vast expanse of water meeting the sky.
derivation: 唐·张若虚《春江花月夜》江天一色无纤尘，皎皎空中孤月轮。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·張若虛《春江花月夜》江天一色無纖塵，皎皎空中孤月輪。”
derivationEn: Zhang Ruoxu's 'Spring River in the Flower Moon Night' (Tang Dynasty): 'The river and sky are one color without a speck of dust, the bright moon hangs alone in the sky.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指杂乱无条理。
explanationTraditional: 指雜亂無條理。
explanationEn: Disorderly and unsystematic; messy and without order.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 机时机，形势。随着情况的变化灵活机动地应付。
explanationTraditional: 機時機，形勢。隨著情況的變化靈活機動地應付。
explanationEn: To adapt flexibly to changing circumstances; to act according to the situation.
derivation: 《旧唐书·郭孝恪传》世充日踧月迫，力尽计穷，悬首面缚，翘足可待。建德远来助虐，粮运阻绝，此是天丧之时。请固武牢，屯军氾水，随机应变，则易为克殄。”
derivationTraditional: 《舊唐書·郭孝恪傳》世充日踧月迫，力盡計窮，懸首面縛，翹足可待。建德遠來助虐，糧運阻絕，此是天喪之時。請固武牢，屯軍氾水，隨機應變，則易為克殄。”
derivationEn: 'Old Book of Tang', Biography of Guo Xiaoke: 'Shichong is increasingly pressed, exhausted and out of plans, soon to be captured. Jiande comes from afar to aid, but his grain transport is blocked; this is heaven's chance to destroy them. Please hold Wulao, station troops at Sishui, and adapt to changes, then it will be easy to defeat them.'
example: 四境之内，百姓之事，蠡不如臣，与群周旋，～，臣不如蠡。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 四境之內，百姓之事，蠡不如臣，與群周旋，～，臣不如蠡。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十回
exampleEn: Within the four borders and matters of the people, Li is not as good as me; but in dealing with others and adapting to situations, I am not as good as Li. — Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' (Chapter 80)

explanation: 形容极大的罪恶。
explanationTraditional: 形容極大的罪惡。
explanationEn: A heinous crime; an enormous sin.
derivation: 元·无名氏《谢金吾》第四折纵有那弥天罪，也难赎。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《謝金吾》第四折縱有那彌天罪，也難贖。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty anonymous play 'Xie Jinwu', Act 4: 'Even with a crime that fills the sky, it is hard to atone.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 密严密。形容包围紧密或防卫严密，连风也透不进去。
explanationTraditional: 密嚴密。形容包圍緊密或防衛嚴密，連風也透不進去。
explanationEn: So tightly sealed that not even wind can pass through; describing tight encirclement or defense.
derivation: 元·纪君祥《赵氏孤儿》第二折这两家做下敌头重，但要访的孤儿有影踪，必然把太平庄上兵围拥，铁桶般密不通风。”
derivationTraditional: 元·紀君祥《趙氏孤兒》第二折這兩家做下敵頭重，但要訪的孤兒有影蹤，必然把太平莊上兵圍擁，鐵桶般密不通風。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty Ji Junxiang's 'The Orphan of Zhao', Act 2: 'These two families are deadly enemies; once the orphan is found, they will surround Taiping Village with troops, as tight as an iron barrel, not letting wind through.'
example: 岂知中军闻知按院奉旨捉拿钦犯，想又奉过密谕，在辕门领兵防守，～。（清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第八十二回）
exampleTraditional: 豈知中軍聞知按院奉旨捉拿欽犯，想又奉過密諭，在轅門領兵防守，～。（清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第八十二回）
exampleEn: But the central army, hearing that the imperial envoy was arresting a wanted criminal by decree, and having received secret orders, guarded the camp gate with troops, so tightly that not even wind could pass. — Xia Jingqu, 'A Country Codger's Exposure of Officialdom' (Chapter 82), Qing Dynasty

explanation: 诺许诺。一个诺言价值千金。指守信用，不轻易许诺。
explanationTraditional: 諾許諾。一個諾言價值千金。指守信用，不輕易許諾。
explanationEn: A promise worth a thousand gold pieces; describing someone who keeps their word and does not make promises lightly.
derivation: 《史记·季布栾布列传》得黄金百斤，不如得季布一诺。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·季布欒佈列傳》得黃金百斤，不如得季布一諾。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian', Biographies of Ji Bu and Luan Bu: 'A hundred catties of gold is not as good as Ji Bu's one promise.'
example: 酒后一言，就果然相赠，又不惮千里送来，你员外真可谓～矣。★明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 酒後一言，就果然相贈，又不憚千里送來，你員外真可謂～矣。★明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第五十六回
exampleEn: With a word after drinking, you indeed gave it away, and did not hesitate to travel a thousand miles to deliver it. Truly, you are a man of your word. — Lanling Xiaoxiao Sheng, 'The Plum in the Golden Vase' (Chapter 56), Ming Dynasty

explanation: 日月每天都经过天空。比喻光明正大，历久不衰。
explanationTraditional: 日月每天都經過天空。比喻光明正大，歷久不衰。
explanationEn: As constant as the sun and moon crossing the sky; metaphor for something that is righteous and enduring.
derivation: 南朝·宋·范晔《后汉书·冯衍传上》其事昭昭，日月经天，河海带地，不足以比。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·范曄《後漢書·馮衍傳上》其事昭昭，日月經天，河海帶地，不足以比。”
derivationEn: Fan Ye's 'Book of the Later Han': 'The matter is as clear as the sun and moon crossing the sky, and as rivers and seas bearing land, incomparable.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 蝎一种蜘蛛类的毒虫。形容心肠狠毒。
explanationTraditional: 蠍一種蜘蛛類的毒蟲。形容心腸狠毒。
explanationEn: Heart of a snake and scorpion; describes a person with a venomous and cruel nature.
derivation: 元·无名氏《抱妆盒》第二折便是蛇蝎心肠，不似恁般毒害。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《抱妝盒》第二折便是蛇蠍心腸，不似恁般毒害。”
derivationEn: Anonymous Yuan play 'The Palace of Embracing the Box': 'Even a snake or scorpion's heart is not as poisonous as this.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 寡少，缺少×无意味或毫无兴致的样子。
explanationTraditional: 寡少，缺少×無意味或毫無興致的樣子。
explanationEn: Dull and insipid; lacking interest or flavor.
derivation: 刘师培《论近世文学之变迁》然以空疏者为之，则枯木朽莇，索然寡味，仅得其转折波澜。”
derivationTraditional: 劉師培《論近世文學之變遷》然以空疏者為之，則枯木朽莇，索然寡味，僅得其轉折波瀾。”
derivationEn: Liu Shipei's 'On the Changes of Modern Literature': 'But when done by the shallow, it becomes like withered wood and rotten grass, dull and insipid, only capturing the twists and turns.'
example: 现在依旧是那些红缎对联，那些题款，但当他凝神望定它们的时候，他的兴致却～了。★沙汀《困兽记》二二
exampleTraditional: 現在依舊是那些紅緞對聯，那些題款，但當他凝神望定它們的時候，他的興致卻～了。★沙汀《困獸記》二二
exampleEn: Now those red satin couplets and inscriptions were still there, but when he stared at them intently, his interest became dull and insipid. — Sha Ding, 'The Trapped Beast', Chapter 22

explanation: 形容数量极多。
explanationTraditional: 形容數量極多。
explanationEn: Thousands upon thousands; an immense number.
derivation: 汉·王充《论衡·自然》天地安得万万千千手，并为物万万千千乎？”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王充《論衡·自然》天地安得萬萬千千手，併為物萬萬千千乎？”
derivationEn: Wang Chong's 'Balanced Discourses': 'How could heaven and earth have thousands upon thousands of hands to create thousands upon thousands of things?'
example: 他们预备散到各地去，把～的心团结成一颗心呀。★叶圣陶《寒假的一天》
exampleTraditional: 他們預備散到各地去，把～的心團結成一顆心呀。★葉聖陶《寒假的一天》
exampleEn: They were about to scatter to various places, to unite thousands upon thousands of hearts into one. — Ye Shengtao, 'A Winter Day'

explanation: 原意是说穷苦人家的女儿没有钱置备嫁衣，却每年辛辛苦苦地用金线刺乡，给别人做嫁衣。比喻空为别人辛苦。
explanationTraditional: 原意是說窮苦人家的女兒沒有錢置備嫁衣，卻每年辛辛苦苦地用金線刺鄉，給別人做嫁衣。比喻空為別人辛苦。
explanationEn: To work for others without benefit to oneself; to toil for others' benefit.
derivation: 唐·秦韬玉《贫女》诗苦为年年压金线，为他人作嫁衣裳。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·秦韜玉《貧女》詩苦為年年壓金線，為他人作嫁衣裳。”
derivationEn: Qin Taoyu's poem 'The Poor Girl': 'Bitterly every year I press gold thread, to make wedding clothes for others.'
example: 何必～？但是我进京以来，素无人知，今日你来破例，恐将来缠绕不休。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十五回
exampleTraditional: 何必～？但是我進京以來，素無人知，今日你來破例，恐將來纏繞不休。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十五回
exampleEn: Why must I toil for others? But since I entered the capital, no one has known me. Today you break the rule, fearing endless entanglements. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 95

explanation: 露显露。头上的角已明显地突出来了。指初显露优异的才能。
explanationTraditional: 露顯露。頭上的角已明顯地突出來了。指初顯露優異的才能。
explanationEn: To show one's horns; to reveal one's outstanding talent for the first time.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《柳子厚墓志铭》虽少年，已自成人，能取进士第，崭然见头角焉。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《柳子厚墓誌銘》雖少年，已自成人，能取進士第，嶄然見頭角焉。”
derivationEn: Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Liu Zihou': 'Though young, he had already become a man, passed the进士 exam, and prominently showed his horns.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指对人或对事物顷注了很深的感情，向往而不能克制。同一往情深”。
explanationTraditional: 指對人或對事物頃注了很深的感情，嚮往而不能剋制。同一往情深”。
explanationEn: To be deeply devoted to someone or something, unable to restrain one's longing; same as '一往情深'.
derivation: 明·汤显祖《〈牡丹亭记〉题词》情不知所起，一往而深，生者可以死，死者可以生。”
derivationTraditional: 明·湯顯祖《〈牡丹亭記〉題詞》情不知所起，一往而深，生者可以死，死者可以生。”
derivationEn: Tang Xianzu's preface to 'The Peony Pavilion': 'Love, without knowing where it starts, becomes deep and profound; the living can die, and the dead can live.'
example: 与知己交，绸缪缱绻，～，不以贫富易其念。★清·珠泉居士《雪鸿小记·补遗》
exampleTraditional: 與知己交，綢繆繾綣，～，不以貧富易其念。★清·珠泉居士《雪鴻小記·補遺》
exampleEn: In friendship with a confidant, he was deeply affectionate and devoted, not changing his feelings due to wealth or poverty. — Zhuquan Jushi, 'Xue Hong Xiao Ji: Supplement'

explanation: ①形容光滑润泽。②形容人的圆滑、狡诈。
explanationTraditional: ①形容光滑潤澤。②形容人的圓滑、狡詐。
explanationEn: ① Smooth and glossy. ② Describes a person who is slick and cunning.
derivation: 《儿女英雄传》第七回原来这顶柜子里面，中腰不安抽屉，下面也没榻板；那后面的背板一扇到底抹的油光水滑，像是常有人出入的样子。”
derivationTraditional: 《兒女英雄傳》第七回原來這頂櫃子裡面，中腰不安抽屜，下面也沒榻板；那後面的背板一扇到底抹的油光水滑，像是常有人出入的樣子。”
derivationEn: 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 7: 'The back panel of the cabinet was wiped smooth and glossy, as if often used for entry.'
example: 这东昌巡道衙门住扎临清；因临清是马头所在，有那班～的光棍，真是‘天高皇帝远’晓得怕些什么。★《醒世姻缘传》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 這東昌巡道衙門住紮臨清；因臨清是馬頭所在，有那班～的光棍，真是‘天高皇帝遠’曉得怕些什麼。★《醒世姻緣傳》第十二回
exampleEn: The Dongchang patrol office was stationed in Linqing; because Linqing was a port, there were many slick and cunning rogues, truly 'the sky is high and the emperor is far away,' knowing no fear. — 'The Story of a Marriage That Awakens the World', Chapter 12

explanation: 从我处掠取。
explanationTraditional: 從我處掠取。
explanationEn: To take or seize from me; to plunder at will.
derivation: 秦牧《拳头海岸》许多被目为可以予取予夺地得到财富的海岸，一处处都伸出了拳头来，变成了‘拳头海岸’。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《拳頭海岸》許多被目為可以予取予奪地得到財富的海岸，一處處都伸出了拳頭來，變成了‘拳頭海岸’。”
derivationEn: Qin Mu's 'Fist Coast': 'Many coasts that were seen as places to plunder wealth at will have stretched out fists, becoming 'fist coasts'.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 优美动听的音乐长久地回荡。形容悦耳的歌声或乐曲使人听了不能一下子忘掉。
explanationTraditional: 優美動聽的音樂長久地迴盪。形容悅耳的歌聲或樂曲使人聽了不能一下子忘掉。
explanationEn: The lingering sound of beautiful music; describes a song or melody that is unforgettable.
derivation: 《列子·汤问》昔韩娥东之齐，匮粮，过雍门，鬻歌假食，既去而余音绕梁，三日不绝，左右以其人弗去。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·湯問》昔韓娥東之齊，匱糧，過雍門，鬻歌假食，既去而餘音繞樑，三日不絕，左右以其人弗去。”
derivationEn: 'Liezi: Tang Wen': 'Once Han E went east to Qi, ran out of food, passed through Yongmen, sang for food, and after she left, the lingering sound circled the beams for three days, and the people thought she had not left.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容举动偷偷摸摸，不光明正大。
explanationTraditional: 形容舉動偷偷摸摸，不光明正大。
explanationEn: Behaving stealthily and furtively, not openly or honestly.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十四回他们大凡吃物，不肯大大方方，总是贼头贼脑，躲躲藏藏，背人而食。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十四回他們大凡吃物，不肯大大方方，總是賊頭賊腦，躲躲藏藏，揹人而食。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 14: 'Whenever they eat, they are never generous, always sneaky and hiding, eating behind others' backs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指竞相比美。
explanationTraditional: 指競相比美。
explanationEn: Vying for beauty; competing to show off one's charm.
derivation: 郭沫若《丁东草·石榴》五月过了，太阳增加了它的威力，树木都把各自的伞盖伸张了起来，不想再争妍斗艳的时候；有少数的树木却在这时开起了花来。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《丁東草·石榴》五月過了，太陽增加了它的威力，樹木都把各自的傘蓋伸張了起來，不想再爭妍鬥豔的時候；有少數的樹木卻在這時開起了花來。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'Pomegranate': 'After May, the sun intensifies its power, and trees stretch out their canopies, no longer wanting to compete in beauty; but a few trees begin to bloom at this time.'
example: 海滨公园内，热带的奇花异草，～。★雨海《马来西亚的新兴城市——歌打基纳巴卢》
exampleTraditional: 海濱公園內，熱帶的奇花異草，～。★雨海《馬來西亞的新興城市——歌打基納巴盧》
exampleEn: In the seaside park, tropical exotic flowers and plants vie for beauty. — Yu Hai, 'Malaysia's New City: Kota Kinabalu'

explanation: 把钱财看得跟生命一样重要。形容极端吝啬。
explanationTraditional: 把錢財看得跟生命一樣重要。形容極端吝嗇。
explanationEn: Loving money as much as life; extremely stingy.
derivation: 清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第四回我想近来世界，不管什么英雄，什么豪杰，都是爱财如命，何况吃官司的，少不免要和那些狼官鼠吏交手，这更没钱不行了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第四回我想近來世界，不管什麼英雄，什麼豪傑，都是愛財如命，何況吃官司的，少不免要和那些狼官鼠吏交手，這更沒錢不行了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Lingnan Yuyi Nushi's 'Eastern European Heroines', Chapter 4: 'I think in today's world, no matter what hero, they all love money as life, let alone those involved in lawsuits, who must deal with wolf-like officials and rat-like clerks, and without money, nothing works.'
example: 那个人极端自私，～。
exampleTraditional: 那個人極端自私，～。
exampleEn: That person is extremely selfish and loves money as life.

explanation: 死的讳称。
explanationTraditional: 死的諱稱。
explanationEn: A euphemism for death.
derivation: 《诗·唐风·葛生》百岁之后，归于其居。”《史记·李不韦列传》夫百岁之后，所子者为王，终不失势。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·唐風·葛生》百歲之後，歸於其居。”《史記·李不韋列傳》夫百歲之後，所子者為王，終不失勢。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs·Tang Feng·Ge Sheng': 'After a hundred years, return to his dwelling.' And 'Records of the Grand Historian·Biography of Lu Buwei': 'After a hundred years, the son you made king will not lose power.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指文章表达流畅，内容充足。
explanationTraditional: 指文章表達流暢，內容充足。
explanationEn: Describing writing that is fluent and full of content.
derivation: 秦牧《艺海拾贝·巨日》那些作品的作者在节骨眼上，没有真正做到笔酣墨饱，因此，便不能获得预期的作用了。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《藝海拾貝·巨日》那些作品的作者在節骨眼上，沒有真正做到筆酣墨飽，因此，便不能獲得預期的作用了。”
derivationEn: From Qin Mu's 'Gleaning in the Sea of Art·Giant Sun': 'The authors of those works did not truly achieve fluency and fullness at the critical point, thus failing to achieve the expected effect.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 兵将众多。形容军队人员多，兵力强大。
explanationTraditional: 兵將眾多。形容軍隊人員多，兵力強大。
explanationEn: Having many soldiers and generals; describing a large and powerful army.
derivation: 元·郑廷玉《楚昭公》第一折凭着俺这里兵多将广马壮人强，量吴国姬光到的那里，就怕着他哩？”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭廷玉《楚昭公》第一折憑著俺這裡兵多將廣馬壯人強，量吳國姬光到的那裡，就怕著他哩？”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zheng Tingyu's 'Chu Zhaogong', First Act: 'With our many soldiers, numerous generals, strong horses, and robust men, how can Wu's Ji Guang be a match? We need not fear him!'
example: 小人觑探梁山泊～，武艺高强，不可轻敌小觑。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第五十四回
exampleTraditional: 小人覷探梁山泊～，武藝高強，不可輕敵小覷。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第五十四回
exampleEn: The scout reported that Liangshanbo has many soldiers and generals, with high martial arts skills, and should not be underestimated. — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 54

explanation: 常不变；势形势。用兵无一成不变的形势。用以说明办事要因时、因地制宜，具体问题要用具体办法去解决。
explanationTraditional: 常不變；勢形勢。用兵無一成不變的形勢。用以說明辦事要因時、因地制宜，具體問題要用具體辦法去解決。
explanationEn: War has no constant form; it means that in doing things, one must adapt to circumstances and use specific methods for specific problems.
derivation: 《孙子·虚实》夫兵形象水，水之行，避高而趋下；兵之形，避实而击虚。水因地而制流，兵因敌而制胜。故兵无常势，水无常形，能因敌变化而取胜者，谓之神。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·虛實》夫兵形象水，水之行，避高而趨下；兵之形，避實而擊虛。水因地而制流，兵因敵而制勝。故兵無常勢，水無常形，能因敵變化而取勝者，謂之神。”
derivationEn: From 'Sun Tzu·Xu Shi': 'The military formation is like water; water avoids heights and flows downward. Military formation avoids strength and strikes weakness. Water adapts to the terrain to control its flow; troops adapt to the enemy to achieve victory. Therefore, war has no constant form, water has no constant shape; those who can adapt to the enemy and win are called divine.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指意外的祸患。
explanationTraditional: 指意外的禍患。
explanationEn: Refers to unexpected misfortune or disaster.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《田表圣奏议叙》自太平兴国以来，至于咸平，可谓天下大治，千载一时矣。而田公之言常若有不测之忧近在朝夕者，何哉？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《田表聖奏議敘》自太平興國以來，至於鹹平，可謂天下大治，千載一時矣。而田公之言常若有不測之憂近在朝夕者，何哉？”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Preface to Tian Biaosheng's Memorials': 'From the Taiping Xingguo era to the Xianping era, it can be said that the world was greatly peaceful, a rare moment in a thousand years. Yet Tian Gong's words often spoke of unexpected worries imminent day and night—why?'
example: 郎君若自恃其勇，好杀不已，将来必犯天道之忌，难免～矣。★《醒世恒言·大树坡义虎送亲》
exampleTraditional: 郎君若自恃其勇，好殺不已，將來必犯天道之忌，難免～矣。★《醒世恆言·大樹坡義虎送親》
exampleEn: If you, young sir, rely on your bravery and kill without restraint, you will surely violate the way of heaven and inevitably face unexpected worries. — 'Stories to Awaken the World·The Tiger Sends Off the Bride at Dapo'

explanation: 揣估量，考虑。用于没有慎重考虑就轻率行事的客气话。
explanationTraditional: 揣估量，考慮。用於沒有慎重考慮就輕率行事的客氣話。
explanationEn: A polite expression used when acting without careful consideration; meaning 'to take the liberty'.
derivation: 晋·郭璞《〈尔雅〉序》璞不揆梼昧，少而勿焉。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·郭璞《〈爾雅〉序》璞不揆檮昧，少而勿焉。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Guo Pu's 'Preface to Erya': 'I, Pu, without measuring my ignorance, have studied it since youth.'
example: 又看到日本学界也每每用汉文出书，我真是～，竟想把我的论著也拿去尝试。★郭沫若《海涛集·我是中国人》
exampleTraditional: 又看到日本學界也每每用漢文出書，我真是～，竟想把我的論著也拿去嘗試。★郭沫若《海濤集·我是中國人》
exampleEn: Seeing that Japanese academia often publishes books in Chinese, I took the liberty of trying to submit my treatise as well. — Guo Moruo, 'Sea Tides·I Am Chinese'

explanation: 置安放。不容许别人进行辩解。指没有辩护的余地。
explanationTraditional: 置安放。不容許別人進行辯解。指沒有辯護的餘地。
explanationEn: Not allowing others to argue or defend; leaving no room for debate.
derivation: 清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·三生》吾合休矣。既而俘者尽释，惟某后至，不容置辩，立斩之。”
derivationTraditional: 清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·三生》吾合休矣。既而俘者盡釋，惟某後至，不容置辯，立斬之。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Pu Songling's 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio·Three Lives': 'I am finished. Then all captives were released, only one arrived late, and without allowing any defense, he was immediately beheaded.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 极为公正，不偏不倚。
explanationTraditional: 極為公正，不偏不倚。
explanationEn: Extremely fair and impartial, without bias.
derivation: 明·王守仁《传习录》上卷不知先生居夷三载，处困养静，精一之功，固已超入圣城，粹然大中至正之归矣。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王守仁《傳習錄》上卷不知先生居夷三載，處困養靜，精一之功，固已超入聖城，粹然大中至正之歸矣。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shouren's 'Instructions for Practical Living' in the Ming Dynasty: '...already transcended into sagehood, purely returning to the state of great fairness and perfect correctness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容走路不稳。比喻容易动摇、不坚定。
explanationTraditional: 形容走路不穩。比喻容易動搖、不堅定。
explanationEn: Describes unsteady walking; metaphorically refers to being easily swayed or lacking firmness.
derivation: 毛泽东《关于农业合作化问题》一我们的某些同志却象一个小脚女人，东摇西摆地在那里走路，老是埋怨旁人说走快了，走快了。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《關於農業合作化問題》一我們的某些同志卻象一個小腳女人，東搖西擺地在那裡走路，老是埋怨旁人說走快了，走快了。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'On the Question of Agricultural Cooperation': 'Some of our comrades are like a woman with bound feet, staggering east and west, always complaining that others are walking too fast.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 无所事事，到处闲诳。
explanationTraditional: 無所事事，到處閒誑。
explanationEn: To wander around idly with nothing to do.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》六回他因没事干管理，东游西荡，朕又恐别生事端，着他代管蟠桃园。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》六回他因沒事幹管理，東遊西蕩，朕又恐別生事端，著他代管蟠桃園。”
derivationEn: From Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 6: 'Having nothing to manage, he wandered east and west; I feared he might cause trouble, so I put him in charge of the Peach Garden.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指行动自由，没有阻碍。又指作文用字独具一格，后指单独往来。
explanationTraditional: 指行動自由，沒有阻礙。又指作文用字獨具一格，後指單獨往來。
explanationEn: To act freely without hindrance; also refers to unique style in writing; later means to come and go alone.
derivation: 《庄子·在宥》出入六合，游乎九州，独往独来，是谓独有。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·在宥》出入六合，遊乎九州，獨往獨來，是謂獨有。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: Zaiyou': 'Moving through the six directions, roaming the nine continents, coming and going alone—this is called being unique.'
example: 破八家藩篱，而自成一～文字。★清·平步青《霞外捃屑·顾黄公春秋论》
exampleTraditional: 破八家藩籬，而自成一～文字。★清·平步青《霞外捃屑·顧黃公春秋論》
exampleEn: Breaking through the barriers of the Eight Great Prose Masters, he created a unique style of his own. (From Qing Dynasty Ping Buqing's 'Xiawai Junzhi: Gu Huanggong's Spring and Autumn Commentary')

explanation: 用脚跺地，以拳捶胸。形容极度悲痛或恼怒，到了极点。
explanationTraditional: 用腳跺地，以拳捶胸。形容極度悲痛或惱怒，到了極點。
explanationEn: To stamp one's feet and beat one's chest, expressing extreme grief or anger.
derivation: 元·无名氏《白兔记》第十四折他那里醉朦胧语言都不省，只获得顿足捶胸也，短叹长吁千万声。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《白兔記》第十四折他那裡醉朦朧語言都不省，只獲得頓足捶胸也，短嘆長吁千萬聲。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty anonymous 'The Story of the White Rabbit', Act 14: 'He was so drunk that he didn't understand a word, only stamping his feet and beating his chest, sighing deeply.'
example: 只见杨子哀号哽咽，～，抚棺长恨，欲拔剑自刎。★明·吴元泰《东游记》第七回
exampleTraditional: 只見楊子哀號哽咽，～，撫棺長恨，欲拔劍自刎。★明·吳元泰《東遊記》第七回
exampleEn: Yangzi wailed bitterly, stamping his feet and beating his chest, grieving by the coffin, and wanted to draw his sword to kill himself. (From Ming Dynasty Wu Yuantai's 'Journey to the East', Chapter 7)

explanation: 恩恩惠；怨仇恨。对于恩惠和仇恨的界限分得十分清楚，毫不含糊。
explanationTraditional: 恩恩惠；怨仇恨。對於恩惠和仇恨的界限分得十分清楚，毫不含糊。
explanationEn: To clearly distinguish between kindness and resentment, without ambiguity.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第五十回某素知云长傲上而不忍下，欺强而不凌弱；恩怨分明，信义素著。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第五十回某素知雲長傲上而不忍下，欺強而不凌弱；恩怨分明，信義素著。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 50: 'I have always known that Yun Chang is proud to superiors but tolerant to inferiors, bullies the strong but not the weak; he clearly distinguishes kindness and resentment, and is known for his integrity.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 因眼前事物而引起对往事的追思。同抚今悼昔”。
explanationTraditional: 因眼前事物而引起對往事的追思。同撫今悼昔”。
explanationEn: To recall past events triggered by present circumstances.
derivation: 秦牧《长街灯语一九七九年的晨钟》抚今思昔，心头掀起了思想的浪花。”
derivationTraditional: 秦牧《長街燈語一九七九年的晨鐘》撫今思昔，心頭掀起了思想的浪花。”
derivationEn: From Qin Mu's 'Long Street Lights: The Morning Bell of 1979': 'Recalling the past while contemplating the present, waves of thoughts surged in my heart.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻没有做亏心事，并不感到惭愧。
explanationTraditional: 比喻沒有做虧心事，並不感到慚愧。
explanationEn: To have a clear conscience, having done nothing shameful.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》仰不愧于天，俯不愧于人。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》仰不愧於天，俯不愧於人。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jinxin I': 'Looking up, I am not ashamed before Heaven; looking down, I am not ashamed before men.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 骨肉指父母兄弟子女等亲人。比喻亲人分散，不能团聚。
explanationTraditional: 骨肉指父母兄弟子女等親人。比喻親人分散，不能團聚。
explanationEn: Refers to the separation of close family members, unable to reunite.
derivation: 《诗经·唐风·杕杜》小序《杕杜》刺时也。君不能亲其宗族，骨肉离散，独居而无兄弟，将为沃所并尔。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·唐風·杕杜》小序《杕杜》刺時也。君不能親其宗族，骨肉離散，獨居而無兄弟，將為沃所並爾。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Tang Feng: Dì Dù' preface: 'The poem satirizes the times. The ruler cannot be close to his clan, causing family members to scatter, living alone without brothers, about to be annexed by Wo.'
example: 冲风夺佳气”，～也。★清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷八
exampleTraditional: 衝風奪佳氣”，～也。★清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷八
exampleEn: The strong wind seizes the good aura, causing the separation of family members. (From Qing Dynasty anonymous 'Du Shi Yan Zhi', Volume 8)

explanation: 春秋时，齐人管仲和鲍叔牙相知最深◇常比喻交情深厚的朋友。
explanationTraditional: 春秋時，齊人管仲和鮑叔牙相知最深◇常比喻交情深厚的朋友。
explanationEn: Refers to a deep friendship, like that between Guan Zhong and Bao Shuya in the Spring and Autumn period.
derivation: 《列子·力命》生我者也，知我者鲍叔也。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·力命》生我者也，知我者鮑叔也。”
derivationEn: From 'Liezi: Liming': 'The one who gave me life are my parents; the one who knows me is Bao Shuya.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 和、同混合⊥光混合各种光彩；同尘与尘俗相同。指不露锋芒，与世无争的消极处世态度。也比喻同流合污。
explanationTraditional: 和、同混合⊥光混合各種光彩；同塵與塵俗相同。指不露鋒芒，與世無爭的消極處世態度。也比喻同流合汙。
explanationEn: To blend in with the world and not stand out; to adopt a passive, non-confrontational attitude towards life; also implies going along with the crowd or compromising one's principles.
derivation: 《老子》第四章和其光，同其尘。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第四章和其光，同其塵。”
derivationEn: From Laozi, Chapter 4: 'Harmonize with the light, mingle with the dust.'
example: 休要欺三瞒四，我赵某不是与你～的。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷二十一
exampleTraditional: 休要欺三瞞四，我趙某不是與你～的。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷二十一
exampleEn: Don't deceive me; I, Zhao, am not one to blend in with the world like you. — Ming Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Warn the World', Chapter 21

explanation: 为夸张或渲染的需要，在叙事或说话时增添原来没有的内容。同加油加醋”。
explanationTraditional: 為誇張或渲染的需要，在敘事或說話時增添原來沒有的內容。同加油加醋”。
explanationEn: To add extra details or exaggerate when narrating or speaking, for the sake of emphasis or sensationalism.
derivation: 克非《春潮急》二六有种人并不怀着什么恶意，却专喜欢探究人家的隐秘，然后再加油添醋，偷偷地、热衷地广播出去。”
derivationTraditional: 克非《春潮急》二六有種人並不懷著什麼惡意，卻專喜歡探究人家的隱秘，然後再加油添醋，偷偷地、熱衷地廣播出去。”
derivationEn: From Ke Fei's 'Spring Tide Rushes' (26): 'Some people, without malicious intent, enjoy prying into others' secrets and then add fuel to the fire, broadcasting them secretly and enthusiastically.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 浪迹到处流浪；江湖泛指各地。到处漂泊，没有固定的住处。
explanationTraditional: 浪跡到處流浪；江湖泛指各地。到處漂泊，沒有固定的住處。
explanationEn: To wander from place to place without a fixed home; to drift around the world.
derivation: 宋·张君房《云笈七签》卷一百十三某不能甘于寒苦，且浪迹江湖。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》卷一百十三某不能甘於寒苦，且浪跡江湖。”
derivationEn: From Song Zhang Junfang's 'Yunji Qiqian' (Volume 113): 'I cannot endure poverty and cold, so I wander the rivers and lakes.'
example: 一时未际，～。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十一
exampleTraditional: 一時未際，～。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十一
exampleEn: For a time, he was unrecognized and wandered the rivers and lakes. — Ming Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Surprise', Volume 11

explanation: 多用作自称衰老之语。
explanationTraditional: 多用作自稱衰老之語。
explanationEn: Often used as a self-deprecating expression referring to one's own aging.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《谢胡参政启》少不如人，所向墙壁；老之将至，乃羐网罗。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《謝胡參政啟》少不如人，所向牆壁；老之將至，乃羐網羅。”
derivationEn: From Song Chen Liang's 'Xie Hu Canzheng Qi': 'When young, I was inferior to others and faced walls; now old age is approaching, and I am caught in a net.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 快乐而不过分。指表现的情感有节制。
explanationTraditional: 快樂而不過分。指表現的情感有節制。
explanationEn: Joyful but not excessive; expressing emotions with restraint.
derivation: 《论语·八佾》《关雎》乐而不淫，哀而不伤。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·八佾》《關雎》樂而不淫，哀而不傷。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects', 'Eight Rows': 'The Guan Ju is joyful but not licentious, sorrowful but not hurtful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 会的人就当老师。即谁会就向谁学习。
explanationTraditional: 會的人就當老師。即誰會就向誰學習。
explanationEn: Whoever is capable can be the teacher; learn from whoever knows how.
derivation: 《礼记·学记》能博喻，然后能为师。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·學記》能博喻，然後能為師。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites', 'Record on the Subject of Education': 'One who can expound widely can then be a teacher.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻人长得高大强壮。
explanationTraditional: 比喻人長得高大強壯。
explanationEn: Describes a person who is tall and strong.
derivation: 《小说月报》1981年第1期东宁县县委书记刘番成长得浓眉大眼，牛高马大。”
derivationTraditional: 《小說月報》1981年第1期東寧縣縣委書記劉番成長得濃眉大眼，牛高馬大。”
derivationEn: From 'Fiction Monthly' (1981, Issue 1): 'Liu Fancheng, the county party secretary of Dongning County, had thick eyebrows and big eyes, and was as tall and strong as an ox or horse.'
example: 三人中那位五十来岁，～、脸色黧黑的壮年人，抬头看见方爱华的小轿车。★牧夫《相思豆》一
exampleTraditional: 三人中那位五十來歲，～、臉色黧黑的壯年人，抬頭看見方愛華的小轎車。★牧夫《相思豆》一
exampleEn: Among the three, the fifty-something, tall and strong, dark-faced man looked up and saw Fang Aihua's car. — Mu Fu, 'Acacia Beans', Part 1

explanation: 形容陷入无路可走的困境。
explanationTraditional: 形容陷入無路可走的困境。
explanationEn: Describes being in a hopeless situation with no way out.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 发财的门路。
explanationTraditional: 發財的門路。
explanationEn: A way to make money; a method of getting rich.
derivation: 《礼记·大学》生财有大道生之者众，食之者寡，为之者疾，用之者舒，则财恒足矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·大學》生財有大道生之者眾，食之者寡，為之者疾，用之者舒，則財恆足矣。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites', 'The Great Learning': 'There is a great way to generate wealth: let the producers be many and the consumers few, let the workers be diligent and the users frugal, then wealth will always be sufficient.'
example: 只是我一个女孩儿家，除了针绣女工，哪是我的～。（清·文康《儿女英雄传》第八回）
exampleTraditional: 只是我一個女孩兒家，除了針繡女工，哪是我的～。（清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第八回）
exampleEn: But as a girl, besides needlework and embroidery, what way do I have to make money? — Qing Wenkang, 'The Story of Heroes', Chapter 8

explanation: 债欠多了反而不忧愁。比喻困难成堆，认为反正一时解除不了，也就不去愁它了。
explanationTraditional: 債欠多了反而不憂愁。比喻困難成堆，認為反正一時解除不了，也就不去愁它了。
explanationEn: When debts pile up, one stops worrying; when difficulties accumulate, one becomes numb to them.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把死去看做活着一样。形容不怕死。同视死若生”。
explanationTraditional: 把死去看做活著一樣。形容不怕死。同視死若生”。
explanationEn: To regard death as if it were life; describes fearlessness in the face of death.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 立誓宁死也不屈服。
explanationTraditional: 立誓寧死也不屈服。
explanationEn: To swear to die rather than yield; describes unyielding determination.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 说东家，讲西家。形容没有中心地随意说。
explanationTraditional: 說東家，講西家。形容沒有中心地隨意說。
explanationEn: To talk about this and that; to chat aimlessly without a central topic.
derivation: 宋·释惟白《续传灯录》卷二十那堪长老鼓两片皮，摇三寸舌，说东道西，指南言北。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋惟白《續傳燈錄》卷二十那堪長老鼓兩片皮，搖三寸舌，說東道西，指南言北。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Shi Weibai's 'Continued Transmission of the Lamp', Volume 20: 'That old monk beats his two skins, shakes his three-inch tongue, talks east and west, points south and north.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻两者相差极大。
explanationTraditional: 比喻兩者相差極大。
explanationEn: As different as heaven and earth; describes a vast difference.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第五十七回余小琴一想他是制台的少爷，有财有势，我的老人家虽说也是个监司职分，然而比起来，已天差地远了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第五十七回餘小琴一想他是制臺的少爺，有財有勢，我的老人家雖說也是個監司職分，然而比起來，已天差地遠了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 57: 'Yu Xiaoqin thought: he is the governor's son, wealthy and powerful; although my father is also an official, compared to him, it is as different as heaven and earth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指古代神话传说巫山神女兴云降雨的事◇称男女欢合。
explanationTraditional: 原指古代神話傳說巫山神女興雲降雨的事◇稱男女歡合。
explanationEn: Originally refers to the mythical goddess of Mount Wu who summoned clouds and rain; later used to describe sexual intercourse between a man and a woman.
derivation: 战国楚·宋玉《高唐赋序》妾在巫山之阳，高丘之阻。旦为朝云，暮为行雨，朝朝暮暮，阳台之下。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國楚·宋玉《高唐賦序》妾在巫山之陽，高丘之阻。旦為朝雲，暮為行雨，朝朝暮暮，陽臺之下。”
derivationEn: From Warring States period, Chu, Song Yu's 'Rhapsody on Gaotang': 'The goddess lives on the sunny side of Mount Wu, at the high hill. In the morning she becomes a cloud, in the evening she becomes rain, morning and evening, under the balcony.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 薪柴。柴虽烧尽，火种仍留传。比喻师父传业于弟子，一代代地传下去。
explanationTraditional: 薪柴。柴雖燒盡，火種仍留傳。比喻師父傳業於弟子，一代代地傳下去。
explanationEn: When the firewood is consumed, the fire continues; metaphor for the transmission of knowledge or skills from master to disciple, generation after generation.
derivation: 《庄子·养生主》指穷于为薪，火传也，不知其尽也。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·養生主》指窮於為薪，火傳也，不知其盡也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi: The Secret of Caring for Life': 'The firewood is exhausted, but the fire is transmitted, and one does not know its end.'
example: 风流云散，贤豪才色总成空；～，工匠市廛都有韵。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第五十四回
exampleTraditional: 風流雲散，賢豪才色總成空；～，工匠市廛都有韻。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第五十四回
exampleEn: The talented and beautiful have all vanished like wind and clouds; but the transmission of skills from master to disciple continues, even among artisans and merchants. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 54

explanation: 言这里指法令或命令；法法律。话一说出口，法律就跟在后面。指法令一经公布就严格执行，如有违犯就依法处理。
explanationTraditional: 言這裡指法令或命令；法法律。話一說出口，法律就跟在後面。指法令一經公佈就嚴格執行，如有違犯就依法處理。
explanationEn: Once a law or order is announced, it is strictly enforced; any violation is dealt with according to the law.
derivation: 毛泽东《陕甘宁边区政府、第八路军后方留守处布告》倘有不法之徒，胆敢阴谋捣乱，本府本处言出法随，勿谓言之不预。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《陝甘寧邊區政府、第八路軍後方留守處佈告》倘有不法之徒，膽敢陰謀搗亂，本府本處言出法隨，勿謂言之不預。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Proclamation of the Shaan-Gan-Ning Border Region Government and the Eighth Route Army Rear Office': 'If any lawless person dares to plot sabotage, this government and office will enforce the law as soon as the words are spoken; do not say we did not warn you.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不同寻常的香味扑鼻而来。
explanationTraditional: 不同尋常的香味撲鼻而來。
explanationEn: An unusual fragrance assails the nostrils.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 再造再生。象救了自己性命那样大的恩德。
explanationTraditional: 再造再生。象救了自己性命那樣大的恩德。
explanationEn: The grace of giving a second life; describes a great kindness that saves one's life.
derivation: 《宋书·王僧达传》再造之恩，不可妄属。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·王僧達傳》再造之恩，不可妄屬。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Song: Biography of Wang Sengda': 'The grace of rebirth should not be casually bestowed.'
example: ～，恨无所报。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·西湖主》
exampleTraditional: ～，恨無所報。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·西湖主》
exampleEn: I am grateful for your grace of rebirth, but have no way to repay it. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: The West Lake Lord'

explanation: 安安详，不慌忙；安步缓缓步行。以从容的步行代替乘车。
explanationTraditional: 安安詳，不慌忙；安步緩緩步行。以從容的步行代替乘車。
explanationEn: To walk leisurely instead of riding in a carriage; to be content with a simple life.
derivation: 《战国策·齐策四》晚食以当肉，安步以当车，无罪以当贵，清静贞正以自虞。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·齊策四》晚食以當肉，安步以當車，無罪以當貴，清靜貞正以自虞。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Qi Strategy IV': 'Eat late and consider it meat; walk leisurely and consider it a carriage; be innocent and consider it noble; be pure and upright to enjoy oneself.'
example: 每日到局只要把照例的公事办完，立刻回公馆吃饭，一到下午，便一个人～，出门逍遥自在去了。★清·李宝嘉《中国现在记》第七回
exampleTraditional: 每日到局只要把照例的公事辦完，立刻回公館吃飯，一到下午，便一個人～，出門逍遙自在去了。★清·李寶嘉《中國現在記》第七回
exampleEn: Every day he went to the office, finished the routine work, returned home for lunch, and in the afternoon, he would walk leisurely instead of riding, going out to enjoy himself freely. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Present Situation of China', Chapter 7

explanation: 来客多得如聚集的云层。形容客人多。
explanationTraditional: 來客多得如聚集的雲層。形容客人多。
explanationEn: Guests are as numerous as clouds. Describes a large number of guests.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》卷二十九又制下布衣一袭，每逢月朔月望，卸下铅华，穿着布素，闭门念佛；虽宾客如云，此日断不接见，以此为常。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》卷二十九又制下布衣一襲，每逢月朔月望，卸下鉛華，穿著布素，閉門唸佛；雖賓客如雲，此日斷不接見，以此為常。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 29: '...although guests were as numerous as clouds, on that day she absolutely would not receive them.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧指学生恭敬受教。比喻尊师。
explanationTraditional: 舊指學生恭敬受教。比喻尊師。
explanationEn: Refers to a student respectfully receiving instruction. A metaphor for respecting one's teacher.
derivation: 《宋史·杨时传》见程颐于洛，时盖年四十矣。一日见颐，颐偶瞑坐，时与游酢侍立不云。颐既觉，则门外雪深一尺矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·楊時傳》見程頤於洛，時蓋年四十矣。一日見頤，頤偶瞑坐，時與遊酢侍立不雲。頤既覺，則門外雪深一尺矣。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Yang Shi': 'When Yang Shi went to see Cheng Yi in Luoyang, he was forty years old. One day, he found Cheng Yi dozing off, so Yang Shi and You Zuo stood waiting without leaving. When Cheng Yi woke up, the snow outside the door was already a foot deep.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 传说杜鹃昼夜悲鸣，啼至血出乃止。常用以形容哀痛之极。
explanationTraditional: 傳說杜鵑晝夜悲鳴，啼至血出乃止。常用以形容哀痛之極。
explanationEn: Legend says the cuckoo cries day and night until it spits blood. Often used to describe extreme sorrow.
derivation: 唐·白居易《琵琶行》其间旦暮闻何物？杜鹃啼血猿哀鸣。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《琵琶行》其間旦暮聞何物？杜鵑啼血猿哀鳴。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi's 'Song of the Pipa': 'What do I hear at dawn and dusk? The cuckoo's cry, the ape's mournful wail.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 针对病根下的药。比喻纠正缺点错误所用的相应办法。
explanationTraditional: 針對病根下的藥。比喻糾正缺點錯誤所用的相應辦法。
explanationEn: Medicine that targets the root cause of an illness. Metaphor for appropriate measures to correct errors or shortcomings.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·华陀传》府吏倪寻、李延共止，俱头痛身热，所苦正同。佗曰‘寻当下之，延当发汗。’或难其异，佗曰‘寻外实，延内实，故治之宜殊。’即各与药，明旦并起。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·華陀傳》府吏倪尋、李延共止，俱頭痛身熱，所苦正同。佗曰‘尋當下之，延當發汗。’或難其異，佗曰‘尋外實，延內實，故治之宜殊。’即各與藥，明旦並起。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Hua Tuo': 'Two officials, Ni Xun and Li Yan, both had headaches and fevers. Hua Tuo said, 'Ni needs purging, Li needs sweating.' When asked why, he explained their conditions differed, gave them different medicines, and both recovered the next day.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象饥饿的老虎扑向食物一样。比喻动作猛烈而迅速。
explanationTraditional: 象飢餓的老虎撲向食物一樣。比喻動作猛烈而迅速。
explanationEn: Like a hungry tiger pouncing on its prey. Describes a swift and fierce action.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第五十一回饿虎扑食最伤人，蛟龙戏水能凶恶。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第五十一回餓虎撲食最傷人，蛟龍戲水能兇惡。”
derivationEn: From Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 51: 'A hungry tiger pouncing on its prey is most harmful; a dragon playing in the water can be fierce.'
example: 那人刚到面前，便如～，猫儿捕鼠的一般，抱住叫道亲嫂子，等死我了。”★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 那人剛到面前，便如～，貓兒捕鼠的一般，抱住叫道親嫂子，等死我了。”★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十二回
exampleEn: The man had just arrived when, like a hungry tiger pouncing on its prey or a cat catching a mouse, he hugged her and said, 'Dear sister-in-law, I'm dying of longing!' — from Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 12.

explanation: 风土山川风俗、气候等的总称；人情人的性情、习惯。一个地方特有的自然环境和风俗、礼节、习惯的总称。
explanationTraditional: 風土山川風俗、氣候等的總稱；人情人的性情、習慣。一個地方特有的自然環境和風俗、禮節、習慣的總稱。
explanationEn: Local natural environment, customs, and habits. The unique natural and cultural characteristics of a place.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十四回又问了问褚一官走了几省，说了些那省的风土人情，论了些那省的山川形胜。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十四回又問了問褚一官走了幾省，說了些那省的風土人情，論了些那省的山川形勝。”
derivationEn: From Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 14: 'He also asked about the provinces he had visited, discussing the local customs and the geography of those regions.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 亲人间相互残杀。比喻自相残杀。
explanationTraditional: 親人間相互殘殺。比喻自相殘殺。
explanationEn: Fighting among close relatives. Metaphor for internal conflict.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·政事》仲弓曰‘盗杀财主，何如骨肉相残？’”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·政事》仲弓曰‘盜殺財主，何如骨肉相殘？’”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'Zhonggong said, 'A thief killing a rich man—how is that like flesh and blood fighting each other?''
example: 家门不幸，～，诚有愧于邻国。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第五回
exampleTraditional: 家門不幸，～，誠有愧於鄰國。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第五回
exampleEn: Our family is unfortunate, with flesh and blood fighting each other, truly shameful before neighboring states. — from Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 5.

explanation: 咀细嚼，引伸为体味；英、华这里指精华。比喻读书吸取其精华。
explanationTraditional: 咀細嚼，引伸為體味；英、華這裡指精華。比喻讀書吸取其精華。
explanationEn: To savor the essence of literature. Metaphor for absorbing the best parts of reading.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《进学解》沈浸浓郁，含英咀华。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《進學解》沈浸濃郁，含英咀華。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'On Advancing Learning': 'Immersed in rich and profound works, savoring the essence and tasting the flower.'
example: ～，早预蓬莱道山之选。★宋·陆游《答建宁陈通判启》
exampleTraditional: ～，早預蓬萊道山之選。★宋·陸游《答建寧陳通判啟》
exampleEn: Savoring the essence, early selected for the Penglai immortal academy. — from Lu You's 'Reply to Chen Tongpan's Letter'.

explanation: 好喜欢；善亲善，善事；乐乐意；施施舍。指喜欢做善事，乐意施舍。
explanationTraditional: 好喜歡；善親善，善事；樂樂意；施施捨。指喜歡做善事，樂意施捨。
explanationEn: To delight in doing good and being charitable. Describes a person who enjoys helping others.
derivation: 西汉·司马迁《史记·乐书二》闻徽音，使人乐善而好施；闻羽音，使人整齐而好礼。”
derivationTraditional: 西漢·司馬遷《史記·樂書二》聞徽音，使人樂善而好施；聞羽音，使人整齊而好禮。”
derivationEn: From Sima Qian's 'Records of the Grand Historian: Book of Music': 'Hearing the zhi note makes one joyful and fond of giving; hearing the yu note makes one orderly and respectful.'
example: 夫妻两口，为了疏财仗义，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇·张员外又抚螟蛉子》
exampleTraditional: 夫妻兩口，為了疏財仗義，～。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇·張員外又撫螟蛉子》
exampleEn: The couple, generous and charitable, delighted in doing good and giving alms. — from Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement, Part One'.

explanation: 老调子重弹。比喻把老的一套又重新搬出来。
explanationTraditional: 老調子重彈。比喻把老的一套又重新搬出來。
explanationEn: To play the same old tune again. Metaphor for bringing up old ideas or arguments.
derivation: 朱自清《回来杂记》北平早就被称为‘大学城’和‘文化城’，这原是旧调重弹，不过似乎弹得更响了。”
derivationTraditional: 朱自清《回來雜記》北平早就被稱為‘大學城’和‘文化城’，這原是舊調重彈，不過似乎彈得更響了。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Ziqing's 'Miscellaneous Notes on Returning': 'Beijing has long been called a 'university city' and 'cultural city'; this is an old tune replayed, but it seems to be played louder.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指动作或说话来回不断地重复。
explanationTraditional: 指動作或說話來回不斷地重複。
explanationEn: To repeat actions or words back and forth continuously.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 可追可以补救。过去的事已无法挽回，但是未来的事还来得及赶上。
explanationTraditional: 可追可以補救。過去的事已無法挽回，但是未來的事還來得及趕上。
explanationEn: The past cannot be undone, but the future can still be caught up with; it's never too late to mend.
derivation: 《论语·微子》往者不可谏，来者犹可追。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·微子》往者不可諫，來者猶可追。”
derivationEn: From The Analects of Confucius, 'Weizi': 'The past cannot be remonstrated, but the future can still be pursued.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 炼用加热的方法使物质纯净或坚韧。古神话，相传天缺西北，女娲炼五色石补之。比喻施展才能和手段，弥补国家以及政治上的失误。
explanationTraditional: 煉用加熱的方法使物質純淨或堅韌。古神話，相傳天缺西北，女媧煉五色石補之。比喻施展才能和手段，彌補國家以及政治上的失誤。
explanationEn: To refine stones to mend the sky; metaphorically, to use one's abilities to remedy national or political mistakes.
derivation: 汉·刘安《淮南子·览冥训》往古之时，四极废，九州裂，天下兼覆，地不周载……于是女娲练五色石以补苍天。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉安《淮南子·覽冥訓》往古之時，四極廢，九州裂，天下兼覆，地不周載……於是女媧練五色石以補蒼天。”
derivationEn: From Huainanzi, 'Lanmingxun' by Liu An (Han Dynasty): 'In ancient times, the four poles collapsed... so Nüwa refined five-colored stones to mend the azure sky.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻满布得没有空隙。
explanationTraditional: 比喻滿布得沒有空隙。
explanationEn: Densely packed with no gaps.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第六回见那天罗地网，密密层层，各营门提铃喝号，将那山围绕的水泄不通。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第六回見那天羅地網，密密層層，各營門提鈴喝號，將那山圍繞的水洩不通。”
derivationEn: From Journey to the West, Chapter 6 by Wu Cheng'en (Ming Dynasty): 'Seeing the nets of heaven and earth, densely packed, with sentries shouting around the mountain, leaving no gap.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一般人通常有的感情。
explanationTraditional: 一般人通常有的感情。
explanationEn: Common feelings that most people have.
derivation: 南朝·粱·江淹《杂体诗三十八首·序》又贵远贱近，人心向背；重耳轻目，俗之恒弊。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·粱·江淹《雜體詩三十八首·序》又貴遠賤近，人心向背；重耳輕目，俗之恆弊。”
derivationEn: From 'Miscellaneous Poems' by Jiang Yan (Southern Dynasties): 'Moreover, valuing the distant and despising the near is the common inclination of people.'
example: 慕富贵者，～也。★明·赵弼《赵氏伯仲友义传》
exampleTraditional: 慕富貴者，～也。★明·趙弼《趙氏伯仲友義傳》
exampleEn: To admire wealth and status is a common human feeling. — Zhao Bi, Ming Dynasty

explanation: 极短暂的时间内。
explanationTraditional: 極短暫的時間內。
explanationEn: In an extremely short moment.
derivation: 《北史·魏世祖太武帝本纪》雅长听察，瞬息之间，下无以措其奸隐。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·魏世祖太武帝本紀》雅長聽察，瞬息之間，下無以措其奸隱。”
derivationEn: From History of the Northern Dynasties, 'Biography of Emperor Taiwu of Wei': 'He was skilled at listening and observing; in a flash, his subordinates could not hide their deceit.'
example: 且说刘有才那日哄了女婿上岸，拨转船头，顺风而下，～，已行百里。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷二十二
exampleTraditional: 且說劉有才那日哄了女婿上岸，撥轉船頭，順風而下，～，已行百里。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷二十二
exampleEn: That day, Liu Youcai tricked his son-in-law ashore, turned the boat, and with the wind, in an instant, they had traveled a hundred miles. — Feng Menglong, Ming Dynasty

explanation: 看当时实际情况，灵活办事。
explanationTraditional: 看當時實際情況，靈活辦事。
explanationEn: To act according to the actual situation; to handle matters flexibly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这事到时你相机行事，酌情处理吧。
exampleTraditional: 這事到時你相機行事，酌情處理吧。
exampleEn: Handle this matter by acting according to circumstances.

explanation: 耍嘴皮，嚼舌头。形容耍弄嘴皮进行挑拨煽动。
explanationTraditional: 耍嘴皮，嚼舌頭。形容耍弄嘴皮進行挑撥煽動。
explanationEn: To wag one's tongue; to stir up trouble or incite others with eloquent speech.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》多辞缪说，不耕而食，不织而衣，摇唇鼓舌，擅生是非，以迷天下之主。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》多辭繆說，不耕而食，不織而衣，搖唇鼓舌，擅生是非，以迷天下之主。”
derivationEn: From Zhuangzi, 'Robber Zhi': 'Using many words and false arguments, not farming but eating, not weaving but clothing, wagging tongues to create disputes and confuse the world's rulers.'
example: 我正在这里指授进兵的方略，胆敢～，煽惑军心！★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 我正在這裡指授進兵的方略，膽敢～，煽惑軍心！★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十四回
exampleEn: I am here instructing the strategy for advancing troops, and you dare to wag your tongue and incite the army! — Li Baojia, Qing Dynasty

explanation: 把敌人引进来，使它处于孤立而又不易逃跑的不利地位。
explanationTraditional: 把敵人引進來，使它處於孤立而又不易逃跑的不利地位。
explanationEn: To lure the enemy deep into one's territory, putting them in an isolated and disadvantageous position.
derivation: 毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》第五章第三节如果说诱敌深入在以前是有用的，那末在堡垒主义的第五次‘围剿’是无用的。对付第五次‘围剿’，只能用分兵抵御和短促突击的方法。”
derivationTraditional: 毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》第五章第三節如果說誘敵深入在以前是有用的，那末在堡壘主義的第五次‘圍剿’是無用的。對付第五次‘圍剿’，只能用分兵抵禦和短促突擊的方法。”
derivationEn: From Mao Zedong's 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War': 'If luring the enemy in deep was useful before, it is useless in the fifth 'encirclement' with fortress tactics.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伏躲藏；行赶路。白天躲藏，夜间赶路。指为避免被敌人发现所采取的秘密活动。
explanationTraditional: 伏躲藏；行趕路。白天躲藏，夜間趕路。指為避免被敵人發現所採取的秘密活動。
explanationEn: To hide during the day and travel at night; secret activities to avoid detection.
derivation: 西汉·刘向《战国策·秦策》伍子胥橐载而出昭关，夜行而昼伏，至于蓤夫。”
derivationTraditional: 西漢·劉向《戰國策·秦策》伍子胥橐載而出昭關，夜行而晝伏，至於蓤夫。”
derivationEn: From Strategies of the Warring States, 'Strategy of Qin' by Liu Xiang (Western Han): 'Wu Zixu escaped through Zhaoguan in a sack, traveling by night and hiding by day, until he reached Lingfu.'
example: 风吹雨打露沾衣，～人迹稀。★陈毅《寄友》
exampleTraditional: 風吹雨打露沾衣，～人跡稀。★陳毅《寄友》
exampleEn: Wind and rain wet the clothes, dew stains them; traveling by night and hiding by day, few traces of people. — Chen Yi, 'To a Friend'

explanation: 机杼本指织布机上的筘，织布时每条经线都要从筘齿间穿过，比喻心思、心意。比喻写文章能创造出新的风格和体裁。
explanationTraditional: 機杼本指織布機上的筘，織布時每條經線都要從筘齒間穿過，比喻心思、心意。比喻寫文章能創造出新的風格和體裁。
explanationEn: To create a new style or genre in writing, showing originality and innovation.
derivation: 《魏书·祖莹传》文章须自出机杼，成一家风骨，何能共人同生活也。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·祖瑩傳》文章須自出機杼，成一家風骨，何能共人同生活也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Wei: Biography of Zu Ying': 'Writing must come from one's own loom, forming a unique style and spirit, how can one live the same life as others?'
example: 做文章原要～，自行发挥，不是迎合他人的嗜好。★《晚清文学丛钞·黄绣球》第七回
exampleTraditional: 做文章原要～，自行發揮，不是迎合他人的嗜好。★《晚清文學叢鈔·黃繡球》第七回
exampleEn: Writing an essay should be original and express oneself, not just to cater to others' tastes. ★ 'Late Qing Literature Series: Huang Xiuqiu' Chapter 7

explanation: 比喻自我吹嘘、夸张。
explanationTraditional: 比喻自我吹噓、誇張。
explanationEn: To boast or exaggerate about oneself.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他本身是报纸编辑，因此每作新诗词必在报纸上～，俨然以当代文豪自居。
exampleTraditional: 他本身是報紙編輯，因此每作新詩詞必在報紙上～，儼然以當代文豪自居。
exampleEn: He himself is a newspaper editor, so whenever he writes a new poem, he always boasts about it in the newspaper, posing as a contemporary literary master.

explanation: 陶醉沉醉于某种事物或境界里，以求得内心的安慰。指盲目地自我欣赏。
explanationTraditional: 陶醉沉醉於某種事物或境界裡，以求得內心的安慰。指盲目地自我欣賞。
explanationEn: To be blindly self-satisfied or self-appreciative, seeking inner comfort.
derivation: 唐·崔曙《九日登望仙台》诗且欲近寻彭泽宰，陶然共醉菊花杯。。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·崔曙《九日登望仙台》詩且欲近尋彭澤宰，陶然共醉菊花杯。。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Cui Shu's poem 'Climbing the Immortal Terrace on the Ninth Day': 'I wish to approach the nearby Pengze magistrate, and together we drunkenly toast with chrysanthemum cups.'
example: 学习有了进步时，决不能沾沾自喜，～。
exampleTraditional: 學習有了進步時，決不能沾沾自喜，～。
exampleEn: When making progress in learning, one must not become complacent and self-intoxicated.

explanation: 吹牛吹牛皮；拍马拍马屁。指爱说大话，喜欢自我吹嘘和一味逢迎巴结别人的行为。
explanationTraditional: 吹牛吹牛皮；拍馬拍馬屁。指愛說大話，喜歡自我吹噓和一味逢迎巴結別人的行為。
explanationEn: To brag and flatter; behavior of boasting and currying favor.
derivation: 鲁迅《伪自由书·后记》我想假如曾某能把那种吹牛拍马的精力……用到求实学一点上，所得不是要更多些吗？”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《偽自由書·後記》我想假如曾某能把那種吹牛拍馬的精力……用到求實學一點上，所得不是要更多些嗎？”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Pseudo-Free Book: Postscript': 'I think if Zeng could use that energy of bragging and flattering... to seek practical knowledge, wouldn't he gain more?'
example: 简直是一帮～的坏蛋。★杜鹏程《保卫延安》第二章
exampleTraditional: 簡直是一幫～的壞蛋。★杜鵬程《保衛延安》第二章
exampleEn: They are simply a bunch of bragging and flattering scoundrels. ★ Du Pengcheng's 'Defending Yan'an' Chapter 2

explanation: 在路上遇到不敢交谈，只是以目示意。形容人民对残暴统治的憎恨和恐惧。
explanationTraditional: 在路上遇到不敢交談，只是以目示意。形容人民對殘暴統治的憎恨和恐懼。
explanationEn: To exchange glances only with eyes when meeting on the road, due to fear of speaking; describes people's hatred and fear of tyrannical rule.
derivation: 《国语·周语上》国人莫敢言，道路以目。”
derivationTraditional: 《國語·周語上》國人莫敢言，道路以目。”
derivationEn: From 'Guoyu: Zhouyu I': 'The people dared not speak, only exchanged glances on the road.'
example: 此后要防的是～”了，我们等待着遮眼文学吧。★鲁迅《伪自由书·止哭文学》
exampleTraditional: 此後要防的是～”了，我們等待著遮眼文學吧。★魯迅《偽自由書·止哭文學》
exampleEn: From now on, we must guard against 'exchanging glances on the road'; we await the literature that covers eyes. ★ Lu Xun's 'Pseudo-Free Book: Stop Crying Literature'

explanation: 象放上天断了线的风筝一样。比喻一去不回来的人或东西。
explanationTraditional: 象放上天斷了線的風箏一樣。比喻一去不回來的人或東西。
explanationEn: Like a kite with a broken string; refers to a person or thing that is gone and never returns.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《金线池》第三折掴着手分开云雨，腾的似线断风筝。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《金線池》第三折摑著手分開雲雨，騰的似線斷風箏。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Golden Thread Pond' Act 3: 'Clapping hands to part the clouds and rain, soaring like a kite with a broken string.'
example: 去了多时，约摸四更天气，却似石沉沧海，～，不见回来。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷二十一
exampleTraditional: 去了多時，約摸四更天氣，卻似石沉滄海，～，不見回來。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷二十一
exampleEn: He left for a long time, about the fourth watch of the night, but like a stone sunk in the sea, a kite with a broken string, he never returned. ★ Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' Volume 21

explanation: 比喻事情已过去才发议论。
explanationTraditional: 比喻事情已過去才發議論。
explanationEn: To make comments or criticisms after the event is over; to be belated.
derivation: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第29回人已死了，在这里放马后炮，可是迟了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·夏敬渠《野叟曝言》第29回人已死了，在這裡放馬後炮，可是遲了。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Xia Jingqu's 'A Rustic's Idle Talk' Chapter 29: 'The person is already dead, and you are here firing a rear cannon, but it's too late.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指拥有大量钱财的商人。
explanationTraditional: 指擁有大量錢財的商人。
explanationEn: A wealthy merchant with large amounts of money.
derivation: 《史记·货殖列传》汉兴，海内为一，开关梁，弛山泽之禁，是以富商大贾周流天下，交易之物莫不通，得其所欲，而徒豪杰诸侯于京师。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·貨殖列傳》漢興，海內為一，開關梁，弛山澤之禁，是以富商大賈周流天下，交易之物莫不通，得其所欲，而徒豪傑諸侯於京師。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Merchants': 'When Han arose, the world was unified, barriers were opened, and mountain passes were relaxed, so wealthy merchants traveled everywhere, and goods were exchanged without hindrance.'
example: 历史上有名的～，像陶朱、猗顿、计然、白圭，络绎出现了。★郭沫若《奴隶制的下限在春秋与战国之交》
exampleTraditional: 歷史上有名的～，像陶朱、猗頓、計然、白圭，絡繹出現了。★郭沫若《奴隸制的下限在春秋與戰國之交》
exampleEn: Historically famous wealthy merchants, like Tao Zhu, Yi Dun, Ji Ran, and Bai Gui, appeared one after another. ★ Guo Moruo's 'The Lower Limit of Slavery in the Spring and Autumn and Warring States Periods'

explanation: 指肥美的土地或肥沃富饶的地区。
explanationTraditional: 指肥美的土地或肥沃富饒的地區。
explanationEn: Fertile land or a rich, productive region.
derivation: 汉·贾谊《过秦论》东割膏腴之地，以为桂林、象郡。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·賈誼《過秦論》東割膏腴之地，以為桂林、象郡。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Jia Yi's 'On the Faults of Qin': 'In the east, they cut off fertile lands to form Guilin and Xiangjun.'
example: 江南水乡自古就是～，如今变得更加繁荣富足。
exampleTraditional: 江南水鄉自古就是～，如今變得更加繁榮富足。
exampleEn: The Jiangnan water town has always been a fertile land, and now it has become even more prosperous and affluent.

explanation: 姿姿色，姿态。回首抬眼之间就有美妙的姿色。形容眉目传神，姿态动人。
explanationTraditional: 姿姿色，姿態。回首抬眼之間就有美妙的姿色。形容眉目傳神，姿態動人。
explanationEn: To have a charming appearance when turning the head or glancing; describes expressive eyes and graceful posture.
derivation: 三国·魏·嵇康《赠秀才入军》风驰电逝，蹑景追风；凌历中原，顾盼生姿。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·嵇康《贈秀才入軍》風馳電逝，躡景追風；凌歷中原，顧盼生姿。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Wei Dynasty Ji Kang's 'To a Scholar Joining the Army': 'Wind-driven, lightning-fast, chasing shadows and wind; traversing the Central Plains, turning the head with grace.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指醉酒之后胡言乱语或行为出路。
explanationTraditional: 指醉酒之後胡言亂語或行為出路。
explanationEn: Refers to speaking nonsense or behaving improperly after drinking alcohol.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我当着你大奶奶、姑娘们替你赔个不是，担待我酒后无德罢！
exampleTraditional: 我當著你大奶奶、姑娘們替你賠個不是，擔待我酒後無德罷！
exampleEn: I apologize to you on behalf of your grandmother and young ladies; please forgive my lack of virtue after drinking.

explanation: 荦荦明显。指明显的重大的方面。
explanationTraditional: 犖犖明顯。指明顯的重大的方面。
explanationEn: Refers to the obvious and important aspects.
derivation: 西汉·司马迁《史记·天官书》此其荦荦大者。若至委曲小变，不可胜道。”
derivationTraditional: 西漢·司馬遷《史記·天官書》此其犖犖大者。若至委曲小變，不可勝道。”
derivationEn: From Sima Qian's 'Records of the Grand Historian: Treatise on the Heavenly Offices': 'These are the obvious and important ones. As for the minor details, they are too numerous to mention.'
example: 今天讲的内容很多，我们抓住～就行。
exampleTraditional: 今天講的內容很多，我們抓住～就行。
exampleEn: There is a lot of content today, we just need to grasp the obvious and important points.

explanation: 技术高超的人，偶然间即可得到。也用来形容文学素养很深的人，出于灵感，即可偶然间得到妙语佳作。
explanationTraditional: 技術高超的人，偶然間即可得到。也用來形容文學素養很深的人，出於靈感，即可偶然間得到妙語佳作。
explanationEn: Describes a skilled person who occasionally achieves something effortlessly, or a writer who, inspired, produces excellent works by chance.
derivation: 宋·陆游《文章》诗文章本天成，妙手偶得之。粹然无疵瑕，岂复须人为。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸游《文章》詩文章本天成，妙手偶得之。粹然無疵瑕，豈復須人為。”
derivationEn: From Lu You's poem 'On Writing': 'Writing is naturally formed; a skilled hand occasionally obtains it. Pure and flawless, why need human effort?'
example: 若不是～，便确是经过锤炼的语言的精华。★茅盾《白杨礼赞》
exampleTraditional: 若不是～，便確是經過錘鍊的語言的精華。★茅盾《白楊禮讚》
exampleEn: If not obtained by a skilled hand by chance, it must be the essence of refined language. — Mao Dun, 'Praise of the White Poplar'

explanation: 名名声；一时当代。一个时期内名声很大，受到广泛重视。
explanationTraditional: 名名聲；一時當代。一個時期內名聲很大，受到廣泛重視。
explanationEn: Having great fame and being widely regarded during a certain period.
derivation: 宋·释惟白《续传灯录》卷二十七师住径山时，名重一时，如侍郎张公子韶，状元汪公圣锡少卿、冯公济川俱问道。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋惟白《續傳燈錄》卷二十七師住徑山時，名重一時，如侍郎張公子韶，狀元汪公聖錫少卿、馮公濟川俱問道。”
derivationEn: From Shi Weibai's 'Continued Transmission of the Lamp' (Volume 27): 'When the master resided at Mount Jing, his fame was great at that time; officials like Zhang Zishao, Zhuang Wangsheng, and Feng Jichuan all sought his teachings.'
example: 这位朱大人，学问经济，～。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 這位朱大人，學問經濟，～。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十三回
exampleEn: This Mr. Zhu, with his learning and governance, was famous for a time. — Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' (Chapter 33)

explanation: 又黑又密的眉毛，大大的眼睛。形容眉目有神的人。
explanationTraditional: 又黑又密的眉毛，大大的眼睛。形容眉目有神的人。
explanationEn: Describes a person with thick, dark eyebrows and big eyes, indicating a spirited appearance.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第三十三回只见里面一个浓眉大眼的黑面肥胖妇人，穿着一件黑夏布小衣，两袖勒得高高的，膊肘子也露了出来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第三十三回只見裡面一個濃眉大眼的黑麵肥胖婦人，穿著一件黑夏布小衣，兩袖勒得高高的，膊肘子也露了出來。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' (Chapter 33): 'Inside, there was a dark-faced, fat woman with thick eyebrows and big eyes, wearing a black linen blouse with sleeves rolled up high, exposing her elbows.'
example: 那和尚生得～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第五回
exampleTraditional: 那和尚生得～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第五回
exampleEn: That monk had thick eyebrows and big eyes. — Wen Kang, 'The Story of a Heroic Couple' (Chapter 5)

explanation: 比喻生活在好的环境里，也能成为好人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻生活在好的環境裡，也能成為好人。
explanationEn: Metaphor for how living in a good environment can make a person become good.
derivation: 先秦·荀况《荀子·劝学》蓬生麻中，不扶而直；白沙在涅，与之俱黑。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·荀況《荀子·勸學》蓬生麻中，不扶而直；白沙在涅，與之俱黑。”
derivationEn: From Xunzi's 'Encouraging Learning': 'When the artemisia grows among hemp, it stands straight without support; white sand in black mud becomes black along with it.'
example: 目能视而见之，耳能听而闻之，～，不劳翰墨。★北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·风操》
exampleTraditional: 目能視而見之，耳能聽而聞之，～，不勞翰墨。★北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·風操》
exampleEn: The eyes can see, the ears can hear; when artemisia grows among hemp, it stands straight without the need for writing. — Yan Zhitui, 'Family Instructions of the Yan Clan' (Chapter: Customs)

explanation: 别人抛弃的东西我拾起来。原指商人廉价收买滞销物品，待涨价卖出以获取厚利，后用来表示不跟别人争，仍然有好处。
explanationTraditional: 別人拋棄的東西我拾起來。原指商人廉價收買滯銷物品，待漲價賣出以獲取厚利，後用來表示不跟別人爭，仍然有好處。
explanationEn: Originally refers to a merchant buying unsalable goods cheaply to sell at a profit later; now means not competing with others and still gaining benefits.
derivation: 《史记·货殖列传》当魏文侯时，李克务尽地力，而白圭乐观时变，故人弃我取，人取我与。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·貨殖列傳》當魏文侯時，李克務盡地力，而白圭樂觀時變，故人棄我取，人取我與。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Merchants': 'During the time of Marquis Wen of Wei, Li Ke focused on land productivity, while Bai Gui observed market changes, so he took what others discarded and gave what others sought.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时对各行各业的通称。
explanationTraditional: 舊時對各行各業的通稱。
explanationEn: A general term for all trades and professions in old times.
derivation: 清·李渔《玉搔头》三十六行，行行相妒。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《玉搔頭》三十六行，行行相妒。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu's 'The Jade Hairpin': 'Thirty-six trades, each jealous of the other.'
example: ～者，种种职业也。★徐珂《清稗类钞·农商类》
exampleTraditional: ～者，種種職業也。★徐珂《清稗類鈔·農商類》
exampleEn: The thirty-six trades refer to various occupations. — Xu Ke, 'Qingbai Leichao: Agriculture and Commerce'

explanation: 为公共的利益而舍弃个人的利益。
explanationTraditional: 為公共的利益而捨棄個人的利益。
explanationEn: Sacrificing personal interests for the public good.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们从小就应当培养自己具有舍己为公的好品德。
exampleTraditional: 我們從小就應當培養自己具有捨己為公的好品德。
exampleEn: We should cultivate the virtue of sacrificing ourselves for the public good from a young age.

explanation: 指个人的言论行动总是在群众的监督之下，不允许做坏事，做了也不可能隐瞒。同十目所视，十手所指”。
explanationTraditional: 指個人的言論行動總是在群眾的監督之下，不允許做壞事，做了也不可能隱瞞。同十目所視，十手所指”。
explanationEn: Indicates that one's words and actions are always under public supervision, preventing wrongdoing, and if done, cannot be hidden. Same as 'ten eyes watching, ten fingers pointing'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 十分削瘦的样子。
explanationTraditional: 十分削瘦的樣子。
explanationEn: extremely thin; emaciated
derivation: 宋·陆佃《埤雅·释兽》瘦如豺。豺，柴也。豺体瘦，故谓之豺。” 宋·杨万里《武陵春·长铗归乎逾十暑》词旧赐龙团新作祟，频啜得中寒。瘦骨如柴痛又酸，儿信问平安。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陸佃《埤雅·釋獸》瘦如豺。豺，柴也。豺體瘦，故謂之豺。” 宋·楊萬里《武陵春·長鋏歸乎逾十暑》詞舊賜龍團新作祟，頻啜得中寒。瘦骨如柴痛又酸，兒信問平安。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Lu Dian's 'Pi Ya: Explanation of Beasts': 'Thin as a jackal. Jackal, also called chai. Jackals are thin, hence called chai.' Song Dynasty Yang Wanli's poem 'Wu Ling Chun': 'Old gifts of dragon tea caused new trouble, frequent sips brought cold. Thin as a jackal, pain and sour, a child's letter asks about peace.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指无能者侥幸得以成名。
explanationTraditional: 指無能者僥倖得以成名。
explanationEn: an incompetent person becomes famous by chance
derivation: 《晋书·阮籍传》（阮籍）尝登广武，观楚汉战处，叹曰‘时无英雄，使竖子成名。’”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·阮籍傳》（阮籍）嘗登廣武，觀楚漢戰處，嘆曰‘時無英雄，使豎子成名。’”
derivationEn: 'Book of Jin: Biography of Ruan Ji': 'Ruan Ji once climbed Guangwu and observed the battlefield of Chu and Han, sighing: "No heroes in the age, so a mere boy becomes famous."'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 找各种借口推托。同推三阻四”。
explanationTraditional: 找各種藉口推託。同推三阻四”。
explanationEn: make various excuses to decline
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 外方外表有棱角，刚直；内圆内心无棱角，圆滑。指人的外表正直，而内心圆滑。
explanationTraditional: 外方外表有稜角，剛直；內圓內心無稜角，圓滑。指人的外表正直，而內心圓滑。
explanationEn: outwardly upright but inwardly accommodating; appearing honest but being tactful
derivation: 《后汉书·致恽传》案延资性贪邪，外方内员（圆），朋党奸，罔上害人。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·致惲傳》案延資性貪邪，外方內員（圓），朋黨奸，罔上害人。”
derivationEn: 'Book of the Later Han: Biography of Dun Hui': 'An Yan is inherently greedy and evil, outwardly square but inwardly round, forming cliques and deceiving superiors to harm others.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没法形容。
explanationTraditional: 沒法形容。
explanationEn: indescribable; beyond description
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有人居住的地方。同无人之境”。
explanationTraditional: 沒有人居住的地方。同無人之境”。
explanationEn: uninhabited place; no man's land
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 误受惑；歧途错误的道路。由于受煽惑而走上了错误的道路。
explanationTraditional: 誤受惑；歧途錯誤的道路。由於受煽惑而走上了錯誤的道路。
explanationEn: go astray; be led into the wrong path
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文末编·写于深夜里》然被告等皆年幼无知，误入歧途，不无可悯。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文末編·寫於深夜裡》然被告等皆年幼無知，誤入歧途，不無可憫。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'And This Is Also Life: Written Late at Night': 'But the defendants were all young and ignorant, led astray, and not without pity.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 肚子里没有一点墨水。指人没有文化。
explanationTraditional: 肚子裡沒有一點墨水。指人沒有文化。
explanationEn: uneducated; ignorant; without a drop of ink in one's chest
derivation: 清·淮阴百一居士《壶天录》卷上某家本殷实，父母以独子故，甚爱之，读书十年，胸无点墨。”
derivationTraditional: 清·淮陰百一居士《壺天錄》捲上某家本殷實，父母以獨子故，甚愛之，讀書十年，胸無點墨。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Huaiyin Baiyi Jushi's 'Hu Tian Lu' Volume 1: 'A family was wealthy, and the parents loved their only son dearly. He studied for ten years but had no ink in his chest.'
example: 你别看他每天滔滔不绝的，实际是个～的人。
exampleTraditional: 你別看他每天滔滔不絕的，實際是個～的人。
exampleEn: Don't be fooled by his constant chatter; he's actually a person with no ink in his chest.

explanation: 杳无影无声；黄鹤传说中仙人所乘的鹤。原指传说中仙人骑着黄鹤飞去，从此不再回来。现比喻无影无踪或下落不明。
explanationTraditional: 杳無影無聲；黃鶴傳說中仙人所乘的鶴。原指傳說中仙人騎著黃鶴飛去，從此不再回來。現比喻無影無蹤或下落不明。
