explanationEn: disappear like a yellow crane; gone without a trace
derivation: 南朝梁·任昿《述异记》荀瓌憩江夏黄鹤楼上，望西南有物飘然降自云汉，乃驾鹤之宾也。宾主欢对辞去，跨鹤腾空，眇然烟灭。”唐·崔灏《黄鹤楼》诗黄鹤一去不复返，白云千载空悠悠。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝梁·任昿《述異記》荀瓌憩江夏黃鶴樓上，望西南有物飄然降自雲漢，乃駕鶴之賓也。賓主歡對辭去，跨鶴騰空，眇然煙滅。”唐·崔灝《黃鶴樓》詩黃鶴一去不復返，白雲千載空悠悠。”
derivationEn: Southern Liang Dynasty Ren Fang's 'Shu Yi Ji': 'Xun Gui rested at the Yellow Crane Tower in Jiangxia, saw something descending from the clouds, which was a crane-riding immortal. After a pleasant conversation, the immortal departed, riding the crane into the sky, vanishing into smoke.' Tang Dynasty Cui Hao's poem 'Yellow Crane Tower': 'The yellow crane once gone, never returns; a thousand years of white clouds drift idly.'
example: 昨天局长到了没有？”还是～。”★鲁迅《彷徨·弟兄》
exampleTraditional: 昨天局長到了沒有？”還是～。”★魯迅《彷徨·弟兄》
exampleEn: 'Did the director arrive yesterday?' 'Still gone like a yellow crane.' — Lu Xun's 'Wandering: Brothers'

explanation: 比喻轻率地把成绩、优点全部否定。
explanationTraditional: 比喻輕率地把成績、優點全部否定。
explanationEn: completely deny; blot out at one stroke
derivation: 明·沈德符《野获编》遂将前后爱书，一笔抹杀。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《野獲編》遂將前後愛書，一筆抹殺。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Shen Defu's 'Ye Huo Bian': 'Then he blotted out all previous love letters with one stroke.'
example: 然而新的批评家不开口，类似批评家之流便趁势～。★鲁迅《二心集·我们要批评家》
exampleTraditional: 然而新的批評家不開口，類似批評家之流便趁勢～。★魯迅《二心集·我們要批評家》
exampleEn: However, new critics remain silent, and similar critics take the opportunity to blot out everything with one stroke. — Lu Xun's 'Two Hearts: We Need Critics'

explanation: 在水中上下沉浮。
explanationTraditional: 在水中上下沉浮。
explanationEn: Sinking and floating in water; describing something that goes up and down.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·菁菁者莪》泛泛杨舟，载沉载浮，既见君子，我心则休。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·菁菁者莪》泛泛楊舟，載沉載浮，既見君子，我心則休。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs: 'The drifting poplar boat, now sinking, now floating; when I see the gentleman, my heart is at rest.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻良好的环境。
explanationTraditional: 比喻良好的環境。
explanationEn: A metaphor for a good environment.
derivation: 汉·戴德《大戴礼》与君子游，苾乎如入兰芷之室，久而不闻，则与之化矣。”《孔子家语·六本》与善人居，如入芝兰之室，久而不闻其香，即与之化矣。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·戴德《大戴禮》與君子游，苾乎如入蘭芷之室，久而不聞，則與之化矣。”《孔子家語·六本》與善人居，如入芝蘭之室，久而不聞其香，即與之化矣。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Dai De's 'Da Dai Li': 'Associating with a gentleman is like entering a room of orchids; after a long time, you no longer smell the fragrance, as you have become one with it.' Also from 'The Family Sayings of Confucius': 'Living with good people is like entering a room of orchids; after a long time, you no longer smell the fragrance, as you have become one with it.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 后用为在位者礼贤下士之典实。
explanationTraditional: 後用為在位者禮賢下士之典實。
explanationEn: A metaphor for a ruler or leader who humbly seeks out talented people.
derivation: 《史记·鲁周公世家》周公戒伯禽曰‘我文王之子，武王之弟，成王之叔父，我於天亦不贱矣。然我一沐三捉发，一饭三吐哺，起以待士，犹恐失天下之贤人。子之鲁，慎无以国骄人。’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魯周公世家》周公戒伯禽曰‘我文王之子，武王之弟，成王之叔父，我於天亦不賤矣。然我一沐三捉髮，一飯三吐哺，起以待士，猶恐失天下之賢人。子之魯，慎無以國驕人。’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'The Duke of Zhou cautioned his son Boqin: 'I am the son of King Wen, the brother of King Wu, and the uncle of King Cheng. I am not lowly in the world. Yet I often interrupt my bath three times and my meal three times to receive visitors, fearing I might miss a worthy person. When you go to Lu, do not be proud because of your status.'
example: ～，天下归心。★三国·魏·曹操《短歌行》
exampleTraditional: ～，天下歸心。★三國·魏·曹操《短歌行》
exampleEn: The Duke of Zhou spits out his food; all hearts turn to him. — Cao Cao, 'Short Song Style'

explanation: 诸恶各种坏事。佛家语，凡是坏事都不要做。旧时用以劝人行善。
explanationTraditional: 諸惡各種壞事。佛家語，凡是壞事都不要做。舊時用以勸人行善。
explanationEn: A Buddhist saying meaning 'do no evil'; used to advise people to do good deeds.
derivation: 《大般涅槃经》诸恶莫作，诸善奉行。”
derivationTraditional: 《大般涅槃經》諸惡莫作，諸善奉行。”
derivationEn: From the Mahaparinirvana Sutra: 'Do no evil, practice all good.'
example: 劝君诸善奉行，但是～。（明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十八）
exampleTraditional: 勸君諸善奉行，但是～。（明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十八）
exampleEn: I advise you to practice all good, but do no evil. — Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World'

explanation: 指超出常人。
explanationTraditional: 指超出常人。
explanationEn: Outstanding and surpassing ordinary people.
derivation: 《后汉书·刘虞传论》其能历行饬身，卓然不群者，或未闻焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·劉虞傳論》其能歷行飭身，卓然不群者，或未聞焉。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of the Later Han': 'Those who can cultivate their conduct and be outstanding are rarely heard of.'
example: 苟有～之士，不出户庭，潜志味道，诚宜优访以兴谦退也。★晋·葛洪《抱朴子·逸民》
exampleTraditional: 苟有～之士，不出戶庭，潛志味道，誠宜優訪以興謙退也。★晉·葛洪《抱朴子·逸民》
exampleEn: If there is an outstanding person who does not leave home and secretly pursues the Way, he should be visited with courtesy to promote humility. — Ge Hong, 'Baopuzi'

explanation: 钻入心里，侵入骨中。形容刺激极深。
explanationTraditional: 鑽入心裡，侵入骨中。形容刺激極深。
explanationEn: Penetrating the heart and piercing the bones; describing a very deep stimulation or pain.
derivation: 清·李渔《比目鱼》第六回一到登场的时节，他把我认做真妻子，我把他认做真丈夫。没有一句话儿，不说得钻心刺骨。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《比目魚》第六回一到登場的時節，他把我認做真妻子，我把他認做真丈夫。沒有一句話兒，不說得鑽心刺骨。”
derivationEn: From Li Yu's 'The Fish and the Fisherman': 'When the time comes to perform, he treats me as his real wife, and I treat him as my real husband. There is not a word that does not pierce the heart and bones.'
example: 熏得你浑身起红斑点，～的痒痒。★大群《小矿工·续编》
exampleTraditional: 燻得你渾身起紅斑點，～的癢癢。★大群《小礦工·續編》
exampleEn: It makes your whole body break out in red spots, with an itching that pierces the heart and bones. — Da Qun, 'Little Miner: Sequel'

explanation: 洁白的美玉上面没有一点羞。比喻人或事物完美无缺。
explanationTraditional: 潔白的美玉上面沒有一點羞。比喻人或事物完美無缺。
explanationEn: A flawless white jade; metaphor for a person or thing that is perfect without any flaws.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷十三问‘不曾博览空王教略，借玄机试道看。’师曰‘白玉无瑕，卞和刖足。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷十三問‘不曾博覽空王教略，借玄機試道看。’師曰‘白玉無瑕，卞和刖足。’”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty 'Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp': 'The master said: 'White jade without flaw, Bian He had his foot cut off.''
example: 虽以小姐～，何畏乎青蝇，然青蝇日集亦可憎恨耳。★明·名教中人《好俅传》第七回
exampleTraditional: 雖以小姐～，何畏乎青蠅，然青蠅日集亦可憎恨耳。★明·名教中人《好俅傳》第七回
exampleEn: Although the young lady is as flawless as white jade, why fear the slanderous flies? Yet the flies gather daily, which is hateful. — Ming Dynasty 'The Goodly Pear'

explanation: 白惨白。指反动派残酷镇压人民的恐怖气氛。
explanationTraditional: 白慘白。指反動派殘酷鎮壓人民的恐怖氣氛。
explanationEn: White terror; refers to the oppressive atmosphere created by reactionary forces through violent suppression.
derivation: 鲁迅《且介亭杂文·关于新文字》然而他们却深知道新文字对于劳苦大众有利，所以在弥漫着白色恐怖的地方，这新文字是一定要受摧残的。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《且介亭雜文·關於新文字》然而他們卻深知道新文字對於勞苦大眾有利，所以在瀰漫著白色恐怖的地方，這新文字是一定要受摧殘的。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Essays': 'But they deeply know that the new script benefits the laboring masses, so in places filled with white terror, this new script will certainly be destroyed.'
example: 鲁迅先生对于白色恐怖毫不畏惧，一直把密信和文稿珍藏着。
exampleTraditional: 魯迅先生對於白色恐怖毫不畏懼，一直把密信和文稿珍藏著。
exampleEn: Lu Xun was not afraid of the white terror and always kept secret letters and manuscripts safe.

explanation: 打了败仗的将领。现多用于讽刺失败的人。
explanationTraditional: 打了敗仗的將領。現多用於諷刺失敗的人。
explanationEn: A general who has lost a battle; now often used to mock someone who has failed.
derivation: 《吴越春秋·勾践入臣外传》臣闻……败军之将，不敢语勇。”《史记·淮阴侯列传》臣闻败军之将，不可以言勇；亡国之大夫，不可以图存。”
derivationTraditional: 《吳越春秋·勾踐入臣外傳》臣聞……敗軍之將，不敢語勇。”《史記·淮陰侯列傳》臣聞敗軍之將，不可以言勇；亡國之大夫，不可以圖存。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of Wu and Yue': 'I have heard that a defeated general dare not speak of bravery.' Also from 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'I have heard that a defeated general cannot speak of bravery, and a minister of a fallen state cannot plan for survival.'
example: ～，荷蒙厚恩，无可以报，愿施犬马之劳，不须张弓只箭，径取成都。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: ～，荷蒙厚恩，無可以報，願施犬馬之勞，不須張弓只箭，徑取成都。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十三回
exampleEn: I, a defeated general, have received great kindness and have nothing to repay. I wish to offer my humble services and take Chengdu without using a single arrow. — Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms'

explanation: 大海里的珍珠被采珠人所遗漏。比喻埋没人才或被埋没的人才。
explanationTraditional: 大海里的珍珠被採珠人所遺漏。比喻埋沒人才或被埋沒的人才。
explanationEn: A pearl left behind in the vast sea; metaphor for a talented person who is overlooked or hidden.
derivation: 《新唐书·狄人杰传》仲尼称观过知仁，君可谓沧海遗珠矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·狄人傑傳》仲尼稱觀過知仁，君可謂滄海遺珠矣。”
derivationEn: From 'New Book of Tang': 'Confucius said that by observing a person's faults, one knows their virtue. You can be called a pearl left behind in the sea.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 疮痍创伤。满眼创伤。比喻眼前看到的都是灾祸的景象。
explanationTraditional: 瘡痍創傷。滿眼創傷。比喻眼前看到的都是災禍的景象。
explanationEn: Everywhere a scene of devastation meets the eye.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《北征》诗乾坤含疮痍，忧虞何时毕？”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《北征》詩乾坤含瘡痍，憂虞何時畢？”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Northern Expedition': 'The universe is full of wounds; when will my worries end?'
example: 征鼙聒耳乡音杳，～亲人少。★清·李渔《风筝误·和鹤》
exampleTraditional: 徵鼙聒耳鄉音杳，～親人少。★清·李漁《風箏誤·和鶴》
exampleEn: The war drums deafen the ear, hometown sounds are rare; devastation fills the eye, loved ones are few. — Li Yu, 'Kite Mistakes'

explanation: 旧指朝政变革或改朝换代。现泛指除掉旧的，建立拳的。
explanationTraditional: 舊指朝政變革或改朝換代。現泛指除掉舊的，建立拳的。
explanationEn: To abolish the old and establish the new; to innovate.
derivation: 《周易·杂卦》革，去故也，鼎，取新也。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·雜卦》革，去故也，鼎，取新也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes': 'The cauldron takes the new, the removal discards the old.'
example: 速沾雨露，以就去邪归正之心；毋犯雷霆，当效～之意。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 速沾雨露，以就去邪歸正之心；毋犯雷霆，當效～之意。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第八十回
exampleEn: Quickly receive the rain and dew to turn from evil to good; do not provoke thunder and lightning, but rather show the intention of abolishing the old and establishing the new. — Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin'

explanation: 焚烧树木林，猎取禽兽。比喻只图眼前利益，不作长久打算。
explanationTraditional: 焚燒樹木林，獵取禽獸。比喻只圖眼前利益，不作長久打算。
explanationEn: To burn the forest for hunting; to seek short-term gains without long-term planning.
derivation: 《韩非子·难一》焚林而田，偷取多兽，后必无兽。”《淮南子·主术训》故先王之法……不涸泽而渔，不焚林而猎。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·難一》焚林而田，偷取多獸，後必無獸。”《淮南子·主術訓》故先王之法……不涸澤而漁，不焚林而獵。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi': 'Burning the forest to hunt, stealing many animals, but later there will be none.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 偃倒伏。风一吹草就倒下。比喻道德文教的感化人。
explanationTraditional: 偃倒伏。風一吹草就倒下。比喻道德文教的感化人。
explanationEn: The wind blows and the grass bends; metaphor for moral influence transforming people.
derivation: 《论语·颜渊》君子之德风，小人之德草，草上之风，必偃。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·顏淵》君子之德風，小人之德草，草上之風，必偃。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects': 'The virtue of the gentleman is like wind; the virtue of the small man is like grass. When the wind blows, the grass must bend.'
example: 世俗日浅，小小举措已足以震动一世，使秘书得展其所为，于今日断可以～。★宋·陈亮《又癸卯秋书》
exampleTraditional: 世俗日淺，小小舉措已足以震動一世，使秘書得展其所為，於今日斷可以～。★宋·陳亮《又癸卯秋書》
exampleEn: The world is increasingly shallow; even small actions can shake the era. If the secretary could fully display his actions, today he would surely achieve the effect of wind blowing grass bending. — Chen Liang, 'Letter to Qiu Chou'

explanation: 功功劳，功勋；震震动、威震；主君主。功劳太大，使君主受到震动而心有疑虑。
explanationTraditional: 功功勞，功勳；震震動、威震；主君主。功勞太大，使君主受到震動而心有疑慮。
explanationEn: One's achievements are so great that they make the ruler uneasy.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》臣闻勇略震主者身危，而功盖天下者不赏。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》臣聞勇略震主者身危，而功蓋天下者不賞。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian': 'I have heard that those with courage and strategy that shake the ruler are in danger, and those whose achievements surpass the world are not rewarded.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 皇天古代称天；后土古代称地。指天地。旧时迷信天地能主持公道，主宰万物。
explanationTraditional: 皇天古代稱天；后土古代稱地。指天地。舊時迷信天地能主持公道，主宰萬物。
explanationEn: Heaven and earth; used in oaths to invoke divine witness.
derivation: 《尚书·武成》予小子其承厥志，底商之罪，告于皇天后土。”《左传·僖公十五年》君履后土而戴皇天。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·武成》予小子其承厥志，底商之罪，告於皇天后土。”《左傳·僖公十五年》君履后土而戴皇天。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents' and 'Zuo Zhuan': 'I, a small child, will carry on his will, announce the crimes of Shang to heaven and earth.'
example: 这话～，实所共鉴，有渝此盟，神明殛之。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十回
exampleTraditional: 這話～，實所共鑑，有渝此盟，神明殛之。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十回
exampleEn: These words are witnessed by heaven and earth; if this oath is broken, may the gods punish me. — Wen Kang, 'The Story of a Heroic Couple'

explanation: 头脑发昏，迷失方向。
explanationTraditional: 頭腦發昏，迷失方向。
explanationEn: Dizzy and disoriented; confused.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心里着急，脸色难看。形容非常焦急的神情。
explanationTraditional: 心裡著急，臉色難看。形容非常焦急的神情。
explanationEn: Flushed with anxiety; showing extreme worry or anger.
derivation: 老舍《离婚》六她把气咽下去，丈夫是好意，可是，何必那么急扯白脸的呀！”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《離婚》六她把氣嚥下去，丈夫是好意，可是，何必那麼急扯白臉的呀！”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Divorce': 'She swallowed her anger; her husband meant well, but why did he have to be so anxious and red-faced?'
example: 无

explanation: 腮面颊。尖嘴巴，瘦面颊。形容人相貌丑陋粗俗。
explanationTraditional: 腮面頰。尖嘴巴，瘦面頰。形容人相貌醜陋粗俗。
explanationEn: Sharp mouth and monkey cheeks; describing an ugly, vulgar appearance.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第三回象你这尖嘴猴腮，也该撒泡尿自己照照！不三不四，就想天鹅屁吃。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第三回象你這尖嘴猴腮，也該撒泡尿自己照照！不三不四，就想天鵝屁吃。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars': 'With your sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, you should piss on yourself and look in the mirror! You're neither fish nor fowl, yet you dream of eating swan meat.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 江河永远在陆地上奔流。比喻事情明显，无庸置疑，颠扑不破。
explanationTraditional: 江河永遠在陸地上奔流。比喻事情明顯，無庸置疑，顛撲不破。
explanationEn: Rivers flow on the earth; metaphor for something obvious and indisputable.
derivation: 清·郑燮《焦山别峰庵雨中无事书寄舍弟墨》岂得为日月经天，江河行地哉？”
derivationTraditional: 清·鄭燮《焦山別峰庵雨中無事書寄舍弟墨》豈得為日月經天，江河行地哉？”
derivationEn: From Zheng Xie's letter: 'How can it be like the sun and moon in the sky, or rivers on the earth?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 龙潜居的深水坑，老虎藏身的巢穴。比喻极险恶的地方。
explanationTraditional: 龍潛居的深水坑，老虎藏身的巢穴。比喻極險惡的地方。
explanationEn: A dragon's pool and a tiger's den; a metaphor for an extremely dangerous place.
derivation: 元·无名氏《昊天塔》第三折不甫能撞开了天关地户，跳出这龙潭虎窟。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《昊天塔》第三折不甫能撞開了天關地戶，跳出這龍潭虎窟。”
derivationEn: From the Yuan Dynasty play 'The Tower of Heaven' by an anonymous author: 'I barely managed to break through the gates of heaven and earth, and leap out of this dragon's pool and tiger's den.'
example: 你父亲因他不是个诗书礼乐之门，一面推辞，便要离了这～。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十九回
exampleTraditional: 你父親因他不是個詩書禮樂之門，一面推辭，便要離了這～。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十九回
exampleEn: His father, seeing that it was not a family of poetry, books, rites, and music, declined and wanted to leave this dragon's pool and tiger's den. (from Qing Dynasty novel 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines' by Wen Kang)

explanation: 指暂时结合的非正式夫妻；亦指不正当的男女关系。
explanationTraditional: 指暫時結合的非正式夫妻；亦指不正當的男女關係。
explanationEn: A temporary, informal couple; also refers to an illicit relationship.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無

explanationTraditional: 落落坦率，開朗的樣子。形容言談舉止自然大方。
explanationEn: Describes natural and graceful behavior in speech and manner.
derivation: 郭沫若《蔡文姬》第四幕对于我们也是非常宽大的。还有他的夫人也落落大方。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《蔡文姬》第四幕對於我們也是非常寬大的。還有他的夫人也落落大方。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's play 'Cai Wenji', Act 4: 'He has been very lenient with us, and his wife is also very natural and graceful.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 茫不清楚，纷乱。一点儿头绪也没有。形容事情摸不着边，不知从哪里入手。
explanationTraditional: 茫不清楚，紛亂。一點兒頭緒也沒有。形容事情摸不著邊，不知從哪裡入手。
explanationEn: Completely at a loss; having no clue where to start; describing something that is unclear and disorganized.
derivation: 蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第四十二回本驻使与贵总长磋商，已经数次，迁延至一月有余，仍然是茫无头绪，莫非轻视敝国不成？”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第四十二回本駐使與貴總長磋商，已經數次，遷延至一月有餘，仍然是茫無頭緒，莫非輕視敝國不成？”
derivationEn: From 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China' by Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu, Chapter 42: 'This envoy has consulted with Your Excellency several times, but after more than a month, it is still completely at a loss. Could it be that you despise our country?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风景优美的著名河山。同名山胜川”。
explanationTraditional: 風景優美的著名河山。同名山勝川”。
explanationEn: Famous mountains and scenic rivers; renowned beautiful landscapes.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 沐猴猕猴；冠戴帽子★子穿衣戴帽，究竟不是真人。比喻虚有其表，形同傀儡。常用来讽刺投靠恶势力窃据权位的人。
explanationTraditional: 沐猴獼猴；冠戴帽子★子穿衣戴帽，究竟不是真人。比喻虛有其表，形同傀儡。常用來諷刺投靠惡勢力竊據權位的人。
explanationEn: A monkey wearing a hat; a metaphor for someone who is outwardly impressive but lacks true substance, often used to criticize those who seize power by attaching themselves to evil forces.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪》人言楚人沐猴而冠耳，果然。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀》人言楚人沐猴而冠耳，果然。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'People say that the men of Chu are just monkeys wearing hats, and indeed they are.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 奇妙的光亮和色彩。
explanationTraditional: 奇妙的光亮和色彩。
explanationEn: Strange and brilliant lights and colors.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第十一回向里一望，只见是个窈窕洞房，满室奇光异彩，也不辨是金是玉，是花是绣，但觉眼光缭乱而已。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第十一回向裡一望，只見是個窈窕洞房，滿室奇光異彩，也不辨是金是玉，是花是繡，但覺眼光繚亂而已。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'Flowers in the Mirror' by Zeng Pu, Chapter 11: 'Looking inside, it was a delicate bridal chamber, full of strange and brilliant lights and colors, so dazzling that one could not tell gold from jade, or flowers from embroidery.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanationTraditional: 敝破；屣鞋。象扔破鞋一樣把它扔掉。比喻毫不可惜地拋棄掉。
explanationEn: To discard something like a worn-out shoe; to abandon something without any regret.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》舜视弃天下，犹弃敝蹝（屣）也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》舜視棄天下，猶棄敝蹝（屣）也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jinxin I': 'Shun regarded abandoning the empire as discarding a worn-out shoe.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人世社会和神仙世界。指景物极美好的处所。多比喻境遇完全不同。
explanationTraditional: 人世社會和神仙世界。指景物極美好的處所。多比喻境遇完全不同。
explanationEn: The human world and the celestial realm; refers to a place of extreme beauty; often used to describe completely different circumstances.
derivation: 唐·崔颢《七夕词》仙裙玉佩空自知，天上人间不相见。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·崔顥《七夕詞》仙裙玉佩空自知，天上人間不相見。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty poet Cui Hao's poem 'Qixi Poem': 'The fairy's skirt and jade pendant know themselves in vain; in heaven and on earth, they cannot meet.'
example: 真乃是～全珠。★元·汤式《端正好·咏荆南佳丽》
exampleTraditional: 真乃是～全珠。★元·湯式《端正好·詠荊南佳麗》
exampleEn: Truly it is a perfect pearl in heaven and on earth. (from Yuan Dynasty play 'Duanzheng Hao: Ode to the Beauty of Jingnan' by Tang Shi)

explanation: 师军队。伸张仁爱正义讨伐邪恶的军队。亦作仁义之兵”。
explanationTraditional: 師軍隊。伸張仁愛正義討伐邪惡的軍隊。亦作仁義之兵”。
explanationEn: An army that upholds benevolence and righteousness to punish evil; also known as 'the army of benevolence and righteousness'.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一一五回吾欲兴仁义之师，伐无道之主，汝安敢逆吾意！”明·方汝浩《禅真逸史》第十九回君候起仁义之师，吊民伐罪，四海引领而望，孰不归心？”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一一五回吾欲興仁義之師，伐無道之主，汝安敢逆吾意！”明·方汝浩《禪真逸史》第十九回君候起仁義之師，弔民伐罪，四海引領而望，孰不歸心？”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty novel 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' by Luo Guanzhong, Chapter 115: 'I wish to raise an army of benevolence and righteousness to attack the unrighteous ruler; how dare you oppose my will?' Also from Ming Dynasty novel 'The Zen Master's True Story' by Fang Ruhao, Chapter 19: 'You raise an army of benevolence and righteousness to comfort the people and punish the guilty; all within the four seas look forward to it; who would not submit?'
example: 如此说来，虽然谋叛之徒，倒也忠义可嘉。本帅～，何愁杨枭不灭。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 如此說來，雖然謀叛之徒，倒也忠義可嘉。本帥～，何愁楊梟不滅。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第四十九回
exampleEn: In this way, although they are rebels, they are loyal and righteous. Our army of benevolence and righteousness need not worry about defeating Yang Xiao. (from Qing Dynasty novel 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei' by Qian Cai, Chapter 49)

explanation: 指遥远的地方。
explanationTraditional: 指遙遠的地方。
explanationEn: Refers to a very distant place.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 为了寻找地下的矿产资源，地质勘探队员走遍了祖国的山南海北。
exampleTraditional: 為了尋找地下的礦產資源，地質勘探隊員走遍了祖國的山南海北。
exampleEn: In order to find underground mineral resources, the geological exploration team members traveled all over the country, from the mountains to the seas.

explanation: 为国家牺牲自己的生命。
explanationTraditional: 為國家犧牲自己的生命。
explanationEn: To sacrifice one's life for the country.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 黄花岗七十二烈士～的英雄事迹，永远为中国人民所敬颂。
exampleTraditional: 黃花崗七十二烈士～的英雄事蹟，永遠為中國人民所敬頌。
exampleEn: The heroic deeds of the 72 martyrs of Huanghuagang, who sacrificed their lives for the country, are forever revered and sung by the Chinese people.

explanation: 适正，恰好；会时机。恰巧碰上那个机会或时机。
explanationTraditional: 適正，恰好；會時機。恰巧碰上那個機會或時機。
explanationEn: To happen to coincide with the right opportunity or occasion.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十一回戾死树木，也是适逢其会。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十一回戾死樹木，也是適逢其會。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 71: 'The dead trees were also a coincidence of the occasion.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 顺应时势而行动。
explanationTraditional: 順應時勢而行動。
explanationEn: To act in accordance with the times or circumstances.
derivation: 《左传·隐公十一年》度德而处，量力而行之，相时而动，无累后人。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公十一年》度德而處，量力而行之，相時而動，無累後人。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan', 11th year of Duke Yin: 'Assess virtue and act accordingly, measure strength and proceed, act according to the times, and do not burden future generations.'

explanation: 极言对罪大恶极者予以严厉的惩罚。
explanationTraditional: 極言對罪大惡極者予以嚴厲的懲罰。
explanationEn: To describe a severe punishment for a heinous criminal, literally 'to chop into ten thousand pieces'.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第五十二回林冲喝道‘你这个害民强盗，我早晚杀到京师，把你那厮欺君贼臣高俅，碎尸万段，方是愿足。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第五十二回林沖喝道‘你這個害民強盜，我早晚殺到京師，把你那廝欺君賊臣高俅，碎屍萬段，方是願足。’”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 52: 'Lin Chong shouted, 'You harmful bandit, sooner or later I will go to the capital and chop that treacherous minister Gao Qiu into ten thousand pieces to satisfy my anger.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 瓦釜沙锅，比喻庸才。声音低沉的沙锅发出雷鸣般的响声。比喻无德无才的人占据高位，威风一时。
explanationTraditional: 瓦釜沙鍋，比喻庸才。聲音低沉的沙鍋發出雷鳴般的響聲。比喻無德無才的人佔據高位，威風一時。
explanationEn: Metaphor for incompetent people holding high positions and being influential for a time; literally 'an earthen pot thunders like thunder'.
derivation: 《楚辞·卜居》黄钟毁弃，瓦釜雷鸣。谗人高张，贤士无名。”
derivationTraditional: 《楚辭·卜居》黃鐘譭棄，瓦釜雷鳴。讒人高張，賢士無名。”
derivationEn: 'Chu Ci · Bu Ju': 'The yellow bell is destroyed and discarded, the earthen pot thunders like thunder. The slanderers are exalted, the worthy are nameless.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 外表刚强而内在柔弱。同内柔外刚”。
explanationTraditional: 外表剛強而內在柔弱。同內柔外剛”。
explanationEn: Outwardly strong but inwardly weak; same as 'inner softness and outer hardness'.

derivationTraditional: 宋·吳曾《能改齋漫錄·議論》兵戈既起，將帥擅權，武吏功臣，過求姑息。邊蕃遠郡，得以驕矜，外剛內柔，上陵下替，此為屈辱又非多乎？”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wu Zeng, 'Nenggaizhai Manlu · Discussion': 'When war arises, generals seize power, military officials and meritorious ministers seek excessive leniency. Border tribes and distant prefectures become arrogant, outwardly strong but inwardly weak, the superior is insulted and the inferior usurps, this is more than humiliation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 如果以为我的话不真实。
explanationTraditional: 如果以為我的話不真實。

derivation: 《诗经·王风·采葛》谓予不信，有如巳铡！
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·王風·采葛》謂予不信，有如巳鍘！
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs · Wang Feng · Cai Ge': 'If you think my words are untrue, there is the bright sun as witness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanationTraditional: 比喻平白無故地生出事來。有故意製造事端的意思。
explanationEn: Metaphor for creating trouble out of nothing, often with deliberate intent.
derivation: 唐·希运《黄檗断际禅师宛陵录》达摩西来，无风起浪；世尊拈花，一耻缺。”宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷二十六洋澜左蠡，无风浪起。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·希運《黃檗斷際禪師宛陵錄》達摩西來，無風起浪；世尊拈花，一恥缺。”宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷二十六洋瀾左蠡，無風浪起。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Xiyun, 'Huangbo Duanji Zen Master Wanling Record': 'Bodhidharma came from the West, raising waves without wind.' Song Dynasty, Shi Daoyuan, 'Jingde Chuandeng Lu', Volume 26: 'Yanglan Zuoli, waves rise without wind.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 什么事情都知道，没有不懂得的。
explanationTraditional: 什麼事情都知道，沒有不懂得的。
explanationEn: To know everything; to be knowledgeable about all things.
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《东坡梦》第一折此女甚是聪慧……便是三教九流的说话，无所不通，无所不晓。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《東坡夢》第一折此女甚是聰慧……便是三教九流的說話，無所不通，無所不曉。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wu Changling, 'Dongpo Dream', First Act: 'This woman is very intelligent... even in the speech of the three religions and nine schools, she is proficient in everything and knows everything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指各行各业。
explanationTraditional: 泛指各行各業。
explanationEn: Refers to all trades and professions.
derivation: 老舍《龙须沟》第一幕五行八作，就没你这一行。”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《龍鬚溝》第一幕五行八作，就沒你這一行。”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Dragon Beard Ditch', Act 1: 'All trades and professions, but not yours.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指信神者所供养的香烛不断绝。亦作香火不断”。
explanationTraditional: 指信神者所供養的香燭不斷絕。亦作香火不斷”。
explanationEn: Refers to the continuous offering of incense by worshippers. Also used as 'incense never ceases'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人口少的人家。旧时也指寒微人家。
explanationTraditional: 人口少的人家。舊時也指寒微人家。
explanationEn: A family with few members. In old times, also referred to a humble or poor family.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第十九卷和氏道‘我们是小户人家，不像大人家有许多规矩。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第十九卷和氏道‘我們是小戶人家，不像大人家有許多規矩。’”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 19: 'We are a small family, not like big families with many rules.'
example: 我们山里人，～，这算得什么？★鲁迅《彷徨·祝福》
exampleTraditional: 我們山裡人，～，這算得什麼？★魯迅《彷徨·祝福》
exampleEn: We mountain folk, a small family, what does it matter? ★ Lu Xun's 'Wandering: Blessing'

explanation: 头上擦油，脸上搽粉。形容人打扮得妖艳粗俗。
explanationTraditional: 頭上擦油，臉上搽粉。形容人打扮得妖豔粗俗。
explanationEn: Oiled hair and powdered face. Describes someone dressed in a flashy and vulgar manner.
derivation: 元·钟嗣成《骂玉郎过感恩采茶歌·四景》皓齿明眸，粉面油头，点花牌，行酒令。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鍾嗣成《罵玉郎過感恩採茶歌·四景》皓齒明眸，粉面油頭，點花牌，行酒令。”
derivationEn: From Zhong Sicheng's 'Song of Scolding the Jade Lang': 'Bright teeth and beautiful eyes, powdered face and oiled hair, ordering flower cards, playing drinking games.'
example: ～成虚话，广智多谋一旦休。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第九十四回
exampleTraditional: ～成虛話，廣智多謀一旦休。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第九十四回
exampleEn: Oiled hair and powdered face become empty talk; great wisdom and many schemes end in a moment. ★ Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 94

explanation: 直截了当承认，毫不回避隐瞒。
explanationTraditional: 直截了當承認，毫不迴避隱瞞。
explanationEn: To admit frankly without evasion or concealment.
derivation: 中国近台史资料丛刊《辛亥革命·徐锡麟安庆起义清方档案》马子畦一犯即现获之黄福诡名，亦经质讯明确，直认不讳。”
derivationTraditional: 中國近臺史資料叢刊《辛亥革命·徐錫麟安慶起義清方檔案》馬子畦一犯即現獲之黃福詭名，亦經質訊明確，直認不諱。”
derivationEn: From 'Historical Materials of the 1911 Revolution: Xu Xilin's Uprising in Anqing, Qing Official Documents': 'The criminal Ma Ziji, also known as Huang Fu under his alias, was interrogated clearly and confessed without concealment.'
example: 这几条罪案，本社同人当然～。★陈独秀《新青年·罪案之答辩书》
exampleTraditional: 這幾條罪案，本社同人當然～。★陳獨秀《新青年·罪案之答辯書》
exampleEn: These several charges, our colleagues of this magazine naturally confess without concealment. ★ Chen Duxiu's 'New Youth: Apologia for Crimes'

explanation: 犯触犯、冒犯。群众的愤怒不可触犯。表示不可以做群众不满意的事情。
explanationTraditional: 犯觸犯、冒犯。群眾的憤怒不可觸犯。表示不可以做群眾不滿意的事情。
explanationEn: The anger of the masses is not to be provoked. Indicates that one should not do things that displease the people.
derivation: 《左传·襄公十年》众怒难犯，专欲难成，合二难以安国，危之道也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公十年》眾怒難犯，專欲難成，合二難以安國，危之道也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The Tenth Year of Duke Xiang': 'The anger of the masses is hard to offend; personal desires are hard to fulfill. Combining these two difficulties to stabilize the state is a dangerous path.'
example: 你们来意甚善，只是～，赶快去吧。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第一回
exampleTraditional: 你們來意甚善，只是～，趕快去吧。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第一回
exampleEn: Your intentions are good, but the public anger is hard to offend; go quickly. ★ Qing Dynasty Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can', Chapter 1

explanation: 沮丧的样子。情绪低沉，心神忧伤。
explanationTraditional: 沮喪的樣子。情緒低沉，心神憂傷。
explanationEn: A dejected appearance; low spirits and heartache.
derivation: 梁·江淹《别赋》黯然销魂者，惟别而已矣。”
derivationTraditional: 梁·江淹《別賦》黯然銷魂者，惟別而已矣。”
derivationEn: From Liang Dynasty Jiang Yan's 'Fu on Separation': 'The soul-wrenching sorrow is only at parting.'
example: 篝灯询母，如秋蝶～。★清·淮阳百一居士《壶天录》上卷
exampleTraditional: 篝燈詢母，如秋蝶～。★清·淮陽百一居士《壺天錄》上卷
exampleEn: Inquiring about mother by lamplight, like an autumn butterfly in dejection. ★ Qing Dynasty Huaiyang Baiyi Jushi's 'Records of a Pot of Heaven', Volume 1

explanation: 稗官古代的一种小官，专给帝王搜集街谈巷语，道听途说，以供省览，后称小说或小说家为稗官。指旧时的小说和私人编撰的史书。
explanationTraditional: 稗官古代的一種小官，專給帝王蒐集街談巷語，道聽途說，以供省覽，後稱小說或小說家為稗官。指舊時的小說和私人編撰的史書。
explanationEn: Refers to novels and unofficial histories. 'Baiguan' was a minor official who collected street talk for the emperor; later used to refer to novelists or novels.
derivation: 《汉书·艺文志》小说家者流，盖出于稗官，街谈巷语，道听途说者之所造也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·藝文志》小說家者流，蓋出於稗官，街談巷語，道聽途說者之所造也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Treatise on Literature': 'The school of novelists originated from baiguan, who created stories from street talk and hearsay.'
example: 如今我要将这碑记付给文人墨士，做为～，流传海内。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十回
exampleTraditional: 如今我要將這碑記付給文人墨士，做為～，流傳海內。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十回
exampleEn: Now I will entrust this stele inscription to scholars and writers, to be spread as unofficial history. ★ Qing Dynasty Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 70

explanation: 犹表里如一。
explanationTraditional: 猶表裡如一。
explanationEn: Same as 'consistency between inside and outside'.
derivation: 明·王守仁《教条示龙场诸生》苟有谦默自持……叫信乐易，表里一致者，使其人资禀虽甚鲁钝，侪辈之中有弗称慕之者乎？”
derivationTraditional: 明·王守仁《教條示龍場諸生》苟有謙默自持……叫信樂易，表裡一致者，使其人資稟雖甚魯鈍，儕輩之中有弗稱慕之者乎？”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wang Shouren's 'Instructions to Students at Longchang': 'If one is humble and silent... honest and joyful, consistent inside and out, even if dull-witted, would not the peers admire him?'
example: 现在我们要想的对、说的对、写的对，这才是～革命的诗。★续范亭《论诗》
exampleTraditional: 現在我們要想的對、說的對、寫的對，這才是～革命的詩。★續範亭《論詩》
exampleEn: Now we must think correctly, speak correctly, and write correctly; only then is it a poem of revolution consistent inside and out. ★ Xu Fanzheng's 'On Poetry'

explanation: 情情理。不合情理的请求（称自己提出请求时的客气话）。
explanationTraditional: 情情理。不合情理的請求（稱自己提出請求時的客氣話）。
explanationEn: An unreasonable request (a polite expression used when making a request oneself).
derivation: 清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·滦阳消夏录二》不情之请，惟君图之。”
derivationTraditional: 清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·灤陽消夏錄二》不情之請，惟君圖之。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage: Summer in Luanyang': 'An unreasonable request, I hope you will consider it.'
example: 我想这是大年夜，他在暖暖融融的屋里，说说笑笑正热闹，叫他冲黑冒寒送我，是～。★杨绛《冒险记幸》
exampleTraditional: 我想這是大年夜，他在暖暖融融的屋裡，說說笑笑正熱鬧，叫他衝黑冒寒送我，是～。★楊絳《冒險記幸》
exampleEn: I thought it was New Year's Eve; he was warm and cozy at home chatting and laughing, and asking him to brave the dark and cold to see me off was an unreasonable request. ★ Yang Jiang's 'Adventure in Luck'

explanation: 违不遵守。不耽误农作物的耕种时节。
explanationTraditional: 違不遵守。不耽誤農作物的耕種時節。
explanationEn: Not to miss the farming season; to ensure that agricultural work is done in a timely manner.
derivation: 《孟子·梁惠王上》不违农时，谷不可胜食也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·梁惠王上》不違農時，谷不可勝食也。”
derivationEn: Mencius, King Hui of Liang I: 'If the farming seasons are not missed, the grain will be more than can be eaten.'
example: ～，减少误工，也十分重要。★毛泽东《减租和生产是保卫解放区的两件大事》
exampleTraditional: ～，減少誤工，也十分重要。★毛澤東《減租和生產是保衛解放區的兩件大事》
exampleEn: Not missing the farming season and reducing lost work time is also very important. — Mao Zedong, 'Reducing Rent and Production Are Two Major Tasks for Protecting the Liberated Areas'

explanation: 未央未尽。长久欢乐，永不结束。
explanationTraditional: 未央未盡。長久歡樂，永不結束。
explanationEn: Eternal joy without end; everlasting happiness.
derivation: 《金石索·汉长乐宫瓦》‘长乐未央’，此长东宫瓦。”
derivationTraditional: 《金石索·漢長樂宮瓦》‘長樂未央’，此長東宮瓦。”
derivationEn: From 'Jinshi Suo: Han Changle Palace Tile': 'Eternal joy without end,' this is a tile from the Changdong Palace.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 凡指凡人，普通人。超越平常人而达到圣贤的境界。形容学识修养达到了高峰。
explanationTraditional: 凡指凡人，普通人。超越平常人而達到聖賢的境界。形容學識修養達到了高峰。
explanationEn: To transcend the ordinary and attain sagehood; to reach the highest level of knowledge or cultivation.
derivation: 唐·吕岩《七言之二》举世若能知所寓，超凡入胜弗为难。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·呂岩《七言之二》舉世若能知所寓，超凡入勝弗為難。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Lü Yan, 'Seven Poems, Part 2': 'If all the world could know where to dwell, transcending the ordinary and entering sagehood would not be difficult.'
example: 今日弟幸会芝范，想领教一番～的道理，从此可以洗尽俗肠，重开眼界。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一一五回
exampleTraditional: 今日弟幸會芝範，想領教一番～的道理，從此可以洗盡俗腸，重開眼界。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一一五回
exampleEn: Today, I am fortunate to meet you and wish to learn the principles of transcending the ordinary and attaining sagehood, so as to cleanse my mundane heart and broaden my horizons. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 115

explanation: 利锋利，引伸为顺利、成功；印不锋利，引伸为挫折。成功或失败，顺利或不顺利。指做事情可能有的各种情况或结果。
explanationTraditional: 利鋒利，引伸為順利、成功；印不鋒利，引伸為挫折。成功或失敗，順利或不順利。指做事情可能有的各種情況或結果。
explanationEn: Success or failure, advantage or disadvantage; the various possible outcomes or circumstances of an undertaking.
derivation: 三国·蜀·诸葛亮《后出师表》至于成败利钝，非臣之明所能逆睹也。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·蜀·諸葛亮《後出師表》至於成敗利鈍，非臣之明所能逆睹也。”
derivationEn: Three Kingdoms, Shu Han, Zhuge Liang, 'Later Memorial to the Throne': 'As for success or failure, advantage or disadvantage, it is beyond my foresight.'
example: ～，在此一举。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: ～，在此一舉。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第三十三回
exampleEn: Success or failure, advantage or disadvantage, all hinge on this one move. — Chen Chen, 'Water Margin: Later Sequel', Chapter 33

explanation: 抽刀拔出刀来。水流水。抽出刀来要斩断流水。比喻无济于事，反会加速事态的发展。
explanationTraditional: 抽刀拔出刀來。水流水。抽出刀來要斬斷流水。比喻無濟於事，反會加速事態的發展。
explanationEn: To draw a sword to cut flowing water; a futile attempt that only worsens the situation.
derivation: 唐·李白《宣州谢杋楼饯别校书叔云》抽刀断水水更流，举杯消愁愁更愁。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《宣州謝杋樓餞別校書叔雲》抽刀斷水水更流，舉杯消愁愁更愁。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Bai, 'Farewell to Uncle Yun, Imperial Librarian, at Xie Tiao's Pavilion in Xuanzhou': 'Drawing a sword to cut the water, the water flows even more; raising a cup to drown sorrow, sorrow grows even more.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 创创伤；痛疼痛。受了很大创伤，痛苦很深。原指哀痛父母之丧，犹如体受重创◇多比喻遭受很大的伤害和痛苦。
explanationTraditional: 創創傷；痛疼痛。受了很大創傷，痛苦很深。原指哀痛父母之喪，猶如體受重創◇多比喻遭受很大的傷害和痛苦。
explanationEn: Severe wounds and deep pain; great suffering and deep sorrow, originally referring to grief over parents' death.
derivation: 《礼记·三年问》创巨者其日久，痛甚者其愈迟；三年者，称情而立文，所以为至痛极也。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·三年問》創鉅者其日久，痛甚者其愈遲；三年者，稱情而立文，所以為至痛極也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Rites: Three-Year Mourning': 'Those with great wounds have a long recovery; those with deep pain heal slowly; three years is the period established according to feelings, to express the utmost pain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指四面出兵征战讨伐。
explanationTraditional: 指四面出兵征戰討伐。
explanationEn: To campaign east and west; to wage war in all directions.
derivation: 唐·杨炯《左武卫将军成安子崔献行状》至如出车授钺，东征西讨，孤虚向背，则虽女子之众，可以当于丈夫。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·楊炯《左武衛將軍成安子崔獻行狀》至如出車授鉞，東征西討，孤虛向背，則雖女子之眾，可以當於丈夫。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Yang Jiong, 'Epitaph of Cui Xian, Left Martial Guard General and Cheng'anzi': 'From commanding chariots and receiving axes, campaigning east and west, facing solitude and emptiness, even a crowd of women could match men.'
example: 我为国家助成大业，擐甲执锐，垂四十年，～，无复遗恨，第恨汴京下耳！当其勉之。★《元史·木华黎传》
exampleTraditional: 我為國家助成大業，擐甲執銳，垂四十年，～，無復遺恨，第恨汴京下耳！當其勉之。★《元史·木華黎傳》
exampleEn: I have helped the state achieve great deeds, worn armor and held sharp weapons for nearly forty years, campaigning east and west without regret, except for the fall of Bianjing. You must strive! — 'History of Yuan: Biography of Muqali'

explanation: 形容说话语气很凶狠，态度粗暴。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話語氣很兇狠，態度粗暴。
explanationEn: Harsh voice and rude manner; speaking in a fierce and abusive tone.
derivation: 曹禺《北京人》第三幕曾思懿（半天在抑压着自己的愠怒，现在不免颜色难看，恶声恶气地）去，要你去干什么？”
derivationTraditional: 曹禺《北京人》第三幕曾思懿（半天在抑壓著自己的慍怒，現在不免顏色難看，惡聲惡氣地）去，要你去幹什麼？”
derivationEn: Cao Yu, 'Peking Man', Act 3: 'Zeng Siyi (suppressing her anger for a long time, now with a grim face and harsh voice): Go, what do you want to do?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把琴当柴烧，把鹤煮了吃。比喻糟蹋美好的事物。
explanationTraditional: 把琴當柴燒，把鶴煮了吃。比喻糟蹋美好的事物。
explanationEn: To burn a zither for fuel and cook a crane for food; to spoil or destroy something beautiful or refined.
derivation: 宋·胡仔《苕溪渔隐丛前集》引《西清诗话》义山《杂纂》，品目数十，盖以文滑稽者。其一曰杀风景，谓清泉濯足，背山起楼，烧琴煮鹤。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·胡仔《苕溪漁隱叢前集》引《西清詩話》義山《雜纂》，品目數十，蓋以文滑稽者。其一曰殺風景，謂清泉濯足，背山起樓，燒琴煮鶴。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Hu Zai, 'Tiaoxi Yuyin Conghua' quoting 'Xiqing Shihua': 'Yishan's 'Zazuan' lists dozens of items, all humorous. One is 'spoiling the scenery,' such as washing feet in a clear spring, building a house with one's back to a mountain, burning a zither to cook a crane.'
example: ～从来有，惜玉怜香几个知。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷三
exampleTraditional: ～從來有，惜玉憐香幾個知。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷三
exampleEn: Burning zithers and cooking cranes has always existed; how many know to cherish jade and pity fragrance? — Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 3

explanation: 过路过；入进入。路过家门却不进去。形容恪尽职守，公而忘私。
explanationTraditional: 過路過；入進入。路過家門卻不進去。形容恪盡職守，公而忘私。
explanationEn: To pass by one's own door without entering; to be so dedicated to duty that one neglects personal affairs.
derivation: 战国·邹·孟轲《孟子·离娄下》禹稷当平世，三过其门而不入。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·鄒·孟軻《孟子·離婁下》禹稷當平世，三過其門而不入。”
derivationEn: Warring States, Zou, Meng Ke, 'Mencius: Li Lou II': 'Yu and Ji, in a peaceful era, passed by their own doors three times without entering.'
example: 岂有相离咫尺，竟～？★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第42回
exampleTraditional: 豈有相離咫尺，竟～？★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第42回
exampleEn: How could one be so close yet pass by without entering? — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 42

explanation: 指繁华的、吃喝玩乐的地方。也泛指人世间。
explanationTraditional: 指繁華的、吃喝玩樂的地方。也泛指人世間。
explanationEn: A bustling, pleasure-seeking place; also refers to the human world in general.
derivation: 宋·文及翁《贺新郎·西湖》词回首洛阳花世界，烟渺黍离之地。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·文及翁《賀新郎·西湖》詞回首洛陽花世界，煙渺黍離之地。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Wen Jiweng's poem 'He Xin Lang · West Lake': 'Looking back at Luoyang, a world of flowers, amidst misty millet fields.'
example: 史见满园青翠萦目，红紫迎人，真是锦绣乾坤，～。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四回
exampleTraditional: 史見滿園青翠縈目，紅紫迎人，真是錦繡乾坤，～。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四回
exampleEn: The garden was full of lush greenery and red blossoms, truly a splendid universe, a world of flowers. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 4

explanation: 由于灾荒或战乱而流转离散。形容生活艰难，四处流浪。
explanationTraditional: 由於災荒或戰亂而流轉離散。形容生活艱難，四處流浪。
explanationEn: To wander about due to famine or war, describing a life of hardship and homelessness.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·荡》人亦有言，颠沛之揭。”《汉书·薛广德传》窃见关东困极，人民流离。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·蕩》人亦有言，顛沛之揭。”《漢書·薛廣德傳》竊見關東困極，人民流離。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs, Greater Odes, Dang': 'People also say, falling and stumbling.' 'Book of Han, Biography of Xue Guangde': 'I see the east is in extreme distress, people are displaced.'
example: 虽在～之中，他的高华的气度，渊雅的局量，还不曾改变。★郑振铎《桂公堂》
exampleTraditional: 雖在～之中，他的高華的氣度，淵雅的局量，還不曾改變。★鄭振鐸《桂公堂》
exampleEn: Even in the midst of displacement and hardship, his noble demeanor and profound composure remained unchanged. — Zheng Zhenduo, 'Gui Gong Tang'

explanation: 流水一去不复返，毫无情意。比喻时光消逝，无意停留。
explanationTraditional: 流水一去不復返，毫無情意。比喻時光消逝，無意停留。
explanationEn: Flowing water shows no emotion; metaphor for time passing without stopping.
derivation: 唐·白居易《过元家履信宅》落花不语空辞树，流水无情自入地。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《過元家履信宅》落花不語空辭樹，流水無情自入地。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Bai Juyi's poem 'Passing by the House of Yuan Family': 'Falling flowers silently leave the tree, flowing water heartlessly enters the ground.'
example: 落花有意，翻成就无意姻缘；流水无情，倒做了有情夫妇。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第七十八回
exampleTraditional: 落花有意，翻成就無意姻緣；流水無情，倒做了有情夫婦。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第七十八回
exampleEn: The falling flower has intention, yet it turns into an unintentional marriage; the flowing water is heartless, yet it becomes a loving couple. — Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 78

explanation: 以梅为妻，以鹤为子。比喻清高或隐居。宋·林逋隐居西湖孤山，植梅养鹤，终生不娶，人谓梅妻鹤子”。
explanationTraditional: 以梅為妻，以鶴為子。比喻清高或隱居。宋·林逋隱居西湖孤山，植梅養鶴，終生不娶，人謂梅妻鶴子”。
explanationEn: Taking plum trees as wives and cranes as children; metaphor for a hermit's lofty and reclusive life.
derivation: 宋·沈括《梦溪笔谈·人事二》林逋隐居杭州孤山，常畜两鹤，纵之则飞入云霄，盘旋久之，復入笼中。逋常泛小艇，游西湖诸寺。有客至逋所居，则一童子出应门，延客坐，为开笼纵鹤。良久，逋必棹小船而归。盖尝以鹤飞为验也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·沈括《夢溪筆談·人事二》林逋隱居杭州孤山，常畜兩鶴，縱之則飛入雲霄，盤旋久之，復入籠中。逋常泛小艇，遊西湖諸寺。有客至逋所居，則一童子出應門，延客坐，為開籠縱鶴。良久，逋必棹小船而歸。蓋嘗以鶴飛為驗也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Shen Kuo's 'Dream Pool Essays': 'Lin Bu lived in seclusion on Gushan Island in Hangzhou, often keeping two cranes. When guests came, a boy would open the cage and release the cranes, and Lin Bu would soon return by boat.'
example: 兆熊说‘像是像，不过，有最重要的一点不像。人家和靖居士是～，你却是妻儿成群。’★唐浩明《曾国藩第一部·血祭》第二章四
exampleTraditional: 兆熊說‘像是像，不過，有最重要的一點不像。人家和靖居士是～，你卻是妻兒成群。’★唐浩明《曾國藩第一部·血祭》第二章四
exampleEn: Zhao Xiong said, 'It seems similar, but there is one crucial difference. He, like Hejing, had plum trees as wives and cranes as children, while you have a wife and children.' — Tang Haoming, 'Zeng Guofan: Blood Sacrifice', Chapter 2, Section 4

explanation: 原为佛家语，比喻彻悟禅理◇比喻彼此心意一致。
explanationTraditional: 原為佛家語，比喻徹悟禪理◇比喻彼此心意一致。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist term, meaning to fully comprehend Zen; later used to describe mutual understanding without words.
derivation: 《大梵天王问佛决疑经》尔时大梵天王即引若干眷属来奉献世尊于金婆罗华，各各顶礼佛足，退坐一面。尔时世尊即拈奉献金色婆罗华，瞬目扬眉，示诸大众，默然毋措。有迦叶破颜微笑。”
derivationTraditional: 《大梵天王問佛決疑經》爾時大梵天王即引若干眷屬來奉獻世尊於金婆羅華，各各頂禮佛足，退坐一面。爾時世尊即拈奉獻金色婆羅華，瞬目揚眉，示諸大眾，默然毋措。有迦葉破顏微笑。”
derivationEn: 'Sutra of the Great Brahma King's Question': 'The World-Honored One held up a golden flower, blinked, and showed it to the assembly. Only Mahakashyapa broke into a smile.'
example: 自家做来做去，原觉得口吻生花；他人看了又看，也必定～是亦缘也。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第一百回
exampleTraditional: 自家做來做去，原覺得口吻生花；他人看了又看，也必定～是亦緣也。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第一百回
exampleEn: I felt that my words were eloquent; others read and reread, and must have smiled knowingly—this too is fate. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 100

explanation: 形容静悄悄不出声息。同屏声敛息”。
explanationTraditional: 形容靜悄悄不出聲息。同屏聲斂息”。
explanationEn: To hold one's breath and remain silent, describing a very quiet atmosphere.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容跳起舞来的姿态。
explanationTraditional: 形容跳起舞來的姿態。
explanationEn: To dance gracefully, describing the posture of dancing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 面貌虽然是人，但心肠象野兽一样凶狠。形容为人凶残卑鄙。
explanationTraditional: 面貌雖然是人，但心腸象野獸一樣兇狠。形容為人兇殘卑鄙。
explanationEn: Having a human face but a beastly heart; describing someone cruel and despicable.
derivation: 《列子·黄帝》夏桀、殷纣、鲁醒、楚穆，状貌七窍皆同于人，而有禽兽之心。”《汉书·匈奴传赞》被发左衽，人面兽心。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·黃帝》夏桀、殷紂、魯醒、楚穆，狀貌七竅皆同於人，而有禽獸之心。”《漢書·匈奴傳贊》被髮左衽，人面獸心。”
derivationEn: 'Liezi, Yellow Emperor': 'Xia Jie, Yin Zhou, Lu Xing, Chu Mu—their appearance is human, but they have the heart of beasts.' 'Book of Han, Biography of the Xiongnu': 'With disheveled hair and left-sided garments, they have human faces but beastly hearts.'
example: 大虫见了兽面人心”的既不敢伤，若见了～”的如何不啖。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十回
exampleTraditional: 大蟲見了獸麵人心”的既不敢傷，若見了～”的如何不啖。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十回
exampleEn: The tiger dared not harm those with a beast's face but a human heart; but when it saw those with a human face but a beast's heart, how could it not devour them? — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 10

explanation: 通常情况下人们共有的情理或态度。
explanationTraditional: 通常情況下人們共有的情理或態度。
explanationEn: The common feelings or attitudes shared by people under normal circumstances.
derivation: 宋·司马光《应诏论体要》凡用一人，必或以为贤，或以为不肖，此固人情之常，自古而然，不足怪也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·司馬光《應詔論體要》凡用一人，必或以為賢，或以為不肖，此固人情之常，自古而然，不足怪也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Sima Guang's 'On the Essentials of Governance': 'Whenever someone is appointed, some consider him virtuous, others unworthy—this is human nature, common since ancient times, not surprising.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 快痛快。指坏人坏事受到惩罚或打击，使大家非常痛快。
explanationTraditional: 快痛快。指壞人壞事受到懲罰或打擊，使大家非常痛快。
explanationEn: To feel great satisfaction when evil is punished or justice is served.
derivation: 明·沈德符《万历野获编·立枷》东山受恩反噬，其罪盖浮于诸龙光。当时人心大快，佐以此得缙绅闻声，然亦不云立枷。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《萬曆野獲編·立枷》東山受恩反噬，其罪蓋浮於諸龍光。當時人心大快，佐以此得縉紳聞聲，然亦不雲立枷。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Shen Defu's 'Unofficial Gleanings of the Wanli Era': 'Dongshan received favor but turned against his benefactor; his crime was greater than that of the others. At that time, people felt great satisfaction.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 与山外距离远、人急至的山岭、山谷。
explanationTraditional: 與山外距離遠、人急至的山嶺、山谷。
explanationEn: Remote mountains and deep valleys far from human habitation.
derivation: 《列子·黄帝》寝吾庭者，不愿深山幽谷。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·黃帝》寢吾庭者，不願深山幽谷。”
derivationEn: From Liezi: 'Those who sleep in my courtyard do not wish for deep mountains and secluded valleys.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧指天上的军队和将领。也比喻本领高强的人们。
explanationTraditional: 舊指天上的軍隊和將領。也比喻本領高強的人們。
explanationEn: Heavenly soldiers and generals; also metaphorically refers to highly capable people.
derivation: 清·贾凫西《木皮散人鼓词·开场》那鲧却生的儿子，神通广大，伏虎降龙，手下天兵天将，那等利害。”
derivationTraditional: 清·賈鳧西《木皮散人鼓詞·開場》那鯀卻生的兒子，神通廣大，伏虎降龍，手下天兵天將，那等利害。”
derivationEn: From Qing dynasty Jia Fuxi's 'Mupi Sanren Drum Lyrics': 'The son of Gun was immensely powerful, could subdue tigers and dragons, and commanded heavenly soldiers and generals of great might.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 万死死一万次，形容冒生命危险。万一万次也不推辞。表示愿意拼死效劳。
explanationTraditional: 萬死死一萬次，形容冒生命危險。萬一萬次也不推辭。表示願意拼死效勞。
explanationEn: Willing to risk ten thousand deaths; ready to sacrifice one's life without hesitation.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八回貂蝉曰‘适间贱妾曾言，但有使令，万死不辞。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八回貂蟬曰‘適間賤妾曾言，但有使令，萬死不辭。’”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms': 'Diao Chan said, 'As I said before, if you command me, I will not refuse even if I die ten thousand deaths.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①形容嘻嘻哈哈的样子。②形容轻薄嘻笑的样子。③形容谄笑讨好的样子。
explanationTraditional: ①形容嘻嘻哈哈的樣子。②形容輕薄嘻笑的樣子。③形容諂笑討好的樣子。
explanationEn: Grinning cheekily; showing a frivolous or ingratiating smile.
derivation: ①《红楼梦》第三十回你要仔细！你见我和谁玩过！有和你素日嘻皮笑脸的那些姑娘们，你该问他们去！”②赵树理《小二黑结婚》三金旺来了，嘻皮笑脸向小芹说‘这会可算是个空子吧？”
derivationTraditional: ①《紅樓夢》第三十回你要仔細！你見我和誰玩過！有和你素日嘻皮笑臉的那些姑娘們，你該問他們去！”②趙樹理《小二黑結婚》三金旺來了，嘻皮笑臉向小芹說‘這會可算是個空子吧？”
derivationEn: From 'Dream of the Red Chamber': 'Be careful! Have you ever seen me play with anyone? You should ask those girls you usually joke and laugh with!'
example: ③张郎才说了一个宝字，财主就～跑到张郎面前‘小兄弟，你犁到金子银子了吗？给我看看。’★《中国民间故事选·张郎赛宝》
exampleTraditional: ③張郎才說了一個寶字，財主就～跑到張郎面前‘小兄弟，你犁到金子銀子了嗎？給我看看。’★《中國民間故事選·張郎賽寶》
exampleEn: From 'The Marriage of Xiao Erhei': 'Jin Wang came, grinning cheekily, and said to Xiaoqin, 'This is a good chance, isn't it?''

explanation: 伊文言助词；始开始。旧指新官刚到任。现比喻带着工作任务刚到一个地方。
explanationTraditional: 伊文言助詞；始開始。舊指新官剛到任。現比喻帶著工作任務剛到一個地方。
explanationEn: Upon first taking office; newly arrived at a post.
derivation: 《礼记·乐记》武王克殷，反商，未及下车而封黄帝之后于蓟。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·樂記》武王克殷，反商，未及下車而封黃帝之後於薊。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites': 'When King Wu conquered Yin, he enfeoffed the descendants of the Yellow Emperor in Ji before even alighting from his chariot.'
example: 有许多人～，就这也批评，那也指责，这是很不合适的。
exampleTraditional: 有許多人～，就這也批評，那也指責，這是很不合適的。
exampleEn: Many people, upon first arriving, criticize this and that, which is very inappropriate.

explanation: 扬名传播名声。四海古人认为中国四境有海环绕，故以四海”代指全国各处；也指世界各地。指名声传遍各地。
explanationTraditional: 揚名傳播名聲。四海古人認為中國四境有海環繞，故以四海”代指全國各處；也指世界各地。指名聲傳遍各地。
explanationEn: To become famous everywhere; to have one's name known throughout the world.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 游目远眺；骋怀放开胸怀，往远处想。纵目四望，开阔心胸。
explanationTraditional: 遊目遠眺；騁懷放開胸懷，往遠處想。縱目四望，開闊心胸。
explanationEn: To let one's eyes roam and one's mind expand; to enjoy the scenery and broaden one's thoughts.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《兰亭集序》仰观宇宙之大，俯察品类之盛，所以游目骋怀，足以极视听之娱，信可乐也。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《蘭亭集序》仰觀宇宙之大，俯察品類之盛，所以遊目騁懷，足以極視聽之娛，信可樂也。”
derivationEn: From Jin dynasty Wang Xizhi's 'Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection': 'Looking up at the vastness of the universe, looking down at the abundance of things, thus letting the eyes roam and the mind expand, enough to enjoy the utmost pleasure of sight and sound.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象云彩中的白鹤一般。比喻志行高洁的人。
explanationTraditional: 象雲彩中的白鶴一般。比喻志行高潔的人。
explanationEn: A white crane in the clouds; metaphor for a person of noble character and high ideals.
derivation: 《三国志·魏志·邴原传》裴松之注引《原别传》邴君所谓云中白鹤，非鹑鷃之网所能罗矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·魏志·邴原傳》裴松之注引《原別傳》邴君所謂雲中白鶴，非鶉鷃之網所能羅矣。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms': 'Mr. Bing is what is called a white crane in the clouds, not to be caught by nets meant for quails and partridges.'
example: 訏超超越俗，如半天朱霞；歳矫矫出尘，如～。★明·李贽《初潭集·兄弟上》
exampleTraditional: 訏超超越俗，如半天朱霞；歳矯矯出塵，如～。★明·李贄《初潭集·兄弟上》
exampleEn: From Ming dynasty Li Zhi's 'Chutan Ji': 'Xu transcends the mundane like a rosy cloud in the sky; Jiao stands out like a white crane in the clouds.'

explanation: 指代人出力或代写文章。
explanationTraditional: 指代人出力或代寫文章。
explanationEn: To write on behalf of someone else; to ghostwrite.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·客止》使崔季珪代，帝自捉刀立床头。既毕，令间谍问曰‘魏王如何？’匈奴使答曰‘魏王雅望非常，然床头捉刀人，此乃英雄也。’”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·客止》使崔季珪代，帝自捉刀立床頭。既畢，令間諜問曰‘魏王如何？’匈奴使答曰‘魏王雅望非常，然床頭捉刀人，此乃英雄也。’”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'Cao Cao had Cui Jigui impersonate him while he stood by the bed holding a sword. Afterward, he sent a spy to ask the Xiongnu envoy, 'What do you think of the King of Wei?' The envoy replied, 'The King of Wei has an elegant appearance, but the man by the bed holding the sword is the true hero.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 本为佛教表示事物众多的数字，后用以形容极多。
explanationTraditional: 本為佛教表示事物眾多的數字，後用以形容極多。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist term for a vast number; now used to describe an extremely large quantity.
derivation: 《法华经·宝塔品》若持八万四千法藏，十二部经，为人演说。”
derivationTraditional: 《法華經·寶塔品》若持八萬四千法藏，十二部經，為人演說。”
derivationEn: From 'Lotus Sutra': 'If one holds the eighty-four thousand dharma treasuries and the twelve divisions of scriptures, and preaches them for others.'
example: ～颠倒想，与君同付醉眠中。★宋·陆游《醉歌》
exampleTraditional: ～顛倒想，與君同付醉眠中。★宋·陸游《醉歌》
exampleEn: From Song dynasty Lu You's 'Drunken Song': 'Eighty-four thousand upside-down thoughts, I share with you in drunken sleep.'

explanation: 经传指被古人尊崇为典范的著作。经传上没有记载◇常指人没有名声或论述没有根据。
explanationTraditional: 經傳指被古人尊崇為典範的著作。經傳上沒有記載◇常指人沒有名聲或論述沒有根據。
explanationEn: Not recorded in classics; refers to a person without fame or an argument without basis.
derivation: 宋·罗大经《鹤林玉露》卷六三字虽不见经传，却亦甚雅。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·羅大經《鶴林玉露》卷六三字雖不見經傳，卻亦甚雅。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Luo Dajing's 'He Lin Yu Lu': 'Although the character is not seen in classics, it is quite elegant.'
example: 我们住的小胡同，连轿车也进不来，一向～。★老舍《吐了一口气》
exampleTraditional: 我們住的小衚衕，連轎車也進不來，一向～。★老舍《吐了一口氣》
exampleEn: The small alley we live in cannot even accommodate cars, and has never been famous. (Lao She, 'Letting Off Steam')

explanation: 走亲戚，看朋友。
explanationTraditional: 走親戚，看朋友。
explanationEn: To visit relatives and friends.
derivation: 张天民《路考》农民都愿意在春耕开始前赶集进城，串亲访友。”
derivationTraditional: 張天民《路考》農民都願意在春耕開始前趕集進城，串親訪友。”
derivationEn: Zhang Tianmin's 'Road Test': 'Farmers like to go to town and visit relatives and friends before spring plowing begins.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把大题目作成小文章。比喻把重大的问题当做小事情来处理。
explanationTraditional: 把大題目作成小文章。比喻把重大的問題當做小事情來處理。
explanationEn: To treat a major issue as a minor one; to make a small article out of a big topic.
derivation: 周作人《鬼的生长》但是千百年来已非一日，载籍浩如烟海，门外摸索，不得象尾，而且鬼界的问题似乎也多得很，尽够研究院里先生们一生的检讨，我这里只提出一个题目，即上面所说的鬼之生长，姑且大题小做，略陈管见，仁候明教。”
derivationTraditional: 周作人《鬼的生長》但是千百年來已非一日，載籍浩如煙海，門外摸索，不得象尾，而且鬼界的問題似乎也多得很，儘夠研究院裡先生們一生的檢討，我這裡只提出一個題目，即上面所說的鬼之生長，姑且大題小做，略陳管見，仁候明教。”
derivationEn: Zhou Zuoren's 'On the Growth of Ghosts': 'I only raise one topic, namely the growth of ghosts, and treat it lightly, offering my humble opinion.'
example: 这种打算实在是太幼稚，对国事言太近于～”，对文学言又像太近于小题大作”了。★《沈从文传》
exampleTraditional: 這種打算實在是太幼稚，對國事言太近於～”，對文學言又像太近於小題大作”了。★《沈從文傳》
exampleEn: This plan is too naive; regarding state affairs it is like 'treating a big issue as a small one', and regarding literature it is like 'making a mountain out of a molehill'. (Shen Congwen's Biography)

explanation: 大造声势，扩大影响。
explanationTraditional: 大造聲勢，擴大影響。
explanationEn: To make a big show of strength; to expand influence.
derivation: 《宋史·李师中传》今修筑必广发兵，大张声势。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·李師中傳》今修築必廣發兵，大張聲勢。”
derivationEn: 'History of Song: Biography of Li Shizhong': 'Now if we build fortifications, we must deploy troops extensively and make a great show of force.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 井指井栏；垣短墙。断了的井栏，倒塌的短墙。形容庭院破败的景象。
explanationTraditional: 井指井欄；垣短牆。斷了的井欄，倒塌的短牆。形容庭院破敗的景象。
explanationEn: Broken wells and collapsed walls; describes a desolate and ruined courtyard.
derivation: 明·汤显祖《牡丹亭》第十出原来姹紫嫣红开遍，似这般都付与断井颓垣。”
derivationTraditional: 明·湯顯祖《牡丹亭》第十齣原來奼紫嫣紅開遍，似這般都付與斷井頹垣。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Tang Xianzu's 'The Peony Pavilion': 'All the splendor of blooming flowers is left to broken wells and collapsed walls.'
example: 但系～，夸苔砌草，却怎便零落到这般田地呀！★清·梁启超《新罗马·吊古》
exampleTraditional: 但系～，誇苔砌草，卻怎便零落到這般田地呀！★清·梁啟超《新羅馬·弔古》
exampleEn: But with broken wells and collapsed walls, mossy steps and grassy paths, how could it have fallen to such a state! (Liang Qichao, 'New Rome: Mourning the Past')

explanation: 比喻事情很重要，不是闹着玩的。
explanationTraditional: 比喻事情很重要，不是鬧著玩的。
explanationEn: Not a child's play; something very important and serious.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十四回玩是玩，笑是笑，这个事非同儿戏，你可别混说！”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十四回玩是玩，笑是笑，這個事非同兒戲，你可別混說！”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber': 'Playing is playing, laughing is laughing, but this matter is no child's play; don't talk nonsense!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻事物的消失、完结。
explanationTraditional: 比喻事物的消失、完結。
explanationEn: Wind blows and clouds disperse; metaphor for the disappearance or end of things.
derivation: 康濯《春种秋收》这事儿是风吹云散，往后谁也不许提啦！”
derivationTraditional: 康濯《春種秋收》這事兒是風吹雲散，往後誰也不許提啦！”
derivationEn: Kang Zhuo's 'Spring Planting and Autumn Harvest': 'This matter is like wind blowing clouds away; from now on, no one is to mention it!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 芙蓉荷花。刚开放的荷花。比喻诗文清新不俗。也形容天然艳丽的女子。
explanationTraditional: 芙蓉荷花。剛開放的荷花。比喻詩文清新不俗。也形容天然豔麗的女子。
explanationEn: Lotus emerging from water; metaphor for fresh and elegant poetry or natural beauty of a woman.
derivation: 南朝·梁·钟嵘《诗品》卷中谢诗如芙蓉出水，颜如错彩镂金。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·鍾嶸《詩品》卷中謝詩如芙蓉出水，顏如錯彩鏤金。”
derivationEn: Southern Dynasties, Zhong Rong's 'The Poetic Grades': 'Xie's poetry is like lotus emerging from water, Yan's like intricate gold and carved jade.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 挂冠把官帽挂起来。脱下官帽要求离去。比喻辞官归隐。
explanationTraditional: 掛冠把官帽掛起來。脫下官帽要求離去。比喻辭官歸隱。
explanationEn: To hang up one's official hat and request to leave; metaphor for resigning and retiring.
derivation: 《后汉书·逢萌传》时王莽杀其子宇，萌谓友人曰‘三纲绝矣！不去，祸将及人。即解冠挂工都城门归，将家属浮海，客于辽东。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·逢萌傳》時王莽殺其子宇，萌謂友人曰‘三綱絕矣！不去，禍將及人。即解冠掛工都城門歸，將家屬浮海，客於遼東。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Feng Meng': 'Feng Meng hung his hat on the city gate and left, taking his family across the sea to live in Liaodong.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象棋规则中卒子只能向前，不能后退，过了河之后可以横着走，威力更大。比喻只能前进，不能后退。
explanationTraditional: 象棋規則中卒子只能向前，不能後退，過了河之後可以橫著走，威力更大。比喻只能前進，不能後退。
explanationEn: A pawn that has crossed the river; in Chinese chess, a pawn can only move forward but after crossing the river can move sideways, becoming more powerful. Metaphor for someone who can only advance, not retreat.
derivation: 刘绍棠《狼烟》二十四花言巧语蒙哄不了二位老人家，甜言蜜语也迷惑不了二位老人家，于是心慌意乱，闭上眼睛，手捧着怦怦乱跳的胸口，失悔自己的冒险进城，然而已经骑虎难下，只有做一名过河卒子了。”
derivationTraditional: 劉紹棠《狼煙》二十四花言巧語蒙哄不了二位老人家，甜言蜜語也迷惑不了二位老人家，於是心慌意亂，閉上眼睛，手捧著怦怦亂跳的胸口，失悔自己的冒險進城，然而已經騎虎難下，只有做一名過河卒子了。”
derivationEn: Liu Shaotang's 'Wolf Smoke': 'He felt like a pawn that had crossed the river, unable to turn back.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 修业推广、扩大功业。提高道德修养，扩大功业建树。
explanationTraditional: 修業推廣、擴大功業。提高道德修養，擴大功業建樹。
explanationEn: To improve one's moral character and expand one's achievements.
derivation: 《周易·乾》君子进德修业。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·乾》君子進德修業。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Qian': 'The gentleman advances in virtue and cultivates his work.'
example: 所谓有‘价值’，是必须使人看了在‘～’上得到多少的‘灵感’。★邹韬奋《经历》
exampleTraditional: 所謂有‘價值’，是必須使人看了在‘～’上得到多少的‘靈感’。★鄒韜奮《經歷》
exampleEn: What is called 'value' must inspire people to gain some 'inspiration' in 'improving virtue and cultivating work'. — Zou Taofen, 'Experience'

explanation: 像鲸鱼吞食一口吞下，像蚕吃桑叶逐步侵占。比喻用各种手段侵吞。
explanationTraditional: 像鯨魚吞食一口吞下，像蠶吃桑葉逐步侵佔。比喻用各種手段侵吞。
explanationEn: To swallow like a whale and nibble like a silkworm; metaphor for gradually annexing or encroaching by various means.
derivation: 清·王韬《英宜保土》若土耳机三土一旦为俄所鲸吞蚕食，则地兼三海，拓疆万里。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王韜《英宜保土》若土耳機三土一旦為俄所鯨吞蠶食，則地兼三海，拓疆萬里。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wang Tao's 'England Should Protect Turkey': 'If Turkey's three territories are once swallowed and nibbled by Russia, then it will span three seas and expand territory ten thousand miles.'
example: ～言终验，敌弱朋强局已更。★柳亚子《屈辱》诗
exampleTraditional: ～言終驗，敵弱朋強局已更。★柳亞子《屈辱》詩
exampleEn: The prophecy of 'swallowing and nibbling' finally came true, the enemy weak and the friend strong, the situation has changed. — Liu Yazi, 'Humiliation' poem

explanation: 神明泛指神，像敬重神一样敬重对方。形容对某人或某物崇拜到了极点。多用作贬义。
explanationTraditional: 神明泛指神，像敬重神一樣敬重對方。形容對某人或某物崇拜到了極點。多用作貶義。
explanationEn: To revere someone as if they were a god; to worship someone or something to the utmost. Often used pejoratively.
derivation: 《左传·襄公十四年》民奉其君，爱之如父母，仰之如日月，敬之如神明，畏之如雷霆。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·襄公十四年》民奉其君，愛之如父母，仰之如日月，敬之如神明，畏之如雷霆。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xiang's 14th Year': 'The people serve their ruler, love him as parents, look up to him as sun and moon, revere him as gods, fear him as thunder.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 君子有教养、有德行的人；固穷安守贫穷。指君子能够安贫乐道，不失节操。
explanationTraditional: 君子有教養、有德行的人；固窮安守貧窮。指君子能夠安貧樂道，不失節操。
explanationEn: A gentleman can remain steadfast in poverty; a virtuous person maintains integrity even in adversity.
derivation: 《论语·卫灵公》子曰‘君子固穷，小人穷斯滥矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·衛靈公》子曰‘君子固窮，小人窮斯濫矣。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Wei Ling Gong': 'Confucius said: 'A gentleman is steadfast in poverty; a petty person becomes reckless when poor.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 克己克制自己；慎谨慎。约束自己，小心做事。
explanationTraditional: 克己剋制自己；慎謹慎。約束自己，小心做事。
explanationEn: To restrain oneself and act cautiously.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《送齐皞下第序》故上之人行志择谊，坦乎其无忧于下也；下之人克己慎行，确乎其无惑于上也。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《送齊皞下第序》故上之人行志擇誼，坦乎其無憂於下也；下之人克己慎行，確乎其無惑於上也。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Preface to Seeing Qi Hao Off': 'Therefore, those above act with righteousness, calm and without worry about those below; those below restrain themselves and act cautiously, firm and without confusion about those above.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 喟然叹气的样子。因感慨而深深地叹气。
explanationTraditional: 喟然嘆氣的樣子。因感慨而深深地嘆氣。
explanationEn: To heave a deep sigh with emotion.
derivation: 《论语·子罕》颜渊喟然叹曰‘仰之弥高，钻之弥坚。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子罕》顏淵喟然嘆曰‘仰之彌高，鑽之彌堅。’”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Zi Han': 'Yan Yuan sighed deeply and said: 'The more I look up, the higher it seems; the more I delve, the harder it becomes.''
example: 时莫能听用其谋，～，自伤不遭。（冯衍《自论赋》）
exampleTraditional: 時莫能聽用其謀，～，自傷不遭。（馮衍《自論賦》）
exampleEn: At that time, no one listened to his plans, so he sighed deeply, lamenting his misfortune. — Feng Yan, 'Self-Narration'

explanation: 盘仔细查问；问寻问。盘问、追究事情的根由。
explanationTraditional: 盤仔細查問；問尋問。盤問、追究事情的根由。
explanationEn: To probe deeply into the root of a matter; to interrogate thoroughly.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十四回无如林之洋虽在海外走过几次，诸事并不留心，究竟见闻不广，被小山盘根问底，今日也谈，明日也谈，腹中所有若干典故，久已告竣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十四回無如林之洋雖在海外走過幾次，諸事並不留心，究竟見聞不廣，被小山盤根問底，今日也談，明日也談，腹中所有若干典故，久已告竣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 44: 'But Lin Zhiyang, though he had traveled overseas several times, was not observant and had limited knowledge. Being questioned thoroughly by Xiaoshan day after day, he soon exhausted all the anecdotes he knew.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 蚂蚁想摇动大树。比喻自不量力。
explanationTraditional: 螞蟻想搖動大樹。比喻自不量力。
explanationEn: An ant trying to shake a tree; metaphor for overestimating one's strength.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《调张籍》诗蚍蜉撼大树，可笑不自量。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《調張籍》詩蚍蜉撼大樹，可笑不自量。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'To Zhang Ji' poem: 'Ants shaking a big tree, laughable and overreaching.'
example: 蚂蚁缘槐夸大国，～谈何易。★毛泽东《满江红·和郭沫若同志》
exampleTraditional: 螞蟻緣槐誇大國，～談何易。★毛澤東《滿江紅·和郭沫若同志》
exampleEn: The ant boasts of its kingdom on the locust tree, and the mayfly shakes the tree—how easy is that? — Mao Zedong, 'Man Jiang Hong: In Reply to Comrade Guo Moruo'

explanation: 犹千辛万苦。各种各样的艰难困苦。
explanationTraditional: 猶千辛萬苦。各種各樣的艱難困苦。
explanationEn: All kinds of hardships and difficulties.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容非常顺从。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常順從。
explanationEn: To be extremely obedient; to comply with every request.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十七凡是船家教他做些什么，他千依百顺。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十七凡是船家教他做些什麼，他千依百順。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'First Slap the Table in Amazement', Volume 27: 'Whatever the boatman asked him to do, he obeyed in every way.'
example: 苟太太此时，自是～，连忙请姨妈来，悄悄说知，姨妈自无不依之理。★清·吴研人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第八十九回
exampleTraditional: 苟太太此時，自是～，連忙請姨媽來，悄悄說知，姨媽自無不依之理。★清·吳研人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第八十九回
exampleEn: At this time, Mrs. Gou was naturally extremely obedient, and quickly invited the aunt to come and quietly told her. The aunt naturally had no reason not to comply. — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 89

explanation: 形容姿态多种多样。同千姿百态”。
explanationTraditional: 形容姿態多種多樣。同千姿百態”。
explanationEn: Describing a variety of postures or forms; same as '千姿百态'.
derivation: 贺敬之《桂林山水歌》望不尽，千姿万态独秀峰。”
derivationTraditional: 賀敬之《桂林山水歌》望不盡，千姿萬態獨秀峰。”
derivationEn: From He Jingzhi's 'Song of Guilin Mountains': 'Endless view, thousands of postures on the Unique Peak.'
example: 长江三日，～，现在已不是前天那样大雾迷蒙，也不是昨天‘巫山巫峡色萧森’，而是‘楚地阔无边，苍茫万顷连’了。★刘白羽《长江三日》
exampleTraditional: 長江三日，～，現在已不是前天那樣大霧迷濛，也不是昨天‘巫山巫峽色蕭森’，而是‘楚地闊無邊，蒼茫萬頃連’了。★劉白羽《長江三日》
exampleEn: On the three days of the Yangtze River, it was now not the heavy fog of two days ago, nor the 'dark and dreary Wu Gorge' of yesterday, but 'the Chu land vast and boundless, a myriad miles of misty waves.' — Liu Baiyu, 'Three Days on the Yangtze River'

explanation: 谓人的内心难以探测。
explanationTraditional: 謂人的內心難以探測。
explanationEn: It is difficult to fathom a person's heart or intentions.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》始常山王、成安君为布衣时，相与为刎颈之交……此二人相与，天下至欢也。然而卒相禽者，何也？患生于多欲，而人心难测也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》始常山王、成安君為布衣時，相與為刎頸之交……此二人相與，天下至歡也。然而卒相禽者，何也？患生於多欲，而人心難測也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin': 'Changshan King and Cheng'an Lord, when commoners, were sworn friends... yet they ended up attacking each other. Why? Trouble arises from excessive desires, and the human heart is hard to fathom.'
example: 看官你道赚去商家物事的，和是那个？真个是～，海水难量。原来就是贾廉访。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二十
exampleTraditional: 看官你道賺去商家物事的，和是那個？真個是～，海水難量。原來就是賈廉訪。★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二十
exampleEn: Dear reader, do you know who cheated the merchant of his goods? Truly, 'the human heart is hard to fathom, the sea is hard to measure.' It was none other than Jia Lianfang. — Ling Mengchu, 'Slapping the Table in Amazement, Part II', Volume 20

explanation: 偷苟且。忍受屈辱，苟且活命。
explanationTraditional: 偷苟且。忍受屈辱，苟且活命。
explanationEn: To endure humiliation and live on in a cowardly manner.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八回止因未与将军一诀，故且忍辱偷生。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八回止因未與將軍一訣，故且忍辱偷生。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 8: 'Only because I have not yet bid you farewell, I endure humiliation and live on.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 看成好朋友。
explanationTraditional: 看成好朋友。
explanationEn: To regard someone as a close friend.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容山或建筑物很高，都进了云端。
explanationTraditional: 形容山或建築物很高，都進了雲端。
explanationEn: Describing a mountain or building so tall that it reaches into the clouds.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容做事没有魄力。
explanationTraditional: 形容做事沒有魄力。
explanationEn: Describing someone who acts without boldness or courage.
derivation: 峻青《海啸》第四章你喝起酒来，却小手小脚的。这未免和你的身分不相称吧！”
derivationTraditional: 峻青《海嘯》第四章你喝起酒來，卻小手小腳的。這未免和你的身分不相稱吧！”
derivationEn: From Jun Qing's 'Hai Xiao', Chapter 4: 'When you drink, you are so timid and cautious. This hardly matches your status!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指野兽凶残吞噬的大嘴。也比喻剥削者、侵略者蚕食鲸吞的巨大胃口。
explanationTraditional: 指野獸兇殘吞噬的大嘴。也比喻剝削者、侵略者蠶食鯨吞的巨大胃口。
explanationEn: Refers to the ferocious, devouring mouth of a wild beast. Also metaphorically describes the insatiable appetite of exploiters or aggressors.
derivation: 唐·变文《叶净能诗》眼如悬镜，口若血盆，毒气成云。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·變文《葉淨能詩》眼如懸鏡，口若血盆，毒氣成雲。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty transformation text 'Ye Jingneng': 'Eyes like hanging mirrors, mouth like a blood basin, poisonous breath forming clouds.'
example: 原来身后有个山羊在那里吃草，却被大虫看见，扑了过去，抱住山羊，张开～，羊头吃在腹内。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十九回
exampleTraditional: 原來身後有個山羊在那裡吃草，卻被大蟲看見，撲了過去，抱住山羊，張開～，羊頭吃在腹內。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十九回
exampleEn: It turned out that a goat was grazing behind him, and the tiger pounced on it, hugged it, opened its blood basin-like mouth, and ate the goat's head. — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 49

explanation: 一次又一次的失误。形容屡被耽误或屡犯错误。
explanationTraditional: 一次又一次的失誤。形容屢被耽誤或屢犯錯誤。
explanationEn: To make repeated mistakes; to be repeatedly delayed or commit errors.
derivation: 《宋史·魏王廷美传》太宗尝以传国之意访之赵普。普曰‘太祖已误，陛下岂容再误邪？’”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·魏王廷美傳》太宗嘗以傳國之意訪之趙普。普曰‘太祖已誤，陛下豈容再誤邪？’”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Wei Wang Tingmei': 'Emperor Taizong once consulted Zhao Pu about succession. Zhao Pu said, 'The first emperor already made a mistake; how can Your Majesty repeat it?'
example: 徒以误解民治真精神，且过恃自己之武力，～，而卒自陷于穷途。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一二五回
exampleTraditional: 徒以誤解民治真精神，且過恃自己之武力，～，而卒自陷於窮途。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一二五回
exampleEn: Simply because they misunderstood the true spirit of democracy and over-relied on their own military strength, they made one mistake after another and finally found themselves in a dead end. — Cai Dongfan and Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 125

explanation: 指用钱满不在乎，一花就是一大笔。
explanationTraditional: 指用錢滿不在乎，一花就是一大筆。
explanationEn: To spend money carelessly, throwing away a huge sum at once.
derivation: 《晋书·何无忌传》刘毅家无儋石之储，樗蒱一掷百万。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·何無忌傳》劉毅家無儋石之儲，樗蒱一擲百萬。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of He Wuji': 'Liu Yi had not a single grain of rice in his home, but he could gamble away a million in one throw.'
example: 到那赌，刘毅～，是顷刻间可以破家的。★明·东鲁古狂生《醉醒石》第七回
exampleTraditional: 到那賭，劉毅～，是頃刻間可以破家的。★明·東魯古狂生《醉醒石》第七回
exampleEn: When it came to gambling, Liu Yi could lose a million in one throw, ruining his family in an instant. — Donglu Gukuangsheng, 'Awakening the World from Drunkenness', Chapter 7

explanation: 锦有彩色花纹的丝织品。夜里穿着锦绣衣服走路。比喻不能在人前显示荣华富贵。
explanationTraditional: 錦有彩色花紋的絲織品。夜裡穿著錦繡衣服走路。比喻不能在人前顯示榮華富貴。
explanationEn: Walking at night in embroidered clothes. Metaphor for not being able to display one's wealth and honor in front of others.
derivation: 《史记·项羽本纪传》富贵不归故乡，如衣锦夜行。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·項羽本紀傳》富貴不歸故鄉，如衣錦夜行。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Xiang Yu': 'If one becomes rich and does not return to his hometown, it is like walking at night in embroidered clothes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 只有前进，没有后退。
explanationTraditional: 只有前進，沒有後退。
explanationEn: Only advance, never retreat.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第六十一回军中无戏言！吾二人当亲冒矢石，昼夜攻之，有进无退。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第六十一回軍中無戲言！吾二人當親冒矢石，晝夜攻之，有進無退。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 61: 'There is no joking in the army! We two shall personally face arrows and stones, attacking day and night, only advancing, never retreating.'
example: 左右横排断后刀，～退则杀。★清·黄遵宪《冯将军歌》
exampleTraditional: 左右橫排斷後刀，～退則殺。★清·黃遵憲《馮將軍歌》
exampleEn: Left and right rows form a rear-guard with knives; if you retreat, you will be killed. — Qing Dynasty, Huang Zunxian's 'Song of General Feng'

explanation: 象玉那样洁白，象冰那样清净。形容人心地纯洁，品行端正。
explanationTraditional: 象玉那樣潔白，象冰那樣清淨。形容人心地純潔，品行端正。
explanationEn: Pure as jade and clear as ice; describes a person with a pure heart and upright character.
derivation: 汉·桓谭《新论·妄瑕》伯夷叔齐，冰清玉洁，以义不为孤竹之嗣，不食周粟，饿死首阳。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·桓譚《新論·妄瑕》伯夷叔齊，冰清玉潔，以義不為孤竹之嗣，不食周粟，餓死首陽。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Huan Tan's 'New Discourses': 'Bo Yi and Shu Qi were as pure as ice and clean as jade; they refused to be heirs of Guzhu for righteousness, would not eat the grain of Zhou, and starved to death on Shouyang Mountain.'
example: 若辈一经用了手脚，随你三贞九烈，～，亦不能跳出圈外。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 若輩一經用了手腳，隨你三貞九烈，～，亦不能跳出圈外。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第十二回
exampleEn: Once they use their tricks, no matter how chaste or pure you are, you cannot escape the trap. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 12

explanation: 殆危险。知道适可而止的人就不会遇到危险。旧时劝人行事不要过分。
explanationTraditional: 殆危險。知道適可而止的人就不會遇到危險。舊時勸人行事不要過分。
explanationEn: Knowing when to stop prevents danger; advises against overdoing things.
derivation: 《老子》第四十四章知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第四十四章知足不辱，知止不殆，可以長久。”
derivationEn: 'Laozi', Chapter 44: 'Contentment brings no disgrace; knowing when to stop brings no danger; thus one can endure long.'
example: 甚爱必大费，多藏必厚仁，知足不辱，～。★明·赵弼《两教辨》
exampleTraditional: 甚愛必大費，多藏必厚仁，知足不辱，～。★明·趙弼《兩教辨》
exampleEn: Excessive love leads to great expense; excessive hoarding leads to heavy loss. Contentment brings no disgrace; knowing when to stop brings no danger. — Ming Dynasty, Zhao Bi's 'Debate on Two Teachings'

explanation: 转悲哀为喜悦。
explanationTraditional: 轉悲哀為喜悅。
explanationEn: Turn sorrow into joy.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十九回良箴听了，不觉转悲为喜，再三道谢。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十九回良箴聽了，不覺轉悲為喜，再三道謝。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 59: 'Liang Zhen heard this and turned sorrow into joy, thanking him repeatedly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 追究底细。同追根究底”。
explanationTraditional: 追究底細。同追根究底”。
explanationEn: Get to the bottom of something; investigate thoroughly.
derivation: 康濯《春种秋收·三面宝镜》至于后来那水车问题，他也实在说的毫无漏洞，但老来旺一伙竟非要拧住他追根问底！”
derivationTraditional: 康濯《春種秋收·三面寶鏡》至於後來那水車問題，他也實在說的毫無漏洞，但老來旺一夥竟非要擰住他追根問底！”
derivationEn: Kang Zhuo's 'Spring Planting and Autumn Harvest: Three-Sided Mirror': 'As for the waterwheel problem later, he really had no loopholes in his explanation, but Old Laiwang and his group insisted on pressing him to get to the bottom of it!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 魁为首的。作恶犯罪的头子。
explanationTraditional: 魁為首的。作惡犯罪的頭子。
explanationEn: Chief culprit; ringleader of a crime or disaster.
derivation: 明·郑若庸《玉玦记·索命》虽是虔婆杀我，娟奴是祸首罪魁，追了他去。”
derivationTraditional: 明·鄭若庸《玉玦記·索命》雖是虔婆殺我，娟奴是禍首罪魁，追了他去。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Zheng Ruoyong's 'Jade Hairpin: Demanding Life': 'Although the procuress killed me, Juan Nu is the chief culprit; pursue her.'
example: 这场空难事故的～竟然是一只在机场上空飞翔的鸽子。
exampleTraditional: 這場空難事故的～竟然是一隻在機場上空飛翔的鴿子。
exampleEn: The chief culprit of this air crash was actually a pigeon flying over the airport.

explanation: 大体关系全局的道理。不懂得从大局考虑。
explanationTraditional: 大體關係全局的道理。不懂得從大局考慮。
explanationEn: Fail to see the overall situation; lack understanding of the general interest.
derivation: 《史记·平原虞卿列传》平原君，翩翩浊世之佳公子也，然未睹大体。”晋·袁宏《后汉记》卷一○臣愚浅，不识大体。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原虞卿列傳》平原君，翩翩濁世之佳公子也，然未睹大體。”晉·袁宏《後漢記》卷一○臣愚淺，不識大體。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Pingyuan and Yuqing': 'Lord Pingyuan was a graceful nobleman of a chaotic age, but he did not see the big picture.' Jin Dynasty, Yuan Hong's 'Later Han Annals', Vol. 10: 'I am foolish and shallow, and do not understand the general interest.'
example: 上斥为～，仍谕内监在外生事者听人责惩。★《清史稿·高宗本纪》
exampleTraditional: 上斥為～，仍諭內監在外生事者聽人責懲。★《清史稿·高宗本紀》
exampleEn: The emperor rebuked him for failing to see the overall situation, and still ordered that eunuchs causing trouble outside could be punished by others. — 'Qing History Manuscript: Annals of Gaozong'

explanation: 犹言迟疑不决。
explanationTraditional: 猶言遲疑不決。
explanationEn: Hesitate; be indecisive.
derivation: 《易·蒙》初筮告，再三渎，渎则不告”唐·孔颖达疏师若迟疑不定，或再或三，是亵渎，渎则不告。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·蒙》初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告”唐·孔穎達疏師若遲疑不定，或再或三，是褻瀆，瀆則不告。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Changes: Meng Hexagram': 'If the teacher hesitates and is indecisive, or repeats himself two or three times, it is blasphemy, and blasphemy will not be answered.' — Tang Dynasty, Kong Yingda's commentary.
example: ～的神色就很显然地浮上了杜竹斋的山羊脸儿。★茅盾《子夜》二
exampleTraditional: ～的神色就很顯然地浮上了杜竹齋的山羊臉兒。★茅盾《子夜》二
exampleEn: The look of hesitation was clearly visible on Du Zhuzhai's goat-like face. — Mao Dun's 'Midnight', Chapter 2

explanation: 盈盛满；泰平安。旧指在富贵极盛的时候要小心谨慎，避免灾祸，以保持住原来的地位。
explanationTraditional: 盈盛滿；泰平安。舊指在富貴極盛的時候要小心謹慎，避免災禍，以保持住原來的地位。
explanationEn: Maintain prosperity and peace; act cautiously in times of great wealth and power to avoid disaster and preserve one's position.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·凫鷖》小序太平之君子，能持盈守成。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·鳧鷖》小序太平之君子，能持盈守成。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Daya: Fuyi' preface: 'The peace-loving gentleman can maintain fullness and preserve success.'
example: 同时也怕是他自己的官阶已经达到了使他要～的时候。★郭沫若《少年时代·我的童年》
exampleTraditional: 同時也怕是他自己的官階已經達到了使他要～的時候。★郭沫若《少年時代·我的童年》
exampleEn: At the same time, he probably felt that his official rank had reached the point where he needed to maintain prosperity and peace. — Guo Moruo's 'Youth: My Childhood'

explanation: 诵称诵、传述。在某一个时期内，人们到处传述。
explanationTraditional: 誦稱誦、傳述。在某一個時期內，人們到處傳述。
explanationEn: Be widely recited or praised for a time.
derivation: 鲁迅《洋服的没落》这故事颇为传诵一时……不过其中是带一点反对革命的意味的。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《洋服的沒落》這故事頗為傳誦一時……不過其中是帶一點反對革命的意味的。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'The Decline of Western Clothing': 'This story was quite widely recited for a time... but it contained a hint of opposition to revolution.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 放声痛哭。形容非常伤心。
explanationTraditional: 放聲痛哭。形容非常傷心。
explanationEn: To cry loudly and bitterly, expressing extreme sorrow.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第八十九回少奶奶掩面大哭道‘只是我的天唷！’说着大放悲声。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第八十九回少奶奶掩面大哭道‘只是我的天唷！’說著大放悲聲。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 89: 'The young lady covered her face and cried loudly, saying 'Oh my heaven!' and then burst into bitter wailing.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 覆翻过来。形容变化巨大。也形容闹得很凶。
explanationTraditional: 覆翻過來。形容變化巨大。也形容鬧得很兇。
explanationEn: Describes a huge change or a great upheaval; also used to describe a violent disturbance.
derivation: 唐·刘商《胡笳十八拍》六天翻地覆谁得知？如今正南看北斗。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉商《胡笳十八拍》六天翻地覆誰得知？如今正南看北斗。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Shang's 'Eighteen Songs of the Hu Jia': 'Heaven and earth overturned, who knows? Now the south points to the Big Dipper.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指不该说而说。
explanationTraditional: 指不該說而說。
explanationEn: To say things that should not be said; to speak unnecessarily or inappropriately.
derivation: 《水浒传》第六一回卢俊义道‘你妇人家省得什么！宁可信其有，不可信其无。自古祸出师人口，必主吉凶。我既主意定了，你都不得多言多语。’”
derivationTraditional: 《水滸傳》第六一回盧俊義道‘你婦人家省得什麼！寧可信其有，不可信其無。自古禍出師人口，必主吉凶。我既主意定了，你都不得多言多語。’”
derivationEn: From 'Water Margin', Chapter 61: 'Lu Junyi said, 'What do you women know? Better to believe it exists than not. Since ancient times, disaster comes from the mouth. I have made up my mind, you must not speak more than necessary.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在风里晃动的烛光。比喻随时可能死亡的老年人。也比喻随时可能消灭的事物。
explanationTraditional: 在風裡晃動的燭光。比喻隨時可能死亡的老年人。也比喻隨時可能消滅的事物。
explanationEn: A candle flickering in the wind; metaphor for an elderly person who may die at any time, or something that may be extinguished at any moment.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《题卫夫人笔陈图后》时年五十有三，或恐风烛奄及，聊遗教于子孙耳。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《題衛夫人筆陳圖後》時年五十有三，或恐風燭奄及，聊遺教於子孫耳。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Wang Xizhi's 'Postscript to Lady Wei's Brush Diagram': 'At fifty-three, I fear the wind and candle may suddenly overtake me, so I leave this teaching for my descendants.'
example: 老拙夫妇年近七旬，如～，早暮难保。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷十
exampleTraditional: 老拙夫婦年近七旬，如～，早暮難保。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷十
exampleEn: The old couple, nearly seventy, are like candles in the wind, hard to keep from morning to night. — Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 10

explanation: 甘自愿；居在（某种位置）。指甘心落在他人之后。
explanationTraditional: 甘自願；居在（某種位置）。指甘心落在他人之後。
explanationEn: To be willing to fall behind others; to be content to be inferior.
derivation: 明·张岱《自为墓志铭》夺利争名，甘居人后，观场游戏，肯让人先。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張岱《自為墓誌銘》奪利爭名，甘居人後，觀場遊戲，肯讓人先。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Zhang Dai's 'Self-Epitaph': 'Striving for profit and fame, I am willing to be behind others; watching the game, I let others go first.'
example: 她是负有使命的人，都是罄着所有生命之力在奔跑，他也就不愿～了。★老舍《四世同堂》五八
exampleTraditional: 她是負有使命的人，都是罄著所有生命之力在奔跑，他也就不願～了。★老舍《四世同堂》五八
exampleEn: She was on a mission, running with all her life's strength, so he was unwilling to be left behind. — Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof', Chapter 58

explanation: 左看右看，自以为了不起。形容得意忘形的样子。
explanationTraditional: 左看右看，自以為了不起。形容得意忘形的樣子。
explanationEn: To look around and consider oneself great; describes a smug, self-satisfied demeanor.
derivation: 《宋书·范晔传》跃马顾盼，自以为一世之雄。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·范曄傳》躍馬顧盼，自以為一世之雄。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Song', Biography of Fan Ye: 'Riding a horse and looking around, he considered himself the hero of the age.'
example: 少年恃其刚悍，～，视乡党如无物。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·姑妄听之》
exampleTraditional: 少年恃其剛悍，～，視鄉黨如無物。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·姑妄聽之》
exampleEn: The young man, relying on his toughness, looked around with self-importance, treating his fellow villagers as if they were nothing. — Qing Dynasty Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage', 'Gossip'

explanation: 呵欠困倦时往往情不自禁地张开大口吸气的现象。不断的打哈欠。①形容尚未睡醒。②比喻非常疲倦的样子。亦作哈气连天”。
explanationTraditional: 呵欠睏倦時往往情不自禁地張開大口吸氣的現象。不斷的打哈欠。①形容尚未睡醒。②比喻非常疲倦的樣子。亦作哈氣連天”。
explanationEn: To yawn repeatedly; describes being not yet awake or very tired.
derivation: ①明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷六春花也为起得早了，在小师父房里打盹，听得家主婆叫响，呵欠连天，走到面前。”②又卷一众人都被风颠得头晕，个个是呵欠连天，不肯同去。”
derivationTraditional: ①明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷六春花也為起得早了，在小師父房裡打盹，聽得家主婆叫響，呵欠連天，走到面前。”②又卷一眾人都被風顛得頭暈，個個是呵欠連天，不肯同去。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Ling Mengchu's 'First Slap the Table in Surprise', Volume 6: 'Chunhua, having gotten up early, was dozing in the young monk's room. Hearing her mistress call, she yawned repeatedly and came over.' Also Volume 1: 'Everyone was dizzy from the wind, all yawning repeatedly, unwilling to go together.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 老虎嘴里幸存下来的生命。比喻逃脱极危险的境地侥幸活下来。
explanationTraditional: 老虎嘴裡倖存下來的生命。比喻逃脫極危險的境地僥倖活下來。
explanationEn: To survive from a tiger's mouth; metaphor for escaping a extremely dangerous situation and surviving.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》孔子曰‘然，丘所谓无病而自灸也，疾走料虎头，编虎须，几不免虎口哉。”
