derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》孔子曰‘然，丘所謂無病而自灸也，疾走料虎頭，編虎鬚，幾不免虎口哉。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi', 'Robber Zhi': 'Confucius said, 'Yes, I am like one who moxas without illness, runs to touch the tiger's head, braids its whiskers, and barely escapes its mouth.''
example: 我如今在～，急腾腾再不消停。★元·无名氏《硃砂担》第一折
exampleTraditional: 我如今在～，急騰騰再不消停。★元·無名氏《硃砂擔》第一折
exampleEn: Now I have escaped from the tiger's mouth, urgently I will not delay any longer. — Yuan Dynasty Anonymous 'The Red Sand Pill', First Act

explanation: 骄兵恃强轻敌的军队。骄傲的军队必定打败仗。
explanationTraditional: 驕兵恃強輕敵的軍隊。驕傲的軍隊必定打敗仗。
explanationEn: An arrogant army is doomed to defeat; pride goes before a fall.
derivation: 《汉书·魏相传》恃国家之大，矜人民之众，欲见威于敌者，谓之骄兵，兵骄者灭。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·魏相傳》恃國家之大，矜人民之眾，欲見威於敵者，謂之驕兵，兵驕者滅。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han', Biography of Wei Xiang: 'Relying on the state's greatness and the people's numbers, wanting to show power to the enemy, this is called an arrogant army; an arrogant army is destroyed.'
example: 古人云～。”这就是少剑波致死的原因。★曲波《林海雪原》二八
exampleTraditional: 古人云～。”這就是少劍波致死的原因。★曲波《林海雪原》二八
exampleEn: The ancients said, 'An arrogant army is doomed to defeat.' That is the reason for Shao Jianbo's death. — Qu Bo's 'Forest Sea and Snow Plain', Chapter 28

explanation: 形容在最危险的时候得到生路。
explanationTraditional: 形容在最危險的時候得到生路。
explanationEn: To find a way out when in the most dangerous situation; to be rescued from a desperate situation.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言·桂员外途穷忏悔》常言‘吉人天相，绝处逢生。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言·桂員外途窮懺悔》常言‘吉人天相，絕處逢生。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World': 'As the saying goes, 'Heaven helps the good, and one finds a way out of desperation.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 慨然慷慨、爽快。形容豪不犹豫地答应下来。
explanationTraditional: 慨然慷慨、爽快。形容豪不猶豫地答應下來。
explanationEn: To readily and generously agree without hesitation.
derivation: 明·无名氏《杨家将演义》第二十七回令婆召孟良入与言其事，孟良慨然领诺。”
derivationTraditional: 明·無名氏《楊家將演義》第二十七回令婆召孟良入與言其事，孟良慨然領諾。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty anonymous 'The Yang Family Generals' Chapter 27: 'Ling Po summoned Meng Liang and told him the matter; Meng Liang readily agreed.'
example: 张君是认定《浮士德》有可译价值的之一人，我也是认为有可译的价值的，所以我当时也就～了。★郭沫若《论文学的研究与介绍》
exampleTraditional: 張君是認定《浮士德》有可譯價值的之一人，我也是認為有可譯的價值的，所以我當時也就～了。★郭沫若《論文學的研究與介紹》
exampleEn: Mr. Zhang was one of those who believed 'Faust' was worth translating, and I also thought it had translation value, so I readily agreed at that time. — Guo Moruo 'On Literary Research and Introduction'

explanation: 从竹管的小孔里看豹，只看到豹身上的一块斑纹。比喻只看到事物的一部分，指所见不全面或略有所得。
explanationTraditional: 從竹管的小孔裡看豹，只看到豹身上的一塊斑紋。比喻只看到事物的一部分，指所見不全面或略有所得。
explanationEn: To see only a part of something, implying incomplete understanding or limited insight.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·方正》此郎亦管中窥豹，时见一斑。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·方正》此郎亦管中窺豹，時見一斑。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' (Southern Dynasties): 'This young man is like looking at a leopard through a bamboo tube, occasionally seeing a spot.'
example: 有的人孤陋寡闻，～，却喜欢夸夸其谈，炫耀自己。
exampleTraditional: 有的人孤陋寡聞，～，卻喜歡誇誇其談，炫耀自己。
exampleEn: Some people are ignorant and only see a part of things, yet they like to boast and show off.

explanation: 临遭遇，碰到；惧戒惧。遇事谨慎戒惧。
explanationTraditional: 臨遭遇，碰到；懼戒懼。遇事謹慎戒懼。
explanationEn: To be cautious and apprehensive when facing a task.
derivation: 《论语·述而》必也临事而惧，好谋而成者也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》必也臨事而懼，好謀而成者也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects of Confucius': 'One must be cautious when facing a task and good at planning to succeed.'
example: 夫庙算而后出军，犹～，况今庙算有阙而欲用之，臣诚未见其利也。★《三国志·魏志·辛毗传》
exampleTraditional: 夫廟算而後出軍，猶～，況今廟算有闕而欲用之，臣誠未見其利也。★《三國志·魏志·辛毗傳》
exampleEn: If even after careful planning one should be cautious, how much more so when planning is lacking? I truly see no benefit. — 'Records of the Three Kingdoms'

explanation: 指以出卖诗文所得来维持生计。
explanationTraditional: 指以出賣詩文所得來維持生計。
explanationEn: To make a living by selling one's writings or poems.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《闻斛斯六官未归》故人南郡去，云索作碑钱。本卖文为活，翻令室倒悬。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《聞斛斯六官未歸》故人南郡去，雲索作碑錢。本賣文為活，翻令室倒懸。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Hearing that斛斯 Sixth Official Has Not Returned': 'An old friend went to the southern commandery, asking for money to write an epitaph. Originally living by selling writings, now the house is upside down.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指言语或动作鲁莽。
explanationTraditional: 指言語或動作魯莽。
explanationEn: To speak or act rashly and without proper restraint.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第69回那小孩子没轻没重的便说不好了，石师爷的老太太上了吊了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第69回那小孩子沒輕沒重的便說不好了，石師爺的老太太上了吊了。”
derivationEn: From Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' Chapter 69: 'That child, without any sense of propriety, said, 'Oh no, Master Shi's old lady has hanged herself.''
example: 管秀芬这丫头，打断我们的谈话，～的。★周而复《上海的早晨》第一部
exampleTraditional: 管秀芬這丫頭，打斷我們的談話，～的。★周而復《上海的早晨》第一部
exampleEn: Guan Xiufen interrupted our conversation, speaking and acting rashly. — Zhou Erfu 'Morning in Shanghai' Part One

explanation: 佛教用语。认为世界上的事物都象梦境、幻术、水泡和影子一样空虚◇比喻空虚而容易破灭的幻想。
explanationTraditional: 佛教用語。認為世界上的事物都象夢境、幻術、水泡和影子一樣空虛◇比喻空虛而容易破滅的幻想。
explanationEn: Buddhist term meaning that all worldly things are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows; empty and easily shattered fantasies.
derivation: 《金刚般若波罗蜜经·应化非真分》一切有为法，如梦幻泡影，如露亦如电，应作如是观。”
derivationTraditional: 《金剛般若波羅蜜經·應化非真分》一切有為法，如夢幻泡影，如露亦如電，應作如是觀。”
derivationEn: From 'Diamond Sutra': 'All conditioned phenomena are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, shadows, like dew and lightning; thus should they be contemplated.'
example: 但听得那长老将～”四个字，已讲得天花乱坠，大众无不齐声念佛。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第六十一回
exampleTraditional: 但聽得那長老將～”四個字，已講得天花亂墜，大眾無不齊聲唸佛。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第六十一回
exampleEn: But when the elder explained the four words 'dreams, illusions, bubbles, shadows,' he spoke so eloquently that everyone chanted Buddha's name. — Qing Dynasty Qian Cai 'The Story of Yue Fei' Chapter 61

explanation: 人民的生计在于勤劳。
explanationTraditional: 人民的生計在於勤勞。
explanationEn: The people's livelihood depends on diligence.
derivation: 《左传·宣公十二年》民生在勤，勤而不匮。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公十二年》民生在勤，勤而不匱。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan' Duke Xuan 12th year: 'The people's livelihood depends on diligence; with diligence, there is no scarcity.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 衣袖中除清风外，别无所有。比喻做官廉洁。也比喻穷得一无所有。
explanationTraditional: 衣袖中除清風外，別無所有。比喻做官廉潔。也比喻窮得一無所有。
explanationEn: To have nothing in one's sleeves but the clear wind; metaphor for an official being incorruptible or being extremely poor.
derivation: 元·陈基《次韵吴江道中》诗两袖清风身欲飘，杖藜随月步长桥。”
derivationTraditional: 元·陳基《次韻吳江道中》詩兩袖清風身欲飄，杖藜隨月步長橋。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Chen Ji's poem: 'Two sleeves of clear wind, body about to float; with a staff, I walk the long bridge under the moon.'
example: 绢帕麻菇与线香，本资民用反为殃；～朝天去，免得闾阎话短长。★明·都穆《都公谭篡》卷上
exampleTraditional: 絹帕麻菇與線香，本資民用反為殃；～朝天去，免得閭閻話短長。★明·都穆《都公譚篡》捲上
exampleEn: Silk handkerchiefs, mushrooms, and incense, meant for the people, become a curse; with two sleeves of clear wind, I go to court, to avoid gossip in the lanes. — Ming Dynasty Du Mu 'Du Gong Tan Zhuan' Volume 1

explanation: 穷极极端；无聊无所依托。原指光景穷困，精神无所寄托。现也形容无事可做，非常无聊。
explanationTraditional: 窮極極端；無聊無所依託。原指光景窮困，精神無所寄託。現也形容無事可做，非常無聊。
explanationEn: Originally meant extreme poverty with no spiritual support; now also means having nothing to do and feeling extremely bored.
derivation: 宋·费昶《思公子》诗虞卿亦何命，穷极若无聊。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·費昶《思公子》詩虞卿亦何命，窮極若無聊。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Fei Chang's poem: 'Yu Qing also had no fate; extreme poverty left him with nothing to do.'
example: 却被一个～的刘浩三，一个乡愚无知的余知化，提倡实业；工商两途，大受影响。★清·姬文《市声》第三十六回
exampleTraditional: 卻被一個～的劉浩三，一個鄉愚無知的餘知化，提倡實業；工商兩途，大受影響。★清·姬文《市聲》第三十六回
exampleEn: But then a man named Liu Haosan, who was extremely bored, and a simpleton Yu Zhihua, advocated industry and commerce, greatly affecting both sectors. — Qing Dynasty Ji Wen 'Market Sounds' Chapter 36

explanation: 指礼节性的应酬往来。也指来往客人很多。同人来客去”。
explanationTraditional: 指禮節性的應酬往來。也指來往客人很多。同人來客去”。
explanationEn: Refers to social interactions and visits; also means many guests coming and going.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第四十回偶然在家空闲两日，又得分拨家事，整理行囊。再加上人来客往，道乏辞行，转眼间早已假期将满。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第四十回偶然在家空閒兩日，又得分撥家事，整理行囊。再加上人來客往，道乏辭行，轉眼間早已假期將滿。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Son' Chapter 40: 'Occasionally idle at home for a couple of days, he had to manage household affairs and pack luggage. With guests coming and going, farewells and thanks, the vacation time soon ended.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把百姓当作有伤病的人一样照顾。旧时形容在位者关怀人民。
explanationTraditional: 把百姓當作有傷病的人一樣照顧。舊時形容在位者關懷人民。
explanationEn: To care for the people as if they were wounded; describes a ruler who is deeply concerned for the welfare of the people.
derivation: 《左传·哀公元年》臣闻国之兴也，视民如伤，是其福也；其亡也，以民为土芥，是其祸也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·哀公元年》臣聞國之興也，視民如傷，是其福也；其亡也，以民為土芥，是其禍也。”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan, Year 1 of Duke Ai: 'I have heard that when a state is rising, it regards the people as if they were wounded, which is its blessing; when it is falling, it treats the people as dirt and grass, which is its calamity.'
example: 君莅其任，～。★晋·潘岳《扬荆州诔》
exampleTraditional: 君蒞其任，～。★晉·潘岳《揚荊州誄》
exampleEn: When the ruler took office, he cared for the people as if they were wounded. — Pan Yue, 'Eulogy for Yang Jingzhou'

explanation: 四时指春夏秋冬四季；八节指立春、春分、立夏、夏至、立秋、秋分、立冬、冬至。泛指一年四季中各节气。
explanationTraditional: 四時指春夏秋冬四季；八節指立春、春分、立夏、夏至、立秋、秋分、立冬、冬至。泛指一年四季中各節氣。
explanationEn: The four seasons (spring, summer, autumn, winter) and the eight solar terms (Start of Spring, Spring Equinox, Start of Summer, Summer Solstice, Start of Autumn, Autumn Equinox, Start of Winter, Winter Solstice); generally refers to the various solar terms throughout the year.
derivation: 唐·马总《意林》卷一引《隋巢子》鬼神为四时八节以纪育人。”唐·杜甫《短歌行赠四兄》诗四时八节还拘礼，女拜弟妻男拜弟。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·馬總《意林》卷一引《隋巢子》鬼神為四時八節以紀育人。”唐·杜甫《短歌行贈四兄》詩四時八節還拘禮，女拜弟妻男拜弟。”
derivationEn: Ma Zong, 'Yilin' vol. 1 quoting 'Suichaozi': 'The ghosts and spirits use the four seasons and eight solar terms to regulate human life.' Du Fu, 'Short Song for Fourth Brother': 'The four seasons and eight solar terms still demand rituals, the wife bows to the younger brother's wife, the husband bows to the younger brother.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 完全丧失了威严和信誉。
explanationTraditional: 完全喪失了威嚴和信譽。
explanationEn: To have completely lost one's prestige and credibility.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这次贿选的丑闻，使得他～，真是太不值得了。
exampleTraditional: 這次賄選的醜聞，使得他～，真是太不值得了。
exampleEn: The scandal of vote-buying made him lose all his prestige; it was really not worth it.

explanation: 形容孤单。
explanationTraditional: 形容孤單。
explanationEn: Describes being alone and solitary.
derivation: 明·高明《琵琶记·丹陛陈情》但臣亲老鬓发白，筋力皆癯瘁。形只影单，无兄弟，谁奉侍？”
derivationTraditional: 明·高明《琵琶記·丹陛陳情》但臣親老鬢髮白，筋力皆癯瘁。形隻影單，無兄弟，誰奉侍？”
derivationEn: Gao Ming, 'Pipa Ji: Memorial to the Throne': 'But my parents are old with white hair, their bodies and spirits weak. I am alone, without brothers, who will serve them?'
example: 太后因妇人一生衣食莫不倚于其夫，其有夫死而孀居者，既无丈夫衣食可恃，～，饥寒谁恤。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十回
exampleTraditional: 太后因婦人一生衣食莫不倚於其夫，其有夫死而孀居者，既無丈夫衣食可恃，～，飢寒誰恤。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十回
exampleEn: The Empress Dowager said, 'For a woman, all food and clothing depend on her husband. If she is widowed, she has no husband to rely on, is alone and solitary, and who will pity her hunger and cold?' — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 40

explanation: 指很短的时间。
explanationTraditional: 指很短的時間。
explanationEn: A very short period of time.
derivation: 清·李渔《凰求凤·夥媒》机缘凑，把愁肠暂丢，便难成，也一时三刻展眉头。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《凰求鳳·夥媒》機緣湊，把愁腸暫丟，便難成，也一時三刻展眉頭。”
derivationEn: Li Yu, 'The Phoenix Seeks a Match: Matchmaker': 'Opportunity comes, put aside sorrow for a while; even if hard to achieve, in a short while the brows will relax.'
example: 你出来不出来？～就把你烧成黑炭了！★孔厥《新儿女英雄传》第四回
exampleTraditional: 你出來不出來？～就把你燒成黑炭了！★孔厥《新兒女英雄傳》第四回
exampleEn: Will you come out or not? In a short while you'll be burned to charcoal! — Kong Jue, 'New Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 4

explanation: 喻说明。借用古代的事来说明今天的事情或道理。
explanationTraditional: 喻說明。借用古代的事來說明今天的事情或道理。
explanationEn: To use ancient events to illustrate present-day matters or principles.
derivation: 《北史·长孙嵩传》昔叔孙辞沃壤之地，萧何就穷僻之乡，以古方今，无渐曩哲。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·長孫嵩傳》昔叔孫辭沃壤之地，蕭何就窮僻之鄉，以古方今，無漸曩哲。”
derivationEn: 'History of the North: Biography of Zhangsun Song': 'In the past, Shusun declined fertile land, and Xiao He chose a poor and remote village. Comparing ancient with present, there is no shame before the wise of old.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 衷内心。出自内心的话。
explanationTraditional: 衷內心。出自內心的話。
explanationEn: Words that come from the heart; sincere remarks.
derivation: 清·恽敬《辨微论》曹操之令，皆由中之言也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·惲敬《辨微論》曹操之令，皆由中之言也。”
derivationEn: Yun Jing, 'On Discrimination': 'Cao Cao's decrees were all words from the heart.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 知道自己命运的年龄。指50岁。
explanationTraditional: 知道自己命運的年齡。指50歲。
explanationEn: The age of knowing one's destiny; refers to 50 years old.
derivation: 《论语·为政》五十而知天命。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·為政》五十而知天命。”
derivationEn: 'Analects: Weizheng': 'At fifty, I knew the decrees of Heaven.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在怀孕时就为子女定下婚约。
explanationTraditional: 在懷孕時就為子女定下婚約。
explanationEn: To betroth one's unborn child to another's unborn child while both are still in the womb.
derivation: 《魏书·王宝兴传》汝等将来所生，皆我之自出，可指腹为亲。”
derivationTraditional: 《魏書·王寶興傳》汝等將來所生，皆我之自出，可指腹為親。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Wei: Biography of Wang Baoxing': 'The children you will bear are all my offspring; we can betroth them by pointing to the belly.'
example: 彼时九王爷因娘娘又怀身孕，曾与骆老爷～，倘生郡主，情愿与骆公子再续前姻。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 彼時九王爺因娘娘又懷身孕，曾與駱老爺～，倘生郡主，情願與駱公子再續前姻。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第五十六回
exampleEn: At that time, the Ninth Prince's consort was again pregnant, and he had previously made a betrothal by pointing to the belly with Lord Luo, promising that if a princess was born, she would marry Lord Luo's son to continue the former marriage. — Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 56

explanation: 治整理；益越发；棼纷乱。理丝不找头绪，结果越理越乱。比喻解决问题的方法不对头，反而使问题更加复杂。
explanationTraditional: 治整理；益越發；棼紛亂。理絲不找頭緒，結果越理越亂。比喻解決問題的方法不對頭，反而使問題更加複雜。
explanationEn: To try to sort silk threads but make them more tangled; metaphor for using the wrong method to solve a problem, making it more complicated.
derivation: 《左传·隐公四年》臣闻以德和民，不闻以乱。以乱，犹治丝而棼之也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公四年》臣聞以德和民，不聞以亂。以亂，猶治絲而棼之也。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan, Year 4 of Duke Yin': 'I have heard of using virtue to harmonize the people, not of using chaos. Using chaos is like sorting silk and tangling it further.'
example: 以今日外交吃紧，若舍事实而争言法理，势必旷日持久，～，陆沉之忧，悬于眉睫。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第九十九回
exampleTraditional: 以今日外交吃緊，若舍事實而爭言法理，勢必曠日持久，～，陸沉之憂，懸於眉睫。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第九十九回
exampleEn: Given the current diplomatic crisis, if we abandon facts and argue about legal principles, it will inevitably drag on, making the problem worse, and the danger of national subjugation is imminent. — Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 99

explanation: 结果一场空，一无所有。
explanationTraditional: 結果一場空，一無所有。
explanationEn: To end up as nothing; to come to nothing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 希特勒妄想称霸全世界，他逆历史潮流而动，一切诡计～，落得个自取灭亡的下场。
exampleTraditional: 希特勒妄想稱霸全世界，他逆歷史潮流而動，一切詭計～，落得個自取滅亡的下場。
exampleEn: Hitler vainly attempted to dominate the world, but going against the historical trend, all his schemes ended up as nothing, leading to his own destruction.

explanation: 使国家安定太平。
explanationTraditional: 使國家安定太平。
explanationEn: To bring peace and stability to the country.
derivation: 宋·无名氏《新编五代史平话·周史》卷上我这剑要卖与烈士，大则安邦定国，小则御侮捍身，您孩儿每识个什么？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·無名氏《新編五代史平話·周史》捲上我這劍要賣與烈士，大則安邦定國，小則禦侮捍身，您孩兒每識個什麼？”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, anonymous, 'New History of the Five Dynasties: History of Zhou', Volume 1: 'This sword I want to sell to a hero; for great matters, it can stabilize the country and bring peace; for small matters, it can resist aggression and protect oneself. What do you children know?'
example: ～平天下，自有周公孔圣人。★冰心《斯人独憔悴》
exampleTraditional: ～平天下，自有周公孔聖人。★冰心《斯人獨憔悴》
exampleEn: To bring peace and stability to the country and the world, there is the Duke of Zhou and Confucius. ★ Bing Xin, 'The Lonely One'

explanation: 顿困顿。骑马赶路过久，劳累疲困。形容旅途劳累。
explanationTraditional: 頓困頓。騎馬趕路過久，勞累疲睏。形容旅途勞累。
explanationEn: Exhausted from a long journey on horseback; travel-worn.
derivation: 元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第四折兴儿，我一路上鞍马劳顿，我权且歇息。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第四折興兒，我一路上鞍馬勞頓，我權且歇息。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Yang Xianzhi, 'Rain on the Xiao and Xiang Rivers', Act 4: 'Xing'er, I am exhausted from the journey on horseback; I will rest for a while.'
example: 恐王侄一路远来，～，故令王侄回营安歇。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第四二回
exampleTraditional: 恐王侄一路遠來，～，故令王侄回營安歇。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第四二回
exampleEn: Fearing that the prince might be exhausted from the long journey, he ordered him to return to camp and rest. ★ Qing Dynasty, Qian Cai, 'The Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 42

explanation: 瞠瞪着眼看；其代词，他。在别人后面干瞪眼赶不上。形容远远落在后面。
explanationTraditional: 瞠瞪著眼看；其代詞，他。在別人後面乾瞪眼趕不上。形容遠遠落在後面。
explanationEn: To stare helplessly at someone far ahead; to lag far behind.
derivation: 《庄子·田子方》夫子奔逸绝尘，而回瞠若乎后矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·田子方》夫子奔逸絕塵，而回瞠若乎後矣。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: Tian Zifang': 'The Master runs ahead and leaves the dust behind, and I stare after him, unable to catch up.'
example: 乾隆朝的十全武功”固然～，就是康熙朝的平三藩之乱，论规模、论艰难，也都不如。★高阳《玉座珠帘》上册
exampleTraditional: 乾隆朝的十全武功”固然～，就是康熙朝的平三藩之亂，論規模、論艱難，也都不如。★高陽《玉座珠簾》上冊
exampleEn: Even the 'Ten Complete Military Campaigns' of the Qianlong reign lagged far behind; compared to the pacification of the Three Feudatories in the Kangxi reign, in terms of scale and difficulty, they were inferior. ★ Gao Yang, 'Jade Beads and Pearl Curtains', Volume 1

explanation: 形容衣着鲜艳华丽。
explanationTraditional: 形容衣著鮮豔華麗。
explanationEn: Dressed in bright and colorful clothes.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言·钱秀才错占凤凰俦》那颜俊虽丑陋，最好妆扮，穿红着绿，低声强笑，自以为美。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言·錢秀才錯占鳳凰儔》那顏俊雖醜陋，最好妝扮，穿紅著綠，低聲強笑，自以為美。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World: Scholar Qian Mistakenly Marries the Phoenix': 'Although Yan Jun was ugly, he loved to dress up, wearing red and green, forcing a smile, thinking himself beautiful.'
example: 台阶上坐着几个～的丫头。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第三回
exampleTraditional: 臺階上坐著幾個～的丫頭。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第三回
exampleEn: On the steps sat several maids dressed in red and green. ★ Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 3

explanation: 规、矩圆规和角尺，引伸为准则；步用脚走。指严格按照规矩办事，毫不苟且。也指办事死板，不灵活。
explanationTraditional: 規、矩圓規和角尺，引伸為準則；步用腳走。指嚴格按照規矩辦事，毫不苟且。也指辦事死板，不靈活。
explanationEn: To act strictly according to rules; to be rigid and inflexible.
derivation: 晋·潘尼《释奠颂》二学儒官，缙绅先生之徒，垂缨佩玉，规行矩步者，皆端委而陪于堂下，以待执事之命。”北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·序致》规行矩步，安辞定色。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·潘尼《釋奠頌》二學儒官，縉紳先生之徒，垂纓佩玉，規行矩步者，皆端委而陪於堂下，以待執事之命。”北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·序致》規行矩步，安辭定色。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Pan Ni, 'Eulogy on the Release of Captives': 'The Confucian scholars and officials, wearing pendants and jade, walking in measured steps, all stood respectfully under the hall, awaiting orders.' Northern Qi, Yan Zhitui, 'Family Instructions of Master Yan: Preface': 'Walk in measured steps, speak calmly and with composure.'
example: 今士循常习故，～，积阶级，累阀阅，碌碌然以取世资。★《晋书·张载传》
exampleTraditional: 今士循常習故，～，積階級，累閥閱，碌碌然以取世資。★《晉書·張載傳》
exampleEn: Nowadays, scholars follow the old ways, walking in measured steps, accumulating ranks and merits, mediocrity to gain worldly success. ★ 'Book of Jin: Biography of Zhang Zai'

explanation: 精神振奋，情绪激昂，充满正气。
explanationTraditional: 精神振奮，情緒激昂，充滿正氣。
explanationEn: Fervent and impassioned; full of righteous indignation.
derivation: 汉·李陵《录别诗》悲意何慷慨，清歌正激扬。”唐·柳宗元《上权德舆补阙温卷决进退启》今将慷慨激昂，奋攘布衣，纵谈作者之筵，曳裾名卿之门。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·李陵《錄別詩》悲意何慷慨，清歌正激揚。”唐·柳宗元《上權德輿補闕溫卷決進退啟》今將慷慨激昂，奮攘布衣，縱談作者之筵，曳裾名卿之門。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Li Ling, 'Poem of Parting': 'How sorrowful and impassioned, the clear song rises.' Tang Dynasty, Liu Zongyuan, 'Letter to Quan Deyu': 'Now I am fervent and impassioned, shaking off my commoner's clothes, freely discussing among writers, trailing my robe at the gates of nobles.'
example: 况金元院本，演古劝今，情神刻肖，令人～，欢喜悲号，其有功于世不少。（清·郑燮《城隍庙碑记》）
exampleTraditional: 況金元院本，演古勸今，情神刻肖，令人～，歡喜悲號，其有功於世不少。（清·鄭燮《城隍廟碑記》）
exampleEn: Moreover, the Jin and Yuan dynasty plays, performing ancient stories to admonish the present, vividly portray emotions, making people fervent and impassioned, joyful and sorrowful, which is of no small benefit to the world. ★ Qing Dynasty, Zheng Xie, 'Inscription on the City God Temple Stele'

explanation: 吉人善人；相帮助，保佑。迷信的人认为好人会得到天的帮助。多用作对别人的患病或遇到困难、不幸的安慰话。
explanationTraditional: 吉人善人；相幫助，保佑。迷信的人認為好人會得到天的幫助。多用作對別人的患病或遇到困難、不幸的安慰話。
explanationEn: Heaven helps the good; used to comfort someone who is ill or in trouble.
derivation: 《左传·宣公三年》石癸曰‘吾闻，姬、姞耦，其子孙必蕃。姞，吉人也。’”又《昭公四年》晋楚唯天所相，不可与争。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·宣公三年》石癸曰‘吾聞，姬、姞耦，其子孫必蕃。姞，吉人也。’”又《昭公四年》晉楚唯天所相，不可與爭。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Year 3 of Duke Xuan': 'Shi Kui said: 'I have heard that the union of Ji and Ji will surely have many descendants. Ji is a good person.'' Also 'Year 4 of Duke Zhao': 'Jin and Chu are favored by Heaven; they cannot be contended with.'
example: 既然庚贴返去，原聘也必然还璧。但～，令郎尊恙，终有好日，还要三思而行。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷九
exampleTraditional: 既然庚貼返去，原聘也必然還璧。但～，令郎尊恙，終有好日，還要三思而行。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷九
exampleEn: Since the betrothal letter has been returned, the original betrothal gift should also be returned. But heaven helps the good; your son's illness will eventually improve. You must think thrice before acting. ★ Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 9

explanation: 心里突然有了计策。同计上心来”。
explanationTraditional: 心裡突然有了計策。同計上心來”。
explanationEn: A plan suddenly comes to mind.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 伪装仁慈善良。
explanationTraditional: 偽裝仁慈善良。
explanationEn: Hypocritical kindness and righteousness; pretended benevolence.
derivation: 《朱子全书·历代一·唐》汉高祖私意分数少，唐太宗一切假仁假义以行其私。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子全書·歷代一·唐》漢高祖私意分數少，唐太宗一切假仁假義以行其私。”
derivationEn: 'Complete Works of Zhu Xi: History: Tang': 'Emperor Gaozu of Han had few selfish intentions; Emperor Taizong of Tang did everything with hypocritical kindness and righteousness to serve his own interests.'
example: 他第一便想抢曾乡绅的家，那暴发的绅士，～的，好不可恶！★郑振铎《黄公俊的最后》
exampleTraditional: 他第一便想搶曾鄉紳的家，那暴發的紳士，～的，好不可惡！★鄭振鐸《黃公俊的最後》
exampleEn: His first thought was to rob the home of the wealthy squire Zeng, that upstart gentleman, hypocritical and detestable! ★ Zheng Zhenduo, 'The Last Days of Huang Gongjun'

explanation: 慷慨意气激昂，情绪激动；赴义为正义而死。指大义凛然地为正义献身。
explanationTraditional: 慷慨意氣激昂，情緒激動；赴義為正義而死。指大義凜然地為正義獻身。
explanationEn: To die for a just cause with high spirit and righteousness.
derivation: 明·朱鼎《玉镜台记·王敦反》大丈夫当慷慨赴义，何用悲为！”
derivationTraditional: 明·朱鼎《玉鏡臺記·王敦反》大丈夫當慷慨赴義，何用悲為！”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Zhu Ding's 'Yu Jing Tai Ji: Wang Dun's Rebellion': 'A true man should die for righteousness, why be sad!'
example: 材伏哭叩头，举火，烈妇死，三十余人从死，其～如此。★清·王猷定《梁烈妇传》
exampleTraditional: 材伏哭叩頭，舉火，烈婦死，三十餘人從死，其～如此。★清·王猷定《梁烈婦傳》
exampleEn: Cai Fu wept and kowtowed, then lit the fire. The martyr died, and over thirty people followed her in death. Such was their devotion to righteousness. — Qing Dynasty Wang Youding's 'Biography of Liang Martyr'

explanation: 逊谦逊、恭顺。说出的话非常不谦逊。
explanationTraditional: 遜謙遜、恭順。說出的話非常不謙遜。
explanationEn: To speak arrogantly or rudely; to utter disrespectful words.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第七十四回却说关公正坐帐中，忽探马飞报‘曹操差于禁为将，领七枝精壮兵到来。前部先锋庞德，军前抬一木榇，口出不逊之言，誓欲与将军决一死战。兵离城止三十里矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第七十四回卻說關公正坐帳中，忽探馬飛報‘曹操差於禁為將，領七枝精壯兵到來。前部先鋒龐德，軍前抬一木櫬，口出不遜之言，誓欲與將軍決一死戰。兵離城止三十里矣。’”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 74: 'Guan Gong was sitting in his tent when a scout reported that Cao Cao sent Yu Jin with seven elite troops. The vanguard Pang De carried a coffin and spoke insolently, vowing to fight to the death.'
example: 崇应彪～之言，请丞相军令定夺。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 崇應彪～之言，請丞相軍令定奪。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二十八回
exampleEn: Chong Yingbiao spoke insolently; please let the military counselor decide. — Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 28

explanation: 庭龙庭，古代匈奴祭祀天神的处所，也是匈奴统治者的军政中心。犁平敌人的大本营，扫荡他的巢穴。比喻彻底摧毁敌方。
explanationTraditional: 庭龍庭，古代匈奴祭祀天神的處所，也是匈奴統治者的軍政中心。犁平敵人的大本營，掃蕩他的巢穴。比喻徹底摧毀敵方。
explanationEn: To completely destroy the enemy's stronghold and base; to eradicate the enemy thoroughly.
derivation: 《汉书·匈奴传下》固已犁其庭，扫其闾，郡县而置之。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·匈奴傳下》固已犁其庭，掃其閭，郡縣而置之。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of the Xiongnu': 'They plowed their court and swept their villages, establishing counties there.'
example: 雄师百万下江东，辞庙仓皇是蒋凶。丧尽人心终不悔，～事最公。★陈毅《纪念宁沪解放十周年》诗
exampleTraditional: 雄師百萬下江東，辭廟倉皇是蔣兇。喪盡人心終不悔，～事最公。★陳毅《紀念寧滬解放十週年》詩
exampleEn: A million mighty troops descended on Jiangdong; Chiang the tyrant fled his temple in panic. Having lost all popular support, he never repents; destroying his lair is most just. — Chen Yi's poem 'Commemorating the Tenth Anniversary of the Liberation of Nanjing and Shanghai'

explanation: ①打仗接连取得胜利。②今多指体育比赛或考试等接连取得好成绩。
explanationTraditional: ①打仗接連取得勝利。②今多指體育比賽或考試等接連取得好成績。
explanationEn: To win consecutive victories in battles, sports competitions, or exams.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 和应和。比喻夫妻相亲相爱。旧时常用于祝人新婚。
explanationTraditional: 和應和。比喻夫妻相親相愛。舊時常用於祝人新婚。
explanationEn: Harmonious union of a married couple; often used in wedding congratulations.
derivation: 《左传·庄公二十二年》是谓凤凰于飞，和鸣锵锵。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·莊公二十二年》是謂鳳凰于飛，和鳴鏘鏘。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Zhuang's 22nd Year': 'This is called the phoenixes flying together, their calls harmonious.'
example: 夜同寢，昼同行，恰似～。★元·白朴《梧桐雨》第一折
exampleTraditional: 夜同寢，晝同行，恰似～。★元·白樸《梧桐雨》第一折
exampleEn: They sleep together at night and walk together by day, just like a pair of phoenixes in harmony. — Yuan Dynasty Bai Pu's 'Rain on the Wutong Tree' Act 1

explanation: 献把东西送给尊长或敬爱的人。指棕寿辰。
explanationTraditional: 獻把東西送給尊長或敬愛的人。指棕壽辰。
explanationEn: To offer birthday congratulations; refers to presenting gifts to elders on their birthday.
derivation: 晋·葛洪《神仙传》卷七麻姑，建昌人，修道于牟州东南余姑山。三月三日西王母寿辰，麻姑在绛珠河畔以灵芝酿酒，为王母祝寿。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·葛洪《神仙傳》卷七麻姑，建昌人，修道於牟州東南餘姑山。三月三日西王母壽辰，麻姑在絳珠河畔以靈芝釀酒，為王母祝壽。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Ge Hong's 'Biographies of Immortals' Volume 7: 'Magu, a native of Jianchang, cultivated Taoism on Mount Guyu. On the Queen Mother of the West's birthday, Magu brewed wine with lingzhi by the Crimson Pearl River to toast her.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 满山遍野，形容数量多、分布广。
explanationTraditional: 滿山遍野，形容數量多、分佈廣。
explanationEn: Covering the sky and fields; describing a vast number or wide distribution.
derivation: 冰心《颂一团火”》这星罗棋布、漫天遍野的一团团火光，会把我们新的万里征途，照耀得多么光明，多么灿烂！”
derivationTraditional: 冰心《頌一團火”》這星羅棋佈、漫天遍野的一團團火光，會把我們新的萬里征途，照耀得多麼光明，多麼燦爛！”
derivationEn: From Bing Xin's 'Ode to a 'Ball of Fire'': 'These scattered, sky-covering, field-blanketing balls of fire will illuminate our new long march brightly and brilliantly!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人民比君主更重要。这是民本思想。
explanationTraditional: 人民比君主更重要。這是民本思想。
explanationEn: The people are more important than the ruler; a concept of people-oriented governance.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不把尊长放在眼里。形容狂妄无礼。
explanationTraditional: 不把尊長放在眼裡。形容狂妄無禮。
explanationEn: To show no respect for elders or superiors; arrogant and rude.
derivation: 巴金《家》她不满意觉慧的目无尊长的态度，更不满意觉民的反抗家长、实行逃婚的手段。”
derivationTraditional: 巴金《家》她不滿意覺慧的目無尊長的態度，更不滿意覺民的反抗家長、實行逃婚的手段。”
derivationEn: From Ba Jin's 'Family': 'She was dissatisfied with Juehui's disrespectful attitude toward elders, and even more dissatisfied with Juemin's rebellion against parental authority and elopement.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容大声喘气的模样。
explanationTraditional: 形容大聲喘氣的模樣。
explanationEn: To pant heavily like an ox; to breathe loudly and heavily.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十九回脸是喝了个漆紫，连乐带忙，一头说着，只张着嘴，气喘如牛的拿了条大手巾擦那脑门子上的汗。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十九回臉是喝了個漆紫，連樂帶忙，一頭說著，只張著嘴，氣喘如牛的拿了條大手巾擦那腦門子上的汗。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wen Kang's 'The Legend of Heroes' Chapter 39: 'His face was purple from drinking, and amid joy and busyness, he spoke with his mouth open, panting like an ox while wiping sweat with a large towel.'
example: 那总办～的说道‘那贱人我不要了！’★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第六十六回
exampleTraditional: 那總辦～的說道‘那賤人我不要了！’★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第六十六回
exampleEn: The manager panted like an ox and said, 'I don't want that slut anymore!' — Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' Chapter 66

explanation: 壤地。荒远偏僻的地方。
explanationTraditional: 壤地。荒遠偏僻的地方。
explanationEn: A remote and barren area; a desolate and out-of-the-way place.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《条奏经界状·贴黄》故州城县郭所在之乡，其产不甚重，与穷山僻壤至有相倍蓗者，此逐乡产钱租额，所以本来已有轻重之所由也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《條奏經界狀·貼黃》故州城縣郭所在之鄉，其產不甚重，與窮山僻壤至有相倍蓗者，此逐鄉產錢租額，所以本來已有輕重之所由也。”
derivationEn: Zhu Xi of the Song Dynasty, in 'Memorial on Land Survey': 'In the counties and cities, the land tax is not heavy, but in remote and barren areas, it can be several times heavier, which is why the tax quotas vary from place to place.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用享受。从大量材料中选取精华充分加以运用。
explanationTraditional: 用享受。從大量材料中選取精華充分加以運用。
explanationEn: To select the essence from a vast amount of material and make full use of it.
derivation: 先秦·左丘明《左传·昭公七年》蕞尔国，而三世执其政柄，其用物也弘矣，其取精也多矣。”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·左丘明《左傳·昭公七年》蕞爾國，而三世執其政柄，其用物也弘矣，其取精也多矣。”
derivationEn: Zuo Qiuming of the Pre-Qin period, in 'Zuo Zhuan: The Seventh Year of Duke Zhao': 'A small state, yet for three generations they held power, using resources broadly and selecting essence abundantly.'
example: 读书多的，～，自然深了，读书少的便不能如此。★朱自清《文选序》
exampleTraditional: 讀書多的，～，自然深了，讀書少的便不能如此。★朱自清《文選序》
exampleEn: Those who read widely, selecting essence and using it fully, naturally become profound; those who read little cannot achieve this. — Zhu Ziqing, 'Preface to Selected Works'

explanation: 事情出于无可奈何。指迫不得已只能如此。
explanationTraditional: 事情出於無可奈何。指迫不得已只能如此。
explanationEn: A situation arises from helplessness; having no choice but to do something.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇·同窗友认假作真》而今我们匆匆进京去了，心下如割，却是事出无奈。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇·同窗友認假作真》而今我們匆匆進京去了，心下如割，卻是事出無奈。”
derivationEn: Ling Mengchu of the Ming Dynasty, in 'Striking the Table in Amazement': 'Now we are rushing to the capital, our hearts torn, but it is a matter of helplessness.'
example: ～，只得措置银子，……虽不致卖家掘产，也未免挪衣剥当。★清·张南庄《何典》第二回
exampleTraditional: ～，只得措置銀子，……雖不致賣家掘產，也未免挪衣剝當。★清·張南莊《何典》第二回
exampleEn: Having no choice, we had to raise money... though not selling property or digging up assets, we still had to pawn clothes and strip off garments. — Zhang Nanzhuang of the Qing Dynasty, 'What's What' (Chapter 2)

explanation: 指景色美丽，令人心情愉快。
explanationTraditional: 指景色美麗，令人心情愉快。
explanationEn: Refreshing to the mind and pleasing to the eye; describing a beautiful scenery that brings joy.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 肆虐任意残杀或迫害♂行仗势作恶，蛮横凶暴。随心所欲地为非作歹。
explanationTraditional: 肆虐任意殘殺或迫害♂行仗勢作惡，蠻橫兇暴。隨心所欲地為非作歹。
explanationEn: To act tyrannically and violently without restraint; to commit atrocities at will.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《智囊全集·迎刃·留志淑》中官毕贞，逆濠党也。至自江西，声势翕赫，拥从牙士五百余人，肆行残贼，人人自危。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《智囊全集·迎刃·留志淑》中官畢貞，逆濠黨也。至自江西，聲勢翕赫，擁從牙士五百餘人，肆行殘賊，人人自危。”
derivationEn: Feng Menglong of the Ming Dynasty, in 'Wisdom Collection': 'The eunuch Bi Zhen, a member of the rebel party, came from Jiangxi with great arrogance, leading over five hundred armed followers, committing brutal acts, and everyone felt endangered.'
example: 那时侯，暴风雪还在这草原上～，大庆的石油也还在地层深处埋伏。★《离不开你》
exampleTraditional: 那時侯，暴風雪還在這草原上～，大慶的石油也還在地層深處埋伏。★《離不開你》
exampleEn: At that time, the blizzard was still raging across the grassland, and Daqing's oil was still buried deep underground. — 'Inseparable from You'

explanation: 形容从极危险的境地中逃出了性命。
explanationTraditional: 形容從極危險的境地中逃出了性命。
explanationEn: To narrowly escape a fatal accident or disaster; to have a close brush with death.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他在池中游泳突然抽搐，～，幸有旁人相救，方才逃过一劫。
exampleTraditional: 他在池中游泳突然抽搐，～，幸有旁人相救，方才逃過一劫。
exampleEn: While swimming in the pool, he suddenly cramped and nearly met with an accident; fortunately, someone nearby rescued him, and he escaped the ordeal.

explanation: 指人不能因为少年时聪明而断定他日后定有作为。
explanationTraditional: 指人不能因為少年時聰明而斷定他日後定有作為。
explanationEn: A person's childhood cleverness does not guarantee future success.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·言语》小时了了，大未必佳。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·言語》小時了了，大未必佳。”
derivationEn: Liu Yiqing of the Southern Dynasties, in 'A New Account of the Tales of the World': 'Clever as a child, not necessarily excellent as an adult.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 行做事；思思考。做事情成功是因为多思考，失败是由于不经心。指做事情要多思考，多分析。
explanationTraditional: 行做事；思思考。做事情成功是因為多思考，失敗是由於不經心。指做事情要多思考，多分析。
explanationEn: Success in action comes from careful thinking; failure results from carelessness.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《进学解》行成于思，毁于随。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《進學解》行成於思，毀於隨。”
derivationEn: Han Yu of the Tang Dynasty, in 'On Advancement': 'Success in action comes from thinking, failure from following blindly.'
example: ～，这是学业、事业有成的格言。
exampleTraditional: ～，這是學業、事業有成的格言。
exampleEn: Success in action comes from thinking—this is a maxim for academic and career achievement.

explanation: 格阻碍；禁制止。指受形势的阻碍或限制，事情难于进行。
explanationTraditional: 格阻礙；禁制止。指受形勢的阻礙或限制，事情難於進行。
explanationEn: Restricted or hindered by the situation; circumstances make it difficult to proceed.
derivation: 《史记·孙子吴起列传》夫解杂乱纷纠者不控捲，救斗者不搏戟，批亢捣虚，形格势禁，则自为解耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·孫子吳起列傳》夫解雜亂紛糾者不控捲，救鬥者不搏戟，批亢搗虛，形格勢禁，則自為解耳。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Sun Tzu and Wu Qi': 'To untangle a tangled mess, do not clench fists; to stop a fight, do not grab weapons. Strike at the weak points, and the situation will naturally resolve itself.'
example: 他日经营戎素，有～之能，虽徙首都于关、洛可也。当今之时，岂暇仓猝离北京乎？★章炳麟《驳黄兴主张南都电》
exampleTraditional: 他日經營戎素，有～之能，雖徙首都於關、洛可也。當今之時，豈暇倉猝離北京乎？★章炳麟《駁黃興主張南都電》
exampleEn: In the future, when managing military affairs, if one can use the situation to restrict the enemy, even moving the capital to Guanzhong or Luoyang is possible. But now, how can we hastily leave Beijing? — Zhang Binglin, 'Telegram Refuting Huang Xing's Proposal to Move the Capital South'

explanation: 盐任用贤能的人。亦作选贤任能”、选贤与能”。
explanationTraditional: 鹽任用賢能的人。亦作選賢任能”、選賢與能”。
explanationEn: To select and appoint virtuous and capable people; also expressed as '选贤任能' or '选贤与能'.
derivation: 《礼记·礼运》大道之行也，天下为公，选贤与能，讲售修睦。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·禮運》大道之行也，天下為公，選賢與能，講售修睦。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Rites: The Conveyance of Rites': 'When the Great Way prevails, the world is for all; select the worthy and capable, and promote harmony and trust.'
example: 他主张德政，主张～，主张大一统。★郭沫若《历史人物·屈原研究三》
exampleTraditional: 他主張德政，主張～，主張大一統。★郭沫若《歷史人物·屈原研究三》
exampleEn: He advocated virtuous governance, selecting the worthy and capable, and promoting unity. — Guo Moruo, 'Historical Figures: A Study of Qu Yuan (Part 3)'

explanation: 心里明白，眼睛雪亮。形容看问题敏锐，能辨别是非。
explanationTraditional: 心裡明白，眼睛雪亮。形容看問題敏銳，能辨別是非。
explanationEn: Having clear eyes and a bright mind; describing someone who is perceptive and able to distinguish right from wrong.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻事情轻而易举，一下子就成功。几，近，及。同一蹴而就”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻事情輕而易舉，一下子就成功。幾，近，及。同一蹴而就”。
explanationEn: Describes something that can be accomplished easily and quickly in one step.
derivation: 梁启超《中国学术思想变迁之大势》第四章第二节天下事非一蹴可几者。”
derivationTraditional: 梁啟超《中國學術思想變遷之大勢》第四章第二節天下事非一蹴可幾者。”
derivationEn: Liang Qichao, 'The Vicissitudes of Chinese Academic Thought', Chapter 4, Section 2: 'Matters under heaven are not to be achieved in one step.'
example: 我们必须向着改善现实的动向努力，但是我们同时也须明了这并不是～。★邹韬奋《对人对境和对己的态度》
exampleTraditional: 我們必須向著改善現實的動向努力，但是我們同時也須明瞭這並不是～。★鄒韜奮《對人對境和對己的態度》
exampleEn: We must strive towards improving reality, but we also need to understand that this is not something that can be achieved overnight. — Zou Taofen, 'Attitude towards People, Situations, and Self'

explanation: 指没有什么要求或需要。
explanationTraditional: 指沒有什麼要求或需要。
explanationEn: Having no demands or needs.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第16回要我给她遮掩个门户；此外一无所求。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第16回要我給她遮掩個門戶；此外一無所求。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 16: 'She asked me to cover up her household; beyond that, she had no other requests.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 借历史上的成败得失作为鉴戒。
explanationTraditional: 借歷史上的成敗得失作為鑑戒。
explanationEn: Using historical successes and failures as a mirror for guidance.
derivation: 《新唐书·魏徵传》以铜为鉴，可正衣寇；以古为鉴，可知兴替；以人为鉴，可明得失。”按《旧唐书·魏徵传》鉴”作镜”。
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·魏徵傳》以銅為鑑，可正衣寇；以古為鑑，可知興替；以人為鑑，可明得失。”按《舊唐書·魏徵傳》鑑”作鏡”。
derivationEn: 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Wei Zheng': 'Using bronze as a mirror, one can straighten one's attire; using history as a mirror, one can understand the rise and fall of dynasties; using people as a mirror, one can see gains and losses.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 民众犹如水，可以承载船，也可以倾覆船。比喻人民是决定国家兴亡的主要力量。
explanationTraditional: 民眾猶如水，可以承載船，也可以傾覆船。比喻人民是決定國家興亡的主要力量。
explanationEn: The people are like water, which can carry a boat or capsize it. A metaphor for the people being the main force determining a nation's rise or fall.
derivation: 《荀子·王制》传曰‘君者舟也，庶人者水也，水则载舟，水则覆舟。’此之谓也。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·王制》傳曰‘君者舟也，庶人者水也，水則載舟，水則覆舟。’此之謂也。”
derivationEn: 'Xunzi: Kingly System': 'It is said: The ruler is the boat, and the common people are the water. The water can carry the boat, and it can also capsize it.'
example: 怨不在大，可畏惟人。～，报宜深慎。★唐·魏征《谏太宗十思疏》
exampleTraditional: 怨不在大，可畏惟人。～，報宜深慎。★唐·魏徵《諫太宗十思疏》
exampleEn: Resentment is not necessarily great; what is fearsome is the people. The water can carry the boat or capsize it; caution is deeply required. — Wei Zheng, 'Ten Thoughts on Admonishing Taizong'

explanation: 中西合璧。
explanationTraditional: 中西合璧。
explanationEn: A combination of Chinese and Western elements; Sino-Western fusion.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十一回这长苗子是我们中国原有的，如今搀在这德国操内，中又不中，外又不外，倒成了一个中外合璧。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十一回這長苗子是我們中國原有的，如今攙在這德國操內，中又不中，外又不外，倒成了一箇中外合璧。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 31: 'This long spear is originally Chinese, but now mixed into this German drill, neither Chinese nor foreign, it has become a Sino-Western hybrid.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 徐慢。疾快。不快不慢，从容自然。
explanationTraditional: 徐慢。疾快。不快不慢，從容自然。
explanationEn: Neither slow nor fast; unhurried and natural.
derivation: 《庄子·天道》不徐不疾，得之于手，而应于心。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·天道》不徐不疾，得之於手，而應於心。”
derivationEn: 'Zhuangzi: The Way of Heaven': 'Neither slow nor fast, it is obtained in the hand and responds to the heart.'
example: 起初犹乍翱乍翔，～，后来乐声促奏，她便盘旋不已。★清·褚人获《隋唐演义》第三十九回
exampleTraditional: 起初猶乍翱乍翔，～，後來樂聲促奏，她便盤旋不已。★清·褚人獲《隋唐演義》第三十九回
exampleEn: At first, it soared and swooped, neither fast nor slow; later, as the music hastened, she spun around incessantly. — Qing Dynasty, Chu Renhuo, 'Romance of the Sui and Tang Dynasties', Chapter 39

explanation: 比喻在消灭或淘汰过程中残存下来的坏人。孽，邪恶的东西。
explanationTraditional: 比喻在消滅或淘汰過程中殘存下來的壞人。孽，邪惡的東西。
explanationEn: A metaphor for remnants of evil forces that survive elimination or purification.
derivation: 《历史研究》1976年第3期由于不少奴隶主残渣余孽被集中于南阳，故而南阳之俗是‘夸奢、上气力、为商贾’（《汉书·地理志》），成为一个‘难制御’的地方。”
derivationTraditional: 《歷史研究》1976年第3期由於不少奴隸主殘渣餘孽被集中於南陽，故而南陽之俗是‘誇奢、上氣力、為商賈’（《漢書·地理志》），成為一個‘難制御’的地方。”
derivationEn: 'Historical Research', Issue 3, 1976: 'Because many remnants of slave owners were concentrated in Nanyang, the local customs became extravagant, martial, and mercantile, making it a difficult place to govern.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 仓皇匆忙，慌张。匆忙慌张，不知所措。
explanationTraditional: 倉皇匆忙，慌張。匆忙慌張，不知所措。
explanationEn: Panicked and at a loss; flustered and not knowing what to do.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《夷坚志·铁塔神》僧仓皇失措，不暇走，兵已大掠。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《夷堅志·鐵塔神》僧倉皇失措，不暇走，兵已大掠。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Hong Mai, 'Yijian Zhi: The Iron Pagoda Monk': 'The monk panicked and was at a loss; before he could flee, the soldiers had already looted.'
example: 血溢不止，少顷已绝，妪～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·金生色》
exampleTraditional: 血溢不止，少頃已絕，嫗～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·金生色》
exampleEn: Blood gushed endlessly, and in a short while she was dead; the old woman was panicked and at a loss. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Jin Shengse'

explanation: 形容数量极多。
explanationTraditional: 形容數量極多。
explanationEn: Describes an extremely large number; thousands upon thousands.
derivation: 叶圣陶《小病》倘若在广大的都城里，聚集了成千成成的听众，教伊当众唱出这很好的歌，该会增进人们彼此之间的了解。”
derivationTraditional: 葉聖陶《小病》倘若在廣大的都城裡，聚集了成千成成的聽眾，教伊當眾唱出這很好的歌，該會增進人們彼此之間的瞭解。”
derivationEn: Ye Shengtao, 'Minor Illness': 'If in a vast city, tens of thousands of listeners gathered, and she sang this beautiful song publicly, it would enhance mutual understanding among people.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鲠鱼刺。鱼骨头卡在喉咙里。比喻心里有话没有说出来，非常难受。
explanationTraditional: 鯁魚刺。魚骨頭卡在喉嚨裡。比喻心裡有話沒有說出來，非常難受。
explanationEn: A fishbone stuck in the throat; metaphor for having something to say but unable to express it, causing great discomfort.
derivation: 汉·许慎《说文解字》鲠，食骨留咽中也。”段玉裁注韦曰‘骨所以鲠，刺人也。’忠言逆耳，如食骨在喉，故云骨鲠之臣。《汉书》以下皆作骨鲠，字从鱼，谓留咽者鱼骨较多也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·許慎《說文解字》鯁，食骨留咽中也。”段玉裁注韋曰‘骨所以鯁，刺人也。’忠言逆耳，如食骨在喉，故云骨鯁之臣。《漢書》以下皆作骨鯁，字從魚，謂留咽者魚骨較多也。”
derivationEn: Xu Shen's 'Shuowen Jiezi' (Han Dynasty): 'A bone stuck in the throat.' Duan Yucai's commentary: 'Loyal words are unpleasant to the ear, like a bone in the throat.'
example: 但近来作文，避忌已甚，有时如～，不得不吐，遂亦不免为人所憎。★《鲁迅书信集·致黎烈文》
exampleTraditional: 但近來作文，避忌已甚，有時如～，不得不吐，遂亦不免為人所憎。★《魯迅書信集·致黎烈文》
exampleEn: But recently, writing has been full of taboos, sometimes like a fishbone in the throat, I have to spit it out, and thus inevitably incur hatred. — Lu Xun's 'Letters to Li Liewen'

explanation: 致招致⊥睦融洽，可致吉祥。
explanationTraditional: 致招致⊥睦融洽，可致吉祥。
explanationEn: Harmony brings good fortune; amiability leads to auspiciousness.
derivation: 《汉书·刘向传》和气致祥，乖气致异。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·劉向傳》和氣致祥，乖氣致異。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Liu Xiang': 'Harmony brings good fortune, discord brings disaster.'
example: 田家因不分家，那棵紫荆又活转过来，岂不是～”的明验吗？★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第七十一回
exampleTraditional: 田家因不分家，那棵紫荊又活轉過來，豈不是～”的明驗嗎？★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第七十一回
exampleEn: Because the Tian family did not separate, that purple wisteria came back to life. Isn't this a clear proof that 'harmony brings good fortune'? — Li Ruzhen's 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 71

explanation: 怀怀藏。身藏璧玉，因此获罪。原指财能致祸◇也比喻有才能而遭受忌妒和迫害。
explanationTraditional: 懷懷藏。身藏璧玉，因此獲罪。原指財能致禍◇也比喻有才能而遭受忌妒和迫害。
explanationEn: Holding a jade becomes a crime; originally meaning wealth leads to disaster, later used metaphorically for talent causing jealousy and persecution.
derivation: 《左传·桓公十年》匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·桓公十年》匹夫無罪，懷璧其罪。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Huan, 10th Year': 'A commoner is not guilty, but holding a jade is his crime.'
example: 修贡之余远争寄，～渠敢当。★宋·张扩《谢人惠团茶》诗
exampleTraditional: 修貢之餘遠爭寄，～渠敢當。★宋·張擴《謝人惠團茶》詩
exampleEn: After offering tribute, they compete to send gifts; how dare I, 'holding a jade becomes a crime'? — Zhang Kuo's poem 'Thanking Someone for a Gift of Tea' (Song Dynasty)

explanation: 黄口儿童；小儿小孩子。常用以讥讽别人年幼无知。
explanationTraditional: 黃口兒童；小兒小孩子。常用以譏諷別人年幼無知。
explanationEn: A yellow-mouthed child; used to mock someone as young and ignorant.
derivation: 《孔子家语·六本》孔子见罗崔者，所得皆黄口小雀。夫子问之曰‘大雀独不得，何也？’罗曰‘大雀善惊而难得，黄口贪食而易得。’”
derivationTraditional: 《孔子家語·六本》孔子見羅崔者，所得皆黃口小雀。夫子問之曰‘大雀獨不得，何也？’羅曰‘大雀善驚而難得，黃口貪食而易得。’”
derivationEn: 'Confucius' Family Sayings: Six Roots': Confucius saw a bird catcher who only caught small yellow-mouthed sparrows. The catcher said, 'Big birds are alert and hard to catch; small ones are greedy and easy.'
example: 其中自然有古典，为～”所不知。★鲁迅《华盖集续编·古书与白话》
exampleTraditional: 其中自然有古典，為～”所不知。★魯迅《華蓋集續編·古書與白話》
exampleEn: Among them, there are naturally classical references unknown to 'yellow-mouthed children'. — Lu Xun's 'Ancient Books and Vernacular Chinese'

explanation: 科科举考试。指旧举行科举考试以选取优异的士人。
explanationTraditional: 科科舉考試。指舊舉行科舉考試以選取優異的士人。
explanationEn: To hold imperial examinations to select talented scholars.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十四回你只想朝廷开科取士，为国求贤，这是何等大典。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十四回你只想朝廷開科取士，為國求賢，這是何等大典。”
derivationEn: Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines' (Qing Dynasty), Chapter 34: 'The court holds examinations to select scholars for the nation's benefit—what a grand ceremony!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 在寂静的山谷里听到脚步声。比喻极难得到音信、言论或来访。
explanationTraditional: 在寂靜的山谷裡聽到腳步聲。比喻極難得到音信、言論或來訪。
explanationEn: Footsteps in a deserted valley; metaphor for extremely rare news, speech, or visit.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·白驹》皎皎白驹，在彼空谷。”《庄子·徐无鬼》闻人足音跫然而喜也。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·白駒》皎皎白駒，在彼空谷。”《莊子·徐無鬼》聞人足音跫然而喜也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: White Colt': 'A white colt in that empty valley.' 'Zhuangzi: Xu Wugui': 'Hearing human footsteps brings joy.'
example: 幸～，得见君子，机缘难再，千载一时，故忍耻相投。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷十七
exampleTraditional: 幸～，得見君子，機緣難再，千載一時，故忍恥相投。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷十七
exampleEn: Fortunately, your footsteps in the empty valley allowed me to meet a gentleman. This rare opportunity is a once-in-a-lifetime chance, so I braved shame to come. — Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage' (Qing Dynasty), Volume 17

explanation: 历历分明、清楚。看得清清楚楚。
explanationTraditional: 歷歷分明、清楚。看得清清楚楚。
explanationEn: Clearly visible; can be seen distinctly.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《夷坚甲志·郑邻再生》殿前挂大镜，照人心腑，历历可见。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《夷堅甲志·鄭鄰再生》殿前掛大鏡，照人心腑，歷歷可見。”
derivationEn: Hong Mai's 'Yijian Zhi: Jia: Zheng Lin's Rebirth' (Song Dynasty): 'In front of the hall hung a large mirror, reflecting people's hearts and organs, clearly visible.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 深深渊；履踩踏；薄薄冰。面临深渊，脚踩薄冰。比喻小心谨慎，惟恐有失。
explanationTraditional: 深深淵；履踩踏；薄薄冰。面臨深淵，腳踩薄冰。比喻小心謹慎，惟恐有失。
explanationEn: Facing a deep abyss and treading on thin ice; metaphor for being extremely cautious, fearing loss.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·小昮》战战兢兢，如临深渊，如履薄冰。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·小昮》戰戰兢兢，如臨深淵，如履薄冰。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Xiaomin': 'Trembling with fear, as if facing a deep abyss, as if treading on thin ice.'
example: 岂可不～，以为至戒？★《后汉书·杨终传》
exampleTraditional: 豈可不～，以為至戒？★《後漢書·楊終傳》
exampleEn: How can one not be 'as if facing a deep abyss, as if treading on thin ice' as the utmost warning? — 'Book of Later Han: Biography of Yang Zhong'

explanation: 依恋着不愿去。形容依依惜别的情貌。
explanationTraditional: 依戀著不願去。形容依依惜別的情貌。
explanationEn: Reluctant to leave; describes a sentimental farewell.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第二十八回玄德曰‘吾初见子龙，便有留恋不舍之情。今幸得相遇！’”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第二十八回玄德曰‘吾初見子龍，便有留戀不捨之情。今幸得相遇！’”
derivationEn: Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' (Ming Dynasty), Chapter 28: 'Xuande said, 'When I first saw Zilong, I felt reluctant to part. Now I am fortunate to meet him again!''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 履踩踏；夷平坦。走在危险的地方就象走在平地一样。比喻平安地渡过困境。
explanationTraditional: 履踩踏；夷平坦。走在危險的地方就象走在平地一樣。比喻平安地渡過困境。
explanationEn: Walking on dangerous ground as if on level ground; metaphor for safely overcoming difficulties.
derivation: 汉·刘协《喻郭汜诏》今得东移，望远若近，视险如夷。”《晋书·姚苌载记》董率大众，履险若夷，上下咸允，人尽死力。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·劉協《喻郭汜詔》今得東移，望遠若近，視險如夷。”《晉書·姚萇載記》董率大眾，履險若夷，上下鹹允，人盡死力。”
derivationEn: Emperor Xian of Han's 'Edict to Guo Si': 'Now moving east, the distant seems near, and danger is seen as level.' 'Book of Jin: Biography of Yao Chang': 'Leading the troops, treading danger as if level, all are loyal and exert their utmost.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 乱臣叛乱之臣；贼子忤逆之子。旧指不守君臣、父子之道的人◇泛指心怀异志的人。
explanationTraditional: 亂臣叛亂之臣；賊子忤逆之子。舊指不守君臣、父子之道的人◇泛指心懷異志的人。
explanationEn: Rebellious ministers and unfilial sons; refers to those who betray the ruler or defy moral order.
derivation: 《孟子·藤文公下》孔子成《春秋》，而乱臣贼子俱。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·藤文公下》孔子成《春秋》，而亂臣賊子俱。”
derivationEn: Mencius, Tengwen Gong II: 'Confucius completed the Spring and Autumn Annals, and rebellious ministers and unfilial sons were terrified.'
example: 有贼不讨，则故君不得书葬，新君不得书即位，所以防～，法至严也。★清·爱新觉罗·多尔衮《致史可法书》
exampleTraditional: 有賊不討，則故君不得書葬，新君不得書即位，所以防～，法至嚴也。★清·愛新覺羅·多爾袞《致史可法書》
exampleEn: If rebels are not punished, the deceased ruler cannot be buried with honor, and the new ruler cannot assume the throne. This is to prevent rebellious ministers and unfilial sons. The law is extremely strict. — Qing Dynasty, Aisin Gioro Dorgon, Letter to Shi Kefa

explanation: 指永远不会停止或没有边际。
explanationTraditional: 指永遠不會停止或沒有邊際。
explanationEn: Endless or boundless; never stopping.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 科学技术的发展是～的。
exampleTraditional: 科學技術的發展是～的。
exampleEn: The development of science and technology is endless.

explanation: 牛身上一根毛。比喻微不足道。亦作九牛一毛”。
explanationTraditional: 牛身上一根毛。比喻微不足道。亦作九牛一毛”。
explanationEn: A single hair on an ox; metaphor for something insignificant.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 称人才思敏捷。
explanationTraditional: 稱人才思敏捷。
explanationEn: Describes someone with quick wit and literary talent.
derivation: 南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·文学》文帝尝令东阿王七步中作诗，不成者行大法；应声便为诗曰‘煮豆持作羹，漉菽以为汁；萁在釜下燃，豆在釜中泣；本自同根生，相煎何太急！’帝深有惭色。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·文學》文帝嘗令東阿王七步中作詩，不成者行大法；應聲便為詩曰‘煮豆持作羹，漉菽以為汁；萁在釜下燃，豆在釜中泣；本自同根生，相煎何太急！’帝深有慚色。”
derivationEn: Liu Yiqing, A New Account of the Tales of the World: 'Emperor Wen once ordered the Prince of Dong'e to compose a poem within seven paces, or face severe punishment. The prince immediately recited: 'Boiling beans to make soup, filtering the residue to get juice. The beanstalk burns under the pot, while the beans weep in the pot. They come from the same root, why torment each other so?' The emperor was deeply ashamed.'
example: 冷绛雪道‘子建～，千秋佳话，哪有改期姑待之理。’★明·罗贯中《平山冷燕》第六回
exampleTraditional: 冷絳雪道‘子建～，千秋佳話，哪有改期姑待之理。’★明·羅貫中《平山冷燕》第六回
exampleEn: Leng Jiangxue said, 'Zijian composed a poem in seven paces, a timeless tale. How could there be a delay or postponement?' — Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, Ping Shan Leng Yan, Chapter 6

explanation: ①千年万年，形容岁月长久。②婉言帝王之死。
explanationTraditional: ①千年萬年，形容歲月長久。②婉言帝王之死。
explanationEn: ① Thousands of years, describing a long duration. ② Euphemism for the death of an emperor.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象坐在春风中间。比喻同品德高尚且有学识的人相处并受到熏陶。
explanationTraditional: 象坐在春風中間。比喻同品德高尚且有學識的人相處並受到薰陶。
explanationEn: Like sitting in a spring breeze; metaphor for being influenced by a virtuous and learned person.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《伊洛渊源录》卷四朱公掞见明道于汝州，逾月而归。语人曰‘光庭在春风中坐了一月。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《伊洛淵源錄》卷四朱公掞見明道於汝州，逾月而歸。語人曰‘光庭在春風中坐了一月。’”
derivationEn: Zhu Xi, Records of the Origins of the Yi-Luo School: 'Zhu Guangting met Mingdao in Ruzhou and returned after a month. He told others, 'I sat in the spring breeze for a month.''
example: （鲁迅先生）说话时态度镇静，亲切而又从容，使听的人心情舒畅，真个有～”的感觉。★唐弢《琐忆》
exampleTraditional: （魯迅先生）說話時態度鎮靜，親切而又從容，使聽的人心情舒暢，真個有～”的感覺。★唐弢《瑣憶》
exampleEn: Mr. Lu Xun spoke calmly, kindly, and unhurriedly, making listeners feel at ease, truly like sitting in a spring breeze. — Tang Tao, Trivial Memories

explanation: 指年轻人可培养。
explanationTraditional: 指年輕人可培養。
explanationEn: The young person is worth teaching; indicates potential.
derivation: 《史记·留侯世家》父去里所，复返，曰‘孺子可教矣。’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·留侯世家》父去裡所，復返，曰‘孺子可教矣。’”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian, Biography of Zhang Liang: 'The old man returned after a distance and said, 'This young man is worth teaching.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 食言失信。指不守信用，只图自己占便宜。
explanationTraditional: 食言失信。指不守信用，只圖自己佔便宜。
explanationEn: To break one's promise for personal gain; to be untrustworthy.
derivation: 《左传·哀公二十五年》是食言多矣，能无肥乎？”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·哀公二十五年》是食言多矣，能無肥乎？”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan, Duke Ai's 25th Year: 'He has broken his promises so many times, how can he not be fat?'
example: 你们～，不承认这个原来答应承认的区域。★毛泽东《评国民党十一中全会和三届二次国民参议会》
exampleTraditional: 你們～，不承認這個原來答應承認的區域。★毛澤東《評國民黨十一中全會和三屆二次國民參議會》
exampleEn: You have broken your promise and refused to recognize the area you originally agreed to. — Mao Zedong, Comment on the Kuomintang's Eleventh Plenary Session and the Third People's Political Council

explanation: 碧青绿色。形容景色很美，艳丽如画。亦作水绿山青”。
explanationTraditional: 碧青綠色。形容景色很美，豔麗如畫。亦作水綠山青”。
explanationEn: Green water and blue mountains; describes beautiful scenery like a painting.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 丝指弦乐器；竹指管乐器。琴瑟箫笛等乐器的总称。也指音乐。
explanationTraditional: 絲指絃樂器；竹指管樂器。琴瑟簫笛等樂器的總稱。也指音樂。
explanationEn: String and wind instruments; general term for musical instruments and music.
derivation: 晋·王羲之《兰亭集序》虽无丝竹管弦之盛，一觞一咏，亦足以畅叙幽情。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·王羲之《蘭亭集序》雖無絲竹管絃之盛，一觴一詠，亦足以暢敘幽情。”
derivationEn: Wang Xizhi, Preface to the Orchid Pavilion Collection: 'Although there is no grand music of strings and pipes, a cup of wine and a poem are enough to express deep feelings.'
example: ～韵悠扬，歌喉宛转何清越。★李木庵《秧歌舞吟》诗
exampleTraditional: ～韻悠揚，歌喉宛轉何清越。★李木庵《秧歌舞吟》詩
exampleEn: The melody of strings and pipes lingers, the singing voice is clear and melodious. — Li Mu'an, Poem on Yangge Dance

explanation: 昭昭明显。旧称天能主持公道，善恶报应分明。
explanationTraditional: 昭昭明顯。舊稱天能主持公道，善惡報應分明。
explanationEn: Heavenly justice is evident; the belief that heaven upholds justice and rewards or punishes accordingly.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《朱子语类·论语·吾与回也章》伊川有天理昭彰语。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《朱子語類·論語·吾與回也章》伊川有天理昭彰語。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Zhu Xi's 'Classified Conversations of Zhu Xi'.
example: 这一个～，谁想到有今朝。★元·无名氏《冯玉兰》第三折
exampleTraditional: 這一個～，誰想到有今朝。★元·無名氏《馮玉蘭》第三折
exampleEn: Heavenly justice is evident; who would have thought it would come to this today? — Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Feng Yulan' Act 3.

explanation: 头角比喻青年人显露出来的才华；峥嵘特出的样子。形容年轻有为，才华出众。
explanationTraditional: 頭角比喻青年人顯露出來的才華；崢嶸特出的樣子。形容年輕有為，才華出眾。
explanationEn: Outstanding talent in youth; showing exceptional ability at a young age.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《柳子厚墓志铭》虽少年，已自成人，能取进士第，崭然露头角。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《柳子厚墓誌銘》雖少年，已自成人，能取進士第，嶄然露頭角。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Han Yu's 'Epitaph for Liu Zihou': 'Though young, he had already become a man, able to pass the imperial exams, and his talent was evident.'
example: 那时～际，搅海翻江上九天。★元·无名氏《黄鹤楼》第三折
exampleTraditional: 那時～際，攪海翻江上九天。★元·無名氏《黃鶴樓》第三折
exampleEn: At that time of outstanding talent, stirring the sea and overturning rivers to ascend the nine heavens. — Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Yellow Crane Tower' Act 3.

explanation: 不是不可以。委婉地肯定。
explanationTraditional: 不是不可以。委婉地肯定。
explanationEn: Not unacceptable; a polite way to express agreement or possibility.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指文章在词句和内容方面都行不通。
explanationTraditional: 指文章在詞句和內容方面都行不通。
explanationEn: Incoherent in both wording and content; poorly written.
derivation: 《旧五代史·选举志》况此等多不究义，唯攻帖书，文理既不甚通，名第岂可妄与？”
derivationTraditional: 《舊五代史·選舉志》況此等多不究義，唯攻帖書，文理既不甚通，名第豈可妄與？”
derivationEn: 'Old History of the Five Dynasties, Records of Elections': 'Moreover, most of these do not delve into meaning, only focus on memorization; if the writing is not coherent, how can they be given high ranks?'
example: 很难想象，有的人连写信都～，怎么能准确、简炼、明白地写出科学论文呢？
exampleTraditional: 很難想象，有的人連寫信都～，怎麼能準確、簡煉、明白地寫出科學論文呢？
exampleEn: It is hard to imagine how someone who cannot even write a coherent letter can produce accurate, concise, and clear scientific papers.

explanation: ①形容多而分散。②形容少许或细碎。
explanationTraditional: ①形容多而分散。②形容少許或細碎。
explanationEn: Scattered and numerous; or small and trivial bits.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 换一换所处的地位。比喻为对方想一想。
explanationTraditional: 換一換所處的地位。比喻為對方想一想。
explanationEn: To put oneself in another's position; to consider things from someone else's perspective.
derivation: 唐·刘知几《通史·杂说上》若使（司）马迁易地而处 ，撰成《汉书》，将恐多言费辞，有逾班氏。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉知幾《通史·雜說上》若使（司）馬遷易地而處 ，撰成《漢書》，將恐多言費辭，有逾班氏。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Liu Zhiji's 'General History, Miscellaneous Discussions': 'If Sima Qian were in his place and wrote the Book of Han, he would probably be verbose and surpass Ban Gu.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 意思含畜深远，耐人寻味。同意味深长”。
explanationTraditional: 意思含畜深遠，耐人尋味。同意味深長”。
explanationEn: Profound and thought-provoking; rich in meaning.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧俗把神像抬出庙来游行，并举行祭会，以求消灾赐福。
explanationTraditional: 舊俗把神像抬出廟來遊行，並舉行祭會，以求消災賜福。
explanationEn: A traditional custom of parading idols through the streets and holding ceremonies to pray for disaster relief and blessings.
derivation: 元·杜仁杰《刷儿·庄家不识构阑》套曲抬头觑是个钟楼模样，往下觑却是人旋窝。见几个妇女向台儿上坐，又不是迎神赛社，不住的擂鼓筛锣。”
derivationTraditional: 元·杜仁杰《刷兒·莊家不識構闌》套曲抬頭覷是個鐘樓模樣，往下覷卻是人旋窩。見幾個婦女向臺兒上坐，又不是迎神賽社，不住的擂鼓篩鑼。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Du Renjie's suite 'Zhuangjia Buzhi Goulan': 'Looking up, it looked like a bell tower; looking down, it was a whirl of people. I saw some women sitting on a stage, not a god-welcoming festival, but constant drumming and gonging.'
example: 孩子们所盼望的，过年过节之外，大概要数～的时候了。★鲁迅《朝花夕拾·五猖会》
exampleTraditional: 孩子們所盼望的，過年過節之外，大概要數～的時候了。★魯迅《朝花夕拾·五猖會》
exampleEn: What children look forward to, besides New Year and festivals, is probably the time of the god-welcoming parade. — Lu Xun, 'Dawn Blossoms Plucked at Dusk: The Five-Chang Meeting'.

explanation: 纡屈抑。指地位高的人降低身分俯就。
explanationTraditional: 紆屈抑。指地位高的人降低身分俯就。
explanationEn: To condescend; a person of high status lowers himself to associate with those of lower status.
derivation: 梁·简文帝《昭明太子集序》降贵纡尊，躬刊手掇。”
derivationTraditional: 梁·簡文帝《昭明太子集序》降貴紆尊，躬刊手掇。”
derivationEn: Liang Dynasty, Emperor Jianwen's 'Preface to the Collected Works of Crown Prince Zhaoming': 'He condescended to personally edit and compile.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 小鸟的羽毛已经长全。比喻已经成熟或实力已强大。
explanationTraditional: 小鳥的羽毛已經長全。比喻已經成熟或實力已強大。
explanationEn: Fledgling feathers fully grown; metaphor for being mature or having strong power.
derivation: 清·无名氏《杜诗言志》卷十二而彼林木丛杂中，有羽毛丰满而栖于奥援者，令人可望而不可即。”
derivationTraditional: 清·無名氏《杜詩言志》卷十二而彼林木叢雜中，有羽毛豐滿而棲於奧援者，令人可望而不可即。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, anonymous 'Du Shi Yan Zhi' Volume 12: 'In the dense woods, there are those with full feathers perching in high places, unattainable.'
example: 倘若河洛不保，坐看李自成～，以后的事就不堪设想了。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第五十一章
exampleTraditional: 倘若河洛不保，坐看李自成～，以後的事就不堪設想了。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第五十一章
exampleEn: If the Yellow River and Luo River are lost, and Li Zicheng's power grows fully, the future will be unimaginable. — Yao Xueyin, 'Li Zicheng' Volume 2, Chapter 51.

explanation: 臧否褒贬。评论人物好坏。
explanationTraditional: 臧否褒貶。評論人物好壞。
explanationEn: To comment on the merits and demerits of people; to judge others.
derivation: 《晋书·阮籍传》籍虽不拘礼教，然发言玄远，口不臧否人物。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·阮籍傳》籍雖不拘禮教，然發言玄遠，口不臧否人物。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Ruan Ji': 'Although Ruan Ji was not bound by etiquette, his words were profound and he never commented on people.'
example: 语言运用的微妙之处，使～也同样出现了秉的局面。
exampleTraditional: 語言運用的微妙之處，使～也同樣出現了秉的局面。
exampleEn: The subtlety of language use makes the judgment of people also appear in a forced situation.

explanation: 比喻藏书丰富。同坐拥百城”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻藏書豐富。同坐擁百城”。
explanationEn: To possess a vast collection of books; to be surrounded by books.
derivation: 孙百刚《郁达夫外传·风雨茅庐》达夫的书，我们一向知道是多的……但从前住的都是弄堂小房子，没有一间正式的书房，所以未窥全豹。经现在这么陈列一番，真是坐拥书城，洋洋大观了。”
derivationTraditional: 孫百剛《郁達夫外傳·風雨茅廬》達夫的書，我們一向知道是多的……但從前住的都是弄堂小房子，沒有一間正式的書房，所以未窺全豹。經現在這麼陳列一番，真是坐擁書城，洋洋大觀了。”
derivationEn: From Sun Baigang's 'The Story of Yu Dafu: The Thatched Cottage in Wind and Rain': 'Dafu's books, we always knew, were many... but previously he lived in small alley houses without a proper study, so we never saw the full collection. Now displayed like this, it truly is sitting amidst a city of books, a grand spectacle.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 言说；状描绘。无法用言语形容。
explanationTraditional: 言說；狀描繪。無法用言語形容。
explanationEn: Indescribable; beyond words.
derivation: 晋·葛洪《神仙记·王远》衣有文采，又非锦绮，光彩耀目，不可名状。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·葛洪《神仙記·王遠》衣有文采，又非錦綺，光彩耀目，不可名狀。”
derivationEn: From Ge Hong's 'Records of Immortals: Wang Yuan': 'The clothes had patterns, yet were not brocade; they were dazzling and indescribable.'
example: 当时我真悲哀到～。★蒋光慈《少年飘泊者》八
exampleTraditional: 當時我真悲哀到～。★蔣光慈《少年飄泊者》八
exampleEn: At that time, I was sad beyond words. ★ Jiang Guangci's 'The Young Wanderer' Chapter 8

explanation: 形容说话内容混乱，无法理解。同不知所云”。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話內容混亂，無法理解。同不知所云”。
explanationEn: To speak incoherently; to not know what one is saying.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀书·诸葛亮传》臣不胜受恩感激，今当远离，临表涕零，不知所言。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀書·諸葛亮傳》臣不勝受恩感激，今當遠離，臨表涕零，不知所言。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Book of Shu: Biography of Zhuge Liang': 'I am overwhelmed with gratitude and emotion. Now I am about to leave, and with tears I write this memorial, not knowing what I say.'
example: 公长民短，临时～，既后觉其不可耳。★南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·政事》
exampleTraditional: 公長民短，臨時～，既後覺其不可耳。★南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·政事》
exampleEn: The lord's words were long and the subject's short; at the time he did not know what he said, and later realized it was inappropriate. ★ Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World' (Shishuo Xinyu)

explanation: 掌握运用或驾驭得心应手，毫无阻碍。
explanationTraditional: 掌握運用或駕馭得心應手，毫無阻礙。
explanationEn: To handle or control with ease and skill; to have full command.
derivation: 明·文秉《先拨志始》卷上所以太阳下移，而忠贤辈得以操纵如意也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·文秉《先撥志始》捲上所以太陽下移，而忠賢輩得以操縱如意也。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Wen Bing's 'Records of the First Stirrings of Ambition' Volume 1: 'Thus the sun moved downward, and the eunuch faction could manipulate as they pleased.'
example: 他驾驶的情状亦有～之妙，不意今日遇见这么大的风浪，所以都毛了手脚。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》
exampleTraditional: 他駕駛的情狀亦有～之妙，不意今日遇見這麼大的風浪，所以都毛了手腳。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》
exampleEn: His driving showed such mastery that it seemed effortless; unexpectedly encountering such strong winds and waves, everyone became flustered. ★ Liu E's 'The Travels of Lao Can'

explanation: 有正当理由进行征伐。
explanationTraditional: 有正當理由進行征伐。
explanationEn: To have a just cause for launching a military campaign.
derivation: 京剧《将相和》第一场赵若献璧，乃惧怕我邦，不难臣服；若是不献，再去征讨，方算出师有名。”
derivationTraditional: 京劇《將相和》第一場趙若獻璧，乃懼怕我邦，不難臣服；若是不獻，再去征討，方算出師有名。”
derivationEn: From Peking opera 'The General and the Prime Minister Make Up' Act 1: 'If Zhao presents the jade, it shows fear of our state and can be easily subdued; if not, then we attack, which is a justified campaign.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹殚精毕力。尽心竭力。
explanationTraditional: 猶殫精畢力。盡心竭力。
explanationEn: To exhaust one's mental and physical energy; to do one's utmost.
derivation: 明·胡应麟《诗薮·古体中》而其叙致周折，语意神奇处，更千百年大匠国工，殚精竭力不能恍惚。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡應麟《詩藪·古體中》而其敘致周折，語意神奇處，更千百年大匠國工，殫精竭力不能恍惚。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty Hu Yinglin's 'Poetic Depths: Ancient Style': 'And its narrative twists and turns, the wonder of language and meaning, even the greatest craftsmen and masters of a thousand years could not achieve it even with utmost effort.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旦早晨。夕晚上。早晚之间，形容在很短时间内。
explanationTraditional: 旦早晨。夕晚上。早晚之間，形容在很短時間內。
explanationEn: In a very short time; between morning and evening.
derivation: 汉·无名氏《焦仲卿妻》蒲苇一时纫，便作旦夕间。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·無名氏《焦仲卿妻》蒲葦一時紉，便作旦夕間。”
derivationEn: From Han dynasty anonymous 'The Peacock Flies Southeast': 'The pampas grass is tough for a while, but it will break within a day.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容血腥的杀戮。
explanationTraditional: 形容血腥的殺戮。
explanationEn: The gleam of knives and shadows of blood; a scene of bloody slaughter.
derivation: 郭沫若《洪波曲》第五章一武汉三镇，自北伐以来，在刀光血影之下已经窒息了整整十年。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《洪波曲》第五章一武漢三鎮，自北伐以來，在刀光血影之下已經窒息了整整十年。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'Waves of the Hongqu' Chapter 5, Section 1: 'Wuhan's three towns, since the Northern Expedition, had been suffocated under the gleam of knives and shadows of blood for a full ten years.'
example: 在～面前，他昂然直视。★胡旷《短促而光辉的生命》
exampleTraditional: 在～面前，他昂然直視。★胡曠《短促而光輝的生命》
exampleEn: In the face of the gleam of knives and shadows of blood, he looked straight ahead. ★ Hu Kuang's 'A Short but Brilliant Life'

explanation: 像鹅毛一样的雪花。形容雪下得大而猛。
explanationTraditional: 像鵝毛一樣的雪花。形容雪下得大而猛。
explanationEn: Snowflakes as big as goose feathers; heavy snowfall.
derivation: 唐·白居易《雪夜喜李郎中见访》可怜今夜鹅毛雪，引得高情鹤氅人。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《雪夜喜李郎中見訪》可憐今夜鵝毛雪，引得高情鶴氅人。”
derivationEn: From Tang dynasty Bai Juyi's 'Happy Snow, Thanking Li for Visiting at Night': 'Pity tonight's goose-feather snow, attracting the high-minded guest in crane-feather cloak.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻子女长大奉养父母，报答恩情。
explanationTraditional: 比喻子女長大奉養父母，報答恩情。
explanationEn: A metaphor for children repaying their parents' kindness by supporting them in old age.
derivation: 明·李时珍《本草纲目·禽部》慈鸟此鸟初生，母哺六十日，长则反哺六十日，可谓慈孝矣。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李時珍《本草綱目·禽部》慈鳥此鳥初生，母哺六十日，長則反哺六十日，可謂慈孝矣。”
derivationEn: From Li Shizhen's 'Compendium of Materia Medica' (Ming Dynasty): 'The filial crow, when born, is fed by its mother for sixty days, and when grown, it feeds its mother for sixty days in return.'
example: 他按月把钱寄给乡下的母亲，好让母亲从这～中来体会儿子对她的孝心。
exampleTraditional: 他按月把錢寄給鄉下的母親，好讓母親從這～中來體會兒子對她的孝心。
exampleEn: He sends money to his mother in the countryside every month, so that she can feel his filial piety through this act of repaying kindness.

explanation: 羁约束。放纵任性，不加检点，不受约束。
explanationTraditional: 羈約束。放縱任性，不加檢點，不受約束。
explanationEn: Unrestrained and unconventional, without self-discipline or constraints.
derivation: 《晋书·王长文传》少以才学知名，而放荡不羁，州府辟命皆不就。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·王長文傳》少以才學知名，而放蕩不羈，州府辟命皆不就。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Wang Changwen': 'Known for his talent and learning from a young age, but was unrestrained and refused all official appointments.'
example: 他是个～的人，便辞了职，游山水，喝酒，作诗。★朱自清《诗第十二》
exampleTraditional: 他是個～的人，便辭了職，遊山水，喝酒，作詩。★朱自清《詩第十二》
exampleEn: He was an unrestrained person, so he resigned, traveled, drank, and wrote poems. (Zhu Ziqing, 'Poetry No. 12')

explanation: 堵墙壁。观看的人象一堵墙一样。形容观看人数众多。
explanationTraditional: 堵牆壁。觀看的人象一堵牆一樣。形容觀看人數眾多。
explanationEn: Spectators form a wall-like crowd; describes a large audience.
derivation: 《礼记·射义》孔子射于矍相之圃，盖观者如堵墙。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·射義》孔子射於矍相之圃，蓋觀者如堵牆。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: The Meaning of Archery': 'When Confucius shot at the Ju Xiang garden, the spectators formed a wall.'
example: 在都市偶过市廛，闻弦歌声，～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·口技》
exampleTraditional: 在都市偶過市廛，聞絃歌聲，～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·口技》
exampleEn: In the city, passing by a market, hearing string songs, the spectators formed a wall. (Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Ventriloquism')

explanation: 观看的人如行云那样密集。形容观看的人多。
explanationTraditional: 觀看的人如行雲那樣密集。形容觀看的人多。
explanationEn: Spectators gather like clouds; describes a large crowd of onlookers.
derivation: 《云笈七签》卷一一三引前蜀·杜光庭《墉城集仙录·王奉仙》自咸通迄光启四十年间，游淮浙之宛陵，所至之处，观者云集。”
derivationTraditional: 《雲笈七籤》卷一一三引前蜀·杜光庭《墉城集仙錄·王奉仙》自鹹通迄光啟四十年間，遊淮浙之宛陵，所至之處，觀者雲集。”
derivationEn: From 'Yunji Qiqian' (vol. 113, citing Du Guangting's 'Biographies of Immortals'): 'From Xiantong to Guangqi, for forty years, wherever she went in Wanling, spectators gathered like clouds.'
example: 于是～，皆恐伤其子。计无所出。★清·俞樾《右台仙馆笔记》卷四
exampleTraditional: 於是～，皆恐傷其子。計無所出。★清·俞樾《右臺仙館筆記》卷四
exampleEn: Thus spectators gathered like clouds, all fearing harm to the child, but no plan was found. (Yu Yue, 'Notes from the Right Terrace Immortal's Studio', vol. 4)

explanation: 荒淫淫乱无度，贪恋酒色。无道不讲或不行道义。多指君主生活糜烂，重用奸佞，残害忠良，奴役百姓。
explanationTraditional: 荒淫淫亂無度，貪戀酒色。無道不講或不行道義。多指君主生活糜爛，重用奸佞，殘害忠良，奴役百姓。
explanationEn: Describes a ruler who is debauched, neglects moral principles, and oppresses the people.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百九回今主上荒淫无道，亵近娼优，听信谗言，闭塞贤路其罪甚于汉之昌邑，不能主天下。吾谨按伊尹、霍光之法，别立新君，以保社稷，以安天下，如何？”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百九回今主上荒淫無道，褻近娼優，聽信讒言，閉塞賢路其罪甚於漢之昌邑，不能主天下。吾謹按伊尹、霍光之法，別立新君，以保社稷，以安天下，如何？”
derivationEn: From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' (Chapter 109): 'The current ruler is debauched and unprincipled, favoring actors and prostitutes, listening to slander, and blocking the path of the virtuous.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 江汉指长江和汉水；朝宗诸侯朝见天子，借喻百川入海。指江河奔流入海。也比喻魇、大势所趋，人心所向。
explanationTraditional: 江漢指長江和漢水；朝宗諸侯朝見天子，借喻百川入海。指江河奔流入海。也比喻魘、大勢所趨，人心所向。
explanationEn: Rivers flow into the sea; metaphor for an irresistible trend or popular sentiment.
derivation: 《尚书·禹贡》江汉朝宗于海。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·禹貢》江漢朝宗於海。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Tribute of Yu': 'The Yangtze and Han rivers flow into the sea.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 进身上升；阶台阶。使身体能够上升的阶梯。旧指借以提拔升迁的门路。
explanationTraditional: 進身上升；階臺階。使身體能夠上升的階梯。舊指藉以提拔升遷的門路。
explanationEn: A stepping stone for promotion or advancement in one's career.
derivation: 元·胡柢遹《紫山大全集·礼论》殊不察自即位以来，所闻之言无大利害，适足以为口舌者进身之阶，虚失待大臣之体，渎上下之分。”
derivationTraditional: 元·胡柢遹《紫山大全集·禮論》殊不察自即位以來，所聞之言無大利害，適足以為口舌者進身之階，虛失待大臣之體，瀆上下之分。”
derivationEn: From Hu Zhiyu's 'Complete Works of Zishan' (Yuan Dynasty): 'Since ascending the throne, the words heard have no great benefit, but serve as a stepping stone for those who speak.'
example: 此行倘有～，必当举荐吾兄。（明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十七回）
exampleTraditional: 此行倘有～，必當舉薦吾兄。（明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十七回）
exampleEn: If this trip provides a stepping stone, I will certainly recommend you, brother. (Feng Menglong, 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms', Chapter 87)

explanation: 亢至高的；悔灾祸。意为居高位的人要戒骄，否则会失败而后悔◇也形容倨傲者不免招祸。
explanationTraditional: 亢至高的；悔災禍。意為居高位的人要戒驕，否則會失敗而後悔◇也形容倨傲者不免招禍。
explanationEn: A person in a high position should avoid arrogance, or else regret and disaster will follow.
derivation: 《周易·乾》上九，亢龙有悔。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·乾》上九，亢龍有悔。”
derivationEn: From 'I Ching: Qian Hexagram': 'The dragon at the top has regret.'
example: 进则～，退则蒺藜生庭，冀此求安，未知其福。★《晋书·王豹传》
exampleTraditional: 進則～，退則蒺藜生庭，冀此求安，未知其福。★《晉書·王豹傳》
exampleEn: Advancing leads to the dragon's regret, retreating leads to thorns in the court; seeking safety in this way is unknown fortune. ('Book of Jin: Biography of Wang Bao')

explanation: 比喻自己称赞自己的货色好或本领高强。
explanationTraditional: 比喻自己稱讚自己的貨色好或本領高強。
explanationEn: Metaphor for praising one's own goods or abilities.
derivation: 杨啸《大字报》这是我出的大字报呵！那不成了老王卖瓜，自卖自夸了吗？”
derivationTraditional: 楊嘯《大字報》這是我出的大字報呵！那不成了老王賣瓜，自賣自誇了嗎？”
derivationEn: From Yang Xiao's 'Big Character Poster': 'This is my big character poster! Isn't that like Old Wang selling melons, praising his own goods?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 五色各种颜色。形容颜色既多又杂，因而看不清。比喻事物措综复杂，不易分辨清楚。
explanationTraditional: 五色各種顏色。形容顏色既多又雜，因而看不清。比喻事物措綜複雜，不易分辨清楚。
explanationEn: Dazzled by a variety of colors; metaphor for being confused by complex situations.
derivation: 《老子》五色令人目盲。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》五色令人目盲。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi': 'The five colors blind the eyes.'
example: 慎卿先生此一番评骘，可云至公至明；只怕立朝之后，做主考房官，又要～，奈何？★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: 慎卿先生此一番評騭，可雲至公至明；只怕立朝之後，做主考房官，又要～，奈何？★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回
exampleEn: Your judgment is fair and clear; but once in office, as an examiner, you may be dazzled by complexities. (Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 46)

explanation: 劭美好。年纪大，品德好。
explanationTraditional: 劭美好。年紀大，品德好。
explanationEn: Aged and virtuous; having both advanced age and high moral character.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·孝至》年弥高而德弥劭。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·孝至》年彌高而德彌劭。”
derivationEn: From Yang Xiong's 'Fayan: Xiao Zhi': 'The older one gets, the more virtuous one becomes.'
example: 沈钧儒先生～，爱国热诚，感动全国。★邹韬奋《患难余生记·流亡》
exampleTraditional: 沈鈞儒先生～，愛國熱誠，感動全國。★鄒韜奮《患難餘生記·流亡》
exampleEn: Mr. Shen Junru, aged and virtuous, moved the whole nation with his patriotic fervor. (from Zou Taofen's 'Memories of Hardship: Exile')

explanation: 骗人的鬼话。
explanationTraditional: 騙人的鬼話。
explanationEn: Deceptive words; lies meant to cheat others.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第二十二回你可晓得老爷是讲理学的人，凡事有则有，无则无，从不作欺人之谈的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第二十二回你可曉得老爺是講理學的人，凡事有則有，無則無，從不作欺人之談的。”
derivationEn: From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' (Chapter 22): 'You must know that I am a man of reason; I never speak deceptive words.'
example: 他那番话，都是～，你不要上当。
exampleTraditional: 他那番話，都是～，你不要上當。
exampleEn: His words are all deceptive; don't be fooled.

explanation: 将骨、角、玉、石加工制成器物。比喻学习或研究问题时彼此商讨，互相吸取长处，改正缺点。
explanationTraditional: 將骨、角、玉、石加工製成器物。比喻學習或研究問題時彼此商討，互相吸取長處，改正缺點。
explanationEn: To cut, file, carve, and polish; metaphorically, to learn from each other by discussing and improving together.
derivation: 《诗经·卫风·淇奥》有匪君子，如切如磋，如琢如磨。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·衛風·淇奧》有匪君子，如切如磋，如琢如磨。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Wei Feng: Qiyu': 'There is a gentleman, like cutting, like filing, like carving, like polishing.'
example: 盖以朋友之臧否，文艺之优劣，～，匪朝伊夕，抑扬去就，与众共之。★五代·王定保《唐摭言》卷一
exampleTraditional: 蓋以朋友之臧否，文藝之優劣，～，匪朝伊夕，抑揚去就，與眾共之。★五代·王定保《唐摭言》卷一
exampleEn: Discussing friends' merits and demerits, the quality of literature and art, learning from each other day and night, and sharing opinions with everyone. (from Wang Dingbao's 'Tang Zhiyan', Volume 1)

explanation: 擒抓，捉。指作战要先抓主要敌手。比喻作事要抓住要害。
explanationTraditional: 擒抓，捉。指作戰要先抓主要敵手。比喻作事要抓住要害。
explanationEn: To capture the ringleader first; to strike at the key point or main enemy.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《前出塞》诗之六射人先射马，擒贼先擒王。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《前出塞》詩之六射人先射馬，擒賊先擒王。”
derivationEn: From Du Fu's poem 'Before Going Out' (No. 6): 'To shoot a man, first shoot his horse; to catch bandits, first catch their leader.'
example: 所谓～，这就是办事的诀窍。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第四十四回
exampleTraditional: 所謂～，這就是辦事的訣竅。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第四十四回
exampleEn: The so-called 'catch the leader' is the secret to getting things done. (from Li Baojia's 'A Brief History of Civilization', Chapter 44)

explanation: 迷信的人遇有疑难，求神鬼帮助，或靠卜卦解决。
explanationTraditional: 迷信的人遇有疑難，求神鬼幫助，或靠卜卦解決。
explanationEn: To seek help from gods or divination when in doubt or trouble.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言·乔太守乱点鸳鸯谱》人事不省，十分危笃。吃的药犹如泼在石上，一毫没用。求神问卜，俱说无效。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言·喬太守亂點鴛鴦譜》人事不省，十分危篤。吃的藥猶如潑在石上，一毫沒用。求神問卜，俱說無效。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World: Qiao Taishou Randomly Matches Couples': 'Unconscious and critically ill, medicine was useless like water on stone. Seeking gods and divination all proved ineffective.'
example: 我与你～，且自宽心，将息守己。（明·胡文焕《群音类选·南西厢记·莺莺探病》）
exampleTraditional: 我與你～，且自寬心，將息守己。（明·胡文煥《群音類選·南西廂記·鶯鶯探病》）
exampleEn: I will seek gods and divination for you; just relax and take care of yourself. (from Hu Wenhuan's 'Qun Yin Lei Xuan: The Story of the Western Chamber: Yingying Visits the Sick')

explanation: 原指古凉州治内贺兰山一带◇泛指塞外富庶之地。
explanationTraditional: 原指古涼州治內賀蘭山一帶◇泛指塞外富庶之地。
explanationEn: Originally referred to the area around Helan Mountain in ancient Liangzhou; later used to describe fertile lands beyond the Great Wall.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泛指各种朋友。
explanationTraditional: 泛指各種朋友。
explanationEn: Various friends; a circle of friends.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷五常言‘同声相应，同气相求’，自有一班无赖子弟，三朋四友，和他擎鹰放鹞，驾犬驰马，射猎打生为乐。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷五常言‘同聲相應，同氣相求’，自有一班無賴子弟，三朋四友，和他擎鷹放鷂，駕犬馳馬，射獵打生為樂。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World' (Volume 5): 'As the saying goes, like attracts like; naturally, there were a bunch of rascals, three friends and four buddies, who flew kites, hunted, and had fun together.'
example: 大学毕业，年届三十，婚姻难就，累得～八方搭线，但一次一次介绍终未能成就。★贾平凹《笑口常开》
exampleTraditional: 大學畢業，年屆三十，婚姻難就，累得～八方搭線，但一次一次介紹終未能成就。★賈平凹《笑口常開》
exampleEn: After graduating from university at thirty, marriage was hard to achieve, so friends everywhere helped arrange matches, but none succeeded. (from Jia Pingwa's 'Always Smiling')

explanation: 比喻贪吃的人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻貪吃的人。
explanationEn: A glutton; someone who loves to eat excessively.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻只顾眼前，用有害的方法来救急。
explanationTraditional: 比喻只顧眼前，用有害的方法來救急。
explanationEn: To cut flesh to mend a sore; to resort to a harmful method for temporary relief.
derivation: 唐·聂夷中《咏田家》诗二月卖新丝，五月粜新谷；医得眼前疮，剜却心头肉。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·聶夷中《詠田家》詩二月賣新絲，五月糶新谷；醫得眼前瘡，剜卻心頭肉。”
derivationEn: From Nie Yizhong's poem 'On Farming Families': 'Selling new silk in February, selling new grain in May; to cure the sore before the eyes, cut out the heart flesh.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容声音粗大低沉。
explanationTraditional: 形容聲音粗大低沉。
explanationEn: Describing a deep, muffled, and loud voice.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 禄旧时官吏的薪俸。没有功劳而得到报酬。
explanationTraditional: 祿舊時官吏的薪俸。沒有功勞而得到報酬。
explanationEn: To receive rewards without having made any contributions.
derivation: 《诗·魏风·伐檀序》在位贪鄙，无功而受禄，君子不得进仕尔。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩·魏風·伐檀序》在位貪鄙，無功而受祿，君子不得進仕爾。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Songs, Wei Feng, 'Cutting Sandalwood' preface: 'The officials in power are greedy and base, receiving salaries without merit, and gentlemen cannot advance in office.'
example: 依我看来，这银子虽非是你设心谋得来的，也不是你辛苦挣来的，只怕～，反受其殃。★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷二
exampleTraditional: 依我看來，這銀子雖非是你設心謀得來的，也不是你辛苦掙來的，只怕～，反受其殃。★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷二
exampleEn: In my opinion, although this silver was not obtained by your scheming, nor earned by your hard work, I fear that receiving rewards without merit may bring disaster instead. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories Old and New', Volume 2

explanation: 指人的身材矮小。
explanationTraditional: 指人的身材矮小。
explanationEn: Refers to a person of short stature.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》第三十二回这个好汉，祖贯两淮人氏，姓王，名英，为他五短身材，江湖上叫他做矮脚虎。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》第三十二回這個好漢，祖貫兩淮人氏，姓王，名英，為他五短身材，江湖上叫他做矮腳虎。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 32: 'This hero, originally from the Huaihe region, surnamed Wang, given name Ying, because of his short stature, was known in the martial world as the Short-legged Tiger.'
example: ～偏有趣，二八年纪正当时。★明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第十卷
exampleTraditional: ～偏有趣，二八年紀正當時。★明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第十卷
exampleEn: Short stature has its charm, at the age of sixteen, just the right time. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Enlighten the World', Volume 10

explanation: 古代的一种酷刑，用五匹马分裂人的头和四肢，又称四裂”。比喻硬把完整的东西分割得非常零碎。
explanationTraditional: 古代的一種酷刑，用五匹馬分裂人的頭和四肢，又稱四裂”。比喻硬把完整的東西分割得非常零碎。
explanationEn: An ancient cruel punishment of dismembering a person's head and limbs with five horses; metaphorically, to split a whole thing into very small pieces.
derivation: 明·胡文焕《群音类选·北腔类·王昭君和番》无不盖你亏心汉，今日把你分尸五马，远配千年。”
derivationTraditional: 明·胡文煥《群音類選·北腔類·王昭君和番》無不蓋你虧心漢，今日把你分屍五馬，遠配千年。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Hu Wenhuan, 'Selected Tunes of Various Sounds, Northern Tunes, Wang Zhaojun and the Huns': 'You heartless man, today you will be dismembered by five horses and exiled for a thousand years.'
example: 我张飞虎又不能～！也没有三头六臂！那些事我指派给组长了，你们不会问人家。（康濯《工人张飞虎》）
exampleTraditional: 我張飛虎又不能～！也沒有三頭六臂！那些事我指派給組長了，你們不會問人家。（康濯《工人張飛虎》）
exampleEn: I, Zhang Feihu, cannot be dismembered by five horses! Nor do I have three heads and six arms! I assigned those tasks to the team leaders; why don't you ask them? — Kang Zhuo, 'Worker Zhang Feihu'

explanation: 犹扬清激浊。比喻抨击、清除坏人坏事，表彰、发扬好人好事。
explanationTraditional: 猶揚清激濁。比喻抨擊、清除壞人壞事，表彰、發揚好人好事。
explanationEn: To promote the good and suppress the bad; to praise and spread good deeds while criticizing and eliminating evil.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 隅角落。形容地域狭小。
explanationTraditional: 隅角落。形容地域狹小。
explanationEn: A small corner of land; describes a very narrow area.
derivation: 《南史·王弘传论》晋自中原沸腾，介居江左，以一隅之地，抗衡上国。”
derivationTraditional: 《南史·王弘傳論》晉自中原沸騰，介居江左，以一隅之地，抗衡上國。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Southern Dynasties, Biography of Wang Hong': 'Since the Central Plains were in turmoil, Jin took refuge in Jiangzuo, using a small corner of land to contend with the powerful state.'
example: 无
