exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用竹管看豹，只能见其身上的一斑。比喻目光狭隘，见识短浅。
explanationTraditional: 用竹管看豹，只能見其身上的一斑。比喻目光狹隘，見識短淺。
explanationEn: To look at a leopard through a bamboo tube; to have a narrow view and limited insight.
derivation: 语出南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·方正》此郎亦管中窥豹，时见一斑。”
derivationTraditional: 語出南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·方正》此郎亦管中窺豹，時見一斑。”
derivationEn: From Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World, Uprightness': 'This young man also sees a leopard through a tube, occasionally glimpsing a spot.'
example: 至于杨修小儿，目光不离其鼻，～，更不足以知此。★徐懋庸《鸡肋》
exampleTraditional: 至於楊修小兒，目光不離其鼻，～，更不足以知此。★徐懋庸《雞肋》
exampleEn: As for Yang Xiu, a petty man whose gaze never leaves his nose, looking at a leopard through a tube, he is even less capable of understanding this. — Xu Maoyong, 'Chicken Ribs'

explanation: 案案卷，文书；稽查考。指有证据可查。
explanationTraditional: 案案卷，文書；稽查考。指有證據可查。
explanationEn: There are records that can be verified; there is evidence to check.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 尊重中国行政和信封的完整，以及反对任何外国控制中国等等，这是～的。（毛泽东《友谊”，还是侵略？》）
exampleTraditional: 尊重中國行政和信封的完整，以及反對任何外國控制中國等等，這是～的。（毛澤東《友誼”，還是侵略？》）
exampleEn: Respecting the integrity of China's administration and territory, and opposing any foreign control over China, etc., these are matters that can be verified. — Mao Zedong, 'Friendship or Aggression?'

explanation: 抱怨天又抱怨地。形容埋怨不休。
explanationTraditional: 抱怨天又抱怨地。形容埋怨不休。
explanationEn: To complain about heaven and earth; to grumble incessantly.
derivation: 元·高文秀《遇上皇》第三折到今日，悔，悔，悔。也是我前世前缘，自作自受，怨天怨地。”
derivationTraditional: 元·高文秀《遇上皇》第三折到今日，悔，悔，悔。也是我前世前緣，自作自受，怨天怨地。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Gao Wenxiu, 'Meeting the Emperor', Act 3: 'Now I regret, regret, regret. It is also my past life's fate, self-inflicted, complaining to heaven and earth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 挨次序一字一句地。
explanationTraditional: 挨次序一字一句地。
explanationEn: Word by word and sentence by sentence; in sequence.
derivation: 清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第四十一回自上横行退一字成句，逐句逐字逆读，俱成回文。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第四十一回自上橫行退一字成句，逐句逐字逆讀，俱成迴文。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 41: 'From the top horizontal line, retreat one character to form a sentence, read each sentence and word in reverse, all become palindromes.'
example: 要听他这段虚文合后面的实事，却是～针锋相对。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十六回
exampleTraditional: 要聽他這段虛文合後面的實事，卻是～針鋒相對。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十六回
exampleEn: To hear this empty talk and then the subsequent facts, they match each other word for word and sentence for sentence. — Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Story of Heroic Sons and Daughters', Chapter 16

explanation: 指某种错误的思想言行没有约束，到处扩散。
explanationTraditional: 指某種錯誤的思想言行沒有約束，到處擴散。
explanationEn: Refers to erroneous thoughts, words, or actions spreading without restraint.
derivation: 周而复《上海的早晨》十六如果让资产阶级这样猖狂进攻，自由泛滥下去，真的像陈市长所说的，我们国家新民主主义的经济就不能建设成功，人民的生活也不可能改善，社会主义的前途更不可能实现。”
derivationTraditional: 周而復《上海的早晨》十六如果讓資產階級這樣猖狂進攻，自由氾濫下去，真的像陳市長所說的，我們國家新民主主義的經濟就不能建設成功，人民的生活也不可能改善，社會主義的前途更不可能實現。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Erfu, 'Morning in Shanghai', Part 16: 'If we allow the bourgeoisie to launch such fierce attacks, to spread freely and without restraint, as Mayor Chen said, our country's new democratic economy cannot be successfully built, people's lives cannot be improved, and the socialist future cannot be realized.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 受到无数挫折都不屈服、动摇。形容意志坚强。
explanationTraditional: 受到無數挫折都不屈服、動搖。形容意志堅強。
explanationEn: Not yielding or wavering despite countless setbacks; describes strong will.
derivation: 清·恽敬《〈卓忠毅公遗稿〉书后》一旦竟成其名，史书及府县志纪录则有之，必不能千百年之后，人人变色动容，有一百折不屈之人，如在其心，如出其口，如忠毅、方学士、铁尚书者也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·惲敬《〈卓忠毅公遺稿〉書後》一旦竟成其名，史書及府縣誌紀錄則有之，必不能千百年之後，人人變色動容，有一百折不屈之人，如在其心，如出其口，如忠毅、方學士、鐵尚書者也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Yun Jing's postscript to 'Collected Works of Zhuo Zhongyi': 'Once his name was established, historical records and local gazetteers recorded it, but it is certain that after thousands of years, everyone would be moved and stirred, having a person who never yields despite a hundred setbacks, as if in their hearts, as if from their mouths, like Zhongyi, Scholar Fang, and Minister Tie.'
example: 要像总理那样……奋不顾身，～。★郭小川《痛悼敬爱的周总理》诗
exampleTraditional: 要像總理那樣……奮不顧身，～。★郭小川《痛悼敬愛的周總理》詩
exampleEn: Like the Premier... disregard personal safety, never yield despite a hundred setbacks. ★ Guo Xiaochuan's poem 'Deeply Mourning Our Beloved Premier Zhou'

explanation: 形容经过种种曲折和纡回。
explanationTraditional: 形容經過種種曲折和紆迴。
explanationEn: Describes undergoing many twists and turns.
derivation: 赵朴初《与日本佛教友人谈时事为拈一偈》百折千回心不退，无畏方能施无畏。”
derivationTraditional: 趙樸初《與日本佛教友人談時事為拈一偈》百折千迴心不退，無畏方能施無畏。”
derivationEn: From Zhao Puchu's 'A Verse on Current Affairs with Japanese Buddhist Friends': 'With a heart that never retreats despite a hundred twists and a thousand turns, fearlessness enables one to bestow fearlessness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指国土的一部或大部分。
explanationTraditional: 指國土的一部或大部分。
explanationEn: Refers to a part or most of a country's territory.
derivation: 清·钮琹《觚剩·虎林军营唱和》昊《怀古》四首《咏岳忠武》云‘将军野战最知名，半壁河山一力撑。’”
derivationTraditional: 清·鈕琹《觚剩·虎林軍營唱和》昊《懷古》四首《詠嶽忠武》雲‘將軍野戰最知名，半壁河山一力撐。’”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Niu Qiao's 'Tiger Forest Camp Chanting': 'General Yue's poem 'Huai Gu' says: 'The general was most famous in field battles, holding up half the rivers and mountains with all his strength.''
example: ～沉血海，几多知友化沙虫。★陈毅《三十五岁生日寄怀》诗
exampleTraditional: ～沉血海，幾多知友化沙蟲。★陳毅《三十五歲生日寄懷》詩
exampleEn: Half the rivers and mountains sunk in a sea of blood, how many old friends turned to sand and insects. ★ Chen Yi's poem 'Commemorating My 35th Birthday'

explanation: 杯子中的东西，指酒。同杯中物”。
explanationTraditional: 杯子中的東西，指酒。同杯中物”。
explanationEn: The thing in the cup, referring to alcohol. Same as 'thing in the cup'.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第五卷一生挣得一副好酒量，闷来时只是饮酒，尽醉方休，日常饭食，有一顿，没一顿，都不计较，单少不得杯中之物。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第五卷一生掙得一副好酒量，悶來時只是飲酒，盡醉方休，日常飯食，有一頓，沒一頓，都不計較，單少不得杯中之物。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World' Volume 5: 'He had a good capacity for wine all his life, and when bored, he just drank until drunk. For daily meals, he had some and missed some, not caring, but he could not do without the thing in the cup.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 博学广博。学识广博，见闻丰富。
explanationTraditional: 博學廣博。學識廣博，見聞豐富。
explanationEn: Broad learning and extensive knowledge; learned and well-informed.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》博学之，审问之，慎思之，明辨之，笃行之。”《荀子·修身》多闻曰博。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》博學之，審問之，慎思之，明辨之，篤行之。”《荀子·修身》多聞曰博。”
derivationEn: From 'The Doctrine of the Mean': 'Learn extensively, inquire carefully, think prudently, discern clearly, and practice earnestly.' From 'Xunzi: Cultivating Oneself': 'Being well-informed is called broad.'
example: ～，性气英迈，幅巾布裘，游于东西两浙间。★明·瞿佑《剪灯新话·修文舍人传》
exampleTraditional: ～，性氣英邁，幅巾布裘，遊於東西兩浙間。★明·瞿佑《剪燈新話·修文舍人傳》
exampleEn: Broadly learned and well-informed, with a heroic temperament, wearing a headscarf and cloth robe, he traveled between the two Zhejiang regions. ★ Ming Dynasty Qu You's 'New Tales of the Trimmed Lamp: Biography of the Cultured Man'

explanation: 不差一毫一厘。
explanationTraditional: 不差一毫一釐。
explanationEn: Not off by a hair's breadth; extremely accurate.
derivation: 宋·李昿《太平广记》一百五十八郑引《玉堂闲话·许生》显晦之事，不差毫厘矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李昿《太平廣記》一百五十八鄭引《玉堂閒話·許生》顯晦之事，不差毫釐矣。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Li Fang's 'Extensive Records of the Taiping Era' Volume 158 quoting 'Jade Hall Idle Talk: Xu Sheng': 'Matters of the visible and invisible are not off by a hair's breadth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 趁着虚弱疏漏的地方进入。
explanationTraditional: 趁著虛弱疏漏的地方進入。
explanationEn: To take advantage of a weakness or gap to enter.
derivation: 《去笈七签》卷一二０将至所居，自后垣乘虚而入，径及庭中。”
derivationTraditional: 《去笈七籤》卷一二０將至所居，自後垣乘虛而入，徑及庭中。”
derivationEn: From 'Seven Slips of the Cloudy Satchel' Volume 120: 'When he was about to reach his residence, he took advantage of the void from the back wall and entered directly into the courtyard.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 受宠或受辱都毫不计较。常指一种通达的超绝尘世的态度。
explanationTraditional: 受寵或受辱都毫不計較。常指一種通達的超絕塵世的態度。
explanationEn: To be indifferent to favor or disgrace; often describes a transcendent and detached attitude towards the world.
derivation: 宋·范仲淹《岳阳楼记》登斯楼也，则有心旷神怡，宠辱皆忘，把酒临风，其喜洋洋者矣。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·范仲淹《岳陽樓記》登斯樓也，則有心曠神怡，寵辱皆忘，把酒臨風，其喜洋洋者矣。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Fan Zhongyan's 'Record of Yueyang Tower': 'Ascending this tower, one feels relaxed and happy, forgetting both favor and disgrace, holding a cup of wine in the wind, full of joy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 踌躇犹豫，迟疑。形容犹犹疑疑地拿不定主意。
explanationTraditional: 躊躇猶豫，遲疑。形容猶猶疑疑地拿不定主意。
explanationEn: Hesitant and indecisive; unable to make up one's mind.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第二十二回四人争论未定，绍踌躇不决。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第二十二回四人爭論未定，紹躊躇不決。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 22: 'The four argued without conclusion, and Yuan Shao hesitated and could not decide.'
example: 景公口虽不唯唯，终以田陈同族为嫌，～。★明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第八十三回
exampleTraditional: 景公口雖不唯唯，終以田陳同族為嫌，～。★明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第八十三回
exampleEn: Duke Jing did not verbally disagree, but ultimately suspected the Tian and Chen clans of the same lineage, hesitating and unable to decide. ★ Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 83

explanation: 指出乎人的意料之外。
explanationTraditional: 指出乎人的意料之外。
explanationEn: Beyond one's expectations; unexpected.
derivation: 《黄绣球》第四回自想这件事真出于意外，必须自家投到，中诉明白，不能平白地叫妻子良受诬辱。”
derivationTraditional: 《黃繡球》第四回自想這件事真出於意外，必須自家投到，中訴明白，不能平白地叫妻子良受誣辱。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of Huang Xiuqiu' Chapter 4: 'She thought this matter was truly unexpected, and she must go and confess herself, explain clearly, and not let her good wife suffer false accusation in vain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 刚出生的小牛，比喻单纯或勇猛的青年人。
explanationTraditional: 剛出生的小牛，比喻單純或勇猛的青年人。
explanationEn: A newborn calf, metaphor for a naive or fearless young person.
derivation: 先秦·庄周《庄子·知北游》德将为汝美，道将为汝居，汝瞳焉如新生之犊而无求其故！”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·莊周《莊子·知北遊》德將為汝美，道將為汝居，汝瞳焉如新生之犢而無求其故！”
derivationEn: Pre-Qin·Zhuang Zhou, 'Zhuangzi: The Knowledge of the North'
example: 以～的勇气，站在一切战斗的前列。★夏衍《戏剧抗战三年间》
exampleTraditional: 以～的勇氣，站在一切戰鬥的前列。★夏衍《戲劇抗戰三年間》
exampleEn: With the courage of a newborn calf, stand at the forefront of all battles. — Xia Yan, 'Three Years of Drama in the War of Resistance'

explanation: 柱子的基石润湿了，就是要下雨的征候。比喻见到一点迹象，就能知道它的发展方向。
explanationTraditional: 柱子的基石潤溼了，就是要下雨的徵候。比喻見到一點跡象，就能知道它的發展方向。
explanationEn: When the foundation stone is damp, rain is coming. Metaphor for foreseeing development from early signs.
derivation: 《淮南子·说林训》山云蒸，柱础润。”宋·苏洵《辨奸论》月晕而风，础润而雨，人人知之。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·說林訓》山雲蒸，柱礎潤。”宋·蘇洵《辨姦論》月暈而風，礎潤而雨，人人知之。”
derivationEn: 'Huainanzi: Forest of Sayings'; Su Xun, 'On Identifying Treachery'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 存保存；续接续。恢复灭亡的国家，延续断绝了的贵族世家。
explanationTraditional: 存保存；續接續。恢復滅亡的國家，延續斷絕了的貴族世家。
explanationEn: To restore a fallen state or continue a broken lineage.
derivation: 清·龚自珍《古史钩沉论二》天生孔子不后周，不先周也，存亡续绝，俾枢纽也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·龔自珍《古史鉤沉論二》天生孔子不後周，不先周也，存亡續絕，俾樞紐也。”
derivationEn: Qing·Gong Zizhen, 'On Ancient History: Part Two'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻自然流畅，不矫揉造作。
explanationTraditional: 比喻自然流暢，不矯揉造作。
explanationEn: Natural and smooth, without affectation.
derivation: 《周易·涣》象曰风行水上，涣。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·渙》象曰風行水上，渙。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes: Huan Hexagram'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指丈夫尊贵，妻子也随之光荣。见夫荣妻贵”。
explanationTraditional: 指丈夫尊貴，妻子也隨之光榮。見夫榮妻貴”。
explanationEn: When the husband is honored, the wife shares the glory.
derivation: 唐·唐正辞《太子宾客赵夫人夏侯氏墓志》鱼轩象服，夫贵妻荣。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·唐正辭《太子賓客趙夫人夏侯氏墓誌》魚軒象服，夫貴妻榮。”
derivationEn: Tang·Tang Zhengci, 'Epitaph for Lady Zhao, Wife of the Crown Prince's Guest'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 皮肤像凝固的油脂。形容皮肤洁白且细嫩。
explanationTraditional: 皮膚像凝固的油脂。形容皮膚潔白且細嫩。
explanationEn: Skin like solidified fat, describing white and delicate skin.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 无心富贵，被迫出仕。也指因有财势，人来靠拢。
explanationTraditional: 無心富貴，被迫出仕。也指因有財勢，人來靠攏。
explanationEn: Wealth and honor come unbidden, forcing one to take office; also, people flock to the rich and powerful.
derivation: 《北史·杨素传》臣但恐富贵来逼臣，臣无心图富贵。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·楊素傳》臣但恐富貴來逼臣，臣無心圖富貴。”
derivationEn: 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Yang Su'
example: 这时港中绅商富户，差不多也到齐了。自古道～来。”到也难怪。★清·黄小配《廿载繁华梦》第二十四回
exampleTraditional: 這時港中紳商富戶，差不多也到齊了。自古道～來。”到也難怪。★清·黃小配《廿載繁華夢》第二十四回
exampleEn: By then, the wealthy and gentry of Hong Kong had mostly arrived. As the old saying goes, 'Wealth and honor come unbidden.' — Huang Xiaopei, 'Twenty Years of Splendor' Chapter 24

explanation: 经书正文上端留有较宽空白，刊印讲解文字，这些文字称为高头讲章”◇来泛指这类格式的经书。
explanationTraditional: 經書正文上端留有較寬空白，刊印講解文字，這些文字稱為高頭講章”◇來泛指這類格式的經書。
explanationEn: Commentaries printed in the wide upper margin of classical texts; later, such annotated classics in general.
derivation: 《儿女英雄传》第十八回先生见了那没头没脑辟空而来的十五个大字，正不知从那里开口，才入得进这中庸两个字，只得先看了一遍高头讲章，照着那讲章往下敷衍半日，才得讲完。”
derivationTraditional: 《兒女英雄傳》第十八回先生見了那沒頭沒腦闢空而來的十五個大字，正不知從那裡開口，才入得進這中庸兩個字，只得先看了一遍高頭講章，照著那講章往下敷衍半日，才得講完。”
derivationEn: 'The Story of a Heroic Couple' Chapter 18
example: 鬼嗫嚅良久曰‘昨过君塾，君方昼寝。见君胸中～一部。’★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·滦阳消夏录一》
exampleTraditional: 鬼囁嚅良久曰‘昨過君塾，君方晝寢。見君胸中～一部。’★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·灤陽消夏錄一》
exampleEn: The ghost muttered after a long pause: 'Yesterday I passed your school and saw you napping. In your chest was a copy of Gaotou Jiangzhang.' — Ji Yun, 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage' Volume 1

explanation: 鬼形容人阴险狡诈。形容行为举止诡秘，不光明正大。
explanationTraditional: 鬼形容人陰險狡詐。形容行為舉止詭秘，不光明正大。
explanationEn: Sneaky and furtive behavior, not open and aboveboard.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷二十巢氏有兄弟巢大郎，是一个鬼头鬼脑的人，奉承的姊夫姊姊好。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷二十巢氏有兄弟巢大郎，是一個鬼頭鬼腦的人，奉承的姊夫姊姊好。”
derivationEn: Ming·Ling Mengchu, 'Striking the Table in Amazement' Volume 20
example: 又～，不知说了些甚么，便叫请出大爷来。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: 又～，不知說了些甚麼，便叫請出大爺來。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十六回
exampleEn: He acted sneakily, said something unclear, and then asked for the eldest master to come out. — Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars' Chapter 46

explanation: 比喻捏造事实陷害别人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻捏造事實陷害別人。
explanationEn: To fabricate facts to frame others.
derivation: 宋·晓莹《罗湖野录》卷二含血喷人，先污其口；百丈野狐，失头狂走。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·曉瑩《羅湖野錄》卷二含血噴人，先汙其口；百丈野狐，失頭狂走。”
derivationEn: Song·Xiaoying, 'Records from Luohu Wild' Volume 2
example: 况且没有把柄的事，给一个低三下四的奴才，～，自己倒站着听风凉话儿！★清·曾朴《孽海花》第十八回
exampleTraditional: 況且沒有把柄的事，給一個低三下四的奴才，～，自己倒站著聽風涼話兒！★清·曾樸《孽海花》第十八回
exampleEn: Moreover, without any evidence, a lowly servant slanders others, while you stand by listening to sarcastic remarks! — Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Sins' Chapter 18

explanation: 表示比得上，丝毫不差。
explanationTraditional: 表示比得上，絲毫不差。
explanationEn: Not inferior in any way; fully comparable.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 把黑的说成白的，将白的说成黑的。比喻故意颠倒是非，制造混乱。
explanationTraditional: 把黑的說成白的，將白的說成黑的。比喻故意顛倒是非，製造混亂。
explanationEn: To call white black and black white; deliberately confound right and wrong.
derivation: 《后汉书·杨震传》白黑溷淆，清浊同源。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·楊震傳》白黑溷淆，清濁同源。”
derivationEn: Book of the Later Han: Biography of Yang Zhen: 'White and black are mixed, clear and turbid share the same source.'
example: ……君子见斥，不人骤迁，章奏多决中旨，～，邪正倒置。★《明史·聊让传》
exampleTraditional: ……君子見斥，不人驟遷，章奏多決中旨，～，邪正倒置。★《明史·聊讓傳》
exampleEn: ...The gentleman is rejected, the unworthy are promoted suddenly, memorials are often decided by imperial decree, black and white are confused, the evil and the upright are reversed. ★ History of Ming: Biography of Liao Rang

explanation: 黄钟黄铜铸的钟，我国古代音乐有十二律，阴阳各六，黄钟为阳六律的第一律；毁毁坏；弃抛弃。比喻贤人遭受摈斥。
explanationTraditional: 黃鐘黃銅鑄的鐘，我國古代音樂有十二律，陰陽各六，黃鐘為陽六律的第一律；毀毀壞；棄拋棄。比喻賢人遭受擯斥。
explanationEn: The golden bell is destroyed and cast aside; metaphor for the worthy being rejected.
derivation: 战国·楚·屈原《卜居》黄钟毁弃，瓦缶雷鸣；谗人高张，贤士无名。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·屈原《卜居》黃鐘譭棄，瓦缶雷鳴；讒人高張，賢士無名。”
derivationEn: Warring States, Chu, Qu Yuan: 'Divination': 'The golden bell is destroyed and cast aside, earthen pots thunder; slanderers are exalted, the worthy are nameless.'
example: 噫！鼠辈邸张，其若是哉！～，瓦缶雷鸣，蠢兹幺么，毒害乃尔。★清·汇阴百一居士《壶天录》
exampleTraditional: 噫！鼠輩邸張，其若是哉！～，瓦缶雷鳴，蠢茲么麼，毒害乃爾。★清·匯陰百一居士《壺天錄》
exampleEn: Alas! The rats are rampant, is it so? The golden bell is destroyed and cast aside, earthen pots thunder; these petty villains poison and harm thus. ★ Qing: Huiyin Baiyi Jushi: 'Records of the Pot and Sky'

explanation: 看风向转发动舵柄。比喻看势头或看别人的眼色行事。
explanationTraditional: 看風向轉發動舵柄。比喻看勢頭或看別人的眼色行事。
explanationEn: To see the wind and turn the rudder; metaphor for acting according to the situation or others' attitudes.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》看风使舵，正是随波逐流。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》看風使舵，正是隨波逐流。”
derivationEn: Song: Shi Puji: 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'To see the wind and steer the rudder is exactly to go with the flow.'
example: 万一上面再传我去问话的时候，我也好～，别再那么一股死心眼儿卖傻劲。★茅盾《腐蚀·十二月二十二日》
exampleTraditional: 萬一上面再傳我去問話的時候，我也好～，別再那麼一股死心眼兒賣傻勁。★茅盾《腐蝕·十二月二十二日》
exampleEn: If I am summoned for questioning again, I should turn the rudder according to the wind and not be so stubborn and foolish. ★ Mao Dun: 'Corrosion: December 22'

explanation: 与慷慨”意思相同，指充满正气，情绪激动。当以”无实际意义。
explanationTraditional: 與慷慨”意思相同，指充滿正氣，情緒激動。當以”無實際意義。
explanationEn: Same as 'generous and indignant'; full of righteousness and emotion. 'Dang yi' has no actual meaning.
derivation: 汉·曹操《短歌行》慨当以慷，忧思难忘。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·曹操《短歌行》慨當以慷，憂思難忘。”
derivationEn: Han: Cao Cao: 'Short Song Style': 'Generous and indignant, sorrowful memories are hard to forget.'
example: 与知己别来十年，而此生遭际，～，乃有出于契阔之外者。★清·侯方域《复倪玉纯书》
exampleTraditional: 與知己別來十年，而此生遭際，～，乃有出於契闊之外者。★清·侯方域《復倪玉純書》
exampleEn: After ten years apart from my confidant, my life experiences have been so generous and indignant that they exceed the ordinary. ★ Qing: Hou Fangyu: 'Letter to Ni Yuchun'

explanation: 天宪指朝廷法令。比喻说话就是法律，可以决定人的生死。
explanationTraditional: 天憲指朝廷法令。比喻說話就是法律，可以決定人的生死。
explanationEn: To hold the imperial decree in one's mouth; metaphor for one's words being law, able to decide life and death.
derivation: 《后汉书·朱穆传》手握王爵，口含天宪。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·朱穆傳》手握王爵，口含天憲。”
derivationEn: Book of the Later Han: Biography of Zhu Mu: 'Holding the king's title in hand, holding the imperial decree in mouth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 以之慨叹功高不爵，命运乖舛。同李广未封”。
explanationTraditional: 以之慨嘆功高不爵，命運乖舛。同李廣未封”。
explanationEn: Lament over high merit but no title, and ill fate. Same as 'Li Guang not enfeoffed'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 免不要。不必开口说什么。多表示要求不会得到同意。
explanationTraditional: 免不要。不必開口說什麼。多表示要求不會得到同意。
explanationEn: Do not open your esteemed mouth; meaning don't bother speaking, as the request will not be granted.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第二十六回你若果然有成全我的心，卫顾我的话，就请说；要是方才伯父合九公说的那套，我都听见了，也明白了，免开尊口。？”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第二十六回你若果然有成全我的心，衛顧我的話，就請說；要是方才伯父合九公說的那套，我都聽見了，也明白了，免開尊口。？”
derivationEn: Qing: Wen Kang: 'Heroic Sons and Daughters' Chapter 26: 'If you truly have the heart to help me, then speak; but if it's what Uncle and Ninth Master said, I've heard it and understood, so spare your esteemed mouth.'
example: 何况此刻靠着点小生意，还有饭吃，我看娘舅还是～吧。（清·吴沃尧《九命奇冤》第五回）
exampleTraditional: 何況此刻靠著點小生意，還有飯吃，我看孃舅還是～吧。（清·吳沃堯《九命奇冤》第五回）
exampleEn: Moreover, now I can make a living with a small business, so I think you'd better spare your esteemed mouth, uncle. ★ Qing: Wu Woyao: 'Nine Lives' Chapter 5

explanation: 脸色没有一点血色。形容恐惧到极点或非常虚弱。
explanationTraditional: 臉色沒有一點血色。形容恐懼到極點或非常虛弱。
explanationEn: Face without any color; extremely frightened or very weak.
derivation: 《汉书·李广传》广为匈奴所败，吏士皆无人色，广意气自若。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·李廣傳》廣為匈奴所敗，吏士皆無人色，廣意氣自若。”
derivationEn: Book of Han: Biography of Li Guang: 'Li Guang was defeated by the Xiongnu, and his officers and men all had no color in their faces, but Li Guang remained calm.'
example: 不过一钟茶的时候，那马兵押着车子已到。吴举人抢到面前，见他三人～。★清·刘鹗《老残游记》第四回
exampleTraditional: 不過一鍾茶的時候，那馬兵押著車子已到。吳舉人搶到面前，見他三人～。★清·劉鶚《老殘遊記》第四回
exampleEn: In less than the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, the cavalryman arrived with the cart. Wu Juren rushed forward and saw that the three of them had no color in their faces. ★ Qing: Liu E: 'The Travels of Lao Can' Chapter 4

explanation: 名士指恃才放达不拘小节的人。名士的风度和习气。指有才学而不拘礼法。
explanationTraditional: 名士指恃才放達不拘小節的人。名士的風度和習氣。指有才學而不拘禮法。
explanationEn: The style and manner of a famous scholar; refers to talented and unconventional behavior.
derivation: 《后汉书·方术传论》汉世这所谓名士者，其风流可知矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《後漢書·方術傳論》漢世這所謂名士者，其風流可知矣。”
derivationEn: Book of the Later Han: Biographies of Magicians: 'The so-called famous scholars of the Han dynasty, their style can be known.'
example: 好好！咱们～，下该洒脱些才是。★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第三十一回
exampleTraditional: 好好！咱們～，下該灑脫些才是。★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第三十一回
exampleEn: Good! Good! We are famous scholars, so we should be more free and easy. ★ Qing: Li Baojia: 'A Brief History of Civilization' Chapter 31

explanation: 迷信传说中的两个鬼卒，一个头象牛，一个头象马。比喻各种丑恶的人。
explanationTraditional: 迷信傳說中的兩個鬼卒，一個頭象牛，一個頭象馬。比喻各種醜惡的人。
explanationEn: Two demon attendants in Chinese mythology, one with an ox head and the other with a horse face. Used metaphorically to describe various ugly or evil people.
derivation: 宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷十一释迦是牛头狱卒，祖师是马面阿婆。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷十一釋迦是牛頭獄卒，祖師是馬面阿婆。”
derivationEn: From 'The Jingde Record of the Transmission of the Lamp' by Shi Daoyuan of the Song Dynasty: 'Sakyamuni is the ox-headed jailer, the patriarch is the horse-faced old woman.'
example: 只是近来常常在梦中，或是在将醒未醒之顷，一阵悚然，从前所怕的～，都积压了来，都聚围了来。★冰心《山中杂记—遥寄小朋友》
exampleTraditional: 只是近來常常在夢中，或是在將醒未醒之頃，一陣悚然，從前所怕的～，都積壓了來，都聚圍了來。★冰心《山中雜記—遙寄小朋友》
exampleEn: But recently, often in dreams or in the moments between waking and sleeping, I feel a shudder; the Ox-Head and Horse-Face that I used to fear have all pressed upon me, gathered around me. — Bing Xin, 'Mountain Miscellany—A Letter to Little Friends'

explanation: 移改变。不因生活贫困、社会地位低下而改变自己的志向。形容意志坚定。
explanationTraditional: 移改變。不因生活貧困、社會地位低下而改變自己的志向。形容意志堅定。
explanationEn: Not changing one's aspirations despite poverty and low social status. Describes a firm will.
derivation: 《孟子·滕文公下》富贵不能淫，贫贱不能移，威武不能屈，此之谓大丈夫。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·滕文公下》富貴不能淫，貧賤不能移，威武不能屈，此之謂大丈夫。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Teng Wen Gong II': 'One cannot be led into dissipation by wealth and rank, nor deflected from one's purpose by poverty and low station, nor made to bend by power and force—this is what is called a great man.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹千岩万壑。形容山峦连绵，高低重迭。
explanationTraditional: 猶千巖萬壑。形容山巒連綿，高低重迭。
explanationEn: Thousands of peaks and ravines. Describes continuous, overlapping mountains.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻永存。也比喻时间久长。
explanationTraditional: 比喻永存。也比喻時間久長。
explanationEn: Metaphor for eternal existence or a long duration of time.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十回青山不老，绿水长存。他日事成，必当后报。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十回青山不老，綠水長存。他日事成，必當後報。”
derivationEn: From 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' by Luo Guanzhong, Chapter 60: 'The green mountains never age, the clear waters ever flow. When the day comes, I will surely repay you.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 听任凭。听任它自然发展，不去过问。
explanationTraditional: 聽任憑。聽任它自然發展，不去過問。
explanationEn: To let things take their natural course without interference.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十八回王玉辉也不懊悔，听其自然，每日在牛公庵看书。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十八回王玉輝也不懊悔，聽其自然，每日在牛公庵看書。”
derivationEn: From 'The Scholars' by Wu Jingzi, Chapter 48: 'Wang Yuhui did not regret it, letting things take their natural course, reading books daily at the Niu Gong Nunnery.'
example: 孩子成长时期，家长不能～，不管不问。
exampleTraditional: 孩子成長時期，家長不能～，不管不問。
exampleEn: During a child's growth period, parents cannot just let things take their natural course and not care.

explanation: 今江西北部，春秋时是吴、楚两国交界的地方，它处于吴地长江的上游，楚地长江的下游，好象首尾互相衔接。
explanationTraditional: 今江西北部，春秋時是吳、楚兩國交界的地方，它處於吳地長江的上游，楚地長江的下游，好象首尾互相銜接。
explanationEn: Refers to the northern part of Jiangxi, which was the border between the states of Wu and Chu during the Spring and Autumn period, with Wu upstream and Chu downstream, like head and tail connected.
derivation: 宋·王象之《舆地纪胜》《职方乘序》‘吴头楚尾。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·王象之《輿地紀勝》《職方乘序》‘吳頭楚尾。’”
derivationEn: From 'Yudi Jisheng' by Wang Xiangzhi of the Song Dynasty: 'The preface to 'Zhifang Cheng' says: 'Wu's head and Chu's tail.''
example: ～路如何？★清·王士慎《江上》诗
exampleTraditional: ～路如何？★清·王士慎《江上》詩
exampleEn: Where is the road of Wu's head and Chu's tail? — Wang Shizhen of the Qing Dynasty, poem 'On the River'

explanation: 比喻见到的不全面。
explanationTraditional: 比喻見到的不全面。
explanationEn: Metaphor for seeing only a part of something, not the whole.
derivation: 《关尹子·五鉴》譬如犀牛望月。月形入角，特因识生，始有月形，而彼真月初不在角。”
derivationTraditional: 《關尹子·五鑑》譬如犀牛望月。月形入角，特因識生，始有月形，而彼真月初不在角。”
derivationEn: From 'Master Guan Yin: Five Mirrors': 'Like a rhinoceros looking at the moon. The moon's shape enters its horn, and only then does it recognize the moon's form, but the true moon is not in the horn.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 抬头仰望，对天无愧。指没有做过坏事，问心无愧。
explanationTraditional: 抬頭仰望，對天無愧。指沒有做過壞事，問心無愧。
explanationEn: Looking up, one has no shame before heaven. Means having done nothing wrong and having a clear conscience.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》仰不愧于天，俯不怍于人。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》仰不愧於天，俯不怍於人。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jin Xin I': 'Looking up, I have no shame before heaven; looking down, I have no shame before men.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 杳不见踪影；迹脚印。连一个人的脚印也看不到。形容地方非常荒凉、偏僻，从来没有人去过。
explanationTraditional: 杳不見蹤影；跡腳印。連一個人的腳印也看不到。形容地方非常荒涼、偏僻，從來沒有人去過。
explanationEn: No trace of human footprints. Describes a very desolate, remote place that no one has ever visited.
derivation: 唐·常沂《灵鬼志·郑绍》至明年春，绍复至此，但见红花翠竹，流水青山，杳无人迹。绍乃号恸经日而返。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·常沂《靈鬼志·鄭紹》至明年春，紹復至此，但見紅花翠竹，流水青山，杳無人跡。紹乃號慟經日而返。”
derivationEn: From 'Ling Gui Zhi: Zheng Shao' by Tang Changyi of the Tang Dynasty: 'The next spring, Zheng Shao returned, but saw only red flowers, green bamboos, flowing water, and green mountains, with no trace of human presence. He wailed for a day and then returned.'
example: 穿过小亭，有秋千一架，上与云齐；而羒索沉沉，～。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·西湖主》
exampleTraditional: 穿過小亭，有秋千一架，上與雲齊；而羒索沉沉，～。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·西湖主》
exampleEn: Passing through the small pavilion, there was a swing reaching the clouds; but the ropes hung silently, with no trace of human presence. — Pu Songling of the Qing Dynasty, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: West Lake'

explanation: 杳无影无踪。没有一点儿音信。
explanationTraditional: 杳無影無蹤。沒有一點兒音信。
explanationEn: No news or information at all.
derivation: 明·沈德符《野获编》微闻有浮海行者，踪迹可疑。乃南至闽广近海诸地，无不遍历，杳无消息。”
derivationTraditional: 明·沈德符《野獲編》微聞有浮海行者，蹤跡可疑。乃南至閩廣近海諸地，無不遍歷，杳無消息。”
derivationEn: From 'Ye Huo Bian' by Shen Defu of the Ming Dynasty: 'I heard faintly of someone sailing the seas, with suspicious traces. So I went south to Fujian and Guangdong and nearby coastal areas, traversing everywhere, but there was no news at all.'
example: 我四处打听，也～。★鲁迅《故事新编·铸剑》
exampleTraditional: 我四處打聽，也～。★魯迅《故事新編·鑄劍》
exampleEn: I inquired everywhere, but there was no news at all. — Lu Xun, 'Old Tales Retold: Forging the Sword'

explanation: 心香旧时称中心虔诚，就能感通佛道，同焚香一样。比喻十分真诚的心意（用在祝愿）。
explanationTraditional: 心香舊時稱中心虔誠，就能感通佛道，同焚香一樣。比喻十分真誠的心意（用在祝願）。
explanationEn: A sincere and devout heart, like offering incense to Buddha. Used to express heartfelt wishes.
derivation: 唐·韩偓《仙山》诗一柱一香洞府开，偃松皱涩半莓苔。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓偓《仙山》詩一柱一香洞府開，偃松皺澀半莓苔。”
derivationEn: From Han Wo's poem 'Fairy Mountain': 'With a stick of incense, the cave opens; the pines are wrinkled and half mossy.'
example: 编者谨掬～，吁请海内文豪，从兹多谈风月，少发牢骚，庶作者编者，两蒙其休。★鲁迅《伪自由书·后记》引《申报》副刊《自由谈》
exampleTraditional: 編者謹掬～，籲請海內文豪，從茲多談風月，少發牢騷，庶作者編者，兩蒙其休。★魯迅《偽自由書·後記》引《申報》副刊《自由談》
exampleEn: The editor sincerely offers this heartfelt wish, calling upon literary giants to talk more about pleasantries and less about grievances, so that both authors and editors may benefit. — Lu Xun, 'False Freedom: Postscript', citing 'Free Talk' supplement of 'Shenbao'

explanation: 的箭靶的中心。一句话正好射中箭靶。比喻一句话就说到关键的地方。
explanationTraditional: 的箭靶的中心。一句話正好射中箭靶。比喻一句話就說到關鍵的地方。
explanationEn: Hit the bull's-eye with one word. To say something that hits the nail on the head.
derivation: 《中国现在记》第一回你做折子须要在此等地方着想，保管你一言中的，上头不能不准。”
derivationTraditional: 《中國現在記》第一回你做摺子須要在此等地方著想，保管你一言中的，上頭不能不準。”
derivationEn: From 'China Now' (first chapter): 'You must think from this perspective when writing your memorial, and I guarantee you will hit the mark with one word, and the emperor will not disapprove.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 由于心情不舒畅而很少高兴的时候。
explanationTraditional: 由於心情不舒暢而很少高興的時候。
explanationEn: Feeling depressed and seldom happy due to a gloomy mood.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 担忧被谗言中伤。
explanationTraditional: 擔憂被讒言中傷。
explanationEn: Fear of being slandered and ridiculed.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 知道满足就不会受到羞辱。表示不要有贪心。
explanationTraditional: 知道滿足就不會受到羞辱。表示不要有貪心。
explanationEn: Contentment avoids disgrace. One should not be greedy.
derivation: 《老子》第四十四章知足不辱，知止不殆，可以长久。”《汉书·疏广传》吾闻知足不辱，知止不殆。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第四十四章知足不辱，知止不殆，可以長久。”《漢書·疏廣傳》吾聞知足不辱，知止不殆。”
derivationEn: From Laozi, Chapter 44: 'He who is contented is not disgraced; he who knows when to stop is not in danger; he can long endure.' Also in 'Book of Han: Biography of Shu Guang': 'I have heard that contentment avoids disgrace, and knowing when to stop avoids danger.'
example: 常言～。”官人宜急流勇退，为山林娱老之计。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三十一
exampleTraditional: 常言～。”官人宜急流勇退，為山林娛老之計。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三十一
exampleEn: As the saying goes, 'Contentment avoids disgrace.' You should retire at the height of your career and enjoy leisure in the mountains and forests. — Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Caution the World', Chapter 31

explanation: 百形容多；弊弊端，害处。各种弊害都产生出来了。
explanationTraditional: 百形容多；弊弊端，害處。各種弊害都產生出來了。
explanationEn: All kinds of evils arise. Many problems emerge simultaneously.
derivation: 梁启超《政治学学理摭言》而此等异论，何以能容喙焉？何以能动人焉？则以智慧程度未达于大多数，而欲幸福之程度进于大多数，未有不百弊丛生，而贻反对之徒以口实者也。”
derivationTraditional: 梁啟超《政治學學理摭言》而此等異論，何以能容喙焉？何以能動人焉？則以智慧程度未達於大多數，而欲幸福之程度進於大多數，未有不百弊叢生，而貽反對之徒以口實者也。”
derivationEn: From Liang Qichao's 'Discourse on Political Science Principles': 'If the level of wisdom has not reached the majority, and one desires to advance the happiness of the majority, it is inevitable that all kinds of evils will arise, giving opponents a pretext.'
example: 今以十当一，是反以四钱八分铜作一钱二分用也。民间私閒改铸，～。★柯劭忞《清史稿·袁希祖传》
exampleTraditional: 今以十當一，是反以四錢八分銅作一錢二分用也。民間私閒改鑄，～。★柯劭忞《清史稿·袁希祖傳》
exampleEn: Now using ten as one, it is equivalent to using four coins and eight candareens of copper as one coin and two candareens. Private recasting among the people leads to all kinds of evils. — Ke Shaomin, 'Draft History of Qing: Biography of Yuan Xizu'

explanation: 拙不巧。形容没有口才，不善言辞。
explanationTraditional: 拙不巧。形容沒有口才，不善言辭。
explanationEn: Clumsy in speech; inarticulate.
derivation: 杨朔《石油城》我这个人，笨嘴拙舌的，谈什么呢？”
derivationTraditional: 楊朔《石油城》我這個人，笨嘴拙舌的，談什麼呢？”
derivationEn: From Yang Shuo's 'Oil City': 'I am clumsy of speech; what can I talk about?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 薄微小。指自己掌握了微小的技能。
explanationTraditional: 薄微小。指自己掌握了微小的技能。
explanationEn: Possessing a minor skill. Having a small but useful ability.
derivation: 北齐·颜之推《颜氏家训·勉学》积财千万，不如薄技在身。”
derivationTraditional: 北齊·顏之推《顏氏家訓·勉學》積財千萬，不如薄技在身。”
derivationEn: From Yan Zhitui's 'Family Instructions of the Yan Clan: Encouraging Learning': 'Better to have a small skill than a thousand pieces of gold.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不分高下，差不多。
explanationTraditional: 不分高下，差不多。
explanationEn: Not much difference; about the same.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第80回一般是鲜花嫩柳，与众姊妹不差上下。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第80回一般是鮮花嫩柳，與眾姊妹不差上下。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 80: 'Generally, they were like fresh flowers and tender willows, not much different from the other sisters.'
example: 这个一向坚实乐观的汉子第一次遭到烦扰的袭击了，简直就同一个处在这种境况的平常人～一点抓拿没有。★沙汀《在其香居茶馆里》
exampleTraditional: 這個一向堅實樂觀的漢子第一次遭到煩擾的襲擊了，簡直就同一個處在這種境況的平常人～一點抓拿沒有。★沙汀《在其香居茶館裡》
exampleEn: This usually steadfast and optimistic man was troubled for the first time, just like an ordinary person in such a situation, completely at a loss. — Sha Ting, 'In the Tea House of Qixiang'

explanation: 痛痒比喻疾苦或紧要的事。比喻切身相关的事。指与自身利害没有关系。
explanationTraditional: 痛癢比喻疾苦或緊要的事。比喻切身相關的事。指與自身利害沒有關係。
explanationEn: Not related to one's own interests; of no concern.
derivation: 《朱子语类》卷一０一那不关痛痒底是不仁。”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子語類》卷一０一那不關痛癢底是不仁。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Xi's Classified Conversations', Volume 101: 'That which does not concern pain or itch is not benevolence.'
example: 这里虽还有两三个老婆子，都是～的，见李妈走了，也都悄悄的自寻方便去了。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第八回
exampleTraditional: 這裡雖還有兩三個老婆子，都是～的，見李媽走了，也都悄悄的自尋方便去了。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第八回
exampleEn: Although there were two or three old women here, they were indifferent to the matter. Seeing Li Ma leave, they quietly went off to attend to their own affairs. — Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 8

explanation: 才才能。德品德。备具备。才能和品德都具备。
explanationTraditional: 才才能。德品德。備具備。才能和品德都具備。
explanationEn: Having both ability and moral integrity.
derivation: 宋·许月卿《先天集·人邑道中三首》天涵地育王公旦，德备才全范仲淹。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·許月卿《先天集·人邑道中三首》天涵地育王公旦，德備才全范仲淹。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Xu Yueqing's 'Xiantian Ji': 'Heaven and earth nurture the king, virtue and talent complete like Fan Zhongyan.'
example: 江东有一故友，乃鲁子敬，此人～。★元·无名氏《娶小乔》第一折
exampleTraditional: 江東有一故友，乃魯子敬，此人～。★元·無名氏《娶小喬》第一折
exampleEn: There is an old friend in Jiangdong, Lu Zijing, who possesses both ability and moral integrity. — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Marrying Xiaoqiao', Act 1

explanation: 诚真诚。心意真诚恳切。形容对人十分真挚诚恳。亦作诚心诚意”。
explanationTraditional: 誠真誠。心意真誠懇切。形容對人十分真摯誠懇。亦作誠心誠意”。
explanationEn: Sincere and earnest; wholehearted sincerity towards others.
derivation: 元·宫大用《范张鸡黍》第一折皇天有意为斯文，教人从诚心正意修根本，以至齐家治国为标准。”
derivationTraditional: 元·宮大用《范張雞黍》第一折皇天有意為斯文，教人從誠心正意修根本，以至齊家治國為標準。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Gong Dayong's 'Fan Zhang's Chicken and Millet', Act 1: 'Heaven intends to cultivate culture, teaching people to cultivate sincerity and rectify intentions as the foundation, to govern the family and state as the standard.'
example: 则为他治国齐家存妙策，～请贤臣。★明·无名氏《孟母三移》第四折
exampleTraditional: 則為他治國齊家存妙策，～請賢臣。★明·無名氏《孟母三移》第四折
exampleEn: He governs the state and family with wise strategies, and sincerely invites virtuous ministers. — Ming Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Mencius' Mother Moves Three Times', Act 4

explanation: 惩惩罚；警警戒。处死一个人，借以警戒许多人。
explanationTraditional: 懲懲罰；警警戒。處死一個人，藉以警戒許多人。
explanationEn: To punish one as a warning to many.
derivation: 《汉书·尹翁归传》其有所取也，以一警百，吏民皆服，恐惧改行自新。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·尹翁歸傳》其有所取也，以一警百，吏民皆服，恐懼改行自新。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Yin Wengui': 'When he took action, he warned a hundred by punishing one, so officials and people all submitted, fearing and reforming their ways.'
example: 兄弟今天定要～，让众人当面看看，好叫他们有个怕惧。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第五十六回
exampleTraditional: 兄弟今天定要～，讓眾人當面看看，好叫他們有個怕懼。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第五十六回
exampleEn: Today I must punish one to warn a hundred, so that everyone can see and be afraid. — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 56

explanation: 指犹豫等待，不作决定。
explanationTraditional: 指猶豫等待，不作決定。
explanationEn: To hesitate and wait, not making a decision.
derivation: 清·李渔《比目鱼·肥遁》相公，俞旨既下，就该速速抽身，为什么还要迟疑观望？”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《比目魚·肥遁》相公，俞旨既下，就該速速抽身，為什麼還要遲疑觀望？”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Yu's 'The Flounder: Escape': 'Sir, since the imperial decree has come, you should leave quickly. Why hesitate and wait?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 安抚和强制同时施行。
explanationTraditional: 安撫和強制同時施行。
explanationEn: To use both kindness and severity simultaneously.
derivation: 《三国志·吴书·周鲂传》鲂在郡十三年卒，赏善罚恶，恩威并行。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳書·周魴傳》魴在郡十三年卒，賞善罰惡，恩威並行。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Book of Wu: Biography of Zhou Fang': 'Zhou Fang served in the commandery for thirteen years, rewarding good and punishing evil, using both kindness and severity.'
example: 我一向倒是～，以德服人的。★陈白尘、贾霁《宋景诗》十九
exampleTraditional: 我一向倒是～，以德服人的。★陳白塵、賈霽《宋景詩》十九
exampleEn: I have always used both kindness and severity, and won people over by virtue. — Chen Baichen and Jia Ji, 'Song Jing Poetry', Chapter 19

explanation: 当相当，抵挡。处吠罪行不相当。
explanationTraditional: 當相當，抵擋。處吠罪行不相當。
explanationEn: Punishment not commensurate with the crime.
derivation: 《荀子·正论》夫德不称位，能不称官，赏不当功，罚不当罪不祥莫大焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·正論》夫德不稱位，能不稱官，賞不當功，罰不當罪不祥莫大焉。”
derivationEn: 'Xunzi: On Rectification': 'If virtue does not match position, ability does not match office, reward does not match merit, and punishment does not match crime, nothing is more inauspicious.'
example: 谁个惩办要严，谁个处罚从轻，农民都有极明白的计算，～的极少。★毛泽东《湖南农民运动考察报告》
exampleTraditional: 誰個懲辦要嚴，誰個處罰從輕，農民都有極明白的計算，～的極少。★毛澤東《湖南農民運動考察報告》
exampleEn: Who should be punished severely and who leniently, the peasants have a very clear calculation; cases where punishment does not match the crime are extremely rare. — Mao Zedong, 'Report on the Peasant Movement in Hunan'

explanation: 瘼疾，疾苦。关心群众的疾苦。
explanationTraditional: 瘼疾，疾苦。關心群眾的疾苦。
explanationEn: To care about the sufferings of the people.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第三十四回非得关心民瘼之员，竭力抚循，不足以资补救。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第三十四回非得關心民瘼之員，竭力撫循，不足以資補救。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Scene', Chapter 34: 'Only officials who care about the people's hardships and strive to comfort them can remedy the situation.'
example: 身为政府官员，～当为本职。
exampleTraditional: 身為政府官員，～當為本職。
exampleEn: As a government official, caring about the people's hardships should be one's duty.

explanation: 指有彩绘装饰的十分华丽的房屋。
explanationTraditional: 指有彩繪裝飾的十分華麗的房屋。
explanationEn: Ornately decorated and magnificent buildings.
derivation: 元·王子一《误入桃源》第二折光闪闪贝阙珠宫，齐臻臻碧瓦朱甍，宽绰绰罗帏绣成栊，郁巍巍画梁雕栋。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王子一《誤入桃源》第二折光閃閃貝闕珠宮，齊臻臻碧瓦朱甍，寬綽綽羅幃繡成櫳，鬱巍巍畫樑雕棟。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wang Ziyi's 'Mistaken Entry into Peach Blossom Spring', Act 2: 'Glimmering pearl palaces, neat green tiles and red ridges, spacious embroidered curtains, and majestic painted beams and carved pillars.'
example: 各处尽是～，珠帘绮户，那派艳丽光景，竟是别有洞天。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第九十八回
exampleTraditional: 各處盡是～，珠簾綺戶，那派豔麗光景，竟是別有洞天。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第九十八回
exampleEn: Everywhere were painted beams and carved pillars, pearl curtains and embroidered doors, a scene of such splendor that it seemed like another world. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 98

explanation: 吉吉利；良好；辰时日。美好的时辰，吉利的日子◇常用以称宜于成亲的日子。
explanationTraditional: 吉吉利；良好；辰時日。美好的時辰，吉利的日子◇常用以稱宜於成親的日子。
explanationEn: An auspicious day and good time; often used for weddings.
derivation: 战国·楚·屈原《九歌·东皇太一》吉日兮辰良，穆将愉兮上皇。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·屈原《九歌·東皇太一》吉日兮辰良，穆將愉兮上皇。”
derivationEn: Warring States, Qu Yuan's 'Nine Songs: The Great One of the East': 'On an auspicious day and good hour, we reverently honor the Supreme.'
example: 则今日是～，辞别了母亲，便索长行也。★元·尚仲贤《柳毅传书》第一折
exampleTraditional: 則今日是～，辭別了母親，便索長行也。★元·尚仲賢《柳毅傳書》第一折
exampleEn: Today is an auspicious day and good hour. I bid farewell to my mother and set out on a long journey. — Yuan Dynasty, Shang Zhongxian, 'The Story of Liu Yi Delivering a Letter', Act 1

explanation: 寂静没有声音。
explanationTraditional: 寂靜沒有聲音。
explanationEn: Silent and without sound.
derivation: 《淮南子·泰族训》高宗谅暗，三年不言，四海之内寂然无声；一言声然，大动天下。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·泰族訓》高宗諒暗，三年不言，四海之內寂然無聲；一言聲然，大動天下。”
derivationEn: 'Huainanzi: Great Clan Training': 'Emperor Gaozong was in mourning, silent for three years, and within the four seas all was silent without a sound; but once he spoke, the whole world was moved.'
example: 这些和尚是山野的人，收了这残盘剩饭，必然聚吃一番，不然，也要收拾家火，为何～？★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第二十一卷
exampleTraditional: 這些和尚是山野的人，收了這殘盤剩飯，必然聚吃一番，不然，也要收拾家火，為何～？★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第二十一卷
exampleEn: These monks are mountain folk. After collecting the leftover food, they would surely eat together, or at least clean up. Why are they silent without a sound? — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 21

explanation: 比喻头绪极多。
explanationTraditional: 比喻頭緒極多。
explanationEn: Describes a situation with numerous and complex threads or aspects.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·问神》神心恍惚，经续万方。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·問神》神心恍惚，經續萬方。”
derivationEn: From Yang Xiong's 'Fa Yan' in the Han Dynasty: 'The mind is in a daze, with countless threads.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 激扬振奋昂扬。精神振奋，意气昂扬。形容情绪、语调激动昂扬而充满正气。
explanationTraditional: 激揚振奮昂揚。精神振奮，意氣昂揚。形容情緒、語調激動昂揚而充滿正氣。
explanationEn: Describes being fervent and excited, with high spirits and righteous indignation.
derivation: 汉·李陵《录别诗》悲意何慷慨，清歌正激扬。”《周书·韦孝宽传》孝宽慷慨激扬，略无顾意，士卒莫不激励，人有死难之心。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·李陵《錄別詩》悲意何慷慨，清歌正激揚。”《周書·韋孝寬傳》孝寬慷慨激揚，略無顧意，士卒莫不激勵，人有死難之心。”
derivationEn: From Li Ling's 'Farewell Poem' in the Han Dynasty: 'How generous the sorrowful meaning, the clear song is stirring.' Also from 'Book of Zhou: Biography of Wei Xiaokuan': 'Wei Xiaokuan was fervent and excited, showing no hesitation, inspiring all soldiers to fight to the death.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 隙空子，机会。可以被对方利用的弱点、空隙。
explanationTraditional: 隙空子，機會。可以被對方利用的弱點、空隙。
explanationEn: A weakness or gap that can be exploited by an opponent.
derivation: 宋·晁补之《鸡肋集》当是时，皆有可乘之隙，而中国不可取。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·晁補之《雞肋集》當是時，皆有可乘之隙，而中國不可取。”
derivationEn: From Chao Buzhi's 'Jilei Ji' in the Song Dynasty: 'At that time, there were exploitable gaps, but China could not be taken.'
example: 小沛原非久居之地。今徐州既有～，失此不取，悔之晚矣。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 小沛原非久居之地。今徐州既有～，失此不取，悔之晚矣。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第十四回
exampleEn: Xiaopei was never a place for long-term stay. Now that Xuzhou has an exploitable gap, if we miss this chance, we will regret it too late. — From Chapter 14 of 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' by Luo Guanzhong in the Ming Dynasty.

explanation: 朗朗明朗、清亮；乾坤原是《周易》中的两个卦名，这里指天地、世界等。形容政治清明，天下太平。
explanationTraditional: 朗朗明朗、清亮；乾坤原是《周易》中的兩個卦名，這裡指天地、世界等。形容政治清明，天下太平。
explanationEn: Describes a time of political clarity and peace under heaven.
derivation: 元·李文慰《燕青博鱼》第一折清平世界，浪荡乾坤，你怎么当街里打人。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李文慰《燕青博魚》第一折清平世界，浪蕩乾坤，你怎麼當街裡打人。”
derivationEn: From the first act of 'Yan Qing Bo Yu' by Li Wenwei in the Yuan Dynasty: 'In a clear and peaceful world, how dare you hit someone in the street?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 沦落流落，指陷入坏的境地。风尘旧指娼妓的生活。旧指妇女不幸沦为娼妓。
explanationTraditional: 淪落流落，指陷入壞的境地。風塵舊指娼妓的生活。舊指婦女不幸淪為娼妓。
explanationEn: Refers to a woman who has fallen into prostitution.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言·杜十娘怒沉百宝箱》可怜一片无瑕玉，误落风尘花柳中。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言·杜十娘怒沉百寶箱》可憐一片無瑕玉，誤落風塵花柳中。”
derivationEn: From 'Stories to Warn the World: Du Shiniang Sinks the Jewel Box in Anger' by Feng Menglong in the Ming Dynasty: 'Pity the flawless jade, mistakenly fallen into the world of prostitutes.'
example: 她的～是终生的！她的悲剧也是终生的！★朱自清《温州的踪迹·四》
exampleTraditional: 她的～是終生的！她的悲劇也是終生的！★朱自清《溫州的蹤跡·四》
exampleEn: Her fall into prostitution was lifelong! Her tragedy was also lifelong! — From Zhu Ziqing's 'Traces in Wenzhou: Four'.

explanation: 比喻夫妻离异，无法挽回。
explanationTraditional: 比喻夫妻離異，無法挽回。
explanationEn: Metaphor for a divorced couple that cannot be reconciled.
derivation: 钱钟书《围城》虽然‘马前泼水’，居然‘破镜重圆’。”
derivationTraditional: 錢鍾書《圍城》雖然‘馬前潑水’，居然‘破鏡重圓’。”
derivationEn: From Qian Zhongshu's 'Fortress Besieged': 'Although water was spilled before the horse, the broken mirror was miraculously reunited.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 名声和实际一致。
explanationTraditional: 名聲和實際一致。
explanationEn: The reputation matches the reality.
derivation: 汉·陆粹《为曹公与孔融书》昔国家东迁，文举盛叹鸿豫名实相副，综达经学，出于郑玄，又明《司马法》；鸿豫亦称文举奇逸博闻。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·陸粹《為曹公與孔融書》昔國家東遷，文舉盛嘆鴻豫名實相副，綜達經學，出於鄭玄，又明《司馬法》；鴻豫亦稱文舉奇逸博聞。”
derivationEn: From Lu Cui's 'Letter to Kong Rong on Behalf of Cao Cao' in the Han Dynasty: 'In the past, when the state moved east, Wenju praised Hongyu for being worthy of his name, well-versed in classics, surpassing Zheng Xuan, and understanding the 'Sima Fa'; Hongyu also praised Wenju for his extraordinary talent and broad knowledge.'
example: 又如臣下有所建议，君主便叫他去做，看他能照所说的作到否。～的赏；否则罚。★朱自清《经典常谈·诸子第十》
exampleTraditional: 又如臣下有所建議，君主便叫他去做，看他能照所說的作到否。～的賞；否則罰。★朱自清《經典常談·諸子第十》
exampleEn: For example, if a minister makes a suggestion, the monarch orders him to carry it out and sees if he can do as he said. If his name matches reality, reward; otherwise, punish. — From Zhu Ziqing's 'Classic Talks: Various Schools'.

explanation: 母亲因儿子的显贵而显贵。
explanationTraditional: 母親因兒子的顯貴而顯貴。
explanationEn: A mother becomes honored because of her son's prominence.
derivation: 《公羊传·隐公元年》桓何以贵？母贵也。母贵则子何以贵？子以母贵，母以子贵。”
derivationTraditional: 《公羊傳·隱公元年》桓何以貴？母貴也。母貴則子何以貴？子以母貴，母以子貴。”
derivationEn: From 'Gongyang Zhuan: First Year of Duke Yin': 'Why is Huan noble? Because his mother is noble. If the mother is noble, why is the son noble? The son is noble because of the mother, and the mother is noble because of the son.'
example: 任凭他是青楼婢妾，到得收他做了侧室，后来生出儿子，做了官，就可算的～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第五十三回
exampleTraditional: 任憑他是青樓婢妾，到得收他做了側室，後來生出兒子，做了官，就可算的～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第五十三回
exampleEn: Even if she was a prostitute or maid, once taken as a concubine and later bearing a son who becomes an official, she can be considered honored because of her son. — From Chapter 53 of 'The Scholars' by Wu Jingzi in the Qing Dynasty.

explanation: 眼睛不忍看视。形容景象极其悲惨。
explanationTraditional: 眼睛不忍看視。形容景象極其悲慘。
explanationEn: The eyes cannot bear to look; describes an extremely tragic scene.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 泥拘泥，固执。拘泥于古代的成规或古人的说法而不知变通。
explanationTraditional: 泥拘泥，固執。拘泥於古代的成規或古人的說法而不知變通。
explanationEn: Describes being stubbornly attached to ancient rules or sayings without adapting to change.
derivation: 《宋史·刘几传》儒者泥古，致详于形名度数间，而不知清浊轻重之用。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋史·劉幾傳》儒者泥古，致詳於形名度數間，而不知清濁輕重之用。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Song: Biography of Liu Ji': 'Confucians are stuck in antiquity, focusing on details of form and number, unaware of the uses of clarity and turbidity, lightness and heaviness.'
example: 故对近代军旅之事，亦深有研究，非一般徒卖弄《孙子兵法》、～者可比。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第四十八章
exampleTraditional: 故對近代軍旅之事，亦深有研究，非一般徒賣弄《孫子兵法》、～者可比。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第四十八章
exampleEn: Therefore, he also had deep research on modern military affairs, unlike those who merely show off 'The Art of War' by Sun Tzu and are stubbornly attached to antiquity. — From Chapter 48 of Volume 2 of 'Li Zicheng' by Yao Xueyin.

explanation: 形容非常高傲，看不起任何人。
explanationTraditional: 形容非常高傲，看不起任何人。
explanationEn: Extremely arrogant, looking down on everyone.
derivation: 季羡林《文化交流的轨迹》我之所以这样不厌其烦地引这许多话，决不是因为外国人夸中国人有两只眼睛而沾沾自喜，睥睨一切。”
derivationTraditional: 季羨林《文化交流的軌跡》我之所以這樣不厭其煩地引這許多話，決不是因為外國人誇中國人有兩隻眼睛而沾沾自喜，睥睨一切。”
derivationEn: Ji Xianlin, 'The Trajectory of Cultural Exchange': 'I have quoted so many words tirelessly, not because foreigners praise Chinese for having two eyes, making me complacent and looking down on everything.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 青荧的油灯和年代久远的佛像。借指佛门寂寞的生涯。
explanationTraditional: 青熒的油燈和年代久遠的佛像。借指佛門寂寞的生涯。
explanationEn: The dim oil lamp and ancient Buddha statue; refers to the lonely life of a Buddhist monk or nun.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一一八回可怜绣户侯门女，独卧青灯古佛旁!”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一一八回可憐繡戶侯門女，獨臥青燈古佛旁!”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 118: 'Alas, a daughter of a noble house, lying alone beside the dim lamp and ancient Buddha!'
example: 想我智能年方二九，难道真将我的青春献给～不成？★欧阳予倩《馒头庵》第二场
exampleTraditional: 想我智能年方二九，難道真將我的青春獻給～不成？★歐陽予倩《饅頭庵》第二場
exampleEn: I, Zhineng, am only eighteen; can I really dedicate my youth to the dim lamp and ancient Buddha? — Ouyang Yuqian, 'Tou'an Temple', Act 2

explanation: 需求多而供应量少。
explanationTraditional: 需求多而供應量少。
explanationEn: Demand exceeds supply.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 印刷用纸若是～，便会影响出版品的及时问世。
exampleTraditional: 印刷用紙若是～，便會影響出版品的及時問世。
exampleEn: If demand for printing paper exceeds supply, it will affect the timely publication of books.

explanation: 肉眼佛经中说有，天、肉慧、法佛五眼，肉眼为肉身之眼，也泛指俗眼；凡胎指凡人的身体。指尘世平常的人。
explanationTraditional: 肉眼佛經中說有，天、肉慧、法佛五眼，肉眼為肉身之眼，也泛指俗眼；凡胎指凡人的身體。指塵世平常的人。
explanationEn: Mortal eyes and ordinary body; refers to ordinary worldly people.
derivation: 元·范子安《竹叶舟》第一折这都是神仙骨，不似你肉眼凡夫。”
derivationTraditional: 元·範子安《竹葉舟》第一折這都是神仙骨，不似你肉眼凡夫。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Fan Zi'an, 'Bamboo Leaf Boat', Act 1: 'These are all immortal bones, not like you mortals with ordinary eyes.'
example: 孤先见列位时，只以为唐朝远来的行脚僧，其实肉眼凡胎，多致轻亵。（明·吴承恩《西游记》第八十八回）
exampleTraditional: 孤先見列位時，只以為唐朝遠來的行腳僧，其實肉眼凡胎，多致輕褻。（明·吳承恩《西遊記》第八十八回）
exampleEn: When I first saw you, I only thought you were traveling monks from the distant Tang Dynasty; indeed, with mortal eyes and ordinary body, I was too disrespectful. — Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 88

explanation: 夙夜早晚，朝夕；匪不；懈懈怠。形容日夜谨慎工作，勤奋不懈。
explanationTraditional: 夙夜早晚，朝夕；匪不；懈懈怠。形容日夜謹慎工作，勤奮不懈。
explanationEn: Diligent and unremitting day and night; working hard without slack.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·焌民》既明且哲，以保其身，夙夜匪解，以事一人。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·焌民》既明且哲，以保其身，夙夜匪解，以事一人。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Songs, Greater Odes, Zheng Min': 'Both wise and prudent, to preserve his person, diligent day and night, to serve one man.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 谈论天文地理。形容博学多识。
explanationTraditional: 談論天文地理。形容博學多識。
explanationEn: Discussing astronomy and geography; describes broad knowledge and erudition.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 天然的道理和人的常情。
explanationTraditional: 天然的道理和人的常情。
explanationEn: Natural principles and human emotions.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十六回你可晓得一念不违天理人情，天地鬼神会暗中阿护；一念背了天理人情，天地鬼神也就会立刻不容。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十六回你可曉得一念不違天理人情，天地鬼神會暗中阿護；一念背了天理人情，天地鬼神也就會立刻不容。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wen Kang, 'The Legend of Heroes', Chapter 36: 'You should know that if one does not violate natural principles and human emotions, the gods and spirits will secretly protect; if one goes against them, they will immediately be unforgiving.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 阡陌田间小路。形容田地方袤，接连不断。
explanationTraditional: 阡陌田間小路。形容田地方袤，接連不斷。
explanationEn: Fields stretching continuously; describes vast landholdings.
derivation: 汉·荀悦《汉纪·武帝纪四》富者田连阡陌，贫者无立锥之地。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·荀悅《漢紀·武帝紀四》富者田連阡陌，貧者無立錐之地。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Xun Yue, 'Han Records, Annals of Emperor Wu', Part 4: 'The rich have fields stretching across paths, the poor have no place to stand.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 铜壶古代计时的漏器。用铜壶盛水滴漏来计时刻。
explanationTraditional: 銅壺古代計時的漏器。用銅壺盛水滴漏來計時刻。
explanationEn: A copper clepsydra (water clock) used in ancient times to measure time by dripping water.
derivation: 唐·温庭筠《鸡鸣埭歌》铜壶漏断梦初觉，宝马尘高人未知。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·溫庭筠《雞鳴埭歌》銅壺漏斷夢初覺，寶馬塵高人未知。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Wen Tingyun, 'Song of the Cockcrow Mound': 'The copper clepsydra stops dripping, dreams just awaken; precious horses raise dust, unknown to men.'
example: 静听得～，夜月微残。★《白雪遗音·马头调·好梦儿》
exampleTraditional: 靜聽得～，夜月微殘。★《白雪遺音·馬頭調·好夢兒》
exampleEn: Quietly listening to the copper clepsydra dripping, the night moon fades. — 'Snowy Relics, Matou Tune, Good Dream'

explanation: 形容家产极丰。
explanationTraditional: 形容家產極豐。
explanationEn: Extremely wealthy family property.
derivation: 元·无名氏《玩江亭》第一折牛璾有万贯家财，在赵江梅家作赘。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《玩江亭》第一折牛璾有萬貫家財，在趙江梅家作贅。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Playing in the Jiang Pavilion', Act 1: 'Niu Lin has a fortune of ten thousand strings, and lives as a son-in-law in Zhao Jiangmei's house.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 相当于一箭射程的距离。比喻相距不远。
explanationTraditional: 相當於一箭射程的距離。比喻相距不遠。
explanationEn: A distance equivalent to the range of an arrow shot; metaphorically meaning not far apart.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第九十回宋江上得马来，前行的众头领，已去了一箭之地，见宋江和贯忠说话，都勒马伺候。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第九十回宋江上得馬來，前行的眾頭領，已去了一箭之地，見宋江和貫忠說話，都勒馬伺候。”
derivationEn: From Chapter 90 of 'Water Margin' by Shi Nai'an of the Ming Dynasty: 'Song Jiang mounted his horse, and the forward leaders had already gone a bowshot's distance...'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 琼美玉。用美玉制成的浆液，古代传说饮了它可以成仙。比喻美酒或甘美的浆汁。
explanationTraditional: 瓊美玉。用美玉製成的漿液，古代傳說飲了它可以成仙。比喻美酒或甘美的漿汁。
explanationEn: A liquid made from beautiful jade, which in ancient legend could make one immortal; metaphorically refers to fine wine or sweet nectar.
derivation: 汉·王逸《九思·疾世》吮玉液兮止渴，啮芝华兮疗饥。”战国楚·宋玉《招魂》华酌既陈，有琼浆些。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王逸《九思·疾世》吮玉液兮止渴，齧芝華兮療飢。”戰國楚·宋玉《招魂》華酌既陳，有瓊漿些。”
derivationEn: From 'Nine Longings: Suffering the Age' by Wang Yi of the Han Dynasty: 'Suck jade liquid to quench thirst, nibble zhi flowers to cure hunger.' And from 'Summons of the Soul' by Song Yu of the Warring States period: 'The ornate goblets are set out, with jade-like nectar.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 要发扬、放开，先控制、压抑。
explanationTraditional: 要發揚、放開，先控制、壓抑。
explanationEn: To first restrain or suppress in order to later promote or release.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 写文章经常采用欲扬先抑的手法。
exampleTraditional: 寫文章經常採用欲揚先抑的手法。
exampleEn: Writing articles often employs the technique of first suppressing then promoting.

explanation: 装潢原指裱糊字画，现也指装饰物品使之美观；门面指外观。比喻只把外表装饰得很漂亮。
explanationTraditional: 裝潢原指裱糊字畫，現也指裝飾物品使之美觀；門面指外觀。比喻只把外表裝飾得很漂亮。
explanationEn: Originally refers to mounting paintings, now also means decorating items to make them beautiful; metaphorically means to only make the exterior look attractive.
derivation: 元·秦简夫《东堂老》第一折止则有这两件儿衣服，装点着门面。”
derivationTraditional: 元·秦簡夫《東堂老》第一折止則有這兩件兒衣服，裝點著門面。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'The Old Man of East Hall' by Qin Jianfu: 'Only these two clothes adorn the front.'
example: 里面用了佛说，外面排斥佛说，不过是～，难道有识的人，就被他瞒过去。★清·章炳麟《论教育的根本要从自国自心发出来》
exampleTraditional: 裡面用了佛說，外面排斥佛說，不過是～，難道有識的人，就被他瞞過去。★清·章炳麟《論教育的根本要從自國自心發出來》
exampleEn: Inside using Buddhist teachings, outside rejecting them, it's just window dressing. Can a knowledgeable person be fooled by this? — Zhang Binglin, 'On the Foundation of Education Must Come from One's Own Country and Mind'

explanation: 饱充分；以用。痛打，尽情地揍。
explanationTraditional: 飽充分；以用。痛打，盡情地揍。
explanationEn: To beat someone thoroughly; to give a good beating.
derivation: 《晋书·石勒载记下》孤往日厌卿老拳，卿亦饱孤毒手。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·石勒載記下》孤往日厭卿老拳，卿亦飽孤毒手。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Shi Le': 'In the past, I tired you with my old fists, and you also gave me a poisonous hand.'
example: 他随即把老婆痛打一顿。～是把男女生理上的共性消除不了的。★李欣《从男女有别”谈起》
exampleTraditional: 他隨即把老婆痛打一頓。～是把男女生理上的共性消除不了的。★李欣《從男女有別”談起》
exampleEn: He then gave his wife a thorough beating. 'Satiating with old fists' cannot eliminate the commonality of male and female physiology. — Li Xin, 'On the Difference Between Men and Women'

explanation: 指报复冤仇，洗刷耻辱。
explanationTraditional: 指報復冤仇，洗刷恥辱。
explanationEn: To take revenge for grievances and wash away shame.
derivation: 《水浒传》第九八回主女琼英，素有报仇雪耻之志。”
derivationTraditional: 《水滸傳》第九八回主女瓊英，素有報仇雪恥之志。”
derivationEn: From 'Water Margin', Chapter 98: 'The daughter of the lord, Qiongying, has long had the ambition to avenge and cleanse shame.'
example: 虽然～，从来不曾放在考虑之列；但‘非我族类，其心必异’的道理，兔先生却是明白的。★聂绀弩《兔先生的发言》
exampleTraditional: 雖然～，從來不曾放在考慮之列；但‘非我族類，其心必異’的道理，兔先生卻是明白的。★聶紺弩《兔先生的發言》
exampleEn: Although 'avenging and cleansing shame' has never been considered, the principle 'those not of our race are of a different mind' is well understood by Mr. Rabbit. — Nie Gannu, 'Mr. Rabbit's Speech'

explanation: 仰起头来鼻孔朝天。形容高傲自大。
explanationTraditional: 仰起頭來鼻孔朝天。形容高傲自大。
explanationEn: To tilt the head back so nostrils point upward; describes arrogance and self-importance.
derivation: 见鼻孔撩天”。
derivationTraditional: 見鼻孔撩天”。
derivationEn: See 'nostrils pointing to the sky'.
example: [李嵩平]平常那种～的凌人盛气，不知跑到哪里去了。★《花城》1981年第3期
exampleTraditional: [李嵩平]平常那種～的凌人盛氣，不知跑到哪裡去了。★《花城》1981年第3期
exampleEn: [Li Songping's] usual arrogant and overbearing manner had vanished. — 'Flower City', 1981, Issue 3

explanation: 就凑近，靠近。躲开难的，去找容易的做。也指做事情先从容易的做起。
explanationTraditional: 就湊近，靠近。躲開難的，去找容易的做。也指做事情先從容易的做起。
explanationEn: To avoid the difficult and approach the easy; also means to start with the easier tasks.
derivation: 《元史·文宗本纪》四大都总管刘原仁称疾，久不视事，及迁同知储政院事，即就职，侥幸巧宦避难就易。”
derivationTraditional: 《元史·文宗本紀》四大都總管劉原仁稱疾，久不視事，及遷同知儲政院事，即就職，僥倖巧宦避難就易。”
derivationEn: From 'History of Yuan: Annals of Emperor Wenzong': 'The grand capital's Liu Yuanren claimed illness and long did not attend to affairs; when transferred to the same post in the Palace Secretariat, he immediately took office, a cunning official avoiding difficulty and seeking ease.'
example: 有些地方你的确说出了我的弱点，比如你说我～地在手法上取巧。★巴金《生之忏悔·我的自剖》
exampleTraditional: 有些地方你的確說出了我的弱點，比如你說我～地在手法上取巧。★巴金《生之懺悔·我的自剖》
exampleEn: In some places you indeed pointed out my weaknesses, such as when you said I took the easy way out in technique. — Ba Jin, 'Confessions of Life: My Self-Analysis'

explanation: 不改变自有的快乐。指处于困苦的境况仍然很快乐。
explanationTraditional: 不改變自有的快樂。指處於困苦的境況仍然很快樂。
explanationEn: Not changing one's happiness; refers to remaining joyful even in difficult circumstances.
derivation: 《论语·雍也》一箪食，一飘饮，在陋巷，人不堪其扰，回出不改其乐。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·雍也》一簞食，一飄飲，在陋巷，人不堪其擾，回出不改其樂。”
derivationEn: From 'Analects: Yong Ye': 'With a single bamboo bowl of rice, a single gourd of drink, living in a mean alley, others could not bear the distress, but Hui did not change his joy.'
example: （孔子）称赞颜回吃喝不够，‘～’。★朱自清《论吃饭》
exampleTraditional: （孔子）稱讚顏回吃喝不夠，‘～’。★朱自清《論吃飯》
exampleEn: Confucius praised Yan Hui for being content with little food and drink, 'not changing his joy'. — Zhu Ziqing, 'On Eating'

explanation: 原指被美妙的音乐所陶醉，因而辨不出肉味◇形容专心学习，吃东西辨不出味道。也形容生活困难，无肉可吃。
explanationTraditional: 原指被美妙的音樂所陶醉，因而辨不出肉味◇形容專心學習，吃東西辨不出味道。也形容生活困難，無肉可吃。
explanationEn: Originally means being so captivated by beautiful music that one cannot distinguish the taste of meat; later describes being so absorbed in study that one cannot taste food; also describes living in poverty without meat to eat.
derivation: 《论语·述而》子在齐闻《韶》，三月不知肉味。曰‘不图为乐之至于斯也。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》子在齊聞《韶》，三月不知肉味。曰‘不圖為樂之至於斯也。”
derivationEn: From 'Analects: Shu Er': 'When the Master was in Qi, he heard the Shao music, and for three months did not know the taste of meat. He said, 'I never thought that music could be so sublime.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 草率粗枝大叶，敷衍了事。马马虎虎就处理了。形容办事不认真。
explanationTraditional: 草率粗枝大葉，敷衍了事。馬馬虎虎就處理了。形容辦事不認真。
explanationEn: To do something carelessly or perfunctorily, without due diligence.
derivation: 清·赵翼《廿二史札记·新唐书本纪书法》欧公本纪，则不免草率从事，不能为之讳也。明初修史时，即据其成文编入，不复彼此互订，以归画一，亦可见其草率从事也。”
derivationTraditional: 清·趙翼《廿二史札記·新唐書本紀書法》歐公本紀，則不免草率從事，不能為之諱也。明初修史時，即據其成文編入，不復彼此互訂，以歸畫一，亦可見其草率從事也。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhao Yi's 'Twenty-Two Histories Notes': 'Ouyang Xiu's annals could not avoid being careless.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 乖荒谬的；丑可耻的。指在人前出丑。
explanationTraditional: 乖荒謬的；醜可恥的。指在人前出醜。
explanationEn: To make a fool of oneself in public; to show one's disgrace.
derivation: 金·董解元《西厢记诸宫调》卷下已恁地出乖弄丑，泼水再难收。”
derivationTraditional: 金·董解元《西廂記諸宮調》卷下已恁地出乖弄醜，潑水再難收。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty Dong Jieyuan's 'The Story of the Western Wing': 'Already made a fool of oneself, spilt water cannot be gathered.'
example: 象我娄家表叔结交了多少人，一个个～，若听见这样话，岂不羞死！★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 象我婁家表叔結交了多少人，一個個～，若聽見這樣話，豈不羞死！★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十四回
exampleEn: Like my uncle Lou's friends, each one made a fool of themselves; if they heard such words, wouldn't they die of shame? — Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 14

explanation: 度度量；包容纳。形容气量大，能宽容人。
explanationTraditional: 度度量；包容納。形容氣量大，能寬容人。
explanationEn: Magnanimous and tolerant; having a generous spirit that can forgive others.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十回这事情自以为不办为是。倘若嫂夫人是大度包容的呢，自然没得话说。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十回這事情自以為不辦為是。倘若嫂夫人是大度包容的呢，自然沒得話說。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 10: 'If your wife is magnanimous and tolerant, naturally there will be no words.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 为了形式上的好看，不顾一切地过分讲究排场。
explanationTraditional: 為了形式上的好看，不顧一切地過分講究排場。
explanationEn: To go to great lengths for ostentation, extravagantly arranging things for show.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他有大肆铺张的不良习惯。
exampleTraditional: 他有大肆鋪張的不良習慣。
exampleEn: He has the bad habit of being overly extravagant.

explanation: 形容说话离题，没有中心。
explanationTraditional: 形容說話離題，沒有中心。
explanationEn: To talk irrelevantly or digress from the main topic.
derivation: 《官场现形记》第五三回制台问了几句话，亏他东扯西拉，居然没有露出马脚。”
derivationTraditional: 《官場現形記》第五三回制臺問了幾句話，虧他東扯西拉，居然沒有露出馬腳。”
derivationEn: From 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 53: 'The governor asked a few questions, and he managed to ramble on without revealing his ignorance.'
example: 这批导工会的事是很麻烦的，你得给他详细说说以前的经过情形，不要～的什么英美，什么南洋。★瞿秋白《矛盾”的继续》
exampleTraditional: 這批導工會的事是很麻煩的，你得給他詳細說說以前的經過情形，不要～的什麼英美，什麼南洋。★瞿秋白《矛盾”的繼續》
exampleEn: This matter of guiding the trade union is very troublesome; you need to explain the previous circumstances in detail, not ramble on about Britain and America, or Southeast Asia. — Qu Qiubai's 'Continuation of Contradictions'

explanation: 形容水的飞溅犹如珠玉一般。
explanationTraditional: 形容水的飛濺猶如珠玉一般。
explanationEn: Describing water splashing like pearls and jade; very beautiful.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 汉朝冯唐身历三朝，到武帝时，举为贤良，但年事已高不能为官。感慨生不逢时或表示年寿老迈。
explanationTraditional: 漢朝馮唐身歷三朝，到武帝時，舉為賢良，但年事已高不能為官。感慨生不逢時或表示年壽老邁。
explanationEn: To lament that one is getting old and has missed opportunities for achievement; often used to express regret over aging or unfulfilled ambition.
derivation: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王阁饯别序》嗟乎！时运不齐，命运多舛，冯唐易老，李广难封。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王閣餞別序》嗟乎！時運不齊，命運多舛，馮唐易老，李廣難封。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Wang Bo's 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng': 'Alas! Unfavorable times, ill fate; Feng Tang easily grows old, Li Guang is hard to enfeoff.'
example: ～双蓬鬓，殷浩难投一纸书。★元·吴景奎《寄苏伯夔诗》
exampleTraditional: ～雙蓬鬢，殷浩難投一紙書。★元·吳景奎《寄蘇伯夔詩》
exampleEn: Feng Tang easily grows old with twin temples white; Yin Hao finds it hard to send a single letter. — Yuan Dynasty Wu Jingkui's 'Poem to Su Bo Kui'

explanation: 惯于骑马的人常常会从马上摔下来。比喻善长某一技艺的人，往往因大意而招致失败。
explanationTraditional: 慣於騎馬的人常常會從馬上摔下來。比喻善長某一技藝的人，往往因大意而招致失敗。
explanationEn: A good rider often falls from his horse; meaning those skilled in something may fail due to carelessness.
derivation: 汉·袁康《越绝书·外传记吴王占梦》悲哉，夫好船者溺，好骑者堕，君子各以所好为祸。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·袁康《越絕書·外傳記吳王占夢》悲哉，夫好船者溺，好騎者墮，君子各以所好為禍。”
derivationEn: From Han Dynasty Yuan Kang's 'Records of Yue': 'Alas! A good sailor drowns, a good rider falls; gentlemen each suffer from their hobbies.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容神情逼真，使人感到好象亲眼看到一般。
explanationTraditional: 形容神情逼真，使人感到好象親眼看到一般。
explanationEn: Vivid and lifelike; describing something so realistic it seems as if one sees it with one's own eyes.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷五再说王氏闻丈夫凶信，初时也疑惑。被吕宝说得活龙活现，也信了。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷五再說王氏聞丈夫凶信，初時也疑惑。被呂寶說得活龍活現，也信了。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Warn the World', Volume 5: 'Wang's wife heard of her husband's misfortune and was initially doubtful, but Lü Bao described it so vividly that she believed it.'
example: 他把那个的的模样说得～。
exampleTraditional: 他把那個的的模樣說得～。
exampleEn: He described that person's appearance so vividly.

explanation: 解解救；倒悬人被倒挂，比喻处境困难、危急。比喻把受苦难的人民解救出来。
explanationTraditional: 解解救；倒懸人被倒掛，比喻處境困難、危急。比喻把受苦難的人民解救出來。
explanationEn: To rescue the people from extreme suffering or danger; to relieve the distressed.
derivation: 《孟子·公孙丑上》当今之时，万乘之国行仁政，民之悦之，犹解倒悬也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·公孫丑上》當今之時，萬乘之國行仁政，民之悅之，猶解倒懸也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Gongsun Chou I': 'In the present time, if a state of ten thousand chariots practices benevolent government, the people will be delighted, as if rescued from hanging upside down.'
example: 近一两年来，他常常在心中琢磨着要得天下必须如何～收买人心。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第六章
exampleTraditional: 近一兩年來，他常常在心中琢磨著要得天下必須如何～收買人心。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第六章
exampleEn: In the past year or two, he often pondered how to win the world by rescuing the people from misery and winning their hearts. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 6

explanation: 九表示极多。纵然死很多回也不后悔。形容意志坚定，不认经历多少危险，也决不动摇退缩。
explanationTraditional: 九表示極多。縱然死很多回也不後悔。形容意志堅定，不認經歷多少危險，也決不動搖退縮。
explanationEn: Even if one dies many times, there is no regret. Describes unwavering determination and refusal to retreat despite any danger.
derivation: 战国·楚·屈原《离骚》亦余心之所善兮，虽九死其犹未悔。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·屈原《離騷》亦餘心之所善兮，雖九死其猶未悔。”
derivationEn: From Qu Yuan's 'Li Sao' of the Warring States period: 'For the good that my heart loves, I would die nine deaths without regret.'
example: 忠臣挟忠，则扶颠持危，～，志士侠义，则临难自奋，之死靡他。★明·李贽《焚书·杂述·昆仑奴》
exampleTraditional: 忠臣挾忠，則扶顛持危，～，志士俠義，則臨難自奮，之死靡他。★明·李贄《焚書·雜述·崑崙奴》
exampleEn: A loyal minister, holding to loyalty, supports the state in crisis, even at the risk of death without regret; a righteous scholar, facing adversity, rises to the occasion and dies without complaint. — Ming Dynasty, Li Zhi, 'A Book to Burn: Miscellaneous: The Kunlun Slave'

explanation: 灯光酒色，红绿相映，令人目眩神迷。形容奢侈糜烂的生活。
explanationTraditional: 燈光酒色，紅綠相映，令人目眩神迷。形容奢侈糜爛的生活。
explanationEn: Lights and wine, red and green intermingling, dazzling and confusing. Describes a luxurious and decadent life.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第三十三回（玉生）侧着头想了一会道‘灯红酒绿’好吗？”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第三十三回（玉生）側著頭想了一會道‘燈紅酒綠’好嗎？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren's 'Strange Situations Observed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 33: 'Yu Sheng tilted his head and thought for a moment, then said, 'How about 'lamp red and wine green'?'
example: 总之，大罢工使香港这个～的城市完全失色了。★秦牧《沙面晨眺》
exampleTraditional: 總之，大罷工使香港這個～的城市完全失色了。★秦牧《沙面晨眺》
exampleEn: In short, the general strike completely overshadowed this city of 'lamp red and wine green'. — Qin Mu, 'Morning Stroll on Shameen'

explanation: 微细小。精心细致地描摹，连极小之处也不大意。形容认真细致，一丝不苟。
explanationTraditional: 微細小。精心細緻地描摹，連極小之處也不大意。形容認真細緻，一絲不苟。
explanationEn: To depict meticulously, leaving no small detail unattended. Describes careful and thorough work.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 庐山山名，在江西省九江市南。比喻事物的真相或本来面目。
explanationTraditional: 廬山山名，在江西省九江市南。比喻事物的真相或本來面目。
explanationEn: The true face of Mount Lu. Metaphor for the true nature or reality of something.
derivation: 清·杨伦《序》所谓万丈光焰化作百重云雾者，自非摧陷廓清，不见庐山真面。”
derivationTraditional: 清·楊倫《序》所謂萬丈光焰化作百重雲霧者，自非摧陷廓清，不見廬山真面。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Yang Lun's 'Preface': 'The so-called ten thousand feet of radiance turning into a hundred layers of clouds and mist, unless one clears away the obstacles, one cannot see the true face of Mount Lu.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻大致看到一些情况，但不够全面。同略见一斑”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻大致看到一些情況，但不夠全面。同略見一斑”。
explanationEn: To roughly see a part of something, but not the whole picture. Similar to 'catching a glimpse of a leopard through a bamboo tube'.
derivation: 明·张居正《答南列卿陈我度》孤虽不肖，其于人之贤否，略窥一斑，内不敢任爱憎之私，外不轻信誉之说。”
derivationTraditional: 明·張居正《答南列卿陳我度》孤雖不肖，其於人之賢否，略窺一斑，內不敢任愛憎之私，外不輕信譽之說。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Zhang Juzheng's 'Reply to Minister Chen Wodu of the Southern Ministry': 'Although I am not worthy, I can roughly see a part of a person's worth, neither favoring personal likes nor trusting hearsay lightly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻写作能力大有进步。也形容文章写得很出色。
explanationTraditional: 比喻寫作能力大有進步。也形容文章寫得很出色。
explanationEn: Dreaming of a pen blooming flowers. Metaphor for a great improvement in writing ability or for writing exceptionally well.
derivation: 五代·王仁裕《开元天宝遗事·梦笔头生花》李太白少时，梦所用之笔头上生花，后天才赡逸，名闻天下。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·王仁裕《開元天寶遺事·夢筆頭生花》李太白少時，夢所用之筆頭上生花，後天才贍逸，名聞天下。”
derivationEn: From Five Dynasties, Wang Renyu's 'Kaiyuan Tianbao Anecdotes: Dream of Pen Tip Blooming': 'When Li Taibai was young, he dreamed that the tip of his pen bloomed with flowers, and later his talent became extraordinary, renowned throughout the world.'
example: 李太白～，特睡乡幻景耳！★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷五
exampleTraditional: 李太白～，特睡鄉幻景耳！★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷五
exampleEn: Li Taibai's 'dream of pen blooming flowers' is just a scene from a dream! — Qing Dynasty, Ji Yun, 'Notes of the Thatched Cottage', Volume 5

explanation: 鸟没有了，弓也就藏起来不用了。比喻事情成功之后，把曾经出过力的人一脚踢开。
explanationTraditional: 鳥沒有了，弓也就藏起來不用了。比喻事情成功之後，把曾經出過力的人一腳踢開。
explanationEn: When the birds are gone, the bow is put away. Metaphor for discarding those who have helped after success is achieved.
derivation: 《史记·越王勾践世家》蜚（飞）鸟尽，良弓藏；狡兔死，走狗烹。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·越王勾踐世家》蜚（飛）鳥盡，良弓藏；狡兔死，走狗烹。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: The House of King Goujian of Yue': 'When the flying birds are gone, the good bow is put away; when the cunning hare is dead, the running dog is cooked.'
example: 小弟从征方腊回来，苦劝我东人隐逸。明知有～”之祸。★清·陈忱《水浒后传》第二十二回
exampleTraditional: 小弟從徵方臘回來，苦勸我東人隱逸。明知有～”之禍。★清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第二十二回
exampleEn: After the campaign against Fang La, I earnestly advised my master to retire in seclusion, knowing the disaster of 'when the birds are gone, the bow is put away'. — Qing Dynasty, Chen Chen, 'Water Margin Sequel', Chapter 22

explanation: 旧时对风流而有文采的富贵子弟的誉称。
explanationTraditional: 舊時對風流而有文采的富貴子弟的譽稱。
explanationEn: A graceful and cultured young man from a wealthy family. A complimentary term for a refined and talented youth.
derivation: 三国魏·曹植《侍太子坐》诗齐人进奇乐，歌者出西秦，翩翩我公子，机巧忽若神。”
derivationTraditional: 三國魏·曹植《侍太子坐》詩齊人進奇樂，歌者出西秦，翩翩我公子，機巧忽若神。”
derivationEn: From Three Kingdoms Wei, Cao Zhi's poem 'Attending the Crown Prince's Feast': 'The people of Qi present rare music, the singers come from Western Qin; graceful is my young master, clever as if divine.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 卉草的总称。原意是指希奇少见的花草。也比喻美妙的文章作品等。
explanationTraditional: 卉草的總稱。原意是指希奇少見的花草。也比喻美妙的文章作品等。
explanationEn: Rare and exotic flowers and plants. Also metaphor for beautiful literary works or articles.
derivation: 北魏·杨衒之《洛阳伽蓝记·白马寺》庭列修竹；檐拂高松，奇花异草，骈阗堦砌。”《西京杂记》卷三奇树异草，靡不具植。”
derivationTraditional: 北魏·楊衒之《洛陽伽藍記·白馬寺》庭列修竹；簷拂高松，奇花異草，駢闐堦砌。”《西京雜記》卷三奇樹異草，靡不具植。”
derivationEn: From Northern Wei, Yang Xuanzhi's 'Record of Buddhist Monasteries in Luoyang: White Horse Temple': 'The courtyard is lined with tall bamboos, the eaves brush against tall pines, rare flowers and exotic plants fill the steps.' Also from 'Xijing Miscellanies', Volume 3: 'Rare trees and exotic plants, all planted.'
example: 奉命前往洛阳，不问权豪势要之家，选拣～，和买花栽子，趁时栽接。★元·白朴《墙头马上》第一折
exampleTraditional: 奉命前往洛陽，不問權豪勢要之家，選揀～，和買花栽子，趁時栽接。★元·白樸《牆頭馬上》第一折
exampleEn: Ordered to go to Luoyang, regardless of powerful families, to select rare flowers and exotic plants, buy seedlings, and plant them in season. — Yuan Dynasty, Bai Pu, 'At the Wall', First Act

explanation: 想方设法奉承讨好别人。同曲意逢迎”。
explanationTraditional: 想方設法奉承討好別人。同曲意逢迎”。
explanationEn: To go out of one's way to flatter and please others. Same as 'currying favor'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 权势压倒天下。形容权势极大。
explanationTraditional: 權勢壓倒天下。形容權勢極大。
explanationEn: Having power that overwhelms the whole world; extremely powerful.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指谈论的人多，各种议论都有。
explanationTraditional: 指談論的人多，各種議論都有。
explanationEn: Many people talking, leading to various opinions and gossip.
derivation: 《脂砚斋重评石头记》第九回宁府人多口杂，那些不得志的奴仆们聑能造言诽谤主人。”
derivationTraditional: 《脂硯齋重評石頭記》第九回寧府人多口雜，那些不得志的奴僕們聑能造言誹謗主人。”
derivationEn: From 'A Dream of Red Mansions' (Zhiyanzhai Re-evaluated Version), Chapter 9: 'In the Ning Mansion, with many people and mixed voices, those disgruntled servants would slander the master.'
example: 在～的地方，我就尽可能的少作些引人注目的行为。★夏衍《谈自己》
exampleTraditional: 在～的地方，我就儘可能的少作些引人注目的行為。★夏衍《談自己》
exampleEn: In a place with many people and mixed voices, I try to avoid attracting attention as much as possible. — Xia Yan, 'Talking About Myself'

explanation: 叵不可。人的心地不可探测。形容人心险恶。
explanationTraditional: 叵不可。人的心地不可探測。形容人心險惡。
explanationEn: The human heart is unfathomable; describing treacherous intentions.
derivation: 《新唐书·尹愔传》吾门人多矣，尹子叵测也。”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·尹愔傳》吾門人多矣，尹子叵測也。”
derivationEn: From 'New Book of Tang: Biography of Yin Yin': 'I have many disciples, but Yin Zi is unfathomable.'
example: 夫～，险于山川，机阱万端，由斯隐伏。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记·滦阳消夏录》
exampleTraditional: 夫～，險于山川，機阱萬端，由斯隱伏。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記·灤陽消夏錄》
exampleEn: The human heart is unfathomable, more dangerous than mountains and rivers; traps and pitfalls are hidden everywhere. — Ji Yun, 'Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Observations'

explanation: 洒水扫地，酬答宾客。封建时代儒家教育、学习的基本内容之一。
explanationTraditional: 灑水掃地，酬答賓客。封建時代儒家教育、學習的基本內容之一。
explanationEn: Sweeping and sprinkling water, and receiving guests; basic elements of Confucian education for children.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《〈大学章句〉序》人生八岁，则自王公以下，至于庶人之子弟，皆入小学，而教之以洒扫应对进退之节，礼乐射御书数之文。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《〈大學章句〉序》人生八歲，則自王公以下，至於庶人之子弟，皆入小學，而教之以灑掃應對進退之節，禮樂射御書數之文。”
derivationEn: From Zhu Xi's 'Preface to the Great Learning': 'At age eight, from princes to commoners' children, they enter elementary school to learn the etiquette of sweeping, receiving guests, and advancing/retreating, as well as the arts of rites, music, archery, charioteering, calligraphy, and mathematics.'
example: 圣人之道，贯彻上下，自～，以至均平天下，其事理一也。★明·王廷相《慎言·作圣》
exampleTraditional: 聖人之道，貫徹上下，自～，以至均平天下，其事理一也。★明·王廷相《慎言·作聖》
exampleEn: The sage's way permeates all levels, from sweeping and receiving guests to pacifying the world; the principle is the same. — Wang Tingxiang, 'Cautious Words: On Sages'

explanation: 比喻能说会辩的口才。
explanationTraditional: 比喻能說會辯的口才。
explanationEn: A metaphor for eloquence and persuasive speech.
derivation: 《史记·平原君虞卿列传》毛先生以三寸不烂之舌，强于百万之师。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平原君虞卿列傳》毛先生以三寸不爛之舌，強於百萬之師。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lord Pingyuan and Yu Qing': 'Mr. Mao, with his three-inch tongue, is stronger than a million troops.'
example: 他凭着～，使许多人听信了他的谎言。
exampleTraditional: 他憑著～，使許多人聽信了他的謊言。
exampleEn: With his silver tongue, he made many people believe his lies.

explanation: 常指不安心，不专一。同三心二意”。
explanationTraditional: 常指不安心，不專一。同三心二意”。
explanationEn: Often refers to being unsettled or not single-minded; same as '三心二意'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻廉洁奉公。
explanationTraditional: 比喻廉潔奉公。
explanationEn: Metaphor for being honest and incorruptible in official duties.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻至尊至贵、最有权威的人。
explanationTraditional: 比喻至尊至貴、最有權威的人。
explanationEn: Metaphor for the most supreme and authoritative person.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: ①形容威武雄壮的士兵和战马。②谓战事，兵事。
explanationTraditional: ①形容威武雄壯的士兵和戰馬。②謂戰事，兵事。
explanationEn: ① Describes mighty soldiers and warhorses. ② Refers to warfare or military affairs.
derivation: 宋·李纲《以旧赐战袍等赠韩少帅》诗之二铁马金戈睢水上，碧油红旆海山滨。”元·关汉卿《双赴梦》第三折忆当年铁马金戈，自桃园初结义，把尊兄辅佐。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·李綱《以舊賜戰袍等贈韓少帥》詩之二鐵馬金戈睢水上，碧油紅旆海山濱。”元·關漢卿《雙赴夢》第三折憶當年鐵馬金戈，自桃園初結義，把尊兄輔佐。”
derivationEn: From Li Gang's poem 'Giving Old Battle Robes to Young General Han' (second poem): 'Iron horses and golden spears on the Sui River, green flags and red pennants by the sea.' Also from Guan Hanqing's play 'Double Dream' (third act): 'Remembering those years of iron horses and golden spears, since the peach garden oath, assisting my elder brother.'
example: 生长承平听画筝，几闻～声。★清·魏源《秦淮镫船引》
exampleTraditional: 生長承平聽畫箏，幾聞～聲。★清·魏源《秦淮鐙船引》
exampleEn: Born in peaceful times, listening to painted zithers, how often do we hear the sound of iron horses and golden spears? — Wei Yuan, 'Qinhuai Lantern Boat Song'

explanation: 没有完成的志向。
explanationTraditional: 沒有完成的志向。
explanationEn: An unfulfilled ambition or aspiration.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 惩惩罚；诫警告，劝告。有小过失就惩戒，使受到教训而不致犯大错误。
explanationTraditional: 懲懲罰；誡警告，勸告。有小過失就懲戒，使受到教訓而不致犯大錯誤。
explanationEn: To punish small mistakes to prevent major errors; a lesson learned from minor punishment.
derivation: 《周易·系辞下》小惩而大诫，此小人之福也。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭下》小懲而大誡，此小人之福也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Xici II': 'Small punishment leads to great caution; this is the blessing of the petty man.'
example: 悖入非无悖出时，临歧知悔已嫌迟。～由来说，到底贪官不可为。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第七一回
exampleTraditional: 悖入非無悖出時，臨歧知悔已嫌遲。～由來說，到底貪官不可為。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第七一回
exampleEn: Ill-gotten gains will be lost; regret at the crossroads is too late. The saying 'small punishment, great caution' ultimately shows that corrupt officials cannot be tolerated. — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China', Chapter 71

explanation: 恍惚神志不清，精神不集中。形容精神不集中或神志不清楚。
explanationTraditional: 恍惚神志不清，精神不集中。形容精神不集中或神志不清楚。
explanationEn: Distracted or confused state of mind; unable to concentrate.
derivation: 唐·无名氏《东阳夜怪录》自虚心神恍惚，未敢遽前扪撄。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·無名氏《東陽夜怪錄》自虛心神恍惚，未敢遽前捫攖。”
derivationEn: From Tang dynasty anonymous 'Dongyang Night Monster Record': 'Zixu was in a daze, not daring to approach and touch.'
example: 彩云胡思乱想了一回，觉得～，四肢软胎胎提不起来。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 彩雲胡思亂想了一回，覺得～，四肢軟胎胎提不起來。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第十二回
exampleEn: Caiyun thought wildly for a while, feeling dazed and her limbs weak and limp. — Qing dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower of the Sea of Sins', Chapter 12

explanation: 既悲伤又高兴。
explanationTraditional: 既悲傷又高興。
explanationEn: Both sad and happy; mixed feelings of sorrow and joy.
derivation: 《平妖传》二回表公单单一身，不胜凄惨，且喜有了性命，又得了两件至宝，正所谓一悲一喜。”
derivationTraditional: 《平妖傳》二回表公單單一身，不勝悽慘，且喜有了性命，又得了兩件至寶，正所謂一悲一喜。”
derivationEn: From 'Ping Yao Zhuan', Chapter 2: 'Biao Gong was alone and desolate, but glad to be alive and have obtained two treasures, truly a mix of sorrow and joy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 花儿正盛开，月亮正圆满。比喻美好圆满。多用于棕人新婚。
explanationTraditional: 花兒正盛開，月亮正圓滿。比喻美好圓滿。多用於棕人新婚。
explanationEn: The moon is full and flowers are blooming; a metaphor for perfect happiness, often used for newlyweds.
derivation: 宋·晁补之《御街行》词幽期莫误香闺恨，罗带今朝褪。月圆花好一般春，触处总堪乘兴。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·晁補之《御街行》詞幽期莫誤香閨恨，羅帶今朝褪。月圓花好一般春，觸處總堪乘興。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty, Chao Buzhi's poem 'Yu Jie Xing': 'Do not miss the secret tryst, today the belt is loosened. The full moon and blooming flowers mark the spring, everywhere brings joy.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容眩晕而神志不清。
explanationTraditional: 形容眩暈而神志不清。
explanationEn: Dizzy and groggy; feeling faint and disoriented.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 给予赏识和重用的恩情。
explanationTraditional: 給予賞識和重用的恩情。
explanationEn: The kindness of being appreciated and given important responsibilities.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》只因一时知遇之感，不觉为之一哭。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》只因一時知遇之感，不覺為之一哭。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty, Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms': 'Just because of the feeling of being appreciated, he couldn't help crying.'
example: 大帅的～，卑职终身难报。★刘章仪《枭雄吴佩孚》
exampleTraditional: 大帥的～，卑職終身難報。★劉章儀《梟雄吳佩孚》
exampleEn: Your Excellency's kindness in recognizing my talent is something I can never repay in my lifetime. — Liu Zhangyi, 'The Tyrant Wu Peifu'

explanation: 两面为难，不容易决定。
explanationTraditional: 兩面為難，不容易決定。
explanationEn: In a dilemma; difficult to decide between two options.
derivation: 元·杨显之《潇湘雨》第一折我欲待亲自去寻来，限次又紧，着老夫左右两难，如何是好？”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊顯之《瀟湘雨》第一折我欲待親自去尋來，限次又緊，著老夫左右兩難，如何是好？”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty, Yang Xianzhi's 'Rain on the Xiao and Xiang Rivers', Act 1: 'I wanted to go find him myself, but the deadline is tight, leaving me in a dilemma. What to do?'
example: 这件事真叫他左右两难。
exampleTraditional: 這件事真叫他左右兩難。
exampleEn: This matter really put him in a dilemma.

explanation: 指不求甚饱或吃不饱饭。
