explanationTraditional: 指不求甚飽或吃不飽飯。
explanationEn: Half hungry, half full; not having enough to eat or not eating to satisfaction.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第二十八卷若论起吴衙内，只算做半饥半饱，未能趁心像意。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第二十八卷若論起吳衙內，只算做半飢半飽，未能趁心像意。”
derivationEn: From Ming dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 28: 'As for Master Wu, he was only half full, not yet satisfied.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有完全成熟或未烹煮至可食用的程度。比喻不熟悉；不熟练。
explanationTraditional: 沒有完全成熟或未烹煮至可食用的程度。比喻不熟悉；不熟練。
explanationEn: Half-raw, half-cooked; not fully cooked or ripe. Metaphorically, not familiar or not skilled.
derivation: 元·元怀《拊掌录》北都有妓女美色，而举止生梗，土人谓之生张八……野（魏野）赠之诗曰‘君为北道生张八，我是西州熟魏三，莫怪尊前无笑语，半生半熟未相谙。’座客大发一噱。”
derivationTraditional: 元·元懷《拊掌錄》北都有妓女美色，而舉止生梗，土人謂之生張八……野（魏野）贈之詩曰‘君為北道生張八，我是西州熟魏三，莫怪尊前無笑語，半生半熟未相諳。’座客大發一噱。”
derivationEn: From Yuan dynasty, Yuan Huai's 'Clapping Records': 'In the northern capital, there was a beautiful prostitute but with awkward manners, called 'Raw Zhang Ba'... Wei Ye wrote a poem: 'You are the raw Zhang Ba of the north, I am the ripe Wei San of the west. Don't be surprised at no laughter before the cup, half-raw half-ripe, not yet acquainted.' The guests burst into laughter.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻相聚饮酒时的欢乐。觥，酒器。
explanationTraditional: 比喻相聚飲酒時的歡樂。觥，酒器。
explanationEn: Glasses clink and wine cups cross; lively drinking and merrymaking.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《醉翁亭记》射者中，弈者胜，觥筹交错，坐起而喧哗者，众宾欢也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《醉翁亭記》射者中，弈者勝，觥籌交錯，坐起而喧譁者，眾賓歡也。”
derivationEn: From Song dynasty, Ouyang Xiu's 'The Story of the Drunkard's Pavilion': 'The archers hit the target, the chess players win, wine cups and tally sticks cross, and people sit and stand shouting—this is the joy of the guests.'
example: 近30年未见的几个老同学齐聚一堂，～，乐不可支。
exampleTraditional: 近30年未見的幾個老同學齊聚一堂，～，樂不可支。
exampleEn: Nearly 30 years later, a few old classmates gathered together, clinking glasses and having a great time.

explanation: 形容为了逃避灾祸而到处躲藏。
explanationTraditional: 形容為了逃避災禍而到處躲藏。
explanationEn: To hide everywhere to escape disaster or danger.
derivation: 明·无名氏《伐晋兴齐》第四折杀的他军兵胆碎魂先丧，一个个哭啼啼东躲西藏，枪刀剑戟都潎样。”
derivationTraditional: 明·無名氏《伐晉興齊》第四折殺的他軍兵膽碎魂先喪，一個個哭啼啼東躲西藏，槍刀劍戟都潎樣。”
derivationEn: From the Ming Dynasty play 'Fa Jin Xing Qi' by Anonymous: 'He killed their soldiers, their souls shattered, each crying and hiding east and west.'
example: 真亏你领着母亲和一群孩子～的，末一回还要走多少里路，翻一道大岭。★朱自清《给亡妇》
exampleTraditional: 真虧你領著母親和一群孩子～的，末一回還要走多少里路，翻一道大嶺。★朱自清《給亡婦》
exampleEn: It was really tough for you to lead your mother and a group of children hiding everywhere, and at the end you had to walk many miles and cross a big ridge. — Zhu Ziqing, 'To My Deceased Wife'

explanation: 寒风象刀，严霜象剑。形容气候寒冷，刺人肌肤。也比喻恶劣的环境。
explanationTraditional: 寒風象刀，嚴霜象劍。形容氣候寒冷，刺人肌膚。也比喻惡劣的環境。
explanationEn: Cold wind like a knife, frost like a sword; describes bitter cold that cuts the skin, also metaphor for harsh environment.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十七回中林黛玉的《葬花辞》一年三百六十日，风刀霜剑严相逼。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十七回中林黛玉的《葬花辭》一年三百六十日，風刀霜劍嚴相逼。”
derivationEn: From Lin Daiyu's 'Burial of Flowers' in Dream of the Red Chamber by Cao Xueqin: 'Three hundred and sixty days a year, the wind like knife and frost like sword press hard upon me.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用一笑来对待或回答。比喻不值得理会。同付之一笑”。
explanationTraditional: 用一笑來對待或回答。比喻不值得理會。同付之一笑”。
explanationEn: To dismiss with a laugh; to treat as not worth taking seriously.
derivation: 清·韩邦庆《海上花列传》第六回仲英乃恍然大悟，付诸一笑，就在高椅上坐下，问雪香道‘耐意思要我成日成夜陪仔耐坐来里，勿许到别场花去，阿是嗄？’”
derivationTraditional: 清·韓邦慶《海上花列傳》第六回仲英乃恍然大悟，付諸一笑，就在高椅上坐下，問雪香道‘耐意思要我成日成夜陪仔耐坐來裡，勿許到別場花去，阿是嗄？’”
derivationEn: From 'Flowers of Shanghai' by Han Bangqing, Chapter 6: 'Zhongying then suddenly understood, dismissed it with a laugh, and sat down on the high chair.'
example: 把一切诞罔不经之事，～，那就不负我今日一番饶舌了。★清·壮者《扫迷帚》第九回
exampleTraditional: 把一切誕罔不經之事，～，那就不負我今日一番饒舌了。★清·壯者《掃迷帚》第九回
exampleEn: Treat all absurd and unfounded matters with a laugh, and then I will not have wasted my eloquence today. — Qing Dynasty, Zhuang Zhe, 'Sweeping Away Superstition', Chapter 9

explanation: 负背着；致送到。背着重东西走远路。比喻能够负担艰巨任务。
explanationTraditional: 負揹著；致送到。揹著重東西走遠路。比喻能夠負擔艱鉅任務。
explanationEn: To carry a heavy burden and travel a long distance; metaphor for being able to undertake arduous tasks.
derivation: 《周易·系辞下》服牛乘马，引重致远，以利天下，盖取诸随。”《三国志·蜀书·庞统传》陆子可谓驽马有逸足之力，顾子可谓驽牛能负重致远也。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭下》服牛乘馬，引重致遠，以利天下，蓋取諸隨。”《三國志·蜀書·龐統傳》陸子可謂駑馬有逸足之力，顧子可謂駑牛能負重致遠也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Changes: Appended Judgments': 'Tame oxen and ride horses, carry heavy loads and go far, to benefit the world.' Also from 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Biography of Pang Tong': 'Lu Ji can be called a horse with extra speed, and Gu Shao can be called an ox that can carry heavy loads and go far.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 苟且得过且过；偷安只图眼前的安逸。只顾眼前的安逸，不顾将来。
explanationTraditional: 苟且得過且過；偷安只圖眼前的安逸。只顧眼前的安逸，不顧將來。
explanationEn: To seek temporary ease and comfort without regard for the future; to drift along.
derivation: 宋·汪应辰《文定集·廷试策》承晏安太平之后，苟且偷安，昧于远图，政令日弛，法度日隳。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·汪應辰《文定集·廷試策》承晏安太平之後，苟且偷安，昧於遠圖，政令日弛，法度日隳。”
derivationEn: From 'Collected Works of Wang Yingchen' by Wang Yingchen of the Song Dynasty: 'After a time of peace and prosperity, they drifted along seeking temporary ease, ignorant of long-term plans, decrees daily lax, laws daily decayed.'
example: 做大员的这样～，做属吏的又是那般逢迎得意。★清·张春帆《宦海》第二十回
exampleTraditional: 做大員的這樣～，做屬吏的又是那般逢迎得意。★清·張春帆《宦海》第二十回
exampleEn: High officials were so content with temporary ease, and subordinates were so sycophantic and pleased. — Qing Dynasty, Zhang Chunfan, 'The Sea of Officialdom', Chapter 20

explanation: 国家富强，人民安定。
explanationTraditional: 國家富強，人民安定。
explanationEn: The country is prosperous and the people are at peace.
derivation: 《汉书·刑法志》至齐桓公任用管仲而国富民安。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·刑法志》至齊桓公任用管仲而國富民安。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Treatise on Punishment': 'When Duke Huan of Qi employed Guan Zhong, the country became prosperous and the people at peace.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 骇使惊怕；涛大波浪。汹涌吓人的浪涛。比喻险恶的环境或尖锐激烈的斗争。
explanationTraditional: 駭使驚怕；濤大波浪。洶湧嚇人的浪濤。比喻險惡的環境或尖銳激烈的鬥爭。
explanationEn: Frightening waves and surging billows; metaphor for dangerous circumstances or fierce struggles.
derivation: 唐·田颖《玉山堂文集·海云楼记》人当既静之时，每思及前经所履之惊涛骇浪，未尝不惕然。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·田穎《玉山堂文集·海雲樓記》人當既靜之時，每思及前經所履之驚濤駭浪，未嘗不惕然。”
derivationEn: From 'Jade Mountain Hall Collection: Record of the Sea Cloud Tower' by Tian Ying of the Tang Dynasty: 'When people are quiet, they often think of the terrifying waves they have experienced before, and cannot help but be fearful.'
example: 年未及笄，遍历海外，走蛮烟瘴雨之乡，受～之险。（清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第六回）
exampleTraditional: 年未及笄，遍歷海外，走蠻煙瘴雨之鄉，受～之險。（清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第六回）
exampleEn: Before reaching adulthood, she traveled overseas, enduring lands of miasma and rain, and facing dangers of terrifying waves. — Qing Dynasty, Li Ruzhen, 'Flowers in the Mirror', Chapter 6

explanation: 用胶把柱粘住以后奏琴，柱不能移动，就无法调弦。比喻固执拘泥，不知变通。
explanationTraditional: 用膠把柱粘住以後奏琴，柱不能移動，就無法調絃。比喻固執拘泥，不知變通。
explanationEn: To glue the tuning pegs of a zither and then play it; metaphor for being rigid and inflexible, not adapting to changes.
derivation: 《史记·廉颇蔺相如列传》王以名使括，若胶柱而鼓瑟耳。括徒能读其父书传，不知合变也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·廉頗藺相如列傳》王以名使括，若膠柱而鼓瑟耳。括徒能讀其父書傳，不知合變也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru': 'The king appointed Zhao Kuo by name, as if gluing the pegs and playing the zither. Zhao Kuo could only read his father's books, not knowing how to adapt.'
example: 若非公孙杵臼，焉得赵氏孤儿，既以遇难避仇，不必～。★明·无名氏《鸣凤记·桑林奇遇》
exampleTraditional: 若非公孫杵臼，焉得趙氏孤兒，既以遇難避仇，不必～。★明·無名氏《鳴鳳記·桑林奇遇》
exampleEn: If not for Gongsun Chujiu, how could the orphan of Zhao have survived? Since he encountered trouble and avoided enemies, there is no need to be rigid. — Ming Dynasty, Anonymous, 'The Phoenix's Cry: Mulberry Grove Adventure'

explanation: 教育引导很有办法。
explanationTraditional: 教育引導很有辦法。
explanationEn: To have effective methods in teaching and guiding.
derivation: 清·吴研人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第九十九回凡此种种，虽然是他叔祖教导有方，也是他福至心灵，官星透露，才得一变而为闻一知十的聪明人。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳研人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第九十九回凡此種種，雖然是他叔祖教導有方，也是他福至心靈，官星透露，才得一變而為聞一知十的聰明人。”
derivationEn: From 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years' by Wu Jianren of the Qing Dynasty, Chapter 99: 'All these, though due to his uncle's effective teaching, were also because his mind was enlightened and his official star shone, so he suddenly became a clever person who could infer ten from one.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 闻听到。早就听到对方的盛名。多用作初见面时的客套话。
explanationTraditional: 聞聽到。早就聽到對方的盛名。多用作初見面時的客套話。
explanationEn: To have long heard of someone's great reputation; a polite phrase used when meeting for the first time.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第十五回晚生久闻大名，如雷贯耳。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第十五回晚生久聞大名，如雷貫耳。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of a Heroic Youth' by Wen Kang of the Qing Dynasty, Chapter 15: 'I have long heard of your great reputation, like thunder piercing the ear.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 合按照，适合；自如不受阻碍和拘束。打开闭合不受拘束，形容按照自己的意愿办事。
explanationTraditional: 合按照，適合；自如不受阻礙和拘束。打開閉合不受拘束，形容按照自己的意願辦事。
explanationEn: To open and close freely without hindrance; to act according to one's own will.
derivation: 法·法布尔《蝉》腿可以伸缩，前面的爪能够开合自如。”
derivationTraditional: 法·法布爾《蟬》腿可以伸縮，前面的爪能夠開合自如。”
derivationEn: Fabre's 'The Cicada': 'The legs can stretch and contract, and the front claws can open and close freely.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻精力旺盛，斗志昂扬。
explanationTraditional: 比喻精力旺盛，鬥志昂揚。
explanationEn: Full of energy and high morale; vigorous and spirited.
derivation: 陈残云《山谷风烟》第二一章大家一夜没睡觉，到如今还是龙精虎猛，表现了兄弟姐妹们对地主的仇恨。”
derivationTraditional: 陳殘雲《山谷風煙》第二一章大家一夜沒睡覺，到如今還是龍精虎猛，表現了兄弟姐妹們對地主的仇恨。”
derivationEn: Chen Canyun's 'Valley Wind and Smoke', Chapter 21: 'Everyone hadn't slept all night, yet they were still full of energy, showing the brothers and sisters' hatred for the landlords.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 犹漫天要价。形容所提出的条件、要求过高。
explanationTraditional: 猶漫天要價。形容所提出的條件、要求過高。
explanationEn: To ask an exorbitant price; to make excessive demands.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 茫然失意的样子；若失好像失去了东西。形容精神不集中，恍惚，若有所失的样子。
explanationTraditional: 茫然失意的樣子；若失好像失去了東西。形容精神不集中，恍惚，若有所失的樣子。
explanationEn: Dazed and confused, as if something is lost; absent-minded and disoriented.
derivation: 先秦·孟轲《孟子·滕文公上》徐子以告夷子，夷子抚然为间曰‘命之矣。’集注‘抚然茫然自失之貌。’”
derivationTraditional: 先秦·孟軻《孟子·滕文公上》徐子以告夷子，夷子撫然為間曰‘命之矣。’集註‘撫然茫然自失之貌。’”
derivationEn: Mencius, 'Teng Wen Gong I': 'Xu Zi told Yi Zi, and Yi Zi was stunned for a moment, saying, 'I accept it.' Commentary: 'Yi Zi looked blank and lost.'
example: 他被这个消息弄得～，焦虑不安。★沈西蒙《南征北战》第二章
exampleTraditional: 他被這個消息弄得～，焦慮不安。★沈西蒙《南征北戰》第二章
exampleEn: He was dazed and anxious after hearing the news. ★ Shen Ximeng, 'Southward Expedition, Northward Battle', Chapter 2

explanation: 翩翩形容举止潇洒超脱。风度美好的举止姿态。形容人的举止言谈超逸洒脱。
explanationTraditional: 翩翩形容舉止瀟灑超脫。風度美好的舉止姿態。形容人的舉止言談超逸灑脫。
explanationEn: Elegant and graceful demeanor; poised and refined in speech and manner.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十八回早有那般世谊同年，见他翩翩丰度，蔼然可亲，都愿和他亲近进来了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十八回早有那般世誼同年，見他翩翩丰度，藹然可親，都願和他親近進來了。”
derivationEn: Wen Kang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 38: 'The colleagues and peers, seeing his elegant demeanor and amiable nature, all wished to approach him.'
example: 周恩来这样惊人的酒量，偶尔也有喝醉的时候。不过，他再醉也不会有伤大雅，始终保持着他那与生俱来的～。★权延赤《走下圣坛的周恩来·周恩来与酒》
exampleTraditional: 周恩來這樣驚人的酒量，偶爾也有喝醉的時候。不過，他再醉也不會有傷大雅，始終保持著他那與生俱來的～。★權延赤《走下聖壇的周恩來·周恩來與酒》
exampleEn: Zhou Enlai, with his astonishing capacity for alcohol, occasionally got drunk. But no matter how drunk, he never lost his dignity, always maintaining his innate elegant demeanor. ★ Quan Yanshi, 'Zhou Enlai Leaving the Sacred Altar: Zhou Enlai and Alcohol'

explanation: 仆仆行路劳累的样子；风尘指行旅，含有辛苦之意。形容奔波忙碌，旅途劳累。
explanationTraditional: 僕僕行路勞累的樣子；風塵指行旅，含有辛苦之意。形容奔波忙碌，旅途勞累。
explanationEn: Weary from travel; exhausted by the hardships of a journey.
derivation: 元·尚仲贤《柳毅传书》你索是远路风尘的故人。”
derivationTraditional: 元·尚仲賢《柳毅傳書》你索是遠路風塵的故人。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Shang Zhongxian's 'The Story of Liu Yi Delivering the Letter': 'You are an old friend from a distant journey.'
example: 又想菲亚～，席不暇暖，现在又被囚系，少不免担惊受苦。（清·岭南羽衣女士《东欧女豪杰》第三回）
exampleTraditional: 又想菲亞～，席不暇暖，現在又被囚繫，少不免擔驚受苦。（清·嶺南羽衣女士《東歐女豪傑》第三回）
exampleEn: Also, Feiya, weary from travel and with no time to rest, is now imprisoned, inevitably suffering fear and hardship. (Qing Dynasty, Lingnan Yuyi Nushi, 'The Heroine of Eastern Europe', Chapter 3)

explanation: 很有风趣。
explanationTraditional: 很有風趣。
explanationEn: Full of wit and humor; very amusing.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他谈吐幽默，饶有风趣。
exampleTraditional: 他談吐幽默，饒有風趣。
exampleEn: He speaks with humor and is full of wit.

explanation: 暮傍晚；途路。天已晚了，路已走到了尽头。比喻处境十分困难，到了末日。也形容穷困到极点。
explanationTraditional: 暮傍晚；途路。天已晚了，路已走到了盡頭。比喻處境十分困難，到了末日。也形容窮困到極點。
explanationEn: The day is late and the road has ended; to be in a desperate situation, at the end of one's rope.
derivation: 《史记·伍子胥列传》吾日暮途远，吾故倒行而逆施之。”唐·杜甫《投赠哥舒开府翰二十韵》几年春草歇，今日暮途穷。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·伍子胥列傳》吾日暮途遠，吾故倒行而逆施之。”唐·杜甫《投贈哥舒開府翰二十韻》幾年春草歇，今日暮途窮。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Wu Zixu': 'My day is late and my road is far, so I act contrary to reason.' Du Fu's poem: 'After years of spring grass withering, today the road ends at dusk.'
example: 匪徒们真是～，矛盾百出。★曲波《林海雪原》二十九
exampleTraditional: 匪徒們真是～，矛盾百出。★曲波《林海雪原》二十九
exampleEn: The bandits were truly at the end of their rope, full of contradictions. ★ Qu Bo, 'Tracks in the Snowy Forest', Chapter 29

explanation: 肉食者吃肉的人，引伸为有权位的人；鄙鄙陋。旧时指身居高位、俸禄丰厚的人眼光短浅。
explanationTraditional: 肉食者吃肉的人，引伸為有權位的人；鄙鄙陋。舊時指身居高位、俸祿豐厚的人眼光短淺。
explanationEn: Those who eat meat (the powerful) are shortsighted; referring to high-ranking officials who lack foresight.
derivation: 《左传·庄公十年》肉食者鄙，未能远谋。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·莊公十年》肉食者鄙，未能遠謀。”
derivationEn: 'Zuo Zhuan: The Tenth Year of Duke Zhuang': 'Those who eat meat are shortsighted; they cannot plan far ahead.'
example: 彼唯有见于近而无见于远，有察于寡而无察于多，～，端推此辈。★严复《救亡决论》
exampleTraditional: 彼唯有見於近而無見於遠，有察於寡而無察於多，～，端推此輩。★嚴復《救亡決論》
exampleEn: They only see the near but not the far, only perceive the few but not the many; the shortsightedness of the powerful is indeed exemplified by such people. ★ Yan Fu, 'A Treatise on Salvation'

explanation: 怎么办。
explanationTraditional: 怎麼辦。
explanationEn: What can be done about it?; an expression of helplessness.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 彼此串通，互通消息。
explanationTraditional: 彼此串通，互通消息。
explanationEn: To collude with each other and exchange information secretly.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷一这相知有几样名色恩德相结者，谓之知己；腹心相照者，谓之知心；声气相求者，谓知知音。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷一這相知有幾樣名色恩德相結者，謂之知己；腹心相照者，謂之知心；聲氣相求者，謂知知音。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World' of Ming Dynasty: 'Those who are bound by kindness are called confidants; those who are heart-to-heart are called bosom friends; those who share the same spirit are called soulmates.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 老马认识路。比喻对某种事物十分熟悉的人。
explanationTraditional: 老馬認識路。比喻對某種事物十分熟悉的人。
explanationEn: An old horse knows the way. A metaphor for someone very familiar with a certain matter.
derivation: 《韩非子·说林上》管仲、隰朋从于桓公伐孤竹，春往冬反，迷惑失道。管仲曰‘老马之智可用也。’乃放老马而随之，遂得道。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·說林上》管仲、隰朋從於桓公伐孤竹，春往冬反，迷惑失道。管仲曰‘老馬之智可用也。’乃放老馬而隨之，遂得道。”
derivationEn: From 'Han Feizi: Shuo Lin Shang': 'Guan Zhong and Xi Peng followed Duke Huan of Qi to attack Guzhu. They went in spring and returned in winter, losing their way. Guan Zhong said, 'The wisdom of an old horse can be used.' So they let the old horse lead and found the way.'
example: 你也不用发忧，还有你老子是～”，慢慢地来指拨你罢！★茅盾《子夜》四
exampleTraditional: 你也不用發憂，還有你老子是～”，慢慢地來指撥你罷！★茅盾《子夜》四
exampleEn: Don't worry, your father is an old horse who knows the way; he will guide you slowly! — Mao Dun, 'Midnight', Chapter 4

explanation: 啼哭；号叫。因为饥饿寒冷而哭叫。形容挨饿受冻的悲惨生活。
explanationTraditional: 啼哭；號叫。因為飢餓寒冷而哭叫。形容挨餓受凍的悲慘生活。
explanationEn: To cry from hunger and cold. Describes a miserable life of suffering from cold and hunger.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《进学解》冬暖而儿号寒，年丰而妻啼饥。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《進學解》冬暖而兒號寒，年豐而妻啼飢。”
derivationEn: From Han Yu's 'Jinxue Jie' of Tang Dynasty: 'In warm winter, children cry from cold; in abundant year, wives cry from hunger.'
example: 值岁凶，～。★清·王晫《今世说·贤媛》
exampleTraditional: 值歲凶，～。★清·王晫《今世說·賢媛》
exampleEn: In a bad year, they cried from hunger and cold. — Qing Dynasty, Wang Zhuo, 'Jinshi Shuo: Xianyuan'

explanation: 眼泪鼻涕满脸乱淌。形容极度悲伤。
explanationTraditional: 眼淚鼻涕滿臉亂淌。形容極度悲傷。
explanationEn: Tears and nasal mucus flowing all over the face. Describes extreme sadness.
derivation: 《世说新语·言语》陶公疾笃”刘孝标注引王隐《晋书》临书振腕，涕泗横流。”
derivationTraditional: 《世說新語·言語》陶公疾篤”劉孝標註引王隱《晉書》臨書振腕，涕泗橫流。”
derivationEn: From 'Shishuo Xinyu: Yanyu' with annotation by Liu Xiaobiao quoting Wang Yin's 'Jin Shu': 'Writing a letter with trembling wrists, tears and mucus flowing.'
example: 抚剑悲歌，临书浩叹，每感岁时之易失，不知涕泗之横流。★宋·陆游《上王宣抚启》
exampleTraditional: 撫劍悲歌，臨書浩嘆，每感歲時之易失，不知涕泗之橫流。★宋·陸游《上王宣撫啟》
exampleEn: Clutching the sword and singing sadly, writing a letter and sighing deeply, often feeling the loss of time, unknowingly tears and mucus flow. — Song Dynasty, Lu You, 'Shang Wang Xuanfu Qi'

explanation: 假给予。天公不给以寿命。指寿命不长。
explanationTraditional: 假給予。天公不給以壽命。指壽命不長。
explanationEn: Heaven does not grant a long life. Refers to a short lifespan.
derivation: 清·平步青《霞外裙屑》卷六予以先生此考，为一生心力所瘁，成以行世，足为读史者一助，惜天不假年，积四十六年之岁月，仅成全史三之一。”
derivationTraditional: 清·平步青《霞外裙屑》卷六予以先生此考，為一生心力所瘁，成以行世，足為讀史者一助，惜天不假年，積四十六年之歲月，僅成全史三之一。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Ping Buqing's 'Xiawaichun': 'I think this work by the gentleman was the effort of his whole life, published for the world, enough to help readers of history. Unfortunately, heaven did not grant him a long life; after 46 years, he only completed one-third of the full history.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原为佛家语。指善人死后升入天堂，恶人死后堕入地狱。佛家用以劝善惩恶◇常用以比喻幸竿凄苦两种截然相反的生活境遇。
explanationTraditional: 原為佛家語。指善人死後升入天堂，惡人死後墮入地獄。佛家用以勸善懲惡◇常用以比喻幸竿悽苦兩種截然相反的生活境遇。
explanationEn: Originally a Buddhist term. Refers to good people ascending to heaven after death and evil people descending to hell. Used to encourage good and punish evil. Often used to describe two completely opposite life situations: happiness and misery.
derivation: 《宋书·天竺迦毘黎国传》且要天堂以就善，曷若服义而蹈道；惧地狱以敕身，孰与从理以端心。”
derivationTraditional: 《宋書·天竺迦毘黎國傳》且要天堂以就善，曷若服義而蹈道；懼地獄以敕身，孰與從理以端心。”
derivationEn: From 'Song Shu: Tianzhu Jiapili Guo Zhuan': 'Moreover, to seek heaven for goodness, why not follow righteousness and the Way; to fear hell to discipline oneself, why not follow reason to correct the mind.'
example: ～门相对，任君拣取那边好。★元·无名氏《度柳翠》第二折
exampleTraditional: ～門相對，任君揀取那邊好。★元·無名氏《度柳翠》第二折
exampleEn: Heaven and hell gates face each other; choose whichever you like. — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Du Liuliu', Second Act

explanation: 画笔画；钩钩勒。形容书法刚键柔美。
explanationTraditional: 畫筆畫；鉤鉤勒。形容書法剛鍵柔美。
explanationEn: Describes calligraphy that is both vigorous and graceful.
derivation: 唐·欧阳洵《用笔论》徘徊俯仰，容与风流，刚则铁画，媚若银钩。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·歐陽洵《用筆論》徘徊俯仰，容與風流，剛則鐵畫，媚若銀鉤。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Ouyang Xun's 'Yongbi Lun': 'Pacing and bowing, graceful and flowing, firm like iron strokes, charming like silver hooks.'
example: 银钩铁画石经余，想见先唐字学书。★清·沈曾植《题北宋本广韵四绝》诗
exampleTraditional: 銀鉤鐵畫石經餘，想見先唐字學書。★清·沈曾植《題北宋本廣韻四絕》詩
exampleEn: Silver hooks and iron strokes remain on stone scriptures, recalling the calligraphy of early Tang. — Qing Dynasty, Shen Zengzhi, 'Ti Bei Song Ben Guangyun Si Jue' poem

explanation: 白把希望寄托于空话。指只讲空话，而不实行。
explanationTraditional: 白把希望寄託於空話。指只講空話，而不實行。
explanationEn: To place hopes in empty words. Refers to only talking without acting.
derivation: 《史记·太史公自序》子曰 ‘我欲载之空言，不如见之于行事之深切著明也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·太史公自序》子曰 ‘我欲載之空言，不如見之於行事之深切著明也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Taishigong Zixu': 'Confucius said, 'I would rather express my views through actions than through empty words, which are more profound and clear.''
example: 我在西报上，看见这种议论，也不止一次了，……光景是～罢？★清·李宝嘉《文明小史》第四十六回
exampleTraditional: 我在西報上，看見這種議論，也不止一次了，……光景是～罷？★清·李寶嘉《文明小史》第四十六回
exampleEn: I have seen such discussions in Western newspapers more than once... I'm afraid they are just empty words? — Qing Dynasty, Li Baojia, 'Wenming Xiaoshi', Chapter 46

explanation: 泛指各种疾病和致病因素。
explanationTraditional: 泛指各種疾病和致病因素。
explanationEn: Refers to various diseases and pathogenic factors.
derivation: 元·刘唐卿《降桑椹》第二折糊突虫云'我会医五劳七伤。'”
derivationTraditional: 元·劉唐卿《降桑椹》第二折糊突蟲雲'我會醫五勞七傷。'”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty, Liu Tangqing's 'Jiang Sangchen': 'The muddle-headed insect says, 'I can cure five kinds of fatigue and seven kinds of injuries.''
example: 大同之世，生人最乐，内无～之感，外极饮食、宫室、什器、服用、道路之精。★清·康有为《大同书》甲部第三章
exampleTraditional: 大同之世，生人最樂，內無～之感，外極飲食、宮室、什器、服用、道路之精。★清·康有為《大同書》甲部第三章
exampleEn: In the world of Great Harmony, people are happiest, internally free from the feeling of five fatigues and seven injuries, externally enjoying the finest food, housing, utensils, clothing, and roads. — Qing Dynasty, Kang Youwei, 'Datong Shu', Part A, Chapter 3

explanation: 为了国家的利益而作一定的让步。
explanationTraditional: 為了國家的利益而作一定的讓步。
explanationEn: To make certain concessions for the sake of the country's interests.
derivation: 《左传·昭公元年》鲁以相忍为国也，忍其外不忍其内，焉用之。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·昭公元年》魯以相忍為國也，忍其外不忍其內，焉用之。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Zhao Gong First Year': 'Lu endures for the country, enduring external but not internal, how can it be used?'
example: 我们除向国民党提出抗议和善后条件外，仍然～。★毛泽东《评国民党十一中全会和三届二次国民参政会》
exampleTraditional: 我們除向國民黨提出抗議和善後條件外，仍然～。★毛澤東《評國民黨十一中全會和三屆二次國民參政會》
exampleEn: Besides lodging protests and demanding compensation from the Kuomintang, we still endure for the country. — Mao Zedong, 'Comment on the Kuomintang's Eleventh Plenary Session and the Third People's Political Council'

explanation: 斩首悬示于众。
explanationTraditional: 斬首懸示於眾。
explanationEn: To behead someone and display the head publicly as a warning.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 交关相关。形容关系重大，非常紧要。
explanationTraditional: 交關相關。形容關係重大，非常緊要。
explanationEn: Of vital importance; a matter of life and death.
derivation: 清·张春帆《宦海》第十一回这个性命交关的事情，不是可以试得的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·張春帆《宦海》第十一回這個性命交關的事情，不是可以試得的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zhang Chunfan's 'The Sea of Officialdom', Chapter 11: 'This matter of life and death cannot be tested.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻在别人急需时给以物质上或精神上的帮助。同雪中送炭”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻在別人急需時給以物質上或精神上的幫助。同雪中送炭”。
explanationEn: To provide material or spiritual help when someone is in urgent need; same as '雪中送炭'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧指文人写作或朗诵以风月等自然景色为题材的作品。现多形容作品空虚无聊。
explanationTraditional: 舊指文人寫作或朗誦以風月等自然景色為題材的作品。現多形容作品空虛無聊。
explanationEn: Refers to literati writing or reciting works themed on natural scenery like wind and moon; now often describes works that are empty and boring.
derivation: 唐·范传正《李翰林白墓志铭》吟咏风月，席天幕地，但贵其适所以适，不知夫所以然而然。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·範傳正《李翰林白墓誌銘》吟詠風月，席天幕地，但貴其適所以適，不知夫所以然而然。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Fan Chuanzheng's 'Epitaph of Li Bai': 'Chanting about wind and moon, with the sky as a curtain and the earth as a mat...'
example: 于是曹雪芹平静地说绣春，你别以为我们诗社里，都是～，无病呻吟。”★高阳《曹雪芹别传》
exampleTraditional: 於是曹雪芹平靜地說繡春，你別以為我們詩社裡，都是～，無病呻吟。”★高陽《曹雪芹別傳》
exampleEn: Then Cao Xueqin said calmly, 'Xiuchun, don't think that in our poetry society we are all chanting about wind and moon and moaning without being ill.' — Gao Yang's 'Biography of Cao Xueqin'

explanation: 形容幽静美好的夜晚。
explanationTraditional: 形容幽靜美好的夜晚。
explanationEn: Describes a quiet and beautiful night.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《后赤壁赋》有客无酒，有酒无肴，月白风清，如此良夜何？”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《後赤壁賦》有客無酒，有酒無餚，月白風清，如此良夜何？”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Shi's 'Second Ode to the Red Cliff': 'We have guests but no wine, we have wine but no food. The moon is bright and the wind is clear—how can we spend such a fine night?'
example: 是夜～，水天共碧，二人正在僧房里，睡至半夜，忽听得江上潮声雷响。（明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第一百十九回）
exampleTraditional: 是夜～，水天共碧，二人正在僧房裡，睡至半夜，忽聽得江上潮聲雷響。（明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第一百十九回）
exampleEn: That night the moon was bright and the wind clear, the water and sky were both blue. The two were in the monk's room, sleeping until midnight, when they suddenly heard the sound of thunder from the river tide. — Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 119

explanation: 月晕月亮周围出现的光环。月亮出现光环，就是要刮风的征候。比喻见到一点迹象就能知道它的发展趋向。
explanationTraditional: 月暈月亮周圍出現的光環。月亮出現光環，就是要颳風的徵候。比喻見到一點跡象就能知道它的發展趨向。
explanationEn: A halo around the moon indicates that wind is coming; metaphorically, seeing a sign can predict the development trend.
derivation: 宋·苏洵《辨奸论》月晕而风，础润而雨，人人知之。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇洵《辨姦論》月暈而風，礎潤而雨，人人知之。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Su Xun's 'On Recognizing Treachery': 'A halo around the moon foretells wind, a damp foundation foretells rain—everyone knows this.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 修整陈旧的、破损的东西，使之如同新的一样。
explanationTraditional: 修整陳舊的、破損的東西，使之如同新的一樣。
explanationEn: To repair old or damaged items so they look like new.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第六十三回行者却将芝草把十三层塔层层扫过……这才是整旧如新，霞光万道，瑞气千条，依然八方共睹，四国同瞻。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第六十三回行者卻將芝草把十三層塔層層掃過……這才是整舊如新，霞光萬道，瑞氣千條，依然八方共睹，四國同瞻。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West', Chapter 63: 'The Pilgrim swept the thirteen-story pagoda layer by layer with the magic grass... This is truly making the old like new, with rays of light and thousands of auspicious clouds, still seen by all directions and admired by all nations.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容速度极快。多指马飞速奔驰。同追风逐电”。
explanationTraditional: 形容速度極快。多指馬飛速奔馳。同追風逐電”。
explanationEn: Describes extremely fast speed, mostly referring to a galloping horse; same as '追风逐电'.
derivation: 唐·杨炯《后周明威将军梁公神道碑》励衔策而追风逐日，加剪拂则绝电奔星。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·楊炯《後周明威將軍梁公神道碑》勵銜策而追風逐日，加剪拂則絕電奔星。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Yang Jiong's 'Epitaph of General Liang': 'Spurring the horse to chase the wind and pursue the sun, with a flick it outruns lightning and shooting stars.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人数众多、威武雄壮的军队。同百万雄师”。
explanationTraditional: 人數眾多、威武雄壯的軍隊。同百萬雄師”。
explanationEn: A large and mighty army; same as '百万雄师'.
derivation: 宋·赵葵《南乡子》词束发领西藩。百万雄兵掌握间，召到庙堂无一事，遭弹。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·趙葵《南鄉子》詞束髮領西藩。百萬雄兵掌握間，召到廟堂無一事，遭彈。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Zhao Kui's poem 'Song of the Southern Countryside': 'I tied my hair and led the western frontier. A million brave soldiers were under my command. Summoned to the court with nothing to do, I was impeached.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容品质恶劣，导心不正，言行肮脏。
explanationTraditional: 形容品質惡劣，導心不正，言行骯髒。
explanationEn: Describes despicable character, improper intentions, and dirty behavior.
derivation: 郭沫若《郑成功》第五章他们里面的坏人，的确是天地间最坏的东西。背信弃义，杀人放火，横抢武夺，卑鄙龌龊，什么都干得出来。”
derivationTraditional: 郭沫若《鄭成功》第五章他們裡面的壞人，的確是天地間最壞的東西。背信棄義，殺人放火，橫搶武奪，卑鄙齷齪，什麼都幹得出來。”
derivationEn: From Guo Moruo's 'Zheng Chenggong', Chapter 5: 'The bad guys among them are indeed the worst in the world. They break faith, commit murder and arson, rob and plunder, and do all kinds of despicable and dirty things.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鼻子发青，眼睛肿起。形容脸部伤势严重。亦比喻遭受严重打击、挫折的狼狈相。
explanationTraditional: 鼻子發青，眼睛腫起。形容臉部傷勢嚴重。亦比喻遭受嚴重打擊、挫折的狼狽相。
explanationEn: Black and blue nose and swollen eyes; describes severe facial injuries. Also metaphorically refers to a miserable state after suffering a heavy blow or setback.
derivation: 《醒世姻缘传》第三五回众人齐上，把一个德行之儒做下了个胯下之客，打得鼻青眼肿。”
derivationTraditional: 《醒世姻緣傳》第三五回眾人齊上，把一個德行之儒做下了個胯下之客，打得鼻青眼腫。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of a Marriage That Awakens the World' Chapter 35: 'The crowd attacked together, turning a virtuous scholar into a humiliated man, beaten black and blue.'
example: 现在蒋介石在其他各战场，碰得～。★杜鹏程《保卫延安》第二章
exampleTraditional: 現在蔣介石在其他各戰場，碰得～。★杜鵬程《保衛延安》第二章
exampleEn: Now Chiang Kai-shek, on other battlefields, has been battered black and blue. ★ Du Pengcheng, 'Defending Yan'an' Chapter 2

explanation: 广泛采纳群众的建议。
explanationTraditional: 廣泛採納群眾的建議。
explanationEn: To widely adopt the opinions of the masses.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·孙登传》臣闻为政听民，律令与时推移，诚宜与将相大臣详择时宜，博采众议，宽刑轻赋，均息力役，以顺民望。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·孫登傳》臣聞為政聽民，律令與時推移，誠宜與將相大臣詳擇時宜，博採眾議，寬刑輕賦，均息力役，以順民望。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Biography of Sun Deng': 'I have heard that governance should listen to the people, and laws should change with the times. It is fitting to consult with ministers and generals, carefully choose what is timely, widely adopt opinions, relax punishments, reduce taxes, and balance labor to follow the people's hopes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不能适应移居地方的气候和饮食习惯。
explanationTraditional: 不能適應移居地方的氣候和飲食習慣。
explanationEn: Unable to adapt to the climate and dietary habits of a new place.
derivation: 《三国志·吴志·周瑜传》不习水土，必生疾病。”《宋书·索虏传》道理来远，或不服水土，药自可疗。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·吳志·周瑜傳》不習水土，必生疾病。”《宋書·索虜傳》道理來遠，或不服水土，藥自可療。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms: Wu Shu: Biography of Zhou Yu': 'Not accustomed to the local conditions, they will surely fall ill.' And from 'Book of Song: Biography of Suo Lu': 'Having traveled far, they may not adapt to the climate; medicine can cure them.'
example: 吾兵久劳于外，～，必生疾病。宜召军还，再作后图。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一二０回
exampleTraditional: 吾兵久勞於外，～，必生疾病。宜召軍還，再作後圖。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一二０回
exampleEn: Our troops have long been fatigued abroad and are not acclimated; they will surely fall ill. We should recall the army and plan again. ★ Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 120

explanation: 胜尽；计计算。不能全部计算完。形容数量极多。
explanationTraditional: 勝盡；計計算。不能全部計算完。形容數量極多。
explanationEn: Cannot be fully counted; describes an extremely large number.
derivation: 《战国策·韩策一》秦带甲百余万，车千乘，骑万匹，虎挚之士，踭跔科头，贯颐奋戟者，至不可胜计也。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·韓策一》秦帶甲百餘萬，車千乘，騎萬匹，虎摯之士，踭跔科頭，貫頤奮戟者，至不可勝計也。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States: Strategy of Han I': 'The Qin army has over a million soldiers, a thousand chariots, ten thousand cavalry, and fierce warriors who are too numerous to count.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 锋芒比喻锐气或才干。不显露出锐气或才干。多指有意地将自己的才能、抱负等加以掩饰。
explanationTraditional: 鋒芒比喻銳氣或才幹。不顯露出銳氣或才幹。多指有意地將自己的才能、抱負等加以掩飾。
explanationEn: Not revealing one's sharpness or talent; deliberately concealing one's abilities or ambitions.
derivation: 宋·沈括《梦溪笔谈·补笔谈》（寇准）能断大事，不拘小节；有干将器，不露锋芒。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·沈括《夢溪筆談·補筆談》（寇準）能斷大事，不拘小節；有干將器，不露鋒芒。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shen Kuo's 'Dream Pool Essays: Supplementary': 'Kou Zhun could decide major matters, not bound by trivialities; he had the quality of a fine sword but did not show its edge.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 表示以不贪为可贵、崇高，也表示廉洁奉公。
explanationTraditional: 表示以不貪為可貴、崇高，也表示廉潔奉公。
explanationEn: To regard not being greedy as a precious virtue; signifies incorruptibility and noble character.
derivation: 《左传.襄公十五年》，我以不贪为宝，尔以玉为宝，若以与我，皆丧宝也。
derivationTraditional: 《左傳.襄公十五年》，我以不貪為寶，爾以玉為寶，若以與我，皆喪寶也。
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: Duke Xiang Year 15': 'I consider not being greedy as a treasure; you consider jade as a treasure. If you give it to me, we both lose our treasures.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指吃剩的饭菜。也比喻别人施舍的东西。
explanationTraditional: 指吃剩的飯菜。也比喻別人施捨的東西。
explanationEn: Leftover soup and rice; also metaphorically refers to something given as charity.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《蝴蝶梦》第三折我三个孩儿都下在死牢中，我叫化了些残汤剩饭，送与孩儿每吃去。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《蝴蝶夢》第三折我三個孩兒都下在死牢中，我叫化了些殘湯剩飯，送與孩兒每吃去。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Guan Hanqing's 'Butterfly Dream' Act 3: 'My three children are all in death row; I have begged some leftover soup and rice to send to them.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 陈旧；因沿袭。原指皇仓之粮逐年增加，陈粮上压陈粮◇多比喻沿袭老一套，无创造革新。
explanationTraditional: 陳舊；因沿襲。原指皇倉之糧逐年增加，陳糧上壓陳糧◇多比喻沿襲老一套，無創造革新。
explanationEn: Originally meant grain in the imperial granary piling up year after year; now metaphorically refers to following old routines without innovation.
derivation: 《史记·平准书》太仓之粟，陈陈相因，充溢露积于外，至腐败不可食。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·平準書》太倉之粟，陳陳相因，充溢露積於外，至腐敗不可食。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Treatise on the Balanced Standard': 'The grain in the Taicang granary piled up layer upon layer, overflowing and rotting, until it was inedible.'
example: 而儒者又疏阔，其言庸迂，～。★清·恽敬《上陈笠帆按察书》
exampleTraditional: 而儒者又疏闊，其言庸迂，～。★清·惲敬《上陳笠帆按察書》
exampleEn: And the Confucians are impractical, their words mediocre and outdated, following old patterns. ★ Qing Dynasty Yun Jing, 'Letter to Chen Lifan'

explanation: 急促的呼吸还没有平稳下来。指还没有休息、恢复的时间。喘息呼吸急促。
explanationTraditional: 急促的呼吸還沒有平穩下來。指還沒有休息、恢復的時間。喘息呼吸急促。
explanationEn: Breathing has not yet calmed down; indicates no time to rest or recover.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒传》七十七回方才进步，喘息未定，只见前面尘起，叫杀连天。”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸傳》七十七回方才進步，喘息未定，只見前面塵起，叫殺連天。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 77: 'Just as they advanced, before their breath settled, dust rose ahead and shouts of killing filled the sky.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 拱、揖两手合抱致敬。弯身报拳行礼。表示恭敬顺从或恳求的样子。
explanationTraditional: 拱、揖兩手合抱致敬。彎身報拳行禮。表示恭敬順從或懇求的樣子。
explanationEn: To bow with hands clasped; to make a deep bow as a gesture of respect, obedience, or entreaty.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十七回宝玉见他这样，还认作是昨日晌午的事，那知晚间的这件公案，还打躬作揖的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十七回寶玉見他這樣，還認作是昨日晌午的事，那知晚間的這件公案，還打躬作揖的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 27: 'Baoyu saw her like this and thought it was about the noon incident, unaware of the evening affair, so he bowed and scraped.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指冬去春来，草木萌生，大地上出现一片生机景象。有时亦用比喻形势好转。
explanationTraditional: 指冬去春來，草木萌生，大地上出現一片生機景象。有時亦用比喻形勢好轉。
explanationEn: Spring returns to the earth; a revival of life and vitality after winter, also used metaphorically for improvement in a situation.
derivation: 罗广斌、杨益言《红岩》第十六章楼三室的对联，引用了古人的诗句‘满园春色关不住，一枝红杏出墙头。’横额是‘大地春回’。”
derivationTraditional: 羅廣斌、楊益言《紅巖》第十六章樓三室的對聯，引用了古人的詩句‘滿園春色關不住，一枝紅杏出牆頭。’橫額是‘大地春回’。”
derivationEn: From Luo Guangbin and Yang Yiyan's 'Red Rock', Chapter 16, quoting ancient poem 'The garden full of spring color cannot be confined; a branch of red apricot blossoms leans out of the wall.' The horizontal scroll reads 'Spring returns to the earth.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 风凉爽，月明亮。
explanationTraditional: 風涼爽，月明亮。
explanationEn: Cool breeze and bright moonlight; describing a clear and pleasant night.
derivation: 唐·段成式《酉阳杂俎·支诺皋下》时春季夜间，风清月朗。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·段成式《酉陽雜俎·支諾皋下》時春季夜間，風清月朗。”
derivationEn: From Duan Chengshi's 'Youyang Zazu' of Tang Dynasty: 'In spring at night, the breeze is cool and the moon bright.'
example: 西方极乐真幽境，～天籁定。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第七十九回
exampleTraditional: 西方極樂真幽境，～天籟定。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第七十九回
exampleEn: The Western Paradise is truly a secluded place, with cool breeze and bright moonlight, the sounds of nature are still. — Ming Dynasty, Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 79

explanation: 指意志不为金钱和地位所迷惑。同富贵不能淫”。
explanationTraditional: 指意志不為金錢和地位所迷惑。同富貴不能淫”。
explanationEn: Not corrupted by wealth and rank; remaining steadfast in one's principles despite riches and honors.
derivation: 清·方亨咸《邵村杂记·武风子传》或曰其有道者欤？不然，何富贵不淫，威武不屈耶？”
derivationTraditional: 清·方亨鹹《邵村雜記·武風子傳》或曰其有道者歟？不然，何富貴不淫，威武不屈耶？”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty, Fang Hengxian's 'Shaocun Miscellany: Biography of Wu Fengzi': 'Some say he is a man of the Way; otherwise, how could he not be corrupted by wealth and rank, nor subdued by power?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指官员之间互相包庇。同官官相护”。
explanationTraditional: 指官員之間互相包庇。同官官相護”。
explanationEn: Officials shield one another; mutual protection among officials.
derivation: 赵树理《李有才板话》七老秦觉着这一下不只惹了祸，又连累了邻居。他以为自古‘官官相卫’，老杨同志要是回到村公所一说，马上就不得了。”
derivationTraditional: 趙樹理《李有才板話》七老秦覺著這一下不只惹了禍，又連累了鄰居。他以為自古‘官官相衛’，老楊同志要是回到村公所一說，馬上就不得了。”
derivationEn: From Zhao Shuli's 'The Story of Li Youcai', Part 7: 'Old Qin felt that this time he had not only caused trouble but also implicated his neighbors. He thought that since ancient times, officials shield one another, and if Comrade Old Yang reported it to the village office, it would be disastrous immediately.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鬼话不真实的话。连篇一篇接一篇。满口说的全是蒙骗人的胡言乱语。
explanationTraditional: 鬼話不真實的話。連篇一篇接一篇。滿口說的全是矇騙人的胡言亂語。
explanationEn: A pack of lies; a series of deceitful or nonsense statements.
derivation: 蔡东藩《前汉演义》第四回鬼话连篇，捏造出许多洞府，许多法术。”
derivationTraditional: 蔡東藩《前漢演義》第四回鬼話連篇，捏造出許多洞府，許多法術。”
derivationEn: From Cai Dongfan's 'Annals of the Former Han', Chapter 4: 'A pack of lies, fabricating many caves and many spells.'
example: 他最爱瞎掰，经常～。
exampleTraditional: 他最愛瞎掰，經常～。
exampleEn: He loves to talk nonsense, often spouting a pack of lies.

explanation: 指中秋前后桂花开放，散发馨香。
explanationTraditional: 指中秋前後桂花開放，散發馨香。
explanationEn: The fragrance of osmanthus flowers wafting; referring to the blooming of osmanthus around Mid-Autumn Festival.
derivation: 唐·宋之问《灵隐寺》诗桂子月中落，天香云外飘。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·宋之問《靈隱寺》詩桂子月中落，天香雲外飄。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty, Song Zhiwen's poem 'Lingyin Temple': 'Osmanthus seeds fall from the moon, heavenly fragrance wafts beyond the clouds.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 好生爱惜生灵。指有爱惜生灵，不事杀戮的品德。
explanationTraditional: 好生愛惜生靈。指有愛惜生靈，不事殺戮的品德。
explanationEn: The virtue of cherishing life; the quality of loving and preserving life, refraining from killing.
derivation: 《尚书·大禹谟》与其杀不辜，宁失不经，好生之德，洽于民心。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·大禹謨》與其殺不辜，寧失不經，好生之德，洽於民心。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents: Counsels of the Great Yu': 'Rather than kill an innocent person, it is better to let the guilty go unpunished. The virtue of cherishing life reaches the people's hearts.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指话中包含着讥笑和讽刺。同话中带刺”。
explanationTraditional: 指話中包含著譏笑和諷刺。同話中帶刺”。
explanationEn: Words with a sting; speech containing sarcasm or veiled insults.
derivation: 范乃仲《小技术员战服神仙手》升级一听，话里带刺，来者不善。”
derivationTraditional: 範乃仲《小技術員戰服神仙手》升級一聽，話裡帶刺，來者不善。”
derivationEn: From Fan Naizhong's 'Little Technician Defeats the Immortal Hand': 'Upon hearing this, Shengji sensed that the words had a sting, and the newcomer was not friendly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指官场生涯曲折复杂，变化不定。
explanationTraditional: 指官場生涯曲折複雜，變化不定。
explanationEn: The ups and downs of officialdom; the vicissitudes of a bureaucratic career.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 好象是在梦里一样。
explanationTraditional: 好象是在夢裡一樣。
explanationEn: As if in a dream; feeling like being in a dream.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻饮食得到了满足。
explanationTraditional: 比喻飲食得到了滿足。
explanationEn: Describes being fully satisfied with food and drink.
derivation: 元·杨显之《酷寒亭》我如今且不打你，等我吃得酒醉饭饱了，慢慢的打你。”
derivationTraditional: 元·楊顯之《酷寒亭》我如今且不打你，等我吃得酒醉飯飽了，慢慢的打你。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'The Cool Pavilion' by Yang Xianzhi: 'I won't beat you now, wait until I am drunk and full, then I will beat you slowly.'
example: 其一，不舟不车，不衫不帻，～，呼群三五，跻入人丛。★明·张岱《陶庵梦忆西湖七月半》
exampleTraditional: 其一，不舟不車，不衫不幘，～，呼群三五，躋入人叢。★明·張岱《陶庵夢憶西湖七月半》
exampleEn: One group, neither by boat nor by carriage, without shirt or headdress, drunk and full, calling a few companions, mingling into the crowd. — Ming Dynasty, Zhang Dai, 'Tao'an Dream Memories: West Lake on Mid-July'

explanation: 举措举动，措置。指行动措施不得当。
explanationTraditional: 舉措舉動，措置。指行動措施不得當。
explanationEn: Refers to actions or measures that are inappropriate or improper.
derivation: 《管子·禁藏》举措不当，众民不能成。”
derivationTraditional: 《管子·禁藏》舉措不當，眾民不能成。”
derivationEn: From 'Guanzi: Prohibitions and Storage': 'If measures are improper, the masses cannot succeed.'
example: 敌军调动忙乱，～，两队优劣之势，也就不同于前了。★毛泽东《中国革命战争的战略问题》
exampleTraditional: 敵軍調動忙亂，～，兩隊優劣之勢，也就不同於前了。★毛澤東《中國革命戰爭的戰略問題》
exampleEn: The enemy's troop movements are chaotic and their measures are improper, so the balance of advantage between the two sides is different from before. — Mao Zedong, 'Problems of Strategy in China's Revolutionary War'

explanation: 和尚静坐，使心定于一处，不起杂念，叫入定。形容人静静地端坐着。
explanationTraditional: 和尚靜坐，使心定於一處，不起雜念，叫入定。形容人靜靜地端坐著。
explanationEn: Describes a person sitting quietly and still, like an old monk in deep meditation.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第二十回看时，却是个黑瘦老者，危然端坐，彷彿老僧入定一样。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第二十回看時，卻是個黑瘦老者，危然端坐，彷彿老僧入定一樣。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty novel 'Flower in the Sea of Sins' by Zeng Pu, Chapter 20: 'Looking, it was a thin, dark old man sitting upright, just like an old monk in meditation.'
example: 华池置无用之乡，谬说～；蛮洞乃不毛之地，遂使眇帅称戈。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·黄九郎》
exampleTraditional: 華池置無用之鄉，謬說～；蠻洞乃不毛之地，遂使眇帥稱戈。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·黃九郎》
exampleEn: The Huachi pool is placed in a useless place, absurdly speaking of an old monk in meditation; the barbarian cave is a barren land, thus making the one-eyed commander raise his spear. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Huang Jiulang'

explanation: 愉快地从事自己的职业，过着安定的生活。形容生活、生产、思想状况安定正常。
explanationTraditional: 愉快地從事自己的職業，過著安定的生活。形容生活、生產、思想狀況安定正常。
explanationEn: Describes people happily engaged in their occupations and living stable lives; a state of social stability and normalcy.
derivation: 元·无名氏《延安府》第一折见如今四海无虞，八方黎庶皆丰富，乐业安居。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《延安府》第一折見如今四海無虞，八方黎庶皆豐富，樂業安居。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty play 'Yan'an Prefecture' by Anonymous, Act 1: 'Now the world is peaceful, all people are prosperous, happy in their work and content in their homes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 分离前后惜别、相思的愁苦情绪。
explanationTraditional: 分離前後惜別、相思的愁苦情緒。
explanationEn: The sorrowful feelings of parting and longing before and after separation.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《梁州令》离情别恨多少，条条结向垂杨缕。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《梁州令》離情別恨多少，條條結向垂楊縷。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty, Ouyang Xiu's poem 'Liangzhou Ling': 'How many parting feelings and regrets, all tied to the drooping willow twigs.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容感情激动或害羞的样子。同脸红耳赤”。
explanationTraditional: 形容感情激動或害羞的樣子。同臉紅耳赤”。
explanationEn: Describes a flushed face and hot ears due to emotional excitement or shyness. Same as 'red-faced and hot-eared'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 量估量。根据才能大小分配一定工作。
explanationTraditional: 量估量。根據才能大小分配一定工作。
explanationEn: To assign a job according to one's abilities.
derivation: 《礼记·王制》凡官民材必先论之，论辨然后使之。”宋·苏轼《上神守皇帝万言书》凡所擘画利害，不问何人，小则随事酬劳，大则量才录用。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·王制》凡官民材必先論之，論辨然後使之。”宋·蘇軾《上神守皇帝萬言書》凡所擘畫利害，不問何人，小則隨事酬勞，大則量才錄用。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Royal Regulations': 'When appointing officials and employing talents, one must first evaluate them.' Also from Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Letter to Emperor Shenzong': 'For all planning of benefits and harms, regardless of who, small matters are rewarded accordingly, large matters are employed according to talent.'
example: 凡愿继续服务者，在人民政府接管后，准予～。★毛泽东《中国人民解放军布告》
exampleTraditional: 凡願繼續服務者，在人民政府接管後，准予～。★毛澤東《中國人民解放軍佈告》
exampleEn: Those who wish to continue serving, after the People's Government takes over, will be employed according to their abilities. — Mao Zedong, 'Proclamation of the People's Liberation Army'

explanation: 形容因饥饿而显得营养不良的样子。
explanationTraditional: 形容因飢餓而顯得營養不良的樣子。
explanationEn: Describes a malnourished appearance due to hunger.
derivation: 《礼记·王制》虽有凶旱水溢，民无菜色。”《荀子·富国》故禹十年水，汤七年旱，而天下无菜色者。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·王制》雖有兇旱水溢，民無菜色。”《荀子·富國》故禹十年水，湯七年旱，而天下無菜色者。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Royal Regulations': 'Even in years of drought and flood, the people have no hungry look.' Also from 'Xunzi: Enriching the State': 'Thus, even with ten years of flood under Yu and seven years of drought under Tang, the people had no hungry look.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 畏惧怕。人民不怕死。形容不怕死的气慨。
explanationTraditional: 畏懼怕。人民不怕死。形容不怕死的氣慨。
explanationEn: The people are not afraid of death; describes a fearless spirit.
derivation: 《老子》第七十四章民不畏死，奈何以死惧之。”
derivationTraditional: 《老子》第七十四章民不畏死，奈何以死懼之。”
derivationEn: From 'Laozi', Chapter 74: 'If the people are not afraid of death, how can death be used to threaten them?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 脂、膏脂肪。比喻人民用血汗换来的财富。多用于指反动统治阶级压榨人民来养肥自己的场合。
explanationTraditional: 脂、膏脂肪。比喻人民用血汗換來的財富。多用於指反動統治階級壓榨人民來養肥自己的場合。
explanationEn: Metaphor for the wealth obtained by the people through hard work; often used to criticize ruling classes for exploiting the people.
derivation: 五代·后蜀·孟昶《戒石文》尔俸尔禄，民膏民脂。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·後蜀·孟昶《戒石文》爾俸爾祿，民膏民脂。”
derivationEn: From Five Dynasties, Later Shu, Meng Chang's 'Admonition on Stone': 'Your salary and emolument are the people's fat and grease.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 迁客被贬谪到外地的官吏；骚人诗人。贬黜流放的官吏，多愁善感的诗人。泛指忧愁失意的文人。
explanationTraditional: 遷客被貶謫到外地的官吏；騷人詩人。貶黜流放的官吏，多愁善感的詩人。泛指憂愁失意的文人。
explanationEn: Refers to demoted officials and sentimental poets; generally describes frustrated and melancholy literati.
derivation: 宋·范仲淹《岳阳楼记》迁客骚人，多会于此。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·范仲淹《岳陽樓記》遷客騷人，多會於此。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Fan Zhongyan's 'Record of Yueyang Tower': 'Demoted officials and poets often gather here.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 清美新颖，不落俗套。
explanationTraditional: 清美新穎，不落俗套。
explanationEn: Fresh, novel, and elegant; not conforming to conventional styles.
derivation: 唐·杜甫《春日忆李白》诗清新庾开府，俊逸鲍参军。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜甫《春日憶李白》詩清新庾開府，俊逸鮑參軍。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Du Fu's 'Thinking of Li Bai on a Spring Day': 'Fresh like Yu Xin, elegant like Bao Zhao.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 人在呼喊，马在嘶鸣。形容一片喧闹声。
explanationTraditional: 人在呼喊，馬在嘶鳴。形容一片喧鬧聲。
explanationEn: People shouting and horses neighing; describes a noisy and bustling scene.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷十四只听得外面喧嚷，似有人喊马嘶之声，渐渐近前堂来了。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷十四隻聽得外面喧嚷，似有人喊馬嘶之聲，漸漸近前堂來了。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 14': 'Heard a clamor outside, like people shouting and horses neighing, gradually approaching the front hall.'
example: 田野上～，一片丰收的景象。
exampleTraditional: 田野上～，一片豐收的景象。
exampleEn: In the fields, people are cheering and horses are neighing, a scene of abundant harvest.

explanation: 指城市中游手好闲、品行不端的人。
explanationTraditional: 指城市中游手好閒、品行不端的人。
explanationEn: Refers to idlers and miscreants in cities who are dishonest and ill-behaved.
derivation: 宋·胡铨《戊午上高宗封事》王伦本一狎邪小人，市井无赖。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·胡銓《戊午上高宗封事》王倫本一狎邪小人，市井無賴。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Hu Quan's 'Memorial to Emperor Gaozong in the Wuwu Year': 'Wang Lun is originally a frivolous villain, a street rogue.'
example: 懒龙道‘小人是～，既蒙相公青目，要干何事，小人水火不避。’★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案惊奇》卷三十九
exampleTraditional: 懶龍道‘小人是～，既蒙相公青目，要幹何事，小人水火不避。’★明·凌濛初《二刻拍案驚奇》卷三十九
exampleEn: Lan Long said, 'I am a street rogue. Since you, sir, have taken notice, whatever task you assign, I will face fire and water without flinching.' — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement, Volume 39'

explanation: 形容畏缩不前，或胆小不敢出头。
explanationTraditional: 形容畏縮不前，或膽小不敢出頭。
explanationEn: Describes shrinking back in fear or being timid and afraid to take the lead.
derivation: 鲁迅《华盖集·碰壁之后》但是我也说明了几句我所以来校的理由，并要求学校当局今天缩头缩脑办法的解答。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《華蓋集·碰壁之後》但是我也說明了幾句我所以來校的理由，並要求學校當局今天縮頭縮腦辦法的解答。”
derivationEn: Lu Xun's 'Huagai Collection: After Bumping into a Wall': 'But I also explained a few reasons for coming to the school and demanded the school authorities to explain their timid approach today.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容受压抑的心情得以舒展而感到快意。
explanationTraditional: 形容受壓抑的心情得以舒展而感到快意。
explanationEn: Describes the feeling of relief and elation after being released from oppression.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 威名传于全国，震惊世上。
explanationTraditional: 威名傳於全國，震驚世上。
explanationEn: Fame spreads across the nation, shocking the world.
derivation: 汉·桓宽《盐铁论·非鞅》蒙恬却胡千里，非无功也，威震天下，非不强也。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·桓寬《鹽鐵論·非鞅》蒙恬卻胡千里，非無功也，威震天下，非不強也。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Huan Kuan's 'Discourses on Salt and Iron: Against Shang Yang': 'Meng Tian drove the Xiongnu back a thousand li, not without merit; his might shook the world, not without strength.'
example: 发金作冶，制为铠甲及剑，造立兵仗刀戟大弩等，～。★宋·张君房《云笈七签》卷一百
exampleTraditional: 發金作冶，製為鎧甲及劍，造立兵仗刀戟大弩等，～。★宋·張君房《雲笈七籤》卷一百
exampleEn: He smelted metal to make armor and swords, and manufactured weapons like halberds and crossbows, his might shaking the world. — Song Dynasty, Zhang Junfang's 'Yunji Qiqian, Volume 100'

explanation: 指精纯专一。
explanationTraditional: 指精純專一。
explanationEn: Means being refined and single-minded; focusing on one thing with utmost concentration.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 心里急得象着了火一样。形容非常着急。
explanationTraditional: 心裡急得象著了火一樣。形容非常著急。
explanationEn: Heart burning like fire; describes extreme anxiety or impatience.
derivation: 元·王实甫《西厢记》第一本第四折要看个十分饱。”金圣叹批心急如火，更不能待。”
derivationTraditional: 元·王實甫《西廂記》第一本第四折要看個十分飽。”金聖嘆批心急如火，更不能待。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu's 'The Story of the Western Wing, Act 1, Scene 4': 'I must see her fully.' Jin Shengtan commented: 'Heart burning like fire, cannot wait any longer.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 信真实不欺。有功劳的一定奖赏，有罪过的一定惩罚。形容赏罚严明。
explanationTraditional: 信真實不欺。有功勞的一定獎賞，有罪過的一定懲罰。形容賞罰嚴明。
explanationEn: Reward those who merit it and punish those who deserve it; describes strict and fair enforcement of rewards and punishments.
derivation: 《韩非子·外储说右上》信赏必罚，其足以战。”
derivationTraditional: 《韓非子·外儲說右上》信賞必罰，其足以戰。”
derivationEn: 'Hanfeizi: Outer Congeries of Sayings, Upper Right': 'Reward faithfully and punish surely; this is sufficient for warfare.'
example: 诸葛治蜀，赏信必罚，彭羕、李严，皆纵横之魁杰，故羕诛而严流。★章炳麟《诸子学略说》
exampleTraditional: 諸葛治蜀，賞信必罰，彭羕、李嚴，皆縱橫之魁傑，故羕誅而嚴流。★章炳麟《諸子學略說》
exampleEn: Zhuge Liang governed Shu with faithful rewards and sure punishments. Peng Yang and Li Yan were both outstanding figures, so Peng was executed and Li was exiled. — Zhang Binglin's 'Brief Discussion on Various Schools of Thought'

explanation: 言辞简练，含意深刻。
explanationTraditional: 言辭簡練，含意深刻。
explanationEn: Concise in wording but profound in meaning.
derivation: 清·赵翼《瓯北诗话·陆放翁诗》不在乎奇险诘曲，惊人耳目，而在乎言简意深，一语胜人千百。”
derivationTraditional: 清·趙翼《甌北詩話·陸放翁詩》不在乎奇險詰曲，驚人耳目，而在乎言簡意深，一語勝人千百。”
derivationEn: From Zhao Yi's 'Oubei Poetry Talks: Lu Fangweng's Poems' in the Qing Dynasty: 'It does not lie in oddity and difficulty to astonish people, but in concise words with deep meaning, where one phrase surpasses thousands.'
example: 词语虽然粗俗，笔气极其纵横，而且～，包括不遗。★《三侠五义》第四一回
exampleTraditional: 詞語雖然粗俗，筆氣極其縱橫，而且～，包括不遺。★《三俠五義》第四一回
exampleEn: Although the words are vulgar, the style is extremely bold and free, and it is concise yet profound, covering everything without omission. (From 'Three Heroes and Five Gallants', Chapter 41)

explanation: 指死亡。
explanationTraditional: 指死亡。
explanationEn: To die; to pass away.
derivation: 老舍《四世同堂》不留神？好，噗哧一下儿，我不就一命归西了吗！”
derivationTraditional: 老舍《四世同堂》不留神？好，噗哧一下兒，我不就一命歸西了嗎！”
derivationEn: From Lao She's 'Four Generations Under One Roof': 'If I'm not careful? Well, with a puff, wouldn't I be dead and gone?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 丘土山；壑山沟。原指隐者所居之地◇多用以指寄情山水。
explanationTraditional: 丘土山；壑山溝。原指隱者所居之地◇多用以指寄情山水。
explanationEn: Originally refers to a hermit's dwelling; later used to denote a person who delights in natural scenery.
derivation: 《汉书·叙传上》渔钓于一壑，则万物不奸其志；栖迟于一丘，则天下不易其乐。”南朝宋·刘义庆《世说新语·品藻》端委庙堂，使百官准则，臣不如亮；一丘一壑，自谓过之。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·敘傳上》漁釣於一壑，則萬物不奸其志；棲遲於一丘，則天下不易其樂。”南朝宋·劉義慶《世說新語·品藻》端委廟堂，使百官准則，臣不如亮；一丘一壑，自謂過之。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biographies of the Xu Family': 'Fishing in a valley, nothing in the world can disturb one's will; dwelling on a hill, the world's joys cannot change one's happiness.' Also from Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Grading Personages': 'In court affairs, setting standards for officials, I am not as good as Liang; but in hills and valleys, I consider myself superior.'
example: 兄以～过之，且筑圹于侧，与山缔生死盟。★明·徐宏祖《题小香山梅花堂诗序》
exampleTraditional: 兄以～過之，且築壙於側，與山締生死盟。★明·徐宏祖《題小香山梅花堂詩序》
exampleEn: You surpass me in hills and valleys, and even built a tomb nearby, forming a life-and-death alliance with the mountains. (From Xu Hongzu's 'Preface to Plum Blossom Hall Poems')

explanation: 指一句话可以兴国。
explanationTraditional: 指一句話可以興國。
explanationEn: A single word can make a country prosper.
derivation: 《论语·子路》一言而可以兴邦，有诸？”唐·刘禹鍚《唐故相国李公集纪》古所谓一言兴邦者，信哉！”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·子路》一言而可以興邦，有諸？”唐·劉禹鍚《唐故相國李公集紀》古所謂一言興邦者，信哉！”
derivationEn: From 'The Analects: Zilu': 'Is there a single phrase that can make a country prosper?' Also from Liu Yuxi's 'Records of Prime Minister Li': 'Truly, the ancients said a single word can make a country prosper!'
example: 元礼首议太真、国忠辈，近乎～，宜得此语。★宋·许顗《许彦周诗话》
exampleTraditional: 元禮首議太真、國忠輩，近乎～，宜得此語。★宋·許顗《許彥周詩話》
exampleEn: Yuanli was the first to discuss Tai Zhen and Guo Zhong, which nearly made the country prosper; this saying is fitting. (From Xu Yi's 'Xu Yanzhou Poetry Talks')

explanation: 形容家庭和顺，夫妻和睦。
explanationTraditional: 形容家庭和順，夫妻和睦。
explanationEn: Describes a harmonious family and loving couple.
derivation: 《诗经·周南·桃夭》之子于归，宜其室家。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·周南·桃夭》之子于歸，宜其室家。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Zhou Nan: The Peach Tree': 'When the girl goes to her new home, she will bring harmony to her household.'
example: 有风有化，～。★明·汤显祖《牡丹亭》第七出
exampleTraditional: 有風有化，～。★明·湯顯祖《牡丹亭》第七齣
exampleEn: There is grace and propriety, suitable for the family and home. (From Tang Xianzu's 'The Peony Pavilion', Scene 7)

explanation: 用勤奋补救笨拙，含有自谦之意。
explanationTraditional: 用勤奮補救笨拙，含有自謙之意。
explanationEn: To compensate for lack of skill with diligence; often used self-deprecatingly.
derivation: 隋·李德林《〈霸朝集〉序》心无别虑，笔不暂停。或毕景忘餐，或连宵不寐。以勤补拙，不遑自处。”
derivationTraditional: 隋·李德林《〈霸朝集〉序》心無別慮，筆不暫停。或畢景忘餐，或連宵不寐。以勤補拙，不遑自處。”
derivationEn: From Li Delin's 'Preface to the Collection of the Hegemonic Court' in the Sui Dynasty: 'With no other thoughts, the brush never stops. Sometimes forgetting meals at sunset, sometimes staying up all night. Using diligence to make up for clumsiness, I have no time for leisure.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 英姿英勇威武姿态；焕发光彩四射。形容英俊威武的样子。
explanationTraditional: 英姿英勇威武姿態；煥發光彩四射。形容英俊威武的樣子。
explanationEn: Heroic and spirited; handsome and valiant in appearance.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《念妈娇·赤壁怀古》词遥想公瑾当年，小乔出嫁了，雄姿英发。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《念媽嬌·赤壁懷古》詞遙想公瑾當年，小喬出嫁了，雄姿英發。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Remembering the Past at Red Cliff' (to the tune of Niannujiao): 'I recall Zhou Yu back then, just married to Xiao Qiao, his heroic bearing radiant.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 冠位居第一；三军军队的统称。指勇敢或勇猛是全军第一。
explanationTraditional: 冠位居第一；三軍軍隊的統稱。指勇敢或勇猛是全軍第一。
explanationEn: Bravery that ranks first among the entire army.
derivation: 汉·李陵《答苏武书》陵先将军功略盖天地，义勇冠三军。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·李陵《答蘇武書》陵先將軍功略蓋天地，義勇冠三軍。”
derivationEn: From Li Ling's 'Letter to Su Wu' in the Han Dynasty: 'My late general's achievements and strategies overshadowed heaven and earth, his righteousness and bravery topped the three armies.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容摇摇晃晃，飘浮不定。现多形容不勤奋。
explanationTraditional: 形容搖搖晃晃，飄浮不定。現多形容不勤奮。
explanationEn: Describes swaying, floating, or drifting; now often used to mean not being diligent.
derivation: 《雍熙乐府·卷六·粉蝶儿》则见那梧桐叶儿滴溜溜飘，悠悠荡荡，纷纷扬扬下溪桥。”
derivationTraditional: 《雍熙樂府·卷六·粉蝶兒》則見那梧桐葉兒滴溜溜飄，悠悠盪盪，紛紛揚揚下溪橋。”
derivationEn: From 'Yongxi Yuefu: Volume 6: Fendie'er': 'Then I see the parasol leaves drifting, swaying and floating, scattering over the bridge.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指事情有漏洞可以利用。
explanationTraditional: 指事情有漏洞可以利用。
explanationEn: There is a loophole that can be exploited.
derivation: 《秦并六国平话》卷中万一有隙可乘，如蚌鹬相持，只为渔者之利耳。”宋·楼钥《攻媿集》卷九十五公之有行，请益兵备，机有可乘，虽烹可畏。”
derivationTraditional: 《秦並六國平話》卷中萬一有隙可乘，如蚌鷸相持，只為漁者之利耳。”宋·樓鑰《攻媿集》卷九十五公之有行，請益兵備，機有可乘，雖烹可畏。”
derivationEn: From 'The Pacification of the Six Kingdoms' (Pinghua): 'If there is a gap to exploit, like the snipe and clam contending, it only benefits the fisherman.' Also from Lou Yue's 'Gongkui Ji': 'When you act, request more troops for defense; if there is an opportunity, even if it means death, do not fear.'
example: 今魏～，不就此时伐之，更等何时？（明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百十回）
exampleTraditional: 今魏～，不就此時伐之，更等何時？（明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百十回）
exampleEn: Now Wei has a loophole we can exploit; if we don't attack now, when will we? (From Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 110)

explanation: 月圆则缺。比喻事物发展到极点则开始衰退。
explanationTraditional: 月圓則缺。比喻事物發展到極點則開始衰退。
explanationEn: When the moon is full, it begins to wane. Metaphorically, when things reach their peak, they start to decline.
derivation: 《史记·范雎蔡泽列传》语曰‘日中则移，月满则亏’。物盛则衰，天地之常数也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·范雎蔡澤列傳》語曰‘日中則移，月滿則虧’。物盛則衰，天地之常數也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Fan Ju and Cai Ze': 'The sun reaches its zenith then moves, the moon becomes full then wanes. When things flourish, they decline; this is the constant law of heaven and earth.'
example: 你如何连两句俗语也不晓得？常言‘～，水满则溢。’又道是‘登高必跌重。’★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第十三回
exampleTraditional: 你如何連兩句俗語也不曉得？常言‘～，水滿則溢。’又道是‘登高必跌重。’★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第十三回
exampleEn: How can you not know even two common sayings? As the saying goes, 'When the moon is full, it wanes; when water is full, it overflows.' And also, 'The higher the climb, the harder the fall.' — Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 13

explanation: 憎恨∞什么，爱什么，界限清楚，态度鲜明。
explanationTraditional: 憎恨∞什麼，愛什麼，界限清楚，態度鮮明。
explanationEn: Clear distinction between what to hate and what to love; clear-cut attitude.
derivation: 周恩来《向雷锋同志学习》题词憎爱分明的阶级立场，言行一致的革命精神，公而忘私的共产主义风格，奋不顾身的无产阶级斗志。”
derivationTraditional: 周恩來《向雷鋒同志學習》題詞憎愛分明的階級立場，言行一致的革命精神，公而忘私的共產主義風格，奮不顧身的無產階級鬥志。”
derivationEn: From Zhou Enlai's inscription 'Learn from Comrade Lei Feng': 'Clear-cut class stand of hatred and love, revolutionary spirit of consistency between words and deeds, communist style of selflessness, and proletarian fighting spirit of fearing no sacrifice.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻本来想害别人，结果害了自己。
explanationTraditional: 比喻本來想害別人，結果害了自己。
explanationEn: Lifting a rock only to drop it on one's own feet. Metaphorically, intending to harm others but ending up harming oneself.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 刘婉蓉道我说了怕你赌气，拂袖而去，那岂不自己～，得不偿失。”★卧龙生《镖旗》第二十六回
exampleTraditional: 劉婉蓉道我說了怕你賭氣，拂袖而去，那豈不自己～，得不償失。”★臥龍生《鏢旗》第二十六回
exampleEn: Liu Wanrong said, 'I was afraid you would be angry and leave, which would be like lifting a rock to drop on your own feet, gaining nothing.' — Wolong Sheng, 'Banner', Chapter 26

explanation: 把著作藏在名山传给志趣相投的人。形容著作极有价值。
explanationTraditional: 把著作藏在名山傳給志趣相投的人。形容著作極有價值。
explanationEn: To hide one's writings in a famous mountain to pass them to like-minded people. Describes works of great value.
derivation: 三国·魏·鱼豢《魏略》虽未能藏之名山，将以传之同好。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·魚豢《魏略》雖未能藏之名山，將以傳之同好。”
derivationEn: From Wei Dynasty, Yu Huan's 'Brief History of Wei': 'Although it may not be hidden in a famous mountain, it will be passed to those of similar interests.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 发落处分，处置。指处罚从宽，轻予放过。
explanationTraditional: 發落處分，處置。指處罰從寬，輕予放過。
explanationEn: To deal with leniently; to impose a light punishment.
derivation: 明·李贽《与周友山书》想仲尼不为已甚，诸公遵守孔门家法，决知从宽发落、许其改过自新无疑。”
derivationTraditional: 明·李贄《與周友山書》想仲尼不為已甚，諸公遵守孔門家法，決知從寬發落、許其改過自新無疑。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty, Li Zhi's 'Letter to Zhou Youshan': 'I think Confucius was not excessive; you gentlemen follow the Confucian family rules and surely know to deal leniently and allow reform.'
example: 蔡公先问罗公起居，然后说到就是仁寿二年皂角林那桩事，我也～。★清·禇人获《隋唐演义》第十四回
exampleTraditional: 蔡公先問羅公起居，然後說到就是仁壽二年皂角林那樁事，我也～。★清·禇人獲《隋唐演義》第十四回
exampleEn: Cai Gong first asked about Luo Gong's daily life, then said, 'Even the incident at Zaojiao Woods in the second year of Renshou, I will deal with leniently.' — Qing Dynasty, Chu Renhuo, 'Romance of Sui and Tang Dynasties', Chapter 14

explanation: 旧时指有身分有地位的人。有时带讽刺意味。
explanationTraditional: 舊時指有身分有地位的人。有時帶諷刺意味。
explanationEn: In old times, refers to people of status and position. Sometimes used sarcastically.
derivation: 晋·刘伶《酒德颂》有大人先生以天地为一朝，万期为须臾，日月为扃牖，八荒为庭衢。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·劉伶《酒德頌》有大人先生以天地為一朝，萬期為須臾，日月為扃牖，八荒為庭衢。”
derivationEn: From Jin Dynasty, Liu Ling's 'Ode to the Virtue of Wine': 'There is a great man who regards heaven and earth as one morning, ten thousand years as a moment, the sun and moon as doors and windows, and the eight wilds as a courtyard.'
example: 咳！好好一座中国江山，被这班强有力的～闹到四分五裂，不可究结，共和在哪里？★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一回
exampleTraditional: 咳！好好一座中國江山，被這班強有力的～鬧到四分五裂，不可究結，共和在哪裡？★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一回
exampleEn: Alas! The beautiful land of China was torn apart by these powerful 'great men' until it was fragmented beyond repair. Where is the republic? — Cai Dongfan, Xu Qinfu, 'Popular Romance of the Republic', Chapter 1

explanation: 等因旧公文用以结束表示理由说明原因的上文；奉此用以引起重心所在的下文。比喻例行公事，官样文章。
explanationTraditional: 等因舊公文用以結束表示理由說明原因的上文；奉此用以引起重心所在的下文。比喻例行公事，官樣文章。
explanationEn: Originally bureaucratic jargon in official documents; now refers to routine official formalities or red tape.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 我们对于上级的文件绝不能～一番就完事大吉。
exampleTraditional: 我們對於上級的文件絕不能～一番就完事大吉。
exampleEn: We must not just go through the motions of 'etc.' and 'hereby' when handling documents from higher authorities.

explanation: 楼阁两层以上的房屋。指各种建筑物。殿堂高大的房屋。
explanationTraditional: 樓閣兩層以上的房屋。指各種建築物。殿堂高大的房屋。
explanationEn: Palaces, halls, towers, and pavilions; various types of buildings.
derivation: 《晋祠》在山上的参天古木中，林立着一百多座殿堂搂阁和亭台桥榭。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉祠》在山上的參天古木中，林立著一百多座殿堂摟閣和亭臺橋榭。”
derivationEn: From 'Jinci Temple': 'Among the towering ancient trees on the mountain stand over a hundred halls, towers, pavilions, and bridges.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 战争的火焰从四面八方燃烧起来。形容边防不安宁，四处有敌人进犯。
explanationTraditional: 戰爭的火焰從四面八方燃燒起來。形容邊防不安寧，四處有敵人進犯。
explanationEn: Beacon fires rising on all sides. Describes border insecurity with enemies invading from all directions.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 楷法式；模模范。把某种事物当作榜样。
explanationTraditional: 楷法式；模模範。把某種事物當作榜樣。
explanationEn: To regard as a model or example.
derivation: 鲁迅《坟·论费厄泼赖”应该缓行》听说刚勇的拳师，决不再打那倒地的敌手，这实足使我们奉为楷模。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《墳·論費厄潑賴”應該緩行》聽說剛勇的拳師，決不再打那倒地的敵手，這實足使我們奉為楷模。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'On Deferring 'Fair Play'': 'It is said that a brave boxer never strikes a fallen opponent; this indeed makes us regard it as a model.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原为道家语，指神道居住的名山胜地◇多比喻风景优美的地方。
explanationTraditional: 原為道家語，指神道居住的名山勝地◇多比喻風景優美的地方。
explanationEn: Originally a Taoist term referring to famous mountains and sacred places where immortals dwell; now often used to describe a scenic spot of great beauty.
derivation: 唐·杜光庭《洞天福地记》列出十大洞天、三十六小洞天、七十二福地的名称。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·杜光庭《洞天福地記》列出十大洞天、三十六小洞天、七十二福地的名稱。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Du Guangting's 'Record of Cave Heavens and Blessed Lands' lists ten great caves, thirty-six small caves, and seventy-two blessed lands.
example: 一到南边，果然山明川丽，如登～。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第七回
exampleTraditional: 一到南邊，果然山明川麗，如登～。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第七回
exampleEn: Upon arriving in the south, the mountains were indeed bright and the rivers beautiful, as if stepping into a blessed land and cave heaven. — Qing Dynasty, Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Retribution', Chapter 7

explanation: 死了父亲的孩子，死了丈夫的妇女。泛指失去亲人，无依无靠者。
explanationTraditional: 死了父親的孩子，死了丈夫的婦女。泛指失去親人，無依無靠者。
explanationEn: Orphans and widows; refers to people who have lost their family and are helpless.
derivation: 战国·楚·宋玉《高唐赋》孤子寡妇，寒心酸鼻。”
derivationTraditional: 戰國·楚·宋玉《高唐賦》孤子寡婦，寒心酸鼻。”
derivationEn: Warring States period, Chu, Song Yu's 'Ode to Gaotang': 'Orphans and widows, their hearts cold and noses sore.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 光风雨后初晴时的风；霁雨雪停止。形容雨过天晴时万物明净的景象。也比喻开阔的胸襟和心地。
explanationTraditional: 光風雨後初晴時的風；霽雨雪停止。形容雨過天晴時萬物明淨的景象。也比喻開闊的胸襟和心地。
explanationEn: Describes a scene of clear and bright weather after rain; also metaphorically refers to an open-minded and pure-hearted person.
derivation: 宋·黄庭坚《豫章集·濂溪诗序》舂陵周茂叔，人品甚高，胸怀洒落，如光风霁月。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·黃庭堅《豫章集·濂溪詩序》舂陵周茂叔，人品甚高，胸懷灑落，如光風霽月。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Huang Tingjian's 'Preface to the Lianxi Poem': 'Zhou Maoshu of Chunling is of high character, with a heart as open as the clear wind and bright moon.'
example: 胸无城府，～，令我忆君之天真有如提孩。★陈毅《哭叶军长希夷同志》
exampleTraditional: 胸無城府，～，令我憶君之天真有如提孩。★陳毅《哭葉軍長希夷同志》
exampleEn: With no hidden thoughts, like clear wind and bright moon, I recall your innocence like a child. — Chen Yi, 'Mourning Comrade Ye Ting'

explanation: 耸起眉毛，瞪大眼睛。形容怒视的样子。
explanationTraditional: 聳起眉毛，瞪大眼睛。形容怒視的樣子。
explanationEn: To raise one's eyebrows and glare angrily; describes a furious expression.
derivation: 五代·后蜀·何光远《监戒录》引陈裕诗横眉怒目强干嗔，便作阎浮有力神。祸福岂由泥捏汉，烧香代养弄蛇人。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·後蜀·何光遠《監戒錄》引陳裕詩橫眉怒目強幹嗔，便作閻浮有力神。禍福豈由泥捏漢，燒香代養弄蛇人。”
derivationEn: Five Dynasties, Later Shu, He Guangyuan's 'Record of Admonitions' quotes Chen Yu's poem: 'With frowning brows and angry eyes, he forces a scowl...'
example: 三三两两的打手，都～，短打扮，随时进来，往后院去。★老舍《茶馆》第一幕
exampleTraditional: 三三兩兩的打手，都～，短打扮，隨時進來，往後院去。★老舍《茶館》第一幕
exampleEn: In groups of twos and threes, thugs with angry brows and glaring eyes, dressed in short clothes, came in and went to the backyard. — Lao She, 'Teahouse', Act 1

explanation: 将拿；折抵偿。拿功劳补偿过失。
explanationTraditional: 將拿；折抵償。拿功勞補償過失。
explanationEn: To atone for one's crimes with meritorious deeds.
derivation: 汉·荀悦《汉纪·元帝纪》齐恒先有匡周之功，后有来项之罪，君子计功补过。”元·无名氏《隔江斗智》楔子如今权饶你将功折罪，点起人马，随我追赶去来。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·荀悅《漢紀·元帝紀》齊恆先有匡周之功，後有來項之罪，君子計功補過。”元·無名氏《隔江鬥智》楔子如今權饒你將功折罪，點起人馬，隨我追趕去來。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Xun Yue's 'Han Records: Emperor Yuan's Chronicle': 'Duke Huan of Qi first had the merit of assisting Zhou, then the crime of attacking Xiang, so the gentleman weighs merit against fault.' Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Stratagem Across the River' wedge: 'Now I temporarily allow you to atone for your crime with merit...'
example: 也亏他至蜀中赚你回来，使我母子相会，～，莫怨他罢。★明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》卷六
exampleTraditional: 也虧他至蜀中賺你回來，使我母子相會，～，莫怨他罷。★明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》卷六
exampleEn: It was thanks to him that he went to Shu to bring you back, allowing mother and son to reunite. Let him atone for his crime with merit, and do not blame him. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong, 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 6

explanation: 金鼓指金钲和战鼓。金钲战鼓一齐响起。形容战斗气氛紧张激烈。
explanationTraditional: 金鼓指金鉦和戰鼓。金鉦戰鼓一齊響起。形容戰鬥氣氛緊張激烈。
explanationEn: Gold gongs and war drums sound together; describes a tense and fierce battle atmosphere.
derivation: 《吕氏春秋·不二》有金鼓，所以一耳。”
derivationTraditional: 《呂氏春秋·不二》有金鼓，所以一耳。”
derivationEn: 'Lüshi Chunqiu: No Two': 'There are gold drums to unify the ears.'
example: 走不到百十步，只见四下里～，喊声枕地，一路都是火把。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十回
exampleTraditional: 走不到百十步，只見四下裡～，喊聲枕地，一路都是火把。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十回
exampleEn: Before they had gone a hundred paces, they heard gold drums sounding together from all sides, shouts shaking the ground, and torches lining the road. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 60

explanation: 比喻剧烈的社会运动。
explanationTraditional: 比喻劇烈的社會運動。
explanationEn: Metaphor for violent social movements.
derivation: 清·梁启超《近代第一女杰罗兰夫人传》其立于城上之罗兰夫人及狄郎的士党，遂不得不为狂涛骇浪之所淘尽矣。”
derivationTraditional: 清·梁啟超《近代第一女傑羅蘭夫人傳》其立於城上之羅蘭夫人及狄郎的士黨，遂不得不為狂濤駭浪之所淘盡矣。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Liang Qichao, 'Biography of the First Modern Female Hero, Madame Roland': 'The Roland and Girondins standing on the city wall were inevitably swept away by the raging waves.'
example: 我和诸同志当时也是飘流震荡于这种～之中。★瞿秋白《饿乡纪程》
exampleTraditional: 我和諸同志當時也是飄流震盪於這種～之中。★瞿秋白《餓鄉紀程》
exampleEn: My comrades and I were also drifting and tossed about in such raging waves. — Qu Qiubai, 'Journey to the Hungry Country'

explanation: 由于快乐而忘记了忧愁。形容非常快乐。
explanationTraditional: 由於快樂而忘記了憂愁。形容非常快樂。
explanationEn: To forget one's worries due to happiness; describes being extremely joyful.
derivation: 《论语·述而》发愤忘食，乐以忘忧。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》發憤忘食，樂以忘憂。”
derivationEn: 'The Analects: Shu Er': 'So absorbed in study as to forget his food, and so happy as to forget his worries.'
example: 似这等～，胡必归欤！★元·王实甫《丽春堂》第三折
exampleTraditional: 似這等～，胡必歸歟！★元·王實甫《麗春堂》第三折
exampleEn: Being so happy as to forget worries, why must I return! — Yuan Dynasty, Wang Shifu, 'Lichun Hall', Act 3

explanation: 乱世动乱的不安定的时代；英雄才能勇武超过常人的人。混乱动荡时代中的杰出人物。
explanationTraditional: 亂世動亂的不安定的時代；英雄才能勇武超過常人的人。混亂動盪時代中的傑出人物。
explanationEn: Heroes in turbulent times; outstanding figures in chaotic eras.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·识鉴》曹公少时见乔玄。玄谓曰‘天下方乱，群雄虎争，拨而理之非君乎？然君实是乱世之英雄，治世之奸贼。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·識鑑》曹公少時見喬玄。玄謂曰‘天下方亂，群雄虎爭，撥而理之非君乎？然君實是亂世之英雄，治世之奸賊。”
derivationEn: Southern Dynasty, Song, Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Insight': 'When Cao Gong was young, he saw Qiao Xuan, who said: 'The world is in chaos, heroes fight like tigers. Who but you can settle it? You are truly a hero in troubled times, but a villain in peaceful times.''
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原意是明亮的珍珠，暗里投在路上，使人看了都很惊奇。比喻有才能的人得不到重视。也比喻好东西落入不识货人的手里。
explanationTraditional: 原意是明亮的珍珠，暗裡投在路上，使人看了都很驚奇。比喻有才能的人得不到重視。也比喻好東西落入不識貨人的手裡。
explanationEn: Originally meant a bright pearl thrown on the road at night, surprising passersby; now metaphorically refers to a talented person not being valued, or a good thing falling into the hands of someone who cannot appreciate it.
derivation: 《史记·鲁仲连邹阳列传》臣闻明月之珠，夜光的璧，以暗投于道路，人无不按剑相眄者∥则？无因而至前也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魯仲連鄒陽列傳》臣聞明月之珠，夜光的璧，以暗投於道路，人無不按劍相眄者∥則？無因而至前也。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Lu Zhonglian and Zou Yang': 'I have heard that a bright moon pearl or a night-shining jade, when thrown on the road in the dark, makes people clutch their swords and glare—why? Because it appears without cause.'
example: 又在扬州商家见有虞山客携送黄杨翠柏各一盆，惜乎～。★清·沈复《浮生六记·闲情记趣》
exampleTraditional: 又在揚州商家見有虞山客攜送黃楊翠柏各一盆，惜乎～。★清·沈復《浮生六記·閒情記趣》
exampleEn: Also in Yangzhou, a merchant had a potted cypress and boxwood brought by a guest from Yushan; it's a pity they were pearls cast before swine. — Qing Dynasty, Shen Fu, 'Six Records of a Floating Life: Notes on Leisure'

explanation: 泛指所有的人。
explanationTraditional: 泛指所有的人。
explanationEn: Refers to all people regardless of age or gender.
derivation: 南朝·梁·沈约《齐故安陆昭王碑文》男女老幼，大临街衢，接响传声。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·沈約《齊故安陸昭王碑文》男女老幼，大臨街衢，接響傳聲。”
derivationEn: From Shen Yue's 'Qi Gu An Lu Zhao Wang Bei Wen' of the Southern Dynasties: 'Men and women, old and young, gather in the streets, voices echoing.'
example: 不论～，都要和和气气组织起来。★巴金《火》第二部
exampleTraditional: 不論～，都要和和氣氣組織起來。★巴金《火》第二部
exampleEn: Regardless of age or gender, everyone should organize harmoniously. — Ba Jin, 'Fire', Part 2

explanation: 偶偶尔；为做。指平耻少这样做，偶尔才做一次。
explanationTraditional: 偶偶爾；為做。指平恥少這樣做，偶爾才做一次。
explanationEn: To do something occasionally, not often.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《纵囚论》若夫纵而来归而赦之，可偶一为之尔。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《縱囚論》若夫縱而來歸而赦之，可偶一為之爾。”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Xiu's 'Zong Qiu Lun' of the Song Dynasty: 'If prisoners are released and then return, they can be pardoned, but this can only be done occasionally.'
example: 但我以为这些方法，也只能随时随地，～，难以多做。（鲁迅《书信集·致赖少祺》）
exampleTraditional: 但我以為這些方法，也只能隨時隨地，～，難以多做。（魯迅《書信集·致賴少祺》）
exampleEn: But I think these methods can only be used occasionally and not often. — Lu Xun, 'Letters to Lai Shaoqi'

explanation: 形容房屋全部毁坏。同片瓦无存”。
explanationTraditional: 形容房屋全部毀壞。同片瓦無存”。
explanationEn: Describes complete destruction of a house; not a single tile remains.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《喻世明言》第一卷那婆子被蒋家打得个片瓦不留，婆子安身不牢，也搬在隔县去了。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《喻世明言》第一卷那婆子被蔣家打得個片瓦不留，婆子安身不牢，也搬在隔縣去了。”
derivationEn: From Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Enlighten the World' of the Ming Dynasty: 'That old woman was beaten by the Jiang family until not a single tile remained, and she could no longer stay, so she moved to another county.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 多方面同时前进。多形容几件事情或几项工作同时进行。同齐头并进”。
explanationTraditional: 多方面同時前進。多形容幾件事情或幾項工作同時進行。同齊頭並進”。
explanationEn: To advance simultaneously on multiple fronts; often used for multiple tasks or projects progressing together.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指良辰美景。也指美好的岁月。
explanationTraditional: 指良辰美景。也指美好的歲月。
explanationEn: Refers to beautiful scenery or good times; also means美好的岁月 (fine years).
derivation: 唐·白居易《琵琶行》今年欢笑复明年，秋月春风等闲度。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《琵琶行》今年歡笑復明年，秋月春風等閒度。”
derivationEn: From Bai Juyi's 'Pipa Xing' of the Tang Dynasty: 'This year we laugh, next year we laugh again; autumn moons and spring breezes pass idly by.'
example: 白发渔樵江渚上，惯看～。（明·杨慎《临江仙》词）
exampleTraditional: 白髮漁樵江渚上，慣看～。（明·楊慎《臨江仙》詞）
exampleEn: White-haired fishermen and woodcutters on the riverbank are accustomed to autumn moons and spring breezes. — Yang Shen, 'Linjiang Immortal' lyrics

explanation: 形容情思缠绵，翻腾不已。
explanationTraditional: 形容情思纏綿，翻騰不已。
explanationEn: Describes tender feelings churning and tossing repeatedly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 桑间在濮水之上，是古代卫国的地方。古指淫风◇也指男女幽会。
explanationTraditional: 桑間在濮水之上，是古代衛國的地方。古指淫風◇也指男女幽會。
explanationEn: Refers to licentious music or a place for romantic trysts; originally a location in ancient Wei.
derivation: 《礼记·乐记》桑间濮上之音，亡国之音也。”《汉书·地理志下》卫地有桑间濮上之阻，男女亦亟聚会，声色生焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·樂記》桑間濮上之音，亡國之音也。”《漢書·地理志下》衛地有桑間濮上之阻，男女亦亟聚會，聲色生焉。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Record of Music': 'The music of Sangjian and Pushang is the music of a doomed state.' Also 'Book of Han: Geography': 'Wei had the barrier of Sangjian and Pushang, where men and women often gathered and indulged in sensual pleasures.'
example: 我弹的不是靡靡之音，我唱的也不是～之辞。★郭沫若《蔡文姬》第四幕第三场
exampleTraditional: 我彈的不是靡靡之音，我唱的也不是～之辭。★郭沫若《蔡文姬》第四幕第三場
exampleEn: What I play is not decadent music, nor are my lyrics those of Sangjian and Pushang. — Guo Moruo, 'Cai Wenji', Act 4, Scene 3

explanation: 形容对父母十分孝敬。同扇枕温席”。
explanationTraditional: 形容對父母十分孝敬。同扇枕溫席”。
explanationEn: Describes extreme filial piety towards parents; same as '扇枕温席'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指神气悠闲安静。
explanationTraditional: 指神氣悠閒安靜。
explanationEn: Describes a calm and composed demeanor.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 敬慎。自始自终都谨慎。
explanationTraditional: 敬慎。自始自終都謹慎。
explanationEn: To be cautious from beginning to end.
derivation: 《礼记·表记》子曰事君慎始而敬终。”汉·贾谊《新书·胎教》易曰‘正其本而万物理，失之毫厘，差以千里，故君子慎始。’春秋之元，诗之关雎，礼之冠婚，易之乾坤，皆慎始敬终云尔。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·表記》子曰事君慎始而敬終。”漢·賈誼《新書·胎教》易曰‘正其本而萬物理，失之毫釐，差以千里，故君子慎始。’春秋之元，詩之關雎，禮之冠婚，易之乾坤，皆慎始敬終云爾。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Rites: Biao Ji': 'Confucius said: In serving a ruler, one should be cautious at the start and respectful at the end.' Also from Jia Yi's 'Xin Shu: Tai Jiao': 'The Book of Changes says: 'Correct the root, and all things will be orderly; a slight error leads to a great mistake, so the gentleman is cautious at the start.' The Spring and Autumn Annals, the Guan Ju of the Book of Songs, the marriage ceremony of the Book of Rites, and the Qian and Kun hexagrams of the Book of Changes all emphasize being cautious at the start and respectful at the end.'
example: 忧懈怠则思慎始而敬终。★唐·魏征《谏太宗十思疏》
exampleTraditional: 憂懈怠則思慎始而敬終。★唐·魏徵《諫太宗十思疏》
exampleEn: When worried about slackness, think of being cautious at the start and respectful at the end. — Wei Zheng, 'Admonitions to Emperor Taizong of Tang'

explanation: 生下来就懂得知识和道理。这是唯心主义者的观点。
explanationTraditional: 生下來就懂得知識和道理。這是唯心主義者的觀點。
explanationEn: Born with knowledge and understanding; an idealist view that some people are innately wise.
derivation: 《论语·述而》子曰‘我非生而知之者，好古敏以求之者也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·述而》子曰‘我非生而知之者，好古敏以求之者也。’”
derivationEn: The Analects of Confucius, Shu Er: Confucius said, 'I am not one who was born with knowledge; I am one who loves antiquity and earnestly seeks it.'
example: 人非～者，孰能无惑。★唐·韩愈《师说》
exampleTraditional: 人非～者，孰能無惑。★唐·韓愈《師說》
exampleEn: People are not born with knowledge; who can be without doubts? — Han Yu, 'On Teachers'

explanation: 王祥卧冰求鱼以奉母。比喻子女孝顺父母。
explanationTraditional: 王祥臥冰求魚以奉母。比喻子女孝順父母。
explanationEn: Wang Xiang lying on ice to get fish for his mother; a metaphor for filial piety.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 武艺武术上的本领。也指军事、战斗的本领。形容武艺高强，超出一般人。
explanationTraditional: 武藝武術上的本領。也指軍事、戰鬥的本領。形容武藝高強，超出一般人。
explanationEn: Martial skills surpassing the crowd; describing someone with outstanding military or combat abilities.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 观察时机，针对具体情况采取行动。
explanationTraditional: 觀察時機，針對具體情況採取行動。
explanationEn: To observe the timing and act according to specific circumstances.
derivation: 《左传·隐公十一年》许无刑而伐之，服而舍之，度德而处之，量力而行之，相时而动，无累后人，可谓知礼矣。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公十一年》許無刑而伐之，服而舍之，度德而處之，量力而行之，相時而動，無累後人，可謂知禮矣。”
derivationEn: Zuo Zhuan, Duke Yin, 11th Year: 'When Xu has no law, attack it; when they submit, spare them. Assess virtue, measure strength, act at the right time, and do not burden future generations. This can be called knowing propriety.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 旧时诗文中用以象征忠君爱国的思想。
explanationTraditional: 舊時詩文中用以象徵忠君愛國的思想。
explanationEn: Fragrant grass and beautiful woman; used in classical poetry to symbolize loyalty to the ruler and love for the country.
derivation: 汉·王逸《离骚序》《离骚》之文，依《诗》取兴，引类譬谕，故善鸟、香草、以配忠贞，……灵修、美人，以譬于君。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·王逸《離騷序》《離騷》之文，依《詩》取興，引類譬諭，故善鳥、香草、以配忠貞，……靈脩、美人，以譬於君。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Wang Yi's 'Preface to Li Sao': 'The poem Li Sao follows the Book of Songs in using analogies, so good birds and fragrant grass represent loyalty... and the beautiful woman represents the ruler.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指恶势力在短时间内喧闹一起。
explanationTraditional: 指惡勢力在短時間內喧鬧一起。
explanationEn: To be arrogant and noisy for a short period; referring to evil forces making a temporary clamor.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这帮土匪在这穷山沟也只能～，一待大军到来，他们就会做鸟兽散了。
exampleTraditional: 這幫土匪在這窮山溝也只能～，一待大軍到來，他們就會做鳥獸散了。
exampleEn: This gang of bandits can only be arrogant for a while in this remote mountain valley; once the army arrives, they will scatter like birds and beasts.

explanation: 旌旗子；摇曳摆动。指心神不安，就象旌旗随风飘荡不定。形容情思起伏，不能自持。
explanationTraditional: 旌旗子；搖曳擺動。指心神不安，就象旌旗隨風飄蕩不定。形容情思起伏，不能自持。
explanationEn: Heart swaying like a flag; describing emotional turmoil and inability to control oneself.
derivation: 《史记·苏秦列传》心摇摇如县旌，而无所终薄。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·蘇秦列傳》心搖搖如縣旌，而無所終薄。”
derivationEn: Records of the Grand Historian, Biography of Su Qin: 'My heart sways like a hanging flag, with no place to rest.'
example: 眉翠含颦，靥红展笑，一张小嘴，恰似新破的榴实，不觉看得～起来。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第五回
exampleTraditional: 眉翠含顰，靨紅展笑，一張小嘴，恰似新破的榴實，不覺看得～起來。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第五回
exampleEn: Her brows were knitted with sorrow, her cheeks blushed with a smile, and her small mouth was like a freshly cracked pomegranate; he couldn't help but feel his heart sway. — Zeng Pu, 'Flower in the Sea of Evil', Chapter 5

explanation: 探寻求。胜胜地，风景优美的地方。游览山水时寻找、搜索幽雅的胜地。亦作寻幽探奇”、寻奇探幽”、探幽选胜”。
explanationTraditional: 探尋求。勝勝地，風景優美的地方。遊覽山水時尋找、搜索幽雅的勝地。亦作尋幽探奇”、尋奇探幽”、探幽選勝”。
explanationEn: To search for secluded and scenic spots; to explore beautiful places in nature.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 律约束。严格要求自己。
explanationTraditional: 律約束。嚴格要求自己。
explanationEn: To be strict with oneself; to hold oneself to high standards.
derivation: 宋·陈亮《谢曾察院启》严于律己，出而见之事功；心乎爱民，动必关夫治道。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·陳亮《謝曾察院啟》嚴於律己，出而見之事功；心乎愛民，動必關夫治道。”
