derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Chen Liang's 'Letter of Thanks to Censor Cai': 'Be strict with oneself, and when acting, see results; love the people, and every move must concern governance.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一路同一类；货色货物。比喻同一类丑货。
explanationTraditional: 一路同一類；貨色貨物。比喻同一類醜貨。
explanationEn: Goods of the same kind; metaphor for people or things of the same ilk, usually derogatory.
derivation: 郭澄清《大刀记》第七章叫我看，一进了他们这个大染缸，就全变成一路货色了。”
derivationTraditional: 郭澄清《大刀記》第七章叫我看，一進了他們這個大染缸，就全變成一路貨色了。”
derivationEn: Guo Chengqing, 'The Big Knife', Chapter 7: 'In my view, once they enter that big dye vat, they all become the same kind of goods.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 沿袭旧的，敷衍应付。
explanationTraditional: 沿襲舊的，敷衍應付。
explanationEn: To follow old routines and handle matters perfunctorily.
derivation: 宋·吕祖谦《答潘叔度》以此等语言自恕，则因循苟且，无一事可为矣！”
derivationTraditional: 宋·呂祖謙《答潘叔度》以此等語言自恕，則因循苟且，無一事可為矣！”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Lü Zuqian's 'Reply to Pan Shudu': 'If one excuses oneself with such words, then one will follow old routines and handle matters perfunctorily, and nothing can be accomplished!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有一点消息。
explanationTraditional: 沒有一點消息。
explanationEn: No news or information at all.
derivation: 明·吾邱瑞《运甓记·剪发延宾》盼前程音信杳无。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吾邱瑞《運甓記·剪髮延賓》盼前程音信杳無。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Qiurui's 'Fortune Telling': 'Looking forward to the future, there is no news at all.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 以此事为遗憾。
explanationTraditional: 以此事為遺憾。
explanationEn: To regard something as a regret.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这篇精妙的论文，因为名额有限，未能入选，颇令人～。
exampleTraditional: 這篇精妙的論文，因為名額有限，未能入選，頗令人～。
exampleEn: This exquisite paper, due to limited slots, was not selected, which is quite regrettable.

explanation: 既有钱财，又有势力。同有钱有势”。
explanationTraditional: 既有錢財，又有勢力。同有錢有勢”。
explanationEn: Having both wealth and power. Same as '有钱有势'.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二十比如一边有财有势，那趋财慕势的多只向一边去。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二十比如一邊有財有勢，那趨財慕勢的多隻向一邊去。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement' Volume 20: 'For example, if one side has wealth and power, those who seek wealth and power will flock to that side.'
example: 计氏不肯降心，珍哥不肯逊让，晁大舍虽然～，如此家反宅乱，也甚不成人家。★清·西周生《醒世姻缘传》第一回
exampleTraditional: 計氏不肯降心，珍哥不肯遜讓，晁大舍雖然～，如此家反宅亂，也甚不成人家。★清·西周生《醒世姻緣傳》第一回
exampleEn: Lady Ji refused to humble herself, Zhen Ge was unwilling to yield, and although Squire Chao had wealth and power, such family turmoil was hardly a proper household. — Qing Dynasty, Xi Zhousheng's 'Marriage That Awakens the World' Chapter 1

explanation: 指辜负众人的期望。
explanationTraditional: 指辜負眾人的期望。
explanationEn: To fail to live up to people's expectations.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指言行符合不偏不倚的中正之道。
explanationTraditional: 指言行符合不偏不倚的中正之道。
explanationEn: To adhere to the impartial and balanced way of the mean.
derivation: 《书·大禹谟》人心惟危，道心惟微，惟精惟一，允执厥中。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·大禹謨》人心惟危，道心惟微，惟精惟一，允執厥中。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Documents: Counsels of the Great Yu': 'The human mind is precarious, the Dao mind is subtle. Be refined and single-minded, hold fast to the mean.'
example: 圣人之道，中而已矣，堯、舜、禹三圣人为万世法，一‘～’也。★明·方孝儒《夷齐》
exampleTraditional: 聖人之道，中而已矣，堯、舜、禹三聖人為萬世法，一‘～’也。★明·方孝儒《夷齊》
exampleEn: The way of the sage is nothing but the mean. Yao, Shun, and Yu, the three sages, set the eternal model for all generations, and it is all about 'holding fast to the mean'. — Ming Dynasty, Fang Xiaoru's 'Bo Yi and Shu Qi'

explanation: （歇后语）摸不着头脑。指弄不清是怎么回事。
explanationTraditional: （歇後語）摸不著頭腦。指弄不清是怎麼回事。
explanationEn: (A two-part allegorical saying) 'Cannot touch the head' — meaning to be completely baffled.
derivation: 《金瓶梅传奇》第六回诸方地保瞧见，恰似丈二和尚，摸不着头脑，不觉腿关节软了下来，扑通扑通跪成一片。”
derivationTraditional: 《金瓶梅傳奇》第六回諸方地保瞧見，恰似丈二和尚，摸不著頭腦，不覺腿關節軟了下來，撲通撲通跪成一片。”
derivationEn: 'The Legend of Jin Ping Mei' Chapter 6: 'The local constables saw this and, like a ten-foot-tall monk, could not touch his head, and their knees involuntarily softened, falling to the ground in a row.'
example: 周天虹有点～摸不着头脑，忙问‘怎么，阵地不要了？’★魏巍《火凤凰》一○七
exampleTraditional: 周天虹有點～摸不著頭腦，忙問‘怎麼，陣地不要了？’★魏巍《火鳳凰》一○七
exampleEn: Zhou Tianhong was somewhat baffled, like a ten-foot-tall monk, and quickly asked, 'What? Are we abandoning the position?' — Wei Wei's 'Fire Phoenix' 107

explanation: 可哀呀可哀，我的父母啊！原指古时在暴政下的人民终年在外服劳役，对父母病痛、老死不能照料而悲哀。
explanationTraditional: 可哀呀可哀，我的父母啊！原指古時在暴政下的人民終年在外服勞役，對父母病痛、老死不能照料而悲哀。
explanationEn: Alas, alas, my parents! Originally refers to people under tyranny who are forced to labor all year round and cannot care for their sick or dying parents.
derivation: 《诗经·小雅·蓼莪》蓼蓼者莪，匪莪伊蒿，哀哀父母，生我劬劳。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·小雅·蓼莪》蓼蓼者莪，匪莪伊蒿，哀哀父母，生我劬勞。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Songs: Xiaoya: Liao'e': 'Lush is the e, but it is not e but hao. Alas, alas, my parents, who toiled to give me birth.'
example: 咱人有子方知不孝娘，岂不问～情肠！★元·无名氏《小张屠》第一折
exampleTraditional: 咱人有子方知不孝娘，豈不問～情腸！★元·無名氏《小張屠》第一折
exampleEn: Only when one has children does one know the hardship of one's mother. How can one not feel the sorrow of 'alas, alas, my parents'? — Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous 'Little Zhang Tu' Act 1

explanation: 磐石大石头。如同磐石一般安然不动。形容非常稳固。
explanationTraditional: 磐石大石頭。如同磐石一般安然不動。形容非常穩固。
explanationEn: As stable as a huge rock. Describes something very firm and secure.
derivation: 《荀子·富国》为名者否，为利者否，为忿者否，则国安于磐石，寿于旗翼。”
derivationTraditional: 《荀子·富國》為名者否，為利者否，為忿者否，則國安於磐石，壽於旗翼。”
derivationEn: 'Xunzi: Enriching the State': 'Those who seek fame, those who seek profit, those who seek vengeance, none succeed, then the state is more stable than a rock, and endures longer than a banner.'
example: 立宪国皇室所以～，道皆在是也。★清·梁启超《责任内阁释义》
exampleTraditional: 立憲國皇室所以～，道皆在是也。★清·梁啟超《責任內閣釋義》
exampleEn: The reason why the royal family in a constitutional monarchy is as stable as a rock lies in this. — Qing Dynasty, Liang Qichao's 'Interpretation of Responsible Cabinet'

explanation: 抬起头，挺起胸膛。形容斗志高，士气旺。参见昂首挺胸”。
explanationTraditional: 抬起頭，挺起胸膛。形容鬥志高，士氣旺。參見昂首挺胸”。
explanationEn: To raise one's head and puff out one's chest. Describes high morale and strong spirit. See '昂首挺胸'.
derivation: 语出欧阳予情《小英姑娘》她伸开两手昂首挺胸，狂了似的往外跑。”
derivationTraditional: 語出歐陽予情《小英姑娘》她伸開兩手昂首挺胸，狂了似的往外跑。”
derivationEn: From Ouyang Yuqian's 'Miss Xiao Ying': 'She stretched out her arms, raised her head and puffed out her chest, and ran out like a madwoman.'
example: 你看！提到内战，就连妇人女子都反对啦……”～，老老师欣喜地叫出来。★沙汀《范老老师》
exampleTraditional: 你看！提到內戰，就連婦人女子都反對啦……”～，老老師欣喜地叫出來。★沙汀《範老老師》
exampleEn: Look! When it comes to civil war, even women and children oppose it...' Raising his head and puffing out his chest, the old teacher exclaimed joyfully. — Sha Ting's 'Old Teacher Fan'

explanation: 形容旅途或野外生活的艰苦。
explanationTraditional: 形容旅途或野外生活的艱苦。
explanationEn: Describes the hardships of traveling or living in the wild.
derivation: 明·王守仁《瘗旅文》餐风饮露，无尔饥兮。”
derivationTraditional: 明·王守仁《瘞旅文》餐風飲露，無爾飢兮。”
derivationEn: From Wang Shouren's 'Burial of a Traveler' in the Ming Dynasty: 'Eating wind and drinking dew, may you not be hungry.'
example: 但是野外勘测，～，地质工作也是艰苦卓绝的。★徐迟《地质之光》
exampleTraditional: 但是野外勘測，～，地質工作也是艱苦卓絕的。★徐遲《地質之光》
exampleEn: But field surveys, eating wind and drinking dew, geological work is also extremely arduous. ★ Xu Chi's 'Light of Geology'

explanation: ①早晨刚生，晚上就死亡。②今亦形容事物生命短暂。
explanationTraditional: ①早晨剛生，晚上就死亡。②今亦形容事物生命短暫。
explanationEn: ① Born in the morning and dead by evening. ② Also used to describe something with a very short lifespan.
derivation: 《重修政和证类本草·草下之上》朝生幕落花……生粪秽处，头如笔，紫色，朝生暮死。”
derivationTraditional: 《重修政和證類本草·草下之上》朝生幕落花……生糞穢處，頭如筆，紫色，朝生暮死。”
derivationEn: From 'Revised Zhenghe Materia Medica': 'The flower that blooms in the morning and falls at dusk... grows in filthy places, head like a brush, purple, born in the morning and dead by evening.'
example: 任何一部文学作品，只要不是～的东西，总会让一些人喜欢，让另一些人讨厌。★巴金《探索集·灌输和宣传》
exampleTraditional: 任何一部文學作品，只要不是～的東西，總會讓一些人喜歡，讓另一些人討厭。★巴金《探索集·灌輸和宣傳》
exampleEn: Any literary work, as long as it is not something that lives only from morning to evening, will be liked by some and disliked by others. ★ Ba Jin's 'Exploration Collection: Indoctrination and Propaganda'

explanation: 指行动出于敌方意料。
explanationTraditional: 指行動出於敵方意料。
explanationEn: To act in a way that catches the enemy off guard.
derivation: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第八章不如让我去，出敌不意，拦腰插一拳，也许能够把敌阵冲乱。”
derivationTraditional: 姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第八章不如讓我去，出敵不意，攔腰插一拳，也許能夠把敵陣衝亂。”
derivationEn: From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 8: 'Better let me go, catch the enemy off guard, strike a blow in the middle, and maybe we can break their formation.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 低眉弯腰。形容没有骨气，巴结奉承。
explanationTraditional: 低眉彎腰。形容沒有骨氣，巴結奉承。
explanationEn: To bow and scrape; describes fawning and flattering without dignity.
derivation: 唐·李白《梦游天姥吟留别》安能摧眉折腰事权贵，使我不得开心颜。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《夢遊天姥吟留別》安能摧眉折腰事權貴，使我不得開心顏。”
derivationEn: From Li Bai's 'Dreaming of Mount Tianmu: A Song of Farewell' in the Tang Dynasty: 'How can I stoop and bow before the powerful, never to be happy and free?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 无论怎样摔打都破不了。比喻理论学说完全正确，不会被驳倒推翻。同颠扑不破”。
explanationTraditional: 無論怎樣摔打都破不了。比喻理論學說完全正確，不會被駁倒推翻。同顛撲不破”。
explanationEn: Cannot be broken no matter how much it is knocked about. Metaphor for a theory or doctrine that is completely correct and cannot be refuted. Same as '颠扑不破'.
derivation: 《朱子语类》卷五伊川（程颐）‘性即理也’，横（张载）‘心统性情’二句，颠簸不破！”
derivationTraditional: 《朱子語類》卷五伊川（程頤）‘性即理也’，橫（張載）‘心統性情’二句，顛簸不破！”
derivationEn: From 'Zhu Xi's Classified Conversations', Volume 5: 'Cheng Yi's saying that nature is principle, and Zhang Zai's saying that the mind governs nature and emotions, these two statements are unbreakable!'
example: ‘干部决定一切’，这是句～的至理名言。★邹韬奋《事业管理与职业修养·关于干部与待遇二》
exampleTraditional: ‘幹部決定一切’，這是句～的至理名言。★鄒韜奮《事業管理與職業修養·關於幹部與待遇二》
exampleEn: 'Cadres decide everything' is an unbreakable maxim. ★ Zou Taofen's 'Career Management and Professional Cultivation: On Cadres and Treatment II'

explanation: 特指男女之间缠绵的恋情。同儿女私情”。
explanationTraditional: 特指男女之間纏綿的戀情。同兒女私情”。
explanationEn: Specifically refers to the lingering romantic feelings between a man and a woman. Same as '儿女私情'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 短不足。各有各的不足。
explanationTraditional: 短不足。各有各的不足。
explanationEn: Each has its own shortcomings.
derivation: 《史记·白起王翦列传》……及孙王离为项羽所虏，不亦宜乎！彼各有所短也。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·白起王翦列傳》……及孫王離為項羽所虜，不亦宜乎！彼各有所短也。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biographies of Bai Qi and Wang Jian': '...And when his grandson Wang Li was captured by Xiang Yu, was it not fitting? Each had his own shortcomings.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 关隘山岭阻挡隔绝。形容路途艰难，往来不易。
explanationTraditional: 關隘山嶺阻擋隔絕。形容路途艱難，往來不易。
explanationEn: Blocked by mountain passes and ridges. Describes a difficult journey and hard communication.
derivation: 元·郑德辉《　梅香》第一折不争他回家去呵，路途艰难，关山阴隔，这亲事几时得就。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭德輝《　梅香》第一折不爭他回家去呵，路途艱難，關山陰隔，這親事幾時得就。”
derivationEn: From Zheng Dehui's Yuan Dynasty play 'Plum Fragrance', Act 1: 'If he returns home, the journey is hard, mountains and passes block the way, when will this marriage be fulfilled?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 成诵能背诵。看过一遍就能背下来。形容记忆力强。
explanationTraditional: 成誦能背誦。看過一遍就能背下來。形容記憶力強。
explanationEn: To be able to recite after reading once. Describes a strong memory.
derivation: 《晋书·苻融载记》耳闻则诵，过目不忘。”《宋史·刘恕传》恕少颖司，书过目即成诵。”
derivationTraditional: 《晉書·苻融載記》耳聞則誦，過目不忘。”《宋史·劉恕傳》恕少穎司，書過目即成誦。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Jin: Biography of Fu Rong': 'He could recite what he heard and never forget what he read.' From 'History of Song: Biography of Liu Shu': 'Liu Shu was intelligent from a young age; he could recite a book after reading it once.'
example: 天资高妙，～，出口成章。★明·冯梦龙《警世通言》卷三
exampleTraditional: 天資高妙，～，出口成章。★明·馮夢龍《警世通言》卷三
exampleEn: He was highly gifted, could recite after reading once, and could speak eloquently. ★ Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Caution the World', Volume 3

explanation: 怙依靠，依仗；悛改过，悔改。坚持作恶，不肯悔改。
explanationTraditional: 怙依靠，依仗；悛改過，悔改。堅持作惡，不肯悔改。
explanationEn: To persist in evil and refuse to repent.
derivation: 《左传·隐公六年》长恶不悛，从自及也。”
derivationTraditional: 《左傳·隱公六年》長惡不悛，從自及也。”
derivationEn: From 'Zuo Zhuan: The Sixth Year of Duke Yin': 'To persist in evil without repentance will bring disaster upon oneself.'
example: 若授以远方牧民之官，其或～，恃远肆毒，小民罹殃，卒莫上诉。★《宋史·王化基传》
exampleTraditional: 若授以遠方牧民之官，其或～，恃遠肆毒，小民罹殃，卒莫上訴。★《宋史·王化基傳》
exampleEn: If appointed as an official governing distant people, they might persist in evil, rely on distance to do harm, causing the common people to suffer without being able to appeal. ★ 'History of Song: Biography of Wang Huaji'

explanation: 贿赂因请托而私赠财物；公行公开做。指公开行贿受赂。
explanationTraditional: 賄賂因請託而私贈財物；公行公開做。指公開行賄受賂。
explanationEn: Openly offering and accepting bribes.
derivation: 《北史·柳彧传》前在赵州，暗于职务，政由群小，贿赂公行。”
derivationTraditional: 《北史·柳彧傳》前在趙州，暗於職務，政由群小，賄賂公行。”
derivationEn: From 'History of the Northern Dynasties: Biography of Liu Yu': 'Previously in Zhaozhou, he was ignorant of his duties, governance was left to petty men, and bribery was practiced openly.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 吉凶吉利与不吉利，引申为祸福，成败；卜占卜，引申为预测。无法预测是福是祸、是成是败。
explanationTraditional: 吉凶吉利與不吉利，引申為禍福，成敗；卜占卜，引申為預測。無法預測是福是禍、是成是敗。
explanationEn: Unable to predict whether something will turn out good or bad, fortunate or unfortunate.
derivation: 清·钱彩《说岳全传》第五十九回圣人命我进京，怎敢抗旨？但奸臣在朝，此去吉凶未卜。”
derivationTraditional: 清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第五十九回聖人命我進京，怎敢抗旨？但奸臣在朝，此去吉凶未卜。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Qian Cai's 'The Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 59: 'The sage ordered me to go to the capital; how dare I defy the decree? But with treacherous ministers at court, this journey's outcome is uncertain.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 热心主动帮助别人解决困难。
explanationTraditional: 熱心主動幫助別人解決困難。
explanationEn: Eagerly and actively helping others solve their difficulties.
derivation: 《史记·魏公子列传》胜所以自附为婚姻者，以公子之高义，为能急人之困。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·魏公子列傳》勝所以自附為婚姻者，以公子之高義，為能急人之困。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of Lord Wei': 'The reason I attached myself to you through marriage is because of your noble righteousness and your ability to help others in distress.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 用本钱谋求利润。
explanationTraditional: 用本錢謀求利潤。
explanationEn: Using capital to seek profit.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 纡弯曲，屈抑。降抑尊贵的地位，谦以自处。
explanationTraditional: 紆彎曲，屈抑。降抑尊貴的地位，謙以自處。
explanationEn: To condescend or humble oneself from a high position; to act with humility despite one's status.
derivation: 清·梁启超《中国专制政治进化史论》乃实由纡尊降贵，自放弃其贵族之特权，以结欢于处士。”
derivationTraditional: 清·梁啟超《中國專制政治進化史論》乃實由紆尊降貴，自放棄其貴族之特權，以結歡於處士。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Liang Qichao's 'On the History of Chinese Autocracy': 'In fact, they condescended and abandoned their aristocratic privileges to curry favor with scholars.'
example: 连国王乔治三世也不惜～，以推动新的农业经营为乐事。
exampleTraditional: 連國王喬治三世也不惜～，以推動新的農業經營為樂事。
exampleEn: Even King George III did not hesitate to condescend, taking pleasure in promoting new agricultural practices.

explanation: 点脚尖着地。形容走得非常快，好象脚尖都未着地。
explanationTraditional: 點腳尖著地。形容走得非常快，好象腳尖都未著地。
explanationEn: Walking very fast, as if one's feet barely touch the ground.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《古今小说》卷二十七七八个老妪丫环，扯耳朵、拽胳膊，好似六贼戏弥陀一般，脚不点地，拥到新人面前。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《古今小說》卷二十七七八個老嫗丫環，扯耳朵、拽胳膊，好似六賊戲彌陀一般，腳不點地，擁到新人面前。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Stories Old and New', Volume 27: 'Seven or eight old maids and maidservants, pulling ears and dragging arms, like the six thieves tormenting Maitreya, they rushed the bride to the front without her feet touching the ground.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 绝世当世独一无二；佳人美人。当代最美的女人。
explanationTraditional: 絕世當世獨一無二；佳人美人。當代最美的女人。
explanationEn: A woman of unparalleled beauty; the most beautiful woman of the time.
derivation: 《汉书·外戚传》载李延年歌北方有佳人，绝世而独立。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·外戚傳》載李延年歌北方有佳人，絕世而獨立。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of the Consort Families', quoting Li Yannian's song: 'In the north there is a beauty, peerless and independent.'
example: 虽居富贵，不爱铅华。敢夸～，自许朝天素面。★清·洪昻《长生殿·幸恩》
exampleTraditional: 雖居富貴，不愛鉛華。敢誇～，自許朝天素面。★清·洪昻《長生殿·幸恩》
exampleEn: Though living in wealth and honor, she does not love makeup. She dares to call herself a peerless beauty, presenting herself with a plain face in the morning. — Qing Dynasty Hong Sheng's 'Palace of Eternal Life', Act 'Favored by Fortune'

explanation: 姑且备为一种风格或格式。
explanationTraditional: 姑且備為一種風格或格式。
explanationEn: To include something as a token or for the sake of having a variety; to offer as a mere formality.
derivation: 清·陈廷焯《白雨斋词话》第五卷余于别集中求其措语无害大雅者择录一二，非赏其工也，聊备一格而已。”
derivationTraditional: 清·陳廷焯《白雨齋詞話》第五卷餘於別集中求其措語無害大雅者擇錄一二，非賞其工也，聊備一格而已。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Chen Tingzhuo's 'Baiyu Zhai Ci Hua', Volume 5: 'I select a few from other collections whose wording is harmless to morality, not because they are excellent, but merely to have a token style.'
example: 但是以为谈论文艺，思想、生活问题应该大谈特谈，谈技巧则只宜‘～’，否则就有些不妙。★秦牧《跋》
exampleTraditional: 但是以為談論文藝，思想、生活問題應該大談特談，談技巧則只宜‘～’，否則就有些不妙。★秦牧《跋》
exampleEn: But when discussing literature and art, issues of thought and life should be discussed at length, while technique should only be included as a token, otherwise it would be somewhat inappropriate. — Qin Mu's 'Postscript'

explanation: 凌云高入云霄的志气。形容远大的志向。
explanationTraditional: 凌雲高入雲霄的志氣。形容遠大的志向。
explanationEn: Ambition that soars to the clouds; lofty and far-reaching aspirations.
derivation: 《汉书·扬雄传》往时武帝好神仙，相如上《大人赋》欲以风帝，反缥缥有陵（凌）云之志。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·揚雄傳》往時武帝好神仙，相如上《大人賦》欲以風帝，反縹縹有陵（凌）雲之志。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Yang Xiong': 'In the past, Emperor Wu of Han loved immortals, and Xiangru presented the 'Fu on the Great Man' to admonish him, but instead the emperor felt a soaring ambition.'
example: 鲁编修飘飘有～。★清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第十回
exampleTraditional: 魯編修飄飄有～。★清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第十回
exampleEn: Lu Bianxiu had a lofty ambition that soared to the clouds. — Qing Dynasty Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 10

explanation: 荦荦清楚、分明的样子。指主要的项目，明显的要点。
explanationTraditional: 犖犖清楚、分明的樣子。指主要的項目，明顯的要點。
explanationEn: The main items or prominent points; the most important aspects.
derivation: 《史记·天官书》此其荦荦大者，若至委曲小变，不可胜道。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·天官書》此其犖犖大者，若至委曲小變，不可勝道。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Grand Historian: Treatise on the Heavenly Offices': 'These are the major points; as for the minor details and small changes, they are too numerous to mention.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容心情喜悦，满脸笑容。
explanationTraditional: 形容心情喜悅，滿臉笑容。
explanationEn: Describes a joyful mood with a beaming smile.
derivation: 清·文康《儿女英雄传》第13回早见那位钦差顶冠束带满脸春风的迎出舱来。”
derivationTraditional: 清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第13回早見那位欽差頂冠束帶滿臉春風的迎出艙來。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Wenkang's 'The Story of Heroes and Heroines', Chapter 13: 'Early saw that imperial envoy, wearing a hat and belt, full of spring breeze, welcoming out of the cabin.'
example: 她慌慌张张接着被子，笑得～。★李准《李双双小传·春笋》
exampleTraditional: 她慌慌張張接著被子，笑得～。★李準《李雙雙小傳·春筍》
exampleEn: She hurriedly took the quilt, laughing with a spring breeze on her face. ★ Li Zhun's 'Li Shuangshuang's Biography: Spring Bamboo Shoots'

explanation: 宗派之间的争论。
explanationTraditional: 宗派之間的爭論。
explanationEn: Disputes between factions or schools.
derivation: 《清史稿·沈桂芬翁同龢等传论》然以政见异同，门户之争，牵及朝局，至数十年而未已。”
derivationTraditional: 《清史稿·沈桂芬翁同龢等傳論》然以政見異同，門戶之爭，牽及朝局，至數十年而未已。”
derivationEn: From 'Draft History of Qing: Biographies of Shen Guifen, Weng Tonghe, etc.': 'However, due to differences in political views, factional disputes involved the court for decades without end.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容转战南北，经历过多次战斗。
explanationTraditional: 形容轉戰南北，經歷過多次戰鬥。
explanationEn: Describes fighting many battles across the country, experiencing numerous campaigns.
derivation: 元·朱凯《昊天塔》第一折想老夫幼年时，南征北讨，东荡西除，到今日都做了一场春梦也。”
derivationTraditional: 元·朱凱《昊天塔》第一折想老夫幼年時，南征北討，東蕩西除，到今日都做了一場春夢也。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zhu Kai's 'Wu Tian Pagoda', Act 1: 'Thinking back to my youth, I campaigned south and north, east and west, but now it's all a spring dream.'
example: 昔日魏武祖皇帝，东荡西除，～，非容易得此天下。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第一百十九回
exampleTraditional: 昔日魏武祖皇帝，東蕩西除，～，非容易得此天下。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第一百十九回
exampleEn: In the past, Emperor Wu of Wei, Cao Cao, campaigned east and west, south and north, and did not easily obtain this empire. ★ Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 119

explanation: 比喻心心相印、会心。
explanationTraditional: 比喻心心相印、會心。
explanationEn: Metaphor for mutual understanding and heart-to-heart connection.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元·七佛·释迦牟尼佛》世尊在灵山会上，拈花示众，是时众皆默然，唯迦叶尊者破颜微笑。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元·七佛·釋迦牟尼佛》世尊在靈山會上，拈花示眾，是時眾皆默然，唯迦葉尊者破顏微笑。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'The World-Honored One held up a flower on Vulture Peak, showing it to the assembly. All were silent, only Venerable Mahakashyapa broke into a smile.'
example: 伊为新至我，我是旧来伊，～，心是口。★清·李渔《奈何天·巧怖》
exampleTraditional: 伊為新至我，我是舊來伊，～，心是口。★清·李漁《奈何天·巧怖》
exampleEn: She is the new arrival to me, I am the old self to her, with a flower in hand and a smile, heart is mouth. ★ Qing Dynasty Li Yu's 'What Can Be Done: Clever Tricks'

explanation: 整治家庭和治理国家。
explanationTraditional: 整治家庭和治理國家。
explanationEn: Regulate the family and govern the state.
derivation: 《礼记·大学》所谓治国必先齐其家者，其家不可教，而能教人者，无之。故君子不出家而成教于国。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·大學》所謂治國必先齊其家者，其家不可教，而能教人者，無之。故君子不出家而成教於國。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites: The Great Learning': 'What is meant by 'To govern the state, one must first regulate his family' is that if one cannot teach his own family, he cannot teach others. Therefore, the superior man, without leaving his home, can accomplish the teaching of the state.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指永远流传，不会磨灭。
explanationTraditional: 指永遠流傳，不會磨滅。
explanationEn: Refers to something that will last forever and never fade.
derivation: 清·李渔《闲情偶寄·词曲》谁肯以千古不朽之名人，抑之使出时流下。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李漁《閒情偶寄·詞曲》誰肯以千古不朽之名人，抑之使出時流下。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Li Yu's 'Casual Expressions: Lyrics': 'Who would suppress an immortal celebrity of a thousand ages to make them inferior to contemporaries?'
example: 此地有一白虎山，极好风水，若葬于此，～。★清·如莲居士《薛刚反唐》第一回
exampleTraditional: 此地有一白虎山，極好風水，若葬於此，～。★清·如蓮居士《薛剛反唐》第一回
exampleEn: There is a White Tiger Mountain here with excellent feng shui; if buried here, one will be immortal for a thousand ages. ★ Qing Dynasty Rulian Jushi's 'Xue Gang Rebels Against Tang', Chapter 1

explanation: 形容犯的罪永远被人记着。
explanationTraditional: 形容犯的罪永遠被人記著。
explanationEn: Describes a crime that will be remembered forever.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 这个卖国求荣的无耻汉奸终将成为～，遗臭万年。
exampleTraditional: 這個賣國求榮的無恥漢奸終將成為～，遺臭萬年。
exampleEn: This shameless traitor who sells out the country will become a sinner for all ages, leaving a stench for ten thousand years.

explanation: 比喻不随便结交朋友。也比喻清闲无事。同清风明月”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻不隨便結交朋友。也比喻清閒無事。同清風明月”。
explanationEn: Metaphor for not casually making friends; also means leisurely and carefree. Same as 'clear breeze and bright moon'.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 慕求贤人，如渴思饮。形容求贤心情十分迫切。
explanationTraditional: 慕求賢人，如渴思飲。形容求賢心情十分迫切。
explanationEn: Seeking talented people as eagerly as one thirsts for water. Describes an urgent desire to recruit talent.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無

exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 却推却。指对别人的邀请、赠与等，如果拒绝接受，就显得不恭敬。
explanationTraditional: 卻推卻。指對別人的邀請、贈與等，如果拒絕接受，就顯得不恭敬。
explanationEn: Refusing an invitation or gift would be disrespectful.
derivation: 《孟子·万章下》却之却之为不恭。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·萬章下》卻之卻之為不恭。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Wan Zhang II': 'To decline it is disrespectful.'
example: 我们觉得～，只好让他劳驾。★邹韬奋《经历·惨淡经营之后》
exampleTraditional: 我們覺得～，只好讓他勞駕。★鄒韜奮《經歷·慘淡經營之後》
exampleEn: We felt that refusing would be disrespectful, so we had to let him take the trouble. ★ Zou Taofen's 'Experience: After Hard Work'

explanation: 连太阳和月亮都失去了光彩。比喻极其黑暗。
explanationTraditional: 連太陽和月亮都失去了光彩。比喻極其黑暗。
explanationEn: Even the sun and moon lose their luster. A metaphor for extreme darkness or gloom.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 精神饱满，气息充足。
explanationTraditional: 精神飽滿，氣息充足。
explanationEn: Full of spirit and vitality; energetic and robust.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 鼻涕眼泪同时流下，形容极度哀痛。同涕泪交零”。
explanationTraditional: 鼻涕眼淚同時流下，形容極度哀痛。同涕淚交零”。
explanationEn: Tears and nasal mucus flowing together, describing extreme grief.
derivation: 宋·邵伯温《闻见前录》卷六是何微类，误我至尊，乞明验于奸人，愿不容于首恶。兴言及此，涕泪交流。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·邵伯溫《聞見前錄》卷六是何微類，誤我至尊，乞明驗於奸人，願不容於首惡。興言及此，涕淚交流。”
derivationEn: Shao Bowen of Song Dynasty, 'Records of Things Heard' Volume 6: 'Such a petty person misled my emperor. I beg to verify the traitor and not tolerate the chief culprit. Speaking of this, tears and mucus flow together.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 剜用刀挖去。挖下身上的好肉来补伤口。比喻只顾眼前，用有害的方法来救急。
explanationTraditional: 剜用刀挖去。挖下身上的好肉來補傷口。比喻只顧眼前，用有害的方法來救急。
explanationEn: Cutting out good flesh to patch a wound. A metaphor for using a harmful method to solve an immediate problem, neglecting the long-term consequences.
derivation: 唐·聂夷中《咏田家》诗二月卖新丝，五月粜新谷；医得眼前疮，剜却心头肉。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·聶夷中《詠田家》詩二月賣新絲，五月糶新谷；醫得眼前瘡，剜卻心頭肉。”
derivationEn: Nie Yizhong of Tang Dynasty, poem 'Song of the Farmer': 'In February, sell new silk; in May, sell new grain. To heal the present sore, cut out the heart's flesh.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原指国家将亡，人民困苦，因此音乐也多表现为哀思的曲调，后多指颓靡淫荡的歌曲。
explanationTraditional: 原指國家將亡，人民困苦，因此音樂也多表現為哀思的曲調，後多指頹靡淫蕩的歌曲。
explanationEn: Originally referred to music reflecting the sorrow of a declining nation; later refers to decadent and licentious songs.
derivation: 《礼记·乐记》亡国之音哀以思，其民困。”又桑间濮上之音，亡国之音也，其政散，其民流。”《史记·乐书》亡国之音哀以思，其民困。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·樂記》亡國之音哀以思，其民困。”又桑間濮上之音，亡國之音也，其政散，其民流。”《史記·樂書》亡國之音哀以思，其民困。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Rites: Record of Music': 'The music of a dying state is mournful and thoughtful, its people are distressed.' Also: 'The music of Sangjian and Pushang is the music of a dying state, its government is lax, its people are drifting.' 'Records of the Grand Historian: Book of Music': 'The music of a dying state is mournful and thoughtful, its people are distressed.'
example: 卿勿为～，使人悒悒。★清·蒲松龄《聊斋志异·林四娘》
exampleTraditional: 卿勿為～，使人悒悒。★清·蒲松齡《聊齋志異·林四娘》
exampleEn: Do not make the music of a dying state, it makes one melancholy. — Qing Dynasty, Pu Songling, 'Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio: Lin Siniang'

explanation: 象吃蜡一样，没有一点儿味。形容语言或文章枯燥无味。见味同嚼蜡”。
explanationTraditional: 象吃蠟一樣，沒有一點兒味。形容語言或文章枯燥無味。見味同嚼蠟”。
explanationEn: Like chewing wax—tasteless. Describes language or writing that is dull and uninteresting.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容范围极为广阔。同无边无际”。
explanationTraditional: 形容範圍極為廣闊。同無邊無際”。
explanationEn: Boundless and vast; extremely extensive.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 没有一点痕迹、影子。形容完全消失。
explanationTraditional: 沒有一點痕跡、影子。形容完全消失。
explanationEn: Without a trace or shadow. Describes complete disappearance.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十六回说毕，一阵香风，无踪无影去了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十六回說畢，一陣香風，無蹤無影去了。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 66: 'After saying this, a fragrant wind blew, and he disappeared without a trace.'
example: 端甫道此刻～的，往哪里去访寻呢。只得破了脸，追问景翼。”★清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 端甫道此刻～的，往哪裡去訪尋呢。只得破了臉，追問景翼。”★清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第三十三回
exampleEn: Duanfu said, 'Now there is no trace or shadow, where can we go to find him? We have no choice but to break the matter and question Jingyi.' — Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, 'Strange Events Witnessed in the Past Twenty Years', Chapter 33

explanation: 逐追随；颜脸面，面容。形容十分喜悦，满脸笑容。
explanationTraditional: 逐追隨；顏臉面，面容。形容十分喜悅，滿臉笑容。
explanationEn: Joy chases the face open; describes extreme happiness with a beaming smile.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第七回学道看罢，不觉喜逐颜开，一天愁都没有了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第七回學道看罷，不覺喜逐顏開，一天愁都沒有了。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jingzi, 'The Scholars', Chapter 7: 'The examiner read it and couldn't help but beam with joy, all his worries gone.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 星星和月亮交相照耀。
explanationTraditional: 星星和月亮交相照耀。
explanationEn: Stars and moon shine together, illuminating each other.
derivation: 宋·欧阳修《秋声赋》星月皎洁，明河在天。” 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第六十九回至正月十五夜，天色晴霁，星月交辉，六行走三市，竞放花灯。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·歐陽修《秋聲賦》星月皎潔，明河在天。” 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第六十九回至正月十五夜，天色晴霽，星月交輝，六行走三市，競放花燈。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Ouyang Xiu, 'Autumn Sound Rhapsody': 'Stars and moon are bright, the Milky Way is in the sky.' Ming Dynasty, Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 69: 'On the night of the fifteenth of the first month, the sky was clear, stars and moon shone together, and the streets were filled with lanterns.'
example: 这三月十四日晚上，～，风清气爽。★清·西周生《醒世姻缘传》第九十回
exampleTraditional: 這三月十四日晚上，～，風清氣爽。★清·西周生《醒世姻緣傳》第九十回
exampleEn: On the evening of March 14th, stars and moon shone together, the wind was clear and the air refreshing. — Qing Dynasty, Xi Zhou Sheng, 'Marriage Destinies to Awaken the World', Chapter 90

explanation: 羊续，汉时官吏。羊续把生鱼悬于庭。形容为官清廉，拒受贿赂。
explanationTraditional: 羊續，漢時官吏。羊續把生魚懸於庭。形容為官清廉，拒受賄賂。
explanationEn: Yang Xu hung a fish in the courtyard. Describes an official who is incorruptible and refuses bribes.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 改正一个字的老师。有些好诗文，经旁人改换一个字后更为完美，往往称改字的人为一字师”或一字之师”。
explanationTraditional: 改正一個字的老師。有些好詩文，經旁人改換一個字後更為完美，往往稱改字的人為一字師”或一字之師”。
explanationEn: A teacher who corrects one character. Refers to someone who improves a poem or text by changing a single word, often called a 'one-word teacher'.
derivation: 宋·计有功《唐诗纪事》郑谷改僧齐己《早梅》诗‘数枝开’作‘一枝开’。齐己下拜，人以谷为一字师。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·計有功《唐詩紀事》鄭谷改僧齊己《早梅》詩‘數枝開’作‘一枝開’。齊己下拜，人以谷為一字師。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty Ji Yougong's 'Anecdotes of Tang Poets': Zheng Gu changed a line in Monk Qiji's poem 'Early Plum Blossoms' from 'several branches bloom' to 'one branch blooms'. Qiji bowed in respect, and people called Zheng Gu a 'one-word teacher'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 佛教禅宗用语。指离开语文文字而以慧心相传授。
explanationTraditional: 佛教禪宗用語。指離開語文文字而以慧心相傳授。
explanationEn: A Buddhist Zen term meaning to transmit teachings from mind to mind without relying on words or texts.
derivation: 《六祖大师法宝坛经·行由品》法则以心传心，皆令自悟自解。”
derivationTraditional: 《六祖大師法寶壇經·行由品》法則以心傳心，皆令自悟自解。”
derivationEn: 'The Platform Sutra of the Sixth Patriarch': 'The Dharma is transmitted from mind to mind, each must awaken and understand by themselves.'
example: 师问只如古德，岂不是～？”★宋·释道原《景德传灯录》卷十八
exampleTraditional: 師問只如古德，豈不是～？”★宋·釋道原《景德傳燈錄》卷十八
exampleEn: The master asked, 'Is it not like the ancient virtuous ones, transmitting from mind to mind?' - Song Dynasty Shi Daoyuan's 'Transmission of the Lamp' Volume 18

explanation: 指超逸不俗的情趣洋溢而出。
explanationTraditional: 指超逸不俗的情趣洋溢而出。
explanationEn: Describes an overflow of refined and unconventional charm or interest.
derivation: 清顾禄《桐桥倚棹录·冢墓》[梅花和尚钱堉]醉后落笔，逸趣横生，自谓醒时不及也。”
derivationTraditional: 清顧祿《桐橋倚棹錄·冢墓》[梅花和尚錢堉]醉後落筆，逸趣橫生，自謂醒時不及也。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty Gu Lu's 'Records of Leaning on the Bridge at Tongli': '[The painter Qian Kun] after drinking, his brushstrokes overflowed with unconventional charm, and he said he could not match it when sober.'
example: 郭老的发言总是～，写的则是笔花四照。★冰心《晚晴集·悼郭老》
exampleTraditional: 郭老的發言總是～，寫的則是筆花四照。★冰心《晚晴集·悼郭老》
exampleEn: Guo Lao's speeches always overflow with unconventional charm, and his writings are brilliant. - Bing Xin's 'Evening Collection: Mourning Guo Lao'

explanation: 坚硬的榆树根。比喻思想顽固。
explanationTraditional: 堅硬的榆樹根。比喻思想頑固。
explanationEn: A hard elm root. Metaphor for a stubborn person.
derivation: 葛洛《卫生组长》人人都是封建迷信脑袋，像榆木疙瘩一样，三斧子五斧子劈不开。”
derivationTraditional: 葛洛《衛生組長》人人都是封建迷信腦袋，像榆木疙瘩一樣，三斧子五斧子劈不開。”
derivationEn: Ge Luo's 'Health Team Leader': 'Everyone has a feudal superstitious mind, like an elm root, impossible to split with three or five axe blows.'
example: 罗心刚老夏？你认识？”夏雨岂止认识！是我爸爸，典型的～脑袋！”★《新华文摘》1981年第2期
exampleTraditional: 羅心剛老夏？你認識？”夏雨豈止認識！是我爸爸，典型的～腦袋！”★《新華文摘》1981年第2期
exampleEn: Luo Xingang: 'Old Xia? You know him?' Xia Yu: 'Of course I know him! He's my father, a typical elm root head!' - 'Xinhua Digest' Issue 2, 1981

explanation: 治治理；安安定。治理国家，安定人民。
explanationTraditional: 治治理；安安定。治理國家，安定人民。
explanationEn: To govern the country and bring peace to the people.
derivation: 《汉书·食货志上》财者，帝王所以聚人守位，养成群生，奉顺天德，治国安民之本也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·食貨志上》財者，帝王所以聚人守位，養成群生，奉順天德，治國安民之本也。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Treatise on Food and Money': 'Wealth is the means by which emperors gather people, maintain positions, nurture lives, and follow heaven's virtue; it is the foundation of governing the country and pacifying the people.'
example: 十一届三中全会以来，中央政府实行了一整套～的措施。
exampleTraditional: 十一屆三中全會以來，中央政府實行了一整套～的措施。
exampleEn: Since the Third Plenary Session of the 11th Central Committee, the central government has implemented a complete set of measures to govern the country and pacify the people.

explanation: 案牍公文。文书劳累身体。形容公事繁忙。
explanationTraditional: 案牘公文。文書勞累身體。形容公事繁忙。
explanationEn: Documents tire the body. Describes being busy with official paperwork.
derivation: 唐·刘禹锡《陋室铭》无丝竹之乱耳，无案牍之劳形。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·劉禹錫《陋室銘》無絲竹之亂耳，無案牘之勞形。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty Liu Yuxi's 'Inscription of My Humble Room': 'No stringed instruments disturb my ears, no official documents tire my body.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻文人才思俊逸，写作的诗文极佳。
explanationTraditional: 比喻文人才思俊逸，寫作的詩文極佳。
explanationEn: Metaphor for a writer's brilliant talent, producing excellent poetry or prose.
derivation: 五代·王仁裕《开元天宝遗事下》李太白少时梦所用之笔头上生花，后天才赡逸，名闻天下。”
derivationTraditional: 五代·王仁裕《開元天寶遺事下》李太白少時夢所用之筆頭上生花，後天才贍逸，名聞天下。”
derivationEn: Five Dynasties Wang Renyu's 'Anecdotes of Kaiyuan and Tianbao Era': 'When Li Bai was young, he dreamed that flowers grew from the tip of his brush; later his talent became extraordinary and famous worldwide.'
example: 晚唐诗人杜牧才气过人，～，创作了许多诗文佳品，尤以《阿房宫赋》传诵千古。
exampleTraditional: 晚唐詩人杜牧才氣過人，～，創作了許多詩文佳品，尤以《阿房宮賦》傳誦千古。
exampleEn: The late Tang poet Du Mu was exceptionally talented; his brush produced flowers, and he created many excellent poems and essays, especially 'Ode to Afang Palace' which has been recited through the ages.

explanation: 长物多余的东西。除一身之外再没有多余的东西。原指生活俭朴。现形容贫穷。
explanationTraditional: 長物多餘的東西。除一身之外再沒有多餘的東西。原指生活儉樸。現形容貧窮。
explanationEn: Having no extra possessions besides oneself. Originally described a frugal life; now means extreme poverty.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·德行》丈人不悉恭，恭作人无长物。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·德行》丈人不悉恭，恭作人無長物。”
derivationEn: Southern Dynasty Liu Yiqing's 'A New Account of the Tales of the World: Virtuous Conduct': 'Sir, you do not know me; I have no extra possessions.'
example: 他们除双手外，～，其经济地位和产业工人相似。★毛泽东《中国社会各阶级的分析》
exampleTraditional: 他們除雙手外，～，其經濟地位和產業工人相似。★毛澤東《中國社會各階級的分析》
exampleEn: They have nothing besides their hands, and their economic status is similar to industrial workers. - Mao Zedong's 'Analysis of the Classes in Chinese Society'

explanation: 顾顾念，考虑。连生死也不考虑了。形容拼命蛮干，不顾一切。
explanationTraditional: 顧顧念，考慮。連生死也不考慮了。形容拼命蠻幹，不顧一切。
explanationEn: Not considering life or death. Describes acting recklessly or desperately, regardless of consequences.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第六十三回这呆子不顾死活，闯上宫殿，一路钯，筑破门扇，打破桌椅，把些吃酒的家伙之类，尽皆打碎。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第六十三回這呆子不顧死活，闖上宮殿，一路鈀，築破門扇，打破桌椅，把些吃酒的傢伙之類，盡皆打碎。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty Wu Cheng'en's 'Journey to the West' Chapter 63: 'This idiot, regardless of life or death, charged into the palace, smashing doors and tables with his rake, breaking all the drinking utensils.'
example: 他们更希望有经验的人来领导他们，他们原意～地保卫家乡。★巴金《火》第二部十
exampleTraditional: 他們更希望有經驗的人來領導他們，他們原意～地保衛家鄉。★巴金《火》第二部十
exampleEn: They hope for experienced leaders to guide them; they are willing to defend their homeland regardless of life or death. - Ba Jin's 'Fire' Part 2, Chapter 10

explanation: 咎责怪。对以往的错误或罪责不再追究。
explanationTraditional: 咎責怪。對以往的錯誤或罪責不再追究。
explanationEn: Not to blame someone for past mistakes or crimes; to forgive and forget.
derivation: 《论语·八佾》成事不说，遂事不谏，既往不咎。”
derivationTraditional: 《論語·八佾》成事不說，遂事不諫，既往不咎。”
derivationEn: The Analects of Confucius, Ba Yi: 'Things that are done, it is useless to speak of; things that have gone by, it is useless to blame.'
example: 既然他已经承认了错误，我们就可以～了。
exampleTraditional: 既然他已經承認了錯誤，我們就可以～了。
exampleEn: Since he has admitted his mistake, we can forgive and forget.

explanation: 不嫌详细。指越详细越好。
explanationTraditional: 不嫌詳細。指越詳細越好。
explanationEn: Not minding going into detail; the more detailed, the better.
derivation: 宋·朱熹《答刘公度》讲学不厌其详，凡天下事物之理，方册圣贤之言，皆须子细反覆究竟。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·朱熹《答劉公度》講學不厭其詳，凡天下事物之理，方冊聖賢之言，皆鬚子細反覆究竟。”
derivationEn: Zhu Xi, Song Dynasty, Reply to Liu Gongdu: 'In teaching, one should not tire of detail; all principles of things in the world and words of sages must be carefully and repeatedly examined.'
example: 我那时确实从心底里关心这个孤苦的小女孩，就～的问黎凤关于小英的事。★茹志娟《在果树园里》
exampleTraditional: 我那時確實從心底裡關心這個孤苦的小女孩，就～的問黎鳳關於小英的事。★茹志娟《在果樹園裡》
exampleEn: At that time, I truly cared about this lonely little girl from the bottom of my heart, so I asked Li Feng about Xiao Ying in great detail. — Ru Zhijuan, In the Orchard

explanation: 败衰败。残凋残。凋残的柳树，残败了的花。旧时用以比喻生活放荡或被蹂躏遗弃的女子。
explanationTraditional: 敗衰敗。殘凋殘。凋殘的柳樹，殘敗了的花。舊時用以比喻生活放蕩或被蹂躪遺棄的女子。
explanationEn: Withered flowers and decayed willows; metaphor for a woman who has been promiscuous or abandoned, often used derogatorily.
derivation: 元·白朴《墙头马上》三折休把似残花败柳冤仇结，我与你生男长女填还彻，指望生则同衾，死则共穴。”
derivationTraditional: 元·白樸《牆頭馬上》三折休把似殘花敗柳冤仇結，我與你生男長女填還徹，指望生則同衾，死則共穴。”
derivationEn: Yuan drama, Bai Pu, On the Wall: 'Do not tie a knot of enmity like withered flowers and decayed willows; I have borne you sons and daughters, hoping to share the same quilt in life and the same tomb in death.'
example: 我是个嫩蕊娇花，不比那～。★明·无名氏《女贞观》第二折
exampleTraditional: 我是個嫩蕊嬌花，不比那～。★明·無名氏《女貞觀》第二折
exampleEn: I am a tender bud and delicate flower, not like those withered flowers and decayed willows. — Ming Dynasty, Anonymous, Nü Zhen Guan, Act 2

explanation: 当道横在道路中间。比喻坏人当权。
explanationTraditional: 當道橫在道路中間。比喻壞人當權。
explanationEn: Jackals and wolves blocking the road; metaphor for evil people in power.
derivation: 汉·荀悦《汉纪·平帝纪》宝问其次，文曰‘豺狼当道，安问狐狸！’宝默然不应。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·荀悅《漢紀·平帝紀》寶問其次，文曰‘豺狼當道，安問狐狸！’寶默然不應。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Xun Yue, Han Ji: 'When jackals and wolves block the road, why ask about foxes?'
example: 男子汉非不以功名为念，那堪～，不如只在家中侍奉尊堂兄弟。★元·宫大用《范张鸡黍》第一折
exampleTraditional: 男子漢非不以功名為念，那堪～，不如只在家中侍奉尊堂兄弟。★元·宮大用《范張雞黍》第一折
exampleEn: A man of honor does not fail to think of fame and achievement, but when jackals and wolves block the road, it is better to stay home and serve his parents and brothers. — Yuan Drama, Gong Dayong, Fan Zhang Ji Shu, Act 1

explanation: 指超出世事离群独居。
explanationTraditional: 指超出世事離群獨居。
explanationEn: To stand aloof from worldly affairs and live in seclusion.
derivation: 《淮南子·修务训》君子……超然独立，卓然离世。”
derivationTraditional: 《淮南子·修務訓》君子……超然獨立，卓然離世。”
derivationEn: Huainanzi, Cultivating Effort: 'A gentleman... stands aloof and independent, towering above the world.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 昭显着。形容坏名声尽人皆知。亦作臭名昭著”。
explanationTraditional: 昭顯著。形容壞名聲盡人皆知。亦作臭名昭著”。
explanationEn: Infamous; notorious; having a bad reputation widely known.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指没有正当理由而出兵征伐。
explanationTraditional: 指沒有正當理由而出兵征伐。
explanationEn: To dispatch troops without just cause; to wage war without legitimate reason.
derivation: 《新唐书·东夷传·高丽》莫离支杀君，虐用其下如檴阱，怨痛溢道，我出师无名哉？”
derivationTraditional: 《新唐書·東夷傳·高麗》莫離支殺君，虐用其下如檴阱，怨痛溢道，我出師無名哉？”
derivationEn: New Book of Tang, Eastern Barbarians, Goguryeo: 'The regicide killed his ruler and abused his people like a trap; resentment fills the roads. How can we dispatch troops without just cause?'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 像春天的和风和雨滴露水那样滋润着万物的生长。旧常用以比喻恩泽。
explanationTraditional: 像春天的和風和雨滴露水那樣滋潤著萬物的生長。舊常用以比喻恩澤。
explanationEn: Spring breeze and rain dew; metaphor for grace or favor that nurtures growth.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 存心怀着某种心思或打算。指存着坏心眼。
explanationTraditional: 存心懷著某種心思或打算。指存著壞心眼。
explanationEn: To harbor evil intentions; to have bad motives.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第一百六回他不服查账，非但是有弊病，一定是存心不良的了。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第一百六回他不服查賬，非但是有弊病，一定是存心不良的了。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wu Jianren, Strange Events of the Past Twenty Years, Chapter 106: 'If he refuses to accept an audit, it is not only because of irregularities, but certainly because he harbors evil intentions.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 丹青原指丹砂和青欔两种作颜料的矿物，后泛指颜料。多指国画大师。
explanationTraditional: 丹青原指丹砂和青欔兩種作顏料的礦物，後泛指顏料。多指國畫大師。
explanationEn: A master painter; especially a master of Chinese painting.
derivation: 唐·高蟾《金陵晚眺》世间无限丹青手，一片伤心画不成。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·高蟾《金陵晚眺》世間無限丹青手，一片傷心畫不成。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Gao Chan, Evening View at Jinling: 'There are countless master painters in the world, but none can paint this heartbreak.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 叨谦词，受到（好处）；陪奉陪；末座席中最后的座位。这是受人宴请的客气话。
explanationTraditional: 叨謙詞，受到（好處）；陪奉陪；末座席中最後的座位。這是受人宴請的客氣話。
explanationEn: A polite expression used when being invited to a banquet, meaning to have the honor of sitting at the lowest seat.
derivation: 《仪礼·士冠礼》兴，筵末坐啐醴。”
derivationTraditional: 《儀禮·士冠禮》興，筵末坐啐醴。”
derivationEn: From 'Yili: Shiguanli': 'Rise, sit at the end of the mat, and sip the sweet wine.'
example: 学艺社曾经大大地欢宴过他们，请了章士钊做陪客，我自己也曾～。（郭沫若《革命春秋·创造十年续编》）
exampleTraditional: 學藝社曾經大大地歡宴過他們，請了章士釗做陪客，我自己也曾～。（郭沫若《革命春秋·創造十年續編》）
exampleEn: The Xueyi Society once held a grand banquet for them, inviting Zhang Shizhao as a guest, and I myself had the honor of sitting at the lowest seat. (Guo Moruo, 'Revolutionary Spring: Continuation of the Decade of Creation')

explanation: 用白粉装饰，用白玉砌成。形容雪景及人皮肤白嫩。
explanationTraditional: 用白粉裝飾，用白玉砌成。形容雪景及人皮膚白嫩。
explanationEn: Describes a snow scene or fair skin, as if decorated with white powder and built with white jade.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 丰姿风姿，风度姿态。绰约柔美的样子。形容女子体态柔美，神采飘逸。同丰神绰约”。
explanationTraditional: 丰姿風姿，風度姿態。綽約柔美的樣子。形容女子體態柔美，神采飄逸。同丰神綽約”。
explanationEn: Describes a woman's graceful and elegant bearing and figure.
derivation: 清·曾朴《孽海花》第七回 一回头时，却见那轿子里坐着个十四五岁的不长不短、不肥不瘦的女郎，面如瓜子，脸若桃花，两条欲蹙不蹙的蛾眉，一双似开非开的凤眼，似曾相识，莫道无情，正是说不尽的体态风流，丰姿绰约。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曾樸《孽海花》第七回 一回頭時，卻見那轎子裡坐著個十四五歲的不長不短、不肥不瘦的女郎，面如瓜子，臉若桃花，兩條欲蹙不蹙的蛾眉，一雙似開非開的鳳眼，似曾相識，莫道無情，正是說不盡的體態風流，丰姿綽約。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower in the Sea of Sins', Chapter 7: 'Turning around, she saw a girl of about fourteen or fifteen in the sedan chair, neither tall nor short, neither fat nor thin, with a melon-seed face and peach-blossom cheeks, eyebrows that seemed to frown yet did not, and eyes that seemed to open yet did not, with an indescribably charming demeanor and graceful bearing.'
example: 李文益～，冰雪聪明。★清·李斗《扬州画舫录·新城北录下》
exampleTraditional: 李文益～，冰雪聰明。★清·李鬥《揚州畫舫錄·新城北錄下》
exampleEn: Li Wenyi was graceful and intelligent. (Qing Dynasty Li Dou, 'Yangzhou Huafang Lu: New City North Record')

explanation: 仪容仪。凤凰来舞，仪表非凡。古代指吉祥的征兆。
explanationTraditional: 儀容儀。鳳凰來舞，儀表非凡。古代指吉祥的徵兆。
explanationEn: A phoenix comes to dance with extraordinary grace, an ancient omen of good fortune.
derivation: 唐·柳宗元《晋问》有百兽率舞，凤凰来仪，于变时雍之美，故其人至于今和而不怒。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·柳宗元《晉問》有百獸率舞，鳳凰來儀，於變時雍之美，故其人至於今和而不怒。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Liu Zongyuan's 'Jin Wen': 'There was the beauty of all beasts dancing and phoenixes coming to perform, so the people there are harmonious and not angry to this day.'
example: 自魏即位以来，麒麟降生，～。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第八十回
exampleTraditional: 自魏即位以來，麒麟降生，～。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第八十回
exampleEn: Since Wei ascended the throne, qilins have been born and phoenixes have come to perform. (Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong, 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 80)

explanation: 抚拍。拍手大笑。形容非常高兴。
explanationTraditional: 撫拍。拍手大笑。形容非常高興。
explanationEn: To clap hands and laugh heartily, expressing great joy.
derivation: 南朝·宋·刘义庆《世说新语·纰漏》帝抚掌大笑。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·宋·劉義慶《世說新語·紕漏》帝撫掌大笑。”
derivationEn: From Southern Dynasty Liu Yiqing's 'Shishuo Xinyu: Pileu': 'The emperor clapped his hands and laughed heartily.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 瓞小瓜；绵绵延续不断的样子。如同一根连绵不断的藤上结了许多大大小小的瓜一样。引用为祝颂子孙昌盛。
explanationTraditional: 瓞小瓜；綿綿延續不斷的樣子。如同一根連綿不斷的藤上結了許多大大小小的瓜一樣。引用為祝頌子孫昌盛。
explanationEn: Like a continuous vine bearing many melons, big and small; used to wish for numerous descendants and prosperity.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·绵》绵绵瓜瓞，民之初生，自土沮漆。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·綿》綿綿瓜瓞，民之初生，自土沮漆。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs: Daya: Mian': 'The melons and gourds are continuous, the people first born, from the Tu and Qi rivers.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 光焰光辉。灿烂的光辉射向远方。原形容诗文美妙，留传后世。现多形容新生事物前程远大。
explanationTraditional: 光焰光輝。燦爛的光輝射向遠方。原形容詩文美妙，留傳後世。現多形容新生事物前程遠大。
explanationEn: Originally described brilliant poetry that would be passed down through generations; now often describes new things with a bright future.
derivation: 唐·韩愈《调张籍》诗李杜文章在，光焰万丈长。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·韓愈《調張籍》詩李杜文章在，光焰萬丈長。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Han Yu's poem 'To Zhang Ji': 'The writings of Li and Du shine with a light that will last ten thousand years.'
example: ～地，将要出现了哟——新生的太阳！★郭沫若《女神·太阳礼赞》
exampleTraditional: ～地，將要出現了喲——新生的太陽！★郭沫若《女神·太陽禮讚》
exampleEn: Radiant with boundless light, the newborn sun is about to appear! (Guo Moruo, 'Goddess: Ode to the Sun')

explanation: 指为国事而忘其家。
explanationTraditional: 指為國事而忘其家。
explanationEn: To forget one's family for the sake of the country.
derivation: 《儒林外史》第六回但自古道‘公而忘私，国而忘家。’我们科场是朝廷大典，你我为朝廷办事，就是不顾私亲，也还觉得于心无愧。”
derivationTraditional: 《儒林外史》第六回但自古道‘公而忘私，國而忘家。’我們科場是朝廷大典，你我為朝廷辦事，就是不顧私親，也還覺得於心無愧。”
derivationEn: From 'The Scholars', Chapter 6: 'But since ancient times, it is said: 'Put public before private, forget family for the country.' Our examination hall is a grand affair of the court; as officials serving the court, even if we disregard our own relatives, we should still feel no shame.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 毁誉诋毁和称赞；不一不一样，不一致。有人说好，有人说坏，说法不一。
explanationTraditional: 譭譽詆譭和稱讚；不一不一樣，不一致。有人說好，有人說壞，說法不一。
explanationEn: Some praise, some criticize; opinions vary.
derivation: 清·名教中人《好逑传》第十七回外臣毁誉不一，俱着各自据实奏闻。”
derivationTraditional: 清·名教中人《好逑傳》第十七回外臣譭譽不一，俱著各自據實奏聞。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Mingjiao Zhongren's 'The Good Match', Chapter 17: 'The opinions of external officials are inconsistent; all are to report truthfully according to their own views.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 济、扶帮助。救济贫困的人，扶助有危难的人。
explanationTraditional: 濟、扶幫助。救濟貧困的人，扶助有危難的人。
explanationEn: To help the poor and aid those in danger.
derivation: 元·郑廷玉《楚昭公》第三折一个报冤仇称了子胥，一个打赌赛去了包胥，何处也济困扶危重复楚。”
derivationTraditional: 元·鄭廷玉《楚昭公》第三折一個報冤仇稱了子胥，一個打賭賽去了包胥，何處也濟困扶危重複楚。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Zheng Tingyu's 'Chu Zhaogong', Third Act: 'One avenged his grievance as Wu Zixu, one won the bet as Bao Xu, where is the one who helps the poor and aids the endangered to restore Chu?'
example: 你是最肯～的人，难道就眼睁睁的看着人家来摆布死了我们娘儿们不成？★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第二十五回
exampleTraditional: 你是最肯～的人，難道就眼睜睜的看著人家來擺佈死了我們娘兒們不成？★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第二十五回
exampleEn: You are the most willing to help the poor and aid the endangered; how can you just watch others come to torment us mother and son? (Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin, 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 25)

explanation: 济拯救；邦国家。拯救时世，安定国家。
explanationTraditional: 濟拯救；邦國家。拯救時世，安定國家。
explanationEn: To save the world and stabilize the country; to rescue the times and bring peace to the nation.
derivation: 元·无名氏《九世同堂》第一折你学济世安邦策，按六韬三略书。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《九世同堂》第一折你學濟世安邦策，按六韜三略書。”
derivationEn: Yuan Dynasty, Anonymous, 'Nine Generations Under One Roof', Act 1: 'You learn the strategy to save the world and stabilize the country, following the Six Strategies and Three Tactics.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 将门世代为将的人家。比喻父辈有才能，子孙也身手不凡。也指后生子弟不辱门庭。
explanationTraditional: 將門世代為將的人家。比喻父輩有才能，子孫也身手不凡。也指後生子弟不辱門庭。
explanationEn: A brave son from a family of generals; metaphor for a child who is as capable as their parent, or a young person who does not disgrace their family.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 毫无保留地献出一片忠诚和所有才智。
explanationTraditional: 毫無保留地獻出一片忠誠和所有才智。
explanationEn: To devote all one's loyalty and wisdom without reservation.
derivation: 《屈原列传》屈平正道直行，竭忠尽智，以事其君。”
derivationTraditional: 《屈原列傳》屈平正道直行，竭忠盡智，以事其君。”
derivationEn: 'Biography of Qu Yuan': 'Qu Yuan followed the right path and acted uprightly, exhausting his loyalty and wisdom to serve his lord.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 积虑长期地或一再地思考。费尽心思长时间的思考问题。
explanationTraditional: 積慮長期地或一再地思考。費盡心思長時間的思考問題。
explanationEn: To rack one's brains and think over a long period; to expend great effort and prolonged thought.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 奇逢谓其苦心积虑，阅历深而动忍孰。《清史稿·文苑传·申涵光》
exampleTraditional: 奇逢謂其苦心積慮，閱歷深而動忍孰。《清史稿·文苑傳·申涵光》
exampleEn: Qifeng said that he had racked his brains and accumulated worries, experienced deeply and endured silently. — 'Draft History of Qing: Biography of Shen Hanguang'

explanation: 指不顾脸面或不顾一切，狠狠；也满头满脸。
explanationTraditional: 指不顧臉面或不顧一切，狠狠；也滿頭滿臉。
explanationEn: To disregard face or recklessly; also means all over the head and face.
derivation: 明·吴承恩《西游记》第45回那道士闻得此言，拦住门，一齐动叉钯、扫帚、瓦块、石头，没头没脸，往里面乱打。”
derivationTraditional: 明·吳承恩《西遊記》第45回那道士聞得此言，攔住門，一齊動叉鈀、掃帚、瓦塊、石頭，沒頭沒臉，往裡面亂打。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Wu Cheng'en, 'Journey to the West', Chapter 45: 'Upon hearing this, the Taoist blocked the door and together they attacked with forks, brooms, tiles, and stones, hitting indiscriminately all over the head and face.'
example: 咱们得有点身价，以后不准你～地去撩骚。★陈登科《破壁记》第五章
exampleTraditional: 咱們得有點身價，以後不准你～地去撩騷。★陳登科《破壁記》第五章
exampleEn: We need to maintain some dignity; from now on, you are not allowed to flirt shamelessly. — Chen Dengke, 'Breaking Through the Wall', Chapter 5

explanation: 久经岁月。指时间长久。
explanationTraditional: 久經歲月。指時間長久。
explanationEn: Over many years; referring to a long period of time.
derivation: 《二刻拍案惊奇》卷九那晓得花园门年深月久，苦不甚牢，早被外边一伙人踢开了一扇。”
derivationTraditional: 《二刻拍案驚奇》卷九那曉得花園門年深月久，苦不甚牢，早被外邊一夥人踢開了一扇。”
derivationEn: 'Erke Pai'an Jingqi', Volume 9: 'Who would have known that the garden gate, having been there for many years, was not very sturdy, and was soon kicked open by a group of outsiders.'
example: 张奇一口气吃了两三碗热酒，用脚将门一蹬，那门闩是日夜开闭，～，滑溜异常，一脚激动，便跳将出来。★清·褚人获《隋唐演义》第十二回
exampleTraditional: 張奇一口氣吃了兩三碗熱酒，用腳將門一蹬，那門閂是日夜開閉，～，滑溜異常，一腳激動，便跳將出來。★清·褚人獲《隋唐演義》第十二回
exampleEn: Zhang Qi drank two or three bowls of hot wine in one breath, kicked the door with his foot, and the door bolt, having been opened and closed day and night for many years, was extremely slippery, and with one kick, it jumped out. — Qing Dynasty, Chu Renhuo, 'Romance of Sui and Tang', Chapter 12

explanation: 一块瓦都没有了。形容房屋全部毁坏。
explanationTraditional: 一塊瓦都沒有了。形容房屋全部毀壞。
explanationEn: Not a single tile remains; describes complete destruction of buildings.
derivation: 《明史·五行志一》贵州暴雪，形如土砖，民居片瓦无存者。”
derivationTraditional: 《明史·五行志一》貴州暴雪，形如土磚，民居片瓦無存者。”
derivationEn: 'History of Ming: Treatise on the Five Elements': 'In Guizhou, a violent hailstorm occurred, with hailstones shaped like adobe bricks, leaving not a single tile on the people's houses.'
example: 疯僧，你就把相府烧个～，我也要把你解到有司衙门，打你八十竹棍，方出我胸中之气。”★《济公全传》第十九回
exampleTraditional: 瘋僧，你就把相府燒個～，我也要把你解到有司衙門，打你八十竹棍，方出我胸中之氣。”★《濟公全傳》第十九回
exampleEn: Mad Monk, even if you burn down the prime minister's mansion to the ground, I will still take you to the authorities and have you beaten eighty bamboo rods to vent my anger! — 'The Legend of Ji Gong', Chapter 19

explanation: 不多的几句话，极少的几个字。指零碎的文字材料。
explanationTraditional: 不多的幾句話，極少的幾個字。指零碎的文字材料。
explanationEn: A few words or a few characters; refers to fragmentary written material.
derivation: 晋·陆机《谢平原内史表》片言只字，不关其间；事踪笔迹，皆可推校。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·陸機《謝平原內史表》片言隻字，不關其間；事蹤筆跡，皆可推校。”
derivationEn: Jin Dynasty, Lu Ji, 'Table to the Prince of Pingyuan': 'A few words or a few characters are not involved in this; the traces of events and handwriting can all be verified.'
example: 君得其～，必手抄之。★清·黄宗羲《五军都督府都事佩于李君墓志铭》
exampleTraditional: 君得其～，必手抄之。★清·黃宗羲《五軍都督府都事佩於李君墓誌銘》
exampleEn: Whenever he obtained a few words or characters from you, he would copy them by hand. — Qing Dynasty, Huang Zongxi, 'Epitaph for Li Peiyu, Commander of the Five Military Commands'

explanation: 为男女爱慕之典实。
explanationTraditional: 為男女愛慕之典實。
explanationEn: A classic allusion to love between a man and a woman.
derivation: 唐·白居易《井底引银瓶》诗妾弄青梅凭短墙，君骑白马傍垂杨。墙头马上遥相顾，一见知君即断肠。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·白居易《井底引銀瓶》詩妾弄青梅憑短牆，君騎白馬傍垂楊。牆頭馬上遙相顧，一見知君即斷腸。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Bai Juyi, 'Drawing Water from the Well' poem: 'I played with green plums by the low wall, you rode a white horse by the poplar. We glanced at each other from wall and horse, and at first sight I knew you would break my heart.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 愿象犬马那样为君主奔走效力。表示心甘情愿受人驱使，为人效劳。
explanationTraditional: 願象犬馬那樣為君主奔走效力。表示心甘情願受人驅使，為人效勞。
explanationEn: To serve like a dog or horse; willing to be driven and serve others.
derivation: 《汉书·孔光传》臣光智谋浅短，犬马齿臷诚恐一旦颠仆，无以报称。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·孔光傳》臣光智謀淺短，犬馬齒臷誠恐一旦顛仆，無以報稱。”
derivationEn: 'Book of Han: Biography of Kong Guang': 'I, Guang, have shallow wisdom and short plans, and my teeth are like those of an old dog or horse; I fear that one day I will fall and have no way to repay.'
example: 李某不才，食禄多矣，无功报德，愿施～。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: 李某不才，食祿多矣，無功報德，願施～。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第六十三回
exampleEn: I, Li, am untalented and have received much salary without merit; I wish to render the service of a dog or horse. — Ming Dynasty, Shi Nai'an, 'Water Margin', Chapter 63

explanation: 形容思想糊涂，愚笨痴呆。
explanationTraditional: 形容思想糊塗，愚笨痴呆。
explanationEn: Describes someone who is muddle-headed, foolish, and stupid.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第九十九回只是我愁宝玉还是那么傻头傻脑的，这么说起来，比头里竟明白多了。'
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第九十九回只是我愁寶玉還是那麼傻頭傻腦的，這麼說起來，比頭裡竟明白多了。'
derivationEn: From Chapter 99 of Dream of the Red Chamber by Cao Xueqin of the Qing Dynasty: 'I was just worried that Baoyu is still so foolish and muddle-headed, but from what he says now, he seems much more sensible than before.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容回音响亮，也比喻此鸣彼应，互相配合。
explanationTraditional: 形容迴音響亮，也比喻此鳴彼應，互相配合。
explanationEn: Describes a loud echo; also metaphorically refers to mutual response and coordination.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《后赤壁赋》戛然长啸，草木震动，山鸣谷应，风起云涌，余亦悄然而悲，肃然而恐，凛乎其不可留也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《後赤壁賦》戛然長嘯，草木震動，山鳴谷應，風起雲湧，餘亦悄然而悲，肅然而恐，凜乎其不可留也。”
derivationEn: From Su Shi's 'Second Ode to the Red Cliff' of the Song Dynasty: 'With a sharp cry, the grass and trees shook, the mountains echoed and the valleys responded, wind rose and clouds surged. I felt a quiet sadness, a solemn fear, and dared not stay long.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 胜友良友。许多良友聚集一处。
explanationTraditional: 勝友良友。許多良友聚集一處。
explanationEn: Many good friends gather together.
derivation: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王阁饯别序》十旬休暇，胜友如云。千里逢迎，高朋满座。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·王勃《秋日登洪府滕王閣餞別序》十旬休暇，勝友如雲。千里逢迎，高朋滿座。”
derivationEn: From Wang Bo's 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng' of the Tang Dynasty: 'During the ten-day holiday, good friends gather like clouds; from a thousand li, honored guests fill the seats.'
example: 今日之聚，可谓极盛了，我出高朋满座，～”，打曲牌名。★清·李汝珍《镜花缘》第八十一回
exampleTraditional: 今日之聚，可謂極盛了，我出高朋滿座，～”，打曲牌名。★清·李汝珍《鏡花緣》第八十一回
exampleEn: Today's gathering can be called extremely grand. I have 'honored guests filling the seats' and 'good friends like clouds'—a tune name. ★ From Chapter 81 of Li Ruzhen's Flowers in the Mirror of the Qing Dynasty.

explanation: 作诗饮酒。古人以此为风流韵事，故称。
explanationTraditional: 作詩飲酒。古人以此為風流韻事，故稱。
explanationEn: Writing poetry and drinking wine; ancients considered this a romantic and refined pursuit.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 探寻求，探测；赜幽深玄妙；索搜求；隐隐秘。探究深奥的道理，搜索隐秘的事情。
explanationTraditional: 探尋求，探測；賾幽深玄妙；索搜求；隱隱秘。探究深奧的道理，搜索隱秘的事情。
explanationEn: To explore profound principles and search for hidden things.
derivation: 《易·系辞上》探赜索隐，钩深致远，以定天下之吉凶，成天下之亹亹者，莫大乎蓍龟。。”
derivationTraditional: 《易·繫辭上》探賾索隱，鉤深致遠，以定天下之吉凶，成天下之亹亹者，莫大乎蓍龜。。”
derivationEn: From the 'Appended Remarks' of the Book of Changes: 'To explore the profound and search out the hidden, to hook up the deep and reach the distant, thereby determining the good and bad fortune of the world and accomplishing the great tasks of the world—nothing is greater than the yarrow and tortoise.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容春日美景。也比喻男女爱情。
explanationTraditional: 形容春日美景。也比喻男女愛情。
explanationEn: Describes the beautiful scenery of spring; also metaphorically refers to romantic love between men and women.
derivation: 唐·李白《山中问答》诗桃花流水窅然去，别有天地非人间。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《山中問答》詩桃花流水窅然去，別有天地非人間。”
derivationEn: From Li Bai's 'Answering a Question in the Mountains' of the Tang Dynasty: 'Peach blossoms and flowing waters go away unseen; there is another heaven and earth beyond the human world.'
example: ～，不出人间。★明·徐宏祖《徐霞客游记·盘江考》
exampleTraditional: ～，不出人間。★明·徐宏祖《徐霞客遊記·盤江考》
exampleEn: Peach blossoms and flowing waters, not leaving the human world. ★ From Xu Hongzu's Travel Diaries of Xu Xiake, 'Study of the Pan River' of the Ming Dynasty.

explanation: 涂泥沼；炭炭火；生灵百姓。人民陷在泥塘和火坑里。形容人民处于极端困苦的境地。
explanationTraditional: 塗泥沼；炭炭火；生靈百姓。人民陷在泥塘和火坑裡。形容人民處於極端困苦的境地。
explanationEn: The people are trapped in mud and fire; describes the people in extreme misery.
derivation: 《尚书·仲虺之诰》有夏昏德，民坠涂炭。”《晋书·苻丕载记》先帝晏驾贼庭，京师鞠为戎穴，神州萧条，生灵涂炭。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·仲虺之誥》有夏昏德，民墜塗炭。”《晉書·苻丕載記》先帝晏駕賊庭，京師鞠為戎穴，神州蕭條，生靈塗炭。”
derivationEn: From the 'Announcement of Zhong Hui' in the Book of Documents: 'The Xia ruler was benighted and the people fell into mud and fire.' Also from the Book of Jin, 'Biography of Fu Pi': 'The late emperor died in the rebel camp, the capital became a den of bandits, the divine land was desolate, and the people were in dire straits.'
example: 若能顺时达变，可保宝贵，毋为～，自贻后悔。★《元史·世祖纪五》
exampleTraditional: 若能順時達變，可保寶貴，毋為～，自貽後悔。★《元史·世祖紀五》
exampleEn: If one can adapt to the times, one can preserve wealth and honor; do not cause the people to suffer, regretting later. ★ From 'Annals of Shizu, Volume 5' of the History of Yuan.

explanation: 万古千秋万代。指某种好的精神或品德永远存在。
explanationTraditional: 萬古千秋萬代。指某種好的精神或品德永遠存在。
explanationEn: Refers to a certain good spirit or virtue lasting forever.
derivation: 元·无名氏《谢金梧》第四折也论功增封食邑，共皇家万古长春。”
derivationTraditional: 元·無名氏《謝金梧》第四折也論功增封食邑，共皇家萬古長春。”
derivationEn: From the fourth act of the anonymous Yuan play 'Xie Jinwu': 'Also, for your merits, we increase your fief and stipend, so that you may enjoy eternal spring with the imperial family.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 能治各种病的灵药。比喻能解决任何问题的好办法。
explanationTraditional: 能治各種病的靈藥。比喻能解決任何問題的好辦法。
explanationEn: A miraculous cure for all diseases; metaphorically refers to a perfect solution for any problem.
derivation: 鲁迅《花边文学·看书琐记（二）》不过我们中国人是聪明的，有些人早已发明了一种万应灵药，就是‘今天天气……哈哈哈！'”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《花邊文學·看書瑣記（二）》不過我們中國人是聰明的，有些人早已發明了一種萬應靈藥，就是‘今天天氣……哈哈哈！'”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Random Thoughts on Reading (II)' in Flower Market Miscellany: 'But we Chinese are clever; some have long invented a panacea: 'Today's weather... haha!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 原比喻残暴的统治迫使自己一方的百姓投向敌方。现多比喻不会团结人，把一些本来可以团结过来的人赶到敌对方面去。
explanationTraditional: 原比喻殘暴的統治迫使自己一方的百姓投向敵方。現多比喻不會團結人，把一些本來可以團結過來的人趕到敵對方面去。
explanationEn: Originally metaphor for cruel rule driving one's own people to the enemy; now often means failing to unite people and driving potential allies to the opposition.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄上》为渊驱鱼者，獭也。为丛驱爵者，鹯也；为汤武驱民者，桀与纣也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁上》為淵驅魚者，獺也。為叢驅爵者，鸇也；為湯武驅民者，桀與紂也。”
derivationEn: From Mencius, 'Li Lou I': 'Those who drive fish into the deep are the otters; those who drive sparrows into the thickets are the hawks; those who drive the people to Tang and Wu are Jie and Zhou.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 病卧床上，不能起来。
explanationTraditional: 病臥床上，不能起來。
explanationEn: Confined to bed due to illness, unable to get up.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》吴主孙休，闻司马炎已篡魏，知其必将伐吴，忧虑成疾，卧床不起。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》吳主孫休，聞司馬炎已篡魏，知其必將伐吳，憂慮成疾，臥床不起。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms': 'Sun Xiu, the ruler of Wu, heard that Sima Yan had usurped Wei and knew he would attack Wu. Worried and ill, he became bedridden.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容兄弟或内部之间的残杀或破坏。
explanationTraditional: 形容兄弟或內部之間的殘殺或破壞。
explanationEn: Describes internal conflict or destruction among brothers or within a group.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 现在正是公司危机之时，每个部门都要团结一致，何必～呢？
exampleTraditional: 現在正是公司危機之時，每個部門都要團結一致，何必～呢？
exampleEn: Now that the company is in crisis, every department must unite. Why must we be so cruel to each other?

explanation: 言说话；据依据。说话一定要有根据。
explanationTraditional: 言說話；據依據。說話一定要有根據。
explanationEn: Every statement must be based on evidence.
derivation: 鲁迅《序言》对于历史小说，则以为博考文献，言必有据者，纵使有人讥为'教授小说'，其实是很难组织之作。”
derivationTraditional: 魯迅《序言》對於歷史小說，則以為博考文獻，言必有據者，縱使有人譏為'教授小說'，其實是很難組織之作。”
derivationEn: From Lu Xun's 'Preface': 'For historical novels, those who extensively research documents and have evidence for every statement, even if mocked as 'professor novels', are actually difficult to compose.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 任职务，责任。一个人承担两种职务。
explanationTraditional: 任職務，責任。一個人承擔兩種職務。
explanationEn: One person holding two positions or responsibilities.
derivation: 《汉书·王吉传》诸侯骨肉莫亲大王，大王于属则子也，于位则臣也，一身而二任之责加焉。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·王吉傳》諸侯骨肉莫親大王，大王於屬則子也，於位則臣也，一身而二任之責加焉。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Wang Ji': 'Among the feudal lords and blood relatives, none is closer than the king. The king is both a son and a minister, thus bearing two responsibilities in one person.'
example: 况于微臣愚陋无比，～，力所不堪。★宋·司马光《辞知制诰第一状》
exampleTraditional: 況於微臣愚陋無比，～，力所不堪。★宋·司馬光《辭知制誥第一狀》
exampleEn: Moreover, I am a humble and foolish minister, yet I bear two responsibilities, which is beyond my ability. — Sima Guang, Song Dynasty

explanation: 永远。
explanationTraditional: 永遠。
explanationEn: Forever; eternally.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 郁郁心里苦闷。闷闷不乐。
explanationTraditional: 鬱郁心裡苦悶。悶悶不樂。
explanationEn: Gloomy and unhappy; in low spirits.
derivation: 唐·蒋防《霍小玉传》伤情感物，郁郁不乐。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·蔣防《霍小玉傳》傷情感物，鬱鬱不樂。”
derivationEn: From Tang Dynasty Jiang Fang's 'Biography of Huo Xiaoyu': 'Moved by emotions and things, she was gloomy and unhappy.'
example: 他那方寸之间，兀自～的，不晓得要怎样才好。★蔡东藩、许廑父《民国通俗演义》第一二一回
exampleTraditional: 他那方寸之間，兀自～的，不曉得要怎樣才好。★蔡東藩、許廑父《民國通俗演義》第一二一回
exampleEn: He was still gloomy and unhappy, not knowing what to do. — Cai Dongfan, 'Popular Romance of the Republic of China'

explanation: 鸢老鹰。鹰在天空飞翔，鱼在水中腾跃。形容万物各得其所。
explanationTraditional: 鳶老鷹。鷹在天空飛翔，魚在水中騰躍。形容萬物各得其所。
explanationEn: Kites fly in the sky, fish leap in the water. Describes all things thriving in their proper places.
derivation: 《诗经·大雅·旱麓》鸢飞戾天，鱼跃于渊。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·大雅·旱麓》鳶飛戾天，魚躍於淵。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Songs: Daya: Hanlu': 'The kite flies to the sky, the fish leaps in the deep.'
example: 清水池塘傍茅舍，～竹万竿。★陈毅《由北京到广州》诗
exampleTraditional: 清水池塘傍茅舍，～竹萬竿。★陳毅《由北京到廣州》詩
exampleEn: A clear pond beside a thatched cottage, kites fly and fish leap among ten thousand bamboos. — Chen Yi, 'From Beijing to Guangzhou'

explanation: 张皇慌张；失措举止失去常态。惊慌得不知怎么办才好。
explanationTraditional: 張皇慌張；失措舉止失去常態。驚慌得不知怎麼辦才好。
explanationEn: Panicked and at a loss; flustered and unsure what to do.
derivation: 清·采蘅子《虫鸣漫录》遍索新郎不得，合家大噪，远近寻觅，廪生与表妹亦张皇失措。”
derivationTraditional: 清·採蘅子《蟲鳴漫錄》遍索新郎不得，閤家大噪，遠近尋覓，廩生與表妹亦張皇失措。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cai Hengzi's 'Notes on Insects and Cicadas': 'They searched everywhere for the groom but couldn't find him. The whole family was in an uproar, and the scholar and his cousin were also panicked and at a loss.'
example: 不管风浪多大，他也不会～的。
exampleTraditional: 不管風浪多大，他也不會～的。
exampleEn: No matter how big the storm, he will not panic and lose his composure.

explanation: 比喻在处理问题过程中意外地发生岔子。
explanationTraditional: 比喻在處理問題過程中意外地發生岔子。
explanationEn: Metaphor for unexpected complications arising during problem-solving.
derivation: 清薛福成《通筹南洋各岛添设领事官保护华民疏》洋人每有人命债公等案，均有领事官自理，往往掣我地方官之肘，从前中国各口之枝节横生，亦实由于此。”
derivationTraditional: 清薛福成《通籌南洋各島添設領事官保護華民疏》洋人每有人命債公等案，均有領事官自理，往往掣我地方官之肘，從前中國各口之枝節橫生，亦實由於此。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Xue Fucheng's 'Memorial on Establishing Consulates in Southeast Asian Ports': 'Foreigners often handle cases involving life and debt through their consuls, which often hinders our local officials. This is why complications have arisen in various Chinese ports.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 知道满足知道适可而止。
explanationTraditional: 知道滿足知道適可而止。
explanationEn: Know contentment and know when to stop.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容双方人力的多少相差极大。
explanationTraditional: 形容雙方人力的多少相差極大。
explanationEn: Describes a situation where the numbers of people on both sides are vastly different.
derivation: 茅盾《一个女性》琼华不能再笑了，在众寡悬殊的形势下，她有些可怜这位被呼为‘遗产’的少年了。”
derivationTraditional: 茅盾《一個女性》瓊華不能再笑了，在眾寡懸殊的形勢下，她有些可憐這位被呼為‘遺產’的少年了。”
derivationEn: Mao Dun's 'A Female': Qiong Hua could no longer laugh; in the situation of great disparity in numbers, she felt some pity for the young man called 'legacy'.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 常指乡村中因陋就简的屋舍。
explanationTraditional: 常指鄉村中因陋就簡的屋舍。
explanationEn: Often refers to a simple and crude house in the countryside.
derivation: 元·乔吉《卖花声·悟世》尘风薄雪，残杯冷炙，掩青灯我竹篱茅舍。”
derivationTraditional: 元·喬吉《賣花聲·悟世》塵風薄雪，殘杯冷炙，掩青燈我竹籬茅舍。”
derivationEn: Yuan·Qiao Ji's 'Selling Flowers·Realizing the World': Dusty wind, thin snow, leftover cups and cold food, I cover the green lamp in my bamboo fence and thatched cottage.
example: 众人瞧那签上，画着一枝老梅，是写着霜晓寒姿”四字，那一面旧诗是～自甘心。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第六十三回
exampleTraditional: 眾人瞧那簽上，畫著一枝老梅，是寫著霜曉寒姿”四字，那一面舊詩是～自甘心。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第六十三回
exampleEn: Everyone looked at the slip, which had a picture of an old plum branch and the words 'cold dawn frosty grace'; on the other side was an old poem: 'Bamboo fence and thatched cottage, content with fate.' — Qing·Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 63

explanation: 把老虎放回山去。比喻把坏人放回老巢，留下祸根。
explanationTraditional: 把老虎放回山去。比喻把壞人放回老巢，留下禍根。
explanationEn: To release a tiger back into the mountains. Metaphorically, to let a villain return to their lair, leaving a source of trouble.
derivation: 晋·司马彪《零陵先贤传》璋遣法正迎刘备，巴谏曰‘备，雄人也，入必为害，不可内也。’既入，巴复谏曰‘若使备讨张鲁，是放虎于山林也。’璋不听。”
derivationTraditional: 晉·司馬彪《零陵先賢傳》璋遣法正迎劉備，巴諫曰‘備，雄人也，入必為害，不可內也。’既入，巴復諫曰‘若使備討張魯，是放虎于山林也。’璋不聽。”
derivationEn: Jin·Sima Biao's 'Biographies of Virtuous Men of Lingling': Zhang sent Fa Zheng to welcome Liu Bei; Ba admonished, 'Bei is a hero; if he enters, he will cause harm, do not let him in.' After he entered, Ba again admonished, 'If you send Bei to attack Zhang Lu, it is like releasing a tiger into the forest.' Zhang did not listen.
example: 今刘备釜中之鱼，阱中之虎；若不就此时擒捉，如放鱼入海，～矣。★明·罗贯中《三国演义》第四十二回
exampleTraditional: 今劉備釜中之魚，阱中之虎；若不就此時擒捉，如放魚入海，～矣。★明·羅貫中《三國演義》第四十二回
exampleEn: Now Liu Bei is a fish in a pot, a tiger in a trap; if we do not capture him now, it will be like releasing a fish into the sea, or letting a tiger return to the mountains. — Ming·Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms', Chapter 42

explanation: 某些人贪爱钱财就像吝啬生命一样。形容十分贪婪、刻薄。
explanationTraditional: 某些人貪愛錢財就像吝嗇生命一樣。形容十分貪婪、刻薄。
explanationEn: Some people love money as if it were their life. Describes extreme greed and stinginess.
derivation: 明·谢谠《四喜记·大宋毕姻》既称月老，又号冰人，爱钱如命，说谎能神，自家高媒婆是也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·謝讜《四喜記·大宋畢姻》既稱月老，又號冰人，愛錢如命，說謊能神，自家高媒婆是也。”
derivationEn: Ming·Xie Dang's 'Four Joys·Great Song Marriage': Called both the moon elder and the ice man, loves money as life, lies like a god, I am the matchmaker Gao.
example: 1942年我在成都重见她的时候，她已经成了一个～的可笑的胖女人。★巴金《谈》
exampleTraditional: 1942年我在成都重見她的時候，她已經成了一個～的可笑的胖女人。★巴金《談》
exampleEn: In 1942 when I saw her again in Chengdu, she had become a ridiculous fat woman who loved money as life. — Ba Jin's 'Talk'

explanation: 傲视寒霜，抗击白雪。形容不畏严寒。比喻人身处逆境而不屈服。
explanationTraditional: 傲視寒霜，抗擊白雪。形容不畏嚴寒。比喻人身處逆境而不屈服。
explanationEn: To defy frost and fight snow. Describes not fearing severe cold. Metaphorically, not yielding in adversity.
derivation: 元·吴昌龄《张天师》第三折玉骨冰肌谁可匹，傲雪欺霜夺第一。”
derivationTraditional: 元·吳昌齡《張天師》第三折玉骨冰肌誰可匹，傲雪欺霜奪第一。”
derivationEn: Yuan·Wu Changling's 'Zhang Tianshi', Act 3: Jade bones and ice skin, who can match? Defying snow and fighting frost, winning first place.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 佛家语，指禅家悟道，不涉文字不依经卷，唯以师徒心心相印，理解契合，传法授受。
explanationTraditional: 佛家語，指禪家悟道，不涉文字不依經卷，唯以師徒心心相印，理解契合，傳法授受。
explanationEn: A Buddhist term meaning that Zen enlightenment does not rely on words or scriptures, but only on the heart-to-heart transmission between master and disciple.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》卷七师问‘祇如古德，岂不是以心传心？’峰曰‘兼不立文字语句。’”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》卷七師問‘祇如古德，豈不是以心傳心？’峰曰‘兼不立文字語句。’”
derivationEn: Song·Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting', Volume 7: The master asked, 'As for the ancient virtues, is it not the transmission of mind to mind?' Feng said, 'And also not establishing words and phrases.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 虞料想；誉称赞。没有意料到的赞扬。
explanationTraditional: 虞料想；譽稱讚。沒有意料到的讚揚。
explanationEn: Yu means anticipate; yu means praise. Unexpected praise.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄上》有不虞之誉，有求全之毁。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁上》有不虞之譽，有求全之毀。”
derivationEn: 'Mencius·Li Lou I': There is unexpected praise, and there is blame that seeks perfection.
example: 但是，～”，也和不虞之毁”一样地无聊。★鲁迅《三闲集·我和（语丝）的始终》
exampleTraditional: 但是，～”，也和不虞之毀”一樣地無聊。★魯迅《三閒集·我和（語絲）的始終》
exampleEn: However, 'unexpected praise' is as boring as 'unexpected blame'. — Lu Xun's 'Three Leisures·The Beginning and End of Me and (Yu Si)'

explanation: 不知道应当前进还是应当后退。比喻无决断。也形容言语行动没有分寸。
explanationTraditional: 不知道應當前進還是應當後退。比喻無決斷。也形容言語行動沒有分寸。
explanationEn: Not knowing whether to advance or retreat. Describes indecisiveness. Also describes inappropriate speech or action.
derivation: 宋·洪迈《容斋续笔》卷十一慕容绍宗挫败侯景，一时将帅皆莫及，而围攻颖川，不知进退，赴水而死。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·洪邁《容齋續筆》卷十一慕容紹宗挫敗侯景，一時將帥皆莫及，而圍攻穎川，不知進退，赴水而死。”
derivationEn: Song·Hong Mai's 'Rongzhai Sequel', Volume 11: Murong Shaozong defeated Hou Jing; none of the generals of the time could match him, but when besieging Yingchuan, he did not know when to advance or retreat and drowned.
example: 他们已经多嫌着我呢！如今我还～，何苦叫他们咒我？★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四十五回
exampleTraditional: 他們已經多嫌著我呢！如今我還～，何苦叫他們咒我？★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四十五回
exampleEn: They already dislike me! Now I still don't know when to advance or retreat; why should I let them curse me? — Qing·Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 45

explanation: 犹言涂脂抹粉。
explanationTraditional: 猶言塗脂抹粉。
explanationEn: Same as 'applying rouge and powder'.
derivation: 《儿女英雄传》第二一回原来这海马周三，名叫周得胜，便是那年被十三妹姑娘刀断钢鞭，打倒在地，要给他擦脂抹粉，然后饶他性命，立了罚约的那个人。”
derivationTraditional: 《兒女英雄傳》第二一回原來這海馬週三，名叫周得勝，便是那年被十三妹姑娘刀斷鋼鞭，打倒在地，要給他擦脂抹粉，然後饒他性命，立了罰約的那個人。”
derivationEn: 'The Legend of Heroes' Chapter 21: It turned out that this Haima Zhou San, named Zhou Desheng, was the one who was knocked down by the thirteenth sister's sword, breaking his steel whip, and was about to have rouge and powder applied to him before being spared and made to swear an oath.
example: 花枝招展，～的太太小姐，在洋广杂货店穿进穿出。★《中国民间故事选·打绥定》
exampleTraditional: 花枝招展，～的太太小姐，在洋廣雜貨店穿進穿出。★《中國民間故事選·打綏定》
exampleEn: Gaudily dressed, rouged and powdered ladies and misses bustled in and out of foreign goods stores. — 'Selected Chinese Folktales·Conquering Suiding'

explanation: 形容深入地思考。沉深。默不作声。
explanationTraditional: 形容深入地思考。沉深。默不作聲。
explanationEn: Describes deep thinking. Chen means deep; mo means silent.
derivation: 魏巍《路标》在沉思默想的时候，我仿佛听到一种深沉有力的呼喊。”
derivationTraditional: 魏巍《路標》在沉思默想的時候，我彷彿聽到一種深沉有力的呼喊。”
derivationEn: Wei Wei's 'Landmark': While deep in thought, I seemed to hear a deep and powerful call.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 死后将骨头挫成灰撒掉。形容罪孽深重或恨之极深。
explanationTraditional: 死後將骨頭挫成灰撒掉。形容罪孽深重或恨之極深。
explanationEn: To grind bones and scatter ashes after death, describing extreme hatred or heinous crimes.
derivation: 《儿女英雄传》第三回倘然要把老爷的这项银子耽搁了，慢说我，就挫骨扬灰也抵不了这罪过。”
derivationTraditional: 《兒女英雄傳》第三回倘然要把老爺的這項銀子耽擱了，慢說我，就挫骨揚灰也抵不了這罪過。”
derivationEn: From 'The Story of a Heroic Couple' Chapter 3: 'If I delay this silver for the master, even if I were ground to bones and ashes, I could not atone for this crime.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 丹心红心、忠心。碧血血化为碧玉。碧青绿色的宝石，表示血的珍贵。赤诚的忠心，宝贵的鲜血。用以赞扬为国捐躯的重大牺牲。
explanationTraditional: 丹心紅心、忠心。碧血血化為碧玉。碧青綠色的寶石，表示血的珍貴。赤誠的忠心，寶貴的鮮血。用以讚揚為國捐軀的重大犧牲。
explanationEn: Loyal heart and precious blood, used to praise great sacrifices for the country.
derivation: 《庄子·外物》苌弘死于蜀，藏其血，三年而化为碧。”元·郑元祐《张御史死节歌》孤忠既足明丹心，三年犹须化碧血。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·外物》萇弘死於蜀，藏其血，三年而化為碧。”元·鄭元祐《張御史死節歌》孤忠既足明丹心，三年猶須化碧血。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi·External Things': 'Chang Hong died in Shu, his blood was stored and turned into jade after three years.' Yuan·Zheng Yuanyou's 'Song of Imperial Censor Zhang's Death': 'Loyalty alone is enough to show a red heart, three years still need to turn into green blood.'
example: 这一个～扶周主，那一个赤胆忠肝助纣王。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第九十五回
exampleTraditional: 這一個～扶周主，那一個赤膽忠肝助紂王。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第九十五回
exampleEn: One with a loyal heart and precious blood supported the Zhou lord, the other with red loyalty helped King Zhou. ★ Ming·Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 95

explanation: 指有得道者及仙人的气质神采。
explanationTraditional: 指有得道者及仙人的氣質神采。
explanationEn: Having the temperament and aura of an immortal or a Taoist adept.
derivation: 宋·程珌《喜迁莺·寿薛枢密》词道骨仙风，安排顿著，须是人间紫府。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·程珌《喜遷鶯·壽薛樞密》詞道骨仙風，安排頓著，須是人間紫府。”
derivationEn: Song·Cheng Bi's 'Xi Qian Ying·Birthday Greeting for Minister Xue': 'With the bone of Tao and immortal wind, arranged and settled, must be in the human immortal mansion.'
example: 神功大力，有时济困扶危，～，尽可度人出世。★明·冯梦龙《双雄记龙神遣救》
exampleTraditional: 神功大力，有時濟困扶危，～，儘可度人出世。★明·馮夢龍《雙雄記龍神遣救》
exampleEn: With divine power and great strength, sometimes help the needy; with Taoist bone and immortal style, can guide people to transcendence. ★ Ming·Feng Menglong's 'Double Heroes' Tale: Dragon God Sends Rescue'

explanation: 泛泛浮浅不深入。一般化地泛泛地谈谈。
explanationTraditional: 泛泛浮淺不深入。一般化地泛泛地談談。
explanationEn: Superficial or general talk without depth.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他的泛泛之谈让我如堕五里雾中。
exampleTraditional: 他的泛泛之談讓我如墮五里霧中。
exampleEn: His superficial talk left me completely confused.

explanation: 白粉装饰的，白玉雕成的。形容女子妆饰的漂亮或小孩长得白净。也用来形容雪景。
explanationTraditional: 白粉裝飾的，白玉雕成的。形容女子妝飾的漂亮或小孩長得白淨。也用來形容雪景。
explanationEn: Adorned with white powder and carved from white jade, describing a woman's beautiful makeup or a child's fair complexion; also used for snow scenery.
derivation: 明·兰陵笑笑生《金瓶梅词话》第十三回每日打扮的粉妆玉琢，皓齿朱唇，无日不在大门首倚门而望。”
derivationTraditional: 明·蘭陵笑笑生《金瓶梅詞話》第十三回每日打扮的粉妝玉琢，皓齒朱唇，無日不在大門首倚門而望。”
derivationEn: Ming·Lanling Xiaoxiaosheng's 'Jin Ping Mei' Chapter 13: 'Every day she dressed up like powder and jade, with white teeth and red lips, always leaning at the gate looking out.'
example: 士隐见女儿越发生得～，乖觉可喜，便伸手接来，抱在怀中，斗他玩耍一回。★清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第一回
exampleTraditional: 士隱見女兒越發生得～，乖覺可喜，便伸手接來，抱在懷中，鬥他玩耍一回。★清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第一回
exampleEn: Shiyin saw his daughter growing more beautiful like powder and jade, clever and lovely, so he reached out to hold her in his arms and played with her. ★ Qing·Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 1

explanation: 扶助弱小，压制强暴。
explanationTraditional: 扶助弱小，壓制強暴。
explanationEn: To help the weak and suppress the strong.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 《水浒》这本书中，描述了众多杀富济贫，扶弱抑强的英雄豪杰。
exampleTraditional: 《水滸》這本書中，描述了眾多殺富濟貧，扶弱抑強的英雄豪傑。
exampleEn: The book 'Water Margin' describes many heroes who rob the rich to help the poor and support the weak against the strong.

explanation: 腹心比喻要害处；疾疾患。比喻要害处的祸患。
explanationTraditional: 腹心比喻要害處；疾疾患。比喻要害處的禍患。
explanationEn: A disease in the vital organs, metaphor for a serious internal threat.
derivation: 《战国策·魏策三》所以为腹心之疾者赵也。”
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·魏策三》所以為腹心之疾者趙也。”
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States·Wei Strategy III': 'The one that is a disease of the heart and belly is Zhao.'
example: 陛下只知行乐欢娱，歌舞宴赏，作一己之乐，致万姓之愁，臣恐陛下不能享此乐，而先有腹心之患矣。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》十八回
exampleTraditional: 陛下只知行樂歡娛，歌舞宴賞，作一己之樂，致萬姓之愁，臣恐陛下不能享此樂，而先有腹心之患矣。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》十八回
exampleEn: Your Majesty only seeks pleasure and feasting, causing the people's suffering. I fear you will not enjoy this pleasure but first suffer a disease of the heart and belly. ★ Ming·Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods' Chapter 18

explanation: 告贷向别人借钱。想借钱但没有地主借。指生活陷入困境。
explanationTraditional: 告貸向別人借錢。想借錢但沒有地主借。指生活陷入困境。
explanationEn: Having nowhere to borrow money, describing financial hardship.
derivation: 明·瞿式耜《表急公绅士疏》各勋之索米索饷，刻不可迟，称贷无门，征催莫济。”
derivationTraditional: 明·瞿式耜《表急公紳士疏》各勳之索米索餉，刻不可遲，稱貸無門，徵催莫濟。”
derivationEn: Ming·Qu Shisi's 'Memorial Urging Public-Spirited Gentry': 'The nobles demand money and provisions urgently, with no way to borrow and no means to collect.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 洪大。旧时颂扬人福气极大。
explanationTraditional: 洪大。舊時頌揚人福氣極大。
explanationEn: Great blessings as vast as the sky, used to praise someone's immense fortune.
derivation: 元·关汉卿《西蜀梦》这南阳排叟村诸葛，辅佐着洪福齐天汉帝王。”
derivationTraditional: 元·關漢卿《西蜀夢》這南陽排叟村諸葛，輔佐著洪福齊天漢帝王。”
derivationEn: Yuan·Guan Hanqing's 'Dream of Western Shu': 'This Nanyang hermit Zhuge Liang assists the emperor whose blessings are as vast as the sky.'
example: 我居然逃过了这一关，真是～，就是每年开一次庆祝会也不算过分。★鲁迅《集外集拾遗·我的种痘》
exampleTraditional: 我居然逃過了這一關，真是～，就是每年開一次慶祝會也不算過分。★魯迅《集外集拾遺·我的種痘》
exampleEn: I managed to escape this ordeal; truly my blessings are as vast as the sky. Even holding a celebration every year would not be excessive. ★ Lu Xun's 'Collection of Extracollected Works·My Vaccination'

explanation: 厚推崇，重视；薄轻视，怠慢。重视现代的，轻视古代的。多用于学术研究方面。
explanationTraditional: 厚推崇，重視；薄輕視，怠慢。重視現代的，輕視古代的。多用於學術研究方面。
explanationEn: To value the present and devalue the past, often used in academic research.
derivation: 范文澜《历史研究必须厚今薄古》厚今薄古是中国史学的传统。”
derivationTraditional: 范文瀾《歷史研究必須厚今薄古》厚今薄古是中國史學的傳統。”
derivationEn: Fan Wenlan's 'Historical Research Must Value the Present and Devalue the Past': 'Valuing the present and devaluing the past is a tradition of Chinese historiography.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 间空隙。空隙中容不下一根头发。比喻与灾祸相距极近或情势危急到极点。
explanationTraditional: 間空隙。空隙中容不下一根頭髮。比喻與災禍相距極近或情勢危急到極點。
explanationEn: A hair's breadth away from disaster; extremely critical situation.
derivation: 汉·枚乘《上书谏吴王》系绝于天，不可复结，坠入深渊，难以复出，其出不出，间不容发。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·枚乘《上書諫吳王》系絕於天，不可復結，墜入深淵，難以復出，其出不出，間不容髮。”
derivationEn: Han Dynasty, Mei Cheng's 'Letter Advising the King of Wu': 'A rope broken in the sky cannot be reconnected; falling into an abyss is hard to escape; the moment of decision leaves no room for a hair.'
example: 这事～，明天就上个折子，一定要争回此事。（清·梁启超《新中国未来记》第一回）
exampleTraditional: 這事～，明天就上個摺子，一定要爭回此事。（清·梁啟超《新中國未來記》第一回）
exampleEn: This matter is extremely urgent; we must submit a memorial tomorrow to fight for it. (Liang Qichao, 'The Future of New China', Chapter 1)

explanation: 出卖自己，投靠有权势的人。比喻丧失人格，甘心充当恶势力的工具。
explanationTraditional: 出賣自己，投靠有權勢的人。比喻喪失人格，甘心充當惡勢力的工具。
explanationEn: To sell oneself to a powerful person; to betray one's integrity and willingly serve as a tool of evil forces.
