derivationEn: From History of the Southern Dynasties: 'The charm of the writing cannot be fully expressed in words. The meaning beyond the strings, the sound in the void, one knows not whence it comes.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指一切除旧更新。
explanationTraditional: 指一切除舊更新。
explanationEn: All participate in the renewal. Refers to completely discarding the old and embracing the new.
derivation: 《书·胤征》天吏逸德，烈于猛火，歼厥渠魁，胁从罔治。旧染污俗，咸与维新。”
derivationTraditional: 《書·胤徵》天吏逸德，烈於猛火，殲厥渠魁，脅從罔治。舊染汙俗，鹹與維新。”
derivationEn: From the Book of Documents: 'When the emperor's virtue goes astray, it is fiercer than a raging fire. Kill the ringleaders, but do not punish those who were coerced. Those stained by old customs shall all join in the renewal.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 撤掉官职，降为平民。
explanationTraditional: 撤掉官職，降為平民。
explanationEn: To be stripped of one's official position and reduced to a commoner.
derivation: 清·陈忱《水浒后传》第十九回王黼大怒，将宋昭削职为民。”
derivationTraditional: 清·陳忱《水滸後傳》第十九回王黼大怒，將宋昭削職為民。”
derivationEn: From Water Margin Sequel by Chen Chen: 'Wang Fu was furious and had Song Zhao stripped of his post and reduced to a commoner.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 一个人行事，凡自己认为可耻的就不去做。
explanationTraditional: 一個人行事，凡自己認為可恥的就不去做。
explanationEn: To act with a sense of shame; to refrain from doing what one considers shameful.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 知识分子对现实不满，有所反抗、斗争。
explanationTraditional: 知識分子對現實不滿，有所反抗、鬥爭。
explanationEn: A scholar rebels. Refers to intellectuals who are dissatisfied with the status quo and engage in resistance or struggle, but often lack the power to succeed.
derivation: 清·李宝嘉《文明小史》秀才造反，三年不成，无论他们有没有这回事，可以不必理他，就是实有其事，且派个人去查一查，看他们为何作此举动，再作道理。”
derivationTraditional: 清·李寶嘉《文明小史》秀才造反，三年不成，無論他們有沒有這回事，可以不必理他，就是實有其事，且派個人去查一查，看他們為何作此舉動，再作道理。”
derivationEn: From A Short History of Civilization by Li Baojia: 'A scholar's rebellion will not succeed even in three years. Whether they have such intentions or not, we need not bother with them. Even if they do, send someone to investigate.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 眼力好，动作快。
explanationTraditional: 眼力好，動作快。
explanationEn: Sharp-eyed and quick-handed; having keen eyesight and fast reflexes.
derivation: 沈从文《阿金》地保眼尖手快，隔桌子一手把阿金捞着。”
derivationTraditional: 沈從文《阿金》地保眼尖手快，隔桌子一手把阿金撈著。”
derivationEn: From Shen Congwen's 'A Jin': The local constable, sharp-eyed and quick-handed, grabbed A Jin across the table.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容胆量大，无所畏惧。
explanationTraditional: 形容膽量大，無所畏懼。
explanationEn: Extremely brave; fearless.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀书·赵云传》注引《云别传》先主明旦自来，至云营围视昨战处。曰‘子龙一身都是胆也！’”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀書·趙雲傳》注引《雲別傳》先主明旦自來，至雲營圍視昨戰處。曰‘子龍一身都是膽也！’”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms, Book of Shu, Biography of Zhao Yun' commentary: The next day, the lord came personally to Zhao Yun's camp and, looking at the battlefield, said, 'Zilong is all courage!'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 指超逸豪放的意兴勃发飞扬。
explanationTraditional: 指超逸豪放的意興勃發飛揚。
explanationEn: Unrestrained and soaring spirits; a surge of creative inspiration.
derivation: 唐王勃《滕王阁序》遥襟俯畅，逸兴遄飞。”
derivationTraditional: 唐王勃《滕王閣序》遙襟俯暢，逸興遄飛。”
derivationEn: From Wang Bo's 'Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng': Gazing afar with relaxed feelings, unrestrained spirits soar.
example: 觥筹交错，～。★清王韬《淞滨琐话·瑶台小咏上》
exampleTraditional: 觥籌交錯，～。★清王韜《淞濱瑣話·瑤臺小詠上》
exampleEn: Wine cups and chopsticks intermingle, unrestrained spirits soar. ★ From Wang Tao's 'Trivial Talks from Songbin: Little Songs of Yaotai, Part 1'

explanation: 隐隐匿；扬宣扬。不谈人的坏处，光宣扬人的好处。
explanationTraditional: 隱隱匿；揚宣揚。不談人的壞處，光宣揚人的好處。
explanationEn: Conceal others' faults and praise their virtues; to overlook bad points and highlight good ones.
derivation: 《礼记·中庸》舜好问而好察迩言，隐恶而扬善。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·中庸》舜好問而好察邇言，隱惡而揚善。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Rites, The Doctrine of the Mean': Shun loved to ask questions and examine close words, concealing evil and promoting good.
example: 他和你是同僚官，虽有些过失，你可隐恶而扬善。★明·施耐庵《水浒全传》第三十三回
exampleTraditional: 他和你是同僚官，雖有些過失，你可隱惡而揚善。★明·施耐庵《水滸全傳》第三十三回
exampleEn: He is your colleague; although he has some faults, you should conceal evil and promote good. ★ From Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin', Chapter 33

explanation: 更始重新开始。原指封建帝王即位改元或采取某些重大措施◇比喻改革旧状。
explanationTraditional: 更始重新開始。原指封建帝王即位改元或採取某些重大措施◇比喻改革舊狀。
explanationEn: To start anew with the people; to reform and begin afresh, often used when a new emperor ascends the throne or implements major changes.
derivation: 《庄子·盗跖》与天下更始，罢兵休卒。”《汉书·武帝纪》朕嘉唐虞而乐殷周，据旧以鉴新，其赦天下与民更始。”
derivationTraditional: 《莊子·盜蹠》與天下更始，罷兵休卒。”《漢書·武帝紀》朕嘉唐虞而樂殷周，據舊以鑑新，其赦天下與民更始。”
derivationEn: From 'Zhuangzi, Robber Zhi': Start anew with the world, cease military campaigns. From 'Book of Han, Biography of Emperor Wu': I admire Tang and Yu and delight in Yin and Zhou; based on the old to examine the new, I pardon the world and start anew with the people.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 雨水淋浇，太阳曝晒。亦形容露天劳作或旅途的辛苦。
explanationTraditional: 雨水淋澆，太陽曝曬。亦形容露天勞作或旅途的辛苦。
explanationEn: Exposed to rain and sun; enduring the hardships of outdoor work or travel.
derivation: 杨朔《三千里江山》第一段［姚长庚］多少年来，雨淋日晒，脸比石头还粗。”
derivationTraditional: 楊朔《三千里江山》第一段［姚長庚］多少年來，雨淋日曬，臉比石頭還粗。”
derivationEn: From Yang Shuo's 'Three Thousand Miles of Rivers and Mountains', first paragraph: [Yao Changgeng] over the years, rain-soaked and sun-scorched, his face rougher than stone.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 巡按之名，起于明代，非固定职官，临时由朝廷委派监察御史担任，分别巡视各省，考核吏治。八府巡按”常见于戏曲、小说，民间多视为清廉而有权势的大官。
explanationTraditional: 巡按之名，起於明代，非固定職官，臨時由朝廷委派監察御史擔任，分別巡視各省，考核吏治。八府巡按”常見於戲曲、小說，民間多視為清廉而有權勢的大官。
explanationEn: An imperial inspector for eight prefectures; a term from operas and novels referring to a powerful and incorruptible official who inspects local governance.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 你如今是～，为父的乃是个皂班头，诚恐砧辱于你，这也无妨紧要，待我回得衙去，写个辞条，将这个皂班头辞掉也就是了。★名家名剧之《胭脂宝褶》
exampleTraditional: 你如今是～，為父的乃是個皂班頭，誠恐砧辱於你，這也無妨緊要，待我回得衙去，寫個辭條，將這個皂班頭辭掉也就是了。★名家名劇之《胭脂寶褶》
exampleEn: You are now the imperial inspector for eight prefectures; I, your father, am but a lowly constable. Fearing to disgrace you, I will write a resignation letter and quit this post. ★ From the famous opera 'The Jewel of Rouge'

explanation: 偏偏差；弊赞美。补救偏差漏洞，纠正缺点错误。
explanationTraditional: 偏偏差；弊讚美。補救偏差漏洞，糾正缺點錯誤。
explanationEn: To remedy deviations and correct abuses; to make up for shortcomings and rectify errors.
derivation: 《汉书·董仲舒传》先王之道必有偏而不起之处，故政有眊而不行，举其偏者以补其弊而已也。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·董仲舒傳》先王之道必有偏而不起之處，故政有眊而不行，舉其偏者以補其弊而已也。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han, Biography of Dong Zhongshu': The way of former kings must have deviations that are not corrected, so governance becomes blind and ineffective; lift the deviations to remedy the abuses.
example: 苟不自其本页图之，则亦仅能～，偷为一时之治而已矣。★严复《原强》
exampleTraditional: 苟不自其本頁圖之，則亦僅能～，偷為一時之治而已矣。★嚴復《原強》
exampleEn: If we do not plan from the root, we can only remedy deviations and correct abuses for a temporary peace. ★ From Yan Fu's 'On Strength'

explanation: 指已婚妇女又乱搞男女关系。
explanationTraditional: 指已婚婦女又亂搞男女關係。
explanationEn: Not content with staying at home; refers to a married woman engaging in extramarital affairs.
derivation: 《诗经·邺风·凯风序》卫之淫风流行，虽有七子之母，犹不能安其室。”
derivationTraditional: 《詩經·鄴風·凱風序》衛之淫風流行，雖有七子之母，猶不能安其室。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Songs, Bei Feng, Preface to Kaifeng': The licentious customs of Wei spread; even a mother of seven sons could not remain content in her chamber.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不甘心落在别人后面。
explanationTraditional: 不甘心落在別人後面。
explanationEn: Unwilling to fall behind others; competitive and ambitious.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 在劳动中，大家你追我赶，谁也不甘后人。
exampleTraditional: 在勞動中，大家你追我趕，誰也不甘後人。
exampleEn: In labor, everyone vies with each other, unwilling to fall behind.

explanation: 指事物不正常，古代现代都不曾有过。原讥讽人学无所得却故作诡异◇常比喻折衷。
explanationTraditional: 指事物不正常，古代現代都不曾有過。原譏諷人學無所得卻故作詭異◇常比喻折衷。
explanationEn: Refers to something abnormal, neither ancient nor modern; originally satirized those who pretend to be profound but are actually ignorant; often used to mean compromise.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《太玄经·更》童牛角马，不今不古。”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《太玄經·更》童牛角馬，不今不古。”
derivationEn: Yang Xiong's 'Taixuanjing' in Han Dynasty: 'A hornless ox and a horned horse, neither modern nor ancient.'
example: 遥见双炬，疑为虎目，至前则官役数人，衣冠～。★清·纪昀《阅微草堂笔记》卷十八
exampleTraditional: 遙見雙炬，疑為虎目，至前則官役數人，衣冠～。★清·紀昀《閱微草堂筆記》卷十八
exampleEn: In the distance, he saw a pair of torches, suspected to be tiger eyes, but upon approach, they were several officials in attire that was neither ancient nor modern. — Ji Yun's 'Notes of the Thatched Abode of Close Scrutiny', Volume 18

explanation: 不知道他的详细情况。
explanationTraditional: 不知道他的詳細情況。
explanationEn: Not knowing the detailed circumstances of something or someone.
derivation: 清·吴敬梓《儒林外史》第四十四回施御史家的事，我也略闻，不知其详。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳敬梓《儒林外史》第四十四回施御史家的事，我也略聞，不知其詳。”
derivationEn: Wu Jingzi's 'The Scholars', Chapter 44: 'I have heard a little about the affairs of Secretary Shi, but I do not know the details.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 表示一个人一辈子聪明。
explanationTraditional: 表示一個人一輩子聰明。
explanationEn: Describes a person who is clever all their life.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《古今小说·滕大尹鬼断家私》若我断不出此事，枉自聪明一世。每日退堂，便将画图展玩，千思万想。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《古今小說·滕大尹鬼斷傢俬》若我斷不出此事，枉自聰明一世。每日退堂，便將畫圖展玩，千思萬想。”
derivationEn: Feng Menglong's 'Stories Old and New': 'If I cannot decide this case, I would have wasted my lifelong cleverness.'
example: 六十九岁的人了，反倒～，糊涂一时，教一群猴儿王八蛋给吃了。★老舍《骆驼祥子》十四
exampleTraditional: 六十九歲的人了，反倒～，糊塗一時，教一群猴兒王八蛋給吃了。★老舍《駱駝祥子》十四
exampleEn: At sixty-nine, he was clever all his life but muddled for a moment, letting a bunch of monkeys and bastards eat him up. — Lao She's 'Rickshaw Boy', Chapter 14

explanation: 粗略微；通通晓。文墨指写文章。稍微懂得一些写作方面的学问。
explanationTraditional: 粗略微；通通曉。文墨指寫文章。稍微懂得一些寫作方面的學問。
explanationEn: To have a rough understanding of writing and literature; to be somewhat literate.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《醒世恒言》第六卷有一少年，姓王名臣，长安人氏，略知书史，粗通文墨。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《醒世恆言》第六卷有一少年，姓王名臣，長安人氏，略知書史，粗通文墨。”
derivationEn: Feng Menglong's 'Stories to Awaken the World', Volume 6: 'There was a young man named Wang Chen, from Chang'an, who knew a little about books and history, and was roughly literate.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 绝完结；续延续。事物处在生存或灭亡、断绝或延续的关键时刻。形容局势万分危急。
explanationTraditional: 絕完結；續延續。事物處在生存或滅亡、斷絕或延續的關鍵時刻。形容局勢萬分危急。
explanationEn: A critical moment of survival or extinction, continuation or cessation; describes an extremely perilous situation.
derivation: 《晚清文学丛钞·新中国未来记》第一回这六十年中，算是中国存亡绝续的大关头。”
derivationTraditional: 《晚清文學叢鈔·新中國未來記》第一回這六十年中，算是中國存亡絕續的大關頭。”
derivationEn: 'Late Qing Literature Series: The Future of New China', Chapter 1: 'These sixty years were a critical juncture for China's survival or extinction.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 达显贵；宦官。旧指职位高而声势显赫的官员。
explanationTraditional: 達顯貴；宦官。舊指職位高而聲勢顯赫的官員。
explanationEn: High-ranking and influential officials; those with high positions and great power.
derivation: 《礼记·檀弓下》公子丧，诸达官之长杖。”
derivationTraditional: 《禮記·檀弓下》公子喪，諸達官之長杖。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Rites: Tan Gong II': 'When a high official dies, all high officials should support their staffs.'
example: 我所知道的是四十年前的绍兴，那里没有～，所以未闻有专门为堂会的演剧。★鲁迅《且介亭杂文附集·女吊》
exampleTraditional: 我所知道的是四十年前的紹興，那裡沒有～，所以未聞有專門為堂會的演劇。★魯迅《且介亭雜文附集·女吊》
exampleEn: What I know is the Shaoxing of forty years ago, where there were no high-ranking officials, so I never heard of special performances for private gatherings. — Lu Xun's 'Essays from the Qiejieting', Appendix: 'Female Ghost'

explanation: 比喻三方面对立的局势。也泛指三个方面。
explanationTraditional: 比喻三方面對立的局勢。也泛指三個方面。
explanationEn: Metaphor for a situation where three parties are in opposition; also refers to three aspects in general.
derivation: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》臣愿披腹心，输肝胆，效愚计，恐足下不能用也。诚能听臣之计，莫若两利而俱存之，三分天下，鼎足而居，其势莫敢先动。”
derivationTraditional: 《史記·淮陰侯列傳》臣願披腹心，輸肝膽，效愚計，恐足下不能用也。誠能聽臣之計，莫若兩利而俱存之，三分天下，鼎足而居，其勢莫敢先動。”
derivationEn: 'Records of the Grand Historian: Biography of the Marquis of Huaiyin': 'I wish to bare my heart and offer my humble plan. If you listen to me, the best course is to let both sides benefit and coexist, dividing the world into three parts, each standing like a tripod.'
example: 老头儿在席上，看着安老夫妻的这个佳儿，这双佳妇，～，未免因羡生感，因感生叹。★清·文康《儿女英雄传》第三十二回
exampleTraditional: 老頭兒在席上，看著安老夫妻的這個佳兒，這雙佳婦，～，未免因羨生感，因感生嘆。★清·文康《兒女英雄傳》第三十二回
exampleEn: The old man at the feast, seeing the An couple's fine son and two fine daughters-in-law forming a tripod, felt envy and then emotion. — Wen Kang's 'The Story of a Heroic Couple', Chapter 32

explanation: 翻倒，反转；箧小箱子。把箱子柜子都翻倒过来。形容彻底翻检。
explanationTraditional: 翻倒，反轉；篋小箱子。把箱子櫃子都翻倒過來。形容徹底翻檢。
explanationEn: To turn over boxes and chests; to conduct a thorough search.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《二十年目睹之怪现状》第四回船上买办又仗着洋人势力，硬来翻箱倒箧的搜了一遍，此时还不知有失落东西没有。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《二十年目睹之怪現狀》第四回船上買辦又仗著洋人勢力，硬來翻箱倒篋的搜了一遍，此時還不知有失落東西沒有。”
derivationEn: Wu Jianren's 'Strange Events of the Last Twenty Years', Chapter 4: 'The ship's purser, relying on foreign power, forcibly searched through boxes and chests, and we still don't know if anything was lost.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 不是自己应得的钱财。指本身不应该拿的钱财。
explanationTraditional: 不是自己應得的錢財。指本身不應該拿的錢財。
explanationEn: Money that one is not entitled to; ill-gotten gains.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 改正错误，变成好的。指去恶就善。
explanationTraditional: 改正錯誤，變成好的。指去惡就善。
explanationEn: To correct one's mistakes and become good; to abandon evil and follow good.
derivation: 《周易·益》君子以见善则迁，有过则改。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·益》君子以見善則遷，有過則改。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes: Yi': 'The superior man, seeing good, moves towards it; having faults, he corrects them.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 改换原来的姓名。多指为了隐瞒原来的身分。同改名换姓”。
explanationTraditional: 改換原來的姓名。多指為了隱瞞原來的身分。同改名換姓”。
explanationEn: To change one's original name, often to conceal one's identity.
derivation: 明·余继登《典故纪闻》卷十三其后往往私创庵院，滥将无籍之徒收充，亦有逃军囚匠改名易姓，削发顶冠，人莫之识。”
derivationTraditional: 明·餘繼登《典故紀聞》卷十三其後往往私創庵院，濫將無籍之徒收充，亦有逃軍囚匠改名易姓，削髮頂冠，人莫之識。”
derivationEn: Ming Dynasty, Yu Jideng's 'Records of Anecdotes' Volume 13: 'Later, they often privately founded temples and indiscriminately accepted unregistered people, including escaped soldiers and convicts who changed their names and surnames, shaved their heads, and wore caps, so that no one recognized them.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 公公开；诸之于；同好爱好相同的人。指把自己所收藏的珍爱的东西拿出来，使有相同爱好的人都能欣赏。
explanationTraditional: 公公開；諸之於；同好愛好相同的人。指把自己所收藏的珍愛的東西拿出來，使有相同愛好的人都能欣賞。
explanationEn: To share one's treasured possessions with those who have similar interests.
derivation: 三国·魏·曹植《与杨德祖书》虽未能藏之于名山，将以传之于同好。”
derivationTraditional: 三國·魏·曹植《與楊德祖書》雖未能藏之於名山，將以傳之於同好。”
derivationEn: Three Kingdoms, Wei, Cao Zhi's 'Letter to Yang Dezu': 'Although I cannot store it in a famous mountain, I will pass it on to those with similar interests.'
example: 虽经同人研究再三，余心犹耿耿，未敢～。★清·胡凤丹《〈龙川文集〉辨伪考异跋》
exampleTraditional: 雖經同人研究再三，餘心猶耿耿，未敢～。★清·胡鳳丹《〈龍川文集〉辨偽考異跋》
exampleEn: Even after repeated study by colleagues, I still felt uneasy and dared not share it with fellow enthusiasts. — Qing Dynasty, Hu Fengdan's 'Postscript to the Collation of Chen Liang's Collected Works'

explanation: 指升官发财。
explanationTraditional: 指升官發財。
explanationEn: Official rank and wealth; to rise in position and become rich.
derivation: 唐·李白《江上吟》功名富贵若长在，汉水亦应西北流。”明·洪应明《菜根谭·应酬》功名富贵，直从灭处观究竟，则贪恋自轻；横逆困穷，直从起处究由来，则怨尤自息。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·李白《江上吟》功名富貴若長在，漢水亦應西北流。”明·洪應明《菜根譚·應酬》功名富貴，直從滅處觀究竟，則貪戀自輕；橫逆困窮，直從起處究由來，則怨尤自息。”
derivationEn: Tang Dynasty, Li Bai's 'Rhapsody on the River': 'If fame and fortune could last forever, the Han River would flow northwest.' Ming Dynasty, Hong Yingming's 'Cai Gen Tan': 'If one sees fame and fortune from the perspective of their end, greed and attachment will naturally diminish.'
example: 单道着人生～，总有天数，不如图一个见的怜活。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷之一
exampleTraditional: 單道著人生～，總有天數，不如圖一個見的憐活。★明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷之一
exampleEn: Simply put, life's fame and fortune are determined by fate; it's better to seek a clear and lively present. — Ming Dynasty, Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement' Volume 1

explanation: 其代词，指敌人。趁敌人还没有防备时进攻。
explanationTraditional: 其代詞，指敵人。趁敵人還沒有防備時進攻。
explanationEn: To attack the enemy when they are unprepared.
derivation: 《孙子·计篇》攻其无备，出其不意。”
derivationTraditional: 《孫子·計篇》攻其無備，出其不意。”
derivationEn: Sun Tzu's 'The Art of War': 'Attack where the enemy is unprepared; appear where you are not expected.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容事物具有非常大的吸引力或威吓的力量。
explanationTraditional: 形容事物具有非常大的吸引力或威嚇的力量。
explanationEn: Describes something extremely attractive or terrifying.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 槊长矛；赋吟♂着长矛而赋诗。指能文能武的英雄豪迈气概。
explanationTraditional: 槊長矛；賦吟♂著長矛而賦詩。指能文能武的英雄豪邁氣概。
explanationEn: To compose poetry while holding a lance; describes a heroic and scholarly spirit.
derivation: 宋·苏轼《前赤壁赋》酾酒临江，横槊赋诗，固一世之雄也。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·蘇軾《前赤壁賦》釃酒臨江，橫槊賦詩，固一世之雄也。”
derivationEn: Song Dynasty, Su Shi's 'Former Ode to the Red Cliff': 'He poured wine on the river, composed poetry with lance in hand, truly a hero of his age.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 悔改罪行，重新做人。
explanationTraditional: 悔改罪行，重新做人。
explanationEn: To repent one's crimes and start anew.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 看到适当时机立即行动。
explanationTraditional: 看到適當時機立即行動。
explanationEn: To act promptly when the opportunity arises.
derivation: 《周易·系辞下》君子见几而作，不俟终日。”
derivationTraditional: 《周易·繫辭下》君子見幾而作，不俟終日。”
derivationEn: 'The Book of Changes': 'The superior man sees the opportunity and acts, without waiting for the end of the day.'
example: 富春子见似道举动非常，惧祸而逃，可谓～者矣，★明·冯梦龙《古今小说》第二十二卷
exampleTraditional: 富春子見似道舉動非常，懼禍而逃，可謂～者矣，★明·馮夢龍《古今小說》第二十二卷
exampleEn: Fuchunzi saw Jia Sidao's unusual behavior, feared trouble, and fled—truly one who acts upon seeing the opportunity. — Ming Dynasty, Feng Menglong's 'Stories Old and New' Volume 22

explanation: 睫眼睫毛。形容很近，就在眼前。
explanationTraditional: 睫眼睫毛。形容很近，就在眼前。
explanationEn: Very close, right before one's eyes.
derivation: 《列子·仲尼》虽远在八荒之外，近在眉睫之内，来干我者，我必知之。”
derivationTraditional: 《列子·仲尼》雖遠在八荒之外，近在眉睫之內，來幹我者，我必知之。”
derivationEn: 'Liezi': 'Though far beyond the eight wildernesses, or near before the eyebrows and eyelashes, anything that affects me, I will surely know.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 形容才华惊人，文辞瑰丽。
explanationTraditional: 形容才華驚人，文辭瑰麗。
explanationEn: Describes extraordinary talent and magnificent literary style.
derivation: 清·王晫《今世说·企羡》彭羡门惊才绝艳，词家推为独步。”清·梁章钜《浪迹丛谈·刘英初编修》英初本惊才绝艳，而近作大不如前，同人比之江郎才尽。”
derivationTraditional: 清·王晫《今世說·企羨》彭羨門驚才絕豔，詞家推為獨步。”清·梁章鉅《浪跡叢談·劉英初編修》英初本驚才絕豔，而近作大不如前，同人比之江郎才盡。”
derivationEn: Qing Dynasty, Wang Zhuo's 'Modern Sayings': 'Peng Xianmen's astonishing talent and unparalleled beauty made him the unrivaled master of ci poetry.' Qing Dynasty, Liang Zhangju's 'Random Notes': 'Yingchu was originally astonishingly talented, but his recent works are far inferior, and peers compare him to Jiang Yan whose talent declined.'
example: 不知堕向泥犁者，可有～词。★清·舒位《鬼》诗
exampleTraditional: 不知墮向泥犁者，可有～詞。★清·舒位《鬼》詩
exampleEn: I wonder if those who fall into hell have such astonishing talent and unparalleled beauty. — Qing Dynasty, Shu Wei's 'Ghost' poem

explanation: 交集一起袭来。两种事物同时出现或同时加在一个人身上，又惊又喜。
explanationTraditional: 交集一起襲來。兩種事物同時出現或同時加在一個人身上，又驚又喜。
explanationEn: A mix of surprise and joy; both emotions come together.
derivation: 金·董解元《西厢记》卷四生闻之，惊喜交集。”
derivationTraditional: 金·董解元《西廂記》卷四生聞之，驚喜交集。”
derivationEn: From Dong Jieyuan's 'The Story of the Western Wing' Volume 4: 'Upon hearing this, the student was filled with surprise and joy.'
example: 正在这里，夫妻不期而遇，～。（程思远《李宗仁先生晚年》第五章）
exampleTraditional: 正在這裡，夫妻不期而遇，～。（程思遠《李宗仁先生晚年》第五章）
exampleEn: Right then, the couple met unexpectedly, filled with surprise and joy. (From Cheng Siyuan's 'The Later Years of Mr. Li Zongren', Chapter 5)

explanation: 看风向转发动舵柄。比喻看势头或看别人的眼色行事。
explanationTraditional: 看風向轉發動舵柄。比喻看勢頭或看別人的眼色行事。
explanationEn: To trim one's sails; to act according to the situation or to follow others' lead.
derivation: 宋·释普济《五灯会元》看风使舵，正是随波逐流。”
derivationTraditional: 宋·釋普濟《五燈會元》看風使舵，正是隨波逐流。”
derivationEn: From Song Dynasty Shi Puji's 'Five Lamps Meeting': 'Trimming the sails to the wind is just going with the flow.'
example: 有些人惯于～，看领导眼色行事。
exampleTraditional: 有些人慣於～，看領導眼色行事。
exampleEn: Some people are used to trimming their sails, acting according to the leader's expression.

explanation: 原指年老没有作战能力的士兵。现多比喻因年老体弱以及其他原因而工作能力较差的人。
explanationTraditional: 原指年老沒有作戰能力的士兵。現多比喻因年老體弱以及其他原因而工作能力較差的人。
explanationEn: Originally refers to old and weak soldiers; now metaphorically refers to people who are less capable due to age or infirmity.
derivation: 明·罗贯中《三国演义》第三十二回城中无粮，可发老弱残兵并妇人出降；彼必不为备，我既以兵继百姓之后出攻之。”
derivationTraditional: 明·羅貫中《三國演義》第三十二回城中無糧，可發老弱殘兵並婦人出降；彼必不為備，我既以兵繼百姓之後出攻之。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Luo Guanzhong's 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms' Chapter 32: 'With no food in the city, send out the old, weak, and disabled soldiers along with the women to surrender; they will not be on guard, and we can then attack from behind.'
example: 以前，他不肯抢别人的买卖，特别是对于那些～；以他的身体，以他的车，去和他们争座儿，还能有他们的份？★老舍《骆驼祥子》五
exampleTraditional: 以前，他不肯搶別人的買賣，特別是對於那些～；以他的身體，以他的車，去和他們爭座兒，還能有他們的份？★老舍《駱駝祥子》五
exampleEn: Previously, he was unwilling to snatch business from others, especially from those old and weak; with his physique and his rickshaw, competing with them for seats would leave them no chance. (From Lao She's 'Rickshaw Boy', Chapter 5)

explanation: 冷水从背上浇下来。比喻因突然遭受意外的打击或刺激，思想为之一震或希望为之幻灭。同冷水浇背”。
explanationTraditional: 冷水從背上澆下來。比喻因突然遭受意外的打擊或刺激，思想為之一震或希望為之幻滅。同冷水澆背”。
explanationEn: Like cold water poured over the head; a sudden shock or disappointment that dashes hopes.
derivation: 清·丁耀亢《续金瓶梅》第四十三回忽然听得说太太来了，好一似——天雷霹雳，冷水浇头。”
derivationTraditional: 清·丁耀亢《續金瓶梅》第四十三回忽然聽得說太太來了，好一似——天雷霹靂，冷水澆頭。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Ding Yaokang's 'Sequel to The Golden Lotus' Chapter 43: 'Suddenly hearing that the lady had arrived, it was like a thunderbolt and cold water poured over the head.'
example: 他一看，像一瓢～，不禁浑身一颤，颓然靠在椅背上。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十二章
exampleTraditional: 他一看，像一瓢～，不禁渾身一顫，頹然靠在椅背上。★姚雪垠《李自成》第一卷第二十二章
exampleEn: He took one look, as if a ladle of cold water had been poured over him, shuddered, and slumped back in his chair. (From Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng', Volume 1, Chapter 22)

explanation: 内外勾结，串通一气。
explanationTraditional: 內外勾結，串通一氣。
explanationEn: To collude with outsiders from within; to be in league with external forces.
derivation: 明·施耐庵《水浒》第六十二回你这厮是北京本处良民，如何却去投梁山落草，坐了第二把交椅？如今倒来里钩外连，要打北京！”
derivationTraditional: 明·施耐庵《水滸》第六十二回你這廝是北京本處良民，如何卻去投梁山落草，坐了第二把交椅？如今倒來裡鉤外連，要打北京！”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Shi Nai'an's 'Water Margin' Chapter 62: 'You are a good citizen of Beijing, how could you go to Liangshan and become an outlaw, sitting in the second seat? Now you come to collude with outsiders to attack Beijing!'
example: 这两个就～的朋比为奸，闹的不成样子。★清·吴趼人《糊涂世界》第七回
exampleTraditional: 這兩個就～的朋比為奸，鬧的不成樣子。★清·吳趼人《糊塗世界》第七回
exampleEn: These two colluded with each other, causing great trouble. (From Qing Dynasty Wu Jianren's 'Confused World', Chapter 7)

explanation: 力量不能支撑。
explanationTraditional: 力量不能支撐。
explanationEn: Strength is insufficient to support; unable to sustain.
derivation: 隋·王通《文中子·事君》大厦将倾，非一木所支也。”
derivationTraditional: 隋·王通《文中子·事君》大廈將傾，非一木所支也。”
derivationEn: From Sui Dynasty Wang Tong's 'Wenzhongzi: Serving the Lord': 'When a great building is about to fall, a single beam cannot support it.'
example: 南宫适大战黄元济，未及三十回合，元济非南宫适敌手，～。★明·许仲琳《封神演义》第二十八回
exampleTraditional: 南宮适大戰黃元濟，未及三十回合，元濟非南宮适敵手，～。★明·許仲琳《封神演義》第二十八回
exampleEn: Nangong Kuo fought fiercely with Huang Yuanji, but before thirty rounds, Yuanji was no match for Nangong Kuo and could not sustain. (From Ming Dynasty Xu Zhonglin's 'Investiture of the Gods', Chapter 28)

explanation: 指日夜不停。
explanationTraditional: 指日夜不停。
explanationEn: Day and night without stopping; continuously.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第117回如今竟成了痨病了，现在危急，专差一个人连日连夜赶来的。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第117回如今竟成了癆病了，現在危急，專差一個人連日連夜趕來的。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber' Chapter 117: 'Now it has become consumption, critical, and a special person has been sent day and night.'
example: 李大个子的铁匠炉子～生着通红的烈火，他正忙着给人修犁杖，打锄头。★周立波《暴风骤雨》第二部
exampleTraditional: 李大個子的鐵匠爐子～生著通紅的烈火，他正忙著給人修犁杖，打鋤頭。★周立波《暴風驟雨》第二部
exampleEn: Big Li's blacksmith forge burned with a red fire day and night, as he was busy repairing plows and making hoes for people. (From Zhou Libo's 'The Hurricane', Part 2)

explanation: 旧指人的天赋的首选观念和本能。
explanationTraditional: 舊指人的天賦的首選觀念和本能。
explanationEn: Innate knowledge and ability; intuitive moral sense and natural capability.
derivation: 《孟子·尽心上》人之所不学而能者，其良能也；所不虑而知者，其良知也。”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·盡心上》人之所不學而能者，其良能也；所不慮而知者，其良知也。”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Jinxin I': 'What a man can do without learning is his innate ability; what he knows without reflection is his innate knowledge.'
example: 孟子皆以仁义言之，言～亦然。★清·恽敬《读孟子二》
exampleTraditional: 孟子皆以仁義言之，言～亦然。★清·惲敬《讀孟子二》
exampleEn: Mencius always speaks of benevolence and righteousness; the same applies to innate knowledge and ability. (From Qing Dynasty Yun Jing's 'Reading Mencius II')

explanation: 比喻绿叶繁茂覆盖成荫。同绿叶成阴”。
explanationTraditional: 比喻綠葉繁茂覆蓋成蔭。同綠葉成陰”。
explanationEn: Green leaves form a dense shade; metaphor for lush foliage providing shade.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 当年种的小树苗，如今已是～了。
exampleTraditional: 當年種的小樹苗，如今已是～了。
exampleEn: The saplings planted back then have now grown into a dense shade of green leaves.

explanation: 形显露；色脸色。内心的愤怒在脸上显露出来。
explanationTraditional: 形顯露；色臉色。內心的憤怒在臉上顯露出來。
explanationEn: Anger shows on one's face; visibly angry.
derivation: 明·冯梦龙《东周列国志》第十八回曹沫右手按剑，左手揽桓公之袖，怒形于色。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮夢龍《東周列國志》第十八回曹沫右手按劍，左手攬桓公之袖，怒形於色。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Feng Menglong's 'Chronicles of the Eastern Zhou Kingdoms' Chapter 18: 'Cao Mo grasped his sword with his right hand and grabbed Duke Huan's sleeve with his left, his anger showing on his face.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 低劣的技艺；低劣的对象。
explanationTraditional: 低劣的技藝；低劣的對象。
explanationEn: Inferior skill or object; something of poor quality.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 三国时，诸葛亮出兵南方，将当地酋长孟获捉住七次，放了七次，使他真正服输，不再为敌。比喻运用策略，使对方心服。
explanationTraditional: 三國時，諸葛亮出兵南方，將當地酋長孟獲捉住七次，放了七次，使他真正服輸，不再為敵。比喻運用策略，使對方心服。
explanationEn: To capture and release someone seven times, making them truly submit; metaphor for using strategy to win someone over.
derivation: 《三国志·蜀志·诸葛亮传》亮率众南征，其秋悉平。”裴松之注引《汉晋春秋》亮笑，纵使更战，七纵七擒，而亮犹遣获。”
derivationTraditional: 《三國志·蜀志·諸葛亮傳》亮率眾南征，其秋悉平。”裴松之注引《漢晉春秋》亮笑，縱使更戰，七縱七擒，而亮猶遣獲。”
derivationEn: From 'Records of the Three Kingdoms' and 'Han-Jin Spring and Autumn Annals': Zhuge Liang captured and released Meng Huo seven times.
example: 那敬德鞭无虚举，举无不中。你便要一冲一撞，登时间早将你～。★元·无名氏《小尉迟》第一折
exampleTraditional: 那敬德鞭無虛舉，舉無不中。你便要一衝一撞，登時間早將你～。★元·無名氏《小尉遲》第一折
exampleEn: That Jingde's whip never misses; you charge and clash, but soon you'll be captured and released seven times. — Yuan Dynasty, anonymous 'Little Yuchi' Act 1

explanation: 指牵牛星、织女星。亦指古代神话中的牛郎、织女。
explanationTraditional: 指牽牛星、織女星。亦指古代神話中的牛郎、織女。
explanationEn: Refers to the stars Altair and Vega, or the mythological cowherd and weaver girl.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 和风习习，阳光灿烂。形容晴朗暖和的天气。
explanationTraditional: 和風習習，陽光燦爛。形容晴朗暖和的天氣。
explanationEn: Gentle breeze and bright sunshine; describing clear and warm weather.
derivation: 元·李爱山《集贤宾·春日伤别》那时节和风丽日满东园，花共柳红娇绿软。”
derivationTraditional: 元·李愛山《集賢賓·春日傷別》那時節和風麗日滿東園，花共柳紅嬌綠軟。”
derivationEn: From Yuan Dynasty Li Aishan's 'Collection of Worthies: Spring Sorrow': At that time, gentle breeze and bright sun filled the eastern garden.
example: 这日正是清明佳节，～。★清·曾朴《孽海花》第七回
exampleTraditional: 這日正是清明佳節，～。★清·曾樸《孽海花》第七回
exampleEn: It was the Qingming Festival, with gentle breeze and bright sunshine. — Qing Dynasty Zeng Pu's 'Flower of the Sea' Chapter 7

explanation: 锦有彩色花纹的丝织品。如同花朵、锦缎一般。形容风景绚丽或前程美好。
explanationTraditional: 錦有彩色花紋的絲織品。如同花朵、錦緞一般。形容風景絢麗或前程美好。
explanationEn: Like flowers and brocade; describing beautiful scenery or a bright future.
derivation: 清·黄小配《廿载繁华梦》第三回那香屏牌价嫁了周庸祐，早卸了孝服，换得浑身如花似锦。”
derivationTraditional: 清·黃小配《廿載繁華夢》第三回那香屏牌價嫁了周庸祐，早卸了孝服，換得渾身如花似錦。”
derivationEn: From Qing Dynasty Huang Xiaopei's 'Twenty Years of Splendor' Chapter 3: She changed into clothes as beautiful as flowers and brocade.
example: 节日的广场被打扮得～，绚丽多彩。
exampleTraditional: 節日的廣場被打扮得～，絢麗多彩。
exampleEn: The festive square was decorated as beautiful as flowers and brocade, colorful and splendid.

explanation: 形容极度不安。同如芒在背”。
explanationTraditional: 形容極度不安。同如芒在背”。
explanationEn: Extreme unease; like having thorns on one's back.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 象一群飞鸟走兽一样逃散。形容溃败逃散。也比喻集团或组织解散后，其成员各奔东西。
explanationTraditional: 象一群飛鳥走獸一樣逃散。形容潰敗逃散。也比喻集團或組織解散後，其成員各奔東西。
explanationEn: To scatter like birds and beasts; describing a rout or disbandment.
derivation: 《汉书·李陵传》今无兵复战，天明坐受缚矣！各鸟兽散，犹有得脱归报天子者。”
derivationTraditional: 《漢書·李陵傳》今無兵復戰，天明坐受縛矣！各鳥獸散，猶有得脫歸報天子者。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Han: Biography of Li Ling': Without troops to fight, at dawn we'll be captured. Scatter like birds and beasts, some may escape to report to the emperor.
example: 粤兵素弱，见之即溃，～。★清·采蘅子《虫鸣漫录》
exampleTraditional: 粵兵素弱，見之即潰，～。★清·採蘅子《蟲鳴漫錄》
exampleEn: The Guangdong soldiers were weak and fled at the sight, scattering like birds and beasts. — Qing Dynasty Cai Hengzi's 'Insect Noises'

explanation: 如是指佛经经文内容如此；我闻阿难自称我闻之于佛。佛教传说，后为佛经开卷语。
explanationTraditional: 如是指佛經經文內容如此；我聞阿難自稱我聞之於佛。佛教傳說，後為佛經開卷語。
explanationEn: Thus I have heard; opening phrase of Buddhist sutras, indicating the text is as heard from the Buddha.
derivation: 《佛地经论》一如是我闻者，谓总显己闻，传佛教者言如是事，我昔曾闻如是。”
derivationTraditional: 《佛地經論》一如是我聞者，謂總顯己聞，傳佛教者言如是事，我昔曾聞如是。”
derivationEn: From 'Buddhabhumi Sutra Sastra': 'Thus I have heard' means summarizing what was heard, transmitting the Buddha's teaching.
example: ～一时，佛在舍卫国，祇树给孤独园，与大比丘众，千二百五十人俱。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十一章
exampleTraditional: ～一時，佛在舍衛國，祇樹給孤獨園，與大比丘眾，千二百五十人俱。★姚雪垠《李自成》第二卷第三十一章
exampleEn: Thus I have heard: once the Buddha was in the Jetavana grove near Sravasti with a great assembly of 1,250 monks. — Yao Xueyin's 'Li Zicheng' Vol. 2 Ch. 31

explanation: 授给予；受接受。旧指男女不能互相亲手递受物品。指儒家束缚男女的礼教。
explanationTraditional: 授給予；受接受。舊指男女不能互相親手遞受物品。指儒家束縛男女的禮教。
explanationEn: No direct hand-to-hand contact between men and women when giving or receiving items; Confucian ritual restriction.
derivation: 《孟子·离娄上》淳于髡曰‘男女授受不亲，神情民？’孟子曰‘礼也。’”
derivationTraditional: 《孟子·離婁上》淳于髡曰‘男女授受不親，神情民？’孟子曰‘禮也。’”
derivationEn: From 'Mencius: Li Lou I': Chunyu Kun asked, 'Is it proper that men and women do not touch when giving or receiving?' Mencius replied, 'It is a ritual.'

explanation: 水中月，镜中花。比喻虚幻景象。
explanationTraditional: 水中月，鏡中花。比喻虛幻景象。
explanationEn: Moon in water, flower in mirror; metaphor for illusory scenes.
derivation: 明·谢榛《四溟诗话》卷一诗有可解，不可解，不必解，若水月镜花，勿泥其迹可也。”
derivationTraditional: 明·謝榛《四溟詩話》卷一詩有可解，不可解，不必解，若水月鏡花，勿泥其跡可也。”
derivationEn: From Ming Dynasty Xie Zhen's 'Four Seas Poetry Talk' Vol. 1: Poetry can be understood, not understood, or need not be understood, like moon in water and flower in mirror, don't cling to traces.
example: ～空好看，不过是，今生如此算收梢。★《再生缘》第六十七回
exampleTraditional: ～空好看，不過是，今生如此算收梢。★《再生緣》第六十七回
exampleEn: Moon in water and flower in mirror are beautiful but empty; this life ends like that. — 'Rebirth' Chapter 67

explanation: 顺着水流的方向行船。比喻顺应情势说话行事。
explanationTraditional: 順著水流的方向行船。比喻順應情勢說話行事。
explanationEn: To sail with the current; metaphorically, to act according to circumstances or follow the trend.
derivation: 清·曹雪芹《红楼梦》第四回小的闻得老爷补升此任，亦系贾府王府之力，此薛蟠即贾府之亲，老爷何不顺水行舟，作个整人情，将此案了结，日后也好去见贾府王府。”
derivationTraditional: 清·曹雪芹《紅樓夢》第四回小的聞得老爺補升此任，亦系賈府王府之力，此薛蟠即賈府之親，老爺何不順水行舟，作個整人情，將此案了結，日後也好去見賈府王府。”
derivationEn: From Cao Xueqin's 'Dream of the Red Chamber', Chapter 4: 'I heard that you got this promotion thanks to the Jia and Wang families. Since Xue Pan is a relative of the Jia family, why not go with the flow and do them a favor, settling this case and making it easier to face them later.'
example: 这男女二家，便～，不费推移之力。★清·李绿园《歧路灯》第一○七回
exampleTraditional: 這男女二家，便～，不費推移之力。★清·李綠園《歧路燈》第一○七回
exampleEn: The two families, male and female, went with the flow without any effort. — From Li Lüyuan's 'The Lantern at the Crossroads', Chapter 107.

explanation: 天地天地之间，人世间。容宽容。天地所不能容纳。指大逆不道、罪孽深重的人与事。
explanationTraditional: 天地天地之間，人世間。容寬容。天地所不能容納。指大逆不道、罪孽深重的人與事。
explanationEn: Not tolerated by heaven and earth; refers to heinous crimes or extreme wickedness that cannot be forgiven.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 天理自然之理，上天主持的公理。良心旧指人类纯真善良之心。指人的天性善心。
explanationTraditional: 天理自然之理，上天主持的公理。良心舊指人類純真善良之心。指人的天性善心。
explanationEn: Natural justice and innate conscience; refers to the inherent goodness and moral sense in humans.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 比喻前程远大。
explanationTraditional: 比喻前程遠大。
explanationEn: A roc's journey of ten thousand miles; metaphor for a bright and promising future.
derivation: 明·冯惟敏《桂枝香·春怨》曲拼着你万里鹏程，撇下俺一腔春恨。”
derivationTraditional: 明·馮惟敏《桂枝香·春怨》曲拼著你萬里鵬程，撇下俺一腔春恨。”
derivationEn: From Feng Weimin's 'Cassia Twig: Spring Resentment' song: 'I stake your roc's journey of ten thousand miles, leaving behind my springtime sorrow.'
example: 见他人～，叹老儒，叹老儒功名无份。★《戏曲选·祭头巾》
exampleTraditional: 見他人～，嘆老儒，嘆老儒功名無份。★《戲曲選·祭頭巾》
exampleEn: Seeing others' bright future, he sighs for his own lack of success in officialdom. — From 'Sacrifice of the Headwrap' in Opera Selections.

explanation: 唐画家吴道子善画佛像，笔势圆转，所画衣带如被风吹拂◇人以之称美其高超画技与飘逸的风格。
explanationTraditional: 唐畫家吳道子善畫佛像，筆勢圓轉，所畫衣帶如被風吹拂◇人以之稱美其高超畫技與飄逸的風格。
explanationEn: Wu's sash flowing in the wind; refers to the painter Wu Daozi's style, where the sashes in his Buddhist figures seem to flutter as if blown by wind, praising his superb technique and ethereal style.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 对某些错误事情习惯了，反以为本来就是对的。
explanationTraditional: 對某些錯誤事情習慣了，反以為本來就是對的。
explanationEn: To become accustomed to what is wrong and accept it as right.
derivation: 汉·扬雄《法言·学行》一哄之市政，必立之平；一卷之书，必立之师，习乎习，以习非之胜是，况习是之胜非乎？”
derivationTraditional: 漢·揚雄《法言·學行》一鬨之市政，必立之平；一卷之書，必立之師，習乎習，以習非之勝是，況習是之勝非乎？”
derivationEn: From Yang Xiong's 'Model Sayings: Learning': 'In a market of shouting, one must establish a standard; for a book, one must have a teacher. Practice, practice: if practice makes wrong seem right, how much more does practice make right overcome wrong?'
example: 于是～，一若文不用典，即为俭学之征。（钱玄同《寄陈独秀》）
exampleTraditional: 於是～，一若文不用典，即為儉學之徵。（錢玄同《寄陳獨秀》）
exampleEn: Thus, it becomes habitual to accept wrong as right, as if using no allusions in writing is a sign of frugality in learning. — From Qian Xuantong's 'Letter to Chen Duxiu'.

explanation: 锋芒刀剑的尖端，比喻人的才干、技能。比喻稍微显示一下本领。
explanationTraditional: 鋒芒刀劍的尖端，比喻人的才幹、技能。比喻稍微顯示一下本領。
explanationEn: To show a little of one's ability or skill; to test one's edge briefly.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 他今天在谈判桌上只不过是～而已。
exampleTraditional: 他今天在談判桌上只不過是～而已。
exampleEn: He only showed a little of his skill at the negotiation table today.

explanation: 丘山丘；壑山沟。指绘画、作文时，心中已把握到了深远的意境。也比喻对事物的判断处置自有高下。
explanationTraditional: 丘山丘；壑山溝。指繪畫、作文時，心中已把握到了深遠的意境。也比喻對事物的判斷處置自有高下。
explanationEn: To have hills and valleys in one's mind; originally refers to having a deep artistic conception in painting or writing; also means having a clear judgment and strategy for things.
derivation: 唐·厉霆《大有诗堂》胸中元自有丘壑，盏里何妨对圣贤。”
derivationTraditional: 唐·厲霆《大有詩堂》胸中元自有丘壑，盞裡何妨對聖賢。”
derivationEn: From Li Ting's 'Great Poetry Hall': 'In my heart there are hills and valleys; why not face the sages with a cup in hand?'
example: 毕竟戴大理～，听了此言，恍然大悟。★清·李宝嘉《官场现形记》第十一回
exampleTraditional: 畢竟戴大理～，聽了此言，恍然大悟。★清·李寶嘉《官場現形記》第十一回
exampleEn: After all, Dai Dali had a clear plan in mind and suddenly understood upon hearing this. — From Li Baojia's 'The Bureaucrats' Exposure', Chapter 11.

explanation: 冲去污水，让清水上来。比喻抨击、清除坏人坏事，表彰、发扬好人好事。
explanationTraditional: 衝去汙水，讓清水上來。比喻抨擊、清除壞人壞事，表彰、發揚好人好事。
explanationEn: To raise the clear and wash away the muddy; metaphorically, to promote good and eliminate evil.
derivation: 《尸子·君治》扬清激浊，荡去滓秽，义也。”
derivationTraditional: 《屍子·君治》揚清激濁，蕩去滓穢，義也。”
derivationEn: From 'The Book of Master Shi: On Rulers': 'To raise the clear and wash away the muddy, to remove dregs, is righteousness.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 尧、舜古代传说中的两位贤君。尧、舜在位的时期。原用以称颂帝王的盛德◇也比喻天下太平的时候。
explanationTraditional: 堯、舜古代傳說中的兩位賢君。堯、舜在位的時期。原用以稱頌帝王的盛德◇也比喻天下太平的時候。
explanationEn: The days of Yao and Shun; originally used to praise the virtue of emperors, now metaphorically refers to times of peace and prosperity.
derivation: 南朝·梁·沈约《四时白纻歌》佩服瑶草驻容色，舜日尧年欢无极。”
derivationTraditional: 南朝·梁·沈約《四時白紵歌》佩服瑤草駐容色，舜日堯年歡無極。”
derivationEn: From Shen Yue's 'Four Seasons White Silk Song' of the Southern Liang: 'Admiring the jade grass to preserve youthful looks, the days of Shun and years of Yao bring endless joy.'
example: ～庆三多，鼓腹含哺遍地歌。★清·钱彩《说岳全传》第一回
exampleTraditional: ～慶三多，鼓腹含哺遍地歌。★清·錢彩《說岳全傳》第一回
exampleEn: In the days of Yao and Shun, celebrating many blessings, the people are well-fed and sing everywhere. — From Qian Cai's 'The Complete Story of Yue Fei', Chapter 1.

explanation: 相传伏羲画八卦，始于干卦三之第一画，干为天，故指一画开天”。
explanationTraditional: 相傳伏羲畫八卦，始於乾卦三之第一畫，幹為天，故指一畫開天”。
explanationEn: Refers to the first stroke of the trigram Qian (Heaven) drawn by Fuxi, symbolizing the beginning of creation.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 佛教指人类和一切生物。
explanationTraditional: 佛教指人類和一切生物。
explanationEn: In Buddhism, refers to all living beings, including humans and all creatures.
derivation: 《妙法莲花经·譬喻品》一切众生皆是吾子。”
derivationTraditional: 《妙法蓮花經·譬喻品》一切眾生皆是吾子。”
derivationEn: From the Lotus Sutra: 'All living beings are my children.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 依照老办法制中药◇比喻按照已有的模式去做。
explanationTraditional: 依照老辦法制中藥◇比喻按照已有的模式去做。
explanationEn: Originally meaning to prepare Chinese medicine according to the traditional method; now used figuratively to mean following an existing model or method.
derivation: 邹韬奋《法西斯作风的罪恶》但还少见到有人衷心羡慕这种罪恶，认为大有依法炮制的价值。”
derivationTraditional: 鄒韜奮《法西斯作風的罪惡》但還少見到有人衷心羨慕這種罪惡，認為大有依法炮製的價值。”
derivationEn: From Zou Taofen's 'The Evil of Fascist Style': 'But few are seen to sincerely admire this evil and think it worth following as a model.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 贻遗留；口实话柄。指做事或说话不小心，给人家留下了话柄。
explanationTraditional: 貽遺留；口實話柄。指做事或說話不小心，給人家留下了話柄。
explanationEn: To leave a handle for gossip; to give others something to talk about due to careless words or actions.
derivation: 《尚书·仲虺之诰》于恐来世以台为口实。”明·朱之瑜《与东守约书二十五首》若能相与有成，将来为人传诵，则后来人人发愤向学，其父母亦尊师重傅；倘不能有成，后来反贻他人口实。”
derivationTraditional: 《尚書·仲虺之誥》於恐來世以臺為口實。”明·朱之瑜《與東守約書二十五首》若能相與有成，將來為人傳誦，則後來人人發憤向學，其父母亦尊師重傅；倘不能有成，後來反貽他人口實。”
derivationEn: From 'Book of Documents' and Zhu Zhiyu's letters: 'If we cannot achieve success, we will leave a handle for others to criticize.'
example: 世续知其隐，言于光绪帝，谓庆宽为醇贤亲王赏识之人，父功之，子罪之，未免～。（清·李宝嘉《南亭笔记》卷二）
exampleTraditional: 世續知其隱，言於光緒帝，謂慶寬為醇賢親王賞識之人，父功之，子罪之，未免～。（清·李寶嘉《南亭筆記》卷二）
exampleEn: Shixu knew his secret and said to Emperor Guangxu, 'Qing Kuan was appreciated by Prince Chun; if you punish the son for the father's merit, you will give others a handle.' (from Qing·Li Baojia's 'Nan Ting Notes')

explanation: 指生物在生存竞争中适应力强的保存下来，适应力差的被淘汰。这是达尔文进化论的一个基本论点。
explanationTraditional: 指生物在生存競爭中適應力強的保存下來，適應力差的被淘汰。這是達爾文進化論的一個基本論點。
explanationEn: Survival of the fittest; in biological competition, the better adapted survive while the less adapted are eliminated. A basic tenet of Darwin's theory of evolution.
derivation: 清·吴趼人《痛史》第一回优胜劣败，取乱侮亡，自不必说。”
derivationTraditional: 清·吳趼人《痛史》第一回優勝劣敗，取亂侮亡，自不必說。”
derivationEn: From Qing·Wu Jianren's 'History of Pain': 'The superior win, the inferior lose; the strong take over the weak, needless to say.'
example: 在人类社会中，～的现象经常发生。
exampleTraditional: 在人類社會中，～的現象經常發生。
exampleEn: In human society, the phenomenon of survival of the fittest often occurs.

explanation: 渔人比喻第三者。比喻双方争执不下，两败俱伤，让第三者占了便宜。
explanationTraditional: 漁人比喻第三者。比喻雙方爭執不下，兩敗俱傷，讓第三者佔了便宜。
explanationEn: The fisherman's gain; a third party benefits from a dispute between two others, who both suffer losses.
derivation: 《战国策·燕策二》记载蚌张开壳晒太阳，鹬去啄它，嘴被蚌壳夹住，两方面都不相让。渔翁来了，把两个都捉住了。
derivationTraditional: 《戰國策·燕策二》記載蚌張開殼曬太陽，鷸去啄它，嘴被蚌殼夾住，兩方面都不相讓。漁翁來了，把兩個都捉住了。
derivationEn: From 'Strategies of the Warring States': A clam opened its shell to sun itself, a snipe pecked it, and the clam clamped shut; both refused to yield, and a fisherman caught them both.
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 馐滋味好的食物，馔饭食。珍贵而味道好的食物。亦作珍羞美味”。
explanationTraditional: 饈滋味好的食物，饌飯食。珍貴而味道好的食物。亦作珍羞美味”。
explanationEn: Rare and delicious food; delicacies.
derivation: 无
derivationTraditional: 無
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無

explanation: 关系最近的亲人。
explanationTraditional: 關係最近的親人。
explanationEn: One's closest relatives; flesh and blood.
derivation: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案惊奇》卷二除是至亲骨肉，缓和疼痛日在面前的，用意体察，才看得出来。”
derivationTraditional: 明·凌濛初《初刻拍案驚奇》卷二除是至親骨肉，緩和疼痛日在面前的，用意體察，才看得出來。”
derivationEn: From Ming·Ling Mengchu's 'Slapping the Table in Amazement': 'Except for the closest relatives who are always by one's side and observe carefully, it is hard to detect.'
example: 无
exampleTraditional: 無
